According to the book, cultivators could gain insight into several Sambodhas and cultivate multiple Dao Seeds. Although Dao Seeds could coexist in harmony, one should not blindly cultivate them. Otherwise, one would risk ruining one’s future.
“If the Sambodhas of the Dao Seeds are of the same lineage, it’s possible for them to coexist and even fuse into one. However, if they’re Dao Seeds of fire and water, I’ll have to gain insight into the Yin Yang Path and cultivate a Yin Yang Dao Seed. Otherwise, I’ll have to destroy either the fire or water Dao Seed since it could cause my cultivation to stagnate.”
Soon after, an idea appeared in Jiang Ming’s mind.
Sambodhas were divided into several categories. Some shared the same lineage, some complemented each other, and some could be fused.
“Interesting! The Grand Path is close at hand!”
Jiang Ming continued reading, thoroughly enjoying himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 27
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Master Dao Yan and An Attack
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
A Detailed Explanation of Human Cultivation Realms contained thorough explanations of Sambodhas.
According to the book, Sambodha was divided into multiple ranks.
The Detailed Explanations on Human Cultivation Realms contained thorough explanations on Sambodhas.
For example, Suppression, Abundant, and Boundless were categorized under Earth Sambodha. Drizzle, Rainstorm, Optimal Water, Frost, and Mist were derivatives of Water Sambodha. As for Wood Fire, Sun Flames, Earth Fire, and Desire Fire, they were categorized under Fire Sambodha.
Abundant was considered low-rank among the Earth Sambodhas; Earth Fire was considered low-rank among Fire Sambodhas.
Sambodhas were divided into rudimentary, intermediate, advanced, and ultimate ranks.
The Five Elements were the most fundamental powers of order that formed the world. The Sambodhas they formed were considered rudimentary. Most cultivators formed their Dao Seeds with rudimentary Sambodhas.
Needless to say, not all rudimentary Sambodhas were equal. For instance, Frost Sambodha and Drizzle Sambodha were both derivatives of Water Sambodha but Frost Sambodha was more powerful than Drizzle Sambodha.
As for intermediate Sambodhas, the most common ones were the Five Elements themselves.
Many advanced Sambodhas were fusions of the Five Elements. For example, Wood and Fire would produce Wind; Water and Fire would produce Thunder or Yin and Yang; Water, Fire, Wood, and Earth would produce Vitality; Water, Fire, Metal, and Earth would produce Death. They were not limited to these fusions; there were various types of fusions.
Light evolved from Fire while Water, Earth, and Metal would form Darkness.
When the Five Elements flowed in harmony, they would form the world; when they flowed in reverse, they would bring about destruction.
The derivatives of the Five Elements were considered rudimentary while the fusions were considered advanced.
There were also powerful Sambodhas apart from the Five Elements such as Destruction, Reincarnation, Karma, Time, Space, and others.
There were only two ultimate Sambodhas: Space and Time and Chaos.
Apart from that, there were other special Sambodhas as well such as Sword Sambodha, Saber Sambodha, Fist Sambodha, and many others. These could only be classified as rudimentary Sambodhas. However, they could be easily manipulated to fuse with other Sambodhas. Examples of the fusions were Drizzling Sword Sambody, Death Sword Sambodha, and Destructive Sword Sambodha.
“Technically, they’re categorized under the Five Elements and non-Five Elements.”
Thoughts continued to race in Jiang Ming’s mind.
In fact, Destruction, Reincarnation, and Karma were part of the Five Elements. The flow of the Five Elements gave rise to the powers of Destruction, Reincarnation, and Karma.
When Jiang Ming flipped to the next page, his eyes instantly lit up. His attention was caught by a few specific sentences: ‘At its roots, there’s only one ultimate Sambodha, which is the legendary Chaos. However, since the dawn of time, no one has ever mastered it in the human world. This Sambodha only exists in theory. Even the Space and Time Sambodha isn’t included in the records. Chaos formed the words, giving rise to time, space, Yin and Yang, and the Five Elements. When the Five Elements flowed, all creations were formed’.
Jiang Ming felt something in him stir. Was the book delving into the nature of the world? He shook his head as he thought to himself, ‘This can’t be. After all, it’s called A Detailed Explanation of Human Cultivation Realms.’
As expected, he saw a footnote at the end of the page: ‘This conclusion is made after poring over millions of cultivation tomes in the human world. I’m not responsible for any inaccuracies or mistakes. *cough* I’ve gained insight into the Wind and Thunder Sambodhas, and in the end, I selected the Thunder Sambodha to form my Nascent Soul’.
‘The f*ck?!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed. Then, he hurriedly flipped to the end of the book. As expected, he saw a description: ‘This book was written by Master Dao Yan before he attained immortality. You should trust this writing, but not completely. You’ll have to depend on your ingenuity to discern the truth. Good luck on finding your Grand Path!’
“I thought this book contains the knowledge from the system so I read every page seriously, sorting out the information and mulling over it. In the end, it’s written by some person who merely gained insight into the Wind Sambodha and the Thunder Sambodha! Moreover, he even gave up on one of them!” Jiang Ming was overwhelmed with the urge to lose his temple.
He stood up and paced around his room as he muttered under his breath, “I viewed you as the truth, and now, I find out it’s just someone’s personal views! I have to depend on my ingenuity? Good luck?! If you’re standing in front of me, I’d tear you into pieces.”
After a moment, Jiang Ming took a deep breath to calm down before he stopped pacing. He sat down again and continued reading. This time, he took everything he read with a pinch of salt.
…
The days went by.
Jiang Ming’s life was as peaceful as ever.
After completing his chores, he spent time gaining insights into various Sambodhas.
In the afternoon, he took a short break from cultivating. He drank a cup of tea before he routinely opened the Human Path Records to check on Yue Cheng. He would check on Yue Cheng’s information once a day.
Name: Yue Cheng
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm.
Background: First Seat of Zhiyang Peak (Note: He’s an Elder of Yinmo Sect)
Innate Talent: Eight stars
Relationship: -48
Status: Secretly investigated Zuo Han’s death, but yielded no results. After analyzing the experts of the sect, he concluded that the culprit is an outsider. He was delighted when Zi Linglong cleared the Tower of Trials and is determined to recruit her so she could be the Holy Daughter of Yinmo Sect. He plans to wait for three months for things to settle down before making a move. Once everyone lets their guards down, he plans to send Zhou Yizhao, an Elder of Zhiyang Peak, to Chuyang Peak to set up a Formation. When Zi Linlong returns to Chuyang Peak, the Formation will be activated, isolating Chuyang Peak from the world. At that time, he plans to abduct Zi Linglong and bring her away from the sect to nurture her.
‘This old geezer really didn’t learn from his lesson. I must look for a chance to deal with him,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself indignantly.
It seemed like his days on the mountain were too carefree, and it was time for him to shake up the balance slightly.
Following that, Jiang Ming flipped to a blank page and mentally wrote down Zou Yizhao’s name.
Name: Zou Yizhao
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Purple Mansion Realm.
Background: Elder of Jiuyang Sect’s Zhiyang Peak (Note: He’s actually an Elder of Yinmo Sect)
Innate Talent: Six stars.
Relationship: -12
Status: He’s been ordered by the First Seat of Zhiyang Peak to head to Chuyang Peak tonight to set up a Formation.
A relationship value of -12 meant that the other person disliked him.
‘As a Yinmo Sect elder, your fate is sealed,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself with a hint of contempt, ‘Yue Cheng, you’re taking me too lightly by sending a lone Purple Mansion cultivator here…’
Following that, Jiang Ming looked at his Junior Sister’s information and discovered she was already at the 3rd Extreme of the Golden Core Realm.
“Amazing!” Jiang Ming exclaimed in shock.
After Jiang Ming was done looking through the Human Path Records, he leaped in the air and looked at the back of the mountain.
The lands had been plowed. When he had run out of soil previously, he had brought some back from the foot of the mountain. After obtaining Gu Hai’s permission, he had also demolished the buildings on the other side before plowing the land and planting some seeds and herbs. Most of them were ordinary herbs.
“When it’s time for the harvest…” Jiang Ming’s expression was one of anticipation and delight as he thought about the harvest.
…
As night began its descent, Jiang Ming waited with an anticipatory expression on his face.
“He’s here!”
When the stars and moon finally made their appearance, he sensed a concealed aura approaching from a distance. If he did not cultivate his special cultivation method, he would not have been able to sense the person.
The person he sensed was none other than Zou Yizhao. He could tell Zou Yizhao was not traveling through air. Instead, Zou Yizhao was currently making his way through the woods.
…
At the same time.
Zou Yizhao finally arrived at the foot of the mountain. He surveyed his surroundings and was surprised to discover the inactive protective Formation. This caused a smile to bloom on his face.
“That old fart Gu Hai isn’t around. Apart from that useless Jiang Ming, there’s no one on the mountain. Heh, this is too easy!” Zou Yizhao muttered to himself, “I should set up the Formation near their residence to ensure success…”
Zou Yizhao was about to climb up the mountain when he discovered the ripples in his surroundings. A Grand Formation suddenly shrouded in just a blink of an eye.
“No!” Zou Yizhao exclaimed in shock as he hastily brought out a top-grade item to defend himself.
In the next moment, he saw a figure appear in front of him before reaching for his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 28
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: A Killing and a Breakthrough
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Apart from completing his daily chores and comprehending the Sambodhas, Jiang Ming also spent time studying Formations. He thought Formations were important. He had planted several mid-rank and low-rank weapons around Chuyang Peak to be used as Formation cores in case of a need. As it turned out, they came in handy today.
After Zou Yizhao triggered a Formation that isolated him from the world, Jiang Ming used his Great Akasa Step and traveled using the Akasa Network. As soon as he appeared before Zou Yizhao, he raised his hand and unleashed a wave of energy. The space around him seemed to still at once as he struck the defensive bell Zou Yizhao had brought out.
Crack!
The bell shattered immediately. The fragments fell on the head of the flustered Zou Yizhao.
‘It’s over!’ Zou Yizhao thought in despair. After all, someone who was capable of shattering his top-grade defensive bell with just a strike definitely possessed strength beyond his imagination. He had no hope of fighting against this person. Moreover, the space around him had stilled, rendering him immobile.
In the next moment, Zou Yizhao felt a hand landing on the crown of his head. A terrifying torrent of mana surged from the point of contact and neutralized the various powers in his body before shackling his Purple Mansion. Just like that, his cultivation base had been sealed.
‘Purple Mansion cultivators are… too weak,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself as he grabbed Zou Yizhao’s neck and dragged Zou Yizhao up the mountain.
After Jiang Ming came to the courtyard, he tossed Zou Yizhao to the ground.
“J-jiang Ming?!” Zou Yizhao exclaimed in shock and disbelief when he saw his assailant. Colors drained from his face immediately. He continued, “Impossible! How can you be so powerful? Y-you’re just a Qi Cultivation cultivator!”
“Shut up! I’ll be asking the questions, not you!” Jiang Ming said frostily, “Is the Yinmo Sect planning to take over Jiuyang Sect?”
“H-how do you know that?” Zou Yizhao stopped breathing for a moment when he heard this question. He shuddered as realization dawned on him. He cried out, “You killed Zuo Han!”
“That’s right. Now, talk!”
At this time, Zou Yizhao chuckled and said, “This won’t change anything. Jiuyang Sect is destined to be reduced to ashes! You won’t get any answers from me, kid!”
Jiang Ming’s expression grew frostier.
Zou Yizhao scoffed and turned his head to the side.
Crack!
Jiang Ming smacked his hand on Zuo Yizhao’s left leg, and a crisp cracking noise rang in the air instantly.
Zou Yizhao’s bones and muscles were destroyed, but he only grunted without any change in his expression. “There’s no need to waste your energy. With my cultivation base, physical pain won’t shake my will at all. Your best option is to hand me over to the Sect Master.”
“No, how am I supposed to explain the circumstances of your capture if I hand you over to the Sect Master? Moreover, I have no evidence to prove that you’re from Yinmo Sect…” Jiang Ming said as he looked at Zou Yizhao with a frown. Then, he pressed his hand down, destroying Zou Yizhao’s sea of consciousness and his Purple Mansion, effectively destroying Zou Yizhao’s cultivation base.
“It should be easier to interrogate you without your cultivation base.”
Jiang Ming was considering his next step when he saw Zou Yizhao suddenly jolt. Following that, blood trickled out of Zou Yizhao’s seven orifices before his eyes rolled back into his head, and he stopped breathing.
Jiang Ming was speechless when he saw this. “I should’ve been more careful! Forget it! It’s enough that I know the Yinmo Sect is up to no good.”
‘Yue Cheng hasn’t made any big movements. This shows that the Yinmo Sect isn’t so powerful to the point where they’re invincible. Moreover, if Yinmo Sect dares to try anything in the Eastern Region, the first to act would be the Qingyun Sect…’
Jiang Ming flicked his wrist.
Zou Yizhao’s corpse levitated. When Jiang Ming clenched his hand, his corpse was instantly reduced to a bloody pulp. Then, Jiang Ming spat fire from his mouth, reducing his remains to ashes.
After getting rid of the evidence, Jiang Ming claimed the storage ring and the low-grade Artifact sword that Zou Yizhao left behind.
With just a leap, he returned to the rooftop.
In truth, he was not bothered by Zou Yizhao at all. He treated this as a fun activity. After all, he was confident he would be able to kill Yue Cheng with a single strike.
Jiang Ming sensed his body. The liquid mana in his Purple Mansion was already full. This meant he could attempt to break through now. However, he was not in a hurry and decided to give himself another two days to prepare.
…
Zhiyang Peak.
“What’s taking him so long?”
Yue Cheng sat cross-legged on his seat in the great hall. He seemed like he was cultivating, but he was actually waiting for Zou Yizhao’s return. At the same time, he was also keeping an eye out for elders who might be heading to Chuyang Peak. He needed to be very cautious.
After waiting until daybreak, Zou Yizhao still had not returned.
“What’s the meaning of this?” Yue Cheng wore a sour expression on his face. At the same time, he began to feel uneasy as well.
First, Zuo Han was killed. Now, it seemed like Zuo Yizhao had vanished into thin air.
Since he had been monitoring the situation, he was sure there was no fight around Chuyang Peak. He did not sense any powerful aura. Nevertheless, he was rather sure that Zuo Yizhao would not be coming back. He wondered who was strong enough to get rid of Zou Yizhao without causing any commotion at all.
“What’s the meaning of this? Is the culprit the same person who killed Junior Brother Zuo Han?” Yue Cheng suddenly had the urge to flee. However, in the end, his rational thoughts won, and he remained seated.
Zuo Han went to Chuyang Peak previously to kill the two disciples on Chuyang Peak to push the blame to Lieyang Peak, but he died.
Zou Yizhao went to Chuyang Peak to set up a trap for Zi Linglong, and he had gone missing, most likely dead as well.
Both of them died without too much of a commotion as though the culprit did not want anyone to find out.
“Chuyang Peak must be hiding a huge secret…” Yue Cheng muttered to himself as a biting cold rose in his heart.
Various expressions flitted across Yue Cheng’s face as he thought to himself, ‘I’m no longer safe here. I should urge them to make a move within five years. Otherwise, I’ll f*cking quit!’
In any case, Yue Cheng decided that he would not act against Chuyang Peak anymore. He had already made two unsuccessful attempts, anything beyond that was too much. If he persisted, the culprit would definitely look for him.
“F*ck! How can I be unaware of someone like that in the sect?” Yue Cheng cursed. He felt as though he was going to go crazy, and it took some effort for him to calm down.
In any case, he was fine with the culprit wanting to keep a low profile.
…
Two days later.
Jiang Ming activated the Formation before he sat cross-legged outside his bedroom. He was going to attempt to break through tonight.
He had spent very little time in his current realm. His feat was unprecedented considering his Purple Mansion was almost completely filled due to the mana he accumulated as soon as he broke through.
His accumulations over the past few months helped propelled his current state to a certain extreme. Since he was already at the limit, the only thing left to do was to break through. There was no point hesitating.
“I’ll be entering the Dao Seed Realm from the Purple Mansion Realm. The key is to understand nature, its wonders and workings, and gain insight into the Sambodha of all creations. Following that, I’ll have to turn my Sambodha into a Dao Seed.”
While Jiang Ming was mulling over this matter, he held the Enlightening Stone in his hand.
Over the past few days, he had used up the Enlightening Tea Leaves and four Enlightening Stones to cultivate. The stones were more than 100 times more effective compared to the tea leaves. When he first used the stone, he instantly entered a meditative state. He had been surprised when he gained insight into nine Sambodhas in an hour.
Now that he was attempting a breakthrough, he decided to use his final Enlightening Stone.
“I’ve gained insight on 81 Sambodhas. Do I pick one to cultivate or do I cultivate all of them?” Jiang Ming was in a dilemma.
It would be easy if he chose to cultivate one Sambodha into a Dao Seed. Needless to say, if he had to separately cultivate all the other Sambodhas into Dao Seeds, it would take him a long time.
During the breakthrough, with the support from heaven and earth, he could try to cultivate all his Sambodhas into Dao Seeds at once. However, if he failed, he risked destroying his cultivation path.
‘The path of cultivation is fraught with dangers anyway. You can reach the heavens, but every step that leads you there comes with danger. Cultivation, by nature, goes against the will of the heavens. If one wishes to become an immortal, one must overcome trials and tribulations. This obstacle in front of me is nothing in the grand scheme of things. I shouldn’t hesitate too much over this minor risk,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself decisively.
With that, Jiang Ming steeled his resolve.

chapters.title: Chapter 29
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Two Years and Ninth Extreme with Ten Stars
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming held the Enlightening Stone in his hand as he cultivated with the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra.
Liquid mana churned in his Purple Mansion, forming vortexes. Each vortex contained a character. As the mana churned, the flowing Sambodha fused without forming small seeds, which were Dao Seeds.
As soon as the Dao Seeds formed, Jiang Ming was considered to have entered the Dao Seed Realm.
At this moment, the Dao Seeds emitted a strange energy that swiftly melted into his Purple Mansion, further expanding it. This was the second chance for the expansion of the Purple Mansion. If one managed to form a powerful seed, the Purple Mansion would expand even more.
Dao Seeds continued to appear as the liquid mana in Jiang Ming’s Purple Mansion was rapidly decreasing. At the same time, his Purple Mansion was expanding at a shocking speed.
According to A Detailed Explanation of the Human Cultivation Realms, when Dao Seeds were forming and the sea of consciousness was expanding, forming Dao Seeds from rudimentary, intermediate, and advanced Sambodhas would expand the Purple Mansion by half its size, twice its size, and at least ten times its size respectively. There was no mention of ultimate Sambodhas.
The formation of every Dao Seed was an extension of the seed before it. The more Dao Seeds one had, the larger one’s Purple Mansion would be. This was an alluring but dangerous temptation. After all, one would risk one’s life doing so.
Master Dao Yan, the author of A Detailed Explanation of the Human Cultivation Realms, had to give up on one of his Sambodhas and give up on further expanding his Purple Mansion to reach the Primal Spirit Realm. If he was not protected by his Nature Fluid, his Purple Mansion would have crumbled, and he would have suffered irreversible damage himself.
‘A person can obtain mana and extend his life through cultivation, but it’s not without risks and dangers. The path of cultivation leads to heaven, but every step was fraught with danger.’
This saying was not exaggerated at all. The Dao Seed Realm was a fine example of it. Forming multiple Dao Seeds could expand the Purple Mansion greatly and would bring about an explosive increase in strength and combat powers, but if the Dao Seeds could not be fused, it was no different having one’s future ruined. As for the Dao Seeds, 99.5% of them would be rendered useless while the remaining 0.5% would stagnate and would never improve.
Since Jiang Ming had?made up his mind, he no longer hesitated. His Purple Mansion expanded rapidly and outrageously. Compared to the first expansion when he was in the Golden Core Realm, the current expansion felt easier. As his Dao Seeds increased in numbers, various characters fused with his Purple Mansion, fortifying it. Eventually, he formed 81 Dao Seeds and completed the breakthrough.
Accordingly, his Purple Mansion stopped expanding. At this time, he barely had any liquid mana left, and what was left turned to mist in the vast space. 81 Dao Seeds hovered in the air, emitting their respective characters.
“My Purple Mansion is now 640 square kilometers wide!” Jiang Ming was stunned. Before this, it only had a radius of 10,000 meters. The expansion was truly outrageous.
“I wonder if anyone could form 81 Dao Seeds? Even if they could, would they dare to attempt such a feat?”
Although Jiang Ming felt pleased, he was feeling uneasy as well. If he could not fuse the Dao Seeds, everything would have been for naught.
…
Jiang Ming continued living peaceful and carefree days on the mountain. He repeated the routines of his simple life. Occasionally, the system would give him some special rewards such as basic almanacs, combat strategies, spiritual crystals, medicinal pills, Enlightening Tea Leaves, and Enlightening Stones. Mostly, he would be rewarded with cultivation.
Apart from that, he had also begun to use spiritual crystals when he was cultivating. Since his sea of consciousness was too vast, who knew how long it would take to fill it? Using spiritual crystals would help him with filling his sea of consciousness even if the effect was not as exaggerated as the years of cultivation that the system rewarded him with.
Jiang Ming did not neglect to master the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi and the Great Akasa Steps as well. He even used these two Special Abilities to slowly gain insight into various derivatives of spatial abilities such as the Spatial Wave Sambodha, Spatial Cut Sambodha, and Spatial Movement Sambodha.
When he gained insight into the Boundless Sea Sambodha, he felt as though he had been slightly enlightened. He could now fuse Dao Seeds with water elements.
There were 64 Dao Seeds with the water element. Among them were the Drizzle Dao Seed, Light Rain Dao Seed, Rainstorm Dao Seed, Sudden Rain Dao Seed, Droplet Dao Seed, Misty Rain Dao Seed, Extreme Cold Dao Seed, Ice Blade Dao Seed, Snowflake Dao Seed, Fog Dao Seed, Boundless Sea Dao Seed, Optimal Water Dao Seed, and Wave Dao Seed.
Jiang Ming tried to fuse them using the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra and managed to do so without much trouble. After the fusion, he managed to form the Water Dao Seed.
“I did it!” Jiang Ming exclaimed in delight. He wondered if it would be so easy fusing the other Dao Seeds as well. Perhaps, fusing all the cultivation methods under the heavens was not so impossible, after all.
“Fusing all the cultivation methods will leave me with one Grand Path…” Jiang Ming felt like his understanding of the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra had deepened as well.
…
The next few days passed by uneventfully.
Zi Linglong would return to visit him every now and then. Each time she visited, Jiang Ming could see the huge changes in her.
Similar to before, he would also flip through the Human Path Records daily, especially to check in on Yue Cheng in case he tried something funny.
…
During a certain rainy morning.
Jiang Ming stood on the rooftop, resting his hands on the railings. The rain that fell parted to the sides, unable to touch him.
He looked into the distance through the misty rain. The mountains were majestic, and the scenery was beautiful.
When he looked to the side, he saw the paddy stalks were bent low while the wheat stalks swayed with the wind.
The entire mountain had been converted into farmland, including the land where the abandoned buildings used to stand. All in all, he now had 100 Mu of farmland.
When the rain stopped and the sky cleared, it would be time for him to harvest his crops. The spiritual herbs he planted had matured as well.
Jiang Ming muttered to himself, “In ten days, it would be three years since I gained the system. Time sure flies!”
Cultivators rarely counted the years. Even decades were just a short time to them.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records out of habit and flipped to Zi Linglong’s page. This had become part of his daily routine.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Female.
Cultivation base: 9th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm
Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 95
Innate Talent: Ten stars (primary phoenix bloodline)
Status: Cultivating in Taiyang Peak’s Sun Pit. She just cultivated the ninth Dao motif on her Golden Core. She broke the shackles she was born with and raised her Innate Talents to ten stars.
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up. He could not help but exclaim, “She was at the 8th Extreme yesterday, but she’s already at the 9th Extreme today! As expected of my junior sister! She’s really amazing. She’s the indisputable main character of this story!”
Their relationship value was as stable as ever. Although they did not meet often, their relationship value did not decrease. As expected, he could really depend on her in this regard. It was one of the reasons she was the apple of his eyes.
“The quality of her 9th Extreme Golden Core improved as well? Her constitution is now the primary phoenix bloodline! An Innate Talent of ten stars is considered the top among humans. However, as my Junior Sister, she can’t stop here in the human world. At the very least, I expect her to reach the ranks of the immortals!”
Jiang Ming was in a wonderful mood. His mood improved further as he thought to himself, “She should be done with her cultivation for now since she’s reached the 9th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm.”
He placed his hands on his back as the rain continued to fall and the clouds sailed in the sky. Soon enough, his information appeared before his eyes. His eyes lit up as his confidence grew and his mood lifted further.
“I’m now strong enough to protect Chuyang Peak!”

chapters.title: Chapter 30
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: The Sacred Land and the Empress
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm.
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Spell: Ten Thousand Sword Technique, basic Formations, basic Talismans, and others
Special ability: Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures
Innate Talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Item: Human Path Records, three Shadowless Needles (high-grade Artifact), Noble Robe (low-grade Artifact), Flowing Cloud Sword (top-grade weapon)
Although it did not seem like Jiang Ming had experienced many changes, in truth, his change was dramatic.
His cultivation base was now at the Dao Seed Realm, and his sea of consciousness was close to a radius of 3,000 kilometers. It was both terrifying and incredible at the same time. A Dao Seed sea of consciousness of this size was unprecedented. He had many Dao Seeds in his sea of consciousness as well such as the fused Water, Wood, and Earth Dao Seeds. He had yet to fuse the Fire Metal and Metal Dao Seeds.
There were also the Wind, Thunder, Light, Shadow, Darkness, Death, and Spatial Wave Dao Seeds. He could have fused the Wood and Fire Sambodhas to produce the Wind Sambodha, but he directly gained insights into it by contemplating the Wind character in the world. It was the same for the Thunder Dao Seed.
Some Dao Seeds were in their primary states when he formed them while some were already completed. They each varied.
Jiang Ming was still some ways from forming the Dao Seeds of the Five Elements, Yin Yang, Karma, and the Sambodhas of Destruction, Reincarnation, Fabrication, Space, Time, and Space and Time.
If he gained enlightenment of all of them, his combat strength would increase explosively by several magnitudes. He wondered how vast his sea of consciousness would be at that time.
Unfortunately, he was out of Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones. Although he had gained some from the system, he had quickly used them up.
There were no major changes to his spells, but he was becoming more well-rounded with the spells he had mastered.
When Jiang Ming was tired from cultivating, he spend time studying pills, drawing talismans, experimenting with Formations, and forging Artifacts to spice up his otherwise monotonous life.
He gained a new special ability, the Nine Divine Mountain Treasures. He had yet to gain?much of an understanding of it and only learned that it held endless power. The Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi was peerless in offensive strength and stealth, but the Nine Divine Mountain Treasures had terrifying suppressive effects and destructive power. They both had their own advantages. Unfortunately, this was the only special ability he gained after two years; he gained while he was harvesting his crops.
“What’s my current combat strength like?” Jiang Ming wondered out loud.
He had far surpassed his master a long time ago. Even Yue Cheng, a First Seat, did not pose a threat to him. A few months ago, he had observed the Sect Master from afar and found that he did not have any reason to fear the Sect Master as well.
“I don’t think I’ve fought a decent battle since I started cultivating…” Jiang Ming shook his head.?The rare instances where he had made a move was a one-sided battle. He had easily crushed his opponents, hence, he did not find it enjoyable or stimulating.
Jiang Ming sat on the recliner and continued looking at the falling rain. It would be perfect if his close friends were with him now to enjoy the scenery.
After a while, Jiang Ming began to contemplate his next step.
In less than ten days, it would be 3 years since he obtained the system. He was certain he would be greatly rewarded at that time since he was not rewarded during the second anniversary. He had figured out the pattern of the timing. He would be rewarded for farming on the?mountain every seven days, a fortnight, a month, three months, six months, a year, and three years. Perhaps, the next rewards would be five years and ten years from now. Although he was not completely certain, he thought it was likely so.
He would also be hugely rewarded for the 100 Mu of crops that were about to be harvested.
“I hope I’ll get more Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones. Otherwise, I’ll have to pay a steep price for my ambition!” The steep price he referred to was time.
Jiang Ming was about to cultivate again when he saw a streak of light flying toward him before landing on the greeting platform. It was Zhang Junbao.
“Senior Brother Zhang, are you for more booze?” Jiang Ming rose to his feet and greeted Zhang Junbao with a smile. He lifted his hand and tossed a bottle of wine over. He had personally brewed this bottle of wine.
Zhang Junbao caught the bottle and eagerly opened it. He took a large swig from the bottle before he wiped his lips. He was filled with praise as he said, “Your wine is the best! Not bad, First Disciple Jiang. You’re already at the Foundation Establishment Realm! You can be considered a genius in the sect.”
With just a leap, Zhang Junbao landed on the rooftop.
Jiang Ming said modestly, “And yet, I’m still far behind you.”
Jiang Ming chose to disguise his cultivation base at the Foundation Establishment Realm. With this, he was not considered a peerless genius, but he was still better than most disciples.
“You’re almost there. After another decade or two, you’ll definitely become a Proud Son of the sect,” Zhang Junbao said. Then, his expression turned grim as he continued to say, “Anyway, I came here for another matter as well. A Qingyun Sect elder brought ten disciples here to challenge the Tower of Trials. One of them managed to clear the tower. He’s incredibly powerful. As for the other nine, they made it to the eighth floor at least!”
“Amazing!” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“They’re more than amazing,” Zhang Junbao said, “Qingyun Sect is the Sacred Land of the Eastern Region, after all. Our sect can’t compare to them. Anyway, one of Qingyun Sect’s disciples suggested a friendly match between the sects. The Sect Master has said that every peak will have to participate in the match. I came here to tell you about this. We can’t disobey the Sect Master. Come on.”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming did not hesitate at all.
With that, the duo flew away on their swords immediately.
As they flew, Jiang Ming asked, “Senior Brother Zhang, why did the mighty Qingyun Sect visit us?”
“They’re not here to make friends for sure,” Zhang Junbao said. Then, after hesitating for a moment, he added, “The Elder mentioned Junior Sister Linglong’s name several times. Even the core disciples he brought with him mentioned her as well…”
“Does it have anything to do with her phoenix bloodline?” Jiang Ming asked with a frown, “Are they trying to recruit Linglong?”
“I’m not sure,” Zhang Junbao said as he shook his head and smiled wryly, “Although they said it’s a friendly match, they only want to use it as a chance to flaunt their strength. It’s too bad that we’re weak so we can only acquiesce and play along.”
Jiang Ming felt rather helpless as well.
The Qingyun Sect was the undisputed overlord of the Eastern Region. In comparison, Jiuyang Sect was like a child.
It did not take long before the duo arrived at Taiyang Peak’s main plaza. Many disciples were already gathered at this time, and many were on their way over as well.
As soon as the duo landed, they saw Lieyang Peak’s Huoyun reeling as he spat out blood.
…
In the Sun Pit, a restricted area.
Zi Linglong’s cultivation base had already stabilized after she reached the 9th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm.
At this time, she leaped out of the pit.
“Did you achieve another breakthrough?” Gu Hai asked. He suddenly found it hard to breathe from the pressure his little disciple radiated. While he felt proud for having such a talented disciple, he felt slightly ashamed of himself.
“Yes!” Linglong said excitedly, “I’m ready to return to Chuyang Peak. Let’s cultivate there from now on!”
Gu Hai laughed. “Alright! If you continue cultivating here, you’ll only bring heartache to the Sect Master!”
Gu Hai was filled with delight whenever he recalled how the Sect Master’s face would twitch whenever he saw the liquid in the Sun Pit rapidly depleting after he failed to convince Linglong to become his disciple.
Suddenly, Zi Linglong turned to look at the main hall in Taiyang Peak. “Hm? I sense Senior Brother’s aura. What’s he doing here?”
Gu Hai briefly recounted what had happened.
“What? The Qingyun Sect disciples proposed a friendly match with disciples from all the peaks? Senior Brother would be beaten up for sure!” Linglong exclaimed. Then, she leaped toward the main hall as she said through gritted teeth, “I’ll destroy anyone who dares to harm Senior Brother!”

chapters.title: Chapter 31
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Is That All You’ve Got?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On the plaza before Taiyang Peak’s main hall.
After Huo Yun was tragically defeated, Zhang Junbao, who had just arrived, was challenged and subsequently defeated as well.
The eight first disciples of Jiuyang Sect’s nine Peaks were all defeated.
“They’re trying to thoroughly humiliate us!” Chang Yiming said with a dark expression on his face as he supported Zhang Junbao who sported a bloody lip.
Jiang Ming could see this clearly as well.
There were ten Qingyun Sect disciples present at this moment. Some of them stood with their arms crossed while some stood lazily. Despite their varying postures, all of them lifted their chins slightly, knowingly or unknowingly portraying their superiority.
One of the Qingyun Sect disciples, who was dressed in a black robe with golden embroidery, was surrounded by the others. He had an insolent, domineering, and arrogant air about him.
Many of those from Jiuyang Sect found the black-clad Qingyun Sect disciple’s arrogant gaze rather annoying.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming flipped open the Human Path Records.
Name: Mu Lei
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Fourth Extreme of the Golden Core Realm
Background: Core disciple of Qingyun Sect
Relationship: -45.
Innate Talent: Eight stars (primary flood dragon bloodline)
Status: After hearing about a female disciple of Jiuyang Sect with the phoenix bloodline, he suggested to the Elder to bring him here so he can ask for her hand in marriage. He would entice her with benefits, and if that fails, he would use force. Once he succeeds, he plans to use
Heard that there was a female disciple with the phoenix bloodline in the Jiuyang Sect. Hence, he invited the Elder on this trip where he would ask for her hand in marriage. He would entice her with benefits and pressure her with force. Once he succeeds, he plans to use the furnace method to harvest the power from the phoenix bloodline. The dragon and the phoenix were a pair. He intends to use the phoenix bloodline to boost his flood dragon bloodline. When his dragon rises to the ninth heaven, he’ll be a candidate of the Holy Son.
Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed and flashed coldly upon reading Mu Lei’s status. ‘Trying to lay your filthy hands on my junior sister? Keep dreaming!’
Jiang Ming fought back the violent urges surging in his body as he carefully studied Mu Lei’s information.
Mu Lei had an Innate Talent of eight stars, the primary flood dragon bloodline, and was at the 4th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm. With these, he was considered a peerless expert, a Proud Son of the generation, and a cultivator with exceptionally high talent. As expected of a core disciple of Qingyun Sect.
Jiang Ming was not surprised by the -45 relationship value. After all, Mu Lei was trying to get Linglong. It was only natural that Mu Lei had heard about Linglong’s senior brother.
At this moment, Mu Lei said to a young man next to him, “Zhang Yu, you’re the youngest among us. You’re not even 30, and you’re the weakest among us since you’re only at the Real Core Realm. You’ll spar against Chuyang Peak’s first disciple. After that, we’ll end this friendly match. Remember to show restraint and not hurt disciples from another sect.”
“Yes, Senior Brother!” Zhang Yu replied respectfully. He stepped forward and looked at the disciples of Jiuyang Sect contemptuously before he asked, “Who’s the first disciple of Chuyang Peak? Step forward now.”
Jiang Ming frowned. His impression of Mu Lei grew worse.
‘F*ck him!’
Mu Lei naturally knew how ‘weak’ Jiang Ming was, but he shamelessly asked his fellow disciple to challenge him. Moreover, he told his fellow disciple to show restraint and not hurt him. Mu Lei was clearly trying to further humiliate Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming took a step forward before he was held back by Chang Yiming.
Chang Yiming said, “I’ll fight in your place.”
At the same time, Zi Linglong appeared in the sky. Before her feet even touched the ground, her melodious voice, which sounded like the clattering of pearls on a jade tray, rang in the air. “Which unknown person challenged my senior brother?”
Then, she landed in front of Jiang Ming before she dove into his arms. “Senior Brother, I missed you so much!”
Chang Yi Ming raised an eyebrow before he tactfully moved to the side with a small smile on his face.
At the same time, Zhang Junbao sighed with relief.
Mu Lei, who was standing in the distance, narrowed his eyes immediately.
Jiang Ming ruffled Linglong’s hair before he pulled away, “Show some propriety, Linglong.” Then, he asked, “Are you done cultivating in seclusion?”
“Yes, I just came out. I was about to return to Chuyang Peak when I sensed your aura here. That’s why I rushed here!” Zi Linglong explained, “Senior Brother, these shady people don’t have the right to challenge you. Sit back and watch the fight from the side. Leave the rest to me!”
“Be careful,” Jiang Ming cautioned.
“He’s just a weakling!” Zi Linglong said dismissively. Then, she looked at Zhang Yu and asked, “Are you the one who challenged my senior brother?”
“Yes,” Zhang Yu’s depression darkened as he said, “You’re the first person to call Qingyun Sect disciples shady and unknown.”
“Are you famous?” Zi Linglong asked coldly, “Are you the Holy Son of Qingyun Sect?”
“No.”
“Are you a core disciple?”
“No.”
“Then, are you a first disciple?”
“I’m not,” Zhang Yu said through gritted teeth.
“So what did I say that’s wrong?” Zi Linglong scoffed. “You’re not a Holy Son, a core disciple, or even a first disciple. That means you’re a nobody. My senior brother is a first disciple. You’re insulting my senior brother by challenging him!”
“Impudent!” Zhang Yu was furious. “You should feel honored that Qingyun Sect disciples even deigned to challenge Jiuyang Sect disciple. You’re just a brat with a sharp tongue who knows nothing!”
Zi Linglong sneered. “Based on your words, as long as they’re from Qingyun Sect, it doesn’t matter if they’re just a cleaner, they’d have the right to order people around, is that it? Do you think the Qingyun Sect is the king of the Eastern Region? Are we supposed to worship everyone from the Qingyun Sect? Just because I’m dismissive of you, you say I know nothing?”
Zhang Yu was furious, but he did not dare to act recklessly. Although Qingyun Sect was strong, it could not openly bully other sects. At this moment, his ears suddenly twitched, Mu Lei had sent him a voice transmission. Following that, he hurriedly said, “Stop talking nonsense! We’re here to have a friendly match today. Our core disciple, Mu Lei, hasn’t even stepped forward yet, but eight of your nine first disciples have already been defeated. We haven’t fought anyone from Chuyang Peak yet. Are you going to fight or is that what’s-his-name going to fight?”
Zi Linglong’s eyes flashed coldly. “I won’t allow my senior brother to fight an idiot. I’ll fight you!”
Zi Linglong stepped forward and released her aura. The void around her rippled as her sleeves fluttered in the air.
“Alright!” Zhang Yu said grimly. His mana surged before forming a divine barrier around him.
With just a move, Zi Linglong seemed to have vanished into thin air. She moved at blinding speed and was instantly upon Zhang Yu. She raised her hand to strike without wasting time.
“No!” Zhang Yu’s eyes widened as his heart jolted. She was too fast for him. He hastily retreated and activated his Artifact at the same time. Alas, it was too late.
Bam!
Zi Linglong’s hand landed on Zhang Yu’s chest, causing him to reel back and spit out blood.
“Is that all you’ve got? You don’t even deserve to be called an idiot!” Zi Linglong flicked her sleeves and placed her hands on her back, naturally exuding a majestic and domineering aura. However, just as quickly as it had appeared, it disappeared. Then, she turned to Mu Lei and the others before she said, “Come at me all at once. Show me the strength of the supposedly powerful Qingyun Sect disciples. Let’s see if you’re a group of heavenly kings or experts as rumored or if you’re just riding on the name of your sect to bully others.”
The members of Jiuyang Sect were smiling at this moment. Some of them were even cheering.
“Good job, Linglong!” Chang Yiming gave her a thumbs-up.
“You’re doing great!” Zhang Junbao added.
“You’ve really grown up,” Jiang Ming said with a smile. He noticed that Zhang Yu was only injured and did not die. With this, there would not be any issue.
On the contrary, the expressions of Mu Lei and the others darkened immediately. All of them were furious. Some of them even stepped forward but were held back by Mu Lei. Subsequently, he walked toward Zi Linglong and forced a smile on his face before he said, “I, Mu Lei, a core disciple of Qingyun Sect, has cleared the Tower of Trials today. You must be Junior Sister Zi Linglong. Your reputation precedes you. I’m honored to meet you today.”
“I’m not your junior sister,” Zi Linglong said as she raised a slender eyebrow. Her expression grew frostier as she said, “Are you going to fight or not? I’m tired of talking.”
The flames of fury in Mu Lei’s heart had been extinguished at this moment. Instead, he was appraising Linglong and was filled with the desire to conquer. “After I reached the Golden Core Realm, I once held my own against a Purple Mansion Elder from the sect. I’ve also defeated several Purple Mansion cultivators from other sects. Apart from that, I’ve also killed three Purple Mansion demons.”
“Is that all? Don’t you feel ashamed for bragging about something like that?” Zi Linglong said scornfully, “You should all fight me at once.”
Mu Lei felt his breath caught in his throat for a moment as his face turned red.

chapters.title: Chapter 32
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Shocking Killing Intent and the Grinding of Bones
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Inside the great hall.
Sect Master Yan Yan was keeping the Qingyun Sect elder, Ge Changqing, company. They chatted idly over tea.
Ge Changqing looked outside the great hall and asked with a smile, “What do you think of our current batch of disciples in Qingyun Sect? Apart from Mu Lei, the others are internal disciples.”
“As expected of Qingyun Sect. The disciples are all talented!” the Sect Master said as he looked at Jiuyang Sect’s first disciples who were defeated. He cursed inwardly, ‘F*ck you! How dare you flaunt your strength here? Moreover, you want me to flatter you! You f*cking bast*rd!’
“They can’t be considered giants among men. They’re only average,” Ge Changqing said casually after taking a sip of tea, “The core disciples are better. Only those at the Golden Core Realm are qualified to become core disciples. The internal disciples are far inferior to the core disciples.”
“The Sacred Land of Qingyun is like the head of the dragon that is the Eastern Region. Even the achievements of your disciples are worthy for us to learn from!” the Sect Master said dutifully. Inwardly, he cursed again, ‘F*ck you! Your ordinary disciples defeated our first disciples. What are you trying to say? I really want to tear your mouth off your face!’
“These disciples are only riding the coattails of their seniors. They’re not worthy,” Ge Changqing said with a smile. Then, he set his teacup down before he solemnly asked, “Comrade, I heard a disciple of Jiuyang Sect, Zi Linglong, has awakened the phoenix bloodline. Is it true?”
Alarms rang in the Sect Master’s mind immediately. He said, “It’s only a trace of the bloodline.”
“Still, it’s the phoenix bloodline. This is something worth celebrating for humankind. She should be carefully nurtured. Although humans occupy the most territories and fertile lands, demons and devils constantly watch us. We can’t neglect the young talents. We must provide them with the best cultivation resources and environment so that they’ll swiftly grow up and become pillars of humanity. Only with that will we be able to continue to stand at the peak. Do you agree, Comrade?”
“Spoken like an elder from the Sacred Land of Qingyun. Your words are filled with concern for humans as a whole. You’re too kind,” the Sect Master continued to praise Ge Changqing. Inwardly, he cursed again, ‘The f*ck? Is he going to talk about his ideals and philosophies now? No, no, he must be up to no good. Is he trying to poach Zi Linglong? That’s it! F*ck! I really want to poke him to death with a toothpick now!’
“No, no, my kindness is far cry from yours,” Ge Changqing said with a smile as he waved his hand, “Comrade, don’t you agree Zi Linglong should have access to the best resources? I’m sure you agree. In the eastern region, my sect is the place to cultivate. Comrade, for the sake of Linglong’s growth and for the sake of humanity, why don’t you let Linglong cultivate in Qingyun Sect? Don’t refuse me just yet. I don’t want others to say Qingyun Sect likes to bully others. On behalf of Qingyung Sect, I’d like to give a set of low-rank Artifacts if you agree to my request.”
“I’m impressed by your righteousness, Comrade!” the Sect Master grimly said, “You have countless geniuses in the Sacred Land. You even have disciples whose cultivation bases are higher than the Golden Core Realm. Linglong will only be an ordinary disciple in your sect. Certainly, she won’t have the sect’s full attention. On the other hand, Jiuyang Sect is able to wholly concentrate on nurturing Linglong. For Linglong’s sake and humanity’s sake, my sect is willing to support her growth!”
Ge Changqing sneered inwardly. He knew he would not win the argument if he continued with this topic, hence, he swiftly switched tactics. “What do you think of Mu Lei? His mother is a Primal Spirit elder, and he’s a core disciple. He’s not much different from a Proud Son. He’s already at the 4th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm, and it’s likely he’ll reach the 9th Extreme. The foundation he has laid ensures a bright future ahead. Most importantly, he possesses the bloodline of the flood dragon. Your disciple, Zi Linglong, has the phoenix bloodline. Tell me, in the entire Eastern Region, is there a better match than them? The dragon and the phoenix are symbols of good fortune. Should I send a low-grade Artifact as a betrothal gift? If our sect is allied through marriage, it’ll be a legendary and captivating story that’ll spread far and wide in the Eastern Region.”
“Linglong is still young, and she’s still growing. I can’t let her be tied down by marriage!” the Sect Master spread his arms with a helpless expression as he said, “This will have to wait until she’s an adult.”
Ge Changqing’s expression darkened. “Sect Master Yan Yan, in the entire Eastern Region, others would beg to have Qingyun Sect disciples as their cultivation partners. If one of my disciples announces his intention to search for a cultivation partner, the girls in the Eastern Region would all rush to queue up!”
The Sect Master straightened his back and said in a firm tone, “Alas, those girls don’t include those from our Jiuyang Sect.”
“Mu Lei’s mother is a powerful Primal Spirit cultivator. Her words hold weight in the sect. I came at her request. Do you know the consequences if you reject this proposal?” Ge Changqing said.
“Jiuyang Sect may be small, but we won’t stand being bullied,” the Sect Master said firmly.
Ge Changqing’s expression soured immediately. He inhaled deeply before he said, “Everyone has free will. Before making a decision, why don’t we ask Linglong for her opinion?”
“Don’t overstep your bounds, Comrade.” Flames of fury began to surge in the Sect Master’s heart.
“This is how things are done in the Eastern Region,” Ge Changqing said with a smile, “No one can say for sure if Linglong wishes to stay in Jiuyang Sect. Moreover, even with the marriage alliance, she’ll still be considered a disciple of Jiuyang Sect.”
“I have to remind you that we’re in Jiuyang Sect’s great hall,” the Sect Master said thunderously.
Ge Changqing raised his teacup, unperturbed. “Sect Master Yan Yan, there’s no need to get angry. I’m trying to reason with you, after all.”
The Sect Master forcefully suppressed his anger as he launched a barrage of curses at Ge Changqing inwardly. ‘You f*cking bast*rd! F*ck your immortal as*! How dare you trample on my authority in Jiuyang Sect! I really want to rip you into pieces. No, I wish I could throw you into a pen filled with sows so they can violate you ten thousand times over!’
When the Sect Master calmed down slightly, he sighed inwardly. “What can I do against this powerful and shameless bully? What should I do? No matter what, you can’t take my disciple away! Otherwise, I’ll send you to the sun!’
At this time, Zi Linglong appeared outside the great hall. She had just sent Zhang Yu flying.
Upon seeing this, a smile appeared on the Sect Master’s face. However, he quickly replaced it with a sneer before he said, “I’ll remember your words. I’ll have to ask your Sect Master about them when I visit Qingyun Sect. I want to ask if this is the way Qingyun Sect does things. If this is really the way your sect does things, I’ll have to visit the Hundred Elixir Garden and Life and Death Sword Sect.”
“You!” Ge Changqing took a deep breath to calm down. Then, he said, “Comrade, let me give you a piece of advice. If you reject this, Qingyun Sect will be humiliated. Mu Lei and his mother would become laughingstocks in the sect. At that time… Anyway, don’t say I didn’t warn you..”
“Jiuyang Sect is founded with the sun in mind. We might not have much, but we’re ready to burn both jade and the common stone,” the Sect Master said before he raised his teacup.
At this time, the situation outside changed again.
The Sect Master who had been keeping an eye on the changes outside chuckled before he said, “Nine Suns! Nice! As expected of a peerless disciple who appeared only once every millennium. It seems like core disciples aren’t all that great.”
“What?!” Ge Changqing’s expression turned hideous as he hastily flew out of the hall.
…
Outside the great hall.
Mu Lei nearly snapped when he heard Linglong’s mocking words.
He was a core disciple of Qingyun Sect and the son of a Primal Spirit Grand Elder. Everyone admired his talents, and the other sects worshiped him. How could he endure being mocked?
Mu Lei managed to reign in his temper. He decided to be honest so he said, “Nice. As expected of someone who caught my attention. Zi Linglong, I’ll give you a chance to be my cultivation partner.”
“Be your cultivation partner? Are you worthy?” Zi Linglong retorted. She was inwardly surprised. Then, she stepped forward and said domineeringly, “Let’s see what core disciples of Qingyun Sect are made of!”
Zi Linglong raised her hand. Mana surged immediately before a ball of flame appeared. Then, a fiery lightning bolt struck Mu Lei’s head, sending him flying.
“How dare you?!” Mu Lei was infuriated. With a flurry of movements, the power in his body surged out. Soon after, the silhouette of a flood dragon appeared behind him. His strength seemed to surpass that of ordinary Golden Core cultivators.
“Rending Claw!” When Mu Lei cast the spell, the flood dragon behind it extended its claws and sailed toward Linglong.
Mu Lei’s strength shocked the disciples watching the fight. They instinctively retreated.
“Nine Suns!” Zi Linglong was not flustered. A Vision began to appear behind her. Nine suns rose and hovered in the air. The nine balls of flames brought with them a heavy pressure. When she waved her hand, the nine suns shot toward the dragon, easily shattering the dragon’s claws.
Bam!
The battle was not over yet. The suns exploded and sent Mu Lei reeling from the impact. His tunic was ripped, and his body was nearly destroyed.
Ge Changqing flew out of the great hall and protected Mu Lei at the critical moment. Even then, Mu Lei was still covered in blood and burns.
Mu Lei howled and struggled. His eyes were bloodshot as he screamed, “I’ll kill you! I’ll! Kill! You!”
“Cut that out!” Ge Changqing said sternly. Then, he looked at Zi Linglong and asked, “Will you join Qingyun Sect? You’ll definitely be a core disciple in the sect. You can learn many Special Abilities there. You’ll have access to cultivation resources that are 1,000 times better than what you get here.”
“No thanks,” Zi Linglong said coldly.
“Very well!” Ge Changqing grabbed Mu Lei and leaped into the air. At the same time, he said, “We’re leaving!”
The other disciples followed Ge Chanqing.
The Sect Master frowned as he watched Ge Changqing. Something seemed to be troubling him.
As Zi Linglong looked at their backs, she thought to herself, ‘This is another deviation. I can’t afford to wait any longer!’
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming’s heart felt heavy. “Qingyun Sect…”
Qingyun Sect was like the overlord of the Eastern Region. It was almost invincible.
“Mu Lei…” Jiang Ming recalled the other party’s vicious expression before he left. He flipped open the Human Path Records.
Swoosh!
Name: Mu Lei
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Fourth Extreme Golden Core Realm.
Background: Core disciple of Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: -91
Innate Talent: Eight stars (primary flood dragon bloodline)
Status: Came to Jiuyang Sect determined and confident about winning but was badly defeated and driven back. His pride has gotten the best of him. Before leaving Jiuyang Sect, he swore to get Linglong back no matter what. He plans to capture everyone on Chuyang Peak and torture them while he makes her watch. He wants her to know the consequences of offending him. After obtaining the power from her phoenix bloodline, he plans to torture her to death.
“Sh*t!” Killing intent rose in Jiang Ming’s heart immediately. “Even if the Sect Master of Qingyun Sect makes a move, I’ll grind his bones to dust, let alone a Qing Yun Sect disciple!”

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: First Trip off the Mountain
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The other disciples eventually left and returned to their respective peaks. All of them would be talking about today’s incident for a long time to come.
Qingyun Sect disciples came to challenge the Tower of Trials; one of them even cleared the tower. Following that, they challenged the first disciples of the nine peaks, and eight of the first disciples were defeated. They had been powerless to fight back. However, a female disciple from Chuyang Peak, a peak that most of them disdained and often ridiculed, stepped forward and nearly killed Qingyun Sect core disciple.
The disciples of Jiuyang Sect were both shocked and embarrassed by this.
…
Chuyang Peak.
“Senior Brother, was I amazing?” Zi Linglong asked as she hugged Jiang Ming’s arm and swung it.
Zi Linglong was now close to 1.7 meters tall. She had snow-white skin, a sweet face, a pair of beautiful eyes, flowing hair, a fine body, and a pair of long legs. She looked like a painting that had come to life.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming gave her a thumbs-up. “Qingyun Sect is known as the Sacred Land of the Eastern Region. Their core disciples are very gifted, and yet, you almost killed one of them. You’re more than amazing!”
A troubled expression appeared on Zi Linglong’s face as she asked, “Will I get in trouble for beating him up so hard, Senior Brother?”
“Don’t worry, it’ll be fine. Qingyun Sect’s experts won’t come seeking revenge just because we beat up one of the core disciples. If they did, they wouldn’t be known as the Sacred Land anymore,” Jiang Ming said. Inwardly, he thought to himself, ‘Don’t worry. I’ll head over there tonight and kill them!’
“Alright!” Zi Linglong’s eyes lit up upon hearing Jiang Ming’s words. “Since you’re now at the Foundation Establishment Realm, no one will dare to call you mediocre anymore! I’m sure no one in the sect reached the Foundation Establishment Realms as quickly as you did!”
“It’s all thanks to your Foundation Establishment Pills.”
Zi Linglong giggled. “I’ll make sure to get more of them for you!”
“In that case, I must make sure to stay on your good side, Junior Sister. Alright, wait here. I’ll cook up a feast for you!”
“I’ll give you a hand, Senior Brother!”
Laughter rang in the mountain once again.
Gu Hai felt reassured when he saw his disciples were still as close as ever. He stroked his beard as he enjoyed his tea. He would let the Sect Master worry about the repercussions of offending Mu Lei and Ge Changqing.
The sun that emerged after it stopped raining quickly disappeared again. The day was almost over. When night fell, the moon hung in its rightful spot in the east.
The two disciples admired the moon under the pavilion. They had a good view; it looked as though they could see to the ends of the world from where they were seated.
The mountain breeze that carried the sweet fragrance of the flowers caressed their faces.
“What do you want to do in the future, Senior Brother?”
“Me? I’ll stay on Chuyang Peak and cook for you and Master. I’ll spend my time cultivating, admiring the flowers and the moon. I’ll live a carefree life! What about you, Linglong?”
“I’ll stay with you, Junior Brother. Whoever dares to disturb your peace, I’ll send them running!”
Jiang Ming laughed. “That sounds great!”
…
When it was close to midnight, Jiang Ming sent Linglong back to her room.
Zi Linglong’s eyes flashed as she sat cross-legged on the bed.
‘I remember Qingyun Sect’s Mu Lei. At that time, he cultivated the furnace technique and devoured many geniuses’ bloodline foundations to raise his strength. I didn’t expect to catch his attention after awakening my phoenix bloodline ahead of time. Just as well. I’ll kill him when the chance presents itself. Although many things have deviated due to certain events, the general trend remains the same. The devil sects should be making a move within ten years. There’s also Bishui Sect. I wish to stay?by Junior Brother’s side forever but… After a few days, I should increase my strength again. My foundation has stabilized, and I’m at the 9th Extreme Golden Core Realm now. With this, I’ve already surpassed my past self. With this, I no longer have to concern myself with certain things…’
Zi Linglong mulled over her current situation and tried to imagine the future. She could not help but recall her past life as well. In the past, she had grown up happily under the protection of her master and senior brother. Everything was fine until the Yinmo Sect attacked, plunging the sect into chaos. At that time, her senior brother brought her along and fled for their lives. He experienced many hardships trying to protect her and nearly lost his life on several occasions. Moreover…
Zi Linglong’s eyes brimmed with tears as she recalled the past. However, despite the tears, her eyes shone with determination as well.
She exhaled slowly and regulated her breathing before she continued refining her mana.
…
Jiang Ming stood at the window of his bedroom and looked at the world that was bathed in the moon’s silver light.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open.
Name: Mu Lei
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: 4th Extreme Golden Core Realm.
Background: Core disciple of Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: -93
Innate Talent: Eight stars (primary flood dragon bloodline).
Status: Since he left Jiuyang Sect, he has been cursing Zi Linglong, Chuyang Peak, and Jiuyang Sect. At this moment, he’s tending to his injuries on a mountain 30,000 miles northwest of Jiuyang Sect.
“30,000 miles? That’s quite a distance away…” Jiang Ming considered his options.
When he saw the relationship value had dropped another two points, he only sneered. ‘I’ve never even spoken to you before, but you hate so much…’
Jiang Ming flipped to the next page that displayed Ge Changqing’s information.
Name: Ge Changqing
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Nascent Soul realm.
Background: Elder of Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: -33
Innate Talent: Eight stars.
Status: He had to retreat and bring Mu Lei and the others away. He resents the Sect Master of Jiuyang Sect for failing to appreciate his kindness and favor. He decided to destroy, if not kill, Jiuyang Sect Master when the chance presents itself. He grew even angrier when he thought about how Jiuyang Sect Master refused him and humiliated Qingyun Peak. He thinks Jiuyang Sect Master has a death wish. Moreover, he really wanted to kill Zi Linglong earlier for almost killing a core disciple of Qingyun Sect. He would have done so if they were not in Jiuyang Sect. Currently, he’s watching over Mu Lei as Mu Lei recuperates on a mountain 30,000 miles from Jiuyang Sect. At the same time, he’s also thinking about how he could spice the story up about how despicable Jiuyang Sect is when he recounts them to Mu Shuiyun, Mu Lei’s mother.
“You didn’t even look at me, and I don’t think you even know me, but our relationship value is -33.” Jiang Ming felt quite speechless.
A core disciple and elder of the Sacred Land should be tolerant. Why were these two people so petty? Were they so used to living an easy life that they could not tolerate any setbacks?
Subsequently, Jiang Ming expanded his senses and noticed his master was tempering his mana. His junior sister was cultivating as well.
Then, he activated a Formation. If his master or junior sister came looking for him, they would think he’s cultivating due to the activated Formation.
“Junior Sister might cultivate outside the sect soon. I can’t allow someone like Mu Lei, who harbors ill intentions toward her, to live!”
Jiang Ming stepped forward into the spatial network and vanished into thin air like a phantom. When he reappeared, he had just stepped past the Grand Formation and arrived outside the mountain.
When he took another step forward again, it was without ripples or disturbance in the air. He vanished again and reappeared 1,000 miles away in just a blink of an eye.
He used his Great Akasa Steps and traveled through the spatial network, which provided stealth and agility that greatly surprised him.
“If I can completely master the Space Sambodha, I’ll definitely be able to travel through different spaces. It’d be like teleportation!”
Jiang Ming finally came to a stop when he was 100 miles away from his destination. He saw Ge Changqing and the others in the distance.
As though he had turned into a completely different person, the mana surged in his body as Devil Qi rose from his body.
Jiang Ming said gruffly, “There they are…” Then, he laughed maniacally for a moment before he said, “I’ll kill all of you today, Ge Changqing, for destroying my sect in the past.”

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Slice the Heavens and the Devil Luo Hou
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was not confident he would be able to take all of them down in one fell swoop. He decided to disguise himself to hide his identity since he was about to face experts with a powerful background. The best choice was to disguise himself as a member of the devil sect. After all, he could change the nature of his mana at will.
Jiang Ming howled when he appeared before the group from Qingyun Sect.
“The devils will destroy the heavens with 1,000 palm strikes!” Jiang Ming sent out waves of energy with his palm, bringing chaos to the place. Devil Qi permeated the air immediately and shrouded the surroundings.
Countless ink-color palm seals appeared in the sky and rained down on the mountain like a storm. The powerful impact shook the void and rippled out into the surroundings.
“A surviving member of the devil sect?” Ge Changqing frowned. Killing intent had only begun to surge from his body when he sensed the waves of diabolical energy. His expression turned grim immediately. He spat out a golden orb that swiftly expanded into a barrier that covered everyone.
Boom!
The sound of an explosion rang in the air as the torrent of palm strikes landed on the light barrier. Cracks began to form on the barrier immediately.
“Stop!” Colors drained from Ge Changqing’s face as he mobilized his mana to boost the mid-grade defensive item.
Mu Lei and the other disciples were frightened. They had never witnessed a battle of such proportions from a close distance before. The turbulent and mighty waves of energy made them feel as though they were a dinghy stranded in the middle of the sea on a stormy night.
Mu Lei no longer kept up the appearance he had when he was in Jiuyang Sect. After all, among the sect members, he did not have to worry about keeping up appearance.
Crack!
A crisp noise rang from the barrier.
“This is bad!” Ge Changqing’s expression turned even grimmer as more and more cracks began to appear on his barrier. He could feel it swiftly weakening. Just as he was about to reach for Mu Lei, his barrier shattered. Without any hesitation, he hurriedly retreated after he grabbed Mu Lei. At the same time, he flicked his sleeve and carried the other nine disciples before tossing them into the distance. He did not have the time to look after them now.
Boom!
A thunderous explosion rang in the air after Ge Chanqing’s barrier shattered. The force seemed capable of leveling the mountain.
Following that, Jiang Ming howled again.
‘I can’t believe I’m so powerful!’ Jiang Ming’s lit up. His blood was boiling at this moment. The attack earlier was a diabolical spell that the system had rewarded him with. It was only an ordinary spell; it could not compare to Special Abilities at all. However, it was capable of breaking Ge Changqing’s barrier. This alone proved its terrifying power.
Following that, he swept his gaze across the nine disciples who had been abandoned by Ge Changqing. Three of them had exploded into a mist of blood and another three had fallen to their deaths in the distance. The remaining three survivors who were grievously injured landed in a different spot.
Jiang Ming was about to kill them when an idea appeared in his head. “I shouldn’t kill all of them. I should leave a few witnesses behind.”
With a flash of movement, Jiang Ming chased after the fleeing Ge Changqing. He used the Great Akasa Steps and used the spatial network. With that, he traveled at top speed. He closed the distance of 1,000 meters in just a blink of an eye. Soon enough, he saw Ge Changqing suddenly turning around and tossing Mu Lei aside.
This range was close enough for Jiang Ming’s most powerful attack. If Ge Changqing abandoned Mu Lei now, Mu Lei would surely die.
“Who are you?” Ge Changqing shouted. At the same time, streaks of light weaved a protective barrier around him. “I’m an elder of Qingyun Sect. If you make an enemy out of me, it’s akin to making an enemy out of Qingyun Sect. You should think carefully before you act!”
Jiang Ming laughed maniacally. His laughter traveled 1,000 miles away. He said in an insufferably arrogant tone, “I told you that I’m from the devil sect, didn’t I? Others might fear Qingyun Sect because it’s a Sacred Land, but that’s not the case for me! I remember Qingyun Sect contributed to the destruction of my sect back then. Now that I found one of you, how can I let you live?”
“We swept through the entire Eastern Region back then and eradicated every single one of you. Every few years, our disciples would also scour the lands and weed out survivors. Even if you managed to recover slightly after all these years, what can you do? Do you know what it means for you now that you’ve shown yourself? This means there’ll be another hunt for the devils in the Eastern Region. I’ve already cast a spell and sent word back to Qingyun Sect. You should leave now before it’s too late!” Ge Changqing said with a sneer.
“Since I’ve already revealed myself, I can’t possibly leave without doing anything,” Jiang Ming said as he stepped forward. The void distorted and rippled around him when he moved. “Moreover, didn’t it occur to you that the devil sect must be prepared since I dare to show myself? We’ll roam the lands once again! Remember, the person who’ll kill you today is Luo Hou of Yinmo Sect! Now, die!”
Jiang Ming did not restrain his oppressive aura as he looked at Ge Changqing disdainfully. As soon as his voice fell, he made a move. In just a blink of an eye, he appeared next to Ge Changqing. He punched Ge Changqing with an earth-shattering force. However, he discovered that his fist went through his target’s body.
“An illusion?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“Exactly!” Ge Changqing said from 1,000 miles away. His eyebrows were furrowed, and his expression was solemn. At some point, without Jiang Ming noticing, he had brought out a sword that emitted a purple light. The sword seemed to hold enough power to level the mountains and part the sea.
“This is Purple Cloud, a high-grade Artifact!” Ge Changqing said as he pointed the tip of the sword to the sky. A character appeared before dark clouds began to gather above him. Lightning flashed as thunder resounded in the sky. Following that, a huge vortex appeared, churning in the sky.
“Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning! Strike!”
Ge Changqing brandished the sword before a bolt of lightning struck at Jiang Ming.
The lightning bolt was extremely swift, and it seemed to have locked onto Jiang Ming’s aura, making it impossible for him to evade. Nevertheless, he vanished into thin air and reappeared a distance away. He looked at the sky and exclaimed, “Is the lightning Special Ability that Qingyun Sect is known for? Its might is truly something to behold!”
Jiang Ming had read about this from the books in the sect’s collection. He had read once it was cast, there was no escaping it. The target could only face it directly.
The Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning was a famous Special Ability. At the advanced stage, the entire world would turn into a sea of lightning. It was like a divine punishment that would strike fear into the hearts of those who witnessed it.
“You’ve gained insight into the Space Sambodha!” When realization dawned on Ge Changqing, chills ran up his spine. “Comrade Luo Huo, are we really going to fight to the death? I have no quarrel with you! I wasn’t involved in the great battle that involved the whole world 1,500 years ago! At that time, I don’t think you’re even old enough to participate in the battle, right? Why must you be stubborn then?”
“Some things never change! So-called righteous cultivators are still as hypocritical as ever! You’ll kill us when it’s in your favor but run away when things go south. When you can’t escape, you spout grand-sounding nonsense! You’d even bend your knees and lower your head!” Jiang Ming said contemptuously in a thunderous voice that seemed to reverberate across the heavens, “We, devils, cultivate without restraining ourselves and live happily without restraining our desires. We have clear beliefs and we do as we please! I feel unhappy when I see you, therefore, I’ll kill you since you make me unhappy! Die!”
Jiang Ming mobilized his diabolical power and charged forward.
“Slice the Heavens! Part the heavens and the earth!” At this time, Purple Cloud exploded with light as a terrifying Sword Sambodha shot out, seemingly capable of rending heaven and earth or cleaving the moon into two.
Boom!
Alas, Ge Changqing’s attack was destroyed by Jiang Ming’s countless palm strikes.
“Your Slice the Heaven technique isn’t as powerful as you made it seem,” Jiang Ming said as he laughed maniacally again. He did not restrain his energy and let it rampage, shattering the protective barrier around Ge Changqing. He truly looked like a devil lord at this moment.
“Lingering Specters! Follow the shadows!”
Ge Changqing kept throwing up blood after being hit. If it were not for the protective item he was wearing, he would have long died. The devil’s unrestrained energy and strength caused him to shudder. He quickly cast a spell. Clones began to appear around him. It was difficult to tell which was the real him. Moreover, he could switch places with the clones.
“I let you use your skill earlier. Do you think you’ll succeed this time?” Jiang Ming sneered. He waved his hand and used spatial energy to destroy the clones.
Ge Changqing fell. A horrified expression could be seen on his face.
“Die!” A terrifying energy burst forth from Jiang Ming. He sealed the area with the first palm strike. Then, he destroyed Ge Changqing’s defensive Artifact and protective barrier with his second strike. With the third palm strike, he destroyed Ge Changqing’s soul.
Jiang Ming, who was immersed in his role, laughed maniacally.. “The devils will have dominion over the human world!” Then, he sped toward the fleeing Mu Lei. He cackled as he said, “You must be rather important since an elder of Qingyun Sect went out of his way to protect you! I won’t let you get away, brat! Come here!”

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Hearing About the Bishui Sect Again
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Mu Lei was shocked. After Ge Changqing tossed him to the side, he had hurriedly fled. When he sensed the terrifying waves of energy at his back, he felt as though Death was creeping up on him. At this moment, it meant nothing that he was a core disciple of the Sacred Land or that he was a son of a Primal Spirit cultivator. When he turned around and saw Ge Changqing’s soul being destroyed, he was shocked that his eyeballs almost popped out of their sockets. Then, when Jiang Ming’s wicked laughter rang in the air, goosebumps erupted across his flesh and chills ran up his spine.
‘Run! Run! Run!’ Mu Lei repeated this word over and over again like a mantra in his mind. He brought out talismans and ignited them with his mana before he brought his Artifact out. He drew an arc in the air, traveling tens of miles away in just an instant. Alas, to an expert who could kill Ge Changqing, this distance was nothing. Although he had a head start, he only managed to travel several hundred miles.
At this moment, Mu Lei saw two figures atop a distant mountain in front of him. Their clothes fluttered in the air under the moonlight. He could sense a profound energy from the duo, and his eyes brightened immediately. He immediately changed course and flew toward them as he called out, “Seniors! I’m Mu Lei, a core disciple of Qingyun Sect! My mother is Elder Mu Shuiyun! A devil is chasing after me to kill me! Please help me!”
…
On the mountaintop.
The two individuals were playing chess under the moon earlier. The fragrance of tea and wine permeated the air around them. They chatted as they played. However, when they sensed a violent fluctuation of energy in the distance, they rose to their feet immediately. Soon after, they saw a figure flying toward them.
