They were about to turn and leave but stopped in their tracks upon hearing Mu Lei’s words and exchanged a look.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming finally caught up. He sneered. ‘This kid is really lucky! He’s about to die, but two people suddenly showed up at this place. They’re clearly going to protect him as well…’
At this moment, the white-clad elder standing on the left cupped his fists together and said loudly as his sleeves fluttered in the wind, “Comrade, as humans, we’re prone to making mistakes. We should forgive when we can. There’s no need to lower yourself and make things difficult for a junior. I’m Sima Lang of the Eastern Region’s Sima family!”
Following that, Sima Lang flashed a smile at Mu Lei.
Mu Lei sighed in relief. He wisely chose not to say anything else except, “Senior Sima! Your reputation precedes you!”
Sima Lang seemed overjoyed.
Jiang Ming’s eyebrow twitched. He remembered that he had once read a book about the forces in the Eastern Region. He sneered when he recalled the person in front of him. “The Sima family is one of the top ten major forces in the Eastern Region. Get lost, Sima Lang, and I’ll spare your life. Otherwise, this will be your burial ground, and your family will follow in your footsteps shortly.”
Devils were always unrestrained, cruel, violent, and vindictive.
Whoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open.
Name: Sima Lang
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm.
Background: Elder of the Sima family
Relationship: -87
Innate Talent: Seven stars.
Status: After receiving an invitation by Lan Shi, an elder of Bishui Sect, he secretly came to investigate the situation in the Eastern Region. He wanted to find out how the Bishui Sect is going to avoid persecution if they move here. At the same time, they’ll also have to pick a faction to establish themselves. When he saw Mu Lei being chased, he was pleasantly surprised. He’s prepared to save Mu Lei.
‘-87? Wow! He’s going to kill just to curry favor with Mu Lei? In any case, he thinks too highly of himself.’
‘Invitation from Elder Lan Shi of Bishui Sect? They’re moving here? Where are they from then? Overseas?’ Jiang Ming found the word ‘invitation’ interesting. Naturally, when Bishui Sect was mentioned, he remembered Momo from Jiaoyang Peak.
At this time, Sima Lang scoffed. “You’re going to bury me here and kill my family? The devils never change; you’re all wicked to the bones! Have no fear, Comrade Mu. Comrade Lan and I will protect you today!”
“Comrade Mu is a core disciple of the Qingyun Sect, the Sacred Land! He’s a Proud Son, and his name will one day be known throughout the Eastern Region and the entire world. I won’t let this fellow threaten him! Comrade Sima, since we encountered this devil, we should work together to get rid of him to protect Comrade Mu,” Lan Shi said.
Mu Lei was overjoyed. He hastily thanked them. “Thank you, Seniors! I’ll remember this favor! When I return, I’ll surely tell my mother and the Sect Master about this. You’ll be esteemed guests of Qingyun Sect!”
“We’re not doing this for you to repay us,” Sima Lang said as he shook his head. Nevertheless, he could barely conceal the look of delight in his eyes.
“It’s our duty to rid the world of evil!” Lan Shi said as he stroked his beard, “Saving you is only part of the process, Comrade Mu. It’s enough that you serve us a cup of tea when we visit Qingyun Sect in the future.”
Mu Lei thumped his chest and said vehemently, “I’ll surely prepare grand gifts for you!”
Jiang Ming looked at the affectionate display in front of him speechlessly. ‘Are they really trying to forge a relationship now? Are they even taking me seriously?’
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open.
Name: Lan Shi
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Nascent Soul Realm.
Background. Elder of Bishui Sect.
Relationship: -92
Innate Talent: Eight stars.
Status: The situation overseas is tumultuous. He has a vague feeling that a disaster is about to befall them. Hence, his sect plans to move to the land of Shenzhou. After years of planning, the sect has finally seen some results. He came at the sect’s orders to contact the Sima family’s elder, who’s one of the sect’s people, to get the lay of the land. The sect’s also planning to get rid of a faction and to claim it for their own. When he heard Mu Lei stating his identity earlier, he was incredibly happy that he was being presented with a golden chance. He’s prepared to kill the devil.
‘What the…’ Jiang Ming did not care that Lanshi was a Nascent Soul cultivator or that their relationship value was -92, but the amount of information packed under Lan Shi’s status was overwhelming.
‘The situation overseas is tumultuous?’
Only a handful of disciples in Jiuyang Sect liked talking about the overseas nation. Not even his master, Gu Hai, knew much about the situation overseas. He read in the books that the seas were mostly infested with sea demons. It was a treacherous place. This was especially true for the places that were further away where nothing but barren lands existed. The furthest the disciples would go were places that were close to the sea where the risks were relatively low.
When Jiang Ming learned that Momo was a Bishui Sect disciple, he had a lot of questions. Now, many of his questions were answered. She was likely a scout.
To be honest, he was more shocked by the bravery of the Bishui Sect. It was one thing to move the sect here but to destroy a faction to establish their dominance?
‘Aren’t they worried that we’d team up and fight them? They clearly think that they’re superior to us. Well, as long as they leave Jiuyang Sect alone…’
At this moment, the two men stood in front of Mu Li with surging killing intent and imposing airs. One of them wielded a sword while a bell hovered above the other one.
Jiang Ming grinned. “You’re sure you’re going to protect him and stand in my way?”
With the bell hanging above him, Sima Lang said righteously, “Everyone will kill devils when they encounter them! You can choose to leave or die!”
“Why are we still talking? Let’s just kill him!” Lan Shi had a profound cultivation base and a powerful weapon. He was confident that he could kill the devil before him. He wanted to flaunt his strength to impress Mu Lei.
“The boundless seas will topple the universe; this sword will flip the oceans and cut down the mountain!” Lan Shi brandished his sword. There was a flash as a Vision of waves appeared in the sky. It was like a tsunami pulling back just before it crashed down with its boundless might.
Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes that flashed with killing intent as he thought to himself, ‘You’re even more eager than I am to act. Who’s the devil? Well, I can hardly reason with a fool who deserves to die. Forget it!’
“Die!” Jiang Ming only uttered one word before he made his move.

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Primal Spirit and Destruction
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
With a single palm strike, Jiang Ming broke the firmaments’ character and shattered the sword’s radiance.
Another wave of diabolical energy surged and struck Lan Shi, the Nascent Soul expert, killing him on the spot. It was done cleanly without fanfare.
Sima Lang was thunderstruck upon seeing this. Soon, his shock was replaced by endless fear. He shuddered before he forced a smile on his face that looked uglier than if he were to cry. Then, he said, “Senior, this is all a misunderstanding! It’s a misunderstanding, Senior!”
“Misunderstanding?” Jiang Ming sneered. He might only be at the Dao Seed Realm, but his accumulations, the purity of his mana, and the vastness of his power had already broken the rules of old. Even he was not sure how powerful he was now.
When he had fought Ge Changqing earlier, he did not use any special skills. He only used ordinary skills and less than one-tenth of his actual combat strength when he killed Ge Changqing. One had to remember that Ge Changqing was not an ordinary cultivator. Ge Changqing was from the Sacred Land and was skilled in spells and Special Abilities.
Apart from that, he only needed to be slightly serious to kill Lan Shi in just an instant.
‘I’m f*cking powerful now! I wonder if I can kill a Primal Spirit expert with my current strength…’
Jiang Ming’s ambitions had grown after these battles. He could kill enemies who were one realm ahead of him, but he did think this was anything to be proud of. He would only be proud of himself if he could kill a Primal Spirit cultivator.
“What must I do for you to spare me, Senior?” Sima Lang was on the verge of crying at this moment.
‘F*ck! What should I do?’ Sima Lang cursed inwardly. He had thought that with Lan Shi by his side, he would be able to defend himself even if they could not kill the devil. Alas, Lan Shi proved to be useless; Lan Shi was killed almost as soon as the battle started.
“Senior, I’ll give you everything I have. Please spare me!” Sima Lang threw his dignity away and fell to his knees in the air.
Upon seeing this, the despairing Mu Lei was shocked. ‘You’re an expert, for f*ck’s sake! Why are you kneeling? Sh*t! You have no f*cking dignity!’
Following that, Mu Lei said in a trembling voice, “I-I’m a core disciple of Qingyun Sect. My mother is a Primal Spirit cultivator. My patriarch is Dong Tian. If you kill me, you’ll be hunted down even if you run to the end of the world…”
Bam!
Jiang Ming reduced Sima Lang into a mist of blood with just a palm strike.
Mu Lei stiffened.
“Who will save you now?” Jiang Ming asked frostily. He raised his hand.
Devil Qi surged within a ten-mile radius.
Jiang Ming was about to kill Mu Lei when he saw a streak of golden light shot out of Mu Lei’s forehead before forming a silhouette of a person. It burst forth with tremendous power and blocked Jiang Ming’s palm strike.
“Who dares to harm my son? I’ll make your life a living hell!” a charming woman shouted as soon as she appeared. She had insufferably arrogant air about her, and her killing intent surged to the high heavens as soon as she appeared.
This woman was none other than Mu Shuiyun, Mu Lei’s mother and an expert of Qingyun Sect.
“Mother!” Mu Lei was overjoyed. Then, he pointed at Jiang Ming and viciously said, “It’s him! He killed Elder Ge and the other disciples. He wants to kill me as well! Kill him, Mother! No, capture him alive. I want to torture him for 100 years!”
“Torturing him for 100 years is too light of a punishment for someone who tried to kill you. After I catch him, I’m going to torture him for 10,000 years!” Mu Shuiyun said, “Stand back, Lei. I’ll capture him now!”
“Be careful, Mother!” Mu Lei retreated into the distance.
Jiang Ming’s lips twitched when he saw Mu Shuiyun. ‘D*mn it! They just keep coming! Is Mu Lei truly favored by the heavens? F*ck! I’ll definitely kill him today!’
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records appeared and flipped to a new page.
Name: Mu Shuiyun
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit
Background: Elder of?Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: -98.
Innate Talent: Nine stars (Water Spirit Body)
Status: She’s the former Holy Daughter of Qingyun Sect. Her looks are exceptional. She’s arrogant, obstinate, and proud. In the past, she was captured by a flood dragon while she was cultivating at the sea and went missing for six months. When she returned to the sect, it was discovered that she was with child, but the father of the child remains unknown. As a result, she was stripped of her Holy Daughter title. She dotes on her son greatly. When she heard the rumors of a disciple with the phoenix bloodline in Jiuyang Sect, she sent an elder to ask for the disciple’s hand in marriage with the goal of extracting the phoenix bloodline’s power for her son. She had planted a strand of her Primal Spirit in her son’s sea of consciousness for the sake of safety. She was cultivating when her son awakened her from her cultivation. When her son’s under threat, her Primal Spirit awakened.
‘Wow! A relationship value of -98! How much does she hate me exactly?’
Jiang Ming was shocked by Mu Shuiyun’s innate talent of nine stars as well. She had a Water Spirit Body, which meant that she had a high affinity for water techniques.
Many of Jiang Ming’s questions were answered when he saw Mu Shuiyun’s status. No wonder Mu Lei took his mother’s surname. Mu Lei was an illegitimate child born after his mother was violated.
As expected, Mu Shuiyun was not simple. She was once the Holy Daughter and was now a Primal Spirit expert. With her cultivation base at the Primal Spirit Realm, she could easily rule over an area.
Jiang Ming was slightly excited at the thought of fighting such an individual. However, he also felt slightly disappointed that this was just a strand of her Primal Spirit.
While Jiang Ming was deep in his thoughts, he saw Mu Shuiyun charging toward him.
“Primal Spirit Heart Sword, destroy!” Mu Shuiyun acted decisively. When she learned that Ge Changqing had died, she knew that her opponent would not be a pushover. She was prepared to sacrifice this strand of her Primal Spirit here. She did not hesitate and used her most powerful skill as soon as she attacked.
Mu Shuiyun spun, bursting with a dazzling light that seemed like it would not dim no matter what. Even the moon that shone high in the sky paled in comparison. Following that, the golden light formed a sword. It was a highly concentrated body of energy. In just a moment, it arrived near Jiang Ming’s forehead.
Jiang Ming’s eyes widened as an expression of fear appeared on his face. He hurriedly stepped onto the Akasa network and retreated.
“You mastered a spatial ability? Alas, you’re up against my Primal Spirit Heart Sword. It’s locked onto your aura so you won’t be able to escape!” Mu Shiyin said confidently, “With my Primal Spirit in sword form, its speed is peerless. Based on what I’d sensed, you’re not at the Primal Spirit Realm yet. You might be powerful, but you won’t be able to defend against a Primal Spirit attack! I’ll shatter your sea of consciousness, crush your Dao Seeds, and destroy your cultivation base before I imprison you. After that, I’ll whip you every day to my heart’s content!”
After Jiang Ming stepped into his spatial network to dodge the attack, his mana surged within his sea of consciousness. He was about to cast his Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi when an idea appeared in his mind.
Following that, Jiang Ming stored his Human Path Records in his sea of consciousness, just in case. Then, he appeared in midair, seeming as though he had no intention of dodging.
Swoosh!
The Primal Spirit Heart Sword shot into Jiang Ming’s forehead and stabbed at the barrier around his sea of consciousness.
Mu Shuiyun had assumed it would be easy to breach the barrier, but the sword seemed to have hit an impenetrable iron wall at this moment. The barrier only shook in response to the sword’s attack. Not only did the sword fail to leave a crack on the barrier, but the barrier caused the sword to explode as well.
‘My sea of consciousness is exceptionally tough.’ Jiang Ming sighed in relief inwardly. He had been looking for an opportunity to test his sea of consciousness’ defenses for a long time now. Even if his barrier did not hold, his sea of Consciousness would still be protected by the Human Path Records.
Although the Human Path Records did not have any powerful abilities, it gained some functionalities after his cultivation base improved. It was easy for it to protect his sea of consciousness.
Jiang Ming nodded, satisfied with the result.
“Impossible! How can your sea of consciousness be so tough? How could it withstand my special ability?!” Mu Shuiyin shrieked. Following that, she said threateningly, “Leave my son alone. If you kill him, I swear I’ll hunt you down and tear you into pieces. You won’t be able to run from me! Not only that, I’ll kill everyone related to you! I’ll leave no survivors!”
As Jiang Ming listened to Mu Shuiyun’s threats, he sensed the fragments of the Primal Spirit floating outside his sea of consciousness. With this discovery, another idea appeared in his mind.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records pulled the fragments of the Primal Spirit into his sea of consciousness. In the next moment, fragmented memories and several Special Abilities appeared in his mind. The fragmented memories were mostly about her son and her cultivation. They were of no value to him. On the contrary, the Special Abilities caught his attention.
Jiang Ming put the matter of the Special Abilities aside for now and looked at Mu Lei who was watching the battle from a distance with a sneer on his face. It was not difficult to tell that Mu Lei was likely fantasizing about the 1,008 ways he could torture him.
Jiang Ming flew over. “How can you smile when your mother is dead?”
The smug smile on Mu Lei’s face stiffened immediately. Then, he said in a horrified tone, “I-impossible! My mother is a Primal Spirit expert!”
“Do you think Primal Spirit experts are impervious to death?” Jiang Ming said tonelessly, “I wonder if anyone else is going to show up to rescue you. Let’s see if your luck holds out against my palm strike!”
With just a palm strike, Mu Lei was quickly reduced to a mist of blood.
Following that, Jiang Ming destroyed all the evidence.
‘This feels great,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself, feeling much more at ease now that he had eliminated a potential threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Wood Dragon and the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming did not leave immediately. He released more Devil Qi until it covered an area of 100 miles in just a blink of an eye. At the same time, black flames surged around his body. He was using the black flames to get rid of any potential risks or evidence that he might have missed. Subsequently, he cleansed his spoils with mana and removed whatever traces were left before he finally felt more at ease.
Jiang Ming saw three surviving disciples from Qingyun Sect trembling in the corner, but he ignored them. He activated his Great Akasa Steps and returned to Chuyang Peak after taking a huge detour.
…
Almost dawn.
Mu Shuiyun hurried to the scene of the battle.
“Lei! My son!” Mu Shuiyun cried out as she searched for him to no avail. Her powerful energy distorted the air around her, causing a meteorological phenomenon in the sky that ravaged the mountainous terrain.
When she found the three surviving Qingyun Sect disciples, she questioned them about what had transpired. After learning about the ins and outs of the event, she cried out in a voice that held indescribable sorrow and hatred, “Luo Hou! I’ll kill you! I’ll kill you! I’ll kill you!”
When she calmed down slightly, she began to search for traces of her son’s murderer. She started by searching the epicenter of the battle.
…
Inside a room at Chuyang Peak.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open.
Name: Mu Shuiyun
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: Elder of Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Nine stars (Water Spirit Body)
Status: She awakened from her cultivation completely when a fragment of her Primal Spirit was destroyed. She rushed to the site of the battle and found three surviving disciples from Qingyun Sect. She’s now searching for traces of Luo Hou and traces of the devil sects in a frenzy.
“The relationship value is now 0? It used to be -98. Does this have something to do with me disguising myself as Luo Hou when I fought a strand of her Primal Spirit? Her hatred must be directed at Luo Hou. She doesn’t know I am, after all.” Jiang Ming smiled.
After putting away the Human Path Records, he began to go through his spoils. He had gained many items from this battle. There was the high-grade Artifact, Purple Cloud, from Ge Changqing and Lan Shi’s high-grade sword, Blue Crystal. He had also obtained several other Artifacts and dozens of weapons. Apart from that, he also had many spiritual crystals.
A middle-grade spiritual crystal held 100 times more power than a low-grade spiritual crystal while a high-grade spiritual crystal held 100 times more power than a middle-grade spiritual crystal.
The spiritual crystals he obtained this time were equivalent to 100 high-grade spiritual crystals. This was considered a huge number of crystals.
“Villains are always rewarded with riches! I feel like I’ve gotten rich overnight,” Jiang Ming exclaimed to himself.
After sorting his spoils and putting them away, he began to look at the Special Abilities he gained from the fragment of Mu Shuiyun’s Primal Spirit.
Primal Spirit Heart Sword was an attack using one’s Primal Spirit. The requirements to cultivate it were high. After studying it, he finally understood that if Mu Shuiyun were to unleash it in person, he might not have been able to block it with his sea of consciousness.
The Heart Sword was capable of slashing Primal Spirits and destroying one’s will. It would strike suddenly and could not be evaded. Indeed, it was a powerful move.
Then, there was the Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning. Ge Changqing had used this spell previously. He had called upon the power of lightning. It was a terrifying sight to behold. However, Jiang Ming could tell Ge Changqing had yet to completely master the spell.
Wood Dragon. This was a Wood Element Special Ability. It could conjure up trees that would then turn into dragons. It was a move that combined both offense and defense.
Slice the Heavens sword technique was also one that Ge Changqing had used. Its power seemed capable of parting heaven and earth.
Then, there was the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal. It was an immense seal that could suppress all things.
“Although it was just a fragment of her Primal Spirit, I gained five techniques from it. They might not be able to compare to my Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, or Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, but they’ll still be powerful moves after I master them. There’s no denying these Special Abilities are unique. With them, I have more weapons in my arsenal!” Jiang Ming smiled, satisfied.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Spell: Primal Spirit Heart Sword, Ten Thousand Sword Technique, basic Formations, basic Talismans, basic Pills, and basic Artifacts.
Special abilities: Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Wood Dragon, Slice the Heavens, and Heaven Suppression Divine Seal.
Innate Talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Item: Human Path Records, three Shadowless Needles (high-grade Artifact), Purple Cloud (high-grade Artifact), Blue Crystal (high-grade Artifact), Noble Robe (low-grade Artifact), Flowing Cloud Sword (top-grade Artifact)
He nodded in satisfaction when he saw the changes in his information.
…
While Jiang Ming was happy, there was someone who could not even sleep.
Mu Shuiyun quickly spread the word about the reemergence of the devil sects.
With that, it did not take long before experts arrived at the site of the battle. They tried to glean information from their surroundings with their Special Abilities and spells. Alas, they did not find anything noteworthy. All they could sense was the extremely pure Devil Qi.
After that, they did a sweep and found a base of the Yinmo Sect that was located 10,000 miles away. It was hidden in the mountains and was concealed by a Grand Formation. Needless to say, the Grand Formation did nothing to hide the base from the experts.
Just like that, another battle took place at dawn. It was a bitter battle since both parties were not prepared for it.
…
The Sima family.
The destruction of Sima Lang’s soul caused the head of the Sima family to lose sleep. He felt extremely uneasy.
He was aware of the Sima family’s connection to Bishui Sect so he knew if the matter was exposed, the other forces would definitely work together to deal with the Sima family. At that time, the Sima family would be known for trying to ally with a powerful sect and would be called the thief of the Eastern Region.
…
On a remote island located in the East Sea.
The base camp of Bishui Sect.
The sect was alerted as soon as Lan Shi died. One of the experts hurriedly contacted the other members in the Eastern Region’s Shenzhou and told them to look into the matter.
…
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming was unaware of the chain of events that were unfolding as a result of his killing spree.
When it was dawn, Jiang Ming was in a good mood as he went downstairs. He fetched water, chopped wood, and cleaned the courtyard before he began to prepare breakfast.
Even in his past life, he did not mind cooking. Moreover, he would gladly cook for his junior sister. What he disliked was doing the dishes after the meals. However, things were different now. With just a spell, he could remove the grease.
…
Taiyang Peak.
The Sect Master had been feeling uneasy due to yesterday’s events. He drank a cup of tea as he looked at the light that dawn brought. He was mulling over the possible troubles that Jiuyang Sect might face after offending Ge Changqing and Mu Shuiyun.
At this moment, he saw a streak of light flying over from a distance. He raised his hand and intercepted the message that was sent to him. Words could not describe the shock he felt after reading the message. When he recovered from his shock, a grin appeared on his face immediately before he began to laugh heartily.
He quickly restrained himself before he muttered under his breath, “I can’t believe that fiend, Ge Changqing, is dead! What impeccable timing! This is wonderful! This is great! I have to admit I’m really happy!”
He could not help but stand up and do a little celebratory dance. When he realized what he had done, he cleared his throat and looked around to make sure no one saw him before he hurriedly sat down. In just a moment, he regained his dignified air. Nevertheless, he could not hide the smile on his face.
Soon after, the smile was replaced by a frown. “A devil killed Ge Changqing. Clearly, that devil isn’t afraid of Qingyun Sect at all. Are the devils trying to make a comeback? That would be bad. Fortunately, it seemed like they’re only targeting Qingyun Sect for now.”
The Sect Master began to think of what Jiuyang Sect should do if the devil sects made a move again.
…
The sun rose in the east, illuminating the lands with its golden light.
Jiang Ming placed the dishes he had cooked on the stone table in the courtyard. When he saw his junior sister, he said, “I cooked your favorite dishes. There are shrimp dumplings, steamed egg custard, green onion tofu, tofu with shallots, bamboo shoot salad, and fish balls.”
“You’re the best, Senior Brother!” Linglong’s eyes curved when she smiled. “Even the best pills and spiritual crystals can’t compare to the breakfast you made, Senior Brother!”
Jiang Ming laughed. “That’s exactly what I like to hear!”
At this moment, Gu Hai cleared his throat before he said, “Someone seems to have forgotten about their master whom they should honor first!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless by his master’s words while Linglong covered her mouth and laughed.
The trio chatted merrily as they ate the breakfast Jiang Ming had prepared.
After that, Jiang Ming went to the back of the mountain.
It was time to harvest his crops.

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Shocking Rewards
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The gentle mountain breeze blew, rustling the stalks of paddy.
“Look at the paddy! You won’t have to worry about starving for years, Senior Brother!”
“Once I start brewing wine with them, you’re going to complain they aren’t enough.”
“You can make wine from them?”
“Of course!”
“The wine you brew will definitely be tasty! I want to drink 800 cups of it!”
Jiang Ming laughed. “Alright!”
“What about the wheat, Senior Brother? What can you do with it?”
“I can make noodles, buns, twisted bread rolls, tutmaq, dumplings, meat buns, wontons, sliced noodles, pulled noodles, braised noodles, minced noodles, noodles with soybean paste, dry noodles with sesame paste, oily noodles, plain noodles… You’ll have a different menu every day! There are also soft and fluffy cakes!”
“You can make so many things with it? That’s amazing, Senior Brother! I want to eat them all!”
“Sure. I’ll make them all for you to try. I’ll make sure you grow into a healthy and plump young lady!”
“I don’t want to get fat, Senior Brother!”
As the duo chatted, they hovered in the air and launched wind blades to harvest the crops.
…
Meanwhile, Gu Hai looked at his two disciples from a distance. A happy smile could be seen on his face as he stroked his beard.
“My first disciple is in his early 20s, but he’s already at the Foundation Establishment Realm. He can be considered a talented disciple of the sect. My second disciple is only 13 years old, but she’s already at the Extreme Golden Core Realm, breaking the record in Jiuyang Sect since its founding. With this, who would dare say Chuyang Peak is in a state of decline? Who would dare to say that I don’t have any talented disciples? Who would dare to complain that I don’t deserve the position of First Seat?”
Gu Hai was extremely pleased. He flicked his sleeve and brought his wine gourd out before taking a few swigs from it.
He sighed in contentment after he wiped his mouth with his sleeve. ‘It tastes amazing!’
…
At the same time, Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong continued chatting as they harvested the crop.
“Look at Master, Senior Brother! I wonder what kind of happy thoughts are in his mind right now!”
“That old geezer must be incomparably happy because of how proud you’ve made him!”
“I think he’s thinking about the First Seat of Jiaoyang Peak!”
“Do you know what their relationship is like?”
“I heard the seniors at Taiyang Peak spoke about this before. When First Seat Yin Yue was younger, she was an aloof beauty. She had many admirers, but she never paid much attention to them. She had a good relationship with Master, but Master had always avoided her for some reason.”
“Strange!”
“Indeed.”
The two disciples continued to harvest the crops as they chatted. It was not even noon yet when they finished harvesting the 100 Mu of paddy, wheat, vegetable, fruits, and the other crops and storing them in the warehouse.
Jiang Ming had just received a notification of the rewards when he saw his master waving him over.
When Jiang Ming approached Gu Hai, Gu Hai said, “The Sect Master just summoned me over to Taiyang Peak. I’ll be away for a moment. Guard the mountain well while I’m gone.”
Upon hearing this, Linglong said, “Don’t worry, Master! I’ll destroy the cultivation bases of those who dare to look for trouble with us!”
Gu Hai laughed. “Yes, destroy their cultivation bases!”
Jiang Ming’s eyes gleamed as he watched Gu Hai leave. He had an idea why Gu Hai had been summoned to Taiyang Peak.
Following that, Jiang Ming returned to the front courtyard with his junior sister. He decided to check his rewards. He could not help but inhale sharply when he looked at the notification again.
[Ding! Congratulations on harvesting 100 Mu of crops. Reward: 2,000 years’ worth of cultivation, 100 Enlightening Tea Leaves (high-grade), 30 Enlightening Stone (rare), a Space Crystal, and the Tyrant Halberd (middle-grade Dao Vessel]
“I didn’t expect to receive such wonderful rewards just by harvesting the crops.”
Jiang Ming felt as though he was dreaming. The rewards he received daily from preparing meals and chopping wood would only amount to two months’ worth of cultivation. This was equivalent to a 60-time increase in his cultivation speed. How could he not be shocked by the 2,000 years of cultivation he was just rewarded with? He could hardly believe this windfall. With 2,000 years of cultivation, he could easily fill his vast sea of consciousness and still have leftovers.
Apart from that, he needed the Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones as well. They would help him gain insight into various Sambodhas at a higher speed and cultivate more Dao Seeds.
When he read the description for the Space crystal, his heart skipped a beat. This object was the result of the crystallization of spatial energy. It held the mysteries of the law of space.
“What if I gain full insight into the Space Sambodha? With that, I’m certain I’ll be able to kill Mu Shuiyun!”
This was not a fanciful thought, it was filled with confidence and certainty.
Currently, he was using his Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi and Great Akasa Steps to gain insight into several derivations of the Space Sambodha. With that, he could be considered terrifyingly powerful. What would happen if he gained insight into all of them? He could hardly imagine how much more powerful he would become.
“If only I have a Time Crystal as well.” Jiang Ming was beginning to develop an insatiable appetite.
The final item Jiang Ming was rewarded with was a Dao Vessel. Dao Vessels were superior to Artifacts. The Jiuyang Sect might not even have such an item.
While Jiang Ming considered the various happy possibilities, Linglong tilted her head slightly and asked, “Senior Brother, why do you suddenly look so happy?”
“I’m happy because of the harvest!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile. Inwardly, he wondered if he should give some of the rewards to his junior sister. After considering for a moment, he dismissed the idea.
She was still too young, reaching the 9th Extreme Golden Core Realm at 13 years old. Although it was an amazing feat, she was still immature. She should continue to build her character, temper her foundation, and gain knowledge. When she was 17 or 18 years old, he would then help her grow.
“I’m happy as well, Senior Brother!”?Linglong said excitedly, “From now on, I’ll farm and harvest by your side, Senior Brother!”
Jiang Ming nodded. “I won’t be bored with you around. Alright, what do you want for lunch?”
“I want noodles!”
“Alright. I’ll make ten kinds of noodles for you. You can eat to your heart’s content!”
…
In Taiyang Peak’s great hall.
The Sect Master and the eight First Seats were all gathered at this moment.
The Sect Master slowly said, “I received news this morning that Ge Changqing and the disciples who were here yesterday were ambushed by a devil called Luo Hou last night. Almost all of them died. Ge Changqing and Mu Lei didn’t survive.”
A heavy silence loomed over the great hall as the expressions of the eight First Seats changed.
The expression of Yue Cheng, the First Seat of Zhiyang Peak, underwent the most drastic change. His heart nearly jumped out from his chest when he heard these words. Fortunately, he quickly recovered from the shock and corrected his expression.
The Sect Master continued to say, “I also received news that Mu Shuiyun, Mu Lei’s mother, had left the mountain as well. She and a few elders of Qingyun Sect inspected and searched the site of the battle. They found one of the devils’ bases. It’s on one of the mountains 40,000 miles away from us. The battle there saw the loss of three elders from Qingyun Sect; two of them were Nascent Soul cultivators. Even Mu Shuiyun was injured during the battle. Fortunately, reinforcements from the sect arrived at the nick of time, sparing them from the fate of suffering an even bigger loss.”
The eight First Seats exchanged a look. Some of them broke out in cold sweat at this moment.
The base of the devils was only 40,000 miles away from Jiuyang Sect, after all. Those devils could have easily come to Jiuyang Sect. Would Jiuyang Sect be able to fend the devils off if the devils attacked?
At this time, Yue Cheng nearly died from shock. He naturally knew about the base the Sect Master mentioned. The devils stationed at that base were meant to invade Jiuyang Sect. Once the preparations were completed, they would activate a Grand Formation to trap Jiuyang Sect. After that, they would kill, conquer, and replace the members of the sect.
‘Have I been exposed?’ Yue Cheng wondered inwardly, frightened out of his wits. He felt as though he was sitting on needles at this moment. When Zuo Han and Zou Yizhao’s deaths surfaced in his mind again, he was overwhelmed with the urge to flee.
The Sect Master asked, “Why do you think the devils set up camp 40,000 miles away from us? Are they planning to make a comeback?”
The great hall was still silent as everyone tried to process this shocking news.
When the Sect Master saw that no one responded to him, he looked at Yue Cheng as he slowly asked, “Junior Brother Yue Cheng, you’ve always been calm and resourceful. What do you think about this matter?”
Yue Cheng, who had been stewing in anxiety, instinctively rose to his feet when he was called out. Then, when he realized everyone was staring at him, he quickly removed the shocked expression from his face and replaced it with a bitter smile. “I… In my opinion, the devils must be preparing for something but were discovered by Qingyun Sect and were forced to fight. I’m still shocked by this. Sect Master, I think we can’t afford to involve ourselves in this matter. We should just close our gates, and enjoy our lives!”
The Sect Master nodded. “You have a point. However, sometimes, it’s impossible to not get involved even if it’s what we want. Does anyone have any more ideas on what we should do?”
The atmosphere slowly warmed up.
Yue Cheng participated in the discussion with a smile, but inwardly, he was feeling very restless and uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: The Empress on the Move
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Nine Peaks continued discussing the courses of action that Jiuyang Sect should take.
Shortly after, an order went out to seal the sect’s gates. Disciples were also prohibited from venturing out of the sect, and disciples who were training outside were summoned back to the sect.
…
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming could not have cared less about the commotion outside.
He used his mana to turn the paddy he and Linglong had harvested into rice-flour noodles, rice noodles, rice noodle rolls, rice cakes, and glutinous rice balls. He made several other varieties of noodles as well.
Linglong undoubtedly had the feast of life.
“You’re amazing, Senior Brother! The food is delicious!” Linglong exclaimed. She asked curiously, “Where did you learn to make these?”
She wondered inwardly, “Where did he learn how to cook? Why is he so interested in farming? Is it because my cultivation base is too profound? Is that why he feels there’s no need to work hard?”
“When you were cultivating at Taiyang Peak, I was quite bored. Hence, I spent time looking through the books in the library and somehow started studying how to cook. I wanted to prepare delicious food for you when you return,” Jiang Ming explained with a smile, “In the future, I’ll grow and cook all the things you want to eat!”
“You’re so nice to me, Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong’s eyes reddened as she threw herself into Jiang Ming’s arms.
“That’s only natural.” Jiang Ming ruffled her long hair. “Alright, you’re not a kid anymore. Why are you crying?”
“I don’t care!” Linglong rubbed her face on his chest.
Jiang Ming looked at her helplessly.
…
When Gu Hai returned in the afternoon, he recounted the things he had heard to his two disciples.
Jiang Ming did not have much of a reaction, but Linglong was greatly shocked.
‘Ge Changqing and Mu Lei died? Luo Hou the devil? They discovered the devils’ base and battled intensely? All I did was awaken my phoenix bloodline ahead of time. How did it lead to this chain of events?’ Linglong was shocked and confused. However, it did not bother her. To her, the most important thing was to protect her senior brother. She could not care less about other matters.
The situation at Chuyang Peak remained the same even after receiving the explosive news.
After dinner, the trio sat on the rooftop and admired the moon as they drank tea.
Gu Hai said emotionally, “Ming, I didn’t expect you to have such a huge improvement in your cultivation in just a few years by farming and tempering your character. You’re now at the Foundation Establishment Realm. Since this method is beneficial to your cultivation, why don’t you use the lands on the neighboring mountains as well?”
“I’m tempering my heart, character, and will. I will put my heart and soul into working hard. Before this, I tried to gain insights by pondering on how the seeds germinate, grow roots, shoots, flowers, and fruits before they mature and wither away. Before I knew it, my heart was one with nature and I gained insight into several wonderful truths. As a result, my cultivation improved as well. Moreover, Junior Sister’s Foundation Establishment Pills helped me reach the Foundation Establishment Realm in one go,” Jiang Ming said.
“This is the path of sincerity!” Gu Hai said as his eyes lit up, “Wonderful! Who would have thought that farming would help your heart be one with nature? It’s a Grand Path as well!”
Linglong nodded silently.
Jiang Ming smiled. Inwardly, he thought to himself, ‘F*ck the path of sincerity! Well, at least they bought this nonsense.’
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open.
Jiang Ming wanted to check on Yue Cheng to see if he was up to no good.
Name: Yue Cheng
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm.
Background: First Seat of Zhiyang Peak (Note: He’s actually an Elder of Yinmo Sect)
Relationship: -12
Status: He’s puzzled by Ge Changqing and Mu Lei’s deaths that were supposedly the work of the devil sect’s Luo Hou. He did not know who Luo Hou was. When he learned that one of their bases had been discovered and a big battle had taken place, he was struck with fear. He contemplated fleeing the sect since it would be too late once he’s exposed. He continues to anxiously wait for updates.
A confused expression appeared briefly on Jiang Ming’s face. Their relationship value was now -12. This meant that Yue Cheng was slowly forgetting about a minor character like himself.
To the current Jiang Ming, Yue Cheng was no longer someone he feared. All he needed to do was keep an eye on Yue Cheng.
…
Over the next few days, Jiang Ming and Linglong did not cultivate.
The two of them plowed and tilled the land.
This time, Jiang Ming was only given one reward: the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Plate. It was an extremely powerful Dao Vessel. After it was cultivated, he could set up a Grand Formation. It would be able to maintain itself by absorbing spiritual qi and could also be boosted with spiritual crystals. This reward was undoubtedly useful.
After receiving the reward, Jiang Ming buried the Formation Plate under the pavilion. It silently fused with the original Grand Formation, leaving no traces nor ripples behind. With that, Chuyang Peak’s defenses were greatly enhanced.
…
The carefree days continued to pass.
Jiang Ming was two days from reaching the third anniversary of him obtaining the system when Gu Hai brought back grim news.
“Qingyun Sect has issued a decree to all the sects and great families in the Eastern Region to send out disciples to annihilate the devils!” Gu Hai said with a sigh, “Our sect can’t defy the decree. Our peaceful days are over, and we’ll see blood again…”
“Can’t Qingyun Sect deal with this matter on their own?” Jiang Ming asked.
“They can’t if it’s the Six Devil Sects we’re dealing with. However, it seems like we’re only dealing with the Yinmo Sect. It’s unfortunate that its members are scattered everywhere so it’s difficult for us to clean them up in one fell swoop. This is why the Qingyun Sect wants the other forces to join in this mission,” Gu Hai explained, “A few great battles took place several days ago which resulted in a high number of casualties. Based on the situation, it’s likely that Yinmo Sect is trying to make a comeback. I wonder what the devil sects are planning. I think chaos will descend on the world soon. This is really bad…”
After a brief pause, Gu Hai continued to say, “Each sect will have to send disciples to search the surrounding lands at least. However, since there are only three of us here at Chuyang Peak, and we only have the elderly and the young, the Sect Master exempted us from this mission. Both of you should stay put on the mountain, understand?”
Following that, Linglong hurriedly said, “Master, I want to participate in the mission!”
“No!” Gu Hai refused her decisively. “You’re the hope of Chuyang Peak. You’re the sect’s future. I won’t let you take this risk. Your current mission is to focus on your cultivation. You don’t have to worry about anything else.”
“I won’t go far by just cultivating, Master! I won’t grow without experiencing trials,” Linglong argued, “Now that the devils are on the move, our peaceful days are over!”
“It’s still a no! I’m going to the great hall to check on things. Look after your junior sister, Ming.” Gu Hai waved his sleeve and left.
“Senior Brother!” Linglong held Jiang Ming’s arm and shook it before saying in a soft voice, “I’m now a 9th Extreme Golden Core cultivator. I can easily suppress someone with Master’s cultivation base. Moreover, I’ve also mastered spells and Special Abilities I inherited from my phoenix bloodline. They’re really powerful so I can look after myself. Due to my phoenix bloodline, I can sense there’s a huge opportunity waiting for me outside. If I can grasp it, I’ll definitely experience another great boost in my strength!”
“You’re so powerful now? I didn’t know your bloodline came with those things.” Jiang Ming was shocked. However, he shook his head and said, “You’re too young. When it comes to cultivating, you should take one step at a time. Don’t take risks when it’s unnecessary. There’ll always be other opportunities in the future.”
“But I want to go, Senior Brother!”
“No!”
“Fine, I’ll sneak out then!”
“If you dare, I’ll spank you like when you were little!”
“I don’t care!”
“Are you not going to listen to me anymore?”
“Please, Senior Brother. It’s just this once. I’m worried I won’t be able to protect you if the sect is under attack. What would I do at that time? Now that I have an opportunity, at least let me try. Don’t worry, Senior Brother. I promise to leave if I encounter the devils!”
Upon hearing these words, Jiang Ming felt distressed. He hugged her and said, “Don’t worry. Nothing will go wrong as long as I’m here. You’re still so young, and yet, you’re already worried about so many things. I feel distressed seeing you like this.”
“Senior Brother,” Linglong said softly, “The devil sects are already making their moves. It’ll only become more dangerous from here on out. I’ll have to venture out of the sect to kill the enemies sooner or later. Why can’t I seize the opportunity now to improve my strength? Please, Senior Brother, just this once! I promise I’ll listen to you in the future. With my strength, I’m confident I’ll be able to escape from Dao Seed cultivators even if I can’t kill them. Moreover, I have the protective Artifact that the Sect Master gave me. I’ll be safe!”
Jiang Ming could sense Linglong’s determination. He knew that even if he refused her, she would still sneak out. In the end, he had no choice but to nod. “Alright.”
With her cultivation base at the 9th Extreme Golden Core Realm, she should be powerful enough to protect herself.
Jiang Ming thought to himself, ‘Moreover, I’ll be protecting her from the shadows. I should let her go. She’s grown up, after all. She’ll have to venture outside eventually…”
A surge of emotions welled up in Jiang Ming’s heart when he thought about this.. For some reason, he felt lonely.

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Huge Reward on the Third Anniversary
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Linglong left the next day.
Gu Hai tried to stop her by force, but she trapped him in a Sword Formation. Then, she giggled and waved at Jiang Ming before she flew away to join the other disciples. With that, she left to slay the devils.
The Sect Master did not stop Linglong.
“Look at her!” Jiang Ming sighed emotionally.
When the Human Path Records appeared and flipped to Linglong’s place, he studied the information carefully.
When the Sword Formation finally lost its effect, Gu Hai brought his wine gourd out with a sullen expression on his face. After taking a few swigs, he said with a sigh, “I can’t believe her strength has already surpassed mine. To think I’m her master. I’m truly getting old. I can only manage you from now on. Ming, you’re guilty of being unable to keep Linglong in check. You should be punished according to our old rules.”
“Don’t vent your anger on me, old geezer!” Jiang Ming rolled his eyes. He thought to himself, ‘I can blow off your head if I want to!”
Gu Hai continued to sulk as he said, “Go prepare our next meal.”
Jiang Ming was speechless. As a disciple, he could only obey his master’s orders.
After the meal, Gu Hai rushed to the great hall so he could learn more about the situation outside.
With that, Jiang Ming was alone again. He called up Linglong’s information again.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Ninth Extreme Golden Core Realm
Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 95.
Innate Talent: Ten stars (primary phoenix bloodline)
Status: Left the sect to slay the devils.
He would glance at her information from time to time.
…
When night fell, Jiang Ming left the sect gates and found his junior sister soon after.
He noticed there were more than 20 male and female disciples in their group. Most of them were Core Formation cultivators. The leaders were two Purple Mansion experts from Taiyang Peak. A Dao Seed elder was also tailing them from the shadows.
The safety measures were sufficient.
After all, the powerful experts of the devil sects were either being monitored by Qingyun Sect or were still too afraid to show themselves for now.
Jiang Ming watched his junior sister from afar before he slipped into the void and traveled tens of thousands of miles before the night was even half over. He spread his senses as far and wide as he could. When he determined there were no devils who could be of threat to his junior sister and the other disciples, he returned to Chuyang Peak, feeling more at ease.
…
After washing up, Jiang Ming sat cross-legged on his bed as he silently waited for midnight to come. Based on his prediction, he would be greatly rewarded for the third anniversary. He was filled with excitement and anticipation and found it difficult to calm down.
When it was finally time…
[Ding! Congratulations on living at Chuyang Peak for three years and carrying out menial tasks every day. Reward: 1,000 years’ worth of cultivation, an earth spiritual fruit, a sky spiritual fruit, 100 Enlightening Tea Leaves (high-grade), 50 Enlightening Stones (rare), a spiritual spring (top-grade), Enlightening Tea Plant Seed (immortal-grade)]
[Ding! The beginner phase has ended!]
[Ding! An ordinary life isn’t a life of labor! Ordinary doesn’t have to mean mediocre. Ordinary doesn’t mean endless toiling. Protecting one’s home while living a carefree life is what being ordinary means!]
[Ding! The spiritual farmland that can be developed in the future will depend on your cultivation base. With a Dao Seed cultivation base, you can develop five Mu of spiritual farmland]
[Ding! Spiritual seeds have to be at the low grade at least before they can be planted on the spiritual farm. The higher the grade, the greater the reward will be during the harvest]
[Ding! Here’s to wishing you’ll be able to understand the true meaning of being ordinary and to surpassing yourself as you live your life]
The series of notifications came to an abrupt stop after that.
Jiang Ming was surprised. However, a bitter smile soon appeared on his face. He had a feeling that something was not right when he developed the farmland in the past. After all, if he kept developing the lands, he would be receiving an endless stream of rewards. The rewards he received previously were rather shocking. As expected, the beginner phase was over after three years.
The system was imposing restrictions on him now.
“Ordinary, huh? Being carefree and ordinary?” Jiang Ming mulled over this, but he could not understand what the system meant by surpassing his own ordinariness.
After a while, he shook his head and dismissed his thoughts. ‘Who cares? I don’t mind as long as there are benefits. The rewards this time are great as well. I received 1,000 years’ worth of cultivation. I wonder if this is because it’s the end of the beginner phase. I hope there’ll be big rewards like this in the future.’
Then, Jiang Ming took a look at his rewards.
The earth and sky spiritual fruits were similar to the human spiritual fruit he received in the past. They were rare items that would boost his chances of attaining enlightenment. He was certain these fruits were more potent as well.
Based on the description, the sky spiritual fruit was comparable to immortal items.
Jiang Ming did not hesitate. He brought it out and consumed it immediately.
Following that, he felt as though his mind was running at least 1,000 times faster than before. His mind seemed to merge with the world as he contemplated the laws of the world. He could even sense certain characters appearing in his mind.
This effect was similar to the effects of the Enlightening Tea Leaves.
Jiang Ming was amazed and motivated. “The Grand Path is close at hand!”
Although his improvements were not very noticeable, they were more precious than 1,000 years’ worth of cultivation.
He did not have many comments about the Enlightening Tea Leaves and Stones this time around.
Another thing that surprised him was the top-grade spiritual spring. When he brought it out, it settled into the ground and took root. It tapped into the spiritual veins in its vicinity and absorbed the heaven and earth essence. Then, it changed the environment by increasing the density of the spiritual qi before forming pure spiritual liquid. It could turn an ordinary place into a Sacred Land for cultivation. It could be used to establish Sacred Lands.
Jiang Ming was filled with praise. “This is wonderful!”
Following that, he cast an Earth spell to dig a space underground in the courtyard. Then, he activated the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Plate to keep the spot hidden.
He brought out the spiritual spring, which seemed like a bottomless aquarium, and set it on the ground where it took root and formed a spring.
At the same time, characters silently appeared along the ley lines.
Buzz!
The spring rippled before releasing very rich Qi. The space he cleared out was filled with spiritual qi that was in the form of a mist.
The spiritual fluid that appeared that was of the high-grade at least appeared as well.
“This is great. How lucky!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
Then, he used a Formation to spread the spiritual qi to every corner of Chuyang Peak. Following that, the Formation circulated the spiritual qi at the peak.
“Someone will eventually notice the changes at Chuyang Peak, but oh, well.” Jiang Ming shrugged as he considered several matters.
After that, he leaped onto the rooftop to have a look. He saw the mist lingering in the air around the mountain. The mist was the spiritual fluid that was being circulated around the mountain.
“I’ll turn this place into a blessed land in the future…”
After that, he looked at the final reward.
The immortal-grade Tea Plant Seeds were an item of the immortals. It would be difficult to grow them in the mortal realm. It could be nourished with pseudo-immortal power every day or by a top-grade spiritual spring for it to germinate and slowly grow.
“How thoughtful of the system! It gave me a top-grade spiritual spring and an immortal-grade seed. I wonder how long it will take for the seed to grow into tea leaves?”
Alas, Jiang Ming did not receive any answer from the system.
He shook his head. He did not look forward to the fruits of this immortal item. They would be useless if he had to wait for 10,000 years for it to produce tea leaves.
‘I wonder what effects it would have on me if I eat the seed?’ A strange idea appeared in Jiang Ming’s mind, and he was itching to try it out.

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - The Great Manifestation Technique; The Tomb of Extreme Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: The Great Manifestation Technique; The Tomb of Extreme Path
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Main cultivation: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Spell: Primal Spirit Heart Sword, Ten Thousand Sword Technique, Basic Formation, Basic Talisman, Basic Pills, Basic Instrumentation
Special Ability: Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Wooden Dragon, Slice the Heavens Sword, and Heaven Suppression Divine Seal.
Innate talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Items: Human Path Records, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Plate, middle-grade Dao Vessel Tyrant Halberd, three high-grade Shadowless Needles, high-grade Purple Cloud, high-grade Blue Crystal, low-grade Noble Robe, top-grade Weapon Flowing Cloud Sword, 3,000 years of cultivation, 200 Enlightening Tea Leaves, 80 single-use rare Enlightening Stones, a Space Crystal, an immortal-grade Enlightening Tea Seed
Jiang Ming looked at his inventory. It was quite abundant.
He felt rather uneasy so he called up the Human Path Records to check on his Junior Sister. He discovered there were not many changes. He scratched his head as he muttered to himself, “Am I worrying too much? She’s at the 9th Stage of the Golden Core Realm and has mastered many powerful spells. No one, not even the First Seats’ disciple, can harm her. Moreover, she can easily kill Purple Mansion cultivators and escape from ordinary Dao Seed cultivators. Why am I still worried? I feel like her father…”
Apart from that, Jiang Ming had also been worried about the Yinmo Sect and the Bishui Sect. He had a strong feeling that trouble was just around the corner. Moreover, his cultivation base was only in the Dao Seed Realm. This meant that he could only hold his own against Primal Spirit cultivators at most; he could not kill or defeat them at all. This made him feel very insecure.
After a moment, he cleared his head of unwanted thoughts and muttered, “I should cultivate now.”
Now that he was in the possession of a lot of Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones, coupled with the Earth Spiritual Fruit and Heaven Spiritual Fruit he had consumed, his cultivation should progress smoothly.
Jiang Ming brought out a teapot from his storage ring. With a wave of his hand, he brought out a stream of water from the spiritual spring and moved it into the teapot. Subsequently, he placed an Enlightening Tea Leaf into the pot and began to heat the pot with his hands. In just a moment, the water was already boiling. When it was finally done, he poured the tea into a teacup and blew on it before he took a sip.
Following that, he sat cross-legged and closed his eyes. As his mind merged with nature, he could keenly sense the wonders of nature, the principles of creation and reincarnation, and various Dao rhythms.
Whenever he comprehended a new Sambodha, he would form a new Dao Seed. He would continue to comprehend the Sambodha to grow the seeds. If he only had one Dao Seed, he would have long been able to break through the Nascent Soul Realm with the mana he had accumulated.
…
The next day.
After Jiang Ming stopped cultivating, he fetched water, swept the courtyard, and made breakfast. Having breakfast alone reminded him of his junior sister’s absence. Hence, he called?up the Human Path Records again to check on her. He also looked at Yue Cheng and Momo’s pages, but to his disappointment, there were no changes as well.
After breakfast, he went to the back of the mountain and thought about what else he could do with the farmland. While he walked to the back of the mountain, he called up the Human Path Records again.
A short while later, when he reached the bank of a lake, he brought out a fishing rod before he sat down. Similar to before, he felt compelled to call up the Human Path Records.
By midday, he had already called up the Human Path Records five times.
Jiang Ming smiled wryly. “Why am I so worried?”
As Jiang Ming made his way to the rooftop, he thought to himself resolutely, ‘From now on, I’ll check it once, no, twice a day at most. I’ll check it once in the morning and once at night.”
Following that, he sat in the pavilion with his legs crossed and began to cultivate.
…
The days continued to pass, and the mountains remained uneventful.
Jiang Ming used two to three Enlightening Tea Leaves daily. As a result, the Dao Seeds in his sea of consciousness continued to grow rapidly. At the same time, he spent time mastering his special ability as well. Although his cultivation base remained the same, his combat strength had grown stronger.
…
In just a blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
In the evening.
Next to the lake.
Jiang Ming was fishing silently at this moment. This remained part of his routine apart from cultivating.
Due to his unique cultivation method, it was easy for him to comprehend a Sambodha. To comprehend another Sambodha, he would need some time for the transitioning process. Daily menial tasks and manual labor were the best way for him to increase the speed of his cultivation.
At this time, Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up when his fishing rod sank slightly.
Without casting a spell or using a special ability, he reeled the fish in. A fish that was longer than 2 meters with pitch-black scales, a large mouth, and two whiskers leaped out of the lake. It flapped its body in a frenzy, stirring up waves on the previously calm surface of the lake.
[Ding! Congratulations on catching a 200-year-old Black Dragon Loach! Reward: A special ability, the Great Manifestation Technique!]
Jiang Ming was stunned when he heard the system notification. He knew about the Black Dragon Loach. Since it carried a trace amount of the dragon bloodline, it could evolve into a dragon once its cultivation base reached a certain stage. A 200-year-old Black Dragon Loach had a strong internal force so it was equivalent to being in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Based on Jiang Ming’s speculation, the Black Dragon Loach must have been wandering the mountain streams that led to the lake since it did not know how to cultivate demonic energy.
Now that the spiritual energy in Chuyang Peak had soared, it was only natural that the lake here was dense with spiritual energy as well. As a result, it attracted the Black Dragon Loach.
‘I’ll let it live for now, and stew it for Junior Sister when she returns…’ Jiang Ming thought to himself as he returned the Black Dragon Loach to the lake.
The Black Dragon Loach swam away swiftly, vanishing from sight in just an instant.
Following that, Jiang Ming looked at the special ability, the Great Manifestation Technique, that he had just received.
It was a great spell to create a clone of himself. An ordinary manifestation technique relied on one’s mana. This meant that the clone would not last for a long time, and it was not very strong. On the other hand, the Great Manifestation Technique did not only rely on mana. One could also rely on one’s blood essence or a spiritual object to power the clone. High-grade spirit items could carry more of their owners’ powers. Apart from that, the power could be restored after it was depleted. This meant that the clone would not vanish quickly.
“This is great!” Jiang Ming was ecstatic. This reward was the best reward he had received over the past few days.
“After I form a clone of myself, I can leave the mountain easily,” Jiang Ming said to himself excitedly.
In fact, he had wanted to see the world beyond the mountain. However, due to his low cultivation base and safety, he thought it was best to stay on the mountain.
After obtaining the system, his cultivation had improved greatly. However, for some reason, he still remained on the mountain.
After he put away the fishing rod, he returned to his room.
He brewed a pot of tea before he began to comprehend the special ability. It took him the time to finish a cup of tea to master the special ability to the rudimentary stage.
When he opened his eyes, he exhaled a wisp of vital energy. There was a flash of light before a figure that was identical to him appeared in front of him.
‘A clone formed from vital energy is the lowest level of manifestation. It only carries a wisp of my consciousness and less than a millionth of my strength. Moreover, I won’t be able to recover the depleted power. It’s like a disposable item…’ Jiang Ming thought to himself. He knew that manifesting a duplicate of himself meant he would have to divide his consciousness into two so that he could do two things at once.
Swoosh!
The clone vanished along with the vital energy; only the wisp of consciousness returned to him.
Following that, Jiang Ming rose to his feet and moved his hand, releasing strands of consciousness and Qi to form 81 clones of himself.
“Amazing!”
His 81 clones were capable of acting on their own. They looked at each other at this moment as though they were sizing each other up.
“The clones are quite flawless…”
After a while, Jiang Ming finally withdrew the clones. After all, he had no use for them now.
‘I should spend more time mastering this technique so I can form a clone whose energy can be recovered…’
At this time, night had already fallen. The moon illuminated the night sky as the stars shone next to it.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records to check on his junior sister again.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: 9th Extreme of the Golden Core Realm
Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak.
Relationship: 95
Innate Talent: Ten stars (primary phoenix bloodline)
Status: Encountered and fought the experts from the Devil Sect. The elders of Jiuyang Sect who are secretly protecting the disciples had to reveal themselves. The group was separated, and she hid in the forest. She used a secret technique to hide her presence. She has just discovered and entered a Tomb of Extreme Path. She found the medicine king’s essence and is currently refining it..

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - The Revival of the Empress Soul and Soaring Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: The Revival of the Empress’ Soul and Soaring Strength
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was surprised that his Junior Sister ran into the experts from the Devil Sect. Moreover, the experts from the Devil Sect were strong enough to force the Jiuyang Sect elders to show themselves. Nevertheless, he was pleased that she managed to escape.
Apart from that, he was also amazed his Junior Sister managed to stumble upon the Tomb of Extreme Path. He began to grow slightly suspicious. Before she left, she had told him she could sense a great opportunity waiting for her outside. Then, she did not even leave that long ago, but she had already stumbled upon a great opportunity. Moreover, he was also bewildered by how easily she had obtained the legacy without encountering any danger.
Jiang Ming knew what the Extreme Path was. He had read about it in ‘A Detailed Explanation on Human Cultivation Realms’. There were ten cultivation realms: Qi Cultivation, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Purple Mansion, Dao Seed, Nascent Soul, Primal Spirit, Paradis, Extreme Path, and Imminent Immortal.
An Extreme Path expert was so strong that he or she could easily annihilate the Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet; he could not help but feel worried. After a moment, he vanished from sight as soon as the void began to distort and ripple. When he reappeared, he was already far from the mountain entrance. Then, in the next second, he vanished again.
…
The bright moon hung in the dark sky as Jiang Ming traveled using the Akasa Network at an incredibly fast pace. At the same time, he swept through the surroundings with his consciousness.
In the end, he found three of Jiuyang Sect disciples who were with his Junior Sister earlier. As for the others, he had no idea if they were alive or dead. However, since the three disciples only looked tired and not sad, he assumed the others were only separated and still alive.
Jiang Ming did not show himself. Instead, he called up the Human Path Records and checked on his Junior Sister’s status.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Purple Mansion Realm
Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 95
Innate Talent: Immortal(primary phoenix bloodline)
Status: She has successfully refined the medicine king’s essence, opened up her sea of consciousness, and broke through to the Purple Mansion Realm. She rested for a while and is now continuing to absorb the refined medicine king’s essence, which raised her cultivation base tremendously.
“Is Junior Sister the protagonist or the heaven’s child?” Jiang Ming wondered out loud. His Junior Sister’s progress was heaven-defying!
When his Junior Sister awakened her phoenix bloodline, she was still a naive little girl with not much experience both social and cultivation-wise. Her swift and sudden rise to the 9th Stage of the Golden Core Realm could be explained by her extraordinary bloodline. However, to progress to the Purple Mansion Realm when she was away from the mountain without any protection was truly baffling. It could be attributed to her bloodline alone.
Apart from that, her innate talent had risen as well. Jiang Ming was not certain if there were grades for ‘Immortal’ innate talent, but it should be almost impossible for one to raise one’s innate talent. After all, there was a reason it was called ‘innate’ talent. It was something given by the heavens and something one was born with. However, his Junior Sister’s innate talent had risen from 8 Stars to Immortal.
In the end, he concluded his Junior Sister must have obtained a Clock of Fortune or something like that.
The thing that pleased him the most was despite his Junior Sister’s tremendous improvement, their relationship value remained the same.
Jiang Ming searched around for the Tomb of Extreme Path, but his efforts were in vain. When dawn was close at hand, he called up the Human Path Records again. When he saw there were no changes, he decided to return to the mountain.
‘Since Junior Sister is abnormally lucky, she should be fine,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself in an attempt to reassure himself.
…
After returning to the mountain, he brewed a pot of tea before he began to cultivate.
The Dao rhythm rang in his ears. The sound of deadly silence from ancient times, the vibrant sound of creation and nature, the silent buzz of killing intent, and the energy fluctuations that were like wind blades entered his ears one after another.
…
Jiang Ming improved tremendously every day.
Apart from cultivating, he had also spared time to look for spiritual seeds. He had also asked for Chunyang Peak’s Zhang Junbao’s help to look for spiritual seeds. With that, he continued to farm.
…
In just a blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
When Jiang Ming checked on his Junior Sister, he was shocked and bewildered. His Junior Sister was now in the Dao Seed Realm. He exclaimed in shock, “How’s this possible?”
If he did not have the Human Path Records, he would have thought his Junior Sister’s soul had been swapped out from her body.
‘One can only break through to the Dao Seed Realm after filling the Purple Mansion with mana. One also needed to form a Dao Seed by comprehending a Sambodha. All of this would take a long time to accomplish so how did she break through so quickly? Does she have a system as well?’ Jiang Ming wondered inwardly, perplexed.
‘Although I have a system that provides me with cheats, I’m only at the Dao Seed Realm. Junior Sister started cultivating later than I did, but we have the same cultivation base now. Who would believe that a 13-year-old girl is a Dao Seed cultivator?’ Jiang Ming smiled wryly as he thought about this.
If it were not for the fact that their relationship value did not change, he would have suspected that something was terribly wrong with his junior sister.
In the end, he could only tell himself that his junior sister was just extremely lucky. At the same time, he was no longer worried about her since he knew she was now capable of protecting herself.
Jiang Ming smiled and shook his head as he thought to himself, ‘I should cultivate diligently as well. Otherwise, I’d have to rely on Junior Sister to protect me in the future.”
There were quite a few Dao Seeds in Jiang Ming’s sea of consciousness. He had gathered the five elemental Dao Seeds such as wood, fire, earth, metal, and water. Apart from that, there were also thunder, wind, life, death, and other seeds.
He was preparing to merge the five elements and to comprehend the mysteries of Yin Yang and the law of space. He knew he had a long journey ahead of him. Fortunately, he had a huge supply of mana. All he needed to do was drink the tea he brewed with the Enlightening Tea Leaves and cultivate.
…
In the main hall of Jiuyang Sect’s main peak.
Gu Hai asked with a worried expression, “Sect Master, do you have any news about Linglong? It’s been three months since she left! Most of the disciples who left with her have already returned. Why don’t we have news about her? Did you really send people to look for her?”
Dongfang Lie, the First Seat of Lieyang Peak, snorted. “Gu Hai, watch your words. Linglong has a high innate talent and should’ve stayed in the sect to cultivate. However, you let her venture down the mountain! Do you feel you have too many disciples on Chuyang Peak? Or do you think the sect doesn’t have a need for a rare genius like her? You should’ve been stripped of your position as the First Seat a long time ago!”
“You!” Gu Hai was furious.
At this time, Yin Yue, the First Seat of Jiaoyang Peak, cocked an eyebrow and said, “Dongfang Lie, the Sect Master agreed to let Linglong leave the sect. I remember you agreed as well. In fact, you even said it’s good for a talented disciple like Linglong to venture out and gain experience. Now that things don’t look good, you intend to push all the blame to Senior Brother Gu?”
Yue Cheng, the First Seat of Zhiyang Peak, tried to mediate and said, “Alright, alright. Little Linglong is highly talented and blessed. I’m sure she’s fine. Moreover, no news is good news, right?”
At this moment, a streak of light suddenly shot into the main hall.
When the Sect Master caught it in his hand, the light dissipated, revealing a letter. After reading the letter, he rose to his feet abruptly with a furious expression on his face.
Upon seeing this, Gu Hai trembled slightly as his face turned pale. He asked, “W-what happened? D-did something happen to Linglong?”

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - A Beautiful Scene That Almost Caused a Nosebleed
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: A Beautiful Scene That Almost Caused a Nosebleed
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
When Gu Hai returned in the evening, a frown was etched on his face. He looked worried.
After Jiang Ming brought a seat for his master, he brewed a pot of tea as he asked, “What’s wrong, Master? Do we have any news about Junior Sister yet?”
“No,” Gu Hai said as he shook his head, “Nevertheless, your Junior Sister is very lucky so I’m sure she’s safe.”
“I agree.” Jiang Ming nodded. After tea was brewed, he poured a cup of tea for Gu Hai. Then, he said with a smile, “Junior Sister used to say she broke the record in Jiuyang Sect when she entered the 9th Stage of the Golden Core Realm. How can anything bad happen to a person who’s so lucky like her? Don’t worry. She’ll be back soon.”
Gu Hai forced a smile on his face and said, “I hope so.” After taking a sip from the teacup, he continued to say, “The Sect Master received news that a powerful foreign sect has moved to the Eastern Region’s Hai Province. Not only is there the resurgence of the devil sects, but now, there’s also a possibility of invasion by a foreign sect. This is a truly troublesome year!”
“Powerful foreign sect? How powerful? How can a foreign sect thrive in Hai Province?” Jiang Ming toyed with the teacup in his hand as he said, “The Jiang clan, Feiyun Sect, and Tian Shui Sect are the three main forces in Hai Province. Although individually they aren’t as strong as Jiuyang Sect, collectively, they’re as strong as us. How can they let a foreign sect move into their territory? Moreover, our Jiuyang Sect is located in Qing Province that neighbors Hai Province. Isn’t the foreign sect afraid of our sect attacking them?”
The Eastern Region has nine provinces: Feng Province, Yu Province, Lei Province, Yun Province, Shui Province, Wu Province, Mu Province, Qing Province, and Hai Province. Hai Province was located near the sea, neighboring Qing Province.
“I heard the Sect Master said that the foreign sect is called Bishui Sect. It’s powerful, and it moved in quietly without alerting anyone. It destroyed the Feiyun Sect and subjugated the Jiang clan. The Tianshui Sect has just requested our assistance,” Gu Hai explained. He smiled wryly as he continued to say, “In the early days, Bishui Sect would’ve been met with the fury of the entire Eastern Region. Alas, currently, there’s the resurgence of the devil sects. Bishui Sect has also announced that now they’ve moved here, they’re willing to obey the Qingyun Sect and fight the devil sects to death. From the looks of it, it’s likely that the Bishui Sect had bribed the Qingyun Sect with some rare and precious gifts. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have had the guts to act in such a manner.”
“Bishui Sect?” Jiang Ming frowned.
A few months ago, when Jiang Ming was chasing after Ge Changqing and Mu Lei of the Qingyun Sect, he had met Lan Shi, the elder of Bishui Sect. At that time, Lan Shi was plotting with the Sima clan on how to gain a foothold in the Eastern Region. Based on how Lan Shi had tried to save Mu Lei at that time to curry favor and forge a connection with the Qingyun Sect at that time, it was clear the Bishui Sect had yet to form any relationship with the Qingyun Sect at that time.
After Lan Shi’s death, Bishui Sect should be in chaos. Jiang Ming did not understand how they could have made such a strong move in Hai Province after only a few months. Nevertheless, he was certain, just like his master, that the Bishui Sect must have given the Qingyun Sect something incredibly precious. Otherwise, Qingyun Sect certainly would not have overlooked Bishui’s sudden move to the Eastern Region’s Hai Province. After all, Qingyun Sect was the Eastern Region’s Sacred Land. Although there were still many uncertainties, it was likely that war would break out sooner or later in the Eastern Region if this continued.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming could see that his master was still worried about Linglong. It was not difficult to tell that his master was afraid the young girl who had yet to be found had fallen into the hands of the devil sect. He could only continue to say reassuringly, “Master, don’t worry. I’m sure Junior Sister is safe!”
Jiang Ming could naturally empathize with his master. After all, if he did not have the Human Path Records, he would likely be even more worried than his master.
Gu Hai only nodded. Following that, he asked Jiang Ming to cook him a sumptuous meal for dinner to satiate his appetite before he returned to the main hall in the main peak again.
After Gu Hai left, Jiang Ming cleaned up before he flew up to the rooftop and sat on the reclining chair. Then, he called up the Human Path Records as he thought about the Bishui Sect.
Name: Jiang Momo
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Late-stage Foundation Establishment Realm.
