Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Jiaoyang Peak (Note: She’s actually from the Bishui Sect; she’s also the daughter of Fairy Shuiyue)
Relationship: 63
Status: She has received an order from Bishui Sect to send information about the Jiuyang Sect. The information that was requested pertained to the strongest expert’s cultivation base, the number of experts, the state of the Formation at the mountain entrance, and so on. She’s currently facing a dilemma. After all, although she was from Bishui Sect, she grew up and was raised in Jiuyang Sect.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming muttered under his breath. He had no conflict with Momo. In fact, he had a rather good impression of her. However, if she were to betray the Jiuyang Sect, then he would not hesitate to act. He would kill her as soon as the chance presented itself.
‘Bishui Sect is where she was born, but Jiuyang Sect is where she was raised. Indeed, it’s a rather difficult choice to make,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself. He wondered how she had come to join the Jiuyang Sect but could not come up with an answer.
Following that, he wrote down the names of disciples at Jiaoyang Peak on the Human Path Records to check if there were any more spies from the Bishui Sect. Fortunately, there was none.
‘I should continue checking daily…’
Jiang Ming did not withdraw the Human Path Records. Instead, he flipped to his Junior Sister’s page to check on her again. Her cultivation base was still at the Dao Seed Realm. From her status, he learned that she had left the ruin after collecting the treasures in the Tomb of Extreme Path.
‘Junior Sister should be returning to the sect now!’ Jiang Ming was overjoyed. He was filled with the urge to go beyond the mountain entrance. After all, he was no longer restricted by the sect’s Formation. With his current knowledge about Formations, he could easily break the Formation with his eyes closed. Although he had only studied the Basic Formations given by the system, they were judged as basic by the system. This meant the Formations were not necessarily basic.
After leaving the sect’s estate, he discovered he had nowhere to go. Hence, he could only smile wryly and return to the mountain.
He returned to the rooftop again and looked at the surrounding mountains. At the same time, he had called up the Human Path Records again. After looking at his Junior Sister and Jiang Momo’s information again, he looked at Yue Cheng’s information as well.
Jiang Ming sighed when he saw Jiang Momo’s status. He learned that she was now preparing to leave the sect under the pretext of waiting for Zi Linglong’s return. In fact, she was leaving to send out information to the Bishui Sect.
He thought about leaving the mountain again to check on Jiang Momo before he decided against it for now. With just a thought, he extended a strand of his divine consciousness out. He was very cautious since he was not certain he would be able to hide his aura from First Seat Yin Yue. However, when the scene in Jiaoyang Peak appeared before his eyes, blood almost gushed out of his nostrils.
“Ah! I’m sorry! I don’t mean it!”
The disciples at Jiaoyang Peak were all female. Through his divine consciousness, he saw a wonderful scene. He saw a few disciples cultivating quietly as they soaked in the hot spring, two disciples tumbling playfully on the bed, and another two cultivating in a bed of flowers as they held hands.
Usually, one would be able to see a scene as it was through divine consciousness. However, perhaps, his divine consciousness was different. He could see through things like robes and what underneath them as though he had x-ray vision.
When he saw this scene, he was filled with embarrassment, anticipation, and a strong urge to take action. It took him quite a while to calm down.
After a while, when he finally found Jiang Momo, he sent a strand of his consciousness into her mind to hypnotize her before he quietly withdrew his consciousness without leaving any traces behind.
Jiang Ming massaged his temples. When he looked in the direction of Jiaoyang Peak, his eyes sparkled. He had to inhale deeply and clear his mind of distracting thoughts before he finally calmed down again. He thought to himself, ‘No wonder people say that beauties can cause the downfalls of heroes.’
Shortly afterward, he checked on junior sister again.
“F*ck!”
He discovered she had run into two devil experts. He did not hesitate and hurriedly flew away.
…
At the same time.
At Jiaoyang Peak.
Jiang Momo was kneeling in front of Yin Yue.
“Momo, what is it that you need to talk about that can’t wait until tomorrow?”
Without any warning, Jiang Momo blurted out, “Master, I’m originally a disciple of Bishui Sect.”
“What?!” Needless to say, Yin Yue was shocked by Jiang Momo’s sudden confession..

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - The Mighty Linglong and Bai Yu from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: The Mighty Linglong and Bai Yu from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion
As soon as Jiang Ming left the mountain, he moved at top speed as he mobilized all his mana. In just a second, he was already a thousand miles away. He looked like a meteor as he traveled in the night sky. At the same time, he extended a strand of his divine consciousness, sensing the auras in the distance.
Eventually, he looked in the southeastern direction and saw a faint divine light. The power it emitted was rather powerful. He wondered inwardly, ‘Is she there?’
He moved in that direction as anxiety gripped his heart. He was worried about his junior sister going up against two devils. She would be able to kill them if their cultivation bases were lower than her, but if their cultivation bases were also at the Dao Seed Realm, he was not sure she could defeat them due to her lack of combat experience.
…
Previously, Zi Linglong did not waste time and began to cultivate as soon as she discovered the Tomb of Extreme Path based on her memory. With that, her cultivation soared until she broke through to the Dao Seed Realm. Prior to that, she had maintained her cultivation base at the Golden Core Realm to accumulate more mana before she opened up her Purple Mansion. This was so she could quickly fill up the mana in her Purple Mansion after she broke through to the Purple Mansion Realm. With that, she would be able to directly break through to the Dao Seed Realm.
After entering the Dao Seed Realm, she needed more time to form Dao Seeds by comprehending Sambodhas. She wanted to build a strong foundation so she would not have any regrets in the future so she stopped cultivating after forming a few Dao Seeds, which were fire, wind, and thunder. Apart from that, she had been away for too long so she did not want her senior brother to worry about her. For all these reasons, she decided to resume cultivating after she returned to the mountain.
Before Zi Linglong left the Tomb of Extreme Path, she did not forget to bring all the treasures away. As soon as she stepped outside, a divine light burst forth from the tomb as energy began to fluctuate.
She frowned and shook her head. Although she had been the tomb in her past life, she only found it when it had been looted and destroyed. From her past life, she only knew the way to enter the tomb, the treasures, and the treasures’ locations. She did not know anything about the divine light.
As she glanced back at the tomb, “Are you trying to seek revenge from the person who looted your tomb by announcing it to the entire world?”
Following that, she sensed two auras rushing toward her direction. In just a second, two figures appeared and quickly released their energies to seal off the area.
“A cave?”
“An ancient ruin?”
The two newcomers, a young man and a middle-aged man, looked at each other excitedly. Then, they turned to look at Zi Linglong.
The young man standing on the left asked rudely, “Did you just come out from the ruin? What’s in there? Bring out all the things you obtained in there!”
The middle-aged man standing on the right emitted a faint aura, which clearly belonged to a high-grade Protective Robe. He held a sword, which was an Artifact, in his hand as he said threateningly, “We’re at the border of Qing Province and Hai Province. It’s now late in the night, and the mountains are deserted. No one’s around for thousands of miles. If you cooperate with us, we’ll let you leave in peace.” Then, he smirked and said lewdly, “Otherwise, I’ll toy with you…”
Zi Linglong sneered before she said tonelessly, “I’ll only say this once: move out of my way!”
Then, a slight frown appeared on her face as she looked at the distant sky from the corners of her eyes.
The young man laughed out loud upon hearing Zi Linglong’s words. “What an arrogant little girl! Forget about leaving! I’m going to capture you back with me and make you my concubine!”
Swoosh!
As soon as the young man’s voice fell, Zi Linglong raised her hand. A long sword materialized immediately. An energy sword shot out at lightning speed, leaving ripples in the void, before it cleaved the young man into two.
“Liu Kong!” the middle-aged man cried out. A black energy rose from his body, forming a strong defensive shield as he swiftly retreated. He knew the young man had just broken through to the Dao Seed Realm, and yet, the young man was easily cleaved into two in just an instant. Even he, who was at the peak of the Dao Seed Realm, was incapable of such a feat. Hence, he decided to flee.
“Trying to flee?” Zi Linglong scoffed. A whistling sound rang in the air as she thrust her sword out and accurately pierced through the middle-aged man’s skull.
Zi Linglong snorted coldly. Along with a whistling sound, she thrust her sword forward.
“I just came out to look for women to have fun with, how did things…” the man said in despair before Zi Linglong’s sword accurately pierced through his skull.
Zi Linglong’s eyes narrowed when she heard the middle-aged man’s dying words. Currently, she could easily kill anyone who had the same cultivation base as her.
Zi Linglong did not waste time and left the site. After all, who knew if the two men had friends in the area. In just a blink of an eye, she traveled a thousand miles away.
She suddenly came to a halt when she saw the void rippling up ahead. The clouds parted and revealed a flying ship that was inscribed with countless glowing inscriptions. She sighed inwardly and lamented her bad luck.
The flying ship was three stories high. A pavilion made from polished crystals was erected on the top floor. Translucent drapes that shone in the moonlight fluttered around the pavilion.
Eight female dancers danced as a young man watched them with great interest. Three middle-aged men dressed in dark golden robes sat next to him, silently sipping from their teacups. On the deck, there were roughly 100 warriors in silver armor neatly lined up in two rows. All of their auras were strong, and they were Purple Mansion cultivators.
Zi Linglong thought that the leader of these silver-armored warriors must be powerful or had high status since he or she was able to command so many Purple Mansion cultivators. After a quick look, she noticed something strange about the silver-armored warriors. Their faces, necks, arms, and other parts of their bodies that were exposed were all veiny and scaly. With this, realization dawned on her immediately.
“They’re from one of the sea clans!”
At this time, the young man rose to his feet and introduced himself. He bowed and said with a smile, “Miss, I’m Bai Haitian. The night is still young, and I’m wide awake. Would you like to have a drink with me?”
The young man’s face was fair, and he was handsome. His smile was very bright as well.
Nevertheless, Zi Linglong responded indifferently, “What if I refuse?”
Bai Haitian smiled. “I don’t usually force people. After all, with just a word of hello, millions of girls would flock to me…” Then, his expression darkened as he continued to say, “However, if someone I’m interested in refuses me…”
Bai Haitian waved his hand, causing to drapes to flutter, before he continued to say in a threatening tone, “I’ll take pleasure from her body before I cook her. Then, I’ll continue savoring her body!”
“You loach! F*ck off!” Zi Linglong said furiously.
Bai Haitian said frostily, “It’s best you don’t refuse me.”
Before Bai Haitian could say anything else, Zi Linglong brought out her sword and released a destructive wave of the sword Sambodha. It sailed in the air and parted the clouds in its path. She was determined to kill everyone who stood in her way or harbored ill intentions toward her.
Swoosh!
The flying ship suddenly burst forth with light as though it was trying to fend off the destructive force. Alas, it still hit the ship.
Zi Linglong’s sword Sambodha was so powerful now that it could cut all things.
Bai Haitian’s expression turned grim, but he did not dodge. This was because the three middle-aged men were now standing before him, shielding him.
Swoosh!
The divine light shrouding the pavilion could not keep the energy sword at bay. Only when the three middle-aged men joined forces did they manage to destroy the energy sword. Even then, they were pushed back.
Bai Haitian exclaimed in shock, “How powerful! How did you manage to release such a powerful sword Sambodha when you’re only in the Dao Seed Realm?”
Zi Linglong ignored Bai Haitian. Instead, she frowned as she was looking at the bottom of the flying ship. She sensed a stronger aura hiding in the flying ship when her attack breached the divine light from the flying ship. Although she was not afraid, she could not help but complain inwardly about her bad luck. She wanted to avoid people, but who knew she would run into the people from the sea clan? Finally, she turned to Bai Haitian and said, “Little loach, I’ll kill you sooner or later!”
At this time, a burst of laughter rang in the air. “Little loach? Well said!”
Then, a flash of light appeared as the void rippled in the distance. Following that, a group of people appeared before everyone’s eyes.
The young man in the lead rode on a white horse with dragon horns. Its four hooves treaded on the clouds, and it looked fearsome and majestic. Its body revealed its domineering strength and terrifying vital energy and blood. It was the legendary dragon horse, an immensely powerful bloodline from the devil race, and yet, it was now reduced to a mount.
Four snowy-white unicorns stood behind the white dragon horse. With just a brief glance, they could be mistaken for the dragon horse, but in reality, there was a world of a difference between them.
It did not take long for the group of newcomers to draw close to them.
Bai Haitian’s expression had darkened as soon as he saw the young man riding on the dragon horse. He said reproachfully, “How dare you ride the dragon horse! How dare you! And you, dragon horse, you bear the noble bloodline of the dragons! How dare you tarnish your bloodline by becoming a human’s mount? D*mn you!”
The dragon horse whinnied. It even exhaled a puff of flames through its nostrils. However, a gentle nudge from the young man riding it made it docile immediately.
The white-clad young man smiled as he looked at Bai Haitian and said, “I haven’t visited the sea yet during this trip to the Eastern Region. It’s good to meet you here! I’m going to cook you and see how tasty you are later!” Then, he shifted his gaze to Zi Linglong and said, “Miss, you really made me chase you a long way! I’m Bai Yu from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in Zhong Province. I accidentally found the note of Yun Tiankong, an Extreme Path expert. When he got grievously injured, he knew he would not live so he returned to the Eastern Region where he was born and raised. However, the places he knew no longer existed. After searching for a long time, I finally discovered he had buried himself near the border of Qing Province and Hai Province.”
Bai Yu paused for a moment before he continued to say, “I came and secretly searched that place three years ago, but my efforts were in vain. I thought the resurgence of the devil sects is due to the discovery of Yun Tiankong’s tomb, but it seems like that’s not the case. Fortunately, I didn’t give up. I didn’t expect that I would sense the Dao fluctuation of an Extreme Path expert tonight. I was overjoyed. Alas, when I arrived, I only saw the corpses of two devils. After that, I followed your lingering aura here.”
Bai Yu narrowed his eyes at this moment as he asked, “Miss, can you please tell me what you obtained from the tomb? If you tell me, I’ll catch that loach for you and even stew it for you. Moreover, you’ll also be considered a friend of the Infinity Alchemy Pavilion. In fact, if you want, I can get the pavilion to accept you as a disciple. With that, you’ll even have a chance of becoming a true disciple of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion.”
“The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?!” Bai Haitian, who was on the ship, exclaimed in shock. Then, he shouted, “Let’s leave!”
The flying ship burst forth with light, preparing to leave. However, before it could move, four of Bai Yu’s men suddenly vanished and reappeared in four different directions up ahead. Then, they brought out a large flag and thrust it down in the air, forming a great Formation that sealed off the entire place.
Bang!
The flying ship crashed against a barrier of light and bounced back. At the same time, the light around the ship dimmed as well.
“Sir!” Bai Haitian, who was standing at the top of the ship, forced a smile on his face before he bowed slightly at Bai Yu and said, “My surname is Bai as well. For the sake of the surname we share, can you please let us go?”
“You’re surname is Bai as well? Well, it seems like you’re entitled to a chance,” Bai Yu said with a raised eyebrow. Then, he demanded, “Kneel and apologize to this miss, and I’ll spare your life!”
“D*mn you!” Bai Haitian was thoroughly enraged. “Although the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion is strong, it’s in Zhong Province. Don’t forget that we’re now very close to the sea in the Eastern Region.. Moreover, you’re just a mere disciple of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! How dare you act so arrogantly, you brat! Let me kill and cook all of you today so I can have all of you for dinner with wine!”

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - Jiang Ming Enters the Battle and Begin to Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Jiang Ming Enters the Battle and Begin to Kill
When Jiang Ming arrived, he was furious when he saw his junior sister being surrounded. However, he did not act rashly. Instead, he hid himself in the void and called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Bai Haitian
Race: Scaled dragon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Purple Mansion Realm.
Background: The third son of the white scaled dragon king of the Eastern sea.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: 8 stars
Status: Came to the Eastern Region under the order of the white scaled dragon king to meet with the experts from the dragon sect to find out about the current situation. He planned to have fun during his trip and enjoy the beautiful scenery of mountains and rivers. While he was enjoying the scenery, he felt a strong fluctuation in the distance. When he was making his way to the source of the fluctuation, he ran into Zi Linglong. He sensed Zi Linglong’s extraordinary bloodline so he wants to capture her and make her his concubine, food, or harvest her power to boost his own.
Jiang Ming grew even more enraged when he read Bai Haitian’s status. His eyes shone with killing intent as he thought to himself, ‘Very well, I’ll remember your name Bai Haitian.’
Jiang Ming mentally added Bai Haitian to his list of people to kill. When he calmed down slightly, he finally realized there was a slight change to the Human Path Record. There was now a ‘race’ category. The status seemed much more detailed than before as well. It seemed the status would now briefly recount the target’s past.
However, since Jiang Ming did not know much about the scaled dragon clan, Bai Haitian’s information was not very useful. He wondered to himself, ‘Are the sea clans colluding with the devil sects as well? Did Bishui Sect move here because of that?’
Subsequently, he looked up the information of the three golden-clad middle-aged men who guarded Bai Haitian. They were all Dao Seed cultivators. Apart from that, he also discovered a Nascent Soul devil hiding in the ship. However, he was not worried about the devil.
Then, Jiang Ming shifted his attention to the other group of people and flipped the Human Path Record to a new page.
Name: Bai Yu
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Current Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion
Relationship: 0
Innate talent: 10 stars (Heaven Overlord Body)
Status: After finding the note of Yun Tiankong, an Extreme Path expert, he began to investigate and found out that Yun Tiankong did not have any disciples. For that reason, he’s certain Yun Tiankong must have left his legacy behind. He’s determined to get his hands on Yun Tiankong’s legacy. He came to the Eastern Region three years ago but didn’t find anything. Tonight, he sensed the Dao fluctuation of an Extreme Path expert. However, when he arrived, he found out the tomb had been unsealed. Then, he followed the lingering aura in the tomb here.
Jiang Ming frowned when he read Bai Yu’s information. He was not intimidated by Bai Yu’s cultivation base in the Dao Seed Realm, but he was concerned about Bai Yu’s status as the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion.
Jiang Ming had a basic understanding of the forces in Zhong Province. The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was famous for their weapon forging and body tempering skills. In fact, it was on par with a Sacred Land like Qingyun Sect.
The Holy Son of such a powerful sect would be welcomed wherever he went. If Bai Yu were to visit Jiuyang Sect, the Sect Master would deactivate the Formation and lead all the eight First Seats to welcome him at the entrance. In fact, let alone the Sect Master of Jiuyang Sect, even the Sect Master of Qingyun Sect would have to personally welcome the Holy Son of Bai Yu. After all, Holy Sons and Holy Daughters were representatives of their respective forces.
Apart from that, Bai Yu’s innate talent was quite high as well. He possessed a 10-star innate talent and even possessed a special physique, the Heaven Overlord Body.
There are various special physiques listed in the books available to the public. The Heaven Lord Body was ranked in the top twenty physiques. Such a physique was already incredibly strong on its own. Coupled with the unique body tempering techniques from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, Bai Yu was unimaginably strong.
Jiang Ming’s eyes only narrowed slightly when he read Bai Yu’s status. After that, he checked the information of the four experts with Bai Yu and discovered they were all Nascent Soul experts.
Jiang Ming could not help but curse, “F*ck! My Sect Master is a Nascent Soul cultivator, but Nascent Soul cultivators are only guards in the Infinite Alchemy Sect!”
In fact, Jiuyang Sect was not weak. It was just that the Infinite Alchemy Sect was incredibly strong.
Jiang Ming shook his head as he thought to himself, ‘Bai Haitian looks very pathetic in comparison to Bai Yu…’
As the saying went, ‘There’s no harm without comparison’.
At this moment, Jiang Ming heard Bai Haitian cry out. He thought Bai Haitian was about to fight for his life, but he only saw an energy sword shooting out of the flying ship toward the light barrier.
Bang!
The barrier shook violently, and a small hole appeared on it. Alas, the hole mended itself quickly.
Bai Haitian’s eyes widened as he paled with fright.
Bai Yu laughed. “You’re quite clever to use provocation as a means to escape! By the way, that person hiding in the ship is quite strong. Alas, he’s not strong enough to save you; not when I’m the enemy!”
Bai Haitian said with a hint of desperation, “Why would you do this when I’ve never offended you? I’m the third son of the white scaled dragon king of the Eastern sea! You’ll only incur my father’s wrath if you kill me! It won’t do you any good to kill me!”
Bai Yu replied coldly, “You’re wrong. There’s an advantage to killing all of you. I can make seafood out of all of you! To me, the white scaled dragon king is just a bigger loach. If he dares to look for me, I’ll make sure to send him to reunite with you!”
Inwardly, Bai Haitian burned with fear and anxiety. Outwardly, he shouted, “You’re crazy!”
At this moment, Zi Linglong who had been watching quietly from the side finally said, “Bai Yu, do you think you’d be able to leave after revealing that you’re here to look for the Tomb of Extreme Path and that you’re from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?”
Bai Yu clapped his hand as he said in admiration, “Miss, you’re quite clever. Not only that, but you’re really lucky as well since you managed to find the Tomb of Extreme Path. You’re definitely qualified to be my maidservant!”
Zi Linglong looked at Bai Yu speechlessly. Then, she looked at Bai Haitian and asked, “You’re still not making your move?”
Bai Haitian said, “Miss, I can see you’re very prideful and will never submit to him. However, you might die if you don’t. Why don’t we work together to deal with him?”
Zi Linglong nodded. “Alright, you attack first.”
The corners of Bai Haitian’s lips twitched. However, he had no other choice but to order in a hoarse voice, “Uncle Prawn, let’s fight!”
Following that, the silver-armored warriors at both sides of the flying ship straightened their backs. Following that, streams of energy surged out of their bodies into the flying ship as their bodies swiftly withered; it was as though they were transferring all their energies to the flying ship.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Energy began to surge from the flying ship. Then, the flying ship shook before it flew forward.
Alas, four experts standing in four different directions waved their flags in unison, stopping the flying ship from leaving.
Following that, the flying ship cracked as divine light burst forth. It looked as though it was being slowly crushed by a pair of huge invisible hands.
Bai Haitian was frightened out of his wits. His three subordinates charged out furiously, but they were easily blasted away by three bolts of lightning that appeared out of thin air.
At this moment, the sound of an explosion rang in the air as a figure suddenly appeared. The figure belonged to an old man. He grabbed Bai Haitian with one hand as he tore the void open. Then, he hurriedly pulled Bai Haitian into the void with him.
Bai Yu watched with a cheerful expression on his face. Clearly, he had no intention of making a move.
Instead, Bai Yu’s four guardians controlled their respective swords and formed a sword Formation that surrounded the old man and Bai Haitian before the duo could escape. The swords continued to spin in place before releasing countless energy swords.
Upon seeing this, Bai Haitian cried out desperately, “Stop! Please stop! I’m willing to submit to you! I… I’m willing to become your mount!”
Alas, no one paid attention to Bai Haitian.
Soon after, Bai Haitian and the old man were reduced into a mist of blood.
Bai Yu sighed helplessly. “Why didn’t the four of you restrain yourselves? What can I do with them when they’re nothing but a mist of blood now?” Then, he shifted his eyes to Zi Linglong and asked with a smile, “Have you decided?”
“What if I refuse?” Zi Linglong asked icily.
The smile vanished from Bai Yu’s face immediately. He straightened his back as he said, “It’s a golden opportunity and a blessing for you to become my maidservant. There’s only one outcome waiting for you if you refuse me. Moreover, you entered Yun Tiankong’s tomb and took away what’s meant to be mine. I give you one last chance. Do you agree to be my slave?”
Zi Linglong’s voice turned even frostier as she said, “Oh, so now your offer has been reduced to slave from maidservant?”
At the same time, mana surged out of her body, turning into streaks of light. At this moment, she looked like a fairy who had descended from the heavens.
Bai Yu said, “That’s the price of refusing me before this. I’m only giving you a second chance because I’m in a good mood today.”
At this moment, Bai Yu suddenly turned when he saw an energy sword shooting out a tear in the void, killing one of his guardians.
Jiang Ming was enraged by Bai Yu trying to force his junior sister to become his slave that he instinctively attacked. He did not use his weapon or special ability. Instead, he used the high-grade Artifact he obtained from Qingyun Sect’s Ge Changqing and used the sect’s special Slice the Heaven sword technique..

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - Indiscriminate Killing; Paradis Sword Inten
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Indiscriminate Killing; Paradis Sword Intent
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Usually, apart from comprehending Sambodhas and cultivating, Jiang Ming would also focus on learning his special abilities and techniques. He was not an exceptionally fast learner, but after cultivating the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, his physique and mind underwent a huge transformation. His comprehension skills, which were further enhanced by Human Spiritual Fruits, Earth Spiritual Fruits, and Heaven Spiritual Fruits, had improved by leaps and bounds as well. Coupled with the Enlightening Tea Leaf, he could comprehend a special ability to the rudimentary stage in just a day.
The Slice the Heaven was a special sword technique that Jiang Ming had comprehended to the mastery stage. He was just a few steps away from reaching perfection.
When he struck with Slice the Heaven, its force was so powerful that it cut down one of Bai Yu’s guardians with just a strike.
“Bai Yu, the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! You’re a prominent figure, a brilliant prodigy, and widely respected in Zhong Province so no one dares to discipline you even when you’ve done wrong. Is that why you dare to act rampantly even though you’re in Qing Province, which is a territory of Qingyun Sect? Do you have a death wish? If so, I’ll kill you and fulfill your wish today!” Jiang Ming said in a loud voice that reverberated in the air. Then, he cried out, “Wood Dragon!”
He raised his left hand and mana surged out immediately, merging with the universe’ Dao fluctuations. In just a moment, countless seedlings sprouted from the ground for a few dozen miles. Just as swiftly, they grew into towering trees that were hundreds of meters tall. Subsequently, what looked like three small green dragons shot toward Bai Yu and his three guardians from different directions before surrounding the trio in a deadly formation.
Bai Yu frowned deeply as he brought out a sword. He looked like a streak of light as he moved, slashing the branches around him in a frenzy as he said, “Slice the Heaven? Wood Dragon? These are two of Qingyun Sect’s secret techniques. Fellow cultivator of Sacred Lands, since you know I’m the Holy Son of the Infinity Alchemy Pavilion, you still dare to attack me? Do you intend to start a war between two Sacred Lands?”
When Bai Yu finished speaking, he brandished his sword and carved a path open before charging toward Jiang Ming.
Linglong, who was standing at the side, frowned upon seeing this. ‘This person feels familiar. However, I can’t see his face due to the divine light masking his appearance…’
Although towering trees grew in front of Linglong, there was a path of retreat behind her. She spun around and retreated into the distance before she watched the fight up ahead with a confused expression on her face. At the same time, various thoughts raced through her mind.
‘Qingyun Sect and the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion are both Sacred Lands. It’s hard to tell which of them is stronger. Why is that person attacking Bai Yu though? Openly attacking and killing a Holy Son is tantamount to a declaration of war.’
‘Is he an impostor?’
‘It’s possible, but the techniques he used are Qingyun Sect’s special techniques…’
‘Moreover, it seems like he’s not bothered with me at all. He even let me leave… Wait a minute! When I was about to get attacked, he suddenly appeared. Is it possible that he’s trying to help me? But why? Even if he’s not from Qingyun Sect, I don’t think he’s from Jiuyang Sect.’
Zi Linglong stood in the distance; she did not leave. She wanted to watch the outcome of the battle. As for her safety, even if the newcomer was in the Primal Spirit Realm, she was confident that she could protect herself.
“Bai Yu, you think too highly of yourself! You don’t represent the entire Infinite Alchemy Pavilion just yet!” Jiang Ming said. His figure flashed as he suddenly merged with one of the towering trees. This was a feat only possible after one had mastered the wood Sambodha.
Following that, Jiang Ming appeared behind one of the guardians. Alas, he had underestimated the person in front of him; his opponent was stronger than he had expected.
A huge bell shrouded in golden Qi descended at once. Underneath the bell, four swords spun swiftly around him, doubling as a weapon and a shield. As they spun, they easily cut off the branches and vines that had snaked toward him.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!” Jiang Ming cried out as he drew a seal in the air with his left hand. As he leaped up, a divine seal appeared out of thin air, drawing power from the earth and the sky. Its power was overbearing.
“No!” the guardian, a Nascent Soul expert, cried out. Upon sensing the danger, his instincts commanded him to turn around. At the same time, the four swords shot toward the divine seal?but were easily blasted away. Even the bell hanging above crashed down on him, nearly smashing his head. Blood gushed out of his injuries as he fell.
At the same time, the branches and the vines seized the chance and shot toward the guardian. They pierced him, draining him of his mana and blood before causing his flesh to wither. Just like that, he died.
“D*mn it!” Bai Yu cursed upon seeing this. He roared, “Heaven Blazing Swords!”
Swoosh!
Bai Yu summoned 108 flying swords, all of which were medium-grade Artifacts, forming a sword formation. He intended to keep this move as his trump card, but the situation forced him to unleash this skill now. Based on how powerful his opponent was, he had no choice but to use this skill now.
Bai Yu had heard of the Wood Dragon, but he did not expect it to be so formidable. Its force was like that of a Primal Spirit cultivator. He could not destroy the attack easily. Hence, he knew he had no choice but to go all out in this battle.
When the flying swords appeared, they shot fire out of their tips, forming a few flaming dragons. The flaming dragons flew toward the towering trees and reduced half of them into ashes in just a moment.
“Charge!” The remaining two guardians rushed out. They brought out a flag each to form a Formation to trap Jiang Ming and restrict his movements.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!” Jiang Ming launched another divine seal, breaking the formation. Then, he raised his sword with his right hand.
At the same time. Dark clouds began to converge above Jiang Ming. Claps of thunder sounded in succession as lightning bolts flashed in the sky.
“Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning! I’ll end all of you with this!” Jiang Ming brought his sword down.
Simultaneously, the lightning bolts struck his enemies.
Boom!
Thunder continued to ring in the air as lightning bolts struck continuously, flashing blindingly.
Bai Yu mentally recalled his swords. When they returned to his side, they formed a sword formation above him to keep the lightning bolts at bay.
“It’s so powerful!”
The sword formation was trembling to Bai Yu’s shock; the lightning bolts were wearing the formation down.
Bai Yu was confident he could hold off an ordinary Primal Spirit expert with the sword formation. However, he was falling into a disadvantageous position at this moment. The force of the attack was too strong, and its range was too wide.
At this time, two miserable cries rang in Bai Yu’s ears. His heart skipped a beat as he used a special ability. His eyes suddenly shone and the scene of his remaining guardians being struck to death by the lightning bolt appeared before his eyes.
Overwhelmed by his rage, Bai Yu growled. “D*mn you, Qingyun Sect! I’m going to kill everyone in your sect for this!”
The guardians were given to him by the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. Not only did they protect him, but they were like a status symbol as well. Not even in his wildest dreams did he imagine he would lose them all today.
“I’m going to kill you!” Bai Yu roared as he brought out a jade amulet with a small sword carved on it. When it tossed the jade amulet into the air, it suddenly exploded, releasing a small sword that was sealed within.
For a moment, the lightning and the thunder seemed to disappear as an overwhelming and destructive sword intent swept out in all directions.
Time seemed to stand still for a second before millions of small swords suddenly appeared, causing violent Dao fluctuations. The millions of small swords converged into a sword domain immediately.
Zi Linglong’s eyes widened upon seeing. “This energy sword contains the force of a Paradis Realm expert! It can easily kill a Primal Spirit expert!”
Following that, a thought appeared in Zi Linglong’s mind.
‘Can that mysterious man withstand this attack?’

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - The Heaven Shattering Hammer, Cleaving the Sky Into Two, and the Chessboard Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: The Heaven Shattering Hammer, Cleaving the Sky Into Two, and the Chessboard Formation
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At the peak of a mountain 5,000 miles away, an older man sat in a lotus position while meditating under the moon. At this moment, his eyes suddenly snapped open. It shone brightly as he looked into the distance.
“This is the energy sword sealed by my martial uncle! This is bad! The Holy Son is in danger!”
The older man’s expression changed drastically when he figured out what was happening. He looked like a streak of light as he flew toward his destination.
…
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming’s eyelids twitched as he looked at the destructive energy sword in front of him. The air seemed frozen, and he felt so heavy, as though a mountain was pressing down on him. At this time, Linglong’s voice rang in his ears, telling him that the energy sword was the power of a Paradis expert.
‘Paradis expert?’ Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat.
A Paradis cultivator was on a whole different level compared to a Primal Spirit cultivator. Even if this power had been sealed for a long time, it was still a huge force to be reckoned with.
In just a blink of an eye, the energy sword, which seemed like it could tear the sky asunder, fell toward Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming felt as though he was being restrained by invisible hands. He could not move to avoid the incoming attack no matter how hard he struggled.
“Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!” Jiang Ming unleashed all his power at this moment. He swung his sword and manifested nine energy swords.
The nine energy swords swiftly surged into Purple Cloud. Then, crisp noises rang in the air as cracks appeared on its surface.
Nine energy swords indicated that one had reached the rudimentary stage.
Boom!
Jiang Ming slashed the Purple Cloud upward, bringing it to meet the descending energy sword in midair.
A devastating burst of energy swept out when the two attacks collided.
Boom!
Energy swords shot out in all directions as the void rippled and distorted.
Crack!
The Purple Cloud shattered into pieces, and Jiang Ming was also pushed back 1,000 meters by the blast.
“Impressive!” Jiang Ming exclaimed. This was by far the strongest attack he had encountered. It had forced him to unleash his full strength. He sighed in relief when he lifted his head and saw that the energy sword had dissipated after the collision.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong, who was watching from a distance, frowned deeply.
‘He’s terrifyingly strong! Although he’s only in the Dao Seed Realm, he’s able to hold his ground against the sealed force of a Paradis expert! Even I am not capable of such a feat. If I were in his shoes earlier, there are only two outcomes for me: dead or grievously injured. However, he…’
‘When he cast his technique earlier, it felt like he had a mysterious connection to the space around him. His mastery over the law of space and the force of his technique is definitely top-notch among cultivators. However, even if he’s terrifyingly strong, how could he parry the attack of a Paradis expert? Just how much mana does he have? Ten times more than mine? Now, it should be at least 100 times more. But how’s that possible? How can such a freak like him exist in the mortal realm?’
Zi Linglong still found it difficult to accept after analyzing the person in front of her.
‘I don’t remember such a person in my previous life. Just where or when did things start to change?’ Zi Linglong could not figure it out no matter how hard she tried.
Meanwhile, Bai Yu felt even more dumbfounded than Zi Linglong. His shock was written all over his face as he exclaimed in disbelief, “You blocked my attack?! No, I can clearly sense you’re not in the Nascent Soul Realm nor did you form your Primal Spirit. You’re only in the Dao Seed Realm so there’s no way you could’ve blocked my attack! You… You must be hiding your strength! I don’t care if you’re hiding your strength; you’re still going to die today! Astral Primal Sword Array!”
Bai Yu raised his hand as 108 swords soared into the sky. In just a matter of minutes, they filled the entire sky and formed a circle with all their tips pointed at Jiang Ming. They thrummed, distorting the void around them. After a brief moment, energy swords flew out one after another and swept toward Jiang Ming like a storm.
At this time, Blue Crystal, a high-grade Artifact, materialized in Jiang Ming’s hand. Truth be told, he was not concerned about the sword array at all. After all, Bai Yu was just a Dao Seed cultivator. Even if Bai Yu was a Holy Son and had the Heaven Overlord Body, Bai Yu was still no match for him.
“Slice the Heaven!”
Jiang Ming brandished his sword, blocking all the energy swords that shot at him. After a moment, a huge number of energy swords burst forth from his body and formed a shield around him to ward off the attack.
“I’ll draw my sword and cleave the sky into two!” Jiang Ming blasted the sword formation apart at this moment.
The 108 swords flew back immediately.
Upon seeing this, Jiang Ming sighed in disappointment. If it were him, he was certain nobody would be able to break his Formation. ‘What a shame.’
“Die!” Jiang Ming prepared to cast his special ability as the fluctuations from the Death Dao surged. He swung his sword down with all his might at Bai Yu’s head.
The clouds parted as the sky rippled. The moon shone brightly like a solitary white disc in the sky.
Bai Yu inhaled deeply as he brought a hammer. It was huge. Its handle alone was more than two meters long, and the diameter of its head was about a foot long. As soon as it appeared, a destructive force exploded.
Bai Yu roared, “You’re the one who’s going to die today!”
Bai Yu swung the hammer down. The leyline in the ground thrummed as energy exploded. The force of the attack was immense and unimaginably destructive.
Boom!
The wind stirred and the earth shook.
The impact blew Bai Yu back, and the hammer almost dropped from his hand. A surprised expression appeared on his face when he saw the Dao Vessels on his body flashed one after another.
“I was hurt?!” Bai Yu exclaimed.
“The Heaven Shattering Hammer and the armor I’m wearing are low-grade Dao Vessels. Your sword is just a high-grade Artifact! There’s a huge difference between them. Even if I couldn’t stop your attack, my armor should’ve absorbed most of the damage. There’s no way you could’ve injured me!” Bai Yu continued to ramble on in disbelief.
Bai Yu narrowed his eyes as killing intent shone in them. “You old monster from the Qingyun Sect! You’re hellbent on killing me, the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! It seems like the Qingyun Sect really wants to wage a war against the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! Very well! Let me show you the might of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion!”
Swoosh!
Bai Yu waved his hand and sent a glowing disc formation toward Jiang Ming.
When the disc formation shone, it drew energy from the void and transformed into a chain that imprisoned Jiang Ming.
“Is this all you’ve got?” Jiang Ming scoffed. He brought his sword down and cleaved the disc formation into two. Just when he thought he had successfully neutralized the attack, a ball of flames descended and exploded.
“I can’t believe a Holy Son would stoop so low and resort to such a dirty trick!” Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes. Then, he vanished into thin air. When he reappeared, he was already very far away from the explosion. When he looked at the spot where he was standing earlier, nothing could be seen but ashes.
“I’m the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, and the Artifacts are my weapons,” Bai Yu said, not letting his guard down, “What about you? You’re an old freak, but you attack someone younger than you! Don’t you feel any shame?”
“You deserve it!” Jiang Ming used the Great Akasa Step and appeared in front of Bai Yu.
Bai Yu defended himself with the Heaven Shattering Hammer, but he was sent flying back again. However, this time, he spat out a mouthful of blood. He was in such excruciating pain that it felt as though his body was being torn apart.
Bai Yu was horrified by Jiang Ming’s immense strength. Fear and anxiety began to sprout in his heart.
‘I’ve been very careful. I activated the jade amulet after he killed my four guardians. After activating the jade amulet, the other guardians should’ve rushed to my aid immediately. Where are they? Is it because I’m too far away?’ Bai Yu’s expression changed when this thought appeared in his mind.
“The power of the Dao Vessels is indeed formidable, but this is where it ends,” Jiang Ming said, “Remember this! Your demise is caused by you trampling on Qingyun Sect’s dignity!”
“With my sword, I’ll cleave the sky into two! Meet your death! Ultimate Slash!” Jiang Ming unleashed the strongest form of this special ability. At the same time, he imbued it with the Destructive Sambodha he had comprehended, boosting the attack to another level.
“No! There’s no way for me to block this attack!” Bai Yu’s face turned ashen. He could now sense his guardian was on the way over, but it was too late.
‘It’s all or nothing now!’ Bai Yu thought to himself as he tossed something into the air before a chessboard appeared in the air.
As soon as the chessboard appeared, the void distorted and rippled, destroying Jiang Ming’s energy sword.
Following that, the chessboard suddenly turned into an orb, pulling Jiang Ming into it..

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - Mana Sealing, Invincibility, and Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Mana Sealing, Invincibility, and Shock
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Zi Linglong did not leave. She continued watching the battle from a distance. A lot had happened, but it all happened in just a blink of an eye. Her eyes widened when she saw the chessboard. “That’s the Mana Sealing Chessboard!”
Before she could ponder on it, her head suddenly jerked up as she looked into the distance. She could sense an immense aura coming this way at a high speed. Her body grew translucent immediately, and it did not take long before she disappeared into thin air. She did not leave; she had only cast an invisibility spell.
In the distance, Bai Yu had vanished as well. Only the chessboard remained hovering in the night sky.
At this time, the strong aura that Linglong sensed finally arrived. It belonged to an old man. His aura was so strong that it felt like the aura of a supreme immortal who had descended to the mortal realm.
“This… The Mana Sealing Chessboard?” The old man’s expression darkened when he saw the glowing chessboard in the air. “Who the hell dares to attack the Holy Son? Whoever you are, you must have a death wish!”
The old man drew closer to the chessboard and tried to look at the situation inside but to no avail.
“Once the chessboard is activated, there’ll be death! I’ve warned him repeatedly not to use it unless he’s in a life-or-death situation,” the old man muttered to himself with a frosty expression on his face, “I don’t care who you are! Even if you’re from the Qingyun Sect, there’s only one outcome for acting against the Holy Son: death!”
The old man continued to look at the chessboard silently.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong, who had turned invisible, remained still. She did not even dare to look at the old man for she knew even a look would betray her presence.
…
Inside the chessboard, there was nothing?but a flat landscape.
After Jiang Ming surveyed his surroundings, he had a basic understanding of his situation. The radius?of this place was about 100 miles. It was not very vast and was square in shape.
His heart raced in his chest as he descended. He had tried his best to escape the pulling force from the chessboard Bai Yu had tossed out earlier.
When his feet finally touched the ground, the sense of something was amiss grew stronger. Soon enough, he discovered that he had lost access to his mana.
It felt as though the energy in this place had isolated him from his mana. It was like it had erected a barrier between him and his mana. No matter how much strength he mustered up, he could not break the barrier.
“Did it seal my mana?” Jiang Ming muttered, “With my current cultivation base, even a Paradis expert wouldn’t be able to seal my mana without my notice. However, this item did it with ease. This means this item is of top grade, and its power has been fully unlocked.”
Jiang Ming tried to fly but failed. Then, he discovered his physical strength and fake appearance, born from a secret facial molding technique, were unaffected.
“Interesting…” Jiang Ming murmured. Then, he shifted his gaze to Bai Yu who just appeared in front of him. He called up the Human Path Records. The book did not seem to be affected, and he could control it as usual.
At this moment, a thought appeared in his mind. ‘Maybe I can use the Human Path Records to break the barrier that isolates me from the mana in my sea of consciousness! Why didn’t I think of this earlier?’
“You look younger than I expected,” Bai Yu said, pulling Jiang Ming away from his thoughts. At this moment, he was no longer holding the Heaven Shattering Hammer. Instead, he was holding a black sword that was more than a meter long. He kept his eyes trained on Jiang Ming as he walked forward and said, “I’ve been keeping a low profile since I came to the Eastern Region so I don’t think I’ve offended anyone. Even if I did, I would definitely kill them. No, the reason you’re after me is not because I’ve trampled on Qingyun Sect’s dignity, right? You’re just looking for a scapegoat, correct?”
“The Eastern Region is Qingyun Sect’s territory. We have eyes everywhere. Did you think you can hide what you’ve done from us?” Jiang Ming coldly said, “As a Holy Son, you should be killing devils and maintaining the order, but did you do? Destroying villages and families, and leaving destruction in your wake. Do you really think you’re qualified to be a Holy Son?”
Bai Yi said derisively, “They’re nothing but peasants. I’m sure Qingyun Sect does this all the time as well! If my memories serve me right, you’d even started a massacre in a captured city. How shameless of you to accuse me of destroying villages and families? Don’t make me laugh! I take back what I said earlier about you looking for a scapegoat. Based on how you used the few special techniques of Qingyun Sect with such ease, you’re definitely an accomplished cultivator. However, I don’t know what happened, but I can tell you now loathe the Qingyun Sect to the core. Hence, you want to kill me to start a war between the two Sacred Lands, am I right?”
Jiang Ming clapped his hands. “As expected of a Holy Son! You’re really quick-witted!” Then, he pointed upward and asked, “Can you tell me what’s this thing?”
Bai Yi?flexed his arm as he flipped his sword, looking really powerful. He said, “I thought you’d never ask. Once, I entered an ancient immortal’s cave. After a life-or-death struggle, I obtained this chessboard. It’s called the Mana Sealing Chessboard. Once you enter it, you won’t be able to use mana at all. You can only fight hand-to-hand combat in here. Unfortunately, I’ve yet to master it so other than myself, I can only bring one person to this place at a time. Now that we’ve entered this place, the only way for us to leave is if one of us dies!”
A smile appeared on Bai Yi’s face as he continued to say, “Oh, right. I forgot to mention that as the master of the chessboard, my physical strength has been enhanced to five times stronger. I feel like I must also mention that I possess the Heaven Overlord Body. This means my physical strength is unparalleled. As the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, I cultivated the strongest body tempering secret technique. My physical body has been tempered to that of a Nascent Soul cultivator from the endless stream of resources the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion provides me as well.”
“Once I activate my Heaven Overlord Body, I’ll be as strong as a Primal Spirit cultivator. With the effect of the chessboard, you’re as good as dead!” Bai Yi said smugly, “This is why the Mana Sealing Chessboard is perfect for me and why I kept it as my trump card. Even a Paradis expert’s mana would be sealed if he or she came in here!”
“When I first obtained the Mana Sealing Chessboard, I tested it out with the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion elders. We fought without our powers, only with our physical strength. I’ve defeated both elders in the Primal Spirit Realm and the Paradis realm,” Bai Yi said, “Hence, you’ll definitely die today!”
The more Bai Yu spoke, the more confident he grew.
“I’ll definitely die today?” Jiang Ming shook his head and said with a smile, “You’re all bark and no bite. The reason you told me so much is to convince yourself you’re stronger than I am and to intimidate me. You said your physical strength is enhanced by five times? You’ve defeated Primal Spirit and Paradis cultivators in here? Bullsh*t! If that’s true, you would’ve attacked me immediately without rambling on and on!”
“You’re the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, the most respected figure in Zhong Province, and you hold yourself in high esteem. After I killed all four of your guardians, there’s no way you’d waste time talking to me if you’re really capable of killing me so easily like you said? Come, Bai Yu! Like you said, only one of us will survive today!”
Jiang Ming felt his blood boil as he wielded his sword with his right hand and clenched his left hand into a fist. Then, he walked toward Bai Yu.
Bai Yu threw his head back and laughed heartily. Nevertheless, his laughter did not reach his eyes. When he stopped laughing, he looked at Jiang Ming and said, “Do you know why most cultivators focused on mastering spells and only a few chose to temper the bodies? It’s because the process of tempering the body is arduous and painful. Although there are many people from Sacred Lands, unless they have a God Body, Saint Body, or a special physique like mine, they won’t bother to temper their bodies. I have the Heaven Overlord Body, and I’ve defeated others with God Bodies at the same level. Who do you think you are that I have to use such a petty trick on you?”
“The sword in my hand is a weapon specially forged for the Mana Sealing Chessboard! Although it has no special abilities, it’s strong and sharp. It can easily pierce the scales of a demon!”
Bai Yu swung his sword toward Jiang Ming with deadly precision as he shouted, “Today, I’ll cut you down with my Golden Obsidian! Die!”
The wind began to howl, and the void began to ripple.
Jiang Ming frowned as he raised his sword to parry the sword. He knew he had to be cautious since he was in Bai Yu’s Mana Sealing Chessboard.
Boom!
The two swords clashed.
Jiang Ming’s arm trembled slightly from the clash. He was briefly stunned. When he recovered, he asked incredulously, “Is this all you’ve got? I thought you cultivated the strongest body tempering technique? Don’t you possess the Heaven Overlord Body? Isn’t your strength amplified by five times? Didn’t you defeat Primal Spirit and Paradis experts in here? Is this really all you’ve got?”
“H-how… H-how… How’s this possible?” Bai Yu stammered as his face turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - Primal Spirit Guardian
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Primal Spirit Guardian
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
When Bai Yu regained his senses, he hurriedly retreated. He looked at Jiang Ming and Jiang Ming’s sword with a stupefied expression on his face. Although the things he told Jiang Ming were not completely true, he was not lying when he said he had a strong physical body. He could not wrap his mind around what had just transpired.
“Do you have a God Body or a Saint Body?” Bai Yu asked as he gulped. Beads of cold sweat began to form on his forehead and trickled down the sides of his face.
A physical combat was simple; whoever was stronger would win.
There were very few special abilities that boosted physical strength, and the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion only had one. Bai Yu had only mastered it to the rudimentary stage. He had planned to focus on cultivating it, but he had to neglect it since he had been focused on searching for the Tomb of Extreme Path over the past few years.
“What do you think?” Jiang Ming smiled like the Cheshire Cat as he looked at Blue Crystal. After clashing with Bai Yu, the sword was slightly dented and hairline cracks could be seen on it.
‘Well, I guess this is as far as it can go. It’s too light, and I couldn’t imbue it with my mana. However, I have to admit his physical body and strength are quite strong. Alas, mine is stronger than his,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself.
Jiang Ming knew his body was strong even if he did not cultivate any body tempering technique. It was stronger than most people’s. After all, half of his cultivation reward from the system went into his body. Moreover, whenever he cultivated the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, it would automatically temper his body as well. It focused on both the physical body and the mana, after all. As a result, his body had been transformed into the Primary Daoist Body.
‘It seems like my Primary Daoist Body is stronger than a God Body and Saint Body.’
Jiang Ming now had a better grasp of his physical body’s strength after crossing swords with Bai Yu.
At this time, Jiang Ming tossed Blue Crystal to the side before he leaped into the air toward Bai Yu. “You’ve had your shot! It’s my turn now!”
Boom!
When Jiang Ming punched his fist out, the was a swoosh and a crack of thunder.
“This is my territory! I don’t believe you can kill me!” Bai Yu shouted as his body began to grow. This was the effect of the physical special ability he had comprehended. His blood began to pump into his veins vigorously, increasing his strengths by leaps and bounds.
“Die!” Bai Yu brought his sword down with all his might.
Unexpectedly, Jiang Ming did not dodge. Instead, he kept his arm outstretched and met the blade of the sword head-on.
The force of the collision exploded, blowing Golden Obsidian away.
Bai Yu was shocked as he was sent flying back. When he looked down, he saw skin had burst, his muscles were torn, and his bones were cracked.
Jiang Ming stepped forward, closing the distance between them in mere seconds before he punched Bai Yu’s face.
When Bai Yu heard the sound of wind whistling that accompanied the incoming punch, which sounded like a death knell, his face paled. He quickly crossed his arms in front of him to block the punch. Alas, it was futile. The sound of an explosion rang in the air as Jiang Ming broke both his arms.
“Ashes to ashes; dust to dust. This will be the end of you, Bai Yu!” Jiang Ming said as he leaped into the air. He spun to build up his momentum before he kicked Bai Yu, crushing Bai Yu’s head.
Blood gushed out, forming an arc in the air.
Just like that, Bai Yu died.
After Jiang Ming landed, he called up the Human Path Records
Swoosh!
Name: Bai Yu
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm.
Background: Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Ten stars (Heaven Overlord Body)
Status: Dead
“He’s finally dead!” Jiang Ming heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, he could feel the energy sealing his mana dissipating.
[After being pulled into the Mana Sealing Chessboard, everyone’s mana would be sealed. One’s mana would only be unsealed after one party died]
Now that Bai Yu died, the Mana Sealing Chessboard was without a master. However, before Jiang Ming could do anything, he felt a force pulling him away. He hurriedly grabbed Blue Crystal, Golden Obsidian, and Bai Yu’s spatial ring before he was sent out.
As soon as Jiang Ming was sent out of the chessboard, he saw a pair of frosty eyes as soon as he looked up.
The old man was slightly startled before his eyes burned with the flames of fury when he finally processed what Jiang Ming’s appearance meant.
“Die!”
The old man had been waiting for Bai Yu outside the Mana Sealing Chess Plate. However, when he saw the person who came out was not Bai Yu but a stranger, he completely lost it. He raised his hand, and a cauldron appeared above Jiang Ming.
The cauldron descended swiftly on Jiang Ming. Its power was so immense that it even caused a ripple in the void.
As though he had expected it, Jiang Ming waved his hand, conjuring the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal.
Both attacks carried a great force. When they collided, even the void was torn.
The two opponents were sent flying back from the force of the collision.
The force of the collision was as explosive as an atomic bomb. It swept out in all directions, causing the ground to split and the mountains to shake.
Even Zi Linglong, who was hiding, had no choice but to emerge and retreat into the distance.
“Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning!” Jiang Ming cried out. He only regained his footing after flying thousands of meters back. When he regained his composure, he charged out again. At the same time, he used his special ability.
Boom!
A lightning bolt struck at the old man.
Jiang Ming knew the old man had to be Bai Yu’s helper. Since the old man was on Bai Yu’s side, there was only one thing left for him to do: kill the old man!
“Wood Dragon!”
Jiang Ming did not give the old man time to attack before he used another special ability.
The old man had just blocked the lightning bolt when a forest grew around him in just a blink of an eye. Branches and vines shot out, turning into lances, spears, and small dragons. They surrounded the old man and attacked him relentlessly.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records appeared once again.
Name: Yang Fan
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm.
Background: Elder of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion
Relationship: -98
Innate Talent: Nine stars
Status: Wasted his potential by becoming the Holy Son’s guardian. He accompanied Bai Yu to look for Yun Tiankong’s tomb. He realized something was amiss when he sensed Bai Yu had activated the Paradis energy sword that was sealed. When he arrived, the Mana Sealing Chessboard has been activated so he was waiting for Bai Yu to come out. However, when he discovered Bai Yu is dead, he flew into a rage and began to attack Jiang Ming.
‘A Primal Spirit guardian?!’ Jiang Ming felt his eyes twitch. It seemed like the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion really treasured their Holy Son. Not only did Bai Yu have four guardians in the Nascent Soul Realm, but Bai Yu even had a guardian in the Primal Spirit Realm.
Jiang Ming’s mind inadvertently wandered to Mu Lei. As the core disciple of the Qingyun Sect, his treatment was very bad compared to Bai Yu’s. However, he thought it was reasonable. Mu Lei was just a core disciple in the Golden Core Realm; Mu Lei was not a Holy Son, after all.
With just a thought, a halberd appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand.
“Middle-grade Dao Vessel, Tyrant Halberd!”
Rumble!
The trees up ahead were burning at this moment.
The old man appeared in the air and glared at Jiang Ming. “State your name!”
Jiang Ming did not bother to respond to the question. He brandished the Tyrant Halberd and used the Slice the Heaven technique. Since the halberd was a middle-grade Dao Vessel, it was much stronger than Blue Crystal. Needless to say, the force of Slice the Heaven was much stronger now that he used it with a middle-grade Dao Vessel.
The old man summoned a sword and swung it down to intercept Jiang Ming’s attack. He growled, “Slice the Heaven, Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, and Wood Dragon… These are all Qingyun Sect’s secret techniques! Who are you? Why did you kill the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?”
Jiang Ming continued to ignore the old man. He imbued all his mana into the halberd and attacked with all his might.
However, the old man managed to parry all his strikes. “You’re not going to speak? Very well. It’s not like I care. Since you killed the Holy Son of our Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, I’m going to destroy the Qingyun Sect!”
The old man waved his hand, and four cauldrons suddenly appeared around Jiang Ming.
“Cauldrons, heed my call…”
The old man was about to attack with his Dao Vessel when Jiang Ming suddenly raised his halberd.
A divine mountain suddenly appeared in the sky. It was massive and majestic.. The aura it exuded was so vast and immense that the four cauldrons were instantly blown away and the space collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - Immortal Fetus, Sword Transformation, and Extermination
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Immortal Fetus, Sword Transformation, and Extermination
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Although special abilities were powerful, they consumed a lot of mana and energy. It was impossible to cast them multiple times. However, this did not apply to Jiang Jin. He possessed a vast amount of mana after all. Not even a Primal Spirit cultivator was a match for him now. Hence, he was able to cast multiple special abilities consecutively without any problems.
The strongest offensive special ability in his arsenal was the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi. However, he had only comprehended it to the rudimentary stage. The other offensive special ability was the Nine Divine Mountains Treasure. This ability could call forth the otherworldly Nine Divine Mountain, which emitted a terrifying and oppressive aura.
Nine rings of light circled the black mountain, sending the old man’s four cauldrons flying and suppressing the old man at the same time.
“What’s this special ability?! It’s so powerful!” the old man exclaimed as his eyes widened in shock. The force of the mountain did not lessen even though he was wearing his armor. The air seemed frozen, and he was having a difficult time breathing. Moreover, an incomparably heavy weight seemed to be pressing down on him and his sea of consciousness.
“Six Heavenly Cannon!” The old man clapped his hands, forming a circle that shot out a barrage of laser beams at the descending divine mountain.
The laser beams shot out at lightning speed and landed with a loud bang on their target. The force was strong enough to kill a Nascent Soul cultivator, but it did nothing to the divine mountain.
Rumble!
The divine mountain continued to fall unimpeded toward the old man, and he had no other choice but to descend to the ground. He hurriedly controlled the cauldron to move back to his side.
The cauldron began to spin and glow again as though they were supplying him with power since he was able to withstand the oppressive force for a moment.
The old man shouted, “Merge, Nine Heavenly Cannon! Open up a path for me!”
The attack this time managed to destroy the divine mountain, but the old man’s face paled immediately. The attack had depleted a lot of his mana and energy, after all.
“Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning!” Jiang Ming was determined not to give the old man even a moment of respite. He waved his hand, summoning lightning bolts to strike the old man again.
The force of the lightning bolts was terrifying; it successfully intimidated the old man. He planted his feet firmly on the ground as the cauldron spun around him, shielding him from the lightning bolts.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!” Jiang Ming stepped forward, putting away the Tyrant Halberd as lightning bolts flashed in the sky. He raised his left hand, turning his palm upward, as inscriptions appeared out of thin air. The inscriptions spun, forming a divine seal, before it shot toward the old man.
Jiang Ming cast his special abilities one after another. The lightning bolts that flashed around made him look like a thunder god who had descended to the mortal realm.
A deep chasm appeared on the ground as the mountains in the vicinity trembled and collapsed. Destruction was left in the wake of the battle between two cultivators. None of them cared about the damages they caused at this moment now that the situation had escalated to this point.
“You’re not in the Primal Spirit Realm, right? Since our battle started, I’ve not sensed the fluctuations of the energy of a Primal Spirit cultivator from you. How is it that you possess so much mana?” the old man asked. Although he was shocked, he was still able to maintain his composure. After all, he was very experienced. At this time, he raised his hand, and a divine sword appeared in his hand. With an upward slash, he cleaved the divine seal into two. Nevertheless, the force of the destruction sent him flying back.
The old man panted heavily. He had depleted a lot of mana maintaining the cauldron and summoning the middle-grade divine sword.
“Do you think I can’t kill you if I’m not in the Primal Spirit Realm?” Jiang Ming scoffed. “Let me tell you, I’m the Immortal Fetus. I’ve been cultivating in the forbidden land, but as soon as I came from seclusion, I found a Holy Son from the Zhong Province acting rampantly here. Do you think we’re pushovers? Do you think we’ll let you get away with this? You’ll have to die for this!”
Jiang Ming cast the Nine Divine Mountain Treasure again.
When the divine treasure appeared, its immense force blasted the old man’s cauldron away again.
“Immortal Fetus? To hell with the Immortal Fetus! You’re the one who’s going to die!” The old man grew agitated when Jiang Ming mentioned the Holy Son. His eyes burned with rage as he shouted, “Great Sky Shattering Sword Technique!”
The old man slashed upward, destroying the divine mountain with just a strike.
Jiang Ming frowned as he looked at the old man’s sword. ‘As expected of an expert from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! He really has a lot of high-grade weapons in his arsenal!’
If the old man were just a Primal Spirit cultivator, Jiang Ming would have been able to kill the old man a long time ago. Alas, the old man was not a weak Primal Spirit cultivator. Moreover, he was from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, a Sacred Land, that was known for their weapon forging skills. Not only were they wealthy, but they possessed many weapons and Artifacts.
Boom!
While Jiang Ming was lost in his thoughts, the divine mountain collapsed, releasing an immense force. He did not move out of the way. Instead, he brought Blue Crystal out.
“Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!” Jiang Ming brought his sword down on the old man.
The old man parried the attack.
Boom!
An explosion rang in the air as the two swords collided, sending the old man flying into the distance.
“Why is he so hard to kill?” Jiang Ming grumbled as he launched three Shadowless Needles at the old man.
The Shadowless Needles were equivalent to a high-grade Artifact. They shot toward the old man, who had yet to regain his footing. Their target was his forehead and ears.
Swoosh!
Four cauldrons appeared around the old man in the nick of time, deflecting the three Shadowless Needles. However, due to the needles’ nature as forbidden weapons, when they came into contact with the cauldrons, they exploded, sending the four top-grade cauldrons flying again.
The old man was injured by this impact, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
“Die!” Jiang Ming roared as he charged out. He appeared in front of the old man in just a blink of an eye. The Tyrant Halberd was in his hand once again. He raised it above his head, channeling all his mana and strength into his hands. Then, he struck with all his might, further amplifying his shocking strength.
Boom!
As the halberd fell, it left ripples in the void.
The old man’s face turned pale as he hurriedly summoned a shield, a low-grade Dao defensive vessel. Alas, as soon as it appeared above him, it was destroyed by the halberd.
“Die, die, die!” Jiang Ming brandished his halberd with all his might. After he shattered the shield, he struck at the old man again, destroying the old man’s Dao sword and blasting the old man into the distance.
This attack crushed the old man’s protective armor, piercing his body and causing him to plummet to the ground.
Boom!
A huge pit appeared on the ground when the old man fell. He lay listlessly at the bottom of the pit as he stared at the night sky. He had lost his left arm, and half of his face was disfigured.
When Jiang Ming was about to strike for the fourth time, a slit appeared on the old man’s forehead. Following that, a miniature version of the old man appeared. It was the old man’s Primal Spirit. Its expression was twisted in rage at this moment.
“Flaming Primal Spirit, transform! Turn into a sword and kill the man before me,” the old man shouted;?his voice dripping with venom.
The miniature figure opened its mouth, breathing out a stream of fire that turned into a sword. After that, it disappeared into the old man’s forehead again.
The flaming sword’s speed was incredibly swift as it shot toward Jiang Ming.
Bam!
Jiang Ming could not evade it in time. When it landed, he felt his sea of consciousness shake, but it did not collapse. Following that, it sent the flaming sword flying back before Jiang Ming summoned a bolt of lightning to destroy it.
“Impossible! It didn’t even pierce your sea of consciousness?” the old man cried out, horrified, “Are you really an Immortal Fetus blessed by an Extreme Path cultivator or an Imminent Immortal cultivator? The earlier attack was a forbidden spell! It’s capable of injuring a Paradis cultivator! How can you escape unscathed? If it were to hit me, I’d need at least a century to recover! T-this… This is unfair!”
Boom!
Jiang Ming ignored the old man and slammed his hand on the old man’s head.
Following that, a miniature figure appeared, trying to fly away.
“Trying to flee?” Jiang Ming sneered.
Jiang Ming was just about to cast the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi again when a sword pierced the miniature figure, leaving a tear in the void.
Jiang Ming was stunned.. His eyes widened in shock when he finally regained his senses. “He managed to tear a hole in the void! This is only possible after comprehending the mysteries of the void or the void movement techniques!”

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - The Three Stages of the Akasa; A Delicate Cry of Senior Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: The Three Stages of the Akasa; A Delicate Cry of Senior Brother
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was shocked when he realized it was his junior sister who had cut down the old man’s Primal Spirit. He would not be so surprised if her cultivation base was really high. After all, with a high cultivation base, one would have to comprehend the spatial Sambodha and the derivative of spatial Sambodha. However, with her current cultivation base, when did she have the time to comprehend these Sambodhas?
Even the most talented cultivator needed more than three months to raise his or her cultivation base from the Golden Core Realm to the Dao Seed Realm while comprehending the spatial Sambodha. If his junior sister truly managed to achieve such a feat, then she was truly remarkable.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Disciple of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak.
Relationship: 95
Innate Talent: Immortal (intermediate phoenix bloodline)
Status: After coming out of Yun Tianlong’s secret tomb, she ran into two devil cultivators and killed them. Then, after she ran into the flood dragon, Bai Haitian, and his people, Bai Yu suddenly appeared. After Bai Yu killed Bai Haitian, she watched the battle between Bai Yu and Jiang Ming, who made a sudden appearance. When she sensed the aura of a Primal Spirit cultivator, she hurriedly hid in the void. When the Primal Spirit cultivator’s Primal Spirit was trying to flee, she cast her special ability and quickly ended his life.
‘My junior sister is really impressive. She’s able to hide her presence from a Primal Spirit cultivator. Is this the power of the phoenix bloodline?’
“Thank you, Senior,” Zi Linglong said as she placed her hands in front of her and bowed. She was standing quite a distance away from Jiang Ming, amazed and slightly fearful of the strength of the person standing in front of her. She was certain the person in front of her was in the Dao Seed Realm. However, the mana he possessed was even greater than that of a Primal Spirit cultivator. She had never met someone like him before. Not only that, but his physical strength and power were one of the strongest she had seen of people with the same cultivation bases as him.
‘Why don’t I remember anything about him from my previous life? This is impossible. I’m sure there isn’t such a person in Qingyun Sect. What’s his purpose? Why wasn’t he known in my previous life?’ Zi Linglong could not find any answers despite how hard she racked her brain for answers. She sighed inwardly as she thought to herself, “Even the softest gust of wind can stir up a storm and bring about great destruction. Fate truly works in an unpredictable and mysterious way. In any case, I’m still too weak. I have to spend time exploring all the other secret tombs that have yet to be found. And then, there’s that place… I have to go to that place and obtain the things there…’
While countless thoughts raced through Zi Linglong’s mind, Jiang Ming flicked his sleeve and said, “Don’t mention it.”
After collecting the spoils of his battle, he thought about it for a moment before he decided against giving them to his junior sister. After all, he did not gain these things through righteous means. At the same time, he briefly wondered if he should reveal his identity to her but quickly dismissed that idea. He was not the strongest yet so until then, he had to be very careful.
“You should leave now. There are people watching,” Jiang Ming said as he glanced into the distance. There was someone observing them from afar. However, since he was not very strong yet, and he was alone, he decided not to pursue the matter. After saying that, he turned around and left.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong stood with her hands clasped in front of her as she looked at the figure that was slowly disappearing into the distance. Then, she left the area as well, still confused.
…
After traveling a distance away, Jiang Ming sensed his junior sister had left using the void so she would not leave any traces behind. With that, he sighed in relief.
Then, he called up the Human Path Records and read it as he flew back.
…
The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in Zhong Province.
