This Sacred Land was located among the mountains. One of the mountains, which was more than 5,000 feet tall, towered above the clouds. From a distance, it looked like a cauldron.
The peak of the mountain was constantly spitting out fire that reached 1,000 meters high.
People could be seen around the fire from time to time, and without an exception, all of them had very powerful auras.
Many palaces could be seen at the peak of the other mountains. They were all, without fail, majestic and glowed with a divine light. It was not hard to deduce that these were the residences of powerful people.
At this moment, a thunderous cry rang from one of the palaces.
“Holy Lord, the Holy Son’s soul token has shattered! The four men are dead, and even Zhang Fan, his guardian, is dead!”
“What?! How’s that possible?! Who dares to kill him? Who’s capable of killing him? Are they trying to wage a war with the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?”
“Holy Lord, before Elder Zhang Fan met his demise, he sent a message with his Primal Spirit saying it’s the Qingyun Sect.”
“The Qingyun Sect? Indeed, Xiao Yu was in the Eastern Region. In that place, only Qingyun Sect has the guts to do something like this! The Holy Son is our pride. Killing him is tantamount to trampling on our pride and dignity. Since they want war, we’ll give them war. Pass on my order! We’re going to the Eastern Region! We’re going to annihilate the Qingyun Sect and conquer the Eastern Region!”
Soon after, a wave of terrifying energy erupted one after another from the palaces in the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion.
One of the people who had gathered was so strong that he could even tear the void open with his bare hands. Following that, a sword appeared in his hand before he vanished into thin air.
…
It did not take long for news of Bai Yu’s death to spread in Zhong Province.
“The Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was killed in the Eastern Region? How dare they kill the Holy Son of Zhong Province? They must have a death wish. I’m going to show the Eastern Region what we’re made of! Who’s with me?”
“Me! I’d like to meet the cultivator in the Eastern Region who managed to kill our Holy Son!”
“Although Bai Yu was sinister and ruthless, he’s one of the few who could represent Zhong Province. Killing him is tantamount to slapping our faces! Let’s go!”
“The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion won’t sit back and do nothing either. It’s highly likely the two Sacred Lands will go to war. How can I not join in the fun? I’ll bring the 99 fairies from the Hundred Flowers Chamber to entertain everyone during our trip!”
…
Following that, news of Bai Yu’s death quickly spread to the Northern, Southern, and Western Regions as well.
This was big news since the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was a prominent figure. Not only did he possess the Heaven Overlord Body, but he was also the strongest among the younger generations in the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion as well.
Everyone had high expectations of Bai Yu. In the future, no one doubted he would become the Holy Lord of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. He was very famous in Zhong Province. He was not as strong as the older generation yet, but he would have surpassed them in the future. It was unfortunate that he had died before he could realize his potential.
…
Jiuyang Sect in the Eastern Region.
Jiang Ming was unaware of the storm that was brewing in the horizon as a result of him killing Bai Yu.
After arriving at Jiuyang sect, he returned to Chuyang Peak. At this moment, he stood on the rooftop and gazed into the distance, thinking about the earlier battle.
“My mana is greater than that of a Primal Spirit cultivator. My body is also stronger than the Heaven Overlord Body. I should’ve been able to deal with Zhang Fan, who was in the Primal Spirit Realm, swiftly, and yet, it took me such a long time just to deal with him. I think the problem is that… I didn’t comprehend my special abilities enough.”
Jiang Ming had a lot of powerful special abilities. However, he had yet to comprehend and master them completely. For example, he had only comprehended the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi and the Nine Divine Mountain Treasures to the rudimentary stage. These two were his strongest special abilities. If he had comprehended them to the mastery stage, it would have been like a walk in the park to kill Zhang Fan.
“I should focus on comprehending these two special abilities when I’m comprehending the Sambodhas, especially the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi.”
There were three stages to the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi. First, there were the invisible energy swords. When they fused with the void, they would be invisible and silent. However, their speed was very fast. One would be considered to have mastered this stage once one was capable of manifesting nine energy swords.
The second stage was to fuse all nine energy swords into one. With that, it would be able to travel through space and kill an enemy that was thousands of miles away in just an instant.
The third stage was strengthening the energy swords until they were capable of piercing through the void.
“Once I’ve fully comprehended this special ability, I’ll be able to master the space Sambodha as well…”
…
While Jiang Ming was immersed in his thoughts, Zi Linglong finally returned to Jiuyang sect. After speaking to the Sect Master, she looked for Jiang Ming immediately.
“Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong called out.. Her eyes were as bright as the moon as she threw herself into Jiang Ming’s arms like a fledgling that had just returned to its nest.

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - There Are No Secrets Between Us
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: There Are No Secrets Between Us
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Spell: Primal Spirit Heart Sword, Ten Thousand Sword Technique, basic Formations, basic Talismans, basic Pills, and basic Artifacts.
Special ability: Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, Great Manifestation Technique, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Wood Dragon, Slice the Heavens, Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Three-Fold Astral Transformation, Nine Layer Cannon, Orbital Sword Formation
Innate Talent: Immortal (primary Daoist body)
Item: Human Path Records, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk, Mana Sealing Chessboard (top-grade Dao Vessel), Tyrant Halberd (middle-grade Dao Vessel), Sky Rending Sword (middle-grade Dao Vessel), Heaven Shattering Hammer (low-grade Dao Vessel), Golden Obsidian (low-grade Dao Vessel), Heaven Suppression Cauldron (top-grade Dao Vessel), 3,000 years of cultivation, Enlightening Tea Leaf x13, Enlightening Stone x80, Space Stone, immortal-grade Enlightening Tea Tree Seed
Jiang Ming was relieved now that his junior sister had returned. At this moment, he was lying on the rocking recliner and admiring the starry sky.
His junior sister lay next to him with a smile on her face as she rocked the recliner.
Meanwhile, their master, Gu Hai, stood at the top of the main building with his hands clasped on his back as he gazed into the distance.
Jiang Ming and Gu Hai did not ask about what happened to Zi Linglong over the past three months. After all, she had just returned, and they had plenty of time to ask about it in the future.
At this time, Jiang Ming was also going through the spoils of his battle with Bai Yu and the old man. He was rather surprised when he looked through them. He did not expect the Mana Sealing Chessboard to be a top-grade Dao Vessel that was incredibly rare. However, he was even more surprised when he discovered that the chessboard did not increase the owner’s physical strength at all. It was only now that he realized Bai Yu was bluffing. Clearly, Bai Yu was trying to intimidate him with his lies.
The Mana Sealing Chessboard only had one function: it could pull one’s opponent into it to duel using only their physical strength. One would not be able to leave until someone died. There was no limit to the number of people that could enter the chessboard.
Jiang Ming shook his head. ‘The person who created this must have something wrong with his head!’
Not only would the Mana Sealing Chessboard not enhance its owner’s strength, but it would not even protect its owner. All it did was pull people into it for a life-or-death fight. Perhaps, for others, it might be useless, but it was quite useful toward Jiang Ming. After all, even he did not know the limits of his physical body and strength.
Jiang Ming nodded in satisfaction.
Thanks to the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, there was not much he needed to do, but his body would constantly be tempered. Apart from that, his body would undergo a transformation whenever he comprehended a Sambodha and formed a Dao Seed. If he had to guess, he would say his physical body and strength were not any weaker than his cultivation base.
‘The Mana Sealing Chessboard is rather useful to me…’ Jiang Ming thought to himself after various ways to use the chessboard appeared in his mind.
‘Look, System, the spoils of my battle are much better than the rewards you give me!’
Alas, he did not receive a response from the system.
Apart from the Mana Sealing Chessboard, Sky Shattering Hammer, Golden Obsidian, Heaven Suppression Cauldron, and other items, he was most satisfied with the Sky Rending Sword, which was a middle-grade Dao Vessel. After all, neither Purple Cloud nor Blue Crystal could handle the power of the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi. For this reason, the offensive strength was greatly reduced. However, with the Sky Rending Sword, the problem was solved.
The 108 swords Bai Yu had used to form his sword Formation were all Artifacts from a complete set.
‘As expected of a Holy Son from a Sacred Land! He was really wealthy! Just his possessions alone are enough to make me rich. With his possessions alone, I’m afraid no one in Jiuyang Sect is as rich as I am.’
Needless to say, he obtained many medicinal pills, spirit crystals, rare items from Bai Yu as well.
Apart from that, he also obtained three special abilities from Bai Yu’s storage ring. The first one was called the Three-Fold Astral Transformation. At the first stage, one could increase one’s height by 333 cm and double one’s strength. At the second stage, one could increase one’s height by 666 cm and double one’s strength again, which was four times stronger than before. At the third stage, one could increase one’s height by 999 cm and double one’s strength again, which was eight times stronger than the original.
Unfortunately for Bai Yu, he had only mastered it to the first stage. Otherwise, Jiang Ming would have to expend more strength to kill him.
The second special ability was the Nine Heavenly Cannons. When Zhang Fan had used it against his Nine Divine Mountain Treasure, it was capable of destroying his divine mountain with just a strike.
The third special ability was the Orbital Sword Formation. Bai Yu had used 108 swords to form the Formation, and Jiang Ming had been rather impressed.
All in all, with these three special abilities in his arsenal, his attacks would be more versatile.
Jiang Ming continued to absorb the cultivation he received from the daily reward. However, he did not use the 3,000 years of cultivation yet because he planned to use them when breaking through to the next realm.
Jiang Ming was not in desperate need of mana. What he needed was more special abilities and to comprehend the Sambodhas.
He had been using a lot of the Enlightening Tea Leaves. However, since he was rewarded with them daily, he still had 12 left. As for the Enlightening Stone, he had yet to use any of them.
At this moment, Zi Longlong turned to her side and rested her head on her hands as she looked at Jiang Ming. Then, she said, “Senior Brother, home is the best place in the world. I feel safe here.”
“Of course! There’s no place better than one’s home in the world!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “So don’t simply run away from home again, understand?”
“Alright, alright,” Zi Linglong replied with a giggle.
The duo continued to chat.
Jiang Ming was delighted that his junior sister’s treatment of him did not change at all even though she had broken through to the Dao Seed Realm. In other words, his junior sister still loved him very much, and no one could take her away from him.
…
When the sky began to brighten, Jiang Ming got up and began to prepare breakfast.
This time, he served breakfast on the rooftop. They ate their breakfast while they enjoyed the gentle morning breeze and the beautiful mountain scenery.
“This is delicious, Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong exclaimed before she continued to say, “While I was away, the thing I miss most was your cooking!”
“Alright. I’ll prepare food for you, and you keep them in your spatial ring before you leave the mountain next time. With that, you’ll be able to eat the food I make even if you’re away,” Jiang Ming said affectionately.
“You’re the best, Senior Brother!”
At this time, Gu Hai who had been keeping quiet all this time put his chopsticks down and asked, “What about me? Why do you talk as though I’ve never taken care of you before?”
“Master! I’m talking about food!” Zi Linglong said with a laugh, “After so long, you’ve only cooked for us a few times!”
Jiang Ming chimed in, “Master, I don’t mean to be rude, but your cooking is really… unpalatable…”
“So what? Didn’t I still manage to raise both of you?” Gu Hai scoffed. Then, his expression suddenly turned solemn before he said, “Tell me about everything that happened.”
Linglong nodded. She began by recounting how she and the other disciples ran into devil cultivators before she was separated from them. She said that accidentally stumbled upon a secret tomb while she was running away. Since there were many treasures in there, she decided to spend her time cultivating there.
Her story was simple. She did not tell her master about her encounter with Bai Yu or Bai Haitian, the flood dragon. She did not want her master to worry about her too much, after all.
After listening to Zi Linglong, Gu Hai exclaimed in shock and disbelief, “What?! You’ve entered the Dao Seed Realm?!”
“That’s amazing, Junior Sister!” Jiang Ming exclaimed, trying his best to look surprised.
“Thank you!” Linglong said, grinning from ear to ear. Then, she brought a medicinal pill out and handed it to Gu Hai as she said, “Master, this is the Divine Purple Mansion Pill. I heard you damaged your Purple Mansion in the past. Perhaps, this pill might be able to repair the damage.”
“The Divine Purple Mansion Pill?” Gu Hai’s eyes widened in shock. His hands trembled as he reached out to take the pill before he asked, “Are you sure this is the Divine Purple Mansion Pill?”
Zi Linglong nodded. “I’m sure!”
“Up until now, this medicinal pill only existed in legends. Many people had searched for it, but they couldn’t find it. I didn’t expect my disciple to find it in the end! This is a blessing! I really didn’t make a mistake accepting you as my disciple! Thank you so much, Linglong!” Gu Hai said as he laughed happily.
“Don’t mention it, Master! Without you, I wouldn’t even be sitting here!”
“Very good, very good! Linglong, you’ve grown up into a fine young lady,” Gu Hai said, pleased. However, his tone turned solemn as he continued to say, “However, apart from the Sect Master and a few First Seats, don’t tell anyone about your current cultivation base.”
“Why?” Linglong asked as she tilted her head slightly.
Gu Hai sighed before he said, “It’s a long story. Do you remember Momo? As it turns out, she’s a spy from Bishui Sect. To think she’s been with us for such a long time, and the Bishui Sect has just moved to Hai Province. How long were they planning for this? In any case, we don’t know if there are other spies in the sect so it’s best to maintain a low profile. You might attract jealousy and hate if you reveal your cultivation base. You managed to break through to the Dao Seed Realm after cultivating for only three months in the secret tomb. We really can’t let anyone about such a heaven-defying feat.”
“Huh? Senior Sister Momo is a spy? But…” Linglong sighed heavily. After a moment, she nodded and solemnly said, “You’re right, Master. I’ll make sure to keep my cultivation base a secret.”
Inwardly, Zi Linglong thought to herself, ‘This is strange. Why did she get exposed so early?’
Jiang Ming asked, “Do you know of any technique to conceal your cultivation base?”
“Yes! I learned a special ability that can help me conceal my cultivation base. I’m confident that even cultivators who are two realms ahead of me won’t be able to detect my real cultivation base,” Zi Linglong replied.
“That’s great,” Jiang Ming said. Then, he turned to Gu Hai and said, “Master, I think it’s enough that the Sect Master knows about Junior Sister’s cultivation base. There’s no need for anyone else to know. After all, the more people who know about it, the more dangerous it’ll be. Take the three of us, for example. We’re like a family, and there are no secrets between us. Although some of the First Seats are trustworthy, I’m afraid they won’t guard against their disciples and will reveal Junior Sister’s cultivation base to them. At that time, the matter won’t be a secret any longer.”
“You have a point. We’re really similar; you’re just as cautious as I am!” Gu Hai said as he stroked his beard.
“This is all thanks to your teachings,” Jiang Ming replied.
Linglong only lowered her head and chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - The Great Akasa Divine Hand; The Woman Who Has Lost Her Mind
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: The Great Akasa Divine Hand; The Woman Who Has Lost Her Mind
The trio discussed for a long time before they finally agreed on a plan. Apart from the Sect Master, they were going to keep Zi Linglong’s cultivation base a secret from everyone.
“You should also remind the Sect Master to keep it a secret. We need to make sure Linglong has a safe place to cultivate until she breaks through to the Primal Spirit Realm where she can finally protect herself,” Jiang Ming said.
“You’re right. That’s very thoughtful of you,” Gu Hai said as he nodded.
Warmth suffused Zi Linglong’s heart when she saw how much the duo cared and worried about her. After a moment, she brought out a few porcelain vials and items and set them down the table. Then, she said to Jiang Ming, “Senior Brother, these are pills that can help you form your core and expand your Purple Mansion. This armor here is a low-grade Artifact. You can use it for the time being. Once you’ve broken through to the Golden Core Realm, I’ll find you another armor. As for this bell, it’s a top-grade Artifact. It’s very suitable for you, and…”
Zi Linglong continued to hand one item after another to Jiang Ming as she spoke.
Jiang Ming looked at her with his mouth agape, stunned. Initially, he planned to refuse her gifts, but when he saw her expectant gaze, he swallowed his refusal and accepted them with a smile on his face.
Gu Hai was equally stunned. He said, clearly jealous, “So this is how it is. You forget about your master when your senior brother is present.”
“That’s not true!” Linglong smiled sweetly. She brought a piece of armor out and handed it to Gu Hai as she said, “This is for you. It’s a middle-grade Artifact.”
“Middle-grade?” Gu Hai was stunned again. A piece of defensive armor was far more precious than a weapon of the same grade. Even the sect only had two of such items. When he regained his senses, he shook his head and said, “Keep it for yourself. After all, you’ll still be going out to train. I’m sure the armor will come in handy.”
“Don’t worry, Master. I already have one, and it’s much better than this one!” Zi Linglong said.
“Even if you have a better one, you should still keep it. It’s always good to have extras. What if your armor breaks? Moreover, you can don two armor for extra protection. I rarely leave the mountain so it’s not very useful to me.”
“Master, you have to accept it. Consider it a small token of appreciation from me,” Zi Linglong said.
Jiang Ming chimed in, “Master, just accept it since Senior Sister is so sincere.”
Jiang Ming was aware of his junior sister’s strength and cultivation base, and he knew what kind of tomb she had stumbled upon. Hence, he was certain she possessed many treasures. As for why she did not bring all of them out, it was likely because she thought his and their master’s cultivation bases were not high enough. Possessing treasures when one was weak would only attract trouble, after all.
The trio chatted and laughed as they finished their breakfast.
[Ding! Congratulations on having a harmonious breakfast. Reward: the Great Akasa Divine Hand]
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up upon hearing the system notification.
‘Another one from the Great Akasa series? It must be a powerful technique! First, it was a sword technique; second, it was a movement technique; now, it’s a palm seal technique. I wonder if there are fist techniques and Primal Spirit techniques as well? This is really exciting!’
…
While Jiang Ming was doing the dishes, Gu Hai released a flare of light into the air.
Before long, the Sect Master appeared on Chuyang Peak.
The duo kept their heads closed as they chatted.
When the Sect Master learned that Zi Linglong had broken through to the Dao Seed Realm, he was shocked. He was very tempted to laugh out loud but restrained himself in the end. Following that, he instructed Gu Hai to keep the matter a secret so that Zi Linglong could cultivate in peace. His thoughts were in line with Gu Hai and Jiang Ming’s. He had high expectations of her, and she was one of the candidates who were set to lead the Jiuyang Sect. He decided to tell everyone that she injured herself while she was out so she was going to heal her injuries and cultivate in seclusion. After he was done giving his instructions, he prepared to leave.
Although the Sect Master did not ask Linglong about the secret tomb, Linglong still brought a medicinal pill out and handed it to him.
“T-this… This is the Spirit Rejuvenation Pill?” The Sect Master was shocked. He stared at the pill longingly. Although he really wanted the pill, he resisted the urge to keep it before he said, “Linglong, this pill is very useful in helping one form the Primal Spirit. You should keep it for yourself. After reaching the Nascent Soul Realm, you can use it to enter the Primal Spirit Realm!”
“Sect Master, I still have a long way to go before reaching that realm. You’re the backbone of our sect. You have to become stronger so that we, disciples, will be able to cultivate without worries,” Zi Linglong replied.
“See that? My disciple is not only lucky and talented, but she also has a great personality!” Gu Hai said proudly as he lifted his chin slightly. A big smile could be seen on his face as he continued to say, “You heard what she said. You should accept the pill and become stronger so you can continue supporting the sect!”
In the end, the Sect Master no longer refused the pill. He lamented, “I didn’t expect I’d be given such an opportunity from Chuyang Peak, and the person who helped me the most is your disciple. Fortunately, I had foresight and supported you back then. Otherwise, I’d miss out on a golden opportunity!”
As soon as the Sect Master’s voice fell, the formation at the entrance of the sect shook, and the alarm resounded through the sect.
“Someone is attacking our gate!” The Sect Master’s expression turned grim. “No matter who it is, they can’t have come with good intentions. Gu Hai, look after them. No matter what happens outside, don’t leave. If the worst happens, bring them with you and leave the sect!”
Gu Hai inhaled deeply and nodded.
Following that, the Sect Master rode on a puff of cloud and vanished from sight.
Zi Linglong furrowed her brows as she looked in the direction of the sect’s entrance.
…
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming, who had heard the alarm, leaped up to the rooftop. His eyes glowed with a divine light as he looked past the formation to see what was going on outside.
He saw a woman glowing with a green light hovering in the air in front of the gates of Jiuyang Sect. She was stunningly beautiful, but her expression was frosty. When she lifted her hand and pointed ahead, the barrier around Jiuyang Sect shook again. It looked as though it was going to shatter at any given moment.
Subsequently, she cocked an eyebrow before she brought out a blue sword. With a single strike, she tore an opening in the barrier and stepped into the sect.
Upon seeing this, everyone from the Jiuyang Sect who were present, whether they were First Seats, elders, or disciples, was stunned. Tearing the barrier and entering the sect without permission was no different from trampling on the sect’s pride and dignity.
Jiang Ming’s expression darkened as he saw this blatant invasion.
Swoosh!
He called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Mu Shuiyun
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm.
Background: Elder of the Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Nine stars (Water Spirit Body)
Status: She was once the Holy Daughter of Qingyun Sect. She was abducted by a flood dragon and lost her chastity. When she returned to Qingyun Sect, she was stripped of her title due to her pregnancy. She lost her mind when her son, Mu Lei, was killed after visiting Jiuyang Sect to propose to Zi Linglong. When she found the base of a devil sect, she had a huge battle with them. As a result, she was injured. After she recovered from her injuries, she continued to grieve the loss of her son. When she recalled the woman who had rejected her son’s proposal, she was overcome with rage. She couldn’t accept that her son was dead while the woman who rejected is still alive. As such, she came to Jiuyang Sect to capture Zi Linglong with the intention of burying Zi Linglong with her son.
‘Mu Shuiyun!’ Jiang Ming said through gritted teeth as he narrowed his eyes. ‘You want to bury my junior sister with your son? Dream on!’
At this time, Zi Linglong and Gu Hai came to Jiang Ming’s side.
Zi Linglong stood in between Jiang Ming and Gu Hai as she mobilized her mana and gazed into the distance.
…
The Sect Master appeared, holding a sword in his hand. His face was flushed red from anger as he said, “Daoist Shuiyun, what’s the meaning of this?”
As the Sect Master spoke, the sword in his hand buzzed and thrummed, causing ripples to form in the void.
At the same time, a barrier was forming in the sky.
A few First Seats, Dongfang Lie; Yue Cheng; and Yin Yue. appeared one after another and moved to stand next to the Sect Master. Their expressions were all dark.
“My son, Mu Lei, took a liking to a girl in your sect,” Mu Shuiyun bluntly said, “Hand her over to me.”
“How dare you!” the Sect Master growled. “Not only did you trespass into my sect, but you even dare to demand I hand my disciple to you?” Mu Shuiyun, do you really think Jiuyang Sect is a place where you can come and go as you please and make unreasonable demands?”
“Even if you’re from the Qingyun Sect, this is too much!” Yue Cheng snarled. “Damaging our formation and trespassing into our sect are a declaration of war!”
Swoosh!
The white-clad Hao Chen, the First Seat of Shaoyang Peak, wore a frosty expression on his face as he held onto his sword that was buzzing. As he launched an energy sword into the sky, nine suns rose at his back, distorting the void. His eyes brimmed with killing intent as he stared at Mu Shuiyun.
With that, the other First Seats began to mobilize their mana as well.
“I represent no one but myself,” Mu Shuiyun said as she looked at the people in front of her contemptuously, “I admit I’m a bully, but what can you do about it? I’ll ask you one more time. Yan Yan, are you going to hand that disciple over to me or not? If you refuse…”
Mu Shuiyun paused briefly. A cruel smile appeared on her face before she said, “I’ll tell the world that Jiuyang Sect is colluding with the devil sects to conquer the Eastern Region. At that time, everyone will have the right to attack the Jiuyang Sect. The devil’s base we found thousands of miles away from here is the best evidence.. Are you sure you want to drag everyone to hell for the sake of one disciple?”

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - Huo Daoren; Die, Old Tie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Huo Daoren; Die, Old Tie!
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Although the Jiuyang Sect was much weaker than Qingyun Sect, Jiuyang Sect was rather popular in the Eastern Region. Even a Primal Spirit cultivator would not dare to trespass into Jiuyang Sect. After all, the Jiuyang Sect had more than 1,000 years of history and possessed an ancient formation that protected the sect’s estate. There was also a group of highly-skilled and experienced elders.
However, Mu Shuiyun was not just any cultivator. Not only did she have a high cultivation base, but her background was special as well. Moreover, she no longer cared about anything else but avenging her son at this moment. Hence, how could she be afraid of the Jiuyang Sect?
Upon hearing Mu Shuiyun’s threat, the Sect Master laughed in anger. “Mu Shuiyun, if anyone’s colluding with the devil sect, it’d be you!”
“So is that a no?” Mu Shuiyun asked frostily, The Dao sword in her hand burst forth with light.
“Get lost!” the Sect Master barked.
“You asked for this!” Mu Shuiyun hissed. She raised her sword and launched a powerful strike at the Sect Master.
The Sect Master lifted his hand, summoning a cauldron in front of him to block the attack. Alas, he and the cauldron were sent flying back.
Hao Chen, the First Seat of Shaoyang Peak, felt his killing intent surged. Along with the other First Seats, he charged at Mu Shuiyun.
Unfortunately, as powerful as the seven First Seats were, they were no match for Mu Shuiyun.
Mu Shuiyun brandished her sword with her right hand while she conjured the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal with her left hand, sending the seven First Seats flying.
All of the First Seats had blood at the corners of their lips except for Hao Chen. Among the First Seats, he suffered the least damage from the strike.
Mu Shuiyun was too strong. She was once the Holy Daughter of Qingyun Sect, after all. Regardless of her cultivation base and special abilities, she still had a certain advantage over those from the Jiuyang Sect.
When the Sect Master was about to draw power from his body to activate the Formation again, a formidable energy burst forth from Taiyang Peak. Following that, a figure appeared in front of Mu Shuiyun.
The newcomer raised his hand and cast a Formation, sending Mu Shuiyun flying.
“Old Man Huo? You’re still alive?!” Mu Shuiyun exclaimed in shock and disbelief.
“Scram!” the newcomer, an old man, barked. His eyebrows and beard that were fiery red were a match for his fiery temper. He pointed at Mu Shuiyun as he roared, “I’m not going to repeat myself. Get lost or I’ll kill you today! I want to see if Qingyun Sect will avenge your death once they know what you’ve done!”
Mu Shuiyun scoffed coldly. “Old man, do you think you can kill me? You overestimated yourself too much!”
“Is that so?” The old man mobilized his Primal Spirit, and the nine peaks began to shake. A beam of divine light shot out from each peak into the sky, merging with the Formation before turning into nine suns. At the same time, a terrifying energy surged out his body, boosting the strength of the Formation tremendously.
The old man sneered. “What do you think? I’ve lived for a long time, and I have no qualms dragging you to hell with me.”
“How dare you!”
“Little girl, you might not care about your dignity, but what do you think the Qingyun Sect is the same as you? Now, get lost!”
“Very good! I won’t forget about this, Jiuyang Sect!” Mu Shuiyun said through gritted teeth. Then, she turned around and left when she saw how determined the old man was.
After Mu Shuiyun left, the nine suns vanished from sight. Then, the old man turned around and swept his eyes across the crowd before he said with a sigh, “This is a world that belongs to the strong. It’s unfortunate, but we can only grow stronger and stronger by devouring the weak. For example, if the devil sects are powerful enough to rule over everyone, they’d become the rule. Little Yan, you need to grow stronger. Otherwise, the future of Jiuyang Sect will be at stake.”
“Master!” Yan Yan, the Sect Master, called out as his expression changed slightly.
“Don’t worry. I still have quite a few years left in me,” the old man said as he waved his hand.
The Sect Master and the others bowed as the old man flew back.
…
On Chuyang Peak.
Gu Hai looked in the old man’s direction and bowed as well.
Jiang Ming was silent. He was overwhelmed with the urge to sneak out and kill Mu Shuiyun. However, he knew it was not wise to do that. After all, if Mu Shuiyun died so soon after leaving Jiuyang Sect, the sect will definitely be implicated somehow. Moreover, Mu Lei and Ge Changqing had also died not long after they left Jiuyang Sect.
‘Just you wait, Mu Shuiyun,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself as he suppressed the urge to leave. Then, he looked at Gu Hai and asked, “Master, who’s that old man?”
“He’s the founder of the sect,” Gu Hai explained, “In the past, he was known as Hua Daoren. He’s Jiuyang Sect’s trump card.”
Jiang Ming nodded. Inwardly, he called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Huo Daoren
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm.
Background: Founder of Jiuyang Sect.
Relationship: 60
Innate Talent: Nine stars (Flaming Sun Body)
Status: His time’s almost up so he’s been sleeping in a coffin. He was woken up earlier when he sensed a strong burst of energy. When he realized the sect was facing a powerful enemy, he risked losing his life force and made a move. After scaring off the enemy, he returned to his sleep after sealing himself in the forbidden land.
‘His time’s almost up?’ Jiang Ming sighed inwardly.
When he saw the relationship value at 60, he knew it was because he was a disciple of Jiuyang Sect.
The Flaming Sun Body was special and ordinary at the same time.
Jiang Ming sighed as mixed feelings brewed in his heart. Just an elder from Qingyun Sect was enough to throw Jiuyang Sect into chaos. He and the sect still had a long road ahead of them.
“Master, is it that place?” Jiang Ming pointed to the only undisturbed place in the sect. It was none other than the forbidden land.
In the past, Gu Hai had refused to speak about that place to his disciples. This time, he nodded. Then, he said, “It’s also the formation of the sect.”
Gu Hai paused briefly before he asked, “What did both of you learn from this incident?”
Zi Linglong replied, “Power is everything. As long as you’re strong enough, you can do whatever you want. We need to grow stronger to protect our sect!”
Then, Jiang Ming added, “She’s only an elder of Qingyun Sect, but she alone is enough to throw the sect into chaos. Moreover, even if we complain to Qingyun Sect, it’s likely they won’t do anything to her.”
Gu Hai nodded. “Very good. Linglong, although this isn’t your fault, we can’t deny that it’s related to you. Don’t worry. The sect has no intention of abandoning you. Keep this in mind: cultivate diligently so you’ll grow strong enough to protect our sect!”
“Of course! This is my home after all!” Linglong said as she pointed at the ground beneath her feet.
After a moment, Gu Hai left his two disciples alone.
“I was worried they would hand you over to Mu Shuiyun,” Jiang Ming said, “After all, she’s not only a Primal Spirit cultivator, but she’s also from the Qingyun Sect.”
“What if the sect decides to abandon me?” Zi Linglong asked in a low voice.
“I’ll take you away. Then, I’ll find a chance to kill her!” Jiang Ming replied without any hesitation.
“You’re the best, Senior Brother!” Linglong exclaimed as she hugged his arm. She was smiling so widely that her eyes were narrowed.
…
In Taiyang Peak’s main hall.
The atmosphere was gloomy
The First Seats were gathered, but they were all silent.
After a while, the Sect Master took the lead to say, “I have three things to announce. First, I’ll be sending a letter to Qingyun Sect, demanding an explanation for Mu Shuiyun’s actions. Second, recall all our disciples who have yet to return to the mountain. Then, we’ll close the sect. Forget about the devil sects for now. Third, I’ll be going into seclusion to break through to the Primal Spirit Realm.”
‘Qingyun Sect! You may be the Sacred Land of the Eastern Region, a place where all cultivators aspire to join. However, I won’t let you have your way!’
…
In a mountain range.
A divine light illuminated the sky and the ground. Every peak in the mountain range was connected to one another by rainbow bridges. Various divine beasts flew in the sky from time to time. Apart from that, many palatial buildings were erected on the mountain range.
Jiuyang Sect truly looked shabby compared to this place.
At this moment, a tear appeared in the void before two people walked out from it. One was a burly old man with a head of silver hair holding a huge hammer in his hand. The other person was a young man with an androgynous appearance. He was wearing the Sun God Robe.
The duo was so powerful that as soon as they appeared their immense auras suppressed the law of void.
The old man lifted his hammer and wordlessly brought it down. With that, the void shattered, and the clouds within 10,000 miles were blown away.
The formation of Qingyun Sect automatically erected a barrier as soon as the old man brought this hammer down.
Light burst forth in many places across Qingyun Sect as various laws appeared around it.
Boom!
The hammer fell again, shaking the sky and the ground.
The barrier creaked as though it could no longer withstand the attack.
At this moment, another old man appeared. He lifted his hand to block another attack before he roared, “Old Tie, why are you attacking Qingyun Sect! Do you want a war?”
“That’s right! I came to wage a war, you son of a b*tch!” Old Tie replied.. Then, he flung his hammer out at the old man. At the same time, he shouted, “Qing Xuzi, you killed the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion so I came here today to destroy your sect!”

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - The Explosive Hammer
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: The Explosive Hammer
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Old Tie raised his hammer before he brought it down with all his might. In just a blink of an eye, he had hammered down nine times consecutively, injuring the old man from Qingyun Sect. The explosion of energy each time he brought the hammer down rippled out and even caused many disciples in the vicinity to explode into mists of blood. At this point, no one knew how many people he had already killed.
Qing Xuzi was enraged by the deaths of his disciples. The anger and Old Tie’s attacks caused him to spit out a mouthful of blood. As he resisted Old Tie’s attacks, he growled, “Old Tie, stop being so childish! You better stop this! Neither I nor my Qingyun Sect is afraid of a war with the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion! You better have a good explanation for your actions today!”
Old Tie stopped attacking for a moment as he glanced at the mists of blood that still hung in the air as he said, “This feels great!” Then, he looked at Qing Xuzi and said with a sneer, “Your Qingyun sect killed Bai Yu, the Holy Son of our Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, yesterday night while he was looking for a fortuitous encounter in the Eastern Region!”
Qing Xuzi immediately denied the accusations. “Impossible! The Holy Sons and Holy Daughters of Sacred Lands are representatives our their respective Sacred Lands! As such, no one from my Qingyun Sect would kill your Holy Son! Moreover, we have no conflict between us, why would we kill your Holy Son? Old Tie, with the resurgence of the devil sects, I’m sure this is the devil sects’ doing. They’re trying to sow discord!”
Old Tie’s eyes burned with the flames of fury as he growled, “F*ck the devil sects! You think I’m making baseless accusations? Look at this!”
Old Tie waved his hand, and a projection appeared in midair. It replayed part of the battle yesterday night. Although the rippling void and burst of energy obscured the view slightly, one could still see the battle between two figures.
Old Tie continued to say, “Look at how the man cast the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Wood Dragon, Slice the Heaven, and the Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning with ease and speed! All these are special abilities unique to the Qingyun Sect, right? By the way, this battle was extracted from the memories of a man watching the battle from afar. How can you still deny this, Qing Xuzi?”
Qing Xuzi watched with his mouth agape, baffled. Various expressions flitted past his face as he fell deep into his thoughts. Finally, he shook his head and said, “Old Tie, you know that it’s not impossible for special abilities to leak out.”
Old Tie sneered. “You’re still denying? I don’t care! Hand the man over, and we can still negotiate. Otherwise, I won’t stop my hammer from falling again!”
Qing Xuzi smiled wryly. “Is there a need for me to lie? This is clearly an attempt to frame my sect!”
“Fine, I’ll send you to hell then!” Old Tie said before he decisively attacked.
At this time, the red-clad young man standing next to Old Tie prepared to assist Old Tie. He summoned a crimson sword in his hand. The sword’s appearance instantly drew the energy from the sun, raising the temperature immediately.
Qing Xuzi defended against Old Tie’s attacks as he asked, “Old Tie, don’t you believe me?”
“Who would?” OId Tie retorted. His attacks did not slow down at all.
Meanwhile, many elders were awakened from their cultivation. They looked at the battle from afar, clearly not worried. They were confident of the strength of their sect, which was the strongest in the Eastern Region. They believed they could hold their ground even if all the experts from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion were here. Moreover, they had lived for such a long time that they knew it was unlikely for a war to break out between two Sacred Lands. At most, they would have to compensate for the loss. They understood that venting anger, throwing accusations, killing, and compensation were all parts of the process for cases like this. Moreover, it was just the death of a Holy Son. At most, the compensation would be a little more costly.
…
The impact from the battle was felt for quite a distance. Even the people from Jiuyang Sect could sense the fluctuations.
On the rooftop in Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming sensed the mild fluctuations of energy in the void, and his heart skipped a beat. ‘This kind of fluctuation can only be the result of a battle in Qingyun Sect. Perhaps, they’re fighting with the experts from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. I hope they fight each other to the death! In any case, this has nothing to do with Jiuyang Sect, and I can cultivate in peace.”
At the same time, Jiang Ming noticed Zi Linglong glancing in the direction of the battle as well. He could not help but smile.
Zi Linglong peeled a grape and sent it to Jiang Ming’s mouth before she asked, “Senior Brother, why are you happy?”
“I’m happy because of your high cultivation base,” Jiang Ming replied. Then, he reached out and took the bowl of grapes in front of Linglong as he said, “Let me do it.”
Linglong refused. “No, I want to do it!”
“I’m not disabled. I can do it,” Jiang Ming said.
“Just let me do it! You used to feed me all the time. Now, it’s my turn! Open your mouth, Senior Brother,” Zi Linglong said as she fed Jiang Ming another grape.
After eating the grape, Jiang Ming said, “I’m just worried you’ll use too much strength and knock my teeth out.”
Linglong snickered in response.
“Little girl, you’re so disrespectful.”
Zi Linglong smiled as she reached out to pat Jiang Ming’s head and said, “You’re just a few years older than I am. Moreover, seniority in our sect is based on our cultivation bases. Since my cultivation base is higher than yourS…” She paused to giggle before she continued to say, “You should address me as Senior Sister from now on!”
“Impudent! Do you believe I’ll spank you?”
“Senior Brother, don’t forget my cultivation base is higher than yours. You better not provoke me. Otherwise, I’ll make you cook delicious food for me all day long!” Zi Linglong said jokingly.
Jiang Ming only chuckled in response. After a moment, he said, “Oh, that’s right. Do you remember the rice wine I told you about during the last harvest? It’s ready now!”
“Really? Hurry up and bring it out. I want to try it,” Zi Linglong said excitedly.
“What did you say you’ll do if I provoke you?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Senior Brother, I apologize for my earlier words. Can you not use so much strength?” Zi Linglong asked as she turned around with her butt facing Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming spat out the grape in his mouth when he saw Zi Linglong’s round and plump bottom.
…
When Gu Hai returned in the evening, he told Jiang Ming about the Sect Master’s instructions.
Jiang Ming sighed, “So we’re going to seal the mountain? What about Hai Province?”
After all, Hai Province had been invaded by Bishui Sect and was on the brink of being conquered.
Gu Hai sighed before he said, “There’s nothing we can do about it. That crazy Mu Shuiyun came, determined to seek revenge, but she was forced to leave. Do you think she’ll let the matter go considering how petty she is? She’s like lurking outside waiting to kill our disciples.”
“What about those who have yet to return to the mountain?”
“The elders who went out to search for Linglong have returned. We’re rather certain she won’t attack the other disciples due to their low cultivation base…”
“That’s a relief…”
…
After dinner, Zi Linglong left to cultivate.
Jiang Ming stood on the rooftop and gazed into the distance. When he called up the Human Path Records, he discovered that Mu Shuiyun indeed did not go far. She was about 3,000 miles away from the sect. Clearly, she had not given up.
Then, he turned to look in the direction of Qingyun Sect. He was certain Mu Shuiyun had already sensed the fluctuations of a battle from Qingyun Sect so he could not help but wonder why she did not hurry back to Qingyun Sect. In the end, he came to two conclusions: one, she was afraid of death, and two, she was too consumed by seeking revenge.
Jiang Ming did not dwell on this matter; he felt it was a waste of time. Instead, he began to cultivate. After all, his survival is dependent on having a high cultivation base. After checking on the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Plate Disk that was buried underground, he sat cross-legged and began to cultivate.
He planned to learn two of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s special abilities: the Three-Fold Astral Transformation and the Nine Divine Cannons.
After only a night, he managed to comprehend them to the rudimentary stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - Let the Hunt Begin; Teleportation
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Let the Hunt Begin; Teleportation
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Since Jiuyang Sect was located quite a distance away from Qingyun Sect, they only heard some rumors and had yet to hear about the final result of the battle in Qingyun Sect. All they knew was that the battle leveled thousands of mountains, damaged Formations, and dried up the lakes. Although the destruction was not small, all in all, the Qingyun Sect did not suffer too many losses.
…
More than a month passed in just a blink of an eye.
In the evening, when the sky was dyed with the colors of burnt orange, crimson red, and dark blue.
Linglong lay on Jiang Ming’s lap as she rested her legs on a stool. She stared at the sky as she said, “How great would it be if there were no disputes in the world…”
Jiang Ming replied, “As long as greed remains so will disputes. If you want to live a carefree life, you can only cultivate diligently until you gain absolute power.”
“Senior Brother, you’re really wise.”
“Of course! I have a few more years of experience compared to you, after all!”
“Yeah, but my cultivation base is still higher than yours!”
Jiang Ming cleared his throat and said, “Can we stop poking at each other’s shortcomings? At the very least, I’m in the Foundation Establishment Realm now.”
“That’s not enough, Senior Brother. Why don’t I transfer some energy to you?” Zi Linglong asked.
“What’s the point? I’ll only increase my mana, but it won’t help me break through to another realm,” Jiang Ming said as he shook his head.
“I’ve read books about how we can raise our cultivation bases through sexual cultivation techniques! Shall we give them a try?”
“What kind of nonsense are you reading? Stop reading those kinds of books and focus on cultivating from now on!”
“Okay!”
“Hey…”
“Hmm?”
“You know about Sambodhas, right?”
“Yes! Senior Brother, do you want to comprehend them earlier?”
“That’s right. Apart from natural wind movement, I wonder if we can comprehend wind Sambodha through wind induced by burning wood?”
“I think so.”
“Why do you say so?”
“Wind Sambodha is one of the easiest to comprehend since you can comprehend them through natural wind movement or wind-related special abilities. However, to comprehend it through wind induced by the burning of wood, you’ll have to comprehend the fire Sambodha and the wood Sambodha first. The five natural elements are wood, fire, earth, water, metal, and water. It’s already difficult to comprehend one elemental Sambodha so it’s even more difficult to fuse two Sambodhas.”
“I see…”
“In fact, you can try to convert natural energy. For example, extreme Yin can be transformed into extreme Yang and vice versa. Although they’re conflicting, they’re also interchangeable. It’s often said that water represents Yin and fire represents Yang, but that’s not true. Fire has both Yin and Yang, and the same goes for water, wood, earth, and metal. The five elements form the base of all things, and Yin and Yang is the source of all things. Hence, there’s a saying that the five elements can form all things, and Yin and Yang can rule the world.”
“What about space and time?”
“Yin and Yang, the five elements, space, time, nature, death, reincarnation, karma, and so on are energies at the same level. However, most things in the world are the results of a fusion of energies. For example, a grain of rice contains the elements of water, earth, and wood. Then, there’s also lava that a fusion of fire, earth, and water.
“Are these energies difficult to comprehend?”
“Of course!”
As Jiang Ming listened to his junior sister, he discovered her explanations were easier to understand compared to Master Dao Yan’s A Detailed Explanation on Human Cultivation Realms.
The duo continued to talk until darkness fell, the moon rose in the sky, and the gentle night wind made its appearance.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records and was surprised by what he saw. Hence, he said to Zi Linglong, “Alright, you better return to your room now. I’m going to cultivate.”
“Alright, Senior Brother! Don’t push yourself too hard! If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask me!” Zi Linglong said before she left.
“Alright.”
After Zi Linglong vanished from sight, he turned his attention to the Human Path Records.
Name: Mu Shuiyun
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: An elder of Qingyun Sect.
Relationship: -90
Innate talent: 9 stars (Water Spirit Body)
Status: After being forced to leave Jiuyang Sect, she grew even more resentful. Her anger and hatred intensified so she was no longer content with burying the b*tch who rejected her son; she wanted to bury the entire Jiuyang Sect as well now. She’s lurking about 3,000 miles away but hasn’t found an opportunity to act. Due to her son’s death, she’s indifferent to the battle in Qingyun Sect. Moreover, when she heard about the death of the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, she laughed madly. It did not take long for her to learn about the chaos and the deaths of countless disciples due to the battle between two Extreme Path experts. Apart from insisting the Qingyun Sect hand over the murderer, the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion also demanded a formal apology and two top-grade Dao Vessels as compensation. Hearing these pieces of news gave her an idea to seek revenge from the Jiuyang Sect. She plans to use her identity as an elder of Qingyun Sect to order Bishui Sect to send a troop to attack Jiuyang Sect. She’s now arrived in Hai Province and making her way to Bishui Sect.
Jiang Ming carefully read through Mu Shuiyun’s information. Upon seeing their relationship value at -90, he knew Mu Shuiyun wanted everyone from Jiuyang Sect to die. After all, Mu Shuiyun did not know him at all. Then, he read her incredibly long status without missing a word.
Jiang Ming felt rather speechless after he finished reading Mu Shuiyun’s status. ‘Mu Shuiyun is really vicious and heartless! She doesn’t even care that her sect’s in trouble. She’s really crazy!’
His eyes shone with killing intent as he thought to himself, ‘Qingyun Sect must be enraged by the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s demands, especially the two top-grade Dao Vessels. Qingyun Sect is busy dealing with their problems now so this is the best time for me to begin my hunt. I won’t stand for her plotting to kill Junior Sister or anyone from Jiuyang Sect!’
Jiang Ming returned to his room and activated the Formation that isolated the building from the outside. Then, he extended a strand of his consciousness to check on his master and sister. When he saw his master was digesting the medicinal pill and his junior sister was cultivating, he felt it was safe enough to sneak out.
Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly froze in his steps before turning to look in the direction of Qingyun Sect. He frowned. He was suddenly seized by a sense of unease. His gut instincts had been very accurate so he did not think lightly of it.
‘Are there experts searching the Tomb of Extreme Path at the border of Hai Province and Qing Province?’
After a while, he finally left. With just a thought, he reappeared outside the sect. He used the Akasa network and traveled to a hillside 5,000 miles away.
To be safe, he found himself a safe spot. He leaped onto a tree branch before he sat cross-legged on it. At the same time, he suppressed his aura to avoid detection. Following that, he brought out a space crystal. He planned to comprehend the space Sambodha using it.
He brought the crystal to his forehead, channeling his mana into it. In just an instant, a mysterious energy shrouded his mind. He could see spatial networks, spatial ripples, spatial vibrations, spatial distortions, spatial nodes, and so on.
He continued to comprehend the space Sambodha as he tried to master its powers.
He only stopped cultivating when the energy in the space crystal was depleted, reducing the crystal to dust.
When he opened his eyes, it was as though he was looking at a whole new world. He could now clearly see the spatial network and waves. He could even sense the spatial nodes that were as countless as the stars.
Jiang Ming exclaimed in delight, “Amazing!”
He decided to cast the Great Akasa Steps since it was related to the void and space. He vanished in just a blink of an eye and reappeared thousands of miles away. This time, he did not travel through the Akasa network, otherwise also known as the void or spatial network. Instead, he had stepped on a spatial node and arrived at another spatial node. In other words, he had teleported!
Jiang Ming felt like laughing out loud. ‘With this, I have nothing to fear!’
After he calmed down, he recalled he had to kill Mu Shuiyun as fast as he could so he rushed toward Hai Province.

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - New Functions: Locate and Projection; Step Grandmother
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: New Functions: Locate and Projection; Step Grandmother
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Without understanding, one would not be able to see things even if they were right in front of one’s eyes.
For example, space. It was abstract and had no form, but it was everywhere. However, once one gained an understanding of it, one would see a whole new world. One might not be able to see space or the void, but one would be able to see the things related to it like spatial nodes.
At this time, Jiang Ming continued to travel using the spatial nodes, leaping from one node to another. The further the spatial node was, the more mana it consumed. After a while, he discovered his limit was teleporting 3,000 miles away. He was delighted. “This is amazing!”
Previously, when he traveled using the Akasa network, it would cause spatial vibrations. Hence, it was impossible for him to not leave any traces behind. With this, he would be truly traceless. Although it consumed a lot of mana, this was not an issue to Jiang Ming.
It did not take long before Jiang Ming arrived at the Hai Province. Since it was located near the sea, the people had to frequently deal with ferocious sea beasts. For this reason, the province was not very affluent.
In the past, there used to be three main forces here: the Jiang clan, the Feiyun Sect, and the Tianshui Sect. After the invasion of Bishui Sect, the Jiang clan submitted while Feiyun Sect was annihilated. Only Tianshui Sect was left struggling.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records to check on Mu Shuiyun again. Following that, he received notifications that he had unlocked two new functions of the Human Path Records: Locate and Projection.
As its name suggested, the Locate function would help Jiang Ming pinpoint the location when he wrote his target’s name in the Human Path Records. He was delighted with this function. In the future, he would be able to find everyone in the future.
As for the Projection function, Jiang Ming could project his power over to his target after pinpointing his target’s location. He was shocked and delighted by this function.
Jiang Ming thought to himself with bright eyes, ‘This means I’ll be able to send my clones over. Why do I feel like the Human Path Records is much better than the system?’
Name: Mu Shuiyun
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: Elder of the Qingyun Sect
Relationship: -90
Innate Talent: Nine stars (Water Spirit Body)
Status: She was on her way to Hai Province to order Bishui Sect to attack Jiuyang Sect. When she was 10,000 miles away from her destination, she sensed a familiar aura that seemed to agitate her. She hurriedly switched directions, following the familiar aura. When she arrived, she saw a mansion near a beach. At that time, there was a banquet in the mansion. When she forced her way in, she saw Bai Lang, the white-scaled dragon, whom she had met in the past after being captured. She attacked Bai Lang in a frenzy, but when she realized she could not win, she cried. As it turns out, Bai Lang is Mu Lei’s nephew; Mu Lei’s father is his grandfather. Then, she pleaded with Bai Lang to seek revenge for his junior uncle, Mu Lei. Later on, she discovered two of the guests are the Chief Overseer of the Bishui Sect and the Clan Leader of the Jiang clan respectively. Currently, she’s plotting with them to annihilate Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming frowned when he read Mu Shuiyun’s status. He speculated that the Bishui Sect had allied with the sea clan. The sect had moved here with the intention to conquer the Eastern Region. He wrote the words ‘Clan Leader of the Jiang clan’ on the Human Path Records, but nothing showed up as expected. It was not a name, after all; it was just a title.
Apart from that, Jiang Ming had a headache when he thought about Mu Shuiyun’s complex relationships. Initially, he had thought Bai Lang was Mu Lei’s father. Who knew Mu Lei was Bai Lang’s junior uncle instead? Mu Lei’s father was Bai Lang’s grandfather. After thinking about it, he thought it made sense. After all, Bai Lang’s grandfather was really strong. It was the reason the Qingyun Sect did not dare to retaliate even after he captured and violated Mu Shuiyun.
Jiang Ming shook his head as he muttered, “What a complicated relationship!”
Following that, he activated the Locate function with just a thought. In just a moment, he saw two figures that represented him and Mu Shuiyun respectively. A line connected the two figures, and the words ‘32,000 kilometers’ could be seen in the middle of the line.
Jiang Ming would have to travel southeast to get to Mu Shuiyun. Although he could easily find anyone with the Locate function, he was slightly dissatisfied. He mumbled to himself, “It’d be better if it’s more detailed and shows the route’s geography as well…”
Using the Human Path Records as a medium, his consciousness traveled through the void and arrived at the place where Mu Shuiyun was. He could clearly sense her and the spatial node within 100 miles radius. He could project anywhere within the area.
“The Human Path Records is really amazing! With these, I can be the best assassin in the world!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
A naughty thought popped up in his mind at this moment. With these abilities, he would be able to go to Jiaoyong Peak’s pool without being discovered. At that time, he would be able to peek…
Jiang Ming hurriedly shook his head to dismiss the thought. It was inevitable to have bad thoughts. The important thing was to have self-control and to be able to distinguish right from wrong.
Following that, Jiang Ming looked at Bai Lang’s information.
Name: Bai Lang
Race: Scaled dragon.
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: Cave Master of the White Scaled Dragon Cave; one of the 36 demon kings in the Red Mountain Palace.
Relationship: 0
Innate talent: 9 stars
Status: After learning about the devil sects’ resurgence, he decided to investigate Bishui Sect by sending his son there. However, he was seized with rage when he learned of his son’s death. For this reason, he came to the mansion near the beach. He invited the Chief Overseer of Bishui Sect and the Clan Leader of the Jiang clan over to find out what had happened and to also plan their next step. During the banquet, he sensed the aura of an expert. The expert, who turned out to be Mu Shuiyun, attacked immediately. After he subdued Mu Shuiyun, he learned about his junior uncle’s death. The truth is that he doesn’t care for his junior uncle, but he decided to foster a good relationship with Mu Shuiyun due to her position in Qingyun Sect.
Jiang Ming was speechless when he read Bai Lang’s status. As it turned out, Bai Haitian was Bai Lang’s son! Bai Haitian’s father was a demon king in the Palace and his great-grandfather was the expert who captured Mu Shuiyun in the past, resulting in the birth of Mu Lei.
While Jiang Ming was on the move, he thought to himself, ‘Bishui Sect, the White Scaled Dragon Cave, the Red Mountain Palace, the Jiang clan, Mu Shuiyun… There’s also the Sima clan that Bishui Sect has contact with… All of them are all knowingly or unknowingly linked…’
Jiang Ming usually remained indifferent toward the chaos in the world. However, the current mess would, unfortunately, affect him so he knew he had to cut the source of the problems at their roots tonight.
In just a moment, Jiang Ming crossed hundreds and thousands of miles as he traveled to his destination.

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - Astonishing Secret; the Submerged Dragon Continent; Killing the Holy Daughter First
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Astonishing Secret; the Submerged Dragon Continent; Killing the Holy Daughter First
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The moon illuminated the sky, vaguely revealing a valley that was surrounded by mountains. A stream that sparkled with a silvery-white light from the moonlight snaked through the valley. A cool breeze blew in the air, bringing the smell of the ocean with it. The sound of waves hitting the shore rang softly in the air as well.
Sea creatures such as mussel women were seen carrying plates of food while the mermaids sang in their melodious voices and danced with charming movements.
Jiang Ming hid in the void about 100 miles away as he observed the manor in the distance. He speculated inwardly, ‘Mu Shuiyun and Bai Lang are both in the Primal Spirit Realm, I think the Chief Overseer of Bishui Sect is in the same realm as well. However, the Clan Leader of the Jiang clan should be a realm lower in the Nascent Soul Realm.’
He lamented that he did not know their names. Otherwise, he would have their information as soon as he wrote their names in the Human Path Records.
He knew he could not kill these people rashly. He had to think of a foolproof way to kill them. While he was lost in his thoughts, he used the Human Path Records to conjure up clones of himself. Since they were formed from vitality energy, they would not last long. Nevertheless, they were good enough to be used as tools.
Jiang Ming equipped all the clones with a top-grade spirit crystal, which he had obtained from killing Bai Yu and the others. Then, with Mu Shuiyun in the center, he sent his clones to the four cardinal directions and eight secondary intercardinal directions around her. Not only that, but he also sent his clones to the 72 star positions and the points of the 36 ley lines around her. The clones were all within 100 miles of Mu Shuiyun. After the clones arrived at their respective positions, they tossed their respective top-grade spirit crystals out in a specific direction.
With this, Jiang Ming completed the Ten Directions Heavenly Transformation Formation. The formation’s range covered the manor and the area within a radius of 100 miles. Then, he activated the Formation with his mana, turning the area in the Formation into a forbidden area and isolating it from the world.
This Formation was not very powerful, and it was mainly used to isolate and imprison. It suited Jiang Ming’s purpose very well at this moment.
As soon as the Formation was activated, the people in the manor became aware of it immediately.
Bai Lang roared, “Who is it? How dare you make a move against me?”
Bai Lang rushed into the sky as huge waves surged above him. The waves looked terrifying and endless.
At the same time, Mu Shuiyun, the Chief Overseer of the Bishui Sect, and the Clan Leader of the Jiang clan rose into the air as well. They brought out their Artifacts and activated their defensive special abilities to ensure their safety.
When they rose in the air, they saw a huge chessboard hovering in the sky. Lines crisscrossed above it, looking like connected stars. In the next moment, a huge pulling force surged out from the chessboard.
Bai Lang was shocked and frightened by the abrupt appearance of the pulling force. He unleashed his power, trying to resist, but it was futile. In just a short moment, he was pulled into the chessboard.
Following that, the other old men were pulled into the chessboard as well.
Mu Shuiyun, who was watching this, was terrified. She did not know what kind of Dao Vessel the chessboard was. The energy she used to resist the pulling force only managed to help for a few moments before she was pulled into the chessboard like the others.
Following that, all living things in the manor were pulled into the chessboard as well.
At this moment, Jiang Ming appeared in midair. His hand held the Golden Obsidian, which was suitable for a fight using only physical strength. Then, he allowed himself to be pulled into the chessboard as well.
…
Inside the chessboard.
The area was divided into a black region and white region. One represented the game master, and the other represented the opponents.
Mu Shuiyun and the other three men’s expressions were grim. They stood in front of the slaves and servants of the manor who were mostly from the sea clans.
Upon seeing Jiang Ming, Mu Shuiyun asked in confusion, “Who are you? Where are we?”
She had been shocked to discover she could not mobilize her mana and her Primal Spirit energy in this place. Moreover, her cultivation base had also been suppressed.
Bai Lang said, “This must be a Dao Vessel with an independent realm.”
As Bai Lang spoke, his head transformed into that of a white-scaled dragon’s head. It somewhat resembled a turtle. At the same time, claws grew from his fingers as a long tail grew out of his back. This form was the battle form of a white-scaled dragon.
When the transformation was complete, Bai Lang asked, “Who are you? Why are you targeting us?”
Jiang Ming replied, “I’m from the Qingyun Sect. No one knows about me since I’ve been cultivating in seclusion in the sect’s forbidden area. Mu Shuiyun, I can be considered your junior granduncle.”
Being a cautious person, Jiang Ming naturally did not reveal his true identity.
Jiang Ming smiled and continued to say, “I know you’re colluding with one of the sea clans. Your son has the blood of a scaled dragon so you must be partial toward the sea clans. The sea clans are restless and have been coming to the shores of the Eastern Region. They must be up to no good. I thought that by killing Mu Lei, you’d be able to sever your ties with the sea clans and come to your senses. However, it seems like I was wrong. You actually came to meet Bai Lang. It’s just as well. I’ll kill all of you tonight!”
He had heard someone calling out to the Clan Leader of the Jiang clan and the Chief Overseer of the Bishui Sect earlier. Hence, he called up the Human Path Records inwardly and mentally wrote their names on it.
Name: Jiang Feng
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Nascent Soul Realm
Background: Clan Leader of the Jiang clan.
Relationship: -99
Innate talent: Eight stars
Status: The clan was on the wane so he was struggling to revive it. Alas, the members were not powerful enough so the clan was suppressed by the Feiyun Sect and Tianshui Sect. The clan’s chances of survival grew slimmer and slimmer with time. However, a few years ago, the elders of Bishui Sect persuaded him to ally himself with them. The Bishui Sect promised him cultivation resources and half of the Hai Province as long as he promised to assist them in annihilating the Feiyun Sect and Tianshui Sect. Despite learning of the sea clans and Bishui Sect’s intention to invade and conquer the Eastern Region, due to the promised rewards, he agreed to the Bishui Sect’s request. He was asked by the Chief Overseer of Bishui Sect to meet the Cave Master of the White Scaled Dragon Cave to discuss ways to annihilate the Tianshui Sect without provoking the Qingyun Sect. During the meeting, Bai Lang had requested them to look for his son’s murderer. Halfway through the meeting, Mu Shuiyun suddenly showed up. He was overjoyed when he discovered the relationship between Bai Lang and the former Holy Daughter of the Qingyun Sect.
After reading Jiang Fei’s information, Jiang Ming thought to himself, ‘As expected. Bishui Sect is colluding with the sea clans to invade and conquer the Eastern Region. With the resurgence of the devil sects, the conflicts with the Zhong Province’s Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, and the sea clans and Bishui Sect’s plot, the Eastern Region is in a mess…’
Jiang Ming shuddered when he thought about what the future held for the Eastern Region. He did not care about the relationship value at -99. After all, he was planning to kill Jiang Fei after this.
Swoosh!
He flipped to the next page of the Human Path Records.
Name: Hai Yan
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: Grand Elder of Bishui Sect
Relationship: -86
Innate talent: Nine Stars
Status: The Bishui Sect was located in the outer regions of the Submerged Dragon Continent. The sect was crowded out and struggled to survive. Through a series of coincidences, the sect secretly joined the Red Mountain Palace. Under the order of the Red Mountain Palace, the sect sent disciples to the Eastern Region to lay down their foundation and to investigate the situation of the forces in the Eastern Region. After leading his team here, he reached out to the Jiang clan, which had submitted to him years ago, and ordered them to annihilate the Feiyun Sect and bribed the Qingyun Sect. He plans to annihilate the Tianshui Sect next on his quest to conquer the Eastern Region. He had been delighted when he heard about the resurgence of the devil sects, and the attack the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion launched on the Qingyun Sect. During his meeting with Bai Lang today, they discussed reaching out to the experts from the devil sects. They plan to work together with the devil sects and divide the Eastern Region. With that, Bishui Sect will be able to expand and conquer Qing Province. When he first saw Mu Shuiyun from the Qingyun Sect earlier, he panicked and was about to strike. However, when he learned about her relationship with Bai Lang, he was delighted. With the former Holy Daughter of the Qingyun Sect on their side, it would be easier to carry out their plan.
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat when he saw the information of the Chief Overseer, no, the Grand Elder of Bishui Sect. As it turned out, the main culprit, the one pulling the strings, was the Red Mountain Palace.
The Bishui Sect was unaware that Bai Lang had long sent his son to secretly investigate and contact the Yinmo Sect. It was likely that the devil sects and the Red Mountain Palace were already working together.
When Jiang Ming thought about the Yinmo Sect, Red Mountain Palace ,and the Submerged Dragon Continent’s plot, he gritted his teeth as killing intent surged from his body.
It took only a few seconds for Jiang Ming to read through the information. Outwardly, he had just finished speaking.
Upon hearing Jiang Ming’s words, Mu Shuiyun asked with bloodshot eyes, “You’re the one who killed my son?”
She disregarded the matter of Jiang Ming coming from the Qingyun Sect. She looked at him with eyes filled with rage as the desire to avenge her son rose in her heart. In the next moment, she lunged toward him as she cried out, “Go to hell, you bast*rd!”
Although she could not mobilize her mana, her physique was strong. When she punched out, the wind whistled in the wake of her fist.
Although Mu Shuiyun was fast and strong, Jiang Ming was faster and stronger.. He brought down the Golden Obsidian, cleaving her into two.

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - A Plan to Take Down the Enemies; He’s Coming
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: A Plan to Take Down the Enemies; He’s Coming
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The moon shone brightly in the sky as the roars of the wild beasts rang from the distance.
Two young experts, a black-clad man and a white-clad man, hovered above the peak of a mountain.
The black-clad clasped his hands on his back as a cloud of dark mist hung at his back. The dark mist roiled and writhed as though there was something within it. It was a rather eerie and strange sight.
The white-clad man had silver hair that fluttered in the night breeze. He was very handsome, but his eyes shone with the vicissitudes of life that belied his appearance.
The two men were chatting with each other at this moment.
“Are you done with the preparations?”
“No. Our initial plan was to wait for another 100 years before we confront the Qingyun Sect. Now that part of our plan is exposed, our plan has to be pushed forward. This is why I asked to meet you. Brother Bai, we agreed back then you’ll join us immediately after we made a move. Can you fulfill your promise now?”
“Not only did you fail to complete the preparations, but you’ve also gotten ahead of yourself.?I’ve only just laid the foundation so it’s not the right time to join you yet…”
“No, now’s the right time! Due to the conflicts between the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and Qingyun Sect, people from the Zhong Province are rushing over. The Eastern Region will be in turmoil. Our best chance to act is when the Eastern Region is in chaos!”
“The conflict between the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and the Qingyun Sect isn’t big enough to shake their foundations. They’re just fighting to uphold their pride. Moreover, your Yinmo Sect is just one of the six devil sects so it’s not very strong on its own. Once your sect acts in the open, the Qingyun Sect will surely come after you with all their might. At that time, even the Infinite Alchemy Sect will unite with them to take you down!”
“The Infinite Alchemy Sect doesn’t have the guts to do something like that!”
“What makes you say so?”
“We’ve been gathering our strength. The other five sects will also slowly begin to come out of hiding. Moreover, the Million Demon Mountain in the Southern Region has had enough of?being suppressed by humans so they’re raring to strike back!”
“You’re right. With the sea clan, we’re more than strong enough to fight them.”
“Not only that, but we can crush all human forces. The land of Shenzhou is vast. When your clan occupies it, the strength of your clan will increase tremendously.”
“You’re too naive. How many million years have humans dominated the world? The strength of their foundation is beyond our imaginations. It’s not so easy to crush all of them. Moreover, do you think humans can’t wipe out your devil sects?”
“I can’t say for sure if they can wipe out the devil sects. However, I’m sure that now is our chance to act! Brother Bai, we will come out of hiding in 10 years. Will you join us then?”
“We’re still making preparations. If you want me to join you openly, your devil sects should have come out of hiding by now. At least, that would give me more confidence,” the white-clad man said. At this moment, he felt a burning sensation on his finger. When he lifted his hand, he saw the thread of green silk twined around his left ring finger was burning. In just a blink of an eye, it was reduced to ashes. He was clearly stunned by this sight. He frowned as he muttered under his breath, “He’s dead?”
As though he had the sixth sense, the white-clad man turned to look into the distance. Then, he said to the black-clad young man, “Don’t look for me again if you’re not sincere. If you’re sincere, just act according to the plan that we’ve agreed upon.”
Following that, the white-clad man flew away like a streak of light.
Upon seeing this, the black-clad man frowned and scoffed coldly. “Why are you in such a hurry? Those from the sea clans are as cowardly as a mouse. When things are optimistic, you don’t hesitate to go all out. Very well. I’ll let you see hope and go all out. When you step foot onto the land of Shenzou, and we stabilize our power here, I’ll make a seafood buffet out of you and your kind.”
Following that, the black-clad man vanished into the darkness.
…
Inside the chessboard.
After Jiang Ming cleaved Mui Shuiyun into two, her Primal Spirit appeared before it disintegrated into a wisp of smoke. He was slightly surprised when he saw that. However, he gained a further understanding of death in the Mana Sealing Chessboard. Once a person’s physical body was damaged to a certain extent in here, they would die.
To be safe, he called up the Human Path Records to check on Mu Shuiyun’s status to confirm she was truly dead.
Meanwhile, Bai Lang, Jiang Feng, and Hai Yan were shocked by Mu Shuiyun’s quick death.
Hai Yan quickly regained his composure and roared, “Attack!”
As an experienced Primal Spirit expert, how could he not figure out that Jiang Ming intended to kill all of them after trapping them here? He had also figured out the only way for them to leave this place was to kill Jiang Ming. He also shared his discovery with Bai Lang and Jiang Feng. He explained, “We can’t mobilize our mana, but we can use our vitality energy and blood to access the weapons in our spatial ring.”
After Hai Yan finished speaking, he brought out a large knife.
