Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes as he looked at Hai Yan. ‘As expected as the man leading the members of Bishui Sect to conquer Hai Province. He’s rather smart.’
The trio moved swiftly even though they could not mobilize their mana. Alas, there was still a huge gap between their strengths and Jiang Ming’s.
Jiang Ming charged out. His sword collided with Hai Yan’s knife before breaking it. Then, it fell on a downward trajectory on Hai Yan and slashed through Hai Yan’s body.
Just like that, Hai Yan died tragically.
At this time, Bai Lang’s Wolf Fang Mace and Jiang Feng’s long sword struck at Jiang Ming at the same time. Jiang Ming did not bother to dodge despite being more than capable of doing so. He merely glanced at his shoulder before he laughed contemptuously. “Too weak!”
Bai Lang was stunned. When he regained his senses, he shuddered in fear. “I… I… I’m a scaled dragon! In this world, my bloodline is only second to the dragon, and my body is incredibly powerful. Just my body alone is stronger than Nascent Soul experts! How’s it possible that you’re not affected at all by my strike? Impossible! Impossible!”
On the other hand, Jiang Fei fell to his knees immediately. “Senior, I surrender. I promise that the Jiang clan and I will follow you and do your bidding. Needless to say, our clan’s resources are all yours as well. Please just spare my life!”
Bai Lang roared, “Keep dreaming! He killed Mu Shuiyun without even batting an eyelid! Do you really think he’ll spare your life? Attack!
him. He did not dodge even though he was capable. He merely took a glance on his shoulders because he felt nothing at all.
Jiang Ming laughed, “Too weak!”?When laughing he showed two rows of white teeth, but it actually looked ferocious.
Bai Lang was stunned for a moment, and shivered with terror, “I, I, I! I’m a scaled dragon, a scaled dragon! In this world, my bloodline is merely second to the dragon and my body is incredibly powerful! Merely based on my body, I am stronger than the experts of Nascent Soul! But how, how is it that you didn’t even move with one blow of the bat? It doesn’t make sense, it doesn’t make sense at all!”
Meanwhile, Jiang Feng knelt down straight away, “Senior, I submit. I can lead the entire Jiang clan to submit, be your slave and servant. I am also willing to give all the resources of my clan. Please just spare my life!”
Bai Lang roared, “Rubbish! He killed Mu Shuiyun without any hesitation, do you think he’ll let you go? Attack! Scaled Dragon Blood Explosion!”
A mist of blood rose from Bai Lang’s body, which returned to his body after a moment. During this time, his aura soared. As though he had gone berserk, he swung his Wolf Fang Mace in a frenzy. His speed was rather fast, leaving afterimages in his wake.
Alas, Jiang Ming was still faster. He parried the Wolf Fang Mace before he kicked Bai Lang with so much force that Bai Mang exploded into a bloody mist.
‘I feel as though I’ve been given a cheat,’ Jiang Ming thought to himself. Bai Lang was not weak at all, but Jiang Ming was just insanely strong.
In the cultivation world, physical fights were very basic. Apart from some rare instances that involved bloodline special abilities, physical fights were dependent on only speed, reaction, and strength.
Jiang Fei’s face was ashen. Beads of cold sweat broke out on his forehead and he kowtowed continuously and pleaded, “Senior, please spare my life! Please spare my life!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless by Bai Lang’s action. “You’re in the Nascent Soul Realm, but you’re so afraid of death?”
Jiang Feng smiled bitterly. “Senior, I’m not afraid of death. However, I shoulder the lives of my clansmen. If I fall, their lives would be miserable. I can’t die for the sake of my clan!”
Jiang Ming shook his head, feeling slightly regretful. Nevertheless, his expression remained indifferent as he said, “I would let you work for me, but unfortunately, to leave this place, one of us will have to die.”
Contrary to his words, Jiang Ming would not have accepted Jiang Fei even if he could leave the chessboard without killing anyone. After all, Jiang Fei was even capable of abandoning his teammates as soon as his life was threatened.
As soon as Jiang Ming’s voice fell, a maniacal grin appeared on Jiang Fei’s face as he suddenly leaped toward Jiang Ming, brandishing his sword that was pointed at Jiang Ming’s eye.
Jiang Ming did not evade the attack. He lifted his leg and kicked Jiang Feng.
Jiang Feng suffered a similar fate as Bai Lang, exploding into a mist of blood.
Then, Jiang Ming looked at Bai Lang’s servants in the distance. As he moved, he left afterimages in his wake. In just one breath, all 50-60 members of the sea clan died.
After gathering the spoils of the battle and reducing the corpses to ashes, he left the Mana Sealing Chessboard.
Then, after he put the chessboard away, black mist surged out of his body, transforming into a demonic fire that cleansed his aura. Then, he directed the fire toward the manor. He was not going to leave any traces behind.
At this time, the Formation suddenly shattered.
A white-clad young man with silver hair flew over. He glanced at Jiang Ming before he raised his hand.
Flowing that, two wisps of energy flew out from the burning manor.
The white-clad young man’s eyes flashed coldly as he said, “These belong to Mu Shuiyun and Bai Lang. You’re the one who killed the woman I love and my grandson!”
Jiang Ming shrugged. “You missed another two people. I killed your son, Mu Lei, and your other grandson, Bai Haitian, as well.”
When he saw the white-clad man’s information on the Human Path Records, he was slightly nervous. However, an idea soon appeared in his mind. He said provocatively, “Isn’t that surprising? Let me tell you something even more surprising! Mu Shui Yun, the woman you love, was having an affair with Bai Lang, your grandson! Isn’t that exciting?”
As Jiang Ming spoke, he began to attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - The Resonance Curse and the Source of Uneasiness
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: The Resonance Curse and the Source of Uneasiness
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Bai Zizai
Race: Scaled dragon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Paradis realm
Background: One of the four commanders of Red Mountain Palace
Relationship: -92
Innate Talent: Ten stars (Pure scaled dragon bloodline)
Status: He was called out by an expert from the Yinmo Sect to discuss the invasion of the Eastern Region when he sensed Mu Shuiyun’s death through the green silk thread around his finger. The green silk thread was the product of the Resonance Curse he had cast on her. When he arrived, he couldn’t find anything. However, when he used his energy to sweep the surroundings, he accidentally shattered the Formation.
Jiang Ming knew he was in trouble when he saw Bai Zizai’s information on the Human Paths Record. He had no trouble facing Primal Spirit cultivators, but that was not the case for Paradis experts.
Cultivators who had entered the Paradis Realm were also known as Great Monarchs. This was the case everywhere in the world.
When Jiang Ming initially sensed Bai Zizai’s presence, he had wrongly assumed he would be able to deal with Bai Zizai. Although he had come with an idea in his mind, he still could not help the fear that rose in his heart.
While Jiang Ming tried to provoke Bai Zizai with his words, he brought the Mana Sealing Chessboard again and activated it.
Buzz!
The chessboard vibrated before a powerful pulling force swept toward Bai Zizai, pulling him into the chessboard.
“What a powerful force! What kind of Dao Vessel is that?” Bai Zizai exclaimed in shock as divine light burst forth from his body. A vortex formed around him, counteracting the chessboard’s pulling force.
“He managed to resist it?!” Jiang Ming was shocked. He hastily mobilized his mana and channeled it into the Mana Sealing Chessboard.
“Who are you?” Bai Zizai asked, shocked. Despite being able to withstand it for the moment, he felt as though the force was able to devour him whole. He could clearly sense a great threat from the chessboard and was shocked by it. With his current cultivation base, barring those powerful beings living in seclusion, he could easily defeat most people in this world. He did not expect he would run into someone who made him feel so highly threatened today.
In all honesty, Bai Zizai was not really bothered about the deaths of his illegitimate son, grandsons, and even Mu Shuiyun whom he had been infatuated with for a long time. Moreover, he was not lacking women. With just a wave of his hand, countless women would flock to him. If he wanted children, he only needed to expend a little more effort.
When Bai Zizai sensed the pulling force had intensified and that he was about to be sucked in, he hurriedly summoned his battle armor on himself. The battle armor shone with a silver light and emitted a formidable aura.
The armor glowed with intensifying brightness, neutralizing some of the pulling force.
At this time, two dragon horns appeared on Bai Zizai’s head. This was a sign that he was about to revert to his dragon form. With this, his aura soared terrifyingly.
Shortly afterward, a sword that also shone with a silver light appeared in Bai Zizai’s hand. The sword looked so intimidating that Jiang Ming felt as though he had already been cleaved into two by the sword even though the sword had not even moved yet.
A strange phenomenon appeared above Bai Zizai’s head at this moment. It looked as though the ocean, which was flashing with lightning bolts, had appeared above his head. The lightning bolts looked like thunder dragons leaping out of the surface of the sea. At this moment, it looked as though the ocean had drowned the sky.
With a combination of his abilities, Bai Zizai finally managed to completely neutralize the pulling force from the Mana Sealing Chessboard.
Jiang Ming was stunned. ‘D*mn it! I thought I wouldn’t run into any problems considering my strength and a top-grade Dao Vessel. I didn’t expect to run into a monster like him!’
A hint of despair rose in Jiang Ming’s heart when he realized the precarious situation he was in. He thought that Bai Zizai must be the source of uneasiness he had felt when he had first left Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming had been very cautious when he acted this time. Before trapping Mi Shuiyun and the others in the Mana Sealing Chessboard, he had even cast a Formation to isolate the area from the world. It was out of his expectation that Bai Zizai had cast the Resonance Curse on Mu Shuiyun or that Bai Zizai would rush here as soon as he sensed Mu Shuiyun’s death.
‘Today is definitely not my day!’
Countless thoughts raced through Jiang Ming’s mind as he hastily put the Mana Sealing Chessboard away and vanished into thin air.
“Where did he go?” Bai Zizai muttered to himself, “Although he’s strong, I can sense he’s still in one of the lower realms. He definitely didn’t tear the void open. This means… he has comprehended the technique to control space! I have to kill him today! Otherwise, he’ll become a threat to us in the future!”
Bai Zizai knew how formidable spatial control ability was. He closed his eyes and extended his consciousness. In just a blink of an eye, he saw Jiang Ming who had appeared 3,000 miles away.
“He didn’t leave any fluctuations when he moved. Did he teleport?” Bai Zizai inhaled deeply before he shot toward Jiang Ming like a streak of light.
As soon as Jiang Ming reappeared 3,000 miles away, he felt Bai Zizai charging toward him at top speed.
“Seriously?!” Jiang Ming exclaimed. When he looked up, he saw an energy sword tearing through the sky. The silver light it emitted was so bright that it illuminated the entire night sky.
“D*mn it!” Jiang Ming cursed. He knew he would die if he was unable to dodge the attack.
“I need to run!” Jiang Ming hurriedly teleported away again.
As soon as stepped on the spatial node, he saw a ripple in the void before he was expelled from the void by a powerful force. In the end, he only managed to teleport 300 miles away.
“The power to distort space!” Jiang Ming cried out.
At the same time, the energy sword landed on a mountain behind him, splitting the peak into two and reducing the rubble into dust.
In just a moment, Jiang Ming felt Bai Zizai coming at him again.
“D*mn it! Why can’t I shake him off?” Jiang Ming cursed in an anxiety-laden voice. He had assumed that even if he were no match for Bai Zizai, he would have no problem fleeing from Bai Zizai. After all, he had once blocked an attack from a Paradis expert. At this moment, he finally realized how naive he was.
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record appeared in his mind. Then, just as Bai Zizai was about to attack again, he cried out, “Akasa projection!”
Jiang Ming used one-tenth of his power to form a powerful decoy. With the help of the Human Paths Record, he sent the clone near Bai Zizai.
The clone used the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal and Wood Dragon to attack Bai Zizai.
Bai Zizai froze for a moment but swiftly regained his senses. He brandished his sword, destroying both the divine seal and the clone. At this time, the forest that had shot out from the ground launched their attacks against him. He summoned a lightning bolt, destroying the forest that spanned several dozen miles in just a blink of an eye. Then, when he tried to track Jiang Ming again, he discovered he had lost Jiang Ming.
“You think you can run?” Bai Zizai scoffed. Then, he closed his eyes and extended a stand of his consciousness into the void before he began to search for Jiang Ming.
“Although you did a good job concealing your presence and didn’t leave any traces behind, I’m sure you’re still around…” Bai Zizai murmured to himself. After a moment, his eyes snapped open as he said, “Found you!”
With that, Bai Zizai shot toward the northwestern direction at top speed.
At the same time, Jiang Ming was teleporting away with all his might after sending his clone out as a decoy. After teleporting about 6,000 miles away, his face turned pale when he sensed that Bai Zizai had destroyed his clone. Since the clone was formed from his power, its destruction would naturally affect him as well.
“He shouldn’t be able to find me now, right?” Jiang Ming had concealed himself with the system’s help. He was just about to sigh in relief when he felt Bai Zizai’s consciousness locking onto him again.
“So fast?!”?Jiang Ming’s expression changed drastically. He hurriedly flicked his fingers before nine top-grade spirit crystals appeared, forming a simple Formation around him. His body began to increase in size until he was 3.33 meters in height.
This was the first stage of the Three-fold Astral Transformation that could boost his physical strength. Then, he teleported again. When he reappeared, he had already teleported 10,000 miles away. He did not stop and kept teleporting again and again.. He only stopped when he arrived at a place that once belonged to the Feiyun Sect but had been seized by the Bishui Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - Massacre and Blame-Shifting; Gu Hai’s Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Massacre and Blame-Shifting; Gu Hai’s Breakthrough
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming’s clone stood outside of the Bishui Sect while he hid his presence and observed from a distance.
A moment later, the terrifying aura of Paradis cultivator locked appeared again.
“Bai Zizai, why won’t you leave me alone?” the clone shouted, “I’ll dismember you one day and feast on dragon meat!”
Swoosh!
An energy sword appeared out of thin air, tearing across the night sky with a destructive might. Its length was a few hundred miles long, and as soon as it appeared, an immense pressure descended on the area, causing the air to freeze.
“Bai Zizai, do you know that when I found Mu Shuiyun, she was trying to conceive a child with Bai Lang? You should thank me instead. How can you be so ruthless?”
After saying this, the clone leaped and vanished into the void.
At the same time, Jiang Ming seized the chance and undid the clone, returning the energy to his body.
“Die!” Bai Zizai roared.
The force of the energy sword surged and shrouded the area where Jiang Ming was standing.
The Formation that covered the back of Bishui Sect had collapsed. When the energy sword landed, some of the people there exploded into mists of blood and flesh immediately. They did not even have a chance to cry for help before they died.
It did not take long before the Bishui Sect’s estate was completely destroyed.
When the energy sword and its light vanished and receded, one could see the entire place had been reduced to rubble and debris.
When Bai Zizai finally arrived, his expression was unsightly, and his eyes seemed capable of shooting fire when he looked at the scene of destruction. He said furiously, “No matter who you are or where you go, I’ll find you and kill you!”
Bai Zizai had always been cool-headed, but at this moment, he had completely lost his composure. His mind was filled with scenes of Mu Shuiyun and Bai Lang’s bodies intimately intertwined. These scenes fanned the flames of fury in his heart to great heights.
Bai Zizai inhaled deeply before he narrowed his eyes and looked at the survivors in front of him. Then, he said, “It’s because of this branch of Bishui Sect that my enemy slipped away from me! All of you will have to pay with your deaths!”
As soon as his voice fell, Bai Zizai lifted his hand, absorbing the saber Sambodha, before he pointed his finger down. He summoned lightning bolt after lightning bolt down on the ruins of Bishui Sect, killing everyone. Even the chasm caused by his energy sword was quickly filled up with rubble.
…
Back in Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming silently returned to his room after he arrived at Chuyang Peak. He sat in a lotus position as he panted. His chest heaved up and down as he gulped for air. He knew he had been extremely lucky tonight. Luckily, he had mastered space control and the Great Akasa Steps, which helped him to escape from Bai Zizai. Otherwise, he would have died.
Swoosh!
He called up the Human Paths Record to at Bai Zizai’s information again. His eyes quickly moved down to Bai Zizai’s status.
Status: Destroyed the Bishui Sect with just a strike. He vented his anger by destroying a branch of the Bishui Sect. He had intentionally used lightning bolts so it would look like Qingyun Sect had killed everyone with the Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning. At this time, he’s thinking about how he can tempt the head of the Bishui Sect to continue serving the Red Mountain Palace.
‘After I provoked him, he’s still able to maintain his cool and shift the blame to the Qingyun Sect? What a terrifying monster!’ Jiang Ming thought to himself.
Considering how often he ran into powerful enemies, he decided to stay put in the sect unless his junior sister was in danger.
Following that, he brought a spirit crystal out, closed his eyes, and began healing himself.
As for the cultivation that he had been storing the whole time, he decided not to use it yet.
It was calm and peaceful on the mountain, but the world outside had been thrown into chaos.
…
The Jiang clan in the Hai Province.
The Jiang Clan was one of the main forces in Hai Province.
In the forbidden area of the Jiang Clan, there was a pavilion that housed the soul tokens of their core disciples.
When the soul token of Jiang Fei, the clan leader, shattered, which was on the top row, shattered, it startled the old guard. When he regained his senses, he rubbed his eyes before he took another look. His face paled and he trembled when he realized his eyes were not playing tricks on him.
With that, chaos descended on the Jiang clan.
…
In the middle of the ocean.
A fight had erupted in the White Scaled Dragon Cave. A few of Bai Lang’s wives were fighting each other for the treasures that he left behind.
…
In the main branch of the Bishui Sect.
When the bell tolled 81 times, the Sect Master and all the elders gathered. All of them wore grim expressions on their faces.
Their grand elder, Hai Yan, who went to the Eastern Region had died. Even the group of disciples there had died. Hai Yan was a Primal Spirit Realm cultivator while the branch sect there was protected by a Formation. With that, they were certain the culprit responsible for the murder of Hai Yang and the massacre in the branch sect was a Paradis expert.
In the Eastern Region, Qingyun Sect had the highest number of Paradis experts.
…
In the Qingyun Sect.
As soon as the Holy Lord of Qingyun Sect learned that Mu Shuiyun’s soul token had shattered, he had no doubts that the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was responsible for her death.
“Was it those two monsters from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?”
The Holy Lord of Qingyun Sect was at a loss over what to do. Due to the tension recently, it was not wise to directly confront the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion about this matter. He was sure if he mentioned them killing their former Holy Daughter, Old Tie would smash his hammer at him immediately.
…
In just a night, many things had changed.
…
The next day.
Jiang Ming stopped cultivating and started on his daily routine.
He had breakfast on the rooftop with his junior sister as they admired the sunrise.
All of a sudden, a powerful aura erupted from the main building on Chuyang Peak. Following that, the spiritual energy in the universe began to converge.
“Master has recovered! He’s breaking through now!” Linglong cried out excitedly as her eyes lit up. Then, she said, “Master has very high innate talent. The only reason he didn’t progress was due to his injuries. Now that he has recovered, with his rich experience, he’s bound to progress rapidly and break through to higher realms!”
“I’m sure he’s overjoyed!” Jiang Ming nodded with a smile.
“That’s right.” Linglong nodded. Then, after a moment, she added, “I noticed the spiritual essence on the mountain had gotten richer recently. It’s quite strange…”
“I’ve been studying Formations so after I made some progress, I set up a few Formations like the spirit Formations and the Ley Line Dragon Formation,” Jiang Ming explained.
“When did you become so skilled in Formations, Senior Brother? I wasn’t aware of this at all!” Linglong was surprised. After surveying the surroundings again, she discovered that there were indeed traces of Formations.
There were spirit Formation, illusory Formation, Formations that trapped trespassers, and defensive Formations. Although the levels of the Formations were not high, they were all linked and very organized.
“Senior Brother, you’re amazing!”
“Of course! My junior sister is a prodigy so as your senior brother, it goes without saying that I have to be more amazing than you, right?”
“That’s right!”
While the duo was chatting, an orb of light that resembled the sun suddenly rose to the sky above the main building.
“Master is really talented! He has comprehended the fire Sambodha and is now forming the Dao Seed to break through to the next realm!” Linglong exclaimed.
As soon as her voice fell, the sun-like orb descended as Gu Hai’s aura soared tremendously.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming silently called up the Human Paths Record.
Name: Gu Hai
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: First Seat of Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 85
Innate Talent: Eight stars
Status: He has healed his Purple Mansion, comprehended the fire Sambodha, and formed a fire Dao Seed.. With these, he has successfully broken through to the Dao Seed Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - Ding! Activation of the Training Zone; I’m So Awesome
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Ding! Activation of the Training Zone; I’m So Awesome
Soon, Gu Hai returned. He landed on the roof with his chin held high and chest puffed. He then swaggered toward his two disciples in a measured gait with the toes pointing outward.
He looked very pleased and proud of himself.
“Quack! Quack! Quack!” Jiang Ming quacked like a duck, causing Linglong to cover her mouth and giggle like a little girl.
Gu Hai staggered as he asked angrily, “What do you mean by that?”
“I just saw a duck!” Jiang Ming replied in a serious manner, “Did you see it, Master?”
“How dare you!” Gu Hai harrumphed. “You must be asking for a beating!”
He lifted his hand and hit the air with his palm, causing the wind to surge and the clouds to gather. He then raised his eyebrows, stroked his beard, and sat down. “In the past, although I was a First Seat, providing you two with a shelter was all I could do. However, things have changed. I can protect both of you now!”
“Master, have you forgotten that Junior Sister’s cultivation base is higher than yours?” Jiang Ming pitched his voice low and said, stumping Gu Hai.
“Other than the Sect Master, your cultivation base is still the lowest amongst the First Seats,” Jiang Ming added.
Gu Hai’s face turned dark. “Go prepare a meal. I want 32 dishes, and I’ll hit you if you can’t make them!”
“No way! How could you punish me like that? I didn’t do anything wrong!”
“I’m your Master!”
“You’re being unreasonable!”
“I’m your Master!”
“Alright, you’re the boss!” Jiang Ming sighed and went to do his Master’s bidding.
Gu Hui pulled out his wine guard and took a sip. Then, he exclaimed, “Gosh, this is so good!”
Linglong did not know what she should say.
Soon, all 32 dishes were served.
“Good, good, good. This is too good! One of my disciples is a genius, while the other is good at cooking. I bet no one in this world is luckier than me!” Gu Hai said as he enjoyed the dishes.
“They all taste really good!” Linglong commented with a smile on her face.
She really liked this kind of life.
Jiang Ming pouted but did not say anything.
Soon, they all finished all the dishes.
[Ding! You’ve successfully satisfied your Master and Junior Sister with a scrumptious meal. As such, access to the Training Zone has been activated!]
Jiang Ming let out a smile when he heard the notification.
After filling his stomach, Gu Hai rose to his feet and said, “You two stay here. I’m going out for a walk.”
“He definitely is going to show off to other people!” Jiang Ming muttered before reminding, “Master, make sure you don’t expose yourself!”
“Don’t worry. It’s my perseverance, wisdom, and knowledge that has brought me this far,” Gu Hai said as he waved his hand. “Even the heavens are on my side, and now that my Purple Mansion has recovered, I’m sure I’ll become stronger than other First Seats or even the Sect Master one day! Haha!”
He threw his head back in a burst of boisterous laughter and left.
“He just likes to show off,” Linglong said, smiling brightly.
Jiang Ming sighed. “It has been pretty hard for him in the past few years. He presumes his seniority and refuses to step down from the position of the First Seat in order to protect the two of us.
“Although nobody talks about it, I’m sure that there are some people who’re not happy with it. However, after you’ve proved yourself to be a prodigy and now that he has recovered from his injuries and has ascended into the next realm, of course, he would feel delighted!
“I guess that his first stop would be Jiaoyang Peak!”
“Yeah, you’re right.” Linglong smiled and nodded.
After cleaning the table, both of them came to the back of the mountain.
There were only five Mu of land left as he had used the rest of the land to grow some flowers and plants.
He decided to use one Mu to grow some vegetables while planting some spiritual medicine to the remaining four Mu.
Spiritual items were divided into two grades, namely normal grade, and rudiment grade.
Normal-grade spiritual items were food for junior disciples, such as spiritual rice and wheat. They usually ripened early and yielded high harvests.
As for rudiment-grade spiritual medicine, they were further categorized into low-grade, middle-grade, high-grade, top-grade, and medicine king.
A low-grade spiritual medicine would take at least a year to ripen, and some of the best quality would take at least 10 years. Middle-grade spiritual medicine took between 10 to 100 years, high-grade took 100 to 1,000 years, and top-grade took more than 1,000 years.
As for the medicine king, it would normally take 10,000 years and above.
This categorization was only usable under suitable growing conditions. It could be used as a general guideline, but it was not absolute.
What Jiang Ming grew was known as the Azure Silver Grass. It was a very common low-grade spiritual medicine. As long as the soil conditions and the concentration of spiritual essence in the air were favorable, it could be harvested in a little more than a year.
Jiang Ming planted one seedling per square meter, and there were a lot of them.
“Senior Brother, why are you growing the Azure Silver Grass only?” Linglong asked incredulously.
“The maturation time for each spiritual medicine is different, so if we grow one type at a time, we can harvest them all together!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “Do you want to try to harvest them all together? It’s a lot of fun!”
Of course, he also wanted to try to raise an Azure Silver Grass King.
“Do you think that the most common spiritual medicine like the Azure Silver Grass can become human?”
Hugging his arm, Linglong walked in the farm and said, “Become human? That’s a demon! It’s extremely difficult for a plant to become a demon, especially a common plant like this one. Not only does it require opportunity, but it also needs to absorb essence from the universe.”
The wind was breezy, and the sun was warm.
In the afternoon, Linglong started her cultivation.
Jiang Ming opened up the Human Paths Record and took a look. He noticed that Bai Zizai had gone to another place after he turned around the Jiuyang Sect, and he heaved a sigh of relief.
Just when he was about to continue his cultivation, Chang Yiming and Zhang Junbao arrived.
Jiang Ming threw two bottles of wine at them.
“Although you rarely come out of the mountain, your wine is the best in the world!” Zhang Junbao said. He took a big gulp from the bottle of wine and went to the gazebo.
“I must bring some spiritual items for you to make into wine one day!” Chang Yiming chimed in.
“Sure!” Jiang Ming laughed. “How come you’re not in seclusion?”
“I was about to go into seclusion when I heard something that made my scalp tingle. Thus, I figured I should come and let you know as well,” Zhang Junbao said. Then, he stretched his arm forward.
It went without saying that Jiang Ming knew what he wanted. He took a big bottle of wine out of his storage ring and threw it to him.
“Hahaha! You know me the best!” Zhang Junbai said as he stored the wine bottle away.
“How about me?” Chang Yiming stretched his arm out as well.
“Are you two here just for my wine?” Jiang Ming said exasperatedly.
That being said, he still gave a bottle to Chang Yiming.
“You’re the only winemaker here, so of course, we would come to you!” Zhang Junbao said. Then, he pitched his voice low and continued. “I received two messages today.”
“I thought we’ve shut down all the connection to the outside world?”
“As a cultivation sect, that is just a show to the outside world. How could you not know about it since you’re the head disciple?” Zhang Junbao said, “Two martial art experts from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in Zhong Province have come to Eastern Region. They attacked the Qingyun Sect and stirred up a ruckus across the world some time ago.
“It’s only until very recently that I learned the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was killed by someone in Eastern Region! All the evidence is pointing toward the Qingyun Sect, and this is big news!”
“The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion is a Sacred Land, and they take pride in their Holy Son. Does the Qingyun Sect really have what it takes to kill him?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with shock. “Why do I have a feeling that this is just a fake rumor?”
“Honestly, I don’t believe it either.” Zhang Junbai continued. “Although all the evidence is pointing toward the Qingyun Sect, I can almost assure you that the murderer is someone else!”
He paused for a moment before adding, “The Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion is a powerful being. I heard that his guardian is a Great Monarch in the Primal Spirit Realm. To think that a person like him would be killed by someone in silence. It’s just… Unbelievable!
“Yeah, right!” Jiang Ming added, “I can assure that whoever killed the Holy Son, they must be an admirable figure with an imposing demeanor! We should make them our model!”
“Yes, they’re truly our model. I don’t even dare to kill a Holy Son in my dreams!” Chang Yiming licked his lips and said, “My dream is getting a Holy Daughter as my wife!”
“Well, keep dreaming!” Zhang Junbai laughed. “But a lot of things have been going on Eastern Region lately. You see, the Qingyun Sect will certainly pour in every punch of their resources in investigating the matter about the Holy Son’s death, the devil sects have started to move again, and a genius from Zhong Province is coming to Eastern Province. I’m sure something big is about to happen in Eastern Region!”
“Well, it’s none of our business since we’ve already cut off our connection to the outside world for the time being,” Jiang Ming said. “What about the second message?”
“The Bishui Sect was annihilated last night!” replied Zhang Junbai. “They’re definitely not weaker than us, yet all of them were killed in one night! I nearly jumped when I heard the news! First, a Holy Son was killed, and now a sect was destroyed. Hell, this is too much. I don’t even feel safe anymore staying in the sect!”
The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips quivered..

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - The Year 9,994, Zhou Calendar; Life and Death; Reincarnation; Great Decimation
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: The Year 9,994, Zhou Calendar; Life and Death; Reincarnation; Great Decimation
After Zhang Junbao and Chang Yiming left, Jiang Ming then looked into the Training Zone, a newly activated feature of the system.
Currently, the function of the Training Zone was simple. He could enter the Training Zone with his consciousness to practice the special ability that he had learned.
In other words, it was a more advanced martial arts training ground.
He then returned to his room, activated a formation, and sat in a lotus position on his bed. He closed his eyes, and by the time he opened them again, he was already inside an empty space.
It was a platform, hovering in an endless starry sky.
Jiang Ming lifted his head and saw nothing but stars. Then, he lowered his head and noticed that he was standing on top of a not-so-large rock. He took a glance at himself, and he looked exactly the same as when he was outside. Even the Dao Seed in the sea of consciousness remained the same. It was as if he had manifested his own body in this space.
Suddenly, an idea popped up in his mind. He closed his eyes, and then when he opened them again, the environment in front of him changed into that of the Jiuyang Sect.
He was now standing on top of Chuyang Peak. He looked around and noticed there were also eight other main peaks and countless peaks around him.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself and commented, “Terrific!”
He could change the environment in this space according to his wish.
Jiang Ming stepped on the ground and touched the stone. He realized that everything in this space was so real that he couldn’t tell the difference between real and fake.
He then leaped into the air and formed a seal with his hand. He pointed it downward and a divine seal appeared, instantly covering the things below in an impressive suppression force.
The divine seal landed on Chuyang Peak, and an explosion occurred at the moment of collision, giving rise to a storm of dust that covered even the sky.
“This is great. I can do whatever I want here!” Jiang Ming was delighted.
He formed multiple hand seals, and divine seals appeared in the sky one after another. He then sent them all plunging downward and decimated the entire Chuyuang Peak.
He turned his head around and lifted his arm into the air as he activated the Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning. With a stroke of his hand, thunder descended on Zhiyang Peak and drowned the mountain in a mighty roar.
The Wooden Dragon, the Slice the Heavens sword technique, the Nine Heavenly Cannons, the Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, and even the Great Akasa Divine Hand… He performed one special ability after another in this space to his heart’s content.
In the blink of an eye, he had leveled the entire Jiuyang Sect.
“This feels so great!” Jiang Ming shouted.
He had been suppressing himself the whole time he was in Jiuyang Sect. Even if he did go out of Jiuyang Sect once in a while, he was always in a rush, so he couldn’t get to enjoy most of the battles.
One thing he found out about this space was that he could perform the special abilities as much as he wanted without any fear of exertion as the special abilities would not consume any mana when he was here.
He continued to perform his special abilities again and again. In the end, he found that he had a better understanding of his special abilities.
After having his fun, Jiang Ming called his consciousness back to his body.
Other than the flow of time, he did not feel anything else.
Jiang Ming smiled.
Time was flowing slowly. He was improving his understanding of special abilities and Dao Seeds, while his Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones were being depleted at a shocking rate.
He had successfully fused the Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth Dao Seeds together and transformed them into the Five Elemental Dao Seeds.
The Five Elemental Dao Seed was one of the rarest Dao Seeds in this world.
No!
Whether it was the record in the sect or the “Detailed Explanations on Human Cultivation Realms” written by Master Dao Yan, only one person in 1,000 years might have succeeded in forming the Five Elemental Dao Seed, and that was the reason it was one of the hardest Dao Seeds to form.
After successfully forming the Five Elemental Dao Seed, the Yin-Yang Dao Seed was slowly taking shape as well.
Since he had absorbed the Space Crystal, Jiang Ming had a better understanding of space. After performing the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, the Great Akasa Steps, and the Great Akasa Divine Hand in the Training Zone, he had fully comprehended the Spatial Sambodha and successfully formed the Spatial Dao Seed.
The Death Dao Seed and Vitality Dao Seed had merged together and formed the Life-and-Death Dao Seed.
The Great Demolition Sambodha, the Reincarnation Sambodha, the Light-and-Dark Sambodha, and the True Illusion Sambodha had formed their respective Dao Seeds as well.
Under the combined effort of Enlightening Tea Leaves and Enlightening Stones, Jiang Ming had made a couple of breakthroughs.
Unfortunately, he still couldn’t comprehend the Time Sambodha and the Karma Sambodha.
Jiang Ming came out of his seclusion today.
He leaped to the roof and turned his head to see that his Junior Sister was still in seclusion.
He could not see his Master around, so he figured that he must have gone somewhere else.
The glow from the westbound sun had dyed everything in its path red.
He took a glance at the back mountain and found that the Azure Silver Grass was almost ready to be harvested.
It had been more than a year since his Master’s Purple Mansion had recovered.
In the past year, Zhang Junbao would bring him news from time to time, and he also learned about the outside world through the record in the Human Paths Record.
For example, the Sect Master had broken through the Primal Spirit Realm, and the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and the Qingyun Sect were still at war.
The Bishui Sect had moved their main force to Eastern Region and had taken Hai Province from the Tianshui Sect.
The devil sects were getting more and more active with more of their disciples appearing in the public.
The geniuses from Zhong Province had arrived. As they traveled across Eastern Region, they defeated one genius in Eastern Region after another. They were unstoppable.
These were the geniuses from Zhong Province and each of them was supported by a powerful force such as a Sacred Land, so no one dared to mess with them.
Jiang Ming had a basic grasp of the dating system here as well.
When he was on the mountain, there were no four seasons, and he could not feel the flow of time at all unless something big happened. He did not even make the effort of understanding it.
They were now in the year 9,994 of the Zhou Calendar. The Great Zhou Dynasty in Zhong Province had been founded nearly 10,00 years ago, and it had become a force as powerful as the Sacred Land. They were using the Zhou Calendar as the main dating system.
As for the history further ahead? That’s much longer.
They were changing the dating system constantly in order to prevent the emergence of mind-numbing dating systems such as the Tian Yuan Calendar or the Divine State Calendar that lasted several million or tens of millions of years.
“It has been four years and nine months since the activation of the system!”
Jiang Ming did not know if it was a coincidence or not either.
“In my current realm, I can unify and merge all the spells through the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra to form the Chaos Dao Seed! However, I only managed to form five types of Dao Seed. The Yin-Yang, Life-and-Death, Reincarnation, Light-and-Dark, True Illusion, and Great Decimation Dao Seeds are amongst the highest level of Dao Seeds. There are also others such as the Saber, Blade, Fist, Stellar, and Sentience Dao Seeds.
“The only things I lack right now are the Time and Karma Dao Seeds!
“However, if I use the Five Elemental Dao Seeds as the foundation, the Yin-Yang Dao Seed as the catalyst, and the Spatial Dao Seed as the support to connect the Reincarnation, Life-and-Death, Light-and-Dark, and True Illusion while using the rest as supplements, I can already form the Chaos Dao Seed. It’s just that it’s incomplete!”
Jiang Ming was reflecting on his own situation. He was both hesitant and worried.
Karma was too difficult to comprehend, and he did not have the faintest inkling of how to do it. Time was the most enigmatic thing in this world, and it was even harder than climbing into the sky to capture it.
Jiang Ming did not know what he should do at all.
“I guess I’ll just wait for a little longer. If it doesn’t work, I’ll settle for what I can get,” Jiang Ming said.
Suddenly, he jerked his head back and looked toward his Junior Sister’s direction when he sensed a terrifying Pure Sun Sambodha from her room. Even if there was a formation around her room, it could not prevent him from detecting her changes.
“This is the Pure Sun Sambodha!” Jiang Ming exclaimed as his eyes glowed.
His Junior Sister had formed the Fire Dao Seed, but now she had successfully transformed it into the Pure Sun Dao Seed. It might seem like an easy feat, but in fact, it was very difficult, even for some geniuses.
At present, there were not many people in this world who had comprehended the Pure Sun Sambodha.
This was because everything in this world had both Yin and Yang.
Absorbing the Yang energy from the universe to comprehend the Sun Sambodha was already a difficult feat, not to mention that his Junior Sister’s Dao Seed had directly evolved from the Fire Dao Seed.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record was opened once again.
Name: Zi Linglong
Gender: Human female
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Disciple of the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 95
Innate Talent: Immortal (Advanced Phoenix Bloodline)
Status: When she was cultivating, her Fire Dao Seed transformed into the Pure Sun Dao Seed while her bloodline evolved. At present, she has the strongest Phoenix Warrior Body, further amplifying her physical and spell-casting prowess.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself and exclaimed, “While your cultivation base is improving, your body is getting refined as well. You truly are a genius with a lot of luck, Junior Sister!”
‘I must pick up my pace, or else I’ll get surpassed by her!’
As the thought surfaced in his mind, he came to the back mountain and looked at the Azure Silver Grass that had already ripened.
“I hope I won’t be disappointed. If it really doesn’t happen, it will be the fifth year in another three months. At that time, the rewards will be phenomenal!”
He decided to harvest the Azure Silver Grass tomorrow. Unfortunately, he couldn’t find any Azure Silver Grass King..

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - Three Minutes; A Challenge for Junior Sister
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Three Minutes; A Challenge for Junior Sister
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming made a simple dinner for himself. After eating his food, he earned five days’ worth of cultivation base.
The wind was blowing strong outside, but there was no wind on the inside.
The sky was spotted with many stars, and he was so bored that he wished he could take one down to play with it.
Swoosh!
Since he had nothing to do right now, he opened up the Human Paths Record.
Senior Sister Momo still retained her cultivation base, but she was told to guard the medicinal field and was not allowed to leave without permission.
It was considered a good ending as well.
Instead of returning to Red Mountain Palace, Bai Zizhi stayed on the east coast.
“I must find a chance and get rid of him after I’ve broken through,” said Jiang Ming.
Although Jiang Ming was much stronger right now than when he was chased by him, Jiang Ming still did not have the confidence that he could defeat him.
A martial artist in the Paradis Realm was too powerful. They had the ability to manifest the image of a heavenly cave and affected a wide area. It would be hard to get near to them and kill them in a sneak attack under that kind of condition.
Zi Linglong took a deep breath inside the room and opened her eyes. There was a smile tugging at the corner of her lips as she said, “My Dao Seed has transformed into the Pure Sun Dao Seed, and I have the Phoenix Warrior Body after my bloodline evolved. Taking down a martial artist in the Primal Spirit Realm would be a breeze with my special abilities and secret arts!”
She had been reborn, so she needed to start everything anew.
It was harder to refine the bloodline, as she needed to do it step by step. On the contrary, raising her realm was much easier. That being said, she still needed to communicate with the universe and accumulate bit by bit after receiving the blessing. After all, there was nothing such as a free lunch in this world.
Also, the Jiuyang Sect did not have enough resources to support her.
Her current achievement was all thanks to The Tomb of Extreme Path of Yun Tiankong that she had come across last time. Otherwise, she reckoned that she would have needed to take a longer time to reach what she had today.
“Absorbing the essence of the universe into one’s body to become one with nature. This is cultivation!”
After being reborn, she had a better understanding of cultivation than she was used to in the past.
“The next step is to transform extreme Yang into extreme Yin, comprehend the Yin-Yang Sambodha, and form the Yin-Yang Dao Seed. This way, only I can go father without any worries in the future.
“Then…”
Zi Linglong’s eyes glittered. There was a subtle spatial wave and a Dao rhythm around her, but all of them eventually fell silent.
She had a clear plan for her future.
Zi Linglong came down from her bed and walked to the window. She opened the window and looked at her Senior Brother, who was standing on the rooftop in front of her. The hard lines on her face melted away, and a gentle expression appeared.
“I can abandon everyone, but I will never abandon my Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong mumbled.
At that moment, nothing was more important than her Senior Brother.
“Senior Brother!” she shouted while approaching him.
The night sky was boundless, and the stars were dancing here and there happily.
Both of them sat on rattan chairs and looked at the starry sky.
“How is your cultivation going?”
“Great! Senior Brother, you’ve already perfected the Foundation Establishment Realm, so when are you going to step into the Golden Core Realm?”
“That can wait.”
“Let me know when you’re going to break into the Golden Core Realm. I’ll guard you!”
“Thank you, Linglong. That’s really assuring.”
Both of them chatted and time flew past rapidly.
The next day, at the back of the mountain…
“Senior Brother, this is so awesome. All of the blades of Azure Silver Grass have ripened!” Zi Linglong exclaimed as she hopped here and there amongst the blades of grass, looking just like a happy rabbit.
“I’ve heard that it’s challenging to raise spiritual medicine. Not only do we have to ward the pests off, but we also need to pay attention to the changes of spiritual essence in the air. We even need to sprinkle crushed spirit crystals on them as nourishment and water them frequently. However, even if we’ve done everything, we can’t guarantee the survival rate!”
“Well, since I have a lot of time, I might as well put it to good use,” Jiang Ming replied simply.
However, what he did not tell Zi Linglong was that raising spiritual medicine was really a tedious process. Just like a farmer taking care of his crops, he had to come to the back mountain every day to check on their condition from time to time and to stop the pests from destroying these spiritual medicines.
The silver lining was that his effort had finally paid off, and he could harvest them now.
“Senior Brother, while you’re cultivating these spiritual medicines, you still manage to make time to prepare meals for me every day, brew wine, take care of the crops, and you even have entered the peak of the Foundation Establishment Realm! If anyone still dares to say you’re slow in your cultivation, I’m going to bring him to the Restraining Tower!” Zi Linglong said in a serious manner.
“You’re a girl, and as a girl, you need to be more gentle. Besides, I’m your Senior Brother, so of course, I can’t be too useless. Or else, I’ll be in a lot of stress.” Jiang Ming smiled and shook his head.
“Senior Brother, you just live your life as you wish and leave everything else to me,” Zi Linglong said as she patted her chest.
“You really have a honey tongue, do you know that?”
“Hehe, I know I have a honey tongue, but how did you know that, Senior Brother?”
“Ahem, stop making fun of me!”
“Alright, alright! What should we do with these blades of Azure Silver Grass, Senior Brother?”
“Well, I have no idea yet.”
As they were talking, they had finished harvesting the Azure Silver Grass. Some of them had wilted, so they got 2,600 blades of Azure Silver Grass in the end.
[Ding! Congratulations to the host on his first massive harvest of entry-grade spiritual medicine. A special reward of 2,600 years of cultivation base and a Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card has been given to the host as rewards!]
Jiang Ming blinked his eyes.
Although he seemed emotionless on the surface, he was greatly surprised inwardly.
‘I can’t believe I got so many years of cultivation as a reward. Is it because this is my first time?’ he thought.
He then commanded and the information about the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card appeared in his mind
[Using the host’s current cultivation base as a template to extrapolate the strength of reaching the peak of the Extreme Path Realm. Once activated, it cannot be stopped, and the host will be granted the battle power of the Extreme Path Realm for 3 minutes.]
“Using me as a template?” Jiang Ming exclaimed, disbelief thick in his voice.
Judging from his current situation, if he could have the power of the Extreme Path Realm, he was confident that he could slay even a martial artist in the Imminent Immortal Realm. He felt this was really a great item, but it was such a shame that it lasted for three minutes.
‘Why can’t it last for a bit longer? This is no fun at all!’ he thought.
“Senior Brother, are we still going to grow the Azure Silver Grass?” Linglong asked as she looked at the harvest in front of her.
“Nope. Let’s wait for a while!”
As soon as Jiang Ming finished speaking, he caught a glimpse of a figure through the corner of his eyes. He turned his head and realized that it was Zhang Junbao. He was waving his hand as he approached them.
“Senior Brother? Did something happen” Jiang Ming asked as he went closer to Zhang Junbao.
Zi Linglong followed suit as well.
“A big thing happened!” Zhang Junbai replied. He did not go into the courtyard. Instead, he stood at the reception platform and smiled bitterly. “Someone challenged Junior Sister Linglong to a battle!”
“I thought we closed our mountain?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“They’re from Zhong Province. They have a big background, so do you think we can say no when they said they wanted to pay us a visit? No, we can’t!” Zhang Junbai said helplessly. “Their objective is simple. They heard that Junior Sister Linglong has the phoenix bloodline, so they want to have a match with her. They told us that they would like to have a match with every genius or people with special bloodlines in Eastern Region.”
“Our Sect Master is already in the Primal Spirit Realm. He can’t stop them?” Zi Linglong chimed in, frowning deeply.
Zhang Junbao shook his head. “We’re going up against the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Not only is he surrounded by a martial artist in the Primal Spirit Realm and many other geniuses, but there are also many powerful beings protecting him from the dark. Our Sect Master has rejected their demand, but they refuse to listen. They have defeated many sects and powerful clans as they travel across the continent. Nobody can defeat them!”
“Are they really that powerful?” Jiang Ming asked.
“They’re not only powerful… They’re monsters!” Zhang Junbai added, “A few of the youngsters that follow the 18th Prince have already conquered our Tower of Trials! And they’re only in the Golden Core Realm!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
In the Jiuyang Sect, only his Junior Sister had managed to conquer the Tower of Trials, but now these outsiders could clear it without any difficulty?
This was absolutely a disgrace!
“Senior Brother, should I go meet them?” Zi Linglong asked as she looked into the distance.
Jiang Ming was looking in the same direction as well.
They saw many figures flying toward the main peak.. In particular, one of them exuded such a domineering aura that it would make everything lower their head in obedience and yield to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - Domineering Empress; Kill Them All
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Domineering Empress; Kill Them All
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Spells: Primal Spirit Heart Sword, Ten Thousand Sword Technique, Basic Formations, Basic Talismans, Basic Pills, Basic Artifacts…
Special power: Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Great Akasa Steps, Great Akasa Divine Hand, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, Great Manifestation Technique, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Wooden Dragon, Slice the Heavens Sword Technique, Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Three-fold Astral Transformation, Nine Heavenly Cannons, and Orbital Sword Formation
Innate Talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Items: Human Path Records, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk, Mana Sealing Chess Plate (top-grade Dao Vessel), Tyrant Halberd (middle-grade Dao Vessel), Sky Rending Sword (middle-grade Dao Vessel), Heaven Shattering Hammer (low-grade Dao Vessel), Obsidian Black (low-grade Dao Vessel), Heaven Suppression Cauldron (top-grade Artifact) x 4. Cultivation Base x5,600, one-time use Enlightening Stone (rare-grade) x5, Enlightening Tea Tree Seed (immortal-grade) x1, Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card
Support: Primary Training Zone
The interface of the system had changed. There was a “Support” section right now. It stated that it was still a primary training zone. Besides, he was running out of Enlightening Tea Leaves, and he had only five Enlightening Stones left. He had a shocking amount of 5,600 years of cultivation base in reserve, but unfortunately, the cultivation base had little use in forming Dao Seeds.
Jiang Ming took a glance at his record and suddenly felt that the 18th Prince was nothing. He would leave him alone if he did not do anything stupid, but if he wanted to court death, Jiang Ming would get rid of him and send him to make friends with Bai Yu without any hesitation.
In the blink of an eye, a group of people arrived and landed on the platform. They were accompanied by the Sect Master as well as his own Master. There were other 20 to 30 young men, and Jiang Ming reckoned that they must be Zhou Tian and his gang.
Jiang Ming took a look at the Sect Master’s “Status.” It was recorded that Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince, had challenged the Jiuyang Sect to a fight, but none of the people in Jiuyang Sect posed an actual challenge to them. He then insisted on meeting Zi Linglong. The Sect Master had tried his best to talk him out of it, but he refused to. In the end, the Sect Master had no other choice but to bring him and his party to Chuyang Peak since they couldn’t wait any longer to meet her.
“Greetings, Sect Master!” Jiang Ming greeted the Sect Master while taking the opportunity to take on the crowd behind him. Some of them had their arms crossed in front of their chests, while the others held their hands behind their backs. There were even a few of them who lifted their chins and looked at them condescendingly with a smile on their faces.
They all had different looks, but they had one thing in common—arrogance.
Amongst them, Zhou Tian had the most domineering and powerful aura. He did not even take a single effort to tone down his aura, and he looked just like a divine mountain that gave off a silvery light.
“Jiang Ming, meet Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. He’s in the Dao Seed Realm, and this is the first time he came to Chuyang Peak. So, remember to behave yourself!” The Sect Master mentioned Zhou Tian’s origin and cultivation base while he was introducing him to Jiang Ming, for he was worried that Jiang Ming would do something inappropriate.
“Nice to meet you, Senior Brother Zhou,” said Jiang Ming.
Zhou Tian threw a glance at him, and then he looked at Zi Linglong.
Jiang Ming maintained the smile on his face, while Zi Linglong’s eyes turned icily cold.
A young man beside Zhou Tian roared, “So you’re Zi Linglong’s rumored good-for-nothing Senior Brother. You’re in no position to call the 18th Prince as your Senior Brother! Get the hell out of the way now!”
Jiang Ming’s face sank while Gu Hai’s face turned red with anger. The Sect Master frowned as well.
Zi Linglong was infuriated. Before anyone could do anything, she appeared right in front of the young man and gave him a slap in the face, sending him flying into the air as he spat a few bloodied teeth out of his mouth.
Unfortunately, this was not the end yet. She leaped into the air, grabbed the young man, and pinned him on the ground, forcing him to kneel before Jiang Ming. Then, she said with an apathetic voice, “What did you say just now?”
Everyone was taken aback by the sudden change of events.
Gu Hai opened his mouth several times, but he did not say anything in the end.
He knew better than anyone how much she cared about her Senior Brother, and she cared about her Senior Brother more than she cared about his Master. Therefore, humiliating him in front of the public was similar to courting death.
Although Zhang Junbao felt the young man deserved it, he was worried about Zi Linglong.
The Sect Master squinted his eyes.
As for Zhou Tian, something flickered across his eyes as he was surprised.
“How dare you!” Another young man behind him stepped forward. He activated his special abilities, forming a rain of light in the air before throwing them all together at Zi Linglong.
“Watch out!”
Some of the disciples who did not know about Zi Linglong’s situation exclaimed in fear and anxiety.
Smack!
In the next moment, she lifted her hand without turning her head and destroyed the rain of light. At the same time, she sent the young man flying down the mountain. Had it not been for his comrade to save him, he would have fallen to his death.
“That’s enough!” Zhou Tian growled as he took a step forward. He unleashed a wave of powerful aura, causing a few First Seats to take a few steps back.
“Let go of Chen Liang!”
Zi Linglong pushed Jiang Ming to her back and glanced at Zhou Tian. She then turned toward the kneeling young man and asked again, “What did you say just now?”
It was only then Chen Liang came around to his senses. He was surprised at first, and then his face contorted in a grimace of anger. “How dare you make me kneel in front of everyone!? Ah, nobody has ever done this to me! I’m going to kill you! I’m going to shred you into a million pieces!”
In the next second, Zi Linglong pumped more force into her palm, sending the young man deeper into the ground. His kneecaps cracked, and blood was pooling under his body.
Chen Liang grunted in pain and became even angrier. “I’ll never forget what you’ve done to me today. I swear to heaven that I’ll get it back from your Senior Brother one day! I’ll torture him and humiliate him to the point that you won’t even be able to recognize who he is!”
Zi Linglong’s eyes turned cold.
Gu Hai’s expression changed, and he shouted, “No!”
“Stop it!” Zhou Tian growled as he knew that Zi Linglong was going to kill Chen Liang. He waved his hand and threw sword energy at her, but Zi Linglong easily intercepted his attack with just a flip of her hand.
After that, she delivered a palm strike at the young man with her right hand, crushing the arrogant young man into the ground. Light immediately left his eyes, and he died wearing a look of disbelief on his face.
It was never in his wildest dreams that Zi Linglong would be this powerful and that she would really want to kill him. After all, he came from Zhong Province and had a big background.
Ever since they had landed in Eastern Region, all of the clans and sects had treated them with high regard. Nobody dared to talk back to them, let alone take their lives.
Therefore, he became more and more arrogant, and finally, it was his arrogance that got him killed.
The crowd gasped at the gruesome scene. Chen Liang’s body had turned into a bloodied mush after receiving the mana-imbued blow from Zi Linglong.
“Terrific. As expected of the owner of the phoenix bloodline!” Zhou Tian exclaimed. Then, he roared, “How dare you kill one of my own? Zi Linglong, if you don’t give me a proper explanation, I’m going to put you down today!”
“An explanation?” Zi Linglong said, her face cold, “You’re stepping on the territory of Chuyang Peak, which belongs to my Senior Brother. However, instead of behaving decently, you humiliated and insulted him.
“Do you really think you can do whatever you want to the sects in Eastern Region just because you came from Zhong Province? Fat chance!
“Besides, it was him who humiliated my Senior Brother in the first place, and there is only one end for those who dare to talk that way to my Senior Brother—Death!
“Zhou Tian, if you don’t give me a proper explanation, I’m going to kill all of you here today!”
After she finished speaking, she was cloaked in a menacing aura, and everyone could sense her killing intent.
“Great, great. Zi Linglong, you truly are one ruthless and determined woman. Initially, I thought you were only in the Golden Core Realm, and I wanted to take you in as one of us. I didn’t expect that you had ascended into the Dao Seed Realm. The speed of your cultivation is so fast that few people can match you even in Zhong Province!” Zhou Tian said as he lifted his brow.
“We’ve yet to come across any worthy opponents ever since we stepped into this land. Fueled by our achievement, we become more and more arrogant and consider everybody and everything beneath us.
“Although we’re wrong, you can’t blame us since we have never been defeated before.. Today, if you can defeat me, I’ll apologize to you. But if you lose, you’re going to come with me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - Jiang Ming’s Lesson, Junior Sister’s Obedience
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Jiang Ming’s Lesson, Junior Sister’s Obedience
Name: Zhou Tian
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty
Relationship: -22
Innate Talent: Nine Stars (Primary True Dragon Bloodline)
Status: After learning about the downfall of Bai Yu, the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in the hand of a martial artist in Eastern Region, as the one who was blessed by heaven, he departed from Zhong Province and came to Eastern Region. While he was planning to lift his popularity, he also aimed to get to know more talented people so that he could recruit them to expand his own team. After setting foot in Eastern Region, he had been going around and challenging young people below the age of 100. He had yet to be defeated, and his team was unstoppable. When he heard that the owner of the phoenix bloodline was in the Jiuyang Sect, he was overjoyed and wanted to recruit her.
If it were in the past, Jiang Ming might be scrupulous, but after obtaining the Extreme Path Experience Card, he did not care so much anymore. Unfortunately, the Extreme Path Experience Card only lasted for three minutes, not to mention that it was a one-time use item. After using it, he wouldn’t be able to use it anymore.
‘Relationship -22, huh? He seems like someone who has some heroic ingredients in his composition, but… Oh well…’
Jiang Ming shook his head inwardly after he checked Zhou Tian’s information through the Human Paths Record.
That being said, he was not going to let him off so easily since he had the nerves to set his eyes on his Junior Sister.
‘Compete with young people below the age of 100? 100 years old is still considered a young person?’ Jiang Ming was confused.
This was one fascinating aspect of the cultivation world. One could increase their lifespan through cultivation. Therefore, a person under the age of 100 could still be considered a young person as well.
His face sank after he heard what Zhou Tian said. However, he did not step forward. He had faith in his Junior Sister that she could handle the situation, but in the case where the situation went out of her control, he would step in.
“Hah! How arrogant!” Zi Linglong commented coldly, “You did something wrong, so it’s only right and natural for you to apologize, but now you want to use it as a bet? You will apologize if I can defeat you, and I have to come with you if you win the match? Who do you think you are?”
Zhou Tian’s face turned ugly and an intense murderous intent appeared in the depth of his eyes.
He was a prince, and his status was comparable to that of a Holy Son. He had never been insulted like this before in his life.
‘She’s just a little girl. Who does she think she is?’ he thought. Be that as it may, he was not going to lash out at her since he had his pride as a prince.
However, that was not the same case for the people behind him. One of his followers jumped and growled, “How dare you insult the prince. You must have a death wish!”
He was a martial artist in the Nascent Soul Realm, and he could not forgive Zi Linglong for the things she said to Zhou Tian.
Swoosh!
Without any hesitation, he split his sword into eight and surrounded Zi Linglong.
Gu Hai’s expression changed, Zhang Junbao clenched his fists tightly, and the Sect Master gathered his power within his body, while Jiang Ming looked at the man coldly.
Although his Junior Sister was only in the Dao Seed Realm, she had formed the Yang Dao Seed. It was immensely powerful and combined with the legacy she had acquired from The Tomb of Extreme Path, even if she couldn’t kill the man, it wouldn’t be a problem for her to defend herself.
Zi Linglong summoned a sword in her hand without any hesitation. She brandished it in an upward slash, and nine globes of sun appeared in the air.
The intense heat released by the suns distorted the air and seemed to be able to burn everything down.
After effortlessly deflecting the man’s attack, she continued to dash toward him.
“Oh no!”
The man’s expression changed. He wanted to run, but he was surrounded by the nine globes of sun. It was already too late to activate his special abilities, so he could only resort to using his armor to protect himself.
Bam!
Zi Linglong’s sword landed on the man, causing his armor to glow brightly as he was sent flying away.
Zi Linglong was not going to show any mercy.
She closed the distance between them in a few steps and delivered several quick blows—one stronger than the last—at the man with her sword. She was moving so fast that the crowd could barely catch her movements. All of them took a few steps back and guarded themselves. By the time they could finally see her, the fight was coming to an end.
She penetrated through the man’s armor with her sword. The nine globes of sun entered his body, and he exploded in a plume of blood mist.
Zi Linglong killed a martial artist in the Nascent Soul Realm within the blink of an eye. It was an extraordinary feat, and the crowd was dumbfounded.
Even the Sect Master couldn’t believe what had just transpired before his eyes. He had the confidence to defeat the man, but that was all he could do. He did not think he could kill him at all. However, not only did Zi Linglong defeat him, but she also managed to kill him effortlessly. Even if the man had underestimated her, it was still very unlikely for her to kill him. Unless Zi Linglong had grown far more powerful than he had expected her to be.
“How dare you!” Zhou Tian’s eyes were burning with rage when he saw another of his followers getting killed. The gold black robe he was wearing glowed divinely and made him look even more impressive.
“How dare you kill my fellow followers again? Zi Linglong, you’ve broken the rules!”
As Zhou Tian was talking, a halberd appeared in his hand, making him look even more powerful. Rays of golden light were fanning out from the top of his head, and he looked just like a god of war.
“Rules? Did you follow our rules after you came here?” Zi Linglong turned her sword around and said, “Get the hell out of here now. Or else, this place will be your grave today!”
Jiang Ming stepped forward and patted her shoulder. “Junior Sister, you mustn’t let the demon in your heart get the best of you. It’s not good for your cultivation.”
“Did I make a mistake, Senior Brother?’ Zi Linglong turned around and asked in a soft, worried voice. The murderous aura she exuded disappeared in that instant, and she blinked her eyes as she looked at Jiang Ming.
Everyone was shocked at the sudden change.
“Nope! You didn’t do anything wrong.” Jiang Ming laughed. “As a fellow cultivator, you shouldn’t feel bad when it comes to killing. Besides, those two people made a mistake, and they deserved what they got. Of course, we shouldn’t just go around and take lives as we wish. Some of these people didn’t show any malice toward us, nor did they insult us, so we shouldn’t kill them.
“As for the 18th Prince, although he came to challenge us, if we kill him here, it will put the Jiuyang Sect in a difficult position and will affect our reputation. After all, we aren’t a devil sect, and we need to keep our name clean.
“Most importantly, we must not let them affect our feelings.
“No matter who they are or what they came for, they’re just guests and there is a probability that we might not be seeing each other again for the rest of our lives. Therefore, you shouldn’t be too hard on yourself, and you must not let them affect your emotions.
“In the future, kill those who should be killed and treat it as if you’re crushing a bug. You don’t need to have any hard feelings for yourself, and you don’t have to take them too seriously!” Jiang Ming said while sighing inwardly.
It would be bad for his Junior Sister to have such a strong killing intent. Therefore, he figured that he should find a way and lead her back to the right path. After all, other than taking one’s life, they could just lock them up in a place like the Restraining Tower.
The crowd gasped when they heard what Jiang Ming said.
Although he seemed like he was lecturing Zi Linglong, it occurred to them that he was telling her to treat those people she wanted to kill like bugs so that she wouldn’t get affected after killing them.
Even Gu Hai felt a chill running down his spine.
“Okay, Senior Brother. I’ll think of them as bugs before I kill them!” Zi Linglong replied and nodded seriously.
“I’ll get rid of them now before they become bugs and affect your mood!”
“Smart girl!” Jiang Ming nodded in relief.
“This is all thanks to you, Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong replied, offering him a sweet smile.
Zhang Junbao, who was standing at the side, opened and closed his mouth several times. He wanted to say something, but he swallowed the words back to his stomach pit in the end.
Zhou Tian was infuriated after listening to the conversation between Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong. His face was livid with rage as he hissed, “Great, this is great! Jiuyang Sect, all of you are the most brazen bunch of people I’ve ever seen!”
“I’ll take that as a compliment,” Zi Linglong said as she turned around, her face cold. “Now, back to the topic. You’re here for a challenge, yet you acted like a bully and refused to follow the rules. Not only that, but you even humiliated the owner of this land! Either you get the hell out of my face now, or I’m going to kick your *ss!”
As soon as she had finished speaking, she darted straight toward Zhou Tian. She lifted her sword and the nine globes of sun once again appeared in the sky. When they were descending, the destructive power they brought forth made people feel as if they could incinerate everything in their path, regardless of the mountain, the sea, or the sky.
“Zi Linglong!” Zhou Tian shouted fiercely, “I’m going to kill you!”
In the blink of an eye, their battle started..

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - The Ninth Time, Checked
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: The Ninth Time, Checked
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Zhou Tian was wearing the low-grade Black Gold Arcane Armor and holding the Heavenly Polearm, a low-grade Dao Vessel. He then activated the Great Polearm Tyrant technique. It was the powerful special ability that the royal family of the Great Zhou Dynasty used to conquer the land.
His aura surged, and it made him look even stronger. He would have made quick work of his opponent, but unfortunately, his opponent today was Zi Linglong.
When comparing special abilities alone, even Jiang Ming was no match for her. Even if she just used a few of her special abilities, she was still very impressive.
Bam!
Zhou Tian fell from the sky and crashed on the peak of a mountain.
“When the dragon gets furious, the sky will be stained with blood!” He leaped into the air, his eyes spewing fire. His long hair and armor fluttered along with the wind as he shouted, “Great Polearm Heaven Strike, bring down the foe!”
His power surged following the incantation. He charged straight at Zi Linglong with all his might, but he was sent flying away again.
Next, Zhou Tian kept getting beaten to the ground again and again. In the end, his hair was disheveled, and there was blood lining the corner of his lips. Even the divine light around him had dimmed down.
“This is the ninth time!” Zi Linglong said as she looked coldly at him, “If you come at me again, you’ll become a bug. If you become a bug, I’ll have to kill you. If not, you’ll affect my emotions!”
“Arghhh!”
Something inside Zhou Tian’s head snapped, and he shouted at the top of his lungs in rage.
Ever since he was born, he had been highly admired. He cultivated quickly and was known as a prodigy. Besides, he had never lost to anyone, except for a few people.
Even if he lost a battle, he had never been humiliated like this before.
In his eyes, the Jiuyang Sect was just a second-rate sect. He looked down on them and barged in forcefully in an attempt to recruit Zi Linglong, but now…
He was getting his *ss kicked!
His hand that was holding the polearm was shaking. His bones were broken, and he was confident that his organs must have sustained a great amount of damage.
Be that as it may, he was not going to give up just yet. Just when he was about to throw himself at Zi Linglong again, a hand appeared on his hand and stopped him.
“Your Highness, please stop!”
“Uncle Chang, I, I, I…” Zhou Tian was so exasperated that he was on the verge of crying.
“You’ve lost, Your Highness. This is not something humiliating. Bai Yu was a powerful being who reigned over Zhong Province, but he still met his demise in Eastern Region. Back then, the Eldest Prince was known as the most talented martial artist, yet he was defeated again and again when he attempted to overpower his peers. There are countless talented people in this world, and nobody dares to say they are the strongest.
“Your Highness, it’s only through defeat that you can truly accomplish self-realization. What you should do right now is go back, put more effort into your training, and come back to challenge them again one day,” the elder man said, his voice filled with wisdom.
“You know it. You know why I came here!” Zhou Tian said, “I… I just can’t accept it. If I lose today, can I still defeat her in the future? She’s not even 20 years old!”
The corner of the elder man’s lips quivered, but he still forced a smile on his face, “She’s able to step into the Dao Seed Realm despite her young age, defeated you, and killed a martial artist in the Nascent Soul Realm. Can’t you see it yet, Your Highness? She’s an unparalleled prodigy who’s favored by heaven, and she’s bound to achieve something great in the future!
“Your Highness, you should consider yourself fortunate to have run into such a person today. After all, regardless of sparring or sharing experience, I’m sure she will be of great help to you in the future!
“You’re the prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. You’re broad-minded and ambitious. If can could bring all the outstanding people under your command, I’m certain you’ll be able to forge your own great achievements one day!”
This time, he talked to him through mind transmission.
“You’re right.” Zhou Tian pouted. His expression changed, and he had returned to his normal self.
Divine light began to radiate from him, and he finally calmed down.
Opposite of them, at the moment the elder man appeared, the Sect Master had arrived beside Zi Linglong too. Even Dongfang Lie, the First Seat of Lieyang Peak, and Hao Chen, the First Seat of Shaofeng Peak, flew and stood behind Zi Linglong.
“I lost!” Zhou Tian announced after taking a deep breath. He offered Zi Linglong a big grin and continued. “Amongst the geniuses I’ve come across, you definitely are the best! I lost today, but I’ll come back again!”
He paused for a moment and threw a medicinal herb to Zi Linglong. “This is the gift of compensation. I’ll be taking my leave now. Farewell!”
After he finished speaking, he turned around and left.
The rest of the people who followed him looked at each other with strange expressions on their faces as they left the scene one after another.
“Thanks for your time!” The elder man known as “Uncle Chang” made a bow at the Sect Master before leaving.
The Sect Master heaved out a long sigh of relief.
No one knew how stressed he was just now, but luckily, everything had come to an end now.
“Great work, Linglong,” the Sect Master said with a smile.
