“I’m sorry for making you worry about me, Sect Master,” Zi Linglong replied. She grabbed the medicinal herb and came to Jiang Ming’s side. She hugged his arm and said softly, “Senior brother, I didn’t do anything wrong, right?”
“You’ve done a great job!” Jiang Ming laughed. “Zhou Tian may seem fine on the surface, but I’m sure he must hate you to the core since you’ve made him look like a clown in front of his followers. We can’t do anything to him since there are so many people watching. If no one was watching, we would’ve gotten rid of him already!”
“You’re right. Let’s find a chance and get rid of him in the future!” Zi Linglong nodded.
The mouths of the crowd twitched vigorously after they heard the conversation between Zi Linglong and Jiang Ming, especially the Sect Master. He was a little bit worried about the future of the Jiuyang Sect, and he could foresee that she would get herself into a lot of trouble in the future if she did not change her attitude.
The Great Zhou Dynasty must have an army of martial artists in the Paradis, Extreme Path, or Imminent Immortal Realm, and they said they could kill Zhou Tian if nobody was watching? What kind of joke was that!?
After the death of the Holy Son of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, even the Qingyun Sect had a hard time dealing with the two powerful beings they sent after them, and the Qingyun Sect was a sacred land.
How about the Jiuyang Sect?
Even if they just spit at them, they could easily drown them.
“Gu Hai, you have to guide her properly!” The Sect Master sent a mind transmission to Gu Hai. “She’s still young, and if she’s guided properly, she will bring the Jiuyang Sect to a whole new level. However, if… If she killed Zhou Tian today, all of us would need to run for our lives!”
“Don’t worry, I… I…” Gu Hai stammered, “I’ll try my best!”
“Try your best? No, you have to do it. This is related to the future of the Jiuyang Sect. If you cannot guide her properly, you will be condemned as a sinner through the ages. However, if you can guide her properly, you will be highly regarded for the rest of your life!” The Sect Master said, “Just let me know if you need anything.”
“Honestly, she just listens to Jiang Ming alone.”
“But he’s your disciple too!”
“But that brat… You don’t know, Sect Master. He looks gentle and kind on the surface, but he’s very cunning and sly. I don’t have the confidence to make him listen to me!”
“What else can you do if you can’t even control your own disciple?”
“Alright, alright. Leave it to me!”
Both of them then ended their conversation.
The rest of the people started leaving one by one as well.
While they were leaving, their eyes were filled with admiration and wonder as they looked at Zi Linglong.
She did not hesitate even for the slightest moment when she was taking someone else’s life, but she acted as docile and obedient like a kitten in front of her Senior Brother, who was only in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
That said, they were still very surprised that Zi Linglong had ascended into the Dao Seed Realm.
Jiang Ming and his Junior Sister returned to the courtyard hand-in-hand. Suddenly, the Human Paths Record opened up before him.
Name: Zhou Tian
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty
Relationship: -77
Innate Talent: Nine Stars (Primary True Dragon Bloodline)
Status: Attacked Zi Linglong in a fit of rage after two of his followers were killed. However, he was defeated swiftly and got even angrier.. Although he was pacified by Chang Tian in the end and pretended to be the bigger man, he still harbors hatred against Zi Linglong.

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - A Plan That Can Conquer the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: A Plan That Can Conquer the World
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming ingrained Zhou Tian’s condition deeply in his heart.
Since their relationship had dropped to -77, it meant if Zhou Tian had the chance, he would kill him without any hesitation. If he hated him so much, then how about his Junior Sister who defeated him?
He must hate her to the core, right?
‘Life is so wonderful, so why must you have a death wish? Is it really bad to stay alive?’ Jiang Ming shook his head.
The pages flipped and the record of another person appeared.
Name: Cang Yun
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Primal Spirit Realm
Background: An Elder of the Great Zhou Dynasty
Relationship: 39
Innate Talent: Nine Stars
Status: Secretly protects Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince. When he witnessed Zi Linglong’s might, he exclaimed inwardly, expressing his disbelief at the emergence of a golden phoenix inside of a mountain. When he saw how exasperated Zhou Tian was after he was defeated, he sighed inwardly. Although he knew the prince wouldn’t listen to him, he still tried his best to pacify him. He told him to stay low profile and be humble since he was in a foreign land. After all, even if he was a prince, he would still be killed or assassinated if he accidentally ran into a ruthless person. At that time, even the Great Zhou Dynasty wouldn’t be able to do anything about it. Besides, if he really wanted other people to come under his command, he needed to be humble and open-minded. If he couldn’t do that, then how was he going to make other people come under his command? Wasn’t it nonsense? Sigh, I’ve done everything I needed to do. It’s up to him now!
‘It can record other people’s inner thoughts too!? Jiang Ming was amazed. He couldn’t understand how the “status” worked at all. Sometimes, it would be very short, but other times it would be very detailed.
That said, it seemed to him that this elder man known as Cang Yun was rather open-minded. It was just such a shame that he followed a shortsighted master.
While Jiang Ming was thinking, he came to the courtyard.
He made a pot of tea, poured out a cup, and handed it to his Master. After that, he sat next to his Master with his Junior Sister while waiting for his Master to start talking.
“You’ve done an awesome job today, Linglong,” Gu Hai said after sipping from the cup of tea and clearing his throat.
“Master, Junior Sister has made you proud, hasn’t she?” Jiang Ming chimed in and smiled, “The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty has a high social status, not to mention that he’s really strong. He has never been defeated ever since he stepped into Eastern Region, but what happened to him after he came to the Jiuyang Sect?
“He got his *ss kicked by my Junior Sister. From today onward, everyone will look at you from a different perspective. You must be an immortal sage for being able to raise an impressive disciple like my Junior Sister!”
“An immortal sage?” Gu Hai’s eyes glowed up, and he nodded happily. However, when he saw the expression on his disciple’s face through the corner of his eyes, his face sank. “Don’t you ever try to change the topic, kid. I’m sure that with your intelligence, you know what problem we’re going to face next, right?”
Keeping the smile on her face, Zi Linglong looked at them and listened.
“What problem?” Jiang Ming handed a cup of tea to his Junior Sister. He then lifted his own cup and took a sip before continuing. “Are you worried that Zhou Tian will come back to get his revenge? Don’t worry, I’m sure he won’t do that. After all, he’s a prince, and it will only tarnish his reputation if he really comes to attack us in secret.
“Besides, they have set up a rule from the moment they stepped into Eastern Region, and that is that the people from the older generation are prohibited from joining the fight. In this case, nobody can defeat my Junior Sister.
“If you’re talking about the people from the devil sects, then you can rest assured.
“Nobody could tell how many powerful beings exist in Eastern Region. All we can say is that there are a lot of them, and they are all hiding in the dark, waiting for the right opportunity to make a name for themselves. Nobody would dare to kill a young prodigy openly, not even the devil sects. This is because arousing a nest of hornets is the last thing they want to do!
“Therefore, just have more faith in your disciple, Master,” Jiang Ming said.
“Of course, I have faith in my disciple,” Gu Hai said, “But the Jiuyang Sect is, after all, a small sect. We can’t afford the consequences of messing with the wrong person. Besides, even if everything you said makes sense, what if they come back to get their revenge after everyone has forgotten about it?”
“At that time, my Junior Sister will have become even stronger, and I’m sure she can protect us!”
“Are you sure about that? Although it seems like she’s making a lot of progress, no one knows when she’ll stop. If that happens, what should we do? What about your Junior Sister? What about you? What about me? And what about the sect?”
“Have you forgotten about me, Master?” Jiang Ming said as he gulped the cup of tea in one sitting.
Looking at her Senior Brother, Zi Linglong was stunned. She did not know why, but it appeared to her that her Senior Brother had suddenly become very confident. He looked as if he could solve every curveball that life threw at him. She even began to wonder about the possibility of her Senior Brother coming across a certain opportunity because of her. However, she soon rejected the thought. After all, her Senior Brother had never left the mountain before.
“You?” Gu Hai scoffed. “If we have to depend on you, we might as well disband the entire sect!” He turned his head around to look at Zi Linglong and said, “In the future, if you’re challenged by other people again, can you promise me that you won’t simply kill someone like what you did today?”
Zi Linglong blinked her eyes and looked at Jiang Ming.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming nodded. “After all, we’re a righteous sect. We won’t simply go around taking other people’s lives, and we will only kill someone when we’re pushed to the corner. Also, we must not show any mercy toward our enemies!”
“Okay!” Zi Linglong nodded obediently.
Gu Hai opened his mouth and stroked his beard. He was rendered speechless. Initially, he wanted to tell Zi Linglong that she shouldn’t take someone else’s life even if they were the enemy. However, he was worried that it might upset her and make her feel disappointed in him. That said, what if she accidentally provoked a being stronger than her after killing someone?
Gu Hai was torn. He looked at Jiang Ming, who was sipping on his tea and harrumphed. “Go prepare something for me to eat. I want 32 dishes. If I don’t like any of the dishes, I’ll hit you with my whip ten times!”
Zi Linglong covered her mouth and giggled.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He rose to his feet and went into the kitchen. After all, there was nothing he could do other than follow his Master’s orders.
Seeing how obedient Jiang Ming was, Gu Hai felt delighted.
After finishing their meal, Zi Linglong took the precious medicinal herb out. It was the top-grade Jet Black Blue. The aroma it emitted could calm one’s mind and cleanse one’s thoughts. It was a good thing to use during cultivation.
Zi Linglong gave it to her Master.
Gu Hai refused to take it, but Zi Linglong insisted. In the end, he planted it in a jade flower pot and scattered a few high-grade spirit crystals around it as nutrients. He then placed it at the courtyard, and the air was instantly pervaded by a strong aroma.
Jiang Ming knew that his Master was doing this for both of them as well.
The next day, as they expected, a disciple from a family in Zhong Province came to them and challenged Zi Linglong to a fight. He was strong.
‘Should we decline the challenge? But since we accepted the challenge yesterday, it wouldn’t make sense if we refuse to accept any challenge today.
‘How about letting other disciples accept the challenge? That wouldn’t work either.
‘The challenger is a martial artist in the Dao Seed Realm, so should I send elders or First Seats to accept the challenge? Nope, nope, that’s a no-go!’ the Sect Master thought.
He could sense that someone was watching them from the dark, and he felt a chill travel down his spine. Leaving with no other options, he went to Chuyang Peak and looked for Zi Linglong.
Without a doubt, Zi Linglong defeated the challenger effortlessly.
There were challengers every day for the next three days. Jiang Ming was annoyed, let alone Zi Linglong.
After she defeated another challenger, Jiang Ming gathered up Chang Yiming, Zhang Junbao, and Huo Yun to discuss how they should deal with those challengers.
They couldn’t reject the challenge, but it would bring them even more problems if Zi Linglong kept on winning and attracting more and more attention.
How about pretending to be defeated? To lose on purpose was to humiliate others. After all, it was an open challenge.
“We’re already in the eye of the storm, and there’s nothing we can do.” Huo Yun, the First Seat of Lieyang Peak, frowned and said, “Go into seclusion? Considering those people’s attitudes, they might cause havoc in our sect to force Linglong to come out and fight them. She can’t leave the sect either.
“After all, there are so many people keeping an eye on her, and leaving the sect now is like walking straight into a snake pit. However, if we keep accepting the challenge, it will only attract more people to come and challenge her. This is hard.”
“Judging from the current situation, we can only accept the challenge,” Zhang Junbao said. “But how can we make it work in our favor?”
“Simple,” Chang Yiming said as an evil smile appeared on his chubby face, “I have a plan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - We Make the Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: We Make the Rules
Chang Yiming’s plan was simple. It was to set up an arena and select the strongest genius among them. By then, naturally, there wouldn’t be that many people coming up the mountains to disturb them.
Huo Yun was doubtful. “Is this feasible? Firstly our sect isn’t a sacred land, and secondly, we don’t have a widespread talented genius. If you set up an arena, how would anyone acknowledge us?”
Zhang Junbao agreed, “You’ve got a point there. The talented are mostly arrogant. If they came, would they be willing to wait for the other talented ones to fight for the rankings? Of course they wouldn’t. Since the ranking does not have enough acknowledgment from others, they’d rather directly challenge Linglong herself.”
“Our sect is still too weak!” Chang Yiming lamented.
Everyone kept their silence.
In the past, Mu Shuiyun had forced her way into the Jiuyang Sect just because her son died. She wanted to sacrifice the innocent disciples for her son’s burial. A few days ago, the 18th Prince of Great Zhou Dynasty did not care to get permission before barging into Chuyang Peak.
It all came down to the same thing—the sect was too weak.
Zi Linglong kept quiet the whole time, with her eyes glistening in purity, listening to the whole discussion. Seeing everyone kept quiet, she blinked and muttered, “Then what should we do?”
Zhang Junbao sighed. “Although Linglong has a high cultivation base, she’s not even in her 20s, and yet she has to face such problems. We and our Masters cannot help out much, I… I’m quite disappointed in myself. I used to proclaim myself to be a genius but when it matters the most, I cannot help out one bit.”
Huo Yun and Chang Yiming were both bitter and astringent.
Jiang Ming, who kept silent the whole time, finally spoke up. “Senior Zhang, this isn’t your fault!” He then looked at Zi Linglong and asked, “Do you have any needs for spiritual items to aid your cultivation but the sect cannot provide them?”
“There are!” Zi Linglong tilted his little head and replied earnestly, “Such as the Lunar Stone, Water Crystals, the Nine Yin Flower, Acheron Fruit, and so on!”
Zi Linglong did not hold back nor was there any need to when it came to the items she needed for her cultivation.
She could guess what her Senior Brother was planning on doing and was down for it.
Jiang Ming said, “Then we can just challenge them to a duel directly! We will say that Linglong does not want to be disturbed during her cultivation as an excuse and ask that the one who wants to challenge her to bet on spiritual items such as Lunar Stone and Water crystal if they want to challenge her!”
Chang Yiming, Huo Yun, and Zhang Junbao were all puzzled. They had never heard anything about the Lunar Stone or the Acheron Fruit. They even thought that the Lunar Stone was a stone agglomerated from the sun!
Zhang Junbao asked, “What if they do not have the spiritual items and still demand a duel?”
Jiang Ming blurted out, “Slaughter!” He made a pause before continuing. “If they want to challenge us, then they will have to abide by our rules. If they break the rules, we will just slaughter them!”
Zhang Junbao asked, “But what if they have strong backgrounds? What if the opponents are too strong for her? Can we guarantee that Linglong will emerge victorious for every duel?”
Jiang Ming replied with a smile, “If she loses even once, there won’t be anyone who will challenge her anymore. Moreover, our Sect Master has already stepped into the Primal Spirit Realm. With him looking over her from the shadows, it won’t be a problem!”
After some more discussion, the trio left.
Gu Hai, who had been sitting through the whole thing in silence, finally spoke up. He advised, “Don’t kill if you don’t really have to. We need to be humble. Only then can we go further and live freely!”
“If the enemy already forced their way to our doorsteps, how can we still back down? Do we purposely admit defeat?” Jiang Ming shook his head and added, “I think Junior Sister will not agree to this as well.”
Zi Linglong said, “Forge ahead with bravery and diligence! Only then can we continuously breakthrough! If we back down and admit defeat because of hardships, it is bad for the spirit!”
Gu Hai was baffled. “But… But…There is a high chance that we will be facing all the talented geniuses from both the Zhong Province and Eastern Region! How can we keep ourselves emerging victorious throughout the whole thing?”
Zi Linglong replied, “Losing in battle and admitting defeat are two different things! Master, you don’t have to worry about this!”
Jiang Ming said, “What you should do now is to ask if the Sect Master has any good spiritual items for the duel.”
Gu Hai sighed. “Really… the two of you! Can’t get my words into your heads anymore!” He cast a spell into the distance.
Not long after, the Sect Master arrived.
Zi Linglong said, “Sect Master, what I’ve formed is the Yang Dao Seed and fully mastered all special abilities the sect has to offer. The special abilities I gained from outside are at the brim of full mastery, and I need to duel others to win myself the spiritual items to fully grasp the Yin Sambodha.”
The Sect Master was astonished at first, before slowly turning agitated. In the end, he laughed out loud.
He went back without hesitation and took a piece of Sun Stone out of the treasure vault. It was the sect’s uncommon treasure, encased in strong fire energy.
When the Sect Master returned to Chuyang Peak, he handed over the spiritual item to Gu Hai for safekeeping. Following that, he sternly instructed Zi Linglong, “If you find yourself to be unable to win the fight, do not force yourself. Always remember!”
Zi Linglong nodded in response.
After that, they started tackling each scenario that might come up during the plan.
Jiang Ming suggested that for convenience, a mountain gate could be opened on the east side to allow straight access to Chuyang Peak. It would help to avoid each challenger from affecting the sect’s peacefulness and causing any chaos.
The Sect Master considered significantly before agreeing.
Chuyang Peak was located at the east of the sect. The Sect Master went ahead and used his great mana to build a mason staircase that extended out of the mountain. He also made a few pavilions along the way.
Following that, he erected a piece of stone tablet outside of the main gate, with the rules of the duel engraved onto it.
In Zi Linglong’s room…
Zi Linglong thought with her arms crossed, ‘I exposed my phoenix bloodline too early and caused a chain reaction, such as Mu Lei’s early death and Bai Yu’s agonized death, leaving everything in a mess!
‘Well, either way, it’s a small thing. I’ll just use this opportunity to start collecting some spiritual items that help speed up my comprehension of Yin Sambodha, forming the Yin Dao Seed. Once my Yin Dao Seed is equally strong to my Yang Dao Seed, I will be able to fuse them into the Yin-Yang Dao Seed and realize a dual cultivation foundation.’
As Zi Linglong continued pondering, she frowned. ‘But… even though my phoenix bloodline may have caused Mu Lei’s jealousy, how did it implicate Bai Yu’s death? Through all this chaos, I always felt there’s someone up there manipulating the whole thing! And I wonder who killed Bai Yu…’
She was constantly trying to unravel the whole thing, only to realize some things did not make any sense, yet she could not quite find the source of it. Thus, she continued contemplating and sat cross-legged on her bed. ‘Why am I even pondering so much over this? Given my current speed of growth, I have no one to fear. Even if there’s any incident throughout this whole thing, I can just activate the spell and expend my latent energy to directly breakthrough to the Primal Spirit Realm. By then, protecting my Senior Brother will not be a problem!’
…
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming was still on the rooftop.
He had to keep watch to avoid any unforeseen accidents.
Although he was confident that his Junior Sister would be safe and sound under his supervision, he could not stop himself from feeling worried.
The next day…
Early in the morning outside of Chuyang Peak, a man sat cross-legged on a stone beneath the stone tablet, waiting patiently. That man was Hao Chen, Shaoyang Peak’s First Seat.
The 100-feet-tall stone tablet stood there, radiating a strong aura across miles.
As morning went by, a group of young people started to be attracted.
When they saw the content engraved on the stone tablet, the blue-clad man, who was also the leader of the group, could not help but snicker. “Turning the challenge into a duel and betting on these rare spiritual items? How arrogant of the Jiuyang Sect!”
His words were echoed by others. They began discussing the whole matter.
“Being poor drives them nuts I guess. Do they really think just because of the phoenix bloodline, they are invincible and can trample over the generation? How arrogant!”
“It’s a small sect and to think that just because they defeated Zhou Tian, they are capable of racking in profits with this duel? How absurd! When compared all over Zhong Province, Zhou Tian doesn’t even rank high!”
“Coming over to challenge is just us lowering our standards and giving them some credit. Now, they make it look like it’s us trying desperately, asking them to accept the duel instead! Such humiliation!”
While they were discussing, one of them even went up and tried to smash the engraved stone tablet.
A long slashing sound echoed as the First Seat Hao Chen opened his eyes. He forced the young man to retreat with just a slash.
At the same time, he said, “This is our Jiuyang Sect’s territory. We make the rules! Come if you comply, leave if you don’t! Any attack on the stone tablet signifies waging war against the Jiuyang Sect.. I will forgive the first offense! But if there’s a second, then prepare for a battle to the death!”

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - Old Tie Follows
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Old Tie Follows
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the previous generation of the Jiuyang Sect, Hao Chen the First Seat was undeniably the number one genius.
If he were to be placed in the Sacred Land, given his talent, he would have a breakthrough to the Primal Spirit Realm, or better yet, to an even higher realm. Even so, he had already reached the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Realm.
At that moment, he was sitting beneath the stone tablet to avoid anybody from creating chaos.
“Brother,” yelled a blue-clad young man as he waved away the young man who had tried to smash the stone tablet. The man then stepped in the air pacing toward Hao Chen, clasped his hands, and said, “I am Lan Jue from the Lan clan in Zhong Province. We come over to challenge Eastern Region’s geniuses. Well, I’m here now, yet you all set up such conditions for a duel. Is this not humiliating us?”
Hao Chen eased himself at the politeness of the blue-clad young man. He explained, “Ever since the defeat of Zhou Tian, there have been challengers coming to challenge her daily, disturbing our training and being a nuisance. We can only do so to decline them! Moreover, a challenge with a wager seems to be fair”.
“This sounds reasonable!” Lan Jue nodded.
Following that, he glanced at the engraved stone tablet and frowned. “Lunar Stone, Water Crystal, Nine Yin Flower, Acheron Fruit, and Nine Tranquility Water. All these are extreme Yin spiritual items.
“Zi Linglong has the phoenix bloodline, a natural fit for the Dao of Fire. Yet today she is asking for these items. Could it be that her Dao of Fire has sublimed into the Dao of Yang? So she plans to use these waged duels to gain these spiritual items to form a Yin Dao Seed, and then fuse her Yin and Yang Dao Seeds?”
He paused before exclaiming, “Such wild ambition, boldness, and confidence!”
A young man walked over and sounded doubtful. “Brother Lan, is that so? The Yin Dao Seed hasn’t emerged for so many years, and yet she’s trying to fuse Yin and Yang Dao Seeds? I don’t believe it!”
Lan Jue said, “Neither do I. But sometimes you have no choice but to believe that there is a possibility of a miracle!”
Following that, he looked at Hao Chen and asked, “Brother, were my speculations correct?”
Hao Chen’s face remained expressionless.
Lan Jue wasn’t offended because Hao Chen didn’t respond. He then said, “Brother, you are too indifferent. You are not suitable to be guarding the mountain door, but more toward meditation! If what I said is true, then I will give Zi Linglong a big gift! Rest assured that in Zhong Province, my Lan clan, as an ancient clan, keeps our promises even though we aren’t as strong as Sacred Lands!”
At that moment, Zi Linglong paced over from the skies and gave a clenched fist bow to Hao Chen.
She then stared at Lan Jue and said bluntly, “What big gifts? If you lie to me, I will kill you here and now!”
Woosh!
Immediately after that, the top of her head started to burst out with an extreme Yang aura, formidable as it was, swaying even the skies!
She was familiar with the Lan clan. She also knew Lan Jue was a person with temperament. More importantly, he seemed to be really able to provide her the help.
Lan Jue’s pupils shrank as he gasped in astonishment. “It’s Yang Sambodha! The Fire Sambodha itself is already extremely difficult to comprehend! In this world, 99% of the population can only comprehend the branches of the Five Elements’ Sambodha, yet you managed to comprehend the Pure Sun Essence.
“Naturally, you are already a level above normal people! I commend you! Even the Holy Sons and Holy Daughters from the Sacred Lands hold no candle against you. But the thing is, aren’t you worried that you might attract problems out of people’s jealousy?”
Zi Linglong replied indifferently, “Then I’ll just kill them!”
Lan Jue clenched his hand in respect. “Great! Listing down all the items you need is to let them know, akin to showing everyone your cards. Not concealing anything, but showing your ambitious intent. That’s really a show of boldness and confidence. Seems you are trying to mold a strong will into yourself!”
“You seem to have some wisdom in you! Where’s my big gift?” demanded Zi Linglong.
Lan Jue laughed. “These extreme Yin spiritual items that you need are all very rare. If you passively wait for them, I’m not sure how long it will take you to collect even one of them. Rather, why not be aggressive about it? Do you mind if we spread the news of your Yang Sambodha and you trying to form a Yin Dao Seed?”
Zi Linglong replied, “No, I don’t!”
Lan Jue said, “That’s easy then! Anyhow, since I’m already here, I’ll have to check your skills.”
Zi Linglong accepted his challenge as she replied, “Come on!”
At that moment, she extended her body to a height of thousands of meters.
Lan Jue was ecstatic.
Above the Chuyang Sect…
Jiang Ming gazed afar and couldn’t help but scowl. Inexplicably, he felt a little unhappy and called up his Human Path Records.
Name: Lan Jue
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Direct disciple of the secluded Lan clan in Zhong Province (The Lan clan is on par with the first-tier sects)
Relationship: 15
Innate talent: Nine Stars (Wind Spirit Body)
Status: Person of influence in Zhong Province, came to have a look after overhearing about Zi Linglong of the Jiuyang Sect. He knows she is the embodiment of the phoenix bloodline and that she defeated Zhou Tian.
When Jiang Ming read the simple contents, he thought Lan Jue could possibly reach the Extreme Path Realm with his considerably high Nine Stars innate talent. He also shook his head, speechless, when he learned about the Lan clan, which was a clan on par with first-tier sects!
Zhong Province was without a doubt the center of everything. It had many talents, a handful of Sacred Lands, and countless forces that anyone coming from the province would be of great background.
He raised his head to see his Junior Sister had already started sparring with the opponent. She defeated Lan Jue in the glimpse of an eye.
Jiang Meng smiled. “That’s my little girl, truly exceptional!”
When he took another look at his Human Path Records, he realized that Lan Jue’s status had more content now.
Status: He lost his challenge against Zi Linglong. He sent out messages to all the young geniuses in Zhong Province, saying that Zi Linglong has formed the Yang Dao Seed and is capable of overwhelming those of the same generation.
Jiang Meng thought, ‘Is he trying to place Junior Sister against the world?’ At that moment, he had the thought of killing this person.
At the end of the battle, Zi Linglong landed on Chuyang Peak. When she saw Lan Jue still following her, she couldn’t help but frown. “Are you not leaving?”
Lan Jue said, “The champions of the world will be gathering here. Why would I leave? In any case, I’ve given you my help. Aren’t you going to invite me to your mountain peak for a drink?”
Zhi Long was absolutely indifferent when she replied, “The mountain peak does not welcome anyone!”
Meanwhile, she stroked the air with her sword with a flick of her wrist. She seemed to be cutting the void in half.
Lan Jue’s expression quickly changed, and he stopped in his tracks.
He gnashed his teeth and still gave it a try. “What about the foot of the mountain?”
Zi Linglong did not reply and went directly up to the mountain peak, back to her Senior Brother.
She sat on the rooftop and chatted with her Senior Brother.
“Senior Brother, are you unhappy?”
“I feel the kid is thick-skinned.”
“Senior Brother, are you worried that we will be chummy together?”
“You only need a glance to see that he is not a good person. Pay less attention to him.”
Zi Linglong hugged Jiang Ming’s arm as she promised, “Sure, I will listen to you, Senior Brother. From now on, no men can come atop the mountain, not even women!”
“Won’t that make us seem disrespectful?”
“They are the ones who are disrespectful. But my Senior Brother is always respectful!”
At the bottom of the mountain…
Lan Jue landed beside the stone tablet.
A member of the Lan clan asked, “Brother Lan, you lost just like that? You are someone who can compete with a Holy Son! And yet you lost so easily?”
Lan Jue shuddered. “She’s too exceptional, I can’t do much!”
“A defeat is a defeat, but she didn’t even invite you up the mountain?”
Lan Jue cleared his throat as a reply.
“Brother Lan, since they don’t welcome us, let’s just leave.”
“I plan on staying here. There’s going to be a scene soon.”
“Brother Lan, you aren’t thinking of snubbing up to her, are you?”
“Scram you imbecile!
In an inn located in Shui Province…
A beautiful young lady was surrounded by many handsome men. She suddenly received a message: Zi Linglong, phoenix bloodline, formed Yang Dao Seed, defeated Zhou Tian, wagering on duels!
The young lady thought, ‘Such a peculiar lady! Let’s see if I can make her submit!’
Not long after, the young lady paced away in the air.
…
A young man sat cross-legged atop of a mountain. He grasped onto the incoming message, and his eyes glistened. ‘What an interesting message from Lan Jue! If this can really gather the geniuses from Zhong Province and Eastern Region, maybe I can try giving them a ranking!’
…
The current Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect had also received the message. He was surprised at the emergence of such a talent in Eastern Region. Hence, he intended to keep her as his maidservant.
Soon, he walked out of the sect, heading toward the Jiuyang Sect.
Meanwhile, Old Tie saw him and followed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - Immortal Treasure, F*cking Interesting
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Immortal Treasure, F*cking Interesting
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
There was a mountain peak on the side of the stone tablet. It had now been used as a welcoming area, also known as the Reception Peak for it had gathered a large number of experts in just about 10 days. Even the disciples of the Jiuyang Sect had to come over to serve.
Zi Linglong, as the master of Reception Peak, simply entertained them. Hao Chen the First Seat sat cross-legged in a corner, cultivating. Meanwhile, the Sect Master was overwatching from afar.
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming called up his Human Path Records to check on the experts one after another.
Name: He Fang (Son of Prophet)
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Contemporary representative of the Yantian Sect
Relationship: 45
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Violet Star Body)
Status: He came to Eastern Region to collect data about geniuses under the command of his Master. After receiving the message from Lan Jue, he came to meet Zi Linglong. At the same time, he thought of creating a Genius Ranking Board. He is currently assisting Zi Linglong in entertaining guests.
Jiang Ming had heard about the Yantian Sect. He knew it was another Sacred Land in Zhong Province and was well-known among top-notch forces. The sect specialized in divination and fortune-telling. Given its detached status, it generally did not participate in disputes. In addition, each generation had a representative, which was equivalent to a Holy Son, going around. They would call themselves the Son of Prophet.
Jiang Ming pondered, ‘He’s indeed ambitious in creating a Genius Ranking Board! If he really puts his thoughts into action, I bet there’ll be a mess!’
With the presence of countless geniuses from many Sacred Lands, they would only laugh when they heard each other’s names. However, they would definitely compete if they were really ranked.
Jiang Ming flipped the page.
Name: Xi Yao
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: The Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect in Zhong Province
Relationship: 26
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Cold Moon Body)
Status: She came to meet Eastern Region’s geniuses and to chasten herself. At the same time, she is looking for the legendary immortal treasure. She came because she was attracted by the news of Zi Linglong embodying the phoenix bloodline but looking for extreme Yin items. She also wishes to make Zi Linglong submit to her.
Jiang Ming could not help but shake his head as he exclaimed to himself, ‘Another person from a Sacred Land, with Ten Stars innate talent!’
He continued murmuring to himself, “With her Cold Moon Body, does she also wish to comprehend the Dao of Yin? She wants to make Junior Sister submit to her? Hah! She’s too ambitious.
“That immortal treasure? Do immortals really exist?’
In the end, he just shook his head smiling before he went on to the next person.
Name: Lin Han
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect
Relationship: 9
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Mystic Ice Body)
Status: Since the death of Holy Son Bai Yu, two Extreme Path experts from the Infinite Alchemy Pavillion came to create chaos by slaughtering thousands of outer court disciples. Although he does not believe that his sect’s experts would kill Bai Yu, he dares not go out to avoid being killed by Old Tie.
At the end of the day, the Qingyun Sect experts were annoyed and fought with them for 32 days before a temporary reconciliation was made. He was delighted at the news that Zi Linglong embodied phoenix bloodline in the Jiuyang Sect and that she had actually managed to comprehend the Dao of Yang. He wanted Zi Linglong to submit to him.
Following that, he could utilize her bloodline to transmute his body into the Icy Fire Daoist Body and might even comprehend the Yin-Yang Dao Seed.
He left the Qingyun Sect with the belief that his sect’s experts would protect him from Old Tie’s attack!
Jiang Ming felt a headache at Lin Han’s intention. His eyes filled with killing intent as he thought, ‘Previously, there were the arrogant Mu Lei and his mother, Mu Shuiyun. Now, this new Holy Son also dares to have ill intention toward my Junior Sister! I wonder if these Holy Sons and Holy Daughters are arrogant just because their Qingyun Sect is the only Sacred Land in Eastern Region…’
Jiang Ming added Lin Han’s name onto his killing list and flipped the page again.
Name: Mo Lin
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect
Relationship: -15
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Dark Devil Body)
Status: The gathering of geniuses in Eastern Region has formed unspoken rules that no one from the older generation can intervene in the matches among young people. Thus, he thought of using this great opportunity to make a public appearance. He wants to see others’ reactions and attitudes so that he can get ready for the devil sects’ thorough resurgence.
Mo Lin had just defeated the 18th Prince of Great Zhou. When he heard from the prince about the specialty of Zi Linglong, he was delighted. Hence, he came over. He also wanted to capture her to be his cauldron and steal her bloodline so that he might transmute his body into the Light-Dark Body.
If it worked, he certainly could become a Great Holy Son of all six devil sects. Following that, he could accomplish his dream of becoming the king of kings by uniting all six devil sects and making all humans, devils, and demons submit to him!
When Jiang Ming read Mo Lin’s status information, he grinned. “What a d*mn ambitious guy!” He could not help but despise Mo Lin’s ambition to unite the world as he recalled the boastful keyboard warriors in his past life.
In fact, Jiang Ming abhorred devil sects. He told himself to kill Mo Lin so that he will realize his great ambition in Hades instead. But when he recalled Mo Lin’s intention to capture his Junior Sister, he changed his mind. He wanted Mo Lin’s soul scattered as well!
Of course, he wanted to slaughter the Yinmo Sect’s spies in his Jiuyang Sect too. Nonetheless, he needed them to check on Yinmo Sect’s movement and to be alerted in advance just in case they decided an attack against the Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming was also curious how Mo Lin could sublime himself and transmute his body into a Light-Dark Body!
He shuddered as he learned about these geniuses with innate talent of ten stars. More troublesomely was them having ill intention toward his Junior Sister.
At that moment, Jiang Ming abruptly turned his head. He saw a tall and imposing old man suddenly appear sitting leisurely on the cane chair next to him. His heart missed a beat. He thought that the old man must be stronger than an expert of the Paradis Realm because of his ability to cross the defensive Formation on Chuyang Peak and make a sudden appearance without his knowing.
Jiang Ming prepared the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card given by the system before standing up, tidying up himself, and greeting, “Senior!”
Meanwhile, he called up the Human Path Records!
Name: Tie Dan (Generally known as Old Tie)
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: One of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s Supreme Elders
Relationship: 45
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Starburst Fire Body)
Status: He was furious when he learned about the death of Holy Son Bai Yu in Eastern Region. He took his Explosive Hammer to the Qingyun Sect and hammered the sect even though he knew the sect might be innocent. He felt slight relief after killing numerous disciples and receiving some compensation as a token of apology because the Qingyun Sect, being the strongest in Eastern Region, failed to ensure the safety of his Holy Son. However, he failed to obtain a top-grade Dao Vessel. While secretly investigating the culprit, he continued urging the Qingyun Sect for a proper explanation.
When he saw the Qingyun Sect’s Holy Son, he wanted to capture him. But he was stopped by the Qingyun Sect’s Extreme Path expert. Thus, he followed after him to the Jiuyang Sect instead. Upon arrival, he heard about Zi Linglong, who was embodied with phoenix bloodline and had comprehended Yang Sambodha. He was delighted.
He felt Zi Linglong should be a disciple of his Infinite Alchemy Pavilion because she was no weaker than the contemporary Holy Daughter. Not wanting to lose the opportunity, he came to further understand the situation and find ways to take her back for training.
Jiang Ming felt his heart skip a beat when he learned that the old man was an Extreme Path expert from the Infinite Pavilion Realm. Fortunately, he knew the old man was not here to take revenge on him.
Anyway, when he saw the word ‘haha’ in the Status shown in the system, he thought it was f*cking interesting.
Still, when he realized the fact that the old man was up to targeting his Junior Sister, he felt very helpless. At the same time, he showed no expression and pondered, ‘Shall I take Junior Sister away directly, kill him by surprise with the Mana Sealing Chessboard or use the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card?’

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - Another Extreme Path Expert; The Senior Brother Acknowledged by All
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Another Extreme Path Expert; The Senior Brother Acknowledged by All
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming felt surprised but not afraid at the sudden appearance of Old Tie. But he, as a young man, had to be polite by greeting Old Tie.
Old Tie friendly replied as he waved, “Don’t mention it! As I come directly without invitation, I’m disturbing you instead!”
“It’s my honor that you are here!” Jiang Ming said as he sat down. He then asked with confusion, “But why don’t you go there, where the geniuses are gathering?”
“Can you identify their specialty?”
“No, I can’t! I can’t even identify my Junior Sister’s, what’s more those geniuses’!”
“It’s normal that you can’t! A few of them are top-notch geniuses. They will become very prominent figures in the future. The rest are not bad either. They will be as good as your Sect Master!”
Jiang Ming exclaimed, “They are so amazing?”
Old Tie explained, “If we are to rate them with the five fingers, whereby the best gets five fingers, they can get two fingers.” He suddenly squinted with a smile. “You’re not bad either. At this young age, you are already at the peak of the Foundation Establishment Realm!”
Jiang Ming humbly replied, “Thank you. But I’m still far behind when compared to them!”
Old Tie said mysteriously, “Do you want to be like one of them? It’s very simple. All you need to do is to come to my Infinite Alchemy Pavilion together with your Junior Sister. You’ll definitely become a Primal Spirit expert in the future!”
Jiang Ming acted as though he was very surprised. “Infinite Alchemy Pavilion? Is it the legendary Sacred Land of Zhong Province? Senior, what’s your relationship with Infinite Alchemy Pavilion?”
Old Tie smiled brightly as he said, “I’m an Elder there. When you two get there, your Junior Sister will be placed in a position comparable to the Holy Daughter. Meanwhile, you will be trained as a core disciple.”
Jiang Ming rubbed his hands. He looked as though he was aspiring and at the same time, fidgeted. “Err… This is indeed my honor to be selected—”
A figure approached them before he could finish his sentence. As soon as he arrived, he snorted. “Old Tie, how dare you snatch people from my Eastern Region!”
He was an old man with white hair. But his face looked like a baby, and his eyes were brimming with vigor. He turned to Jiang Ming and said, “We have the Qingyun Sect as the Sacred Land in Eastern Region too. Since we were born and grew up in Eastern Region, we shouldn’t leave easily. If you and your Junior Sister need better cultivation resources, just come over to my Qingyun Sect. I can even make the decision to recognize your Junior Sister as our Holy Daughter directly!”
Old Tie was enraged and growled, “Qing Fengzi, how dare you! We haven’t settled our issue yet, and you’re now here trying to snatch people away from me!”
Qing Fengzi smirked. “This is a very different matter. Moreover, we’re now at the Jiuyang Sect, which is not your territory. You’ve already come here without invitation, don’t tell me you want to destroy this place and snatch people as well?”
Old Tie retorted, “Your Qingyun Sect’s Holy Son is out of the sect! But the soul of my Holy Son is still crying for injustice!”
Qing Fengzi’s face slightly darkened.
Jiang Ming was listening silently. Occasionally, he blinked his eyes as though he was truly innocent.
While listening to the conversation, he also called up the Human Path Records to check on the old man called Qing Fengzi.
Name: Yang Feng (Qing Fengzi)
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: One of the Supreme Elders of the Qingyun Sect in Eastern Region
Relationship: 32
Innate talent: Ten Stars
Status: When Old Tie was making a fuss in the Qingyun Sect, he was forced to stop his cultivation to deal with him together with a few other Supreme Elders! Based on Old Tie’s accusation, he conducted an investigation in the sect with the help of various special abilities and Dao Vessels and concluded that the murderer was not a member of the sect. Thus, he shifted his focus of investigation outside of the sect and even utilized all resources the sect had but to no avail. In the end, he could only attribute it to the devil sects; plot.
The sect was facing a predicament with various issues occurring simultaneously. Examples were the forced entanglement with the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, the Bishui Sect’s invasion, the almost full resurgence of the Yinmo Sect, and the Red Mountain Palace’s plot. Unexpectedly, he felt that it was an opportunity and was prepared to take advantage of these issues to eradicate all disobedient forces in Eastern Region!
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat while reading the status. The old man was not merely an Extreme Path expert but also knew about the Yinmo Sect and Red Mountain Palace, and perhaps, the situation of the Bishui Sect too.
The amount of information the old man knew made Jiang Ming admire the power of the Qingyun Sect’s information network. He also marveled at the old man’s confidence in utilizing external forces to control other forces in Eastern Region. Hence, he presumed the Qingyun Sect should be capable of handling both the Yinmo Sect and Red Mountain Palace.
While reading, Jiang Ming did not forget to brew a pot of tea. He meticulously poured two cups of tea with his ignorant expression and longing eyes while listening to the duo’s conversation. When he served, he politely said, “Enjoy your tea!”
Old Tie nodded in approval as he praised, “Indeed a good boy!” Then he took up a cup of tea and had a sip before he sneered at Qing Fengzi. “Unlike some people who never invited me for a sip of hot tea since I’ve come to Eastern Region from afar!”
Following that, he threw a clay bottle toward Jiang Ming while saying, “It’s by luck that I receive your hospitality and drink your tea. This is the Extreme Primal Pill for you. Take it after your successful breakthrough to the Golden Core Realm. It will help you to go further into the Golden Core’s extreme state!”
Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed it. He appreciated it with an excited expression. “Thank you, Senior!”
He then murmured, “It’s the Golden Core’s extreme state that not many disciples of our Jiuyang Sect have ever achieved in history! I can’t believe that I’m going to be like one of the few geniuses soon! Oh my, I’m so blessed. Nope, it should be the grace of the Senior!”
Old Tie could not help but smile at Jiang Ming’s response.
Qing Fengzi also took a sip of the tea and said, “All disciples of Eastern Region are good and kind! Kid, beware of this old fella. He is here to lure you away! Anyway, I shall give you something in return for your tea.”
He took out a clay bottle containing a pill and threw it at Jiang Ming. “This is the Divine Source Pill. Take it after you break through to the Golden Core’s extreme state. It will help you to expand your sea of consciousness to break through to the Purple Mansion Realm!”
Jiang Ming hastily reached out, grabbing the bottle. He was so excited that his neck turned red when he said, “Thank you, Senior! Thank you! With these two medicinal pills, I can directly reach the Purple Mansion Realm! Gosh, am I dreaming?”
His excited expression seemed to carry a hint of holding back his laughter. In fact, he rolled his eyes within himself. ‘They’ve been too generous to give Extreme Prima Pill and Divine Source Pill! I wonder whether they’d still be this generous if they learned that I’m the murderer of Inifinite Alchemy Pavilion’s Holy Son and that I framed the Qingyun Sect, as well as the murderer of Mu Lei and Mu Shuiyun! I think they will strike me to death instead!’
Jiang Ming meticulously kept those pills before he left to take some spiritual fruits to serve. At the same time, he had the urge to take out the Mana Sealing Chessboard when they were unaware, wondering if they would be sucked in. In the end, he forcefully suppressed his intention.
He took a glance at the mountain peak in the distance and rubbed his head as he asked, “Seniors, there are already many geniuses gathered there, but why aren’t they starting their battles yet? Are they not planning to compete with each other while training and refining themselves?”
“Every genius feels they are invincible. At the same time, they are looking for a match to help them grow. That’s their main reason for gathering there. The reason they haven’t started their battle is that they are waiting for a man,” Old Tie replied.
At the same time, Qing Fengzi nodded and hints of dignity appeared in his eyes.
“Let them wait together? I heard from my Junior Sister that among them are Holy Sons and Holy Daughters. Who’s so capable of making them wait patiently?” Jiang Ming asked, amazed.
In fact, he was really surprised.
Old Tie replied frankly, “Senior Brother! The Senior Brother all of them have acknowledged!”

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - Tianyuan School, Immortal Fetus, Golden Heavenly Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Tianyuan School, Immortal Fetus, Golden Heavenly Path
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The two did not reveal the background of the so-called Senior Brother.
Jiang Ming was not in a rush either. He would learn about him from his Human Path Records later when the Senior Brother got here.
He gradually calmed down from the uneasiness and nervousness he had at the start.
Old Tie realized the changes in Jiang Ming and asked with a smile, “Are you no longer afraid?”
“Since both of you are the seniors of Sacred Lands, and also kind-hearted, you won’t bully a kid like me. Thus, I’m no longer that nervous,” Jiang Ming replied with an innocent smile.
“Pretty good mindfulness of yours!” Qing Fengzi complimented.
Jiang Ming smiled in response before he abruptly asked seriously, “Seniors, I know the innate talent of my Junior Sister is incredible. But you wouldn’t take her away by force, would you?”
“As an upright man, I definitely won’t use force on the younger generation. Moreover, even though your Junior Sister has good innate talent, it’s merely good for people like us,” said Old Tie squarely.
Qing Fengzi nodded. “Yes. Kid, there are too many highly-gifted prodigies in this world, but how many succeeded? The number is extremely low because most of them failed. Therefore, most of the time we’d only appreciate those gifted prodigies, unwilling to see their talents being buried underground.”
“In this case, what type of innate talent would truly move people like you?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Immortal Fetus!”
“Immortal Fetus!”
The two gave the same answer.
“What’s the Immortal Fetus?”
At that moment, none of them replied. Instead, they suddenly looked toward the southwest.
A young man could be seen pacing over. He stepped into darkness while his head radiated rays of light. Each stride he took brought him 1,000 miles away. He looked as if he was the son of god in the wind.
In just a short moment, he had arrived at the outer region of Chuyang Peak.
He looked like an outstanding gentleman in his white robe with his sleeves fluttering. He was surrounded by black and white streams of lights with a gentle smile on his face.
As soon as he stopped, he bowed toward the two old men.
Both Old Tie and Qing Fengzi nodded in return.
Following that, the young man cast a smile at Jiang Ming before heading to Reception Peak.
At that moment, Old Tie introduced, “He’s the Senior Brother. Nobody should look down on him even though his cultivation base is currently pretty low.”
“He’s an Immortal Fetus! Provided he survives, he can easily reach our level!” Qing Fengzi sighed.
Old Tie nodded. “Whenever such a person appeared in the past, they’d often have great fortune and great changes in life. Perhaps the resurgence of all six devil sects is his misfortune. Nevertheless, due to his very strong background, the devil sects may refrain from attacking him.”
Qing Fengzi shook his head in disagreement. “That’s difficult to say. The six devil sects are incredibly mysterious and unscrupulous. Perhaps, a devil is currently watching, ready to capture to refine him, turn him into a doppelganger, or absorb his fortune.”
“I’m afraid that’s what you have in mind!”
“Huh! Do I have to? I think that’s what you have in your mind. Given your Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s skills, I think you can create an unprecedented item by using an Immortal Fetus as a material. Can you withstand the temptation?”
“F*ck off! I’m absolutely a righteous man. I don’t have such nasty thoughts as you!”
The duo bickered.
If they were not on Chuyang Peak, they might fling their clothes, initiating a fair and intense battle.
On Reception Peak…
Many geniuses came out welcoming the white-clad young man.
He clenched his fist and greeted apologetically, “Ladies and gentlemen, I heard that you all are meeting here for a battle of geniuses. I was looking forward to it, so I contacted the Son of Prophet and asked you all to wait. Thank you for your willingness to wait!”
The Son of Prophet laughed. “Senior Brother, since you’re here in Eastern Region, leaving you out would be a great sin. Moreover, we also wish to witness your peerless talent.”
The others agreed.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong was seen quietly standing afar. At that moment, a touch of coldness flashed across her eyes, but she immediately concealed it.
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Records to check on this man, the so-called Senior Brother.
Name: Tian Ci
Race: Immortal
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Contemporary Senior Brother of the Tianyuan School (Chenguang Immortal Mansion)
Relationship: 12
Innate talent: Immortal (Immortal Fetus, a reincarnated wisp of immortal soul)
Status: The broken immortal soul, which carried the golden heavenly path, and transformed into an Immortal Fetus, descended to the earthly world with a mission. Once the immortal soul awakens and his memory is restored, he will certainly set off a great change.
Currently cultivating in the Tianyuan School. He could improve himself quickly because he had amazing talent, a strong physique, and invincible special abilities. He was the best among geniuses in the school; hence, the most promising to become invincible in his generation.
He had his breakthrough to the 9th Stage of the Golden Core realm when he was 20 years old, comprehended Light Sambodha and Dark Sambodha when he was 25 and 30 respectively, and managed to form the Light Dao Seed and Dark Dao Seed two years later.
He was ambitious to fuse both Light Dao Seed and Dark Dao Seed but to no avail.
The news of Holy Son Bai Yu’s death gave rise to much discussion in Zhong Province. Thus, he thought of coming to Eastern Region for an earthly cultivation, to find a way to fuse the Light and Dark Dao Seeds.
He also heard Zi Linglong from the Jiuyang Sect had the phoenix bloodline and had comprehended Yang Sambodha and formed the Yang Dao Seed. He presumed Zi Linglong intended to fuse the Yin and Yang Dao Seeds because she was looking for Yin-related items. Hence, he came with a wish of having a light-bulb moment.
Jiang Ming was bewildered by Tian Ci’s race. He never thought that immortals could be categorized as a race.
He had also heard about the Tianyuan School. It was the oldest school, no weaker than any Sacred Lands. Still, nobody knew how strong its foundation was.
He pondered on the innate talent of immortal, Immortal Fetus, and immortal soul of reincarnation. He felt bizarre to see the term reincarnation!
Hiang Ming felt a headache when he saw Tian Ci had a background related to the Chenguang Immortal Mansion and his status, which stated ‘carried the golden heavenly path, descended to the earthly world with a mission’.
Besides, he realized that the system gave Tian Ci a relatively detailed introduction.
Tian Ci was indeed amazing. After all, he was capable of comprehending two strong Sambodhas, the Light Sambodha and Dark Sambodha, before 30 years old.
Of course, Jiang Ming thought that he was still incomparable to his Junior Sister, let alone himself!
He sighed to himself. ‘It should be quite easy for Tian Ci to fuse the Light and Dark Dao Seeds. After all, with an Immortal Fetus, he should be strong in both physique and comprehension. F*ck! Before I can be invincible in the human world, this immortal had to make his appearance!’
He knew a strong guardian must be protecting Tian Ci.
He also realized that his Junior Sister, Tian Ci, and he, all had unrated immortal innate talent. He wondered whether immortal innate talent was equally strong. But because he could not prove it for the time being, he could only suppress it.
Jiang Ming thought, ‘Fortunately, he’s not really after Junior Sister.’ He was more or less relieved.
He also decided that he would not descend the mountain whenever possible in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - The Might of the Empress
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: The Might of the Empress
Jiang Ming felt he had learned something new today.
The two men beside him were his enemies, and they were stronger than him. If each of them knew the real situation, they would kill him without any hesitation. However, they were talking happily and even gave him gifts.
There were several geniuses with ten-star innate talent on Reception Peak. Some of them were Immortal Fetuses as well.
Jiang Ming initially thought he would need to wait for at least 100 years before he could see such a scene. However, it was happening before him now.
Jiang Ming even had an impulse to see what would happen if he killed all of the people here.
Of course, it was just an evil thought messing with his brain.
“It’s about to start!” Old Tie stood up and looked toward Reception Peak. “This is so exciting!”
“It’s understandable. After all, you wouldn’t be able to see something like this in 100 years,” Qing Fengzi said as he nodded.
The fight between geniuses was not all about who was stronger, but it was also about who had more luck.
“It’s such a shame that you’re too weak.” Old Tie shook his head after he took a look at Jiang Ming. “For us, they’re just our juniors. But for you, you might not even be able to see their movements.”
“It’s fine. I’m here for the show only,” Jiang Ming replied, offering him a grin.
In the meantime, on the peak next to Reception Peak…
There were a dozen people there. All of them were the top martial artists in the Jiuyang Sect. Even Gu Hai was there as well.
“I only realize how weak our disciples are after seeing them!” Yin Yue lamented. “I can feel that those young people can defeat me, not to mention those Holy Sons and Holy Daughters.”
“Well, they’re the geniuses from Zhong Province and Eastern Region.” Gu Hai smiled. “Besides, Linglong is not any weaker than them.”
“You’re right. Given our Jiuyang Sect’s condition and resources, it’s really fortunate that we could have such an extraordinary genius.” Yin Yue smiled. “Look over there. Do you know those two fellows on Chuyang Peak?”
“Nope, I don’t know them,” Gu Hai replied as he shook his head. Then, he frowned and continued. “Although nothing seems to have changed on Chuyang Peak, it’s guarded by a formation. The fact that they could come here without any problems shows they are martial artists beyond the Primal Spirit Realm.”
“Are you not going back to check on them?”
“Nope. Definitely not. I assume they’re here to watch the battle between the geniuses, so it would be bad if I went back and disturbed them. If they harbor any malicious intent, there’s nothing I can do even if I go there.”
“Well, I guess you’re right.”
Both of them ended their conversation and looked toward Reception Peak.
The atmosphere there had become even livelier.
“Today, not only all geniuses from Zhong Province and Eastern Region are gathered here, but Senior Brother is here with us as well. It brings this self-organized gathering to a higher level, and it can be called the battle between the Proud Children!” said a young man in a blue robe.
After he had greeted the crowd, he went up to Zi Linglong and continued. “I’ll do the honors and start the first battle! I, Tan Hao from Zhong Province, challenge Zi Linglong to a battle!”
“So what’s your bet?” Zi Linglong said plainly.
“Bet?” Tan Hao was stunned for a moment before saying seriously, “The objective of this event is to improve our skills, as well as to exchange experience regarding our cultivation methods. It will be remembered for ages. Don’t you think it’s a little bit inappropriate to talk about bets at a grand event like this one?”
Zi Linglong lifted her head and glanced at the man. Then, she said, “I never enjoyed fighting. However, each and every one of you came to the Jiuyang Sect and challenged me to a battle. The Jiuyang Sect doesn’t dare to go against you because of your background, so I had no other choice but to stop my cultivation and accept your challenges. If you want to fight me, I have a condition. If you accept it, then I’ll fight you. If you refuse to accept it, then keep your mouth shut and sit down!”
She paused for a moment and added, “The Jiuyang Sect doesn’t have anything better to offer than the Sun Stone. What I need are extreme Yin objects, and I’ve already written them down on the stone tablet!”
She closed her eyes upon saying that.
Tan Hao’s face sank. Some people’s faces were livid with rage, while others were chuckling.
Tian Ci took a step forward and said gently, “Junior Sister Linglong, this is a grand event between the geniuses. Each and every one of us here has mastered our own cultivation method. Besides, this is a great opportunity for us to share our knowledge and to grow together, so why should we sacrifice the big for the small?”
Zi Linglong said without opening her eyes, “If that’s all that you want, then go somewhere else.”
Tian Ci’s eyebrows twitched as his face turned red with embarrassment.
“How dare you!’ Tan Hao shouted, “How dare you talk like that to my eldest senior brother?”
Clank!
He stretched his arm out, and a sword appeared in his hand. At that moment, the ground shook, and the aura around him changed. He seemed to have become one with Reception Peak, and he could draw the power from the ground around him.
“He’s your eldest senior brother, not mine,” Zi Linglong said as she opened her eyes. Her gaze was sharp as lighting, and she said, “If you’re not accepting the bet, then get lost!”
“I’m going to kill you today!” Tan Hao charged at Zi Linglong.
Amongst the crowd, regardless of Xi Yao, the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect, or the Son of Prophet from the Yantian Sect, even Mo Lin, the Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect, remained silent. They had no intention of stopping Tan Hao.
“Why must we fight each other?” Tian Ci sighed.
Lin Han, the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect, glanced at him coldly and smirked.
Pfft!
In the meantime, Zi Linglong summoned a crimson sword into her hand. She shattered Tan Hao’s sword energy in an instant, and her sword energy kept traveling forward until it cut off her opponent’s left arm.
After that, she delivered a palm strike at him and sent him flying away.
“As the host of the event, I’ll spare his life this time. However, if there is another person who acts like him, I’ll show them no mercy!” Zi Linglong stabbed her sword beside her and glanced around at the people. “If you don’t agree with my condition, then leave!”
After that, she closed her eyes again.
Suddenly, Tan Hao’s angry voice belted out from the distance. “How dare you cut my arm off, Zi Linglong!? I’m going to kill you!”
He was furious, and his killing intent was so thick the sky around him had changed.
Swooosh!
Zi Linglong appeared right before him without giving him any moment to react. She stared at him icily and crushed Tan Hao’s special ability in one strike. She then conjured up an invisible rope to entangle Tan Hao with the power of the universe.
Clank!
Her sword energy glowed. Carrying the power that could split the sky, she slashed at Tan Hao, cutting him in half.
After that, she turned around and left.
A moment later, a ray of light came out of Tan Hao’s stiffened body. His body was split into two, and he plunged into the ground below.
Tan Hao was dead.
It had happened so fast that Tian Ci still could not come around to his senses even after Tan Hao was dead.
Zi Linglong returned to her seat and stabbed her sword in the ground beside her.
‘I memory serves me well, Tan Hao is a descendant from a second-rated family in Zhong Province. The strongest of his family is in the Primal Spirit Realm, yet he has the nerves to act like an *sshole here. He deserved to die!’ she thought.
Nobody cared about Tan Hao’s death.
“Well done, Linglong,” Xi Yao walked across the air with a smile. Stars were glowing around her which made her look ethereally pretty.
She waved her hand, and a Moon Cloud Flower appeared before her. She gave it to Zi Linglong and said, “Although this flower is not an extreme Yin object, it’s still a rare Yin spiritual item. I have no use of it anymore, so I’m giving it to you as a gift.”
Zi Linglong took a look at the Moon Cloud Flower in front of her and then turned to Xi Yao. A smile blossomed across her face as she said, “Thank you, Senior Sister. After you!”
She grabbed the sword with her hand and flew into the sky.
“It’s my pleasure!” Xi Yan followed after Zi Linglong..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - Light and Dark Barrier; Screeching Phoenix; One-sided Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Light and Dark Barrier; Screeching Phoenix; One-sided Fight
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Above the cloud, the wind howled.
Both Zi Linglong and Xi Yao were standing opposite each other. The aura they exuded was so powerful it seemed as if a barrier had appeared around them, causing the wind to be repelled a hundred meters away.
“I have the Cold Moon Body, and my greatest wish is to comprehend the Dao of Extreme Yin, but it’s a near-impossible feat,” Xi Yao said.
Snowflakes began to appear on her left and ripples on her right. There were stars on top of her head, and a crescent moon was taking shape behind her back. She looked just like a goddess from heaven.
“I’ve comprehended the Frost Sambodha, the Moon Sambodha, the Stellar Sambodha, and the Water Sambodha. Even though I have formed the corresponding Dao Seeds, I didn’t stop. I want to break the boundary and ascend to a higher level, yet I have no clue how to do it! After seeing that you’ve comprehended that Dao of Yang, which happens to be my weakness, I’m thinking of borrowing your hands to push me to the limit so that I can realize my potential!”
“I’m comprehending the Dao of Extreme Yin as well, and this is a good opportunity for both of us to share our knowledge!” Zi Linglong did not use her weapon, yet there were different kinds of fires such as the wood fire, the stone fire, the thunder fire, and the hell fire behind her back.
They started the fight without saying anything.
Freezing ice and blazing fire were raging through the sky. The exchange between the two was not intense, but rather, it was quite entertaining. They performed all sorts of special abilities and Dao rhythms that they knew. On top of that, both were stunningly gorgeous, and the way they moved in the sky gave people the impression they were dancing. Therefore, it was difficult for people to look at them without being immersed in them.
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming and the other two felt proud of Zi Linglong after seeing her slaying Tan Hao and fighting toe-to-toe with Xi Yao.
“Zi Linglong’s so young, yet she has already ascended into the Dao Seed Realm. Not only that, but she has also comprehended the Dao of Yang and can hold herself against Xi Yao, a Holy Daughter. She’s truly exceptional, and I can say that she’s even better than Tian Ci!” Old Tie said, his eyes glowing with delight and admiration.
“Judging from her actions and her words, I can see that she’s a determined and firm-minded young woman. It’s going to be very hard to convince her to join the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion.”
“Yeah, you’re right.” Qing Fengzi added, “At her current level, unless those old monsters come out of their seclusion, she can go wherever she wishes. Besides, she has a firm mind, so she will not abandon her sect.”
He paused for a moment before continuing. “It’s widely recognized that Tian Ci is an Immortal Fetus. Upon his birth, an anomaly occurred. He contains an immense amount of power, and he’s a force to be reckoned with, yet even a person as great as him pales in comparison with Zi Linglong. Generally speaking, an immature young girl like her shouldn’t be able to have such a great achievement. I wonder how she did it…”
“Have you forgotten that she has the phoenix bloodline?” Old Tie chimed in. “I can sense the massive and terrifying fire power in her. Even I couldn’t help but feel a chill down my spine. Perhaps, she is the direct descendant of a human and phoenix, so she has inherited the knowledge through her bloodline. After all, she can control fire with a shocking degree of precision. There aren’t many of them that can rival this special ability in the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. Therefore, I’m almost certain that she inherited the ability through her bloodline!”
Jiang Ming, who was sitting beside Old Tie, raised his brows when he heard what he said.
He knew his Junior Sister was a human, but at the same time, he felt everything Old Tie said made sense.
The fight lasted for a long while, and it ended with Xi Yao’s defeat. She gracefully accepted her defeat.
In the next few days, many people came to challenge Zi Linglong.
However, none of them behaved like Tan Hao. All of them had brought some extreme Yin objects with them, and they all were defeated by Zi Linglong.
This was very shocking as nobody expected that Zi Linglong, who came from a second-rate sect, would be this powerful.
The weakest opponent she came across was a genius as well, while the others were Holy Sons or Holy Daughters. It was truly shocking that she could defeat all of them.
For example, Lin Han was best known for his Mystic Ice Body. He wielded the power of ice that could freeze everything, and he had a powerful and terrifying physical body. As the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect, he was a powerful being, yet he was defeated by Zi Linglong.
Another example would be Mo Lin. He activated Dark Devil Body right off the bat and revealed himself as the Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect. Although many people were shocked, none of them went after him.
He shared the same fate as Lin Han and got defeated by Zi Linglong.
More and more people were coming to Reception Peak. Even Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty had come as well.
Unfortunately, Zi Linglong made quick work of all of them.
The only one who hadn’t challenged Zi Linglong was Tian Ci.
“Here’s an Extreme Yin Black Water Stone. It’s an extreme Yin precious item. I’ll give it to you as a gift, Junior Sister Linglong!” Tian Ci came forward and flipped his palm upward. A silver crystal stone appeared on his palm. For a moment, chilly and eerie energy filled the air and froze the akasa.
“No!” Zi Linglong declined, and her aura surged forward like an unsheathed sword.
Everyone in the surroundings could sense her terrifying aura and her confidence. After all, she had defeated multiple geniuses in a row, and it was only right and natural for her to be so confident with herself.
“This is a bet!” Zi Linglong said as she flew into the sky, “After you!”
“Alright, then!” Tian Ci threw the Extreme Yin Black Water Stone next to the Sun Stone. As soon as he finished talking, darkness began to gather around his feet while a halo of light appeared on top of his head as he slowly rose into the air. Once he stood in front of Zi Linglong, he said, “I never expected that I would run into a genius like you before I came to Eastern Region. I’m sure this will be a fun match.”
“Let’s start now!” Zi Linglong summoned her sword. It was a crimson Dao sword.
“Here I come!” Tian Ci said as he frowned.
Boom!
An explosion echoed, signaling the fight had started.
This time, everyone fixed their eyes on the match.
Tian Ci had defeated most of the geniuses in Zhong Province. He was widely recognized as the Senior Brother, and he was abnormally strong. He was now facing off a new rising star who had proved herself to be a formidable opponent.
Everyone was wondering who would be the winner of this match in the end.
“As expected of the Immortal Fetus. Casting those special abilities is a piece of cake for him. He can defeat a martial artist in the Nascent Soul Realm and can fight toe-to-toe with a martial artist in the Primal Spirit Realm!” exclaimed Old Tie. “And he hasn’t gone all out yet!”
“Yeah, this isn’t his limit yet.” Qing Fengzi nodded. “At the same time, it shows how powerful Linglong is!”
“Remarkable! She’s only in her teenage years, yet she’s already this powerful!” Old Tie exclaimed again. Suddenly, his eyes gleamed, and he shouted, “Look, he’s going to unleash the power of an Immortal Fetus!”
“Maybe this is our chance!” Qing Fengzi’s eyes lit up.
After that, both activated their divine eyes as they attempted to peer into the true mysteries of the Immortal Fetus.
Rumble!
Suddenly, the sky trembled, and multiple rays of light rained down.
They then saw Tian Ci slowly descending from the sky while divine light gathered around him. A divine voice sounded out of his body, and an illusory door that seemed to be able to communicate with the Immortal Realm and bring down the power of creation had appeared behind him.
His aura had surged to a shocking degree as well. He could amass the power of the universe in his palm with a single wave of his hand. The sky seemed to have fallen, causing the people below to have a hard time breathing while they stared at him in shock.
“Terrific!” The Sect Master of the Jiuyang Sect exclaimed when he sensed the power from the akasa. “Is it really the power of a martial artist in the Dao Seed Realm? Not even I have the confidence that I can stop it!”
Gu Hai and the others were taken aback as well.
However, when they saw the flame behind Zi Linglong had turned into a phoenix and intercepted the attack, their expression changed again. Their eyes glowed with astonishment.
While watching the fight intently, Jiang Ming thought, ‘As expected of an Immortal Fetus. He’s truly powerful, and I doubt I can kill him in his current state.’
Rumble!
The air was vibrating, and the sun dimmed.
“Immortals from the past, come forth and share with me your power!” Tian Ci chanted the incantation. He pointed one of his palms upward while the other downward. He then clapped his palms together, and light began to descend from above while darkness rose from below.
“Light and dark barrier!”
He had created a domain around them.
“Junior Sister Linglong, this is my ultimate skill, the combination of light and darkness. Once the barrier is formed, everything within it will be sealed away,” said Tian Ci.
Unexpectedly, his expression changed before he could heave a sigh of relief.
Screech!
The screech of the phoenix reverberated across the sky, and it reminded him of a legend. When a phoenix screeched, all birds would submit to it.
In the next second, Zi Linglong created a phoenix talon with her hand and shattered the barrier.
She then stepped on Tian Ci’s face and kicked him down to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - She: A Useless Senior Brother; Teach Her a Lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: She: A Useless Senior Brother; Teach Her a Lesson
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The fight ended with Tian Ci’s defeat.
This was something that nobody had expected.
After all, he was unmatched amongst his peers, and the fact that he was regarded as the Senior Brother by some Holy Sons and Daughters in Zhong Province showed how frightening his strength was.
However, he was defeated by a little girl today.
Most of the people couldn’t come around to their senses. Tian Ci was shocked by the outcome of the battle as well.
“People always say that there’s always someone better than us. I used to think that I’m the strongest, but only now do I realize how ignorant I was!” Tian Ci sighed. “You’re truly powerful, Junior Sister Linglong. Your strength and power are unparalleled amongst your peers, especially your phoenix bloodline. It’s so pure that it feels as if you’re the direct descendant of a phoenix! I can see that I still need a lot of training after today’s defeat. Therefore, I’m going back to my place to continue training. I hope to see you all again in the future!”
Tian Ci greeted the crowd and flew into the sky.
A lot of the people in the mountain had mixed expressions on their faces as Tian Ci’s figure was getting smaller and smaller in their vision. They turned their heads to look at Zi Linglong, and the mixed expressions on their faces grew even more complicated.
Some of them were jealous of her, but a lot of them shook their heads inwardly. Although Tian Ci did not state it explicitly, they could see what he was trying to do. He was setting up a trap for Zi Linglong.
On Chuyang Peak…
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped open.
Tian Ci’s status: He was amazed by Zi Linglong’s strength. He was delighted when he saw Zi Linglong defeating many geniuses in a row.
