Initially, he planned to defeat her and bring her under his command, but things didn’t go as he wished. He was defeated by Zi Linglong. After his defeat, he was disappointed in himself and felt too ashamed to stay. After thrusting Zi Linglong into the limelight, he left. He swore to himself that he would come back one day and make Zi Linglong submit to him in the future!
A glimmer of light flitted across Jiang Ming’s eyes, but it disappeared in the next second. He lifted his head and looked into the sky.
He had a hunch that they were being watched by a powerful being. It was a shame that he did not know their name and had never seen them before. Otherwise, he would have checked their information through the Human Paths Record.
“I think there’s nothing I can do other than wait now,” Jiang Ming muttered.
“Tian Ci lost!” Old Tie said, disbelief accenting his voice. “Ever since he became a martial artist, he had never been defeated before. No matter if it was a genius, a Holy Son, or someone with a special body, he triumphed over all of them, and that fueled his ego. It makes him feel like he’s the strongest, and he must be very upset after his defeat in Linglong’s hands today!”
“He seems like a gentle person on the surface, but deep down, he’s very prideful. If he cannot pick himself up after his defeat today, then this is as far as he can go. If he’s able to walk out of it, he will reach a whole new level. At that time, he will become a very formidable person!” Qing Fengzi commented, “Unfortunately, he’s weak-willed.”
“Weak-willed?”
“Yes! You spend all day either working out or taking a lava bath in the mountains, so you’re not as good as me at looking through someone. The power of darkness is one of the Daos as well. If you want to comprehend it, first, you need to immerse yourself in it, but what about him? He’s always gentle and covers all his sides beautifully. It’s as if he has never made a single mistake before, and he seems a little bit too perfect. So how is this a genius who has forged an invincible faith?”
“That’s why I have been getting a strange vibe from him, so this is it! His smile isn’t as warm and sincere as this boy over here!”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded in assent.
Many people were leaving Reception Peak, but a few of them stayed behind.
Unfortunately, the Son of Prophet did not get to form a list in the end.
The sun was setting into the horizon in the distance.
Zi Linglong returned to Chuyang Peak.
“Girl, I’m sure you’ve heard of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, right? It’s a Sacred Land in Zhong Province, and I’m a Supreme Elder of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. If you come with me, I can make you a Holy Daughter, and you’ll have access to a full range of resources such as precious pills, Dao Vessels, and many more!” Old Tie said.
“I’m the Supreme Elder of the Qingyun Sect, and I say you should come with me. Although the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion is a Sacred Land, there are many of them in Zhong Province. But the Qingyun Sect is the only Sacred Land in Eastern Region. If you come with me, I assure you that you can have whatever you want. Holy Daughter, a full set of Dao Vessels, you just need to name it, and I’ll prepare everything for you!” Qing Fengzi said.
“This is my home, and I have no intention of leaving,” Zi Linglong said with a smile. “Thank you for your offer.”
They did not press on, just sighed and left.
Zi Linglong wrapped her arms around his and asked, “What do you think of my performance, Senior Brother? Even though some of them are Holy Sons and Daughters, they’re no match for me.”
“You’re the most awesome,” Jiang Ming replied. “In fact, you’re the best, and I’m a little bit scared of you right now.”
“Are you going to leave me alone, Senior Brother?” Linglong asked with a pout, looking just like an abandoned kitten.
“I’m just scared that you will accidentally kill me when you’re hugging me,” Jiang Ming said.
“Hmph! I can even jump on you and crush you with my weight!” Zi Linglong harrumphed.
“Haha, you’re so funny!”
“Hehe, Senior Brother, it has been some time since I last ate your food.”
“So what do you want to eat today?”
“Anything! As long as you’re the one who makes it, I’ll eat it.”
“Alright, then. Sigh, I’m really such a busy bee,” Jiang Ming said as he rushed into the kitchen happily.
In the next few days, more and more people left Reception Peak.
Name: Lin Han
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect
Relationship: 1
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Mystic Ice Body)
Status: Although he was defeated by Zi Linglong, he was delighted. This was because he realized that Zi Linglong had mastered the Dao of Yang. After returning to his sect, he would ask an Elder to keep an eye on the Jiuyang Sect. He was going to take her away when she left the sect and force her to help him in his cultivation!
Standing on the roof with his hands clasped behind him, Jiang Ming looked at the figures that were leaving Reception Peak.
He checked Qing Fengzi’s information again. When he tried to trace him, he realized that he was at a location 1,000 miles away from him.
“Tch! What a shame… I can’t kill him like this!”
Jiang Ming had come up with a few plans, but he discarded all of them in the end. He did not have the confidence that he could take Qing Fengzi down. No matter if he used his decoy to distract him or went up straight at him, none of them would work. After all, Qing Fengzi was too strong, even stronger than Bai Zizai.
“I guess I’ll let him live for now,” Jiang Ming said to himself.
The remaining two people left as well.
Xi Yao’s status: She felt upset when she was defeated by Zi Linglong, but the negative feeling dissipated after seeing Zi Linglong defeating several geniuses in a row, including Tian Ci, with her powerful special abilities. She challenged Zi Linglong to a fight in the next few days. Initially, she wanted to make Zi Linglong submit to her, but she had long forsaken the goal and admired Zi Linglong from the bottom of her heart. She also had a slight understanding of the Dao of Extreme Yin. When she was leaving, she promised that she would come to visit Zi Linglong again after digesting everything she gained through her fights with her.
“Well, she’s one-of-a-kind. She isn’t as arrogant as other Holy Sons or Daughters.”
Jiang Ming nodded inwardly.
In fact, he hoped that she would stay.
After all, she had a voluptuous body figure, and her skin was as fair as snow. On top of that, she was gorgeous and pleasing to the eyes. Jiang Ming was certain that she could add a lot of fun and color to this bleak and boring mountain if she stayed.
Just when he was locked in his thoughts, Xi Yao turned her head around, and a smile appeared on her face. She looked just like a blooming flower under the sun.
“She’s really gorgeous!”
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat and then the corner of his lips twitched when he noticed the new addition in the Human Paths Record.
Xi Yan’s status: When she realized someone was looking at her, she turned her head around and realized the person standing on the roof was Zi Linglong’s Senior Brother. She wondered why Zi Linglong would have a useless Senior Brother like him since she was a prodigy herself. She felt ashamed on her behalf.
“Should I teach her a lesson?” Jiang Ming gnashed his teeth.
However, when he saw Mo Lin’s status, killing intent surged in his eyes. “Well, it seems like someone is asking for a beating~”

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - It Hurts; Kill the Holy Son First
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: It Hurts; Kill the Holy Son First
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Mo Lin
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Holy Son of Yinmo Sect
Relationship: -55
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Dark Devil Body)
Status: He initially wanted to fight with Tian Ci, but little did he expect that he would be defeated by Zi Linglong. However, he was not disheartened. He kept a close eye on the Jiuyang Sect, and then he noticed that the Jiuyang Sect was not powerful at all. After everyone left the Jiuyang Sect, he was going to ask his guardian to ambush and abduct Zi Linglong to become his cauldron. If he succeeded, he would become stronger than his peers.
Jiang Ming’s killing intent surged after he read Mo Lin’s status.
“I’ll let you live until nighttime. It’s not the right time yet.”
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped.
Name: Yue Cheng
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: First Seat of Zhiyang Peak (Note: He’s actually an Elder of the Yinmo Sect)
Relationship: -1
Status: He was already taken aback by the fact that Zi Linglong could defeat Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty, and now he was even more frightened after witnessing Zi Linglong defeat so many geniuses. He was worried that she would kill him in one slash if he busted himself.
‘D*mn it! Should I stay here, or should I run away? Maybe I should turn myself in? Do I still have a chance to redeem myself? No, no, I don’t! Should I tell the Holy Son about me? No, it doesn’t work either. He doesn’t know my existence at all. If I go straight up to him recklessly, I will be done for if he refuses to acknowledge me or I expose myself! Sigh, this is really hard.’
Jiang Ming lifted his brows. He was going to leave him aside first. After all, since he already knew Yue Cheng was a mole, it was better to keep him alive than kill him since he could get some information about the Yinmo Sect from him.
“Senior Brother!” Zi Linglong threw herself at him after she saw everyone out.
Jiang Ming opened his arms subconsciously and secured her tightly in his embrace. However, he couldn’t stop the momentum and nearly fell to the ground.
Before his back could touch the ground, an invisible energy barrier appeared behind him and saved him from the fate of falling to the ground.
Lying on top of him, Zi Linglong asked, “Are you hurt, Senior Brother?”
“Just like what you said earlier, you nearly crushed me,” Jiang Ming replied as he tousled her hair.
“You should be grateful that I didn’t go all out on you, Senior Brother. Anyway, are you hurt?”
“You nearly broke my spine.”
“Hehe, don’t worry. I can heal you right away!”
“Hmph! Get off me now!”
“No!”
“I’m going to spank you!”
“No, you’re not!”
Smack!
In the afternoon, Gu Hai returned and announced, “Ming, I’ll leave the affairs of the peak in your hands. Linglong, you’re going to assist your Senior Brother.”
“What about you, Master?” Jiang Ming asked in surprise, “Are you going to discuss your life and dreams with First Steam Yin Yue?”
“Ahem! Ahem!” Gu Hao took a big gulp of wine and said, “I’ve been busy my whole life. It’s time for me to take some rest. Once you’ve ascended into the Purple Mansion Realm, I’ll make you the First Seat. As for Linglong. Well, we need to give her some space and time to cultivate.”
“So you’re going to dump your responsibility on us?” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“I’m leaving now,” Gu Hai said as he flew into the air. “I’ll leave everything here in your care. I’ll come back from time to time, so make sure you clean my room every now and then!”
“This old man!” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Is he seriously going to pursue a woman in his current age?”
“Who knows?” Linglong chimed in. After that, she turned around and chirped happily. “Senior Brother, does this mean that we’ll be the only ones on the mountain? And no one will bother us anymore?”
“Yeah!”
“That’s awesome!”
The joyous times were always short-lived.
After they finished their dinner, Jiang Ming was rewarded with one month’s worth of cultivation base. He then absorbed it into his sea of consciousness, and it marked the end of the day.
Just like what they usually did, they sat on their chairs and watched the starry sky until midnight.
“You should go back to your room and get some rest.”
“Senior Brother, I don’t need rest anymore in my current realm. Let me keep you company. If you want to cultivate, I’ll be your guard.”
“Be good.”
It took Jiang Ming a lot of effort to convince her to go back to her room.
At midnight, in his room…
Jiang Ming activated his formation, left a decoy behind, and departed quietly.
The mountain ranges were shining beautifully under the starry sky and moon.
At the edge of Hai Province, there was a valley. It was quiet there as it was surrounded by a formation. Although it looked like there was nothing from outside, there was a massive altar in the center of the valley. The altar was engraved with a dense amount of crimson devilish patterns as if it was burning.
Mo Lin was standing at the center of the altar.
“Everything is ready, and all I need is a missing piece,” Mo Lin said excitedly as he stood with his hands clasped behind him and looked into the sky.
“Even if the phoenix bloodline cannot help me in my transformation, it can enhance my physical body and bring my strength to a whole new level. Once it’s done, I will obtain the Light-Dark Body. I only need to absorb Tian Ci, and I’ll have the power to conquer the world!” said Mo Lin as a bright future was presented before his eyes.
Suddenly, someone appeared in front of him.
“Who are you?” Mo Lin shouted in surprise when he saw the man. However, he soon calmed down and started his attack. The altar gave off a bright red light, and runes began to appear throughout the valley.
“Who are you? How did you find it here?” Mo Lin asked, his face stern. “I didn’t expect someone could enter my formation without me knowing anything. Could it be that you’ve mastered the Dao of Spatial?”
The person was none other than Jiang Ming.
After getting here, he teleported himself into the formation. To prevent Mo Lin from recognizing him, he even changed his appearance.
“Who am I? I’m the one who came to take your life!” Jiang Ming replied as he summoned the middle-grade Sky Rending Sword in his hand. He swiped it down and performed the Slice the Heavens sword technique, which was one of the Qingyun Sect’s special abilities.
He imbued the special ability with the Dao of Great Demolition, which further enhanced its attack output to a shocking degree.
Sword energy appeared and shattered the formation. The runes were falling from the sky one after the other, and even the altar slowed down as it couldn’t handle the attack.
“Reverse Demon Mirror! Counter!” Mo Lin reacted swiftly when he realized something was not right. A pitch-black demon mirror appeared from his body and emitted an eerie light.
It was a top-grade artifact that could reflect any attack.
However, when the sword energy fell, the Reverse Demon Mirror was cut in half and dropped on Mo Lin.
Bam!
Light burst forward as the nine layers of protective barriers on Mo Lin’s battle armor shattered. He was then sent flying through the air with blood spilling out of him.
‘He survived that hit? Well, considering that he has two defensive armors with his Dark Devil Body and protective special ability, it’s not surprising that he can survive that.’
Jiang Ming was not surprised. After all, Mo Lin was a Holy Son. Not only was he equipped with defensive artifacts, but he also had cast formation on himself.
However, he was still nearly reduced to a bloody pulp by that attack.
“Slice the Heavens!” Jiang Ming did not give him any chance to take a breath and launched another attack on him.
It slashed through the akasa and destroyed everything in its path.
“No!” Mo Lin shouted, “Master, save me!”
Pfft!
Mo Lin couldn’t stop the attack without his defensive artifacts and was cut in half.
He was dead.
Rumble!
The altar crumbled, and the formation shattered, causing the surrounding mountains to shake and crack as if an earth dragon was rolling on the ground. Just when Jiang Ming was about to leave, a palm appeared above him.. The starlight disappeared and darkness enveloped him, plunging him into absolute darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - Paradis; A Highly Cautious Old Freak
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Paradis; A Highly Cautious Old Freak
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Darkness enveloped Jiang Ming whole, depriving him of all his senses. The air thickened, and even the spatial nodes had distorted.
Jiang Ming couldn’t use his special abilities, and he knew that he was within the “Paradis” enacted by a martial artist in the Paradis Realm. It was like a sphere or a dimension. Once one was trapped in it, it would be impossible to get out. A martial artist in the Paradis Realm only needed to manifest their Pradis to deal with a Primal Spirit martial artist, and this showed how terrifying the power of a Pardis martial artist was.
“Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!”
Jiang Ming lifted the Sky Rending Sword and formed nine formless sword energies around him. The sword energies pierced through the dimension and ripped apart the darkness, charging toward the falling palm above him and resulting in a huge explosion.
Light returned, the air was vibrating, and all of the clouds under the moonlight were gone.
The mountain peaks surrounding him had crumbled and the earth wailed.
“I didn’t expect you to be able to control the power of space. It’s no wonder that you’re able to destroy my Paradis projection and repel my attack!” A voice echoed, followed by the figure of a man. He looked like he was in his middle age. He was wearing a blood-red robe, and his hair was long and curly, giving him a wild vibe.
There was a deep wound on his hand behind him. Blood could be seen flowing out of the wound, but it soon evaporated into the air as the wound was closing up rapidly.
“Who are you?” Jiang Ming frowned.
The Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi he performed just now was in the second stage. It could pierce through space, and the fact that he could unleash nine sword energies at once meant that he had reached perfection for this stage. It was extremely powerful, and no ordinary people could stop it. Therefore, he was kind of surprised to see that the man in front of him appeared unscathed from the attack.
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record appeared.
Name: Ge Xiang
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Paradis Realm
Background: Supreme Elder of the Yinmo Sect
Relationship: -91
Innate talent: Nine Stars
Status: After sensing that he had reached the bottleneck in his cultivation, he decided to become the guardian of Mo Lin, the Holy Son. In the meantime, although the chance was slim, he did not give up on searching for the opportunity to advance into the next realm. He was observing from the dark throughout the entire fight in Reception Peak of the Jiuyang Sect. He sighed at the sight of so many geniuses, especially Tian Ci and Zi Linglong. They were so gifted that he was envious of them. If he was as talented as them, he wouldn’t be trapped in the Paradis Realm for such a long time. He hesitated for a moment when he received Mo Lin’s plan, but he agreed to his plan eventually. He was going to prepare himself before he went to the Jiuyang Sect to take Zi Linglong away by force.
Just when he was cultivating, he noticed with shock that there was a fight going on here. He hurriedly rushed over here, but he was too late. The formation had collapsed, the mountain peaks had crumbled, and the Holy Son was dead. Fueled by his anger, he attacked Jiang Ming. However, he didn’t expect that the young man before him was able to injure him, and he nearly lost his hand. He was confident that this young man was an existence even more terrifying than Tian Ci and Zi Linglong. He never expected there would be someone like Jiang Ming in this world, and he wondered if chaos was coming since so many geniuses had emerged all of a sudden. That said, he soon felt it must be the case, and chaos was going to descend on this world when he thought that the Six Paths of the Sky Devil were going to emerge.
The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips quivered after he took a glance at his “Status.”
It seemed to him that the system was getting more and more mischievous. His status was very detailed, but there was a limited amount of useful information.
While he was going through Ge Xiang’s information, Ge Xiang harrumphed coldly. “Who am I? You killed my Holy Son, and you have the nerves to ask who am I? Tell me your name”
“Why don’t you give it a guess?” Jiang Ming said as he formed a seal with his left hand. A lightning bolt came down from the sky and struck the man with deadly precision.
It was the Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, and he had comprehended it to the mastery stage.
He was going to have a fight with Ge Xiang to see how he could hold out against a martial artist in the Paradis Realm, as well as to have a primary assessment of his own combat power.
Rumble!
Thunder and lightning fell again.
“Hah, petty trick!” Ge Xiang harrumphed coldly. A ray of dark light shot out of his head and stopped the lightning.
In the next second, Jiang Ming summoned his sword and used the Slice the Heavens sword technique against Ge Xiang.
“You’re a disciple from the Qingyun Sect?” Ge Xiang frowned. In the next second, he appeared behind Jiang Ming and delivered a palm strike at him.
The attack was soundless and formless, but it carried with it so much force that it could crush everything in its path.
Swoosh!
As if Jiang Ming had read his movement, he took a step sideways and entered the void to avoid the attack.
“You’ve mastered the Dao of Spatial!’ Ge Xiang said, his brows twitching vigorously. “Not only can you pierce through space with your sword energy, but you know how to teleport as well. None of your peers can be better than you, but unfortunately, your opponent today is me. Kingdom of Darkness, descend!”
Ge Xiang’s killing intent rose after he learned what kind of Dao had Jiang Ming mastered. He figured that he had to kill him here today. Otherwise, he would become a threat to him in the future.
In the next instant, the entire area was covered in complete darkness, followed by an immense pressure that could crush the people within.
Jiang Ming had already prepared for this. In the next second, an intense light that was brighter than the moon and whiter than the sun emitted from him.
It was the perfect counter for Ge Xiang’s Kingdom of Darkness, which consisted of nothing but pure darkness. Not only that, but he even had invoked the light power of order.
“What? You’ve mastered the Dao of Light as well!?” Ge Xiang exclaimed
His Kingdom of Darkness was shattered by the light. Fortunately, this was his Paradis projection. The power of his attack surged and fought back the light with a flick of his mind.
“I can’t let someone like you exist in this world! I have to kill you here today!” Ge Xiang hissed. “Darkness Stream!”
Rumble!
The power of darkness came from the surroundings and swarmed over Jiang Ming like a tidal wave. It even distorted the Akasa, and the spatial nodes were disappearing.
Jiang Ming sighed inwardly.
The power of light he released just now was just a rendition of the Dao of Light. He did not know any special light ability, so he couldn’t unleash the true power of light.
When he sensed that the spatial nodes were disappearing, he knew it was time for him to get serious.
“Great Akasa Steps!
“Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!
“Great Akasa Divine Hand!”
Slaloming in the darkness through the spatial networks, Jiang Ming covered the sky with his left hand and formed sword energies with his right hand as he unleashed all of his special abilities one after another.
“Darkness Vanish!”
Ge Xiang disappeared and completely merged into the darkness to avoid Jiang Ming’s attack.
“Shadow clone!”
Soon, Ge Xiang’s clones appeared in the darkness and charged at Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming took a step forward and emitted light into the surroundings, forming it into sword energies and cutting down anyone who came near him.
However, in the next second, he suddenly felt a force on his body.
He turned around and noticed that there were three mirrors around him. All of them emitted a ghastly light on him, and he felt as if he had fallen into a swarm. He could barely take a step forward, let alone performing any teleport techniques or moving along the spatial nodes.
The air thickened, and the pressure was getting stronger and stronger.
“Come on!” Jiang Ming was on the verge of crying, “Three low-grade Dao Vessels, and all of them are supporting types that can restrict my movements!”
“Although you’re younger than me, I treat you as my equal. If I don’t kill you today, you will come and kill me one day. Thus, I have to go all out and kill you!” Ge Xiang said faintly, “Once I cast my Paradis projection, I can easily kill a Primal Spirit martial artist. However, not only does that not affect you, but you nearly shattered it with your Dao of Light! This is something I refuse to accept! I don’t know how many trump cards you still have on your body, but I must destroy you today to save me from worries!”
A sword appeared in his hand. The sword was sharp, and Jiang Ming felt a chill down his spine just by looking at it.
It was even stronger than the Sky Rending Sword.
“Crap! It’s a high-grade Dao Sword!” Jiang Ming cursed, “You really are the most cautious being I’ve ever come across.. I’m younger than you, and you should fight me with your special abilities. You shouldn’t use your Paradis projection and high-grade Dao Vessels right off the bat just to kill me! D*mn it! You’re even more cautious than me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - Eight Times; Nine Primal Spirits; Sky Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Eight Times; Nine Primal Spirits; Sky Devil
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The combined effort of the Paradis projection and three low-grade Dao Vessels had successfully contained Jiang Ming. He couldn’t even take a step forward, let alone run away.
When Ge Xiang pulled out his top-grade Dao sword and cut through all of his special abilities, it further pushed him into the abyss of despair.
Voom!
It went without saying that Jiang Ming wouldn’t just stand still and wait for his death. His body began to enlarge, and his aura surged. He was getting taller and taller, and it only stopped when he reached about 999 cm in height.
This was the Three-fold Astral Transformation from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. He had already mastered it to the third stage. His height had reached 999 cm, and his physical strength had increased by eight times.
The power of suppression became lighter.
The Sky Rending Sword in Jiang Ming’s hand disappeared, and the middle-grade Dao Vessel Tyrant Halberd appeared in its place.
In the meantime, the sword energy had already arrived right in front of his face.
Bam!
Jiang Ming hurriedly turned the halberd around to intercept the attack, but he was knocked back by the impact as well.
“Just as I expected. Killing a genius like you is harder than reaching the sky! But no matter what, I must destroy you today!’ Ge Xiang’s face was dark, and he launched another attack at Jiang Ming.
“Have you never heard of the phrase ‘Don’t count your chickens before they hatch’? Are you sure you can destroy me?” Jiang Ming brandished his halberd and began intercepting Ge Xiang’s attack.
He was not using any special abilities at all. He was just swinging his halberd and fending off Ge Xiang’s attack with his brute strength.
The Akasa crumbled, and Ge Xiang was forced to take a few steps back.
“Again!” Jiang Ming shouted.
He lifted his halberd and started his attack again.
“Hah, what a fool!” Ge Xiang harrumphed coldly. In the next second, he turned into a plume of smoke and disappeared into the darkness.
The three mirrors on top of Jiang Ming began to vibrate while giving off an eerie light.
Bam!
The area around Jiang Ming began to distort, and in the next second, he appeared in front of a mirror. He lifted his halberd and struck down with a mighty swipe, cutting the mirror in half.
“What!?” Ge Xiang, who had just come out of the darkness and appeared behind Jiang Ming, couldn’t help himself and exclaimed, “He can cut a low-grade Dao Vessel into half!?”
Before he could retrieve the remaining two mirrors, Jiang Ming had destroyed them.
“Come at me, you b*stard! There’s only one of us who can get out of here today! It’s either you or me!” Jiang Ming shouted, his aura surging madly, and it made him look even more imposing.
He brandished his halberd, and the Akasa distorted.
“Alright, then! I shall grant you your wish!” Ge Xiang harrumphed coldly, and then a black flag with a dense devil pattern emerged from the darkness.
In the next second, the black flag shone brightly, and several tiny human figures flew out of it. All of them looked very delicate, but their faces were distorted.
There were a total of nine of them.
“Primal Spirits!” Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted.
“That’s right!” Ge Xiang’s voice rang out. “These nine people are the martial artists in the Primal Spirits who have been killed by me in the past. I trapped their Primal Spirits with my God Subordination Flag so that I can use them whenever I want! God Demolition!”
As soon as he gave out his command, the nine little human figures opened their mouths simultaneously and let out a silent scream.
In an instant, the terrifying power of the Primal Spirit set off a frightening storm that descended directly into Jiang Ming’s mind, trying to destroy his sea of consciousness and annihilate his divine soul.
“With these nine Primal Spirits puppets, I can even kill a Paradis martial artist easily! I would like to see how you’re going to stop this attack this time!” Ge Xiang said, his voice thick with confidence. “This is my trump card, and I won’t use it until the last moment, so consider yourself lucky, kid!”
Afterward, he suddenly frowned.
Although Jiang Ming was bleeding profusely and looked like he was going to fall at any moment, he did not seem like he was going to die soon.
“Could it be that he’s protecting his sea of consciousness with an item?” Ge Xiang squinted and approached Jiang Ming with his sword pointing straight at the center of his forehead.
“This is the moment I’ve been waiting for!” Jiang Ming cracked his eyes open. A chess plate appeared in front of him, trying to suck Ge Xiang in with its terrifying suction force.
However, Ge Xiang was a Paradis martial artist. He was able to resist the suction force.
Suddenly, a figure appeared behind him. It was the decoy Jiang Ming projected with the Human Paths Record. The decoy then kicked Ge Xiang into the chess plate.
Even the nine tiny human figures and the black flag were sucked into the chess plate along with Ge Xiang.
The Paradis projection disappeared, and moonlight shone on Jiang Ming once again.
Swoosh!
He took a deep breath and entered the chess plate. The chess plate then fell to the ground while emitting a divine light.
Inside the chess plate, as soon as he landed on the ground, he was greeted by a sword.
Ge Xiang was fast, but Jiang Ming was a tad faster. He waved his hand and deflected his attack, sending him flying away.
“Here is my world!” Jiang Ming smiled.
His face was full of blood, and his smile made him look even fiercer.
The nine Primal Spirit puppets were disappearing. They were not returning to the black flag. Instead, they were dissipating into the air.
“This is why I hate geniuses the most, especially a genius like you, even if I was one of them as well in the past!” Ge Xiang hissed.
A bad feeling had been stirring his heart from the moment the chess plate appeared. Once he was inside the chess plate, he found that he couldn’t activate his mana or use the Paradis projection at all. When he tried to activate them by force, his sea of consciousness nearly exploded.
“Why?” Jiang Ming asked.
When he was attacked by the nine Primal Spirit puppets just now, although he managed to prevent them from destroying his sea of consciousness, he ended up bleeding profusely. The silver lining was that he did not sustain other injuries anymore.
“Isn’t that obvious?” Ge Xiang growled madly. He wanted to attack Jiang Ming, but he suppressed the urge. “I used to be a genius as well. I was beloved by heaven and could always turn calamities into blessings every time! After that, I became stronger and stronger, but who knew I would run into a bottleneck? No matter how hard I train or cultivate, I just cannot make it into the next realm. I’ve studied many geniuses, and I know all of them are extremely hard to kill. Therefore, when I saw you, I used all of my special abilities and tried to kill you, but, but, but… I still couldn’t kill you! D*mn it! You’re just a martial artist in the Dao Seed Realm, but I’ve already reached the Paradis Realm!
“Dao Seed, Nascent Soul, Primal Spirit, Paradis, there is such a big gap between you and me, yet not only did I fail to kill you, but you also trapped me in this godd*mn place! D*mn it! Why is the world so unfair!?” Ge Xiang shouted.
“You’re very cautious, ruthless, and you wouldn’t hesitate to kill someone. Had you run into other people, I don’t think they would stand a chance against you.” Jiang Ming said, sneering sarcastically, “Are you hopeless now?”
“Of course, I am! I can’t use my mana, I’m not good at physical fighting, and look at you. Who would’ve thought that you have perfectly mastered the Three-fold Astral Transformation from the Infinite Alchemy Sect? Now that your physical body is so strong, how am I supposed to fight you?” Ge Xiang smiled bitterly. “What do you want me to do to let me go?
“Kneel before you?
“Give you all my precious items?
“Make you my master?
“Enslave me?
“Can’t you just say something? You’re making me even more nervous!” Ge Xiang said.
“I’m going to die soon, so can you fulfill my last wish and tell me who you are and why you want to kill Mo Lin so that I can die in peace?” Ge Xiang asked as he sighed.
“Why do I have to tell you?” Jiang Ming let out a cold laugh. Holding the halberd in his hand, he walked up to Ge Xiang and said, “You said you want to die in peace? Fat chance!”
“Please, I beg you! Can you please fulfill my last wish before I die?” Ge Xiang said as he dropped to the ground on his knees.
Jiang Ming was stunned.
“Now is my chance! Sky Devil Deconstructive Technique!” Ge Xiang shouted as his mana surged. He lifted his head and pointed his sword at Jiang Ming.
Pfft!
At the same time, the halberd fell and cut him in half.
Ge Xiang was dumbfounded. He did not expect that at all. After coming to his senses, he huffed and said, “I, a martial artist in the Paradis Realm, knelt, and you still want to kill me? You… You d*mn—”
Bam!
Jiang Ming delivered a kick at him, reducing him into a plume of blood mist before he could finish his sentence.
“Just shut your mouth and die, you sneaky son of a b*tch!”

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - Activate: Three-Minute Experience Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Activate: Three-Minute Experience Card
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Ge Xiang
Status: Was sucked into an unknown dimension. He was filled with worries, trepidation, and apprehension when he realized he couldn’t use his mana. When he saw his opponent falling from the sky, he tried to ambush him, but when his attempt failed, he felt hopeless. Knowing that he had only one chance, he fell to his knees in an attempt to distract his opponent. Then, he activated a forbidden spell to enhance his physical attribution and try to ambush his opponent once again.
“Want to ambush me? Fat chance!”
Jiang Ming chuckled as he read the content in the Human Paths Record.
Once Ge Xiang died, the chess plate was deactivated. Jiang Ming grabbed the air with an outstretched arm, and Ge Xiang’s sword appeared in his hand. The sword was thoroughly black with two words engraved on the blade that read, Dark Abyss.
“Dark Abyss, huh?” Jiang Ming stored the sword away, and then he took all the items out of Ge Xiang’s storage space. After that, he burned everything into ashes.
After he finished doing everything, his body began to shrink to its original size, and he felt a surge of lethargy rush through him.
“That was a close call!”
Jiang Ming noticed that his battle prowess was not much worse than that of a Paradis martial artist. That being said, the Paradis projection was indeed a tricky skill. It could suppress and render a lot of his special abilities and power useless.
Besides, he also noticed that he lacked special abilities, no matter if it was the five-elemental type or the light and darkness type.
He thought for a moment and went out of the Mana Sealing Chess Plate.
Before Jiang Ming could stand straight, he felt a strong aura coming straight at him. He lifted his head, and one person was looking at him from a distance.
Jiang Ming was stunned.
That man was none other than Bai Zizai, the Paradis Monarch.
Although Jiang Ming had changed his appearance, the Mana Sealing Chess Plate was right in front of him.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped open.
Name: Bai Zizai
Race: Scaled Dragon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Paradis Realm
Background: One of the four commanders of the Red Mountain Palace
Relationship: -99
Innate Talent: Ten stars (Pure Scaled Dragon Bloodline)
Status: He was delighted when he heard the news that Zi Linglong from the Jiuyang Sect had crushed many geniuses, and even the Immortal Fetus from the Tianyuan School was no match for her. He also found out that Zi Linglong had a pure phoenix bloodline. Therefore, he was going to utilize her bloodline to make himself even stronger. After all of the geniuses returned to their own places, he knew his chance would arrive and that he would have to act fast to prevent anything from going south.
To be on the safe side, he sent the Bishui Sect to the Jiuyang Sect first. He even goaded the Elder of the Bishui Sect, who had the same cultivation base as him, to launch an attack on the Jiuyang Sect. As for himself, he hid in the dark and observed if there were any martial artists stronger than him around so that he wouldn’t be targeted.
When the members of the Bishui Sect were heading toward the Jiuyang Sect, he noticed a terrifying aura coming from this area. After he came here, he found the chess plate hovering in the air. He remembered that the owner of the chess plate was the one who killed his lover, his son, and his grandson, and he flew into a rage. After he got closer, although the person that came out of the chess plate had a different appearance, he was confident that he was the man. He decided to kill him and obtain all of his treasured items before going to capture Zi Linglong from the Jiuyang Sect.
Rumble!
A veil of water appeared and swept across the sky, turning the entire area into a world of water.
Paradis projection. This was the Dao of Water.
Jiang Ming felt he had fallen into the sea. Countless forces came from all different directions, forming into multiple vortexes and distorting the spatial nodes to prevent Jiang Ming from running away.
“Who are you?” Bai Zizai’s voice wafted into Jiang Ming’s ears.
His silver hair was fluttering in the wind, and his shirt was as white as snow. He then summoned a sword onto his hand. The sword emitted a divine light, and it was so sharp that it seemed it could cut through everything in the world.
“Who am I?” Jiang Ming laughed coldly. He lifted his head up in an arrogant manner and continued. “Do you really want to know? Are you sure you can take it when you learn who I am?”
At the same time, he wrote the name Bishui Great Monarch on the Human Paths Record using his mind.
Surprisingly, his information appeared.
Name: Bishui (Bishui Great Monarch)
Race: Human-demon (Half Human Bloodline and half Blue-Blooded Toad Bloodline)
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Paradis Realm
Background: Great Monarch of the Bishui Sec
Relationship: -66
Innate Talent: Nine stars
Status: Used to be ashamed of his blue-blooded toad bloodline. In order to make himself stronger, he annihilated all of the blue-blooded toads in his father’s lineage and absorbed them through a demonic formation, forcibly refining them and enhancing his bloodline origin. Afterward, he formed the Bishui Sect. However, he was ostracized in the Submerged Dragon Continent and could only survive on the periphery.
Refusing to accept his fate, he made an alliance with the Red Mountain Palace. When the Red Mountain Palace approached him, they told him that the devil sects were going to reappear in the land of Shenzhou. Chaos would descend upon the world, and Eastern Region would fall into disorder. The Red Mountain Palace wanted to dominate Eastern Region, as well as join forces with the Yinmo Sect, one of the six Sky Devil Sects, to destroy the Qingyun Sect.
He was asked to lead the Bishui Sect to investigate the situation first. If they succeeded, the Bishui Sect would get at least 1/3 of Eastern Region. He was tempted. If he could occupy 1/3 of Eastern Region, with the help from the items he collected from the Qingyun Sect, he was certain that he could push his strength to a whole new level.
First, he sent Hai Yan, the Elder of the Bishui Sect, to Hai Province. Just when Hai Yan was about to take over Hai Province, the entire Bishui Sect in Hai Province was destroyed in one night, and he was furious.
Then, he heard that many people were coveting Eastern Region. Bai Zizai, the leader of the Red Mountain Palace, and even Long Yuan had set his eyes on Eastern Region. Moreover, more and more sea clans from the sea were quietly moving toward the coastal waters. After hesitating for a while, he finally decided to move his sect to Hai Province in Eastern Region.
When he was in Eastern Region, he noticed that a big war was about to befall Eastern Region.
Several days ago, Bai Zizai came to look for him and asked for his assistance in taking over Qing Province. At the same time, they were going to test the reaction of the Qingyun Sect, as well as urge the Yinmo Sect to speed things up.
When he received the message from Bai Zizai, he knew the chance had come. He led nearly half of his sect toward the Jiuyang Sect in an attempt to destroy the Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted after seeing Bishui’s status.
‘D*mn it! I just didn’t check on him for a while, and he has already prepared such a big gift for me. Submerged Dragon Continent, Red Mountain Palace, Long Yuan, Bishui Sect, Yinmo Sect… The entire world is going crazy!’
“If you want to destroy the Jiuyang Sect, then you’d have to step over my dead body!” Jiang Ming shouted.
Jiang Ming did not really care about everything that happened in the outside world. Even if the Qingyun Sect had dominated Eastern Region or the Yinmo Sect was rising up, he would not do anything to them as long as they did not disturb him.
However, they wanted to destroy the Jiuyang Sect right now.
‘Hah!’
“You’ve comprehended the Dao of Spatial, so you mustn’t be a nobody!” Bai Zizai said, “Tell me where are you from. Perhaps I can spare your life.”
“I came from the Tianyuan School!” Jiang Ming said, smiling coldly, “So are you sure you want to kill me?”
“Tianyuan School?” Bai Zizai was stunned. Then, he shook his head. “This is impossible! There’s no way you’re from the Tianyuan School! You’re much stronger than Tian Ci, and if you’re from the Tianyuan School, then where is your guardian? Anyway, it doesn’t matter anymore now. Since you refuse to tell me who you are or where you come from, I’m going to kill you now!”
“Kill me?” A card appeared in front of Jiang Ming. It was the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card, and he activated it without any hesitation.
The experience card turned into a flash of light and entered his body, further amplifying his power to a shocking degree.
Bai Zizai’s face turned pale in fear.
“The one who’s going to die today isn’t me.. You are!” Jiang Ming shouted, distorting space.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - A Fight Against the Whole World
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: A Fight Against the Whole World
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
A speck of light entered Jiang Ming’s body as soon as the experience card was activated.
For a moment, Jiang Ming felt as if a human figure that resembled him had come to his aid across time and space. The human figure then became one with him, causing his power to skyrocket to a shocking degree.
He could crush a planet just by lifting his arm and crack the ground with a stomp. He looked ahead and everything was clear in his eyes. He could see the flow of mana, the changes of Yin and Yang, and the five elemental forces in the air. He stretched his arm forward with his palm facing upward, and the chain of law that could cut through nature appeared in his hand.
The only thing he couldn’t comprehend completely was the force of time. That being said, he still had some understanding about it.
It was only now that Jiang Ming understood what it meant by the Extreme Path Realm. Once a person had achieved the Extreme Path Realm, they would have control over the extreme force in the universe.
“The power of the Extreme Path depends on the Dao that I’ve mastered so far. Even the strength of my physical body has reached an unimaginable level.”
Jiang Ming was shocked.
He was a thousand times, no, a million times stronger than he was before now.
Jiang Ming only needed to think, and he could perform the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi at its highest level.
Jiang Ming really wanted to test how strong he had become, but he knew now was not the right timing.
He turned his head and realized Bai Zizai had already run away.
‘What the…?’
Initially, Bai Zizai had been under the impression that Jiang Ming was just an ant he could crush easily. However, it turned out that Jiang Ming was much stronger than him, so he decided to run away. After all, going up against Jiang Ming at his current state was no different than walking himself into his own grave.
Although he did not know what had happened to Jiang Ming, he knew he had to run away right now.
“Want to run? Fat chance!”
Jiang Ming stored the Mana Sealing Chess Plate away and leaped upward. He formed a seal with his hand and threw the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal on Bai Zizai.
The divine seal was massive. As soon as it appeared, millions of cracks appeared in the Akasa. It seemed as if the divine seal was going to crush the Akasa and destroy everything in its path.
“Please, please forgive me, senior! This is all a misunderstanding!” Bai Zizai shouted after he was pinned onto the ground by the divine seal. While he was screaming, he unconsciously transformed back to his original form, a white dragon.
He spat out a divine pagoda, which was a middle-grade defensive Dao Vessel. It emitted a blue light and formed into a dome to protect him.
Bam!
The divine seal fell and crushed the pagoda.
“No!” Bai Zizai screamed. There was nothing he could do other than watch in despair as the divine seal fell onto him, crushing him and all of his belongings in the process.
Even the mountain was crushed, and there was nothing but a deep abyss left behind.
Jiang Ming did not look at Bai Zizai anymore and leaped into space. In the next second, he appeared 10,000 miles away from the Jiuyang Sect. He looked toward his sect and realized that the formation responsible for protecting the Jiuyang Sect had broken.
“Other than Bishui Great Monarch, the rest of the four people are in the Primal Spirit Realm? Very well, then!” Jiang Ming harrumphed coldly. Then, he conjured up sword energy and sent it toward Bishui Great Monarch.
It was the Slice the Heavens sword technique. It tore through the air and left a big crack in the night sky.
In the distance, Bishui Great Monarch did not attack the Jiuyang Sect right away. After all, he was a Paradis martial artist, and he didn’t feel like degrading himself by joining the war right away. Besides, Bai Zizai hadn’t appeared yet, so he dared not to stand at the front of the crowd.
“This is the sword energy from an Extreme Path martial artist! D*mn it, who the hell could it be!? No, it must be Bai Zizai!” Bishui Great Monarch’s face turned pale, and he soon realized what was going on.
After all, he had arrived at Eastern Region not long ago, and he doubted there would be anyone who wanted to kill him. Besides, the one who had invited him to this war was Bai Zizai, and only he would attract such a powerful being.
“Golden Sand Tent, come to my aid!”
“Blue-blooded Toad Transformation!”
As he activated his Dao Vessel to defend himself against the attack, he transformed into a big toad. His body began to glow divinely as he cast another defensive special ability on himself.
Pfft!
In the next moment, the Golden Sand Tent crumbled. The defensive special ability on himself was breaking as well like a paper.
“D*mn you, Bai Zizai!” shouted Bishui Great Monarch, and then he was cut into half by the sword energy. However, it did not just stop there. The tremendous force contained in the sword energy then proceeded to destroy Bishui Great Monarch’s body completely.
Jiang Ming snapped his fingers, and three sword energies appeared. In an instant, the strongest three of the four Primal Spirits who had just attacked the Jiuyang Sect were exterminated.
He decided to leave the last one as a practice dummy for the Jiuyang Sect. He did not kill the other disciples of the Bishui Sect as well.
He glanced at his Junior Sister again and left.
He was going to make use of the three minutes granted to him by the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card.
On Chuyang Peak…
Zi Linglong appeared as soon as the Jiuyang Sect was under attack. She looked at her Senior Brother’s room and heaved out a sigh of relief after seeing a formation encircling his room.
“I never knew someone would attack us at this time. The original trajectory is a complete mess now!” Zi Linglong sighed inwardly.
She had also decided that if the Jiuyang Sect couldn’t get through this, she was going to bring her Senior Brother away from here.
She came to the site and noticed that the formation protecting the sect had been destroyed.
Four Primal Spirit martial artists were hovering in the air, and several members of the Bishui Sect were casting their special abilities.
Suddenly, she jerked her head to the side.
“Who is that person? He’s strong, much stronger than anyone I’ve ever known. I can sense more than ten types of Dao rhythms from him, and he has mastered every single one of them!?” Zi Linglong exclaimed.
In the next second, sword energy appeared in the sky.
“The Slice the Heavens sword technique? But there isn’t anyone in the Qingyun Sect who could perform this special ability at this level!”
The man who had killed Bai Yu the other day appeared in Zi Linglong’s head. However, this man was obviously stronger than the one who had killed Bai Yu.
Then, she saw three of the four martial artists in the air explode into a blood mist.
“Who is he? The person who killed Bai Yu last time also used the special ability from the Qingyun Sect. However, I don’t know if he was there to kill Bai Yu or to save me. And now, this one over here is even stronger. Is he here to save us?”
Zi Linglong’s head was a muddled mess.
Suddenly, she felt that the man was looking at her.
“The way he looks at me…” Zi Linglong’s eyes widened as her heart raced. “Why does it look so much like Senior Brother?”
At Hai Province…
Jiang Ming had come to the main body of the Bishui Sect.
“All of you are going to die today!”
Jiang Ming raised his arms without any hesitation,?and thousands of lightning bolts fell onto the buildings below, destroying everything and killing everyone in them.
“Next…”
The Human Paths Record appeared.
Ling Han, the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect had gone back, so he couldn’t kill him.
He then looked at Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Zhou Tian was weak and even his guardian was just a Primal Spirit martial artist. Killing him would be a waste of time.
Suddenly, he stopped flipping across the book.
This page showed the information of Tian Ci.
He had no idea why, but at the moment he saw his name, he had a hunch that he was going to become his enemy if he did not kill him now.
“Alright, it’s you then!” Jiang Ming said as he disappeared again.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - Killing the Immortal Fetus
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Killing the Immortal Fetus
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At the intersection of Eastern Region and Zhong Province…
There was a deep chasm, stretching 30,000 miles across with mountains extending on both sides. The roars of tigers and screeches of eagles echoed from time to time, and there were fewer animals here.
Tian Ci came out of a valley.
“Well, it seems like today is my lucky day. I just came out for a walk to lighten my mood. Who knew I would run into an immortal’s cave left behind by a Paradis martial artist?” Tian Ci said while playing with a tiny blade in his hand. The sword energies the blade released from time to time were so powerful they could destroy a mountain with ease.
He leaped into the air and stood on top of a mountain. As he took in the mountain ranges and the deep abyss, the fight he had with Zi Linglong at Reception Peak appeared in his mind.
“I’m an Immortal Fetus with great talent, yet I was defeated by a little girl. What a disgrace!” Tian Ci’s face sank.
“I should’ve taken my greatest weapon out and destroyed her along with the Jiuyang Sect,” he said, but then he sighed.
“Unfortunately, Qing Fengzi from the Qingyun Sect and Old Tie from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion were there at that time. Why were they so free? Did they not have other things to do? Why must they show up in a fight between the people of the younger generation?” Tian Ci shook his head.
“I must work harder and fuse both the Light Dao Seed and the Dark Dao Seed to form the Dao of Light and Dark. Then, I’ll ascend into the Nascent Soul Realm and form my Primal Spirits. After I return to the school, I’ll not come out of my seclusion until I’ve stepped into the Primal Spirits Realm!”
He had a clear plan for his future.
“Just you wait, Zi Linglong. After I come out of seclusion, I’ll definitely make you yield to me. I want you to be my slave to make up for what you did to me!”
Tian Ci let out a breath. Suddenly, a storm came, and a human figure appeared about 100 feet away from him. Tian Ci did not know who the newcomer was, but he did not have a good feeling about it as fear began to grow in his heart.
The person was none other than Jiang Ming.
Even though he had been 1,000,000 miles away from Tian Ci, he was able to locate him through the Human Paths Record.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!”
Jiang Ming formed the divine seal with his hand as soon as he appeared. The divine seal materialized in the sky and even the night sky dimmed.
Tian Ci opened his mouth, but no voice could come out.
The descending divine seal was so powerful that it exceeded his limit. It caused the Artifacts in his body to be awakened one after another as they came to protect their master.
A pagoda appeared on top of him, a mirror in front of him, and battle armor on his body. All of them were top-grade defensive Dao Vessels.
“What the heck!?” Jiang Ming cursed after seeing those Dao Vessels.
“He truly is beloved by heaven! Very well, then! I would like to see who is stronger, you or me!”
After that, Jiang Ming poured the power of the Dao of Great Decimation into the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, further amplifying its power to a shocking degree in a few seconds.
Bam!
When the divine seal dropped, the pagoda was crushed, the mirror broke, and the armor on Tian Ci’s body began to dissipate.
As a hopeless expression appeared on Tian Ci’s face, he exploded into a blood mist.
It took Jiang Ming only one divine seal to destroy three top-grade Dao Vessels and kill Tian Ci.
However, Jiang Ming suddenly squinted his eyes and looked into the distance.
He sensed Tian Ci’s presence over there.
“Puppet Substitution?”
He looked toward where Tian Ci was located and saw a broken wooden doll, which then exploded and disappeared.
“Who would have expected him to have such an ability to save his *ss!”
Just as Jiang Ming was about to go after Tian Ci, someone came.
“How dare you! How dare you try to harm the Immortal Fetus? You must have a death wish!”
It was a middle-aged man. He threw something into the air, and a web appeared in the sky. It covered the entire area around Jiang Ming as it tried to pin him down.
Unfortunately, Jiang Ming was a tad faster.
He located Tian Ci with the Human Paths Record and sent his decoy after him.
Then he clapped his hand and turned it over. His palm was pointed outward, and his thumbs and forefingers were interlocked, forming a heart shape aimed at the incoming person.
“Nine Heavenly Cannon!”
Bam!
A crimson light burst forward, engulfing the net-like Dao Vessel as well as the incoming person.
The effect of the Dao Vessel disappeared, and the middle-aged man was gone.
Considering Jiang Ming’s current power, even the most ordinary special ability would have devastating effects.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped open, and the information about the middle-aged man appeared.
Name: Liu Yuan
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Paradis Realm.
Background: Grand Elder of the Tianyuan School
Relationship: -99
Status: His time was drawn near, and he knew he had no hope in making any progress in his cultivation anymore. He was delighted at the emergence of Tian Ci, the Immortal Fetus, and proposed himself to be his guardian. He followed Tian Ci to Eastern Region but just watched him from afar. He was happy to see that Tian Ci was able to appear victorious from every fight he had fought.
Initially, he thought Tian Ci could make a name for himself after defeating the geniuses in Reception Peak. Little did he expect that Tian Ci would be defeated by Zi Linglong. He was furious at that time, but he sighed inwardly.
‘People always say that there is always another heaven beyond this one. I didn’t expect that there would be such a powerful being in a small place like this one.’ He felt that he should recruit Zi Linglong into the school after escorting Tian Ci back to the school.
He followed behind Tian Ci while on the way back. However, someone appeared and destroyed three Artifacts of Tian Ci. While he was infuriated, he was stunned as well. He hurriedly informed the Supreme Elder in the school and went forward to buy some time.
After watching Tian Ci being blown up and surviving the hit through a special method, he knew he had to step forward even if he was going to die. In the meantime, he hoped that the Supreme Elder would come as soon as possible so that Tian Ci could escape with his life.
He was disappointed at the fact that he was going to die before he could see Tian Ci grow to his full might.
Jiang Ming read and understood the middle-aged man’s information in a second. At the same time, he learned that the Supreme Elder of the Tianyuan School was heading there.
In the meantime, his decoy had arrived on top of Tian Ci.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!”
This decoy had 1/10 of his original power. He flipped his palm, and the divine seal fell downward.
“Who are you? Why do you want to kill me?” Tian Ci asked, his voice desperate.
However, he did not receive any response.
Rumble!
The seal fell, and Tian Ci’s rigid body began to fall apart. Just when he was about to explode into a blood mist, his forehead began to slip from the center. A weapon within his soul, unknown even to him, suddenly awoke.
A terrifying aura swept across the area, and everything stopped moving for a second.
The divine seal was still falling, but it had slowed down.
Suddenly, a sword appeared from the center of Tian Ci’s forehead. It shot into the sky, destroying the divine seal along with Jiang Ming’s decoy.
However, it did not just stop there. The sword locked onto Jiang Ming and flew directly toward his soul in the sea of consciousness.
“An Immortal Weapon!?” Jiang Ming exclaimed, his voice filled with trepidation.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - Invincible Ye Ming, Overwhelming Those of His Era, Mystical Light Weapon
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Invincible Ye Ming, Overwhelming Those of His Era, Mystical Light Weapon
The luminous sword massacring everything gave Jiang Ming the jitters. He actually felt he did not have any confidence to take that head-on.
This only explained one thing—the long sword that suddenly appeared from Tian Ci’s forehead was not of top-grade for he had already broken three of them. They were too fragile!
Nor was it an Imminent Immortal’s weapon. Thus, it should be a Forged Immortal Weapon!
Nevertheless, even if the weapon expended every bit of its power, it could only be on par with the Imminent Immortal level due to the absence of its owner.
Thus, even if Jiang Ming was not confident enough to completely take him down, at least he could completely withstand the attack.
He quickly came to a conclusion based on Tian Ci’s Status and the sheer terror of that sword.
Bang!
The space behind him suddenly burst. Jiang Ming took a step back into the void trying to avoid the fury of the sword’s slash.
However, the feeling of being targeted like it was a shadow never faded, and the tip of the sword was slashing onward through space, getting closer and closer.
“I can’t avoid this?” Jiang Ming was getting terrified.
He quickly lifted his hand and slashed in the air, creating a void in between. The void looked as if it was near, yet it was actually miles and miles between them.
Puff!
However, the sword still penetrated easily.
“What now?”
In the blink of an eye, he thought of using the physical matter of the Human Path Record to block off the attack. At the last minute, however, he grabbed onto the Human Path Record, flipped it before him, and directly cut the sword targeting him.
Jiang Ming quickly dashed up into the air and left. Meanwhile, the sword which lost its target had to go back where it came from.
Coming back to reality, Jiang Ming rested atop a mountain.
He called up his Human Path Record.
Name: Tian Ci
Race: Immortal
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Contemporary Senior Brother of the Tianyuan School (Chenguang Immortal Mansion)
Relationship: -97
Innate talent: Immortal (Immortal Fetus, a reincarnated wisp of immortal soul)
Status: He left the Jiuyang Sect after losing the battle. He found and benefited from the ruin of a Paradis expert. As he hurried back to the school, he was hunted down.
‘The three top-grade Dao Vessels were completely destroyed. How absurd is his strength to be able to destroy even top-grade Dao Vessels with just a special ability?
‘Luckily, I have a Puppet Substitution Talisman to avoid the fatal attack, though all of my equipment was completely destroyed.’
He was ecstatic upon seeing the timely arrival of Liu Yuan, his guardian. He quickly retreated even further, praying that his guardian was able to hold the fort longer. Unfortunately, his guardian was instantly killed. He felt despair when he noticed he was being chased again.
He was surprised at the sudden emergence of a sword from his forehead when he was on the brink of death. He sensed its dreadful aura and was bewildered at its ability to force back his opponent.
He was uncertain if the sword was able to take down the enemy when he saw its return. Suddenly, information streamed into him.
He learned that the sword was the Mystical Light Sword. It was a true Immortal Weapon that had transcended the mortal shackles, where only immortals could truly bring out its power. Hidden in it were three instances of Automated Protection, and it had been used once.
‘Why would I have such a weapon? Do I have a hidden identity that I do not know of?’
…
Jiang Ming frowned upon checking Tian Ci’s Status.
He could not imagine how blessed Tian Ci was for not only having three defensive top-grade Dao Vessels but also an Immortal Weapon! To hell with that?
‘There’s still some time!’ Jing Ming thought.
He recreated a clone that only had a fraction of its original power. He thought it would be sufficient.
He projected his clone through the Human Path Record to where Tian Ci was located. However, it was quickly destroyed.
Jiang Ming frowned even more as he traveled through space. In the blink of an eye, he was 1,000 miles away from Tian Ci.
A young man suddenly appeared next to Tian Ci.
Jiang Ming immediately unsheathed his Sky Rending Sword and cast the Slice the Heavens sword technique.
At the same time, his consciousness quickly skimmed through the Human Path Record.
Name: Ye Ming
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: One of the Tianyuan School’s Supreme Elders
Relationship: -82
Innate talent: Immortal (Space Illusion God Body)
Status: A former finest disciple of the Tianyuan School. He is embodied with the Space Illusion God Body. He unintentionally consumed the Ethereal Flower, a type of immortal medicine, and it helped build an absolutely strong foundation.
He started cultivating by the age of 8, broke through to the Foundation Establishment Realm, Core Formation Realm, Golden Core Realm, Golden Core Ninth Stage, and Purple Mansion Realm at the age of 10, 15, 22, 30, and 31, respectively. He managed to form the Spatial Ripple Dao Seed at the age of 32. By the age of 68, he not only completely comprehended all branches of the Space Sambodha, but he also managed to fuse everything together into a Spatial Dao Seed!
Before the age of 75, he defeated all Holy Sons, Holy Daughters, cultivators with God and Saint Bodies, overwhelming those of his era. He took down demons and dismayed many geniuses. He was the target of assassination countless times but still managed to pull through.
In the same year, he met a woman and fell deeply in love, but his cultivation was still growing drastically. He perfected the Spatial Dao Seed at the age of 78, broke through to the Nascent Soul Realm at the age of 79, and then to the Primal Spirit Realm at the age of 80.
When he was 100 years old, he pioneered in the Paradis Realm, creating a huge uproar. After he came out of seclusion, he overwhelmed everyone at his level and could even take down those Extreme Path experts, rendering him unbeatable.
He broke through to the Extreme Path Realm at the age of 120 but was back-stabbed by his wife, who wanted to make him her servant. Even though he pulled through the whole ordeal, the whole incident left him with not only a scar in his cultivation path but also a scar in his heart.
After investigating further, he found out that the love of his life was actually the secret disciple of the Qiqingmo Sect, who were trained specifically to seduce the world’s best geniuses. However, his determination toward his cultivation remained unwavering, and she could not find the opportunity to strike. Feeling that her chances had been getting slimmer, she took action when he started ascending into the Extreme Path but failed.
He retreated into cultivation to recover from the injury and rarely ever acted.
He sometimes revealed himself in the school to check up on the disciples but was not satisfied with them. It was only until he discovered Tian Ci that he was pleased. After much investigation, he discovered that Tian Ci was not only an Immortal Fetus but also had exceedingly good fortune. He was so lucky that he obtained the top-grade Protective Body Armor Dao Vessel and the Changlan Mirror by himself!
He occasionally checked on Tian Ci with the intent of training him. He even gave him a top-grade Dao Vessel, the Nine Reincarnation Glass Pagoda, to protect himself.
When he heard that Tian Ci was out with Liu Yuan as his guardian, he was not worried at all. Still, in order to avoid any unexpected incidents, he gave Liu Yuan a token to call him immediately if anything bad happened.
Upon receiving Liu Yuan’s distress call, he quickly tracked the token down and ripped the void apart only to arrive and see someone trying to kill Tian Ci. Enraged, he immediately slaughtered that person.
Jiang Ming was astonished when he looked at Ye Ming’s incredibly detailed Status, which never happened. Moreover, it could be said to be the most detailed intel the Human Path Records had ever produced.
Jiang Ming felt that Ye Ming was a great enemy of his because he actually had Immortal innate talent. Ye Ming was also a pinnacle Extreme Path expert, who was specializing in Spatial Sambodha. His strength was no weaker than an Imminent Immortal expert.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming was not afraid.
“How dare you hunt down my school’s genius and kill my Supreme Elder! You are looking for your own death!” Ye Ming roared.
Meanwhile, he wielded his sword, slashing and dispersing Jiang Ming’s attack.
He then pushed Tian Ci to the top of a mountain located 1,000 miles away.
Ye Ming waved his hand without even looking back. He invoked the power of spatial order and set a peerless Formation around Tian Chi.
“Great technique!” Jiang Ming applauded with his eyes lit.
Meanwhile, his body steadily grew taller until it was 3 miles high. His aura, particularly his blood, increased many folds that made it feel like the waves were hitting against everything. The surrounding area was at the brink of destruction under such immense power.
Jiang Ming cast the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi at Ye Ming with the Sky Rending Sword. He then swapped it with the Tyrant Halberd as he lunged toward Ye Ming.
At the same time, he secretly created a clone and projected it above Tian Ci using the Human Path Records. It flipped its palm and cast the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal..

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - Akasa Gate, Seizing, Splitting Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Akasa Gate, Seizing, Splitting Heaven and Earth
Tian Ci heaved a sigh of relief inside the formation.
‘Even though the Elder Ye Ming is only an Extreme Path expert, he isn’t afraid of any Imminent Immortal expert in the school. He is the strongest in his generation. It is said that his Spatial Dao is up to the point of perfection. He can go anywhere without leaving a trace. Thus, he is unthreatened by any of the Imminent Immortal experts. I’m safe because he’s here,’ Tian Ci thought, but he suddenly felt uneasy.
He raised his head only to see a giant palm falling on him from above.
“This is Elder Ye Ming’s formation! How is it possible for him to infiltrate without anyone noticing?” Tian Ci was beyond startled.
His physical body was deteriorating, and his forehead split again, revealing the sword tip, which neutralized the attack from the giant palm. The immortal sword glimmered in bright arrays shuddered for a bit before withdrawing from the scene.
On the other end…
Jiang Ming launched a barrage of Formless Sword Qi, prompting the void to crumble. A void akin to a black hole was formed, pulling Ye Ming into it and trying to shred him to bits.
Jiang Ming hastily raised up the halberd as he released a surge of tremendous strength. He ripped apart the night sky, shook the stars, and dimmed the night sky.
Yet, right when it happened, numerous spatial doors formed at the center of the crumbling void as Ye Ming barged out of it, escaping narrowly.
“To think that your Spatial Dao is not inferior to mine. How have I not heard of you?” Ye Ming was surprised.
Jiang Ming did not answer as he swung the halberd aiming at him.
“Akasa Gate!” Ye Ming’s pupil shrank as countless Akasa Gates closely appeared around him, each with a figure of himself standing in it.
This was Spatial Dao at its pinnacle, yet it still shattered under the halberd’s attack.
“Great special ability!” Jiang Ming gasped in applause, but his eyes were locked onto Ye Ming’s real self.
Ye Ming’s Spatial Dao was formidable. But at the same time, Jiang Ming was not at the weaker end of the match.
‘Five Elemental Dao, Yin-Yang Dao, Light-and-Dark Dao, Life-and-Death Dao, Reincarnation Dao, Demolition Dao…’ Jiang Ming thought and cast his Paradis projection.
Jiang Ming’s Paradis projection encompassed various Daos, covering thousands of miles in a blink of an eye, then condensing to only a 100-mile radius.
As his Paradis projection took over the area, the space itself started to shatter layer by layer, forcing Ye Ming out in the open.
“This, this, how is this possible!?” Ye Ming sensed numerous types of Dao around him. Even with his Dao, he couldn’t keep his composure as he was bewildered.
Ye Ming had had to do his best to master the Spatial Dao completely, even with his talent and wisdom. Yet, this person right here just conjugated so many different terrifying Daos, each Dao reaching the pinnacle of mastery!
At that very moment, Ye Ming was surrounded and chained by numerous Dao energies, which drowned him like a swamp.
He shuddered, releasing bursts of energy. His Forged Immortal Sword started to hum profusely, completely awakening to its full power. He slashed through the air, dispersing numerous Daos all at once. Just as he was about to struggle free, the Tyrant Halberd’s attack was already on top of his head.
He had no way to escape, for he was under spatial confinement, with the surroundings swamped by the Dao energy.
Clang!
Ye Ming kept his composure and slashed onward another wave to counteract the halberd’s attack but to no avail.
A bright ray of light shone atop his head as a mystical bell emerged, ringing profusely and penetrating the 99 layers of space. It radiated continuous waves of mystical lights in successions, trying to protect him.
Bang!
The glowing light shattered, bombarding the mystical bell away.
Ye Ming’s pupil shrank. Never did he expect that the bell would fail to withstand even a single blow from the halberd. As he swung his head, the halberd struck his shoulder.
Crackle!
As the bursting sound from the attack echoed, a silver battle armor hidden under his skin surfaced with numerous cracks from shattering. The cracking sound from bones fissuring could be heard coming from his shoulder as blood came bursting out.
Neverending energy traveled along his body, causing Ye Ming to tremble intensely.
At the brink of death, he unleashed all of his strength to withstand the damage.
Jiang Ming’s Tyrant Halberd suddenly rebounded and burst into pieces, unable to withstand the sheer strength of Ye Ming’s power.
Jiang Ming was about to continue with his barrage of attacks when his pupil shrunk suddenly. He then dashed in retreat into the void.
The Mystical Light Sword chased Jiang Ming into the void, hunting him down.
Ye Ming exhaled a breath of rotten breath as he was startled over the whole ordeal.
“That was too close to death! How can there be such a terrifying existence in the Human world?” Ye Ming was frightened.
He recalled the moment he reached this place and saw a sword merging into Tian Ci’s forehead. He was already startled when it happened.
That power was something that had transcended the normal human world. At first glance, he could already tell that the weapon was an Immortal Weapon—an authentic Immortal Weapon, not some forged imitation.
He was perplexed, wondering how Tian Ci owned such an immortal weapon.
Puzzled as he was, yet another abnormal existence appeared before him.
“I even heard that Tian Ci was defeated in battle by some 10-yearish little girl, sigh!” Baffled, Ye Ming felt as though he had really grown old.
Reaching up into the void, he took a bottle of potion out of the bright light from thin air. Upon consuming the potion, his shoulder that was supposed to be nearly obliterated quickly started to heal.
The mystical bell came flying back to him with a simple thought. Unexpectedly, the radiance on it had dimmed down.
Ye Ming put the mystical bell away and leaped high into the air, standing in midair. Behind him, layers and layers of Shadow Voids emerged as he was prepared for the worst.
Suddenly, the Mystical Light Sword that was hunting Jiang Ming down turned around abruptly, slitting into the huge formation far away.
Ye Ming thought, ‘How did he manage to infiltrate the formation to assassinate Tian Ci and evoke the Immortal Weapon again? I myself formed the formation, and yet I never sensed him penetrating into it!’
He felt the whole ordeal was becoming more and more out of hand. ‘Forming a clone to assassinate Tian Ci during our battle without me ever knowing! I can no longer hold back my curse! F*ck!’
As the whole thing ran through his mind, an array of light suddenly came out of his body, forming a silhouette of himself. It was projected into the formation directly, arriving by Tian Ci’s side.
At that moment, Jiang Ming leaped out of the void once again, launching his attacks.
“Die!”
Jiang Ming never uttered a word, but he conjugated the Great Akasa Divine Hand with a wave of his hand, encompassing the whole region and confining the space itself. The whole area was confined under the Divine Hand, making it impossible for the enemy to hide or escape.
Woosh!
Ye Ming’s figure swayed once again this time creating 9,999 Akasa Gates. He leaped into one of them, keeping himself out of reality by staying inside the pocket of space.
Even if more than half of the Akasa Gates were destroyed by Jiang Ming, more than hundreds of them were left.
Ye Ming said, “I’ve merged into the void, constantly existing in thousands and thousands of spatial nodes, ever moving in this 10,000-mile radius. Unless you can completely seal off this whole area here and force yourself through layers of space, you won’t be able to lay a finger on me! You possess the power to penetrate through many, but I’ve mastered the essence of space, making me unparalleled at dodging and escaping!”
Forced by Jiang Ming, Ye Ming could only use this plan. The truth was, it was an act of desperation.
Since Ye Ming could not fight Jiang Ming head-on, he could only stall for time.
“Your skills are indeed impeccable, but…” Jiang Ming smiled in reply, “But you were never my target in the first place!”
Ye Ming suddenly looked over to the formation afar.
Once again, hundreds and thousands of Spatial Gates emerged, each with a figure in it, looking in the same direction and radiating a haunting feeling.
Inside the formation…
Two of Jiang Ming’s clones emerged, one fending against Ye Ming’s clones and the other trying to cut down Tian Ci again.
Boom!
The formation completely burst open almost immediately. Jiang Ming’s clones were quickly taken care of by the Mystical Light Sword.
“Damn it! I’ve used up all three times!” Tian Ci was beyond terrified, yet he could not do anything.
There was no use escaping while facing such impeccable existence. Unless he managed to escape into the Tianyuan School, he would be hunted down in just a matter of seconds.
He could only put all his hopes on Ye Ming.
On the other side…
A part of Jiang Ming’s consciousness was on the Human Path Record.
Person: Ye Ming
Status: Currently fighting against a formidable opponent that is adept in many different Daos! ‘Truly incredible! In the Dao Realm, this person completely overwhelms me to the point that I cannot even fight back. This person is too strong, to the point that I doubt he is even human!’
Tian Ci’s Immortal Weapon emerged and fended off the opponent upon sensing that he was almost taken down. In a blink of an eye, pertaining to the current situation, he could only think of using Akasa Gate to trade attacks, teleporting back and forth hundreds and thousands of miles, not giving the opponent any chances of subjugating him.
He needed to spare a portion of energy to protect Tian Ci simultaneously!
After Jiang Ming finished reading, he thought, ‘Adapt as you wish for I have already completely seen through you. Prance around anywhere you want. You won’t be able to escape from my hand. Perceiving the future and anticipating the opponent’s moves, it is as simple as that.’
Upon seeing the Mystical Light Sword’s slash launching at him again, Jiang Ming leaped into the void again.
