Ye Ming wanted to stop him from escaping, but he felt the sword’s attack would target him if he were to be near the sword.
Ye Ming was rather speechless.
Within the void, Jiang Ming held the Human Path Record in his hand. A simple flick, and he could already disjoin the Mystical Light Sword from locking on.
The Mystical Light Sword lost its target and swirled around for a while before heading back to where it came from.
Woosh!
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record.
Person: Tian Ci
Status: ‘God, who is this person? Why is he trying to kill me? Why can’t my Mystical Light Sword kill him? Why can’t Supreme Elder Ye Ming protect me?
‘I’m screwed. This is already the third time the Mystical Light Sword launched its attack. If it returns to me, its power will completely cool down, and there will not be any auto protection ability left. I can only wait until I have fully mastered elementary control before I can use it again!
‘The Mystical Light Sword has returned. I am done for!
‘Damn this Supreme Elder Ye Ming! Isn’t he the legendary impeccable one? How can he be so weak!?
‘What about the old ones from the school? Why haven’t they arrived!?’
At that moment, Tian Ci noticed in front of him two human figures.
The two human figures that literally brought him into despair
This time, Jiang Ming conjured two clones, sending them over using the Human Path Record as a guide! One of them caught onto the returning Mystical Light Sword while the other charged up for Heaven Suppression Divine Seal!
Just when everyone thought he was going to be successful, the space warped suddenly. Two Akasa Gates appeared. Two hands reached out of the Akasa Gates each, with the palms smacking the two clones.
At the same time, another clone emerged behind the two clones.
Although all of them were dispersed, it was that slight break of time that changed everything.
The first clone managed to grab ahold of the Mystical Light Sword but was quickly destroyed by the sheer formidable power in it.
On the other side, as the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal almost landed its killing blow onto Tian Ci, the space suddenly shattered and an old, skinny, skeleton-like hand appeared, dispersing the clone.
However, the sheer power bursting out gave Tian Ci’s whole body a concussion, nearly bursting his body into piles of blood.
“How dare you lay your hands on the disciples of my school!?”
A deep and decrepit voice was heard transmitting through layers of space, filled with anger.
Such tremendous strength felt as if it could overtake Ye Ming.
“Do you think your school is invincible?” Jiang Ming huffed, and even more clones emerged densely around Tian Ci.
The numbers were no less than tens of thousands, taking over the area.
“How can he conjure up so many of them?” exclaimed Ye Ming.
He quickly leaped to Tian Ci’s side and marked a boundary with a wave of his arm, creating a defensive barrier.
At the same time, he splashed Nature Fluid onto Tian Ci’s body, which seeped in and rejuvenated his vitality that was almost snuffed out.
When Jiang Ming’s clone was destroyed upon grabbing onto the sword, he could feel that the Mystical Light Sword was already very weak. His true self could surely handle its remaining power.
“Knew you were gonna try and snatch it! Die!”
The void suddenly cracked open right next to the Mystical Light Sword. An old man with a long sword at hand dashed out, slashing at Jiang Ming’s true body.
“As many clones as may be, as long as I can lock on to you, the spell will break easily!”
Bang!
A loud explosion echoed as the light from the sword split apart heaven and earth..

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - Tri-Immortal Slash, Acheron Water, Forbidden Place
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Tri-Immortal Slash, Acheron Water, Forbidden Place
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming frowned. He knew a person like Tian Ci would be very hard to kill but never expected it to be this hard.
Tian Ci had three top-grade Dao Vessels for protection, a Puppet Substitution Talisman, three times protection from the Mystical Light Sword, and the protection from a Paradis guardian.
After killing Liu Yuan, the guardian, Ye Ming made his entrance. He was an Extreme Path expert who used to be an overwhelming genius from the past. As Ye Ming had also completely mastered the Spatial Dao, he could challenge an Imminent Immortal expert. Hence, he was indeed a terrifying character that stood atop the pinnacle of the world.
Even so, Tian Ci could have been completely taken down with the use of the Human Path Record’s layers of calculations. But at the last moment, yet another peerless expert emerged.
The aura from the person itself gave people a sense he had gone through the limits of many Daos, sending chills down people’s spines.
This man was obviously not an Extreme Path expert but one level above, an Imminent Immortal expert.
An Imminent Immortal could be labeled as a Pseudo Immortal or a Para-Immortal. This was akin to the Immortal of the mortal world. In other words, an Imminent Immortal was half a step beyond the mortal world, a real transcendence.
It never crossed Jiang Ming’s mind that the whole ordeal would invoke the appearance of such a formidable existence. It did not matter if Tian Ci was a distinctive genius. He was just a small character in the Dao Seed Realm.
Having a Paradis protector was already absurd. Then one of the Extreme Path experts joined the fray, and now even one of the Imminent Immortal experts appeared.
Damn! Was he God’s favorite?
“So what if he is in the Imminent Immortal Realm?”
Jiang Ming grabbed onto the Mystical Light Weapon in one hand while he clenched the other hand into a fist and charged onward.
His fist broke through the void itself, creating a dark hole in the process. Even the sky itself started to tremble and warp. Its strength was beyond imagination.
Bang!
The clashing of swords sent the old man flying backward. As he was pushed back with tremendous force, he left a huge deep trail and shattered countless mountain peaks along the way. By the time he came to a stop, he was already thousands of miles away.
“Such power?” exclaimed the old man. “You are only of the Extreme Path Realm, yet you manage to disperse such formidable strength? Is this because of absolute physique? Topping off with the Three-Fold Astral Transformation from the Infinite Alchemy Pavillion?”
“So what if it’s true?”
“Tri-Immortal Slash!” The old man simply twisted his neck and unleashed a formidable special ability. The luminous glow from its slash was akin to riding the waves of the galaxy, cutting through layers of space.
Jiang Ming was pushed back by it, but only a few hundreds of miles.
In his grip, the Mystical Light Sword was violently shaking as it tried to break free from him. Much to its dismay, after using up all three instances of power endowed to protect its master, how could it escape with only its own spiritual power left?
Jiang Ming tried to keep the sword back in his spatial ring, but the ring could not contain it. He could not contain the sword in his body without refining it either.
Just when Jiang Ming was in a dilemma, he suddenly looked at the Human Path Record. He had a sudden moment of inspiration and inserted the long sword straight into the Human Path Record. To his surprise, the sword went right into it.
Jiang Ming’s eyes gleamed brightly.
Among one of its pages, the symbol of a long sword appeared with a description: Mystical Weapon Mysterious Light Sword. Marked by an Immortal Being. When activated, it brings forth the strength of an Immortal Being.
Side Note 1: If used not by the owner, the person will be killed by the Immortal Beings power.
Side Note 2: Mana can be inserted into the weapon to cleanse the sword.
Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched upon reading the description.
This was a time bomb waiting to go off if not for the Human Path Record. If he activated the sword and the power of the Immortal Being trying to cut himself descended, that would have been a headache.
He punched forward with both his fists without hesitation and shattered the three sword attacks just like that, leaving only three white marks on his fists.
“Is that all?” Jiang Ming scowled as he launched himself at Tian Ci.
Ye Ming’s eyes gleamed. He wanted to rechallenge Jiang Ming, but he knew it was not the right time. He quickly grabbed Tian Ci, who had partially recovered, entered the void, and hurried back to the Tianyuan School.
“Take that again!” The old man’s attack had already come flying toward him. This time, the attack was wrapped in a blue aura.
Jiang Ming suddenly felt uneasy and quickly shifted his body, sidestepping into the air to avoid the attack.
“You insidious old thing!” Jiang Ming cursed at the old man.
Name: Liu Changkong
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Imminent Immortal Realm
Background: One of the Supreme Elders of the Tianyuan School
Relationship: -81
Innate talent: Immortal (Sword Skeletal Body)
Status: One of the strongest martial artists in the Tianyuan School. He was once a person of influence back in the days, loathed evils, and was the main force to subjugate the demons. As the Demons force weakened, he retreated in hiding to mediate and comprehend the Dao.
During meditation, he got a message from Ye Ming. He ripped apart space and came, saving Tian Ci in the nick of time. When Ye Ming informed him of the whole ordeal telepathically, he was shocked and acted without hesitation. After all, as a Supreme Elder of the Tianyuan School, how could he allow his school’s disciple to be bullied by others? Only he could be the one bullying the disciples!
‘The opponent can even withstand the attack from my Forged Immortal Weapon. His absolute physique and his formidable power are unheard of. There is only one way to tackle such a person. To permeate Dark Blue Archeron Water into the sword’s light, corroding his body, eroding his blood vessels, and subjugating him. We will bring him back to the school and investigate further on his background. If he is not of the devil sect, he can still be saved.’
If not for reading the opponent’s history, Jiang Ming would have fallen in his scheme. After all, his physical special ability was not equipped with any special spell.
‘I should go now!’ thought Jiang Ming as he lurched into the void.
“Trying to escape?” Liu Changkong’s sword attack came flying at him, heading straight into the void.
Jiang Ming turned over and launched the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi. Used to its limits, the middle-graded Dao Vessel shattered into pieces.
Nine Instances of Sword Qi came rushing at Liu Changkong, causing the void to crumble and submerging him in it.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming hid his aura with the help of the system and used the Human Path Records to cut off the enemy’s space-lock as he weaved through the layers of space.
After circling around a couple of times, he finally returned to Chuyang Peak quietly, heading back into his room.
“Three minutes, with only about 15 seconds left!” Jiang Ming was constantly keeping time.
It was then that he finally heaved out a breath of relief.
He then scanned through the sect with his consciousness and found out that the sect was still at war.
Gu Hai had returned to Chuyang Peak for support.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong, with her formidable strength, weaved back and forth, slaughtering the Nascent Soul experts from the Bishui Sect. The enemies of Chuyang Peak were decimated regardless of their strength.
After getting rid of the last Nascent Soul expert, she continued launching attacks onto the last Primal Spirit expert that the Sect Master deterred.
‘The whole situation has been set!’ Jiang Ming thought and no longer paid attention.
He did not try to invoke any special ability but took the chance to allow his mind to slowly sink into the heavens and earth, assimilating the power of Time and the wonders of Karma.
This time, he could really feel the Sambodha in-depth, especially on the Karma Dao.
In order to kill Mo Lin, he had lured out Bai Zizai and also the Paradis Bishui Great Monarch. He had had no choice but to invoke the Three-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card.
After killing the enemy by force, he continued to hunt down Tian Ci. As a result, he had elicited Ye Ming and Liu Changkong.
The whole ordeal was so entangled it was hard to explain. This, however, was also a form of Karma.
Jiang Ming now possessed the power to suppress thousand Daos and had Dharma at sight to comprehend its essence slowly. Just like that, the wonders of Karma had slowly stepped into the correct doorway.
Jiang Ming shifted his focus, slowly unraveling the enigma of Time. If he manages to also step into the pathway toward the Time Dao, his Sambodha would truly be perfected. As for the rest of the Daos, it was only a matter of time before completion.
However, even with powers able to suppress thousand Daos, or even the ability to interrupt the cycle of orders, the power of Time still remained vague. It was like a flower reflected in a mirror, a reflection of the moon by the waters, very hard to see time for what it was truly.
In battles, fighters traded blows at a swift pace, but time moved very slowly. Yet, during enlightenment, time passed swiftly.
Jiang Ming suddenly trembled, and his face turned pale. Immense power was drawn away from him.
The eyes which peered into heaven and earth were enveloped by countless layers of curtains that impeded the essence of heaven and earth. Even the heart itself seemed to have become dimmer.
The feeling of immense weakness came surging at him, leaving Jiang Ming feeling as if he had grown very old, unable to lift even a finger.
In actuality, he could still shatter a mountain with his bare hands. But when compared to before, the difference was too big. He was unable to acclimate yet!
Releasing a breath filled with impurities, Jiang Ming closed his eyes as he started to readjust himself.
Inside the Jiuyang Sect…
After Zi Linglong and the Sect Master worked together to defeat the Primal Spirit expert, they returned to Chuyang Peak. They landed on top of Jiang Ming’s building with their hands holding on to their swords, protecting the place.
Meanwhile, in the Tianyuan School…
Upon returning to the Tianyuan School, Ye Ming ensured that Tian Ci was well taken care of and waited for Liu Changkong’s return. The two then went into the Forbidden Place and started deciphering what had happened.
“He mastered the Five Elemental Dao? Yin-Yang Dao? Light-and-Dark Dao? Life-and-Death Dao? Reincarnation Dao? Spatial Dao? Unbelievable! Even the hair on my arms stood tingling at the thought of it! If Tian Ci is like a bright star, then this person is akin to the whole universe itself!”
“His clones are intriguing, but the rest of his special abilities aren’t that many!”
“He has an invincible physique, yet he only just cast the Three-Fold Astral Transformation of the Infinite Alchemy Pavillion. He has not mastered other physical offensive special abilities!”
“Why did he try to kill Tian Ci?”
“Why does Tian Ci hold an immortal sword? It could even protect its master three times!”
“Tian Ci is an Immortal Fetus!”
“That person… is only of the human race, a pure human race. There’s no doubt about it!”
“What is the secret hidden in all this?”
There were many people in the palace of the Forbidden Place.. Each of them was in the Paradis Realm and above.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - She Lunged at Me from the Window, I…
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: She Lunged at Me from the Window, I…
That night, there were many who were rendered sleepless.
One of them would be the Red Mountain Palace, where Bai Zizai resided. Another would be the Yinmo Sect, where Mo Lin was at. The others would be the many people who focused their attention on the whole war.
The most miserable party was none other than the Bishui Sect. Even though some of their disciples managed to escape from the Jiuyang Sect, they could no longer pose any threat to anyone. The sect itself could be considered to have ended.
At the Qingyun Sect…
A jade scroll was floating in front of Qing Fengzi atop a suspended mountain. Rows and rows of words began to stream out of the scroll, appearing out of thin air and radiating bright light.
They were the information they had gathered last night.
“Holy Son Mo Lin from the Yinmo Sect and his guardian have been killed. Bai Zizai of the Red Mountain Palace was nearby and was killed with the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal.
“The Bishui Sect’s Monarch was killed with the Heaven Slicing Sword Technique. The Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning destroyed the sect itself.
“Three of the four Primal Spirit experts were murdered by an unknown expert who escaped. The Jiuyang Sect then killed the remaining Primal Spirit expert. The rest of the disciples were killed, leaving only a portion of them escaping all over.
“From the side of the Nantian Grand Canyon, Tian Ci from the Tianyuan School was attacked, whereas his guardian Liu Yuan was killed by the Nine Heavenly Cannons.
“Ye Ming, who arrived later, almost failed to protect Tian Ci.
“The intimidating blinding light that dispersed was suspected to be from Tian Ci’s hidden Immortal Vessel.
“Liu Changkong arrived in time and forced the enemy to retreat.
“This person has used the following Special Abilities: Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Heaven Slicing Sword Technique, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Nine Heavenly Cannons, and Three-fold Astral Transformation.
“Assumption: The Holy Son from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion was killed by this person.”
“How did such a powerful person suddenly appear out of nowhere? He even specifically used ours and the Infinite Alchemy Palace’s special abilities! Is he trying to pin it on us? If he is, then he is really a fool!” said Qing FengZi as he frowned.
“That’s right! At our level, imitating other people’s special abilities is not hard at all! It would be foolish to think that he can pin this all on us just like that.” Qing Xuzi nodded, standing beside him. “However, based on the information collected on the way to the Bishui Sect and also the remnants from the battlefield where Bai Zizai fell, that person has mastered the Lightning Dao, Earth Dao, Destruction Sword Dao, and the Fire Dao. If all these are from the same person, then this person cannot be taken lightly! Should we ask the Tianyuan School to give us more details on the whole battle?”
“It’s impossible for them to provide more detailed information than this,” said Qing Fengzi as he shook his head. “Anyhow, it’s just another strong opponent. If he dares step into the Qingyun Sect, we can just obliterate them! Though, it is weird. Why would this person help out the Jiuyang Sect? Even if it’s just to help, why would they intentionally leave behind a person of the Primal Spirit Realm to train them? This relationship itself seems to be abnormal! Mo Lin and Tian Ci went to the Jiuyang Sect, and both of them were attacked. Are there any connections between these two incidents? Or is this just a coincidence?”
“We completely understand the Jiuyang Sect’s strength inside out. There’s nothing hidden that we don’t know of. The only variable to this is the sudden rising of Zi Linglong. Being able to defeat so many geniuses when she is merely 10-ish years old is already abnormal. Keep an eye out for the Jiuyang Sect, especially Zi Linglong. I’m afraid the only connection that formidable person has with the Jiuyang Sect is Zi Linglong.”
“What you said makes sense!”
“These are all minor matters. We should prepare ourselves and wait for the Yinmo Sect and Red Mountain Palace to reveal themselves. This time, we will really give them a lesson! They must be punished for making these small movements!”
“Haha, I really do miss the taste of these prawn and crab soldiers, especially those flood dragons’ tendons and real dragons’ livers!” Qing Fengzi laughed. “They are really delicious!”
“Mermaids, dragon women, clam ladies, they are not bad at all!”
“You old man!”
At the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion…
Old Tie stood side by side with a red-clad young man.
They also received the same information.
“Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, Heaven Slicing Sword Technique, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Nine Heavenly Cannons, and Three-fold Astral Transformation. He only used the special abilities from our sects. Trying to pin this on us? It’s all meaningless!”
“Why would you think it’s meaningless? When the Holy Son was killed, you were the first to jump out and force yourself all the way into the Qingyun Sect. I was even forced to follow you all the way!”
“This incident happened in Eastern Region. How is it possible that the Qingyun Sect had nothing to do with it? As I was brimming in anger, it is natural to find some way to vent it all on. What better choice than the Qingyun Sect? It’s a shame that the Qingyun Sect and we haven’t found the culprit behind this. Now we have to deal with yet another person appearing out of nowhere. Even if he is not the one who took the Holy Son’s life, he must be involved one way or another!”
“He will surely be found if he dares to come out in the open. We are not the only ones paying close attention to him. The Qingyun Sect, Tianyuan School, and even the Yinmo Sect are eyeing him as well. But I think that person must have something to do with the Jiuyang Sect. Old Tie, you stayed quite a few days atop the mountain. Did you not find anything out of the ordinary there?”
“Not at all! The only thing that felt off was Zi Linglong. Being able to train up to the Dao Seed Realm at the age of 10 is just incredible. She’s even grasped the Sun Sambodha, comprehended various special abilities, and defeated many strong opponents. I investigated in secret, and there was no sign of her being possessed by someone else. Qing Fengzi also investigated himself and came to the same conclusion. There’s nothing wrong anywhere! We came to the only rationale that the phoenix bloodline she has awakened is abnormal and has inherited the memories from the past!”
“This explains quite a bit. Remember to keep an eye out from now on. Remember, don’t find me over something insignificant. If a Holy Son dies, so be it! A Holy Son that has not been developed is just a good for nothing! It’s not worth it for two Extreme Path Supreme Elders like us to take any action!”
“You’re speaking as if you’ve been a Holy Son yourself!”
“Hmph! I almost beat to death the Holy Son that year. In the end, I had him abused until he was mentally disoriented and went crazy!”
“You’re really a demon!”
Early morning…
“Great dream! Such a great dream!” Jiang Ming exhaled as he pushed open the window. He was in great spirits, inhaled a fresh breath of air, and stretched himself pleasantly.
The formation looming over the room was temporarily deactivated.
His Junior Sister suddenly jumped from the window straight into his arms and softly said, “Senior Brother!”
“What’s this all about, early in the morning?” Jiang Ming was puzzled.
“Last night, the whole sect was in shambles! I thought… I thought I was done for!” she said, finding a comfortable spot to snuggle into.
“Shambles?” Jiang Ming lifted her up onto the table in shock.
However, his Junior Sister would not let go of him.
He could not do anything but continue standing there. He asked in concern, “What shambles? It’s all good as long as you are okay. What about Master?”
“Only a few of the disciples were killed. It was nothing,” said Zi Linglong as she briefly recounted the previous night’s events. Then, she huffed softly. “Senior Brother, I was scared that I might lose you. And I wondered what I could do if it happened…”
The mere thought made her tremble.
“It’s all because I’m too useless. I still need you to protect me!” Jiang Ming sighed, feeling disappointed. He quickly collected himself and said, “I’ve made up my mind. From now on, I will train even harder to protect you. I won’t let you run around out there, getting into fights and killings!”
Zi Linglong giggled with her eyes smiling. “Sure thing, Senior Brother!”
“Alright, let me make you some food to calm down a bit.”
“No need. This is already calming me as it is.”
“You are breaking me in half with your hug!”
“I’ll just put you back together if you break.”
“You think I can still be alive after falling apart like an earthworm?”
“You are like an eel. If I loosen just a bit, you’ll run off! Senior Brother, I was terrified the whole night. Just let me hug you for a little while longer. It feels reassuring by your side!”
Jiang Ming resignedly replied, “Okay, okay, okay!”
While having breakfast on the rooftop…
It was rare to see Gu Hai eating silently. After a long while, he finally uttered, “Based on the initial headcounts, 1/3 of the disciples were killed last night!”
“So many of them?” asked Jiang Ming, in shock.
“The Bishui Sect’s attack was too sudden, and their disciples were too strong. If it weren’t because a few of their higher-ups were killed by someone, the Jiuyang Sect would have been wiped out,” said Gu Hai solemnly.
He looked at Zi Linglong and said, “Little girl, the Qingyuan Sect and the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion invited you to become their disciple, right? Accept it and go. It’s safer, and you can grow much faster there,” Gu Hai said with a bitter face.
“Senior Brother, what do you think?” asked Zi Linglong. She felt afraid as she recollected what had happened the day before.
She then looked attentively into Jiang Ming’s eyes. She felt the gaze from that person seemed very much alike with that of her Senior Brother, but the temperament was obviously different.
The biggest difference was still their cultivation. One was so formidable that he could even shake the sky and mountains. The other was so feeble he could only hide in the mountains.
“Stay. Don’t go anywhere.” Jiang Ming smiled. “In the end, the Bishui Sect is just a foreign influence that dominated Hai Province and launched their sudden attack trying to conquer Qing Province. Now that we have warded them off, the Bishui Sect no longer poses a threat. What are we still afraid of? Each of the influences in Eastern Region has its own distinct domain. Who will dare to act? So, there will not be any more danger in the future. Little girl, do you still want to leave?”
Jiang Ming felt rather nervous..

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - Five-Year Term Finally Arrived! Must be Great!
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Five-Year Term Finally Arrived! Must be Great!
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
“Wherever my Senior Brother is, I will be there!” Zi Linglong replied without hesitation.
Jiang Ming secretly exhaled in relief and smiled. “Don’t worry. I will continue protecting you.”
Zi Linglong’s eyes gleamed brightly.
“You? Able to protect Linglong?” Gu Hai smirked.
“Why can’t I protect her? When she was little, whenever she encountered rats and snakes or mischievously climbed trees and fell off, I was always there to protect her!” Jiang Ming rebutted.
“This time, it’s different! Who knows what other dangers lie in the future? We’ve warded off the Bishui Sect, but what if the devil sects come attacking? Don’t you forget, there was once a platoon of the devil sects hidden right outside of our sect! It’s obvious they were targeting us!” Gu Hai replied sternly.
“Relax, Master. Now that the devil sects have been exposed, why would they come here again? Moreover, our sect is now in hot waters. If we were to leave now, wouldn’t people think bad of our characters?” comforted Jiang Ming.
“You are such a smart talker!”
“I’m just stating the facts.”
None of them wanted to back down.
Three days later, the funeral was held. Jiang Ming also attended. The solemn atmosphere looming over thousands of gravestones left him in an even deeper sentiment. He felt that human life seemed to be so fragile in a world where power was dominant.
‘I must train harder for my Junior Sister,’ Jiang Ming thought.
Upon returning to Chuyang Sect, Jiang Ming went to the veranda at the rooftop. As he lay on the rattan chair, it started to sway gently.
He felt very comfortable, so comfortable that he did not want to move at all. Thus, he thought that some witch must have conjured the recliner.
“Senior Brother,” muttered Zi Linglong as she snuggled up to Jiang Ming. “I’m preparing to retreat for cultivation!”
“Trying to comprehend the Lunar Dao?” asked Jiang Ming.
“Yes, I want to improve myself further! I realized that I am still too weak during the last battle. I almost failed to protect you, Senior Brother,” replied Zi Linglong.
“You little girl. Protecting our home should be my responsibility, yet you are bearing it,” said Jiang Ming.
He was hesitating over whether he should tell her he was the person that night. In the end, he still held back.
If it caused too much of an uproar, rumors would spread, which would only mean trouble.
Jiang Ming flipped his palm, revealing two little gray pebbles. He handed them over to Zi Linglong as he said, “Use them during your cultivation. They are helpful.”
“These are Enlightening Stones!?” Zi Linglong was astounded.
“You recognize these?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“Yes!” Zi Linglong calmed down before continuing. “Can’t you remember I was blessed with the Tomb of Extreme Path? I also found a description about these Enlightening Stones Senior Brother. This is a rare world treasure! How did you get them?”
“Don’t ask. I will just say I don’t know,” said Jiang Ming as he gently stroked her hair.
“Okay, I won’t ask,” answered Zi Linglong like a well-behaved child. “Senior Brother, I think it’s better if you use them for yourself.”
“Don’t be so long-winded and just take them. This is a one-use kind of object. Use it at the right time to get the best out of it.”
“Okay!”
After a while, Zi Linglong returned to her room.
Looking at the Enlightening Stones in her palms, she felt baffled. “Why does Senior Brother own such a thing? Could it be that person that night was in fact Senior Brother? Impossible. My Senior Brother never left my sight! But… Sigh!
“Also, why is it that the Bishui Sect was the first one to attack our sect? Everything is just messed up! It doesn’t matter! If it’s a mess, then it’s a mess! As long as I improve my cultivation base, it’ll be enough to protect my Senior Brother and to overwhelm everything!”
Zi Linglong sat cross-legged on her bed as she took out the Yin spiritual items that she had obtained, absorbing the Dao fluctuations in them and speeding up her comprehension of cultivation.
Time passed by, much like how the river flowed.
Jiang Ming was once again farming behind the mountains.
This time, however, all that he had planted were middle- or top-grade herbs, not knowing what rewards he would get when he reaped his harvests.
In addition, he was finally able to arrange for the Immortal Enlightening Tea Leaf’s seed to be planted in a spiritual fountain located underground. He readjusted the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk, making the formation more discreet and powerful.
Brother Zhang came over once but sat quietly at the side. He was not as carefree as he was in the past. Before leaving, he said that he would be retreating for cultivation as well, trying to ascend into the Purple Mansion Realm.
Chang Yiming came over as well. He sighed a few times before asking for a jar of wine. He chugged down the whole jar with a big gulp and exclaimed, “This feels good!”
“A total waste of provision,” said Jiang Ming, astonished.
“Who asked you to brew them?” Chang Yiming snickered before he suddenly became solemn. He said, “Momo is not doing well. Even though we won in the battle against the Bishui Sect, too many of our brethren fell. Many went to find fault with her. If not for the First Seat Yin Yue feeling nostalgic over the past, she would be in even more trouble.”
Jiang Ming paused in silence for a while before suggesting, “Bring her over to your side. Let her stay and take care of you. You can take care of her as well.”
He still felt a bit remorseful over it. After all, they knew each other.
“There aren’t many people here in Chuyang Peak. It’s better for her to come here. Linglong has a high position here, just a level before the Sect Master. If Momo comes over here, nobody will dare trouble her. She’s all alone now. She will be perfect to accompany you. You can be busy farming, and she can be busy back at the kitchen, such happiness,” replied Chang Yiming.
“Enough! I have my hands full taking care of just one, let alone two,” said Jiang Ming as he rolled his eyes.
Chang Yiming laughed. “Finally, you show your true colors! Such impure thoughts!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
Chang Yiming did not stay for long before leaving as well.
After Chang Yiming left, Jiang Ming sat there for some time before lifting his head and gazing at the floating clouds.
“I have impure thoughts?” he questioned himself.
Alas, he shook his head. “Where in the world is there anyone that is as pure as I am?”
He stood up and slowly strolled back to the back of his house, humming along as he went. “I have myself a bright pearl, a dusty pearl sealed for ages. Now with the dust gone and the pearl shining bright, it will shine upon mountains and rivers, thousands oh thousands of mountains and rivers. One day I will make sure it gleams, gleaming onto my fields~”
Standing in the courtyard, he looked upon Zi Linglong’s window.
He felt the waves of Dao fluctuations dispersing from her room, leaving a chilling sensation akin to the moonlight, like the fog in the winter.
“Did she succeed?” Jiang Ming’s eyes were gleaming in delight.
He called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Zi Linglong
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Golden Core Realm (Ninth Extreme)
Background: Disciple of the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 97
Innate Talent: Primary Daoist Body (High-tier Phoenix Bloodline)
Status: After she defeated Holy Daughters and geniuses, her name spread through Eastern Region and Zhong Province. During the Bishui Sect’s assault, she saw a pair of eyes in the dark, almost similar to her Senior Brother’s. There were too many strong enemies. Thus, she telepathically asked the Sect Master to stall the Primal Spirit expert as she went on to kill the Nascent Soul experts. They successfully protected the sect through a night of much bloodshed.
Although she was victorious, her heart was trembling. If not for that unknown expert lending a hand by fending off against four Primal Spirit experts, she had no idea if she could protect her Senior Brother. She was wondering whether she would go crazy if anything happened to her Senior Brother. She eventually thought she would slaughter the world.
‘Senior Brother actually took out Enlightening Stones!’ She thought it was just unimaginable but didn’t care as they were a gift from her Senior Brother.
After absorbing the Yin spiritual items, plus using one Enlightening Stone, she finally was able to invoke the Extreme Yin Dao and comprehend the Extreme Yin Sambodha.
Jiang Ming had a convoluted smile upon reading the Status. Their relationship had actually risen by 2 points, reaching 97 points. He wondered whether their feelings became even stronger because they were in the face of danger.
“If I die, she might slaughter the world? My oh my Junior Sister!” Jiang Ming was smiling delightedly.
He looked at the main building, and its door was shut tight. That old man was probably out somewhere doing whatever he wanted.
Jiang Ming returned to his room and activated the formation. He temporarily shut Chuyang Peak as he also retreated into cultivation.
His heart and mind started to merge into the heavens and earth as he continued to perceive the wonders of karma.
As he started to feel around, he could sense that many illusionary threads were coming out of him, penetrating into the void and connecting to anything and everything. One of the thickest threads was like a chain in order, extending itself into his Junior Sister’s room.
However, most threads were so fine that they felt they would snap off anytime.
“Karma, karma… It is only the relationships between humans, that is all! Directly connected, relating to one another, or simply existing in a specific time and space can all lead to the birth of karma. There was a saying from the past that was so very true: ‘As long as you are correlated, there will be an exchange of matter.’
“Also, being connected indirectly always ends up with some very important ordeals. I killed Mo Lin, hence my relationship with the Yinmo Sect. I fought against Tian Ci, hence my relationship with the Tianyuan School.
“There are both Good Karma and Bad Karma!”
Jiang Ming was immersed in his feeling of Karma. His comprehension of the Karma Sambodha started to rocket. Whenever he hit a dead end, he would just pop another one of those Enlightening Stones. Even if there were not many of them left, he never cared.
Time flew the quickest during cultivation, yet Jiang Ming was still spending some of his time daily checking on the herbs he grew. It was a shame that the middle- and top-grade ones grew very slowly. Even after being watered with spirit waters, they had only just begun budding.
Splitting firewood, getting water from the rivers, and cooking—these were all his daily routines. Sometimes, he would mix it up a bit and go fishing.
He heard from Chang Yiming that the outside world was tense.
The Qingyun Sect surrounded and started to suppress the disciples of the devil sects, who fought back in madness. The whole situation was becoming more severe. Even water demons had started to emerge from various water regions.
Jiang Ming only listened quietly.
In a blink of an eye, the five-year term had finally arrived.
‘It’s been five years! Time passes ever so quickly! I’m sure this time the system will have a great explosion!’ Jiang Ming was very excited about it.
He had a weird feeling that he might be getting his hand on something that he would have never thought of this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - Verdant Emperor, Supreme Order, Five Minutes
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Verdant Emperor, Supreme Order, Five Minutes
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Time flitted past and would not stop for anyone.
January, the year 9,995 of the Zhou calendar…
As soon as it reached midnight, it marked the fifth year since the awakening of the system. Jiang Ming had been looking for it for a long time.
The westbound sun cast a red glow on the sky and the mountains in the evening.
There were eight dishes and two bowls of soup on the table on the rooftop.
The entire courtyard was filled with the fragrance of the dishes.
“Senior Brother, this is the first time I made shrimp dumplings. Please give it a try,” Zi Linglong said as she placed a dumpling near Jiang Ming’s mouth.
“I’ll do it myself.’
“You used to feed me in the past, so it’s my turn now.”
“I’m not an old man who can’t move anymore.”
“Be good, Senior Brother.”
“A-Alright, then!”
Jiang Ming opened his mouth and ate the dumpling. Then, his eyes glowed, and he exclaimed, “This is so good. You’re even better than me at cooking!”
“Really?”
“Of course! There’s no way I would lie to you!” Jiang Ming said as he wolfed down the rest of the food.
The night came, and the sky was filled with stars.
Jiang Ming sat on the rattan chair, admiring the sky. Zi Linglong washed a plate of fruits and put it on the desk beside him. She poured a cup of tea for herself, went to the other side of the chair, and sat on it.
“Isn’t there another chair on the side?”
“This one is big enough to fit two people, Senior Brother. Let’s share.”
“It’s not that big. Go to the other chair!”
“I’m cold, Senior Brother!”
“Hey, do you think I’d fall for your trap?”
“You don’t love me anymore, Senior Brother? We used to sleep on the same bed when we were kids, remember? How could you do this to me now? I’m so sad…”
“Alright, alright, you’re giving me goosebumps!” Jiang Ming shuddered and hurriedly scooched over.
The wind was warm, and the moon was beautiful.
Seeing that it was almost midnight, Jiang Ming reluctantly sent his Junior Sister away.
After that, he went back to his room and sat on his bed in a lotus position.
He closed his eyes and waited.
Suddenly, he cracked his eyes open, and light burst out in the dark room as the voice of the system rang out in his head.
[Ding: Congratulations to the host for living on Chuyang Peak for five consecutive years and doing at least one kind of labor every day. 2,000 years of cultivation base, 1,000 pieces of top-grade Enlightening Tea Leaf, 1x Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card, 1x Supreme Order, and 1x Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique!]
Although there weren’t many rewards, each of them was good.
‘2,000 years of cultivation base!?’ Jiang Ming was shocked. It seemed to him that the system did not want him to waste his time on collecting mana anymore.
‘Well, this is interesting. 1,000 pieces of top-grade Enlightening Tea Leaf...’
Jiang Ming was certain that its effect would be even better, but he was kind of disappointed at the fact that the system did not give him any Enlightening Stone as a reward.
‘Another one Extreme Path Experience Card? Well, this is a good thing,’ Jiang Ming thought. After all, it could help him to change the tide of the battle in his favor.
When he saw what the Supreme Order could do, Jiang Ming nearly leaped up in shock.
[Supreme Order: A certain being, who had transcended beyond destiny had crafted a supreme pagoda, had distributed different Supreme Orders throughout the entire world. Those who were lucky enough to receive it could enter the pagoda to receive the trial and obtain his legacy or other benefits. Note: It can only be activated with a drop of blood.]
“A being who had transcended beyond destiny? System, on what cultivation base can one transcend beyond destiny?”
However, the system did not reply.
Jiang Ming felt a tingling sensation across his scalp.
‘Transcended beyond destiny, distributing the orders across the entire world. What kind of a monster is he to achieve these feats?’
He commanded his mind to stop going any further and calmed himself down.
He then looked toward the only one special ability in the reward.
[The Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique: After mastering this special ability, one can increase the growth rate of spiritual objects.]
“There is actually a special ability like this?” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed.
Amongst the spiritual plants he was raising right now, middle-grade would need at least 10 years, while top-grade would take at least 100 years before reaching maturity.
He needed to wait for a long time before he could harvest them. Had he not wanted to gamble, he would have planted all the low-grade spiritual herbs.
He looked through the information of the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique and was shocked.
This special ability had three stages. In the first stage, it could increase the growing speed by 10 times. In the second stage, the rate would be increased by 100 times, and in the third stage, 1,000 times.
“Holy moly!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
However, the special ability had its flaws as well. One was that it could only be used on a spiritual plant once, and second, it needed something to facilitate it from running.
“The world is really a big and wondrous place. I didn’t expect someone could create such a special ability. This is just perfect for me!”
Jiang Ming got down from his bed and paced around in his room.
He decided to put the special ability aside first, for he had something else more important to do.
He flipped his palm, and an order appeared.
The order was gold in color, and the word “Supreme” was engraved on it. Other than that, it looked nothing different from other orders.
It couldn’t be activated through mana and couldn’t be destroyed through physical force. It was an order made from an indestructive material.
After thinking for a long while, Jiang Ming dropped a drop of blood on it, but nothing happened.
Since he had already made up his mind, he was not going to regret his decision.
He activated it through his mana, and in the next second, a strong suction force appeared from the order and sucked him into it.
When he finally regained his posture, he took in his surroundings. It seemed to him that he was in a valley, and he had never been there before. He tried to look forward, but there was nothing but a stretch of mountain ranges in his vision.
He began to check himself, but nothing had changed. He could still open the Human Paths Records.
Just when Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh of relief, a majestic voice echoed.
[Jiang Ming, a human from the Tianyuan World favored by destiny who comes here to accept trials. There will be three trials. Once you pass all of the trials, only then can you see the true face of the supreme pagoda. If you fail, your memory of this place will be removed, and you will be sent back to where you come from. At the same time, the Supreme Order will disappear as well!
[Note: Any special abilities or weapons above the level of a middle-grade Dao Vessel are forbidden.
[Note: No matter how long you’re going to stay here, only one hour will pass in the world you are in!
[Note: The first trial will begin in another 30 seconds!]
The divine voice sounded as if it was talking next to his ears, but in fact, the voice entered right into his head.
‘There are trials? And the world I’m staying in is known as Tianyuan World?’
The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips twitched as a stern expression appeared on his face.
Time flitted by, and a figure appeared about 1,000 miles away from him. It was a young man wearing a white robe. His long hair was neatly tied behind his head, his eyes were sharp, and he had a sharply-chiseled face.
As he was coming toward Jiang Ming, he said, “I’m in the same realm as you, and I’m practicing the Five Elemental Dao Seed!
“Five Elemental Great Grinder!”
As soon as he had finished speaking, he threw an attack at Jiang Ming directly.
“He isn’t a puppet!” Jiang Ming said, “Well, this is going to be tough!”
He was in the same realm as Jiang Ming, but he had already mastered the Five Elemental Dao Seed. There were very few people in the Tianyuan World who could master the Five Elemental Dao Seed. In other words, he couldn’t take the young man in front of him lightly.
While Jiang Ming was thinking about how he should deal with the young man, the young man had engulfed him in a torrent of five elemental forces, trying his very best effort to destroy him like a grinder.
“This special ability is even stronger than the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal and the Wooden Dragon! Besides, he has mastered this special ability to the perfect stage, and I’m afraid even Tian Ci wouldn’t be able to take this attack head-on.”
Jiang Ming thought for a while and then delivered a punch at the Five Elemental Great Grinder.
His mana surged through his veins as he collected all his strength on his fist. He delivered another punch at the young man and crushed him.
“Congratulations to Jiang Ming for passing the first trial!”
The voice rang out again, and his surroundings shattered like a mirror. As light began to flash around him, he found that he was standing at one end of a staircase.
He lifted his head and looked up. The stairs were made of jade and extended into mid-air, with a total of 100 steps.
“Jiang Ming, this is your second trial. You will need to climb the heavenly ladder. Reaching the top means you’ve passed the trial, and falling means you’ve failed!” The voice rang out again.
Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted.
‘Climbing the heavenly ladder?’
As he was thinking, he had stepped onto the first step. Suddenly, he felt as if a heavy weight was suppressing him and there was a big stone on his heart.
“Is this trial going to test my willpower?” Jiang Ming speculated.
As he moved on step forward, the weight on his heart would become stronger while his body would become heavier.
However, he had strong willpower, so it did not affect him much.
When he was staying at Chuyang Peak, he might look lazy and weak-willed, but he would do his best in mastering it whenever he comprehended one Dao. It was also considered a form of refining and strengthening his willpower.
As such, he had strong willpower that couldn’t be compared by other people.
Soon, he had arrived at the 89th step.
As his feet landed on the step, something rang through his heart. It felt as if a divine mountain had descended and exerted strong pressure on him, trying its best to crush his willpower.
When he reached the 90th step, the invincible pressure transformed into a sword of light. It flew across the sky and aimed straight at his sea of consciousness.
“This attack is as strong as a strike from a peak Nascent Soul martial artist!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
The sword of light landed, but it did nothing to his sea of consciousness.
Jiang Ming continued to climb the stage.
On the 91st step, the sword of light split into two.
On the 98th step, the sword of light split into nine, each and every one of its attacks equivalent to the full power of a Nascent Soul martial artist.
Jiang Ming was stumped momentarily. However, he soon regained his composure and continued to climb the stairs.
Bam!
The swords of light became even stronger and more terrifying. It was something he had never seen before as the barrage of swords of light dashed toward his sea of consciousness.
“This is equivalent to a strike of a Primal Spirit martial artist!”
This wasn’t a physical attack. Instead, the attack was directed straight into his mind.
Jiang Ming stopped when he arrived at the top, and the pressure he felt disappeared.
His mind also suddenly shone brightly, as if a layer of dust had been wiped away. He was more in tune with heaven and earth.
At that moment, the feeling was akin to when he was drinking the Enlightening Tea.
He knew this was a trial as well as an opportunity.
Suddenly, he felt something and turned around.
In front of him was a big platform, and on top of the platform stood a stone monument. There were countless lines and light dots on it, looking just like stars.
“Congratulations on passing your second trial, Jiang Ming.
“Now, onward to the third trial. In front of you is the Million Mana Monument. You’re required to comprehend a special ability in three days.”
The voice disappeared after it had given its instructions.
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat.
‘I need to comprehend a special ability in three days?’
It took more than three days to learn a special ability, let alone comprehend it.
“The first trial is about combat prowess, and only a genius like Tian Ci has a chance of passing it. The second trial is about willpower, and only a person in the Primal Spirit Realm can pass it. The third trial is about intellect. Unless one is extremely bright, who can accomplish it?”
Jiang Ming shook his head.
Battle prowess, willpower, and intellect—these three represented the innate ability of a living being, and apparently, intellect was more important than the rest of the two.
After all, one just needed to master more special abilities to increase their battle prowess. Willpower could be cultivated as well, but how about intellect?
It was nearly impossible to improve one’s intellect through the help of external force.
“Three days, huh…”
Jiang Ming walked over and sat in front of the stone monument. He wanted to take out an Enlightening Tea Leaf, but he couldn’t do so no matter how hard he tried.
“This ability…”
He felt a chill creeping down his spine.
He turned his head toward the stone monument without thinking twice and was absorbed into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 7 Heavenly Monuments, Seven Dao Monuments, Million Dao Chart, Xinghe World
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: 17 Heavenly Monuments, Seven Dao Monuments, Million Dao Chart, Xinghe World
The light dots became stars while the lines turned into rivers, forming a vast starry universe.
Captivated, Jiang Ming threw himself in it and swam across the universe. Then, he found that every dot was formed with laws, and every line was the chain of order. Together, they formed nature.
There were also Wood Dao, Fire Dao, and Earth Dao. He also saw the Five Elemental, the Decimation, and the Reincarnation, to name a few.
There were even traces of time here.
A surge of great joy and freedom welled up in Jiang Ming’s soul. The light of Dao was bursting from every pore in his body. He just wanted to keep exploring and roaming in this wondrous space in order to ascend to a higher level.
Suddenly, a light dot twitched and formed into a human figure in front of him.
“Junior Sister?”
Jiang Ming’s eyes shone as a smile appeared over his face. Just when he was about to go forward, he suddenly realized something.
He wasn’t at Chuyang Peak!
“I need to comprehend a type of special ability. I can lose myself here!”
He hurriedly calmed himself down. At the same time, he noticed something.
Although it seemed on the surface that comprehending a special ability was the trial, in reality, he had to watch out so that he wouldn’t get too immersed in the sea of Dao. Otherwise, he would have failed the test.
‘Thank you so much, Junior Sister! You really are my lucky star!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed inwardly.
It seemed to him that half a day had passed. Next, he closed his eyes and calmed his mind. A virtual image of himself had manifested behind him, aiding him in comprehending a special ability.
Suddenly, he flipped his hand, and a wisp of fire appeared on his palm. He formed it into a spear and threw it toward the void.
“Congratulations, Jiang Ming on comprehending a fire-type special ability and passing the third trial!” The voice rang out, pulling Jiang Ming back to his thoughts.
Before he could do anything, the things around him began to fall apart, and by the time he appeared again, he found that he was standing on a platform.
He turned his head around to take in the surroundings. It was a wide area, and his eyes couldn’t register anything no matter how far he looked.
‘Where am I?’
No sooner had the thought surfaced in his mind than a voice erupted.
“Finally! A new friend!”
“We have a new companion!”
“I wonder what world he comes from? What are the characteristics of his world?”
“He doesn’t look like a devil or a demon, and he definitely is not a ghost, a sorcerer, or a vessel. Ah, I get it! He’s a human, the master of all different worlds!”
He heard voices coming around him, but he couldn’t see any of them.
In the meantime, a surge of information appeared in Jiang Ming’s head, and he got a basic grasp of the situation after absorbing the information.
This was the third dimensional space of the Supreme Pagoda, and everyone here was in the Dao Seed Realm.
The center was the resting zone of the platform.
People could choose to stay here forever, and no matter how long one stayed here, it would only be one hour in the world outside. However, the flow of time still had an effect on the essence of life itself.
In other words, when the end of life came, one would die as well.
Fighting was prohibited here, but they were allowed to communicate and exchange knowledge with the geniuses from other worlds.
After ascending into the Nascent Soul Realm, they would go to the fourth dimensional space in the Supreme Pagoda. However, they still needed to go through three trials, and if they failed the trials, the Supreme Order would be taken back, and they would forget everything that was related to the Supreme Pagoda. Besides, they would be forbidden from talking about the Supreme Pagoda in their own world.
Jiang Ming turned his head around and began to take in his surroundings.
On the left side of the platform stood 17 Heavenly Monuments of unknown height, and their ends were covered in a veil of cloud, rendering them indistinguishable. All of them were engraved with the basics of the laws and order of the universe, which could be deciphered by consuming points.
The first Heavenly Monument was glowing with a red radiance, and the fire Dao rhythm was flowing in it. It was the Fire Heavenly Monument. The second one gave off a faint green glow, and Jiang Ming could vaguely sense the aura of vitality. This was the Wood Heavenly Monument.
As Jiang Ming continued to observe the monuments, he noticed that each of them represented different Dao rhythms. There were the Wood, Earth, Metal, Water, Wind, Thunder, Light, Dark, Spatial, Time, Reincarnation, Decimation, Karma, Unlimited, Blade, and Illusion Heavenly Monument.
Behind him was the Million Dao Chart, and he could also earn points from there.
“This is… If I stay here and cultivate, wouldn’t it be…”
Jiang Ming’s heart began to race.
He turned his head around and looked to his right.
On the right side of the platform, there were seven Dao Monuments, all of which were imprinted with the basics of the fusion of the Grand Path, and like the 17 Heavenly Monuments, they were tall, and he couldn’t see their ends as well.
The first Dao Monument had the divine light of the five elements around it. It was the Five Elemental Dao Monument. The second monument was covered in the light of Yin and Yang, and it was the Yin-Yang Dao Monument. There were other Dao Monuments as well, such as the Life-and-Death, the Light-and-Dark, the True Illusion, the Space-Time, and the Chaos Dao Monuments, the origin of the world’s law, and the ultimate Sambodha.
“There is time on the left, and space-time and chaos on the right!”
Jiang Ming was so shocked he did not know what to say.
Even with his system and the Human Paths Record, he had never expected that a place like this existed.
Although it was not the legendary 3,000 Heavenly Paths in the mortal realm, it had surpassed the world’s boundary.
One side was a bridge corridor extending up diagonally to a platform. After the platform, it still extended to the next platform until it was lost into the depths of the sky.
This was the Heaven Battle Stage. One could earn points by stepping onto the battle stage and engaging in battles.
The other side was a staircase made of white jade that extended into the horizon. This was the Heavenly Ladder. One could climb the ladder to accept trials and earn points.
He turned around and looked back.
There was a sky where the vast majority of it was hidden from view. Even though only a small part of it was visible to Jiang Ming, he was confident that it was a lot larger than the monument that gave him the trials.
This was the Million Dao Chart, and one could obtain points by studying it as well.
“Marvelous!” Jiang Ming exclaimed. He took a deep breath and calmed himself down. He then looked sideways, and he saw a few couches and desks.
‘Couches?’ Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed slightly.
Five people were sitting on the couches. Three of them were men, while the remaining two were women. The men had good-looking faces and imposing auras, while the women were pretty.
When they noticed that Jiang Ming was looking at them, they bobbed their heads in greeting.
One of the young men in black combat gear, boots, and a sword on his back came over and said in a very enthusiastic manner, “Do you feel surprised and amazed?”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded. “All of you come from different worlds?”
“Yeap,” The short-haired young man replied as he invited Jiang Ming to sit with them.
Jiang Ming walked to the couch and noticed that several other people were special.
“All of us come from different worlds, different civilizations, different races, and even have different cultivation backgrounds,” the short-haired young man said as he poured a glass of red wine for Jiang Ming. Then, he continued. “What a fate for us to meet each other across the world. Brother, let me make introductions. I’m Luo Heng, and I’m a human from the Xinghe World.
“Guang Rui, an angel from the Guangming World.
“Ye Qingxian, a human from the Zhantian World.
“Aurum, an elven prince from the Great Forest World.
“Liu Yuan, a plant lifeform from the Boundary Sea World.
“How about you, Brother?” Luo Heng asked after he had finished introducing the rest of the people.
The remaining people were waiting for his answer as well.
While Jiang Ming was listening, he also checked their information through the Human Paths Record to see if everything Luo Heng said was true.
‘Luo Heng, a human, male. His strength is equivalent to that of a martial artist in the Dao Seed Realm, and he comes from the Xinghe World.
Relationship: 55
Innate Talent: Immortal
Status: The human race is indeed the strongest race across so many worlds! Here comes another one!
The information for the rest of the people was about the same, save for Aurum. His name was too long, so Luo Heng did not tell Jiang Ming his full name.
‘Well, since all of us come from different worlds, there’s no need for me to hide anything from them,’ Jiang Ming thought and whipped up a smile. “I come from the Tianyuan World. You can call me Jiang Ming!”
“Brother Jiang, let’s toast to our fate!” Luo Heng said.
The rest of the people picked up their wine glasses and drank them in one go.
“Brother Jiang, have you ever heard of this place before?” Luo Heng asked.
“Nope. I obtained the Supreme Order by accident, and I was here after activating it.” Jiang Ming shook his head.
“Just as I expected,” Luo Heng replied, “I got the Supreme Order very early. I was in the first level when I first came here, and it took me quite a long while to reach the third level. I met many people at the first level. They were all from different worlds as well, and there was no news of the Supreme Order circulating in their respective worlds. The more I learn about the Supreme Order, the more I admire the owner of this place.”
He had come across hundreds of people on the first level, and he also noticed that only one person in each world could get the Supreme Order. Unfortunately, he had only bumped into one person he had known before after he came to the second level.
He also told Jiang Ming that the world he was in was a combination of technology of evolution. Technology allowed some objects to fly in the sky and travel through the universe. People could even communicate face-to-face with each other while being hundreds of millions of miles apart.
As for evolution, it was the evolution of the physical body. Ultimately, they would cultivate the cosmic force and understand the laws of the universe.
“Although different worlds have different cultivation methods, they all come from the same root,” Luo Heng concluded.
Then, he took a tablet out and began introducing his world to Jiang Ming. Jiang Ming’s eyes were glowing with excitement as he thought, ‘Finally! My boring days have finally come to an end!’
Although the tablet was small, it had the whole world in it.
“Unfortunately, we don’t have an internet connection here, but don’t worry. I’ve downloaded many things in advance. I have a lot of movies, portraits, novels, and many more here. At my place, it’s the era of the knowledge explosion,” Luo Heng said, grinning from ear to ear. “I’m pretty sure that cultivation isn’t the only reason the Supreme Order brings us all here. This is a platform for cross-border exchange. If you can make use of it, you’ll gain a tremendous amount of fortune. What do you think? Do you want to get it?”
He waved the tablet in his hand.
“It’s cheap,” he said while grinning like a Cheshire Cat.
Jiang Ming rubbed his hands..

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - The Greatest Genius of the Last 10,000 Eras
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: The Greatest Genius of the Last 10,000 Eras
Everything that happened in the Supreme Pagoda was already shocking enough for Jiang Ming. However, what made him even more surprised was that this place could allow him to communicate with people from other worlds.
“Awesome! Is this technology?” Jiang Ming was both surprised and amazed, yet he commanded himself to calm down.
“Although it isn’t useful for cultivation, we can use it to pass the time of boredom. However, there’s one thing I don’t understand. Why are all these girls wearing so little? Are they cultivating some kind of demonic technique to seduce people? That being said, they really are pleasing to the eyes.”
“Hehe!” Lup Heng giggled. “If I put this on your side of the world, would it be worth anything?”
“Well, it’s hard to say,” Jiang Ming said. “Those who cultivate the path of heaven would definitely not like it. Those who’re weak don’t have much money in their hands. Brother Luo, why don’t you tell me what you want in exchange?”
“Spiritual pills and immortal weapons,” Luo Heng said without any hesitation.
“What do you think about this spiritual pill, then?” Jiang Ming asked as he handed a Qi Maintenance Pill to Lup Heng.
“Are you kidding me?” Luo Heng’s face sank. “This pill only has a small amount of vitality in it. Even a Golden Core martial artist wouldn’t want it at all.”
“You’re the one who messed with me first,” Jiang Ming said. “This thing of yours couldn’t be eaten or drunk. It can’t assist us in our cultivation either, and you still have the audacity to ask for a spiritual pill or an immortal weapon as an exchange? Do I look like a fool to you?”
The scale finally had dropped before his eyes. Luo Heng was just trying to cheat him with something he had never seen before since he was the new guy here.
Would a picture gallery of pretty women be more appealing than female dancers?
Would an 18-rated movie be better than a demoness?
It was not that he had never seen it before. After all, he was already an adult.
Besides, in a world where power reigned supreme, having a lot of women wasn’t a problem at all if one was strong enough. He could have banquets every single day, and many pretty ladies would dance and entertain him right in front of him.
Moreover, with his current level of intelligence and the knowledge he had amassed in his previous life, he might be able to develop an atomic bomb in another ten years. At that time, creating something entertaining or building a new island dedicated to entertainment would be a breeze.
However, the thought disappeared as soon as it popped up in his head. He was a cultivator now. His goal was to attain immortality, so how could he do something inappropriate like that?
“Ahem! Ahem!” Luo Heng grinned embarrassingly and said, “I’m just joking with you. Please don’t take it to heart, Brother Jiang. Just show me everything that you have. I’m going to make a big deal with you. I have everything you need here. Food, drink, games… I’m sure you’ll be satisfied!”
“Alright,” Jiang Ming replied. He still had a lot of spoils that he hadn’t sorted out yet, so he figured that this might be the perfect chance for him to go through all of them. With that thought in mind, he came to the side, channeled his mana onto his palm, and made a table about 100 meters long out of thin air.
Luo Heng was stunned. He wasn’t stunned because Jiang Ming could manifest a table out of thin air but because he could sense the endless stream of mana inside of Jiang Ming. His heart couldn’t help itself but tremble in fear. At the same time, he came to a conclusion. Jiang Ming was strong, a lot stronger than him. He himself was already considered a great genius of the last 10,000 eras, yet Jiang Ming was even better than him.
Not only him, but even Guang Rui, Ye Qingxian, Aurum, and Liu Yuan were astonished by Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming paid them all no mind. He waved his hand, and several heaps of items appeared on the table.
All of these were spoils that he had gotten from his battles with Mo Ling, the Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect, Ge Xiang, Mu Lei, Mu Shuiyun, and so on. Although some of them were destroyed alongside their original owners by him, he still managed to gather a lot of them.
On the first heap were spiritual herbs, such as the Azure Spiritual Grass. The second heap consisted of multiple pills and elixirs. There were more than 1,000 bottles of them, and they were all labeled with their uses and functions. The third heaps were weapons, instruments, and some Dao Vessels. There were nearly a million of them. The fourth heap was the biggest amongst the heap. It consisted of many different rare stones and gems.
He couldn’t take them out when he was at Chuyang Peak, so he hoped to get rid of them here.
Luo Heng’s eyes were glowing with excitement. He had the urge to claim all of these things as his own, but luckily, he pressed the urge down.
“What do you need?” Aurum asked as he looked across the spiritual herbs.
“I want spiritual fluids, spirit crystals, or energy crystals. The purer, the better,” Jiang Ming said slowly, “Of course, I’ll accept seeds of spiritual plants or something special from your world.”
“I have the seed of the Ancient Tree of War with me,” Aurum said after he thought for a while. He then took out a fist-sized turquoise seed that was brimming with vitality.
“I want to use this to exchange for all of your spiritual herbs!”
Jiang Ming took a look at the seed and shook his head. However, he did not say anything.
“All of your spiritual items are low-grade, but this seed of the Ancient Tree of War is different. It can grow into the Ancient Tree of War, and it’s very powerful.” Aurum explained, “In my world, it’s a treasured item that everyone seeks!”
“My items are treasured items in your world too,” Jiang Ming said. “Don’t think that your item is the best. I believe that all of our items here are unique in their own ways and are sought by the people in our own respective worlds.”
“Alright then. But I want seeds as well. Do you have any?” Aurum asked.
“Yes, I do have some with me.” Jiang Ming smiled.
Although Aurum had only a dozen types of seed, all of them were of high quality. For example, the Flower Fairy Tree seed could produce flower fairies.
He gave the Azure Spirit Grass and some seeds to Aurum in exchange.
“I’ve heard from a legend that the elves are accompanied by the elven sacred tree. Is there a seed for it?” Jiang Ming asked.
Aurum’s face sank when he heard his question. “The Mother Tree is our origin!”
He flung his sleeve and took a seat at the side.
“I apologize for my rudeness,” Jiang Ming said embarrassingly.
‘Origin? In other words, the Mother Tree is their mother? I’ve heard that elves are born from the elven tree. It seems like it’s not a myth at all…’
Ye Qingxian picked some materials, weapons, artifacts, and Dao Vessels. She gave Jiang Ming 100 pieces of divine stones, which were equivalent to 100 pieces of top-grade spirit crystals.
Liu Yuan looked around but did not ask for anything.
“I have a bottle of Holy Water of Light with me. It can purify evil energy, cleanse one’s body, and strengthen one’s foundation,” Guang Rui said as she took out a bottle. The liquid inside swirled with white light, giving a sense of holiness.
“So, what do you want?” Jiang Ming asked expressionlessly.
“Raw materials!” Guang Rui pointed at the heap of stones and gems. There was a halo of light on top of her head and two big wings at her back. She lifted her chin slightly and added, “All of them!”
“So, how much holy water are you going to give as an exchange?”
“Ten kiloliters!”
“Hah!” Jiang Ming scoffed.
A smirk crossed Luo Heng’s face, Aurum frowned, there was a grin tugging at the corner of Ye Qingxian’s lips, and Liu Yuan smiled.
“What do you want?” Jiang Ming turned to look at Luo Heng.
“All of them!” Luo Heng said, “All of us here are geniuses. It’s without a doubt that all of your items are good, but in fact, they are of little use to us. I’m not going to point them out…” He paused for a moment.
“Why?” Jiang Ming asked.
Guang Rui’s expression changed when Jiang Ming ignored her. A flash of anger crossed her face as she asked, “Ten kiloliters of my holy water isn’t enough to exchange for these low-quality raw materials?”
“Low quality?” Jiang Ming smiled coldly. He picked up a purple metal ore and said, “Do you know what this is? This is the purple copper ore. It can be refined and made into a weapon far beyond our cultivation level. This one alone is more precious than your so-called holy water. Oh yeah, since we’re here, I might as well tell you that your holy water is nothing but spiritual water infused with the power of light.”
“My holy water is a sacred item in my world. It can purify evil energy, ward away darkness, and cleanse all negative statuses! How dare you say it’s just spiritual water?” Guang Rui flew into a rage. However, her expression changed in the next second.
A wine cup had appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand. Then, he waved his hand, and a stream of water appeared in the air, filling the cup. Afterward, his palm glowed with light, and the cup of ordinary water became holy water that emitted a soft white light.
“You… You have mastered the power of light?” Guang Rui was stunned. Her mouth opened and closed several times, but she did not say anything anymore. She flung her long hair and strode to one side. She turned her head around as she did not want to look at Jiang Ming anymore.
Jiang Ming shrugged. For him, she was just a little girl who needed to be taught some manners. Unfortunately, fighting was prohibited here. Otherwise, he would make her, a prideful girl, scream with fear..

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - Breaking Record
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Breaking Record
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Luo Heng continued. “I’ve been here a lot of times, from the first level until the third level, so I know that if I can make use of this place. I can get a lot of benefits in my world. Not long ago…”
He grinned, looking prideful.
“It so happens that not long ago, I participated in the selection battle of the entire universe. I’m one of the top three, I’m backed by a great supporter, and I’ve taken a great martial artist as my master. I’m not the person I used to be in the past anymore, and I can take whatever you have,” Luo Heng said. He did not try to hide anything about his situation.
“Let me tell you something. If I can bring these things back, maybe I can earn a thousand times, ten thousand times, or even a million times the benefits!”
“Are you not worried about getting too much attention?” Jiang Ming asked. “After all, these items aren’t items from your world.”
“Haha!” Luo Heng tossed his head back and let out a boisterous peal of laughter. “This is the difference between your world and my world! The universe I’m in is vast. It’s home to hundreds of millions of communities and hundreds of millions of civilizations. Different civilizations will naturally give birth to different cultivation methods. There are also secret cosmic realms or forbidden places, and it’s normal to see some exotic plants and special materials. No one will question me if I tell them I got these from my adventure. Besides, these new artifacts and materials that have never appeared before are priceless to some powerful people who like to study them!”
‘Very well, then!” Jiang Ming laughed. “Name your price!”
“Okay!” Luo Heng said. Gone was the guy who tried to sell him a tablet and 18-rated movies. It was only now Jiang Ming realized that Luo Heng was just sounding him out just now while trying to make friends with him to reduce the awkwardness between them.
Luo Heng waved his hand, and a four-sided peak-like item appeared out of thin air. It was invisible and made of small pieces stacked together.
“These are energy crystals. What do you think?” Luo Heng asked.
“Awesome!” Jiang Ming picked up one. He indeed could sense a massive amount of pure energy from the energy crystal. It was equivalent to a spirit crystal, but this energy crystal was obviously synthetic, and it could only be considered as a low-grade spirit crystal.
“This is too little!” Jiang Ming shook his head. He picked up the low-grade Dao Vessel, the Heaven Shattering Hammer, and said, “In terms of level, this hammer is equivalent to the sixth level, and needless to say, there are many more of the same items!”
“I have another two heaps of energy crystals and some other daily necessities. That’s all I have. If you want, then take it. If you don’t want to, then there’s nothing I can do about it,” Luo Heng said.
“Alright, then.” Jiang Ming nodded after some contemplation. After all, he had no use for these spoils. “Maybe I’ll get some more items in the future. Do you want them?”
However, Luo Heng shook his head, much to Jiang Ming’s surprise. Then, he sighed helplessly. “No matter how long we stay here, it will only be an hour for the world outside. But once we leave and come back again, we won’t know how long has passed here, and it will be near impossible for us to meet again.”
“Why?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Who knows?” Luo Heng replied, shrugging. “Well, this place is, after all, a terrifying existence that can bring people from different worlds and universes together. Perhaps, it’s only normal that it can’t be understood!”
Jiang Ming nodded.
He looked at the three mountains of energy crystals before him and scratched his head.
‘There are too many of them. How should I use them?’
“A suggestion, Brother Luo. You should prepare more high-quality energy crystals,” Jiang Ming said helplessly. “Although it’s great to have so many of them, it’s a pain in the *ss to use!”
“Haha!” Luo Heng laughed. “Don’t worry! My wealth will definitely increase after I return. At that time, I’ll buy the highest grade of energy crystals! Of course, I hope we can still meet.”
“I hope so. After all, it’s a pleasure to trade with you!”
“Me too! By the way, Brother Jiang, you took these items from other people, right?”
“Well… Please don’t tell anyone about it.”
“Okay, don’t worry!”
Both of them were mumbling to each other, and then Jiang Ming suddenly walked to the front.
He was going to earn some points.
Luo Heng and the others followed behind him as they were curious about what he was going to do.
“It’s a pain in the *ss to gain points here.” Luo Heng sighed. “I’ve never earned more than 5 points!”
“Seriously?” Jiang Ming was stunned. “But there are three spots that can earn the points.”
“You’re right. However, you need to use it as soon as you gain it. Or else, the points will be useless,” Luo Heng explained. “Also, the process of gaining points is an arduous one. Take the Heaven Battle Stage as an example. There’s a probability that our opponent is someone who surpasses us by two realms!”
“You’re kidding, right?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“Nope. I’m not kidding. This is how things work here,” Luo Heng replied. “After all, only geniuses from different worlds and universes can come here, and those who’re too weak and can’t pass the three trials won’t be able to get here as well.”
“In my world, those who are able to come here have the qualifications of being a great emperor,” Ye Qingxian chimed in.
“In my world, those people are beloved by God,” Aurum said.
Jiang Ming fell silent.
He came to the corridor, lifted his head, and looked toward the first battle stage.
There was a stone tablet beside the corridor with three names engraved in gold on it.
Nian Beichen: Four stages
Ming Fei: Four stages
Peng Mo: Four stages
“What are these?” Jiang Ming asked as he pointed at the stone tablet.
“If you want to know what these are, just step onto the corridor or touch the stone tablet,” Luo Heng explained. “Oh yeah, one more thing. Since we all come from different worlds and have different cultivation methods, to make it easy to understand, our strength is classified into “level” here.”
Jiang Ming nodded. He glanced at the stone tablet and stepped onto the corridor.
Voom!
At that moment, a stream of information surged into his head.
Rule No. 1: 1 point will be granted for defeating the opponent, and the point will be doubled for every subsequent victory.
Rule No. 2: The opponent on the first battle stage has the combat power of Level 7.
Rule No. 3: Only those who have cleared the fourth battle stage can be bestowed with supreme honor and be recorded to be admired by future generations.
