Rule No. 4: Those who are defeated will be teleported back to the corridor. Challengers will appear directly on the battle stage that they were defeated in the next challenge.
Jiang Ming turned his head and asked, “What is the strength of the Fourth Heavenly Platform equivalent to?”
“According to my speculation, it should be on the early stage of Level 8,” Luo Heng replied. “I’ve managed to clear the first three battle stages, but I was defeated on the fourth battle stages. I’m pretty sure that the opponent that I went up against was at least a Level 8, as for the former three battle stages, they were all at lower Level 7, middle Level 7, and upper Level 7, respectively.”
“Does this mean that the strength of those three people on the stone tablet is at least on Level 8?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
A Level-8 martial artist was equivalent to a Paradis martial artist.
He knew very well how powerful and how hard it was to kill a Paradis martial artist.
During his fight with Ge Xiang, he wouldn’t have the confidence that he could defeat him if he hadn’t pulled him into the Mana Sealing Chess Plate.
“Yeah,” Luo Heng replied. “This is also the reason why it’s hard to earn points. When I was attempting the third battle stage, it took me nine attempts and three years to clear it.”
“I only managed to clear the first battle stage!” Aurum added.
A look of indignation crossed Guang Rui’s face, Liu Yuan sighed softly, while Ye Qingxian said with her hands behind her back, “I’m confident that I can clear the fourth battle stage on my second attempt!”
In other words, she had only attempted once, but she had already cleared the third battle stage.
Jiang Ming shot a glance at Ye Qingxian. He had to admit that she truly was one pretty woman.
“I’m really looking for you to leave your name on the stone tablet. After all, we all came in here at the same time, and I’ll feel very proud as well if one of us could leave our name on the stone tablet!” Luo Heng said, “Of course, I’ll take it as encouragement. After all, who knows if I’ll have a chance as well! But still, it’s very hard. Throughout history, only three people managed to leave their names on the stone tablet. Ms. Ye has the confidence to do so, but how can two people leave their names on the stone tablet? Oh yeah, and you too, Brother Jiang.
“Anyway, good luck, Brother Jiang. I hope you can conquer the fourth battle stage!” Luo Heng said.
“The fourth battle stage, huh…” Jiang Ming smiled.
He picked up his pace and soon arrived at the first battle stage.
It looked like a stone platform from the platform, but it was only then Jiang Ming knew he was wrong after he arrived here.
This was a huge battleground. There were deep ravines and rocky outcrops everywhere that stretched for nearly hundreds of kilometers in circumference.
“Please register your weapon. Please take note that only ordinary weapons are allowed. Weapons with special attributes are strictly prohibited.”
A voice rang into Jiang Ming’s ears, and a minotaur stood in front of him.
The minotaur had two horns on its head and was holding a big hammer. There was golden light swirling around it, giving it an impressive look.
“No weapon needed!” Jiang Ming announced.
“Battle starts!”
The minotaur on the other side swung its hammer and charged toward Jiang Ming in the next moment. Golden light burst out, and the sound of an explosion echoed as if the akasa couldn’t handle its power.
At the same time, a strong suppressive force swept across Jiang Ming and increased the gravity by multiple times.
This was the Earth Dao.
Jiang Ming was not perturbed by it. He clenched his fist and gathered up all his strength and mana in his punch, sending both the minotaur and hammer flying away.
Jiang Ming stepped on the spatial nodes without giving the minotaur a chance to fight back and delivered another kick to it.
“Congratulations, Jiang Ming on clearing the first battle stage. You have been rewarded with 1 point. You can choose to continue the battle or return to the corridor!”
Jiang Ming flew toward the corridor in the distance without any hesitation.
Luo Heng and the others had been watching the fight from the moment Jiang Ming stepped onto the first battle stage.
“How long do you think he is going to take to clear the stage?” Luo Heng asked.
“I think he’ll lose,” Guang Rui said. Her voice was charming, but there was a hint of derision in it. “He really has a lot of guts not to use any weapon?”
“Maybe he has a lot of confidence in his own strength.” Ye Qingxian added, “Maybe he can defeat his opponent in two punches.”
“Two punches? That’s ridiculous,” Guang Rui replied. “He’s just a human. Without any weapon, he—”
She came to an abrupt stop when she saw Jiang Ming had made quick work of the minotaur, and her face sank.
Ye Qingxian darted a glance at him.
“That’s terrific!” Luo Heng exclaimed. “How many battle stages do you think he can clear, Ms. Ye?”
“Maybe all four?” Ye Qingxian replied. There was a divine light swirling in her eyes.
“All four?” Guang Rui scoffed as she summoned a chair behind her. She sat down, and a green-colored wine glass appeared in her hand.
Jiang Ming cleared both the second and the third battle stages with ease.
Soon, he stepped onto the fourth battle stage, and a serious expression appeared on his face.
“Let’s see if I can defeat a Paradis martial artist or not,” Jiang Ming said.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - Special Authority; the First Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Special Authority; the First Death
There was a sword in front of Jiang Ming on the fourth battle stage.
‘A sword? Well, it’s better than nothing!’
As the thought flitted across Jiang Ming’s head, he stretched his arm forward and picked up the sword.
A human figure appeared right in front of him. He was wearing a blue robe and had long hair. There was a sword in his hands as well.
[Battle starts!]
“God Slaying Heart Sword!”
No sooner had a light flashed on the forehead of the man than his attack came.
It was an attack on the level of the Primal Spirit Realm, which was a terrifyingly powerful move. Without a special defensive ability, it could kill one in merely a second.
Voom!
However, Jiang Ming was prepared.
The light of five elements began to flow and weave around the membrane of the sea of consciousness before turning into a simple defense barrier.
In the past, when Mu Shuiyun’s Primal Spirit had attacked him, he had been comprehending the method to defend his sea of consciousness. However, even until today, he only managed to achieve the elementary stage.
He used the Five Elemental Sambodha to form a protective barrier. The membrane of the sea of consciousness shook, but it did not break.
The man’s sword had already arrived in front of him.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming disappeared, and when he appeared again, he was behind the man.
“Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!”
Jiang Ming raised his hand, and nine sword energies appeared around him. He then sent them all toward the young man, cracking the akasa and crushing the divine light of protection around the young man in the process.
Suddenly, the area around him dimmed, and an ocean descended on the battlefield.
Jiang Ming knew this was the akasa projection. The young man was trying to use this to suppress her sword energies. It was rather effective, but Jiang Ming was unperturbed.
He took a deep breath, and his body began to increase in size until he became as large as a titan. This was the Three-fold Astral Transformation.
His physical strength had been increased by eight times his original strength, and his raging aura had turned into an ocean, causing the Paradis projection to shake violently.
“Nine Divine Mountain Treasures!”
Jiang Ming threw his sword away and activated another special ability.
This was also another powerful special ability given to him by the system.
Nine divine mountains had appeared on top of him, their aura so powerful that they could crush everything around it.
This special ability had three stages as well.
During the first stage, he could form a black divine mountain. When he could form nine of them, it would be considered he had cultivated it to perfection, and the black divine mountain would transform into the silver divine mountain, which was the elementary level of the second stage.
In order to master the second stage and enter the third stage, which was the golden divine mountain, he needed to form nine of them first.
Right now, Jiang Ming had reached the second stage of the special ability, which was the silver divine mountain.
“Divine Mountain Embracement!” Jiang Ming shouted. He activated the Earth Dao, the Suppression Dao, and the Decimation Dao as he wrapped his arms around the divine mountain.
The divine mountain shrank rapidly, and Jiang Ming felt himself become heavier.
“Suppress!” he shouted.
Rumble!
The divine mountain contained immense power, and Jiang Ming threw the divine mountain toward the young man.
Seeing that the divine mountain was coming straight at him while crushing everything in its path with its terrifying power, the young man finally parted his lips and shouted, “Paradis Ascension. Come forth, Thunderstorm Spears!”
The Paradis projection turned into a sheet of light and engulfed the divine mountain in an attempt to stop it. At the same time, the sword energy became spears of lightning and stormed at the divine mountain.
Unfortunately, his effort was futile.
The Paradis projection dissipated, and the Thunderstorm Spear exploded. The divine mountain crumbled away, and the young man was flying toward the back; half of his body had turned into a blood mist.
Jiang Ming was sent backward by the blast as well, but he soon regained his stance. His figure disappeared, and when he appeared again, he was behind the young man. He delivered a punch at him and crushed his head.
However, a small human figure appeared out of the young man’s forehead. It was his Primal Spirit. The small human figure turned around in the air and transformed into sword energy before darting straight at the center of Jiang Ming’s eyebrow.
“Soul Decimation!”
This was the young man’s last resort. It was fast, but unfortunately, Jiang Ming was a tad faster.
He disappeared again and reappeared 10,000 meters away.
“There’s no way I’ll let you have your way! Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, die!”
Jiang Ming raised his hand, and a barrage of thunder rained down on the Primal Spirit, obliterating it in the process.
A Primal Spirit was agile but very fragile.
“Congratulations to Jiang Ming for clearing the fourth battle stage and gaining 8 points!
“Congratulations to Jiang Ming again for clearing the fourth battle stage. Special access permission has been granted, and please check the details through the Supreme Order later.”
Jiang Ming was surprised.
‘There’s a hidden bonus? Special access permission? What is that?’
Although Jiang Ming was curious about it, he knew now was not the right time to check on it.
Due to the enhancement of the power from the akasa, Jiang Ming was able to regain all his lost energy in the blink of an eye. He flew toward the next corridor and headed to the fifth battle stage.
Meanwhile, a new name had appeared at the bottom of the stone tablet on the corridor beside the platform.
Jiang Ming: 4 stages
Luo Heng and the others were shocked.
“He… Did he just kill his opponent?” Guang Rui asked, her voice filled with disbelief.
“Unbelievable!” Luo Heng explained, “Many geniuses have come to this place, but only those three were able to leave their names on the stone tablet, and now there’s another one! Why am I a little jealous to witness such a historic moment? Also, I can feel my blood boiling!”
“I’m feeling the same way too,” Aurum chimed in. “The opponent in the fourth battle stage is on a whole different level. They can bring forth a dimension that I don’t even know how to fight against.”
“That’s the ability that I keep losing to,” Luo Heng smiled bitterly, “Not only does the dimension has the ability to suppress and restrict our movements, but we also have to watch out for the attacks that will come at us from all directions. Defending myself is all I could manage.”
“That’s right!” Ye Qingxian joined the conversation, her eyes filled with surprise. “But he could break through that ability and defeat his opponent by fully utilizing his great power and teleportation skill!”
“You made it sound very easy, but do you know how hard it is?” Luo Heng said, “Great power? No matter how strong he is, he’s going up against someone who’s much stronger than him. Do you know how much of a combat experience one would need to carry out the feat that he just did? And the teleportation skill that you mentioned. That’s a special ability that can only be achieved after one has fully comprehended the Spatial Dao. Not many in our realm can do that. At least, I’ve never heard of anyone in our realm who can comprehend the Spatial Dao.”
“Me neither,” Ye Qingxian said as she shook her head. “Both his strength and level of intelligence are beyond imagination. I think he can clear the fifth battle stage too.”
“The fifth battle stage?”
Everyone gasped when they heard what Ye Qingxian said. All of them couldn’t help but wonder if Jiang Ming could really clear the fifth battle stage or not. Given his performance on the fourth battle stage, there was a possibility, no, he must be able to clear it. If he could clear the fifth stage, did that mean that he had broken the record?”
Luo Heng couldn’t help himself and exclaim, “Wow! If he really can clear the fifth stage, then it would be so awesome!”
“Oh, please!’ Guang Rui harrumphed.
On the fifth battle stage, Jiang Ming picked the sword as well.
He was going up to the same young man, but this time, the young man was wearing a black robe and was giving off a different vibe. His entire being was clad in the aura of calamity as if he was the manifestation of disaster.
“The Calamity Dao? And he’s in the middle stage of the Paradis Realm?” Jiang Ming became serious.
Rumble!
For a moment, the young man cast the Paradis projection on him.
Raging wind, fiery sun, falling meteorites, surging magma, and sword energies that flew here and there… The entire area was filled with all sorts of calamitous forces, and it seemed like the end of the world inside the Paradis projection.
“This is…” Jiang Ming was shocked, “Amazing! He has combined all the Sambodhas together to form the Calamity Dao!
“Wooden Dragon!”
That being said, Jiang Ming knew now was not the time to get amazed by his opponent. He swiftly calmed himself down and activated his special ability.
A huge forest appeared on the battlefield. The tree branches and vines twined against each other and formed into multiple green dragons.
As they all rushed toward the young man, they were crushed by the various calamitous forces.
“Great Manifestation Technique!”
Jiang Ming summoned two decoys and sent them to the left and right of the young man. One of them flipped his palm to form the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, while the other activated the Nine Heavenly Cannon.
“Storm Hypostasis!”
The young man transformed into a wisp of wind and merged into the Paradis projection, causing both of the decoys to miss their attacks.
Jiang Ming had already activated the Three-fold Astral Transformation. Initially, he planned to use the decoy as a distraction while he himself attacked the young man, but his plan failed.
He even had lost track of his opponent. He could use the Human Paths Record to track him, but he refused to, for he was going to rely on his own strength to fight.
A few minutes later, both of the decoys were defeated.
His opponent’s movements were unpredictable, but luckily, he could teleport so he could still hold on.
“I can’t keep on like this. He can merge into the Paradis projection, and it’s too hard to kill him. If I want to get him, I need to get rid of the Paradis projection first!”
Jiang Ming calmed himself down and successfully found his opponent with that thought in mind.
“Found you!” he exclaimed.
He activated the Nine Divine Mountain Treasures without wasting any time and forced the young man to come out. In the meantime, the Paradis projection was distorted and disappeared.
“Die!” Jiang Ming shouted and dashed toward the young man.
The young man was not going down just like this. Countless calamitous forces fell on Jiang Ming and created many wounds on his body.
In the end, the young man was defeated, and this time, Jiang Ming had obtained 16 points.
As soon as Jiang Ming entered the battlefield on the sixth battle stage, he felt he was enveloped in a chrysalis of despair and darkness.
His opponent was a martial artist who had mastered the Light-and-Darkness Dao.
He just summoned the darkness on him, and Jiang Ming had fallen into absolute darkness. Even if he tried to teleport here and there, he couldn’t prevent himself from getting stabbed through his forehead.
“So this is death?” Jiang Ming said as he appeared in the corridor beside the platform. He touched his forehead as a chill ran down his spine.
He took a while to calm himself down and heaved out a sigh.
“Let’s see what is so special about the access permission. I hope it’s something good, like becoming the master of the Supreme Pagoda.”
As he was thinking, he pulled out the Supreme Order..

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - The Heavenly Realms Supreme Chat Group
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: The Heavenly Realms Supreme Chat Group
Luo Heng and the others had come down as well.
All of them looked at Jiang Ming in amazement.
In the past, only three people could clear the fourth battle stage, but Jiang Ming had broken the record by clearing the fifth stage.
“Congratulations, Brother Jiang!” Luo Heng said.
He knew that someone like Jiang Ming would certainly grow into an incredible person if he had the chance.
“That’s terrific!” Ye Qingxian said.
She had managed to clear three stages, but she stopped at the fourth stage. Therefore, she was well aware of how powerful the opponent of the fourth stage was. However, Jiang Ming had not only been able to clear the fourth stage, but he could even clear the fifth stage. He was a lot stronger than her.
‘In my world, a lot of people say that I’ll become the empress in the future, but how about him? There are no words that can describe him better than boundless prospects.’
Aurum and Liu Yuan also came forward and congratulated him.
As for Guang Rui, she just pouted and turned her head sideways. After all, both of them came from two different worlds, and she was confident that they wouldn’t meet each other again.
When they looked at the name on the top of the stone tablet, they still couldn’t help but feel amazed.
Jiang Ming: 5 stages
He was number one. Throughout history, only four people could leave their names on the stone tablet, and one of them had even managed to break the record and clear the fifth stage.
Since all of them were geniuses and were much stronger than their peers in their respective worlds, they had all felt they were the best when they first arrived here.
However, the longer they stayed here, the more they felt how wrong they were. The gap between each genius was different. Some were as small as a river, while some were as large as a ravine.
First was Luo Heng, then Ye Qingxian, and now Jiang Ming.
They were not humans but monsters who were ridiculously strong.
“Do you want to give the Heavenly Ladder a try?” Luo Heng asked as he pointed at the jade white staircase on the other side. “Your willpower will be tested. Since you have such great battle prowess, I’m sure you have strong willpower too.”
“I’ll take a break first,” Jiang Ming said. “Although I’ve physically recovered from the battle, I still feel tired mentally.”
“You’re right. But remember to tell me when you’re going to attempt the Heavenly Ladder. I’m sure it’ll be a sight to behold.”
“Sure!”
“Thank you so much, Brother Jiang!”
They all left him alone after chatting with him for a while.
Some of them continued to enjoy their drinks while the others formed into a group and were discussing something. However, none of them were going to attempt the Heavenly Battle Stage, the Heavenly Ladder, or try to comprehend the Million Dao Chart.
Sitting on the couch, Jiang Ming pulled out the Supreme Order.
A stream of information entered his head with a flick of his mind, and he was shocked.
The information about the special access permission was as follows: Those who had cleared the fourth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage would be granted a chance to join the Supreme Chat Room. It allowed everyone in the group to chat with each other outside of the Supreme Pagoda. After joining the chat room, one would be kicked out of the chat room if they did not pass the trial of the Supreme Pagoda on the next attempt after their cultivation base had been raised. However, one would be kicked out of the chat room as well when their cultivation base had surpassed Level 10.
It was not anything impressive, yet Jiang Ming was shocked.
‘In other words, I can chat with different geniuses even if we’re in different worlds or universes? This is sick! But why is there a group chat that brings together the top group of geniuses? What is the purpose?’ Jiang Ming thought.
There was his information in the Supreme Order as well.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 5
Point Accumulated: 31 Points
Honor: Five stages record
It was just some basic information.
At the bottom was the link to join the chat room. As long as he clicked yes, he would be part of the chat room.
Jiang Ming closed his eyes, pretending that he was taking a nap.
He joined the chat room with a flick of his mind.
At that moment, a chat interface appeared in the Supreme Order.
On the top was the name of the chat group—Supreme Group (9)
Below was where the conversation took place, and the group members’ name information was shown on the right.
[Zhan Ge: It has been 30 years, we finally have a new friend! Welcome, welcome!]
[Ao Jiu: Welcome! Welcome!]
[Feng Wu: Welcome! Welcome!]
[Zhan Ge: Guys, we have a new friend here. Let’s come out and welcome him!]
[Ao Jiu: Those guys must be in seclusion again!]
[Feng Wu: Or maybe they’re currently being hunted down!]
[Ao Jiu: Well, that’s possible! But there’s only one end for going against people like us—death!]
[Feng Wu: Well, nobody can be luckier than us. We’re beloved by the world, and going up against us is like going up against the entire world.]
[Zhan Ge: Then can you explain why I always end up very miserably when someone is hunting me down? There’s an instance where I nearly died!]
[Ao Jiu: Give me some points, and I’ll give you a forbidden weapon that can even slay a Level 10 martial artist!]
[Feng Wu: Forbidden weapon, talismans, sealed powers… Just give me your points, and I’ll give you all these to save your life!]
[Zhan Ge: Get lost!]
Jiang Ming looked at their conversation and fell into silence.
‘There are only nine members in this chat group?’
In other words, only very few people across different worlds could clear the fourth stage.
Amongst the three people, Ao Jiu and Feng Wu had a big background, and they both had an immense amount of power that gods could only rival.
However, Zhan Ge was a little bit sad.
At the same time, he also noticed that everyone who could enter this chat room felt that they were the chosen ones.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped open, and Zhan Ge’s name and his information appeared.
Name: Zhan Ge
Race: Human
Origin: Huanggu World
Cultivation Base: Level 8
Status: Currently recuperating after being hunted down.
“Well, he truly is one unlucky b*stard!” Jiang Ming commented.
He then went to the next page.
Name: Ao Jiu
Race: Dragon
Gender: Male
Origin: Small Chiliocosm World.
Cultivation Base: Level 10 (Mutated Nine-Headed Dragon)
Status: It has been the 18th day since he started to sleep with a female Scaled Dragon.
“D*mn! He truly has a lot of stamina!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“But he’s a nine-headed dragon… Does this mean that he has nine heads? Would their heads fight with each other?”
Jiang Ming hastily stopped the thought as soon as it surfaced in his head.
“I’ve heard of a nine-headed snake, a nine-headed scaled dragon, but this is the first time I come across a nine-headed dragon. There really are a lot of interesting things in this universe, but the world he’s in is known as the Small Chiliocosm World? Is the chiliocosm the same as the small chiliocosm in my mind?”
A myriad of questions appeared in his head, but he decided to push them aside first.
He flipped to the next page.
Name: Feng Wu
Race: Phoenix
Gender: Female
Origin: Fire God Middle Chiliocosm World
Cultivation Base: Level 10
Status: She couldn’t make up her mind if she should break into the next level or not. Once she ascended into Level 11, she would lose access to the chat room, as well as the possession right to the Supreme Order if she failed the Supreme Pagoda’s trial. She was also wondering if she should get two juvenile dragons to satisfy her desires.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
Ao Jiu would certainly fly into a rage if he knew what Feng Wu was thinking.
[Ao Jiu: New friend, you’ve been a little bit too quiet. Hurry up and tell us your race, where you come from, your cultivation base, and your achievement!]
[Feng Wu: Judging by his name, he should be a human. Basic information is also available on the group member profile. Let me have a look first. He’s only Level 5, and he… What!? He has cleared the fifth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage? This is incredible!]
[Ao Jiu: He has cleared the fifth stage? That’s pretty awesome! After all, the Heavenly Battle Stage is the hardest in the Supreme Pagoda. If my memory serves me right, no one has ever cleared the fifth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage before throughout history, and he’s the first one! Brother Jiang, you’ll be my brother from today onward!]
[Feng Wu: Shame on you!’ You’re considered a Great Monarch for him now!]
[Ao Jiu: He’s a genius, not to mention that he’s a human and could enter the Supreme Pagoda. In another hundred years, I’m afraid he will become even stronger than both of us!]
[Zhan Ge: Another hundred years? You’re wrong! If I didn’t need to suppress my realm, I’d be able to surpass you in just ten years! A junior of mine took only 30 years to reach Level 10! Although he’s still no match for me, and I nearly killed him!]
[Feng Wu: That’s the reason you’re being hunted, right? Judging from your battle prowess, by right, you should be able to roam about in different planes without much effort. How come you are being hunted down?]
[Zhan Ge: There are eight Level 10 and a dozen Level 9 coming after me, and all of them are equipped with immortal weapons. There’s nothing I could do other than running for my life!]
[Feng Wu: This is weird. Considering your status in your world, you shouldn’t be able to come across so many powerful beings.]
[Zhan Ge: Well, I created a palace that was dedicated to collecting all the beauties from different locations in my world.]
[Feng Wu: Hah! Serve you right!]
[Ao Jiu: D*mn it! You really have a lot of nerves, Brother!]
Jiang Ming gave Zhan Ge a thumbs up inwardly after seeing what he had done.
He thought for a moment and decided to say something.
[Jiang Ming: Hi, guys. Pleased to meet you.]
[Ao Jiu: Here he comes! Introduce yourself. For example, what kind of world do you come from and what’s so special about it?]
[Jiang Ming: Well, there’s nothing special. All of us there just keep cultivating to become stronger. By the way, can we trade here?]
[Ao Jiu: Yes! But the feature isn’t available now. We were just joking when we said we’re going to give forbidden weapons to Zhan Ge just now.]
[Jiang Ming: Why?]
[Ao Jiu: We need a group admin! We had one in the past, but unfortunately, he left the group, and we haven’t had one since then.]
[Jiang Ming: How can one become the group admin?]
[Feng Wu: Brother Jiang, you have the chance of becoming the group admin! After all, you have cleared the fifth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage, so you must have strong willpower and a high level of intelligence! Brother Jiang, work harder and try to become the group admin. After you become the group admin, we can trade between us!]
[Ao Jiu: Hah, what an idiotic woman. You haven’t told him how to become a group admin yet. Anyway, Brother Jiang, if you want to become the group admin, you just need to clear the fourth stage, have 10 levels records, and 99 units of special abilities.. If you can really become the group admin, I’ll call you my boss!]

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - Junior Sister, I’ll Kill You Today on Behalf of Justice
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Junior Sister, I’ll Kill You Today on Behalf of Justice
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The three of them chatted for a long while.
Since all of them were from different worlds, there was nothing for them to hide from each other. Besides, there was a probability that Jiang Ming could become the group admin, so Zhan Ge and the other two would answer all of his questions.
For example, the division of worlds.
The planes were at the lowest level, and they were further divided into different levels. Generally speaking, they could sustain Level 10 martial artists at most, but only a few of them could do it.
Moving up were the small chiliocosm, middle chiliocosm, and great chiliocosm.
As for the higher level of worlds, even Zhan Ge and the others did not know about it.
By now, he had only one doubt about the higher-level worlds and the origins of the group members. Amongst the group members, were they from different worlds within chaos, or did they cross the chaos?
As a human, he couldn’t help himself but keep wondering. If they could cross the chaos, then the Supreme Pagoda was truly a terrifying existence.
Jiang Ming called his wandering mind back, but he did not open his eyes. He needed to figure out what he should do to become the group admin.
According to Ao Jiu, only the group admin could activate the trading feature in the chat room. Also, the group admin would have different other powers as well. As for what they were…
[Ao Jiu: I can’t tell you!]
‘The requirements to become the group admin are 4 stages record, 10 levels record, and 99 units of special abilities.’
He needed to clear the fourth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage, climb up to the tenth level of the Heavenly Ladder, and comprehend 99 special abilities from the Million Dao Chart. Then, he would be qualified to be the group admin.
Honestly, it was difficult for other races, but it was nothing for him as he was a human. After all, humans grew very fast and had a high level of intelligence. As for other races, such as the dragons, they indeed were born with powerful bloodlines and great powers, but their minds and willpower grew slowly. They might get really powerful in the later stage, but they were pretty weak in the early stage, and it was hard for them to defeat an opponent who was in a higher realm.
After that, Jiang Ming opened his eyes and walked to the front.
Luo Heng hurriedly walked forward and asked excitedly, “Brother Jiang, are you going to attempt the Heavenly Ladder now?”
Ye Qingxian and the others also followed suit.
“Yeah, I’m going to give it a try.” Jiang Ming smiled.
There was a question in his heart.
All of the people that could come here were geniuses, but little did they expect that there was a Supreme Chat Room above them.
Those people were the real beings who stood on top of all the worlds.
“Brother Jiang, I wish you good luck!” Luo Heng said.
Soon, they arrived below the Heavenly Ladder.
There was a stone tablet beside them, and eight names were on it.
Nian Beichen: 14 Levels
Hong Yi: 13 Levels
Tian Fozi: 12 Levels
Ming Fei: 11 Levels
Qing Fan: 11 Levels
Xu Wuji: 10 Levels
Lei Luo: 10 Levels
Hu Jun: 10 Levels
Jiang Ming saw two familiar names. One was Nian Beichen, and the other was Ming Fei.
Both Nian Beichen and Ming Fei had cleared the fourth stage on the Heavenly Battle Stage. However, at the Heavenly Ladder, Nian Beichen had climbed three more steps than Ming Fei. Although it might not seem like a lot, it was a world of difference.
“Hong Yi had climbed up to the 13th level, but why didn’t he clear the fourth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage?” Jiang Ming asked.
“He has strong willpower, but that doesn’t mean that he’s strong in combat,” Ye Qingxian explained. “Combat strength is the combination of physique, bloodline, special abilities, and battle sense. I’ve seen one person who has rock-solid willpower, but he’s weak in combat.
“Simply put, willpower represents the spiritual dimensions. Martial artists that follow the teaching of Buddhism have a natural advantage in this regard. For example, Tian Fozi. But I have to say that Nian Beicheng is truly powerful. He had reached the 14th level. I stopped at the 9th level, and I collapsed when I stepped on the 10th level.”
“I only reached the 8th level,” Luo Heng said as he smiled bitterly. “You guys truly are geniuses.”
“Our future isn’t determined by our innate talent. Otherwise, the existence of this place would be meaningless,” Jiang Ming said. “Both the Heavenly Battle and the Heavenly Ladder are the best places for us to hone our skills. In my world, there is one saying that goes, ‘the early bird gets the worm, so we just need to wake up earlier’! Also, the clumsy birds need to start early. We’re not clumsy, nor are we stupid, and if we work harder than the slow, we’ll have a very bright future!”
“Haha, nice one, Brother Jiang!” Luo Heng couldn’t help but chuckle.
He felt Jiang Ming was right.
He was a genius, and if he worked even harder than other people, there was nothing he needed to be afraid of.
Ye Qingxian nodded.
Jiang Ming stepped on the Heavenly Ladder without saying anything.
In an instant, a terrifying pressure manifested itself as an overpowering sword, cutting through the air and falling straight into his sea of consciousness.
“On the first level of the Heavenly Ladder, one’s soul will be attacked, but a Primal Spirit martial artist will be able to withstand it.”
Jiang Ming knew what he was facing based on the information he received from Luo Heng and gang, as well as the experience of Zhan Ge and the others.
Generally speaking, a martial artist would not be able to withstand the attack if they hadn’t entered the Primal Spirit Realm yet, but Jiang Ming was unaffected.
He moved up the staircases one after another without stopping.
When he reached the ninth level, nine swords appeared in front of him and rammed into his sea of consciousness.
It was a test of his willpower, and there was nothing he could do but go up against it.
It was the best if he could withstand it, but if he couldn’t, he would fail.
Jiang Ming took a few deep breaths. He already had the experience since he had come across something like this when he first entered the Supreme Pagoda. Therefore, he knew how to deal with it.
Luo Heng and the others were watching him from the bottom of the Heavenly Ladder.
“He’s already at the 9th level? Terrific!” Luo Heng exclaimed, “Even though I’m a genius in my own world, I’m still very impressed by him. He truly is the greatest genius I’ve ever seen across so many worlds!”
“Well…” Ye Qingxian chimed in, “You’re probably right.”
Looking at him, Guang Rui did not know what to say.
She had just managed to reach the second floor. Before coming across Jiang Ming, she thought she had a noble bloodline and unparalleled talent, but it was only then she realized how insignificant she was after meeting Jiang Ming.
“Sigh, I thought we’re already considered highly talented geniuses, but he’s truly in a whole different world compared to us!” Aurum sighed.
“Yeah, you’re right,” Liu Yuan added. There was a mixed expression on his face.
People always said that there would be no harm if there were no comparison, and it was only through comparison that one knew their limit.
On the Heavenly Ladder, Jiang Ming had reached the tenth level.
Suddenly, a rain of thousands of arrows descended to rip his sea of consciousness apart, and his leg trembled for a moment.
On the 11th level, countless bolts of lightning and thunder enveloped his sea of consciousness, filling every inch of space and trying to annihilate everything.
This time, he stopped for even longer.
On the 12th level, his face turned slightly pale.
On the 13th level, his body began to shake.
On the 14th level, a drop of sweat dripped down from Jiang Ming’s forehead.
On the 15th level, the space above his sea of consciousness suddenly collapsed and turned into a black hole, sweeping away everything and trying to swallow his entire sea of consciousness into it.
Jiang Ming’s vision turned black, but there was a light deep inside of his heart.
“When the darkness looms, use the light of your heart to shatter the darkness!”
The light inside of his heart turned into a sword and slashed across the surroundings, driving the darkness away.
On the 16th floor, countless stars appeared above his sea of consciousness. Each of them then fell down as streams of light, giving rise to an apocalyptic scene.
Bam!
The stars burned with flames and fell into the sea of consciousness, exploding with an impact force that destroyed everything.
Jiang Ming trembled, but he pressed on.
“My heart is a boundless place that can hold everything under heaven!”
Jiang Ming’s heart let out a cry, and the sea of consciousness suddenly expanded. It rolled over violently, enveloping the starry sky and integrating it all into the sea of consciousness.
He cleared the level and felt a surge of relief washing through his heart. Then, he suddenly understood something.
He had comprehended multiple Sambodhas and various special abilities, including the Five Elemental, Yin-and-Yang, Light-and-Dark, Life-and-Death, Reincarnation, Karma, and Spatial in the past.
Whenever he successfully mastered one Sambodha or special ability, his heart and mind would be strengthened once. As time passed, he had indomitable willpower.
Unfortunately, although the membrane around his sea of consciousness was strong, it could only serve as a passive defense, and he did not have any special abilities that could improve the protection.
He cleared the 17th level as if he was walking through the park.
On the 18th level, a human figure and a sword appeared in his sea of consciousness.
The human figure was none other than his Junior Sister, and the sword was Sword of Demise.
“Either you or I will die today!” his Junior Sister said.
There was no expression on her face as she swung her sword downward in a mighty swipe. Then, Jiang Ming realized with surprise that the sword seemed to have the ability to control time. Whenever she swung it, a billion years seemed to have passed.
His sea of consciousness dimmed under the sword light, his willpower withered, and the fire inside of his heart seemed to be extinguished.
Jiang Ming was getting older and older as time passed. He could barely move, and all he could was watch as the sword descended on him.
Suddenly, his figure, old and hunched, appeared in his sea of consciousness that had already gone dry.
“Am I going to die in the hands of my Junior Sister? Am I going to die without getting to understand everything in this universe? Hah!” He lifted his head with a crooked smile tugging at the tip of his lips.
“I’ve seen the secret to immortality here. I’ve seen the power that can move mountains and raise the sea. But I haven’t achieved immortality. I haven’t obtained the power that can reshape the world, and I haven’t truly experienced everything in the world yet, so how could I lose here?
“You will forever be my Junior Sister, but I’ll not get defeated by you!” Jiang Ming said as determination appeared on his face.
“Junior Sister, although you’re my sweetheart, I’ll never allow you to do this to me!” Jiang Ming shouted, his voice cold.
Slowly, he lifted his finger.
“I love you, I care about you, and I can allow you to do whatever you want to me, but how could you do this to me?”
The arrogance that he had been suppressing in the heart erupted.
“Now, die!”
He channeled all his mana and strength to his fingertip, causing it to emit light so bright it could only be compared by the starlight in the sky.
Bam!
The tip of the sword broke, and his Junior Sister began to dissipate.
The pressure that had been pressing on him vanished, and he had returned to how he usually looked.
Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh of relief. He felt as if something inside of him had changed. His sea of consciousness was glowing brightly, and his willpower had gotten even stronger.
He was hunched over, sweating profusely as if an unbearable weight was weighing him down.
However, he refused to give up.
He kept his head high as he looked at the sky.
He lifted his right finger and pointed at the sky, and slowly, he straightened his body as he asked inwardly, ‘Is this the real me?’
He took a deep breath and stepped on the 19th level.
Suddenly, a spear came from chaos, pierced through the sky, and dashed straight toward his sea of consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - Special Abilities
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: 99 Special Abilities
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 5
Points Accumulated: 130 points
Honor: 5 stages record, 18 levels record
Jiang Ming failed on the 19th level and fell to the ground from the Heavenly Ladder. Although he recovered fast, his mind was still a muddled mess, and his soul was trembling. The spear on the 19th level had been so powerful that it stunned him the moment it appeared and crushed his sea of consciousness in the blink of an eye.
“It’s too powerful!” Jiang Ming exclaimed. He let out a sigh and then smiled when he saw how many points he had accumulated.
He had accumulated 31 points from the Heavenly Battle Stage, but he got even more points from the Heavenly Ladder. One would get one point for clearing the first nine levels of the Heavenly Ladder dedicated to the martial artist in the Primal Spirit Realm. Starting from the 10th level to the 18th level, only a Paradis martial artist had a chance of clearing them. Not only that, but they were getting 10 points for each stage.
“You’re awesome!” Luo Heng and the others came over. All of them were wearing surprised expressions on their faces.
They didn’t think that someone could reach the 18th level until they met Jiang Ming.
“Terrific!” Ye Qingxian exclaimed, her eyes glowing. She looked at the stone tablet next to her and unexpectedly saw Jiang Ming’s name on the top.
Ye Qingxian couldn’t help herself and exclaim again, “18th level. It means that you have the willpower of a Level 8 martial artist, yet in reality, you’re only a Level 5 one. This is unbelievable!”
“What I envy most are the points you gained. It… It’s just too amazing!” Aurum cried out after he did mental calculations. “Once he consumes those points, I can’t imagine how powerful he will become!”
Everyone sucked in air sharply after they heard what Aurum had said.
Even Guang Rui couldn’t help herself and lick her lips.
Jiang Ming let out a smile but did not say anything. After chatting with them for a while, he went to the side, sat in a lotus position, and began recuperating.
After all, his mind was exhausted, and the spear had pierced through his sea of consciousness.
Time was flowing slowly. It was only when his sea of consciousness returned to its original state that Jiang Ming rose to his feet. He felt refreshed, and the lethargy he felt earlier was gone.
Luo Heng and the rest did not leave. They did not go to comprehend the Heavenly Monuments or the Dao Monuments as they waited for him.
Jiang Ming nodded at them, and after a short contemplation, he walked toward the Million Dao Chart behind him.
He was going to get some special abilities.
The Million Dao Chart was a massive monument. Jiang Ming had to lift his head to look at it, and he was amazed.
There were many lines and nodes on top of the Million Dao Chart, and they gave off the vibe of a starry sky. He squinted his eyes slightly and saw several Dao Rhythms in them.
He hastily sat in a lotus position and closed his eyes.
As he tried to make a mental connection with the Million Dao Chart, he felt a strange aura had enveloped him in a barrier, preventing people from the outside from interrupting him.
He did not have to worry about the passage of time, so he decided to take his sweet time comprehending the special abilities.
An illusionary scene that represented the world of his mind appeared behind him. It seemed like the Paradis projection, but nobody could see it.
Inside the Million Dao Chart, Jiang Ming felt he had arrived at the origin of all forces. A plume of flame exploded and turned into a star. It then continued to collapse and condense into a point before turning back into a plume of flame.
In the next second, he felt he had come to the eye of the storm. He was surrounded by a raging wind that could even destroy his body and soul. Before he could take a closer look at it, lightning burst out of nowhere, and a dark fog descended.
“This is the transformation of power, but it’s a muddled mess. I need to sort them out one by one and analyze the changes of power during the process, as well as the transformation of the Sambodha,” Jiang Ming said.
Jiang Ming had a basic understanding of the special ability. In fact, special abilities were divided into several grades as well.
Elementary-grade special abilities only utilized the Sambodha. In the intermediate grade, one could fuse several Sambodhas and make changes regarding the mysteries of Dao. In the advanced grade, it generally involved the changes of laws, the fusion of several Sambodhas, or the utilization of space and time power. As for the supreme grade, well, as the name suggested, it could draw out the full power of laws and suppress everything in the world.
This was everything that Jiang Ming knew about special abilities.
He would be granted one point for every eight elementary special abilities comprehended, and it accumulated from there. However, one supreme special ability was equivalent to two advanced special abilities, four intermediate special abilities, and eight elementary special abilities.
Some people would have a hard time gaining points from the Million Dao Chart, while it was a breeze for other people. It all depended on the level of intellect of that particular person.
Feng Wu had once said that one person had comprehended thousands of special abilities, a feat that nobody could surpass until this day.
Time went by slowly.
Three days later, a silhouette that looked like Jiang Ming appeared behind his back. The silhouette then performed a hand seal and created a red lotus.
The red lotus then exploded, and a pillar of light rushed out from above his head.
In the distance, Ye Qingxian, who had been observing Jiang Ming, exclaimed, “Amazing! It took him only three days to comprehend a special ability.”
“Yeah, he is truly a genius,” Luo Heng chimed in, “How many special abilities do you think he can comprehend?”
“10? Or 20? I can’t tell,” Ye Qingxian said. “Comprehending special abilities is a tiring process, and one would get exhausted very easily. However, judging from his willpower, I think a dozen shouldn’t be a problem for him.”
Luo Heng smiled bitterly. “It took me half a year to comprehend one special ability, and I was already exhausted.”
“How can you compare yourself to him?” Ye Qingxian said, darting him a glance.
Luo Heng nearly choked.
Several hours later, another beam of light shot out of Jiang Ming’s head. This meant that he had comprehended another special ability.
Ye Qingxian froze when she saw the scene.
“Hah!” Luo Heng turned around. “He has shattered my pride and confidence!”
“Well, you’re not alone,” Ye Qingxian said, her voice low.
Guang Rui, Liu Yan, and Aurum were rendered speechless too.
More and more pillars of light appeared from Jiang Ming’s head. Most of them were under ten meters in height, but some were about 100 meters in height. This meant that he had comprehended an intermediate special ability.
Generally, a Level 5 martial artist would need a lot of effort to comprehend an intermediate special ability.
“Holy!” Luo Heng shouted.
“Jesus Christ!” Ye Qingxian followed suit.
This was because a light pillar of about 1,000 meters in height had appeared above Jiang Ming’s head. It was so bright it could light up the entire sky.
If there was a light pillar of about 1,000 meters in height, it meant he had successfully comprehended a supreme special ability.
Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian sighed.
A supreme special ability generally involved the utilization of laws. However, there were several special occasions as well. For example, fusing several Sambodhas together or developing a certain Sambodha to a higher degree.
But either way, it was a miracle.
However, what surprised them the most was that although Jiang Ming had comprehended more than 40 types of special abilities, he still did not stop.
One day, a voice rang out in Jiang Ming’s heart.
“Congratulations, you’ve successfully comprehended 2 advanced special abilities, 6 intermediate special abilities, and 79 elementary special abilities. You’re eligible to have your name carved on the Divine Tablet! Simply put, since you’ve comprehended 99 special abilities, conquered the fifth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage, and cleared 18 levels of the Heavenly Ladder, you’re qualified to become the group admin of the Supreme Chat Room!
“Jiang Ming, you’ve become the group admin of the Supreme Chat Room!
“Jiang Ming, the trade feature in the Supreme Chat Room has been activated. Also, as the group admin, you can mute or prevent members from trading.
“Please take note that the trade item is genuine, doesn’t have any marks on it, and doesn’t have any owner.”
Jiang Ming opened his eyes again. He was exhausted but happy.
He was satisfied since he had successfully comprehended 99 special abilities. If he could ascend into the next realm, he could come back here and keep comprehending more special abilities.
Jiang Ming was pleased with the last notification as he did not have to worry about trading items with other people in the Supreme Chat Room anymore. After all, if the item contained a mark that a certain Great Monarch could trace, then he would be in big trouble.
‘I can assure that whoever is behind the Supreme Pagoda, they must be a transcendent being.’
While Jiang Ming was contemplating, he entered the Supreme Chat Room.
It was very lively in the Supreme Chat Room.
