chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Level 15 0ld Ancestor, Preparing to Refine a
World
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation| Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
In the Supreme Chat Group
[Ao Jiu: Brother Jiang, how can you be so great and awesome in becoming a
group admin!? Brother Jiang, Im now willing to acknowledge you as my elder
brother throughout my life.]
Feng Wu: From now onward, we’re a family. Congratulations, Brother Jiang,
congratulations to every one of us!
(Zhan Ge: “Sob sob, I can finally stop fleeing! Brother Jiang, thank you, I truly
appreciate your presence! Ive got some points here. Do any of you have great
killing weapons? I want to counterattack. I want to snatch all of their Holy
Daughters to bear me sons!]
ITian Fozi: Amitabha, Mr. Zhan, please do less killing!]
(Zhan Ge: Hee, what I despise most is you bald-headed, who talk of
compassion and equality of all beings, but are more ruthless and noble than
anyone else!]
(Zi Lei: I agree! A fcking monk nearly refined me. Hence, I decided to make
my world Buddha-free when my cultivation base reaches its pinnacle!]
Hei Gu: Lei, you’re as dominant as ever!]
(Ming Fei: Brother Jiang, Im the Heaven God Small Chiliocosm’s first princess.
Because of my distinguished status, I can customize any item for you whenever
you need it. Just to be clear that this service is not free, but I can give you a
50% discount.]
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, Ive got a Level 15 old ancestor here. Do let me know if
you’re in danger. I will help you at the cost of 1 point!]
[Zhan Ge: Brother Wang is indeed generous. Im now in danger, please help!]
[Wang Ye: What do you need?]
(Zhan Ge: “A Level 11 war sword!]
(Wang Ye: Don’t just attack without any defense. You’ll likely be killed when
you’re being targeted by enemies!]
[Zhan Ge: Ive got 2 points left!)
(Wang Ye: 1 point in exchange for a weapon! After your counterattack, do enter
the Supreme Pagoda to cultivate for a while first. After all, it’s not difficult for
you to earn back more points with your ability!]
Zhan Ge: Alright, Brother Wang, thanks!
Jiang Ming read messages quietly but in astonishment. He had not thought
that Wang Ye had a Level 15 expert with him. Although he had no idea how
strong a Level 15 expert was, he knew that a Level 15 expert could easily
destroy his world.
Jiang Ming indeed did not expect to meet people with profound backgrounds in
the chat group.
Jiang Ming: Brother Wang, why do you still remain at Level 10 when you’ve
such a strong background and you’re from a middle chiliocosm?]
He had checked on Wang Ye with his Human Path Records.
Wang Ye: Human, Male, Level 10, from Mythical Middle Chiliocosm, was so
talented that incurred heaven’s jealousy. He was currently suppressing himself
with an Artifact so that he could continue enhancing his foundation for a
breakthrough. He wanted to continue staying in the Supreme Pagoda and also
wished to join the Supreme Chat Room of a higher level.
Jiang Ming was surprised to read Wang Ye’s information. Although it was the
system’s evaluation, the use of ‘so talented that incurred heaven’s jealousy
was, after all, unbelievable.
Moreover, Wang Ye seemed to have a better understanding of the Supreme
Pagoda.
(Wang Ye: Just because the world T’m in is ranked too high, I was born witha
Primal Spirit, grow too fast, and miss out on a lot of opportunities. Therefore,
since I now have this Supreme Order, I shall suppress my cultivation base.
However, because my cultivation base is now at its limit, I can’t suppress it
much longer. Anyway, Im surprised to see someone becoming the group
admin before I leave. What an unexpected pleasure!
Feng Wu: Little Wang, I can’t suppress any longer either! Let’s decide a time to
leave together. Who knows? We could meet again!]
(Wang Yue: Sure, let’s leave together! T’m glad to see Brother Jiang becoming
our group admin. So, Ill spill some beans about the Supreme Pagoda. It’s a very
tall pagoda, beyond your imagination. Based on my understanding, it’s
challenging to have a group admin. But if each group admin can grow up
smoothly, they’ll definitely be a shining star in all heavens and worlds!
(Wang Yue: One must also stay low profile, as low as possible! Well, let me just
share my experience as a piece of advice for you!
(Wang Yue: In fact, T’m not the one who’s supposed to get this Supreme Order
in my world. It belonged to another man. Obtaining this Supreme Order equals
obtaining an inconceivable opportunity. As expected, he started growing up
rapidly and took out items not belonging to my world. To us, it was obviously
abnormal, wasn’t it? This man also acted in a high-profile and domineering
manner. As a result, he offended my Wang clan and was killed. In the end, I
accidentally got this Supreme Order, and it became mine. Remember, never
make this Supreme Pagoda a sanctuary, for however long you stay in it, only
two hours will pass in reality.)
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement as he read. Staying high profile could indeed
easily offend others, hence becoming a target.
Anyway, he did not believe in Wang Ye’s claim that he had killed that man just
because that man provoked his Wang clan. It must be due to the ability of that
man to grow up at an incredible speed and take out something unusual that
had attracted the Wang clan’s attention, which then forcefully decapitated that
man.
That man’s death was unjustified? No, it was not! In the cultivation world, it
was, after all, all about competing for chances.
Being low profile is the way to go! Jiang Ming exclaimed to himself.
Meanwhile, he remained silent while reading the chat content.
(Zhan Ge: ‘m sorry to ask, but am I being too high-profile?
[Ming Fei: If you’re a member of my world, you’d have been killed! If you’re to
act high profile, you’d have to get a strong ally or support. Otherwise, you’d
mostly be killed! Just like your situation now, if Brother Jiang did not become
the group admin, how long could you last?]
(Zhan Ge: So, I must thank Brother jiang. Does his presence as a group admin
mean that we now have strong support?]
[Wang Ye: Haha, that’s right. The group admin is indeed our strongest
support!]
At the same time, Jiang Ming also checked the condition of other members.
Ming Fei: Divine Being, Female, Level 10, originated from the Heaven God
Small Chiliocosm. Currently suppressing her cultivation because of her
intention to strengthen her foundation to a degree that no one has ever done
before so as to pull off with a great coup.
Tian Fozi: Spiritual Buddha, born from exceptionally precious Bodhi Seed,
Level 10, originated from the Benevolence Small Chiliocosm. The biggest
question in his mind is whether he is a male or a female. Hence, he decided to
question Buddha for clarification when he meets Buddha in the future.
Zi Lei: Innate Being, born from a wisp of foreign Violet Heavenly Divine
Lightning, Level 10, originated from the Thunder Small Chiliocosm. Currently
preparing for further metamorphosis.
Hei Gu: Devil Clan, a fallen devil skeleton from beyond heavens which was
conceived and born after 10,000 years, Level 10, originated from the Devil
Skeleton World. He is wondering whether he is a son of the devil skeleton or
the devil skeleton itself. He is also planning to refine the Devil Skeleton World
and use it for its own achievement.
Jiang Ming felt shivers run down his spine as he read these people’s
information.
He was surprised to see the existence of the legendary Divine Being and the
fact that Tian Fozi was born froma Bodhi Seed. No wonder Tian Fozi had an
unyielding will, capable of leaving his name on the Heavenly Ladder. The
weirdest thing about Tian Fozi was the obsession he had with his own gender.
zi Lei was so great for being an innate being.
The scariest was Hei Gu, who actually was planning to refine the world he was
from. Nevertheless, it would be a great being in the future if it succeeded!
With the presence of immortals, devils, demons, buddhas, and human beings,
the world is so big that nothing is to be surprised at!
Jiang Ming was overcome with emotions and began asking his questions.
Jiang Ming: Ms. Feng Wu, Brother Wang, since both of you come from middle
chiliocosms, will one ascend to another higher world once their cultivation
base reaches a limit?]
(Feng Wu: Yes, but Ive no idea where theyd be ascending to!)
Wang Ye: [Neither do I! But T’m sure that they won’t ascend to the great
chiliocosm!
Jiang Ming: If it’s not the great chiliocosm, where would it be? This is indeed
strange!)
(Wang Ye: It must be recorded in my clan, but Tm not qualified yet to know!
Brother Jiang, if we meet in a higher level Supreme Chat Room, rll definitely
give you the answer!]
Jiang Ming: Tm sorry, but I wonder if there’s any legend about the Supreme
Pagoda?
[Wang Ye: I know what you want to ask, but I can’t answer your question!]
Jiang Ming felt his heart skip a beat but did not inquire further. He just replied,
Let me know when you’re about to leave. I might order from you a batch of
items
Wang Ye: That’s great! Brother Jiang, just remember the preciousness of these
points is beyond your imagination. Don’t simply waste them.)
UJiang Ming: Thanks! What if one’s cultivation level rises above the limitation
of the Supreme Order? Won’t the points be useless?]
[Wang Ye: Perhaps the benefits will be even greater!]
Jiang Ming was startled. He stopped focusing on the chat. He had learned that
the chat room would be his greatest support. Therefore, he no longer had to be
too scrupulous while confronting any Extreme Path experts or even Imminent
Immortal experts in the near future.
Jiang Ming took a last look at the Millions Dao Chart before he rose to his feet,
walking towards where Ye Qingxian and the others were.
“Remarkable!” Luo Hen only blurted a word.
You’re indeed a genius beyond my perception!” Ye Qjngxian exclaimed.
“However strong you are, there is always someone stronger! The Supreme
Pagoda has an unknown number of levels, each of which has many geniuses.
Looking further back in time, how many more will there be? I’m merely one of
the insignificant ones.” Jiang Ming smiled. He then made a pause before
continuing profoundly. “We’re fortunate to be able to come here. Accumulate
and improve yourself as much as possible!”
Ye Qingxian reacted with her eyes gleaming, while Luo Hen looked as if he was
absorbed in thoughts.
Jiang Ming nodded at the other three people. Then he shifted his focus to the
Time Heavenly Monument on his left before sitting cross-legged at one side
and beginning to self-recover.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - omprehended the Time Sanmbohdha; Missing
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Comprehended the Time Sanmbohdha; Missing
Junior Sister
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor. EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 5
Points Accumulated: 142 Points (+3 Special Ability)
Honor: 5 stages record, 18 levels record, 99 units of special abilities
Jiang Ming looked at his information in the Supreme Pagoda after recovering.
His accumulated points changed again.
The comprehended special abilities had been converted to primary level, with
exactly 99 of them. Each special ability was counted in units, and he could earn
1 point for every eight units. This meant Jlang Ming had earned another 12
points, and the other 3 special abilities were not added into account.
Initially, he had 130 points.
It might seem that getting points through deducing special abilities was low,
but it was not true in reality.
The battle stages put combat power to the test, but it got really hard to
improve it further when combat power reached a certain level.
The same went for climbing up the Heavenly Ladder. The improvement of
one’s willpower was extremely slow.
However, it was different for special abilities! As long as one continued
deducing special abilities, there were bound to be results. It was just a matter
of time.
Jiang Ming greeted them and went straight toward the Time Heavenly
Monument on the left.
It was the Sambodha that he had been trying to comprehend but to no avail.
Comprehending the Heavenly Monument and the Dao Monument is akin to
enlightenment. The respective Sambodha can be felt directly, but the cost isn’t
cheap! Comprehending a Heavenly Monument costs one point for every two
hours, and as for the Dao Monument, it’s two points!
This was not just pricey; it was extremely expensive!
How many points could normal geniuses, such as Guang Rui, accumulate?
Those who got three or four points were already considered an amazing feat!
The Heavenly Monument stood so tall that you would have to be very near to
see its contents clearly.
As Jiang Ming went near the 100-meter radius of the Heavenly Monument, he
could hear a voice reminding him, “Jiang Ming, you have stepped into a
100-meter radius from the Heavenly Monument. You may start
comprehending. One point will be deducted every 2 hours. If you do not choose
to stop comprehending, your points will continue to be deducted until there’s
none left!
Jiang Ming paused for a moment and paced a few steps further before coming
to a stop.
Jiang Ming sat cross-legged and looked up at the Heavenly Monument. The
monument seemed very peculiar. There was nothing else other than random
scribbles and some vortexes.
He could feel the time’s power with just a simple glance. He quickly prepared
his mind to meld in it.
He instantly realized that the vast, never- ending time could be felt upon
assimilating into time itself. There were instances of time that slowly formed
vortexes, in disorder, and even in a backflow. These were all instances where
time flowed in reverse.
Jiang Ming was astonished. “So this is time?
In the past, Jiang Ming felt that time was something that could not be seen,
touched, or even felt. He felt that time was more mysterious and abstract than
space.
When a person achieveda certain level of power, they could punch through
space but time.
However tremendous a person’s cultivation was, or even if they were able to
destroy the whole world, none could affect time.
As time passed by, Jiang Ming’s body suddenly shook. A mysterious aura was
flowing out of its body. It felt gentle, like the leaves falling down and soft like
the luminescence of sunsets.
As he felt time flowing boundlessly through the vast space, Jiang Ming finally
began stepping into the rudiments stage of the Time Sambodha. He did not
stop there!
He was prepared to fully comprehend the Time Sambodha at one to save time
fusing the Time Dao in the near future!
From afar
Guang Rui was speechlessly envious of Jiang Ming, who took over 20 hours for
one session of comprehending the Heavenly Monument. “If I had so many
points myself, I would have easily comprehended my Light Dao up to the law’s
level!
“Never mind him. I think we should face reality and fully digest what we’ve
obtained this time around rather than staying here and feeling irritated. If fate
allows, we will meet again,” said Guang Rui looking over at Jiang Ming in
perplexity. He said his goodbyes before disappearing from the place.
Ye Qingxian, however, was not discouraged by Jiang Ming at all. “I will use him
as my goal to catch up to him and overtake him! We are all still in the lower
cultivation realm and struggling along in the midst of this mundane world. The
future is still far ahead of us, and our fate is indefinite. There are still chances
of us surpassing him!”
You are right!” Luo Heng nodded.
Aurum smiled bitterly as he said his goodbyes. T can no longer compare myself
with all of you. Hopefully, we can still meet again in the future!” Initially, he
wanted to stay around. Alas, he could not withstand the continuous blows of
self-depreciation. Hence, he left disheartened.
In the end, even Liu Yuan left the place.
As everyone was leaving, Ye Qingxian asked, “Aren’t you leaving? It’s
impossible to improve much in such a short time. You traded with Brother
Jiang earlier, and it is the best time now for you to head back to reality and
earn a fortune from it. It’s much easier for you to improve yourself in the real
world with that speciality of that world of yours, right?”
“Why don’t you leave then?” rebutted Luo Heng
I will wait for Brother Jiang and try comprehending the Heavenly Monument
myself. I’m sure that I will improve drastically by then and leave a name for
myself on the Stone Monument,” said Ye Qingxian enthusiastically, as Luo
Heng twitched in disbelief.
Ye Qingxian started reading while Luo Heng indulged himself with alcohol,
waiting patiently in silence.
Jiang Ming, who sat in front of the Heavenly Monument, finally finished up his
meditation and walked toward them.
Ye Qingxian was the first to bounce up and congratulate Jiang Ming for
mastering the Time Dao.
Luo Heng followed after. “Congratulations, Brother Jiang! Back at my place, we
have a saying that those who mastered time are well-respected as though they
are kings! I still can’t believe that you’ve now mastered it yourself!
“Yes, Ive gained quite a bit today,” jiang Ming replied happily.
He had gained tremendously from this round of comprehension with the
Heavenly Monument by spending 39 points in just 78 hours. In fact, he not
only stepped foot into understanding the Time Sambodha but also ended up
mastering the Time Sambodha as a whole!
Taking just three days to master the Dao Sambodha fully was truly an
imaginable feat!
It was without a doubt a combination of his profound comprehension of Dao
and also the extraordinary effect from the Heavenly Monument.
Jiang Ming was able to feel an even higher level of Time Sambodha as he
completely mastered the Time Sambodha. He knew that what he felt then was
the Time Law, a more profound and even more mysterious level than before.
iang Ming calmed himself down for now because he understood it was nearly
impossible to try stepping into the latter level in such a short time.
Although he had accumulated many points, he had yet to master many other
Sambodhas completely. He needed to start planning wisely.
Ye Qjngxian asked, “Brother Jiang, is there any benefit for leaving our names
on the Stone Monuments?
Luo Heng hurriedly clenched his fist in respect, stating that he wanted to ask
the same thing himself.
It was the reason both of them had stayed behind and waited for Jiang Ming
“Yes, there are benefits to it. Once we leave our names on the Stone Monument,
we will be invited to join the Supreme Chat Room,” Jiang Ming answered. He
did not hold back, nor was there any need to hide it from them.
“A chat room? Ye Qingxian asked as she frowned in confusion.
Luo Heng was surprised and asked, You mean a place where people can chat
around. That kind of chat room?
“We can even trade in the chat room,” added Jiang Ming
Luo Heng was suddenly overwhelmed by this piece of news. “A chat room
where members can even trade across different worlds? Doesn’t that mean
there’s no longer any restriction among worlds?
“Yes, something like that.” Jiang Ming nodded.
Ye Qjngxian finally understood, and her eyes gleamed. “This means that all of
the group members are people who left their names on the Stone Monument,
the crème de la crème among geniuses?”
“Right again!” Jiang Ming smiled.
Upon hearing this shocking piece of news, Luo Heng was brimming with
enthusiasm!
“Never have I imagined there are such benefits hidden in this Supreme Pagoda.
No, I have to work and strive harder! I am Luo Heng, the genius of the
universe! I cannot fall behind anyone!
“Thank you, Brother jiang, for sharing this! If I manage to join this chat room,
I will provide you with as many high-quality energy crystals as you desire!”
Luo Heng promised as he bowed in respect.
Ye Qingxian clenched her fist and thanked Jiang Ming as well.
“Gathering together is proof of fate. You two were able to understand the whole
thing with just a few hints fully. It’s a sign!”
Jiang Ming did not plan to tell the other three about this. They had left and
missed their chances.
If they knew the existence of such a chat room, they might continue to strive
harder, and there would still be a slight chance for them to join. But now, it had
become almost impossible.
Jiang Ming did not go deeper into what the chat room was all about. After
chatting briefly, he left for the other Heavenly Monuments.
He continued to comprehend many more Heavenly Monuments such as
Reincarnation, Decimation, Karma, Unlimited, Blade, and Illusions.
He only comprehended a glimpse of most Sambodhas, for he had a limited
amount of points available.
He remembered the seven main Dao Monuments, namely the Five Elemental,
Yin-Yang, Life-and-Death, Light-and-Dark, True Illusion, Space-Time, and
Chaos.
Comprehending these Dao Monuments required two points for every two
hours, and the difficulty of comprehending was even harder, especially for the
Space-Time and Chaos Dao Monuments.
Understanding space-time was easier in comparison because the
comprehension of Spatial Sambodha and Time Sambodha could act as a base
for reference. However, the same could not be said for the Chaos Dao
Monument. Even if a person spent points on comprehending it, the level of
comprehension for it was still a blur and immensely difficult to even set foot
on the rudimentary stage.
Jiang Ming went to the Million Dao Chart again when he had spent most of his
points. He could accumulate points easily so did spending them. He was
prepared to continue deducing special abilities to gain more points.
He had a target this time around. He slowly managed to deduce many special
abilities, such as the physical offensive special ability, the consciousness
defensive special ability, and the mind offensive special ability.
As Jiang Ming’s aura became stronger and stronger, Luo Heng and Ye Qjngxian,
who glanced over occasionally, started to get anxious. They could only sigh
because the distance between them and Jiang Ming was becoming bigger and
bigger.
This session of comprehending special abilities is enough for my use! Jiang
Ming thought as he finally stood up after a very long time. He had a great
feeling of accomplishment but was very tired at the same time. This feeling of
exhaustion came from his very spirit.
He looked around at the Heavenly Monument and the Dao Monument, finally
looking at the Battle Stage and the Heavenly Ladder. Jiang Ming shook his
head, suppressing his urge to continue pushing onward.
“Never mind, I should get myself some rest. I’m starting to miss Junior Sister
anyway,” Jiang Ming muttered.
“Brother Luo, Sister Ye, Im going back now. Hopefully, we can still see each
other in the future.” Jiang Ming clenched his fist and said his goodbyes. He
didn’t want to stay there any longer.
He took a look at his own information before leaving
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Levels
Points Accumulated: 52 points
Honor: 5 stages record, 18 levels record, 336 units of special abilities
The current special abilities accumulated, minus the previous 96 types of
special abilities, accounted for a total of 30 points. Adding the 22 points that
remained previously, it came to a total of 52 points.
Next time, I’ll be back again to break my limits!’ Jiang Ming thought as he
evoked the Supreme Order and returned to reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - Senior Brother, Don’t Move, Just for a While
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Senior Brother, Don’t Move, Just for a While
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Special Ability:
[Supreme: Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Great Manifestation Technique, Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, etc.]
[Advanced: Five Elemental Defense, Yin-Yang Grinding Disc, Nine Divine Mountain Treasures, etc.]
[Intermediate: Three-fold Astral Transformation, Tian Gang Punch, etc.]
[Elementary: Wooden Dragon, Nine Heavens Imperial Lightning, Slice the Heavens sword technique, etc.]
Innate talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Item: Human Path Records, Supreme Order, Mystical Light Sword, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disc, Mana Sealing Chessboard (top-grade Dao Vessel), Dark Abyss Sword (high-grade Dao Vessel), 7,600 years of cultivation, Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card, top-grade Enlightening Tea Leaf (1,000 pieces)
Support: Primary Training Zone
For what looked to be a long passing of time in the Supreme Pagoda, only wo
hours had gone by in the real world
Jiang Ming walked out of the room and went up the roof. Gazing at the galaxy
far beyond, he took a deep breath. It gave him an indescribable feeling of
serenity.
Laying back on the rattan chair, he checked his Status and noticed there were
some changes. The Spell column had been removed, while the Special Ability
section had been separated into different types. The rest did not change much.
With 7600 years of cultivation, the mana accumulated in his sea of
consciousness had reached its peak
If he consumed them, the benefits would be insignificant, but if left to
overflow, the mana would only dissipate away.
Currently, what Jiang Ming was comprehending was the Sambodha, what he
was trying to form was the Dao Seed, and what he was cultivating was his
cultivation realm.
Although it might seem that there are not many changes to his physique, he
had reached the current physical limits.
The Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra and physical training were linked
together, but even then, cultivating both at the same time still would not be
enough to help him break through.
His battle prowess, however, had grown immensely.
“Never would I have guessed that the Great Manifestation Technique would
actually be a supreme-grade special ability. This is really a surprise!”
exclaimed Jiang Ming
He figured that the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi would be considered to be
of supreme-grade as well, and the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation
Technique being a supreme-grade special ability was not surprising either.
Suddenly, Jiang Ming saw a figure flying toward him from afar and landed
right next to him. It turmed out it was Zi Linglong.
“Senior Brother, let’s just squeezea little,” she said as she leaned against Jíang
Ming, who was trying to inch over to the other side.
“You little girl, why don’t you go for a rest?” Jiang Ming asked.
Zi Linglong remained by his side and fluffed up his shoulder like a pillow,
latching on comfortably.
The soft night breeze blew comfortably, tickling his face as her hair swayed
around.
“T’ve just completed a part of my training and came running over whenI saw
you were awake!” Zi Linglong said happily. ‘
Brother, you used to be a deep sleeper and seldomly wake up in the middle of
she asked curiously, “Senior
the night. What’s wrong”
With a big smile on his face, Jiang Ming replied, “Tve also just finished my
cultivation and came out for some fresh air. Linglong, do you need any help
with your cultivation?”
Zi Linglong reached out and clung on to his neck, inching nearer and nearer
until half of her body was already bearing down on him.
“You’ve grown so much, and you’re still squeezing on to me.” Jiang Ming
huffed.
“Well, I always slept on top of you when we were kids. I’m older now, but that
doesn’t mean I can’t do it anymore. From now on, you are my pillo,” Zí
Linglong replied with a cheeky smile as she squinted her eyes.
Jiang Ming muttered, “You can even kill a Primal Spirit expert with your
strength. If you suddenly get agitated, you might end upf
bits. I won’t be able to rest in peace!”
ening me into
“Just relax, Senior Brother! My phoenix bloodline has the ability to reincamate.
Even if you really burst into pieces, I can easily fix you up.” Zi Linglong
grinned.
“Yes, you are all that!” Jiang Ming sneered.
Zi Linglong continued to snuggle up to him. “Hehe! It’s really comfortable
laying on you. So don’t move! I want to take a nap!”
“Well, I want to take a nap to0,” Jiang Ming muttered.
Zi Linglong lay on top of Jiang Ming and continued teasing one another before
falling asleep together.
AS the sun rose steadily up the eastern sky, the warm sunlight slowly crept its
way over, illuminating Mother Earth. The two finally woke up from their deep
sleep.
“That was a really good sleep:” Zi Linglong yawned with her eyes still
half-opened. She did not climb down from Jiang Ming but instead snuggled
even closer onto his neck for comfort.
“The sun is already up. You are killing me here.” Jiang Ming huffed.
“Brother, let me sleep just for a bit more. Early momings are the best timeto
sleep. Pretty please?” Zi Linglong begged as she refused to come down.
Jiang Ming simply flipped over, placing her down before waking up himself.
“I’m making breakfast!” he said as he jumped off and went off to prepare their
breaktast.
Zi Linglong continued to snuggle on the rattan chair with the biggest smile on
her tace.
As the sun finally rose, illuminating everyone and everything, Zi Linglong
finally got up and saw that Jiang Ming had already prepared a table full of food.
“Brother, what’s this? It looks murky and sticky,” asked Zi Linglong curiously.
“This is black pepper soup. Have a taste. Maybe you might like it. If not, then go
for those white soft looking things on the side. This is Tofu Pudding. They are
much lighter and retreshing answered jlang Ming while dipping his bun into
the black pepper sauce, taking a big bite. The crispy bun covered with the
gooey black pepper soup tasted heavenly!
Zi Linglong looked at the gooey black pepper soup and frowned. She stirred the
soup around with her spoon and muttered, “Brother, this soup looks
unappetizing. I know there’s mutton, yellow flower herbs, purple fungus, and
even prawns in them, but it still looks really hard to swallow!”
Jiang Ming could only ask her to give it a try.
“Well, you made them for me. So I guess I must give them a try,” Zi Linglong
murmured as she took a sip hesitantly.
“Delicious!” Zi Linglong praised as she continued to sip more and more of the
black pepper soup.
As Jiang Ming smiled in delight, an announcement could suddenly be heard in
his mind. “Ding! Congratulations! Master has hada delicious breakfast with
Junior Sister. Reward of 10 days of cultivation is awarded!”. This made his smile
spread.
They finished up their breakfast, and just as Jiang Ming was about to sit down
after doing the dishes, Zi Linglong had already prepareda pot of tea and was
walking toward him.
“Come, little girl, sit,” said Jíang Ming as he patted the seat next to him.
Zi Linglong hugged onto his arms, sat next to him, swinging around, and
asked, “Brother, what is it?”
I have something for you.” Jiang Ming smiled as he flipped over his hands,
revealing a piece of red crystal. The crystal was scarlet red and looked
somewhat ominous. Even though the crystal was sealed, a threatening aura
dispersed out of it, sending chills down one’s spine.
This is.” Zi Linglong gasped when she saw the crystal lying in Jiang Ming’s
palm. Her eyes were staring wide at the scarlet crystal in disbelief. “This looks
like the Phoenix’s Blood!?”
Jiang Ming simply nodded. “This is actually the Phoenixs Blood Essence. The
phoenix’s will has already been refined, and its raging power has been
suppressed. Consuming it now is completely safe and should be very beneficial
you.
“Here you go. Don’t ask questions,” Jiang Ming said as he handed Zi Linglong
the crystal.
“Thank you, Brother!” Zi Linglong thanked Jiang Ming. She had so many
queries and confusions on how he had gotten them in the first place but ended
up not asking any questions and simply thanked him for it.
Jiang Ming followed up with another jade box sealed with 10 herbs. Just by
looking at the Yin-Yang aura lingering around the herbs, one could tell they
Were exotic items.
“These are 10 blades of king-grade Yin-Yang Sword Grass. It helps a lot with
the cultivation of the Yin-Yang Dao,” Jiang Ming explained as he tossed her the
OX.
Jiang Ming had gotten the items from trading with Feng Wu. The Phoenix
Blood was of the immortal grade, which only cost him 1 point; the same went
for the 10 blades of Yin-Yang Sword Grass.
n the past, he couldn’t give anything to her because he wasn’t strong enough
and would invite suspicion from others. Another reason was he couldn’t find
any explanation for how he got them in the first place.
Even though Jiang Ming had the Supreme Order now, he still could not let
others know of the items’ origins, but at least he felt the reason was good
enough.
He now had the confidence and the ability to face the world. Of course, he
Would start to train his Junior sister.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record and took a look at his relationship
with Zi Linglong to see that there were no changes, and it remains at 97.
Her Status, however, stated: ‘My goodness! How does Brother Jiang own such
an immortal-grade Artifact? Did he stumble upon Immortal encounters? That
must be it!
Seeing her Status in the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming smiled as he
explained, Tve gotten some lucky Immortal encounters, that’s all. Don’t pry!”
“Ha! Thats where you got them!T knew it! With your vast knowledge and
peerless talent, how would you be weaker than anyone? Brother Jiang, I think
you can continue pretending to be weak and let me handle the problems
outside. You can continue your cultivation in the shadows,” exclaimed Zi
Linglong, who was delighted for Jlang Ming but was still a little perplexed.
Jiang Ming noticed that her Status had added yet another row: “Brother Jiang
had Immortal encounters? That’s really good news. In the future, with both of
us working together, we can kill the Nine Heavens!’
Reading this, Jiang Ming had a weird thought that Zi Linglong was arranging
for her to deal with the affairs outside and arranging himself to deal with
internal affairs.
As Zi Linglong went back to continue her cultivation, Jiang Ming walked to the
back of the mountain. He pondered long at the 5 acres of planted lands and
decided just to destroy all of them, leaving only an acre of farmland.
He turned around and entered into the underground void that he had opened
It was enclosed with a formation evoked from the Life and Death
Disillusionment Formation Disk. Jiang Ming knew now that this disk’s grade
was exceptionally good and actually on par with an immortal-grade Dao
Vessel.
The void was huge, and an immortal-grade spiritual fountain was standing in
the middle of it. It was constantly communicating with the ley line, absorbing
the heaven and earth spiritual essence and turning it into an immortal-grade
spiritual fluid.
An immortal-grade Enlightening Tree seed could be seen starting to bud in the
middle of the fountain.
Pondering for a bit, Jiang Ming suddenly announced, “From now on, this here
will be called the Chuyang Cave!
He started to evoke spatial energy to widen the land further, reaching a total of
10 acres wide. Four acres were lands surrounding the spiritual fountain and
were recognized by the system as fertile land.
Jiang Ming evoked the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk once
again, placing a bundle of low-grade energy crystals into it.
Upon detecting the loW-grade energy crystal, the formation started operating
to whittle away at the energy crystal, turning them into gaseous spiritual
essence, which intensified the cave’s spiritual essence to its limit in an instant!
At the same time, waves of patterns started coming out of the formation. Some
of them followed the ley lines into the ground while others reached out into
the air as if following an invisible network, triggering the power of the orders
of heaven and earth. It slowly covered the entire cave, permeating through
Chuyang Peak, quietly raising the sect’s defense.
All of a sudden, the spiritual fountain was suddenly stimulated by the gaseous
spiritual essence in the air and started to hum. These gaseous spiritual
essences were slowly pulled toward the fountain, condensing and saturating
until they eventually turmed into top-grade spiritual fluid!
“Incredible! This really works” exclaimed Jiang Ming euphorically as he
continued adding two more bundles of those low-grade energy crystals into
the fomation.
Jiang Ming thought for a while before deciding to plant more seeds into the
land, namely the Ancient ‘Tree of War’s seed, Flower Fairy Tree’s seed, Scarlet
Fruit’s seed, Phoenix Blood Crystal Rice, and many more.
All of these seeds were considered rare elixir seeds, which even the worst
among thenm were of high grade. There was even a chance for these seeds to
grow into a King of Medicine. It was a shame that he could not plant them as
densely like he did before because the seed’s grade was so high that it might
not even bud when it was planted too near to each other
Jiang Ming quickly finished farming the four acres of land and came to realize
that there was no reward given by the system this time around.
“I destroyed the previous plot of land and reopened this land. Maybe that’s why
there’s no reward this time.” speculated Jiang Ming
He reasoned that this might be a way to prevent people from cheating, but he
paid no heed. It would be absurd if he could keep destroying and replanting the
few acres of land repeatedly and receive rewards for doing so.
“The spiritual essence has become so saturated, turning into rain clouds and
irrigating the whole plot of land. With such great conditions, there’s bound to
be a bountiful harvest in the future! I can’t wait!” exclaimed Jiang Ming.
“Everythings all set in place and ready for the next crucial part. Hopefully, the
Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique can effectively help speed
up the plants’ growthl” thought Jiang Ming as he leaped up enthusiastically and
sat cross-legged atop the middle of the patch of land.
He started to slowly evoke the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation
Technique, which caused waves and waves of green aura to appear, radiating
through and engulfing the four acres of land.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - Three Years Swept by; Age of 18 Already;
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Three Years Swept by; Age of 18 Already;
Incredibly Huge Changes
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
The Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique was a mysterious
special ability.
Jiang Ming focused on comprehending the technique even more during his
spare time in the Supreme Pagoda. Although it did not cost him much effort,
he only managed to comprehend it up to the second level, for this special
ability was just too hard to master.
The second level of this technique could speed up the growth of spiritual herbs
by up to 100 -fold!
Jiang Ming slowly evoked the special ability, molding mana into pieces of tiny
runes. These runes formed waves of lights which then merged into each seed.
As the light slowly seeped in, it triggered the seeds’ growth, expanding it until
the bud from the seed’s membrane bloomed. The seeds started to absorb all the
spiritual essence upon budding wildly and grew rapidly.
Woosh!
Numerous whirlpools could be seen forming on top of each seed as the
spiritual essence was siphoned as nutrients.
It didn’t take long before all the small whirlpools caused a storm, devouring the spiritual essence in the entire area in just a glimpse.
“So, this is the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique’s weakness!”
exclaimed Jiang Ming.
The cave, initially rich with spiritual essence, was wiped clean in an instant.
The seeds ravaged even the Enlightening Tree’s two newly nurtured sprouts.
The whole thing was just too violent.
Jiang Ming quickly realized that in order to speed up the seeds’ growth by
100 -fold, the amount of spiritual essence needed would drastically increase by
the thousands or even ten thousands!
Jiang Ming evoked the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk to
speedily refine the energy crystals, instantly filling up the whole place with
spiritual essence once again!
However fast Jiang Ming tried refining them into spiritual essence, the seeds
devoured them even faster. This phenomenon continued for another two hours
before coming to an end.
This special ability consumed a tremendous amount of spiritual essence in the
beginning but started to dwindle down after absorbing to a certain level.
Even so, its consumption of spiritual essence was simply terrifying. Luckily,
with the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disc’s ability to absorb the
energy from the ley lines, Jiang Ming was able to keep up with the seeds’ speed
of absorbing spiritual essence. Jiang Ming started to regret his actions and sighed. “I’ll have to find more
top-grade spiritual crystals or even immortal crystals if I want to keep up with
this.’
It was evident that the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique
depleted a lot of resources. He might not have been able to keep up with such
consumption in the past. If he failed to provide ample spiritual essence, the
spiritual herbs might wither out from the technique’s backlash.
The seed from the Ancient Tree of War had already budded to more than 10
inches tall. Even the Enlightening Tea Tree’s seeds had grown substantially.
The growth of some top-grade spiritual herbs’ seeds was truly gratifying.
Jiang Ming stood high above in the air, admiring his work.
‘Hopefully, when the time comes, I’ll get a good harvest from this. Otherwise,
this would have been a huge waste,’ Jiang Ming thought before flying off.
Time passed slowly without anyone noticing. The outside world was filled with
wars and carnages daily, yet the mountaintop remained as peaceful as always.
Gu Hai returned to the mountains occasionally to loiter around, enjoying the
peace there. He went around playing chess and drinking wine and sometimes
even visited the city by the mountain foot to listen to some music, enjoymg
himself. Meanwhile, Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong were always busy cultivating in
Chuyang Peak. The duo could be seen eating and drinking on their time off and
enjoying the serenity too.
Jiang Ming was still trying to comprehend the Sambodhas, for he wanted to
master them quickly to move on to the next step, the fusion of Dao.
He would still occasionally cultivate in the Supreme Pagoda but did not visit
the Heaven Ladder or the Heavenly Battle Stage. He spent his time
comprehending the Heavenly Monuments or observing the Dao Monuments.
Most of the time, however, he would be seen deducing his techniques at the
Million Dao Chart.
Although he did not improve his cultivation realm, his battle prowess rose
drastically.
The imprint on the Immortal Weapon Mysterious Light Sword was completely
removed during his time in the Supreme Pagoda.
Three years of such peaceful days passed swiftly.
One morning, Zi Linglong finished up her breakfast and washed for Jiang Ming
a plate of fruits before continuing her cultivation. Her Yin-Yang Sambodha was
almost fully mastered already.
Jiang Ming, who was loitering around leisurely in Chuyang Peak, suddenly
sensed something different. He quickly dived into the Supreme Order to open
the chat room and quickly realized that a new member had joined their chat room.
The quiet, gloomy chat room suddenly became active again!
[Zhan Ge: A warm welcome to our new friend here, Ye Qingxian! Qingxian,
such a nice name! I can tell that you must be a lady for sure by your name! An
exquisite lady radiating with temperament! Sister Ye, send us a photo of
yourself and let us know more about you!]
[Feng Wu: Sister Ye, don’t listen to this guy babbling. He is really a pig!]
[Zhan Ge: Hey! That was personal!]
[Feng Wu: TeeHee!]
[Zhan Ge: (speechless)]
[Jiang Ming: Ms. Ye, welcome to the Supreme Chat Room!]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang! I knew it, I knew you were here! Thank you!]
[Feng Wu: Huh? Seems something is going on here!]
[Zhan Ge: You should just say this here is an affair!]
[Feng Wu: You stupid guy! You just freed yourself from getting killed, and now
you are trying to get yourself into trouble again! One day you might offend
some powerful being, and they will put you out of your misery!]
[Zhan Ge: We are all God’s Destined Children! What are we even afraid of?]
[Ao Jiu: Enough squabbling you two. Group admin, I went through Ye
Qingxian’s information, and it seems her cultivation base is Level 5. I guess you two acquainted each other in the Supreme Pagoda?]
[Jiang Ming: Yes. Her talent is peerless, and she’s not any weaker than us here!]
[Ao Jiu: Those who manage to reach this chat room are surely not weak!]
[Wang Ye: Now that we have a new member joining us, I think it’s time I take
my leave! Meeting each other here is fate after all, so if anyone here needs any
help, speak up now, and I’ll see what I can do!]
[Feng Wu: If Brother Wang is going to break through soon, I guess I can’t wait
any longer myself! Fate brought us together, and I hope we can still meet each
other in the future! group admin, do you still need anything?]
[Jiang Ming: I do need something, actually. I’ll DM you. I’m sure we will meet
again in the higher-tier supreme chat rooms in the future!]
[Feng Wu: Great! See you all again then! Also, group admin, when you join the
higher tier, you can definitely be an admin again!]
[Wang Ye: Given Brother Jiang’s talent, I think it’s really possible!]
Ye Qingxian joining the chat room sparked many conversations, and some
even started trading among them.
In the Supreme Pagoda, Ye Qingxian was standing at the Heavenly Ladder and
had just stepped foot onto the 10th level. Although she failed at the 11th level, it
still gave her the opportunity to join the chat room.
It was through joining the chat room she came to realize that those in the group there should be called the real peerless geniuses from the infinite
worlds. Ye Qingxian went through a few of the members’ information and saw
there were many peerless bloodlines, such as the Divine Being, phoenix, and
even dragons.
‘To think that Jiang Ming was able to become the chat room’s group admin.
That was truly incredible,’ Ye Qingxian thought.
‘This is really an unbelievable chance for me!’ Ye Qingxian gasped. What really
made her euphoric was that she could even trade among worlds through this
chat room.
“Jiang Ming was able to get a 5 stages record, 18 levels record, and even
managed to become the group admin on his first try upon entering the
Supreme Pagoda. If they knew of his achievement, how shocked would they be?
Jiang Ming! You are truly remarkable!” exclaimed Ye Qingxian.
The more she understood him, the more she realized how terrifying Jiang
Ming’s potential was. As conceited as she was, she couldn’t help herself from
marveling at Jiang Ming.
On top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming smiled as he received a message from Ye
Qingxian thanking him.
He then messaged Feng Wu and Wang Ye privately and traded some things.
‘A group even superior to the Supreme Chat Room? Are these the true immortal
beings?’ Jiang Ming pondered as Gu Hai suddenly flew back and landed next to him.
Gu Hai lifted the teapot nonchalantly and drank the whole thing in a sip.
“Like that, and you’ve just wasted such a good tea.” Jiang Ming laughed.
“I’m satisfied, and that’s what matters,” Gu Hai replied as he sat right next to
Jiang Ming. He then sneered jokingly. “Little brat, you really don’t show this
old -timer his due respect. I’ve come back, and you don’t even stand up to greet
me anymore!”
“What if you try making your grand appearance again? I’ll stand up and
welcome you this time. Master, do you need anything?” Jiang Ming chuckled in
reply.
“You are looking for a beating young man! I’m the First Seat for crying out
loud! Can’t I come back to my own turf as I wish?” Gu Hai sneered while Jiang
Ming continued just to chuckle.
“Why do I feel like beating you up?” As Gu Hai started to get worked up, Zi
Linglong suddenly flew down and joined them.
Gu Hai’s face instantly lit up when he saw her. “Little girl! You’ve grown so
much!”
“Master! I’m 18 now!” Zi Linglong smiled as she sat next to her Master. “Do you
have anything to tell us this time, Master?”
Gu Hai’s face slowly turned solemn, and he explained, “Yes, I do. It’s been 1,000 years now, and the Immortal Treasure of Lei Province has finally opened
again. Only those below the Nascent Soul Realm can enter. There will be not
only trials or inheritance but also great chances of blessings.
“Chances of dying are slim, and most who enter the Immortal Treasure are
bound to benefit from it. Legend has it that if a person manages to pass the last
trial, he or she will even obtain the core inheritance of the Immortal Treasure.”
Gu Hai paused and looked at her, asking, “Linglong, do you want to go?
“Lei Province’s Immortal Treasure?” Zi Linglong exclaimed before asking her
Master for more details of the place.
Gu Hai nodded in agreement and started to explain more as Jiang Ming
listened attentively.
“Tens of thousands of years ago, there lived a peerless warrior who many
called him as God of Thunder.
“His cultivation reached an extraordinary level, and he left his inheritance
behind for others before starting his journey toward immortality. However, he
also put a restriction on his inheritance, and those who have exceeded the
Nascent Soul Realm will be slaughtered if they try entering his place of
inheritance. Those who are below the Nascent Soul Realm, however, will not be
met with much danger.
“There was a time when many powerful warriors tried to force themselves into
this God of Thunder’s inheritance and were killed mercilessly. Because of that,
the place slowlv became a forbidden area. “The Immortal Treasure was set to open once in every 1,000 years, and there
will surely be a lucky person who will be met with great fate and rise among
others.
“This is now the ninth time the Immortal Treasure opens up.”
“I want to go for a try! Senior Brother, may I?” Linglong answered as she
looked over at Jiang Ming, asking for approval.
Jiang Ming smiled. “If you want to go, just go. I will be there to protect you
along the way. You can go anyvvhere you wish under this vast world.”
“Keep bragging. You are only a Core Formation brat! I can easily kill you with
just one finger. How do you plan on protecting Linglong along the way?” Gu
Hai huffed.
Zi Linglong only smiled but kept her silence.
Jiang Ming scratched his head. He had the urge to try pulling off a strand of his
hair and see if he could overwhelm Gu Hai with it.
“Well, just go and try. With your cultivation, coupled with you obtaining some
lucky encounters in the past, I don’t think the sect can give you much help.” Gu
Hai sighed reluctantly before he continued to advise, “The Sect Master will
always be monitoring the whole thing as it progresses. If you meet any
troubles, just wave around our flags and scream for help. Using our sect’s name
seems more imposing. I think that’s all you can do, anymvay.” “Master, that is more than enough.” Jiang Ming smiled in reply.
“How is that even enough, you brat?” Gu Hai huffed again
“It’s best if nothing bad happens. But if something happens, it will make your
Master and our sect seem useless. I’ll go discuss with the Sect Master and see if
I can get more information on this Immortal Treasure.” He sighed before flymg
off.
The wind blew strong over the vast land. Waving his hand, Jiang Ming evoked a
formation, isolating him and Zi Linglong from the surrounding area. A few
items suddenly appeared in front of them with a simple thought. Their
appearance instantly caused the sunlight to turn as rays of light started
diverging from them, radiating a powerful aura that filled up the top of
Chuyang Peak.
Zi Linglong gasped in shock at the items and asked, “What are these, Senior
Brother?”
“Golden Phoenix Shoes, Golden Phoenix Feather, Golden Phoenix Suit, Golden
Phoenix Crown, Golden Phoenix Belt, Golden Phoenix Sword, and Golden
Phoenix Fan.” Jiang Ming named each of the equipment and pushed them over
to Zi Linglong. He then added, “This here is a full set of top-grade Dao Vessels.
They will fit perfectly with your phoenix bloodline. If you manage to refine the
set of equipment, coupled with your peerless battle prowess, you can even fend
off against Paradis experts!”
Zi Linglong was moved by Jiang Ming’s gift and sniffed while her eyes started to water. “Senior Brother, you prepared this set just for me!?”
“I only have you as my Junior Sister. Who else would I prepare these for?” Jiang
Ming replied.
“You’re the best, Senior Brother! Did you have to pay a lot for them? I think
maybe you should just return them,” Zi Linglong said because she was worried
for him.
Jiang Ming chuckled. “Haha, it’s fine. Don’t worry. Wait till you get to the
Paradis Realm. I’ll get you a full set of Immortal Weapons!”
Hearing that Jiang Ming would even give her a set of Immortal Weapons, Zi
Linglong leaped into his arms and said, “Senior Brother, I’m starting to think
that you might be a reincarnated immortal!”
Half a month went by, and Zi Linglong finally left.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record and was occasionally looking for
any changes in her status.
He discovered that his relationship with Zi Linglong had increased another
point, reaching 98 points in toatal, which seemed to be the maximum already.
He flipped the pages out of boredom and stumbled upon the Status of Yue
Cheng, the First Seat of Zhiyang Peak. As he looked through his status, he
looked shocked at first, but deep inside of him, his urge to kill was bubbling. “This guy! Is he finally making his moves? I’ve been waiting for ages for this!
Old Yue, I’d really hate to kill you,” muttered Jiang Ming..

Chapter 100: Great Dao Furnace, Infinite Technique
Fusion, Ultimate Dao Seed Emerges
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Year 9,998 of the Zhou calendar...
Name: Yue Cheng
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: First Seat of Zhiyang Peak (Note: He’s actually an Elder of the
Yinmo Sect)
Relationship: -9
Talent: Seven Stars
Status: Just received news that the God of Thunders Immortal Treasure opens
in one month’s time. It’s time to launch their attack onto the Jiuyang Sect and
take over the place. He is to be prepared to launch an attack from the inside
and take down the sect in a sweep to avoid any unforeseen accidents.
He was confused why they kept on targeting the Jiuyang Sect, a second-tier
sect.
If they want to take over the Jiuyang Sect, won’t it be a piece of cake if they just
send a Paradis expert to take it over! Are they worried that any big commotion
will bring them to the Qingyun Sect’s attention?
‘Is there really a big secret hidden by the Jiuyang Sect?
That last phrase of the status was First Seat Yue Cheng’s doubt and something
Jiang Ming couldn’t make of.
The Yinmo Sect started laying out their plans very early on. They placed
someone undercover who climbed up to the First Seat’s position and tried to
secretly take over Jiuyang Sect, only to end up being decimated by the Qinyun
Sect.
Now, it’s been only a couple of years, and they are planning to do this yet
again. It seemed very abnormal to Jiang Ming.
On a hunch, Jiang Ming flipped open the Human Path Record over to the page
of the Qingyun Sect’s Supreme Elder, Yang Feng
Yang Fen, also known as Qing Fengzi, Extreme Path Realm
Status: “The opening of the God of Thunder’s Immortal Treasure will surely
attract all the young geniuses to try their luck. The Yinmo Sect and Red
Mountain Palace will surely take this chance to strike.
“Keeping my Qingyun Sect’s expert at bay, these two forces will launch their
attack on the other sects as well taking over the domains and clearing out any
hindrance. The timing is just right! We will take this chance to clean up Eastern
Region and secretly kill off a few of those sects and families who dare to defy
our Qinyun Sect, especially these two. Still thinking of becoming a Sacred
Land? Keep dreaming!
“The trap is set, and when they launch their attack, I will be able to sweep them
up in one go!’
As Jiang Ming read through the status, a chill went down his spine as he
realized that they were all cunning old men.
The Qingyun Sect knew about the collaboration between the Yinmo Sect and
Red Mountain Palace but acted as if they didn’t have a clue and continued just
naturally to fend off these demons as they emerged. Yet, in reality, a big trap
was already in place for them.
There must be a Qingyun spy among the higher-ups of the Yinmo Sect,
thought Jiang Ming confidently. ‘How could the Yinmo Sect be so useless
preparing their scheme for such a long time?’ Jiang Ming was in disbelief.
If the Yinmo Sect knew what was happening in the Qingyun sect, it wouldve
been a heck of a show! Everything would be evident in a month’s time.
“Why do you have to challenge my Jiuyang Sect? You’re just forcing me to go on
a killing spree, aren’t you? muttered Jiang Ming, annoyed.
He really wanted to live a peaceful life, where he could just cultivate in the
shadows and slowly grow strong. Once the time was right, he could then kill
every single one of those who plotted against him. This would have been
perfect for him.
Unfortunately, he had no choice, as some people were just rushing to their
death.
Jiang Ming went back to his underground cave.
There had been a huge change compared to how it looked initially, especially
the Spiritual Fountain right in the middle of the whole cave. Inside the
Spiritual Fountain, a 3-meter-tall Enlightening Tea Tree could be seen with
3,000 young sprouts. Boundless fluctuation could be seen streaming along its
surface, yet there was still a long time to go before these sprouts could be
harvested.
Furthermore, the Ancient Tree of War could be seen growing up to 10 meters
tall with its lush green leaves; truly a sight to behold. Jiang Ming could even
sense a small and weak spirit slowly emerging from the tree. Once the spirit
developed fully, it would grow to become a real Tree Being
A myriad of spiritual herbs had grown substantially, and many of them were
already mature and ready to be harvested. Jiang Ming did not give them much
thought and looked around his cave. The cave had truly tumed into a cavern,
being thousands of meters high, with its land reaching tens of thousands of
meters wide.
Jiang Ming had been continuously opening more lands with his spatial ability,
and its dense spiritual essence had turned into fog, permeating into every inch
of its space for the longest of time. The spiritual essence had accumulated so
much that a spiritual essence stream was slowly formed.
After surveying the area, Jiang Ming sat cross-legged on one of the clouds and
was prepared for his breakthrough.
Deep in his consciousness, many of his Dao Seeds had reached their limit
causing their mana to overflow.
Jiang Ming was now in a state where all his Dao Seeds were at their pinnacle, a
maximum that had never been achieved.
His next step was to start and nurture them into a Nascent Soul.
There can only be one Nascent Soul, but Jiang Ming had numerous types of Dao
in him. If they could not be fused together, he had no choice but to cut off the
extra Dao Seeds, leaving only 1 to his use.
“All Dao Seeds are perfectly mastered and what’s left is to fuse them,” muttered
Jiang Ming as he closed his eyes to focus.
He had gotten a lot of rewards, had been drinking the Enlightening Tea daily,
and would even go to cultivate inside the Supreme Tower occasionally in the
past three years. He had long accumulated the Dao Seeds to a level no one had
ever tried to.
Had he not had a wild ambition in his heart, he could have easily reached the
Nascent Soul Realm, Primal Spirit Realm, or even the Paradis Realm.
“System, seal my body changes within,” commanded Jiang Ming as the system
slowly permeated around him.
He evoked the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra and formed endless surges
of waves in his consciousness that had already reached a radius of 10,000
kilometers.
Even if Jiang Ming tried to continue expanding his consciousness, a
10,000-kilometer consciousness was already the true limit, and it would not
expand any further.
As waves of enormous mana surged, the Dao Seeds started illuminating one
after another. Each luminance represented one type of Dao, and trying to fuse
them into one was not an easy feat.
Using my consciousness as a furnace, fusing every Dao and merging all into a
single Dao!’ thought Jiangg Ming as he evoked his technique to its limits.
Loud rumbling sounds could be heard from his consciousness as a destructive
storm of power that could shatter the heavens and earth was fomed.
Countless types of Dao could be seen, such as the Five Elemental, Yin-Yang,
Space-Time, Life-and-Death, Light-and-Dark, True Ilusion, Reincarmation,
Karma Dao Seeds, and many mor
Jiang Ming used the Five Elements as a base, Yin-Yang as a frame, Space-Time
as support, filing up with Light-and-Dark, running through Life-and-Death,
containment of True Illusion, absorbing Reincamation, and entanglement of
Karma to start the fusion process.
As the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra was evoked, countless waves of Dao
fluctuations started radiating. This technique could contain up to ten thousand
spells, and as it was continuously evoked, it felt as if a grand path of energy
was boosting the process, forcing the different types of Dao Seeds to fuse into
one.
As Jiang Ming continued trying to fuse the Dao Seeds, he felt as if there was a
strong invincibly repulsive force stopping them from merging. It was a feeling
as though what he was trying to perform was a taboo that the Great Dao would
not tolerate.
In the end, nothing could stop the inevitable!
Deep within his consciousness, a deafening explosion suddenly echoed from
Jiang Ming’s soul. As the countless Dao Seeds completely fused, radiating a
terrifying force that engulfed every inch of mana from his consciousness.
No one knew if the Chaos Dao ever descended the human realm throughout the
ages, but if it did, it was sure to be a forbidden Dao.
“It’s still not enough,” Jiang Ming muttered.
He was shocked because the moment all the Dao Seeds successfully merged,
they completely consumed every drop of mana from his consciousness. The
fusion was a success, but it did not mean he had successfully formed the Chaos
Dao Seed.
“System, infuse 600 years of mana!” commanded Jiang Ming. He understood
what would happen if he could not form a new Dao Seed and was prepared for
it.
The system started to infuse a ball of mana right into his consciousness, right
onto the fused Dao Seed. The Dao Seed instantly sucked dry every ounce of
mana that was poured in, but it still seemed to be inadequate.
That wasn’t enough? System, infuse 2,000 years of mana!” commanded Jiang
Ming. He was adamant and instantly added an even bigger burst of mana than
before! With an accumulation of 7,600 years of mana, Jiang Ming was not
afraid to expend even more.
Loud buzzing noises could be heard constantly.
His consciousness trembled uncontrollably as the newly fused Dao Seed acted
if it was a black hole, rapidly engulfing the mana it was given. Just when the
2,000 years of mana were almost depleted, the Dao Seed suddenly stopped
absorbing. Iluminating rays of light could be seen glaring in his
consciousness. The blinding light gave off a feeling of the most primitive Dao,
a flare from the primitive era, and with that, a brand-new Dao Seed emerged.
This round dusk-looking Dao Seed seemed to be extremely heavy, hidden in it
a mysterious chaotic power. Yet, it was such a weird-looking Dao Seed that was
beaming such illuminating rays of light.
The light continued to illuminate as Jiang Ming’s consciousness continuously
rumbled. Even so, he realized that his consciousness did not expand at all. On
the other hand, the space within his consciousness had been strengthened by
more than ten-fold.
The fetal membrane had undergone drastic transformations, where densely
packed veins started to appear on its surface. 3,000 of these veins were
imprinted onto the membrane, and each of these veins signified a type of Great
Dao.
Jiang Ming felt the membrane of his consciousness had been terrifyingly
strengthened to more than a hundred-fold.
He could already fend off against mind attacks from a Paradis expert in the
past. Now that he had grown even stronger, how would he fare against them?
It was truly unimaginable, but the transformation did not stop there!
The illuminating light seeped through his consciousness, shining onto every
part of his bone, vein, muscle, organs, membrane, skin, and even strands of
hair. Every inch of his body was bathed in luminance.
At that moment, Jiang Ming’s physical body started to change little by little,
and he started to feel an excessive feeling of hunger coming from his stomach.
As he tried to guide the mana into his physical body, the energy snowballed
and was directly infused into his body like it was a sponge or a dessert hungrily
devouring for more mana.
He continued to evoke the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra as his body
rapidly underwent evolution.
This transcending metamorphosis that he was going through was helping him
to revamp his core drastically.
It took 3,000 years of mana before his metamorphosis finally ended.
After a long moment of silence, jiang Ming finally opened his eyes, smiling a
little before bursting out in euphoria. “Hahaha! I’ve finally formed the
strongest Dao foundation of all! My Dao has been forged!”
His physical body was so unimaginably strong that as he gripped his first, the
space itself started to ripple.
“Even if I don’t use any of my special abilities, I can now kill a Primal Spirit
expert with only a single punch. No, not any Primal Spirit expert but the
pinnacle of the Primal Spirit Realm itself!” exclaimed Jiang Ming.
It wasn’t arrogance that he was showing, but sheer confidence, an appalling
amount of confidence!
Never did it come over his mind that fusing different Daos and forming the
Chaos Dao Seed would improve him by leaps and bounds.
He was still considered to be a Dao Seed Realm based on his cultivation realm,
but his battle prowess had reached an unimaginable level.
What I need to do now is to visit the Supreme Tower to continue pushing on
for the Chaos Seed Dao’s growth. I will settle down a little and fully assimilate
my cultivation to reach the Dao’s peak! That will be the time that I
breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Realm.
Once I step foot into the Nascent Soul Realm, I can advance straight into the
Primal Spirit Realm without much accumulation. thought Jiang Ming.
He realized he had only 2,000 years of mana left, and it was not enough. He
wondered how bountiful it would be if he went to harvest from his farm.
After thinking briefly, he noticed that only half a month had passed since the
beginning of his transformation.
Jiang Ming fully adapted to the changes and never felt any problem with his
body, even though he had just had his breakthrough with his powers
increasing exponentially.
He leaped up and paced along into his spiritual farm.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - Harvested 10,000 Years of Mana, Ready to Break the Limits!
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Harvested 10,000 Years of Mana, Ready to Break the Limits!
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Though it had only been three years since these spiritual herbs were planted on his farm, the cave improved their growth by 100 folds, causing all of these herbs to look as if they had been growing for 300 years instead.
Top-grade spiritual herbs had a minimum maturity time of 100 years, and quite an amount had fully matured.
Jiang Ming harvested 10 Heavenly Hearts Orchids with a swift sleight of hand and stored and sealed them into a jade box to prevent any loss of its medicinal effects. Top-grade spiritual herbs were very precious, and even the sect could only produce a small amount of them.
As he continued harvesting different types of spiritual herbs, Jiang Ming could not stop smiling in euphoria, for he could continuously hear the system’s announcements about his harvest and the rewards he was awarded for them.
“Ding: Congratulations, master, on obtaining 10 portions of the top-grade spiritual herb, Heavenly Hearts Orchid. You are rewarded 1,000 years of cultivation and 1x Special Ability Bead!”
“Ding: Congratulations, master, on obtaining 7 portions of the top-grade spiritual herb, White Jaded Ginseng, You are rewarded 700 years of cultivation and a pair of top-grade Dao Vessels, the White Jaded Sparring Gloves.”
“Ding: Congratulations, master, on obtaining 32 portions of the top-grade spiritual herb, Thousand Festivals Grass. You are rewarded 3,200 years of cultivation and a set of top-grade Dao Vessels, a Combat Mannequin!”
“Ding: Congratulations, master, on obtaining 50 portions of the top-grade spiritual herb, Azure Ocean Emerald Sky Begonia Flower. You are rewarded 5,000 years of cultivation and a Pseudo Immortal Sword, the Soaring Feather Sword.”
Obtaining 100 years of cultivation for just one top-grade spiritual plant came as a surprise to Jiang Ming. It was already mind-blowing that he was rewarded with up to 9,900 years’ worth of cultivation and four other rare items, including a Pseudo Immortal Sword!
Though, it was a shame that all of the top-grade spiritual herbs were completely harvested.
“If the rewards from top-grade spiritual herbs were already so magnanimous, wait till my supreme-grade herbs or even the king-grade herbs mature completely!” Jiang Ming gasped in astonishment as he looked forward to his harvest.
Looking at the remaining spiritual herbs left, he could not help but feel a little dismayed.
Initially, Jiang Ming thought that he just had to provide enough spiritual essence for the spiritual herbs to grow. But reality hit hard on him when he found out the herbs’ seeds started to break through their membranes. They needed not only ample spiritual essence but also a special environment in order
for them to bud.
An example would be that Aurora Herb a stone’s throw away from him. That herb seed could only bud in an extremely cold environment.
Soon after these seeds started budding, Jiang Ming continued to monitor and discovered that none of the buds continued growing. Some of them even had signs of withering!
He was horrified and quickly asked around in the Supreme Chat Room to seek advice, only to realize that he had more work to do.
Jiang Ming started getting busy trying to prepare a suitable environment for the herbs and prepare a huge formation at the same time.
As if that was not enough, what ticked him off was when pests started appearing out of nowhere and started to endanger his herbs.
My goodness! How could there be pests if he had already sealed off the area!?
Jiang Ming summed it up to the herbs themselves. Maybe the heavens were jealous of the herbs, where the higher the herb’s grade, the more misfortune it would have to face. He had no choice but to check up on them every two to three days, but it was fortunate his harvest was abundant.
After collecting himself, Jiang Ming went up to the roof to relax. As he held onto the railings in the balcony, he set his gaze upon the vast mountains and rivers afar, enjoying the serenity.
Interestingly, Jiang Ming discovered that he was able to see numerous Dao fluctuations and Sambodha signs all across the mountains up to the skies. He could even vividly sense the orders of the world turning in sync.
As he lay onto the rattan chair, he naturally turned over to the side and paused for a while, shaking his head as he smiled upon realizing Zi Linglong wasn’t by her side.
“ve become so used to being with her. She left, and now I suddenly feel uneasy,” muttered Jiang Ming.
The next time Zi Linglong left the mountains, he would venture the world with her, climbing mountains and crossing rivers, enjoying the wonders of the world.
He took out the small bead he got as one of the rewards and gasped. “The Special Ability Bead can grant a person one special ability!”
Upon closer inspection, he was shocked to find out that if he imprinted a special ability into the bead, it would evoke the special ability once activated. There was a limit to the bead that it could only work with a special ability that did not surpass the human realm. It was still a good Dao Vessel,
nonetheless.
The White Jaded Sparring Gloves and the Soaring Feather Sword seemed to fit him perfectly, though he did not expect to get his hand on a Combat Mannequin type of Dao Vessel.
The Combat Mannequin’s exterior was as tough as a top-grade Dao Vessel, and it even had a simple ming of its own. Once fully merged with the mannequin, it could serve as a tool to protect himself.
A Combat Mannequin could even rival Extreme Path experts; defeating it would be difficult indeed.
Jiang Ming kept away the Combat Mannequin and flipped open the Human Path Record to check on Zi Linglong.
Reading her status, he discovered that Zi Linglong had arrived early to the God of Thunder’s Immortal Treasure’s gate and was patiently waiting for it to open. She got to know quite a handful of people; among them were Xi Yao, the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect, and even Lin Han, the Holy Son of the
Qingyun Sect.
“Lin Han!” Jiang Ming grinned as he had already sentenced him to death.
He then took a peek at his Master’s status and learned that this old man was sitting on top of Jiaoyang Peak, enjoying the Enlightening Tea with First Seat Yin Yue.
Jiang Ming looked toward the direction of Jiaoyang Peak and focused his consciousness through the void into the distance. He sensed that First Seat Yin Yue had already reached the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Realm and was not far from breaking through. On the other hand, Gu Hai, who had been
cultivating the Fire Dao Seed, had reached its pinnacle as well and could ascend into the Nascent Soul Realm anytime soon.
‘Twonder. When will this old man marry over First Seat Yin Yue? thought Jiang Ming.
He started imagining First Seat Yin Yue’s marriage where many of the Senior Sisters came over from Jiaoyang Peak, turning the mundane Chuyang Peak into a festival with so many pretty ladies.
“That doesn’t seem bad at all,’ thought Jiang Ming, scratching his lower chin.
He then looked over at First Seat Yue Cheng. This person was complex indeed. He was looking forward toward the Yinmo Sect to finally take over the Jiuyang Sect swiftly, saving him from all the anxious, sleepless nights.
Yet, at the same time, he was worried that the Yinmo Sect might end up like the Bishui Sect, where an unknown peerless expert obliterated them.
His heart, on the other hand, felt a sense of guilt, for he had been in the Jiuyang Sect for a long time, and he had already begun to grow fond of the place.
Pondering for a bit, Jiang Ming flipped over to check on Luo Heng, and his eyes lit up. He quickly returned to his underground cave and took out the Supreme Order. He then disappeared into the Supreme Pagoda in a stream of light.
He emerged on the third floor and checked his status.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 5
Points Accumulated: 3 Points
Honor: 5 stages record, 18 levels record, 992 units of special abilities
‘When Jiang Ming saw the meager 3 points that he had left, he could not do much. He had a lot of accumulated points initially. After buying some stuff and cultivating at the Heavenly Monument and Dao Monument, he practically used up all the points he had accumulated thus far.
He turned over and saw Luo Heng, who had successfully set foot onto the 10th level of the Heavenly Ladder. Although he looked pale as he swayed around on stage drenched in a cold sweat, Luo Heng was finally able to steady himself.
“I’ve done it! Haha! It was a success! There’s really a special permission given for it!” Luo Heng laughed so loud that even tears of joy could be seen streaming down his face. Determined, he bit his lips and braced onward, lifting his feet to take the next step onto the 11th level. However, his body simply
quivered and disappeared from the 10th level, and reappeared at the bottom of the ladder. He failed to take on the 11th level!
“Brother Luo, congratulations to you!” said Jiang Ming as he paced through the air, clenching his fist in respect.
Luo Heng paused briefly before turning over with the biggest smile and yelling out, “Brother Jiang!”. He then quickly took a deep bow at Jiang Ming, thanking him. “Thanks a lot, Brother Jiang! If it weren’t for your guidance, I would’ve never been able to go up to the 11th level!”
“You owned it because of your strong physique,” answered Jiang Ming. “Quickly accept the special permission. Ye Qingxian has already entered the group.”
“Yeah, I knew that,” said Luo Heng as he pointed at the Stone Monument. High above on the Stone Monument, Ye Qingxian’s name could be seen engraved on the column, and it wasn’t the 1oth level but the 11th level instead. She was truly a formidable lady.
“We three joining the Supreme Chat Room from the same level in such a small time frame will surely be the talk among others.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Join the group now, and you’ll be surprised.”
“Sure!” Luo Heng nodded as he also couldn’t wait anymore.
After joining the Supreme Chat Room and receiving warm welcomes from the group members, they introduced themselves among each other and got to know what level of cultivation they were at and where they originated from.
Luo Heng was shocked, but what made him even flabbergasted was that Jiang Ming was the group admin. Moreover, he discovered that he could even trade among worlds in this group.
It took a while before Luo Heng finally came back to his senses, and the way he looked at Jiang Ming was no longer the same.
“Any thoughts?” asked Jiang Ming leisurely as he lifted his glass of wine.
“My comprehension of the Dao was enlightening!” exclaimed Luo Heng. “Who would’ve thought that above the geniuses, there’s the existence of the Supreme Chat Room? The group members here are the best of the best from numerous different worlds! And moreover, you are the group admin, rising to
the real pinnacle!”
“Tm now only at Level 5. Who knows what’s going to happen in the future?” said Jiang Ming as he waved it off and smiled cheekily at Luo Heng, “I have some spiritual herbs. Do you need any?”
“Of course,” Luo Hang answered swiftly without any hesitation.
Jiang Ming took out all the spiritual herbs that he had harvested with a simple wave and arranged them in order, each with their description written.
“These are all good stuff!” exclaimed Luo Heng as he rubbed his hands together. “What do you want to trade them for?”
“Energy crystals,” answered Jiang Ming immediately.
“Great! These here are origin crystals. They are formed from the crystallization of the Original Laws of the universe where I’m from. They are akin to the immortal crystal of the Immortal World. Would 10 pieces be enough?” said Luo Heng as he handed over the 10 origin crystals.
“That’s enough, Brother Luo. Thank you!”
“Haha, I should be the one thanking you,” replied Luo Heng.
“Well then. I’ll gladly take them,” said Jiang Ming, exhaling a breath of relief.
To him, the spiritual herbs might be precious, but their value was incomparable with these 10 origin crystals.
Luo Heng wanted to show that he meant well, and Jiang Ming gladly accepted the favor.
“Brother Jiang, you came here to continue to challenge the battle stage and climb up the Heavenly Ladder, right?” asked Luo Heng.
Jiang Ming nodded, replying, “Of course. But I’m worried you might be appalled.”
“Haha! I’ll wait and see if you can continue breaking the limits. You will help me set an even higher goal. I’m used to your surprises already. The more you surprise me, the stronger my will becomes.” Luo Heng laughed as he looked forward to seeing what Jiang Ming could achieve.
“Tl need to meditate for a bit before trying to challenge the Heaven Battle Stage and climb up the Heavenly Ladder,” said Jiang Ming. He then sat cross-legged there and refined an origin crystal, promoting the Chaos Dao Seed’s growth and filling up his consciousness with mana to the brim.
