Time went by steadily, but Luo Heng was not in a rush. He occasionally took out his tablet to watch some short video clips or admire some pretty ladies. If not, he would try challenging at the Heaven Battle Stage or further sharpen his will at the Heavenly Ladder.
The routine continued daily until one day, Jiang Ming suddenly stood up.
“Brother Jiang, are you ready?” asked Luo Heng.
“Yes, I’m ready. I’ve mastered Level § now, the pinnacle of Level 5,” replied Jiang Ming, feeling energized.
“That’s great! What would it be? The Heaven Battle Stage or the Heavenly Ladder?” asked Luo Heng.
“The Heaven Battle Stage,” answered Jiang Ming as he walked toward the doorway of the battle stage.
‘When he looked up and gazed above, the space around him started trembling slightly as waves of empowering combat aura could be felt radiating off him.
Luo Heng, who was following him to the Heaven Battle Stage, couldn’t help but fall back 10 meters away before he could stand his ground against the tremendous aura Jiang Ming emitted.
“My God! You’re that crazy strong? I can’t even stand my ground against your battle aura! Are we really in the same cultivation realm!?’ thought Luo Heng in great disbelief.
The whole thing really took a toll on him as he started to question himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - Jiang Ming’s True Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Jiang Ming’s True Strength
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming stopped at the fifth stage last time, so he could start directly from the sixth.
It went without saying that he could start anew, but other than honing his own battle skills, he wouldn’t get any points for the first five stages.
“I want to start over!”
Jiang Ming walked through the corridor and came to the first stage.
His opponent this time was a man with long black hair. He was holding a sword in his hand, and he was in the early Primal Spirit Realm. In other words, he was two realms ahead of Jiang Ming.
‘The battle started. A sword tore through the sky and homed straight at him.
Jiang Ming did not dodge, nor did he activate his mana. He just stretched his arm forward and smashed the sword into pieces. Riding on the momentum, he punched the man through his chest, and the man’s body exploded.
‘As soon as his Primal Spirit came out, Jiang Ming crushed it in one clean slap.
On the second stage, he defeated his opponent with a punch, and the same thing was repeated on the third stage.
Luo Heng, who was watching from the sidelines, couldn’t help but shudder in fear.
“all of them are two realms ahead of him, yet he defeated them with just a punch? He didn’t even use his special ability or activate his mana! He’s a monster! Just how strong is his physical body?”
It was only now he saw Jiang Ming’s true strength. If he had not seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn’t have believed it.
On the fourth stage, Jiang Ming’s opponent was a Paradis martial artist this time.
Jiang Ming activated the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation.
This was a new special ability after he had fully comprehended the Three-fold Astral Transformation. Initially, the Three-fold Astral Transformation had only three stages, yet he had developed the fourth stage, so he changed the name.
His body began to undergo extreme changes, and he grew 1,665 cm in height, turning himself into a giant.
A storm of aura erupted from him and surged through the battlefield.
This was the fourth stage of the Three-fold Astral Transformation, and his physical strength had been enhanced by 16 times.
In the meantime, his opponent activated the Paradis projection, bringing forth a world of destructive lightning that enveloped the entire battlefield.
Lightning whips appeared and wrapped around him one after the other, restricting his action. Without giving him a chance to take his breather, human figures made of lightning appeared and dashed toward him.
Jiang Ming exerted some force through his body and broke himself free from the restriction of the lightning whips.
He brandished his arms rapidly, throwing one punch after another at the human figures and destroying them in the process. At the same time, the Paradis projection couldn’t sustain his immense strength anymore and collapsed.
The Paradis projection was gone.
“He’s strong!” the young man wearing a pink robe exclaimed. He seemed to be someone real. He activated the Paradis projection again in the next second, enveloping the entire battlefield.
“Thunder God Strike!”
As the voice rang out, a dense cluster of finger shadows appeared in all directions. The power of thunder that could pierce through everything was being gathered around them.
A Paradis martial artist was on a whole different level compared to a Primal Spirit martial artist. They were far stronger and harder to deal with.
“Unlimited Killing Punch: Sky Dawn!” Jiang Ming roared and threw a punch at the young man. The power of the punch was so great that even the energy in the surrounding area resonated with him. It shattered the entire sky. The lightning disappeared, and the fingers vanished.
This was the physical special ability he had comprehended. It condensed the killing intent and unleashed it in a destructive force. Jiang Ming was hoping to develop this special ability further, so he took on the path of infinity.
Although the finger shadows had disappeared, one suddenly appeared behind him. A purple light that would fill one’s heart with fear began to form around the fingertip.
Just when the finger was about to touch Jiang Ming’s head, a hand appeared and stopped it.
“Within the Paradis projection, you can elementalize and blend into each lightning as if you’re the lightning itself. This is a powerful technique, and it can’t be countered. Unfortunately, you’re up against me this time!”
Jiang Ming turned his head around and grabbed the finger, crushing it in the process.
“Now, die!”
He threw another punch at his opponent, the force of the punch so great that it distorted space.
“Exploding Blood Thunder!”
‘The young man unleashed a powerful move in an attempt to break himself free and escape. However, his effort was futile. Jiang Ming grabbed him and destroyed him in one punch.
“Thunder God Slaying Explosion!”
Even though Jiang Ming had destroyed the young man’s physical body, his Primal Spirit remained unscathed. It gave off a bright light, turned into lightning, and entered Jiang Ming’s forehead.
This was an attack that could only be used by Primal Spirit martial artists. It could be considered as a last resort, and they wouldn’t use this move until the very last moment.
‘The young man was very close, so Jiang Ming couldn’t evade in time.
Inside his sea of consciousness, the lightning crashed into the membrane. It tried to annihilate Jiang Ming’s soul but to no avail. The membrane was so thick that it couldn’t even leave a dent in it. A circle of light appeared on the membrane, and the lightning was gone.
This was Jiang Ming’s spiritual special ability, the Spiritual Arcane Light!
It had the ability to defend as well as the ability to deflect one’s attack.
At present, Jiang Ming had a plethora of special abilities in his arsenal, and he doubted there would be anyone who he couldn’t defeat.
He moved on and came to the fifth stage.
The opponent this time was different from the last time as well. It was also a young man, but the robe on his body was peculiar. One side of it was black, while the other side was white, and his entire body was filled with Life-and-Death Dao rhythm.
Black and white represented Yin and Yang, respectively, but it represented death and life here.
Since the opponent did not do anything, Jiang Ming stayed put as well.
He was going to give it his all this time. He flicked his finger and sent a wisp of mana forward. Compared to the power he used to forge the Chaos Dao Seed, his power skyrocketed by nearly a hundred times.
‘The Paradis projection appeared, and the energy of life and death filled the entire battlefield. At that moment, countless seedlings sprouted from the Akasa and grew rapidly.
Seedlings were growing from Jiang Ming’s shirt as well.
He felt itchy, and the feeling was akin to something was going to burst out of his skin.
“The power of life is truly mesmerizing!”
He exerted some force, and both the seedlings and the strange feeling disappeared.
Suddenly, the seedlings wilted and a surge of death energy swept across the entire area.
“Die!”
No sooner had the word spilled out of the young man’s mouth than he vanished into thin air. Then, 16 human figures appeared around Jiang Ming. Each of them had the same aura, and they were pointing their swords at him.
This time, Jiang Ming did not use the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation. Instead, he dashed toward one of them and shouted, “Mountains Seal!”
At the same time, the swords turned around and charged at him.
He formed a hand seal without wasting any second, and nine black divine mountains appeared in the air. They all descended at the same time and crushed the Paradis projection. All of the 16 human figures vanished, leaving only one that got pushed down by the mountains.
The nine divine mountains that he had conjured were also a formation, increasing his power to a shocking degree.
“Great Akasa Divine Hand! Die!”
Jiang Ming delivered a palm strike at the young man, causing the young man to explode in a mist of blood.
Jiang Ming thought he had defeated his opponent, but the blood mist twisted around, and a sudden surge of life energy burst forward. As it glowed dazzlingly, the blood mist began to come together and formed into a new body.
“This is… reincarnation?” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“That’s right,” His opponent replied. “I’ve comprehended the Life-and-Death Dao to perfection. I can come back to life once after dying. It’s just that I’ve underestimated you. I didn’t expect you to kill me in just a few hits. Come, show me what you’ve got!
“With the sword of life, everything will be reborn! With the sword of Death, everything will wither away! Life and death is a never-ending cycle. Come forth, Sword of Life and Death!”
‘The sword in the young man’s hand was shaking as he pumped the forces of life-and-death into it. He then held the sword and threw himself at Jiang Ming.
Even if he did not activate the Paradis projection, Jiang Ming was not going to take him lightly.
Squinting his eyes, he took a step back and held the tip of the blade with his finger. Then, nine Dao burst from his finger and formed into a beam on his fingertip.
“Infinite Technique Fusion Strike!”
This was one of the moves Jiang Ming had developed, as well as one of his trump cards.
Bam!
‘The beam shattered the sword and pierced through the young man’s body.
Without giving the young man a second to catch his breath, he formed a hand seal and activated the Mountains Seal. Nine divine mountains descended and crushed the young man into a blood mist along with his Primal Spirit.
On the sixth stage, the opponent was the same as the first time this time. He was at the peak of Paradis Realm, and he wielded the Light-and-Dark Dao.
He summoned his Paradis projection, and darkness descended, enveloping Jiang Ming whole and masking his senses.
Suddenly, a light burst out of Jiang Ming’s forehead and shattered the darkness like countless arrows of light.
“Unlimited Killing Punch!”
He activated the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation, and his body grew 1,665 cm in height. He leaped into the air and delivered a total of 36 punches in quick succession. The darkness crumbled, the Paradis projection collapsed, and even the fabric of space cracked like a mirror.
‘When Jiang Ming saw his opponent, he charged at him.
However, his opponent was not going to go down just like that. As soon as he saw Jiang Ming was rushing toward him, he turned into a streak of light and shouted, “Light Purification!”
Suddenly, a dazzling light filled the entire battlefield. It banished the darkness away and purified the dark side, the murderous intent, the fury, and the fighting spirit in one’s heart.
“Do you think you’re the only one who can wield the power of light? I can too! It’s just that I’m not as strong and proficient as you, but it’s going to take more than that to purify my fighting spirit!” Jiang Ming shouted.
‘The Spiritual Arcane Light burst out and enveloped him whole. After that, he leaped into the sky and charged at the man.
While he was charging at the man, he formed a hand seal, and nine divine mountains descended. It sealed the area and prevented the man from running away.
That being said, his opponent was powerful.
In just the blink of an eye, both of them had exchanged more than 100 blows.
They used one after another special abilities against each other, yet neither of them could take their opponent down.
Eventually, Jiang Ming saw his chance and defeated the man in one strike.
On the seventh stage was an Extreme Path martial artist.
Jiang Ming’s face turned serious. He knew very well how powerful an Extreme Path martial artist was. They were a bunch of people who stood at the top of the world, and they represented the ultimate form of Dao.
He did not have the slightest confidence in defeating him.
He was given a chance to pick a top-grade Dao Vessel.
“Dao Seed, Nascent Soul, Primal Spirit, Paradis, Extreme Path… If I can kill someone who’s four realms ahead of me…”
Jiang Ming stopped the thought and shook his head..

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - The True Terror of Mastering the Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: The True Terror of Mastering the Law
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
A handsome young man was standing in front of Jiang Ming. He was wearing a blue robe, and there was a warm smile tugging at the corner of his lips.
“Are you guys humans?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Of course, we are!” The man nodded. “You can assure that I’m human, but don’t ask where I come from or my past or where I’ll be going. You’re only at Level 5, yet you’re standing before me, a Level 9 martial artist.
Throughout the entire history of the Supreme Pagoda, you’re the only one who could do it, so be proud of yourself.”
Jiang Ming was shocked.
“They are real humans! But who do they serve? The person who built the Supreme Pagoda? Or are they one of the highest executives who have joined the Supreme Pagoda”
Multiple questions flitted across Jiang Ming’s head, but he did not have the answers for them.
“How about outside of the Supreme Pagoda?” Jiang Ming pressed on.
“The universe is big, a lot bigger than you could’ve imagined,” the man said.
Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows.
Although the man did not answer his question directly, he knew what he was trying to tell him.
He was not the only Level 5 martial artist outside of the Supreme Pagoda.
He was not disappointed since it was considered useful information to him.
“The universe is truly massive!’
“Come! The man shouted, “Most of the Level 9 martial artists are standing at the top across different worlds and have fully mastered some sort of ultimate power.”
“1m coming!” Jiang Ming’s face turned serious.
He activated the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation. Then, he raised his sword and shouted, “Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi!”
Nine sword energies distorted the air and dashed toward the young man. This was by far the greatest power Jiang Ming had unleashed with this special ability. Without giving the young man a chance to take a breather, the sword in his hand disappeared, and he leaped into the air. He formed a hand seal
and summoned the Mountains Seal.
Following this, nine divine mountains appeared in the air. They formed into a formation, and all sorts of powers, such as the power of suppression, restriction, and destruction, poured down on the young man.
‘The young man looked at the nine divine mountains that hovered on top of him and said, “It’s truly impressive that you can master such a special ability although you’re just a Level 5 martial artist.”
His clothes looked rather tattered, and the blue light that wrapped around his body like a protective shield was flickering.
“Dripping water can penetrate the stone. Dripping Strike!”
‘The young man leaped into the air with his sword in his hand. The sword energy that condensed on the tip of the blade pierced through all nine divine mountains, causing the power of the Mountains Seal to collapse.
This was something within Jiang Ming’s expectations. He knew it wouldn’t be that easy to defeat an Extreme Path martial artist.
He raised his fist high and activated the Ground Shattering Strike of the Infinite Killing Punch.
‘This move was a powerful attack packed with the power that could suppress the earth and split the abyss.
“Drizzle Sword!”
‘The young man turned his sword around, and a dense blanket of water droplets appeared in the air before charging at Jiang Ming.
‘The water droplets collided with Jiang Ming’s fist, giving rise to the sound of metal clashing against each other.
Jiang Ming did not back away despite the onslaught of the young man’s attack. The water droplets rained down on his fist and left multiple white spots on the surface of his fist.
He knew very well that if he hadn’t activated the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation and the Unlimited Killing Punch, the water droplets would have penetrated his skin and crushed his bones.
After all, he was fighting against an Extreme Path martial artist who wielded a top-grade Dao Vessel.
“What a strong body!” the young man exclaimed. He grabbed his sword, and the aura around him changed again. At the same time, he growled, “Three Thousands Vortex!”
Whoosh!
‘Waves after waves of water poured in out of thin air and transformed the entire battlefield into a world of sea. On top of the water were vortexes that spun and emitted a terrifying suction force, trying to pull Jiang Ming in with an unrelenting force.
“You don’t have a special ability that can fit your strong body. Otherwise, you might stand a chance against me,” the young man said as he shook his head. “Your power is seriously underdeveloped, so you can’t bring out the full power of your body. Even if you have a strong body, it doesn’t necessarily mean
you have to fight with your brute force. Other than an immense strength and a solid defense, you still have a vast amount of Blood Qi! Blood Qi is similar to mana, and it can be used in the same way as mana to fuel a plethora of moves and skills.
“Unfortunately, we’re in the middle of a fight, so I can’t go easy on you. If not, maybe I could teach you something useful.” The young man paused for a moment and added. “What I’m using now is just the most basic form of Water Dao. I infuse the power of Paradis projection into it, and I still haven’t
unleashed the true power of an Extreme Path martial artist.”
The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips twitched.
It seemed to him that the young man in front of him was rather talkative.
That said, he knew now was not the time to chitchat. After all, he still needed to deal with the vortexes that were trying to suck him in. He felt as if he had fallen into a swarm, and no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t pull himself out of it.
“Sky Drill!”
Jiang Ming gave out a violent cry. The punch triggered the power of the Akasa and blew up all the vortexes in front of him.
“I don’t believe I have no way to defeat you!” he shouted and continued to throw punches at his surroundings, crushing the vortexes around him and piercing through the ocean.
“That was a nice one, but how about this one? Can you counter it?” The young man smiled as he waved his sword. Multiple streams appeared from thin air and wrapped around the ocean.
There were vortexes in the streams as well, and they further amplified the power of the suction force.
“I told you. Your knowledge about the use of your physical body is too shallow. If not, you would be able to escape from this technique of mine easily.” The young man chuckled. “Alright, I suggest you stop resisting. It’s meaningless.”
“Really?” Jiang Ming asked.
In the next second, he vanished. Just when the young man wondered where Jiang Ming had disappeared to, he appeared behind him and sent a punch at his head.
Bam!
The young man’s head exploded, but water came out instead of blood much to Jiang Ming’s surprise.
“Is that teleportation?” The young man appeared behind Jiang Ming. “This is a very powerful move for martial artists that haven’t achieved the Paradis Realm, but for those who already have, the effect isn’t as effective. We can find where you are instantly through the Paradis projection. Not only that, but
it will also give us a chance to deliver the final blow on you!”
He was talking through his Primal Spirit, and it wafted right straight into Jiang Ming’s ears.
In the next second, the tip of his blade arrived in front of Jiang Ming.
“spiritual Arcane Light!” Jiang Ming hastily activated the defensive special ability. A light enveloped his forehead in a protective barrier, but it did nothing to stop the young man’s attack. The tip of the blade pierced through the barrier as if it was cutting through butter.
That being said, it still bought Jiang Ming enough time to escape from his imminent defeat.
‘When Jiang Ming reappeared, his forehead was filled with cold sweat. He asked, “How did you do that?”
“Tm Level 9 martial artist, and it can be translated as an Extreme Path martial artist according to your cultivation system,” the young man replied, grinning from ear to ear. “I didn’t perform the Paradis projection, but I can use its power whenever I want. No matter how fast you are, you can never be
faster than the train of thought. If you teleport, I’ll leave a water clone for you, giving you a false impression that you’ve defeated me while I tun the table to my favor.”
“How come you’re so much stronger than a Paradis martial artist?”
Although Jiang Ming had experienced the might of being an Extreme Path martial artist before, it was a borrowed power.
He did not know how to utilize the power fully, and it was only now that he realized how terrifying the power of an Extreme Path martial artist was.
It was not something that a human could fight against.
“In your cultivation system, the difference between a Level 8 and a Level 9 is as big as the sky and the earth,” the young man said patiently, “For example, I can manipulate all of the water in the surrounding. Wherever there is water, it’ll be my territory. Of course, the effect will diminish the further the
water is away from me!”
“That means in my body…” Jiang Ming’s eyes grew wide in shock.
‘The young man smiled. “Water Dao or the ability to manipulate water is just the basics of a Level 9 martial artist. It won’t be enough to defeat someone who has the same level as me, but it’s more than enough to defeat someone who is lower in level than me.”
“Water Burst!”
‘The young man lifted his sword and pointed at Jiang Ming.
Although there was no sword energy and he wasn’t unleashing any attack, Jiang Ming’s face turned pale in fear.
At that moment, he felt that his muscles, bones, organs, blood, and cells were vibrating. If it hadn’t been for his strong body, he would have been turned into a pile of water.
“Great Protection!”
He swiftly activated the strongest defensive move he had right now.
This defensive spell was developed based on the Five Elemental Defense. He had merged all of the defensive special abilities together and formed them into a powerful defensive spell, which he named Great Protection.
Multiple colors shot out of Jiang Ming’s body in the next second. It was the force of five elements. They swirled around his body and forced the unknown power in him out.
“Well, that was one nice defensive spell, but that’s all it could do,” the young man commented. “It’s useless against someone like me who has reached the pinnacle of the Extreme Path realm. I can blow you up with one Water Burst, but don’t get disheartened. It isn’t because you aren’t strong enough. You
can be considered very powerful at your level, but unfortunately, your realm is too low.”
“Thank you very much,” Jiang Ming replied. “If you had used this ability from the beginning, I would be dead, so why?”
“What’s the point of killing you? This is the Heavenly Battle Stage. You can keep coming here again and again, and eventually, you will figure out how terrifying a Level 9 martial artist is,” the young man said. “Do you want to continue the fight?”
“Of course!” replied Jiang Ming. “I will not give up until I win!”
“That’s the spirit! Let me show you the real strength of an Extreme Path martial artist, although I haven’t fully mastered the Water Law yet!” The young man said in a serious manner, “Here I come!
“3,000 Water Domain, envelop my foe and crush him!”
He waved his hand, and an ocean and vortexes appeared.
‘The suction force was so strong that Jiang Ming could barely stand straight. He tried to teleport away, but the vortexes around him did not give him a chance.
“It’s a piece of cake to counter your move after knowing your ability.” The young man’s voice wafted into Jiang Ming’s ears. “Keep this in mind. Always have one trump card up your sleeve. Here I come! Water Pump, Water Blast!”
This time, not only could Jiang Ming feel the water molecules in his body were agitated, but water was also flowing out of his orifices..

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - Breaking the Barrier, Ascending to the Next Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Breaking the Barrier, Ascending to the Next Level
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jun Sangian
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Extreme Path (His bodily form)
Background: The Supreme Tower (To be confirmed)
Relationship: 55 (Relationship with his bodily form)
Innate Talent: Undetectable (The gap between their realms is too big to detect)
Status: He’s a promising kid.
After ascertaining that Jiang Ming couldn’t move anymore, he swooped in for the final blow by plunging his sword into Jiang Ming’s forehead.
In the corridor, Jiang Ming touched his forehead as his heart palpitated.
He was dead. Even though he could be revived, his heart was still trembling.
He opened up the Human Paths Record to check the young man’s information, and then he was shocked.
‘Bodily form? What is that? And it isn’t confirmed if he’s one of the Supreme Pagoda yet? His innate talent is undetectable? And even there’s not much information about his status. Is it because I’m too weak?”
Jiang Ming sighed in disappointment.
Luo Heng came over, his face still filled with shock. “Brother Jiang, you actually have cleared the sixth stage. That’s so awesome!”
“Lwas trying to clear the seventh stage, but unfortunately… My opponent thoroughly defeated me.” Jiang Ming sighed lightly.
“What are you talking about, Brother Jiang?” Luo Heng said, “Do you know that you’ve already broken the record by clearing the fifth stage, and how amazing it’s for you to get through the sixth stage? I can’t even clear the fourth stage, and you’re here sighing in disappointment because you can’t clear the
seventh stage. People always said that no compare no despair, and it’s only now I know how true the statement is.”
“You can do it too.” Jiang Ming smiled. He leaped into the air and landed on the seventh battle stage. Then, he said, “I’m going to try again!”
As soon as he landed on the seventh battle stage, the young man appeared again.
“You still don’t want to give up yet?” Jun Sangian shook his head. “In my honest opinion, you won’t stand a chance against me at your current level. Even if you have entered Level 6, your chance of defeating me will still be slim. You might stand a chance, though, if you can reach Level 7.”
“Not even Level 6?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with confusion. “Judging from my current strength, when I reach Level 6, my cultivation can be increased ten times, and my combat strength may be able to increase a hundred times. That’s not enough?”
“Don’t even think about it,” Jun Sangian replied. “In your cultivation system, the Extreme Path means mastery over the laws in the mortal realm. Everything that is beneath the laws is nothing. Generally, a Paradis martial artist stands no chance against an Extreme Path martial artist. This is because the
latter is on a whole different level compared to the former. Under the influence of Dao rhythm, one will lose several percent of their combat strength, so how are they going to fight? Even the weakest Extreme Path martial artist is an existence that can’t be defeated easily.”
“What if my opponent wields the Fire Dao?”
“Haha, do you think you couldn’t defeat me because I could manipulate the water inside of your body through the Water Dao? If you were up against an opponent who uses the Fire Dao, he could make your heart burn with desire, anger, or even turn you into a pile of ashes by burning you from the inside,”
Jun Sangian said as he shook his head.
“Seems like I have a lot of things to lea about the Extreme Path,” Jiang Ming replied. “Since an Extreme Path martial artist is so powerful, judging from the Supreme Pagoda’s rules when one has reached the Primal Spirit Realm, how are they going to clear the trial if they’re matched up against an
Extreme Path martial artist on the first day? And if one has reached the Extreme Path Realm, does it not mean that they have to defeat an immortal? Isn’t that impossible?”
“Different levels have different rules, Alright, enough talking. Do you want to fight or not?” Jun Sangian flung his sleeve.
“guess I’ll pass. Since no matter how many times I try, I’ll never be able to defeat you,” Jiang Ming said. “I hope we’ll meet again at the next level. At that time, I’ll try my best to beat you!”
“Well, you do have the potential,” Jun Sangian commented.
Jiang Ming bowed at him and came to the platform.
He took a look at his point. Initially, he had only three points, but he had 35 points now.
He had already gotten the points for the first five stages, and he earned a total of 32 points for clearing the sixth stage.
He could gain 64, points if he cleared the seventh stage, but unfortunately, he failed. He wondered if he would have the chance to get the points or not in the future.
“Brother Jiang,” Luo Heng called out to him as he handed him a glass of wine.
“Thanks!” Jiang Ming took it over. He took a sip and said with a smile, “Can I have some more of this wine? I stay inside a mountain, so I have little access to good wine. This wine is addictive, and I’m sure it’ll be a pleasure to drink a glass of it after cultivation!
“Well, you asked the right person. I might not have other things, but I have a lot of wine,” Luo Heng said as he handed Jiang Ming a ring. “There are a total of 1,800 wines in this ring. I collected them by myself, and I’m giving them to you now. Please, you need to take it. There are billions of races, millions
of living beings, and an abundance of materials in my world. Everything you can imagine, we have it there!”
“Well, since you insist, I’ll gladly take it then!” Jiang Ming took the ring over. When he scanned it with his mind, he found that there was a big space in it and it was filled with all sorts of bottles.
“Brother Luo, if you need anything in the future, let me know. I’ll do my best to help.”
“Haha, thanks.”
Both of them chatted for a long while, and Jiang Ming went to the side to recuperate. After recovering his energy, he went to the Heavenly Ladder.
He reached the 18th level swiftly. He took a deep breath and climbed onto the 19th level.
Voom!
His mind shook, and he felt as if there was an invisible spear coming at him, trying to destroy his willpower and mind.
“Spiritual Arcane Light!”
Jiang Ming activated his special ability.
His body shook, but he did not fall down this time.
“I did it! I have the willpower of an Extreme Path martial artist!” He grinned.
He continued to climb upward, and when he came to the 22nd level, his vision turned dark, and by the time he opened his eyes again, he was already in the corridor.
“Well done, Brother Jiang!” Luo Heng commented.
“I thought I could reach the 27th level. Well, I guess I’ve overestimated myself.” Jiang Ming sighed.
“L.. L.. Do you know how hard it’s for me to restrain myself from beating you up?” Luo Heng said, gritting his teeth. “Do you know how many levels I managed to clear? 10! Only 10! That’s my maximum, and you…”
He turned around and stormed away.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself and chuckle.
He took a look at his points, and the grin on his face widened.
The 19th level corresponded to the willpower of a Paradis martial artist, and he was granted 100 points. It was the same for the 21st level and the 22nd level. In other words, he had obtained 300 points.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 5
Points Accumulated: 335 points
Honor: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special abilities.
He had gained a lot of points this time, and his honors had changed.
Jiang Ming took a look at the Heavenly Monuments and the Dao Monuments. He thought for a while and chose not to go in the end.
According to his friends in the chat room, the higher the realm, the better the effect of comprehension.
He was still in the Dao Seed Realm, so he decided to first raise his realm to the Nascent Soul or Primal Spirit Realm.
“I guess it’s time for me to ascend into the next realm!”
Jiang Ming had made up his mind.
After bidding goodbye to Luo Heng, he returned to his world.
The first thing he did was check his Junior Sister’s condition and Yue Cheng at Zhiyang Peak. However, nothing had changed since only an hour had passed.
Jiang Ming heaved a sigh of relief, but he knew that something big was going to happen in another half a month.
However, there was still plenty of time for him to prepare.
Jiang Ming came to Chuyang Peak’s immortal cave and sat in a lotus position on the cloud bed. He cast the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk to seal this place and closed his eyes.
He cleared his mind, and a dimly lit Dao Seed appeared in his sea of consciousness.
He knew it was almost time for him to ascend into the next realm. Therefore, he chanted the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, and multiple rays of light shot out of his body. They fused together and merged into the Dao Seed.
The Dao Seed flickered and trembled gently before turning into a placenta with beating sounds coming from inside.
It sounded like the noise when the sky was separated from the earth. His sea of consciousness shook. It began to transform again, and the space inside became more stable.
The fetal membrane squirmed, and its density intensified again.
The size of the space remained the same, but its quality had taken a quantum leap. Even his mana had undergone further changes and had increased by more than ten times.
This sound, too, spread into all parts of the body, causing his bloodline to transform, his skeletal structure to reform, his organs to refine, and his muscles to strengthen. Even his skin was glowing brightly, and both its toughness and strength suddenly increased.
Thump! Thump!
‘The sound rang out again in a regular rhythm.
‘The transformation was beginning to stop.
‘Finally! The Nascent Soul Realm!”
When a soul entered the Dao Seed, it would turn into the Nascent Soul. This was the Level 6 of cultivation.
After a short while, Jiang Ming opened his eyes and realized that two days had passed.
He opened up the Human Paths Record, and luckily, nothing had happened in the past two days.
He then activated the Supreme Order and went into the Supreme Pagoda.
This time, what appeared before him was a grass plain.
“Jiang Ming, since you’ve ascended into the next realm, you need to go through the trial again. If you pass the trial, you can enter the Supreme Pagoda. If you fail, you will lose access to the Supreme Pagoda, and the Supreme Order will disappear.
“The trial is separated into three stages.”
Jiang Ming listened carefully to the instructions. Honestly, he was not worried at all.
The first stage was battle, the second was the test of willpower, and the third stage was the test of knowledge.
Jiang Ming passed through all of them in a breeze.
There was not much difference in the fourth level of the Supreme Pagoda.
He could see the Heavenly Monuments, the Dao Monuments, the Heavenly Battle Stage, and the Million Dao Chart.
However, there was not a single person here, and it made the area even more spacious.
“Well, this isn’t bad!”
Jiang Ming smiled and took out a couch. He pulled out a jar of wine and began sipping on it.
Next, he summoned a tablet onto his hand. When he opened it up, he noticed there was a special folder in it. He tapped into it, and his eyes widened in shock.
He watched everything in the folder for three days and three nights. He only reluctantly stopped on the fourth day.
“Lwill be wasted if I don’t stop watching this.”
Jiang Ming shook his head and stored the tablet away.
He calmed himself down and began absorbing the mana to enhance the Nascent Soul.
It was all about breeding and growing in the Nascent Soul Realm.
He had a strong willpower and adequate reserves of mana. All he needed was time. The silver lining was that it would only be an hour on the outside world no matter how much time he spent here.
‘Time flitted by slowly, and Jiang Ming had consumed 4,000 years of cultivation to reach the perfect stage.
“L guess I should try the Heavenly Battle Stage and the Heavenly Ladder and see if I can ascend into the Primal Spirit Realm or not.”
He jumped and landed below the Heavenly Battle Stage with that thought in mind.
“I wonder if I can kill him or not this time.”
Jiang Ming stepped into the corridor and walked toward the first battle stage..

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - Another Breakthrough, Rainy Night, Killing Mode
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Another Breakthrough, Rainy Night, Killing Mode
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Only those who had reached the Nascent Soul Realm, or Level 6, could come to the fourth level of the Supreme Pagoda.
Jiang Ming was matched up with a Paradis martial artist this time, and he made quick work of his opponent.
He gained one point for clearing the first stage. Soon, he arrived at the fourth stage.
He thought he would be facing an Extreme Path martial artist, but surprisingly, what appeared before him were two Paradis martial artists who had cultivated to perfection.
Although they were powerful, he still defeated them with ease. The fifth stage had three Paradis martial artists, while the sixth stage had four.
When he came to the seventh stage, his opponent was Jun Sanqian.
“I didn’t expect you to come so soon,” Jun Sanqian said in surprise. “I thought you would stop at the sixth stage.”
“Well, all I can say is that it’s a close shave,” Jiang Ming replied.
“If I were in the world outside, I would be dead by now.”
“All right, let’s stop talking. Come!”
“Here I come!”
Both of them began to engage in a fight again.
Jiang Ming lasted for a long while, but he still lost in the end. After all, it was truly difficult for him to defend against the Water Dao.
“You might stand a chance if you wield some powerful special abilities. Unfortunately, you don’t have a good foundation,” Jun Sanqian lamented when he saw Jiang Ming again. “I’m not saying that you have a shallow amount of mana. What I’m trying to say is that you don’t have a strong background.
“You can know that just by looking at me?”
“Although it seems like your special abilities are powerful, you haven’t fully understood them. Apparently, you learn them by yourself. However, I have to say that you…” Jun Sanqian looked at Jiang Ming for a while, but he did not finish his sentence.
Jiang Ming did not notice the changes of expression in Jun Sanqian’s face as he asked, “Can you give me some advice in cultivation, then?”
“Haha!” Jun Sanqian tossed his head back and laughed. “Nope!”
“Am I still not good enough to be your disciple?”
“Do you want to start the battle or not?”
“Alright, alright,” Jiang Ming shook his head and left after being turned down by Jun Sanqian.
That being said, he had gotten 63 points after clearing six stages of the Heavenly Battle Stage.
He then went to the Heavenly Ladder, and this time, he started from the level that corresponded to the Paradis Realm.
The first nine levels corresponded to the willpower of a Paradis Realm martial artist, while the 10th level to the 18th levels corresponded to the willpower of an Extreme Path martial artist.
The reward he would get was still the same. It was one point each for the first nine levels and 10 points each starting from the 10th level.
Jiang Ming reached the 15th level swiftly, and he failed at the 16th level. Although it wasn’t much of an improvement, it was still considered very impressive for someone at his level.
In the end, he received 69 points as a reward.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 6
Points Accumulated: 467 points
Honor:
[Third Level: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special ability]
(Fourth Level: 6 stages record, 15 levels record.) Jiang Ming’s information in the Supreme Pagoda had changed.
He had 467 points now, and he reckoned it could last for a long while.
The honor part had changed too. Unfortunately, he hadn’t comprehended any special abilities on this level yet, but he was not really worried about it.
“The members in the Supreme Chat Room said that the lower the realm, the better the rewards. The higher the realm, the harder it is to cross the next realm. Well, it seems like they’re not wrong,” Jiang Ming lamented.
After taking some rest, he went back to reality when he was confident that he could ascend into the Paradis Realm.
He went into seclusion one more time
Time flitted by rapidly, and one day, Jiang Ming stood at the rooftop and looked into the distance.
He lifted his hand and grabbed something in the air as if everything was in his palm.
He drew something in the air, and the space in front of him shattered. He continued to point his finger forward, and a beam of light slowly gathered at his fingertip. He felt that he could pierce the ocean and the earth right now.
“I’m too strong right now. I bet no one can stand a chance against me now!” Jiang Ming smiled.
“The God of Thunders Immortal Treasures will be released tomorrow. I wonder what I can find inside.”
He was very much looking forward to the opening of the God of Thunders Immortal Treasure. His blood was boiling, and his heart was pumping rapidly.
He thought for a moment, and a holographic screen appeared before him.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Primal Spirit Realm
Cultivation Method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Innate Talent: Immortal (Primary Daoist Body)
Special Ability: Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Great Manifestation Technique, Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation, Unlimited Killing Punch, Mountains Seal, Return of Infinite Law Finger, Great Body Protection Technique, Spiritual Arcane Light, Killing Sword Technique, Yin Yang Severing Technique, and so on.
Item: Human Paths Record, Supreme Order, [Immortal Weapon: Mystical Light Sword, Heavenly War Blade, Heavenly Feathered Shirt, Celestial Soul Bell, Starry Hall, Heavenly Ark), Soaring Feather Sword, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk, Mana Sealing Chess Plate (top-grade Dao Vessel), Combat Mannequin (top-grade Dao Vessel), Dark Abyss Sword (high-grade Dao Vessel), White Jaded Sparring Glove (high-grade Dao Vessel), 1x Special Ability Bead, 100 years of cultivation, Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card.
Support: Primary Training Zone
Jiang Ming’s situation had changed. He had ascended into the Primal Spirit Realm. His sea of consciousness covered a radius of 10,000 kilometers, and the Chaos Primal Spirit was hovering around. It looked completely like him, and this was the sign of perfection.
Once his Primal Spirit could open up his sea of consciousness, it could then turn into a Paradis.
He had comprehended a lot of special abilities as well.
Most of them were of supreme-grade ones, but he only had a basic understanding of them, and further development was needed.
What made Jiang Ming intrigued the most was that even if he had formed the Chao Dao Seed, which then transformed into the Chaos Primal Spirit, he still had a Primary Daoist Body.
Even his innate talent remained the same.
“Could it be that the Primary Daoist Body couldn’t be improved anymore?” he asked.
He did not have any reference or someone to guide him, so he could only rely on himself.
He had gotten quite a number of items as well, immortal weapons in particular. They combined both offensive and defensive into one. He had bought them from Wang Hua the other day.
He still had 100 years of cultivation left. This was the price for ascending into the Primal Spirit Realm in such a short amount of time.
As for the Enlightening Tea Leaves, he had used them all.
‘I think I should be able to fight against Jun Sanqian now, right?’ Jiang Ming thought.
That being said, he still did not have the confidence.
After all, an Extreme Path martial artist was too terrifying. Even though he couldn’t defeat Jun Sanqian, he figured that he should be able to defeat most of the people in this world.
Swoosh!
Suddenly, a storm came, and the sky was covered with billowing clouds, blotting out the sun. The trees in the forest were swaying vigorously along with the wind, and Jiang Ming’s eyes widened.
“It’s happening!” Jiang Ming exclaimed as he looked into the distance. There was nothing but dark clouds in his vision.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record was opened up.
Nothing happened to his Junior Sister. She was waiting for the opening of the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures. The Sect Master was still cultivating, unaware of the looming danger.
“This old man!”
Jiang Ming’s face changed when he saw what was happening to Gu Hai.
Status: Was enjoying tea and listening to stories with First Seat Yin Yue from Jiaoyang Peek. He was having a great time, and there was a content smile etching on his face.
“It seems like they’re progressing really well.” Jiang Ming chuckled.
Below this mountain was a town under the protection of the Jiuyang Sect.
The page flipped again. Name: Yue Cheng Status: Received news that the Holy Daughter was coming with another five Primal Spirit martial artists. They were currently hiding in the Dark Wind Valley about 30,000 kilometers away, preparing to destroy the Jiuyang Sect when the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures had opened up. It seemed like the Holy Daughter was accompanied by a Paradis martial artist. ‘Sigh, why am I feeling so sad when the Jiuyang Sect is on the verge of destruction? Sigh, my heart has already been tarnished by darkness. I didn’t want this to happen either! But there’s nothing I could do either.
‘Since the Jiuyang Sect is finished, I must ask the Holy Daughter to get rid of Zi Linglong. As for a reason… I should tell her that Zi Linglong is a genius, and if she joins the Yinmo Sect, she will certainly replace her as the Holy Daughter. Judging from her pride, I’m sure she won’t let Zi Linglong live.
‘When the attack starts tomorrow, I must think of a way to kill the Sect Master. Sigh, I don’t want to do this either, and I. I really want to become a good person. This is all the world’s fault. This is all the world’s fault. Why must it push me further and further down the path to the abyss?’
Jiang Ming shook his head.
There were very few people in this world who could act according to their own wishes. They either had to follow the flow or were forced to do something that they did not want to do.
A black dot appeared in the distance, and it arrived at the receiving platform in the next second. “Senior Brother Chang!” The person was none other than Chang Yiming. He had already stepped into the Purple Mansion Realm.
In fact, it was Jiang Ming who had helped him. He had infused two pieces of Enlightening Tea Leaves into his body without him knowing anything. Therefore, his cultivation speed had increased by leaps and bounds, and eventually, he ascended into the Purple Mansion Realm.
“First Seat Jiang!” Chang Yiming landed and stretched his hand out.
Jiang Ming knew what he wanted, so he threw a jug at him. “Help yourself. What brought you here today. Besides, is everything fine with Senior Sister Momo?”
After breaking through, he had taken Senior Sister Momo from Jiaoyang Peak to help him manage his stuff.
“Well, she’s doing fine,” Chang Yiming said as he took a sip. Then, he frowned and said, “I have no idea why, but I have a hunch that something big is going to happen lately, especially today. Look at the sky. It’s so dark and filled with dark clouds. It made me jittery, so I figured I should come here and have some wine.”
“Jittery?” Jiang Ming chuckled. “Are you sure you’re not having a kidney problem?”
“Hah!” Chang Yiming rolled his eyes. “You’re still a virgin, right? I can see why you can’t understand the wonder of women. Do you want me to take you down the mountain? Those women over there are gorgeous. I’m sure you won’t be able to resist them!”
“It seems to me that you’re quite experienced in this matter, huh?”
“You can’t blame me. I’m sure you know how boring it is to cultivate, right? The only way to relieve our loneliness is wine and sex. Besides, when we went down the mountain to kill the demons that year, the non-stop fighting and killing was taking its toll on us, and it was only by going to the brothels in different areas that our stressful minds could be eased.”
“I have a question. Can those women from the brothels keep up with your strength?”
“Easy! I made a huge bed that can occupy 49 women simultaneously!”
“Terrific!”
“Hehe!”
“Senior Brother Chang, you mustn’t force it.”
“Force it? Are you saying that I shouldn’t be forcing them? Don’t worry about that. We’re good guys. I only look for pleasure in the brothels. I won’t force other women.”
“That’s good to hear.”
“If we can’t even control ourselves, we’re no different from the evil ones!” Chang Yiming laughed. “Do you know that our Eldest Senior Brother and Senior Sister are coming back?”
“Senior Brother, and Senior Sister?” Jiang Ming seemed confused.
“Ah, silly me. I’ve forgotten that you’re only around 20 years old,” Chang Yiming said. “One of them is the oldest disciple of the Sect Master, while the other is the oldest disciple of Jiaoyang Peak. The former has left the Jiuyang Sect for more than 40 years to train himself in the mortal world, while the latter has left for about 30 years. Both of them are prideful, and I guess they won’t be satisfied with all the attention that Junior Sister Linglong is getting.”
“Don’t worry. If they dare to do anything to us, we’ll have my Junior Sister to teach them a lesson!”
“You’re right. After all, our Junior Sister is the best!”
“She’s my Junior Sister, not yours!”
“Why is she not my Junior Sister? I’m older than you two. You’re my Junior Brother, so of course, she’s my Junior Sister.”
Chang Yiming felt better after talking to Jiang Ming, and he left afterward. “That fellow… Could it be that he senses that something is going to happen in our sect?” Jiang Ming said.
He wasn’t worried about the Eldest Senior Brother or Sister.
If they dared to cause them trouble, they would teach them a lesson. If they harbored any ill intention, he would kill them.
Swoosh!
Rain began to fall, and the dark had gotten dark completely. He looked into the distance. The blanket of rain had merged everything together.
“A rainy night, huh… It’s the best opportunity to take some people’s lives!”
Jiang Ming rose to his feet. He turned around and disappeared into thin air..

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - Killing A Paradis Martial Artist, A Narrow Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Killing A Paradis Martial Artist, A Narrow Escape
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Soon, Jiang Ming found the place. However, he concealed his presence and hid about 1,000 kilometers away from them.
Swoosh!
The downpour continued relentlessly, and many places had been turned into a pool.
“This rain is strange,” Jiang Ming said as he landed on a peak. He had changed his appearance. Right now, he had a beard and a chiseled jaw. He raised his head to look at the sky and fell into contemplation. Today had nice weather, but the sky had suddenly turned dark, and rain began to fall heavily.
He wouldn’t suspect anything if it happened only in a small region, but it wouldn’t be normal if it happened across tens of thousands of miles.
He squinted his eyes and activated the Dharma Eyes as he looked toward the East Sea. He saw that the surface of the ocean was filled with water vapor. They were all heading inland as if they were going to turn here into a sea.
“Is it the Red Mountain Palace?” Jiang Ming frowned slightly.
He turned around and realized that flood was happening everywhere.
Many cultivators had come to the town and helped the people in the town.
He then looked toward the Qingyun Sect, but it seemed to him that nothing was happening over there.
“Sigh…” Jiang Ming let out a breath.
He couldn’t show himself in a war like this. He could only make his plan in the dark.
“Well, since you want war, I’ll give you war then!” he said as his eyes tumed cold.
He headed toward the Dark Wind Valley afterward.
The valley was massive, but an array surrounded it. The rain couldn’t get in, and people couldn’t detect their presence from the outside.
At the top of a mountain not far away sat an older man. He seemed to have merged into the dark. It was difficult to detect his presence, but Jiang Ming could sense a strong power from him.
Whoosh!
‘The Human Paths Record flipped open.
Name: Chou Long
Race: Human-demon (Human-Demon Body, possess the Howling Moon Heavenly Wolf bloodline)
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Paradis Realm
Background: Grand Elder of the Yinmo Sect
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Nine Stars
Status: The Yinmo Sect had been planning for more than 1,000 years to destroy the Qingyun Sect and set up a foundation in Eastern Region. Received news the Six Paths of the Sky Devil had decided to emerge and cause havoc to the world while turning the land of Shenzhou into a demonic domain when
the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures in Eastern Region opened up. There were fewer sacred lands in Eastern Region, so it could become their main battlefield. When the Yinmo Sect heard that the Qingyun Sect pretended not to know about their appearance, they decided to go along with the act and
use the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures to lure the Extreme Path martial artists from the Qingyun Sect to kill them.
The plan was already on the move, and a big war would happen once the Thunders Immortal Treasures opened up. He was certain that he wouldn’t be able to defend himself, so he was thinking of how to escape.
Knowing that the Qingyun Sect wanted to get rid of some clans and forces in Eastern Region through the hands of the Yinmo Sect, the Yinmo Sect then went along with it and cleared some annoying people out of their way.
When he found out that the Holy Daughter was coming to destroy the Jiuyang Sect, he volunteered to become the Holy Daughter’s guardian and escaped from the main battlefield.
‘That being said, he wondered why the Holy Daughter would bring five Primal Spirit martial artists with her since the Jiuyang Sect was just a second-rate sect. He also knew that there was a mole in the Jiuyang Sect, but one thing he couldn’t fathom was why they were acting so secretly. Could it be that the
Jiuyang Sect was hiding some secrets?
Then, a downpour came, and he figured that it must be the Red Mountain Palace’s doing. They were going to turn Eastern Region into a country of water, forming an environment conducive to their battle. It was just that he wondered if Long Yuan would make his move or not.
‘If the Yinmo Sect and the Red Mountain Palace work together, we should be able to crush the Qingyun Sect, but why am I feeling so nervous? Hold on for a second! Someone is watching me!”
Just when Chou Long noticed something was not right, a streak of light appeared in front of him. He knew it was too late to activate the Paradis projection, so he summoned an armor to protect himself but to no avail.
Pfft!
Jiang Ming pierced through his forehead without any difficulty, and then he quickly followed up by casting the Return of Infinite Law Finger.
‘The old man’s sea of consciousness collapsed, and his Primal Spirit crumbled away.
Chou Long was dead.
“[can finally kill a Paradis martial artist in seconds if I ambush them now,” Jiang Ming said.
Who could have thought that a 26-year-old young man was able to kill a Paradis martial artist in just a few seconds?
He stretched his arm forward and retrieved all of Chou Long’s items, and then he burned the rest of it.
He looked into the valley and fell silent.
It turned out that the Red Mountain Palace was the one that caused the rain.
As for Long Yuan… Jiang Ming did not know much about him yet. However, judging from the information he had collected, he must be the strongest force from the East Sea.
‘Both the people from the Qingyun Sect and the Yinmo Sect are indeed cunning. By the way, is there anything special about the Jiuyang Sect? Why is everyone coming to destroy us? Also, why have we never heard of Chou Long, a Paradis martial artist before? And we know nothing about Ge Xiang either.
This is weird.’
Jiang Ming thought, but he did not have any answer for his questions.
He decided to run an investigation over his sect so that he could prepare in advance if anything went sideways.
“The Yinmo Sect’s target is the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures… A large number of geniuses will be gathered there, and if all of them get killed there, it will be a big loss for Eastern Region. Besides, the Six Paths of the Sky Devil were going to make a move as well! Well, it seems like something big is
going to happen.” Jiang Ming sighed.
Jiang Ming couldn’t fathom why they couldn’t just focus on their cultivation. The devil sects focused on diabolical cultivation, while cultivators yearned for immortality. Why couldn’t they just cultivate and wait for the day of ascension? Why must they kill each other?
Was it because of the resources?
Jiang Ming discarded the thought as soon as it appeared in his head.
“The energy in the universe is still sufficient, though.”
Jiang Ming suddenly went into a trance as his pupils constricted. His brain was spinning fast, and he felt like a storm was going on inside his head.
Since ancient times, wars had always been facilitated by the minority, and their reasons were simple—power and wealth.
However, for cultivators, especially for those who were standing at the pinnacle of cultivation, their goal should have been trying to ascend to a higher level. Why must they be involved in a fight? Why did the Yinmo Sect keep fighting? Why were the Six Paths of the Sky Devil showing themselves right
now? Why must the Yinmo Sect go as far as join forces with the Red Mountain Palace to destroy the Qingyun Sect?
‘The Extreme Path or Imminent Mortal martial artists would certainly join the fight if a war broke out. At that time, nobody could guarantee that they wouldn’t die from the fight.
“It would be reasonable if those martial artists could no longer ascend to a higher level, but those who start this fight in the dark are obviously someone who has the ability to go to the next level, so why? There must be some secrets in it!”
Jiang Ming thought, and then Tian Ci, who was a reincarnation of an immortal, appeared in his mind. Not only did he have immortal weapons, but he also had the Golden Heavenly Path in the depth of his soul.
“Well, I shouldn’t think so much.”
Jiang Ming shook his head and suppressed those thoughts. After all, over-thinking was bad for health and hair.
He rose into the air. Although he had concealed his presence, his opponent had noticed his arrival. Without waiting for them to react, he formed a hand seal.
It was the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal, the special ability of the Qingyun Sect.
The great seal suppressed even the sky and had tons of divine power in it. Once it appeared, all the rain evaporated. The endless power had also formed a domain and prevented the people inside from escaping.
Rumble!
The seal descended and crashed into the valley, killing all of the people inside.
Before Jiang Ming could do anything, his vision went dark, and a chill crept down his spine.
‘This is Darkness Dao!”
The thought flitted across Jiang Ming’s head, and he disappeared. It was also at this moment that a sword stabbed the spot he stood before.
“Teleportation?” A voice echoed.
The darkness disappeared, rain began to fall, and a black-robed old man had appeared on top of the valley.
He seemed to have completely merged into the surroundings.
“Who are you?” Jiang Ming asked, his forehead filled with sweat..

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - Extreme Path’s Life-or-Death Battle, Annihilate the Jiuyang Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Extreme Path’s Life-or-Death Battle, Annihilate the Jiuyang Sect
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Hu Zhi
Race: Fox Clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: Supreme Elder of the Yinmo Sect
Relationship: -72
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Mutated Black Fox)
Status: Accidentally swallowed a drop of devil’s blood, leading to the mutation of his bloodline. Hence, his cultivation base improved rapidly as soon as he joined the Yinmo Sect.
A great change is on the horizon. Hence, he wants to take over the Jiuyang Sect completely. However, he feels the creepiness of the sect with the presence of an incredibly strong phoenix bloodline and the failure of a team plotting against the Jiuyang Sect, being wiped out by the Qingyun Sect.
Mo Lin, the Holy Son, was killed on his return from challenging the Jiuyang Sect, and his guardian, Ge Xiang, a Paradis Realm Elder, died as well. Bai Zizai was also killed there, and the Bishui Great Monarch, who was invading the Jiuyang Sect, was not only killed but his Bishui Sect was destroyed too.
Further investigation had also shown that in earlier days, Mu Lei, a Qingyun disciple that used to challenge the Jiuyang Sect, was killed on his return. His mother, who had gone to take revenge, died after she left the sect.
‘Whoever connected to the Jiuyang Sect would end up in tragedy. Hence, he assumed that an expert was protecting the sect.
He secretly followed the Holy Daughter, who was on the mission to overwhelm the Jiuyang Sect, while investigating the expert behind the scene.
‘When he felt the strong wave, Chou Long had already died. He held back his killing intent just to observe the killer without being noticed, even if the entire team, including the Holy Daughter, were killed. He was waiting for the moment when the killer would relax after the entire team was dead before he
began to counterstrike.
‘When Jiang Ming dodged, he checked on the attacker and felt his scalp pins and needles. After all, Hu Zhi had cold-bloodedly watched the death of more than 10 Primal Spirit experts, including the Holy Daughter, just for the best moment to counterstrike, even though he could have saved them.
Jiang Ming felt a shiver run down his spine as he thought of the sudden attack. Fortunately, he had enough experience fighting against the Darkness Dao in the Supreme Pagoda, allowing him to react in time.
He was particularly shocked at the details the attacker investigated, coming to the conclusion that those who had died were somewhat connected to the Jiuyang Sect. This made him think that both Old Tie and Qing Fengzi might have similar doubts.
With doubts, they usually would be assured even without evidence. Nevertheless, Jiang Ming was unafraid because of his improved cultivation base.
Hu Zhi interrogated, “Who are you? You are the killer of Mo Lin the Holy Son, Ge Xiang, Bai Zizai, and the Bishui Great Monarch, right?”
Nine divine mountains appeared along with an outburst, connecting each other to form an incredibly great formation that sealed the entire area within a 100-meter radius. As they fell, they crushed all things beneath them.
Hu Zhi saw through Jiang Ming’s cultivation base as soon as Jiang Ming struck. He did not care despite the terrifying pressure that could pose a threat to him. Instead, he huffed. “Small trick!”
And when he was about to counterattack after taking out a top-grade Dao Sword, he saw Jiang Ming take out a bell.
The bell was so heavy that it crushed the void and millions of Daos.
“This is an immortal weapon!” Hu Zhi expressed his astonishment.
He immediately disintegrated himself into darkness in retreat but was constrained by the nine divine mountains above him. It was this moment that decided the end of his life.
Sound waves swept through the void, encompassing all things, even the darkness formed by disintegrated Hu Zhi.
Hu Zhi screamed in despair and transformed back to its original shape, a 100-meter tall, pure black fox demon. At that moment, blood gushed from the seven orifices of its head as it cried out in pain. In the next moment, its head exploded, and it died in an instant.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record and heaved a sigh of relief only after confirming its death.
He knew how terrific an Extreme Path expert was—the ability of an Extreme Path expert to merge his body into the law made them even more difficult to be killed.
In fact, Jiang Ming could also come out with an effective countermeasure because of his understanding of an Extreme Path expert. He knew he had to constrain the movement of the Extreme Path expert and strike them dead with a blow, or he would fail. After all, he was in reality, not in the Supreme
Pagoda.
Thus, Jiang Ming had cast Mountains Seal, which prompted Hu Zhi despisal, enabling him to take out and inject half of his mana into the Celestial Sou! Bell, an immortal weapon. This prompted a terrific outburst that instantly killed Hu Zhi.
Jiang Ming sighed. “Wanted a fight, but it wasn’t a good time, unfortunately.”
He gathered up all the spoils and swept away Hu Zhi’s corpse. Black flames then surged from his body, sweeping across a 100-miles radius, and burned away all traces except the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal’s.
Following that, he turned and burrowed into space.
Not long later, two figures came over in the form of light. They were Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi, the Extreme Path experts from the Qingyun Sect. They looked grave and meticulous. They even took out their weapons for protection and got ready to cast their special abilities.
The duo went around before they came to a halt above the destroyed valley.
Qing Fengzi lifted his hand and transferred all accumulated rainwater out of the valley. He said, “The devil flame removed all traces but the Heaven Suppression Divine Seal’s. Obviously, it’s a plan to frame us. But what’s the point of doing so since we’re already engaging in the battle with the Yinmo Sect?
Is it because the culprit is trying to hide their identity?”
He made a pause and looked at the point where Hu Zhi was killed before continuing. “There are slight traces of demonic power and devil scent in addition to the Dao fluctuation induced by the outburst of immortal weapons in the void.”
Qing Xuzi nodded in agreement. “Who would use an immortal weapon at this time? An immortal weapon is, after all, an inherited weapon that guards a clan. It doesn’t make sense. Moreover, is it worthy to use an immortal weapon against a Yinmo team on a mission to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect? I think
the culprit should not be that strong, but I wonder why they have to kill all of them even at the cost of revealing their immortal weapon.”
He turned to look at the Jiuyang Sect.
Qing Fengzi followed after. He said gravely, “It’s confirmed that an expert of at least the Paradis Realm is hiding in the Jiuyang Sect. But something is not right, isn’t it? We do know the sect thoroughly, don’t we? Could it be due to Zi Linglong’s bloodline? And it’s abnormal that the Yinmo Sect is far too
concerned about the Jiuyang Sect.”
“Let’s go check it out!”
“Okay!”
The duo left in the form of light. They arrived above the Jiuyang Sect in merely a short moment. While hiding themselves, they went around all peaks as though the sect’s protective formation did not exist.
‘The duo would stop at each peak for a while, surveying meticulously, but found nothing valuable that could answer their questions.
Jiang Ming on Chuyang Peak was aware of the duo in an instant. He anxiously merged the Starry Hall into the cave underground and hid the entire place with an immortal weapon to avoid being discovered.
Following that, he sat cross-legged in the room calmly as though he was cultivating.
He also called out the Human Path Record to check on Qing Fengzi.
Name: Yang Feng (Qing Fengzi)
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: One of the Supreme Elders of the Qingyun Sect in Eastern Region
Relationship: 25
Innate talent: Ten Stars
Status: The layout against the Yinmo Sect and Red Mountain Palace had reached a critical moment. When the rain suddenly fell, he did not take it seriously because he knew it was the act of the Red Mountain Palace.
He was shocked when his sect’s artifact suddenly detected the immortal weapon’s energy wave from the direction of the Jiuyang Sect. Thus, he came over with his Junior Brother for an investigation. Without much effort, he speculated the team that had been killed was from the Yinmo Sect, which was
heading to the Jiuyang Sect. Based on other clues obtained previously, he again speculated that the person with the immortal weapon probably originated from the Jiuyang Sect.
Therefore, he went to the Jiuyang Sect to investigate further but found nothing strange, not even Chuyang Peak. He began doubting whether his speculation was a mistake and wondered if that person had gone to the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures to protect Zi Linglong.
Also, he pondered whether to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect to frame the Yinmo Sect and force the appearance of the Jiuyang Sect’s hidden expert.
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat as he read.
This Qing Fengzi, who had been so amiable with Old Tie on Chuyang Peak and even fought with Old Tie for Zi Linglong, had come this time intending to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect!
As expected of a Qingyun person-in-charge behind the scenes—he was indeed extraordinarily ruthless and decisive.
Jiang Ming felt nervous as he thought, ‘I thought I’ve been meticulous enough, leaving no valuable traces, but he actually could speculate relatively well. These old things that have lived for thousands of years are indeed filled with wisdom!
‘What shall I do if he does what he thinks”

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - Two Died Tragically, Thunder Penalty Immortal Spear
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Two Died Tragically, Thunder Penalty Immortal Spear
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Both Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi were standing above Taiyang Peak’s great hall, looking at the entire sect’s estate as their eyes gradually turned indifferent.
“Wanna annihilate?” asked Qing Fengzi.
Qing Xuzi nodded. “All incidents such as the death of Mu Shuiyun, the annihilated Bishui Sect, the death of Bai Zizai, and even the incidents whereby the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s Holy Son was killed and Tian Ci from Tianyuan School was chased that happened in recent consecutive years are more or
less related to the Jiuyang Sect. Perhaps the root cause is Zi Linglong. But now, with the current situation, we should destroy it with a thunderous blow rather than leaving this unstable factor as it is!”
“Even Zi Linglong must di
“She is a mere peerless genius. We shall kill her too since we’re to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect.”
“I thought you wanted to get her to our sect?”
“She’s too insensitive. Regardless of how talented she is, she can only grow up to be an Expert Path, or an Imminent Immortal at most, which is no big deal to us after all. But now, it is likely that the person behind her is constantly making mischief and even framing our Qingyun Sect. Hence, the enemy
that we shall get rid of!”
“I think let’s just forget about it. If we do so and are discovered, it’ll cause negative influence! Since the Jiuyang Sect and Yinmo Sect have been feuding with each other, let’s just watch how it goes. Who knows, we may reap some benefits from it. Moreover, if any matters arise, we can annihilate them by
then. After all, Zi Linglong is still under our scrutiny.”
“alright!”
The duo eventually left.
Atop Chuyang Peak
Jiang Ming had taken out the Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card and Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk. He was also ready to activate the formation to seal the surroundings so that he could slay the duo as soon as he activated the Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card.
He slightly heaved a sigh of relief when he saw them leave.
‘think I’m too naive compared to them. After all, they’d kill even without evidence.’ As Jiang Ming was thinking, he suddenly rose to his feet, looking into the distance. He expressed astonishment on his face before vanishing into thin air.
40,000 miles away from the Jiuyang Sect.
‘Two people stopped both Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi. One held a long spear radiating an intimidating aura that permeated the void, while the other held a long sword with its Sword Sambodha cutting through nine heavens.
“Qing Ming, Li Ruoshan, how dare you block our way!” Qing Fengzi huffed.
“Qing Fengzi, you old bastard!” Qing Ming pointed his long spear at Qing Fengzi as he got even more intimidating. “Did you two kill Chou Long and Hu Zhi
“We’re here investigating the matter too!” Qing Fengzi frowned as he had a sinister foreboding.
“Ha, old b*stard! Why deny hypocritically when it’s a fact? Who else in the entire Eastern Region knows everything about my Yinmo Sect and has the ability to kill Hu Zhi, an Extreme Path expert, in a short time? There’s none other than you two!”
“No, we didn’t. Don’t talk nonsense!” Qing Fengzi panicked.
Li Ruoshan paced forward and said, “Arrogant as you are, why are you panicking? Hu Zhi died nearby, and you two are here. Thus, even if you aren’t the murderers, you two must be somehow responsible for his death. Since we’re enemies, let’s have a life-and-death match now that we’ve met. You die, we
live, and we’ll all be happy!”
“Haha, Shan, I like what you’ve just said! For so long they’ve dominated Eastern Region, it’s time for their downfall! Moreover, we’ve been hiding for countless years and have never had the pleasure of a battle. My long spear has been rusty. Now it’s time to give it some lubricant! Shan, I will make my move
first!”
As he wielded his long spear, aura infused with Golden Law converged at its spearhead till an extreme point before it was directed toward Qing Xuzi. As it was penetrating through the void, the surrounding void distorted.
“Do you really think that I’m afraid?” Qing Xuzi was annoyed. Thunder struck down with a slash of his long sword, dissipating Qing Ming’s attack.
“Come on, Little Fengzi, let’s get closer too,” Li Ruoshan said as he stabbed toward Qing Fengzi.
The battle instantly started.
How terrific was the damage when Extreme Path experts fought? All things in a 1,000-kilometer radius were shattered and devastated in just a moment.
Jiang Ming appeared at a peak in the distance. He concealed his aura with the system while merging into space. His eyes gleamed as he watched the battle.
“Looks like it’s quite difficult for them to kill Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi,’ Jiang Ming thought as he got more vehement. He decided to kill these two old b*stards because of their intention to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect and slaughter his Junior Sister.
Space distorted before Jiang Ming as a black-clad young man bearing a long sword at his back and emanating an incredibly cold aura showed up. It was his Combat Mannequin. In fact, it was an extremely special top-grade Dao Vessel because it had a hint of spiritualism.
Jiang Ming fed it with his consciousness and transferred half of his mana into the Combat Mannequin. Then, he teleported away to another end and hid while waiting for an opportunity to make his move.
Swoosh!
Meanwhile, the Combat Mannequin flew toward the battle area in the form of a sword. Upon reaching about 100 kilometers away, he drew his long sword from his back and roared, “Brother Ming and Ruoshan, I’m Qing Tianzhu from the Shimo Sect. I just got here and saw both of you being surrounded by
the two old b*stards from the Qingyun Sect. So I’m here to help. Let’s kill them.
“One Sword Chills 3,000 States!”
‘The Combat Mannequin introduced himself and called the two Yinmo Sect’s experts’ names to prove that they were allies.
Meanwhile, its long sword slashed across heaven with a pitcher of light dissecting the rolling black clouds, revealing the moon. Moonlight spilled down as if the light had shone into the abyss.
Amidst the sword ray was a terrific destructive force.
Bang!
“Qing Tianzhu from the Shimo Sect?” Both Qing Ming and Li Ruoshan were doubtful as they wondered about the existence of such a man in the Shimo Sect.
‘They felt the Combat Mannequin had a similar cold corpse-like aura as the Shimo Sect but a rather strange one. Nevertheless, because of the peculiarity of the sect itself, they could not identify the strangeness. Thus, they ended up omitting the person’s real identity, provided he was not against them.
“Haha, Brother Zhu, let’s kill them!” Qing Ming laughed as he wielded his long spear, engulfing Qing Xuzi.
“die!” Li Ruoshan struck even harder.
With an additional equally strong expert, they eventually managed to take over the battle, completely suppressing both Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi.
Meanwhile, the battlefield gradually moved away from the Jiuyang Sect under the intentional guidance of the Combat Mannequin, eventually arriving on a lake, the intersection point between Mu Province and Hai Province.
‘Wherever they passed, what they left behind was a mess.
At the same time, they attracted the attention of experts from various forces along the way.
But none of them cared nor came forward. After all, they were not stupid to commit suicide.
Yet, Jiang Ming was tailing them secretly.
He also checked the Status of two Extreme Path experts from the Yinmo Sect.
Qing Ming: Is of the human race but with devil blood. He is one of the Yinmo Sect’s Supreme Elders. He was patrolling around with Li Ruoshan in preparation for the war when he learned about Hu Zhi’s death as his mark had disappeared from the Dao Vessel used for communication. At the same time, he
sensed waves of terrific energies in the distance, compelling him to come over to find out what was going on. On his way there, he accidentally met Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi.
The Status was similar to Li Ruoshan’s. However, their Status showed nothing about the Jiuyang Sect.
‘Ithink we shall end the fight as soon as possible. The longer they fight, the higher chance it is for more Qingyun experts rushing over. Since we’re already far away from the Jiuyang Sect, I think we can just slaughter them here. After all, I don’t think others could connect such an incident to the Jiuyang
Sect at this distance. But I wonder whether it’d initiate the war earlier than expected” Jiang Ming thought as he shifted his consciousness to the Combat Mannequin.
Boom!
The long sword that cut through heaven, separating the dark clouds. Lake water exploded and almost dried up as a result of evaporation.
“Brother Ming and Ruoshan, I’m about to activate my artifact to constrain their movement for a while. Meanwhile, please grab the opportunity to kill them!” The Combat Mannequin transmitted his plan to the two.
Qingming and Li Ruoshan’s eyes lit up, and they both nodded imperceptibly.
Buzz!
