In the next moment, a bell appeared before the Combat Mannequin, suppressing the void and millions of Daos in an instant. The force seemed to be overwhelming the earth, permeating through space.
Dark clouds dissipated, and lake water evaporated. Chains of orders appeared in the void, barely carrying the great artifact.
As soon as the Celestial Soul Bell appeared, it rang out.
Dong!
As the bell rang out, all things fell silent. Its soundwaves instantly swept over Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi, cracking their protective Dao Vessels, tearing apart their protective light, and entering straight into their consciousness. They trembled, and blood instantly oozed out of their seven orifices.
‘The Combat Mannequin was merely a mannequin. Although it had an incredibly strong physique and the Killing Sword Dao that allowed it to trigger Sword Law and Killing Law, its mana originating from Jiang Ming was limited.
Thus, it used up all mana given with just a strike.
“T’ve spent too much of my energy. Hence, that’s all I can do now. Brothers, I’ll leave first to the Red Mountain Palace. Farewell,” the Combat Mannequin said and slashed through the void, where it disappeared into it.
Qing Ming and Li Ruoshan frowned slightly, but they did not spend time thinking further. After all, they did not want to miss the golden opportunity to slaughter the duo.
“Die!” Qing Ming pierced his long spear through Qing Xuzi’s head.
“You too, go to hell!” Li Ruoshan’s long sword was already atop the head of Qing Fengzi, who was still reeling. Unexpectedly, the moment when he was about to slaughter Qing Fengzi, a streak of light suddenly appeared in the void and rapidly pierced through Li Ruoshan, exploding and dissipating his
body.
As the light solidified, it was a long spear.
“The Qingyun Sect Guarding Immortal Weapon, Thunder Penalty Immortal Spear!?” Qing Ming looked at the long spear, horrified..

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - The Qingyun Sect’s Imminent Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: The Qingyun Sect’s Imminent Destruction
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming looked at the death of Qing Xuzi from afar. He had been under the impression Qing Fengzi would also be killed because he was, after all, seriously injured by the immortal weapon while confronting two Extreme Path experts simultaneously. Yet, a Thunder Penalty Immortal Spear suddenly
appeared out of nowhere, killing Li Ruoshan.
“The Qingyun Sect is fast!” Jiang Ming was shocked. He immediately teleported away, returned to a peak, and waited for the return of his Combat Mannequin. Meanwhile, he took out and waved the Human Path Record to cut off all the karma before teleporting again.
Ina short while, he had returned to Chuyang Peak.
Standing on the rooftop, he looked in the direction of Mu Province.
‘think the Qingyun Sect will be furious at the death of Qing Fengzi. I wonder whether the Yinmo Sect will panic at the death of Li Ruoshan and Hu Zhi in merely a night? Jiang Ming thought.
It would be strange if the Yinmo Sect did not take any action at the consecutive death of two Extreme Path experts.
As expected, Jiang Ming felt terrific waves of energy not long later. Although long-distance transmission weakened the waves, the powerful energy that was not of earthly origin still made his heart palpitate.
The rain was getting heavier, leaving the night in complete darkness.
‘The Jiuyang Sect’s formation was in operation, drawing all rainwater into the river.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming brewed a pot of tea and washed a plate of Purple Jade Grapes. Then, he lay on the rattan chair, sipping tea and eating grapes. He was enjoying his leisure time.
“It’d be even better with the presence of Junior Sister. At least she can help peeling grapes,” Jiang Ming muttered.
He then shifted his focus to the Human Path Records.
The Status of Qing Ming: ‘How’s it possible for Qing Tianzhu to have an immortal weapon!? Anyway, it’s a good opportunity to kill Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi, two great enemies, tonight.
‘Damn it, Li Ruoshan was killed by the Qingyun Sect’s immortal weapon, the Thunder Penalty Immortal Sword.
‘My goodness! How am I going to break free when Qing Tianzhu ran away while Li Ruoshan was killed?
‘My sect indeed doesn’t disappoint me by also offering up an immortal weapon.
‘F*ck, the energy emanating from the clash of two immortal weapons was too terrific, my heart palpitated!
‘are we going to launch a guerilla attack soon? Since both Li Ruoshan and Hu Zhi were killed consecutively, if we waited, more might be killed. After all, launching the attack tonight shouldn’t be a big deal because it’s merely a day or two earlier than planned.
“They are launching immortal weapons against the Qingyun Sect’s headquarters too.
‘Lsensed the aura of the Red Mountain Palace’s Palace Master. But I think only he alone can afford to do so. Fortunately, this time, Long Yuan is very proactive.
‘I think the Qingyun Sect wouldn’t have taken into account Long Yuan, right? Haha!
‘since all parties have started attacking, the Qingyun Sect will be annihilated.
As Jiang Ming read the Status, he frowned heavily.
He saw the name of Long Yuan again. But it was evident that Long Yuan was not the main reason Qing Ming was confident in causing the Qingyun Sect’s downfall.
He thought of another possibility, which instantly made him feel a chill run down his spine.
To prove his thought, he flipped through the pages.
Old Tie of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion: ‘The world is getting more chaotic. Someone even dared try to kill Tian Ci from the Tianyuan School. Eastern Region is in extreme chaos as the Yinmo Sect is about to resurge. Even the Qigingmo Sect and Liuyumo Sect’s little devils hiding in Zhong Province are
getting more active. Well, how many can stop them from seducing people by offering their bodies?
‘Tm afraid they already have many people from all sects, Great Zhou, and even sacred lands in their control. Once the war breaks out, it’ll cause great chaos!
‘speculating from various information, the moment the Yinmo Sect resurges, the other five devil sects will resurge simultaneously. By that time, itll set off a catastrophe again.
‘With the recent occurrence of bloodshed among sects, the downfall of many forces overnight, and even riots in various parts of Great Zhou, all these instances indicate that the Qigingmo Sect and Liuyumo Sect are going to resurge along with the Yinmo Sect.
‘Well, regardless of their resurgence, they’ll be uprooted. Since they don’t want to live quietly in peace, let’s just send all of them into purgatory.
‘But I wonder if the Qingyun Sect can resist. It would be difficult with Long Yuan’s involvement! Well, it’s not a big deal if the Qingyun Sect is annihilated. I believe the other sacred lands and my Infinite Alchemy Pavilion can pull it through.’
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless upon reading the Status.
This old man looked boorish, but he was no slouch. He was obviously planning to reap advantages whichever side won.
He even was contemptuous of the Qigingmo Sect and Liuyumo Sect. Well, he was capable of doing so. The forces in Zhong Province were the strongest—even the Fo Sect dominating the entire Western Region had failed to expand its influence to Zhong Province.
‘Are all six devil sects truly resurging soon?’ Jiang Ming pondered.
He flipped the pages of Human Path Records again.
Liu Changkong: One of the Supreme Elders of the Tianyuan School
Status: ‘How strange it is for the inability to trace the man who tried to kill Tian Ci! He seemed to have appeared out of nowhere, leaving no traces at all. I tried to track him down with Karma Law and immortal weapons but to no avail.
“Tian Ci actually had an immortal weapon within himself, yet he utterly had no idea. I wonder if Tian Ci as an Immortal Fetus is a blessing or a curse.
‘All indications show that the case of Tian Ci seemed to be related to the Jiuyang Sect. But how could an ordinary sect link to such a strong expert?
“The fact that Zi Linglong could actually defeat Tian Ci was implausible. Investigation showed that her soul was not hijacked, while the high intensity of her phoenix bloodline is indeed incredible. It’s strange because she obviously is a human being but with phoenix’s lineal descendant bloodline. Her origin
has become a mystery, for it could not be deduced with Karma Law either. This is puzzling!
‘Could it be that the legend is real? In this case, that would be a catastrophe!
“Sigh, what a year of troubles!
‘In the unrestful Eastern Region, the Yinmo Sect is working with Long Yuan to annihilate the Qingyun Sect. If this is the case, the Qingyun Sect should be able to pull off the ordeal at a serious cost. The worst fear is that the other devil sects have already secretly traveled to Eastern Region.
“The Million Demons Mountain and Xuemo Sect are getting more active in Southern Region, the Qiqingmo Sect and Liuyumo Sect are getting more restless in Zhong Province, and the Shimo Sect and Xiuluomo Sect have already raised up their flags for the war in Northern Region, but why do I feel that
they are merely swashbuckling?
‘If they are truly swashbuckling, it will be very troublesome!
“The Submerged Dragon Continent is also getting more presumptuous.
‘And the Fo Sect in Western Region, do they still want to be onlookers? The six devil sects would not have resurfaced if it weren’t for them!
‘It is indeed a catastrophe for all citizens when the world is in chaos. Unfortunately, my Tianyuan School always advocates staying out of disputes among forces and being in a transcendent position… but.
As Jiang Ming read the Status, his feeling of uneasiness grew even stronger.
He also admired Liu Changkong for his thoroughness in sorting out all forces in the world. “Indeed, the strongest expert in the Tianyuan School. His capability of perceiving the world from Zhong Province is remarkable!”
Jiang Ming thought that Liu Changkong’s speculation was somehow similar to his deduction. He was afraid that all six devil sects would gather in Eastern Region. Together with Long Yuan, whose capability was unknown, it would impose a significant threat that even the Qingyun Sect could not pull off.
‘If the Qingyun Sect were annihilated, Eastern Region would be in great chaos. Yet my cultivation base is still too low for me to survive!’
Jiang Ming felt that his personal safety was threatened. His enemies were at least Paradis experts. He had even fought with Liu Changkong, an Imminent Immortal expert. Now there were even immortal weapons around.
If he deducted correctly, Eastern Region might not be submerged but scattered.
‘Imust quickly break through to the Paradis Realm then continue deducting special abilities in the Supreme Pagoda. By that time, I believe I’ll be able to protect myself!” Jiang Ming planned as he began to have a sense of urgency.
As for his Junior Sister being investigated, he did not care.
suddenly, he rose to his feet, looking in the Qingyun Sect’s direction. At this moment, divine light flowed through his eyes, allowing him to see into the distance.
Ina place extremely far away, he saw boundless divine light surging up into heaven, suppressing all darkness and covering all things, including dark clouds, heavy rains, and moonlight.
There seemed to be an ocean covering the Qingyun Sect in the sky and terrifying waves descending.
On another side, there were the roaring devil waves.
“A full blast has just launched!” Jiang Ming muttered with anticipation, and at the same time, he fidgeted.
He flipped his Human Path Records again.
His Junior Sister was still safe and sound. Despite the urge to bring his Junior Sister back just in case, he held back because of his ability to rush there anytime and the troubles that might be induced by bringing her back abruptly. In addition, his Junior Sister would be safer in the God of Thunder Immortal
Treasure than staying outside.
As his thoughts flew, he continuously flipped the Human Path Records to check on the Status of a few others.
“Long Yuan and the Yinmo Sect are indeed joining hands in striking a blow against the Qingyun Sect’s protective formation. They sent Paradis, Extreme Path, and even Imminent Immortals experts to act together in addition to having activated more than one immortal weapon just to destroy the Qingyun
Sect in a blow!”
Jiang Ming learned the rough situation in the Qingyun Sect through Qing Ming and Qing Fengzi’s Status..

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - Chuyang Peak’s Tragedy, Surprise Change
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chuyang Peak’s Tragedy, Surprise Change
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
‘What happened next was very strange.
The Qingyun Sect’s formation was broken. A couple of Imminent Immortals came out from within, and they actually managed to force invading enemies to retreat to the seaside.
Half of Mu Province was devastated as the war continued while a third of Hai Province was submerged.
The rain finally stopped in the morning and dark clouds dissipated.
Yet the terrific waves transmitting from the horizon remained.
On Chuyang Peak
Jiang Ming was looking at the sunrise from the fence. The eastern sky was colored red, not knowing whether it was due to the shining sunlight or the reflecting bloodstains.
“Qingyun Sect is this strong? It’s surprising that the sect actually forced the retreat of the Yinmo Sect and Long Yuan’s combined forces. What an extraordinary Sacred Land that occupies a region!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
He then turned and looked around. He sensed the atmosphere of Eastern Region filled with invisible disastrous gi and killing intent.
He sighed, “It’d be great if the Human Path Records could do live!”
Then, he laid back on the rattan chair, swaying leisurely.
Meanwhile, he called up Human Path Records, where he ‘saw his Junior Sister entering the God of Thunder Immortal Treasure.
He also ‘saw’ Qing Ming muttering as he wondered why was the Qingyun Sect not annihilated? Why didn’t the two Imminent Immortals of his sect attack? Qing Ming thought it was unusual that the number of experts sent by Long Yuan was fewer than expected.
At the same time, all devil sects in Zhong Province, Southern Region, and Northern Region resurfaced. They initiated war throughout their regions, although not as fierce as the one in Eastern Region.
‘The Western Region was the only region remaining free from war.
jiang Ming suddenly sat up straight, thoughts racing through his mind.
He thought devil sects should be resurging while creating massive chaos based on all six devil sects’ current situation and various information he had read. But it turned out otherwise.
The war in Eastern Region looked fierce and intense, yet something was not right.
‘That night, Yinmo Sect managed to force Qingyun Sect’s experts to retreat to its sect.
The war continued for the next three days as a drawn-out war.
The devil sects failed to break through Qingyun Sect’s gate, but the war held outside the gate affected more than half of Eastern Region’s area as they slaughtered countless people every second.
Gu Hai returned in the evening.
He looked very grave as he ordered, “With the great war outside, small sects like ours might be annihilated anytime. Do prepare for an immediate escape because I’ll immediately send you away if anything happens or if Qingyun Sect is defeated!”
“Why?” Jiang Ming was confused.
For a moment, Gu Hai remained silent before he sighed. Then, he flew to the sealed area and demanded, “Come over!”
The formation had always shielded the area. Jiang Ming did not probe into it because he knew the old man would tell him one day.
“Do you know the reason why Chuyang Peak has only you two disciples and me?” Anguish flashed across Gu Hai’s face as he removed the formation with a wave of his hand.
Inside the formation were palaces connecting to each other. It was not large but enough to accommodate about 100 people. The buildings were now in ruin, with various broken weapons scattered on the ground. Bloodstains could be seen everywhere too.
These showed that the place used to be the location of a tragic battle.
Jiang Ming had expected earlier, but at this moment, he was merely waiting in silence.
“At that time, when I first accepted the position as Chuyang Peak’s First Seat, I was very ambitious to expand it to the size of a sect, but…” Gu Hai got even more anguished that his eyes reddened. He continued, “I’ve got a great disciple, who was incredibly talented, even in the perspective of the sect. I
treated him as my son! As I got weaker after my injury, I let him take over my First Seat’s responsibilities as my disciple. In the beginning, he did very well, so well that Chuyang Peak was at its pinnacle!”
Gu Hai lifted his head, gazing into the sky. He recalled the past, those disciples who surrounded him
He shuddered.
He took a deep breath, calmed himself, and said, “Everything was good until he became too obsessed with his cultivation one day. No, he was devilized and became a devil. He went berserk, and his cultivation soared. He then went on a killing spree, and because he was stronger than many others, he killed
many disciples and even a few of my Senior Brothers.”
“When I got back here, corpses were seen all around!”
“Many of the disciples who died had their eyes open with disbelief: why did the Senior Brother kill us?”
“He was also badly hurt. He knelt before me, kowtowing and also crying, He said intermittently: it wasn’t me, it wasn’t me, it wasn’t me, I couldn’t control myself, no, it was as if I was being controlled, Master, it really wasn’t me, I didn’t want to…I don’t know what happened!”
“Llifted my hand, wanted to kill him, but didn’t manage to!” Gu Hai closed his eyes before he continued, “Although I was burning with rage, I didn’t lose my senses and felt something was not right. But he… he slapped himself to death. Before he died, he said: “Master, it was not my intention, it really
wasn’t. Master, I have made a terrible mistake, and I can only atone for it with my life!”
Jiang Ming listened to Gu Hai quietly. He instantly recalled the Zhiyang Peak First Seat, the spy of the devil sect who was always plotting to take over Chuyang Peak.
He just knew that Yue Cheng must be the culprit over the entire incident.
Gu Hai sighed as he described what had happened in the past. “Based on what I knew about him and what he said at the end, both Sect Master and I sensed that something was wrong, But no matter how I investigated, all my efforts were in vain. Eventually, nothing could be done! In the end, because all
Chuyang Peak disciples died except 10 external disciples, I was being discouraged. Hence, I dispersed them to other peaks.”
“In addition to my consciousness’s injury, that incident had completely left me traumatized! At that time, I was either indulging myself in drinking or wandering aimlessly to various places until I met you!”
“Ididn’t plan to take care of you after I saved you. But the strong yearning to live you showed in your eyes touched my heart. As I thought it would be disgraceful being the First Seat and not having a disciple, I brought you up to the peak!”
“Master, this is your fault then. If you didn’t take me here, with my cleverness, I’d have become rich, married dozens of concubines, and embraced them on my two sides. What a beautiful life that would be!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Married dozens of concubines? You’re such a big talker!” Gu Hai curled his lip, feeling better. He then added, “What happened back then is definitely related to the devil sect. Moreover, instances such as the case a few years ago whereby a team from the devil sect tried to destroy us, followed by the Bi Shui
Sect’s attack, and the recent cases whereby teams from the Yinmo Sect destroyed various sects and clans indicate that our Jiu Yang Sect will not be spared once the Qingyun Sect is defeated! Therefore, the Sect Master has arranged for a group of elite disciples to hide. In case the situation changes, I will
also arrange for your immediate retreat! As for your Junior Sister, some of the sect’s elders have gone there to tell her to leave as soon as she comes out quickly.”
“What about you, Maste!
ang Ming’s heart sank as he listened.
Perhaps that was the sadness of the weak.
“Here’s my home!”
“Master, here’s my home too!”
“Listen to me this time!” Gu Hai demanded in an unprecedented, serious manner.
Jiang Ming could only obey by nodding his head. He turned, looking in the Qingyun Sect’s direction, his eyes gleaming.
“You’re now already in the Core Formation Realm. In fact, few in the sect can compare with your innate talent, not to mention your Junior Sister, who stunned the whole world. Therefore, we’re no worse than the other peaks even though we have only a few people!”
Gu Hai then said, “The past is the past after all. Let’s just make this place history!”
He released a glob of flame, which melted the palace ruin.
“It’s best that you’re able to let it go! Junior Sister and I will be responsible for taking good care of you during your old age!” Jiang Ming said.
“Are you cursing me to die earlier? I’m still thinking of improving my cultivation base to live as an immortal!” Gu Hai snorted.
“You?”
“Are you looking down upon your Master?”
“Haha!”
“Looking at you being so lazy makes me furious. Go on, cook for me 32 dishes, one dish less and I’ll hang you up and beat you!”
“Old man, this is abuse!”
“Hehe, I’m your Master!”
“Sigh, this’s a powerful reason indeed.” Jiang Ming went away, helpless.
After the old man fed himself enough, he told Jiang Ming before he left, “If our sect survives this disaster, I’ll pass my position as the First Seat to Linglong, You’ll be the acting First Seat to recruit disciples and bring Chuyang Peak to greater height!”
Jiang Ming opened his mouth, halfway flicking out his middle finger, which he withdrew hastily as he did not feel right to do so. In the end, he mumbled, “Recruit disciples? I don’t want to be troubled. Does this old man think that he’s got a hold on me? Junior Sister’s position is the highest in the sect now,
but she listens to me, hehe!”
He took a look at the back of the mountain. He also knew why his Master told him all these was to prepare him to escape at any time and show him that he had let go of the past.
It was also that night, Jiang Ming expressed his shock when he looked at the Qingyun Sect’s direction.
The change had eventually come..

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, Declaration about Extreme Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, Declaration about Extreme Path
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
That was a giant immortal ship. As it propelled forward, clouds dispersed, and its intimidating aura overwhelmed all things. It was reaching and clashing onto the Qingyun Sect in just a short moment.
It prompted an impact so strong that even Jiang Ming could feel its dreadfulness from 100 miles away.
If he were to confront the clashing, he might die even if he activated the Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card. In just a moment, he felt the ripples of the terrific impact. He could not imagine how terrific it would be if he were at the scene.
He quickly checked on Qing Fengzi and Qing Ming.
Qing Ming’s Status: F*ck, even the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union is here. And I don’t even know that they are joining us in this mission of attacking the Qingyun Sect. F*ck, even they are keeping it from me. I’m, after all, an Extreme Path expert, yet I knew nothing at all. Anyway, with the union of
Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, Submerged Dragon Immortal Ally, Qingyun Sect is done.
Qing Fengzi Status: How’s it possible that the Submerged Dragon Continent suddenly takes their move? They have been under our watch all this time, yet there isn’t even a hint of them planning to go against us! Our men in the Yinmo Sect too didn’t send us any relevant news. This is really troublesome.
Oh no, that’s the immortal ship driven by many experts. We’re done for.
“With Long Yuan as an ally, they’d just take over rivers and lakes as their territories, but the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union will definitely want to take their parts in Eastern Region. I wonder what’s the ultimate goal of Yinmo Sect?” Jiang Ming doubted.
Just like its name, the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union was a combination of forces on the Submerged Dragon Continent, hence extraordinarily strong.
Jiang Ming checked on the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s Old Tie and also the Tianyuan School’s Liu Changkong.
‘As expected, Zhong Province was in chaos too.
Jiang Ming checked again at around 4 in the morning.
Liu Changkong’s Status: Together with Long Yuan and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, Yinmo Sect has turned Eastern Region into disastrous land. The other regions’ forces even dare not simply take actions to avoid being involved in the war and suffer losses!
Southern Region, Northern Region, and Zhong Province are getting more chaotic.
This is truly a devil-induced war!
And their target is as expected: to devastate the Fo Sect in Western Region. Other than the Yinmo Sect in Eastern Region, turmoil in other regions is actually to mask their true purpose, ie., to unite all five devil sects’ experts in attacking the Fo Sect of Western Region.
‘Who’d dare to simply counteract when the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, Yinmo Sect, and Long Yuan are located at the Eastern Region facing the Western Region in addition to the Million Demons Mountain located in the Southern Region?
‘There must be a powerful expert who could unite all six devil sects, Long Yuan and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union.
A catastrophe is truly just around the corner!
Ha, the Fo Sect must have never thought that they’d have to bear the karma of their overindulgence today.
While Liu Changkong was looking through the world, he even had hints of gloater.
Jiang Ming also learned about the latest world’s situation, which caused his head pins and needles.
After all, the Eastern Region would become a demon-devil land upon the destruction of the Qingyun Sect. Moreover, the Fo Sect of Western Region most probably was unable to pull off the war while confronting the strong union of devil sects. All Southern Region, Eastern Region, and Western Region will
be connected through the Southern Region by that time.
Jiang Ming thought that it was a great plan. But he sighed because he was unable to do anything!
Jiang Ming learned about how terrific the war field was through Qing Ming and Qing Fengzi’s Status in the next few days. Primal Spirit experts were considered weak, and Paradis experts were everywhere. There were even Extreme Path experts dying every day.
Meanwhile, Jiuyang Sect remained closed, and its protective formation was operating at its maximum capacity.
“Can the Qingyun Sect resist them?” Jiang Ming doubted. After all, more than half of the Qingyun Sect was in ruin.
Nevertheless, when Qingyun Sect was about to fall completely, they activated their peerless emergency formation built on four provinces: Feng Province, Yun Province, Shui Province, and Yu Province as its foundation, which immediately slaughtered four Imminent Immortal experts and about 20
Extreme Path experts.
The scene was so bloody that their heads rolled on the ground, creating pools of blood.
This enraged the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union. Hence, they also activated their own foundations.
As a result, one could witness cracking void and interweaving divine lights from Qing Province. He could even feel ripples of destructive waves and neverending earthquakes.
A sword ray even slashed through the sky, reaching the area 1,000 miles away from Jiuyang Sect, frightening all disciples.
Jiang Ming stood on the rooftop, planning for the worst. He was ready to activate the Combat Mannequin and Expert Path Experience Card.
He turned, looking at the west, and could not help to shake his head. He knew that the Fo Sect of Western Region had fallen from Liu Changkong’s Status. The war not only flattened the region but turned it into an abyss.
At this moment, Jiang Ming had finally understood the meaning of ‘life is fragile!
In fact, not only in Western Region, even in Eastern Region, the death toll of civilians must have risen up to millions.
‘When power isn’t constraining the world, life is the cheapest of all!” Jiang Ming sighed. He then sat down, silently updating himself with the latest news.
‘The war gradually ended only a month later. The few large Sacred Land in Zhong Province had finally sent their support. Yet, Qingyun Sect still had to withdraw their authority on Feng Province and Yun Province because they were barely enough to protect themselves.
The war had resulted in the almost depletion of Qingyum’s foundation. The sect had lost more than half of their Extreme Path experts, let alone the common disciples.
Qing Fengzi managed to survive but was seriously injured. His Primal Spirit almost crashed.
On the other hand, the Yinmo Sect’s Qing Ming had died.
The Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union were no better than the Qingyun Sect. In fact, it was a pyrrhic victory. They won just because they were allies.
The worst was the Fo Sect of Western Region. Although the sect was stronger and more terrific than Qingyun Sect, they had to confront five devil sects. In the end, the entire sect was devastated, and almost all disciples were slaughtered. The survivors were the ones who managed to retreat to the adjacent
Zhong Province. They survived because the five devil sects’ experts were getting weak. Hence they stopped the chasing.
Moreover, if those devil sects’ experts continued, they might have provoked forces of Zhong Province, causing more losses.
Strangely after the war, the Tianyuan School led Great Zhou Dynasty’s Royal Family, Riyue Sect, Yantian Sect, Taishang Sword Sect, and Infinite Alchemy Pavilion to declare that from now onward, all Extreme Path experts shall battle above Nine Heavens only or be killed by the rest. The declaration was
followed by Million Demons Mountain of Southern Region, Tianlei Sect, Taixu Sect of Southern Region, among others.
After all, the war in Eastern and Western regions was too horrifying. Mountains collapsed, the earth sank, lakes evaporated, and living things became extinct, which had caused severe irreparable damage to Shenzhou land.
“Strange!” Jiang Ming was confused.
Such an act of the forces in Zhong Province was abnormal. After all, the common sense would be to take advantage of the heavy casualties, send out troops to besiege and exterminate them all, seize territory, and so on.
The statement should not have been issued in any case. However, Jiang Ming could only suppress his thoughts because all Status of Liu Changkong, Old Tie, and Qing Fengzi explain nothing about the matter.
‘It’s about time for Long Yuan, the Yinmo Sect, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union to divide their territories. I’m afraid that they may attack my sect again!” Jiang Ming pondered and checked on Zi Linglong again.
He was surprised to learn how lucky his Junior Sister was. As soon as she entered the God of Thunder Immortal Treasure, she had received great opportunities consecutively. She even had comprehended the Life-and-death Sambodha. Moreover, she found top-grade spiritual crystals, medicine king, Dao
Vessels, Para-Immortal weapons, etc.
She was indeed extraordinarily lucky.
At this moment, he saw a change in his Junior Sister’s Status that she had found a thunder pond. Thus, she was tempering her body with the liquified thunder’s power and comprehended Thunder Sambodha.
‘It’s time to prepare for any unforeseen circumstances!’ Jiang Ming thought and entered the Supreme Pagoda.
He had decided to stay in the Supreme Pagoda until he had a breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - Innate Saint Daoist Body, Jiang Ming’s Jealousy
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Innate Saint Daoist Body, Jiang Ming’s Jealousy
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 7
Honor:
Level 3: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special ability
Level 4: 6 stages record, 15 levels record
Level 7 corresponded to Primal Spirit Realm, and Jiang Ming had arrived at the fifth level of the pagoda.
He hadn’t attempted anything yet, and as soon as he arrived at the square, he found two people in front of him.
One of them was obviously a demon. He had two horns on top of his head, two wings at his back, and a tail that looked like a metal whip at his back. He was also clad in a dark demonic aura that would cause anyone who came close to him to have goosebumps bursting over their skins.
“This demonic aura…” Jiang Ming was stunned as he looked at the demon in front of him.
‘The demonic aura that this demon was exuding was even stronger than Qing Ming, an Extreme Path martial artist.
‘The person standing beside the demon was a young woman. She exuded a regal aura, her eyes were bright like stars, and her teeth were white like pearls. There was divine light swirling around her, and it made her look even more surreal.
She looked so adorable that she could melt everyone’s heart in a single glance.
It seemed to Jiang Ming that she was only 28 years old.
“Seems like we have a new companion!” The young girl’s chirpy voice rang out, pulling Jiang ming out of his reverie. She wiped up a smile and walked up to him. “Is this your first time here as well?”
‘As well? Is this the first time she comes to the Supreme Pagoda*’ Jiang Ming thought.
‘The young girl in front of him had an innocent look, but there was a probability that it was just a pretense. However, he figured that it was very unlikely, judging from his observation.
“Nope. I came up from the floor below.”
After replying to the young girl’s question, he opened up the Human Paths Record.
Name: Dongfang Chenxi
Race: Human
Gender: Woman
Cultivation Base: Primal Spirit realm.
Background: Daughter of Heavenly Emperor Dongfang from the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm
Relationship: 52
Innate Talent: Immortal (Innate Saint Daoist Body)
Status: Before she was born, her father had formed a plane inside of her. He extracted metal, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder, light, dark, space, and time, all eleven basic chains of laws from the mortal world, as well as the origin force of the plane world, and incorporated her body. After that, he
suppressed the Immortal Fetus with his great divine power and injected a vast amount of energy into the depths of her life. Had it not been for her just forming her Primal Spirit, and she was sealed, she should have been born straight as an immortal. She has started to train her willpower and special
abilities since she was young. She was given the Supreme Order when she was 28, and she came here.
Jiang Ming was so shocked that he did not know what he should comment on. In fact, he felt kind of jealous of her. After all, not only did she come from a great chiliocosm, but she had a plane inside of her before she was born. She had the Innate Saint Daoist Body, and she should have been an immortal
as soon as she was born. And now, she was given the Supreme Order.
“You came from below? That’s awesome! I’m Dongfang Chenxu. What’s your name?”
“Tm Jiang Ming.”
“ll call you Brother Jiang then! What do you think?”
“That’d be my pleasure.”
“Can you tell me more about here?”
“Sure,” Jiang Ming replied, grinning from ear to ear.
He took out a couch, a bottle of wine, and a home theater set. He turned it on and played the music.
“Wow! What are these things?” Dongfang Chenxi asked as her eyes glowed up.
Jiang Ming then explained them to her one by one while serving food and wine.
On the Human Paths Record, their relationship increased, and after an hour, the number had become 75.
“This is great.’
As for the demon at the side, Jiang Ming knew he came from another plane as well. He had a 10-star innate talent, and from here, Jiang Ming knew that all of them were immortals for those with 10 stars or above innate talent.
“Brother Jiang, do you think I should attempt the Heavenly Battle Stage or the Heavenly Ladder first?” Dongfang Chenxi asked.
“I think you should try the Heavenly Ladder first. It will put your willpower to the test, and you can know your limit even better,” Jiang Ming said.
“alright, then. The Heavenly Ladder it is!”
Dongfang Chenxi headed toward the Heavenly Ladder.
While Jiang Ming was following behind her, he commented inwardly, ‘What an innocent little girl. If she goes to my world, she’ll certainly get cheated.’
“Brother Jiang, I’ll be going now,” Dongfang Chenxi said. After that, she stepped onto the stairs that were made from white jade. However, she seemed unaffected as she climbed up one step after another with ease.
‘The comer of Jiang Ming’s lips twitched.
This was the fifth level of the Supreme Pagoda. It corresponded to Level 7 cultivation or the Primal Spirit Realm.
‘The first few steps of the Heavenly Ladder required the willpower of an Extreme Path martial artist. However, Dongfang Chenxi did not fret at all.
Soon, she had arrived at the ninth level.
Just when she stepped onto the tenth level, she froze for a second. Then, she turned her head around and shouted at Jiang Ming, “Brother Jiang, I started to feel something here!”
“Good job! Keep it up!” Jiang Ming responded though he chided inwardly, ‘She only starts to feel something on the tenth level? If I’m not wrong, the tenth level corresponds to the willpower of an Imminent Immortal martial artist.’
Jiang Ming had an urge to get her down and beat her up.
If Luo Heng was here, he would certainly laugh at him. “Now you know how I felt!”
Even the demon looked at Dongfang Chenxi in surprise.
“Hold on for a second! I heard a voice! It says I can join the Supreme Chat Room!” Dongfang Chenxi shouted. “Anyway, I’ll keep going first. I’ll check the chat room later.”
“Alright, keep it up!”
“Okay!”
Dongfang Chenxi continued to move upward.
The 11th level, the 15th level, the 18th level.
She went up to the 18th level in one setting, and the 19th level corresponded to the willpower of a Level 11 martial artist.
‘When she stepped on the 19th level, Jiang Ming sighed inwardly.
‘She must be cheating!”
However, when Dongfang Chenxi stepped onto the 28th level, her figure trembled, and she fell down from the ladder.
“It’s getting harder and harder as I move upward,” Dongfang Chenxi said after she got up from the floor. She shook her head and continued. “I felt as if something had pierced through my mind. I couldn’t stand it and blacked out.”
‘The comer of Jiang Ming’s lips twitched.
“Brother Jiang, I got 999 points. It isn’t even 1,000. Does this mean that I failed?” Dongfang Chenxi asked.
Plop!
‘The demon dropped to the ground.
Jiang Ming raised his head and looked at the sky speechlessly. It took him quite a while to come around to his senses and reply. “I’ve come across some martial artists, and they couldn’t even get more than 10 points!”
“Really? How so? This Heavenly Ladder is easy. I didn’t feel any pressure at all,” Dongfang Chenxi replied, looking perplexed.
“Well, you should check out the chat room first,” Jiang Ming said. He felt that he needed some time to calm himself down first.
Dongfang Chenxi nodded.
In the Supreme Chat Room, Wang Ye and Feng Wu had already left. However, the number of members in the chat room remained the same after both Ye Qingxian and Luo Heng joined.
[Zhan Ge: Dongfang Chenxi? Judging from the name, you must be a cute and pretty little girl, right?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: So this is the chat room? Who are you? How do you know that I’ma little girl?]
[Ming Fei: You’ve exposed yourself, girl! How old are you, by the way? 30?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’m just 16!]
(Ming Fei: …]
[Zhan Ge: …]
[Luo Heng: You’re only 16, yet you’re already Level 7? This is incredible! Boss, you have a contender!]
Uiang Ming: I’m with her now!]
{Luo Heng:What? You’ve left? Do you not love me anymore?)
Uiang Ming: Get lost!]
[Ming Fei: Holy!]
[Zhan Ge: What!?]
[Ao Jiu: D*mn it!]
[Tian Fozi: Oh dear! She’s only 16. She’s already at Level 7, but she has the willpower of a Level 11, no… Level 12 martial artist? This is insane!]
Uiang Ming: Hey! Mind your language! Chenxi is still young. Anyway, if any of you is free, tell her the rules and how things run here.]
After that, Jiang Ming came out of the chat room.
‘As for Dongfang Chenxi, since this was the first time she came across something like this, she stayed in the chat room and talked with the rest of the people.
Jiang Ming champed his lips and went to the Heavenly Ladder.
He wanted to know how many levels he could reach this time.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven… eight… nine… ten.
He fell down from the ladder at the tenth level.
The tenth level corresponded to the willpower of an Imminent Immortal martial artist, and Jiang Ming failed.
He only got nine points in the end.
Afterward, he went to the Heavenly Battle Stage.
On the first stage, his opponents were two Paradis martial artists.
On the second stage, there were three.
On the third stage, he was matched up with four Paradis martial artists.
He cleared all three stages without any difficulty, and he came to the fourth stage.
His opponent this time was his old friend, Jun Sanqian.
“It’s you again.” Jun Sanqian smiled. He turned around and looked at Dongfang Chenxi.
“Do you know her?” Jiang Ming asked.
“You stinky brat. You’re so weak, just like an ant, yet you year for the stars,” Jun Sangian said. “Come. Let me see how much you’ve improved..”

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - The First Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: The First Law
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
It took Jiang Ming a lot of effort to defeat Jun Sangian.
‘When he got to the next stage, he ran into Jun Sangian, but this time, Jun Sangian was much stronger than he was in the previous stage. He was now in the middle level of the Extreme Path Realm, and Jiang Ming was defeated by him this time.
After Jiang Ming came up again, he did not start the battle this time. Instead, he looked at him and asked, “Senior, on the third level of the Supreme Pagoda, I could clear the sixth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage and reach very far in the Heavenly Ladder. However, as I become stronger, my results are
getting worse. I consider myself a genius, but why is the difference so big?”
“Simple,” Jun Sangian replied, “The higher the level, the difference between the realms will get bigger. When you get to the Extreme Path Realm, you’ll have the ability to control the law in the mortal world. The law is the origin of power, the foundation of the world, the core of all things. All powers are
bom from the law, so how are you going to fight against it? Honestly, it’s considered a miracle that you can clear the fifth stage with your background.”
“But I’ve improved a lot, and I’ve gotten many special abilities.”
“Well, you’re right. It’s true that you’ve comprehended many special abilities, and most of them are of supreme grade but don’t forget that you haven’t fully mastered them yet. You haven’t tapped into the utility of the laws, and although they seem to be powerful, in reality, they’re weak. The only reason
you can get past the fourth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage is due to your Primal Spirit and your vast amount of mana. Your reserve of mana is so huge that it even exceeds mine. You can also crush through everything with absolute force, but the force needs to be more than a hundred times, a thousand
times, or even ten thousand times in quantity to make it happen!”
“Lee. So what should I do next, senior?”
“Try to comprehend a law.”
“Is that even possible?”
“Why do you have so many questions? Are you going to fight or not?”
“There is no point in fighting. Senior, I’m going to comprehend a law now. If I can do it, will I be able to defeat you then?”
“Comprehending the law is just the basics. You need to know how to use it. If you can comprehend the law on the Heavenly Monuments and the Dao Monuments and form your own special ability, you can even crush through your opponent in the next stage!”
“So I go now, or should I wait until I’ve broken through?”
“The earlier, the better!”
“Thank you so much, senior!” Jiang Ming expressed his gratitude before going away.
Jun Sanqian nodded at him. He glanced at Dongfang Chenxi for one last time before vanishing into thin air.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 7
Point Accumulated: 491 points
Honor:
Level 3: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special abilities
Level 4: 6 stages record, 15 level records
Level 5: 4 stages record
He had gotten a total of 41 points, so he had 491 points in total right now. His achievement on the fifth level had been recorded in Honor, but it was nothing compared to his previous achievement in the third and fourth levels.
Apparently, he needed to clear at least four stages of the Heavenly Battle Stage and 10 levels of the Heavenly Ladder to be recorded in the honor.
Jiang Ming glanced at the demon. He noticed that there was a surprised expression on the demon’s face as he mumbled, “She’s new here, yet she has already got through the 28th level of the Heavenly Ladder? And now this young man over here has cleared the fourth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage.
How about me? I’m known to be a genius that only comes into existence every million years, and I’m destined to surpass the Demon Lord. Yet I stopped at the fifth level of the Heavenly Ladder, and it took me nearly all of my effort to defeat my opponent on the second stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage. If
T’ma genius, then what are they?
“am [really a genius?
“But they’re humans, the lowest level of all races!
“Is the Supreme Pagoda making fun of me, or I’m still dreaming?”
The demon asked himself.
Initially, Jiang Ming wanted to say hi to him, but his face sank when he heard his comment about humans.
The demon would be his first target if he could kill someone here.
“Brother Jiang! Why didn’t you tell me that you’re the group admin?” Dongfang Chenxi walked over, her eyes glowing with joy. “The chat room is so amazing. All of the people there come from different worlds. The Supreme Pagoda is so awesome! It seems even more powerful than my Dad!”
The demon was stunned again when he heard what Dongfang Chenxi had said.
‘All of the people there come from different worlds? Group admin? More powerful than her father? What the hell is she talking about? Just where did this girl come from? How can she compare her father to the Supreme Pagoda? And what on earth is a group admin?”
There were a lot of questions in his mind, but Jiang Ming and Dongfang Chenxi paid him no mind.
He wanted to join them, but his pride did not allow him to do so. He just pricked his ears and listened to their conversation.
“If [hadn’t come earlier, you might have become the group admin,” Jiang Ming laughed, “What do you think about those members in the chat room?”
They took their seats in front of the couch as they were talking.
He took out several packets of snacks and drinks that Luo Heng had given him.
There were a lot of them. The food and drinks Luo Heng had given him were more than enough to feed the people in a city.
Luo Heng had told him that the world he was in was filled with plenty of resources. As long as one could not die from eating, they could eat forever. Someone of his status could mobilize the resources in a galaxy with just one word.
“All of them are nice!” Dongfang Chenxi replied, “I’ve heard from my father that there are plenty of different words outside. Although the warriors under his command have been conquering many different small chiliocosms, I don’t know much about them. But listening to them talk about the special
features of their world now is a real eye-opener for me.”
Jiang Ming lowered his head and scratched his nose.
‘Holy. Conquering many different small chiliocosms? Does this mean war?
“Then do you know there is any world after the great chiliocosms?” Jiang Ming asked.
“I think there is, but I don’t know much about it,” Dongfang Chenxi said. “But I do know that there are plenty of planes, middle and small chiliocosms below a great chiliocosm.”
“So what’s outside the great chiliocosm?”
“Chaos, of course!
“I think it’s chaos.”
Jiang Ming had a basic grasp of the universe now.
Dongfang Chenxi continued to talk to him as she seemed to be very curious about everything,
Jiang Ming pointed at the Heavenly Battle Stage and asked, “Do you want to try that?”
“Battle stage? Well, it seems boring. I guess I’ll wait.”
“How about trying to comprehend some special abilities?” He pointed at the Million Dao Chart.
“Honestly, I hate cultivation the most. I can only sit there and do nothing when I’m cultivating. It’s so boring!”
“Well, you’re free to do whatever you want. As long as you’re happy.” Jiang Ming was speechless.
“Brother Jiang, since you’re the group admin, do you know if there’s a feature that could bring us to another world?” Dongfang Chenxi asked, “How good it would be if we 3can travel to another world. When we feel bored, we can go on a vacation in another world!”
“That’s a good idea…” Jiang Ming said as he fell into contemplation.
Judging from how the Supreme Pagoda could bring people into the pagoda with ease, it shouldn’t be a problem for it to bring them to another world.
“Maybe we could in the future,” Jiang Ming said.
As they continued to talk to each other, Jiang Ming had a basic understanding of the girl in front of him.
Due to her status, her parents were worried about her very much, so she had been living in a very small social circle.
She seemed to have a happy and worry-free life. In fact, she was like a canary that was locked up in a cage.
‘Lyearn for your worry-free life, and you admire my freedom!”
The phrase popped up in Jiang Ming’s head.
It seemed to him that every being in this world had something to worry about themselves.
After a short while, Dongfang Chenxi returned to the chat room. As for Jiang Ming, he walked toward the Heavenly Monuments.
He looked around, and then he walked toward the Wood Heavenly Monument.
‘Wood represented vitality. It was the origin of all life.
Jiang Ming came to the monument and sat down.
At the same time, a voice rang out in his ear, telling him that one point would be deducted for every hour that passed.
He lifted his head and closed his eyes.
There seemed to be many layers within the Wood Heavenly Monument, and each layer represented a corresponding Dao. In order to get through one layer, one needed to have a strong willpower and comprehend the previous layer completely.
“It seems like we need to have strong willpower to comprehend the Dao in the heavenly monument,” Jiang Ming said to himself.
After all, how could one be able to master a Dao if they did not have a strong willpower?
Soon, he arrived at a spacious area. It was filled with a rich amount of vitality, and he felt as if he was inside the real Wood Dao. There were fragments swimming and drifting around like fishes.
Suddenly, he seemed to have seen chains in front of him.
“Is that… the fragment of law? The chain of law?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
Without wasting any second, he threw himself into the space in front of him. It was also at this moment that he felt an endless stream of Wood Law entering his body, enhancing both his mind and body.
His mana surged, his willpower and even his physical body had become stronger.
“I’ve finally comprehended the basics of the Wood Law!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
It had only been three hours.
Although he could only comprehend the basics, it was already considered a big improvement for him.
He could sense that his willpower and physical body had become much stronger.
What if he could comprehend the Wood Law? What if he could comprehend all 3,000 laws?
Jiang Ming dared not to think about what he would be able to achieve at that time..

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - Changes in 300 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Changes in 300 Years
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Supreme Pagoda was indeed a place filled with opportunities.
It took Jiang Ming four days to comprehend the Wood Law to 30%. As a result, his willpower, Primal Spirit, mana, physical body, and so on had improved by leaps and bounds.
When he tried to proceed, he found out that it had become a lot harder for him to make any advancement. At this moment, he understood that this was the limit of his current realm, and the only reason he could comprehend the Wood Law to 30% was due to the enhancement of the Wood Heavenly
Monument.
If he had not come to the Supreme Pagoda, it might take him more than 40 years to comprehend 30% of the Wood Law. For other people, they might need even more time.
Four days, 48 hours, and 48 points spent.
Jiang Ming knew it was time for him to stop. After all, the consumption was too big for him to continue.
Jiang Ming changed to another place, and this time he came to the Fire Heavenly Monument.
Time was flitting rapidly, and his points were going down fast.
After using up all his points, he came to the Million Dao Chart and began comprehending special abilities in the hope that he could replenish his points.
He would chat with Dongfang Chenxi from time to time, but she soon found it boring, so she returned to her own world in the end.
Since they could still contact each other through the Supreme Chat Room, Jiang Ming was not worried about her losing contact with him as well.
In the blink of an eye, 300 years had passed.
Jiang Ming stood up from the Chaos Dao Monument.
“It has only been 20 or so years since I was reborn, but I’ve used 300 years in cultivation this time!”
He was surprised.
He paced around on the platform and slowly calmed himself down.
He looked around, and a surge of emotion rose from the depth of his heart.
‘Three hundred years had passed. Compared to the past, although his level of cultivation remained the same, his combat power had increased by a lot.
‘Wood, fire, earth, metal, water, wind, thunder, light, dark, space, time, reincarnation, decimation, karma, unlimited, sword, illusion, and so on, he had comprehended all of them to 30%
As for those high-level Daos such as Five Elemental, Yin-Yang, Life-and-Death, Dark-and-Light, True Illusion, Space-Time, it was harder to master them, so he had only comprehended 10% of them.
As for Chaos, well, he did not want to talk about it.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 7.
Accumulated Point: 81 points
Honor:
Level 3: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special abilities
Level 4: 6 stages record, 15 levels records
Level 5: 4 stages record, 68,672 units of special abilities
Jiang Ming glanced through his information inside of the Supreme Pagoda. He had only 81 points left, but he had comprehended more than 60,000 types of special abilities.
This was also the reason he still had some points left.
“Let’s go to the Heavenly Battle Stage and the Heavenly Ladder to see how far I can go,” Jiang Ming said as his eyes glowed with unfounded confidence.
Even if he was matched up to Dongfang Chenxi, he also had the confidence to defeat her.
Suddenly, he noticed someone from a distance. Jiang Ming squinted his eyes, and he broke into a smile when he saw who the person was.
“Brother Luo, congratulations on reaching the fifth level!” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
‘The person was none other than Luo Heng.
“Brother Jiang? I didn’t expect you to be here still!” Luo Heng shouted, “I’m so happy to see you. Let’s have a feast!”
“Haha, sure!”
After they took their seats, Luo Heng placed all the dishes and wine on the table.
There were a total of 810 dishes on the table.
“Are you sure we’re going to finish all of them?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with shock, “By the way, all of them are high-quality.”
“This is nothing!” Luo Heng replied, “I have the habit of storing several hundred thousands of dishes in my spatial ring. The food won’t go stale in the spatial ring as the time and temperature are frozen there. I can take them out to eat whenever I want, and besides, if I run into a friend like you, I can take
them out to serve them—anyway, feast on. Let me know if it’s not enough. I’ll get more.”
“This is really awesome!” Jiang Ming exclaimed as he gave Luo Heng a thumbs up.
“Well, this is the most I can do. Honestly, I’m much weaker than other members in the chat room. Perhaps I’m the weakest.” Luo Heng smiled bitterly. “Let’s put you and Dongfang Chenxi out of the equation. Even Ye Qingxian has become a lot stronger than me. We met at the third level, but she has
stepped into the sixth level and achieved Level 8 cultivation. As for me… Sigh, it took me double the effort and time to get where I’m right now! I’m really so pathetic!”
“As long as you have the heart and mindset to get stronger, you will get what you want in the end,” Jiang Ming said. “Just let me know if you need anything in the future. I’ll try my best to help.”
“Sure! Thank you so much, Brother Jiang!”
“also, if you face any problem or you don’t have the confidence of passing the trial at the higher level of the Supreme Pagoda, you can try to ask for advice from Ms. Dongfang.”
“Lhope that day won’t arrive!”
Both of them talked and finished all the 810 dishes.
Jiang Ming had a lot of fun, but when Luo Heng was going to bring out more of the dishes, he stopped him.
Both of them then came to the Heavenly Ladder.
“Do you want to try it, Brother Luo?”
“Tm not really fond of making a fool of myself, so I’ll pass. I’ll wait for your good results. As for now, I’ll comprehend some special abilities to earn some points!”
“Sure! I’ll be going now.”
“Lhope you can make me proud again!”
“Tm sure you will!”
Jiang Ming mounted the Heavenly Ladder and came to the ninth level in one setting.
Lifting his head, he looked upward and fell into silence.
Then, without any hesitation, he stepped onto the tenth level.
In the blink of an eye, he had already arrived at the 19th level. This level corresponded to the willpower of a Level 11 martial. Jiang Ming’s body trembled, and his face turned pale.
It took him quite a while to come around to his senses and continue to move forward.
Luo Heng, who was watching him from below, could do nothing but open his mouth wide in shock.
When Jiang Ming arrived at the 22nd level, his vision turned black, and he fell down.
“Brother Jiang, you truly are my idol!” Luo Heng said.
“Lonly come in second place,” Jiang Ming said as he pointed at the monument at the side. The first place was none other than Dongfang Chenxi, who had reached the 27th level.
“She’s a monster, so she doesn’t count!” Luo Heng shook his head.
Jiang Ming chuckled.
After recuperating, he came to the Heavenly Battle Stage.
He walked across the corridor and arrived at the first stage.
Bam!
He defeated two Paradis martial artists in two punches.
On the second stage, it took him three punches, and on the third stage, it took him only four punches.
“He’s also another monster!” Luo Heng exclaimed. “I wonder how many stages he can clear this time.”
On the fourth stage, Jun Sanqian appeared. He greeted him with a smile and said, “You’re finally here. Let me see how much you’ve improved.”
“You can’t see it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“It’d be meaningless if I could see through it,” Jun Sanqian said. He clenched his fist, and a sword appeared. A golden light swirled around his body as he said, “I’m going to use Earth Dao this time. How long do you think you need to defeat me?”
“T’ll try if I can defeat you with a punch!” Jiang Ming said, a devilish grin tugging at the corner of his lips.
“One punch?”
1
“yes! One punch!”
“Alright then!”
“Tve already seen it through, senior. Your cultivation level is equivalent to the early stage of Extreme Path on the fourth stage, and you wield about 30% of the power of the law. On the fifth stage, you’re at the middle stage of Extreme Path, and you wield 60% of the power of the law. Then, on the sixth
stage, you’ll be at the last stage of Extreme Path, and you’ve fully mastered all the power of the law. Am I right?”
“That’s right. Come, show me how much you’ve improved!”
“[ won’t let you down, senior!”
Jiang Ming did not pick any weapon this time. As soon as he finished speaking, his body began to grow, and in the next second, he had already become a titan.
His blood Qi surged and distorted the space.
This was the fifth level of the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation. He would grow up to 3,333 cm, and his strength would increase by 32 times.
“Unlimited Killing Punch: Sky Dawn!” Jiang Ming shouted as he threw a mighty punch at Jun Sangian.
“What a powerful punch!” Jun Sangian’s expression turned serious, and he activated his special ability. “Gravity Switch, Gravitational Vortex, Earth Sword Crush!”
He activated three special abilities with his sword.
Gravitational force appeared from thin air. Jiang Ming could feel a strong gravitational force on his limbs, his head, and his body.
As Jun Sanqian swiped his sword down, a yellow divine mountain appeared in the sky and descended on Jiang Ming.
‘They might have been defeated already if it were other people, but Jiang Ming was different. His body trembled, and he pulverized all of the attacks, including Jun Sangian in a punch.
“Lreally defeated him with a punch?”
Although Jiang Ming was confident that he would defeat Jun Sangian in a punch, he was still stunned by the result.
“If ‘d known it earlier, I wouldn’t have used the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation. I should try and see if I could defeat him with my own physical strength.”
He leaped and came to the fifth stage with that thought in mind.
“You really made it!” Jun Sangian exclaimed, “Seems like I won’t be able to defeat you at this stage as well.”
“Of course, you won’t be able to defeat me,” Jiang Ming said in confidence. “How many punches do you think I would need to defeat you, senior?”
“How many punches? Don’t look down on me!”
Let’s try then! Jiang Ming’s body grew large again, and this time, his body size had reached 6,666 cm in height, and his strength had increased by 64 times, “This is the maximum power I can use in my current state. Do you think you can stop it, senior?”
Bam!
Pfft!
Jun Sangian exploded!

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 3,000 Enchanted Realms
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: 3,000 Enchanted Realms
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation was evolved from the Three-fold Astral Transformation. There were six stages on the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation instead of three. Jiang Ming had conquered the sixth stage, and on the sixth stage, his body would reach 6,666 cm in height,
and his physical strength would be increased by 64, times.
He smashed right through Jun Sangian, who was in the middle stage of Extreme Path with a punch.
On the sixth stage of the Heavenly Battle Stage…
Jiang Ming deactivated the Physical Body Divine Astral Transformation, but he was still clad in an immense amount of Blood Qi. He looked at Jun Sangian and said embarrassingly, “Well, this is out of my expectatio!
The corner of Jun Sangian’s lips quivered. He really wanted to give Jiang Ming a good beating. He harrumphed and said, “I didn’t expect you to become so strong, That’s very good. If you can achieve the ninth stage of your special ability, no one in this world will be able to defeat you!”
“Thank you for your compliment, senior,” Jiang Ming said. “I’l continue to use this special ability of mine to fight you. Please give me guidance.”
“Sure!” Jun Sangian said. There was a weird smile playing around his lips. “I’m currently at the last stage of Extreme Path, and I’ve mastered two laws to perfection.
“Let’s do it!” Jun Sangian shouted, his voice echoing across the space.
“Sentience Law and Illusion Law, huh?” Jiang Ming mumbled.
At the same time, his body began to grow, and he had become 60 meters in height in the blink of an eye.
He wanted to seize this opportunity and see how strong his physical prowess could become.
“Sky Dawn!”
This was the first form of the Unlimited Killing Punch. The Akasa was distorted, and the immense force seemed to be able to crush everything in its path.
However, Jun Sangian did not even take a single step to dodge the attack.
suddenly, the area around him began to crack like a mirror.
“Mlusion isn’t real,” Jun Sangian said with his hand clasped behind his back, “Even if you can see through it, can you fight against it?”
“Ground Shattering Strike! Heaven and Earth Attack! Star Burst Strike!” Jiang Ming threw another few punches at Jun Sangian without saying anything. The battlefield spanned ten thousand miles in circumference. The stones were harder than the stones in reality, yet they still couldn’t escape the fate of
getting pulverized by Jiang Ming’s attack. Most parts of the battlefield were destroyed, and there were even huge and deep holes here and there.
“Your attacks are real, but I exist in the illusion,” Jun Sangian’s voice rang out again, “Even if you destroy the entire battlefield, you can’t land a single hit on me! This is the true power of the Illusion law! No other powers can even come close to it in terms of defense!”
“Really?” Jiang Ming smiled, “You’ve said before that the Physical Dao isn’t as simple as it seems. Do you really think I don’t have a plan after I know what the Illusion Dao is capable of? Take this! Shockwave Blow!” Jiang Ming shouted, and his Blood Qi surged like a tidal wave. It merged into the Akasa and
triggered the power of law.
A strange storm swept across the battlefield, and Jun Sanqian’s face turned grim. His body figure shook, and it seemed like his body was going to crumble.
Suddenly, his eyes glowed as he exclaimed, “You’ve infused your punches with your Blood Qi to force me out of my illusion and kill me? Impressive! You surely are a pack of surprises!”
At the same time, his body suddenly solidified. Like a reef in the sea, he remained standing still no matter how big the waves were.
“This is the Sentience Law!” Jiang Ming squinted his eyes. “Star Burst Strike!”
He delivered another punch at Jun Sanqian, and his body was distorted.
“This is cheating!” Jiang Ming commented.
“Haha!” Jun Sanqian laughed. “How can you call it cheating? It’s the perfect transformation between reality and illusion. I’m just changing my form in accordance with your attack!”
“Hmph! How about this, then? Exterminate Punch!” Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes and unleashed the strongest punch at Jun Sanqian.
This attack was known as the Exterminate Punch. It was even more fearsome than the Shockwave Blow. It could exterminate everything in its path, be it real or unreal.
This attack nearly defeated Jun Sanqian. He spurted out a mouthful of blood when he appeared at the other side. However, instead of getting stunned by Jiang Ming, his eyes were brimming with delight and excitement. “Incredible! This attack of yours is enough to defeat a normal Imminent Immortal
martial artist!”
“But I still couldn’t defeat you!” Jiang Ming said.
“The fact that you can injure me, who has mastered two laws to perfection, already proves that you are powerful!” Jun Sanqian replied. “It’s my turn now!
“Three Thousands Enchanted Realms, descend!” He waved his hand, and many worlds descended upon Jiang Ming. At the same time, his voice rang out around him. “This is a powerful special ability that I have developed after fusing the True Illusion Dao. If you can overcome it, it means that your Physical
Dao is impressive. Anyway, good luck, young man.”
In the next second, Jiang Ming found himself standing in a street of a town.
‘There were many people around him. Some of them were walking, while the others were hawking. There was a brothel beside him, and the girls were waving their handkerchiefs to attract their customers.
Everything here felt so real that it seemed like they truly existed.
However, Jiang Ming knew they were fake.
“Sir, do you want some pears? They’re very sweet, and they were just harvested this morning! Please get one! It costs only one coin for one!” A 10-year-old girl walked past him. She was holding a basket, and her eyes were filled with pleas.
Jiang Ming lowered his head and replied with a smile, “Alright. I’ll get one.”
“Really? Thank you so much, sir. I’ll get the biggest one for you!” The girl replied as she handed a big pear to Jiang Ming.
However, in the next second, the pear turned into sword energy and charged straight at Jiang Ming’s throat.
As if he had expected the attack, Jiang Ming raised his hand and shattered the sword energy in a swipe. At the same time, he sent the girl in front of him flying away. She landed on the ground several meters away with a meaty smack and died instantly.
The lively street suddenly fell quiet. All of them turned their heads to look at him, and one of them shouted, “Someone just got killed!”
“How dare you kill someone in broad daylight, not to mention that she’s just a little girl! Monster, you must be a monster!”
“Let’s bring him to the government office.”
People were starting to gather around him. Some of them even threw rotten eggs and vegetables at him.
Jiang Ming sighed.
Even if he knew none of these were real, he still felt bad getting reprimanded by these people.
Meanwhile, a dozen government officials appeared. They were holding a chain in their hands, and there were swords pinned to their waists.
As they dashed toward him, they shouted, “Scat! Scat! Where’s the criminal?”
The crowd all retreated to the side.
‘When the captain saw Jiang Ming, he was stunned. “Good grief, you are a good-looking man with an upright face, but who would have thought that you would be so evil-minded as to kill an unarmed little girl! Take him!”
Two people came up to him with a chain in their hands, and Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted. The chain was the chain of law. It was enchanted with the power of law, and it would be troublesome if he got chained down by it.
He flicked his finger, and the chain shattered.
“How could you!” The captain shouted, “Since you refuse to come with us, we have no choice but to kill you here!”
Swoosh!
All of them unsheathed their swords and charged at Jiang Ming.
Their movements were slow, but when they came close to him, he noticed that their swords were glowing, and it did not take him long to realize that it was the power of Extreme Path.
It went without saying that Jiang Ming wouldn’t just stand here and do nothing. He raised his arm and killed all of the government officials in one hit.
The street was filled with the stench of blood, and everyone fell silent once again.
In the next second, one of them shouted, “He’s a monster! We can’t let him go away! Let’s work together and take him down!”
Countless people came out of the shops or the brothel. Some of them were holding scissors while the others were holding shovels and sickles.
All of them pounced at him, and when Jiang Ming was about to leap into the air, he was unable to do so. His feet seemed to have cemented on the ground, and no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t peel his feet off the ground.
Leaving with no other choices, he raised his arms high in the air. Just when he was about to kill all of them, he saw a 13-years-old girl in front of him. She was holding a dagger in her hand, and her eyes were filled with hatred.
On his left was a young woman, who was charging at him with a pair of scissors. On his right was a little girl who pounced at his legs.
‘There were some old people throwing themselves at him as well.
Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat.
He did not take these attacks seriously, but when they got near him, their attacks were imbued with the power of law, which amplified their attacks to a shocking degree..

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - The Great Akasa Technique, Baring Ferociousness for the first time
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: The Great Akasa Technique, Baring Ferociousness for the first time
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming sighed softly, for he understood what Jun Sangian was trying to do by pitting him against 10,000 powerless mortals. Could he really bring himself to kill them?
He deduced that what he was facing should probably be the effect from the True Illusion Dao at its finest. These were all real living humans~at least that was what Jiang Ming was making of them.
Yet, could he really cut them down young girls, ladies, elderlies, and old farmers?
‘What was in front of him were rows of people with their lives in Jiang Ming’s hands. Could he set aside his morale and take away their lives?
“You are cold-blooded!” Jiang Ming smiled lightly as his gaze turned stone cold. “Trying to make me think this ‘reality’ of yours is actually real. Senior, don’t you think you are underestimating me too much?
“Heaven and Earth Attack!” Undeterred by the illusion, Jiang Ming launched the Heaven and Earth Attack technique, destroying the whole city, ripping apart the world he was in, all with a simple punch.
He felt a slight fluctuation in space only to realize he was now in the middle of a pool surrounded by alluring young women. The ladies were frolicking in the pool around him, giggling seductively, truly a heavenly melody to a man’s ear.
They were of many shapes and sizes, from the petite and voluptuous to the plump and mature. Some of them even had furry kitten ears or bunny ears, and there were even those who had snow-like fox tails on their backs. Taking a closer look, he noticed one of the ladies even had a pair of angelic wings
coming out of her creamy white back! Though each of them was unique, they had something in common. They were all ladies with faces that could launch a thousand ships!
A petite cat woman swam over to Jiang Ming, circling around him. “Hey there, handsome! I know 36 ways of the Kama Sutra, would you like to hear a song?”
Before Jiang Ming could react, another mermaid swam over from another direction. “Pick me! I know 72 of them!”
Jiang Ming could feel he was getting a nosebleed soon. Alluring ladies splashing around in the water? It was truly a sight to behold!
“Me too! Me too! Let’s all do it together!” More and more of them started swarming around Jiang Ming.
“This is truly men’s ultimate dream!” exclaimed Jiang Ming as he was getting agitated and was trying to suppress his urges. “Given the choice, I would really like to stay a few years or even 10,000 years here!”
Putting away his thoughts, he punched the whole illusion into smithereens, only to find himself resting on an enormous bed laid by hundreds of seductive women.
“Is there no end to this?” Jiang Ming howled, enraged. Licking his lips, he knew he could not allow this to continue any further.
“Three thousand domains! Did you just conjure 3,000 of these domains? I’ll just destroy every one of them then!”
“Inch Strength Thousand Punch!” As Jiang Ming leaped up into the air, his body started exploding with raw energy. He launched a thousand punches in every direction at speed so fast, it even created countless afterimages of himself.
Deafening explosions could be heard as he threw punches into the skies, penetrating the void, disintegrating the laws itself, and blasting through the chaos.
As each of these illusions was conjured, they were shattered one after another. In a glimpse of an eye, Jiang Ming found himself back at the Sixth Battle Stage.
“Inch Strength Thousand Punch, a skill fused with countless strands of mysterious energy. Alone, the punches didn’t account too much, but the combined force could destroy almost everything as they add up!” exclaimed Jun Sangian. His face was now pale white, and there was even a smudge of blood on the
side of his lips. He could not help himself from being amazed at the fact that Jiang Ming was able to launch so many different mysterious techniques by himself. It was truly an unimaginable feat!
“Senior, you were, however, a little less earnest. You even made me kill mere commoners, destroy cities, and take down worlds! That was quite cruel of you!” lamented Jiang Ming in contempt.
Jun Sangian wiped the blood off his mouth. “I did impart them some of my wisdom, but they weren’t real, were they? Is this considered cruel? You would go back to the real world and fight till the end among the experts of your cultivation realm. You’d inevitably bring carnage to tens of thousands of miles
around the battleground, and how many lives could’ve been living in that vast land? How many towns and cities could’ve been trampled as your battleground? Ever thought of that?”
Jiang Ming stayed quiet and never uttered a word. He looked back to when he killed Bai Yu, the Holy Son from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. Both Bai Yu and he hadn’t been as strong as they were now, but with so many special abilities launched unhesitantly, how many lives had been caught up in the
mishap?
‘When he had taken down the Bishui Sect, how many innocent lives were taken?
The time he had attempted to kill Tian Ci and even brought upon those of the Imminent Immortals, How big was the aftermath from the battle? How many lives got caught up then?
He had taken on both Qing Fengzi and Qing Xuzi using the Combat Mannequin not long ago, and the battle stretched over millions of miles. Though he had tried to negate as much damage and casualties, how many innocent people were dragged into the turmoil?
In the name of protecting his Junior Sister, Jiang Ming had secretly instigated the Qingyun Sect, Yinmo Sect, Bishui Sect, and many more. All of them had resulted in a big battle that shook Eastern Region, costing the lives of billions. Yet, this had never gone through Jiang Ming’s mind.
‘Deep inside, could I have been cold-blooded all along?’ As Jiang Ming started to assess himself, the thought sent chills down his spine.
Jun Sangian only smiled and continued preaching. “There’s no right or wrong walking along the path of the Dao. Everything revolves around yourself. If you think it’s the right thing to do, then it is. Similarly, if you think you’re wrong, then you are. The road toward immortality is a long and winding one. The
laws of Dao take no shape. The road ahead is a road paved with millions and millions of corpses through bloodshed and carnage. Nevertheless, do you know what it was that led to this?”
“Power cannot be fully controlled!” Jiang Ming blurted.
“Indeed!” exclaimed Jun Sangian as he flung his sleeves to the back of his body and continued. “The inability to truly control power is the root of all chaos. Be it the demons, devils, Buddha, or the immortals. The truth is that every one of them is selfish and egocentric! Without anything to control the powers
they possess, those with power will take reign, and lives would only be worth or so meager to them, let alone the powerless. This is the true nature of the infinite worlds; the cultivation of the Great Dao is a cruel, ruthless path.”
“Can’t power ever be controlled?” Jiang Ming retorted, seemingly unwilling to accept it as it is.
“Of course it can! Take your world, for example. If an Imminent Immortal steps up and creates the rules to follow, will the others acknowledge them? Of course not! They’d even be killed! Why? Because there isn’t any power that could overwhelm anything and everything.
“When a peerless warrior whose power overwhelmed all in their era, a person who could bring down judgment to anyone does emerge, they will be the one to set the rules. Yet who will be the one to control him? Maybe a group of such peerless experts could band up and create a faction to set the rules. But the
question remains! Who will be the one to control them then?”
“How can it be controlled then?” Jiang Ming was confused by what Jun Sanqian had just said, contradicting himself.
