“Well, if there’s a being who could not only overwhelm all but also be selfless and magnanimous, then total control can be realized,” Jun Sanqian explained patiently.
“Is there such an existence? A selfless and benevolent existence. One who can be impartial to all?” questioned Jiang Ming.
“Well, why isn’t there? Isn’t the Great Dao that existence?” Jun Sanqian retorted.
The simple answer rendered Jiang Ming speechless, and Jun Sangian continued. “The Great Dao treats all as equals. It doesn’t matter if you are good or bad, the world still exists by revolving around the rules of the Great Dao. For example, every living thing goes through the cycle of birth, growth, prosperity,
old age, and the inevitable death. What makes it cruel is that there are no morals or laws in this cycle and that everything has to go through that natural order.”
His answer rendered Jiang Ming speechless.
“Alright, enough of that. As the living thing, it doesn’t matter where you stand. What’s important is to stand firm on your duty or heart, know your limits and your own conscience. Those will be enough,” added Jun Sangian.
‘Own heart, limits, and conscience… Thank you for the enlightenment!” Jiang Ming repeated these three phrases before he took a bow and thanked him.
“Prepare yourself. Let’s finish up this fight of ours,” exclaimed Jun Sangian once again, preparing himself for the fight.
“Sure,” Jiang Ming replied before launching his attack.
Seeing the attack from Jiang Ming, Jun Sangian had an energy outburst, conjuring numerous illusionary images of himself, and gave Jiang Ming a hard time.
After a long battle, Jiang Ming was finally able to kill off all the illusions as he finally ascended up the 7th Battle Stage.
Upon reaching the 7th Battle Stage, Jiang Ming was caught off guard to see that his opponent was Jun Sangian once again. This time, however, there was not one, but two of them simultaneously!
“Haha! Didn’t expect this, did you?” The one in a Daoist robe standing on the left laughed.
“Of course the kid’s surprised!” The other one clad in black, standing on the right, smirked.
“Not at all,” Jiang Ming replied with a smile. ‘When I was at the Paradis Realm, I had to face up to two to four opponents. The Extreme Path Realm should be similar, shouldn’t it?”
Apart from their clothing, both of them looked strangely identical to each other.
“You are right. I possessed the Yin-yang Dao.” The Jun Sangian in the Daoist robe nodded. 1
“While I possessed the Reincarnation Dao, ” said the other Jun Sangian in black.
“Bring it on, senior. Though I’m giving it all I’ve got this time!” exclaimed Jiang Ming enthusiastically. “Great Akasa Technique, Gates of the Infinite Realms!”
As he swayed along, numerous gates emerged one after another out of the void, each with a figure of Jiang Ming in the gates. All of the gates gave off the same aura and were all densely scattered throughout, yet each of them seemed to be in an alternate space of their own.
This technique was conjured using his mastery in the cultivation of the Dao of Spatial. The technique was a combination of the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, the Great Akasa Steps, Great Akasa Divine Hand, and many more, merging into the mysterious spatial techniques, Great Akasa Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - Time Dao: The Great Millennium Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Time Dao: The Great Millennium Technique
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming had fought against Ye Ming from the Tianyuan School before. He was an Extreme Path expert who had the Space Illusion God Body and had already mastered the Spatial Dao to its pinnacle.
Ye Ming performed the Akasa Gate Technique before.
As Jiang Ming started his cultivation in the Spatial Law, he had followed his instinct and was able to reproduce the same technique. Although his Akasa Gate Technique was not as strong as Ye Ming’s, it was still a formidable technique.
“Great Akasa Sword Technique!” Jiang Ming brandished the Pseudo Immortal longsword that he had chosen from that level.
“sword imposing the Universe, slashing through the vastness and destroying Yin-Yang!” As Jiang Ming launched his attack, each doppelganger in the Akasa Gates also launched a slash simultaneously. Never-ending streams of light could be seen from the slashes while its overwhelming intensity locked
the space in place as the attacks ceaselessly came from all corners.
‘The black-clad Jun Sangian dashed around in the air, forming one black hole after another, engulfing all the slashes. The slashes then emerged from another black hole reflecting back at Jiang Ming with an even stronger force. This was the specialty of the Reincarnation Dao.
“yin-Yang Execution!” Jun Sangian in Daoist robe evoked the power of Yin-Yang, molding it into a formidable attack, and took down Jiang Ming’s Akasa Gates one after another in the meantime.
Their first exchange of attacks ended in just a glimpse.
“Great Five Elemental Technique!
“Five Elemental Imprisonment, forming an eternal prison!
“ive Elemental Great Grinder, obliterating the living!
“Five Elemental Sword Luminous, slashing the heavens and Earth!”
Jiang Ming howled and continued on with a barrage of attacks. His mana surged violently, interacting with the orders of power and evoking numerous terrifying special abilities. The blinding lights produced dawned over the area, illuminating all.
The Great Five Elemental Technique was a special ability that he had invented by fusing various Five Elemental special Aabilities and the Five Elemental Laws into one. He had an ambition that one day when the Great Five Elemental Technique was performed, the five laws of elements within the heavens
and earth would be in his total control.
Luo Heng was staring at the whole battle above the sky atop the plaza with his eyes wide open in shock. “Is this even the same Level 7 as mine? Why do I feel so hopelessly weak against Brother Jiang? I’d be dead in seconds if he wanted to kill me!” Luo Heng muttered.
“Lknow he is a genius, but I’m not so shabby myself! How can there be such a big difference?” Luo Heng started to become flabbergasted. He knew he could hardly fare against Jiang Ming, but he had his own ego and the will never to admit defeat. Even if the gaps were big, he had the confidence to chase
after him and close the gap. Watching the fight today, Luo Heng seriously questioned if he could keep up with Jiang Ming.
“Oh my heart, my ego, they’re all shattered! I really can’t take this! I have to admit, those countless special abilities are just terrifyingly strong! Did he comprehend every one of the Heavenly and Dao Monument?” Luo Heng wondered to himself.
“That’s the Great Five Elemental Technique! And that’s the Reincarnation Dao! My god, that slash attack’s insane destructive power! Could it be that’s the Demolition Dao?” The more Luo Heng watched, the more agitated he got.
On the battle stage
Jiang Ming clenched his fist, and a drop of fresh blood could be seen in his palm. “Cursed Killer Technique!” Jiang Ming let out a loud how as his eyes began to erupt with divine lights, followed by gray lights flowing out and then fusing into the blood droplet.
Woosh!
The black-clad Jun Sangian shivered and saw numerous runes on his wounds appearing out of nowhere. The runes sunk into his body, covering his entire body instantly as his lifeline collapsed drastically. Had he not negated the Reincarnation Law’s damage, he would have already turned into puddles of
blood.
“Light-and-Dark Great Enhancement!” Jiang Ming quickly launched the Light-and-Dark Dao to form a confined territory onto the Daoist-robed Jun Sangian when he saw him trying to come to his aid.
At the same time, a clone could be seen emerging from his body, launching the Light-and-Dark Annihilation Sword Slash onto the black-robed Jun Sanqian.
The confinement territory collapsed onto the Daoist-robed Jun Sangiang with a grip of his hand.
“Great Catastrophes Technique! Disasters of the Wind, Fire, Flood, Natural, Thunder, Inner Demon! Reign down! Die!” As he unsheathed his sword performing the Great Catastrophes Technique, boundless power of catastrophes surged onward, obliterating the Daoist-robed Jun Sangian who had just
escaped from the confinement territory’s collapsed void.
Having defeated the duo, Jiang Ming moved up to the 8th Battle Stage.
A white-clad Jun Sangian could be seen standing on the battle stage. “Great special abilities coupled with great tactics. Conjuring the Five Elementals Yin-Yang, Light-and-Dark Reincarnation like the back of your hands. Your comprehension of Daos is outstanding! Your ambitions surprise even me!” The
white-clad Jun Sangian was amazed.
He was obviously a master of the Light Dao as white lights could be seen radiating all over his body in ordered strands.
To his left was the Jun Sangian in black, mastering the Dark Dao, whereas the one to his right was a purple-clad Jun Sangian, a master of the Lightning Dao.
“How can I defeat you if I didn’t possess these special abilities?” Jiang Ming asked rhetorically, not in a hurry to make any moves.
“True enough! Comprehending different laws helps to temper and sublimate your soul, Primordial Spirit, mana, and flesh and allows your cultivation base to reach an unimaginable height. What you are showing here is actually another act of breaking through numerous laws in a different form. Come on,
let’s go at it again!” invited Jun Sanqian as he nodded to Jiang Ming’s question.
“Senior, please!” The battle broke out again. It was a sheer collision of special ability, the true interpretation of their powers. Jiang Ming had to go all out before he managed to go through to the next level.
On top of the 9th Battle Stage, there were four Jun Sangian this time, each with their own mastery of different Daos.
“Tm afraid it will be too hard for you to go past this level. Being the defender of the stage, every one of me has mastered a kind of Dao to the extreme, possessing the strongest special ability in the world. When placed in the mortal world of the heavens and the world, you can say that we are peerless
geniuses that emerge even thousands of years. It’s not a problem for any one of us to take on a normal Imminent Immortal, yet you are now facing four of us at the same time! One of us even mastered the Spatial Dao.”
“How would we know if we haven’t tried? I have two more of my strongest special abilities up my sleeves!” Jiang Ming was still confident in himself but perked up to the max. He agreed with what Jun Sangian just mentioned.
Overlooking the mortal worlds, only a few had grasped the top-grade Daos, and their special abilities were only subpar. However, the Jun Sangian here was an existence that had almost reached the pinnacle in the same realm.
If Jiang Ming had only comprehended one type of Dao, he wouldn’t have been able to get past the 6th level, let alone the 9th level. However, he was still worried about facing Jun Sangian, who had mastered the Spatial Dao.
“Truly ambitious! Bring it on then!” exclaimed Jun Sangian with a longsword ready in his hands as his aura shot through the skies, billowing his clothes.
“Okay!” With a short answer, Jiang Ming immediately launched his attack.
He did not hold back and showed all of the strength of his physiques coupled with the mysteries of his different special abilities.
With Jiang Ming’s ability to conjure special abilities smoothly like the back of his hands, many other different dao techniques such as Fire, Earth, Gold, Five elementals, Yin-Yang, Catastrophes, Light-and-Dark, Reincarnation, Unlimited Killing Punch, and Karma were launched in a barrage at Jun
Sangian.
The boundless strength was truly baffling, yet Jiang Ming was still at a disadvantage.
Luo Heng, the sole person spectating the whole battle, had his jaws dropped throughout, appalled by the ongoing battle.
“Goodness gracious, the 9th level had four guardians simultaneously, and there’s even one who mastered the Spatial Dao! How can anyone fight this? Simply looking at it makes my head go numb and gives my heart a tremor! Meanwhile, this made Brother Jiang seem to be even more terrifying! With his
current combat power, he can easily kill those normal Level 10 experts in the outside world for sure!” exclaimed Luo Heng as his eyes gleamed uncontrollably.
He was not only spectating the whole battle but was also absorbing whatever experience he could get to use as his own, particularly their utilization of Laws and execution of special abilities, which amazed him.
On the battle stage.
“The Heavenly Ladder in the Supreme Pagoda uses the strongest of the experts as the bench line to test a person’s willpower. The same applies to the Heavenly Battle Stage! Both of them are testing a person with a benchmark of one type of the top-grade Daos. The truth was, however, the benchmark has
not reached its true absolute pinnacle. The current me in this stage here has not completely mastered the true essence of the power of time or the mystery of spatial energy. However, the comprehension of Spatial Dao with the other three different Daos can be said to be a limit here already.” Jun Sangian’s
deafening voice could be heard.
A wound could be seen on Jiang Ming’s body as he backhand-palmed the sneaky attacker as he retorted, “What about the Chaos?”
Upon hearing ‘Chaos’, Jun Sangian laughed out loud and said, “The Chaos that you understand is not the real Chaos. I’m sure you’ve already figured out that the Chaos here is actually just the fusion of many different Daos. One such example is the Five Elemental Dao being the fusion of Gold, Wood, Water,
Fire, and Earth!”
“Then what about the true real chaos?” Jiang Ming continued asking.
“You are getting too ambitious, little fellow! If you still don’t show those tricks up your sleeves, then you will be defeated! Spatial Imprisonment!” As soon as Jun Sangian howled, the space suddenly froze.
Jiang Ming’s body was frozen in place. He discovered countless chains running through space, blocking off every direction and locking in his body. The chains imprisoned heavens and earth, turning the place into a standstill.
Although he could not move a muscle, his thoughts were still running as it was not the power of time. Jiang Ming did not panic because he had expected this much.
Thunderous rumbling could suddenly be heard.
The bones in his body trembled as his muscles contracted. Blood started rushing violently through his vein, and a terrifying force exploded from his body. The boundless mana energy became in sync with the sudden outburst of energy, causing his outburst to reach its peak. He abruptly shook the space,
distorted the laws, and broke out of the confinement.
Jun Sangjan’s attack was already almost on him as he escaped the confinement.
“Great Body Protection Technique!” Jiang Ming shouted. As he evoked the defensive special ability’s power, waves of different Dao energy were dispersed and started to entangle together to form a colorful light barrier brimming with various types of Dao energy.
‘What he performed was a type of powerful defensive technique he deduced.
At the same time, his body started to grow bigger as he became a 60-meter-tall giant.
Boom!
Jun Sangjan’ss attack landed directly on Jiang Ming arduously trying to break through his defensive technique while four swords tips stabbed onto his chest and his back, inching forward.
The Great Body Protection Technique was Jiang Ming’s first line of defense, while his own body was the second.
Jiang Ming didn’t resist at all as he waved the longsword up from below, sending a slash toward the Spatial Dao expert Jun Sangian as he howled, “The Great Millennium Technique, Solitary Dessert!”
It was like a rippling of smoke through the vast desert.
‘What Jun Sangian saw was a line of smoke rising straight up into the boundless sky, into the scarlet sunset. Yet what the smoke he saw was actually the longsword blade, while the sunset was just the dazzle from the sword’s light.
“This is the power of time! The attack can only be blocked with the Time Dao or forcibly withstood using the origin of life with my real body! If I cannot block this, then death is inevitable! Under the influence of the power of time, even a person’s cycle of thought can be stopped.” As this thought raced
through Jun Sangian, the sword had already split him into two, destroying its Primal Spirit..

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - The Finishing Blow
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: The Finishing Blow
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was victorious, standing in the middle of the 9th Battle Stage.
Although his body was tattered with his left arm cut off and extremely serious injuries, he recovered to his original state in just a blink of an eye.
‘Tcouldn’t have passed this level if I did not have the Time special ability,’ Jiang Ming thought. The Solitary Desert was only the first form of special ability in the Great Millennial Technique. It distorted time, slowing down the surrounding timeline but did not affect himself in the process.
The power of time could be said to be almost unparalleled.
Jiang Ming tured swiftly, reaching the 10th level of the Battle Stage.
Once again, Jun Sangian appeared before him. “Never had I expected that you’d reach the 1oth level. Honestly, the 9th level of the Battle Stage is more terrifying than the 10th level in some ways.” Jun Sangian looked at Jiang Ming with amazement written all over his face.
“I’s only because I’ve comprehended the power of time. That’s all there is.” Jiang Ming explained as he chose a sword for the battle, which was still a Pseudo Immortal Weapon.
“Through the countless worlds, there are only a few special beings with the exception of being able to comprehend the Time Dao. It’s just too difficult otherwise. If you put it in a certain way, the power of time is actually considered taboo. Who would’ve thought that you have not only been able to step foot
into the rudimentary stage of time but also managed to perform the time’s special ability of Time? You are truly amazing!” Jun Sangian was astonished.
“There are only three ways to break free from the power of time. One, to master the Time Dao itself and fight fire with fire. Two, to have enough strength to withstand the erosion of the power of time. The third is to have a high enough cultivation base to suppress the power of time.” Jun Sangian
continued explaining.
“Can an Imminent Immortal expert suppress the power of time?” Jiang Ming asked.
“That depends how strong the Imminent Immortal is.” Jun Sangian smiled, turning his sword over, and pointed at the ground. “Go ahead. You might be able to reach the 12th level.!”
“Okay!” Jiang Ming responded before raising his hand to evoke the Five Elemental Great Grinder. The five-elemental power started its circulation, crushing and destroying anything it touched. The construction and deconstruction relation between the five elements made the attack extremely difficult to
defend from.
However, it only took Jun Sangian a simple flick to form a sword slash that dispersed the Five Elemental Great Grinder’s attack. He continued slashing the longsword, creating 81 sword qi slashes, with each slash able to rip through the void, cutting down the laws in its path.
However many special abilities Jiang Ming threw at Jun Sangian, the latter dispersed the attacks easily with a simple slash that could even cut through the void.
“The Level 10 is akin to the Imminent Immortal Realm in your world. When a person reaches the Imminent Immortal Realm, their Primal Spirit, mana, and physiques will be enlightened to a whole new level, and the essence of the very person will be enhanced with the characteristics of an Immortal.
“The Extreme Path Realm is the limit among the human realm, whereas the Imminent Immortal Realm surpasses the human limits. An ounce of the Imminent Immortal’s mana is akin to ten ounces of that of the Extreme Path’s. However, the destructive power that it possesses multiplies by a
hundred-fold and even has the ability to break down infinite laws,” Jun Sangian explained to Jiang Ming.
The Imminent Immortal Realm was not just your normal level of power.
Jiang Ming did not give in and continued throwing millions of special abilities at Jun Sangian, but the exchanges only ended up in a draw. He just couldn’t defeat Jun Sangian.
“Solitary Desert!” Jiang Ming had to reluctantly use the time special ability to cut down Jun Sangian.
Moving on to the next level, the Jun Sangian in the 11th Battle Stage also possessed the mastery of Time Dao in addition to an immense increase in his defense by using the Yin-Yang Dao as his protective measure. Jiang Ming could only break through his defensive barrier but was not able to cut him down
in one slash. Killing him again was getting harder.
Evoking the same ‘Solitary Desert’ technique, Jiang Ming looked for an opening and launched the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique at Jun Sangian. As Jiang Ming’s finger met Jun Sangian’s body, he was able to break through the Yin-Yang Dao’s seemingly impenetrable defensive barrier, leaving a
hole in his forehead.
The technique accumulated infinite laws into a finger, giving it the ability to penetrate anything and decimating any power of laws.
As he ascended onto the 12th Battle Stage, Jiang Ming again evoked the same Retum of Infinite Law Finger technique.
“Such a fearful special ability cumulating infinite laws into a single finger! Your technique is still not fully developed. Once you are able to merge 3,000 laws into one, this technique will then be overwhelmingly strong and can penetrate anything and everything, Your technique here has an infinite amount
of potential. Cultivate it carefully, little boy,” Jun Sangian of the 12th Battle Stage gave his advice before said technique cut him down.
‘When Jiang Ming reached the 13th Battle Stage, this time, there were two Jun Sangian on the stage. Jiang Ming was able to kill one of them but was killed off instantly by the other.
Defeated at the 13th Battle Stage, Jiang Ming did not hesitate and went back to the same level again to greet the 13th level’s Jun Sangian.
Upon seeing Jiang Ming’s return, he asked, “Do you know what caused you to be defeated?”
“Senior, your current state has the power to overwhelm me completely. However, with my defensive techniques and peerless physiques, can I really not take on even a single attack?” Jiang Ming questioned sincerely.
“Well, of course, the current you cannot withstand my attack. I am at the pinnacle of the Imminent Immortal Realm, possessing infinite different special abilities.” Jun Sangian laughed before he added, “I am unable to fend off your Time Law’s attack, which gave you the chance to kill me. However, if you
can kill me, so can I. It comes down to whoever finds the opening first. When you retum to the world and fight against an Imminent Immortal expert, never give them any chances and directly take their lives. Of course, the typical Imminent Immortal expert back in your world wouldn’t be as strong as I
am.”
“Thanks to your guidance, I have the experience now. If I face any opponent, I will be sure to kill them with a single strike!” Jiang Ming thanked Jun Sanqian profusely for his guidance.
Jiang Ming’s reply brought a big smile to Jun Sanqian’s face. Slowly, his face turned solemn, and he stared at Jiang Ming, asking, “You are of the human race. What will you do when you return to reality and discover millions and millions of humans were slaughtered, enslaved, or kept in captivity?”
Jiang Ming’s expression turned solemn, and he suddenly turned silent upon hearing the question.
Jun Sanqian continued asking, ” If you were part of the cause that led to these happenings, what would you do? Do you have the ability to deal with this? Once you make a move, there’s a risk of getting killed yourself!”
Startled by the question, Jiang Ming remained in silence, but he understood that Jun Sanian should be referring to the current predicament of Eastern Region in Jiang Ming’s world.
Humans were now being slaughtered as one of the aftermaths of the big war.
What about slavery and captivity? It might happen as well!
Although most devils were humans before, most of them had already lost their humanity. Moreover, there were many devils of the other demonic races who were truly the real devils.
‘Then there was the Sea Clan to consider. Once they dominated most of Eastern Region’s domain, their next step would surely be world domination!
How would their domination be? To the demonic race, humans were considered food, whereas the devils saw humans as means for them to breed parasites.
‘Lwanted to keep a low profile. However, to protect my Junior Sister and maintain peace, I’ve unknowingly killed off so many enemies. This has directly led to Eastern Region’s great war, causing calamity and chaos!
‘Was it my fault? No! Of course, it wasn’t! If they wanted to take down my Junior Sister, how could I not kill them?
‘Without the ability to protect then, I can only silently watch the demons and devils terrorizing my human race. But now that I have the ability to save them, what should I do? Born a human, die a human…” Jiang Ming pondered for a very long time before laughing at himself.
He took a swift glance at his Status before taking a bow and leaving the Battle Stage.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 7
Accumulated Points: 991 Points (81+399+511)
Honors:
Level 3: 6 stages record, 21 levels, 992 units of special abilities
Level 4: 6 stages record, 15 levels
Level 5: 9 stages record, 21 levels, 68,672 units of special abilities
1
Jiang Ming’s accumulated points had skyrocketed, reaching the thousand-mark
There were slight changes to his Status, but the numbers were still considered the extremes to the others.
“Brother Jiang, are you even a human?” Luo Heng paced over to meet up with him with his face still in shock. This time, Luo Heng was getting numb from amazement. He could not even dream that someone would be able to get a 9-stage record, yet that person was standing in front of him now.
“Tm not sure if you are mocking me or praising me here.” Jiang Ming cleared his thoughts and smiled back at Luo Hong. He took out two jars of wine and threw one over to Luo Heng. As he opened the jar, he started chugging down the whole jar.
“Brother Jiang, take it easy! This is the Fire of the Nine Heavens wine. It has a huge kick to it!” Luo Heng tried to warn him.
“Satisfaction!” Jiang Ming howled as he exhaled an alcoholic breath. The breath turned into flames, yet its sweetness was exceedingly rich. “This is what men should drink!” he exclaimed as he took another jar and started to chug down again. The flames of the alcohol slowly burned away his feelings of
depression.
“Are you even a man? Why do I not see it?” Luo Heng took a glance below.
“You can try and turn into a lady. I’ll let you see how much of a man I am,” retorted Jiang Ming as he grinned at Luo Heng.
Luo Heng’s body tightened uncontrollably, and he took a step back instantly. “I know a guy in my world. With his immense capability, he occasionally restructures his own cells, changing his appearance as well as his gender. He kills any man or woman and even lusts for both genders! He is so strong that
he cultivated a secret technique. The technique allowed him to cut off a part of himself to be used to reconstruct another clone to have an insightful sexual relationship with himself!” Luo Heng gasped.
“Holy! There’s even something so perverted?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“Well, the people back in my place are not that rigid and respect the so-called freedom of gender. Anything is possible! It stains not only the souls but also burns a person’s eyes!” Luo Heng continued.
“Have you seen it with your own eyes?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.
“Absolutely not! Brother Jiang, don’t tell me you want to watch this? Would you like me to find some material for you?” Luo Heng snickered.
“My heart is pure, and I’m straight.” Jiang Ming stated firmly.
“Your heart might be, but that doesn’t mean your eyes are,” Luo Heng commented.
“That kind of makes sense,” Jiang Ming muttered.
‘The two went on chattering for quite some time.
Adjusting himself, Jiang Ming looked around the surroundings and said goodbye to Luo Heng.
High above the Chuyang Peak, the lunar moon dimly illuminated the infinite stars in the skies.
Jiang Ming stood atop his roof and gazed into the night. He noticed the vast lands of Eastern Region were still shrouded indefinitely by the evil spirit’s aura. Due to the intense bloodbath, a dense bloody aura could be seen oozing and permeating into the skies.
Indistinctly, it felt as if endless innocent souls were grieving with curses.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh softly. He flipped through the Human Path Records and noticed no changes to his Junior Sister’s Status.
However, when he looked over at the Status of the Chuyang Peak’s First Seat, he raised an eyebrow, and a monstrous, murderous intent could be felt radiating from his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - The Sun Falling, Jiuyang Sect’s Real Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: The Sun Falling, Jiuyang Sect’s Real Secret
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Primal Spirit Realm
Cultivation Method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
special abilities: Great Akasa Technique, Great Body Protection Technique, Great Catastrophe Technique, Great Five Elemental Technique, Great Yin-Yang Technique, Great Light-and-Dark Technique, Great Reincarnation Technique, Great True Illusion Technique, Great Karma Technique, Great Demolition
Technique, Great Akasa Sword Technique, Great Boundless Technique, Great Millennium Technique, Great Clone Technique, Great Divine Seal Technique, Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Unlimited Killing Punch, Astral Transformation, Return of Infinite Law Finger…
Innate Talent: Immortal (Secondary Daoist Body)
Items: Human Path Records, Supreme Order
[Immortal Weapon: Mystical Light Sword, Heavenly War Blade, Heavenly Feathered Shirt, Celestial Soul Clock, Starry Hall, And Heavenly Ark]
[Para-Immortal Weapon: Soaring Feathered Sword, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk]
[Supreme-grade Dao Vessel: Mana Sealing Chessboard, Combat Mannequin]
[High-grade Dao Vessel: Dark Abyss Sword, Vessel White Jaded Sparring Gloves]
[Special Ability Bead, 100 years of Cultivation, Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card]
Support: Primary Training Zone
There were a lot of changes to Jiang Ming’s Status in the record.
After 300 years of cultivation in the Supreme Pagoda, many of his special abilities were integrated and classified, forming a series of different abilities, One of them included the skill Great Akasa Technique, which included special abilities, such as Formless Sword Qi, Akasa Steps, Teleportation, Divine Hand,
Movement, Infinite Realm Gateway, and many more.
Although there were no changes to his Innate Talent, his Physique, however, has reached the Secondary Daoist Body. This metamorphosis was the result of his cultivation of various laws.
Given the current strength of his physique, Jiang Ming was confident he could even arm wrestle with the Imminent Immortal experts of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, who specialized in body training.
After seeing no other changes, Jiang Ming now had a clearer understanding of his Status.
As he lay down onto the rattan chair, he called up the Human Path Records.
Status of Zhiyang Peak First Seat, Yue Cheng:
Just received orders to recheck the Jiuyang Sect’s internal condition to see if there is anyone whose cultivation base is superior to Huo Daoren. He is also to investigate whether the annihilation of the platoon led by the Holy Daughter to attack the Jiuyang Sect before the Great Eastern Region War broke loose
has to do with Jiuyang Sect. He needs to report back in 10 days’ time, and there will be another attack on the Jiuyang Sect in a month’s time.
‘My God, not again! Is there no end to this?
‘It’s just the Great Eastern Region War. Now that the Qingyun Sect has retreated, wouldn’t it be easier just to inform the Jiuyang Sect to submit directly? Why do we still have to destroy them? Now that the Holy Son and Holy Daughter have been killed, does that mean I will be the next?
‘Was it easy for me? Living in fear, living in torment, and even my conscience has long been eaten by dogs. We’ve ended up failing not once but twice already, and now we are prepping up for the third? F*ck this, I’m turning neurotic already!
‘Damn it! You kept asking me to work but never gave me anything in return! I’m already the First Seat, and I might even become the Sect Master in the future! Can’t you just give me some herbs, medicinal pills, or even some rare medicine king? That way, I can directly bring up my cultivation base into the
Primal Spirit Realm and take another step closer toward the Paradis Realm! That way, I will naturally become the strongest in the sect already! Why go through all these troubles?
‘Just arrange a lucky encounter for me, or send me some Dao Vessels or Immortal Weapons! It’s just that easy.
‘Darn, these imbeciles just want to dry me up!
‘If we still lose this time, I’ll… I’l just tell the Sect Master about myself and become a double agent! That way, I’ll have something to retreat to!
‘Why oh why is my life so miserably difficult!?”
Jiang Ming remained expressionless after reading through the Status, but in his mind, he had marked a big red cross onto the Yinmo Sect.
He suddenly disappeared from his seat with a slight thought and reappeared on Zhiyang Peak. Many disciples were seen mostly cultivating as they breathed in and out the essence of heaven and earth, causing the surroundings to sparkle with bright holy light. A few of them were training their spells to
improve their combat power further.
In addition to Yue Cheng, who was in the Dao Seed Realm, there were many other Elders, particularly the two among them who were also of the Dao Seed Realm, which was considered quite good for the sect.
They were considered personnel of the higher tier in the Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming easily crept into the main hall where Yue Cheng was at. With a swift glance, he could sense everything around and noticed there were no special arrangements or traps set.
At that time, Yue Cheng was pacing back and forth in the main hall with his brows frowning full of worries while he kept sighing in despair.
“With such feeble power of mine, I couldn’t even make any drastic changes. What else can I do but follow wherever the flow takes me? Dear God!” Yue Cheng gritted his teeth.
suddenly, an invisible aura fluctuation appeared out of nowhere, shrouding the whole hall. Reality and illusions began to intertwine, forming an illusory domain. Yue Cheng was shocked and horrified to discover that the roof above his head had now disappeared and what was above him was a sea of
auspicious clouds. Countless knights in golden armor could be seen standing in a crowd above the clouds, each of them with the strength to easily annihilate him.
Leading them was a man sitting atop a 1,000-meter-tall throne, surrounded by fairies dancing around as 3,000 spell lights could be seen circling his entire body.
He gave off a feeling of might, strength, holiness, and divinity!
“Yue Cheng! As the peerless existence atop the king’s throne suddenly spoke, his voice was like deafening thunder to his ears, striking his heart, dispersing his mana, and crushing his will. Yue Cheng could feel an endless heaviness descending onto his body, causing him to kneel down involuntarily.
He was trembling in fear, not daring to move or even raise his head, let alone trying to resist.
“Lam the Supreme entity of the Hao Tian Golden Tower, the Supreme Natural Mira’s true Jade Emperor God!” the entity bellowed. “Traveling through the infinite worlds today, I had a sudden feeling crossing this world and chose to descend here, discovering that you not only act as the Jiuyang Sect’s First Seat
but also as the Yinmo Sect’s Elder. You have been bestowed much greatness by this sect, yet the Yinmo Sect forces you to launch their third attack to annihilate Jiuyang Sect!
“This place here is one of the 129,600,000 places in which I’ve endured mortal calamities and will not tolerate anyone trying to defile my place!
“Open up your mind and let me see through your past!” As the entity’s voice bellowed, countless thunders were accumulating in the sky above. It was as if the dragons were emerging with the cries of the fire phoenixes, the roars of the white tiger, and the roaming of the black tortoise.
‘The terrifying force crashing down caused Yue Cheng’s heart to tremble as his mind started to succumb.
“Hao Tian? God? Heavens! Is this the real Immortal? No wonder the Yinmo Sect has to keep scheming! No wonder the Jiuyang Sect has been inexplicably turning corners!” Yue Cheng shivered, not daring to resist at all.
He even realized that he couldn’t even lose his voice.
Sitting atop the throne, Jiang Ming started to smile as he evoked the Primal Spirit Soul Spell and entered Yue Cheng’s mind with ease, peeking into his past memories.
Yue Cheng did not resist one bit.
Upon looking into his past, Jiang Ming suddenly frowned as his murderous intent soared but was finally calmed down. Using the Primal Spirit Soul Spell, he erased the current moment of his memory.
The auspicious clouds disappeared along with the warriors in golden armor as the main hall reverted as if nothing ever happened.
Yue Cheng, who was kneeling in the middle of the hall, suddenly shivered as his eyes were filled with confusion.
‘Why am I kneeling? Why am I drenched? Shit, I even had an incontinent? What happened here? Yue Cheng was terrified as he started to sense his surroundings, yet he could not find anything out of place.
‘Could it be the thought that after I’ve done all those bad deeds, I will end up miserably in the future and now starting to be afraid? thought Yue Cheng as he started imagination various torture techniques, such as tongue-pulling, getting fried in hot oil, or getting crush by the big mill.
“Haih!” Yue Cheng sighed inexplicably as he shivered yet again. “If I really suffered those punishments… Why is my life so difficult!?”
Standing on top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming looked up into the sky. He had learned a lot from peeking into Yue Cheng’s memory.
Yue Cheng was the culprit for the Senior Brother’s accident at Chuyang Peak. He had caused the peak to fall into chaos so that he could easily climb up to the First Seat position.
He had joined the Jiuyang Sect when he was young. With the Yinmo Sect secretly providing him a small number of medicinal pills, his cultivation base skyrocketed until he was able to become the First Seat for one of the sect’s peaks.
As the Yinmo Sect had yet to have a use for him in the past, Yue Cheng had been quietly accumulating and managing his own influence.
‘T guess I’ll let you be for now. You are still more or less useful to me,’ Jiang Ming thought.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record to check on Xue Yin.
Name: Xue Yin
Race: Human-devil (Possess the Sky Devil Bloodline)
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Paradis Realm
Background: The Yinmo Sect’s Sect Master
Relationship: -60
Innate Talent: Immortal (Pseudo Sky Devil Body)
Status: Since birth, he had had the signs of being a Sky Devil. With his extremely high aptitude, his cultivation progressed by leaps and bound to the point that challenging those of a higher realm that he was, were considered a norm to him, He had beaten the Holy Son and forcefully replaced him. When he
was only at the Primal Spirit Realm, he defeated the previous Yinmo Sect’s Sect Master and became the Sect Master with the support of many Supreme Elders!
He has a wild ambition to unify the six diabolical sects and revive the might of the Sky Devil.
Once he became the Sect Master, he spread around many spies, which was when Yue Cheng joined the Yinmo Sect. Due to his bloodline, he saw fragments of memories showing the sun falling in the Jiuyang Sect, where many Immortals were buried.
He is always scheming onto the Jiuyang Sect. In order not to look suspicious and let others find clues about his actions, he did not take special precautions but continued his effort scheming against Eastern Region little by little, believing the Jiuyang Sect would naturally fall into his hands.
Failing twice to take down the Jiuyang sect, even his sect’s Holy Son, Holy Daughter, and several Paradis experts were killed. This made him realize that the Jiuyang Sect wasn’t as simple as it may seem.
‘The Eastern Region’s war was bound to be won, so he only watched from the sidelines. As expected, the Qingyun Sect retreated in defeat but was unfortunately not completely destroyed because of the various support from several Zhong Province’s Sacred Lands.
After the war, the Yinmo Sect obtained Qing Province, Shui Province, and Hai Province. Long Yuan obtained Yu Province and Mu Province, while the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union ruled over Lei Province and Wu Province.
‘Til let them be happy for the meantime. When I’m free, I will annihilate all of you.
‘The current plan nowis to take down the Jiuyang Sect, yet many strange things are going around over there.’
He remembered placing Yue Cheng as a spy and ordered him to investigate more, even though he expected that Yue Cheng wouldn’t be able to discover anything. Whatever it was, he planned to take down the Jiuyang Sect first and continue concentrating on his cultivation to improve his cultivation base!
Jiang Ming had found out about Xue Yin’s name from Yue Cheng.
He was oblivious before this, but Jiang Ming could not help but grin once he found out.
‘The sun falling? Immortal experts getting buried? And the memories even came from the Sky Devil bloodline?’
Jiang Ming leaped up and stood in the air as his eyes started to gleam. Lights of thousands of laws started accumulating in his eyes as he started to see through everything, penetrating any illusions..

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - Devil King Xue Wujiu, Terrifying Father and Son
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Devil King Xue Wujiu, Terrifying Father and Son
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In Shui Province, vast mountains were stretching up to 180,000 miles.
The Yinmo Sect had always been hiding under the many mountains here and even opened up a Devil Domain below.
Xue Yin was sitting in the main hall, outlining his next action.
“We will test the water of the Jiuyang Sect in a month. If our people are still killed, I’m afraid those old ones will realize that something’s up. That’ll be the chance to send another old guy over!
“This month, our sect will be taking over the three provinces and eliminating everyone who stands against us. I’ve accumulated enough cultivation years and have already stepped into the pathway toward the Dark Law. I will take this time to try and break through to the Extreme Path Realm. By that time,
Til further stimulate my Sky Devil Bloodline… Hahaha!’ As Xue Yin thought about what he was about to achieve, he could not help himself standing up and laughing aloud.
“Who is it?” Xue Yin asked as he saw a person suddenly appear right before him.
He was indeed the Yinmo Sect Master—his reaction was extremely fast as he quickly conjured a piece of top-grade Dao Vessel battle armor when he realized someone was near him.
It was Jiang Ming’s clone projected out of the Human Path Records! As he suddenly appeared right before Xue Yin, he evoked the Immortal Weapon Mysterious Light Sword and launched the Great Akasa Sword Technique slash onto Xue Yin. The sword attack disintegrated the armor on his body and
slashed his head in half. He eventually exploded into mists of blood.
A feeble Paradis expert was easily slaughtered like a farm animal.
However, Jiang Ming only frowned as he noticed a red line emerging from the mists of blood. The red line started twisting rapidly and tumed into a bloody human figure as an angry howl resounded. “How dare you kill my host? Die!”
While a red flash was shot directly at Jiang Ming’s forehead, Jiang Ming merely lifted his eyebrow as he evoked the Great Akasa Formless Sword Qi, concentrating the slash into a sharp blade and breaking the attack.
A strong, invincible force could be felt crushing down the void with a swift flick, confining from all directions and freezing the area around the bloody human figure, followed by the Mysterious Light Sword slashing onto his body.
Unexpectedly, the bloody figure suddenly twisted, and it was able to go through Jiang Ming’s confinement spell.
“Such a feeble insect! Yet you dare to kill me? Since you’ve killed my host, I’l just have to use you as my new host!” the bloody figure howled as he speedily leaped toward Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank as he saw the bloody figure launch itself at him. It was in a state where it was in the middle of reality and illusions, unable to be stopped by time or tampered with by laws. It was truly a high-level technique.
“Solitary Desert!” Jiang Ming’s sword slash was so powerful that a vast desert was conjured out of nothing, and smoke from the flames slowly rose into the sky, forming a pillar with the sunset dyeing the surroundings sky scarlet red. Yet hidden in this seemingly mesmerizing picturesque scenery was
endless killing intent.
The bloody figure suddenly paused as it was annihilated by the Mysterious Light Sword, dispersing into nothingness. The pent-up suppressive force crushing down on him suddenly erupted, blowing the main hall into smithereens.
Jiang Ming skimmed through the Human Path Records, and his pupils shrunk as he noticed waves of bright light far away were trying to seal off the entire area. He even felt a peerless expert locking on him and rushing over with strong weaponry. Jiang Ming disappeared into thin air with a swift tum.
Right after Jiang Ming disappeared, an elderly appeared right where he had been standing and projected his vast mana sweeping the whole surrounding, He tried to detect the intruder with his spiritual sense but to no avail.
“We’ve already sealed off the space here, and yet he was able to escape just like that? Even if that being has mastered the Time Dao, it wouldn’t be possible for him to escape so easily! Who is he, and why did he kill the Sect Master? Other than Sect Master and that being’s presence, I can feel another hidden
presence that brought shivers to my soul as if it is naturally suppressing me at my core! The great war has just ended, and many old friends have fallen. Now, something like this happens! It’s so troublesome!” Numerous thoughts raced through the elderly’s mind.
Not only had that person snuck into the sect’s main hall undetected and killed the Sect Master, but he also escaped right before his nose! That person’s ability truly made his heart skip a beat!
Atop Chuyang Peak, the clone that Jiang Ming had evoked using half of his mana came back through the Human Path Records and fused into Jiang Ming’s body as he let out a soft turbid breath.
He quickly put his focus on the Human Path Records and checked.
Name: Xue Wujiu
Race: Sky Devil
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Paradis Realm
Background: A wisp of the Devil King’s consciousness
Relationship: 0 (-99)
Innate Talent: Immortal
Status: A long time ago, the Devil King once accumulated nine bloodline seeds and brought them into the Tianyuan Continent, waiting for the destined people to merge with them and become a carrier that could be nurtured into. Once the carrier stepped into the Extreme Path Realm, the consciousness
fused in the bloodline would be awakened and forcefully transform the carrier into one of his doppelgangers!
Bloodline seeds could be inherited.
Over the past, seven bloodline seeds had been completely destroyed.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He never expected that killing a mere Paradis expert would bring such a terrifying existence to the surface and a Devil King at that!
He suddenly felt helpless as there was still another bloodline seed that was not discovered yet, and it might pose a hidden threat in the future.
‘With the descent of the Devil King into this human realm, there must be a huge secret hidden in this world!”
It was a shame that the given information about the Devil King was very little.
‘I’s just a Devil King, right? If he comes, I’ll just kill him!” Jiang Ming gave himself some encouragement.
The Relationship column was very weird. The value 0 meant that the person could not detect him, but the value -99 meant that once he found out about Jiang Ming, that person would kill him without any hesitation.
Jiang Ming shook his head as he thought about Xue Yin. However ambitious he was, he was merely one of the chess pieces in the end.
Even if he wasn’t killed today, he would be consumed and taken over by the Devil King in the future. A truly awful tragedy.
“That’s what people mean when they say that fate is unpredictable!” Jiang Ming sighed softly.
Jiang Ming flipped the Human Path Records again, and this time it was a person that was seen by his clone.
Name: Luo Shali
Race: Xiuluo
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Imminent Immortal Realm
Background: The only surviving Immortal Realm expert of the Yinmo Sect (Was the disciple of the Xiuluomo Sect)
Relationship: 0
Innate talent: Immortal (Xiuluo Body)
Status: The illegitimate child of the Xiuluomo Sect’s Holy Son, who has wild ambitions. Hence he placed his son to stay undercover in the Yinmo Sect to scheme for the future.
With his strong bloodline coupled with the various arrangements from his father, he grew rapidly and became the Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect in less than 100 years. He then slowly grew, took over the Sect Master’s position before abdicating, and cultivated into the Imminent Immortal Realm, becoming
one of Yinmo Sect’s strongest triumph cards.
His father once told him that their Xiuluo bloodline could cultivate evil spirits and use fresh blood to strengthen their bodies. The more lives they killed, the stronger they could get. They schemed together in the dark, slowly encouraging the six devil sects to resurface and eliminate the Fo Sect of Western
Region and pulling Long Yuan and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union into their accomplices.
After their plans were a success, they allied with the Million Demons Mountains and launched attacks onto Zhong Province, bringing down bloodshed into the world, strengthening their Xiuluo Body to rise when they ascended in the future quickly.
“We won the Eastern Region war, and the Qingyun Sect retreated in defeat. However, the Yinmo Sect suffered heavy casualties and had no choice but to take some time to recover.
“A few days ago, I discussed with Long Ri and Xiao Jingyun about dividing the territories. Long Ri said their Sea Clan will take rivers as their core habitat and lands as their food suppliers, raising humans in captivity. Meanwhile, Xiao Jingyun suggested turning territories into a place to breed parasites,
encouraging everyone to kill each other to nurture disciples quickly. Thus, I have the thought of massacring 1/3 of the human populations of Qing Province, Shui Province, and Hai Province by turning them into food stock for my cultivation to help me reach the pinnacle of Imminent Immortal Realm and
forge the Immortal Xiuluo Body.
‘Just when I was thinking about how to convince Xue Yin into this, there was a sudden incident, and the Sect Master was killed.’
Upon reading Luo Shali’s Status, Jiang Ming’s brows tingled violently while his heart oozed with killing intent.
“Raising humans as food stock? Breed parasites? Massacring 1/3 of the three provinces’ human population?” as Jing Ming muttered, he could not help but tremble. He even felt a trace of fear.
The feeling when he observed the great war from afar, knowing that the commoners were in peril, was far different than when he took a closer look.
Jun Sangian’s questions on the battle stage in the Supreme Pagoda had made him question himself.
Now that he had seen the Status of Luo Shali from the Human Path Records, how bloody Luo Shali’s malice was, and the sheer number of lives at stake, caused his heart to be in tremor.
He could come up with many excuses, but he could never change the fact that the calamity raining upon Eastern Region was directly related to him.
“actually just wanted to protect my Junior Sister!” Jiang Ming grabbed his hair in distress.
“Since you won’t let me be at ease, I will have to kill you all!” Jiang Ming suddenly raised his head, gazing at the stars as his face turned grim.
He took a deep breath to calm his restless emotion. When he calmed himself, he thought of something strange.
Never would he have thought that this Supreme Elder belonged to the Xiuluomo Sect. A father and son duo scheming, pulling the strings in the dark, and initiating such a calamity.
Who would have thought of this?
If it weren’t for the Human Path Records, Jiang Ming was afraid that he would not even dare to have thought about it.
The Yinmo Sect, which was even akin to a Sacred Land, was taken over by some undercover agents.
This was even more outrageous than Yue Cheng being the Jiuyang Sect’s First Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - Don’t Let Me Know Your Name
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Don’t Let Me Know Your Name
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
If Jiang Ming was not happy about them, he would just have to kill all of them. Since he had made up his mind, it was time for him to make his move.
However, before he started to do anything, he had to make some preparations first.
He closed his eyes and went into the chat room.
Uiang Ming: I need items that could quickly replenish Level 10 cultivation consumption, does anyone have them?]
[Ming Fei: I have it! In what form do you need?)
[Zi Lei: I have some too. Will supreme-grade spiritual fluid work for you?)
(Tian Fozi: I have a Buddha Lotus with me here. One piece can replenish all the consumption of Level 10 and also heal the wounds.)
{Luo Heng: Brother Jiang, I can get them for you. How much do you need?)
[Ye Qingxian: I have some too. Just let me know!]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang, only Level 10? I have a lot of them. The lowest spiritual item in my garden is higher than Level 10. Oh yeah, I nearly forgot about it. I have a mountain with me that is inlaid with many, many small pearls. They are spiritual pearls, and one of them is equivalent to a small
lake of quasi-spiritual fluid.]
Everyone suddenly fell silent.
At the Heavenly God Small World.
‘As the daughter of the Divine Emperor, Ming Fei was eating Chalcedony as she figured she should prepare something for her group admin to cotton up with him.
She had many spiritual items that could replenish the Level 10 cultivation.
“Now that Feng Wu and Wang Ye are gone, no one in the group can come close to me in terms of wealth.
“Luo Heng? It’s true that the world he resides in is strange and filled with many resources, but his level is too low.
“Ao Jiu? I doubt he has the habit of storing any items. He’s just a perverted stupid dragon.
“Tian Fozi? He’s from the Fo Sect, so nope.
“Dongfang Chenxi? Well, she’s the only one who’s better than me, but she’s just a little girl. I don’t think she would have the guts to speak out when so many people are around.
“This is a good chance for me to earn some points from the group admin so that I can comprehend more special abilities!”
With that thought in mind, many spiritual items appeared before her. However, when she saw Dongfang Chenxi’s message, she was stunned.
She cracked the spoon in her hand and pressed her lips tight.
“What a spoiled little girl!”
She then stored the stuff in front of her.
Yes.
She wasn’t angry. She wasn’t angry at all.
[Dongfang Chenxi: Let me see. I have a total of 36,000 pearls here. But all of them are too low in level, so I don’t think it’s nice to give them to you, Brother Jiang. How about I give you some top-grade immortal fluid too?)
Nobody in the group knew what to say.
Uiang Ming: My cultivation level isn’t that high yet, so high-level items have no use for me. Just give me a spiritual pearl. It will do.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Alright then! If anyone bullies you, let me know. I’ll give you some powerful weapons to defend yourself! ]
Uiang Ming: Sure! I’ll surely contact you if anything happens.)
[Dongfang Chenxi: That’s right! You’re the group admin, and won’t it make us bad if we don’t help you when you run into trouble? Anyway, I’ve transferred the thing to you, Brother Jiang.]
Suddenly, a divine mountain about several hundred meters tall appeared in front of him—the aura it contained shook him to the core. A dense amount of Spiritual Qi erupted and swept across the entire Chuyang Peak, causing the cloud to appear and rain to fall.
“Holy!” Jiang Ming exclaimed. He quickly took the Heavenly Ark out and kept the divine mountain in it.
In the chat room.
Uiang Ming; Why did you give me the entire mountain!? How many points should I give you back?}
[Dongfang Chenxi: Well, those have no use for me at all. Besides, I’m looking for a better one. You don’t have to give me any points.]
Uiang Ming: Alright, then! Thank you so much, Chenxi. You really are the prettiest and kindest girl I’ve ever met.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe, don’t mention it!]
Jiang Ming returned to the real world after chatting with the other group members for a while.
“She’s filthy rich! Well, it seems like having good parents is really important.
“But I wonder how I am going to pay her back in the future…”
He stopped all his thoughts and opened his mouth to absorb the Spiritual Qi. After that, he refined all of them into his mana.
Jiang Ming came to the Heavenly Ark. There was a space inside, and the mountain was there.
“This mountain is obviously a supreme-grade spiritual crystal. No… It should be a quasi-spiritual crystal!” Jiang Ming exclaimed, “Not only that but it’s inlaid with 36,000 spiritual pearls? And they are just for decoration purposes only?
“Sure enough, poverty has limited my imagination!”
Jiang Ming shook his head.
People always said that there wouldn’t be pain and despair if there wasn’t a comparison.
He had a system, the Human Paths Records, not to mention that he was also the group admin of the Supreme Chat Room. He was what people would say the winner in life, but it now seemed to him that his wealth was still no match for this mountain. Not only that, but it also seemed to him that
Dongfang Chenxi did not like this mountain at all.
Jiang Ming shook his head.
He calmed himself down and began looking at the mountain. He found these spirit beads arranged in the form of an array. It was not a powerful array, and it did not have any attribute. It was just a simple, normal array.
The mountain was the sky, while the pearls were the stars.
If he took one out, the array would be destroyed.
That being said, he still had other ways to do it.
He activated his mana and began absorbing Spiritual Qi from the mountain. The Spiritual Qi then condensed into liquid beads before him.
Soon, there were 100 of them in front of him.
Each of them could replenish 1/10 of his mana.
He looked at the mountain again and didn’t feel the slightest depletion.
“Everything has been laid. It’s time for some killing spree!”
Jiang Ming came out of the Heavenly Ark. He grabbed the air, and the ark shrunk before he stored it away.
The Human Paths Records appeared in front of him, and he located Luo Shali.
He lifted his head to look at the sky. It occurred to him that there was still some time before dawn.
His body began to glow, and eight doppelgangers appeared.
All of them had 1/10 of his mana.
Although they did not have a corporeal body, each and every one of them could use his special abilities.
“Gol”
Jiang Ming then sent all of them toward his target via the Human Paths Records, and his mana had reduced by 1/10.
This was the price he needed to pay.
He opened his mouth and devoured nine liquified spiritual pearls in one go to replenish his mana.
At the main body of the Yinmo Sect.
Nobody could come around from the fact that their Sect Master had been killed.
After Luo Shali had finished making arrangements, he returned to his palace and contemplated over it for a long time. However, he couldn’t get any idea, so he sat down in a lotus position and began refining his mana.
At the same time, he also tried to refine the blood and essence that he had collected.
Suddenly, his heart trembled.
He cracked his eyes open and saw eight figures around him. He was both startled and stunned. After all, the entire place was protected by an array, and the palace itself was a Dao Vessel. He couldn’t understand how they had managed to come in without anyone knowing about it.
Just when he was about to activate his special ability, sword energy appeared in front of him. He tried to evade it, but he found that his reaction speed had been slowed to a stop.
Pfft!
Ahuman figure slashed at him, while another activated the Return of Infinite Law Finger, piercing through his forehead and destroying his Primal Spirit.
Even though Luo Shali was an Imminent Immortal expert, he still couldn’t escape his fate of getting killed by Jiang Ming.
All eight human figures headed out of his room after collectivy his belongings.
“Great Catastrophes Technique: Million Catastrophes Descent!”
“Great Light Technique: Dispel!”
“Great Fire Technique: World of Inferno!”
“Great Lightning Technique: Heavenly Punishment of Thunder!”
Four of Jiang Ming’s doppelgangers activated four special abilities, and an intense light enveloped the entire demonic land.
‘The remaining four went to look for the four remaining Extreme Path martial artists. They changed their mana into a sword and activated the Great Millennium Technique, killing them before they could even react.
On Chuyang Peak, all eight of his doppelgangers returned with considerable loot. A smile appeared on the corner of Jiang Ming’s lips, and he heaved out a sigh of contentment.
“Once I know your name, you can’t escape from me!
“Long Ri? You’re next!”
Jiang Ming smiled coldly.
Tonight was a restless night.
In Shui Province, amongst the mountain ranges, the lair of the Yinmo Sect appeared, but it was blasted to pieces, and none of the people inside were still alive.
Many martial artists came to check it out, and all of them were stunned when they arrived at the place.
Yu Province, at the center of Daming Lake.
It was a huge lake, and it had become the temporary residence of Long Yuan before they invaded Eastern Region.
Long Ri, the Imminent Immortal martial artist, was one of them.
It was a lively and bustling scene in the hall, and all of the dishes were human meat.
The eight doppelgangers flew into a rage and killed Long Ri on the spot. Long Ri was a black dragon. He was powerful, but he stood no chance against Jiang Ming.
At around 5:00 a.m. in the morning, the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, where Xiao Jingyun was, was slaughtered as well.
A lot of the experts met their demise tonight, and most of them were from the Sea Clan.
‘They marched toward the land through the river after conquering Eastern Region. However, before they could harvest the fruit of victory, they were all killed.
Jiang Ming surmised he had killed more than a million sea beasts.
On Chuyang Peak, the eight doppelgangers returned to Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming looked toward the East Sea. He was certain he would exterminate every single one of them if they dared to set their foot on the land again.
Unfortunately, he killed them all too fast and too quickly, so he didn’t get to collect more information about Long Yuan.
“Will the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union still come?” he mumbled as he looked toward the west.
“Now, there are still the Five Paths of the Sky Devil left!”
Jiang Ming’s gaze was sharp as a sword.
‘The day was dawning, and the sun was showering its rays over the ground.
“Today is definitely a good day!”
Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh of relief and threw himself on the rattan chair. He was going to take a short nap.
However, unbeknownst to him, a terrifying storm was about to sweep through the entire world..

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - The Great Secret of Jiuyang, Hua Huo, Saint Province Dao Square
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: The Great Secret of Jiuyang, Hua Huo, Saint Province Dao Square
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At the Qingyun Sect
‘When Qing Fengzi returned, a myriad of emotions etched on his face. He seemed serious but at the same time joyful. There was also a hint of fear on his face, and he looked like he had the urge to laugh.
Soon, he came to the Elder Hall. There were a lot of powerful martial artists there. The atmosphere was tense, but he could smell a hint of trepidation from the air.
“Fengzi, what is going on out there?” An old man asked, “Could it be that they are fighting against each other?”
“Nope,” Qing Fengzi replied as he shook his head.
“Then what is it?” The old man harrumphed. “Stop beating around the bushes and get straight to the point!”
“Tm sorry, Martial Uncle. Please give me some time to calm down first,” Qing Fengzi said, laughing bitterly. After a short while, his expression became serious as he said, “The Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union have been destroyed!”
“Are you sure about that?” the old man asked.
The rest of the people also turned around and looked at Qing Fengzi suspiciously. They did not believe that the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union had been destroyed.
“Everyone that came to Eastern Region, be it demons or humans, all of them are dead!” Qing Fengzi continued after taking a deep breath. “I’ve been to Shui Province, the Daming Lake at Yu Province, and the residence of the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union in Lei Province. All of them are dead. The
bodies are either charred or burned to ashes.”
“How is that possible? Did the Tianyuan School summon powerhouses from the Sacred Land in Zhong Province and exterminate them?”
“Idon’t think so. This is because I did not encounter any other martial artists. I’ve contacted Old Tie from the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and Ye Ming from the Tianyuan School. They all told me that the Sacred Land of Zhong Province hadn’t made any move yet. They are just monitoring everything that is
going on here! I think you guys should go and see it for yourselves.”
“sure!”
All of them realized the gravity of the situation and headed out of the Elder Hall.
On this day, the remaining forces in Eastern Region were exclaiming in joy.
The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and the Tianyuan School from Zhong Province, the Million Demons Mountain from Southern Region, the Five Paths of the Sky Devil from Western Region, and Fo Sect were both dumbfounded and stunned. They were wondering who the person was that destroyed the
Eastern Region Alliance without taking over Eastern Region. After all, there were only a handful of forces in this world, yet none of them had made any move.
This made them feel even more suspicious, and many of them even came to Eastern Region in secret to see things for themselves.
At the Jiuyang Sect, on Chuyang Peak.
The glow of the sun sprayed on Jiang Ming. It was so warm that it felt as if his Junior Sister was holding his hand.
Jiang Ming opened his eyes and stretched his body.
It was a good nap.
He then looked toward Taiyang Peak. There was a Taiyang God Lake behind the mountain, where Zi Linglong had cultivated there before, and 10,000 meters below the lake, on top of the spatial node, there was a slight fluctuation in the realm of true illusion.
If he hadn’t looked into it himself and that he could see through the Akasa due to his mastery over the speech of all Dharmas, as well as his understanding of the Akasa Dao and the True Illusion Dao, he might not have been able to notice it either.
He continued to look into it and found an ancient stone tablet. The stone tablet was scarred with sword marks, and it seemed like it had been there for many years.
Just when Jiang Ming was about to go forward and check it out, immense trepidation overwhelmed him, and he chickened out.
‘There was no smoke without fire. It was only now that he confirmed the Jiuyang Sect was built on top of a volcano that would explode at any moment. If it hadn’t been for him, the Jiuyang Sect would have been destroyed a long time ago.
No, it should be that if it hadn’t been for him, the Jiuyang Sect was destined to doom.
“Well, there’s nothing to be worried about. I’ll protect the Jiuyang Sect at all costs, and no one can injure the people that I care about,” Jiang Ming said.
He jumped down and came to the courtyard. He took a broom from the corner and began sweeping the floor.
[Ding: Congratulations to the host. You’ve been awarded a Yin-Yang Dao Fetus for sweeping the floor!]
Jiang Ming heard the notification from the system as soon as he put the broom down. However, he was stunned when he saw the reward.
Piqued by his curiosity, Jiang Ming took the thing out. It was a small man of about 90 cm. It looked like a real human being. It was filled with the power of nature and possessed an immense amount of lifeforce.
However, it did not have a soul, and it had female characteristics.
Yin-Yang Dao Fetus: A rare treasure bred by heaven and earth. It contains innate Yin and Yang Dao rhythms and has infinite potential. It’s a perfect material for making a clone.
“So am I supposed to make a clone with feminine traits?” Jiang Ming asked.
He had no intention of making any clones. After all, if something went sideways, it would cause a nervous derangement and even bring unimaginable damage to one’s soul. Of course, the biggest drawback was that he would be in big trouble once the clone formed an independent personality.
He now had the Great Manifestation Technique. He could create one-time use decoys as much as he could, so it was a lot more convenient and better than a clone.
“Well, I should just keep it first,” Jiang Ming said as he stored the thing away.
He raised his head, and it was already afternoon. He went to get a few buckets of water without using his special ability.
{Ding: Congratulations to the host! You’ve been awarded with a Spatial Dao Fetus for getting a few buckets of water without the use of a special ability!]
Jiang Ming was stunned.
The Spatial Dao Fetus was indeed an invaluable reward, and it was far more precious than a Para-Immortal. It was just that he wondered why he kept getting this kind of reward today.
In the past, the system would only award him with mana or things like the Enlightening Tea Leaves. Those were rather common, but this Dao Fetus was worth a lot of money.
“This is weird,” Jiang Ming mumbled.
He came to the kitchen, poured half a packet of flour into a bowl, and cracked two eggs into it without adding water to make a dough.
His movement was gentle but quick, and he nearly knitted the dough into a Golden Core.
Then, he set it aside for it to rise.
He made some sauce and began boiling the water.
Soon, a bowl of knife-shaved noodles was done.
After finishing his meal, the system awarded him a Light-Dark Dao Fetus, and Jiang Ming scratched his head.
He tried to ask the system, but he did not get any reply in return.
“Does the system really want me to create a clone?”
Even if he wanted to create a clone, he did not know how to do it.
Jiang Ming decided to put the matter aside first. He turned around and came to the underground immortal’s cave.
He hadn’t been here since he came back from the Supreme Pagoda.
Even with a supreme-grade spiritual fountain with the spirit formation and many refined energy crystals, the Spiritual Qi here did not appear to be very dense even at a growth rate of a hundred times.
“The Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique has reached the third stage. I think I can cast it again.”
Jiang Ming’s heart was filled with joy as he looked at the Enlightening Tree, Ancient Tree of War, Flower Fairy Tree, and other spiritual herbs in the spiritual fountain.
He could only cast the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique on the spiritual items once. However, if they had gotten a higher level, he could cast it again on them, but the effect would cover the previous one.
He activated the special ability without wasting any time, ,and countless green sigils appeared in the air. All of them formed into rays of green lights and merged into spiritual items.
In the next second, these spiritual items were growing rapidly. He could clearly see their branches were turning thicker and thicker while the Spiritual Qi here was getting thinner.
Jiang Ming waved his hand, and the Heavenly Ark appeared mid-air. He drew a river of Spiritual Qi out of it and sprinkled it on the area to solve the issue.
The entire process lasted for an hour.
Krak!
A flower bloomed.
Jiang Ming looked over and saw the flower on top of the Flower Fairy Tree was blooming. It was emitting an intense light as a tiny human figure flew out of it.
She was not more than 30 cm tall, and there were two transparent wings at her back. She was dressed in flower petals and smelled like flowers.
“Master!” She flew over and made a bow at Jiang Ming.
Her voice was so sweet and alluring that it would melt anyone’s heart who heard it.
“You can talk as soon as you’re born?” Jiang Ming asked, “Could it be that you can inherit the memory from your predecessor?”
“Master,” the flower fairy said, “As soon as I was born, I received messages from the universe, and that’s why I can talk. I also know that you’re the one who bred me, Master!”
“This is incredible. Do you have a name?”
“Nope. Please give me a name, Master!”
“You’re born from a flower, and since it’s afternoon now, let’s call you Huo Hua!”
“Thank you so much for the name, Master!” the flower fairy replied.
[Ding: Congratulations to the host. You’re awarded with 1,000 years of cultivation and the Saint Province Dao Square.]
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed when he received the reward. He sucked in a sharp breath when he read through the description of the Saint Province Dao Square.
Saint Province Dao Square: Anyone who is not a hundred times stronger than the owner can be easily subdued.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - Senior Brother, I Missed You So Much
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Senior Brother, I Missed You So Much
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Hua Huo
Gender: Female
Cultivation Base: Qi Cultivation Realm
Background: Affiliated with Jiang Ming
Relationship: 99
Innate Talent: 6 Stars
Status: Bred by her master. Born to serve her master and willing to die for her master. A good housekeeper in nature. She could help to take care of the medicinal garden and attend to every of her master’s needs.
Jiang Ming chuckled.
He did not expect the flower fairy to have such a good relationship with him. As for her innate talent, it was not too impressive, but Jiang Ming figured that it should be more than enough.
[Ding: Congratulations to the host for successfully breeding three unique living beings. 3,000 years of cultivation, a Saint Body Dao Fatus, 1,000 pieces of supreme-grade Enlightening Tea Leaves have been awarded.]
Another three flower fairies were born. He was rewarded handsomely, and one of the rewards was the Saint Body Dao Fetus.
He named them Hua Yu, Hua Rui, and Hua Jing, respectively.
Four flower fairies were fluttering around him, and they would peck on his cheek intimately from time to time.
“It’s such a shame that they’re too small in size,” Jiang Ming mumbled.
He headed out of the underground immortal’s cave and returned to the ground surface. He thought for a while and decided to merge the Saint Province Dao Square into Chuyang Peak. There was a restriction, and he could only transform one peak.
At that moment, Jiang Ming felt everything around him was under his control. He had a feeling that he could destroy everything with a simple wave of his hand, and even an Imminent Immortal martial artist wouldn’t stand a chance against him should they step into Chuyang Peak.
“L guess I’m invincible when I’m on Chuyang Peak!”
He raised his head and looked skyward. The clouds were rolling high in the sky, and it was only then Jiang Ming’s heart was filled with a sense of security.
He waved his hand, and his residence turned into an estate.
There was a two-story main building at the center and two adjacent buildings on the left and right.
There was still a gazebo on the rooftop. However, vines were entwining the pillars, and flowers were blooming everywhere. It was the perfect place for taking a break.
The air was enveloped in a veil of mist, and the area below was surrounded by a fence.
Suddenly, an idea popped up in his head. He then moved the underground immortal’s cave, including the spiritual fountain, to the back of the courtyard/
After all, very few people could defeat him right now, so he did not have to worry about anything anymore.
Jiang Ming came to the back of the courtyard and fused both the spiritual field and the vegetable patch together. It now had been expanded to seven mu in circumference, which corresponded to his cultivation level.
After that, he took some Spiritual Medicine Seeds that could grow into the medicine king and planted them. He activated the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, causing them to start growing at an intense speed.
Since the consumption rate was high due to the fast growth rate, Jiang Ming decided to move the divine mountain out of the Heavenly Ark after thinking for a while. He put it at the side of the spiritual fountain as well as the center of the spiritual field.
Using the power of the Dao Square, he transformed the spiritual fluid in it into a river. He injected part of it into the spiritual fountain while letting the rest flow through the medicinal patch.
“Hua Huo, I’ll leave this place in your hands from now on.”
“Alright, Master!”
After he had finished all the arrangements, he came to the rooftop.
Hua Yu and Hua Rui followed after him.
One of them prepared tea for him while the other was washing fruits.
After serving the tea and the fruits, one of them flew to his back to massage his shoulders while the other landed on his lap and massaged his legs.
“ah, this is life!” Jiang Ming squinted his eyes.
After a short while, Hua Yu picked up the cup of tea and brought it to his mouth.
Jiang Ming took a sip, and then Hua Rui popped a grape into his mouth.
“This feels so great!”
Three days passed in the blink of an eye. Jiang Ming had gotten so many Dao Fetuses that he was not surprised anymore.
Whoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open, and his eyes glowed when he saw his Junior Sister’s Status.
She had already come out of the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures.
In Lei Province, the place of the immortal treasures.
A vortex suddenly appeared on top of the mountain, and a group of people appeared out of it. All of them were young. The men were all handsome while the women were all pretty.
There were different glows of divine light swirling around them, and it made them look even more surreal.
“Linglong!” Xi Yao landed beside Zi Linglong. There was a big grin on her face as she said, “I can feel that you’ve become a lot stronger. I suppose you must have come across something great while you were inside, right?”
“Well, I believe all those who came here have come across something great,” Zi Linglong replied as she smiled at her. She looked at the surroundings and frowned. “This is odd. How can there be such a dense amount of evil energy in the air?”
Xi Yao was stunned for a while. She closed her eyes to sense her surroundings, and her face turned serious when she opened them again. “This is terrifying. It makes me feel that something big and evil is coming. What is going on?”
