Not only them but the rest of the people had noticed something from the air as well.
Suddenly, a group of people showed up. Some of them were in middle age while the others were in old age.
“Granny Wang, do you know what’s going on?” Xi Yao asked when an old woman landed beside her. In the meantime, she also introduced her to Zi Linglong.
Granny Wang was her guardian. She was also the Primal Spirit Elder of the Riyue Sacred Land in Zhong Province.
“After you entered the God of Thunders Immortal Treasure, a war broke out in Eastern Region,” Granny Wang explained. “The Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan from East Sea, and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union all joined forces and waged war against the Qingyun Sect. The mountains collapsed, the land
sank, the rivers were diverted, and the living creatures were wiped out! The entire Eastern Region was in the midst of a destruction-level catastrophe! Many clans, families, and people were killed! It was tragic. However, just when everyone thought that Eastern Region was about to fall, the three alliances
were wiped out!”
As an elder of a Sacred Land as well as the guardian of a Holy Daughter, it went without saying that she was very well-informed, and she also knew how powerful the person that had wiped out the three alliances was.
After all, even if the Sacred Lands in Zhong Province worked together, they might not be able to defeat the three alliances. However, that person had done it, and not only that, but it had only taken him one night to wipe all of them out.
“Oh my gosh! So many things have happened!” Xi Yao exclaimed.
“Senior, do you know the condition of the Jiuyang Sect?” Zi Linglong asked, her voice thick with trepidation.
She knew everything that would happen in the future, but she did not expect the catastrophe would fall on Eastern Region so soon.
She was only worried about her Senior Brother right now. Although she kept telling herself that her Senior Brother was fine, she still couldn’t help herself from being worried about him.
“The Jiuyang Sect?” Granny Wang thought for a while and replied, “I know that place, but the war didn’t spread there, so I guess they’re fine.”
“Thank goodness!” Zi Linglong heaved out a sigh of relief.
suddenly, they heard someone crying not far.
“Young Master, you’ve finally come out. The Ximen Family has been wiped out. All of our people are dead. I’m able to escape the disaster because I came here with you! What are we supposed to do next, Young Master?”
“Yueyue, our clan is gone! Everyone is gone!”
Some of them had lost their families, while some of them had lost their clans.
All of them had entered the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures to make themselves stronger, but by the time they came out, they were left alone.
A lot of the geniuses fell silent. They did not know what they should do right now.
“Holy Daughter, it’s not safe to stay in Eastern Region. Let’s head back to our Sacred Land!” Granny Wang said.
“Go back?” Xi Yao thought for a while and shook her head, “It might be a disaster for what happened to Eastern Region, but it might be an opportunity as well. I want to hone my skills, so I’m going to stay in Eastern Region and cultivate. Besides, Linglong is my friend, and there’s no way I’m letting my
friend face the danger alone,” Xi Yao said.
After that, she tumed to Zi Linglong and continued. “Is that okay for you, Linglong?”
“Xi Yao!” Ling Han came to them through the air. There was a smile on her face as she said, “Why don’t you follow me to the Qingyun Sect instead? You too, Junior Sister Linglong. I’ve come across an immortal opportunity, and I wish to cultivate with you two.”
“I think I’ll pass,” Zi Linglong turned down her offer and shook her head. She then rose into the air and said, “I’m going back to my own sect. You’re welcome to stay with me too, Xi Yao!”
“Okay!” Xi Yao offered Lin Han an apologetic smile and followed Zi Linglong.
Looking at the two delicate figures that were getting further and further away, Lin Han’s gaze was turning colder with each passing second.
Granny Wang glanced at her. She knew what she was thinking, but she was not going to say anything to her. She turned into a streak of light and went away.
Most of the people on the peak of the mountain were leaving too.
However, by the time they got home, what awaited before them was not the warm welcoming of their families but huge craters and destruction.
“Linglong, so many things have happened, and I think we should go check them out first. Why are you in such a hurry to go back?”
“Xi Yao, I miss my Senior Brother!”
“Hmm, you’ve only been away from him for a month, and you’re already missing him so much? Could it be that you’re in love with him?”
“Senior Brother is my closest family!”
“I’s always good to have someone to return to, but no offense, Linglong, you’re a phoenix, and you belong to the sky. Although your Senior Brother has great potential, he’s just going to be a drag to you!”
“Senior Brother will never drag me down,” Zi Linglong replied, her face filled with determination, “Even if he’s going to drag me down, I’m willing to let him do so. This is because I love him, and I’m willing to give up everything in my life just to be with him!”
“You…” Xi Yao was confused. “Are you sure about that?”
“Yes!”
“Is this what they call love?”
Zi Linglong did not reply.
By the time Zi Linglong arrived at the Jiuyang Sect, the sun had already set. She came to Chuyang Peak, and the first thing she saw was Jiang Ming and a few flower fairies.
She ignored those flower fairies and threw herself into Jiang Ming’s arms.. “Senior Brother, I missed you so much!”

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - Jiang Ming’s Exaltation, Senior Sister Wants to Cultivate the Clone Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Jiang Ming’s Exaltation, Senior Sister Wants to Cultivate the Clone Technique
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
‘The sun was setting in the distance.
Zi Linglong squirmed in Jiang Ming’s arms on the rooftop as if she wanted to fuse herself with him.
“What happened, silly girl?”
“Nothing. I just missed you very much.”
“Huh? Haha, it’s only been a month or so.”
“I don’t want to leave your side for even a moment, let alone a month! After this time, I’m not going to leave you alone anymore!”
“alright, alright!”
Jiang Ming secured her tightly in his arms as he ran his fingers over her long hair.
Xi Yao had arrived as well.
‘When she saw that both of them were hugging each other like nobody, her face flushed pink with embarrassment. However, just as she was about to turn her head around, the comer of her eyes caught sight of two fairies that were flying here and there around them.
“are they fairies?” Xi Yao’s eyes glowed up in excitement.
Both fairies looked so delicate and adorable that she wanted to cuddle and kiss them.
“alright, alright! Stop being so clingy. We have company here,” Jiang Ming said as he pushed Zi Linglong away.
“I just want to cuddle with you, Senior Brother,” Zi Linglong replied. After that, she looked at the fairies and asked, “Senior Brother, what are they?”
“They are flower fairies. They are born from flowers,” Jiang Ming explained.
Zi Linglong nodded. Although she felt strange, she did not press on.
She knew her Senior Brother had an immortal opportunity. After all, flower fairies were not supposed to appear in the Tianyuan World.
“Lady Xi Yao, welcome, welcome,” Jiang Ming greeted.
It seemed to him that Xi Yao had gotten even prettier. Although she was not as pretty as Zi Linglong, she was a beauty in her own right. She had a curvaceous body figure, and her smile was alluring.
“Nice to meet you, Brother Jiang!”
Although Xi Yao was disappointed at the fact that someone like Jiang Ming dragged down a talented person like Zi Linglong, she was still able to retain her courtesy and greeted him back. She offered him a warm smile and said, “You don’t have to call me lady. Just call me Xi Yao.”
“Alright. Xi Yao,” Jiang Ming said.
He could notice the disdain in her eyes, but he did not care about it.
After all, he was just a “Core Formation” martial artist.
“Hua Yu, Hua Rui, remember this. From now on, she is the lady of the house,” Jiang Ming said as he pointed at Zi Linglong.
“Yes, Master!” Both of the flower fairies replied reverently. Then, they turned to look at Zi Linglong and continued in a sweet voice. “You’re so pretty! Are you a goddess?”
“You two are so sweet,” Zi Linglong replied.
After that, both of the flower fairies served tea to them.
Jiang Ming was sitting on the left while Zi Linglong on the right on the rattan chair. She was recounting the things she had come across in the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures.
As for Xi Yao?
Both of them ignored her.
‘Well, guess I’m the extra here,’ Xi Yao said to herself while looking at them speechlessly.
She was the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sacred Land. Everywhere she went, she would be treated with courtesy. People would gather around her, attending to each of her demands, but things were different here—she was like an invisible person.
She wanted to cuddle with the fairies, but her pride as a Holy Daughter did not allow her to do so.
Just when she turned around and decided to leave, she sensed something in the air.
“This is…” She noticed that there was a dense amount of Spiritual Qi here. Even the mist in the surroundings was made of Spiritual Qi.
However, this wasn’t the thing that surprised her the most. After all, there were a lot of places like this in the Riyue Sacred Land.
‘What surprised her the most was that she could sense the Dao Rhythm here better than the Enlightening Holy Land in the Sacred Land!
If she could cultivate here, her speed and level of cultivation would be increased by leaps and bounds!
“How is this even possible!?” Xi Yao exclaimed when the realization hit her.
It took many generations of Extreme Path and Imminent Immortal martial artists to form the Enlightening Holy Land, yet it still paled in comparison to here.
She was so stunned that her brain went blank for a moment.
‘When she looked toward Jiang Ming again, her gaze had changed.
“Xi Yao, are you leaving?” Zi Linglong asked. “I’ve a lot of things to talk to my Senior Brother, so I won’t see you off. I’ll find you again when I head to Zhong Province!”
“L..L.. L..” It went without saying that Xi Yao knew what Zi Linglong was talking about. She was asking her to leave.
Asa Holy Daughter, she should have just walked away like that. However, her anger faded away as soon as it rose in her heart.
She pretended she couldn’t understand what Zi Linglong was implying. A grin blossomed across her face as she said to her, “Linglong, I’ve just been here not long ago, and if I left now, people out there might think we’ve turned against each other. We can’t let those rumors ruin our relationship. I decided
to stay here and cultivate for a while. Besides, if someone comes and attacks your sect, I could be of use as well.”
Zi Linglong squinted her eyes, and Jiang Ming could notice the slight changes in her emotion. He patted her hand and said, offering Xi Yao a smile, “Sure. It’s our honor to have you here, Sister Xi Yao. However, we rarely have any guests, so I hope you can forgive us if we slighted you.”
‘Xi Yao was stunned.
‘Did he just call me Sister Xi Yao? I’m older, stronger, and the Holy Daughter of a Sacred Land, while he’s just a member of a second-rate clan! How dare he call me that!? Who gave him the permission and courage to call me “sister”?
That said, when she looked at Zi Linglong and thought of the immense amount of Dao Rhythm around, she decided to put up with Jiang Ming for the time being.
‘After I find out the secret here, I’ll hang you up and punish you to my heart’s content!”
“Of course, I wouldn’t mind,” Xi Yao replied. “Is it okay if I walk around?”
“Sure. Help yourself, please.” Jiang Ming nodded.
“Thank you very much,” Xi Yao replied and flew toward the back mountain, leaving both Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong behind in the gazebo.
Zi Linglong nudged closer to Jiang Ming. She rested her head on his arm and mumbled, “This Holy Daughter is so annoying!”
“Well, it’s kind of rare that she could calm herself down although she’s a Holy Daughter,” Jiang Ming chuckled, “Besides, aren’t you two besties?””
“I just met her a few times, so nope, she’s not my bestie! Senior Brother, don’t tell me that you’ve taken a liking of her because she has a curvaceous body figure?”
“What are you talking about? She’s a Holy Daughter. She’s totally out of my league!”
“So that means you will fall for her if she’s someone around your level?”
“Stop messing with me, will you?”
“Hehe. By the way, the Dao Rhythm here is even thicker and of higher quality than the Dao Rhythm in the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures’ Enlightening Place. Is this your immortal opportunity too?”
“Yeah. You don’t have to go out and look for opportunities anymore. If you need anything, just let me know.”
“You’re the best, Senior Brother!”
She turned around, found herself a comfortable spot, and leaned on Jiang Ming’s body.
At the back mountain, Xi Yao noticed that although this place looked very normal, it was filled with an unlimited amount of Dao Rhythms to the brim.
She looked at the place that was enveloped with mist. She squinted her eyes, trying to look through the mist but to no avail.
‘There’s no array at this place. It’s only a mist, yet I can’t see through it?”
“This mountain peak is truly an incredible place,” Xi Yao said. She turned around. Although she could see Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong, she couldn’t sense anything or hear any sound.
‘Is he really at the Core Formation Realm? This is getting interesting.’ Xi Yao smiled. ‘I’ve decided. I’ll stay here, and I won’t leave even if you chase me. I’ll just close my eyes and pretend I don’t see anything when you’re hugging each other. I don’t believe that you have the guts to carry out the Sexual
Cultivation Technique in front of me!’
She continued to walk around, yet she couldn’t find anything.
‘When she exited Chuyang Peak, the Dao Rhythms disappeared.
‘Although it’s just one step different, it’s like two different worlds. This is strange.’
Xi Yao still couldn’t find any sign of an array.
She returned to Chuyang Peak, and then she saw the stones in the back mountain rise into the air. All of them then formed into a building made of rock in the blink of an eye. Although the building was made of rocks and stones, it had a grand appearance.
In the meantime, Jiang Ming’s voice rang out in her ears. “Sister Xi Yao, if you’ve decided to stay here, this will be your temporary abode. I hope you won’t mind it.”
‘He hopes that I won’t mind it?”
Xi Yao looked at the stone building in front with her eyes bulged wide.
‘Tm the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sacred Land! I’m a Dao Seed martial artist and your guest, yet you’re letting me stay in a stone building at the back of the mountain?”
‘Xi Yao’s face sank as she felt humiliated.
‘Calm down, Xi Yao! Calm Down! She took a deep breath to calm herself down. “After I find out the secret of this place, I’ll let you know what happens when you offend me, Jiang Ming!”
“Thank you so much, Brother Jiang! I’m sure I’ll have a lot of fun staying here!” Xi Yao replied.
“Haha! Don’t mention it! Just make yourself at home.” Jiang Ming’s voice rang out again.
‘shameless! He’s such a shameless b*stard!’ Xi Yao chided Jiang Ming inwardly and went into the stone building.
On the rooftop, Jiang Ming said, “She can accept that? Although she’s a Holy Daughter, she knows when to yield and when not to. She’s pretty good.”
“Senior Brother, could it be that she has fallen for you?”
“What do you think?”
“Well, you can marry her and make her your second wife!”
“Haha!”
“Do you need my help?”
“Hehe!”
“Hmph!”
“Alright, alright! What are your next plans?”
“I’ve gotten quite a lot of things from the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures. I have an idea what to do, so I need your advice.”
“Tell me about it.”
“I want to learn how to make clones.”
“Clones? This isn’t easy. You might damage your soul, and the clones will go out of control if something goes wrong. I don’t think this is a good idea!”
“Senior Brother, I have confidence that I can master it. Besides, you’re here with me, so I’m sure you’ll help me, right?”
“Me?”
“The user can control all of the clones formed through the clone technique, so they won’t go out of control. Besides, there’s one thing special about my clone technique. I can give specific orders to a clone.”
“So you’re going to let the clone stay with me?”
“Exactly! Senior Brother, why is your heart pumping so fast?”
“Tm happy for you, of course! I didn’t expect you to have such a powerful special ability. You’re the best, Junior Sister. I’m truly happy for you! Haha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, What? Nine!?
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, What? Nine!?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The atmosphere in the mountain had gotten a lot livelier after Zi Linglong’s return.
The sun was getting lower and lower, and Jiang Ming went to the kitchen to prepare dinner for them.
He was going to prepare 32 dishes. The silver lining was that he was quick with his hands, and the fire was strong, so it took him only a very short time to finish preparing all of the dishes.
‘Xi Yao was invited as well.
“This is… lobster? Why can I sense the Water Sambodha from it?
“Oh my gosh, this is crab roe! Holy cr*p, there is a fragment of law in it? Am I dreaming right now?
“What, what, what is this? Why is it glowing with an immortal light that only appears from an Imminent Immortal martial artist? I know what it is now. I’ve read it from the record in my sect. This is the liver of a dragon!”
Xi Yao was stunned by the dishes before her, and her body shook when she saw the liver of a dragon on the table.
“I don’t know what you are talking about. This is just food,” Jiang Ming replied. “Come. Have a seat and give them a try!”
“I didn’t even need to taste. Just by smelling it alone, I know they taste great!” Zi Linglong said with a smile, “Senior Brother, I’m going to eat now!”
She picked up lobster meat with a pair of chopsticks and put it into her mouth. She just took a bite, and her mouth was filled with the juice and aroma.
“This is so nice!” Zi Linglong exclaimed and squinted her eyes contentedly. She then picked up another piece and sent it into Jiang Ming’s mouth.
“Senior Brother, you also have some!”
“You’re right! This is really nice!” Jiang Ming commented, “Today is a seafood feast. One day, I’ll make you a bird feast!”
“Senior Brother. I’m considered a bird myself too. Are you going to eat me?” Zi Linglong asked gloomily.
Jiang Ming and Xi Yao were rendered speechless.
Xi Yao looked at the dishes on the table and thought, ‘Are these really sea beasts?”
She took her chopsticks and put some crab roe into her mouth. In the next second, her eyes widened as she could sense a surge of energy, Water Dao, vitality, and so on coursing through every cell in her body.
She felt that her whole body had been cleansed, and her cultivation level had been increased.
“This is definitely an Extreme Path crab beast!” Xi Yao said confidently.
She looked toward the plate of dragon liver and couldn’t help herself but wonder. ‘Where did he find all of these ingredients? Did he kill all of the sea beasts? Oh yeah, Granny Wang told me that all of the forces in Long Yuan were killed one day ago. Could it be that…’
Xi Yao’s eyes widened even larger when the realization hit her.
‘Oh my goodness. Did he kill the dragon and take its liver? No, no, no, this is impossible! He’s still so young, and even if he started cultivation when he was in his mother’s womb, there’s no way he could have done that. Maybe it’s someone behind him? Someone who is a lot stronger?
The disdain in Xi Yao’s eyes was gone when she looked at Jiang Ming again. There were a lot of questions in her mind now, and she just wanted to know more about him.
“Why are you not eating, Xi Yao?” Zi Linglong asked, pulling Xi Yao out of her thoughts. She had eaten a few pieces of dragon liver, and her body was glowing with divine light. There was even a phoenix shadow in mid-air behind her back.
She popped a few more pieces into her mouth as she was talking.
“T’ll be eating now!” She had decided to throw away all her pride as a Holy Daughter.
After all, she had never had such a scrumptious meal before when she was in her sect. Now that she had the chance for such a massive feast, there was no way she was going to let it go away.
“Xi Yao, these foods are from the mountains. I think we should just have them for ourselves. What do you think?” Zi Linglong asked without raising her head.
Xi Yao froze for a moment before nodding. “Yeah, yeah, I’m thinking the same thing too. We must not let other people from the world outside learn about it.”
She popped a piece of dragon liver into her mouth and could feel her cultivation level increasing.
Jiang Ming enjoyed the feast as he looked at Zi Linglong with a smile on his face. ‘Seems like she didn’t forget everything I taught her. Not only is she talented, but she also has a big heart. I don’t have to worry about her getting taken advantage of by other people when she goes down from the mountain in
the future.
Zi Linglong had made herself very clear. She did not want Xi Yao to tell anyone about anything that happened here.
‘Xi Yao could read between the lines and promised her that she wouldn’t tell anyone about it.
Everyone enjoyed the feast very much. Even the four flower fairies ate some of the food, increasing their cultivation level.
After they finished the meal, they sat in lotus positions to digest them.
Jiang Ming huffed out a breath and formed a clone to clean up the table.
He then threw himself on the rattan chair, and a voice rang out in his mind.
[Ding: Congratulations to the host. 1,000 years of cultivation and a Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed has been awarded for making a scrumptious meal for everyone, including Zi Linglong, Xi Yao, and the four flower fairies.]
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed up.
‘A meal for 1,000 years of cultivation? This is awesome!”
However, when he thought of the ingredient he used to make the meal, he felt that the reward was no longer a surprise.
‘As for the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, he was shocked after he read the description.
Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed: It can fit up from two people to 1,000 people. If the man and the woman are in love with each other, an immense Dao Rhythm can be activated. Both people can comprehend the Dao in the universe more easily.
Suddenly, an image appeared in Jiang Ming’s head. There was this huge-sized Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed in his head, and there were 500 Zi Linglongs on his left and another 500 Zi Linglongs on his right while he himself slept at the center.
‘As soon as the thought popped up in his mind, he shook his head to chase the thought away.
He looked at the bed again and realized that it did not have a level. It was just a treasured item.
“Finally, I have a good bed!”
Jiang Ming sat in the chair, and his thoughts began to wander away.
His Primal Spirit had reached the perfection stage. He also had enough special abilities, and he figured that it was time for him to step into the Paradis Realm.
The Paradis Realm was a special realm, and he reckoned that he would spend a lot of time in this realm.
The night wind was cold.
‘The peak of the mountain was shrouded in a faint light. It chased the darkness away as it gleamed ethereally.
Zi Linglong was the first one to wake up. She jumped into the chair and squeezed beside him when she saw Jiang Ming.
“Senior Brother, this meal is even better than the opportunity I came across in the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures. It saves me a lot of time, and I believe I can practice how to form a clone very soon.”
“You need a vessel to form a clone, right? Do you have one?” Jiang Ming asked as he secured her tightly in his arm.
Zi Linglong smiled faintly and replied, “Yeah. I got an Innate Thunder Essence from the God of Thunders Immortal Treasure. I can use it for the vessel as my clone.”
“Thunder essence? It’s just the essence of thunder. It’s not the perfect material for you to form a clone.” Jiang Ming said. “I have something a lot better than that, and I’m sure you will like it.”
“Really? Can I have a look?”
“Sure!”
Jiang Ming created a barrier around the rattan chair, and no one could sense anything from the outside.
Zi Linglong’s eyes lit up, and she did not know why but she heaved out a sigh of relief.
At the same time, a Dao Fetus appeared in front of her.
“This is…” Zi Linglong sprang up, her face written with shock. “This is the Space Dao Fetus!? It’s filled with so much vitality, and it’s not something from our region. Where did you get it from, Senior Brother?”
“What do you think about it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“There is nothing better than this!” Zi Linglong said, “Senior Brother, you should keep it for yourself.”
“I don’t need it,” Jiang Ming said as he shook his head. “My way of cultivation is to amass every great power in this universe onto myself. I don’t need a clone.”
“Really?”
“Yes.”
“Then…”
“Yes, you can take it. Don’t worry, my things are all yours.”
“You’re the best, Senior Brother! I just happened to have comprehended the Spatial Dao and formed the Spatial Dao Seed. I can form a perfect Spatial Clone right now!” Zi Linglong said as she kissed her cheek.
“Tstill have a few more with me.”
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed as he waved his hand, and eight Dao Fetuses appeared before him. They were the Ying-Yang Dao, Life-Death, Light-Dark, Five Elemental, Reincarnation, and the Saint Body Dao Fetus.
He stretched his face over to Zi Linglong. She was shocked and couldn’t come to her senses for a long while. However, she soon understood what her Senior Brother wanted, and a smile appeared on her face.
She wrapped her arms around his neck, and the rattan chair gave out a groan..1

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - The Foxin Sect of Western Region, the Holy Daughter Intended to be the Second Wife?
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: The Foxin Sect of Western Region, the Holy Daughter Intended to be the Second Wife?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The next morning, Jiang Ming overlooked the scenery on the east side in an exceptionally good mood. He took in fresh air and breathed out clouds of mist.
“Brother Jiang, thanks! I managed to absorb various benefits from the meal yesterday. I finally comprehended the Extreme Yin Dao. Hence, I believe the path to immortality will be getting smoother.” Xi Yao bowed to him.
“Don’t mention it,” Jiang Ming replied. A thought suddenly crossed his mind, so he turned around and asked, “The Riyue Sect has a long history, so I believe it has also recorded a lot of mysterious events. Xi Yao, do you know whether any immortals have ever descended to our world before?”
“Tused to read thousands of books in the sect, and I do remember that there are some records about immortals but in the form of legend without any proof. There are even records about great demons and devils, but just a brief one. So I’ve no idea about their credibility.” Xi Yao replied as she recalled.
She spoke in a gentle manner, just like a neighbor’s sister. Her gaze at Jiang Ming had also changed. She looked curious about Jiang Ming and, at the same time, admired him. After all, who on earth could afford to serve guests with Imminent Immortal’s dragon liver?
Jiang Ming nodded. Then he asked, “From your understanding about the Fo Sect of Western Region, do you think they’d be taken down that easily? What I knew was that the Fo Sect should be far stronger than the Qingyun Sect. Although the Qingyun Sect is the strongest, it is not the only influence in
Eastern Region. Conversely, Buddhist temples can be found everywhere in Western Region.”
Xi Yao frowned as she pondered. “This is what I’m also confused about! The five devil sects are strong, but they used to be suppressed. Thus, how many experts could they have even if they’ve stayed dormant for quite some time? Since they didn’t dare to come forward, they definitely have a limited
number of experts. On the other hand, the Fo Sect of Western Region has existed since thousands and millions of years ago. Even if they are no match to the five devil sects, they should be able to defend themselves. Yet they were overrun so quickly. This is obviously unreasonable!”
“Perhaps…” Xi Yao’s eyes gleamed with flames of wisdom as she continued. “Perhaps the Fo Set of Western Region has another plan.”
“For instance?”
“For instance, they plan to round up all five devil sects in one fell swoop. And I have a bold guess that they want to use this downfall as their opportunity for their disciples to go out of Western Region, preaching throughout the world. After all, they were stopped immediately when they tried to walk out of
their Western Region, weren’t they? Now they’ve good reason to do so. We’d be seen as too cruel if we drove them away when they’re in trouble.”
“Your instances are reasonable indeed.” Jiang Ming gave Xi Yao a thumbs up.
Meanwhile, he exclaimed to himself that Xi Yao was indeed a Holy Daughter, who was not only highly talented in terms of cultivation but also filled with wisdom.
“Tm merely giving it a guess.” Xi Yao smiled tenderly, being humble.
Jiang Ming did not continue on the topic. Instead, he looked beyond the mountain and said, “There’s an old lady snooping around 800 miles away. She also seemed to want to come over silently. If she’s your acquaintance, make sure she doesn’t have any ill intent and doesn’t come here. All trespassers will
be killed.”
“That’s my guardian. I think she’s worried about my safety. I’ll go now to make things clear.” Xi Yao said frankly.
Jiang Ming wanted to ask why she was not going back, but he held back in the end. After all, he felt sorry to chase her away.
Well, he certainly did not lust for her body. He only wished to see the Holy Daughter dance a hot dance at most.
Xi Yao understood Jiang Ming’s requirement and flew toward her guardian immediately.
At the same time, Jiang Ming left for the spiritual field.
Zi Linglong was there in the field, an authority he had given her.
“Senior Brother, I’ve never thought that you’d develop such a place filled with precious spiritual medicine, many of which I haven’t seen before. Such an environment is well beyond the God of Thunders Immortal Treasures. But… But why are they growing so fast? This is absolutely abnormal,” Zi Linglong
paced in the air as she said with her eyes gleaming.
“Tve cultivated a special ability which can help them grow 1,000 times faster.” Jiang Ming held her little hand, led her to the side of the spiritual mountain next to the spiritual fountain, and added, “If it wasn’t because of this spiritual mountain supplying a large amount of spiritual essence, the special
ability couldn’t work at all.”
“Grow 1,000 times faster?” Zi Linglong muttered with a shocked look on her face. She was truly shocked. She had never seen such a terrific special ability, not even in her past life. It was terrific because it was more difficult to boost plants’ growth than to control time directly.
“Yeap.” Jiang Ming nodded, further affirming his words. Then, he added, “You can also take whichever you need. Please help take care of them whenever you’re free.”
“Sure, Senior Brother! Spiritual things are generally nurtured by heaven and earth in gathering supreme Dao fluctuations. Top-grade spiritual medicines and above, in particular, may fail to grow even in a peak rich in spiritual essence. Even if they can grow, they usually ostracize other species. Yet many
species are growing well here. Divine lights and various Dao fluctuations intervening here is indeed a peerless Sacred Land, incomparable by any other places present in this world, I’m afraid.” Zi Linglong promised and complimented.
“You have a great Senior Brother, don’t you?” Jiang Ming said with a sense of pride.
“That’s for sure. You can actually build all these things under my watch. What’s your cultivation base now, by the way?” asked Zi Linglong.
“Primal Spirit,” replied Jiang Ming.
“Primal Spirit? So high? Oh my, you’re indeed a peerless genius. You’re concealing too much!” Zi Linglong was astonished.
“Low profile, have to stay low profile,” said Jiang Ming.
“Senior Brother, I just remembered a thing, Were you the one who killed the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion’s Holy Son?” inquired Zi Linglong.
“Ya, that was me. I don’t care about their identity. I’l kill whoever is bullying my little girl!” Jiang Ming said domineeringly.
“Aww, you’re the best! So you’re the one behind the Bishui Sect’s ordeal, too?” asked Zi Linglong.
“Yes. I was also behind the incident a couple of days ago. I’ve killed many Yinmo members because of their ill-intention toward our sect. Who knew it’d incur a war in Eastern Region? Yet the Qingyun Sect is such a pile of crap, failing to resist. Moreover, Long Yuan, the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union,
and the Yinmo Sect are being too wanton, wanting to keep us humans in captivity. Ha, I’ll get them all killed to save myself the trouble and for the peace of mind.” Jiang Ming confessed.
“Senior Brother, were… Were you the one who killed all the experts of the Yinmo Sect, Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, and Long Yuan? But… But…” Zi Linglong was utterly bewildered. She barely could believe it but recalling the dinner she had yesterday, she had to.
“But you’re merely a Primal Spirit!” Zi Linglong could not help but grumble.
“What to do when those Paradis, Extreme Path, and Imminent Immortal experts are all such pieces of trash that I managed to kill them without much effort? None of them is my match.” Jiang Ming sighed.
Zi Linglong was rendered speechless. She was unable to do so even though she had the empress’s memory. In fact, she was far from being able to do so.
“Senior Brother, you’re showing off!” Zi Linglong pointed out.
“Therefore, we no longer have to be afraid of anyone in this world, Just kill whoever provokes you!” Jiang Ming laughed out loud.
“When my phoenix bloodline was awakened, I received the inheritance which greatly improved my innate talent. I tried my best to cultivate to quickly improve my cultivation base and protect you, Chuyang Peak, and the sect. Who knew you’re the one secretly protecting me!” Zi Linglong embraced Jiang
Ming’s hand tightly on her chest before continuing. “Senior Brother, I’ve never thought that you’ve done so much for me without me knowing.”
“Little girl, who else can I protect other than you, my Junior Sister? You’re, after all, the girl I’ve raised by cleaning your shit and your pee!” Jiang Ming grinned.
“Senior Brother, I’m no longer a kid!” Zi Linglong retorted.
“Alright, my little girl has grown up!” Jang Ming said.
Meanwhile, he called up the Human Path Records and saw that the relationship value of Zi Linglong was 98. He felt pleased because such a value meant Zi Linglong would be willing to sacrifice herself for him.
Status: ‘Gosh, Senior Brother is too amazing! I wonder what type of immortal opportunity he has got to be able to grow this fast? What a good Senior Brother of mine, willing to share his secret. I’ll have to work harder in cultivation so that I can be the one protecting him in the future.
The duo retumed to the yard.
Xi Yao had already returned. She said she had demanded her guardian to go cultivating 1,000 miles away and merely be her messenger. She told her guardian that she no longer needed protection with the reason that she was not much weaker than a Primal Spirit expert, and she could kill a Primal Spirit
expert once she had a breakthrough.
“Xi Yao, do you plan to stay here long-term? As my Master is always not around, my Senior Brother and I are the only two living on Chuyang Peak. Therefore, I’m afraid it will tarnish your reputation if you stay here too long,” Zi Linglong said with a smile.
Xi Yao hugged Zi Linglong’s hand as she said, “Linglong, I’ll kill whoever dares to gossip about me! You don’t want to kick me out, do you? We are considered life-and-death friends since we have gone through the God of Thunders Immortal Treasure together. Moreover, I know you’re kind-hearted, and
you won’t kick me out. As for the reputation, don’t worry. I don’t care about it either. How about I call you elder sister?”
Listening to Xi Yao, Jiang Ming at the side almost sputtered.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong was startled and speechless. She could not help but transmit her words to Xi Yao, “You’re a Holy Daughter. Why are you talking as though you’re an oppressed daughter-in-law? Let’s make it clear. Make sure you don’t seduce my Senior Brother!”
Xi Yao smiled and replied in the form of voice transmission, “Ha, I’ve no intention to be the second wife! Don’t worry, I just want to cultivate here quietly, without any interruption. Moreover, with my presence, I’m able to save you all from troubles and bring some news from outside.”
The duo was murmuring to each other.
The mountain gained back its peace.
Time flew. About a year passed in the blink of an eye.
It was the day when peace was broken…

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - Had a Breakthrough to Paradis Realm, Little Junior Sister Number One
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Had a Breakthrough to Paradis Realm, Little Junior Sister Number One
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
It was September 9999 on the Zhou Calendar.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Paradis Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
special abilities: Great Akasa Technique, Great Body Protection Technique, Great Catastrophe Technique, Great Five Elemental Technique, Great Yin-Yang Technique, Great Light-and-Dark Technique, Great Reincarnation Technique, Great True Illusion Technique, Great Karma Technique, Great
Demolition Technique, Great Akasa Sword Technique, Great Boundless Technique, Great Millennium Technique, Great Clone Technique, Great Divine Seal Technique, Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Unlimited Killing Punch, Astral Transformation, Return of Infinite Law Finger…
Innate Talent: Immortal (Secondary Daoist Body)
Items: Human Path Records, Supreme Order, Saint Province Dao Square, Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed
[Immortal Weapon: Mystical Light Sword, Heavenly War Blade, Heavenly Feathered Shirt, Celestial Soul Clock, Starry Hall, And Heavenly Ark]
[Para-Immortal Weapon: Soaring Feathered Sword, Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk]
[Supreme-grade Dao Vessel: Mana Sealing Chessboard, Combat Mannequin]
[High-grade Dao Vessel: Dark Abyss Sword, Vessel White Jaded Sparring Gloves]
[Special Ability Bead, 72 pieces of Enlightening Tea Leaves, Five-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card]
Support: Primary Training Zone
Innate Talent: Immortal (Secondary Daoist Body)
Support: Primary Training Zone
Three days had passed since Jiang Ming’s breakthrough. At present, he was lying on the rattan chair located on the rooftop while checking on himself via the System. The change was insignificant.
There was no significant change in the information, but the cultivation years, which he had accumulated up to 50,000 years, were all used up for the sake of his breakthrough.
He closed his eyes, allowing his mind to enter the Paradis Space in the sea of consciousness. It was incomparably vast, a real world with its boundless heaven and earth.
In heaven was a blazing sun condensed by the Sun Law. Its rays warmed all things on earth. Meanwhile, in the boundless starry sky were stars blinking. The Stellar Law formed them.
There was also a moon formed by Extreme Yin Dao, hiding behind heaven and earth. The moon would appear only after the sun descended from heaven as it revolved. It was a cycle repeating itself.
With the sun and moon taking their turn, all things were in order.
On the land
Mountains lifted, forming ranges as a result of Earth Law and Golden Law’s evolution. There were also numerous rivers and lakes, a roaring sea, and countless forest areas covering mountain ranges.
Jiang Ming could control all things in the world. He could make cold breeze blows, mountains and rivers ripple—he could even regulate the revolving five elements and rendering cycle of reincarnation, as well as control light and darkness, life and death.
He descended the world in the form of an imaginative body with a thought. He could clearly see the mysterious world and even reach the end of the world, the size of a million in radius, in just a step.
Jiang Ming could be said as the almighty and omnipotent god of the world.
The only flaw was that there was no living thing yet.
‘When Jiang Ming opened up the sea of consciousness with his Primal Spirit, he knew that the size of the Paradis World in the sea of consciousness was affected by the comprehended laws.
He also knew he needed tremendous support from his mana and spiritual essence to grow the world to its limits.
Thus, he fused all his 50,000 years of cultivation into it. He even withdrew endless spiritual essence from the spiritual mountain, which converted to about half a million years of cultivation before he could open up the Paradis Space to its limit.
Paradis was originally an illusion; after all, it was the evolution of mana and the derivation of laws.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming made True Illusion Law as its support, Spatial Law as its backbone, Five Elemental Law and Yin-Yang Law as its foundation, Life-and-Death Law and Reincarnation Law as its impulsion, Light-and-Dark Law as its transformation progress, and Time Law as its order.
These had made his Paradis evolve into a real space that broke the shackles, transcending ages. Hence, his Paradis was unique.
His Paradis could evolve, grow, expand and even nurture other numerous laws on its own. All these because of the basic foundation it had.
It was equivalent to a world’s perfect seed with massive potential if it could grow smoothly.
‘Can it evolve into a universe in the future? Jiang Ming pondered, but he had no answer to his question.
As for his Primal Spirit, it had merged with his Paradis, becoming its energy core, life foundation.
Jiang Ming withdrew his mind.
As he reached out his hand, a black hole instantly appeared on his palm.
“Tm too strong indeed. The current me can kill the me before my breakthrough with a punch! Who else in the mortal world can be my match? Sigh, what a lonely life!” Jiang Ming moaned as though he was ill.
After he had a breakthrough to Paradis Realm, various laws of his fused to develop a world that started evolving, As a result, his mana soared up to a level beyond imagination. Even his will and body had enhanced multiple folds.
At that moment, a soft lady voice rang out. “Senior Brother!” And a figure suddenly appeared along with the voice.
The figure teleported.
In fact, the figure was Jiang Ming’s Junior Sister, who lunged herself into his embrace, hugging his neck.
“1m about to be crushed!” Jiang Ming moaned.
“Senior Brother, you’re still being dishonest, even crushed!” Zi Linglong wriggled her body before continuing. “Guess who I am?” She was lying on Jiang Ming as she gently shook her head and pouted. Meanwhile, her long hair lightly brushed against his face, tickling him.
“You’re the little girl, aren’t you?” Jiang Ming replied, and his eyes gleamed. “You’ve Spatial Dao in you. Are you the spatial clone of hers?”
Zi Linglong wriggled as she said, “Bingo! The main body is still cultivating, trying to form other clones as soon as possible. Although we are in two different bodies, we share the same heart. Hence, you can see us as the same person. But this body is slightly different from the main body. This is my actual
look.”
As she finished speaking, she grew three inches higher and thinner. She looked cooler than the main body, but her smile was sweet with her squinting crescent eyes.
“Senior Brother, which of us looks better? Me or the main body?”
“Since you two are the same, of course, both of you look good!”
“Senior Brother, can’t you just tell me?”
“Err, one looks beautiful and the other charming.”
“Hng, you’re just brushing me off! Senior Brother, why don’t you give me a new name!”
“Name? Will it create an independent personality:
“Don’t worry! Even if I do, I’m forever your Junior Sister.”
The duo was being mushy.
But Jiang Ming felt a headache when he thought of the need for naming. After all, there would be more than one clone of his Junior Sister.
He temporarily withheld his thought and called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Linglong Number One (Zi Linglong’s Spatial Clone)
Relationship: 98
Jiang Ming was speechless after seeing it.
At that moment, he raised his head and saw Chang Yiming coming.
“Chang Yiming is here! Rise up!” He patted Junior Sister’s bouncy butt as he spoke.
“Pat once more!”
Pat! Pat! Pat!
“Senior Brother, you’ve patted two times more. It hurts!” Junior Sister wiggled her body and said as she blinked her eyes, “So bad of you!”
“Ahem, rise up!”
“Hehe!”
Zi Linglong rose up into the air while her body changed rapidly, returning to the main body’s look. But she remained chill and aloof.
‘As Chang Yiming landed on the rooftop, he said, “Linglong, you’ve finished your cultivation. It’s been so difficult to meet you!”
“Hello, Senior Brother Chang! Anything for rushing here?” Zi Linglong greeted Chang Yiming with smiles.
She then brewed a teapot of tea and poured two cups for both Jiang Ming and Chang Yiming before she sat at one side.
“Yes.” Chang Yiming sat on the chair, looked around, and could not help but exclaim, “First Seat Jiang, the cultivation condition here is the best with super-rich spiritual essence. The most peculiar thing is that I have a particularly strange feeling that I can fall into enlightenment at any time. Thus, I’d like
to ask for a favor. I’d like to request for a place on the side of the mountain or at the bottom of the mountain to cultivate. Don’t worry, I won’t disturb the two of you!”
“Senior Brother Chang, don’t mention it. It’s big here, just build a house wherever you like. But would Senior Uncle Chang allow you to come over? You’re, after all, the Laoyang Peak’s First Seat. Who knows, you might be backstabbed and called a traitor.”
Jiang Ming knew clearly the cultivation conditions in the sect better than anyone else. Since he was not hiding the cultivation condition in Chuyang Peak, he knew others would come over sooner or later. He might reject others’ requests, but Chang Yiming was one of the few friends he had, so he did not
reject. After all, the mountain area was quite large.
Moreover, Yu Yao was cultivating on the mountain.
In fact, he even thought of setting aside part of the mountain for the sect’s disciples to cultivate. After all, he had to return the favor he received from the sect.
Chang Yiming was delighted, “That’s great! Thanks. I don’t care about my identity as the First Seat. If my Master learns I’m cultivating here, I think he’ll love it!”
After chattings, only he brought out the main topic. “The Taiyang Peak’s First Seat Ximen Guanhai is back. Think he’s got a lucky encounter that helped him break through to Nascent Soul Realm. He held a large celebration after he got back, and he’s unhappy with the absence of Chuyang Peak’s
representative. He got furious when he learned that the sect has given Linglong the authority to utilize the sect’s wealth without limitation and that Linglong is the first choice to take over as Sect Master. From the hearsay I heard, he may get you all into trouble soon.”
“Get us into trouble?” Jiang Ming was irritated. He turned to his Junior Sister and asked, “Little girl, what’s your plan to deal with it?”
“Senior Brother, what if I slap him to death now so that he won’t disturb us?” Zi Linglong suggested.
Chang Yiming twitched the corner of his mouth as he heard Zi Linglong’s suggestion. He quietly lifted the cup of tea and drank. He knew that even though Zi Linglong respected him, he could not and dared not provoke her at all.
After a long engagement with Zi Linglong, he further understood that Linglong only listened to Jiang Ming and might not even obey her own Master, Gu Hai.
“He is the so-called Senior Brother, after all. If you slap him to death directly, it means you aren’t respecting the Sect Master. Let’s just give him a chance. We shall forget about it if what he does is tolerable. Otherwise, we can still punish him at that time,” Jiang Ming said.
In merely a few sentences, Jiang Ming had decided the so-called Senior Brother’s fate.
Chang Yiming flew out after he had conveyed his main message. He looked around the mountain, took a glimpse at the stone hut in the corner of the mountain’s back, and made his way to the other side of the cliff.
It was an even more remote area, where he opened up a place for himself.
“This is a good place indeed, a place which is located away from the duo, and I can sit on the side of a cliff while watching the scenery.” Chang Yiming was satisfied with the place he had selected.
Following that, he sent out a couple of messages to make some arrangements.
It was still very quiet on the mountain. Neither Jiang Ming nor Junior Sister were bothered by Ximen Guanghai’s plot at all.
Ten days later.
“Senior Brother!” Another Junior Sister flew over, jumped into his hands, wrapped her hands around his neck, and dangled in front of him.
This Zi Linglong was a few inches shorter and with a rounded face. Her smile looked even sweeter while her body was radiating five elemental rays.
“Five Elements, get away, don’t hug my Senior Brother!”
“Spatial, you’ve stayed with him for more than 10 days already. He’s mine from now onward!”
“Tl beat you up if you don’t get away!”
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?”
Jiang Ming, who was surprised at the presence of another Junior Sister, immediately stiffened as he listened to their conversation.
“Stop acting, just come over.” Jiang Ming said as he opened his arms..

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - Killed a Monk with a Slash
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Killed a Monk with a Slash
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Clone Dao meant all cloned bodies were one. Therefore, how would the two little Junior Sisters argue?
“Senior Brother, we’re acting because we were afraid you would not be used to so many of us.” Linglong Number One, the Spatial Clone, hugged his left arm.
“Senior Brother, you won’t be angry, will you?” Meanwhile, the Five Elemental Linglong hugged and swayed his right arm.
“I feel rather awkward.” Jiang Ming had the urge to scratch his head but could not move his arms.
“aren’t you supposed to feel happy with an additional me?” the two Zi Linglongs said simultaneously.
“Yes, I’m happy!” Jiang Ming looked at one and then at the other.
He suddenly felt he was on cloud nine, hugging one on his left and the other on his right.
He still had one on each side when he lay on the rattan chair. But it made the otherwise slightly spacious chair seem a little narrow.
Jiang Ming let a faint mist shroud around Chuyang Peak to protect their privacy, making it impossible for the outsiders to see through. It prevented Xi Yao and Chang Yiming from finding out what was happening inside.
“Senior Brother, the Five Elemental Clone is done. Hence, I plan to start cultivating in seclusion,” the Spatial Clone said as she drew circles on him with her finger.
“Cultivating in seclusion? Would your actions affect the main body who’s also cultivating simultaneously?” Jiang Ming asked with concern.
“No, it won’t. Although we share the same heart, we are independent individuals. Our telepathy may be disconnected temporarily, but we can synchronize our thoughts later. Therefore, Senior Brother, I’m a brand new me!” replied the Spatial Clone seductively.
“Haha! Why do you start cultivating in seclusion so fast? I heard that . Isthe main body’s cultivation base limits the clones, is it true?” Jiang Ming said as heat was raging in his body that he almost could not suppress his boiling blood from surging.
“Yes, the cultivation base of a clone can be of the same level as the main body at most. Just like when the main body’s cultivation base is at Dao Seed Realm, I can achieve up to the pinnacle of Dao Seed Realm only. But now, since I’ve just formed not long ago, my cultivation base is still very low, and I’m
still far away from mastering Spatial Sambodha. Therefore, I must improve it as soon as possible. Then I shall try whether I can comprehend the law!”
“It’s indeed logical. The law? Perhaps I’ll be able to help you at that time.”
Really?”
“Of course!”
“That’s great! Senior Brother, do help me when I’ve achieved the pinnacle of Dao Seed Realm. But which method are you going to use to help me comprehend the law? Don’t tell me it’s Sexual Cultivation Technique?”
“Err… It’s almost the same.”
“Senior Brother, that’s why you’ve gotten so bad. You must be thinking a lot recently.”
“Lonly said that it’s almost the same. It’s you who’s dirty-minded.”
“Hehe, Senior Brother, why is your heart beating so fast?”
“Ahem, this proves that I’ve exuberant vitality.”
“Senior Brother, I shall go cultivating now and try to reach the pinnacle of Dao Seed Realm. Then, we can practice the Sexual Cultivation Technique before I go out looking for encounters.”
“and you’re planning to go out?”
“Yes. I sensed a great encounter through the inheritance of the main body’s bloodline, and I must seize it after I reach the pinnacle. Then, I’ll cultivate in the mountain and accompany you, not going out again.”
“Encounters? With clones, it’s indeed not that dangerous. But please do remember to tell me whenever you need anything. I don’t go out of the mountain, but I’ve got a lot of good stuff,” Jiang Ming said.
He suddenly grabbed the little hand of Five Elemental Linglong, who’s been very quiet, and said, “Are you trying to commit a crime?”
“L feel the rhythm of life, manic hot blood, and raging Extreme Yang energy. Let’s see if I can calm it down for you,” said Five Elemental Linglong seriously.
“Hehe!” Spatial Linglong chuckled while covering her mouth.
Jiang Ming gave her a sly look.
Then, the Spatial Linglong flew away, starting her cultivation in seclusion.
Meanwhile, the Five Elemental Linglong stayed back, accompanying Jiang Ming.
“What do you like to eat? I’ll cook for you.”
“Anything because whatever you cook is tasty!”
“alright!”
Jiang Ming paced into the air and into the kitchen.
Not long later, he had taken two bowls of noodles to the rooftop.
The duo sat before the stone table, enjoying a bowl each.
“Egg noodles! White noodles, green onion, clear soup, and an egg. They are simple ingredients, but they make up the delicious bowl of noodles!” The Five Elemental Linglong ate with relish.
At that moment, a stream of light flew over. It fell on Jiang Ming’s hand as he lightly waved. It turned into a page of letters, sent over by Gu Hai.
The content was simple. Gu Hai said he would continue serving the Jiuyang Sect, expanding its estate, managing its property, and helping the sect in its efforts to try to dominate the entire Qing Province.
The other thing was that if Ximen Guanhai, the Sect Leader’s eldest disciple, came disturbing, Gu Hai requested that Jiang Ming let his Junior Sister not to hit too hard for the sake of the Sect Master.
The last point was that a team of Fo Sect disciples had come to Qing Province, wanting a piece of land from the sect to preach about Buddhism.
Jiang Ming handed over the letter when he saw Five Elemental Linglong looked over. He could not help but laugh. “You’re so powerful now that the old man is a bit scared of you. He has to go through me even when he wants to tell you something.”
The Five Elemental Linglong pouted. “It’s not that he’s scared, but he’s afraid that after he personally persuaded me to spare Ximen Guanhai’s life, it won’t be easy for him to persuade me again if Ximen Guanhai pisses me off again. Now that he goes through you, he’ll still be able to talk me off if there is
any trouble in the future. The old man is very smart.”
“I’s you who’s been appearing too cold and dominant. We are Jiuyang disciples, after all. If it weren’t because of the sect, we wouldn’t be who we are, would we? So we must not forget our roots. We shall not kill any disciple of the sect if it’s not too intolerable.”
“Senior Brother, I do understand!”
“Tknow I can count on you. By the way, you may go to cultivate in the spiritual field. I think with your high proficiency in the Five Elemental Dao and that you’ve almost mastered its Sambodha, you can withdraw spiritual essence there and try your best to improve your cultivation base as fast as possible.
Next, ah, I’m afraid there will be trouble, and you’ll need to sort it out.”
“Senior Brother, don’t you want to make a name for yourself?”
“What’s so good about making a name for myself? It’s better that I cultivate quietly. Having you alone is enough to represent Chuyang Peak. If you can’t settle it, I’ll do it for you secretly. With us working together, one as a public representative, while another one supporting from behind the scene, we’ll be
invincible in the world.”
“Hehe, Senior Brother, usually it’s a man who makes public appearances, but for us, it’s the opposite. Do I look more like a man than you do?”
“You jerk!” Jiang Ming rolled his eyes.
The Five Elemental Linglong rose to her feet, turned around, slightly bent her body, and aimed her butt at Jiang Ming.
Puhh!
Jiang Ming spat out a mouthful of noodles.
After they finished their meal, they looked at the stars in the night sky.
Five Elemental Linglong was lying on Jiang Ming. She reached out her hand and grabbed at the air. Then, a long stream of spiritual essence came together. She gulped it in and began refining.
Simultaneously when she was refining, she was radiating glamorous five elemental rays.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming gently hugged Five Elemental Linglong, conjuring five elemental Dao Fluctuation, which filled the surroundings, to support her cultivation.
It was a quiet night.
Jiang Ming felt exceptionally peaceful.
At that moment, he did not want to watch any porn at all.
suddenly, he slightly tilted his head. His eyes looked through the void, and he saw the scene 1,000 miles away.
He saw a monk trying to probe here with a special ability.
“They indeed have ill intentions!” Jiang Ming smirked and took out the Combat Mannequin, placing it on the other side of the abyss.
The Combat Mannequin withdrew its logsword, slashed through the void, and cut the monk in half, who died in an instant.
The sword was both powerful and hidden. Hence, no one in the Jiuyang Sect was alerted.
Jiang Ming did not keep the Combat Mannequin back. He merely stood in the abyss, looking toward the east. He looked as though he was a mountain guardian.
‘Junior Sister will be the publicly known expert, while the Combat Mannequin will act as an invisible figure guarding her and as a deterrent. I’ll take action only if the trouble still can’t be solved.’ Jiang Ming pondered while looking at his Junior Sister with a doting gaze.
10,000 miles away from the Jiuyang Sect was a temple where about ten saints were sitting cross-legged. Everyone was radiating with golden rays and a peaceful and profound aura.
At that moment, the leading monk abruptly opened his eyes and said, “Amitabha, Junior Brother Xuan Neng has returned to Buddha’s embrace!”
Following that, he started to recite the Sutra of the Afterlife.
“amitabha!” The other monks all began to bow their heads in solemnity, chanting sutras and releasing souls from purgatory.
After a while of chanting sutras, they stopped.
The great monk explained in a low voice, “Junior Brother Xuan Neng was sent to survey the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak. According to previous surveys, the Jiuyang Sect is considered a general force. It is divided into nine peaks, and Chuyang Peak is somewhat mysterious. It not only has Zi Linglong, who
defeated all geniuses of Eastern Region and Zhong Province but also survived Eastern Region’s catastrophe. I think it must have been a hidden secret, so I decided to send Junior Brother Xuan Neng to check them out before we planned our next move. Yet, not long after he left, he was killed before he could
send us messages. From my initial estimation, I’m afraid that there is a Paradis expert protecting the peak.”
He then asked for the others’ suggestions, “Therefore, gentlemen, what do you think we should do next?”
They remained silent.
After all, their team was not very strong—even their leader, the great monk, was merely a Paradis expert.
A young monk did a fist and palm salute as he said, “Master, I shall pay a visit to the Jiuyang Sect tomorrow as a first core disciple of the Fo Sect. With my relationship with their eldest disciple Ximen Guanhai, I believe I won’t be placed in a difficult position. Meanwhile, I’l try to probe Chuyang Peak and
also convince the Jiuyang Sect to turn to Buddha and enjoy great purity, freedom, and meri
“That’s great!”

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - System Task Change, Pat Pat Pat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: System Task Change, Pat Pat Pat!
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The sum rose up, shining brightly.
Jiang Ming was sweeping the courtyard, carrying water, and chopping firewood. After he had done all the work, he felt very awkward when he heard the System’s reward beep.
“System, what’s the meaning of letting me clean the courtyard and carry water? I can get clean water with a thought. I have the formation that can clean the fallen leaves spotlessly, and chopping wood… It’s not like I have nothing better to do!” Jiang Ming had felt the awkwardness for a while.
After all, he was not in a Wuxia’s world, where he could act like a monk sweeping the floor. He was, after all, in a fantasy world, where he could devastate the world and enjoy the convenience of boundless formation, consciousness, etc.
Even an outer disciple could tum his exhalation into a gale and get water by just reaching out his hand. Hence, how could Jiang Ming, as a First Seat, still have to carry water and chop wood manually?
It would make him look like a fool, wouldn’t it?
“Ding: In view of the host’s current state, in which you are able to go up the sky, grab the moon and down to the lake, catching a turtle, the following changes can be made to your daily rewards!”
“First: Maintain the current state as it is.”
“Second: Change daily labors to daily check-in for rewards. There won’t be surprises except for specific times. The rest remain unchanged.”
“Third: Change daily labors to refine a medicinal pill or artifact for rewards. The rest remain unchanged.”
“Fourth: Change daily labors to cook a meal. The rewards will be increased, may even have a blast. There will be surprises. The rest remain unchanged.”
“Ding: Please select one.”
Listening to the notification, he felt rather speechless.
The System gave four options, but in fact, he had only three. The principle remained the same, still binding him to the mountain.
Jiang Ming began weighing the three options’ pros and cons.
Check-in? But without surprise?
Refine Artifacts? It’s too troublesome. Jiang Ming felt he’d better do the house chores. Moreover, he was not short of medicinal pills and Dao Vessels; hence refining Artifacts was merely a waste of time.
Cook a meal? Not only did his Junior Sister like it, but he craved it too. He craved all demons’ meat, especially after he had the seafood feast. Moreover, there would be surprises.
After he thought about all the options available, he felt that check-in was the simplest thing to do.
“Ding: A reminder to you that it won’t be replaced for about 100 years once selected. There are 90 years and three months remaining. Please choose carefully.”
“system, it’s 90 years, and I’m sure I’ll ascend before that. What’d happen then?” Jiang Ming inquired.
“Ding: No answer to be given.”
“L.L..I put up my middle finger!” Jiang Ming almost cursed.
“It’s 90 years of work. How could it not be troublesome?” He pondered and made his decision in the end, “I choose to cook a meal daily. The advantages of having surprises are still greater than the troubles of cooking a meal.”
“Ding: Congratulations on your selection. Hint, time continues as before. However, once you miss a day, time accumulated would end and require a fresh start!”
Jiang Ming immediately bumbled his way to the kitchen.
Not long later, he carried a tray and landed on the rooftop.
On a tray were two porridge bowls, radiating five-colored rays corresponding to the five elements. As the rays were rotating and intertwining, they produced different sights.
There were another few pieces of biscuits.
“Little girl, let’s eat first!” Jiang Ming softly called Five Elemental Linglong, who was still cultivating.
The swirling vortex of spiritual essence that had condensed over her head gave a lurch and then abruptly dispersed, turning into a gust of wind, which was again affected by an inexplicable force and eventually turned into only a fresh breeze.
Five Elemental Linglong opened her eyes and blinked. She was then immediately attracted by a mouth-watering smell. As she sniffed further, her eyes gleamed. “Senior Brother, what smells so good? I feel a great improvement in my mana and the sublimation of my Five Elemental Daoist Body with just a
sniff. What’s it that smells so tasty?”
She made a leap and landed before the stone table. When she looked at the dish on the table, her eyes squinted to a crescent shape. “Five-colored porridge that is actually deducing the wonder of five elements? The five main ingredients: green beans, red beans, yellow beans, white and black beans are
common, but they are all top-grade spiritual beans. When boiled in porridge, their spiritual substances are fused together as if they were refined as medicinal pills. Wonderful, wonderful, this is absolutely great for me! Senior Brother, you’re so amazing. I love you so much!” As she exclaimed, she flew
toward Jiang Ming, wrapped her hands around him, and could not help to give him a kiss.
“You have bad breath!” Jiang Ming complained.
“Senior Brother, why do I feel like I can’t help but bite you?” After she said that, she leaned over Jiang Ming’s shoulder and bit down. She even ground, but she could leave no teeth marks. Hence, she grunted in anger.
“You are my Senior Brother indeed. Even your skin is so thick.” Five Elemental Linglong went back to her seat with a flash.
“Did you just realize it?” laughed Jiang Ming.
The duo eventually sat down, enjoying their breakfast.
At this moment, a robust aura surged from afar. They merely took a glimpse at it and shifted their focus. They knew it was the result of Xi Yao’s breakthrough. She had become a Nascent Soul expert.
“Senior Brother.”
“Yes?”
“Is Xi Yao good-looking?”
“Pretty much.”
“She’s well qualified too, right?”
“Not too bad.”
“She does have a large blossom and a pleasing curve, right?”
“Barely.”
“Senior Brother, you aren’t taking my questions seriously.”
“Frankly, how can she be compared to you?”
“Hehe, you aren’t telling the truth. She’s, after all, a Holy Daughter. What if you let her be your concubine?”
Meanwhile, she was slurping the porridge like a cat as her eyes were widely opened, staring at Jiang Ming.
The five-colored rays surrounded her continuously, causing her aura to surge while her blood raced in her body like a roaring river. It was the wonder of the five-colored porridge.
“What a pain in the ass. Don’t you have better things to do?” Jiang Ming rebutted.
“Senior Brother, my ass isn’t painful at all!”
Pffft. Jiang Ming sputtered.
Then he grumbled as he wiped his mouth. “You aren’t as cute as when you were little already.”
“Tl call Hua Huo and the other three here. They’re little!”
“You need a spanking, don’t you?”
Jiang Ming put down the bowl in his hand, lifted his hand, grabbed, pulled Five Elemental Linglong over, and placed her horizontally with her face down on his lap.
Pat! Pat pat! Pat pat pat! Jiang Ming spanked her.
Her butt was so bouncy and sounded so melodious when spanked that he became rather addicted.
The duo was frolicking while Jiang Ming managed to fondle his Junior Sister too.
“Ding: Congratulations for having made a spiritual meal, enjoyed the meal, taken pleasure in spanking, and relished each moment. Thus, you are rewarded with 3 months of cultivation and a Five Elemental Heavenly Heart Pill.”
The System added the explanation of the pill. “Five Elemental Heavenly Heart Pill: For the consumption of Five Elemental Daoist Body. Its nature, which is in tune with the five elements of heavens and earth, allows the consumer to comprehend the Five Elemental Sambodha directly. If the consumer has
a tiptop comprehension level, his Five Elemental can even reach the pinnacle.”
Three months of cultivation… That was too amazing.
But Jiang Ming felt rather speechless with the medicinal pill given. Jiang Ming felt rather resentful, wondering who really was the owner? After all, it was not the first time the System had given something to his Junior Sister.
When Junior Sister was still in the God of Thunder Immortal Treasure, the System had given him a couple of Daoist Bodies, which were obviously useless to him but his Junior Sister. At that time, his Junior Sister intended to cultivate clones as soon as she got back.
Now the System has given such a medicinal pill, which could be said as a spiritual pill. But it was also obvious that the pill was prepared for his Junior Sister.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming still gave the pill to Five Elemental Junior Sister and explained its functionality.
“Do you even have this kind of medicinal pill? Senior Brother, you are too awesome!” Junior Sister exclaimed.
“ma male, I don’t have that thing.” Jiang Ming said slyly.
Pfft…!
His little Junior Sister spurted out a mouthful of tea to a long distance.
Jiang Ming laughed as he rose to his feet and gazed in Taiyang Peak’s direction.
He saw a Dao Seed monk coming over.
Dao Seed Realm was a stage of accumulation in which the accumulation amount would determine one’s future potential. Therefore, many geniuses would forcibly suppress themselves to stay in this realm as long as possible.
Xi Yao was one of them. If she wanted to make a breakthrough, she would have become a Nascent Soul Realm expert for a very long time.
Now that all her efforts paid off. She managed to comprehend Extreme Yin Sambodha and cultivated it here in the mountain for about a year till its mastery, she could finally move on to the next realm.
‘Tkilled one yesterday, and today another one came over openly? Haha… I don’t care who you are, provided you don’t provoke me. Otherwise, hehe!” Jiang Ming thought as his face wore a grim look.
He did not need to think about it to guess that the aim of monks in coming here to Eastern Region was to preach Buddhism and seize territory.
He also thought the monks must have gotten used to being arrogant because they chose to come to the Jiuyang Sect instead of going elsewhere. The Jiuyang Sect was, after all, the largest sect in Eastern Region after the turmoil.
‘I think there’s a deep hidden secret behind the incident whereby the Fo Sect of Western Region was destroyed!” As Jiang Ming thought, he called up the Human Path Records.
Name: Hui Xin
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: The First Seat Core Disciple of Fo Sect
Relationship: 0
Innate talent: Nine Stars
Status: With the death of Wan Fu, and the occupation of his sect, his heart was filled with demonic fire, but there was nothing he could do about it. He came to the Eastern Region with his Master, seeking a place to stay and turn it into a Buddhist state. With the exception of the Feng and Yun Provinces,
where the Qingyun Sect is located, there is a team of Buddhist disciples preaching in the other seven provinces each. Of the seven teams, even if one succeeds, it will be a great Buddhist virtue.
The Jiuyang Sect is the largest sect in Qing Province. Hence, the other little sects and clans are not a concern.
In fact, they speculated that the Jiuyang Sect isn’t considered a threat, only the Chuyang Peak, which seems secretive. The incident where his Senior Uncle Xuan Neng came probing yet was killed further proved their speculation.
Therefore, he comes openly today to find out more details and to try to enlighten all nine peaks of the Jiuyang Sect so that they can be freed from suffering, return to the Buddha and enjoy great purity and freedom.
Jiang Ming was jaw-dropped, looking at Hui Xin’s Status. “I’ve finally confirmed that the Fo Sect is taking this opportunity to spread their Buddhism. Otherwise, why would they form seven teams? And this Hui Xin, a mere Dao Seed expert, actually wants to enlighten the entire The Jiuyang Sect? I wonder
if he’s arrogant or he’s despising us? Anyway, he’s indeed too awesome for being so ambitious, hehe.” Jiang Ming could not help but be amused.

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - Feng Yungi Had Come
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Feng Yungi Had Come
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At the Qingyun Sect…
The sect was still Eastern Region’s Sacred Land, high above the rest and a cultivation place to which everyone aspires.
‘There was a huge palace in the midst of the astral flow layer. It was surrounded by immortal light and supported by a great formation. The palace remained unaffected in the slightest despite the storm sweeping by and consistently changing weather.
An old man was seen standing in the palace.
At this moment, Lin Han flew over, bowing towards the old man as he said, “Greetings to you, my Supreme Elder.”
“How’s your cultivation going?” The old man was Qing Fengzi. Putting his hands behind his back, he looked through the sky toward the direction where the Jiuyang Sect was.
“Not so well!” Lin Han smiled bitterly. “I’m of Mystic Ice Body. Comprehended Water Dao but unable to go further in comprehending Extreme Yin Dao. Hence, I’m not sure if I shall continue to accumulate or break through to the Nascent Soul Realm with Water Dao?”
“Breaking through with Water Dao is considered pretty good. Let me give you a mission chastening yourself. If you still fail, then just go for a breakthrough.” replied Qing Fengzi.
“Tm all ears.”
“All members of Long Yuan, Submerged Dragon Immortal Union, and the Yinmo Sect who came to Eastern Region were killed that night. This year, many Long Yuan and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union experts came probing, but none of them dared to appear openly because of the ordeal they faced
here. But now, the Fo Sect of Western Region is here to preach to turn all people into Buddhist followers. Their acts obviously are despising our Qingyun Sect. Nevertheless, in the current Eastern Region, the Jiuyang Sect is the only sect we are worried about.”
“The Jiuyang Sect?”
“Yes. As to the reasons for this, you don’t have to know. Just today, a Fo Sect’s disciple has gone to the Jiuyang Sect. Thus, I want you to go there to send the Jiuyang Sect a message that Eastern Region belongs to the people of Eastern Region. Also, please check out what’s different about Chuyang Peak.”
“Yes, Supreme Elder!”
Qing Fengzi remained looking in the direction of the Jiuyang Sect even when Lin Han was leaving.
“I’ve been trying to find out what happened that night for more than a year but to no avail. Even the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, Riyue Sect, Tianyuan School, Long Yuan, and the rest have been investigating but to no avail. Who’s the one who did it that night? Was he an immortal? And the Fo Sect, what’s
their plan actually? Do they really voluntarily give up their sect just to spread their Buddhism to the world? I think something is not right indeed. What a year of troubles!” Qing Fengzi sighed.
He understood that the Qingyun Sect was still the largest sect in the current Eastern Region, but the sect was no longer as mighty as it was before.
In the Jiuyang Sect.
With the coming of Hui Xin, Ximen Guanhai took the initiative to offer hospitality.
And the Sect Master approved his initiative without much consideration. After all, Hui Xin was not a Holy Buddha Son but a mere disciple coming from the Western Region. Hence, it was not suitable for the Sect Master to entertain personally.
“Hui Xin, it has been a while, and I have never thought that we would meet again. It’s really a fate that I’ve just got back, and you come to Eastern Region. Now that I’m the host, please give me the opportunity to provide you with hospitality, and also, I’ll show you around the Jiuyang Sect.” The handsome
Ximen Haiguan said in a loud voice.
“Senior Brother Ximen, I know you’re back. That’s why I came to visit you as soon as I got here.” Hui Xin smiled.
The two began catching up harmoniously. There was a lot of laughter and good conversation.
“Senior Brother Ximen, I’ve heard that the Eastern Region, especially the Jiuyang Sect, is full of geniuses. Can you introduce me to the geniuses of each peak?” Hui Xin asked.
“Sure!” Ximen Guanhai accepted instantly as he gleamed. Then, he commanded a disciple to invite geniuses of each peak here.
On Chuyang Peak!
Chang Yiming was sitting cross-legged in a stone house located at a side of the abyss.
At this moment, a paper crane flew over, and he opened his eyes to grab it. Then, he received the message that their Senior Brother was calling all peaks’ First Seats to receive the visitation of the First Seat Core Disciple of the Fo Sect.
“This is interesting!” Chang Yiming thought as he rose to his feet and saw a paper crane fly into the manor.
He remained standing for a while before he flew towards Jiang Ming.
“Brother Jiang!” He greeted Jiang Ming and landed on the rooftop.
At this moment, he only saw Jiang Ming. Zi Linglong was not around.
“Going?” Chang Yiming asked while smiling. He even sat down and poured himself a cup of tea as though he was at his home.
No, it’s not interesting at all!” Jiang Ming shook his head and explained, “He’s just the Taiyang Peak’ First Seat, hence no right to forcibly call every one of us. What about you?”
“Just like you’ve said, it’s not interesting at all. The Fo Sect’s disciple is obviously coming with bad intentions. They are here to seize our territory and resources to spread Buddhism if they were to stay here. Moreover, as outsiders, they not only come to pay homage to our sect in a swaggering way but also
let a mere disciple come. Are they despising us?”
He snorted and added, “I don’t believe that Ximen Guanhai isn’t aware of this. And he actually wanted to invite all First Seat of each peak there to support? Ha, this is too much!”
“Let’s just ignore it! What about Senior Brother Zhang? I haven’t seen him for quite some time.” Jiang Ming smiled.
“He’s trying to seize other territories outside the sect!” Chang Yiming replied slyly.
In this year, many sect’s disciples were out to level the mountains, divide the rivers, and help the victims. They also were seizing territories in their efforts of making the entire Qing Province Jiuyang Sect’s.
In other words, the Qingyun Sect was expanding. With so many forces being wiped out during the war, the survival naturally shall redraw their territory’s boundary.
Zhang Junbao was one of the disciples who had gone to execute it.
“It’s still your place that’s at leisure. Neither do you have to take care of the sect’s duty nor handle any messy rivalry among disciples. First Seat Jiang, I think I shall just move to Chuyang Peak and forget about the rest.” Chang Yiming suddenly exclaimed.
“If you are to stay here, I think Senior Uncle Chang will definitely hang you up and beat you.”
“Ha, that old man is crazy, more unreliable than yours.”
“Since Senior Uncle Chang is always a drunkard, I think it’s possible. By the way, how’s Senior Sister Momo?”
“She’s good!”
