“That’s great! Ahem, let me ask you a thing, if there’s a mortal woman, who can’t cultivate or temper her body and soul, hence can’t get rid of her body’s toxins, micro-sized worms, and so on. And if you were to fall in love with her, were you able to kiss her when her face was filled with oily pores as large
as cups and where bugs were crawling.”
Chang Yiming retched.
“Haha, could it be that you’ve really experienced it?”
“Sigh, it’s a long story, but frankly, I do!”
Chang Yiming was reminded of when he was almost disappointed in all women.
He became physically and mentally exhausted on a mission in slaying demons. Thus, he visited a brothel.
‘There were many dancing enchantingly and seductively.
He called one to accompany him. Although he was much older, how could he resist a little girl’s endless flirtation when he spent much of his time on the mountain?
Nevertheless, he remained vigilant.
Slightly executing his Dharma eyes, he saw the pores on her face suddenly grow as large as a bowl. Inside the pores were queasy sticky mucus that even dripped out and crawling bugs.
He was so disgusted that he almost destroyed the brothel. He quickly ran away, and it took him a while to calm down.
He later met an experienced dandy who was actively f*cking the mortal women. Hence, he asked the dandy, who gave a simple reply. The dandy said, “Close all your senses, and a beautiful woman would remain beautiful. Else, go to the brothel that specializes in supplying fairies, only it’s too expensive.”
“What a good solution. So have you also started doing the same?” laughed Jiang Ming.
“No, don’t simply say. I’m still a virgin.”
“Haha!”
The two were chatting.
Chang Yiming did not attend the meeting, and Jiang Ming knew the reason why he did so.
Jiang Ming was rather looking forward to what would happen next too.
Approaching noon…
A group of people was seen pacing in the air, coming over to Reception Peak..

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - Mind Control? One Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Mind Control? One Down
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the gazebo.
“They’re here already? Well, it seems like they can’t wait any longer,” Chang Yiming said, his voice filled with derision. He stood up and looked at Jiang Ming, “I’m pretty sure they didn’t come with good intentions. What should we do to them?”
“Let’s see what they’re here for first,” Jiang Ming replied as he rose to his feet. He leaped into the air and landed in the courtyard. “After all, we’re from the same sect, and we should show him some respect.”
He walked toward the guest receiving platform at a steady pace. The Dao Square had created a door with its power, and the Dao Rhythm here dissipated before this group of people arrived.
Inside the Dao Square, he was the king.
“Hah, look who’s here. Junior Brother Jiang, don’t you know any manners? Your Senior Brother is here, and not only did you not come out to welcome him, but you made him wait for so long!”
‘The person who talked was a fat young man with short stature.
He was wearing a dark gold robe that exuded a low-key luxury vibe. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and there was an arrogant expression on his face.
“Tian Dafeng, you’re still as annoying as you were in the past. Nothing good can come out of your mouth,” Chang Yiming, who was standing beside Jiang Ming, said sarcastically.
After that, he made a bow at the man standing in the front of the group.
Jiang Ming glanced at Tian Dafeng, He knew who he was. He was the head disciple of Haoyang Peak’s First Seat, and he was in the Golden Core Realm.
They rarely talked to each other.
“Chang Yiming, how dare you!” Tian Dafeng growled, but judging from the situation, he knew that it wouldn’t do him any good if he lashed at Tian Yiming here right now. Therefore, he forcibly pushed his anger down and dusted his robe. “We have a guest today, so I’m not going to stoop down to your
level and argue with you.”
He then looked at Jiang Ming. “What are you still waiting for? Hurry up and bow to your Senior Brother.”
“Both him and I are the head disciple of our respective peaks. We’re standing on equal ground, so why should I bow to him?” Jiang Ming replied with his hands behind his back. “If you have anything to tell me, say it now.”
“How insolent!” Tian Dafeng growled coldly, “We have our Senior Brother and guest here, yet you still gave us this kind of attitude? It’s no wonder that First Seat Gu would accept you as his disciple!”
Slap!
The moment he finished speaking, he was sent flying several hundred meters away with a slap.
Blood was dripping out of his mouth, and he had lost a few of his teeth.
Light gathered in the area beside Jiang Ming, and Zi Linglong walked out of it. She gazed at Tian Dafeng and said coldly, “You’re the first person who has the nerves to talk like that to my Senior Brother and Master. I’ll spare you this time on behalf of the First Seat of Haoyang Peak. However, if you dare to
do it again next time, I’ll kill you!”
She had just finished her cultivation, and she flew into a rage when she heard what Tian Dafeng said.
Jiang Ming’s face was gloomy as well.
“That’s right. If there is next time, we’ll kill you,” Jiang Ming said.
Five Elemental Linglong’s eyes glowed, and then she nodded.
They were the master of this peak, and if those who came treated them respectfully, they would treat them the same way. However, if they had the guts to show their attitude, they would make sure they would regret what they did.
“That’s enough, Linglong, Jiang Ming,” Ximen Guanhai said, his face grim. He was their Senior Brother, and nobody dared to treat him lightly in the sect.
Now that he had returned as a Nascent Soul martial artist, he had become a lot stronger than most of the First Seats. Therefore, he expected the disciples in the sect would treat him reverently. Even if they did not do so, at the very least, they would show him some respect.
However, what had the people from Chuyang Peak done?
Not only did they not come out and welcome him, but they also had the nerves to show him attitude?
He was seriously pissed off.
“Tll repeat again. If you have anything to say, say it now. If not, please leave!” Jiang Ming said, his voice flat.
Whoosh!
‘The Human Paths Record was opened up.
Name: Ximen Guanhai.
Race: Human.
Gender: Man.
Cultivation Base: Nascent Soul Realm (Puppet of the third prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty).
Background; Head disciple of the Jiuyang Sect’s Taiyang Peal’s First Seat.
Relationship: ~78.
Innate Talent: 8 stars.
Status: He joined the Jiuyang Sect when he was a kid. The Sect Master could see his potential, so he decided to take him in as his disciple. He went out to gather more experience when he reached the Golden Core Realm. After narrowly escaping death, he arrived at Zhong Province and successfully
ascended into the Purple Mansion Realm. He came across the third prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty one year ago. After the third prince learned of his identity, he controlled his mind with his special ability and turned him into his puppet. At the cost of expending his potential, he raised his cultivation to
the Nascent Soul Realm in just one year. After that, he turned to the Jiuyang Sect to look into the sect and Zi Linglong’s secrets. By the time he arrived, he was overjoyed, and he felt it was a chance when he did not see anyone from Chuyang Peak. Hui Xin came to meet them, yet the people from Chuyang
Peak refused to show up. When Hui Xin proposed to come to Chuyang Peak to meet Zi Linglong, he was even more delighted.
Jiang Ming was speechless.
‘What a poor fellow.
In fact, he felt something was not right as well. After all, even the Sect Master had only ascended to the Primal Spirit Realm several years ago, and there were only a handful of people in the sect who had reached the Nascent Soul Realm.
However, this guy only went out for a few years, and he came back as a Nascent Soul martial artist.
Initially, he did not care about it, but he did not expect it to turn out this way.
“There is this eighteenth prince from the Great Zhou Dynasty, and now there’s another third prince? Are they all targeting Linglong? Well, I guess so. If not, there is no need for them to go to the extent of creating a puppet from a second-rate sect. It seems to me that the Great Zhou Dynasty is looking for
some trouble!”
That said, Jiang Ming was not worried about it.
One thing was that the Great Zhou Dynasty was located in Zhong Province, which was very far from them. Even if they waged war against the Jiuyang Sect, he had the confidence of crushing them as well.
Ximen Guanhai’s face was dark. Before he could say anything, Tian Dafeng returned and snarled. “How dare you slap me in the cheek, Linglong. I’m the head disciple of Haoyang Peak. I’ve already forgiven you for not greeting us when we made it all the way here, but how could you slap me on the cheek?
Do you want to rebel against the Jiuyang Sect?!”
“Keep your mouth shut. If not, you’ll need to bear the consequences yourself!” Five Elemental Linglong pointed at the Tian Dafeng and said, her voice cold and her expression bereft of emotion.
“L. 1…” Tian Dafeng wanted to say something more, but he was so startled that he couldn’t squeeze any word out of his mouth, and there was a chill running down his spine.
Although he did not believe that Zi Linglong would have the guts to kill him, what if she could?
Zi Linglong was highly admired in the sect. Even if she killed him, she wouldn’t be punished at all.
“You’re so cool!” Chang Yiming exclaimed.
The people in front of them frowned.
Ximen Guanhai looked at them gloomily as he sent a message to someone in the distance secretly.
Hui Xin had been standing beside him quietly with a smile on his face. Suddenly, he noticed something, and he frowned slightly. However, he did not say anything and pretended as if he did not notice it.
Five Elemental Linglong turned to Jiang Ming, grinning from ear to ear.
“Manners!” Jiang Ming reprimanded.
It went without saying that both of them knew what Ximen Guanhai was doing.
“Tm the head disciple of Haoyang Peak, and I represent Haoyang Peak. I came here in the hope of exchanging knowledge and skills with you, but see what you did to me! You slapped me in the face, and you didn’t take our Senior Brother seriously! Are you looking down on Haoyang Peak?!” Tian Dafeng
said as his face contorted in anger, “Not only that, but you even threatened to kill me? It’s no wonder that the people from Chuyang Peak would rebel against the sect and slaughter many people in the past. All of you are the same. You’re monsters! You’re evil and rotten to the core! I need to tell the Sect
Master about this. I want him to…”
Pfft!
Before Tian Dafeng could finish his sentence, Zi Linglong raised her hand and bifurcated him.
Ximen Guanhai was stunned. He did not expect that Zi Linglong would actually kill Tian Dafeng in front of everyone.
That being said, a faint smile crossed his face.
“Amitabha!” Huixin chanted. He lowered his head and did not say anything anymore.
“You! How dare you kill one of your own?!” Ximen Guanhai shouted, “Are you guys really going to rebel against the sect? I’m going to inform the Sect Master about this.”
With that, he leaped into the air and flew away.
“Amitabha!”
Hui Xin gave them a smile and followed after Ximen Guanhai.
The rest of the disciples looked at them with a cold grin on their faces and went away as well.
“Linglong, you… how could you kill a head disciple in front of everyone? This is going to be a lot of trouble,” Chang Yiming said as he also had realized the gravity of the situation.
‘The head disciple represented the pride of a peak. Even if they did something wrong, one should never kill them. What’s more, Tian Dafeng just talked to them in a rude manner. He did not do anything overboard yet.
“That said, something was not right with Tian Dafeng before his death. Judging from what I know about him, he wasn’t someone who would say something like that,” Chang Yiming added.
“Don’t worry. Everything will be fine,” Jiang Ming smiled, “We just want to cultivate. We want nothing to do with the people from the outside. If they don’t bother us, we won’t bother them. I’m sure the Sect Master and the First Seats would understand.”
“What if they don’t?” Five Elemental Linglong asked.
“Then we have no other choice but to show them who is the boss,” Jiang Ming replied.
Chang Yiming shook his head as he looked helplessly at the pair of people in front of him.
He did not know what to say anymore, but one thing he knew was that he would always stand by their side.
“Linglong, I’m sure this matter will cause some trouble for us. I guess you should take this opportunity to clean up those unrelated people in the sect,” Jiang Ming said when he remembered Chuyang Peak. “Yue Cheng and the others are the remnant forces of the Yinmo Sect. I’ll leave them in your hands.”
“You know about that, Senior Brother?” Linglong exclaimed.
“Of course, I know about it. Now that the Yinmo Sect is gone, there’s no use of keeping them.”
“Okay!” Five Elemental Linglong said. Since Jiang Ming had known about it for a long time, she figured that he was keeping Yue Cheng to learn about the movement of the Yinmo Sect.
However, there was one person who was oblivious to the entire thing. Chang Yiming’s face tured pale when he heard their conversation, and he said, “What?! Zhiyang Sect’s First Seat is from the Yinmo Sect? How is that possible?!”
Jiang Ming chuckled, but he did not say anything. He looked in the direction where Ximen Guanhai was heading and lifted his arm..

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - Killing through the Causal Line
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Killing through the Causal Line
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
He looked toward Ximen Guanhai, and then he noticed the strands of causal lines on him. One of them was particularly thick that spread across the Akasa and linked with Zhong Province in the distance.
“I think this is the causal line that links to the third prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Since you have the nerve to lay your eyes on my Junior Sister, I should teach you a lesson first!”
Jiang Ming gathered the force of karma in his hand and threw it toward the third prince through the causal line.
Five Elemental Linglong was standing beside him. When she noticed what he had done, she squinted her eyes and thought, ‘Is this the Karma Law? I didn’t expect that he would comprehend this kind of law. What kind of opportunity has he come across, and how many secrets he’s hiding from me?”
Linglong was startled.
If she hadn’t tested Jiang Ming before, she would’ve thought that he had been reborn like her.
“What are you doing?” Chang Yiming asked.
“There’s a bug,” Jiang Ming replied. After that, he turned around and went back into the courtyard.
He was certain that Linglong had noticed what he did just now. As for Chang Yiming, well, there was something that he shouldn’t be knowing.
“Really? Why didn’t I see any bugs?” Chang Yiming asked.
He knew that Jiang Ming had become different, and he must be hiding something from him. It was just that since Jiang Ming refused to tell him anything, he wouldn’t ask him.
Ximen Guanhai had just arrived at Taiyang Peak, and his heart suddenly skipped a beat. He jerked his head back to look at Chuyang Peak, and he hurriedly went to look for the Sect Master.
Zhong Province, the Great Zhou Dynasty.
In the middle of the imperial capital, the palace of the third prince…
‘The palace was massive and magnificent, with immortal lights pulsating everywhere. The divine sounds could be heard everywhere, and most of the servants here were from the Golden Core Realm. All of them looked ethereally beautiful, and each of them was a beauty in their own right.
‘They would be regarded as beauties in the world outside, but they were only servants in the palace.
The palace was filled with all sorts of decorative items to the brim, and most of them were artifacts. Some of them were blowing air, while the others were emitting cold air and glowing in a different light.
One man sat on the cloud bed in the deepest part of the room. He was none other than the third prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. He was renowned as a prodigy amongst his peers, and some of them even said that he had the potential of becoming an immortal.
There was a silhouette behind his back, and it was only when one went closer to him would realize that it was the Paradis projection.
It was very rare for a prince to cultivate to Paradis Realm. However, he suddenly let out a pained cry. The immortal lights on him went astray, and the various protective forces that were on him exploded, shattering the palace.
In the end, a mirror appeared. It was a supreme-grade Dao Vessel.
Crack!
The mirror cracked, and it nearly broke into half.
‘There was a cut on the third prince’s face as well. It ran across his nose, slashing through his eyes, and blood was flowing out profusely.
“Who did this!”
Deep in the imperial palace came an angry cry. A streak of sword energy then flew across the air and slashed across the karma. Just when the person was about to trace where the energy was going, he missed his chance and lost his target.
Meanwhile, several human figures appeared on top of the third prince’s palace. They looked at the crater below with a dark expression etched on their faces.
‘They were at the imperial capital of the Great Zhou Dynasty. There were plenty of powerful martial artists here, not to mention that the entire area was protected by several layers of formations and arrays. However, the attacker was still able to go through all the protections and injured the third prince.
‘Whoever the person was, they felt this was a humiliation for the imperial court, and their faces became even uglier when they saw the wound on the third prince’s face.
The wound was laced with the force of law, and they needed a lot of effort to cure it.
“We have to get to the bottom of this!” Someone in the palace shouted.
Eastern Region, Chuyang Peak.
“Seems like they’re not known as the Great Zhou Dynasty for nothing. They even have an array that could counter the karma force. Not only that, but the third prince has a lot of items to protect him. I guess I need a lot more than that if I want to get rid of him. Anyway, there’s still a lot of time. I shall let
him live for some time now,” Jiang Ming said.
It went without saying that he could still attack him again, but it would be a lot harder now since they had raised their guard.
As for the Projection. Well, he hadn’t met the third prince personally, so he couldn’t learn about him even if he killed him right now.
“Twonder if they can pinpoint my location through the karma force. Even though it would be very hard to do, it should be a piece of cake for martial artists who have mastered the Karma Law.
“The Fo Sect is proficient in the Karma Law. It would be very interesting if I could use the attack on them.”
Jiang Ming killed his thoughts and landed in the gazebo on the rooftop.
Chang Yiming did not follow after him. However, Jiang Ming felt he should tell his master about Yue Cheng being a member of the Yinmo Sect.
He arrived at the stone building, and a worried expression sat on his face. He pulled a talisman out, said something into it, and sent it out.
Under the gazebo…
“Senior Brother, Tian Dafeng wanted to step back just now, but Ximen Guanhai had to do something and made him piss me off,” Five Elemental Linglong said as she leaned toward Jiang Ming, “I’m sure Ximen Guanhai knows Tian Dafeng is no match for me and he has no chance to fight with me for the
position of the Sect Master, so why did he still want to do that? After all, he has been training in the outside world for so many years. He would’ve been dead already if he didn’t know how to conceal his emotion and intention.”
“He’s been mind-controlled!” Jiang Ming said.
“What?!” Linglong was stunned.
‘I don’t remember Ximen Guanhai being mind-controlled by other people!”
That said, she accepted it very soon. After all, things had become so much different from her previous life that she did not think it was strange anymore.
‘Lguess it must be because I’ve attracted too much attention after defeating so many geniuses. They all want to know my secret, so they mind-controlled Ximen Guanhai to observe me from the dark.’
“Yeah, I’ve injured the mastermind through the causal line. Although I couldn’t kill him, I’ve gotten some information. He should be controlled by the royal family from the Great Zhao Dynasty.”
“The Great Zhao Dynasty? Hold on a second. How did you manage to injure him while you were so far away from him? Did you do that again?”
“How many times do I have to tell you that I’m not like you? I don’t have such a thing!”
“Just admit it, Senior Brother. It’s not that I’m going to laugh at you.”
“Hah!”
In the mortal city below the mountain…
Gu Hai was enjoying tea with Yin Yue in a teahouse. There was an old man telling stories on the stage, and both of them were having a good time.
“You’re the First Seat of Chuyang Peak. Are you sure nothing would happen if you don’t go back?” Yin Yue asked.
“Don’t worry. Nothing would happen. Linglong has grown up a lot, and I’m sure no one, not even the Great Monarch could defeat her right now. Besides, Jiang Ming is smart and mature. He can handle every situation without any problem.”
“Well, you’re right. Anyway, the sect is going to take in more disciples after this. You’re not going to say no this time, are you?”
“Tm going to pass the First Seat to Jiang Ming, and that’s something he should be taking care of.”
“Jiang Ming? His cultivation level is pretty low. Are you sure about that? I’m worried that he might not be able to handle the situation.”
“Don’t underestimate him. I thought his cultivation level was low as well, but in the past few years, I have increasingly found that he’s hiding something from me. Also, when I went back, I found that the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect treated him with respect. I’m sure you know how arrogant and
prideful those Holy Daughters and Holy Sons are, so it’s very unlikely for her to treat him like that. Therefore, I’m pretty certain that Jiang Ming is hiding his strength the whole time.”
“Well, maybe you are right.”
While they were talking, two light streaks came into their minds, and their expression changed.
“What?! Linglong killed Tian Dafeng? Isn’t he the head disciple of Haoyang Peak? This is bad. Let’s go back to the sect right now!”
“calm down, Don’t you feel this is suspicious? How would Linglong kill Tian Dafeng? Judging from what I know about her, she might not even know who Tian Dafeng is, so how would she kill him?”
“That’s true. Linglong rarely left Chuyang Peak. Either Tian Dafeng went over there and provoked her, so she killed him. Is Ximen Guanhai behind this too?”
“I guess so. Ever since he came back, he has been making a lot of scenes. I’m pretty sure that he wants to become the Sect Master, and Linglong will be his biggest obstacle. Therefore, he must get rid of her as soon as possible.”
“This is bad. After all, it’s considered a violation of the sect’s rule for killing one of our own. If the Sect Master doesn’t do anything, he might not be able to calm the crowd down. If he punishes her… She has a lot of potential, and she’s the only one who can keep the sect running for another thousand
years!”
“So we should just stay here and enjoy our tea.”
“What if he really punishes Linglong?”
“Even if he’s really going to punish Linglong, you don’t have to worry about her as well. After all, even the Sect Master is no match for her. Besides, I want to see if Jiang Ming will make any move too. If things really have gone out of hand, then we’ll go back.”
“You’re their master, and you’re going to let them handle the matter themselves? You’ve changed, Gu Hai. You’re not like this in the past!”
“Well, I’m old, and the younger generations will do all right on their own.”
“I thought of wanting a kid, but after seeing what you’ve become, I think I should reconsider my choice.”
ptt”
Gu Hai spurted the tea. His face turned red in embarrassment.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming received a letter through the crane. At the same time, he also felt that a lot of people were watching them.
“The Sect Master wants to see us. I don’t have a good feeling about this.”
“Leave it to me, Senior Brother. I’ll handle it.”
“You’re right. You should try your best and talk to them.”
“What if they refuse to listen to my explanation?”
“Even if that happens, you have to keep yourself cool and don’t go around killing people. It will put our master in a difficult position. All in all, just act according to the situation.”
“alright!”
Five Elemental Linglong chuckled and went toward Taiyang Peak..

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - Pushing His Soul Out, He Knelt on the Jiuyang Grand Hall’s Floor
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Pushing His Soul Out, He Knelt on the Jiuyang Grand Hall’s Floor
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At the Jiuyang Grand Hall.
Other than Gu Hai and Yin Yue, the rest of the First Seats were here.
The head disciples of each peak, such as Ximen Guanhai and a few Elders, were present as well.
Hui Xin returned to his room to rest.
“Guys!” Guo Xiao, the First Seat of Haoyang Peak, got up from his seat and walked to the hall’s center. He glanced around and said, “Sect Master, our Nine Suns Sect has been established for thousands of years and has always been lawful and fair, which has allowed the sect to thrive and flourish and be
passed down to this day. I’m not wrong, right?”
Yan Yan knew what he was talking about, so he nodded and replied, “Of course!”
“That’s great, then!” Guo Xiao continued, “Tian Dafeng is my head disciple. In other words, he’s the Vice First Seat. However, he was killed by Zi Linglong at Chuyang Peak today, so what are you going to do about her, Sect Master?”
Yue Cheng, the First Seat of Zhiyang Peak, lowered his head so that he wouldn’t attract too much attention.
He was scared out of his wits when he heard the Yinmo Sect was annihilated by someone overnight. However, he also felt relieved. After all, he could finally become a good person after this as nobody would know he was a spy from the Yinmo Sect. He did not have to do something against his conscience.
Since that day, he became even more easy-going, and he stayed away from all fights.
If it were in the past, he would certainly poke his nose into something like this, but right now, he just wanted to stay away from all trouble.
Dongfang Lie stood up and commented, “Although I despise Gu Hai, Linglong indeed is a talented young girl. Not only did she defeat all of the geniuses from Zhong Province and the Eastern Region, but even the legendary Senior Brother of the Tianyuan School was no match for her. She truly holds a lot of
potential!”
He paused for a moment before continuing, “When the Bishui Sect attacked us, Zi Linglong was the one who rushed to the front and defeated most of the strongest martial artists. She killed even the Primal Spirit martial artist and their Sect Master. After that, she entered the God of Thunders Immortal
Treasures and came across a great opportunity. Who knows how strong she has become now? I can say for certain that she’s the powerhouse of the Jiuyang Sect. Without her, we would be gone in a few seconds!
“Besides, judging from her behavior,” Dongfang Lie moved on. He truly admired Zi Linglong a lot, even if she had insulted him in the past. “Other than Jiaoyang Peak, she rarely goes to other places and rarely fights with other people.
“Do you all understand what I’m saying now?
“She just wants to stay at her own place, mind her own business, and cultivate.
“As for why she would kill Tian Dafeng today…” He looked toward Ximen Guanhai. “Why did you guys go to Chuyang Peak today? And what happened there? In any case, I don’t believe that Zi Linglong would kill Tian Dafeng without any reason. That’s all from me.”
He sat down after he had finished speaking.
If Jiang Ming were here, he would certainly give him a thumbs up. After all, despite what Zi Linglong had done to him, he did not take it to heart and focused on the bigger picture. He did not accuse her of killing Tian Dafeng mindlessly. He brought up her talent, how she saved everyone in the sect, and
how she rarely left Chuyang Peak. A gentle and low profile person like her would never let her anger get her best and kill someone without any reason.
The rest of the First Seats nodded.
Guo Xiao’s face was dark. He looked at Ximen Guanhai and said, “Tell us the whole story.”
Ximen Guanhai bowed to the crowd even though he did not have to do it at his current cultivation level, “Today, the head disciple of the Fo Sect, Hui Xin, paid us a visit, so 1 invited all of my peers to welcome him. However, the people from Chuyang Peak refused to show up. Hui Xin said that he wished to
meet with Junior Sister Linglong because he had heard much about her. Therefore, I brought them to Chuyang Peak. However, Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong refused to come out and welcome us. Junior Brother Tian couldn’t stand their behavior, and he reprimanded them. Who knew Zi Linglong sent him
flying with a palm strike, and then she killed him!”
He just ran them through the whole story, but he did not tell them a lot of things.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong appeared.
“Sect Master, Elders, and Martial Uncles, Zi Linglong has come to see you,” she greeted as she bowed to them.
After that, she waved her hand, and a mirror made of water appeared. Everything that happened since Tian Dafeng and the others descended to Chuyang Peak appeared on it.
Ximen Guanhai frowned.
“Fascinating! Linglong, when have you mastered such a special ability?” Dongfang Lie exclaimed.
Everyone watched and listened to everything that happened in the mirror. Very soon, the mirror disappeared.
“Sect Master, I’ll be leaving now!” Zi Linglong turned around and left.
“Hold it right there!” Guo Xiao shouted.
“Is there anything else?” Zi Linglong turned around, her face bereft of emotion.
“Even though Tian Dafeng was at fault for throwing impertinent remarks at you, you should never take it upon yourself and kill him! However, you ignored the sect’s rules and killed him!” Guo Xiao then looked at Yan Yan and continued, “Are you not going to do something about it, Sect Master? If you
don’t do anything about it, what’s the point of having rules? How are you going to manage the sect, and how are you going to make everyone listen to you?”
“You’re right, Martial Uncle Guo,” Ximen Guanhai added, “One should be rewarded for meritorious deeds and punished for crimes, and this is the truth of the longevity of the sect.”
The Sect Master looked intently at Ximen Guanhai and fell into silence.
“Alright then. In that case,” Zi Linglong tured around to look at Ximen Guanhai and smiled at him, “What makes you think that you can stand here, Ximen Guanhai?”
“What? That’s because I’m the head disciple of Taiyang Peak!” Ximen Guanhai replied. However, there was a bad feeling rising up from his stomach pit.
The rest of the people looked at Zi Linglong in confusion. They also understood that she wouldn’t be punished gravely today.
“Hah,” Zi Linglong scoffed, “You all saw it with your eyes just now, right? Tian Dafeng had already quieted down after being intimidated by me, but why would his behavior suddenly change toward the end? Don’t you think it’s weird? I didn’t think too much about it at that time, but I felt something wasn’t
right afterward, so I looked into it. Do you know what I have found?
“Ximen Guanhai, do you want to say it, or do you want me to help you to say it?” Zi Linglong said.
“Are you implying that I was the one who caused the sudden behavior change in Junior Brother Tian?” Ximen Guanhai shook his head and laughed, “The reason he would act erratically is because of you. You pissed him off, and he felt humiliated. He got the best of his anger, and that’s why he did that.
Besides, did he say anything wrong? He just said that he was going to report to the Sect Master, but you killed him directly. Do you really think no one can bring you to justice because you’re powerful?”
“This is such a waste of time!” Zi Linglong waved her sleeve and said, “Sect Master, he has been mind-controlled!”
“What?” The Sect Master shot up from his seat.
The rest of the people were shocked as well. As for Ximen Guanhai, he was startled at first. Then his eyes glowed, and he tossed his head back in a burst of boisterous laughter. “I have been mind-controlled? This is the funniest thing I’ve heard! Zi Linglong, even if you want to shift all the blame to me, you
should pick a better reason. I’m a Nascent Soul martial artist, and who can control my mind? Besides, do I look like I’m being controlled?”
“Simple. Just let the Sect Master examine your soul,” Zi Linglong said.
Ximen Guanhai shook his head, “Everyone has their own secret, and so do I. Even if I’m the Sect Master’s disciple, there’s no way I would let him look into my soul. However, if you let other people examine your soul, I would do the same too.”
“That’s a good reason. Unfortunately, it has no use for me!” Zi Linglong harrumphed coldly. Suddenly, multi-colored lights shot out from her back, formed into a grinding disc, and fell on top of Ximen Guanhai.
“How dare you do this to me in front of so many people! Let go of me!” Ximen Guanhai shouted angrily. He tried to break himself free, but he found that he could barely move.
The light of five elements sealed Ximen Guanhai’s movement and his mana.
“How dare you, Zi Linglong! Are you trying to kill one of your own in the great hall?” Guo Xiao shouted. Just when he was about to dash forward, Dongfang Lie stopped him and said, “She didn’t kill him. Let’s see what she’s doing first.”
“Junior Brother Guo, calm down!” The First Seat of Laoyang Peak said.
In the next second, everyone sucked in a breath sharply.
Zi Linglong delivered a palm strike at Ximen Guanhai and pushed his soul out.
The soul was protected in a case after one had formed the Primal Spirit from the Nascent Soul.
Everyone was shocked at what Zi Linglong was capable of doing. Then, they saw there was a cage made of runes around Ximen Guanhai’s soul.
In the next second, those runes burst into flame.
Ahhh!
Ximen Guanhai shouted in pain, and then his soul dissipated.
‘When one soul dissipated, he died. When everyone came back to their senses, they found that Ximen was dead.
“D*mn it!” Zi Linglong frowned. “Sect Master, this is a defensive measure. Once discovered, it self-destructs, and I cannot save him.”
“Don’t worry. You’ve already done a good job,” the Sect Master said.
It went without saying that he knew it was not Zi Linglong who did that to Ximen Guanhai but other people who were far more powerful.
“Who is so evil as to do this to my disciple?” He asked.
Regardless of everything that happened, Ximen Guanhai was his favorite disciple, so he was furious that he was killed.
At the same time, he was worried as well. After all, just how powerful was the person who could control his disciple?
“Sect Master, there’s one more thing!” Zi Linglong smiled and looked at Ziyang Peak’s First Seat.
Yue Cheng’s heart leaped into his throat, and his face tumed pale.
Plop!
He fell to the floor on his knees…

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - An Arrogant Holy Son, An Incoming Strong Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: An Arrogant Holy Son, An Incoming Strong Enemy
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Yue Cheng understood everything when he saw Zi Linglong’s gloomy gaze. He did not want to die, so he fell to his knees without hesitation. After all, pride and reputation were nothing when one’s life was at risk.
‘Tjust want to survive. Why is it so hard? Yue Cheng signed inwardly.
Everyone was even more shocked at the scene before them than at Ximen Guanhai’s death.
Laoyang Peaks First Seat let out a sigh. He walked up to Yue Cheng and sealed his mana. He had already known Yue Cheng’s identity through Chang Yiming.
“What’s going on?” The Sect Master asked. He had no idea why but he did not have a good feeling about this.
After all, nothing could make a First Seat fall to his knees unless something big had happened.
Zi Linglong stood at her spot without saying anything.
Everyone focused on Yue Cheng.
“Senior Brother!” Yue Cheng let out a bitter laugh. He first looked at Zi Linglong and asked, “How and when did you find you?”
“Along time ago,” Zi Linglong said, “You can’t wrap up a fire with paper, and there are no secrets in this world. It’s just that I didn’t expect you would confess yourself.”
“I regretted it. I truly regretted it. I was tormented day and night. I couldn’t even sleep at night, and I was constantly condemned by conscience! Now that you’ve busted me, it actually makes me feel relieved. I want to live in constant fear that other people will discover my identity, so I decided to confess
myself,” Yue Cheng said. His eyes were red, and his voice was deep. “I was rescued by the Sect Master of the Yinmo Sect in the past. He took me in as his disciple, and I don’t know how but he managed to slip me into the Jiuyang Sect. With their support, my cultivation speed increased by leaps and bounds. I
managed to achieve countless feats and finally became the First Seat.”
‘The Sect Master was stunned.
Other than the First Seat of Laoyang Peak, the rest of the people were shocked as well.
All of them couldn’t believe that one of the First Seats was a member of the devil sect.
‘The Sect Master approached Yue Cheng, his face grim. “So you were behind the incident in Chuyang Peak that year?”
“yes!”
“Why?”
“Because we need power. We want to take control over everything!”
‘The Sect Master closed his eyes after he heard what Yue Cheng said.
“Both you and I grew up together. We went through countless challenges. We vanquished many demons together. We explored the world as a team, and we survived through thick and thin together, and now you’re telling me that you’re the disciple of the Yinmo Sect?!”
The Sect Master was sad.
He just lost his disciple, and now he was going to lose one of his own brothers again.
Just when he was about to keep asking, someone came into the hall.
A member of the Jiuyang Sect rushed in and said anxiously to the Sect Master, “This is Lin Han, the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect. He came here for a visit, so I brought him into the mountain. Just when I was going to inform you about his arrival, he barged into the hall. I couldn’t stop him!”
“Don’t blame him, Sect Master,” Lin Han said. There was a smile on his face. “I heard that there is a remaining member of the Yinmo Sect in the Jiuyang Sect, so I couldn’t help myself and come in to check it out myself.”
“Amitabha!” Hui Xin also walked into the hall. “Everyone from the devil sect is evil to the core. They had destroyed the Eastern Region and wreaked havoc on the Western Side. They’ve committed such a great crime that they can’t be forgiven.”
‘The Sect Master was angered, and the rest of the people’s faces turned dark.
“Tm sorry, but this is the Jiuyang Sect’s internal affairs, so please help yourself and leave immediately!” The Sect Master said, his voice stern.
“Well, it’s true, but when it involves the remaining members of the Yinmo Sect, it’s no longer an internal affair. Rather, it’s a matter involving everyone in the Eastern…” Lin Han came to a short pause before continuing his sentence, “No, I should put it this way. It’s a matter that involves everyone from
every side of the world!”
“That’s right,” Hui Xin chimed in and modded.
Both of them had joined forces at this moment.
“Sect Master Yan Yan, could it be that you’re going to protect a remaining member of the Yinmo Sect?” Lin Han raised his voice and asked, “Could it be that here is also one of the lairs of the Yinmo Sect?”
“Shut your d*mn mouth!” Dongfang Lie roared, “Even though you’re the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect, you can’t simply sling mud at us like this. Now, please get out of here!”
“Leave this place immediately!” Hao Cheng, the First Seat of Shaoyang Peak, stood up. His eyes were filled with anger.
He had already stepped into the Primal Spirit Realm.
He was a person of few words, but he would say it decisively whenever he decided to speak.
“Hah!” Lin Han laughed, “Are you guys getting mad because we’ve found out your secret? What are you going to do now? Kill both of us?”
He was here to investigate the Jiuyang Sect’s secret. Little did he expect that he heard the conversation in the grand hall the moment he arrived, and he was overjoyed.
‘This is… This is great! This is just great! After knowing their secret, I can do whatever I want with the Jiuyang Sect. Perhaps, I can even get Zi Linglong to my side! Today must be my lucky day!’
Clank!
Hao Chen drew his sword, but Lin Han was not perturbed.
“Don’t do it, Hao Chen!” The Sect Master hastily went forward and stopped Hao Chen. He suppressed his anger and looked at the two people. “Please, leave the Jiuyang Sect immediately!”
“Sect Master Yan Yan, I represent the Qingyun Sect now,” Lin Han said as he lifted his chin arrogantly.
“So? What do you want?” Linglong walked over. There was a cold smirk playing on the corner of her lips.
“Tt isn’t what I want. It’s what you want,” Lin Han said, “Who could’ve thought that the Jiuyang Sect would protect a person from the Yinmo Sect. I guess no one could sit still and ignore it when they heard about it.”
Linglong ignored him and looked at the Sect Master. “Can I kill him:
Lin Han’s expression changed.
He was very well aware of Zi Lingling’s strength and ruthlessness.
She had no qualms about killing and defeating countless geniuses in the past, so he was certain that she would do it when she said she wanted to kill him.
“That said, we’re at the grand hall of the Jiuyang Sect. I suppose she wouldn’t dare to kill me here, right? Lin Han thought inwardly.
The Sect Master let out a bitter smile.
‘Kill him? If I could kill him, I would’ve done it a long time ago. I didn’t have to wait until you asked me that. Besides, he represents the Qingyun Sect. If we kill him now, it will be waging war against the Qingyun Sect. Maybe we should do it at night?
However, before he could say anything, Zi Linglong had dashed and charged toward Lin Han.
“Not only did you barge into the grand hall of the Jiuyang Sect without any permission, but you even have the audacity to twist the truth and throw mud at us? I should just kill you here and now!”
Slap!
Even though Lin Han was prepared for it, he was still sent flying into the distance by Zi Linglong, leaving a trail of blood in the air.
“And you also! Do you really think I don’t know what you came here for? You’re here to seize our land, so you’re not welcomed here as well! Get lost!”
Zi Linglong slapped Hui Xin and sent him out of the hall.
“The Holy Son? The head disciple? Bullsh*t! Don’t you ever come back again! If not, I’ll kill all of you!” Zi Linglong said as she conjured five sword energies on her back. She threw all of them at Lin Han and Hui Xin, seriously injuring them while sending them flying several hundred meters away.
She did not kill them in the end. After all, it was not the right time to do it right now.
All of the disciples came out and looked at Zi Linglong admiringly. However, the group of First Seats all let out a bitter smile.
“Linglong, both of them are the disciples of a Sacred Land. How are we going to fend them off if they join forces and attack us in the future?” The Sect Master said helplessly.
“Don’t worry. I have the confidence to defeat all of them if they come at us,” Zi Linglong said. She looked in another direction and frowned slightly when she noticed something.
“Anyway, don’t worry about anything, Sect Master,” she said after she suppressed the doubt in her heart.
After she had finished speaking, she flew toward Chuyang Peak.
‘Don’t worry about anything? Are you kidding me? If it wasn’t because I couldn’t defeat you, I would’ve punished you a long time ago. Do you know the consequences of offending two Sacred Lands?
‘The more the Sect Master thought about it, the more he wanted to cry.
“What should we do now, Sect Master?” Laoyang Peak’s First Seat asked.
“What should we do? There’s nothing we can do now,” the Sect Master replied, shaking his head helplessly.
He then waved his hand and activated the protective formation.
After he went back to the hall, he looked at Yue Cheng, and a surge of killing intent filled him. Yue Cheng’s heart sank, and he said, “I… I’ve told you everything, and you still want to kill me?”
Outside of the Jiuyang Sect, Lin Han stood up from a deep hole. He wiped the blood that lined the corner of his lips, and his face was contorted with rage.
As the Holy Son, he had been treated like this before.
“Elder!” He shouted into the air. “Why didn’t you help me just now?”
“If I showed up just now, both of us would be dead here. Anyway, let’s get out of here first!” An elder appeared in front of Lin Han, his face stern. He grabbed Lin Han and quickly left.
At the same time, he said, “There was a sword energy locking on me just now. If I made a move, I would be dead.”
“There’s someone who can kill you in the Jiuyang Sect?” Lin Han asked in shock. However, he soon came around to his senses and asked, “Could it be that this is the secret they’ve been hiding?”
The elder did not reply.
Suddenly, he sensed something and looked in another direction. He frowned, but he decided not to care about it and kept on running.
“Amitabha! This place is truly a place full of monsters!”
Hui Xin stood up. He looked at Lin Han for a moment before leaving as well.
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming looked into the distance. He was not looking at either Lin Han or Hui Xin. Instead, he was looking at the mountain on the other side.
Both Linglong and the elder who took Lin Han away could sense something over there, but they couldn’t tell it very clearly. However, Jiang Ming could sense it very clearly.
‘There was a person there.
He had a strange presence, and it was very clear to him that he did not come here with good intentions.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - Heaven Reincarnation Hall, Beneficiary
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Heaven Reincarnation Hall, Beneficiary
Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming stood atop Jiuyang Peak as he saw everything that happened in the Taiyang Hall. He thought that Linglong would make a big scene out of it, but she reasoned it out, and it made him feel relieved.
“This old man is really scared of death!” Jiang Ming shook his head, speechless, as he saw Yue Cheng kneeling on the ground with a terrified look on his face.
As Lin Han and Hui Xin arrived and waltzed right into the main hall, Jiang Ming only snickered.
The guardian who came along with Lin Han saw Lin Han being knocked out, hence wanted to engage in battle. The Combat Mannequin in the Jiuyang Sect stood up and radiated waves of sword qi at the guardian, imposing fear on him until he did not dare to move.
Five Elemental Linglong came back to the hall in a blink of an eye.
“Stay here, for now. I need to go out for a bit,” Jiang Ming explained before vanishing into thin air. Five Elemental Linglong could only look towards the
west.
“First Seat Jiang had a lot hiding in his sleeves!” Chang Yiming took a deep breath and shook his head with a smile. He had a hunch about this a long time ago, and this was just confirming his guesses. It did not take long before Chang Yiming noticed something and said, “First Seat Jiang has almost never left Jiuyang Sect. What happened today?”
If memory serves him right, Jiang Ming seemed to have never left the sect, and it was not an exaggeration to say he was a million-year shut-in. With Junior Sister back, he should be getting lovey-dovey with her, yet he suddenly decided to leave the place. This seemed obviously abnormal.
Five Elemental Linglong did not respond and only gazed far away.
Jiang Ming left the Jiuyang Sect and came to a place ten thousands of miles away to the west.
There were three people here, two men and a woman, all with their auras hidden.
They were strangely inspecting their surroundings. All the while, there were traces of auras leaking from their bodies that seemed to be incompatible with the heavens and earth, yet they intervened with each other and merged together. It was truly a strange sight. Jiang Ming opened the Human Path Record and looked them up.
Name: Pei Long
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 7 (Primal Spirit Realm)
Background: The Pei clan of the Nine Cubical Plane. (PS: Beneficiary of the Heaven Reincarnation Hall, One of the members of the Sky Dragon Clan.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Nine Stars
Status: Originally a normal human being, he was accidentally invited by the Heaven Reincarnation Hall to become a beneficiary. He descended into many infinite realms to complete missions through the Reincarnation Hall and received rewards for them. Through numerous missions, his cultivation skyrocketed and slowly earned the trust of many other beneficiaries, ultimately forming the Sky Dragon Clan.
They suffered serious casualties from the previous mission and were left with only three members.
Now they have accepted an easier mission to recover their vitality. The mission was to save Yue Cheng of the Jiuyang Sect in 3 days and safely send him out of Qing Province.
When they arrive in this realm, they first integrate with the heavens and earth aura so that they will not be rejected and will then start gathering information before taking further actions.
“Dang! They came from the Infinite Heavenly Realms? Reincarnation Halls? Beneficiaries?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
The emergence of the Supreme Pagoda was already shocking, and now there was even a Reincarnation Hall? And it can even descend into the Infinite Heavenly Realms? Jiang Ming was starting to feel everything had become a mess.
He quickly checked the statuses of the other two, and those two were also beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall and members of the Sky Dragon Clan, as expected. Both their cultivation levels were also at Level 7.
Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed as his mind slowly merged into the illusionary realm, seeping into the special network, and entering the three’s sound-isolation array formation.
“I’ve fused with this world’s aura and merged completely with it. I no longer feel the sense of rejection from it!” Pei Long breathed a sigh of relief, “Tian Xin, Zui Hu, how about the two of you?”
“I’m done!” Tian Xin replied. A mirror appeared in his hand, emitting white lights as inscriptions started to spray out of the mirror into the void. “This is a perfect planar word that can withstand the powers of a level 10 cultivation. No, it seems there might be a deep hiding potential and cannot be discovered!”
“I’m done as well!” replied Zui Hu. He had a burly physique with a face filled with tiger stripes that gave off a savage feeling. “We will have to lay low when we complete our mission, for there will surely be a lot of strong experts in a perfect planar world. However, the mission this time is only at C-grade. With our strength, it won’t be difficult to complete. After we finish up with this mission and merge into this world, we should go and relax here. The last world we went to was just too brutal!”
“I was exhausted from the last world and haven’t even recovered from it until now. Big Brother, how about we take a good rest after completing the mission?” Tian Xin said with a smile, “There will surely be a lot of Practitioners in this world. I would also like to catch a few geniuses to use as a furnace and improve my core strength.”
“Complete the mission, retreat, explore and try to find opportunities and reap benefits! It’s not too late to relax after getting enough benefits. Let’s go and scout for a bit!” Pei Long replied.
The three of them could hear the same voice echoing in their mind as they planned on scouting.
“Ding: Reminder. Due to unforeseen circumstances, Mission danger level has increased to B Grade.”
“Ding: Affected by external circumstances, mission danger level increased to A Grade!”
“Ding: Affected by force majeure, mission danger level increased to SSS Grade!”
Their faces changed instantly upon hearing the reminders. Jiang Ming suddenly struck at that very moment.
A projection was suddenly formed as though another world had descended, binding the three of them and rendering them unable to move.
They could hear echoes in their mind.
“Ding: Mission was aborted, forcing a return teleportation.”
Upon hearing the reminder, the three of them let out a breath of relief. It was supposed to be a normal C-grade mission. When it suddenly rose to the highest level, it nearly scared the life out of them. To the three of them, death was imminent for such high-level missions.
Fortunately, right after they arrived and noticed the mission danger level increased, they initiated the force-returning teleportation function so that they could escape death. Only, where did such danger come from? Even if they were attacked, they did not even see a glimpse of the enemy. At that moment, Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed, and a book appeared right in his hand as he swiped in the air.
The three outsiders could hear a rushing prompt in their minds with streaks of blood-red text.
“Ding: Forced Return Teleportation forcefully interrupted.”
“Ding: Affected by force majeure, self-protection sequence activated.”
“Ding: To prevent the Beneficiaries’ information from leaking, the self-destruction sequence has been forcefully activated: Soul annihilation and all traces of memory will be erased!”
“Ding: Pei Long, Tian Xin, Zui Hu. Three Beneficiaries. Reincarnation Hall has recorded your current situation. You may now die!”
The three of their faces changed instantly as they twisted into a panic.
Then, their souls were directly obliterated along with the other special items they had.
Goosebumps were all over his body as Jiang Ming watched the whole scene unfold before him.
He could feel a terrifying aura hidden around the area. That aura could easily wipe away his existence. Jiang Ming retreated immediately while he recalled the Human Path Record and hid with the system.
As soon as he hid, he felt an untraceable fluctuation sweeping the whole area. It did not seem to discover anything and retreated swiftly.
Jiang Ming returned to Jiuyang Peak, and his face slowly returned to normal.
“Brother, what happened just now?” Five Elemental Linglong asked.
She could feel that Jiang Ming had done something earlier. Even though it was subtle, she still noticed it.
Chang Yiming also looked at him with concern.
“Nothing’s wrong. Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming smiled as he sat on the chair. He looked over at the tea prepared by Linglong and chugged down the whole cup.
“Great. I’m going to go cultivate now!” Chang Yiming noticed something strange about Jiang Ming. Jiang Ming did not want to tell them what happened, and he knew he should not continue bothering him. He clenched his fist and headed back to his house,
“Jiang Ming’s strength should be higher than Linglong, or even much higher! My cultivation is too bad after all!” Chang Yiming smiled bitterly and continued his cultivation.
Under the pavilion, Linglong slumped right next to Jiang Ming as she looked at her with a face filled with queries.
“I can’t tell! I can’t tell!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
It would just cause Junior Sister to feel worried if they talked about it. She was better off not knowing about it. Jiang Ming sighed in his heart.
When Jiang Ming heard the conversation between Zui Hu and the two, he also checked their Status changes through the Human Path Record. Seeing that they were about to escape, he did not hesitate to move out, planning to pin them down and search through their memories.
When the trio heard the Reincarnation Hall’s reminder in their mind, the whole incident was recorded in the Human Path Record as well.
When Jiang Ming realized that they were going to be forcefully teleported back to where they came from, he tried using the Human Path Record to cut off their connection with the Reincarnation Hall and was successful.
Never did he anticipate that the self-destruct sequence was initiated, and it completely obliterated their soul and erased all traces of these outsiders.
“Reincarnation Hall. Are they the primary god? Or are they something similar to the Supreme Pagoda?”
“The last fluctuation seemed to be a probe but was blocked by my System, and it didn’t manage to discover me!”
“The Human Path Record can even cut off their connection!” Several thoughts crossed Jiang Mings’s mind as he tried to make sense of the situation.
The beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall had emerged today. Jiang Ming feared that this would probably happen again, and he had to be prepared..

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - Seeds of the Law; The Deepest Level of Bonding
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Seeds of the Law; The Deepest Level of Bonding
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming thought of another problem
To think that the beneficiaries could be killed.
Just because the external force was stronger, the beneficiaries were forcefully terminated. This Reincarnation Hall seemed to be improper however you look at it.
“Or was it because they picked up the scent of the Human Path Record?”
Jiang Ming thought even deeper to himself.
If that was not the case and they could easily terminate these beneficiaries as they like, then this Reincarnation Hall seemed to be just a den to breed parasites, fooling around with people’s fate and controlling their life and death.
Seeing that Senior Brother Jiang Ming did not want to talk about what happened, Five Elemental Linglong tried looking through her memories and discovered there wasn’t anything of importance happening in that time frame!
“Sigh, everything is now a mess. These memories can only be used as a reference!” Five Elemental Linglong thought resignedly.
“There will be some troubles soon!” Jiang Ming softly muttered as he placed Junior Sister into his arms, “The Fo Sect has some hidden intentions. Now that they know that there is a Yinmo expert hiding within our sect, they will definitely take this opportunity to bring the problem up so that they can have
a better chance of developing their influence in Qing Province. Lin Han, who came over this time around,, also has impure intentions. When he returns, he will surely spread the news about Yue Cheng. It will be an even bigger problem if the Qingyu Sect has malicious intent.”
“Bigger problem?” Linglong asked.
“Of course! Who knows how many were pulled into the Great War of Eastern Province and how many had their families broken apart? If the Qingyun Sect starts advocating that we are hiding the remnants of the devil sects, who knows how many will come and demand justice?” Jiang Ming explained.
“True that! We should’ve just killed Lin Han and the other one there and then!”
*Even if we killed them, it wouldn’t matter! There might be people waiting on them from the outside. If that’s not the case, this incident of Yue Cheng has already been exposed and will surely spread around! If we really killed Lin Han, that would really be the point of no return!”
“Senior Brother, what can we do?”
“Just wait! If the problem isn’t much, then T’ll let you handle it. If the Qingyun Sect doesn’t show respect and troubles us, then we will just let them disappear!”
“Senior Brother, are you sure about thi:
“Just relax!”
“Senior Brother is the strongest!”
With a simple thought, Jiang Ming hugged Junior Sister and reappeared in the spiritual field.
Now that he was at the Paradis Realm, which was Level 8, he had opened 8 Mu of land.
Shrouded by the power of Dao Square, the area was extremely rich in spiritual essence, and even the field ridge opened, flowing with spiritual fluid. Each of the spiritual plants grown here had created a corresponding growth environment.
Branches of leaves swayed as the fairy-like lights glistened.
Four flower fairies could be seen weaving around, trimming the spiritual grass and the spiritual bugs that had grown, working as hard as ever.
“Hail Master!”
“Hail Master!”
‘When they saw Jiang Ming and Linglong, they came over and started cheering around the two.
Since they were flower fairies, they still had a pure heart and mind even if their cultivation had risen. In this spiritual field, living in this world filled with beds of flowers brought them nothing but happiness and carefree life.
They are also cultivating the Flower Fairy Tree that was improved by Jiang Ming, looking forward to the next batch of Flower Fairy fruits to mature, though it would be more difficult.
“Hail Master, hail Mistress!”
‘The four enormous tree people around the spiritual field were swaying around the branches on their heads as they gave their greetings.
These were the Ancient Trees of War that had formed their own wisdom and were akin to a tree demon now.
‘They were used to being rooted onto the land and growing slowly. With the Flower Fairies accompanying them, they did not yearn for the outside world. Basking in the sun and rain daily and slowly growing up was everything to them.
Jiang Ming lifted his hand around.
“Hua Huo, did you manage to brew the Hundred Floral Nectar Wine successfully?” Jiang Ming asked as he slowly walked towards one of the top graded spiritual herbs.
It was a Purple Jaded Gypsophila, and it had already matured.
‘There were many small purple flowers that bloomed, shining little bits of starry lights. It was akin to the twinkling stars in the starry night, truly a sight to behold.
It was very useful as well. Once taken in, it could help a person comprehend the Stellar Dao Fluctuation, cleanse and restructure a person’s physique, improve his innate talent, and improve his affinity with the Stellar Dao.
If placed in this world, it could be said to be a rare treasure that was very precious.
“Master, we are almost done with it!” said the Hua Huo fluttering their wings around as countless twinkles of light sprinkled around, radiating a nice floral scent. “We will tell you immediately once we successfully brew them!”
Jiang Ming nodded in reply.
‘This Hundred Floral Nectar Wine was made from the spiritual grass and honey that they collected in their spare time, coupled with some spiritual fruits. After the fermentation process, it would become an everyday drink.
Jiang Ming swiped his hand in the air and harvested the spiritual herb.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host on obtaining one top graded spiritual Heb, rewarded 1000 years of cultivation.
As he heard the reminder in his ear, Jiang Ming let out a smile.
One top-grade spiritual herb was equivalent to 1000 years of cultivation.
“It’s a pity that these top graded spiritual herbs are difficult to be grown, and one mu of land can only grow a few of them. Otherwise, I will be very rich!” Jiang Ming thought to himself as he directly absorbed the mana and caused the spiritual fluctuation in his Paradis World to become denser and the
Paradis Space bigger.
He harvested another two plants and obtained two different mysterious items. Although both of them did not have mana, it caused Jiang Ming to fly over the moon.
He got Wave Law Seed and Cut Law Seed.
“Even Law seeds are given as rewards! Amazing!”
After Jiang Ming’s simple refining, he integrated the seeds into the Paradis. They quickly rooted themselves and grew rapidly.
Jiang Ming had a wild ambition of turning this Paradis Space of his into the real world itself. However, this was a very difficult task because a world had to have at least 3,000 laws to be considered a complete world.
He got a hold of this information from Dongfang Chenxi, and Jiang Ming knew he was still very far from achieving his ambition.
However, the structural integrity of his Paradis was considered perfect where he had already comprehended the basic Yin-Yang and Five Elemental. The Time and Space at the utmost levels were also completely ready.
In fact, it was possible to slowly make this world complete by just simply allowing the Paradis to operate by itself, but the time consumption would be enormous. It would take millions of years and hundreds of millions of years for it to be completed.
Now that he had the law seeds that the Paradis could slowly convert and merge with, it would now be able to give birth to the respective laws.
“This is truly a great opportunity!” Jiang Ming was in a good mood as he looked over at a few Spiritual Herbs that were on the verge of being fully matured.
“Senior Brother, what do you need these Spiritual Herbs for?” Five Elemental Linglong asked with a puzzled look on her face.
“This is our family’s asset, accumulation, and wealth! If I come across anything that I need in the future, won’t I be able to exchange them for it simply?” Jiang Ming explained with a smile on his face.
“You have a point there. With Senior Brother’s special ability to speed up their growth by a thousand-fold, if given a hundred years’ time, won’t you be able to grow mountains of spiritual herbs, piles of medicine kings, and even be able to nurture immortal graded spiritual herbs?” Linglong, who was
normally level-headed, couldn’t help herself from being amazed.
Her Senior Brother was too amazing!
If only Senior Brother was that amazing in the past life, he would not have had to go through so many hardships.
“Was it because of my reincarnation that caused Senior Brother to obtain such great opportunities?” The thought ran through her head but was quickly suppressed.
They came to the side of the spiritual fountain.
In the fountain, spiritual fluids could be seen streaming endlessly as spiritual fluctuations aura were flowing within. It even accumulated into the Heavens and Earth Dao Fluctuation, and the silhouette of the chains of law could be seen vaguely.
Standing tall in the middle of the spiritual fountain was an Immortal Grade Enlightening Tea Tree which was glowing ever brightly. There were 3,000 leaves hanging on it, and each of the leaves had countless opening and closing pores on their surfaces, slowly forming tides of energy flowing in the void.
These waves of energy even had the power of orders and the power of source, which allowed the Enlightening Tea Tree to grow even faster. Though, the whole process was still considered slow.
“The Dao fluctuation here is even denser than normal. I think that there isn’t any place in the world that can compete with this place! Senior Brother, why don’t you cultivate here?” Five Elemental Linglong could not help herself from being amazed.
“Well, I don’t need to! I specifically left this place for you, but you still insist on cultivating in your own room! Such a waste!” Jiang Ming explained as he shook his head.
“This place is suitable for cultivating Dao and comprehending the laws of the Heavens and Earth. The main body requires meditation to cultivate the Clone Dao, which makes this place inappropriate! Isn’t Spatial Linglong over here? She’s reaching her pinnacles soon!” Five Elemental Linglong explained.
On the other side of the spiritual fountain was a spiritual stone mountain that was embedded with 36,000 pieces of spiritual beads, which was a great fortune.
Right at the very peak of the mountain, Spatial Linglong could be seen sitting cross-legged.
“So soon?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“yes! When she reaches the pinnacles, she will be leaving the sect to look for other great opportunities. Of course, she would like to have sexual cultivation with Senior Brother before she leaves to form the deepest level of bonding.
“The deepest level of bonding?” Jiang Ming looked forward inexplicably.
“As clones, we need to be left with an imprint from Senior Brother so that even when we lose control of ourselves and form different distinct personalities, we will still be bonded with Senior Brother and not cause any mishaps. Of course, it’s even better if we can take the next step and have the next
bloodline ready!” Five Elemental Linglong explained.
“This is for every one of the clones?” Jiang Ming was shocked to hear her explanation.
Five Elemental Linglong nodded with a soft smile and asked, “Senior Brother, don’t you want this
“Well
Jiang Ming suddenly felt his skin tingling, thinking of it.
Junior Sister, clones, bloodline

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - Let’s Kill the First Wave
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Let’s Kill the First Wave
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming had mixed feelings of happiness, confusion, fear, and anxiety, yet he never spoke of anything. With his arm wrapped around Linglong, they strolled along the garden.
Such mystery, such beauty, and such wonders!
Jiang Ming evoked the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique to speed up the growth of the newly planted spiritual seeds before heading back to the pavilion.
As he looked over at the sea of clouds and thousands of mountains, every moment gave off a different feeling, and it was not mundane at all. Sometimes when Junior Sister was not around, he would bring out his tablet and watch a few clips, feeling his urges boiling and his heart raging. A truly different
feeling altogether.
Today on the ninth floor of the most prosperous Zui Xiao Building in Luo City, more than ten people came over. No food was served, nor were there any escorts accompanying them.
Upon reaching, subtle changes could be felt around the surroundings as it had been sealed from both the inside and outside to prevent anyone from peeping in and to block out any sound.
“Master Xuan Ku, it’s okay for you to gather us today, but why did you have to choose a normal human restaurant? What if there was a slight leak of aura when we were here. It could destroy this whole building, and god knows how many will end up injured or dead? Wouldn’t that just be a sin?”
“Lagree! If we were to gather around, we should go for the great mountains accompanied by flowing rivers!”
“Making a scene here will surely damage our identity.”
“Everyone! When you look at this prosperous, booming place, doesn’t it make you want to take control over the whole place? With the Great Eastern War ending not long ago and so many changes happening all around, we should grasp this opportunity and climb to the top! If we don’t grasp this
opportunity now, then this place will eventually fall into other people’s hands anyway,” Master Xuan Ku replied.
“Master Xuan Ku, we fully understand why you came all the way here from the Western Region. Just directly state your business!” Zhang clan’s Great Monarch of the Qing He City said bluntly. “Since we came, surely we have already prepared ourselves mentally!”
Upon hearing that, Master Xuan Ku nodded his head and explained: “Because of the Great Eastern War, the strength of the Qingyun Scared Land has been whittled by more than half. Although their ‘Sacred Land title remained on them, they no longer possess the prestige and dignity compared to the past.
‘When you look at the nine provinces of the Eastern Region, you will see that countless sects were destroyed, clans perished, and not a few of the strong ones were left. The time now is the chance of a lifetime! Once you miss this chance, it would be very difficult to rise up again!”
“Haha!” The Great Monarch merely smiled in response while he picked up the cup of tea and took a sip. The rest of them remained expressionless.
“Although all of your forces are within the Qing Province, this place here is dominated by the Jiuyang Sect alone. Even if all of you combined and teamed up to fight them off, it would still seem to be far-fetched! I’m sure all of you realized as well that the Jiuyang Sect has been expanding its control
rapidly. Once they lay out their dominations completely, the entire Qing Province will be truly under the Jiuyang Sect’s total domination. Itt would be impossible for any of you to turn yourself around by thend. You will all be left with two choices. Either you move out from the place, or you submit to their
authority.”
“So what if that happens?” the Zhang clan’s Great Monarch asked indifferently.
How could anyone not know about the current situation here?
Even if we knew, there seemed to be no chances for them to turn over, let alone fighting head-on against the Jiuyang Sect. This was just nonsense.
Putting aside the Jiuyang’s Sect master, who had already advanced into the Primal Spirit Realm, Zi Linglong, who had defeated so many geniuses around the world, already sent chills down their spine.
The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak. They could only go along with the flow.
As for starting a rebellion against the Jiuyang Sect after listening to this Master Xuan Ku’s sincere analysis? The Zhang clan’s Great Monarch only chuckled.
“Everyone! What if I tell you there’s a way to break the Jiuyang Sect down?” Master Xuan Ku smiled softly.
Suddenly, everyone turned serious as the Zhang clan’s Great Monarch asked, “What way?”
“Well. The First Seat of the Zhiyang Peak of the Jiuyang Sect is a person of the Yinmo Sect!” Master Xuan Ku blatantly shared the secret he had uncovered, no longer hiding it from them. “The Yinmo Sect is the common enemy of the Eastern Region, and everyone would kill to take them now. Yet now we
know that the First Seat of one of the Jiuyang Sect’s peaks has such an identity. Well? What would you think might happen when this news gets around?”
“Jiuyang Sect will be attacked by everyone!” Zhang clan’s Great Monarch took a deep breath as he muttered each word, getting louder and louder. He looked over with his eyes ablaze, asking, “Is this for real?”
“Lin Han, the Holy Son of the Qingyun Sect, also knew about this!” Master Xuan Ku replied.
“Haha! Wonderful! Truly Wonderful! Finally, our chance has come! Finally, the regime of the Jiuyang Sect suppressing us all this time has finally come to an end! Master Xuan Ku! You are undeniably an eminent monk and brought us such a huge gift! Once the Jiuyang Sect crumbles, what do you think if
we equally split the Jiuyang Sect?” Zhang clan’s Great Monarch laughed.
“Gratifying!”
“More than Gratifying!” Everyone cheered with a bright smile on their faces.
Chuyang Peak
Gu Hai returned to Chuyang Peak with a cloudy face.
“What wrong, old man?” Jiang Ming poured a cup of tea and handed it over to Gu Hai.
“You are getting cheekier and cheekier, huh!” Gu Hai hummed. As he took a sip of tea, he could feel a chilling sensation cruising all over his body as his heart fluttered and his tension slowly got relieved. He could not help but praise, “Your tea is still a good one to enjoy! Get me 1,000 pounds of them!”
“A thousand pounds? Not a thousand leaves?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“It’s justifiable for a disciple to show their filial piety to their masters! If you think 1,000 pounds is not filial enough, then make it to 10,000 pounds of them! I won’t complain about it being too much at all!” Gu Hai retorted.
Jiang Ming only gave a cheeky chuckle in response.
“Just listening to you chuckling makes my blood boil! Go make me 64 dishes! Ah! Forget it. Hold on for a minute. I need to tell you some proper business first!” Gu Hai was irritated by his laugh.
“What’s riled you up so much that you even paused making more children!” Jiang Ming teased as Gu Hai suddenly spewed out his tea.
“You are asking for some beating!”
Seeing Gu Hai getting worked up, Jiang Ming only smiled on and didnt utter a word.
“You lazy bum! Rumors about the Jiuyang Sect harboring a person of the Yinmo Sect have been spread around already. Some even said that our sect is actually a devil’s cave! Many have formed alliances and want to demand justice from us, especially those who had suffered great losses in the Great Eastern
War. Even some experts from other provinces also joined in the ruckus.” Gu Hai explained solemnly.
“Is that it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“My goodness! You think this is trivial?” Gu Hai was agitated.
“Master! Chill out! Relax!” Jiang Ming tried to calm him down
“How the hell am I supposed to be relaxed! Do you realize we are about to be sieged by everyone? We are the common enemy to all now, yet you still ask me to relax? Why do I have the kind of anger to whip you 3,000 whips!”
“This really isn’t a big deal, Master! Just relax. These nobodies are not even worth mentioning.” Jiang Ming explained.
“You really can solve this?” Gu Hai hesitated.
“Of course! It’s easy!” Jiang Ming commented.
“How are you planning to solve this?” Gu Hai was still puzzled.
“Well, I’ll lead off by simply killing the first wave that arrives. If they still dare to come here, then we will just kill them all! There’s never a right or wrong when it comes to the bloodshed between practitioners, so we don’t have to feel guilty about it!” Jiang Ming replied confidently.
“simply killing a wave. Do you even realize how many experts there are? I fear there are more than 10 Primal Spirit experts and even Paradis Experts among them! And a scanty little you will be able to kill them?” Gu Hai exclaimed in disbelief.
“Master, scanty little me can even turn mountains over!” Jiang Ming was starting to get a headache from Gu Hai questioning his ability. He knew he had to bring something for the show, or his master would constantly be worrying and panicking.
Jiang Ming simply waved his hand, and a Combat Mannequin came flying over to him.
Upon seeing the mannequin, Gu Hai was immediately astonished.
“Of the Extreme Path Realm. How’s that?” Jiang Ming said blatantly.
“The Extreme Path Realm?” Gu Hai took a deep breath, wanting to bow in respect before realizing what really happened, and asked, “Why would it listen to you?”
“It’s a secret!” Jiang Ming gave a cheeky smile. As he flipped his hand over, he took out a Formation Disk and passed it over to Gu Hai, explaining, “This formation disk is a top-grade Dao Vessel. Just give it to the Sect Master. I’m sure after he fully refined the Dao Vessel, enveloping the whole Jiuyang Sect
would be a breeze. If he evokes it, he should be able to even trap and kill a Paradis expert.”
“This… Little Ming! What kind of celestial encounter have you stumbled upon?” Gu Hai exclaimed
“Well, an unbelievable celestial encounter, of course!” Jiang Ming replied.
“Fine, I’m not asking anymore! The more I know, the more my heart is trembling! Go make me 64 dishes to calm my nerves!”
“I knew you coming back would be bearing no good news! Hey old man. From now on, you don’t have to worry about the peaks anymore. Just focus on procreating with First Seat Yin Yue and get me a small little sister! I’ll even help you babysit!” Jiang Ming retorted jokingly.
“With you and your antiques, how would I even dare to have a baby girl! Get lost, you little rascal!” Gu Hai started chasing Jiang Ming away.
“Right! Off I go then!” Jiang Ming had no choice but to go cook.
As Gu Hai laid back on the rattan chair, looking at the Combat Mannequin slowly leaving towards the mountain’s edge, he trembled a little. He then looked at the formation disk in his hand and could not help but smile.
He knew his disciple was getting more and more mysterious, but never did he imagine that he would be so terrifying.
To think he could even order an Extreme Path expert around!
The fact that an Extreme Path expert that could be said to be a mythical existence was now being ordered around by his own disciple! He couldn’t even dream of this if he wanted to!
“Little Ming orders an Extreme Path expert around while I order Little Ming around! Haha! I’m still the best!” Gu Hai was so excited as he took out his wine gourd, tilted back, and chugged down a mouthful of delicious wine.
It didn’t take long before a huge table was filled with various dishes.
Jiang Ming purposely prepared a truly enormous table for this.
