Even Five Elemental Linglong came over to the table.
“My disciple will always be a filial one!” Gu Hai exclaimed as he picked up his chopsticks and helped himself with the dishes.
“Senior Brother’s dishes are always so delicious!” Zi Linglong praised as she tasted the dishes. She still looked so good even when she was eating!
Jiang Ming accompanied them for the meal and had the usual conversations with them.
After the meal, Gu Hai flew into the air and went to look for the Sect Master.
“Now that you have revealed the Formation Disk, I think even the Sect Master will have realized that you are not so ordinary anymore. Senior Brother, won’t this affect you?” Zi Linglong asked.
“There isn’t anything much that can affect me anymore.” As Jiang Ming muttered, he merged the reward he got from the system, a piece of Gluttony Law Seed into his Paradis Space. To think that he was rewarded with a Law Seed after just a simple meal! It was simply a pleasant surprise.
As for revealing a little bit of his hands, he did not care much.
“That’s great then! I never thought that the Sect Master unexpectedly spared Yue Cheng’s life and only sealed off his cultivation.” Zi Linglong was wondered and was relieved at the same time
“Killing him no longer matters!” Jiang Ming responded.
It really did not matter anymore.
Jiang Ming no longer minded about this.
Gu Hai also had placed it over his shoulder.
In the middle of the night, Jiang Ming stood holding onto the balcony as he gazed far away.
“It’s started, huh?”
“Well then, let’s kill the first wave!” Jiang Ming thought to himself with Junior Sister in his arms. With a simple command, the Combat Mannequin flew out to engage..

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - Descending Once Again, Hei Gu’s Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Descending Once Again, Hei Gu’s Death
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
That night the moon was nowhere to be seen as the wind howled through the mountains. Countless stars scattered moon dusts throughout the night sky, reanimating the footprints from eons ago.
“Girl, am I being too cruel here?” Jiang Ming muttered softly.
“No!” Linglong shook her head explaining, “For cultivators, once we are at opposing groups, then it’s either kill or be killed. Senior Brother, why do we name the devil as the devil? That’s because they don’t draw any lines and even kill the commoners. On the other hand, we cultivators only kill other
cultivators. Cultivators rob and steal from the creations of the heavens and earth, seeking for longevity themselves. The heavens and earth see cultivators as robbers and the commoners see us as the source of chaos. There is no right or wrong, no morals to be spoken of and no justice or maleficent to be
judged upon for bloodshed between cultivators. It’s simply kill or be killed and there’s no need to feel any guilt about it. Whether you kill someone or have your life taken from you, there’s no one to be blamed for it! This applies to both you and 1! But if anyone goes against you, then I will slaughter 36,000
clans!” Linglong had extraordinary resolution when she said that last part.
“Thirty-six thousand clans? Girl, if you counted like that then it’d be annihilating the whole world!” Jiang Ming could not help but laugh.
“So what? If something really happens to you, then the heavens and earth shall be sacrificed for your burial!” Linglong muttered as she laid her head onto his shoulders.
“Stop speaking nonsense. You are fine and so am I!” Jiang Ming muttered as he hugged her even tighter, “Since you’ve already created clones, try your best to let your real self be safe in the mountains.”
“Okay! I’ll listen to you, Senior Brother!” Linglong agreed.
The two quietly sat together listening to the silence of the peaceful night.
It didn’t take long before the combat mannequin returned to Jiang Ming.
The first alliance formed by many great monarchs of different clans came to seek justice from Jiuyang Sect but was totally annihilated. Even the monk Hui Xin and the rest were all killed, including Ming Yuan who was a Paradis expert. There were no survivors at all.
From the incident, immense fear immediately loomed over all the other alliances and broke up the alliances altogether.
Qingyun Sect
“Master!” The Holy Son Ming Yuzi greeted Qing Fengzi and continued, “We’ve just received news from the Qing province that the alliance lead by Ming Yuan, the expert of the Fo Sect was disbanded.”
“Oh? That was fast. What happened? Did Ming Yuan get killed?” Qing Fengzi was taken aback.
“That’s right! Even though many Great Monarchs were not at the scene, there were still quite a number of people from the alliance. However, it didn’t take long before they were all killed and even Ming Yuan didn’t manage to cause any problems. From our speculations, it seems that there’s at least one
Extreme Path expert protecting Jiuyang Sect.
“An Extreme Path Expert?” Qing Fengzi pondered to himself as numerous thoughts were rapidly racing through his mind. “Long ago, Jiuyang Sect has always been quiet and respectful to our clan. Ever since.
He paused a little before continuing on, “Ever since Mu Shuiyun’s son went to propose his marriage, there seems to be some changes from then on. Mu Shuiyun’s son was killed around that time and upon investigation, it was discovered that a faction formed from the Yinmo sect was prepared to launch
their attack onto Jiuyang Sect. This erupted into a great war. Later on, Mu Shuiyun tragically died but no one knew where. Bishui Sect who launched their attack onto the Jiuyang Sect was then annihilated and there were even a few Paradis Experts who died in the battle!”
“Not long after, there was a huge explosive wave of terrifying aura coming from the direction of Qingyun Sect. Qing Xuzi and I went over to investigate but we bumped into two Extreme Path experts from the Yinmo Sect instead. A great battle erupted that night!”
“Traces of Jiuyang Sect’s shadow could be seen from every one of these incidents!”
“Now that I think of it, I’m suspecting that the total annihilation of Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union had something to do with Jiuyang Sect!”
Qing Fengzi kept analyzing what happened before and after the Great Eastern War, carefully going through the information he received, careful not to miss out any details. Yet the more he thought about the whole incident, the more he felt that Jiuyang Sect had a lot to do with all of them.
Today, this incident has further confirmed his speculations.
“That can’t be! Jiuyang Sect looked so innocent and without any background. What can they even be hiding? Master, don’t forget that when Yinmo Sect and the rest were destroyed, how many experts were present? There were a few Imminent Immortal experts and even a few Extreme Path experts among
them! Even when our Qingyun Sect is in its glorious days and has ample preparation, we might not be able to take them down overnight!”
“That’s what I’m saying! There’s just so much mystery shrouding over this incident!”
“Master, what should we do now? Now that we know the Jiuyang Sect is hiding a Yinmo Sect’s remnant, should we continue to investigate the matter?”
“Don’t take any drastic action before we understand more details. After all, we can’t afford to experience another fiasco again. For the sake of our own safety and to find out more about the real situation of Jiuyang Sect, we will just ensure that the news is thoroughly spread throughout the Eastern Region,
sit back and watch them fight among themselves.”
Jiang Ming did not know about the Qingyun Sect’s situation, nor did he care.
Five people appeared hundreds of miles away from Jiuyang Sect.
Leading them was a shirtless man who had two curved homs on his forehead. Although the aura emitted from his body was very obscure, it still gave off a strong oppressive feeling and boiling rage.
He stopped atop the mountain, gazing around with his bloodshot eyes.
“This is indeed a perfect planar world with ample spiritual energy and obscure Dao Fluctuation!” With a sigh, the man turned around and said, “The mission to investigate details on Jiuyang Sect seemed to be considered a lower level mission of only C-Grade, yet the time given for this mission is one whole
month. This seems a little abnormal. To be on the safe side, we will follow what we did previously, find the location of Jiuyang Sect, collect information and then control the disciples of the Jiuyang Sect to infiltrate into their internal departments. How about that? Does anyone have anything to add?”
“No! Let’s do what you’ve just said!” the rest of the figures replied.
“Alright then. We will split up here and go collect more information. Regroup here after a day!” the shirtless man commanded.
Among the five of them, some flew away, some dug into the ground, some disappeared just like that, while some took out their flying machine and everyone was just gone in a blink of an eye.
In Chuyang Peak.
“It’s late at night now, go and rest!” Jiang Ming shook Linglong who was lying on his body.
“I don’t want to! It’s comfortable like this!” Linglong simply shook her head.
“Well, if you don’t want to rest, I still need to go to sleep!”
“You could just sleep like this!”
“Stop making trouble!”
“Fine!” Linglong finally gave up and reluctantly left.
Once Jiang Ming went back to his room, with a simple thought, the room was completely sealed, not allowing any outsiders to peek into the room.
“Guess it’s time to head into the Supreme Pagoda for a look!” As Jiang Ming thought in his mind, he took out the Supreme token and vanished instantly.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 8 (Paradis Realm)
Points Accumulated: 991 points.
Honors: [3rd Level: 6 stages record, 21 levels record, 992 units of special ability], [4th Level: 6 stages record, 15 levels record], [5th Level: 9 stages record, 21 level record, 68672 units of special ability]
Since he had improved in his cultivation, he naturally returned to the Supreme Pagoda again to take on the third test and passed the test without any hitches.
As he stood in the middle of the square looking around. It was very spacious yet very empty.
He knew that even if someone left anything such as a sofa around here, it would be recycled or wiped away when there was no longer anyone around.
“So very few people were chosen by the Supreme Pagoda!” Jiang Ming muttered to himself.
He later opened up the Supreme Chat room and started chatting inside.
Uiang Ming: I’m now at the Level 8 of cultivation and currently in the 6th level of the Supreme Pagoda. Anyone up for some gathering?}
[Zhan Ge: What a surprise group admin! Unfortunately, I’m now at level 9, otherwise I will be able to take a look at the peerless face of our group admin.]
Uiang Ming: I’ma straight man, don’t have a peerless look and I’m very masculine!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe! This I can vouch for. From his masculinity there’s a hint of peerlessness in them!]
[Ao Jiu: That means he can be both on the giving and the receiving end right? Oh mighty group admin! Care to have in-depth interaction with me?]
[Ming Ji: Pervert!]
Uiang Ming: You know the group admin can mute people right?)
[Ao Jiu: Well, don’t mind me. I was sleepwalking just now.]
[Hei Gu: Guys, I’m in trouble.]
[Ao Gu: What happened? Still haven’t fended off their attacks?]
[Hei Gu: No I haven’t. The enemy is just too strong. Even with the world’s law suppressing him, it still couldn’t stop him. I’m losing ground on my side now and I think I’m about to die.]
Uiang Ming: Hei Gu. What’s this about?)
[Ao Jiu: Let me have the honor! Wait, wait. I need to adjust myself before the story.]
{Zhan Ge, Jiang Ming, Tian Fozi: ….]
All three were speechless.
[Ao Jiu: (Cough) Right! The planar world that Hei Gu is in right now is facing invasion by another small chiliocosm. Even under the suppression of his world’s power, there were still quite a number of level 9 and level 10 experts who descended into their world and started a bloodbath. I heard from Hei Gu
that they seemed to be trying to completely annihilate his world. We’ve given a few Immortal Weapons to back him up but still couldn’t stop them.]
(Jiang Ming: Complete annihilation? What good does that do for them? Won’t there be a lot of restrictions when a peerless outsider descends into another world?
[Ao Jiu: Of course there’s a lot of benefits to it! Once they completely take over, they will be able to lay their hands on a sea of fresh and blood spiritual essence and also souls. They can then draw out the power of the world’s origin and even forge the world into a special vessel for example.]
[Ao Jiu: It’s typically very hard to fend off once a planar world faces invasion. But it’s not impossible!]
[Ao Jiu: Every world is protected by the world’s laws. When a foreign living being descends, it will naturally be rejected and suppressed. Moreover, it also takes a huge effort for them to descend into a foreign world. Another thing to take note is that when descending to another world, if the person has a
cultivation level higher than what the world is able to withstand, then it will be directly destroyed by the Heavenly Curse. There are of course certain ways to hide from this but the cost is much greater.]
[Ao Jiu: A planar world is typically located deep in the boundless spatial time and trying to locate it is extremely difficult. Once a planar world is discovered and a person wants to infiltrate into the world, the coordinates of the place will be marked to allow a Great Divinity to open up an inter-world
gateway for them to descend. When a planar world is discovered yet its coordinate is not found, it will still be very difficult to reveal the real location of the world because the spatial time realm is an enigma. This also serves as a protection to the planar worlds.]
[Ao Jiu: The world that Hei Gu is in now has been found and its coordinates marked. Once the gateway is activated, countless invaders will descend into the world. Invaders typically invade with the aim of dominating the world, using the place as a temporary base for them to nurture geniuses. Very few
invaders came over just for the sake of wantonly killing living beings. Hei Gu’s invaders should be those who came from malicious factions. He was unlucky. ]
Hearing Ao Jiu’s detailed explanation, Jiang Ming’s heart shrank.
He recalled killing the three who were members of the Reincarnation Hall. Could it be that they also had invasive nature?
“The more I know, the more I feel insecure!” Jiang Ming sighed inside.
Uiang Ming: “Aren’t there any peerless experts from the higher-level world to manage these sorts of things?]
[Ao Jiu: “Well. My cultivation is still low and the level I’m at is also not high enough. I’m not sure about that!]
[Hei Gu: I’m done for! They slaughtered their way towards me!]
[Hei Gu: I plan to rip space apart and try to escape from the world!]
[Hei Gu: Damn! They’ve sealed off the surroundings by using Devilish Soldiers that exceed level 10! There’s a total of 32 of them!
(Hei Gu: I’m doomed!]
(Hei Gu: Can anyone save me?]
[Hei Gu: I don’t have any accumulated points left! Can anyone give me something for protection? I’ll return the favor in doubles! ]
(Hei Gu: L….]
[Dongfang Zhenxi: I’ve got some! Give me a second, I’ll send it over right… just wait for a bit more!]
Immediately after, Hei Gu’s avatar turned dim.
There was a sudden numbing silence in the whole chat room..

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - World Dao, The Lord God Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: World Dao, The Lord God Space
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
His avatar dimmed gray before it completely vanishes.
Everyone knew that Hei Gu had died.
Those able to join the Supreme Chat Room proved that the person had excellent innate talent, being the best from each of their worlds to the point that even countless worlds might not be able to give birth to such a being.
Yet such a monstrous genius was killed under everyone’s watch.
Great sadness could be felt, mourning Hei Gu’s departure from the living.
[Jiang Ming: Everyone! Please find yourself an escape route immediately when you discover your world is under invasion.]
[Zhan Ge: Always prepare a way out for yourself!]
[Ao Jiu: That’s just too difficult! Take my world for example. If a great war between the powerful ones were to be triggered, with my level of cultivation, however many escape plans would only be futile!]
[Zhan Ge: Your world’s level is too high! The level 10 is but only a small prawn in the big sea.]
[Ao Jiu: I won’t deny that. Hei Gu’s death really rang a bell in me. I’ve made up my mind! I’ll work hard on my cultivation, further precipitate my strength and look for a chance for a breakthrough, but accumulation is just too hard. To this day, I don’t have any confidence that I can still stay in the Supreme
Pagoda once I break through, let alone joining an even stronger chat room. A dragon’s life is of so much hardship! Alas, I’m going to go to another one of my palaces to find Xiao Cui and the gang to talk about our life and ideals.]
[Zhan Ge: My God, you have other harems?]
[Ao Jiu: Calm down, calm down. I don’t have that many harems, only eighty-one!]
[Zhan Ge: I’m gritting my teeth now with envy and hate.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’ve just hunted down a level 14 true dragon and cooked myself a bowl of medicinal food with dragon’s liver, dragon’s marrow, dragon’s heart and dragon’s blood.]
[Zhan Ge: Haha! It must taste so good!]
[Ming Fei: Delicious!)
[Ye Qingxian: Delicious!]
[Ao Jiu: My goodness, level 14? Back in my place, level 14 is already the Great Monarch’s level. Aunt! I’ll admit I’m scared of you now, can I?]
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh as well.
Suddenly, he noticed two figures appearing in the square, both almost arriving at the same time.
“Brother Jiang Ming! Long time no see!” Dongfang Chenxi ran over happily.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian greeted with a smile as she clenched her fists.
“I didn’t expect us to meet up again!” Jiang Ming also gave a joyous smile.
Meeting up with friends across different worlds yet again was not that easy nor was it just an ordinary fate.
Jiang Ming took out a sofa for them to sit and also some great wines that he got from Luo Heng to enjoy together. As they touched wine glasses, they shared their own experiences.
Ye Qingxian had been thriving back in her world and had become the most dazzling talented genius back in her world. She could even fight against the experts of the older generations without falling behind.
Looking at how she was in the same level as Jiang Ming in the past and now arriving at the same place again, proved how much talent and potential she had, a rare scene indeed.
On the other hand however, Luo Heng lost out by a little.
As for Dongfang Chenxi, it had been very boring for her. She simply had her cultivation, chatted in the chatroom and felt bored.
“Sigh! When will it be my turn to travel the world freely like you two!” Dongfang Chenxi laid back onto the sofa with a face full of grudge.
“The young ones never tasted the sorrows and yearns to rise above. As they rise above, they no longer feel the sorrows yet they have to reluctantly show their sorrow. Now that I’ve tasted the sorrows and the agony, I feel like sharing, yet it felt wrong to do so. Wanting to share my sorrows, yet what comes
out were just compliments of the windy autumn.” Jiang Ming recited a poem with a smile and continued, “Many among our chat room should be envious of you actually. Take me for example! My biggest ambition is to live a carefree and worry-free life. I like to imagine myself basking in the sun and
feeling the wind caressing my face! Oh how peaceful that would be!”
“Brother Jiang, your dream is simple yet it’s very difficult at the same time!” Ye Qingxian said softly, “Just looking at the worlds around us, how many of them can really live a care-free life? The weather varies much like how a person’s fortune flickers. Even if you don’t cause any troubles, those around you
may, and that would eventually affect you as well. Even if you are all alone, living a secluded life in the deep mountains, there’s still a chance to be found by some demon devils or maybe the great wars from another province also mayt ripple over to you. Take Hei Gu for example. He’s already conquered
the world he lived in and how did it end for him? After all that, he was killed by invaders. Who can really live a carefree life? Brother Jiang, it’s just too difficult!”
“You are right! It’s way too difficult!” Jiang Ming sighed as he waved his hand around, “Enough of that. Sister Ye, what Dao are you cultivating?”
“Flying Feather Immortal Dao!”
“Flying Feather Immortal Dao?”
“Yes. My Dao is all about transcending oneself and rising over the limits!”
Ye Qingxian’s body started emitting violent bursts of luminance, radiating streams after streams, pushing waves after waves. It felt as if there were tens of thousands of feathers piling up in order, but also gave off a feeling as though they were petals falling down from the skies.
‘When the luminance shined onto Jiang Ming’s body, it gave him the urge to succumb to her willingly to the point that even his physique and mana were starting to change slightly.
Immediately, Ye Qingxian retracted her aura and explained, “Turning into feathers, returning to me, forging myself to be the strongest and aid me to soar into the skies. This is the Dao that I’ve cultivated. A Dao that can turn anything and everything into Dao and fuse into my body, strengthening myself.”
“Sister Ye is so amazing!” Dongfang Chenxi exclaimed in surprise.
Hearing Chenxi’s praise, Ye Qingxian only shook her head, “There’s still a big gap between myself and the two of you. Although it was just a demonstration just now, it also allowed me to sense that there was unyielding power coming from within the both of you.”
Ye Qingxian was really astonished. It wasn’t surprising about Dongfang Chenxi as she had a strong background coming from the great chiliocosm and was even an empress.
Simply listening about her background causes people to drop their jaws.
Anything she owned could easily exceed the level limits of the worlds.
But what about Jiang Ming?
He was from the planar world as well yet for an instance when she was demonstrating her Dao, she could feel a kind of deep and unshakable qi and blood, as well as a terrifying manain his body that seems to be comparable to a world.
It was simply beyond her comprehension.
“Amazing! Truly amazing! You’ve managed to fuse tens and thousands of Dao into your own body. Without an unyielding courage, it’s impossible to even comprehend such a Dao!” Jiang Ming praised in astonishment.
“You are exaggerating!” Ye Qingxian replied as she turned over to the other side and asked, “What about you, Chenxi?”
“Me oh me! My path has already been arranged by my father to walk onto the World Dao” Dongfang Chenxi answered reluctantly.
“World Dao?” Ye Qingxian was getting curious.
“Yes. It’s like forming a world in your sea of consciousness and to later give birth to a real world in the future. It really feels pointless!” Dongfang Chenxi did not hold back.
As she explained, a shadowy image was suddenly formed atop of her head as it slowly turned into a vast world. You could see that it had everything from mountains and rivers to lakes and seas. The only thing it did not have was living beings in it.
“Turning illusions into reality! This is a perfect Dao!” Ye Qingxian exclaimed, “I’ve thought over this before but the thought of trying to do it seems to be impossible! From my speculations, if I were to walk down that path, I’d need 100 million years and end up with a few percent of chances of success.
Chenxi, if you can really conjure up a real world in the future, then you’d become the Creator! ”
“Creator? It would be great if that’s the case. I can create whatever I want from thin air! Hehe. That means there will be endless delicious food for me to eat and drink or even play! If I can create a sci-fi world like Luo Heng’s world, that would be perfect!” Chenxi was starting to get interested.
Hearing Chenxi’s remark, Ye Qingxian was speechless as she shook her head silently. She then looked over to Jiang Ming and asked: “Brother Jiang, what about you?”
“Mine is the World Dao as well!” Jiang Ming also conjured an image of a world similar to that of Dongfang Chenxi, except that it was much wider and extensive.
In fact, he was actually very surprised.
‘With how difficult it was to open up a perfect Paradis World, he thought that there would not even be one in tens of thousands of years and yet he encountered one so easily today.
But when he thought about her background and that her ‘Status’ in the Human Path Record mentioning about her father who cultivated a world and infused it into Dongfang Chenxi’s body, it all made sense.
If he had such conditions, he would have been able to barge through any hardships.
“Another Planar world!” Ye Qingxian was startled and suddenly turned speechless.
“Eh! Brother Jiang Ming, we are both the same! This really is fate! Our cultivation is of the same genre. Could it be that we are in the same universe? If that’s the case, doesn’t that mean we might meet each other in reality in the future?”
“That’s really quite possible. This fate between you two is really something!” Ye Qingxian was at a loss for words.
‘When she thought of these two geniuses getting together and how intense will their spark be, she felt a bit jealous of them
“If that’s really the case then I’ll have to curry favor with Sister Chenxi from now on!” Jiang Ming said with a smile on his face.
Dongfang Chenxi laughed out loud and exclaimed: “T’ll look over you from now on!”
Ever since they had demonstrated their Dao, their relationship had gotten a lot closer inexplicably.
‘As time slowly drifted by, the three of them chatted and laughed together, discussing and sharing the mysteries of their worlds.
Finally, Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself but asked Dongfang Chenxi: “Do you know of an organization that’s similar to the Supreme Pagoda that can recruit talents across the world and place them in another world of some sort?”
Ye Qingxian’s body perked up slightly due to curiosity.
Pondering for a bit, Dongfang Chenxi then shared, “I heard from my father not long ago that he knew of a friend who created some sort of tool that can illuminate countless small worlds and select a few geniuses to be nurtured. Instead of training them personally, these geniuses that were selected will be
placed in different worlds to undergo missions and train themselves in the process. The death rate is quite high as well. Oh! I remember now! That thing is called the Lord God, something that was forged with God’s body after a Lord God was slain.
“There’s really such a thing! Able to illuminate countless small worlds! That’s really amazing!” Jiang Ming was in shock as his heart trembled.
There’s even a Lord God now! Is it possible that there’s even a Chu Xuan?
“It’s not that amazing. My father despises it saying that such imitation was nondescript.” Dongfang Chenxi said as she shook her head in disapproval.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Ming was left speechless. He was now completely sure that Dongfang Chenxi’s father should at least be at the Great Arching Golden Immortal level. If that wasn’t the case, how would the father despise someone who was so peerless that he could forge a Lord of God?
It seemed she was really a genuine princess!
Her thigh seems to be very thick! The main thing is that they’re not only white and soft but pure in heart!
Translator note: “Thick thigh’ in Chinese can also be a metaphor for a supportive person; a person in authority.
I must hug them tightly!
Only hugging them? Aren’t there any other thoughts?
Jiang Ming admittedly did not dare to have any.
Their chatter finally came to a stop.
Ye Qingxian came over to the Million Dao Chart and started to comprehend special abilities. This was considered another form of cultivation.
“I’m preparing to cultivate the Heavenly Monument Laws now. What about you, Chenxi? Any plans?” Jiang Ming asked.
Cultivation of the Heavenly Monument was part of Jiang Ming’s plan all along.
“Tl head back for a bit. Brother Jiang Ming, don’t leave first! Wait for me to return!” Dongfang Chenxi waved her hand before she suddenly disappeared.
“Wait?” Jiang Ming shook his head and laughed.
He did not mind one bit as he walked over to the Wood Heavenly Monument and sat in front of it.
An enormous palace was floating and sinking in the endless torrents, as boundless blinding lights were constantly radiating from it as if it could illuminate millions and millions of worlds.
Dongfang Chenxi suddenly appeared deep within the palace and walked outside. She lifted her head and yelled out: “Old Father!”
The maids by her sides simply bowed their heads and smiled.
“Little Xixi! I didn’t expect you to take the initiative to call me! Did you miss me?” an elegant middle-aged man came walking out of the blinding light with a look of surprise on his face.
“Of course not!” Chenxi took her father’s arm and asked: “Father, do you still have any World Heart? Give me one.”
“Your internal world has already been merged with one. If you haven’t fully digested it yet, then adding more of them won’t be of any use” he explained.
“Tm asking for a friend,” she retorted.
“A friend?” her father was confused.
“yes! Well, he is the same as I am. We both walk on the path of World Dao. His internal world seems to be even more perfect than mine.” Chenxi explained cheekily.
“World Dao? What level of the world was your friend from?” the father pressed on.
“The Planar world!” Chenxi replied blatantly.
“What? The Planar World?” The middle-aged man skipped a breath as his face was filled with shock..

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - Chaos Sea, World Heart, I’m Not Thinking Anything
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chaos Sea, World Heart, I’m Not Thinking Anything
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the Supreme Pagoda, in front of the Heavenly Monument.
Jiang Ming had comprehended the Wood Law. The Wood Law was otherwise known as the Law of Origin. It was the first law of all laws as well as the source of all life force.
1
Due to the limitation of his cultivation level, 30% was the maximum he could comprehend. After all, only an Extreme Path martial artist could fully understand a law.
In the Primal Spirit Realm, one could form his or her Primal Spirit. In the Paradis Realm, one’s consciousness would be expanded, and the Extreme Path Realm was the beginning of understanding the law.
However, Jiang Ming had long since broken the limit.
Generally speaking, no matter how big or vast the Paradis Space inside the sea of consciousness was, it wasn’t real. However, Jiang Ming had comprehended the basic laws that formed the world such as the Five Elemental, Yin-and-Yang, Light-and-Dark, True Illusion, Time-Space, and so on. Therefore,
he was able to break the shackles and turn the Paradis Space into a real world.
From a specific standpoint, one could be considered an Extreme Path martial artist after comprehending a law. Right now, Jiang Ming only needed to complete the Paradis Space and he could ascend into the Extreme Pathm Realm.
Honestly speaking, realms were irrelevant now.
He did not know if it were because of the Primal World, or his willpower had become stronger, he breezed through the enlightenment process without any difficulty and successfully comprehended 90% of the Wood Law.
He could go on, but he decided to stop now.
Inside the Primal World, Jiang Ming manifested a body and stood in the sky, looking out in all directions.
The mountains were green, the land was filled with forests, and the rivers were covered in green duckweed. Wherever he looked, he only saw green in his eyes. Even the sun and the moon were glowing in green.
Not only that, but he was also able to sense a strong life force from the air.
‘Is this the result of mastering only one law?’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly.
After that, he rose to his feet and came to the Fire Heavenly Monument to comprehend the Fire Dao.
Time fluttered by and a few days had passed.
“Wood, fire, earth, metal, water, I’ve comprehended all of them to 90%! This is incredible!”
Even himself was startled by his own speed. However, he hadn’t made any progress on Yin-and-Yang and Light-and-Dark.
“Let’s keep it going!”
Jiang Ming did not stop and walked up to the Light Heavenly Monument.
The time was running slowly, and he kept changing from one Heavenly Monument to the other.
Meanwhile, Ye Qingxian had finished her initial comprehension of special ability. She looked at Jiang Ming and she was shocked. She found out that he had become a lot more powerful now. The aura he exuded was so terrifying that it caused goosebump to burst all over her skin.
“Just how many points does he have now? The more points he has, the stronger he will become after he goes to the next level. He’s truly amazing,” Ye Qingxian exclaimed.
At the same time, a human figure materialized. It was Dongfang Chenxi.
“You’re back so soon,” Ye Qingxian smiled.
“Thank goodness that you’re still here!” Dongfang Chenxi said as she scanned around. When she saw that Jiang Ming was sitting in front of the Heavenly Monument, she heaved out a sigh of relief and smiled sweetly, “I miss you so much, Sister Ye!”
“That’s so lovely,” Ye Qingxian chuckled, “Chenxi, do you have any transcendents in your world? Like those who ascend from the lower level worlds.”
“Yes, there are a lot of them. Some of them come from the planer world while the others come from the small chiliocosm. However, I’ve never heard any of them coming from the middle chiliocosm before. My father told me that after breaking their limit, those who were at the top of the middle
chiliocosm will ascend to a place known as the Origin, which is the origin of all the worlds. My father has been there before, but he said that it’s too dangerous and we should just stay in our own world.”
“The origin of all the worlds?”
“Yeah.”
“So does this mean that the Supreme Pagoda comes from there too?”
“T’ve asked my father about it, but he told me that he has no idea as well and he prevented me from investigating it.:”
While both of them were talking, Jiang Ming opened his eyes. He walked toward them and asked, “The origin of all the worlds? Could it be the Chaos Sea in the legend?”
“Brother Jiang!” Dongfang Chenxi chirped happily, “I’m not sure about that either. My father rarely talks about the Origin. He also told me that I should go around and tell everyone about it. It’s a taboo for me to talk about it over there in my place, but since I’m here, I can talk about whatever I want to you
guys!”
“You’re treating us like your true friends!” Jiang Ming chuckled.
“Of course! The more I know, the smaller I feel. I thought I was at the top of my world, but when I looked up, it turned out that I had just crossed a stream, and there were big rivers, lakes, rivers and seas, seas of stars, seas of the universe, seas of Dao!”
“Haha!” Ye Qingxian couldn’t help herself and laughed, “Seas of Dao? Brother Jiang, just how insecure do you feel? You seriously have underestimated yourself!”
“Tm afraid of death!” Jiang Ming sat down. “I just want a normal life. I want to enjoy the sun, the wind and all kinds of food, but reality doesn’t allow it. All kinds of messy things keep swarming around and pushing you forward, or even forcing you to take other people’s lives!”
“You’re right,” Ye Qingxian said, “I used to be a princess. I didn’t have to worry about anything, but something happened to my family and I had no other choice but to grow up and take care of myself. I had to keep on moving forward, cultivating martial arts and taking other people’s lives to keep myself
alive. My hands are drenched in blood and beneath me are the bones of the people that I killed. I despise a life like this but I have no other choices. I can only keep moving forward and I can’t see where my future lies.”
“Is it really that hard? I can’t relate at all,” Dongfang Chenxi said. “However, I kind of admire the way you live. After all, you don’t have to get confined in a place.”
“You admire the way we live, and we admire the way you live. There’s one phrase in my world that goes: the grass is always greener on the other side. We always find it difficult to cherish the things we’re used to, and we always end up ignoring their beauty,” Jiang Ming said, “Chenxi, actually you can make
your life more colorful.”
“Really?” Dongfang Chenxi’s eyes glowed.
“Did you not ask for anything from Luo Heng?”
“I don’t dare to!”
“You don’t have to feel that. I’ve met him twice in the Supreme Pagoda, and he’s very eager to get to know you. See, these are the things I get from him!” Jiang Ming said as he pulled out a tablet, a computer, and a projector. He clicked on the computer and pulled out a movie.
“This is known as a movie. There are tons of movies over there in his world, so you don’t have to worry about not having anything to watch. Besides, there are a lot of games as well for you to kill your free time!” Jiang Ming said.
“Wow!” Dongfang Chenxi’s eyes were glowing brighter and brighter. “I only asked for some food, drink, or toys. These are the real good stuff!”
“Just the right things for you!” Jiang Ming said.
“You shouldn’t play with these things too often!” Ye Qingxian knew what these things were in just a single glance and shook her head.
“Sister Ye, you have no idea how dull my life was. It’s only after meeting you guys that my life has become a lot more interesting, and with these things, I’m sure my life is going to become a lot more colorful!” Dongfang Chenxi said as she spun a few rounds in the air.
After that, she took out a pitch black seed and threw it to Ye Qingxian.
“Sister Ye, this is known as the Devouring Seed. I think it’s very suitable for you, so I’m giving it to you.”
“This is…” Ye Qingxian studied the seed and her expression changed when she noticed the dense amount of Dao rhythm in it. After a short while of hesitancy, she rose to her feet and made a bow at Dongfang Chenxi, “This might be nothing to you, but it means a lot to me. Thank you so much, Chenxi. I’ll
never forget about it.”
“I’s good that you like it, Sister Ye!” Dongfang Chenxi said. After that, she pulled out an energy crystal that looked like a heart. “Brother Jiang, this is the World Heart.It’s the core after refining a planar world. It’s very suitable for our World Dao, so I want you to have it,” Dongfang Chenxi said as she handed
the World Heart to Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming hastily shook his head and said, “This is too much for me to take!”
“Holy! This is a world! How could she give it away just like that?
“Just take it, Brother Jiang. Take it as an investment,” Dongfang Chenxi persuaded, “My father said that someone like you who could develop the World Dao in a planar world is destined to have a great achievement if you don’t die young, Your potential is much greater than mine. Your World Dao is
developed by yourself, while I require the help from other people. Although they look the same, there’s a huge difference between the two. My father told me that if I help you now, I might be able to get something big in return in the future, so just take it. Besides, aren’t we friends?”
“Alright, then!” Jiang Ming had no other choice but to take it.
Dongfang Chenxi was overjoyed.
Three of them sat together and watched the movie. There were plenty of intimate scenes, and Ye Qingxian’s cheek flushed red. She darted glances at Jiang Ming from time to time as a strange feeling rose from her heart.
As for Dongfang Chenxi, her cheeks were red and her eyes were big.
‘There were a lot of thoughts in Jiang Ming’s head, but he suppressed them all..

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - Their Inner Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 141 Their Inner Thoughts
Jiang Ming felt his blood was boiling, and in the blink of an eye, plenty of images flashed across his head, but he had to act calm.
Ye Qingxian’s body stiffened, and she did not dare to turn her head around.
Dongfang Chenxi’s cheeks were red.
Both of them remained sitting still like they were statues.
There seemed to be a hint of awkwardness in the air.
“Now that I have the World Heart, I can finally perfect my inner world. Guys, I’ll go cultivate now. I can’t wait any longer,” Jiang Ming said as he went to a corner and sat down with his back facing the two of them.
Phew…
Both of the girls heaved out a sigh of relief at the same time. They looked at each other, and they froze when they noticed they had done the same action. After that, they chuckled and went closer to each other.
A soundproofing barrier appeared around them. Both of them talked and laughed from time to time.
Jiang Ming couldn’t hear what they were talking about.
He did not cultivate either. Instead, he opened up the Human Path Records as he wanted to check both of their Status.
Name: Dongfang Chenxi
Race: Human
Cultivation Base: Paradis Realm
Background: Daughter of the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm’s Eastern Heavenly Emperor
or
Relationship: 82
Innate Talent: Immortal (Innate Saint Daoist Body)
Status: She told her father that there was one man in the planar world who had chosen the World Dao, and her father was shocked. After all, although it was nearly impossible for someone like that to appear in the planar world, they would certainly be able to achieve something great when one finally appeared. Her father proceeded to ask her about the man’s personality, and she told him that he was a nice guy with a nice personality.
: When she told him that the man was the group admin, he told her to make friends with him and help him when he hadn’t come into power yet. He also gave her the World Heart and asked her to give it to the man as a gift.
: She gave the gift to Jiang Ming after entering the Supreme Pagoda, and Jiang Ming took out some high-tech stuff.
: She had heard about the movie from Luo Heng. It didn’t seem bad to her, but there were several things she did not understand about. Why were the man and the woman hugging each other? Why were they biting each other’s lips? Were they kissing?
: It was too much for her to watch, and she wanted to close her eyes. However, Jiang Ming was just sitting next to her. She wondered if it would leave a bad impression on Jiang Ming if she closed her eyes or if she showed she had a lot of interest in the movie.
: She did not know what to do and felt her blood boiling.
: When she saw how engrossed the couple were while kissing, she had a feeling of trying it out as well.
: She looked at Jiang Ming and thought that his lips must taste sweet since they were so nicely shaped. She also noticed that Ye Qingxian was in the same condition as her as well.
a
: She was shocked when she saw the couple lying down on the bed and covering themselves with the blanket. She wondered what they were doing ‘Are they going to have a baby? Would I need to do that too when I’m going to have a baby in the future? Eww, it’s so gross. I don’t want other men to touch me, but if it were Brother Jiang… Oh gosh, oh gosh, this is too embarrassing! I have to stop thinking!
: She was a bit disappointed after seeing Jiang Ming leave. She went closer to Ye Qingxian, and both of them began to talk.
Jiang Ming’s eyebrows twitched, and a faint smile appeared on the corner of his lips.
Whoosh!
The Human Path Records flipped open once again.
Name: Ye Qingxian
Status: ‘So this is kissing? Do they need to press their lips together? This is so disgusting. There’s no way I would let other men lay their grubby paws on my body. H-How can they show this to the public?
‘Wait a second…
‘Why do I have the urge to keep watching it? I want to see how they strip each other naked and…
‘Oh my goodness, what the hell is wrong with me? D*mn it! Brother Jiang is just sitting beside me. Will he think that I’m an easy woman if I close my eyes?
‘Argh, this is so frustrating! My body is getting hotter and hotter, and my heart is pumping faster and faster. Did I fall into some kind of spell? There are scenes of me doing that with Brother Jiang in my head…
‘Oh gosh, oh gosh, what’s wrong with me!?
‘Phew, finally, he’s gone. But what is that disappointing feeling tugging at the depths of my heart? There is a voice inside of me asking me to hug him and…’
Jiang Ming nearly had a nosebleed.
‘Well, this is a surprise.”
It took him quite a long while to calm himself down.
He stored the World Heart away and went into the Paradis Space. As soon as he entered the Paradis Space, the World Heart gave out an intense light, and a natural force merged into the air around him.
Countless chains of order appeared in the thin air, piercing through the sky, the land, the sun, and the moon.
Jiang Ming hastily activated the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra and absorbed the power emitted by the World Heart.
While many laws and orders were forming, the Paradis World was taking shape as well.
In the meantime, Jiang Ming’s willpower and mana had gained tremendous improvement.
Even his body was reforming and evolving too.
Jiang Ming was completely engrossed in his cultivation, and the benefit he obtained far exceeded his expectation. A complete world required the support of 3,000 different laws, such as the Five Elements, Yin-and-Yang, and so on.
He had only comprehended about 20 or so laws. It was far too less. Although other laws would appear by themselves as the inner world continued to take shape, it would take a lot of time.
However, with the help of the World Heart, as he refined and absorbed the power from it, 3,000 chains of laws appeared from it. Although it was incomplete, it was more than sufficient to fill up the hole of the Paradis World, saving him tons of time.
Besides that, the essence of the World Heart had also provided an endless stream of nature force to his Paradis World. Therefore, he did not have to accumulate it bit by bit by accumulating his mana.
On one particular day, Jiang Ming cracked his eyes open and let out a bitter smile.
“Chenxi, Qingxian, I’ve broken through, so I’ll see you in the next level!”
He disappeared as soon as he finished speaking
Just now, a voice appeared in his head.
(Jiang Ming, you’re a Level 9 expert now, so you have two choices. Go back to reality or take the test to enter Level 7 of the Supreme Pagoda.)
This was the reason he had to pause his cultivation.
His Paradis World had accidentally reached its maturity in the middle of his cultivation. This was the limit of a Paradis Realm martial artist, and since he had comprehended some of the laws, he naturally stepped into the Extreme Path Realm.
“I haven’t tried the Heavenly Ladder and the Heavenly Battle Stage yet!” Jiang Ming sighed.
After he told Dongfang Chenxi and Ye Qingxian about his condition, he chose to accept the test, and he arrived at Level 7 without any difficulties.
Dongfang Chenxi was having snacks while watching TV on the couch. Suddenly, she jerked her head back, and before she could say anything, Jiang Ming had disappeared.
“That… That’s so fast!” Dongfang Chenxi exclaimed.
“As expected of Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian chimed in, “He’s the only one who has the guts to accept the test without fearing of failing it.” “Yeah. Even my father admires his talent very much.” Dongfang Chenxi nodded and said, “I assume that he must’ve gone too fast while absorbing the World Heart. As expected of Brother Jiang. I still need some time to fully absorb the nature force of the World Heart inside of me. I guess I should go back and have my father cast a time acceleration spell on me so that I can get into the next level as soon as possible to meet up with Brother Jiang!”
The corner of Ye Qingxian’s lips twitched.
‘D*mn it! Not only does she have a World Heart, but her father can cast the time acceleration spell too? Why is the world so unfair!?”
“Alright then. I guess I will stay here and enjoy a few movies,” Ye Qingxian said. “After that, I’ll go back to my cultivation. Let’smeet up at the next level.”
“See you at the next level, Sister Ye. Let me know if you need anything!”
“Don’t worry. I will.”
Both of them chatted for a while before Dongfang Chenxi left.
Ye Qingxian fast-forwarded the movie and only stopped when it reached the kissing scene. She then sat in a lotus position and continued her cultivation.
‘A time acceleration spell? Isn’t that what this place could do?’
“Let’s absorb the Devouring Seed first, then the Heavenly Monument, the Heavenly Ladder, the Heavenly Battle Stage, and finally the Million Dao Chart!” Ye Qingxian had everything planned out.
“After that, I’ll increase my cultivation level and go to look for Brother Jiang to watch the movie together…”
She froze, and her thoughts came to a stop.
‘What on earth am I thinking!?!

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - Seven Stars Immortals Extermination, Falling of the Great Sun
chapters.content:
Chapter 142 Seven Stars Immortals Extermination, Falling of the Great Sun
At Level 7 of the Supreme Pagoda, Jiang Ming encountered a bird-headed creature covered in scarlet gold.
He checked the Human Path Records, and it was only then that he knew that the creature was from a race known as the Golden Demons.
Initially, the creature was delighted to see someone here, but his face sank when he realized that Jiang Ming was a human.
Jiang Ming offered him a smile, but he did not say anything. He sat in a lotus position and checked on his Paradis World. After absorbing the Word heart, the breadth of the inner world had reached three million kilometers in circumference, and the transformation process was still going on.
After the laws and order had reached a certain point, the inner world would undergo a huge transformation and become a true world.
However, Jiang Ming did not have the confidence that he could achieve that even though he had absorbed the World Heart.
After a short while, he came to the Million Dao Chart.
Since his cultivation level had increased by leap and bounds, he had reached another realm, and he had nearly mastered some of the laws. He figured it was about time for him to add some new special abilities into his arsenal.
He was now at the later stage of the Extreme Path Realm.
At present, he just needed to master one law fully and could reach the peak of the Extreme Path.
After acquiring a few special abilities, he went to the Dao Monument to further his understanding of some Daos, such as the Five Elemental Dao and the Yin-Yang Dao. After that, he came to the Million Dao Chart again.
Since he had ascended into another realm, his life expectancy had increased greatly, so he did not care about the passage of time.
His life expectancy was several hundred times greater than that of the normal Extreme Path expert due to his inner world.
This year, Jiang Ming stood up and walked toward the Heavenly Ladder. As for the golden birdman, he was already gone.
He lifted his head and noticed that there was not much change to the Heavenly Ladder.
“Last time, my willpower was equivalent to that of a Level 11 expert. I wonder how many levels I can reach this time?”
Jiang Ming surmised that a Level 11 expert was considered an immortal being. This was what Dongfang Chenxi told him. It was only by stepping into the Immortal Realm that one could consider them had entered the first sphere of heaven.
Jiang Ming stepped onto the Heavenly Ladder, and his body trembled.
The first step was comparable to the willpower of an early Level 11 expert.
He froze for a moment before moving up step by step.
Soon, he arrived at the 8th level, and just when he was about to reach the 9th level, he trembled slightly.
Huff…
He let out a breath and took a step forward.
As soon as his feet landed on the 9th level, Jiang Ming felt as if a sword had landed on his soul. The attack was so powerful that it sent a chill down his spine.
ICCE
Jiang Ming’s heart glowed and successfully defended against the attack.
“Again!”
He continued.
The 11th level, the 12th level…
He continued to move forward until the 18th level in one setting. His face was pale, while his entire body was shaking profusely.
On the 19th level, his willpower was crushed, and his vision turned black. By the time he opened his eyes again, he had already appeared below the Heavenly Ladder.
“Congratulations to Jiang Ming on conquering 18 levels of the Heavenly Ladder. You have earned 990 points! Note: The higher one expert is in one realm, the more difficult it would be for them to pass one level. Thus, the rewards would be increased.”
Jiang Ming listened to the voice in his head, and his mind drifted off.
He would be awarded 1 point for each level of the first nine steps in the past, but now the reward had been increased by ten times.
He took a short break and came to the Heavenly Battle Stage. Same as before, nothing had changed. He walked across the corridor and came to the first stage, and to his surprise, Jun Sanqian did not appear. The battlefield had also changed to a separate space.
“Jiang Ming, kill the opponents in front of you!” The voice rang out again.
10 people were standing in front of him. One of them was the Imminent Immortal expert, while the remaining nine were at the Extreme Path Realm. All of them were humans.
Rumble!
Jiang Ming activated his Paradis Projections and killed all ten of them in one hit; even the Imminent Immortal expert was no match for him.
“I have become so strong already?” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
He did not know how strong he had become. After all, the inner world was something beyond common sense, so there was no standard frame of reference for him to gauge how strong he had become.
He got 10 points from this stage.
On the 2nd stage…
He was matched up against 10 opponents too. Two of them were Imminent Immortals, while the remaining were Extreme Path experts.
He defeated all of them without any difficulties and got 20 points.
On the 3rd stage, there were four Imminent Immortal and six Extreme Path experts. He made quick work of them and got 40 points. Jiang Ming continued to move forward, and when he stepped onto the 4th stage, he appeared in the sky.
There was an island, surrounded by stormy seas, ahead of him.
“Jiang Ming, destroy the Canglan Sect!”
This time, it was not a voice but a line of words written in blood that appeared in front of him.
“Seems like the requirement to clear the stage has changed!”
As the thought surfaced in Jiang Ming’s head, he extended his consciousness forward into the Akasa to check on the Canglan Sect. However, since an array protected the sect, he couldn’t see the things inside.
Dong! Dong! Dong!
At the same time, the sound of a bell rang, and human figures appeared from the Canglan Sect one after another. The one standing at the front of the group was an old man in the Imminent Immortal Realm.
“Incoming attack! Hurry up and activate the formation!” the old man shouted.
In the next second, several rays of starlight descended from the sky and surrounded Jiang Ming.
“Once the Seven Stars Immortal Extermination Formation has surrounded you, you won’t be able to escape from it even if you are an immortal! Die!” the old man shouted.
As soon as his voice died away, seven Imminent Immortal experts stepped into the starlights, followed by 49 Extreme Path experts and 108 Paradis experts. All of them sat around the formation and powered it up. Jiang Ming stood silently in the formation. His surroundings were filled with an endless amount of starlight, and every bit of starburst contained an extremely frightening power. He couldn’t blink out of the formation either.
“Well, I guess it’s time for some action.” Jiang Ming waved his arms, and a surge of terrifying power appeared from him.
At that moment, the formation turned into a long sword made of starlight and dashed straight at Jiang Ming.
“It’s almost as strong as an immortal weapon.” Jiang Ming deduced.
He raised his hand and crushed the blade before it could even touch him.
“Starry Rain!” The old man’s voice rang out again.
He saw the endless starlight turn into countless tiny swords in the next second. They all charged toward Jiang Ming at top speed, and each of them was no weaker than the long sword they threw at him.
“This is interesting!”
Jiang Ming darted forward, leaving several afterimages behind. In the blink of an eye, he threw 1,800 punches to the front and crushed all of the swords that fell on him.
“If this is what you’ve got, then die!” he shouted. He amassed his strength on his palm and activated the Sky Dawn.
Bam!
The formation distorted, and 108 Paradis experts burst into a mist of blood. The 49 Extreme Path experts spurted blood, and the 7 Imminent Immortal experts’ faces were dark.
“Guys, I guess we have no other choice but to activate the forbidden technique to destroy this monster!” the old man shouted. “Let’s sacrifice ourselves to power up the formation and bring forth the power of a star!”
All of the experts burned their Primal Spirits and merged their power into the formation, forming into a blazing giant star known as the sun and descended on Jiang Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - The Second Form of the Great Millennium Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 143 The Second Form of the Great Millennium Technique
The sun continued to fall on Jiang Ming, shattering the fabrics of space and distorting all laws.
It was an attack capable of bringing destruction to the world, but Jiang Ming neutralized it with a punch. “I wonder how strong I have become right now. I haven’t even used the Three-fold Astral Transformation yet.”
However, there was one thing he was very certain of. An Imminent Immortal expert wasn’t a threat to him anymore.
On the 5th stage, a holy kingdom appeared before him.
There was nothing but light here as the Light Dao had suppressed all other forces.
His opponents this time were 12 Imminent Immortal experts and 81 Extreme Path experts. They just used one type of special abilityLight Purification.
It was a special ability that could purify all evil. All of their powers merged into one and further amplified the power of the special ability to a shocking degree.
However, it did nothing to Jiang Ming, and he defeated all of them easily.
The 6th stage was an abyss. The moon was blood red, the land was brown, and the air was pervaded with Demonic Qi that could corrupt one’s mind.
He looked into the distance, but all he could see was nothing but skeletons, headless horsemen, and demonic beasts. All of them were rushing toward him like a tidal wave, and there seemed to be no end to it.
At the end of the horde stood a group of people. There were a total of 18 of them, and they were all Imminent Immortal experts. They all joined in forces and formed a devilish weapon. They threw it at him, causing his skin to crack and blood to splurt out of his body.
However, his bones remained intact.
“It’s almost as powerful as an immortal weapon,” Jiang Ming commented as a serious expression appeared on his face.
In the next second, his body began to increase in size, and he destroyed all of them and the demonic kingdom in one punch. On the 7th stage was a vast land with many mountains.
This time, he was only going up against one opponent, and that person was none other than Jun Sanqian.
“I thought you’re not going to show up anymore, senior,” Jiang Ming said excitedly as he bowed to him.
“The rules have changed, so of course, I won’t appear on every stage like how I used to,” Jun Sanqian said. He measured Jiang Ming from his head to his toe, and then his eyes glowed. “Good lord, you’re finally back on the right track!”
“Well, am I considered unique in this universe now?” Jiang Ming asked, grinning from ear to ear.
ne
Jun Sanqian shook his head and said meaningfully, “Nope. You’re still far from it. You’re undoubtedly one of the best ones right now, but unfortunately, you’re still rather mediocre if compared to them.”
“Seriously?” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
Jun Sanqian chuckled but did not say anything anymore. “I know you have an inquisitive mind, so just ask if there’s anything you want to ask. I’ll answer them as much as I can.”
“Thank you so much, senior,” Jiang Ming replied with a smile. Several questions appeared in his head, and he asked, “Senior, do you know anything about organizations that could descend on multiple worlds such as “The Lord God”, the “Temporal Temple”, the “Reincarnation Hall”, and the “Unlimited Wonderland”?!”
“You’re still too weak. Besides, knowing too much is a bad thing sometimes.” Jun Sandian said, “I’ll tell you when you reach Level 15 in cultivation level.”
“Alright, then. If I come across these people, will they kill me?” Jiang Ming asked his second question. Honestly, this was the question he truly wanted to know the answer to.
Jun Sanqian squinted his eyes and chuckled. “Don’t worry. They have a certain set of rules to follow for descending into the world. First, they need to be fair. Second, they can’t force other people to do something they don’t want to do. Third, they can’t bully others just because they’re stronger, and fourth, they need to focus on competition. Their core principle is that talent comes first. Do you understand
now?”
“Yes. Thank you very much, senior!”
“There are also some guys who would go to a certain world in search of new disciples. However, there is this group of people who don’t follow the rules and toy with people for fun. These are the bad guys.” “What should I do if I run into them?” “What should you do if you run into them? Do you even need to ask? Just get rid of them, of course,” Jun Sanqian said as he waved his arms. “Alright, let’s see if you can kill an immortal. At this point, my strength level is comparable to an ordinary expert who has just stepped into the Immortal Dao Realm.” “Senior, here I come!”
Jiang Ming bowed at Jun Sanqian before activating his Paradis Projection.
The majestic world descended, bringing forth an endless suppressing force.
The area under the projection was a forbidden area.
Pfft…
Jun Sanqian destroyed the forbidden area with a swing of his sword.
“How…” Jiang Ming was shocked, “How is this possible? My projection is capable of crushing an Imminent Immortal expert with ease. You just destroyed it with a single swing?”
‘This is unbelievable!’
“Seems like you still don’t get it,” Jun Sanqian said. “Level 10 and Level 11 are fundamentally different. In your world’s cultivation system, the difference is like between a mortal and an immortal. The difference between immortal and mortal is like an abyssal chasm. It’s an elevation of the level of life. One is mortal, while the other is immortal. Like me, I can easily kill thousands of Imminent Immortal experts with ease.” “Seriously?”
“Yeah. You’ve comprehended many laws, but those are laws that belong to the mortal. It’s nothing in front of an immortal. Even the power of time you wield is the same. You can try if you don’t believe me.
“Sure! The Solitary Desert!” Jiang Ming shouted as he conjured a sword with his hand and swung it in a mighty downward swipe. The power of time was clad around the sword as it charged toward Jun Sanqian. However, Jun Sanqian was unperturbed. He turned into a streak of light and crushed the power of time.
“Even the laws have different levels,” Jun Sanqian said. “Do you get it now?”
“I guess so!”
“Haha! That’s right. The power of the Immortal Dao is transcendental. There’s no way you can defeat me with the laws from the mortal world.”
“Is there nothing that can be done?”
“Of course, there is. But you’ll have to figure that out yourself.”
“Hold on a second! My willpower is equivalent to that of a Level 12 immortal when I was climbing the Heavenly Ladder. Does this mean that I have the power to fight against you?”
lea
“Nope!”
“Why?”
“Why don’t you test it out yourself?” Jun Sanqian said as a ray of light appeared from his forehead and turned into a formless sword. It flickered and entered Jiang Ming’s forehead.
The barrier in his inner world shook at that moment, but that attack did not stop there. It pierced through its soul and entered its sea of consciousness, setting off endless waves and nearly decimating his mind in one fell swoop.
“What!?” Jiang Ming exclaimed, “You’re only at the initial stage of Level 11, but my willpower is at the peak of Level 12.”
Jun Sanqian did not say anything.
He raised his hand, and a mountain appeared on top of him. He grasped, and the mountain began to turn smaller and smaller until it became a needle.
“Do you understand now?”
“My willpower is scattered like cotton, while yours is concentrated like a needle. In other words, you can destroy me easily even though we have the same willpower?”
“You’re really smart, do you know that?” Jun Sanqian nodded. “You passively strengthen your willpower by perfecting the laws. It’s indeed powerful, but it’s hollow. In other words, you don’t know how to use it, and you lack training. If you can fully utilize your willpower, even I won’t be a match for you. Besides, your inner world is complete. There is room for your willpower to improve again. When coupled with the protection of the inner world, it will be really difficult to attack your mind.”
“Thank you!” Jiang Ming bowed at him again.
“Don’t mention it. That being said, it isn’t impossible to defeat an Immortal. Come!”
“Okay!” Jiang Ming replied and activated the Three-fold Astral Transformation.
“The Great Akasa Technique!”
His figure vanished, and a thousand copies of them appeared in the next seconds, attacking Jun Sanqian at once.
Sky Dawn, Ground Shattering Strike, Heaven and Earth Attack, Star Burst Strike, Shockwave Blow, Exterminate Punch, and Inch Strength Thousand Punch.
He used all of the moves in the Unlimited Killing Punch at him. Coupled up with the Great Akasa Technique, he pushed Jun Sanqian back and successfully destroyed one of his arms.
“Fundamentally speaking, you’re stronger than I am. But when it comes to strength, I’m stronger!” Jiang Ming said. So what if he was an immortal?
It did not mean that he couldn’t be defeated. He could still best him in a fight. It was just that the process was a little bit harder.
“Exactly!” Jun Sanqian laughed. “Thank you for your teaching, senior. I’ll end this fight with this move! The Solitary Desert! The Descending Sun!” Jiang Ming shouted. He used two moves from the Great Millennium Technique.
He had obtained the second form not long ago. In the midst of the flurries of sword energies, a big sun descended into the river that stretched far and wide into the distance.
However, it did not cause any ripples. The surface of the river was calm as if time had stopped at this moment.
Jun Sanqian froze for a moment. Although he was able to break himself free from the restraints, it was too late.
Pfft!
Jiang Ming’s sword had arrived and pierced through his forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - Don’t Move, Senior Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Don’t Move, Senior Brother
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
He had cleared the 7th stage. On the 8th stage, it took him quite a long while to defeat Jun Sangian.
On the 9th stage, although Jiang Ming had used various special abilities, such as the Great Millennium Technique and other time-space abilities, it still took him a great effort to defeat his opponent.
On the 10th stage, he was defeated rapidly.
However, Jiang Ming refused to give up just like that. After recovering, he put every ounce of effort into cultivation and perfecting his special abilities. Then, he started challenging the Heavenly Battle Stage again. He was going to make use of this opportunity to train himself and gather more combat
experience.
Again, again, and again.
Day after day.
He became more and more experienced in combat, yet no matter how many times he tried, he still couldn’t defeat the Level 12 opponent on the 10th stage.
After he lost again, he stood at the square.
He felt he should take a short break.
He scanned around and did not know why but a surge of loneliness shot up from the bottom of his heart.
“The longer I stay here, the fuzzier my memories become.”
It was only then Jiang Ming understood why people always said that the stronger one became, the more detached they would be.
It was because as time went on, their memories would fade away along with the passing of their friends or families.
“That said, I’ve gained quite a lot of stuff,” Jiang Ming said as a grin appeared on his face.
He had gotten 990 points for clearing 18 levels of the Heavenly Ladder, 5,110 from the Heavenly Battle Stage, and 533 points from the Million Dao Chart.
The way to earn points from the Million Dao Chart had changed as well. He would only be able to get one point for comprehending one of the top special abilities from the mortal world, and Jiang Ming had comprehended 533 types.
Given his mastery over the law, the figure would increase by double if he stayed focused. It was just that there was no point for him to do that.
“Top up with the 126 points I have, now I have a total of 6,759 points.”
Jiang Ming took a deep breath. He had gotten so many points that he felt he was dreaming.
“In the past, it’s the Heavenly Ladder that gave more points, but it’s the Heavenly Battle Stage now?” Jiang Ming was confused.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 9
Point Accumulated: 6,759
Honor Gained (7th level): 18 levels of the Heavenly Ladder, 9 stages of the Heavenly Battle Stage, 533 types of special abilities
His information had changed as well.
Those honors he had gained in the past were gone, and it only showed the honor he obtained on the current level.
“Neither Dongfang Chenxi nor Ye Qingxian came. Is it because of the different time flow?”
Jiang Ming thought for a while. He could contact them through the Supreme Chat Group, but he did not do so. He returned to reality.
On Chuyang Peak, the sky was dark.
Many years had passed in the Supreme Pagoda, but it had only been one hour here.
He was at the Paradis Realm before entering the Supreme Pagoda, but he was at the Extreme Path Realm right now.
Not only had his cultivation level improved, but he had become a lot stronger in combat.
Jiang Ming vanished from the room and appeared on the rooftop. He stood by the railing and looked into the distance.
As the inner world continued to absorb more energy from the World Heart and was slowly transforming into a real world, he noticed that he had gained the ability to see through the countless chain of laws that pierced through the Akasa and merged into every living being.
Many chains of law penetrated even him himself.
“Everything in this world is governed by the law,” Jiang Ming said.
At that moment, he gained a better understanding of the fundamentals of the world.
It was not totally unfounded, but rather it was a truth based on fact. Once one had the ability to manipulate the power of law, they could suppress everything in the world with just a snap of their fingers.
Even a Paradis expert stood no chance against an Extreme Path expert.
Of course, everything had its exceptions.
“Everyone is an open book for me now.”
Other people only cultivated one law, but he cultivated all.
Not only that, but he also cultivated the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra. He had the Daoist Body, and he could connect with all Dharmas. Even his eyes were the Dharma Eyes. He could see through the Akasa and the nature of the world.
“Tm so awesome!” Jiang Ming said to himself.
He then raised his hand and stretched out one finger. He thrust it forward and pierced into the space without any difficulty. After that, he slashed downward, and the space in front of him cracked open.
He flicked his finger, and a chain of order filled with the spatial runes, the Spatial Dao, and the spatial power appeared.
He flicked his finger again, and a peak 30,000 miles away exploded before being engulfed by a dark hole that appeared out of nowhere.
This was the law that could control space.
Even Ye Ming from the Tianyuan School couldn’t do something like this. He was just drawing power from the law, but Jiang Ming was completely different. He had full control over it.
‘There were several reasons why he could do so. His physical body was too strong, and he had an immense amount of mana. His inner world had the spatial law, so it gave him better control over the spatial law in the outside world.
Jiang Ming raised his head and looked into the night.
He did not have to worry about his cultivation level. He just needed to complete his inner world, but it would take a lot of time. Once his inner world is completed and turned into reality, he would become even stronger at that time.
As for the Imminent Immortal Realm?
He did not really care about it.
After all, he just needed to cultivate one type of law to perfection, and he could step into the Imminent Immortal Realm.
“Senior Brother!”
Avoice came, and Five Elemental Linglong appeared in front of him in the next second. She landed beside him and wrapped her arms around his. “Aren’t you going to sleep? Why are you up again?”
“Ican’t sleep,” Jiang Ming said as he secured his Junior Sister tightly in his arms. He stuck his nose into her hair and reveled in the fragrance.
“What’s wrong, Senior Brother?” Five Elemental Linglong asked.
“Nothing. It’s just that I missed you a lot.”
“What are you talking about, Senior Brother? We just saw each other like an hour ago.”
“an hour is long enough.”
“You’re so funny, Senior Brother. How about I don’t leave from now on? I’ll stay by your side every day, every moment.”
“Are you not going to cultivate anymore?”
“We can cultivate together. What do you think, Senior Brother?” she asked, hugging Jiang Ming even tighter.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Stop moving.”
“It’s you who are moving, Senior Brother.”
“Ts it?”
Jiang Ming was stunned when he heard the answer from his Junior Sister, and his face turned red.
“Stop shaking me.”
“Senior Brother, I feel itchy all over,” she replied as she kept wriggling her body.
Jiang Ming did not know what to say.
The two snuggled up on a couch and gazed at the star-filled sky.
“Do you have any dreams?”
“Of course, I do!”
“Can you tell me about it?”
“I want to conquer the whole world!”
“Why?”
“Lwant to create a world where you can live peacefully and happily!”
“Seems like my years of taking care of you have finally paid off!”
The next day, just as Jiang Ming served breakfast, Xi Yao appeared.
She was wearing a white dress, and it made her look like a goddess.
“Can you make one for me too, Brother Jiang?” Xi Yao asked, causing Linglong to roll her eyes at her.
“Alright. I’ll go make one for you,” Jiang Ming replied with a smile and went back down into the kitchen.
“Yippie!” Xi Yao exclaimed, “By the way, Brother Jiang, why don’t you set up a simple kitchen on the roof?”
“Oh yeah! Why didn’t I think of that?” Jiang Ming smacked his head.
“That’s because you’ve gotten used to cooking in the kitchen below!” Linglong chimed in.
After a short while, all of the dishes were served.
Pickled cucumber, onion with tofu, fried egg, and pancakes.
“They all seem ordinary on the surface, but in reality, they are either made from the flesh of great demons or spiritual items. Take this cucumber as an example. It’s a low-grade spiritual medicine! Brother Jiang, this is too extravagant,” Xi Yao said.
“You should get used to it,” Jiang Ming said, “Are you done with your cultivation?”
“yes! The Nascent Soul Realm is much stronger than the Dao Seed Realm!” Xi Yao’s eyes were glowing, “However, this realm doesn’t need plenty of cultivation. I plan to reach the peak in one setting so that I can break through the Primal Spirit Realm. After that, I’l refine my Primal Spirit and get myself
ready for the Paradis Realm!”
“That sounds like a good plan to me.”
“Brother Jiang, I have a favor to ask.”
“Shoot.”
“Can I stay here and cultivate?” Xi Yao asked.
“I thought you already have a house here?” Jiang Ming said as he pointed at the stone building at the back of the mountain.
“Thank you so much, Brother Jiang!” Xi Yao’s eyes lit up. Then, she hugged Linglong. “Thank you too, Linglong.”
Linglong gave her a warning look, and Xi Yao responded with an assuring gaze.
The wind was warm, and the sun was hanging high in the sky.
100,000 miles away.
The five people who descended from the Reincarnation Hall met again..

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - Reincarnation Hall’s Return, Making Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Reincarnation Hall’s Return, Making Love
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The five remained silent when they got back together.
They could easily get the information they needed with their abilities and means. But that was what surprised them.
The Great Easter Region War that had just happened about two years ago had caused millions of deaths. At that time, Primal Spirit experts would be seen much petty and lower than dogs, Paradis experts had been everywhere, Extreme Path experts would be killed if careless, and many Imminent Immortal
experts had died. Even true immortal soldiers had appeared.
However, at the end of the war, the winning parties had all been slaughtered overnight.
“What’s this world? It’s too insane, isn’t it?” Xiao Yu asked in a trembling voice. She had unique hair. Her ponytail was tied up with a snake’s head at the end, and it kept flicking its tongue, appearing very bizarre.
“It’s beyond insane. We’d be having trouble if we descended into this world during the war. Fortunately, we’re here only after the war. Since Eastern Region is getting weaker, we can do whatever we want and gain numerous benefits here. We can even spend our points to stay here after accomplishing our
mission. We’d be rich if we could get a few great items.”
“Don’t think about future stuff. Let’s just make a summary of all the information we’ve got and see how the Jiuyang Sect is.” Shan Hu, who had a pair of horns on his head, spoke.
The others nodded in agreement.
The information they got was: The Jiuyang Sect was exempted from the Great Eastern Region War. The Jiuyang Sect also resisted the Fo Sect from spreading Buddhism in Qing Province. But the Fo Sect managed to find out that the First Seat of the Jiuyang Sect was a devil. Hence, the Fo Sect united with
other forces in Qing Province to protest against the Jiuyang Sect in an effort of trying to annihilate the sect, but they were all wiped out in a night. Even the Great Monarchs of some minor forces in Qing Province were killed. Many doubted that the Jiuyang Sect was behind this series of actions.
“There’s a key question here. The Fo Sect is a peerless sacred land from the information we got. Although on the wane, the team coming to Eastern Region consisted of a Level 8 expert, aka a Paradis expert. Yet, he was killed without anyone knowing. Looking back at the Jiuyang Sect, its Sect Master is
merely a Primal Spirit expert. Isn’t it contradicting? From the mission description that we saw, I think the only possibility is that a terrifying top-notch expert is hiding within Jiuyang Sect.” Xiao Yu frowned tightly.
“These are what we’ve got now. But we’ve just accomplished 30% of our mission. Therefore, it’s obvious that the Jiuyang Sect has a hidden secret. Xiao Xuan, you make a plan!” Shan Hu looked at a pale-faced young man at a side.
The young man was wearing glasses, looking reticent.
“Sure,” Xiao Xuan replied in a serious mamner. He pushed his glasses and started voicing out his plan. “The Jiuyang Sect survived the great war without any losses. When besieged, all enemies’ leaders were killed. These show that the Jiuyang Sect doesn’t look weak as it appears. Since our mission is to find
out the exact details of the Jiuyang Sect and not become their enemy, we can make a comprehensive preparation.
