“First, since Xiao Long is good at disguising, you can infiltrate the Jiuyang Sect to pry for news. Remember to play safe and go slowly. We have a month after all.
“Second, Xiao Yu, use your soul manipulating technique that you’re good at to manipulate leaders of some forces in Qing Province so that they will demonstrate against the Jiuyang Sect again. It must be loud, public, and upright, with morality and benevolence as propellers. If the Jiuyang Sect has scruples
about it, then just launch an attack. If they act recklessly, they’ll be disgraced. Either result is beneficial to us. We can find out some additional details about the Jiuyang Sect and create an opportunity for Xiao Long at the same time.
“Third, the Fo Sect has sent out a total of seven teams to Eastern Region in their mission to spread Buddhism, hasn’t it? How do you think the other teams will react when they learn that one of their teams has been wiped out? Xiao Hai, your task is to spread out the propaganda that the Jiuyang Sect hates
Fo Sect and has wiped out the entire team stationed in Qing Province to all those Fo disciples as soon as possible. Xiao Yu, you also need to do the same through those leaders you’ve manipulated.
“Fourth, the Yinmo Sect is the world’s enemy, yet one of the Jiuyang Sect’s First Seats is actually the Yinmo Sect’s member. Regardless of its reason, it’s given Jiuyang Sect a tag that is ‘living with a devil’. Therefore, I’ll go to other provinces to spread the news to victims and survivors. Meanwhile, I’l try to
get them together in protesting against the Jiuyang Sect.
“In short, we need to put the Jiuyang Sect into the position that it’s the world’s enemy. And we shall do it within two weeks. Boss, do you have anything else to add?” Xiao Xuan pushed his glasses again.
“It’s already very perfect! But what about me?” Shan Hu said.
“Boss, I feel rather insecure regarding this mission. Therefore, you shouldn’t expose yourself just in case. You shall just hide yourself and forcibly launch a return if all four of us die,” replied Xiao Xuan.
Shan Hu frowned but still nodded.
The five continued their discussion in detail before they parted.
On Chuyang Peak
Jiang Ming naturally did not know anything about the five of them.
He spent most of his time laying on the rattan chair while dividing part of his consciousness into his internal world, comprehending Laws Operating Dao, the wonders induced by fortune, and the wonderful transformation from an illusion world to a real world.
This was comparable to the enlightenment state.
Ina blink of an eye, 10 days had passed.
Five Elemental Linglong had secluded herself as Spatial Linglong came out. Although they were two clones, they shared the same heart. Hence, they were not much different.
“Senior Brother, I’ve improved my cultivation base. Haven’t you said you’ll help me in comprehending Spatial Law?” Linglong landed beside Jiang Ming and squeezed in.
After lying comfortably, she grabbed Jiang Ming’s hair strands and wrapped them around and around her fingers.
Feeling a jerk in his heart, Jiang Ming said, “In such a hurry?”
“That’s for sure. It’s a great opportunity, after all!” As Linglong spoke, she turned over on Jiang Ming’s chest. “I was afraid that the opportunity would be taken away if I were late. Moreover, I as a clone, need to be left with an imprint from Senior Brother so that you’ll be my strongest obsession. Even if
there’s any potential that I form a distinct personality, I can still be bonded to you and not cause any mishap.”
“Leave an imprint?” Jiang Ming felt rather speechless.
“Yes!” Linglong buried her head in Jing Ming’s embrace and mumbled, “I’ve got a secret technique, but only if we do the deepest level of bonding.”
“Ahem, is it really good to do so?”
“Senior Brother, don’t you realize that you’ve started losing control of yourself?”
“Let’s go then!” Hugging Linglong, they vanished into thin air. In the next moment, they appeared in a room, on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed.
Jiang Ming finally took out this large bed because its special functionality would be activated only if more than one person were sleeping on it.
“Senior Brother, what’s this bed? It looks very special. Could it be that you prepared it on purpose?”
“Do you like it?”
“Senior Brother, you can’t wait for it indeed.”
“Aren’t you the one coveting my body?”
“Hng, T’ll leave then.”
“Wanna leave? It’s too late. Tonight I’m going to go wil
Their clothes were shed one after another.
Occasionally whining and moaning sounds could be heard
Ina blink of an eye, three days had passed.
Jiang Ming was only seen again on the rooftop.
At the back of the mountain, Xi Yao was gazing into the distance at the side of the abyss, obviously feeling very lonely.
She had wanted to go into the manor in these three days, but it was sealed.
Jiang Ming saw her but shifted his focus away immediately. He then lay on the rattan chair and massaged his waist.
“The only benefit of being a cultivator is that I’ve got a good physique, stamina, and sensitivity.’ Jiang Ming could not help but laugh.
“Senior Brother!” Five Elemental Linglong walked over, brewed him a cup of tea, and teased, “Shall I boil you a pot of soup as your compensation?”
“No, I can still endure!” Jiang Ming refused in defense of his dignity.
“Really?” Five Elemental Linglong gleamed brightly and added, “Let’s return to the room then!”
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat. He said, “Didn’t we just come out?”
“You just came out with her, not me. We share the same heart, not the same body,” Five Elemental Linglong explained smilingly.
She threw her hands around Jiang Ming’s neck from behind and whispered delicately in his ears, “You’re still a bridegroom tonight.”
Jiang Ming’s body stiffened, and his heart was beating fast.
“Senior Brother, what do you think if I cultivate 365 different clones? Every day will be different for you.” Five Elemental Linglong suggested in a lower voice.
Jiang Ming’s eyes gleamed brightly.
“All men are indeed bad!” Five Elemental Linglong muttered and sat aside.
Jiang Ming felt rather helpless at Linglong’s sudden changes. But at the same time, he wondered if 365 clones were slightly insufficient?
At that moment, he saw Chang Yiming coming over. He immediately removed the seal of the manor so that Chang Yiming could come to the rooftop.
Jiang Ming asked, “Senior Brother Chang, seeing you frowning, could it be that something great has happened?”
“Yes, a very great matter!” Chang Yiming nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - Isn’t it Better to Live?
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Isn’t it Better to Live?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The news that Chang Yiming brought was simple. All forces of various scales in Qing Province had come together to the Jiuyang Sect. Even the weakest were of Purple Mansion Realm.
They came under the guise of enforcing justice, demanding the Jiuyang Sect to give people an explanation on why they were protecting the Yinmo Sects remnants.
They were very loud, and the movement had spread through half of Eastern Region. Some forces and experts not from within Qing Province had joined in the crusade too.
Chang Yiming said worryingly, “This is an ordeal to our Jiuyang Sect. In fact, we can’t deny it because we do have a First Seat who’s a member of the Yinmo Sect. Who in the entire Eastern Region doesn’t hate the Yinmo Sect? Hence, we can’t even make any explanation. Moreover, someone is aggravating
the entire situation, trying to put us on the stage, antagonizing the whole world, and even trying to annihilate us. I even doubt that the Qingyun Sect is part of them. First Seat Jiang, Do you have any solution to pull off this ordeal?
“Do you let my Senior Brother handle everything? This is the Sect Master and every other First Seat’s responsibility.” Zi Linglong said indifferently.
“Let’s just see how it goes.” Jiang Ming laughed.
Chang Yiming smiled bitterly, for he could not do much. He could just do what Jiang Ming had said. He hesitated a while and bade farewell before returning to Laoyang Peak.
“Senior Brother, from what Chang Yiming has said, something’s obviously wrong. Someone seems to be manipulating the entire thing. This is forcing our Jiuyang Sect toward its verge. Shall I go check it out?” Linglong said as she pondered.
“No!” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Regardless of whose plot it is, they’ll reveal on their own soon. Moreover, I’ve killed almost all experts with levels higher than the Primal Spirit in Qing Province. Those united forces are no longer a threat. Don’t forget that I’ve given the Life and Death Disillusionment
Formation Disk to the Sect Master, and First Seat Hao Chen has stepped into the Primal Spirit Realm. Hence, we are supposedly able to overcome it. If he can’t even handle it well, he shouldn’t be the Sect Master.”
“You’re so cool, Senior Brother! What if a Paradis expert comes?”
“Of course, we’ll just kill them!”
Abook appeared out of nowhere in Jiang Ming’s hand. He laid on the rattan chair and started reading quietly.
He was indifferent toward the restlessness outside.
Xi Yao came pacing through the air. As soon as she reached, she asked , looking odd, “This manor was sealed three days ago. Were both of you cultivating the Unity of Heaven and Man Dao?”
“Do you know what the Unity of Heaven and Man is? Xi Yao, you still seem to be a virgin.” Linglong playfully scanned through her.
Xi Yao’s face turned slightly red, and she hugged Linglong, “You little kid, you sneer at me.”
“You are big indeed!”
Xi Yao’s body stiffened, and she could not help but grind her teeth. “Linglong, you’ve changed. Could it be that you’re seized by that pervert?”
“Hehe, there’s a great pervert over there!” Linglong said as she pointed at Jiang Ming.
Xi Yao blushed even more.
Jiang Ming slightly frowned upon sensing that something had gone wrong. He felt that the Five Elemental Linglong’s character had deviated from the main body. He was wondering if their thoughts were not synchronized, and the Five Elemental Linglong started to have hints of distinctive character.
After Xi Yao and the Five Elemental Linglong frolicked for a while, Xi Yao sat down and said while seriously looking at Jiang Ming, “I’ve received some news that might be useful for you all.”
“Go on.” Jiang Ming scanned through Xi Yao, particularly at her chest. That glimpse made his heart skip a beat, and he immediately shifted his focus back to staring at his book.
“I’s regarding the matter whereby the Jiuyang Sect is being targeted. Someone is instigating the whole thing, but they’re difficult to pinpoint. The news about the Jiuyang Sect harboring a member of the Yinmo Sect hiding is spreading out very fast too. Almost all experts whose families were almost
destroyed and whose sects were wiped out know about it. And the other few teams of the Fo Sect learned about it almost simultaneously.” Xi Yao said. She was more informed than Chang Yiming.
“The Riyue Sect’s ability to collect information is indeed very good,” Jiang Ming said.
“I’s a Sacred Land, after all.” Xi Yao poured herself a cup of tea before she continued. “Now, with Eastern Region greatly affected, many forces in Zhong Province want to take this opportunity to reap some benefits. In fact, many forces from the Zhong Province are somewhat involved, and of course, the
Qingyun Sect has also secretly stepped in. Therefore, it naturally further worsened the situation.”
Jiang Ming nodded as he had expected.
Xi Yao was bizarre seeing Jiang Ming could remain calm. She added, “The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty is back, openly, leading a team. I speculate that he’s got two objectives. First, it’s to develop his influence, and second, it’s to aim at the Jiuyang Sect. After all, he lost his face the last time he
came.”
“The 18th Prince?” Jiang Ming closed his book and continued. “Isn’t it better to live? Why is he fretting over trifles?”
Xi Yao felt a chill run down her spine, and she reminded Jiang Ming, “That’s the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty. Once he is killed, you’ll be bound to be crushed by the imperial dynasty.”
Jiang Ming smiled and paid no more attention.
In Taiyang’s great hall.
“Gentlemen, we’re now facing enemies’ attack. They said we’re hiding the Yinmo Sect’s remnants and that we’re the seed that the Yinmo Sect has left. All forces of various scales in Qing Province are here. More experts from other provinces are joining them to crusade against us too. What do you think we
can do to solve it?” Sect Master Yan Yan threw everyone present the critical question.
“Something is very wrong. We’ve already been leading Qing Province and have many clans and forces depending on us. The last time when we were being targeted, many of them were still with us, but why are they now against us? The weirdest thing is that none of them ever notified us secretly. Even if
they are threatened to go against us, they should at least notify us to leave a way out for themselves, right? Therefore, something’s obviously wrong. It’s as though they are facing some irresistible force or they are being manipulated,” Chuyang Peak’s First Seat Zhang Ren said.
“Whether this is a plot, they are facing some irresistible force, or they are being manipulated, whatever it is, it’s not important. The most important thing is that we can utilize such a chance to clean up alll the trash in Qing Province. So from now onward, we’ll be the only dominant force in Qing Province,”
Lieyang Peak’s First Seat Dongfang Lie said aggressively.
“But have you ever thought that our enemies are not made out of forces within Qing Province only? There are also experts from the six teams of the Fo Sect, other provinces, and even the Qingyun Sect. How can we defend ourselves? If we aren’t careful enough, welll face the danger of our sect being
destroyed,” Zhang Ren rebutted.
Laoyang Peak’s First Seat Chang Ming also voiced his thoughts as he was clutching his gourd. “What if a few Primal Spirit experts are launching their attacks simultaneously? What if experts stronger than Primal Spirit Realms secretly attack us?”
This was truly a serious matter.
They were not afraid if the attackers were from within Qing Province. But who could stay carefree when they now had to confront the entire Eastern Region?
Both First Seat Yin Yue and First Seat Gu Hai remained sitting quietly.
They had returned a long time ago and lived in a city built within the sect’s estate. They had come over because of the Sect Master’s summon.
The Sect Master took a glimpse at Gu Hai before he spoke. “I will kill any Primal Spirit expert who steps into our sect, and I can also trap and kill the Paradis experts. Thus, don’t worry!”
The few First Seats startled listening to the Sect Master’s words.
“Sect Master, why do you say so?” Zhang Ren asked.
“Senior Brother Zhang, this is a secret,” Sect Master replied with a smile.
“In this case, I’m relieved. Since we’re able to resist Paradis experts, what else are we afraid of? Let’s spread the word about Yue Cheng as a spy, and it’s up to them to believe it or not. Then, we shall also declare that whoever steps 100 miles into our estate is declaring war against us, and we will take action
to defend ourselves. We can take this opportunity to clean up Qing Province and expand while the entire Eastern Region is still weak.” Zhang Ren said with his eyes gleaming.
“Lagree!” Dongfang Lie nodded. He then frowned as he asked, “Sect Master, are you sure you can kill Paradis experts? This is because both the Fo Sect and Qingyun Sect do have Paradis experts.”
The Sect Master only nodded in reply.
“Then we shall first treat them politely by telling them that we’ve just learned about Yue Cheng’s background. If they don’t believe it and trespass our estate, hehe, they’ll have given us a good reason for bloodshed. No, it’s not bloodshed but cleaning the unclean in Qing Province.” Dongfang Lie smirked.
Everyone present nodded in agreement.
Then they paced away because the meeting was dissolved. Only Gu Hai alone was asked to stay back.
“”Tve refined the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk and merged it into the sect’s great formation. I think with its terrifying might, it could trap a Paradis expert.” The Sect Master no longer was as confident as he was earlier. Instead, he asked worryingly, “But what if there are a few Paradis
experts or Extreme Path experts? Please let me know if they could block them?” He pointed at Chuyang Peak as he said his last sentence.
When he had gotten the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk and learned that all men, including Hui Xin, who were besieging the sect, were all killed, he only understood that Zi Linglong had a mighty expert of at least Extreme Path Realm protecting her.
Otherwise, how could that mighty expert kill a Fo Paradis expert?
“provided Qingyun’s men don’t come over, you don’t have to worry,” Gu Hai replied after a slight hesitation.
“Old Gu, why don’t you go to confirm again? This is related to our sect’s survival, after all.”
“alright.”
The Sect Master sighed as he saw Gu Hai off.
“Damn it! I really don’t understand this world anymore. First, it was Eastern Region’s disaster, then the Yinmo Sect, etc., were all wiped out in one night. Following that, it was the Jiuyang Sect’s turn, but it was solved over a night. I thought that’s it, but here comes another big group of crusaders. F*cking
bastards!” The Sect Master scratched his head in annoyance..

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - Soul’s Breakdown
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Soul’s Breakdown
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On Chuyang Peak
“Little Ming, I’m still worried. Tell me, what can we do if the Qingyun Sect is joining forces to attack us? Can we block them? We need to prepare for the worst. Please don’t fool around. This is, after all, a matter related to our sect’s survival.” Gu Hai directly questioned Jiang Ming as soon as he got back.
“Master, don’t worry. If the Qingyun Sect dares to attack, I’ll let the Jiuyang Sect be the only Sacred Land in Eastern Region.” Jiang Ming promised in a serious manner.
“Don’t bluff. Tell me the worst scenario!” Gu Hai was not pleased with the answer. He was very concerned about the sect because the sect was, after all, his home.
“You wouldn’t believe me even if I told you. I’m the one who wiped out the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union,” Jiang Ming said.
“Sh*t, you’re getting out of line! Can you not boast? If you’re to talk nonsense again, I’ll make sure you get punished!” Gu Hai was furious.
“Come with me. Let me show you!” Jiang Ming felt rather helpless. Thus, he rose to his feet and flew toward the mountain’s back.
Gu Hai was confused, but he followed after.
Meanwhile, he took a glance at the Combat Mannequin, which was still standing straight at the side of the abyss. That glance actually convinced him slightly, but he still felt it was too absurd.
When he came to the sealed spiritual field, he froze with his mouth wide open.
“Lit… Little… Ming, this, this is not an illusion, right?” Gu Hai stammered.
He saw supreme-grade spiritual medicine, and spiritual fruits were everywhere. Dazzling immortal lights were intervening, Dao fluctuations were congregating, the air was filled with mists formed by spiritual essence, and on earth, where rives water was flowing, was all spiritual liquid.
He even saw four little men flying around and a few tall tree demons.
Sh*t, what did he just see? A mountain of spirit crystals? No, he thought it should be some crystals beyond supreme grade. He tried sensing the bead embedded on the mountain, and the monstrous spiritual essence in it shook him to his core.
He also saw a spiritual fountain. ‘Wait… A spiritual fountain? What was it? But why did its aura make my soul tremble?”
Gu Hai was utterly amazed at what he saw.
At that moment, Jiang Ming started explaining, “Master, I’ve got a supreme immortal encounter. A supreme existence who calls himself the Immortal King of Pan Gu preached to me in my dreams and also bestowed countless benefits. The Life and Death Illusion Formation Disc and the Combat
Mannequin are all small things given to me. Just little things, Master, do you understand?”
“Tm even more confused!” Gu Hai replied with a confused look. He could not imagine that both the Combat Mannequin and the supreme-grade Formation Disk were merely little things. What’s more about the preaching in the dreams and Immortal King Pan Gu?
After a while, Gu Hai smiled slyly, “Little Ming, you aren’t being seized, are you?”
Jiang Ming knelt instantly. His Master alone was the only one on earth he was willing to do so. Let alone the grace of upbringing, he would have died if it was not because of his Master.
Gu Hai was startled for a moment before he collected himself. He began feeling excited as he helped Jiang Ming rise to his feet. Then he could not help but laugh out loud. “I never thought that I’d have such heaven-defying disciples. Linglong, who defeated all geniuses, and you who’s been hiding your
exact cultivation base to the point that I don’t even know. Tell me, what’s your current cultivation base now? And how strong are you?
“Tm afraid that I may scare you off if I tell you, Master.” Jiang Ming scratched his head.
“Don’t tell me then. I can’t really endure such a surprise! Well, now I know already.” Gu Hai immediately shook his head before he added solemnly, “You’ve been hiding well all this while. Keep hiding your real self, and do not reveal anything until it’s absolutely possible. Your boundless immortal encounter
can easily incur jealousy, and the fortune here too can easily induce conflicts. Therefore, I’ll zip my lips, not telling even your Senior Aunt Yin Yue and Sect Master. I’l just say that a peerless expert is protecting your Junior Sister.”
“Great!” Jiang Ming felt grateful for the promise of the old man.
Following that, Gu Hai left in relief while Jiang Ming returned to the balcony.
Jiang Ming saw Linglong and asked, “Why did you go away?”
“Master came back. And it’s clear what’s his main purpose. Therefore, I’m afraid that I’d get a headache with him asking this and that,” Linglong replied.
“And then leave me alone facing the headache? Girl, you’re not behaving well anymore,” Jiang Ming said.
“Senior Brother, who said I’m not behaving well? Didn’t I obey you doing whatever position you wanted?” rebutted Linglong.
“That’s Spatial Junior Sister.’
ang Ming felt rather embarrassed.
“She’s me too.” Five Elemental Linglong got herself closer and said, “Senior Brother, I want to feel and experience the wonder of the Unity of Heaven and Man too.”
Jiang Ming pursed his lips. Suddenly, he turned his head and saw a bee flying over. It was not flying at a very fast rate, but it was almost reaching the peak.
“What’s wrong, Senior Brother?” Five Elemental Linglong looked over, “It’s just a bee. Wait, if you’re paying attention to it, it must be a problematic bee.”
She gleamed with five elemental rays trickling and found the clue. “This is a bee being controlled. It seems like it can share its view with its controller, and it has probing functionality too. Who in the sect has such ability? Or is it a spy?” Thoughts raced through her mind in just a short while.
“Tl deal with it.” Jiang Ming had already targeted the controller through the karma line connected to the bee.
‘There was a peak 50 miles away. It was where many inner disciples lived. One of them was sitting cross-legged cultivating, but he was secretly controlling the spiritual bee.
“An inner disciple actually dares to probe Chuyang Peak?” Jiang Ming was very surprised.
He called up his Human Path Record.
Name: Long Qian
Race: Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 7 (Primal Spirit)
Background: The Chameleon Family of the Fighting Dragon Planar World (Remark: Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary, one of the Black Tiger Clan’s members)
Relationship: -55
Innate talent: Nine Stars
Status: A Heaven Reincarnation Hall beneficiary who accepted a C-grade mission together with his teammates. Hence, they descended into this world to survey the Jiuyang Sect’s exact details.
Reached an agreement with another four members to take surveying the Jiuyang Sect as their main task, but at the same time, they shall besiege the sect and try to annihilate it to earn a superb evaluation.
‘The other teammates are creating chaos outside.
Because he’s good at disguising, he captured an inner Jiuyang Sect disciple to replace him and entered the sect. Carefully, he explored and surveyed the sect. He has basically learned about the sect structure and that there’s a Great Monarch known as Huo Daoren.
‘When he learned about a peerless genius Zi Linglong in Chuyang Peak, he knew the peak must have something. However, he never gets to find a reason to go and dares not take the risk.
‘When he learned that the First Seats had gathered earlier today, he knew he must not wait any longer. Thus, he maneuvered a spiritual bee to have a peep at Chuyang Peak.
“It’s the Heaven Reincarnation hall again…” Jiang Ming frowned.
He let his Junior Sister stay and immediately vignetted and vanished into thin air.
‘The next moment, he appeared before Long Qian. But no one saw him, including Long Qian.
Jiang Ming took out the Human Path Records, which floated in midair, showering rays of lights that also enveloped Long Qian.
He pressed on Long Qin’s forehead with a finger, probing his memory.
His memory was simple. Long Qian came from Qing Province, and a Jiuyang disciple destroyed his clan. He was the only one left. He later had an encounter where his cultivation base suddenly improved greatly. Hence, he thought of taking revenge on the Jiuyang Sect.
“Why is it so short?” Jiang Ming was bewildered.
At this moment, Long Qian abruptly opened his eyes, and a streak of blades erupted from his body, sweeping and attacking indiscriminately in all directions.
However, they were all frozen when they were only half an inch away from Long Qian himself.
Long Qian was bewildered.
‘The bee he was controlling had entered Chuyang Peak. When he was trying to maneuver it into the manor, the system notification suddenly rang out in his mind.
“Ding: Beneficiary Long Qian, your soul is under attack.”
“Ding: Beneficiary Long Qian, your memory is under probing.”
“Ding: Beneficiary Long Qian, your background memory has been covered.”
“Ding: A reminder, whoever reveals the secret of Reincarnation Space will be killed.”
Upon hearing the notifications, Long Qian was terrified. He immediately activated a treasure without any hesitation, but he was still trapped.
Jiang Ming also showed himself, but neither he nor Long Qian could be seen from the outside because he had sealed off the surroundings.
“I feel your aura does not belong to our world here. Tell me, where are you from?” Jiang Ming asked without any expression. Meanwhile, he pointed his sharp, glittering fingertips at Long Qian as though he was to kill Long Qian at the next moment.
“Senior Brother, I’m… just an inner disciple of the sect. W-Why are you doing this to me?” Long Qian revealed a look of resignation.
“know how to read your mind and know the trustability of your words. I’ll give you three chances. If you aren’t speaking the truth, I’ll kill you and disintegrate your soul. You’ve now used one of your three chances.” Jiang Ming said indifferently.
“L…” Cold sweat started oozing out of Long Qian’s forehead. Meanwhile, thoughts ran across his mind, ‘How strong is this guy when he could appear before me and probe my memory without my knowing until the system reminded me?
“all my family members were killed by Dongfang Lie. Thus, I’m here to get revenge.” As Long Qian spoke, he showed great hatred, “My father, my mother, my older brother, and younger brother, all were killed by that devilish Dongfang Lie. Tell me, is it wrong for me to take my revenge?”
“This is the second time, you’ve got the last chance.” Jiang Ming’s voice rang out.
Long Qian’s body stiffened, and he smiled slyly, “I’m a demon, and I’m here to find out the details of the Jiuyang Sect. After all, your sect is quite secretive. And that Zi Linglong may be a demon too.”
“Interesting. Tell me, how many teammates do you have?” Jiang Ming laughed. Long Qian gave a smart answer, and it was correct too.
“Four!”
“What’re their names?”
“Wang Yu, Jiang Hai, Liu Hu, and Zhang Xuan!”
“Do you think you can fool me by giving a mixture of truth and false? Tell me the names of your other four teammates.” Jiang Ming snorted.
Jiang Ming tested the four names with the Human Path Records but with no results. Therefore, he knew Long Qian was lying.
Long Qian remained silent.
‘When Jiang Ming wanted to interrogate Long Qian further, he held back forcefully because he thought he probably should find out on his own by executing the Karma Law. But to his surprise, Long Qian’s karma was limited only to the sect. No line was linked to other teammates.
“They can shield each other from karma?’ Jiang Ming frowned.
Pat!
He slapped and scattered Long Qian’s skull and captured his soul. Meanwhile, the Human Path Records released a burst of light on the soul to start the probe again.
But Long Qian’s soul expressed its extreme fear because of the system notifications.
“Ding: Beneficiary is under the attack of a supreme artifact that’s about to break apart the Reincarnation’s lock.”
“Ding: Must not reveal any secret about the Reincarnation Hall based on the Reincarnation Contract.”
“Ding: Erase the will, erase the memory.”
Long Qian’s soul abruptly dispersed.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - The Origin Essence, The Gift of Reincarnation Hall
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: The Origin Essence, The Gift of Reincarnation Hall
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was speechless at Long Qian’s death. But he did not leave this time. Instead, he maximized his senses while letting the Human Path Records hang high above him, showering rays of lights.
This Human Path Records became mightier along with the improvement of his cultivation base. For instance, it could now isolate him from karma automatically once activated.
Jiang Ming was surprised that with the death of Long Qian, there were no prying eyes from the Reincarnation Hall like the last time; no fluctuations appeared at all. Anyway, he did not know if there really wasn’t or if they were getting more hidden.
Following that, Jiang Ming discovered something was wrong. Transparent gas flew out of Long Qian, intending to bore into the earth.
“This aura… Jiang Ming grabbed it. He felt that the gas wiggled like snakes and was as heavy as a mountain.
He was astonished because he finally recalled what it was. It was the purest origin essence. The origin essence was the origin of the world. It could be evolved into all things and nurtured all things.
‘Why did such a thing appear after Long Qian’s death?’ Jiang Ming was confused.
Meanwhile, his mind was racing with thoughts. He recalled the three beneficiaries he had killed. He had been too meticulous and retreated too quickly at that time. He had been afraid when he noticed the sudden scanning movement that appeared soon after their death. Hence, he had not checked what
happened after that.
But this time, he discovered the origin essence because it appeared too close to him.
‘Could it be that the Reincarnation beneficiaries have affected the world, so they’ll leavethe origin essence ascompensation once they die?’ Jiang Ming speculated as he recalled Jun Sanqian’s words.1
Regardless of the organization that had descended, they had to follow heaven and earth’s fair and sound principle. Perhaps it was an equal exchange.
A Reincarnation beneficiary was equivalent to an invader to a world. Hence, if they died, the winner (the world) naturally would have its compensation. And the compensation was the origin essence.
Jiang Ming thought his speculation was logical but still needed to be verified. Jiang Ming checked the essence thoroughly and found no imprints on it. But because he was still worried, he inserted it into Human Path Records.
‘The Human Path Records gave this description below:
Planar World’s Origin Essence: No attribute, the origin of all things and can be absorbed by all things. Spiritual items, artifacts, and living things can absorb it to raise their grade, quality, mana, and bloodline, respectively. The greatest effect is to promote the evolution of the world.
Jiang Ming was excited. He no longer hesitated to take it out and put it in his internal world.
The gas burst and turned into spiritual rain the next moment, which showered and merged into heaven and earth. At the same time, Jiang Ming could clearly feel that his internal world evolved faster, and the origin grew thicker.
Soon, the evolution stopped.
‘Absorbing this origin essence is equivalent to a year of evolution. This Is absolutely a great fortune.’ Jiang Ming was stunned upon thinking of it.
A Primal Spirit’s Reincarnation beneficiary could actually give such a surprising gift.
‘If all Reincarnation beneficiaries’ deaths would give such a gift… He has another four teammates… hehe.’ Jiang Ming was agitated.
He almost wanted to roar in excitement, ‘I’ve found a way!’
‘As he saw the corpse of Long Qian, he held the palms of both hands together, and the corpse was obviated. Following that, he returned to Chuyang Peak.
No one among the internal disciples realized the sudden disappearance of their mate.
Chuyang Peak.
“Senior Brother, what’s happening?” Linglong asked with concern.
“Just an external thief. Already solved.” Jiang Ming laughed as he sat on the rattan chair.
Linglong washed a plate of grapes and cut a few types of fruits before she took them over.
She picked up a slice of apple and delivered it to Jiang Ming’s mouth, which he took in with a bite.
In the pavilion, the tranquility remained.
Millions of miles away from Jiuyang Sect.
Shan Hu, who had a pair of horns growing on his head, was standing on a hill. His eyes glowed red with murderous intent, and the powerful fluctuations he unconsciously emitted stirred up and destroyed all the plants within a 1,000-metre radius. Even numerous rocks were cracked.
“Xiao Long was killed. A mere scouting mission actually cost me a brother’s life. Everyone in the Jiuyang Sect should die for his burial!” He was emitting a vicious aura as he sent a message to Xiao Yu.
1
3,000 miles away from the Jiuyang Sect.
There were 10,000 people gathered here. Among which, the lowest cultivation base was Foundation Establishment Realm. Some even radiated various lights, which intertwined together, forming a special scene.
Xiao Yu was among the crowd. At this moment, a trace of killing intent flashed across her face. She had just received Shan Hu’s message that Long Qian had died.
‘Almost half of the scheduled time has passed, and it’s time to attack! By the way, with Long Qian’s ability, how could he be exposed so easily? Moreover, the strongest Jiuyang expert is just on a par with him. Logically, none should be able to discover him. Even if he’s discovered, why couldn’t he escape?
Xiao Yu pondered and shook her head. She then looked into the temporary house not far away.
In the house were a few Dao Seed and Nascent Soul experts. All of them were now her slaves.
“Attack, forcibly attack the Jiuyang Sect!” She secretly gave an order.
Soon, the group had arrived 100 miles away from the Jiuyang Sect. But they were stopped by Dongfang Lie, Lieyang Peak’s First Seat, and Hao Chen, Shaoyang Peak’s First Seat.
Hao Chen was hugging his long sword in his chest, standing quietly. Meanwhile, Sword Sambodha surged from his head, stirring up an intimidating storm.
On the other hand, Dongfang Lie moved a step forward, emitting Nascent Soul suppressive might that stopped the group from pacing on. He scanned across them and said coldly, “Here is the area 100-meters into our Jiuyang Sect. Once you step in, it means you’re declaring war against us. By that time,
we’ll fight until death!”
A Nascent Soul middle-aged man walked to the front and called up, “First Seat Dongfang! The Yinmo Sect had initiated the war and caused countless deaths in our human race, hence our sworn enemy. Why would a righteous sect like the Jiuyang Sect have a Yinmo disciple as the First Seat? Do give us an
explanation!”
“ll repeat it again! Yue Cheng has become a Jiuyang disciple since young. No one knew his hidden identity until recently. Wang Wei, are you satisfied?” Dongfang Lie explained in a dominant manner.
“No! How can a recent discovery get you off the hook? We want to go into the Jiuyang Sect to find out the truth on our own!” Wang Wei roared.
Dongfang Lie could not help but laugh out loud. “How can we, a dignitary Jiuyang Sect, let you in just like that? Wang Wei, how dare you?”
“It’s the justice that gives me courage. It’s the incompatibility between righteous and evil that gives me courage. It’s the entire Qing Province’s innocent souls killed by the devil sect that gives me courage. It’s the hundreds and millions of people across Eastern Region who defy power that gives me courage.
The devil sects brought disasters to the world; hence our human race’s sworn enemies. Yet, the Jiuyang Sect is teaming up with the Yinmo Sect, hence a public enemy of Qing Province, Eastern Region, and the world.” Wang Wei denounced in a resounding voice, and his killing intent rumbled.
Dongfang Lie was so enraged at Wang Weis false accusation that he laughed. “We’re the sworn enemy to the whole world just because we don’t let you all enter the sect to investigate? Wang Wei, I think you all have decided to be our sworn enemies. Well, if you have the guts, just step 100 meters into the
Jiuyang Sect! Hao Chen, let’s go!”
As he spoke, he retreated 10,000 meters into the Jiuyang Sect. Hao Chen remained silent but also retreated to a hill far away. Following that, both of them indifferently looked at Wang Wei and the crowd.
Meanwhile, Sect Master Yan hid in midair. Various dazzling powers surged from him and were intertwined into a prison, hovering over the Jiuyang Sect.
He was staring coldly at Wang Wei as he had confirmed that Wang Wei was either being controlled or maneuvered by a terrific force.
Wang Wei was a member of the Wang clan, which was one of the most influential clans in Qing Province. Such a clan would not openly take a side until it was a matter of life and death, let alone take a strong stand. Otherwise, if they chose the wrong side, the entire clan would be devastated.
The Sect Master pondered, ‘I think I shall kill all of them to prevent bitter reprisals in the future. By the way, I wonder if this is the act of the Qingyun Sect. If so, they’ve miscalculated this time. We aren’t that weak to be bullied! Anyway, I do wish that this situation could draw out the force in the shadows
of Chuyang Peak. Otherwise, I’ll still be in the midst of worries.”
On the other side, Jiang Ming had come over too. He was hugging his Junior Sister.
“The Sect Master is indeed courageous to wipe out all of them. But I’m afraid that he is going to cause a stir,” said Linglong laughingly.
“Strength determines ambition! Who doesn’t get enraged when one is still being bullied after getting stronger? Moreover, it’s a good time to expand now when Eastern Region is still weak. Therefore, how can the Sect Master not seize this golden opportunity? Anyway, a battle will settle the matter and
return peace to Eastern Region.” Jiang Ming smiled.
“think he’ll get more afraid of me. But he will never be able to imagine that I’m actually a mere pawn in front of my Senior Brother, a horse,” Linglong said.
“Tm a horse that has a cannon behind it!”! Jiang Ming said.
“What do you mean?” Linglong was confused.
“Ah, just forget about it,” Jiang Ming replied.
Jiang Ming shifted his focus to Wang Wei. His eyes released karma power, and he saw many lines connecting to Wang Wei. One of the thickest lines was directed to a woman among the crowd.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - You’ll Only be a Concubine
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: You’ll Only be a Concubine
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Liu Yu
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Level 8 (Paradis)
Background: Liu Clan of Mystic Planar World (Remark: Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary, one of the Black Tiger Clan’s members)
Relationship: -88
Innate talent: Ten Stars (Mystical Soul Body)
Status: A Heaven Reincarnation Hall beneficiary who accepted a C-grade mission together with his teammates to find out the exact details of the Jiuyang Sect.
Secretly used the soul-manipulating special ability to enslave the great monarchs of various forces. This is to intimidate and probe the Jiuyang Sect and, if possible, annihilate the Jiuyang Sect.
She got furious when she learned about Long Qian’s death. Hence, she swore to take revenge by annihilating Jiuyang Sect.
‘Found another one! Jiang Ming felt delighted within himself.
He had never thought that he would find one on his first check.
The girl looked delicate and naive, but who would have thought that she was a Paradis expert?
The relationship value of -88 proved the fact that she intended to annihilate the entire Jiuyang Sect. Otherwise, she would not have such a great grudge against Jiang Ming, a Jiuyang disciple she had never known.
‘Since I’ve got you, your fate I’ve decided. Unfortunately, there aren’t any karma lines with the other three members,’ Jiang Ming thought.
‘The fact that the party of five was separated and that their karma lines with each other were cut showed how meticulous they were.
In front of him.
‘Wang Wei roared, “Gentlemen, for the sake of millions and millions of our dead counterparts in Eastern Region, let’s come with me to claim our justice. I don’t believe that there’s no more justice in this world.” Following that, he took the lead to step 100 meters into the Jiuyang Sect.
Other great monarchs who were being controlled went along.
More than half of the crowd had trespassed the sect in just a moment. However, a small part of them did not. Liu Yu was one of them.
‘It’s indeed very difficult to advise those who wish to die!” Dongfang Lie snapped. He then felt rather excited. ‘After this battle, my Jiuyang Sect will truly dominate Qing Province. Then, we can look into Eastern Region. In the near future, we’ll… He dared not to think any further.
He lifted his head, looking at where the Sect Master was.
At that moment, a dazzling white light abruptly appeared and shot toward the trespassers, shrouding them. Within the white light was an endless sword qi that formed a storm.
The Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk was activated.
Screaming and crying noises rang out, but no one outside the whitish-shrouded area could hear them.
Dead bodies were seen lying on the ground as the white light dispersed in just a few moments. Even Wang Wei was killed on the spot.
‘The Sect Master called up as he showed himself, “Dongfang Lie! Whoever trespasses our estate is seen as an invader. Do have them all killed!” He demanded while pointing at the other people who were 100 meters away from the limited area
“Sure!” Dongfang Lie responded excitedly and flew out. Following him was a group of JIuyang Elders.
The Sect Master fluttered his sleeve, releasing dazzling rays that removed all the dead bodies all at once.
Those people who had not gone forward with Wang Wei were frightened when they saw how Wang Wei and the group were killed in an instant.
“How dare they do that? How dare they!?”
“That’s the pinnacle of our Qing Province’s power, which was formed under the unison of numerous clans and forces. Yet, they were all killed by the Jiuyang Sect?”
“The Jiuyang Sect is too overbearing and cruel. Are they doing so just to take us all out?”
“No, they are to become an enemy of Qing Province and even the world. As they dare to raise their butcher’s knife, they’ll be conquered by the entire Eastern Region. No, they’re also a devil sect.”
“Hurry, let’s go and spread the news that all Jiuyang disciples have become devils and intend to slaughter everyone in Qing Province.”
“Hurry up! Otherwise, it’ll be too late for us to retreat. They are coming over!”
Everyone was shocked and retreated in fear.
Liu Yu, who was hiding in the dark, was shocked too. She thought and hesitated, ‘Why would a large sect like the Jiuyang Sect dare to conduct a massacre, risking their dignity and fame? Could it really be a devil sect? Shall I take this opportunity to kill a few?
She squinted her eyes while looking at Dongfang Lie flying over. She decided to kill one to vent her anger.
‘As she flew upward, ready to strike, she felt her heart miss a beat as a sword ray came slashing toward her.
‘can’t block this!” Liu Yu was terrified and activated a protective treasure. Then, a thought flashed across her mind, “There’s indeed an expert hiding in the Jiuyang Sect!”
The sword ray crashed her shield and amputated her left arm in the next moment.
She screamed and bored into the earth, disappearing from sight.
On the other side, the Sect Master turned in the direction of Chuyang Peak. He sensed that slash. It was extraordinarily strong to him, too strong and irresistible.
‘If that slash was targeting me…’ He felt chills down his spine.
At that moment, Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak. That slash was which he had demanded the Combat Mannequin to unleash.
“Senior Brother, why didn’t you kill her? She’s a super-strong expert, could it be that you like her? She is quite good-looking but far worse than Xi Yao.”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. “I did so to gain more benefits in the near future.”
“The benefit is to get more girls in the near future, right?” Linglong smirked.
“Nah!” Jiang Ming refused as he sat down. Then he looked at Five Elemental Linglong and said, “Girl, I think this clone of yours has a slight change in characters. Could it be that it has its independent character already?”
“A change in character?” Linglong was startled. She then could not help but frown. “The main body is still continuously condensing new clones. Hence, we have not synchronized our thoughts yet. But it shouldn’t be since it’s not long enough. As you talk about it, it seems that there’s a slightly different
character this clone of mine has.”
She sat in Jiang Ming’s embrace and pondered. “In Clone Dao, even if our thoughts aren’t in sync, it doesn’t affect much for a couple of years. Could it be that I’ve created too many clones that accelerate its change?”
Jiang Ming said gravely, “Stop cultivating further after you form the clone you’re currently working on. Continue it only after you’ve settled alll the issues.”
“Sure, Senior Brother!” Linglong turned over and flung her arms around his neck. She stared into Jiang Ming’s eyes as her tongue licked around her own lips before she mumbled, “Senior Brother, do you like me or my main body?”
Jiang Ming, who planned to bite on her lips, frowned as he heard the question.
“Hehe, Senior Brother, I’m just joking around. But this body’s character seems to be more enchanting,”
“If it truly has grown to have independent character, can the main body control it?”
“Yes. Our core origins are on the main body. Thus, the main body can control our life with just a thought. However, just in case we can no longer be controlled by the main body, we make sure we already have our first time with you as soon as possible so that your imprint is on us. This way, we’ll remain
faithful to you and forever be your Junior Sisters regardless.”
“Your little brain can actually come up with such a countermeasure idea.” Jiang Ming did not even know whether he should praise his Junior Sister or not.
Meanwhile, Xi Yao came pacing through the air. Her long flowing hair, fluttering sleeves, and elegant aura that came with her would draw people unconsciously closer to her.
As soon as Xi Yao landed before them, she said, “This massacre will put the Jiuyang Sect in a desperate situation. The six branches of the Fo Sect, other provinces’ experts, and even the Qingyun Sect may induce troubles at any time. The forces in Zhong Province too may take this opportunity to stir up the
situation. Brother Jiang, do you need any help?”
“How can you help?” Jiang Ming smiled.
“Since I’m the Riyue Sect’s Holy Daughter, I can represent the sect. The current information network the Riyue Sect has in Eastern Region is under my control. If I voice out, I can prove the innocence of the Jiuyang Sect by saying that Yue Cheng is just a piece of pawn hidden deeply in the Jiuyang Sect.”
“No, thanks,” Jiang Ming rejected Xi Yao’s offer.
“Why? Can’t you give me the opportunity to repay the benefits I’ve gained here?” Xi Yao was confused.
“The Jiuyang Sect must go through the battle to establish its authority,” Jiang Ming explained.
“Brother Jiang, isn’t it against your principle of staying low profile?” Xi Yao questioned.
“No worries, just see how it goes,” Jiang Ming replied.
Xi Yao stopped talking. She was getting more curious about Jiang Ming.
Meanwhile, Zi Linglong pulled her aside, sealed and isolated their surroundings and voices.
“What’s the matter, Linglong? What is it that you don’t want your Senior Brother to hear? This is indeed strange.”
“Xi Yao, I think you should leave.”
“Why?”
“If you continue staying here, you’ll fall into the love trap!”
“Do you mean that I’ll fall in love with your Senior Brother? No way, this is impossible!” Xi Yao said while pointing oddly at herself.
“Why is it impossible? You’ve roughly learned about him. Who on earth can be compared to him? Holy Sons? That so-called Senior Brother Tian Ci? All of them are pieces of trash. Given his strength, amazing innate talent, and young and good character, which girl wouldn’t have a crush on him?”
“Not me, at least!”
“Don’t you feel curious and want to seek more about him?”
“This one—”
“Don’t you feel like getting closer to my Senior Brother unconsciously?”
“I don’t think so!”
“Don’t you want to express the best you to my Senior Brother?”
“Do I?”
“Think carefully! Don’t blame me for not reminding you that you won’t get a positive response if you fall for him. Even if my Senior Brother accepts you, you’ll only be a concubine with my presence. Moreover, the love of Senior Brother is definitely on me, though he may share it with you a bit out of
compassion. Can you endure it as a Holy Daughter?
“If you dare to compete with me for favor, hmph, not to mention I’ll beat you up, my Senior Brother will be the first not to spare you. Therefore, it’ll certainly be a disaster once you fall in love with my Senior Brother. You shall leave before you fall into it as soon as possible,” Linglong said as she pouted.
“Linglong, you’re underestimating me!” Xi Yao lifted her head, revealing her fair and long neck as she confidently said, “My aim is to transcend the world, ascending to another. Having this type of love relationship will only affect my cultivating speed, and it doesn’t exist in my world. Moreover, a ‘man’ is
not a category in my dictionary.”
“It’s up to you then. Your thoughts don’t affect me, after all. Maybe we’ll just have an extra person to warm our feet.” Linglong sighed.
“You’re being too confident, aren’t you? What I know is that all men are innately lascivious. Be careful that you may fall from favor.”
“Fall from favor? You’ll never understand our relationship.” Linglong stretched out a bit as she continued. “The pretties out there, my Senior Brother would only scan through them to admire their prettiness.”
Xi Yao was rendered speechless by Linglong’s confident reply.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless too. He could hear it clearly even though that area was sealed off. After all, they were still within his Dao Square.
“Indeed, my Junior Sister!”
“Does she actually allow me to keep more concubines?
“It’s so kind of her~”
Jiang Ming felt touched, and his heart itched too.
“Xi Yao? It seemed that…’
Jiang Ming shook his head.
He then called up the Human Path Records to check on Liu Yu because this was the most important matter now..

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - The Tip of the Reincarnation Hall
chapters.content:
Chapter 150 The Tip of the Reincarnation Hall
In the Jiuyang Sect’s great hall…
Dongfang Lie said excitedly, “Sect Master, now is the right time to take advantage of the situation to eradicate the forces behind Wang Wei and others completely, as well as to take full control of Qing Province before they can get back on their feet!”
Zhang Ren, the First Seat of Chunyang Sect, shook his head. “No, I don’t think so. If we go after them right now, our reputation will be affected. Not only that, but we might bring about a rebellion and make ourselves look like the bad guys if we strike again.”
“Bad guys? Are you serious?” Dongfang Lie harrumphed. “In the mouths of the besieged clans, for them, yes, we’re the bad guys. But to the common folks, we represent order. Those who disrupt the order should pay with their lives. As for our reputation, that’s easy. We just need to dispatch our disciples and help the common folks with some things such as repairing the bridges, paving the roads, praying for rain, providing support during floods, or even punishing the landlords and the bullies. In less than two years, I believe we’ll be able to make a good image of ourselves amongst the people. It is too easy to improve our reputation. I don’t think that’s a problem at all.”
“You’re right, but…” Zhang Ren said, his expression stern, “Our biggest enemy hasn’t shown up yet! Do you know how many people or experts outside of Qing Province have their eyes on us? If we dispatch our disciples to help the common folks, what if they get killed by them?”
“So, are we just going to keep waiting?”
“Yes! We just need to wait for the next batch of enemies! Then we’ll get rid of them all in one
go!”
“Alright!” Yan Yan chimed in, “We will wait, but we can’t wait for so long. Besides, we also need eyes and ears all over Qing Province so that we’ll know what’s going on in the province at all times!”
Everything would come along once a plan had been formulated.
Chuyang Peak… The sun was setting, and the trees were whistling along with the wind. There were eight dishes on the table right now.
“This is so good. Even the Sect Master of the Riyue Sect would only get a chance to enjoy a feast like this once a year, but I can eat it here every day!” Xi Yao said. Divine light was emitting from her body, further accentuating her beauty. “My mana is increasing, and my body is changing. I’m becoming stronger and stronger, and this is amazing!”
Linglong sighed. “It’s over.” “What do you mean by it’s over?” Xi Yao asked as she looked at Linglong. Suddenly, she sensed something and chuckled. “I’m just talking about the food. I know what I should do and what I shouldn’t, so you can rest assured.”
“Well, it’s good that you understand that,” Linglong said.
Jiang Ming listened to their conversation as he chuckled inwardly.
“Brother Jiang, you don’t mind me eating here every day, right?” Xi Yao asked, looking at Jiang Ming like a kitten waiting for food.
“Of course, I don’t mind,” Jiang Ming laughed, “I have plenty of ingredients left that would last us for another hundred years. Besides, even if we run out of food, I can just go to get some from the East Sea.”
“To use hundreds of millions of sea creatures in the East Sea as ingredients, I believe there’s no one in this world other than my Senior Brother who can do it,” Linglong said as she looked admiringly at Jiang Ming. After that, she looked at Xi Yao, whose face and eyes were brimming with light, and asked, “Are you sure you can take him on?” Xi Yao was stunned, and her heart skipped a beat.
She knew Jiang Ming was not lying or boasting when he said he was going to use the sea creatures in the East Sea as his personal food source. She just couldn’t explain the feeling that was tugging at her heart, and no matter how hard she tried, she couldn’t shake it off.
‘I’ve fallen for him!’ Xi Yao was stunned when the realization finally hit her.
If it hadn’t been for Linglong, she wouldn’t have realized it. Now that she had realized it, she had to think about it.
‘Should I leave? No. This is a test for me, and I must get over it. If I can get over it, my state of mind will get better, and it’ll help a lot in my cultivation in the future. What if I can’t get over the test? That’s not even a problem for me. I’m the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect, and there’s no way I can’t get over something like this. What I seek is the path of immortality, and every obstacle that stands in my way will only make me stronger.’
Xi Yao became more determined as a smile appeared on her face.
Linglong looked at her and pouted. It went without saying that she knew what Xi Yao was thinking about.
‘Seems like my Senior Brother is going to have a taste of a Holy Daughter. No, I won’t let that happen. I have many clones with me. Each of them can have different personalities and figures. I’m sure I’ll be able to satisfy my Senior Brother,’ Linglong thought.
Jiang Ming thought for a while and put his chopsticks down. “Linglong, please take care of the dishes afterward. I’m going out for a while!”
“Sure,” Linglong nodded. “Please be careful, Senior Brother!”
Jiang Ming nodded and vanished into the air.
30,000 miles away, Liu Yu appeared, her face pale and her arm severed.
“Jiuyang Sect!” Her face was contorted with rage. “I must destroy you one day!”
She took out a pill and swallowed it. Her shoulder wriggled, and a new arm grew out of the wound.
“I still need some time to get used to it before I can regain my previous strength!” Liu Yu said as she swung her arm.
After all, she had just grown a new arm. It was weak, and she needed some time to get used to it.
Swoosh!
A streak of light appeared and landed beside her. It turned into a human figure, and it was none other than Xiao Hai. “Sister Yu, I immediately rushed over as soon as I received your message. Judging from your condition, could it be that you’ve failed?”
“Yes, I’ve failed,” Liu Yu said, “I had no idea that a righteous sect like the Jiuyang Sect would slaughter the alliance of so many clans without any qualms. They should have called themselves an evil sect instead!”
“How is this possible? If the Jiuyang Sect wants to expand, how can it not care about its reputation?” Xiao Hai frowned. “Anyway, what’s done cannot be undone. The experts from the Fo Sect are on their way here. I also received information from Brother Xuan that other experts from other provinces are coming this way as well. Many people were reluctant to attack the Jiuyang Sect in the past, but now since they’ve committed such an atrocity, I’m certain that no one is happy with them. For the Fo Sect, no matter if they want to get their revenge or spread their influence in Qing Province, the Jiuyang Sect will be an obstruction for them, and they must get rid of them first. The Qingyun Sect is the Sacred Land. Although they’re going down the hill, they’re still very powerful. I’m sure they won’t let the Jiuyang Sect get what they want. Even if they don’t show themselves, they will do something in secret to hinder the Jiuyang Sect.”
“So, does this mean that the Jiuyang Sect is
over?”
“Yes!”
“Well then, we should just sit and watch. No, we have to do something in the dark. We need to act fast, or else we won’t have enough time!”
“Calm down, Sister Yu. Brother Xuan is already planning. By the way, is the Jiuyang Sect really that powerful? Even you can’t defeat them?”
“I have no idea who it is since they didn’t show themselves. They just swung their sword, and it nearly killed me. In my opinion, it should be a Level 9 expert. However, what is strange is that they didn’t come after me.”
“Perhaps they don’t know where you come from, so they didn’t dare to do anything rashly. Should we consult our boss?”
“No, our boss is our trump card and our final hope when everything has fallen through.”
Both of them were talking, yet neither of them realized that Jiang Ming was observing them in the sky above.
“Ming Hai, Level 7, Primal Spirit Realm.”
Jiang Ming looked at them.
Xiao Hao was at the peak of the Primal Spirit Realm, so he was someone to be reckoned with.
“Brother Xuan and their boss, huh…” Jiang Ming mumbled, “One of them is planning from the back, while another is their final hope…”
“It would be easy to locate Brother Xuan since he has formed connections with the people outside. As for their boss… Well, this is hard. How exactly is the karma between them severed? Is it some sort of protection from the Reincarnation Hall or a special item? If it’s a special item, it should also be able to cut off all the karma that comes from interacting with others after coming here.”
As the thought surfaced in his mind, he turned around and left.
Judging from their conversation, he knew that they had already found out he was the one who killed Long Qian.
If he killed both of them now, the other two members would certainly be able to know about it. If they went into hiding, it would be very difficult to look for them.
“Since their boss is their last hope, he won’t show up easily. But I’m sure he’ll be observing everything from the side, so he must be in Qing Province now as well. If he’s their boss, he should be at the Paradis Realm, and if that’s true, it’ll be easy to find him!”
Jiang Ming thought and activated his Paradis Projection. It just covered a hundred-mile radius in the beginning. Then, the projection began to fade away. It merged into the law of the universe and began to spread out far. It only stopped after it reached about 100,000 kilometers.
Jiang Ming used his Paradis Projection as a medium and successfully located all of the experts that were hiding in Qing Province.
He also noticed a lot of Purple Mansion experts and some Dao Seed experts. He did not find many Nascent Soul experts, and he did not find any experts with the realm higher than that. Suddenly, Jiang Ming realized something and looked toward the north. A group of ten or so Primal Spirit experts was heading toward the Jiuyang Sect.
“A bunch of pieces of trash!”
However, he did not do anything to them.
After all, he was certain that the Jiuyang Sect was capable of dealing with them, so he decided to leave them for the Sect Master.
After a short while, he noticed a group of monks, and the one leading them was a Paradis expert.
“This is getting more and more interesting!” Jiang Ming chuckled.
Finally, he found his target on the other side.
It was a mountain, and there was a small sect on it. Its name was Kaoshan Sect, and the strongest of them was just a third-stage Golden Core expert.
However, there was a Paradis expert amongst them. He sealed up the entire sect, and although all of the disciples were still alive, they were like marionettes.
All of the female disciples were gathered up in a hall, serving a man with two horns on his head.
Suddenly, the man on the bed jerked his head up, and his surroundings exploded, turning everyone in the hall into blood mist.
“How vicious!” Jiang Ming had no idea that he would notice him. He also did not expect that he would kill his servants without any qualms.
“Who are you?” Shan Hu asked as an armor appeared on him. He lifted his head and looked into the sky through the roof.
As soon as he finished speaking, he kicked the floor and came outside.
“Why do you enslave a small sect?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with rage.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records was opened.
Name: Shan Hu
Race: Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 8 (Paradis).
Background: The Black Tiger Clan of the Xinghai Planar World (Note: Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary, a member of Team Black Tiger)
Relationship: -89
Innate Talent: Ten Stars Status: A beneficiary of the Heaven Reincarnation Hall. Took on a C-level mission, Investigate the Jiuyang Sect, with his team members. After arriving here, he formed a plan with the other four teammates. One of them sneaked into the Jiuyang Sect, one went to persuade the Fo Sect experts, one enslaved the Great Monarchs of each clan in Qing Province to launch an attack on the Jiuyang Sect, while the last went around spreading the news. As the team’s last hope, he went into hiding and waited to see if his teammates could destroy the Jiuyang Sect or not. When he learned that Long Qian was dead, he was furious and sent Liu Yu to launch her attack first. In the meantime, he found a small sect and enslaved all of them. Just when he was having a good time, the alarm in his heart blared, and he knew someone was there.
Jiang Ming was a little bit disappointed after looking through Shan Hu’s Status. He still couldn’t get the names of the other four members. “They really are overly cautious!’ Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
He had already found two Paradis experts.
They had a fine, powerful team, and they should have pushed all their way across Qing Province. However, not only did they sever the karma between them, but they also went separate ways, and their boss went into hiding.
The man in front of him was the boss.
“I passed by here, and a female disciple caught my attention, so I came here to coddle them. They should feel honored!” Shan Hu sneered. “Who are you, and what are you doing here?” “It’s in human’s nature to help those in need. It would be fine if I didn’t encounter you, but since I’m here, there’s no way I’m going to ignore it,” Jiang Ming said, his eyes gloomy. “Are you going to attack the Jiuyang Sect too?” “You too?” Shan Hu was surprised.
“Of course.” Jiang Ming’s gaze softened a bit. “I just came back from there. The Jiuyang Sect just crushed a batch of experts, and they’re strong. They even caught a spy, who was a Primal Spirit expert, and killed him. Oh yeah, if my memories still serve me right, his name should be Long Qian. Before he died, he sold his four other members out. I remember one of them is called Xuan something. The Jiuyang Sect is too powerful. I was too scared, so I decided to run. While I was running, I came across this place.”
As he was talking, he was staring at the Human Paths Record.
Unfortunately, the real name of “Xiao Xuan” did not appear.
“Long Qian is dead?” Shan Hu’s eyes were spewing fire. Suddenly, his pupils constricted. “No, you were not going to attack the Jiuyang Sect. You’re one of them! Even if Long Qian was compromised, he would never sell us out. Who are you? How do you know there are five of us? And you’re here specifically to look for
me!
“D*mn it!
“I have to run!”
Shan Hu’s face turned pale when the realization dawned upon him. He shouted inwardly, ‘System! Hurry up and beam me back to the Reincarnation Hall!’
It was also at this moment that Jiang Ming activated the Human Path Records. A blanket of light descended and enveloped Shan Hu. The Paradis Projection was activated as well and sealed the area.
[Ding! Intercepted by a supreme weapon. Beneficiary Shan Hu, your authority is too low. Unable to transmit you back to the Reincarnation Hall.]
(Ding! New SSS-Class mission: Investigate your opponent’s background. Different rewards will be given according to the degree of completing the mission.]
(Ding! Please keep up with the good work and complete the mission as soon as possible, Beneficiary Shan Hu.]
“D*mn it!” Shan Hu cursed out loud.
‘You can’t beam me back, and now you even gave me a new SSS-Class mission? I’m going to die soon!
He was filled with fear and, at the same time, confused.
“Who, who are you?” Shan Hu suppressed the fear and asked, “How do you know I’m here?”
Jiang Ming chuckled. “I’ll ask the questions, and you need to answer them, do you understand?”
“Understood!” Although Shan Hu was not happy about it, he understood that the man in front of him could kill him easily. Otherwise, the system wouldn’t have given him an SSS-Class mission.
He also tried to run away, but he couldn’t. His surroundings were sealed, and he could barely move a single step. Since he was at the man’s mercy, he had to do everything he said.
“How did you guys sever the karma between you all?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Simple. It’s a feature of the past,” Shan Hu replied.
“I see!” Jiang Ming replied.
Although he did not say it explicitly, Jiang Ming knew he was telling him that it used to be one of the Reincarnation Hall’s features.
Seeing Jiang Ming’s reaction, Shan Hu was stunned. ‘Could it be that he knows about the Reincarnation Hall? How is that possible? This is just a planar world, and the people here shouldn’t know about the Reincarnation Hall. Not only that, but he also possesses a supreme weapon that can prevent me from beaming back to the Reincarnation Hall? This is unbelievable!”
“The strongest of your kind, are there any from the Great Chiliocosm?”
Shan Hu opened his mouth, but the alarm in his head rang out.
(Ding! Warning! Warning! Answering the question evasively is also leaking information. You’ll be erased if you leak any more information!]
Shan Hu smiled bitterly. Human Path Records:
Name: Shan Hu
Status: Was being warned by the Reincarnation Hall. He was not allowed to divulge any information about the Reincarnation Hall, or else he would be erased.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“This Reincarnation Hall is too cautious. He can’t even answer my questions in an evasive way?’
“What is your name?” Jiang Ming asked. “Your next question is my brothers’ names, right?” Shan Hu said calmly, “Since you know the karma between us has been severed, you should have a way to know who and where they are if you know their names. After knowing this, do you think I’d still tell him their names?”
“In this case, then die!”
Jiang Ming raised his finger and pierced through Shan Hu’s forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - All In One Net
chapters.content:
Chapter 151 All In One Net
Since Jiang Ming knew he couldn’t get any information from Shan Hu, he killed him without hesitation. After Shan Hu was dead, a gush of energy rose from his body, and Jiang Ming was overjoyed. He grabbed it, and just as he expected, it was the origin essence of a non-elemental world. It was ten times stronger than the one he had gotten from Long Qian.
“Long Qian was a Primal Spirit expert, while Shan Hu was a Paradis expert. It’s only one realm difference, and it increases by ten times and saves me ten years of work!”
Jiang Ming was happy with the outcome.
Now it was confirmed the beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall were not beasts or monsters but food for him.
Although there was a World Heart in his inner world, it was still tough and took a long time to transform into a real world.
Now that he had the origin essence, things would be easier.
Jiang Ming did not absorb it into his inner world instantly. Instead, he checked through it with the Human Path Records, and he only started absorbing it after he was certain that it was fine.
The inner world absorbed the origin essence in the blink of an eye. As the origin began to grow, more laws were formed. Some of the residual energy also merged into his body and made his physical body even stronger.
He squinted his eyes and looked over Shan Hu’s corpse. His corpse remained on the ground lifelessly. He had quite a few items on him, but none of them were technology gadgets. “Did his soul get obliterated?” Jiang Ming thought for a while.
He found two items on par with the supreme-grade Dao Vessel and one forbidden weapon on the same level as an Imminent Immortal Weapon. Honestly, Jiang Ming was kind of surprised. If Shan Hu was an Extreme Path expert, Jiang Ming was confident that he would be able to escape from him.
He took all his items and clapped his hands, reducing Shan Hu’s corpse into dust and blowing it away with the wind.
Meanwhile, Liu Yu and Ming Hai were planning their next move. Suddenly, the voice of the Reincarnation System rang out in their heads at the same time.
(Ding! Before coming here, Beneficiary Liu Yu, Team Black Tiger activated the karma-severing feature. Now that your captain Shan Hu has been killed, team members’ condition function has been activated. All of you will be notified when one of your team members is killed.]
The same thing was going on in “Xiao Xuan” and Ming Hai’s brains.
“The boss has been killed? How is that possible!?” Liu Yu’s face turned pale. “We’ve activated the karma-severing feature. There’s no way other people would know where our boss is. He has never shown himself, so how did he get killed all of a sudden? This is so weird!”
“Could it be that a powerful being killed him?” Ming Hai said, his face was as pale as Liu Yu’s.
“That’s impossible. How many strong beings are left in Eastern Region? I’m sure the Jiuyang Sect killed our boss. Now that they’ve gotten both Long Qian and our boss, the Jiuyang Sect is terrifying. They aren’t as simple as they seem to be. If they could even kill our boss, then how about us?” Liu Yu’s expression changed, and she stopped speaking. Ming Hai froze.
They looked at each other, and they could see the fear in each other’s eyes.
At the same time, a figure had appeared before them.
It was Jiang Ming. After killing Shan Hu, he pinpointed their location with the Human Path Record as he was worried that they might run away.
As soon as he arrived here, he activated the Great Akasa Cage Technique and prevented them from running away.
I
U
The Human Path Records appeared and hovered over his head.
“Liu Yu, Ming Hai!” Jiang Ming shouted.
“Who are you?” Liu Yu asked, her face filled with trepidation. “Are you the one who killed our boss?”
“Are you talking about Shan Hu? Yes. I’m the one who killed him,” Jiang Ming replied. “Do you want to live or not?”
“Of course, but how?” Liu Yu replied without any hesitation.
Ming Hai tried to activate his special ability but to no avail. He then chose to use one of his forbidden weapons. However, the weapon was destroyed as soon as it shot out of his body. Ming Hai was taken aback, and his face turned ashen pale.
“Tell me about the other friends,” Jiang Ming said with a grin. “If I’m happy with your answer, I’ll let you go.”
“He’s Ming Hai, a Primal Spirit expert!” Liu Yu said without any hesitation, “Long Qian, who you killed, was a Primal Spirit expert. Our boss, Shan Hu, was a Paradis expert. We have one more member. His name is Zheng Xuan. He’s a Paradis expert too, and he’s currently inviting other experts from other provinces to Qing Province. What else do you want to know? I’ll tell you everything. All I ask for is just let me live!” Liu Yu pleaded.
“Liu Yu, how could you!?” Ming Hai snarled, “Have you forgotten about our vow? Even if we weren’t born on the same day, we should die together on the same day. We will go through thick and thin together and keep each other’s secrets! Now that our boss is dead, I won’t blame you if you don’t want to avenge him, but how could you leak our information to our enemy? You’ll die a gruesome death, Liu Yu!”
“This man comes from the Jiuyang Sect, and he’s far stronger than us. Since he knows that we’re plotting against the Jiuyang Sect, how is there any possibility that he would let us go? I don’t want to die. It took me long enough to come here, and there’s no way I’m giving up my life just like that!” Liu Yu said, her face contorted with rage. “Besides, we’re just hired by the experts from the Fo Sect, so what does it matter if we say it out loud? Our boss is dead, Long Qian is dead, so if both of us are dead, who is going to protect our clan?”
“I… I…” Ming Hai’s face was filled with remorse.
Jiang Ming lifted his eyebrows and looked at them.
The Human Path Records was opened up.
Name: Liu Yu.
Status: She was caught between laughter and tears. Her boss was killed, but the reincarnation notification feature was activated at the same time. They came here just to get rid of the Jiuyang Sect. They had never made any enemies yet, so the one who killed their boss should be the expert from the Jiuyang Sect.
She was worried about herself since even they could discover her boss and kill him. She had been ambushed when she was attacking the Jiuyang Sect, and now she finally saw the reason why the person had not killed her on the spot despite having the ability to do so.
Now that he had found her, she noticed that she couldn’t break herself free from the constraint no matter how hard she tried. She wondered if the man before her was one of the beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall. After all, not only did he know their boss was Shan Hu, but he also knew their names. However, there was one thing she couldn’t understand. Since he knew who they were, why did he not kill them instantly?
He had mentioned all of their names but Xiao Xuan’s. Did this mean that he still did not know about Xiao Xuan’s name? Since he did not kill them right away, she felt that she still had a chance to get away from here. She then formulated a plan with Ming Hai and pushed all the blame to the Fo Sect. At the same time, she swore to God that she would keep Xiao Xuan’s real name a secret with her life.
Jiang Ming sighed inwardly. He still did not get Xiao Xuan’s real name, and it seemed to him that “Zheng Xuan” was a fake name.
He tried his luck at Ming Hai’s Status, but it was the same.
Smack!
He did not want to waste his time with these two people anymore and killed them in one strike before proceeding to absorb their origin essence.
“Xiao Xuan, huh…”
Mumbling that name, Jiang Ming shook his head and went back to the Jiuyang Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - Found You
chapters.content:
Chapter 152 Found You
In Wu Province, at Yanyu City…
Xiao Xuan was eating his meal in a restaurant, his face grim.
‘I’ve done everything I could do. If everything goes well, the Jiuyang Sect’s fate will be sealed! The Fo Sect has sent in three teams, and two Paradis experts are going with them too. One of them had their sect destroyed, while another had their families slaughtered. Both of them hated the Jiuyang Sect to the core. They would certainly go to get their revenge when they found out that one of the First Seats of the Jiuyang Sect is from the devil sect. Maybe other Paradis experts would go after them too.
‘I guess I should get back after I finish my meal. Maybe I could provide them with some help somehow.”
As the thought surfaced in his head, he froze, and his face turned pale.
“Our boss is dead? But how!?’ Xiao Xuan was stunned.
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath to calm himself down. ‘Did the Jiuyang Sect kill them? If this is the case, it will be terrible. Liu Yu and Ming Hai, they… A surge of anger rose from the bottom of his stomach pit, and he had the urge to destroy this town to vent his spleen. However, he did not do that and just went on to finish his meal.
After a short while, Xiao Xuan was stunned again.
[Ding! Beneficiary Xiao Xuan, your team members, Liu Yu and Ming Hai, have been killed. You’re the only one left in Team Black Tiger. Please complete your mission as soon as possible.]
The notification that popped up in his head was short, but Wang Xuan felt so cold as if he had fallen into an ice cavern, as fear trickled down his spine.
“They killed four of us before we could even make our move? How… How did they do that? I’m afraid they’re coming for me next!’
Wang Xuan checked his remaining points and shook his head helplessly.
He did not have enough points left to cover the penalty for failing the mission or forfeiting the mission and going back to the Reincarnation Hall.
‘I guess I have no other choice but to wait until the time runs out by itself!’
As for revenge?
He did not even dare to think about that.
After he finished his meal, he turned into a beam of light and went in the opposite direction of the Jiuyang Sect.
Chuyang Peak…
“Senior Brother, have you gotten rid of them?” Linglong jumped and coiled her arms around Jiang Ming’s neck.
