“Yes!” Jiang Ming sat on the rattan chair and put his junior sister beside him. “Mind your manners, Junior Sister. People are watching.”
“Well, it isn’t that she’s an outsider,” Linglong said nonchalantly.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
Xi Yao glanced at them and flung her sleeve. As she flew away, she said, “Can you two stop being so lovey-dovey in front of me? It stings my eyes!”
“Well, you’re always welcome to join us!” Linglong said, chuckling.
Xi Yao froze and nearly fell from the sky.
Jiang Ming patted his Junior Sister and said, “Stop teasing her. She’s a Holy Daughter.” “Don’t you want it?”
“Want what?”
“Hmph, playing dumb again, huh? I don’t believe you don’t get what I’m trying to say.”
“Of course, I don’t know. What are you trying to say?”
“You want her to be your woman too!” “What are you talking about? You are all I need. Why should I need another woman?”
“Really?”
“Of course!”
“Hmph! You’re lying! Look at her. She has a good personality, good cultivation level, good status, and most importantly, her body figure is one of the best I’ve seen. Do you need my help? If you want, I can help you to take her down.”
“Seems like you’re looking for some beating!”
“Come at me!”
Three days later, under the gazebo… “Senior Brother, I had no idea that the sexual cultivation technique is so good. Not only could I reach the peak of the Dao Seed Realm and perfect the Five Elemental Sambodha, but I also tapped into the wood, fire, earth, metal, and water, these five laws. You’re so awesome, Senior Brother. Can we do it again?”
“Ahem…”
Jiang Ming rolled his eyes at Linglong.
After that, he looked outside of the Jiuyang Sect. A lot of experts had gathered outside of the Jiuyang Sect. It seemed to him that they were the team that had come to destroy the Jiuyang Sect. Some of them were the disciples of the Fo Sect, while the others were Primal Spirit experts. There were even a few of them who had reached the Paradis Realm.
“Senior Brother, should I go and meet them?” Linglong asked as she popped a grape into Jiang Ming’s mouth.
“Nope.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Our sect is in need of a war to establish our reputation as well as to polish our members. If we take the lead in everything, the disciples of our sect will be ruined.”
“But many people will die if we don’t do anything.”
“There’s nothing we can do about it. There is no war without casualties. Only after experiencing death will they grow up and put more effort into cultivation. However, we need to watch over our Master and Yin Yue.”
“Aright!”
Both of them continued to enjoy their time together while Yan Yan went to negotiate with their enemy. However, their enemy refused to back down. They wanted Yan Yan to hand over Yue Cheng as well as let them go into the Jiuyang Sect to run a check through the entire sect.
It was obvious that Yan Yan would not allow them to do that.
Since they could not come to a consensus, they had no other choice but to fight.
Yan Yan did not activate the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk despite the enemy having destroyed the original protection formation. He was going to wait until more of them were inside before activating the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk to defeat a bunch of them in one go. However, there were quite a number of Primal Spirit experts, so it would be hard to get rid of them.
The war ensued, and the air was filled with the smell of blood.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet and looked toward the mountain gate. There were a total of seven Paradis experts, three experts from the Fo Sect. When they saw another formation, all of them were startled.
“Are you not going to help them?” Xi Yao came over. “Although the formation is powerful, there are too many Primal Spirit experts. Some of your friends may die. Do you want me to help them? With the help from the formation, I think I can hold back two of them.”
“It’s not necessary,” Jiang Ming shook his head, “I’m sure the Sect Master can handle them. As for the rest of the Paradis experts, just let them be.”
“There are Paradis experts among them?” Xi Yao was shocked.
At the same time, the Combat Mannequin at the cliff turned into a streak of light. He dashed forward and soon arrived at the battlefield. “He’s so strong!” Xi Yao exclaimed, “Is he your guardian?”
Jiang Ming just smiled at her without replying.
He turned around and looked in the other direction.
There was nothing but clouds in his vision, and hiding amongst the clouds was an expert. He was watching the war.
“He’s the person who was attacked by two Extreme Path experts from the Yinmo Sect that night. He wasn’t from the devil sect, but he’s one of the Jiuyang Sect? Not only that, but he seems to have some immortal weapons with him.”
The man was none other than Qing Fengzi, and he was watching the Combat Mannequin.
Nothing that happened in Eastern Region could escape his eyes. He knew that a group of experts was coming to destroy the Jiuyang Sect, so he came here to check it out.
It would be best if the Jiuyang Sect could go down the drain like this, but even if they could survive through this battle, he could learn more about the Jiuyang Sect too.
Suddenly, Qing Fengzi felt a chill down his spine as a bad feeling rose from his stomach pit.
Without thinking twice, he went away.
“He’s sharp!” Jiang Ming shook his head as he looked at Qing Fengzi’s departing figure.
He was wondering if he should kill Qing Fengzi just now, but he did not expect Qing Fengzi to be so sharp.
He turned around and looked toward the mountain gate.
The Combat Mannequin was currently fighting with seven Paradis experts.
He had killed one just now, and the remaining six had joined forces to fight him.
Jiang Ming watched the battle with his hands clasped behind his back.
The Human Path Records was opened.
“I finally found you!” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed with joy as he dashed toward the person.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - orld Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: World Destruction
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Combat Mannequin had led the six Paradis martial experts away.
His sword was sharp, and he had sent one of them flying away. The other five were not perturbed.
However, while he was flying in the air, the space behind him suddenly collapsed, and he was sucked inside. When he appeared again, he was already in another area.
The middle-aged man looked around and noticed that he had now gone very far away from the battlefield.
“Who are you?” he asked.
“He has mastered the Spatial Dao and transported me here. This person is strong.
Jiang Ming did not reply to him. He put his finger on his forehead and entered his Paradis.
Inside the middle-aged man’s Paradis was a sea of fire.
Apparently, he had comprehended the fire law.
The core of the Paradis was where the soul was.
Jiang Ming activated the soul special ability and destroyed the middle-aged man’s soul. After that, he began reading his mind.
A few moments ago, he had noticed a message from the Human Path Records that interested him. That’s why he had decided to make a move.
Name: Cai Bin
Status: Instigated by a strange strong man with a broken family to join together to besiege the Jiuyang Sect in revenge.
There was only one simple line in his Status.
Jiang Ming reckoned that the person should be at least as strong as this middle-aged man. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to convince him so easily.
The first person who came into Jiang Ming’s mind was “Xiao Xuan.” That’s why he decided to come after this middle-aged man.
Several minutes later, he found a piece of memory in his mind.
Inside of the memory, he was talking to a young man.
“He’s wearing glasses? It’s you, right?”
‘When the thought surfaced in Jiang Ming’s head, he used the Karma Law and located a causal line easily.
The causal line was thin, and it seemed as if it was going to break at any moment.
He clipped the causal line with two fingers and activated the Karma Law. Then he noticed there was a strong person on the other side of the causal line moving at a fast pace.
“Well, it seems like I have to act now. Or else, the little mouse is getting away.” Jiang Ming chuckled. He grabbed Cai Bin, tore open the space before him, and jumped into it.
Soon, he appeared in front of a young man.
“Wang Xuan, do you know how hard it was to find you?” He sealed the surroundings as soon as he appeared as well as summoned the Human Path Records.
The young man’s information appeared before his eyes. He was none other than the last member of Team Black Tiger.
“You’re fast!” Wang Xuan was stunned. He pushed his glasses and could sense his surroundings were sealed by a force that he could never break through. Knowing that his fate was sealed, he sighed. “You’re the one who killed them, aren’t you? It must be it. We’ve been keeping a very low profile, and we’ll
escape whenever we sense something isn’t right. We even severed the karma between us before we came here to prevent other people like you who have mastered the Karma Law from locating us. But little did I expect that you would find my boss.”
“Well, the world is pretty small. All you just need to do is look, and you’ll be able to find it.” Jiang Ming smiled.
“That’s not possible. It’s easier said than done,” Wang Xuan refuted calmly. “The karma between the five of us was severed, and you didn’t know who we were, so it’s impossible that you could locate us. However, you were able to locate us, and I could only think of one reason. You know about us. Or else
there’s no way you could find us, and you would never be able to know where I am through Cai Bin. You have comprehended the Karma Law, know about us, and even know there are five of us. If you lack one of these three elements, you won’t find us all out.”
Jiang Ming smiled and did not say anything.
Wang Xuan was right.
Without the Human Path Record, even if he had fully mastered the Karma Law, he wouldn’t be able to find them all, let alone knowing that there were five of them.
“You’re going to kill me, right?” Wang Xuan sighed, “Can you tell me who you are? But I’m sure you wouldn’t tell me. Sigh, when I was young, I kept struggling to survive. When I entered the cultivation world, I wanted to control my own destiny. When I attained power, I started to yearn for longevity.
When I am trapped, I long for freedom. One would have a different goal in different life stages, but in the end, all of us will return to the same place with our unattainable dreams.”
“People would have different goals in different stages of life,” Jiang Ming said, “You’ve put my family in danger, so I have to kill you. There’s no right or wrong between us. We’re just in a different position. Since I found you today, I won’t let you go. As for…”
He pointed above his head and continued. “Just say as much as you can.”
“Alright!” Wang Xuan smiled. “You’re right. There’s no right or wrong between us. We’re just in a different position serving different masters. Since I’m going to die anyway, there’s nothing I should worry about. When all of us are wiped out, there will be other people coming.
“But this will follow a certain set of rules. It won’t exceed a certain tolerance limit, and it’s relatively fair. However, one special condition will trigger the destruction of the world…”
Wang Xuan’s expression suddenly froze as notifications began to ring out in his head.
(Ding! First warning! Beneficiary Wang Xuan, you’ve intentionally leaked information about the Reincarnation Hall.
(Ding! Second warning! Beneficiary Wang Xuan, stop whatever you are doing right now immediately!]
(Ding! Beneficiary Wang Xuan, you’ll be executed for revealing important information about the Reincarnation Hall!)
There was a smile on Wang Xuan’ss face, but the light had left his eyes.
His soul had been destroyed, and his memories were gone.
A stream of energy appeared from the top of his head. Jiang Ming grabbed it, and he felt exasperated.
He lifted his head and looked into the sky.
Then, he stomped, and a crack appeared on the ground. He buried Wang Xuan’s body into the ground and closed up the crack.
As for Cai Bin?
He reduced him into a blood mist with a stomp.
“More of them are coming, huh? As long as they have the guts to come, I’ll make this world your grave! But he said something about world destruction… Is it something to do with a world-destroying mission? I guess I should ask Jun Sangian when I see him next time.”
Jiang Ming pondered and returned to Qing Province.
The battle was still going on.
The Combat Mannequin had killed another three Paradis experts. There were three experts from the Fo Sect left. Just when they were about to get defeated by the Combat Mannequin, a Buddha palm appeared and smashed the Combat Mannequin into the ground.
“An Extreme Path expert from the Fo Sect?” Jiang Ming smiled coldly.
As he looked in the direction, the Human Path Records was opened up.
Name: Xi Guang
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Extreme Path Realm
Background: One of the Supreme Elders of the Fo Sect,
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Ten Stars
Status: The Fo Sect lost to the five devil sects intentionally and hid to shatter the predicament of getting confined in Eastern Region and spread their influence to the rest of the world. He came to Eastern Region secretly to support the seven teams that had been sent there to spread their influence. He was
furious when one of the teams in Qing Province was wiped out. When he learned that one of the First Seats of the Jiuyang Sect was from the devil sect, he knew his chance had come. He could publicly punish the Jiuyang Sect. He first sent three teams to attack the Jiuyang Sect. Little did he expect that an
Extreme Path expert would appear and stand in their way. He watched silently as the Extreme Path expert defeated four Paradis experts. When the lives of his members were in danger, it was only then he decided to step in.
“Seven Paradis experts and one Extreme Path expert… They must’ve wanted to take advantage of the situation in Eastern Region. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have sent in so many experts. Generally speaking, they would be able to establish a foundation in Eastern Region with such a team since the Qingyun
Sect is in a weakened state right now.
“Unfortunately, they have offended someone they should never be offending, and that’s me!
“It is just that I didn’t know the Fo Sect deliberately lost to the five devil sects. They really are a bunch of lunatics!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
“Now I can confirm that the five devil sects are going to get destroyed soon.”
He threw a palm strike into the distance with that thought in mind. The palm strike turned into a sword and killed the Extreme expert from the Fo Sect.
Extreme Path? They were nothing to him!
“Twon’tt let you all get your way!” Jiang Ming mumbled before returning to Chuyang Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - keletal Sword, He Actually Came Arrogantly
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Skeletal Sword, He Actually Came Arrogantly
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
That night, the Combat Mannequin went on a rampage. He first killed seven Paradis Realm experts and then traversed into Eastern Region and beheaded all the Fo disciples who came forth.
There was a saying about Eastern Region not having any Buddha, and it really became true.
The Jiuyang Sect also went crazy, slaughtering their enemies.
Countless experts trapped by the great formation were decimated as the bloodshed slowly formed into streams. However, the Jiuyang Sect also suffered some setbacks, where many hilltops were shattered, and numerous disciples were killed.
God knew how many Eastern Region experts could sleep peacefully that night.
Early in the morning in the Qingyun Sect, Holy Lord Ming Yuzi and Supreme Elder Qing Fengzi stood silently as they looked in the direction of the Jiuyang Sect, their expression solemn as ever.
“Numerous Primal Spirit experts, seven Paradis experts, and even an Extreme Path expert were all killed!” Ming Yuzi muttered in a trembling voice, “How does the Jiuyang Sect have such a strong background?”
“It’s not seven Paradis experts but 10. All who came from the Fo Sect were killed, and there was no one left standing. It was ruthless!” Qing Fengzi exhaled a mouthful of turbid breath that turned into a gust of wind, swiftly sweeping through the horizon. “I am now 50% sure that the overnight annihilation
of the alliance between the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union had something to do with the Jiuyang Sect.”
“The Jiuyang Sect was always under our surveillance all this while! How could such a strong person suddenly appear? It shouldn’t be possible!” Ming Yuzi could not wrap his head around this fact.
“Yes, it really shouldn’t be possible!” Qing Fengzi was also confused. “Whatever the case is, we cannot continue probing the Jiuyang Sect now. Before we can get to the bottom of it, we should only wait and see from afar. By the way, secretly pass the news to the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion. Tell them that
their Holy Son’s death was the Jiuyang Sect’s doing.”
“Was it really them?”
“It’s very likely. There’s even a chance that Tian Ci of the Tianyuan School being hunted down and killed was the doings of the Jiuyang Sect as well. Whether it’s really the case, just spread the news around.”
“Alright! The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty from Zhong Province will be visiting the Eastern Region again. Should we secretly induce him a little about the Jiuyang Sect?”
“although it won’t be of great use, you can still try. But remember not to expose us all.”
“Got it. Now that the Eastern Region’s Fo Sect has been annihilated, will the Western Region’s Fo Sect be enraged? Will they send over more experts?”
1
“They wouldn’t! They can no longer take any losses!”
The two continued discussing and made their plans.
On Chuyang Peak.
Standing in the pavilion, Jiang Ming sniffed the fragrance of the flowers and stretched himself as he muttered, “It’s yet another wonderful day!”
He was in a great mood.
The Combat Mannequin had long returned from its battle and was now sitting cross-legged near the cliff, facing the Eastern direction.
“Many were killed last night!” Five Elemental Linglong came over and snuggled next to Jiang Ming. “However, after this battle, Qing Province and even Eastern Region will not dare to provoke us anymore.”
“A battle to determine the peace of the whole world!” Jiang Ming smiled and asked, “What would you like to eat? I’ll be making breakfast.”
“Brother, let me do it!”
“No, let me!”
“Senior Brother’s the best! I like whatever you cook!”
“Alright then! Wait here for a while!”
Jiang Ming did not go downstairs but instead took out a whole set of kitchen utensils and started preparing breakfast just by the side.
There was no need for firewood or to get water from the wells. The fire needed was ignited with mana, and the water was condensed from spiritual essence into liquid. It was much simpler!
It didn’t take long before breakfast was prepared. It was a prawn porridge and soup-filled buns, a simple meal.
‘Xi Yao, who was looking over from afar, started to feel jealous of them.
“Tm here for a bite,” she yelled, flying over to them as she couldn’t help herself. “The prawns are still glowing even after they’re cooked, and even Dao fluctuations are emitted around. What level was the Prawn Demon?” Xi Yao asked.
“primal Spirit level, just eat it,” Jiang Ming explained, “The soup-filled buns are infused with the crab roe of a Paradis Crab Demon.
“That’s so extravagant!” Xi Yao could not help but grin. “My tastebuds are getting used to all this pampering. What will I do in the future?”
“Nothing!” Linglong snorted and started drinking the porridge.
Although it was a simple breakfast, everyone ate with much relish.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for preparing a scrumptious breakfast. You enjoyed the meal, and so did the guests. Rewarded with a bottle of Skeletal Sword Pill.”
The reward really took Jiang Ming by surprise.
Skeletal Sword Pill: 10 tablets per bottle. When used by those below the Purple Mansion Realm, it will help the consumer forge a Sword Skeletal system that improves the person’s affinity with the Sword Dao, allowing the consumer to learn Sword Dao techniques in one go easily.
‘Alteration of the physiques and even granting a talent. This is truly an overwhelming pill but of what use to me’ Jiang Ming shook his head before keeping the bottle of pills.
He lay back on the rattan chair to enjoy the peaceful and chilling morning as the morning breeze swept softly.
Suddenly, Gu Hai returned, his face betraying exhaustion.
“Tm exhausted!” Gu Hai sat right beside Jiang Ming, picked up the teapot, and chugged down the whole pot of tea. Immediately, the pores of his body started to spurt bright lights, and his exhaustion was completely swept away.
“It’s still comfortable here!” Gu Hai sighed.
“Many died?”Jiang Ming asked knowingly.
“Many were killed. Hundreds of disciples and many Elders passed away last night,” Gu Hai replied moodily. “If it wasn’t for the Life and Death Disillusionment Formation Disk that you gave us, the Jiuyang Sect’s name would’ve been erased from existence. Speaking of which, the waves of aura from the
aftermath of the great battle last night gave everyone the chills! How did the battle go?” Gu Hai turned to his side and looked at the Combat Mannequin that was right on the edge of the cliff. He felt inexplicably safe.
“The Fo Sect was eradicated,” Jiang Ming replied. “From today onward, there should be no one above the Primal Spirit Realm that will cause trouble here. Even if they do, they’ll just end up dead. Don’t worry, Master. From now on, you old man can just live a happy life with Yin Yue and work on getting me a
baby Junior Sister!”
“You dare make fun of your Master! You brat!” Gu Hai was furious as he slapped Jiang Ming on the back of his head. He then smiled before starting to laugh out loud. “Haha! Great! Splendid! Our Jiuyang Sect is finally rising to its glory. And to think the foundation that brought upon our sect rising were my
two disciples! Well! It’s truly wonderful!”
Jiang Ming rubbed the back of his head and smiled helplessly. To think that he, a person who could even kill an Imminent Immortal expert, was getting the back of his head slapped.
Anyway, this old man was the only one in the world who could beat him like that. If someone else tried.
“Master, what are your plans?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Heal up, put our dead ones to rest and then expand ourselves,” Gu Hai replied. “There is no rush for us to expand our sect. After all, the forces in Qing Province are almost completely wiped out. The result will be the same whether it’s sooner or later.”
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement.
With the Great Eastern War followed by the carnage and bloodshed last night, how many experts were left in Qing Province?
The birth of an expert required an accumulation of time, after all.
“This saddened heart of mine cannot suppress my restless heart. Just the thought of our Jiuyang Sect’s future of completely taking control of the whole Qing Province and even expanding beyond it makes me ecstatic. I need to share this great news with your Senior Aunt Yin Yue and the Sect Master as.
well.” Gu Hai stood up, smiling as he flew off.
“This old man!” Jiang Ming could not help but smile as well.
Peace and calm were restored on the mountains.
The restless Eastern Region slowly calmed down.
The 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty and his group, who had just arrived in Eastern Region were stunned.
High above the skies, in the midst of the ever-flowing clouds, a thousand-meter-long flying vessel was pushing through the sea of clouds moving forward rapidly.
The 18th Prince, Zhou Tian, stood at the top full of energy, with a blazing fighting spirit and extreme confidence.
“Linglong, I’ve returned! I’ll pay back all the shame you’ve brought upon me! And I’m going to get you for sure! I’ll make you my slave and let the Jiuyang Sect submit under me!”
Zhou Tian placed his hands behind his back, as his face was brimming with overbearing pride and arrogance.
At that very moment, an old man walked over and whispered, “Your Royal Highness, I’ve just received news that the Great Qing Province Battle last night has affected the entire Eastern Region.”
“Great Qing Province Battle? Affecting the whole Eastern Region? What’s going on?” Zhou Tian asked in confusion.
The old man was the one who acted as Zhou Tian’s guardian, Chang Yun. He followed along this time reluctantly.
“The First Seat of one of the Jiuyang Sect’s peaks was discovered to be of the Yinmo Sect! Instigated by someone, Qing Province, along with many forces of Eastern Region, gathered to form an alliance and besieged the Jiuyang Sect. However, they were the ones who were countered and killed. Even the Fo
disciples who came to preach in Eastern Region were all killed.
“All the Fo preachers were killed!” Zhou Tian was shocked by the news. “As far as I know, the Fo preachers were at the very least led by a Paradis expert, right?”
“Yes, that’s right!” Chang Yun answered.
“They were still killed?”
“There were seven Paradis experts and one Extreme Path expert. All of them were killed, and none survived!”
“How is that possible? Is this piece of news reliable!?” Zhou Tian drew a cold breath.
“The news came from the internal departments of the Qingyun Sect. It’s extremely reliable!”
“How is that possible? How can the Jiuyang Sect be so powerful?”
“Tdon’t understand this either. Your Royal Highness, do you still want to head toward the Jiuyang Sect?”
“Hehe… Hehe…” Zhou Tian’s mind was completely jumbled.
He had wanted to subdue the Jiuyang Sect and capture Zi Linglong one moment ago, yet the very next moment, he found out that the Jiuyang Sect had annihilated the Eastern Region alliance? That even included seven Paradis experts and one Extreme Path expert of the Fo Sect?
Zhou Tian thought someone must be pulling his legs and that it was more nonsense than a dream! Yet he had no choice but to believe it!
“Your Royal Highness, we are still marching in the direction of the Jiuyang Sect. We are very near now with only ten or so thousand miles away from them!” Chang Yun reminded him.
Zhou Tian suddenly shivered upon hearing the reminder.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - Lord God Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Lord God Space
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Bathing under the warm sunlight, Jiang Ming squinted his eyes as he swayed slowly.
“Senior Brother, why haven’t you been cultivating recently?” Fire Elemental Linglong asked curiously. “You used to insist on cultivating every day, but now you seem to be quite lazy.”
“Tm multitasking,” Jiang Ming answered with his eyes still shut tight. “You might see that I’m just being lazy lying around, but I’m actually cultivating all the time.”
“Multitasking? Maybe you might want to try and make a few clones of yourself like me?” Linglong suggested.
“And why would I do that?”
“Then we can try having our real bodies be intimate with each other and our clones between them. I wonder how that would feel,” Linglong answered.
“Girl, you are getting naughtier these days!”
“Sexual acts are actually proper business!” Linglong lay on Jiang Ming as she started drawing circles on him with her fingers.
“Hehe! Too proper? You and Spatial Linglong were quickly formed, but why is this next one taking so long?” Jiang Ming wondered.
“Senior Brother, the third clone has already been formed, and the fourth one is coming along soon. It’s just that since I’m here by your side, the third one hasn’t come over and is constantly cultivating. Should I ask her to come over as well? Senior Brother, are you thinking of hugging two of us on both
sides at the same time? Can you handle the two of us, though?” Linglong asked as she touched his hips.
Jiang Ming titled his head and gazed up at the sky.
There was something good about cultivation, for it made a man last longer.
Yet there was also a downside to it, for it made his Junior Sister have a high tolerance.
“Senior Brother, I’m going to start cultivating now!” Linglong said as she rolled over to his side, hugging onto Jiang Ming’s arm with squinted eyes. It looked as though she had fallen asleep, but her heart was actually deep like the ocean and was cultivating special abilities.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records to check on the Status changes of a few people.
As he flipped over a few pages, he saw Zhou Tian’s Status. This 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s Status was very lively.
Name: Zhou Tian
Status: Having been humiliated at the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak, he overheard that Zi Linglong had defeated many Holy Sons and Holy Daughters and that even Tian Ci of the Tianyuan School was of no match. Thus, his mood suddenly improved a lot.
After returning to the Great Zhou Dynasty of Zhong Province, he devoted himself to cultivation and leaped to the Nascent Soul Realm. Upon coming out of seclusion, he learned of the Great Eastern War and was shocked. It was the same time that the dynasty wanted to get their hands on certain rights
within Eastern Region. With the recommendation of the 3rd Prince, Zhou Tian came to Eastern Region again.
Sailing while leading an army on his war vessel, he came over this time with high spirits to redeem his dignity from the last humiliation, striving to subdue the Jiuyang Sect and capture Zi Linglong. Brimming with confidence, he also intended to take control of a province in Eastern Region, making it a
subdivision of the dynasty.
‘When he was 10,000 miles away from reaching the Jiuyang Sect, he got the news from one of the undercover agents in the Qingyun Sect that: In the battle last night, the Jiuyang Sect annihilated the Fo Sect, who had at least seven Paradis experts and one Extreme Path expert.
Upon receiving the news, he was greatly frightened and turned the war vessel around, retreating swiftly.
“The Great Zhou Dynasty. Why do I have the feeling that I’m going to have to face them sooner or later? Jiang Ming pondered.
The previous lesson was not enough for this 18th Price that he dared to return to the Jiuyang Sect. He was fortunate to have received the news in advance. Otherwise, he was definitely not leaving this time.
Jiang Ming had cut down this 3rd Prince with a Karma Slash, who had turned the Jiuyang Sect Master’s disciple into a puppet and tried to scheme in the shadows, but he didn’t end up dying.
Jiang Ming raised his hand, ready to behead the 18th Prince. After thinking for a while, he let it go.
As for the undercover agent that the Great Zhou Dynasty had placed in the Qingyun Sect, Jiang Ming was not surprised at all.
In between these major forces, having undercover agents hidden among them was normal.
On a mountain in Western Region near Zhong Province, the area was entirely covered by an invisible array formation.
Inside this mountain, there were a lot of Buddhist followers.
In one of the Buddhist palaces sat around 20 people above the Extreme Path Realm.
“Wu Hai, who went to Eastern Region, has returned to the arms of the Buddha. The rest of the disciples have also transcended into the ultimate bliss. Namo Amitabha.” An old monk who had a golden halo behind his head was the leader among them, looking compassionate. He recited the Namo Amitabha
and continued. “The preaching in Eastern Region ended in failure, Zhong Province faced some difficulties whereas the Southern and Northern Region have been straining.
“With such big changes happening in Eastern Region and even the Qingyun Sect keeping this a secret, we do not know the depth of their background. Thus, I suggest that we ignore them momentarily. Zhong Province is a place where luck converges and intertwines with many Sacred Lands. It is not a
place that can be penetrated easily, so let’s not even bring them up. As for the Southern and Northern Region, as long as our plan is successful, the next step will be turning the place into our true place for preaching, becoming a Buddhist Land.”
“That makes sense. I suggest that we immediately initiate our plans to avoid any more sudden changes!”
“Lagree! It’s high time to let the world see the supreme power of our Fo Sect! If this next step goes according to plan, the next targets will be the Southern and Northern Region. Then, we will take down Eastern Region and finally surround the whole Zhong Province. All the land will form our Fo nation!”
They discussed among themselves and made up a plan.
As for suffering a defeat in the last Eastern Region battle, they did not care much. It ended up in failure, and so be it. It didn’t matter much to the big picture.
“Then we will commence in three days!”
A decision was finally made.
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming stood on the rooftop, gazing to the west. He felt an indescribable agitation in his heart.
“Is something about to happen there?” Jiang Ming frowned as he thought about it. Unfortunately, he did not get any news about it.
He lifted his head and looked up into the sky, wondering, ‘Will the people from the Reincarnation Hall still descend to our world? I’m starting to miss them!”
He was really starting to miss these invaders.
These beneficiaries from the Reincarnation Hall were like cheat codes to him.
A Primal Spirit expert, Paradis expert, Extreme Path expert, and Imminent Immortal expert would save him 1, 10, 100, and 1,000 years of cultivation, respectively.
Therefore, how could Jiang Ming not miss them?
Suddenly, the Supreme Order started to vibrate.
Jiang Ming subconsciously dived into the Supreme Order and opened the Supreme Chat Room.
[Zhan Ge: Everyone, I found something strange that really shook me.]
[Ao Jiu: Spill it out! You are dangling your findings in mid-air like this and caused me to be dangling as well! My little ladies have started complaining.]
[Zhan Ge: You old pervert! Sooner or later, you will die on a woman’s belly.]
[Ao Jiu: This is my pleasure! Such beauty, such wonders, such thrill.]
[Zhan Ge: You indulge in your harem every day. I really don’t understand how you are able to enter this chat room. $o strange, oh so strange!)
[Ao Jiu: My talents are amazing and unparalleled in the world! Even if I’m not focused on my cultivation, I won’t lose out when compared with you all! Heck! If I focus for just a little, I will probably beat you down the nine streets!]
[Zhan Ge: Oh, forget it! If you continue living in the fast lane, I can assure you that you will not be able to join the chat room once you break through to the next level.]
[Ao Jiu: Sigh… I’m also worried! With my bleak future, I guess I will just have to find more mermaids and talk about life and dreams with them!]
(Zhan Ge: My god!]
[Ao Jiu: Spill it out! I’m currently lying down motionlessly. Not taking the lead is not my style!]
[Zhan Ge: Damn it, you win! I was involved in a plundering event recently. There were six opponents in total. I discovered that their Dao energy was incompatible with those of my world. The auras emitted from their bodies had somewhat of a repulsion effect on heaven and earth. It was very strange.]
[Zhan Ge: They were powerful. Even if I haven’t seen them, I should’ve at least known something about them, yet they were completely unfamiliar to me.]
[Zhan Ge: I captured one of them and thought of digging through their memories but couldn’t find anything in the end. It was as if some type of energy was blocking his soul.]
(Zhan Ge: There was one of them who they called ‘Captain’. When I was about to kill him off, they suddenly disappeared. I tried conducting divination and even used the fresh blood from these invaders for it. The result was that there was no such person, and no information was obtained at all.]
[Zhan Ge: Not long after that, I could suddenly hear a voice in my mind inviting me to join some sort of ‘Lord God Space’. It will allow a person to ascend into millions of worlds, scheming on endless opportunities and obtaining infinite benefits from it. A terrifying force enveloped my whole body with
strength that even quaked my soul.]
[Zhan Ge: Just as I was hesitating, the Supreme Order in my body suddenly vibrated and destroyed that voice. Yes, it literally destroyed the voice and directly dispelled the terrifying force enveloping my body.]
[Zhan Ge: Do any of you know what just happened to me? What is this ‘Lord God Space’? Can it really ascend into millions of worlds?

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - Devils Destroying the West, Buddha Burying the Devils
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Devils Destroying the West, Buddha Burying the Devils
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
[Ao Jiu: This seems to be a bit of a mystery! But with the existence of the Supreme Order, it doesn’t seem difficult to believe that there is such a thing as a Lord God Space. Though, I wonder what the purpose of that organization is and why they want to hunt you down?)
[Zhan Ge: I don’t know why either.]
[Ao Jiu: Could it be that this Lord God Space and our Supreme Pagoda are actually enemies with each other? Maybe they accidentally found you and sent people over to hunt you down? Wait, that doesn’t make sense either. If they wanted to hunt you down, then why would they bother inviting you to join
them?)
(Dongfang Chenxi: There’s an organization that can send people into other worlds here in my place, but they can only descend to some of the planar worlds. They select several talented disciples and send them over to other worlds to train them. Once they grow strong, they will become their soldiers.
They are far from being comparable with the Supreme Pagoda in terms of function and power.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Those that have descended over Zhan Ge’s are probably just there for training. Once they discovered that you were too strong with great aptitude, they wanted to invite you over to join them but were ultimately rejected by the Supreme Order. These are just my hypothesis, so I’m not
sure if they are accurate.]
[Ye Qingxian: That explanation should be close enough to the truth! Are there even that many organizations that can descend into different worlds? Using other worlds as their training grounds suddenly made me feel bitter.]
[Ao Jiu: Alas, I feel the same. Such bitterness, using us as if we’re shepherds! That’s why I want to be happy and enjoy life! I’ve made up my mind! I will form another 18 harems!]
[Ming Fei: You lewd swine!]
[Ao Jiu: That… My sister, you are wrong. It should be a lewd dragon!]
[Ming Fei: How shameless!]
[Ao Jiu: *Cough* *Cough* I’m just joking.]
Jiang Ming silently read through the screen, but his heart was actually racing profusely.
‘The Reincarnation Hall had appeared here in his world, and a Lord God Space had appeared over at Zhan Ge’s.
He checked Zhan Ge’s Status in the Human Path Records, and it seemed he was not lying.
‘Seriously, what kind of world is this? It’s just a pile of mess!’ Jiang Ming was starting to have a migraine just thinking of it.
Lord God Space, Reincarnation Hall, the organization Dongfang Chenxi had mentioned, the Supreme Pagoda, and even the System he had.
Gosh! This was more than a mess, it was just chaos!
At that very moment, Jiang Ming came out of his subconscious, flew up into the air, and looked toward the west.
‘The heaven and earth laws were trembling, creating waves of terrifying invisible aura, instantly sensible by those who comprehended laws.
‘The laws were vibrating so vigorously as if the whole world was about to come down.
‘How could such a change happen? Jiang Ming was greatly shocked. He then saw a golden ray of light bursting out from the western sky, engulfing the entire Eastern Region.
Millions of golden rays took over the entire half of the western sky.
‘Could it be that the Fo Sect has put their plans in motion?’ As Jiang Ming pondered to himself, he noticed the golden rays of light started to accumulate and slowly formed a giant million-foot tall Buddha overlooking the western land. Boundless Fo fluctuations were spread out and even reached Eastern
Region.
Jiang Ming also noticed that there were places throughout the world that had rays of light emitting from below, blocking the Fo fluctuation outside.
“What’s going on?” Zi Linglong, who was cultivating in seclusion, was startled. She leaped over beside Jiang Ming and looked west. She couldn’t help but be surprised and muttered, “Is… Is this the Fo Sect’s ultimate card?”
“This should be it,” Jiang Ming replied after deep thoughts. “The Fo Sect has been rooted over a territory here for the past hundreds of millions of years. How deep could their accumulation have been after so long? Take Eastern Region, for example, the Qingyun Sect was the only one that stood strong, yet
if the rest of the forces band up against the sect, they could probably make it. As for Western Region, most of them are Buddhist believers. How can such a terrifying Sacred Land be easily taken over by the devil sects?
“This is a scheme!
“What’s even more special is that the Fo Sect is good at accumulating the power of faith. How much faith have they accumulated over hundreds of millions of years? I’m afraid the whole Western Region should be the manifestation of this faith power.
“Nowy, it seems that the Fo Sect’s plan was very simple, which was to take the initiative to give up the sect and allow the five devil sects to have a taste of success. They were trying to trick the devil sects into thinking they were no match for them. If not, why would they give up the inheritance to their
Sacred Land?
“Devils living in the lands of the Buddha are truly terrifying, It’s akin to an enormous cage, a great place of danger.
“The Fo Sect is thinking of using the power of faith to fight with the five devil sects and take them all down in one go. If all these devils were to be enlightened, that would mean
“Such a great move! Such a wild ambition!
“They are placing not only the Sacred Land or billions of years of faith but also the ancient inheritance as a gamble! Once they emerge victorious, they will have enough to take over the world truly.”
The more Jiang Ming analyzed the whole ordeal, the more shocked he got, and the more he admired the Fo Sect’s courage.
“The Fo Sect’s ultimate goal is to take over the whole world?” Five Elemental Linglong’s eyes gleamed as she was shocked upon listening to Jiang Ming’s deduction.
“I’s obvious that their goal is the entire world. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have to go through all this trouble merely defeating the five devil sects.” Jiang Ming sighed.
‘The great Buddha of the West started to merge with the golden lights forming a single entity, one that wasn’t visible to the eyes of the commoners.
Yet, the two of them could clearly see the enormous Buddha opening his mouth and uttering, forming waves and waves of enlightening illuminance that guided beings to enter the reincarnation cycle.
Experts started to burst out with monstrous amounts of devilish power, trying to defy and resist the luminance but were quickly smothered by the golden rays of light.
“This is fueled by the power of faith accumulated over hundreds of millions of years! I’m afraid this accumulated faith power will be totally exhausted whether they succeed or fail. The Fo Master of this generation is really an amicable person!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
Not only did it surprise Jiang Ming, but the Holy Lords over the world, Extreme Path experts, and even the Imminent Immortal Great Monarch all gasped when they looked toward the west, inexplicably shocked at what transpired.
At the Qingyun Sect.
“The five devil sects are finished. Or rather, the whole Six Path of the Sky Devil is doomed! Who would’ve thought that the arrogant and domineering devil sects who seemed to have everything planned out would end up being the clown, schemed to the grave by the Fo Sect.” Qing Fengzi sighed.
Holy Lord Ming Yuzi frowned and muttered, “The Fo Sect is really terrifying indeed. From the strength that they’ve portrayed, they shouldn’t have abandoned their sect at all, yet they did. Was it all just to annihilate the devil sects? Or rather, to enlighten them? Depleting endless streams of faith power,
countless deaths, and carnage the devil sects unleashed… all of these just to enlighten them?”
“This is not just a simple act of enlightening them! The Fo Sect’s wild ambition is now clearly visible to the whole world!” Qing Fengzi could not help sneering. “We’ll see if those Scared Lands in Zhong Province can still sit still through all these. They didn’t bat an eye when the devil sects brought chaos
into the world, but what if it’s now the Fo Sect then? Now they are the real impending enemy!”
“Is the world turing upside down again? If they really manage to enlighten the devil sects completely, I fear the Fo Sect will start off by coming over to Eastern Region. After all, the forces here are already few. When the time comes, what can anyone do?” Ming Yuzi sighed.
Qing Fengzi remained silent.
Meanwhile
Old Tie of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion and Liu Changkong of the Tianyuan School, had solemn looks on their faces.
In Western Region, millions of the devil sects’ disciples were growling at the skies, unleashing waves and waves of destructive special abilities at the Fo Sect’s golden lights but to no avail. They were unable to shake the incomparably thick curtains of the fiery faith.
One of them, a man with a pair of blood-colored engraved horns, roared at the sky, “We schemed the entire world and made it as though we were targeting Eastern Region, and yet were actually aiming for the west! With a single war dictating our success, we’ve killed countless Fo disciples and chased off
the Fo Sect, thinking that our success was set in stone. Even though we’ve known that there’s boundless power of faith in the world, we planned to turn over the Buddhas into devils, and that victory is surely ours! We even had ways to deal with the power of faith, but who knew that we were one step
behind?
“Someone once said, ‘The devil is the Buddha’s anger, running rampant; the Buddha is the devil’s heart, sinister and malevolent.’ But now I know how true this saying really is!
“You Fo Sect burned up your beliefs just to turn devils into Buddhists, rending the world into a true Buddhist nation!
“Such cruelty!
“Everyone! The situation is dire now, so let’s just kill everything!”
He, who was the Supreme Elder of the Xiuluomo Sect, roared toward the heavens, burning through the demon blood in his body as his aura started to rise, reaching a certain peak.
He brandished an Immortal Weapon and launched his attack at the enormous Buddha figure.
‘Waves and waves of demonic flames crashed through Western Region’s heaven and earth yet were ultimately suppressed by the luminance of the Buddha.
A great war erupted, shattering the skies.
The Xiuluo Supreme Elder finally fell with a loud bang, as his aura quickly declined.
‘As he looked around, extreme sadness and angst were boiling, for he could see the devil sects’ disciples getting killed one after another and, if not, transcended into the next realm. When he sensed his body’s injury, his face slowly turned into a mocking smile.
“What’s done is done. Once we lose this battle, it will be difficult for our devil sect to emerge once again in the future. Very difficult indeed! Well, if that’s the case, then…” His face suddenly turned bloodshot ruthless, and he reached out, grabbing in between his eyebrows. A token was ripped out of his
Primal Spirit. “Now that you’ve ignited and are burning through the power of faith, you’ve lost your strongest defense! Oh! Intending to destroy us devil sects? I’ll bring down catastrophe to your Fo Sect in return!”
The Xiuluo Supreme Leader opened his mouth and spat a mouthful of spiritual blood essence onto the token..

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - Foreign In
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Foreign In
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the land of the extreme north, where ice-cold snow blanketed the land all year round with chilling wind blowing through like blades, it was difficult for even those of the Core Formation Realm to survive.
The land was extremely barren. Only a few cultivators followed the path of the Frost Dao that ever stepped foot here to open up caves and practice their year-round cultivation there. Even so, gazing through thousands of miles, not a single human figure could be seen.
Beneath a 10,000-foot-high iceberg, a hidden space was opened up inside. There was a 100-meter round pool filled with blood that was engraved with complex engravings and inscriptions in it. The evil energy that was oozing out of the pool slowly accumulated and materialized into matter.
The blood never coagulated under the extremely cold temperature, nor was it frozen, but it stayed completely in liquid form.
There were a total of 81 crystal coffins, and each of them had a corpse in it. Through some method, absurdly terrifying power was sealed in each of these corpses, and even chains of orders were pinning them down.
At that moment, rays of light bloomed as the blood started to ripple into the skies. Waves of terrifying aura were released into the air, completely drowning the cavern.
The rippling blood continued vibrating as lines and lines of runes could be seen flowing out of it.
At the same time, the 81 crystal coffins were suddenly engulfed in flames, forming rays of bright light as they beamed into the blood pool. Blood red lines could be seen trickling out on the cavern walls.
The whole place turned into an incomparably terrifying land of evil in an instant.
It didn’t take long before the corpses in the crystal coffins, and the accumulated pool of blood disappeared completely, accumulating into a portal.
The portal was bloodshot red, emitting a terrifyingly bad omen.
After a short while, an extremely ugly creature with two heads on its shoulders emerged from the portal, its body radiating a suffocating aura of the evil spirits. It was followed by another skeleton being, whose bones were of a dark tint of gold, suppressing terrifying power in them.
“This really is another world, a whole new world! I smell the smell of human flesh, such wonderful blood, and such alluring souls! Motoro! My soul is howling, and my bones are trembling! I can hardly contain myself from going on a killing spree already!”
“No hurry! According to the legends, the ancient county kings left a legacy over here and also left the coordinates to this place, awaiting the right person to inherit their legacies. Once the place of inheritance is opened, that will be our cue to start this feast of flesh and blood. Stand down and wait for
orders. We need to wait for more people to arrive.”
“Alright, you wait here. I’ll go and inform them!
“Hurry!”
At Chuyang Peak
Standing in the sky on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming felt the roaring wind ravaging from the west. He glanced over, spanning tens of thousands of miles away, with his divine eyes and had a general glance of the situation there.
“Even an Imminent Immortal expert equipped with immoral weapons stood no chance against the Buddha formed by the boundless faith power. The Fo Sect is worthy of being the sect with the most hidden secrets, planning to eradicate the Six Paths of the Sky Devil directly completely.” Jiang Ming was
astonished.
In his eyes, among the many disciples of the devil sects, a portion of them was completely disintegrated under the Buddha’s luminance. Some were enlightened, while other big portions of them were turned from devils to saints.
This kind of enlightenment completely distorted a person’s mind and will, turning them into the most devout follower of Buddha. Even the devilish aura and power in their bodies were swiftly converted into the power of Buddha. It was truly mysterious and mind-boggling.
Only those experts of the Primal Spirit were still left standing, These disciples would either end up dead or enlightened if this went on. There were no other possibilities left.
“Exhausting every bit of their resources just to enlighten the devil sects. Although the cost was enormous, they were able to take over the devil sects’ resources, so it seems to be a fair trade. No, it should be a huge profit!”
At that very moment, Jiang Ming saw three Buddhist monks launching their attack on an Imminent Immortal devil disciple. Under the suppression of the great Buddha, the three easily enlightened their opponent. That Imminent Immortal expert did not even have the chance to self-destruct.
Jiang Ming’s eyes were locked onto a cultivator who was smacked down from the sky by the great Buddha. When he saw that cultivator taking out a relic, for some reason, it made him feel uneasy.
He quickly opened up the Human Path Records to look up this person’s information.
Name: Luo Batian
Race: Xiuluo Clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Imminent Immortal Realm
Background: Supreme Elder of the Xiuluomo Sect
Relationship: 0
Innate Ability: Immortal (Body of Shura)
Status: Originally of the human race, he had the blood of Asura flowing through his veins. He joined the Xiuluomo Sect and cultivated the techniques of the devils. He obtained great encounters that allowed him to reverse-engineer his body into the body of Shura, cleansing away the bones and blood of
the human race and ending his journey as a human.
With an incomparably strong aptitude, he fought his way and became the Holy Son of the Xiulomo Sect. He had wild ambitions to unite the six great devil sects and arranged his illegitimate son, Luo Shali, into the Yinmo Sect. Luo Shali became the Holy Son of the Yinmo Sect and later became the Sect
Master. He was at the Imminent Immortal Realm when Jiang Ming killed him.
‘When he became the Sect Master, he secretly killed off countless experts, preparing a god-defying formation to turn his Shura body into the monstrous Asura Demon Body.
He knew of the great secret that the six great devil sects were established by a few Sky Devils who descended into this realm tens of thousands of years ago. These six great devil sects slowly turned into the Sky Devil Sect. These original founders left a great formation onto the coordinate of the realm that
would be activated when an Immortal God descended or if the devil sects were about to be annihilated.
‘When he stepped into the Imminent Immortal Realm, he got the news that the great formation was ready and prepared a blood pool, collecting 81 corpses of the Extreme Path Realm tens of thousands of years ago. These corpses were sealed with boundless energy, ready to be evoked at any time.
Only the Imminent Immortal experts of the devil sects knew his secret.
After countless planning and scheming, he got ahold of the relic that could evoke the great formation and discovered its exact location. He also speculated that there must be a huge secret hidden in this Qianyuan Continent. After countless investigations with no results, he made plans to scheme and
collect the books from various Sacred Lands to uncover more.
Feeling that the time was ripe, he took the opportunity of the Yinmo Sect’s plan to take over Eastern Region and invited Long Yuan and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union into the alliance as a cover to secretly take down the Fo Sect in Western Region. He planned on using the power of faith the Fo
Sect had accumulated over the hundreds of millions of years to forge his Asura Demon Body, allowing him to reach a realm that was never attained by anyone before. Even when he was enlightened, he wouldn’t be just a small fry over there.
Unexpectedly, he fell into the traps of the Fo Sect like a tiger waltzing into a cage. It was even more unexpected when he discovered that the Fo Sect could burn through the boundless power of faith to form a Great Buddha that could enlighten anything and everything, It really caused his plans to fall
through completely.
He also understood that once he was enlightened, he would no longer be himself but merely a puppet to be manipulated by others. Yet, if he didn’t want to be enlightened, it would only mean death. Since he was dying anyway, he planned to drag the whole world down with him and used the relic to
activate the great formation without hesitation.
As the gates open, chaos follows.
Upon reading his Status, Jiang Ming was shocked to think that the six devil sects had such a hidden last card.
In the past, Jiang Ming had also killed a devil expert who was possessed by the Demon King’s Spiritual Mind seed. He was now certain that the devil sects originated from the inheritance of beings from an even higher realm. Perhaps that was also why it was impossible to eradicate these devil sects
completely.
‘Unfortunately, the location of this formation is not stated in the Status…’ Jiang Ming sighed helplessly.
If he knew where the coordinate was, he could still rush over to destroy it. Even if there were devil experts who crossed over from another world, he could just kill them all. Yet, he had no idea where the place was, so there was nothing he could do.
Jiang Ming continued looking through the Status of a few other Imminent Immortal experts, but none of them knew about it.
At this point, Luo Batian had already burned himself to death as all the threads of karma completely disappeared.
“Senior Brother, anything wrong?” Five Elemental Linglong, who was snuggled around him, asked.
“Great catastrophe is coming down on our world,” Jiang Ming simply explained.
He felt a little admiration for Luo Batian. This person had had the body of a human-devil but managed to remove flesh and blood of his human side, reverse-engineered into the body of Shura, and later improved to become the Asura Demon body.
Putting those aside, he had become the Holy Son of the Xiuluomo Sect and even placed his illegitimate son into the Yinmo Sect.
The result?
Both father and son had become Holy Sons and later the Sect Masters and finally Imminent Immortal Supreme Elders.
This was not just exceptional. This was absurdly superb!
Jiang Ming even thought to himself that if it were not for him, this father and son duo might have been able to unite the six devil sects and revive the glory of the Sky Devil Sect.
The Yinmo Sect wouldn’t have been destroyed if it weren’t for him. With how the current situation had unfolded, Luo Shali could have simply led the experts of the Yinmo Sect over, promising them great benefits with inspiring speeches to form an alliance with Long Yuan and the Submerged Dragon
Immortal Union to launch their attacks on Western Region. He could have rescued the five devil sects and even completely damaged the Fo Sect.
“Senior Brother, what kind of catastrophe?” Linglong asked.
“Foreign devils induced catastrophe,” answered Jiang Ming
“Devil catastrophe?” Linglong’s pupil shrank as she looked over to the west. She thought for a moment, and there was a flash of a wry smile on her face.
‘What’s coming really came eventually, just that it was too early this time.
Fortunately, the Senior Brother in this life had obtained who knew what kind of immortal encounters and was now very overwhelming. Maybe he would be safe and sound this time.
Jiang Ming did not notice anything unusual about Linglong as he hugged her and jumped down.
Xi Yao had already come over to the rooftop when she saw the two land near her and quickly asked, “Brother Jiang, what’s going on?”
“Foreign devils induced catastrophe,” Jiang Ming said solemnly. “You should send news back to your sect. Just say that devil sects have been destroyed, but it opened a portal that connects us to the demons outside our realm. I think they’ve already descended. Let the Riyue Sect inform the other Sacred
Lands to be prepared and look out for the portal’s location.”
“Portal? Foreign devils induced catastrophe!?” Xi Yao’s face changed rapidly, “Brother Jiang, is this piece of news accurate?”
“Yes, it is!”
“But… But no one will believe me when I pass back such a piece of news!”
“Just tell them that the person looking over Linglong was the one who got the news. Spread the news! If they don’t believe, then so be it!”
“Alright!” Xi Yao smiled bitterly. Without turning over her back against the two, she took out a mirror and started writing the news using her consciousness as a pen, sending the news back to the Riyue Sect..

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - Reincarnation Hall Releasing Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Reincarnation Hall Releasing Mission
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The drastic changes in Western Region shocked the world
No one would have thought that the Fo Sect would lay out such a plan and have such courage to go through with it.
Hundreds and millions of years of accumulation all burned out in one go, but it completely destroyed the five devil sects. However, what was even more unexpected was that this was only the beginning of a great catastrophe.
Xi Yao stayed back at Chuyang Peak.
To put it in her own words: there would not be a difference whether she was there or not in such a big catastrophe. She might as well stay there and continue training and improving her cultivation in preparation for the future.
“Foreign devils induced catastrophe. Simply thinking about this brings chills to the core of my heart!” Xi Yao was still unable to calm herself down. She looked over to Jiang Ming and asked, “Will you participate in this?”
Zi Linglong looked over at Jiang Ming as well, waiting for an answer.
Jiang Ming was already lying on the rattan chair with his eyes still gazing at the far west. He gently shook his head and muttered, “It’s just like what you’ve said. There’s not much of a difference whether I’m there or not. If I’m there, the catastrophe will take place; yet without my presence, the catastrophe
will still take place.
“Twill naturally take action if these foreign devils come over to Eastern Region, into Qing Province. As for the others? Let’s just see what happens. After all, there are so many Sacred Lands there that have been plundering the world’s wealth. It’s high time they give their contribution.”
“What you said makes sense, I guess!” Xi Yao smiled wryly.
At that very moment, the sound of the bell echoed.
The 81 instances of the might bell evoked the power of order, spreading through the entire world.
“This is the Immortal Bell!” Jiang Ming judged immediately, as his face turned solemn, “The ringing came from Zhong Province.”
“The Zhong Province’s Immortal Bell?” Xi Yao’s eyes flickered as she continued. “I remember there was a legend that said, once the world faces a great catastrophe, the Tianyuan School will ring the bell to warn the world of what had happened. The Tianyuan School might have noticed the catastrophe
already. After all, it is the oldest force still existing with the best deduction Dao and supervision methods.”
“When the bell rings, it should also mean to gather the various Sacred Lands, right?” Linglong asked.
“It should!” Xi Yao kept silent after she answered.
The mountain wind howled, repeating yesterday’s monotony.
Jiang Ming simply took out a book and read in silence. He did not care much about the drastic changes in Western Region or the invasion of the foreign devils.
The world was in turmoil, but hadn’t it been like this for hundreds of millions of years?
His biggest concern now was that the 10-year duration was approaching.
He didn’t know what benefits he would be reaping, but it was definitely worth looking forward to.
There were also the beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall, and he wondered if they would descend.
His inner world was evolving rapidly, but he still needed a long time before it was complete.
Linglong was quietly squatting beside Jiang Ming, whereas Xi Yao gazed afar with a slight frown.
‘When the night fell, the great Buddha from the west disappeared, and nothing happened after.
Jiang Ming closed the book and stood up to ask, “Girl, what do you think is the difference whether I involve myself with the catastrophe?”
Linglong was stunned at first but quickly understood what he meant. She couldn’t help smiling and said, “Senior Brother, how long has this world existed? 10,000 years, 100,000 years, 10,000,000 years, 100,000,000 years? How many disasters have occurred during this period? The world still came
through as it is.”
“But it’s different this time. After all, this is a foreign devils’ induced catastrophe.”
“What about that year? When the Sky Devil Sect emerged, wasn’t that an invasion by foreign devils? And the result? The world continues as it is to this day. Those ancient Sacred Lands surely know the origin of the devil sects. Since they knew about it all along, why were they still not eradicated? Well, 1
think they have the confidence for it. What confidence, you might ask? That would be the generations and generations of ancestors who have ascended into the higher realms! If the foreign devils really descend into our world, how can the Immortal Spirits behind the Sacred Lands ignore them?”
“Can the Sacred Lands contact those Immortal Spirits that have already ascended?”
“This is just my guess. Who knows? Senior Brother, the world will not be changed by one person.”
No, it was about changing the tide.
“Alas, I still don’t possess a normal perspective and calm heart!” Jiang Ming sighed.
During the Great Eastern War, whether it was because of his weakness or maybe because of a lack of intuitive feeling toward it, Jiang Ming had not participated in the ordeal.
But after seeing all the misery that had happened in Eastern Region, his heart had been restless, surging with great anger. It was only then that he had wiped out the entire Yinmo Sect overnight.
“TIl go prepare for dinner!” Jiang Ming took kitchen tools and started operating.
“Senior Brother, I’ll help you! Linglong walked over as well.
“Til help out as well.” Xi Yao didn’t want to be idle either.
Right now, being idle was kind of like torture.
At the Qingyun Sect.
“The Holy Lord of Riyue Sect just sent over the news, informing us about the foreign devils’ invasion. I didn’t dare to believe it, but how long has it been since the warning bell rang!” Holy Lord Ming Yuzi sighed. “You won’t even have to guess to know. The devil sects were going to be destroyed, so they
evoked their last resort, risking everything to bring over devils from foreign realms to drag the living down with them. What the Fo Sect did was too extreme, leaving no chances to the devil sects. That led to this situation.”
“Yes, the Fo Sect was too extreme. Did they really want the devil sects’ wealth, or did they discover something?” Qing Fengzi frowned and continued. “Whatever it is, the great catastrophe is coming, and we should just be prepared.”
Ming Yuzi smiled bitterly as he spoke. “It has not been long since the Great Eastern War ended, and the sect suffered severe damage. If there’s another devil-induced catastrophe like this befalling us, can we still resist them? We don’t even know where these foreign devils descended from.”
“Just wait. I’ll go over to the Tianyuan school for a bit,” Qing Fengzi muttered as he left the scene.
Ming Yuzi started to gather all the disciples who were out in the world to get into a defensive state.
‘The 18th Prince, who had come over to the Qingyun Sect as a guest, was in a daze.
He originally wanted to cause trouble for the Jiuyang Sect and had almost hit the rocks himself. Before he could even take the next step, he overheard the bell ringing from the Tianyuan School and also got news about the impending devil catastrophe.
“Let’s return!” Cang Yun advised, “Even if we don’t know what is happening, through the looks of the Qingyun Sect’s reaction and also the calling by the great dynasty, it seems to be an indication that it is a big problem this time around. It’s only safer if we return.”
“Do I really need to go back in despair?” Zhou Tian’s face was filled with unwillingness. “Once I go back, I will still be suppressed and unknown to anyone. Can I only continue watching them dance around like that? I cannot accept this! We are not going back this time! This great catastrophe also means
great encounters!”
Cang Yun frowned and asked, “What can we use to get through this catastrophe? What can we use to get great encounters?”
“We have the Sacred Lands to deal with this great catastrophe. As for encounters? Well, this great catastrophe is our chance to take control and take over domains and manage our own forces!” Zhou Tian couldn’t help showing his joy as he thought of the benefits he could reap.
Cang Yun looked at the 18th Prince as if he was looking at an idiot.
‘To hell with great encounters! This is courting death! If I cannot persuade him then I’m not serving anymore! he cursed in his heart.
1
In the lands of the extreme north, the whole area was shrouded by a devilish soldier, not allowing any aura from leaking into the outside worlds.
One by one, the devils got out of the portal, crowded together, waiting for the order to go out into the human world to kill and devour flesh and blood.
Inacertain space, there stood a palace that looked atmospheric and grand. It had been floating and skinning through the endless chaotic torrent for who knew how many billion years.
There were many creatures of different skin color and race in the main hall of one of the levels in the palace, either chatting or fighting around.
suddenly, an empowering voice rang through the entire main hall.
“Attention to all the beneficiaries! A B-grade public mission about exploring a sect of a perfect planar world is now being released. Once the mission is accepted, you will have to complete at least 80% exploration of the sect, or else you will not be allowed to forcefully return here. After accepting the
mission, we will then impart detailed information about the mission.
“Reminder: The Sky Dragon Team and Black Tiger Team have been wiped out one after another.
“Tips: A maximum of 10 teams are allowed to go..”

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - Combat Mannequins
chapters.content:
Chapter 159 Combat Mannequins
Inside the council chamber of the Tianyuan School…
Several Supreme Elders from different Sacred Lands, including the one from the Fo Sect, had gathered up here.
In normal times, everyone treated the Tianyuan School as if it was invisible. However, when an order was issued concerning the safety of the world, no Sacred Lands would dare not to come.
“Everyone!” Liu Changkong said after everyone had taken their seats. He glanced across the crowd with a serious face and said, “The Tianxin Bell is a divine tool created from the universe. It has the ability to communicate with the origin of the world, but today, it chimed 81 times by itself, and this foretells a cataclysmic event that will destroy the world is going to happen. Before this, Venerable Fanxing from the Riyue Sect sent a message to us. According to the message, the devil sects have been eliminated, but a portal has appeared, and devils from other dimensions are coming.
“The reason we summoned you all here is to inform you of the gravity of the situation.
“At the same time, we also want to ask if any of you know the portal’s location so that we can destroy it as soon as possible. If not, things will worsen when the devil army arrives. The world will be destroyed, and our land will be trampled on.”
Liu Changkong’s voice was deep and serious.
However, none of them replied to him as they all did not know about it.
Toward the end of the meeting, they came to three conclusions:
Look for the location of the portal.
Prepare for the war.
The Tianyuan School would act as the center of connection.
Each Sacred Land issued orders to its affiliated forces on the same day.
Many experts were patrolling around the land as well to look for the portal, but they could not find anything.
At the Jiuyang Sect…
The people here were oblivious to the catastrophe that was about to befall them.
After burying all of the disciples that had died during the war and fixing the mountain gate, they dispatched many disciples into different locations in Qing Province to take over the properties of the families or clans that had gotten massacred and to bring all parties under their actual control.
Disciples from different peaks were dispatched except Chuyang Peak’s.
As for Zhiyang Peak, the First Seat had been killed, and most of the disciples had been removed from the sect, leaving only a few of them behind.
The Sect Master had no idea what he should do with Zhiyang Peak. None of the remaining disciples were good enough to lead Zhiyang Peak. In the end, the Sect Master governed over Zhiyang Peak temporarily while he looked for a member to take over from him in the future.
The Jiuyang Sect was busy, while Jiang Ming was as free as he used to be. Today, the Great Zhou Calendar 20th October 9,999. It marked the tenth year since the system had awakened.
“One more month!”
While Jiang Ming was reading a book, he kept his eyes on the watch.
He did not have to cultivate anymore.
The inner world would evolve by itself, so he hardly needed to do anything. That being said, he was still able to speed up the process by splitting his mind and integrating it into the inner world.
As for special abilities?
He did not need any of them anymore as he had too many of them right now.
“Winter is so boring without the howling wind and falling snow,” Jiang Ming commented as he closed the book. He looked skyward and let out a sigh.
The weather was basically the same for all four seasons.
It was nice, but it was a bit dull.
Not far away from him, Xi Yao was playing Weiqi with Five Elemental Linglong.
“Xi Yao!” Jiang Ming shouted.
“Yeah?” Xi Yao replied without lifting her head. She was playing with a white stone between her fingers, pouting. “The location of the portal hasn’t been found
yet?”
“Nope. All Sacred Lands, including Long Yuan and the Submerged Dragon Continent, are looking for it, yet none of them has found anything. I suspect that the portal must have been sealed as soon as it emerged. Once it appears again, I’m afraid that our world will be in big trouble.”
“Will there be experts even stronger than Imminent Immortal experts?”
“I doubt so. According to the ancient records of the Sacred Land, if a being more powerful than an Imminent Immortal expert appears, the sky will change.”
“Then there’s nothing to worry about,” Jiang Ming said as he rose to his feet.
He looked toward the north, and a serious expression dawned upon his face.
“What’s wrong, Senior Brother? Did you find anything?”
“Have you noticed anything, Brother Jiang?”
Linglong and Xi Yao stood up at the same time and looked toward the north.
“They’re here!”
Jiang Ming had noticed a dense amount of evil energy spreading from the land in the far north. It was so thick that it enveloped the entire sky and was rapidly moving toward the south.
At the same time, there was also a strange, terrifying aura in the air, and it sent a chill down his spine.
In the far north, tall figures appeared on the horizon one after another. They stopped the wind and caused the ice plain to collapse.
“How terrifying!” Xi Yao’s expression changed.
“Will they keep on coming?” Jiang Ming asked. “I’m not sure about that either,” Xi Yao replied, offering him a bitter smile. An idea popped up in Jiang Ming’s head, and he entered the Supreme Chat Room.
(Jiang Ming: An interdimensional portal has appeared in my world, and we’re under attack by the army from another dimension. What I want to know is, will they keep on appearing through the portal?] [Ming Fei: Group admin, just let me know if you need any help. I’ll do my best to help you! If an interdimensional gateway appears, the cost is small as long as it doesn’t exceed the limit of the power the world can bear.]
[Tian Fozi: Generally speaking, crossing over the gateway is very difficult, even if there’s an interdimensional portal. However, there’s one particular situation that would be a problem if it were to occur.]
[Ming Fei: What you’re trying to say is that there has been a similar occurrence in the past? After they’ve invaded his world, they gradually incorporate the energy of the other world into the world to reduce the rejection?]
(Tian Fozi: Exactly. Group admin, have they come to your world before? Or this is the first time?]
(Jiang Ming: They’ve come to my world before. The Sky Devil appeared in our world and established the Sky Devil Sect.]
[Tian Fozi: That would be a problem! If they’ve set up a sect in your world, the rejection will be close to none when they come to your world through the portal again. If the portal has stabilized, I’m afraid more and more of them will be coming. Group admin, I have something that might be useful in driving them off. Do you need it? Oh yeah, the most important thing you need to do right now is to find the portal and destroy it. Once the portal is destroyed, it will be tough for them to create a new one.]
[Ming Fei: Group admin, I forgot to ask, is it a passage opened based on the coordinates, or is it a gate that is established directly?]
[Jiang Ming: Is there any difference between the two?]
[Ming Fei: Of course, there is! If it’s the former, it needs to be maintained at all times, and every time it transports a living being, it needs to consume a huge amount of energy. However, if it’s an interdimensional portal, it means a stable passageway has been established. It’s the same as crossing from one door to another, but the other world will reject one after crossing the gate.] (Tian Fozi: It requires a rare special item to create an interdimensional portal, not to mention that it takes a huge amount of mana to activate it. Group admin, don’t care if it’s a temporary passageway or a portal. What you should do right now is that you need to find the portal and destroy it. All of us here are ready to help.)
[Ming Fei: I have plenty of light scrolls and light divine weapons with me right now!)
[Zhan Ge: I’m ready to help.]
[Ao Jiu: Me too!]
[Zi Lei: Count me in!]
(Luo Heng: Brother Jiang, I’ve prepared a team of Level 10 spaceships. Robots pilot them so they can fly themselves!) [Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang, just let me know if you need anything!)
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang, I’ve sent a team of Level 10 Combat Mannequins to you. I’ll send you more afterward! I want to let those people know the consequences of attacking your world!)
(Jiang Ming: Thank you so much, guys!)
(Jiang Ming: Chenxi, don’t! As the group admin, if I can’t even defend against an invasion like this, I will only be bringing disgrace to you all and the Supreme Pagoda. Don’t worry. As long as there aren’t any Level 10 to Level 12 experts, I will be fine.]
[Zhan Ge: You have a point. If even our group admin can’t ward off the invasion, no one can.)
[Ming Fei: In any case, I’ll be here. Just let me know if you need any help, group admin!]
Jiang Ming returned to reality, and a smile broke across his face.
There was nothing he should be afraid of since so many people supported him.
‘Don’t give me a reason to get mad!’
Jiang Ming looked toward the land in the far north and heaved out a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - Savior and Destroyer of the World from the Lord God Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 160 Savior and Destroyer of the World from the Lord God Space
Today, the Qingyun Sect issued an order and demanded the Jiuyang Sect send their disciples to the war.
They could not disobey an order like this.
Just when the Sect Master was about to rise to the order, Jiang Ming asked Zi Linglong to stop him. He told him that they would only send an Extreme Path expert into the war. The rest of them would not join the war as they could not do anything other than add to the number of casualties.
On Taiyang Peak, the Sect Master bowed at Chuyang Peak in gratitude. Swoosh!
