The Combat Mannequin rose into the air and came to the sky above the Jiuyang Sect. At the same time, a strong burst of sword energy that reached the sky and shattered the cloud surged forth. The Combat Mannequin stood tall and flew toward the north, representing the Jiuyang Sect to join the fight.
“Senior Brother, it’s just an Extreme Path Combat Mannequin. There’s nothing it can do even if you send it there!” Five Elemental Linglong said worriedly.
Xi Yao nodded. She felt the same as well.
For a war of this scale, even an Extreme Path expert couldn’t do anything, and there was a great possibility that they would perish.
“You guys don’t need to feel sorry for it. It’s just a Combat Mannequin,” Jiang Ming said nonchalantly, his gaze dark as he looked toward the north.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records was opened.
Name: Bone 36 Races: Abyssal Devil Bone Clan
Gender: Genderless
Cultivation Base: Level 10 (Imminent Immortal Realm).
Relationship: -96
Innate Talent: Immortal
Status: Cluelessly crawling out of the underworld, he adapted to the abyssal mode of killing, devouring, and growing. He set himself the biggest goal, to become a devil ruler and rule over an area of devil land. First, he aimed to become a fighter under the Ninth Devil Lord. He did not meet the requirements since he was Level 10. Therefore, he kept hunting and growing in the bottomless abyss. He was delighted when he was summoned to join the war in the human world. For him, the human world contained a lot of opportunities. Whether it was the Blood Qi or the soul of the living, it was great nourishment.
If he could consume a lot of them, he was certain that he could ascend into Level 11. He stepped into the interdimensional portal and came to another world with the rest of the devils. The air in the world was sweet and filled with plenty of vitality. It made him feel like he had arrived at a miracle land as he could feel himself had become stronger. Unfortunately, they were sealed underground when they first arrived. They needed to wait for more of them to arrive before they could start the real hunt. Finally, the seal was lifted, and the Devil Lord’s voice rang in his ears, “My children, go forth and destroy. Turn this great human world into an abyssal devil land. When I’m born, I’ll grant you endless blessings.”
Jiang Ming fell silent. All of these devils came from the abyss, and they were under the governing of the Ninth Devil Lord. The only good news was that it was a small chiliocosm-level abyss.
Looking at his relationship, Jiang Ming was certain that he was going to slaughter everything that he saw in his path.
“I should go kill some of them and destroy the portal. If not, many people would die if more of them were to cross the portal,” Jiang Ming said.
He formed a clone with half of his mana and brought out the Celestial Soul Bell. He gave it to the clone before going away with his Human Path Records.
In the meantime, a group of people descended at various places on Zhong Province and Northern Region’s border.
There were about four to five people each time, and there were a total of 20 of them. The teams were far apart from each other.
A voice rang out in their head upon arrival. [Ding! Beneficiary of the Lord God, you’ve arrived at Tianyuan planar world. This world is currently being invaded by the devils from the abyss. Team Zephyr is on the devils’ side. I’ll now issue the A-Class mission: Destroy all Sacred Lands in this world in less than half a year and help the abyss get their victory. Five times the reward will be deducted as the penalty for not completing the task.]
(Ding! Beneficiary of the Lord God, you’ve arrived at Tianyuan planar world. This world is currently being invaded by the devils from the abyss. Team Astral will be on the guardian side. I’ll now issue the S-grade mission: Prevent invasion of the devils from the abyss. Exterminate all of them within half a year and destroy the interdimensional portal. Five times the reward will be deducted as the penalty for not completing the task.] [Ding! Attention to all beneficiaries of the Lord God, this mission is sanguine adversarial mode. Hunt and kill the opponent’s beneficiaries to get the sanguine key and the opponent’s items. There will be no rewards for killing people on the same side. Note: The number of remaining personnel on both parties is visible now.]
Team Astral’s members looked at each other in dismay.
They did not know how they should protect a world that was facing an invasion of the devil army through an interdimensional gate.
“Cap, what should we do? It’s an S-grade mission. We’re definitely going to die!”
“Well, it isn’t totally hopeless yet. The first thing we should do right now is to look for other team members. Then, we’ll get some information from the people here to find out everything about this world before formulating any plan.”
“That’s the only way now!”
There were 12 of them. The weakest of them was a Level 8 expert, while most of them ranged from Level 9 to Level 10. However, all of them were worried.
On the other side, Team Zephyr seemed rather happy with their assignment.
“We need to team up with the devils? How are we going to do that? Those are real devils. I’m afraid they’ll eat us as soon as we show ourselves in front of them. What should we do, Cap?”
“Haha, don’t worry! I’ve just found out through a special item that our opponent’s defensive mission is S-grade, so what does that mean? It means that their task is almost impossible to accomplish, and relatively speaking, our task is much easier.”
“An S-grade mission? D*mn, they’re so unlucky. There’s no way they can finish the mission. Haha, I can rest assured now. There’s nothing to be afraid of as long as our opponent’s mission is even more difficult than ours. Cap, tell us what we need to do.”
“Honestly, there’s nothing we can do. Although we should team up with the devils, I’m sure they don’t like us, so we aren’t going to get in touch with them! Right now, we just need to rendezvous with the rest of the members. Then, we’ll follow behind the devil army. I’m sure we’ll be able to get a lot of special abilities or divine weapons!”
The members of Team Zephyr were excited.
Suddenly, they looked toward the north simultaneously, and a surprised expression dawned upon their faces.
There was a man on top of Bone 36. He had a bell above him, and he was emitting a divine light.
At that moment, even the snow and the wind had stopped. That person was none other than Jiang Ming’s clone.
Bone 36 jerked his head up and could sense a chill down his spine
He was very close to Jiang Ming, so he knew better than anyone else how powerful the man in front of him was. He was certain that he could easily kill him in one strike. The rest of the devils also looked toward Jiang Ming’s clone.
At the same time, the clone scanned across the area. It seemed to him that there were at least a million devils, and most of them were above the Dao Seed Realm.
If he let such a force swarm into the rest of the world, the danger it would bring would be absolutely incalculable.
Without hesitation, the clone poured 80% of his mana into the Level 11 Celestial Soul Bell and activated this immortal weapon.
Dong!
When the bell rang, it set off a storm that swept across the souls of the beings in this place.
“D*mn it!” Bone 36 shouted, and before he could do anything, his soul was destroyed. His body crumbled away, and he was dead.
With him as the center, many devils fell down, and their souls perished.
In the blink of an eye, most of the devils were killed. Even if some of them could survive the attack, their souls were heavily damaged.
The clone narrowed his eyes and looked at the interdimensional portal below the ice mountain. He lifted his finger and activated the Return of Infinite Law Finger.
The attack pierced through the ice plain, shattered the mountain, and went straight into the portal, causing the portal to get blasted while the devils coming out of it were killed.
An angry voice could be heard coming from inside, but unfortunately, the interdimensional portal had crumbled away.
The clone heaved out a sigh of relief and flew up high into the sky.
He rang the bell as he said, “I’ve killed 90% of the devils as well as destroyed the interdimensional portal. I’ll leave the remaining devils in your hands. Tianyuan School, Sacred Lands, if any of the devils get out of Northern Region, I’ll come and destroy your lands, just like how I got rid of the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and Submerged Dragon Immortal Union.”
After he finished speaking, the clone looked into the distance. A strange expression appeared on his face before he vanished into thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - Stunned
chapters.content:
Chapter 161 Stunned
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Northern Region…
Celestial ships appeared in the sky one after another. Each of them was at least 1,000 meters long, and there were a lot of figures standing on them. They were all experts who were ready to go into the battle.
Behind the celestial ships were divine mountains and palaces. They all broke through the clouds and blotted the sun, looking just like a sea of dark clouds.
Everyone, including Liu Changkong, had serious expressions on their faces.
He knew the gravity of the situation after the opening of the interdimensional portal. Facing the invasion of the devils from another dimension, he was certain that half of the people here wouldn’t be able to return to
their homes anymore.
Suddenly, all of them felt a terrifying power from the sky in the north. They lifted their heads and were shocked by the things that happened before their eyes.
The sky was filled with an immense amount of immortal light. It shook the sky and caused the stars to tremble.
All of them then narrowed their eyes, and they saw a human figure with a celestial bell above his head in the sky above Northern Region.
“That’s an immortal weapon!” Liu Changkong shouted, “Who is he? What is he doing there?”
“I’ve seen this celestial bell before. I was nearly killed by it once!” Qing Fengzi said, and his expression changed drastically. “I’d never forget what happened back then. This celestial bell triggered the great war between
the Qingyun Sect and the Yinmo Sect, as well as the series of events that ravaged through Eastern Region.”
In the next second, the celestial bell rang, and a destructive sound echoed.
The soundwave swept across the surrounding area, reducing the group of devils into nothing but a pile of dust.
Only a handful of devils at the far end survived the attack.
After that, the ice plain cracked, and the snow mountains crumbled. The entire Northern Plains nearly disappeared before their eyes, startling Liu Changkong and the others.
“Even an Imminent Immortal expert wouldn’t be able to unleash such a terrifying power after activating an immortal weapon. What if he’s our enemy?” Qing Fengzi asked, his face pale with fear.
“His mana reserve is far more than that of an Imminent Immortal expert. He could bring out the full power of an immortal weapon, and that attack just now was equivalent to an attack of an immortal! This is a miracle!”
Liu Changkong added.
Next, they saw the clone pointing at the ground and destroying the interdimensional portal.
“The portal has been destroyed!” Liu Changkong said, his voice thick with relief.
After all, things would become very bad if they couldn’t destroy the portal.
Afterward, the clone’s voice rang out and wafted into their ears.
Qing Fengzi and the others frowned as an exasperated expression appeared on their faces.
As people from the Sacred Lands, they had never been threatened like this before.
And that person even said that he was going to kill them?
However, they all lowered their heads in embarrassment when they recalled the earlier scene. After all, that person really had the power to destroy a Sacred Land.
“He’s helped us get rid of the biggest problem, the interdimensional portal. Now, the devils can’t enter our world through the portal anymore. Not only that, but he has killed 90% of the devils. If we can’t destroy the
rest, we should give up on becoming the guardians of the human race!” Liu Changkong said, “Today, I’ll issue an order on behalf of the Tianyuan School. If any of you don’t give your all and let the devils get away, the
Tianyuan School will hunt you down!”
Qing Fengzi and his team’s hearts sank, but there was nothing they could do other than nod.
After that, they surrounded the entire Northern Region according to the plan they had formulated in advance. They sealed the entire region, and no one could get out of it.
On the other side, the beneficiaries of the Lord God Space were stunned.
“How, how, how is that possible!?” The captain of Team Zephyr said as he looked terrified at the sky in the north.
“Isn’t this just a planar world? How could that person unleash such terrifying power? He nearly wiped out the entire devil army and destroyed the interdimensional portal in one blow! He’s even stronger than a Level 11
expert!”
“Now the mission level is at least SSS-grade, right? I don’t even know if we can survive or not, so how are we supposed to conquer this world? Since we’re with the devils, it goes without saying that the people in this
world won’t let us go away so easily? Cap, what should we do?”
“l… L…” The captain stammered, “In any case, what we should do right now is try our best to keep ourselves alive, so let’s go into hiding. After the war is finished, we’ll then see if there’s anything we can do.”
“There’s nothing we can do! Cap, going into hiding won’t do us any good. Judging from the situation, we’re mostly going to fail our mission. If we don’t earn enough points, we’ll be eliminated! I suggest we go hunt some
experts, clear some side missions, and earn some points!”
All of them panicked.
Not only them but Team Astral was stunned as well. However, after returning to their senses, they were overjoyed.
“He killed nearly 90% of the devil army all by himself? How is that possible? Could it be that I’m in illusion?”
“I’m in an illusion too!”
“It’s not an illusion. It’s real. Oh my goodness, the luck goddess is finally smiling at us this time. We haven’t even done anything yet, and our enemies are cut into half. Even the interdimensional portal has been
destroyed!”
“Long live justice!”
All of them cheered as they rushed toward the north.
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming frowned after the clone had returned.
Whoosh!
The Human Path Records was opened.
Name: Hei Yao
Race: Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation: Level 10 (Imminent Immortal)
Background: The Great Monarch of the Black-Scaled Dragon in the Redstone Planar World (Note: A beneficiary of the Lord God, a member of Team Zephyr)
elationship: 0
nnate Talent: Immortal
Status: One of the beneficiaries of the Lord God. Was forced to take on an A-grade mission: Help the invader to destroy the Sacred Lands in Tianyuan World.
He originally was a mutated black-scaled dragon. He was rejected and bullied by his clan in his early childhood. His mutated bloodline became more and more powerful after he grew up, until one day, he killed all his
clan members, leaving no one behind. His strength grew even faster after getting invited by the Lord God Space and becoming a beneficiary. However, he knew that he might die at any time, so he created a new
black-scaled dragon family to retain his bloodline.
This time, he had to team up with the devil army. There were ten teams for each party, and the strength of each party was equally matched. He was overjoyed when he heard that his opponent was given an S-grade
mission through a special item. However, his delight was short-lived. After seeing what had happened in the north, he fell into despair. He planned to go into hiding and wait for the right moment for him and his team
to strike. He was going to hunt some experts to deal with the penalty for not completing his mission.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Even the beneficiaries from the Lord God Space have arrived as well!”
Jiang Ming did not know if he should be happy or sad.
He was happy because he could get the origin essence from them after killing them, and it could speed up the evolution of his inner world. In the meantime, he was worried because he had a feeling that more and more
troubles like this would show up since the Lord God Space targeted him..

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - Just How Many Spies Are There In the Sect?
chapters.content:
Chapter 162 Just How Many Spies Are There In the Sect?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Just when Jiang Ming was about to go ahead and destroy both parties, he froze, and an amusing expression appeared on his face.
While one disciple wearing the uniform of Haoyang Peak was flying toward another peak, he kept darting glances in this direction. He was in the Core Formation Realm, and Jiang Ming could understand his action.
After all, Chuyang Peak was no longer the same as it used to be.
However, he had never seen this disciple before in the sect. Besides, Jiang Ming could see that the disciple had sealed most part of his strength away in a single glance. He was actually a Paradis expert.
“A Paradis expert?” Jiang Ming gritted his teeth.
Other than the Qingyun Sect, he couldn’t think of any other sects that had the audacity or were capable of doing this.
‘If it isn’t the Qingyun Sect, it should be the Reincarnation Hall…”
Jiang Ming sighed.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records was opened once again.
Name: Hou Renjie
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 8 (Paradis Realm)
Background: A member of the Hou Clan from Xiyi Planar World (Note: A beneficiary from the Reincarnation Hall, a member of Team Divine Flame)
Relationship: -59
Innate Talent: 10 Stars
Status: A beneficiary of the Reincarnation Hall. Received the B-grade mission: Investigate the Jiuyang Sect with team members. Ten teams worked on the same mission, and he felt it was weird. After discussing with his
team members, they decided to take on the mission as well. After arriving in this world, they found out that the Jiuyang Sect was not as simple as it seemed to be. At the same time, he learned that all of the experts that
had invaded the Jiuyang Sect were killed after the catastrophe that befell Eastern Region. After that, he was even more dumbfounded when he learned that the devil army from another dimension would invade this
world. To be on the safe side, he enslaved a disciple from the Jiuyang Sect, replaced him, and came to the Jiuyang Sect to check the situation himself. He knew everything about the Jiuyang Sect save for Chuyang Peak.
All he knew about Chuyang Peak was that there were three people and a Level 9 expert living there.
Jiang Ming frowned.
‘Ten teams? All to investigate the Jiuyang Sect? What the hell do you want, Reincarnation Hall? Are you investigating the Jiuyang Sect, or are you investigating me? Could it be that the Reincarnation Hall couldn’t learn
anything about me because of the system and the Human Path Records?”
Myriad of questions flitted across Jiang Ming’s head.
“What’s wrong, Senior Brother?” Linglong came forward and wrapped her arms around his after realizing that something was not right.
After all, they had been living together for so many years, let alone they had slept with each other on the same bed before. It went without saying that she could detect even the slightest change of expression.
“Well, a few bugs have infiltrated our sect,” Jiang Ming said as a smile blossomed on his face. “Don’t worry. It’s just a small matter.”
“Do you need me to get rid of them?”
“Nope.”
Honestly, Jiang Ming was not worried about them at all. After all, they were too weak to cause him any trouble.
That being said, to be on the safe side, he still merged some of his power into the Akasa and enveloped the entire Jiuyang Sect. Then, he was stunned.
There were 10 of them who had infiltrated the Jiuyang Sect.
When he flipped through the Human Path Records, he found something interesting.
After learning that the Jiuyang Sect was not as simple as it seemed, the captains had come to a conclusion that they would act together when they were outside while they would go separate ways to investigate the
sect while they were inside.
Jiang Ming did not know about them, but it seemed like a rather loose alliance to him.
Jiang Ming then looked into them with the Karma Dao, and to his surprise, some of their causal lines were connected together on the outside.
“Are they overestimating themselves, or are they underestimating the Jiuyang Sect?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself but chuckle.
He grabbed their causal lines, and ten Paradis experts that infiltrated the Jiuyang Sect appeared in front of him. Their mana was sealed, and they couldn’t even move a single finger.
“Senior Brother, they are…” Linglong looked at the ten people that appeared out of nowhere. She pondered for a short while before saying hesitantly, “I can sense that their aura doesn’t fit in our world. What is going
on?”
“That’s because they aren’t from our world,” Jiang Ming said after a short contemplation.
Now that the Reincarnation Hall and the Lord God Space had appeared, he assumed that more of them would show up in the future. Therefore, he decided to tell the truth to his Junior Sister so that she could prepare
herself for it.
“They aren’t from our world?” Linglong exclaimed as her heart sank.
‘What?! There is a devil army, and now there are invaders from another world? Which world do they come from? By the way, why does it seem to me that my Senior Brother already knew about it a long time ago? Sigh,
I’m getting more and more useless. I wonder if it’s a wrong decision to cultivate the Clone Dao,’ Linglong thought.
“Yeah,” Jiang Ming replied, “There is an immortal world beyond our world. However, there are countless other worlds beyond the immortal world, and these people are from there. Girl, you need to keep your eyes
open when you’re traveling outside in the future.”
“Senior Brother, are you chasing me away?” Linglong said, her eyes turning red around the rims.
“What are you talking about? There’s no way I would chase you away,” Jiang Ming said as he pinched her cheek. After that, he said, “Let me take care of them first.”
“Be careful, Senior Brother.”
“Don’t worry. They can’t harm me.”
While he was talking, Jiang Ming had been looking at the Human Path Records as well, and he found something new.
Name: Hou Renjie
Status: ‘I’ve been caught? Oh crap, the young man in front of me is Jiang Ming, the head disciple of Chuyang Peak, right? According to the information, he’s only 28 years old this year, but how could he be so strong?
‘Impossible, this is impossible. What? What did he just say? He knows that we’re from another world? But… But how did he know about that!?
‘Anyway, I should use the Dao Vessel to communicate with my team members and ask them to send the captain to save me.
‘Hold on a second! How come the message doesn’t get through? What? When did he get my Million Iridescent Mirror!?”
Hou Renjie was stunned.
Jiang Ming smiled at him as he played with the mirror he got from him with his hand.
As he studied the mirror, he nodded and thought, ‘There is a spell formation inside it, and one can communicate with their team members after activating it. It’s a pretty good artifact, but the only downside is that the
messages can’t be sent if two parties are too far apart.’
As the thought surfaced in his mind, he killed all ten people before him.
He did not care if they were good or bad people. As long as they came to the Jiuyang Sect, he regarded them as their enemies and would kill them all.
“Girl, I’ll be right back,” Jiang Ming said and disappeared into the air..

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - A Pie From the Heaven, the Final Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 163 A Pie From the Heaven, the Final Evolution
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Ata lake in the middle of the wilderness…
It was the resting spot for many of the waterfowl. Some of them came here to rest while the others were here to catch some fish to fill their bellies.
There was a palace on top of the lake. It emitted a divine light that made it look extraordinarily majestic.
There were several people around the lake. Some of them were standing in the air, while others were hiding in the clouds. There was also a group that was chatting and having a barbeque by the water. All of them
engaged in their own activity, but there was one common trait amongst them. That was, they were keeping an eye on a place very far away from them.
There were dozens of people sitting in the main hall, and the atmosphere was relatively lively.
“Guys, don’t you think our mission is a little bit too simple?”
“Simple? Yang Wei, it seems to me that you still cannot see through the appearance to perceive the essence.”
“Hah, come, Luo Feng, tell me the essence that you see.”
“We have been here for some time, so I’m sure all of us know most of the things that happened here. Let’s start with the catastrophe that befell Eastern Region. The catastrophe in Eastern Region has affected all nine
provinces. Countless sects and families were destroyed, and even the Qingyun Sect sustained a great loss. However, there’s only one sect that didn’t lose anything. That’s the Jiuyang Sect,” Luo Feng said. He was a
young man ina blue shirt, and there was a plumpy woman in his arms.
He swirled the wine and took a sip before continuing. “After the catastrophe, all the experts in the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and the Submerged Dragon Immortal Union were killed in one night.
As for how they were killed? Although we don’t have any solid proof, I think the people from the Jiuyang Sect killed them.
“Some time ago, one of the First Seats of the Jiuyang Sect was found out to be a member of the Yinmo Sect. They were attacked by many clans and families from Qing Province, as well as the entire Eastern Region. Even
the Fo Sect from Western Region also joined forces with other people to crusade against them.
However, all of them were killed, so I can assure you that it was the Jiuyang Sect’s doing.
“The Jiuyang Sect is a second-rate sect on the surface. In the past, they only had one Level 7 or otherwise known as the Primal Spirit Great Monarch called Huo Daoren. Even the Qingyun Sect thought the same way as
well. Not long after, their Sect Master, Yan Yan, ascended into the Primal Spirit Realm.
“It’s not wrong to say that the Jiuyang Sect is nothing special.
“However, all of this changed when one disciple known as Zi Linglong appeared. She awakened the phoenix bloodline, and at a very young age, she defeated many Holy Sons and Daughters from Eastern Region and
Zhong Province. Even the eldest disciple of the Tianyuan School, the most ancient force in this world, was no match for her.
“When Zi Linglong awakened her phoenix bloodline, she was just a Level 1 expert and hadn’t gotten the ability to turn herself into the phoenix yet. Generally speaking, she wouldn’t inherit any memories from her
bloodline at all. Even if she did, it would be very few, so how did she get so strong? How did she manage to defeat those Holy Sons and Daughters? It doesn’t make any sense at all.
“The only possibility is that she has a terrifyingly strong person behind her to guide her and even further enhance the strength of her bloodline. At the same time, a powerful individual appeared in the Jiuyang Sect that
had the ability to cut down many Paradis experts from the Fo Sect. I guess he should be her guardian. Based on observations from afar, we still need more information if we want to know more about them.
“Most importantly, our teams have all the information about the disciples in the Jiuyang Sect. We even have checked that Huo Daoren several times, and guess what? We have only explored 70% of the Jiuyang Sect.
“There are only three people on Chuyang Peak. Gu Hai, the First Seat, and his two disciples, Zi Linglong and Jiang Ming. There’s nothing special about Gu Hai. Zi Linglong has a lot of potential, so she’s one of the
suspects. As for Jiang Ming, according to the information we’ve gathered, Jiang Ming is only a Level 3 expert. Although he has a lot of potential as well, he’s very normal.
“Besides, the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect is staying in the back mountain. I guess she wants to exchange skills with Zi Linglong. As for Chang Yiming, well, let’s not talk about him.
“As for that Level 9 expert, he has gone to Northern Region to wipe out those devils.
“We should’ve known everything about the Jiuyang Sect by now, but why is the exploration process only at 70%? Remember, our mission is to investigate the Jiuyang Sect. As for the person behind Zi Linglong, they
aren’t in the Jiuyang Sect.
“So how are we supposed to finish the remaining 30%?
“There is only one possibility—Chuyang Peak. There must be a secret hidden there! In my opinion, we shouldn’t act so carefully anymore. We should cast all our fear away and send our people to Chuyang Peak. Or we
should all go together and demand them to tell us the secret.
“It would be best if we could eliminate Chuyang Peak. Even if Zi Linglong has someone powerful to back her up, their world is currently being invaded by a devil army, so I don’t think they will have the leisure to care
about her. Besides, if we all work together, we can even easily destroy the Jiuyang Sect. We don’t have to worry about anything, so why should we waste our time?
“After we’ve finished our mission, we can go to Northern Region. I’m certain we’ll be able to gain something from it with our strength,” Luo Feng said.
Yang Wei scoffed and replied, “You talked so much, but all of these are nothing but your speculations.”
“Hah!” Luo Feng laughed. “Didn’t I already tell you? All secrets of the Jiuyang Sect come from Chuyang Peak. We can all go together and check it out ourselves. As for the powerful being behind Zi Linglong, I doubt they
would pose a threat to us.”
“Have you forgotten that countless experts were killed that night after the catastrophe? What if it has something to do with Chuyang Peak?” An old man chimed in with a frown. “Besides, you haven’t pointed out the
most crucial thing.”
“The most crucial thing?” Luo Feng frowned. “Are you talking about the mission, Ming Hai?”
“Exactly! It’s just a scouting mission, yet it needs ten teams? This obviously isn’t normal. I can even say that this mission might be a suicide mission. There’s a huge probability that all of us will be wiped out, and now you
want us to take a more proactive approach?” Ming Hao shook his head. “It’s always not wrong to be cautious.”
Suddenly, all of their expressions changed.
“Liang Yun from our team is dead!”
“Xiao Lei too!”
All of them jerked up from their seats, and their faces were dark.
“All of them were killed?” Yang Wei said, his voice thick with disbelief. “How is this possible? Each and every single one of them excels in the art of camouflage. How is there any possibility they would be discovered and
killed at the same time? The weakest of them was a Level 8 expert. They couldn’t even last for a minute?”
“All 10 of them had kept in touch with each other as well. If any of them was discovered, they could contact each other, but all of them were killed simultaneously. Guys, do you know what this means?” Luo Feng said,
his face turning pale with each passing second.
“Oh no! Guys, we have to leave!” Ming Hai knew what Luo Feng was trying to say.
“Since they could kill them in such a short time, they could find us as well. Now, I can assure you all that the destruction of the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and the others are related to Chuyang Peak! We have to leave
now. Or else, it will be too late!”
As soon as he arrived at the entrance, he froze. He looked at the person in front of him, and his heart sank. “It’s too late!”
Bam!
As soon as Jiang Ming appeared, he enveloped the area with his World Projection and reduced all the beneficiaries on the outside into a blood mist.
He stretched his arm into the air and absorbed streams of origin essence into his inner world.
“This is great nourishment. I wouldn’t trade it even if someone gave me a medicine king!” Jiang Ming smiled.
He looked at the palace in front, and his eyes lit up.
After he killed them and absorbed their origin essence, even if it wouldn’t make much of a change to his inner world, it was better than nothing.
He summoned the Human Path Records and let it hover over his head.
“Seems like all of you are here.”
Jiang Ming smiled as he arrived at the door to the palace.
Their surroundings had been sealed away, so there was no way they could run away now.
“You’re Jiang Ming!?” The corner of Ming Hai’s lips twitched when he saw Jiang Ming. “So the person who hides most deeply in the Jiuyang Sect is not Zi Linglong but you!”
Apparently, he had gotten Jiang Ming’s portrait, so he could recognize him instantly.
“Our mission progress has reached 80%? He just shows himself, and the progress went up by 10%!?” Yang Wei’s voice reverberated throughout the hall, and his face was dark.
“You’re not even 30 years old, right? You’ve actually cultivated to such a degree, and the most frightening thing is that you’re so good at hiding that you could escape the eyes of the Qingyun Sect!” Ming Hai exclaimed.
“Jiang Ming, has Zi Linglong been your scapegoat the whole time?”
“Well, I wouldn’t use the word ‘scapegoat’. I’m just letting her develop by herself,” Jiang Ming replied. “How can I become like you guys?”
“What!?” Ming Hai’s pupils constricted. “Through invitation. Do you have someone powerful to back you up? Are you the one who destroyed the Yinmo Sect, Long Yuan, and the others?”
“Through invitation?” Jiang Ming frowned.
He knew Ming Hai understood what he was asking, but the answer he got was not the answer he wanted.
Ming Hai’s status did not mention anything either.
“Yes, it’s me. However, I don’t have anyone to back me up. I’m all by myself,” Jiang Ming replied. Then, he pointed upward and continued. “There is no other way? Is it a puppet of fairness and justice?”
“You killed all of them by yourself? Impossible!” Ming Hai exclaimed as he shook his head. “According to our investigation, some of them were Level 10 experts while the others were Level 8 and Level 9. There’s no way
you could kill them all by yourself.”
“I’ve answered your question, but you haven’t answered mine yet,” Jiang Ming said, looking coldly at him.
“Nope. There is no other way!” Ming Hai replied. He still couldn’t quite accept what he had just heard. “It’s the omnipotent God, or you can call it a program—”
He came to an abrupt stop before he could finish his sentence.
“System! Beam me back! Right now!”
Ming Hai felt that something around them prevented them from escaping, so he knew he could not wait any longer.
After all, he did not think he could go up against Jiang Ming.
[Ding! Beneficiary Ming Hai, your surroundings have been sealed by a divine item, so you can’t transfer you back here.]
“What!?”
Ming Hai’s face turned pale.
The rest of the people were stunned as well.
He forced himself to calm down and asked softly, “Can we call a truce?”
“You guys want to destroy my sect, and now you want to call a truce? Are you kidding me?” Jiang Ming scoffed.
“Please, Jiang Ming, please let us go. We didn’t want to do this either. If you can let us go, we can give you anything you want. Spiritual crystals, immortal crystals, divine crystals, medicine, artifacts… Just name it, and
we’ll give it to you!” Ming Hai said.
While he was trying to hold Jiang Ming back, he talked to the rest of the people through telepathy.
‘Wen Feng, prepare to move the palace. Guys, get yourself ready for a fight!”
“Ming Hai, you’re old,” Yang Wei said. “He’s alone, so why do you have to be so afraid of him? We’re beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall. We have gone through countless battles across many worlds in the past.
We’ve never lost hope, even in the direst situation. Ming Hai, don’t you forget about this. This is just a planar world. The strongest they could reach is Level 10, and all of us here are Level 10. With our skills, our special
abilities, and items, do you think we can’t kill him? Haha, I’m going to kill him right now!”
As soon as he finished talking, a sword that exuded an immense killing intent appeared in his hand.
While he swung his sword at Jiang Ming’s head, another person opened his mouth and threw an attack directly at Jiang Ming’s soul.
Jiang Ming lifted one finger and stopped both of their attacks. The storm of power that burst out from the collision sent Ming Hai and the other flying away.
‘Is he crazy?’
A thought appeared in Ming Hai and the others’ heads at the same time. ‘He’s trying to use his own body to stop the attack of an immortal weapon?’
Even Yang Wei was stunned.
However, what happened next sent a chill down their spines.
After all, not only did Jiang Ming appear unscathed from the attack, but the attack did not even leave a single scratch on his finger.
“This…” Yang Wei stammered. “Am… Am I dreaming?”
“Not bad,” Jiang Ming said as he threw the sword away.
He looked at his finger, and there was nothing but a scar there.
He chuckled.
Back when he was on the seventh floor of the Supreme Pagoda, he had defeated a Level 11 expert once.
After absorbing the World Heart Dongfang Chenxi had given to him, he started to grow nonstop.
He had no idea how strong he had become right now.
it seemed to him that the immortal weapon was nothing special, but he also understood that it was because Yang Wei did not bring out the full potential of the immortal weapon.
‘Even if he can use the full strength of the immortal weapon, it can’t cut through my bone. After my inner world transforms into a reality, not even a Level 11 immortal weapon will be able to harm me! Jiang Ming
thought.
“How can there be such a strong person like you in the human world?” Ming Hai said, his voice filled with admiration and fear.
Jiang Ming did not want to waste his time with them anymore. He threw a punch at them and reduced all of them into a bloody puddle.
He stepped into the palace and killed the rest of the people in there.
“The origin essence each of the 10 Imminent Immortal experts provides can speed up the evolution of my inner world for 1,000 years. How about the Extreme Path and the Paradis?”
Jiang Ming couldn’t wait any longer to test it out.
After collecting all of the loot, he did not return to Chuyang Peak. Instead, he went to Northern Region.
There were about 20 Lord God Space’s beneficiaries over there.
“My inner world will be able to turn into reality this time.”.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - World-Annihilating Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 164 World-Annihilating Mission
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming was reading quietly as he swayed his rocking chair.
The sunset hung on the mountain as the fair breeze blew. The surroundings of the pavilion had vines intertwining. Bright flowers were blooming on the vines, sending fragrance out with the breeze. It was simply tranquil and beautiful.
“At first sight, Brother Jiang, you’re a quiet and peerlessly handsome man.” Xi Yao sat in the pavilion, swaying her feet as her laces fluttered.
She looked at the person below and in front of her and sighed inexplicably. “After getting used to your look, I discovered that you’re just like an old man without any motivation and ambition. You don’t fight, nor do you
cultivate. You only enjoy your sunbath every day.”
“Isn’t it good?” Jiang Ming closed up the book in his hand, picked up the teacup beside him, and had a sip. While he was holding the teacup in his hand, he gazed into the mountain range afar and said, “No fighting, no
killing, and witness time tickling like a painting.”
After killing the Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiaries, he had also visited Northern Region to wipe out all the Lord God Space’s beneficiaries. Following that, he returned and stayed quietly at Chuyang Peak. But his internal
world was evolving quickly.
Xi Yao thought Jiang Ming was indifferent to all things. In fact, he was insanely cultivating, though he was forced to.
“But isn’t such a life too boring?” Xi Yao stepped down and lay in the air. She did not fall because she was held up by a cloud that automatically appeared out of thin air as she lay.
“What’s boring? What’s fun? Whichever you like, it’d be good?” Jiang Ming took another sip of tea before he continued. “Northern Region will stabilize soon. Aren’t you going to reap some benefits?”
“Regardless of how great the benefits are, | prefer to stay here. I can fall into the state of enlightenment easily, almost daily. There’s no other place in the world where I can do so, after all.” Xi Yao was gazing at sunset
as she spoke.
“Didn’t you say it’s boring?”
“I’m just having some emotions here when I see you staying like this every day.”
While the two were chatting, Five Elemental Linglong was pacing over through the air. She was followed by Huo Hua and the other three fairies, each holding a tray with fruits and drinks in their hands.
“There, is that you?” Xi Yao hesitated but still pointed to the north.
Jiang Ming slightly nodded.
“Can the world still accommodate you since you are this strong now?” Xi Yao was astonished.
She knew Jiang Ming was the one who had wiped out the Yinmo Sect in Eastern Region overnight. But when she learned that the one who had slaughtered the devils in Northern Region, she still felt it was unbelievable.
Millions of invaders must be entering Northern Region, yet Jiang Ming could massacre so many of them. Jiang Ming was indeed inhuman.
“I’m still an Extreme Path expert…” Jiang Ming looked odd.
Logically, his power had long exceeded the world’s limits, but his cultivation base was really low.
“This is unbelievable!” Xi Yao said as she walked to the table and fed herself with a violet pear.
“Senior Brother is the one who breaks our common sense!” Linglong sat beside Jiang Ming, delivered a peeled grape to his mouth, and saw him take it in before she started peeling another one.
“I think I know why Brother Jiang is this lazy.” Xi Yao pouted as she walked to the fence and looked at the floating clouds amid the mountains. She then said, “It’s because you are spoiling him.”
” like it, and I’m willing!” Linglong said with a smile.
Xi Yao was rendered speechless.
In the Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s space…
When an enormous screen showed the abrupt disappearance of 10 teams, it caused a commotion. It was rather outrageous when a B-grade investigating mission resulted in the total downfall of all 10 teams.
“Ding: Issuance of an SSS-grade mission: Destroy the Jiuyang Sect of Eastern Region, which is located in the Tianyuan World, a perfect planar world.
Limitation: Minimum requirement of S-rated teams, up to 10 teams, limited to one year.
Reward: Distribute according to the amount of contribution, the highest can get an Immortal Ascension Pill, Level 11 Immortal Weapon, special physique, etc., and the lowest can get a Level 10 item.”
The notification rang out three times.
Many Reincarnation beneficiaries were astounded because such an SSS-grade mission hadn’t been issued for many years already. Each time one was issued, it would be a big event.
The fall of 12 teams in total was indeed a big event.
Meanwhile, in the Lord God Space…
“Ding: All 20 teams fell in a perfect planar world just now. No one managed to return. Hence, it’s a provocation and defiance against our Lord God Space.”
“Ding: Issuing now an Unlimited-grade World-Annihilating Mission: Destroy the Tianyuan World.”
“Ding: Because of the world’s limitation itself, a maximum of 100 teams can join in. Register now, and we will start arranging based on the team’s ranking in two hours.”
A commotion was created in the Lord God Space along with the series of notifications.
Jiang Ming knew nothing about what was happening in the Heaven Reincarnation Hall and the Lord God Space. He would not care even if he knew.
He rose to his feet and stretched himself.
“Girl, what do you want to eat later?”
“Senior Brother, I want to have a hotpot!”
“Okay, I’ll prepare a few ingredients.” Jiang Ming thought for a while and vanished into thin air.
He had returned with a few ingredients floating next to him in just a short time.
“Senior Brother, what’re these? They look fresh!” Linglong was stunned.
Xi Yao walked over and said, “I know what’s this. It’s the Golden Tripe. But looking at its majestic life essence, it should be at least in the Primal Spirit Realm. Brother Jiang, where did you get it?”
“I went to Southern Region and killed a few demons,” Jiang Ming replied as he started preparing.
Xi Yao was stunned at the reply before she smiled slyly because of Jiang Ming’s act, who saw the entire world as his hunting ground.
“Is Golden Tripe tasty?” Linglong was very excited instead.
“Of course it is!” Xi Yao slurped before she continued. “In my sect’s previous celebration, we had the Golden Tripe. It was a cow demon of the Purple Mansion Realm that was killed, and it was especially delicious. It’s
just that golden cows are scarce and also mostly living in Southern Region, hence too difficult to hunt. I can’t imagine that I would be lucky enough to taste it again today, and it’s one of the Primal Spirit Realm.”
While they were talking, Jiang Ming took out a furnace and ignited it with True Samadhi Fire. He added some spices after the spiritual liquid was boiled, and immortal lights began surging.
“Taking top-grade spiritual medicine as spices and spiritual medicine as dips, this is too luxurious, I’d say!” Xi Yao was still amazed even though she had become rather used to these.
At that moment, two light streams came from afar.
“This smells so good! Ming, what good stuff are you cooking? And why didn’t you call me? You’re being too unfilial!” Gu Hai had just returned.
Beside him was the First Seat Yin Yue. She looked like she was about 30 years old. She had a glowing face and was no longer as cool as before.
“Master, Mistress, it’s just in time that the two of you got back. C’mon, have a seat, have a seat. Girl, do serve them tea first!” Jiang Ming beckoned. “Master, how can you reprove your own disciple like this when the
mistress is around?”
First Seat Yin Yue slightly blushed as she quickly diverted the topic, “Holy Daughter Xi Yao, are you comfortable staying here?”
“You’re a senior here, so just call me Xi Yao. As the cultivation location here is much better than any Sacred Land, it’s a land of opportunity to me. Moreover, I can have peculiar spiritual items as my daily meals. Look at
this Golden Tripe. It’s sourced from a Primal Spirit cow demon. And these Cinnamon and Danlan Flowers are top-grade spiritual medicine. These prawns, dragon meat, and fishes are either from Primal Spirit or Paradis
demons that I have never tried even in the Sacred Land.”
“These… Linglong, really?” First Seat Yin Yue was bewildered.
“Mistress, of course they are real!” Linglong came over to hold First Seat Yin Yue’s arm and sat beside her. “Senior Brother is a good chef. You must try his dishes later!”
“I’ve told you that Ming’s dishes are scrumptious and unique, haven’t I? Can you believe what I said now?” Gu Hai was feeling proud.
He was proud because he could raise two great disciples. His younger disciple was well-known for defeating all Sacred Lands’ geniuses, while his elder disciple, although infamous, would slaughter great demons as
food ingredients. Who else was on par with them?
“I previously thought you were boasting!” First Seat Yin Yue confessed as she was still staring at Jiang Ming with disbelief.
When Jiang Ming finished preparing, they sat around the table, enjoying the hotpot while chatting..

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - Upgraded Saint Province Dao Square, Heaven-Defying Functionality
chapters.content:
Chapter 165 Upgraded Saint Province Dao Square, Heaven-Defying Functionality
“Each bite is equivalent to a fortune. I think it’ll take more than a year just to digest this one meal!” First Seat Yin Yue got even more amazed as she took a bite. She was amazed because, at her first bite, she felt boundless life essence flow throughout her body, tempering her physique and enhancing her mana and even her spirit.
“Who’d say otherwise? Look at how this kid’s enjoying his life. I’m afraid that no one can enjoy like he does except the Sacred Lands’ Holy Lords!” Gu Hai exclaimed.
“No, it’s incomparable! My Riyue Sect’s Holy Lord may not even be able to enjoy such a great meal in 100 years.” Xi Yao shook her head in disagreement.
“Really? That’s the Holy Lord of a Sacred Land after all.” Gu Hai was surprised.
“Senior Uncle, look at what’s in here? The ingredients are either harvested from great demons or spiritual items. Who else is capable of being more luxurious than this? Even the Holy Lord would feel guilty for a long time after having some luxurious meal once every 100 years.” Xi Yao smiled slyly.
“If this is the case, am I not comparable to a Sacred Land’s Holy Lord?” Gu Hai was excited.
Jiang Ming laughed. “No, you’re greater than Holy Lords. You can enjoy it daily, but the Holy Lords can’t.”
“Yeah, you’re right!” Gu Hai stroked his beard, took a glance at First Seat Yin Yue, and put down his chopsticks. He then shifted his focus to Jiang Ming and said, “Ming, I’m the one who raised you up, right?”
“Yes, you’re the one who raised, educated, and nurtured me. Do tell directly any request of yours. Otherwise, you’ll make me panic,” said Jiang Ming.
Gu Hai could not help but laugh. Then he said in a serious manner, “If this meal is given to the sect, it will raise the sect’s strength by half a level. Ming, can you offer the sect some help?”
First Seat Yin Yue also put down her chopsticks and listened with hope.
“Master, I feel uncomfortable at your politeness. Just tell me whatever you need. Moreover, I’d help even without you requesting it. Previously, I didn’t manage to do it because I was too busy cultivating and handling those matters.
“Since you are now talking about it, and the mistress is also around, I shall make a promise now. I promise that I’ll make our sect comparable to the Sacred Lands. What do you say, is it good?” Jiang Ming said smilingly.
“Great! Tell me how you are planning to do it in detail.” Gu Hai was ecstatic.
“I plan to raise Dao fluctuations up to 10-fold, spiritual essence up to 100-fold in the sect’s estate, and give 10 types of medicinal pills, 100 types of techniques, 1,000 types of special abilities, and 10,000 pieces of Dao Vessels to the sect. What do you think?” Jiang Ming said.
“T-this… This… Ming, it’s too much, isn’t it? I only want you to help the sect out, not to make you fall into bankruptcy.” Gu Hai was stunned at Jiang Ming’s promise. Xi Yao was bewildered too. She did not know that Dao fluctuations could be raised up to 10-fold. And she was shocked by Jiang Ming’s promise to give out 1,000 types of special abilities and 10,000 pieces of Dao Vessels. But when she thought further about Jiang Ming’s achievements so far, she felt Jiang Ming’s promise was somehow acceptable. Meanwhile, First Seat Yin Yue was so stunned that she almost rose to her feet. It felt so surreal as she looked at Jiang Ming, who she thought was still a kid.
Zi Linglong remained calm, still eating quietly. She knew all these things were nothing to her Senior Brother and thought that all of them might go nuts if they were to see the spiritual field her Senior Brother had developed.
Jiang Ming laughed. “I’m a disciple of the sect. Hence I shall repay some when I’m rich, right? Master, no worries, these are nothing to me. I actually thought of giving some immortal weapons, but the strongest First Seat is only at the Primal Spirit Realm. They’re incapable of using them yet.” “You’re showing off again!” Gu Hai said. Then, he could not help but laugh. “Having such a disciple, what else can I request? Ming, shall I call the Sect Master here?”
“Nope.” Jiang Ming threw a ring to Gu Hai and said, “All things are in there. As for the spiritual essence and Dao fluctuations, I’ll arrange them in two days.”
“Great! Great!” Gu Hai laughed, and his eyes turned red.
The meal ended in a harmonious way.
“Ding: Congratulations for preparing and having a harmonious meal. Rewarding an upgraded Saint Province Dao Square.”
“The original Saint Province Dao Square covered only the peak where the host lives. The Dao fluctuation in the peak is 100 times stronger than the external area. Hence it is easier to enter the state of enlightenment and comprehend the heaven and earth’s laws. Besides, you as the host can easily suppress anyone within the Dao Square whose strength is not 100 times stronger than you yourself.”
“After the upgrade, the Dao Square will expand itself to cover the entire sect’s estate. And as the host, you are capable of adjusting the strength of Dao fluctuations and the percentage of enlightenment. No rules of heaven and earth are enforced within the Dao Square. The rest remains unchanged.”
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit as he got excited due to the reward. He was unconcerned with the expanded Dao Square, but the fact that there would be no rules of heaven and earth enforced in the Dao Square meant he would not be rejected by the world even if he went beyond the Imminent Immortal Realm, provided he stayed within the Dao Square. In other words, he could remain at Chuyang Peak as long as possible.
‘Does the system want to prepare me as a 10,000-year-old shut-in?’ Jiang Ming thought.
He then felt rather upset after his excitement. The benefits of the upgraded Saint Province Dao Square were not to his will. He thought it should have the ability to suppress people at least 1,000 times stronger than him.
After Gu Hai helped himself with enough food, he left together with First Seat Yin Yue.
While they were pacing across the air…
“Here’s a token of respect from that boy!” Gu Hai handed the First Seat Yin Yue a storage ring and added, “He requested that I give it to you on his behalf just in case you’d reject him.”
“I should be the one who gives him something instead!” First Seat Yin Yue smiled slyly.
Gu Hai laughed. “We’re a family, don’t mention it. Moreover, you did take care of him when he was still young. Although he looks unmindful, he’s very filial.”
“Yes, I agree! Previously, I was afraid that it’d be difficult for him to lead a peak with his average innate talent. Who knew he’d grow up to this level in just a blink of an eye? It seems so unreal, just like a dream.” First Seat Yin Yue nodded.
“I’d think that he’s a different soul if not because his character and filial piety remain the same and that he kneels before me unhesitantly,” said Gu Hai. “Anyway, this is a blessing to us and our sect. By the way, you may go back first. I shall go to the Sect Master. This time, I shall let that old fella thank me himself.”
“Don’t go too far.”
“No worries, I won’t.”
The two went separate ways.
In the great hall of Taiyang Peak…
Gu Hai had his hands behind his back, and his chin lifted as he walked in.
“Yo, where does an old duck come from? You demon, you’re obviously not a human. Quickly show your original self!” yelled Sect Master Yan.
Gu Hai stumbled, almost falling on his heels. Thus, he pouted. “You b*stard, how dare you scold me? I thought of giving you a great fortune, but now, no more!”
Gu Hai turned and walked out.
Sect Master Yan’s eyes lit, and he trotted toward Gu Hai as he said, “Junior Brother Gu, Senior Brother Gu, Brother, it’s my eyes that are clumsy!”
He ordered his disciple, “Serve tea! Serve good tea!” But he suddenly changed his mind and quickly added, “No, I’ll do it myself.”
He pulled Gu Hai’s arm and directed him to a seat before he started brewing tea.
“Not bad!” Gu Hai crossed his legs as he sat. Then, he reached out to receive the teacup the Sect Master handed. As soon as he took a sip, he spat out and put the teacup on the table beside him as he was disgusted. “How can a Sect Master drink such bad-tasting tea?” The Sect Master sat on the chair next to Gu Hai and said earnestly, “How can I be compared to you, Brother Gu? Tell me, what’s the great fortune that you were talking about? We grew up together, experiencing honors and shame together, so please stop acting mysterious. Just tell me what it is.”
Gu Hai did not answer but took out a teapot, poured the spiritual liquid into it, and closed his palms together to boil it. Then, he took out a piece of tea leaf, which he put into an empty teacup before he filled it full with hot water.
As the tea leaf was spinning along with the water flow, it glowed, emitting Dao fluctuations and vigor.
“What extraordinary tea!” The Sect Master was good to see the difference in the tea leaf. He asked, “Is this for me?”
“Taste it!”
“Sure!”
The Sect Master disregarded the hotness of the tea as he immediately took the teacup up and had a sip that made his eyes close.
Only after a while did he open his eyes, revealing an expression of astonishment as he said, “With just a sip, I actually fell into the state of enlightenment in an instant. Besides, my mana is refreshed, and my Primal Spirit is enhanced. Is this immortal tea?”
He looked at the tea leaf in the cup, thrilled.
“Almost similar. How’s it when compared to yours?” Gu Hai smiled.
“It’s utterly incomparable!” the Sect Master replied in an instant. “Brother Gu, is this the fortune you said you wanted to give me? You’re indeed my brother who is willing to share good things!”
“This is nothing, nothing at all when compared to real fortune!” Gu Hai frowned.
“Brother Gu, you’re boasting! The immortal tea is not considered a good fortune, and it’s nothing at all?” asked the Sect Master in disbelief.
“People with long hair usually have short insight, and that’s referring to you! The concentration of spiritual essence in the sect will be increased by 100 times!” said Gu Hai.
“Brother Gu, are you sure? The person behind her now plans to support our sect?” The Sect Master hissed with surprise.
“Oh, Yan Yan, do stay calm, stay calm. There is more. Ten types of medicinal pills, each of them able to help one breakthrough to the Paradis Realm when they reach the pinnacle of the Primal Spirit Realm!”
“D*mn! Brother Gu, are you messing with me? I’ve never heard about the medicinal pill that’d help one break through to the Paradis Realm at all.”
“100 types of techniques, 1,000 types of special abilities!”
“Brother Gu, are you serious?”
“10,000 Dao Vessels!”
“D*mn! I doubt that my little heart can bear it further!”
“Dao fluctuations in the sect will be increased 10-fold!”
“Oh my, I never knew that the Dao fluctuations can be increased 10-fold!?”
The Sect Master Yan was utterly dumbfounded.
“Do you want them?” Gu Hai asked smilingly.
“Are they real?” Sect Master Yan’s eyes turned red as his heartbeat grew faster, just like an old bull in its oestrus period.
“How would I dare to lie about this stuff?” Gu Hai stared slightly angrily at the Sect Master.
“You’re my elder brother, my own elder brother from now onward!” The Sect Master took two steps back and bowed with his fist crossed before he added, “Brother, we’ve been worrying so much about the sect. Do you know how stressful it was when we had to confront the persecution of Qing Province’s union, the suppression of the Qingyun Sect, and the pressure from the Fo Sect? Look at me now. My hair is white even though I’m a Primal Spirit expert. I know that the girl, Linglong, had a great encounter, hence lots of treasures. But because I’m afraid that I’d offend them, I refrained from requesting anything at all!”
The Sect Master wiped his eyes and said with his rationality still intact, “Brother, I also know that you see the sect as your home and have been sacrificing a lot for the sect. But make sure you don’t force your disciple. With her presence, the sect will be fine and will slowly develop. Therefore, we can’t make too many requests that may disappoint and upset her!”
“You old thing, you are indeed quite kind!” Gu Hai huffed and threw the storage ring at the Sect Master. “Rest assured that this is what the kid willingly gives to show filial piety, not by force. And it will take two to three days to fulfill the promise of increasing the concentration of spiritual essence and Dao fluctuations.”
“That’d be great, that’d be great!” The Sect Master checked the contents of the storage ring with his consciousness upon receiving it, and he was stunned. After taking a while to recollect himself, he said as he breathed heavily, “Brother Gu, I’m feeling uneasy with this lavish gift. Maybe I shall kneel before you as a token of appreciation!”
“F*ck off!” Gu Hai fluttered his sleeve as he left. Before he went off, he added, “There needs tranquility!”
“Sure!”
Sect Master Yan held the ring tightly in his hand and smiled but with tears dripping out.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - The Explosion of 108 Nuclear Bombs, Virus Spread
chapters.content:
Chapter 166 The Explosion of 108 Nuclear Bombs, Virus Spread
That night… Jiang Ming expanded the Saint Province Dao Square to cover the entire sect’s estate, including the nine main peaks and hundreds of other peaks.
He then increased Dao fluctuations in the nine main peaks up to 10-fold and the other peaks up to 3-fold when compared to non-estate areas.
Standing amidst the sky, Jiang Ming looked at the spiritual field, where its spiritual essence’s concentration was at its extreme.
It was due to the infusion of the supreme-grade spiritual fountain in the center of the spiritual field into earth veins that connected the entire Eastern Region, extracting its power and gathering spiritual essence from heaven and earth. Jiang Ming executed a special ability to diverge spiritual essence into eight branches that flowed to the bottom of the eight main peaks, forming spiritual veins. He also sent the majestic spiritual essence out of the spiritual mountain located in the center of the spiritual field, infusing it in them.
In less than two hours, spiritual essence had rapidly diffused out of all eight peaks, forming wisps of vapor that condensed into fogs.
Outside Taiyang Peak’s great hall…
Sect Master Yan was waiting silently. He could not help waiting since Gu Hai left even though the latter had told him that it would take about two to three days.
Meanwhile, he felt very excited, so excited that he seemed to have returned to feverish days in his youth.
‘Ten types of medicinal pills, all of them are extremely valuable that I only heard of them previously. The most valuable ones are the 100 techniques, which not only have given our disciples more choices, but each technique is also strong beyond imagination.
‘And the 1,000 special abilities, each stronger than any special ability available in the sect. All these have further enhanced the sect’s foundation by 100 times. Thus, our Jiuyang Sect has more than enough to rise up soon!
‘Besides, it’s 10,000 pieces of Dao Vessels, among which are some supreme-grade with terrific might! Even now, I feel that I’m still dreaming. It’s so surreal, just like an illusion. ‘If the concentration of Dao fluctuations and spiritual essence further increases… Oh heaven, oh my earth, I’ll have no regrets even if I die now!
‘With the downfall of Eastern Region, it’s time for my Jiuyang to rise up and maybe become a Sacred Land in about 100 or 1,000 years?
‘I think we will. We will definitely be one! By that time, I’ll be the Holy Lord then! Hahaha.’
He became more ecstatic as he thought.
At that moment, he somehow sensed the changes in the surroundings and abruptly lifted his head, gazing into the night sky.
Following that, he closed his eyes and opened them abruptly after a while. “I almost fell into the enlightening state earlier, and the speed of comprehending the mysteries of heaven and earth has got faster. Is this the effect of strengthened Dao fluctuations?”
Surprise filled Sect Master Yan’s face, and he was ecstatic as he muttered, “With such additional support, our disciples will be able to improve themselves rapidly. After all, the easier it is to comprehend heaven and earth’s laws, the easier it is to have a breakthrough. This ability is heaven-defying. I don’t think any Sacred Land can do so!”
He was ecstatic.
He then discovered wisps of spiritual vapor surging out of each peak, which gradually got denser.
‘A large amount of spiritual essence is surging everywhere. Is this induced from the earth veins? Oh my, what a holistic strengthening of the sect! I think it’s no longer an extravagant hope for our sect to become a Sacred Land in no time!’ Sect Master Yan shuddered in shock at that thought.
Following that, he took a deep breath to recollect himself, straightened his clothes, and paid his respects in the direction of Chuyang Peak, sincerely from his heart.
In the dark night…
The Submerged Dragon Continent in Shenzhou was a slightly bigger island but a size smaller than Eastern Region. Nevertheless, it was considered big enough. On this continent, there were many sects with many experts too. However, if these experts were to be compared to those in Shenzhou, they were a lot weaker.
At the bottom of a mountain, 18 people appeared out of thin air. Their intimidating auras were incompatible with the world.
As soon as the first one appeared, he pushed upward with his opened palm, and invisible power gushed out, forming a defensive shield that enveloped them. It was removed only when they were assured that their surroundings were safe enough. A strong-looking young man closed his eyes as a mirror emerged from his head, diffusing into the void. He reopened his eyes only after a while.
“My aura is merging into this world. Through the probing of Akasa Mirror, we’re on a lonely continent in the ocean. There are many sects here, but basically they’re in a messy state. Far in the west is an enormous continent. I think it should be the center of this world because it has 70% of the world’s luck and numerous terrific fortunes! Our mission is to destroy the world, but it’s difficult with our current power,” the young man said.
“We have 100 teams here, but I don’t care about the others! Our aim is to loot benefits and get as many points as possible! To get points, we can only hunt and slaughter! And this continent we’re on is just a good start! Chen, you do the planning,” the man said in a simple manner.
Chen nodded. “Destroying the world is to slaughter! Whether it’s looting benefits or gaining points, we still have to slaughter! But what we need to do now is to scout out the exact condition here, identify the number of experts, and find out if we can overbearingly overwhelm them?”
“It’d be quite difficult to overwhelm them overbearingly, I think. I just sensed that there are at least five Level 10 experts. They have location advantages and may unite to suppress us if we overwhelm them overbearingly. Also, don’t forget that our real strength is suppressed.”
“Boss, what about we devastate a force to induce doubts and even internal power struggle among them? After all, 100 teams are descending to this world, and we have no idea how many of them will be sent to this continent. If there’re many of them, the benefits we can gain will be greatly reduced,” Che suggested.
“Great, let’s do it as soon as possible. Let’s start scouting out the conditions and scheming against the others!” The young man made a decision.
Not long after that, they found a sect called Shenshui Sect. It was a Sacred Land with an Imminent Immortal Supreme Elder.
As soon as they got there, they did not trespass the sect. Instead, they took out 108 nuclear bombs and buried them around the sect.
“Elder Brother, isn’t it a waste to take out all of them?”
“No, it’s not. We can completely destroy this sect and wipe out a few cities in its surroundings to earn some points with just a blast. Moreover, we can see if we can kill the Imminent Immortal expert too.”
“Alright!”
After setting up the bombs, they immediately retreated.
Another tram appeared in East Sea, 14 of them. They were at least Paradis experts, very powerful.
“Destroy a world means wiping out all living things. Most worlds have ocean areas larger than land, hence a greater number of living things. Since we’ve descended here, shall we start from here?”
“Are we going to sweep across them overwhelmingly or kill only strong experts?”
“Since a perfect planar world allows 100 teams to descend simultaneously, many great forces and numerous Level 10 experts must be here. We might be besieged if we sweep across them, so it’s too dangerous for us. Taking our personal safety as a prerequisite, we shall take meticulous steps and attack without anyone knowing.”
“How are we going to earn lots of points then?”
“Virus!”
“Elder Brother, won’t it be too cruel if we do that?”
“Since it’s a world-annihilating mission, the fate of this world is decided. If we don’t do it, the other teams will do it anyway. Disperse, spill the virus, and come back. We’ll head to the land together!” “Got it!”
After an hour, they gathered again, heading toward the land.
At that moment, a blazing ray of light abruptly surged from the eastern part of East Sea into the sky, brightening the night sky.
After a while, a rumbling sound was heard.
It stirred up a 1,000-meter high wave and shook the void, creating a scene like the end of the world.
“D*rn, who’s so cruel to detonate nuclear bombs? They denoted at least 100 of them!”
“Such a thing can only kill mortals and destroy the sects’ formations. It’s almost impossible to kill Level 9 and Level 10 experts. Moreover, it’s not only expensive and ineffective but purely a waste as well. It also easily attracts attention, stupid!”
At the edge of Western Region, a team appeared.
One of them brandished a scepter and opened up a pitch-black passage. Many black coffins flew out of it and released a zombie each, forming a great army dispersing to all directions. Meanwhile, a great number of Zerg fighters appeared in Southern Region.
The world that night was in total chaos.
In Eastern Region…
A flag appeared above Black Wind City, enveloping it. The scarlet light burst out, and in just a few moments, the large city of nearly a million people was dead silent.
Eight people were standing on a peak about 1,000 miles away. They were gazing in the direction of Black Wind City, their faces betraying their shock.
“Who’s this? Why are they slaughtering a mortal city? Are they not afraid of creating public anger? Fortunately, our mission is merely to devastate the Jiuyang Sect!”
“Crazy, whoever did it must have gone nuts! No way! Look at the devastative light at the sea in the east! It looks like the nuclear bomb from the technological world, isn’t it?”
“There is also a large amount of dead aura over the ocean. What is going on?” “D*rn, would it be that gang which doesn’t have any bottom line?”
“If it is, this world is terribly unlucky.”
“Let’s just ignore them and focus on devastating the Jiuyang Sect! Since we have 10 teams in this mission, the Jiuyang Sect must be very dangerous, comparable to a forbidden area. We shall not take any risk but shall first infiltrate the sect from its periphery.”
This team was very meticulous.
On Chuyang Peak…
After Jiang Ming was done setting up what he had to, he was planning to start evolving his internal world. But he abruptly sensed something and squinted his eyes as he gazed into the east.
Five Elemental Linlong came closer to Jiang Ming and asked, “Senior Brother, what’s going on? Why is the atmosphere filled with so much death aura? It’s like the end of the world.”
“I’ve got a strong feeling of restlessness!” Xi Yao said.
“It’s a disaster affecting the whole world. Girl, notify the Sect Master so that he can call back all disciples, must act quickly! Xi Yao, notify your Master that foreign sky devils have descended on our world. Meanwhile, both of you stay here in the mountains. Don’t go anywhere else,” Jiang Ming said as he frowned.
“I’ll go to Northern Region and will come back in a short while!” Jiang Ming said as he tore the space to enter it.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - Intense Killing Intent, Jiang Ming was Enraged
chapters.content:
Chapter 167 Intense Killing Intent, Jiang Ming was Enraged
Change was an eternal subject, and no one knew what would happen in the next moment. Just like Jiang Ming, who thought it would be safe enough by destroying the portal. Yet, things didn’t go his way. Death aura again filled the atmosphere.
Jiang Ming fused his consciousness to heaven and earth and sensed the trembling world’s core. He knew it meant the world was in danger of annihilation. Upon activating his Dharma Eyes to observe Eastern Region, he discovered many different auras.
Others might not understand what these different auras meant, but he clearly knew what was going on. It obviously was the beneficiaries from either Reincarnation Hall or Lord God Space.
A terrifying storm of destruction was set off In the eastern part of East Sea. And a dense death aura spurted out of the ocean.
Bloodshed was also occurring in Southern Region, Western Region, and even in Zhong Province. The atmosphere was filled with a bloody aura, death aura, evil spirits, and an endless baleful aura, which must be the result of a large number of deaths.
“This is troublesome!” Jiang Ming had a headache. The current him was unable to shatter both the Reincarnation Hall and Lord God Space. He did not want to be passive all the time, yet he had no better method than taking action based on his current ability. Jiang Ming tore space and reached Northern Region in just a short while. He discovered that the entire Northern Region was suppressed by the para-immortal, which sealed its space, turning it into a prison that only allowed entry. The war had already started. Many Sacred Lands sent out about 30 terrific Imminent Immortal experts though there were more Extreme Path experts.
Nevertheless, many foreign devils were still alive. Hence, it would take a long time to slaughter them all.
‘The world is too big, yet I’m alone. Hence, I can’t spend too much time here!’ This was Jiang Ming’s plan.
At that moment, he was wearing the Heavenly Feathered Shirt, a real immortal weapon’s fighting suit, strong in defending. He wore it just in case any unexpected matter arose. With the blazing immortal suit enveloping him, no one could clearly see his face. The Celestial Soul Bell was hanging above him too. It could distort the laws with just a slight shiver.
As soon as he appeared, he did so in an imposing manner. He was seen being surrounded by immortal rays, and his majestic might encompassed millions of miles of land. With a rumbling voice, he told the people, “Gentlemen, more foreigners descended to all parts of the world with an unknown method, slaughtering everyone they find! Let me handle the devils here in Northern Region while you all return to where you’re from immediately to identify these foreigners and have them killed! Because these foreigners descended on our world, they are still being rejected by heaven and earth, although they have integrated into our world using a special method. Therefore, you can identify them if you observe carefully. Be careful because most of them are at least Primal Spirit experts, and some are even Imminent Immortal experts.”
He reached out to grab his Combat Mannequin as he finished his words. Then, he tore open space to throw it back to Chuyang Peak so that it could guard the Jiuyang Sect temporarily.
The next moment, a Mystical Light Sword appeared in his hand. It was an immortal weapon that he had snatched from Tian Ci. He wielded the sword to release hundreds of strands of Sword Qi that infused into the void as he slashed open the void.
Jiang Ming slew many devils at Extreme Path Realm and above in an instant.
Jiang Ming didn’t stop brandishing his sword, producing endless sword lights that cut through devils as though he was cutting grass.
Liu Changkong and the others who were massacring stopped. Though they did not see Jiang Ming’s face clearly, they knew that the man was someone incredibly strong as they saw the Celestial Soul Bell atop his head.
When they heard Jiang Ming’s words, they tried sensing the world on their own, and all their facial expressions changed instantaneously. They felt the extraordinary dense death aura in the atmosphere. They had not sensed it while massacring as they were in a bloody war themselves. But now, when they stopped to sense it on purpose, they somehow could feel a
bit.
“It’s a world-annihilating catastrophe!” Liu Changkong shuddered. His jaw went slack when he saw the boundless sword lights of Jiang Ming, which had slain almost all devils.
Liu Changkong thought, ‘F*ck. The union of all Sacred Lands’ experts had a slaughtering speed slower than the man alone. No, it was far slower? I wonder how insane the man is. Is he an immortal?’
Suddenly, Liu Changkong discovered that he could recognize the Mystical Light Sword in that man’s hand. It was the immortal weapon that had surged out of Tian Ci’s mind when he was hunted down.
He doubted why the sword was with that man. Could he be the one who… He dared not think further.
‘Fortunately, that man is a human. It’s enough that he’s willing to protect the world. As for the past? No, there’s no past, only the future!’ As Liu Changkong thought, he presented a hold fist salute as he bowed to Jiang Ming. “Thanks!”
Following that, he rose up and shouted, “Gentlemen, let’s return to our respective sects and wipe out all foreigners together. Remember, do maintain a connection with each other and don’t hold back but do whatever you can because this is a disaster that affects the entire world’s safety! When you go back, wake all the Imminent Immortal experts up in your sects. Whoever retreats, I’ll go and have them killed!”
Liu Changkong’s voice was resounding, and his killing intent was terrifying. With a flutter of his sleeves, he turned and left.
Meanwhile, the rest looked at each other, confused. However, as they saw Jiang Ming was on a killing spree and had almost wiped out all the devils, they too left immediately while in shock.
“Why are there so many issues recently?” Qing Fengzi felt like scratching his head.
It had started with the Great Eastern War, then the changes in Western Region. Relatively speaking, the issue about the Jiuyang Sect was nothing at all.
Following that, before the invasion issue in Northern Region had been settled, the world was facing the danger of annihilation.
“F*ck, this is trying to play us to death,” Qing Fengzi cursed as he teleported along with his sect’s Imminent Immortal Great Monarch.
In just a blink of an eye, all experts who came to Northern Region vanished into thin air. Only those experts of Extreme Path and below returned either by taking a war boat or riding a divine mountain.
Of course, there were quite many who had died in Northern Region.
Clang!
Jiang Ming killed the last devil standing, and the sword light eventually dissipated into thin
air.
The devils’ corpses in Northern Region piled up like mountains.
Jiang Ming heaved a sigh of relief, took out a spiritual bead, and fiercely sucked a vast river of mana from it, which he refined to replenish his consumption.
In just a while, he had fully replenished the mana he consumed.
He collected the loot with a flutter of his sleeves before merging his consciousness into the void, scanning through thousands and millions of miles to look for any escaped devils. In fact, he found some which he killed with a flip of a finger.
Following that, he turned and gazed at Southern Region. His eyes flickered with intense killing intent as he searched around.
“Found them!” Jiang Ming gasped as he flew toward there. He got to a place in just a while. There were about 10 experts with strong auras in the mountain before him.
