“Die!” Jiang Ming launched his attack on them immediately.
With the appearance of world projection that suppressed the void, he slapped all of them to death. Two of them were protected by immortal weapons, but none survived.
While collecting the loot, Jiang Ming checked out Human Path Records.
Name: Chang Jiao
Race: Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 10 (Imminent Immortal)
Background: Scarlet Planar World’s Horned Horse Great Monarch (Remark: A beneficiary of the Lord God Space and one of the Skyhorse Clan’s members)
Relationship: -78
Innate talent: Immortal
Status: One of the Lord God Space’s beneficiaries who accepted an unlimited mission to exterminate the Tianyuan Planar World.
Such a world-annihilating mission was issued because the 20 teams sent to this world to fight against each other were all wiped out.
There were a total of 100 teams that accepted this mission, for it was the maximum number this planar world could accept simultaneously.
As soon as he descended into this world, he found out that there was a war outbreak. Therefore, he decided to observe first so that he could reap the utmost profits from the war.
“F*ck, the Lord God Space actually sent 100 teams here! They already turned my world into a battleground, so I killed their teams, yet they now retaliated by issuing a mission to exterminate my world! Lord God Space, you’re good, very good, indeed extremely good! I’ll remember you!” Jiang Ming tried suppressing his rage as he again merged his consciousness with the void and activated his Dharma Eyes to look for other teams.
He managed to find eight teams, killed them, and collected origin essence before he tore space, returning to his sect. He did not land on Chuyang Peak but stood atop the Jiuyang Sect. Meanwhile, his eyes flickered as he maximized the use of Dharma Eyes, scanning the world up to a million miles. He saw a man with an Extreme Path cultivation base. He called up the Human Path Records to check on that man.
Name: Pan Lin
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 9 (Extreme Path)
Background: Heavenly King Planar World’s Pan Clan’s Great Monarch (Remark: Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary, one of the Linhai Clan’s members)
Relationship: -95
Innate talent: Immortal (Gold Overlord Body)
Status: A Heaven Reincarnation Hall beneficiary who accepted the SSS-grade mission together with his members to destroy the Jiuyang Sect. Because the mission’s time frame was one year, and a total of 10 S-rank teams were sent, he thought the Jiuyang Sect must be quite strong. Therefore, his team decided to go slow, meticulously collecting enough data about the sect to plan their next move.
Jiang Ming could not help but take a deep breath.
‘Even the Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiaries are here. Even though it’s slightly better than the Lord God Space, it sent 10 teams simultaneously just to destroy my sect. In other words, it’s to destroy my home and my family. Very well!’ Jiang Ming gnashed his teeth as killing intent soared in his eyes.
A tyrannical desire surged from within his heart, insuppressible regardless.
Nevertheless, he did not take immediate action. He continued observing instead. After a while, his yearning to kill surged further in his eyes as he checked on another Lord God Space beneficiary.
Name: Daladol
Race: Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 9 (Extreme Path) Background: Thousand Moon Planar World (Remark: Lord God Space’s beneficiary, one of the Warhammer Clan’s members)
Relationship: -78
Innate talent: Ten Stars
Status: One of the Lord God Space’s beneficiaries who accepted an unlimited mission to exterminate the Tianyuan Planar World.
As he and his team descended on the sea, they were of no advantage in competing with the other 99 teams. Therefore, they decided to take action secretly, plotting to massacre living things and plunder wealth and points.
Therefore, they spread the vampire virus, zombie virus, and mutated seeds, among others, in the ocean to induce a carnage among millions and millions of living things in the ocean.
As he reached the land, he saw the mushroom cloud in the eastern areas of the ocean. He knew it was the nuclear bombs the other team had detonated. From the degree of the explosion, he deduced that there were more than 100 bombs had been detonated, and many must have been killed.
He was standing on the cliff by the sea, quietly watching the bloodshed, mountains of corpses, and the ocean that would be completely turned into a dead sea.
He thought the extermination of the world meant millions and millions of living things would be slaughtered, and that was exciting. Could a planar world defend themselves from 100 teams? No, the answer is a resounding no.
He felt unlucky because he didn’t have the technique to improve cultivation by snatching others’ blood essence. Otherwise, this would have been a great encounter for him!
Jiang Ming shuddered as he read the Status. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his eyes had turned alarmingly cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - The World Monitoring Mirror of Dao Square
chapters.content:
Chapter 168 The World Monitoring Mirror of Dao Square
Jiang Ming was so furious as he learned that the foreigners were using viruses and nuclear bombs to exterminate his world.
‘Don’t leave since you all have come!’ Jiang Ming thought. He obviated three Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiaries who had just gotten into the sect with just a thought. Following that, he vanished into thin air again as his figure fluttered.
He went on a killing spree in Qing Province, Yu Province, Shui Province, Lei Province, Wu Province, Mu Province, and Hai Province, except for the Feng Province and Yun Province, which were under the Qingyun Sect’s command.
At sunset, Jiang Ming arrived at the seaside of the East Sea, looking out over the raging waves of the sea, and the dense death aura suffused the sky.
The sea surface was covered with corpses that flowed along with the waves. Meanwhile, numerous sea demons appeared from the bottom of the sea, executing special abilities to clean the seawater as tussles set off monstrous
waves.
Jiang Ming turned and returned to Chuyang Peak.
He lay on the rattan chair on the rooftop’s balcony when he felt extremely tired. He had been continuously attacking and killing experts throughout the Northern Region and Eastern Region. It looked easy to others, but such an act greatly consumed his mana and strength.
Five Elemental Linglong came over, softly massaging his temples with her fingers radiating white lights.
In the room of an inn located in a city within the Qing Province, a man was seen shivering as he sat crossed-legged.
“Dead, all dead. In just a short while, all dead!” He looked ghastly pale. It was only not long ago that all his teammates were killed. They had scattered around 100,000 miles just in case. Yet, they were all killed almost simultaneously as the killer snapped his fingers.
“Is it that I survived because I’ve shielded my aura?” the young man muttered as he shuddered.
He did not understand how they could be found in a short while based on their abilities and experiences in concealing themselves in numerous other worlds. Even if they were found, based on their strengths, how they, particularly his team leader, could be killed with a snap of a finger? His team leader was, after all, a peerless man who could resist a Level 11 expert. ‘How terrifying is the expert in the Jiuyang Sect?’ the young man thought as he opened up the System’s list, where the total number of all members that had descended was listed. There were 82 members at the start.
“How’s it possible?” The young man looked amazingly shocked because the total number of members left had changed to three.
“F*ck! Almost everyone was killed even before we managed to enter the Jiuyang Sect. Is this how horrible the SSS-grade mission is? But something is not right. How could a planar world with the highest cultivation base at the pinnacle of Level 10 have someone who can slaughter almost everyone in a night without creating much attention? This is not even achievable by a Level 11 expert. Can it be that the Jiuyang Sect has a mighty figure comparable to Level 12?
“Even if such an expert existed, how could they find all of them in just a short while? This is completely impossible even if that person cultivated the Karma Law! A Level 10 expert transcends the laws, and their Dao can suppress 10,000 Daos. Hence, they can shield themselves from karma and even cut off the karma strand connected to a Level 10 expert at their pinnacle. What can I do?” The young man struggled.
nan
He did not want to risk his life to complete the mission. So he thought he might just wait till the end of the scheduled mission as he was unable to call a return forcibly.
“Sigh, all 10 teams failed just like that. I wonder if the Reincarnation Hall would be concerned? Concern? Ha!” The young man smiled slyly.
Meanwhile, the other survivors scattered around the Eastern Region were all terrified.
On Chuyang Peak…
“This Is comfortable! Girl, I didn’t know that you have such a skill. When did you learn it?” Jiang Ming smiled.
“A long time ago! I’ve always wanted to try, but you’ve been so energetic like a monkey. Hence, I had no chance at all. Is it really good?” Linglong smiled.
“Yes, it is. Very soft and gentle. The method of stimulating my temples with special ability can quickly restore the tired spirit indeed! I was really quite tired, but not anymore!” Jiang Ming said. “Senior Brother, I haven’t seen you being this tired before. What’s going on?”
“I went on a killing spree.”
The eastern sky was getting brighter, approaching dawn. The morning sunshine’s rays intertwined, weaving a nest for the sun to leap out at the best timing. Jiang Ming could not help but frown as he thought of the bloodshed yesterday night. He had also discovered that a Level 10 expert could cut off their own karma. Jiang Ming would not be able to find the Level 10 expert if the expert were to do so in addition to self-concealing, even with consciousness.
If he did not use the world projection, many would have escaped. Nevertheless, there were still three Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiaries who had managed to escape. From the information given by their team members, the three were highly capable of self-concealing.
“Brother Jiang, what has happened to our world? Why are we continuously being attacked by foreign devils? Can we resist them if they continuously descend into our world?” Xi Yao came over and asked with her brows knitted together.
Jiang Ming turned to Xi Yao and said in an assuring manner, “Yes, we can. Don’t worry. These invaders are incredibly strong, have various means, are highly capable of self-concealing, and will do whatever they can to achieve their goals. From what I know, they wanted to exterminate our world. Hence, they are killing everyone indiscriminately.”
“What are the benefits they could reap for doing so?”
“Who knows?”
The wind whistled on the rooftop as the sun leaped up.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet and stretched himself energetically. Then, he went to the open kitchen at the side to start preparing breakfast.
He took out spiritual herbs one after another as he started mixing and matching. He eventually used dragon heart as the main ingredient to cook a medicinal dish that restored the state of mind, and the three ate quietly.
“Ding: Congratulations for having eaten a depressingly good breakfast and turned on the World Monitoring Mirror function of Dao Square.”
Jiang Ming was surprised that an item was rewarded for this breakfast. The World Monitoring Mirror was a special functionality of the Saint Province Dao Square. Once turned on, a World Monitoring Mirror would be formed in the Dao Square, which allowed Jiang Ming to monitor the world, identify, and target a foreign lifeform.
Jiang Ming was ecstatic upon looking at the manual because this was what he needed. He was not concerned about these invaders and could even omit their presence, provided they were not killing ordinary people recklessly.
Nevertheless, he currently could neither be unconcerned nor omit their presence because a team had detonated nuclear bombs while another dispersed viruses.
These creatures should be killed, but it was too difficult to locate them. It was particularly difficult when they had a higher cultivation base and more different methods. Just like this time, he had yet to find the three beneficiaries who aimed to annihilate the Jiuyang Sect, even though he had tried his best.
“Girl, please help me do the dishes. I need to ponder quietly for a while.” Jiang Ming requested and returned to his room. “I’ll do it!” As Xi Yao lifted her fingers and the dishes flew upward. She then started washing them. At the same time, she said to Linglong, “Brother Jiang is like a cloud of mysterious fog, getting difficult to understand.”
Linglong replied with her speculation, “Perhaps, Senior Brother is the son of the world, or he’s the reincarnation of an immortal emperor?”
“That’s indeed possible! Otherwise, how could he be so strong when he’s merely 28 and always stays home? The son of the world is the luckiest one. He’d have fortune even if he’s just sitting all the time. As for the reincarnation of an immortal emperor? That’d be even more terrifying. In fact, I doubt that both of you are. After all, you two are talented beyond logic. I shall make sure that I curry favor with both of you.” Xi Yao nodded in a serious manner. “Ha, I think you want to curry favor with my Senior Brother, don’t you?”
“Nasty!”
The two were chatting and joking in a low voice.
In the room…
With a thought, a mirror appeared before Jiang Ming, its size adjustable as he wished. As he focused on the mirror, white-colored points appeared on the mirror.
As he pointed with his finger at one of the points, the mirror zoomed in to the point, gradually showing an inn, a room, and the man sitting cross-legged in the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - Materialization, the Final Changes of the Inner World
chapters.content:
Chapter 169 Materialization, the Final Changes of the Inner World
The Human Path Records was flipped open once again, and the opponent’s information appeared before his eyes.
“Awesome!” Jiang Ming exclaimed, his eyes lighting with joy.
However, he did not do anything. He activated the Supreme Order and came to the seventh floor of the Supreme Pagoda once again.
Name: Jiang Ming Cultivation base: Level 9 Points accumulated: 6,759
Honor for the seventh floor: 18 floors Heavenly Ladder, 9 stages Heavenly Stage, 533 points of special abilities
Jiang Ming stepped on the Heavenly Stage and began climbing Soon, he arrived at the 7th stage. This time, his opponent was Jun Sanqian. He was now at the initial stage of Level 11.
“Nice to see you again, senior!” Jiang Ming greeted Jun Sanqian.
“Well, it seems like you have more questions for me,” Jun Sanqian laughed, “Fire it away!” “My world is now under the invasion of two organizations. They can come to my world freely, and it seems like they need to accomplish some kind of mission. One time they were tasked to destroy my world, while another time, they were tasked to investigate a sect,” Jiang Ming said. “Senior, do you know who they are?”
“Destroy your world and investigate a sect? This is interesting.” Jun Sanqian said, “Anyway, I don’t think it matters to you even if I know who they are. You just want to ask if you can kill them all, and if you do so, will it bring you any trouble, right?”
“Yes, senior.” Jiang Ming affirmed. “If you can kill them, just do so,” Jun Sandian laughed, “If they come to your world through a normal process, you can just kill them.” “Normal process? Could it be that there are abnormal ones?”
“Bingo! Those you mentioned earlier appeared in your world through a normal process. As for those abnormal ones, they’re even simpler to understand. Those who can destroy your world without descending on your world personally are considered abnormal. The beings in your world can’t stop them.”
“Senior, could there be a situation where someone in my world facilitates the descent of a powerful person who exceeds the world’s tolerance limit?”
“Yes, but it’ll also come with many restrictions, and it falls in the category of normal. Also, you don’t have to worry too much. As long as you have the Supreme Order, nothing serious will happen.”
“Thank you for your explanation, senior,” Jiang Ming said. “What will happen if I kill all of them in those two conditions I mentioned just now?”
“They will keep coming to your world, but if the number of people you kill has reached the maximum, they will stop coming to your world. However, there are also some special cases where they will bring an interdimensional gate with them to lead a large number of powerful people from another world into your world. Or, they might set up coordinates in your world to facilitate the invasion of another world.”
“What?” Jiang Ming was stunned. “Facilitate the invasion of another world?”
“Exactly. They will bring in a world of a lower level, or the same level to fuse with your world.”
“Fuse? Are you talking about a collision? Wouldn’t that be bad?”
“Either fuse or collide against each other! This is a very rare occurrence since the cost of propelling a world forward, or targeting a specific world, is so great that even Dongfang Chenxi’s father would rather not do it.”
“You know her father?”
“Well, that’s my secret.” After talking for a long while, Jiang Ming resumed clearing the stages. He went up to the 9th stage, but he was defeated on the 10th stage when he was going up against a Level 12 expert. This time, his opponent was still Jun Sanqian.
“Come at me. I hope you can create a miracle this time,” Jun Sanqian said. “A miracle?” Jiang Ming asked, “Didn’t you tell me that I’m not the most talented despite having a lot of potential? How am I supposed to create a miracle?”
“Create a miracle that belongs to the mortal realm!” Jun Sanqian explained, “Amongst the mortal realm, although there are beings that are capable of slaying immortals, it’s only because they own superb weapons. However, here, we’re fighting on equal ground, and on this stage, I’m a Level 12 expert.” “Understood. I’ll try my best to create a miracle!”
Jiang Ming grabbed his sword and made his first move.
He activated the World Projection in order to suppress his opponent. Then, he cast the Astral Formation and two forms from the Great Millenium Technique, the Solitary Desert and the Descending Sun.
He was exceedingly powerful, but unfortunately, Jun Sanqian was more powerful than him.
An immortal light burst out from him as he met Jiang Ming’s attack head-on.
Compared to the last time, Jiang Ming had become a lot stronger. Although his moves were the same, their power had increased by leaps and bounds.
That being said, it was still a tough fight for him.
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!” Jiang Ming shouted, and with this move, he finally defeated Jun Sanqian.
In the next second, his battered body recovered.
On the 11th stage…
“You’ve succeeded. You’re only a Level 9 expert, yet you’ve defeated a Level 12 expert. You truly are remarkable,” Jun Sanqian commented. “However, this is where you stop!” “You’ve flattered me, senior,” Jiang Ming said. “Senior, considering my condition, would I be able to conquer the 12th stage if I ascend to Level 10?”
“I don’t see why you can’t. Even the 13th stage might not be a match for you,” Jun Sanqian replied, “It depends on how far you can go. You have the strongest foundation, and you can break the rules.”
This time, Jiang Ming did not attack Jun Sanqian anymore but left.
After all, it was meaningless for him to fight.
He came to the platform and looked at the Heavenly Ladder before peeling his gaze away. He did not leave. Instead, he came to the Million Dao Chart and sat down. However, he was not going to comprehend some special abilities. He was just going to take a rest.
He had eliminated quite a number of beneficiaries, so he had to absorb and digest the origin essence inside of him. He decided to take this chance and transform his inner world into a real world.
He closed his eyes and focused on his inner world. As time went on, his mastery and understanding of the laws and Dao had become better and better.
On this day, an illusion manifested above Jiang Ming’s head. It was the projection of his inner world. There were mountains, rivers, gullies, and forests, to name a few.
Suddenly, the illusion contorted and began shrinking. The same thing was happening in the inner world as well. The world was shrinking, the mountains were collapsing, and the rivers were disappearing Everything had been destroyed at this moment before turning into a mass of Chaos Qi.
Jiang Ming’s eyes remained closed, and he continued to focus on his inner world.
He knew that this was the most essential step in bringing his inner world to reality. The Chaos Qi exploded and formed into a big empty space in the next moment.
The feeling of illusion was gone. The soil, the sand, the rocks, all of them were real.
The sun, moon, and stars formed in the sky. The sun was rising from the east while the moon was falling in the west.
A strange power was also taking form as the laws came into play and all things evolved.
This power was far better in quality than mana. It was mysterious, and in the end, it was scattered on all sides of the world and integrated into all things.
As the world began to spin, the power was increasing
At the same time, a stream of esoteric aura flowed out, partly injected into the mind and will, causing the soul to be transformed and the Primal Spirit to be elevated.
Part of it also flowed into his flesh, allowing his bones, muscles, blood vessels, internal organs, skin, and so on to all begin to restructure and transform.
It was a vigorous and rapid process.
An excruciating pain assaulted his mind as well, but for today’s Jiang Ming, even a thousand cuts would not make him frown.
The transformation finally ended.
Before he could do anything, a voice echoed into his ears.
[Congratulations Jiang Ming on ascending to Level 10. Now you have two choices, enter the eighth floor of the Supreme Pagoda and take the test or return to the real world. Please choose as soon as possible.]
Jiang Ming was delighted, but then he sighed.
He did not expect that he would immediately step into the Imminent Immortal Realm after his inner world turned into a real world. Despite still having some doubts, he did not hesitate too much and chose to enter the next floor to accept the test.
The test was nothing but a walk in the park for
him.
After passing the three tests, he arrived at the eighth floor of the Supreme Pagoda.
He stood on the platform and looked around. The surroundings were quiet, and there was nobody else here except for him.
After all, there were very few geniuses, and they did not have much choice. Besides, it took a lot of luck for one to get the Supreme Order. It would be difficult to get their hands on one unless one was very lucky.
That being said, getting the Supreme Order was not the end of it. Even if one had gotten the order, it would be useless if they could not pass the test.
Once a candidate failed to pass the test, the Supreme Order would disappear, and it would take many years until it was found again.
In other words, the Supreme Pagoda was very calm.
“It needs two steps for one to reach the Imminent Immortal Realm, so how did I do it? Is it because of the transformation of my inner world?”
With that thought in mind, Jiang Ming began to study what changes had happened to his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - The Division of the Realm, the Realm of Immortality
chapters.content:
Chapter 170
The Division of the Realm, the Realm of Immortality
One had to reach two requirements in order to ascend from the Extreme Path Realm to the Imminent Immortal Realm.
The first was to fully master a law, and the second was to comprehend the method of transcendence to free oneself from the shackles of the world. When that happened, one’s mana would become the immortal force. The immortal force in the human world was also known as the pseudo-immortal force or quasi-immortal force. This was a difficult process. However, it was much easier for some people, such as Ming Fei and Dongfang Chenxi.
Jiang Ming had also learned that different worlds had different laws through his friends in the chat room. Besides, the conditions and degree of difficulty when breaking through differ by world level as well.
Jiang Ming closed his eyes and began to feel the changes in his body.
After a short while, he finally found the reason for his breakthrough. Since his inner world had transformed into a real world, the Yin-Yang Law and the Light-and-Dark Law, two of the most basic laws of the five elements, had been perfected.
“For others, the Paradis is illusory and is formed by the manifestation of mana. When one reaches the Imminent Immortal Realm, mana will transform into the pseudo-immortal force.
“But in my case, my Paradis has transformed into a real world. As for my mana… I probably should call it the worldly force right now. It’s even stronger than the pseudo-immortal force. “Could it be that the worldly force is equivalent to the pseudo-immortal force?”
Jiang Ming fell into thought. “I guess that should be it.”
He summoned a clone and appeared in the inner world.
He stood midair and looked at the surroundings.
Jiang Ming had never felt so happy before.
He stretched his arm forward and grabbed a cloud in front of him. It felt so real, and the illusory sensation was gone.
“Although the inner world has become smaller, its origin has improved a lot!”
He then looked skyward at the sun that hung in the sky. The earth veins were still evolving, and he was certain that they would finish their evolution sooner or later.
He looked into the distance, and there was nothing but barren ground, lakes, and rivers in his vision.
Everything in this world was under his control.
He was the owner and the creator of this place.
“Can I speed up evolution?”
The idea popped in Jiang Ming’s head, and he activated the Time Law.
The inner world had become a lot smaller, so he could accelerate the time here by 1,000 times easily. However, as he activated the Time Law, there was a heavy sluggishness, and he had a feeling that the inner world was going to collapse.
He hastily stopped and understood something.
It was not that he could not do it. It was just that the inner world had not finished the evolution process yet. It was still in the incipient state, so if he tried to speed up the evolution process with the Time Law, the inner world would collapse.
He came out of his inner world and stood up. He clenched his fist, and he could feel an immense power coursing inside of him.
“At my current level, I could have blown the previous me away with one punch!”
It was not an illusion but a fact.
After his inner world had turned into a real world, his strength had reached a whole new level.
“I should probably test it out now!”
With that thought in mind, Jiang Ming walked toward the Heavenly Stage in the south. In the meantime, he opened up his status in the Supreme Pagoda.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 10
Points Accumulated: 11,879
Honor (Eighth Floor): None
He was now at Level 10, and he had collected 11,879 points.
Jun Sanqian appeared on the first stage, “Congratulations!” He studied Jiang Ming for a while and exclaimed, “Your foundation is perfected, and I assure you that you’ll have a bright future ahead.”
“Thank you for your compliment, senior!” Jiang Ming replied. “Senior, do planar worlds have a level?” “The planar world? There is the nascent, general, and perfect planar world,” Jun Sandian said after a short contemplation. “Just like your inner world, it’s considered as a nascent planar world. This kind of planar world is incomplete. Whether it’s the operation or the laws, or the power of creation, they’re still in the evolving stage. Thus, it’s hard for intelligent life to be born. Even if intelligent life exists, it will have a lot of flaws in them.
“For example, Paradis can be transformed into a planar world as well through some measures. However, such worlds can only breed beings with relative attributes and no potential because of their defects.
“Once the 3,000 laws mature, the power of creation can run freely, and the cycle of reincarnation is completed, it’ll turn into a general planar world. Amongst so many worlds, the general planar world is the most abundant!
“Further up, when the world origin, the laws, or the cycle of reincarnation has reached a certain threshold, it’s a perfect planar world, and it can become a small chiliocosm.
“It’s just that it’s not that easy to reach that stage. Not only are there tribulations, but also man-made disasters. Generally speaking, among 1,000 planar worlds, only one can become a small chiliocosm,” Jun Sanqian explained.
“A world still has to go through tribulations as well as man-made disasters in the evolution process?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with disbelief.
Jun Sanqian nodded.
“The evolution of a world is similar to cultivation. There will be stages and trials. If a world can pass the trial, it’ll ascend to the next level. If it can’t, it will be the end of the world.
“As for man-made disasters, it’s much simpler. The evolution of a world often comes with great opportunities, which will naturally attract some powerful beings. They might want to absorb the creation energy when the world is evolving or get their hands on world origin. Some even want to take advantage of world evolution to help them in their cultivation. However, this situation rarely happens. After all, it’s generally hard to locate a planar world, and most of them are protected by laws and the Great Dao. They will also tend to suffer great tribulations once they hunt a planar world, and whether they can succeed or not it’ll depend on their own ability. “As for you, you don’t have to worry about anything since your inner world is within you. You’re the master of your world, and as long as
i exist, no one can touch your inner world!” Jun Sandian laughed.
er
Jiang Ming fell silent. This information might not be useful to Jun Sanqian, but it was extremely useful for someone like him.
“Senior, so can I just leave my inner world alone?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“Yeah, you could. But you can accelerate the evolution if you put more effort into completing it.” Jun Sanqian explained, “The evolution of the inner world is the process of growing the origin and perfecting the law. If you absorb more World Hearts, origin essence, spiritual crystals, and so on, it will speed up the evolution process.”
“But how should I make progress in my cultivation? I just need to focus on my inner world?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“No! With your cultivation system, in your current state, you’re slowly severing the ties between you with your world. Eventually, you’ll be severed from all laws, and this is known as the Severing Dao. After you’ve broken away from the world, you’ll be able to ascend into the next realm,” Jun Sanqian answered as he sat down.
He gestured to Jiang Ming to sit down and continued. “After you’ve ascended, you will become a pseudo-immortal. In a world of a higher level, the realm will be differentiated into Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, Mystical Immortal, and Golden Immortal. Of course, there are more realms, but this is all you need to know now.
“After you’ve become a pseudo-immortal, you should start cultivating the Heavenly Immortal Dao, otherwise known as the Heavenly Immortal Law and the Heavenly Immortal Fruition. Once you’ve perfected it, you’ll become a Heavenly Immortal. Your Dao Body will undergo drastic changes, and your mana will turn into the immortal essence. It’s easy to ascend from the pseudo-immortal to the Heavenly Immortal, and usually, it only takes less than a few hundred years.
“Each realm will have its own Fruition and laws, and the difference between each realm is as big as the heaven and the ground.
“Since you have your inner world, you’re a step faster than the rest of the people.
“For example, when you reach the Heavenly Immortal Realm, you’ll have more mana than other people, and you could easily defeat opponents who are stronger than you.”
Jun Sanqian’s eyes were glowing while he was talking
Although Jiang Ming did not have any special feelings, he knew that Jun Sanqian could see through his inner world. There were too many mysteries surrounding the man in front of him, and he wondered how strong he really was.
“Because of my inner world? Senior, the world I’m in is just a perfect planar world, and Level 10 is the maximum my world could contain.”
“Haha!” Jun Sanqian laughed. “It’s a different thing. The world you are in can only contain at most Level 10 cultivation, but it’s a different case for you.
“This tolerance limit refers to the limit of how many lives can be born.
“The power or the essence of a world is exceedingly powerful, and it can be comparable to a Golden Immortal.
“You’re the owner of your inner world. You’re the king, and you have command over everything in it. When you’re a Heavenly Immortal, if the inner world evolves to the limit of the planar world, you can mobilize the power equivalent to that of a Golden Immortal. Do you understand?”
Understanding instantly dawned upon Jiang Ming
“I get it now! My power might be limited when I’m in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but my inner world can be enhanced infinitely!”
“That’s right!”

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - Burning Down the World, It’s Time to Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 171 Burning Down the World, It’s Time to Kill
After Jiang Ming finished asking his question, he made a bow at Jun Sanqian. Jun Sanqian nodded and said, “Let’s get started!”
“Let’s go!” Jiang Ming replied and cast his World Projection, trying to defeat Jun Sandian in one hit.
Compared to the last time, he had become a lot more powerful
Upon the activation of his World Projection, the Akasa crumbled.
Everywhere it reached, the laws failed to work, and he could defeat an Imminent Immortal with ease.
Even though Jun Sanqian was a Level 11 expert, his movement was restricted, and he couldn’t use some of his powers.
Bam…
Lifting his fists high, Jiang Ming dashed toward Jun Sanqian.
He did not pick any weapon, while Jun Sandian was still holding a sword like he used to. He waved his sword, and strands of sword energy flew forward, but they could do nothing against Jiang Ming’s punch.
However, Jiang Ming did not press forward. After he had crushed the strands of sword energy with a punch, he grabbed a wisp of immortal origin and began feeling it. He found out that Jun Sanqian’s immortal origin force was not that powerful compared to his worldly force, and he was excited.
Upon realizing the difference between him and Jun Sanqian, Jiang Ming activated the Unlimited Killing Punch, throwing a barrage of punches at him and defeating Jun Sanqian.
He received 10 points for clearing the first stage.
On the second stage, Jiang Ming activated the Astral Transformation, further amplifying his physical strength and defeating his opponent with ease.
The opponent on the third stage shared the same fate as the guy on the second stage.
When he reached the fourth stage, there were two Jun Sanqians. Both of them were at the peak of Level 11. In other words, their strength was equivalent to a Heavenly Immortal at the peak level.
Although they were very strong, they still couldn’t stop Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming came to the seventh stage in one go, and this time he was matched up against a Level 12 True Immortal at the elementary level.
It took him a lot of effort to defeat his opponent in the past, but right now, he defeated him without any difficulties.
The opponents on the eighth and ninth stage were True Immortals at the intermediate and peak levels, respectively.
Both of them gave Jiang Ming a hard time, but he still vanquished them in the end.
On the tenth stage, it was a Level 13 Mystical Immortal.
Jiang Ming stopped and looked at Jun Sanqian. “Senior, my inner world formed not long ago. Generally speaking, I shouldn’t be this powerful, so how am I able to defeat so many experts?”
He really couldn’t understand at all.
Jun Sanqian chuckled and replied, “Essentially speaking, your inner world is a planar world. The power it contains is comparable to the Golden Immortal Realm. Although the origin power is inferior, its quality is not much different from that of the immortal essence. In fact, the most crucial thing is the several special abilities you have comprehended, which makes you much stronger than many people. “For example, your Astral Transformation that could amplify your strength up to 64 times. It’s something that can’t be achieved in the mortal world. As for your Return of Infinite Law Finger, it consists of several Daos, so it’s even more terrifying than the Astral Transformation. While other techniques, such as the Great Catastrophes Technique, the Great Five Elemental Technique, and the Great Millennium Technique, they’re much weaker since they haven’t exceeded the scope of the mortal world.”
“They haven’t exceeded the scope of the mortal world?” Jiang Ming asked, his voice filled with confusion.
He was kind of surprised when he learned that Jun Sangian found the Great Millennium Technique weak.
However, he soon understood why Jun Sangian would say that. What he had comprehended was the Time Law for the mortal world, so of course, it was a power belonging to the mortal world. No matter how powerful it is, there’s a limit for it to grow. “So, does this mean that I should merge all Daos together?”
“Nope,” Jun Sanqian replied. He waved his sword, and a trail of fire appeared in the air. As it slowly fell to the ground, the fire kept getting stronger, and Jiang Ming could see the chain of order in the flames.
This was the Fire Law; it was also one of the Daos belonging to the mortal world.
Suddenly, the Fire Law collapsed, and instead of fading away, the flames grew in intensity. It kept growing and growing, and it only stopped after reaching a certain threshold.
“Each law has the potential of becoming the Grand Path. The fusion of the laws is difficult, but the advantage is that the special abilities that you comprehend would be very powerful. You belong to this category. The reason I’m saying this is because you have your inner world to support you,” Jun Sanqian said. “There is no superiority when it comes to Dao, but there is a power difference. For you, since you haven’t ascended yet, it would be hard to comprehend the Heavenly Immortal Dao. If you want to advance to the next step, there are only two ways. One of them is to enhance the origin of the inner world, and another is to comprehend the fusion dao. Do you know the origin of the inner world is so powerful? It’s because of the 3,000 laws. All of them form a whole, creating countless wonders and emitting a strong force.
“Of course, it doesn’t mean that you can abandon the rest of the Daos. Once you’ve comprehended them to perfection, you’ll reach a whole different level.
“The mortal world is too small, and there are a lot of limitations when it comes to comprehending laws and Daos.”
Jun Sanqian paused for a moment before continuing. “Alright, I guess that should be enough. Let me see if you have what it takes to defeat me or not. Let me warn you first. The Mystical Immortal Realm is on a whole different level compared to the True Immortal, especially the Mystical Immortal Dao. It can bring out countless wondrous effects and is powerful.”
Jiang Ming made a bow and charged at Jun Sanqian again.
He cast the World Projection, but it got destroyed in a matter of minutes.
Realizing that he couldn’t use this move anymore, he activated other special abilities, such as the Great Karma Technique and the Great Millennium Technique, but all of them were neutralized by Jun Sanqian with ease.
He then tried to defeat Jun Sanqian with the Astral Transformation and the Return of Infinite Law Finger but to no avail.
Suddenly, an idea popped into his head. He cast the Great Spiritual Technique, burning his inner world to conjure a sword of soul and attack Jun Sanqian’s soul.
After that, he followed up with the Return of Infinite Law Finger, and he finally defeated Jun Sanqian.
Although he won the fight, it was a bitter victory.
By the time Jiang Ming arrived at the 11th stage, he had already recovered.
“I suggest you not to use that again if it is not absolutely necessary. If not, you might really destroy yourself,” Jun Sanqian said. “That being said, I have to say that you truly have a lot of guts.”
“Well, I can only use it here.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Senior, can my inner world still recover if it burns out?”
“Well, it depends. The planar world can recover by itself, but it’s hard and comes with a cost. There’s a chance you might die on the spot too,” Jun Sanqian said with a serious expression. “Remember, if it’s not absolutely necessary, don’t ever try to burn your inner world. Even if you have no other choice but to use it, make sure you leave a way back for yourself.”
Jiang Ming nodded.
He did not attempt the stage and left.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation: Level 10
Points Accumulated: 22,109 (11879+10230)
Honor for the Eighth Level: 10 Heavenly Stages
To his surprise, he received 10,230 points for clearing 10 stages, and he had 22,109 points right now.
“After my inner world has evolved, maybe I can attempt the 11th and 12th stage as well as the Heavenly Ladder!”
Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh.
He was going to wait until his cultivation level had become stable. Then, he would go to get more special abilities before attempting the Heavenly Ladder and the Heavenly Stage. He sat in front of the Million Dao Chart.
He wouldn’t be disrupted if he cultivated here.
After he sat down, he was enveloped in a fog that cut him out of the outside world.
He did not know how long it had been, but his inner world had finally settled down. It was just that there was still nothing but a barren land inside.
“This is too slow!” Jiang Ming stood up and sighed.
He finally realized the drawbacks of evolving the inner world.
It took too much time.
He thought for a moment and came to the Heavenly Stage.
“Senior, can you help me to accelerate my time?” Jiang Ming asked carefully.
Jun Sanqian laughed when he heard what Jiang Ming had asked. “You really love to take advantage of other people. Well, I can do that, but I’m not going to help you this time. In fact, you can do it yourself.”
“Myself?” Jiang Ming was stunned, “It’s true that I can speed up the evolution process. It’s just that I’m worried I might mess up the laws in the inner world.”
“You don’t have to do it here. You can do it outside.”
“Do it outside? Isn’t it going to consume the origin force of the inner world? Wouldn’t that be bad?”
“You’re such a fool.”
“What do you mean, senior?” “You’ve comprehended the Time Dao, correct? All you need to do is make a time acceleration formation.”
“Well…” Jiang Ming froze. “I didn’t think of that. Thank you for the suggestion, senior.”
“Using the time acceleration formation to aid in the cultivation isn’t actually very useful for other people, but it’s a different case for you.”
Jiang Ming nodded and left.
He thought for a while and returned to reality.
It had only been an hour, and it was still morning.
The sun at 8:00 in the morning was bright. Jiang Ming closed his eyes for a moment. Everything that happened in reality appeared in his mind. He opened his eyes and said, “It’s time to get rid of some bugs!”

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - Suppressing the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 172 Suppressing the World
Jiang Ming used the World Monitoring Mirror to pinpoint the Submerged Dragon Continent. He zoomed in bit by bit, and the situation over there soon appeared in his vision. There was fire everywhere. The mountains were crumbling away, and the ground was cracking. Shouts and wails of agony could be heard everywhere, and the people were in pain.
(
It looked just like doomsday.
“I can understand why they want to kill cultivators, but they’re killing commoners too?”
Jiang Ming frowned, and a surge of killing intent erupted from him.
Although he was more powerful than most people, there was one thing that he had always insisted on, and that was that the feud between cultivators should not involve ordinary people.
The commoners already had a tough life. They were living at the bottom layer of the society, and now they had to be subjected to massacres?
He locked onto one person and began checking his information. When he found out that he was going to slaughter every living being in the Submerged Dragon Continent, Jiang Ming couldn’t hold himself back anymore. His figure disappeared, and when he reappeared again, he was at the Submerged Dragon Continent. He kept teleporting until he arrived in front of a lavishly decorated restaurant. There were a dozen people on the top floor. All of them had sat down together and were having a lot of fun.
“Seems like you guys are having a lot of fun!” Jiang Ming appeared. He snapped his finger and sealed the area around them.
The Human Path Records had also appeared on top of his head.
“Who are you?” The group of people rose to their feet. Some of them tried to activate their items to guard themselves, while the others tried to break through the seal by tearing the space. However, all of their efforts were wasted, and their expressions changed. “Who am I? I’m the one who came to take your lives!” Jiang Ming said. He then stared at the tallest man amongst the group and asked coldly, “Qi Chong, why are you slaughtering commoners? Won’t you feel guilty when you kill them?”
W
“You’re from this place? And you know me?” Qi Chong’s pupils were constricted as a surge of murderous intent erupted from him. “How do you know me?”
“Answer my question!” Jiang Ming said.
“Hmph! You must have a death wish!” a young man shouted angrily and threw his sword at Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming glanced at him, and he suddenly froze. Blood began to flow from his orifices, and he collapsed on the floor in the next second.
The young man was dead.
Jiang Ming had used the Great Spiritual Technique on him.
“Nine!”
The expressions of the rest of the people changed. They tried to save the young man, but they found that his soul had been destroyed.
“D*mn it!” Qi Chong growled as a bell that gave out a bright immortal light appeared on his head.
This was an immortal weapon.
Jiang Ming activated the World Projection and pinned them on the floor. Qi Chong tried to command his bell to attack, but he found that he couldn’t move at all. It felt as if the entire space around them had frozen in place.
“I want to know. Won’t you guys feel guilty when you kill the commoners?” Jiang Ming repeated his question.
Qi Chong’s face turned ashen pale in fear. It occurred to him that the man before him was much stronger than all of them here. “Who are you?” Qi Chong asked. Jiang Ming smiled, and his eyes glowed. He sealed their power away but amplified their sensation and feelings 1,000 times. Swoosh!
In the next second, multiple wind blades appeared in the air and fell on Qi Chong and his group, cutting through their flesh slowly.
Cries of pain rang out in the air.
Normally speaking, they wouldn’t even be bothered by such an attack. They wouldn’t even shed a single tear when they lost their limbs. However, things were different right
now.
Their feelings and sensation had been amplified by 1,000 times, not to mention that their power had been sealed away. They couldn’t even do anything right now, and all they could do was shout in pain.
“Won’t you guys feel guilty when you kill the commoners?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“Will you feel guilty when you kill an ant?” Qi Chong’s voice rang out amidst the cries. “Who are you, senior? Why are you attacking us? You aren’t someone from this place at all.”
“Well, it seems like I can’t expect monsters to have the heart of a human.”
Jiang Ming turned around.
Honestly, he had expected an answer like that.
He continued to torture them for a long while before destroying their souls. Jiang Ming stretched his arm and collected all the origin essence in the sky not far away. He absorbed them into his inner world to nourish the origin.
“Today is a good day for some hunting!”
Jiang Ming rushed here and there, and it took him merely a few minutes to kill all of the beneficiaries that came to his world. After that, he returned to the Jiuyang Sect.
On Chuyang Peak…
“Senior Brother, are you done already?” Five Elemental Linglong asked as she walked up to his side.
“Not yet,” Jiang Ming said. He pointed to the air in front of him, and the World Monitoring Mirror materialized itself.
“What is this, Senior Brother?”
“It’s the World Monitoring Mirror. It can see everything in this world.” “Really? That’s awesome!” Linglong exclaimed.
“See everything in this world?” Xi Yao was shocked as well. “So, can you find those intruders?”
Jiang Ming nodded. He flicked his finger, and a place appeared in the mirror.
It was a huge castle. The wall had crumbled, and the houses were on fire. Zombies and monsters were running on the street, and the people were wailing in agony.
“D*mn it!” Linglong growled.
“We’ve got to help them!” Xi Yao said.
Jiang Ming did not say anything. After checking the area, he disappeared again.
Since they had the guts to lay their hands on the commoners, he was going to kill them all.
This time, he killed most of the beneficiaries in different locations. One of them had three clones and was a lot stronger than the rest. That fellow was confident that he had the ability to slay an immortal, but unfortunately, he ran into him today, and there was only one ending for him-death.
It was already afternoon by the time he returned.
“Girl, go tell the Sect Master that there are no more intruders in Qing Province,” Jiang Ming said before throwing himself on the chair. He looked at the vines above him, and his heart was slowly calming down.
“Alright!” Five Elemental Linglong sent a message to the main peak. After that, she squatted in front of Jiang Ming and asked, “Do you feel better now?”
“Yeah!” Jiang Ming smiled, “I initially intended to get some rest today, but these things came out and ruined my plan.”
“Yeah. They’re the worst!” Linglong picked an orange from the fruit basket that the flower fairy carried over. After she peeled it, she popped one into Jiang Ming’s mouth.
Xi Yao was rendered speechless.
“Just because they disturbed you while you were resting, you killed them all?’
“I can say with certainty that you’re either the son of the world or the reincarnation of an immortal emperor!” Xi Yao said, “Only the son of the world is capable of seeing everything that’s happening around the world. Besides, Brother Jiang, have you ever used this skill to peek at girls while they are taking a bath?”
“That sounds pretty nice. Senior Brother, let’s watch it!” Five Elemental Linglong’s eyes glowed. “I’m sure it must be a pleasure to see a group of fairies taking a bath together. Should we start with Jiaoyang Peak first?”
“You’re becoming more and more like a demon, girl,” Jiang Ming said as he rolled his eyes at Linglong. He wanted to watch them take a bath as well, but he knew he couldn’t do
it.
“I thought you were going to get jealous, but it turns out that it’s your Senior Brother who got jealous,” Xi Yao said.
The sun was bright, but the weather was breezy. While the three of them were talking, Xi Yao was mumbling inwardly, ‘Just who is he? He’s so powerful, and I bet he hasn’t used his full strength yet. It took him only half a day, and he has already gotten rid of all those intruders. This is just too ridiculous.
‘Also, about that World Monitoring Mirror. Not only can he use it to observe the world, but it can also pinpoint the location of those intruders.
‘Besides, I can get different enlightenment every day I cultivate here. It’s even better than my Sacred Land. They’re known as Chuyang Peak on the surface, but I’m certain that their real identity must be terrifying.’ Suddenly, Xi Yao’s heart trembled, and a hint of inferiority rose from the bottom of her stomach pit.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - Ancient Immortal War, Slashing through the World, Ten Junior Sisters
chapters.content:
Chapter 173 Ancient Immortal War, Slashing through the World, Ten Junior Sisters
The Human Path Records was floating right in front of Jiang Ming as he flipped over to a certain page. Name: Spatial Linglong Race: Human Gender: Female
Cultivation Base: Dao Seed Realm
Background: Clone of Zi Linglong, a disciple of the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak
Relationship: 99 Innate Talent: Immortal (Spatial Daoist Body)
Status: Conceived through the creation of clones, great relation with Senior Brother, enjoys the joy of human life, turning obsession into emotions, heart bounded by the body, forever unchanged.
Went out to search for great encounters. Headed toward the Zhong Province and finally found the ruins of the ancient immortal war. Faced difficulties with each and every step as the dangers were boundless yet managed to turn the corner and reaped countless benefits from the encounters.
After reading the Status, Jiang Ming kept the Human Path Records. He often checked on the Status of Spatial Linglong to prevent any accidents from happening to her.
Never did he expect Spatial Linglong to have entered some sort of ruins of the ancient immortal war.
The word ‘ancient’ must be referring to ages ago. However, it was difficult to confirm whether immortals had participated in the immortal war.
And the word ‘ruins’ showed that the war must have been tragic and that this ruin had been hidden very well. Otherwise, it would have been discovered long ago, and Spatial Linglong wouldn’t have found it to this day. As Jiang Ming saw the phrase ‘faced difficulties with each and every step’, he was worried for her but couldn’t do anything for the time being.
That was Zi Linglong’s great encounter, and he did not want to disturb unless it was necessary.
As for the relationship value of 99, Jiang Ming smiled knowingly.
The phrase ‘obsession into emotions, heart bounded by the body, forever unchanged’ made Jiang Ming feel complicated.
He understood that he was everything to his Junior Sister, but what about the other way around?
Jiang Ming didn’t continue pondering over it.
After resting briefly, Jiang Ming could not stand being idle and got up to make lunch.
This time the menu was simple, a dish of Minced Meat Noodles.
The minced meat was quite good as it was made of venison from the Nine Colored Deer.
He had accidentally discovered the Nine Colored Deer when he was heading toward the Southern Region. He had seen this deer demon that radiated nine different colors and was truly a sight to behold. It looked very beautiful, which had led him to think that the taste would be great. Thus, he ended up butchering it.
By lunchtime, this ingredient was just right.
“Nine Colored Deer!” The corner of Xi Yao’s mouth twitched. “I’ve heard that there was a peerless Paradis deer demon with invincible special abilities in the Southern Region, hence reigning over the area. The seniors in my sect even commented before that this deer demon had the potential even to reach the Imminent Immortal Realm, yet who would’ve thought she became someone’s meal today.
“Brother Jiang, she’s a woman who had an alluring physique and a face that could launch 1,000 ships. Her body radiated nine layers of halo and had an extremely attractive body fragrance! How could you bear to behead her?”
“She was in demon form when I found her.” Jiang Ming didn’t expect it and added, “I didn’t expect that she had such a background.”
“You wouldn’t kill her if she was in her human form?”
“She looked delicious, and so I killed her. If she was in human form, where would I have the appetite for it?”
“You’re really… really…” Xi Yao was at a loss of words and ended up just smiling. “Fortunately, she was in her demon form. Otherwise, where could we enjoy such a delicacy? To think that Nine Colored Deer has nine different flavors! Such wonders!”
“Senior Brother, let’s catch all of the demons in the Southern Region and raise them in captivity. That way, we can eat them as we like,” Linglong suggested.
“This can be put into consideration.” Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up.
Xi Yao was simply shocked upon hearing what the two had just said.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for enjoying nine different tastes for a meal of lunch. You are rewarded with a part of the Sky Shattering Sword Technique.
Upon hearing the reminder, he was very surprised.
This sword technique’s strength was beyond the realm of the mortal world.
It could cut down boundless laws, cut through heaven and earth, and rip through the infinite space to launch attacks across portals. This was truly a peerless sword technique. A technique that was purely for killing. Jiang Ming separated part of his focus onto silently understanding the sword technique, but most of his focus was still on his inner world, where he was promoting its evolution and quickly absorbing the origin essence he obtained to strengthen his inner core.
The remaining invaders were all extremely frightened.
In a blink of an eye, more than 80% of the Lord God’s beneficiaries who were prepared to run rampant in the world were killed, leaving the rest in panic.
They quickly realized something strangewhoever killed the mortals would be quickly killed.
At this point, how could they still not understand what was happening? They must be monitored by an unknown existence. Killing the ordinary mortals was a big taboo, yet their mission was to eradicate the world!
How could they complete the mission if they couldn’t kill all of them?
The remaining beneficiaries were in total despair.
After pondering over their despair, they quickly turned their aim over to earning more points so that they won’t be eradicated for failing the mission. Thus, they began to hunt down the strong experts of various sects.
Relatively speaking, the Eastern Region was much calmer. The beneficiaries could only hunt down the experts from the Qingyun Sect in the Feng and Yun Provinces. Once their battleground went outside of the two provinces, they would be immediately killed.
Under this situation, not only were the beneficiaries startled, but the local forces were shocked as well. All of them recalled the same person, the one who had destroyed the foreign demons in the Northern Region.
Time slowly flowed by, and the mountain was as calm as ever.
It was the 20th of December, year 9,999 of the Great Zhou calendar.
That day, the real Junior Sister was about to end her cultivation session.
Her clones had all been formed completely.
The night quickly fell as the bright moonlight loomed over the skies.
Xi Yao was quietly meditating over the far north. Even so, the manor was still sealed shut.
“Senior Brother, what do you think?” Nine Junior Sisters asked at the same time. There was the tall one, the cute and helpless one, the voluptuous one, the young and inexperienced one, the mature one, and such. They were all similar yet different at the same time.
They surrounded Jiang Ming with smiles on their faces. They were swaying around, each showing their unique beauty.
“I’m dazzled!” Jiang Ming knew that this would eventually happen, but he was still a little stunned and at a loss of words when it
did.
“Hehehe!” Linglong could not help bursting into laughter as she held onto his arm. “There are 9 clones in total. Other than Spatial, there’s also Time, Yin-Yang, Five Elemental, Light-and-Darkness, Life-and-Death, Karma, Reincarnation, and Phoenix. I stripped out all my phoenix bloodline to form another clone so that I myself can merge with the Innate Saint Daoist Body.”
“Nine clones and the real you. That makes you a perfect ten, then?” Jiang Ming joked around.
“Yep! It’s a perfect ten! But Senior Brother, there’s only one of you!”
“Ahem, as long as the bed is big enough, then it’ll be fine!”
“Can you handle all of us, though?”
“Oh, you are underestimating me too much!”
That night was one without conversation.
On the evening of the next day, Jiang Ming came over to the rooftop, seemingly as though he was fleeing. He hunched over and trembled as he made himself a nourishing medicinal meal.
Upon finishing the medicinal meal, he felt much better.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for making and eating a satisfying meal. Rewarded a bottle of super-enhanced Rehmannia Six Formula.”
Jiang Ming silently raised a middle finger at it.
He was a person who could even kill immortals! What did he need these pills for?
He opened the bottle to take a sniff and was instantly hit with an energetic feeling, which made him feel like taking the pills.
He took a deep breath and carefully put the pills away.
“Senior Brother, should we have another night of Ten out of Nine tonight?” Linglong laughed softly.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless as he quickly changed the subject and asked, “Why do these clones all have different cultivation realms?”
“I’m actually just beginning to understand some of the Sambodha. Take the Time Sambodha and the Reincarnation Sambodha. for example. If the understanding of sambodha is weaker, then their cultivation will be weaker as well! However, I feel our cultivation will be able to reach its pinnacle up in the mountains quickly!
“Senior Brother, I discovered that cultivating on the bed had a great effect on our cultivations that’s even better than sudden enlightenment! You will have to work harder!” Linglong smiled. “Aren’t you worried that you might tire me to death?”
“Senior Brother, don’t think like I don’t know! You won’t be tired to death even if there’s another thousand of me! Hmph! Senior Brother, is it that you no longer like me? Should I maybe get Xi Yao over?”
“Screw you! What cultivation path is your real self currently taking?”
“The Innate Saint Daoist Body has a strong physique and a great affinity with boundless Daos. I plan on walking the path of cultivating physiques. As for the major cultivation, I’m not sure yet. I have clones that need to raise their cultivation base quickly, so I’m thinking of going for an easier Dao. Senior Brother, do you have any suggestions?” “An easy one?” Jiang Ming hesitated for a bit. He was pondering over which was considered easy. Wood, Fire, Earth, Gold, and Water were easy but way too easy.
Moreover, there was a Five Elemental clone already, so there was no need for them.
“I guess you should just base it on your current situation,” Jiang Ming replied. “Just walk the path depending on which Dao you prefer. I’ll assist you in your cultivation to reach the Imminent Immortal Realm as soon as possible.”
“I’ll go for the Sword Dao then!” Linglong thought for a moment before coming to a decision, “The Sword Dao can merge with boundless special abilities, has great offensive capability, and can also be used for defense.”
“That works,” Jiang Ming replied. “You have a lot of clones that are currently cultivating different Daos. If you merge all the Daos into your Sword Dao, with boundless Dao all into a single furnace, you might even pave a new path on the Sword Dao!”
“Since it’s been decided, I’ll go cultivate right now!” Linglong waved before leaping into the air, flying toward the spiritual farm behind. Before leaving, she left a message saying, “The eight of them will take turns with you. Let them quickly reach the pinnacle of the Dao Seed. Once I break through myself, it will allow them to improve even further.”
“Should I be happy or depressed?” Jiang Ming had a complicated expression and sighed inexplicably.
Jiang Ming quietly dispersed the seal.
As he looked over the other peaks, he discovered divine lights that were constantly rising along with excited laughter from time to time. He understood that those were the disciples breaking through.
It used to happen occasionally, but it now happened almost every time of the day.
Jiang Ming’s divine sense swept through the peaks and discovered that the number of people who had reached the Core Formation Realm had doubled. It was unbelievable that this happened in such a short time.
However, he understood that these were the results of their accumulation of cultivation in the past. When the surroundings of the sect went through drastic changes, it transformed this accumulation into sublimation, causing so many of them to break through.
At that moment, a stream of light flew over.
Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed it, quickly realizing it was a message from Gu Hai. It was written there would be a selection of disciples by the sect in ten days’ time to replace the ones that had been lost. He was asking for Linglong and him to come over together and see if there was anyone that matched their taste and make them direct disciples.
“Expanding?”
The last time the sect had experienced an invasion, quite many were lost in battle.
Now that the sect was trying to expand, the remaining disciples seemed to be at a lower number. Since the sect had stabilized, it was naturally the best time to be recruiting disciples.
“Another ten days will also be the day the 10-year duration is up.” Jiang Ming gazed afar with much anticipation.
It was going to be a whole 10 years! What might be the reward? What surprises will there be?
“First Seat Jiang!” Chang Yiming flew from afar as his clothes fluttered in the air with that round belly of his. He was always cheerful and carefree but had a gloomy face this time around.
Jiang Ming had a bad feeling that something had happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - The Night Devil King Emerged and Immortal General Awakened
chapters.content:
Chapter 174 The Night Devil King Emerged and Immortal General Awakened
Chang Yiming sat down on top of the roof as Jiang Ming poured him a cup of tea and pushed it over to him.
After being silent for a while, Chang Yiming finally spoke up, “Brother Zhang is dead!”
“How did he die?” Jiang Ming was taken aback by the shocking news.
Brother Zhang was a gentle and elegant person, topped off with his handsome looks and extraordinary potential. There were few who could even be compared to him in the sect. Being such an outstanding and strong person, how did he suddenly die like that?
Chang Yiming slowly explained the details of his demise, “The expansion of our sect requires the elite disciples to stand guard. As Chunyang Peak’s head disciple, Zhang Junbao was no exception. However, with so many forces that tried to invade the Jiuyang Sect previously, there were naturally a few who escaped and retreated successfully. Many of them retaliated and killed quite a number of our disciples, including Brother Zhang.”
“Doesn’t our sect own a bunch of Dao Vessels? Did Brother Zhang not have one?” Jiang Ming asked.
“He did, but he did not have much time to fully integrate the Dao Vessel before they were set up again. Because he couldn’t fully exert its power, he ended up dead in the siege,” Chang Yiming replied with a bitter smile.
“What about the enemy?”
“We tracked them down and killed every one of them!”
Upon hearing his answer, Jiang Ming was silent/ He did not even have the chance to take revenge.
There was a sudden instance of depression looming through the air.
The two continued chatting while drinking tea.
Because of this incident, the First Seat of Chunyang Peak went crazy and slaughtered many of the enemies. The sect even caused a bloodbath in various places all over the Qing Province. Who knew how many cultivators were killed at that time?
“Senior Brother Chang, what do you say if you stay here up in the mountains to cultivate? It’s safer here, and there shouldn’t be many restrictions either. If you have any queries, you can ask me anytime.” Jiang Ming managed to convince Chang Yiming to stay.
He had only a few friends in the sect, and one of them had now died.
Although the uprising and death of cultivators were but a norm, it was still difficult for a person to let go if it fell on oneself. All in all, there was nothing that could be done.
Chang Yiming did not leave and created his own residence on the edge of a cliff. He was prepared to continue his cultivation there. In his own words, he claimed that if he didn’t become powerful, he wouldn’t stop cultivating.
Jiang Ming had his dinner that night with Yin-Yang Junior Sister.
Among the variety of dishes on the huge table, the ingredients used were the ones flying in the sky, the ones that lurked in the earth, and those that swam in the water. Each dish was gleaming in bright luminance as its fragrance pampered everyone’s nose.
Moreover, there was even the company of beautiful women. It was truly a delicious meal.
“Senior Brother, these are really delicious!” Yin-Yang Lingolong happily enjoyed her meal as she requested, “I want to eat this every day!”
“Alright! Even three meals a day is not a problem!”
“Senior Brother, you’re the best!”
“Haha! Of course I am!” “Senior Brother, finish your meal faster so that we can resume training.” “Training?” “Yeah! Training on the bed!”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but cough upon hearing her answer.
“Yin and Yang are the great Daos of the mortal realm. You are Yang, while I am Yin. The harmony of Yin and Yang complements each other and is truly a good fortune. Isn’t there a saying that says Lust and Gluttony are the human sins and virtue? Comprehending the mystery of Yin-Yang after a satisfying meal is the natural way of the great Dao!”
“You cheeky girl! Wait, something’s not right. Why do I feel that each of you has a different personality? I thought all the clones’ personalities should follow the original one, right?”
“Senior Brother, that’s where you are wrong. The formation of our characters has innate factors, such as the embodiment of the real flesh and blood, and there are also the acquired factors, such as the living environment. I have a newly formed body, so I will naturally be affected and form a distinct personality. Fret not, Senior Brother. We are all clones of the original one and will never become truly independent in any case.”
“As long as you can control yourself, then everything’s good.”
“Hehe, if you’re finished with your meal, let’s go. You are mine tonight, but tomorrow it won’t be my turn anymore.
“I-I… Why do I feel so awkward?”
“You are pushing your luck! Different companions every day, different partners every night!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
Suddenly, the system’s reminder popped up.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for enjoying a meal of Yin-Yang, eating eagerly and restlessly. Rewarded with a bottle of lubricant and a set of black and white laced stockings!”
Jiang Ming almost choked on his meal!
‘Son of a… To think that such a reward would even come up! Are you taking me for a fool!?’ Jiang Ming sealed off the manor with a wave of his hand as he carried Yin-Yang Linglong back into his room.
It was a night of repetitive exercise, swaying side to side and thrusting back and forth.
Up above one of the mountains in the Southern Region, a sudden deafening blast resounded.
“A terrifying wave of aura dispersed wildly from the top of the mountain peak. Its trembling power traveled through the air as the power of laws slowly materialized, rendering the mountain unable to bear such force, and it collapsed.
“Haha! I’ve finally stepped into the Extreme Path Realm!”A loud peal of laughter could be heard coming from the cave’s interior
A burly middle-aged man rose into the air, suppressing the dust and mist as he landed on top of another mountain. His body radiated with a violent aura that could twist the laws and suppress boundless Daos.
At that moment, he suddenly screamed abruptly. Blood started to spurt out of his seven orifices, turning into streaks of fiery snakes as he clenched his arms over his head and shrieked in pain. Boundless energy radiated into the surroundings, destroying anything and everything. Even the mountains below collapsed from the sheer power.
“Who is this? Who are you? Why are you in my bloodline? Why did you emerge in my Paradis subconscious?
“Damn it! You’re trying to take over me?”
He continued screaming incessantly.
Yet, after a short while, he stopped screaming and waved over his hand in a domineering gesture. His eyes stared into the world with an overbearing look.
“I, the Devil King, have finally been reborn!” He placed his hands behind his back and respired a massive amount of heaven and earth energy. It allowed his body’s power to continue skyrocketing after the breakthrough as though there was no end to it.
“Nine bloodline demon seeds, and only this one here remains!” the Devil King sighed. “One is fine.
“However…” He raised his head, gazed at the sky, and felt the boundless aura of death, suffocation, resentment, and curses through heaven and earth. He couldn’t help but frown. “This world here. Why does this world feel so shattered? It shouldn’t be! What happened here? Is it about to start?”
He closed his eyes and slowly absorbed the memories of his body.
“Northern Region, invasion by foreign devils yet were all killed by one person, and even the portal was destroyed? At least thousands of Level 10 experts were killed? “How is that possible?
“People from foreign territories descend to different places. The human race is spreading rumors about the apocalypse. Could it be that organization? This is really troublesome!
“Why has this world changed so much?
“I’m afraid it will be difficult to deal with this issue with the current transformed devil body of mine. I need first to collect a few things and gather a group of men! “After waiting for hundreds of millions of years, even if the world gets destroyed, I will investigate thoroughly this time no matter what.”
With a swift sway, the Devil King disappeared without a trace.
At the Tianyuan School of Zhong Province…
A person walked out of the time room in the forbidden area. That person was none other than Tian Ci. Only this time, there were various huge changes to him.
His eyes were deep like swamps, and his aura was like the abyss. With his hand behind his back, he gazed into the night sky, and his calm face suddenly flashed a strange look.
“My accumulation of cultivation is always enough. My last defeat against Zi Linglong allowed me to comprehend the Light-and-Dark Dao. This time I shut myself into cultivation in the time house, broke through a few realms, and finally reached the Paradis Realm! Who would have thought I’d awaken my past memories! Immortal General, ha, I’m an Immortal General!
“Only a strand of immortal soul left and was projected into this world with even a mission at hand.
“Golden Heaven Path.
“And the Mystical Light Sword has actually been robbed off? Who can even rob such a thing in this world here? Who is it?
“With my memories awakening and being in the Tianyuan School here, one of the ancient forces, there is no shortage of resources. I can step into the Imminent Immortal Realm in a short time and start planning!
“I will definitely unearth the secret this time!” As Tian Ci took a step forward, the lights distorted, and he disappeared without a trace.
In a glimpse of an eye, 10 days passed by.
Tomorrow would be the beginning of the 10,000 years of the great Zhou Calendar. On the year’s last night, Jiang Ming stood on top of the roof overlooking the spiritual field.
Zi Linglong’s real self was sitting cross-legged on top of the spiritual mountain surrounded by a few of her clones as all of their cultivations were skyrocketing. It was especially faster for her real self as she had the Innate Saint Daoist Body, with a great physique, and possessed boundless Dao fluctuations. Along with the blessing of the supreme memories, her major cultivation of Sword Dao was rising rapidly. Without the need to comprehend the Spatial, Time, Five Elemental, Yin-Yang, and other Sambodha, there was nothing that restricted her progress.
Her cultivation rose rapidly as though leaping a realm every single day.
She extracted the endless spiritual qi from the spiritual mountains, integrated it into herself, and also practiced the sexual cultivation technique that suited her Saint Daoist Body, which sped up her cultivation beyond anyone’s imagination.
Speeding through the Dao Seed and Nascent Soul realms, she advanced into the Primal Spirit Realm in only 10 days’ time, which was incredible.
Even Jiang Ming was shocked by her progress and commented, “By majoring on a single Dao, coupled with ample resources, Junior Sister’s cultivation speed is truly terrifying. She should be the child of destiny, the child of luck, and the child of the word! If I didn’t have the system, how could I even compare to her?”
He saw several long rivers of spiritual qi that appeared around Zi Linglong, constantly merging into her body. It was as though she was a black hole that was constantly devouring.
“If she was cultivating in the outside world, she would’ve sucked dry the spiritual qi in the sect within the time it takes to drink a cup of tea.” Jiang Ming shook his head and laughed. ‘Not sure if the Paradis Realm might stop Junior Sister on her track?’
Just as Jiang Ming pondered over it, the void above Linglong’s head was distorted, and a shadow appeared suddenly. The shadow then continued evolving into a spatial void that was filled with boundless sword energy.
Such heteromorphism was obviously the projection of the Paradis Realm. “This…” Jiang Ming was speechless and utterly shocked. ‘In the past, cultivation of various different Sambodhas, coupled with a limited supply of spirit crystals and other resources, had restricted the growth of Junior Sister. Now that she’s majoring in cultivating a single Dao, she has become a genuine phoenix that is deafening through the nine skies. Or rather…’ Jiang Ming thought of another possibility. “Could it be that I accidentally pierced her limiter?’

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - Great Rewards for the Tenth Year, The Reincarnation Transmigration Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 175 Great Rewards for the Tenth Year, The Reincarnation Transmigration Technique
The time was exactly 00:00 on the 1st of January, Year 10,000 of the Great Zhou Calendar.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for living on Chuyang Peak for ten continuous years and insisting on working and cooking daily. Rewarded with 1,000 wisps of origin essence, five strips of top-grade spiritual veins, a set of Sword Tome, one Universe Sword, one Universe Furnace, and one Ofuda Talisman.”
The rewards were not many. In fact, very few rewards were given, yet each of them was exquisite!
Origin essence: Each strip was akin to a long river where there was an overwhelming power of creation embedded in it.
Jiang Ming directly merged them into his inner world. In an instant, the origin essence rapidly decomposed and integrated into every corner of the world, causing the order of the world to accelerate by 10,000-folds abruptly.
The inner world’s area was also expanding rapidly.
Originally, Jiang Ming had killed a lot of beneficiaries and gotten his hands on quite a number of origin essences. Upon absorption, his inner world had expanded from its original 1-million-mile radius into a 1.2-million-mile radius already. Now that the inner world further absorbed 1,000 strips of origin essence, its area expanded directly to about 1.5 million miles and was still expanding rapidly.
The spatial condition of the inner world became much more stable, and the spiritual qi was getting denser. The law of order was also tuned to a perfect state as the core continuously expanded.
Such rapid improvement was truly astounding.
“Once the strips of origin essence merge completely, I wonder what extent my inner world will reach.” Jiang Ming was thrilled about it.
