At the same time, waves of energy were fed back into his physique. He quickly evoked the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra to temper his body, allowing it to grow stronger constantly.
Such overall enhancement was from the inside out.
Jiang Ming did not pause and continued placing the other five strips of spiritual veins to merge into the lands of his inner world.
The spiritual veins were of top grade, which was rare even in the Tianyuan World.
Not only could they automatically evolve the spiritual qi and sort out the ley lines, but they also had the effect of suppressing the earth, atomically making different kinds of leylines condense and operate in an orderly manner.
The most important thing was that it could also improve the world’s core and expand its space.
‘After all these completely merge with my inner world, will my inner world directly reach its perfect state? The system’s rewards are still the best!’
Jiang Ming felt powerful as if it was an enhancement after breaking through a realm. Sword Tome: Expounding the supreme Sword Dao.
m
Universe Sword: Level 14 Immortal Soldier, possesses unparalleled attack.
Universe Furnace: Level 14 Immortal Weapon, able to refine weapons and pills. It can be used for defense and suppression. Ofuda Talisman: Restricted by the Dao contract, it can be integrated into those who are of a lower realm than the caster, forming a slave or servant connection between the casters as though the person was a puppet. It does not change the will, nor does it distort the heart, and it is difficult to be detected or changed without the power of the Great Dao.
They were great items, especially the sword and the furnace, which were both absolutely supreme weapons. After imprinting the weapons with droplets of blood, Jiang Ming directly merged the Universe Furnace into his inner world to use it as an item from suppression and to be used as protection at the same time.
After all, the inner world was fundamental, and he could not risk anything happening to it.
Now that he owned such an item, he had a better guarantee of his inner world’s safety.
He thought, ‘What was the most insane of all was the Ofuda Talisman! My goodness! A deed for forcing enslavement? This is over the top already! How can they be enslaved without changing the person’s will or distorting the heart? Moreover, it cannot be detected and changed unless the power of Great Dao is used. This… It’s too outrageous! “The only downside is that the person you use it on cannot exceed the level of your own realm, which is a little ineffective, to say the least.’ Jiang Ming was out of words. Even the Great Dao was mentioned, and yet the item could not be used against those stronger than himself. Just thinking about it hurt!
‘I’m afraid that it will take another 10 years for the next great batch of rewards!’ Jiang Ming thought as he walked out of his room.
He sat on top of the roof and watched as the moonlight bathed over the land.
With a few taps, he took out the World Monitoring Mirror and saw that there were not many lights, only 10 or so left.
‘I’ll just let you cause some trouble!’ He did not plan to continue paying attention to them. He would leave them to the many Sacred Lands to deal with them.
Even if some incidents happened in the future, he could just kill them at any time.
Jiang Ming lay on a rattan chair, swaying slowly and enjoying the tranquility of the night.
He evoked the Human Path Records to take a look at his own Status.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Imminent Immortal Realm
Major Cultivation: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Special Ability: Return of Infinite Law Fingers, Astral Transformation, Heaven Shattering Sword Technique, Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Unlimited Killing Punch; The Great Spatial Technique, The Great Millennium Technique, The Great Body Protection Technique, Great Five Elemental Technique, Great Yin-Yang Technique and etc.
Innate Talent: Immortal (Tertiary Daoist Body)
Item: Human Path Records, Supreme Order; Saint Province Dao Square, Sword Tome, Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, Ofuda Talisman; Level 14: Universe Sword, Universe Furnace: [Immortal Soldier: Mystical Light Sword, Heavenly War Blade, Heavenly Feathered Shirt, Celestial Soul Bell, Starry Hall, Heavenly Ark]; Top graded Dao Vessel Combat Mannequin, One Special Ability Bead, 5-Minute Extreme Path Experience Card.
Support: Primary Training Zone
Jiang Ming’s Status did not have huge changes. What was more obvious was that his cultivation base had risen to the Imminent Immortal Realm, the Sky Shattering Sword Technique was added to his special abilities, and he had a few additional Dao Vessels.
The next morning…
“Senior Brother, today the sect will be holding a ceremony to accept new apprentices. Are you planning on taking in any disciples?” Linglong asked while she was helping to stir the egg mixture herself. “We’ll see what happens.” Jiang Ming hesitated, “After all, Chuyang Peak is one of the main peaks. It wouldn’t make sense if there were only the two of us here at the peak. What about you? Do you have any plans to take in disciples?”
“I’m only 20 years old, for crying out loud. How can I accept disciples when I’m still so young myself?”
“Haha! You seem to realize that you are still young!”
“Am I really young, though?” Linglong asked as she puffed out her chest, causing Jiang Ming’s nose to feel warm suddenly.
It was a simple breakfast that morning.
After the meal, the rewards came, and this time it was one Blood Dominator Pill. Upon consuming the pill, it could alter the person’s bloodline to become the Celestial Tyrant Body, truly a potent effect.
Chang Yiming walked over and asked, “Brother Jiang, shall we go together?” “Let’s go,” Jiang Ming replied swiftly before asking, “Are you prepared to accept disciples of your own?”
“Of course I am!” Chang Yiming answered with a smile. “After all, I’m already in the Purple Mansion Realm and am currently the head disciple ofLaoyang Peak. I’ve long qualified for this. Given the opportunity this time around, I will take in a disciple one way or the other. My disciple will be doing all the hard work, and I’ll just be the shopkeeper resting at the back!”
“If your Senior Uncle knew you had such a plan in mind, you would surely be getting a beating from him!”
Chang Yiming only chuckled as the three walked away together.
On Reception Peak…
There was a huge square, which was made by cutting off the top of a mountain, with jaded white bridges connecting the places together. The surroundings were shrouded with a thin mist as though it was a scene straight from an immortal’s dwelling.
There were tens of thousands of teenagers gathered in the square.
Most of them were in their early teen years. They were all great seedlings selected all over Qing Province, each giving off a feeling of ignorance but was ablaze with fervent.
It was especially true for the ones who were looking at the Sect Master and the others who were standing mid-air. The fiery spirit burning in the teenagers’ eyes looked as though it was materializing due to them getting overly high-spirited. Many people would have to kneel upon seeing these masters if they weren’t strictly warned.
“Linglong, Ming, Yiming, you have arrived!” Upon seeing the three of them, the Sect Master immediately greeted them. Although it wasn’t that obvious, it was clear that he was very enthusiastic. The rest of the First Seats also came over. All of them knew that everything the Jiuyang Sect had today was Zi Linglong’s doing.
“Hail the Sect Master!” Jiang Ming clenched his fist, greeting with a bow as Zi Linglong did the same.
The Sect Master was a little flattered and ecstatic in his heart. From Jiang Ming’s gesture, he clearly saw that Jiang Ming didn’t give off a distant feeling toward the sect, nor was he arrogant at all, still regarding himself as a disciple of the Jiuyang Sect.
That much was already enough for him.
“You don’t have to be too polite!” The Sect Master waved his hand quickly and asked, “Planning to accept a disciple today?”
“I’ll have a look first. Sect Master, are there any rules here?” Jiang Ming asked.
“It’s very simple!” The Sect Master answered, “Each main peak can first select those they think possess excellent aptitude and bring the candidates back to their respective peaks. The rest of the candidates will be temporarily placed in the outer sect and undergo training together. In 3 years’ time, if these candidates do not meet the requirements, they will have to return to where they came from, whereas those who meet the requirement will be officially enlisted as outer disciples.”
Jiang Ming understood the process clearly upon listening to the Sect Master’s explanation.
Back then, he hadn’t gone through such a process as Gu Hau had brought him back to Chuyang Peak to be his direct disciple. It was truly a major leap, skipping the whole process.
If he had to start from being in the outer sect, he would have had to grow slowly, fight for resources, cultivate diligently, and finally reach the Foundation Establishment Realm before he could apply to become the inner disciples of one of the main peaks.
“Junior Brother Gu Hai intends to hand over the position as the First Seat to you. You seem to be wise and responsible, so you will temporarily take on the First Seat position. There are very few people at Chuyang Peak, so we will let you choose first. If you see any of them that suit you, feel free to choose one or two of them.” the Sect Master thoughtfully offered.
“Alright!” Jiang Ming took up on his offer and continued. “Sect Master, I’ll be using our Chuyang Peak’s selection method then.” “You may!” Sect Master nodded with a smile on his face.
He took a short glance at Zi Linglong and quickly noticed that she was standing right next to Jiang Ming the whole time, not saying a word. In his heart, he now fully understood what Gu Hai meant when he said, “That little girl Linglong! I’ve raised her in vain! She treats her Senior Brother better than me!”
Jiang Ming glanced through tens of thousands of these teenagers, all full of energy and brimming with spirit.
Those that were brought up to the mountains must have gone through selections and were all good seedlings.
Jiang Ming transmitted a few words to Zi Linglong, and she quickly leaped up in the air. An invincible wave of energy shrouded the whole square with just a simple thought.
In an instant, the tens of thousands of teenagers suddenly found that all figures beside them had disappeared, and they were left all alone.
The sky darkened, quickly turning pitch black, and soon they realized they couldn’t even see their own fingers if they wanted.
It felt as if a huge mountain was pressing down on them, trying to pressure and suffocate them.
Most of the teenagers knew that this was a test. Even so, when placed in absolute darkness, they couldn’t help but start to panic and get scared.
In their minds, such terrifying pressure was forcing them to break down.
One by one, the teenagers’ eyes slowly became dull, and their bodies began to sway. Some of them fell head first, and the darkness immediately faded, and so did the overwhelming pressure.
They noticed that their feet were still planted on the square, and they were still surrounded by teenagers.
Their faces turned pale as they knew that they were finished in their hearts.
The teenagers fell face down one after another as the Sect Master and the rest watched in silence.
“This is just a test of will.” Lieyang Peak’s First Seat, Dongfang Lie, transmitted to the Sect Master, “Accepting disciples should be based on the root bones. Sect Master, is she correct for selecting disciples in such a way? Even if the person has a strong will, their cultivation will be immensely slow, and their potential will be limited with a weak root bone!”
“Junior Brother Dongfang, you’re looking at the small picture.” The Sect Master casually transmitted, “Do you think she doesn’t have anything that can change a person’s root bone with her? In her perspective, the root bone isn’t that important to her.
“On the contrary, what’s important to her is a person’s will and comprehension. If a person has a will of steel, they will possess a firm mind. As for comprehension? With the current resources available for cultivation, it isn’t comparatively as important as a person’s will.” “This…” Dongfang Lie smiled bitterly. “You’re right. The sect has been developing way too fast. My vision has been a little too short.”
The Sect Master took the matter seriously.
In the end, 10 people slowly rose up in the square. They had dull eyes and were trembling all over as though they might fall down at any moment.
Obviously, this was Zi Linglong’s intention, as it was easier to distinguish them apart from the rest by floating them in mid-air.
Of course, the remaining 10 candidates were extraordinary compared to the rest.
Jiang Ming slowly inspected each and every one of them.
His pupils quickly shrank when his eyes locked onto one of the young girls with two ponytails. ‘The Reincarnation Transmigration Technique! There’s even such a special ability! This is a great technique indeed!’

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - Fifth Immortal Moon
chapters.content:
Chapter 176 Fifth Immortal Moon
Jiang Ming looked up the girl’s Status in the Human Path Records.
Name: Liu Xin (Fifth Immortal Moon)
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation Base: Qi Cultivation
Background: The youngest daughter of the Liu Clan (Fifth clan of the Yin-Yang Small Chiliocosm. Note: Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary, one of the members of the fifth squad)
Relationship: -28
Innate Talent: Immortal (Innate Daoist Body)
Status: Originally a Heaven Reincarnation Hall’s beneficiary. She and her teammates accepted an SSS-grade mission: to destroy the Jiuyang Sect. She was the child of a concubine, but her birth was accompanied by great heteromorphism, and she was persecuted. Although her life was spared, her core was damaged. Suffering many ailments, she struggled to survive during her childhood. By chance, she was invited to join the Reincarnation Hall as one of the beneficiaries and used her wisdom to obtain great opportunities time after time. Not only did it make up for her shortcomings, but it also increased her cultivation step by step.
The Reincarnation Hall posted an SSS-grade mission, and she was tempted by it. She planned that once she received the rewards from completing the mission, and coupled with her years of boundless accumulation of cultivation, she’d step into the peerless Immortal Dao. She could even excel on the path toward Immortal. She planned on returning to her clan one day to take her revenge.
She understood that there was a high probability that the whole team would be decimated in an SSS-grade mission. She knew she had to be extra careful along every step of the way.
Upon descending to this world, she separated herself from her teammates and used an immortal weapon to cut off any connection with the outside world. After arriving at a mortal city, she evoked a supreme special ability to merge herself among the commoners, covered up her tracks further, and waited for the other teams to investigate the strength of the Jiuyang Sect before making the next move. When she looked through the system’s list and saw her teammates killed overnight and the numbers of beneficiaries that descended into the world declining drastically, she was horrified.
She suddenly understood that it was impossible to hide like this and that she would surely be found out. By then, her death would have been imminent. However, she could not forcefully return to her world, and there was nothing that she could have done about it. Gritting her teeth, she took a gamble and evoked the forbidden Reincarnation Transmigration Technique. Merging her own soul with a sacrificial reincarnation figure, she turned herself into a native being and further forged the body that she had taken over by sacrificing her own Dao to restructure an Innate Daoist body all over again.
The only flaw was that her previous cultivation would be in vain as she had to start over from the beginning
As she prepared to retreat into cultivation and scheme another day, she unexpectedly learned that the Jiuyang Sect was recruiting disciples. She instantly hatched a plan and portrayed her talents. After a little more effort, she was selected to be a reserved disciple and easily came to the Jiuyang Sect.
The girl’s emergence surprised Jiang Ming again and again.
He had never discovered this Fifth Immortal Moon!
To think that she had used the Reincarnation Transmigration Technique to fuse herself with a native being, cleansing herself of everything that an invasive foreigner had, yet her cultivation would all be in vain. Such a ruthless and decisive person!
If she didn’t come before him today, he would have never been able to find this person.
“Such a mysterious special ability, able to forge a person’s body and even turn the reincarnated body into an Innate Daoist body. Unbelievable, simply unbelievable. It seems I’m really underestimating the world here.” Jiang Ming sighed as the pride in his heart eased a little.
Who would have thought that even the World Monitoring Mirror was unable to detect such a person?
But it wasn’t too surprising, for he hadn’t sorted out each invader in detail as there were too many of them.
After Jiang Ming secretly transmitted his finding over to Zi Linglong, she purposely selected two disciples from the ten of them and left the place with the two.
The other peaks scrambled to recruit the remaining eight candidates.
Chang Yiming also stayed behind as he was prepared to choose a batch of disciples for himself slowly.
At Chuyang Peak..
After the two sat down on top of the roof, in front of them stood two teenage girls who were in their early teens with cowardly expressions on their faces.
The two looked delicate and charming.
One of them was Liu Xin, Fifth Immortal Moon.
The other was Mo Xiaoyu, who had Eight-Star innate talent with an extraordinarily strong will. Based on her Status in the Human Path Records, her character was also quite good. “Senior Brother, is there anything special about the two of them?” Linglong asked.
“Xiaoyu is quite good. Teach her well. You can take her with you and accept her as a disciple,” Jiang Ming responded.
Linglong had thoughts on his response and took another closer look at Liu Xin before she flicked her wrist, leaving the place and taking Xiaoyu with her. Liu Xin was a little overwhelmed with her eyes filled with confusion as she didn’t know what to do.
She felt like a lamb in a lion’s den.
“I should really give you an Oscar award,” Jiang Ming suddenly muttered. Liu Xin’s pupils immediately shrank, “YouWhat are you talking about? I don’t understand!” she retorted in confusion. “Fifth Immortal Moon,” Jiang Ming smiled, “Need I say more?”
Now that she was already face to face with him, there was no point in hiding anymore.
“How did you know?” Liu Xin, or rather Fifth Immortal Moon, had a shocking look on her face before smiling bitterly. “Never would I expect that I would personally send myself to you. It shouldn’t be! I severed all connections and karma and completely merged into this world. You shouldn’t be able to find out about me at all! How did you discover who I am?
“Also, when you said ‘Oscar’, this phrase shouldn’t be something that would come out of your mouth! Who exactly are you? Were you the one who killed all of them? But you are only 28 years old and are a mere Chuyang Peak’s First Seat, so rationally, it would be impossible for you to be the one who did that. Yet.. Yet… Yet the Jiuyang Sect had too many things that were not logical, to begin with!”
She was starting to become disoriented. All her questions were on point as well, yet Jiang Ming didn’t answer them. Instead, he asked her, “Do you want to live or die?”
“Of course I want to live. You plan to release me?” Fifth Immortal Moon’s eyes lit up with a glimpse of hope.
Jiang Ming didn’t mind her acting at all, nodded, and replied, “Of course!”
He took out the Ofuda Talisman and was prepared to use it on her.
Although this item seemed to be exceptional, it was pleasant to the eyes but of no use. The person that he wanted to enslave couldn’t exceed his own cultivation realm.
Even if he became a Saint in the future, the most he could do would be to enslave another Saint. What use would that be?
It would be better just to try it out now and see if it really had those terrifying effects, as seen from the item’s description.
“Open up your consciousness, and I will plant an imprint onto you.” Jiang Ming didn’t keep a secret about what he was doing.
Fifth Immortal Moon struggled briefly before bitterly saying, “It is better to die swiftly than to live in vain. Alas, I accept my fate. I only hope that you will treat me kindly in the future!”
“Once you join me and follow my rules, I will naturally treat you well.” Jiang Ming smiled inexplicably.
He was looking up the Human Path Records and discovered that her Status was quite interesting as well.
Status: ‘Who is he? He even used the word “Oscar”. “Oscar” is a word only the world of science fiction has. Did he learn this from the other beneficiaries? Or could it be that he has other complicated identities?
‘I’ve severed every string of karma and cut all means of retreat by performing the Reincarnation Transmigration Technique! I’ve done so much to this extent, yet he was still able to discover who I am! How did he do that? Oh, my life is so pitiful!
‘So many of the beneficiaries were killed, all because of him? Was the SSS-grade mission initiated because of him? It must be! If not, how could he have figured out my identity!
‘Sigh, am I about to die? I’m not willing to accept this!
‘Gosh! He is trying to enslave me? He doesn’t know my identity as a beneficiary of the Reincarnation Hall? Hahaha! Great! That’s wonderful! Once I return to my world, any enslavement would be in vain!
‘Haha! This is such a turnaround. I’ll first seal off part of my memories to prevent him from looking through them. I’ll stay on Chuyang Peak and continue my cultivation from now on. Even if I’ve failed the mission, I can at least clearly investigate Chuyang Peak and understand everything about them. Maybe this will reduce the punishment for failing the mission by a little.
‘And the most crucial point of all, I have to figure out how he found out about my current identity. This is simply unbelievable. I won’t be able to sleep or eat in peace if I cannot understand how he discovered me!’
Fifth Immortal Moon thought that Jiang Ming hadn’t found out about her real identity.
In reality, Jiang Ming clearly saw the thoughts racing through her mind, and there wasn’t any secret left covered.
Jiang Ming continued smiling when he placed the Ofuda Talisman onto Fifth Immortal Moon’s forehead as it slowly merged into her.
He stared at the Human Path Records and discovered that her Status did not have any reminder from the Reincarnation System.
Then, he realized that he was in total control of everything about the other person-life and death, all the past memories, and he could even control the other person’s body and share their sight.
Fifth Immortal Moon no longer had any secrets from him from that moment on.
It was as if she was a puppet with a will of her own, and it didn’t prompt anything from the Reincarnation System either.
‘This Ofuda Talisman is truly terrifying!’ Only after using it did Jiang Ming realize how terrifying the Ofuda Talisman was.
He was also excited about it. The Reincarnation System didn’t notice anything unusual when she was in this world. If she returned to the Reincarnation Hall and still the system didn’t detect anything amiss, that would be even better!
When the time came, it would be as though he had placed an undercover agent into the Reincarnation Hall.
‘It’s a shame that there’s only one of this Ofuda Talisman. If I had a few more of these, I could control a few beneficiaries of the Lord God
Space!’
As these thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind, he quickly realized something. Fifth Immortal Moon didn’t feel any discomfort at all and didn’t seem to notice that she was under someone else’s control. However, she was good at acting and showed a panicked expression. She then sighed and bitterly said, “Master, from now on, I am yours!”
The corners of Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched upon hearing her remarks, and he pointed outside. “Besides the manor, you can find a place or a cave or even build a house and cultivate on your own. Remember, call me ‘Master’ from now on!”
“Yes, Master!” Fifth Immortal Moon honestly knelt down and bowed three times before leaving ‘reluctantly’.
Jiang Ming had a playful expression on his face.
This disciple of his was a person who was able to bend and stretch according to the situation. She knew what to say to whom, and her acting skills were also superb.
With the right grooming, she would definitely be a great tool.
At that moment, Linglong paced in the air toward Jiang Ming and sat on his lap. “Senior Brother, what’s wrong with her?” she asked curiously. “She’s from the foreign realm.”
“What? But Senior Brother, she’s only at the Qi Cultivation Realm!”
“She was an Imminent Immortal expert.” Jiang Ming briefly explained to her the situation regarding the Reincarnation Transmigration Technique. “There’s such an unbelievable special ability?” Linglong was shocked. “Senior Brother, why didn’t you kill her? Such foreign invaders should be killed off decisively. You might see that she is harmless now, but once she grows up, she will surely bite you from the back!”
“Relax, she is under my total control.”
“Total control? Senior Brother, don’t tell me you are trying to control her and….” “You’re looking for a beating, aren’t you?”
“Let’s go back to our room. I’ll pose nicely for your beating.”

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - Nine-Reincarnation Mysterious Technique, Pangu’s Ax
chapters.content:
Chapter 177 Nine-Reincarnation Mysterious Technique, Pangu’s Ax
In a blink of an eye, nearly a whole year passed.
On Chuyang Peak… Fifth Immortal Moon came to Jiang Ming from her seclusion.
She had only been in the mountains for about ten months, yet Jiang Ming had arranged a time acceleration formation array for her. Under a 100-fold acceleration, it was as if she had been cultivating for more than 80 years.
With ample resources and her cultivation base still intact, her cultivation base directly skyrocketed into the pinnacle of the Imminent Immortal Realm, ready to break through to the next realm anytime, shattering the shackles and turning from an ordinary human into the Immortal.
Jiang Ming had even imparted quite a few special abilities to her.
“Master!” Fifth Immortal Moon came in front of Jiang Ming as she knelt in respect.
In the beginning, she would make up lots of lies, and there would be various conflicts from time to time. But before she knew it, those conflicts slowly disappeared without a trace, and she was now trusting Jiang Ming completely for no reason.
It was a trust that originated straight from the heart.
Occasionally, doubts would flash through her mind as she thought that she should not act that way in her current situation. However, these thoughts slowly disappeared without a trace, and now she had become completely loyal.
However, her character and her ability to think independently were not weakened in any way, which was extremely strange. Relationship: 100 It was a bone-chilling number.
Upon seeing Fifth Immortal Moon, Jiang Ming nodded.
Zi Linglong was right next to Jing Ming as the two silently looked at Fifth Immortal Moon, both patiently waiting for something to happen. “Master!” Fifth Immortal Moon spoke again, and then she suddenly disappeared without a trace right in front of the two.
“She left just like that?” Linglong was surprised as her eyes flashed with strange colors. “Senior Brother, can you still control her?”
“Let me try and sense the connection.” Jiang Ming closed his eyes and focused.
A ray of consciousness slowly drifted through the void as it finally connected to the soul of Fifth Immortal Moon without any hindrance at all. As it merged with the soul of the other party, they became one.
They even had shared visions.
Jiang Ming saw that she was in a spacious room that had soft, comfortable white light gleaming around the area.
A loud voice was suddenly blaring in the room.
“Ding: The 10 squads sent over to the perfect planar Tianyuan World on an SSS-grade mission to eradicate the Jiuyang Sect ended with failure. Only one of them returned.”
“Ding: Fifth Immortal Moon, you are the only one who returned. The chance of death is 99%. Based on my calculation, you shouldn’t even be alive. The defense mechanism is now activated to perform a deep scan onto your soul to avoid any intrusions!”
Fifth Immortal Moon remained silent, yet Jiang Ming, who was looking at what was transpiring, was starting to feel worried. ‘Will she be able to pass the Reincarnation System’s scanning?’
An invisible wave swept through her whole body thoroughly, scanning inside out and even her soul.
“Ding: The soul is intact, the memory is intact, and the will is intact. No imprint was marked, and no enslavement has been set. Fifth Immortal Moon, you are still an independent entity!”
Upon hearing the announcement, Jiang Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
He also realized that the announcement should be the setting of some kind of program.
“Ding: Fifth Immortal Moon, the overall mission has ended with failure, yet you survived through it and even infiltrated into the internal departments of the Jiuyang Sect, reaching the most secretive place of all, the Chuyang Peak. You are exempted from the penalty of failure and are rewarded 1,000,000 points, a streak of Immortal Spiritual Essence, and one chance of enlightenment!”
A milky white gas suddenly fell out of thin air. Its quality exceeded those of the origin essence.
So this was Immortal Spirit Essence?
Also, there was this token there.
Fifth Immortal Moon kept the items in her storage ring, opened the door, and walked out. The outside was an incomparably wide hall that was in the shape of a circle, surrounded by various doors. Some of those doors were opened, while some were closed.
Among the doors, there was a huge door that had a notice on the SSS-grade mission to destroy the Jiuyang Sect of the Tianyuan World. Quite a number of people had gathered outside, waiting for the result. As for the other places, they were flooded with people milling around.
“This is an SSS-grade mission! It’s so rare that it doesn’t even necessarily appear once in 10 years. Each time it appears, it will surely cause a huge sensation! The ten teams that were sent for this mission were all of the top rankings. I wonder how many of them will safely return.”
“I’m guessing at least half of them will make it, right? After all, with the background and strength of those teams, even if they fail the mission, they can still bear the punishment.” “Hah! You’re underestimating the horror of an SSS-grade mission here. It’s already a miracle if 1/3 of them can survive the mission. Just wait and see. These 10 teams will surely come back miserable. However, those who manage to survive always reap unimaginable benefits.” Just when they were discussing, the huge door was suddenly pushed open, and a single person walked out, which was none other than Fifth Immortal Moon.
All the experts in the great hall looked inside the huge door. When they realized there weren’t any other people inside, their faces suddenly changed wildly.
To think that 10 teams had been sent out and only one member safely returned!?
That was just preposterous!
It was awful and incredibly terrifying! “Fifth Immortal Moon, that’s only a planar world that you’ve been to. With the strength of your 10 teams, you could completely dominate the whole world there. Moreover, the task was only to deal with one sect. How come you are the only one to return?” an enchanting lady walked over, asking solemnly.
Fifth Immortal Moon softly sighed with a bitter smile and muttered, “It was too dreadful over there!”
Since Jiang Ming shared Fifth Immortal Moon’s vision, he discovered the various beings in front of her were of different shapes and sizes, such as stone creatures, living plants, and chimeras, where most of them were in human form. Even so, the human population there seemed to be a bigger proportion.
Jiang Ming understood the situation there. That place was the third floor of the Reincarnation Hall.
The first floor was for Level 1 to 3 experts, namely of the Qi Cultivation, Foundation Establishment, and Core Formation Realms. The second floor was aimed for Level 4 to 6 experts, namely of the Purple Mansion, Dao, Seed, and Nascent Soul Realms. Naturally, the third floor was aimed for Level 7 to 10 experts, namely of the Primal Spirit, Paradis, Extreme Path, and the Imminent Immortal Realms.
The members of the third floor in the Reincarnation Hall, when evaluated against the missions released by the Reincarnation Hall, would only have to complete one mission every 10 years.
However, if they failed twice consecutively, they would be forced to accept the next mission. Such a mission would have an extremely high death rate.
There were also a few missions that had no restriction, and their dangers were even greater. This mission was considered one of them.
“When we descended, the Tianyuan World was under the invasion of foreign devils, and even a portal was conjured. In addition, there were also beneficiaries of the Lord God Space that descended over there, yet none survived!”
Fifth Immortal Moon continued. “A terrifyingly strong opponent suddenly emerged over in that world, and for some unknown reason, our teammates were hunted down one by one. At that time, seeing the rapid decline in the number of the beneficiaries in the system completely terrified me. I ended up using the Reincarnation Transmigration Technique, sacrificing all my cultivation thus far in order to merge with that planar world completely. That was why I wasn’t discovered!”
“You actually evoked the Reincarnation Transmigration Technique!?” the little lady just now exclaimed in shock. “This forbidden technique has a very high chance of failure! If you fail, your own consciousness will be the one destroyed, and everything you have will belong to the one you were trying to transmigrate into! “Even if you were successful, all your cultivation up to that point of time would be in vain. The moment those thousands of years of cultivation disappeared, you would’ve been weak and fragile there. Any small incident would’ve meant death! Who knows how many months and years it would take for the person to restore their cultivation to its original level?
“Wait! Something’s not right! Immortal Moon, your cultivation base has not weakened!”
“That’s because I had some great encounters, plus a few of the teammates did not make up their mind to use the technique and handed over their items to me for safekeeping. It was then that I used the time acceleration formation to recover. However, everything that I had accumulated has all been exhausted. Alas, I’m beaten back to zero this time around!” Fifth Immortal Moon sighed.
“So many beneficiaries had descended through countless worlds and were extremely careful because if there were any mistakes along the way, they would’ve lost everything they’ve achieved so far, and it might even cost their life.” The lady sighed. “Immortal Moon, you mentioned that there were also beneficiaries of the Lord God Space? Those things! There’s no limit to what they do! Do you have any clue what their mission was?”
“I only know that they released an enormous amount of nuclear bombs, viruses, zombies, Zerg warriors, and many more. My guess, it should be a mission to destroy the world,” Immortal Moon replied. “Goddamnit! As expected of the Lord God Space! Destroying the world as though it’s afternoon tea!”
She went over to the side and sat down. Some people came over to buy her drinks and continued asking her for more details.
Fifth Immortal Moon did not hide anything and generally told them some of what had transpired over there.
After quite some time, she finally returned to her dwelling through the system.
This was an incomparably huge manor with lakes and some artificial mountains in its compound, a little of everything. There was even an enlightening room and a sparring room. As long as she had enough accumulated points, all of these could be bought.
Fifth Immortal Moon sat in the huge hall, stretched out her hands a little, and a screen suddenly appeared right in front of her. That screen was the System’s Shop, densely packed with everything someone might buy.
Other than various bloodlines, countless body types, and peerless pills. There were even the legendary Level 18 Immortal Artifacts among the items inside!
Examples were the Nine-Reincarnation Golden Pill, Ancestral Witch Blood Essence, Nine-Reincarnation Mysterious Technique, Four Swords of Immortal Slaying, and even Pangu’s Ax.
As Jiang Ming’s wisp of consciousness returned to his body, he sat there dumbfounded with his eyes full of shock.
He was surprised to see the existence of the Pangu’s Ax, hence wondering whether the Prehistoric World also existed.
‘Holy heavens! What kind of existence is this Heaven Reincarnation Hall?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t calm down.
That was the legendary Pangu’s Ax! That was a supreme mythical existence, a legend of his previous life! Especially this Pangu who could open up worlds and shape the beings of the Prehistoric World, armed with unimaginable power!
‘This exceeded my imagination by a long shot!’ Jiang Ming suppressed the tremor in his heart as he began to ponder over it.
‘When Immortal Moon goes on her next mission, I will try it out. If this really works, then I’m rich!’ He had already hatched a plan in such a short time span.
“Senior Brother, how is it?” Linglong noticed the slight changes in Jiang Ming’s expression and asked, “Can you still control her?”
“Yes, I can!” Jiang Ming didn’t hide any secrets.
“But that…” Linglong had a look of horror on her face as her eyes were full of disbelief. “Senior Brother, can you still control her even after she has crossed into different worlds?”
Linglong’s heart was trembling as she had heard of the Reincarnation Hall before.
“That’s because your Senior Brother is amazing! Haven’t you felt my amazingness already?” Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows cheekily.
“Senior Brother, I want to feel your amazingness again!” Linglong turned over and pressed herself on top of him.
“This is broad daylight!”
“Isn’t this more exciting?”
“Hey! Don’t bite!”
In the land of the Zhong Province, Spatial Linglong, who had just come out of the Ancient Immortal Ruins, inexplicably shivered, and a red flush flashed across her face.
“I miss it so much!” She stuck her tongue out, licking her lips tenderly
Spatial Linglong was prepared to return when she suddenly discovered a war vessel in front of her. Divine lights were emanating from the war vessel, sealing the space around her.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - Eventually, He Died
chapters.content:
Chapter 178 Eventually, He Died
Spatial Linglong smiled coldly. She did not go away. Instead, she stood silently in the air. As the group of warships was getting closer and closer, a ripple was spread through the sea of clouds.
There were ranks after ranks of soldiers standing on the warships. They all gathered their energy together, making themselves look like a sword that was waiting to slice through everything in their path. “Zi Linglong!” Zhou Tian, the 18th prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty, shouted with a frown. “No, this isn’t right. Although both of you have the same look, you’re a different person and give off a different vibe. Who are you? What is the relationship between you and Zi Linglong?”
He had experienced a lot since he came to the Eastern Region for a year.
First, the Jiuyang Sect had destroyed the Eastern Region Alliance, and then an interdimensional portal had been opened up in the Northern Region, giving the devils from another dimension a chance to invade this world and throw this world into a state of chaos.
He had wanted to get his revenge on the Jiuyang Sect, but he forwent the thought in the end after weighing the pros and cons.
After all, he did not have much power here in the Eastern Region.
Even if he wanted to grow his own troops and force, it would be difficult since the world was in chaos.
In the end, he could only wait for a year before returning to this place.
When he saw Spatial Linglong, his eyes glowed. He sealed the area with a formation and prevented her from running away.
“I think it’s none of your business, right?” Spatial Linglong said, her eyes cold, “What are you going to do to seal this area? Are you going to kill me?”
irse
me
“Of course not!” Zhou Tian replied, “Allow me to introduce myself first. I’m a prince from the Great Zhou Dynasty. It must be fate that brought us here today, so may I invite you to be a guest at the imperial court?”
“I’ll say this for one last time. Move!” Spatial Linglong growled impatiently.
She still needed to go back to see her Senior Brother. She couldn’t waste her time here.
Zoom!
A strand of sword energy shot out of her head, dispersing the cloud and turning into a sword before falling into her hand as a killing intent erupted.
“Calm down, girl!” Zhou Tian smiled, “Look at the sun. It’s so bright and warm. Listen to the beautiful sound of the flowers blooming, it’s so — D*mn it! Stop attacking me!”
Before he could finish speaking, Linglong’s sword fell on the warship. At that moment, a bright light erupted as the protective barrier was activated. However, the barrier only lasted for a few minutes before it crumbled away.
“This is too weak!” Linglong commented.
The sword in her hand was glowing brightly, and its power was growing with each passing second.
A war general who was standing quietly shouted furiously, “How dare you attack the prince!? You must have a death wish to go against the Great Zhou Dynasty!”
With a resounding clang, a spear appeared in his hand. After charging up his attack, he threw the spear at Linglong without any hesitation. It pierced through space, tearing through everything in its path as it darted toward Linglong
In the meantime, the warship gave out a blinding light. The protective barrier was reenacted, and the attack was fully charged. “Hmph!” Linglong squinted her eyes. She turned her sword around and intercepted the spear, causing the spear to crack and fall apart.
“Zhou Tian, I initially didn’t want to deal with you, but since you have a death wish, I shall grant you your wish!”
With that, she disappeared and appeared above the warship. As she waved her sword in a mighty downward swipe, she shouted, “Great Akasa Slash!”
This attack was imbued with the power of the Spatial Law. It slashed right through the protective barrier that wrapped around the warship, leaving a huge cut on the ship’s body.
Zhou Tian was able to survive the attack, but his men were not that fortunate. Some of them died on the spot, while the others were pulverized into a mist of blood.
“How dare you, you vile woman!?”
Eight war generals clad in golden armor appeared on the deck. All of them were Primal Spirit experts, and they were holding swords in their hands. They all sent an endless amount of sword energy with immense destructive power toward Linglong, but she easily deflected them and killed all of them.
When Zhou Tian saw the scene, his face turned pale.
“D*mn it! How can she be so powerful? Today is certainly not my day!” Zhou Tian shouted as he felt regret. “Your Highness, there’s a good chance that she’s an Extreme Path expert. We should ask for reinforcements,” Cang Yun said.
“Hurry!” An elder came out of the warship. He darted a glance at Zhou Tian, sending a chill down the latter’s spine.
After that, he went up to Linglong.
He was the strongest man in the warship, a Paradis Great Monarch.
“Girl, can you do us a favor and stop now?” the old man asked as he activated the Paradis Projection. It was a world of yellow, and it was the Earth Dao.
“Stop?” Linglong laughed. “I won’t make my move, but as soon as I’m on the move, I won’t stop until I’ve struck down all the enemies in my path!”
She stretched her hand forward and grabbed something in the air. The space around the old man began to collapse.
“No! I’m from the Great Zhou Dynasty! You can’t kill me!” the old man shouted when he sensed how terrifying Linglong was.
At the same time, he chided Zhou Tian inwardly.
‘D*mn you, Zhou Tian! Why couldn’t you just return to your home quietly? Why must you lose your head over lust? See who you’ve offended!’
However, it was too late.
Pfft!
The old man was crushed by the spatial power and died instantly.
“San Yanggong is dead?!” Zhou Tian was stunned. “He’s a Paradis expert! How is there any chance he would get killed just like that?!”
“That’s because she’s too powerful!” Cang Yun said hopelessly.
He was regretful. He regretted why he hadn’t left this brain-dead prince soon enough. If he had left him, he wouldn’t have been in such a predicament.
A serious expression appeared on Linglong’s face.
Swoosh!
She brandished her sword and cut the warship in half.
Zhou Tian and Cang Yun were transported to another place by a special item.
“Who are you? Why must you kill us?” Zhou Tian shouted, “Senior, I’m sorry for whatever I said just now. Can you please forgive us?”
“I’ll forgive you once I’ve killed you!” Linglong replied. She threw a strand of sword energy at Zhou Tian, but it was intercepted by another strand of sword energy that traveled from afar.
Something flashed in the distance, and a man appeared in front of Linglong. “As an expert, why do you have to make things difficult for someone who’s weaker than you?” He was a middle-aged man. He was holding a longsword in his hand and was clad in a terrifying aura.
“Senior Dao Sheng!” Cang Yun heaved a sigh of relief.
“Senior Dao Sheng!” Zhou Tian dropped to his knees.
“I’ll deal with you after we’ve returned to the dynasty!” Dao Sheng glanced at him. “Now, get lost!”
Zhou Tian trembled and ran away.
“Do you think you can run away after what you did?” Linglong smiled. Her figure began to blur, and Dao Sheng’s expression changed.
“Do you really have to do that?”
His sword flashed, and a barrier engulfed Zhou
Tian.
Pfft!
However, a strand of sword energy pierced through the barrier and penetrated Zhou Tian’s forehead.
Zhou Tian was stunned. He opened his mouth, and light began to leave his eyes slowly.
“D*mn it!” Dao Sheng shouted furiously, but there was nothing he could do either.
Although he was an Extreme Path expert, he could do nothing against an opponent who was at the same level as him and wielded the power of space.
“If I were not strong enough, do you think they’d let me go away? Since he’s already dead, now is your turn!” Linglong shouted.
“I’ll kill whoever comes in my path! Even if you represent your country!”
“Hmph! Don’t get so cocky, you little girl!” Dao Sheng shouted.
‘Both of us are Extreme Path experts, so how could you not show me some respect? Do you really think you’re invincible?’

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - Conquering the Eastern Region, Tian Ci’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 179 Conquering the Eastern Region, Tian Ci’s Plan
“Senior Brother, the spatial clone has killed Zhou Tian, the 18th Prince of the Great Zhou Dynasty,” Zi Linglong said. “Would it cause us any trouble?”
“Don’t worry. It’s just a dynasty,” Jiang Ming replied nonchalantly. “I tried to take his life once, but he was able to escape. Since he had already escaped, I decided to leave him alone, but I didn’t expect that he would have the guts to come back again. Well, all I have to say is that he asked for it himself. By the way, did her cultivation level increase again? That’s why she’s coming back here?”
“Yes!” Linglong nodded. “She has come across a chance of enlightenment. She thought of coming back here, but she didn’t expect to run into Zhou Tian and his troops. She tried to ignore them, but they refused to let her go, so she decided to kill them all to test her strength as well as to raise the name of the Jiuyang
Sect.”
When Jiang Ming heard what Linglong said, he shook his head and massaged his back.
Linglong covered her mouth and chuckled. “Senior Brother, is it necessary?”
“Why is it not necessary?” Jiang Ming said exasperatingly, “What can I do? All of you nine take turns to come on top of me. Do you think I don’t need to take a rest? Even an iron bar would become a needle if going at your pace.”
“Each of us is different, and we entertain you every single night. How can you still complain about us, Senior Brother?” Linglong was rendered speechless. “Could it be that you can’t do it anymore, Senior Brother?”
Jiang Ming was stumped. He hastily changed to another topic and said, “Linglong, all of your clones seem to have developed their own personalities. Are you sure it’ll be alright?”
“I did that on purpose. After all, only in this way could each of them grow independently,” Linglong said as she leaned on Jiang Ming’s chest. “I’m holding their true essence, so their lives are in my hands. Besides, I can also synchronize their memories at any time. Don’t worry so much, Senior Brother. Even if they detach from me and become a completely different individual, they will still be your Junior Sister.”
“That’s great to hear, then.” Jiang Ming nodded.
He looked ahead and locked onto the direction of Zhong Province.
The Human Path Records was hovering beside him as he kept an eye on Spatial Linglong.
In Zhong Province…
Spatial Linglong chopped off Dao Sheng’s left arm in a swipe. An immortal light erupted from his body to block the attack that was directed at his mind and saved his life.
“As expected of an Extreme Path expert who has mastered the Spatial Law. You’re truly powerful!” Dao Sheng said, his face grim at the fact that he was nearly killed just now.
“Guys, are you still going to stand there and watch?” he snarled without turning his head.
The light in the distance warped, and three people appeared out of thin air in the next second.
All of them looked young and exuded an imposing aura.
“Old Dao!” The young man in white walked toward Dao Sheng with a grin plastered across his face. “I thought this would be like walking in the park for you. I didn’t expect that you’d be defeated so soon!”
“Nope!” The young man in red shook his head, “He’s just giving her a chance. Old Dao, it truly surprises me that you still have a tender heart for the fair sex despite your age.”
The young man in blue just smiled and did not say anything
While they were talking, Spatial Linglong activated her Paradis Projection and sealed the entire area.
“You guys finally have decided to show up? I thought you were going to keep hiding!” she said, her eyes brimming with joy. “You’ve noticed us?” The young man in white frowned slightly.
“The Light Ray Dao is indeed a good ability in concealing your presence, but it’s nothing in front of the Spatial Dao,” Linglong said. “Are you guys going to attack me as well?”
“You killed our prince, disregarded our empire’s dignity, and still expected us to sit by and do nothing? If we don’t step forward, what if other people just simply come to our country and kill one of our princes? It would bring us a lot of trouble as well, don’t you think so?”
The young man in white said, “Honestly, we don’t really care if we lose one or two of our princes, but it doesn’t mean that we have to sit by and do nothing about it. Miss, please come with us to the imperial palace. With your cultivation level, I’m sure no one will dare to make things hard for you.”
“I can let you go for what you’ve said. Now, get out of my face!” Linglong said, “I must kill Dao Sheng today, but I can spare your life if you guys leave now. If not, here will be your graveyard!”
“Nonsense!” the young man in red shouted. “Do you really think you can do everything you want just because you’ve fully mastered the power of space? You seriously have underestimated us and the empire!”
“Are you guys not leaving?” Linglong asked again, her voice low.
“And we’ll say it one last time. Give no resistance and allow yourself to be captured. If not, we’ll kill you right away!” the young man in red said as a lyre appeared in front of him.
“Chronostasis!”
Without giving them a chance to say anything, Linglong launched her Paradis as well as the strongest special abilities in the Spatial Law.
At that moment, Dao Sheng and the three young men were frozen in place. However, there was an immense amount of power erupting from their bodies as they tried to break themselves from the restraints.
They only needed one more minute, and they could break themselves free, but they did not have the chance anymore.
Swoosh…
Linglong had pierced through their foreheads within the blink of an eye, destroying their sea of consciousness and exterminating their souls in the Paradis. The four of them were dead. Their bodies crumbled away, leaving quite a number of loot behind.
Linglong waved her sleeve, collected all the loot, and went away.
After a short while, an old man appeared.
“How vile! She killed every one of them!” The old man was furious, but he was confident he couldn’t chase after Linglong at his current speed. He thought for a moment and then went back to the empire.
He did not really care if Zhou Tian was dead or not, but it was a huge loss to the empire since they had lost four Extreme Path experts.
One day later, an imperial edict was released. The Crown Prince would bring an army to invade the Eastern Region and destroy the Jiuyang Sect.
100 warships were heading toward the Eastern Region.
Inside the imperial palace, the emperor, otherwise known as the Holy Emperor, was sitting on his throne.
He was a man in his middle age, but he had a dominating and regal aura around him. A yellow light exuded from his head, making him look even more imposing than ever.
“Your Majesty!” An old man said, “According to the information we received, although the Jiuyang Sect is a second-rate sect in the Eastern Region, they’re protected by a Great Monarch. There’s a good chance that it’s the Jiuyang Sect who destroyed the devil army that invaded the Northern Region. If we really send troops to attack them, I’m afraid that not even we can stop that being if he gets annoyed.
“Rest assured, Minister Zuo,” Emperor Zhou replied flatly.
Suddenly, there was a commotion outside of the palace.
“The Holy Lord of the Yantian Sect has arrived!”
The voice sounded nervous and filled with fear.
A figure stormed into the hall in the next second, followed by a few guards.
Emperor Zhou rose to his feet and waved his hand at the guards to dismiss them. He walked down from his throne and smiled. “What’s the matter, Shen Daoyou? You should’ve sent me a message if you’re coming.” “Emperor Zhou!” Shen Daoyou made a bow at Emperor Zhou, his face stern, “Did you send a troop to the Jiuyang Sect in the Eastern Region?”
“I knew I couldn’t hide it from you. My son was killed, and four Elders died tragically. This is a huge matter. It’s about the dignity of our empire, and there’s no way we can let it slide.” “Sigh! Listen to me, Your Majesty. Withdraw your order immediately. Then, we’ll figure out what we should do next.”
“No way. I’m the emperor, and I can’t withdraw an order that has been given. Shen Daoyou, I’m just dispatching my troops to the Eastern Region. Why do you look so worried?”
“After learning that you’ve dispatched a troop to the Eastern Region, I tried to look into the future. Do you know what I saw? The sky is raining blood, and the land is falling apart. Zhong Province… Zhong Province will be destroyed!” As Shen Daoyou talked, his face turned paler and paler with each passing second.
Emperor Zhou frowned. He was well aware of the Yantian Sect’s ability to look into the future.
“Brother Zhou!” Shen Daoyou sighed and continued. “That person comes from the Eastern Region, and according to our speculation, he’s a lot stronger than a Heavenly Immortal. Not only that, but he also has immortal weapons in his hands, so what are we supposed to do if we piss him off? “It took him only one hit to exterminate nearly all of the devils that invaded the Northern Region, and when he descended for the second time, he wiped out the remaining devils that couldn’t be destroyed despite the combined effort of all Sacred Lands. Are you sure our Great Zhou can stop him if he comes to destroy us?”
“I…” Emperor Zhou hesitated. It went without saying that he knew how powerful that person was, but the Court of Elders decided this matter. Therefore, he couldn’t do anything as either.
“This, this, this…” Shen Daoyou opened his mouth and sighed. “Brother Zhou, the Yantian Sect is gifted with the ability to look into the future, and what we seek is immortality. Unless there is a great disaster, we won’t participate in any fight. Now that a great catastrophe is going to happen soon, the Yantian Sect is going into seclusion. Please take care of yourself, Brother Zhou.”
Emperor Zhou’s expression changed. “Brother Shen, are you really sure about that?” Shen Daoyou sighed in relief and said with a smile, “The Court of Elders of the Great Zhou is very strong, but it’s nothing more than a coalition of the royal family and many clans. However, the Yantian Sect is no weaker than the Court of Elders. Brother Zhou, please take care of yourself.”
After that, he turned around and left.
Emperor Zhou’s face sank.
On a mountain 10,000 miles away from the imperial palace…
This was the headquarters of the Yantian Sect.
After Holy Lord Shen returned, he briefly described the situation to his members. Then, a wizened voice rang out. “The Yantian Sect is bestowed with the great ability to look into the past and the future. We’ve helped the Great Zhou Dynasty to rise to its eminence, so we don’t owe them anything. Right now, the Great Zhou Dynasty is bent on taking the risky path of looking for supporters, but little do they know that they’re stepping onto the edge of a cliff. One more step ahead, and they’ll fall to their death. From today onward, the Yantian Sect will move out of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s territory and go into seclusion!”
The palace on the mountain gave out an intense light before disappearing into the ether.
At the Tianyuan School…
Ye Ming, an Extreme Path expert who had the Space Illusion God Body, came to look for Liu Changkong
“Sir, Emperor Zhou has dispatched his troops to attack the Eastern Region. Is he out of his mind?”
“No, he didn’t lose his mind. Rather, he became more audacious since he found someone to back him up. Therefore, he decided to unify Zhong Province and the world so that he can find a good location when he’s going to ascend in the future.”
“What is going on, sir?” “This has something to do with Tian Ci.” “Tian Ci?”
“When I found out that he was hiding some immortal weapons after being attacked, I knew something was wrong. When he ascended into the Paradis Realm after we’ve activated the Chamber of Time to speed up his cultivation, we noticed that his soul fluctuated abnormally, and he had been connecting to the Akasa. Then, he continued to cultivate in seclusion and stepped into the Imminent Immortal Realm. After that, he went to the forbidden land and tried to convince the Elders to attack and investigate the Jiuyang Sect.”
“Sir, could it be that he’s reincarnated? Why does he want to investigate the Jiuyang Sect?”
“Listen to me first. Due to the invasion of the devils from another dimension, the being who is likely related to the Jiuyang Sect has been tagged as a supreme being. Perhaps he’s a reincarnation of an immortal, we don’t know, but in any case, he’s someone who wields power that is beyond the mortal realm. Since they’re on the human’s side, we have no position to investigate them, so we rejected Tian Ci.”
“That’s the right thing to do.”
“Yeah, then Tian Ci unleashed all his power in an attempt to kill all of the Elders. However, little did he expect that the Tianyuan School still had a trump card up our sleeves. We activated a great weapon, and just when we were about to kill him, he ran away.”
“How dare he! Sir, why didn’t I know anything about it?” “You were in seclusion at that time, not to mention that it happened in the forbidden land, so it didn’t affect the outside world. Now the Great Zhou Dynasty suddenly sent troops to the Eastern Region, the situation is as clear as the sky. It must be related to Tian Ci.”
“How did he convince the Great Zhou Dynasty? They have power even greater than the Sacred Land, and how can they take risks easily when stability is the main concern? Could it be that Tian Ci’s origins are truly astounding?” “I’m not really sure about it, but one thing I can assure you is that he can contact someone from above.”
“So, what are we supposed to do?”
“I’ve sent a message to the Jiuyang Sect, so all we can do now is wait and see who the person is. At the same time, we need to find out about Tian Ci’s origins. Things are getting more and more complicated.”
“Yeah. If we take a step wrong, we might…”
Both of them fell silent.
At the Jiuyang Sect, on Chuyang Peak…
Xi Yao forwarded a message to Zi Linglong.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - Immortal General, Devil Lord, Golden Heaven Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 180 Immortal General, Devil Lord, Golden Heaven Path
“The Great Zhou Dynasty has dispatched a troop with the Crown Prince as the leader to the Eastern REgion. Tian Ci has the potential to become immortal. He has returned and joined the Great Zhou Dynasty,” Xi Yao read the message that she received.
“Senior Liu Changkong from the Tianyuan School sent me this message,” Xi Yao said. “But why would the Great Zhou Dynasty suddenly send their troops to the Eastern Region? The chaos has only ended for a short period, and they’re going to expand their territory? Are they not afraid of incurring the wrath from other Sacred Lands? We all know that Tian Ci has the potential to become immortal, but what does it mean that he has returned? Besides, did he join the Great Zhou Dynasty? But why? The Tianyuan School is a much better place to cultivate compared to the Dynasty.”
Xi Yao couldn’t understand it at all.
“I think we’re the reason they dispatched a troop to the Eastern Region.” Zi Linglong smiled. “As for Tian Ci, he obviously has betrayed the Tianyuan School and joined forces with the Great Zhou Dynasty to destroy us. As for what it means that he has returned, I guess they’re suspecting that he’s a reincarnator.” “Linglong is right!” Jiang Ming nodded and said, “This Liu Changkong is kind of interesting. He knows that our Jiuyang Sect holds a big secret, and it’s related to you, so he sent the message to Xi Yao instead, hoping that she could forward the message to us.”
It was no longer a secret that Xi Yao was with them.
“The Tianyuan School has always maintained a neutral stance. Besides, their foundation is far deeper than we can imagine,” Xi Yao said with a frown. “What I don’t understand now is why Tian Ci would choose to cultivate in the Great Zhou Dynasty instead of in the Tianyuan School. Why does the Great Zhou Dynasty want to attack you guys?”.
“Because I killed Zhou Tian and four Extreme Path experts,” Linglong said. “What!? You killed Zhou Tian and four Extreme Path experts!?” Xi Yao was shocked. “Linglong, since when did you become so strong? Even though I’m the Holy Daughter of the Riyue Sect and I’ve been cultivating here, I’m still only in the Primal Spirit Realm. But you… You killed four Extreme Path experts? Hold on for a second. Haven’t you been on the mountain the whole time? How did you kill them?”
“Look over there,” Linglong said as she nudged her chin.
Xi Yao jerked her head back and saw a human figure coming in their direction. She went through Chuyang Peak’s protective barrier and landed in the gazebo without any difficulties.
“Another Linglong?” Xi Yao was stunned but soon saw the light. “She’s your clone?”
“Long time no see, Xi Yao,” Spatial Linglong greeted her as she studied her from head to toe. “Why are you still a virgin? You haven’t made a move on my Senior Brother yet? You suck, Xi Yao.”
Xi Yao’s face turned red in embarrassment as she glared at her. She wanted to turn around and leave, but it would only give herself away if she did that.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming’s voice rang out. “Stop making fun of her. The army from the Great Zhou Dynasty is coming soon. Can you handle them?”
“Well, I can try,” Spatial Linglong said. “Can I really kill them all? After all, I was holding myself back when I was there. Since they have the guts to step into our territory, I don’t need to hold myself back anymore.” “Yeah, you can do whatever you want,” Jiang Ming said as he opened the Human Path Records to check Liu Changkong’s Status.
He learned why Tian Ci had joined the Great Zhou Dynasty from his Status.
‘He tried to kill the Elders from the Tianyuan School? He really has a lot of guts. Since he was able to reach the Imminent Immortal and the Extreme Path Realm, he must’ve awakened the Immortal Memory. If not, he wouldn’t have been so arrogant. But I have to say, the foundation of the Tianyuan School is truly incredible. It’s even deeper than I expected.’
Name: Tian Ci (Jun Tianci)
Race: Immortal
Gender: Male Cultivation Base: Imminent Immortal Realm.
Background: The reincarnated soul of the Immortal General from the Chenguang Immortal Mansion
Relationship: -67
Innate Talent: Immortal (Awakened Immortal Soul)
Status: After returning from the Eastern Region, he was assassinated and received a heavy blow. He went into seclusion to cultivate after returning to the Tianyuan School. He had comprehended the Light-and-Dark Dao and reached the Paradis Realm in the Chamber of Time. His broken soul was mended, and he awakened the memory of his immortal soul. After knowing the significance of his reincarnation, he learned that this world was special, and the big secret was hidden in the Eastern Region. However, he was too weak, so he did not do anything and focused on cultivation. It was only when he reached the Imminent Immortal Realm that he came out of his seclusion and learned about the changes in the outside world.
He was stunned at the news of a powerful being sabotaging the devil invasion in the Northern Region. He was certain that he must have stepped into the Immortal Realm, and he wondered who he was. After all, if he wanted to claim the Eastern Region, he must learn his identity. Therefore, he tried to convince the Elders of the Tianyuan School to do something about it. However, little did he expect that the Elders would reject him because they thought it was unnecessary to do that. Besides, they did not want to stir up any more commotion. Also, they had noticed his changes and wanted to investigate him.
Not intending to let them learn about his real identity, he tried to kill them and take control of the Tianyuan School but to no avail. After escaping from the Tianyuan School, he ran to the Great Zhou Dynasty. When he learned that four of the Extreme Path experts from the Great Zhou Dynasty had been killed, he had an idea and approached Emperor Zhou. He revealed himself as a reincarnated immortal and informed him that he was capable of showing him the Golden Heaven Path that could lead to the Immortal Realm. He also said that he came here to look for a sinful disciple who had run to the mortal world. The Tianyuan School had refused to offer him help, so he came to the Great Zhou Dynasty instead.
He offered them three slots in exchange for their help. He said that the sinner should be hiding in the Eastern Region and asked the Great Zhou Dynasty to look into it. After the Court of Elders had discussed amongst themselves, they decided to ask Emperor Zhou to send troops to the Eastern Region. Emperor Zhou then ordered the Crown Prince to lead the troops to the Eastern Region.
Jiang Ming fell silent.
‘His original name was Tian Ci, but now he called himself Jun Tianci? This is interesting. He even offered so many things in exchange for the Great Zhou Dynasty’s help, but I bet they didn’t believe him. The reason they decided to help is probably because of the Golden Heaven Path, right?’
Jiang Ming frowned as he thought.
It went without saying that a criminal from the immortal realm was nothing but a fraud. Tian Ci just wanted to look and get rid of him first so that no one would stand in his way as he revealed the secret of the Eastern Region.
‘What kind of secret is it? Could it be the secret chamber behind the sect door?’
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes and looked toward Taiyang Peak.
There was a spatial node, and the thing that was hidden within it was terrifying. He had once tried to go into it, but he forwent the attempt in the end when he sensed a chill down his spine that felt like death after getting closer to it.
‘I guess I should explore it after everything is over.’
The first thing he should do right now was to get rid of Tian Ci. After all, he was a reincarnated immortal soul.
‘Should I just try it?’ Jiang Ming thought, but he abandoned the idea very soon.
After all, it was not an exaggeration to say that Tian Ci was an immortal right now. He was completely unaware of his power, and he did not know what kind of immortal weapons he had up his sleeves.
It would be troublesome if he could not kill him in one strike.
Most importantly, he was becoming stronger and stronger every day. ‘Well, I guess I should let him live for some time. After all, he doesn’t know my real identity, and I’m able to keep an eye on him.’
Most importantly, he wanted to know the secret of the Eastern Region as well.
Meanwhile, at the Submerged Dragon Continent…
On a peak, the Devil Lord grabbed a ray of light. After reading the message, he smiled. ‘Interesting! The Great Zhou Dynasty has sent troops to the Eastern Region? Are they going to fight that person? It would be best if they could enrage that person. Then, he would wipe out all of the Sacred Lands on this world, exhaust their powers, and then I would destroy them all in one fell swoop!’
The Devil Lord stood up and looked at the land of Shenzhou beneath him with a serious expression dawning upon his face.
He was well aware of the situation over there.
‘There were many devils that scattered all over the land. All of them were very powerful and wielded different special abilities, but most of them are dead now. There’s only one explanation for this kind of situation. That person is able to notice us when we come into this world. That is also the reason I haven’t made any moves until now. However, it’s time for me to take action! I’m sure he won’t be able to take care of me while he’s dealing with the troops from the Great Zhou Dynasty.’
When the thought appeared in the Devil Lord’s head, a pitch-black portal appeared in his hand. There was nothing but darkness on the other side of the door, and it was filled with the aura of another world.
He tossed it into the air, and the portal landed in the middle of the mountains.
‘Once the Great Zhou army enters the Eastern Region, it will be my time to take action. But to be on the safe side, I should leave the Submerged Dragon Continent first.’
The Devil Lord turned around and vanished into the air.
On Chuyang Peak…
“Girl, the troops are arriving at the Eastern Region and Zhong Province intersection, so what are you still waiting for?” Jiang Ming said as he patted Spatial Linglong’s leg.
His eyes were closed.
“I’m hungry!” Spatial Linglong mumbled, “They should pay with their lives for making me starve!”

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - Kill Them All, Activation of the Heaven Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 181 Kill Them All, Activation of the Heaven Path
Spatial Linglong suppressed it and said, “I don’t think I can stop them all by myself. Should we ask them for help as well?”
“That’s your secret, and the lesser people know about it, the better,” Jiang Ming said as he pulled her into his arms. He ran his fingers over her long hair and said, “They are nothing but a group of intruders. I’m sure you’re more than enough to get rid of them. However, if you think you can’t do it, you can just stay here.”
“Stay here and entertain you! i’ll stay then!”
“Hold it!” Jiang Ming turned around and changed to another topic, “I haven’t asked you yet. What kind of opportunity have you come across?”
Spatial Linglong pulled a purple gold order.
Zi Linglong suddenly showed up and grabbed the order. She threw herself into Jiang Ming’s arms and said, “It seems to me that both of you are having a lot of fun. Care if I join?”
“How can you be jealous of her?” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Well, she feels lonely,” Spatial Linglong said as she looked at Zi Linglong. “Right?”
Jiang Ming shivered and asked, “So what’s the use of this order?” “This is an inheritance order. Once refined, it can transfer you to a Heavenly Inheritance Space to accept trial and inheritance. Senior Brother, I think you should keep it,” Linglong said as she handed the order to Jiang Ming.
However, Jiang Ming shook his head. “I have plenty of opportunities myself, so you should probably keep it. Will it be dangerous? I mean the inheritance.” “Nope. I don’t think so.”
“That’s great to hear then!”
After that, Jiang Ming rose to his feet. He looked toward Zhong Province, and his gaze slowly changed. “Since they have the guts to come to us, I should seize the chance and get rid of them. You guys don’t have to do anything. Just stay here and focus on your cultivation. After all, the difference in cultivation level between you guys is too big, and it’s not a good thing.” “Sure, Senior Brother,” Zi Linglong replied in a serious manner.
She practiced the Sword Dao, and under Jiang Ming’s help, she had already ascended into the Imminent Immortal Realm. However, her clones were much weaker than her. Well, they were not to be blamed. After all, some of their laws were hard to master, for example, Spatial Linglong.
She had just ascended into the Extreme Path Realm not long ago.
Time Linglong was still in the Paradis Realm, and she hadn’t comprehended the Time Law yet.
That being said, they did not feel anxious. They just needed to follow their own pace, and one day, they would be able to reach the Imminent Immortal Realm.
Jiang Ming lifted his finger, and a light ray erupted, forming into a strand of sword energy as it charged into the distance.
Above the sky, at the intersection of the Eastern Region and Zhong Province, there was a large fleet of warships.
Suddenly, a strand of sword energy tore through the air and pierced through the warship at the front, but it did not just stop there.
The strand of word energy continued to travel forward and penetrated through the entire fleet.
Although these warships were not particularly strong, they were all Dao Vessels, not to mention that they were protected by a protective formation and were guarded by many experts. “Who attacked us?” the Crown Prince asked, his face grim. The fleet represented the honor of the Great Zhao Dynasty. Nobody dared to stop them, let alone attack them.
“Why didn’t you stop the attack, Elder?” the Crown Prince hissed out his question.
An elder appeared beside him, his expression stern. “Crown Prince, that attack just now was more than the Imminent Immortal experts could handle. If the sword’s energy was dispersed, I’m afraid all of us would be dead by now!”
“More than Imminent Immortal experts could handle?” The Crown Prince’s expression changed. “Could it be that person?” At that moment, another strand of sword energy came.
The face of the elder beside the Crown Prince turned pale when he saw the attack. “Oh no! We have to run! Hurry!”
He grabbed the Crown Prince’s shoulder, and just when he was about to run, he found himself unable to move.
The sword energy had triggered the destructive power of time and space and sealed the entire area. The sword energy then exploded into a barrage of tiny swords as they all rained down on the remaining warships.
After that, the swords spun, cutting through everything and reducing the area into nothing. The fleet of warships was turned into dust, and all of the people on them were dead.
On Chuyang Peak…
After Jiang Ming had two strands of sword energy, he squinted his eyes and looked into the distance.
He was very happy with the outcome.
Those two attacks were the Sky Shattering Sword Technique, and it was far stronger than he had expected.
It could pierce through and destroy everything, including the laws, orders, and so on.
“It’s only because of my inner world that I could unleash the full potential of the Sky Shattering Sword Technique.”
After the thought appeared in Jiang Ming’s mind, he flipped open the Human Path Records.
He turned to Jun Tianci’s page.
“Since I’m already here, I might as well kill him too!”
Zhong Province, at the Tianyuan School… Liu Changkong and Ye Ming were standing in the air. Both of their expressions changed when they saw the energy that tore the sky asunder. “This sword energy…” Ye Ming did not know what to say. “If it were coming for me, I’m sure I’d be dead in no time!” “Not only you, me too,” Liu Changkong chimed in. “The power of the attack far exceeds what we human beings are capable of handling. It came from the Eastern Region and charged straight at the Great Zhou Dynasty’s warship fleet. Could it be him?”
They activated their divine eyes and looked into the distance, and they were stunned by what they saw.
“The fleet of warships had been destroyed!?” Ye Ming exclaimed, his voice shaking. “Yes!” Liu Changkong added. “It took only a strand of sword energy to destroy the entire fleet from the Great Zhou Dynasty? Unbelievable!” Ye Ming still found it hard to believe.
“Just how powerful he is?” Liu Changkong asked, “Oh God, the Great Zhou Dynasty is over. Tian Ci… He can’t keep his secret anymore. Since that person has decided to make a move, there’s no way he will let go of him!”
Both of them turned around and looked at Great Zhou’s palace.
At the imperial palace…
Emperor Zhou was sitting on his throne with a mirror hovering in front of him. The scene inside was exactly the picture of 100 warships speeding forward, and sitting beside him was none other than Jun Tianci.
There was no one else left in the hall.
“They’re reaching the Jiuyang Sect,” Emperor Zhou said. “Are you sure that person is hiding in the Jiuyang Sect?”.
“Most likely!” Jun Tianci said. Suddenly, he rose to his feet and stammered, “This… This attack…”
Emperor Zhou’s expression changed as well.
Immediately after, 100 warships were destroyed, and the image in the mirror disappeared without a single trace.
“How is this possible!?” Emperor Zhou jerked his head around to look at Jun Tianci, “This is beyond what human beings can handle!”
“It is… Oh no!” Before Jun Tianci could finish his sentence, he jerked his head up and saw a human figure appearing in front of him. A divine light instantly erupted from his body to protect him.
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!” As soon as Jiang Ming appeared, he cast his strongest attack.
The attack pierced through the divine light that wrapped around Jun Tianci and went straight through his forehead.
Bam!
His head exploded, but a golden path appeared, and Jun Tianci’s angry voice rang out, “D*mn it! How dare you destroy my body and Primal Spirit? I’m going to kill all of you! Golden Heaven Path, devour my body and open the immortal path for me!”
Voom!
The Golden Heaven Path vibrated and devoured Jun Tianci’s body. Soon, a golden light burst and destroyed the entire palace, killing Emperor Zhou in the process.
