The Golden Heaven Path suddenly expanded and rapidly extended high into the sky. At that moment, the entire Tianyuan World was bathed under a golden light.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - The Activation of the Immortal Portal, Taiyi Immortal Armament
chapters.content:
Chapter 182 The Activation of the Immortal Portal, Taiyi Immortal Armament
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted.
His clone had destroyed Jun Tianci’s body and Primal Spirit. However, a wisp of his consciousness had entered the Golden Heaven Path.
He did not know the item got activated, but it suddenly let out a blinding light, killing King Zhou and destroying his clone.
The palace was destroyed, and many people were killed.
At that moment, everyone in the imperial palace, even those experts in Zhong Province, was attracted by the light and turned their heads to look at the giant golden path.
This was the Golden Heaven Path in Jun Tianci’s mind. It was getting larger and larger as it grew upward. When it reached a certain size, it stopped, and then a golden gate appeared at the end.
Without making any noise, the golden gate opened. In a flash, an immense aura flowed out of it. Even if just a wisp of it flowed out, it immediately turned into a long river of aura, sweeping in all directions.
In the next second, a war general wearing golden armor and riding on a white horse came out of the golden gate and stepped onto the Golden Heaven Path. There were a group of silver-armored warriors behind him, and they soon arrived above the imperial palace. His face was stern, and he exuded an imposing aura.
He hit the heaven path with the halberd in his hand, and a wisp of smoke rose from below. The smoke took the form of Jun Tianci, but his body looked a bit unreal.
The golden-armored war general greeted Jun Tianci reverently, “Master Jun!”
“Thank goodness that it has succeeded,” Jun Tianci heaved a sigh of relief. He looked at him and asked, “Dong Yao, I didn’t expect it would be you who came. How is Master Immortal Lord? Is he doing fine?”
‘Yeah,” Dong Yao replied expressionlessly. “According to the rules, you need to open your sea of consciousness and allow me to read your mind. I need to know what’s going on over here as soon as possible, and I hope you won’t resist.”
“You want to read my mind!?” Jun Tianci’s face turned grim.
“I hope you won’t resist, Master Jun,” Dong Yao repeated again. He brandished the halberd in his hand and stabbed Jun Tianci’s body.
“Dong Yao, I won’t forget what you’ve done!” Jun Tianci snarled, his eyes glowing with fire.
In the next second, his face turned blank.
“Useless!” Dong Yao harrumphed coldly and threw Tianci into the golden gate at the back.
The heaven path turned around and spread toward the Eastern Region.
In the air above the Tianyuan School…
“Sir, what is that? And who are those people?” asked Ye Ming. “I can feel an immense power that can suppress all laws in the mortal world from them.”
“That’s the Golden Heaven Path!” Liu Changkong said as sealing spells began to appear around him, preventing him from sending messages to the people outside of the spell.
His voice was trembling as he said, “According to a secret record in the Tianyuan School, there is one divine item in the immortal realm that, once activated, will turn into the Golden Heaven Path that will connect our world with their world. It can lead mortals into the immortal realm, but at the same time, it also acts as a portal for the immortals to descend into our world. I thought it was just a legend. I never thought it was real.
“Oh gosh, the Jiuyang Sect is over!
“Looking at them, they could unleash the power of the immortal realm. How is the Jiuyang Sect or that person supposed to hold them back?”
Liu Changkong’s face was dark.
There was no way mortals like them could fight against immortals.
“Everything in this world is balanced,” Liu Changkong said after he calmed himself down. “Tianci is a reincarnated immortal. He has the Golden Heaven Path with him, and he was the one who activated it, and those immortals come to our world through the Golden Heaven Path. Perhaps it doesn’t necessarily mean that we can’t fight against them. I assume that these immortals can’t leave the Golden Heaven Path. I also assume that their cultivation level will be much lower the second they come to this world. If not, there will be no way we can fight against them.”
“I couldn’t believe that Tian Ci would become a traitor to our human world!” Ye Ming cursed, “They are immortals. How are we supposed to fight against them? Although we have geniuses popping up here and there from time to time, how about them? They have a lot more of them. Their special abilities are stronger, their weapons and items are better, and they have better talent than us! There is no way we can defeat them!”
“Sigh! Let’s just watch!”
“Sir, the Tianyuan School is the protector of the human world. Do we really don’t have anything that we can do?”.
“We can, but not now. We can’t simply take action unless the situation calls for it,” Liu Changkong said.
Ye Ming fell silent. He frowned and looked at the Eastern Region.
In the Eastern Region, Hai Province, on top of a mountain… The Devil Lord looked in the direction of Zhong Province. When he saw that the Golden Heaven Path was heading toward the Eastern Region, he smiled. “These immortals are so cheeky and arrogant. I’m sure they must want to get this done as soon as possible. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have used the Golden Heaven Path. Very well, then. I should watch which of you is stronger! And then, I’ll turn this human world into a devil realm!”
The Devil Lord looked into the distance with his hands clasped behind his back.
He was still waiting for the perfect opportunity to make his strike.
Several monks were sitting in the Buddhist Temple in the Western Region.
“The Golden Heaven Path is here. Has the time finally come? It’s not too far from what has been written into the Buddha’s message.”
“I didn’t expect that the legendary supreme item would show up in our world. According to the Buddha’s message, it should be around this time that the Golden Heaven Path will appear. In other words, a lot of opportunities have arisen. Who would have thought that a great event would appear in our generation? I wonder if this is a blessing or a disaster.”
“Of course, it’s a blessing! We’ve destroyed the devils, and the remaining forces, such as the Golden Heaven Path and the Tianyuan School, are nothing.”
“Don’t forget about Long Yuan and the Million Demons Mountain in the Southern Region!” “They’re nothing in front of the glory of the Buddha! Let’s just watch and see how things
go.”
“To be on the safe side, we should probably prepare ourselves first.”
The few monks looked at the disciple of the devil sect and let out a satisfactory grin.
In the Eastern Region, at the Jiuyang Sect… The corner of Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched when he saw the Golden Heaven Path. ‘D*mn it! I just want to bask under the sun, feel the wind, eat some good food, and spend my time with my Junior Sister! Is it too much to ask?!’
“Are they immortals?” Zi Linglong asked as she grabbed Jiang Ming’s arm. “Senior Brother, I don’t have a good feeling about this. It seems to me that they’re coming to us. Let’s go, Senior Brother. It’ll be too late if we don’t run now. I’m sure we’ll be able to get our revenge one day.”
She glanced at Taiyang Peak.
“How did they come to our world? I thought there was a great terror between the mortal and the immortal realm? And I also don’t feel good about it. They’re coming to the Jiuyang Sect,” Xi Yao chimed in, her face filled with worries. “Let’s go, Brother Jiang. We should escape before things get too bad.”
“Xi Yao!” Jiang Ming turned around to look at her and asked in a serious manner, “Is there any record about the Golden Heaven Path in your sect?”
“The Golden Heaven Path?” Xi Yao frowned and fell into thought. After a short while, she shook her head and said, “Nope. I don’t remember seeing something like that.”
“Is there any restriction for immortals to come to the mortal world?”
“I have no idea either. Brother Jiang, let me go ask around.”
Xi Yao pulled out a mirror and began contacting the expert in her sect.
“Senior Brother!” Linglong shook his arm.
“Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming gave her an assuring smile.
“Alright, then!” Linglong responded with a smile as well.
She had decided. In the worst-case scenario, she would sacrifice all of her clones to shatter the Golden Heaven Path.
Swoosh!
The Human Path Records opened up.
Name:Dong Yao
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: True Immortal Realm
Background: General of Morning Glory Immortal Palace
Relationship: -92 Innate Talent: Immortal
Status: He knew that Jun Tianci had reincarnated in the mortal world with the Golden Heaven Path, a Taiyi Immortal Armament, so he had been guarding the Golden Palace, and once something happened, he would immediately take action. He had been waiting for many years, yet nothing happened. Suddenly, a gate appeared in the Golden Palace one day, and he felt the aura from the mortal world. He knew that the “Golden Heaven Path” had been activated, and a portal toward the mortal world had been opened. As he asked his men to send the message, he led a troop and came to the mortal world.
It had been a long time since he returned to the mortal world, and it was only then he realized how filthy, lowly, and disgusting the mortal world had become.
He lamented at the fact that he couldn’t do anything he wanted here. After all, he still had to follow the rules, and even with the blessing of the Golden Heaven Path, he could only use 30% of his strength. That being said, he felt it was more than enough for him to deal with the things down here.
When he learned that Jun Tianci was defeated again, he scoffed sarcastically, and he was confident that the Immortal Lord wouldn’t let him go easily this time.
He was surprised to learn that there were so many things that happened in the mortal world, such as the invasion of devils from another dimension, the emergence of a powerful being, and the descend of people from other worlds.
Although he was surprised, since he was here, he would be the one to lord over everything.
After learning that the powerful being probably came from a small sect named Jiuyang Sect in the Eastern Region, he felt strange but decided to come and destroy them first. As Jiang Ming read through his Status, the Golden Heaven Path had appeared on top of the Jiuyang Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - Immortal Restrictions
chapters.content:
Chapter 183 Immortal Restrictions
The information Dong Yao had given Jiang Ming was too much.
Just like Jun Tianci, Dong Yao also came from the Morning Glory Immortal Palace, but he was merely an average commander.
Jiang Ming felt uncomfortable with the relationship value of -92. Dong Yao was not his acquaintance. Hence the only explanation was that Dong Yao intended to massacre Jiuyang Sect.
Jiang Ming was disappointed and had been losing hope in the so-called ‘immortal’. After all, it was a world where strength was paramount throughout.
‘Is the Golden Heaven Path a mere mark in Jun Tianci’s mind? Originally it was a Taiyi Immortal Soldier! Taiyi is not that strong, yet it could connect the immortals and mortals? I wonder whether it’s the projection of a mark that has absorbed the mortals’ power?’
In fact, Jiang Ming was concerned about the capability of the Golden Heaven Path to form three golden territories and carry the Heavenly Immortal’s energy.
He pondered on the topic but to no avail. Hence, he decided not to dwell further on it.
He entered the Supreme Chat Group with just a thought, where he chatted occasionally.
(Jiang Ming: Who’s around?]
(Ao Jiu: Exercising. And I think my back pain is killing me now. Group admin, if you are asking for my experience, then I’m absolutely the right person.]
[Zhan Ge: The saying that dragons are naturally obscene is indeed true! I’m planning to kill a few to taste.]
[Ao Jiu: Do you believe that I’ll travel across worlds one day for you and to engulf you?]
[Zhan Ge: Hehe, if we’re to meet, you’ll become one of my dishes on the table. After all, humans’ cultivation speed is the fastest among the worlds! How can you compete with me when I’ve already stepped into Level 10, and you are still hanging in Level 10? By the way, group admin is the strongest. He was only Level 5 when he joined this chat group. Now he’s already Level 10 and passed 10 battle stages.]
[Ao Jiu: Little Ge Ge, you’re now Level 10? Impressive! What!? The group admin has passed 10 battle stages? This is f*cking crazy and unbelievable!)
[Ming Fei: I’m now in the Supreme Pagoda. From the record on the battle stage’s stone tablet, yes, our group admin has replaced the first record holder. It’s 10 stages, 10 stages! I can’t believe it either! How can a man beat a Level 13 with his cultivation base at Level 10? What the heck!)
(Tian Fozi: I’m in too, what the heck! Amitabha, group admin, are you the legendary Innate Saint Spirit? Otherwise, how can you be such a prodigy?]
[Luo Heng: Group admin, forever my idol!]
(Ye Qingxian: Having such a group admin, it’s both our honor and melancholy!)
[Zhan Ge: Yes! It’s our honor to have met a prodigy beyond our common sense and imagination. On the other hand, it’s our melancholy because the prodigy is too strong that none of us want to, or even have the thought to compete with.]
[Zi Lei: Aww… We are all geniuses here. We overwhelm our generation, overpowering the world, hence, forging our will of invincibility. We can compete among ourselves but barely can compete against our group admin.]
(Jiang Ming: Ahem, I’m just slightly stronger. Do stay calm, guys, be calm.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Group Admin is the mightiest! Brother Group Admin, so quickly, and you’re in your Level 10! I’ll try to break through within these two days and then try how many stages I can pass.]
(Jiang Ming: We’re on the same path, so you’ll at least pass 10 stages.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe, I’m incomparable to you, but I think I can pass about 8 stages.]
[Zhan Ge: Eight stages? Are you human? Someone like me who has passed only three stages is a mere newbie then.)
(Ao Jiu: Let’s shake hands, we’re both newbies.)
[Luo Heng: Shake hands, I’m worse than a newbie.]
(Jiang Ming: Hold on, I’d like to ask a question here. Can the domain formed by the energy coming from the immortal world through the passage created by an immortal weapon carry energy beyond a mortal world?]
[Ming Fei: I’ve heard Feng Wu talking about it before. It seems that a weapon beyond a certain level can form a domain in a mortal world. Through the domain, it can release energy beyond the world’s limit, but with great limitations.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Hold on a second, let me ask.]
OS
[Zhan Ge: The formed domain releases energy beyond the world’s limit? What the f*ck, how is it possible? In this case, the so-called immortal world can easily dominate any mortal world, isn’t it?]
[Ao Jiu: I’ve heard about it too, but I don’t know the details. Group admin, don’t tell me that immortals are invading your world?]
(Jiang Ming: I’m very unlucky!)
(Ao Jiu: Oh my, group admin, you are strong enough to pass 10 stages, so have them all killed. So what if they’re the immortals? Just have them all killed. I believe you can kill all beneath Level 13 easily.)
(Zi Lei: What if among them is a Level 14 expert?]
(Luo Heng: Group admin, is it serious? If I’m to beg my Master, I think I can get you a Level 13 weapon but not Level 14.]
(Ao Jiu: Level 14 weapon! It’s already considered the top-notch immortal weapon here in my world.)
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’ve found it.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: The weapon to create a passage connecting the immortal world and mortal world has to be at least a Level 15 Taiyi Immortal Soldier and above! Cultivation realms higher than Level 10 are the Level 11 Heavenly Immortal, Level 12 True Immortal, Level 13 Mystical Immortal, Level 14 Golden Immortal, and Level 15 Taiyi Golden Immortal. The weapon refined by a Taiyi Golden Immortal can be known as the Taiyi Immortal Soldier.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: For such an immortal weapon to create a passage connecting the immortal world and mortal world, there must be coordinates, and it requires enormous immortal energy. By the standard of a Taiyi Golden Immortal, it’s 1/3 of their immortal origin that’s needed. Moreover, such a strong Taiyi Golden Immortal usually won’t pay attention to the mortal world at all, let alone creating a passage.] (Dongfang Chenxi: If someone from the mortal world has the ability to act as a receiver, then less energy will be spent.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: When the passage is created, a domain can be conjured using an immortal weapon. The domain is also known as a Dao Domain, Forbidden Domain, Immortal Land, etc., and can carry anyone with a cultivation realm higher than the maximum a mortal world can carry.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Yes, just a cultivation realm higher. It’s the universe’s limitation and also the silver lining—the silver lining for both immortals and mortals.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: In general, invading a mortal world is to create a passage to the targeted mortal world and send Dao weapons over to overwhelm the world before setting up a great formation to refine the entire mortal world.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Nevertheless, it’s very rare that someone would use a Taiyi Immortal Soldier to create a passage because it’s a must to have coordinates.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Whenever it happens, it means that the mortal world has an insuppressible terrifying force through general means. Of course, it may also mean that the mortal world has certain secrets. Oh yeah, the number of people that can descend on a mortal world usually doesn’t exceed 100 immortals.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Group Admin, that’s all I know.]
[Jiang Ming: Chenxi, thanks! If the item used to create the passage is greater than the Taiyi Immortal Soldier, does it allow someone even stronger to descend?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: No, a cultivation realm stronger than the maximum of a mortal world is its maximum limit.]
(Jiang Ming: This is great! By the way, can such a passage send a mortal to the immortal world?)
(Dongfang Chenxi: Yes, but the mortal must be protected by someone at least in the Golden Immortal Realm. Otherwise, the mortal will be scattered by the Ascending Law. Besides, the greater the number of people sent through the passage, the greater the limitation.]
(Jiang Ming: The Grand Path Law gives hope and, at the same time, prevents cheating.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: The Grand Path is fair and square after all! Brother Group Admin, in fact, whenever an item is used to open up the passage, it usually means that the mortal world has a terrific attraction, attracting the immortal to conspire for it. What’s more terrifying is that they’d send infinite Dao weapons to flood the mortal world or transfer the mortal world into a wasteland so that the mortal world would lose its protection from the Grand Path.]
(Jiang Ming: Wasteland? Dao weapons?]
(Dongfang Chenxi: A wasteland is formed when a mortal world’s core is destroyed or is turned into a subsidiary space, Paradis space, etc. Examples of Dao weapons are puppets of Level 11 and below.) (Jiang Ming: Got it!] (Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe, based on your current pathway, cultivation realm, and strength, I don’t think you should be worrying.]
[Jiang Ming: How can I destroy the passage?]
(Dongfang Chenxi: You just need to wipe out the imprinted coordinates and destroy the gateway!)
(Jiang Ming: But that’s the power of Taiyi Immortal Soldier!)
(Dongfang Chenxi: In a mortal world, provided you have Level 11 strength, you can destroy it. Otherwise, who in the mortal world can resist the invasion?]
(Jiang Ming: You’re right!) (Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Group Admin, do you need any support?] (Jiang Ming: Not for now.]
(Dongfang Chenxi: Okay! Brother Group Admin, don’t hesitate to tell me whenever you need help. I’ll prepare Dao weapons, Golden Immortal weapons, and Taiyi Immortal Soldiers in advance for you.]
(Jiang Ming: Chenxi, thanks. You’ll be the first one I’ll go to whenever I need help.]
[Luo Heng: I’m so jealous.]
[Ao Jiu: Sister Chenxi, your brother, I, need Golden Immortal weapons and Taiyi Immortal Soldiers too.)
(Dongfang Chenxi: Hng, who’s your sister. Beware that I’ll request my dad to curse you. Whenever you are, I’ll make sure that your entire body is secreting pus.]
[Ao Jiu: Oh my, I’m shivering as a chill runs down my spine. Chenxi, you’re too cruel.] [Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe~]
(Jiang Ming: I shall go to confront the war! Then, I’ll make time for us to gather in the Supreme Pagoda!)
[Zhan Ge: Agree!)
[Ao Jiu: Agree!]
Jiang Ming withdrew his consciousness.
As he looked at the Golden Heaven Path which was now above the Jiuyang Sect, he smirked. “You have your immortal world, but I have all the worlds. It’s merely a piece of cake to learn about you. I shall slaughter immortals today!” He ended his sentence with high spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - Killing Immortals in the Saint Province Dao Square
chapters.content:
Chapter 184 Killing Immortals in the Saint Province Dao Square
Golden rays of light formed a Golden Heaven Path that stretched diagonally into the void. Dong Yao, riding on a Pegasus, was leading a team of fifty immortal soldiers.
The fleet marched on with pride as their imposing aura loomed through the air.
They stood on the Golden Heaven Path, looking down at the Jiuyang Sect below, aloof and indifferent.
Suddenly an abyss-like imposing aura poured down from above, forming a storm that could destroy anything in its path. It led to a celestial change with lightning and thunder as the dark clouds ensued. The only thing that never changed was the shining bright luminance from the Golden Heaven Path.
However, when the imposing aura came down on Jiuyang Sect, it immediately dissipated. “Sure enough! There’s something about this place!” Dong Yao’s eyes shone brightly as he swept up and down through Jiuyang Sect. His gaze finally stopped at Chuyang Peak and paced through the Golden Heaven Path and reached the mid-air of Chuyang Peak. “Already an Imminent Immortal are you? It’s still considered to be rare in this small morrtal world.” He stared at Zi Linglong, “Kneel before me!”
“Who do you think you are? Asking me to kneel!” Zi Linglong replied indifferently as a sword appeared on her hands. It was an Immortal-level Weapon, something that Spatial Junior Sister acquired during a great encounter and ended up in the hands of her original self.
At that moment, the experts from each peak of Jiuyang Sect looked into the sky with an ugly expression. Immortals were great encounters? No one was stupid as they could clearly see the hostility in the eyes of this so-called immortal.
“You feeble human disrespecting an immortal is akin to disrespecting heaven and earth, disrespecting power, disrespecting the great Dao! Your soul must be decimated!” Dong Yao was not annoyed as his voice was just calm and indifferent, “This Jiuyang Sect here, will sink along with you!”
Swoosh….
As soon as he waved his hands, numerous glitter of lights started falling from the sky, a total of 36 of them.
As these glittery lights fell on the Golden Heaven Path, they swelled up and turned into mannequins where each of them had the aura of an Imminent Immortal expert!
The mannequins held on to their swords and directly launched their attack at Chuyang Sect.
“Can you handle him? “Jiang Ming asked.
“No problem at all!” Zi Linglong replied as she immediately launched her attack.
She rose into the air and the Immortal sword on her hands burst out rays of light. Its attack speed rose to a limit, fending off all 36 of the immortal mannequins, sending them flying across the back of the mountains, with no other signs of movement left. “Soul Spirit Sword and the Spirit Slaying Light.” Dong Yao finally had a change in his expression, “I never expected that such a level of Sword Dao special ability would exist in this mortal world. War Mannequins have strong physiques and are endowed with special abilities which make them extremely difficult to deal with. The only flaw they have is that its spirituality is too weak but it is also protected by a forbidden law defensive mechanism. Even if it’s a flaw, it is also the part where the defense is the strongest. I never expected you to have such a special ability that can attack directly into the spiritual wisdom core, destroying it in one blow.”
“Jiuyang sect is a lowly sect and yet was able to nurture such a genius like you. It seems that the Jiuyang Sect isn’t as simple as it seems! I’ve now confirmed that you are the anomaly! Hence, you shall perish!”
Dong Yao was very decisive. With a tap of the halberd in his hands, the whole Golden Heaven Path trembled slightly and golden luminance that was on it flowed throughout like mercury, polluting the void and seeping into the great earth. It quickly spread out with Jiuyang Sect as its center.
Jiang Ming transmitted his voice and told her about the Golden Heaven Path that could evoke a domain, and finally asked, “Girl, they will soon become serious and all of them will emit the power of the Heavenly Immortal Realm. Do you still want to try it yourself?” “I can still handle it if there’s only one or two of them, but there’s too many of them. I might still have a chance if the nine of my clones attack at the same time!” Zi Linglong was a little surprised at how Jiang Ming knew about the existence of the domain, but still helplessly replied to him.
With her clones’ cultivation being in different realms, she had no confidence to fight against 50 Heavenly Immortals at all.
“Senior Brother, can you handle them then?” Zi Linglong asked him back. “Just relax!” Jiang Ming nodded.
At that very moment, experts from all of the great forces in the Tianyuan World were looking over to see what was happening.
Qingyun Sect of the Eastern Region.
“Sure enough, there’s something going on with Jiuyang Sect!” Qing Fengzi looked over to the direction of Jiuyang Sect with a very solemn expression, “Immortals descending into the mortal world. This is a catastrophe, a true catastrophe at that. The Immortals should just be staying high up in the Nine Heavens. Once they descend into the mortal realm, they are more of a devil than the devil itself.”
“You are just exaggerating it!” the holy lord smiled bitterly. “Heh!” Qing Fengzi shook his head, “As the Holy Lord, don’t you know about the essence of the world? This is a dog-eat-dog world! Immortals who stayed aloof naturally occupied the commanding heights. With their absolute power, they can do whatever they want in this world. Who dares to resist them? Those who resist will be the devil! If it’s the devil that descends into the mortal world, at least it can encourage the forces all over the world to be united and fight back together.”
“What you just said is the truth but when you look at the current situation, they are here to destroy the Jiuyang Sect, which we are more than happy to see it happens!” “Yet it’s still saddening to see one of the humans perish!”
ee
There was a moment of pure silence.
So many doubts were popping out in their minds.
How did this Golden Heaven Path form?
How did the Immortals descend into the mortal world?
None of them understood what happened and they could only watch them unfold.
On top of a mountain in the Hai Province.
“Have they finally started? I guess I’ll be making my move as well!” the Devil King smiled, and with a thought of his mind the undercovers that he had planted over the great lands immediately spun into action. ‘This mortal world! Finally it’s time to turn it upside down!’
‘Immortal Region, Immortal Region! Haha!”
‘Jiuyang Sect, could it be it’s really there?’
The Devil King couldn’t stop pondering while the whole Qing Province was painted gold by the bright light.
…
In Jiang Ming’s eyes, he could see that even the world’s origin was completely suppressed under the luminance of the golden lights. All the power of laws retreated and there was only a type of supreme Dao that shrouded the entire place. “So this is the Immortal Law?” Jiang Ming thought to himself.
In the air above, Dong Yao landed his Pegasus and the Immortal Soldiers who followed him still stayed in midair, right behind him.
“Your face still remains indifferent even when the situation is already like this! Great courage, I must say!” Dong Yao glanced at the two of them, sighing indifferently. He then pointed his halberd at the two and howled, “Kill them, and then level the entire Jiuyang Sect. Kill each and every one and them. Spare no mercy!”
“Immortals huh?” Jiang Ming merely smiled and with a simple thought, the power of Saint Province Dao Square spread out in an instant, forming a forbidden region, isolating everything from the outside world.
“This power…” The Immortal Soldiers who were about to make a move paused for a moment, with their faces full of shock. Even Dong Yao’s expression had changed as he shouted, “Why do I feel a type of overbearing supreme power? This is merely a mortal world! This is impossible!”
“Nothing is impossible!” Jiang Ming muttered, raising his palm and grasping onto the air in front of him. The immense Dao energy turned into a storm that could destroy anything it touches. This led Dong Yao and the other immortals to be stunned stiff as their faces were filled with an incomprehensible fear.
Boom..
The storm then simply shattered. All 50 of the immortals including Dong Yao were dead in an instant, not even the Pegasus was left. However, all of the Immortal Soldiers were still fine.
“If your combat ability does not exceed mine by a hundred fold, I am the master here! Yet if you want to exceed my combat ability by a hundred fold? Then I’m afraid you’ll have to reach the Golden Immortal Realm here then. But can the Golden Immortal’s even descend here?” Jiang Ming simply smiled. However, Zi Linglong who was right beside him was shocked out of breath.
She knew Senior Brother was strong and extremely strong at that. Yet she never expected him to be so strong to such an extent.
Those were Immortals!
The one leading them was even of the True Immortal Realm and he must also be carrying a defensive immortal weapon with him. Coupled with the Pegasus, how powerful was he! Yet, he just perished with a simple grasp of Senior Brother’s hand?
Not to mention there were another 50 Immortal soldiers with Heavenly Immortal Realm!
“I’ve already been so honest about everything with my Senior Brother, communicating so intimately with him every day. Yet why do I feel that he has more and more secrets?” Zing Linglong’s face flashed a wry smile.
Thinking that she was going to protect her Senior Brother for the rest of her life, yet now it seemed that she who was a reincarnated peerless character still needed the protection of her Senior Brother.
Zi Linglong mentally prepared herself a little for it, yet Xi Yao who was standing silently behind Jiang Ming through the whole incident was already stunned at her feet.
‘Are these really the Immortals?’ Xi Yao felt as though she was dreaming.
Jiang Ming looked over at the furthest end of the Golden Heaven Path and saw a golden gate at the end.
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!” Without any hesitation, he smashed the golden gate into smithereens with just a finger.
The golden color that shrouded the entire Qing Province disappeared without a trace as though it was an illusion.
The whole incident was like a dream. It happened so fast and ended so fast.
Up on the mountain of the Hai Province.
The Devil King saw Dong Yao landed on the Chuyang Peak and just disappeared without a trace. Even with his pair of godly visions, he couldn’t see what was happening inside and this really surprised him.
Immediately afterwards, a finger flew out of Chuyang Peak, smashed the Golden Gate and the Golden Heaven Path simply disappeared.
The Devil King’s vision was extraordinary that he could see how terrific that finger was as he muttered to himself, “That finger…. Merging 99 Daos of the mortal realm allowed this special ability to be empowered to such a terrifying extent. So, are they all dead? What in the world is the Jiuyang Sect hiding? They killed more than 50 immortals in such a short period of time!”
This time, the Devil Lord was really surprised but he was not alone.
Even Qing Fengzi of the Qingyun Sect, Lao Tie of the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, Liu Changkong of the Tianyuan school and many more were all in disbelief.
Dong Yao and his men disappeared without a trace just as they landed on Chuyang sect. They were isolated from sight and the rest immediately ensued.
There was only one explanation: Dong Yao and his men were all killed.
Fifty or more immortals dead just like that?
What was Jiuyang Sect actually hiding?
Over in the Western Region, the few great Buddha were shocked at first, but quickly turned ecstatic.
“The secret of the world is in Jiuyang Sect! Now that we have confirmed our target, everything will be easier to handle!”
“Easier to handle? Fifty or so Immortals were killed just now, the Golden Heaven Path was smashed into smithereens as well. With power as strong to such an extent, how is this easier to handle?”
“Now that we’ve confirmed the target, we can just arrange it in a targeted manner. If worst comes to worst then we’ll just…..”
The few great Buddha suddenly just fell silent.
On top of Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming pointed his finger and the World Monitoring Mirror appeared.
He sensed some changes just now, but didn’t have the time to check on it.
It was only then that he took the mirror out and noticed in one part of the mirror, a large number of abnormal light spots appeared.
“Other newcomers? No! Newcomers wouldn’t be so dense nor would they be in such a huge number. If so, the only possibility would be that the world’s gate has opened!”
Upon coming to such a conclusion, Jiang Ming had the urge to start cursing.
God damn it! I haven’t even finished dealing with the problem there and there’s another new problem popping out yet again!
“Now that I’ve made my move, I guess I’ll just kill them to my content!” Jiang Ming was inexplicably enraged.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - Child of the World, Two Devil Kings, Demon Emperor of the Demon Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 185 Child of the World, Two Devil Kings, Demon Emperor of the Demon Abyss
The seal of the Saint Province Dao Square vanished.
The Jiuyang Sect reappeared in the world yet again, this time the Immortal Soldier and the likes of Dong Yao were nowhere to be seen. Immediately, mist started rising and the great formation that was initially suppressed by the Golden Heave Path started to evoke again, blocking off line of sight.
“Brother Jiang, am I dreaming?” Xi Yao still had not come out of her shock as she grabbed onto Jiang Ming’s arm as her warm breath exhaled onto his arm.
“Are you trying to take this opportunity to take advantage of my Senior Brother?” Linglong grabbed Xi Yao’s hands off him, as she kneaded and pinched her, “It’s really soft and boneless”
Xi Yao’s face turned red as she quickly pulled out her hand and harrumphed, “You perverted lady!”
Jiang Ming ignored the two, turned around and disappeared without a trace. He teleported away, arriving in the Submerged Dragon Continent.
What was in front of him were mountains of different heights, rivers and ravines across the horizons. Birds could be seen soaring in the skies and beasts fighting in their natural habitat. There wasn’t anything unusual about the place.
Jiang Ming swept his hand mid-air, slashing the void in front of him, bringing a whole new world into revelation.
Thick demonic fog rolled through the area and the grounds were pitch black. There were all kinds of demons roaming around, each giving an eerie aura yet were powerful nonetheless.
He noticed a few of the demons pouring some sort of black liquid into the gullies. These black liquids were like living creatures that quickly drilled into the grounds.
As Jiang Ming’s eyes shone, he discovered that the places that were infected by these liquids no longer had the breath that the lands of the mortal world was supposed to have, but instead gave off the power of the abyss.
These aura of the abyss were rapidly rising.
‘Are they trying to turn this place into a demonic domain?’ Jiang Ming was shocked.
In a far distance, there was a huge spatial gateway where demons of all kinds swarming in and out like tidal waves.
Roughly estimating, there were already as many as ten millions of these demons spreading across the hills with varying strengths.
He saw a 100-feet tall demon standing right next to the gateway.
Jiang Ming quickly opened up the Human Path Record.
Name: Hei Luoli
Race: Abyssal Devil Troll Clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 11 (Heavenly Immortal Realm)
Background: The underlings of the Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm’s Third Devil King
Relationship: -98
Innate Talent: Immortal
Status: Currently following the orders of the Third Devil King, Xue Tao to guard the gateway.
When he first came over to demonize this mortal word, he gazed around. When he saw that this was just a planar world, he was shocked, wondering why would the Devil King choose to demonize such a small mortal world? After all, the cost of completely demonizing the little world with the origin source of the Abyss, is too much of a consumption, and will not be enough to be compensated. He’s afraid that the Devil King’s thousands of years of accumulation will be exhausted in just one go, hence he couldn’t believe it!
What kind of secret is hidden in this mortal world?
Who was the one who opened up the gateway to cross worlds? Why is there the scent of the Devil King?
Legend has it that the Devil King left an imprint somewhere in the mortal world. Could it be that this is the world? What secret can there even be in a mortal world?
Could it be that the Devil King wants to merge this world into the abyss or rather devour it? But that can’t be! Even if the Devil King devours this world, it is of little use to him.
Demonizing the lands here already is sufficient for it to cater to the power of the Sky Devil, so why continue doing so? Could it be that we’re trying to bring forth the True Demon or maybe the Demon General?
No, even if the Devil King has boundless resources, he won’t be able to demonize the world and bring upon the Demon General.
Upon reading through the ‘Status’ Jiang Ming felt restless.
‘What secret does the mortal world actually hold? There’s first the Golden Heaven Path and now even the Devil King from small chiliocosm did not hesitate to exhaust their boundless resources to bring upon demonization to this world.’ He was puzzled, really puzzled by all this. However, he noticed something important, that was, the Devil King Xue Tao seemed to be determined on taking over Tianyuan World.
‘Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm, why does this seem so familiar? Oh I remember! The demonic invasion that took place over at the Northern Region was also from this small chiliocosm, but it was the Ninth Devil King’s underling that time. This group today belongs to the Third Devil King. To think that they came from the same world. Could it be that the secret of the mortal world had something to do with their world? How are the abyss divided though?’
Jiang Ming suppressed his thoughts as he could not wait any longer.
Once more and more Sky Devils and True Demons descended, then it would be even more of a problem.
As for the Sky Devils and the True Demons, Jiang Ming also learned from his chat group’s friends that they were a division of the demonic domain, corresponding to the Heavenly Immortal and the True Immortal; where Demon General corresponded to the Immortal General, both of the Mystical Immortal Realm.
Hum….
Ripples started to form in the void as immeasurable pressure descended onto the land. It was the World Projection.
With a simple thought, Jiang Ming evoked the projection as boundless lights instantly rained down, cleansing and purifying all evil, demonic energy and darkness.
The power of World Projection suppressed all of the demonic energy that transformed the land. The demons collapsed one after another as though there was a bottomless mountain pressing down on them, and when the lights shined on them, loud shrieks could be heard before they turned into wisps of black smoke, disappearing without a trace. The light purifies and restraints demonic cultivations.
Right next to the gateway.
“How can there be such a strong power in this world? The Devil Troll Hei Luoli was shocked and what made him even more unbelievable was that he was almost unable to move a muscle under the suppression of the World Projection.
It was simply unbelievable.
Hei Luoli hurriedly evoked his demonic blood, burned through his essence, trying to break free and escape through the gateway.
“Perish!”
How would Jiang Ming allow his wish to come true? He bombarded him with the Unlimited Killing Punch. Energizing with the power of his inner world allowed his punch to greatly exceed the limits of a human being.
The moment he landed onto the gateway on impact, the gateway which was forged by the Devil King clone instantly shattered. “We’re finished!” Devil Troll Hei Luoli had a face of despair.
The expressions on the other 80 Sky Devils were also of extreme desperation. “Who in the world are you?” Devil Troll Hei Luoli asked while looking at Jiang Ming who was shrouded in bright light.
On top of his head, demonic flames were ignited, twisting the void as he tried to break free from the World Projection’s suppression.
“What a strong devil! It’s no weaker than a True Immortal already!” Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up. In order to avoid any incident, he had the Level 14 Immortal weapon, Universe Furnace that was suppressing in his inner world, to release a wisp of immortal energy, which completely suppressing Hei Luoli, rendering him unable to move one bit. Immediately after, the Universe Furnace suddenly appeared, floating on top of them. As the furnace turned upside down, it released a powerful suction, swallowing the Devil Troll Hei Luoli and the other 80 Sky Devils whole, suppressing them inside.
Jiang Ming did not leave immediately, and continued to maintain the World Projection to evoke the power of light, quickly cleansing and purifying the demonic region.
Slowly the power of mortal law returned to the land and the suppressed world’s origin started to operate again.
It didn’t take long for the area to be completely purified. It was also at that moment, Jiang Ming suddenly felt a burst of clarity in his heart, as his comprehension of the world’s origin and the operation of law rose to an even greater level.
There was also a kind of intimate aura gathering before him from various parts of the world.
“Is this destiny?” Jiang Ming raised his head and had a sudden clear comprehension of what had transpired.
Save the world and you would receive the blessing from heaven and earth.
From now on, he would have boundless luck, the ability to turn bad luck into good luck and also receive the blessing of heaven in this planar world.
“If it was the old me, I would be very happy, but now…” Jiang Ming shook his head.
He no longer cared for it.
The things that this mortal world could provide him no longer sparks his interest.
After keeping away all the trophies he got from the devils, Jiang Ming started to write on the Human Path Record.
With his mind as the pen and his spirit aiding his mind, he wrote: Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm’s Third Devil King, Xue Tao.
The person’s was written in incredible detail and without any accidents, the details were shown below:
Name: Xue Tao
Race: Xuemo Clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 14 (Devil King, Golden Immortal Realm)
Background: Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm’s Third Devil King
Relationship: -72
Innate talent: Immortal
Status: In ancient times, there was a blood-colored lake in the demonic domain, which gave birth to a large number of xuemo. He coincidentally swallowed a droplet of blood that had boundless strength, which made him grow and evolve rapidly. He ended up devouring all the other xuemo that were in the lake.
Ultimately, he devoured even the blood-colored lake and gave himself a name, with Xue as his surname and Tao as his name, Xue Tao. As the bloody waves loom, it would surely sweep through the Demon Abyss and the heavens.
Upon leaving his birth place, he started to conquer the demonic lands. Through carnage, devouring and growing in a land filled with bloodshed, he had life-and-death battles for tens of thousands of years before he became the Devil King of a new era. He never continued to grow up until he became the third Devil King standing at the pinnacle of this demonic land.
He also knew a lot of secrets. For example, the place that he was in was just a small chiliocosm called the Blood Red Abyss and that Blood Red Abyss belonged to the Boundless Demonic Domain. There is a passage that connects the places together, which he secretly used to go into the Boundless Demonic Domain. But he later returned with severe injury in just 10 days’ time. Fortunately, the non-native demons find it hard to descend into their world.
He spent his following years constantly sneaking into higher and higher levels of the Demonic region to commit bloodshed, in search of an opportunity to break through.
A hundred thousand years, a million years, ten million years and slowly billion years had passed. After witnessing how grand and magnificent the battlefield was, and also watching Devil Kings falling like the rain, his desire to break through started corroding his mind. Upon reaching this stage or cultivation, the next step forward will be even harder, much harder than breaking through the skies.
It seems as though his potential had been exhausted.
Just as he was about to join a new Demon Emperor and exchange his credit for further opportunities to improve himself, the Ninth Devil King angered him. Just when he was about to beat him to death, the Ninth Devil King revealed a secret: Somewhere in the mortal world, there are hidden secrets that allows the Devil King to improve further in cultivation and that he had already set up a demonic inheritance there.
He believed the news when the Ninth Devil King swore on it. After pondering for a long time, he accumulated nine seeds that were infused with his own demonic spirit and used the coordinate that the Ninth Devil King provided to barely tear a tiny opening in the world, throwing the nine seeds as an investment for the future.
Tens of millions of years ago, one of the demonic seeds had matured and he found clues about the world containing a certain great secret. He then collected various rare materials, forged an interdimensional gateway and allowed a great number of demons to descend.
Just when it looked like he was about to completely take over the mortal word, an immortal gateway opened up and the Buddha descended. It was a huge battle that even caused the sun to fall, the sea to run dry and destroyed more than half of humanity. The land towards the east was shattered and a huge part of it submerged into the deep sea. In the end, he was defeated and the Demonic spirit clone was killed. The incident strengthened the Devil King’s idea of seizing the opportunity over in this world. After all, it was much safer than the bloodshed in the higher-level world.
When the last demonic spirit matured, formed a clone and opened up another interdimensional gateway, he depleted billions of years of accumulated resources to demonize the mortal world, regardless of the cost. He was determined to succeed this time.
Unfortunately, he still fell short in the end. Devil King Xue Tao: Damn it! Why is there such a powerful being hidden in such a small little world? Not only did he destroy the Ninth Devil King’s arrangement, annihilate the immortals who descended on the Golden Heaven Path, but he also destroyed my demonic land! I’ve sent over 81 Sky Devils and among them were Hei Luoli who was comparable to a True Devil! A whole hundreds of millions of year’s effort going down the drain just like that? Fortunately, the demonic spiritual clone is now hidden somewhere. If it was killed, then I’ll join hands with the Ninth Devil King to destroy this mortal world and see what secrets lie beneath it!
Upon reading through the ‘Status’, Jiang Ming’s heart sank. To think that the world was actually targeted by two Devil Kings!
Devil Kings were akin to the Golden Immortals.
It seemed that the Blood Red Abyss was not an independent existence but whether the Infinite Demon Abyss that it was part of was considered a middle chiliocosm or a great chiliocosm was uncertain. ‘The source of the Demonic Dao inheritance has finally been found.’ Jiang Ming was speechless.
The ‘Status’ display on the Human Path Record had not ended yet, and the current status of the Devil King’s clone appeared below. It was very simple. After a certain person cultivated into the Extreme Path Realm, the demonic spirit had awakened and taken over the person’s body. After learning of the series of events that took place in the Tianyuan Continent, he didn’t dare to reveal himself but instead went over to the Submerged Dragon Continent to finish forging the interdimensional gateway and hid himself after.
Coincidently, the Golden Heaven Path appeared and he took this opportunity to evoke the interdimensional gateway, thinking that it would be quite some time before their battles ended. Never did he think that the incomparably arrogant immortal soldiers could be destroyed with just a flick!
Devil King’s clone: I will just continue hiding for another ten, hundreds, thousands or even tens of thousands of years! After this unknown Jiuyang Sect expert ascends into the higher realm, I will initiate my plans yet again! As for the secret? Now that I know it’s within Jiuyang Sect, there’s nowhere to run! “Can he even hide from me?”
Upon reading, Jiang Ming simply sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - Heavenly Order, SS-Grade Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 186 Heavenly Order, SS-Grade Mission
The Human Path Record locked on onto the Devil King’s clone.
It was on a mountain peak in Hai Province of the Eastern Region. It took Jiang Ming a simple teleportation to arrive.
“You actually found me!” The Devil King’s clone had a face of dismay, “My aura is the same as the locals and I’ve cut off all connections to the outside world, yet how could you possibly find me?” “That’s simple!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “I am the Natural Laws of Heavens!”
“Natural Laws of Heavens?” the Devil King’s clone was confused, “What trickery is this?”
“It means I’m this world’s Dao incarnation, the manifestation of the source, a collection of the wills of all beings.” Jiang Ming sat down and gestured for him to sit with him as well, “Let’s talk, shall we?”
The Devil King’s clone sat down subconsciously and asked: “Dao Incarnation? Origin Manifestation? Will of the beings? What you just mentioned are laws, and it’s impossible for laws to give birth to a will of its own.”
He paused for a moment before his eyes suddenly lit up, “Could it be you’ve taken over the world’s origin?”
“You can put it that way I guess!” Jiang Ming’s smile became even brighter.
“It’s no wonder that you’re so powerful already but still haven’t ascended into the higher realm. It’s no wonder that you can easily find those who have descended from another world. Taking over the world’s origin, you are able to thoroughly see through the entire heaven and earth!” The Devil King’s clone had a face filled with amazement, “Where did you actually come from?”
The Devil King’s clone’s ‘Status’ wrote: This guy is toying with me. Taking over the world’s origin? He’s just pulling my legs! The world’s origin is the congregation of laws, the accumulation of the will of all living beings. Trying to take over when your strength is weak and your own will will be shattered into pieces. If you are too strong, you could simply just refine the world and there would be no point in taking over it already. Could it be that this guy doesn’t have a clue about my background? Otherwise, how could he try to fool me with such a poor excuse?
Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched upon seeing the status. To think that he didn’t manage to fool him, he thought this guy he was facing was quite a good actor himself!
“Alas, you clone, you won’t believe me even when I say it. Xue Tao, you feeble Devil King from the Blood Red Abyss, disturbing my peaceful life! You should be killed!” Jiang Ming preached in an old-fashioned manner.
Upon hearing this, the Devil King’s clone suddenly jumped up, pointing at Jiang Ming and asked in disbelief, “How do you know about my identity as a clone?”
“I even know you are of the Xuemo race. Now, sit down!” Jiang Ming pointed towards the ground with a harsh, unopposable tone.
The Devil King’s clone suddenly burst into rage, yet felt his head numb from the shock and sat down tangled: “What exactly are you?”
“I’m from the Primitive Chaotic World. Do you know where that is?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Primitive Chaotic World? Never heard of it.” the clone frowned.
“Such petty narrow-minded being! In the Chaotic World, there’s a Verdant Lotus of Destiny of the 36th ranking, the treasured artifact of the chaotic world, giving birth to the Ancient Heavenly King, Pangu. At the same time, there were also 3,000 Chaotic Demon Gods, given birth concurrently.” As though caught up in his memory, Jiang Ming slowly continued: “Pangu was born with his hand holding onto the Heavenly Artifact, Pangu’s Ax, and on the top of his head were jaded butterflies that was imbued with 3,000 strands of the chaotic Dao. He then massacred the 3,000 Chaotic Demon Gods, split apart the Chaotic World and formed a great chiliocosm.”
“Forming a great chiliocosm? God, that’s impossible!” the clone nearly leapt up in shock with his eyes staring widely at Jiang Ming, “That’s the great chiliocosm! How can a great chiliocosm be formed? It’s impossible!”
“To think that you still don’t believe me when I say you’re narrow minded!” Jiang Ming sneered in contempt, “At the beginning of the world, there were countless innate holy beings born, with the Dragons, Phoenix, and Kirin as the three main races. The three battled ceaselessly, trying to take over the world. Later, the Ancestral Demon was born and wiped out the three races. In order to prove his own Dao, he fought with the Ancestral Dao but was defeated, dying a tragic death.”
The Devil King’s clone opened his mouth but in the end didn’t argue, and continued listening quietly.
Jiang Ming continued speaking slowly while closely monitoring the Human Path Record, hoping to derive some new content into the clones ‘Status’.
He talked about the Great Lich War, the Six Great Saint Overbearing the world and how someone was conferred God in the mortal world etc.
“Ever heard of these then?” Jiang Ming finally asked.
The Devil King’s clone was dumbfounded from the stories. He didn’t want to believe him, yet this small person sitting in front of him told so many details that it didn’t look fake at all.
“Never!” the clone shook, “Never heard of it at all! I know that the current highest-level realm is overlooked by the various Immortal Emperors. There aren’t any of these so-called Six Saints at all.”
Jiang Ming’s eyes gleamed, and knew the clone wasn’t lying when he saw his ‘Status’.
However, Jiang Ming discovered Pangu’s Axe, Nine-Reincarnation Mysterious Technique and many more from the Heavenly Reincarnation Hall, which led him to a terrifying guess.
“Still the arrogant feeble Devil King.” Jiang Ming muttered, “Tell me a little about the current Infinite Demon Abyss then.”
“Alright!” the clone nodded and continued, “The Infinite Demon Abyss consists of countless levels, levels upon levels like a bee hive. It’s exactly opposite standing with the Immortal Realm.”
“Continue!”
“That’s all I know, I didn’t understand much!” “Continue!” “Alright, alright!” The clone showed a face of despair but still nodded. At that very moment, he suddenly burst into action, with his hands condensing a small pointed edge, ramming straight at Jiang Ming’s forehead, but his body froze all of a sudden.
The power of imprisonment made it difficult for him to move.
“Such feeble little Devil trying to play tricks in front of me.” Jiang Ming sneered, “I wanted to let you live longer but since you’re looking for your death, I’ll fulfill your wish!”
“Suppressing me with only the World Projection. You’re amazing, kid. But no matter the case, I won’t believe your so-called Pangu pioneering worlds and the other nonsense. You’re just trying to snoop about the Abyss from me, and why would I allow your wishful thinking?” the clone sneered as well, before coldly announced, “I’m the Devil King! Even if it’s just a clone of myself, I possess supreme power! With my Demonic Soul, I curse you with bad luck…” Before being able to finish his sentence, he burst into smithereens, dying on the spot.
However, the curse was still casted onto Jiang Ming as he could clearly feel it.
Jiang Ming’s face turned serious, ready to evoke the level 14 Immortal Weapon, Universe Sword. The Human Path Record that was floating by his side suddenly trembled and the curse dissipated into thin air.
“This item is the greatest of all!” with a sigh, Jiang Ming teleported back to where he came from.
High atop Chuyang Peak.
“Senior Brother, did you solve it?” As soon as he reappeared, Linglong went straight up to hug his arm and observed him from head to toe.
“There’s nothing your Senior Brother cannot handle in this mortal world!” Jiang Ming pinched her chin and gave her a peck. “You’re just bragging!” Linglong pouted, “Try dominating all the Holy Daughters of the Sacred Lands if you dare then!”
“You really allow me to?
“Of course!”
“Hehe, I’m afraid you will castrate me.
“Meh, you’re just worried you can’t withstand them!”
“Nonsense!”
The two continued whispering to each other.
Fortunately Xi Yao left for the time being. Otherwise, her face would’ve definitely been blushed right down to her neck. Jiang Ming casually pointed with his fingers, taking out the Universe Furnace. He released Hei Luoli and the other 80 Sky Devils and suppressed them with the power of his domain.
Linglong’s pupil shrank upon seeing this and asked, “Senior Brother, are these demons?”.
over
“Sky Devil to be exact!” Jiang Ming continued, “Wait till I enslave them and place them over the mountain peaks to be the mountains protector. Then we won’t have to be the one doing everything. I regret very much now that we killed those immortal soldiers. Won’t it be better if we just kept them alive?”
“Hehe, Senior Brother, you still feel like eating them up? It’s quite sad what happened to the Pegasus though.” Linglong laughed and seriously asked, “Senior Brother, since these are Sky Devils, can they be completely enslaved?”
“Let me try!” Jiang Ming wasn’t sure either.
With his extraordinary mind and will, he evoked the power of the world’s origin and at the same time mobilized the power of the Saint Province Dao Square, aiming at a demon to forcefully evoke a special ability, erasing his will and planting a soul imprint in him.
The whole process was almost effortless.
The “Relationship” of the demon soared straight to 100.
Completely loyal with its soul bonded as a slave, its life and death could be determined with just a simple thought from Jiang Ming.
After three whole days, he finally finished enslaving all of the captured demons.
Even so, Jiang Ming was nearly exhausted to death from this.
It was fortunate the result was perfect. As he waved his hands, the 81 Sky Devils turned into light, landed on the edge of the cliffs, turning into stone statues and stood in silence.
“From now on, they will be the guardians of the Jiuyang Sect. Girl, if you need anything, just ask them for help but it’s only limited to the vicinity of the sect. Once they step out, I’m afraid they will be forced to ascend to higher realms.” Jiang Ming reminded Linglong.
“Brother, you’re still the best.” Linglong said sincerely and asked, “Will they escape your control?”
“As long as they are in the mountains, absolutely not!”
As for leaving Jiuyang Sect, it wouldn’t be much of a problem either.
However, if they were able to return to the Demonic Realm, Jiang Ming no longer had the confidence, for there were many other strong experts in the Demonic Realm.
Jiang Ming swayed softly, resting on the reclining chair.
Junior Sister came over with a fruit bowl, placed a slice of orange in front of his mouth and asked, “Senior Brother, do you no longer care about the Great Zhou Dynasty anymore?”
“There’s no longer the need to.” Jiang Ming answered, “When the Golden Heaven Path appeared, it destroyed the royal palace. Who knows how many princes were killed in the incident and not to mention the casualties of those royalty that were hidden deep within the palace? After the last great catastrophe, the resources of the Great Zhou Royal Family may have been exhausted. Occupying the best territory without the corresponding strength, their ending is sealed, that is, ending up divided by the other forces.”
“You’re right!” Linglong nodded and laid down on his laps, “Senior Brother, initially, I didn’t want to evoke the Heavenly Order because I’m afraid that I might accidentally break through into the Imminent Immortal Realm and ascend into higher realm. But you also said it yourself, that as long as we are in the mountains, we can break through into the Imminent Immortal Realm without ascending. Those Sky Devils can be examples, so I don’t want to wait further. According to my estimation, I’m afraid that my true self and the clones have to go together and I don’t know how long I’ll stay there. I’m also reluctant to part with you. I’m really conflicted now!”
“Will there be dangers?” Jiang Ming asked as he turned serious.
It’s the inheritance of a Heavenly Being, and will probably be extraordinary. “There shouldn’t be any”
“Do you really want to go?”
“I’m tangled as well. But if I don’t improve myself quickly, I won’t be able to keep up with your footsteps, Senior Brother!”
“If you can’t keep up, so be it. You’re not worried that I might bully you, are you?”
“Hmph! I’m afraid you’ll find a harem yourself!”
“Haha! Once you leave, you won’t be able to control me anymore!”
“Accept Xi Yao then! She’s of good temperament as well. When I leave, she’ll be able to satisfy your cravings. Can’t leave your lust pent up can we?”
“Puff…” Jiang Ming spurted a mouthful of tea.
Before leaving, the ten Junior Sisters accompanied Jiang Ming in his room for a month before coming out.
Jiang Ming’s face had turned pale but Linglong was full of smiles.
She evoked the Heavenly Order, originally wanting to send a clone over to test it out, but ended up with her own body and the other 10 clones to be sucked away into it.
Jiang Ming sighed in his heart, and hurriedly looked up the Human Path Record, closely monitoring his Junior Sister’s movement.
At the same time, he sensed the spiritual prayer from Fifth Immortal Moon that she had accepted a SS-Grade mission and was getting ready to descend.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - Inheritance, Jiang Ming’s Sleek Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 187 Inheritance, Jiang Ming’s Sleek Move
In the Blood Red Abyss World.
Devil King Xue Tao sat quietly in an ancient great hall, yet the atmosphere was depressing to the extreme. Even the witches who served him all knelt to his right and left, shivering in fear.
“I’ve exhausted all my resources, conjured up a demonic land and even sent 81 Sky Devils over in a short while. Yet, all my plans failed in just a glimpse of an eye. The mortal world, the mortal world that was supposed to be my place of great encounter, how can I fail! His strength has already far exceeded the limits of the mortal world. He was comparable to even the True Demon. No, even the ordinary True Demon might not stand a chance against him! Yet how can he still stay in the mortal world for such a long time? Could it be that he is a one in a hundred-million years genius? Whatever the case is, the normal methods are of no use anymore. So… should I go there myself to seek it? I can’! Even with my strength, crossing through endless torrents of space time and illusory lands, my chance of survival is close to none. How can I deal with this?” Devil King Xue Tao pondered.
Eventually, he got down to three conclusions: One, to first form an alliance with many other Devil Kings and make their next move together; Two, to wait for a great change in the mortal world, and that peerless figure to ascend to higher realm; Third, to head on over to the Infinite Demon Abyss and serve up the great encounters.
In the Supreme Immortal World.
Immortal-like luminance shone brightly as the rainbow hung high, entwined by the purple clouds. It really served as a foil to the Immortal Palace that was right in the middle with extreme beauty and an overwhelming feeling of nobility.
There was a young man that sat in the middle of the palace, with rays of immortal luminance ever changing behind his head.
There was a person kneeling right in front of him, which was Jun Tianci who had returned from the mortal world. He, who was once the arrogant genius, was kneeling down like a lowly dog, not daring to even move.
“How long, just how long did it just take for Dong Yao’s whole fleet who descended through the Golden Heaven Path to just perish like that.” The young man smiled coldly, “I was still here planning my next move, yet all of you were wiped out over there. Even the interdimensional gateway was destroyed. Tianci.”
“I’m here master.” Jun Tianci Shivered.
“Tell me, how should I punish you?” the young man asked indifferently, “You sent the entire legion to their death on the battlefield that year. However, because I took mercy on your hundreds of millions of year’s effort cultivating, I sent the remnant of your soul over to the mortal world at a huge price to incidentally complete a mission. It was just a mission in the mortal world and the result? Not only have you failed to take over the mortal world, you failed to even build a Sacred Land in the mortal world and leave our inheritance behind.”
“What use do I have for you?” the young man simply waved his hand and Jun Tianci just weathered and dissipated into the air into nothingness.
He then stood up and paced around in the main hall.
“There’s surely a great secret hidden in that mortal world and I for sure cannot give up on it. Yet with how things have changed, it’s way too difficult to tackle this with normal means. Destroy it? No, I can’t bear the changes caused by that. I’ll just push the whole world into the battlefield then!” the youth’s expression turned ruthless.
Linglong ended up appearing in an unknown space. In front of her was a staircase that led straight to the small island above.
Although the island suspended in midair wasn’t huge, it contained a mighty power that even made her soul tremble. Right next to it, there was a stone bridge that connected to somewhere else, but was shrouded in mist, making it difficult to see through clearly.
Linglong wanted to fly up, but quickly discovered that there was a peculiar energy in the area that made it difficult for her to soar.
At that moment, a stream of information suddenly entered her heart, information about the place here.
“I see!” Linglong suddenly understood what was happening
She wasn’t that too familiar with the place in actuality.
In the original locus of time, the Heavenly Order was originally acquired by the Holy Son of the Taishang Sword Sect which led his cultivation to improve by leaps and bounds with combat power that could even defy the sky. His might was simply absurd.
When she came over to the Immortal realm, it was accidentally revealed by the Holy Son then that he had strayed accidentally into the ancient immortal battlegrounds, obtaining the Heavenly Order which led to his incredible upbringing
Before this, Linglong also deliberately collected various information on the situation after the emergence of the ancient immortal battle grounds.
After investigating for a long time, she realized how terrifying the inheritance was. However, the Holy Son suddenly turned quiet all of a sudden which was just strange.
In fact, she cultivated various Dao and formed clones, all in order to prepare for this day: to intercept that great encounter.
‘Only by stepping foot on the island will you be deemed to have passed the preliminary test. Else, you will be sent back and the Heavenly Order will automatically fly away?’
Linglong pondered for a moment, looked over at the nine clones who were also sent over with her and wasn’t surprised about it.
Such terrifying inheritance naturally required the individual to be complete.
With a simple thought, the nine clones were stored in the Paradis Space of her sea of consciousness that she had opened up.
Her original body which was of Paradis Realm had already formed an illusory sword realm where the various types of terrifying Sword Sambodha framed it into a special world.
After looking around again, she stepped up onto the staircase and felt her heart sink in an instant.
“An invisible power acting on the mind. Is this a test of a person’s will?” Linglong was suddenly enlightened.
This sort of test was the type that she was least afraid of.
Taking a step at a time, she quickly reached the ninety-ninth floor. Even though she had reached such a high level, she didn’t feel too much pressure from the place.
“This place here is equivalent to the mental suppression of a level 11 Heavenly Immortal at its peak.” Linglong could easily tell its intensity.
Taking another step, she arrived on the island and with a flash of a light, she directly appeared at the center of the island.
“Such dense Dao fluctuation!” Sensing the surrounding condition, Linglong was suddenly taken aback
The intensity of Dao fluctuation back at Chuyang Peak was already amazing but the intensity in this place was more than 100 times denser than Chuyang Peak. It was very incredible.
Yet the rules here were very brutal.
A person has to reach enlightenment here, and then go through the stone bridge that was connected to the island to really enter the real place of inheritance.
The rate of time flowing in the place when compared with the outside world was a hundred to one. In other words, a year in the outside world was akin to a hundred years here.
A person had only three chances and could only stay here for 100 years each time.
If the stone bridge wasn’t opened after the three chances were used up, the person would lose the Supreme Order.
Once the person’s cultivation base had improved, the test on the stone bridge would naturally change accordingly.
“No wonder the strength of that person from the Taishang Sword Sect improved a lot slower to the point that I surpassed him. It might be because of him failing the three tests.” Linglong was stunned in thought.
She also now understood that these tests must be extremely difficult.
“Since I’m here, I might as well make the best out of it.” Linglong suppressed her thought of the difficulties, released her nine clones and started cultivation, preparing herself to raise her own strength to the pinnacle of Imminent Immortal Realm.
What she was focusing the most was on the Daos that these nine clones were comprehending.
As for going up right now to take on the challenge of the stone bridge? She didn’t think that it was a rush.
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming was lying on the rattan chair, swaying leisurely as the Human Path Record was floating midair in front of him, displaying the information on his Junior Sister. Zi Linglong’s ‘Status’: Entered the Heavenly Inheritance Space, passed the basic test and entered the next test.
The first test was very easy.
Jiang Ming was speechless upon reading her ‘Status’.
“As long as there isn’t any danger!” he let out a breath of relief.
As expected, she failed in trying to send over one of her clones to ascend into that inheritance space.
Xi Yao paced over in the air, landed right next to Jiang Ming and asked with a complicated expression, “Did Linglong really go to accept the inheritance? And it would be for at least a year? She even purposely handed Mo Xiaoyu over for me to teach.”
“She told you?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing.
Xi Yao nodded her head as she sat aside. Picking up a teapot, her two hands moved, inducing spiritual liquid into the tea pot and steam started coming out of it. She then poured Jiang Ming a cup and asked, “Aren’t you anxious?”
“Anxious of what?” Jiang Ming looked at Xi Yao with a confused look.
He could not deny that it was difficult to remove his gaze once he locked eyes with this Holy Daughter in front of him, whose pure looks with glints of holiness.
Xi Yao’s face flushed and quickly said, “It is already a quiet place here and will be even quieter without her. Will you be used to it?”
“Already accustomed.”
“You really don’t look like a young man.”
“My heart had long been used to vicissitudes! How can I still look like a young man after I fought in the Northern Region, killed many around the world and even slaughtered Immortals. Xi Yao, I really envy you.”
Xi Yao was speechless.
If it was based on the age of the normal person, she could be his aunt already.
The two sat quietly as the sun set down in the west.
“What do you want to eat? I’ll make some.” Jiang Ming stood up and lazily stretched himself.
“I…” Xi Yao almost blurted out, but quickly held back, “I’m not eating today. I’m afraid of getting fat.”
She quickly left the place, afraid that once she had dinner, she would feel even heavier hearted to leave.
Jiang Ming didn’t mind that she rejected and made himself a bowl of noodles. After finishing his meal, he laid down on the chair as his subconscious slowly drifted, sinking through the dark sea of consciousness and a strand of spirituality descended on the Firth Immortal Moon.
Inside the Main Hall of the Reincarnation Hall.
The Fifth Immortal Moon stood quietly. On her left was an opened room with scarlet red writings that wrote: SS-grade mission, catastrophe of the end of the world, stop the demon’s invasion.
There was a half an hour countdown.
Anyone could freely choose as those who chose first would enter first. If there weren’t enough people who take on the mission, those teams who had failed the previous three missions would be forced to take the mission.
The Fifth Immortal Moon did not break through into the Immortal Realm, but continued on the mission according to Jiang Ming’s will.
She had the choice whether to enter the room or not, but if she returned, she would also be sent inside.
Time quickly passed and a reminder suddenly rang in the Fifth Immortal Moon’s mind.
“Ding: You’ve accepted the SS-Grade Mission. The time is up. Beginning teleportation now.”
Her figure vanished without a trace yet it did not attract much attention from the surrounding for it was all too common already.
The very next moment, the Fifth Immortal Moon arrived at an unfamiliar place where the sky was painted gray, ever flowing with a dense demonic aura.
The suffocating evil spirit in the air caused people to become inexplicably manic, as their killing intent rose and they couldn’t help their urge to go on a killing spree.
“Ding: Xingyue World was originally a perfect planar world, but was invaded by a piece of demonic land. Its world origin was corroded, which reversed the laws of heaven and earth, turning the half the nature of the place into the demonic land’s nature, which in turn caused the planar to lose its self-defensive ability.”
“Ding: As larger numbers of devils descended into the world, rampaged through the land, committed sins and plundered all living beings, it left the world in a state of destruction where the world will soon wither and be completely lost.”
“Ding: Because this planar world’s origin was destroyed, the land was turned into demonic land, living beings that descended into the world have risen to level 11.
“Ding: This is a rescue mission. Kill off the invading demons and save the world from destruction.”
“Ding: Killing a level 7, 8, 9 and 10 Demon will be rewarded 1, 10, 100 and 1000 points respectively. Killing a low tier, middle tier and high tier level 11 demon will be rewarded 100 000, 500 000 and 1 000 000 points respectively.”
“Ding: Once the world is saved from destruction, all beneficiaries will be rewarded based on the ranking of accumulated points at the end of the mission.”
A series of reminders promptly appeared in Fifth Immortal Moon’s mind, and naturally, Jiang Ming heard it too.
“Worth a try. If this ends up successful, I won’t have to worry about cultivation in the future anymore.
On Chuyang peak, just as Jiang Ming thought through the whole plan, he started forming a clone of himself. Based on the Fifth Immortal Moon’s spiritual soul as the coordinates, he used the Human Path Record and began transmitting his clone over to the other side.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 8 Braving through Doomsday, Junior Sister Is On A Killing Spree
chapters.content:
Chapter 188 Braving through Doomsday, Junior Sister Is On A Killing Spree
When one reached the Imminent Immortal Realm, their power came from their Paradis world.
Jiang Ming was the same as well, but he was different from other people. Other people’s Paradis Worlds were not real, so they could draw power from it infinitely. However, his Paradis had become a real world. If he drew all powers from it, the world would crumble away.
In his inner world, he had full command over a large portion of the origin force, and this was the source of his mana. Even if he had used up this portion, he could replenish it with spiritual Qi.
For him, developing his inner world and expanding his origin was more important than ever.
Compared to last time, his inner world had become even larger.
The land had become thicker and the sky wider.
Jiang Ming summoned half of the origin of his inner world to form a clone. Then, he sent it out through the Human Paths Record.
In the next second, his face changed.
Projection could be carried out, but it was draining his mana frantically.
The origin of his inner world was pouring out, and in the blink of an eye, he had only half of the origin force left.
Jiang Ming hastily came to the spiritual field and opened his mouth. The river of spiritual fluid formed here long ago came rushing in. It didn’t enter his mouth. Instead, it entered his inner world to be refined at a rapid pace.
It lasted for a long while before the process came to a stop.
“I didn’t expect that projecting a clone across the world would consume so much energy!” Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh and his face turned grim.
If he did not replenish the lost spiritual Qi, his inner world would definitely shrink in size. However, luckily he succeeded.
‘Now that everything is in place, please don’t let me down!’
Jiang Ming thought inwardly and entered the mind of the Fifth Immortal Moon to share her vision.
At this moment, he was able to see everything that the Fifth Immortal Moon was looking at. He saw that the space in front of him warped and a figure emerged from it. It was none other than his clone, but the clone had a different look from him.
It was a burly man that breathed a prideful air. He was wearing the Heavenly Feathered Shirt with the Mystical Light Sword strapped on his back and Celestial Soul Bell on top of his head. These three were immortal weapons which bestowed him with impressive offensive and defensive power.
The only downside was that his clone couldn’t cultivate, and the clone would disappear once he ran out of power.
