“Nice to meet you, sir!” The Fifth Immortal Moon greeted the man. This was something Jiang Ming asked her to do. She did not need to try to curry the favor of the man or whatsoever.
The clone nodded and looked into the distance. He grabbed something in the air, and when he opened his palm, there was a level seven demon in his hand.
It was a real demon. There were two wings at its back, its eyes were blood red, and it was clad in a demonic Qi.
Jiang Ming had seen a lot of demons, and all of them looked the same.
The clone waved his hand and killed the demon.
“Negative!” The Fifth Immortal Moon nodded and said.
It meant she did not get any points.
The clone did not say anything and activated his special ability again. This time, he caught five level seven demons, and threw them all on the ground after sealing them.
The Fifth Immortal Moon lifted her finger silently and crushed one. Her eyes glowed and she exclaimed, “One point!”
The clone smiled.
Jiang Ming had a basic grasp of the mechanism of the Reincarnation System. He waved his hand, and a combat mannequin appeared. He had gotten a batch of level 10 combat mannequins from Dongfang Chenxi after he had decided on his plan.
Unknowingly, he owed Dongfang Chenxi a very big favor.
Unfortunately, there was nothing he could give her in return in his current state. The only thing he could give her was the point from the Supreme Tower. However, Dongfang Chenxi had a lot of points herself as well, so she did not need it at all.
‘Well, I guess I can only try to pay her back in the future.’
na
The Fifth Immortal Moon understood what the clone was implying. Without any hesitation, she dropped her blood on the mannequin and refined it. After that, she commanded the combat mannequin to kill a level 7 demon and got one point.
The clone smiled and tossed a storage ring to the Fifth Immortal Moon. There were 9,999 combat mannequins inside of the rings. He wanted her to refine 1,000 of them here right away even though it was going to consume some time.
An SS-Class mission was simply impossible to complete in a short time, not to mention that there were other teams as well.
As for the combat mannequin, Dongfang Chenxi had given him a million of it. She told him that these were outdated items in her storage and she had no use of them anymore. She also said that if he needed more, he just needed to ask.
When Jiang Ming heard what she had said, he had the urge to cross the world and call her his master.
He was worried that he couldn’t bring too many items with him while leaping around the world, so the clone only brought 10,0000 combat mannequins with him.
In the end, the Fifth Immortal Moon only managed to refine 1,000 of them, and her face was as pale as a sheet of paper. It was too much for her. After all, she needed to brand each combat mannequin with her Primal Spirit, and refining so many of them in such a short time was a burden for her.
Fortunately, these combat mannequins possessed their own intelligence and were able to act on their own to a certain extent? Otherwise, it would have been difficult for her to control even 300, not to mention a thousand.
“Let’s go!”
The Fifth Immortal Moon commanded.
Nine hundred combat mannequins dashed forward, leaving a hundred of them by her side.
The clone stayed as well.
He wouldn’t make any move unless the situation called for it.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming opened his mouth and a satisfying grin appeared on his face.
He did not have to worry about anything right now.
With the army of combat mannequins, they could easily crush anything that came in their path.
Even if there was an opponent that the Fifth Immortal Moon couldn’t handle, the clone was there to help her too.
“I’ll see what I’ll be rewarded after the Fifth Immortal Moon has finished the mission.”
Jiang Ming shook the thought away and went back into his inner world again.
He needed to speed up the evolution of his inner world. If not, he wouldn’t be able to cultivate the Heavenly immortal Dao. While he was speeding up the evolution of the inner world, he was comprehending the special abilities too.
In the meantime, he would cook at least once a day.
The rewards he received were varied, and he would get the Xuanhuang origin essence from time to time.
Time was flowing by slowly.
It had been 90 years in the Heavenly Inheritance Space. Zi Linglong had woken up from her seclusion. She had reached the peak stage of the Imminent Immortal Realm. Throughout the years, other than waiting for her clones, she also tried to comprehend several sword special abilities.
She also had the sword techniques manual that Jiang Ming gave her.
“After 90 years, I finally have come to this
stage.”
If Dong Yao and other immortal soldiers appeared in front of her right now, she had the confidence that she could kill them all in one swipe of her sword even if Dong Yao unleashed his true combat power.
Besides, her spatial, time, five elemental, yin-yang, life-death, light-and-dark, karma, reincarnation, and phoenix clones had reached the peak stage of the Imminent Immortal Realm as well.
This place is truly a heaven for all cultivators. I’m sure I’ll be able to become even stronger if I stay here, but… it’s time for me to go out,’ Zi Linglong thought inwardly. “It has been a year. I wonder what my senior brother is doing now?” Zi Linglong said to herself.
She missed Jiang Ming a lot, but she was not worried about him.
After all, she had the confidence that her senior brother was able to come out safely from any perilous situations.
With that thought in mind, she jumped downward and came to the other side of the stone bright. The nine clones followed after her.
Ripples began to appear around them and the stone bridge suddenly became larger. For a level 10 expert like her, the stone bridge was narrow.
Suddenly, a voice rang out in her head.
[Destroy all the living beings on the stone bridge and reach the other side of the bridge to pass the test. If you die here, you fail.] The instruction was simple, but Linglong noticed something.
She couldn’t fly in here, and there was something in the air trying to attack her mind. Although those attacks were weak, they were troublesome.
A number of experts had appeared in front of her. Humans, demons, devils, aliens… There were all sorts of living beings, and those at the front were at level 10.
With every step Linglong took, those attacks on her mind would become stronger. She frowned slightly and she hissed, “Bring it on!”
As she dashed forward, her enemies charged at her as well.
The fight began, but it was a one-sided annihilation.
Spatial Linglong came forward and activated the Great Millenium Technique, causing their enemies to freeze on the spot.
Linglong then swung her sword and killed all of them.
Spatial Linglong stretched her arm forward and grabbed something in the air, causing the space in front of them to freeze. Five Elemental Linglong followed up with the Five Elemental Great Grinder, crushing 30 of them in the process.
It took them quite some time to kill all of the level 10 experts. However, there were more of them coming, and they were all in the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Not only that, but the attacks on her mind were getting stronger and stronger as well.
“This isn’t looking good. I have to get rid of them as soon as possible!”
As the thought surfaced in her head, she dashed forward.
This time, three Heavenly Immortals came at her.
After she killed three of them, another three came again, and they only stopped coming at her after she had killed 30 of them.
There were three more True Immortals standing in front of her.
Linglong’s eyelids twitched vigorously. Her face was pale, and her chest was huffing up and down intensely.
Tap! Tap! Tap!
Linglong charged at the three True Immortals, and the nine clones followed suit.
“Great Spiritual Technique, Spiritual Light, Unison of Souls, guard!”
She completely merged with the Primal Spirits of the nine clones to form into a Spiritual Light Barrier that weakened the attacks on her mind greatly.
There was a golden line on the floor in front of her. She knew that once she crossed the line, she would be attacked by her opponents.
However, she did not stop.
“Let’s go!”
“Time and Space Cage!”
Time Linglong and Spatial Linglong stepped forward and combined their attacks together, successfully restricting the movements of the three True Immortals.
“Yin-Yang Confinement: Five Elements of Entanglement!”
Yin-Yang Linglong and Five Elemental Linglong combined their attacks together as well.
The remaining clones also threw their special abilities at the three True Immortals. “My sword can cut through the sky!”
Linglong activated her strongest sword technique and killed the three of them. “Phew…”
She let out a sigh and arrived on the island opposite of the stone bridge.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - Great Heavenly Venerate, Battlefield of the Worlds, Elder Bai
chapters.content:
Chapter 189 Great Heavenly Venerate, Battlefield of the Worlds, Elder Bai
As soon as she stepped on the island, a divine light spread from her feet. Linglong was led away, and the nine clones followed after her.
They were not traveling at a fast pace, so it gave them a chance to take in the surroundings.
It was a big island that floated amongst the clouds.
They couldn’t tell how high they were in the sky as they couldn’t see the ground below. On this island, there were three mountains and they all looked normal.
The mountain right in front of them had its top cleaved clean and became a platform. At the center of the platform sat an old man in a lotus position. He was beaming brightly and waving at Linglong, who was approaching him.
“Nine clones? Not only that, but all of them are of high level? You’re truly impressive, girl!”
“Nice to meet you, sir!” Linglong and the nine clones landed in front of the old man and greeted him respectfully.
“Zi Linglong, you’ve passed the test. From today onward, you’ll be the disciple of the Heavenly Venerate. I’m your personal guide, and you can call me Taoist Bai,” the old man said, “I can answer your queries about the ‘Dao’, I can explain to you the way of your cultivation, or I can teach you about the thousands of Dao. Of course, you can make a request and ask for the Dao you want to know. I’ll answer everything that you want to know about cultivation! Could you see the two mountains over there? One of them is the place for you to rest. You can cultivate over there as well, and there are a lot of scrolls and books for you to study. On the other side, it’s a training ground. If you want to leave this place, you need to go through the Heavenly Order. When you return to this place again, you’ll arrive at your resting zone.”
“Thank you for the information, Master Bai!” Linglong bowed at him again. Taoist Bai shook his hand and said, “Just call me Taoist Bai. After you’ve become the Heavenly Venerate, I won’t be good enough to become your master.”
“I’ll call you Elder Bai, then!” “Alright then!” “Elder Bai, can I know where my master came from?”
“You’re too weak right now, so you don’t have the right to know about it. You’ll learn of his origin in the future. You’re at the Imminent Immortal Realm right now, and you have the capability of ascending into the next realm. However, you should take some rest now. After you’ve conditioned yourself back to your peak state, I’ll start teaching you the Dao.”
“Thank you, Elder Bai!”
Linglong sat in a lotus position and began to recuperate.
It was only then she noticed the massive amount of Dao fluctuation and spiritual Qi here.
Very soon, she had recovered to her full strength and she asked Elder Bai to start teaching her.
“Look closely!”
Elder Bai smiled and the surroundings began to change. A Sword Dao space appeared. It was filled with sword energies to the brim. When Linglong turned around, she could also sense the Dao fluctuations and the essence of True Immortal here.
Her eyes glowed and she thought inwardly, “This is performing Dao with the law. It’s the best way of teaching Dao.’ She also sensed that each of the nine clones had appeared in the realm of Dao that corresponded to their attributes.
She felt relieved and began cultivating.
Doomsday.
After the clone defeated the last level 11 higher demon and flung it in front of the Fifth Immortal Moon, he looked at the interdimensional portal ahead and fell silent.
It had been almost a year since he came here. He had crushed many parties with the army of combat mannequins, and in the end, he found there were a lot of demons gathered in a valley trying to create an interdimensional portal. He was delighted, so he did not exterminate all of them and spare them.
After the interdimensional portal had been created, hordes of demons poured out from it, but all of them were killed by the combat mannequins.
The combat mannequins could kill even level 11 demons since they were in a daze when they first came out of the portal. In the event where they slipped past the combat mannequins’ hands, the Fifth Immortal Moon would step in and put them down.
After all, she was a genius and was capable of putting down a True Immortal.
Even if she couldn’t kill them, the clone would help her.
After they did this for a month, perhaps the demons had noticed something was wrong on the other side, fewer and fewer of them were coming through the portal. Eventually, none of them were coming through the portal.
The corner of the Fifth Immortal Moon’s lips twitched.
The clone waited for some time, but the demons were not appearing from the portal anymore. Leaving with no choices, he destroyed the portal.
He turned around and glanced at the Fifth Immortal Moon. His voice rang inside her soul, “Try to purify the land of the demons and return this land to its original form. Maybe we can get higher marks in the rating.”
The Fifth Immortal Moon’s eyes lit up and she nodded.
They still had some time left, and it was worth a try.
The clone flew into the sky and gazed down at the land.
He thought about the Tianyuan World. What would it become and what would happen to the living beings over there if it weren’t for him to thwart the invasion of the demons?
He did not dare to think about it. Before the mission deadline, the Fifth Immortal Moon tried to purify the land of the demons. However, it was a difficult process and it was only possible because all of the demons had been exterminated as well as the blessing of the origin of the universe.
The clone was running out of power, so he handed the three immortal weapons to the FifthImmortal Moon before returning through the Human Paths Record.
It also consumed some of Jiang Ming’s mana this time, but it was nothing compared to when he first sent the clone over to the Fifth Immortal Moon. He did not know whether it was because the clone was running out of energy or because he did not carry many items with him. Perhaps it was because it consumed less mana on the way back?
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming cracked his eyes open and let out a boisterous laugh.
“Hahaha! I did it!”
He rose to his feet and his face was brimming with joy.
After the Fifth Immortal Moon returned, the rating was raised by one level to SSS level and he received a large amount of rewards.
He had gotten plenty of points as well. “Next step, I should ask the Fifth Immortal Moon to exchange the Xuanhuang Origin Essence and accept another mission.”
When the thought appeared in Jiang Ming’s head, he stretched his body and he was in a good mood.
The sun was bright and the wind was comfortable.
When he saw Xi Yao was coming at him, the grin on his face widened.
“Have you done with your cultivation?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“Well, it’s not good for our mental health if we keep staying in seclusion for a long time. Since it’s almost noon, I think it’s almost time for me to eat something,” Xi Yao said as she landed.
“Right on time! I was about to cook something to eat!” Jiang Ming smiled as he walked into the kitchen, “Is there anything that you want to eat?”
“Noodles. I like the noodles that you make.”
“Alright, then! I’ll make some noodles for
you!”
Jiang Ming took out the flour, which surprisingly emitted a seven-colored light.
This was the spirit wheat given to him by the system. He used the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique to speed up the ripening process and grinded it into flour with his own strength.
After he had finished kneading the dough, he set it aside for it to rise. Then, he started to prepare the minced meat.
He thought for a while and decided to use the crab roe as the main ingredient with some chopped squids and slices of sea eel’s heart.
“I’m already drooling!” Xi Yao came over and swallowed a large gulp of saliva. “It’s a great pleasure to eat the food cooked by you!”
“Well, thank you for the compliment!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“I don’t think I can find any cook like you in this world anymore!” Xi Yao added.
Very soon, the noodles were ready.
Jiang Ming gave a bowl to Xi Yao, and both of them sat opposite of each other to enjoy the meal.
Jiang Ming ate the noodle slowly, reveling in the aroma and fragrance that tickled his nostrils.
Suddenly, he thought of Pan Jinglian and Ximen Qing.
He felt itchiness on his feet, and he had the urge to throw his chopsticks below the table. In the meantime, a scene that he watched from one of the videos appeared in his head.
In a restaurant, a man was peeking at a young lady who was enjoying her meal. The young lady knew that the man was looking at her, so when he cast his gaze on her again, she opened her legs and the man was stunned.
“What are you thinking, Brother Jiang?” Xi Yao asked, snapping Jiang Ming out of his thoughts. “Looking at your face, could it be something enjoyable?”
“Well, it is,” Jiang Ming replied, “I remembered a forest that has a lot of interesting things in it.”
“What kind of a forest is that?”
“Well, there’s a hot spring in the forest and there’s an eel inside the hot spring, but I killed it in the end!”
Both of them then laughed.
After a short while, Xi Yao patted her tummy and said, “I’m so full.”
Then, she went to clean her bowl and flew away. “See you again, Brother Jiang.”
“You’re leaving so soon?”
“I’m worried that I won’t be able to go away if I don’t leave now.”
“You talk as if I’m a demon.”
“You’re more evil than a demon!” Xi Yao mumbled and went away.
She landed in the courtyard.
She turned around and looked at the front. There was a strange expression on her face and she suddenly sighed, “Why can’t I just stop wanting to go near him? I really hope that I can stay by his side forever…”
She sat on the stone stool. Suddenly, something glowed in her eyes and she shouted inwardly.
‘Pull yourself together, Xi Yao! You’re here to cultivate, to become stronger, not to fall in love with another man!’
After she had admonished herself inwardly, her eyes became clear again.
In the endless flood of space and time, a crumbling world appeared. It was being pulled by several great torrents of power, and was moving fast. However, the endless void space was so vast that even immortals looked like ants here.
This torn world would eventually be torn apart and annihilated by the endless torrent of power.
Immortal Realm.
There was a magnificent palace, and inside sat a middle-aged man that exuded a terrifying aura.
“Greetings, father,” a young man walked in and greeted the middle-aged man.
“Is there anything you want to tell me, Chen Guang?” “Father, I’m sure you’re aware that I’m seeking an opportunity in the mortal world. I activated the Golden Heaven Path, but I failed in the end. Therefore, I would like to ask for assistance from you, father. I hope you can lend me some immortal soldiers so that I can lure that world to the Battlefield of Multiverse so that I can seize it again.”
“You can’t even take control of a mere mortal world?”
“Father, that world is very special. Not only are there abyssal demons, but it’s also frequented by many visitors from other dimensions. Besides, they also have a genius that is capable of slaying immortals.”
“These are nothing but your excuses!” “That world holds a chance for me to gain enlightenment. I hope you can give me another chance, Father.”
“Not long ago, I went to the Heaven Court to see the Great Heaven Venerate. He has laid down the Great Astral Formation to seal off the universe and prevent the middle immortal chiliocosm from reaching the Land of Eternity. He wants to unify and take control over all the worlds.”
“How could he?!”
“He’s strong, so of course, he can do whatever he wants. If I were him, I would do the same too. Perhaps he will reach the realm in the legend. Sigh, there’s nothing we can do about it. Now that we’re being restricted, we can’t do anything as we wish. If we mobilize an army of immortal soldiers, we will be noticed.”
“But…”
“Fine, I’ll give you one last chance. Remember, you have to succeed this time. Plan everything carefully before making your move, and you must keep a low profile.”
“Thank you, father. I’ll be aware of it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - Descending Once Again, Taking Over the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 190 Descending Once Again, Taking Over the World
Jiang Ming was oblivious toward the changes outside of the world.
He was still enjoying his good life.
He would read books or watch videos with his tablet from time to time during his leisure time.
The only downside was that his junior sister was not with him, and he felt a little bit lonely sleeping alone on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed.
Xi Yao brought Mo Xiaoyu to come and pay Jiang Ming a visit. “Greetings, Uncle Jiang!” Mo Xiaoyu got to her knees and greeted Jiang Ming respectfully. “Alright. Get up,” Jiang Ming said as he waved his hand, “You are in Qi Cultivation Stage 5 now? That’s pretty good. So how do you find the living on the mountain? Can you adapt to
it?”
“Yes!” Mo Xiaoyu rose to her feet.
“Of course, she could adapt to it!” Xi Yao chuckled, “She’s the only disciple on the mountain, and she receives guidance from both Linglong and me.Who else has a better treatment than her? I’m afraid that the only thing she can’t get used to is that it’s lonely
here.”
“Well, you have a point,” Jiang Ming replied as he fell into a contemplation. “Maybe we should ask Linglong to accept more disciples when she comes back later.”
“How about you? Are you not going to take in any disciple?” Xi Yao asked as she sat beside Jiang Ming. “It has been so long and she has already passed the test. You’re her martial uncle, so don’t you think you should show something?”
“Don’t worry,” Jiang Ming said, “After all, she’s the first third-generation disciple of Chuyang Peak. She will be the senior sister in the future, so we have to be careful.” After he paused for a short while, he pulled something out and threw it into the air. A streak of white light appeared, and when it fell on the other side of the mountain, it transformed into a ladder that reached the sky.
“What is that?” Xi Yao asked, her voice thick with surprise, “The power that lies within is so immense that it gives me a chilling sensation.”
“It’s an immortal weapon known as the Heart Refining Path. It can discipline one’s mind and harden one’s will. You can try it when you have free time,” Jiang Ming explained, smiling, “It’s a very useful tool in nurturing and training our disciples.”
This was his reward when he first harvested the supreme-grade spiritual medicine. It had no use to him, so he had totally forgotten about it. He only remembered it when Mo Xiaoyu appeared today.
“An immortal weapon? And you call it a tool?” Xi Yao did not know what she should say.
Jiang Ming nodded. He then looked at Mo Xiaoyu and continued, “If you can get to the 19th level in one year, I’ll give you a big present.”
“A big present? What is that?” Xi Yao asked.
“I’ll help her to forge a special body for her!”
“What?” Xi Yao was stunned. After she had come around to her senses, she turned and said to Mo Xiaoyu, “What are you still waiting for? Hurry up and thank your martial uncle!” She was fully aware of how difficult it was to change one’s body, not to mention that a special body. It was also now that the scale fell before her eyes when Linglong said she wanted someone with a strong will in the past.
“Thank you so much, Uncle Jiang!” Xiao Yao said.
Jiang Ming then added in a serious manner, “You can thank me after you’ve passed the test. If you can’t pass the test, then you should cultivate in a step-by-step manner.”
Xi Yao brought Xiaoyu to the Heart Refining Path. After that, she returned to Jiang Ming and squatted beside him. Lifting her head, she looked at her and asked, “Brother Jiang, do you think there is a need for me to modify my body?”
“You’re as pretty as a fairy that descends on the mortal world. I don’t see any need for you to modify your body,” Jiang Ming commented after he studied Xi Yao from head to toe, “You’re already very perfect, and I think the only person who can compete with you is Linglong.” Xi Yao’s eyes glowed, but she snorted, “Brother Jiang, I’m being serious here.”
“You’re in the Primal Spirit Realm. In other words, your Dao is already fixed and it would be hard for you to change to another body,” Jiang Ming shook his head, “There’s nothing I can do to help you at my current level of strength. Unless you abolish your cultivation level.”
“Abolish my cultivation level?” Xi Yao pouted, “Once I abolish my cultivation level, I’ll turn into an old woman within a second?” “You’re that old?”
“Hmph! I’m still a little girl in the cultivation world.”
“Well, I doubt so.”
“Hmph!”
Xi Yao did not know why but she could feel a surge of exaltation deep in her heart.
She did not wish to stay here anymore, so she rose into the air and came to the Heart Refining Path.
Right now, Mo Xiaoyu had already stepped onto the Heart Refining path. She stopped at the 10th floor. Her face was ashen pale, sweats were oozing out of the pores on her forehead, and her steps were faltering.
Shortly after, she fell down and disappeared from the path. In the next second, she appeared below the Heart Refining Path, huffing heavily.
“How do you feel?” Xi Yao went forward and helped her up from the ground.
“Martial Uncle, I thought I was about to die just now,” Mo Xiaoyu said, her face pale, “Every level has a different environment. Some wanted me to kill someone, while another wanted me to rescue someone. There was one that asked me to make a choice, and I fell into an endless panic before I could even realize it. At the last level, I saw an endless stream of sword energies falling from the sky. I tried to defend myself but to no avail, and I thought I was going to get killed.” Xi Yao instantly understood what she was talking about.
“All of those are illusions to test your mind and willpower. I think you should come here more often. However, judging from your current situation, you can come here every seven days.” “Okay, Martial Uncle!”
Apparently, Mo Xiaoyu had grown attached to her.
After that, she returned to Xi Yao’s home to recuperate.
“The Heart Refining Path huh?” Xi Yao breathed out and stepped on the ladder.
Underneath the gazebo, Jiang Ming glanced at her but he did not say anything.
After all, he was certain that Xi Yao had a strong mind and willpower.
Suddenly, he felt the calling from the Fifth Immortal Moon and his eyes glowed with delight.
After the Fifth Immortal Moon had digested all of the rewards, she took on another SS-Class mission: Demons hunting.
The mission looked easy, but the level was exceedingly high.
Sensing that the Fifth Immortal Moon was about to start the mission, Jiang Ming sealed the courtyard with a flick of his mind and formed two clones around him. One of them was formed with half of the origin force from his inner world, while another was formed with only half of his power.
In the blink of an eye, both clones were done. Realizing that the Fifth Immortal Moon had already departed, Jiang Ming summoned the Human Paths Record and followed after her.
Voom… For a moment, his origin force was depleting at a rapid pace, but Jiang Ming was prepared. There were several beads in his inner worlds. These were the origin force that he refined and stored up for emergencies.
One of them cracked and a large amount of origin force gushed out to make up for the consumption at a rapid pace.
Abyssal World.
The Fifth Immortal Moon was standing by the edge of the forest.
The forest looked strange. All of the trees were either made of grey or black or red. There was no green color at all, not even the leaves or the flowers.
She raised her head. The air was filled with the demonic Qi.
She lowered her head. The ground looked like a dried blood stain.
Very soon, two people appeared beside her. They were none other than the two clones of Jiang Ming. “Sir!” The Fifth Immortal Moon greeted them before throwing a ring at them. The second clone grabbed it and his eyes glowed.
The ring was filled with the Xuanhuang Origin Essence to the brim. This was the best nourishment if he wanted to strengthen the origin of his inner world.
The second clone nodded and disappeared.
His job was to bring good items back to Jiang Ming in case anything bad happened.
The Fifth Immortal Moon then handed the Mystical Light Sword, the Heavenly Feathered Shirt, and the Celestial Soul Bell to the first clone.
The first clone gave her 100,000 combat mannequins in return.
It seemed as if they were not talking to each other, but in reality, they were communicating through their minds.
Jiang Ming soon understood her mission. [Ding! Beneficiary the Fifth Immortal Moon. The world you’ve arrived at is known as the Third Dark Abyss of the Quasi-small Chiliocosm World. This world could accommodate up to level 12 cultivation level.]
[Ding! Your hunting tasks are as follows:
Hunt 100 level 10 demons. 2. Hunt 3 level 11 demons.Kill the Western Demon Princess and the Eastern Demon Prince.]
(Ding! Note: You’re the only beneficiary that comes to this world this time.]
“This is strange,” Jiang Ming frowned. “Immortal Moon, what do you think is going on based on your experience? Why is it you’re the only one in this world? It’s a Quasi-small Chiliocosm World and could accommodate up to level 12 experts.”
The Fifth Immortal Moon frowned and replied, “Judging from my experience, it seems like the system wants to force me to break through and improve my cultivation level.”
“What makes you say so?”
“Simple. This mission is an SS-class mission. After I’ve selected it, it was locked and I’m the only one who is allowed to come to this world. Otherwise, there should be many teams.” “You have a point. Continue.”
“Second, this is a hunting mission. Once we start to hunt, it’ll certainly alert those higher demons. Although there is no specific information, according to the mission analysis, the Western Demon Princess and the East Demon Prince should be located in two places, and they can not be killed at the same time. Once we kill one, the experts here will make their moves, and the only way to prevent us from getting killed is to become stronger since they’re mostly level 12 experts.”
“Did something like this happen in the past?”
“I have no idea, but in my opinion, once a mission like this appears, the only way to get through it is to become stronger. If not, there are only two endings for us: dead or half crippled. Once we break through the realm and return to the Reincarnation Hall, we will directly appear in the next level of space. Even if the mission fails to return, we won’t get transport out. Also, there is no extra points for this demon hunting mission. I guess it’s because we’ve gone too far in the previous mission.”
Jiang Ming did not know what to say after he heard what the Fifth Immortal Moon had said.
“We can’t get extra points anymore?” Jiang Ming was a little bit disappointed.
“We can,” the Fifth Immortal Moon said, “We can collect loot and when we go back, we’ll recycle it. The only downside is that we might not be able to get many points.” “I’m fine with it as long as we can recycle them!” Jiang Ming rubbed his hands as he looked at the land.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - Changes in Tianyuan, Jiang Ming: “Should I Kill Them?”
chapters.content:
Chapter 191 Changes in Tianyuan, Jiang Ming: “Should I Kill Them?”
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming grinned.
It was truly good news for him that the Reincarnation Hall could recycle loot.
He had plenty of loot and he did not know what he should do with them. He had been keeping them in his storage space, and now he finally could turn them into something useful. ‘I shouldn’t have destroyed the portal at the Northern Region and the Submerged Dragon Continent,’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly and took out the Xuanhuang Origin Essence that was brought back by the second clone. He checked through it, and after ascertaining that it was fine, then he absorbed it into his inner world.
The Xuanhuang Origin Essence could greatly enhance the inner world. It could widen the space as well as strengthen the origin.
The inner world was working in the same way as the realm.
Mana was similar to the worldly force, and it could be replenished rapidly after consumption. However, the Xuanhuang Origin Essence was capable of upgrading the realm, and it was only by upgrading the realm that more mana would be available.
“I wonder when I can evolve my inner world to the perfect level?”
He did not have any reference, so it was difficult for him to know how perfect his inner world was.
That being said, one thing he was very certain was that he had become very strong now. Fearing that the clone might run into something dangerous, Jiang Ming formed another more powerful clone. He was going to send the clone over to the Fifth Immortal Moon should something arise. “Ming!”
It was Gu Hai’s voice.
He flew through the air and landed on the stool beside him. He grabbed the teapot on the table and finished the tea in it in one setting.
“What brought you back here today?” Jiang Ming asked, “Where’s your girlfriend?” “We’re swamped. You’re the only one who is so free,” Gu Hai mumbled, “After we’ve recruited more disciples last time, most of the elite disciples and elders from the sect have gone out to keep guard at various places in Qing Province. I felt embarrassed for not doing anything, so I went to guard a place. Yun Yue is still guarding her area, so she won’t be able to come back for a while.”
“You asked for it!” Jiang Ming said exasperated after he heard what Gu Hai had said, “Nobody would dare to talk or criticize you for doing nothing.”
“Well, you’re right,” Gu Hai replied, “But I’m the First Seat of Chuyang Peak, and it’s kind of embarrassing if I don’t do something.”
“You would feel embarrassed? That’s new to me.”
“How dare you mock me!”
“Haha! Anyway, what are you doing back here?”
“I’m craving for some food.”
“Ahem…” Jiang Ming spurted a mouthful of tea, “I thought you missed me. So it turns out that you just miss the food.”
“It is the same, isn’t it? You or the food,” Gu Hai said with a smile, “Make me 3,000 dishes. I want to keep them in storage so that I can take them out to eat when I’m thinking about you.”
Jiang Ming looked skyward speechlessly.
“First, go prepare something for me to eat now,” Gu Hai urged, “Hurry!”
“When can I have a good disciple that would allow me to boss him around?” Jiang Ming sighed and rose to his feet.
“Hahaha!” Gu Hai tossed his head back and let out a boisterous laugh, “Do you think everyone is as lucky as me to have a good disciple? Having a good disciple is the best!”
There was nothing Jiang Ming could say.
After he had prepared a scrumptious meal for Gu Hai, he summoned Chang Yiming, who had been in seclusion the whole time.
“Uncle Gu!” Chang Yiming greeted Gu Hai before taking his seat. “Jeez, there are a total of 32 dishes? Uncle Gu, it’s only when you’ve returned that I can enjoy such a feast.”
“If you want to eat anything in the future, just let me know,” Gu Hai said, patting his chest.
“It’s a deal, then, Uncle Gu. From now on, whenever I’m craving for some food, I’ll come to look for you and ask Jiang Ming to prepare 360 dishes to feast on.”
“Sure! Ming, remember to prepare 360 dishes next time!”
“Hehe, Uncle Gu, don’t you think we’re lacking something on the table?” “Oh yeah, silly me. How can I forget about that? Ming, bring us some wine. I’m going to have a drinking match with Yiming!”
Jiang Ming was speechless. “Are you sure you want me to prepare some dishes for you?” “Of course!” Gu Hai smiled, “I’ve used up all my money to raise both you and Linglong. I can’t even pay for a meal, so I have to keep some dishes with me in case I need to entertain my guests in the future and not embarrass myself, don’t you think so?”
“That’s one hell of a good reason you have there, and I have no way to fight it back,” Jiang Ming said through gritted teeth and disappeared into thin air.
A few moments later, he appeared again.
He waved his sleeve and a dozen massive beasts appeared in the air.
There was a three-headed scaled dragon that was about a few hundred meters long, an octopus that was several thousand meters tall, a lobster that was a few hundred meters long, a nine-headed lion that was as big as a hill, a Paradis wild boar, and a golden-winged eagle with a wingspread of several thousand meters.
“Master, are these good enough?” Jiang Ming asked as he pointed skyward. “This, this…” Despite knowing that his disciple was hiding a lot from him, he still couldn’t quite accept it when he saw it with his own eyes. Even though he had a low cultivation level, his knowledge was extraordinary.
A three-headed scaled dragon that was about a few hundred meters long was normally a Paradis demon, not to mention the giant octopus and the nine-headed lion. Gu Hai just did not know what he should say right now.
“Are you…” Gu Hai stammered, “Are you going to use them as your ingredient?”
Chang Yiming was so stunned that his mouth was left wide open.
Luckily Jiang Ming had cast an enchanted barrier around Chuyang Peak. If not, the entire sect would’ve been thrown into a turmoil.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming replied, offering his master a smile, “I’m going to make them into a stew. I’ll add some spiritual medicine in it so that their flesh and blood will become mild enough for better absorption. Of course, it’s also to make them tastier.”
“You want me to eat these demons?” Gu Hai did not know why but he felt slightly uncomfortable.
“If not, how am I supposed to prepare so many dishes for you?” Jiang Ming said, shaking his head, “These should last you for a long while. Besides, the weakest among these demons is in the Primal Spirit Realm, and some of them are in the Extreme Path Realm. Coupled up with the spiritual medicine that I’m going to use to cook with them, I’m sure other people will be impressed when you serve them with these dishes.”
After he had finished talking, he waved his hand and a cauldron appeared before him.
It was a supreme-grade Dao Vessel that he got after he defeated someone.
The cauldron spewed fire and engulfed the demons on top of it. It burned their skins and scales away as well as reducing their organs into dust.
Then, he waved his hand again to cut the demons into small pieces. He added some spiritual fluid and spiritual medicine before simmering them in the cauldron. After that, Jiang Ming adjusted the amount of spiritual medicine and the flame to cook it in the way of boiling medicinal food.
Rays of divine lights were spewing out of the cauldron, stunning both Gu Hai and Chang Yiming. “Impressive!” Gu Hai lamented.
“Indeed!” Chang Yiming nodded blankly. After all, he had never seen or heard of a scene like this before. Very soon, Jiang Ming waved his hand and two storage rings appeared in the air. The food then flew from the cauldron into both rings. Then, he gave one of the rings to Gu Hai and another to Chang Yiming. “I have one too?” Chang Yiming was surprised. After that, he smiled and said, “Jiang Ming, should I offer myself to entertain you on the bed to return the favor?”
“Get away from me!” Jiang Ming shouted.
Gu Hai’s eyes widened in shock when he saw the food in the storage ring. He came to Jiang Ming and patted his shoulder.
“Ming, with these foods, those old guys would never dare to look down on me again! Hahaha! I’ll be leaving now!”
“This old man!” Jiang Ming shook his head helplessly. It seemed to him that Gu Hai was becoming more and more immature. However, he knew it was because Gu Hai did not have anything to worry about anymore. “Uncle Gu is truly enjoying his life!” Chang Yiming said.
“That’s because he has thrown all the jobs to me!” Jiang Ming laughed, “Look at him. Does he look like the First Seat of Chuyang Peak to you? He only comes back once in a while, and whenever he’s back, he just wants me to cook for him. Does he think I’m a chef?” “That’s your destiny!” Chang Yiming commented. After that, he waved the storage ring in his hand and said, “Brother Jiang, I’m going back to my seclusion. I’ll not come out until I’ve stepped into the Primal Spirit realm!”
“Good luck! After you’ve ascended into the Primal Spirit Realm, I’ll give you a few Dao Vessels.”
“Haha, I’ll be looking forward to that!” Chang Yiming laughed and went away.
Silence once again returned to the gazebo.
Jiang Ming threw himself into the rattan chair and closed his eyes.
The Human Paths Record appeared in front of him.
Linglong had gotten the inheritance, so he did not have to worry about her.
The clone was preparing to go on a killing spree after knowing that the Reincarnation Hall could recycle some items.
The Fifth Immortal Moon had finished the mission perfectly, albeit she came across some difficulties along the way. After she returned to the Reincarnation Hall, her rating increased again and she was an SSS-Class now.
For the next few years, Jiang Ming had been assisting the Fifth Immortal moon with his clone on her mission. He had received a lot of benefits in the process, and the evolution speed of his inner world increased by leaps and bounds.
It was just that the Fifth Immortal Moon had to ascend into the Immortal Realm when they were doing a mission.
Time was flowing slowly, and there were only a few days left before the 20-year deadline was over.
On the rooftop, below the gazebo, Jiang Ming looked toward Xi Yao’s house and he felt an agitation inside of his heart.
He thought Linglong would be back in one or two years, but he was wrong.
Every time he looked at Xi Yao, he had the urge to do something to her.
Suddenly, he squinted his eyes and looked to the west.
After a short while, he turned his head and gazed at Zhong Province before spinning around and cast his eyes at the depths of the Eastern Sea.
“Hah, it seems like some people need to be taught some lessons again!” Jiang Ming hissed through gritted teeth as anger rose from his stomach pit.
Then, he noticed something and turned around. His eyes glowed brightly and wrapped his arm around his junior sister that appeared from thin air.
“I miss you so much!”
“We miss you very much too!” All ten of them shouted and threw themselves onto Jiang Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - A Fine Line between the Devil and Buddha
chapters.content:
Chapter 192 A Fine Line between the Devil and Buddha
Three days later, Jiang Ming felt refreshed. Half a month later however, Jiang Ming came over to the pavilion as he kept rubbing his waist, with ten junior sisters surrounding him.
“Junior Brother, can’t anymore?”
“It’s one against ten! Even a bull might die from exhaustion.”
“Hmph, just admit that you cannot already.”
“Wait till I start training on the Golden Steel Impeccable Body, then I’ll go another 3 million rounds with you.”
“All talk!”
The nine clones flew around hidden in Jiuyang Sect, looking at the changes for the past few years. Linglong’s main body stayed by Jiang Ming’s side and slowly talked about what happened in the Inheritance Space.
Over on the island where she was accepted as a disciple by name, time flowed100 times faster than the outside world. When coupled with immense resources along with 1,000 years of cultivation, she raised her cultivation base straight to level 14 Golden Immortal Realm. However, the rest of her clones had varying cultivation bases, some at Golden Immortal Realm while others in Mystical Immortal Realm.
This was especially the case for the Time Clone because it was relatively more difficult for her to improve, as she had just recently stepped into the Mystical Immortal Realm. Linglong’s main body, however, had already reached the pinnacle of the Golden Immortal Realm.
“You’re at Golden Immortal Realm and you’re still not named the true disciple?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.
“Yeah.” Linglong nodded, “Master’s background should be very big, beyond expectation. I won’t ponder on other things and will just need to practice my cultivation step by step and it will do.”
“Of course!” Jiang Ming agreed.
After becoming a named disciple, there weren’t any missions or mandatory requirements imposed. She was allowed to continue her cultivation and the conditions were not strict at all.
“However, old Bai did bring up something, that is if I cannot reach the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm within a million years, I will be expelled and have my identity as a named disciple taken back.
Linglong’s tone was casual and she obviously didn’t care about it much.
The Great Overarching Golden Immortal was above the Taiyi Golden Immortal. Once a person reached such a realm, the person would be considered one of the main powerhouses across the galaxies.
Though Jiang Ming wasn’t clear how impeccable a Great Overarching Golden Immortal expert was for he hadn’t even visited the immortal world until now.
“Are you confident?”
“Yes I am! Even if I’m not, don’t we still have the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed!” “Haha! This can be a thing. However, we still have to focus on our cultivation. There’s only a limit to a whole day’s time, so we shouldn’t be focused on intimacy and love everyday.” “Well, there’s so many hours a day and the sun will be shining for so many hours! Senior Brother, the day is still young, let’s go.” “Cough….” Jiang Ming shut himself up. It was at that moment, Xi Yao came flying through the air and the moment she saw Linglong, her expression suddenly brightened, “I was just wondering why this place was sealed! It turns out that Linglong is back! I came over ten days ago and saw that it was sealed then, you guys didn’t just….”
In an instant, a thought ran through her mind as her eyes widened and her ears turned red. “Xi Yao, you are such a failure.” Linglong walked over with her hands behind her back, looking like an overbearing queen, “I gave you a few years’ time and you’re still a virgin!”
“Linglong, what nonsense are you talking about.” Xi Yao’s face turned red, as her expression turned serious, “I long for longevity, in search of the path towards the Great Dao and my wish is to step into the Immortal Realm. As for the rest, those are just insignificant like splashes of water and fleeting clouds.”
“Immortal Realm?” Linglong smiled strangely, “Well you’re looking at an Immortal Realm right in front of you! If you…. *cough*, you’d probably be at least Extreme Path Realm, if not Imminent Immortal, rather than staying at the pinnacle of Primal Spirit Realm.
*Slap…*
Jiang Ming slapped Linglong’s butt through the air and said, “You rascal, you’re getting more and more out of tune!”
Linglong only pursed his lips as Xi Yao lowered her head deep in thought.
‘If you…. *cough*, you’d probably be at least Extreme Path Realm, if not Imminent Immortal.’ Linglong’s words kept running through her head. How was that possible?
She couldn’t sense Linglong’s cultivation base at all. Standing right next to her inexplicably made her soul feel insignificant.
“Linglong, what’s your cultivation base now?” Xi Yao asked.
“Immortal Realm” answered Linglong.
“Immortal Realm? How is that possible?” Xi Yao exclaimed.
Linglong smiled as she raised her hands and grabbed into the air. A chain of order was forcibly pulled out by her, condensing into a chain as she swiftly threw it over to Xi Yao.
“This… This is the Lunar Law’s Chain!” Xi Yao’s eyes widened, her face filled with shock. “Even Imminent Immortals couldn’t materialize the Law’s Chains. You really became an Immortal? But how did you not ascend?”
Linglong didn’t answer but cheekily replied, “That’s why I told you, Immortal Realm is just in front of you, yet you’re turning a blind eye!”
Xi Yao was speechless as she took a glance at Jiang Ming secretly.
The mountain breeze was rippling through the air under the warmth of the sun.
Jiang Ming stretched his body and exclaimed in his heart, ‘This is what I called truly living!’
Accompanied by a fairy-like lady with another Holy Daughter on the other side, what more could a husband ask for!
However, Jiang Ming’s face turned slightly solemn and asked: “Xi Yao, is there any news from your Master?”
“There is. They’re just telling me to return to my master as soon as possible.” Xi Yao had a clear mind and immodestly felt that something was wrong, “Brother Jiang, did something happen?”
“Half a month ago, the cross dimensional gateway of the Western Region was opened, followed by Long Yuan in the deep Eastern Sea, Southern Region and Zhong Province. ” Jiang Ming explained, “There should also be a cross dimensional gateway opened in the Riyue Sect, which should be the so-called true heritage of the Sacred Lands.” “This…” Xi Yao’s expression changed slightly and anxiously continued, “Brother Jiang, my master’s sect…. my master’s sect will never be your enemy.”
Maybe her master’s sect didn’t know of Jiang Ming’s terror, but how could she not know?
He was the person who could decimate descended Immortals in a glimpse of an eye.
He was the one overseeing the world, suppressed countless foreigners who came from the outside world, preventing them from creating chaos and problems.
Now, even Linglong had already reached the Immortal Realm. How terrifying was that?
To top that off, the most important thing was that she could choose not to ascend when she was here.
Who else could even compete with her in this world?
But upon hearing what Jiang Ming told just now, she also understood in her heart that it was the Sacred Lands who were used to their arrogance. Now that various cross dimensional gateways were opened, they still thought that the world belonged to the Sacred Land, and thus ignoring this place now.
Otherwise, how could there be no concrete news? That was not right.
Could it be that they want to be enemies against us here? Otherwise, there should be more news.
As these thoughts ran through her mind, her face turned extremely solemn.
“Allies or enemies, it doesn’t really matter to me.” Jiang Ming spoke softly as he walked over and half onto the railings on the balcony, overlooking the distant mountains, “Just don’t come to Qing Province. Don’t come to Jiuyang Sect
He turned his head over, facing the spatial node right below Taiyang Peak.
He never looked there.
It was something that caused the Devils and Immortals to try and get their hands on at all cost, and it must be something that must not be taken lightly. For the sake of safety, he hadn’t acted.
He didn’t need the great encounters and only had to grow step by step. He didn’t want to endanger himself in these inexplicable encounters.
Xi Yao stood at the side and was trying to get into contact with her Master’s sect.
…
In the Tianyuan School of Zhong Province.
Liu Changkong was sitting together with Ye Ming
“Old Dean, the various sacred lands in the world all had their cross dimensional gateway opened. What are they planning? What are they trying to do? When the Eastern Region was lost, they did not take action; when the demons from the Northern Region invaded and when the foreigners from other worlds descended, these Sacred Lands did not open their cross dimensional gateways. Yet, what are they opening now for? The cross dimensional gateways have been opened yet the information about its opening is hidden from
us.”
“They are called Sacred Lands because they have a method of opening a cross dimensional gateway and will not simply evoke it unless it is the critical moment that leads to the destruction of the sect. Qingyun Sect was an example. Now, with all the cross dimensional gateways opening at one go, it seems the legend is true.”
“What legend?”
“A long time ago, this world of ours was once 90% destroyed, and almost collapsed completely. Later on, there was also a gruesome battle between the immortals and the devils. Based on these, it seems as though there’s something hidden in this world of ours that the gods craze for.Now that the cross dimensional gateways are opened in so many Sacred Lands, it can only explain one thing, that is, the hidden secret is true and it’s time to open it.”
“This… What should we do? Allow them to do as they wish?”
“Just wait and see!”
“Sigh, we can only do so. Old Dean, the secret is in Jiuyang Sect in the Eastern Region?”
“Everything that’s happened show’s it’s there.” “Should we inform them?”
“I’ll do it!”
Liu Changkong looked at the clouds in the skies with a heavy expression.
He never expected this kind of situation to happen and didn’t even realize it beforehand.
Qingyun Sect of the Eastern Region.
In a forbidden land, there were immortal lights trickling down with divine notes reverberating through the air, interweaving into a melody that didn’t belong to the human world.
Qing Fengzi came over to the place and he didn’t look very good.
He didn’t even know that the sect could open a cross dimensional gateway that could cross over to other worlds.
When he thought of the catastrophe in the Eastern Region and the heavy casualties that the sect had suffered, his heart was even more uncomfortable.
In the cross dimensional gateway, tens and thousands of these so-called “Immortals’ had descended but they were only at level 10. At the moment, these experts were sacrificing a mountain as an offering, turning it into an immortal land.
“Turning the mortal land into immortal land, guiding the projection of the immortal region to allow the real immortals to descend. They will then control the immortal land and travel around the world, conquering and wage war with everyone. Isn’t this the same as that Tian Ci from the Tianyuan School?”
Qing Fengzi understood a little more on what was occurring as he sighed in his heart, ‘This small feeble world is too miserable, constantly bullied by so many others.’
Meanwhile, Longyuan of the Eastern Sea, Taishang Sword Sect of Zhong Province, Million Demons Mountain of the Southern Region and many others were all doing the same thing
Western Regions.
Over at the Peak of Bliss, the mountain was also offered as sacrifice, turning into Buddha Land where peaceful Buddha lights illuminating throughout. Even thousands of Buddha phantoms started appearing in the air, reciting the sutras of compassion.
At the same time, there were as many as 10 millions of people gathered together, where some were devoted believers, while others the remnants of the Five Paths of the devil sects who were enlightened.
They knocked on the wooden fish, recited the scriptures, seemingly losing their own self-awareness through their immense devotion.
It could be clearly seen that their bodies were collapsing and disintegrating under the blessing of the great array formation below them. Those with their hands gone, their mouths never stopped; those with their mouths gone, their hands were still knocking on the wooden fish; those that had even lost their heads, their souls were still reciting the scriptures.
At a certain point, all of them completely disappeared, but there were countless spots of lights gathering together turning into a ball of light, as a streak of Buddha light rushed out of the cross dimensional gateway, merging with
After a while, the ball of light shattered and out walked a young Buddha monk, with a huge golden wheel of merit suspended behind his head.
He wore a cassock with a gentle smile on his face.
“All hail our Buddha!” Many Fo Sect’s elders knelt down one after another throwing their bodies onto the ground as respect.
“Namo Amitabha! You have all done greatly. After I save the world, I’ll take you all back with me to be under the originator Buddha!” the young Buddha monk nodded with a gentle smile, as his faint voice resounded through the
west.
Over on Chuyang peak, Jiang Ming also looked over that direction, his brows furrowed, “Such gruesome technique, such cruel method! Oh the Western Region, truly crueler than even the devils! A fine line between the Devil and the Buddha, both never apart. I finally understood what this saying meant.”

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - One of the Buddhist from the Heavenly Realm’s Spiritual Mountain: the Six-Winged Golden Cicada
chapters.content:
Chapter 193 One of the Buddhist from the Heavenly Realm’s Spiritual Mountain: the Six-Winged Golden Cicada
Name: Chan Xin
Race: Six-winged Golden Cicada
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 12 True Immortal
Background: One of the Buddhist from the Heavenly Realm’s Spiritual Mountain.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Great Overarching
Status: In the maple forest at the foot of Spiritual Mountain, a golden cicada which was mutated with six wings, flapped its wings and chirped around, resounding through the entire Spiritual Mountain. An elder Buddha who was preaching, heard the cicada’s chirping and smiled. He said: The Cicada is a Zen, with a mind of wisdom that will startle the world one day, becoming an Arhat Buddha in the future. He will be named Chan Xin.
Transforming into human figure in a year, becoming an immortal in 10 years and stepping onto the True Immortal Realm in 100 years, his art of meditation were unmatched by the younger generations; his Dharma-protecting special abilities were overwhelming among other monks and was named by the various living beings of the Spiritual Mountain as the Holy Buddha.
Shocked to find out that an old Buddha was laying out an encounter in the mortal world, who took the opportunity to communicate with the dharma of the mortal world when the tides of the voids were at its weakest and lead the supreme Buddha energy to form the cross dimensional gateway.
Heard that there are people tempering Buddha soil over in the mortal world which will evoke an unyielding Buddha array formation. By refining the blood essence of countless living beings, a Buddha Embryo can be formed. Integrating with the laws of the human world, evolving supreme special ability allows the body to withstand the descension of a True Immortal, traveling freely in the world.
Chan Xin was pleasantly surprised and said that he admires the mortal world, asking for an opportunity to look for his encounters in the mortal world. The old Buddha readily agreed and said, “The Heavenly Realm is located at the highest point among all of the worlds. Opening a gateway towards the mortal world is hard, and it is even more difficult for an immortal to descend. The price to descend is too high, otherwise no one would wait until now. If it was a middle immortal chiliocosm or a small immortal chiliocosm it would have been relatively easier.”
Now that the Great Heavenly Venerate is setting up the Zhou Tianxingdou Great Formation, it will be even more difficult for the Buddha to descend into the mortal world in the future. Fortunately it is now still in the setting up phase.
Also heard the old Buddha’s saying, “There is a small devil trying to scheme on the encounters of this mortal world. Initially hoped that once the other party captures it, our side can directly come to suppress the abyss. It would have saved a lot of trouble, but alas the other party failed. There was also an immortal from a middle immortal chiliocosm that tried their hands on the mortal world but also ended up failing. The two of these parties weren’t reconciled from the defeat and continued to plan on capturing the mortal world. Haha! Such little devil, such a feeble middle immortal chiliocosm. The two are merely circus monkeys dancing on the stage.
Also heard the old Buddha continued, “There are a few other forces who are scheming the mortal world. Kill if you want, destroy if you want, just do whatever you want.
Upon reaching the human world and saw the great mountains and rivers of the world, his heart was in euphoria thinking, This world will be my playtoy. Haha, the Spiritual Mountain is too miserable and isn’t as free as the world here. Heard that humans are delicious! I must have a taste.’ ‘As for the great encounters? There’s no rush! No rush at all. I’ll first eat to my heart’s content, play to my heart’s content, destroy this human world as I go along and then get my hands on the great encounters.
0
Upon reading this, Jiang Ming’s heart sank and his killing intent surged exponentially.
Chan Xin from the Heavenly Realm? At the peak of worlds?
It was apparent that Chan Xin’s world was far beyond the middle immortal chiliocosm. Jiang Ming also realized something important, which was that descending from Heavenly Realm into the mortal world was much more difficult compared to the other realms such as the middle immortal chiliocosm.
‘How on earth does this great Dao work? There’s even a Great Heavenly Venerate. Could it be equivalent to the Jade Emperor? Setting up the great array formation was really aimed at the orders of the worlds?’
Various thoughts crossed Jiang Ming’s mind as the killing intent in his heart gradually boiled.
It was especially the case when he read about evoking a great Buddha Formation array and refining the essence of countless living beings.
Such a simple sentence yet it was referring to the millions of lives in the world, many of those were in the Primal Spirit Realm, Paradis Realm and even the Extreme Path Realm.
What if the commoners were sacrificed instead? Ten billion of them will probably not even be enough.
Jiang Ming finally understood fully the real purpose of Western Region pretending to be defeated in the beginning. Their real intention was to purify the devils of five devil sects, and sacrificed them to welcome the arrival of their “True Buddha”.
“Sky-defying Great Formation, what an old Buddha”
There was a story that a Buddha observed 480 million living beings in front of him and himself with a scoop of water, muttering, “Drink!”
Perhaps the old Buddha’s view of the world was somewhat the same.
To him, all living beings in the mortal world were as feeble as grasses.
This old Buddha however, regarded the Devil Kings and the Immortal Beings as somewhat a circus monkey dancing on the stage, was truly horrifying
Jiang Ming lifted his finger.
Linglong, who was right next to him, suddenly felt chills running down her spine yet Xi Yao didn’t feel anything. Instead, she came over to Jiang Ming and said, “Senior Liu Changkong from Tianyuan School sent over a message, saying that many Sacred Lands have opened up cross dimensional gateways and there are a lot of immortals that descended. They also said that these immortals are tempering the place into immortal lands to form immortal domains. Just like the previous Golden Heavenly Path, these will be able to lead the real immortals over and roam our world.”
Such info was a way of the other party showing their good will towards the expert behind Linglong.
Jiang Ming paused and looked around in all the directions again as his face flashed a smile of sarcasm. He looked at Xi Yao and said, “Tell your Master, your relatives that are in your sect. Ask them to quickly leave the place.”
“This…” Xi Yao’s face turned pale as her body swayed. She grabbed Jiang Ming’s arm forcefully, “Brother Jiang…Brother Jiang, must it be this way?”
“A True Buddha has descended in the Western Region, and guess how he descended?” Jiang Ming smiled a little yet there wasn’t a hint of warmth in his smile, as he continued “Sacrificing the purified devil experts and also millions of devout believers, where all of them had had results in their cultivations.”
Upon hearing this, Xi Yao’s pupil shrank, and her face was filled with shock and terror.
Jiang Ming continued explaining: “While planning on getting his hands on this world’s great encounters, the True Buddha is prepared to devour humans and destroy this mortal world. As for those immortals that had descended in the Sacred Lands, hehe….”
“How can this happen?” Xi Yao was dumbfounded by the news, and then smiled bitterly, “I don’t have the right to persuade you, but can you handle this?”
Jiang Ming smiled and this time, his smile had more warmth in it.
He looked over to Linglong, “Girl, have I been lying too low, allowing these people to invade, others to conspire against us, and now even people who are wanting to destroy this world of ours. Haha! A few immortals that had descended in several Sacred Lands even planned to completely refine our world or decimate our world just to land their hands on the great encounters.”
“To hell with that!” Jiang Ming cursed angrily, “Although I’ve only lived on a mountain, I still have this piece of sky above my head and my feet firmly on this ground. How can I allow these people to do our world harm! The Sacred Lands have been arrogant, enjoying the worships of millions of people for hundreds of millions of years. In the end, they have forgotten about their roots. If that’s the case, I shall just destroy all of them, and cut off their connection to the higher realms. Let this world remain as it is!”
“Xi Yao, for your sake, I will deal with Riyue Sect last, but you don’t have much time.”
Jiang Ming soared into the air, still within the range of the Saint Province Dao Square. He shrouded himself and isolated all prying eyes from the outside world.
Linglong on the other hand stayed silent.
She knew that this time, her Senior Brother was angry… Really angry…
Unfortunately, she was unable to leave the Chuyang Peak, hence there’s nothing else she could do. Otherwise, she would not let her Senior Brother to be the one getting his hands dirty. She also soared up into the air, arriving next to Jiang Ming as she hugged onto his arms and accompanied him quietly.
Xi Yao was in great hurry as she continued to send messages back to her sect.
Back in Riyue Sect…
Upon receiving the news from Xi Yao, Xi Yao’s Master immediately went to find their Sect Master without any hesitation.
“Holy Lord, Xi Yao sent over a message again. Her words were sharp and urgent, asking us to ignore those immortals and leave the sect immediately. Otherwise, there will be a chance of our sect’s annihilation. No, what she said was the sect will surely be annihilated, cutting off chances of inheritance. From what I know about Xi Yao’s temperament, she currently has no confidence at all in us or the other Sacred Lands!”
They knew Xi Yao was in Jiuyang Sect all the while and was of no urge to hurry her back to the sect, because there was a peerless figure that could overwhelm the world there.
In their view, it would be good if they could befriend that person.
“It’s probably that person who found out about it I guess.” Riyue Sect’s Sect Master smiled and shook her head, “Anyway, he is overestimating himself in his effort trying to annihilate us. Now that the great encounter has been initiated, countless immortal worlds have been opened and boundless immortals have descended into the world, who can stop this overwhelming force? Those who oppose it will surely die. After all, Xi Yao is still a junior with insufficient experiences and a limited vision of how the world truly is.”
“But… but, Sect Master! The person behind Linglong is a terrifyingly powerful existence of mysterious background yet we still don’t even know his identity. What if, I mean, what if. Don’t forget about the devils over in the Northern Region a few years ago and also what happened to the Golden Heavenly Path.”
“This…” the Holy Lord frowned, pondered for a moment and said, “The possibility is minute and even if it’s possible, it cannot be stopped and we are even less likely to leave. After all, those above us are our backbones, places that we see as our final destination. Elder Liu, just in case anything happens, you can lead your branch and a few of our disciples to leave this place. Let it be if nothing happens, but if there’s a risk of something happening, consider this as the inheritance of our legacy.”
“Holy Lord, let’s leave together!”
“Everyone can go but I can’t. This is actually a great encounter for me! If I missed it, I will regret it for the rest of my life!”
Upon hearing his answer, Elder Liu sighed softly.
After a quick discussion, she left the place hurriedly.
On top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming raised his arms once again, lifted his index finger as a small flicker of light started to condense on his fingertips.
Linglong could see clearly that it was the fusion of various mortal laws. To the Immortals, the mortal laws were insignificant, but once they were integrated and merged into one, it would turn into a blinding luminance that shone upon the entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - Not just Rubbing It in His Face, But Also Stomping
chapters.content:
Chapter 194 Not just Rubbing It in His Face, But Also Stomping
At the Buddhist Land in the Western Region…
Chan Xin stood afloat high in the air, with the golden wheels of merit and virtue above his head. He looked down over at the many devout Buddhist believers who were kneeling below, stretching from that area to the ends of the sky.
He couldn’t even conceal the smile on the corner of his mouth.
Although his status back in the Spiritual Mountain in the Heavenly Realm was good, he was still considered just a small shrimp in the big ocean. But here, they were addressing him as: My Buddha, Lord Buddha, Saint Buddha, Elder Buddha and even Holy Buddha!
Hearing all these, he himself had now become the Lord Buddha here already!
Haha! Such a joyful experience over in this mortal world!
When he looked to the other side, he saw the 3,000 female devout believers who were selected for him. He couldn’t help but chuckle thinking of so many of them warming his bed.
‘Today will be the day I become the Lord and Savior!’ Chan Xin was extremely satisfied with his status.
He even started to have thoughts that even if the mission was completed, he wouldn’t be going back to the Spiritual Mountain in the Heavenly Realm but stay here in this mortal world. It was, after all, too much like heaven to him.
All of a sudden, his heart had a sudden throb as he inexplicably felt terrified. The feeling of death suddenly emerged, causing him to feel suffocated.
‘Who can even threaten me in this mortal world? Could it be that the Elder Buddha heard my thoughts just now?’ Chan Xin thought to himself. Meanwhile, as he was ready to activate his Buddha weapon, he realized the feeling just now disappeared.
Golden lights trickled down the sides of his eyes as he thoroughly scanned the world and noticed there were movements over in the Eastern Region.
rose
‘That sudden induction can’t be wrong! What’s going on?’ Chan Xin’s vigilance rose greatly, ‘Have the other descended Immortals started to take action?’
Over at the Eastern Region, Jiang Ming was about to launch his attack to decimate Chan Xin, but discovered a spatial breach that just opened up right outside of Jiuyang Sect. A piece of Immortal Land shot out of the rift, with boundless luminance of immortality shrouding the whole land along with various different chains of order surrounding it, giving off a holy and sacred feeling. “I didn’t expect you all to be the first to act.” Jiang Ming looked confused, paused his attack on Chan Xin and instead landed below.
“Senior brother, what should we do?” Linglong asked.
“Well, I’m bored to death now. So let’s see what fun they’d bring us!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile.
Right outside of Jiuyang Sect, the piece of Immortal Land stayed afloat in mid-air as boundless divines were radiated throughout the vast land, causing even then skies to feel intimidated. Who knew how many of the living beings who were ignorant of what was happening were trembling in fear. There was a throne on the Immortal Land where a strong individual was sitting on it. Every pores on his skin exuded lights of immortality, with inexplicable runes flashing around, merging to form a terrifying array formation.
“So this is Jiuyang Sect?” The man finally spoke.
“Yes, Venerable Immortal!”Qing Fengzi was right by his side, standing respectfully. He was in charge of the Qingyun Sect’s external affairs.
“It’s too much to call me the Venerable Immortal, I cannot shoulder such greatness.” The young man then continued, “Just refer to me as the Immortal Envoy. In the Heavenly Realm, it should be the Patriarch who is Qingyun’s Venerable Immortal.”
“Yes, Immortal Envoy!”
“Alright! The likes of you have been preaching about Jiuyang Sect being of such amazement, but it seems like it is just due to that one incident. The Golden Heavenly Path arrived here and the Immortals who had descended disappeared without a trace, ending with the Golden Heavenly Path being destroyed. Is that right?”
“Yes!”
“Was there really no other movement?”
“There isn’t!”
“That is it!” The Immortal Envoy stood up and smiled,” This is a perfect planar world and the strongest expert that can possibly be nurtured here is but of the Imminent Immortal Realm. How would it be possible that a couple Immortals would be annihilated without even a sound? I’ve also checked around just now. It seems that in this little Jiuyang Sect, the strongest person is but only of the feeble Paradis Realm. There isn’t any heavenly-defying array formation in place here either. I suspect the scene that you witnessed that day was an illusion all the while.”
One
“Immortal Envoy, not only were we the one who witnessed the whole ordeal that day. Even the other experts from various Sacred Lands around the world saw the whole thing as well.” Qing Fengzi cautiously said.
“Is it so difficult to project an illusion that can mask the whole world? It is impossible to do so back in the Heavenly Realm but this is the mortal world, a small feeble mortal world, the size akin to a person’s palm.” The Immortal Envoy shook his head and continued, “Moreover, a few years back, there weren’t any other forces who descended into this mortal world. Come along! I’ve already sensed it. The secret is within the Jiuyang Sect!”
SA
“Immortal Envoy, should we send a few of our people to scout out the place?”
í mo
“With us already making our move, how can the other forces hold themselves back? Making our moves early is our initiative to be the first among all. If we slowly scout out the place, it would just waste our time. Besides, with the immortal land here, can this feeble small Jiuyang Sect threaten us? Such a joke!”
The Immortal Envoy waved over his sleeves and sat back down.
There were dozens of other Immortal beings around him, most of them expressionless
Qing Fengzi lifted his gaze at one of them. He was one of the sect’s elders, his Master, who had ascended into the higher realm. Back in the days, he was of the highest status in Qingyun Sect, respected by all.
Yet, he could only stand aside today.
Even though his level of cultivation was on par with the Immortal Envoy, his status however, was totally different.
While Qing Fengzi smiled bitterly in his heart, he was also trying to inquire. The Immortal slightly shook his head, implicating him to be more honest.
Therefore, Qing Fengzi could do nothing other than back down.
‘I have a strong sense of unease in my heart. It’s as though something of great catastrophe was imminent.’ Qing Fengzi was very uneasy the whole time.
The whole parchment of immortal land barged directly into Jiuyang Sect, floating right above Jiuyang Sect’s main hall.
With a pair of divine vision, the Immortal Envoy peered through the layers of barriers and discovered the spatial node underground. He couldn’t help but nodded, stood up and commanded in high spirit, “The Immortal encounter is right here! Everyone listen up! Once I successfully obtain this Immortal encounter, you can all follow me ascending into the Heavenly Realm!”
He didn’t even look at Chuyang Peak. It was apparent that his arrival this time was much smarter than that of Dong Yao’s.
“Something’s wrong!” Qing Fengzi suddenly blurted.
“What’s wrong?” the Immortal Envoy frowned, a little unhappy with the comment. Lights were flowing in his palms and seemed to already condense into a supreme power of law.
Qing Fengzi felt chills running down his spine but couldn’t help himself from commenting, “It’s too quiet here. We came here with such a big commotion! How is it possible that the Jiuyang Sect’s disciples didn’t discover us?”
The Immortal Envoy opened his mouth, wanting to say that these disciples merely felt his presence and were covering in fear, yet when he gazed around, it seemed those of the Jiuyang Sect didn’t even care about their arrival and were still going off with their own business.
The Immortal Envoy was clearly not stupid. Squinting his eyes with his eyebrows sharp as the sword, the immortal land started to radiate waves and waves of luminance, forming a peerless formation array. He then saw a pair of young man and woman pacing over towards him in the air.
The man was beyond handsome while the woman looked unparalleled.
‘Such a matching couple!’ The Immortal Envoy exclaimed secretly, and quickly realized the two of them were actually talking and laughing, walking in a bee’s line towards the immortal land. His eyes flashed.
“This here are Zi Linglong and Jiang Ming of the Jiuyang Sect’s Chuyang Peak. Zi Linglong’s aptitude is unparalleled while Jiang Ming is quite ordinary in comparison. Everything that has happened in the past was suspected to be the doings of the person behind Zi Linglong,” Qing Fengzi explained.
“Jiang Ming is ordinary?” The divine lights in the Immortal Envoys palm lit up again, “He has already reached the Imminent Immortal Realm, yet you say that he’s ordinary?”
“This… This is not possible!” Qing Fengzi had a face of disbelief.
Back then, he came over to Chuyang Peak and personally did his investigation on Jiang Ming. He was of ordinary aptitude and had a low cultivation base. How could he reach the Imminent Immortal Realm now?
“What’s more terrifying is that lady there! I can’t even see through her cultivation!” The Immortal Envoy gaze turned over to Linglong, his face turning into an unprecedented solemn look.
Divine lights started to appear around his body and a formation even formed around himself, protecting him in the middle.
“Impossible!” Qing Fengzi shook his head, “You’re the Immortal Envoy! A being beyond the mortal world! How can you not see through Zi Linglong’s cultivation base? If she has stepped into the Immortal Realm, how can she even continue staying in this mortal world? She must possess some sort of rare artifact that concealed her level of cultivation.”
“This explanation seems reasonable!” The Immortal Envoy nodded his head but was secretly trying to mobilize the immortal land, planning to first flee from Jiuyang Sect and further plan his next step later on.
Yet to his shock, he discovered that the immortal land now couldn’t move an inch.
“This…” his heart sank immediately.
As the Immortal Envoy recalled what Qing Fengzi just told him, it seemed that there was a possibility, that maybe, it might have been real all along In front of him, he saw Jiang Ming and Zi Linglong who rushed over, watching and listening quietly.
“Senior Brother, he noticed it.” Linglong sensed someone trying to mobilize the immortal land, and couldn’t help but laugh. “There’s so many great incidents happening in this mortal world and yet they still dare to barge right in.
