Is this arrogance? Or just pure ignorance?” “Well, they are Immortals after all. Of course they are arrogant. When they become arrogant, they look down on anything and everything which make them look stupid. However, how many idiots are there that could cultivate right up into the Immortal Realm?” Jiang Ming laughed.
The moment when the immortal land appeared right outside of Jiuyang Sect, Jiang Ming secretly manipulated the power of the Saint Province Dao Square, covering the sect from top to bottom so that none of the sect’s members could see what was happening. This was also to prevent the people from getting agitated from all the ruckus.
As for the Immortal Envoy’s effort to peep through the barriers? It was also affected by the Saint Province Dao Square.
Even when the Immortal Land came within their vicinity, Jiang Ming had already disguised the whole place as though they had already destroyed Jiu yang Sect and had already made their way to the place of great encounter.
This time however, it was Linglong who made the next move and imprisoned the whole immortal land.
“Although he’s not an idiot, he still looks stupider than an idiot.” Linglong smiled as though no one was around her and continued, “The Golden Heavenly Path appeared, the immortals descended and yet all of them fell right here. How could Qingyun Sect not know of this? How could they not inform him? Yet in the end, he still barged in. Tsk, tsk, tsk! Such stupidity is unreal.”
“He thinks that the mortal world is something he can just toy with. Linglong we should take them as a warning to ourselves and be extra careful when we encounter anything in the future. Otherwise, we will end up like these idiots, with their lives in other peoples’ grasp, too late for regrets.”
“Don’t worry, senior brother. If I become arrogant and ignorant in the future, I’ll think back on these idiots today. That will certainly wake me up!”
As the Immortal Envoy listened to their conversation, his face turned frighteningly gloomy. The two of them were using him and his people as bad examples!
God damn it! One didn’t just rub it on someone’s face like that!
These two not only rubbed it in his face, but it was as if the two were stomping his face right into the abyss and smothering it.
If even such shame could be withstood, what else could not be?

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - A Massacre Outside of the Jiuyang Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 195 A Massacre Outside of the Jiuyang Sect
The Immortal Envoy could no longer stand the insults.
He pointed at Jing Ming and Linglong, violently howling, “I am the immortal of the Heavenly Realm! I’ve seen the Great Dao and witnessed its longevity. Now that I’ve descended onto your mortal world, it is your great encounter to be able to meet me in person! Now, I’m giving the two of you the chance to become immortals. Kneel before me and worship me as your Master, for I will bring you two back to the Heavenly Realm with me to absorb the immortal spiritual qi and comprehend the genuine Great Dao. With just a flick of a finger, you will be able to step into the Immortal Realm and enjoy longevity.”
The Immortal Envoy flicked his sleeves and turned his back, gazing up in the skies with great magnanimity.
Qing Fengzi stole a glance at the Immortal Envoy and cursed in his heart, ‘Such an idiot! You’re weaker than them and still claiming that you are the Immortal Envoy! Still trying to deter the two of them under such a situation? God damn it! You’re going to be the death of me!’
He himself could clearly see that Linglong and Jiang Ming were definitely two terrifying beings, and yet this Immortal Envoy was still trying to threaten the two?
To hell with that!
Upon hearing the Immortal Envoy’s preach, Jiang Ming’s face was full of astonishment, shook his head and muttered, “I was wrong. This is an idiot, right here.”
“Yeah, just an idiot!” Linglong agreed indifferently.
OV
“You dare insult me? You’re just digging your own grave!” howled the Immortal Envoy, as he couldn’t stand their insult anymore. He then commanded, “Ming Daozi! Go forth and kill him!”
“As you command!” A middle-aged man walked out from one side of the Immortal Land. With a swift flick of the sword in his hand, 3,000 strands of extremely violent sword Dao qi were formed that could even cut off all the laws and principles of the mortal world.
The sword’s strength was extremely powerful and could easily sever the entire Eastern Region if he was placed outside.
Bang…
The very next moment, the sword qi could be seen shattering into pieces, dispersing into the air. Linglong made her move as she simultaneously commented, “This sword of yours has the look and the essence of Sword Dao. If you are fighting against someone of the same cultivation realm, you can be considered the ultimate expert but sadly, you shouldn’t have descended into this mortal world and what’s more, shouldn’t have come here.”
As Linglong muttered, she lifted her right index finger, emanating strands of Sword Qi.
Immediately after, with just a point of the finger, the sword qi pierce right through the middle-aged man’s forehead, severing his Primal Spirit and he tragically died on the spot.
The whole incident was swift and ruthless. It directly shook the Immortal Envoy and the rest of his underlings, especially Qing Fengzi.
Shocked by what he just witnessed, Qing Fengzi couldn’t help but exclaim, “How is this possible? Linglong, you actually killed an immortal with only just a finger! Wait a minute! The destruction of the devils in the Northern Region, and the decimation of the immortals of the Golden Heavenly Path, are all of these your doings?”
He was overwhelmed by the whole ordeal.
He looked back and realized that at this point in time, Linglong was but only in her 20s and yet she had already reached the Immortal Realm?
Was the Phoenix Bloodline that powerful?
Or did she come across sky-defying encounters?
Yes! It must be the encounters! The hidden encounter in Jiuyang Sect! She must have got her hands on them!
When he thought of it, he couldn’t help regretting why he didn’t forcefully take in Linglong as his disciple. He could have also killed her or even destroyed the Jiuyang Sect altogether.
Unfortunately it was too late for regrets. “How can immortals be born in the mortal world?” The Immortal Envoy’s expression became even more unsightly as the uneasiness in his heart rapidly grew.
Real experts could be seen from their actions.
Jiang Ming started to feel bored over the whole charade as he turned over to Linglong and said, “Let’s just kill all of them.”
“All of them? Wouldn’t it be a waste?” Linglong asked.
“Then let’s suppress them and seal them first. Then, maybe we can try to enslave them?” Jiang Ming hesitated.
“Alright then!”
As Linglong nodded her head, she reached out and grabbed with her hands. The whole immortal land suddenly trembled, bursting out hundreds of millions of immortal lights, yet confined within a limited area.
Dense minute sword qi appeared through the void with each strand of these sword qi made out of minute inscription. The strands evoked a supreme energy, pierced through each and every one of the Defensive Immortal Light of the immortals, shattered their defensive Immortal weapons and directly entered their bodies, sealing off their cultivation.
They couldn’t resist at all.
As for Qing Fengzi and the like, they were all beheaded and not a single one remained.
“This is the power of a Golden Immortal! You are actually a Golden Immortal expert! God damn it!” The Immortal Envoy was first startled before getting scared shitless as his whole body trembled in fear.
Right that very moment, an incomparably terrifying power suddenly burst out from his body, smashed through waves and waves of the sword qi, turned into a giant hand aiming right at the likes of Linglong.
The huge palm’s strength overwhelmed the skies, as the palm print formed a formidable array formation. There was even a hint of Timelessness flowing in it. “The power of a Golden Immortal is sealed in his body.” With just a quick glance, Linglong saw through everything. She understood exactly what had happened and chuckled softly, “But this is the mortal world!”
She pointed her finger like a sword, destroying the huge palm and continued to tap on the Immortal Envoy’s forehead, directly wiping out the imprint that was in his sea of consciousness.
The Immortal Envoy had a face of utter despair.
With just a flick of a finger, those who were killed, died, and those who were suppressed, were sealed.
The higher management of the Qingyun Sect seemed to be almost wiped out in just one go.
Jiang Ming however, looked outside and saw a great mountain thousands of miles away. There were quite a number of immortals standing on top of the mountain, with divine light emanating from their bodies as though they were gods, overbearing with inviolable divinity.
He knew that those were from the Taixu Sect of the Northern Region.
When the devils of the Northern Region invaded, Taixu Sect retained their strength and yet now that the cross dimensional gateway had opened and the immortals descended, their power reached its peak again.
A short moment passed by before the voids started to crack open one after another, with blinding lights of divinity seeping through the cracks, revealing the immortal lands and the divinity lands. All of them were from the different forces of the Tianyuan World.
Although there were quite a number of them, Jiang Ming was able to identify each of them clearly.
There were Million Demons Mountain and Tianlei Sect of the Southern Region; Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, Riyue Sect and Taishang Sword Sect of the Zhong Province; and the Fo Sect of the Western Region. Almost all Sacred Lands of the world had gathered over.
A long stretch of mountains was forged into the shape of a huge sword with various strong experts standing atop of it. Each of them armed with their Sword Sambodha, shooting through the air, drenched with destructive nature.
These were obviously the characteristics of the Taishang Sword Sect.
A person standing at the front, holding onto a long sword in his arms as he lightly said. “Everyone! The Qingyun Sect has already entered. Aren’t any of you anxious?”
“Yang Jian! Only a fool would rush!” An old man standing on the immortal mountain formed by the Tian Lei Mountain sneered. Then, he continued, “The brat named Yang that descended from Qingyun Immortal Sect has always been arrogant and ignorant. He even dares to directly enter this Jiuyang Sect just like that! Although this Jiuyang Sect is but a small feeble sect in this tiny mortal world, yet the sect was tied with the various great incidents that had happened here. How would they be so easy to be dealt with? Even if anyone is anxious to take the lead and seize the great encounter, they should at least test the waters first like maybe give them a huge slap and destroy Jiuyang Sect. If the sect can be destroyed then there’s no danger to it; but if it can’t be destroyed, then that would’ve been a huge problem!”
“That makes sense!” Yang Jian smirked, “Everyone saw it just now, when that Yang person went into the lands of the great encounter as if nobody was inside. Isn’t that a proof already?”
“Yang Jian, you’re trying to make a fool of us all!” the old man snorted coldly, “He entered the place and yet what does that even prove? If there’s something wrong with the Jiuyang Sect then they could’ve easily conjured us an illusion; if there isn’t anything wrong with them then the Jiuyang Sect should be so deserted to begin with.”
“Long-winded people!” a monstrous demon from the Million Demons Mountain couldn’t hold back anymore, “Why not act, rather than just waiting here!”
His palms turned into a knife as he slashed towards Jiuyang Sect.
The force could even split open the skies and shatter the stars.
The light from the knife seemed as if it was going to divide heaven and earth into two.
If this slash fell on the Jiuyang Sect, it would definitely turn the sect into ashes and even the great earth would be cut open by thousands of miles wide. Who knew how many beings would die from this?
Evidently, this monstrous demonic immortal didn’t care about human life, and the rest of the other experts on the immortal lands merely watched indifferently.
Yet it was at that moment, a person walked out of Jiuyang Sect. Raising his arm, the slash paused mid-air, then quickly shrank and fell into the palm of his hand, finally condensing into a small three-inch knife.
It was Jiang Ming who came out to greet them.
He actually wanted to lure these immortals into Jiuyang Sect to take care of all of them in one go. Unfortunately, none of them entered and he was slightly disappointed.
Therefore, he decided to come out instead. It was just a few steps away.
“Demons. Even when you have reached the Immortal Realm, you are still a demon, a brute!” Jiang Ming threw the knife casually, as the three-inched knife turned into a meteor piercing through that Immortal Demon in a flash, killing it on the spot.
The other immortals were all shocked at the whole ordeal yet Jiang Ming didn’t stop.
The World Projection was manifested, covering the whole 100,000 miles-radius area, encircling all of the immortal lands in it. It was as though the sky was showing its might, crushing the countless layers of divine light that was emitted as the immortal lands crumbled.
Those who were below the Immortal Realm that stayed on the immortal lands died on the spot.
Each of them mobilized their Immortal Soldiers, evoked their special abilities to protect themselves.
“How can there be such a strong existence in this mortal world?” Yang Jian was beyond shocked, “With only just the projection of Dao, it nearly even suppressed me. Everyone! If the immortal lands completely collapse, we will all be punished by heaven. Moreover, this person here is just too powerful! I suggest we all bring out whatever last cards you have or we will all be dying today! All of us!”
Boom…
Just as he finished his words, a ray of sword light rushed out of the top of his head, tearing through layers upon layers of the world’s projection. Just when it looked as though he was going to break out of the suppression, a furnace suddenly appeared out of nowhere, shattering the sword light completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - Destroying all of the Sacred Lands just so I Can Enjoy Tanning under the Sun Every Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 196 Destroying all of the Sacred Lands just so I Can Enjoy Tanning under the Sun Every Day
Jiang Ming’s World Projection was really the power of the world itself.
Even then, he didn’t stop.
W
Just when the likes of Yang Jian and the others finally revealed their triumph card and were bursting into action, Jiang Ming evoked the Level 14 Immortal Weapon, the Universe Furnace. Its boundless might suppressed the countless special abilities, shattering the sword qi that was produced by that old man in an instance.
Such an immortal of the Heavenly Realm, exploded on the spot.
As for the rest, their endings were all the same.
Their so-called triumph cards were nothing more than just unsealing the power of the Golden Immortal. That was already the limit that one could achieve in this planar world.
Nevertheless, once they evoked the power of Golden Immortals, it would completely trigger the punishment from the Great Dao. If they did not quickly leave the world, it would immediately bring forth heavenly punishment and they would all return to ashes.
This was already their last resort.
Even so, it was unfortunately not of any use at all.
With just a flick of a finger, the various Immortals turned into ashes.
Jiang Ming stood high in the sky and with a wave of his sleeves, he kept the remaining Immortal Soldiers left by them. But he destroyed whatever other Artifacts or Dao vessels.
The windy breeze blew strong across the lonely mountains once again.
That moment, all the mortal world’s powerful experts were at a loss of words.
Never would it cross their minds that these many immortals who had descended into their mortal world would be killed just like that. Why did it look like it was all just a show?
Following that, they saw Jiang Ming, who was shrouded by divine light and could hardly see his face, pointing his fingers in all directions continuously, striking out an infinite amount of sword qi.
First off was Qingyuen Sect. There were quite a number of Imminent Immortals guarding the cross dimensional gateway in Qingyun Sect. It was at that very moment, a streak of sword qi came ripping through the void, destroying the entire gateway in an instant.
The sword qi exploded, killing all of the Imminent Immortals around it. The illuminating sword qi scattered in all directions, raging through Qingyun Sect and in just a short time, 90% of the sect were murdered.
The Qingyun Sacred Land was now crippled completely.
It didn’t matter if it was the Taixu Sacred Land, Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, Riyue Sect, Taishang Sword Sect, Million Demons Mountain, Fo Sect of the Western Region and the likes, all of them were completely destroyed. Even the Long Yuan of the Eastern Sea was destroyed as well.
‘Oh, you Sacred Lands. Wasn’t it better to just stay at the top like you always do, looking down at the world arrogantly? You had to just come to the Eastern Region, to come to Jiuyang Sect and to provoke me. Well, in order to live my carefree life in the future, I’ll have to only ask that you all go to hell.’
Jiang Ming turned his thoughts over, focusing on the last of them: Chan Xin.
Jing Ming wasn’t sure what the thought process behind Chan Xin was. He sent a lot of Immortal Buddhists over and yet he himself remained hidden in the dark, observing. Right that very moment, he had already escaped to the depth into the Eastern Sea, evoking special abilities to conceal himself.
Jiang Ming looked through the Human Path Record.
Name: Chan Xin
Race: Six-winged Golden Cicada
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 12 (True Immortal)
Background:One of the Buddhist from the Spiritual Mountain of the Heavenly Realm.
Relationship: -11
Innate talent: Great Overarching
Status: Ever since he felt his own impending death, he had been restless. This only meant one thing, that was, the next great movement would be dangerous, a very dangerous one at that.
When he saw the Immortal Envoy of Qingyun Sect going into Jiuyang Sect, and even saw that he directly opened up the secret pathway that led him towards the land of the great encounter, his heart trembled and he wanted to barge right into it. However, something felt off.
It was too quiet, so very quiet.
Even if the Jiuyang Sect was weak, they could’ve at least resisted a little. Moreover, now that the land of encounter has been opened, how did it not affect Jiuyang Sect at all?
“When he saw Yang Jian and the other immortals go up into Jiuyang Sect, he ordered many Buddhist Immortals to go in as well on behalf of the Fo Sect. He however, continued to observe in the dark.
And what did I see? Holy Hell, my goodness! A person rushed out of Jiuyang Sect and killed Yang Jian and all of the like!
Is there such a terrifying existence in this mortal world? There shouldn’t be and it’s just not logical. Could it be this is an old reclusive monstrous being? That’s not right. If it was an old monstrous being, how can the many forces of us not know of it?
This must be an existence that broke through common sense, and I have encountered him here! Damn it! Should I go back? Or should I continue to stay hidden?”
Oh this is giving me such a headache!
After all the trouble of coming into this mortal world, how can I leave the place with tail in between my legs when I haven’t even enjoyed my charming believers here, haven’t gotten the great encounters and haven’t played to my heart’s content!
I think I’ll just stay hidden first and see how things go. The place to go is none other than the deepest area of the Eastern Sea. The place is vast and there are very few people there.
Jiang Ming smiled and felt a little emotional.
To think that this person didn’t carry any hatred towards him. Such a weird person indeed.
He thought it was truly scary for this person to have Great Overarching innate talent? No wonder that he was crowned the Holy Buddha Son.
However, it all was coming to an end now.
Jiang Ming raised his arm, pointed his finger and shot out a dazzling divine light that zipped away in a flash.
It wasn’t the Sky Shattering Sword Technique this time, but the Return of Infinite Law Finger.
In this mortal world, he could reach every part of the world easily.
Over the East side of the Eastern Sea, there was an island filled with mountains and trees. If you gaze at it from afar, you could easily see the lush greenery.
Chan Xin landed there and with a simple touch of his hand, a great palace appeared right on the mountain top. The palace was extremely gorgeous, yet it was but a Buddhist treasure.
‘From now on, I’m going to be staying here living in seclusion!’
As he thought about it, he saw a light flickering on the surface of the sea. His eyes lit up as he stretched out his hands to grab it. Like that, a stream of light approached him from afar quickly, but it was only a clam girl who was swallowing and spitting out pearls.
‘Not only is it gorgeous, it’s also very delicious! I’ll play around with it first before I eat her. Such wonders!’
Chan Xin was overjoyed as he hugged the clam girl and entered his palace.
After a short while, the whole palace started to shake.
But at that very moment, a streak of light came flashing through the sky, piercing directly into the palace.
Bang…
The light exploded into a terrifying torrent of fluctuation, abruptly blowing apart the whole palace. Chan Xin rushed out of his palace with a grave look on his face…
There were supposed to be three layers of defensive Buddha Light protecting his body and yet two of the layers were already shattered.
This supreme defense was what the Old Buddha blessed him before his departure to this mortal world.
“To think that it not only penetrated the Buddha palace but also shattered two layers of my defensive barrier!’ Chan Xin was extremely horrified, ‘How did he find me?’
“That’s not good!”
Right that very moment, another streak of light appeared in front of his eyes yet again, faster than he could think to react. He only had time to sacrifice an alms bowl right in front of him to try and block the streak of light. Layers upon layers of Buddhist inscriptions were accumulated on the surface of the alms bowl, forming a huge formation array with him in the middle of it.
However, the attack was too terrifying, penetrating through the layers of Buddhist inscription, piercing through the alms bowl and even destroying the last layer of defensive light on his body.
Chan Xin himself was thrown back thousands of miles due to the impact as he spewed thousands of feet of golden blood.
Swish…
Just as he stabilized himself, he suddenly vanished. By the time he reappeared, he was already a million miles away in the South Sea. Alas, just as he reappeared, yet another streak of light was already approaching him.
“Dear Lord Buddha! Save me!” Chan Xin’s face filled with terror as he couldn’t help but howl into the sky.
Just as he was about to be killed, a ray of golden light emitted from his Primal Spirit and blocked off the attacking streak of light.
Chan Xin couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief, then ecstatically knelt down and bowed, “Thank you Lord Buddha for your
grace!”
At the same time, tens of thousands of dark clouds suddenly appeared right above his head, as thunder started to roll and the destructive force locked on to him.
The Heavenly Punishment had arrived.
Chan Xin’s expression turned yet again. The golden light from his body swept him up and disappeared in a flash, disappearing between heaven and earth. Nevertheless, there was a streak of lightning chasing after him, producing a subtle muffled sound as it cruised through the endless torrent of void.
Right outside of Jiuyang Sect, Jiang Ming had evoked the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique twice and yet it didn’t manage to kill off Chan Xin. This really came as a surprise to him as he followed up with the third finger.
Just when it was about to wipe the other party off, an accident happened yet again.
“Lord Buddha?”
Even though Jiang Ming was thousands of miles away from Chan Xin, he could still see the Buddhist light emanating from his body. In the light, Jiang Ming vaguely sensed someone taking a glance at him.
It inexplicably sent chills down his spine.
Hualalala..
He opened up the Human Path Record, and yet there wasn’t anything recorded in it.
“Is it really the Lord Buddha?” Jiang Ming’s heart sank.
As for the divine punishment that appeared, Jiang Ming didn’t care at all.
He suppressed the various thoughts in his mind and looked over the entire world.
Instead of returning to Chuyang Peak, he turned his body and began to teleport everywhere.
Long Yuan, Qingyun Sect, Taixu Sect…
He searched through the places one by one, taking away all the ancient tombs that were left behind. Those remaining experts who were above the Primal Spirit were all killed.
In the end, Jiang Ming came to Tianyuan School.
“You really pushed us to the limits!” Ye Ming looked at Jiang Ming with a complicated expression.
Never did he imagine that the great expert hidden in Chuyang Sect was this little guy.
“Back then, were you the one who killed Tian Ci and traded blows with me?”
Ye Ming looked back to the past.
Tian Ci, who returned after being defeated by Linglong in Chuyang Peak, was assassinated as he passed by the junction between Zhong Province and the Eastern Region. At that moment, he acted to save Tian Ci.
“Yes, though I was still very weak back then!” Jiang Ming laughed.
He revealed himself this time because he no longer thought that he needed to continue hiding? There really wasn’t any need to hide anymore.
Ye Ming’s expression became even more complicated.
He knew about Jiang Ming
It was truly incredible that Jiang Ming could fight against him and even nearly killed him when he was only in his early twenties.
Now he was surely beyond anyone’s imagination.
“Cutting off the inheritance of the Sacred Lands all over the world, erasing the methods of creating the cross dimensional gateways. Aren’t these the right thing to do?” Jiang Ming asked rhetorically. “Yes!” Liu Changkong butted in, “As long as the cross dimensional gateway exists, our mortal world will still belong to the Sacred Land. Even if there are any strong Imminent Immortals that stand up to resist the Sacred Lands, they will eventually be suppressed. It has always been this way since time immemorial.”
“What about Tianyuan School?” Jiang Ming looked over at him.
“The school has the method of forging the cross dimensional gateway yet it doesn’t have a place to connect to. It is merely just a form of record.” Liu Changkong smiled and continued, “Do you know why? Do you know the meaning behind the school’s existence?”

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - Tianyuan Great Monarch, Opening the Immortal Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 197 Tianyuan Great Monarch, Opening the Immortal Treasure
A long long time ago, a great war between the immortals and the demons took place in the mortal realm. It shattered the sky and crushed the land. After the war, 90% of the mortal world was ruined.
Blood was flowing like a river, and there was heap after heap of dead bodies.
After the great war, an immortal descended on the mortal world. Seeing that the mortal world was in shambles, he created the Tianyuan School to prevent the world from falling into ruin as well as to preserve humankind.
The school remained absolutely neutral, and they refrained from participating in any disputes or conflicts.
They welcomed all humans to come and cultivate in the school, but the disciples of the Sacred Lands were not allowed to become their core disciples.
“Then how about this time? Many Sacred Lands have opened the immortal gates and many immortals are descending. They’re going to attack and obliterate this mortal world, so what will the school do?” Jiang Ming asked.
It went without saying that he would not believe it entirely. However, such a statement indeed had appeared in his “status,” but it was too general.
“The school can protect the people in Zhong Province!” Liu Changkong said.
“Protect Zhong Province?” Jiang Ming frowned.
He activated the Dharma Eyes and scanned Zhong Province. Then, he discovered there were spatial nodes in all four directions, each with a terrifying aura. When he tried to look into it, he felt a chill down his spine.
Liu Changkong nodded. “When that happens, I think the mortal world is beyond saving.”
He did not explain more, and Jiang Ming did not press on. Instead, he turned around and left.
He did not have any reason to attack the Tianyuan School or the Yantian Zhong. The Yantian Zhong only yearned for immortality. They did not participate in any of the fights, so Jiang Ming did not have any reason to attack them either.
Both Ye Ming and Liu Changkong couldn’t come to their senses for a long while. “I can’t believe that he has the ability to wipe out so many immortals and Sacred Lands. Sir, am I still dreaming?”
“I think I’m dreaming too. This is too unbelievable. But it’s a bl;essing for us that such a person exists in our world. Once the Sacred Lands are gone, it would be hard for those immortals to come to our world.”
“True. It’s a blessing for us as well as the mortal world that so many Sacred Lands are gone. But, sir,I’m afraid that the destruction of many Sacred Lands would lead to some chaos. Should we do something about it?”
“Yeah, we should. We need to guide them. Besides, pass on an order to the sects across the world and tell them that they shouldn’t attack normal people.
“There is no good or evil among cultivators, but they must not bring the ordinary people into play. However, now is the best time to set some rules! Haha, this is a blessing for all the people across the world!”
Chuyang Peak.
After Jiang Ming had returned, he threw himself on the rattan chair and let out a long sigh.
Hua Huo and the other three flower fairies fluttered their wings and came to his side. They began wiping his face with a towel, or fetching him water and fruits.
“You’re the best, senior brother!” Linglong shouted happily before landing beside him. She peeled a piece of orange and popped it into Jiang Ming’s mouth, “Not only did you kill those immortals, but you also had destroyed those Sacred Lands. No one in history has ever done that before. Senior brother, you’re the first one!”
“I just want to enjoy the sun, but they don’t allow me to. So I have no other choice but to kill them all,” Jiang Ming said, “I’d like to see who has the guts to bother me again.” “You killed them all just because you wanted to enjoy the sun? That’s one hell of a good reason,” Linglong chuckled.
Xi Yao, who was standing at the side, had a complicated expression on her face.
The man in front of her had slain the immortals and destroyed the Sacred Lands.
“Do you hate me?” Jiang Ming cocked his head and asked Xi Yao.
“Should I?” Xi Yao smiled bitterly, “It’s true that you’ve destroyed the Riyue Sect, but I should thank you for sparing my master and me. If not, no one would be able to inherit the Riyue Sect.
“Brother Jiang, Linglong, I guess it’s time for me to go. Thank you for everything so far.”
Xi Yao said as she rose into the air.
“Go ahead!” Jiang Ming nodded, “You can always come back whenever you want. I’ll keep the house for you.”
Xi Yao nodded and went away.
“Senior brother, you have already lost your only chance to sleep with her,” Linglong teased.
“Well, I’m satisfied with ten of you,” Jiang Ming replied.
“Really? You’re not lying, right?”
“Of course, I’m not.”
“I don’t believe it! Let’s go, senior brother. I want to test if you’re telling the truth or not.”
“How are you going to test that?”
“It depends on how hard you work!”
“What?”
Three days later, Jiang Ming returned to the rooftop.
He looked into the sky and rubbed his back.
He turned around and looked at Taiyang Peak. He remembered something and sent a message to the sect master, telling him to prepare since the Eastern Region will fall into chaos after all Sacred Lands had been destroyed as well as to move everyone out of Taiyang Peak.
When the sect master received the message, he was first taken aback before he leapt into joy.
“The Qingyun Sect is gone? I’ve been receiving news that big things are happening in the world outside. I thought it was just a rumor, but it turned out to be real! Haha, now that the Qingyun Sect is gone, it’s time for the Jiuyang Sect to shine!” He laughed.
As for the second part of the message, he had no objection to leaving Taiyang Peak.
Very soon, all the disciples on Taiyang Peak were relocated to another location. Jiang Ming landed on Taiyang Peak, followed by Linglong and her nine clones.
Immediately after, they came to a spatial node, a little globe of light between reality and illusion, below the Jiuyang Sect.
If they did not wield the True Illusion Dao or the Spatial Law, they wouldn’t be able to notice it.
“Let me do it!”
Spatial Linglong took a step forward and shattered the seal. The globe of light glowed brightly before turning into a door. She walked into it, followed by Jiang Ming and Linglong Five Elemental Linglong stayed outside to guard the surroundings.
As soon as he stepped into the door, Jiang Ming felt a strong pressure on him as well as an immense amount of violent aura in the air.
It was a spacious area.
The sky was blood red and the land was brown.
There were bones and corpses littered all over the space as well as divine light that seemed to be glowing for an eternity.
“Senior brother, upon reaching the Golden Immortal Realm, one would become impossible to be destroyed,” Linglong said as she enveloped Jiang Ming in a light barrier. She pointed at a dead body and continued, “That’s the corpse of a Golden Immortal. It should be indestructive, but it’s decaying and withering away. Do you know what happened, senior brother?”
“Is it being eroded by the blood and violent qi in this space?” Jiang Ming replied.
“Exactly! Although the Golden Immortal is indestructible, they can be eroded by many other powers or forces until they finally vanish into oblivion,” Linglong said, “In the land of inheritance, I’ve read a lot of books and scrolls so I know what is going on. This place should be the place where the great war happened 10,000 years ago. Many of these dead bodies are the Golden Immortals, which shows how great and cruel the war was.”
“How can a battlefield of this scale appear here?”
“There’s only one reason, senior brother. The original location where the great war happened was wrecked and it fell into the depths of space and time, merging into one of the spatial nodes of our world. Perhaps those great monarchs from the immortal worlds noticed it, so they sent immortals into our world, trying to seize control of the situation here. However, for some real Great Monarchs, they might not care about it since it’s just a ruin. Only those who’re in between will want to explore it. Perhaps there are some treasures here.”
As they were talking, they continued to move forward. What Linglong was talking about was nothing but her own speculation.
Suddenly, both of them stopped and looked at a stone monument beside them, and their eyes widened.
“The stone monument contains the supreme dao fluctuation that suppresses the spatial node that leads to the outside of this place,” Linglong said as she frowned, “Look, senior brother. There is a message on top of it. A divine monument sealing the ancient battlefield. Entering is allowed, but exit is prohibited. The one who left this message is Tianyuan Great Monarch.”
Linglong said, “Entering is allowed, but exit is prohibited. No wonder no one can come to disturb the Jiuyang Sect this whole time, so they have all been suppressed. Anyway, don’t worry, senior brother. I’ve checked it, and we can go out after coming.
“As for this Tianyuan Great Monarch…” Linglong continued, “Our world is known as the Tianyuan Continent, so could it be related to this guy?”
“I’ve been to the Tianyuan School, and Liu Changkong told me that the Tianyuan School was created by an immortal, so I guess it must be him. It truly surprises me to find that he has come here before in the past and suppressed the violent souls here to prevent them from escaping,” Jiang Ming said.
After they had finished studying the stone monument, they continued to move forward.
Spatial Linglong, who was standing at the front of the group, raised her hand and a ray of light beamed out of her finger. A soul then appeared from a broken jade on the ground in front of them and vanished into thin air.
“I can’t believe some of the souls are still here after such a long time. Unfortunately, they won’t have a good ending in such a place where evil energy fills the air!” Spatial Linglong said as she continued to move forward.
The land was barren and filled with many holes. They would come across a blood pool formed by the blood of the fallen experts from time to time. These pools were filled with so much evil energy that it even bred immensely powerful blood spirits that danced and screamed on the lake.
“These blood spirits are powerful. Their strength is on par with an Imminent Immortal expert. Unfortunately, they can’t leave the blood pool and they aren’t sentient.”
Spatial Linglong waved her hand and destroyed the blood pool.
At the same time, she was also collecting items that were still left intact.
Suddenly, Jiang Ming felt something in front of him and he was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - Ancient Immortal Battle Zone, Great Overarching Mountain River Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 198 Ancient Immortal Battle Zone, Great Overarching Mountain River Map
Wind was ravaging through the barren land.
He saw a white fog was rolling over, and it soon came close.
There were a lot of shadows inside the fog, but he couldn’t see them closely.
“Are they evil spirits, or souls, or Primal Spirits?” Jiang Ming asked. “They’re remnants of souls formed from evil energy and absorbing the endless essence that permeates this place. But they are weak and don’t pose any threat,” Linglong said, “However, looking at the scale, I’m afraid there will be more.”
Light-dark Linglong walked forward and lifted her finger. A light burst forth and the white fog dissipated without a single trace along with the evil spirits in it.
Throughout their journey, they came across a headless warrior, tree monster, or monster formed from a mountain. However, all of them were killed by them regardless of how strong or powerful they were.
There were many dangers in here, and even if an Imminent Immortal came in, they would be killed before they could go far.
Jiang Ming had collected a lot of immortal soldiers.
Suddenly, a strange phenomenon appeared before them.
It was a volcano. The flames spewed from inside reached 10,000 feet into the sky, lighting up the sky. Even though they were several thousand miles away, they still felt the terrible scorching heat.
There was a huge nest on the peak of the mountain, with dozens of fire crows circling above it. Each of the fire crow was comparable to a Heavenly Immortal Realm.
On the other side of the mountain was a lake that was as big as a sea. There was an island surrounded by mountains at the center of the lake, and within the center of the mountain was an ancient castle.
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes and he could vaguely see some shadows inside the castle.
“I sensed a powerful flame power over the volcano. I’m sure there’s a high-quality flame origin over there. Let me go have a look!” Phoenix Linglong said as she glanced at Linglong before turning her head to set her gaze at Jiang Ming. “Take care of yourself!” Jiang Ming said.
“Sigh…” Linglong sighed, “My clone cares more about you than me, senior brother.”
“Of course!” Spatial Linglong giggled, “Our senior brother can sleep with us. Can you?”
“Hmph? Seems like all of you need to be taught a lesson!” Linglong frowned and snarled.
CO
“Senior brother!” Spatial Linglong ran to take cover behind Jiang Ming. Pouting her mouth, she said, “Look at her. She scolded me again. You need to punish her.”
Jiang Ming was speechless. “Stop messing around, you guys. We’re in an area we’ve never been before, and we need to keep our guard up at all times.”
Bam…
An explosion came from the distance. All of them jerked their heads to the front and saw that Phoenix Linglong had already started slaying some fire crows. She controlled the power of the phoenix, and every single move of her was imbued with a supreme aura. She was naturally stronger than the fire crows, not to mention that her cultivation level was at a whole different level from them.
It took her only a few seconds to kill all of the fire crows. She then waved at Jiang Ming and jumped into the volcano.
“Senior brother, we two are going to check out the castle over there,” Spatial Linglong said, “I sense something ominous from there, so you two just stay here for a while.”
Time Linglong stepped forward.
Both of them decided to work together to explore the castle.
Jiang Ming nodded.
Swoosh!
Both of them then flew toward the castle.
“Senior brother, did you sense anything?” Linglong asked as she gazed at the castle.
Jiang Ming frowned. It was true that he could sense something over there, but he did not know what it was.
A divine light appeared from his eyes as he activated his Dharma Eyes.
A haze suddenly appeared in front of his eyes and he couldn’t see through it no matter how hard he tried.
In the meantime, Spatial and Time Linglong had arrived above the castle in the lake. Before they could come into the land, a horde of creatures rushed at them from below and started attacking them.
“What is going on? I can’t sense anything even though they’re fighting over there?” Jiang Ming asked, “Could it be that the castle is protected by some sort of formation?”
“No!” Linglong’s eyes glowed, “It should be an immortal weapon.”
“An immortal weapon?”
“Exactly! There are no strong people over there, and all of them are no match for Spatial Linglong. However, one of them is at the peak of the Mystical Immortal Realm. He wields a powerful ability, and he could fight on par with Spatial and Time Linglong. According to my experience, the lake as well as the entire area over there is brought into existence by an immortal weapon.”
“An immortal weapon huh…” Jiang Ming mumbled and he activated the World Projection to envelope the entire area.
At the same time, he activated the Universe Furnace, sending a shockwave across the Akasa. Then, he saw the surface of the lake begin to fold and the island began to turn blurry. It seemed like a painting that had fallen into the void.
He could also sense a terrifying power from inside.
“You’re right. It’s formed by an immortal weapon,” Jiang Ming said, his voice filled with surprise. “Are those creatures trapped in there by mistake, or are they sealed in there?” He squinted his eyes and zeroed in on one of them.
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record was opened. Name: Peng Fei.
Race: Golden-wing Eagle.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation Base: Level 13 (Mystical Immortal Realm).
Relationship: 0.
Innate Talent: Taiyi.
Status: Originally the royal prince of the Golden-wing Eagle race. He was incredibly talented, but brutal at the core. He once devoured three million living creatures as food and was sealed in the Mountain River Map, a Great Overarching Weapon. Several years later, a tremor was sent over the Mountain River Map, causing the mountains to collapse and rivers to overturn. It seemed like everything was on the verge of destruction, but it came to a stillness in the end. However, everything inside had become a mess. He tried to run away but to no avail.
After some time had passed, he noticed that the master of the Mountain River Map was gone. He was both excited and stunned. He tried to run away again, yet he failed. In the end, he tried to refine the immortal weapon.
As time passed, more and more creatures were coming into the map, and it was only then he realized the world outside was a ruin of a great war that had been forgotten in an unknown corner.
“The Mountain River Map huh. It’s a Great Overarching Weapon, but its owner died without any reason. Could it be that he was killed in the war? That’s why the Mountain River Map was left here and formed a space like this.”
When the thought surfaced in Jiang Ming’s, he poured more power into the Universal Furnace in an attempt to suppress the Mountain River Map.”
The difference between the grades of two immortal weapons was huge. However, since the Mountain River Map had lost its master, not to mention that it was damaged before, it only lasted for a while before it got crushed by the Universal Furnace.
“Senior brother, he’s already dead,” Linglong said, “When you were repressing the map, he lost his power, and both of them killed him. It’s just that they don’t know how to come out of the map. Do you have any idea, senior brother?”
“That is a Great Overarching Weapon, but it doesn’t have any master anymore. Tell both of them to refine it from the inside, while the rest of you do it from the outside. We’re going to make this immortal weapon ours!” Jiang Ming said.
Linglong nodded.
She flew away with the rest of the clones. They came to the middle of the air and sat in a lotus position. After that, they began activating their mana to refine the Mountain River Map.
Yin-Yang Linglong stayed on Jiang Ming’s side to protect him.
“Senior brother!”
“Yeah?”
“It’s just the two of us left here.”
“So?”
“I’m sure you know what I’m trying to say, senior brother.”
“Wh… What? Are you crazy? We can’t do it here.”
“Why not? Nobody is watching.”
“No means no! If you don’t stop now, I’m going to smack you.”
“Hehe, you want to smack me? Come, come! You can smack me all you want. Senior brother, why is your face so red? Could it be that you’re excited as well?”
“Stop teasing me!”
“Haha!”
Bam…
The volcano burst and a phoenix appeared from within. Its wings were so wide that they covered the entire sky.
Screech! The phoenix let out a cry before turning back to its human form and went back to Jiang Ming.
When she saw what Jiang Ming and Yin-Yang Linglong was doing, she harrumphed coldly, “Hmph! Shameless!”
Jiang Ming was now sitting on top of a rock. He seemed a little bit excited as he looked at Phoenix Linglong, who was dusting her clothes, and asked, “How do you feel?”
“Excellent!” Phoenix Linglong replied as she smiled at him. “I found my opportunity there, and guess what I found inside, senior brother.”
“It must be something related to fire. Since there are fire crows circling on top of the volcano, there must be a high-leveled creature inside. Could it be the three-legged golden crow?”
“Bingo, senior brother!” Phoenix Linglong exclaimed, “There is nothing but lava inside the volcano and at the bottom of it is the corpse of a three-legged golden crow in the Taiyi Immortal Realm. Unfortunately, it doesn’t have much origin essence left since it has been eroded by time and due to the existence of the fire crows. I refined the remaining sun’s true fire, and allowed my bloodline to evolve once again. I guess I’m one step closer into the Taiyi Realm.”
“It really is the three-legged golden crow!”
Jiang Ming then remembered one expert that he killed in the past. In the person’s status, he said that he had seen a great sun descending from the sun. Now that Jiang Ming thought about it, he was certain that the person must’ve seen the three-legged golden crow.
After all, the three-legged golden crow was otherwise known as the god of the sun.
Woosh!
Suddenly, a noise came from the area in front.
A painting appeared from thin air, and both Spatial and Time Linglongs came out of it.
“We did it!” Linglong had returned as well, her face filled with joy, “This is a Great Overarching Weapon. Although it’s broken, it’s still a very versatile and powerful item.”
“Not bad. I’ll be counting on you to protect our peak from now onward,” Jiang Ming said.
“Hah,” Linglong pouted, “In the past, I always said that I would protect you and guard Chuyang Peak, but what happened was that you were the one who did everything in the dark. Senior brother, you should take this map.”
“You keep it. I have other items to protect myself,” Jiang Ming replied as he shook his head. “You should put more effort in your training so that you can step into the Great Overarching Realm faster. Then, I can finally relax and enjoy the sun to my heart’s content.”
“Hehehe, then I’ll massage your back!”
“Hahaha! I’ll be looking forward to it!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Senior brother, you see, don’t you think this is a moment that is worth celebrating?” Linglong walked forward, followed by the eight clones.
“You’ve already had a lot of fun with Yin-Yang and Phoenix Linglong, so for the sake of fairness, you can’t forget about us too!”
After a long while, Linglong carried Jiang Ming and both of them traveled across the entire area. After they had collected all of the immortal weapons and spiritual medicines, they returned to the stone monument and went back to the Jiuyang Sect through the spatial node.
To be on the safe side, Linglong added another layer of seal outside.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming sat in the rattan chair and took a sip from his ginseng tea. “I’m sure I’d die in your hands one day.”
“Senior brother, I’ve decided. I must cultivate the pill making techniques so that I can make some pills for you to regulate your body,” Linglong blinked her eyes and chuckled, earning herself a glance from Jiang Ming.
“Senior brother!” Linglong squatted beside him and said seriously, “I don’t feel good about the series of events that happened some time ago. There’s no way the Heavenly Realm would let us go so easily after we’ve killed so many immortals and destroyed all of the Sacred Lands. Also, about the battlefield ruin beneath the Jiuyang Sect. I’m sure there will be other people coming for it to get the Mountain River Map. After all, it’s a Great Overarching Weapon. It’s going to be very dangerous after this, so I decided to go back to the inheritance space to keep on cultivating.”
“Go ahead!” Jiang Ming said, “No matter what is going on, making yourself stronger is never wrong.”
“What about you, senior brother? What are you going to do after I leave?”
“I’ll just do nothing!”
“Answer me seriously, senior brother!”
“I’m answering you seriously. There’s nothing I can do other than enjoying the sun.”
“Well, you’re right. Your situation is different. It isn’t very useful for you to cultivate in seclusion, so you can only enjoy the sun every day. Why don’t you go look for Xi Yao to keep you company?”
“Go ahead. When you come back next time, you will have a lot of nephews.”
“Hah, nothing happened after you slept with all 10 of us for so long, and you wish to impregnate Xi Yao? Don’t make me laugh, please, senior brother!”
“Are you looking for some beating?!” Jiang Ming snarled.
“Hehe, senior brother, wait for me. We’ll have 3,000 children together, and each of them can learn one Dao!” Linglong said as she activated the Heavenly Order.
She took the nine clones with her, and Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself but let out a chuckle.
He looked to the side and shouted, “Senior brother Chang, come out. Have you come out of your seclusion already?”
“Yeah,” Chang Yiming replied as he landed in front of Jiang Ming, “I didn’t want to disturb you two, so I didn’t show myself so soon. By the way, I have to admit that you’re really good at raising Linglong. Look at her. She has grown up to be such a mature and beautiful woman.”
“Watch your mouth! If she’s here, she would have crushed you!” Jiang Ming said.
A chill rushed down Chang Yiming’s spine as he looked around. After ascertaining that Linglong was not around, he let out a sigh and said gloomily, “Stop scaring me!”
“Hah! Come, let’s drink!”
Jiang Ming prepared some dishes and took out the wine that he brewed himself.
“Sure! I’ve been craving your food for a very long time!’ Chang Yiming said.
He had already stepped into the Nascent Soul Realm, and his cultivation speed had improved by leaps and bounds.
Right now, there were plenty of Nascent Soul experts in the sect, and there would be more in the future.
Both of them chatted with each other until night time.
Jiang Ming watched the sky and flipped through the Human Paths Record.
When he saw the “status” of Xue Tao, the Demon Lord, he nearly jumped up.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - Entering the Supreme Tower Once Again, Guanghui’s Sheng Qianyue
chapters.content:
Chapter 199 Entering the Supreme Tower Once Again, Guanghui’s Sheng Qianyue
Name: Xue Tao
Race: Blood Demon Race
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Demon Lord, Golden Immortal Realm).
Background: The third demon lord of Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm Demon World.
Relationship: -99.
Innate Talent: Golden Immortal.
Status: After the invasion had failed and the last remaining bloodline seed was killed, he learned from his mistake and decided to join forces with other demon lords.
He first approached the Ninth Demon Lord, and told him his plan. Then, they were joined by fifteen others. They put their target in the Tianyuan World. They looked at the surroundings for a long time before they stumbled upon a barren demon land.
All 16 demon lords then worked together to push the demon land toward the Tianyuan World. They were going to use the demon land to break the planes and destroy the origin force of the world to open the gate for them as well as to minimize the adverse effect
According to their calculation, there was one more year before the demon land would crush into the Tianyuan World.
Jiang Ming was furious.
‘How dare he join forces with another 15 demon lords to push a demon land and crush into the Tianyuan World? Is he going to destroy my world? I won’t forget you, Xue Tao. One day, when you fall into my hands, I’m going to give you a taste of all the torture methods in this world. Just you wait!’
Jiang Ming closed his eyes to calm himself down.
He noticed that Xue Tao’s innate talent had changed.
Xue Tao’s innate talent was the Golden Immortal, and he had already reached the Golden Immortal Realm. In other words, he had fully developed his potential, and had already reached his limit.
“Another 16 demon lords would come to my world in another year. When that happens, I’m afraid those immortals wouldn’t just sit by and watch. All hell would break loose, and there’s a huge probability that I can’t keep the situation under control with my current cultivation level. I might not even be able to protect myself. If that really happens…”
He would not care about it if he was alone. His junior sister was fully capable of protecting herself, but how about the Jiuyang Sect? How about the Eastern Region, and the rest of the world?
“I still have a few months left. The 20 years period is almost up, and I would be able to receive a ton of rewards at that time, but… what if none of it is useful in raising my cultivation level?”
Jiang Ming’s brain was spinning fast. He rose to his feet and began pacing back and forth on the rooftop.
He lifted his head and looked ahead. His clanmates were working hard in cultivation, and the people in the town were talking, smiling, laughing, bustling in and out of their houses.
“This world…”
JiangMing let out a bitter smile.
He did not care about what happened in the world outside. That was the reason why he did not make any move from the beginning when the catastrophe befell the Eastern Region.
But right now…
As he looked at this world, he did not want it to be destroyed. He did not want the people to live in despair, and he did not want his life to be disturbed.
“There’s still time left!” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed with determination.
When the sky had turned darker, he cast a seal around his courtyard and went into the Supreme Tower.
There was no better place to cultivate in seclusion than here.
He had not come here ever since he gathered with Dongfang Chenxi and the others that year.
It was still very spacious here, and there was no one to be seen.
He pulled out the Supreme Order and went into the chat room.
(Jiang Ming: Is there anyone here?]
(Ao Jiu: Yeah? I’m having some fun with a mermaid on a bed right now.]
[Zhan Ge: Holy. Ao Jiu, it truly surprises me that you haven’t been drained dry yet.)
[Niu Ben: It’s only after I entered this chat room that I noticed that Brother Jiu is better than me. I’ve never heard him getting out of his bed once. As you know, I’ve given birth to 800 children, and all of them could form into a huge clan already.)
[Zhan Ge: Jeez, Old Niu, that’s really impressive. Oh yeah, group admin, meet our new member. He’s from the Purple-eyed Demon Bull Clan of Bahuang Small Chiliocosm. He has been mutated, so he’s exceedingly powerful, and now we’ve discovered another great thing about him. He’s very good at propagating his bloodline.]
[Niu Ben: Nice to meet you, group admin. Well, I’m still inferior when compared to Brother Jiu. Unlike Brother Jiu, I can only sleep with 72 people at the same time, and I need to rest for half a month.]
[Ao Jiu: Hahaha, you’ve flattered me. Old Niu, I’ve decided. From now onward, I need to work harder and make more children. Who knows one of them would turn out to be a genius? At that time, I can just rest and let him do all the work.]
[Niu Ben: That’s a good idea. I should work harder as well. Brother Jiu, do you want to have a match?]
[Ao Jiu: You dare to challenge me? Alright then, I accept your challenge. My target is 10,000 dragons!]
[Zhan Ge: Both of you… I don’t have anything to say.)
[Luo Heng: Silently peer at the screen and look up with envy.[
(Sheng Qianyue: Shameless!)
[Ye Qingxian: Shameless!)
(Dongfang Chenxi: Shameless!)
(Sheng Qianyue: You’d better hope that you won’t run into me. If not, I’d purify all of you and turn you all into followers of the light.]
[Niu Ben: I’m so scared.]
[Ao Jiu: I’m so scared too.]
[Zhan Ge: Hehe! Group admin, Sheng Qianyue has just joined the chat room not long ago. She’s an angel from Guanghui Great Chiliocosm. Chenxi is from a great chiliocosm as well, but both of them have a very different background. Group admin, can you see the pattern here?]
(Jiang Ming: Another one from a great chiliocosm? According to what I know, great chiliocosm is the highest level. Every great chiliocosm has countless middle chiliocosms, small chiliocosms, and planar worlds under it, and together, they form into a universe.]
(Sheng Qianyue: Pleasure to meet you, group admin. I don’t know much about the differences between worlds. After all, I’m only 14. A portion of my abilities and special abilities are sealed, so my cultivation level is only at level 10.)
(Jiang Ming: You’re only 14, and you’re already at level 10?]
Jiang Ming was shocked.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record opened up.
Name: Sheng Qianyue.
Race: Holy Angel.
Gender: Female.
Cultivation Level: Level 10.
Background: Daughter of the Saint Lord from Guanghui Great Chiliocosm.
Relationship: 81.
Innate Talent: Great Overarching (Innate Holy Light).
Status: She was the first ray of light that was born from the Dao square opened by the Saint Lord to transform a world. She attained intelligence after fusing the angelic emperor’s heart.
Even so, she achieved level 10 in cultivation at the age of 10. She was bestowed with the Supreme Order and came to the Supreme Tower to cultivate.
Jiang Ming was astounded after he read her “status.”
‘Another Great Overarching? Not only that, but she’s even more terrifying than Chan Xin. The Saint Lord activates a Dao square to transform a world? The Saint Lord huh… Could she be a saint? She’s a ray of light that has attained intelligence after fusing with the angelic emperor’s heart. Chenxi’s Supreme Order is given to her by her father, but this fellow here is bestowed with the order…’
Jiang Ming looked into the sky speechlessly.
She had attained level 10 in cultivation at the age of 10, and it was under the condition that most of her power and special abilities were sealed away. Therefore, he could imagine how powerful she really was when all of the seals were lifted, and it was also only now that he understood the things Jun Sanqian told him at that time. Even though he was a genius in his world, he was nothing but a speck of dust in the vast universe. Although he was at the top tier in terms of combat prowess, he was only at a mediocre level among the top ones.
What surprised him the most was that this girl came from a great chiliocosm world.
The chat room fell silent for a moment before Dongfang Chenxi said something, shattering the silence.
(Dongfang Chenxi: That’s impressive, Sister Qianyue! Brother Jiang, I only know of Xuanhuang World. It’s the only world that dominates all other worlds, and it’s the only great chiliocosm that I’ve ever known. If Sister Qianyue comes from a great chiliocosm, according to what my father has told me, there is only one explanation. Sister Qianyue and I are not in the same universe.]
(Sheng Qianyue: The Saint Lord has told me before that she’s one of the strongest amongst the God Realm, and beyond the God Realm is nothing but an endless chaos.]
The chat room fell into silence once again.
[Ao Jiu: Why do we have to care about these? We are all small shrimps who haven’t jumped out of the cage. We should savor the moment and work hard to cultivate. That’s what we need to do.)
(Zhan Ge: Although I’m surprised and I’d like to explore different worlds, Ao Jiu is right. We’re too weak. We’re nothing but a speck of dust in the vast universe, and there’s no point in exploring it. Right now, what we should do is improve our cultivation level. Oh yeah, group admin, do you know that Ming Fei, Tian Fozi, and Zi Lei have broken through the tenth level and left the chat group? I don’t know if they can just get into a higher level group, so I really hope to see each other again in the future. Sigh, I’m starting to miss Wang Ye and Feng Wu. I wonder where they are now.]
(Ao Jiu: I miss them too. I joined the chat room earlier than them, but they’ve already left.]
[Zhan Ge: You should feel ashamed of yourself. They’re working tirelessly in their cultivation, but you just spend your days in bed, having fun with different women.)
(Ao Jiu: You’re right. I shouldn’t keep on like this anymore. I need to work harder. I want to become the group admin of a higher level chat room! At that time, I’ll protect all of you!] [Zhan Ge: Hah, I don’t think you’d be able to do that.)
There were not many people in the chat room, but it was lively.
Then, another person came into the Supreme Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - Quasi-Sage, Inner World Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 200 Quasi-Sage, Inner World Limit
Jiang Ming’s heart trembled, and one person appeared beside him.
She had a fine physique, and her body was glowing with a divine light. She looked just like a little angel who just came to the mortal world.
“I knew you’re here!”
That person was none other than Dongfang Chenxi. As soon as she saw Jiang Ming, she ran toward him with a bright smile etching on her face.
“I’m going to cultivate here, so I thought I should let you guys know,” Jiang Ming replied, offering her a smile, “How is your cultivation going?”
He waved his hand and a couch appeared next to him. He gestured her to sit down, and brew her a cup of tea.
“It’s going great, but I’m not sure how long it’s going to take for me to make a further breakthrough!” Dongfang Chenxi said as she took a sip from the tea. “But luckily, once my inner world becomes a planar world, I would have the combat prowess of a Golden Immortal. If it takes a step forward and becomes a small chiliocosm, I would be as strong as a Taiyi Realm, but…” She paused midway through her sentence.
“What’s wrong?” Jiang Ming asked.
“My father told me that this will be a very tough path. The advantage is that I don’t need to go into seclusion always for cultivation,” Dongfang Chenxi replied before lifting her head to look at Jiang Ming, “I’m sorry, Brother Jiang. This is nothing personal.”
“Haha…” Jiang Ming laughed, “Why are you apologizing to me? You’ve done nothing wrong. Besides, I’m not afraid of failing either.”
“You’re so optimistic, Brother Jiang,” DongfangChenxi chuckled, “Honestly, only those who have a big background would take on the path of evolving their inner worlds and most of them are able to evolve their inner worlds into the perfect planar world level.Once they’ve reached this point, only one out a hundred will be able to break through, and the time consumed will be measured in millions of years. After reaching the small chiliocosm, and if you would like to advance into the middle chiliocosm, for now, my father has only heard of one person who’s achieved it.”
Jiang Ming was stunned. However, he soon came around to his senses and asked, “What is your father’s cultivation level?”
“Level 10. He’s a Quasi-sage.”
“Quasi-sage?”
“That’s right!”
“Terrific!” Jiang Ming was taken aback, and at the same time, his heart sank.
Even a quasi-sage level expert had only heard of one person who took on the path of evolving the inner world into the middle chiliocosm. Jiang Ming did not know why, but he found it unbelievable.
‘Hold on a second. If he has only heard of it, then it must not be in the great chiliocosm he’s residing in… So…’
Jiang Ming sucked in air sharply through his teeth.
“Why is it so hard?” He calmed himself down and asked again.
“That’s because it needs plenty of time and resources,” Dongfang Chenxi said, “Anyway, don’t worry too much, Brother Jiang. My father said that someone like you from the mortal world must have been blessed with fortune to have taken on such a path. Therefore, you’ll certainly be able to achieve something great in the future.”
‘Well, she’s right. I have a system, the Human Paths Record, and the Supreme Tower.’
Besides, his junior sister had formed nine clones for him, and she had gotten the inheritance from the Heavenly Venerate.
If this was not blessed with fortune, then he did not know what it could be.
However, after listening to the answers Dongfang Chenxi gave him regarding his questions, his heart was sinking lower and lower.
Apparently, Dongfang Chenxi had a deep knowledge about evolving the inner world.
The evolution of the inner world was the combination of the process of creation, the diffusion of laws, and the growing of the origin, and this required an enormous amount of time.
Jiang Ming was very well aware of this.
If he had enough resources, growing the origin was like a walk in the park. However, he couldn’t just focus on growing the origin only. After all, if the origin was the foundation, then the process of creation and the formation of laws were equally important.
If the formation of laws was incomplete and the frame of the world was underdeveloped, it would be difficult for him to break through. However, this process required a lot of time.
Once his inner world had become a planar world, there were two ways to advance into the next level.
One was to reach the limit, triggering a quantitative change and a leap into the small chiliocosm.Second was to comprehend 3,000 laws or Heavenly Immortal Law.
However, both routes were hard.
Jiang Ming was getting more and more lost after he talked to Dognfang Chenxi.
He thought he just needed to keep on growing his origin essence, but it now seemed to him that he was wrong.
“The only good thing is that you’ll have an unparalleled combat prowess and it would be easy for you to kill someone who’s a lot stronger than you,” Dongfang Chenxi said, “This cultivation method suits me the best, but Brother Jiang, if you need any help, just let me know. I have a lot of resources over there, and I’ll certainly help you.”
“That’s not necessary,” Jiang Ming rejected as he shook his head, “You’ve helped me too much.”
“It’s fine. You don’t have to feel embarrassed at all,” Dongfang Chenxi replied with a pout.
“I’m going to sleep here for a while and try my best to evolve my inner world to its peak. If I really can’t break through, I’ll let you know and beg you for your help!”
“You don’t have to beg me, Brother Jiang. I’ll help you no matter what! You just need to let me know!”
“Okay, okay.”
After they had finished their conversation, Jiang Ming came to the Million Dao Chart. He sat down and began to obtain the special abilities.
A white mist slowly appeared around him and enveloped him whole in its white veil.
DongFang Chenxi looked at Jiang Ming with a complicated expression on her face. In the end, she left the Supreme Tower and went back to the real world.
Time was fluttering slowly, and Jiang Ming had no idea how long it had passed.
Jiang Ming had gained multiple special abilities and he opened his eyes to let out a sigh.
A hundred year had passed, but his inner world did not grow into the size he had imagined in the first place despite the fact that he had absorbed countless Xuanhuang Origin Essence and his origin had grown to an unimaginable proportions.
Although the formation of laws and the process of creation were still very slow, they indeed had become a lot faster than they were in the past.
“Well, I guess I should take a nap!”
In
Jiang Ming leaned on the side and fell into a slumber.
Time flew and many years had passed.
Suddenly, he cracked his eyes open one day and he seemed a little bit confused.
It took him quite a while before he finally regained his composure.
“It seems like I’ve slept for too long!” Jiang Ming smiled bitterly.
It was only now he truly realized how scary it was to take on the inner world path. The time consumed would drive one crazy.
In order to kill the endless time, he could only force himself to sleep.
He fell into a thought and formed a clone in his inner world.
He stood above the sky and looked into the distance.
The sky was high and there was nothing but a green wilderness in his vision. The mountains were
Compared to the last time, his inner world had become much more complete.
“I’m the master of everything here.”
Jiang Ming closed his eyes, and all things came to his mind. He was able to manipulate everything here, or even create something out of thin air.
He landed beside a river, and a fish leaped out of the river. It drew a perfect arc in the air before falling back into the water.
Next to the river, a deer was drinking water. When it saw him, it quickly ran away.
“These are the creatures that I created,” Jiang Ming mumbled.
He stuck his hand into the water and grabbed a fish. He studied the fist meticulously and he noticed that it was nothing different from the fish outside.
“The World Dao, in a sense, is the Creation Dao,” Jiang Ming said as he returned to the Supreme Tower.
He opened up his status in the Supreme Tower and glanced through it.
Name: Jiang Ming.
Cultivation Base: Level 10.
Accumulated Points: 58,664 (22,109 + 36, 555) 8th Floor honor: Heavenly Stage (10 stages), 36,555 supreme-grade special abil;ities.
He had a total of 58,664 points right now.
“I believe I can earn more points this time,” Jiang Ming said, “Would the owner of the Supreme Tower think of such a situation?”
He looked at the Heavenly Battle Stage before turning his head and fixed his gaze on the Heavenly Ladder.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - Slapping Jiang Ming In the Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 201 Slapping Jiang Ming In the Face
Jiang Ming headed toward the Heavenly Ladder and climbed onto it.
As soon as his feet fell on the first step, his mind was ambushed by an attack that was on the True Immortal Realm. For every step he took, the attack would become stronger. By the time he reached the ninth level, the attack was at the True Immortal Realm.
However, he remained steadfast, unaffected by the attack. He continued to climb the ladder without stopping. Very soon, he arrived at the 18th level, and the attack on his mind was on the level of Mystical Immortal Realm.
Although he felt pressured, he could handle the attack.
“I’m expecting Golden Immortal’s level attack on the next level, but I’m sure I can get through it without fail! It’s just that I wonder where my limit is? My inner world has successfully evolved into a perfect planar world, and my vast origin force is equivalent to that of the peak of the Golden Immortal Realm. Perhaps I should try challenging the oppression from the Taiyi Realm.”
With that thought in mind, Jiang Ming stepped on the 19th level.
As soon as he stepped on the 11th level, a black spot appeared in his mind. It rapidly expanded and turned into an immense black hole, swirling and devouring his mind and will.
Jiang Ming was stunned, but he soon came around to his senses.
“Don’t you dare look down on me! Great Protection Technique, the Radiance of Heart!”
Jiang Ming activated a skill to protect his mind and willpower, yet he was still unable to stop the terrifying suction force of the black hole.
On the outside, his body was shaking and his face was pale as a sheet of paper. There were cold sweats beading on his forehead, and in a blink of an eye, his vision turned black and he fell down.
“How is that possible?”.
He lifted his head to look upward with an incredulous expression on his face.
He thought he was able to pass the test effortlessly, but it turned out that he was wrong. “This is strange!”
Jiang Ming did not know what went wrong. After all, he could feel that his willpower was much stronger than the force of the black hole.
He sat down and took a short break. After that, he stepped onto the Heavenly Ladder once again with full confidence that he was able to conquer the 19th level this time, but little did he expect that he would fail at the 19th level again.
‘What is going on? Could it be that the Golden Immortal Realm is different?’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly, ‘No, I have to find out why.’
He took a deep breath to calm himself before coming to the Heavenly Battle Stage. He came to the first stage, and he was paired up against a Heavenly Immortal expert. Without a doubt, his opponent this time was none other than Jun Sanqian.
“Wow, impressive. Your inner world has evolved into a perfect planar world,” Jun Sanqian said after he studied Jiang Ming from head to toe. “Although your inner world has granted you extraordinary combat prowess, there is one downside and it’s very difficult to ascend into the next level. Of course, there’s one benefit as well. Once you step into a certain level of the world, you can keep improving until you reach your limit. You’re at your limit now, and if you want to break through it, you’ll need some opportunities.
“That being said, you can consider yourself very lucky. You have… Hahaha! I wouldn’t say it’s a bad idea…. Well, you know what? It’s actually a brilliant idea. Maybe you’re the only person in this universe who can evolve your inner world to the great chiliocosm,” Jun Sanqian said, laughing loudly at the same time.
Jiang Ming lifted his eyebrows as a thought surfaced in his head.
‘Could it be that he knows what I’ve been doing with the Reincarnation Hall? If that’s the case, then Jun Sanqian might be someone of great consequences, and the background of the Supreme Tower might be beyond imagination.’
“Thank you for your suggestion, senior,” Jiang Ming replied, “Senior, I have a question, and I hope you can give me an answer for it. My inner world has evolved into a perfect planar world, so by right, I should’ve mastered the power of the Golden Immortal Realm, but why couldn’t I defend myself against the mind attack of the Golden Immortal Realm?”
“Well, you’ve already answered your question yourself. You said ‘should’ve,’ right?” Jun Sanqian clasped his hand behind his back, sat in the air, and answered patiently, “The Golden Immortal Realm is a special realm for all of the cultivation methods including immortal, divine, necromantic, spiritual, demonic, combat, killing, and soul.
“Gold will never decay. Once you’ve reached the Golden Immortal Realm, regardless of your body or Primal Spirit, they won’t decay. An immortal will die eventually. However, a golden immortal could be freed from the shackles of life and live for an eternity. They won’t need to go through any tribulation, and they can go on with their lives without any worries.
“Although there’s only one level difference between a level 13 Mystical Immortal and a level 14 Golden Immortal, the latter is on a whole different level compared to the former. For example, level 10 is just a mortal, but a level 11 is an immortal.
“Even though you pick the path of improving your inner world, and your origin force is as massive as that of the Golden Immortal Realm, there’s still a fundamental difference between both.
“You don’t have the Dao, the immortality, the special abilities, and the willpower of a Golden Immortal.
“If we’re looking at the quantity, it’s without a doubt that you’re there, but in terms of quality, it’s so much worse.
“The changes of quantity cause the changes of quality, but yours is like a plate of loose sand that scatters all over the place, so how is there any possibility you can withstand a mental attack of a Golden Immortal? The attacks here are measured by the standard of the geniuses across the universe.
“You might be able to do it outside, but here, it’s impossible.”
Jun Sanqian explained everything in detail to Jiang Ming.
“Does this mean that I have the combat prowess of a Golden Immortal?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Exactly,” Jun Sanqian smiled, “You want to ask why you’d fail the Heavenly Ladder so quickly, right?”
When he saw Jiang Ming nodding, he continued, “The reason is simple. Have you ever trained your willpower?”
Jiang Ming was stunned.
“Have you participated in a great war before?” Jun Sanqian continued, “Have you been in a life-or-death situation before? No,
right?”
Jiang Ming smiled bitterly, “You’re right. I’ve been sleeping here for a very long time in order to evolve my inner world.”
“See?” Jun Sanqian smiled. He lifted his finger and an ocean appeared before his vision. The waves were large and ran high. Afterward, the ocean began to shrink and change until it became a droplet of water.
“Essentially, there is no difference between an ocean and this drop of water,” Jun Sanqian said, “An ocean can, at most, flood the land, but this drop of water can destroy the world. Can you understand now?”
It went without saying that Jiang Ming could understand what he was trying to say.
What Jun Sanqian was trying to say was that he was outwardly strong, but in truth, he was weak.
“Not only your willpower, but it can also be applied to your special abilities and other techniques as well. Anyway, are you ready for a fight now?” Jun Sanqian asked as he rose to his feet.
“Sure!”
Jiang Ming charged toward Jun Sanqian, but he did not kill him right away.
While they were fighting, he was honing his skills as well. In the end, he defeated Jun Sanqian and went on to the next stage.
When he arrived at the fourth stage, he was going up against two Heavenly Immortal experts.
The seventh stage was a True Immortal expert, while the tenth stage was a Mystical Immortal Expert.
He defeated all of them with practised ease and came to the 13th stage.
Without any surprise, his opponent this time was Jun Sanqian. He looked at Jiang Ming and laughed, “I’m a Golden Immortal expert, but judging from your previous performance, it might not be that easy to beat me. Come, young man, make your move!”
“Here I come, senior!” Jiang Ming bowed at him and activated his World Projection. Then, he brandished his sword and cast the Grand World Dharma.
