The Grand World Dharma was a skill he developed after fusing spatial and time Dao. With a swipe of his sword, he could freeze time and space, and it was the strongest restriction technique he had ever developed.
However, Jun Sanqian was able to break himself free without any difficulty. At the same time, he said, “This is still a Dao belonging to the mortal world. Although it’s a fusion of space and time, it’s too primitive, and it won’t have any effect on an expert like me!
“You have great power, but your level is too low. If you want to defeat me, you might stand a chance if you use your Return of Infinite Law Finger. Other than that, it’s useless.
“You have a massive amount of mana and your origin is as vast as a sea. When you’re fighting against an expert like me, you can only try to overwhelm me with force. If you think you can defeat me with your special abilities, there’s only one ending for you, dead!
“After all, I can crush and neutralize all of your special abilities without any problem,” Jun Sanqian said.
Jiang Ming nodded and activated the Sky Shattering Sword Technique, and the Return of Infinite Law Finger. However, he still couldn’t defeat Jun Sanqian.
In the end, he had no other choices but to use his Unlimited Killing Punch. That being said, the result was the same.
He couldn’t defeat Jun Sanqian. After a long while, he was stabbed through his forehead by Jun Sandian.
Not long after, Jiang Ming came to the 13th stage and asked for guidance from Jun Sanqian.
He wanted to know what he should do right now to improve himself. After all, his inner world had reached its limit, and it was too difficult and hard to advance in a short period of time.
Jun Sanqian suggested that he should cultivate the Heavenly Immortal Law.
In the immortal realm, each level corresponded to a different law and different Dao Fruition.
Another way was to train his willpower as well as the Return of Infinite Law Finger. At the same time, he also suggested to him that he should come to the Heavenly Battle Stage more often to hone his skills as well as to gain knowledge of the higher sword techniques.
“In other words, I just need to cultivate one out of the 3,000 laws and I could enter the Heavenly Immortal Realm. But…”
Jiang Ming hesitated.
Once he stepped into the Heavenly Immortal Realm, did that not mean that he had to leave his sect?
However, he was soon relieved when he thought of the function of the Human Paths Record.
Since the Human Paths Record was able to prevent the Reincarnation Hall and the Lord God Space from forcibly sending their beneficiaries back, he was certain that it would be able to do something about his condition to avoid him from getting rejected by his world.
Ascension?
He had never thought of it before.
He was the strongest in the mortal world, but once he ascended, he would become nothing but a small fry. Why should he aggravate himself? It was not like he could not become even stronger anymore.
“Time is heard. I should pick space instead, and reach the Golden Immortal Realm directly!”
After Jiang Ming had made up his mind, he told his thoughts to Jun Sanqian. Jun Sandian shook his head and said, “You take on the path of evolving your inner world, so you just need to work on developing the laws in your inner world and it would reflect on your body. Similarly, the Dao you learned outside would also be reflected on your inner world too. Once a certain Dao becomes too powerful, it’ll tilt the balance of the inner world, mess up the process of creation. In the end, your inner world might even collapse.”
“What?” Jiang Ming was shocked, “Something like that could happen also?”
“Haha, of course!” Jun Sanqian laughed, “Both dangers and opportunities exist on the path to become immortal. One step wrong, you will be destroyed. Therefore, you need to be extra careful. Your inner world has reached the limit, but it’s too difficult and it would take a lot of time to become a small chiliocosm.
“However, you can cultivate the 3,000 Heavenly Immortal Laws. Once you’ve learned all of them, it’ll naturally drive the changes of your origin and the world will evolve. Of course, you don’t need to learn all of the 3,000 Heavenly Immortal Laws. You only need to comprehend the basic laws that build the world, and then push the inner world laws to diffuse themselves and gradually transform.
“In fact, it would be faster for you to directly comprehend the 3,000 Heavenly Immortal Laws instead. After all, you have enough foundation, so it shouldn’t be a problem for you, and this place is the best spot for cultivation. Besides, you’re not lacking in points too.
“No one is more suitable than you to cultivate the World Dao,” Jun Sanqian lamented.
“Thank you for your guidance, senior. If it hadn’t been for you, things would’ve gone badly,” Jiang Ming said.
He was truly grateful to Jun Sanqian.
Although he had the system as well as the Human Paths Record, no one could give him any guidance in cultivation.
Dongfang Chenxi had given him a lot of help, but she did not know many things.
After he left the Heavenly Battle Stage, he stepped on the Heavenly Ladder to train his willpower.
After that, he came to the Heavenly Monument on the left side of the square and began to study the Heavenly Immortal Dao.
The Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra had become different as well.
In front of the Wood Heavenly Monument.
After roughly an hour, a surge of energy erupted from Jiang Ming. It was the energy of the Heavenly Immortal Law.
At this moment, the trees, vines, and seagrasses in his inner world began to grow at a rapid pace.
In the meantime, the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, which had been silent for a long time, finally started to react and Jiang Ming’s soul was transforming.
His body was undergoing a transformation at this moment. In comparison, the transformation on his body was the most intense and had the greatest magnitude of improvement.
“Although the origin of the inner world didn’t improve much, after entering the Heavenly Immortal Realm, my combat prowess has improved by leaps and bounds!” Jiang Ming was beyond excited.
It was true that his combat prowess had improved by leaps and bounds, but he also noticed something. The Astral Formation had lost its effect.
The Astral Formation was a special ability of the mortal world. However, he had become immortal, so the Astral Formation would work on him anymore.
Heavenly Monument, Heavenly Ladder, Heavenly Battle Stage, and Million Dao Chart.
Jiang Ming kept rotating in these four places, and his strength kept improving.
People were coming into the Supreme Tower from time to time. However, other than Zhan Ge and the others, he did not care about the rest.
Time was passing slowly.
If he was outside right now, a lot of time must have passed, but time did not work here in the Supreme Tower.
On the Heavenly Ladder, Jiang Ming stood on the 27th level.
His body shook, but he did not fall down, and this meant that he had passed the test.
Jiang Ming did not continue the Heavenly Ladder. He went to the Heavenly Battle Stages and fought with Jun Sanqian for three days and three nights. One day, he seized the chance and pierced Jun Sanqian’s forehead.
On the 13th stage, he was defeated by Jun Sanqian again, who was at the early stage of the Golden Immortal Realm.
“I guess it’s time for me to go out. If I stay here any longer, I’ll become crazy.”
He had cultivated in seclusion for too long.
Although he was very spirited, his mind and heart were exhausted.
He figured that he needed to take a good rest.
Just when he was about to leave, he suddenly thought of something and he froze.
“I’ve stepped into the Heavenly Immortal Realm, how come I’m still stuck at this level?”

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - The 20 Years Period is up
chapters.content:
Chapter 202 The 20 Years Period is up
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 10 (Level 11)
Points Accumulated: 90354 Points
Level 8’s Honor: 12 stages record, 18 levels record. 36555 units of special ability.
Jiang Ming was startled looking at his result.
The result which he created after he broke through to Heavenly Immortal Realm: 13 stages record and 18 levels record, was obviously not included. However, his accumulated points were up to about 90 thousand.
This was a surprising number indeed.
Having questions in mind, Jiang Ming went to the heaven battle stage to inquire Jun Sanqian.
“This level is quite special. You can remain here if you have your breakthrough here. But your result is not counted anymore. Once you leave, you will be taken to the next level upon reentering. Therefore, this is considered the last benefit you can earn from the preliminary stage,” Jun Sanqian explained.
“Benefit?” Jiang Ming was surprised. Meanwhile, he made some assumptions himself.
Jun Sanqian smiled as he disclosed, “There’s also a Chat Room in the higher level but the Group Admin changes quite often. Therefore, it’s easier to become a Group Admin while you’re at lower realms than higher realms.” He made a pause before he added while giving Jiang Ming a meaningful glance, “Here, you can see it as a beginner stage.”
Jiang Ming stopped questioning further. Instead, he bowed respectfully three times at Jun Sainqian before he returned to the public square.
He pondered for a while and decided to sleep because he needed a rest.
When he woke up, he saw three people: Luo Heng, Ye Qingxian and Dongfang Chenxi.
“Brother, you’ve finally woken up! I’ve waited for you here for about 10 days already.” Dongfang Chenxi ran over delightedly.
“I haven’t had enough sleep for a long time, so I allowed myself to take a good rest. By the way, why are the three of you here?” Jiang Ming asked as he took a glass of wine from Luo Heng.
“I’m preparing for a breakthrough, a breakthrough to level 11. When we heard Chenxi say that you’re here, we came to meet you.” Luo Heng laughed.
“So fast?” Jiang Ming blurted, astonished.
Luo Heng felt speechless at Jiang Ming’s response but he still explained patiently, “Didn’t you know how long you’ve been here? Although there’s a time gap among different worlds and the time here is also absurd, in my world, 100 years have passed.”
“Mine too! Brother Jiang, we’re going to have a better cultivation base than yours this time!” Ye Qingxian said.
“I’m already at level 11!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“How’s it possible?” Luo Heng was surprised. He knew Jiang Ming would not lie but he hesitated, “Is it that we’re able to stay here even after our breakthrough?”
“There’s such a thing? Can it be that it’s the final hidden benefit for a mortal before his transition to the immortal?” Ye Qingxian was surprised too.
Jiang Ming laughed in response.
“Brother, you’re so amazing! Choosing this path means you’d need boundless time to accumulate yet you’ve already had a breakthrough.” Dongfang Chenxi was even more amazed.
“It’s not that type of breakthrough you have in mind. I’m considered to have entered level 11 because I managed to comprehend a Heavenly Immortal Law. And I’m not sure when I will have my real breakthrough though.” Jiang Ming clarified.
“This is normal then. But this is indeed extraordinary. I’ve decided to get my father to conjure a time formation upon return and I’ll seal my memory to have a good sleep within it.” Dongfang Chenxi said decisively.
Dongfang Chenxi’s words rendered everyone speechless.
As they were chatting, they sat down around a table.
Luo Heng took out a great amount of food as he said, “These are what I purposely prepared. I searched the entire universe for scrumptious food and got many talented chefs to cook. Come, let’s try how they taste.”
“I’m so envious of your universe, Luo Heng. What a gigantic universe that nurtures countless unique creatures, and has incredibly flourishing materials.” Ye Qingxian exclaimed.
“Agree, I have always been envious of Brother Luo. All games, movies, and novels are indeed awe-inspiring. There is no better way to pass time than these.” Dongfang Chenxi said as she smiled.
Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian were left speechless. They were busy cultivating, exploring encounters in order to grow all these while. Yet this little girl here was so free that they became envious of her.
Jiang Ming only laughed. He would have been very if not because of the Devil King Xue Tao’s plot.
Such a gathering lasted for three whole days before it ended.
Both Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian did not leave as they planned to prepare for their breakthrough here.
Meanwhile, Dongfang Chenxi decided to return to her world after a rather long ponder. She said she would fall into a deep sleep to have her inner world evolved to its pinnacle.
As Jiang Ming had completely recovered to his best self, he went back to the life of comprehending Million Dao Chart and Heavenly Monuments as well as challenging heaven battle stage and heavenly ladder.
In the meantime, Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian had a breakthrough one after another, and left.
Time passed unknowingly as Jiang Ming cultivated whole-heartedly.
His special abilities, wills, Heavenly Immortal Laws etc, were improving at an incredible speed.
When he climbed the heavenly ladder again, he managed to step stably on level 28.
As he had successfully resisted the will attack of a Taiyi Golden Immortal expert on level 28, he had his mind and will level akin to a Taiyi Golden Immortal’s.
In fact, he did not stop there but went on. He fell only when he had reached level 31.
And he was extremely ecstatic at his personal achievement.
Though the Golden Immortal and Taiyi were just a level different, the difference was absolutely tremendous. What’s more his Taiyi’s will was beyond average.
‘It’s time for the heaven battle stage!’
Jiang Ming got to the 15th stage directly because he had passed the 14th.
“A human’s potential is infinite. In fact, you’ve gone beyond your potential. When you first came here, the will attack you could resist was the Golden Immortal’s. But now, you manage to resist Taiyi’s. This is incredible!” Jun Sanqian said with a tinge of emotion.
“If it wasn’t without your advice, I won’t be able to reach this level regardless. Senior, can you see the world where I’m from?” Jiang Ming said sincerely.
“Don’t ask, my answer would be ‘I don’t know if you insist on asking,” Jun Sanqian replied with a smile.
This rendered Jiang Ming speechless.
Nevertheless, he understood that Jun Sanqian had given him two answers with his words: first, Jun Sanqian could see it; and second, Jun Sanqian knew what Jiang Ming wanted to ask.
“Can the Supreme Order resist the attack of a Golden Immortal expert and above?” Jiang Ming could not help but ask because he needed an assurance.
“You, living in a mortal world, shall act according to its rules. Within the rules, it’s your fate whether to live or die; outside the rules, the Supreme Order is a symbol of status.” Jun Sanqian did not reply directly but he talked about the rules instead.
Yet Jiang Ming got what Jun Sanqian meant. Jun Sanqian meant that provided the matter went against the rules, the Supreme Order would naturally act accordingly.
Jiang Ming again bowed respectfully before he launched his attack. “Time and Space Confinement!” Jiang Ming evoked the fusion of space and time laws, which he deduced from Heavenly Immortal Dao, based on his inner world’s core. It was at least 1,000 times stronger than that time.
Its terrifying and unusual power froze the space and stopped the time, forming a confinement that confined all things, except Jun Sanqian.
Jun Sanqian did not rush to evoke his best technique for he intended to chasten Jiang Ming.
Though they were standing on a stage, Jiang Ming transformed it into a universe. The aftermath of the battle swept over a distance of 10,000 miles, extraordinarily terrifying.
Jiang Ming even evoked various incredibly terrific special abilities such as the Five Elemental Divine Fists, Five Elemental Marquee, Five Elemental Great Grinder, and Five Elemental Reverse Strangulation Technique he deduced from the Great Five Elemental Technique as well as other special abilities such as Great Yin-Yang Technique, Great Destructive Technique etc.
These were the special abilities Jiang Ming deduced again after he stepped into the Heavenly Immortal Realm. Hence, a lot stronger than before.
Nevertheless, these special abilities were not strong enough to hit against Jun Sanqian.
“Great Manifestation Technique!”
From within Jiang Ming spurted out streams of air as he conjured Five Elemental Clone, Yin-Yang Clone, Light-and-Dark Clone, True Illusion Clone, Karma Clone, among many. “Great World Destructive Technique!”
In a short while, all his clones formed a great formation and built a world which abruptly collapsed so that all forces produced would further sublimate into a terrific destructive force.
Jun Sanqian counteracted by producing a sword’s defense as he wielded his sword, emitting layers of sword qi. His Sword Dao was unpredictably powerful. He could cast millions of laws with a mere sword in his hand. Nonetheless, he failed to resist Jiang Ming’s attack, rendering him looking rather miserable.
“Not bad, not bad. You do improve greatly in each of our battles. Your ability to deduce the world’s destructive technique based on your inner world, and conjure a mighty one with only your clones, at minimum cost. This is awesome!” Jun Sanqian exclaimed before he added, “Let’s continue!”
“Sure!” Jiang Ming was getting more fierceful as he fought.
It was within his expectation that he would fail to hit against Jun Sanqian even after he evoked thousands of special abilities. In fact, he was merely testing all his special abilities he had cultivated because he knew only a few could threaten Jun Sanqian.
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!” As Jiang Ming leapt into the midair, he emitted boundless immortal rays of laws, which fused at his finger tip. He pointed at Jun Sanqian, sending out the ray of light towards Jun Sanqian as he said, “In this finger alone, I’ve fused the forces of 365 Heavenly Immortal Laws!”
Boom!
The finger collapsed the space, reversed the time, exterminated all things and laws, rendering the area into a ruin.
“Fusing infinite laws into one, kid, this is amazing!” Jun Sanqian howled, “I’ve got a sword that can bury heaven and earth, and destroy all living beings into ruin! A slay turns all things into ruin, ending an era.”
On the long sword radiating aura of wither, decay, destruction, curses, death, bloodshed, and other horrific aura.
Such an aura could instantly withered a Heavenly Immortal’s Primal Spirit, and collapse a True Immortal’s physique because it was simply too strong.
These aura layers were the one which resisted Jiang Ming’s finger, but still his arm was blasted into a bloody and holely arm. Jun Sanqian appeared to be miserable.
“Indeed a great Infinite Law of Finger, a great special ability. If you can fuse all 3,000 laws into the finger, I’ll be exterminated. Kid, good job,” Jun Sanqian was delighted.
His wounded arm was completely healed in just a moment but he got a lot weaker.
“I’ve fused all the laws I’ve comprehended to date.” As Jiang Ming said, his physique expanded in a burst, “Senior, do experience my physical combat capability.” “Great Boundless Technique!”
It’s a technique whereby Jiang Ming deduced through Astral Transformation, allowing him to exert his strength to the extreme.
After elicitation, his body would grow up to 100 meters, and his aura got stronger by 100-times. This was incredibly unbelievable.
“Unlimited Killing Punch!”
Jiang Ming lunged forward as he punched in the air, conjuring a frantic attack. His raging blood, his boundless power and his core energy violently surging out from his inner world were supporting his punches.
“Inch Strength Thousand Punch!”
Jiang Ming laughed his head off as he punched. Though his punches overwhelmed Jun Sangian, he could not take him down.
“I’ve got the last bow, which I’ve just comprehended. Senior, do take it!”
“You actually still have another one? Alright, com’n!”
“With my blood raging, and my mind blossoming, I shall fuse laws into Return of Infinite Law Finger, and destroy the world with a finger!”
Jiang Ming fused all the power of his physique, mind, inner world’s core into one. It was the real fusion of Infinite Law that allowed him to make the peerlessly powerful strike. “Jiang Ming, this finger is truly interesting.” Jun Sanqian could not help but nodded as he burst forth his ultimate sword. Unfortunately, he burst into bloody mists along with the sword.
Jiang Ming heaved a sigh of relief and felt extremely weak. He had, after all, spent more than 90% of his enormous power.
He passed the 15th stage. As for the 16th stage, he didn’t go because he knew he wouldn’t pass.
As Jiang Ming returned to the public square, he looked around. He then took out the Supreme Order to check the list of Chat Room’s members. He discovered the appearance of two unknown living beings but Luo Heng, Ye Qingxian etc had left.
‘That’s it for now. I’ve comprehended about 300 laws. I shall let the inner world evolve the rest on its own. It’s simple, and I only need time. The formation of small chiliocosm is just around the corner.’
‘As for my special abilities, will, and strength, I’ve somewhat reached an extreme, hence it’d be incredibly difficult to improve them in a short period. Moreover, because I’m very tired, I think I shall just go back!’
As Jiang Ming thought, he took a glimpse at his accumulated points. There were 68888 points left after he comprehended the Heavenly Monuments.
The accumulated points were still a shocking number anyway. After all, he knew that the accumulated points of Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian did not exceed 100 points.
He immediately left and reappeared on Chuyang Peak.
He was standing on the balcony where he gazed into the scene in the distance.
He somewhat felt unfamiliar. Although a mere hour had passed in reality, he had been staying in the Supreme Pagoda for too long, so long that he felt rather unfamiliar with Chuyang Peak.
He smiled, laid on the rattan chair and started falling asleep. He woke up only after two weeks.
It was a beautiful sunset as the cold breeze blew.
Jiang Ming felt energetic and got familiar again with the place.
Then, he saw Xi Yao pacing over in the air. She looked slightly tired.
“So fast and you’re back? You aren’t looking good, are you alright?” Jiang Ming asked.
For some unknown reason, Jiang Ming felt rather restless and lustful when looking at Xi Yao’s curvy body.
Xi Yao’s head lowered as she complained, “After I left here, I found my Master, who remained kind to me. But many of my fellow disciples were very hostile to me, and some even accused me for not saving the sect?”
Jiang Ming wanted to say that those were morons but he eventually held back. After all, he was the one who slaughtered them.
“They would have died by now without you. You are their savior and you have repaid all past favors by saving the sect’s legacy. From now on, just cultivate here on the mountain, pursue your immortal path and your long life. The past is but the trials of life.” Jiang Ming could not help but comfort.
“That’s not as easy as you’ve said.” Xi Yao pursed her lips.
Jiang Ming felt even more restless, wanting to pull Xi Yao into his arms but held back as he was reminded of the ten Junior Sisters he had.
Xi Yao somewhat felt Jiang Ming’s lustful desire as she surreptitiously took a glimpse at Jiang Ming’s thigh. She blushed as she paced into the sky. “Brother Jiang, I’m going back to my seclusion.”
Jiang Ming rubbed his nose as he tried to calm himself.
The mountain remained tranquil.
Xi Yao came over occasionally for meals.
The four flower fairies also always surrounded him with dances, served him so well that he couldn’t help feeling restless.
“Sigh, Junior Sister has been secluding herself too long. Why didn’t you come back for a while!” Jiang Ming grumbled.
As the time tickled passed, he kept checking on the Devil King Xue Tao while waiting for their arrival.
At this day, Jiang Ming revealed his excitement, “Tonight, the 20 years period is
up!”

chapters.title: Chapter 203
chapters.content:
Chapter 203 The Big Surprise: Doomsday
Midnight of the first day of January in 10,011 of Great Zhou calendar.
Jiang Ming laid on the rattan chair, swaying, in the pavilion.
Above him were countless blinking stars.
He abruptly stopped swaying as a long-awaited notification rang out in his mind.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for living on Chuyang Peak consecutively for 20 years and persistently working or cooking daily. The reward is a Chaos Vital Essence, five low-grade immortal veins, a set of level 16 Immortal Weapons: Heavenly War Sword, Heavenly Protective Shirt, Heavenly Illusion Pagoda, Heavenly Destructive Clock, Heavenly Star Boat, Heavenly Suppressing Furnace; Preternatural Soil; the expansion of Saint Province Dao Square up to 10 million radius (locking on the Eastern Region where the host is. But the lock would disappear once the host thoroughly leaves the Chuyang Peak).”
Jiang Ming gasped in surprise. Chaos Vital Essence and low-grade immortal veins? These two he could not evaluate their value.
But a set of level 16 Immortal Weapons, in which level 16 was akin to the Great Overarching Dao Vessels. And there were six of them. This was truly heaven defying.
‘I wonder if I’m the reincarnation of a super rich guy?’ Jiang Ming had a strange thought.
He couldn’t believe that he would earn such terrific benefits by just staying on the mountain and cooking a meal every day.
With just a thought, five immortal veins appeared in Jiang Ming’s inner world. The moment they fused into the surroundings, the inner world shuddered, emitting terrific vitality.
As the great fortune revolved, laws instantly were evolving at a speed of at least 1,000 times faster. Even the quality of the inner world’s Spiritual Qi began transforming.
Jiang Ming took out the Chaos Vital Essence. He thought it was amazing because the moment it appeared in the inner world, it burst into a long stream of boundless vital essence, which spread out in all directions.
Following that, he discovered the sudden intensification of his inner world’s origin, the remaining laws that are still evolving, accelerated by leap and bounds, rapidly transforming toward the laws of the Immortal Laws.
In just a short while, more than 100 laws had transformed into Immortal Laws.
‘I think my inner world will have 3,000 Immortal Laws in 100 years’ time. By that time, my inner world will become a real small chiliocosm.’ Jiang Ming was ecstatic thinking about it.
In fact, the current inner world of his was best known as the para-small chiliocosm.
As for the Preternatural Soil, he could yet to estimate its value. However, he was surprised by the expansion of the Saint Province Dao Square to the entire Eastern Region.
He was peerless in the Dao Square itself unless the enemy was 100 times stronger than he was. Hence, it was akin to an invincible protective talisman.
This made him the absolute ruler over the entire Eastern Region.
‘If and only if the Saint Province Dao Square can expand further to cover the entire world, does it mean that I’ll be the ruler over the entire world?’ Jiang Ming had a rather smug thought.
He rose to his feet and went to the spiritual field behind the house, which had been expanded to 11 Mu. Top-grade spiritual liquid was flowing in the spiritual fountain, and the Enlightening Tea Tree which was radiating immortal rays, had 3,000 immature leaves growing on it.
The spiritual field had various dazzling rays intertwining and interlacing, while nurturing numerous Dao fluctuations.
As Jiang Ming turned his palm up, the Preternatural Soil appeared. It was very heavy but filled with incredible force of fortune. Jiang Ming flipped, and it was sprinkled evenly on the spiritual field . In the next moment, the spiritual field emitted boundless immortal rays as though it was alive. Meanwhile, all spiritual medicine grew leaps and bounds and many became matured.
Even the leaves on the Enlightening Tea Tree grew a lot too.
Other immortal plants also received profuse fortune, and rapidly nurtured their origin.
“What a great fortune!” Jiang Ming exclaimed brightly.
Just a handful of the soil had raised the grade of the spiritual field by several levels. The field was now akin to an immortal field.
He picked a lot of matured supreme-grade spiritual medicine and received lots of origin essences, and Immortal Weapons such as True Illusion Pagoda, Life Death Gate, etc.
The leftover Preternatural Soil, Jiang Ming sprinkled them on his inner world to further enhance it. Meanwhile, Hua Huo and the other three fairies, each about 1.5 meter tall, flapping their wings which emanated layers of dazzling rays, flew over and surrounded him. Meanwhile, they said, “Master, our origins have been greatly improved just now. We even managed to break our bloodline confinement, and evolved. I think it won’t take long for us to step into the Paradis Realm.”
“Thank you for giving us a great fortune, Master!” Many Ancient Tree of Wars rumbled as they bowed at Jiang Ming at the edge of the spiritual field.
Jiang Ming nodded as he looked at the four flower fairies and became fond of them.
After spending some time in the spiritual field, he returned to his rooftop and lied on the rattan chair again. An idea suddenly crossed his mind, and he took action immediately. He had his consciousness go across the void to look for Liu Changkong in Tianyuan School. As soon as his consciousness detected Liu Changkong, he transmitted, “In about a month, the demonic domain being pushed by Devil Kings will crash into our world. So be prepared.” Then, he immediately withdrew.Liu Changkong who was cultivating in seclusion, was awakened by Jiang Ming’s voice ringing in his ears.
‘His consciousness actually penetrated the school’s formation and my seclusion’s formation without difficulty, and entered directly into my sea of consciousness? How strong is he to be able to do so?’ Liu Changkong was astonished.
But when he thought of the information he heard, he abruptly rose to his feet, and gasped, “Devil Kings are pushing the demonic domain over?” His eyes bulged as he cursed, “What the f*ck, this is insane!”
He flew out, began to gather all the experts of the school to have an emergency meeting.
On Chuyang Peak. Jiang Ming was swaying his rattan chair in a chillax manner.
He had done his part in notifying the Tianyuan School and he was unconcerned about how they would respond.
Instead, he initiated the expansion of Saint Province Dao Square surreptitiously to cover the entire Eastern Region. No one realized it for it did not change anything. Following that, he called up the Human Path Records to check on a few people.
One was his Junior Sister. He learned that she was safe and sound, currently cultivating quietly.
Another one was the Devil King Xue Tao. His Status had a slight change: Almost, we’re almost there. The demonic domain we are pushing is going to crash against the mortal world within a month. It will definitely devastate the origin of the world, turning it into wasteland. By that time, it’ll lose the law protection. Hold on, something is not right. Why is that mortal world moving at fast speed? It seems to be pulled by a terrific force. Can it be that some other experts are trying to do something similar?
The Status rendered Jiang Ming speechless. He could not sense the changes outside the mortal world, hence he sighed helplessly, “My cultivation base is still fra too low.”
He sighed because he was limited by his cultivation base although he was strong enough. But he later was determined that he would do whatever he could in resolving any troubles.
At dawn, Jiang Ming waved his hand, transferring the Heart Refining Path from the back of Chuyang Peak to the square before the main hall of Taiyang Peak. He had also taken out the level 14 Immortal Weapon True illusion Pagoda and put it there.
The Heart Refining Path was used for tempering the mind and testing will. On the other hand, the True Illusion Pagoda had a little world within it. It was akin to the heaven battle stage in the Supreme Pagoda, where one needed to fight in battles which became more difficult one after another. But once he died in the battle, he would be sent out alive.
He had also told the Sect Master about their functionalities. And Sect Master Yan Yan was amazed, “Such Immortal Weapons actually exist in the world?” But later he was overwhelmed with joy. When he managed to compose himself, he bowed respectfully towards Chuyang Peak.
He knew that the Jiuyang Sect had grown stronger and he was no longer afraid of the Holy Lands.
While he was immersing in joy, he saw Huo Daoren come pacing through the air. Huo Daoren had stepped into the Paradis Realm before his life ended. Therefore, his life had further lengthened. “Great, this’s so awesome!” Huo Daoren was thrilled when he learned about the two Immortal Weapons. He couldn’t help nodding gratifyingly as he said, “I can now die in peace.”
The Sect Master only replied with a smile.
When the sect’s disciples learned about the two Immortal Weapons, all of them were delighted. Many of them even entered either one of them, chastening themselves.
In a restaurant located in the city at the bottom of the sect’s mountains.
Both Gu Hai and Yin Yue were sitting in front of the window, enjoying their tea while listening to the storyteller.
At this moment, two streaks of light came streaming, grabbed by the two of them.
“Your peak there actually gave the sect two Immortal Weapons which can assist cultivation. From Sect Master’s speculation, they can speed up disciples’ cultivation speed by a few times. This is so cool! By the way, which cultivation base are your disciples at now?” First Seat Yin Yue exclaimed.
Gu Hai shuddered as he replied, “Neither do I know!”
“Are you not concerned about your own disciples?”
“Sigh, they’re stronger than I am, what else can I do? Anyway, they are both my disciples, and Jiuyang Sect’s disciples regardless of their cultivation base. And that’s more than enough!” “Yes, I agree that this is more than enough. Everyone has different encounters, and things would turn out blemish when we dig further.”
“This is what I meant. So we shall leisurely cultivate, enjoy the tranquility and beauty of life from now onwards. As for the rest, well, I have my disciples’ support.” “Other disciples have their Master as their support but yours, it’s inverted.”
“Well, this is my blessing others can’t enjoy.”
“You’re being arrogant again! By the way, Brother Gu, when are we going to have one?”
“Have one…what?”
“Of course I’m referring to having a kid. Perhaps when he is born, he’d have innate talent comparable to Linglong and Ming! If we’re having a kid, we shall have two, one boy and one girl. Also, I’ve already got the idea of naming them. When they are about 6 years old, we shall let Linglong and Ming as their teachers.”
“Yue Yue, I…I can’t believe you’re thinking this far ahead!”
“Humph, can I rely on you to figure out what our future would be like? You have made me wait so long for nothing, almost taken away all my youth years.”
“That, hehe…” Gu Hai scratched his head.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming, who was on Chuyang Peak, took a glance at their direction, with a cheeky look flashed across his face.
“That old man’s good life is ending soon!” Jiang Ming smirked.
As he was preparing to cook breakfast, he saw Xi Yao pacing over towards him in the air and landed beside him.
“You come here everyday, on time! What do you want to eat?” Jiang Ming was speechless.
“I’m here because Linglong entrusted me to make sure that you aren’t that lonely!” Xi Yao smiled brightly and flirtatiously as she added, “I want to have egg custard made from the eggs of the Nine Colored Yunjin Chicken. Steaming it makes it look fairly white, tender and smooth, chiling it will make it taste even better. Oh, I’m mouth-watering just thinking of it.”
“Fairly white, tender and smooth…why do I find such descriptions familiar?” Jiang Ming muttered.
“Familiar?” Xi Yao was startled. She looked at her fairly white chest and blushed as she reprimanded, “You rascal!”
“What? Why?”
“Humph!”
“You were describing tofu, weren’t you? I’ve just recalled it. Look at this tofu, it looks fairly white, tender and smooth. Feels good, and tastes even better!”
“You…humph…”
Xi Yao was enraged as she saw Jiang Ming gave his explanation seriously. Yet, she somehow felt rather excited and restless.
Jiang Ming turned to a piece of drawing hanging on the pavilion. He reached out and grabbed, a few eggs appeared on his hand.
That drawing was a reward for a meal he once made. It was called Million Beasts Drawing, an Immortal Weapon with an enormous space suitable for rearing demons and beasts within
it.
Therefore, Jiang Ming gathered a lot of spiritual birds and demons from the water, the sky and the earth in it so that he could raise them in captivity for easy consumption.
Jiang Ming took only a while to make egg custard, tofu with spring onions and pancakes.
The dishes were simple but scrumptious.
The two sat face to face, eating quietly.
“Xi Yao!”
“Ya?”
“Don’t leave here for a while because another catastrophe is coming.”
“Catastrophe? Brother Jiang, anything else can affect you today? Is it because there are more foreigners coming?”
“Yes, but this time it’d be too great that even I myself can’t guarantee my personal safety.”
“What? How strong those foreigners can be to you since you can blast an immortal to death!” Xi Yao was shocked.
“That’s all you need to know. Stop asking further!”
“Alright, I won’t ask anymore!” She replied docilely.
Jiang Ming was so surprised at her docility that he knocked down a pair of chopsticks accidentally when he reached out to pour himself a cup of tea.
“I didn’t know that you’d be this careless!” Xi Yao laughed.
“I’m not controlling myself much since it’s a casual meal at home!”
Jiang Ming squatted down to pick up the pair of chopsticks. When he was under the table, he couldn’t help but look at Xi Yao’s legs.
Meanwhile, Xi Yao squeezed her legs together as though she sensed it. Then, she extended out her pair of pearl-white legs towards Jiang Ming.
As Jiang Ming looked at them, he couldn’t help but lick his lips. With much effort, he held back, picked up the chopsticks and sat straight.
Meanwhile, Xi Yao lowered her head, eating the egg custard one spoon after another.
Her face turned rather red but Jiang Ming remained looking casual. In fact, he couldn’t help but call out the Human Path Records to check on Xi Yao.
Her Status: Jiang Ming was being naughty, did he not refer to my bust when he muttered fairly white, tender and smooth? And he said he felt familiar! He must have a peek on them with some special ability. Did he also see through my entire body?
Humph, Brother Jiang is a lascivious person. He must have seen it. Why am I feeling so hot?
And he said, ‘it feels good, tastes even better.’ Did he want to eat me out?
He’s indeed a lech.
How is it possible that Brother Jiang dropped his chopstick by accident? He must be intentional.
He doesn’t bend but squat to pick the chopsticks! Does he want to peek at my…
Why is my heart beating faster?
Does he want to touch my legs?
Shall I open up my legs to make it more exciting?
What if he touches me? Perhaps I shall go
on…
Sigh, he ended up doing nothing at all. Why do I feel disappointed?
What a lascivious person, yet a coward!
Humph!
After Jiang Ming read the Status, he felt speechless. But he pretended as though nothing happened as he continued eating. Meantime, Xi Yao glanced at him sulkily.
This made Jiang Ming even more restless. But he recalled his Junior Sister and suppressed his lustful desire.
Time passed by quickly.
Xi Yao came almost everyday for a free meal. At the same time, she would somewhat purposely have close contact with Jiang Ming.
This act was a great challenge to Jiang Ming. He wanted to do it with Xi Yao, a Holy Daughter, but he was restrained by morality.
At this moment, Jiang Ming rose to his feet, solemnly gazing at the sky in the Southern Region.
“Brother Jiang, is the catastrophe coming soon?” As Xi Yao was just standing beside Jiang Ming, she sensed his emotion and asked.
“Yes, it’s starting!” Jiang Ming nodded.
The next moment, the sky in the Southern Region suddenly split open, revealing a giant hole.
The sky trembled as fireballs fell down. In that instant, countless stars were wiped out. Destructive force infused the void as Dark Devil Qi raged.
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes as he was gazing at an enormous piece of land forced its way through heaven, destroying laws and the revolving fortune.
It was at this moment, he sensed the Fifth Immortal Moon’s prayer.
Please enter the translation

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - Reincarnation Mission, Ultimate Struck
chapters.content:
Chapter 204 Reincarnation Mission, Ultimate Struck
In the Reincarnation Hall.
The Fifth Immortal Moon had reached the Mystical Immortal Realm. Her achievement in just a few years was incredibly unbelievable. But she made it.
In fact, Jiang Ming contributed greatly to her achievement because he intended to train her. He surreptitiously joined her to accomplish all missions of at least SS-grade, hence obtained incredible benefits.
At this floor, all were immortals of level 14 Heavenly Immortal to level 14 Golden Immortal. There were many of them, among which were many geniuses.
In the great hall.
The Fifth Immortal Moon was standing before a mission gate, where a mission had just shown on it.
“This is a S-grade mission to eliminate devils. Cultivation limit: level 13. Request: Kill 10 Devil Generals and a Devil King.
Note 1: Your evaluation will improve based on your result. Note 2: Tianyuan Planar World is currently facing a plot of many Devil Kings. They are pushing the demonic domain to crash into Tianyuan World in order to destroy the revolving laws and the world’s origin so that they could descend onto the world when it loses its protection.’
The Fifth Immortal Moon was not the only one standing before the mission gate, many other experts too, discussing among themselves.
“Many Devil Kings actually intriguing against a mere planar world? Pushing the demonic domain to crash into the world is very costly and needs lots of effort. Are they too bored or are they just fooling around?”
“The planar world must have something so valuable that they are willing to try and get their hands on at all cost. I think that thing must be at least level 15. So do you want it?”
“Who wouldn’t want it? But can our level 13 cultivation base handle so many Devil Kings?”
“They are just little Devil Kings. With the last card and various means we have, I think we can easily kill one or two if we lay out a good
plan.”
“In this case, we shall register quickly.”
Everyone was discussing and planning with their teammates enthusiastically.
As soon as the mission appeared, the Fifth Immortal Moon immediately registered and contacted Jiang Ming simultaneously. She also told him what had happened at where she
was.
On Chuyang Peak.
‘The Reincarnation Hall issues the mission just because it is assured that our Tianyuan World is incapable of resisting it?’ When Jiang Ming received the information from the Fifth Immortal Moon, a dark expression etched on his face.
With a thought, he dispersed the power of Saint Province Dao Square.
But the moment he dispersed the power, he felt a strong repulsion force, forcing him to ascend to another realm.
He also subconsciously sensed that he would be punished by heaven if he forcibly chose to stay.
Jiang Ming evoked Human Path Records. As rays of light showered upon him, the repulsion vanished into thin air.
‘The Human Path Record doesn’t disappoint me indeed!’ Jiang Ming took a sigh of relief.
As he turned his focus onto the sky in the Southern Region, a ruthless look flashed across his face.
‘Based on the Reincarnation Hall’s evaluation, my world will definitely be destroyed and give way to the descendent of Devil Kings. Otherwise, it won’t issue a mission for Mystical Immortals to eliminate devils. In this case, I shall go over to resist!’ As Jiang Ming pondered, he made a decision and teleported away.
Meanwhile, while gazing at Jiang Ming, Xi Yao opened her mouth and wanted to say something but she ended up letting out a sigh.
“World’s collision? Such a catastrophe can be handled by only Brother Jiang indeed. We…” She shook her head as she understood that even with the existence of Sacred Lands, none could do anything while confronting such an attack.
At this moment, all experts in the world were astounded.
In Zhong Province.
“Gone, we’re gone! This is the worlds’ collision. Who can resist? Who can resist?!” Liu Changkong was suspended midair as he gazed into the sky in the south, with a severe expression.
Then he shouted harshly, “Elders, activate the Boundary Protection Formation!”
Buzz…In the next moment, the void in Zhong Province distorted, and four large flags appeared out of thin air, fluttering against the wind while emitting yellowish lights. The light was connected to the great Artifacts in the Tianyuan School, forming a peerless great formation, hovering over the entire Zhong Province.
“Hopefully this formation is strong enough to defend ourselves!” Liu Changkong was not confident at all.
“Old Dean, can’t we defend ourselves with this strongest defensive means of ours?” Ye Ming came to his side, frowning.
“Look at that piece of land appearing in the southern sky. It’s so enormous and filled with majestic power. It has incinerated the stars there even prior to its complete entrance. Once it falls down, the force burst forth can easily scatter an immortal. Tell me, who can stop it?” Liu Changkong gasped as he replied.
“Didn’t…Didn’t that man from the Jiuyang Sect say that we’re facing a man-induced catastrophe. Who’d dare to annihilate a world? Are they not afraid of being punished by heaven?” Ye Ming asked.
“That’s why they made a collision to minimize that risk.” Liu Changkong answered. Then, he said with his face distorted in anger, “God damn it! Who’s the culprit behind the scene? Who the hell is so insane? I shall curse him so that he dies tragically, his son born without an ass, and that he becomes a god-condemned man!”
Liu Changkong had lost his usual demeanor.
Ye Ming abruptly said, “I think that man from the Jiuyang Sect can possibly deal with it since he managed to learn about it earlier.”
“He…” Liu Changkong was startled. But as he gazed at the southern sky, he was again desperate, “How could he manage to resist it? Such a destructive force produced from the collision can even kill a True Immortal, let alone a Heavenly Immortal!”
Ye Ming remained silent this time.
Jiang Ming had arrived in the Southern Region.
When he lifted his head, he saw that the sky had been occupied by the enormous demonic domain.
Millions of stars had been burst and incinerated.
As the demonic domain was falling, it induced boundless flames as though it was going to burn the entire area into ashes.
Jiang Ming looked grave while confronting the pressure of destruction.
‘Why is there such a terrific suppressive force?’ He was shocked. Meanwhile, he evoked his Dharma Eyes and discovered the numerous burning chains of orders beneath the demonic domain. They burst forth dreadful and devastating power.
On the other side of the demonic domain, he discovered the pushing force of the 19 Golden Immortals.
The destructive force induced from the worlds’ collision in addition to the powers of the 19 Devil Kings, was indeed a dreadful destruction.
“Damn it, all 19 Devil Kings actually made their moves!” Jiang Ming was furious.
He took out a Great Overarching Dao Weapon, the Heavenly War Sword as he was preparing to slash through the demonic domain.
However, as soon as the supreme Dao Weapon appeared, he somewhat sensed that he had been targeted as a tremendously strong will power, unable to be shielded by the Human Path Record, befalling.
“Don’t tell me that it is a Divine Condemnation again!” Jiang Ming was astonished. And as he quickly kept the sword, that power disappeared.
‘Why is it so? Why can the Human Path Record shield my aura but not the Heavenly War Sword’s?’ Jiang Ming was confused.
He wondered whether perhaps there was a maximum limit whereby the Human Path Record can shield or perhaps the Great Overarching Dao Weapon was beyond the pinnacle of the mortal world?
He recalled the power of Divine Condemnation which went after Chan Xin, the Holy Buddha Son, when he was saved by the immortal.
Meanwhile, above him, the demonic domain was rushing in with a destructive storm.
‘Once it falls, it will devastate all areas except Eastern Region. I think not even the defense system of Zhong Province can shield themselves from its destructive storm. However, once all things are scattered, will its aftermath affect the safety of Eastern Region?’ Jiang Ming was not confident this
time.
as a
He took out the Universe Sword, which was a level 14 Golden Immortal Weapon. Then, he paused for a while. When he was assured that he did not feel the befalling will, he took a sigh of relief.
“Sky Shattering Sword Technique!”
As he brandished his long sword, millions of sword qi burst forth, shattering across the sky towards the demonic domain.
However, more than half of the sword qi were dispersed even before they could reach the demonic domain.
“This is…” Jiang Ming gasped with astonishment.
Based on his ability to kill a Golden Immortal at his pinnacle, such a situation would not occur. Therefore, he thought the only possibility was that the power emitted by the worlds’ collision was stronger than a Golden Immortal. What’s more there were thepushing forces of 19 Devil Kings.
His face turned even severe as he kept the Universe Sword.
He began trying another method. His physique grew enormously while his power surged tremendously. Then all his power condensed and gathered at the tip of his right forefinger, which he casted Return of Infinite Law Finger at the demonic domain.
This finger gathered all his power, even more powerful than the one he had casted previously in the Supreme Pagoda.
The finger pierced through the destructive storm, forcibly penetrated through the demonic domain, scattering it into eight pieces.
However, its terrific recoil, blasted Jiang Ming into the earth, leaving a ten thousand-foot deep abyss and the collapse of millions of miles of earth.
Jiang Ming rapidly rose into the air. Blood coming out from the corner of his mouth while his pale face looked extremely grave.
‘What a terrific force of recoil.’ He had used up 90% of his energy for that strike yet he failed to completely scatter the demonic domain.
Moreover, if his physique was not strong enough, he would have died from the force of recoil. It was horrible.
At this time, the befalling speed of the eight pieces of demonic domain was accelerated.
“What else can I do?” Jiang Ming smiled wryly. And he teleported away.
The forces of the befalling demonic domain and the worlds’ collision were beyond his imagination indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - The Anguish of Millions of Souls, Hatred and Craziness
chapters.content:
Chapter 205 The Anguish of Millions of Souls, Hatred and Craziness
“I’ve done whatever I can, no regrets. Following that, if my world is destroyed, I’ll kill all the 19 Devil Kings, the main culprit.”
Jiang Ming returned to his Chuyang Peak.
Meanwhile, in his inner world, many sealed little balls burst one after another, releasing large amounts of origin essence to replace those consumed, rapidly recovering his energy.
Rumble!
It was at this moment that the eight pieces of demonic domain landed: one in the East Sea and Western Region each, two in the South Sea, and the other four in the Southern Region.
In that split second, the immeasurable impact of the force formed a monstrous wave, which overwhelmed and hit against the entire Southern Region, destroying all buildings and wiping out all living beings.
Meanwhile, 90% of the seawater in both the East Sea and South Sea evaporated in an instant, causing the death of all sea creatures and demons regardless of their cultivation realms.
The Submerged Dragon Continent crumbled into dust while in Western Region, mountains collapsed and rivers dried.
In Eastern Region…
The destructive storm waves from the seas and Southern Region were blocked by inexplicable force as soon as they hit against the region.
The level 81 terrific storm was transformed into a gentle breeze. Meanwhile, endless shooting flames, debrises, lava etc suddenly stopped upon reaching the region, and befell on the boundary area at a slow speed. Even the tremendous earthquake had no effect on the Eastern Region at all.
This allowed the Eastern Region to remain peaceful.
In Zhong Province…
The four flags formation which appeared, radiated millions of immortal lights layers. Nevertheless, they were destroyed one layer after another, barely resisting the terrific shock waves.
Besides, the terrific quakes had caused the collapse of mountains, forming deep abyss in various locations of Zhong Province.
In the Jiuyang Sect…
The Sect Master Yan Yan was floating in the midair above the main hall of Taiyang Peak, looking in various directions as he frowned with astonishment etching on his face.
was
“So these are the effects of worlds’ collision? The Southern Region has gone while the East Sea almost? Even the Zhong Province was struggling amidst the ordeal! Only the Eastern Region, our Eastern Region is safe and sound!” He was utterly shocked.
He eventually turned stiffly to Chuyang Peak, took a deep breath and paid his respect in that direction.
The Sect Master knew that Chuyang Peak must have something to do with protecting the Eastern Region from the ordeal.
Following that, he had a sophisticated feeling and immense hatred towards the foreign enemies, who were trying to destroy his world.
He was so furious that he cursed and thought that he would slaughter their entire race if he was capable of it. Nevertheless, he could only swear surreptitiously.
On Chuyang Peak…
Xi Yao asked after she recollected herself from her bewilderment, “Are you the one protecting the Eastern Region from the destruction?”
Jiang Ming nodded silently.
“What about the other places?”
“I am not capable of doing it!”
“That’s enough, more than enough! Brother Jiang, can we survive throughout the catastrophe?”
“No worry!”
“That’s great!”
Xi Yao felt inexplicably secure.
Jiang Ming lifted his head looking at the sky.
The sun had disappeared, so did the moon. The vast starry sky was devastated. Even the 3,000 laws that maintained the world’s order and fortune had become a mess.
The majestically vast world’s origin was dispersed and the remainder turned into a world’s shield, a final effort to shield the world.
‘The world can persist for another 100 years!’ Jiang Ming realized that provided the world was not completely destroyed, the remainder could last for another 100 years before being destroyed by the outer space torrent.But once the time’s up, the shield would vanish, giving way for the outer space torrent destroying all living things. Eventually the giant yet lifeless land would float in the infinite void just like the demonic domain, until it was completely destroyed one day.
“I feel like crying!” Xi Yao muttered,
“Me too!” Jiang Ming’s eyes turned red.
It was the anguish that came from millions of souls which died along with the world breakdown. In fact, the two were not the only ones who felt like crying, all other living beings too, felt the same. Many even cried out loud, and had tears gushing out from their eyes even though they had no idea why they were crying. “Why is it so?” Xi Yao was confused.
“Relatively speaking, the world is equivalent to our home, our mother and our roots. Now when its origin is destroyed, we lose everything. All our hopes, our memories, and even our attachment are ruined!” Jiang Ming replied with a low voice.
“H…how is it so? Other…other than the destructive storms, nothing seems different, why do you say that the world is destroyed?” Xi Yao was bewildered.
“Along with the world’s origin being destroyed, the 3,000 laws in a mess and the revolving fortune disappeared, our world cannot be considered as an independent world. It should be recognized as a ruin, where any expert can come in and out freely. After 100 years, the final protection will vanish, allowing the outer space torrent to come sweeping in. by that time…” Jiang Ming explained but he stopped before he finished.
Xi Yao shuddered.
Jiang Ming lifted his head as he looked and felt what was happening quietly.
At this moment, he managed to have a deeper understanding regarding the world’s origin, operation, fortune, and laws.
Even though his inner world was also a world, it was far weaker than the Tianyuan World.
Now, it was as though the Tianyuan World was presenting itself nakedly in front of him.
At this moment, Gu Hai pacing in the air towards him and landed beside him. His eyes were red and he asked directly, “Ming, what’s happening?”
Jiang Ming explained in a simple way.
“Devil Kings pushed the demonic domain into our world?” Gu Hai was shocked. Then, his face distorted in anger as he said, “They are destroying us, aren’t they? F*cking Devil Kings! Ming, are you strong enough to confront them?”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded. “I tried to block the demonic domain earlier but I failed. However, I can kill all descended Devil Kings regardless of their number.”
“Very well, wipe them all out. If possible, make the devil race extinct in the future as revenge for destroying our home!” Gu Hai said fiercely.
He showed resentment and anger before he added, “Just do what you can while taking your safety as the priority!”
“No worry, Master!” Jiang Ming remained calm though his heart filled with killing intention.
“I’ll start my cultivation now so that I’ll have the ability to fight into the devil’s living nest!” Gu Hai turned and left.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming remained standing quietly as he saw his Master off.
Then, he turned to gaze into Zhong Province. The defensive formation was broken but fortunately it blocked offthe strongest storm. So he took out the Universe Furnace and threw it towards Zhong Province. It fused into the earth and turned into a defensive weapon.
Other than the Zhong Province, all areas including the Southern Region, Western Region and the Northern Region were destroyed, and the seas were dried.
The whole world, except the Zhong Province and Eastern Region, were tattered and broken, and all life withered.
At this moment, a group of people appeared along with the distorted void beside Jiang Ming. They were his Junior Sister and her nine clones.
“Linglong…you…you…” Xi Yao was stunned with her eyes bulging out. But she managed to recollect herself and asked, “How is it possible for you to have 9 clones? Can your soul endure them?”
“Can!” Linglong replied with a word and held Jiang Ming’s arm as she asked, “While I was cultivating, I had a bad feeling because my heart abruptly palpated. Therefore, I stopped cultivation and came back. What’s happening?”
Jiang Ming explained in a simple way again. “Devils, f*ck them! Senior Brother, entrust them to me, I’ll kill all of them regardless of their number!” Linglong was filled with killing intent.
“Okay!” Jiang Ming agreed.
Meanwhile, the storm raging the world gradually slowed down. Although the storm had caused the disappearance of the Southern Region, collapsed Western Region and almost dried up seas, the befallen demonic domain had formed a new barren land.
Nineteenth incredibly terrific aura descended abruptly from the sky, which extended to the entire world in a split second.
At the same time, 19 gates descended and were suspended in the midair of various locations. Each gate was extremely enormous and was up to 1,000 meters high. As they were blinking dimly, from within them were a large amount of devils gushing out.
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes as he scanned through the world. He discovered the descending of beneficiaries from the Reincarnation Hall and Lord God Space to all areas. Many of them even passed through the Saint Province Dao Square and landed on Eastern Region.
“Ha, very well. This is very good!” Jiang Ming had a wry smile.
From heaven, an arrogant and overbearing voice was heard, “After millions of years of conspiring, spending all my resources and fighting my best, I’ve finally opened up this mortal world thoroughly. Haha, my hard work paid off. There are another two areas with lots of humans remaining. Gentlemen, let’s have a satisfying feast later. I tell you what, their blood, their flesh, and their soul are incredibly scrumptious!” It was the Devil King Xue Tao, who spoke in a rumbling voice.
The other Devil Kings agreed.
“Senior Brother!” Linglong’s killing intent surged exponentially and she could barely hold back.
“Just wait a little longer, until they have completely landed!” Jiang Ming said as his eyes narrowed into shape like a sharp blade.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - The Malevolence of the Lord God Space, The Horror of a Drop of Liquid
chapters.content:
Chapter 206 The Malevolence of the Lord God Space, The Horror of a Drop of Liquid
Name: Nan Gongfeng
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Level 13 (Mystical Immortal)
Background: A beneficiary of the Lord God Space, one of the eight members of the Maple Leaf Clan
Relationship: -99
Innate talent: Golden Immortal
Status: A beneficiary of the Lord God Space who is forced to accept this SSS-grade mission to assist the invaders in exterminating all intelligent beings of the Tianyuan World within one year.
Note 1: Must at least kill 99% of intelligent beings at level 5 and above.
Note 2: 19 Devil Kings had pushed a demonic domain into the Tianyuan Planar World, hence destroyed its world origin, rendering a world without the protection of Great Dao.
Note 3: This is a battle mission, a team for the attacking and defending each. Team members are limited to level 13 only.
He thinks that the mission is super easy. After all, how can a planar world which has lost its origin as a result of the conspiracy of 19 Devil Kings, resist? It will definitely be destroyed.
He is assured that this planar world must have benefits of immense value. Otherwise, it would not have been targeted by the joint efforts of 19 Devil Kings.
Thus, he wonders why it is a SSS-grade mission because he finds it impossible for the defending members to win the battle even if they are all at level 13.
No, something is not right. We have eight members here but now with another 14 members joining us, we have a maximum number of 22 members in the team.
SSS-grade mission with a team at its member limits? God damn it! Is the Lord God Space want to have us all killed?
It is impossible to have an expert stronger than level 11 in a planar world. What’s the hidden secret of this world?
With the world origin being destroyed not long ago, it shows that Tianyuan World doesn’t have any expert stronger than level 11. Therefore, I think the only possibility is the descent of experts from other forces.
In this case, what can I do?
No, this is not right, this planar world has just experienced a great catastrophe that caused great destruction in various areas but why is this area unaffected at all?
God damn it, within it must have a supreme expert, who protected such a large area.
In the Hai Province of Eastern Region.
Nan Gongfeng was standing 1,000-meters high in the sky. As he checked on the mission, meticulously scrutinizing and looking down at the other members, his face expression changed drastically.
He looked at the East Sea, which had now become a huge basin. Densed aura of death, suffocation and resentment filled its atmosphere, streams of flames flowed along with the raging remaining seawater. Such a view was a scene of doomsday.
When he turned to the Southern Region, there had become a mess.
But when he looked beneath him, it remained as it is, without being affected at all.
“Holy sh*t!” Nan Gongfeng shuddered as the crisis of death instantly enveloped his heart, “The intention of the SSS-grade mission with a team reaching its member limits is to send us to hell, send us to hell! By the way, what’s the hidden secret that attracted the 19 Devil Kings to join hands conspiring against? When they pushed an enormous demonic domain and crashed into this world to destroy this planar world’s origin, it was akin to the collision between two worlds. The strength of the power burst forth absolutely reached up to level 15 but why is this area not affected at all? The middle region is protected by a great array formation formed by the four flags, which was obviously a level 13 Immortal Weapon. The formation is so mystical that even I can’t understand, it certainly must be a terrifying great array formation. However, it is destroyed and tattered, completely at its verge of collapse! Yet, over here…”
Nan Gongfeng was astonished.
At this moment, he shuddered suddenly as he felt a terrific power befalling on him. In a split second, he was rooted to the ground, unable to move a bit.
Even if he evoked the level 14 Immortal Weapon within his body, burst forth all his mana, bloodline force and evoked forbidden techniques, he still could not break free from the confinement.
‘What level of power is this? I know it’s definitely not level 14. Otherwise with my capability of slaughtering a Golden Immortal, it definitely can’t confine me, leaving me defenseless like a peasant! So this is a sure death situation of the SSS-grade mission and maximum number of team members? Damn it, I’ll be killed, so do the other members! And I believe that the 19 Devil Kings will be killed too! The resisting team members will also die because they are invaders from a point of view! Haha, all will have to die!’ Nan Gongfeng was thinking a lot.
He wanted to laugh out loud but he couldn’t; even when he felt like crying, the tears just didn’t come.
Not long later, he burst with a ‘bang’. As a result, both his body and Primal Spirit were destroyed, leaving behind boundless Immortal Origin Essence permeating the Eastern Region, causing the sudden increase of spiritual qi by 100 times.
Bang bang bang!
Following after were the death of 21 Mystical Immortals beneath Nan Gongfeng, leaving behind various immortal weapons and numerous thick strands of origin essence.
On Chuyang Peak.
While Jiang Ming checked on the Human Path Records, he collected and kept all plunder by just lifting his hand to grab at the air. The 22 strands of origin essence he kept in his inner world to speed up its evolution.
The time for my inner world to sublime into its pinnacle, break through its limits and become a small chiliocosm is reduced by half, to only about 50 years!’ Jiang Ming thought and he did not dwell on it further.
In fact, Jiang Ming killed Nan Gongfeng and his gang by initiating the power of the Saint Province Dao Square. The Immortal Origin Essence they left behind in Hai Province, Jiang Ming transferred and evenly distributed 80% into each peak, instantly transforming the abundant spiritual qi to a level akin to the para-immortal origin, and abruptly increasing the atmospheric pressure by tens of times.
This had pressed some disciples at Qi Cultivation Realm to the ground. However, through the scouring of the immortal origin, they were instantly metamorphosized with better innate talent, hence adapted to the change in atmospheric pressure.
They stood up, clenched their fist and were ectatics when they felt the boundless, raging power within their body.
Some disciples whose cultivation was at their bottleneck, all had their breakthrough, entering to the next realm.
In various parts of the peaks was a large amount of medicinal plants mushrooming.
As for the other 20%, Jiang Ming distributed to various parts of Eastern Region, making the region the best place for cultivation.
On the Taiyang main peak.
The Sect Master Yan Yan was excited at the change. But then his heart leapt wildly for the change had come too abruptly and frighteningly.
“Other than the surprising benefits, it’s the terrifying disasters!” He could not help but worry.
“For such disasters, we can do nothing but just watch and wait! Anyway, we don’t have to worry now!” Gu Hai, who was standing beside him, spoke in a rather indifferent voice.
“That’s what I can do now!” Sect Master Yan Yan smiled wryly.
He could not do anything because that was beyond his control. Hence, he could only await the judgment of fate.
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming looked in the direction of Zhong Province. Fortunately because of the torn formation, he could see through. There was a team of 25 Mystical Immortals.
‘They should be the resisting team!’ He thought in an affirming manner.
Besides, there were another few teams of about five to six members. He knew they were from the Reincarnation Hall.
Jiang Ming averted his gaze.
He also sensed the presence of some Reincarnation Hall’s members in the Eastern Region. Therefore, he lifted his hand, grabbed at the air, and his Immortal Spirit again spurt forth, transforming into the sustenance of the Eastern Region.
His act left none of them alive except the Fifth Immortal Moon.
Then, with a point of a finger, a huge screen appeared before him. On the screen were red points clearly pinpointed out the others’ location in the Zhong Province. He turned to the Spatial Junior Sister and ordered, “Please go to these points and kill all of them! Also, attract those 19 Devil Kings over. As for those of Devil Generals, the best is to confine or cripple them.”
“Sure!” The Spatial Junior Sister’s eyes flashed as she agreed. Following that, she leapt up into the air, emitting great strength of Golden Immortal and rushed towards the Zhong Province without concealing herself.
“Senior Brother, are you revealing the existence of ‘Spatial’ to conceal the fact that the Eastern Region is safe and sound? After all, it’s logicable to say that the presence of a Golden Immortal is capable of shielding a region. Other than the 19 Devil Kings, none of those little devils can do any harm,” said Linglong.
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded. Then, he added, “Other than the 19 Devil Kings, perhaps, there are other threats. Thus, you’ve to prepare for the worst, in case…”
“Senior Brother, there’s no ‘in case’!” Linglong said with determination.
“Yes, there’s no ‘in case’!” Jiang Ming could not help but smile.
The stress he felt had now dispersed. He felt good that he was not the only person bearing the stress.
Linglong did not inquire further about the other threats. She only knew that she would confront all threats with her Senior Brother regardless.
Xi Yao, who was beside them, was in a complete daze. She had just recovered from her shock and asked surprisingly, “Linglong, is your clone currently at the Golden Immortal Realm?”
“Yes! That’s why you are too weak, so weak that you can’t stand to be tossed around.” Linglong smiled.
Xi Yao startled for a moment before she blushed because she eventually understood what Linglong had said. She replied indignantly, “Don’t forget that you are a Golden Immortal! Do act like an immortal please!”
“An immortal is still human!” Linglong laughed, “If you don’t work harder, I’m afraid that you can’t stand even a drop of liquid?”
“What type of liquid you said that I can’t stand?” Xi Yao had a confused look.
Jiang Ming tugged a corner of his mouth while Linglong could not help but laugh out loud.
In the distance, the Spatial Junior Sister had made her move.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - Great Overarching Attraction, Welcoming the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Great Overarching Attraction, Welcoming the Universe
Name: Zi Linglong
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation Base: Level 15 (Taiyi Golden Immortal)
Background: Disciple of Chuyang Peak in the Jiuyang Sect (Heavenly Venerate’s named disciple)
Relationship: 99
Innate Talent: Great Overarching (Innate Saint Daoist Body).
Status: After returning to the Heavenly Inheritance Space, she continued to listen to the Dao and cultivate. Her cultivation level improved rapidly, and finally, she had a breakthrough and stepped into the Taiyi Realm.
Phoenix Linglong’s bloodline had been enhanced, and she had entered the Taiyi Realm as well.
While she was cultivating, she did not stop from gaining more special abilities as well as honing her combat ability. Her combat prowess improved greatly, and she had attained a lot of enlightenment.
One day, her heart shuddered in fear as a bad feeling rose from her stomach pit. She knew something had happened outside, so she hastily returned to the outside world.
At the same time, Time Linglong and the other clones had ascended into the Golden Immortal Stage as well.
There was not much information about his junior sister, but without a doubt, his junior sister was very strong, so strong that even he himself did not have the confidence that he could defeat her if they were to go against each other.
After all, aside from herself, she still had nine more clones that could aid her in a battle. Phoenix Linglong had already achieved the Taiyi Realm, while the remaining eight had stepped into the Golden Immortal Realm. When 10 of them worked together, nobody could stop them.
Fortunately, she still liked him as she was in the past.
Their relationship was 99, and this was the maximum.
“Junior sister’s innate talent is only Great Overarching?” Jiang Ming frowned.
This was not good. It was a little bit low, and she would reach her maximum potential when she reached the next realm.
However, when he gave it a second thought, he felt he was being paranoid. It was considered a miracle that his junior sister could have such an achievement at her current age and cultivation level. He was certain that she would continue to improve in the future, and even if she couldn’t, he would do everything he could to improve her innate talent.
Right now, what he needed to focus on was Spatial Linglong. Although he was fully confident that Spatial Linglong was capable of solving this herself, Linglong and him still decided to stay here so that they could give her support at any time.
Securing Linglong tightly in his arms, Jiang Ming looked toward the 19 humongous inter dimensional portals. Horde after horde of demons were pouring out of them, and all of the demons were powerful.
The weakest of them were at level 9, and some of them had already achieved the Heavenly Immortal Realm, the True Immortal Realm, or the Taiyi Immortal Realm.
These demons were marching toward the Eastern Region and Zhong Province, bringing forth a terrifying destruction force and wiping out everything in their wake.
At the same time, Spatial Linglong had already arrived in the air above Zhong Province. Looking at the swarm of incoming demons, she harrumphed coldly and waved her hand, causing a distortion in the space around them and killing them in the process.
However, a few of them still managed to get away.
“Spatial Cube!”
With a snap of her finger, she drew power from the universe to form into a few invisible cages, sealing the demons’ movements and causing them to fall from the sky.
“How can such a powerful person exists in this world?”
“Unbelievable!”
“Did she just seal those demons away?”
“She’s using the Spatial Law. I don’t think we can stop her.”
“Don’t give up so soon yet! No matter how powerful she is, she’s just alone. Don’t forget that there are 19 of us here. If we join forces, we can even defeat the Demon King, let alone a Golden Immortal. So what are we still waiting for? We don’t have much time left. Once the human world’s origin has been destroyed, we would lose our only chance to go to the Infinite Realm Battlefield, so to be on the safe side, let’s work together and kill her. Then, we can think about the rest after that.”
“Let’s go, then!”
After they had made up their minds, all 19 demon lords stepped into the battlefield.
Meanwhile, Spatial Linglong made her move again.
She waved her hand and cast a powerful special ability.
“I’ll cut through the Akasa and turn the universe into a cage!”
The Great Akasa Technique was activated, enveloping the remaining beneficiaries of the Lord God and the Reincarnation Hall in its divine light.
“Rupture! Annihilate everything!”
Spatial Linglong tightened her grip and the cage crumbled, transforming into an obliterating power and destroying the flesh and Primal Spirit of one of the Mystical Immortals within.
There were two of them who escaped their fate through special items. However, as soon as they got out, they were killed by Spatial Linglong.
Even though most of the beneficiaries were geniuses, Linglong was the genius among geniuses. Not only did she have the experience and memory of the great emperor, but she had also cultivated in the Heavenly Inheritance Space. She was more powerful than the others, and killing a few Mystical Immortals was like walking in the park for her.
She spun around and looked toward the 19 interdimensional portals.
At this moment, demon lords were gushing out of all of them one after another. Each of them carried a terrifying and mighty aura.
Zhong Province, in the air of the Tianyuan School.
Liu Changkong and Ye Ming stood frozen stiff in the air.
“There are 19 interdimensional portals. Each of them brings out a huge number of demons, in which the weakest of them are in the Extreme Path Realm. There are countless demons from the Immortal Realm too. How are we going to win this?
“Sir, why don’t we just submit and join them?”
“I would like to, but I guess they would only treat us as food rather than comrades.”
“Sigh, you’re right. Sir, do you think our world is cursed? If not, how can there be so many calamities? Our world is going to end now!” Liu Changkong fell silent for a moment before muttering, “Are we all going to die?”
He couldn’t see any future in this world and he had lost all his hopes. The collision was so powerful that all of the formations they had laid in advance failed.
The demons that poured out of the interdimensional portals were too strong and too many.
Even if the mysterious being from the Jiuyang Sect came to their aid, he was confident that there was very little he could do as well.
“This is so unfair!” Ye Ming shouted.
Suddenly, they all felt an impressive aura coming from the other side. Their souls trembled and they had the urge to get on their knees and bow at it.
They jerked their heads back and they were stunned.
“It’s Zi Linglong from the Jiuyang Sect! I’m very sure of it! Since when has she become so strong? Look at those demons. They’re all trembling in fear!
“Sir, this is our chance! We’re going to get through this!” Ye Ming shouted excitedly
as if he was clutching at the last straw.
In the next second, they watched and shouted in joy as Spatial Linglong killed hundreds of thousands of demons in the blink of an eye.
Just when they thought they were going to win this war, 19 demon lords stepped out of the interdimensional portals.
Liu Changkong and Ye Ming’s heart skipped a beat, and then they saw the formation that they had laid began to crumble away.
Their faces turned pale.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes, and the Human Paths Record flipped open.
Name: Xue Tao.
Race: Blood Demon.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Demon Lord, Golden Immortal Realm)
Background: The 3rd Demon Lord of the Blood Red Abyss Small Chiliocosm.
Relationship: -99.
Innate Talent: Golden Immortal.
Status: Joined forces with another 18 Demon Lords in an attempt to push the demonic land against the human world. However, little did he expect that a mysterious being appeared and destroyed the demonic land before it could crush into the human world.
