Even though they did not manage to destroy the human world, the silver lining was that they managed to destroy their origin.
However, there were two places that were shielded by formations. One was the Eastern Region, while another was Zhong Province.
When the interdimensional portals opened, he sent a group of monsters to scout the surroundings.
A Golden Immortal emerged in the direction of the Eastern Region, and she killed a swarm of demons in the blink of an eye.
After the origin of the world had been destroyed, the pulling power increased steeply and they were moving at a fast pace toward the Infinite Realm Battlefield. He assumed that this was a plan of those immortals, so they couldn’t wait anymore. If not, they would arrive at Infinite Realm Battlefield soon, and things would become complicated if the immortals came here directly.
He also noticed that the terrifying power within the pulling force was probably the power of a Great Overarching Dao Vessel, it was a powerful weapon that could suppress even the universe, and it had the power to kill them within an instant.
Luckily, he successfully convinced the other 18 Demon Lords to step through the interdimensional portal to defeat the Golden Immortal experts.
Jiang Ming shook his head after he looked through Xue Tao’s status.
Not only were they targeted by the Demon Lords, but they were targeted by the immortals too. Even a Great Overarching Dao Vessel had appeared.
“What am I supposed to do if a Great Overarching Golden Immortal came here?” Jiang Ming asked, “Also, where exactly is the Infinite Realm Battlefield?”
As for Xue Tao, he was not worried at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - Remaking the World, Further Preparation
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Remaking the World, Further Preparation
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Heavenly Immortal Realm
Main Cultivation Method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Special Ability: Return of Infinite Law Finger, Sky Shattering Sword Technique, Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, Unlimited Killing Punch, Great Boundless Technique, Great Akasa Technique, Great Millennium Technique, Great Body Protection Technique, Great Five Elemental Technique, Great Yin-Yang Technique, and so on.
Innate Talent: Saint Dao (Immortal Body)
Item: Human Paths Record, Supreme Order, Saint Province Dao Square, Sword Tome, Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, level 16 Immortal Weapons: Heavenly War Sword, Sky Defensive Sweater, Heaven Illusion Tower, Heavenly Star Ark, Heaven Suppression Cauldron, level 14 Immortal Weapons: Universe Sword, Universe Cauldron, level 11 Immortal Weapons: Mystical Light Sword, Heavenly War Blade, Heavenly Feathered Shirt, Celestial Soul Bell, Starry Hall, Heavenly Ark, Special Immortel Weapons: Heart Refining Path, True Illusion Pagoda, Life Death Gate, Million Beasts Drawing, and so on.
Support: Primary Training Zone
Jiang Ming checked through his own status, and realized that not much change had happened to it.
He had the Immortal Body now instead of the Daoist Body. His physical body was still as tough as it used to be, and he reckoned that it would be a piece of cake for him to kill an ordinary Golden Immortal.
He lifted his head and stared fixedly at Xue Tao, or more precisely, Xue Tao’s clone. At the same time, he thought inwardly, ‘What should I do if a Great Overarching expert comes here?’
If that was the case, then things would turn for the worst. There was nothing they could do to defeat a Great Overarching expert, not even with the combined effort of Linglong and her nine other clones.
‘What if I trap them in the Saint Province Dao Square? With my current combat prowess and the power of the Saint Province Dao Square, will I be able to defeat a Great Overarching expert?’
Jiang Ming wasn’t sure of it as well. After all, he had never come across a Great Overarching expert before, so he did not know about it.
‘One more thing, we’ve killed all of the beneficiaries from the Lord God. Judging from their way of doing things, they would send more of the beneficiaries to our world. If one of them is a Great Overarching expert…’
Jiang Ming hastily stopped his thought from going too deep into it.
He glanced at Linglong, who was standing beside him, and asked, “Can you temporarily seal them away with Five-Elemental, Yin-yang, and Spatial?”
“Of course, I can,” Linglong answered confidently, “There are only 19 Demon Lords. They aren’t that strong, not to mention that their demonic aura is weak and most of them haven’t even mastered the Dark Dao yet. It’d be a piece of cake for us to seal them!”
“Alright, then! I’ll leave them in your hands!”
“Sure!”
Five Elemental Linglong and Yin-Yang Linglong disappeared at the same time.
Xi Yao, who was standing beside them and overheard their conversation, was speechless. She found it hard to understand why both of them felt it was easy to seal 19 Demon Lords away.
‘Both of them are younger than me, right? They were looking up at the Immortal Realm the other days, but now, they’re slaughtering those immortals and demons as if they were cutting through butters.’
Xi Yao pressed the center of her forehead. She sighed inwardly as she felt that the gap between them was getting bigger and bigger.
In the meantime, Five Elemental Linglong and Yin-Yang Linglong had arrived at their destination. As soon as they arrived, they activated their special ability.
“All things born in the universe are governed by five elements. Go along with it, you rise; Against it, you fall. I’ll now reverse the laws with five elements. All rules will fall apart, the force of creation will cease to exist, and chaos will return to nothingness! Crush!”
“Overturning yin and yang. Black and white will be the order! Lock!”
“Space will be the seal! Seal!”
All three Linglongs chanted their special abilities in unison and formed a great immortal formation. It enveloped the entire area and rendered all special abilities unusable. As soon as the 19 demon lords stepped out of the portals, they froze in place.
Before they could do anything, a seal broke through their protective barrier, entered their sea of consciousness, and sealed their souls away.
Immediately after, Spatial Linglong moved them along with the remaining demons to the place where the Fifth Immortal Moon was.
Without any hesitation, the Fifth Immortal Moon gripped her sword and took down all the demons as well as the demon lords. After that, she flew into the air, charged up her attack, and destroyed all 19 interdimensional portals.
She did not go away after destroying the portals. Instead, she sat in a lotus position in the sky. Rays of light began to appear around her as she activated the world’s purifying special ability and began purifying the demonic Qi in the air.
Chuyang Peak.
“Senior brother, is she still under your control?” Linglong asked.
She knew the Fifth Immortal Moon.
Jiang Ming nodded.
“That’s great. You’re the best, senior brother!” Linglong exclaimed.
Meanwhile, Spatial Linglong and the other two linglongs had returned. They landed beside Jiang Ming and smiled brightly, “Did we do a good job, senior brother?”
“Of course!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile.
“Then how are you going to thank us?” Spatial Linglong asked as she wrapped her arms around Jiang Ming’s arm, shaking and sending jingle down Jiang Ming’s spine.
He shook his head and said helplessly, “Alright, alright! Settle down. Our world is in danger. The people are about to face the real danger of destruction. I have to find a way to reshape the mountains and rivers. Girl, since you’ve gone to the Heavenly Inheritance Space before, do you have any idea how to do this?”
“Yeah, I do,” Linglong said solemnly, “The destruction of the world is due to the collapse of the origin, rendering the laws in disorder and causing the reversal of creation. The sky will not be the sky anymore, and the ground will not be the ground.
“Look over there, senior brother,” Linglong said as she pointed at the sky. There was nothing but darkness in the sky. There was no sun, moon, nor star.
Other than the divine light that erupted from different parts of the land, the rest of the area was shrouded in pure darkness.
“The star and the sky will act as the fetal membrane, while the cycle of the sun and moon will establish the order. The ground has the ley lines running through it, acting like lungs while the lava provides energy. The most important thing is the law and order of the world, that is, the world origin. It exists between reality and void, hidden among the true illusion, and is the condensation of the will of all spirits throughout the ages. It’s the source of everything,” Linglong said, “It’s simple to reshape the world. You just need to refine the sky, establish the cycle of the sun and the moon, sort out the ley line Qi, make the law and creation to work again, and then finally, reshape the origin.”
“That’s it?” Jiang Ming said in surprise.
“Yes, that’s it,” Linglong said, “It’s indeed very easy for Golden Immortals. After all, all Golden Immortals possess supreme power, but in reality, it’s also very difficult.”
“What do you mean?”
“Because it’ll take a lot of time! Look, senior brother. How long do you think it’ll take to rebuild the star, the sky, the sun, and the moon? After that, you’ll need to make sure that it has been stabilized before you can sort out the ley line Qi and make the law and creation to work again. The most crucial step is still to shape the world’s origin. The world’s origin is connected to everything in this world. It’s both the source and the end, so of course it’s going to be a tedious process!”
“I see! Now I get it!”
Jiang Ming knew his junior sister was not lying since the process was similar to when he was working on his inner world.
“Let me give it a try!” He said and went to the Northern Land.
This place had already fallen into disarray. Lava was gushing out of the ground and storms were sweeping through the land. There was scarcely an inch of intact ground left.
He sat in a lotus position and activated his special ability.
After one day had passed, he had successfully generated 100,000 miles of land. However, Jiang Ming stopped and let out a sigh.
“It’s too slow!”
He shook his head.
Honestly, it was considered very impressive that he was able to generate such a vast land in such a short amount of time. It was just that other than the land, he still needed to reform the core, the sky, the star, and most importantly, the world’s origin.
He made a rough estimation, and he surmised that he would need at least a thousand year to complete everything.
‘A thousand year? I can’t wait that long! Besides, even if I spend a thousand years, it doesn’t necessarily mean that it’ll succeed in the end.’
“Senior brother, I’ll come help you!” Linglong came to his side and said, “Regardless of whether it is going to work out or not, we’re going to give it a shot!”
Jiang Ming sighed, “We don’t have that much time?”
“Why would you say so?” Linglong asked, her voice filled with confusion, “Isn’t the catastrophe over?”
“Do you still remember the Golden Heaven Path?”
“Yeah, I do. Are you saying that…”
“Exactly! The owner of the Golden Heaven Path is on the move as well. He’s using a Great Overarching item to push our world toward a place known as the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Besides, people from other dimensions like the Fifth Immortal Moon will come as well at any time!”
“This…” Linglong was stunned.
She was familiar with the Golden Heaven Path as well as the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
“How can there be so much calamity in our world?” Linglong couldn’t help herself and smiled bitterly, “What should we do now, senior brother?”
Jiang Ming looked into the distance. There was a sad expression on his face, but he still gritted his teeth and gave out his order, “Let Spatial Linglong go to the Tianyuan School at Zhong Province. Ask them to move the people in Zhong Province to the Eastern Region.”
After that, both of them returned to Chuyang Peak.
Standing on the rooftop, Jiang Ming thought inwardly, ‘It’s time to make some preparations!’

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - Ten Thousand Times Acceleration, the Completion of the Small Chiliocosm
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Ten Thousand Times Acceleration, the Completion of the Small Chiliocosm
Blood Red Abyss...
It was a barren land consisting of nothingness, and it became even more empty after the death of the 18 demon lords.
Inside the palace, the demon lord Xue Tao was sitting on the supreme throne. Suddenly, he spurted out a mouthful of blood and his complexion changed.
“My clone is dead, and the 18 demon lords are killed. How could such a terrifying figure be hidden in a small human world like that? Three Golden Immortals... Not only all three of them look alike, but they have the same smell as well. Could it be that they were born from one body? But what are they doing in the human world?
“I can understand how Zhong Province could survive the collision since they’re protected by a great formation, but how about the Eastern Region? I don’t see any protective formation at all, but they emerge unscathed from the collision as well. This is strange.
“Not only that, but there is a Great Overarching Dao Vessel pulling the world toward the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
“Just what kind of secret is this human world holding?
“I’ve used up all my power. There’s nothing I could do anymore, but how could I let it end like this?
“Maybe I should offer the hidden secrets in exchange for some benefits. Should I go look for a demon king? No, I should go for a demon emperor instead!”
After the demon lord Xue Tao had made up his mind, he turned into a streak of light and disappeared from his throne.
Immortal World.
Chengguang Immortal was standing on top of the palace. He was looking toward the Tianyuan World, but unfortunately, he was too far away and couldn’t see what was going on inside.
“Something big is happening there. Their world is falling apart! Not only that, but the aura of the 19 demon lords is gone! What the hell is going on there?”
Chengguang Immortal was stunned. He fell into contemplation for a while before finally making up his mind. He gritted his teeth and said, “I need to act fast. The world that is moving toward the Infinite Realm Battlefield belongs to the Immortal World. I don’t believe we can’t do anything we want with it as we wish! To be on the safe side, I think I should start my preparation.”
With that thought in mind, Chengguang Immortal began to contact other experts.
Reincarnation Hall.
The Fifth Immortal Moon had returned, and she was currently in the mission room. There was no one in the mission room other than her.
[The Fifth Immortal Moon, congratulations on clearing your mission. You have cleared the S-Class mission: Hunt 10 demon generals and 1 demon king; SS-Class mission: Hunt 100 demon generals and 10 demon kings; SSS-Class mission: Kill all the demon generals single handedly, destroy the interdimensional portal, and purify the demonic land. Here are your rewards: 1x Unattributed Golden Immortal Dao Fruit, 1x low-grade immortal vein, 1x level 14 Golden Immortal Battle Suit, 10 million points.]
The Fifth Immortal Moon was taken aback when she received the rewards. However,
However, she soon felt it was only reasonable since she had cleared the SSS-Class mission and that she returned alone.
‘But can’t the reincarnation system find out that I am cheating?’ She thought inwardly and then took out the dead bodies of demon soldiers, demon generals and demon lords as well as other immortal weapons and demon weapons for the system to recycle.
Then, she had gotten another massive amount of points.
“Awesome!” The Fifth Immortal Moon exclaimed.
Jiang Ming was able to learn everything that was going on her side. He told her to continue cultivating to improve her cultivation level through telepathy.
After all, Mystical and Golden Immortals were too weak.
Chuyang Peak.
Spatial Linglong had gone to the Tianyuan School at Zhong Province, and helped them to move the people over there to the Eastern Region.
Jiang Ming figured that she should be able to get the job done alone, so he was not worried about her. He turned his head around to look at Time Linglong. “”Set up a time formation for me. The greater the degree of reversal of time, the better.”
“Senior brother,” Time Linglong frowned, “You’re too powerful, and I doubt there is a limit to the number of times I can reverse time before the effect stops working on you.”
“I’ll seal myself and then cast the method of Harmony with Light to conceal all my power and vital energy,” Jiang Ming said, “It doesn’t need to be big. What is the factor of time that can be reversed in this way?”
“Ten thousand times should be no problem, but if it is 100,000 times, with our current space, I’m afraid it’ll trigger the annihilation of time,” Time Linglong said after a short contemplation, “Is it enough, senior brother? If not, I can refine some items to aid me.”
“Ten thousand times should be enough.”
“Okay. Please wait for me for a moment while I prepare the formation!”
After she had finished speaking, she went to the side of the rooftop and started preparing the formation.
Very soon, the formation was completed.
Jiang Ming sealed himself up and used the Human Paths Record to cover his aura and power before entering the formation.
When he was inside the formation, he lied down and went into his inner world.
There were too many creation forces in his inner world. Most of the immortal laws had been completed, and the remaining were working toward completion at a rapid pace.
Time was passing by slowly, and finally, 3,000 laws were completed.
Right now, his inner world was filled with the immortal dao to the brim. It was also at this moment that the origin of his inner world began to change.
The sky and the ground expanded, and even the spiritual Qi in the air was transforming. A mysterious power also streamed forth, merging into his limbs and bones, triggering changes in his body.
Even his soul was transforming as well, and the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra began working.
At this moment, Jiang Ming was undergoing a tremendous change, until at a certain point, a popping sound, as if the first thunderclap at the beginning of the universe, came from the depths of his mind.
The transformation of his inner world had completed, and it had transformed from a planar world to a small chiliocosm.
A small chiliocosm was also known as a small immortal world. It was a transcendental world that had transcended the ordinary.
The lowest level of the law was the Heavenly Immortal level.
The origin had become even stronger as well. It had exceeded the Golden Immortal level and stepped into the Taiyi Realm. In other words, the power contained in the whole world had reached the level of the Taiyi Golden Immortal.
The level of life bred within could reach up to the Heavenly Immortal level.
As the law improved and the origin strengthened further, the strongest life would also keep improving, with the strongest reaching the level of Golden Immortal, which was considered the completion of the small chiliocosm.
Jiang Ming cracked his eyes open and shattered the time formation.
“Senior brother, are you alright?” Linglong rushed over. When she sensed the tremendous amount of power in her senior brother’s body, she was stunned. “You only went into seclusion for two days and you have achieved such an improvement? Way to go, senior brother!”
“Two days? That’s 20,000 days, almost several decades of time!” Jiang Ming lamented.
However, it was already considered very fast.
The completion of the evolution of his inner world meant he had become a lot stronger right now.
The weakest power contained in the small chiliocosm was equivalent to the early stage of the Taiyi Realm. Once it reached perfection, he would be able to tap into the power which was equivalent to the Great Overarching Realm.
“Once I’ve reached the Great Overarching, there will be no more limitation to my cultivation anymore!” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed with joy, and the worries in his heart had faded away.
Even if they couldn’t kill a Great Overarching Golden Immortal, at the very least, they could hold him off.
“Brother Jiang, what’s your cultivation level right now?” Xi Yao asked. She did not know why but her heart was trembling and she had the urge to bow at Jiang Ming.
Sensing the changes of expression on Xi Yao’s face, Jiang Ming took a deep breath and said, “Well, I know this will sound bad to you, but I can destroy you with just a snort.”
Xi Yao was stunned.
Suddenly, Jiang Ming sensed something and he looked into the distance with his eyebrows deeply frowned.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - Supreme Lord, Saint Lord, Great Heavenly Venerate
chapters.content:
Chapter 210 Supreme Lord, Saint Lord, Great Heavenly Venerate
Jiang Ming could sense that there was a supreme power pulling their world in a rapid speed toward a certain direction.
In a very faraway location, there was a place that was shrouded with an immense amount of negative energy.
“The pulling force of a Great Overarching Item?” Jiang Ming said.
He was familiar with the power of a Great Overarching Item. After all, he had a few of them as well. Although he had the confidence that he could stop the pulling force, what would happen next?
Their world was in a mess, and everything was dying. He could foresee that their world would welcome its true destruction very soon. It would become a place where nothing could grow, and unfit for them to cultivate.
Therefore, he decided to let it be.
As for the place he sensed just now.
“Is it the Infinite Realm Battlefield?” Jiang Ming asked.
He surmised that they would arrive there in one more month.
“Well, I guess I’ll have to play it by ear then!” He said. After all, there was nothing he could do other than waiting. Besides, it was not known who would emerge victorious in the end as well.
In the meantime, Xi Yao was still unable to come around from the shock.
‘He said he could destroy me with a snort? Sigh! Seems like I need to cultivate more!’ Xi Yao sighed inwardly.
She then looked into the darkness in the distance and fell silent.
It seemed to her that this world was becoming more and more unfamiliar.
“Senior brother!” Linglong wrapped her arm around Jiang Ming’s, shaking lightly. “Now that things have settled down, what do you say we head back to the house and take a
rest?”
“Good idea!” Jiang Ming replied. A bolt of heat surged from the bottom of his belly and coursed through every nerve end in his body, making his blood boil. Just when he was about to scoop Linglong from the ground, he noticed that Xi Yao was standing next to them and he said hesitantly, “Xi Yao, you…”
“Xi Yao, why don’t you come with us?” Linglong chimed in.
“Come with you? To where?” Xi Yao asked, her voice thick with confusion.
“My senior brother’s bed, of course! His bed is large, so it’ll fit all three of us!”
“What? Linglong, how… How could you be so shameless?” Xi Yao snarled. After that, she snorted and went away with her face flushed red with embarrassment.
Smack…
Jiang Ming smacked Linglong’s head and said, “Stop teasing her.”
“Senior brother!” Linglong jumped onto Jiang Ming’s body, coiled her arms around his neck, and pouted, “This is what you both want, isn’t it? Do you really think I don’t know what you two are thinking, you pair of shameless beasts.”
“Beasts? Then what are you?”
“I? I’m a wolf!” Linglong said as she bit his shoulder.
The remaining Linglongs also bared their teeth and brandished their arms in the air, causing Jiang Ming to let out a boisterous laugh.
He waved his sleeves, and all of them went back into the house.
For Jiang Ming, this was probably the best activity and most meaningful activity in this world.
One day later, at the attic of the house in the back of the mountain.
Xi Yao looked skyward with a mixed expression on her face.
She rested her chin on her hand and thought inwardly, ‘Are they cultivation?’
Along with the thought that popped up in her head were some obscene scenes and images.
It had been three days.
She looked ahead, and there were wisps of pink fluttering out from the rooftop in front of her. She knew that it was a phenomenon that would only happen when the Qi of lust was at its thickest.
Another ten days had passed, and Xi Yao sighed heavily. She lifted her head to look into the sky in the distance, but her gaze was greeted by nothing but darkness.
Suddenly, her heart was filled with fear.
“When I was young, I aspired to join the immortal sect. After I’ve grown up, I want to become a Holy Daughter and be respected by other disciples. After becoming the Holy Daughter, my wish is to become the Holy Lord and lead the Riyue Sect to a glorious future. I also want to challenge the geniuses in the world and overpower my peers. However, upon losing to Linglong, it was only then I realized how ignorant I was. Therefore, my desire at that time was to work hard on my cultivation so that I become an immortal and see the world beyond.
“Then, I… I don’t know when it happened, but by the time I realized it, I had already fallen in love with him. Even though I’ve been refraining myself, I still couldn’t help but wanting to get closer to him. When the disaster hit this land, he cut down the immortals and demons as well as destroyed the Sacred Lands. I should’ve hated him, but how could I? It was the Sacred Lands that summoned the immortals into this world. If it hadn’t been for me, my master would’ve been dead and the Riyue Sect would’ve been gone forever, so how could I hate him?
“And now, our world is in great danger, and he has once again become the savior. Not only that, but he has become so strong that he could destroy me with a snort…
“Sigh… Which path should I take on now? Since my sect is gone, the task of rebuilding it has fallen into my hands. The Immortal Dao is just in front of me, and all I need to do is extend my hand to reach for it. The world has fallen apart, so how could I be immersed in love?”
Xi Yao’s heart was filled with a myriad of emotions.
She closed her eyes. Suddenly, a sword energy appeared in her head. Without any hesitation, the sword energy swooped down in a downward swipe, and when she opened her eyes again, all those surging emotions were gone.
OT
She lifted her head and looked ahead once more. Initially, she thought she wouldn’t have any feelings anymore, but as soon as she looked ahead, waves after waves of intense emotion began to sweep through her.
“It has been 10 days. Can he really last that long?”
Xi Yao was stunned when the thought appeared in her head, and she let out a bitter smile. She then proceeded to sit in a lotus position and closed her eyes.
Another ten days passed, and Jiang Ming finally appeared on the rooftop.
He was sitting on his chair as he sighed contentedly, “This is life.”
Before he came back here, he had been staying in the Supreme Pagoda for God knows how long, and he had been wanting to do this for a long time.
It looked like it had only been half a month, but under the time acceleration formation laid out by Time Linglong, it had been 15 years in the room.
“What are you talking about, senior brother?” Linglong appeared and threw herself on Jiang Ming’s body. She looked at his face and smiled brightly, “You really have had your fill this time. All of us could barely get off the bed.”
“Hmph! Now you know how good I am,” Jiang Ming replied.
“Yeah, you’re so good until you need to run away in the end.”
“What? I was bleeding, you know?”
Both of them stopped talking, and then laughed at each other.
“Do you know about the Infinite Realms Battlefield?” Jiang Ming asked.
He did not have much knowledge about that place, and he was worried about it.
“The Infinite Realms Battlefield?” Linglong said, “In the Heavenly Inheritance Space, there is a library which contains millions of books and scrolls. It tells about the countless situations across the myriad of universes, and it’s always updated. I accessed some information about our side of the world.”
After that, Linglong looked into the sky and asked, “Senior brother, do you know how vast our universe is? According to the book, each universe has one great chiliocosm, and under each great chiliocosm, there are many middle chiliocosm, but the maximum number is not more than 3,000. Further down, there is the small chiliocosm, which doesn’t exceed the number of 48,000. And then there is the mortal world, which is also known as the planar world. There are countless of them, and they constitute the building blocks of an universe.
“The great chiliocosm of our universe is known as the Honggu Heavenly Realm. In the heavenly realm, there is this one reigning supreme power called the Heaven Court, and every world in this universe is ruled by them. The lord of the Heaven Realm is known as Heavenly Emperor or Great Heavenly Venerate. He’s someone of great importance, and he can be called as the lord of all realms.
“There are many forces under the Heaven Court such as immortals, demons, monks and so on.
“They would fight endlessly against each other for different purposes such as spreading their teachings, religious reason, cultivation resources, territory, and so on. Even the Great Heavenly Venerate couldn’t control them.
“According to the records, the previous Great Heavenly Venerate was caught in the fight and died. The Heaven Court collapsed, and countless middle and small chiliocosms were destroyed because of it.
“It took the current Great Heavenly Venerate a lot of effort and energy to rebuild the Heaven Court and restore order. To prevent the history from repeating itself, he invited many experts to pour in their power to refine the once destroyed middle chiliocosms, small chiliocosms, ancient stars, and many secret realms into a special place which came to be known as the Infinite Realms Battlefield!
“It’s a place where people could fight, kill, or seek gains to their heart’s content.
“After countless years of evolution, the Infinite Realms Battlefield has gradually evolved into many realms, and because of that, all forces have gathered around and come to a consensus. They divided the Infinite Realms Battlefield into three levels: the Small Chiliocosm Battlefield, the Middle Chiliocosm Battlefield, and the Great Chiliocosm Battlefield!
“The Small Thousand Realm Battlefield can only accommodate up to Golden Immortals. The Middle Chiliocosm Battlefield can accommodate up to Great Overarching Golden Immortals. As for the Great Thousand Realm battlefield, there is only one place where, according to the records, there are even countless chaos Qi inside, as well as endless secret treasures waiting to be discovered. It’s able to withstand the battle between Quasi-Sages.
“A Quasi-Sage is an existence even more powerful than a Great Overarching Golden Immortal.
“In the heavenly realm, the realm is divided into Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, Mystical Immortal, Golden Immortal, Taiyi, Great Overarching, and Quasi-Sage, which at the same time corresponds to Immortal Soldier, Immortal Commander, Immortal General, and Immortal Lord. The Immortal Lord is the Golden Immortal, and it’s the same as the Demon Lord. Taiyi is the Immortal King, Great Overarching is the Immortal Emperor, and Quasi-Sage is the Supreme.
“The Great Heavenly Venerate is the strongest amongst the Quasi-Sages. But legend has it that in the distant past, there were beings in the Heavenly Realm who were even more powerful than the Quasi-Sages, and they were known as the Saint Lords. However, for some reasons, it seems that all the Saint Lords have disappeared without a trace.
“Therefore, there are a lot of secret treasures of immense might that even the Supremes cannot fathom left in the universe, and on top of that, there have been a lot of wars and battles happening in the Infinite Realms Battlefield over the years. Many lives have been lost, and many secrets and items have been left on the battlefield. This is why many people are attracted to the battlefield,” Linglong told Jiang Ming everything she knew about the Infinite Realms Battlefield.
However, there were a lot of things that were not recorded in the library of the Heavenly Inheritance Space, but rather, they were her memories from her previous life.
Jiang Ming listened with rapt attention, and a question rose in his head.
He knew about the stages and levels in cultivation, but he did not expect that beyond the Great Overarching was the Quasi-Sage. This was exactly the same as the mythical and legendary prehistoric realm he knew in his previous life.
Besides, the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, where Dongfang Chenxi was located, was using this cultivation system as well.
‘Could it be that this cultivation system is the real mainstream?’ He thought inwardly.
‘Oh yeah, the Supreme Pagoda. Could it be that the owner of the pagoda is a Supreme? But it doesn’t seem right. Dongfang Chenxi and I come from different Great Chiliocosms, while Sheng Qianyue comes from the Guanghui Great Chiliocosms. That is three Great Chiliocosms, which is equal to three universes! What’s more, Sheng Qianyue is the most special amongst us, and I doubt a Supreme will be able to get her over here!’
Many questions popped up in Jiang Ming’s head.
He shook his head to shake those thoughts out of his brain. After all, it wouldn’t do him any good other than giving him more worries to think about it right now.
“That’s a lot of new information!” Jiang Ming sighed, “Do you know about Chengguang Immortal Lord?”
“Chengguang Immortal Lord?” Linglong frowned. She thought for a moment before her eyes glowed and she said hesitantly, “I seem to have read about him before. Why do you ask, senior brother?”
“Do you still remember Tian Ci?”
“Of course, I do. He was known as the senior brother of all Holy Sons and Holy Daughters. It was later discovered that he was a reincarnation of an immortal and he triggered the Golden Heaven Path. Senior brother, could it be that Chengguang Immortal Lord is related to the Golden Heaven Path?
“Exactly. Tian Ci came from the Chengguang Immortal Lord Palace, and since Chengguang Immortal Lord is an immortal, he might be one of our enemies,” Jiang Ming said.
He had tried to look for Chengguang Immortal Lord through the Human Paths Record, but unfortunately, he did not get anything
“I know one Chengguang Immortal Lord, but I’m not sure if he’s the one you’re talking about,” Linglong said. She really wanted to tell him everything, but she was worried about it.
In the end, she decided not to tell Jiang Ming that she was reincarnated and said, “Under the Honggu Heavenly Realm, there is a middle chiliocosm called the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm. Within it, there is an Immortal Emperor named Bei Chengxing. Bei Chengxing has a son called Bei Chengguang. He’s at the Golden Immortal Realm, and his residence is known as the Chengguang Immortal Palace. So, senior brother, is Bei Chengguang the Chengguang Immortal Lord you are talking about?” Linglong asked as she blinked her eyes. “I guess so!” Jiang Ming nodded.
“If that were true, then it would be a big problem!” Linglong continued with her brows frowned, “Bei Chengxing comes from a middle chiliocosm. He is a Great Overarching Immortal Emperor. He’s amongst the top in his world, and he has a lot of men serving under him. As the son of an Immortal Emperor, Bei Chengguang is both powerful in terms of influence and cultivation level. If he really is the one who led our world to the Infinite Realms Battlefield, it would be a problem if he were to lead many Immortal Lords and Immortal Kings to take on us, not to mention that if his father joins the fight. It’s said that a Great Overarching Immortal Emperor is an entity who stands at the pinnacle of all the realms, transcends beyond the long river of destiny, and according to the records, can suppress Taiyi with a snap of his fingers.” “Is a Great Overarching that powerful?” Jiang Ming asked in surprise.
“Calling them powerful is an understatement. Their power is simply unfathomable,” Linglong said, “Both Phoenix Linglong and I are in the Taiyi Realm, and we could unleash a formidable battle power with the other eight Golden Immortal clones. However, even then, I don’t have the confidence that I could cut down a newly promoted Great Overarching Golden Immortal!”
“Cut down?” Jiang Ming was stunned.
Linglong nodded and said in a serious manner, “If we work together, we can hold them off, but we can’t kill them.”
The corner of Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched.
‘You just said that a Great Overarching is exceedingly powerful, but now you’re telling me that you can hold them off even though you can’t kill them? Are you kidding me?’
That being said, Jiang Ming was relieved.
He stood up and began going through his own condition.
His inner world had evolved, and he had the power of a Taiyi Golden Immortal. However, power did not mean combat strength.
Even though he had many special abilities and most of them were powerful, he could take on a Taiyi expert, but he did not think he would stand a chance against a Great Overarching expert.
‘What if I lure them to the Eastern Region? Under the enhancement of the Saint Province Dao Square, I should be able to fight toe-to-toe with an ordinary Great Overarching Golden Immortal, right? Besides, I still have a Great Overarching Immortal Weapon up my sleeves. But what if Bei Chengxing is at the peak of the Great Overarching?’ Jiang Ming thought. ‘There is no use in thinking so much about it. I should just check it out first.’
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record flipped open.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - Quasi-Sage: Little Guy, Scared Yet?
chapters.content:
Chapter 211 Quasi-Sage: Little Guy, Scared Yet?
While evoking the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming asked, “Is that heavenly inheritance of yours from a Great Heavenly Venerate of the Honggu Heavenly Realm?” “No!” Linglong placed her arms around Jiang Ming, rubbed her little face against his face and softly said, “My master’s cultivation level should be higher than that of that Great Heavenly Venerate.”
Jiang Ming nodded his head, expressing his understanding, as he turned his gaze over to the Human Path Record.
Name: Bei Chengguang Race: Half-human, half-god
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Golden Immortal Realm
Background: Palace Master of the Chengguang Immortal Palace, affiliated to the Emperor Star Palace of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm.
Relationship: -88
Innate Talent: Taiyi Status: With his father of the Innate Saint Spirit and his mother of the human race, he was born with great fortune, blessed with great luck and boundless blessings. Upon stepping into the Golden Immortal Realm, he established the Chengguang Immortal Palace. However, his cultivation remained stagnant. Later, he found out that there was a great secret hidden in the mortal world that could potentially be the supreme treasure, which might help him break through to Taiyi or even the Great Overarching Realm. Hence, he started planning his moves. After years of searching and endless investigations, he finally found the mortal world which was called the Tianyuan World.
On his first arrival, he met several other immortals that came from other realms. They were involved in a great war in the mortal world. The world was torn apart and the human race was miserable. Hence, his visit was considered a failure and he returned. However, it made him more convinced that the hidden encounter in that mortal world was of no trivial matter.
On his second visit to the mortal world however, he encountered numerous demons from the Abyssal Devils and another war broke out again. It was then that he discovered there were various immortals from other worlds who left their inheritance in the mortal wealm a long time ago. It was obvious that they had planned it for a long time.
The great battle between the immortals and devils went on for days.
The place of the hidden encounter was revealed by force. This in turn led to the descent of a Golden Crow, but it was killed inexplicably high up in the skies, falling into the hidden place and disappearing without a trace. The Immortal lands went into hiding completely.
The war that time was over just like that.
Seeing the various dangers in the mortal world, he started plotting his plan again. His subordinate, Tian Ci fell in battle in the Infinite Realm Battlefield, leaving only the remnant of his soul. With a sudden thought, Bei Chengguang imprinted the Golden Heavenly Road onto Tian Ci’s remnant of soul and projected it into the mortal world. He waited for the soul remnant to awaken, activate the imprint and allow him to descend into the mortal world, yet his plans failed again.
Endless years of stagnant cultivation base led him to feel distressed and tangled. He also knew that it was now even more difficult to seize the great encounter in the mortal world. Finally, he made up his mind to ask for his father’s aid, borrowing the Great Overarching Dao Vessel to lead the mortal world into the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Then, he plans to forcefully seize the great encounter this time.
Upon going through the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming sighed in his heart. The mortal world had been preyed upon by various great forces and was already battered. It was really a miracle that it had not been completely destroyed.
However, it seemed that all these had finally come to an end.
‘A Golden Crow descended but was killed in the sky? Was it the doing of that Tianyuan Monarch? There is only the Mountain River Map that was of the Great Overarching Dao Vessel hidden in the battlefield. So how did it lead to so many forces competing over it?’ As he pondered, he was puzzled. It would have been normal if there was an expert of a middle chiliocosm that tried to conspire against that Mountain River Map, but it seemed that there were many other forces of the Honggu Heavenly Realm that also tried their hands on it. This really seemed to be out of the ordinary. Swoosh! Jiang Ming flipped the Human Path Record onto the next page and wrote down the name: Bei Chengxing of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm.
His information was immediately revealed.
Name: Bei Chengxing
Race: Innate Saint Spirit
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm
Background: Lord of the Emperor Star Palace, One of the several Immortal Emperors of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm.
Relationship : -55
Innate Talent: Great Overarching
Status:
In the beginning of the evolution of Heaven and Earth where the black and white started its transformation and at the point where Yin and Yang finally met, the various stars of the northern sky congregated by coincidence. After absorbing the Innate Great Fortune of Creation, Bei Chengxing was born. With his Innate Divine Saint, he was born with great fortune and controlled a portion of the Starlight’s authority, processing boundless power. In the ancient times, he fought off other Innate Divine Saints and hunted down wild beasts. With each of his steps drenched with bloodshed, he rapidly grew into a peerless being and finally entered into the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, becoming an Immortal Emperor. He then established the Emperor Star Palace, stayed in control of the Starlight, controlling the authority of the stars and wielded total control over the laws.
Invited by the Great Heavenly Venerate to the Heaven Court, he followed on to join with the forces and accidentally learned that a portion of the previous Heaven Court that was beaten up, had fallen into the mortal world. There were some great hidden encounters in it. He did not care much about it as he was already at the later stage of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm. Hence, he secretly arranged that his son, Bei Chengguang will get ahold of the information and plan to use it to train him.
Never did he expect for his son to be such a failure. He is disappointed because his son still couldn’t get his hands on the great encounter, even after a few attempts.
He plans to help his son for the last time. If he still fails, then he will have to do it himself.
Jiang Ming finally understood the origin of the ancient battlefield ruin in the mortal world. It turned out to be a corner of the Heaven Court that had shattered, which was somewhat incredible.
‘This person who is at the later stage of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm should have never paid attention to the mortal world previously and yet his relationship is already – 55. Once he makes his move, I’m afraid it will be a massacre, wiping out every living being!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help worrying inside.
He would still be able to manage it if the enemy was a mere early stage Great Overarching Golden Immortal expert. However, this here was a Great Overarching Golden Immortal Expert at the later stage.
It was troublesome this time!
“To think that such a terrifying existence was born just at the beginning of the birth of a Middle Chiliocosm!’
Jiang Ming was a little melancholy. “Senior brother, what’s wrong?” Feeling a sudden change in his mood, Linglong looked up at him and asked. “Perhaps I know the real origin of that battlefield under Taiyang Peak.” As Jiang Ming explained, he hugged his little Junior Sister and stood up, “I need to go and take another look!”
“Could it be that there are still some secrets that we have yet to discover?” Linglong was a little surprised. It was quite a surprise for Linglong as she really didn’t know much about the ancient battleground ruin. “Perhaps there is. In any case, I need to go check it out again!” Jiang Ming left a clone in his place as he paced off into the air. Linglong followed behind him. The other nine Junior Sisters also appeared one after another. Most of the people of Zhong Province had all been relocated here.
Spatial Junior Sister has long since returned. Jiang Ming did not give any attention to the arrangement of these people from Zhong Province, but set a general rule that cultivators must not meddle with the commoners affairs.
Even though Heaven and Earth were shattered, it didn’t affect the Eastern Region. Hence, the ancient battlefield ruin that was hidden under Taiyang Main peak was naturally not affected as well.
Coming here again, Jiang Ming had a different experience.
“The place…” Linglong also immediately noticed that there was something wrong, “It’s been covered up!”
She turned her gaze over and looked at the stone tablet on the side. There were Daoist texts left by the Tianyuan Great Monarch: The tablet of the ancient battlefield ruin. Can be entered from the outside but cannot escape from the inside.
The rules were very simple. “The last time we were here, our cultivation base was still too low and we didn’t notice it. However, we finally discovered signs of it today.” Linglong continued, “I think that it’s the doing of this stone tablet here.” “Perhaps!” Jiang Ming replied, as his inner world was conjured, shrouding the world around them.
Jiang Ming’s inner world has now evolved into a vast, vast world and was incredibly powerful As soon as the world was projected, Linglong immediately felt her nerves tightened and some pressure from it. “Senior Brother’s Dao is really terrifying!” she gasped secretly as she took out the Mountain River Map. When evoked, the mountains and rivers will be manifested, which could suppress the immortals and prevent any unwanted incidents. Jiang Ming on the other hand, stood still.
However, several Great Overarching Dao Vessels that were hidden in his Inner World were all on the verge of being evoked.
“This place is shrouded by some sort of terrifying force. The strength of this force feels as though it can escape faith, break free from the shackles of laws and gives off a sense of freedom; it also has a some sort of Dao Fluctuation that suppresses all and even makes my heart tremble. Girl, this is way more terrifying than your power of Taiyi.” as Jiang Ming warned, his eyes kept staring at the stone tablet with an imposing gaze.
He discovered that the source of all these seemed to be coming from the stone tablet.
“I also feel it. It seems to be even stronger than the power of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal. Perhaps, this is the power of Quasi-sage!” Linglong brought up another possibility that was even more terrifying.
The two looked at each other, both worried.
“However, this is directly under the sect, so we have to investigate it either way. Otherwise, if the whole thing breaks out, it will bring even greater danger!” Jiang Ming said solemnly, “Girl, get prepared for the worst. Prepare to evoke your Heavenly Order anytime!” Jiang Ming actually preferred to just continue waiting for anything to happen. However, he didn’t have the time. They were descending into the Infinite Realm Battlefield soon and who knew what might happen there.
If any accidents happen here during the great war later on, their whole base will be destroyed. “Senior brother, what about you?” Linglong asked.
“I also have my own ways of protecting myself. Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming replied.
Linglong kept silent. Immediately after, her nine clones turned into streams of light and merged into her body, causing her aura to skyrocket.
“Girl, I thought your clones evolved from different Daos. How can they be merged into one?” Jiang Ming asked curiously. “Well, this is the specialty of my ability!” Linglong smiled and continued, “Using my body to store the different clones’ bodies allows our primordial spirit to merge, condensing ten of the bodies into one, exerting boundless combat capabilities. In this current state, I can even fight against a Great Overarching Golden Immortal expert.” “That’s great!” Jiang Ming replied as he turned around and looked at the stone tablet again.
The Sky Defensive Sweater that he wore had already pushed its defensive capability to its maximum.
The several other Great Overarching Dao Vessels were also on the verge of bursting into action.
At the same time, he secretly communicated with the Supreme Order. He would immediately escape into the Supreme Pagoda if anything went wrong. After much preparation, Jiang Ming pointed his fingers like a sword, as a single bright light burst out of his fingertips. The glints of starlight seemed to be very small yet, the immense power hidden in it terrified Linglong who was standing by his side. She couldn’t help herself from the sudden shock as her heart trembled, ‘This finger of the Senior Brother has merged various laws. Once it is sent forth, I won’t be able to even withstand it. No, I might even be killed by it. I thought I already grew fast enough, but he seems to be even crazier.” Whoosh….
The air trembled as the laws and principles in the very moment shattered under the force of his fingertips. The hidden invisible power was torn apart but quickly fell onto the stone tablet. With a loud ‘bang’ the stone tablet exploded into pieces as a ball of light appeared, slowly turning into an illusory figure.
It was an old man who had snow white hair and beard, giving off the appearance of a kind-hearted person. “To think that even a power that has reached the Great Overarching level has appeared in the mortal world!” The old man glanced at Jiang Ming and Linglong, turned his eyes, looked up into the sky and couldn’t help himself from sighing, “In the end, the mortal world is still destroyed.”
“You are not bad, so are you. You are both people with great luck and fortune, protecting the human world from complete destruction.”
The old man turned his gaze back at the two and looked at them with admiration.
“Senior, are you the Tianyuan Great Monarch World?” Jiang Ming clenched his fist in respect, as he was extremely shocked inside.
With the might of that finger of his that could decimate any substance, it only shattered the stone tablet and did not even destroy the imprint left inside it.
This was enough to show how terrifying the person opposite them was. Right that very moment, the ruin of the battlefield finally showed its true colour. No, it didn’t actually change much from how it looked previously. It was just that in the middle of the earth, there was boundless light of creation spewing out as various divine brilliance interweaved, manifesting into endless different visions, as different types of Dao Fluctuation were flowing in the surrounding area. It was truly a place of ultimate treasure.
Even without closer inspection, Jiang Ming knew that this place here was a peerless medicine field with terrifying roots of the immortal plants.
“Yes, I am the Tianyuan Great Monarch, belonging to the human race!” The old man nodded, not hiding anything and continued, “Once, I incarnated myself into thousands of planar worlds to realize the mortal world’s Dao with the aim of breaking through to a higher level! Oh the mortal worlds! Their lifespan is but a few dozens of years, a few seasons of spring and summer that would’ve been a glimpse of an eye to the cultivators. Yet, the mortals went through an immensely interesting life in this short lifespan of theirs. A person’s character, wisdom, perseverance and such was able to reach such a terrifying level in just a few decades time! Mortal World is truly the origin of Dao.” “I’ve cultivated for a long time in this mortal world and discovered this ancient battlefield ruin. It was actually a fraction of the fallen Heaven Court that had fallen into the endless space-time vortex and ended up hidden coincidently in the interlayers of the human world.” “Soon after, there were a few forces in the Heavenly Realm that noticed it and began to conspire on it. I left an imprint here to hide the true nature of the place from others.” “I also established Tianyuan School, left a legacy here, with the aim of preventing great wars befalling the world in the future, destroying the world as it is. It can also be considered the silver lining.” “In the case that the world is really destroyed, my imprint will then be awakened and I will still be able to protect a part of the world!” “I didn’t expect the world would actually give birth to the two of you peerless beings!” As the Tianyuan Great Monarch explained, he paused for a little while and looked at Linglong. With a complicated expression, he continued, “You’ve obtained the Heavenly Order! Oh the Heavenly Order that even makes me envious! It was a shame that I was no longer qualified to use it for myself and hence didn’t use it. I didn’t expect you to get a hold of it and even formed nine peerless clones! Little girl, your ambition is very great. Alas, it is only through such wild ambitions that pushes a person to attain great achievements.”
“Senior, you knew about the Heavenly Order?” Linglong asked in shock. “There are no secrets to me in this mortal world!” Tianyuan Great Monarch smiled and continued, “Since the Heavenly order has appeared in this planar world, it belongs as a great encounter to this world. Grasp the chance well and your achievements in the future may even surpass mine!”
“Senior, you should be at the Quasi-sage Realm, right?” Linglong continued asking. “Quite some insight you have, as expected from a person that accepted the inheritance there!” The Tianyuan Great Monarch nodded, “After comprehending the boundless great Dao of the mortal worlds, I’ve broken down the shackles of the Great Overarching Immortal Realm and entered the Quasi-sage Realm. I wanted to see how this mortal world will turn out in the end as there’s this legacy of Heavenly Order and this place here. Hence, other than leaving a few other means, I also sealed an imprint over here. “Senior! If you are a Quasi-sage… Then… Then… The original owner of the Heavenly Order…Could it be that he has already surpassed the Quasi-sage Realm and reached the legendary Holy Venerable Realm?” Linglong’s face had shock written all over it. “Maybe he is, or maybe even stronger than the Holy Venerable! Who knows?” The Tianyuan Great Monarch sighed as he couldn’t help showing his endless yearn towards stepping foot into the higher realm. He then waved his hand and continued, “Since you’ve gotten the Heavenly Order and also received the inheritance, it means that you have a promising future and you will definitely find out about the true meaning behind the Heavenly Order in the future.” He then looked over at Jiang Ming again with a strange expression and continued, “You actually walk the path of the World Dao, and even conjured yourself a small chiliocosm. Little guy, I have to say, your encounters are much more terrifying than that of this little girl here. You are a creature that belongs to the mortal world. With the superficiality of this human planar world, it is impossible for you to comprehend the World Dao unless you’ve obtained some heaven-defying encounters that are beyond common sense.”
Without pausing, he quickly continued, “You don’t have to tell me what it is and I don’t want to know about it either. I fear I won’t be able to stop myself from just killing you for it! Encounters, they’re both the most miraculous yet unpredictable.
Jiang Ming twitched the corner of his mouth and muttered, “Senior, the current you in front of me is but only an imprint. I’m afraid you can’t do anything to me.”
“Little guy, this planar world here has great restraints onto those of the Great Overarching Realm. However, it is considerably less towards stronger cultivators such as myself.” The Tianyuan Great Monarch couldn’t help but rejoice, “Moreover, now that this mortal world is shattered, I have my imprint right here and so my true self can just descend here anytime I wish to.”
“To walk the path of Worlds Dao! For those experts who truly understood the meaning of it, they will go crazy! Scared yet?”
The Tianyuan Great Monarch’s face suddenly sank, as the surrounding atmosphere suddenly became extremely depressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - Qian Yuan, the secret amidst the Chaos, great encounters
chapters.content:
Chapter 212 Qian Yuan, the secret amidst the Chaos, great encounters
Boom!
Black lightning suddenly flashed on top of their heads as each stroke of lightning could easily destroy the sky and shatter the earth; The surrounding space started to crack, obliterating all laws and suppressing boundless Dao and Laws. It was an extremely terrifying phenomena. The divine brilliance that illuminated felt like prison, suppressing both the past and present. Jiang Ming’s heart started beating wildly.
Swoosh…
The Human Path Record was opened diagonally above as Jiang Ming continued staring at the great monarch. He discovered that this Tianyuan Great Monarch didn’t look at his Human Path Record, which brought him some relief.
Name: Qian Yuan (A strand of divine spiritual imprint)
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Quasi-Sage
Background: Master of the Tianyuan Mountain in Honggu Heavenly Realm
Relationship: 78
Innate talent: Quasi-Sage
Status: Originally a peasant’s son at a mountain village in the mortal world, he was born with an Innate Daoist body. Being poor during his childhood, he obtained great wisdom and tenacity in the very early years. He worked as a shepherd, an apprentice, joined gangs and even the officials for a living and met with Immortal encounters by chance.
By only relying on himself, he abruptly cultivated himself into success and started to have a feel of the world.
After his ascension, he joined one of the Immortal Sect and grew up in a carefree environment. However, the sect was weak and was oppressed by one of the Immortal Kings of the previous Heavenly Court. The sect was destroyed and he escaped the tragedy.
Having his master killed, his Junior Sister dying tragically and the sect completely destroyed, there was a monstrous amount of hatred that brewed in his heart.
He retreated into the mountains for millions of years, put on a new face, entered various forbidden areas, ventured through dangerous places, and obtained countless great encounters which led to his cultivation improving continuously. He finally reached the Great Overarching Immortal Realm. Just as the Heaven Court seemed to be crumbling anytime, he took this opportunity to secretly kill off all of the Immortal King’s lineage, leaving no one behind. After taking revenge, his immense hatred slowly dissolved as he turned into a free and unfettered Solo Immortal, traveling freely through the boundless worlds. In the end, he opened up a Dao square in Tianyuan Mountain and claimed himself to be the master of Tianyuan Mountain. Although he did not take in any disciples, he secretly instructed countless descendants of the human race.
When he comprehended Great Overarching Immortal Realm up to perfection, he took the risk of splitting himself into countless avatars and reincarnated in various different world in order to comprehend the great Dao of the mortals, accumulate the encounters of Dao to take a step further in his cultivation. One of his reincarnations came to the Tianyuan World, cultivated to the Imminent Immortal Realm and awakened his memory. He discovered there was a fraction of the Heaven Court’s pieces that was hidden in the world. He also faintly detected that this planar world’s future is ever changing with great fortune but also with great destruction. He decided to stay and continued observing.
Immortals, Buddhist, Devils and Demons ascended into the mortal world and brought harm to the world. Even though he had been accustomed to life and death, he still pitied the human there and spread laws around, creating the Tinayuan School. As Tianyuan School continued becoming stronger and stronger, ascenders appeared one after another and the world was named Tianyuan World.
He was shocked when he later discovered a secret area with a Heavenly Order hidden in it. Unfortunately, based on some of the secrets he knew that those of the Great Overarching Immortal Realm are not eligible for the Heavenly Order’s inheritance.
Coupled with a small piece of Heaven Court that fell into this world here, he calculated that there is bound to be major changes in this world in the future. He paid more attention to the world and left a stone tablet at the ancient battlefield ruin with his imprint to suppress the place. He wanted to avoid any remnant spirits that were born from it from wreaking havoc in the mortal world and protect it from being completely destroyed, along with the extinction of the human beings. His avatar in this world was recalled by his original self, as he retreated into cultivation for several years, finally breaking through into the realms of Quasi-Sage and became a great influence in the Heavenly Realm. He continued wandering in the heavens and left a strand of divine spiritual subconscious in Tianyuan World, waiting for the reform of the future generations. As the stone tablet that suppressed the ancient battlefield ruin was destroyed, his divine spiritual subconscious was awakened. He sensed the changes that the world has gone through and couldn’t help but sighed. Alas, the world still suffered a great catastrophe in the end. Luckily there are still two regions dominated by the human race that survived.
As he took in the memories of the void and got ahold of what happened in the past, he was very amazed.
Although Zi Linglong has evoked nine clones with each of them walking on the great path of Daos, her own cultivation wasn’t stunted by it at all, which showed how she was truly of a genius of the era, peerless among all. Furthermore, she even got a hold of the Heavenly Order.
But what about Jiang Ming here? What is actually going on with him? To walk on the path of World Dao and even conjured himself a small chiliocosm. This is just unbelievable beyond common sense.
Growing up in a planar world and actually leading to the birth of a small chiliocosm. He felt as though he was being taken for a fool. It was just too unreal. This boy’s combat ability is even more terrifying. He managed to shatter the stone tablet that was suppressing the area here with an instance of eruption of power that reached the Daluo Immortal Realm. It was too unimaginable. However, his cultivation base is only of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
God damn! Never have I seen such an outrageous thing in all these years as I travelled the boundless heavenly worlds and cruised through the endless chaotic domain. This kid’s achievement in the future is surely not of the human level.
The great encounter that he holds is probably sky-defying to the extreme, that even made my heart flutter. However, he is but a junior of the human race. How can I even bring myself to make my move!
The hidden secret behind such a great encounter of his even gave me the chills. Needless to say, his inheritance and the people supporting him must have come from that place.
Moreover, there’s a terrifying aura that is lurking throughout the Eastern Territory that made it difficult for even myself to see through. It is comparable to the Dao Square of a Holy Venerable already! This kid will definitely reign through the Heavenly Realm in the future. But this little guy here is quite calm, so I’ll just give him a scare and see how it goes.
As Jiang Ming finished looking through the Human Path Record, he was left speechless. However, looking at the background of this old man, he seemed to be not ordinary at all and was even a real Quasi-Sage Realm Expert. In the Heavenly Realm where there were no Holy Venerate, he was considered a figure that stood above all.
The main thing was that he was of the human race.
He was still able to achieve the Quasi-Sage even though he was born with an ordinary background. It was unbelievable!
His ‘relationship’ value was close to 80, which was not bad as well and was considerably high already
“This old guy who even cruised through the endless chaotic domain guessed that I have a terrifying existence behind me? Could it be that there was an even higher realm than the chaotic domain? I guess all is well. This unwarranted identity will be able to deter these experts a little. And he is trying to scare me? Haha! Well, I won’t lose anything from it, so I guess I’ll just let you scare me a little.’ Thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind as he read the information.
“Senior, we human race gives great importance to respecting the elders and loving the young ones, being consistent when facing against those of the outside world.” Upon sensing the terrifying aura from the surroundings, Jiang Ming bowed down yet again and continued, “My junior Sister and I are both geniuses that have never been seen for ages. You would’ve given us all the protection and love you could. How would you even harm us?” “Haha!” The Tianyuan Great Monarch couldn’t help himself from bursting into laughter as the suppressing aura that lurked into the atmosphere was swept away in an instant. He looked at Jiang Ming and said with admiration, “Little guy, you have a good heart. However, you seem poised with great confidence, which means that even If I wouldn’t be able to touch you even if I wanted to, right?”
Jiang Ming only smiled in response. However, he was secretly mumbling in his heart, ‘How can I be confident if I didn’t know that was just a deterrent!’ Linglong who was standing anxiously beside Jiang Ming secretly let out a breath of relief. “Can you tell me a little about your inheritance?” Tianyuan Great Monarch hesitated a little but couldn’t help himself from asking the question. However, he lowered his voice a little and asked with sincerity. “I don’t understand the specifics either!” Jiang Ming smiled helplessly and continued, “I’ve just become a disciple myself. The day I finally conjure my inner world into a middle chiliocosm will be the time that I can finally be accepted into the Supreme Holy Land. For now, I am still unqualified. Senior, you’re of the Quasi-Sage Realm and must’ve cruised through the chaotic domain right? Do you know which supreme forces are harsher when recruiting for disciples? I want to understand a little bit more in advance.” “You knew about that place in the chaotic domain?” the Tianyuan Great Monarch was taken aback and his mind was suddenly clear, “That makes sense. Since there isn’t any Holy Venerate in the Heavenly Realm currently, only that level of existence would be able to nurture such a disciple like you. They are extremely harsh when it comes to recruiting disciples but shouldn’t be to the extent of requiring you to conjure up a great chiliocosm before accepting you. Hmm, the middle chiliocosm! Once it’s completed, the person’s inherent power of origin would be comparable to… comparable to that of…”
At that moment, the great monarch was so amazed that he was at loss of words
Jiang Ming’s heart also trembled upon hearing it.
There seemed to be an even higher realm in the chaotic domain! “All the Holy Venerable went to that place?” Jiang Ming asked again. “Of course! You will understand more in the future. I can’t say too much about it.” Tianyuan nodded, as he suddenly felt a little emotional, “Now that there’s the two of you in this world, I can be completely relieved!” “Senior, the world has been destroyed.” Jiang Ming smiled bitterly and continued, “Even after it has been destroyed, our world is currently being dragged towards the Infinite Realm Battlefield. No one can be sure of what will happen then.” “Everything has a beginning and an end, a cycle of life and death. Humans are like this, and the same goes for the World!” The Tianyuan Great Monarch continued, “After a planar world is born, it will evolve continuously. After a certain period of time, once it cannot continue to advance into the next level, it will veer towards extinction. This world has long been tossed around to the point where it was basically impossible to make the transition into the next level anymore. Now that it has reached this point in time, if it’s destroyed, so be it. You can lead them into the Infinite Realm Battlefield. After they gain a firm foothold over there, it will also be their fortune in the making.’ “Immortals also have a limited lifespan?” Jiang Ming was surprised. “Well of course!” The Tianyuan Great Monarch continued explaining the reason behind it, “Each universe has a long river of destiny and all spirits has its corresponding imprint on the long river of destiny upon birth which is limited to one world. If the world perishes, life perishes as well. How can the Immortals that also rely on the world survive alone? It’s just because the lifespan of a world is too long. Also, this world that they are relying on, isn’t the planar world or even the small chiliocosm, but the great chiliocosm of each universe. If a mortal world perishes and the creatures still have a place to go, they will be safe and sound. However, once the Heavenly Realm is destroyed, countless sentient beings will all be destroyed together. A person will have the possibility of surviving alone if he advances into the Great Overarching Realm, transitioning his life and escaping the shackles of destiny. Also, if there’s a great being that can take out the imprints from the long river of destiny, then that can also be regarded as breaking free of the confinement of fate.” “To think there’s such a secret!” Jiang Ming gasped in surprise, “If that’s the case, then having the mortal world descending into the Infinite Realm Battleworld is really a chance for a great encounter?”
“Of course.”
“Senior, what if I provoked a Great Overarching Golden Immortal or other great forces over in the Heavenly Realm there? Once I reach that place, how am I to deal with it?”
“Don’t worry! Those Great Overarching Golden Immortal experts are all great giant forces and people with great status. Who would even squabble with the junior ones? Moreover, would you even be afraid to face a Great OverarchingGolden Immortal Expert? They’re the ones courting death! Haha! Young one, I’ll be going now and I’m leaving this place over to the two of you. By the way, this hidden ruin is actually a medicine field from the last Heaven Court. Transplanting them into your inner world will greatly promote the evolution of your inner world. Also, if you have the capability, then try and refine this whole piece of ruin. After all, it’s formerly the land of the Immortals and is considered supreme nourishment for your inner world!”
Jiang Ming’s opened his mouth as he wanted to keep him around longer but it was too late. Right as the Tianyuan Great Monarch finished, his body collapsed and dissipated immediately.
“Does he need to be in such a hurry?” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
In the ‘status’ of this Tianyuan Great Monarch however there was another sentence that appeared at the end, saying: I can’t go on talking. If I accidentally leak some information that the strong person behind him doesn’t want him to know for the time being and he turns his anger on me, I’ll be in great trouble. Sigh! This kid and his damn encounter even made me envious! The Infinite Realm Battlefield will turn lively in the near future! Same goes for the Heavenly Realm! Hehe, it would be interesting if some Great Heavenly Venerate provokes him.
Jiang Ming was speechless again when he read that last sentence. To think that he left because he was afraid of the unwarranted peerless being behind him.
This old guy seemed to be quite interesting for actually wanting to just sit and watch the whole ordeal.
“I thought he was going to give us a hard time!” Linglong breathed out a sigh of relief, dispelling the special abilities that had been brewing in her body. The nine clones were separated from her body but continued to occupy a place in all directions to scout around and prevent other incidents from happening “He is after all an old senior of the human race. How would he make it difficult for the two of us juniors?” Jiang Ming smiled, and continued, “Let’s go and see the medicinal field of the Heaven Court!” “Alright!” Linglong was also looking forward to it as well. They paced in the air and quickly reached the medicinal field.
The divine luminance here intertwined with each other as good fortune flowed in the atmosphere, materializing different types of Dao fluctuation. As the aura of vitality was dense like the vast ocean, the whole ordeal was phenomenal! “This concealment formation seems to be quite common. The Tianyuan Great Monarch most likely broke through a portion of it.” As Linglong commented, she requested that Spatial Junior Sister walk right into the place first.
“I’m always the first to go in when there’s danger and you’re always the first to have a go at Senior Brother.” Spatial Junior Sister pouted but still moved forward obediently.
“Are you asking for a beating!” Linglong simply smiled, as Jiang Ming was left speechless.
“Senior Brother!” Yin-Yang Junior Sister hugged onto Jiang Ming arm and swayed in between her breasts, and continued ‘The Yin-Yang Dao is the root of the boundless laws, and the foundation of the world. Now that we have encountered such a place how can we not perform the act of yin and yang creation? Otherwise, it would be a waste of this beautiful scenery!”
*Smack Smack*
Jiang Ming slapped and flicked her left breast with the back of his hand as Linglong’s arm stretched out and patted the right breast. The Yin-Yang Junior Sister gave a coquettish cry, “You only know how to bully people! Humph, wait till the next time we are united as one! I will trap you for 1,000 years and exhaust you to death, Senior Brother! I’ll also let our real self be starved of you!”
Jiang Ming was speechless yet again. “There’s no danger!” Linglong ignored her as she muttered and continued advancing onwards.
Jiang Ming also went onwards as the rest of the Junior Sisters followed suit. Upon stepping foot into the medicinal field, an extremely dense Immortal Spirit Natural Aura came rushing towards them. Jiang Ming felt as though there was a whole sea with raging waves pummeling onto him, drowning him.
The high quality of the Immortal Spirit and the vitality aura that was extraordinarily dense, coupled with the weaving of the immortal luminance, really opened up his eyes as he was extremely amazed by it. There were fruit trees as high as 10,000 feet and even immortal herbs that could even conjure various shocking phenomena, a whole plethora of medicinal herbs.
The medicinal field looked to be not more than 10 acres in diameter from the outside, but was extremely vast to more than even ten thousand miles in size from the inside.
There were immortal veins below and the immortal spirit had even gathered to form a long river flowing through, watering the whole area.
“Senior Brother, there are tens of thousands of immortal herbs here! As far as I know, these are all extremely rare and valuable even in the Immortal Realm; There’s also more than 10 kinds of immortal fruits where most of them are of middle and low-graded spiritual roots. Spiritual roots are more precious and rarer that each of them are considered a rare Immortal existence. The middle-graded spiritual root would even lead the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm experts to fight over it!This place is indeed qualified to be the medicinal garden that used to belong to the Heaven Court. It’s quite unexpected that the Tianyuan Great Monarch did not take them for himself.” While Linglong was amazed by the medicinal field, she couldn’t help but sighed at the generosity of that Tianyuan Great Monarch. “Tianyuan Great Monarch is worthy of being the great existence of our human race with such noble qualities!” Jiang Ming added. Linglong nodded her head and hurriedly urged, “Senior Brother, hurry up and put them into your inner world. After all, immortal medicine and spiritual roots have endless vitality and can even promote the cycle of creation. It will definitely speed up the evolution of your inner world!” “Alright!” Jiang Ming responded. He didn’t say much as he also knew that time was of the essence. Conjuring his inner world, he formed a large black hole and forcefully stored the whole medicinal field inside. Then, he sat cross-legged in the sky, used the world projection technique to shroud the entire ruin of the battlefield and began to evoke his special ability to refine the Immortal Land and turn them into nourishment for his inner world. Ten days later, Jiang Ming finally reappeared on top of Chuyang Peak. “That almost exhaust me to death!” he swayed leisurely on a rattan chair.
Yin-Yang Junior Sister came over with a teacup, took a sip and then leaned in front of him, transferring the mouthful of tea directly into his mouth. “Have a good rest and replenish yourself. Come, Senior Brother, take another sip.” His mouth was filled with fragrance.
Suddenly, a streak of light streamed over to him.
Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed and the stream just stood still before disintegrating, turning into runes that formed lines of words.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - One Trillion Heavenly Immortals, Reuniting with Qingxian
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: One Trillion Heavenly Immortals, Reuniting with Qingxian
The text formed right in front of him was from the Sect Master.
The relocation of the people of Zhong Province was originally a huge task but the resettlement was completed in the shortest time through the cooperation of many experts
After that, Liu Changkong came over on behalf of Tianyuan School. After negotiating to reform the orders, he sent over the rules and regulations to Chuyang Peak’s to go through.
Now, even an idiot knew that Chuyang Peak was actually the real anchor. Anything related to the future, as well as life and death would have to be aligned with Chuyang Peak.
