Even if they no longer paid attention to the mundane things of the world, if the action would result in great changes, the plan would still need to be gone through by them over at Chuyang Peak.
“They seem to be understanding!” Linglong took a glance and couldn’t help laughing, “With Jiuyang Sect taking the role as the leader, they preach to the world in the name of Jiuyang Sect for all the people to take on cultivations, allowing legacies to be continuously inherited and to make sure that further improvements will be continuous. It is also in order to cope with the impending catastrophes in the future.”
“Overall, it’s not bad!” Jiang Ming nodded in agreement and continued, “Just let them be. However much they make a fuss of things, it’s all trivial matters but at least this time there’s order to things.”
Linglong very much agreed to this.
However, the current conditions for cultivation were now above average.
Looking to the North, Xi Yao had already broken through and entered the Paradis Realm.
Chang Yiming’s cultivation base had also reached the pinnacle of Nascent Soul Realm and would step into the Primal Spirit Realm very soon.
“Senior brother, I already started to sense the aura from the Infinite Realm Battlefield. We will soon descend there. Let’s first make a plan!” Linglong stood up, gazing into the depth of the sky.
Without the stars in the skies as well as the disappearance of the moon and sun, the sky above looked extremely strange.
Beyond the thin layer of membrane were endless torrents of time and space, full of boundless dangers.
Updates by
. com
She turned around, sat on Jiang Ming’s lap and asked: “What if... What if we lose this time? What will we do?”
“Well, of course our lives will be the first priority.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Don’t worry. I’m not a pedantic old man and I’m not going to die trying to save just that one mountain. If it really gets to that point, I’ll just take the entire Eastern Region into my inner world and make a run for it.”
“I was really afraid that you would die forcing yourself to protect the mountain!” Linglong smiled and was relieved.
She laid down onto Jiang Ming, enjoying the rare silence.
Jiang Ming closed his eyes as his subconscious sank into his inner world.
Currently, the whole inner world had been evolving rapidly.
After he took in that small portion of medicinal field that was once a part of the Heaven Court, he planted it in the middle of the vast parchment of land. The soil below was Preternatural Soil which allowed the many immortal herbs to grow even more vigorously.
The breath of natural aura was integrated into the atmosphere and absorbed by the origin, causing the evolution of the inner world to skyrocket.
Vitality was the main core for a world.
The battlefield ruin that was refined was also rapidly absorbed and digested by his inner world.
‘If it goes on like this, it won’t be long before the inner world derives the true immortal laws! I can wait no longer! Otherwise, once the true immortal laws are derived, I will automatically enter the True Immortal Realm. That would not be as perfect as I wanted.’
As Jiang Ming’s thoughts raced through his mind, he recovered himself and made ample preparation. Opening his eyes, he pinched Linglong’s delicate nose as she was laying on top of him and softly muttered, “I need to leave for a while”
“Alright, I’ll hold the fort!” Linglong startled as she turned over to the side.
“Don’t worry, I’ll be back soon!” Jiang Ming said, as a token suddenly appeared in front of him, glowing faintly as his figure disappeared without a trace.
With a flash of light from the Supreme Order, he plunged into the endless time and space.
This time, he did not hide the fact that he had a Supreme Order.
“That token…” Linglong couldn’t help but laugh, “It turns out that Senior Brother has obtained a similar inheritance to mine. No wonder he is improving so quickly!”
Inside the Supreme Pagoda, Jiang Ming appeared on top of a piece of land suspended in the endless void.
No matter how you looked at it, the place seemed to be the remnants after a world’s destruction.
Suddenly, a huge and incomparable voice started to echo from the surrounding: “Jiang Ming, congratulations on entering the Immortal Realm. The assessment will now be carried out. Only by passing the assessment, can you enter the Immortal Realm Supreme Pagoda.”
“There is one item in the content of the assessment! Corresponding to your cultivation realm, trillion of Heavenly Immortals in the Infinite Realms are ranked in terms of combat power, the ten-thousandth person will be used as a template to create an opponent. Kill the opponent and the assessment is passed. Fail the assessment and the Supreme Order will disappear. Please choose your Immortal Soldier. Tips: Immortal Soldiers are up to level 12.”
“Jiang Ming of the Human Race, we wish you good luck.”
As the sound disappeared, a screen appeared right in front of Jiang Ming with all kinds of Immortal Weapons listed on it. He randomly chose a long sword and with a flick of his finger, the sword broke.
He smiled casually and lost interest.
‘A trillion Heavenly Immortals, choosing the ten-thousandth as the combat template!’
Jiang Ming felt a bit of a headache at the number. Such a number really caused him to despair.
A young man in white appeared right in front of him holding onto a long sword. After waiting 30 seconds for the barrier between them to disappear, the young man quickly lunged into action.
“Boundless Catastrophe! ”
As he muttered the words, sword lights swept through. An outburst of dark lightning,?three-fold heavenly flames, storms of destruction, absolute freezing confinement, soul annihilation technique and so on were bombarded at Jiang Ming simultaneously.
Even lines of blood veins surfaced on his body, bursting with terrifying power that merged into the slash.
It was an attempt to kill with a single slash.
Jiang Ming raised his arm lightly, his mana whistled, evoking the orders of Taichi, forming the Yin-Yang Dao Chart. As it rotated, the slash was blocked completely.
“The power of mind, the mana of the primordial spirit and the power of the physique merged into one that formed the eruption of power for this sword slash can even slay a Mystical Immortal!”
Jiang Ming had his preliminary assessment of the exchange.
The Mystical Immortal that he referred to was based on the Devil General that descended into Tianyuan World.
After understanding the power, he pinched his finger and the Yin-Yang qi turned into a strangling force, completely wiping out the opponent.
“Congratulations Jiang Ming! You have passed the assessment. You will now enter the Supreme Pagoda of the Immortal Realm!”
Right after the sound ended, the space around Jiang Ming collapsed and he reappeared in another place the very next moment.
It was a very vast plaza that was illuminated by all kinds of divine light. The Immortal Spirits were so dense that it seemed to almost materialize as it flowed slowly through the air.
On the right, there was a huge lake that was covered with lotus leaves and blossoming lotus flowers. Not, referring to it as a lotus platform seemed to be much more appropriate.
The lights from the lotus flower slowly turned with Dao fluctuation gathering on its surface.
Jiang Ming discovered that some of these lotus flowers even had people sitting cross-legged on top of it, conducting their cultivation. However, most of them were empty.
There were seven pagodas suspended on both sides in front of him where each of them had nine levels, surrounded by divine light that made it look extremely sacred. At the rear right, it was a Heavenly Ladder which was very wide that extended into the depth of the sky. The ladder had a platform for every nine steps as a dividing line, which should be the same as the previous Heavenly Ladder that he went on.
There were a lot of people scattered around the plaza as they gathered in twos or threes. Some of them were drinking, while others were chatting leisurely. The place looked quite idle.
Jiang Ming glanced around and got a general impression of the place.
Compared with the previous Supreme Pagoda, there were quite a lot of changes to it.
There were no longer the Heaven Battle Stage, Million Dao Chart and the Heavenly Monuments.
It was at this moment, a stream of messages flowed into his mind.
‘This is the inside of the Immortal Realm Supreme Pagoda. On the left is the Dao Enlightenment Sea. Upon entering it and landing on top of the lotus flowers, it allows you to submerge into the Dao Enlightenment state. Two hours is equivalent to one point. It’s a real state of enlightenment.’
‘The seven pagodas in the front right are called the Battle Towers. Each one corresponds to a realm from level 11, the Heavenly Immortal Realm, to level 17, the Quasi-Sage Realm. Breaking through the pagoda allows you to accumulate points. The Battle Tower that you enter corresponds to your own realm. Prior to the Golden Immortal Realm, one level is equivalent to one point; if you surpass your own realm, the points will be increased by tenfold; once you break through the Golden Immortal Battle Towers, your accumulated points will be multiplied by a hundred fold.’
‘The one on the rear right is still the Heavenly Ladder. Every ninth step is a different level and its points are similar to that of the Battle Tower. For example, if you step onto the first level, you will attain 1 point, the tenth level will be a ten point, and so on. Once you cross the Heavenly Ladder that corresponds to his Golden Immortal Realm, the points will increase by a hundred fold.’
‘Whether it is the Battle Tower or the Heavenly Ladder, all of them are based on the strongest figures of the same cultivation base across the Infinite Realms as the template.’
‘Taking the first Battle Tower for example, the strong cultivator that is ranked at the ten-thousandth among the one trillion Heavenly Immortals is used as the template for the first level of test; similarly, the first step of the Heavenly Ladder is based on the will of the person ranked at ten-thousandth.’
‘Then, it is constantly increased in strength. The combat power of the ninth level of the first Tower Pagoda is equivalent to the combat power of the cultivator ranked 100.’
‘The second tower is the True Immortal Battle Tower where it uses the ten-thousandth ranked expert among the one hundred billion True Immortals of the Infinite Realm as its template; the Mysterious Immortals corresponds to the ten thousandth of the ten billion cultivators; the Golden Immortal battle Tower corresponds to the one thousandth ranked cultivators among the one billion Golden Immortal Ranked experts; the Taiyi Battle Tower corresponds to the hundredth ranked expert as its template and so on.’
‘For each cultivation realm, a person has three chances to enter the Supreme Pagoda; once the chances are exhausted, it will cost you one point to enter again. If you have exhausted the three times and no longer have any points, you will lose the Supreme Order.’
‘When compared with the outside world, the time difference has also changed and is no longer the same as before: however long you stayed here will be equivalent to two hours in the outside world. Rather the flow of time here is a thousand times greater than that of the original flow of time. One year in the outside world is akin to a thousand years here.’
“There are more restrictions now. Points are even more important now and even the flow of time has changed!”
Jiang Ming sighed to himself and felt a familiar aura coming towards him.
Turning over to have a look, he couldn’t help but smile.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian called out with a smile and hint of excitement. She clasped her fist to greet him and continued, “I knew you would definitely come here! I was right!”
“Miss Ye!” Jiang Ming clasped his fist to return her greeting.
The two looked at each other and smiled as one of them took out a set of sofas and sat down.
“Have you seen any other acquaintances?”Jiang Ming took out a bottle of immortal brew, poured a glass and handed it over to her before filling himself a glass as well.
They cheered and took a sip.
“No I didn’t!” Ye Qingxian shook her head and continued, “Each person only has three free chances of entering the place for every realm and not many people will want to waste it. This makes it extremely difficult to meet past Daoist friends. When you enter the Immortal Realm Supreme Pagoda, the tests are also much more difficult and the difficulty of accumulating points has also increased exponentially.”
“Did it?” Jiang Ming wondered. During the test earlier, he didn’t find it too difficult.
Ye Qingxian was speechless as she rolled her eyes at him. For a lady who was cold-shouldered towards others and had the poise of a queen, her act of rolling her eyes looked captivating instead.
She also felt that what she did was somewhat inappropriate as she collected herself and continued, “Who can even compare to you? In my world, I can overwhelm those of the same generation, but you, on the other hand, can overwhelm the whole Infinite Realm. You might think that it was easy, but to me, it’s not any simple matter. I almost lost the test and was even more desperate after successfully entering here.”
“What do you mean?” Jiang Ming was very surprised.
Ye Qingxian was able to join the Chatroom which spoke of some volume. However, she was now saying that she was in despair upon arriving here, which seemed to be quite abnormal.
She pointed to the Battle Tower and explained: “I am still on level 11 which is the Heavenly Immortal Realm. When I entered the First Battle Tower, I only passed the second level and got a total of two points.”
“No way!” Jiang Ming was taken aback.
“Yes way!” Ye Qingxian sighed and she continued, “Moreover, the combat power of everyone’s tests were of not much difference but the special abilities kept on changing. There isn’t much value in referring to each other on the tests. The first level is equivalent to the assessment when we first entered the Supreme Tower, the second level however is equivalent to twice the combat power of the first level and the third level would be doubled yet again! I heard that the last level, which is the ninth level, is extremely terrifying and can even slay the ordinary Golden Immortal Expert.”
“Isn’t the tenth level’s combat power supposed to be based on the hundredth ranked cultivator among the trillion Heavenly Immortals? How can it be so terrifying? No matter how many of these Heavenly Immortals that exist, they are still just Heavenly Immortals. Taking my universe for example, although there isn’t exactly one trillion Heavenly Immortals there, the numbers are quite close already.” Jiang Ming was puzzled.
Ye Qingxian on the other hand gave him a strange look.

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - Brother Jiang, Can I Latch Onto You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Brother Jiang, Can I Latch Onto You?
Ye Qingxian had been here for quite a long time, met quite a few people and had learned about a lot of the norms around the place.
For example, there were cultivators ranging from level 11 to level 15, or the Heavenly Immortal Realm to the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm, and not a Realm for each level.
The opponents in the Battle Tower were all at the pinnacle of their Realm.
The so-called one trillion Heavenly Immortal Realm cultivators that were ranked, were not just from the planar world or small chiliocosm but truly covered the all of the infinite realms including: planar world, small chiliocosm, middle chiliocosm, great chiliocosm and others.
“I suspect that this ranking of Heavenly Immortal includes the entire Infinite Realms. The person ranked at the ten-thousand is the real ten-thousand ranked among all of the Heavenly Immortals.” Ye Qingxian smiled bitterly and continued, “Brother Jiang, do you know what this means?”
“It means it is almost impossible to get through a Battle Tower under the same realm!” Jiang Ming’s face turned into shock.
Ye Qingxian nodded in agreement and continued: “As far as I know, there are no more than 10 persons who have ever completely broken through the first Battle Tower!”
“That shouldn’t be!” Jiang Ming exclaimed, and suddenly continued, “No, it should be said that such a number of people is already considered a lot!”
“That’s right! After all, obtaining the Supreme Order requires great encounters and cannot be snatched or obtained through a person’s strength. Without great encounters, it is impossible to obtain them. Most of the Supreme Orders are scattered in the planar worlds instead of the extraordinary worlds. Its existence is especially less in the great chiliocosm. You might have noticed this before!”
Yes, I did notice!”
Jiang Ming recalled the previous Supreme Chat Room, there were only two that came from great chiliocosms.
These two who were from great chiliocosms both had amazing backgrounds.
Dongfang Chenxi’s father was an Immortal Emperor at the Quasi-Sage Realm while the person behind Sheng Qianyue was a Holy Venerate.
As for the other members, they were either from the planar worlds or from small chiliocosms.
Updates by
. com
Even the other creatures that they encountered were mostly from planar worlds.
It was clear from these numbers that the Supreme Pagoda was more inclined towards the mortal beings.
“However hard it might be, the number of people that broke through the first Battle Tower shouldn’t be less than 10!” Jiang Ming was getting skeptical, “Take Sheng Qianyue and Dongfang Chenxi for example, if the two of them came here, even if they couldn’t break through the first Battle Tower, they would probably almost have it.”
“I knew you would say that! But there are very few people who are like them!” Ye Qingxian exclaimed and continued, “It should be said that it’s extremely rare to the point that there may not be one of them in existence through countless epochs! However, the two of them appeared in our group at the same time. I didn’t feel anything about it before but now that I’ve arrived here, I realized the two of them being gathered in one place is just unimaginable! Moreover, those who are able to get their hands on the Supreme Order have great fortune. To the great chiliocosm however, great fortune would mean that their cultivation base would’ve exceeded Heavenly Immortal Realm as soon as they were born. The reason why there are so many beings here is because when they obtained the Supreme order, they were Heavenly Immortals or True Immortals already.”
Jiang Ming merely smiled bitterly because what Ye Qingxian had said was not a possibility, but a fact.
Take Dongfang Chenxi for example. If it weren’t for her father’s seal, and her deliberately walking on the path of the World Dao, she would have become a Heavenly Immortal or even Golden Immortal long ago.
There was also Sheng Qianyue, whose innate talent and bloodline were sealed. Even so, she was already an Imminent Immortal at the age of ten. Once the seal was unlocked, even if she did not cultivate, her cultivation base would still skyrocket.
“Moreover, any seal is useless here!” Ye Qingxian laughed and continued, “If Sheng Qianyue arrives here and her seal is lifted, guess what would’ve happened next? Would she reach True Immortal, Mysterious Immortal or even Golden Immortal? All of these are possible! How can she even break through the first Battle Tower then! Also, she might even ascend into the next realm while she’s breaking through the tower.”
“Brother Jiang, are you thinking that the second Battle Tower will be easier?” Ye Qingxian paused, and continued with a big smile on her face, “It’s actually not. The higher the cultivation base, the higher the realm, the harder it is to break through a level higher. You might think that you are a genius in the countless epochs, overwhelming the era. However, the guardians of the Supreme Pagoda are much more of a genius and even more terrifying that you are. How do you plan on defeating them? How do you plan on getting through?”
“Wouldn’t this mean that accumulating points will be extremely difficult?” Jiang Ming suckled as he asked. He finally completely understood the situation.
It was not difficult but it was abnormally difficult!
“As far as I know, there are very, very few people who have more than 100 points here. It’s just extremely rare.” At this point, Ye Qingxian paused and looked over at Jiang Ming with a glint of resentment but more towards envy.
“What kind of look are you giving me here!”
“Envy! Your accumulated points give me the urge to rob you!”
“Hehe! I don’t have many points with me. Really, it’s not much!”
“Can you at least tell me? I think exceeding the thousands isn’t a problem for you right? Sigh! If I knew it earlier, I wouldn’t have broken through the Immortal Realm so soon. I didn’t know that these points were so precious before. Now that I realize this, I no longer have the chance to get a huge amount of them! Alas, the mortal realm’s Supreme Pagoda is the real true love! Compared to this place, it was a fairyland, a heaven for accumulating points!”
“Yeah! I’m also regretting this already! As for my points? Cough* it’s in the ten thousands!”
“God damn it!”
Ye Qingxian couldn’t help but let out vulgarity, gave him a thumbs up without muttering another word, picked up the wine glass and chugged it down in one go.
“I almost exceeded the hundred thousand last time, but I spent a few ten thousand already!” Jiang Ming continued.
Puff….
Ye Qingxian spewed a mouthful of the wine, her eyes were straight as she stared at Jiang Ming, muttering to herself, “Almost over one hundred thousand? Are you still human? It takes one point to experience enlightenment once! Enlightenment! Every time a person experiences enlightenment, there will be a huge improvement for the person. Assuming that you could go for enlightenment a hundred thousand times… God damn it! A person is definitely able to step into the Great Overarching Realm even if it was me!”
She licked her lips unconsciously and asked, “Brother Jiang, can I latch onto you?”
Jiang Ming almost blurted out flurtative words but he held it back and said, “Sister Ye, you are making me so awkward when you said such a thing with that cold look of yours.”
No! In fact, it wasn’t awkward but impulsive!
Ye Qingxian immediately blushed. She lifted the wine bottle, poured herself a glass and took a sip. Her expression toned down a little and she muttered, “Sigh, it’s just too shocking! If this leaks out, it will definitely start off a tsunami. Let’s not continue. The more you talk, the sadder I become.”
Her face turned a little solemn and continued, “Brother Jiang, it’s better not to use your real name here. If someone from the same universe got a hold of your details, there’s a high chance that you may be targeted. After all, such a thing has happened before!”
“Thanks!”
As the two continued chatting away, Ye Qingxian told him a lot of other information.
For example, there was a trading area in the north where the accumulated points were highly sought after, but very few were willing to trade them. It’s because one point meant that they would still have one chance to come back into the Supreme Pagoda after they ran out of their three free entrances. Even if used for enlightenment, it would mean an instance of improvement.
Therefore, these accumulated points were not ordinary treasures.
Most of the transactions were still done through the barter system. After all, everyone came from different worlds. There were just way too many rare and precious treasures around. Many artifacts or cultivation techniques could bring up different feelings to a person.
“Oh yeah! By the way, there’s still a chat group here. I heard that it’s even more difficult to join the chat group and that you might be prompted anytime as well. I don’t know the specifics.” As Ye Qingxian explained, she couldn’t help but sigh, “I won’t stand a chance this time! Brother Jiang, your younger sister, I’ll have to rely on you in the future now.”
“Alright! If anyone bullies you, just look for me!” Jiang Ming patted his chest proudly.
Both of them couldn’t help but laugh.
After chatting for quite a while, Jiang Ming connected himself with the Battle Tower and his figure disappeared without a trace.
It was the method of challenging the Battle Tower.
The Battle Tower could accept countless challengers at the same time.
“It wouldn’t be a problem for Brother Jiang to pass the first Battle Tower. The second one? It should still be possible. The third should almost be impossible already!” Ye Qingxian thought to herself, ‘There’s a hearsay about a terrifying person who broke through three Battle Towers consecutively. He has some sort of Hongmeng Warrior Body and is so powerful that no one of the same realm can confront him. Standing at the top overbearing others, he is invincible and domineering. The countless geniuses here also say that he is a person with Holy Dao’s innate talent. Rumor has it that he came from a mysterious supreme world. I wonder if Brother Jiang can be compared to him?’
‘In comparison with them, I’ve become a little shrimp. I could still join the chat group at the Human Realm level but now that I’m here…’
Ye Qingxian sighed in despair.
…
In the first level of the first Battle Tower, it was a vast and lush green field. The soft breeze blew through the lands as the tender leaves swayed.
The fresh air could really intoxicate a person.
After Jiang Ming appeared, he understood the rules and regulations around here as it was completely similar to the previous heaven battle stage.
Without choosing any weapons, an opponent appeared right in front of him.
“Senior, it’s actually you!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help overjoying when he saw his opponent.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - The Birth and Destruction of a Great Chiliocosm
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: The Birth and Destruction of a Great Chiliocosm
His opponent was Jun Sanqian, who was considered an old friend already.
For Jiang Ming, Jun Sanqian was akin to his mentor in life. How could he not be happy?
“We are meeting again!” A smile appeared on Jun Sanqian’s ruthless face, “Not bad! Not bad at all! You’ve already conjured it up to a small chiliocosm, yet maintained at the Heavenly Immortal Realm! Perfect! Your physique is also corresponding to the Heavenly Immortal Realm. Although the power is not as great as the inner world, it’s still terrifyingly strong.”
He paused for a while, and continued preaching, “Looking over the various universes, your path of cultivation is definitely in the higher ranks, otherwise, your physique wouldn’t be this strong. Baptism of the core through the inner world coupled with such cultivation of the external physique. Tsk, tsk, tsk! Your current powerful state is not ordinary indeed. I was far inferior to you when I was your age.”
“That’s because of your great advice, senior!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile and continued: “Senior, are you guarding all seven of the Battle Towers?”
“Well, that depends on my mood!” Jun Sanqian answered, and continued, “Stop calling me senior. I’ll become old if you keep calling me that. You can call me Brother Jun or Old Brother in the future.”
“This… This seems inappropriate.”
“How is this inappropriate? Your cultivation base will be stronger than mine in the future soon, so just don’t make me call you a senior.”
“Stronger than you? Old brother, I dare not think about it!”
“You have the potential!”
The two of them continued to chat and reminisced for a while longer.
Jiang Ming finally voiced his doubts and asked, “Old Brother, is there an even higher level above this level in the Supreme Pagoda?”
“Don’t think too much and just remember one thing.” Jun Sanquan turned a little more serious and continued, “Accumulate and continue to accumulate desperately. Accumulate to the point that you can no longer do so. Do this for each and every realm that you are in. It is then that you can only go even further. Well, the world is very, very big, far bigger than what you can imagine.”
“Exceeding the chaotic domain?”
Updates by
. com
“I can’t tell, I can’t tell.”
“One last question, Old Brother. In this level of Supreme Pagoda, it is difficult to accumulate points, extremely difficult. However, it is easy for a person like myself who walks on the path of World Dao. It’s not just easy, but a lot easier when compared to others. Isn’t this considered somewhat of a loophole?”
“Loophole?”?JunSanqian gave him a weird smile and continued explaining, “Do you really think that within the same cultivation realm, the World Dao is the strongest already?”
“Isn’t it?” Jiang Ming wondered, “My inner world has already evolved into a small chiliocosm. Its power is akin to the power of a Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm. If I burst out my powers, I can even kill a Taiyi Golden Immortal Expert yet my cultivation realm is but only of the Heavenly Immortal.”
“First off, your cultivation technique is very special, which has led your mind and will to be tempered to such a terrifying level. Even your physique has also transfigured into an unimaginable level.” There was a strange look on Jun Sanqian’s face as he continued explaining, “For the other World Dao’s cultivators such as Dongfang Chenxi, their physiques are very ordinary! If she wants to temper her physical body to a very strong level, she must naturally improve her physical body’s cultivation realm.”
“Physical bodies have cultivation realms?” Jiang Ming was taken aback at this new information.
“Well of course!” Jun Sanqian nodded and continued, “That’s why your cultivation technique is truly terrifying! If a person’s physical body is ordinary, then the power of the inner world that a person can mobilize will be correspondingly much lesser. To simply put it, the physical body is the vessel, the channel to output energy. No matter how strong a person’s inner world’s power is, what use would it be if the person cannot mobilize them! Continue taking her as an example, even if her inner world has evolved into a small chiliocosm, she won’t even be able to take down a Golden Immortal expert, let alone a Taiyi Immortal expert. In the mortal realm, simply relying on your background can greatly improve a person’s combat ability. However, after stepping into the Immortal Realm, the rest will be difficult as you can only rely on yourself. Dongfang Chenxi’s perseverance is average as well as the special ability that she is cultivating. Even if her inner world evolves into a small chiliocosm, at the initial level, it would already be good if she can take down a Mysterious Immortal Expert!”
He paused for a while and continued, “After all, the path of the World Dao is different from the others. For the inner world to be materialized, the body has to be able to carry such a burden, which has its advantages and disadvantages. Of course, there are very few that can reach your level. Similarly, after evolving into small chiliocosm, if you want to further increase the rate of power output. You will have to improve your physical body. It’s extremely difficult to improve the physical body unless you break into the next realm. When a person’s physical body ascends into the True Immortal Realm, he is considered as a True Immortal, even if his cultivation base is still of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.”
“I understand now!” Jiang Ming felt as if his mind was suddenly enlightened.
He had long noticed this phenomenon.
It was especially apparent when he evoked the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique which had high requirements on a person’s physical body. He sometimes felt an extremely strong oppression pressing down on him as though it was difficult to bear such an outburst of power from this technique.
All these while, Jiang Ming did not deliberately tempered his body.
He only focused on the cultivation of the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, tempering his will and strengthening his physical body.
His?cultivation realm and physical realm had been improving hand in hand as he went on.
“Comparatively speaking, the advantages of the World Dao are still very huge. However, this path is extremely difficult.” Jun Sanqian continued again, “Continuing on the topic just now, although the accumulation of the World Dao is terrifying with powerful energy outbursts, there are still some special beings out there that can potentially completely overwhelm this Dao.”
“Completely overwhelmed?” Jiang Ming drew a breath of cold air in shock.
“How is that possible?” He still couldn’t believe this. He knew how crazy the World Dao was. Taking himself as an example, he was in the Heavenly Immortal Realm and could fight against the Taiyi experts. Who would believe him? I’m afraid there weren’t any, even in the Supreme Pagoda.
“There are some special beings whose origins are terrifyingly powerful, far beyond your imagination.” Jun Sanqian explained, “I’ll give you an example. Assuming that there is this type of being that is the favorite of the space. As it grows, each of his cells can form its own space. It’s like the human body. How many cells are there and how many of these spaces could be produced? These spaces could even materialize from illusions and become a variety of existences that is similar to the Paradis. What’s crazier is that each of these spatial cells can even evolve into a world.”
“There’s such an existence?” Jiang Ming was dumbfounded.
“Of course! The great chiliocosm is full of wonders.” Jun Sanqian smiled and continued, “There’s also a lifeform that is born from the Chaos Vital Essence. How strong do you think it would be?”
“This…” Jiang Ming’s hair was standing at its end.
He knew how terrifying the Chaos Vital Essence was. When he first got a wisp of it, it greatly promoted the evolution of his inner world. Imagine a body filled with such an entity: Every move would only mean catastrophic disasters.
“There are still quite a number of similar beings,” Jun Sanqian smiled, “However, they are also extraordinarily rare. In the early stages, they might look extremely terrifying, invincible among its peers, but it is hard to say in the later stages. Just like the current you who can wrench wrist with any geniuses already. Of course, such beings are normally born a True Immortal, Golden Immortal or even of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm.”
“Old brother, you’re just beating me down! Jiang Ming smiled bitterly, “However, this really broadened my knowledge. I will have to travel through the Infinite Realm and see the wonders of great chiliocosms if I have the chance.”
“It’s the right choice to travel around out there and see more of the world. Your potential will naturally increase. Broadening of horizons is extremely beneficial to a person’s cultivation and enlightenment!” Jun Sanqian agreed and smiled, “I told you all these so that you know there’s always someone stronger out there. However, you shouldn’t worry too much about it. Those beings are considered special beings and are extremely rare to be found. Such a lifeform may not necessarily appear even from the birth of a great chiliocosm to the chiliocosm’s own destruction.”
“So few of them?” Jiang Ming was shocked once again.
“Well, a few of them or not, it depends on where you see them!” Jun Sanqian added indifferently as the might of his aura rose and spread out in a mighty manner, “Alright! Let’s start. Let’s see what you’re made of! *Cough* Though, with my current state, I won’t be able to see your true combat ability.?Make your move. Maybe you might be able to snatch the position as the chat group’s leader. The current group leader position is no longer as non-beneficial as the previous one.”
“There’s even benefits to the group leaders?” Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up.
“Of course there is!” Terrifying rays of light already burst out from the long Sword in Jun Sanqian’s hand, where its overwhelming power could even cut down a True Immortal, “Remember! The strong will only get stronger! The better your talents are, the more benefits you will get.”
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement. Such a saying is true everywhere, after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 2,400, Jiang Ming’s True Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: 2,400, Jiang Ming’s True Strength
They started their fight after they had finished their conversation.
However…
Jiang Ming defeated Jun Sanqian in a single punch.
It was not because Jun Sanqian was too weak. It was because he was too powerful.
He came across Jun Sanqian for the rest of the stages until the ninth stage. Even though he was still in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, his overall combat prowess was much stronger than when he was in the first stage.
Right now, Jiang Ming was able to defeat an ordinary Mystical Immortal, so he made quick work of Jun Sanqian as well.
The second battle tower proved to be little to no challenge to Jiang Ming at all.
Very soon, he had arrived at the ninth stage of the third battle tower. He was still going up against Jun Sanqian, but the latter was in the Mystical Realm right now.
“I can fight against a normal Taiyi expert, but I can’t kill them,” Jun Sanqian said as he looked at Jiang Ming.
Apparently, he could tell Jiang Ming a lot of things. As for the exact reason, Jiang Ming couldn’t figure it out himself, so he decided not to say anything and listen to what Jun Sanqian had to say.
“If you could kill me, it means you’re in the Heavenly Immortal Realm and you have the ability to slay a Taiyi Golden Realm!” Jun Sanqian smiled, “Honestly, I think it shouldn’t be a problem for you.”
“Well, never try, never know. Let’s go!” Jiang Ming said.
“Come at me!” Jun Sanqian replied and threw himself at Jiang Ming.
He activated his special ability, causing his attack power to soar to a shocking degree. However, he was still no match for Jiang Ming and got destroyed by him.
Updates by
. com
Jiang Ming came to the fourth battle tower. This time, he was going to fight against a peak Golden Immortal.
Although all of them were in the same realm from stage one to stage nine, their combat prowess was completely different.
On the ninth stage.
“At my current level, I have the chance of taking down a Great Overarching expert,” Jun Sanqian said, grinning from ear to ear, “If you could kill me, then I’ll consider you the strongest!”
“I’ve killed you so many times!” Jiang Ming said after he heard what Jun Sanqian had said.
Jun Sanqian’s smile froze. He shook his head and said helplessly, “That’s because you’re too powerful! Honestly, I didn’t expect you would come to this step. You truly are amazing!
“Alright then. I’ll tell you something that you shouldn’t be knowing at your current level. You will only be eligible to join the chat room after you pass two battle towers consecutively. In the case where you wish to become the group admin, you will need to clear three battle towers without stopping.
“However, if there are two people who have the same qualification to become the group admin, then the person who has cleared more stages will be chosen to be the group admin, so you need to work harder!” Jun Sanqian said.
Looking at him, Jiang Ming did not know why but he felt that the space around Jun Sanqian began to warp. His figure began to become blurry, and it seemed as if he was an illusory figure instead of a real person.
“I didn’t know about such a rule,” Jiang Ming replied, “So am I qualified to become the group admin?”
“There is one person who has already cleared 35 stages in the group. If you can’t clear this stage, you won’t be able to become the group admin.”
“What? There is actually someone who has cleared 35 stages in the group?”
“Of course, there is. Do you think you’re the only one who could do it?”
“Well, I’m just a bit surprised,” Jiang Ming replied.
After all, those who had reached this stage had the power of a Heavenly Immortal and could spar toe-to-toe with an ordinary Great Overarching.
“Oh yeah!” Jiang Ming remembered something andasked, “How about the Heavenly Ladder? Do we not have to go through the test of the Heavenly Ladder after joining the group?”
“You haven’t realized it, have you? Most of the battles in the battle tower are mind attacks, so your willpower has been put to test as well while you’re going through the battle tower,” Jun Sanqian explained, “The Heavenly Ladder is just a place for you to discipline your mind and train your willpower as well as for you to earn more points.”
“I see.”
Jiang Ming finally saw the light. After they had finished speaking, he did not say anything anymore and charged at Jun Sanqian.
He summoned three clones around him and activated the Worldly Projection in an attempt to overwhelm Jun Sanqian.
“Time and Space Confinement!”
One of the clones cast a time and space attack, freezing the space and time around Jun Sanqian.
The fusion between time and space was a powerful attack, but Jiang Ming knew that it was only a matter of time before his opponent broke himself free.
“Great Malediction Technique: Weaken!”
At the same time, the second clone unleashed his attack. He threw a malediction technique by combining the Karma Dao and the power of fate at Jun Sanqian. This technique wouldn’t kill the opponent. However, it could weaken his attack and make him more susceptible to their attacks.
“Great Cage Technique!”
The third clone cast a skill to restrain Jun Sanqian.
Three clones activated all their attacks at the same time, forcing Jun Sanqian to emerge from his illusion. That being said, it only took Jun Sanqian a single wave of his hand to break himself free from the confinement.
Even though he had freed himself from the layers of confinement techniques, he was still a tad too late.
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
Jiang Ming unleashed his final attack.
A myriad of laws merged into a streak of light and pierced through Jun Sanqian’s forehead.
“Not again?!” Jun Sanqian did not go easy on Jiang Ming, but he still couldn’t make it in time to dodge his final attack.
A burst of light erupted from his forehead. Those were symbols, and they all formed into a chain made of Dao.
At the same time, many other symbols were emerging from his muscles, bones, and blood. They all merged into one and charged toward Jiang Ming.
For a moment, a storm of massive destructive power swept through the area, and Jun Sanqian’s head was crushed.
Jiang Ming was not in a good shape either. He was knocked back by the storm. His fingers were crushed and streaks of blood were jutting out of his arms.
“Did I do it?” His eyes glowed.
Just when Jiang Ming squinted his eyes to look through the storm ahead of him, a light dot appeared and a voice rang out in his head.
“That skill of yours is still as powerfulas always. It nearly destroyed my soul, but luckily, part of my soul managed to survive the attack. Right now, I should give you the last blow. Soul Strike!”
“Haha, do you really think I would let down my guard before I confirm that I’ve defeated you?” Jiang Ming said. Then, he opened his mouth, firing a fireball at the attack to intercept it.
After a short while, the battlefield began to quiet down. A voice rang out above him, “Congratulations Jiang Ming on clearing the fourth battle tower. Do you want to proceed to the next tower?”
“Yes!” No sooner had he given his answer then the wounds on his body started to heal.
In the next second, his figure vanished and when he appeared again, he was already at the first stage of the fifth battle tower.
The first watcher of the fifth battle stage was a Taiyi expert, and without any doubt, it was Jun Sanqian again.
He gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up and said, “Way to go, brother!”
“I don’t think I can defeat you this time,” Jiang Ming said, smiling bitterly, “If it were other people, maybe I can still give it a try. However, you already know everything I can do, so I doubt I can defeat you this time.”
The reason he could defeat Jun Sanqian during the last match was because he caught Jun Sanqian first by tossing many attacks on him, but right now, not only had Jun Sanqian become a lot stronger than the last match, but he was in the Taiyi Realm, which was a realm ahead of Jiang Ming.
“It would be the same if it were other people,” Jun Sanqian laughed, “The battle tower will record every move that you use and pass the knowledge to the opponent in the next stage. It’s just that I didn’t expect you to manage to form three clones during our last match. Not only that, but your Return of Infinite Law Finger had amassed 1,800 laws in it, further enhancing its already incredible power. You have a massive amount of immortal origin, so you’re capable of unleashing a terrifying power by forming many clones. This is a very effective move, but if you don’t have anything else up your sleeves, you won’t be able to clear this stage this time.”
“Don’t worry. I’m sure you’ll be surprised!” Jiang Ming laughed, “Can I ask you a question? If I die here, will I and my inner world recover when I leave?”
“Of course!”
“Great! Here I come then!” Jiang Ming said and formed 24 clones around him, exhausting half of the origin force of his inner world.
The clones attacked Jun Sanqian at the same time, but their attacks did nothing to him.
“Judging from your current strength, it would be as easy as a pie for you to defeat a Great Overarching Golden Immortal from your world. However, you need more than that to defeat me!” Jun Sanqian said and slashed through five clones.
In the blink of an eye, countless sword energies appeared around Jiang Ming, cutting down his clones one by one.
“Really?” Jiang Ming chuckled, “I’ve already finished preparing my ultimate move. Do you think you can take it?”
“Are you going to use the Return of Infinite Law Finger on me again? You can definitely injure me with that skill, but it won’t kill me!” Jun Sanqian replied.
“Well, never try, never know!” Jiang Ming shouted, “Inner world, heed my command! Welcome your destruction and help me in taking down my enemy!”
Rumble!
His inner world began to crumble away.
“Boil, my blood! Crumble away, my bones!” Jiang Ming chanted, “I’ve already amassed 2,400 Daos together and this is my limit. If you can take this attack, then I guess here is where I’ll stop. Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
Jiang Ming thrust his finger ahead, piercing through the Akasa and charging straight at Jun Sanqian’s Primal Spirit.
This attack was his strongest attack. His inner world was on the verge of destruction, and before Jun Sanqian could do anything, the attack shot right through his forehead.
However, Jun Sanqian’s sword had bifurcated him as well.
“It seems that I’ve underestimated you, but I wonder if you can take this attack of mine before I die or not?”

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - Millions of Points, Ridiculous Amount of Benefits, Hongmeng Primordial Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Millions of Points, Ridiculous Amount of Benefits, Hongmeng Primordial Land
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Level 11 (Heavenly Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 68,888
Achievement: None
On the fifth battle tower, Jiang Ming was in bad shape.
Although he had successfully defeated Jun Sanqian, he was bifurcated by him as well.
If it had not been for his inner world to shrink to another side of his brain and that he had cast the Great Protection Technique at the last minute, he wouldn’t be able to withstand the blow either.
Even so, he only had half of his head left.
“This is the first time I got injured so badly,” Jiang Ming sighed.
Half of his inner world was destroyed. Even though it could recover by itself, it was going to consume a ton of time. That being said, this was considered a desperate move that he would only use in a desperate situation.
He did not destroy himself with Jun Sanqian. If he destroyed the entire inner world, the power that unleashed would be destructive.
“Congratulations on clearing the stage. Do you wish to continue?”
As a voice rang out above Jiang Ming, he felt a surge of power entering his body and starting to heal his injuries as well as his inner world to their top condition.
It felt like a power that could reverse time or a very powerful healing ability, and Jiang Ming was shocked.
Updates by
. com
“The owner of the Supreme Pagoda must be at least a Saint Lord!”
Even though he had yet to come across a Great Overarching Golden Immortal and he did not know what a Quasi-Sage was capable of, he was very certain that a Quasi-Sage couldn’t do something like this.
“Nope. I’ll take a break.” Jiang Ming shook his head.
Just when he thought he was going to get transported out of here, the voice rang out again, “Jiang Ming, this is the total of points you’ve accumulated: First battle tower, one point will be given for one stage, so you’ve collected 9 points. On the second battle tower, since the opponents are a realm stronger than you, the point for each stage is increased by tenfold. In other words, 10 points will be given for one stage, and you’ve collected 90 points. On the third battle stage, the opponents are two realms stronger than you. The point is further increased by tenfold which means 100 points will be given for one stage, and you’ve collected 900 points. On the fourth battle tower, the opponents are three realms stronger than you. This battle tower consists of level 14 Golden Immortals, and compared to the last tower, the point is increased by a hundredfold. 10,000 points will be given for one stage, and you’ve collected 90,000 points. The points for the fifth battle tower is increased by another 100 times, and 1,000,000 points will be given for one stage. You’ve only cleared on stage, so you’ve collected 1,000,000 points.
“Right now, you’ve collected a total of 1,090,999 points. Top up with the remaining 68,888 points, you now have a total of 1,159,887 points.”
Jiang Ming’s heart raced when he heard the announcement.
‘I have that many points now? Who told me that it’s hard to earn points? Isn’t it as easy as a piece of cake?’
“I’ll get 1,000,000 points for clearing one stage in the fifth battle tower? That’s incredible! Battle tower, can I continue the challenge?” Jiang Ming went forward andasked.
He was aware that if he broke into the next realm, he would start from where he left off last time, but the point given would be a lot lower.
Of course, he could start from scratch, but he wouldn’t be able to get any points for the previous stages.
“Affirmative. Do you want to continue your challenge?”
“Yes!”
In the next second, Jiang Ming appeared at the second stage of the fifth battle tower.
His opponent was still Jun Sanqian, but he was a lot stronger now. Jiang Ming only lasted for a while before he was eventually defeated.
He did not vanish, and Jun Sanqian was still standing before him.
“I knew I would lost!” Jiang Ming looked at his own body that was recovering and let out a bitter smile.
“You’re already powerful enough,” Jun Sanqian laughed, “The current group admin has only cleared 35 stages. He couldn’t make it through the ninth stage of the fourth battle tower while you’ve already cleared the first stage of the fifth battle tower and obtained 1,000,000 points. Honestly, I’m kind of jealous of you.”
“The points awarded at the later stages are just too many!” Jiang Ming laughed, “How strong is the current group admin? Can he clear the fifth battle tower after he ascends into the True Immortal Realm?”
“He’s a Taiyi Golden Immortal now!” Jun Sanqian said, “He was able to clear the fourth battle stage when he was in the True Immortal Realm. He attempted the first stage of the fifth battle tower many times, but he still failed.”
“Seriously?” Jiang Ming exclaimed, his voice thick with disbelief.
A True Immortal was in a whole different world compared to a Heavenly Immortal. However, he only managed to clear the ninth stage of the fourth battle tower?
Jiang Ming found it hard to believe.
“You won’t experience a lot of improvement when you step into the True Immortal Realm,” Jun Sanqian explained patiently, “The Heavenly Immortal, the True Immortal, the Mystical Immortal may seem very powerful for normal people, but for people like you, you won’t feel much difference.”
He paused for a moment before continuing, “Besides, stepping into the Golden Immortal Realm is yet another large gap. Becoming a Golden Immortal from the Mystical Immortal is even harder than reaching level 10 from level 1, while going from the Golden Immortal to Taiyi is thousands of times more difficult than going from level 1 to level 14 Golden Immortal combined. Toward the later stage of cultivation, the difference between realms would become greater. It would be even harder to increase the cultivation level, and the combat prowess of the geniuses would become even stronger.
“In my case, I’m in the peak stage of the Taiyi Realm and I could easily defeat 90% of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal in your world. This is the true strength of a genius,” Jun Sanqian said, “However, no matter how great the difference of strength between two Great Overarchings, they are still Great Overarching.
“Both you and I are geniuses, but you’re in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but I’m in the Peak Stage of the Taiyi Realm. Can you tell me how big of a difference between our strengths? There aren’t many people in this universe who can do what you did. Our group admin is in the True Immortal Realm, yet he still couldn’t clear the first stage of the fifth battle stage. Even if he has ascended into the Mystical Immortal Realm, he might not be able to clear the fifth battle stage as well, and this is very normal.
When you’ve reached the True Immortal Realm, there is a great chance that you can’t clear the fifth battle stage. Therefore, you wouldn’t be able to clear so many stages anymore in the future,” Jun Sanqian said patiently.
“I think I could earn a lot more points,” Jiang Ming said.
“Throughout the history, there aren’t many people who could earn as many points as you do. If you use all the points you earned wisely, there’s a 50% chance that your inner world would turn into a great chiliocosm,” Jun Sanqian said, “No, if you use your points wisely, you’ll certainly be able to transform your inner world into a great chiliocosm. After all, you still have the Heavenly Ladder. I’m really jealous of you, brother.”
After that, he disappeared.
Jiang Ming smiled, and the voice emerged again.
“Jiang Ming, congratulations on passing 37 stages in a row at level 11 and reaching the qualification to join the Supreme Immortal Chat Group. Do you wish to join the chat group? As a reminder, you will have access to the following features after joining the chat group: One, consume points for unlimited time acceleration. Two, consume points for a spot to listen to the Dao from a supreme being.”
“Yes, I’ll join!” Jiang Ming replied without any hesitation.
Time acceleration might be useless for other people, but it was very useful for him. It could save him a ton of time. After all, he couldn’t leave the real world for too long.
As for the second feature, Jiang Ming figured that nobody would say no to a chance to listen to the Dao from a supreme being. A supreme being was at least a Saint Lord, and he was confident that he would be able to learn a lot of things from him.
Before he got sent out, the voice rang out again.
“Jiang Ming, you’ve cleared 37 stages in a row and you’re the highest achiever in the group. You have the qualification to become the group admin. Do you wish to become the group admin? As a reminder, you’ll have access to the following features as a group admin: One, consume points for unlimited time acceleration. Two, consume points for a spot to listen to the Dao from a supreme being.Three, consume points for the blessing from the supreme being. Four, consume points for a chance to enter the Hongmeng Primordial Land for cultivation.”
“Yes!”
No one would refuse to become a group admin even if there were not so many benefits, let alone he could enjoy so many things after becoming one.
“The blessing of the supreme? Also, a chance to enter the Hongmeng Primordial Land for cultivation?”
Jiang Ming’s heart began to race.
Based on his understanding, Hongmeng was something that was greater than chaos.
“Just who the hell the owner of the Supreme Pagoda is?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Congratulations, Jiang Ming. You’ve become the group admin of the Supreme Immortal Chat Group. After you leave the battle tower, you’ll automatically join the group and become the group admin.”
The voice rang out again.
JIang Ming disappeared and came to the square.
“Four features. Other than time acceleration, I hope the rest of the features wouldn’t use that many points!” Jiang Ming said.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - Breaking the Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Breaking the Limit
He would have access to four features after becoming the group admin, but all of them needed to consume points.
Time acceleration was an effective tool when it came to cultivation. He just needed to spend some points and he could accelerate the time by 10,000 years.
As for listening to Dao, he needed to spend 1,000 points for one lesson?
‘1,000 points?’
He figured that not that many people in the group had that many points.
After all, they would only get 9 points for clearing a stage in the battle tower that corresponded to their realm. Even if they had the ability to clear a stage where it was stronger than them, they would only get 90 points for one stage.
It was too difficult to earn more points during the early stage. However, things would become easier after they became a Golden Immortal.
[The blessing of the Supreme Order: Non-offensive. Spends 10,000 points to defend oneself against a lethal attack.]
“10,000 points for a life? Well, that’s a good bargain. However, it’s a feature only available to the group admin, and I’m afraid that other than the group admin, nobody could accumulate so many points,” Jiang Ming laughed.
He could run into a dangerous situation when he was in the real world, but with the Blessing of the Supreme Order, he did not have to worry about anything anymore.
The only downside was that it would consume a lot of points.
[A chance to cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land: Spends 50,000 points to get a chance to cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land.]
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but suck in air sharply when he saw the announcement.
‘D*mn it. Just how many things could one get for spending so many points to cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land?’
Updates by
. com
Jiang Ming found it hard to believe.
“The point is how many people could get so many points?”
He surmised that not even the previous group admin could get so many points. The only reason he was able to activate the feature was that he had cleared the first stage of the fifth battle tower. If he had only cleared four battle towers, he wouldn’t be able to use the feature as well.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian, who had been waiting for him, asked when she saw him appear, “How is it?”
“Great!” Jiang Ming laughed, “It’s as I expected as well.”
“As you expected?” Ye Qingxian was dumbfounded by him for a while before her eyes turned round. “You’re the group admin now?”
“Exactly.”
“Terrific!” Ye Qingxian couldn’t help herself and exclaimed.
She knew that Jiang Ming was powerful, but she did not expect him to be so powerful. She was fully aware how hard it was to become a member of the Supreme Immortal Chat Group, let alone becoming their group admin.
It was never in her wildest dream that he would become thegroup admin as soon as he joined the chat group.
“Calm down! It’s nothing impressive,” Jiang Ming chuckled.
He found that the sight of a beauty opening her mouth in shock was rather entertaining.
“Calm down? You want me to calm down?!” Ye Qingxian shouted again before she paused abruptly. She knew that she had made a fool of herself. She took a deep breath and let out a bitter smile, “Brother Jiang, you truly are a monster. How many stages did you manage to clear?”
“37!”
“37!? You’re only in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but you managed to clear the first stage of the fifth battle tower and defeated a Taiyi expert?” Ye Qingxian said. Then, she sucked in air through her teeth sharply and continued, “Impressive! I’m truly amazed. When all of us were in the mortal realm, we didn’t really submit to you and we all thought we could catch up to you despite the fact that you were way ahead of us. However, it’s only now that I realize how naive I am. There’s no way we can catch up to you no matter how hard we try. Now I can confirm that the future is in your hands.”
“You’ve flattered me, Qingxian,” Jiang Ming replied as he shook his head. Then, he continued, “Anyway, here’s a piece of advice for you. Try your best to accumulate as much as you can. If you can suppress your cultivation, you must do everything you can to suppress it so that you can clear two battle towers in one sitting!”
Ye Qingxian’s eyes glowed and she bowed at Jiang Ming. She did not ask anything anymore as she already knew everything.
She smiled bitterly and said, “I doubt I could do it. I can barely go through the first battle tower, and now you’re asking me to go through two towers?”
Then, she stood up and looked at the battle tower in the distance. Suddenly, fiery determination rose in her eyes.
“In the past, I used to walk across the continent, fighting strong foes and overcoming hardships. I used to be very weak, but then I was able to join the rest of the experts and stand at the top of the world. However, it seems to me that I’ve become weaker and my determination has deteriorated as time passes.”
Ye Qingxuan was very confident when she first came here. However, it was only after she attempted the battle tower and learned more about this place that she realized how ignorant she was and she felt a little defeated.
It was not because she was not strong enough. It was just that the people here were too powerful, but she figured that she shouldn’t care about so much and just mind her own business.
“That’s the face!” Jiang Ming said, “If others can do it, why can’t I? As for whether it’ll work out or not, we should talk about it after giving it a try.”
“You’re right! We should do what is in front of us first!” Ye Qingxian sat down and pulled out two bottles of wine. She threw one to Jiang Ming and drank one herself.
Her neck was slender and fair. It looked just like a white jade that was flawlessly carved.
“I should start planning from now on!” Ye Qingxian said as she looked intently at Jiang Ming, “I can’t get left behind by you too much. I have to work harder to catch up to you!”
“That’s the spirit!’ Jiang Ming said, “In the past, you were stronger than me, but then I surpassed you and became stronger than you afterward. That being said, you still stepped into the Immortal Realm faster than me. Right now, we’re on the same level. We still have a long way to go, and no one could tell which one of us will stand higher and go farther in the end.”
“I’ll try my best to surpass you again!” Ye Qingxian smiled.
After they chatted for a while, Jiang Ming did not check on the chat group. Instead, he connected with the Heavenly Ladder through his mind, and in the next second, he was transferred to the Heavenly Ladder.
Before he went there, he left a message to Ye Qingxian, “Sister Ye, I’ll leave this place after I attempt the Heavenly Ladder.”
He landed on the white jade staircases, and he saw a few figures ahead of him but he did not mind them. He mounted the staircases one after another.
Ye Qingxian looked in his direction. Even though she could not see clearly, she knew which one of them was Jiang Ming and she was shocked.
“As expected of Brother Jiang. I could only reach level 5 when I attempted the Heavenly Ladder, but he…”
Ye Qingxian continued to look at Jiang Ming.
Her shock slowly faded away as she had become numb.
The ninth level, the 18th level, the 27th level…
Jiang Ming continued to mount the staircases without stopping. However, he became slower after he reached the 30th level.
In the end, he came to the 36th level.
He lifted his head and looked upward, his eyes bright.
‘In comparison, my willpower is strong because I have the protection from the inner world,’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly and came to the 37th level.
Bam…
Suddenly, his vision turned black and a spear appeared in the sky. It pierced through the air and came straight at him.
“Great Protection Technique! Great Devastation Technique! Grand World Technique! Grand World Technique! Soul Light, Spear of Volition, go!”
Jiang Ming unleashed many different special abilities to counter the spear, giving rise to a great storm. The spear tore through layers of barriers, landed in his sea of consciousness before getting engulfed by his consciousness.
A smile appeared on Jiang Ming’s face.
“I’m in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but the origin force of my inner world is at the same level as a Taiyi Golden Immortal. In comparison, I have the advantage here! Let’s keep moving!”
Jiang Ming continued to move up the staircases.
When he reached the 43th level, his vision turned black again and he fell to the 42nd level.
“I didn’t manage to reach the 45th level!” Jiang Ming was shocked.
He thought he could reach the 45th level at his current level, but it now seemed to him that he had overestimated himself.
He tried again but the result was the same.
‘How is this happening? Could it be that my defensive special abilities are too weak?’ Jiang Ming thought.
This time, the voice did not ring out.
He had gotten a total of 6,090,999 points from the Heavenly Ladder.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation base: Level 11 (Heavenly Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 7,250,886
Achievement: [Heavenly Realm: 37 stages of battle tower, 42 levels of Heavenly Ladder]
“I can’t believe that I could get so many points!” Jiang Ming scratched his head.
While other people were still struggling to earn more points, he had already obtained more than 7 million points.
“If I go back and tell Qingxian, would she…”
A thought flashed across his head and he returned to the real world from the Supreme Pagoda.
After all, the world outside was where he truly belonged.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - The Formation of Civilization
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: The Formation of Civilization
Even though it had been a lot of years in the Supreme Pagoda, it had only been a short amount of time in the world outside.
Jiang Ming returned to the rooftop in the real world.
He looked toward the sky. There was nothing but a blanket of darkness and various horrifying phenomena that greeted his vision. This was clearly the terrifying harbinger of impending destruction.
“Well, this is kind of depressing,” Jiang Ming mumbled.
“Yeah, it’s very depressing! As for the Eastern Region…” Linglong said, “Senior brother, is everything okay on your side?”
“Yes. You don’t have to worry about me,” Jiang Ming said as he grabbed his junior sister into his embrace. He then lifted his head and took in the Eastern Region.
After the great catastrophe, the Eastern Region was left with nothing but a barren land. Now that the people of Zhong Province had moved in, it became crowded again. If another war were to break out again, many people would lose their lives.
However, Jiang Ming felt there shouldn’t be any problem. They still had some time left, and he figured that he would start the preparation after they arrived at the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
As for the solar eclipse? There was no need to worry about that either. Every expert from Jiuyang Sect and the Tianyuan School was trying their best to accelerate the ripening of various grains.
“The sun and moon are gone, while a great calamity is approaching. Well, it seems like we need to let them get used to it,” Jiang Ming said as he tightened his arms around Linglong. “We’ll have to play it by ear.”
Linglong nodded.
Jiang Ming turned around and carried Linglong to the rattan chair.
He closed his eyes and sent his consciousness into the Supreme Order.
Inside the chat group, there were 18 members.
Updates by
. com
There were not many of them, and since all of them were in the Immortal Realm, they spent most of their time cultivating, so the chat group was quiet.
After all, their time was measured in tens of thousands of years, so they rarely came out and chatted. Even if they did, they would only make some small talk.
Suddenly, a beep suddenly sounded in the Supreme Chat Group.
[Ding! Congratulations on new member Jiang Ming from joining the Supreme Immortal Chat Group.]
[Ding! The new member, Jiang Ming’s achievements are as follows: 37 stages of battle tower, 47 levels of Heavenly Ladder. He has surpassed the highest achievement of the current group master Hong Zhan and replaced him as the group admin.]
[Ding! Congratulations to Jiang Ming on becoming the new group admin.]
The chat group had been very quiet, but it became even more quiet now.
Some of them were shocked, while the others found it hard to believe.
On a land that filled with an incredible amount of essence there was a palace hovering in the air.
The power of creation permeated the air, and the plants here were all spiritual plants.
There was a platform in the depths of the palace, and a young man was sitting on it. He had a strong physique, a cold, nicely chiseled face, and there was a purple halo of light at the back of his head, emitting countless Dao fluctuations.
Suddenly, he cracked his eyes open. Two purple rays flitted across them, and the Supreme Order appeared before him.
He tapped on it and read through the notifications.
“What? Someone has taken over me as the group admin?”
This young man was none other than Hong Zhan, the previous group admin of the Supreme Immortal Chat Group.
“His name is Jiang Ming and he comes from a… planar world? He’s in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but he has cleared 37 stages of the battle tower and 47 levels of the Heavenly Ladder? How is this possible? How could such a powerful being exist in a planar world? All of the planar worlds are infertile, and I can destroy one of them with a simple short. I can’t believe that someone as powerful as him would appear in a planar world. His achievements are better than mine!”
Hong Zhan still found it difficult to believe. After a short while, his face sank.
“I have been collecting points so that I could cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land. I was so close… I was so close, and now… D*mn it ! Jiang Ming, I’ll kill you! I’m going to look for my guardian. I must know where he is right now, and kill him!”
An intense murderous intent erupted from him. When he stood up, he froze and his face darkened.
He remembered that the group admin was able to access a feature where they could spend their points to receive blessing from the supreme being.
“I can’t kill him like this! If I can’t kill him in one shot, he can enter the Supreme Pagoda and cultivate in it! D*mn it! I guess the only chance I would have is when he becomes a Great Overarching. But how long am I going to wait?”
The chat group became lively.
[Hong Yi: Congratulations, new group admin! We human race has once again gained another genius!]
[Xu Wuxi: Congratulations, new group admin! We human race has once again gained another genius!]
[Wang Ye: Congratulations, new group admin! We human race has once again gained another genius!]]
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, is that you?]
[Ming Fei: Brother Jiang, is that you?]
[Tian Fozi: Brother Jiang, is that you?]
[Ao Long: You guys know each other? What are the odds!]
[Ao Long: Another human huh. You all have great potential, but your bloodline is weak. Generally speaking, there shouldn’t be so many humans in the Supreme Chat Group. I don’t know why there are so many of you, and all of you are powerful! Hong Yi, you have potential that is equal to that of Hong Zhan, who comes from that legendary place! And you too, Xu Wuji. Wang Ye has just stepped into the Immortal Realm not long ago, and he’s entered the chat group. Now, this one over here not only has entered the chat group, but he also has pulled Hong Zhan down from his throne and replaced him as the group admin. I… I just don’t know what to say. Anyway, Wang Ye, you know our new group admin? Did you come across him in the mortal world?]
[Wang Ye: I think he’s Brother Jiang. He used to be the group admin for Ming Fei, Tian Fozi, and me. Like this time, he also became the group admin after he joined the chat group, so I’m pretty sure he’s Brother Jiang.]
[Di Huo: He’s from the planar world, but he could become the group admin. This is just unbelievable!]
[Ao Long: Right? Both of us come from a great chiliocosm. I’m a mutated blood dragon, while you’re a Three-legged Golden Crow. Both of us descended from a powerful and precious bloodline. We have an otherworldly combat prowess, but what happened in reality? Not only did we lose to Hong Zhan, we’re suppressed by Hong Yi, and now there is another human from a planar world?]
[Di Huo: I don’t believe that a simple mortal world could produce such a terrible being!]
[Ao long: I don’t believe it either!]
[Hong Yi: Hah, I came from a planar world too!]
[Di Huo: Sh*t! You monster! You’re the leftover under the great Dao. You’ve absorbed the spark of civilization, formed the Civilization Dao, and absorbed the wisdom of thousands of civilizations. If you keep growing, d*mn it! I don’t even dare to think about it!]
[Ao Long: Hong Yi, are you the son of the Great Dao? Just how many of the 3,000 origin laws have you comprehended?]
[Hong Yi: Ahem! Ahem! You’ve flattered me. I was just a little bit luckier. I’ve comprehended 2,800 laws amongst the 3,000 origin laws, but I’m still far behind those who cultivated the World Dao. It’s getting harder and harder to cultivate the law. Initially, I planned to create an inner world of civilization by force in the Taiyi Realm, but I’m afraid I might not be able to do it now.]
[Di Huo: F*ck!]
[Ao Long: F*ck!]
[Lan Hai: F*ck!]
[Huang Quan: F*ck!]
[Xu Wuji: Hong Yi, you truly are a monster. If you go on the path, you must’ve stepped into the Quasi-Sage Realm.]
[Ming Fei: Other than the group admin, you’re the most powerful being I’ve ever come across]
[Wang Ye: That’s right!]
[Tian Fozi: Guys, take a look at our group admin information. Planar world, human race, level 11, Heavenly Immortal Realm, achievement: 37 stages of battle tower, 42 levels ofHeavenly Ladder. What do you see in this? Aren’t you jealous?]
[Ao Long: Sh*t! Shut up, you fool! Do you know how hard I’ve been resisting myself from looking at it?]
[Xu Wuji: You’ve forgotten to mention one more thing. Our group admin has a total of 7 million points in total!]
[Ao Long: What?!]
[Di Huo: Unbelievable!]
[Huang Quan: Where is our group admin? I have plenty of succubus with me!]
[Ao Long: Are you trying to tempt our group admin? How can you be so shameless?]
At the same time, Jiang Ming was looking at the chat group.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - In the Blink of An Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: In the Blink of An Eye
Jiang Ming was tickled pink by their reaction after he read through their conversation.
At the same time, he also found out that every member only revealed their basic information. For example, Hong Yi came from a planar world. He was also a human and he was in the Taiyi Realm. His highest achievement was clearing 33 stages of battle tower and 36 levels of the Heavenly Ladder when he was in the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Jiang Ming knew who Hong Yi was. After all, his name had appeared on the records for the battle stage and Heavenly Ladder several times.
It was just that he did not expect him to be so strong.
Even though he did not take on the world Dao, he still managed to comprehend 2,800 types of laws.
Jiang Ming was confident that if it had not been for his system, he would be a lot weaker than he was.
It seemed to him that Hong Yi was the true genius. Unlike him, he didn’t have any support from the system yet he still could come so far.
[Jiang Ming: Hi!]
[Jiang Ming: Feng Wu, Ming Fei, Wang Ye, Tian Fozi, it has been such a long time. I’m truly happy that we could gather here.]
[Jiang Ming: How could I have imagined that we would all have access to the Immortal Chat Group!]
[Jiang Ming: If Zhan Ge, Ao Jiu, and the others knew that you’re here, they would be so jealous of you.]
[Ming Fei: Well, that’s it. I can confirm that you’re Brother Jiang. Haha!]
[Feng Wu: You become the group admin for two groups in a row. Brother Jiang, you’re breaking records! Please take care of me from now onward!]
[Tian Fozi: Haha! Seeing you is even more happier than seeing Buddha himself!]
Updates by
. com
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, you’re truly amazing. I didn’t expect that you would give us such a surprise! Haha! I’m so happy that I can barely hold myself from dancing!]
Jiang Ming was truly happy that he could meet up with his friends here.
The rest of the group members welcomed him warmly.
Although some of them did not appear, they did not mind them.
However, Jiang Ming noticed something. Ever since he came to this chat group, no one had ever mentioned the previous group admin, and he wondered why.
After talking to the group members, Jiang Ming had gotten some insider information about the Supreme Pagoda.
For example, their chat group was different from other people from the Supreme Pagoda.
They would help each other whenever any of them needed any assistance. After all, all of them were from different worlds of different forces.
Even if they did not have a large background, they were a force to be reckoned with and the benefits he could get from them would be tremendous.
Here, points were essential, and everyone needed points.
‘Can I consider myself to be supported by many great chiliocosms?’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly.
He kissed his junior sister’s forehead, got up, and went to prepare their dinner.
Even though there were no sun, moon, or stars, he was still able to tell the time correctly.
Very soon, their dinner was ready.
Xi Yao came over and her eyes shone brightly when she saw the food on the table. “It seems like I’m right on time. Brother Jiang, Linglong, I’m sure you won’t mind having one more companion, right? Well, even if you mind, I still want to enjoy this scrumptious meal!”
After she had finished speaking, she sat down.
“I’ll go prepare two more dishes!” Jiang Ming smiled and went back into the kitchen.
“What’s wrong?” Xi Yao asked in confusion, “Could it be that I’m not welcomed here?”
“No, I’m just worried about you.”
“Me?”
“Yeah, you.”
“Why?
“You’re lost. You don’t know what you want, and you have no idea which path you should take on.”
“Am I?” Xi Yao asked, her voice filled with bewilderment.
“You love my senior brother. He knows about it, but he pretends that he doesn’t. However, you think it’s impossible between you two because your cultivation level is too low, so you feel defeated. You don’t know what your future will lead you to, and you’re worried about the future of our world. Long story short, the series of events that happened recently are too much for you to handle.”
“Really?”
“Maybe you didn’t realize it, but all of us could see it through your eyes. You aren’t as happy and as confident as you used to be in the past.”
“I think you’re right,” Xi Yao said, lowering her head and pitching her voice low. “I think you’re right. There are too many things recently. My sect has welcomed its destruction and our world has fallen into chaos. However, you two have become stronger and stronger with each passing day, and you have even slain the demon lord, who’s said to be a terrifying existence.”
“It does seem a bit overwhelming for you with what’s happened! How about I ask my senior brother to sleep with you for a night so that you can relax?”
“What?!” Xi Yao exclaimed, her face turning red with embarrassment. She flew into the air, and before she went away, she stopped abruptly. She turned around and took two dishes while shooting a glare at Linglong before running away again.
