Linglong shook her head helplessly.’
“How could you?” Jiang Ming walked over and flicked her forehead. “How am I supposed to face her in the future?”
“On the bed, of course!”
“I can barely satisfy you, and you want me to entertain another woman? Are you kidding me?”
“Really?” Linglong said with a pout, “All men are the same. You guys love pretty women the most, and I’m sure that you must have a thing on her since she’s such a gorgeous lady!”
“I’m not! I’m a good man!”
Both of them chatted as they ate their dinner.
In the house at the north.
Xi Yao was eating the food in front of her as well, but her eyes were glassy. After a long while, she sighed and wolfed down the food.
“I have to cultivate. I need to go into seclusion, and I won’t come out until I’ve ascended into the Immortal Realm!”
After eating, Xi Yao set up a harsh goal for herself.
On the rooftop.
While Jiang Ming was cleaning the table, he received a notification from the system, telling him that he had gotten a Chaos Vital Essence. He lifted his head and looked into the distance.
“In another three days, we’ll arrive at the Infinite Realms Battlefield,” Jiang Ming mumbled, “However, I’m still not strong enough…”
Jiang Ming thought for a moment before making up his mind.
He walked toward Linglong and grabbed her into his arms. He kissed her forehead and said gently, “Hey, I don’t think I’m prepared for the Infinite Realms Battlefield, so I’m going to cultivate in seclusion for one more day so that I can get away safely when something happens.”
“Don’t worry, senior brother,” Linglong said confidently, “Even if there’s a Great Overarching, I have confidence that I can defeat them as well!”
“Awesome!”
Jiang Ming was not worried about his junior sister since there was no one who could defeat her. After all, she and one of her clones were in the Taiyi Realm, and the rest of the eight clones were in the Golden Immortal Realm. If they all worked together, they could fight on par against a Great Overarching Golden Immortal as well.
He communicated with the Supreme Order and disappeared into thin air.
Linglong sat on the bench and made herself a cup of tea. While she was sipping on the tea, she said, “For people like us, it’s impossible to have any significant improvement in such a short amount of time. If he could only cultivate for one day, that means he has a feature that can accelerate time…
“Sigh!
“I thought I was the one who should protect senior brother, master, and Chuyang Peak, but in the end, I was the one who got protected instead.
“Although it feels good, I have to help him share the burden as well!
“But the Heavenly Inheritance…”
Linglong sighed.
Inside the Supreme Pagoda, Jiang Ming did not see Ye Qingxian when he came in. He shrugged and went into the Dao Enlightenment Sea. he sat on a lotus platform. The lotus platform was huge. It was even bigger than a balcony.
After that, he took a deep breath and commanded the Supreme Order, “Initiating time acceleration. Ten thousand years.”
“Points deducted and time acceleration activated.”
A message flowed into his mind.
He found that a mist began to appear around the lotus platform, blocking his view completely. He could also feel the power of time from the mist, but he couldn’t see through it in his current level.
“Can I activate the Dao Enlightenment Mode at the same time?” Jiang Ming asked again.
The Supreme Order replied, “Affirmative. You can activate the Dao Enlightenment Mode when time acceleration is in effect. One point will be deducted for one hour. However, please take note that you won’t be able to access the chat group during the Dao Enlightenment Mode.”
Jiang Ming replied, “That’s great. Can you wake me up after 10,000 years have passed?”
The Supreme Order replied, “Affirmative!”
“Alright then! I’m going to spend 885 points for the Dao Enlightenment Mode!”
“Activating now,” the Supreme Order said.
In that moment, Jiang Ming felt he came to a space filled with Dao fluctuation. He
He could comprehend a Dao as well as the Fire True Immortal Law in a blink of an eye.
“So this is the Dao Enlightenment Mode?” Jiang Ming asked.
Time fluttered by rapidly. The mist disappeared, and Jiang Ming appeared on the lotus platform.
“It has been 10,000 years already?” Jiang Ming asked, his eyes misted over with confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - Pinnacle of Great Overarching Realm, Inner World Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Pinnacle of Great Overarching Realm, Inner World Destruction
10,000 years were far too long.
If it were to be in the mortal realm, even the sea might have dried out as there would be a lot of historical changes, and even the vicissitude of civilization itself.
Jiang Ming’s past memories were all shattered into pieces.
Looking further back into his past, all the memories that were considered useless for his cultivation were destroyed. Slowly, his aura of extreme indifference gradually returned.
“There isn’t a track of time in the mountains and yet thousands of years have gone by in reality.” Jiang Ming sighed.
He now had a deeper understanding of the fact that the more powerful a cultivator was, the more indifferent the person became.
It was not that these cultivators were trying to be indifferent on purpose, but the long retreat into cultivation caused the person’s emotion to gradually fade away.
“For my next retreat into cultivation, I will have to first seal up my memories!” Jiang Ming had his plans laid out.
He checked his own status, comprehended the changes within himself for he had already stepped into the True Immortal Realm.
His inner world had already given birth to all the laws of the True Immortal, while the origin had also further grown. Although there weren’t any qualitative changes, there were still quite a lot of improvements to it.
In fact, it merely took him 5,000 years to complete his transformation.
After all, it was not the transition of a world but only an accumulation and enchantment of cultivation.
Coupled with the enlightenment that he underwent from time to time out in the world, the True Immortal Laws were formed very quickly.
The rest of the time was used to deduce the special abilities and improve his combat power.
Updates by
Now that his combat power had improved, what more was he waiting for? It was time to clear the levels and accumulate more points.
Jiang Ming connected himself with the Battle Tower and his figure slowly disappeared into thin air as he was transported into the second level of the fifth Battle Tower.
Third level, passed.
Fourth level, passed
Fifth level, passed.
Sixth level, failed.
With the improvement that he received from his transformation, he broke through the levels forcefully.
“To think that the True Immortal Realm really isn’t enough to clear the fifth Battle Tower!”Jiang Ming expected this to happen and wasn’t disappointed about it. He just sort of lamented on the results.
When he first came here, he was able to clear four Battle Towers because his inner world underwent earth-shaking changes due to extreme transformation. Now that he had stepped into the True Immortal Realm, what changed were only an increment of the total accumulation of his cultivation.
‘The accumulation of points isn’t as high as I hoped for, but it’s still quite a lot.’
‘For the True Immortal Realm, no points will be awarded for clearing the first Battle Tower. The points will only be calculated from the second Battle Tower onwards, starting off with 1 point per level, increasing by tenfold into 10 points per level for the third Battle Tower. The points will then be increased by a hundred-fold, giving 1,000 points per level and increased again by another hundred-fold, giving 10,000 points per level!’
‘I’ve already been awarded points for the first level of the fifth Battle Tower and the levels before them, so these didn’t count!’
‘Now that I broke through four levels consecutively, I’m awarded 100,000 points per level. Therefore, it’s a total of 400,000 points!’
‘400,000 points down my pocket!’
‘There’s still the Heavenly Ladder to go for!’
Jiang Ming was in a great mood that day.
He had to stop at the 42nd step the last time. With the improvement to his cultivation realm this time around, his origin had been strengthened and should be able to help him go up a few more levels this time.
After trying the Heavenly Ladder this time, he fell upon reaching the 46th level and was considered to have gone up three steps. He was then awarded 300,000 points for it.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 11 (Heavenly Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 7,734,771
Achievements: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle Tower level 37, Heavenly Ladder step 42], [True Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower, level 2 to 5, Heavenly Ladder step 43 to 45].
His accumulated points had increased by 700,000.
However, his retreat into cultivation this time around consumed quite a bit of his points, racking up to more than 200,000 points used.
If other people knew what he just did, who knows how many would be distressed to death on how he squandered his points.
However, it was worth it for Jiang Ming.
The improvement of the cultivation base had reached his expectation and that he had also fully mastered it.
It could be considered that he had completely digested the whole skyrocket of his powers.
‘Should I return?’ Jiang Ming sat on the lotus platform as he frowned and pondered.
The improvement this time around was not qualitative changes. Therefore, if he were to go back now, it would still be unsafe.
In the end, he decided to stay to continue increasing his cultivation realm!
Jiang Ming, “Supreme Order, set me up for an acceleration by 10,000 years. Remind me in 10,000 years!”
Supreme Order, “Alright!”
His surroundings were shrouded in fog as the time was reversed.
Jiang Ming didn’t sink into his cultivation the first thing it started but took out cooked foods and feasted on it. He also took out bottles upon bottles of immortal brews, drinking himself into satisfaction.
Gluttony and lust are the natural human natures.
Since Junior Sister was not around, he could only eat and drink. It was fortunate that he had enough food.
Jiang Ming, “Question. Will time stand still or be in sync with the outside world if I were to cultivate in Hongmeng Core Land?”
Supreme Order, “In sync!”
Jiang Ming sighed lightly and continued asking, “How long does it take for an instance of cultivation?”
Supreme Order, “Thirty days in terms of mortal time.
Thirty days was not a lot. It was actually very little.
Afterall, it was for 500,000 points!
As he recalled the points that he used for the past 10,000 years, Jiang Ming was at a loss of words. ‘Cultivation of the World Dao is not the ordinary level of difficulty. Luckily, I got my hands on the Supreme Order. Otherwise…’
Otherwise, the current him would definitely be yet to step into the Immortal Realm.
Jiang Ming forcefully suppressed the many thoughts in his mind and turned on the enlightenment mode again.
It cost one point every two hours, but Jiang Ming didn’t mind.
Relatively speaking, using one point for 10,000 years of cultivation time was worth it. Moreover, it was considered the benefits given to the group members.
As for costing 1,000 points to listen to the sermons once, it would be much more difficult.
In a flick of an eye, the time acceleration Jiang Ming was experiencing had come to an end.
In reality, Jiang Ming had been there for merely two hours. His body then disappeared as he entered the Battle Tower and continued to break through the levels.
Upon appearing on the sixth floor of the fifth Battle Tower, Jun Sanqian appeared on the opposite side.
As he looked at Jiang Ming, his face was scrunched as though he was having a toothache as he muttered, “Oh little brother! Enlightenment mode under ten-thousand-year acceleration. You’re really taking these points very lightly! This is such a waste!”
“It’s just some points. Old Brother, you care quite a bit for them?” Jiang Ming asked strangely.
“Points are not to be used like that! This is just too much of a waste!” Jun Sanqian continued as he couldn’t help shaking his head, “You are such a big dog with so many points in hand! You’re a lazy person and yet you are so anxious to improve your cultivation now. Is it because of certain problems over at your side?”
“A bit of a problem. I feel my strength is still lacking and I’m now anxious to improve myself!” Jiang Ming explained, and continued, “Old brother, you were right! With the Heavenly Immortal Realm, I was able to get past a few Battle Towers and yet when I reached the True Immortal Realm, I could only move forward another four levels. I’m really not used to these changes!”
Jun Sanqian was speechless, “The last time you tried yourself in the Battle Tower, you were at the True Immortal Realm and were taking on the Taiyi Realm Battle Tower! You managed to pass four levels consecutively and you’re telling me you’re not used to this? Forget it. You’re a little monster as well. Make your move! Let’s see if you can clear the fifth Battle Tower this time!”
“Bring it on, old brother!” Jiang Ming’s fighting spirit soared.
He was now in the Mysterious Immortal Realm and was at the pinnacle. It could be regarded as the ultimate state of the Mysterious Immortal Realm. Looking over the infinite realms, there were very few people who could be compared to him.
The origin of his inner world had also further grown. In terms of raw power, even if it had not fully reached the Great Overarching Realm level, it was already coming close.
Ten clones appeared around Jiang Ming.
Although the origin of his inner world was strong, it was impossible for him to mobilize all that energy. Therefore, conjuring clones helped increase his combat power. Also, it only consumed some of the origin to do so.
“Time and Space Confinement!”
At the same time, the 10 clones all evoked the same special ability.
That’s right, they only used the same ability.
Space was the king and Time was the Venerate.
The combination of space and time had evolved into a terrifying special ability of confinement. Even Jun Sanqian’s terrifying and boundless power that had just been brewing was imprisoned by the ability.
Before he could break free from the confinement, the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique had already landed onto his forehead, penetrating his sea of consciousness, destroying his primal spirit at the same time.
With that, Jiang Ming was now on the seventh level!
It was still Jun Sanqian standing in front of him. Jun Sanqian looked at Jiang Ming and was quite speechless for what happened, “You’re sort of cheating!”
“Hehe!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh, “Tell me old brother, what do you think of this technique of mine?”
“Strong! Extremely strong at that!” Jun Sanqian commented and continued, “Time-Space Dao can lock space, freeze time, break through all illusions and imprison a target. You used ten clones that evoked the ability at the same time. Such dense immortality essence of yours really makes people envious! It’s extremely difficult to evade it, but still isn’t impossible. The person can either forcefully break through the shackle or use Immortal Soldiers as a defensive mechanism. It’s a pity that this is the Battle Tower and I only have such a level of strength here. Also, I do not have any powerful Immortal Soldier. Therefore, trying to break free from such a technique of yours is quite difficult!”
“I pondered for a long time because of that and finally came up with such a technique to face off against my enemy. This also fully maximizes my advantages over others!” Jiang Ming explained as he nodded.
During his cultivation retreat, he comprehended special abilities and evoked infinite laws. Coupled with the various situations where he fought against many, he finally came up with such an approach towards his enemy.
“The idea is very good indeed!” Jun Sanqian said with a smile, “Your origin is dense, yet your cultivation realm is insufficient. You will definitely suffer a loss in the long run. It’s better to just start off with your ultimate killer move right off the bat! It’s also fortunate that your comprehension of special ability is strong enough, otherwise, it will still not work. Also, your mind and will is also strong enough to be able to evoke such terrifying clones. You were also able to completely control your powers and can even command your avatars to evoke the special ability at the same time! It would be absolutely impossible for someone else to do this. After all, the stronger the conjured clones, the more willpower it consumes!”
“You are amazing, old brother!” Jiang Ming praised Jun Sanqian in amazement.
One of the reasons his mind and will being this strong was because of the evolution of his inner world. The key to it was still because of the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra he was cultivating, mending his mind and will to a terrifying level.
The Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra coupled with his inner world had really formed a qualitative change.
“Should I be the one to make the first move this time?” Jun Sanqian asked.
“Old brother, you’re actually thinking of testing my ability to cope with situations, right? Alright!” Jiang Ming replied, “I’ve also considered such situations happening, so you can just make your move, old brother!”
Jun Sanqian nodded. Immediately after his body swayed, figures of himself were densely packed throughout each corner of the skies, filling each and every gap. Also, all these figures had spiritual auras and were all extraordinarily powerful.
At the very next moment, the millions of figures launched their attacks at the same time.
“Explode!”
Ten clones had already appeared around Jiang Ming.
It was at this moment, one of the clones made its move.
He directly went ahead with the Grand World Technique, incorporating all the surrounding voids into it and then followed up by self-destructing.
BooM!
The void exploded in great successions as waves of torrents rolled out through the surrounding area from the explosion.
Jun Sanqian’s attacks were stunned by the explosion and the millions of figures suddenly blurred for a short while before solidifying yet again.
“Found you!”
“Time and Space Confinement!”
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up and the rest of the nine clones made their moves at the same time, confining Jun Sanqian, before following up with the Return of Infinite Law Finger, destroying him.
With this technique, it did not matter whether it was the eighth floor or the ninth floor, Jiang Ming passed all of them.
He had now reached the first level of the sixth Battle Tower.
“One-trick pony! To think that you were able to pass the fifth Battle Tower with the same move!” The opponent in the sixth Battle Tower was still Jun Sanqian and he was quite speechless at how Jiang Ming dealt with the fifth Battle Tower.
“Old brother! There’s an infinite number of special abilities, yet it all comes down to its effectiveness!” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Old brother. Are you in the Great Overarching Realm state?”
“That’s right!” Jun Sanqian nodded and continued, “All the levels of the fifth Battle Tower were determined based on the rankings of the cultivators across the infinite realms who were at the pinnacle of Taiyi Realm. Now that it has come down to the sixth level, they will all be at the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm now. These geniuses are all arrogant in the infinite realms. Compared to the ninth level of the fifth Battle Tower, their combat powers have increased by more than 100-fold to the point that they could even cut down a Quasi-Sage! Bother, are you still feeling confident?”
“Well, I’ll still have to give it a try!” Jiang Ming replied as 10 clones appeared around him yet again.
This time however, his expression was extremely solemn. His body grew greatly, reaching a height of 300 feet. His physical strength increased by 300-fold. It was extreme to an almost unbelievable state.
“Old brother, I’ll be making the first move now!”
“Time and Space Confinement!”
Jiang Ming let out a long howl as all of his clones burst into evoking the confinement technique.
The power of time and space intertwined, forming chains after chains as they entangled Jun Sanqian. However, this terrifying existence of Jun Sanqian started bursting out streaks and streaks of sword qi, smashing the chains of time and space abruptly, breaking through the special ability.
With a swift beam from the sword light, all the clones were destroyed.
“That strong?” Jiang Ming was horrified, “Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
The power that was brewing in his body finally surged out, putting his physical body to the limits as he burst out in an unprecedented dazzling luminance.
It was a single finger technique aiming to break apart the Great Dao’s Shackle with the sole aim of annihilation. However, the technique was parried with a single sword slash by Jun Sanqian.
“It’s blocked?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“Well, my current state is at the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm. Not only has my cultivation base skyrocketed, I also gained various special abilities at that.” Jun Sanjian gave him a brimming smile and continued, “Alas, the Great Overarching Realm! Overseeing the infinite realms, it can be said to be a type of qualitative metamorphosis to a person where the cultivator experiences sublimation of life, escaping the transcendence of the long river of destiny. From here on, those from where he originates will know him for who he is, where his true self is the one who thread on the path of Great Dao. He will become a unique entity in the infinite realm and only then that a person can truly control his own destiny. Great Overarching also has its own special ability. The essence of control in the Great Overarching Realm and the combat power it produces is something that is far beyond your expectation. You might be able to deal with the ordinary Great Overarching Golden Immortal but facing the current me now is still a very difficult feat.”
“Is that so, old brother? Still, I will not admit defeat!” Jiang Ming’s fighting spirit soared yet again as blood shot smoked rushed out above his head, reaching the million-mile height of the sky that was conjured in this space.
The stars started swaying and the milky ways trembled.
“Worlds Projection, Great Dao Chessboard!”
Jiang Ming struck again.
His inner world started to manifest into reality as chains of the 3,000 laws penetrated through the void, forming a perfect chessboard, criss-crossing, and imprisoning everything in it.
Within the chessboard, Jiang Ming was the Heavenly Dao itself, the true dictator that controls the infinite laws. Everything was mere chess pieces to him.
This was the special ability that Jiang Ming had continued to deduce based on the World Projection technique.
Repression, Imprisonment, Blockade, Suppression, etc.
“It’s not bad! But it’s still useless to me!” Jun Sanqian commented while he shook his head. With a flick of his finger, a sword slash burst out, tearing the void into a huge ravine.
“This is only just the beginning!” Jiang Ming wasn’t the slightest of all surprised but was conversely extremely calm.
Based on the current state of Jun Sanqian’s combative ability, his thoughts cycled through 300 billion times in an instance before finally concluding: If he wants to win, he can only risk his life for it.
“With the laws as the flame and the origin as it’s fuel, let the inner world ignite!”
Boom!
As Jiang Ming muttered, the laws were evoked as the chains of law that was shaking the void were ignited by a holy flame. The power of origin poured out, turning into a monstrous power of destruction.
“Inner World Destruction!”
“Let the inner world be destroyed as all things return to nothingness, fuelling the power of the ultimate annihilation!”
Jiang Ming directly sacrificed his inner world.
The moment when the inner world was destroyed, the power of destruction that transcended everything burst out in all directions.
The strength of such a blow was akin to the tears of the Heavenly Dao, the curse by all living beings that could completely bury an entire era, putting an end into everything there was.
Along with the destruction of the world, calamity, curse, viciousness, decay, annihilation and many more emerged one after another and finally turned into a force that could end everything, condensed on his fingertips.
“Little boy! You actually deduced such a level of special ability!” Jun Sanqian was very surprised, “Although the destruction of a world is capable of leading to such a terrifying outburst of power, it should be far from this level that you produced. You destroyed the world and used it to evoke an ultimate special ability of total annihilation from it! You really dare to think of such thoughts and even do so!”
“Hehe! Well, old brother. Since this is within the Battle Tower, I will naturally have to do my best to get more points!” Jiang Ming’s soul trembled as his voice was 10,000 times faster than the speed of light, “I wouldn’t dare to even deduce such a special ability, let alone evoking it if I was in the outside world!”
His sound echoed through the space.
This finger technique of Jiang Ming had already solidified the surrounding void.
Even Jun Sanqian was struggling frantically as sword qi that transcended fate was bursting out of his body, cutting through the power of laws, and trying to tear apart Jiang Ming’s attack.
It was at this moment, Jiang Ming’s fingertip slowly inched forward, shattering the sword lights that tried to block it and the technique finally landed on Jun Sanqian’s forehead.
Jun Sanqian’s head immediately exploded, and his primal spirit annihilated in an instant.
However, the moment Jiang Ming landed his attack, Jun Sanqian made his dying counterattack as he smashed Jiang Ming’s body into pieces with a slash of sword light.
Due to sacrificing his inner world, Jiang Ming’s head exploded as well.
Although his whole body was smashed into pieces, there was still a ray of divine soul that was left of him as it quickly escaped to a distance and avoided from the effect of the destructive power.
As all the smoke dissipated, Jiang Ming also recovered himself.
“Victorious!”
He couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
However, he couldn’t help but shudder when he recalled the battle just now.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - Returning to the Eastern Region; Senior Brother, You Endured for 10,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Returning to the Eastern Region; Senior Brother, You Endured for 10,000 Years
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 13 (Mysterious Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 11,315,666
Achievement: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle Tower 37th levels; Heavenly Ladder 42nd steps], [True Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower level 2 to 5;Heavenly Ladder step 43 to 45], [Mystical Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower level 6 to 9, Sixth Battle Tower level 1; Heavenly Ladder step 46 to 48]
For Jiang Ming’s attempt on the Battle Tower, he managed to get past the level 1 of the sixth Battle Tower but was defeated at level 2.
That was a pretty good result already.
Next up was the Heavenly Ladder. He managed to also ascend by 3 steps only starting from step 45, and stopped at step 48.
All in all, the points he had accumulated from this time around was quite a lot.
Battle Tower: Mystical Immortal Realm, Third Battle Tower’s level 1 corresponded to one point; the Fourth Battle Tower corresponded to Golden Immortal Realm with an increase of 100-fold or 100 points for the level 1; the Fifth Battle Tower was then increased by yet another 100-fold with the level 1 giving 10,000 points; the Sixth Battle Tower continued to increase by 100-fold with the level 1 giving 1,000,000 points.
For the Fifth Battle tower from level 6 to 9, Jiang Ming obtained 40,000 points; whereas for the level 1 of the Sixth Battle Tower, he obtained 1,000,000 points, hence accumulated a total of 1,040,000 points.
Heavenly Ladder: step 46 to 54 corresponded to the willpower of a Great Overarching Realm cultivator with the Mystical Immortal Realm’s willpower as the standard, giving an increase of a million-fold of points. Jiang Ming went up three steps, which gave him 3,000,000 accumulated points. Since he had already obtained points for the steps below step 46, those were no longer added to the counters.
This time, a total of 4.04 million points were accumulated by Jiang Ming.
He couldn’t help being surprised and was overjoyed with the result.
There were only around seven million points remaining from this cultivation retreat last time, and together there was now a total of 11,315,666 points.
Updates by
He now had more than 10 million points! He was just overwhelmed with points!
Sitting on the Lotus platform, Jiang Ming was prepared to head back to reality. As he glanced around, he noticed an acquaintance of his and could not help but smile.
He paced his way through the air and before he could get near, the person turned over, paused for a moment before a sunny smile bloomed on her face, “Brother Ming! It’s really you!”
“It’s me alright!” Jiang Ming landed right in front of her, “Chenxi, why did you come so soon?”
The lady was Dongfang Chenxi, a cultivator who walks on the same path of World Dao as him.
“When you said you were leaving soon, I went back to ask my father to build me a Time House and slept in it.” Dongfang Chenxi sat on the sofa that Jiang Ming took out and happily said, “As I was sleeping, my inner world automatically evolved into a small chiliocosm itself. After waking up, I practiced a lot of special abilities, and came over here only after ample preparation. I just passed the assessment and saw you right after! God is so kind to me!”
“It’s unbelievable to see so many people here. I was confused and at loss at first, but now that I see you, I’m not afraid anymore!” She was genuinely happy.
“Your inner world naturally evolved into a small chiliocosm while you slept? You really make me jealous!” Jiang Ming was quite speechless.
It could be said that he exhausted all his effort for the sake of allowing his inner world to evolve.
He obtained countless god-like rewards, and great encounters through the Fifth Immortal Moon and the Supreme Pagoda.
It took him countless years before completing the transition of his inner world from a planar world to a small chiliocosm.
However, this person right here had it easy for her, as she only had to fall asleep, and her inner world evolved into a small chiliocosm just like that.
‘Reincarnation is really a technical task!’ Jiang Ming sighed in his heart.
Well, she had a great father, so that was something he could not compare to.
“Haha!” Dongfang Chenxi couldn’t help laughing but turned bitter as she continued in distress, “However, my father also said that in order to help my inner world evolve into small chiliocosm, he exhausted his savings and even owed countless debts to others. Hence, his help to me will have to end here. I will have to rely on myself to evolve my inner world and improve my strength in the future.”
“This shows that you have completely grown up now and it’s time to take responsibility!” Jiang Ming could not help commenting.
“I know right!” Dongfang Chenxi nodded in agreement, “But I don’t want to grow up yet!”
“Why?”
“There’s too much trouble when we grow up!”
“But you’ve grown up now! Haha!”
“Brother Ming!” Dongfang Chenxi pouted.
“Enough about that!” Jiang Ming quickly waved his hand and continued, “If you need anything in the future, just tell me. I’ll help you out!”
“Really?”
“Of course it’s real!”
“Thanks Brother Ming!” Dongfang Chenxi cheered, “Brother Ming, I remember that there were very few people in the old Supreme Pagoda in the past. How are there so many here now?”
“As far as I know, the odds of mortal beings obtaining the Supreme Order is relatively low. Most of the Supreme Order falls into the hands of the beings of the Immortal Realm. Another reason is that the cultivation base from level 11 to level 15 are all in here.” As Jiang Ming explained, he flicked his finger and sealed off the surroundings. With a serious face, he continued, “Chenxi, you must remember what I tell you next.”
Dongfang Chenxi sat up straight, “Alright. Tell me what it is, brother Ming.”
“When you are in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, you must accumulate points to the limit, practice on great special ability and enter the Battle Tower as well as the Heavenly Ladder more.” Jiang Ming was extremely serious as he continued, “When I was in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, I was able to reach level 37 in the Battle Tower and up to step 42 on the Heavenly Ladder. Even if you cannot reach that, try your best to get past more levels!”
“Level 37 in the Battle Tower and step 42 on the Heavenly Ladder?” As soon as Dongfang Chenxi thought about it, she was extremely shocked, “Brother Ming! You are asking me to have the combat power of a Taiyi Golden Immortal when I am in the Heavenly Immortal Realm? Moreover, you’re asking me to compete with the geniuses of Taiyi Golden Immortal Realms, who are no weaker than those who obtained the Supreme Order?”
“Can I even do it?” Dongfang Chenxi’s face suddenly turned bitter, “Brother, I can’t do it!”
“I was able to do it!”
“Well, you are you and I am myself!”
“Just do your best!”
“Alright!”
“Once you reach your own limit, you might be able to inherit the position as the group leader when I step down in the future. When the time comes, you might obtain a truly sky-defyingly great encounter.”
“Brother Ming, you are the group leader again?” Dongfang Chenxi’s eyes suddenly brightened, and she couldn’t help but grab onto Jiang Ming’s arm excitedly, “I knew brother Ming is very powerful! You stood at the top in the mortal world. Now that you have broken into the Immortal Realm, you are standing at the top again just as you arrived! You are amazing, my brother!”
“I’m just normal!” Jiang Ming said with a smile and continued, “Remember, the group leader will be able to obtain a sky-defying level of great encounter. Although I haven’t used it for myself yet, I feel that this kind of opportunity will probably even surpass being nurtured by Holy Venerates!”
“Surpass even Holy Venerates?” Dongfang Chenxi took a deep cold breath.
She was currently more knowledgeable on many things and knew how terrifying a Holy Venerate could be.
Holy Venerate could be really terrifying, overwhelming across the infinite realm and suppressing everything throughout the ages. Even her father had to bow his head in front of a Holy Venerate and treat them with great respect.
It was only at this moment that she realized how precious the information that Jiang Ming told her was.
“One more thing!” Jiang Ming said seriously again, “Don’t ever waste your points! You must accumulate up to 500,000 points. It’s okay if you can’t become the group leader in the future. However, if you really do become one, you might even have the chance to evolve your inner world into a middle chiliocosm and even have the possibility of becoming a great chiliocosm!”
“This…” Dongfang Chenxi’s face was filled with shock.
Whether it was the accumulation of 500,000 points or the middle chiliocosm and great chilicosom, she was shocked by the advice.
“Brother Ming! I will etch your advice deep in my heart, down to my bones and soul!” Dongfang Chenxi was more serious than she was ever before.
Jiang Ming nodded silently in reply.
They continued to talk about their own experiences as well as the basic situation in the Supreme Pagoda.
“This is the special ability that I practice as well as some experience when I was up against some enemies. They are suitable for the cultivation of World Dao, so you can have a try!” Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes, and a ball of light appeared in front of him. He condensed the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique, Great Manifestation Technique, Time and Space Confinement and many other special abilities as well as his various experiences going up against his enemies into the ball of light and handed it over to her, “If you are able to fully master these, your result in the Supreme Pagoda won’t be bad!”
“Brother Ming, I will definitely not let you down!” Dongfang Chenxi took in the ball of light without hesitation while patting on her chest and made a serious promise, “I will definitely become the next group leader!”
“That’s the way of us who walks the path of World Dao!” Jiang Ming smiled, “I have some small problems to take care of in my reality. I cannot stay here long and must leave now. Maybe when we meet up again, you might have joined the group chat as well!”
“I will make it as soon as possible!” Dongfang Chenxi asked worriedly, “Brother Ming, will it be dangerous? Do you need help?”
“Don’t worry!”
“Alright!”
Jiang Ming stood up and glanced around. He looked over at the Battle Tower and then the Dao Enlightenment Sea. After a little hesitation, he still decided to return to his reality.
He no longer could continue his cultivation until the pinnacle of the Golden Immortal Realm so that his inner world could also reach the pinnacle of small chilicosms.
The cultivation this time around had made him mentally exhausted. He needed to communicate with his Junior Sister to prevent psychological problems. In fact, what he was most afraid of was the gradually turning indifference to everything and losing his human side.
In addition, the accumulation he had in his inner world was exhausted as well.
His origin of his inner world was able to grow consecutively in such a short time was because of the ample accumulation from the past events such as Mystical Yellow Motherly Qi exchanged by Fifth Immortal Moon, the absorption of the Heavenly Court’s medicinal field, the daily remuneration from cooking and so on.
Currently, these accumulations were almost exhausted, even the Immortal Medicinal Field’s growth was affected.
If he continued with his retreat for cultivation, he was afraid that there wouldn’t be much improvement even in a hundred thousand years’ time.
Although his inner world was now operating on its own and was able to increase its own origin, it was still way too slow. If he relied on his inner world to evolve on its own, he estimated that he needed tens of billions of years’ time just to reach the pinnacle of a small chiliocosm.
At Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming finally returned.
“Senior Brother, you’re done with your cultivations?” Linglong came to his side immediately and asked softly. As she hugged his arms, she looked up and down Jiang Ming carefully and was relieved once she saw that her Senior Brother was alright.
“Yes, I’m done with it!” Jiang Ming hugged Linglong forcefully, “The time there was boundless, and I almost fell into the pits of the ruthless Dao!”
“Senior Brother, how much time did you accelerate?” Linglong was stunned as he also noticed the aura of indifference that was emanating from her Senior Brother.
“Twenty thousand years!”
“Twenty thousand years? It’s way too long! Senior Brother, can you still endure it?”
“No, I can’t help it anymore!”
“Well, hurry up and let’s go then!”
Linglong dragged him and hurriedly flew back into their room.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - The Fallen World
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: The Fallen World
As Dongfang Chenxi watched Jiang Ming’s figure disappear from the Supreme Pagoda, she was a little disappointed.
“Brother Jiang Ming is the group leader again. What about me? I just entered here.”
“He came from the planar mortal world. He doesn’t have the resources, the easy access to special abilities and even the supreme power of laws.”
“As for myself? I came from a great chiliocosm with my father being a Quasi-Sage Venerate who’s considered a supreme existence over in my world, hence can easily mobilize endless resources for me. Even my World Dao was arranged by my father.”
“I have better qualifications, resources, background, and cultivated special abilities. Yet in the end I’m still not good at everything compared to him. Why is that?”
“I’m such a failure! Brother Jiang Ming was born ordinary, yet is able to rise above all, soaring through the sky like a dragon. I can’t go on like this! I can’t let my father and brother Jiang Ming down! I will work hard and forge ahead!”
Dongfang Chenxi clenched her fist tightly as she muttered and cheered for herself.
Only then she sat down and a divine light burst out from her body, sealing her surroundings. She began absorbing the essence of special abilities that Jiang Ming imparted to her. After sorting all the information, she couldn’t help but be shocked at her discovery.
‘This Return of Infinite Law Finger technique encompasses 3,000 types of laws! Brother Jiang Ming’s comprehensive ability is really out of this world to be able to comprehend such a terrifying special ability. Once these 3,000 laws merge into one, the degree of power eruption would be…’
Dontfang Chenxi took a deep breath.
There were still other special abilities such as the Great Manifestation Technique and Time and Space Confinement.
‘If I am able to comprehend all these special abilities…’
Her eyes suddenly brightened and she suddenly recalled what her father told her before: A person such as him who rose from the mortal world and was able to create the World Dao by himself. Once he succeeds, he will definitely be able to overpower the whole infinite realm.
‘It’s really true…’ Dongfang Chenxi had a complicated look.
Updates by
Without too much hesitation, she came over to a lotus platform at the Dao Enlightenment Sea, used her accumulated points and evoked a 10,000 years acceleration.
On top of Chuyang Peak, the entire manor was shaking as great volumes of pink mists were appearing out of nowhere.
Even the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed was a little overwhelmed by the two.
At the back of the mountain, Xi Yao felt something in her heart and came out from her cultivation retreat. As she looked at the slight haze at the manor in front of her, her feelings were complicated and turned up to look at the skies instead.
Amidst the incomparably dark and vast space, a bright light appeared.
A huge sun seemed to have emerged suddenly from the depth of time and space as its faint light penetrated the endless barriers, expelling darkness and bringing warmth to all.
At the same time, she also saw a vast world that was rapidly approaching.
There, the Immortal lights rose high as a devilish aura permeated through the skies. There were occasionally rays of sword light bursting out, shattering the hundreds and millions of stars. Roars that could even shatter the skies could be heard as well.
“Is the real catastrophe looming already?” Xi Yao whispered to herself.
On the other side of the cliff, Chang Yiming just came out of his cultivation retreat.
He had actually entered into the Primal Spirit Realm. No one in the entire Jiuyang Sect would’ve believed that he was able to improve so much in such a short time if it was in the past.
However, it had really happened.
In fact, not only Chang Yiming, for the rest of the other Jiuyang Sect’s also experienced a skyrocket improvement in their cultivation base.
“Brother Jiang said that our world is descending into a battlefield of the Immortal Realm. It seems that the time has come!” Chang Yiming’s face was filled with worries, “Can we stand up to this?”
‘The world is destroyed and only the Eastern Region is left safe and sound. If anything happens, our entire heritage would be gone!’ Chang Yiming was getting more worried, but he was helpless about it.
At the same time, Jiuyang Sect’s Sect Master, Tianyuan School’s Liu Changkong who had entered the Heavenly Immortal Realm, Ye Ming who had attained the Imminent Immortal Realm and others all looked up into the sky.
Within their looks of shock, glints of sadness could be seen.
The world was facing a catastrophe, yet they could do nothing about it but wait for the judgment of fate.
On top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming walked out of his room feeling refreshed. He stretched himself lazily.
What a great day he felt!
“Senior brother, how do you feel?” Linglong was like a little bird nestled in his arms with a mushy soft voice that felt ticklish.
“The side effect from my cultivation retreat seems to have completely disappeared.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Gluttony and lust are both human natures. With you and great foods, my humanity won’t be diminished. Girl, you are really the best medicine for me.”
“Would you like to take another dose?” Linglong winked her eyes, “As the world descends into the battlefield of the infinite realm, going at it again seems to be very intriguing!”
“You’re asking for a beating!”
Smack…!
Jiang Ming slapped her behind his back.
However, there was a feeling of eagerness brewing in his heart.
To be doing the oldest type of sports up in the mountain as the world was falling. He thought that would have been an absolutely beautiful scene!
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming suppressed his restless heart because he knew that a man had to be able to endure what ordinary people couldn’t in order to achieve great things!
Swoosh!
He flipped open the Human Path Record instead.
Name: Bei Chenguang
Race: Half-human, half-god.
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base : Golden Immortal Realm
Background: Palace Master of the Chengguang Immortal Palace, affiliated to the Emperor Star Palace of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm.
Relationship: -96
Innate Talent: Taiyi
Status: Soon! The mortal world is about to be led into the Infinite Realm Battlefield by the Great Overarching Dao vessel and descend to this battlefield dominated by us.
: To avoid any incidents, he invited three Taiyi Immortal Kings to standby in advance by using his identity as the emperor’s son, while he leads an army of Immortal Spirit awaiting their arrival. Once the mortal world descends, he will directly suppress it, refine it and deprive of it the great fortune of creation.
: The human realm has reached the edge of the battlefield and was detected by the power of laws here.
: Haha! This mortal world can no longer escape! It’s already in the bag!
…
Upon reading this, Jiang Ming revealed a sinister cruel sneer on his face.
At the same time, the membrane that enveloped this broken-up world was shattering into pieces as waves of mighty aura descended onto the land, wanting to completely tear this world apart.
“Our world has integrated into the laws of the other world!” Linglong frowned and continued, “We’re descending into the battlefield right after. I’m afraid our world will be torn apart under the effect of such supreme power. Senior Brother, do you have the confidence to contend with this?”
“Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming nodded with a solemn expression on his face.
He had already felt the terrifying power acting on the ground beneath his feet. With a simple thought in his mind, the Saint Province Dao Square’s power securely protected the Eastern Region
Mobilizing the Saint Province Dao Square with his current power would result in a strength that far surpasses anyone’s imagination.
Atop his head, the great sun was becoming clearer and clearer.
Jiang Ming already knew that this was the sun that belonged to the great chiliocosm, illuminating the infinite realms. It belonged to the Flame and Light origins of the Honggu great chiliocosm.
Although he was able to see them, he sensed that this huge sun was very far away from him as though it was located in the depths of infinite space.
The power that it contained within made even Jiang Ming trembled with fear.
Boom!
As the deafening blast was heard, storms of destruction swept across the sky, ripping apart and decimating everything.
It was even mixed with the outburst of the terrifying power from the chains of law.
Just looking at it trembled a person’s heart and soul.
Puff…
Liu Cangkong who was on the other side looking into the skies suddenly opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood. His breath suddenly wilted and was in great horror, “What level of chains of law is that? I just glanced at it to see if I could have a peek at its essence but was met with such a terrible backlash!”
“It’s over. Everything’s over!”
“Having to descend into such a terrifying world, just the destructive storm alone would have completely destroyed us.”
“Are we humans really going to be destroyed just like this?
“I can’t accept this!”
Liu Changkong howled out in sadness.
Ye Ming on the other hand, had a strange look on his face, “Old Dean, it seems that the world’s membrane has been completely destroyed but the storm that came down on us turned to a mere gentle breeze and didn’t even destroy a single grass or trees on our grounds. Also, there aren’t any trembles at all!”
“There isn’t?” Liu Changkong was stunned for a moment. After sensing his surroundings carefully, he realized that there was in fact no trembling effect from the outside. But as soon as he turned his gaze and looked in the direction of Zhong Province, he couldn’t help himself from being shocked: “Look there, little Ming! Look! Look at our home!”
“This…” Ye Ming looked over and his expression suddenly froze.
The original land of Zhong Province had been torn apart. As the lands that were ripped into chunks of huge rocks fell, they were directly reduced back into the smallest particle of the world.
Only very few pieces remained and continued falling.
When they looked down at their feet, both of them were trembling immensely.
Glancing at each other, they both breathe out a sigh of relief.
Right that very moment, the earth was broken apart, as everything collapsed and disintegrated quickly, falling into the incomparably vast land below, all except for the Eastern Region where there was no movement at all.
Standing on top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was extremely shocked at the scene.
The seas overflowed as the earth disintegrated into pieces.
‘So this is what a fallen world looks like?’
The scene of such an incomparably vast world falling into an even vaster world was way too shocking.
It was just indescribable.
Jiang Ming also felt waves and waves of peerlessly powerful spiritual thoughts that swept over towards his direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - Moon Essence Wheel, Cruelty
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Moon Essence Wheel, Cruelty
Standing on top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming raised his head looking at the fiery scorching hot sun. While it brought warmth to the world, there was also the endless luminance of sunlight. Vaguely, Jiang Ming seemed to have spotted living beings in the sun, but it was too distorted and difficult to be distinguished.
Looking down, it was a piece of overwhelmingly vast land, adorned with a few lakes.
No, these were more of a sea than lakes to him. Yet, these seas seemed like small lakes as the land was way too vast.
Even the Eastern Region descending on to the lake seemed as small as a mere dot.
In addition, there were immortals that were weaving in and out, going around places, each one with a very profound aura.
Jiang Ming also felt that the place was filled with an endless immortal spiritual aura that was dense, majestic and filled with vitality. Merely taking in a single breath could help the people of the mortal world cleanse their bones and marrows, allowing their innate talents to skyrocket.
However, such a phenomenon also brought upon extreme pressure on them.
It was fortunate that the people of the Eastern Region had been baptized by the Immortal Qi before. Otherwise, suddenly appearing in such an environment would have caused them a violent death.
“Senior Brother, it seems that there are a lot of peerless experts gathered right below where we are landing, preparing to attack us!” Linglong suddenly gasped.
Her consciousness had long since spread through the surrounding, sensing across the vast land.
“However, they don’t look too strong and the strongest among them is just at the Golden Immortal Realm. Should we kill them all?” Linglong continued.
All nine of her clones were there, but were all hidden from sight.
Moreover, the hazy Chuyang Peak made it difficult for the outside world to peek into the place and see the truth.
“Don’t. They are from the human race after all!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
Updates by
He also noticed them preparing to attack. However, he felt he could not disallow someone to counterattack as they were falling right on top of the people’s heads?
What’s more, he would have felt sorry if he killed them without them having the chance to counter attack.
“There seems to be a lake not far away. Let’s land there!”
As Jiang Ming muttered, he evoked the Saint Province Dao square, enveloped the entire Eastern Region at the same time with special ability as he began to move the place. With his current cultivation level, such a feat was no problem at all. The land that was falling downward, started to move across horizontally.
“Senior Brother, there are quite a lot of loaches living in the lake!” Linglong smiled, her eyes narrowed into a crescent moon as she said, “They must be delicious!”
“That is why we are landing on this lake here. This pool of water that is way larger than the Eastern Sea will be ours from now on, and these creatures in the water are naturally our food source!” Jiang Ming explained as if it was a matter of fact.
Linglong merely smiled and nodded.
Jiang Ming’s eyes suddenly narrowed as he looked over to another direction. It seemed as though there were a lot of peerless experts hiding in the shadows here and there were even three Immortal Kings of the Taiyi Realm.
“Chenguang Immortal Lord!” Jiang Ming knew in his heart that these peerless experts must be the people of the emperor’s son who had been scheming on his mortal world, but he didn’t care.”
It was no big deal. He would kill them all if they were to come over!
He would then go over to the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm and destroy his father, the Immortal Emperor of Bei Chenxing, putting an end to this, rather than allowing them to continue with their charades.
Turning his head slightly, he looked in another direction and saw a monstrous demonic energy.
‘Is that the Devil King Xue Tao?’ As Jiang Ming pondered, he evoked the Human Path Record.
Woosh! The pages were flipped open.
Name: Xue Tao
Race : Gorefiend
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Devil King, Golden Immortal Realm)
Background: Third Devil King of the Blood Red Abyss of the small chiliocosm.
Relationship: -99
Innate Talent: Golden Immortal.
Status: After exhausting all his resources, his invasion into the mortal world has failed. Unwilling to give up, he entered the abyss and joined the ranks of the Blood Emperor, offering the secrets of the mortal world to them.
: Under his guidance, the Blood Emperor evoked his special ability, peeped into the Tianyuan Continent and discovered that the land was being led into the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Having familiarity with the power leading the land over, the Blood Emperor did not rush to take action. Instead, he sent a few Devil Kings and Devil King Xue Tao to go forth and prepare to act when opportunity rises.
: This is the Infinite Realm Battlefield! A place far more terrifying than the abyss. Now that I arrived here yet again, I must take another step and step into the Devil King Realm. Otherwise, I would still be feeble like an ant and be killed at some point.
: Soon… Soon! I have already sensed the arrival of the Human World.
: Finally, I can see it now!
: Good lord! The world has been shattered, but the outburst of destructive power from the fallen world did not tear that piece of land into pieces.
: Even if the world is destroyed, there should still be some residual power. This is equivalent to two worlds colliding. One of them would be captured by another while the other naturally evoked all its potential and power. The destructive storm erupting from it would be so very terrifying and yet that piece of land still seemed to be safe and sound.
: Sure enough, this mortal world is not normal!
: Is it because of her?
: Anyway, this time, I’ll make sure you die!
: Now that you are targeted by the immortals and demons as well as being monitored by the Immortal Emperor and Devil Emperor, how can they even survive?
: What benefits would I get from it?”
: Sigh… I’ll just wait and see.
…
Upon reading, Jiang Ming’s eyes dimmed.
‘Xue Tao, oh Xue Tao…Isn’t it better to stay alive? You were the only one who survived among the 19 Devil Kings. You didn’t hide and work hard on your cultivation, but chose to continue your charades. Anyways, I will completely destroy you this time and bury the grievances with you.’
“Blood Emperor, Immortal Emperor Bei Chen!” Jiang Ming whispered.
Below them was a lake that spanned out to a radius of 80 million kilometer. Its endlessness made it even bigger than the Eastern Sea of Tianyuan World. Here, the place was occupied by the water race and was led by an Ice Dragon.
Sensing the terrifying aura from the sky, a blue-clad middle-aged man came out of the water, and stood on the surface of the lake.
Shrimp soldiers and crab generals appeared around him.
“Dragon Lord, this must be the remnant of a shattered world that has fallen. I’ll go and blast it to pieces!” A flat-headed shrimp soldier bowed his head asking for instruction. Just as he was about to leave, he noticed the Dragon Lord glancing at him, causing him to shiver in fear and quickly back down.
“Remnants that fell will inevitably disintegrate to a certain degree. However, this piece of residual land seems to be safe and sound. How can it be a simple land?” Dragon Lord snorted as two cold lines spurted out of his eyes. Air immediately froze and the surrounding temperature fell out of the blues. “It took us so much effort and we finally found a place to live. To think that they dare falling on top of our head! I don’t care what secrets are hidden by the land. I want it destroyed!”
“Oh?” His expression changed slightly when he saw a girl rapidly falling from above and couldn’t help laughing, “Such a perfect little girl! This is something worth playing around with!”
“Dragon Lord, should I catch and bring her over?” The flat-headed shrimp soldier said again.
The Dragon Lord gave a single slap, smacking him afar, “To think that you would smear my rations with those dirty claws of yours! You’re asking for it!”
Yet, at that very moment, the girl that seemed to be falling suddenly slashed her sword midair. In an instant, the sky below her feet was densely filled with sword qi.
Its destructive aura caused a wild change on the Dragon Lord’s face as he cursed, “God damn it! This is the power of a Taiyi Immortal King! It’s a Taiyi Immortal King! How can there be such a strong existence in this fallen world remnant?”
“Stop it! Stop! I’m the third prince of the Dragon Palace!”
“Stop what you are doing!”
As the Dragon Lord exclaimed, he opened his mouth and spit out a dragon ball. It burst into 3,000 layers of blue luminance, forming curtains of ice that turned into a defense mechanism, but was easily shattered by the sword light.
He even morphed into a blue true dragon, raising his claws and lunged his attack upwards.
Unfortunately for him, neither his defense nor attack could block those invincible sword lights.
Puff…
As the Dragon Lord’s defense was penetrated, his dragon claws were shattered.
Just as the sword light was about to completely kill the Dragon Lord, a golden light suddenly flew out of his forehead. The light morphed into an old man that radiated auras of extreme nobility and power.
“I’m the Dragon Emperor! Stop this instant!”
The old man’s deafening howl echoed through the sky.
“Dragon Emperor? That must taste even better!”
It was Linglong who launched the attack. She took the initiative to attack after she discovered the situation below.
She didn’t expect that killing such a small true dragon would lead her to such a peerless expert. However, she also saw through that it was merely an imprint and its power was limited.
Linglong attacked again. Between the flashes of the sword’s light, rays of destructive luminance burst out, destroying the Dragon Emperor that was conjured from the imprint.
The Dragon Lord was also beheaded by that single sword slash.
“Seal!”
Linglong didn’t stop there. She slashed a few more swords towards the bottom direction, forming a great formation array that sealed off the lake.
She then turned back around and landed back on Chuyang Peak.
At that moment, the speed that their land was falling was greatly reduced, as though it was a soft feather slowly falling.
Thousands of miles away on top of a mountain peak, there were four people gathered around. One of them was Immortal Lord Chen Guang. When he saw Linglong’s attack, he couldn’t help but gasp, “So strong!”
“It’s really strong!” said a middle-aged person next to him, “She is a Taiyi Golden Immortal. Chen Guang, are you sure that this is a remnant left after a planar mortal world was destroyed?”
“I’m certain.” Immortal Lord Chen Guang nodded, but hesitantly continued, “Are you saying how this world can be destroyed if such a strong existence was hidden in it?”
“Yes!” The middle-aged man next to him continued, “Could it be that they’ve obtained some sort of Immortal encounters after the destruction of their world which led to their strength improving significantly? Chen Guang, could it be that you’ve been scheming on this mortal world all this time because of the great encounter hidden inside? It doesn’t seem small!”
“My uncles!” Immortal Lord Chen Guang narrowed his eyes and said with a smile, “If there’s a great encounter in it, it belongs to every one of us here. Let’s make our move! Those devils hidden over the other side are already waiting to act when opportunity arises. I’m afraid the great encounter will be snatched if we are too late.”
“Aren’t you afraid that the wolves have a winning game when the shepherds quarrels?”
“What are we afraid of?This is our home court and there’s even my father’s Great Overarching Immortal Artifact suppressing the place here. My father will definitely be watching over here and will never put us in danger. Besides, since there is a great encounter, it’s more assuring when it’s in our hands!”
“Alright, let’s make a move then!” The middle-aged man nodded.
The rest reached the same conclusion easily and flew up into the air.
The four of them led in front, followed by a few Immortal Lords at the back. At the same time, there were another 3,000 immortals that formed a battle formation following their leads. One of the peerless experts evoked a blood coloured flag, waved it in midair and mists started to appear in the sky, shrouding the entire million miles of sea.
…
On top of Chuyang Peak, Linglong had already returned from the skirmish. She casually threw to the side and a real dragon that she killed just now was pinned in the air. She then hugged Jiang Ming’s arm as she swayed around, coquettishly asking, “Senior brother, I want to eat!”
“Craving for sausages?”
“Humph! I’ll eat it now, but do you dare to take it out? Aren’t you afraid of accidentally exposing yourself to the infinite realm?”
“Well, you said you wanted to eat!”
“Senior Brother! You’re getting worse and worse! I’ve made up my mind! When this thing is over, we will spend 3,000 years in our room! I won’t believe that I can’t squeeze you dry!”
“You’re trying to murder your Senior Brother.”
“Hehe! Scared? Then hurry up and prepare a dragon feast for me!”
“Alright girl! But the enemies are coming!”
“Leave them to me!”
“Alright then. Just be careful! I’ll be cooking and you’ll be killing the enemies. Doesn’t it mean you are focusing on external affairs while I focus on internal affairs?”
“Hehe!Senior Brother, I will be your queen from now on! Serve me well and there will be rewards!”
“What rewards?”
“I’ll treat you to some buns!”
The two continued to mutter.
After the white fog shrouded the place and sealed off the surrounding, Linglong still did not leave.
Instead, she stood right beside Jiang Ming, watching his Senior Brother dissecting the true dragon and making a dragon feast out of it.
As for the enemies?
Three of her clones had flown out to greet them.
They were the Phoenix Junior Sister, Spatial Junior Sister and Time Junior Sister
“Spatial Imprisonment!”
“Time Lock!”
Spatial and Time Junior sister both evoked the special abilities that they were best at. The two techniques intertwined, forming a qualitative change that evolved into a great time space confinement, imprisoning Immortal Lord Chen Guang and the likes in it.
“Die!”
The Phoenix Junior Sister who was in the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm, started off directly with her ultimate moves.
It did not matter if they were Immortal Lords or Taiyi Immortal Kings. All of them were killed.
Even the great formation that was formed by the 3,000 Immortal Soldiers were wiped out.
As the three were cooperating tacitly, they were terrifyingly strong.
The only person who withstood the attack was Immortal Lord Chenguang. Just as he was about to be burnt to ashes by the Phoenix True fire, a crescent moon flew out of his body. It was his father’s Great Overarching Dao vessel, the Moon Essence Wheel that was used to lead the Tianyuan World to descend into the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
As soon as the artifact presented itself, the Phoenix True Fire was completely blocked by it.
“How can you three be this strong? ” Immortal Lord Chenguang was horrified and even had a look of despair on his face.
“Why not?”Phoenix Junior Sister sneered, “Is that a Great Overarching Dao Vessel? It can only protect you once! Now, die!”
Phoenix Junior Sister raised her hand and a flame vortex suddenly appeared, engulfing both Immortal Lord Chenguang and the Moon Essence Wheel. She was preparing to refine it.
It was at this moment, the flames exploded and Immortal Lord Chenguang could be seen dragged out of the flames by the Moon Essence Wheel.
A figure suddenly appeared on the Moon Essence Wheel, but was very dim as the figure muttered, “Fellow Daoist, I am Immortal Emperor Bei Chen from Starlight Middle Chiliocosm. Can you let go of Chenguang for my sake?”
“Do you think I would let him go with the enmity of my world getting destroyed?” Phoenix Junior Sister said indifferently.
“This Great Overarching Immortal Artifact will be an offer for apology!” Immortal Emperor Bei Chen said as he pointed at the Moon Essence Wheel.
This incarnation of him was imprinted on this Dao Vessel originally and it was also just in case that he needed to save his son’s life. Unexpectedly, his son encountered such a formidable person where even if she was only of the Taiyi Realm, her combat ability was extremely terrifying.
The power he left in the imprint was not strong enough.
“If I kill the both of you, the Dao Vessel will still be mine!” Phoenix Junior Sister launched her attack again.
“How dare you kill my beloved son! I will exhaust all the power of the Starlight Immortal World and destroy all of you!” Immortal Emperor Bei Chen’s voice fell and the imprint was destroyed.
Phoenix Junior Sister reached out, grabbing the Moon Essence Wheel and sealing it off. She then put it away and looked over at Immortal Lord Chenguang who was in shock.
She smiled coldly and muttered, “You know, it’s because of your greed that the hundreds of millions of people in the world I live in are constantly struggling between life and death. It’s also because of you that the world I live in was destroyed and led to this place here. All hopes of our world’s recovery seem to have completely faded.”
“They were merely feeble ants. No matter how many of them died, it has nothing to do with me!” Immortal Lord Chenguang seemed to have calmed down as he smiled indifferently.
Seeing that he was facing death, might as well be facing it calmly.
“What does it have to do with you?” Phoenix Junior Sister laughed as well and continued, “You are going to die soon and still it has nothing to do with you?”
Immortal Lord Chenguang’s face suddenly turned extremely gloomy.
“Your father will also be killed!” Phoenix Junior Sister continued, “The force that you are from will be wiped out too. Even the world that you came from may be destroyed!”
“Thinking of killing my father?” Immortal Lord Chenguang was stunned for a moment and couldn’t help laughing out loud, “Just you? Haha! Just you wait! When my father arrives, you will all perish and be the sacrifice for my death!”
“I won’t kill you now just because of what you just said!” Phoenix Junior Sister smiled cruelly and continued, “I will let you watch how your father gets killed!”
As soon as she finished, she forcefully sealed Immortal Lord Chenguang, brought her over to Chuyang Peak and pinned him directly in the void.
Jiang Ming, who was cooking the dragon’s liver, looked up and said with a smile, “Girl, you are just too kind hearted!”
“Senior Brother, what do you mean?” Phoenix Junior Sister asked in confusion.
“This kid is extremely sinful for the likes of us. If god doesn’t punish him, how can you merely seal him up!” Jiang Ming explained, “If you don’t kill him, there’s a chance of him being rescued. If this really happens, then he would’ve escaped scot free. Wouldn’t that be too good for him? If you don’t want to kill him, at least abolish his cultivation, shatter his sea of consciousness, wipe out his primal spirit and leave only a trace of his soul’s remnant. Even if the remnant of soul is the only thing left, it should be planted with 3,000 types of curses. If he were ever to be rescued, we can just completely kill him with just a single thought!”
“Even then, it’s not enough! Use the flames to burn through the remnant of his soul. Keep burning and let him experience extreme torture to atone for his sins! After all, he directly and indirectly led to the death of more than a trillion people in our world!”
Jiang Ming’s howled with an extremely cold voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 225
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Immortal Moon’s Warning, Meeting Momo Again.
In the vast starry sky of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm, there was an Immortal Palace that radiated bursts of light, laminating trillions of miles away.
“To think my imprint was wiped out!”
Deep in the palace, Bei Chenxing suddenly stood up, and tsunami-like waves of power immediately surged out, sweeping through the endless starry sky.
Some of the stars even straight-up collapsed.
“Didn’t show me respect, wiped out my imprint, stole my Dao Vessel, and imprisoned my son. You’re courting death!”
Bei Chenxing was furious.
Steering the entire palace, he shifted off hurriedly.
In the Immortal Realm Battlefield, the devils from the abyss who saw Immortal Lord Chenguang and the likes launched their attack into the Eastern Region. The place was then shrouded in fog, and they could no longer see what was happening inside, causing them to get more and more impatient.
“Lord Dark Worker Devil King, is it time for us to strike?” Devil King Xue Tao asked a devil with a long head and two horns in front of him.
He was very respectful, and there were even hints of fear.
“Wait!”
The Dark Worker Demon King only responded with one word.
“But… But...” Devil King Xue Tao bravely muttered, “What if they grab ahold of the great encounter first? After all, they have an Immortal Emperor standing behind them.”
The Dark Worker Demon King suddenly turned his head around and looked at him indifferently.
Updates by
Devil King Xue Tao couldn’t help but shiver as he bowed down, looking extremely feeble but was actually raging with anger within.
Next to him, a young Demon King smiled and said, “Xue Tao, you came from an extremely ordinary planar abyss. Although you stood at the peak over in that world, your world was too low-level, which led to your limited vision and knowledge. That piece of land that fell from the sky seemed as though it was a remnant left after the destruction of the mortal world. Now that it has descended into our realm, why has it not shattered but remained intact?
“You also mentioned that you joined forces with 19 other Devil Kings to destroy the planar world, yet what was the result? 18 of them fell, and you were the only one who escaped!
“You saw it for yourself just now that the young girl who came out was of the Taiyi Immortal King Realm. She slew the ice dragon with little to no effort and even destroyed a Dragon Emperor’s Spiritual Incarnation. Could there be a strong background behind her?
“If there isn’t any, then where did she come from? If she was a native being from the planar world, then she might’ve obtained sky-defying great encounters, which led to her strength skyrocketing. If she had such strength from the beginning, why would the planar world still end up being destroyed? She might have improved a lot in a very short span of time. If she wasn’t a being of the planar world, then this would be quite entertaining. Haha!
“The one who went in just now was the Immortal Lord Chenguang from the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm. He is the son of Immortal Emperor Bei Chen. It’s good that we used him as a scout to test the waters inside. Even if they got a hold of the great encounter, we could still intercept and kill them, no?
“Furthermore, this is the Infinite Realm Battlefield! Who knows how many strong experts lay hidden here? Once we make our moves, we must be victorious with just a single blow. Otherwise, this may lead to other big troubles!
“Don’t simply make a move, but emerge victorious the moment you act.”
The young Demon King preached as he patted Devil King Xue Tao’s shoulder.
“It is as what the lord preached!” Devil King Xue Tao’s back was even more arched.
Right this very moment, the cloud scattered, and the fog dispersed.
The land which was hidden in sight appeared yet again but had already landed on the lake, quickly margining into it and turning into a huge island in the middle.
However, the various peerless experts who went in to attack them had disappeared.
“This…” When Devil King Xue Tao looked over, his pupils shrank as he was extremely horrified. “There were three Immortal Kings who made their moves just now, and all of them failed? In such a short time? There hasn’t been any turmoil over there yet as well?”
“There’s something extremely terrifying in it!” The young Demon King turned solemn.
“Seems troubling!” The Dark Worker Demon King frowned.
“Look at that!” The young Demon King patted Devil King Xue Tao’s shoulder again. “If we went over just now, what would’ve happened? It’s very likely that we would’ve died without knowing how.”
“How is that possible?* Devil King Xue Tao was still puzzled.
“Perhaps, there’s an Emperor-level peerless expert hidden inside!” the young demon king speculated.
It was a very solemn guess. Emperor-level?
The Immortal Emperor and Demon Emperor were of both emperor-level, representing the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm. They were the real giants of the era that could crush the voids, a character that was at the level of the ancestors.
…
Standing on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming finished cooking the dragon liver, glanced at Devil King Xue Tao and the others who were hidden at a far distance, and muttered, “What a surprise that they didn’t force their way in here.”
“Senior Brother, shall I go take them down?” Linglong asked.
Jiang Ming pondered for a while, then nodded and said, “Alright then! Capture Devil King Xue Tao and let him fully experience the tortures. This devil has done great sins. Let him regret ever coming into this world and accompany Immortal Lord Chenguang. Don’t go with your true self just in case. Also, let ‘True Illusion’ go out and inquire a little more about the specific situation here.”
Linglong followed through.
This time, five of her extraordinarily powerful clones, namely Phoenix, Time, Space, Life-and-Death, and Karma, were sent out.
Whether it was Space or Time, all of them were able to fight against an opponent of a higher realm than they were. When they joined hands, they were practically invincible.
With the addition of the Phoenix clone who was in the Taiyi Realm, it should be no problem for them to deal with this demonic army that only had four Demon Kings.
All her clones went off their tasks in the blink of an eye.
Linglong took out the Moon Essence Wheel and handed it over to Jiang Ming. “Senior Brother, if you refine this Great Overarching Dao Vessel, your combat power will definitely increase greatly.”
“You can keep it!” Jing Ming smiled and said, “I have quite a few Great Overarching Dao Vessels myself. Moreover, this level of Immortal Artifacts is of little use to me now.”
It really was not a big deal.
“Senior Brother, how strong have you become?” Linglong was taken aback by his reply.
“It’s not a problem to deal with the ordinary Great Overarching Golden Immortal,” Jiang Ming replied as he extracted the dragon marrow and prepared to cook porridge. “If it’s on our territory, I might even be able to compete with a Quasi-Sage.”
Hiss…
Linglong took in a breath of cold air. She was shocked at Jiang Ming’s ability to compete with a Quasi-Sage! She wondered whether that meant he now stood on the top of the heavens and had become a real giant of all ages? A supreme venerate?
“Senior Brother, you are so awesome!” Linglong was amazed.
“You should say, Senior Brother, you’re so ‘potent’,” Jiang Ming whispered.
Linglong rolled her eyes, stretched her hands like claws, and grabbed onto his lifeline.
Two figures seemed to have come over from the sky at that very moment.
One was Chang Yiming, while the other was Xi Yao.
They sensed the tremor under their feet just now and felt that they were no longer falling. The sky seemed to have become stable, and they were now surrounded by seawater. Knowing that they had landed and taken root, they couldn’t help but come over to see the two.
Linglong squeezed her little hand fiercely before retracting her hand and standing with her hands behind her back as if nothing had happened.
“Jiang Ming, is the place stable now?” Chang Yiming couldn’t help but ask.
“It’s stable now!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile and continued. “It’ll be fine from now on. Just cultivate in peace and reach the Immortal Realm as soon as you can!”
“It’ll be fine from now on?” Chang Yiming was stunned, and his eyes turned slightly reddish.
He understood that although this sentence seemed like a promise, it was, in fact, brimming with confidence. It would be definitely fine If Jiang Ming said so. Besides, he was excited about the stability.
Having experienced the Great Eastern War, the sect’s calamity, the demon invasion, the encirclement and suppression of the Sacred Lands, the descent of Immortal beings, and also the world being destroyed, his small heart was almost overwhelmed.
Fortunately, it seemed that he could now be completely relieved.
“Then I’m going to go get myself a whole house of wives!” Chang Yiming smiled.
“Why are you thinking of marrying now?” Jiang Ming asked strangely. “You’re now the head disciple anyway. It’s not even a problem if you want to take over the position of First Seat now. Getting married is but only a matter of sentences!”
“Hey, I used to be a precarious person and didn’t have a clear view of my future. That was why I decided to focus on cultivation and growing quietly, not delaying other people’s growth. Now that you are able to even hold up the sky and also looking to become an Immortal soon. Seeing that there seem to be no worries at all, I will naturally have to enjoy my life now!” Chang Yiming smiled. “After all, you are even my matchmaker, Brother Jiang!”
“To hell with you!” Jiang Ming replied. “Do you have a target already?”
Chang Yiming was a little awkward due to the question.
“It can’t be her!” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“Hehe! I knew I couldn’t hide it from you!” Chang Yiming scratched his head and continued. “She used to be my Junior Sister but was arranged to be by my side after that incident.
