As we got to know each other more, we started to have feelings for each other. Now that the Jiuyang Sect is the strongest of all, there are no taboos like what we used to have.”
“Senior Sister Momo is actually a great lady. She merely couldn’t help herself in the past,” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
He had a very good impression of that particular Senior Sister from Jiaoyang Peak.
It was unfortunate that she was a spy arranged by the Bishui Sect.
When her identity was exposed, she was protected by First Seat Yinyue, but it was inevitable that people were going to make things difficult for her. Under Jiang Ming’s suggestion, Chang Yiming had brought her to his side to protect her.
“Since you’re ready to get married, bring her over to conduct her cultivation here then,” Jiang Ming added.
“Momo will be very happy to hear this!” Chang Yiming’s face was brimming with gratitude. “I’ll go pick her up now!”
“Just go. It just so happens that the dragon feast that I’m preparing over here is almost ready!” Jiang Ming sighed as he lamented, “I was taken care of by Senior Sister Momo a lot when I first got here.”
Linglong nodded slightly, and Chang Yiming left happily to get Momo.
“He is?” When Xi Yao asked and pointed at Immortal Lord Chenguang, who was pinned mid-air, Linglong explained the whole ordeal.
“Immortal Lord? With an Immoral Emperor behind him?” Xi Yao was shocked and couldn’t help laughing bitterly. “I can’t ask what you two are doing from now on. This heart of mine can’t stand it.”
“Let the Senior Brother help you then. He’ll make you an Immortal in a day’s time, if not, two. It’s such a simple matter!” Linglong put her arms around Xi Yao’s shoulder, “It’s just too slow to cultivate on your own!”
“Linglong, you’re shameless!” Xi Yao was annoyed and embarrassed. “Let me go, you rascal!”
“Hehe! How come I’m the rascal now? What I just said was the truth. Senior Brother has a way of sharing his own insights. Tell you what, with his level of cultivation realm, he’ll be able to let you realize the Immortal Dao in just minutes!” Linglong shook Xi Yao’s shoulder and continued. “Besides, didn’t you plan to retreat into cultivation to try breaking into the Immortal realm? How long has it been, and you are already out of your retreat? If you continue with such half-hearted cultivation, how long will it take for you to become an Immortal? Maybe by the time you become an Immortal, you might already be an old woman. By that time, if the Senior Brother doesn’t pay attention and uses a little more force on you, you’ll explode!”
Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched as he listened to Linglong’s monologue. Her words were really pleasant to the ear, but she seemed to be also looking for a beating.
While he was busy cooking, his ears were focusing on their conversation and were paying attention to Junior Sister’s clones at the same time. Multitasking was indeed difficult.
Xi Yao was getting shyer and shyer that her red blushed face seemed as though she was going to bleed out. She couldn’t help screaming, “Linglong… I…I…I want to—”
“What do you want?” Linglong smiled. “You still want to hit me?”
“I can’t beat you, so I’ll bite you!”
She opened her mouth wide and bit at Linglong’s arm while Linglong laughed out loud and stepped back.
“Hmph!” Xi Yao stomped her feet angrily and secretly took a glance at Jiang Ming.
Just as she was about to leave, Linglong grabbed onto her hands and pulled her over onto the stool beside her. “The dragon banquet later will be of a real Golden Immortal Realm dragon. After being cooked by Senior Brother, it won’t cause you to explode when you eat them. However, it will be like an elixir that can improve your physique and raise your cultivation, comparable to a great recreation. Don’t you want to enjoy it?”
Linglong sat peacefully by the side as she emphasized, “A Golden Immortal Realm true dragon, prepared by Senior Brother himself. Therefore, once you miss this, there won’t be a next time!”
Xi Yao hesitated upon hearing this.
…
Far away, a great battle had already begun.
Both Time and Space Junior Sisters joined forces and evoked a great Time and Space Imprisonment technique. Karma Junior Sister evoked a curse technique, weakening the power of several Demon Kings at the same time. Life-and-Death Junior Sister broke out with her peerless fighting power. In addition to Phoenix Junior Sister launching her attacks, the Dark Worker Demon King and the likes were buried just like that.
It did not take long before they returned to Chuyang Peak, having captured Devil King Xue Tao.
“You have so many clones and are all so powerful…” Xi Yao couldn’t help stuttering when she saw the few Junior Sisters. A strange thought suddenly popped in her mind, and she couldn’t help but blurt out, “Can brother Jiang even satisfy you?”
Once the words were out, she was dumbfounded by what she had just said, and her face flushed red. Embarrassed by herself, she lowered her head and was eager to find a place to hide herself.
“Why don’t you come and have a look tonight?” Linglong whispered in her ears.
Xi Yao quickly covered her ears.
Jiang Ming’s ear twitched as he listened to their conversation.
He thought it was a great idea to have Xi Yao watching from the side because it would definitely be exciting.
“Senior Brother, what do we do with him?” Phoenix Junior Sister pinned Devil King Xue Tao in mid-air, restraining him with the power of order and making it difficult to move one bit.
As Jiang Ming looked over, he said, “Xue Tao, here we meet again!”
“Do we know each other?” Devil King Xue Tao’s voice was extremely hoarse.
Now that he understood how dire and hopeless his situation was, he became reckless.
“I was the one who killed your last bloodline clone,” Jiang Ming replied. “Tell me. What’s the real name of that Devil Emperor behind you?”
“Haha! Do you think I would tell you?” Devil King Xue Tao sneered. “Just you wait! You and the rest of your people will definitely end up worse than I am.”
Jiang Ming shook his head and smiled. “I’m but an ordinary person from the planar world, and you are a high-ranking Devil King. However, what was the outcome? All of your plots and plans ended up in failure, and even you are imprisoned in front of me. As for the Devil Emperor? You think his ending will be any better than yours?”
Devil King Xue Tao fell silent and paused for a moment before faintly asking, “Are you really born of this world?”
“You’re right!”
“But how can you be this strong? Did you obtain the great encounters of your world?”
“Right again!”
“What kind of great encounter was it?”
“A very ordinary one!” Jiang Ming replied. “Just something from the ruins of an ancient battlefield.”
“Impossible! If it was just from the ruins of an ancient battlefield, how is it possible for you to grow to such a level in this short period of time?” Devil King Xue Tao didn’t believe him. He wanted to struggle and break free but couldn’t move at all.
Jiang Ming didn’t answer him but asked indifferently, “I’ll give you one last chance. What’s the real name of that Devil Emperor behind you?”
“You really want to know? Haha! I won’t tell you!” Devil King Xue Tao sneered. However, when he glanced around and saw Immortal Lord Chenguang with his face distorted, mouth wide open with no voice coming out of it, he couldn’t help but tremble and started to hesitate.
“You won’t tell me? So be it. It makes no difference to me.” Jiang Ming raised his hands, destroying his body, shattering his primal spirit, and leaving only a mere remnant of his soul.
Xue Tao remained in his human form, unable to move one bit.
As Jiang Ming snapped his finger, pitch-black flames started to ignite below Xue Tao’s feet as he began to refine him.
Devil King Xue Tao immediately screeched in pain as his body twisted around due to the excruciating torment. However, not a sound came out of his mouth because Jiang Ming had obviously sealed him off.
“Because of you, my world was destroyed.” Jiang Ming’s voice was chilly. “That’s why I’ll let you stay this way forever, just existing like this!”
Xi Yao, who stood next to him, couldn’t help shivering.
At that very moment, Chang Yiming could be seen flying over with a gentle- and quiet-looking girl as they landed beside him.
“No introductions needed already, right?” Chang Yiming seemed a little embarrassed.
“Senior Sister Momo!” Jiang Ming greeted her with a smile.
“Head Disciple Jiang!” Momo smiled with a very calm demeanor. It was as if she had been enlightened after going through a life-and-death crisis, indifferently peaceful toward people and things. “Thank you for your honest words that time and also for secretly helping me.”
“There is no right or wrong for the past, but the past is now behind us.” Jiang Ming looked at Momo, and his heart still felt somewhat complicated.
In fact, Senior Sister Momo had been very close with him at the very beginning.
She would even bring him delicious food up the mountains from time to time. It was just a pity that he secretly discovered the problem with her identity and later manipulated her to reveal herself. Only then was Momo’s status as a disciple revoked, and she was taken away by Chang Yiming to be monitored.
“Yes, the past is finally behind us.” Momo also sighed slightly and continued. “Who would have thought that Head Disciple Jiang, who was so mediocre at the beginning, would actually soar into the sky one day, standing on top of the clouds.”
“Enough about this. Sit down. The all dragon banquet will be ready soon!”
“I guess I’m going to have a feast then!” Momo softly smiled.
Linglong walked over with a slightly complicated expression on her face as she reminisced about the past.
Just as Jiang Ming was about to continue getting busy with the preparations, he suddenly raised his head and slightly frowned.
He sensed the prayer from the Fifth Immortal Moon and also noticed an incomparably powerful spiritual sense that had locked on onto the Eastern Region.
‘Reincarnation Hall!
‘Immortal Emperor Bei Chen?’
Jiang Ming’s eyes slowly narrowed as he thought of the names.
‘The real troubles are coming,’ Jiang Ming thought.

He sensed the prayer from the Fifth Immortal Moon and also noticed an incomparably powerful spiritual sense that had locked on onto the Eastern Region.
'Reincarnation Hall!
'Immortal Emperor Bei Chen?'
Jiang Ming's eyes slowly narrowed as he thought of the names.
'The real troubles are coming,' Jiang Ming thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - Unbelievable Mission From the Reincarnation Hall, How Shameless
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Unbelievable Mission From the Reincarnation Hall, How Shameless
?
At the Reincarnation Hall…
After the Fifth Immortal Moon had consumed the Golden Immortal Dao Fruit, her cultivation level rose steeply.
At present, she was standing before a mission gate, browsing through the information about a mission.
[Special Mission: Hunt the beneficiaries of the Lord God.
A planar world under Honggu Great Chiliocosm has been destroyed. The core that remained has been transported to the Infinite Realms Battlefield, and it has landed there safely. A batch of beneficiaries from the Lord God is heading toward it to exterminate the remaining traces of humanity on that planet.
Hint 1: The Jiuyuang Sect is the leader of the human race on that planet.
Hint 2: There are a total of 35 teams of beneficiaries from the Lord God. The strongest team is led by a Level 15 expert, and the weakest amongst them is a Level 14 expert.
Hint 3: There is a chance the beneficiaries from the Lord God will receive a side mission to hunt beneficiaries from the Reincarnation Hall.
Hint 4: The cultivation level limit to receive this mission is Level 14, and only 30 teams are allowed to receive this mission at the same time.
Hint 5: After killing one beneficiary from the Lord God, you will be able to obtain 1/5 of the opponent’s cultivation level and absorb it to improve yourself without any side effects.
Hint 6: You will be able to notice the Lord God’s beneficiaries once you’re within 100 miles of them. Remark: You may also be noticed by the other side.
Hint 7: Crisis and chance are directly proportional to each other.
Note: This mission, according to the estimation, has a mortality rate of at least 95%. Please make your decision wisely!]
The Fifth Immortal Moon accepted the mission without any hesitation. In the meantime, a large group of reincarnators had gathered around her. All of them had shocked expressions etched on their faces.
“What kind of mission is that?”
“Not only do we need to hunt down the beneficiaries from the Lord God, but can we also absorb their power after killing them without any side effects? This is unbelievable!”
“This is a good opportunity to improve our cultivation level!”
“If we can slay a few Golden Immortals, wouldn’t we be able to ascend into the Taiyi Realm right away?”
“Are you mad? There is a big gap between the Taiyi Realm and the Golden Immortal Realm. You’re now only at the initial stage of the Golden Immortal Realm, and even if you kill ten Golden Immortals, you won’t be anywhere near the Taiyi Realm. However, things would be different if you’re at the peak stage of the Golden Immortal Realm. There’s a probability that you can step into the Taiyi Realm after killing a Taiyi expert or a dozen of Golden Immortals.”
“It’s harder than reaching the sky to transform from the Golden Immortal Realm to the Taiyi Realm. But this is such a rare opportunity. There’s no way we let it pass like that. Besides, I thought that we needed to form the Taiyi Dao Fruit if we wanted to break into the Taiyi Realm from the Golden Immortal Realm? Can we skip that step by absorbing some cultivation level?”
“This is what makes the Reincarnation Hall so incredible and great. Look, we can even receive missions from the Lord God Space. Do you know what this means? It means the Reincarnation Hall is a lot stronger than the Lord God Space.”
“I agree. Are you going to accept the mission?”
“I’m not sure about it. What about you?”
“Nope, I’m not going to do it. My team has disbanded, and I’m all alone now. I must have a death wish if I accept this mission! Can’t you see the estimated mortality rate? It’s about 95%! If I go there, I’ll be dead in no time! Besides, some of the Lord God’s beneficiaries are Taiyi experts. If they know we’re there, they will certainly come and kill us. Also, I heard that they’re ruthless and heartless. They can easily kill someone on the same level as them, and from this point alone, we from the Reincarnation Hall are a lot weaker.”
“But this is a golden chance. It won’t appear on a daily basis. If you miss it, you’re going to regret it. After all, this is one of the rare chances where you can step into the Taiyi Realm.”
“Hah, if and only if I can come back alive. Sigh, this mission is for those teams that are well-prepared. I heard that some of them are strong enough to defeat a Taiyi, and one of them could even fight toe-to-toe with a Great Overarching. They’re truly terrifying.”
“Yeah, you have a point. I guess we should just do whatever we can.”
The Fifth Immortal Moon listened to their conversation and went away. She did not have to go through the mission gate after accepting the mission as she would be transported to the mission location as soon as the time was up.
On Chuyang Peak…
Jiang Ming withdrew his consciousness from the Fifth Immortal Moon.
“I had no idea that the Reincarnation Hall would issue a mission to hunt down the beneficiaries from the Lord God. Not only that, but the beneficiaries from the Lord God are also heading here to destroy us? Well, I guess they’re coming straight for me, so can I say that the Lord God is die-hard on killing me. But the strongest of them are only in the Taiyi Realm? They have seriously underestimated me.
“Is it true that the Reincarnation Hall is stronger than the Lord God since it knows the missions issued by the Lord God? Or are they related to each other?”
Countless thoughts flitted across Jiang Ming’s head at that moment. However, he couldn’t figure out why, but he felt the mission issued by the Reincarnation Hall was strange.
However, he was familiar with the experts in the Reincarnation Hall. They were pretty powerful, in his opinion. Some of them were strong enough to fight on par with a Taiyi expert or a Great Overarching expert.
“Alright then! I’ll be here waiting for you guys!” Jiang Ming lifted his head and looked into the sky.
He could sense that there was a surge of powerful force coming straight toward their planet through the void, and they were going to arrive here very soon.
He chuckled and shook his head.
‘Come. The more of them come, the better it is. Since we’re in a new place, of course, I have to make some new rules.’
After he finished preparing the dragon, he waved his hand and sent some into the Jiuyang Hall. At the same time, he also informed his master, all the First Seats, and the Sect Master.
The Jiuyang Hall.
When the Sect Master and the other arrived, what appeared before them was a table filled with scrumptious food.
“Linglong has slain a Golden Immortal-level dragon and made it into food through a special method,” Gu Hai said as he walked around the table, clasping his hand behind his back and stroking his beard with his hand. There was a big grin on his face as he continued. “If she hadn’t prepared it through a special way, we might not be able to handle a piece of dragon meat here.”
He picked up a piece of dragon meat with his chopsticks, and for a moment, a divine light burst forth, and a wonderful aroma filled everyone’s nostrils in the hall, causing some of them to swallow their saliva.
“Impressive!” Yan Yan shouted excitedly. “Who would’ve thought that we would have a chance to enjoy the dragon meat!? This is not an ordinary dragon, but a Golden Immortal dragon. It’s an Immortal Lord!”
It was only now they realized what kind of food was presented before them.
Looking at the food, the Sect Master couldn’t help but shiver in excitement.
“Golden Immortal!” Gu Hai chimed in, “It represents immortality, limitless possibilities, and continuity. It has different names across different realms. In the immortal realm, it’s known as the Immortal Lord. In the demon realm, it’s the Demon Lord. In a small chiliocosm, it’s the Giant. Even in the supreme Heavenly Realm, a Golden Immortal is someone who wields great power. Hahaha, today is surely my lucky day that I have a chance to enjoy such a great feast!”
“Senior Brother Gu!” Dongfang Lie swallowed a large gulp of saliva and looked at him. Then, he snorted. “There’s nothing good about you, but I have to admit that you really are good at taking in disciples.”
“Hehe!” Gu Hai grinned delightfully. “Ever since the establishment of the Jiuyang Sect, none of us have been able to become immortals, but now my disciple has shown her power in slaying an Immortal Lord. You know what? I may be really good at taking in disciples.”
“Stop that, will you?” Ying Yue delivered a glare at him before asking worriedly, “Will killing the Dragon Lord cause trouble?”
“It’s worth it to have trouble if you can eat Dragon Lord meat!” Dongfang Lie rubbed his hand and said, “What are you waiting for, guys? Let’s eat!”
The Sect Master looked at Gu Hai and asked, “Can they hold them back?”
“Don’t worry,” Gu Hai replied as he waved his hand. “The fact that they can send the food here means one thing—they don’t really care about it.”
At the same time, a red-haired elder rushed in and landed in the center of the hall. He pushed the Sect Master away and harrumphed. “How dare you people! How could you not inform me when there’s a feast going on? Do you all want me to punish you?”
“Great Monarch!” The Sect Master greeted him before replying with a smile, “We’re just too shocked and didn’t have the time to inform you. Since you’re here, you should be the first one to eat.”
“That’s more like it!” Huo Daoren picked up a piece of dragon meat with chopsticks. He brought it closer and squinted his eyes. He took a deep breath, and a gush of energy flowed through his body, causing his blood Qi to surge and his cultivation level to rise.
He exclaimed, “As expected of Dragon Lord meat. I just need to take a piece, and my cultivation level has already increased so much. Great, this is great! What are you guys waiting for? Hurry up and feast in! If you don’t want to eat, I’ll eat them all myself!”
“You will get a bloated stomach if you eat too much. Let me help you!” Dongfang Lie said as he picked up a piece of meat and popped it into his mouth.
The rest of the Elders and the Sect Master followed suit.
“It tastes good!”
“It’s delicious!”
“I can feel that my cultivation level is increasing!”
“I’ve already stepped into the Paradis Realm!” Hao Chen couldn’t help himself and said, “My body has become stronger, and I assume that I can step into the Imminent Immortal Realm after this meal. This is unbelievable!”
“Xiao Chen, that’s because you have a lot of potential,” Huo Daoren lamented. “You have the most talent and potential amongst your peers. In the past, the Jiuyang Sect couldn’t provide you with much and limited your growth, but you don’t have to worry about anything anymore! You can explore your potential completely.”
“I will!” Hao Chen nodded.
“Xiao Hai!” Huo Daoren looked at Gu Hai and continued. “After that incident, I thought you wouldn’t be able to cultivate anymore, but little did I expect that the two kids that you brought back would turn out to be such incredible beings. I have to say, you truly are lucky. You’re the chosen one!”
“Great Monarch, you’ve flattered me,” Gu Hai replied. “But I’m not the chosen one, those two kids are. I’m the father of the chosen ones!”
Pfft…
The Sect Master and the rest of the First Seats nearly vomited their food as all of them did not expect Gu Hai to be so shameless.
At Chuyang Peak…
After Jiang Ming finished his meal, he stood up and looked into the sky.
At the same time, the system’s voice rang out in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - Transforming the Sea to Set the Boundary, Junior Sister Talks About the Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Transforming the Sea to Set the Boundary, Junior Sister Talks About the Past
[Ding! Congratulations to the host. You have made a scrumptious meal with the Dragon Lord’s meat. After consuming the meat, the overall battle prowess of the Jiuyang Sect has improved. You have been rewarded with a Great Overarching Immortal Weapon, the God Slaying Bow.]
Jiang Ming was surprised.
It was never in his wildest dream that he would get a reward like that after making a meal.
Not only was the God Slaying Bow a Great Overarching Immortal Weapon, it was a bow as well. He was confident that it would be a weapon of massive power.
The God Slaying Bow also came with nine God Slaying Arrows.
“Not bad!”
Jiang Ming was satisfied, but he did not bring the bow out.
He lifted his head and looked skyward. A great star had appeared high above the sky, spraying its radiance in all directions. It was a palace, but it resembled a star. It was glowing with a silvery light, and it was in the middle of descending. A middle-aged man was standing in the palace. He gave off a strong, regal air, and there was a purple Qi swirling around him.
Suddenly, a storm appeared along with a surge of immense power and swept across the land. In that moment, the sky seemed to have dimmed down and the land to fall silent.
“Bei Chengxing!” Jiang Ming was able to recognize the man in a single glance.
“He’s certainly in the Great Overarching Realm. Not only that, but he’s a lot stronger than a normal Great Overarching!” Linglong said as she came to Jiang Ming’s side. She grabbed his arm and anxiety was written all over her face. “Can we really hold them off?”
“You don’t have confidence in me?” Jiang Ming asked.
“It’s not that I don’t have confidence in you. It’s just that you’ve never shown your true strength in front of me, so how am I supposed to know how good you are?” Linglong said with a pout.
“But I know how good you are,” Jiang Meng went closer and whispered into her ear.
“Are you sure about that?” Linglong asked. “I’m sure you don’t know how good I am, but I certainly know how far you can go!”
“Hah, guess I’ll have to go all out next time!” Jiang Ming hissed.
Linglong’s eyes glowed brightly and she changed to another topic, “Senior brother, let me deal with him. With the ten of us, I guess we should be able to hold him off.”
“Don’t worry. Leave him to me. Today, I’ll show you my true power!” Jiang Ming said confidently, “Also, this is a war to let them know that we’re not pushovers!”
Linglong nodded silently.
At this moment, many experts came out of their hiding and raised their heads to look into the sky. When they sensed Bei Chengxing’s presence, their expression changed.
“I wonder how many of us can survive before the wrath of an ancient emperor.”
Someone shook their heads worriedly, while the others looked with amusement, wondering how things would turn out in the end.
On the other side, a young man in black robe stood with his hands clasped behind his back. He was surrounded by a black fog and there was a sea of blood on top of his head. However, nobody could see him.
He was an expert who cultivated diabolical cultivation.
He looked into the distance and said, “This planet is on the verge of destruction, yet it still has the power to kill two kings from the immortal and the demon. I wonder what kind of secrets are hidden in it?”
Nearly a few thousands miles away, there was a divine ark floating amidst the vast sky. There were nine layers of divine light around the ark, and each layer was filled with an endless amount of Dao fluctuation.
Each and every one of the decorations on the ark was an immortal weapon, and together, they formed into a warship of massive destructive power.
On top of the ark, a dozen girls were dancing. They were the embodiment of holiness and alluring. Their dancing figures were so enchanting that no one would be able to peel their eyes away from them.
These girls were only dancing for one person.
All of them were in the Mystical Immortal Realm. They were pretty, strong, and each of them had their own specialty.
Suddenly, the young man stood up and gazed into the distance.
“Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor? What is he doing here? Although he comes from a middle chiliocosm, he’s powerful and his name is well known even in the Heavenly Realm. Nobody across the universe dares to slight him, so what makes him come here today? Could it be that his son is dead? Interesting! I should go and have a look!”
When the thought surfaced in the young man’s head, he laid down on the bed made of jade. A girl hastily came forward and began massaging his leg.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming stretched his arm forward and four islands rose into the air in the distance. While they were flying toward him, they were becoming smaller and smaller. Eventually , they became four massive stone monuments.
He then flicked his finger, delivering several formations into it. The four stone monuments glowed and the words “Tianyuan” appeared on them.
With a wave of his sleeve, Jiang Ming sent four stone monuments to the lakes in four different directions of the Eastern Region.
In the meantime, the word “Tianyuan” started to glow.
“Senior brother, have you finally decided on a name?” Linglong asked.
Xi Yao and the other three people had arrived as well. They were both shocked and intrigued by Jiang Ming’s action.
Jiang Ming nodded before saying, “Since we’re already here, this place will be our home. It’s natural to erase the stigma of the past here and set the mark that belongs to us. We’re from the Tianyuan World, a planet surrounded by water. And that water is the sea! The water will be the Tianyuan Sea, and the land will be the Tianyuan Realm!”
“Tianyuan Sea, and Tianyuan Realm, huh… Great name!” Chang Yiming exclaimed, “This will be our mark, and we’ll pass this mark to our next generation. Even if our world is destroyed, our legacy will remain alive!”
Xi Yao, on the other hand, let out a sigh. She thought of her past and a surge of sadness assaulted her.
Above the sky in the southern region, a palace was hovering above the sea.
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor was standing in front of the palace. He looked at the Tianyuan realm and frowned. Even though he did not notice anything out of the ordinary, he did not know why but there was a strange feeling stirring his heart.
“What is the strange feeling in my heart?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor couldn’t figure it out.
He knew every expert above the Great Overarching across the Heavenly Realm, the abyss, and the middle chiliocosms under the Heaven Court.
However, he couldn’t detect any familiar sense from the Tianyuan realm. He did not sense any supreme being above the Great Overarching either, and he felt it weird.
Clank!
He grabbed his fist and a sword appeared out of thin air.All of a sudden, a sword energy that could slay gods and immortals tore the sky open, causing the living objects across the land to tremble in fear.
“I should probably erase everything on this land first!” He harrumphed coldly. Just when he was about to do it, he detected a familiar presence coming to him at a high speed. In the meantime, a voice appeared in his head.
“Brother Bei Cheng, how have you been?”
As soon as the voice died away, a warship appeared before him.
“Beiming Emperor!” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor turned his head over and looked at the young man standing on the warship. “What are you doing here? Shouldn’t you be enjoying your life in the Heaven Court?”
“I’m bored, so I came out and traveled around to take a look at the world as well as to gather some beauties on the way,” Beiming Emperor said as he walked down from his warship.
Very soon, he arrived beside Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor. “What made you so mad, Brother Bei Cheng?”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor looked toward the Tianyuan Realm and said faintly, “My son is in danger.”
“Who dares to attack Bei Chengguang?” Beiming Emperor asked in shock.
At this moment, both of them saw a streak of light flying into the Tianyuan Realm before disappearing into the depth of the ground.
“It seems like…” Beiming Emperor frowned. “It seems like there’s a strange power preventing us from peering into it. Hah, this is interesting. Brother Bei Cheng, since your son is in danger, then what are you still waiting for? I don’t think there’s anyone in this universe who can pose a threat to you.”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor squinted his eyes and said, “Although that streak of light is fast, we can still see it clearly. It’s a pretty girl, and she’s clearly different from those on your warship. Do you not want to get her?”
“Of course, I want to!” Beiming Emperor chuckled, “But this is your war. I don’t think I should poke my nose in it.”
On Chuyang Peak, Linglong’s expression changed/
“What happened?” Jiang Ming looked at her before turning his head to gaze at Bei Meng Emperor who suddenly appeared above the sea.
“I want to kill him!” Linglong hissed, her voice cold.
“Why?” Jiang Ming asked.
Linglong opened her mouth, trying to say something but she swallowed her words back into her stomach pit in the end.
“What’s wrong? Is it something that you can’t tell me?” Jiang Ming asked as he grabbed her into his embrace.
“I…” Linglong stammered, looking worried and fearful.
“Don’t worry. With me by your side, no one will be able to hurt you!” Jiang Ming said, “Now, tell me what’s going on.”
He waved his hand and transferred Xi Yao, Chang Yiming, and Momo away, leaving both of them on the rooftop only.
Judging from his junior sister’s combat prowess and cultivation level, it must be something big since she was so hesitant.
In the meantime, True Illusion Linglong had come back, but she stood at the side without saying anything.
Swoosh!
Jiang Ming opened up the Human Paths Record.
Name: Beiming Hai
Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation level: Great Overarching Realm.
Background: Son of the Great Northern Emperor (Black Emperor) of the Heavenly Court in the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Relationship: 0.
Innate Talent: Great Overarching.
Status: His father was known as the Black Emperor. He was Kun Peng, a well-seasoned cultivator since ancient times. He had been keeping a low profile. When the Heavenly Court was rebuilt, the Heavenly Emperor invited the Black Emperor to become the emperor for the north, assisting him in suppressing the universe.
He was lonely and he did not have any kids. Since he couldn’t go any further down the Saint Dao, he decided to collect the essence of all water, the power of the windless, and incorporated them into his own blood to give birth to a son. He gave him the surname of Beiming and named him Hai, which carried the meaning of the sea.
Beiming Hai had everything ever since he was born. He was particularly gifted and his cultivation speed was incredibly fast. As such, he was arrogant and regarded everyone beneath him.
He was particularly fond of women, and he took interest in collecting beautiful women, especially those who were strong, across the universe. If he ever came across one, he would do everything he could to get her in his hands.
After he had enough of a woman, he would use them as a coudron and absorb them with Beiming Absorption Technique to increase his own power.
While he was traveling across the Infinite Realms Battlefield, he noticed the presence of Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor. He came to talk to him as well as to join the fun. When they were talking, they saw a woman was flying toward the land before them and his eyes glowed up. He had the urge to get the woman in his hands and he felt he could have a lot of fun with her for at least three years.
Jiang Ming’s face sank when he saw Beiming Hai’s status.
The woman in his status was none other than True Illusion Linglong.
‘Hah! He must have a lot of guts to have that thought. Very well, then. I don’t care who you are. Even if you’re the emperor, I’ll still kill you!’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly.
“Senior brother!” Linglong opened her mouth slowly. There was a complicated expression on her face, but she was relieved since she had made up her mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - Kill Bei Cheng, Destroy Beiming, Quasi-Sage Middle Stage (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Kill Bei Cheng, Destroy Beiming, Quasi-Sage Middle Stage (Part 1)
The wind was gentle and the sun was warm.
The flowers that bloomed along the vines swung like rainbow ribbons and exuded a refreshing fragrance.
Linglong finally made up her mind.
At the back of the mountain.
Xi Yao landed on her courtyard. She looked toward the manor before her and let out a sigh, ‘At the end of the day, I’m still an outsider.”
If Linglong heard what she had said, she would scoff loudly and said, “Of course, you’re an outsider. After all, you don’t know how deep my senior brother could go.”
“By the way, what happened to her?” Xi Yao asked.
In her impression, Linglong had always been a confident, powerful, and prideful girl. However, today she seemed rather apprehensive and a little bit scared of her own fate.
“She’s an immortal, while I’m a mortal. Of course, I wouldn’t be able to know what she is thinking about,” Xi Yao let out a bitter smile, “The difference between us is too big. There are some things that I don’t qualified to know about.”
At the cliffside.
Holding Momo in his arms, Chang Yiming landed in his courtyard. He looked at the person beside him and smiled, “Don’t mind too much about it! Head Disciple Jiang is too powerful, and we’re too weak. There is something that we shouldn’t know.”
“I know, but…” Momo replied, “I just find it hard to believe that I’ve just eaten the dragon’s meat. It’s not an ordinary dragon’s meat, but the meat of a dragon lord. Right now, even though I’m not cultivating, my body and my cultivation level are increasing at an unbelievable speed.
“I still remember that when he first joined the Jiuyang Sect, he was just an ignorant young man who didn’t know anything. Due to the relationship between our masters, I used to deliver food here. I’ve also carried Linglong a few times when she was small. It has only been such a short time, and both of them are already able to defeat immortals and slain gods. It feels like a dream,” Momo said.
“It’s also because of our relationship that Head Disciple Jiang asked me to bring you to my side, and here we are,” Chang Yiming smiled, “Alright. Let’s not talk about the past. We should look into our future, and our future is just about to start.”
Updates by
“Yeah… You’re right,” Momo whispered.
In the meantime, five figures appeared out of thin air in a valley amidst the vast land beyond the Tianyuan Sea. Each and every one of them had an imposing aura, but nobody knew they were here.
“So here is the battlefield of the Honggu World? A young man asked. He was wearing a purple robe and there was an eye in the middle of his forehead that gave off lightning strikes whenever it opened and closed.
“According to legend, Honggu Heavenly Emperor had great ambition. He wished to dominate over the entire world and the whole universe. He opened up the Infinite Realms Battlefield to divert the conflicts. While various forces fought and killed each other, he also secretly directed to pull in and suppress those who opposed him. In the end, not only was he able to secure his throne, but he had also brought many forces under his control.”
“Honggu Heavenly Emperor is one of the few kings of great talent and bold vision. Many experts surmise that he has the potential to attain the Saint Realm!” A woman standing behind the young man chimed in, “What do you think we should do, captain?”
“This hunting comes with opportunities as well as difficulties, so let’s play it safe!” The young man replied. He tapped the air and a screen appeared before him.
There were five white dots and a red dot in the distance.
“The battlefield is vast, but fortunately the system provides the location of our targets. Otherwise, I don’t know how long it will take to find one,” the young man said, “Anyway, let’s go to the destination and then we’ll play by ear!”
“But captain, there are a total of 35 teams. What if we take action too late and end up getting nothing?”
“Yun Yan, after so many years, you’re still so impatient and reckless. If it weren’t for me, you would’ve been dead a long time ago!”
“That’s because you’re the strongest and mightiest, captain!”
“The strongest and mightiest? If you keep thinking this way, I will die in your hands sooner or later!”
“Captain, I…”
“Do you know why there are 35 teams coming here to wipe out a ruined mortal planar world? It means there is a terrifying being here, and we have to act with care!”
The group went away quickly after they had finished their discussion.
In the meantime, another group of experts had descended on the Tianyuan Sea as well. The Fifth Immortal Moon was one of them, and after she had decided on her direction, she secretly headed toward the Tianyuan Realm.
This was what Jiang Ming asked her to do as well.
Above the sea, Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor still couldn’t make up his mind yet.
It was not because he was fearful of the Tianyuan Realm, but he was worried about Beiming Emperor beside him. After all, he did not have a good impression of him.
Suddenly, he frowned and said, “There are quite a lot of experts gathered up here.”
“They aren’t experts. They’re just some Immortal Lords,” Beiming Emperor snickered, “That being said, it’s kind of suspicious why they would suddenly show up here. Let’s check it out.”
He raised his arm and grabbed the air in front of him. A surge of peerless power burst out, and in the next second, an Immortal Lord had appeared in front of him,
It was a pretty woman.
“You’re pretty, but unfortunately, you’re only in the Golden Immortal Realm,” Beiming Emperor snickered. After that, he looked at the woman in front of him and asked, “What’s your name? And what are you doing here?”
“I’m Xie Haitang,” the woman replied weakly, “I sensed something has happened here, so I came here to check it out and see if I can get something to improve my cultivation level. I… I wonder what have I done to anger you?”
“I’m Beiming Hai!” Beiming Emperor said.
“So you’re Lord Beiming!” Xie Haitang said.
“It came to my attention that you don’t know me. How strange!” Beiming Hai knew the woman was lying to him. He did not get angry. Instead, he smiled at her and said, “I’ll give you one more chance. Tell me the truth, or I’ll absorb your power.”
“Lord Beiming, I was being hunted by my enemy. That’s why I came to this place,” Xie Haitang replied falteringly, her face pale as a sheet of paper.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - Kill Bei Cheng, Destroy Beiming, Quasi-Sage Middle Stage (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Kill Bei Cheng, Destroy Beiming, Quasi-Sage Middle Stage (Part 2)
“You’re very good at faking. Your blood flow, heartbeat, your movements, even the fear that comes out of your soul are all fake,” Beiming Hai said with a smile on his face. “You might be able to fool other people, but it won’t work on me. You are nothing but all lies. There are plenty of women like you in the Red Chamber or the Drunken Pavilion. All of you speak the nicest words, and you like to lick other’s spittle. Although you look genuine on the surface, you’re a bunch of cold-blooded, heartless, lustful demons who only know how to take.”
Without giving Xie Haitang a chance to say anything, he delivered a palm strike at her forehead. Xie Haitang then began to convulse, and the essence of her cultivation flowed toward him rapidly. In the blink of an eye, she became a pile of ashes and fell into the water.”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor looked at her impassively as if it was something very normal for him.
“This is weird!” Beiming Emperor frowned and said, “Although I’ve absorbed her power, it seems as if something is preventing me from accessing her memory.”
“You can’t access her memory?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor was surprised.
Beiming Emperor nodded. “This is interesting! It seems like something unusual is going on in this sea and land over there. Haha, this is great. I happened to be looking for some fun. Brother Bei Cheng, what are you waiting for? I’ll assist you if anything comes up.”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor frowned again as he gazed at the Tianyuan Realm. He wanted to kill the person who harmed his son, but there was a bad foreboding stirring in his heart.
That being said, the sword in his hand was emitting a light that would destroy everything.
Chuyuang Peak.
Linglong finally opened her heart and told Jiang Ming everything, “Senior brother, do you still remember the Mingyu Mountain I told you about?”
“Mingyu Mountain?” Jiang Ming thought for a while before he finally came to a realization. In the morning after he had gotten the system for three months. When he called his little sister for breakfast, she seemed to be in a bad mood and she told him about Mingyu Mountain. However, he did not care about it at that time.
“Yeah. What’s wrong about Mingyu Mountain?”
“According to the main universe, we should get married in Mingyu Mountain,” Linglong said. There was a blush on her cheeks when she recalled her past life.
“Main universe?” Jiang Ming was stunned, but a realization hit him soon after. He sucked in air sharply and looked at his junior sister incredulously, “Are you… Are you saying that you’re reborn?”
Updates by
“Yeah!” Linglong grabbed him tightly as if he was going to disappear in the next second. “That day, after I was reborn, I was thinking if you were also reborn as well. Therefore, I mentioned Mingyu Mountain. After all, it was a place where the most important event of our lives took place.”
“Reborn?” Jiang Ming was shocked. “I don’t understand!”
“Me neither!” Linglong replied, “I don’t know Whether I was reborn back from the future, or I just got some memories. I even speculated that all of this is nothing but a joke of a great one. He projected my life and shoved my memory into the younger me. Due to those memories, I awakened my Phoenix bloodline in advance. I thought I would be the only one to support Chuyang Peak and protect Jiuyang Sect from all troubles, but little did I expect that you would hide so deeply and cultivate faster than me.”
“Am I the same as my main universe?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself and asked.
It was also now that he saw the light as to why his junior sister would be so talented. However, there was one thing he did not understand. Why did the Human Paths Record not show anything about this?
Was it because it was her previous life, so it was not recorded?
Jiang Ming found it strange.
“No, it’s different. Although you were also a genius in the main universe, your cultivation speed was slow,” Linglong said, “I’m not sure if it’s because I’ve tampered with the timeline and messed up our course of life that caused you to have such a great opportunity in this life.”
“Well…”
Jiang Ming did not know what to say either.
His junior sister was reborn. Although he also existed in the main universe, were they the same person?
If they were not the same person, then how was he going to explain about the transmigration? Or was it because of his transmigration that it enabled his junior sister to learn about the things that happened in the main universe?
He couldn’t think it through no matter how hard he tried.
“Tell me about the main universe,” Jiang Ming pushed the thought aside and asked.
Since he couldn’t think it through, he decided not to think about it.
After all, their current life was what mattered the most right now.
Linglong nodded.
In the main universe, both of them were cultivating on Chuyang Peak. Although they were not the strongest and fastest cultivators, they were growing day by day. It was just that the Jiuyang Sect couldn’t hold itself against the attack of the Bishui Sect and was destroyed.
Her senior brother fled with her, and those were the darkest days of their life.
Afterward, the Eastern Region welcomed its most chaotic era. There was war and fight everywhere, and it became even harder for them to survive. Her senior brother was nearly killed several times while protecting her, but the silver lining was his cultivation level increased rapidly.
In the meantime, she also had awakened the Phoenix bloodline.
They had come across Xi Yao as well as Tian Ci. The former was still the high and mighty Holy Daughter, while the latter was arrogant and powerful.
Many Sacred Lands were in turmoil and there was also a demon invasion from another dimension. The immortals also had descended, and the treasure under the Jiuyang Sect was discovered.
They also had learned some information about the Heavenly Order.
“We tied the knot at Mingyu Mountain in the Heavenly Realm. Initially, we were going to spend the rest of our life together without caring about the things that were happening in the world outside. However, little did we expect that a disaster came knocking on our door once again,” Linglong said.
Her senior brother was left with a broken soul in order to protect her, but luckily, after he had reshaped his body, he became even stronger.
Compared to the mortal world, the heavenly realm was even crueler.
Since they did not have anyone to back them up, they had to stay low profile and watch their steps carefully.
However, there were too many lawless beings. Whenever they ran into danger, it was her senior brother who risked his life to protect her.
“Until that day!” Linglong’s eyes glowed with hatred, “We ran into Beiming Hai. He’s a Great Overarching Golden Immortal, and he’s the son of the Black Emperor. This person is greedy and lustful, and because of his powerful background, he is lawless and wants to take me away when he sees me.
“Although we were in the Golden Immortal Realm, we were no match for him. In the end, you sacrificed yourself to cast a forbidden spell and sent me away at the cost of your own mana and Primal Spirit.”
Linglong was trembling when those memories surfaced in her mind and she grabbed Jiang Ming even tighter.
“I’m here. Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming patted her shoulder.
After a short while, Linglong calmed herself down and continued.
She survived, but due to her Phoenix bloodline, she received the memories of the previous bearers of the Phoenix bloodline and her cultivation level increased by leap and bound. She started training hard and stepped into the Great Overarching Realm. She became an Immortal Empress herself and went to seek revenge from Beiming Hai.
Just when she was about to get her revenge and kill Beiming Hai, the Black Emperor appeared.
The terrifying being was an existence beyond her level. She couldn’t even get close to him, let alone running away.
Beiming Hai seized the chance and tried to catch her. He wanted to turn her into his cauldron and absorb her power.
Not wanting to fall into his hand, she killed herself.
At that time, the sun was blotted by the clouds and the wind was howling sadly.
Linglong was slowly calming down. After she had told her secret to Jiang Ming, she felt relieved. However, a sense of apprehension suddenly clutched at her and she asked, “Would you be afraid of me, senior brother?”
“What are you talking about? You’re my junior sister. I raised you myself, so how is there any possibility I would be afraid of you?” Jiang Ming replied as he grabbed her tightly in his arms.
“The past is in the past. What we should care about is our future. Since Beiming Hai killed another me and forced you to kill yourself, then he’s our enemy. If he’s our enemy, we should just kill him.”
“Senior brother, are you not going to blame me for keeping the truth from you the whole time?” Linglong asked, her voice faltering.
“Why should I? You’ve been protecting us the whole time,” Jiang Ming said, “Don’t think too much. You just need to remember that I’ll always be your senior brother.”
“Yeah!” Linglong nodded, “But Beiming Hai is in the Great Overarching Realm. His father, the Black Emperor, is in the Quasi-Sage middle stage. If we kill him, it will…”
“Quasi-Sage middle stage, huh… Well, it’s not like he’s undefeatable. I’ll figure something out!” Jiang Ming smiled, “Even if we can’t defeat him, I’m confident that we can run away safely, so don’t worry about it.”
“Okay!”
“What is the name of Beiming Hai’s father?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Kun Peng!”
“Kun Peng?”
“Yeah. He calls himself that, and according to rumors, he’s the first Kun Peng to succeed in cultivation.”
“But his son’s name is Beiming Hai? Could it be that his wife has cheated on him?”
“He’s called Beiming Hai because he created his son himself. Beiming Hai doesn’t have a mother.”
“What? Is he Hermaphrodite? He can produce offspring by himself? Incredible!”
“Haha!” Linglong chuckled. Then, she said in a serious manner, “He stays in the deepest part of the sea in Beiming Region, so he called his own son Beiming. His name is Kun Peng, or maybe, his real name is Beimeng Kun Peng.”
Swoosh!
The Human Paths Record opened up.
Just when he was about to write the name Kun Peng on it, a sword energy tore through the sky and charged straight toward Tianyuan Realm.
“Does he finally can’t hold himself back anymore? He’s really cautious, by the way. He doesn’t even want to step foot in our land,” Jiang Ming looked toward the sword energy in the sky and flew away. “Girl, just stay here and protect our home. I’ll go kill him right now. I’ll kill Bei Cheng, and then destroy Beiming! I’ll show you my true strength today!”
Jiang Ming destroyed the sword energy in one punch before charging toward Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - Kill Bei Cheng, Destroy Beiming, Quasi-Sage Middle Stage (Part 3)
chapters.content:

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - Flower Blossom and City Falls, Appearance of the Great Heavenly Venerate
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Flower Blossom and City Falls, Appearance of the Great Heavenly Venerate
After Jiang Ming had destroyed the sword energy, the Sky Defensive Sweater appeared on his body and the Heavenly War Sword in his hand.
Both of them were Great Overarching Immortal Weapons.
“Bei Chengxing, your son destroyed my homeland, and now you have come to destroy my sect? I won’t be able to answer to my people if I don’t kill you today!” Jiang Ming shouted.
“Flower Blossom and City Falls!”
As sword energies began to materialize in the air, the Akasa shook and one divine flower appeared after another. As the flowers began to bloom, a blinding light covered the sky and the power of order filled the air.
Each flower represented one type of the power of order. All of them merged together and formed into an attack of immense power.
This was one of the sword techniques that Jiang Ming learned from the Sword Tome. It gave off such an intense light that it lit up the entire sky.
“He could deflect my sword energy? Who is he?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor looked at the figure in the sky and frowned deeply. When he heard what Jiang Ming had said, his heart sank.
It occurred to him that something bad had happened to his son.
In the next second, he saw a sword energy tore through the sky and came straight at him.
“What a powerful move!” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor exclaimed. He shifted his sword in front of him in an attempt to parry Jiang Ming’s attack but to no avail. The sword energy rammed on him and threw him far into the distance.
“Who are you?”
After he had gotten his balance back, he summoned the palace under his feet and wrapped himself up in layers of light. Within the light, there were plenty of stars, and it looked just like a starry sky.
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor did not attack Jiang Ming back.
Beiming Emperor had retreated to the side and looked at them incredulously.
He did not care about what was going on between them. He just wanted to have some fun.
He glanced across the Tianyuan Realm, and an uncomfortable feeling rose from his stomach pit.
From there, he sensed a strong sense of killing intent.
“Sigh, I have made too many enemies for myself, but unfortunately, all of them are weak and they don’t even stand a chance against me!
“I heard that there is one Holy Daughter in the Riyue Sect. She possesses the Yin-Yang Saint Body, and she’s already an Immortal King. She will become the sect leader in the future, and she has the potential to become a Quasi-Sage. I should find a chance and get her into my hands so that I can have some fun with her. After that, I’ll use her as my cauldron to make myself stronger.
“As for the Riyue Sect… Hah, I hope they could bring me some fun.
“Beauties, masacre, cultivate, these are the only things that will bring me eternal joy!”
The smile on Beiming Emperor’s face was slightly distorted.
Tap, tap tap!
Jiang Ming came through the air, looking just like an ancient wild beast on its hunting spree. The sword in his hand was emitting a destructive light that seemed to have the ability of tearing the sky.
“Bei Chengxing!” Jiang Ming stopped several meters away from him. As for Beiming Emperor, he just ignored him.
“We have grudges against each other, and we’re bound to be enemies. Today, we’re not going to find out who is in the right or in the wrong. Today, we’ll only fight until one of us is dead!”
“How dare you!” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor squinted his eyes as an immense amount of killing intent exuded from him. “Tell me. How is Bei Chengguang now?”
Jiang Ming offered him a smile and replied, “Don’t worry, he’s in good hands now. He’s waiting for your broken soul to reconcile with him!”
“Broken soul?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor was so infuriated that his eyes were spewing fire when he heard what Jiang Ming said. “You’ve destroyed my son’s soul? That’s it! Tell me. Who are you? No, the question should be, who’s backing you up? I don’t believe that a normal planar world would produce someone like you in such a short amount of time!”
“Hold on a second!” Beiming Emperor chimed in, “Brother Bei Cheng, are you saying that he’s from a planar world?”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor calmed himself down and nodded. “Look at the land before you. It’s a leftover of a planar world, and it just arrived here not long ago. Before this, a demon lord is killed in this planar world, and my son too. Rumor has it that the treasure of the Primeval Heavenly Court is hiding here. That’s the reason why the demon from the abyss and my son take this place as a land of treasure. My son had been preparing for it for a long time, and I figured this should be a good opportunity for him to hone his battle skills by fighting against the demons. However, little did I expect that both him and the demons would be destroyed here.
“This man over here is born from the planar world, and he has grown to the level that he could fight on par with me. Do you know what this means? It means he’s extremely gifted!”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor’s voice traveled into the distance, startling several beings in the dark.
“Impossible!” Beiming Emperor shook his head. “Even if the treasure of the Primeval Heavenly Court is here, there’s no way someone like him from a planar world could become so powerful in such a short amount of time.”
“You don’t believe in me?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor harrumphed coldly, “Try and look into it yourself!”
Beiming Emperor did not say anything anymore. A dense amount of characters appeared in front of him as a river flowed from his eyes. Suddenly, he squinted his eyes and two lines of blood tears streamed down his face.
“Interesting!’ He licked the blood that flowed out of his eyes and a big smile appeared on his face. “There has been a rumor going around in the heavenly realm. When the Primeval Heavenly Court welcomed its destruction during the war, the treasures in it fell into the depths of the flood of space and time. Since then, no one has been able to find it. I also know that some of the forces in the heavenly realm have been planning to come to a place. Initially, I didn’t care about it, but it now seems to me that this place should be the place they’re looking for. Haha, since I’ve found it, then it should belong to me! If the treasure of the Primeval Heavenly Court that is coveted by many forces is the thing that made this little one so powerful, then maybe…” Beiming Emperor mumbled.
“Maybe it holds the secret of the Saint Lord Realm,” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor chimed in. “After all, there were rumors about the presence of the Saint Lord in the Primeval Heavenly Court, so I’m sure we’ll be able to find more secrets about the Saint Lord in the treasure!”
Beiming Emperor turned around and looked at Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor. He squinted his eyes and snorted coldly, “Hmph, do you think I don’t know what you’re trying to do? You don’t have the confidence to defeat him, so you exposed the secret to stir up my curiosity and spread the news to other places in order to lead other people here. You don’t have to do that at all, Brother Bei Cheng. If you really want my help, you could’ve said it.”
“Will you do it if I ask you to assist me?” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor harrumphed coldly, “The treasure is over there. Whether or not you want to take it, more and more people are bound to come here to get it.”
“As expected of Brother Bei Cheng!” Beiming Emperor laughed, “You people are one slier than the other. Even though your son is dead, you still won’t take the chance.”
“I’m sure the Black Emperor is craftier than me!” Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor pitched his voice low and said.
A chill trickled down his spine at the moment he mentioned about the Black Emperor.
He looked at Jiang Ming and thought inwardly, ‘Why is he not attacking us? Why would he give me the chance to spread the news? Why does he look so confident? And the way he looks at me… It’s like he’s looking at a dead person!”
His heart sank and he decided to treat Jiang Ming even more carefully.
“My father? Haha, without him, I might have gone straight for it after I heard what you said, but now… Haha!” Beiming Emperor let out a boisterous laughter. “Since I’m already here, who else has the guts to come fight with me for it?”
Bei Cheng Immortal Emperor did not say anything.
More and more Golden Immortal and Taiyi experts had appeared around the Tianyuan Sea.
Some of their hearts skipped a beat when they saw who they were going to fight later.
“Great Overarching? This is bad!” A beneficiary from the Lord God exclaimed. After that, he started contacting other teams to work together.
The Fifth Immortal Moon had arrived at the Tianyuan Realm. She stood at one of the mountains and looked at Jiang Ming. “Both of them are Great Overarching Golden Immortals. Will my master be able to defeat them? Right now, the beneficiaries from the Lord God are on the move. Besides, more and more people will be heading over here after they get the news…”
Even though she was worried about Jiang Ming, there was nothing she could do. After all, she was too weak.
Honggu Heavenly Realm, high above the sky where the Heavenly Court was situated.
Amidst the sea of clouds and divine lights, more and more palaces were coming into sight, and at the deepest part of the Heavenly Court, there was one palace hovering amidst an endless stream of violet Qi.
Inside the hall, the Great Heavenly Venerate was sitting on the throne.
Majestic, domineering, supreme, noble, ancient, profound, and solemn.
These were the descriptions one would give to the man when they saw him. He exuded such an impressive aura that it would make people bow to him.
There was a mirror hovering in front of him, and it was showing the Tianyuan Sea in the Infinite Realms Battlefield.
Next to him stood an old man with silver hair and white beard. He was holding a horsetail whisk in his hand, and there was a harmless, gentle smile on his face.
“Taibai, is it possible for the treasure of the Heavenly Realm to produce a being that’s comparable to a Great Overarching expert?” The Great Heavenly Venerate asked.
“Your majesty, no treasure can make a planar world to produce such a powerful being,” Taibai answered as he bowed slightly. The treasure has been torn apart and only a fraction of it is left. Besides, although this mortal world has been coveted by many parties, it isn’t worth mentioning at all since they’re nothing but plots by youngsters. Besides, they’re guarded by Mountain Master Tian Yuan.”
“Mountain Master Tian Yuan!” The Great Heavenly Venerate shouted, “Could it be that he’s his disciple?”

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - Immortal Annihilation Star Formation, Ruthless Kunpeng
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Immortal Annihilation Star Formation, Ruthless Kunpeng
In the current era of Honggu Heavenly Realm, the Great Heavenly Venerate was recognized as the strongest above all. He guarded the Heavenly Court, became the Heavenly Emperor, crushed through the ages, suppressed the infinite realm and was invincible in that era.
In this world, there were very few secrets that he did not know of.
Taking the situation at Tianyuan world for example, he in fact knew it better than anyone else.
However, it was just insignificant to him and he would at most throw glances occasionally at it.
“That’s not it!” Before waiting for Star Lord Taibai to even reply, the Great Heavenly Venerate spoke up once again, “That old man Mountain Master Tianyuan is the one living the most carefree life. He doesn’t have a care for anything which means he has no weakness. He doesn’t ask of others nor does he control anyone. After that incident that year, he is even more unlikely to accept disciples. Look at him now! Who would dare make fun of him?”
“He’s apathetic and has no desire at all. Yet he’s the most stubborn one sometimes!” Taibai Star Lord sighed.
“That’s true!” Great Heavenly Venerate frowned slightly, “It’s just that this human’s growth seems to be a little abnormal. I tried to see through his innate nature and was actually warded off.”
“Even your Majesty can’t see through?” Star Lord Taibai was shocked.
The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded and continued, “However, we can still feel that he has an amazing qi and blood. His physical body is anything but ordinary as well. That sword Dao that he just performed was extremely domineering but its Dao fluctuation was very poor in comparison. His cultivation base shouldn’t be high but his combat power is sky-defying. Taibai, this kid came from the immortal realm and yet had such achievements. Doesn’t this feel familiar?”
“It’s…” Star Lord Taibai’s expression changed slightly and continued, “Could it be that he is related to ‘that place’?”
“That should be the reason! Otherwise, how could he, a human from the immortal world, grow to such a level?” The Great Heavenly Venerate stood up. In an instant, a powerful surge of energy was awakened as countless storms were set off in layers of space, “Alas, ‘that place’. A place that’s both desirable by many, and feared by many as well.”
“Your Majesty, with your cultivation base, you should be able to stand firm there!” Star Lord Taibai thoughtfully said, “Compared to this place here, isn’t it much easier to walk on the path of Dao over at ‘that place’?”
“It isn’t so!” the Great Heavenly Venerate shook his head, “It’s very easy to improve to the Great Overarching Realm there, but becomes extremely difficult to improve further. The great Dao would seem to be far from attainable and it’s even harder for enlightenment.”
With his hand behind his back, the Great Heavenly Venerate paced back and forth in the great hall as the mirror that was floating in front of him continued following him around.
Star Lord Taibai was silent for a while after taking in such news.
“What do you think would happen if that kid killed Beiming Hai?” the Great Heavenly Venerate spoke again with a strange tone.
“Can he kill him though?” Star Lord Taibai shook his head, “Your Majesty, you said it yourself just now that this kid has a low cultivation base and there’s even Bei Chenxing on the sideline. How can he even kill him? There isn’t any grudge between the two and hence there shouldn’t be any reason for them to fight. Besides, Beiming Hai has the Black Emperor behind him.”
There was a glimpse of strangeness in his eyes as he had quite a grasp on the Great Heavenly Venerates thought.
Even if there were some guesses in his heart, he could only pretend to be confused at times.
‘What if the kid was killed by Beiming Hai?’ Star Lord Taibai lowered her head, thinking that this might be the other meaning behind what the Great Heavenly Venerate was saying.
“Let’s just watch this farce unfold!” The Great Heavenly Venerate sat back down on his throne and the peerless power that was raging also fell silent.
…
In the Infinite Realm Battlefield, Jiang Ming paused his attack after a single sword slash.
While he was exchanging blows with Bei Chenxing, he opened up the Human Path Record again.
Name: Beiming Kunpeng
Race: Demon clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Quasi-Sage Realm
Background: The Great Northern Emperor of the Honggu Heavenly Realm Heavenly Court, also known as Black Emperor.
Relationship: 0
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status
: As the first Kunpeng of the Honggu Heavenly Realm, his congenital bloodline and aptitude was extremely high. Since the beginning of his birth, his growth has been smooth sailing as he yearns for an unfettered life and freedom.
: When he was challenged by the ancient Heavenly Court and wouldn’t back down, he was forcefully suppressed and was almost besieged.
: Although he subdued in the end, the foundation of his cultivation aptitude was also destroyed and his potential greatly reduced.
: He stayed in the Heavenly Court but hated the place very much.
: When the ancient Heavenly Court suffered a disaster, not only did he not lend a helping hand, he kicked them when they were down, landing a blow onto the previous Heavenly Emperor before quietly disappearing from the place.
: When the Heavenly Court was rebuilt, he was invited by the Great Heavenly Venerate who treated him generously. Unable to refuse the offer, he took on the position as the Great Northern Emperor, commanded the Northern sky and mastered the Killing Dao.
: His Dao injury still remained and recovery was too difficult. In the endless years, he felt more and more lonely and started thinking about inheritance and leaving a legacy. When he thought of bloodline inheritance, he had a sudden spark in his mind, and came up with a method: To replenish bloodline with bloodline and whittle away his Dao injury with the power of origin.
: As Beiming Hai was born from this thought, he loved him immensely and took great care of him in every possible way. However, it also caused this beloved son of his to develop a reckless and domineering character.
: He didn’t mind it all and even created a type of technique that allowed Beiming to plunder other people’s cultivation base, absorb it as his own, extradite the energy with his bloodline inheritance which allowed him to improve without needing to cultivate.
: At the same time, there was also the Cauldron technique that allowed him to snatch a person’s innate ability, talent and bloodline to enhance his own. This made Beiming Hai even more lawless. Under his intentional indulgence and secret guidance, Beiming Hai plundered rare women everywhere. After toying with them, he either devoured them directly or used them as his cauldron, allowing his strength to skyrocket.
: Upon reaching the Great Overarching Realm, he indulged his beloved son more by even gathering countless artifacts and treasures for him to refine and absorb, so as to improve his cultivation base and potential even further.
: Under his secret guidance, his son even captured some of the most talented female disciples of the major sects as cauldron and continued to grow his origin.
: Seeing the growth of his child, he was extremely happy and reassured.
: He finally made up his mind to retreat into cultivation to adjust his current state to the peak and even practiced the Holy Laws a couple of times in order to be more perfect. After he finishes his cultivation retreat, he plans on forcibly raising his child’s cultivation base up to the pinnacle of Great Overarching Realm. When the time comes, he will devour his son to repair the injury to his body, improve his potential and at the same time cut off emotions and desire. By then, he will be enlightened and be able to peep into the Holy Dao.
: Currently in the midst of a cultivation retreat.
…
“Oh my God!”
Although Jiang Ming remained calm from the outside, he was extremely shocked in his heart.
This Kunpeng had Dao injury on himself, but was still in the Quasi-Sage Realm. Putting that to a side, who would’ve thought that he gave birth to a child, raised his child’s cultivation at any cost, and even developed the child into a lawless domineering character that made enemies everywhere and plunders the beauties of the world, all for the sake the growth of his beloved son’s origin so that he can devour it in the future.
‘Nurturing a child with the aim of devouring it?’ To think of it, Jiang Ming felt chills running through his spine.
He began wondering if Kunpeng was a human and thought that it was a resounding no.
‘He isn’t a human to begin with, but a beast! There’s a saying that a tiger, though cruel, will not devour its cubs. However, this guy gave birth and nurtured his son with the aim of killing it! Who would even believe this if the news went out?’ Jiang Ming sighed in his heart.
Meanwhile, he inexplicably felt some pity for Beiming Hai.
This person’s whole life was arranged from his birth to his upbringing.
However, with this person being a knot in little junior sister’s heart, how could he let him die at the hands of others?
Several thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind.
‘If I kill Beiming Hai, that old Kunpeng will definitely go crazy. But If I don’t, Beiming Hai will surely fight us to his last gasp. Therefore, the result will never change whether I kill him or not! Wait…Why am I even pondering on this?’
He didn’t care about Bei Chenxing spreading the news around about the great encounter hidden in the Tianyuan world.
Since he wanted to assert dominance, he was ready to face anything that comes in his way.
“Are you finished thinking about this?” Jiang Ming walked towards him, “Your son wanted to destroy my homeland but I crippled him instead. He is now left with only a wisp of soul remnant and is being tempered by the Nine Fiery of the Netherworld, yet you still had so many worries about it. Haha, you really make me despise you!”
“You’re courting death!” Despite being cautious, Immortal Emperor Bei Chen couldn’t hold back his rage anymore this time, “How dare you treat my son like this! I will definitely kill you and all the living beings in that island of yours, leaving no survivors at all!”
“What are you waiting for? Bring it on then!” Jiang Ming lunged forward as the sword in his hand was already emanating dense aura of murderous intent.
“Great Akasa Sword Technique, End of Era!”
Hidden in the sword slash were boundless Dao of Destruction.
As an era came to an end, everything withered as the world returned to ruins, burying anything and everything with it.
It was a sword slash of death.
“Although your combat ability is strong, it’s only to such an extent!” Bei Chenxing’s killing intent was raging. He knew that this battle was inevitable and wanted to finish the fight quickly, “Great Overarching Dao where I control the stars!”
With a slash of a long sword, the stars in the sky glimmered, evoking an ancient starry sky. Between the cycles, an immeasurably imposing aura was dispersed.
There was also the power of Dao that belonged to the Great Overarching Realm in it, suppressing all of those under the Great Overarching Realm.
Jiang Ming was flung off from the explosion, as the sea waters below evaporated by thousands of feet and even the Tianyuan world shook slightly.
“Tyrannical indeed! As expected of a strong Great Overarching expert!” Jiang Ming didn’t mind and launched himself onwards to attack again.
The Sword Dao special ability was evoked as the destructive intent of the sword Sambodha pervaded thousands of miles around.
“You’re merely as so. When I get serious, you are nothing to me!” Bei Chenxing hummed, “Thinking to fight against a Great Overarching expert when you aren’t even one yourself? I myself am in the later stage of Great Overarching!”
As the deafening roars shook the sky, the two continued to exchange blows.
Although Jiang Ming was able to withstand the attacks, he was clearly at a disadvantage.
As Beiming Hai stepped back and landed onto his battleship, he held a maidservant in his arms as his hands were caressing up and down whilst carefully observing Jiang Ming.
“Mere ant that isn’t even of Great Overarching Realm to be as strong as this extent! There’s also that young girl from before. This is interesting!”
His eyes flicked as his heart was racing from happiness.
“Great Overarching! Deserving as it’s called!” Jiang Ming blocked off the attacks from his opponent, but couldn’t help and sighed.
The reason why he was at a disadvantage was because he was far from using his full strength.
He had yet to cast the World’s Projection which could suppress his opponents quite a bit. Besides, he had not evoked any physical body technique, incarnation Dao, and many other peerless ultimate techniques.
Nevertheless, it was already very remarkable for him to face up with Bei Chenxing of the later stage of Great Overarching with himself being in the Mystical Immortal Realm.
Fortunately, he hid himself using the Human Path Record so that other people couldn’t see through his actual cultivation realm. Otherwise, if people knew that he was only at Mystical Immortal Realm, who knew how big of a storm this might set off.
‘Although this fight was to assert dominance, I can’t let this stalemate go on for too long. Let’s just end this!’ As Jiang Ming thought to himself, readying to exert an explosive attack to destroy his opponent, he saw that Bei Chenxing had already evoked a terrifying technique.
The palace under his feet suddenly burst out hundreds and millions of light rays from the countless star imprints that were spread millions of miles away. The imprints formed a great array formation, encircling Jiang Ming in it.
“This is the Immortal Annihilation Star Array Formation! A technique which I’ve developed from the beginning of my birth through hundreds of millions of years of comprehension which uses my origin to match the starry sky.” Bei Chenxing’s voice was deafening, “I’ve collected the various star nuclei and the energy of countless stars, condensing into 365 huge stars. Once evoked, I am certain to even trap a Quasi-Sage Realm expert. As for you? It’s also your honor to be able to die under this formation!”
“Is that so?” Jiang Ming remained calm on the outside while his heart skipped a beat.
Did this count as being slapped in the face?

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - The Sea of Chaos, Inhumane
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: The Sea of Chaos, Inhumane
The vast starry sky seemingly stretched through the boundless horizon.
As each star revolved, a type of supreme force slowly gathered that caused Jiang Ming’s body to suddenly feel heavy. If it was just based on the numbers alone, a Golden Immortal would’ve been crushed to dust by such a force already.
Puff…
As a sword qi brisk right at him, he could not dodge in time and the attack tore a hole on his shoulder. The Great Overarching’s power of Daluo that was embedded in the attack formed some sort of drill that desperately tried to infiltrate his body, destroy his body and decimate his soul.
His inner world trembled, swallowing the entire power and then refined it.
“So strong!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“Of course I’m strong!” Bei Chenxing’s figure suddenly appeared on each and every star, all looking towards Jiang Ming. “Tell me, what are the secrets hidden in the mortal world that you lived in? How did it allow you to grow to such an extent?”
“Didn’t you know?” Jiang Ming’s expression was cold.
As his gaze drifted around, he realized that Bei Chenxing’s figure on each of the stars were all main bodies with exactly the same aura.
The Great Overarching Realm was indeed no trivial matter. This special ability of his was even more so.
However, Jiang Ming didn’t mind. It was because of his experience in killing a peerless Great Overarching expert throughout the infinite Heavenly Realm when he was in the Supreme Pagoda. Although his methods were a little rogue, it was still a Great Overarching expert that he killed.
Moreover, he was confident to identify Bei Chenxing’s main body because he had three ways.
Firstly, he could evoke the World Projection which in turn shroud the starry sky, penetrating through the infinite time and space. Forcing him out wouldn’t be difficult; Secondly, he could shatter the great formation and his main body would naturally reappear; Lastly, he could use the Human Path Record.
He decided to use the Human Path Record first. He called out the Human Path Record so that it floated in front of him. As he then flipped the pages, it locked on onto Bei Chenxing’s main body.
“Is it really the inheritance from the ancient Heavenly Court?” Bei Chenxing’s voice echoed through the vast starry sky with immeasurable prestige, “If it was just such an encounter, it wouldn’t allow a human from the mortal realm like you to grow to the point where you are capable of competing with the Great Overarching Golden Immortals. You must have other encounters with you.”
“Well, it’s the Heavenly Court! One that dominated the heavens, controlled the infinite realms, wielded the laws and thousands of other great things.
