For it to have collected various great treasures, it would not be an exaggeration that it allowed me to grow so fast right?” Jiang Ming replied, and retorted,” In middle chiliocosm, if a person such as yourself breaks free of the world’s shackles and ascends, will you reach the Heavenly Realm or the Sea of Chaos?”
“You actually know about the Sea of Chaos?” While Bei Chenxing was very surprised, a sudden thought came into his mind as he muttered: “You are not of the Great Overarching Realm, but you are still capable of going against a later stage Great Overarching expert such as myself. Even though we have gone this far, you still didn’t panic and obviously looked like you still have means to protect yourself. For such a mortal like you to be able to grow to such an extent, it’s only possible if you are connected to that place.”
As he continued, his eyes suddenly glowed with fiery light, “Tell me, what great encounter did you really obtain? Is it the legendary inheritance of Heavenly Venerate? The inheritance of the legendary Lord God? Or the inheritance of the Reincarnation? Perhaps the legendary inheritance of the Daoist Ancestor?”
“As expected of a person that stands at the pinnacle of the world! Your knowledge is extraordinary!” Jiang Ming’s heart trembled within, but still smiled calmly and continued, “I’m currently not older than 50 years old. Who do you think is the person behind me?”
“Not even 50 years old?” The eyes of countless Bei Chenxing bulged as though they were about to fall out due to extreme shock. “That’s impossible! How is that even possible?”
“Nothing is impossible!” Jiang Ming smiled lightly.
He was also closely observing Bei Chenxing’s ‘status’.
Name: Bei Chenxing
Race: Innate Saint Spirit
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm
Background: Master of the Emperor Star Palace, one of the Immortal Emperor of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm
Relationship: -97
Innate Talent: Great Overarching
Status
: My imprint on the Great Overarching Dao Vessel has been erased! Who is so daring to go against my son? He’s courting death!
: Sensing the coordinates, he left Starlight Realm, traveled through the torrents of void and arrived at the Infinite Realm Battlefield. He sensed the residual breath of his son and immediately locked eyes onto Tianyuan World.
: This is the remnant of a mortal planar world. With the combat ability of the three Immortal Kings that my song brought along with him, how can they be defeated? This isn’t right. Something right in front of here is giving me an uneasy feeling.
: I’m afraid there must be something unknowingly terrifying to be able to make even myself uneasy. I can’t go in there. I’ll just destroy the whole land from the outside and see clearly for what’s hidden in it.
: As for my son? Although he was only captured, this place still makes me feel uneasy. How can I put myself in danger? If he dies, so be it. Father will avenge you, my son.
: This bastard Beiming Hai actually came. Whenever this fella appears, something bad is bound to happen. Although he is of the Great Overarching Realm, his combat ability is very poor. If he did not rely on his father’s reputation, he would have been slaughtered long ago. I’m certain that he will die due to his own recklessness in the future.
: Although I’m not afraid of him, I don’t want to cause trouble to myself. It’s all good if he doesn’t stop me.
: Is that Golden Immortal Realm female Immortal, who is flying in from a distance, from that mortal planar world? If so, I’m afraid the secret here is no trivial matter!
: Well, I think I shall test the waters first. Good lord! My sword qi was shattered by just a punch from that person who rushed out of the place! This person’s combat power cannot be underestimated.
: It’s safer to pique Beiming Hai’s interest in this and maybe I can even lead this misfortune upon him. I’ll exaggerate about the great encounter ahead and let more powerful experts join in with the skirmish.
: After all, with Beiming Hai here, I no longer have interest in this place.
: This little guy in front can still remain calm even when he hears me exaggerating about the secrets of his world, piquing the interests of many other experts. Is this fearlessness, arrogance or is he merely a fool? Yet how many fools could cultivate to such a high level? How many experts who killed their way out of a mortal planar world would be as arrogant?
: Does he have the confidence to deal with all the various situations here?
: Hmm... It shouldn’t be!
: Could it be a bluff?
: His breath is obscure and his aura is so violent that even I can’t take a peek of his actual capability. The others might not be able to see through him, but judging by the punch just now, I am certain that he hasn’t reached the Great Overarching Realm yet. This is enough information already.
: Good lord, I didn’t make my move but this guy dared to take the initiative and attack first. This Sword Dao Special Ability of his is too pure and powerful. Although there isn’t any Great Overarching Dao fluctuation in it, its might is still extremely powerful.
: This little guy is too calm and collected. Is there any basis for it? This cannot go on. Although I’m sure I can suppress him, it’s better to be careful and just bring out my ultimate killer move to avoid any unexpected incidents.
: Based on the combat ability he displayed and his capability to remain calm even after being trapped by my Immortal Annihilation Star Array Formation, he doesn’t look like a person born of the mortal world no matter how I look at it. Even if he really got his hands on the treasures left from the Ancient Heavenly Court, it’s still impossible for him to reach such a level.
: There must be a monstrous secret about him. A secret that can even allow a mortal human to grow to the point of being able to compete with me! If I get my hands on such a secret, it might even help me to enter the Quasi-Sage Realm and become the real giant of this world.
: What did I just hear? He’s not even 50 years old?
: God damn it! Did I hear that wrong? Am I hallucinating?
: A 50 years old human from the mortal planar world growing to a point comparable to a Great Overarching expert who’s even in the pinnacle! Rather than just comparing to the world I came from, is there even such genius that ever existed in the Heavenly Realm? There isn’t even one from the past countless eras!
: This is not a miracle, but a terrifyingly dreadful horror!
: What is he hiding behind him?
: Alas, even my heart is shivering!
: Also, he even knew about the Sea of Chaos.
: How many Great Overarching experts even knew of that place? Even some of the Quasi-Sages of weaker background in the Heavenly Realm might have never heard of it. Yet, this guy actually knew!
: Sure enough! Only the inheritance from that place is able to nurture such a terrifying existence.
: I heard those very old people from the Heavenly Realm mentioned before that experts such as a disciple of the Lord God are capable of competing with experts that are of higher rank than they are. Killing a Great Overarching expert when they are at Taiyi Realm isn’t a big deal to them. Although I’m not sure if the rumors were true, I can see how terrifying such inheritance is.
: I even heard that these inheritance’s disciples are generally selected from different Heavenly Realms through various universes. Before these disciples were led to the inheritance, their life would not be taken care of at all. If I manage to get his inheritance and replace him, then…
: Oh for heaven’s sake! I’ve lived for 300 billion years now! Am I finally getting my sky-defying great encounters now?
: My spirit is raging, and my blood is boiling with excitement now! I’m even getting an erection from all these!
: Keep calm… Stay collected… I cannot get carried away and be punished instead.
: Having acquired the inheritance from such a place, he must have possessed extremely terrifying special abilities and perhaps even possessed a great killer weapon. Perhaps these are the basis for his confidence all this while!
: I cannot give him any chance to evoke them and directly kill him in one blow.
: Wait a minute! I’ll get more information out of him first.
: After all, I’m using this great array formation technique to accumulate the stars and conjure this incarnation. Even a great Heavenly Venerate may not be able to identify my main body.
: I’m inherently invincible!
…
As Jiang Ming read through this persons ‘Status’, he felt extremely strange.
This guy really knew about the Sea of Chaos.
He was again confirmed that ‘that place’ was definitely a world beyond the great chilicosms.
However, there was no detailed explanation of it in the ‘Status’, which was a pain in the b*tt!
What surprised him even more was that this person was initially here to save his son, but it turned out that he didn’t care at all. It was as if this son of his was just a mere bastard.
Jiang Ming then thought about Beiming Hai. His father was even more ruthless. He gave birth to his offspring, and nurtured him with all his heart only for consumption in the future.
‘God damn!’ Jiang Ming was frustrated at these peerless experts who were heartless and emotionless! ‘No wonder there was a saying that b*stards don’t have virtues or morals!
‘So inhumane!’

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - Completely Wiping Out, Hearing about Dao Yan Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Completely Wiping Out, Hearing about Dao Yan Again
Bei Chenxing recollected himself after being shocked by Jiang Ming. Then he asked again, “Are you really under 50 years old?”
He could not believe Jiang Ming’s age. After all, someone like him taking a nap would take thousands or ten thousand years already.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming smiled, “Want to know how my cultivation can grow so fast? How about we exchange information?”
“How do you want to exchange this?” Bei Chenxing frowned.
“It’s very simple! I’ll tell you about my great encounter and you tell me about the Sea of Chaos. It’s just that simple!” As Jiang Ming explained, ten clones suddenly appeared around him and all of them evoked the Time and Space Confinement technique at the same time.
In fact, Jiang Ming did not intend to exchange information. He asked just to keep Chen Beixing off guard.
Ten instances of such confinement technique simultaneously landed on one of the stars.
“How is it possible that you found my main body?” Bei Chenxing wanted to teleport away as he howled in his soul, but quickly realized that he could not move an inch.
“Time and Space Technique! Each one of them is comparable to the special ability of the Great Overarching Realm and there are 10 of them! You aren’t of the Great Overarching Realm but how can you comprehend such a powerful special ability? How can you possess so much immortal origin? Are you really under 50 years old? God damn it! You liar! You’re just trying to numb my senses!” Bei Chenxing was anguished as his primal spirit trembled uncontrollably. Howls of despair were wailing from his very soul.
However, what greeted him was Jiang Ming’s ultimate killer technique.
He evoked the Great Boundless Technique to grow his body up to 300 feet high. His physical body became ferociously violent, the outburst of energy from his blood even managed to distort space. He became overwhelmingly powerful!
Nevertheless, he still could not kill off a Great Overarching Golden Immortal by throwing a punch. Anyway, he merely wanted his body to be stronger enough to cater to much stronger special ability, ie. the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique!
Jiang Ming’s attack was extremely ruthless as he directly evoked his killer move, not allowing his opponent any chances to counterattack.
The single finger penetrated the opponent’s forehead, destroying his primal spirit.
“Great Karma Technique, pursuit of the infinite realms!”
“Great Malediction Technique, decimate!”
Jiang Ming did not stop there as he captured the shard of his soul’s remnant and evoked the opponent’s qi and blood, performing the Great Malediction Technique. By mobilizing the power of his inner world’s origin, waves of strange forces permeated all around as they looked for the imprints of soul and such that were left by Bei Chenxing, completely wiping his existence.
Without the main body, these imprints would lose their source or origin and spirituality. As such, it was not hard to deal with these imprints.
Jiang Ming did so because would not give his opponent any chances for resurrection if he wanted to kill.
‘He should be completely dead this time!’ As Jiang Ming thought to himself, he looked up the Human Path Record and sure enough, the name of Bei Chenxing had disappeared.
The great formation array surrounding the place also began to collapse. All Bei Chenxing on each and every star also disappeared without a trace.
As he glanced around, he discovered two great artifacts right beside Bei Chenxing’s corpses. One was a palace, while another a long sword, both were Great Overarching Dao vessels.
There were also other items but Jiang Ming was not interested in them.
‘These are the Emperor Star Palace, and the Infinite Star Sword. Not bad, not bad at all!’ Jiang Ming examined the two Dao vessels and then nodded in satisfaction.
He was especially satisfied with the Emperor Star Palace that could be said as the pinnacle of a Great Overarching Dao vessel. Bei Chenxing had refined 365 giant stars and integrated them into it. With the Emperor Star Palace as the array formation’s core, he was able to mobilize a force that far exceeded the power of Great Overarching.
‘It’s such a huge waste to use those giant stars for conjuring a great formation. It’s better to just integrate them into my inner world!’ Jiang Ming thought.
From the inner world’s perspective, these stars were without a doubt supreme resources. If they were to be completely refined, his inner world’s origin would definitely skyrocket.
Looking at the great formation that was about to completely collapse, with just a thought, his face suddenly turned pale as streaks of sword markings appeared on his skin with blood trickling down. There was even a sword wound on his forehead that almost pierced through.
He looked miserable.
Jiang Ming then flicked his sleeves and put away the many giant stars, directly integrating them into his inner world. These stars began to be refined by the power of origin, providing resources to it and promoting the evolution of his inner world.
The very next moment, he appeared high in the sky as his body suddenly staggered, almost falling to the ground.
He quickly put away Bei Chenxing’s corpse, flew towards Tianyuan World and it did not take long before he reached the depth of Tianyuan World.
Fogs and haze surged in all parts of Tianyuan World, preventing people from seeing what was happening inside. It was also blocking consciousness from scouting. It functioned like a formation with very low lethality.
Beiming Hai had been looking at where Bei Chenxing and Jiang Ming fought. Unfortunately, the place was shrouded in great formation that was prompted by Bei Chenxing, making it difficult to see the situation inside.
However, it didn’t take long for the great formation array to collapse as Jiang Ming appeared out of it, covered in scars and blood. Even his breath was extremely weak.
Before Beiming Hai even reacted, Jiang Ming looked at Bei Chenxing’s corpse lying by the side, put it away and turned into a stream of light, returning to Tianyuan World.
As the fog turned hazy and nothing could be seen, Beiming Hai finally recollected himself and thought,
‘How is it possible that the Immortal Emperor Bei Chen was killed? He is a veteran Great Overarching Golden Immortal and even holds a portion of the world’s authority in the Starlight Middle chiliocosm. His power is unfathomable and his strength unbelievable! How could he be killed? Even if he was no match for this boy, he should be able to escape at the very least! Is that kid so powerful?’
‘Seeing that he was injured all over and even injured his origin, his aura seemed to have been weakened to the extreme. He should be like a spent bullet already! If I made my move just now, I could’ve easily killed him! But now…Might there be other peerless experts on that piece of land? No, absolutely not! Otherwise, how could they not appear when faced against such a powerful enemy like Bei Chenxing and also besieged by a great array formation? Moreover, with my presence, the other experts would definitely not just watch the whole skirmish if he really had people helping him. He should be the strongest on that land!’
‘To think that a mortal planar world actually gave birth to such a terrifying individual that can even kill Immortal Emperor Bei Chen. What kind of sky-defying great encounter is actually in that land? Is it really a treasure trove left by the past Heavenly Court? I don’t believe it. It must be something even more amazing!’
‘That’s right, there are even beautiful ladies there!”
Upon thinking of this, Beiming Hai felt as though his heart was set ablaze. Yet, he still had some doubts about it.
He sensed more and more peerless experts started to gather around the place where there were no less than 10 Taiyi Golden Immortal experts. There were also several peerless auras rushing over. Making up his mind, Beiming Hai rushed forward.
Meanwhile, he tried to convince himself, ‘I’m Beiming Hai! My father is the Black Emperor, the Great Northern Emperor of the Heavenly Court! I kill people and eat their meat, yet who would dare to go against me! Hmph! I am the only one who does the killing in this world! After all, no one would dare to go against me even if I lose. All because I have such an amazing father! Therefore, what am I even afraid of?’
Beiming Hai was beyond bold and fearless. In fact, it was pure recklessness.
…
Back on Chuyang Peak, when Jiang Ming returned, he immediately mobilized the Saint Province Dao Square, creating fogs to isolate themselves from the prying eyes of the outside world. This barrier did not look strong because it only could prevent others from probing.
“Senior Brother!” Seeing Jiang Ming’s injuries, Linglong immediately cried and her murderous intent went ballistic. “How did you end up gravely injured? I’ll… I’ll go and destroy the entire Starlight World!”
“Don’t worry! This is a disguise!” Jiang Ming hurriedly explained himself as he recovered himself without the slightest injury in sight, “Don’t worry. I won’t make my move unless I have absolute confidence.”
“You scared me!” Linglong laughed through her tears, “Senior Brother, are you tired after the great battle or are you purposely showing your weakness to lure Beiming Hai over?”
“As expected of my smart girl!” Jiang Ming caressed her long hair and continued telling his plan, “When Bei Chenxing made his moves, he set up a great array formation that blocked off the sight from the outside and so the others didn’t know of my abilities. Although dealing with Beiming Hai there and then was also a trivial matter, it’s inevitable that others might peek and learn of my abilities. In that case, I’ll be easily targeted if I were to make my move in the future. In addition, because the foreigners that previously descended into our world have come! I want to lure them all over and kill them all at one go!”
“The foreigners?” Linglong’s pupil shrank, “Perhaps I know some details about them!”
“Oh, you used to be an Immortal Emperor after all!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but amuse, “Girl, try and tell me!”
“Even if I’m an Immortal Emperor, I’m still your Junior Sister, your woman, your woman of two lives!” Junior Sister snuggled into his arms as she frowned a little, reminiscing on her past memories, “I once met an ancient powerful expert known as Immortal Venerate Dao Yan. He mentioned that there is a wider and vast world in the Chaos, known as the Sea of Chaos. It’s a place where all Great Overarching and stronger experts yearn to.”
“There is a force there searching for disciples throughout the universe to be nurtured. The kind of nurturing was akin to parasite breeding, allowing them to keep descending into various worlds and put their life at stake in battles. Those who manage to survive till the end are all monstrous. All of them are terrifyingly strong with various techniques. They are unpredictable and it makes it almost impossible to guard against them!”
“Senior Brother, I think they are the foreigners you are talking about right?” As Linglong explained about the past, she asked curiously, “By the way, didn’t you have control of the Fifth Immortal Moon?”
“The Fifth Immortal Moon belongs to the Reincarnation Hall, and another part of them came from the Lord God Space!” Jiang Ming explained, “What I’m dealing with are the Lord God’s beneficiaries.”
“Senior Brother, so you knew about this!” Linglong was very surprised at first, but when she thought of the inheritance that her Senior Brother obtained, it all seemed like it was a matter of course.
“Yeah. I didn’t tell you because I was afraid you would be worried!” Jiang Ming smiled, “What kind of existence is this Immortal Emperor Dao Yan that you just said?”
It reminded him of Master Dao Yan.
Among the rewards that he got in the beginning, there was a book called “Detailed Explanation on Human Cultivation Realms”. Although there were some mistakes in it, it gave him quite a lot of guidance.
“I only know that he is from the human race and nothing else!” Linglong thought for a while before she shook her head, “This person is very mysterious. Also, I didn’t understand much about the outside world back then! Senior Brother, are you able to handle these Lord God beneficiaries?”
“They are all good people. Really! All of them are good people!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing, “Without them, I wouldn’t have grown up so fast. In fact, I like them descending into our world! The more the better!”
Linglong showed a strange and puzzled look.
Suddenly, Jiang Ming looked over in the distance as a cruel smile slowly curved from the corner of his lips, “He’s here. He has come to die!”

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - Kneel, Malicious Curse
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Kneel, Malicious Curse
In one of the corners of Tianyuan Sea, stood a purple-clad young man who had a third eye between his eyebrows. He was the expert that descended from the Lord God Space. He concealed his aura and kept observing the situation at sea.
“To think that there’s an expert that is as strong as a Great Overarching expert in this land of mission, it’s fortunate that I didn’t just rush in or it would’ve been so much trouble. In fact, I didn’t expect that there would be strong enemies coming over. At least they can help me scout and test the waters, saving a lot of my time and effort. Hence, making this mission much easier! Could this be God’s blessing?” The purple-clad young man said with excitement.
“God?” The girl next to him pouted, “How many of these gods have we killed? Rather than trusting good, it’s far better to trust you, boss!”
“Haha! I like the sound of that!” The purple-clad young man laughed out loud and was no longer as cautious as when they first arrived.
The girl was even happier while the other three young people beside them all twitched their mouths.
When they first heard Bei Chenxing telling about a secret hidden in this land of mission, all of their eyes lit up. It was not because of the secret itself but the potential of the secret in attracting more peerless experts over. This would simplify their jobs in completing the mission.
However, when they saw the powerful Bei Chenxing being killed in the end, all of them were shocked. They only heaved a sigh of relief when they saw Jiang Ming’s condition.
“This guy is a monster!” The purple-clad young man commented, “If it wasn’t for today’s skirmish, even if we finally emerge victorious, I’m afraid more than half of us including all of the other teams would end up with deaths and casualties. If we went in on our own, we would without a doubt die in vain.”
“It’s no wonder 30 teams descended to this land together!” The girl was also surprised and then smiled, “However, it’s really wonderful that a Great Overarching expert has sacrificed himself for our mission. Anyway, could there be other experts that are as strong as him there, boss?”
“I don’t think so. Otherwise, our mission would simply be meaningless!” the purple-clad young man put his hands behind his back, confident as though everything was within his hand, “If there are, why didn’t they appear when that young man fought against the Great Overarching expert? Besides, there’s another Great Overarching expert itching to have a go around here. Also, look at how miserable the young man’s condition was after killing that Great Overarching expert. It was almost equivalent to self-destructing. Therefore, I conclude that there is only one such monstrous existence on the land ahead. It’s a pity that such a genius would be falling to his demise today.”
“Hehe! Boss, we have killed many geniuses, haven’t we?” The young girl smiled, “Now then. Do we still need to join forces with the other teams before we make our move?”
“That’s no longer necessary. If we join forces, they will drag us down instead. We need to act on our own now and kill the person ourselves. Once we kill him, our evaluation points will definitely be very high.” As the purple-clad young man commented, he suddenly frowned.
The young lady as well as the other three frowned as well. It was because a side quest had suddenly appeared in all of their minds: Hunt down the beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall.
And they would discover the beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall when they approached a certain range. Moreover, the rewards were also generous.
As the five of them looked over not far away, a few people over there looked back at them at the same time. Invisible murderous intent suddenly emerged.
“Boss!” The young girl called out.
“Complete the main mission first!” The purple-clad young man thought for a while before making a decision, “Let’s go!”
He had already seen Beiming Hai rushing towards the Tianyuan World.
The five of them turned into streaks of light as they sped onwards.
As for the few people not far away, they breathed a sigh of relief. After all, that purple-clad young man was too strong and was clearly in the Taiyi Realm.
Meanwhile, there were an unknown number of experts flying towards Tianyuan World.
…
Jiang Ming had his arms around his Junior Sister as they looked at Beiming Hai who rushed over. He was smiling but his smile was extremely cold.
“Senior Brother, I’ll kill him!” Linglong’s voice was soft and firm.
“Delivered to your doorstep for you to kill!” Jiang Ming replied.
“Kill me? Haha…!” As Beiming Hai rushed over, he quickly discovered the Chuyang Peak of Jiuyang Sect with just a glance. He locked his focus on Jiang Ming and rushed over thousands of miles away in just a snap of a finger. He overheard the conversation between the two as well.
“You are already severely injured after killing Bei Chenxing and are only pretending to look like you’ve fully recovered yourself. Yet you still want to kill me?” Beiming Hai slowly paced his way over, directly entering the vicinity of Jiuyang Sect, passing through the array formation indifferently.
He took a glance at the formation array and sneered, “To think that such a gruff formation array exists. This really widened my knowledge!”
“Beiming Hai!” Jiang Ming yelled as he flicked his sleeves, changing the surroundings of Tianyuan World.
…
Around the edges, white fogs rolling and flames bursting out. Sword slashes were shot around, tearing through the sky.
Special abilities were evoked, shattering the earth, causing the entire Tianyuan World at the verge of collapsing.
This made the Lord God Space’s beneficiary who was initially hesitant, squinted his eyes and rushed over.
It was obvious to him that the battle inside was a fierce one. Moreover, the target of the mission was obviously at a disadvantage now. Otherwise, how could he not be able to protect his own home? That was why the beneficiary had to be quick or this visit would all be in vain.
However, just as he stepped into the white fog, his body froze and he was imprisoned in an instant. He was then silently transferred over to the Fifth Immortal Moon.
“Another one!” The Fifth Immortal Moon smiled and without hesitation, stabbed the opponent’s forehead with a sword, directly destroying his primal spirit. In an instant, a mass of air emerged from the corpse and flew into her body. As she cycled through her cultivation technique, her aura began to skyrocket.
This was the reward, to be able to absorb one-fifth of the cultivation base of the hunted target without any side effects.
However, the origin essence did not appear after the death of the Lord God Space’s beneficiary. It was unknown if this was because of the Infinite Realm Battlefield or because this place was already affiliated with the great chiliocosm.
…
Standing on top of Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was very calm as he looked at Beiming Hai who was walking over, “If it wasn’t because of your father’s reputation, how can a person who is as arrogant, despicable and sinful as you survived until today!”
“You actually know me? This is unexpected. Really unexpected.” Beiming Hai was stunned for a while before cracking out a loud laugh, “Haha! Even if I don’t rely on my father’s power, I am still a powerful Great Overarching expert. Looking through the infinite realms, I stop on top of heavens! I have the strength and the power. Naturally, I can do what I want!”
Pausing for a moment, he turned his gaze over to Linglong, and his eyes flashed with astonishment, “Tsk tsk tsk! This little lady is stunning. Today, I will slaughter your sect and decimate all the living beings on this piece of land. However, for the sake of this little lady who lit up my eyes, I’ll give the two of you a chance!”
“You! Little boy! Kneel down immediately and bark like a dog!”
“You! Young lady! Take off your clothes and dance for me on this balcony. If it makes me happy, I’ll make you two my slaves and let you be the two dogs by my side!”
Bei Minghai was arrogant and domineering. He didn’t have the attitude that a Great Overarching Golden Immortal should possess. Instead, he was more vicious than a villain. “Otherwise, you two shall die today! All of you shall die!”
“To think that there’s such a Great Overarching Golden Immortal in this world. This really widened my knowledge!” Jiang Ming sighed softly as he was also full of emotion.
Before he met him, he looked forward to it; but now that he had seen him, it just made him sick.
“The heavens won’t be able to stand it if you don’t die!” As Jiang Ming muttered, he raised his hand and pressed down forward, shouting, “Kneel before me!” His words were embedded with the power of laws, causing even the sky to tremble.
“Asking me to kneel? Haha! You really are courageous! You might still stand a chance against me if you haven’t fought Bei Chenxing before this. But now…” The sarcastic look on Beiming Hai’s face remained before he could not move one bit. The very next moment, his face turned into shock.
“What did you do to me? Why can’t I move?” Beiming Hai felt a terrifying pressure that was attacking him from all directions.
Not only was he unable to move, the terrifying power caused his body to bend and he was about to kneel.
“Forcing me to kneel? To kneel before you feeble ants? You shall die! You shall all die!” Beiming Hai’s face was distorted as he roared, “Mystical Arcane Halberd! Evoke!”
A halberd’s tip appeared on top of his head and instantly, a wave of force that could destroy worlds as well as all laws and principles erupted, trying to break through confinements and destroy the vast void
However, an invisible force surged out in the very next moment and suppressed the tip of the halberd back into Beiming Hai’s body.
“How is this possible? My father used the Mystical Arcane Jade formed during the birth of the heavens and earth, coupled with boundless rare treasures and took tens of millions of years to forge this Quasi-Sage weapon! When I was bestowed this halberd upon entering the Great Overarching Realm, I could even compete with the pinnacle Great Overarching expert with this halberd! How could it be unable to break through this suppression?” Beiming Hai’s face was filled with disbelief.
Bang…
Finally unable to bear the suppression, two of his legs bent and he finally knelt mid-air. Wildly trying to fight back against the suppression, all seven of his orifices were bleeding. Meanwhile, explosive sounds could be heard coming from his flesh and bones within his body.
The disciples of Jiuyang Sect seemed to have not noticed anything amiss and continued doing what they were supposed to, completely unaffected by the whole ordeal.
Obviously, Jiang Ming mobilized the Saint Province Dao Square’s power to block off their senses.
“Damn it! All of you are damned! You made me kneel!” Beiming Hai’s scarlet red eyes almost fell out as he continued struggling frantically, roaring and cursing out loud, “No! I will keep you two alive! I’ll keep you two alive forever! Even if the stars fall and the earth sinks into the abyss, even if the world ends and everything returns to nothingness, I will make sure the two of you live and enjoy all the torments of the world!”

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - Attack of the Quasi-Sage, Pummel Everyone to the Ground (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Attack of the Quasi-Sage, Pummel Everyone to the Ground (Part 1)
Jiang Ming could not help laughing when he saw Beiming Hai’s furious yet powerless look.
“You’re still thinking of torturing us for hundreds of millions of years?” He shook his head and handed the Great Overarching Dao Weapon, the Infinite Star Sword, over to Junior Sister, “Girl, it’s yours!”
At the same time, he stretched out his hands and grabbed mid-air. The tip of a halberd could be seen emerging out of Beiming Hai’s body. It was the Mystical Arcane Halberd, a Quasi-Sage weapon.
“You…You…You can even force out my Dao Vessel?” Beiming Hai’s look completely changed.
A Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel inside a person’s body could practically recover almost all of a person’s energy. To force the Dao Vessel out like that! What tyrannical power! It was simply impossible! Even his father might not be able to do so.
“Who exactly are you?” Beiming Hai finally felt fear looming in his heart and no longer looked as arrogant as before. It was now that he finally understood that this person in front of him had been acting, and faking his weakness the whole time.
“Someone who wants to kill you!” As Jiang Ming replied, he grasped firmly in front of him and the Mystical Arcane Halberd was seen flying out while trembling violently. However, it could not break free from the restraint.
“Destroy!” With a single point of his finger, an immeasurable divine might entered the battle halberd. Coupled with the absurd power from the Saint Province Dao Square, the imprint was completely wiped from the halberd.
Beiming Hai opened his mouth, spatting out a mouthful of fresh blood with a face that looked like he had seen a ghost.
Junior Sister was already in front of him. Flicking the Infinite Star Sword, she cut off both Beiming Hai’s hands and feet. She then wielded the sword, cut open his head, forcing his primal spirit out of his body.
A strand of flame emerged from the sword tip and was directly penetrated into his primal soul. It caused Beiming Hai to bawl miserably in excruciating pain.
Jiang Ming no longer paid his attention to him. He turned his eyes looking afar and locked on to someone.
That person was a beneficiary of the Lord God. The power contained in his body was not weaker than Beiming Hai and yet that person was only at the Taiyi Realm.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming let out a smile.
As he raised his hand and pressed onwards, he saw the purple-clad young man that had just arrived, frozen in place with a shocked look on his face.
It was then that the youth realized all four of his teammates had disappeared. A moment later, their signs of life were completely gone and their names in the system turned gray.
They were dead!
“What the hell is going on here?” The purple-clad young man was shocked but quickly calmed himself down, “Nothing changed here and there isn’t any ripple from a great battle here as well. I am imprisoned while my teammates are killed. There’s only one possibility. This is a trap and the opponent knows in and out about us!”
After quick reasoning, he was horrified. He knew he could not wait any longer nor hold back anymore.
Whoosh…
A mass torrent of energy exploded in his body as a pagoda rushed out from the top of his head. All of a sudden, countless stands of golden lights were shining out of it with great divine power.
The Pagoda had nine levels and it seemed as though there was a great world hidden inside which was so profound that it could even crush the ancient times. This allowed the purple-clad young man to move his body slightly.
“This here is the Nine Level Golden Pagoda, a level 17 supreme Dao soldier that I risked my life obtaining. Its ability to suppress anything has protected me all this while, which led to who I am today. But now, even after this treasured pagoda has been evoked, it still fails to break me free from these shackles.” The purple-clad young man had a face filled with disbelief. He was becoming more and more uneasy and the death aura looming in the air was making him breathless.
“Damn it!” The purple-clad young man gritted his teeth, opened his third eye between his eyebrows, and spurted out a black light that ripped apart the void in front of him. Just as he was about to flee from the scene, he was blocked off at the very next moment.
“Such a terrifying gaze!” The person who appeared was none other than Jiang Ming.
As Beiming Hai was already dismembered by his Junior Sister, Jiang Ming knew the place was rendered safe and sound now. Therefore, paced over midair heading towards the young man.
Jiang Ming never expected this beneficiary of the Lord God to be this strong. Putting aside the fact that he had a Quasi-Sage Dao vessel with him, this third eye that he had just evoked actually even shook the power of the Saint Province Dao Square. Truly unimaginable!
“It’s you!” The purple-clad young man recognized Jiang Ming at first sight. “All of this was a trap? You pretended everything to lure us in so that you can deal with all of us in one go?”
Jiang Ming nodded. Then he lifted his hand, and grasped it with his palm. The imprisoned Nine Level Golden Pagoda struggled before falling into his palm. After a while, the Dao Vessel was completely quiet.
The purple-clad young man opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood. It was Jiang Ming who erased his imprint on the pagoda.
Whoosh!
At the same time, Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record.
Name: Zi Guang
Race: Holy Spirit (Innately jadeite)
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Level 15 (Taiyi Golden Immortal)
Background: Forbidden area of Purple Mountain in the Thousand Stars Middle Chiliocosm (Note: Beneficiary of the Lord God Space, Captain of Purple Flame Clan)
Relationship: -99
Innate ability: Quasi-Sage
Status
: Originally an innate jade from a forbidden place in Thousand Stars Middle Chiliocosm, he had long formed a spiritual soul of his own and was given birth after absorbing the blood of thirty over Great Overarching Golden Immortal, becoming an innate Holy Spirit.
: Born with great special ability, he was able to open a third eye that could shoot out destructive light of boundless might.
: Growing rapidly, he was nurtured by other holy spirits at the forbidden land in Purple Mountain, slowly becoming vain and arrogant.
: In one of his journeys coming out of the mountain where he challenged all the people throughout, he was beaten miserably and was almost dismembered for it. After he was lucky enough to survive the ordeal, he was invited by the Lord God to become a beneficiary.
: Having seen the different wonders of the Heavenly Infinite Realms, he gradually became mature and developed into a cautious character.
: Descended into a great chiliocosm on a mission, he obtained the Nine Level Golden Pagoda after narrowly escaping death that helped to forge a strong foundation for himself.
: He accidentally obtained yet another rare treasure, the Orb of Destruction. It contains the origin of destruction that was comparable with a Quasi-Sage Dao vessel. Integrating it into his third eye allowed his innate special ability to reach an unimaginable level.
: He then took on the next mission to destroy a certain land. For him, who has destroyed several worlds in the past, it was nothing special to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - Attack of the Quasi-Sage, Pummel Everyone to the Ground (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Attack of the Quasi-Sage, Pummel Everyone to the Ground (Part 2)
Status: After completing this mission, he was prepared to retreat into cultivation and trying breaking through into the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm and peek into the essence of the Lord God Space.
: He heard that after reaching the Great Overarching Realm, once the person passes the assessment, he can ascend to an even higher leveled land of origin.
…
The purple-clad young man’s ‘Status’ was simple, yet unusual at the same time.
He was an innate Holy Spirit and obtained two great encounters for a Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel? And he was preparing to break through to the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm after completing the mission? What a genius!
Jiang Ming sighed secretly. Unfortunately, Zi Guang was the enemy and his fate was destined for coming over here.
‘If he is a Great Overarching Golden Immortal, with such immeasurably peerless innate talent coupled with two Quasi-Sage Dao vessels, he may be able to shake off from the power of Saint Province Dao Square and has a slight hope of escaping!’
As Jiang Ming thought to himself, his finger was inserted deep in between the young man’s eyebrows, digging out the third eye. He did not intent to answer the young man’s question at all
Zi Guang screamed in despair with immense hatred, “How did you find out about our identities? Damn it! You wanted to kill all of us in one go! The existence behind us will definitely bring you to ashes! You will die a painful death!”
Jiang Ming ignored him totally and with a wave of his hand, he teleported the young man over to the Fifth Immortal Moon to temporarily suppress him.
There were also other Taiyi experts that were held captive as well. It was obvious that they were prepared to kill them last.
The Fifth Immortal Moon’s cultivation base had already reached the peak of Golden Immortal.
“Alas, there isn’t anyone that can put up a fight!”
Jiang Ming raised his hand and killed the Reincarnation Hall beneficiaries who came here as well and even got himself a dozen of Great Overarching Dao Vessels.
Currently, the Fifth Immortal Moon was the last Reincarnation Hall beneficiary who descended into the Tianyuan World.
Jiang Ming raised his head and looked up at the sky. It was as if he could see the Reincarnation Hall which gave him a weird feeling. Suppressing his thoughts, he turned around and returned to Chuyang Peak.
Beiming Hai was still howling miserably.
“Have you let go?” Jiang Ming placed his Junior Sister in his arms and kissed her on the forehead.
“I’ve let go of it and the knot to my heart has been completely unraveled as well.” Linglong gave a bright smile, “My cultivation base has also improved. Neither Great Overarching experts nor the Quasi-Sage experts can stop me now!”
“Haha! As expected of the girl I raised!” Jiang Ming laughed.
Linglong leaned on his shoulder.
“Senior Brother, what about these three?”
“They are quite an eyesore. How about we kill them?”
“Alright! Keeping them around is an eyesore indeed.”
“Then let’s return them to ashes, and we prepare ourselves to welcome a new world, a new life, and a new future!” Jiang Ming said, and with a wave of his hand, the soul remnants of Bei Chenguang and Xue Tao were annihilated.
“What about him?” Linglong pointed to the remnant soul of Beiming Hai, “Are you worried that killing him might attract the old monster Kunpeng?”
“Yeah!” Jiang Ming pondered, “Once we kill him, I’m afraid that old thing will be able to sense it happening. If he comes here, I may not be able to stop him.”
“You’re right! There is a connection between the bloodline. We’ll definitely alert that old thing once we kill him.”
“Then let’s keep him captive for now, till we’re confident...” Jiang Ming paused and shook his head helplessly, “That old thing, I’m afraid he is rushing over here.”
“He’s coming?” Linglong’s pupils shrank, and her eyes blinked continuously, “Even if you don’t kill, I am afraid that through the connection between their bloodline, he might be able to sense Beiming Hai’s condition. Based on the traces from the past, he will definitely find this place. He is at the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm, I can’t fight against him. Senior Brother, how confident are you against him?”
“Middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm? Jiang Ming frowned, “Thirty percent!”
“Thirty percent? That’s too little!” Linglong had an imposing look on her face, “Senior brother, aren’t you following the path of World’s Dao? Let’s just put all the people of the Eastern Region into your inner world, or into my Maps of Mountains and Rivers, and then we leave. It takes at least a day to rush here from the Heavenly Realm, even for the middle stage Quasi-Sage expert. One day is enough time for us to hide.”
Jiang Ming shook his head in disagreement.
He asked the system and found out that once Chuyang Peak was taken into the Inner World or a spatial artifact, the daily rewards would be cut off and the accumulation would disappear.
He would have to find a new place and start all over again in the future.
‘How could I choose such an option?’
Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed, flickering like light.
He called up the Human Path Record to check on Kunpeng’s Status.
: At the critical juncture of his cultivation retreat, he suddenly felt something in his heart as it skipped a beat and his blood vessels trembled. It almost caused him to go into qi deviation, hence he hurried out of his retreat.
: He knew that his son Beiming Hai had met with an accident.
: He felt even more shocked when he realized that the imprint left on his son had disappeared.
: Having calculated the past whereabouts of Beiming Hai, he found that his son disappeared on the Infinite Realm Battlefield. He left quickly without any hesitation after preparing himself.
: Whoever dared to lay their hand on my son, ruining my plans, I will crush you to ashes regardless of who you are.
: He plans on going on a killing spree one day later.
…
This was no different from Linglong’s judgment.
“Senior Brother, it’s better to stay alive to fight the battle another day. Leaving with the people of the Eastern Region won’t be any loss.” Linglong said again, “Give me 100 years, and I will kill Kunpeng by then!”
“No!” Jiang Ming still shook his head, “Once I leave, the loss to me would be too great. This is not a choice! Is one day enough? It is!”
Turning his eyes, he looked at the Fifth Immortal Moon, who was outside of Jiuyang Sect.
Beside her were more than ten Taiyi Golden Immortals who were held captive and the spoils she has collected, were countless immortal Dao weapons and soldiers, as well as immortal crystals and divine stones piled into hills. There were even immortal crystal ore veins, various Immortal medicine and spiritual beads.
“The many treasures of these geniuses are enough for me to enrich my foundation!”
Jiang Ming stretched out his hand to grab them, transferring the Immortal crystals and other objects into his inner world.
The Dao vessels were not quite up to his standards, but he still took a lot.
“Immortal Moon, kill them all and break through!” Jiang Ming transmitted his voice over to the Fifth Immortal Moon.
“Yes, Master!” After the Fifth Immortal Moon responded, she proceeded to slaughter all the Lord God beneficiaries that were in front of her. In an instant, a terrifying energy melded into her body.
She hurriedly sat down and cycled through her cultivation technique. She quickly absorbed the energy with the assistance of the Reincarnation Hall’s system. At the same time, she drifted into a state of enlightenment and started comprehending the Taiyi Dao.
Without any shackles limiting her, she quickly ascended into a higher realm.
The whole situation was simply incredible. If the Fifth Immortal Moon did not have the help of the Reincarnation System, she would have exploded and died long ago. However, she made it through well.
Upon assessing the situation over there, Jiang Ming couldn’t help nodding his head and turned to look at his Junior Sister, “Give me half a day or at most one day! I’ll return by then. I’ll show you how powerful your Senior Brother is then!”
“Senior Brother, I want to see how powerful you are right now. I’m just afraid you won’t be able to withstand it first!” Linglong said softly.
“Humph!” Jiang Ming patted his waist, “Don’t worry! Next time, I will be able to stand exercising for even 100,000 years. I’m just afraid you’ll be begging for mercy then!”
Linglong rolled his eyes, full of amorous feelings. Meanwhile, she felt a warm feeling surging inexplicably though her heart causing her to be a little restless.
“I’m leaving now. Take care of our home!” Jiang Ming muttered.
“Don’t you worry, Senior Brother!” Linglong nodded firmly, but hurriedly continued, “Wait for just a moment!”

chapters.title: Chapter 240
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Group Members Are Speechless
In the Supreme Pagoda...
Jiang Ming did not waste his time after coming here. He came straight to the Dao Enlightenment Sea. He activated the time acceleration and sat down in a lotus position to digest the information his junior sister told him before they parted ways.
Those were some basic information the True Illusion Linglong had gotten about the Heavenly Realm as well as the Infinite Realms Battlefield.
The Honggu World was vast. The Heavenly Realm situated at the top of the chain with the Heavenly Court leading everything. Sitting on the throne, the Great Heavenly Venerate governed everything from one end to the other, exerting his influence and power while transforming the Honggu World into a complete universe.
Further downward were the middle chiliocosms, small chiliocosms, and a myriad of planar worlds that floated amongst the depth of the surge of time and space.
After the Great Heavenly Venerate seized the throne, he created the Infinite Realms Battlefield to divert the conflict. The Infinite Realms Battlefield was split into several levels. The low level battlefield was for experts until the Golden Immortal Realm. The middle level battlefield was for experts until the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, while the highest level battlefield was the place for Quasi-Sages to fight against each other.
The Tianyuan Realm belonged to the middle level battlefield category.
Judging from the rules, a Quasi-Sage was not allowed to enter, but who was Kunpeng? He was the Northern Great Emperor of the Heavenly Court, who was also known as the Black Emperor. He was an ancient being who had full authority and had too many excuses and reasons to be able to forcefully descend to the middle level battlefield.
In the Heavenly Realms, experts from the human race consisted of the majority. However, they were like a plate of loose sand. They did not join forces and they were split into different clans and Heavenly Courts. Otherwise, the Great Heavenly Venerate would not be happy about it.
Other than that, there were other sects such as the Fo Sect, the Dragon Race, the demon race, the Riyue Sect, and so on. To put it simply, the Heavenly Court had absolute dominance.
Nobody would have the guts to ignore an order given by the Heavenly Emperor, but how about in private? That was a different story.
This was what was happening at the macro level in the Honggu world.
The Great Heavenly Venerate wouldn’t care even if they kill each other in the Infinite Realms Battlefield.
Another thing was the antagonistic relationship between immortals and demons under the Great Heavenly Venerate.
It was safe to say that the demons from the abyss were the common enemy of many forces in the Heavenly Realm. It was a fight on a grand level. The Great Heavenly Venerate also gave them the permission to go into the abyss and slaughter the demons.
There was more killing from private feuds or war between clans on the lower level.
After Jiang Ming had dissolved all of the information, he went into his inner world and refined all the treasures or spiritual objects such as immortal crystals and great stars he obtained from killing those geniuses into the nourishment for his inner world.
He split part of his mind into promoting the evolution of the inner world to speed up the refine process, while activating the Dao Enlightenment Mode to comprehend the Golden Immortal Law.
Comprehending the Golden Immortal Law was a lot harder than comprehending the Mystical Immortal Law.
The good thing was that he could activate the Dao Enlightenment Mode, and ten thousand years flashed by in the blink of an eye.
When Jiang Ming heard the notification, he opened his eyes.
“Even though I’ve activated the Dao Enlightenment Mode, I only managed to comprehend a small amount of the Golden Immortal. Although the origin force of my inner world has become a lot stronger, I still have a long way to go. Sigh! The Inner World Dao is really a hard path to take on!” Jiang Ming sighed.
If he went on the orthodox cultivation path, he would’ve achieved the Quasi-Sage level by now.
“Since I’ve exhausted my resources, it would only do me no good if I continue to comprehend the Golden Immortal Law. After all, improving the origin force is a slow process. The law is the framework, while the origin force is the foundation. If the framework is strong enough, but the origin force is lacking, the whole inner world would collapse. It’s only when they complement each other can they function perfectly,” Jiang Ming sighed.
“Resources!”
Something flitted his head and he quickly pulled out the Supreme Order.
“System, if I trade an item with my group members, will you notify me if the item contains, let’s say, a tracking item or device?”
“Sir, I’ll remove all the marks on the trade items. However, please take note that some items are connected to each other. For example, the mother-son talisman, or the Yin-yang Sword!”
It was only then the understanding dawned upon Jiang Ming.
The chat group was quiet, and it was normal.
[Jiang Ming: I need advanced grade immortal veins, origin essence, Xuanhuang Origin Essence, Chaos Vital Essence, and World’s Heart to name a few. Do you guys have it? I’m willing to exchange them with you for points.]
[Ao Long: These are the items that you need? CanI assume that you’re cultivating the World Dao? Judging from your battle prowess, if you can get all the items that you need, you’re bound to achieve something great in the future!]
[Di Huo: That’s right! It’s just that these items are high grade materials in cultivation, so it’s hard for me to get them on my hands in such a short amount of time. Do you need it right now? If you can wait for me, I’ll go destroy a few worlds now to get the World’s Heart for you!]
[Ao Jiu: Xiao Huo Huo, how could you do that? You can’t just destroy a world to get its heart, it’s against the laws!]
[Di Huo: I might believe it if a human told me that it’s against the laws for me to do it, but you… Hah!]
[Ao Long: How dare you! That’s prejudice!]
[Hong Yi: Can you two please stop it? Admin, I have an advanced grade immortal vein that costs 10,000 points based on the price of past transactions in the group. For 1,000 points, you’ll be able to listen to the Dao once. The Daos are given by supreme existences at the Saint Lord Level. The benefits of listening to Dao are much greater than enlightenment. It could give you a direct guide on which path you should take on in the future, or help you to break through your bottlenecks. Are you sure you want to trade?]
[Jiang Ming: Yes, please! I have a lot of points to spend! I’m sorry, Di Huo, I’m in urgent need of these items, so I can’t wait for you!]
[Hong Yi: I don’t know about you guys, but I have the urge to hit someone!]
[Ao Long: Me too!]
[Di Huo: Me too! What a shame. This is such a great opportunity to earn some points.]
[Huang Quan: Yeah. All of us are so short of points that we don’t even dare to use the time acceleration feature, and now you are telling us that you have too many points?]
[Tian Fozi: D*mn it! I knew I shouldn’t have come to the chat group!]
[Feng Wu: I’m speechless!]
[Ming Fei: Me too!]
Most of the people in the group did not have the things that Jiang Ming needed. Besides, even if they had the items, they would’ve used them themselves first to increase their cultivation level.
In the end, Jiang Ming only obtained one advanced grade immortal vein from Hong Yi.
10,000 points were nothing for Jiang Ming, but other than Hong Yi or Hong Zhan, no one in the group could spend 10,000 points in one go.
“I just need to spend some points to get so many good items…” Jiang Ming said, “It’s really good to be an expert. However, I’m afraid that I can’t evolve the origin of the inner world to its limit with these items only.” Jiang Ming frowned.
[Jiang Ming: Guys, is that all?]
[Ao Long: We can give you more if you give us some time!]
[Di Huo: Yeah. We need time to collect these items! ]
[Hong Yi: If you’re cultivating the World Dao, immortal crystal, divine stone, spiritual grasses, supreme medicines, and so on could be of use to you too.]
[Huang Quan: Admin, I have a lot of demonic crystals!]
[Di Huo: I have plenty of Sun Crystal Mountains!]
[Xu Wuji: I have an immortal fluid river here!]
[Ao Long: I have quite a lot of low grade water immortal veins here.]
[Di Huo: What do you think, admin? Do you want it? I’m living in the sun of a great chiliocosm, and I have plenty of Sun Crystals here.]
[Jiang Ming: Alright! I want it all!]
Jiang Ming was delighted. Initially, he just wanted to get the highest grade of materials, but he changed his mind after Hong Yi told him that he could use other items to boost his inner world. The only downside was that it might take more time.
[Hong Yi: I’ve mastered a special ability known as the Holy Civilization Fist by fusing many cultivations and laws. The more civilizations are fused, the stronger the power of the special ability. Of course, you can fuse laws into it as well, so do you want it?]
[Jiang Ming: I have something similar too. It can merge 3,000 laws into one to perform a powerfull attack. Do you want it?]
[Ao Long: Holy! These two people are flexing their special abilities!]
[Di Huo: D*mn it!]
[Huang Quan: That being said, I think our group admin’s special ability is stronger.
[Ao Long: As we all know, 3,000 laws are needed by a world to evolve everything, but our group admin could fuse all 3,000 laws into one special ability. Do you guys know how incredible that is?]
[Ao Long: Yeah! That’s really incredible. If our group admin could step into the Golden Immortal Realm, does this not mean that he could easily slay a Great Overarching?]
[Jiang Ming: I’m in the Mystical Immortal Realm, and I’ve already cleared the first stage of the sixth battle tower!]
[Ao Long: D*mn! I’m speechless!]
[Hong Yi: Monster!]
[Di Huo: In the name of the sun, I declare you as the strongest!]
[Feng Wu: As expected of the man who becomes the admin for two groups!]
[Ming Fei: One will need to go up against a Great Overarching Golden Immortal at the first stage of the sixth battle tower, and you’ve already cleared it even though you’re just in the Mystical Immortal Realm? Admin, I’m really speechless right now.]
[Jiang Ming: Well, it’s nothing impressive. After I’ve entered the Golden Immortal Realm, I’ll try and see if I can clear the sixth battle tower or not. But I think I won’t stand a chance if I try to go through the seventh battle tower.]
The rest of the group members were tongue-tied.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - A Perfect World, Yun Feiyan, 100,000 Years Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: A Perfect World, Yun Feiyan, 100,000 Years Later
Jiang Ming had gotten quite a lot of good items in an hour. He also had given one of his special abilities to Hong Yi in exchange for his Holy Civilization Fist.
However, what surprised him the most was a strange special ability known as Sacrificial Artifact Judgment he got from Huang Quan. It was expensive and cost him 1,000 points.
According to Huang Quan, he got this special ability by chance from the Saint Province Dao Square. Although it cost a lot to use this special ability, it was powerful.
After Jiang Ming had dissolved the information, he seemed rather excited. “The Sacrificial Artifact Judgment huh? Isn’t this just for me?”
Everything was ready, and all he needed right now was an opportunity.
Jiang Ming activated the time acceleration mode and started his cultivation again.
It was still very lively inside the Supreme Immortal Chat Group
[Hong Yi: Ever since I joined this chat group, this is the first time I come across a group admin like him. He’s so generous in giving out his points!]
[Huang Quan: Yeah. He’s so generous that he doesn’t feel like a human at all!]
[Di Huo: Hey! Watch your words! How can you say our group admin isn’t a human?]
[Huang Quan: Please don’t get me wrong. All human experts normally lead a frugal life, but our group admin is the opposite. That’s why I said he doesn’t feel like a human at all. In other words, I’m complimenting his generosity.]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha! You can’t blame us for misunderstanding you, Huang Quan. Your comment is just simply too misleading. Besides, what happens if we still have some points left when we’re leaving the Supreme Pagoda? Will it get removed?]
[Hong Yi: Nope. From what I understand, appropriate compensation will be given, or you can consume all the points in the Supreme Pagoda before leaving.]
[Tian Fozi; That makes the points even more precious.]
[Hong Yi: Indeed. Points are precious. Once we’re dead, the points will be gone forever. You can’t pass it to another person.]
[Ao Long: You should be grateful that the Supreme Pagoda still gives you the chance to spend your points. By the way, is it true that our group admin has cleared the first stage of the sixth battle tower? I found it hard to believe. After all, it’s just impossible!]
[Tian Fozi: You’re right. It’s impossible for a Mystical Immortal to defeat a Great Overarching. Is the World Dao really that powerful?]
[Hong Yi: If I were you, I wouldn’t use the word powerful. If you want to describe it with a word, I would say miraculous is more appropriate. However, it’s not that easy to cultivate the World Dao. Even though our group admin is a genius himself, I’m afraid he’ll be stuck at the small chiliocosm for at least a few billion years before he has a slight chance of breaking through to the next level.]
[Hong Yi: Everything has its pros and cons, and when you pick one thing, you have to discard the other. Although evolving the inner world is hard, it could make the cultivator far more powerful than the cultivators of the same level. Besides, once the inner world has reached a certain stage, there will be no more shackles for realm advancement. Take our group admin as an example. He could ascend straight from the Heavenly Immortal Realm to the peak stage of the Golden Immortal Realm if his inner world has evolved into a small chiliocosm. All living things in the inner world would be born as the Golden Immortal, so can you imagine how vast his origin force will be?]
[Hong Yi: Besides, once his inner world evolves into the middle chiliocosm, it could bring him into the Saint Realm right away. At that time, nothing can stop him anymore.]
[Wang Ye: I tried to cultivate the World Dao, but I gave up right away after I learned about it. The resources needed to form a planar world or evolving a planar world to a small chiliocosm is tremendous, let alone evolving a small chiliocosm into a great chiliocosm. Even though our group admin has gotten a lot of items from us, I assume that those items can only bring his inner world to the peak of the small chiliocosm. If those items are given to any one of us, we will definitely be able to step into the Quasi-Sage Realm.]
[Ao Long: That’s why our group admin is a genius. I’m so jealous of him. Not only is he a genius, but even the Supreme Pagoda is helping him.]
[Di Huo: Yeah, you’re right. Don’t forget that he has mastered a powerful special ability that can fuse all 3,000 laws together. People always say that God is fair when He’s creating us, but why is He giving all the good things to our group admin? This isn’t fair at all!]
[Hong Yi: Indeed, his special ability is powerful, and there’s a chance that it’s even stronger than my Holy Civilization Fist. If I can incorporate the special ability into my fist technique, my combat prowess will be improved by leap and bound!]
[Wang Ye: Hong Yi, I’m afraid your Cultivation Dao is still inferior compared to our group admin’s World Dao. After all, if there isn’t a world, there will not be a civilization. Our group admin has fused the 3,000 fundamental laws that make up everything in the world, putting aside its strength, no special ability can be compared to its when it comes to inclusivity!]
[Hong Yi: I have to disagree with you! Although a special ability that incorporates all 3,000 laws is powerful, the 3,000 laws are the foundation of the world or the framework of the cycle of creation. If there is a foundation, then evolution, mutation, and so on will happen. There is one downside to his special ability. Every realm has its corresponding special ability. In other words, every time he ascends into the next realm, he has to start working on the special ability from scratch again. Even though he has the foundation and it doesn’t take much effort, he still has to start working on it again and reintegrate it, and the difficulties will just keep increasing.]
[Hong Yi: As for my Holy Civilization First, as long as I keep interpreting civilization, absorbing wisdom and fusing all kinds of civilization, it will keep upgrading. In terms of potential and power, it isn’t inferior to the group admin’s special ability.]
[Hong Yi: You need to think out of the box to see the whole picture.]
[Wang Ye: Thank you for the lesson.]
[Ao Long: Most of the geniuses are born from human races. Our group admin, Hong Yi, Xu Yuji, and Wang Ye… All of them are humans, and they’re one more talented than the other!]
[Tian Fozi: By the way! I’ve come across a strange woman, and I wonder if any of you know her or not. She’s a Taiyi Golden Immortal and she has defeated all Great Overarching she comes across, Even an expert who has just become a Quasi-Sage is no match for her. I’ve asked Buddha about her, and he told me that she’s a visitor from beyond the sky. Her name is Yun Feiyan.”
[Hong Yi: Buddha? He’s your master, right?]
[Tian Fozi: Yeah. He’s in the later stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm. If he said she’s a visitor from beyond the sky, it means she comes from another world.]
[Hong Yi: A visitor from beyond the sky? Does this mean that she comes here through the chaos? But no one can go through the chaos unharmed. I’m sure she must have someone backing her up, but why would he bring her to cross over the chaos and challenge all those Great Overarching? Is it because he’s training her? But this doesn’t seem right. If that’s their only goal, they don’t have to go through the chaos. After all, it has too much risk. Therefore, I can say that she comes from the Chaos Sea.]
[Hong Yi: If she really comes from there, maybe Hong Zhan will know about her. None of us have been there before, so we don’t know much about it. If she really can defeat a Quais-Sage while she herself is a Taiyi, then she’s truly powerful.]
[Tian Fozi: What kind of a place the Chaos Sea is?]
[Hong Yi: I assume that it’s a perfect world that surpasses the great chiliocosm.]
Inside the Supreme Pagoda.
One second, two seconds, three seconds. After ten seconds had passed, but it had been 100,000 years for Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming woke up from his cultivation and looked ahead blankly.
“An eternity in an instant!” Jiang Ming lamented coldly.
“100,000 years huh…” Jiang Ming mumbled.
He unlocked his sealed memory, but he did not know why he felt those memories did not belong to him. He knew it was not a good feeling, but at the same time, he felt it was normal.
He closed his eyes, and only opened his eyes again in another one hour.
“I almost have forgotten about my junior sister. Will I still be me if I forgot about her totally? But how could I forget about her?”
Jiang Ming rubbed the center of his forehead and came out of the Supreme Pagoda.
On Chuyang Peak, Linglong was standing on the balcony looking into the distance.
Suddenly, a bright light erupted and Jiang Ming appeared beside her.
“What…” Linglong was shocked. “Senior brother, you’ve only been gone for a while. Why are you back so soon?”
“Linglong!” Jiang Ming looked at her and frowned slightly.
The sense of familiarity was returning to him, but it was slow.
Linglong was stunned.
When there were only the two of them, her senior sister would either call her “girl” or “junior sister.” He seldom called her with her name, and that stirred up a bad feeling inside of her.
However, she also understood that this was the side effect of cultivating in seclusion for too long. He could barely remember his past, and he would slowly forget everything that happened between them. In the end, he would only immerse himself in the sea of Dao and cultivate.
“Come over here!” Linglong said as she snapped her finger and sealed the courtyard.
Her clones then came over. Their minds were connected, so they knew what Linglong wanted to do.
Standing around Jiang Ming, they took off their shirts.
Jiang Ming frowned, but he could feel a bolt of heat coursing through his nerves in his body.
“Girl, are you testing me?” Jiang Ming asked and smiled.
“This is not testing. This is just our ordinary daily activity!” Linglong chuckled.
Time Linglong sped up the time. One day was equivalent to a hundred day, and after half a day had passed, Jiang Ming laid on the rattan chair with his body shaking profusely.
Linglong was lying next to him.
“Girl, you nearly killed me!”
“Who told you to forget about me? Hmph! If you can’t recognize me, I’ll make your body recognize me!”
“Well, you did it!”
“Hehe! Senior brother, you told me that you’re going to do it for 100,000 years, but you can’t take it anymore after 70 or 80 years. I’m so disappointed.”
“Disappointed?” Jiang Ming hissed, “Can you see that I’m bleeding? If I do it for 100,000 years, you’re going to become a widow for the rest of your life! By the way, How can you be okay when I’m like this?”
“How can I be fine? Can’t you feel it?”
As both of them chatted, Jiang Ming slowly regained himself.
“Even though cultivation in seclusion for a long time can make one stronger, it can make one forget oneself gradually as well…” Jiang Ming lamented, “one might achieve enlightenment and turn into a Dao…”
“Yeah. This is what all experts in the Immortal Realm have to go through. Once one get too immersed into cultivation, they might achieve enlightenment and turn into a Dao without realizing it!” Linglong said in a serious manner, “Therefore, on the safe side, you should give yourself a deadline when you’re cultivating in seclusion in the future!”
“Don’t worry! I will! I won’t let the same thing happen to me again!”
“That’s great to hear. By the way, what have you achieved this time? Is it enough to go against Kunpeng? Linglong asked, “Judging from his speed, he should arrive here anytime.”

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - The Great Heavenly Venerate, Kunpeng Has Arrived Fighting against Kunpeng?
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: The Great Heavenly Venerate, Kunpeng Has Arrived Fighting against Kunpeng?
Honestly, he did not have any confidence in defeating Kunpeng.
After all, he was a Quasi-Sage as well as a divine beast from the legend. He had no idea how strong he was at all.
That being said, Jiang Ming felt he should be able to hold him off after he had evolved his inner world to the small chiliocosm final stage.
In the meantime, Jiang Ming also noticed something. He felt that, regardless of improving the origin of the inner world or comprehending the Golden Immortal Law, it was getting harder and harder toward the later stage.
Especially the law. He could comprehend 1/3 of it in the first 10,000 years, but the next two thirds took a whole 100,000 years.
“The good thing is that the result is pretty satisfactory!”
Jiang Ming’s cultivation had reached its limit, and he had mastered most of his special abilities.
Not only that, but he also had refined the three Quasi-Sage weapons such as Mystical Arcane Halberd, Nine Level Golden Pagoda, and Eye of Doom, and he could use them with practised ease.
He had done all the preparation, and he even had prepared for the worst case scenario.
“I wonder what the flesh of a Kunpeng tastes like?”
Jiang Ming thought of Beiming Hai. He was Kunpeng as well, but unfortunately, he had been crushed into smithereens by his junior sister.
“Let’s destroy his soul!” Jiang Ming said to his junior sister as he pointed at Beiming Hai, who was still wailing.
“Are you sure about that?” Linglong asked, “If we keep his soul, we might be able to stall Kunpeng for some time. However, if we destroy his son’s soul, considering his cultivation level as a Quasi-Sage, he will be able to pinpoint our location and come here straight away.”
“Just do it!” Jiang Ming said, “Today is a good day to end both him and his father’s reign once and for all!”
“Alright then!’ Linglong flicked her finger. A streak of sword light flew out of her finger and decimated Beiming Hai’s soul.
In the deluge of time and space.
Kunpeng, who was heading toward the Infinite Realms Battlefield, was stunned. His face sank, and an immense power erupted from his body.
“I can’t believe that they have the nerves to destroy my son’s soul! D*mn it! Unforgivable!” Kunpeng’s eyes turned bloodshot. “I should be the one to destroy and consume him. How dare they kill my son. How dare they steal my food! I don’t care who they are, I’m going to kill them all!”
He picked up his speed and headed beeline toward the Infinite Realms Battlefield.
On top of a mountain in the Infinite Realms Battlefield, there was an old man sitting in a lotus position. He looked toward the Tianyuan Sea with a worried expression etching on his face.
After that, he lifted his head and looked into the depths of time and space, the worried expression on his face grew deeper.
He rose to his feet and took a step forward. Just when the thing in front of him started to twist out of shape, he hesitated and stopped.
“Perhaps this is a good opportunity!”
The old man sat back down and closed his eyes.
In the Heavenly Court of the Heavenly Realm.
The Great Heavenly Venerate was still sitting on his throne, looking over the universe like what he had done for the past several billions of years.
There was a mirror hovering in front of him, showing everything that was happening in the Tianyuan Realm, or otherwise known as the Eastern Region in the past. It was just that he couldn’t see everything that was happening.
“Why are there so many secrets in such a tiny human world? Not to mention that it’s on the verge of destruction,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said, “I can’t see everything through my mirror at all.”
“What? How is that possible?” Star Lord Taibai exclaimed. When he saw the mist over the Tianyuan Realm on the mirror in front of the Great Heavenly Venerate, he thought he did not want to peer further.
Little did he expect that it was because the Great Heavenly Venerate couldn’t see through it, but how was that possible?
The World Monitoring Mirror could see through everything across the universe. It could even break through some of the formations laid out by some big clans, so how was there any possibility it couldn’t peer through a normal human world.
Star Lord Taibai did not know why but he suddenly felt a chill down his spine.
“Your majesty, could it be that he got his inheritance there?” Star Lord Taibai asked as he pointed.
“I guess so. Otherwise, I couldn’t figure out other reasons why I can’t peer through the world with the World Monitoring Mirror!” The Great Heavenly Venerate Said, “Kunpeng has already left Northern Emperor Palace and is heading toward the Infinite Realms Battlefield. If I’m not mistaken, his son should’ve been killed.”
“Seriously? That boy really has killed his son!” Star Lord Taibai frowned. “How bold! The Black Emperor is going to be mad. However, Your Majesty, there is one thing I don’t understand. Considering the Black Emperor’s cultivation level, he should’ve worked toward Saint Dao. Why would he give birth to a son, and help him in his cultivation? Also, as far as I know about him, he could’ve guided Beiming Hai toward a right, but he did not. Instead, he doted on him and turned Beiming Hai into an arrogant young man. What is he up to?”
“Even you also can’t figure it out?” The Great Heavenly Venerate smiled.
“I’ve given it a thought, but I dared not to think too much about it,’ Star Lord Taibai said. “Your Majesty, is he… Is he really going to do that?”
“The Black Emperor had sustained a serious inner injury once, and he hasn’t been able to recover from it since then. Therefore, he came up with an idea,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said, “He’s going to use his son to heal his injury. The reason he doted on him so much is that he wanted his son to grow up as soon as possible so that he could consume him when the time comes. He can deceive other people, but he can never deceive me. He’s also a Great Monarch from ancient times, and he’s notorious for his heartlessness and cruelty. He’s willing to do anything if it could benefit him.”
“How cruel!” Star Lord Taibai exclaimed, “Your Majesty, will that person be able to hold him off?”
“Does it matter?” The Great Heavenly Venerate, “It’s the best if he can kill the Black Emperor. After all, the Black Emperor has been a nuisance to the Heavenly Court for a long while. However, if he can’t get rid of the Black Emperor, it’s fine as well as we’ll be able to take a glimpse of the identity of the person behind him.”
Star Lord Taibai lowered his head.
“If he could stop the Black Emperor, then we…” he mumbled. An idea surfaced in his head as a bad feeling stirred his head.
Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming looked into the distance and he noticed that there were another two beneficiaries from the Lord God who hadn’t gotten into the Tianyuan Realm yet. Both of them were extremely powerful, and he wondered if they had sensed something so they decided not to come first.
There were three beneficiaries from the Reincarnation Hall who hadn’t entered the Tianyuan Realm too.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming said.
He turned around and looked toward the Fifth Immortal Moon.
She was in the process of breaking through, and she had become a lot more powerful than when she was here.
The sun was getting low. The sky was dyed red and it looked rather eerie.
The day was about to end, and most of the experts in the Infinite Realms Battlefield felt uneasy. They had a feeling that something bad was about to happen.
“Here he comes!”
Jiang Ming grabbed his junior sister and looked into the sky.
“He is here?” Linglong frowned. “Senior brother, let me test him out first!”
