“Do you have a death wish?” Jiang Ming said, “Just stay here. Remember, stay away from this battle. If not, I’ll punish you when I get back later.”
“Alright,” Linglong replied with a pout.
She understood that she was just going to drag Jiang Ming down if she joined the fight.
“If I can’t defeat him, take everyone with you into the Mountain River Map and go to the land of inheritance,” Jiang Ming said, “Then, you need to wait for at least a year before coming back!”
“Senior brother…” Linglong’s expression changed.
Jiang Ming grabbed her into his arms and landed a kiss on her forehead. “This is the worst possible plan. Even if I can’t defeat him, I have a way to escape, so you don’t have to worry about me.”
“Alright!” Linglong nodded.
At this moment, she blamed herself for being too weak. Her senior brother was going to fight against someone so strong, yet she couldn’t help him at all.
‘I have to work harder and try to get into the Great Overarching Realm as soon as possible after this. If not, I won’t sleep with my senior brother in the same room!’
Boom!
Suddenly, a terrifying power emerged from the sky, causing everything on the land to cower in fear.
Afterward, a man of a great stature and wearing a black robe appeared. His eyes were sharp as he looked at Jiang Ming and Linglong on Chuyang Peak.
“You’re the one who killed my son, right?” Kunpeng asked, his voice booming.
He was asking the question to Jiang Ming. After all, even though Linglong was powerful, she was just a Taiyi Golden Immortal. She might be able to fight on par with Beiming Hai, but she would never be able to kill him.
However, he couldn’t see through Jiang Ming’s cultivation level.
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming replied.
He patted his junior sister’s arm and stepped out of the mountain.
There was no way he could run away from this fight.
“Why do you want to kill him?” Kunpeng asked.
“He wanted to kill me, so of course, I have to kill him back,” Jiang Ming replied.
“What a good reason!” Kunpeng said, his voice cold. “Then you shouldn’t have any problem if I kill you today, right?”
“Of course!’ Jiang Ming replied as he summoned a halberd into his hand.
It was the Mystical Arcane Halberd, a Quasi-Sage Weapon, and it was forged by the Black Emperor himself.
Kunpeng squinted his eyes and asked, “Where is my son’s body?”
“I’ve crushed it!” Jiang Ming replied without any hesitation, “Since you have asked so many questions, may I ask you a few questions?”
“Of course, you can,’ Kunpeng laughed, but his smile did not reach his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - A Tragic Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: A Tragic Battle
Jiang Ming summoned the Human Paths Record.
It was hovering next to Jiang Ming, and he heaved out a sigh of relief when he realized that the Human Paths Record was invisible to Kunpeng.
He became even more curious about this wonderful item. It was just that he still couldn’t see through it until now.
He put the thought to the back of his mind and looked at Kunpeng’s status.
When Jiang Ming saw that their relationship was -99, he shook his head inwardly.
It seemed to him that there was no way he could talk him out of this.
Besides, he saw nothing special about his status. He just wanted to kill him in the most gruesome way, and then eliminate every living being on this land to vent his anger.
“Why are you called the Black Emperor?” Jiang Ming asked, “As far as I know, other than the Heavenly Emperor, there are four other emperors in the Heavenly Court. They are the Eastern Emperor, the Southern Emperor, the Western Emperor, and the Northern Emperor, which is you. I can understand why you’re called the Northern Emperor, but why the Black Emperor though?”
“Simple. The north represents water, while black means virtue for water. I was born in the land of the north where the mythical black sea is. I take the mythical black sea as my mother, so I named myself as the Black Emperor,” Kunpeng replied patiently.
He had a feeling that something was strange about this place. He couldn’t tell what was strange about it, but it was completely different from the world outside. It seemed like it was a forbidden land
It seemed like it was a forbidden land where a great power lay dormant, waiting for the right moment to unleash its wrath.
“Really? But why did I hear that you’re called the Black Emperor because your body is black in color?” Jiang Ming smiled, “Also, there is another way of saying that you’re called the Black Emperor because you have a black heart. Is that correct?”
The corner of Kunpeng’s lips lifted as murderous intent shot out from his eyes. “Any last word?”
“Last word? No, no, no, I think you still don’t get it yet. I’m not the one who’s going to die today, you are! So, let me ask you again. Do you have any last word?” Jiang Ming said, “Do you know what Beiming Hai said before he died?”
Kunpeng frowned, but he did not say anything.
“He said that his coming into existence was a mistake. It’s a conspiracy,” Jiang Ming said, his voice low, “You’re a Quasi-Sage expert. You should be working toward the Saint Dao instead of having a descendant, but you still did it. Why? After he was born, you doted on him and made him into a cruel, arrogant young man who only knows how to take from other people. You, on the other hand, are just helping him to clean up his mess, and you didn’t have the slightest intention of correcting his behavior!
“Beiming Hai said he thought the reason you’re letting him do whatever he wants is that you’re one of the few strongest experts in the universe and you have no one to fear. However, later he found out that it’s not the case at all!
“The reason you nurtured him is that you want him to grow up as soon as possible. After he has stepped into the Great Overarching Realm, you’d consume him to heal your own injuries!
“Is that correct, Kunpeng?
“You’re not a father! You’re the vilest creature in the world!” Jiang Ming snarled.
Kunpeng’s eyes grew wide in shock, and he was surprised that his son had known about his plan all along.
His eyes turned glassy.
Although he had his own agenda for raising Beiming Hai, he was still his son and he actually cared for him. When the day came, he would give his son a painless death.
He wouldn’t make him suffer and he wouldn’t let him know about his plan. He even had planned to bring a few Great Overarching Golden Immortal beauties for his son that his son couldn’t get his hands on. He would let his son spend his final time in euphoria when he was ready to act.
However, his son knew his plan all along.
He knew that his father was going to kill him, no, going to devour him. Kunpeng couldn’t imagine how painful and disappointing his son was when he learned the truth.
Kunpeng’s heart trembled. He fell into a trance, and Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed as he saw his chance.
The reason he was telling him all this was to distract him.
“Saint Province Dao Square, confine!
“Worldly projection, bind!
“Ten clones, Time and Space Confinement!
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
Jiang Ming unleashed a ton of special abilities at Kunpeng at a short amount of time.
The power of the Saint Province Dao Square landed on Kunpeng, causing his body to let out a cracking sound as if it was going to explode.
In the next second, the Worldly Projection appeared. A chess plate appeared around Kunpeng, sealing his movement.
Ten clones showed up, and chanted the Time and Space Confinement at the same time.
With the combined effort of the Saint Province Dao Square, the Worldly Projection, the Time and Space Confinement, Jiang Ming was confident that he could hold Kunpeng down.
In the meantime, the Mystical Arcane Halberd in his hand gave out a brilliant light that seemed to be able to destroy everything in its path. He then turned the point of the halberd at the center of Kunpeng’s eyebrows. A light shot out from the tip of the halberd and darted straight toward the center of his forehead.
Jiang Ming was using the Mystical Arcane Halberd to activate the Return of Infinite Law Finger. This was something he had comprehended in the Supreme Pagoda. After combining with the immortal weapon, it further amplified the power of the special ability to a shocking degree.
“Oh no!”
Kunpeng was still a Quasi-Sage Great Monarch. Even though he was distracted, he soon came around to his senses and reacted quickly.
However, the restriction and confinement on his body caused his expression to change.
“Who is he? How can he unleash such a powerful attack?”
While he was surprised at Jiang Ming’s strength, he unleashed a power that was equal to an explosion of a million atomic bombs.
His body trembled but he was not able to break himself free.
At this moment, the point of the Mystical Arcane Halberd had arrived in front of his forehead.
Bam!
For a moment, an immense power exploded and nearly crushed Kunpeng’s head.
The Mystical Arcane Halberd was still releasing its power.
At this moment, Kunpeng’s head couldn’t handle the power anymore and burst into a mist of blood. There were also cracks appearing on his body, looking as if his entire being was going to explode.
“Slice!” Kunpeng shouted desperately and his body was split into two parts.
He sacrificed one part to block the attack of the Mystical Arcane Halberd while forming a palace to protect himself with another part.
He flipped his hand and a jade amulet appeared in his palm. He activated the jade amulet, and a sword energy shot up into the sky, breaking through the confinement of the Saint Province Dao Square while charging straight at Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming’s face pale when he saw the sword energy.
After all, the power unleashed by the Saint Province Dao Square was a hundred times stronger than his own strength. Yet it was still unable to stop Kunpeng.
“I can’t stop this attack!” Jiang Ming said as his face sank.
Initially, he thought that since was able to slay a Great Overarching since he was in the Mystical Immortal Realm, he should be able to fight against Kunpeng after he had entered the Golden Immortal Realm.
However, things like this happened and he found it hard to accept.
He couldn’t avoid the attack. If not, the entire Tianyuan Realm would be destroyed.
“Supreme Order!” Jiang Ming shouted. 10,000 points disappeared, and a thin layer of mystical yellow barrier appeared around him.
This was a special feature of being the group admin. He could spend 10,000 points to receive a blessing from the Supreme to guard against an attack.
However, to be on the safe side, he activated the Human Paths Record, bringing it on top of his head.
The sword energy landed and crushed everything in its wake. However, it did not break through Jiang Ming’s barrier.
Seeing his chance, Jiang Ming immediately covered the Tianyuan Realm with the Saint Province Dao Square.
“This is impossible!” Kunpeng shouted, his voice filled with fear. Seizing the opportunity while the power of the Saint Province Dao Square was destroyed by sword energy, he turned around and fled from the Tianyuan Realm.
“Try to run?” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed with a murderous intent.
He was nearly killed in the battle. Had it not been for the Supreme Order, he would’ve been dead by now.
Swoosh!
He flipped open the Human Paths Record, and his eyes lit up when he saw Kunpeng’s status.
“Hehe, it’s time to end your life, old thing!” Jiang Ming said as he rushed toward Kunpeng’s direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - Sage Transformation, Hemi-Sage, Demi-Sage
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Sage Transformation, Hemi-Sage, Demi-Sage
In the antechamber of the Heavenly Court. The Great Heavenly Venerate was still looking at the World Monitoring Mirror. When Kunpeng arrived at the Infinite Realms Battlefield, an excited expression hopped onto his face.
“I have a feeling. I think that the Northern Emperor won’t be able to get what he wants from this fight!” he said.
“Your Majesty, you’re the lord of all universes. You govern over a billion sentient beings, and man the boundary of the universe. You can communicate with everything in the universe and you can predict the future,” Star Lord Taibai said reverently, “Since you’ve said that, then the Northern Emperor would certainly not be able to get what he wants.”
“You’re still such a smooth talker,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said with a chuckle.
“Your Majesty, you know me very well, so you should know that I’m an honest person. I’ll never tell lies,” Star Lord Taibai replied.
The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded.
Then, both of them turned their heads and looked at the World Monitoring Mirror. However, they couldn’t see anything once Kunpeng went into the Tianyuan Realm.
“This place…” The Great Heavenly Venerate frowned. “Could it be that the previous Heavenly Court has left a formation for them?”
“I don’t think so!” Star Lord Taibai frowned. “According to the record, there are the Ten Directions Annihilation Formation, the Yin-Yang Ash Transformation Formation, Great Astral Formation, the Four Saint Beasts Heavenly Suppression Formation, the Nine Heavens and Ten Directional Immortal Destruction Formation, and the Sage Transformation Formation. Some of these great formations have been lost in time, while the others are kept in treasures or have been activated. None of them have ever been passed down to other people. “” Even if someone manages to learn it from somewhere, activating these formations require a huge price. It isn’t something that can be handled by a mere planar world. Even the remnant of the previous Heavenly Court couldn’t sustain it either. According to what we’ve seen from the mirror, it doesn’t look like the works of a great weapon, so I guess the only explanation is that it’s something he has inherited.”
“The Sage Transformation Formation!” The Great Heavenly Venerate mumbled, “Something he has inherited huh… I guess you’re right.”
A strange light flitted across his eyes. In the next second, they saw the
Immediately afterward, they saw in the World Monitoring Mirror that the clouds above the Tianyuan Realm suddenly swirled, and then a sword energy appeared from within. The sword energy tore the sky asunder and pierced through the depths of time and space.
Even though it was just a flitting second, the Great Heavenly Venerate saw it clearly with his eyes and his expression changed. He jerked up from his throne and said, “That’s the power of a Hemi-Sage. Is it him or him?”
“If it’s him, then the Northern Emperor would be a goner. If it’s not him, then that place would be even more terrifying than we originally thought!” Star Lord Taibai’s expression changed as well. “Hold on for a second, Your Majesty. Something isn’t right. The Northern Emperor has yet activated his authority as the emperor of the north.”
“Interesting! This is interesting!” The smile on the Great Heavenly Venerate’s face was fading as he slowly took his seat.
Then, he saw Kunpeng running out of the Tianyuan Realm.
“This is getting even more interesting!’ The Great Heavenly Venerate squinted his eyes and his voice was cold.
“What…” Star Lord Taibai was stunned. “Is the Northern Emperor running away? But he was the one who unleashed that sword energy, so why…”
He paused for a moment, pressed his lips tightly, and he felt raw in his throat. “There are three conclusions we can make. First, the Northern Emperor has somehow gotten an opportunity that allows him to unleash sword energy with the power of a Demi-Sage, but he failed to cut down the man from the human world. Second, the Northern Emperor couldn’t activate his authority as the emperor of the north in that area. Third, the man from the human world possesses a power that surpasses a Quasi-Sage, but this is strange. If he really is that strong, how would his world get destroyed by some Demon Lords and get pulled to the Infinite Realms Battlefield by an Immortal Lord with a Great Overarching Immortal Weapon?”
“One thing I can be certain of is that the man from the human world hasn’t achieved the Great Overarching Realm yet. Therefore, there’s only one possibility!” The Great Heavenly Venerate said, “This human world is special. It’s more special than any we have seen before.”
“Maybe…”
“Let’s keep watching,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said.
The Infinite Realms Battlefield, on top of Chuyang Peak.
Linglong was both excited and shocked as she looked at the battle between Jiang Ming and Kunpeng. She was excited because her senior brother was able to severely wound Kunpeng, while she was shocked because Kunpeng was still able to run away in that condition.
She knew the Tianyuan Realm was special. It was enveloped in a very strange power, and once Kunpeng left this place, would her senior brother still be able to kill him?
Even though she was anxious, there was nothing she could do about it.
She clenched her fist tightly and sighed.
Meanwhile, the reason Jiang Ming chased after Kunpeng without any hesitation was that he had seen his status.
Name: Beiming Kunpeng.
Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation base: Quasi-Sage Realm (Severely weakened after cutting himself into half)
Background: The Northern Emperor of the Honggu Heavenly Realm, or otherwise known as the Black Emperor.
Relationship: -99.
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage.
Status: While he was in seclusion, he sensed that his beloved son was in danger, so he came out of his seclusion and rushed toward the Infinite Realms Battlefield, hoping that he could save him.
When he was traveling in the depths of time and space, he felt a pang of pain in the heart and he was shocked. His son was dead.
He was furious when he found out that someone had killed his son, and he swore to himself that he was going to kill the murderer even if he was the Great Heavenly Venerate himself.
After he had arrived in the Infinite Realms Battlefield, he traced his son and came to a place.
When he arrived there, he found out that all of the inhabitants were humans. He felt they were weak and he had the urge to devour them all. It was just that there was one thing he did not understand. He did not know how they managed to survive since their world was on the verge of destruction. However, upon a second thought, he felt that they must be protected by the one who killed his son.
He decided to wipe out all of them to avenge his son.
Afterward, two people appeared in his vision. One of them was a man while another was a woman. The woman was in the Taiyi Realm, and although she was strong, he doubted she could kill his son. Therefore, he turned his target to the man who he couldn’t see through.
At the same time, he felt something was strange about the place, but he shoved aside the feeling as he felt that nobody in this universe could harm him.
A smirk appeared on his face when the man walked toward him, and his anger began to grow.
When the man told him that his son knew he was going to eat him in the future to heal himself, he was shocked.
He couldn’t imagine how sad and disappointing his son was when he learned the truth.
While he was distracted, the man unleashed his special abilities on him, sealing and restricting his movement.
He tried to break free from it, yet he couldn’t do it, and had it not been for the Mystical Arcane Blue Water Flag inside of him, he might not even be able to move his finger.
He realized that the power that restricted his movements was not a formation at all, and he was furious when he saw the man attack him with the Mystical Arcane Halberd he forged for his beloved son.
He tried to guard himself with the Mystical Arcane Blue Water Flag but to no avail. His body was nearly crushed, his Primal Spirit was on the verge of destruction, and his origin was injured once again.
He was a Kunpeng. That meant he could turn into a roc to fly in the sky or a kraken to swim in the sea.
In the end, he decided to discard his kraken side and shifted all his injury to that side.
After he had split his kraken side from himself, he had become severely weakened and he could barely keep himself in the Quasi-Sage Realm.
He had always heard that sons would bring nothing but troubles to their father. Initially, he did not believe it, but he never expected that something like this would happen to him one day.
In order to break himself free from the confinement, he offered up his Northern Emperor Palace. Although he could move for a bit right now, he still couldn’t completely break himself free from the confinement that came straight at him from different directions.
He could not use his authority as the northern king, and he had severed himself into half. Not only that, but he couldn’t use the Northern Emperor Palace as well.
Leaving with no other options, he had to resort to his trump card. The reason he did not use it earlier was that the man was attacking him too fast and he was too close to him. If he used his trump card, he might get engulfed in the attack as well.
A long long time ago, he senior brother had followed the tutelage of a Saint Lord and he had ascended into the Demi-Sage Realm. After he left with the Saint Lord, he gave him the Mystical Arcane Blue Water Flag and a one-time use ultimate attack.
Right now, his Mystical Arcane Blue Water Flag was damaged and it would take some time before it could be used again. Therefore, he could only use the ultimate attack.
The attack was equivalent to the attack of a Demi-Sage, and no one except for the Saint Lord could defend against it. However, the young man emerged unscathed, and he felt this must be the end for him.
He was certain that the man could not defend against the ultimate attack, so he figured that it must be the layer of barrier around the young man that saved his life.
It seemed to him that the young man must have a lot of secrets on him.
Fortunately, the sword energy from the ultimate attack had shattered the power that confined him, so he hastily ran away.
When he arrived above the sea, he could sense a stellar force and he felt it weird. When he noticed that the young man was coming after him, he wondered if the young man was just trying to scare him or if he really had the confidence that he could kill him.
These were the information Jiang Ming got from Kunpeng’s status, and most of them were rather useful to him.
Kunpeng had severed his kraken self. His origin was severely damaged, and this was the best opportunity to cut him down.
Besides, Kunpeng had a senior brother. He was under the tutelage of a Saint Lord and he was in the Demi-Sage Realm. Demi-Sage was equivalent to the Hemi-Sage. They were terrifying beings who were very close to the Sage Realm. However, his senior brother had already left the Honggu World.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - The Great Emperor’s Authority, Bloodbath
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: The Great Emperor’s Authority, Bloodbath
The Great Emperor’s Authority, Bloodbath
At the borders of Tianyuan Sea, Kunpeng stopped and went to stand on top of the North Emperor Palace.
The palace has been transformed into hundreds of feet wide, emitting waves after waves of halo, covering the whole thousand miles. At the same time, star lights were led down onto the lands, seemingly turning the night into day time.
Kunpeng stood atop of it as though he was the lord of the stars.
Jiang Ming stopped outside the aperture, feeling a little inexplicably uneasy. The halberd in his hand started to turn, as the rays of light spewed out. His killing intent was slowly condensing.
“You deserve to die!” Kunpeng stared at Jiang Ming with flames burning directly in his eyes. He then looked behind Jiang Ming and sneered, “There is no imprisoning force here! I guess the suppression on me just now can only be done on the inside. Am I right?”
Although it was a question, he was extremely certain of it.
“It doesn’t matter whether you’re right or not. You are going to die today!” Jiang Ming’s voice was cold, but his feeling of anxiety was even stronger.
Just as he was about to return to the Tianyuan Realm, he discovered numerous amounts of starlight that appeared around him, surrounding him within. Amidst the twinkling of the stars, he realized he had actually returned back to the place he stood just now.
“What kind of power is this?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
He felt a Heavenly power from it. The real power of heavens, almighty as it was, suppressing anything and everything. It had total control of life and death to all beings yet giving off an illusory feeling to others.
“This is the Great Emperor’s authority!” Kunpeng raised his finger and pointed to the sky, “Heavenly Court can suppress all things, communicate with the power of the universe’s origin, hold total authority, and render all to submit to it. As the Northern Emperor of the Heavenly Court, I naturally have the corresponding power. This is the Emperor’s infinite might! I never thought that I would need to use such power to kill you. ”
He also lamented in his heart that it was a shame that he was thrown off guard. He could not do anything about it but his killing intent towards Jiang Ming became unprecedentedly strong.
“The Great Emperor’s authority?” Jiang Ming’s heartbeat rose fiercely.
He thought of the “an external force that cannot be quoted” stated in Kunpeng “status”. It must be referring to the Great Emperor’s authority.
It was blocked off by the Saint Province Dao Square when they were in Tianyuan World. However, it seemed that the power could be used here.
‘God damn it! Shouldn’t this be another way around? Damn!’ Jiang Ming felt as though he was about to vomit blood.
“Yes, it is the Great Emperor’s authority. I will kill you today, and then kill all the creatures of the land where you came from!” Kunpeng’s tone was calm, yet what he just said was something extremely brutal, “Seven-Stars Formation Array, out!”
Hummm!
The North Emperor Palace vibrated slightly under his feet, and the surrounding aperture instantly expanded, covering a million miles. Starlight filled the air, as a killer catastrophe was slowly brewing.
Jiang Ming discovered the seven figures who flew out from the palace at Kunpeng’s feet. And in a flash, they merged into the endless starlight, turned into a Seven-Stars Formation Array, and disappeared without a trace.
‘They are all of the Great Overarching Realm!’ With a glance, he locked on to the seven strong experts and their information manifested in the Human Path Record.
One of them was at the pinnacle, three in their late stage, and the other three in their middle stage of the Great Overarching Realm. They were all Kunpeng’s underlings.
‘Seven-Stars Formation Array, where seven Great Overarching experts gather together to mobilize the power of the ancient stars, coupled with the authority of the universe, so that their power can almost enter the Quasi-Sage Realm!’
Jiang Ming had an even horrible look on his face because he realized that he had underestimated Kunpeng.
He thought that with his ability to cut down geniuses who were in the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm in the Supreme Pagoda, he could also deal with an ordinary Quasi-Sage expert.
After all, the geniuses who were in the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm in the Supreme Pagoda, all possessed the power to challenge even the Quasi-Sage experts.
However, he had forgotten that there was no multiplier of strength through the Dao vessel in the Supreme Pagoda. Also, there was no Universe Authority, no help from any subordinates nor the power of array formations as support.
‘I’m still a little too arrogant after all! I thought that with the System, the Human Path Record, the Supreme Order, the Saint Province Dao Square, and the World’s Dao, I can run amok in the world without any worries. Guess I’m meeting my maker this time! No, not yet!’
Jiang Ming calmed himself down. In a blink of an eye, thousands of thoughts ran through his mind.
His surroundings were filled with the endless starry sky, which had evolved into a sea of stars. There was no sense of direction for there were only starlight in the vast open space.
Right this very moment, the starlight condensed and turned into a thousand-feet-tall silhouette that came down the place with just a single palm. It felt as though it could hold thousands of stars and destroy all things. Its intensity and ferocity truly showed its unparalleled power.
Jiang Ming’s figure swayed and turned into a 400-feet tall figure. His firm muscles and his turbulent aura made him a lot stronger. With the back of his hand, he swatted and shattered the silhouette’s palm.
Jiang Ming himself was also flung thousands of miles away from the impact. Before he could stand still and recover from the exchange, a punch appeared from behind, aiming for the back of the heart. The punch was as strong as it could even blow up the galaxy.
A ray of light exploded from Jiang Ming’s back, as he evoked the Great Millennium Technique, wanting to imprison this punch with the law of time. However, the punch merely paused for a brief moment before shattering the time and space, sending Jiang Ming tumbling back.
Immediately afterwards, a sword light appeared, with its might as if it could split even the sky.
His hair stood on end. But he still chose to put away the Quasi-Sage Mystical Arcane Halber because it was difficult to use. Therefore, it would make him suffer losses easier while confronting a far stronger enemy.
“Unlimited Killing Punch!” Jiang Ming revealed his punch technique and went to counteract the attack that appeared.
Meanwhile, he was protecting himself with the power of his inner world, guarding his sea of consciousness with the Human Path Record, and preparing to evoke the Supreme Order at any time.
Jiang Ming put down everything and prepared to fight to his heart’s content. After all, this was not the same as fighting in the Battle Tower.
He evoked the various killing techniques in his refined Infinite Killing Fist such as Sky Dawn, Ground Shattering Strike, Heaven and Earth Attack, Star Burst Strike, Shockwave Blow, Exterminate Punch, Inch Strength Thousand Punch, and etc. But he was still being suppressed and beaten down, and bloodstains were all over his body.
Fortunately for him, his physical body was strong enough, and he was guarded by his inner world, so he could still hold on for a while. However, if this went on, he would be subdued sooner or later.
As his movement changed, so did his punching techniques. Jiang Ming’s next punch created a picture of the ancient civilization where the ancestors fought against Heaven and Earth, the beasts, and the insects, struggling for their survival.
The flames of civilization were finally ignited where they went on with bloodshed and farming with their backs straightened. One step after another, they grew with their head held high in the sky and their feet planted firmly on the lands, trampling the bugs, and crushing the wild beasts. They went on to trample down on all the beings that were once a threat to their survival.
Between the cycles of images, there seemed to be thousands of figures that were from the ancients’ times up to the present. A recitation formed from the embodiment of the unyielding spiritual will of the human race constantly echoed through: A person should correspond to the strength and vigor of the Heavens to strive for progress with great fortitude and perseverance; a person should correspond to the solidness and humbleness of the Earth, improving one’s virtue to be able to accept anything and everything.
Jiang Ming’s punch portrayed an unyielding will.
Boom...
He blasted a star master that was holding a divine sword in his hand, returning him into the starry sky. That was not the real body, but the battle body deduced by the formation array, which was endless.
As long as the power of the formation array did not disappear, these battle bodies will continue to emerge.
However, this formation array seemed to be able to mobilize the power of the ancient stars and was blessed by the authority of the universe, rendering it an endless supply of power, and can almost run indefinitely.
This was also the terrifying aspect of this formation.
Jiang Ming’s boxing technique were revealed as he continued his onslaught.
This time however, they were almost evenly matched.
‘As expected of Hong Yi, the enlightened Holy Civilization Fist is really terrifying!’ Jiang Ming was amazed.
On the outside, Kunpeng was still standing on the North Emperor Palace. What looked like bright starlight in front of him was actually turned and twisted into a formation space on the inside.
“What kind of punching technique is this? It has the silhouette of the Holy Dao and is terrifyingly horrifying!” He could see the inside of the big formation, and while frowning, he shouted, “Stop playing around already! Go forth to kill him!”
“Yes, Great Emperor!” The seven voices spoke in unison.
A figure walked out from the starlight within the large formation array. It was none other than Star Master Tianquan.
He aimed at Jiang Ming’s head and slashed down on him. In that very instant, the surrounding area became stagnant in time and Jiang Ming was suffocated by the suppressive power coming from all directions.
The space was frozen solid and the power of laws had stopped its cycle.
“This blow...” Jiang Ming’s eyebrows twitched. According to the situation stated in the Human Path Record, he discovered that this phenomena was because all seven star masters had fused their power into one of them, allowing the single person to erupt with the strongest power yet.
Along with the blessing of the array formation, this technique could also divert the attacks received, and allow the person to maintain himself at his peak constantly through the constant cycle of power.
Even a Quasi-Sage expert could be grinded to death.
“I am the master of civilization!”
Jiang Ming also launched his strongest punch yet, condensing all the power of civilization together, turning it into a throne, sitting on it, and overruling all civilizations. With the punch, civilization turned into power, strong and unyielding, smashing through laws, suppressing the present, and granting him a sense of invincibility.
Even so, Jiang Ming was still blown away from the slash. A scar appeared on his fist, as fresh blood could be seen trickling down.
“If it’s a head-on confrontation, I’m not an opponent of a Quasi-Sage expert at all!” Jiang Ming frowned.
Right this very moment, Star Master Tianquan took a step forward, instantly arriving in front of him and followed up with yet another slash. The moment the sword slash was delivered, the attack cut through time and space, cutting off all the powers of law.
With another hard blow onto Jiang Ming, he was knocked back into the distance again. His arms trembled, and his qi and blood were in shambles
“One more blow, and my arm will surely be shattered!” Jiang Ming became calmer and calmer. Because he knew he couldn’t let it go on like that.
Humm...
The light from the sword slash was condensing once again, not giving him any chances to think at all.
It was also at that instant that two clones appeared next to Jiang Ming, both evoking the Space and Time Confinement technique towards the Star Master Tianquan at the same time. However, just as the luminance from the technique had just bloomed, and hadn’t even locked onto the time-space, it was shattered completely by two rays of light that appeared out of thin air. Even his clones also vanished at the same time.
“Do you think that repeating using the same special ability would still be of use?” Kunpeng’s voice reverberated, “You are indeed not an ordinary person. You’ve yet to step into the Great Overarching Realm, but still possess the capability to burst out powers comparable to a Quasi-Sage. This is just incredible!”
Jiang Ming no longer had to heart to be surprised, as a Nine Level Golden Pagoda appeared above his head, blocked off the sword luminance, but the exchange still sent him retreating again.
The sword luminance burst out, forming into a galaxy. It was apparent that Kunpeng was not giving him any chances at all.
“You old bird, do you really think you’ve got me?” Jiang Ming’s voice suddenly rang.
He turned his eyes, locked onto the sword luminance, and a bell could be seen flying out at Kunpeng’s direction.
It was the Great Overarching Dao vessel, Heaven’s Annihilation Bell given by the system.
“Detonate!”
Jiang Ming knew that this bell could not stop the sword luminance at all and hence he evoked yet another kind of special ability called the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment. The technique detonated the origins of the Heaven’s Annihilation Bell, turned it into a monstrous torrent and coupled with the ability of the Heaven’s Annihilation Bell, sweeping through all directions.
All the power of the Great Overarching Dao vessel came to a boil and exploded in an instant, emitting a terrifying power!
The power made the starry sky collapse, the sword luminance disintegrated, disrupted the great formation array, as if it was about to explode.
Star Master Tianquan who stood in front of Jiang Ming had his face turned pale, and was about to withstand the power explosion. However, when he heard the bell rang, he couldn’t help but become numb for a mere second.
Thump...
The last bell rang after the ultimate sublimation of Heaven’s Annihilation Bell, shocked the primal spirits and annihilated the souls. Even Star Master Tianquan was greatly affected at that time as his primal spirit turned dim.
It was also at this very moment that Jiang Ming’s finger pierced through the center of his forehead, completely destroying his primal spirit.
The great formation array became twisted before collapsing suddenly.
“Every one of you! Die!” Jiang Ming roared, and evoked the special ability that he had been brewing for a long while.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - Thousand-Handed, Hong Luo, Tian Yuan, The Fall of Kunpeng
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Thousand-Handed, Hong Luo, Tian Yuan, The Fall of Kunpeng
In the Heavenly Court, the Great Heavenly Venerate sat upright, watching the great battle on the Infinite Realm Battlefield through the World Monitoring Mirror.
“Something’s wrong with the Northern Emperor!” Star Lord Taibai said hesitantly.
“He severed a part of himself, which means he had cut off the way for him to move onward!” the Great Heavenly Venerate said.
“Severed a part of himself?” Star Lord Taibai was shocked, “Could it be that the legend is true? That the Northern Emperor has two bodies?”
“Kunpeng is a very special creature. He is a Roc in the sky and a Kraken in the water. The two bodies are one, yet they can be differentiated. Now that he has cut one part of himself, his origin is no longer complete, and can be regarded as the self-destruction of his own Dao.” The Great Heavenly Venerate tone had a glint of regret in it, “I didn’t expect that he would be forced to such an extent!”
“This...” Star Lord Taibai was horrified, but continued inexplicably, “This child of the mortal realm has not even entered the Great Overarching Realm. Even if he is a heaven-defying genius, it is impossible that he could force the Northern Emperor to such a degree. Could it be...”
He looked at the Tianyuan World in the corner of the mirror.
“There should be something special there!” The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded.
There was a great change in the mirror.
“Seven-Star Formation Array, arranged by seven Great Overarching Star Masters, can trap a Quasi-Sage expert. ” ” With the blessing of the authority of the Heavenly Court, this formation can even grind down the expert who has just stepped into the Quasi-Sage Realm!” The Great Heavenly Venerate commented, “It can be confirmed now. That place on the mortal world can seal off the power of authority.”
“To seal the power of authority… Doesn’t that mean…” Star Lord Taibai shuddered.
Meanwhile, the Great Heavenly Venerate did not speak a word.
Not long after, Jiang Ming launched his barrage of attacks and all seven Star Masters died.
Star Lord Taibai had a look of astonishment, “How…How did he do it?”
“Continue watching!” The Great Heavenly Venerates expression became even more serious.
Seeing Jiang Ming evoked the World’s Projection, producing the crisscrossing and dense chains of laws, Star Lord Taibai’s pupils shrank. As a flash of shock went through his mind, he suddenly felt he had a certain enlightenment from it.
“Your Majesty, is this the legendary World’s Dao?” Star Lord Taibai almost exclaimed, “The law of the Golden Immortals. Doesn’t that mean that his small chiliocosm has been completed? But he is from the human realm! How did he do it?”
Star Lord Taibai was deeply puzzled and shocked at the same time.
“I want to know too!” The Great Heavenly Venerate said faintly, “Once he breaks the bottleneck and the small chiliocosm enters the middle chiliocosm level, the Holy Dao will be right in front of him.”
There was an imperceptible hint of envy in his tone.
Star Lord Taibai grinned secretly upon listening. Right after, he couldn’t help exclaiming, “He, he, he can detonate the Great Overarching Dao Vessels! How did he do it?”
The Great Heavenly Venerate glanced at him lightly.
Star Lord Taibai gave a wry smile, bowed and saluted, “Your old servant’s is greatly astounded. I’m sorry, Your Majesty.”
“I’m also surprised!” The Great Heavenly Venerate suddenly sighed, “No wonder he was able to break out of the Seven-Star Formation Array! A small chiliocosm and can even detonate Great Overarching Dao vessels. Given the Northern Emperor’s current situation, I’m afraid the outcome is not optimistic!”
“Your Majesty, what if the Northern Emperor was killed?”
“This Infinite Realm Battlefield does not allow the descent of Quasi-Sage experts. As the Northern Emperor of Heavenly Court, Kunpeng violated the laws of heaven without authorization; Because of the great battle, the whole world has changed and millions and millions of souls are affected.” The Great Heavenly Venerate continued, “His sin is unforgivable. But the position cannot be left empty…”
He paused, then said, “Is killing the Northern Emperor considered a huge crime?”
“Your Majesty!” Star Lord Taibai turned pale and lowered his head suddenly.
“You’re becoming more and more cowardly!” The Great Heavenly Venerate snorted, his eyes narrowed, and a cold expression flashed, “You Northern Emperor! I really underestimated you and your wild ambitions. As for the rest of you lots, how dare you intervene! Very well then!”
In the Infinite Realm Battlefield, four Great Overarching Dao Vessels were detonated simultaneously. The power that erupted was far beyond everyone’s imagination.
It did not matter if it was the power of laws, orders, rules, time-space or whatever the laws of the great chiliocosm was. All of them were torn to shreds, annihilated completely by the outburst of power.
At the critical juncture, Kunpeng mobilized the power of authority once again, but was easily destroyed as well.
“Mystical Arcane Blue Water Flag!”
He did not care that this supreme weapon had its origin damaged already, as he desperately evoked its potential and unleashed the power of protection.
The blue light glowing faintly should have been invincible in defense, but it still couldn’t stop the power of eruption.
As the light dissipated, the great artifact let out a whimper, and it was suddenly divided into a flagpole and a flag. It was completely crippled to the extent that even the imprint inside it was erased, as it fell into the depths of time and space.
“War Vessel Three Thousand Strike!”
Kunpeng felt a little bit in despair. With a flicker of the light, he turned into another form: a bird-headed human body.
However, his aura also skyrocketed, as he evoked his life-defining techniques.
Boom!
The torrent swept in, crippling all that stood against it.
The moment Jiang Ming detonated the four Great Overarching Dao Vessels, he teleported back into the Tianyuan World to protect himself with the power of the Saint Province Dao Square.
“This attack is really terrifying!” His face was pale and he was not feeling well.
However, looking at the destructive storm ahead, it was even more shocking.
The Tianyuan Sea over there was completely destroyed. The seawater had completely evaporated and a bottomless abyss was bombarded on the bottom of the sea.
In the distance, the earth cracked and it spread to the ends of the sky.
The sky collapsed, causing the torrent of time and space to pour down, but was weakened by inexplicable forces, and finally dissipated into thin air.
As the storm swept over, Jiang Ming raised his hand to press against it, minimizing its impact to a mere breeze.
There were even slight fluctuations in the Tianyuan World, as if an earthquake, but it was not a big problem.
Jiang Ming watched on silently as he called up the Human Path Record, which suspended mid-air in front of him, and flipped to the page related to Kunpeng.
The power of destruction gradually subsided.
“He’s not dead yet! Such a tenacious life!” Jiang Ming muttered, turned into light and rushed over. The World Projection had been manifested and was in a state between existence and non-existence, covering a radius of thousands of miles, forming a subtle oscillating force.
Passing through the storm, he came over to Kunpeng.
This time however, the Northern Emperor of the Heavenly Court was in a very miserable state. Two of his legs were gone and so was one of his arms. There was only a bird head and half of his rib cage left, connected to a left arm. Even so, the remaining part seemed to be almost completely disintegrated. The remaining parts of his body still shone with divine light, resisting the final force of destruction.
“Black Emperor, any last words?” The Mythical Arcane Halberd in Jiang Ming’s hand was raised high, as the power that could split the world was condensed on it.
“Do you really think you can kill me?” Kunpeng’s primordial spirit shook and echoed the sounds of the Dharma.
Jiang Ming’s halberd swung down for the final blow.
Right this very moment, the void split open, and a spear suddenly appeared, blocking the halberd.
The next moment, a figure ripped apart the void and descended directly into the world. He grabbed the spear, and looked at Jiang Ming followed by another person appearing and standing in front of Kunpeng.
“Two Quasi-Sage experts from the Abyssal World!” Jiang Ming’s face turned sour.
The person on the left, wearing a blood-colored robe, had a purple horn between his eyebrows with red lines on his face. He looked very strange, but was at least, in humanoid form.
The one on the right held a spear, had a third eye between his eyebrows, and had four arms. He wore leather armor with his buffed up and exposed arm. A mere glance and you could tell he is full of endless power.
“I am the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate of the Abyss Multi-Handed Clan!” The three-eyed man had a smile on his face, “He is the Hong Luo Demon Venerate. Boy, give us a face and let today’s matter be at rest.”
He waved the spear in his hand, and his threatening intent was clear as daylight.
“Three Eyes, Hong Luo! He is already at the end of his fight. It’s best to kill him now, snatch his great encounter, and strip him of his good fortune. Else, he will become a big problem sooner or later!” Kunpeng’s voice echoed in a hurry.
“This...” the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate frowned, as he was a little hesitant.
A knife appeared in Hong Luo’s hand. It was extremely dark, and caused souls to tremble with just a glance. A blade that could split everything, flashed with a strange breathtaking power. It was a Quasi-Sage weapon.
“It seems that killing you is more beneficial!” Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate muttered.
Jiang Ming smiled, “You two. Do you really want to stop me? Do you want to kill me?”
“We have this intention!” The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate nodded unabashedly, “It shouldn’t be difficult to kill you now!”
“Really?” In front of Jiang Ming, there were four Great Overarching artifacts appearing again, namely the God Annihilating Bow, the Emperor Star Palace, and two war swords.
As soon as the Great Overarching Dao Vessels appeared, both the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate were shocked and retreated immediately.
After all, they saw that Jiang Ming was capable of detonating Great Overarching Dao Vessels with their very own eyes.
Four pieces of Dao Vessel exploding at the same time meant that there was an 80% chance of them falling to their demise on the spot.
“The Black Emperor is already my sworn mortal enemy, and death is the only ending for either one of us!” Jiang Ming said, “If you save him. He will definitely seek revenge on me, and even have the opportunity to kill me after he recovers. So, saving him means you two will become my mortal enemy and death is the only ending for us. Have you two made up your mind? Do you really want to be my enemy for this half-crippled bird person?”
Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate frowned, feeling a little troublesome over the matter, and said after a thought, “Northern Emperor is of great use to us and we can’t help but save him. I give you my word that from now on, the Northern Emperor will not seek revenge on you!”
“Haha!” Jiang Ming laughed, and then looked at the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, “You promise? Who do you think you are? The enemy who saves my mortal enemy is my mortal enemy. From now on, I will not stop hunting you down till I’m dead! It’s okay for you two to leave now. Otherwise …”
He was extremely persistent and must be so. In fact, it did not matter who came forth today.
The four large Great Overarching Dao Vessels in front of him flashed an immortal light at the same time.
The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate’s face sank, revealing a ruthless look, and said with a savage smile, “Boy, do you really think that if the Great Overarching Dao Vessels self-destruct, you can kill both of us? You don’t seem to know what the two of us represent. We represent the nine Demon Venerates of the abyss, one hundred Demon Emperors, tens of thousands of Devil Kings, one million Demon Kings, and hundreds of millions of Devil Generals!”
“Not mentioning the power of the abyss, can you stop the two of us? It’s already unbelievable that you held on for so many great battles consecutively when you are not even in the Great Overarching Realm. I don’t believe you have much immortal essence left in you! Little guy, don’t throw the face that’s given to you!” Today, we are protecting the Northern Emperor for sure! If you still don’t know what’s good for you, you’ll be beheaded, and all the human beings in your land will be wiped out!” The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate sneered.
If it weren’t for the fear of the four Great Overarching Dao Vessels in front of him, he wouldn’t be as so long-winded as he would have gone on with it a long time ago.
Who would want to squabble if the thing could be resolved with action? What’s more, they were lawless Demon Venerates.
“I’m saying it for the last time too!” Jiang Ming raised a finger and said coldly, “If you stop me, I will never stop until I die! Once mortal animosity is tied on, it will be unresolvable for all eternity.”
“What an arrogant and domineering little guy!” The murderous intent in the eyes of Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate almost condensed into reality, “Northern Emperor, you go first! Go directly to the abyss! I’ll see if he dares to make any moves!”
“Alright, I’ll leave the place to you!” Black Emperor said, gave Jiang Ming a cold glance, and flashed a cruel look. He then raised his head to look up at the sky again as the cold color in his eyes became more intense, turning into a stream and went off.
“The Abyss! Very well then!” Jiang Ming raised his hand and was about to detonate the four Great Overarching Dao vessels, but suddenly stopped and had a strange look on his face.
Immediately afterwards, Kunpeng’s screams echoed, wailing abnormally terrifyingly.
“Haha!” A loud laughter followed suit, rolling like a thunderstorm, swept across the earth, and spread throughout the Infinite Realm Battlefield. The laughter was filled with pleasure and the catharsis of hundreds of millions of years, “Kunpeng! Finally you have your day!”
In the distance, an old man shattered the remnant of Kunpeng’s body and was grabbing onto his primal spirit with one hand.
In the palm of his hand, the True Fire of Nine Heavens Pure Yang was burning, refining Kunpeng’s primal spirit. It didn’t take long before more than half of his primal spirit was destroyed.
“Mountain Master Tian Yuan, why?” Kunpeng let out a desperate roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - Holy Venerates Dao Square Translator: EndlessFa
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Holy Venerates Dao Square
It was the Mountain Master Tian Yuan who made the move and captured Kunpeng. He had a sort of relationship with Jiang Ming.
This time however, was his original body and not an incarnation.
Looking at the happiness and satisfaction on the face of Mountain Master Tian Yuan after completing his vengeance from a distance, Jiang Ming was a little puzzled.
He remembered that when he checked on Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s ‘Status’, it seemed that his enemies were all slaughtered. This made him wonder what was happening?
He thought the possible explanation was that there was no further analysis because it was an incarnation rather than the original body that he stumbled upon at the beginning?
Jiang Ming opened the Human Path Record and referred to Tianyuan’s ‘Status’. It became somewhat clearer now.
Name: Qian Yuan (Mountain Master Tian Yuan)
Relationship: 86
Status
: He was the son of a mortal peasant and later ascended through the immortal gates. He was initially a free and unfettered person at heart but when his mountain gate was destroyed, he stayed hidden for hundreds of millions of years in anger, vowing to emerge one day and slaughter all his enemies.
: When the ancient Heavenly Court fell, he made his move and killed off all his enemies. When he thought he had exacted his revenge, he suddenly found new clues to his mountain gate’s demise.
: The Immortal King who annihilated his sect once secretly took refuge with Kunpeng and collected beautiful women with high qualifications for Kunpeng’s son. His Junior Sister was snatched, humiliated and suicided after. Even their sect was destroyed.
: Upon knowing this, his anger fumed and raged.
: He wanted revenge, not only to kill Beiming Hai, but also to kill Kunpeng as well.
: Kunpeng was the root cause of the demise of his master’s sect and the death of Junior Sister. Without him, how could there be Beiming Hai to begin with?
: However, Kunpeng’s influence was very powerful and had become the Northern Emperor of the current Heavenly Court. He now had the power in his hands, and his cultivation realm was unpredictable. Killing him was as hard as flying to the moon. He went into seclusion and became Mountain Master Tian Yuan. He seemed to be at ease, but was in fact secretly investigating the details of Kunpeng.
: After a summary of information, he came to a conclusion: Kunpeng had a cold, cruel and tyrannical temperament, was only into his own interest, mean and unkind, and had always wanted to break through Holy Dao. It is also known that when he was subdued by the Ancient Heavenly Court, he suffered a Dao injury and never recovered from it.
: Suffering from Dao injury, how can Kunpeng’s strength be improved? Qian Yuan even knew that he had tried every means, and even secretly destroyed a lot of sects and families to collect immortal treasures, but still was unable to recover himself. Under such a situation, how would he deplete his own origin to give birth to children?
: If it’s unreasonable, then there must be a secret within.
: Later, it was found out that Kunpeng had an innate special ability called the Kunpeng Reincarnation Technique. With that technique, normal injuries can be recovered in an instant, but couldn’t do much for Dao injuries.
: Nurturing a child with his own essence and blood means their origins are the same. Therefore, he concluded that devouring the child when the child’s cultivation becomes stronger, could heal his wound. And he was ecstatic.
: According to his speculation, if Kunpeng were to make his move, he would definitely wait until the Beiming Hai entered the Great Overarching Realm, and it was best at the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm. When the time comes, once the child is swallowed to heal his wound, he will inevitably be in a state of weakness. It would be a good time for revenge, and he can then eradicate both the father and son together.
: From then on, he began to focus on monitoring Beiming Hai. He saw that Bei Minghai came to the Infinite Realm Battlefield, but unexpectedly discovered that the mortal planar world that he had been keeping his eyes on was about to descend there as well. He sighed in his heart: I was still robbed in the end!
: When he initially saw Bei Chenxing of Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm wanting to kill the little guy he had paid attention to, he was worried. However, when he saw the confident look on Jiang Ming’s face, he held back.
: Unexpectedly, this little guy had grown to such a powerful extent. He did not enter the Great Overarching Realm, but still killed Bei Chenxing, who was in the later stage of the Great Overarching Realm. It was both a shocking and a happy surprise.
: When he saw Jiang Ming was in such a miserable state, as if he was going to die at any time, he felt inexplicably that Jiang Ming was actually pretending. Yes, it was all just him pretending.
: He later saw Beiming Hai rush into the human world to kill Jiang Ming again. His heart moved, and an immature thought ran through his mind: If Beiming Hai was killed, will Kunpeng come forth? He definitely will! Can he kill Kunpeng if he joins forces with Jiang Ming?
: He also discovered that the remnants of the mortal world could not be peeked into. While he was shocked at first, it gave him some hope.
: Seeing Kunpeng’s arrival, he wanted to follow him into the mortal world, but held back at last. When he saw sword light soaring into the sky, the sea of ??clouds being tossed around, he was shocked.
: Seeing Kunpeng escaping for his life was even more horrifying. When he sensed that the enemy’s aura was greatly diminished, he was pleasantly surprised.
: Preparing to take advantage of Jiang Ming, who was chasing Kunpeng to continue their battle, he planned on making his move secretly and killed Kunpeng with one hit. However, he later found out that there were two Demon Venerates hiding in the Abyss. He had discovered before that these two Demon Venerates had been in contact with Kunpeng, and his heart sank.
: But wait!
: It was very gratifying for him to see Jiang Ming’s great powers; His heart was in ecstatic to see how miserable Kunpeng had become. When he saw the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate appearing to save Kunpeng, he couldn’t suppress his bloodlust any longer. Seeing that Jiang Ming used Great Overarching Dao Vessels to intimidate the two Demon Venerates, and was extremely powerful, he knew that his opportunity had come.(copy link “https://bit.ly/3NSnQtR” to continue reading
: Finally, Kunpeng was the first to leave.
: Haha! the opportunity has come! The opportunity has finally come! Thank God! I will destroy this bird man today!
: Once I make my move, I must kill him with one hit!
…
Jiang Ming looked at the Qian Yuan’s ‘Status’ and exclaimed in his heart.
This one was also a ruthless man. When his sect was destroyed, he didn’t rush to take revenge, but endured in seclusion, finding the opportunity to kill his opponent off with one blow. In the face of such a mortal enemy, Kunpeng, he had been planning for a long time, waiting for the most suitable opportunity. And his hard work paid off.
“Calm, ruthless, and cunning like a lone wolf, how could he not amount to great things!” Jiang Ming secretly said in his heart.
What if he was the Mountain Master Tian Yuan? If his sect was destroyed, his master was killed, and his Junior Sister also died. How would he react?
He really might not be able to hold back. What if he couldn’t hold back? He thought he would be killed nine times out of ten.
As all these ran through his thoughts, it was just a snap of his fingers.
Over at the other side, Mountain Master Tian Yuan was slowly reminiscing about the past.
“What? The Immortal King that surrendered himself to me destroyed your sect to collect Immortal ladies for my child?” Upon hearing this, Kunpeng couldn’t help crying out in despair, “Making matters worse! Damn it! How can this single child I raised make matters so much worse for me?”
When the other experts watching the battle heard his cry, they all smiled, and at the same time were very happy: Kunpeng! Finally you have this day too.
Committing evil deeds everywhere in order to nurture Beiming Hai, who was he to bring harm to but not yourself?
It might be nothing before as he did not provoke any ruthless people. But now that he had provoked one such person?
Just provoking that person once was all he needed to be a goner.
“Mountain Master Tian Yuan! Listen to me, listen to me!” Kunpeng resisted the extreme pain of his primal spirit’s destruction, and hoarsely said quickly, “I don’t know what happened in the past. I really didn’t know! It wasn’t me who instructed it. Let me go and I will tell you the secret of the Holy Dao!”
“The secret of the Holy Dao?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan curled his lips and said coldly, “If I do not take my revenge, even if my heads are clear of thoughts, why would I still ponder on the Holy Dao? Kunpeng, even if God himself comes today, you are still sure to die!”
With that said, he looked at Jiang Ming in the distance and nodded.
Jiang Ming cupped his hands to greet him.
It was just that the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate had extremely ugly expressions on their faces.
They thought that it would be smooth sailing to rescue Kunpeng. Who knew that they would first encounter such a dauntless person like Jiang Ming, and then Mountain Master Tian Yuan appearing right after? The two were really two slaps right on their faces.
The two looked at each other and were about to go and stop the Mountain Master Tian Yuan, but was blocked by Jiang Ming, “You two! Are you leaving just like that?”
His tone was cold, and there were four large Great Overarching Dao Vessels suspended in front of him, each of which gave off terrifying luminance, as if they would explode at any time.
Jiang Ming also checked the ‘Status’ of the two Demon Venerates.
They were all Demon Venerates from the Abyss, and their ‘Relationship’ with him was around minus 90. What did that mean? It meant that as long as there was a chance, they would definitely kill him.
Also, it had been made clear just now that saving Kunpeng made them his mortal enemy, and yet these two did not take him seriously at all.
However, he discovered their purpose of saving Kunpeng from the ‘Status’ of these Demon Venerates.
They were in contact before, and Kunpeng wanted to make these two secretly subdue under himself at the cost of knowing the secrets about the Holy Realm.
There was even a hidden place of the Holy Venerates Dao Square that they could go seek for benefits together in the future.
It just so happened that when Jiang Ming was trapped in the Seven-Star Array Formation, Kunpeng felt a little uneasy, and found that these two were also on the Infinite Realm Battlefield. The two of them were on a higher-level battlefield, and so he informed them to come over.
Otherwise, how could they rush over so quickly?
Upon descending into this world and going through so many things, Jiang Ming believed in the truth of this world that if they were to be enemies, they would be his mortal enemies.
If the enemy could not kill him, then he will be the one killing them off.
“Such bravery, little one!” Hong Luo Demon Venerate was furious, and a palace burst out above his head. Its power radiated around, covering the entire surroundings.
Meanwhile, the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate took a glance and quickly left.
“Are you really not afraid?” Jiang Ming didn’t move, but a Nine Level Golden Pagoda appeared above his head, as he held onto the Mystical Arcane Halberd with four large Great Overarching Dao Vessels suspended midair in front of him.
Hong Luo Demon Venerate’s heart was beating wildly, but how could he show any weakness?
He had also discussed with the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate just now that if this little guy was still unyielding, he would block him off here. They won’t aim to kill off the enemy, but just seek for their own protection and block him off.
“We don’t have any grudges, do we?” Hong Luo Demon Venerate forced out an ugly smile, “Everything is negotiable.”
Jiang Ming also smiled, “True. It’s negotiable!”
However, his eyes turned over to Mountain Master Tian Yuan, whilst he also looked this way.
The eyes of the two met. Although they did not speak nor did they transmit their voices subconsciously, the two also exchanged information, forming a tacit understanding between them.
Jiang Ming turned his eyes over and looked at Hong Luo Demon Venerate with a raging gleam in his eyes.

: Preparing to take advantage of Jiang Ming, who was chasing Kunpeng to continue their battle, he planned on making his move secretly and killed Kunpeng with one hit. However, he later found out that there were two Demon Venerates hiding in the Abyss. He had discovered before that these two Demon Venerates had been in contact with Kunpeng, and his heart sank.
: But wait!
: It was very gratifying for him to see Jiang Ming’s great powers; His heart was in ecstatic to see how miserable Kunpeng had become. When he saw the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate appearing to save Kunpeng, he couldn’t suppress his bloodlust any longer. Seeing that Jiang Ming used Great Overarching Dao Vessels to intimidate the two Demon Venerates, and was extremely powerful, he knew that his opportunity had come.
: Finally, Kunpeng was the first to leave.
: Haha! the opportunity has come! The opportunity has finally come! Thank God! I will destroy this bird man today!
: Once I make my move, I must kill him with one hit!
…
Jiang Ming looked at the Qian Yuan’s ‘Status’ and exclaimed in his heart.
This one was also a ruthless man. When his sect was destroyed, he didn’t rush to take revenge, but endured in seclusion, finding the opportunity to kill his opponent off with one blow. In the face of such a mortal enemy, Kunpeng, he had been planning for a long time, waiting for the most suitable opportunity. And his hard work paid off.
“Calm, ruthless, and cunning like a lone wolf, how could he not amount to great things!” Jiang Ming secretly said in his heart.
What if he was the Mountain Master Tian Yuan? If his sect was destroyed, his master was killed, and his Junior Sister also died. How would he react?
He really might not be able to hold back. What if he couldn’t hold back? He thought he would be killed nine times out of ten.
As all these ran through his thoughts, it was just a snap of his fingers.
Over at the other side, Mountain Master Tian Yuan was slowly reminiscing about the past.
“What? The Immortal King that surrendered himself to me destroyed your sect to collect Immortal ladies for my child?” Upon hearing this, Kunpeng couldn’t help crying out in despair, “Making matters worse! Damn it! How can this single child I raised make matters so much worse for me?”
When the other experts watching the battle heard his cry, they all smiled, and at the same time were very happy: Kunpeng! Finally you have this day too.
Committing evil deeds everywhere in order to nurture Beiming Hai, who was he to bring harm to but not yourself?
It might be nothing before as he did not provoke any ruthless people. But now that he had provoked one such person?
Just provoking that person once was all he needed to be a goner.
“Mountain Master Tian Yuan! Listen to me, listen to me!” Kunpeng resisted the extreme pain of his primal spirit’s destruction, and hoarsely said quickly, “I don’t know what happened in the past. I really didn’t know! It wasn’t me who instructed it. Let me go and I will tell you the secret of the Holy Dao!”
“The secret of the Holy Dao?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan curled his lips and said coldly, “If I do not take my revenge, even if my heads are clear of thoughts, why would I still ponder on the Holy Dao? Kunpeng, even if God himself comes today, you are still sure to die!”
With that said, he looked at Jiang Ming in the distance and nodded.
Jiang Ming cupped his hands to greet him.
It was just that the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate had extremely ugly expressions on their faces.
They thought that it would be smooth sailing to rescue Kunpeng. Who knew that they would first encounter such a dauntless person like Jiang Ming, and then Mountain Master Tian Yuan appearing right after? The two were really two slaps right on their faces.
The two looked at each other and were about to go and stop the Mountain Master Tian Yuan, but was blocked by Jiang Ming, “You two! Are you leaving just like that?”
His tone was cold, and there were four large Great Overarching Dao Vessels suspended in front of him, each of which gave off terrifying luminance, as if they would explode at any time.
Jiang Ming also checked the ‘Status’ of the two Demon Venerates.
They were all Demon Venerates from the Abyss, and their ‘Relationship’ with him was around minus 90. What did that mean? It meant that as long as there was a chance, they would definitely kill him.
Also, it had been made clear just now that saving Kunpeng made them his mortal enemy, and yet these two did not take him seriously at all.
However, he discovered their purpose of saving Kunpeng from the ‘Status’ of these Demon Venerates.
They were in contact before, and Kunpeng wanted to make these two secretly subdue under himself at the cost of knowing the secrets about the Holy Realm.
There was even a hidden place of the Holy Venerates Dao Square that they could go seek for benefits together in the future.
It just so happened that when Jiang Ming was trapped in the Seven-Star Array Formation, Kunpeng felt a little uneasy, and found that these two were also on the Infinite Realm Battlefield. The two of them were on a higher-level battlefield, and so he informed them to come over.
Otherwise, how could they rush over so quickly?
Upon descending into this world and going through so many things, Jiang Ming believed in the truth of this world that if they were to be enemies, they would be his mortal enemies.
If the enemy could not kill him, then he will be the one killing them off.
“Such bravery, little one!” Hong Luo Demon Venerate was furious, and a palace burst out above his head. Its power radiated around, covering the entire surroundings.
Meanwhile, the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate took a glance and quickly left.
“Are you really not afraid?” Jiang Ming didn’t move, but a Nine Level Golden Pagoda appeared above his head, as he held onto the Mystical Arcane Halberd with four large Great Overarching Dao Vessels suspended midair in front of him.
Hong Luo Demon Venerate’s heart was beating wildly, but how could he show any weakness?
He had also discussed with the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate just now that if this little guy was still unyielding, he would block him off here. They won’t aim to kill off the enemy, but just seek for their own protection and block him off.
“We don’t have any grudges, do we?” Hong Luo Demon Venerate forced out an ugly smile, “Everything is negotiable.”
Jiang Ming also smiled, “True. It’s negotiable!”
However, his eyes turned over to Mountain Master Tian Yuan, whilst he also looked this way.
The eyes of the two met. Although they did not speak nor did they transmit their voices subconsciously, the two also exchanged information, forming a tacit understanding between them.
Jiang Ming turned his eyes over and looked at Hong Luo Demon Venerate with a raging gleam in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - Great Demon Venerate: I was C*ckolded?
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Great Demon Venerate: I was C*ckolded?
This was a mighty battle as the aftermath swept through the entire Infinite Realm Battlefield. From the low-level battlefield downstream to the ultimate battlefield upstream all felt the waves of destruction here, wave after wave.
It also attracted many strong cultivators to come over and watch the battle.
Up on a white cloud stood a young man wearing a blood colored robe. He watched the battle with relish as his dormant aura was as thick as an abyss. His eyes moved, and he turned to look to the side where a middle-aged man in a dark-golden suit appeared unknowingly.
“Hail the Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate!” The blood-robed youth bowed slightly in great respect.
“Blood Emperor!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerable nodded, “What is going on here? I just arrived at the battlefield above and when I was about to retreat into cultivation, I sensed the shocking fluctuations here.”
“Bei Chenxing of the Starlight Middle Chiliocosm was killed. Beiming Hai, the son of the Northern Emperor, was also killed. The Northern Emperor himself was about to be killed!” As the Blood Emperor listed the names, he quickly explained what he had seen through his primal spirit.
The Blood Emperor was the person the Devil King Xue Tao took refuge under. In fact, he came over early before, but never showed his presence. He also felt very fortunate that he never made a move. Otherwise, he would have had his head planted here today.
Who would have thought that such a shattered and destroyed planar world that had just descended here would have such a great horror in it? It was simply unbelievable.
“To think that such weird things happened!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate was also surprised,” The human planar world, which may hide the treasures of the Ancient Heavenly Court, was invaded by Immortals and Demons one after another. The planar world was destroyed by 19 Devil Kings but 18 of these Devil Kings died. The planar world was led to the Infinite Realm Battlefield by a Great Overarching Dao vessel. Both Immortals and demons of king’s level were dispatched but were all killed by a female expert that appeared. Immediately afterwards, both Bei Chenxing and Beiming Hai died one after another. Kunpeng went in. He may have triggered his own strongest attack but still failed miserably after exhausting all his resources. After Kunpeng escaped, the owner inside, namely Jiang Ming, chased after and killed him. Although the combat power this Jiang Ming displayed was able to compete with Kunpeng, it was far less powerful than what he was capable of in the mortal world.”
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate thought carefully, and easily came to a few conclusions.
There must be secrets hidden in the mortal world that might once be the treasure of the Heavenly Court.
This kid, Jiang Ming, was not of the Great Overarching Realm, but his combat power was comparable to that of a Quasi-Sage Realm. His ability was beyond comprehension and exceeded the norm. Logically speaking, even if he obtained great encounters, he wouldn’t be able to grow to such a level. There must be a huge secret hidden in him.
When he was inside, his combat power was peerless but was comparatively weaker when he was in the outside world. Was it the effect of an Array Formation or a hidden Dao Square that has been evoked? In either case, why was it destroyed without protecting the entire world? Was it because it was just discovered or evoked then? Yes, this must be it.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate placed his hands behind his back, looked into the distance while thinking, and suddenly said, “Kunpeng’s death is inevitable!”
“With the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and Hong Luo Demon Venerate together, he still can’t be saved?” The Blood Emperor hesitated, “Although Mountain Master Tian Yuan is also a Venerate, he became enlightened later compared to the two. How can he be an opponent to them? Does Mountain Master Tian Yuan really dare to kill Kunpeng?”
“Since Mountain Master Tian Yuan said that it was for his revenge, and he had been in hiding for so long, why would he not dare to kill Kunpeng once he grabbed onto the opportunity and even made no secret of it? I’m afraid it’s useless even if the Great Heavenly Venerate is there now.” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate continued, “Trying to save the primal spirit remnant from the hands of a Venerate, no one would be able to manage that unless a Holy Venerate descends. Also, there’s that kid…”
Ghost-Faced Venerate looked at Jiang Ming, frowning slightly, “From the past events you described, it can be seen that this kid is decisive, ruthless and has great resolution. He is also strong and domineering, has no mercy, and will kill all his enemies regardless of their background. Beiming Hai is an example of this. With these successive battles, unless he is at his end, he will definitely make his move. Because this day is the day he first descended into this world, the day that dictates whether or not he can stand firm over here and the day he asserts his dominance. He will make his move. I wonder, will Hong Luo Demon Venerate be able to block him off?”
“This...” The Blood Emperor was surprised, and he couldn’t help nodding after thinking for a while, “Your analysis is as thorough as always. Jiang Ming had been fighting against them one after another. Can he still fight against the Hong Luo Demon Venerate?”
“Aren’t there four Great Overarching Dao vessels in front of him? According to what you said, he can detonate them. In this case, how can Hong Luo stand against them?” Ghost-Faced Venerate couldn’t help shaking his head and cursed, “God damn it! How can there be such a strange and yet powerful special ability in this world? That’s a Great Overarching Dao Vessel for crying out loud. To be able to cause all its power to explode in an instance is beyond incredible. Who can withstand that from now on? I don’t believe he doesn’t need to pay the price for it!”
“He will definitely be paying a price for using such a taboo technique!” The Blood Emperor said, and asked, “If Hong Luo Demon Venerate isn’t able to stand his ground against the kid, will you make your move?”
Ghost-Faced Venerate pinched his chin and muttered, “When he is at his life-and-death situation, I will definitely make my move. After all, he is from our Abyss!”
“What about the kid?” The Blood Emperor pointed.
“Did your heart move?” Ghost-Faced Venerate chuckled lightly.
“Of course I’m excited! What kind of great encounter can make such a being from the planar world to grow to such a level! It’s a pity, I have more than ample desire for it but lack the ability to go for it.”
“Then practice harder!” The Ghost-faced Venerate still did not respond to the question just now.
Over on the other side, the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate had come to the opposite of Mountain Master Tian Yuan, “How about letting the Northern Emperor go? Consider that I owe you a favor for it.”
“A favor to be exchanged for my mortal enemy? Mountain Master Tian Yuan sneered, “What are you?”
The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate suddenly turned gloomy and muttered, “Qian Yuan, you should understand that our Abyss has always been one. Today, I’m not the only one who wants the Northern Emperor, but the entire Abyss wants him. Do you know what it means if you kill him? ”
“It means that you are trying to replace the Great Heavenly Venerate with him!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was even more indifferent. “Sure enough, the wolf cubs from the abyss are all good for nothing. You’ve all long thought of tipping over the Heavenly Court and turning the Heavenly World into a Demon World.”
“Qian Yuan, your slander is too ridiculous!” The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate’s eyes were already spewing with flames, as he already understood that Qian Yuan would not let go at all.
