He quickly changed his way and muttered, “Leave him to me and I swear I will kill Kunpeng. How does that sound? From now on, you will be our most honored guest in the Abyss!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan glanced at Jiang Ming in the distance, and smiled coldly, “Rather than yourself, even if the entire Abyss comes forth today, it still won’t sway my determination to kill Kunpeng! Die!”
The flames in the hands of the Mountain Master Tianyuan suddenly burst into ignition, and burned Kunpeng’s primal soul remnant to the ground.
A Northern Emperor of an era, an ancient force was just killed like that.
“You are courting death!” The Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate was furious, and the spear in his hand was lunged forward without hesitation.
“I’ve been waiting for you!” At that very moment, the obsession in Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s heart completely faded, and his mind relaxed for a while. His whole person felt as if he had seen through everything and could even vaguely see the secrets of a higher realm.
When faced with the attack of the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, he was not afraid at all and took the initiative to lunge towards him.
With a flick of the sword in his hand, boundless sword light broke through the heavens and the earth, pushing the Sword Dao to an extreme level. At the same time, the sword light also contained the power of thunder in it.
A compass appeared under his feet, followed by circles of light appearing, rapidly spreading in 100,000 miles radius. The whole area became totally sealed and imprisoned.
The great battle between the two peerless experts broke up instantly.
As the great battle here commenced, the fight had already begun over at Jiang Ming’s end.
Jiang Ming looked at the Demon Venerable Hong Luo, as his World Projection Technique had already been spread out across the area.
The four Great Overarching Dao Vessels in front of him were on the verge of being detonated, which caused his opponents to be in a constant state of fear.
The two continued to stare down at each other like this.
Demon Venerable Hong Luo originally thought that Jiang Ming would not make his move. After all, how could there be no damage to him after such continuous battles? There was also another Venerate in the area as well. Moreover, he had an entire abyss as his support.
However, when Kunpeng was killed, he suddenly heard Jiang Ming shout, “Hong Luo, the fact that you seduced the Great Demon Venerate’s concubine has been discovered!”
“What?” Demon Venerable Hong Luo was startled, as his mind turned into shock, and his facial expression changed wildly.
‘Great chance!’ Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up, and ten clones appeared around him at the same time.
The moment these clones appeared, all of them ignited their immortal essence at the same time, evoking the Time and Space Confinement technique.
One wave after another were launched at the Demon Venerate, forming a time-space seal onto him.
As for what he just shouted? He obviously saw it from the Demon Venerate’s ‘Status’ in the Human Path Record.
This Demon Venerate was so bold to dare to even seduce the concubine of the Great Demon Venerate.
Those who did not know who the Great Demon Venerate was, might feel indifferent about the news. However, the Great Demon Venerable was the number one expert of the abyss, and his status there was comparable to that of the Great Heavenly Venerate in the Heavenly Court.
How could Hong Luo not be shocked when such deeds of his were discovered?
“That’s not good!” Although his mind was shaken by the sudden news, his reaction was still extremely fast. After all, Demon Venerable Hong Luo was still one of the Quasi-Sage experts. Black lights rushed out of his body, and the magic palace above his head was going to rain down waves upon waves of demonic flames, but it was still a step too late.
His body was frozen for just a slight moment, followed by total imprisonment.
As Hong Luo’s power collided with the power of confinement, Jiang Ming’s Mythical Arcane Halberd had already arrived just when he was about to break free.
The strike was embedded with the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique, brandished into an extremely powerful attack as Jiang Ming went all out.
As the tip of the halberd penetrated between Hong Luo’s eyebrows, his head was pierced through directly. The power contained in the attack immediately destroyed his primal spirit and decimated his true spirit.
Demon Venerable Hong Luo died tragically on the spot.
After Jiang Ming kept Hong Luo’s corpse and the trophies from the battle, he did not stop at all and launched himself after the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate.
When he looked at Mountain Master Tian Yuan just now, the two of them immediately came to a tacit understanding.
Jiang Ming: You were able to capture Kunpeng because of my help. Consider it as me repaying the previous favor.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan: No, this kind of favor is too great. Conversely, I now owe you a favor.
Jiang Ming: Alright then! Help me kill these two Demon Venerates so that I can assert my dominance here. Will you?
Mountain Master Tian Yuan: I Shall. I can keep one of them occupied at most. Are you sure you can kill one?
Jiang Ming: Yes!
The two of them seemed to have a heart-to-heart connection, and when they looked at each other, they understood each other’s thoughts.
This place already belonged to the Heavenly Realm and teleportation had been restricted. Even so, Jiang Ming’s speed was still very fast.
When he was still thousands of miles away from the Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, he conjured ten clones again. However, their faces were already very pale.
Although his immortal essence was endless, the toll onto the power of his mind was immense after such consecutive battles.
“Die!” Jiang Ming shouted loudly.
Just as the ten clones were about to launch their attacks, he saw a stream of light flashing through, and all his avatars were cut down immediately.
He raised his hand and used the Mythical Arcane Halberd to block off the attack, but was still blown across the sky thousands of miles away due to the impact.
A middle-aged man appeared not far away, stretched out his hand and grabbed midair. A sickle was seen returning into his hands.
“You actually killed Hong Luo in such a short period of time! What great techniques!” The expert who launched the attack was none other than the Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate with a gloomy look on his face, “You haven’t entered the Great Overarching Realm, yet your methods are already sky-defying and the profoundness of your primal spirit leaves people in pure despair. You even have all kinds of unbelievable forbidden special abilities that even an unprepared Venerate might get killed with just a single blow. Jiang Ming! You are amazing! Truly amazing! If you continue to grow like this, I am afraid that even the Great Heavenly Venerate will be restless.”
He thought that even if Hong Luo Demon Venerate was no match for Jiang Ming, he would be able to at least hold on for a while longer.
After all, Hong Luo was prepared. Hence he would be able to defend himself a little against the self-destruction of a Dao vessel. Dying should’ve been difficult.
Who knew that Jiang Ming would have such a special ability that ended up with him being too late for the rescue?
In particular, it didn’t matter whether what Jiang Ming said about Hong Luo seducing the Great Demon Venerate’s beloved concubine was true or false, it was a taboo.
As his anger was raging in his heart, his murderous intent sky-rocketed.
However, he was calmer, especially after seeing the four Great Overarching Dao Vessels appearing in front of Jiang Ming again.
“The Great Heavenly Venerate will definitely be restless!” Jiang Ming held the halberd and smiled slightly, “In order to improve himself further, he didn’t even care about his beloved concubine’s affair with Hong Luo. And for what? It was to take one step further towards pulling down the Great Heavenly Venerate from his position. Are you demons of the Abyss ready to wage war against the Heavenly Court already? ”
You tried to incite me with words and praise me for my abilities. Well then, I will use words to smother your hearts and put you onto the pathway to death. Let’s see who’s afraid of who! You’re nothing but only a…
When Jiang Ming saw the opponent’s cultivation realm, his heart sank: This is not an ordinary Demon!
Goddamnit! This was troublesome!

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 1)
Heavenly Court...
The Great Heavenly Venerate was looking at the World Monitoring Mirror.
Upon seeing Kunpeng’s physical body destroyed and his soul burned in the Pure Yang Flame by Mountain Master Tian Yuan, he shook his head. “The Northern Emperor is a goner!”
“Yeah,” Star Lord Taibai chimed in before continuing hesitantly, “Your Majesty, he is, after all, the Northern Emperor of the Heavenly Court. If we just stand aside and not do anything after he’s killed, I’m afraid it’ll affect our prestige…”
The Great Heavenly Venerate did not make any comment on the statement and said, “I had no idea that that human man Jiang Ming was able to bring out all the power of the Great Overarching Dao Vessel. When he unleashed all the power at once, it’s like a Great Overarching expert blowing himself up. What kind of forbidden technique is that? Have you seen it before?”
Star Lord Taibai fell into a contemplation for a while before shaking his head. “Nope. Maybe…”
The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded.
Both of them thought about the “legacy” behind Jiang Ming.
“I didn’t expect there’d be such a feud between Mountain Master Tian Yuan and the Northern Emperor!” Star Lord Taibai lamented when he heard the voice from the World Monitoring Mirror. “It’s no wonder that the Mountain Master refuses to take in any disciple, so this is the reason. That being said, the Northern Emperor is truly a poor person. Not only did his son breed enmity with the Mountain Master, but he also was killed by Jiang Ming after provoking him. When he came to avenge his son’s death, he got defeated by Jiang Ming instead. Just as he thought he was saved when two Demon Venerates came to his rescue, he fell into Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s hands. Sigh, karma, this is all karma. You reap what you sow, so the Northern Emperor can’t blame anyone for his ending.”
Suddenly, the Great Heavenly Venerate squinted his eyes as he gazed at Jiang Ming and Hong Luo Demon Venerate.
“Hong Luo has cuckolded the Great Demon Venerate?” Star Lord Taibai was shocked, “How is that possible? There’s no way he would have the guts to do that! Oh my gosh! How shocking this is. If it gets out, Hong Luo would be done for!”
“The Great Demon Venerate, huh?” A hint of coldness crossed the Great Heavenly Venerate’s face.
Then, they saw Jiang Ming throw himself at Hong Luo and kill him in one strike.
“Hiss!” Star Lord Taibai took a sharp breath, “Jiang Ming deliberately distracted Hong Luo with words and then trapped him with time and space forbidden technique so that he could kill him before he could even retaliate. What a manipulative man and what a powerful move. Nobody would be able to survive a fight with him without knowing what he is capable of. But how did he know the relationship between Hong Luo Great Venerate and the Great Demon Venerate’s wife? Judging from Hong Luo’s reaction, it doesn’t seem like he’s lying.”
“I don’t understand either,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said. Then, his pupils suddenly constricted and shouted, “Hold on for a second! How is there any possibility that the Great Demon Venerate wouldn’t know about the relationship between Hong Luo and his wife. How long have we not heard from him?”
“Please hold on for a second,” Star Lord Taibai replied as he closed his eyes. After a short while, he opened his eyes again and answered, “A whole 12 million years. Although from time to time there is news of the Great Demon Venerate, now that I think about it, those are just fake news to sidetrack me. So that’s the reason his wife is meeting Hong Luo behind his back? Since he has been in seclusion for so long?”
“A whole 12 million years,” The Great Heavenly Venerate mumbled and fell into thought, his face stern.
Star Lord Taibai thought of something and he shuddered.
In the next second, they saw Jiang Ming rush toward Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, who was locked in a fierce melee with Mountain Master Tian Yuan. At this moment, Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate appeared and stood in front of Jiang Ming.
The conversation between them made Star Lord Taibai’s face turn even paler.
“The Abyss…” The Great Heavenly Venerate mumbled. In the next moment, a ray of golden light shot out from his eyes and a sheet of immortal gold paper containing heavenly might appeared in front of him . He then opened his mouth and gave out his order, “The Northern Emperor plotted against the Heavenly Court. His evil plan was uncovered and killed by Jiang Ming in the mortal world. Not only has Jiang Ming defended the prestige of the Heavenly Court, but he also has great virtue and can be the first choice for the new Northern Emperor of the Heavenly Court. We will observe him for a hundred years, and if he does not do anything that crosses the line, he will be the new Northern Emperor.
“This is my first order. Run a thorough investigation into the Abyss, for the demon venerates try to save the rebellious Northern Emperor!
“This is my second order. The Great Abyss Trial will be opened in advance.
“This is my third order. Run a thorough investigation over the Northern Emperor Palace!”
Dao inscriptions began to appear on the golden paper.
Looking at the golden papers, Star Lord Taibai bowed to the Great Heavenly Venerate and asked, “Your Majesty, shall we deliver the order now?”
“Let’s investigate the Northern Emperor Palace first,” the Great Heavenly Venerate said coldly, “We’ll deliver the remaining three orders after the fight is over!”
“Yes, Your Majesty!’ Star Lord Taibai said and went away to deliver the message.
“Northern Emperor, you’re also an ancient being, a Quasi-Sage Great Monarch who’s well respected by the masses. Even until now, I still can’t figure out your intention of having a son. Even if you want to have a son, that’s fine as well. You just need to educate him well, but you did not. You didn’t raise him into a fine person, and you doted on him. What’s more, you even helped him to clean his mess whenever he stirred up trouble. And see what you’ve gotten yourself into now. Not only are you dead, but you’re charged with the offense of trying to overthrow the Heavenly Court and all of your family members will also be executed!
“Although Jiang Ming managed to severely injure the Northern Emperor, it was Mountain Master Tian Yuan who dealt the final blow to him. However, the Great Heavenly Venerate treats as if it’s Jiang Ming who killed the Northern Emperor and makes him into a candidate of the next Northern Emperor. Is he trying to show other people that he’s someone who appreciates talent? Heh, I’m certain that news about Jiang Ming would spread across the universe, but why… Why is there an uneasy feeling inside of me?
“The Great Abyss Trial is about to open as well. Just what the Great Heavenly Venerate is thinking? After the trial, it would be the blood trial, which means a full-scale war is nigh. This is so scary!
“Sigh! I shouldn’t think about so many things. After all, I’m nothing but a messenger.”
Star Lord Taibai told himself and then went to do his bidding.

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 2)
A few moments later, the stars began to move and seal the Northern Emperor’s territory. They began a thorough investigation, arresting and killing those who were found guilty.
The Infinite Realms Battlefield.
After listening to what Jiang Ming said, Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s pupils constricted despite his expression remaining the same.
Seizing his chance, Jiang Ming hastily checked his status.
Name: Ghost-Faced (Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate）
Race: Evil Demon.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation base: Quasi-Sage.
Background: The Fourth Demon Venerate of the Abyss in the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Relationship: -91.
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage.
Status: The Abyss was a place pervaded with evil energy and was the birthplace of countless demon races. There was a race known as the Evil Demons. They had a gruesome and hideous appearance. They were incapable of kindness. They were cruel, and they thirsted for blood.
In the Evil Demon Abyss, there were countless Blood Fury Abysses, which would breed the most primitive form of the Evil Demon. For each gestation, as soon as they grew larger, they would begin to kill and devour each other.
Eventually, there would only be one Evil Demon in each Abyss, and that Evil Demon would be the most powerful, the most brutal, the most cunning, and the most terrifying.
The Evil Demons only had male in their race. They could be born naturally, but they needed to steal females from other races, and then once the ghost babies were born, they would eat the mother.
After consuming thousands of his brethren, Ghost-Faced entered the ancestral land of the Evil Demon Race to cultivate. When he stepped into the Devilish Soldier Realm that was equivalent to that of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, he was released to the world outside to sharpen his skills.
He grew up easily by killing and devouring other people. He could enter the Golden Immortal Realm, but he needed some opportunities if he wanted to go further into his cultivation.
He had gone through a lot of death-or-life situations.
When he became a demon lord, he was surrounded and forced to enter a dangerous place. After he fell into a time rift, he came across a strand of the essence of the Abyss by chance. He swallowed it, and his combat prowess increased by leaps and bounds.
He killed countless of Evil Demons, and eventually, he became a Demon Venerate. Afterward, he slain an expert from the Fo Sect in the Infinite Realms Battlefield. He was hunted by the Fo Sect, so he had no other choice but to run back into the Abyss.
Ten billion years later, he once again showed himself in the advanced Infinite Realms Battlefield. He gravely wounded a monk in the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage to tell the world that he had reached the middle stage of the Demon Venerate Realm. However, before he could kill the monk. Buddha arrived and injured him. He ran away and hid in the Abyss. He had opened up a Dao Square, accepting disciples while keeping a low profile.
In the meantime, he was invited by the Great Demon Venerate. The Great Demon Venerate invited him to join his crusade against the Heavenly Court.
The Abyss had been suppressed by the Heavenly Court, and the demons that dwelled in the Abyss had long wanted to overthrow the Heavenly Court.
In the past, the Saint Lord had absolute authority over the universe, but the Abyss had only one lord of itself. They were repressed by the Heavenly Emperor, so they worked with the Fo Sect to split themselves from the Heavenly Realm so that they wouldn’t be restricted by the Heavenly Realm anymore. However, just when they were on the verge of overthrowing the Heavenly Court, the Fo Sect turned their coat and joined forces with the Great Heavenly Venerate to kill the Great Demon Venerate. If it were not for the remaining several demon venerates joining forces to threaten the Heavenly Court by stating they would bury the Heavenly Court together with the Abyss, the Abyssal Demons would have ceased to exist.
That war was known as the Abyssal Blood Tribulation
Afterward, a new Great Demon Venerate came to power to manage the Abyss. The world was still in a chaotic state. The Great Heavenly Venerate allowed the existence of the Abyss, but at the same time, it also had become the trial ground of the disciples from different sects. They were allowed to enter the perimeter of the Abyss once every million years to carry out their trials. For every 100 million years, a great trial will be carried out. They could go whenever they wanted in the Abyss except for the core.
The Great Demon Venerate was not happy about it, and it had been planning to overthrow the Heavenly Court. In his opinion, they were demons. If they couldn’t be the master of their own destiny, they should’ve just perished.
After he joined him, he began to show up in many places such as the Infinite Realms Battlefield to enslave some key figures. At the same time, they also maintained a good relationship with the experts from different Heavenly Realms so that they could get more information about the Heavenly Court.
Kunpeng was one of their allies, and he was heartbroken when he learned that he was dead.
He came to the Infinite Realms Battlefield once again to look for the ancient dragon. He wanted to know what the dragon race thought about the Heavenly Realm. Then, he detected a terrifying power coming from the battlefield below, so came to take a look.
He did not expect that he would come across something like this.
A human man had killed a Quasi-Sage? It was an impossible feat considering his cultivation level, so he was certain that this man must have some secret on him.
He was also shocked to find out that Hong Luo had been meeting the wife of the Great Demon Venerate, but he wondered where Jiang Ming learned it from.
Could it be that the Great Demon Venerate was aware of the relationship between Hong Luo and his wife the entire time? The reason he did not expose them was that he had something else more important stuff to take care of? Even though they were demons, they couldn’t stand this kind of thing as well. If he couldn’t even handle his own wife, then how was he going to overthrow the Heavenly Court?
He hoped that the Great Demon Venerate did not know about it. He decided to test the Great Demon Venerate after he came out of his seclusion.
As for Jiang Ming, he wanted to kill him right now for slinging mud at the Great Demon Venerate and the Abyss. At the same time, he wanted to show the world that this was what they would end up for discrediting the Abyss!

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 3)
That being said, he did not let his guard down, for he did not know what kind of tricks Jiang Ming was capable of.
Jiang Ming was dumbfounded after he had read through Ghost-Faced’s status. He did not expect that he would get so much useful information such as the Abyss was planning to rebel against the Heavenly Court from him.
It was something he made up, but it turned out to be right.
‘D*mn it!’ He cussed inwardly.
It was also because of this that Ghost-Faced, no, the entire Abyss wanted to kill him.
“How dare you!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerated snarled, “How dare you sling mud at the Great Demon Venerate and the Abyss. Jiang Ming, if I don’t kill you today, everyone will laugh at all of us from the Abyss!
“Now, accept your death!”
After that, he swung the death scythe in his hand at Jiang Ming.
“That’s fast!”
Jiang Ming’s pupils constricted and he tried to parry the attack with his halberd but to no avail. The collision had sent him flying far into the air, and even his bones were cracking.
“Die!”
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate leaped into the air and appeared before him. He swung his scythe in a mighty downward swipe, and Jiang Ming could see nothing but a streak of darkness that flitted before his vision.
“Worldly Repression!” Jiang Ming hastily activated the Worldly Projection. However, it only stopped Ghost-Faced for a while before he started moving again.
The Nine Level Golden Pagoda was floating above his head, sprinkling golden light on him. He held the Mystical Arcane Halberd in front of his chest, trying to defend himself but it was a futile attempt.
Once again, he was sent flying into the distance.
“The World Dao? Incredible. However, since you’ve killed a Demon Venerate from the Abyss, you have to die today!” As Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate said, he delivered another attack at Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming frowned.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerat was too strong. He was totally out of his league.
Jiang Ming glanced at Mountain Master Tian Yuan in the distance. He was still fighting Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, and it seemed to Jiang Ming that it would take some time before their fight would end.
While his brain was spinning fast, an eye appeared in front of him. It was the Eye of Doom he had gotten from the Lord God’s beneficiary.
It emitted a destructive light and barely stopped the attack.
“Die!” Jiang Ming activated the power of his Primal Spirit as he shouted. In the meantime, he also delivered a message into Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s heart.
The old man looked toward Jiang Ming. He frowned and nodded slightly.
“Die? Me?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate gave out a cold sneer. He swung his scythe again, and 30 clones appeared around him. All of them were holding a scythe in their hands, and they were all swinging their scythes at him.
Each scythe was carried with a terrifying power.
Jiang Ming’s Worldly Projection shrunk violently before spreading out rapidly, forming a shield around him at the same time. Meanwhile, he threw a sword at his back and detonated it instantly.
Baam!
The explosion caused by the Great Overarching Dao Vessel set off a torrent of destructive waves that struck the target directly behind it.
However, Jiang Ming was struck by the scythes of the remaining 29 clones. They broke through the defense of the Nine Level Golden Pagoda, leaving one after another deep cuts on his body.
Then, those clones disappeared.
“You’re using the Incarnation Dao too?!’ Jiang Ming gritted his teeth.
He locked on to Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s true form through the Human Paths Record. However, those clones were powerful, but the good thing was that there was a limit to it. Had it not been for his defensive special item as well as his strong physique, he would’ve been dead by now.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate was sent flying all the way into the distance. He was in a mess, and his battle armor was in a tattered state.
“Die!” Jiang Ming looked into the distance and activated his Worldly Projection, the Mystical Arcane Halberd, and the Eye of Doom.
“Great move, kid! But it’s going to take more than that to take me down!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted and countered all of Jiang Ming’s attacks, causing the latter’s face to turn pale.
Meanwhile, Mountain Master Tian Yuan was struck by Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, but he had broken through the latter’s defense as well. Under the help of the Worldly Projection, ten clones appeared and they restrained Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate with Time Space Confinement Technique.
Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate was dumbfounded and his face turned pale in fear.
“Die!”
Seizing his chance, Mountain Master Tian Yuan pierced through his opponent’s forehead without any hesitation.
It was difficult to find out the winner and the loser between the battle of Quasi-Sages. Even if one could defeat the other, killing him or her was near impossible.
After all, both had many special abilities or special items with them, and it was near impossible to kill one another.
However, none of them had expected that Jiang Ming would work with Mountain Master Tian Yuan and take down one Demon Venerate.
After Mountain Master Tian Yuan had struck down Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate, he collected all his stuff and headed toward Jiang Ming’s direction.
“D*mn it!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted angrily.
He did not believe that Jiang Ming still had the capability to assist Mountain Master Tian Yuan to kill his comrade while fighting him.
It was considered a humiliation for him that his comrade died before his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Trial and Blood Trial, Order of the Venerate, Rebel Against the Heavenly Court (Part 4)
“All of you are going to die here!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s face twisted grotesquely as demonic fog began to appear behind him which swiftly turned into a world of darkness. They could hear the howling as well as see the silhouettes of ghosts weaving here and there. All of them were wailing and roaring in pain, but they couldn’t get out of there.
“Die!”
Enveloping his scythe with the power of curse, he swung his scythe in a mighty downward swipe at Jiang Ming.
“Watch out! That’s his Evil Demon Curse! It can destroy your mind and willpower!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan shouted as he arrived beside Jiang Ming. He brandished his sword and countless lighting showered down from the sky above, turning the area around them into a sea of thunder and lightning. It should have been able to fight back against Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s attack, but nobody knew what happened, his attack was overwhelmed by Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s.
Bam…
Mountain Master Tian Yuan flew backward with blood lining on the corner of his lips. His facial features contorted out of shape. He opened his mouth suddenly and black blood and mist gushed out.
That was the power of curse.
“The power of curse is truly powerful. As expected of the Ghost-Faced!”
He glanced at Jiang Ming and he was stunned.
Even though Jiang Ming was hit by Ghost-Faced’s attack, he remained unaffected.
“How could that be?” Both Mountain Master Tian Yuan and Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate were confused.
“Why are you not affected by the power of curse?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate asked, “This is the Evil Demon Curse I developed after consuming millions of souls. It’s also one of my strongest special abilities. It can affect someone who’s on the same level as me, and even if you have the inner world, you can’t escape from this attack, so why doesn’t it work on you?”
“Ever since ancient times, evil will never prevail over good. I represent the justice side, so that evil trick of yours will never work on me! Today, I must take you down so that the people who died in your hands could rest in peace!” Jiang Ming harrumphed coldly.
However, he sighed inwardly. Fortunately, he called the Human Paths Record back into his sea of consciousness in time to guard against the attack.
If not, other than the blessing from the Supreme Order, there was no way he could defend himself against that attack.
Even though the attack did not touch him, he felt his entire being was shaking just by standing near to it.
“What is evil? And What is good?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted furiously, “Will by killing you make me good? If that’s the case, then I’ll have to kill you today!
“Now, prepare to die!” He shouted and threw another attack at Jiang Ming.
The black fog rolled over, trying to envelop Jiang Ming in its darkness world.
Jiang Ming took out a Dao Vessel. It was the Moon Essence Wheel, and he detonated it again.
Jiang Ming’s face turned as pale as a sheet and he had gotten a lot weaker.
“Let’s run!” He shouted and darted straight toward the Tianyuan Realm.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan followed after him without any hesitation.
After all, he did not have the confidence that he could come out safely from the explosion of a Great Overarching Dao Vessel.
Boom…
A torrent of destructive waves swept across the area.
The Tianyuan Sea below them had long become an abyss. They could also vaguely see the chains in the depths of video that kept the battlefield from falling apart.
“Another explosion?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate said as he emerged from the explosion. There were wounds here and there on his body, but all of them were not life-threatening.
His face was twisted with rage and his eyes were spewing fire.
“Run? Where do you think you can run to?” He sneered coldly.
“Demon Venerate, wait!” Blood Emperor came and shouted.
“Why?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate turned his head around and his expression was cold, sending a chill down Blood Emperor’s spine. He was confident that if he couldn’t give him a reasonable explanation, he would kill him instantly.
After all, this venerate was not a good guy at all.
He chidded himself inwardly for being a busybee, but he put on a smile and hastily explained, “Demon Venerate, I saw with my own eyes that after entering it, Kunpeng came out in a mess and even suffered a serious injury!”
“Kunpeng?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate frowned and then he sneered, “He’s an arrogant man, so I can see why he would fall into his trap. But I’m different. I already know all of Jiang Ming’s moves and I’m prepared for them. There’s nothing he could use to harm me!”
After he had finished speaking, he continued to move forward.
Honestly, he was hesitant as well. However, if he did not do something about everything that happened today, he would lose all his prestige and those in the Abyss would laugh at him.
Blood Emperor opened his mouth, but he did not say anything anymore. He looked toward the Tianyuan Realm.
In the meantime, Jiang Ming had already entered the Tianyuan realm. He turned his head around, and Blood Emperor did not know why, but his blood suddenly ran cold.
He hastily took a few steps back.
“This man is too scary. He looks more like a demon than a demon. If he can survive through this fight, I must get as far away as possible from him!” Blood Emperor said.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming and Mountain Master Tian Yuan had entered the Tianyuan Realm.
Jiang Ming let out a sigh of relief.
He looked toward the outside. Initially, he thought Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate would come in, but he stopped outside. He lifted his scythe and struck down again.
“D*mn it! How can he be so cautious?” Jiang Ming cursed.
“I can hold him back for some time. You should get yourself packed, and then we’ll run,” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said as he floated into the air.
“Don’t worry, Senior. Now that we’ve come back here, there’s nothing you should worry about. I can fight toe to toe with the Great Demon Venerate right now, let alone Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate.”
After he had finished speaking, he came in front of Mountain Master Tian Yuan and threw his Mystical Arcane Halberd into the hair,
“This…” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was stunned. “I didn’t expect that you still have something like this up your sleeves. How long can it hold?”
“Senior, it can hold as long as I’m here.”
“Really?”
“Yes!”
“Alright then! I’ll trust you this time!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said. He looked around, and upon realizing that no one here was affected by Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s attack, he was relieved. “It’s fate that brought us together. You don’t need to call me senior anymore, just call me brother.”
“Alright, brother!’ Jiang Ming nodded.
Their relationship had reached 90 points, which was only attainable if he was someone very close to him. Jiang Ming did not know why since this was the first time they met each other.
“That’s more like it!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan nodded. Then, he pointed toward the outside. “What if he comes in?”
“I can fight him. Besides, I’m sure we can kill him this time if we work together.”
Both of them discussed for a while and turned toward Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, who was still attacking them from the outside tirelessly.
On the outside, Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate stopped his attack.
“Is it a formation? Or is it a Dao Square he got after Saint Lord left? I can’t see through it no matter how much I try. Should I go in? The fact that Kunpeng could come out after he went in means that it’s not strong on the inside. Since I’m prepared, I’m sure I won’t end up like Kunpeng.” He thought for a short while before making up his mind.
“I think I should go in. Even if I couldn’t kill him this time, I can figure out what is going on inside and I can prepare myself better when I come to take his life next time. Besides, that old thing is coming, so there’s nothing I should worry about.”
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate made up his mind and went into the Tianyuan Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - Total Annihilation, Evil-Hearted
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Total Annihilation, Evil-Hearted
The Infinite Realms Battlefield was large.
Even though it was just the intermediate Infinite Realms Battlefield, it still spanned millions of miles away. However, there were plenty of experts gathered up here to witness this great battle.
Most of them began to know that the young man who fought against the demon venerate was none other than Jiang Ming, a living being born in a planar world.
After his world was destroyed by the demon, it was pulled toward the Infinite Realms Battlefield. Afterward, Jiang Ming began to show his might by killing several immortal lords, immortal kings, and demon venerates.
He even killed Kunpeng, the Northern Emperor, and two demon venerates.
All of these people were extraordinarily powerful, but three of them had fallen today. Everyone was shocked and all of them wondered how someone from a planar world could be so strong. If he was really this powerful, then why would he allow his world to get destroyed?
There was a rumor saying that he had inherited the remnants of the Primeval Heavenly Court. He had been cultivating in it, so he couldn’t come out in time to save his world from destruction.
Some of them also said that he had gotten the legacy of the ancient Saint lord as well as the Holy Venerates Dao Square.
But no matter what, Jiang Ming held the secret that could allow people to achieve greatness overnight.
If not, why would Beiming Hai and the Northern Emperor come for him? Why would the Demon Venerate show up here and kill so many people?
These rumors were spreading fast, and very soon, everyone in the Tianyuan Realm had learned about them.
Tianyuan Realm.
Jiang Ming’s eyebrows twitched looking at Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate.
He did not expect that he really had the guts to come straight at him despite knowing the danger of his action.
He squinted his eyes, channeling the power of the Holy Venerates Dao Square to form a shield around the land. After all, he did not have the confidence that he could keep everyone safe when the battle broke out later.
“Are you ready, brother?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Rest assured. I’m more than willing to sacrifice my own life if I can take this old b*stard down today!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan laughed.
“It isn’t that easy to die here! Here goes!’ Jiang Ming said and grabbed something in the air. The power from the Holy Venerate Dao Square surged forward and enveloped Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, who was trying to break in.
“What…” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate was stunned and his face turned pale.
He had already mentally prepared for it. Before he came in here, he clad himself in his black fog. Those evil spirits and the power of curse seemed to have their own shapes as they slalomed around him. This was a demon domain, and there were even two demonic vessels inside of it.
One of them was a black flag while another was a mirror. Both of them were Quasi-Sage Weapons.
However, at this moment, he felt his movements were greatly restricted as the immense power poured onto him.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate lifted his head to see that Jiang Ming was rushing toward him. There were four Great Overarching Immortal Weapons in front of him. All of them were emitting a brilliant light, and they were coming straight at him at full speed.
“D*mn it!’ Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted. “Evil Demon Curse, heed my call. Transform into a great being and crush my foe!”
Upon his command, the black fog suddenly shrunk and turned into a giant of several thousands meters tall. There were human figures covering from the giant’s head to its toe. All of the human figures were wailing, screaming, and it was a horrifying sight.
Immediately afterwards, this giant exploded, turning into a monstrous torrent of power to fight against the suppressive force from all directions and simultaneously clash with the four Great Overarching Immortal Weapons.
Bam!
In an instant, the light of destruction annihilated everything. Laws, rules, everything that was tangible or intangible were all destroyed.
Even if Jiang Ming tried his best to divert the destructive force upward, it still formed into a terrifying storm that swept over the land below him.
“I shouldn’t have used such a powerful move here!” Jiang Ming said. He moved the people in that region away to save them from being caught in the storm.
In the meantime, he grabbed something in front of them, once again channeling the power of the Holy Venerate Dao Square to bind Ghost-Faced Demon Generate, who was trying to run away, in place.
“What kind of power is this?” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted, his face pale.
“It took my Evil Demon Curse and the evil spirits that I’ve collected for more than a billion years to break myself free from the restraint now, and now… Demon God Body, Blood Explosion, attack! Black Demon Flag, Heaven Ghost Mirror, hurry up and protect me… Ahhh…”
He shouted as he got engulfed by Jiang Ming’s attack and pushed out of the Tianyuan Realm.
There was a group of experts watching the battle from the outside. They saw that Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate rushed into the Tianyuan Realm, and then the situation suddenly changed. Although they couldn’t see clearly what was happening, they could clearly feel a terrifying power from inside.
In the next second, they saw Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate getting hurled out of the Tianyuan Realm followed by Jiang Ming and Mountain Master Tian Yuan. Both of them flew into the sky, charging toward Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate. All of them looked at each other in shock.
They couldn’t understand the thing that had just transpired before their eyes. Even if Jiang Ming was able to command his Great Overarching Dao Vessels to explode themselves, Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate should be able to dodge or parry the attack easily. How would he be defeated so soon?
“That was one hell of a move, brother!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan exclaimed, “I’m sure even Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate wouldn’t be able to come out unscathed from the attack. We should kill him right now when he’s in his most weakened state. After all, if we’re going to have a war with the Abyss, the less enemy we have, the better it is!”
“Of course, we’ve got to kill him here right now!” Jiang Ming replied decisively.
“Die!” Jiang Ming locked onto Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate and swung his Mystical Arcane Halberd at him.
“This is the end, Ghost-Faced!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan shouted as he cast his ultimate attack at Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate.
Just when their attacks were going to reach their target, a pagoda appeared out of nowhere and blocked both of their attacks.
“This is the Dark Heaven Demon Pagoda!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was stunned, his expression turning serious. He extended his arm to stop Jiang Ming from rushing forward and said, “Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate! I didn’t expect that you’re here as well!’
“If I didn’t come, you guys would’ve killed Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate already!” An old man appeared at the top of the pagoda. He glanced at Jiang Ming and Mountain Master Tian Yuan before grabbing Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate with his hand.
He observed Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate meticulously as the corner of his lips quivered uncontrollably.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate was in a mess. Half of his head, his arms, his legs, his heart were all gone, and there were nothing but only a few rib bones in his chest.
The Black Demon Flag was gone as well.
Even though there was a crack on the Heaven Ghost Mirror, it was still doing its best to protect its master.
Even though the demons could regain their body over time, judging from Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s condition, it was going to take a long time.
“Kill them, Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate!” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate shouted, “They are at the end of their tether. Now is our best chance!”
“I might be able to kill them if I come here earlier, but it’s too late now!” Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate shook his head. “Do you have anything to say?”
“I… I…” Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate gritted his teeth. He hemmed and hawed for a long while, but no words could come out of his mouth.
“If you have nothing else to say, then we should take our leave now,” Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate said. After that, he glanced into the distance, grabbed Ghost-Faced, and went away through a portal.
“We’re going to let them run away just like that?” Jiang Ming hissed.
He had checked through Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate, so he knew that he couldn’t end Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s life today.
Evil-Hearted Demon Venerater was the third Demon Venerate of the Abyss, and he was far stronger than Ghost-Faced.
Right now, both him and Mountain Master Tian Yuan were not in their best condition. Not only that, but there was a strong presence in the distance, and he still did not know if he was their friend or foe.
Therefore, he decided not to do anything rashly despite being disappointed.
“We would be in big trouble if they don’t retreat now!” Mountain master Tian Yuan said. “I can sense the presence of a Great Monarch from the Fo Sect as well as other experts. I guess it’s them who scared Evil-Hearted away.”
“Let’s go back then!”
“Okay!”
Just when they turned around, a golden light descended from the sky and illuminated the entire Infinite Realms Battlefield.
In the next second, an immense pressure came, causing the experts below the Great Overarching Realm to kneel down on one knee and bow down respectfully.
“The Order of the Heavenly Emperor!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan lifted his head and frowned.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - Shocking the Heavenly Emperor, Changes in the Lord God, Sacred Heart Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Shocking the Heavenly Emperor, Changes in the Lord God, Sacred Heart Pill
?
Note: We are really sorry, for the inconvenience everyone. There was a mix-up with the RAWs, so some chapters ended up being merged. Instead, they should be released in parts. We resolved this issue now, so it won’t occur again.
...
The Order of the Heavenly Emperor. It was an order that could only be given out by the Great Heavenly Venerate, which was otherwise known as the Heavenly Emperor.
He had absolute control over the Heavenly Court. He listened to no one, and everyone had to follow his order.
The content of the order was simple. It stated that Jiang Ming had contributed a lot to the Heavenly Court by exposing and taking down the Northern Emperor Kunpeng who tried to rebel against the Heavenly Court. Not only that, but he was powerful enough, so he was picked as the first candidate to be the next Northern Emperor. However, he still needed to be observed for another 100 years.
The heavenly decree was large, and it spanned over 3,000 miles. The Dao inscription on it was clear and it was filled with Dao Fluctuation. The content spread over the entire Infinite Realms Battlefield and to various parts of the Heavenly Realms.
This was the terrifying aspect of the heavenly decree.
Afterward, the heavenly decree turned into a scroll and landed on Jiang Ming’s palm.
“This…” Jiang Ming frowned.
He did not know why but he instinctively disliked the content of the heavenly decree, and he hesitated as he looked at the heavenly decree that fell before him.
He was not sure if he should accept it or not. After all, it was the heavenly decree. Could he reject it?
Just when he was hesitating, Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s voice rang out in his mind. “Take it! You can’t reject the order of the Great Heavenly Venerate. Accept it first, and we’ll then play by ear.”
Jiang Ming then raised both hands and took the heavenly decree. His hands fell and he felt like he was holding a divine mountain.
With a flick of his mind, he flipped his palm and stored the heavenly decree into the Human Paths Record. Before he could check it out, another two heavenly decrees descended from the sky.
One of them told them to investigate the Abyss, while another stated the opening of the Great Abyss Trial.
After that, the two heavenly decrees turned into dots of golden light and merged into the four directions of the sky, spreading the news out rapidly.
“Investigate the Abyss? The opening of the Great Abyss Trial? Things are going to get out of hand!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said as his face set in a serious expression. He nodded into the distance and tugged at Jiang Ming.
“Let’s go back!”
Jiang Ming nodded.
He was exhausted from the battles, and he felt it was safer for him to go back right now.
As for other people, he did not care about them.
Both of them heaved out a sigh of relief after entering the Tianyuan Realm.
“Fortunately, he came. Otherwise, we might be in danger!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “This is truly a special place. Not only do the demons crave it, but the other forces want to take a peek as well. Even the heavenly decree could hardly stop them.”
“Brother, who are you talking about?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Wan Lian Great Monarch. The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in the human world is established by his descendants. You can count it as his legacy!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “It’s him who came just now.
“What?” Jiang Ming exclaimed, “I’m the one who wiped out his descendants. If he finds out, will he come after me.”
“Haha!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan laughed, “Rest assured. He’s not a petty minded person. He cares about the world more than his own descendants. He wouldn’t mind about them as long as they don’t go around and bully other people. For him, they should consider themselves lucky for getting his legacy. He wants them to fare for themselves, and he would never protect them.”
Jiang Ming nodded.
He felt that Mountain Master Tian Yuan did not tell him everything, but now was not the right time to press on the matter.
In the blink of an eye, they had arrived at Chuyang Peak.
“Senior brother!” Linglong threw herself into Jiang Ming’s arms. “I’m worried sick about you!”
When she saw Jiang Ming was injured from his fight against Kunpeng and Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, she wanted to go forward and assist him. However, she was too weak, and she might only cause him trouble than help him, so she held herself back.
The feeling was unbearable and it felt like there were millions of ants gnawing at her heart. She felt like history had repeated itself again.
Her senior brother was standing in front of her to protect her, but there was nothing she could do.
‘I’m still so weak and useless even though I’ve been reborn once.’
Linglong’s heart was dripping blood and she swore to herself that she had to work harder in her cultivation so that she could fight beside Jiang Ming next time.
“Don’t worry. I’m fine!” Jiang Ming rubbed her head.
It was just that after he relaxed, a surge of lethargy and a pang of pain assaulted him. His face turned pale and cold sweats began to ooze out of his forehead.
“Senior brother!” Linglong shouted.
“That’s the aftermath of using those Dao Vessels like bombs,” Moutain Master Tian Yuan said, “You’re wired tight during the war, so you didn’t feel anything. Now that you’ve relaxed, you can’t stop all the pains from coming back to you!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s complexion was pale as well.
“Don’t worry! I’ll be fine!” Jiang Ming forced a smile on his face.
He lifted his head. The sky was dark, and the stars were blinking.
Even if they were in the Infinite Realms Battlefield, even if it was an endless flood of nothingness outside, they could still see stars and moon here. Obviously, there was a power that they couldn’t see through acting in this area.
“You will be fine? Look at you! You can barely stand! Come, senior brother! Let me heal you!” Linglong said as she pulled her into his room.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s eyebrows frowned in confusion.
‘Why does he still need his junior sister around him when he’s healing?’
Jiang Ming patted Linglong’s hand and looked around. He grabbed something in the air, and a house rose from the ground in the southwest of the courtyard. Then, he turned to Mountain Master Tian Yuan and said, “How about you rest and heal in that house over there, brother? We’ll talk after we’ve recovered.”
“Okay!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan nodded. “I have some pills with me. Do you need one?”
“Thank you, brother, but you can keep them for yourself. It isn’t a serious injury after all.”
“Okay. Give me a head up if you need my help!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan leaped into the air and landed in the courtyard not far away. He sat in a lotus position and began healing his wound. He did not set up a formation either.
Jiang Ming came to the kitchen and quickly whipped up two bowls of congee.
Linglong then carried the congee to the table.
She had long since noticed that something wasn’t right. No matter what happened, her senior brother would definitely cook one time a day. Even though she had a lot of questions in her mind, she never asked him anything.
“Senior brother, lie down. I’ll feed you the food!” Linglong said as she pushed Jiang Ming on the chair.
She then picked a bowl of congee, blew it a little, and put the scoop near Jiang Ming’s lips.
He took it and laughed, “As expected of me. The congee is tasty, but I think it’ll be even tastier if you could feed me with your mouth.”
“You…” Linglong rolled her eyes at Jiang Ming. That being said, she still did as he said and fed him the congee with her mouth.
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed.
“This is the best!” Jiang Ming exclaimed as he gave Linglong a thumbs up.
Linglong rolled her eyes at Jiang Ming again and said exasperatingly, “Do you need me to call the remaining nine of them to come and feed you?”
“No, no, no. I’ll die!”
They finished the bowl of congee very soon.
After a short while, he received a notification from the system.
[Ding! Congratulations to host Jiang Ming for enjoying a great breakfast in a weakened state. You have been awarded with a Ten Soul Refining Sacred Heart Pill!]
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up with excitement after he read through the description for the pill.
[Ten Soul Refining Sacred Heart Pill: It’s a supreme pill of wondrous effect. After taking it, it’ll greatly boost one’s soul and willpower, and eliminate all negative states of the soul. Restriction: Can be taken by a Quasi-Sage or below.]
‘This is just what I need!’ Jiang Ming said inwardly.
However, before he could do anything, Linglong had scooped him up from the chair. “Senior brother, let’s go back inside. The Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed can heal your injuries, and ten of us will heal you together!”
“Put me down, Linglong! I’m a man! How can you carry me like this?!” Jiang Ming said as he jumped down from Linglong’s arms.
Linglong rolled her eyes at him. “This isn’t the first time I carry you in my arms.”
After he had regained his balance, he looked around him. He noticed that there were a lot of experts observing them from the dark, but they did not dare to take any action.
This was something he had expected, so he did not care about them.
“I’m going to cultivate in the land of inheritance. I’ll be back in a while!” Jiang Ming said to his junior sister and pointed at Mountain Master Tian Yuan, “If anything happens, just protect yourself and let him go do the job.”
“Okay!” Linglong replied.
Jiang Ming did not say anything anymore and went into the Supreme Pagoda.
Linglong came to the balcony and stood with her back straight. She scanned her surroundings, and her gaze was sharp like an eagle.
The Heavenly Court.
The Great Heavenly Venerate did not leave his throne, and he was still looking at the World Observing Mirror.
He saw Jiang Ming nearly kill Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, and how Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate appeared out of nowhere to save Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate. Then, when he saw Jiang Ming take the heavenly decree, he frowned.
“Where did he keep the heavenly decree? I can’t sense it anymore!” He said, “The heavenly decree communicates with the origin of the universe, and shares the same body as the Heavenly Court. It’s considered part of me, and he has severed the connection? Interesting…” The Great Heavenly Venerate’s eyes glowed.
The scene in the mirror changed to show the different parts in the Heavenly Realm. Many forces had already started to organize their disciples to form a large army to go into the Abyss.
Lord God Space.
Two beneficiaries survived and came back here. Both of them then spread the word about a Golden Immortal human who cultivated the World Dao had slain a Quasi-Sage Great Monarch.
In the Supreme Pagoda.
Jiang Ming came to the lotus platform on the enlightenment sea. He activated the time acceleration, and took the Ten Soul Refining Sacred Heart Pill to start healing himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - The Seven Level, Thousands of Special Abilities, Farewell
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: The Seven Level, Thousands of Special Abilities, Farewell
Jiang Ming was in the Golden Immortal Realm. He had nurtured his inner world to the perfection stage of a small chiliocosm. His origin force was vast and equivalent to that of the Great Overarching Extreme Realm.
The Great Overarching Extreme Realm was the real extreme realm across all universes.
This was the terrifying power one would get after perfecting the small chiliocosm.
Although his realm was low, his inner world was strong. Not only that, but he had mastered all 3,000 laws, and that made Jiang Ming’s soul extraordinarily powerful. However, there was still a limit to how strong his soul could be.
He had used up all his Great Overarching Dao Vessels from the previous fight. Whenever he activated the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment, his soul would receive a recoil damage once, and now, he was at his limit.
After he had taken the Ten Soul Refining Sacred Heart Pill, not only were his wounds healed, but his soul had been greatly boosted and stepped into the next level.
There were strands of gold coiling around his soul.
Jiang Ming opened his eyes and exclaimed, “What an awesome pill!”
His soul was boosted and he now possessed the foundation of the sage soul. In other words, it was like a one way ticket to the Sage Realm for him. If other people were to know about the pill, he was certain that the entire world would fall into chaos.
Even though he had been healed back to his top condition, Jiang Ming still decided to take a rest.
After all, there was no better way to get rid of mental fatigue than sleeping.
“How good it would be if my junior sister was here!”
With that thought in his mind, Jiang Ming fell into slumber.
In the dream, he had formed 30 millions clones and each of them had different shapes…
He only woke up three days later.
He rose to his feet and stretched his body. He felt fresh.
The lotus platform was huge. After he had activated the time acceleration feature, it became even bigger and expanded to nearly 10,000 meters square, which gave him a lot of convenience in his cultivation and it wouldn’t hinder his daily activity.
He took his ingredients out and began cooking himself a feast. After that, he summoned the Supreme Order, but as the order appeared in front of him, he stored it back.
After all, he could not enter the chat group after he activated the time acceleration feature.
“I should’ve exchanged some resources with my group members before starting my cultivation,” Jiang Ming said as he shook his head.
He sat back down in a lotus position and began to go through his fight with the Northern Emperor and those demon venerates.
Even though it seemed like he was powerful enough to slain the Northern Emperor and demon venerates, only he himself knew that he lacked skill and technique that could deliver the final blow.
When he was going through the battle tower, Jiang Ming could defeat all his opponents with his Incarnation Dao and time-space forbidden technique. However, that was because none of his opponents wielded the Quasi-Sage weapons and they did not have any helpers. Even so, he couldn’t go through the second stage of the sixth battle tower.
From here, it was very obvious that he lacked some effective skills when facing a powerful opponent. For example, Bei Chengxing’s great formation, Kunpeng’s Seven Stars Formation, Northern Emperor’s authority, and his helpers, Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate’s Evil Demon Curse and several Quasi-Sage Weapons.
Even if he had the Saint Province Dao Square to help him, he did not have an overwhelming advantage over his opponents.
“I can defeat my opponents with the time-space forbidden technique or the Return of Infinite Law Finger, but if they’re well-prepared, there’s nothing I can do.”
He had the confidence to defeat a Great Overarching Expert, but when it came to a Quasi-Sage, things were different.
Most of his techniques were less effective against them. Even the Holy Civilization Fist he got from Hong Yi or his own Return of Infinite Law Finger were proved to be ineffectual against them.
However, this did not mean that those skills were not powerful. One of the explanations was that his cultivation level was too low.
“My enemies will only get stronger and stronger in the future, and it’s impossible that my inner world would ascend to the next level in such a short amount of time. As for my cultivation level? I could try to cultivate the Taiyi Law, but it wouldn’t help much.”
Jiang Ming fell into thought.
The power of the small chiliocosm was the reason why he could defeat a Quasi-Sage despite him being only a Golden Immortal.
“I guess… If I want to increase my combat prowess in a short time, I can only rely on the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment and the Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
After he had made up his mind, Jiang Ming calmed himself down and began cultivating.
Then, he realized something was different.
“Compared to last time, my cultivation speed has increased by a hundred times!” Jiang Ming was shocked.
“This must be the effect of the Ten Soul Refining Sacred Pill! This is great. I can cultivate even faster now!” Jiang Ming exclaimed delightfully.
After that, he started to comprehend the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment. He had come to the seventh level this time, and he passed it without any difficulty.
“On the seventh level, I can finally detonate Quasi-Sage Weapons!” Jiang Ming said, “But can I bring myself to detonate a Quasi-Sage Weapon?”
Jiang Ming took the Mystical Arcane Halberd out. Feeling the immense strength from it, he shook his head.
He could somehow protect himself from the recoil damage of detonating a Great Overarching Dao Vessels, but what about a Quasi-Sage Weapon?
He was confident that he would kill himself in the explosion as well if he were to detonate a Quasi-Sage Weapon.
He had fully mastered the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment, but he still felt it was not enough.
If he could detonate his own weapons, could he detonate his opponent’s too?
If he could detonate or control his enemy’s Dao Vessels during a fight, it would certainly be able to turn the tide of the battle to his favor.
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed and he continued his cultivation.
This time, he decided to comprehend the Holy Civilization Fist as well as the Return of Infinite Law Finger.
Time was fluttering away.
The fog was dissipating. Jiang Ming opened his eyes, and sighed. He rose to his feet and glanced around the enlightenment sea.
There were many other lotus platforms around him. Some of them were occupied while the others were empty. For those occupied lotus platforms, some were surrounded with fog, and he surmised that they must have activated the time acceleration feature as well.
He turned around and his eyes glowed up when he saw the man on the square.
He flew toward him and greeted him happily, “Brother Luo, it has been such a long time!”
Luo Heng, who was holding a glass of wine in his hand, was stunned for a moment before a smile broke across his face, “”Brother Jiang! I didn’t expect to run into you after entering this place. Today must be my lucky day!”
“I just finished my cultivation and I saw you!” Jiang Ming sat down. “You just came here today?”
“Yes!” Luo Heng nodded. “Well, I have to thank you too. If you hadn’t told me to continue training, you might not be able to see me here today!”
At that time, he had just stepped into level 11, which was equivalent to the Heavenly Immortal Realm. He felt that he was ready, so he wanted to attempt the Supreme Pagoda’s trial.
However, Jiang Ming’s voice rang out in his mind and he held himself back.
“Afterwards, I ventured into the secret domain of the universe and came across a great opportunity to raise my genetic level for 30,000 times. It’s only then I have the confidence to attempt the trial. After I passed the trial, I realized that if I hadn’t come across the opportunity, I might not have been able to pass it. I would then lose the Supreme Order, and you wouldn’t be able to see me here today!” Luo Heng said.
“Genetic level?” Jiang Ming asked.
“It’s similar to the bloodline in your cultivation system,” Luo Heng explained.
Luo Heng was very excited since he had just come here, while Jiang Ming wanted to talk to someone after he finished his cultivation. He took some food out to share with Luo Heng.
Both of them chatted, and when Jiang Ming mentioned Dongfang Chenxi and Ye Qingxian, Luo Heng lamented, “I knew it! I knew they would make it here! Dongfang Chenxi is as powerful as you, while Ye Qingxian, although she’s a mortal, she’s a genius.”
“She has mentioned about you as well. She said you have a lot of determination, and certain that you would make it here too. Haha, now we are able to meet in the Supreme Pagoda, maybe we’ll be able to meet each other in the world outside,” Jiang Ming laughed, “We just need to work harder, and I’m sure the day will definitely come!”
“I’ll be looking forward to it then!” Luo Heng said, “At that time, we’ll fight side by side, and conquer all universes!”
Jiang Ming also had told him the things here. He told him that he must keep on training until he had reached the extreme realm before attempting the trial.
Luo Heng nodded seriously.
After they had finished speaking, Jiang Ming bottomed up the last cup of wine and returned to the real world.
After all, there were a lot of things waiting for him to be done outside.
“It took me a great effort to surpass him last time, and now he has surpassed me again!” Luo Heng laughed and shook his head. He could sense how powerful Jiang Ming had become.
“Training huh… Alright then. I’ll try my best to join the Supreme Chat Group again! Life will only be fun with challenges, and people can only motivate themselves to move forward when they have a goal. With a man like Brother Jiang, life will not be boring in the future,” Luo Heng said.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - Accidental yet Sky-defying Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Accidental yet Sky-defying Reward
The moment Jiang Ming appeared back in Chuyang Peak, Linglong flew over and hugged him fiercely.
“Didn’t you just go out a while ago? Started missing me already?”
“Before the great battle just now, you left before you had a good rest. What do you think? I was missing a lot and worried to death. How are you now?”
“Full of spirit, ready to fight for another three thousand years!”
“Really!”
“Want to try me?”
“Let’s try then! I’m not afraid of you! But Senior Brother, I’m afraid you might be the one to surrender first!”
“I practiced some mythical special abilities and have forged myself an immortal spear. You’re still too na?ve to think that you can shake me down!”
As the two continued to murmur, the fog around the manor slowly rose, and the two of them had returned to their room.
The Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed was getting a little bit more overwhelmed time after time.
“The laws have become more stable on the Infinite Realm Battlefield, and it’s now more difficult to accelerate time!” Time Junior Sister sighed, looking at Senior Brother, her real self and the rest who were so impatient and not shy at all really made her feel like she couldn’t help herself anymore.
…
At the side of the cliff, Chang Yiming stood in the courtyard with his arms around Momo, looking at the manor with a complicated expression on his face.
“Yi Ming, are you not going over?”
“I’m not going! You saw the battle just now, right? That level of destruction is at the heaven and the earth level, far beyond the limits of our imagination. I can’t imagine that Head Disciple Jiang has reached such a level. The fact that he was able to return safely in the end means that there’s nothing to be worried about and he should have emerged victorious. I fear that he won’t feel that well after such a battle, so it’s better not to disturb him.”
“You’re right! We can only watch silently!”
“And silently continue our cultivation! Although he was the head disciple back then, he was taken care of by us like he was our Junior Brother. How long has it been since then? I can’t even compare myself to him anymore!”
Chang Yiming was very emotional.
Momo nodded in agreement.
In another area, Xi Yao had also finished her cultivation retreat. As she looked ahead, her expression became more complicated.
She wanted to go over several times and have a look or ask around on what happened. However, she ended up not doing so.
In the end, she couldn’t hold herself back any longer and just when she flew over to find Jiang Ming, she discovered a thick fog around the surrounding of the manor.
“Right after the great battle outside, the two started off their next great ‘battle’ inside already. Isn’t he afraid of dying from exhaustion?” Xi Yao snorted, returned to the yard, and sat herself down.
With a flick of her wrist, a jar of wine appeared. She poured herself a cup and drank by himself. However, there were many signs of confusion written all over her face.
In Jiuyang Peak’s main hall, the first seats as well as a group of elders were gathered around, and the atmosphere was very solemn.
“What can we do?” The Sect Master looked at Gu Hai with a very complicated expression on his face. The other elders looked over as well.
“What we can do now is to do nothing!” Gu Hai stood at the door of the main hall as his eyes were locked on onto Chuyang Peak. He was anxious and restless as well, but forcibly held back his emotions.
Although he didn’t know what happened, it was clear that this was a critical time, and that his disciples cannot be disturbed.
“But...” The Sect Master sighed faintly, “We’ve been watching and watching all this time! As the Sect Master, it really makes me feel aggrieved, helpless, powerless, like I’m the one to be blamed for this. Yet, I can only watch helplessly from a distance!”
“Same goes for me.” Gu Hai turned around and sighed, “All of us sensed the aftermath of the battle just now. What are we able to do about it? What we can do is to just watch silently, and then continue our cultivation!”
“Cultivation...” The Sect Master nodded silently.
At the place where Qingyun Sect was originally located, Liu Changkong and Ye Ming stood side by side in the sky.
“Did you feel that?”
“I’m the old dean. How can I not feel it? Although I don’t know what managed to block it off, I can still feel that if even only a ray of that aura leaks through, it would still crush us to death. It’s simply too terrifying. Even my soul is still trembling from it.”
“Yes, it’s way too terrifying! This also covertly shows that his strength is far beyond common sense. Perhaps, this is also the chance of life that God has given to this world of ours. Ye Ming, what do you think we should do next?”
“Old Dean, I suggest that the school be merged into the Jiuyang Sect. The integration of all forces will be conducive to all our planning.”
“Once we merge with them, we will become ordinary disciples. Can you reconcile this?”
“Old Dean, what’s not to be reconciled to? We are no longer in the mortal world already. It’s their generosity that allows us to stand on our own feet, but we can’t be ignorant. Besides, in the face of great changes, in the face of the immortal realm ahead, if we don’t make changes, we are destined to disappear in the future.”
“Yes, you are right. He may not care whether we are willing to merge with them, but we can’t be ignorant! By allocating everyone at the same place can also allow him to better arrange for cultivation, and let our mortal realm grow up in this world!”
As the two negotiated, they came to a decision.
Three days later, Jiang Ming was on the balcony of Chuyang Peak.
“It’s really delicious!” Jiang Ming’s face was full of smiles, and the melancholy of the ten thousand years of cultivation retreat was completely dissipated from his mind, leaving only a long aftertaste and comfort.
“This is life!” Jiang Ming was even more emotional when he saw the four flower fairies coming to attend to him.
“Yeah, this is life!” Linglong laid on top of him, “It would be great if there were no disputes or hatred, and we can all live a quiet life like this!”
“There will be such a day!” Jiang Ming stroked her long hair, “Just wait for your Senior Brother to kill all the bad guys in the world! The world will then be peaceful.”
Linglong rolled her eyes in response, and softly said, “Senior Brother, am I too weak?”
“With a cultivation base of Tiayi Realm yourself and your nine clones at the Golden Immortal Realm at least, who dares to even say that you are weak?” Jiang Ming snorted, “Stop thinking about nonsense.”
“Yeah, but I’m still ready to go over to the place of inheritance for my cultivation!” Linglong said hesitantly, “If I stay here, I can’t be of much help to you. It’s better for me to continue my cultivation, step into the Great Overarching Realm as soon as possible, and even break through to the Quasi-Sage Realm.”
“Have you thought well about it?”
“I’ve thought well about it!”
“Alright then! How long will it take?”
“One hundred years over there is akin to one year in the outside world. I will definitely return within a hundred years! I will try again to see if I can continue to increase the flow of time inside and cultivate as much time as possible.”
“One hundred years inside? That is equivalent to 100,000 years in the outside world. If you improve the time acceleration more...” Jiang Ming started hesitating, “The longer you practice, the more indifferent your heart will be. It is quite a long time, so I suggest that you leave Phoenix Junior Sister behind. She is already in the Taiyi Realm so it’s not a big problem for her to cultivate slower. We can communicate on a daily basis, so as not to be unfamiliar with each other to the point that you forgot about me!”
“I also intend to do so! It’s so that you can communicate with her every day and keep your attention away from Xi Yao.” Linglong whispered reluctantly.
In the end, she connected herself with the Heavenly Order to go to the place of inheritance.
Jiang Ming was a little disappointed from her leaving.
Phoenix Junior Sister came over to him, laid by his side, hugged his arm and the temperature began to rise, “Senior Brother, you will be all mine from now on. My whole body is almost burning from excitement!”
As her voice fell, her body was directly ignited in flames.
Jiang Ming started to get light-headed from this. He thought, ‘She’s happy? Hey! That’s easy to work with! We’ll just go back into the house, so that she can’t get up anymore!’
Immediately, he did as he thought!
Leisure time always makes people lazy. Other than exercising every day, Jiang Ming was just lounging around on the roof.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was still recovering himself, and Jiang Ming didn’t know how long it would take for his full recovery.
As he looked at the light on the Eastern horizon, he couldn’t help thinking of Dongfang Chenxi. He was prepared to communicate with the Supreme Order to enter the chat group, and also trade some items at the same time.
However, his expression suddenly changed, and his figure disappeared instantly. He came over to the Immortal medicine garden instead.
The current Immortal Medicine Garden had expanded greatly. Although it had not been carefully managed, it was still in good order. The Immortal lights were flowing, with the aura of vitality transforming into long rivers. The glare from daybreak loomed over as the sun set in the west.
The only thing that was a pity about the garden was that there were very few real immortal medicines because he had no time to plant them. Therefore, most of them were the supreme-grade or the king-grade spiritual medicine in the mortal realm.
They were all basically ripe for harvest already.
“Master!” The four flower fairies, Hua Huo, Hua Yu, Hua Rui, and Hua Jing flew over one after another. They were all one meter tall and were very delicate and sweet.
Behind them were wings that looked like rainbows, fluttering, and sprinkling small sparkles of lights. Although their bodies had not grown, their strength had stepped into the Paradis Realm, and they were a step away from the Extreme Path Realm as well.
It was hard to go slow when they practiced their cultivation here.
“Master!” Several ancient war trees swayed their branches and saluted.
Jiang Ming nodded and looked over at the spiritual fountain.
The supreme-grade spiritual fountain, a reward he obtained in the very beginning, hence was very precious. But now, it was no longer enough for him at this point.
Inside of the spiritual fountain was an Enlightenment Immortal Tea Tree. It used to grow very slowly. Later, Jiang Ming watered it with immortal fluid from time to time, and with the nourishment of Preternatural Soil, it had now matured.
An Immortal plant reaching maturity for the first time. According to its grade, it was only a low-grade spiritual root, but its meaning was totally different. After all, this was planted by him himself, and it was also the first time it matured.
There were 3,000 leaves on the Enlightenment Tea Tree, each of which was crystal clear and imprinted with complex patterns, like the scriptures of the sky. Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed it. The 3,000 leaves flew up and landed in a jade box that he took out. These tea leaves did not need to be fried and could just be brewed directly.
There was a look full of anticipation on his face. Because this was the first time he harvested an immortal item, he thought the rewards would surely not be bad at all. Sure enough, the system prompt sounded.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host Jiang Ming, for the first time harvesting mature immortal treasures. Rewarded one instance of the strongest special ability of the current Heavenly Emperor of Honggu Heavenly Realm today.”
Jiang Ming was very surprised. However, the light in his eyes flickered quickly, and all kinds of ideas and thousands of thoughts poured into his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 1)
?
Special Ability Card No.1: Once instance of the current Heavenly Emperor’s strongest Special Ability
A simple introduction about it was that it contained the power to suppress all the heavens. After all, it was recognized that the Great Heavenly Venerate was the strongest in the Honggu Heavenly Realm. Therefore, the power of his strongest special ability was naturally terrifying.
Jiang Ming took a look and harvested the rest of the spiritual medicine. The quality was poor, but the quantity was very large. He got a few low-grade immortal veins, and a Special Ability Card as rewards.
“This is interesting!” Jiang Ming smiled and put it away.
He was going to put the two Special Ability Cards into good use.
