Looking at the Spiritual Medicinal Garden, it was no longer of much worth. The value of the harvest was poor, and the rewards were not satisfactory.
He was now at the level 14 cultivation base and could open up 14 acres of land. If he planted immortal roots, it was obviously too small. But it would not be an issue. He could use a large formation array to isolate it, and then use the immortal soil and immortal fluid to water it. It was not a big problem.
He then transferred the spiritual fountain over right next to the mountain stream next to Chuyang Peak, and the spiritual medicines in between the mountain peaks. Then, he took out two immortal veins, stabilized with great mana, and then integrated them into the Spiritual Medicinal Garden. In an instant, the divine light rose, and the immortal fogs turned into mist, turning this place a real fairyland.
He later took out two low-grade immortal veins, one to be integrated under Chuyang Peak, while the other to be integrated under the Taiyang Main Peak and branched into various peaks.
The Infinite Realm Battlefield was considered the scribe of the Immortal Realm to begin with. After Tianyuan World descended into the place, it was baptized by the laws of Immortal Dao. The energy of immortal spirits gathered, changing both animals and plants rapidly.
However, it was only now that the Jiuyang Sect had truly ushered into a metamorphosis.
Each peak exhaled immortal luminance, and the immortal essence gathered. It allowed many disciples to undergo a series of baptisms and their aptitudes were greatly improved.
Jiang Ming also told Gu Hai the situation through voice transmission.
The Sect Master and the others naturally realized this change, and when they learned that Jiang Ming was the one who did it, all of them cupped their hands showing gratitude towards Jiang Ming’s direction.
“This is what true great fortune looks like! This is what’s truly called the foundation, the true foundation for us to rise above all!” The Sect Master burst into tears, “In the future, we Jiuyang Sect… No! We will soon become the Jiuyang Immortal Sect!”
Immediately afterwards, they saw Jiang Ming flying away with a spiritual vein in his hand, winding around like a dragon. With a flick in the sky, it landed above the sky and extended into a length of ninety thousand miles.
As Jiang Ming pointed at it casually, the dragon melded into Qing Province and merged into ley lines.
In an instant, the mountains everywhere suddenly rose, reaching the depths of the clouds and the immortal luminance that was beaming from them also caused the plants to grow and evolve rapidly.
After Jiang Ming arranged the five low-grade immortal veins that he had obtained this time around, he landed in the Spiritual Medicinal Garden again. No, it was the Immortal Medicinal Garden now.
However, what he didn’t notice was that his simple act had caused such great sensation all around. Anyway, he wouldn’t have cared even if he knew of it.
The poor would only be good to themselves, and those who are successful would help the world. Although he was not a great person, he was willing to do it casually. After all, these immortal veins were no longer of much use to him.
After rummaging around, he discovered a lot of immortal seeds and their qualities were not bad. After all, most of them were from the beneficiaries of the Lord God Space and Reincarnation Hall.
Those were all geniuses among geniuses with their cultivation bases being above the Immortal Lord Realm. They would collect only the treasures of the infinite realms and wouldn’t have kept them if they were of lower grades anyways.
‘In the Heavenly Realm, immortal plants are divided into immortal medicines and immortal roots. They are then divided into low-grade, middle-grade, high-grade and top-grade. Immortal grasses are still quite common, but immortal roots are rare!’ Jiang Ming thought about it.
Immortal roots were often referred to as spiritual roots, which were all kinds of exotic species that existed in the form of trees. Even if they were low-graded ones, they were still invaluable such as the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Tree for example.
Immortal medicine existed in the form of grass and had amazing effects. It was relatively common, but its value was also immense.
‘It’s too difficult to nurture spiritual roots. The time needed can only be measured in 10,000 years!’Jiang Ming hesitated.
Taking the Enlightenment Immortal Tea Tree for example, he placed much effort into it by providing preternatural soil and even integrated the innate vital essence and many more. Even so, it took a great while before it grew into a stubble. However, once the spiritual root reached its mature state, the time for it to bear fruits would be correspondingly shorter, and they could be harvested one after another.
‘The top-graded ones take too long to mature, the rewards from the low-graded ones may not be satisfactory and my strength has improved too fast. Therefore…’ Jiang Ming thought about it, and came to a decision.
This time around, all the low-grade immortal grasses were planted, and they were all the same species as well. This would allow them to mature together and could be harvested together.
Fortunately, there was one kind of seed with a sufficient number of seeds.
Jiang Ming planted the Yin-Yang Immortal Grass, which absorbs the power of the sun during the day and the light of the stars and moon at night, allowing it to grow very quickly.
Upon maturity, it had a wide range of uses, whether for alchemy, or directly swallowing it to absorb the Yin-Yang energy. They were all of great use.
It was a pity that even if it was a low-grade immortal grass protected by an array formation technique, only ten plants could be planted in one acre of land. The piece of land could not support more if there were.
He imparted the methods of caring for the immortal grass to the four flower fairies, and he no longer paid attention to it.
Jiang Ming then returned to the balcony and laid on the chair, swaying leisurely.
Glancing at the distance, he could see that the Fifth Immortal Moon had completed her breakthrough and was still consolidating her cultivation.
There was still a lot of time remaining for this mission, so she didn’t need to be in a hurry to return.
Jiang Ming didn’t pay too much attention to her. Upon reaching the Taiyi Realm, with the resources of the Reincarnation Hall, coupled with his support, it would be difficult for the Fifth Immortal Moon to even achieve low achievements.
With a thought in his heart, he called out the Supreme Order.
‘Cultivation in Hongmeng Primordial Land once with 500,000 points.’
Jiang Ming looked a little complicated.
This was bound to be a sky-defying great encounter for him. Once he went over, there would definitely be benefits far beyond his imagination there.
After all, one point would grant him an opportunity to accelerate time, comprehend the laws of heaven and earth, and even further initiate the enlightenment mode.
One must know that under the acceleration of time, the principles of law would be distorted, and it would be difficult to comprehend Dao. The individual could only perform self-precipitation and deduce special abilities. A person could see the horror of the Sea of Enlightenment based on that.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 2)
?
In addition, one point allowed a person to experience enlightenment once.
With a thousand points, one could listen to the sermons of a peerless expert who would be at least in the Sage Venerate Realm! The Sage Venerate that was in the Sage realm.
10,000 points could save a person’s life once. Even a peerless expert like Kunpeng who controlled the power of heaven and earth would not be able to shake its defense. This was equivalent to an extra life already.
These were the reasons why points were so precious.
However, 500,000 points could only be exchanged for one chance of cultivating in Hongmeng Primordial Land.
This meant that this was a completely unexpected great opportunity that was beyond common sense.
Even so, Jiang Ming could not go for it. He had communicated with the Supreme Order, whether it was listening to the sermons or going to the Primordial Land to cultivate, the time consumed would be synchronized with reality.
Cultivating at the Primordial Land for a month would be the same as reality. However, the ‘system’ required him to cook and eat on the mountain every day.
‘This is such a pain in the ass!’ Jiang Ming had the urge to clear off his past accumulation and go to the Primordial Land to cultivate.
After pondering about it, the ‘system’ was still the fundamental root to him. His inner world had also recently reached its limit, the precipitation had been exhausted, and it was impossible for him to break through without boundless resources available. It was definitely not possible for Jiang Ming to break through in a short time.
Nevertheless, going to the Primordial Land could help improve his inner world further. Hence, it was very tempting for Jiang Ming.
Ugh! With a sigh, his subconscious sank into the Supreme Immortal Chat Room.
[Jiang Ming: Anyone here?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Group Admin, I’m here! I’m here again! Tee hee, you are still the Group Admin!]
[Jiang Ming: You joined the chat group! Congratulations, are you all familiar with it by now?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: All familiar already! The Daoist here in the group are very friendly. Brother Group Admin, your battle record is too awesome. As soon as you came in, you broke the record and became the Brother Group Admin. With a record of level 37 in the Battle Towers and step 42 of the Heavenly Ladders, you are too incredible! As expected of the Brother Group Admin I admire.]
[Jiang Ming: You’re making me embarrassed! It’s quite a pity. I’m still not sure if my current self can clear the sixth Battle Tower!]
[Ao Long: What you said is true! I’m now of the Taiyi Realm and yet I still couldn’t make my way into the sixth Battle Tower. No, it’s almost impossible! For the initial realms, it is relatively easy to fight by leapfrogging, but it gets more difficult as it goes. When I faced the fifth Battle Tower when I was in the Taiyi Realm, I was only able to make my way up to level 7. God damn! The Group Admin on the other hand has already entered the sixth Battle Tower. I suspect that the Group Admin is not a human, but has the purest Ancestral Dragon bloodline, which has undergone mutation.]
[Jiang Ming: Aren’t you scolding me!]
[Di Huo: He must be scolding you! Dragons, as everyone knows, like to mess around. They wouldn’t even let go of a three-legged toad! He said that you are from the blood of Ancestral Dragon! Cough, cough! I can’t even bear to continue talking…]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Ao Long: You three-legged man! You must have had it with a toad yourself!]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha! You two benefactors! Indiscriminate and incest are not allowed in the group.]
[Feng Wu: It’s okay, this sounds like a great topic! Men and women, women and men! It’s just such trivial matters, so there’s no need to cover it up.]
[Wang Ye: Feng Wu, you are more forthright now!]
[Feng Wu: Sigh. I’m 10,000 years old already. What haven’t I’ve heard or seen before? Even if I haven’t experienced it, with a swift sense of my spiritual thoughts through the great chiliocosm, there is nothing in the mundane world that could be hidden from me! I really don’t understand why it’s such a taboo about the harmony of Yin-Yang inheritance? I suggest that when Ao Long is ‘exercising’ again, he can make a live broadcast so that we can all enjoy it together.]
[Ao Long: You are ruthless!]
[Jiang Ming: You can even broadcast live?]
[Feng Wu: If you can trade, of course you can do live broadcasts and post pictures. Group Admin, I can turn into anything! Would you like some pictures?”]
[Ao Long: That’s not right! Something’s really wrong! Sister Feng Wu is too fierce today. Could it be that she was agitated by something? Was it abandonment? Or did she find out about the mistress?]
[Di Huo: I feel that she’s more on fire than I am.]
[Feng Wu: Can’t an old lady like me seduce the Group Admin?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Sister Feng Wu, you are so much older than me, and the Brother Group Admin is even younger!]
[Ao Long: Pfft... Haha! We should take a screenshot of Feng Wu right at this moment!]
[Di Huo: Turning into anger from embarrassment? Shocked? Or does she want to strangle little Chenxi?]
[Feng Wu: A wife three years older than the husband ensures a richer life, a wife 30 years older than the husband ensures the husband with a whole legacy, a wife 300 years older than the husband ensures the husband with boundless immortal elixirs, a wife 3,000 years older than the husband ensures the husband is well ranked among even the Immortals, a wife 30,000 years older than the husband is like a mother pampering a child, a wife 300,000 years older than the husband makes even the Buddha and monarch salute in respect, a wife three million years older than the husband ensures the husband with total dominance in the Immortal Realm, a wife thirty million years older than the husband ensures the whole infinite realm revolve around him!]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Jiang Ming: Why did the scene change suddenly like that!]
[Feng Wu: Human life is full of loneliness, so it’s better to have more fun; if you have more fun, it is better to open up first. The older you are, the more enjoyable it is. After all, you have a lot more knowledge and a variety of techniques. Group Admin, do you want me to introduce you to a 300 billion year old lady? I guarantee that you will be successful in life by merely lying down!]
[Ao Long: I also want to be successful in life by merely lying down!]
[Feng Wu: She likes to eat dragon meat the most, especially the dragon brain. She cracks open the head and with just a slurp, the brain matters would all be in her mouth, fresh and smooth! The dragon flesh will be cooked later on to savor them slowly!]
[Ao Long: You’re ruthless!]
[Jiang Ming: Stop! I am an honest person, a pure person, and a person with a superior spirit!]
[Feng Wu: Hehe! Then why do you understand these dirty thoughts of mine!]
[Jiang Ming: It’s because I understand them that makes me truly noble! It’s called emerging from the swamps without being stained!]
[Feng Wu: Then that means you’ve emerged too! Group Admin, were you able to hit the nail on the head?]
[Ao Long: If you introduce him to a 300-million-year-old lady, would he still be able to hit the nail? Before he could even hit the nail, his needle would’ve broken!]
[Tian Fozi: Namoamitabha! What are you talking about, what words are using here? Why can’t the little monk myself not understand it? Rather, it makes me want to hear it more!]

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: I’ll Introduce to You a 300-Billion-Year-Old Lady (Part 3)
[Ao Long: Hypocritical!]
[Feng Wu: Well, this is the Buddha of Joy for you!]
[Tian Fozi: I’m not! Absolutely not. I’m the purest! The Lord Buddha also said that I have a delicate and pure heart of Buddha.]
[Feng Wu: I’m chuckling right now! Even the Buddha of joy is also a Buddha!]
Jiang Ming shivered as he read through the conversation. They were all too violent. Especially Feng Wu, who used to be very reserved, had now become so forthright that it was terrifying.
Jiang Ming opened the Human Path Record to take a look.
Good heavens! No wonder she became like that!
It turned out that the grand elder in her clan told her about her match. Apparently the other party had great qualifications, excellent aptitude, refined temperament and even of a noble identity.
However, she found out the secret of the other party, that this guy actually had a taste for females who were fat as a pig or of dragons and demon race. To top it off, he liked not one of them, but a whole group instead.
In a fit of rage, she beheaded the guy and almost killed the grand elder. Even so, she was still full of anger. She even threatened that whoever dared to bring up that man in their conversation in front of her, she would behead them right there and then!
Based on the group however, what Jiang Ming saw was a different scene, though it could be seen that she was still full of anger, and his chest were like two mountains as they puffed up in anger.
Jiang Ming was entertained as he read their conversation.
Dongfang Chenxi however, hid herself as she was obviously thin-skinned and was shy about it.
‘Unrestrained chatting, especially with beautiful women on such an intimate topic! This... feels really good! Really, really good!’ He had a smile on his face, but was also ready to get down to business.
[Jiang Ming: Everyone, does anyone want to do some trading? I have with me tens of millions of points. I’m not afraid if you have a lot of great treasures, just worried that you guys can’t come up with any!]
The chat group went silent for a while.
[Ao Long: My godness! Tens of millions of points? Group Admin, you really are a human!]
[Jiang Ming: Be careful or I won’t give you a deal!]
[Ao Long: Oh my Brother Group Admin, I was wrong!]
[Jiang Ming: God damn it!]
[Feng Wu: I’m going to barf!]
[Di Huo: I spat out a mouthful of Sun God Fire. This little loach is such a disgusting person! Group Admin, what do you need?]
[Feng Wu: As expected of both the former and current Group Admin! What do you want? Beauties? I can collect 3,000 beauties of different races for you!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Group Admin, tell me what you need!]
[Jiang Ming: Chenxi, you just have to practice hard and don’t focus on other things. If you need anything, find me first! Everyone, I need immortal veins, divine veins, immortal crystals, divine stones, immortal fluid, Innate Vital Essence, Chaotic Vital Essence, immortal plants, high-quality energy crystals, etc. I also need level 15 Taiyi Dao Vessels, best if it’s a whole set. And level 16 Great Overarching Dao Vessels, level 17 Quasi-Sage Weapons, and level 18 Holy Weapons. As long as you’ve got them, I want them all!]
[Huang Quan: Group Admin, you actually need so many things? Could it be that your small chiliocosm is at its limit and you are preparing to break through into the middle chiliocosm? It must be! Otherwise, there is no need to trade for such things! Dao vessels? Group Admin, which level is your current cultivation base?]
[Jiang Ming: That’s right. I am accumulating to break through to the Middle Chiliocosm! Seventh floor currently!]
[Huang Quan: Damn it! You’re still the boss of the group. I strained myself working hard and exhausted a lot of points, yet I’m able to advance into the fifth floor only!]
The others reading the conversation probably felt like they were confused, but they could guess that the conversation between the two must be a kind of cultivation technique.
Huang Quan had only cultivated to the fifth level, which must be extraordinary already. But the Group Admin who had just joined the group, had reached the seventh floor already. Just thinking about Jiang Ming’s accumulated points, there was nothing to be curious about.
[Hong Yi: In short, Group Admin, you just need the artifacts to be accumulated in your inner world, as well as Dao vessels of level 15 and above?]
[Jiang Ming: That’s right!]
[Hong Yi: How long is the time limit?]
[Jiang Ming: The sooner the better! No longer than 30 years I think!]
[Hong Yi: Thirty years? There’s enough time, I’ll need to head out and stretch myself already. I’ll first destroy the Lich Realm, and then slaughter the Heavenly Demon Kingdom! If I’m able to exchange enough points, I can either use them for enlightenment or to listen to sermons. My path of Civilization Dao is bound to go further, which will help me open up a civilized world. By then, my Dao will be completed, and I will be able to lead myself directly to the Holy Dao!]
[Tian Fozi: I’m going to go find the Lord Buddha!]
[Ao Long: Should I find the Dragon Monarch? These are points for crying out loud! This is better than any great encounters!]
[Huang Quan: I’m gonna find my great monarch and get ready to initiate a doomsday war!]
[Feng Wu: I will go stir up my clansmen to launch a holy war and start the footwork of unifying the world!]
Every one of them made their own statement. Even Xu Wuji, Lan Hai and the other group members had emerged to have a say in it.
Jiang Ming was very happy to see such a result. With friends in the infinite realm, they really were the best workers of all. Those who have to be paid would only cost him a few points.
‘The time limit for my inner world to reach the middle chiliocosm should be shortened by a lot!’
As Jiang Ming thought to himself, there was a slight tingle in his subconscious and his conscious self returned to reality. As his eyes swept around and he gazed at the southern direction outside of Tianyuan World, his eyes flashed, and he couldn’t help whispering, “Interesting! Hehe! This is really interesting!”

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - Riyue Changfeng, Wandered Through the Long River of Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Riyue Changfeng, Wandered Through the Long River of Chaos
Phoenix Junior Sister came pacing over in the air with a person by her side.
“Greetings, senior uncle!” Mo Xiaoyu was still a young little girl, but she had a serious look on her face as she came to pay homage to Jiang Ming.
“How’s your training coming along?” Jiang Ming was quite satisfied with this disciple of his Junior Sister. At least she was not a naughty one. Most of the time, she meditated alone, asked Xi Yao occasionally for advice and went to the main peak to practice.
“Reporting to my senior uncle, I’m already in the False Core Formation Realm now!”
“False Core Formation? Not bad!” Jiang Ming nodded.
The fact was that she was considered very slow already. After all, the current Tianyuan World had undergone great changes, and the immortal spirit was dense. While improving the physique, it also allowed cultivators to improve their cultivations rapidly.
Mo Xiaoyu’s aptitude was good, but was only in the False Core Formation Realm. The only explanation was that she should have suppressed her cultivation, hence not improving rapidly. Being able to endure such loneliness was not bad at such a young age as her.
“There’s only one such disciple on the mountain right now. Aren’t you going to give her anything?” Linglong said with a smile.
“It’s not time yet!” Jiang Ming shook his head, “When she enters the Golden Core Realm and passes the test, I will bestow her a great fortune.”
“That’s alright as well!” Phoenix Junior Sister knew clearly and understood that her Senior Brother wanted to continue sharpening Mo Xiaoyu’s temperament. After passing the test of the heart, her future cultivation would naturally go smoothly.
Mo Xiaoyu retreated and left the place.
Junior Sister laid herself beside him, held onto her chin and asked, “Senior Brother, what did you see just now? From the looks of your expression, something seems to be wrong!”
Jiang Ming raised his hand and swiped, and a mirror appeared out of thin air, reflecting a scene in the mirror.
When Junior Sister took a closer look, her brows tingled slightly, “Is this the Southern Sea? The changes have been huge.”
It was no ordinary change. After the previous battle, the sea water had evaporated, the area of the sea had expanded dozens of times. Even the earth was almost pierced through and the Infinite Realm Battlefield almost collapsed.
Now that the great battle was over, the rules of the world had been adjusted, and the sea water restored. However, the area of this sea had greatly increased. Relatively speaking, Tianyuan World became almost like a real island, existing alone at the Northern end.
Above the Southern Sea, an incomparably huge palace appeared, slowly descending from the heavens, as endless divine light shone in all directions. The sharp blinding luminance that oppressed the heavens swept through the vast area. Through the intensity of its power, a Great Overarching Golden Immortal could instantly tell that this palace was a Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel.
A palace that was a Quasi-Sag Dao Vessel? It was immeasurably invaluable, and gave off a high mighty aura.
“Are they provoking us by descending at a slow pace?” Phoenix Junior Sister raised her eyebrows, with golden flames flowing in her eyes.
“It should be trying to announce its arrival!” Jiang Ming’s expression was indifferent, “Let’s wait and see.”
It didn’t take long for the palace to fall onto the sea, and actually covered about 10,000 kilometers of the area, a truly monstrous palace indeed. On the walls of the palace, divine brilliance surged through, as immortal luminance were seen flickering. There were also incomparably complicated inscriptions on them, all connected together seemingly sealing a terrifying power within.
The palace gate was facing North, facing directly at Tianyuan World. A young man clad in white robes flew out from the palace. His long hair was fluttering, as his big sleeves waved around, he was beaming with refined temperament, and had a smile on his face.
This person clasped his fists and cupped his hands in respect at Chuyang Peak of Tianyuan World. His voice was loud and reverberated between the heavens and the earth, “I’m Riyue Changfeng, director of the Infinite Realm Auction House. When I was traveling through time and space, I felt the change in energy of this place as well as the accumulation of great fortune here. Hence I decided to descend into this realm. I gathered around for information just now and learned that there was a great battle that took place here not long ago. Brother Jiang took the lead in the battle and became famous all over the world through the great battle. Congratulations on your success! However, when I descended here into this territory of Brother Jiang’s, I did not ask for permission beforehand. Hence, I hope that brother Jiang wouldn’t mind too much about it, as I would like to offer a Great Overarching Dao Vessel as compensation for this incident. At the same time, please allow me to open an auction house here to communicate with all worlds and each other!”
Upon his greetings, he gave a bow of respect while cupping his hands.
He then flung his sleeves and out flew a long sword heading towards Tianyuan World and stopping at the edge of the lands.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming stood up on Chuyang Peak and walked to the balcony, looking over with a pair of divine eyes.
He wasn’t shocked that the other party knew of his name. After all, he could find out about it with just a little probing or even absorb the residual information from the void and such. There were too many methods that could be done to get his name.
However, it was peculiar that he was able to see him over Chuyang Peak. After all, the place was shrouded by the Saint Province Dao Square.
“Allowed!” Jiang Ming replied with just a word, reached out and grabbed with his hand as the long sword at the edge of the lands flew over quickly.
At the same time, he was enveloped by sword with the power of Saint Province Dao Square and discovered that there was no imprint in it. It was an unowned Great Overarching Dao Vessel, and of the pinnacle of Great Overarching Dao Vessel quality.
Very interesting indeed!
When the sword flew nearer in front of him, he inserted the sword into the Human Path Record for further testing and found no problems with it.
Jiang Ming glanced and saw the introduction to the Heaven’s Decree which he kept early, and snorted coldly upon reading.
‘Introduction to Heaven’s Decree: There is a trace of the origin and authority of the Honggu Heavenly Realm, which can be manipulated by the Heavenly Emperor, and its power could explode anytime.’
Whether it was the content of the Heaven’s Decree or the Heaven’s Decree itself, he felt the uneasiness of the emperor and that he was up to no god, but didn’t care much about it.
He knew the Heavenly Emperor would not present himself so soon even if he coveted him. After all, his position and identity as the Heavenly Emperor did not allow him to simply make a move.
‘I look forward to the future!’ As Jiang Ming thought about it, the pages of the Human Path Record flipped through quickly, and the contents on Changfeng appeared.
Name: Riyue Changfeng
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Quasi-Sage Realm
Background: The 49th Director of Infinite Realm Auction House
Relationship: 76
Innate Talent: Holy Dao (Time-Space Daoist Body)
Status
: Originally a prince of a small kingdom of a small chiliocosm, he was born with a Time-Space Daoist Body, but was unable to contain its power. He was frail and sickly during his young age.
: At the age of twelve, their nation fell apart and he was secretly escorted out. Due to his poor aptitude, he did not receive much attention and that saved his life. However, his escort was dead during the journey and Changfeng began to wander around, struggling at the edge of death for survival.
: He had witnessed too many evils, and met countless good-hearted people. He was living in the dark era, but had light of hope in his heart, struggling optimistically to survive. To him, living yet another day meant living up to this great lifetime of his.
: When he was sixteen, the consciousness of the Infinite Realm Auction House’s elder roamed through the void of heavens, swept through the long river of time. When he swept through this place, he discovered Riyue Changfeng that was blessed with the Time-Space Daoist Body who had a tenacious heart. Slightly moved by his tenacity, the elder left a Time-Space inheritance for Changfeng.
: Cultivating the inheritance that was in-sync with his body, Changfeng’s cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds. Once he had attained a certain achievement to his cultivation, he began to wander around the world, shining the world brightly with his sword.
: He was kind to the good and cruel to the evil. Growing up in bloodshed, marching forward in laudations and songs, he was a legend in countless worlds.
: After entering the Great Overarching Realm, he was led to the headquarters of the Infinite Realm Auction House, where he began his meditation until he reached the Quasi-Sage Realm.
: After countless trials and competitions with others, he was selected from many candidates, won the position of director of the Infinite Realm Auction House. He then walked in the long river of time, descended to all places in the heavens and the earth, and collected the breath of the heavens and the earth through conducting auctions, making shocking profits at the same time.
: He once killed the chaotic beasts, once fought against the Sage Venerate and escaped, once auctioned off the heart of the universe of a great chiliocosm and was brimming with countless brilliant achievements.
: As he controlled the mighty power of the Infinite Realm Auction House and wandered in the long river of chaos, he felt that there was a change in the Honggu Heavenly Realm. Hence, he came over. By merging his heart with the world to collect information, he was greatly amazed to discover a man who was also of the human race, could kill a Quasi-Sage expert. He decided to set up an Infinite Realm Auction House here and see if he could get himself a great encounter in return.
Jiang Ming was shocked upon looking through his ‘Status’.
He knew Changfeng was not an ordinary person but a truly sky-defying existence because of his Time-Space Daoist Body. To be able to control time and space when he grew up, he was almost invincible and among those of the same level as him. Putting those aside, this person was able to escape from the clutches of a Sage Venerate upon growing up!
What made a Sage Venerate? Those below the Sage Venerate were mere feeble ants. No matter how strong a Quasi-Sage expert might be, he would still be an ant.
Jiang Ming still didn’t know how strong a Sage Venerate could be but this person’s ability to escape from a Sage Venerate’s grasp clearly showed how sky-defying his existence was.
‘Wandered through the long river of chaos?’ Jiang Ming felt some pain in his teeth as he gritted tightly.
It seemed that this person was of no ordinary background at all. It was obvious that he came from the terrifying areas in the Chaos, which allowed one to travel the infinite realms and even let a Quasi-Sage expert travel through time and space, capable of descending into any place at any time. This background of his was absolutely comparable to the Lord God Space and the Reincarnation Hall already.
Fortunately, Changfeng was of the human race and they had a natural sense of intimacy. Moreover, their ‘relationship’ value was not low. Therefore, Changfeng was a good person.
With a thought in his heart, a clone appeared beside Jiang Ming and walked over to Riyue Changfeng.
“Senior Brother, are you going to test the waters with him?” Phoenix Junior Sister asked.
Jiang Ming nodded, “Since he is showing a good attitude, he should be a guest rather than an enemy. Moreover, he is here at the door of our home, so it’s natural for us to greet him.”
Feeling something in his heart, Jiang Ming turned his head and saw that Mountain Master Tian Yuan had finished his cultivation retreat. His breath was harmonious with the surroundings and he had integrated himself with heaven and earth, giving people a feeling that he was the power of Dao and vice versa.
“Old brother!” Jiang Ming smiled and cupped hands in respect to greet him.
“Young brother!” The Mountain Master Tian Yuan paced over in the air, clasped his fists to greet him. As his gaze swept over Phoenix Junior Sister, his brows moved slightly and said, “This younger brother’s sister…”
“She’s Linglong’s clone, named Phoenix!” Jiang Ming introduced.
“My greeting to you, old brother!” Phoenix Junior Sister greeted him.
“She seems as though she was a complete individual. Such a clone…” Mountain Master Tian Yuan hesitated, “Greetings to younger brother’s sister!”
Jiang Ming smiled, without explaining too much, but said, “Old brother, has your injury recovered?”
“It’s almost there!” As Mountain Master Tian Yuan replied, he looked at Jiang Ming himself and said strangely, “You have fully recovered yourself? Self-destructing a Dao Vessel would damage the soul of the primal spirit. That sort of injury is an injury to a person’s origin and is the most difficult to recover of all!”
“I have a secret technique to it!” Jiang Ming said, pointing to the palace in the Tianyuan Sea and said, “Brother, have you heard of the Infinite Realms Auction House? Originating from Chaos? ”
“Infinite Realms Auction House from the Chaos?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned and was in deep thought. His eyes suddenly lit up, but hesitantly said, “I have heard that in a long time ago, there was an auction house that brought upon huge changes to our Honggu Heavenly Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - A Year Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: A Year Later
A very long time ago, a time where Mountain Master Tian Yuan had not yet attained enlightenment. Rather, it was back in the time where he hadn’t even ascended into the Heavenly Realm.
There were not any Sage Venerates born between heavens and earth yet. Many forces were slaughtering each other in bloodbaths, the universe was chaotic, and calamity spread through all over the world.
One day, a palace suddenly descended on the battlefield of the war that has lasted for 3,000 years. Its divine luminance soared into the sky, brimming with luxuriant immortal power and attracted the attention of many powerful beings. As a result, they were bombarded and eight Quasi-Sages were killed with one blow.
Another ray of divine luminance later slashed down the Quasi-Sage expert of the pinnacle who was the strongest of the time, and it deterred all the others.
The gate of the palace was opened, and placed on display were countless immortal weapons and Dao vessels, peerless immortal special abilities, spiritual pills and spiritual roots, and even the ways of sanctifying a person’s path towards the Holy Dao.
In fact, the existence of the way of sanctifying Dao was first introduced around from then on.
“That’s all that I know of!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan looked at the Southern Sea with a solemn expression, “I didn’t expect the legends to be true. After such a long time, the Infinite Realm Auction House has descended again.”
“The way of sanctifying the path of Dao came from the Infinite Realm Auction House?” Jiang Ming was very surprised.
“The rumor says so!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan laughed, “However, there is no specific technique for sanctifying the path of Dao. It is merely to point out the several routes for it. How can Dao, the most mysterious power, be understood with mere words? It is only through the heavens and earth that a person can understand everything after experiencing enlightenment; without enlightenment, hundreds of millions of years could’ve gone by and the person would still be lost.”
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement.
…
On top of Tianyuan Sea, Jiang Ming’s clone paced midair, weaving through the vast sky, crossing voids and it didn’t take long for him to arrive outside of the Infinite Realms Auction House.
“Brother Jiang!” Riyue Changfeng cupped his hands.
“Brother Riyue!” Jiang Ming smiled.
As the other party bowed slightly, two futons appeared beside him.
Jiang Ming stepped up into the air and sat cross-legged on a futon.
“Brother Jiang, born of the mortal planar world, walking on the path of World’s Dao, yet to enter into the Great Overarching Realm, but still managed to behead Quasi-Sage experts. Looking through infinite realms, you are also one of the small group of peerless talents standing at the pinnacle.” As Riyue Changfeng said, he simply made a gesture, and a pot of tea suddenly appeared, suspended in mid-air. He then waved his sleeves, two crystal clear and flawless teacups appeared in the middle.
As Jiang Ming looked over, his pupils could not help shrinking. Whether it was the teapot or the teacups, they were all carved from innate spiritual jades, which was extremely luxurious indeed.
As soon as Riyue Changfeng raised his hand, a stream from the teapot split into two trickles pouring into the teacups. In an instant, seven parts of the tea filled the tea canister and the water in it started to ripple. As the clouds and mists rose, it conjured into a scene where he saw a jaded dragon circling around, a vermillion bird croaking, a white tiger majestically roaring and a black tortoise roaming through. The scenes suddenly change as the four mythological beasts formed a four-path formation array, which then collapsed and merged into the tea.
“This is the Four-Manifestation Spiritual Tea I collected in a world that evolved naturally in the Chaos. It’s quite tasty. Please, be my guest Brother Jiang!” Riyue Changfeng introduced the tea, and didn’t mind that the Jiang Ming that came forth was just a clone.
“After you!” Jiang Ming was not reserved at all as he lifted the teacup and took a sip. Various flavors tingled through the tips of his tongue as the tea merged into all parts of the body, making even the clone more solid than before. The clone even had a tendency to transform into the original body itself.
“Such great tea!” He couldn’t help but show his admiration.
“If brother Jiang likes the tea, I still have a lot of them. Take them as a gift!” Riyue Changfeng took out a jar, waved it over to Jiang Ming, and continued on the topic just now, “I extracted the time- space imprint to looked through the previous battle, and found that brother Jiang’s special ability is the best of the Honggu Heavenly Realm, and is of extraordinary inheritance. Sacrificial Artifact Judgment technique! I have half of the technique on my side. Such a technique of smelting 3,000 laws into one is timeless and as excellent as it is, I am but not without it. However, brother Jiang’s smelting technique is extremely unique. Its power is unparalleled and the potential is endless. It should be that brother Jiang comprehended the technique all by yourself!”
“Good artifice!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
In truth, Jiang Ming was really shocked. Looking at the past through the method of Time-Space Imprint was although sky-edifying, but was not uncommon at all. However, the other party actually knew about the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment technique and even saw through the smelting of 3,000 laws into one. It really made Jiang Ming feel like he has improved his vast knowledge.
“Good insight!” Jiang Ming said indifferently, “Brother Riyue, with your means and capabilities, you’re still not able to collect the complete details on the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment technique?”
“The follow-up methods of evoking the technique can be deduced, but it’s too time-consuming and labor-intensive. Such a feat is far from being a short span of hard work and is not worth the effort! Moreover, evoking this technique is too expensive.” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “Brother Jiang, would you be willing to sell it to me?”
“Do you even collect items?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.
“Of course!” Riyue Changfeng explained, “The tenet of the Infinite Realm Auction House is to communicate with each other among all realms, to buy low and sell high. In fact, collecting items is also our main purpose. I’m afraid that with your inheritance, you will also know that our Infinite Realm Auction House roams the infinite realms and conducts transactions, with the real purpose of obtaining the Qi of infinite realms, which is the fundamental method of our cultivation!”
“You even revealed such details?” Jiang Ming was even more surprised.
“It’s not a secret to begin with!” Riyue Changfeng said indifferently, “If Brother Jiang has anything good, you can sell it to me. Of course, I also have the items that Brother Jiang needs here, such as the long river of innate vital essence, the chaos vital essence, the heart of the small chiliocosm, the heart of the middle chiliocosm, all kinds of Great Overarching Dao vessels, Quasi-Sage Weapons and etc. There are quite a number of good items! ”
“Aren’t you afraid of being robbed?” Jiang Ming gasped, but couldn’t help saying.
This person in front of him was really a filthy rich man. However, the other party had also really seen through his own details as well.
“Of course not! I’m not afraid if the Sage Venerate does not make a move; if the Sage Venerate does, I am even less afraid!” Riyue Changfeng smiled confidently, “Would you like to go inside and have a look first?”
“Why are you inviting me alone? You are an auction house!” Jiang Ming stood up.
“There are not many people in the Honggu Heavenly Realm that meet my eye. Only Brother Jiang, who has the greatest potential among all. You might even be a big customer of mine in the future. Naturally, I will have to establish a good relationship first!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “The excellence and downfall of long-term customers, also affects our own growth!”
“This is your path of Cultivation?”
“You are correct!”
“That’s really weird!”
“Haha! There are 3,000 types of Daos where each is different, but their final destination is almost the same! Shall we?”
“Lead the way!”
The two landed directly in front of the palace. Right when the door opened, a magnificent aura suddenly loomed over their faces and Jiang Ming was moved by the vast boundless ancient aura.
Riyue Changfeng flicked his finger and a ray of divine luminance exploded, transforming into immeasurable divine voice, merging into thousands of laws, and dispersed into all directions of the Honggu Heavenly Realm: “The Infinite Realm Auction House will be opened in the Infinite Realm Battlefield in a year time. There will be Quasi-Sage Weapons, supreme-grade spiritual roots, Nine-Incarnation Pill, Chaos Vital Essence, the method of the Holy Dao, peerless special abilities, array formation that can trap even the Sage Venerates, the Great Overarching substitutions and so on!”
This voice was integrated into the laws, and those who did not reach a certain level could not hear it at all.
At the same time, streaks of divine luminance erupted from the palace, forming line after line of Daoist motifs, explaining the details of the auction such as how to trade and so on.
The rays of light soared into the sky and spread throughout the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
“Are you always so high-profile?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but wonder.
“Of course!” Riyue Changfeng pointed to the front and said as he walked, “By advertising it, you can attract more customers. As for those with ulterior motives? Just killing them will do! You can even get a lot of good things for free.”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing.
As he spoke, Riyue Changfeng led him into a gate of light, and as the stars shifted around, it seemed as if he had come to an endless starry sky.
As his eyes narrowed, Jiang Ming took a deep breath.
Right in front of him was a huge star. No, it was clearly transformed by the heart of a chiliocosm; there was a mighty long river on the left, flowing the innate immortal liquid; a meteor streaking across the sky that was clearly a spear that was a Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel.
On Chuyang Peak...
‘This is obviously trying to lure me!’ Through the clone, Jiang Ming understood everything and couldn’t help thinking, “This guy, he knows that I need a lot of resources to support the way of the World’s Dao. Is he allowing me to see his treasures first to try and make me complete the trade and to try probing on more details about myself?”

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - The Three-Parts Shackles
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: The Three-Parts Shackles
Deep in the Abyss, many different forces of the Heavenly Realm had already forced their way into the place.
This was an open and upright invasion, where they were even willing to let go of the grievances between each other and form an army of tacit understanding and pushed through together.
After all, the Abyss was equivalent to a quasi-great chiliocosm and who knew how many great treasures were hidden in it. Moreover, based on the Heavenly Emperor’s Decree, it was a great trial for all, an upright plunder.
The Abyss could only fall back and resisted passively, as they were simply unable to resist the forceful invasion of all the forces of the Heavenly Realm.
However, not long after the plunder began, there was a law of divine vibrational sound, which turned into a voice of Daoism in their ears, saying: the Infinite Realm Auction House will be opened a year later!
Upon hearing that many good items, especially the ways of sanctifying a person’s path towards the Holy Dao would be auctioned, many peerless experts were shocked to learn of such news in that instance.
As such the great trial of the Heavenly Emperor’s Decree became even more ferocious as everyone was plundering for wealth.
…
In the Heavenly Court.
“Infinite Realms Auction House!” The Great Heavenly Venerate had a solemn expression on his face, “I didn’t expect for it to descend into our realm again.”
“Your Majesty, does this auction house really come from the Chaos?” Star Lord Taibai was very surprised.
He knew of the terror in the Chaos. Once inside, it wouldn’t matter whether one was a Quasi-Sage expert, or a Great Heavenly Venerate. Losing focus slightly would lead to the person being decimated by the violent Chaos storm.
If the Chaos was not as dangerous as it was, those of the Quasi-Sage Realm of the Heavenly Realm would have gone to seek for treasures in it long ago.
The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded, “A long time ago, I was only... at that time. There was chaos throughout the heavens and earth, there was no order, and nothing but endless bloodshed, be it for power, for territory, for self-tempering or for Dao improvement. For billions of years, there had been endless bloodbaths, yet there was still no one who was able to sanctify the way of Dao. It was not until the Infinite Realm Auction House descended and brought upon various great treasures and even the guide of Dao. Only after that event did the Sage Venerate come into the world, the Honggu Heavenly Realm was brought into order and the Heavenly Court began its establishment! ”
“Although the world is now unified, the Infinite Realm Auction House still descended into the realm...” Great Heavenly Venerate frowned, “With the great trial only just at its beginning, I fear that there will be some chaos happening. Troubled times lead to great opportunities, yet prosperity is the cause of chaos.”
“Your Majesty, are you worried about the Abyss?” Star Lord Taibai thought about the items promoted by the Infinite Realm Auction House and his brows twitched fiercely.
“We’ll just wait and watch!” The Great Heavenly Venerate did not answer.
…
Inside the Infinite Realm Palace, Riyue Changfeng took Jiang Ming’s clone for a tour of his treasury, and said slowly while introducing the many treasures, “Longevity is relative. True immortality however, seems to not exist at present! Birth, old age, sickness and death are the true norml! The world has birth and death, so do the planar worlds, small chiliocosm, middle chiliocosm, great chiliocosm, and even the Chaos! It’s just that the bigger the world is, the longer the lifespan will be. Such a long lifespan causes people to become desperate and makes people want to transform themselves into Dao, such as the Chaos. Chaos has life and death, but its life does not know of the year, and neither does its death. As such, the creatures born in it will have relative longevity, or even eternal life! On the other hand, the lower the level of a world, the shorter the lifespan will be. Be that as it may, this is only relatively speaking!”
“When a world reaches its limit naturally however, it will generally be ‘turned into Dao’ under the rules of the Great Dao, returning to the origin of the world, and that the Heart of the World would not be born at all!”
“The birth of the Heart of the World is usually under forced intervention. Yet such a way would lead to the backlash from the terrifying powers of Dao. We’ll just put aside the planar worlds as an ordinary Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm could’ve forcefully destroyed the world already. It wouldn’t stand a chance against the backlash of the power of Dao. However, it is basically impossible to get the complete heart of the world through such a method of forced destruction. If it wasn’t planned and arranged accordingly, it would be difficult to obtain even an incomplete one! ”
“A complete heart of the world is obtained by condensing and refining the entire world, returning it back into its original origin and transforming it into the Mysterious Yellow Maternal Womb of Origin. The world’s heart in such a state could not be achieved by even a Quasi-Sage expert, and to top it off, it is only aimed at the planar world, not to mention the hearts of small chiliocosm or middle chiliocosm! As such, the hearts of the world are all imperfect!”
“There are many hearts of the planar worlds, but there are very few hearts of small chiliocosm. Even after proper preparation and destroying hundreds of small chiliocosm, we actually may not be able to give birth to one heart of the world! It’s just too difficult!”
“As for the middle chiliocosms? If it’s a Quasi-Sage’s plan to destroy the world and return it to its original origin, I am afraid that the Dao backlash will turn the world into ashes, annihilating it in an instant. Therefore, the heart of the middle chiliocosm is very rare.”
“As for the heart of the great chiliocosm? If you look at the Chaos, it is extremely rare. If a heart of the great chiliocosm really appears, its worth would be comparable to that of the Chaos!”
“I have three hearts of the small chiliocosms and one heart of the middle chiliocosms!” As Riyue Changfeng said, he stretched out his hand and grabbed, a ‘big sun’ burning with raging flames could be seen flying towards them from the depths of the starry sky. As it got closer, it shrank quickly and turned into a divine embryo with boundless divine luminance or abundance power of creation.
By only slightly sensing the divine embryo, the surging vitality contained in it would have moved anyone and left them in shock.
“This is the heart of a middle chiliocosm. However, it is too broken unfortunately and is only equivalent to one-thousandth of the origin of the Middle chiliocosm. However, its essence remains unchanged!” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “For the Quasi-Sages, especially those at the pinnacle, these are all rare treasures to them. However, for the peerless experts who follow the path of the World Dao, its value is comparable to the Sage Artifact. No, even the Holy Artifact couldn’t even compare to it.”
“Brother Riyue, you are really tempting me to rob you!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Brother Jiang is an upright gentleman. What’s more, you are the host, whereas I am a guest. Why would a host rob his guests?” Riyue Changfeng smiled, giving others a feeling as though their faces were caressed by the spring breeze, and he continued, “As we all know, in the Chaos, the World Dao is the most difficult one, but its combat power is extremely powerful!”
He paused for a while and continued: “For the World Dao, it is not difficult to give birth to a planar world, and not too difficult to even ascend into the small chiliocosm. But upon reaching the limits of the small chiliocosm, further improvement is harder than stepping into the Sage Realm directly from the Heavenly Immortal Realm through enlightenment.”
“Is it that difficult?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
He had heard Dongfang Chenxi mentioned it before. Although it was difficult, it seemed that it was not as difficult as what Riyue Changfeng was saying now.
It was totally impossible for one to step into the Sage Realm directly from the Heavenly Immortal Realm. Therefore, this metaphor gave Jiang Ming the feeling of pure despair.
“Of course it’s that difficult! Otherwise, those people cultivating the World Dao would’ve been easily seen roaming around already. After all, one just has to ensure that his inner world keeps improving.” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “Previously in a period of time, there were many people who followed this path, and they were all geniuses. However, the result was that many stopped at the planar world stage, and the rest were all stopped at the small chiliocosm stage, no longer able to advance an inch. Or rather, they were able to comprehend some Taiyi laws at most and that was all. Over time, fewer and fewer people took this path. However, there are also successful ones, but most of them stopped at only the middle chiliocosm stage. ”
Jiang Ming frowned, “Once a person reaches the extreme state of the small chiliocosm, couldn’t he comprehend the 3,000 Taiyi Laws and improve the chiliocosm from the outside in? By accumulating the foundation inside and strengthening the power of origin, such integration from the inside and outside would’ve made it easy to enter the middle chiliocosm. Wouldn’t it? ”
“These are just the assumptions of some people in the great chiliocosms who have gotten their hands on World Dao cultivation!” Riyue Changfeng smiled strangely, “If it is really that simple, why are there so few people who walk the path of World Dao? After all, if a Quasi-Sage can nurture disciples cultivating World Dao, what’s more the Sage Venerates!”
Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat as he thought of Dongfang Chenxi again.
“When the inner world has evolved into the middle chiliocosm, and upon reaching its perfection, its origin is equivalent to that of the Sage Realm!” Riyue Changfeng said, “Which means that once the inner world enters the middle chiliocosm level, you can directly reach the Sage Realm. In the general great chiliocosm, this is the highest combat power already. Brother Jiang, do you think that the small chiliocosm can complete the transition so easily?”
“If that’s the case, I’m afraid there would’ve been countless people who followed the World Dao already!” Jiang Ming smiled bitterly.
The inner world could evolve on its own and even enhance its own origin. All it needed was time. And time was not a matter for cultivators. A period of time as long as 100 billion years was merely a trivial matter.
Take the previous Bei Chenxing for example, he had been cultivating for no less than hundreds of billions of years already.
“That’s the principle behind it!” Riyue Changfeng nodded, “There used to be a lot of people refining countless rare artifacts and accumulated their origins when they were in the pinnacle of the small chiliocosm and at the same time comprehended the 3,000 Taiyi Laws. They thought they could break through through the integration of the foundation inside and outside harmoniously, but none of them succeeded. In fact, there wasn’t one or two people, but many of them who basically ended up stopping at this level. Some tried to forcibly break through. As a result, they ended up dying as their souls were annihilated. Their inner world collapsed, and the accumulation of hundreds of millions of years were wiped out in vain. ”
“Aren’t there those who have succeeded? What was the reason behind their success?” Jiang Ming asked, followed by shaking his head quickly, “Sorry, I’ve crossed the line!”
Such a question regarding enlightenments caused him to somewhat lose his sense of proportion.
“Although this is a great secret, with Brother Jiang’s talent, you should be able to guess it!” Riyue Changfeng still smiled, “There are many experts who speculated that this barricade is a test of Dao, the soul and will. It is also a Dao calamity, and even more of a confinement. Although the person didn’t reveal the specific reason for it, there is also a general assumption that many have agreed upon... Brother Jiang, would you like to take a guess?”
“Spiritual will!” Jiang Ming said without hesitation.
In the Supreme Pagoda, what was originally tested was a person’s combat power, will, and comprehensive ability. Upon entering the Supreme Tower of Immortal Realm, the main test was on combat power and will.
Combat power was not of much use for a person’s cultivation breakthrough and could also be improved through grinding and training. As for the will? Though a person’s will could be honed through training, it was too difficult.
In fact, the reason why Jun Sanqian’s attitude towards him kept changing was also because his own spiritual will had been strengthened to a level beyond common sense.
“The power of the inner world is too powerful. With 3,000 laws constructing the world, creating great fortunes, promoting the cycles of reincarnation, and even nurturing of lives, the inner world has formed a perfect cycle for itself and could even produce the power of heaven and earth by itself. How can a person take hold of such a power without an extremely strong will of the soul? How could they bear such power?” Jiang Ming muttered again.
*Claps*…
Riyue Changfeng clapped and praised, “As expected of Brother Jiang. Such greatness! Your speculations are completely correct! There are three aspects of the evolution of the small chiliocosm: external comprehension of the 3,000 Taiyi Laws to promote the evolution, internal accumulation of dense origin to bear the evolution, and also to possess a will of eternal perseverance to take total control of the evolution. It is through all three of these aspects that the transformation and sublimation can be completed!
“Thank you for pointing them out too!” Jiang Ming cupped his hands to show gratitude and smiled, “Brother Riyue, your way of promoting business is really unusual!”
“Haha…” Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help laughing.
The reason he said so much just now, was to make good friends with Jiang Ming on one hand and to do business on the other hand as well.
Jiang Ming naturally saw through it.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - The Rise of Humanity, An Attack from the Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: The Rise of Humanity, An Attack from the Abyss
Riyue Changfeng’s objective was simple—to sell the heart of the middle chiliocosm.
“I don’t understand, Brother Riyue. Do I look like someone who can afford a treasure like that?” Jiang Ming asked incredulously.
The value for the heart of the middle chiliocosm was immense.
Except for the untouchable Human Paths Record, the Saint Province Dao Square, and the Supreme Pagoda which seemed to be of great value but actually was not, other items were normal.
As for the Quasi-Sage Weapons? They were precious and irreplaceable.
“It takes me a great effort to come here, and whenever I come, I would only deal with clients who have the greatest potential!” Riyue Changfeng said, “I came here this time because I had received a sign. I know I would come across someone who would be a great help to me in my future this time, and when I saw you, Brother Jiang, I knew my hunch was right! I always believe that if I treat people with sincerity, others will treat me back the same way as well. Therefore, everything I’m telling you is the truth, Brother Jiang.
“The cultivation method of our auction house is special. When we reach a certain point in our cultivation, we will need the support from something known as Cosmic Energy. This is the reason the auction house was established in the first place: to collect Cosmic Energy!
“And thus, all of us are equipped with some special abilities! I can sense plenty of Cosmic Energy from you, Brother Jiang. For us, the more items of different worlds we acquire, the higher the quality, the more valuable they are.
“Of course, I see that you have the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment and the special technique that could merge all 3,000 laws.
“Besides, I have faith that you can upgrade your inner world to the middle chiliocosm!
“No matter how I see it, you’re my best client!” Riyue Changfeng said with sincerity.
“Middle chiliocosm? I don’t even know if I can reach that stage. I don’t know why you have so much faith in me,” Jiang Ming laughed bitterly. He knew Riyue Changfeng was just being polite, so he did not take his words seriously. After all, no matter how sincere he was, it could not change the fact that Riyue Changfeng was a businessman, and a businessman would never invest in something that was unprofitable.
“Don’t look down on yourself, Brother Jiang. There is a chance that you may evolve your inner world into a great chiliocosm some day in the future!” Riyue Changfeng said as he pointed at the heart of the middle chiliocosm. “Anyway, back to the business. Do you want to take it? It can boost the origin force of your inner world as well as save you tons of time. It can also aid you in comprehending the 3,000 Taiyi Dao as well as speed up the evolution of your inner world. With one world’s heart, it’s going to save you billions of years of time. Not only that, but it can also act as a catalyst for the evolution of your inner world!”
“Alright, I’ll take it!” Jiang Ming replied without any hesitation. “There is a force that can come to this world easily. If you guys need Cosmic Energy that bad, why don’t you work with them instead? Wouldn’t it make your life easier?”
“You’re talking about the Lord God Space and the Reincarnation Hall?” Although Jiang Ming did not explicitly mention them, Riyue Changfeng knew what he was talking about, “Due to some reasons, I can’t talk too much about them. All I can say is that descending from the depths of endless space and time comes at a price. Take me as an example. I can’t simply come here and go as I wish. Every time I come here, I need to get something back. If not, the cost will be tremendous. Besides, we need to follow a certain set of rules if we want to come here. We can’t just come here whenever we want. If not, there will be bad consequences.”
“So in other words, someone has set up rules, and you guys have to follow them?” Jiang Ming said.
“Bingo!” Riyue Changfeng nodded.
Then, he told him the way they trade in the auction house.
In general, they traded with immortal crystals.
“As a VIP, I’ll give you a special price!” Riyue Changfeng grabbed something in the air, and in the next second, the world’s heart appeared on his palm and transformed into a fist-sized immortal fetus that beat like a heart.
“A Quasi-Sage Weapon might be very precious for a world, but for someone like me that could travel across different worlds, it’s nothing special. I want five Quasi-Sage Weapons, all from different worlds. This is the fairest price I can offer you. After all, it’s a rare item, and a rare item is priceless!”
“You call this fair price?” Jiang Ming had the urge to beat him up.
‘D*mn it! He wants five Quasi-Save Weapons, and all of them need to come from different worlds? Is he kidding me?’
“Of course, it is!” Riyue Changfeng said with a grin, “There’s a probability that the Heavenly Emperor of your world wouldn’t get one world’s heart after he destroys all the great chiliocosms. Besides, the recoil damage of destroying a great chiliocosm isn’t something that everyone could handle. This is the most terrifying aspect of the heart of the great chiliocosms. I have a friend and he sold it for 12 Quasi-Sage Weapons.”
“No one will buy it from you here!” Jiang Ming said.
“I know! That’s why I came for you!” Riyue Changfeng replied matter-of-factly.
“But it’s five Quasi-Sage Weapons!” Jiang Ming still found it hard to believe, and a thought flitted across his head. He pointed at the treasures and asked, “Can I exchange with Dao Vessels?”
“Of course, you can! I accept other things like Spiritual Roots, or Immortal Roots as well. The more variety you have from different worlds, the greater the value will be. Some of their value can even become double of their original value!” Riyue Changfeng said as his eyes glowed.
“In that case, maybe you’ve found the right person!” Jiang Ming laughed, “We can trade, but I hope you have enough items to trade with me!”
“I can’t guarantee anything, but it should be enough for you to evolve your inner world to the next stage!” Riyue Changfeng’s eyes grew even brighter.
On Chuyang Peak.
A smile broke across Jiang Ming’s face after he learned everything through his clone.
‘Items from different worlds huh?’
It might be impossible for other people, but it was an easy task for him. It was just that he needed to come up with a plan since he needed to get high quality items.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was still telling him about the various forces in the Honggu Realm.
The Heavenly Court was the strongest amongst them, and there were many middle chiliocosms under it.
Other than that, it was the Abyss, the Fo Sect, the Dragon race, and the Devil race to name a few.
“Of course, the overall combat prowess of the human race is great, but unfortunately, they’re like a plate of loose sand!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan lamented, “For example, half of the disciples of the Fo Sect are from the human race. The only difference is that they become a Buddha first before becoming human. As for the human-devil in the Abyss, most of them have regarded themselves as demons instead of humans. There are also many different human sects and clans scattering across different parts of the Heavenly Realm. All of them operate in self-contained compartments, and some of them even fight against each other for territory! They ‘re like a plate of loose sand, and they refuse to unite as one. If not, the Heavenly Court…”
He paused for a moment and shook his head.
“If not, those human experts would’ve been exterminated a long time ago!” Jiang Ming chimed in, “The human race makes up the foundation of several different forces, so of course, they wouldn’t let humans unite and become strong.”
“Yeah! You’re right!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled bitterly, “In the past, all I ever cared about was cultivation. I didn’t care what was going on around me at all. It’s only now that I realize the reason why we humans are in an awkward position despite having occupied nearly every corner of the universe. It’s because of them! They don’t want us to be stronger! They want us to be a plate of loose sand instead of working together as one!”
If all humans united and formed into a force, even the Great Heavenly Venerate couldn’t sit still.
“I have heard that in ancient times, a sage once founded the Hall of the Human Emperor. His intention was to make humans rise to the top of the world and dominate all the universe. However, before he could realize his dream, he went missing. We tried to look for him, but we didn’t find anything useful. Now that I think about it, I guess he must’ve been killed by someone,” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “Heavenly generals, buddhas, demons, human-devil... We humans can become anything we want to be.”
Jiang Ming chuckled, “You don’t have to be so pessimistic, brother. Looking from another angle, does this not mean that we humans have infiltrated into different forces? This is the true meaning of spreading across every side of the universe.”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan did not know what to say.
Both of them talked and chatted away.
Most of the time, it was Mountain Master Tian Yuan who told Jiang Ming about his days in the Heavenly Realm, as well as some of the secrets about it, and Jiang Ming finally had a better understanding about the Heavenly Realm.
Afterward, Jiang Ming went into the kitchen and whipped up some food.
“I can’t believe that you still have the appetite to eat at a moment like this…” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said as he looked at the bowl of noodles in front of him.
“Well, it’s a good thing as well!”
He picked up the chopsticks and began eating the noodles.
“It has been such a long time since I last ate something,” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, his voice hoarse and filled with emotion.
“If you like it, I can make some more for you.”
“Really?”
“Of course!”
“That’s great!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan decided to stay and protect the Tianyuan Realm.
Both of them would use their special abilities to look into the Abyss from time to time.
“The Abyss will suffer great loss after the Great Abyss Trial. Now that the Infinite Realm Auction House has descended, in order to get more benefits as well as prepare for the auction, this time more people will die, and the Abyss is going to suffer an even greater loss,” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said. “There’s a possibility that the Great Heavenly Venerate would seize the chance and wipe out the Abyss for good.”
“Is it possible?” Jiang Ming shook his head. “I don’t think so. The Abyss has existed since ancient times. I doubt they would just go down like that without putting up a fight.”
“It all depends on the Great Heavenly Venerate. If he really is hellbent on destroying the Abyss, he can do it.”
“But the problem is will he do it?”
“Honestly, I can’t tell either. If he doesn’t do anything, he’s still able to intimidate the Abyss through his influence. But if he does something and suffers some injuries, things would develop in a different direction.”
“Yeah.”
Jiang Ming nodded.
Once the Great Heavenly Venerate suffered some injuries, many forces would work together and pull him down from his throne.
With that thought in mind, Jiang Ming flipped through the Human Paths Record to check on Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate as well as the situation in the Abyss.
Then, he lifted his eyebrows.
“They’re rallying a group of demons to attack me? D*mn, I’m glad I checked on him! Otherwise, with those Demon Venerates, many people in the Tianyuan Realm would die!
“Hah, want to kill me?”
A glint of darkness crossed Jiang Ming’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - The Hand of Heaven, The Abyss Has Been Punctured
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: The Hand of Heaven, The Abyss Has Been Punctured
Name: Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate.
Status: After he had escaped death, Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate brought him back to the Abyss. Under the assistance of several Demon Venerates, he had healed most of his injuries.
Right now, he was discussing with other Demon Venerates the way to counter the Great Abyss as well as the Infinite Realm Auction House that appeared out of nowhere. He suggested that they should destroy the Tianyuan Realm and kill Jiang Ming first.
He gave three reasons to back up with his suggestion.
Firstly, Jiang Ming had killed two Demon Venerates, so they had to avenge the death of their fallen comrades. If they killed Jiang Ming, not only would they be able to raise the morale of the Abyss, but it could also act as a warning for those forces from the Heavenly Realm that they were not pushovers.
Secondly, there was a great secret inside the Tianyuan Realm, and it was a huge probability that it was related to the Holy Dao. If they could get it, the overall combat prowess of the Abyss would increase by leaps and bounds.
Thirdly, Jiang Ming might be able to get a ton of Dao Vessels from the Infinite Realm Auction House, and it would be too late to kill him by then.
He suggested that they should send four Demon Venerates and kill Jiang Ming before it was too late.
A hint of coldness flashed across Jiang Ming’s eyes.
After Mountain Master Tian Yuan had returned to his own house, Jiang Ming withdrew his gaze. There was an invisible forcefield enveloping the balcony.
“Want to kill me? Let me give you all a big gift first. I wonder if you can take it or not?”
He sat on the rattan chair and checked the status of Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate and the Blood Emperor through the Human Paths Record.
He lifted his eyebrows in surprise when he saw the Blood Emperor’s status.
The Blood Emperor was the new supporter that Xue Tao Demon Lord had found. He was a Great Overarching Expert, and he was very famous in the Abyss. He also had the potential to become the Demon Venerate in the future.
At this moment, he was located in the direction about ten million miles away from Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate.
‘Ten million miles? That’s too close.’
As for Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, he was with Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate right now.
‘Hah!’ Jiang Ming scoffed inwardly as he summoned a clone beside him. At the same time, he also took a jade amulet out.
“Senior brother, you’re going to do that again?” Phoenix Linglong asked as she threw herself on him. “This is so exciting. I can’t wait to see it anymore!”
“I’m not doing anything to you, so what’s there to be so excited about?” Jiang Ming asked as he wrapped his arms around her.
“Now that you mentioned it… Why don’t we have another blood-and-fire showdown on the balcony?”
“You’ll burn yourself to death!”
“I’m more than happy to get burned to death!”
“Hands off! Ouch! You’re hurting me!” Jiang Ming shouted angrily.
He pulled out the Heavenly Batton and flew into the sky. Very soon, he had arrived at the Heavenly Southern Gate.
At this moment, the clone took the jade amulet and went into the Human Paths Record. Using the locate function, he went to the designated location.
Jiang Ming shuddered as he could feel his power was being drained away.
“How fast, senior brother! Is this the best you can do?”
Jiang Ming was speechless.
At the deepest part of the Abyss.
There was a mountain of about 720,000 feet tall that seemed to have reached the sky. It was massive and it was exuding a brilliant light. On top of the peak sat a magnificent palace, which for billions of years had emitted a blood-colored glow, coloring the sky and ground in blood red.
Inside the palace, the meeting chamber.
It looked like deep space here with a dozen stars circling around. Six of them were emitting light, and there were huge figures sitting on them.
Two of them were none other than Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate and Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate.
“Are you sure it’s necessary for all of us to go after a small human cultivator?” A Demon Venerate asked, his voice booming, “If those old things from the Heavenly Realm know about it, they will laugh at us!”
“Hong Luo is dead, Thousand-Handed is dead, and Ghost-Faced was nearly killed,” Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate said with a heavy voice, “Of course, we need to take him seriously. That kid cultivates the legendary World Dao. Not only that, but he has also mastered all 3,000 laws, so we mustn’t take him lightly. He’s in the Golden Immortal Extreme Realm right now, and it would be too late if his inner world evolves again. Right now, his immortal origin is almost on the same level as most of us here, not to mention that he could detonate Great Overarching Dao Vessels to unleash a powerful attack on his enemy. Do you have any idea how many Dao Vessels he has detonated in the previous fight? Ten of them! And he wasn’t affected by the recoil damage from detonating in the slightest bit.
“Who could survive if he were to detonate ten Great Overarching Dao Vessels at the same time? You? Or Me? I’m afraid even the Great Heavenly Venerate himself couldn’t survive against an attack of that magnitude!
“Besides, although the Tianyuan Realm doesn’t look like it, it’s a Sage Venerates Dao Square.
“I think it won’t take long before he’s fully healed from the injuries he sustained from the fight.
“Now that the Infinite Realm Auction House has descended, who could or who has the guts to stop him if he gets some Great Overarching Dao Vessels from them?
“Besides, what if he has another breakthrough?
“We’re his enemies, and if we don’t seize the chance and kill him right now, forget about the Great Heavenly Venerate, I’m sure he’ll kill us all first!
“Gentleman, he’s a monster!
“Have you guys forgotten about what happened to Kun Peng and his son? Despite him being an ancient being, he killed both his son and him without any remorse.
“Also, humans might seem weak on the surface, there are a lot of them. Now that he is on the rise and with Mountain Master Tian Yuan on his side, I’m sure more and more people will join his cause in the future.
“Once he becomes the leader of the humans, he’s going to become a bigger threat than the Great Heavenly Venerate. After all, the Great Heavenly Venerate has to maintain the balance. Even if he has the ability to wipe us out, he wouldn’t do it as well.
“Guys, that’s all I have to say. Let’s cast our vote now.”
Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate had analyzed the situation thoroughly.
As for the Great Abyss Trial?
They did not really care about it.
As long as the Great Heavenly Venerate did not come, there shouldn’t be any trouble.
Suddenly, all of them jerked up from their seats, and there was a shocked expression on their face.
They all hastily came out of the meeting hall. When they lifted their heads and looked upward, their faces turned pale.
There was a palace ten million miles away. The Blood Emperor was drinking wine with his arm around a lust demon.
There was a group of dancers in revealing clothes in front of him, but his gaze was calm and his face was stern.
He was terrified when he saw the death of Kun Peng and Demon Venerates at Jiang Ming’s hand.
After Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate took Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate away, he ran and came back to the Abyss.
He did not dare to stay in the Infinite Realm Battlefield anymore.
“I didn’t expect that the Great Heavenly Venerate would open up the Great Abyss Trial…”
The Blood Emperor shuddered when the thought flitted across his head. He knew exactly what would happen afterward.
Many demons in the Abyss would die. Demon lords, demon kings, and even demon emperors would be killed.
The reason he came here right after he had returned to the Abyss was to hide. He decided to stay here until the Great Abyss Trial was over.
“Sigh, why are there so many things happening at the same time?” The Blood Emperor sighed. Suddenly, he felt a chill crept down his spine. He jerked his head to the side and saw there was a man standing beside him.
“How is this possible?!” He shouted in surprise.
This palace was a powerful demonic vessel. He would know about it even if a Demon Venerate came in, but now…
‘Oh no!’
