Before he could do anything, he saw the man stretch his finger at him. At that moment, space froze and time stopped. Just when the Blood Emperor tried to break himself free from the restraint, the finger had already pierced through his forehead.
The Blood Emperor was dead.
The person was none other than Jiang Ming’s clone. He located the Blood Emperor’s location through the Human Paths Record, and came to kill him first.
He glanced at the female demons in the palace and his eyebrows twitched. Even though Jiang Ming was looking at them through the clone, he could feel a bolt of heat shot up from his lower abdomen to his brain.
“Even if they just stand there and do nothing, they could easily seduce one’s mind. It’s no wonder that Mountain Master Tian Yuan told me that some of the people in the Heavenly Realm like to keep some female demons.”
With that thought in his mind, he activated the Great Catastrophes Technique and wiped out all the female demons here.
After that, he flew into the sky and turned to look at the palace where Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate and the others were at. Without any hesitation, he activated the jade amulet in his hand.
In a blink of an eye, an immense power poured forward and turned into a yellow hand. At the same time, it triggered the endless power of order in the universe.
The mountains within hundreds of millions of kilometers collapsed, and billions of demons vaporized instantly. The ground sank, and the hand descended on the palace in the distance.
Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate and the others were discussing what they should do about Jiang Ming when they sensed the commotion outside. When they came out of the meeting hall, the first thing that came into their vision was the big hand that was dropping on them.
“That’s the Heavenly Emperor’s Hand of Heaven!” Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate shouted, “Qian Yang, you vile man! As the Heavenly Emperor as well as the Great Heavenly Venerate, how could you step forward and attack us? Not only that, but you’ve used such a powerful skill on us! Guys, let’s work together and hold it back! If not, all of us are going to die here today!
“The Great Demon Venerate, hurry up and come out to save us!” Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate shouted in despair.
Bam!
The Hand of Heaven fell on them and sent all six Demon Venerates into the ground.
The demonic palace that symbolized the ruler of the Abyss collapsed, and the billions of formations were shattered.
The other experts from the Abyss that lived on the mountain couldn’t escape their fates and got buried deep into the ground as well.
What was even more terrifying was that there was a hole showing the other side of the void in the deepest part as well as the hardest part of the Abyss.
The Abyss had been punctured.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - The Heavenly Emperor is Dumbfounded, Lord Buddha is Furious, the Great Demon Venerate is Heading Toward the Heavenly Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: The Heavenly Emperor is Dumbfounded, Lord Buddha is Furious, the Great Demon Venerate is Heading Toward the Heavenly Realm
?
In the imperial garden of the Heavenly Court.
It was filled with an iridescent immortal light to the brim, and one would feel like they were walking in a dream world if they were here. There were advanced grade spiritual grasses or high grade spiritual roots everywhere. The river that wound through the garden was the purest immortal fluid.
The Great Heavenly Venerate was taking a stroll in the garden, but he seemed distracted. He was thinking about the changes after the Great Abyss Trial as well as the influence of the appearance of the Infinite Realm Auction House.
“Tiabai, do you think the Great Demon Venerate would kill his wife after he comes out of his training?” The Great Heavenly Venerate asked.
He plucked a flower and put it near his nose. As the flowery fragrance tickled his nostrils, his tensed nerves relaxed a bit.
Star Lord Taibai was stunned at the question for a moment before replying with a smile, “Your Majesty, there’s no man in this world who can tolerate something like that. However, his wife is kind of special, so even if he wants to kill her, it’s very unlikely that he would do it. After all, she was the disciple of the Saint Demon. She maintains a good relationship with a few ancient beings in the Abyss, not to mention that she’s pretty powerful herself.”
“Looking from the greater picture, he shouldn’t kill her, but emotionally speaking, even I would look down on him if he doesnt’ kill her!” The Great Heavenly Venerate blew the flower away and stood with his hands behind his back. “Not only is he a man, but he’s the first person in the Abyss. He can be forgiven if he doesn’t know his wife has been cheating on him, but now that the news is spreading all over the place, he’ll become the laughing stock of the Abyss. He’ll even develop a heart demon, and that will be interesting.”
“We don’t have to worry about anything even if the Great Demon Venerate develops a heart demon!” Star Lord Taibai said. “But I’m afraid all of the venerates are waiting for him to come out of his seclusion! They’re waiting to see his reaction! After all, for those old guys, they wouldn’t have an interesting event like this every day!”
“Haha…” The Great Heavenly Venerate laughed, and then he froze. A surprised expression crawled upon his face as he disappeared in the next second.
“What…” Star Lord Taibai’s eyes grew wide as his face set in a horrified expression. “This is the power of the Holy Dao. How can there be such a terrifying power in the world nowaday? Hold on for a second. This isn’t right… This is…”
His face turned pale as if he had seen a ghost. In the next, he disappeared from the garden and came to the Great Heavenly Venerate’s side.
Right now, both of them were standing under the sky.
The World Monitoring Mirror was hovering in front of the Great Heavenly Venerate. It emitted a blinding like and it was showing the things happening in the Abyss.
“This is the deepest part of the Abyss, and… And it has been punctured?!” Star Lord Taibai shuddered and his face turned pale. “Your Majesty, that thing we sensed just now… It… It seems to contain the power from the Heavenly Court…”
“That’s the Hand of Heaven!” The Great Heavenly Venerate’s face was dark, “It’s a peerless special ability I developed. Once cast, it will draw power from the Heavenly Court to deliver a powerful attack on its target. But… But how would it appear in the Abyss?”
He had never told anyone about the Hand of Heaven after he had developed it. He treated it as his trump card, and yet, someone had cast it upon the Abyss.
“How is that possible?” Star Lord Taibai was shocked.
After a short while, the Great Heavenly Venerate closed his eyes and said, “Ghost-Faced Demon Venerate, Tian Yuan Demon Venerate, and Black Fox Demon Venerate are dead. Their existence has been completely wiped out from the universe. They can’t come back anymore! Taibai, why would an attack like that appear in the abyss? How did three Demon Venerates die? Who struck them? What is his purpose? What will happen next?”
“Your Majesty, I… I…” Star Lord Taibai stammered. He did not even need to think deeply and he already knew what would happen next.
This definitely would have a much greater impact than the one caused by the Great Abyss Trial.
He took a deep breath, braced himself, and asked, “Your Majesty, are you sure this is the special ability that you developed? And are you sure you’re the only one who knows this special ability?”
“I’m very sure of it!” The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded.
“Who can do this? Saint Lord? I’m afraid not even a Saint Lord can do that either!” Star Lord Taibai had already calmed himself down. The fire of wisdom flared in his eyes as he began to analyze the situation. “There can only be one explanation. Someone has learned the special ability as well!”
The Great Heavenly Venerate did not say anything.
Star Lord Taibai continued, “I’m sure the reason he did so is to kill the demon, but I didn’t expect that three Demon Venerates would die from that attack. Under the Great Abyss Trial, the battle of the Infinite Realms Battlefield, and the appearance of the Infinite Realm Auction House, they gathered up to discuss countermeasures. That’s why that person could kill three of them at once.
“No matter who he is and where he comes from, he is an enemy of the Abyss! But if he’s really that powerful, he wouldn’t have just stopped there. He should be planning his second strike, and if he doesn’t, things will turn bad.”
As Star Lord Taibai was talking, he saw a burly young man with purple and gold horns on his head appeared in the World Monitoring Mirror. He seemed to have sensed them and raised his head to look at them, his gaze cold and filled with rage.
“Qian Yang, how dare you! Do you really think the Abyss is a pushover, and that you can do whatever you want here?” The young man shouted. In the next second, two divine lights shot out of his eyes and the World Monitoring Mirror blurred, preventing them from knowing what was happening on the other side. Then, a voice pierced through the layers of space and came into their head. “Qian Yang, just you wait!”
“The Great Demon Venerate is here!” Star Lord Taibai exclaimed, “It seems that he wasn’t affected by the attack, and that person who launched the attack was gone. Your Majesty, this is bad!”
The Great Heavenly Venerate did not say anything.
Star Lord Taibai continued, “That attack contains the power of the Heavenly Court. This clearly tells the people that this is something that only a Venerable Immortal who controls the power of the Heavenly Court can deliver.
“Your Majesty, someone wants to make you their scapegoat!
“Although you’re in the Heavenly Court and we can be your witness, no one will believe in you.
‘After all, you can form a clone to attack the Abyss!
“Your Majesty, if everything I said is the truth, then I’m afraid the person must be someone extraordinarily powerful! After all, he can cast the special ability that you have never told anyone about!
“I can’t think of any other better explanation if this isn’t a conspiracy!
“If everything is just like what I said and he’s trying to make you his scapegoat, then his intention is to trigger the hatred of the Abyss as well as to intimidate other Great Monarchs in the Heavenly Realm. After all, no one wants to see you going all out. I’m sure the Great Demon Venerate would be coming for us. When that happens, Lord Buddha, Lord Dragon, and…”
Star Lord Taibai came to an abrupt stop before he could finish his sentence.
“Goal, purpose!” The Great Heavenly Venerate closed his eyes.
“Goal?” Star Lord Taibai was stumped. After a short while, he said, “There shouldn’t be a Great Monarch like this in this universe under the Heavenly Court. Most likely he is from the Infinite Realm Auction House, or just like the Infinite Realm Auction House, he comes from an unknown world and his goal is to bring the Heavenly Court down and throw the world into chaos.”
The Great Heavenly Venerate laughed, “Even if he has a powerful special ability, the fact that he resorts to a petty trick like this means he’s not confident. Besides, there’s no one who can defeat me other than the Saint Lord.”
The Land of Ultimate Bliss of the Fo Sect.
It was filled with the light of Buddha all year round here. Those who stood in the Buddha light would open their hearts, cast away their obsessions, and dark thoughts. They would eventually lay down in a prostrate position and said with a compassionate smile, “Amitabha.”
At this moment, a golden lotus platform appeared. There was a Buddha with drooping ears sitting on top of it and he was looking toward the Abyss.
“Someone has punctured the Abyss in one strike? Is that the power of the Heavenly Court? Does this mean that it’s the Great Heavenly Venerate’s doing? But why would he do something like this when the Great Abyss Trial has been activated? Is it because he’s worried that the Great Demon Venerate would get something from the Infinite Realm Auction House? No, the Great Demon Venerate survives the attack, so is he intimidating us? There is no need for any of it at all. Hmm, this is strange. Anyway, regardless of his intention, the Great Heavenly Venerate is too powerful. And now, with the Abyss sustaining such a great loss, I’m sure the Great Demon Venerate would not just sit idly and do nothing.”
Various thoughts flitted across Lord Buddha’s head. He then closed his eyes and contacted other ancient beings such as Lord Dragon.
Chuyang Peak.
A shocking expression appeared on Jiang Ming’s face when his clone returned.
“The Hand of Heaven is powerful!” He mumbled.
“Senior brother, your hand is more powerful than the Hand of Heaven… Senior brother, what happened to your hand? It has become bigger!”
Phoenix Linglong had a lot of confidence in her senior brother. She knew more than anyone else how powerful his hands were.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - Enslaving A Quasi-Sage (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Enslaving A Quasi-Sage (Part 1)
His junior sister never had enough, but there was nothing he could do. After all, he was a man, and he had to satisfy his junior sister.
Looking at his junior sister who was lying next to him like a little kitten, he let out a sigh of relief.
Suddenly, a thought appeared in his head.
‘What if I ask her to transform into a phoenix next time?’
Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed and his heart began to beat wildly.
He forced himself to calm down, and then he thought about the Heavenly Emperor’s strongest special ability he cast in the Abyss after using the jade amulet.
Whoosh!
He flipped through the Human Paths Record to check on the condition of the six Demon Venerates.
Three of them were dead, including Ghost-Faced Demon Venerated.
Even though Evil-Hearted Demon Venerate survived the attack, he was not in a good shape either.
In his status, he even stated that the attack had reached the power of the Sage Realm.
“Sage Realm huh…” Jiang Ming fell into contemplation.
It was just the raw power of the special ability. He had not used any formation or Quasi-Sage Weapon to boost up its power yet.
He couldn’t imagine how powerful the special ability would be if it was the Heavenly Emperor who cast it.
“Even with the help of the Saint Province Dao Square, I’m afraid not even I can take on an attack like that from him as well. Even if he can’t kill me, he can seal me away. Even if I can run away through the Supreme Pagoda, what should I do afterward?”
Jiang Ming came to a conclusion.
He should not go against the Heavenly Emperor, the Great Demon Venerate, or other ancient beings such as Lord Buddha for the time being.
“I’m too weak!” Jiang Ming sighed.
Suddenly, he sensed something and lifted his head to look at the direction of the Infinite Realm Auction House.
There was a nine-headed bird fluttering its wings next to the auction house. The bird then wrapped itself up in its massive wings and turned into a young man. He looked at the Infinite Realm Auction House and snorted coldly, “They’re auctioning Quasi-Sage Weapons and sanctification of the Holy Law? What high sounding sentiments! Very well, then! Let me test and see if you have what it takes to do that or not!”
With that, he lifted his hand and grabbed something in the air. The void collapsed as he tried to shrink the massive auction palace and bring it away.
However, the palace remained unbudged, even the sea around it was calm.
“How is that possible?” The young man’s pupils constricted as a surprised expression appeared on his face
Riyue Changfeng emerged from the palace. There was a gentle smile on his face, and judging from the arc of his smile, Jiang Ming knew that he must be in a great mood right now.
“I’m Bi Jiu, an elder from the Demon Holy Palace. Haha, I’m just joking with you, Brother Riyue. I hope you won’t mind it,” Bi Jiu said. Gone was the arrogant young man who wanted to test the strength of the Infinite Realm Auction House. The dark expression had dissolved from his face and there was an amicable smile there right now. He looked just like an old friend of Riyue Changfeng as he said, “Brother Riyue, I have to go now. See you next time!”
With that, he transformed back to the nine-headed bird and flew away. However, before he could let out a sigh of relief, a fearful expression crawled upon his face.
There was a hand in front of him, and no matter how hard he struggled, he could not stop himself from flying toward the hand. In the end, the hand grabbed him.
The young man lifted nine of his heads and looked at the massive face in front of him. He was none other than Riyue Changfeng.
He tried to say something but only the squeaking of birds came out of his beak.
“Nine-headed bird? Hmm, today must be my lucky day!” Riyue Changfeng observed the nine-headed bird that he caught with his special ability. The nine-headed bird was at the Quasi-Sage Realm, and Riyue Changfeng nodded in satisfaction. He then lifted his head and looked around him.
“I’m a traveller of space and time, the representative of the Infinite Realm Auction House. I come here for only one reason: to trade. I have a few rules of mine. I will not participate in any disputes, I will not take the initiative to cause trouble, and I do not care about good and evil. All I care about is my auction house, and you all can treat me as a guest from a distant land. However, if any one of you dare to cause me any troubles like this Bi Jiu or want to take the auction house from me, then please forgive me. Once you fall into my hands, you will become my belonging. Don’t beg for mercy, and don’t try to reason with me. It’s useless. Of course, you can try to take someone away from me by force. I don’t really care about it.
“As for this beast. I don’t have the intention of taking it away since it belongs to this world.
“I’ll enslave him, and control his mind with an item. After that, he’ll become the most loyal slave that will never go against one’s will!
“He’ll be the first item to be auctioned when the auction begins!”
As Riyue Changfeng was talking, several complicated runes came out of his palm and went into Bi Jiu’s body. After a short while, he stopped screaming and became as obedient as a little puppy.
He then pulled out a collar which was a Great Overarching Dao Vessel.
He threw it into the air, and the collar landed on the middlemost of Bi Jiu’s head. After that, several runes came out of his body and merged into the collar.
“Go!”
Riyue Changfeng threw the bird into the air, and Bi Jiu transformed back into the young man. He made a bow at Riyue Changfeng before turning back into the nine-headed bird and perched on the palace.
“Gentlemen and ladies, don’t forget about the auction that will take place in another year!” He bowed at the surroundings before looking into the Abyss. A confused expression appeared on his face, but he shook his head indifferently and went back into the palace.
Those experts who had seen what had happened to Bi Jiu couldn’t help themselves but shuddered.
Even the Great Heavenly Venerate nearly jumped up from his throne and shouted, “How… How did he do that?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - Enslaving A Quasi-Sage (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Enslaving A Quasi-Sage (Part 2)
“I… I have no idea either!” Star Lord Taibai said, his blood turning cold and cold sweats were oozing out of his forehead. He looked at the World Monitoring for a long time before he finally came around to his senses. He pressed his parched lips and said in a faltering voice, “Even though there’s a possibility that Bi Jiu has only entered the Quasi-Sage Realm not long ago, he’s still a Quasi-Sage expert! How is there any chance he would get caught by him so easily? Not only that, but he even has his mind washed and manipulated by that guy! If not, considering Bi Jiu’s arrogant attitude, he would rather die than bow and submit to someone like him. Your Majesty, can a Saint Lord manipulate one mind like that?”
He knew the Great Heavenly Venerate couldn’t do something like that no matter how powerful he was.
“I’m afraid the answer is no. But he obviously isn’t a Saint Lord, so how did he do that?” The Great Heavenly Venerate sat down. He had calmed himself down, but his heart was still pumping wildly.
He thought about the hit that punctured the Abyss.
‘Is it him? If it were him, then why doesn’t he show himself? Does he do that to throw the world into chaos so that he can sell better during the auction?”
Chuyang Peak.
“Riyue Changfeng!” Jiang Ming shouted. “The reason he enslaved Bi Jiu after catching him is to tell other people that he isn’t a pushover, and if they dare to attack him, they would end up like Bi Jiu as well.”
From this alone, he could tell that Riyue Changfeng was at least a Saint Lord.
“It seems like he can only do auctions and is forbidden from taking other people’s lives for descending to this world.”
However, this was just Jiang Ming speculation, but he knew now was not the right time for that.
He shook his head and went into the Supreme Chat Room.
[Di Huo: @Group admin!]
[Jiang Ming: How is the preparation going? Is it done?]
[Di Huo: Yes! I used my special authority to open the Sun Treasure Vault, but I only found 30 Great Overarching Dao Vessels. Amongst the 30 Great Overarching Dao Vessels, 21 of them are of normal grade, five of them are middle grade, and four of them high grade. I’m torn between whether I should exchange them with you for points or not!]
[Ao Long: Do you even need to think about that? Points are everything here. You can always get a Great Overarching Dao Vessel at other places, but a great chance like this to earn a ton of points isn’t something you would come across every day!]
[Ao Long: I’m also doing some preparations. I’m going to start a war to gather some Great Overarching Dao Vessels! Group admin, you have to accept them when I get them later on.]
[Jiang Ming: Don’t worry. You have my words. How are we supposed to exchange the Great Overarching Dao Vessel?]
[Ao Long: According to the rules, the Golden Immortal Weapon costs one point, and the Taiyi Immortal Weapon costs five points. The Great Overarching Dao Vessel is categorized into three levels such as normal, middle, and top grade which cost 50, 75, and 100 points respectively. As for the Quasi-Sage Weapon, it’s even more expensive. It uses the same grading system as the Great Overarching Dao Vessel, and it costs 500, 1,000, and 1,500 points respectively.]
[Jiang Ming: That’s cheap! An advanced grade immortal vein costs 10,000 points, but the lowest grade of the Quasi-Sage Weapon only costs 500 points?]
[Ao Long: Haha, you’re surprised, right? In fact, other than us in the Supreme Tower, no one wants to trade for a Golden Immortal Weapon. The cost for a Great Overarching Dao Vessel is considered quite high, and according to my speculation, I’m afraid no one will exchange it for points. A Quasi-Sage weapon might be a little bit more useful, but for us, it’s not worth much.]
[Ao Long: However, things are different when it comes to an advanced grade immortal vein. It’s something that can only be found in great chiliocosms. There are fragments of law as well as Sage Realm Dao fluctuation in it. It’s extremely useful in our cultivation, so it’s priceless and its value is comparable to that of a holy weapon.]
[Ao Long: You see, amongst us, only Hong Yi could get his hand on one advanced grade immortal vein. That guy has developed the Civilization Dao. He’s blessed with great fortune and great opportunities. I’m afraid he has a lot of good stuff in his hands.]
[Ao Long: It’s normal for other people to use points to exchange for treasures or Holy Law, but you, group admin, you’re the only person who would use points to exchange for weapons.]
[Hong Yi: A Great Overarching Dao Weapon is useless to us, but listening to the teaching of Dao can bring a lot of benefits to us. For example, some people will finally find their own pathway, the others might awaken their bloodline or have a breakthrough. There, again, is an unprecedented sacred place for cultivation. Even if you don’t want to listen to the teaching of Dao, you can spend one point to cultivate in the Dao Enlightenment Sea of enlightenment for an hour. But I would recommend you to save up 1,000 points to listen to the teaching of Dao once. This kind of opportunity is something that we can’t ask for. If you miss it, you might miss your future.]
[Ao Long: Thank you so much. I used to wonder if I should save up those points, but after listening to what you said, it’s only then I realize the true benefit of listening to the teaching of Dao.]
[Di Huo: One would never know how good a thing is without having experienced it first. Brother Hong, how many times have you listened to the teaching of Dao?]
[Hong Yi: Buddha said that I can’t go around and tell everyone about something like that, so I’m sorry.]
[Tian Fozi: I’m a Buddha. I said you can tell us means you can tell us!]
[Hong Yi: Haha!]
[Jiang Ming: Guys, I’ll only need 1,000 Great Overarching Weapons. I won’t accept more than that!]
[Ao Long: 1,000? I think it should be enough for all of us.]
[Jiang Ming: How about the Quasi-Sage Weapon? You guys don’t have any?]
[Ao Long: We do have some, but we still need them for protection, so we can’t trade them with you for points for the time being. By the way, is the time limit really 30 years?]
[Jiang Ming: Yeah. It won’t do me any good if I drag it on for too long.]
[Ao Long: You’re right! Brother Hong, Is it really that useful to listen to the teaching of Dao?]

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 10,000 Items (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: 10,000 Items (Part 1)
[Hong Yi: Absolutely! Trust me, you won’t regret it!]
[Ao Long: Alright, then! Since I’ve made up my mind, it doesn’t matter if it’s 30 years later or now! After I’ve gotten the points, I would sign myself up for a teaching lesson of Dao. It’s fine if I can’t ascend into the next realm, but I wish I could evolve my bloodline to increase my combat prowess so that I can challenge the battle tower!]
[Hong Yi: You’ve made the right choice!]
After their conversation, Jiang Ming had gotten plenty of Dao Vessels through the Supreme Order. He also had obtained other things such as immortal crystals, divine crystals, divine fluid, and spiritual roots to name a few.
Some of the group members also said that they were persuading the people behind them to start a war. After all, in Hong Yi’s words, their group admin had given them a great opportunity to ascend their strength to the next level.
Jiang Ming checked his points, and he realized that he had only used tens of thousands of points.
“The Supreme Pagod is the real treasure!” Jiang Ming said.
He then absorbed the immortal crystals and the other into his inner world.
After that, he rose to his feet and came to the balcony. He looked into the distance. The Tianyuan Realm was vast, and it was filled with an immense amount of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura.
Compared to the first time they came here, the Tianyuan realm had changed a lot. Even the animals and plants were changing.
The cultivation speed of the sect’s disciples also skyrocketed.
Even for normal people, after being bathed in the Immortal Spirit Natural Aura for such a long time, they became healthier and stronger.
He turned around and looked at the Jiuyang Grand Hall. Then, he shook his head. “Their cultivation speed is too slow!”
As an idea surfaced in his mind, he waved his hand and a nine-layered pagoda appeared in the empty space in front of the Jiuyang Grand Hall. It gave off a bright divine light, startling the people in the Jiuyang Sect.
Then, Jiang Ming’s voice rang out in their voice.
“This is a Great Overarching Dao Vessel as the Annulum Pagoda. The first level is a book depository and it houses many immortal techniques and special abilities. You can choose anyone you like to cultivate. On the second level, it’s a space where you can use for cultivating or training. The flow of time inside is one thousand times faster than the flow of time outside!”
At this moment the Annulum Pagoda began to spin as it absorbed the Immortal Spirit Natural Aura from the world outside.
“Senior brother, are you preparing to nurture the disciples of our sect?” Phoenix Linglong came over and hugged his arm.
“We’re in the Infinite Realms Battlefield right now, but our sect is too weak. If I don’t speed up their cultivation, I don’t know when we can get out of here,” Jiang Ming said.
“You’re just like their father.”
“Well, I just do what I can do to help them. After all, this is our home as well.”
“Yeah, you’re right. This is our home… Senior brother, why don’t we get a child?”
“A… A what?!” Jiang Ming was stunned.
He thought for a moment and shook his head.
“Now is not the right time. When the time comes, we’ll have a little phoenix!”
“You promise?”
“I promise!”
After that, Jiang Ming flew into the sky.
He emerged from the Tianyuan Realm and headed straight to the Tianyuan Sea.
Riyue Changfeng seemed to have detected him, and the entrance of the Infinite Realm Auction House opened up. He came out and greeted Jiang Ming with a smile on his face, “Brother Jiang, I’m so happy to see you.”
It carried a whole different meaning since Jiang Ming came to meet him in his real form.
“Brother Riyue, you’ve caught my interest, and I can’t wait to see you in person,” Jiang Ming replied.
“Haha, after you!”
“After you!”
Jiang Ming looked at the nine-headed bird before going into the palace.
The door closed when they were inside.
He flung his sleeve and 80 Great Overarching Dao Vessels, 10 Quasi-Sage Weapons including the Mystical Arcane Halberd, the Nine Level Golden Pagoda, Black God Blade, and God Slaying Spear he used to kill Hong Luo Demon Venerate appeared on the floor.
These Quasi-Sage Weapons, including the Mystical Arcane Halberd were useless to him. Therefore, he figured that he should exchange them for something useful.
“There are so many of them?” Riyue Changfeng’s eyes glowed. All of the Dao Vessels in front of him came from different worlds, and he was excited. He brought the heart of the middle chiliocosm and handed it to Jiang Ming.
“Brother Jiang, what else do you need?”
Jiang Ming took over the heart of the middle chiliocosm and stored it in his inner world before passing it into the Human Paths Record. After he ascertained that there was nothing wrong with it, it was only then he absorbed into his inner world.
He could clearly sense that his inner world trembled, and the evolution speed had increased by a thousand times.
“I need a set of Great Overarching Dao Vessels. I’m going to put them in the Tianyuan Realm as a defensive measure. In the meantime, I can also extract some energy from the void for cultivation,” Jiang Ming said.
“That’s easy!” Riyue Changfeng said after he thought for a while. He tapped the air and a light ball appeared in front of him. There were 49 swords in the light ball and each of them were emitting an immense light. All of them were Great Overarching Dao Vessels, and they were made from the same materials.
“This is the Heavenly Star Sword. There are 49 of them, and once you’ve put them in a formation, they could absorb power from their surroundings.
“The formation will start to run by itself after you’ve set them up. The Immortal Spirit Natural Aura they absorb will be a million times more concentrated than that of the outside world. You can also control the formation as well to defend or to kill the intruders, and it’s strong enough to hold a Quasi-Sage expert. What do you think about it?” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile.
“Cool! I like it!” Jiang Ming’s eyes glowed.
“This is exactly what I need!”
“Haha! I’m glad that you like it!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “It’s still not enough to cover the value of the item you gave me, what else do you need?”
“I have some friends, but their cultivation levels are too low. Can you recommend something that could aid them in their cultivation?” Jiang Ming asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 10,000 Items (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: 10,000 Items (Part 2)
“Let me think…” Riyue Changfeng thought for a while. “I have Enlightening Stone, Enlightening Fruit, and Heavenly Heart Futon with me right now. All of them can aid in cultivation. If you think it’s not enough, I still have some items that can increase one’s cultivation level such as ginseng fruit, stellar fruit, Taiyi Golden Pill, Great Overarching Golden Pill, and so on. Why don’t you pick yourself?”
He flung his sleeve and they arrived in a treasure vault.
Everywhere Jiang Ming looked, he saw immortal pills, spiritual fruits, and treasures. They all filled the entire vault to the brim, and Jiang Ming was shocked.
Great Overarching Golden Pill: If one took it at the peak stage of the Taiyi Realm, there were 50% one could step into the Great Overarching Realm.
Stellar fruit: Those below the Heavenly Immortal could take it and form the Stellar Dao Body directly.
Nine-Reincarnation Golden Pill: After taking it, even an ordinary person could form the Great Overarching Dao Body.
Seven Sacred Heart Jade Fruits: One would obtain the ability to look through everyone’s true form after consuming it.
Jiang Ming did not know what to say at all. “Brother Riyue, can I rob you?”
Riyue Changfeng was tickled pink and chuckled, “Brother Jiang, these don’t have any use for me. I just collect them for fun.”
“How can you say they don’t have any use for you? You can use them to earn a ton of money!” Jiang Ming said, “Anyway, how are you going to trade them?”
“You can pick either three for free!”
“Are you sure?”
“Yeah, go ahead!”
“Thank you very much, Brother Riyue. You’re the best!” Jiang Ming said.
Riyue Changfeng smiled at him and said, “Well, these are nothing compared to the deal we’re going to make.”
He hesitated for a while before gritting his teeth and asked, “Brother Jiang, is it possible to get more treasures from other worlds? Not only Dao Vessels!”
Jiang Ming frowned slightly.
“Brother Jiang!” Riyue Changfeng bowed at him. “If you can get those items, I’ll pay you twice of their original value! For one Great Overarching Dao Vessel, you can exchange for two and one immortal vein with me. Of course, the traded ones don’t count.”
“You might go bankrupt!” Jiang Ming squinted his eyes. He did not know why Riyue Changfeng would go to that extent just to get some items.
He wouldn’t be able to gain any profit from the deal at all.
“Well, since I’m going to do business with you, I guess I should tell you everything, Brother Jiang,” Riyue Changfeng said, “It’s not entirely an unprofitable deal even if I pay you in double, considering the things I’ve amassed in the past. The reason I want different items from different worlds is that I want the aura of the world that linger on those items. Once I get the item, I would send it back and extract it to refine as the Worldly Origin Essence. I’m on the verge of ascending into the next realm, and I need a lot of Worldly Origin Essence. If I do it at the same pace as I did in the past, I might need to go to hundreds of worlds before I can achieve the sanctification of Dao.
“The sanctification of Dao is too difficult, and in my case, it’s even more difficult since I cultivate a different dao.
“A hundred worlds might seem a little, but it needs a ton of time and effort, not to mention the danger that comes with it.
“Brother Jiang, you’re my only hope!
“If you can get me the items I need, I’ll give you the most precious items I have. It’s an item that can evolve your inner world into the great chiliocosm!
“Take the value of an ordinary Great Overarching Dao Vessel weapon as a unit. I’ll give you the best price based on our friendship. 10,000 items. This is the best price I can offer you.Brother Jiang, can you provide items of corresponding value from all the worlds?” Riyue Changfeng said hesitantly.
“10,000 items?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record appeared!
He knew that Riyue Changfeng was not lying from his status. Then, when he saw the item from his “status”, his eyes grew wide and his heart began to gallop.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 1)
Character: Riyue Changfeng
Status
: Jiang Ming’s original self is here. He seems to be interested in this. I have a feeling that there will be a great amount of trades coming up.
: Good gracious! He comes up with so many Great Overarching Dao Vessels and Quasi-Sage Weapons in such a short period of time! They even contain the aura of different worlds, which is somewhat incredible! I already knew that he came from the planar world and had descended to this world not long ago. He hasn’t entered the Great Overarching Realm and should be in the Golden Immortal Realm currently but is still able to cut down a Quasi-Sage expert.
: Looking at various great chiliocosms, there are but only several that can be compared against him!
: Even my achievement back then was far inferior to his.
: As for the inheritance? If it is not from the Lord God Space and the Reincarnation Hall, then it should be that Heavenly Venerate, that Daoist Ancestor or maybe the legendary Supreme Pagoda?
: No matter where his inheritance came from, it all shows that he is able to get in touch with people from other great chiliocosms. Moreover, he walks on the path of World Dao. Not only is his combat power sky-defying, but he also has the possibility of evolving his inner world into the middle chiliocosm.
: Coupled with the transactions with me, such possibility would be increased even further.
: This is a potential customer! Perhaps, he may even be my opportunity to sanctify my way of Dao.
: Should I take my chance on him?
: If I don’t, I will preside over the auction and proceed step by step. As such, it would be impossible for me to sanctify my path of Dao without more than one billion years’ time. Who knows how many twists and turns I’ll be experiencing during this period of time?
: If I take my chance? He can come up with so many things in a short period of time. If the temptation is greater, perhaps, my accumulation would meet the conditions from this trip alone.
: Alas, I’m just not reconciled! I can’t find another Chaotic Tree’s seedling in the future! Once it grows up, it will be able to give birth to the Chaos Law. No, it might even give birth to the power of the Chaos Origin. Nevertheless, how long would it take for it to grow? Hundred billion years? Trillions of years? It would take way too long.
: The beneficiaries of the Reincarnation Hall and the Lord God Space who I formed alliances with in the past were too useless. I’ve forced myself to meet up with them several times, but they still couldn’t offer me with many great items. All of them even ended up getting killed one by one. Otherwise, how could I have such a thought of taking my chance on him?
: Alas! It’s the sanctification of Dao!
: Damn it! I’ll offer it! I’ll give him a hundred years’ time to prepare. If the trade can’t be met, I will honestly continue walking through the various worlds. If the trade goes well, I will return to sanctify my way of Dao.
Jiang Ming was shocked, but his expression remained indifferent.
The Chaotic Tree’s seedling which could breed Chaos Laws and even the power of the Chaos Origin? What level of spiritual root would that be? It would be at a heaven-defying level! However the time it needed to grow would be far too long, to the point that it would lead people to despair.
“An offer of 10,000 Dao vessels and that’s the lowest price I can go with!” Riyue Changfeng’s face was full of pain and his expression was extremely solemn, “Brother Jiang, can you provide them? If you can, I will bring out the seedling. Else, that’s the end of the trade!”
“Ten thousand pieces!” Jiang Ming’s heart throbbed a little.
Ten thousand pieces of great Great Overarching Dao Vessels! Jiang Ming did not even know if there were so many Dao vessels that existed in the entire Honggu Heavenly Realm. Moreover, these Dao vessels must have originated from various infinite realms!
Jiang Ming shook his head, “I won’t be able to get my hands on only Great Overarching Dao Vessels for it. What about mixing with the Taiyi Weapons, spiritual roots, and others? Would such items be acceptable?”
“Alright! But these items need to be at least Taiyi-leveled. Ten Taiyi-leveled items, whether they are at elementary or perfect level, can only be equivalent to one Dao vessel, and that they must come from at least more than 100 great chiliocosms.”
“Is that so?” Jiang Ming frowned, as he sunk into deep thoughts.
‘It would not be enough to just rely on my chat group’s friends. But there are many members in the Supreme Pagoda. There’s also the Fifth Immortal Moon.’ He thought he should be able to collect enough items.
“Is there a time limit?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“A hundred years! At most a hundred years!” replied Riyue Changfeng.
“Alright then! I accept it!
“For real?”
“Yes!”
“In that case...” Riyue Changfeng hesitated for a moment, then let out a sigh before smiling bitterly, “Rarely do I get into such complicated thoughts but the item that I’m about to bring to the table is really a genuine great encounter. It’s a great encounter indeed, but I need to grow up quickly!”
As he continued, his tone slowly turned solemn, “Brother Jiang, let’s just start upfront with each other and specify the terms clearly before we proceed with courtesy later on. After all, this item is too special and there can be no mistakes allowed. Before I bring out the item, I need you to swear an oath. Before the trade, you can never disclose it to a second person. If the trade were to be unsuccessful in the end, the oath will always continue to be valid. At the same time, I will also swear an oath that if the trade is successfully made, I will never disclose it to a second person. Can we agree on this?”
“Brother Riyue...” Jiang Ming frowned, rivaling a displeased expression on his face, “You should know what it means to swear on an oath.”
“Of course I know! It will hinder the heart!” Riyue Changfeng replied apologetically, “But it has to be so! If you are confident that you can get your hands on items that are valued at 10,000 Dao vessels, the oath you swore will be over by the end of the trade. As for myself, I would have to keep my oath inevitably throughout my life.”
“I don’t understand. Since this is such a valuable item, why don’t you refer to the people behind you? Come to think of it, if you hand the item over, they will surely give you a lot of benefits!”
If Jiang Ming didn’t know the item that was to be traded and was asked to swear an oath for it, the trade would have been impossible. He would have flicked his sleeves and left instantly!
As for now, Jiang Ming naturally wanted to pretend to thoroughly ask about the whole thing.
“My master is dead!” Riyue Changfeng’s expression was a little gloomy, “I dare not hand the item over. If I handed the item in, half the chance would be that I’ll be given huge rewards, yet the other half of the chance would be myself getting silenced.”
“What if you hand it over publicly?”
“I’m afraid that I’ll be killed before I can even refine all of the benefits that I would’ve received!”
“It would be that brutal?”
“Alas!” Riyue Changfeng sighed, “Plundering is our essence to begin with!” He paused, looking at Jiang Ming with a complicated expression on his face, “If I hadn’t had a special sense that you are somewhat still an honest person, I would not have even brought this up.”
“I’m still a good person to you?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 2)
?
“Of course!” Riyue Changfeng nodded.
Jiang Ming was speechless, but shook his head and said, “It is impossible for me to swear an oath of the great Dao! However, I can tell you about my inheritance. I believe that after I reveal it, you should be able to feel my sincerity!”
Riyue Changfeng frowned.
The very next moment, he saw a token appear in front of Jiang Ming. His pupils immediately shrank, as he somewhat understood what Jiang Ming was getting at.
“I’m the Group Admin!” Jiang Ming added
“What?” Riyue Changfeng’s eyes instantly widened. He stared at Jiang Ming with disbelief, and after a while, he slowly nodded, “No wonder! No wonder you can get so many great items in such a short period of time. To think that you are the Group Admin to that place! You are truly incredible!”
“I’m now certain that your inner world will definitely evolve to middle chiliocosm. If you were to obtain this item of mine, as long as you don’t die, and keep going, you would eventually reach the great chiliocosm!”
“Great Chiliocosm? Oh my!”
The more Riyue Changfeng continued explaining, the swifter his tone was, as he finally said with a smile, “You no longer have to swear an oath!”
“Why?” Jiang Ming also smiled.
“Your inheritance. It’s mysterious but isn’t a secret.” Riyue Changfeng said, “It just so happens that I know some about it.”
“Can you tell me?”
“Alright! It’s mysterious because no one knew of its details so far. It’s not a secret because there are indeed many people who knew of it. I also know that if you don’t enter the Great Overarching Realm, you won’t be able to obtain the real inheritance nor be considered the real disciple from ‘that’ place. Because of that, I’m sure that there isn’t any powerful person behind you currently.”
“Even you yourself don’t know the details?”
“Of course! I’m afraid you don’t understand that this token can only be obtained by chance and cannot be forced upon. I admire you even more now. For you to be born in the planar world and only relied on the great encounter of this token to grow to such a level today is simply incredible.” Riyue Changfeng sighed again and again, before finally taking out the pot of seedling.
In an instant, a strong aura of vitality surged throughout like the ocean waves with strands of Dao fluctuation lingering around, as if there were echoes from the sound of the great Dao.
Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes and noticed that the seedling in Riyue Changfeng’s hand was only half a foot tall, with nine leaves as green as jade.
On each blade, there were three thousand lines, not a single more or less. Around each line were 3,000 breathing pores. Each pore was breathing the breath of heaven and earth, as well as the power of order.
“This is a Chaotic Tree’s seedling!” Riyue Changfeng had a complicated look on his face, “I was hunted down by a Holy Venerate once, accidentally strayed into a secret realm in the Chaos and got ahold of this seedling. There’re rumors saying that it would give birth to a great chiliocosm after it’s matured; that it can breed the Chaos Laws and give birth to the Chaos Origin; and that the former Chaos was sustained by the Chaotic Tree. No matter what it is, this seedling here is still a Chaotic Spiritual Root, even if it’s still in its infancy stage. If I wasn’t in a hurry to sanctify my way of Dao, I wouldn’t have brought it out at all. Brother Jiang, consider this a steal for you! You can also have a check on its authenticity!” Riyue Changfeng handed the seedling over.
Without being hypocritical about it, Jiang Ming took it in his hand and immediately felt his hand sink from the seedling’s weight. It was extremely heavy as though he was holding a 10,000 feet high sacred mountain on his palms.
All in all, it was just a seedling.
His inner world trembled inexplicably, as if it was very eager for the seedling. With a flip of his palm, the seedling disappeared and was brought directly into his inner world. In an instant, the vast space echoed with roars as 3,000 power of laws were directly manifested, surrounding the seedlings. There were also various anomalies that took place all around the place.
‘If I get this seedling, the evolution of my inner world will be increased by at least 10,000 times and I will definitely be able to enter the middle chiliocosm level!’ Jiang Ming felt deep inside.
When Jiang Ming looked over at Riyue Changfeng, he saw the stiff smile on his face as he forcibly held back himself.
Jiang Ming merely smiled as he inserted the seedling into the Human Path Record.
An introduction appeared on it: The seedling of the Chaotic Tree is the mother of all trees and the source of all things. Upon entering its mature stage, it can give birth to 3,000 great laws and evolve into a great chiliocosm.
As Jiang Ming read the introduction, his heart violently skipped a beat. He took the seedling out, and handed it over, “Great treasure! However, how can I make it grow faster?”
Riyue Changfeng secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He almost made his move just now when Jiang Ming took the seedling into his inner world.
When he heard Jiang Ming’s question, a flash of embarrassment flashed through his face as he answered, “I won’t lie to you. This is a treasure, a supreme treasure at that, but its growth is too slow! It has been 30 million years since I got it, but it has only grown taller by a mere 3 inches. While it had 9 leaves back then, it still only has 9 leaves now.”
“Only one inch taller in ten million years?” Jiang Ming had a look of astonishment on his face.
Riyue Changfeng shrugged helplessly, “As long as it’s an energy object, it absorbs everything, whether they are immortal crystals, divine stones, even spiritual crystals and such. Of course, the best things are innate vital essence, Chaos Vital Essence, Xuanhuang Origin Essence and so on. ”
“Even with that, it’s only grown an inch in a thousand years?” Jiang Ming really felt as if the seedling was but an extra.
“However, for a person like you who walks on the path of World Dao, it is a supreme treasure which allows you to break through the bottleneck of the great chiliocosm in the future. Based on this fact alone would’ve made countless people go crazy for it!” Riyue Changfeng carefully took in the seedling and kept it carefully, “Do you want it?”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming gritted his teeth.
“Alright then. I’ll only give you 100 years to provide me with items worth 10,000 pieces of Dao vessels. I won’t attend to you if you run out of time!” Riyue Changfeng continued again, “I’ll give you a warning first. If you really trade for it in the future, always remember not to easily stimulate the special abilities to accelerate the growth of this spiritual root. That’s because once it’s activated, its growth will accelerate. If you put it into your inner world, it may drain your inner world dry. Of course, ordinary special abilities that accelerate growth are useless to it. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chaos Spiritual Root, Invasion of Infinite Realms (Part 3)
?
“That’s the real reason you took it out to make a deal!” Jiang Ming said speechlessly.
Riyue Changfeng merely smiled.
In the end, Jiang Ming left.
…
On top of Chuyang Peak, Phoenix Junior Sister made a cup of tea and brought it over to Jiang Ming “Senior Brother! Is it done?”
“Yeah!” Jiang Ming held the cup and took a sip. As he sat down, his eyes narrowed and looked towards the distant mountains.
Over there, the Fifth Immortal Moon had already finished breaking through and had also consolidated her cultivation briefly. She had completely entered the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm
Jiang Ming transmitted some of his thoughts over to her.
‘Ten thousand Dao vessels! Ten thousand of them!’ He sighed in his heart and was a little worried.
He had experienced many battles in the past and collected many trophies. But he gave the Fifth Immortal Moon most of them. Although he collected many items this time around, their value wasn’t as great as previous. If he wanted to plan further, he could only head towards the Supreme Pagoda.
Just as he was about to go, he suddenly stood up and looked into the distance.
“Senior Brother, what’s wrong?” Phoenix Junior Sister asked.
“Something big is about to happen!” Jiang Ming’s tone was solemn.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan also felt the same thing.
After all, although the place was shielded from the prying eyes of the outside world, they could still clearly sense the changes in the outside world.
He came out of his cultivation retreat, landed right next to Jiang Ming and said solemnly, “It’s going to be a mess!”
“Yeah, it’s going to be a mess indeed!” Both of them looked over to the west at the same time.
Over there, a total of 36 gates appeared out of thin air, each of which was 10,000 feet tall as large numbers of demons swarmed out from them like tidal waves. As each of them came out of the gate, they forced their way into various stations, and even found the gateway towards many small chiliocosms, middle chiliocosms, and even heavenly realms, barging in directly. In addition, a large number of demon gates appeared in the east, south, and north direction as well.
“This is the Great Demon Venerate’s revenge!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “The Great Heavenly Venerate’s attack before this penetrated through the abyss, must have made the Great Demon Venerate extremely angry and felt the danger of death. In addition, with the beginning of the great trial, he might think that the Great Heavenly Venerate was taking this opportunity to level the Abyss directly. Hence, he wanted to drag down countless realms with him. Even... No, the big trial is ongoing at the moment. How could he mobilize so many demons?”
As Mountain Master Tian Yuan said this, he rose into the sky and came to the top of the sky. With his divine eyes, he evoked his special ability, peered through the layers of space and looked towards the Abyss.
“I am afraid that the disciples of many forces have retreated as well!” Jiang Ming came over to him and speculated, “That attack from the Great Heavenly Venerate not only enraged the Great Demon Venerate, but also led to the disappointment of the many forces. They might even feel the sadness and fear from their enemies being taken down like that. After all, that one attack killed three Venerates in one go. Who can guarantee that the Great Heavenly Venerate will not launch such an attack on them? The stronger a being is, the more they will cherish their life, leading to them being more suspicious of others and sometimes turning them to become more ruthless and decisive. ”
“If that’s the case...” Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s expression became more solemn, “Perhaps, the Great Demon Venerate has secretly affiliated with many of the old peoples. If so, he should also be jumping out and challenging the Heavenly Emperor.”
“If it’s an open challenge...” Jiang Ming hesitated, “Will the Heavenly Emperor appear? If he doesn’t fight, he will lose his majesty; if he chooses to fight, he might be besieged.”
“If the Great Demon Venerate is really desperate to kill the Immortal Emperors and Immortal Venerates sent by the Heavenly Court...” Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s tone became even more serious, “The Heavenly Emperor will definitely fight back. This also means that the Fo Sect, the Dragon Clan, the Demon Holy Palace and many others will also emerge for the Great War. ”
The two looked at each other as both of them thought of the most terrifying consequences from the war.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the Immortals, Challenging the Battle Tower Again_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the Immortals, Challenging the Battle Tower Again_1
Jiang Ming did not care much for what was happening. Upon returning to Chuyang Peak, he laid down to take a rest.
In his words: Chaos! Let there be more chaos. The more chaotic the better. When things became chaotic, no one would pay attention to him and he could continue developing himself silently.
“Other than the Heavenly Emperor, I’m afraid all parties want the world to be in chaos.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was even blunter as he continued, “The Dragon Clan, the Demon Holy Palace, the Fo Sect, the Abyss, and even our Human Race, all hope that there will be chaos to take down the Heavenly Emperor from his throne.”
“Why?” Jiang Ming asked.
The Mountain Master Tian Yuan stood beside the railing and looked over at the Infinite Realm Auction House, “Us human race may seem powerful, but is in fact too scattered and divided by many parties. The Heavenly Court overrules, Fo Sects purifies, the Demon Clan cannibalizes, not to mention the Abyss. You can understand a bit by just looking at the Tianyuan Continent. The Sacred Lands of the Human Race appeared as though they were in control, but was that really a fact? When the Immortals descended into the mortal world, did they even care about the life and death of the human race? The Sacred Land didn’t care, so did the Fo Sect. And the Abyss even destroyed your world. ”
“Only by turning the whole world into chaos!” He stretched out his hand and clenched his fist, “Only then will the scattered parties gather into one and even have the opportunity to take down the Heavenly Court, suppress the Fo Sect, and trample the Abyss under our feet. Only then, will our human race have hope of becoming the real master of this world and not the titular presence.”
“Is there any Quasi-Sage expert at his pinnacle within our Human Race?” Jiang Ming seemed to ask himself again, “If not, what’s the use of chaos!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan turned around with a meaningful smile on his face, “We humans are also the oldest existence. Would you even believe that there is no Quasi-Sage expert at his pinnacle among us? Although I have never seen one, I still don’t believe so!”
Jiang Ming pondered. There was no legend here about the creation of man at all. At the beginning where the world was created, thousands of races, including the human, were born.
If it were not for the fact that the human race was naturally weaker, had no innate special abilities, and grew slower in the initial stages, how would the other races stand a chance?
“It doesn’t matter if there is or not!” Jiang Ming stood up and said with a smile, “There is a saying in the mortal world, if you rely on mountains, the mountains might tumble; if you rely on people, the people might run, relying on others will never be as good as relying on yourself. Being strong yourself is the foundation!”
“Such a good way to put it!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan held his hand, “What are your plans in the future?”
“Guard this place!” Jiang Ming said, “Even if the Heavenly Emperor steps into the Tianyuan World, I am confident that I can exchange a few blows with him. If I end up with desperation, I will just risk everything I have to drag the Heavenly Emperor down from his throne.”
“You can at least protect yourself this way, but...” Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned, “There is still a shortcoming!”
“Shortcoming?”
“Yes!”
“Tell me, old brother.”
“This place is too small. If you are besieged by a large formation array from the outside, bombarded by it day and night; or that the place here is directly cut down and moved into the torrent of time and space. How will you be able to deal with it?”
“This...” Jiang Ming frowned.
He really had not thought about this. However, now that it had been brought up, he had to think about it carefully. In a glimpse of an eye, thousands of thoughts flashed across his mind. In the end, all of them converged into a single line of thought which was then temporarily suppressed.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan returned to his residence and continued with his recovery.
“Senior Brother!” Phoenix Junior Sister hugged his arm, “Would you like me to help you relieve the pressure?”
“Relieve pressure?”
“Well! Look at you, frowning. What’s the use of thinking so much? We’ll just deal with whatever comes our way. Even if it’s the worst case scenario, we can just head towards our place of inheritance. If we really reach such a stage, we can just cultivate to the highest realm before returning here and wipe them all out. So, you don’t have to think too much. Now, let me relax you a little.”
“That’s right... Hey! Stop it with your hand! Hiss! Stop squirming around.”
“Senior Brother, even your weapon has raised its halberd.”
Immediately after, a thick mist shrouded the area, blocking off the view. Facing the sunset overlooking the thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, a raucous melody could be heard echoing from the balcony.
As the sun sank, the sea swirled more and more violently, eventually setting off a torrent of water, heaving. At the mountain in the far distance, a stream of water suddenly shot down, turning into a charming waterfall.
As the night finally came down, Jiang Ming shuddered for a moment before he stabilized himself.
“Life is such a scramble!” He laughed dumbly.
“I know what’s for dinner! Let’s fry a few eggs.” Rousing his hands, he stretched his body and started to prepare dinner.
While he was beating the eggs, his Junior Sister jumped over, put her arms around his neck and hung around beside him.
“Don’t cause trouble. I’m cooking!”
“You cook, I’ll do the heavy lifting!”
“The flavor will change!”
“We’ll just have Seafood porridge then!”
Jiang Ming was speechless.
This meal was finally made with many twists and turns.
After dinner was ready, he laid on the wicker chair, stared at the sky full of stars, looked at the ocean in the distance and ate a unique seafood feast.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for making and enjoying a seafood-scented dinner under the bliss of yin and yang. You are rewarded with the increase of Dao fluctuation within the Saint Province Dao Square to 10,000-fold than that of the outside world.”
Jiang Ming took a deep breath. Because he was really surprised by the System this time. He never imagined that there would be such a reward in exchange for indulging in the bliss of intimacy.
With just a thought, the Dao fluctuation on Chuyang Peak changed, reaching 10,000 times more intense than that of the outside world. The outside world was the Infinite Realm Battlefield, where the Dao fluctuation was the same as the Heavenly Realm. This meant that the Dao fluctuation on Chuyang Peak was now equivalent to 10,000 times more intense than that of the Heavenly Realm.
In an instant, the Dao fluctuation flowed through, almost materializing itself. You could even vaguely see the traces of rules flowing through and the mystery of the cycle of creation. Even the chain of orders occasionally appeared.
“Senior Brother, what’s the matter?” Phoenix Junior Sister sensed the changes immediately. She sat on Jiang Ming’s body, raised her head, and her red face was full of shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the Immortals, Challenging the Battle Tower Again_2
She was truly shocked.
“It seems that with a little comprehension, you can directly fall into the state of enlightenment!” She was really startled.
“Just treat it as a Sage Venerate-leveled Dao Square!” Jiang Ming explained vaguely.
The inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda could be exposed. But he would not speak to anyone about the System except to himself. After all, it was the foundation towards his standing.
“It’s almost better than the cultivation conditions in the inheritance’s place where my original body went.” The Phoenix Junior Sister did not continue asking, but was amazed, “With such an environment, do we even have to worry about the cultivation of our people in Tianyuan World from skyrocketing? I’m afraid that cultivating for a day here, would be akin to ten years of effort in the outside world.”
Jiang Ming merely smiled.
With a slight thought, he began to adjust the intensity of the Dao fluctuation in various places. It was 10,000 times higher on Chuyang Peak, 1,000 times higher in Jiuyang Sect, and 100 times higher in the Tianyuan World.
It was finally enough.
Phoenix Junior Sister finally left.
Jiang Ming exhaled a white gaseous breath that traveled thousands of miles away.
“I need to leave for a while and will return in a few days’ time at most!”
“Just go, Senior Brother!”
“Alright!”
After Jiang Ming explained himself, he communicated with the Supreme Order and entered the Supreme Pagoda.
…
Over on the other side, Mountain Master Tian Yuan opened his eyes, raised his head, and revealed an inconceivable look on his face, “The, the, the Dao fluctuation has actually materialized, and the Heavenly Dao has taken off a veil. Even the legendary Sage Venerate Dao Square can’t be compared to this. In this current time, the laws of heaven and earth have become stable, making it very difficult to comprehend it. However, it seems that it has manifested inside this place. If I continue to cultivate here, am I going to reach the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm? The Later stage or even pinnacle?*
He had a face filled with excitement. As he stood up, he wanted to go see Jiang Ming, but suppressed his thoughts when he realized that the place over there was shrouded with mist.
“He’s getting more and more mysterious! It’s great! It’s still great! The more mysterious the better, the more powerful the better!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled and sat down cross-legged.
…
The Sect Master Yan Yan and the others also sensed the change, but they were all calm. After all, they had experienced too much, too much that they were already numb from the shocks. They merely walked out of the hall and clenched their fist to show respect in the direction of Chuyang Peak.
Looking through the various peaks, Sect Master Yan Yan sensed a surge of aura rising into the sky. He knew that it was the fluctuation caused by cultivators breaking through.
He stroked his beard and nodded with satisfaction, “Not bad! Not bad at all. I will also work hard on my cultivation and strive to enter the Immortal Realm as soon as possible! Oh, the Immortal Realm. A level that I won’t even dare dream of, but now it’s just right in front of me!”
When he thought about it sometimes, the Sect Master still felt that it was a little unreal.
…
Inside the Supreme Pagoda, Jiang Ming appeared in the incomparably spacious square. When he looked around, he saw Ye Qingxian was just standing up on a lotus platform on the Sea of Enlightenment.
As if a slight feeling tingled in her, she looked back at him and was a little startled, but couldn’t help laughing.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian paced over in the air.
“How’s it going?” Jiang Ming cupped his hands, “Any great gains?”
“It’s rewarding. It’s just that turning on the Dao Enlightenment Mode takes up too many points!” Ye Qingxian smiled helplessly, “I’ve either been going to the Battle Tower for training, or to the Heavenly Ladder to temper my will recently. However, to improve in a short time, I still need to turn on the Dao Enlightenment Mode!”
“Take your time, there’s a lot of time anyway!” Jiang Ming waved, two chairs and a coffee table appeared and the two sat down.
“My aptitude is too lacking and I don’t have many points with me, so I can only rely on hard work!” Ye Qingxian took a sip from the teacup, “With the goal of joining the group chat and you as the goal, such a life is not bad at all. After all, it is without the daily hassles.”
“This is a good mentality!” Jiang Ming held his teacup and continued to ask, “Can you leave for a long time from reality?”
“Yes I can!” Ye Qingxian looked puzzled, “Is something wrong? I can stay here for a long time.”
“I need your help!” Jiang Ming went on revealing his intentions of buying items such as Taiyi Weapons, high-grade immortal pills, high-grade immortal medicine, middle-grade and above spiritual roots, immortal veins, and immortal fountains.
“Alright, I’m idle anyway and the flow of time here is 1,000 times faster than the outside world!” Ye Qingxian took in his request for help.
Jiang Ming directly transferred 101,000 points over to her.
One thousand points was the reward, whereas the 100,000 was the principal for buying the items he requested.
“Brother Jiang, are you sure to give me 1,000 points as the reward?” Ye Qingxian was shocked.
“It’s just a drizzle of rain!” Jiang Ming said indifferently.
Ye Qingxian clicked her tongue, but shook her head helplessly, “Well, I’ll be taking advantage of a philanthropist like you I guess. One thousand points for just a meager of my time. I feel like a criminal already.”
“Just give more thought to it!”
“Not to worry, Brother Jiang! However, with 100,000 points in hand, why do I have the urge to directly keep it for myself?”
“It’s only 100,000 points!”
“Brother Jiang, it’s insignificant in your eyes, but for us, it will make us go crazy!” Ye Qingxian couldn’t help laughing, “After understanding from others, the people here are extremely eager to get points. There are people selling Taiyi Immortal Weapons in the public for 5 points each, and they are the pinnacle Immortal Weapon. Even so, no one is willing to exchange them. I can even push the price down further to four or even three points.”
“Such a low price?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“It’s easier to trade Taiyi Immortal Weapon with spiritual items of the corresponding level, but too difficult for the points! And this is a common phenomenon, Brother Jiang. Not everyone is like you. Just look at me for example. I was once a member of the chat group in the past but now, I’m so worried about points that even my hairs are turning gray. In this place, one point is equivalent to two hours of Dao enlightenment. When it comes to the critical moments, this is even equivalent to a great encounter. Some people are even willing to exchange a piece of Taiyi Immortal Soldier for just one point. ”
“You can figure it out! I only have one request. It needs to be fast. After you use up the points, I will give you another batch!”
“You’re so wasteful!” Ye Qingxian nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the Immortals, Challenging the Battle Tower Again_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Saint Province at 10,000-Fold, Qingxian the Center of the Immortals, Challenging the Battle Tower Again_3
She didn’t ask for the reason behind it.
After exchanging information for a while longer, she rose directly into the air, came to the very center of the square and released an immortal light, illuminating in all directions. Then, she turned over her palm, and a stone tablet appeared. She threw it straight down and it turned into a 1,000 feet high tablet.
At the same time, a line of Dao motifs appeared on it: Buying immortal weapons, artifacts, immortal pills, spiritual roots and the likes that are of level 15 and above.
Everyone around was attracted by the sudden commotion. After seeing the content on the tablet, all of them had a shocked expression on their face and were overjoyed as they flew over one after one.
“Is this for real?” a young man asked. At the same time, a long sword that was a Taiyi Immortal Weapon appeared in his hand. As he removed his imprint on the weapon and asked, “High-grade Taiyi Immortal Weapon, do you want it?”
“Each Taiyi Immortal Weapon will be offered a unified price of four points!” Ye Qingxian revealed her price for purchase.
She initially wanted to lower the price. However, when she thought about Jiang Ming only requesting for it to be as swift as possible, she decided to set it at such a price directly.
“Take it!” The young man handed the Immortal Weapon over to her directly and took out his own Supreme Order at the same time.
The rest of the people watched the trade as it took place.
“Alright!” Ye Qingxian waved the Immortal Weapon away into her storage and offered up her Supreme Order. With a thought, four points flew out of it and even manifested itself directly, submerging into the other party’s Supreme Order.
“This is real!” The young man was ecstatic. “I originally only had a few points left. Once I am depleted of points, I would’ve lost the qualification to enter the Supreme Pagoda! Never did I expect such a twist and turn! Haha! The heavens wouldn’t lead us down the path of despair! Miss...”
“My name is Ye Qingxian!”
“Immortal Lady Ye, are you still accepting more?”
“Of course! The more the merrier! No one will be rejected.”
“For real?”
“For real!”
Ye Qingxian pointed a finger, and the balance of her points was directly displayed on her Supreme Order, which was more than 100,000 points
Hiss!
The sound of many gasping for air suddenly sounded from all over the place, as they swarmed up at her one by one to start trading.
Taiyi Immortal Weapon? Spiritual Veins? How could they compare to the accumulated points?
As Jiang Ming saw all the people in the square being attracted by the offer, he couldn’t help but smile, thinking that it was settled.
No one could use forceful means, nor can they go against another person’s will here, which makes it the best place to conduct such trades.
‘Since I’m here, let’s cultivate one more time!’
Jiang Ming came over to an empty lotus platform in the Sea of Enlightenment, sat cross-legged and directly turned on the time acceleration mode.
Ten thousand years flashed by with a snap of a finger.
He was planning to refine a total of 49 Great Overarching Dao vessels, the Heavenly Star Swords. Once refined, they could be used to arrange into a Heavenly Star Sword Array Formation upon returning to reality.
In addition, he planned to continue deducing other special abilities. Nevertheless, he did not plan to do the enlightenment of laws. He didn’t want to step into the Taiyi Realm just yet. Hence, it was not worth it.
His inner world was evolving according to the established laws. Since he was now in possession of a middle chiliocosm’s heart, its growth was obviously much faster. However, for it to completely transform into the next realm would be too difficult.
Ten thousand years of time passed by leisurely. It was just a snap of his fingers in the outside world.
As the fog slowly dissipated, Jiang Ming opened his eyes, showing an indifference in the vicissitudes of life. His aura was radiating with a feeling of indifference again. However, with his past similar experience, he could quickly turn back to his original self.
As he stood up and looked around, he saw Ye Qingxian being surrounded by many eager traders.
“I guess I’ll return and look for my Junior Sister to rekindle the warm memory after 10,000 years?” Jiang Ming pondered.
Because he had been cultivating for 10,000 years, he missed a lot of things, especially the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, dresser, bedside, window, rattan chair, balcony, among the vines, in the white clouds, in the stream, and even on the stove...
Everywhere, there were deep traces, which were the deepest nostalgia in his memory.
‘For the time being, I have reached the limit of the current stage. In that case, let’s go to the Battle Tower again. I don’t want to accidentally comprehend the Taiyi Dao and improve my cultivation realm!’
Jiang Ming communicated with the battle tower and directly teleported himself inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - Sky-defying Battle Record, Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Sky-defying Battle Record, Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Golden Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 10,717,888
Achievements: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle Tower level 37, Heavenly Ladder step 42], [True Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower, level 2 to 5, Heavenly Ladder step 43 to 45], [Mystical Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower, level 6 to 9; Sixth Battle Tower, level 1; Heavenly Ladder step 46 to 48].
He still had more than ten million points left. Originally, he had more than 11.3 million. Apart from giving Ye Qingxian the 100,000 and trading tens of thousands with his friends, the rest was spent on evoking the Dao Enlightenment Mode.
As a result, he managed to deduce many terrifying special abilities from those sessions of enlightenment.
Jiang Ming did not head directly to the 1st floor of the Sixth Battle Tower, but he started from the Fifth Battle Tower. He wanted to try out what his current techniques are capable of and tempered his tactics at the same time.
Upon entering the level 1 of the Fifth Battle Tower, the opponent that appeared in front of Jiang Ming was still Jun Sanqian.
“Why are you starting from this level?” Jun Sanqian was a little puzzled.
“I wanted to try out my current techniques!” Jiang Ming smiled, “Old brother, is the Sea of Chaos the realm of the highest level?”
Jun Sanqian merely gave him an inexplicable and strange smile before asking back, “Why did you ask this question all of a sudden?”
“I met a person from the Sea of Chaos. He knew about the Lord God Space, the Reincarnation Hall, and the Supreme Pagoda. However, he didn’t know the specific details of the Sea of Chaos and even kept it a secret. I find that very strange.” Jiang Ming explained honestly, “When I was still in the mortal world, I thought that becoming an Immortal was the ultimate dream. Later, I learned about the small chiliocosm, the middle chiliocosm and the great chiliocosm. I thought that the great chiliocosm was the top of the world already, and that becoming the Heavenly Emperor, dominating the universe, suppressing the heavens, controlling all laws, and ruling the latitude and longitude was the ultimate dream then. However, I later learned about the Sea of Chaos, which made me wonder why the world is layered like this and is there an end to it? Even the Chaos has a cycle of life and death. If so, is there any real immortality? ”
“Why do you keep thinking so much, kid?” Jun Sanqian said, “You’ve only learned to crawl, yet you’re already thinking about jumping. As for whether such a thing exists, you’d have to experience or witness it yourself for it to mean something.”
“You’re right. What you experience firsthand, would be more meaningful!” Jiang Ming sighed and laughed, “Old brother, do you know of the Chaotic Tree? I heard that it is the greatest treasure in helping the evolution of the inner world.”
“To think that you actually know of this object.” Jun Sanqian was surprised, but smiled, “The Chaotic Tree. If you get your hands on it, the way of Dao is akin to be completed.”
“It’s so powerful?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“Yeah!” Jun Sanqian became more serious as he continued, “If you heard about it, or if you have the chance to get it, just do everything you can to get it.”
Jiang Ming was shocked by his reply. Based on his speculations, Jun Sanqian was at the very least, a terrifying existence of the Sage Venerate Realm.
The fact that he would utter such words highlighted further the preciousness of the Chaotic Tree.
“You have a lot of points accumulated and also the Group Admin of the chat group. You should listen to sermons more as it will be of great benefit to your growth. There is also the training opportunity that costs 500,000 points each time. This is the real sky-defying great encounter to you.” Jun Sanqian brought up a few pieces of advice.
“Thank you very much!” Jiang Ming clasped his fists solemnly.
However, he felt helpless inside. Whether it was listening to the sermon or going to the Hongmeng Primordial land to conduct his cultivation, both would take up a lot of time, which he was unwilling to do.
His routine of one meal a day on the mountain could not be interrupted. Who knew that he might be rewarded with a Chaotic Realm?
“Right then! Let’s get down to business!”
“Alright!”
