As Jiang Ming stretched out his hand and grabbed midair, it felt like a doomsday natural disaster. Raging flames went rampant and countless thunder fell from the skies. This was just an ordinary special ability, but was evoked to its extreme. Its destructive power surged around terrifyingly.
If they were in the original Tianyuan Continent, the whole mortal planar would have been destroyed in an instant.
“Light of Purity!” Jun Sanqian’s hand formed a seal, followed by a flash of azure light blooming in the surrounding, sweeping away the all power of this doomsday disaster. At the same time, he commented, “Your deduction of special abilities has become more and more exquisite.”
“However, such tactics were of no use to you, old brother!” Jiang Ming said, as his aura suddenly erupted. On his left hand he evoked the Sky Engulfing Technique, while his right hand evoked the Sky Entrapment Technique, both unparalleled in power.
Even if Jun Sanqian was at the pinnacle of Taiyi Realm at that time, or that he was the genius ranked at the very top of the world, he was still suppressed by Jiang Ming in the end.
Even if the special ability deduced was of ordinary level, Jiang Ming had too many special abilities at his disposal. These special abilities were but only a swift flick of his wrist, yet these were considered as the top-notch existence in the current Heavenly Realm.
Boom!
With one blow of the Great Five Elemental Technique, he evoked the Five Elemental Great Grinder, wiping out Jun Sanqian.
Level 2…level 3…Jiang Ming progressed level after level and his combat power also kept rising.
He did not even use the Great Manifestation Technique to pair with the law of time and space to confront his enemy, but completely went at it head-on, using his normal means to forcefully kill Jun Sanqian.
An invincible aura also kept brewing in his chest. And he was becoming more and more adept at evoking various special abilities.
“Time Space Reincarnation Destruction Technique!”
On level 9 of the Fifth Battle Tower, Jiang Ming launched a terrifying blow of attack.
Space revolved and time flowed, bringing together the wonders of reincarnation. Its cycle was endless, and even the Demolition Dao was integrated into it. Seeing the disillusionment of the divine light around Jun Sanqian, the power of reincarnation cycles had evoked a supreme power.
The fusion of many great Daos allowed the eruption of power to increase by multiple folds, disintegrating Jun Sanqian with only one blow.
With that, the Fifth Battle Tower was forcefully broken through. However, it was unfortunate that there was no reward given. After all, he had already obtained it before this.
Continuing with the Sixth Battle Tower, he was to face those of the extreme Great Overarching Realm in level 1.
The Jun Sanqian who appeared in front of him was ranked among the 100,000 among the extreme Great Overarching experts through all the infinite realms. His combat power was sky-defying and could even kill the ordinary Quasi-Sage.
When compared with the level 9 of the Fifth Battle Tower, it was a whole realm of increase in strength, which was incomparable with the past.
Jiang Ming once tried his best to kill him. However currently…
“Old brother, come on!” Jiang Ming let out a long roar, spitting out 3,000 thunder lights, where each of which could easily kill a Taiyi Golden Immortal.
Its thunderous luminance could destroy the world as it surged throughout like tidal waves, submerging thousands of miles around.
“Supreme Sword Realm!” The ordinary Quasi-Sage-leveled Dao sword in Jun Sanqian’s hands bloomed, and a world appeared out of thin air. The inside was formed from the laws of sword qi, layer upon layer as though it was infinite, crushing the thunderous light one after another. He also loudly roared, “Brother, enough using such a level of special ability!”
“Alright then!” Jiang Ming responded. His aura suddenly changed, as the breath of civilization flowed out, forming a vast river of history with endless pictures depicting the various wonders of civilization.
“Holy Civilization Fist!”
What he had evoked was the Law of the Holy Dao originated from Hong Yi. It was the original version of the punching technique. With just one punch, it was equipped with the power of civilization, which contained the endless flames of wisdom, vast flexibility of Dao and the extreme desire of wisdom and light all beings yearn for.
Boom...
As the punch fell and shook the sky, Jun Sanqian’s Sword Realm was smashed into pieces and he was pushed back from the exchange, “Your comprehension of this punching technique is almost as good as that of Hong Yi! Brother, you’re amazing!”
“Old brother. You know of Hong Yi?” as Jiang Ming asked, he slammed his fists, sending a barrage of 81 blows. Each punch shook the starry sky and created a whistling sound among the sea of ??stars.
“Of course! I know every person here!” Although Jun Sanqian retreated, he could handle the exchange of blows with ease. It was obvious that such a technique was of no use to him.
“Brother! If this is all you’ve got, you can’t do anything to me!” Jun Sanqian said again, “After all, I’m currently in the extreme stage of the Great Overarching Realm, yet you are only a Golden Immortal. Even though you’ve evoked the Supreme Holy Law, it’s still not enough.”
“Is that so?” Jiang Ming was oozing with confidence.
As his boxing technique unfolded, pictures of historical occurrences were conjured. From each of those pictures, it felt as though all of them were able to absorb an infinite volume power. However, it was as Jun Sanqian said just now that such a technique couldn’t do anything to him.
Boom...
Jiang Ming’s left fist shook, and actually sucked in all of the many pictures of civilization that had been conjured. When he saw Jun Sanqian slashed the sword, producing light of three million miles long, his eyes lit up. Meanwhile,his right hand formed the seal, as he shouted, “Old brother! Have a taste of my new technique!”
Invisible fluctuations were radiated around. This was not any 3,000 great Daos. However, it could be seen that the Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel in Jun Sanqian’s hands suddenly trembled, almost forcing him to let go. The sword light that was three million miles long suddenly exploded, turning into a storm that swept across the vast universe.
Jiang Ming was also able to punch his opponent thousands of miles away, as he opened his mouth to spit out an 8,000 miles blood-colored river.
“That technique can actually affect my Dao weapon. It was deduced based on the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment technique, right? Brother! This is amazing! Amazing indeed!” Jun Sanqian did not care about his own injuries, but instead praised Jiang Ming again and again. As he watched Jiang Ming performing the Time Space Reincarnation Destruction Technique again, he quickly defended himself from it.
Before long, he was killed by the powerful bombardment of the attack.
With that, Jiang Ming broke through the level 1 of the Sixth Battle Tower. After all, the opponent was only at the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm.
It was a pity that there were still no points awarded for this level, because he had passed the level before. The next level would be the real starting point.
Upon entering the level 2, the place was a vast starry sky around as the two stood on a barren star.
“The Sacrificial Artifact Judgment Technique is just the detonation of all the energy of the Dao vessel in an instance, creating an extremely powerful explosion that achieves terrifying lethality, hence comparable to the top special abilities!” As Jun Sanqian explained, he couldn’t help but admire, “This kind of special ability is very difficult to comprehend. Extraordinarily difficult indeed. Not only have you fully comprehended the technique, but you have further deduced it into a mysterious technique that can control even other people’ Dao vessels. Mysterious! This is truly inexplicable!”
“Old brother! You’re praising me too much!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “Before I came in, I once had a great battle with someone and the effect of this Sacrificial Artifact Judgment Technique was very good. It got me thinking. If I can control my Dao vessels, why can’t I control those of others? After I came here, I evoked the time acceleration and Dao enlightenment modes, which cost a lot of points to get to this point. I named this technique the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. It’s such a shame that this technique has not yet met my expectations. At present, it can only affect other people’s Dao vessels!” Jiang Ming said again.
“This is amazing already!” Jun Sanqian asked curiously, “What were your expectations?”
“To detonate the opponent’s Dao vessel!”
“If you manage to do such a thing, I will also kneel down in admiration! Brother, let’s continue!”
“Alright!”
The great battle resumed.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - Bodies of Three Lifetimes, Transcendence Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Bodies of Three Lifetimes, Transcendence Technique
Using the same tactics against the enemy did not work this time around. However, Jiang Ming was not discouraged.
As his body suddenly trembled, the 48,000 pores all over his body spurted out rays of divine luminance, which formed into a picture of civilization. All of which came together to form a mighty river of history.
Jiang Ming stood in the middle.
One end of the river extended behind him, as if running through the infinite time and space of the past; while the other end extended in front of him, flowing towards the vast future.
In the infinite distance behind him, a figure suddenly emerged, pacing on the long river of history, rushing over quickly and finally landed behind the top of Jiang Ming’s head.
This person had a blurry figure, but was roughly the same as Jiang Ming. The figure gave off an immensely powerful aura, but was very strange at the same time. It was as if he was not existing in the present nor future, as if he came from ancient times across time and space.
“The Law of the Past? The incarnation formed by condensing the mighty power of the past?” Jun Sanqian paused for a moment and looked at it carefully, “By deducting the long river of history, once it transforms into the long river of time and space, only then that it becomes the real supreme law. Brother, your comprehensive ability is really terrifying!”
“It’s based on Hong Yi’s Holy Civilization Fist’s ability to absorb the resources of endless world civilization, coupled with my Return of Infinite Law Finger technique as well as the evolution of my inner world. I also merged it with the Incarnation Dao before being finally able to realize this Infinite Transcendence Technique!” Jiang Ming explained, “The ultimate goal was detachment. To detach oneself beyond the past, beyond the present and beyond the future. The Infinite Transcendence Technique integrates what we know, what we see, what we think and the likes to form a long river of history, between reality and illusion. The next step is to condense the body of the past, which represents everything that is known, and absorbs all the power of the past. ”
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique and Infinite Transcendence Technique. These are the summary of my own insight, and also my way of Dao! Jiang Ming added, “Old Brother, how are these techniques of mine?”
“Transcendence! Detachment! Brother, you have really touched the threshold of transcendence!” Jun Sanqian nodded in admiration, “Especially the Infinite Transcendence Technique, has infinite possibilities. Perhaps, there’s really a chance for transcendence! In addition to the past body, there are also the present body and the future body, right?”
“Rightfully so!” The one who replied to him was the Past Body. His voice was very distant, as if the voice was transmitted over from a long time ago, hence filled with vicissitudes of life, “Please enlighten me!”
“Please!” Jun Sanqian turned slightly more serious.
“The past is history and it is the interpretation of civilization. I am the past, the history, and the civilization. I interpret the killing fist and kill all the past!” the Past Body explained as it lunged forward.
The past represented history. It was the cohesion of civilization, the accumulation of wisdom, the rotting of the past, the annihilation from withering and the burial by the darkness.
Jiang Ming took advantage of the situation to deduce the Killer Civilization Punch Technique. Concealed within the underlay of civilization was an infinite killer intent.
Boom...
With a single punch, the Past Body sent void ripples that dispersed into millions of miles away, running through civilization with overwhelming killing intent. However, the two Dao fluctuations were properly merged together, allowing the punching technique’s might to continue rising.
However, Jun Sanqian was also extraordinarily powerful and was not afraid at all.
Divine luminance rushed into the sky with a boundless sword.
The barren planet under their feet could not carry the strength of the two of them, as it kept collapsing and scattered all over the place.
“What a Past Body!” The voice of Jun Sanqian exclaiming was heard, “The Past Body used the original body as resources. As long as the original body’s strength is sufficient, the Past Body can always be at its peak; As long as the real body doesn’t fall, the Past body will be able to continue existing.”
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming placed his hands behind his back, stood on the mighty river of history, and smiled, “This is the mystery of the technique that I’ve comprehended. Otherwise, what’s the point if it disappears as soon as it’s broken? Of course, this technique still has many flaws and it is not as mysterious as what you’ve just said. I’m the one who deduced this technique. Hence, if I am removed from the state of Infinite Transcendence Technique, this technique would’ve been naturally unraveled. Otherwise, shattering the long river of history beneath my feet will also reap the same result.”
“It’s not like your real body can’t fight! That’s too difficult!” Jun Sanqian said while fighting.
The formation array formed under his feet finally collapsed completely, turning into residual nuclei as they scattered in all directions, crushed into dust by the aftermath of the peerless energy and swept away.
The starry sky, which was seemingly vast, was existing between reality and illusion. Otherwise, who knew how many galaxies would’ve been shattered and how many stars would’ve been destroyed?
Such a battle was immensely terrifying.
Jiang Ming watched silently.
Jun Sanqian was truly worthy of being a gatekeeper, being so powerful and terrifying, as well as his sky-defying combat power.
What about Jiang Ming himself? Although he was in the Golden Immortal Realm, his origin and resources were no weaker than Jun Sanqian.
As for Jiang Ming’s special abilities? They were also incorporated with many laws, many powerful Daos and formed through absorbing the essence of special abilities from countless worlds. Hence, they would not be that weak.
In fact, the special abilities were the foundation towards his strength. Otherwise, walking solely on one path of Dao, he would have never been able to compete with the opponent even if his origin was sky defying.
“This is still not enough. It’s still a little lacking!” As Jiang Ming whispered softly, two clones appeared beside him and at the same time, evoked the Time and Space Confinement Technique.
The void trembled for a moment and came to a stop.
Jun Sanqian also realized the change in the void, but it was difficult to be too distracted when fighting with the Past Body. As a result, he was imprisoned for a brief moment.
Even if it was just that brief instant, who knew how many thousands attacks existences like them could have been evoked?
Boom...
As the blow landed, even with Jun Sanqian’s terrifying physique-protecting special abilities and his extremely strong physical body, he still couldn’t withstand the boundless killing intent embodied in the fist. Hence, the fist directly annihilated his physical body, will and destroyed his soul. In the end, his body cracked and his primal spirit was annihilated.
Jun Sanqian finally died.
As Jiang Ming went forth into level 3, the two came face to face with each other again.
“While maintaining the Infinite Transcendence Technique to use your Past Body to attack, you can even evolve another clone to attack…” Jun Sanqian sighed repeatedly, “Based on the normal circumstances, such peerless special ability must have many limitations to it. Once evoked, it’s supposed to be very difficult for the main body to split his focus, let alone condensing another clone. Yet, you managed to do it with ease.”
“I’m just taking advantage of the inner world!” Jiang Ming laughed.
Just like what Jun Sanqian said, if it was someone else, it would be impossible to pull this off at all. It would have already been great to be able to maintain the Past Body using all the person’s strength.
However, Jiang Ming had an inner world.
His divine soul and will was sky-defying strong, along with the 3,000 laws merging into one, which was equivalent to the capability of dividing into 3,000 separate wills. Such power was almost endless, which made him even more terrifying.
Of course, it was almost impossible for other experts with inner worlds to achieve such a level. After all, who could be as abnormal as him?
Not only did he have the system, he also received the inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda and had contacts with the beneficiaries of both the Lord God Space and Reincarnation Hall.
“With your inner world as foundation, you managed to deduce such terrifying combat tactics and even played around with them to such an extent. It’s not something you can easily find in the world!” Jun Sanqian said with a smile, “Come on! Let me see all that you’ve got?”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming was naturally ready for it.
Their great battle ensued.
Unsurprisingly, Jun Sanqian still died in the hands of the Past Body and two clones. This continued on until level 5 before such tactics had finally lost its effectiveness.
However, Jiang Ming had conjured ten clones this time around.
The ten avatars evoked their strongest Time Space Concealment Technique at the same time. Such a feat was Jiang Ming’s current limit.
If he were to conjure more clones, his inner world would not be able to keep up as the consumption would be too immense.
In fact, such a situation would only happen within the Battle Tower. If he were to try it in the outside world, such a great battle would have caused his inner world to collapse for sure. However, Jiang Ming had always stored a large amount of the power of origin that had been tempered, just in case the consumption turns out unexpectedly too much.
It was because he clearly knew the meaning of ‘don’t discuss victory before considering defeat’. And this was the way to live in this world.
Upon reaching level 7, Jiang Ming finally had to conjure his Present Body.
The present. It was not pertaining to the past, nor the future. With hundreds of millions of great powers attributed to the self suppressing the present, one could become invincible in the present world and the only one.
The Past Body when coupled with the Present Body were powerful enough to shock even Jun Sanqian as he could not withstand it at all.
It was not long before Jiang Ming was able to make it to level 9.
“What an Infinite Transcendence Technique!” Jun Sanqian sighed with lament, “By using your inner world as a support, you are not afraid of the consumption; With the Past Body being the accumulation of power from the past civilization coupled with the Present Body suppressing the present, your technique is not of the ordinary power. I fear that I won’t be able to even make you reveal your Future Body.”
“Are you talking about the Future Body? Old Brother, I was able to deduce to such a level from this round of cultivation retreat.” Jiang Ming smiled, “When all three bodies have appeared, only then will this special ability of mine become worthy of being a small success.”
“When you say that it is but only a small success, I agree with you!” Jun Sanqian nodded, he naturally saw the great potential for Jiang Ming’s special ability to grow further. In fact, its potential was very terrifying indeed.
“Let’s get on with it!”
“Alright!”
The two went on with their fights again.
The Jun Sanqian who was on level 9 of the Sixth Battle Tower was so powerful that even Jiang Ming’s heart trembled.
If he hadn’t comprehended such heaven-defying special abilities such as the Infinite Transcendence Technique, he would have had to do all he could in order to defeat his opponents.
However, what had it become now?
“The fist of history suppresses the past; the fire of civilization destroys the traces of the past.”
The Past Body existed between reality and illusion, existed in the past, and was drifting in the long river of history. However, the power that erupted was amassed with extreme killing intent.
“Three Thousand Cataclysm Fingers, where the first finger destroys the body, the second finger destroys the soul, and the third finger destroys the mind!”
The Present Body was even more domineering. With the Return of Infinite Law Finger as the foundation, he merged with the true Sambohdha of Civilization, condensed the sharpness of history, accommodated all power in his finger and struck it at its sharpest.
As the third finger was pointed out, it was an attack that focuses on one’s vital essence and spirit. Hence, if the person could not withstand such an attack, he would definitely disintegrate. That was how domineering the Present Body was.
Whenever the attack was evoked, there was absolutely no room for leeway from it. Even so, Jiang Ming didn’t give up just yet. There were five clones on his left, evoking Time and Space Confinement Technique, and another five clones on his right, evoking the Infinite Vessels Manipulation Technique simultaneously.
Because Jiang Ming had to support the outburst of explosion from so many kinds of special ability, the face of his real body turned pale as his aura suddenly fell to a chilling point.
“Brother, you are cheating!” Jun Sanqian cried out in grief and was bombarded to death on the spot.
Jiang Ming let out a sigh of relief, but sighed softly, “This is almost the freezing point that I can endure. The inner world has its limits after all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - Cutting Off the Past, Severing the Future, The One Blow that Entombed Sky (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Cutting Off the Past, Severing the Future, The One Blow that Entombed Sky (Part 1)
The Seventh Battle Tower, which was also the last tower, corresponded to the Quasi-Sage Realm cultivation base.
Upon reaching level 1, a screen appeared in front of him that allowed him to choose weapons. They were still Quasi-Sage Weapons, but all of them were of the extreme stage.
Jiang Ming could only select one of them at most.
After thinking about it for a while, he did not give up the benefit of choosing a weapon as he did before and selected a sword instead.
In an instant, a feeling of connection with his bloodline was felt, a sign of complete refining.
‘The Supreme Pagoda! It’s really extraordinarily mythical!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed within himself.
This was equivalent to the weapon recognizing him as its master without the need for refinement.
Jun Sanqian once again appeared on the opposite side. He looked at Jiang Ming and lamented, “Throughout the ages, very few were able to force their way here at only the Golden Immortal Realm. In this era of yours, there is only one who can match up to you.”
“Hong Zhan?” Jiang Ming asked.
“No!” Jun Sanqian gave him a strange smile, “It won’t be long before you will truly see a fraction of fact in this world.”
“Old Brother, why do you describe the world like there’s still more to it?” Jiang Ming was puzzled.
“Is it not a fraction of the world that I’m seeing now? Is the Honggu Heavenly Realm not even considered a fraction of the world?”
Jun Sanqian merely gave him a chuckle and changed the subject, “You little boy… Your combat power is really sky-defying. Without any inheritance and by just relying on the convenience that the Supreme Pagoda is providing here, you even manage to deduce the Transcendence Technique with endless potential! Even I myself am really amazed by you. ”
“However, my cultivation realm is still quite lacking after all. Even with the support of the inner world, my power of origin is still somewhat lacking!” Jiang Ming said helplessly.
“Alas, the small chiliocosm. For a small chiliocosm to be able to be used by you to such an extent is already considered a certain limit.” Jun Sanqian smiled, “Just wait till you take one step further as your inner world completes its ultimate transformation and sublimation, and enter the middle chiliocosm. Good gracious. When the time comes, you will definitely be able to get through this Battle Tower.”
“I can’t do it now?”
“No, you can’t!”
“What if my inner world doesn’t evolve into the middle chiliocosm, but I’ve entered the Taiyi Realm myself? Could I do it then?”
“It would still be difficult. Unless you manage to comprehend all the 3,000 Taiyi Laws, then there might still be some possibility!”
“It’s that tough?”
“Hah! For the few higher levels in this last Battle Tower, the combat power is comparable to that of the former Saint Lord in your world. What do you think?”
“This...” Jiang Ming was not very surprised about it, “How is the strength level of this Battle Tower divided into? Can the battle power of a Quasi Sage really reach the level comparable to that of the Saint Lord? I heard that those below Saints were mere feeble ants.”
“Generally speaking, within a world, no matter how strong the Quasi-Sage is, it is still too difficult to compare with the Saint Lord. At most, the Quasi-Sage would amount to only a bigger ant than the rest. However, there are too many worlds in existence, far beyond what you might think of! Naturally, some extremely terrifying existences are bound to be born.” Jun Sanqian continued to impart some secrets, “For example, through the bloodline of some creatures, when they reach the Quasi-Sage Realm, they could evoke their Bloodline Inheritance Technique and their combat power can leap even into the Saint Realm. Some would even be able to crush the ordinary saints. There are also those born with extremely powerful innate souls. They could even be comparable to that of the Saint Lord through just the strength of their innate souls; there are some Holy Soldiers which obtained great opportunities and even gave birth to the will of their spiritual soul. By condensing their Dao body, their combat power directly enters the Holy Realm. There are way too many of such existence.
“Way too many?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help grinning.
Did this mean the words of the people weren’t actually true? That those under the Saints were mere feeble ants? He was now saying that there were many Quasi-Sages who could rival even the Saints. He was a little confused from all this information.
“This ‘way too many’ means that even if you entered the Sea of Chaos, you won’t necessarily see one of these geniuses!” Jun Sanqian smiled, “Alright, Let’s stop talking about this. If we continue on this topic, your spiritual Dao will be messed up! Come on! Let me have a look at your Future Body.”
“Wait!” Jiang Ming waved his hand quickly, “Brother, are all the nine levels of this Battle Tower at the Quasi-Sage limits?”
“No!” Jun Sanqian shook his head, “The Quasi-Sage is divided into five stages, the initial stage, the middle stage, the later stage, the peak, and the Hemi-Sage. Each stage is a whole new world as the strength is very different. The first two levels of the Seventh Battle Tower are of Quasi-Sage initial stage, the third and fourth levels are of Quasi-Sage middle stage, the fifth and sixth levels are the later stages of Quasi-Sage, the seventh and eighth levels are the peak level of Quasi-Sage, and the ninth level is Hemi-Sage! ”
“There is still a Hemi-Sage Realm after the Quasi-Sage Realm?” Jiang Ming had an awkward feeling.
“Of course!” Jun Sanqian said with a smile, “Hemi-Sage, also known as Demi-Sage, is someone who has stepped into the threshold of Sainthood, or has clearly understood the method of sanctifying their Dao yet still unable to sublime and complete the transformation. Hemi-Sage already has some characteristics of Saint Lord.”
After Jiang Ming understood the gist of it, it was then that he made his move. A mighty long river of history appeared under his foot. One of its end came from the ancient past, while the other extended into the unpredictable future. Standing on it while holding a long sword, he conjured both the Past Body and the Present Body at the same time. The two bodies immediately evoked peerless techniques towards Jun Sanqian.
JIang Ming went all out.
He also conjured 10 clones, where five of them evoked the Time and Space Confinement Technique, while the other five evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. As expected, they bombarded Jun Sanqian to his death.
Only then did he breathe a sigh of relief.
On level 2, Jun Sanqian was annihilated using the same techniques. However, before Jiang Ming could be happy about it, Jun Sanqian reappeared behind him with a sword slashing across the sky, splitting the sea of ??stars. Its boundless sword edge gave Jiang Ming a great shock.
Not having any chance to think about what just happened, the sword in his hand flew out and exploded the very next moment. The eruption of power turned into a monstrous torrent that drowned the sword qi and shattered Jun Sanqian’s bombardment of attack.
Jiang Ming was also greatly affected by the exchange as the long river of history under his feet suddenly set off endless waves, which then exploded and disappeared into reality.
The Past body and the Present Body quickly teleported in front of Jiang Ming to block off the torrent of destruction before vanishing.
Even the ten cloners that he had conjured were shattered.
Jiang Ming, whose aura had declined to freezing point, seized the momentary opportunity. His aura soared yet again and he recovered most of it in a blink of an eye, fleeing quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - Cutting Off the Past, Severing the Future, The One Blow that Entombed Sky (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Cutting Off the Past, Severing the Future, The One Blow that Entombed Sky (Part 2)
?
Through the starry vast sky, the aura of destruction swept a trillion miles away until it finally returned to its peaceful state.
The two stood opposite each other again.
“Brother! You are ruthless enough to even detonate a Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel!” Jun Sanqian’s look was in discomposure.
The torrent of destruction erupted from such a level of Dao Vessel almost killed him even when he was of such a level of power. Even though he managed to block off the attack, his physical body was torn apart and almost completely destroyed.
His aura had also declined extremely.
“You’re really in great discomposure! However, that was the self-destruction of a top-grade Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel and still it couldn’t kill you!” Jiang Ming smiled, “Old Brother! I sensed that it was your real body just now. Just how did you dodge my fatal blow? ”
“I have a technique that allows me to travel through the false void!” Jun Sanqian explained, “However, this technique has a drawback. It has to be prepared in advance and can only last for a short period of time. When faced with a fatal blow, it allows me to teleport away. It’s a technique that can save a life, hence it’s considered quite an okay technique.”
“There is such a mysterious special ability?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“Of course!” Jun Sanqian said, his debilitating aura began to climb rapidly, and even grew further after reaching the peak. His whole body was also ignited with wisps of golden flames.
“From here on out, I’ll be going at you with the aim of taking you down with me!” Jun Sanqian’s tone became much higher, “Brother! Bring it on!”
As his voice fell, a sword splash split through the sky as the endless edge seemed to have divided the universe into two.
The Jun Sanqian at that state was terrifyingly powerful.
Even the original Northern Emperor Kunpeng, the Black-Hearted Old Demon was far from being compared with him.
“Then fight!”
Jiang Ming’s fighting intent soared into the sky and with a flick of his body, his figure had grown up to 1,000-feet tall. His aura rose majestically to the extreme and the blood qi even seemingly started to materialize. His physical energy was even more tyrannical.
A long river of history had appeared underfoot again, but was wider and vaster than before. The Past Body, the Present Body, and the Future Body appeared together at the same time.
This time, he condensed all three of his lifetimes into reality. The Past Body gathered the power of civilization, the power of experience, the power of growth, the power of accumulation, and the power of various pasts, forming the precipitation of history.
The Present Body suppressed the present, indifferent to others but himself, did not talk about the past nor respect the future. It was firmly existing in the present as though it was inexhaustible and forever invincible.
The Future Body seemed to be extremely hazy, seemingly real and illusory, elusive, incomprehensible, and seemingly non-existent as though it was a phantom. On his body however, there were thousands of traces on him, each of which was a future, a possibility. This was the Future Body. A future that was unpredictable and incomprehensible.
Each different thought and each different action led to a different future. These billions of futures were condensed together and turned into the end of the long river of history. When condensed together, it was the Future Body, the destination, and the end. The future body was representing all kinds of possibilities in the future.
The past, present, and future had all come together in reality.
“Striking through the past, and cutting off all traces of the past!”
His Past Body evoked a mysterious technique, which led him directly into the darkness to cut off the past of Jun Sanqian, breaking his foundation and causing him to lose his past.
This caused Jun Sanqian to become unstable in a glimpse of an eye.
“Entombing Sky Illusory Palm! Sever the future!”
As the palm attack from the Future Body was evoked, it erased all kinds of changes, and the infinite possibilities in the future, Jun Sanqian could only exist in the present, no longer had any flexibility.
Such an attack was amounting to the ultimate lock-on. One cut the past, while the other severed the future. This made him feel rather flustered and even fear because he could neither look back into the past nor the future.
“Three Thousand Cataclysm Fingers, destroy the body, the soul and the mind!” Jiang Ming’s Present Body evoked the strongest technique.
Boom...
“Ten Thousand Swords Entombing Realm!”
However, the Jun Sanqian at that time had already erupted his own powers to the extreme, pushing himself into desperation. Even with his past cut off and his future severed, causing his aura to decline by half in just an instant, he was still terrifying.
Between the slashes of the sword lights, Jun Sanqian collided with the Present Body.
As a result, Jun Sanqian flew back from the exchange, while the Present Body directly exploded.
“Kill!”
The Past Body and the Future Body pursued onward, destroying Jun Sanqian.
…
On the level 3 of the Battle Tower.
“What a Future Body!” Jun Sanqian looked at Jiang Ming and lamented, “By condensing all kinds of futures together, it leaves only one possibility: the great self-confidence and power. You even realized the technique of destiny, cutting off the past, severing the future, rendering your opponent to float aimlessly like duckweeds. They would feel as though they should not exist in the world while their subconscious falls into a confused state, losing themselves, and even losing their very foundation. If their cultivation base is poor, they would even disappear in an instant.”
“There are still many flaws to it. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be almost broken through in level 2!” Jiang Ming said.
“You brat!” Jun Sanqian was speechless, “You are a Golden Immortal, while I am a Quasi-Sage. The past, the present, and the future. All three were deduced well but are far from perfect. Its flaws are also too obvious! As your three lifetimes, and three clones launch their attacks, however tacit their cooperation and understanding they have between them, they are still three separate entities after all. Once the three bodies merge into one and one strike from it contains the accumulation of the powers from the past, present and future, then can the technique be considered to have reached its Mastery Stage!”
“You are right, old brother!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help nodding, “This is the direction that I’m aiming for. It’s just that such a feat is extremely difficult. I have tried 36 million times, but to no avail!”
“Having no success when your direction is correct implies that you haven’t comprehended the true essence!” Jun Sanqian pointed out.
“Is the direction really correct?” Jiang Ming’s eyes suddenly lit up.
“Of course!”
“Thank you, old brother!”
“Haha! Make your move, brother!”
“Alright!”
The two went down into a great battle again.
This time however, Jiang Ming failed miserably and was killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - Cutting Off the Past, Severing the
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Cutting Off the Past, Severing the Future, The One Blow that Entombed Sky (Part 3)
“Let’s do it again!”
Jiang Ming returned to the Battle Tower and made another selection for his choice of weapon. This time, he had chosen a bell. The long river of history appeared below his feet and so did the three lifetimes of himself. However, all three of his three lifetimes were killed at the same time in just a short time.
The current Jun Sanqian was in the middle stage of Quasi-Sage. His strength was sky-defyingly peerless and his special abilities were incomparably terrifying.
At the moment when all three of his bodies of lifetimes were killed, the endless sword energy directly reached Jiang Ming’s eyebrows, not allowing him a chance to breathe at all.
“Detonate!”
Jiang Ming had expected such a situation earlier, hence he could instantly detonate the Immortal bell. He also squeezed the power of his inner world to the best of his ability and once again conjured bodies of three lifetimes, protecting himself.
When the immortal bell was detonated, he was too close with it. He could not withstand the eruption of power by himself at all and could only protect himself with his bodies of three lifetimes.
As Jun Sanqian was bombarded and became half crippled, Jiang Ming’s bodies of three lifetimes were annihilated again.
“Inner world, total Annihilation!”
Jiang Ming also went into madness.
Half of the realm of his inner world was sacrificed and turned into a monstrous power and evoked bodies of three lifetimes again. This time however, the bodies of three lifetimes formed a Three-Talented Formation and launched a combined blow, killing Jun Sanqian.
Jiang Ming ascended into level 4.
“Such a tactic of mutual destruction is not advisable! Not advisable at all!” Jun Sanqian said solemnly, “Unless you fall into a situation of total despair, such a tactic must not be used! Otherwise, the price for it will be much too high.”
“Old brother, I understand!” Jiang Ming smiled, “If it wasn’t for the fact that we’re here in the Battle Tower, how could I use this method of self-mutilation? After all, I am the Group Admin!”
“Haha!” Jun Sanqian shook his head and smiled.
A Group Admin, could protect himself indefinitely as long as he had enough points.
“Old brother! With 10,000 points used for defense, what’s the strongest level of power that it can block off?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but ask.
“Don’t ask! I won’t tell if you ask!” Jun Sanqian smiled mysteriously, “As theGroup Admin of the Supreme Pagoda, how can you be easily killed!”
Jiang Ming smiled. His heart was also put at ease from his reply.
“Old brother! Let’s fight again!”
“Alright! Let’s fight again! Brother, that method just now is now useless! This time, I’ll give you a taste of despair!”
The great battle erupted again.
It ended up that Jiang Ming was able to kill Jun Sanqian when he sacrificed his entire inner world and in conjunction with the self-destruction of the Quasi-Sage Weapon.
The exchange was extremely brutal this time around.
As Jiang Ming ascended into level 5, he sacrificed his soul in exchange for strength, but to no avail. He ended up dying five times before giving up.
“Old brother! As long as I’m still in the Golden Immortal Realm, I really can’t get past this level?” Jiang Ming asked with a sense of unwillingness to be defeated.
“There is still a chance!” Jun Sanqian said with a smile.
He was in a good mood. An extraordinarily good mood. All these while, he had basically been bombarded to death by Jiang Ming. This time however, he managed to kill Jiang Ming a few times. It was a very good feeling indeed.
“What kind of chance?” Jiang Ming took a breath.
“Bring your comprehension of the Infinite Transcendence Technique to a perfect state and also further improve your Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!” Jun Sanqian pointed out.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless, “Old brother, aren’t you just pulling my legs? You’ve probably seen through me too. With my current cultivation realm, taking these two techniques a step further is like a fool’s dream!”
“You are quite a steadfast kid!” Jun Sanqian smiled and said strangely, “One more thing, the essence of your soul is extraordinarily powerful and it already has the immortal characteristics of the Holy Realm. As far as the soul is concerned, you’re already half a foot into the Holy Realm. Alas, Brother! I have to say, your fortune is really rich and enviable; your great encounters make even myself a little jealous. You can focus on the Soul Dao and develop it to the extreme. Then, you would still have a chance to defeat me at this level.”
Jiang Ming was speechless. The Soul Dao was even more difficult. This involves the most core essence of life. How could it be easily comprehended? The state of extremeness that Jun Sanqian mentioned just now was not to say impossible, but the chance was just too vague.
“Old brother, is my soul really that strong already?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.
“Of course!” Jun Sanqian nodded, “You can try to comprehend the law of thesoul more without involving ascending to higher realms and only consider the use of the power of the soul to turn it into a means of attack.”
Jiang Ming listened carefully. Being able to be specifically pointed out by Jun Sanqian was naturally of great value. In the end, he left and appeared on the lotus platform in the Sea of Enlightenment.
‘The harvest from this time around is not bad!’ As Jiang Ming looked at his increased points, he let out a smile.
He previously stopped at the level 1 of the Sixth Battle Tower and so the points obtained this time around were calculated from level 2 onwards.
In terms of his cultivation in the Golden Immortal Realm, it corresponded to the Fourth Battle Tower, starting at one point. The Fifth Battle Tower meant a 100-fold increase in points and the Sixth Battle Tower was 100 times more than the previous.
For the Sixth Battle Tower, Jiang Ming was considered to have passed 8 levels, with a total of 80,000 points accumulated.
For the Seventh Battle Tower, the calculation of points was doubled by 100 times, where the level 1 was one million points. After passing four levels, he had obtained a total of four million points.
All in all, he obtained a total of 4.08 million points this time.
‘This is just the beginning!’ Jiang Ming smiled as he looked over at the Heavenly Ladder.
There was another wave of harvest that he could reap. However, after this round of accumulation of points, it would be impossible for him to accumulate such a high amount of points in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - Stellar Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Stellar Pagoda
Name: Jiang Ming.
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Golden Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 20,857,888 (10,717,888 + 4,080,000 + 6,060,000).
Honors: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle tower (37 stages), Heavenly Ladder (42 levels)]. [True Immortal Realm: The fifth battle tower (Stage 2 to Stage 5), Heavenly Ladder (Level 43 to 45)], [Mystical Immortal Realm: The fifth battle tower (Stage 6 to Stage 9), the sixth battle tower (Stage 1), Heavenly Ladder (Level 46 to 48)]. [Golden Immortal Realm: The sixth battle tower (Stage 2 to Stage 9), the seventh battle tower (Stage 1 to Stage 4), Heavenly Ladder (level 49 to 60).]
On level 61, Jiang Ming’s mind was destroyed and he returned to the lotus platform in the enlightenment sea.
He was rewarded 6,060,000 points for clearing level 49 to level 60.
“Level 55 to level 63 belongs to the willpower of a Quasi-Sage, and considering the strength of my soul, I should be able to reach level 63. Unfortunately, there are too few special abilities about souls. Right now, I can only defend passively and it’s already very good for me to reach level 60,” Jiang Ming said to himself.
Compared to the battle tower, there was still room of improvement for the Heavenly Ladder.
He sat in a lotus position and began recuperating. After he had regained his health, he flew into the air and came to the square. He walked to an empty area and pulled his couch out.
There were not many people in the square right now.
After a while, Ye Qingxian came up to him. There was a delighted expression on her face as she chirped, “I had no idea that there would be so many people who want to trade, but there aren’t many good items. I guess I should go back to my world and start collecting more. Brother Jiang, is there a time restriction?”
As she was talking, she pulled a ring out and handed it to him. “I spent 45,000 points this time. You should take a look.”
“Cool!” Jiang Ming took the ring and closed his eyes. There was a space as big as a planet filled with many Taiyi Immortal Weapons, Great Overarching Dao Vessels, spiritual roots, pills of immortality, immortal veins, advanced grade divine crystal, ores, and so on in the ring.
There were about 5,000 Taiyi Immortal Weapons, and 200 Great Overarching Dao Vessels.
The fact that Ye Qingxian could exchange them for 40 points per piece showed how wealthy these inheritors were.
Under the circumstances that so much was traded without prior notice and with a small number of people, it was not hard to imagine how intense the ensuing trade would be once word spread.
However, it was something within expectation as well. After all, those who could make it here were elites among the elites.
“Do you see anything you need?” Jiang Ming asked as he waved his ring.
“Yes!” Ye Qingxian replied, “The 1,000 points you gave me are more valuable than any Dao Vessels or pills. I have confidence that I can enter the chat group before I run out of it. At that time, I should be able to earn a lot of points!”
She looked toward the battle tower and the Heavenly Ladder, her gaze blazed with enthusiasm.
Jiang Ming nodded in assent. He had a good impression on Ye Qingxian. She was matured, well-educated, confident, and down-to-earth.
If it were other people, he was certain that they would’ve thrown themselves at him and asked for more.
“Brother Jiang, you haven’t replied to my question yet. Is there a time limit? We don’t have to do anything anymore after the deal is sealed?” Ye Qingxian asked as she sipped from the tea.
“The flow of time here is 10,000 years. Are you sure you can take it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Don’t worry. It’s just like 10 years in the real world,” Ye Qingxian replied with a grin. “I can take it even if it’s a million years!”
“Alright then!’ Jiang Ming replied, “I’ll decide when the deal is done!”
After that, he transferred 300,000 points to Ye Qingxian.
“You’re really loaded!” Ye Qingxian exclaimed, “I believe none of the people here have more points than you do.”
“Well, this is nothing.”
“Jeez! Stop showing off!”
After both of them had chatted for a while, Jiang Ming returned to the lotus platform on the Dao Enlightenment Sea. He was going to resume his cultivation. He activated the time accelerate mode as well as the Dao Enlightenment Mode.
Ye Qingxian looked at the figure on the lotus platform that was shrouded in the fog. “This should be a special benefit for group members! I must work harder and join the Supreme Immortal Chat Group. Brother Jiang has helped me so much, and I can kill myself if I still can’t get into the group!”
He turned around and returned to the massive stone monument. She forged a timer and left a note on it that read “Next trade will be a thousand years later in the Supreme Pagoda.”
After that, she flew toward the Dao Enlightenment Sea. When she saw Jiang Ming rising to his feet, she frowned in confusion. However, she paid him no mind and landed on a lotus platform. She decided to cultivate here, so she activated the Dao Enlightenment Mode.
Time passed rapidly in the time acceleration mode.
“Another 10,000 years has passed!” Jiang Ming lamented, his voice cold and apathetic.
Suddenly, he sensed a familiar presence and turned his head around. He saw Ye Qingxian was cultivating with her eyes closed. Then, he looked toward the huge stone monument and noticed that there was a timer on it. He couldn’t help himself but chuckle.
Turning his body around, he gazed toward the Heavenly Ladder.
He squinted his eyes, and in the next second, he disappeared from the lotus platform. When he appeared again, he was standing at the 61st level of the Heavenly Ladder which corresponded to the willpower of a Quasi-Sage.
Not only did he receive pressure from the outside, but his soul was being attacked as well.
As soon as Jiang Ming straightened his body, a vast universe appeared in his soul.The river of stars spinned and danced. Suddenly, one after another, all the stars began streaking across the universe and falling down with a mighty power.
Jiang Ming raised his head and looked upward.
As the first barrier of the inner world, it only managed to block the bombardment of nine stars before the world membrane shattered. However, it was considered rather good since the barrier was not a specialized defensive mechanism.
The stars continued to fall. It was as if they wouldn’t stop unless they crushed him.
“There are 72 mores!” Jiang Ming said.
There were a total of 81 stars coming relentlessly at him. Even though his soul was imbued by the soul of the Saint Lord, it was impossible for him to counter the attack.
With that thought in mind, he shouted, “Nine Level Stellar Pagoda! Defend!”
A light that was as bright as the stars above erupted from Jiang Ming’s soul, and formed into the shape of a pagoda around him.
The pagoda had nine levels, and this was the defensive technique he had developed to protect his mind and soul. It was called the Stellar Pagoda.
Bam…
The stars continued to fall, but it did nothing to the Stellar Pagoda. A light flitted across Jiang Ming’s eyes as he looked down at the staircase below him. He let out a grin and said, “I did it! It seems like the stellar defensive technique that I developed by combining the 3,000 laws in the inner world as well as using the Civilization Dao as the foundation is not in vain. It’s truly powerful!”
He raised his feet and continued to mount the staircase.
This time, there were 3,000 sword energies tearing through the air and coming straight at him.
The Stellar Pagoda was able to hold back 2,400 sword energies before it started trembling vigorously.
When it reached the 2,800th sword, the Stellar Pagoda cracked.
In the end, even though it was able to hold back all 3,000 sword energies, the Stellar Pagoda crumbled away.
Jiang Ming cracked his eyes open and there were cold sweats oozing out of his forehead.
He did not continue forward. Instead, he closed his eyes and fell into thought.
On the previous level, it was an attack from 81 stars.
This time, it was 3,000 sword energies.
‘Maybe I can try to absorb the attack to boost up my combat power!’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly.
That being said, it was going to take a long time before he could get it done.
He thought for a long while and stepped on the 63rd step.
On this level, the attack was equivalent to the power of the extreme Quasi-Sage, or otherwise known as the Hemi-Sage or Demi-Sage.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - Reveal Yourself, Celestial Heart Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Reveal Yourself, Celestial Heart Sword
Jiang Ming stood as stiff as a ramrod on the staircase.
Suddenly, his surroundings turned dark and he couldn’t see anything past his fingers. However, a bright light erupted from his soul and lit up the entire space.
“Earth Core Sword!”
A deep, booming voice rang out from the depths of his soul. In the next second, the glittering stars in the distance gave off a brilliant light. They began to swirl around in a circle, and very soon, a long sword that pierced through the universe and star appeared.
It was glowing yellow and it seemed heavy. It seemed as if it was formed from the power of earth itself.
The sword rose, the starry sky shook. When the sword fell, the universe was destroyed.
Jiang Ming frowned deeply as he came out of the Nine Layer Stellar Pagoda.
Bam…
The sword fell, crashing through the world membrane and headed straight at the Stellar Pagoda. A piercing sound that sent shivers down his spine rang out, and the Stellar Pagoda began to crack.
“This attack has gathered the power of the earth!”
Jiang Ming had an incredible eyesight and he saw right through the essence of the attack.
It seemed like the power of the stars, but when he gave it a second thought, the stars were planets themselves as well.
At this moment, another voice rang out.
“Humanity Core Sword!”
As the voice erupted, countless light dots appeared around him and various noises emerged one after another. There was laughter of joy, sobbing cries, cursing grievances, hateful killing intent, roaring rage, hissing beasts, and so on.
The sound was like a torrent, and as the light coalesced and turned into a multicolored sword, it became louder and louder like a thunderclap, resounding through the world.
He felt annoyed and his heart began to race.
When the sword fell, Jiang Ming’s expression changed.
Even though he was annoyed by various voices in his mind and wanted to go crazy, he was able to keep himself calm. In the meantime, he also realized something. The Earth Core Sword drew power from the ground.
In other words, the Humanity Core Sword amassed the power from humans.
‘I’m afraid this is the end for me!’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly. A brilliant light erupted from the depths of his heart. There were traces of all the laws, the imprint of civilization, the light of wisdom, and the hope of the future. All of them formed into a sword energy as he shouted, “Celestial Heart Sword, slash!”
This was a mental attack technique that he had developed himself..
Bam…
The sword energy rose, silencing all the sounds, sweeping away all the darkness, and also shattering the Humanity Core Sword.
He turned his head around and realized that his sword energy was on the verge of breaking as well.
“Heaven Core Sword!”
Without giving him a second to take a breather, another sword energy came at him from the depths of the universe.
Jiang Ming’s heart trembled and he hastily activated the Celestial Heart Word again. It was just this time, it was his sword that got crushed.
The Heaven Core Sword was too powerful. Even the Nine Level Stellar Pagoda couldn’t stop its attack.
“Stellar Flare!”
Jiang Ming was stunned and he immediately activated another secret technique. He ignited the broken Stellar Pagoda and threw it toward the Heaven Core Sword.
The sword energy disappeared in the end, and a sword mark appeared on his soul.
He squinted his eyes and his mind returned.
Drip…
A drop of sweat fell to the ground and Jiang Ming heaved out a sigh of relief.
“The Heaven Core Sword is indeed powerful. Luckily, I was able to neutralize the attack. If not, I would certainly be done for,” Jiang Ming said.
Then, a grin appeared on his face.
He had passed the 63rd level.He lifted his head and looked at the 64th level. This level corresponded to the willpower of a Saint Lord.
“Maybe I should give it a try!” Jiang Ming took a deep breath and stepped on the 64th level.
As soon as his feet landed on the staircase, a giganti finger appeared on top of his sea ofconsciousness. The finger fell and crushed the world membrane, the Nine Level Stellar Pagoda, and the Celestial Heart Sword without any difficulty.
His vision turned black, and by the time he opened his eyes again, he was already back on the 63rd level.
“How is this possible? Why is the difference so big?” Jiang Ming wiped the cold sweat off his forehead and there was a shadow of fear lingered on his face.
“Unless I come across a great opportunity and my inner world evolves again, there’s no way I can get past that level.”
With that thought in his mind, Jiang Ming returned to the lotus platform.
When he saw how many points he had right now, his eyes glowed with happiness.
Although he only managed to pass three levels, he had gotten a total of three million points.
Name: Jiang Ming.
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Golden Immortal Realm).
Points Accumulated: 2,3509,999 (10,717,888 + 4,080,000 + 6,060,0000).
Honor: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle tower (37 stages), Heavenly Ladder (42 levels)], [True Immortal Realm: The fifth battle tower: (Stage 2 to 5), Heavenly Ladder (43 to 45 levels], [Mystical Immortal Realm: The fifth battle tower (Stage 6 to 9), the sixth battle tower (Stage 1), Heavenly Ladder (46 to 47 levels)], [Golden Immortal Realm: The sixth battle tower (Stage 2 to 9), the seventh battle tower (Stage 1 to 4), Heavenly Ladder (49 to 63 levels)].
He had a lot of points, but he did not know where to spend them.
He then returned to the real world.
Although he had spent a lot of time in the Supreme Pagoda, it had only been an hour in the world outside.
“Senior brother, were you cultivating in seclusion for a long time again?” Phoenix Linglong asked. She sensed the faint aura of indifference from Jiang Ming, so she jumped and threw herself into his arms.
“Yeah!” Jiang Ming nodded. In the next second, his eyes widened. “Hey, stop that! Hey! Ouch! Be gentle! That’s the most tender part of my body. How can you be so rough?”
“I’m rough?” Phoenix Linglong was stunned. Then, she pouted, “Senior brother, how can you, a man, say that I’m rough? I’m a girl, you know? You’re the one who’s rough here.”
“Oh, really? Then maybe I should show you how rough I can be!”
Phoenix Linglong squinted her eyes as she exerted more strength on her hand, causing Jiang Ming to groan in pain and excitement.
The next morning.
The sun rose from the east and cast its brilliance over the land.
Jiang Ming got up from the bed and rubbed his back.
He looked at the sun and sighed.
“Well, it’s not a good thing when my junior sister becomes so strong!” He mumbled.
He looked through his ingredients, and he felt disgusted when he saw most of them were seafoods.
In the end, he cooked a pot of porridge and a few dishes.
After he had finished his meal, he said, “It’s time to get moving!”
He obtained a low-grade spiritual root after he had finished his meal. Then, he rose up to his feet and flew into the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - An Attack from the Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: An Attack from the Abyss
In the air above Chuyang Peak...
Jiang Ming turned his head as he took in his surroundings. The Tianyuan Realm had become completely different than when they first arrived here. There were divine lights everywhere and the air was pervaded with Immortal Spirit Natural Aura.
He grabbed the air in front of him. When he opened his hand, there was a wisp of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura in the center of his palm.
“The concentration of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura isn’t enough.”
When the thought surfaced in his head, he waved his hand and 49 Heavenly Star Swords appeared out of thin air. They all floated in the air and glowed brightly in divine light.
He had completely refined these Heavenly Star Swords when he was in the Supreme Pagoda.
Using the Saint Province Dao Square to hide their presence, he distributed the Heavenly Star Swords into every corner of the Tianyuan Realm and formed the Heavenly Star Sword Formation.
As the formation was activated, the entire Tianyuan Realm shook and surges of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura were drawn into it.
In the meantime, there were 3,000 spatial rifts around each Heavenly Star Sword. In the blink of an eye, the concentration of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura in the Tianyuan Realm increased by leaps and bounds.
It didn’t take long for clouds of Immortal Spirit Natural Aura to be formed over the Tianyuan Realm and rain of immortal spirit began to fall.
Most of the people in the Tianyuan Realm noticed the changes. However, most of them knew that this must be the doing of that supreme being from the Jiuyang Sect. All of them were excited, and even the experts in the Jiuyang Sect were overwhelmed with joy.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan came out to the courtyard. He looked into the distance and he saw something that other people couldn’t see through his divine eyes .
“Incredible! In another few years, this place will be another Sage Realm Dao Province.”
He took a step forward, and in the next second, he arrived at Jiang Ming’s side. He exclaimed, “Way to go, brother. This is something that not even I can do with my current power.”
“Well, I’m just lucky enough to come across some opportunities!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Opportunity, huh. For me, this place is my biggest opportunity!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said as he gazed into the distance.
“Right now, the Abyss is on the rise and they’re attacking our homeland. Although chaos is nigh, this sudden change of events will still attract the attention of many people, especially the Abyss. I’m sure they’ll stop at nothing.”
“I hope they know their own place!” Jiang Ming said, his gaze cold.
The Abyss?
He was not afraid of them at all.
A divine light flowed in his eyes and he saw many portals from the Abyss had emerged in various places of the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Countless demons were coming out of the portals, laying waste to everything that crossed their path.
This was a catastrophe.
The land was dyed red and the sea flowed of blood.
Suddenly, Jiang Ming chuckled.
“Speak of the devil!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan sighed, “I hope it isn’t the doing of the Great Demon Venerate.”
“I doubt so!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
If the Great Demon Venerate wanted to rebel against the Heavenly Court, he had to defeat the Heavenly Emperor first.
The Abyss had just been gravely damaged by the “Heavenly Emperor,” and now was the perfect moment to wage a war against the Heavenly Emperor.
But what was happening right now?
Instead of going straight to the Heavenly Emperor, he dispatched his troops all over the place. What would this lead to? Everyone would unite together to fight against him and his troop. Wasn’t this stupid?
Not only that, but there was also a troop coming toward this direction. Obviously, they were coming for him.
A battle had just happened here and several venerates were dead. There was no way they would go down without putting up a fight.
And now, not only was he going to attack the Heavenly Court, but he was going to attack him as well?
In Jiang Ming’s opinion, this was a really bad call.
On the Tianyuan Sea.
Riyue Changfeng emerged from his palace. He glanced at the Tianyuan Realm and sighed, “He’s truly fast. It has only been such a short time and he has already finished refining all 49 Great Overarching Dao Vessels. Not only that, but he has used them to form a formation as well.”
His figure vanished, and in the next second, he appeared on top of the palace. He looked around and shook his head. “The Great Dao is right before us, yet they still want to have a war. What’s the point? It’s just the game of a few figures that stand on the top.”
“Aren’t they fighting for the Great Dao?” Jiang Ming said as he appeared beside him.
Since he did not have to worry about the Tianyuan Realm anymore, he came to the Tianyuan Sea to prevent this place from getting destroyed.
“Great Dao?” Riyue Changfeng shook his head, “The Heavenly Emperor of this realm is powerful. Even though he rules over the Heavenly Court, and he’s certainly the most powerful being in this universe, he still stops at the Demi-Sage Realm.”
“Is it really that hard to achieve the Sage Realm?” Jiang Ming frowned. “Generally speaking, if one has come across many opportunities, it shouldn’t be a problem at all.”
“Nope. It’s harder than you think,” Riyue Changfeng said as he looked at him, “Ever since ancient times, there have only been a handful of people who managed to achieve the Sage Realm. Besides, there’s a quota in every great chiliocosm to how many people can reach Sage Realm experts. Once the quota has been filled, it would be extremely hard for other people to reach the Sage Realm.”
“I see. I didn’t know about that at all!” Jiang Ming replied.
“This is to keep the balance of a world,” Riyue Changfeng continued, “There is one easy way to achieve the Sage Realm once the quota has been filled. That’s to kill one Saint Lord!”
Jiang Ming did not know what to say. Suddenly, a thought appeared in his mind and he pointed upward. “What if we go there? Would it be easier for us to achieve the Sage Realm?”
“Well, you’re right. If the quota in a great chiliocosm has been filled, it’s indeed easier to reach the Sage Realm by going there. If the quota hasn’t been filled, I suggest you stay here as it’s easier to sanctify your Dao in a great chiliocosm,” Riyue Changfeng said, “However, in your situation, you have less restrictions compared to other people. Once the condition is met, you can ascend into the next level.”
“That’s easy for you to say.” Jiang Ming shook his head.
“Haha!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “Anyway, what are you going to do with them?”
He pointed at the demon army that was coming at them.
“Let’s get rid of them!” Jiang Ming said.
In the distance, a group of demons were heading toward the Tianyuan Realm. Most of them were demon soldiers, and only a few of them were demon generals or demon lords.
It seemed that this group of demons were unaware of the things that happened here. If not, there was no way they would have the guts to come here.
Within a blink of an eye, the demon army had invaded the southern, eastern, western, and northern regions of the Tianyuan Sea.
As soon as they got here, they pulled out a bottle and poured it into the Tianyuan Sea.
“Those are Archeron Water. It’s filled with negative energy and it could erode everything it touches. A small bottle of it is enough to pollute the entire sea and kill all of the living organisms in it,” Riyue Changfeng said, “Brother Jiang, it seems to me that they’re going to turn this area into a demon realm. I guess someone must be supporting them from the back.”
“Do you know who it is?” Jiang Ming asked. As he was talking, he flicked his finger and a ray of light shot into the air. When it reached the sky, the ray of light exploded into a bolt of bright, white light before spreading out, purifying all of the negative and evil energy it touched.
In that moment, the demons that entered the Tianyuan Realm screamed and groaned in pain. They felt as if someone had spray acid on them as they were pulverized by the light.
Just when the white light was about to purify everything, a black figure appeared and stopped the white light from spreading.
“I know who it is, but I can’t tell you. After all, I have to follow the rules,” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “Brother Jiang, if you make a move now, I’m afraid there will be a lot of consequences!”
“If I don’t do anything now, the Tianyuan Sea will be gone!” Jiang Ming flew into the air and cast the Killer Civilization Punch Technique. “Our enemies are in our home right now, so of course, I have to fight back!”
The Killer Civilization Punch Technique required the user to be very close to his target, but things became different when it came to Jiang Ming.
In the blink of an eye, he had cast a total of 3,600 punches and killed all of the demons in the Tianyuan Sea.
“How dare you!” An angry voice belted out from the distance. Immediately after, a sword energy that carried a powerful force came straight at Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming raised his fist and intercepted the attack. He looked at the incoming person and said in a grim voice, “It seems like you guys from the Abyss never learn. Since you have the guts to show up here, then I’ll kill you first!”
“Kill me? Hah! How arrogant! Very well, then! I shall kill you today and show to other people that we experts from the Abyss are no pushovers!” The incoming person said, grinning coldly.
He was a young man with silver hair. His entire being was exuding a bright light, and he sported a handsome face.
From his look, he did not seem like a demon from the Abyss at all. However, Jiang Ming knew from a single glance that he was a Demon Venerate.
“Chang Yuan?” Jiang Ming looked at the young man as he frowned.
“You’re the kept man of the Great Demon Concubine, right?”
“How dare you insult me! You must have a death wish!” Chang Yuan Demon Venerate hissed. The crescent-shaped sword in his hand glowed brightly.
“I think you yourself know the best if that’s an insult or not,” Jiang Ming laughed, “Now that the Great Demon Venerate has come out of his seclusion, I wonder how he will punish you.”
As soon as he finished speaking, he activated the Worldly Projection and enveloped the young man in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - Thousand Eyes God Decimation, Appearance of the Great Demon Concubine
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Thousand Eyes God Decimation, Appearance of the Great Demon Concubine
?
Name: Chang Yuan (Gen Gu Demon Venerate)
Race: Silver-blooded Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Quasi-Sage
Background: The Ninth Demon Venerate of the Abyss of the Honggu Heavenly Realm
Relationship: -93
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status: A long time ago when the Abyss first was formed, it hadn’t been divided into different areas. In a deep corner, a demonic worm came into existence. It was thoroughly black and had long silver hair. The most special feature was that it had a thousand eyes.
There was a Great Monarch amongst the demonic worms. He had participated in the war, but he failed to claim the throne and became the Great Demon Venerate. He was killed afterwards, but the blood he left behind had merged with the origin of the Abyss and gave birth to another demonic worm, whose name was known as Chang Yuan.
This demonic worm had gotten the legacy from the Great Monarch. Ever since he was born, he kept a low profile and consumed his own brethren to grow fast and strong. During a war in the Abyss, he received help from the current Great Demon Concubine, who was once a disciple of the Saint Demon Lord and became even stronger.
Killing would never cease to exist in the Abyss. After going through multiple obstacles and escaping death many times, he finally became a Demon Emperor and was taken by the Great Demon Concubine under her wings.
After that, he became a Demon Venerate and called himself Gen Gu Demon Venerate. When the Great Demon Concubine expressed her love to him, he was hesitant to respond in the first place. However, he was grateful of her help and he did not want to see her tortured by loneliness, so he offered his body for the Great Demon Concubine.
He was overwhelmed with joy when he heard Hong Luo Demon Venerate was killed on the Infinite Realm Battlefield. That day, he slept with 3,000 Desire Demons, and he even wanted to eliminate the Great Demon Venerate so that he could claim the Great Demon Concubine all to himself.
However, his plan was thwarted when the Heavenly Emperor announced the Great Abyss Trial. He swore in his heart that he would kill theHeavenly Emperor one day and claimed his wife as his own.
When five of the Demon Venerates were killed and the combat prowess of the Abyss greatly dropped, everyone in the Abyss felt insulted and angry. The Great Demon Venerate was infuriated and he gathered up the remaining Demon Venerates as well as a mysterious being from the depths of the Abyss to start a war against the Heavenly Court.
According to the Great Demon Venerate, they were going to use the Infinite Realm Battlefield as their stepping stone to enter the Heavenly Realm and attack the Heavenly Court. At that time, he would challenge the Heavenly Emperor and end him once and for all with the help from other experts such as the Lord Buddha or the Dragon Lord.
After the Great Demon Venerate had initiated his plan, the Great Demon Concubine asked him to bring a troop of demons with him to attack other worlds to collect blood and spirits from other races. She wanted to make the Saint Blood Pill so that she could step into the Demi-Sage Realm.
In the meantime, the Great Demon Concubine also told him to destroy the Tianyuan Realm in theInfinite Realm Battlefield to avenge Hong Luo Demon Venerate. She also told him that a friend of hers would help him as well. Besides, she said that although Jiang Ming was strong, there was a limit to it. He had just finished a battle with other Demon Venerates, so he must be very weak right now. Not only that, but the Mountain Master Tian Yuan was injured as well, so this was the best moment for them to strike. After all, many forces in the heavenly realm were diverted by the invasion from the Abyss.
According to her experience, the terrifying power in the Tianyuan Realm was definitely a power of a Saint Province Dao Square. She was certain that it was a secret Dao Square of a Saint Lord and it must hold various legacies as well as treasures. If they could get their hands on it, their battle prowess would increase by leaps and bounds.
After hearing what the Great Demon Concubine said, Gen Gu Demon Venerate was interested. He led a troop with him and invaded the Tianyuan Realm. In order to force Jiang Ming to come out, he used the Archeron Water to pollute the Tianyuan Sea and turned the area into the Abyss. If Jiang Ming refused to come out, he would move the entire Tianyuan Realm to the Abyss through the Archeron Water.
As for the Great Demon Venerate’s plan? Scr*w it!
Jiang Ming chuckled when he saw his status.
He thought it was the Great Demon Venerate was the stupid one, but it turned out that it was the Great Demon Concubine. Not only was she not helping him, but she even dispatched a troop of demons to attack the Tianyuan Realm and him.
“I kind of feel sorry for the Great Demon Venerate. His wife cheated on him, and now she’s dragging his feet.” Jiang Ming shook his head.
“How dare you insult the Great Demon Concubine and me. Jiang Ming, I swear to the Abyss that I’ll strike you down today!” Chang Yuan said through gritted teeth.
Although Jiang Ming was merely stating the truth, he must not admit it. After all, he was a Demon Venerate. Besides, the Great Demon Venerate was still alive, so…
Swoosh!
He swung his blade, and there were numerous black dots in his sword energy. Jiang Ming squinted his eyes, and he realized that those black dots were miniature demons, screaming and hissing. They all seemed to have formed a formation and come at him in the form of sword energy.
Chang Yuan was, after all, a well-seasoned demon who had fought for many years in the Abyss. It went without saying that he would have a few aces up his sleeves.
In the meantime, countless demonic eyes began to appear on his body. All of them had slitted pupils and they were exuding a strange red hue as the enveloped Jiang Ming in it.
This was a special ability he developed himself. He called it the Thousand Eyes God Decimation.
It could attack his target’s soul directly. Even if he could not kill his target right away, it could serve as a diversion. When his target was diverted, he would then swoop in and kill them with his blade.
Other Demon Venerates knew about his special ability and they had been very wary of it.
Jiang Ming saw through the nature of his “Thousand Eyes God Decimation,” but he ignored it. He cast the Nine Level Steller Pagoda on his soul. He activated the Killer Civilization Punch Technique on his left hand and crushed the sword energy. At the same time, he pointed his finger at Gen Gu Demon Venerate.
This was a special ability that he had developed, Extermination, the first form of the Three Thousand Cataclysm Fingers.
“He can guard against that special ability of mine?” Chang Yuan was stunned. He wanted to evade Jiang Ming’s finger, but it was already too late.
After all, even though Jiang Ming could guard against the special ability, it would throw him off balance for a while. He did not expect that he could retaliate so fast.
The center of his forehead gave off a brilliant light and a silver-colored flag appeared in front of him. It was the Silvered Flag, a Great Overarcing Dao Vessel of great defensive capability.
As soon as it appeared, the flag glowed brightly and enveloped him in a glowing barrier. However, in the next second, cracks began to appear on the barrier.
“How could this be? D*mn it!”
Chang Yuan lost his control over the Silvered Flag and panic clutched at his heart. Before he could do anything, Jiang Ming’s finger had already pierced through his forehead.
At the same time, Jiang Ming activated the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
Voom…
His soul emerged from his mortal body, but Jiang Ming was not going to give him the chance to run away.
“Soul Extinctor!”
Jiang Ming cast the attack again and destroyed his soul, ending the Demon Venerate’s life one and for all.
He waved his arms and gathered up all the items. At this moment, the sky rumbled and a thunder struck down.
Jiang Ming’s eyes constricted and the Nine Level Golden Pagoda appeared on top of him. While it protected him from the thunder, it got fung away as well.
When he was trading with Riyue Changfeng, he wanted to exchange for some stuff with ten Quasi-Sage Weapons. However, when Riyue Changfeng showed him the Chaotic Tree’s seedling, he abandoned his previous plan.
He decided to amass more items to exchange for the Chaotic Tree’s seedling.
In the end, he kept the Nine Level Golden Pagoda with him. Although it wasn’t a Quasi-Sage Weapon, it was a good defensive item.
While Jiang Ming took a step back, two figures appeared in the distance. One of them was a woman. She was clad in a divine light, and she was alluring.
It went without saying that she was the Great Demon Concubine.
“Jiang Ming, how dare you kill our Demon Venerates!” The Great Demon Concubine’s voice rang out angrily.
Even though she was angry, she was stunningly beautiful. Jiang Ming’s heart raced into a gallop, and he had the urge to kill himself to repent for the sins he had committed.
“D*mn it! I didn’t expect this Great Demon Concubine to be so pretty!”
“We should just kill him!” Another person was an old man. He had gray hair, but he had the face of a baby.
There was something fluttering in front of his face. Initially, Jiang Ming thought it was his beard, but when he looked closely, they were tiny white snakes and he felt a chill down his spine.
They had locked the area as soon as they appeared.
“Kill me?” A brilliant light erupted from Jiang Ming’s heart and cleared his mind. He smiled at them and said, “I think you guys shouldn’t count the chicken before they hatch!”
