chapters.title: Chapter 286 - Flabbergasted Jiang Ming, Relationship that Messed up the 3,000 Realms
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Flabbergasted Jiang Ming, Relationship that Messed up the 3,000 Realms
In the Auction House Palace, Riyue Changfeng looked at the distant sky with his hands behind his back, his white shirt fluttering along with the wind, giving people a feeling that he was someone who was left behind and independent.
“Sacrificial Artifact Judgment technique can only be used to detonate a person’s own Dao vessel, but he was able to interfere with the opponent’s, and that’s the Immortal Dao vessel controlled by a Quasi-Sage expert. This is the sublimation of Sacrificial Artifact Judgment Technique!” He had a look of amazement on his face.
“Also, he wasn’t affected at all by the other party’s natal soul technique. It’s either that his soul’s strength is strong to a certain extent, coupled with a very strong defensive technique or that he has a Soul Defensive Dao vessel!”
“And his punching technique, which has the silhouette of the Holy Civilization Fist technique, is more powerful, more profound, and more mysterious!”
“The last two attack with his fingers, destroying the body and the soul...”
“If all these techniques are based on his own comprehension, then this kid is truly amazing, so peerless that such a person had never been seen in ages.”
Riyue Changfeng was really baffled in amazement.
“The Abyss is actually divided into two factions at such a critical moment. This is interesting! Really interesting indeed! If the Great Demon Concubine were to smash up the whole place here, would the Great Demon Venerate go mad?”
“Maybe not. He might even have a sense of relief! Ha ha...”
Riyue Changfeng had a weird look on his face.
…
As Jiang Ming responded standing in mid-air, he was also looking through the Human Path Records at the same time to check on the identities of the two in front of him.
The white-haired old man was the Thousand Snake Demon Venerable, born of the Thousand Silk Snake Clan. He was the monarch of the snake, the great monarch of the Demon Holy Palace. He once listened to the sermon under the Demon Saint, and his strength grew monstrous.
In the past, he had spent 30,000 years with the Great Demon Concubine in the house of time. They became physically and mentally close to each other, and reached a strategy agreement to be allies.
Currently, he was invited by the Great Demon Concubine to make a move.
Moreover, he was also lusting for the Great Demon Concubine’s body. If he was given another 30,000-year to ‘exercise’ with her, coupled with a portrait of the Great Demon Venerate in front of him as they do so, he imagined that it would definitely be exciting.
The corners of Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched. This Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was really not a good person at all.
Swoosh!
The pages of the Human Path Record were flipped again as he looked at another page.
Name: Yu Fei (Great Demon Concubine)
Race: Sky Desire Demon Race
Gender: Female
Cultivation: Quasi-Sage Realm
Background: The Great Demon Concubine of the Abyss in the Honggu Heavenly Realm
Relationship: -66
Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status
: In the abyss at the beginning of time immemorial, 72 original desires, such as desire, demon, mind, greed, murder, lust and many other, converged together and fused into a congenital bone of desire. She was a lady born from the accumulation of thousands of desires in one entity. This woman had a God-given name, Yu Fei.
: When she was born, she was accepted as a child follower by the Saint Demon Lord to stay by his side.
: Being hit on by the Saint Demon Lord, she was imparted with his cultivation techniques and it released all her body’s potential. Her strength advanced by leaps and bounds, and her desire grew stronger and stronger. Since she stayed in the Sage Venerate Dao Square and was hit on by the Holy Demon Venerate, she was able to maintain a pure and holy temperament.
: After entering the Great Overarching Realm, she was publicly accepted as a named disciple by the Saint Demon Lord, which was considered as giving her an official identity. However, Yu Fei had great ambitions and was dissatisfied with the title. She wanted to become the Holy Concubine of the Saint Demon Lord, but was instead imprisoned for three million years. She had to fight against 3,000 incarnations of the Saint Demon Lord every day.
: Since she absorbed the essence of the Saint Demon Lord, her aptitude had greatly increased, and her strength had also been continuously improving.
: When the Holy Demon Lord left, she was slightly in despair but was also very excited at the same time: she was finally a free person! She had plans to traverse the world, behead all men she encounters and take revenge on the Holy Demon Lord.
: She was about to create a harem of her own and collect men from thousands of races to have fun, the Great Demon Venerate of that era came to her requesting for her cooperation so that he could unify the Abyss at ease. Unable to come to an agreement, she was forcefully suppressed by that Great Demon Venerate and was taken in as his partner on bed. At the same time, the forces and influence that Yu Fei had accumulated were also taken in by the Great Demon Venerate, allowing the abyss that was scattered due to the departure of the previous Holy Demon Lord to become unified again.
: During the siege of the last Heavenly Emperor, the Great Demon Venerate was killed, Yu Fei was captured by the present Heavenly Emperor and was secretly held captive for hundreds of years. The Heavenly Emperor was able to taste the beauty of the most alluring lady of the Abyss. She was later released from captivity.
: Yu Fei’s rage and hatred slowly turned into madness. She originally thought that she would be able to wander freely between heaven and earth after the death of the Holy Demon Lord, and no longer be oppressed by anyone. Who knew that she would be forcefully seized by the Great Demon Venerate and then kept in captivity by the Heavenly Emperor later on? The hatred and desire for revenge that took root long ago in the depths of her soul erupted completely.
: She started to go around enticing the Laughing Buddha of the Fo Sect, seducing the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate of the Demon Holy Palace, had private dates with the monarch of the Dragon Clan and many more. However, the Abyss was chaotic around that time frame and now that Great Demon Venerate was able to fight his way to the top and took over the throne. Due to the potential power and influence of hers, he forcefully took in Yu Fei for himself, granting her as the Great Demon Concubine.
: The Great Demon Concubine hated it even more, but kept a low profile.
: When the Great Demon Venerate went into cultivation retreat, she began to seduce many other Demon Venerates of the Abyss, not hesitating to even use force, plot in secret to achieve that. She successively pulled Hong Luo Demon Venerate, Gen Gu Demon Venerate and so on into the whole blunder.
: It was a pity that the Black-Hearted Old Demon and such did not fall for her temptation in the end.
: A great opportunity has finally appeared.
: In a battle at the Infinite Realm Battlefield, two Demon Venerates had fallen.
: No one expected that the Heavenly Emperor would sneak into the origin of the Abyss and forcefully kill three other Demon Venerates.
: These events had left the Abyss deeply troubled.
: How could the Great Demon Venerate let this incident be swept under the rug? In order to maintain his dignity and for the future of the Abyss, he had to assert his dominance. Sure enough, he was ready to defy even the Heavens now.
: Haha! This is my chance!
: Great Demon Venerate, are you trying to go against the Heavens? Only attacking the Heavenly Court? You even want the experts of the various powerful influences to kill the Heavenly Emperor with you? Hehe! How would I let your wishful thinking come true?
: She ordered Gen Gu Demon Venerate to invade the various heavenly realms and to invade into strong influences; ordered many other Demon Emperors who had secretly subdued under her to participate in the whole plot and even contacted her old friends who had tasted her before to secretly help her out. She wanted to leave the Great Demon Venerate alone and helpless as he became the common enemy of the world and kill him off.
: Once the Great Demon Venerate dies, she will then contact the Heavenly Emperor to take over the Abyss forcefully and manage her forces for her. She will then look for opportunities to destroy the Heavenly Emperor himself! From then on, she would finally obtain total freedom, allowing her to collect great men from all over the world as hers and indulge herself every day. How good of a life it would be!
: At the same time, she also planned to kill off Jiang Ming.
: Although she didn’t mind about Hong Luo Demon Venerate’s death, it seemed that Tianyuan Realm was too mysterious. She suspected that it was Dao Square that was left by a Saint Lord. Regardless of whether there would be any great encounters in that realm, she would be able to reap benefits if she managed to kill Jiang Ming. Otherwise, her acts in killing Jiang Ming would definitely enrage him and put him in the position of antagonizing the Great Demon Venerate.
: Great Demon Venerate! Since you made me your plaything, I will make you the cuckold of the thousands! I will drag you down, chop your arms, finally send you into total despair and bury you completely.
: But… but… how could this Jiang Ming be so strong and actually behead my beloved Chang Yuan in just a short skirmish? Alas, my Chang Yuan who was more loyal and courteous than a dog, who was better at stirring my heart than a dog and much better at licking than a dog! It’s such a shame that he was killed just like this! To think that one of my beloved playthings was lost just like this!
: Sigh, I’ll be heartbroken for a second. I’ll find 3,000 men who have similar appearance as Chang Yuan in the future and raise them in captivity. Consider it a commemoration to my Chang Yuan!
: That said, this Jiang Ming here has a good temperament. Should I try and take him under me?
: I think I can!
: After all, how could there be any men who could escape my clutches?
Jiang Ming felt chills in his heart as he was speechless that this Great Demon Concubine’s ‘Status’ was too damn abundant!
Just look at those existences that she had had affairs with?
There were the Saint Demon Lord, former Great Demon Venerate, current Great Demon Venerate, Heavenly Emperor, Laughing Buddha, Thousand Snake Demon Venerate and so on.
‘Dang it!Did she just take over all the great experts of this world? She’s so amazing that I admire her wild ambitions! What she has is just a pretty face and that secreted fishy ‘stream’ of hers. How did she raise the attention of so many peerless experts and make them willing to pour their hearts for her?’ Jiang Ming was puzzled.
However, when he thought about himself currently evoking the Soul technique to calm his mind, he seemed to have understood more.
‘This is a woman of hardship who yearns for freedom. Should I hit on her as well?’
However, when he thought of the Heavenly Emperor and the others, all of them made him shiver as he felt a little disgusted.
‘Don’t they know about her situation? I think they should’ve known! They definitely knew! But still, why did they do so? Was it for her beauty or did they want to do like what the Saint Lord once did?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but allow his thoughts to run wild.
The time he used to look up the Human Path Record while many wild thoughts were running through his mind, it was all as swift as a snap of his fingers.
The Great Demon Concubine opposite him, waved at the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate and started to softly pace herself towards Jiang Ming, coming to a stop 10,000 meters away.
Such a distance was already as close as she could get.
With just a slight smile on the Great Demon Concubine’s face, there were thousands of amorous feelings that directly struck Jiang Ming’s heart, causing him to tremble. He was inexplicably wanting to run over and hold her in his arms and drown her with immense love and affection.
Thousand Snake Demon Venerate who was watching the scene from the side twitched his mouth as his beard became fluttered and twisted. Great anger was even raging in his eyes as his killing intent came to a boil.
He licked his dry lips, and finally forcibly suppressed his restlessness, continuing watching the two silently.
“Brother Jiang!” The Great Demon Concubine’s soft words turned into thousands of echoes, echoing in the depths of Jiang Ming’s soul. Jiang Ming felt a heat flow in his lower abdomen that subsequently went straight to his head.
Jiang Ming’s eyes suddenly turned blood red as he threw himself at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - The Great Demon Venerate’s Plot, Yet Another Bed
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: The Great Demon Venerate’s Plot, Yet Another Bed
?
The Great Demon Venerate was standing on top of a 100,000 miles high mountain in the abyss. He was wearing a dark golden robe radiating a feeling of low-key luxuriousness, as his well-shaped face looked as though he was chiseled.
The feeling of indifference that radiated from him brought chills to people’s hearts, especially from those pairs of his eyes that had double pupils!
With his hands on his back, he glanced at the bottom of the recovered abyss. Unfortunately, the original Holy Mountain that was there was beaten into an abyss.
Raising his head, his eyes glittered, his vision passed through numerous spaces and thousands of obstacles. He could see through heaven with just a glance, but he unfortunately couldn’t see through the important places.
Just as he was about to peek further, he saw a scene suddenly appearing in his eyes. His pupils shrank as he immediately dissipated the special ability of his.
“Heavenly Emperor!” The Great Demon Venerate murmured, as he looked around every direction again.
The great army of the Abyss had already entered heaven. However…
He suddenly frowned.
He discovered that many demons had broken into many middle and small chiliocosms.
After observing a little more, he found out that these were the demon army of Hong Luo Demon Venerate, Gen Gu Demon Venerate, Thousand-Handed Demon Venerate and the other subordinates.
He turned his gaze over to the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
“Yu Fei! You really are the number one Desire Demon in the world. Such a bitch!” The Great Demon Venerate’s face turned even more indifferent.
Right at this moment, an old man appeared beside him. It was the Black-Hearted Old Demon.
“How’s the plan going?”
“Everything is going on in an orderly manner. It’s just that, are you really going to do this?”
“I’ve made my decision!”
“It won’t be good for your reputation!”
“Alas, how do I have reputations to begin with? Besides, we are demons. What makes us demons? It’s the lawless and solitary that make us demons! Why would I even care about other people’s opinions? I was planning for it to be a huge sham this time around, but I didn’t know that this brainless scum Great Demon Concubine wanted to take revenge on me! Hehe… I’ll let her do what she wants, and adapt accordingly. Through her, we’ll complete our great cause in the Abyss.”
“If that’s the case, then it’s good! I was afraid that you’d go mad in anger because of her!”
“For this bitch?” The Great Demon Venerate sneered, “Although I’m angry emotionally, I don’t really care much about it, so don’t worry! By the way, what do you think of Jiang Ming and his Tianyuan Realm?”
“I’ve never entered the Tianyuan Realm before this, but I can infer that Jiang Ming’s combat power would skyrocket when he is inside. He managed to even cause Beiming Kunpeng, who was in control of the power of authority to almost fall and ended up escaping in embarrassment. There is only one possibility in such a situation. That is, the Tianyuan Realm is a Sacred Land that was once the Dao Square of a Saint Lord.” The Black-Hearted Old Demon speculated, but his tone was very certain of it, “This Jiang Ming is a person of both unparalleled talent and aptitude. Otherwise, he would not have followed the path of the Worlds Dao. For a person from the planar world to walk on the path of World Dao. To have yet reached the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, but capable of counterattacking and slay a venerate, the great encounter that he has obtained must have been sky-defying!”
“Absolutely sky-defying indeed!” The Great Demon Venerate nodded, agreeing with this speculation and asked, “Do you think Yu Fei can take him down?”
“I’m afraid not!” The Black-Hearted Old Demon had an imposing look on his face as he continued, “I have a feeling that the Great Demon Concubine will fall here. If she is killed, it will be unfavorable for us. Therefore, we will need you to make a move when such a situation arises.”
The Great Demon Venerate nodded slightly.
The power in his body started to oscillate within and the space in front of him became layered upon layers, as inexplicable changes had taken place.
“I’m going to guide the follow-up changes!” The Black-Hearted Old Demon said before disappearing without a trace.
…
On top of Tianyuan Sea, Riyue Changfeng stood on the palace, watching the exchange silently.
‘If one can’t see through the essence of the Holy Dao, it will be all for naught! Alas, a person like myself, although I can match up a little against those of the Sage Realm, I’m still not at the Sage Realm myself. Without becoming a Saint, I still lack way too much!’ Riyue Changfeng sighed.
…
At the junction of where the lands of waters meet in the Tianyuan Realm, Mountain Master Tian Yuan stood silently as he watched the whole ordeal with an extremely solemn expression on his face.
‘The Great Demon Concubine! She is actually stirring up trouble, worsening the entire condition!’
‘Is she leading the crusade on the infinite realms? Does the Great Demon Venerate allow her to do so? Why is she bothering Jiang Ming? Is it a means to avenge her escorts? No! A Desire Demon like her is the most ruthless demon. In her mind, these so-called escorts are nothing more than just dogs who please her. If she wants to give up on them, so be it! Why would she even care?’
‘If that’s the case...Could it be that she is coming for the secret of Tianyuan Realm? That should be it!’
‘What should I do? The kid asked me to guard the Tianyuan Realm just in case anything happens. Although he killed the Gen Gu Demon Venerate, there are two more Venerates around and one of them is the Great Demon Concubine!’
Mountain Master Tian Yuan had a headache thinking about it.
In the end, he still didn’t make a move and stayed back in Tianyuan Realm.
…
Standing on top of the Chuyang Peak, Phoenix Junior Sister looked in the direction of her Senior Brother with the phoenix’s flame burning in her eyes. The killing intent and unwillingness could be seen continuously flowing in her eyes.
“I can’t even be of any help now!”
Secretly hating herself for her own incompetence, a red crystal appeared in her hand.
The fiery energy immediately surged out like the sun, exuding the most extreme power of yang and even had the aura of fire poison mixed in it. This was the Sun Immortal Essence that Jiang Ming gave her, which was graded the best of the best.
Jiang Ming traded around many rare and precious treasures. Hence he naturally would give the useful ones for those around him.
Without hesitation, Phoenix Junior Sister opened her mouth and swallowed it whole. She then sat cross-legged and began to cultivate.
She knew that she wouldn’t be able to participate in such a great battle. Rather than watching the whole thing in anxiety, it was better for her to cultivate and improve her strength.
…
Over the Tianyuan Sea, the Great Demon Concubine secretly evoked her innate special ability, sending out extreme waves of desire that could seduce souls, twist minds, and make people involuntarily fall in love with her wildly. The person would become a loyal dog and be unknowingly enslaved by her subtly, yet still feel joyous about it.
Upon seeing Jiang Ming’s shortness of breath as he was throwing himself at her, her face was full of pride.
She slightly straightened her body, allowing the two tall and curvaceous mountains of hers to rise even more, especially the two peaks that were round and full of vigor.
“Die!”
Jiang Ming roared as the attack from his palm connected. The long river of history manifested itself, exhausting through all its evolutions with infinite variables. Concealed in it was the supreme Dao fluctuation that could end futures.
This was the Entombing Sky Illusory Palm technique of his future body, exhausting changes and ending the future.
The expression on Great Demon Concubine’s face abruptly changed, turning into great shame and anger as the seven-colored scarf wrapped around her body suddenly burst into seven colors of divine light that evoked the power of order to turn into 49 defensive luminance that surrounded her.
However, the luminance suddenly collapsed right the very next instant.
Jiang Ming’s palm attack landed on her chest. But he was sent backwards bya ray of luminance poured out of her body.
As Jiang Ming looked up, he saw that the Great Demon Concubine had also retreated thousands of miles away from the exchange, and blood was seeping out of the corner of her mouth.
She was seen standing on a big pink bed with her bare feet. Boundless divine light beaming from below, penetrating through her body, forming layers upon layers of shadows to protect her. Obviously, the pink bed was a special defensive Dao vessel.
Even so, she was still injured by Jiang Ming’s palm attack just now and her body almost collapsed from the exchange.
“Thousand Snakes, kill him!”
The Great Demon Concubine’s face was filled with extreme anger.
When she looked at the palm print on her chest, a ferocious expression flashed through her face.
She was the Great Demon Concubine, the noblest woman of all in infinite realms. It was nothing for her to have been beaten by the Heavenly Emperor, old dragon, old Buddha and the Great Demon Venerates before.
However, to think that her precious pure body was beaten ruthlessly by such a feeble existence… How could she not be enraged when her body was her whole life?
“Alright!” The Thousand Snake Demon Venerate paced closer, stroked his snake-like beard and revealed a cruel expression as he said, “This kid should be killed! In fact, I’ve already prepared for this long ago!”
“Ten Thousand Snakes Killing Formation Array, Refinement of the Heavenly Poisoned Blood!”
The Thousand Snake Demon Venerate stretched out to clench his hands midair. Numerous voids could be seen appearing in the surrounding space, from which silver poisonous snakes quickly slithered out, intertwined to form a large formation array, and spewed blood-colored poisonous mist, instantly infecting half the sky.
Jiang Ming had no place to escape!
“These old things are really difficult to deal with!” Jiang Ming frowned.
He pretended to have fallen for her alluring temptation just now to take advantage of his opponent underestimating him. He thought that he could use the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to influence her defensive Dao vessel and the Entombing Sky Illusory Palm to kill her off in one strike.
Who knew that she had a great defensive Dao vessel concealed within her body that was actually in the form of a bed? It was an extremely rare sight to behold.
To think that everything was going according to his plan smoothly, this happened!

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - Sound of Flute, Three Fingers into One, Demolishing Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Sound of Flute, Three Fingers into One, Demolishing Dao
Jiang Ming was about to continue his attack, but realized that the surrounding space had been confined.
This was a special ability of the Quasi-Sage Realm. With his current abilities, it was impossible for him to unravel such an attack and he could only try to break free from the confinement with brute force. Before he could even react, thousands of snakes could be seen appearing, spurting bloody mist that quickly filled the air.
Jiang Ming saw layers upon layers of densely woven chains of rules that kept shattering and dissipating under layers of blood mist.
Heavenly Immortal law, True Immortal Law, Mystical Immortal Law, Golden Immortal law and the likes were all annihilated layer by layer under the blood mist.
The layers of space had also been corroded into potholes as a result.
Upon witnessing such an ordeal, Jiang Ming’s scalp turned numb. The Nine Level Golden Pagoda was seen hanging above his head. As he raised his hand and swatted, sparks were suddenly discharged with the deafening sound of thunder exploding, blocking the blood mist in its tracks before quickly vanishing.
This was the Thunder Flame Dao
The Thunder Flame that was supposed to suppress the blood mist was instead restrained by the seemingly endless blood mist in a blink of an eye.
Jiang Ming frowned as thousands of thoughts flashed through his mind. The very next moment, his body rose steadily, reaching thousands of feet high.
The power of his physical body had also skyrocketed to the extreme, reaching the real peak that a Golden Immortal Realm could achieve. It could also be said that this was the limitation of the Heavens and Earth, and the great Dao.
Reaching such a limitation was an energy outburst of a thousand-fold.
If he were to take a step further and enter the Taiyi Golden Immortal realm, his physical body would have undergone transformation and that it wouldn’t be suitable anymore. He would’ve had to deduce the whole special ability again. Such was the limitation of the physique.
“World Projection, Chessboard Imprisonment!”
“Killer Civilization Punch, break through the infinite realm!”
The surrounding void shook as the World Projection fell. Invisible chains of laws intertwined into a chess board, forming the power of confinement, blockade, and suppression. However, it only managed to delay the speed of the blood-colored poisonous mist from spreading by just a little.
Immediately afterwards, both his fists were in a barrage, naturally evolving into an illusory river of history. One single punch blew up one of the silver snakes that penetrated the confinement.
Deafening blows could be heard constantly.
With both his fists, Jiang Ming formed a torrent made of history. It was extremely violent, destroying everything as if it was an unstoppable force to be reckoned with. With loud explosions, it actually shattered the snake array formation.
The silver snakes exploded in the air one after another, forming bursts of blood mist.
“How dare you kill thousands of my descendants?” The Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was enraged. He opened his mouth and spat out a machete, which disappeared in a flash, directly aiming between Jiang Ming’s eyebrows.
It was extremely fast. So much so that Jiang Ming was almost unable to react to this sudden attack.
Boom…
The machete was blocked by the defensive luminance hanging from the Nine Level Golden Pagoda. However, it kept advancing, bursting with power before forming a circle of storm.
The Golden Pagoda trembled vigorously. Its defensive luminance was about to be broken through.
“Such strength!” Jiang Ming was taken aback again.
When faced against an expert such as the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate, Jiang Ming could’ve easily killed him by just using his special abilities. However, this opponent here had too many supportive Dao vessels in hand.
Inside the snake formation array, the machete, or rather the teeth of a poisonous snake could be seen right in front of him
As Jiang Ming’s eyes flashed, the machete in front of him trembled, as the power that was contained in it was suddenly launched into chaos. He reached out and grabbed onto the machete. Although nine layers of the immortal luminance in his palm were still shattered, he still managed to grab it and throw it into the Human Path Record.
‘Thousand Snake Blade: Made of the fangs of a Quasi-Sage Snake combined with the Innate Wind Essence Stone and the Abyssal Venom, it has unparalleled speed, unyielding strength, and extreme toxicity.’
Jiang Ming took a glance at the ‘Status’ and was done with it.
A long river of history suddenly appeared under his feet. It was seemingly vast and mighty, with no starting point nor destination. It was akin to the river of fate with endless mysteries hidden in it and even seemed to have the power of fate.
“Damn it! This kid actually imprisoned my Thousand Snake Blade!” The Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was shocked, yet his murderous intention was also overwhelming. With a roar, he raised his hands, fired two Yin Thunders at Jiang Ming while he launched himself forward.
A long sword that was as black as ink suddenly appeared in his hands.
“There’s something weird about this kid! Be careful!” The Great Demon Concubine reminded him. As she raised her hand, the Seven-colored Scarf that was wrapped around her body flew out and came right in front of Jiang Ming’s eye in a blink of an eye.
This scarf had already evoked the power of order, forming into a confinement technique.
Right that very moment, three clones appeared around Jiang Ming. They were the Past Body, the Present Body, and the Future Body.
“Break!”
The Past Body raised his hand and punched, dispersing the Yin Thunders.
“The destruction of body, the destruction of soul and the destruction of heart! Three fingers into one, demolishing Daos!”
His Present Body launched his ultimate technique.
The Three Thousand Cataclysm Fingers technique which he had advanced into a terrifying form, completely combined the essence of the first three finger techniques. This technique had become extremely powerful, but its energy consumption had also been pushed to the extreme.
Bright red luminance could be seen flashing all over his body. They were actually burning flames. With just a single finger, he pointed at the tip of the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate’s sword.
Boom...
A peerless power erupted, forming torrents of chaos.
“What kind of special ability is this?” Thousand Snake Demon Venerate screamed in horror. The incomparable gleaming luminance that was contained in the sword was shattered. Its power was transmitted back at him, shattering his palm, hand and even his arms as he was sent flying back from the explosion.
The Present Body then turned into flames and dissipated.
Through the convergence of the three fingers, a single blow could destroy Dao. That was how domineering it was.
Right the very next moment, the Present Body was quickly conjured yet again.
As long as Jiang Ming stayed alive, so did this special ability of his.
The Present Body had already launched itself after the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate, as the Past Body chased behind.
It was also at this time that the Future Body waved his palm swiftly, forming a mysterious power flow, scattering the luminance from Seven-Colored Scarf driven by the Great Demon Concubine. The Future Body then grabbed with his other hand and intended to put the scarf into the Human Path Record.
However, the sound of a flute could be heard echoing in the air. Immediately, the scattered rays of luminance from the Seven-Colored Scarf suddenly converged and entangled the Future Body, crushing it into pieces.
Jiang Ming frowned, only to see the Great Demon Concubine playing a flute. Its notes sounded like elves skipping in the air as an invisible force connected itself with the scarf, resisting the interference from the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique
Even the huge bed under her was dispersing rhythmic notes.
‘Three pieces of Quasi-Sage Weapons! What a f*cking rich woman!’ Jiang Ming complained to himself.
He was also certain that the Great Demon Concubine definitely had other Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels with her.
After all, she was the number one courtesan of the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Having slept with the Heavenly Emperor, fondled with the Laughing Buddha, cuddled with the old dragon, snuggled with Great Demon Venerates and the likes, it could be said that she had a terrifyingly strong background.
Therefore, it wouldn’t be surprising if she had five or six Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels at her disposal.
As the Future Body reappeared, it launched its attack at the Great Demon Concubine.
Standing on the long river of history, Jiang Ming saw the Great Demon Concubine being entangled by his Future Body. He then turned his gaze over to the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate.
This old demon had recovered his shattered arm and was wielding his long sword to fight against Jiang Ming’s Past and Present bodies. The Demon Venerate was quite fearfully adept as he produced poisonous artifacts time after time to interfere with their attacks. Because of that, both the Past Body and Future Body weren’t able to completely suppress the Demon Venerate for a while.
‘It’s time to end this!’ Jiang Ming thought.
He had exposed a lot of his techniques in this great battle, but also understood his shortcomings better.
His physical body, which seemed to be strong, was in fact not. When compared with these Quasi-Sage old demons, his physical body was still very fragile, and was far from reaching the point of invincibility.
Also, he realized that he had very few effective techniques at his disposal, yet he wasn’t to be blamed for this. After all, his cultivation realm was still too low.
Otherwise, if he was also of the Quasi-Sage Realm, he could’ve easily tortured these two demons to death by just relying on the Three Thousand Great Dao Technique.
‘I still have one last technique. Unless it’s absolutely necessary, it must not be used! Nevertheless, it’s the time to end this battle!’
As Jiang Ming thought to himself, two clones appeared beside him.
His physical body had reached a height of 1,000-feet while the power of his flesh and blood increased by a thousand fold. Hence, his capacity to withstand the pressure too, had increased greatly.
While fully evoking the Infinite Transcendence Technique, he could still conjure two more clones. And that would be enough!
“Time and Space Confinement Technique!”
As soon as the two clones appeared, they directly ignited themselves in flame, casting the most terrifying confinement special ability as all their strengths were completely integrated into the technique.
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!”
The Past Body, who was besieging the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate, suddenly changed the special ability that he was evoking. He formed the manipulation seals on both his hands, manipulating the long sword in his opponent’s hand, while his right hand casted the seal interfering with the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate’s battle suit.
“Demolishing Dao!”
As the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was stunned briefly, he was pierced between his eyebrows with just a finger by the Present Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 1)
?
When Riyue Changfeng who was watching from the Infinite Realm Auction House saw Jiang Ming performing the Infinite Transcendence Technique, his pupils suddenly shrunk to the size of the tip of a needle. He was astonished and muttered, “This is definitely Holy-Dao leveled special ability. Better yet, this special ability has endless potential! I remembered that ‘that’ place doesn’t mean to aid in cultivation and there is no real specific inheritance, doesn’t it?”
“Did he deduce it by himself? How is this possible?”
“That illusory long river originated from ancient times, running through the present, flowing into the future, and interprets the creation of civilization, as well as the cycle of history. It is like the epitome of fate and the embodiment of fate.”
“If this technique is advanced even further, then...”
Riyue Changfeng’s vision was so wide that even the Great Heavenly Venerate of the Heavenly Court couldn’t compare to him. Prior to this, he saw many techniques and special abilities of Jiang Ming’s and wasn’t shocked by them.
However, he was really shocked and amazed now.
He knew really well what it meant for him to be able to realize this kind of special ability.
“His comprehensive ability is sky-defying! To be able to understand this kind of Dao and technique means that his soul’s strength is at least at the Quasi-Sage level!”
“With his great encounters and opportunities, there is really a high possibility that he would be able to evolve his inner world into a Middle Chiliocosm. With the support of the Chaotic Tree Seedlings, he may even achieve the Great Chiliocosm stage.”
“Alas, it’s the Great Chiliocosm!”
Riyue Changfeng was getting excited.
“He’s my great encounter! Or rather, I might be his great encounter too! Fate is truly an amazing thing!”
Sparks of wisdom were flowing through Riyue Changfeng’s eyes. He suddenly smiled as he stroked his hands.
…
On the Infinite Realm Battlefield, the Present Body had his one finger pierced through the center of the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate’s eyebrows. His body’s vitality was destroyed and the power of his soul was also annihilated. Just when he was about to completely die, the sea of consciousness of the Demon Venerate was suddenly ignited in golden flames and his primal spirit quickly flashed to the side.
“Golden Evasion Talisman!” The Present Body had an indifferent look in his eye.
Standing on top of the long river of history, Jiang Ming allocated part of his mind to keep an eye on the Human Path Record.
The ‘status’ in the Human Record kept coming up.
All of a sudden, the Past Body and the Present Body vanished in thin air and Jiang Ming’s burden was greatly reduced. He raised his arm and pointed his finger to the air.
Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique
The most powerful special ability that he had in the past was still in the forefront.
The finger, which accommodated all laws and Daos, broke through Yin and Yang, disintegrated the reincarnation, and ran through time and space, landing at a point where space fluctuates.
There, the primal spirit of the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate had just appeared.
“No! How did you find me?” The Demon Venerate was so frightened that he couldn’t even control the two Quasi-Sage Weapons to return into his hand. What’s left were the constant tremble of his consciousness, conveying boundless horror, “My Golden Evasion Talisman! It should be able to escape time and space, and even block off all auras. It should’ve been my strongest means of life-saving technique! How could it be? How could it be? Yu Fei! Save me! Save me! AHHHHH…..”
With a miserable shriek, the Demon Venerates primal spirit shattered and vanished.
This time, he was completely gone.
Jiang Ming waved his hand and kept all the spoils left by the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate, suppressing them in his inner world. As he turned his head to look at the Great Demon Concubine, he had a strange look on his face.
Right that very instance, this so-called top beauty of the world was surrounded by murderous aura. She evoked the Seven-Colored Scarf and blew the flute at the same time, killing the Future Body just like that.
“You actually killed the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate!” The Great Demon Concubine had a look of shock on her face. Her face was filled with murderous intent, as her eyes were filled with anger.
“Do you know who he is? He is the elder of the Demon Holy Palace and his status is extremely respectable. By killing him, you have become the enemy of the Demon Holy Palace! An eternal enemy to them! You will inevitably be besieged and killed by hundreds of millions of Demonic experts. They will not stop until you are killed, chasing after you for eternity!” The Great Demon Concubine’s voice was shrill, but echoed far away. Her screech spread through the whole battlefield.
“Demon Holy Palace?” Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes, as his murderous aura was flickering fiercely.
He looked up the Human Path Record and saw:
Name: Yu Fei (Great Demon Concubine).
Status
: Jiang Ming actually resisted my charming seduction! How is it possible?
: Even the Heavenly Emperor couldn’t resist that time. Although I was caught, he became my servant under my command. In fact, between the other two Great Demon Venerates, who weren’t tempted by my charming seduction and became obsessed with my flawless body?
: Even the old dragon and Laughing Buddha couldn’t help it. How can he still resist!
: This kid is not bad! Not bad at all!
: Heh! Wanting to kill me? You are way too na?ve.
: However, his capability isn’t bad. He killed the Gen Gu Demon Venerate before this. Should I see if he can kill the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate as well?
: I hope he can kill him! This disgusting beast was still laboring under the delusion of trying to hit on my flawless body! My extreme body of the Great Dao! I still remember the last time when he actually revealed his true form with thousands of heads and tails. Damn it! Although I had the ultimate joy with all kinds of postures and positions, he is still extremely disgusting.
: As I’m recalling it now, my stomach is still cramping from the thought and even my intestines could feel his slippery mucus inside.
: It’s quite good if he ends up dead. Let the Demon Holy Palace be detracted from one more person and give this kid some trouble at the same time. Maybe one day in the future, I can truly make him surrender himself under my feet and become an ass-kisser.
: His breath of life is too exuberant! His vitality is so young! His tongue must be very tender.
: Uh... Uh...
: Even my legs are getting wobbly! Damn it! I can’t be distracted!
: This kid’s techniques are very good. I must be careful not to fall into his trap. If someone is to fall, he will be the one to fall into my clutches.
: To think that he can actually affect my Dao vessel! What a brilliant move! I was almost done. Fortunately, my body is always protected by the Bed of Infinite Desire. It has helped me withstood a blow.
: This blow almost beat down my big firm breast! Such annoyance! Such dread!
: He is not a gentleman at all!
: He’s still thinking of suppressing my Quasi-Sage Dao Weapons? Hmph! He’s been underestimating me too much! Let me play with him for a little while first!

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 2)
: Good gracious! This illusory river that he unleashed is so powerful that it directly conjured three clones, where each of them was similar to the main body. They can still be re-conjured after I killed them. Are they immortal and undead? I think they should be maintained by the main body.
: This special ability is sky-defying!
: Now I’m afraid the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate can’t stop Jiang Ming. Damn it! If he really gets killed... To think that I would be missing the extreme pleasure from the thousands of tongues.
: Forget it! I will look for another Ten Thousand Snake in the future.
: As expected, Thousand Snake Demon Venerate is killed.
: Damn, he still wants to kill me?
: Hmph! I’m not like that idiotic Thousand Snake Demon Venerate. If it wasn’t because I didn’t want to expose my strongest ace back then, even the Heavenly Emperor wouldn’t be able to suppress me.
: Hmp! That Heavenly Emperor! When he looked at me during the war, his eyes were filled with great amazement and a strong urge of possessiveness. If it wasn’t for his lack of murderous intentions, how could I have been sullied by him?
: It’s such an unfortunate thing that I did not become a Heavenly Concubine.
: Damn, Heavenly Emperor? Sooner or later I will be the one to suppress you, to trample you under my feet and I will find 10,000… or rather 1,000,000 elephants to violate him.
: Not to forget about that Heavenly Queen.
: Oh, why am I still thinking about these messed up things! Now that the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate is dead, I have to pretend to fight for him. Otherwise my conscience would be stricken, and it’ll also be easier for people to see through me.
: I shall chide him! and also irritate the Demon Holy Palace, forcing them to make their move!
: Ha! Everyone’s trying to stay out of it? I’m going to pull you all into this.
: Later, I’ll act like I am going to lose to Jiang Ming and might even be killed. When the moment comes, that bastard of a Great Demon Venerate will appear, right? That bastard will definitely show himself!
: As men, how can they just watch their wife being beaten by an outsider! Even if they knew that they were cuckolded, there are still bastards!
: Hmph! Just wait for the day I suppress the Great Demon Venerate! I’ll make him kneel at my feet and watch me enjoy myself with thousands of men.
: Haha! That would be a very exciting scene to behold!
: Also, there’s this little guy in front of me. I am going to put him on my Bed of Infinite Desire and sit on his face.
Jiang Ming was speechless as he read the Human Path Record.
He even felt like vomiting. He thought this Desire Demon of lust just wanted to let go of herself and pursue her freedom. But from the latest ‘status’ manifested in the Human Path Record, he despised reading the content for it completely was a shame to his eyes, primal spirit and even his soul!
A devil was still a devil regardless. A leopard can’t change its spot, let alone a Desire Demon!
Moreover, she was the Great Monarch of the Desire Demon Clan who were of the extreme lust.
From the looks of it, when she was captured by the Heavenly Emperor and the others, she was capable of escaping, but because she didn’t feel the killing intent from them, she ended up wanting to play around with them.
Bravo. Jiang Ming somehow respected her acts and thought that such a woman should only exist in none other than the Demonic Realm.
She played through infinite realms like a fiddle!
That was so unbelievable that Jiang Ming had the urge to give her a thumbs up.
As these thoughts ran through his mind, Jiang Ming saw torrents surging out from the Great Demon Concubine’s body. The torrents interwoven into various rays of light, making her look even more beautiful and seductive.
Even if it was anger, it made the air tremble.
“Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was my Dao friend. Now that you’ve killed him, you are my mortal enemy and the Abyss’s. I will kill you today!” The Great Demon Concubine said softly and gently. She stepped on the Bed of Infinite Desire with one foot as her scarf was fluttering in the wind with divine luminance spiraling around her. She placed the jade flute beside her mouth and spat out a white note, one after another, turning them into little dancing elves.
This special ability seemed as though it was giving birth to life.
As the void went with the rhythmic beat, the laws trembled and waves after waves of mysterious forces swarmed towards Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank. He conjured the Past Body, the Present Body, and the Future Body again.
“Entombing Sky Illusory Palm, emtombing all things!”
The Future Body sitting cross-legged in the air, slapped his palm forward, and out bursts thousands of palm shadows as though it was a peacock flaunting its tails or the thousand-handed Guanyin. Thousands of palm shadows were falling in all directions, smashing up all the little elves.
“The flames of civilization should be sheltered by the killing fists!”
The Past Body crossed through the void and let off his punch that contained the power of the past, the evolution of civilization.
“Demolishing Daos!”
Meanwhile, the Present Body directly activated its strongest technique.Combining the destruction of the body, the soul and the heart into one, destroying the Daos and all things with just one finger.
The Great Demon Concubine had a serious expression on her face.
The jade flute in her mouth trembled vigorously, playing a soul-shivering voice, commanding the Seven-coloured Scarf and Bed of Infinite Desire to merge with it into one, turning into a defensive mechanism. The defense actually managed to block the special abilities evoked by both the Past and Present Bodies.
“What a powerful defense!” Jiang Ming was astonished.
As Jiang Ming deduced the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, he immediately sensed that the Great Demon Concubine had connected the power of the three Quasi-Sage Dao Weapons together, making it as if they were one vessel.
No! She also merged into them the power of the Quasi-Sage Vessel that was integrated into her body, which constituted an inimitable defensive technique.
“What a strong attacking power, I almost failed to defend myself!” The Great Demon Concubine’s face turned solemn, “What if all three clones were to shoot me at the same time...? Jiang Ming, what exactly is your origin? How can you possess such powerful special abilities? I am certain that this special ability of yours which conjured a river that looked like the long river of fate and condensed three immortal clones is definitely of the Supreme Holy Laws. However, I have never seen or heard of it. Tell me, where did you get your inheritance from? Your so-called Tianyuan Realm, is it a Dao Square left by a Saint Lord? Or is it a hidden place of cultivation for the supreme experts who fell from the Chaos?”
“To think that a little human child is able to grow to such a terrifying level from the moment he ascended into the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Even if you have a time palace that can reverse time by a million times fold, the encounter of yours must be extreme. Hence, I guess that you must have mastered the secret towards the sanctification of Dao? And you are also blessed with peerless great fortunes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Supreme Venerate Fooled, The Law of All Desires, 3,000 Daos (Part 3)
The Great Demon Concubine’s words were like bullet trains as she swiftly expressed her thoughts.
“You came to kill me because you wanted to know my secret, yet you are now publicly questioning me about it. It’s apparent that something’s wrong!” Jiang Ming had a sarcastic look on his face, “Are you trying to kill me through others?”
The others might not be able to read through Great Demon Concubine’s mind, yet how could Jiang Ming not understand what she was trying to do?
He just followed along with what the Great Demon Concubine had said and made a reversal deduction about it.
He would do it in conjunction with what she wanted to do. After all, the messier the situation the better. Moreover, he no longer intended to hide his own secrets.
“Yes!” The Great Demon Concubine slightly hesitated before she nodded, “Since you’ve killed two of my fellow Dao friends, you are obviously a powerful madman that I’m not your match. That’s why I can only kill you through others!”
“Since you know you aren’t my match, why are you not scrambling away?” Jiang Ming shouted, “As the Great Demon Concubine, you should stay in the Abyssal Demonic Domain to give birth to children of the Great Demon Venerate and not take revenge for your lovers as you are currently doing. Ah yes! Why did the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate help you? Is he also one of your lovers?”
“Slandering me in public means that you are also slandering the entire Abyss, the Great Demon Venerate and the hundreds and millions of demonic descendants!” The Great Demon Concubine hummed proudly, “The Abyss will hunt you down and so will the Great Demon Venerate himself. Even if I’m no match for you, I still have to give it a try to see if I may have a chance to kill you and avenge my fellow Dao friends.”
“My arms are open for hugs! Bring it on!” Jiang Ming wasn’t afraid of her. He even had the urge to take out his long sword to kill her.
In the end, his sword technique wasn’t suitable to go against her.
“Hey, how dare you!” As a Great Demon Concubine, how could she not understand that Jiang Ming was ridiculing her? As her eyebrows twitched slightly, a touch of amorous feelings flowed in her eyes but she did not reveal it in the end. Instead she said, “Do you think that you are the only one who has clones? How could I not have it myself? The Incarnation of All Desires! Come before me!”
The space around her trembled as a large amount of pink mists appeared out of thin air, spreading through thousands of miles in an instant. It then quickly condensed into clumps, turning into incomparably enchanting women.
There were a total of 3,000 of them.
“All desires incarnated into 3,000 clones, corresponding to the 3,000 Daos!” With a flick of the jade flute in her hand, immortal luminance flowed as she placed it behind her back.
She stepped on the bed with another small foot, and continued, “This is my peerless law. Today, I will show you the means of the Abyssal! Die!”
The 3,000 clones formed a torrent as they launched themselves towards Jiang Ming. At the same time, all of them evoked their individual techniques, launching various lustful abilities and means at him.
Aiming to seduce his mind, arouse his desires and even send the very cores of his primal spirit into tremble, a demonic fire suddenly appeared, directly burning the void itself.
“It’s kind of interesting!”
Jiang Ming had a solemn expression on his face.
His three clones went forward to meet the great torrent of lust. It was a battle of the Transcendence Technique against the Law of the All Desires.
The divine luminance could be seen flowing throughout as the torrent continued to vacillate. The void was overwhelmed with endless storms, sweeping through all directions with powerful fluctuations. It was truly a terrifying scene to behold.
The eruption of power of this great battle was no weaker than when he faced Kunpeng last time.
Fortunately, they were fighting high above the air. Otherwise, the lands would definitely be destroyed and crippled.
In the end, the Great Demon Concubine still reserved some of her might. The 3,000 clones she conjured were just empty shells that only could arouse desires and sway a person’s soul. These effects were not of much use to Jiang Ming and they ended up being killed. All 3,000 clones were completely wiped out.
“Killer Civilization Punch!”
“Daos Extinction Finger!”
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!”
The Past and Present Bodies used their strongest offensive technique at the same time, aiming to take down the enemy with one blow. Meanwhile, the Future Body evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, ready to interfere with the three Dao vessels that were lingering around the Great Demon Concubine.
Standing on the long river of history, Jiang Ming placed his hands behind his back and watched attentively.
Suddenly, he frowned and had a strange look on his face.
The moment when his Future Body evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, he did not manage to exert influence on the opponent’s Dao vessel at all. It wasn’t because it couldn’t, but the truth was that after the Great Demon Concubine knew of this technique of his, she had the origins of those Dao vessels constantly communicating and integrating their strength with each other.
Moreover, the power of the Quasi-Sage Dao vessel in her body also integrated into the mix. Even when his Future Body was fully evoking the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, it was still too difficult to manipulate it.
Out of sudden, the divine luminance of the three Dao vessels of the Great Demon Concubine shattered.
“To think that you are willingly allowing your Dao vessels to be affected by my technique. Do you want me to injure you so that you can lead out the Great Demon Venerate?”
Jiang Ming had an extremely cold expression on his face. He was enraged by the Great Demon Concubine’s foul play, and decided to wipe her out completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - The Strongest Behind the Scene, Blood Banner, Twelve
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: The Strongest Behind the Scene, Blood Banner, Twelve
“Killer Civilization Punch!”
“Demolishing Dao!”
Sensing that the Great Demon Concubine had loosened her control over the three Dao vessels and that they could be affected by the Infinite Artifact Control technique, how could Jiang Ming let up this chance?
‘Putting up a show? That’s great! I’ll turn your show into reality!’ Jiang Ming thought as he sneered.
Meanwhile, his Past Body and Present Body directly evoked his ultimate killer technique and dissipated layers and layers of immortal luminance around the Great Demon Concubine.
With his left fist landed on her left chest and his right hand pointed at her right boob, a deafening explosion erupted. The immense power raged through, destroying even the mountains.
These two blows could even penetrate the Infinite Realm Battlefield, let alone a person’s physical body. However, as his attack connected, Jiang Ming felt strange as he sensed a terrifying power fluctuation that was residing in her body. The fluctuation of power even canceled out most of the damage from his two blows of attacks.
Even so, the Great Demon Concubine was obviously too confident as she did not completely cancel off the power from the two blows.
She initially wanted to pretend to wail in pain as she was blown away from the attack. However, she was now wailing miserably in extreme pain for real.
Two puncture wounds appeared on her chest as a great amount of blood spewed out of her mouth.
Argh!!
Her shriek spread all over the infinite realm battlefield coupled with endless curses, “Jiang Ming, to think that you almost killed me, and explode my body into pieces! I will kill you! I will kill you for sure!”
As her body was flying backward from the explosion, a terrifying evil aura suddenly erupted from her body.
However, it was at that instant that she suddenly sensed the presence of a peerless being behind her. It was so abrupt that she didn’t even notice the person behind her until then.
‘That’s not right! This is Jiang Ming’s aura!’
As she turned over her head suddenly, her pupils shrank as her face turned extremely pale.
“Die!”
Jiang Ming locked on to her with the Human Path Record, conjured a clone, and projected it over to the back of the Great Demon Concubine. Without any hesitation, he evoked the three Great Overarching Dao Vessels that he was carrying, forming the Tri-Talent Formation at the same time.
This was a higher level application of the Infinite Vessel manipulation Technique, forming a large formation and then detonating it right after so that the power of the explosion would be more concentrated and terrifying. Its destructive power could be increased by at least 10 times!
Jiang Ming was confident that even if there was a legendary Holy Dao vessel suppressed within her, this unexpected blow of attack would be able to kill this enemy of his for sure.
Boom!
With a deafening bang, even the sky turned pale as the earth collapsed, almost turning the world upside down.
Along with the consciousness of many experts who were peeking at their battle crushed by the power erupted, they screamed in pain as blood started oozing out of their seven orifices.
This attack from Jiang Ming was truly terrifying. It gave off the feeling of the end of the world, the destruction of the universe or the end of the era itself.
Just as Jiang Ming was about to witness the Great Demon Concubine taken down by his assault, the void suddenly split open at that very moment, breaking the confinement of the Tri-Talent Formation. What came after was a violent torrent of destruction as a bloody red flag appeared. It wrapped around the Great Demon Concubine, escaping into thin air.
Upon watching the scene, Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank because he saw the Great Demon Venerate.
Jiang Ming’s eyes were glistening with luminance, piercing through time and space. He saw a slender figure standing in the depths of the interlayer of time and space, holding a large flag with both hands.
Its overwhelming power painted the world blood red.
Seemingly sensing Jiang Ming’s gaze, the Great Demon Venerate looked over and their eyes finally locked on onto each other.
The Great Demon Venerate had a smile on his face, nodded, as if he was expressing goodwill.
Jiang Ming on the other hand had a strange look on his face. To think that this Great Demon Venerate bore no hatred nor killing intent towards him, he felt it was indeed interesting.
Of course, the best thing about it was that Jiang Ming was able to have seen him face-to-face. Hence, he would be able to know the real details about him from the Human path Record.
Name: Sky Demon (Great Demon Venerate)
Race: Sky Demon
Gender: Male
Cultivation: Quasi-Sage
Background: A Great Demon Venerate in the Abyss of Honggu Heavenly Realm
Relationship: 55
Innate talent:Holy Daoist
Status
: Long time ago, a single drop of demon blood floated from the Chaos, quietly pierced through the fetal membrane of Honggu Heavenly Realm, as it fell into the Nine-Orifice Demon Embryo nurtured in the origin of the Abyss. Upon fusing with the embryo, spirituality was born and he was finally conceived from it.
: Since the beginning of his birth, he knew of the great inheritance that awaited him.
: Taking the Sky as his surname and the Demon as the name, he named himself Sky Demon. His name was also the name of the demon clan as he had a great ambition to be the founder of the Sky Demon Clan.
: There wasn’t any big commotion upon his birth into the world. In order not to be discovered by others the uniqueness he has, he lived among low-level demon clans and began to grow rapidly in secret.
: After the Saint Demon Lord left, the former Great Demon Venerate ruled the Abyss. Sky Demon merely watched, observed, waited, and made his moves in silence.
: Walking silently through every corner of the Abyss, he was curious about the Chaos that was outside of the world. He broke through into the Chaos and was almost strangled by the various chaotic forces of Chaos almost instantly. He was then swept off by a large incomplete formation, got a hold of the Holy Dao vessel, the Blood Banner. He then managed to break out of the great formation and quietly return to the abyss.
: In the battle of the previous Heavenly Court, the former Great Demon Venerate died after killing the last Heavenly Emperor as he was attacked by his own ally, the Lord Buddha. Sky Demon knew that his time had come.
: With the Abyss in chaos, he took advantage of the situation to rise above others, drove away all forces, integrated the various forces of the Abyss, and once again unified the Abyss, becoming the next Greta Demon Venerate.
: In order to ensure his position and for the stability of the abyss, he forcefully married Yu Fei who was the named disciple of the former Saint Demon Lord after great lengths of thought. As of then, his position as the dominator was firm and stable.
: However, the Great Demon Venerate knew that for the Abyss to really stand strong, he needed to be able to compete with the Heavenly Emperor. His own strength must at least reach the Demi-Sage Realm. Hence, he began his cultivation retreats.
: Although he was in seclusion for his cultivation retreat, he still noticed that the Great Demon Concubine was lustfully agitated and that she hooked up with the other peerless experts of the Abyss. He also saw the Great Demon Concubine seducing the old monarch of the dragon clan, the Buddhas, and even some Immortal Emperors of the middle chiliocosms. However, he only watched on the sidelines and started to plot his plans at the same time.
: Great Demon Venerate: Although I don’t love you, and that I used you as a tool, you are still my concubine in name after all. How dare you give me the title of a cuckold? Just wait, you bitch...
: During a retreat in the origin of the abyss, he vaguely sensed the tremor from the origin, conveying faint waves of distress. Hesitating for a bit, he followed the induction of the fluctuations and entered the Chaos.
: As he inched forward carefully, he found more than a dozen venerates, who were at the verge of death by the chaotic storm. Right that moment, six of them had already perished due to the storm.
: The Great Demon Venerate rescued the remaining 12 venerates, forced them to swear an oath to follow him and help him towards enlightenment. However, he also promised that after he successfully sanctioned the path of Dao in the future, he will take them with him when he leaves Honggu Heavenly Realm for the Sea of Chaos.
: Quietly returning into the Abyss, he arranged them to be his back-up and the foundation for his power. Based on what was shared by the few of them, after they returned to their positions in the ancient times, they had no way of sanctioning the path of Dao as they were Innate Saint Spirits. Worried that they would be liquidated by the Saint Lord, they joined together to venture into the Chaos and head for the legendary Sea of Chaos.
: Unexpectedly, the Chaos was too terrifying. Even though there were 26 Venerates who joined hands to pull through together, they still encountered all kinds of disasters on their way such as Chaos Winds of Annihilation, Interlacing Power of Time and Space, Chaotic Icicle Imprisonment, Chaos Beast and many more. It was extremely difficult to move forward and the road ahead seems hopeless. After thousands of years, they finally decided to return to where they came from. Just as they were about to return, they encountered the chaotic storm that almost wiped them all out before they were rescued by the Great Demon Venerate.
: A total of fourteen Venerates had fallen from the ordeal.
: The Great Demon Venerate understood the terror of the Chaos once again from this incident. It was difficult to venture through the Chaos unless he was a Saint Lord. As such, he decided to conscientiously continue his cultivation in preparing to break through into the Demi-Sage Realm. His next step was to overthrow the Heavenly Court, unify the heavens, and gather all the great luck of the worlds to break through into the Holy Dao Gate.
: Hundreds of millions of years passed by.
: Finally, he managed to step into the Demi-Sage Realm. As he finished consolidating his cultivation and was preparing to exit from his seclusion to start off with his plot against the Heavenly Realm, he sensed a terrifying force looming over at his direction that pierced through the Abyss.
: After finishing his cultivation, he was greatly enraged. He immediately initiated his plot to defy even the heavens.
: He also learned that in the battle at the Infinite Realm Battlefield, two venerates had fallen, but he didn’t care at all. After all, the two were the gigolos of the Great Demon Concubine. If they died, so be it. Even if they didn’t die, they would sooner or later.
: With the on-going Great Abyss Trial, coupled with the emergence of the Infinite Realm Auction House, the Great Demon Venerate was on high alert and knew that he could not wait any longer. After all, who could compare to the wealth that the Heavenly Emperor scavenged from the Infinite Realm? Hence, he would definitely obtain lots of great treasures from the auction house, and it would be even more difficult for him to plot his plans by then.
: It would be better to set off the catastrophe early. After all, the action of the Heavenly Emperor who broke through the Abyss had caused many great monarchs of various forces to be fearful and wary of him. It would be better to just kill him now.
: Even if he didn’t join forces with other experts, once he challenges the Heavenly Emperor, the Lord Buddha, Dragon monarch, Demon Venerates and many others will definitely make their move and tacitly join forces to kill the Heavenly Emperor. From here on out, there would be no one that could restrain him anymore.
: Defying heaven itself, he opened up many Gates of Domain on the Infinite Realm Battlefield and used them as a stepping stone for him to enter the Heavenly Realm and launch his attack on the Heavenly Court. Unexpectedly, the Great Demon Concubine ordered her subordinates to attack the many powerful forces of the Heavenly Realm and even entered the middle and small chilicosms.
: The Great Demon Venerate was enraged. However, when he saw that the Great Demon Concubine had come to the Infinite Realm and launched her attack on Tianyuan Realm, he changed his mind and decided to adapt with the flow: He planned to wait by the sideline and emerge as the last person standing. Using the supreme Holy Law obtained from chaos, he planned to bloodily sacrifice the many middle and small chiliocosms, to attack the Heavenly Realm and perhaps even destroy the Heavenly Realm in one blow.
: Upon seeing Gen Gu Demon Venerate’s death, he secretly speculated that the Great Demon Concubine would not be able to kill Jiang Ming and that she might even be in danger. However, he couldn’t allow the Great Demon Concubine to die just yet. Without her messing around and colluding with many forces, how could he ensure that the demons could successfully slash their ways into various middle chiliocosm? How could he complete the arrangement of his plots?
: What a person this Jiang Ming is! He actually possesses such a terrifying special ability!
: Three Dao vessels are being detonated and even formed a great formation. That’s not good! The Great Demon Concubine is in danger. It’s too late now. I can only evoke the Blood Banner.
: Fortunately, it’s just a great shock ending with no danger!
: I was hiding in the interlayer of time and space and yet this Jiang Ming could still see me. This is interesting.
: Should I kill him?
: No, I can’t kill him! With the strength of this kid coupled with that forbidden technique of his that can detonate the Great Overarching Dao Vessels, if he were to be cornered into a desperate situation and forced to detonate many Great Overarching Dao Vessels, I am afraid that I will have to expose my real cultivation realm then.
: Even now, the Blood Banner may have been exposed as well. However, with the dense background of the Heavenly Emperor, he will pay attention to it, but won’t care too much about it. It might have been difficult to even notice it just now as we were in the interlayer of the torrents of destruction that destroys all the power of Laws and Daos.
: After destroying the Heavenly Court, I will then subdue this kid. If he doesn’t bow before me, I will just kill him and then keep the human race in captivity.
Upon reading this, Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed and murderous intent were overflowing from the depths of his eyes.
‘God damn it! I’ve only arrived at the Infinite Realm Battlefield and had to face the North Emperor right off the bat, fortunately killing him in the end. Then, I became enemy with the Abyss and followed up by being plotted against by the Heavenly Emperor. Not long after that, the Great Demon Concubine wanted to kill me and now even the Great Demon Venerate is targeting me as well! God damn it! I’m now standing on the opposite sides of both the Heavenly Realm and the Abyss! This is like forcing me against the whole world!’ Jiang Ming thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - A Disgusting Curse, By Hook or By Crook
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: A Disgusting Curse, By Hook or By Crook
Jiang Ming’s gaze was getting colder and colder with every passing second.
The Great Demon Venerate was raising humans as food?
Jiang Ming swore inwardly that he would discard his surname if he couldn’t kill him today. However, he felt the Great Demon Venerate was really good at hiding. Even though his wife had cheated him, he was able to ignore it.
“Not only that, but he will secretly watch his wife have sex with other males?” Jiang Ming mumbled.
Judging from the Great Demon Venerate’s behavior, it was rather possible.
‘If it’s the truth, then…’
Jiang Ming hastily killed his thoughts.
From this point alone, Jiang Ming could see how terrifying the Great Demon Venerate was. He was powerful and tenacious. He was able to endure and tolerate the most difficult thing in the world in order to achieve his goal.
He was born from the combination of the Nine-Orifice Demon Embryo of the Abyss Origin and the demonic blood from the Chaos. He was innately gifted, and he held a lot of power in the Abyss.
He also obtained the Holy Dao Vessel from the Chaos.
The Holy Dao Vessels were items forged by Saint Lord. Most of them held power beyond imagination.
Even until now, Jiang Ming had only come across one Holy Dao Vessel.
Was his Human Paths Record considered a Holy Dao Vessel?
It was hard to say.
This Great Demon Venerata was lucky as well. He saved 12 ancient venerates, and all of them were exceedingly powerful.
The fact that they were able to come back from the Chaos after wandering in it for many years indicated their might.
However, they all submitted to the Great Demon Venerate and became his helpers.
It seemed to Jiang Ming that the Great Demon Venerate was a formidable enemy, and he did not have a good feeling about this if he were to fight against him.
Suddenly, something popped into his mind.
The Chaos.
Even for the venerates, going into the Chaos often meant death. Beside, the legendary Sea of Chaos was not that easy to look for.
“I guess that’s the reason why there are still so many venerates in the Honggu Heavenly Realm. After all, it isn’t an easy task to venture into the Chaos, not to mention that nobody knew where the Sea of Chaos was.
And then, someone came into Jiang Ming’s head.
Riyue Changfeng.
Despite the danger in the Chaos, he came and went into the Chaos as if it was his home. He also had been hunted by a Saint Lord, and it occurred to him that Riyue Changfeng was at least as powerful as a Saint Lord.
At this moment, the explosion of the three Great Overarching Dao Vessels had engulfed the sky.
It was fortunate that the Dao Vessels exploded in the sky. If they exploded on the ground, the Infinite Realm Battlefield would be destroyed in no time.
With that thought in mind, Jiang Ming deactivated his special ability. He retreated to the sky above the palace, and landed beside Riyue Changfeng.
“Impressive!” Riyue Changfeng exclaimed, his face fully written with admiration and surprise, “I’ve gone to many worlds and been exposed to many secret methods or special abilities. However, none of them are as powerful or good as yours. You’re only a Golden Immortal, yet you could take down two venerates in the blink of an eye. Brother Jiang, you truly are the strongest I’ve ever seen.”
“Unfortunately, I let the Great Demon Concubine run away!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
Riyue Changfeng was speechless.
“It isn’t that easy to kill him. Even if she doesn’t run away, she will only end up with a few injuries. If she really wants to run away, there’s nothing you can do to stop her.”
“Really?” Jiang Ming blinked his eyes.
‘There’s nothing I can do to stop her? If it weren’t because I don’t want other people to know that I can pinpoint their location, do you think I can’t kill her if I detonate ten Great Overarching Dao Vessels? If it’s not enough, I still have the Quasi-Sage Weapons on my hands.’
However, Jiang Ming was certain once they learned his secret, the Great Demon Venerate and the Heavenly Emperor might join forces to eliminate him.
As for the clone that appeared behind the Great Demon Concubine? He was not far away from him when they were fighting, and there were too many ways for him to reach him.
“You can kill her?” Riyue Changfeng asked. “Well, it seems like I’ve underestimated you. But considering the fact that you’re the group admin, regardless of luck, knowledge, there are countless possibilities lie before you. But, let me warn you. Don’t look down on her. She still has an ace up her sleeves.”
“I can sense that!” Jiang Ming nodded. “Can you really not do something about it?”
“Nope! This is my principal!” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “Count me out.”
“Do you have any Saint Weapon?”
“Yes, I do!”
“Are you going to sell them off?”
“What? Of course, not. I need the Saint Weapon to protect myself. There is no way I’ll sell it away!”
“You have even taken that thing out!”
“Because it’s useless to me at the moment! A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush. What I have right now is more important. For me, nothing is more important than ascending into the next level. Therefore, if we want something, we have to give up something.”
“You’re just comforting yourself!”
“Sigh! Can we stop this conversation now? I’m starting to regret it now!” Riyue Changfeng said embarrassingly.
“Well, it’s too late!” Jiang Ming laughed, and then he looked far into the distance. There, the Great Demon Venerate had shown himself. He waved his arm, and the Great Demon Concubine appeared not far away.
As for the Blood Banner?
Apparently, she had stored it away.
“My dear wife!” The Great Demon Venerate said as he looked at the Great Demon Concubine endearingly. “You’re the most respectable mistress in the Abyss. As my wife, how could you do something like this yourself? If you don’t like him, you can just send our demon troops to get rid of him.”
“Great Demon Venerate, you despicable, disgusting vermin! How dare you do something like this to me?!” The Great Demon Concubine snarled as she glared at the Demon Venerate, her eyes spewing the fire of hatred.
Many of the experts that saw the interaction between them frowned.
It seemed to them that she was saved by the Great Demon Venerate, and he was comforting her just now. They couldn’t fathom why she was so angry at him.
Even if she was not on good terms with the Great Demon Venerate, she shouldn’t have fallen out with the Great Demon Venerate in a public like this. Besides, she shouldn’t have behaved like this considering her level of cultivation.
All of them were not able to think it through, save for one person, and that person was Jiang Ming.
He had seen everything through the Human Paths Record. Although the Great Demon Venerate was comforting his wife on the surface, he was actually cursing and shouting at her through telepathy.
He told her that he was going to lock her up and burn her with the demonic fire for 30 million years as well as to use the Eternal Demonic Blade to cut her face a hundred times so that her wounds would never recover. Besides, he was going to let the Abyss Maggots crawl over her body and the Abyss Giants puncture her with their massive weapons as a punishment for cheating on him.
“D*mn, this fellow is wild!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“Well, I guess you already know about it!” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “I’m sure the Great Demon Venerate has said something to the Great Demon Concubine through his mind. Maybe he wants her to behave herself and give her a chance to conceive a few little demons for him.”
The corner of Jiang Ming’s mouth quivered.
“Sky demon!” The Demon Concubine shouted, the fire in her eyes grew even larger. However, all her anger disappeared as she offered an alluring smile at the Great Demon Venerate. “Oh my dear Great Demon Venerate, I’ll make sure you’ll fall even deeper for me! Haha! Just you wait!”
Even though she was smiling and laughing when she was talking, Jiang Ming felt a chill down his spine.
After all, he saw the Great Demon Concubine’s true intention through the Human Paths Record as well.
She was going to make him fall from his grace. She wanted to contact the Heavenly Emperor, the Buddha Lord, and the Dragon to kill him. She wanted him to get his soul destroyed.
However, before that, she was going to look for 30 million young men and had some fun with them. Not only that, but she was also going to send the footage of them having fun to the Great Demon Venerate. She wanted to bring disgrace to him and let everyone in the Abyss know that he couldn’t satisfy her desire.
