“From a sense, they really are the perfect match for each other!” Jiang Ming said.
At this moment, the Great Demon Venerate was heading toward his direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - One In a Billion, The Tribulation for Ascension
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: One In a Billion, The Tribulation for Ascension
The wind was blowing while the clouds fluttered through the sky.
The crack in the sky was gone, and the sun had returned.
Jiang Ming lifted his head and looked toward the Great Demon Venerate, who was walking toward him.
In the end, the Great Demon Venerate stopped at about 10,000 meters away from him.
At this distance, the one who made the first move would be the winner.
“Brother Jiang!” The Great Demon Venerate greeted Jiang Ming with his hands on his back. Even though he had concealed his presence, people still felt a chill down his spines around him.
They all felt like they were staring at the abyss itself, and the darkness that followed behind him seemed to house an ancient monster that would pounce at its prey at any moment.
“As a man, how can you do that to a woman?” The Great Demon Venerate said, his voice low and deep, “You’ll leave a bad impression on other people.”
“There is no man or woman when it comes to cultivation,” Jiang Ming smiled, “If I treat her like a woman, I might be dead right now. The fact that she could reach the Demon Venerate Realm shows that there are many lives in her hands. Right now, all of you even extend your evil hands into my world, causing havoc and taking many lives, and you still want me to treat her nicely?
For me, all demons are the same. You all are the source of all turmoil in this world. You’re greedy and bloodthirsty, and all of you’re evil to the core.”
“You’re so narrow-minded!” The Great Demon Venerate said,
“The strong preys on the weak. This is what we demons believe, and we wish for nothing but freedom.”
“Nonsense!” Jiang Ming interrupted.
An argument like this was meaningless.
Both of them had their own points and beliefs, and neither of them could convince the other person.
“You want to get revenge?” Jiang Ming asked.
“You’ve killed too many of my Demon Venerates, as the Great Demon Venerate, I have to do something about it!” A sword appeared in the Great Demon Venerate’s hand. “I’ll let you strike first. If not, people might say I’m taking advantage of you!”
“The Heavenly Court is the one that leads the universe, and the Heavenly Emperor is the one who leads the Heavenly Court. He just complimented me for taking Kun Peng down, but you guys ignored the order of the Heavenly Emperor and disturbed me again and again. It seems to me that you’re going to rebel against the Heavenly Court and make everyone in this universe your enemy. As expected of the demon. You guys are bold!” Jiang Ming said before looking toward Riyue Changfeng. “Brother, do you have anything in possession that can kill him?”
“Well, I can only say yes and no,” Riyue Changfeng replied.
“What do you mean?” Jiang Ming asked.
“No means I don’t have a weapon that can kill him in one strike. Yes means I have something that can kill him. For example, the venom of the black scorpion is potent enough to take his life, and the Mixed Bane is a type of poison that can erase a demon of its existence. However, both of these will only take effect when they’re in the demon’s body, and it’s very hard to do that.”
“Isn’t that bullsh*t?” Jiang Ming was speechless. At the same time, he felt shocked as well.
He found it hard to believe that there was a poison that could take a Demi-Sage expert.
Riyue Changfeng chuckled, while the Great Demon Venerate frowned.
Black Scorpion? Mixed Bane?
Although he had never heard of them before, he reckoned that they were items from the Chaos.
“Are you not coming at me, Jiang Ming?” The Great Demon Venerate turned his eyes around and looked at the Tianyuan Realm.
Apparently, he was telling Jiang Ming that if he refused to make the first move, he would destroy the Tianyuan Realm.
It seemed to Jiang Ming that he had to show the Great Demon Venerate something today.
“Hmph!” He harrumphed as his face sank. He waved his arms, and a river of Dao Vessels appeared before him. There were 108 Taiyi Weapons, six Great Overarching Dao Vessels, and a Quasi-Sage Weapon.
All of them gave off a brilliant light and they got into their positions respectively, forming into a formation.
“This is!” The Great Demon Venerate was so shocked that he was tongue-tied.
“What’s with that face? Aren’t you the one who asked me to come at you?” Jiang Ming laughed, “After all, the Abyss is a force that can fight toe to toe with the Heavenly Court. Before you show up, you’ve sent two Demon Venerates and the Great Demon Concubine at us, so I think it’s only right for me to retaliate with an attack of equal power, right?”
The Great Demon Venerate did not know what to say. He looked at Jiang Ming intently and the river of Dao Vessels in front of him.
The corner of his lips quivered.
‘D*mn it!’ He cursed inwardly. If he denoted all of the Dao Vessels at the same time, the Great Demon Venerate was confident that not even he was able to survive the blow. Once he was gravely injured, there was a possibility that the Heavenly Emperor would come out and kill him right away.
Even if the Heavenly Emperor did not take advantage of the situation, what about the Buddha Lord or the Dragon Lord?
For them, weakness was a sin, and those who were weak shouldn’t even exist in this universe.
Besides, he was certain that Jiang Ming still had other tricks up his sleeves. If he pushed him into a desperate situation, there was no guarantee what he would do in retaliation.
After careful consideration, the Great Demon Venerate looked toward Riyue Changfeng.
He could sense that he was powerful, a lot more powerful than the Heavenly Emperor.
Therefore, there was no way he could snatch the auction house from him. Since he could not get the auction house from him, he could only trade with him.
“Sir!” The Great Demon Venerate smiled at him and greeted, “Do you have anything that I need?”
“Yes, I do!” Riyue Changfeng’s eyes glowed, “I have a ( ). It can restore 30% power of a Demi-Sage expert once consumed. It’s considered as an extra life in a battle. I also have some Demi-Sage Weapons, and several secret techniques that could temporarily seal the movement of your enemy!”
“It’s a lot!” The Great Demon Venerate was shocked. He had the urge to steal all of them from Riyue Changfeng, but when he saw Bi Jiu, who squatted next to Riyue Changfeng, he pressed the urge down.
Apparently, the man in front of him was someone he couldn’t defeat at the moment. Besides, he shouldn’t create more trouble at a crucial moment like this as well.
“Can we trade now?” The Great Demon Venerate asked.
Riyue Changfeng shook his head and said, “I’ve already announced that the auction will begin in another year, so I can’t turn back on my words. This is the integrity of a trader!”
Jiang Ming glanced at Riyue Changfeng.
‘Integrity? Integrity is nothing when benefits are great enough.’
The Great Demon Venerate sighed, “Do you have the location map to the Sea of Chaos?”
“Yep, there is!” Riyue Changfeng squinted his eyes.
A certain expert who was observing them was stunned. His heart skipped a beat, but he soon calmed himself down.
The Sea of Chaos was a place where everyone wanted to go, including the Heavenly Emperor. The reason they did not go there was because they did not have the map.
“The map is here!” Riyue Changfeng pointed at his head.
The Great Demon Venerate did not continue the conversation. Instead, he changed to another topic, “Can you tell us how the realms of the Chaos Sea are divided?”
“Nope!” Riyue Changfeng said, “All I can say is that the Golden Immortal Realm is the weakest over there.”
“The Golden Immortal Realm is the weakest?” The Great Demon Venerate was stumped.
Even Jiang Ming was stunned as well.
Those who had achieved the Golden Immortal Realm were by no means weak, but they were the weakest in the Chaos Sea?
“In the Chaos Sea, the Golden Immortal experts are just like ordinary people in a planar world,” Riyue Changfeng added.
This time, both Jiang Ming and the Great Demon Venerate were speechless.
In other words, the Golden Immortal experts were just like ordinary people when they went to the Chaos Sea?
“There’s one saying in my place. The limit for the growth of the life bred in a small chiliocosm is the Golden Immortal Realm. Once a person has reached the Golden Immortal Realm and comprehended the Taiyi Dao, they can go to another world. Is that true or not?
“And the Immortal Emperor in the middle chiliocosm. Once they’ve ascended into the next realm, they will break their shackles and go to another world. Is that true or false?” The Great Demon Venerate asked.
“It’s both true and false!” Riyue Changfeng said after a short while of hesitation. “Anyway, this isn’t a secret after all, so I guess I can tell you about it.”
Both Jiang Ming and the Great Demon Venerate fell silent.
The experts that were hiding in the dark all pricked up their ears.
“In the chaos, only the great chiliocosm can truly exist and operate independently. Middle and small chiliocosms have to depend on the great chiliocosm. Generally speaking, once someone from the small or middle chiliocosm have broken their shackles, they will be send to the great chilicosm,” Riyue Changfeng said, “Some of the great chiliocosms will become volatile after losing the suppression of a holy saint. In this case, the living beings on the small or middle chiliocosms will be sent toward the Chaos Sea after they’ve broken their shackles
“Of course, there are also some exceptions as well. However, these ascensions also come with great risk. While they’re on the way to ascension, there will be a test. An expert once compiled the total number of people who successfully passed the test, and he found out that out of 100 million people, only one person might be able to pass the test.
“In other words, there is a one in a billion chance. So this ascension is suicidal!” Riyue Changfeng said.
“What…” Both the Great Demon Venerate and Jiang Ming were stunned.
One in a billion?
Suicidal?
This was something that they had never expected before.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - The Rise of the Human Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: The Rise of the Human Emperor
“Why does the test have to be so hard?” Jiang Ming said in confusion.
“Do you know what kind of place the Chaos Sea is? There’s no way you can go there so easily,” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile, “Only those who’re strong enough to pass the test. A Golden Immortal expert might be very powerful in a small chiliocosm, but they will die instantly as soon as they step into the Chaos Sea. Only those Golden Immortal experts who are strong enough to defeat a Great Overarching expert might stand a chance in the Chaos Sea.”
“Seriously?” The Great Demon Venerate shook his head. “A Golden Immortal expert defeating a Great Overarching expert? That’s impossible!”
Suddenly, he thought of something and he looked toward Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming hadn’t reached the Great Overarching realm, yet he was able to kill someone a lot stronger than him. The Great Demon Venerate was a Demi-Sage himself, but he did not have the confidence that he could defeat him either.
“It’s possible, but only a handful of people can do that,” Riyue Changfeng said. After that, he waved his hand and continued with a smile, “Alright, that’s all for today. If you want to buy something, then get ready your immortal crystal, demon crystal, or even Dao Vessels and come back to me in another year!”
“Sure!” The Great Demon Venerate nodded. He took one last look at Jiang Ming before leaving while shaking his head.
“Brother Jiang, you’ve made a name for yourself after this fight, and more people will know about you,” Riyue Changfeng smiled.
“Honestly, I’d rather them not know who I am,” Jiang Ming sighed, “I just want to spend my life in peace, but it seems to me that it’s impossible. Many people are coming after my life, so to protect myself as well as the people I care about, I have no other choice but to fight back and kill them. I guess I would only have my peace after I’ve killed all of them.”
“Well, it seems to me that you still have a long way to go!”
“Sigh, there’s nothing I can do about it!”
“Haha!”
Both of them laughed.
“Sacrificial Artifact Judgment and the special ability that you developed that could disrupt your opponent’s Dao Vessels as well as your special abilities that could form bodies of three lifetimes,” Riyue Changfeng said, “Are you going to trade them?”
“Of course! I don’t see any reason why I shouldn’t trade with you if you have something good to offer,” Jiang Ming said.
Honestly, special ability was the last thing he cared about. After all, he was confident that he could master and perfect different kinds of special abilities.
“That’s the spirit! After you’ve collected everything, I’ll show you some good stuff!”
“Sure!”
After they had finished talking, Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak.
“I was terrified when the Great Demon Venerate appeared just now!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “But honestly, I didn’t expect that you could scare him away!”
“It’s just temporary. If he’s hellbent on attacking me, there’s nothing I can do other than running away!” Jiang Ming said.
“Even so, what you did is still very impressive. It means that you’re now one of the strongest people in the Heavenly Realm. Oh yeah…” Mountain Master Tian Yuan paused for a moment before continuing, “Wan Lian Great Monarch sent me a message just now. After the battle between the Abyss and the Heavenly Court has come to a conclusion, he and the other human venerates will come over here and build a force that belongs to the human race. They will also elect you as the emperor of the human race to lead the entire human race from all universes. They will support you regardless of anything, even if you want to bring the Heavenly Emperor from his throne. He wants me to ask about your opinion.”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was talking to him telepathically.
Jiang Ming frowned slightly and said, “You don’t have to use telepathy here. How is their combat power?”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan raised his head and looked ahead. He was surprised.
He knew what Jiang Ming was trying to tell him.
Nobody would hear their conversation as long as they stayed here.
“Other than me, there will be another eight venerates. One of them is at the peak of the Quasi-Sage Realm, two at the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm, and four at the initial stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm.”
“There are so many of them?”
“It isn’t that many. After all, the human race is the largest race, so I’d say we have the least number of experts. No, wait a second. Let me rephrase. Every time there is a war, the human race will lose one or two experts. Now that I think about it, it should be that we’re targeted by other forces and they want to weaken our power.
“No, it must be because of that!
“If not, there’s no way we won’t have a Saint Lord, right? What do you think, brother?”
“Nope!” Jiang Ming shook his head, “The Heavenly Emperor reigns over the Heavenly Court. He has the authority of the universe and he’s as powerful as Saint Lord. Do you think anyone can defeat someone like that? As for the Great Demon Venerate, he has a Holy Dao Vessel.”
“The Great Demon Venerate has a Holy Dao Vessel?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was stumped.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming nodded. “Not only him, I suspect that even though the Buddha Lord and the Dragon Lord don’t have a Holy Dao Vessel, at least they have one or two Demi-Sage Weapons and powerful formations. In this war, regardless of whether the Abyss or the Heavenly Court wins, we can’t stand forward. The only situation we can stand forward is when the Heavenly Emperor, the Great Demon Venerate, the Dragon Lord, and the Buddha Lord are too occupied with the war and they can’t afford to care about us. Besides, we also need a Demi-Sage expert. It seems to me that they can’t hold themselves back for long.”
“I thought the same way as well.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned. “They have been hiding for so long, so why are they all suddenly becoming so restless? Could it be that they see the hope of the rise of humanity in you, so they can’t hold themselves back anymore?”
“Hope?” Jiang Ming shook his head, “Hope is the most unreliable thing in this world.”
He paused for a moment before continuing in a serious manner, “By the way, make sure you don’t tell anyone about this place.”
“Are you worried that…”
“Well, people’s hearts are unpredictable.”
“Yeah, you’re right. People’s hearts are unpredictable,” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled bitterly.
He sensed that Phoenix Linglong was watching him. He let out a chuckle and left. As soon as he reached his house, the courtyard was instantly covered with a layer of fog. No matter how hard he tried to pry inside, he couldn’t see anything.
“What a mysterious place. Can the Sage Venerates Dao Square do something like this? But I didn’t see any sign of formation at all!”
As the thought surfaced in Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s mind, he sat down in a lotus position and began cultivating.
The Jiuyang Sect.
Many people were getting stronger and stronger. Some of them had just a breakthrough three days ago, and now they had another breakthrough again.
Most of them found it difficult to believe at their cultivation speed.
Even Gu Hai, who seldom cultivate, had already reached the Paradis Realm.
Chuyang Peak.
“Senior brother, do you know how scared I am just now?” Phoenix Linglong wrapped around Jiang Ming’s arms. “The Great Demon Venerate is someone who stands on the same level as the Heavenly Emperor. Yet you can scare him away. You really are the best, senior brother!”
“It’s nothing, honestly. It’s best if I can kill him. Then no one will disturb us anymore!” Jiang Ming said as he threw himself on the rattan chair.
“Ah, this feels so good.”
“You’re just lazy!” Phoenix Linglong threw herself on top of him and drew circles on his chest with her finger. “I guess no one will come to disturb us for the time being. What’s your plan, senior brother?”
“We’ll just wait and watch!” Jiang Ming said, “It’ll be best if no one comes to disturb us, but if there is, we’ll kill them!”
“You don’t want to be the emperor of the king? Or the emperor of the north?”
“Nope!”
Bam!
A cannon shot silenced everything, and the shrill sound was transformed into the world’s most exalted music.
Time was passing slowly.
The heavenly realm was invaded by the demon. They killed everyone they saw in their path, but some of the bigger forces did not care about them.
The Heavenly Court also sent many heavenly soldiers and generals to get rid of the demons. The Heavenly Emperor even gave out orders to eliminate the demons, and this represented the demon completely standing on the opposite side of the Heavenly Court as well as the others.
Some Great Overarching expert would show up from time to time, but a Saint Lord never appeared.
In the midst of the war, there were also rumors about the Infinite Realm Battlefield. Four Demon Venerates and the former Northern Emperor were killed there.
Due to this, the Tianyuan Realm became a force to be reckoned with. Many people sent invitations to Jiang Ming and wanted to visit them, but he rejected each of them.
Time was passing rapidly as the war progressed. Very soon, there was only one month left to Riyue Changfeng’s auction.
“I’m finally at the peak of the Taiyi Realm!” Phoenix Linglong got up and stretched her body.
Jiang Ming looked at her and calmed himself down.
‘Now isn’t the right time for that,’ He told himself.
It was about time he traded with his group members, and he should get serious now.
“Senior brother, I’m strong enough to defeat a Great Overarching Golden Immortal now! Just as I expected, cultivating with you is much faster than cultivating in that inheritance space,” Phoenix Linglong said.
“You’ve absorbed all of my essence, so of course, your cultivation speed will be fast,” Jiang Ming said.
“Yeah. You’re right,” Phoenix Linglong replied. “I want more!”
“What?” Jiang Ming shuddered. “Nope, nope, nope. Let’s stop for the time being. I still have other more important stuff to attend to.”
“Hmph! I’m sure it’s because you can’t do it anymore!”
“I can’t do it anymore? Girl, you shouldn’t challenge me!” Jiang Ming replied, but he rubbed his back in secret.
Then, he entered the Supreme Chat Group.
Something good was happening there.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - Worldly Flame, The Chaos Monument (1
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Worldly Flame, The Chaos Monument (1)
Linglong lay on top of him, but Jiang Ming pushed her away from him.
“You’re so mean, senior brother!”
“Hmph! This is called the joy of a king!”
“King? I’ll let you have a taste of the joy of a saint!”
“Hiss…”
Jiang Ming shuddered.
The personality of this junior sister was different from that of Linglong. She was passionate and bold, as opposed to Linglong.
While Jiang Ming was enjoying her service, he entered the Supreme Chat Group.
It was quiet here, and no one was talking.
‘I guess everyone must be busy!’ He chuckled inwardly.
The relationship between him and the group members had grown considerably in the past year.
[Jiang Ming: Why is there no one to receive their group admin?]
[Wang Ye: If you can give us red packets with 100 points in it, we will come and welcome you every day.]
[Ao Long: 100 points? Are you kidding? It has to be 1,000 points! Not only will we come and welcome you every day, I can also give you 3,000 beauties that I refined for you!]
[Huang Quan: Nah, 10,000 points is the best. If you can do that, group admin, I’ll collect 30 million desire demons, red demons, fallen angels, dark elves, spider women, and so on for you.]
[Lan Hai: I can even call you master if you can give me some points!]
[Feng Wu: How can you guys be so shameless? Group admin, do you need someone to warm your bed? I can do it for you.]
[Di Huo: You’re the same as well, Ms. Feng Wu! You even have offered yourself to our group admin!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang, all of them are bad guys!]
[Feng Wu: What are you talking about, Sister Chenxi? We aren’t bad guys, we’reyour friends. I can share our group admin with you if you want!]
[Tian Fozi: You guys can share me too if you want.]
[Ming Fei: Shoo, shoo, get out of here, you little monk. Are you not worried that your Buddha Lord would punish you?]
All of these people showed their true natures since they did not have to worry about anything here.
[Jiang Ming: Sure! I’ll leave some spaces for you people after I’ve built a palace!]
[Ao Long: What? Group admin, although I’m a dragon, I’m not into that kind of thing!]
[Tian Fozi: I can’t believe you’re this kind of person, group admin? My Buddha Lord will punish me!]
[Wang Ye: Hold on, guys. It seems that our group admin is going to spend some points now. Besides, you’re the one behind this Supreme Chat Group trade thing, right?]
[Jiang Ming: Yes, I need a lot of it.]
[Wang Ye: Judging from the amount of items and points, I’m sure you aren’t preparing them for yourself or the force that’s supporting you from the back. Are you preparing them for the trade?]
[Di Huo: Trade? The Infinite Realm Auction House?]
[Hong Yi: I think the same way as well. I can’t believe that you’ve encountered the person who runs the auction house. You even have struck some deals with him. This is going to be a good opportunity.]
[Jiang Ming: I’m just lucky, haha. Anyway, let’s get back to the business. Do you have anything good to offer to me?]
[Jiang Ming: Quasi-Sage weapons, Holy Dao Vessel, Innate Spiritual Root, treasures… I will receive anything you can offer!]
[Ao Long: When the Great Monarch of my clan ventured into the Chaos, he stumbled upon a destroyed great chiliocosm and got a stone monument. There’s a holy law embedded on it. Holy law is precious, but group admin, a stone monument that contains a wisp of the origin force of the former great chiliocosm is more valuable for the person who runs the auction house, so what kind of price are you going to offer? Of course, it goes without saying that you can make the stone monument into a Quasi-Sage weapon.]
[Jiang Ming: All of you know about the nature of the auction house?]
[Ao Long: Hehe, group admin, most of us here have a big background in their own world. Some of us might be a Saint Lord, so of course, we’re aware of some of the secrets. Besides, Hong Zhan has told us about the Infinite Realm Auction House before too.]
[Ao Long: Using the Chaotic Destiny River as a medium, they wander through the vastness of space and time. Through a certain price, they lock onto a Great Chiliocosm and descend over there. The traded items themselves are of little value to them, but the power of the world, the power of Qi, and the power of destiny contained in the items are the supreme sustenance for their cultivation.]
[Ao Ling: Hehe, group admin, this item I have here is the remains of a destroyed great chiliocosm. The power, the Qi and the Dao Fluctuation in it is massive! For us, the holy law might be more valuable, but for you, the stone monument is of immense value.]
[Ao Long: Group admin, I hope you won’t think of it as a daylight robbery. Just take it as helping the poor. Hehe, I’m so excited today!]
[Jiang Ming: Heavenly King with Earthly Tiger, odd numbers will change and even numbers remain.]
[Ao Long: Huh? What are you talking about, group admin?]
[Jiang Ming: Nothing. Brother Ao, if you believe in me, then give me the stone monument. I’ll appraise it and see how much it is worth.]
He let out a sigh inwardly.
He thought Ao Long was a transmigrator as well.
[Ao Long: Sure! I’ll send it to you right away!]

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - Worldly Flame, the Chaos Monument (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Worldly Flame, the Chaos Monument (2)
[Jiang Ming: Great!]
[Ao Long: I have gathered quite a lot of items and Great Overarching Dao Vessels. I’ll transfer all of them to you first, and I’ll go gather some more!]
[Jiang Ming: Sure!]
[Di Huo: I have a Worldly Flame here. It is the fusion of 3,000 fires such as Sun Fire, Extreme Yin Fire, Stellar Fire, Black Hole Tears, Southern Flare, Thunder Fire, Void Fire, Terra Fire, Karma Fire, Mortal Fire, and Ocean Fire. It’s also the source of all fires in my world, which is equivalent to the Quasi-Chaos Fire. On my side, the value is comparable to that of a Quasi-Sage Weapon, but if you’re going to trade it to the owner of the auction house, the value is going to be several times higher. So do you want it, group admin?]
[Jiang Ming: I think you need it more than me, right?]
[Di Huo: I already have one, and this is the spare. There are only two in this universe, and I doubt there will be the third one in the future. The reason for taking it out is simple. I just want to get a large amount of points. Besides, my clan has high expectations of me. According to my natural talent and opportunity, they all think I have the chance of sanctifying Dao, which is why they spare no effort to support me. If I have enough points, there’s a possibility I can develop a method to break the shackles of my bloodline and realize my potential or comprehend a supreme Dao.]
[Jiang Ming: Well, you came to the right person. I have a million points, so you won’t be disappointed!]
[Di Huo: A million? Terrific! We’re truly honored to have a group admin like you! Anyway, I’ll transfer the item to you first.]
[Jiang Ming: Sure!]
All of them were trading, while on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was biting his lip and his eyes were widened. His body was trembling and a surge of excitation rushed through every nerve end inside of him.
“Phew…” He let out a sigh and looked ahead at the setting sun.
He scooped his junior sister up from the floor. Then cook with one hand and eat with the other.
He made the meal slower than he used to, and he finished the meal even slower.
[Ding! Congratulations! You’ve finished the slowest dinner under double joy. You’ve been rewarded with one of Dragon Monarch’s strongest attacks.]
Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows.
This was not the first time he got a reward like this, but he had only used it once. The attack he used was the strike of the Heavenly Emperor that punctured the entire Abyss.
“Awesome!” Jiang Ming was delighted as a myriad of thoughts flitted across his head.
At this moment, he froze and shuddered. Then, he felt as if he had fallen into an endless void.
Phoenix Linglong was lying next to him. She licked her lips and took a few large gulps from the cup of tea beside her. “Eek! It’s so disgusting!”
“But you like it very much, aren’t you? It’s even more nutritious and flavorful than the cup of tea in your hand.”
“Bullsh*t!” Phoenix Linglong rolled her eyes at him.
Jiang Ming laughed. In the next second, he disappeared, and when he appeared again, he was standing on the platform of the Supreme Pagoda.
On the platform, Ye Qingxian was sitting in a lotus position on top of a stone monument. There was a layer of divine light around her to prevent other people from disturbing her.
There were also other people on the platform. Most of them were talking while the others had their eyes closed, seemingly taking a rest. However, all of them had a big grin on their faces.
Jiang Ming flew through the air and landed outside of the divine light.
“Sister Ye!” He called out to Ye Qingxian.
Ye Qingxian opened her eyes, and a smile broke across her face when she saw Jiang Ming.
“Brother Jiang!” She greeted him as she dispersed the divine light around her.
Jiang Ming walked over and the divine light returned, obscuring everything that was happening inside from the sight of the people outside.
The people on the platform looked over in their direction. Some of them were pointing their fingers at them, but none of them walked over. After all, they were all immortals and they did not really care about what they were doing.
On the stone monument.
“It has been 800 to 900 years, Sister Ye! It must’ve been tough for you,” Jiang Ming said as he sat down.
“Well, the tougher the better!” Ye Qingxian smiled. Then, she tossed a storage ring at her. It was a Great Overarching item that harnessed the power of space. It contained a very unique special ability and it was extremely priceless.
“I’ve used up all my points, but I’ve gotten quite a lot of items. Feel free to check on them!”
“You’ve used up all your points?” Jiang Ming was shocked. “That’s faster than I expected!”
“All of us lack points!” Ye Qingxian shook her head and laughed bitterly. “All of those who made it here are geniuses. They all hail from good backgrounds and they have plenty of good stuff in their hands. However, all of them are facing the same problem—not enough points! Once they have enough points, they could sanctify their Dao here. It’s an opportunity that can only come by luck, so of course, everyone wants to seize it. As for those treasures and good items, we can always get it back somehow.”
Jiang Ming nodded.
Ye Qingxian was right.
For example, some of them with limited innate talent would not be able to ascend into a higher level once they had reached a certain realm. However, the enlightenment mode here could break through the shackles.
“Some of them asked me if there’s anything I want or not.” Ye Qingxian looked at him.
“Let’s stop for the time being,” Jiang Ming replied after he thought for a while. “It’s likely that I will need more, but the items needed will be different, so wait first.”
“Alright then!”
“What is your next plan?”
“I’m going to stay here and cultivate?”
“You’re not going to return to the real world?”
“It has only been a year in the real world. Besides, I still need to cultivate if I go back to the real world, so why not do it here? I still have some points left, and once I’ve used them up, I’ll go challenge the Battle Tower and the Heavenly Ladder to get some points. Besides, I’ve also set up a small goal for myself.”
“A small goal? That sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about it?”
“I won’t return to the real world until I enter the chat room!”
“Hmm?”
Ye Qingxian’s eyes were glowing brightly, She became even more excited, but she did not ask Jiang Ming about the members in the chat group.
After they talked for a long while, Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak.
“You came back faster than I expected,” Phoenix Linglong said in surprise when she saw Jiang Ming, “The taste in my mouth hasn’t gone away yet!”
“I’m going to…” The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips quivered.
“You’re going to what?” Phoenix Linglong smiled her eyes into two fine lines as she turned her body around.
“I’m going to punish you!”
By the time Jiang Ming raised his head, the sun was already setting.
“No wonder people always say that the beauty’s arms are the graves of the heroes,” Jiang Ming lamented, “Junior sister, you’re going to kill me one day.”
“I just took a few bites!” Phoenix Linglong said gloomily, “Senior brother, I’m hungry. Go make something for me.”
Jiang Ming shook his head silently and went away.
While he was flying, he looked across the Tianyuan Realm. There were divine lights everywhere. The trees were tall and the rivers were shimmering.
He turned his head around and looked at the Jiuyang Sect.
“Hao Chen First Seat has already ascended into the Immortal Realm. As expected of the most experienced senior in the Jiuyang Sect.
“As for Xi Yao…”
Jiang Ming looked toward the mountain behind Chuyang Peak.
Xi Yao was still cultivating in the courtyard. She was a Mystical Immortal expert right now.
“All of them are getting stronger and stronger!”
He turned around and flew toward the Tianyuan Sea. Then, he gazed around at the Infinite Realm Battlefield.
The portals to the Abyss were still around, and demons were rushing out of them.
Besides, Jiang Ming also noticed that there were plenty of powerful beings in the void around the Tianyuan Sea. All of them were looking in this direction, and apparently, they were sent by the various forces from the Heavenly Realm to keep an eye on this place.
Jiang Ming did not care about them.
After a short while, he came to the auction palace.
The door opened up and Riyue Changfeng emerged from it. His eyes were glowing and his voice was thick with excitement. “Welcome, welcome, my guest. Please have a seat inside, Brother Jiang!”
“After you, Brother Riyue!” Jiang Ming followed him into the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - The Small Stick That Crosses Three Great Chiliocosms, Jiang Ming Is Stunned
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: The Small Stick That Crosses Three Great Chiliocosms, Jiang Ming Is Stunned
Translation
In the depths of the palace, there was a spacious area.
Jiang Ming and Riyue Changfeng were sitting on a lotus platform. They were floating on top of a sea, and the mountain ranges in the distance were emitting a brilliant light.
There was a desk in between them, and the air was filled with the fragrance of the tea.
“Brother Riyue, I have good stuff here!” Jiang Ming said as he took out the stone monument that Ao Long had given him,
The stone monument was standing at the height of a normal human. It looked ancient, and its many scars made it look like it had existed for more than a billion years.
There was a depiction of a sword in the center. At a single glance, the sword intents in it seemed to be able to cut through one’s Primal Spirit and destroy one’s will.
It was a Sage-level sword technique.
“Can you appraise it?” Jiang Ming pointed at it.
Riyue Changfeng’s eyes glowed. Signs began to appear in his eyes as he peered into the material of the stone monument and analyzed the essence contained within.
He tapped the stone monument with his finger again, and various lights appeared.
“Awesome! This is terrific!” Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help himself and exclaimed, “This stone monument is made from a material known as the Triple Terra Gold. In the great chiliocosm, it’s considered a great material to forge a Quasi-Sage Weapon. This stone monument is of great value by looking at the material alone.
“Of course, for the billions and billions of living beings across the universe, this stone monument is priceless.
“However, these values have no meaning to me!
“This stone monument carries the residual Holy Dao of a great world, the worldly Qi, origin essence, faith, law, hope, as well as the decaying energy after the destruction of the world. Hope and disappointment, creation and death, faith and corruption, light and dark… There are too many of them. For me, this is of immense value!
“If you only consider the stone monument and the sword technique, its value is equal to that of a primary Quasi-Sage Weapon.
“But with all the things I mentioned just now, its value can be increased by ten times!
“The value of this stone monument is 10 primary Quasi-Sage Weapons. It’s even more valuable than a Demi-Sage Dao Vessel.
“So, are you going to sell it for 10 primary Quasi-Sage Weapons?” Riyue Changfeng asked, his eyes glowing with excitement.
“Can’t you extract its Dao fluctuations?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Well, yes and no!” Riyue Changfeng shook his head. He picked up the cup of tea and continued. “I’m nothing but a dealer here. For everything I’ve traded here, there is a wiggle room when it comes to price according to different grades of items. This is also my secret to making some pocket money as well. Of course, the more business I do and the higher the value of the items I get, the more contribution points I’ll receive.”
“Are you sure it’s okay for you to tell me all of these?”
“Haha, you’re my VIP customer. Of course, I’ll tell you everything unless it involves some core secrets.”
“I’ll trade it with you after I’ve mastered the sword technique on the stone monument!”
“Sure!”
“Brother Riyue, then how about this flame? How much do you think it’s worth?”
Jiang Ming stored the stone monument away and flipped his palm. A plume of fire appeared at the center of his palm, and at that moment, a gush of heat energy swept across the surrounding area.
Riyue Changfeng’s eyes glowed, and he stared at the fire. After a long while, he said, “This is a Worldly Flame. It’s the source of fire of a great chiliocosm, the source of civilization, the source of life, or the source of all things! This thing is good!”
“Terrific!” Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up.
The fact that he could see through the Worldly Flame’s essence in a single glance showed that he was truly knowledgeable.
“Well, I’ve traveled to more worlds than you have!” Riyue Changfeng laughed. “The value of this Worldly Flame is the same as the stone monument. However, the value of this Worldly Flame will be ten times that of the stone monument if it were to stabilize until the day the world welcomes its destruction.”
“Pretty good!” As Jiang Ming was talking, he pulled out treasures one after another.
Just like Ye Qingxian had said, all of those who could enter the Supreme Pagoda were beings that were loved by their worlds. They had plenty of opportunities, so they would naturally have some good stuff with them.
For example, a small, black, unpleasant stick was surprisingly refined with the male trait of 3,000 different races and infused with the aura of more than 300 million different females.
Moreover, there were traces of three great chiliocosms on the stick, bringing its value to the middle Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel.
Jiang Ming was shocked.
Ye Qingxian had gotten this item with four points. Its value was increased by 250 times, and Riyue Changfeng was willing to trade it with 20 weapons.
Riyue Changfeng also told him that if a man ate the stick, it would invigorate him and make up for his shortcomings.
Jiang Ming felt a new world had opened up before his eyes as Riyue Changfeng appraised those items.
In the end, the appraisal session ended.
Jiang Ming checked through the items in his storage ring and made a rough estimation inwardly.
A smile broke across his face as he said to himself, ‘I guess this is more than enough, and I still have plenty more left. But I have to say that the profit of monopolizing the market is truly astonishing.’
Riyue Changfeng sighed, “I’m happy that you have reached the target in such a short time, but I don’t know why I feel so depressed.”
“Why do you feel depressed? With so many items, the Holy Dao is just right before you,” Jiang Ming laughed, “Once you’ve entered the Holy Dao, you’ll attain immortality. What could be compared to that? Besides, it’s a seedling that takes an unknown number of years to mature and manifest its true value. Brother Riyue, you’ve earned big this time!”
“For you, you surely have earned a hundred times more than I have!” Riyue Changfeng said while shaking his head. “Anyway, this thing will only manifest its true value when it’s placed in the hands of someone like you who cultivates the World Dao.”
As he was talking, he pulled the Chaotic Tree’s seedling out. He studied it for a while and continued. “Although the value of these things is enough, to be on the safe side, can you give me the stone monument as well after you’ve finished comprehending the sword technique on it? Of course, I’ll give you an item of equal value in return.”
“It’s a deal then!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “If you still need more, I can continue to help you collect, provided that you have enough good stuff!”
Riyue Changfeng’s eyes glowed, and then he narrowed them. “What do you need in return?”
“Quasi-Sage Weapons, Demi-Sage Dao Vessels, Holy Dao treasures, Holy Dao secret techniques, special abilities, formations, immortal roots, spiritual roots, and so on!” As he sipped on the tea, Jiang Ming said, “The more, the better.”
“The more, the better?” The corner of Riyue Changfeng’s lips quivered.
Initially, he was the one who needed these items, but now it was the other way around.
He was considered wealthy in every great chiliocosm. After all, he had traveled to many different worlds and even had the resources allocated by the headquarters.
But now…
The man in front of him was even wealthier than he was.
“I’ll start the auction in another month. Since your world doesn’t have a Saint Lord, I’m afraid not many people can afford a Quasi-Sage Weapon, let alone a Demi-Sage Dao Vessel. From what I’ve seen so far, the most purchased items are Holy Dao secret techniques, formations, immortal pills, and so on,” Riyue Changfeng said. “The highest value of the items I give you to trade is a thousand items. This is my limit, and I can’t go any further.”
“Can’t you request your headquarters to send you some?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Through the Chaos?” Riyue Changfeng shook his head. “Don’t you know that the higher the grade of a living being or item, the greater the cost required to teleport across the Chaos? Let’s take the Lord God Space as an example.
“Generally speaking, sending a Taiyi Realm expert is the limit. They will only send over a Great Overarching expert in a very special situation. As for a Quasi-Sage? It’s totally not worth it.”
“I thought the Lord God Space can send whichever beneficiaries they want,” Jiang Ming replied.
However, he felt this was rather reasonable. After all, if the Lord God Space and the Reincarnation Hall could send their beneficiaries to different worlds without any requirement, all universes would fall into chaos.
That being said, things were slightly different when it came to the Supreme Pagoda.
He could trade a Quasi-Sage Weapon with his group members without any cost.
“There are rules even in chaos,” said Riyue Changfeng. “Although the Lord God is almighty, they can’t ignore the rule.”
“You’re right,” Jiang Ming replied. “When will you come here again after you go back this time?”
“You still want to trade with me?”
“Of course! I need more Holy Weapons.”
“Holy Weapon?” The corner of Riyue Changfeng’s mouth quivered. “Even in my current condition, I have only obtained one Holy Weapon. However, I can’t trade it with you as it’s my ace in the sleeve. Once I’ve stepped into the Sage Realm, my level will become higher, and it’ll be easier for us to trade a Holy Weapon.”
“It shouldn’t be that hard for you to sanctify Dao, right? How long do you need?”
“Yes, it isn’t hard, but I don’t know how long it’s going to take. It might take a year or a million years. It depends.”
“A million years?”
“If I need to take a million years, I’m afraid a Holy Weapon has no use for you anymore when the time comes.”
“Well, it’s hard to say. Brother Riyue, can you sanctify Dao in the Time Chamber?”
“Nope. If you want to sanctify Dao, you need to master the rules of the Holy Dao first.”
Jiang Ming was a little bit disappointed when he heard what Riyue Changfeng said.
After a short while, just when Jiang Ming was about to leave, Riyue Changfeng reminded him, “It seems to me that a storm is coming.”
“What do you mean?” Jiang Ming froze. “The Abyss? The fact that the Heavenly Emperor could rule over the universe means he’s both powerful and sagacious. Do you really think the Abyss can defeat him?”
“In a world without a Saint Lord, the Heavenly Emperor’s status is way too high,” said Riyue Changfeng. “Destruction pursues the great. If there’s a Saint Lord, they will handle everything. When the Saint Lord isn’t around, the remaining are all Quasi-Sages, and no one will submit to anyone. Even a Demi-Sage is considered a Quasi-Sage, and they can be killed! There are too many races and forces across the universes. Once something goes wrong, destruction will follow. Brother Jiang, you need to be careful!”
“You’re right.” Jiang Ming nodded. “But as long as they don’t disturb me, I won’t do anything.”
After that, he left with the Chaotic Tree’s seedling.
“What a strange person!” Riyue Changfeng waved his arm and closed the door. “The Great Demon Venerate is very good at hiding secrets. When you learn about it, I’m afraid you won’t be so calm anymore, Brother Jiang. But anyway, this is a good chance to see his true strength.”

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - Crazy, All Have Gone Insane (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Crazy, All Have Gone Insane (Part 1)
It was a windy day on the Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming called up Human Path Records to check on the Great Demon Venerate, Great Demon Concubine, and Black-Hearted Old Demon.
Great Demon Concubine: Haha, with my surreptitious support, the Abyss has invaded about half of the middle chiliocosms, ruffling infinite realms. Sky Demon, be prepared to be the enemy of all forces. Because of your reprimand, I’ll bring down ruin on you. I’ll make sure you die without burial and that your soul dissipates.
Great Demon Venerate: Ha, what a stupid Yu Fei, the son of b*tch dominated by desires! Do you think I have no idea what you’re up to? Trying to set me against the world, as you wish! I’ll let you see that all your plots are merely a way to help me. I’ll eventually use your blood of desire to wash away my name as a c*ckold. No, this is not enough! I want to suppress the Heavenly Concubine, the Maya, Dragon Queen Regnant, and the Vermilion Bird.
Black-Hearted Old Demon: Yu Fei is such a j*rk. Does she really think that she can do as she desires based on the inheritance of the Saint Demon Lord? This time, I’ll make you the manure of the Abyss. The Great Demon Venerate is getting mightier, and his plot is at a critical point. We must take action before the auction. Oh, my Abyss, let’s rise to the top of the infinite realms. Let’s transform the infinite realms into demonic domains, and we’ll rule over the infinite realms. Our demonic rule, the heavenly rules!
After Jiang Ming read through these Statuses, he had a strange look.
‘It’s unfortunate that I have neither seen the Great Heavenly Venerate nor knew his name to check on him.’ Jiang Ming pondered, ‘In this case, the Heaven Court is indeed in a crisis.’
He shook his head and shifted his focus away. As per his words, he only wanted to mind his own business.
He did not have much sense of belonging in the Tianyuan Realm. He only cared for a few, let alone the infinite realms and the Heavenly Court.
Moreover, as a cultivator himself, he had a better understanding of the world’s nature, hence enlightened. He would protect the Tianyuan Realm whenever possible, but he would be indifferent toward the rest.
“Senior Brother, Riyue Changfeng has many visitors, but why were you the only one he invited into his palace?” Phoenix Junior Sister hugged his arm as she said cheekily, “Is it because there’s an affair between you two?”
“Did I not feed you enough?” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. “You’re way too free, aren’t you?”
“Of course not. What about feeding me more?” A burning flame appeared on top of the Phoenix Junior Sister as she said, “Furthermore, I only eat eggs all this while. Yes, it tastes really good.”
“Do you want me to beat you up?” Jiang Ming took out the World Flame and threw it over as he demanded, “Cultivate properly. The Taiyi Realm is still way too low.”
“This is…” As Phoenix Junior Sister caught the sealed flame, she spent a moment feeling it attentively and was delighted at what she had gotten. “It is a fusion of Sun Fire, Extreme Yin Fire, Stellar Fire, Abyss Fire, and many others. Hence, it has transformed into the superlative World Flame. If I take it in, my bloodline will be transfigured to the stage whereby I can manipulate thousands of types of fire and become the Fire Monarch. Once the main body breaks through to the Great Overarching Realm, I can break through too in an instant. In fact, even the Quasi-Sage Realm would be a piece of cake.”
“By that time, achieving the Great Dao will not be far away!”
“Senior Brother, are you sure that this is mine?” Phoenix Junior Sister was excited.
“Of course it is!”
“Oh, Senior Brother, I love you so much! I think I must bear you a child.”
“Now, go cultivate!” Jiang Ming grabbed and threw her into the Immortal Medicinal Field rather harshly.
Following that, he lay on the rattan chair, chillaxing.
Meanwhile, he distributed part of his consciousness into the chat group.
[Jiang Ming: Ao Jiu, Di Huo, are you two around?]
[Ao Jiu: Yes. Got an estimated price already? I think at least it’s a three-fold, right?]
[Di Huo: Yes!]
[Jiang Ming: You’ve been underestimating my ability as a Group Admin, haven’t you? They are all estimated to be equivalent to five times of low-grade Quasi-Sage Weapons, worth 2,500 points. Do you want to trade?]
They were supposed to be 10 times, but he as the Group Admin shall charge a handling fee. Moreover, he was already kind enough to pay an amount five times higher than the original market price.
[Ao Jiu: 2,500? Yes, I’m all in for that!]
[Di Huo: That’s unexpected. Count me in too!]
[Jiang Ming: If you all can get me Demi-Sage Weapons or Holy Dao items, name your price!]
[Ao Jiu: Group Admin, in my clan, we only have one Demi-Sage Weapon. If I get it for you, my great monarch will definitely kill me.]
[Di Huo: I’d say weakly that I want one too.]
[Ao Jiu: Huo, you should do this. Make an orchid finger gesture and say: B”tch, I want it too.]
[Feng Wu: Pfft, I spat out a mouthful of 30,000-year-old blood.]
[Ao Jiu: Ms. Feng Wu, I thought you’d spit out a mouthful of 30,000-year-old phlegm!]
[Feng Wu: You are so disgusting.]
[Huang Quan: I spat out a mouthful of 30 millions-year-old corpse water!]
[Feng Wu: Yuck! Why are you out to disgust people!]
[Ao Jiu: Huang Quan, you should do this. You should tilt your chin as you purse and scorn: I spat out a mouthful of 30 millions-year-old urine.]
[Di Huo: Damn it, this is too disgusting!]
[Ming Fei: Group Admin, block him, all of them.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Block all of them.]
[Hong Zhan: I was eating a Quasi-Sage Abyssal Demon Fish when I saw your messages, and I spewed. Looking at this dish perfectly cooked and filled with boundless natural vital essence, I… I… Ao Jiu, I want to eat you.”
[Ao Jiu: Roar! The former Group Admin has finally suppressed his anger and shows himself. Congratulations. You are in a great state of mind and will have a promising future.]

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - Crazy, All Have Gone Insane(Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Crazy, All Have Gone Insane(Part 2)
??
[Hong Zhan: Ao Jiu, you are on my list!]
[Ao Jiu: I shuddered…hehe…do you think I’m afraid of you?]
[Hong Zhan: I’m from the Sea of Chaos and in my clan we have about 10 Saints.]
[Ao Jiu: Bro, brother, no, you’re my own brother from now onwards!]
[Hong Zhan: …]
[Di Huo: Ao Jiu: I’m shivering in fear. I wanted to kneel down begging for forgiveness. Can’t…can’t I just dance in women’s clothing? Hong Zhan sits on his strong horse, holding a golden blade: Yes you may. But if you can transform into a woman and have sex with me for 30 millions years, I’ll forget all these nonsense of yours.]
[Feng Wu: I can’t control myself from laughing.]
[Ming Fei: I’m laughing out loud so much that I’m almost misunderstood as insane.]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha, I’m sorry that I’ve held back in difficulty. If I wasn’t in a prayer meeting, I’d laugh out loud 3,000 times.]
[Huang Quan: Ao Jiu: I’m wiggling my butt to transform into a woman and wear women’s clothing.]
[Hong Zhan: Sigh, frankly I’ve just recollected myself from the refusal to defeat and restlessness. I even wanted to utilize my clan’s ability to kill Group Admin Jiang.]
[Hong Zhan: But I know that I won’t be able to kill him!]
[Hong Zhan: Based on his battle strength and sky-defying comprehension, and now his connection with the director of the Infinite Realm Auction House, he’ll definitely soar to the heavens and shine in all the world. Hence, what can I do?]
[Hong Zhan: Since we cannot be enemies, then we’ll just be friends.]
[Hong Zhan: Sigh, my road to invincibility has actually ended far earlier than expected.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, if we’re to meet again one day, I’d like to have a match with you. I’ll go back on the road to invincibility if I win. Else, I’ll have no regrets.]
[Ao Jiu: Who’d ever think that an arrogant man like you would be humble!]
[Hong Zhan: I’m not a kid after all.]
[Wang Ye: Taoist Hong Zhan, you said that you can find the Group Admin but can’t kill him. We as the members have got two privileges, namely time acceleration, and sermon listening. Hence, I assume that a Group Admin has other privileges that prevent you from killing him, right?]
[Hong Zhan:The Buddha said it’s a secret!]
[Tian Fozi: I didn’t say anything. Please don’t slander.]
[Hong Zhan: You’ll know when you become a Group Admin. In fact, I was so mad, utterly mad when I lost the position as the Group Admin. It’s like I could sanctify Dao and become a Saint with the position, but only a Quasi-Sage if without.]
[Ao Jiu: What, a Group Admin actually has such a great encounter? I’m jealous.]
[Wang Ye: I’m jealous too!]
[Hong Yi: Do we have the opportunity to be a Group Admin as well? I thought of the possibility of surpassing Hong Zhan by comprehending the 3,000 laws, merging them with the Dao of Civilization to reverse my physique and forge a Civilized Dao Body before comprehending peerless laws. But now with Jiang Ming around, it seems that I’ve lost the chance!]
[Wang Ye: I didn’t have any thought before this. But since Hong Zhan told us about the privilege of the Group Admin that’s akin to the immortal body, I’ve gone nuts.]
[Tian Fozi: The Buddha is enraged! Shall we discuss how we can kill the Group Admin and take turns to become a Group Admin?]
[Jiang Ming: Ahem, please don’t forget that I’m still around! Be careful that I can use the authority as a Group Admin to block you from speaking in the group and snatch away your Supreme Order.]
[Tian Fozi: What the f*ck, Group Admin can snatch our Supreme Order away?]
[Ao Jiu: I don’t think so!]
[Wang Ye: No, I don’t think so. Otherwise, the Group Admin would be too powerful.]
[Hong Zhan: No worries, the privileges of the Group Admin are only good for the Group Admin himself, in addition to the ban from speaking. Brother Jiang, can you tell me when you will break through to the Great Overarching Realm? If it’s short, I’ll wait for the time to retake the position. By that time, I think I’d have gathered enough points!]
[Jiang Ming: I understood what you meant but I can’t promise. I can only say that I’m only about 40 years old in reality other than the time accelerated.]
[Hong Zhan: …]
[Ao Jiu: …]
[Huang Quan:...]
[Feng Wu: What the f*ck! It turns out that our Group Admin is a young man. I’m drooling. Group Admin, come into my embrace so that I can taste you well.]
[Hong Yi: You’re only 40 years old? Are you kidding me?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’ve just checked the brother group admin’s achievement. He’s passed level 4 of the seventh Battle Tower, step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder and his cultivation base is at level 14.]
[Tian Fozi: …]
[Tian Fozi: I almost cursed! Amitabha, I’m seriously sinned!]
[Ao Jiu: The seventh Battle Tower? That’s corresponding to the level 17 Quasi-Sage Realm! A Golden Immortal fight against a Quasi-Sage and won four times? There are two levels named Taiyi and Great Overarching in between…it’s impossible even one’s talent is sky-defying, isn’t it? By the way, how long has it been since the Group Admin entered our group? Two years?]
[Huang Quan: Do you know what it means by step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder? It’s the spiritual will of a Quasi-Sage, and not a Demi-Sage’s. Oh my, how can a Golden Immortal have such terrific battle capability and the spiritual will? Am I the one who got crazy or it’s the entire world that has gone nuts?]
[Di Huo: I’ve gone crazy! I’ve the Three-legged Golden Crow bloodline, and such a bloodline is very noble among demon clans. With great fortune and a strong background, I’ve cultivated for almost 100 years now but the Group Admin…he…I’m speechless!]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, I laugh out loud, and insanely. In that case, I may still have the opportunity to retake the encounter that I’ve lost earlier. Group Admin, you’re amazing, too amazing. Now that the faster you grow, the happier I’d be. I’m so happy that I wanted to dance. Haha…based on such a growing speed, I think you’ll step into the Great Overarching Realm in ten thousand years. By that time, I will be able to retake the position as the Group Admin. Aww…I feel like crying.]
[Hong Zhan: Group Admin, I think because your battle capability has been raised to the extreme, you’d need to raise your level next. Tell me, what do you need? I’ll provide you at cost price!]
[Hong Zhan: Oh, you’re cultivating on World Dao, do you want World Hearts, Chaos Vital Essence, long river of innate vital essence and great amount of innate spiritual roots?]
Jiang Ming was dumbfounded. He had not expected that the lofty Hong Zhan could be so funny after he overcame his emotion. He also felt that Hong Zhan somewhat became a flatterer as soon as he knew about Jiang Ming’s age and Battle Towers’s result.
Nevertheless, he could understand Hong Zhan’s act. The privilege of spending 10,000 points to save your life once would be nothing to Hong Zhan, who had a strong background. However, he was obviously coveted for the opportunity to cultivate in Hongmeng Primordial Land that cost half a million.
Such an encounter must be extraordinarily sky-defying, particularly when it made even Hong Zhan go crazy and had thought of killing him.
‘World Hearts, Chaos Vital Essence, long river of innate vital essence and great amount of innate spiritual roots?’ Jiang Ming yearned for them. When he saw the Chaotic Tree’s seedling he hadn’t put in his inner world, his eyes brightened exponentially.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - The Beginning of Jiang Ming’s Suffering, The Change (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: The Beginning of Jiang Ming’s Suffering, The Change (Part 1)
Jiang Ming was agitated. Only the middle chiliocosm’s heart itself was extremely helpful. He had fused one into his inner world, and the strengthening of the foundation, and the laws of self operation had been accelerated by at least 10,000-times.
If he would have another dozen of middle chiliocosm’s hearts, he was confident that his inner world would evolve into the middle chiliocosm in 100 years. By that time, he would be strong enough to live according to his will.
[Jiang Ming: I need all these middle chiliocosm’s World Hearts, Chaos Vital Essence, long river of innate vital essence and great amount of innate spiritual roots. Based on my achievement, I think you can estimate the points that I have. Hence, I’m capable of paying for all these things. I’m just afraid that you don’t have enough stuff for me to buy.]
[Hong Zhan: I roughly calculated and you have at least 20 millions points. Damn, a nobleman like me, can’t even control myself from cursing. I’ve been striving hard just to accumulate 500,000 points. I even gave up the chance to listen to the sermons, yet I still can’t accumulate enough. But you…I…I have the urge to curse further.]
[Huang Quan: F*ck the bones! 20 millions points, oh my goodness. I check my accumulated points, and there’s only 80 points left. I…I…f*ck it. I’m speechless and have gone nuts. Group Admin, please do accept me as your servant!]
[Tian Fozi: Amita jeez! You’re indeed a Group Admin! From now onwards, you’re my Lord Buddha.]
[Ao Jiu: Traitor! By the way, if I were to betray my dragon clan, would you accept me?]
[Di Huo: Unfortunately, this chat group allows only members of the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm and below. It would be better if it is until Quasi-Sage Realm! Group Admin, I’ll assist you in dominating the Chaos when you go over in the future!]
[Hong Zhan: I can only hahaha.]
[Di Huo: Based on our Group Admin’s potential, is it hopeless? Anyway, I don’t believe that it is!]
[Hong Zhan: Let’s just talk about it only when you get to the Sea of Chaos. Group Admin, I can now sell you a Middle Chiliocosm World Heart and a long river of innate vital essence. I’ll slowly prepare for the rest.]
[Jiang Ming: Sure! How much is the completeness of the Middle Chiliocosm World Heart? How much is it? What about the long river of innate vital essence?]
[Hong Zhan: It’s not that complete, only one percent. I’ll sell it at the fixed price of 20,000 points. It’s not that expensive. Do you want it?]
[Jiang Ming: It’s indeed not that expensive. Yes, I want!]
From the Middle Chiliocosm World Heart Jiang Ming received earlier from Riyue Changfeng, its completeness was only 0.001 percent but it cost five pieces of Quasi-Sage Weapons, which must be sourced from different worlds.
Five pieces of normal Quasi-Sage Weapons cost only 2,500 points and this World Heart’s completeness was 1 percent, hence the cost should be 10 times more expensive, or 25,000 points.
Yet Hong Zhan requested for only 20,000 points, 5,000 points lower than the cost. Hence, Jiang Ming thought that Hong Zhan was an interesting guy. He did not care about Hong Zhan’s words to kill him, provided no action was taken. After all, he had many people aiming to kill him.
[Hong Zhan: Great! This long river of innate vital essence of mine is a lot cheaper. It’s a lot lower than the cost of a Quasi-Sage Weapon so I’ll give it to you as a gift.]
[Jiang Ming: Thanks! I have more than enough points. Contact me anytime whenever you have something good to trade!]
[Hong Zhan: Sure!]
The two quickly did the transaction through the authentication of the Supreme Order.
[Ao Jiu: Transacting the Middle Chiliocosm World Heart with 20,000 points, and this is called trading. By the way, can a Middle Chiliocosm World Heart really be of 1 percent in completeness?]
[Hong Zhan: Yes! It’s even possible to be up to 10 percent. Unfortunately, the backfire of Dao by doing so would be too terrific to endure, even by the Saints.]
[Hong Zhan: In fact, the world is considered the favorite of Dao in infinite realms. Under the revolving great Dao and Chaos Laws, even the planar worlds are being protected. Talking about the planar world, why do I feel rather uncomfortable?]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang himself comes from the planar world and he overwhelmingly becomes the Group Admin.]
[Hong Zhan: And Hong Yi too, coming from the planar world. I was worrying that he might replace me.]
[Hong Zhan: Is the human race in the planar worlds so blessed?]
[Ao Jiu: The human race is both weak and strong at the same time. They have a weak bloodline but they continuously create various miracles, hence their potential is boundless. Clans like my Dragon Clan and the Three-legged Golden Crow, we have strong bloodlines and we’re even born immortal spirits, but we’re greatly limited by our bloodlines. Without any sky-defying encounters, we’d never be stronger than our ancestors. Meanwhile, the human clan continuously breaks records of their ancestors one after another. I’m indeed filled with admiration.]
[Ao Jiu: Brother Hong Zhan, you mentioned that the worlds are favored by Dao. I’d like to add that the human race is favored by the world, and even more so of the great Dao. Look around, most races in the world stay in human form. And this explains my statement.]
[Hong Zhan: This topic is unexplainable.]
[Jiang Ming: Bronther Hong, do you have any Holy Dao Vessels?]
[Hong Zhan: Yes, but I haven’t had any privilege to use them yet. Unless you can give me the exact period of time you would break through to the Great Overarching Realm. Then, I may have the transaction with you before your breakthrough.]
[Jiang Ming: Holy Dao Vessels should be nothing for you right? Why would you be limited so much?]
[Hong Zhan: Holy Dao Vessels are refined by Saints. They are immortal and the representatives of heaven and earth in great chiliocosms. Hence, the saying that all existences beneath the Saint Realm are nothing but peasants is not nonsense. Even in the Sea of Chaos, the Saints do have supreme position. Therefore, whenever the Holy Dao Vessels, the carrier of enlightenment, and Holy Weapons have no owner, it mostly means that their owner has died.]

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - The Beginning of Jiang Ming’s Suffering, The Change (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: The Beginning of Jiang Ming’s Suffering, The Change (Part 2)
[Wang Ye: Even the Saints would die?]
[Hong Zhan: Even the great chiliocosm is timed, what’s more the Saints? The reason they can’t be killed is because no one is stronger than they are.]
[Wang Ye: Strength is still above all!]
[Hong Zhan: This is the nature of Dao, the source of Chaos and the root of tragedy. To a certain extent, strength is the order, but also the sin and chaos.]
All members of the chat group agreed upon Hong Zhan’s statement.
Jiang Ming left part of his consciousness in the chat group to calculate the points he had to pay while learning some new knowledge such as the mortality of Saints.
Most of his consciousness, however, had returned to his body.
He took out the sealed long river of innate vital essence. It was indeed only about 100 meters long and 10 meters wide. For a while he took a look at it, he simply threw it and sealed it into the immortal medicinal garden, so that it became the immortal medicine’s manure.
The presence of innate spiritual qi accelerated immortal medicine’s growing speed.
Jiang Ming then shifted his focus onto Mo Xiaoyu who was cultivating in a corner. Because he had transformed her body into Innate Daoist Body a few months ago, her cultivating speed had greatly accelerated.
With her transformed physique and supreme cultivating method in addition to the accessibility to various training facilities, she would be a good-for-nothing person if she couldn’t grow up.
However, Jiang Ming believed that Xiayu would have a bright future because of her patient personality.
“Xi Yao…” Jiang Ming muttered as he took out a crystal. It was the Extreme Yin Origin Essence Ye Qingxian had collected on his behalf. It was the Origin Essence of an Extreme Yin Stellar that belonged to a great chiliocosm, hence a very precious crystal.
In fact, Jiang Ming had collected many precious items other than this crystal he had just taken out.
‘She’s selected to cultivate the Dao of Extreme Yin. It’d help her cultivate better after she fuses with it.’
Jiang Ming threw it over and into her body. Then, he also thoroughly scanned through her body.
‘Her physique is too weak but she’s curved indeed.’
Jiang Ming did so out of concern, not because he was ill-intentioned.
Following that, he shifted his focus to Jiaoyang Peak.
There were more female disciples than ever. Everyone of them was exquisite, physically alluring and each of their moves were captivating.
They were indeed seductive.
Jiang Ming blinked and saw his master and his master’s wife were living in harmony, cheerful, and relaxing. He thought for a while and eventually decided not to disturb them.
His master merely wanted Jiang Ming and his Junior Sister to grow stronger and that Jiuyang Sect to grow bigger. Other than that, he wanted to become an immortal, which was an easy task.
‘My master would be safe with my presence. I’ll plan for him whenever he wants to start cultivating!’ Jiang Ming laughed.
With a wave, two streams of light flew speedily away, one into Chang Yiming’s body while the other into Senior Sister Momo’s.
‘That’s a pity that Senior Brother Zhang is no longer around!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh as he recalled about that gentle head disciple.
He died too early.
Jiang Ming suppressed the various thoughts from running through his mind, and had his consciousness into his inner world.
The Chaotic Tree’s seedling that he obtained from a trade, was suspended in the air, vibrating and struggling as though it sensed nature, wanting to immediately root on the earth to absorb nutrients and grow.
‘Although it’s just a seedling, it is too top graded. It’d be an alien species if I were to put it in my inner world. Hence, I wonder if it can be assimilated by my inner world and be my spiritual root.’
Jiang Ming was not confident. Therefore, to play safe, he took out a drop of blood essence and fused it into his inner world so that it’d drop on a leaf of the seedling. However, the leaf slightly shook, and the drop of blood essence fell off.
He squinted his eyes as he had his power of soul flown into the seedling. Immediately after that, he discovered that there wasn’t any imprint of other living things in it and he felt empty and lost when he thought about refining it.
He mobilized the power of his inner world as a support but his efforts to refine it were in vain.
Forceful refinement failed as well.
‘Is it because of the 3,000 laws that the Chaotic Tree had, had formed a complete structure, and formed a perfect loop that I’m not qualified to refine it yet? Or is it because of the great Dao’s limitations, preventing it from having an owner?’ Jiang Ming was confused.
The Chaotic Tree’s seedling had spirituality but had no soul.
After Jiang Ming pondered for a while, he put the Chaotic Tree’s seedling into the Human Path Record.
Jiang Ming did not want it to grow in his inner world if he couldn’t refine it.
When Jiang Ming fed in his immortal power, to his surprise, he managed to refine it through the Human Path Record. However, the process was very slow.
‘Slow? No worries!’
In the three-meter radius area surrounding Jiang Ming’s clone, who sat cross-legged in the midair, the time flow was accelerated. At the same time, he mobilized the power of his inner world to support him in refining the seedling speedily.
Yet, he still needed a very long time to completely refine the seedling.
When he took out from the Human Path Record, he felt the intimacy he had with the seedling instantly. It was as though the seedling was his clone, and he managed to learn about it further.
‘In it has the imprints of 3,000 laws. And more 3,000 laws would be derived along its growth until it matured. The reason why I couldn’t refine it was because the grade of its imprints is far higher than my cultivation base! I’m afraid that even Riyue Changfeng doesn’t know about it. After all, this seedling is extraordinarily rare, so much so that it has no detailed reports. Luckily I have the Human Path Record. Otherwise, if I were to let it grow in here just like that, it might take over my inner world instead.’
Jiang Ming felt fear only after he learned more about the seedling itself.
The Chaotic Tree’s seedling turned into a stream of light and rooted itself in the center of the inner world. The moment it rooted, tiny root hairs grew instantaneously deep into the soil, until the inner world’s origin and landed on the Middle Chiliocosm World Heart, which was fusing continuously.
Buzz…
The next moment, following a tremor of the World Heart, the endless nature and boundless life within, were gobbled up by the seedling. It was as though a man in an arid desert had got himself a bottle of spring water.
‘The World Heart is the best manure for the Chaotic Tree’s seedling!’ Jiang Ming was aware of it as he felt the seedling’s happiness simultaneously.
It wasn’t long that the seedling produced a new leaf. It was dazzling, filled with vitality and nature. In return, it gave Jiang Ming a wisp of peculiar power, strengthening the nature of his soul just like that. Even his physical body was strengthened. Not only that, his inner world had a slight change as it was slightly evolved towards the middle chiliocosm.
‘I didn’t know that it had such a benefit!’ Jiang Ming was greatly surprised. At the same time, he was confused, wondering why Riyue Changfeng didn’t realize it.
‘I think it was because he didn’t refine it.’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh out loud as he thought of it.
‘It’s indeed a sky-defyingly great encounter!’
Jiang Ming then looked at the Middle Chiliocosm World Heart and discovered that 10 percent of it had been consumed. This finding rendered him rather speechless.
Was it akin to the World Heart, in which its completeness was merely 0.001 percent, could only nurture a leaf? No, because the inner world had to absorb part of it as well.
Jiang Ming took out the World Heart with 1 percent completeness and wondered, ‘Would this one produce 100 leaves?’
‘A Chaotic Tree needs to have 3,000 leaves at its juvenile stage. I-I…I wonder how many World Hearts I’d need to achieve that?’
The excitement was followed by a headache.
‘Well, I think I shall stop dwelling in it any further. Let’s just do it slowly!’
After some struggles, Jiang Ming threw the second Middle Chiliocosm World Heart into the origin of the inner world and had his consciousness returned to himself.
On the balcony of Chuyang Peak.
He rose to his feet and looked outside.
Blood and evil aura filled the heaven and the catastrophe was imminent. The change was imminent.
“Senior Brother, I feel something is not right, and it inexplicably gives me the heebie-jeebies!” Phoenix Junior Sister went to his side, hugged his arm and frowned, “I was awoken by the sense of the imminent catastrophe while fusing the world fire. The sense disappeared quickly after that. Very strange, isn’t it?”
“That feeling of heebie-jeebies is the misconception you have because of you sensing the changes outside yet it’s safe here.” Jiang Ming laughed, “The abyss is going to start taking actions. Soon there will be a great fireworks of all time.’
“Really?” The eyes of Phoenix Junior Sister brightened, “Since there’s such a great view, we shouldn’t miss this opportunity, should we? Come on, let’s welcome the beautiful scenery with the most primal enthusiasm!”
“Are you not afraid that you’d wreck the earth?” Jiang Ming curled his lips.
His Junior Sister was too naughty.
“I’m actually trying to fertilize the land. Come on!” Flame had surged around Junior Sister and burned her clothes as she said, “Spring water will ooze out of me and you shall offer your milk so that we can mix it into ‘milk tea’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - Felling Heaven, Sky-Defying Boundary Breaking
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Felling Heaven, Sky-Defying Boundary Breaking
Above the Auction House...
Riyue Changfeng walked out and stood on it, while his hands behind his back. His sleeves fluttered along with the wind.
‘It’s about to start! I wonder whether the Heavenly Emperor is capable of seeing through the Great Demon Venerate’s plot?’
‘It’s quite difficult! The current situation appears as though the abyss is launching its attack continuously at the heavenly realm but the heaven realm is actually besieged and suppressed.’
‘It’s obvious that the reasons why the Great Demon Concubine attacking infinite realms are to obstruct the Great Demon Venerate and to collect blood essence and souls by hunting down living things to refine Holy Blood Pill. Nevertheless, there are subordinates of the Great Demon Venerate in the Great Demon Concubine’s team. They have been laying out the sky-defying Boundary Breaking Formation in every world they conquered.’
‘Anyway, to sit in that position, the Heavenly Emperor must be absolutely extraordinary.’
‘Oh, it’s about to start! It’s gonna be a great show! And I wonder who’d be the winner?’
Riyue Changfeng sat cross-legged as two tea tables appeared before him. He prepared lots of immortal fruits, brewed a pot of tea before he filled a cup for himself and gestured towards the Tianyuan World.
…
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming who was brewing ‘milk tea’ with his Phoenix Junior Sister suddenly looked towards the direction of Tianyuan Sea.
“What’s it?” Phoenix Junior Sister whimpered hoarsely.
“That fella is inviting me to watch a great show!” Jiang Ming was huffing and puffing with pauses in between.
There were gentle and pleasant sounds, mixed with intermittent low murmurs. It was like insects chirping, like a long whistle.
It was the most pleasant music that was played at dawn.
But at that moment, a wailing sound was suddenly heard. It sounded like awe, like grief, and like the satisfaction after the ultimate sublimation, and finally converged into an awe symbol.
It was also at this moment that the aura of the Phoenix Junior Sister abruptly surged and behind her a pair of phoenix wings appeared. The wings were huge and its flames were raging.
The flame had transcended the Phoenix Fire. The blazing flame contained boundless life, and within the destruction laid a vast creation, intertwining life and death, lurking in the opening and the end.
“I actually had a breakthrough during the sublimation of my soul!” Phoenix Junior Sister shouted for joy.
“This explained that the original body had a breakthrough, perhaps earlier than expected. Hence, you managed to have a breakthrough under my nourishment!” Jiang Ming was ecstatic too, “That’s great!”
“Senior Brother, since I’ve got a breakthrough, shall we have another round to celebrate?”
Pat!
“Nah, go consolation your cultivation base!”
Jiang Ming slapped her and threw her into the immortal medicinal garden.
“You’re such a scumbag! Throw me away soon after you use me!” Phoenix Junior Sister said with grief.
The corner of Jiang Ming’s mouth had a jerk. But he sighed in his heart, ‘It’s still the Junior Sister herself who’s cute. All these clones are alluring women indeed’
Jiang Ming had a stretch and paced into midair of the courtyard.
“What’s happening?” Mountain Master Tianyuan immediately opened his eyes, paced in the midair and asked.
“The Great Demon Venerate was about to launch a guerilla attack against the Heaven Court.” As Jiang Ming said, he took out a stone tablet he got from Ao Jiu and handed over, “There’s a Holy Law on it. Please take care of the Tianyuan World while comprehending it.”
“Holy Law?” The Mountain Master Tianyuan looked at the stone tablet and probed it with his consciousness. In an instant, he sensed a surge of sword qi that would slash a soul, causing him to shudder as he was shocked. Then, he was ecstatic, “What a terrific Sword Smbodha!”
He made a pause as he recollected himself before he asked, “Brother, what do you mean by the guerilla attack of the Great Demon Venerate?”
“The abyss has been plotting for millions and millions of years, but it is not supposed to be launched at this time.
