It’s because of the stupid Great Demon Concubine who provided a golden opportunity for the Great Demon Venerate.” Jiang Ming explained, “You may take a look because the Heaven Court may be destroyedand new history would be made this time around.”
“Is the abyss that strong? It shouldn’t be right?” Mountain Master Tianyuan frowned, “It’s supposed to have only nine venerates and six of them are killed one after another. How can the abyss be strong enough to launch a guerilla attack against the Heaven Court? Even if the abyss may have some other unknown to the public, the number wouldn’t be high, would it? After all, it’s difficult for a venerate to hide themselves. Therefore, I’ve always thought that the abyss is merely venting their emotion with omittable fights.”
“You’ve been looking down upon him!” Jiang Ming didn’t explain further but said, “I’m going for an appointment at the Tianyuan Sea. So please take care of the Tianyuan World while I’m away to prevent some rascals and thieves from entering.”
In fact, he could control the entire Tianyuan World in a thought. But because he did not want others to know, he had to take some misleading actions.
After all, there were many spies from various realms even though the Tianyuan Realm remained closed.
Nevertheless, whoever came in was killed and all evidence was destroyed in a prevention of information leaking.
The Mountain Master Tian Yuan was confused as he was looking at the back of Jiang Ming, who was leaving.
‘How can brother Jiang find out about the Great Demon Venerate when he’s just arrived at this Infinite Realm Battlefield not long ago?’
‘It’s not surprising that the Great Demon Venerate is hiding something but how did he find out something that even I myself didn’t know?’
‘What else does the abyss have that allows it to attack the Heaven Court? Can it be that the abyss is cooperating with the Lord Buddha and others? It shouldn’t be. After all, they can trust the Heaven Court better than the abyss because they are the beneficiaries of the Heaven Court.’
‘The support of Brother Jiang…’
He shook his head to stop dwelling further on his thoughts.
The Mountain Master Tianyuan then dispersed his consciousness, covering all parts of Tianyuan World. Strangely, he could probe into all areas except a few areas of Chuyang Peak.
…
Jiang Ming was pacing in the air above the sea and landed on the opposite side of Riyue Changfeng. Then, he directly sat down, took up the cup of tea which Riyue Changfeng had just poured for him, and had a sip. “You know to enjoy life indeed. I’m afraid that this tea is of the top grade spiritual root, right?”
“Bingo!” Riyue Changfeng smiled, “This is the Misty Nine Heavens Tea, which I got from a great chiliocosm. Then I used my contribution points in exchange for this tea.”
“Is it up for a trade?” Jiang Ming laughed as he asked.
Riyue Changfeng startled for a moment before he quickly shook his head, “This is one of a few hobbies I have, don’t think about it!”
“It’s just a tea tree, isn’t it?” Jiang Ming said, “It’s 15 days before the auction, are you not anxious?”
“With you as my most important customer, why should I? It’s better that I watch this great show. Of course, the auction is going on as planned. Anyway, Brother Jiang, have you seen through this imminent disaster?”
“It’s just about the Great Demon Venerate utilizing the Great Demon Concubine in misleading the world while having his plan laid to the point that it has now formed a great momentum against the Heaven Court. Am I correct?”
“Yes!” Riyue Changfeng was astounded, “I can find out because I’ve got a pair of unique divine eyes and a unique item which can map out the world. Moreover, because I don’t believe that the Great Demon Venerate is stupid, I particularly paid attention to find out. On the other hand, you can actually learn about the entire situation by just living in the mountains. I’m really admiring your greatness, Brother Jiang.”
Jiang Ming laughed without explanation. Instead he said, “Brother Riyue, who do you think would win this fight?”
“I’m still not siding with the abyss.”
“Why?”
“How can a Heavenly Emperor, who overrules the heavens, be defeated easily?”
“It’s reasonable indeed. Let’s just see how it turns out then!”
The two continued enjoying their tea.
As Riyue Changfeng pointed his finger, a mirror that was rapidly enlarging and was suspended in his front left. Numerous red dots appeared on it and they were enlarging at great speed. Each dot turned out to be a little world.
“These nine middle chiliocosms and 81 small chiliocosms are selected as the points of thesky-defying Boundary Breaking Formation. Each point will absorb the world’s origin to activate the formation, and when the formation has been fully activated, all the worlds will explode to give an ultimate blow.” Riyue Changfeng exclaimed, “Such an effort is indeed shocking because the ultimate blow may not be withstandable even by the Saint Lord. The single blow would badly beat up the Saint Body, if severe it may lead to death.”
“So many worlds that they are sacrificing?” Jiang Ming was shocked.
The Human Path Record did not give such detailed information. It only stated that the Great Demon Venerate was setting up formation points in many worlds to attack the Heaven Court. Hence, he did not think that many worlds would be sacrificed!
This was so amazing that even he admired the Great Demon Venerate’s deeds.
“Yes, that’s for sure!” Riyue Changfeng nodded.
“Can he survive the backfire of destroying so many worlds?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“You know only part of the story.” Riyue Changfeng smiled as he explained, “This war is akin to the abyss spending all its resources. They have mobilized as many demon soldiers, and experts they can, and fight with their abyss as the carrier. Hence, they fight for the sake oftheir luck, their standpoint and their rules. Even though the backfire is terrific as even Saint Lords may not survive through it. However, because they have the abyss as the carrier and the after effects are dispersed on millions and millions of demon soldiers, numerous Devil Generals, Devil Lords, Devil Kings, Devil Emperors and even the Demon Venerates. Correspondingly, the after effects have been greatly reduced. But…”
He made a pause and solemnly continued, “If the abyss were to fail, they would lose their luck in an instant. Under the after effects, at least more than half of the living things in the abyss would die. And the abyss won’t be rising anymore. Therefore, the Great Demon Venerate is gambling, taking the future of the abyss, himself and the millions and millions of demons in the abyss as security.”
“If he were to win, he would be able to rule over the universe, or at least a world.”
“If he were to fail, not only he can’t sanctify Dao, he would face difficulties to survive.”
“Hence, this is unrestrained gambling!”
Riyue Changfeng explained very clearly.
“Does luck really exist?” Jiang Ming lifted up his head as he asked.
“It’s so mysterious, even I myself aren’t sure about it yet!” Riyue Changfeng replied, “For example, it’s the degree of you being loved by heaven and earth. If you are hated by heaven and earth as well as the great Dao, you’d suffer from qi deviation and die by just drinking water; if you are loved, you’ll be blessed in everything you do.”
“This example is…” Jiang Ming shook his head as he laughed, and did not dwell on it any further.
At this moment, many red dots in the mirror had light pillars shot out simultaneously.
“It’s started!” Riyue Changfeng could not help but rose to his feet.
“It’s started!” Jiang Ming said solemnly.
Once the abyss started to launch its attack against heaven, it was a catastrophe to all.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - The Falling of Heaven Court, The Sky-Defying Means of Lord Buddha
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: The Falling of Heaven Court, The Sky-Defying Means of Lord Buddha
Above Nine Heavens in Honggu Heavenly Realm was where the Heaven Court was located.
It was in the boundless universe. It could suppress millions of stars, rule over the sun and the moon, overlook heavens and dominate infinite realms. In short, it was on top of Honggu Heavenly Realm.
It was where moguls were, and where ordinary cultivators aspire to be and, of course, where the world’s treasures were most abundant.
The Heaven Court was akin to a world with 50 thousands households. It had four gates, leading to four different directions: the East, South, West and North. Each gate had an emperor as the governor. For example, the North Gate used to have the Northern Emperor Kunpeng as its governor.
There was also the fifth gate which was governed by the Heavenly Emperor himself. It was said to be a legend because it had never been opened before. Nevertheless, it was said that the fifth gate was very mysterious because it could connect to any part of the world.
Deep inside the Heaven Court, the Great Heavenly Venerate was sitting while enjoying his tea. Standing beside him was Star Lord Taibai.
“Have you got everything arranged nicely?” The Great Heavenly Venerate put down his cup of tea and asked.
“Yes!” Star Lord Taibai lowered his head and replied. And he asked, “Your majesty, I wonder why you not only transfer back the Sky Demon Army after the death of the Northern Emperor Kunpeng, but also the Water Army, Buddha Army and other legions over, and particularly let them stay near to the four gates of Heaven Court? Does your majesty really think that the Great Demon Venerate can make its way to the Heaven Court? Your servant can’t believe it actually.”
“How many legions does my Heaven Court have?” The Great Heaven Venerate didn’t answer but gave a rhetorical question instead.
“Your majesty, we have a total of 128 legions,” Star Lord Taibai answered directly without much thought, “Twenty-four of them are special legions in which the four emperors lead six legions each. At the same time, they are distributed to various forces throughout the heavenly realm to maintain the balance, to reveal the might of Heaven Court and to rein the world.”
“Twenty-four Guarding Legions protecting the Heaven Court. They are the best among the best.”
“Twenty-four Heavenly Punishment Legions are to fight on all sides to maintain order. They have all been transferred back now.”
“Twenty-four Ordinary Legions mainly are to train the heavenly soldiers and at the same time assist the Guarding Legions. They are the fundamental of Heavenly Warriors. Each legion has billions of members, and all of them have returned to their positions.”
“There are also 24 legions guarding the universe. They are to schedule the stars, maintain the warp and weft, and monitor all small and medium chiliocosms to prevent unforeseen events.”
“The last eight legions are known as the War God Legions and they are the pillar of the Heaven Court. Each legion is led by a Venerable Immortal. They don’t usually go on missions but when they do, they only kill.”
Star Lord Taibai told everything he knew.
“How many of them are loyal to me?”
“Your majesty, this?” Cold sweat broke out on the forehead of Star Lord Taibai.
“You are a coward indeed!” The Great Heavenly Venerate laughed, “There aren’t many. In the last hundred million years, I’ve been ruling by doing nothing and acting in a low profile. However, the Fo Sect, Dragon Clan, Demon Holy Palace, Taishang Sword Sect and etc, have been placing spies in the Heaven Court. Ha, I just don’t want to care.”
“However, the four gates each have a legion, which is loyal to me. And none dares to do anything there!”
“All the 24 Guarding Legions should be loyal to me but in these years, 12 of them no longer are and one even is controlled by the Great Demon Venerate!”
“All the Ordinary Legions have lost their loyalty.”
“The 24 legions guarding the universe still remained in my control.”
“Sixteen out of 24 Heavenly Punishment Legions are not loyal”
“Two Venerable Immortals of the eight War God Legions are in league with others.”
As the Great Heavenly Venerate was enumerating, he remained smiling.
“Your majesty, t-this…” Sweat broke out on the forehead of Star Lord Taibai as he was shivering.
No one knew whether he was scared or because he felt uneasy upon hearing such a sensitive topic.
“I can’t blame them for not being loyal. After all, most of them join the Heaven Court for power, cultivation resources, supreme laws etc. Hence, it’s common that they’d diverge their loyalty when they are offered with better stuff.” The Great Heavenly Venerate shifted his focus on Star Lord Taibai and his smiling face was replaced with solemnity, “But you, Taibai, I do take good care of you right? Why?”
“Your majesty…” The face of Star Lord Taibai suddenly turned pale as he startled for quite a while before he smiled wryly.
The sweat no longer broke out on his forehead, and he stopped shivering.
“Your majesty, you actually knew it.” Star Lord Taibai sighed, “It shouldn’t be!”
“Ya, it shouldn’t be!” The Great Heavenly Venerate rose to his feet, lifted his head and looked through the Heaven Court, into the vast and extensive universe, “You were originally a Star God birthed on the Star of Tai Bai, and I discovered you back then when I was secretly running my forces in the universe. At that time, you were only at Golden Immortal Realm. Seeing that you are a natal star ruler, and that there is no great karma as I deduced from the past, I took you with me. You were good and resourceful, so I used you to my advantage until now!”
“You were dedicated, sincere, very hardworking and attentive, always looking out for me and keeping many things in order.”
“If it weren’t because of two incidents that made me feel something was wrong, I wouldn’t check on you and discover your story!”
“It’s so unexpected that the Lord Buddha has been plotting against me a long time ago!”
The Great Heavenly Venerate exclaimed with hints of admiration.
“Two incidents!” The Star Lord Taibai sighed, “One was when your majesty just took over the Cloud Palace, you wanted to attack the Fo Sect, and the Lord Buddha declare publicly on their willingness to make obeisance to Heaven Court; the second was about the position of Western Emperor was taken by the Future Buddha.”
“Yes, it’s these two incidents!” The Great Heavenly Venerate nodded, “At that time, other than the Heaven Court, all other sects were very influential, but not as much as the Fo Sect. I was about to attack and suppress Fo Sect when the Lord Buddha came to make obeisance by declaring it publicly. This left me with no reason to attack. Obviously, he learned about it through someone serving me. I didn’t think it was you until I filtered out the others in my investigations. Oh ya, at that time there was a man who knew the insights was dead innocently, and all clues led to him. Unfortunately, I investigated in detail and suspected that you were the culprit. I was just unsure about it!”
Star Lord Taibai chimed in, “I actually didn’t realize about your suspicion. You’re indeed Your majesty, even just now I didn’t know that you already knew. The second incident was about the competition to become the Western Gate’s emperor. I played tricks. Otherwise, with you having scruples about the Fo Sect, how’d you allow the position of Great Emperor be given to the Fo Sect!”
“Exactly, this is the incident whereby I validated my suspicion.” The Great Heavenly Venerate said, “After that I gradually dissected and understood what had happened through detailed investigation about the past. While I was secretly running my forces in the universe, I fought with an expert in the depths of the starry sky and were neck and neck although I hadn’t met him in person. I later learned that he’s the Lord Buddha.”
“He learned about me and speculated about my ambition. Moreover, he knew I would go around recruiting men, hence he secretly laid you as a pawn in his game.”
“If I’m not wrong, you’re originally a disciple of the Fo Sect but you are transformed into the Star Lord by the Lord Buddha who performed the method of substation with great power.”
“Am I right?”
The final phrase he said in the affirmative tone.
“That’s right!” Star Lord Taibai admitted, “I used to be a named disciple of the Lord Buddha. Then, my soul was taken to fuse with the star spirit nurtured by the Star of Taibai, and because of Karma Law, my soul was sealed deep into the real soul and I can recover my memory only when I’m being probed. I’m arranged beside Your Majesty because the Lord Buddha sensed that the previous Heavenly Emperor was unpopular and would be overthrown sooner or later. Meanwhile, Your Majesty is a strong contender, hence, the Lord Buddha went ahead and placed me beside Your Majesty. I was also told to be loyal all the time and do nothing extra unless the matter is about the future of Fo Sect.”
“Your Majesty, I don’t understand why would you reveal my identity only now?” Star lord Taibai asked.
“I think you should have known.” The Great Heavenly Venerate said, “You should have sent out the information about my plan right?”
He smiled.
The Star Lord Taibai startled for a moment before he came into realization. Then, he said with surprise, “The message I sent out was that Your Majesty is deeply troubled and worried, hence transferring back many legions and personally doing the planning and arranging the defense. It’s as though Your Majesty is afraid of the Great Demon Venerate’s plot. N-Now…”
“Have you seen through the Great Demon Venerate’s plot?”
“Did you reveal my identity to have a thorough clean-up in Heaven Court?”
“No, in that case, there’s no need to reveal my identity.”
“Then y-you…”
“At the same time you do the clean-up, you plan to…”
Star Lord Taibai’s pupils shrunk into the size of a needle but before he could finish his sentence, the palm of the Great Heavenly Venerate was already on his head.
The supreme power in addition to the authority of Heavenly Emperor, and in the depth of the Heaven Court, rendering the Star Lord Taibai, who was at the early stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm, no resistant ability to the suppression.
Of course, Star Lord Taibai didn’t really resist because he knew he couldn’t.
After a while, the Star Lord Taibai remained standing beside, stupefied. However, his aura remained vaast.
Not long after that, the Great Heavenly Venerate took the Star Lord Taibai along with him and stepped up into the air, and reached the highest point of the Heaven Court. Then, he exclaimed, “No way, the Great Demon Venerate has sacrificed many middle chiliocosms, sending a world-destroying blow to destroy the Heaven Court. Ladies and gentlemen, it’s time for us to defend ourselves. Follow me to activate the Heaven Court Formation, manipulate the authority and start defending!”
As soon as he finished speaking, above him appeared an emperor’s crown and in his hand a Heavenly Emperor Sword. As he wielded it in midair, the entire Heaven Court seemed to have come alive with formations, inscriptions and palaces emanating supreme energies.
Even stars in the universe were shining brightly and the billions of stellar light fell upon the Heaven Court, further reinforcing it.
It was also at this moment that the Heaven Court was in chaos.
It was immediately followed by a light pillar stove through the void, and fell on the Heaven Court. Glaring rays of light burst out, and turned into boundless inscriptions which enveloped the Heaven Court.
Following that, the power capable of terminating an era exploded, destroying all things.
As a result, 3,000 layers of stellar lights went off, 48,000 rays of defensive immortal lights disappeared, palaces collapsed one after another, the legion mainly made up of the Fo Sect’s disciples and the legion mainly made up of the Dragon clan’s dragons were annihilated, among others.
Meanwhile, the Great Heavenly Venerate was witnessing indifferently, not even a trace of warmth could be seen in his eyes.
Nor did he continue in defending the Heaven Court.
With a sudden flicker in his eyes, the Star Lord Taibai beside him roared, “Great Demon Venerate, how dare you sacrifice so many worlds to evoke the world-destroying blow? Are you not afraid of receiving heaven’s punishment? Have you asked me before you plot against His Majesty and destroy the Heaven Court?”
“The power of stars, come into me!”
As soon as he finished his command, his body suddenly lengthened to a height of 100,000 feet. He was standing on the Heaven Court while his head reached the universe.
The duster in his hand recovered, and he evoked the supreme special ability that stove through the destructive light. At the same time, his figure also appeared in the eyes of many peeping experts, but then he was hit by a pillar of light, died on the spot.
“My Star Lord!” The Great Heavenly Venerate let out a cry of sorrow, “Sky Demon, f*ck you!”
His roar turned into thunder and rolled through the heavenly realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - Entombing Heavens, Demon Slaying Order, Tai Yuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Entombing Heavens, Demon Slaying Order, Tai Yuan
Above the Tianyuan Sea...
Both Jiang Ming and Riyue Changfeng lifted their heads simultaneously. They opened up their divine eyes, which penetrated through the void to see the situation in the Heavenly Realm. However, immediately after the explosion of destructive energy, they could no longer see anything. It was too strong and distorted the sense.
Jiang Ming retrieved his sight and said, “The war has thoroughly started!”
“It’s a war of catastrophe!” Riyue Changfeng took up his cup of tea and swayed. “The result would be out soon.”
“I thought such a war would last a long time?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“No! Whether it is the Abyss or the Heavenly Emperor, both are well prepared. Once they started the war, it’d be the most fierceful and intense war they could afford because they are going all in to finish it in one blow. If they were to fall into a seesaw battle, it would not be good for both parties!” Riyue Changfeng speculated, “As the Abyss is gambling, it’ll surely give a thunderous strike as fast as possible. The Heavenly Emperor too, is afraid of dragging time because he won’t want to give the Lord Buddha any chance to overthrow him.”
“It’s logical indeed!” Jiang Ming nodded. In fact, he too had the same thoughts.
While the two were enjoying their tea, they also were feeling the waves transmitted over through the void one after another. These were waves transmitted through Heavenly Realm and boundless torrents of void. This showed how terrific the war was.
As they lifted up their heads and evoked their divine eyes to watch again, they saw the spreading destructive storm, the falling of many ancient stars, so much so that even both the Extreme Yin Stellar and Sun Stellar were vibrating as though they were about to be destroyed.
This was too horrifying.
The next moment, both of them were surprised.
It was because the two saw a scene as the destructive power that rolled out and swept through the Heavenly Realm was gradually faded away.
The Heaven Court hidden in the boundless universe, was revealed. Numerous palaces were rapidly collapsing and scattering. Some scattered parts were directly absorbed by the void vortex while others fell into unknown places.
The Heaven Court which had ruled over the heavens for billions of years, the representative of the most powerful and the highest authority, had collapsed just like that.
Above the Heaven Court was a giant with his height up to a million feet. He seemed like carrying the sky above his head, stepping on the earth and he was surrounded by a boundless divine aura and chains of orders.
Behind his back were messy teams of heavenly armies.
“Heavenly Emperor?” Jiang Ming abruptly rose to his feet.
“Yes, he’s!” Riyue Changfeng nodded and then frowned, “The Heaven Court collapsed with just a blow? Difficult to resist? I don’t think so!”
“It indeed shouldn’t be!” Even Jiang Ming was in confusion too.
Based on his speculation, the Heavenly Emperor should be able to resist at least an exchange even if he couldn’t see through the Great Demon Venerate’s plot.
After all, the Heavenly Emperor had been managing the Heaven Court for so many millions of years. Hence, there should be numerous hidden experts, and great amounts of fortunes accumulated. Moreover, with the authority of heaven and earth in hands that the Heavenly Emperor could manipulate, how could he be dealt with easily?
Yet based on the situation that they saw, it clearly was that the Heavenly Emperor was taken aback by surprise. Even the Heaven Court was collapsing and many Heavenly Soldiers were killed.
Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Record and quickly flipped the page to the Great Heavenly Venerate’s.
fJiang Ming did not read it immediately but took a glance at Riyue Changfeng beside him, and checked out about him simultaneously instead.
He didn’t find anything odd, hence he was at ease.
Before he could check out any further, he heard the roaring sound of the Heavenly Emperor transferred to infinite realms, saying, “Sky Demon, how dare you sacrifice so many small and middle chiliocosms for power. This is indeed a heinous sin against conscience and god! You kill my servant Star Lord Taibai, Western Emperor Future Buddha, Eastern Emperor Dragon Venerate, Southern Emperor Taishang Venerable Immortal and more than half of my heavenly armies. You collapse the Heaven Court, destroy orders and let infinite realms into chaos.”
“Sky Demon, you’ll definitely be punished by heaven!”
“My Heaven Court controls the stars, runs the warp and woof, rules the heavens, administers laws and orders so that heavens and infinite realms may operate in order under all laws, and all spirits may enjoy stability and order.”
“I even lay the Great Astral Formation to ensure the peace of infinite realms.”
“But you, Sky Demon, the Great Demon Venerate, the ruler of the Abyss, actually leads your armies to invade so many worlds. How many spirits have you massacred and how many worlds have you destroyed so that you can collect enough blood and souls for your demonic pills? This are utterly heartless acts!”
“Sky Demon, these numerous worlds you sacrificed, you transformed into energy through the formation array. And the energy erupted not only destroyed the Great Astral Formation, but also collapsed the Heaven Court. You even wanted the Heavenly Realm to be destroyed so that your Abyss will be the only one ruler, chaos be the order, slaughter a norm, and all spirits beyond redemption.”
“Sky Demon, I’m willing to do whatever it takes today so that you’ll be dead and your Abyss thoroughly destroyed!”
“To all cultivators in infinite realms, listen!”
“This ordeal induced by the demons is a matter of everyone’s safety, a matter of your life and death, and even a matter of heavenly justice. Therefore, I, the Heavenly Emperor, decree that the slaying of demons by all races and spirits is a great merit!”
“The decree would remain until demons have gone extinct!”
“I’ll add this demon slaying order into the orders of heaven and earth. In this way, you’ll receive luck, blessing and favor by slaughtering demons!”
The Heavenly Emperor evoked supreme power to summon laws and orders to turn the Imperial Order into a statute and strike it into the rules of heaven and earth.
“Tai Yuan, how dare you!” The Great Demon Venerate roaring voice was heard from the depth of time and space.
Behind him were four Demon Venerates following after. Among them was the Black-Hearted Old Demon.
The other three were rather unfamiliar but some older experts recognized them as the ancestor beings in the Abyss almost in an instant.
Because they had not shown up for billions of years, they were thought to have gone to Chaos.
Their sudden reappearance obviously proved the Abyss’s intention in making the three the Abyss’s secret supporters.
Now that the final war would determine the future of the Abyss, and even more so about themselves, they had to step out.
As for the Great Demon Concubine? The Great Demon Venerate had no idea about her whereabouts.
The Great Demon Venerate held the Demon Saber in his hand while black mists ejected out from his head diffused out, filling an area.
The awe-inspiring power made even the heaven and earth tremble.
What was more terrifying was that he was trampling dozens of virtual worlds. Each and every one of them was burning with extreme intensity, and transformed into destructive power.
“Tai Yuan, how dare you decree such a demon slaying order! Damn it!” The Great Demon Venerate was unable to keep his calmness.
He knew the meaning of such an Imperial Order. It meant that demons would be disgusted by heaven and earth and slaughtered by all beings and spirits.
Hence, even if the Abyss were to win the war, they would have endless troubles and the Abyss would be antagonized.
“Damn it?” The Great Heavenly Venerate had an even grimmer expression, “You shouldn’t have gone against heaven, and you should not have sent troops to thousands of worlds and sacrificed many of them. Do you know how many billions of innocent people have died under your selfish act? This is billions of living things, how could you do it! I shall curse you in the name of the Heavenly Emperor that you will never ever sanctify Dao!”
In the void, thunder seemed to have roared as the power of fate befell on the Great Demon Venerate. His face darkened again, and he had gone wild utterly, “Tian Yuan, how dare you curse me? Well, well, well, I’ll behead you, and destroy your Heaven Court today. The curse would dissipate along with you losing your authority, and the highest position!”
“Returning infinite realms into ruins, and entombing heavens!”
As the Great Demon Venerate roared, the virtual worlds beneath his feet suddenly exploded, and turned into boundless torrents rushing through the voids and towards the Heaven Court, submerging its remnants.
The many worlds he had sacrificed, had scattered, leaving only some pieces behind that were taken away by endless void.
As for the living things in them? Only the curse of unwillingness were left.
“Entombing heaven? What an unblushing exaggeration!” The Great Heavenly Venerate snorted, and as he wielded the Heavenly Emperor Sword in his hand, numerous Imperial Orders appeared before him. All had yellowish light emitted, which evoked the power of authority and orders, and the power of Heaven Court’s support, bursting forth millions and billions of dazzling lights.
Boom.
Along with the explosion of lights, the entire Heavenly Realm had been distorted, blocking the view of Jiang Ming and the rest.
“Is it resistable?” Jiang Ming muttered.
“Difficult, very difficult!” Riyue Changfeng shook his head, “The Great Demon Venerate manipulated the power of the great formation to burn many worlds into ashes and transform the energy released into the ultimate blow. The blow’s power was beyond imagination. The Heavenly Emperor is after all, not a saint, hence his ability to evoke the authority of heaven and earth is limited. But…”
“But what?”
“Something is wrong, not only the Heavenly Emperor, but also the Heaven Court!”
“What do you mean?”
“The Heaven Court here, other than having the Great Heavenly Venerate sitting in the middle of heaven, overlooking all directions, there are four royal positions to assist the control of Heaven Court! Other than the Northern Emperor who died earlier, the other three are in the Heaven Court. Yet they are all killed in the defending just now. Moreover, wasn’t the Star Lord Taibai committing suicide by directly confronting the destructive light pillar of the Great Demon Venerate? He was as though trying to protect the dignity of the Heaven Court and the Heavenly Emperor, but did he not see that the light pillar was terrific? And more than half of the legions died!”
“When you say that, it really doesn’t sound right!” Jiang Ming thought. Even the Great Demon Venerate did not reveal his team of 12 old venerates.
He then shifted his focus on the Human Path Record. The information stated on it made him shudder.

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - The Heavenly Emperor Startling Jiang Ming With His Plan (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: The Heavenly Emperor Startling Jiang Ming With His Plan (1)
??
Even though it had only been a short time since the rebellion of the Abyss, it had affected many parts of the universe.
Even the Fo Sect, which refused to take part in the war, was affected as well. Many of their Great Monarchs, temples, and affiliated families were destroyed.
Right now, there were a lot of people watching.
When the Heavenly Court shattered and began to fall, many of the Great Monarchs were shocked and filled with fear.
All of them were waiting for an outcome for the war between the Great Demon Venerate and the Great Heavenly Venerate.
Most of them hoped that the Heavenly Court would appear victorious in the end. After all, the Heavenly Court represented justice and order. If the Abyss managed to defeat the Heavenly Court, chaos would prevail. Other than a few ambitious personnels, most of them hoped that the Abyss would fail.
However, when they saw the last attack that the Great Demon Venerate unleashed, they were filled with despair.
It was too strong. So strong that even a powerful being like the Buddha Lord couldn’t help himself and shouted inwardly, ‘If this hit me, I’d be dead in no time!’
A bright light erupted and nobody could see how the Heavenly Emperor was going to intercept the attack.
Whoosh!
Jiang Ming flipped the Human Paths Record open.
Name: Tai Yuan (The Heavenly Emperor, the Great Heavenly Venerate, One of the three great clones).
Race: Innate Saint Spirit.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation Base: Quasi-Sage.
Background: The Heavenly Emperor of the Honggu Heavenly Realm’s Heavenly Court, the Great Heavenly Venerate.
Relationship: 45.
Innate Talent: Holy Dao.
Status: In ancient times, not long after the separation of heaven and earth, there were 365 celestial stars that contained a large amount of power within the universe and Taiyin and Taiyang were two of them.
Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, Taiyang, Taiyin, Taishu, Taiyuan were known as the Seven Stars. Taiyang and Taiyin were destined to glow and influence the universe due to the law, so they couldn’t have any sentience. They would eventually be turned into the sun and the moon.
Taiyi and the other four celestial stars developed sentience one after another. They became the lord of the stars and roamed about freely. They watched as the middle and small chiliocosms as well as the planar worlds formed one after another .They also watched as the Innate Saint Spirits appeared in the Heavenly Realm and began to kill each other.
One day, several powerful Chaos Beasts from other universes came. Since the evolution process hadn’t completed and the worldly membrane was not formed, they successfully invaded the universe.
Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, Taishu, and Taiyuan led the other star spirits to fight against the Chaos Beasts.
It was a gruesome fight
Many spirit stars died. Taichu, Taishi, and Taishu fell one after another, while Taiyi was severely injured. Taiyuan was left with only a remnant of his soul, and in the end, he finally was able to kill all of the Chaos Beasts
The remains of the Chaos Beasts and the broken remnants of the ancient star cores, under the operation of the heavenly rules, transformed into billions of stars, forming the starry sky of the heavenly realm.
After Taiyi had regained his strength, he fed on the sun and the moon. Using the crowd of stars as the foundation, he formed a nourishing formation and began recuperating.
Time passed rapidly and the Infinite Realm Auction House arrived with the way to sanctify Dao to fight for the first saint in the universe. Taiyi died in the battle, and he transferred all his power to Taiyuan.
Taiyuan went into hiding for cultivation.
After receiving the power of the sun, moon, and star as well as the remaining powers of his brethren, his cultivation speed increased leap and bound. After the saint had left, he finally came out.
Taiyuan was ambitious. After inheriting Taiyi’s will as well as his responsibility as the star lord, he decided to pull the former Heavenly Emperor down from his throne. In the meantime, he took in the powerful beings that worked under Taiyi before he died as well as other ancient star lords under his wings.
After forming a foundation, he hid all his men and provided them with unlimited supplies of resources. He brought them to the border of the universe for them to cultivate.
While he was traveling across the star, he came across an Innate Spirit that appeared out of nowhere. He tried to take the Innate Spirit down but to no avail. The Innate Spirit got away in the end, and he only knew that it was the Buddha Lord afterward.
Time flowed past rapidly and he noticed Taibai Star had developed its own sentience. He took him under his wings and named him Star Lord Taibai. After Taiyuan became the Heavenly Emperor, he wanted the Fo Sect to submit to him. When the Western Emperor was making a decision and the Future Buddha came into power, he realized something was wrong. He sent Star Lord Taibai to investigate, and then he found that it was the Buddha Lord’s plan all along. While the Abyss was rebelling against the Heavenly Realm, he took him down.
After some secret plotting, the former Heavenly Emperor lost support and was killed by the Buddha, the former Great Demon Venerate, the Dragon Lord, the Phoenix Lord, and him.
The former Great Demon Venerate was betrayed and slain by the Buddha Lord and the others. The Phoenix Lord sustained severe injuries and died in the end.
Taiyuan successfully deterred everyone with his might and ascended to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor.
After a long period of time managing the Heavenly Court, he finally created a more powerful Heavenly Court. Nobody dared to go against him. At least, not on the surface.
He had reached the maximum of his cultivation and he couldn’t make any progress, so he went around to look for the Sage Venerates Dao Square and Holy Law. He had destroyed countless “Sacred Land” and gotten a myriad of special abilities, yet he still couldn’t sanctify his Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - The Heavenly Emperor Startling Jiang Ming With His Plan (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: The Heavenly Emperor Startling Jiang Ming With His Plan (2) Translation
He wished to travel to the Chaos and looked for the legendary Chaos Sea as well. He did go to the Chaos by telling everyone that he was going to cultivate in seclusion, but he was nearly killed by the raging Chaos Force. After he came back, he decided to put the plan of venturing into the Chaos on hold.
He wanted to gain absolute control over the universe and became the true emperor in order to sanctify his Dao. Therefore, he started to look for gold everywhere, forge the stellar banner, and form the Great Astral Formation. While he was strengthening the defense of the Honggu World, he had gained supremacy over the entire universe.
Unfortunately, the Abyss refused his governance. As such, he began to formulate a plan to force them to submit to him or to get destroyed by him. It was not an easy task, but the last time he lacked was time. In the meantime, he also tried to look into the real situation in the Abyss.
He chuckled in derision when he learned that the Great Demon Venerate had made 12 ancient venerates his subordinates. After all, even though all 12 ancient venerates were powerful, they were nothing to him. He also found it ridiculous when the Great Demon Venerate went into hiding so that he could overturn the Heavenly Court and became the Great Heavenly Venerate himself.
After all, he was the star lord, the heavenly emperor. There was nothing in this universe that could escape his eyes.
He lifted his eyebrows in amusement when he found out that the sky demon possessed a Holy Weapon. After all, with the power of the Holy Power, there was a possibility that the Great Demon Venerate would succeed in overturning the Heavenly Court. However, after he thought for a while, he decided to give what the Great Demon Venerate wanted. It was just that he still needed a chance.
However, when the chance came, he hesitated.
A planar world was destroyed and its core was pulled toward the Infinite Realm Battlefield. The reason was that the treasure of the former Heavenly Court might be hidden inside.
‘Treasure? What kind of treasure is it? And this human named Jiang Ming is able to kill the Northern Emperor and two Demon Venerate?’ The Heavenly Emperor was shocked.
‘Who is he? How can he be so powerful? Hold on a second. He isn’t even in the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, but even if he cultivates the World Dao, he shouldn’t be that strong!’
He found it hard to believe that someone as powerful as Jiang Ming would appear in a mortal world. There was no way the treasure of the former Heavenly Court could support the growth of someone at his caliber. Not only that, but his special abilities were powerful, and he could detonate Great Overarching Dao Vessels with one of his special abilities.
He was certain that Jiang Ming must’ve gotten something in secret. Could it be the legacy of the legendary Chaos Sea? Or was he a beneficiary from the Lord God or the Reincarnation Hall? Or did he receive a legacy from a Saint Lord?
If not, there was no way he could develop his World Dao to this extent and there was no way he could master such a powerful special ability.
Regardless, he had given him a chance.
Since he was carrying a great secret, he decided to use him as a driving force to put his plan into action.
He nominated Jiang Ming as the next Northern Emperor. He was going to give Jiang Ming 100 years to prove himself, while in the meantime, allow the Buddha, the dragons, the demons, and the humans to fight for the title.
When the Infinite Realm Auction House arrived, he was delighted. He was confident that the Great Demon Venerate would panic if he had already come out of his seclusion. After all, the Heavenly Emperor was the wealthiest person since he governed the Heavenly Court. When the auction started, he would be able to gain a massive amount of good items.
Initially, he planned to seize the auction house as his own, but after a deliberate consideration, he decided to forgo the thought. After all, those ancient beings might step in if he were to do something to the Infinite Realm Auction House.
He was shocked when he realized someone had punctured the abyss and killed three Demon Venerates with his special ability that he developed himself.
He wondered if it was Riyue Changfeng, the manager of the Infinite Realm Auction House who did it. After all, no one could do something like that except him. However, when he gave it a second thought, he felt it might not be Riyue Changfeng. After all, he did not have to do that at all. It was Jiang Ming. He was mysterious, and he might have obtained some supreme power that allowed him to have access to all sorts of special abilities .
The Great Demon Venerate had already come out of his seclusion.
After all, several Demon Venerates had died and the Abyss had been punctured. As the king of the Abyss, there was no way he could sit still and not do anything. He had been planning for hundreds of millions of years, and it was time to put his plan into motion.
Just as the Heavenly Emperor expected, the Great Demon Venerate had started to rebel against the Heavenly Court.
However, he was stunned when he realized that other than attacking the Heavenly Court, the troops from the Abyss were invading into other worlds as well, and he was certain that this was not the doing of the Great Demon Venerate.
Just like what he thought, it was the doing of the Great Demon Concubine. He felt it was really a bad move for the Great Demon Venerate to keep the Great Demon Concubine, whose brain was filled with nothing but lust, by his side.
‘Oh Great Demon Venerate, you’re really such a fool. You think you can beat me in a game of mind? You think everything would develop as you wish just because you’ve been planning with care all along? You’re wrong! It’s exactly because you’re too careful that you’ve lost your ruthlessness and boldness as a demon. If you initiate a frontal attack against me, it might give me some trouble, but now, you’re going to take advantage of the Great Demon Concubine and make the universe into the eye of your formation to obtain great power to crush the Heavenly Court and kill me. Honestly, it’s a great move, but unfortunately, you’re destined to be defeated by me!
The war lasted for a year, and the Heavenly Emperor knew the Great Demon Venerate was going to make his move as the auction was about to begin.
As such, he was going to order Star Lord Taibai to call the troops back to defend the Heavenly Court, for he thought that the Great Demon Venerate might attack the Heavenly Court out of desperation. In the meantime, he also summoned the other three emperors back to the Heavenly Court, and he was going to kill all of them when the Great Demon Venerate made his move.
He decided to kill all of the troops that had been infiltrated, and he was going to send one of his clones to his death.
‘Hah! This time, I’m going to cleanse the Heavenly Court. At the same time, I’m going to fake my death and go into hiding. After the Buddha Lord comes out and kills the Great Demon Venerate as well as destroying the Abyss, I’ll lure the other to fight for the position of the Heavenly Emperor. Then, I’ll find a chance and kill all of them.
The Heavenly Emperor was shocked when he realized the Future Buddha was still alive. Later, he found out that the Future Buddha used his troop as his shield to block against the attack.
‘You want to live? No way! I’ll kill you first! Eastern Emperor? Where do you think you’re going? You’re not going to get out of here alive! And Star Lord Taibai, well, he has been a loyal subordinate for me for many years, so I can’t let him live either.’
The Heavenly Court was falling.
‘The attack has slowed down, and now is my chance. The Great Demon Venerate, I’m going to make you the target of everyone and nail you to the pillar of shame! The world will fall into chaos at the Demon Slaying Order. The curse of the clone will make you lose your mind. Well, this is what I want things to turn out as well. When my clone is dead and the curse is lifted, you’ll think I’m really dead! Haha!
‘Hmm? You still refuse to ask help from the 12 ancient venerates? Is it because you’re worried about something? I won’t let you have your way! Even if I can’t kill you today, I must clip your wings so that the Buddha Lord and the others could eliminate you!
‘Is this the final round of attack? Then, it’s time for me to bring out the full might of the Heavenly Court.’
He felt a little bit sad at the falling of the Heavenly Court, but he thought this was necessary in his plan. After all, new things wouldn’t come if old things didn’t go away. After he had gotten rid of everyone, he could have absolute control over the universe. When that happened, he was certain that he could sanctify his Dao.
He was willing to give up everything in order to sanctify his Dao.
After he had blocked the Great Demon Venerate’s attack, it was time for him to retaliate.
He was going to unleash everything he had at the Great Demon Venerate. He wanted him as well as the others to know the might of the Heavenly Emperor.
After Jiang Ming had finished reading his status, he felt a chill down his spine.
He did not believe that the Heavenly Emperor in front of them was just a clone. Not only did he see through the Great Demon Venerate’s plan, but he went along with his plan and deceived everyone by allowing the Heavenly Court to fall.
‘As expected of the Heavenly Emperor!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - The Mind of the Great Demon Venerate Collapses, Unleashes All His Trump Cards
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: The Mind of the Great Demon Venerate Collapses, Unleashes All His Trump Cards
‘Relationship 45? It isn’t low. At least, he doesn’t bear any hatred against me,’ Jiang Ming thought inwardly.
However, he was certain that the Heavenly Emperor must have had some plans for him.
After all, if the Heavenly Emperor was given a chance, he would want to take Jiang Ming under his wings. If Jiang Ming refused to submit to him, he would get rid of him right away. Jiang Ming felt there was nothing wrong with the Heavenly Emperor’s decision. He also wanted to get rid of him if he had the chance.
After all, there could only be one alpha on a mountain.
Of course, regardless of being in bed or trying to spread his influence, Jiang Ming was rather inactive compared to the Heavenly Emperor.
“This guy has three clones, and nobody, including Star Lord Taibai, realizes it?” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
He was certain that the one who became the Heavenly Emperor was the real deal. It was just that he was replaced by a clone at some point.
He had no idea how the Heavenly Emperor created his clones as well. All of them were as powerful as the real deal. Besides, he did not know where the other two clones were too.
“I guess I should stay away from this Heavenly Emperor for the time being.”
Jiang Ming had regarded the Heavenly Emperor as the most dangerous person inwardly.
What was even more frightening was that the Heavenly Emperor was the lord of the stars. He was already there when the sky was separated from the ground. In other words, he had already amassed a massive amount of experience throughout the years. Besides, he also had received the legacies of his fallen brethren, and he even was able to absorb energy from the sun and the moon.
Of course, this was not the most terrifying aspect about him. His most terrifying ability was his ability to see through the Great Demon Venerate’s plan. Not only did he see through the Great Demon Venerate’s plan, but he also went along with his plan and destroyed the Heavenly Court as well as a clone in order to achieve his goal.
Nobody wanted someone like him as their enemy, including Jiang Ming. Once he became his enemy, he would need to get rid of him as soon as possible. Otherwise, things would go really bad.
“His ultimate goal is to take down the Great Demon Venerate, the Buddha Lord, and the Dragon Lord in one fell swoop. He’s going to release their energy and absorb it for his own use. After that, he would form the perfect Great Astral Formation and became the lord of multi-universe. At that time, he would be able to sanctify his Dao! The Demon Slaying Order will throw the Abyss into a turmoil. The fall of the Heavenly Court will eliminate all of those who’re against him. Even though this is a move that will bring more damage to himself than to his enemy, the Heavenly Emperor doesn’t care about it. He won’t deliver the final strike to the Great Demon Venerate, but he’ll do everything he can to make sure that he won’t be able to get back on his feet anymore, and there’s one last step before his plan is done!”
A myriad of thoughts flitted across Jiang Ming’s head.
The sky was cloudless and the wind continued to blow.
Riyue Changfeng grabbed something in the air and a cup fell into his palm. He swirled the cup in his hand and emptied the tea in one sitting. With a flick of his mind, a stream emerged from the teapot, creating an arc in the air before falling into the cup.
“Judging from the situation, the Heavenly Court and the Heavenly Emperor have lost,” Riyue Changfeng said. However, he kept his eyebrows in a confused frown as he continued, “But this is strange.”
“Yeah, it’s indeed strange!” Jiang Ming chimed in. There was a frown on his forehead as well. ” The Heavenly Court has been governing the universe for so many years, and the Heavenly Emperor is as powerful as a Saint Lord. By right, he should be able to fend them off easily, but why does it seem to me that he’s rather… How should I put it… Weak? Not only that, but the Western Emperor, the Southern Emperor, and the Eastern Emperor are all dead. Nearly half of his troops were wiped out as well. This is really strange.”
“It seems to me that this is part of the Heavenly Emperor’s plan. Could it be that he’s trying to eliminate all of his enemies through the Great Demon Venerate’s hands?” Riyue Changfeng said after a short while of contemplation. “Is he not afraid that his plan would backfire? If I can see through his plan, it means other experts can as well. Is he not worried of inciting the rage of other experts of other forces? He’ll be completely destroyed if they all join forces with the Great Demon Venerate. There’s no way the Heavenly Emperor would be so stupid. Could it be that he still has an ace up his sleeve?”
At the end of the day, he still couldn’t see through the entire plan of the Heavenly Emperor. That being said, he was considered rather observant since he was able to deduce his plan to this extent.
“I guess so. He’s very confident in himself,” Jiang Ming replied.
“Yeah.” Riyue Changfeng frowned.
Swoosh.
Jiang Ming flipped the Human Paths Record open.
Name: Tian Mo (The Great Demon Venerate).
Status: ‘It’s starting, it’s finally starting, the Sky-defying Boundary Breaking Formation. I hope it could bring down the Heavenly Court and kill the Heavenly Emperor in one blow.
‘I don’t believe that I can’t kill him with the power of so many worlds, but why do I have a bad feeling inside of me? Could it be that Tai Yuan still has an ace up his sleeve?
‘Yes! That’s right! I’m sure he still has an ace up his sleeve, and it’s a big one! However, it won’t be something like the 12 ancient venerates that I have. After all, that kind of opportunity won’t happen a second time.
‘The Great Astral Formation has been dispelled and the Heavenly Court is falling.
‘Just as I expected, Tai Yuan hasn’t died yet, but Star Lord Taibai is dead. This is strange. Did he protect Tai Yuan? Or did he die willingly after seeing the fall of the Heavenly Court? Or is he controlled by Tai Yuan?
‘He’s here! Good riddance! What did she just say? Western Emperor, Southern Emperor, and Eastern Emperor were all in the Heavenly Court and all of them are dead. Even half of his troops have been wiped out, but he’s fine. Why do I have a feeling that this is part of his plan? Why do I have a chill down my spine?
‘I must be overthinking. Under such absolute power, everything is useless .As long as I kill Tai Yuan, the universe will be mine!
‘D*mn it! He has issued the Demon Slaying Order!
‘D*mn it, Tai Yuan! How dare you put a curse on me! If I don’t kill you, I won’t be able to sanctify my Dao. Even if I have to spend everything I have, I must take you down today!
‘This is my final attack! Prepare to die!
‘Oh gosh! He hasn’t died yet?
‘This is bad!
‘F*ck! This is what he has been hiding all along? This is bad!’
The corner of Jiang Ming’s lips quivered as he read through his status.
This Great Demon Venerate was even more stupid than he thought he was.
He was nothing but an open book for the Heavenly Emperor, but he knew nothing about him. He thought that with his formation, the Holy Weapon, and the help from the 12 ancient venerates, he could defeat the Heavenly Emperor.
However, little did he expect that he was the one who fell into the Heavenly Emperor’s trap.
‘Sigh! What a pitiful man!’
“But what is the ace that the Heavenly Emperor has been hiding up his sleeves?”
When that thought surfaced in Jiang Ming’s head, he activated his Dharma Eyes and looked toward the Heavenly Realm.
The divine mirror next to Riyue Changfeng glowed and the situation in the Heavenly Realm appeared on it.
The Sky-defying Boundary Breaking Formation that the Great Demon Venerate activated had crushed the Heavenly Court.
The entire Heavenly Realm was glowing with immortal light everywhere. Many fragments had pierced through the void and fell to an unknown location.
After so many years, the Heavenly Court finally welcomed its second destruction.
The Heavenly Emperor had shown himself as well. He looked battered and weak. He spat a mouthful of blood to the world below and looked at the person in front of him.
“Tian Mo, you still can’t kill me even though you’ve sacrificed so many worlds,” the Heavenly Emperor said, his voice cold, “If you can’t kill me, you can’t be the Heavenly Emperor. When this war has ended, you will receive your retribution due to the karma. At that time, forget about sanctifying your Dao, there won’t be a single bit of you left! And the Abyss, 90% of living objects in it will die, and from that time onward, the Abyss will become a land of death!”
There were two venerates standing behind him.
Another four were dead, and 90% of his troops had been wiped out.
The Great Demon Venerate was cruel. However, only the Heavenly Emperor and Jiang Ming knew the true situation.
“Then you should die!” The Great Demon Venerate shouted, his voice thick with manic, “At this point, do you really think you can survive, Tai Yuan?”
“You’ve underestimated me,” the Heavenly Emperor harrumphed, “Do you really think you can do whatever you want after you crushed the Heavenly Court? Tian Mo, I should show you that in my eyes, you’re nothing but a lowly demon!
“Astral Universal Destruction Formation!”
He waved his sword and the ground shook. A barrier appeared and enveloped the entire Heavenly Realm.
No one could enter or go out of the Heavenly Realm right now, but people could still see what was happening inside.
“After I became the Heavenly Emperor, I’ve been collecting many things such as the Stellar Gold and the Force of Universe. I put them all together and forge 365 Stellar Pillars and split the Heavenly Realm into 365 regions. In each region there’s a pillar buried in it, and all of them have formed into a great destructive formation!
“As the time goes by, the formation will only get stronger and stronger.
“Right now, after billions of years, once the formation starts running, even a Saint Lord comes, I have the confidence to kill them!
“Initially, I’m going to use this formation against a Saint Lord, but I didn’t expect that I would use it on you, Tian Mo.
“Unfortunately, I couldn’t activate it in time. If not, I could’ve saved the Heavenly Court from falling.”
As the Heavenly Emperor was talking, his expression changed. He lowered his head and saw one of the pillars exploded into dust.
The formation had just started running, but it was already flawed.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - The Last Order From the Heavenly Emperor, Heavenly Emperor Seal (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: The Last Order From the Heavenly Emperor, Heavenly Emperor Seal (1)
Above the Tianyuan Sea...
Whoosh!
The Human Paths Record was flipped open.
Name: Tai Yuan (The Heavenly Emperor, the Great Heavenly Venerate, one of the three clones. Note: It’s created by infusing the fusion of yang energy from the stars and the yang fire of 480 million immortal spirits into the Innate Nine-Orifice Stone Puppet.)
Status: ‘All those who’re loyal to me have been relocated, and all those who’re against me have been eliminated. It’s time for me to go all out now.
‘I need to use all of my “trump cards,” and act as if I have nothing left in my arsenal.
‘I’ll activate the Astral Universal Destruction Formation first. This formation is extremely powerful, and I’m afraid the Great Demon Venerate won’t be able to guard against it. It would be no fun to kill them all.
‘I need to destroy two pillars to reduce the power of the formation. None of them will suspect that I’m the one who did it. After all, there are too many people in this universe who want to be the Heavenly Emperor.
‘Oh my! Seems like luck is on my side! Someone noticed my formation and destroyed those pillars before I could do it! Well, this is within my expectation as well. Is it the Dragon Lord or the Buddha Lord? It doesn’t matter who it is, as all of them are going to die soon!
‘Another pillar? They’ve destroyed a total of three pillars without me knowing it! Only a few of them are capable of such a feat.
‘Well, I should let you guys have some fun first.
‘Next, I’ll have to force the Great Demon Venerate to expose all the 12 ancient venerates. At the same time, I’ll also show another trump card of him, and I guess I can kill at least half of them.
‘That trump card of mine is a group of my most loyal subordinates. It’s such a waste to send all of them to their death. However, this is needed for me to sanctify my Dao.’
‘My fate has been sealed, and this is exactly what I’ve wanted.’
Jiang Ming felt a chill down his spine after he read through the Heavenly Emperor’s status.
If it weren’t for the Human Paths Record, he would never have imagined that the Heavenly Emperor would go to such an extent just to sanctify his Dao.
If it weren’t for the Human Paths Record, he was certainly no match for Heavenly Emperor.
The Human Paths Record flipped open again.
Name: Tian Mo (The Great Demon Venerate).
Status: “D*mn it! I didn’t expect him to have something like that up his sleeve! But luckily, its power has been reduced. To be on the safe side, I’ve got to kill him as soon as possible. I should use the Blood Banner and release the 12 ancient venerates to kill him!’
Jiang Ming shook his head as he read through the Great Demon Venerate’s status.
The Great Demon Venerate could only see something in front of him, but the Heavenly Emperor was able to plan further ahead.
He lifted his head.
The wind was howling and the sky was dark.
Above the Heavenly Realm.
Although parts of the formation had been destroyed, it could still run.
“How dare you set me up! No matter who you are, I’m coming for you after I’ve killed Tian Mo!” The Heavenly Emperor roared, sending his voice far and wide into the horizon.
He absorbed the power of the formation into his body and his aura surged.
“Venerate Shan! Venerate Hai! Let’s march with me to destroy the demons and reconstruct the universe!” The Heavenly Emperor shouted as he raised his swords toward five demon venerates.
“Do you think I’ll go down just like that?” The Blood Banner appeared from Tian Mo. As soon as the Holy Weapon appeared, the void crumbled. The power of the order in the surroundings disappeared, but two demon venerates were still cut into halves by the Heavenly Emperor.
“So what if you have a Holy Weapon? I shall show you who is the lord of this universe!” The Heavenly Emperor roared confidently as a seal appeared in front of him.
It was the Heavenly Emperor Seal. It came on top of the Great Demon Venerate and exerted a strong pressure on him.
“I can’t believe that you’d use this weapon!” The Great Demon Venerate’s expression changed. He hastily activated the Blood Banner. Although it could push the Heavenly Emperor Seal away, it couldn’t break himself free from the confinement.
He turned his head around and his eyes bulged.
Black-Hearted Old Demon and the other demon venerate were being held off by Venerate Shan and Venerate Hai.
In the meantime, the Heavenly Emperor cast his attack.
One of them was the Hand of Heaven that punctured the Abyss, while another one was the Divine Hand, which was also an equally powerful special ability.
He threw both attacks toward the two demon venerates and killed them in an instant.
“Guys, it’s time to come out!”
The Great Demon Venerate knew he couldn’t hold himself back anymore. While activating the Blood Banner to push the Heavenly Emperor away, he summoned a scroll from his body and pulled it open.
The 12 ancient venerates flew out of the scroll. At the same time, the scroll expanded rapidly, reaching 100,000 miles square as an army of demons appeared on it.
There were a total of 48,000 Demon Lords, 3,000 Demon Kings, and 72 Demon Emperors. All of them were sitting on the various places in the scroll and formed into an incomparably powerful demon formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - The Last Order From the Heavenly Emperor, Heavenly Emperor Seal (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: The Last Order From the Heavenly Emperor, Heavenly Emperor Seal (2)
“Tian Mo, so this is what you’ve been hiding the whole time? There are 12 ancient venerates assisting you?” The Heavenly Emperor frowned as a worried expression crossed his face. He looked toward one of them and continued, “Venerable Chang Sheng, as one of the Innate Saint Spirit, instead of venturing into the Chaos to look for the Chaos Sea, you hide in the Abyss and assist the Great Demon Venerate to fight against me. What is your goal?”
“I owe him a favor, so I need to pay him back,” Venerable Chang Sheng said flatly.
A favor? Alright then!” The Heavenly Emperor glanced across the remaining venerates coldly and continued, “Since you’ve decided to stand against me, then you’ll need to accept the consequences. The Great Demon Venerate, although you have the help of the 12 ancient venerates, you should never take me lightly as well!
“Astral Universal Destruction Formation, activate!
“Sea of stars, great starfall!”
The Heavenly Emperor cast his special abilities and the formation suddenly gave off a bright light. Countless chains that penetrated the endless void suddenly tightened, turning into layer after layer of immense destructive power.
If his enemy was a Great Overarching Golden Immortal or a venerate, they would be killed instantly.
However, the Heavenly Emperor was going up against a dozen ancient venerates, not to mention that they were protected by a formation and they had the Great Demon Venerate on their side.
At this moment, the stars above them glowed and they began to leap one after another from the infinite sea of stars.
“In order to match the Astral Universal Destruction Formation, I’ve secretly trained 108 Great Overarching Golden Immortals. Unfortunately, I had planned to train 365 of them. Each of them will fuse with a star, and once the formation is activated, even if I don’t have the confidence I could kill a Saint Lord, I’ll be able to hold him off for a very long time!” The Heavenly Emperor said,
“However, you’ve forced me to use this trump card of mine, so you should be proud of yourself that your life will be perished under this attack!”
When the stars fell, they suddenly shrank and the sky began to crack.
“How cruel!” The Great Demon Venerate’s expression changed. All of these star gods that had fused with the stars had sacrificed themselves. Once they started falling, it meant death for them.
“Do you think I don’t have anything to fight back anymore?” He hissed and opened his mouth. A veil of black fog merged into the scroll in front of him. The demons on the scroll burst into flames and fused all their power into the scroll.
In the next second, the scroll rolled itself up and transformed into an arrow made of nothing but darkness. The arrow then leaped into the air and destroyed a falling star. The arrow continued to destroy another 99 stars before disappearing.
“Let’s go!” The Great Demon Venerate shouted as he waved the Blood Banner.
Everyone that was observing the war was stunned. However, they knew they couldn’t keep watching and do nothing anymore as even the Heavenly Realm might be destroyed by the war.
They began to activate their special abilities or weapons to protect themselves.
Above the sky, the stars continued to fall.
The Heavenly Emperor fought with all his might and gained the upper hand of the fight despite the Great Demon Venerate having a Holy Weapon.
Venerable Shan and Venerable Hai were dead.
Most of his troops were wiped out.
However, Tian Mo’s side was not in a good shape either. A Demon Venerate was dead. Black-Hearted Old Demon was seriously injured, and was taking cover at the edge of the battlefield. Amongst the 12 ancient venerates, seven were dead.
Everyone knew that the Heavenly Emperor was powerful, but none of them had expected that he would be this difficult to kill.
The stars continued to fall and crush toward the Great Demon Venerate. It was also fortunate that the power of the Astral Universal Destruction Formation was diminishing with each passing second, otherwise, even Venerable Chang Sheng would be dead by now.
“Tian Mo, if you have anything that can kill him, then you probably should use it by now! If not, all of us are going to die!” Venerable Chang Sheng shouted.
He did not expect the Heavenly Emperor to be so powerful. He was even more powerful than the previous Heavenly Emperor.
“Okay!” Tian Mo replied as he gritted his teeth. He closed his eyes and formed a connection with the origin of the Abyss. In the next second, a pure power of darkness descended and landed behind him.
“What?” The Heavenly Emperor was shocked, “I didn’t believe that you would use part of the origin of the Abyss. Once the origin is depleted, it’s going to take a lot of effort to replenish it. No matter if I win or lose this war, the Abyss is doomed!
“If I can kill you, I’ll have plenty of ways to replenish the lost origin of the Abyss.” Tian Mo’s eyes went bloodshot.
“Let’s go, Heavenly Emperor!” He shouted as he unleashed all of the power of the Blood Banner.
“D*mn it!” The Heavenly Emperor shouted, “Am I going to die today? Ever since I came to power, I have been trying my best to rule over the universe with all my effort. I’m the one who brings order to the Honggu Immortal Realm. I thought I’ve done enough for the universe, but when I’m in trouble, nobody dares to step forward and help me.
“Am I wrong?
“Or have I already lost my support? Why is no one helping me?
“Argh, forget about it! I shall give my everything and fight until the last moment!” The Heavenly Emperor shouted.
The people around wanted to help him, but they did not know how to. Some forces just looked at him with cold eyes.
“D*mn it! How dare you target my pillars? I can forgive you guys for not helping me, but how can you throw stones at me while I’m down? D*mn it! D*mn it! I shall kill all of you! “Since you all want me to die, I shall give you what you want!” The Heavenly Emperor roared, his voice thick with rage.
At this moment, his aura surged. He activated the Hand of Heaven and pushed the Blood Banner back.
“Die!”
He turned around and sliced down two venerates.
“How can he still be so strong?” The Great Demon Venerate was stunned. He decided to give it all out as he shouted, “Blood Banner!”
Upon his calling, the Blood Banner rolled around and wrapped the Heavenly Emperor in it. However, it did not hold the Heavenly Emperor for long as he soon broke out of it.
“Even if I’m going to die today, I’ll bring you down with me!” The Heavenly Emperor growled.
All of the people who were watching this war felt a chill down their spines. The might of the Heavenly Emperor had far exceeded their expectation. Even if he was not a Saint Lord, he had the power of a Saint Lord.
“If he hadn’t been caught off guard, the Great Demon Venerate would be dead now.”
That was the thought of most of the people.
“Argh! D*mn it! Why is it happening now?” The Heavenly Emperor’s pained scream rang throughout the sky.
“All those who manage to slain the Great Demon Venerate will become the Heavenly Emperor! This will be my last order as the Heavenly Emperor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - Yu Fei: He’s a Baby Carrot (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Yu Fei: He’s a Baby Carrot (1)
The Heavenly Emperor had fallen.
The wind was howling and the sky was raining blood. The universe was moaning for the fall of the Heavenly Emperor through its own way.
Some of the people were crying while the others were excited.
Above the Tianyuan Sea.
“He’s dead?!” Riyue Changfeng found it hard to believe. “This shouldn’t be happening. Even if he can’t defeat him, I’m sure he’s fully capable of running away. How can he be killed so easily?”
“It’s because of the Great Demon Venerate. I’m sure no one can survive against the destructive power after burning so many small and middle chiliocosms. Besides, many of the Heavenly Emperor’s formations have been destroyed by someone as well,” Jiang Ming said. “The Heavenly Emperor is dead, but the Great Demon Venerate won’t live for long.”
“Yeah, you’re right.” Riyue Changfeng shook his head. “The Demon Slaying Order and the Heavenly Emperor’s last order aren’t enough to drive the Demon Venerate to the corner. Unfortunately, he has exhausted the origin of the Abyss as well as his own karma by destroying so many worlds. He’s at his most vulnerable state and now is the perfect moment to kill him. Those who have always wanted to get rid of him will definitely not let go of this chance. Besides, if they can kill him, they will be able to ascend to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor too.”
“There is no victor in this war,” Jiang Ming said, “Brother Riyue, I need to go back for a while!”
Riyue Changfeng frowned and he felt confused.
‘Why is he going back at a moment like this? Could it be that…’
The Tianyuan Realm.
After Jiang Ming had come back, he masked his presence and pulled out the Human Paths Record. He wrote the Heavenly Emperor Seal on it, and his eyes glowed.
“Found it!”
The Heavenly Emperor Seal.The supreme treasure of the Honggu World. It represented the Heavenly Court and it held endless power. It was able to mobilize the origin of the universe as well.
After learning the Heavenly Emperor’s situation, he knew that the Heavenly Emperor would not let go of this treasure.
However, the Heavenly Emperor Seal had been banished into the rift of time and space, and it seemed to Jiang Ming that this was part of the Heavenly Emperor’s plan.
He could go look for it if it had fallen into the rift of time and space. As for the Heavenly Emperor Sword and the Emperor Crown, they were thrown into the depths of time and space after the last hit.
Jiang Ming formed a clone and sent it toward them through the Human Paths Record.
The void was vast. No one knew where it started or ended. There was no order or laws in this place, and if one was not careful enough, they could be killed easily even if they were a Great Overarching Golden Immortal.
After the clone had appeared, he noticed the seal that was floating ahead of him.
The one that died was just a clone of the Heavenly Emperor. In other words, this treasure still had its owner, but now…
‘Jiang Ming’ looked at the Human Paths Record beside him and cast his special ability. After he had seized the Heavenly Emperor Seal, he pulled it into the Human Paths Record.
Without wasting a second, the clone went into the Human Paths Record and returned to the original Jiang Ming.
Very soon, a figure appeared.
“The Heavenly Emperor Seal is gone?”
This was none other than the original Heavenly Emperor.
He tried to look everywhere, but he could not find it.
“I’ve left an imprintment on the Heavenly Emperor Seal, so how could it get taken away by other people? Who took it away? A Saint Lord? Or is it Riyue Changfeng?” The Heavenly Emperor frowned.
In the next second, he had lost his connection with the Heavenly Emperor Sword and the Emperor Crown as well.
“Who set me up? Or there is an ancient being who coveted these three treasures and took them away?”
The Heavenly Emperor activated his divine eyes and looked into the void. However, nothing could be found.
“You’d better not get caught by me!” The Heavenly Emperor harrumphed coldly and left in a hurry.
He needed to get the three items back. He was going back first, and then he would look for them through a secret method.
“Well, this is what you get for winding the entire world around your little finger,” Jiang Ming chuckled after the clone had returned to him.
“Should I get the Blood Banner from the Great Demon Venerate next? That’s a Holy Weapon after all!” Jiang Ming fell into a contemplation.
After a long while, he decided not to get the Blood Banner from the Great Demon Venerate for now.
After all, he would become everyone’s target if he got the Blood Banner. This was not something he wanted.
He lifted his head and activated the Dharma Eyes.
The Great Demon Venerate appeared. The Blood Banner was fluttering on top of his head and he was holding his sword in his hand. He exuded an imposing aura, but his physical body was in a poor shape.
It looked as if he would collapse at any moment, but his injuries were healing at a rapid pace.
He was not as powerful as he used to be now. Most of his subordinates were dead. Other than the Black-Hearted Old Demon, he had only Venerable Chang Sheng left.
He brought with him 16 venerates, but he had only two now. Not only that, but both of them were seriously injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - Yu Fei: He’s a Baby Carrot (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Yu Fei: He’s a Baby Carrot (2)
If he had known this earlier, he wouldn’t have waged a war against the Heavenly Court.
The Great Demon Venerate’s expression was grim. When he thought of what would happen to him next, his heart sank. He waved his hand and collected all the loot. Just when he was about to leave, a boisterous laughter erupted.
“Hahaha!” As the laughter wafted into his ears, the Great Demon Concubine appeared out of thin air. She gazed at the Great Demon Venerate and said, her voice filled with manic, “This isn’t what you’ve expected, right, Tian Mo? You took advantage of me and set me up, and what now? Even though you’ve won the war, you lost everything!”
“I’ve killed the Heavenly Emperor!” The Great Demon Venerate said, his voice cold, “Come back with me to the Abyss.”
“Are you serious? You want me to go back there with you?” The Great Demon Concubine snorted, “Do you think you can return to the Abyss today?”
“Don’t you forget that you’re my wife. You’re Yu Fei of the Abyss, the named disciple of the Saint Demon Lord as well as the one who is admired by the countless Abyss Demons.” The Great Demon Venerate said, his face grim.
“Hahaha!” The Great Demon Concubine let out another laugh. After a short while, she stopped laughing as her face contorted into a grotesque expression. “Tian Mo, I can’t believe that you’re talking about the Abyss to me right now. Do you know how many worlds you’ve sacrificed so that you can get what you want and sanctify your Dao? You’ve exhausted the energy of the Abyss and you’ll receive severe repercussions because of that! Besides, there’s a possibility that the Abyss will never be able to heal from its damage and forever be gone from everyone’s sight! But these are fine. At the very least, the residents in the Abyss can still survive, but you… you had to draw power from the origin of the Abyss to attack the Heavenly Emperor!
“The Abyss has lost a portion of its origin, you’re going to get severe repercussions, the Demon Slaying Order, and the curse the Heavenly Emperor put on you before he died.
“Tian Mo, do you really think you can walk out of here alive?
“You’ve brought doom to the Abyss!
“Tian Mo, if you still regard yourself as a member of the Abyss, if you still have the pride of a Great Demon Venerate, then hand over the Holy Weapon to me and let me end your life!” The Great Demon Concubine said.
“You want to kill me?” The Great Demon Venerate’s face was filled with rage. “I know what you want! You want to become the Heavenly Emperor! Not a single chance!”
“Not a single chance? I don’t think so.”
No sooner had the imposing voice rang out than a golden dragon descended from the horizon of the sky. It arrived in front of them in a blink of an eye and transformed into an old man wearing a dark gold robe.
“The Heavenly Emperor has given his order at the last moment of his life. As long as we kill you, we can become the Heavenly Emperor,” the old man said as he offered a grin at the Great Demon Concubine. After that, he continued, “If Yu Fei kills you, we from the Dragon Clan will do our utmost effort to help her to become the Heavenly Emperor.”
“Ao Jin, do you really want to go against the Abyss?” The Great Demon Venerate said.
He was familiar with Ao Jin. He was the second strongest of the dragon clan. He was in the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm, and he was strong.
