He also knew that he had slept with his wife as well.
When the thought surfaced in his mind, his face grew even darker.
‘Could it be that she really wants to kill me? Then she’ll become the Heavenly Emperor with the help of the people she has slept with before?’
“Tian Mo, you can’t represent the Abyss anymore,” the Great Demon Concubine chuckled.
“Yes, she’s right. You can’t represent the Abyss anymore,” Ao Jin chimed in, “Tian Mo, no one is going to stand on your side now.”
He turned his head around and looked at Venerable Chang Sheng. “My old friend, even though you owe the Great Demon Venerate a favor, I’m sure you’ve done enough. You nearly lost your life and you almost lost all of your cultivation. Why don’t you leave now and recuperate?”
Venerable Chang Sheng’s face was grim.
There were 12 of them in the beginning. However, all of them were dead, and he was the only one left.
Although his heart was filled with fear, he was angry as well.
In the past, the Great Demon Venerate guaranteed them that they would win the war. They would kill the Heavenly Emperor and rule over the universe.
But what happened now? Even though they had successfully killed the Heavenly Emperor, they were on the verge of destruction themselves as well.
“Tian Mo, I’ve paid you back what I owe you!” Venerable Chang Sheng said, “We’re even now. Farewell!”
As soon as he had finished speaking, he tore the void open and jumped into it.
The Great Demon Venerate did not stop him from leaving.
“Black-Hearted!” Yu Fei looked toward Black-Hearted Old Demon. “Are you sure you want to keep following Tian Mo? My door is always open to you!”
“Well…” Black-Hearted Old Demon hesitated for a moment.
“Your door? Are you talking about the door on top or the door down there? You b*tch, you’ve seduced me several times in the past, but I didn’t let it happen. And you’re still seducing me now? Do you really think I’m a pushover? I shall show you what I’m made of soon enough!’
When the thought surfaced in his head, he scanned the surroundings. He could sense that there were a lot of people hiding in the dark, waiting for their moment to strike at them. He knew there was nothing they could do to turn the tide around. Therefore, he sighed, “People always say that those who suit their actions to the time are wise. As demons, we don’t talk about affection or friendship, only about benefits. The Great Demon Venerate, under your leadership, instead of seeing the Abyss stronger, I have seen the Abyss fall into a land of despair, and even in the future, the Abyss will become a desert of death. For the sake of the Abyss as well as for the sake of thousands of demons, please forgive me!”
He turned around and stood beside the Great Demon Concubine.
The corner of the Great Demon Concubine’s lips curled upward as she chuckled, “Tian Mo, no one is standing on your side anymore. Hand me over the Holy Weapon. Since you’re my husband, I can grant you a painless death!”
Black-Hearted Old Demon did not say anything, while Ao Jin just looked at them with amusement on his face.
The Great Demon Venerate’s expression was dark. He was not surprised at Venerable Chang Seng and Black-Hearted Old Demon’s decision. He did not ask them to stay. Instead, he lifted his head and announced, “Come on out. Let me see who’s after my life.”
“Amitabha!” A golden lotus appeared from thin air. There was a long-eared Buddha sitting on top of it. He was none other than the Laughing Buddha, who was highly respectable amongst the Fo Sect and was extremely powerful.
He exuded a great amount of golden light and there was pink-colored mist amongst the golden light.
As soon as he appeared, he pointed at the Great Demon Venerate and said, “Tian Mo, you’ve destroyed countless worlds and killed countless people. Not only that, but you’ve brought irrevocable damage to the Heavenly Realm and the Abyss. Your crimes are beyond redemption. If you don’t die today, many fallen souls won’t be able to rest in peace!”
“Indeed!” Another voice appeared. A sword energy emerged in the distance. It pierced through the void, and a young man stepped out of it.
There was a long sword on his back and he was walking with his hands clasped behind him.
He was the famous supreme elder of the Taishang Sword Sect, Tai Jian.
“Tian Mo, you need to die today to comfort those fallen souls!” Tian Jian flicked his finger and the sound of the sword resounded in the void.
“That’s right!” A plume of fire appeared and transformed into a woman in red clothes.
She was wearing a red dress and her hair was red. She looked just like a plume of walking fire in the distance.
She was the current leader of the Demon Holy Palace, Vermilion Bird.
The corner of the Great Demon Venerate’s lips curled sarcastically.
These people were not the only ones who came for his life. There were a lot more, and all of them were still hiding in the dark, waiting for their chance to pounce at him.
“Vermilion Bird, you shouldn’t have come,” the Great Demon Venerate said.
“Why?” Vermilion Bird frowned.
“Ao Jin, Tai Jian, Laughing Buddha… All of them have slept with Yu Fei before,” the Great Demon Venerate said, “Could it be that you’ve slept with her before too?”
He had decided to throw everything to the wind now.
Reputation? Dignity? Screw them!
Vermillion Bird was stunned for a moment before she harrumphed coldly, “I know what you’re trying to do, but it won’t work on me. I’ve underestimated you in the past. I didn’t expect that you would expose something like that. Are you still a man or not?”
“He isn’t a man. He’s just a baby carrot!” Yu Fei chimed in.
Vermillion Bird did not know what to say.
Ao Jin, Tai Jian, and Laughing Buddha were dumbfounded and the corner of their lips quivered.
They all did not expect that Yu Fei would admit it openly. They all thought that she would at least try to say something to reject it, and now, everyone knew that they had slept with her before.
As if she knew what they were thinking, Yu Fei snorted coldly inside of her heart.
‘Do you all really think I’ll let you stay out of this? No way! We’re on the same team now. If we’re going down, we’ll go down together!’
Tian Mo’s face turned red.
‘A baby carrot?’
“I’m a baby carrot?!” Tian Mo shouted angrily, and he had returned to his top condition.
He held the Blood Banner with his left hand and the demon blade with his right.
“Yu Fei, I’m going to make you pay for all the humiliations you’ve brought me!”
He let out a roar and charged at the group of people.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - Ten Thousand Demon Decree, Heavenly Buddha, Paramita Sepulture Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Ten Thousand Demon Decree, Heavenly Buddha, Paramita Sepulture Flower
??
Having seen the great explosion of power by the desperate Great Demon Venerate, all of the experts were left in shock.
Ao Jin, the second strongest of the dragon clan was forcibly torn apart, had his primal spirit swallowed, and died tragically on the spot. The Dragon Monarch erupted in fury, tearing the space itself and descended to the place.
If it weren’t for the Lord Buddha suddenly involving himself into the skirmish, Laughing Buddha, the great master of the Fo Sect, would have been killed.
Vermillion Bird and Tai Jian retreated themselves and were not affected.
Yu Fei was also in a very miserable state where her chest was blown up. If it wasn’t for a whip flying out of her body at the critical moment to withstand the attack, she would have died tragically on the spot.
“You have all made your move! This is all within my expectation!” The Great Demon Venerate had an extremely cold look on his face as he glanced around. His eyes were extremely calm, and his tone was very indifferent. In the end, he just stared at the Great Demon Concubine, and his voice suddenly became cold. “As the Great Demon Venerate of the Abyss, I hereby state the Ten Thousand Demon Decree. From today onwards, Yu Fei will be removed from the position of Great Demon Concubine and her status as a member of the abyss. All creatures in the abyss are allowed to eat her flesh, swallow her blood and soul as the eternal curse of the abyss in return for her betrayal.”
His voice wasn’t deafening, but it reverberated between heaven and earth.
It even evoked the power of order in the Abyss and left an imprint.
Right that very moment, all the creatures in the abyss heard the decree.
“Sky Demon! How could you treat me like this? Damn it! Damn it all!” Yu Fei’s face suddenly turned and was vicious, “Alright! This is alright! You’ve given me a better reason to kill you. I’ll disintegrate your soul and erase all traces of your existence from this world.”
“Amitabha, why must you resort to this?” The Buddha proclaimed the Buddha’s word solemnly, “Lay down the knife of slaughter and become a Buddha on the ground. Sky Demon, you have already made a grave mistake. It is the time for redemption. Be one with our Fo Sect, pray every day and chant scriptures every night to atone for your sins.”
“Heavenly Buddha, how about I kill you and then convert to Buddhism?” The Sky Demon sneered.
“Such stubbornness.” Heavenly Buddha sighed, “All sentient beings desire and suffer at the same time. Sky Demon, you are about to sink into the bottom of the sea of misery. If you don’t turn back, you will fall into reincarnation forever!”
Sky Demon glanced at him indifferently, disdaining to argue. With a flick of his palm, a glimmering crystal flower appeared. At the edges of the crystal flower, there was constant disillusionment appearing, portraying an extremely strange phenomenon.
“Paramita Sepulture Flower!” the Heavenly Buddha exclaimed as his face changed greatly.
“Isn’t this something made up, how could it really exist?” The Dragon Monarch’s face also changed wildly.
The Vermillion bird and the others had an ugly look on their faces.
“Why didn’t I know you had this?” Yu Fei shuddered.
She was furious just now because of the Ten Thousand Demon Decree by the Great Demon Venerate, but her emotions had turned into fright now.
“I once roamed into the Chaos. In a dilapidated ruin, I went through great perils to get ahold of this rare object.” The Great Demon Venerate looked at the crystal flower. His face had a touch of tenderness and was as weird as it could possibly be. “There has always been a legend in the world that when the world reaches its peak, a seed will be bred. With the origin of the world as the soil and the luck of all beings as the irrigation, the world begins to shrink as it grows, and withers when it finally blooms. The destruction of the world means that the world has become paramita. That is why it is called Paramita Sepulture Flower. Burying the entire world, for the flower to bloom in paramita.”
“This is not a legend, but in fact, a real existence.”
“When the Paramita Sepulture Flower blooms completely, the world would then be completely destroyed.”
“The more dazzling it becomes, the faster the world is destroyed and more souls are annihilated.”
“This flower is exactly the afterglow from its extreme dazzle. It’s such a pity! If I got a hold of it when it was at its peak of blooming, I wouldn’t have to scheme on the Heaven Court and end up with my current situation.”
“I didn’t reveal it even when I was at the most desperate in the battle with the Heavenly Emperor.”
“Even as of now, the likes of you could do nothing if I choose to flee from the place.”
“However…I’m not reconciled!”
“I’ve tolerated the Great Demon Concubine messing around.”
“Endured the invasion of the Heavenly Realm onto my Abyss for hundreds of millions of years, turning it into a training ground.”
“Endured hundreds of millions of years of loneliness to only be able to cultivate secretly and strengthen myself.”
“I managed to endure everything.”
“Having exhausted my resources of the Abyss and to finally see the fruits of victory, the only thing I can’t bear is to have my fruits of victory seized by the likes of you! I can’t bear it! The millions of creatures from the Abyss can’t bear it either!”
“Trying to seize me of my fruits of victory? I’ll do whatever it takes to prevent you from getting your wish!”
“Have any of you seen the Paramita Sepulture Flower withers?”
There was a strange look on his face.
“As the Paramita Sepulture Flower, the world withers.”
“If the Paramita Sepulture Flower withers, does the world resets itself?”
“What does reset mean?”
“It means that everything will be disintegrated, and life itself will reenact from its primal form.”
“Even if the person is...A Holy Venerate!”
“Are you ready for this?”
The Great Demon Venerate’s face became stranger and stranger. The Paramita Sepulture Flower in his hand suddenly bloomed with infinite luminance, radiating a strange aura that penetrated into the void.
“Amitabha!” the Heavenly Buddha’s expression became even more solemn, “Sky Demon, you’re now at the Demi-Sage Realm and only a step away from the Saint Realm. Why would you want to risk everything! Is it really worth wasting away everything you have just because of one failure? This is not something a wise person would do. Sky Demon, let go of this.”
“It’s just a bluff!” the Dragon Monarch snorted coldly, “Wanting to wither the world and destroy all beings with just a mere flower? You’re just pulling our legs!”
Although he muttered so, his eyes were extremely solemn and the overwhelming power contained in his body were also dispersed, turning into layers of cover on the top of his head, forming a pagoda.
The Vermillion Bird, Tai Jian and the likes were all in defensive positions at the same time.
They were vigilant and cautious, yet were still in doubts.
“Do you think I don’t know the background of the Heavenly Emperor? You think I don’t know that I might fail? I understand everything! The reason behind why I’m putting my bet on this is because I have the confidence for it. I have the confidence to drag you all down and bury all living beings with me.” The voice of the Sky Demon was deep and hoarse, “The Abyss is over, hence my spiritual sustenance has gone; my Dao is dead. What’s the point of living if I can’t see the future? Tell me, what’s the point of me continuing to live?”
“What do you want?” Heavenly Buddha asked quickly upon seeing the Sky Demon’s slight hesitation.
“Let me ascend to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor.” The Sky Demon replied without hesitation, “By ascending to the throne of Heavenly Emperor, I will be able to relieve my Abyss’s wounds from the Dao’s backlashes. I will be able to wither away the power of the supreme curse on my body and allow me to continue on my path of Great Dao. Would all of you agree?”
“To hell with that!” the Dragon Monarch was the first to reprimand, “You are thinking of threatening us with a flower of unknown origin? Sky Demon! I used to look down on you as the cuckold king, but now I even more detest you! If you really want to evoke it, then just do so! If it really manages to bring the whole world down in perish, I will just have to accept it. If we end up not perishing together? Hehe! Sky Demon, I will remove your Abyss from here on out, and kill you until there’s nothing left of you.”
Yu Fei, who was beside him, gave him a faint glance and licked her lips inexplicably.
The Dragon Monarch shivered.
“Sky Demon! Mere Threats are useless!” Tai Jian said, “Try evoking it then! Either we die together, or you die together with the Abyss.”
“Trying to drag us down and pull the entire world down with you with a mere flower? I, for one, do not believe you.” The Vermillion muttered as well, “You only have one chance to make your move!”
As she muttered, she lifted her hand and pressed down on him, evoking the Thunder of Ten Thousand Flames. It almost blew away the Blood Banner above the Sky Demon’s head.
“It’s over!” the Vermillion Bird’s eyes lit up.
“Alright then!” The Great Demon Venerate smiled in relief, and threw the Paramita Sepulture Flower into the sky. At the same time, he muttered “Let it bloom then!”
Hum!
The flower bloomed with illuminating light. In an instant, the blinding luminance invaded the endless sky and filled the heavens.
The radiance was so dazzling that the primal spirits were plunged into its endless beauty, while layers of ripples appeared in the universe, as if the space had formed billions of layers of separation, causing the people to lose themselves in its beauty, difficult to realize the real world from the illusion.
“Amitabha! This is not the Paramita Sepulture Flower at all. Even if it is, it doesn’t have the ability to destroy the world. It only divides the space and causes people to fall into its illusion, so that he can escape leisurely.” As the Heavenly Buddha smiled slightly, the golden lotus under him bloomed thousands of golden rays, illuminating the space, holding the world in place, while his pair of eyes turned golden, scanning through the heavens and the earth. “He was so swift with his escape to the point that I can no longer find him. No, it was the interference of this flower! However, can you, the Sky Demon, really be able to escape? Today, the world has been set up with ambushes from all directions. Being stared at by countless experts, you stand no chance to even escape into the Chaos! ”
Upon muttering, he forcibly tore apart thousands of layers of space and plunged into it.
“Sky Demon, I look down on you even more!” the Dragon Monarch snorted, opened his mouth and spat out a dragon ball. It tore through the endless rays of light, as he plunged his head into the void and chased after him vividly sensing in the dark.
Vermillion Bird, Tai Jian, Yu Fei and the likes also used their means to leave the place.
Many experts who were paying attention in secret also went off one after another to chase and kill him.
Standing in the endless torrent of void, the Sky Demon stopped on his feet.
He let out a sigh of relief, but had an extremely bad look on his face: “I have conjured 81 incarnations that traveled to different places. Who knows how long I can interfere with their chase? Now, I can no longer stay in the Honggu Heavenly Realm but only going to the Chaos can save my life. I’ll just go on then. Wait till I sanctify my way of Dao, I will return and destroy this world in order to avenge this humiliation.”
“I’ll need to first look for the weak spot of the world’s fetal membranes. Otherwise, I will definitely be discovered if it’s forcibly torn!”
“Alas, the fetal membrane of the World. It’s not something that’s so easy to break!”
As the Sky Demon thought about it and was about to leave, he discovered a figure in front of him, and couldn’t help frowning: “The Future Buddha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - Seven Great Saint Lords, Ten Golden Ancient Races, Secret Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Seven Great Saint Lords, Ten Golden Ancient Races, Secret Realm
??
In the Tianyuan Realm high in the sky, Jiang Ming sat in the clouds, covering his figure.
While he was refining the Heavenly Emperor Seal, Heavenly Emperor Sword and Emperor Crown that he has kept in the Human Path Records, he was also checking on the Sky Demon at the same time.
“Besieged by many great experts, it seems that this is the end for the Sky Demon.”
Jiang Ming was gloating extremely.
He didn’t have any good impression of the demon.
‘Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, Vermillion Bird, Tai Jian and Yu Fei are all experts of the Quasi-Sage Realm, each representing the great strength of different places!’
Jiang Ming pondered and knew that there were not only these top forces in the world, but many more.
Taking the former Sacred Land for example, the Sacred Land of the Heavenly Realm was the place where the Saint Lords were once born. Besides, there were also some seclusive ancient races. The Heavenly Realm was indeed very complicated.
Otherwise, with the power of the Heavenly Emperor, why would it be necessary for him to set up such a big scheme? Wouldn’t it be a pain in the ass?
‘My oh my! To think that the legends about the Paramita Sepulture Flower was actually passed down by the Sky Demon himself. He described its form and explained its abilities which later spread through the endless world and gradually became qualitative.’
‘This guy is really a cunning fox! So devious and slick with his scheme.’
‘However, this flower only evokes the power of the endless tides of time and space, creating extreme interference for him to buy time and escape. The effect is also very impressive and it can be regarded as a rare treasure in the world.’
‘Yet, he is actually blocked by the Future Buddha!”
‘This old Buddha’s strength is not to be taken lightly as well. Otherwise, how could he have deduced the Sky Demon’s escape and blocked him well ahead of time?’
‘The Future Buddha…Could it be that he can deduce the future karma?’
Jiang Ming was a little curious, but didn’t make a move in the end.
He integrated his consciousness into the Human Path Record, looking through the ‘Status’ of the Sky Demon as the contents were constantly updated in it.
Although the Future Buddha just wanted to entangle his opponent, he was still beaten and had to retreat.
The Sky Demon continued escaping, but he also noticed that his incarnations were rapidly annihilated by others.
Just as he was about to head towards where the fetal membranes of the world were, there were others who appeared blocking in front of him.
“Venerate Tai Yin, Great Monarch Tian Song, do the two of you also want to be my enemy?” Sky Demon’s face turned dark.
“I’m not interested in the throne of the Heavenly Emperor!” Venerate Tai Yin was a woman. Her body was enveloped in the moonlight and her coldness exuded a supreme and noble aura.
She lives on the Extreme Yin Stellar and even the previous Heavenly Emperor had to show her some respect. She was independent of the outside world, just continuing on her cultivation of her great Dao and keeping the Extreme Yin Stellar running. She was of honorable status and she enjoyed purity of peace.
“I’m an old friend of Venerate Tai Yin. She wants the Blood Banner to suppress the Moon Palace, so as not to be affected by such a war in the future.” Great Monarch Tian Song said happily, “Taoist Sky Demon. Give in the Blood Banner and you can leave the place safely.”
“Do you really think that you have the upper hand over me?” The Sky Demon sneered. With the Blood Banner already in his hand, the void shook in an instant, rolling up vortexes of torrents.
“Sky Demon, where can you escape to?” Great Monarch Tian Song sighed softly, “Now all the weaker parts of the fetal membrane in the entire Honggu Heavenly Realm are guarded by experts. Once you can’t break through the first time, you will be surrounded and besieged by many other peerless experts. You may be able to escape once but do you think you can escape a second time? Give us the Bloody Banner and you can escape into the Chaos from behind us. That is the place where you still have hope of living. If you obtain great fortunes there, you may even be able to achieve the Saint Realm. ”
“Stop being so long-winded!” The Sky Demon was out of time. He knew that he couldn’t wait any longer, hence evoking the supreme treasures to take on the two of them.
He was, after all, at the Demi-Sage Realm. Moreover, with Holy Weapons in his hands, it didn’t take long for him to successfully retreat easily.
“As expected of the Great Demon Venerate!” With emerald light shining on his head, Great Monarch Tian Song stepped on the torrent of void and sighed softly, “Even if he is in a bad shape and seriously injured after going through successive battles, his combative strength still cannot be underestimated. It’s especially true at this stage in time. We can’t force him too much. Otherwise, no one can guarantee what might happen when he is in such a desperate situation.”
“What you said is true.” Venerate Tai Yin nodded, “I’m also just doing my part to rid of this devil. After all, the effects that he has brought upon are too vile.”
The two continued to chat and didn’t care about the Great Demon Venerate leaving.
It’s just that Venerate Tai Yin was a little weird and had an inexplicable look on her face.
After tossing and turning several times, the Sky Demon returned to the Abyss.
In Tianyuan Realm, Jiang Ming had a strange look on his face.
‘There are actually so many strong experts in the world?’ He was very surprised.
However, he was relatively looking forward to the Sky Demon’s next escape.
This was because the Sky Demon was heading over to the place where the previous Saint Demon Lord cultivated back then. It was a small world that the Saint Demon Lord had opened up and sealed ever since he left.
Sky Demon discovered the place by accident. He was ready to risk dying just to seize the chance of survival.
There was no way for him to escape. His injuries were constantly deteriorating and his combat power had weakened greatly. If he were to be surrounded, he wouldn’t survive.
‘Not one has died after so long!’
Jiang Ming had the urge to take action but he still held down his thoughts because he thought that being still was better than making a move.
He turned around and returned to Chuyang Peak.
“How is the outside world?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan asked.
Phoenix Junior Sister had already brewed the Immortal tea and was listening in as well.
“The Great Demon Venerate is finished. The abyss is finished!” Jiang Ming sat down, motioned for Mountain Master Tianyuan to sit next to him and said, “Brother, tell me about the powerful influences of the Heavenly Realm in detail, especially the influences related to the inheritance of the Sacred Land.”
“Alright!” Mountain Master Tianyuan responded.
He brought it up before, but it wasn’t very detailed.
“The many forces are basically in the Heavenly Realm led by the Heaven Court, where tens of thousands of races submitted to them! However, it’s quite a pity. Now that the Heaven Court has fallen and the Heavenly Emperor dead, a new round of battle will begin.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan slowly revealed the truth behind the veil of Heavenly Realm.
In addition to the Heaven Court, the most powerful ones were none other than the Abyss, the Fo Sect, the Dragon Clan, and the Demon Holy Palace.
In the Honggu Heavenly Realm, there used to be seven Saint Lords.
One of them was the Demon Saint who founded the Demon Holy Palace.
Another was the Holy Buddha who founded the Fo Sect. He once said that when he first realized the Buddhism Fluctuation from the outside world, he finally realized the way of Buddhism, realized the Buddhism Saint Realm and sanctified his way of Dao. The phrase “Amitabha’ was also derived from the Chaos of the outside world. When he left, he said that he was on the path to pursue the supreme truth of the Buddha, the supreme mystery of the Buddha.
One of them was the Saint Demon Lord that integrated the Abyss with monstrous strength.
The next one was the Nature Saint Lord. The legend was that a green lotus had realized the great Dao and founded the Infinite Being Palace. They collected the world’s exotic flowers and plants, and preached for them when they transformed. The palace was the most peaceful among all. Great Monarch Tian Song came from the Infinite Being Palace. He seemed to be a kind old man, but his strength was so great that no one knew exactly how strong he was.
Another was the Supreme Saint Lord who realized the Heavenly Sword Dao, actualized the principle of sword and founded the Taishang Sword Sect. Tai Jian was one of his disciples. However, it was obvious that he did not use all his strength during the encirclement and suppression of the Great Demon Venerate this time around.
Another Saint Lord was the Qing Tian Saint Lord. It was said that he originated from the source of origin of the clear energy of the sky. After sanctioning his path of Dao, he founded the Heaven Court and went on leaving endless legends. It was a pity that this person did not leave a legacy and the whereabouts of the secret realm he opened up was not known till this day.
There was also a Saint Lord who was called Dao Monarch. Rumor had it that he was the first to have preached the Saint Realm. It was also rumored that he was a congenital stone womb with three thousand orifices of the origin of the world that preached the way of Dao. Some said that he was born from the condensed essence of three thousand origin qi. However, no matter which rumor it was, his backgrounds were all very terrifying.
After sanctifying the way of Dao, he sorted out the method of cultivation and spread it throughout the infinite realms.
The current cultivation system came from this Dao Monarch.
It was with his support that the Heaven Court founded by Qing Tian Saint Lord had become the only orthodox force in the infinite realms. It integrated the worlds, regulated yin and yang, gathered luck and fortune and straightened out the rules.
He also made the other Saint Lords recognize the status of the Heaven Court, formed its orthodoxy and its unshakable authority.
Later on, the Dao Monarch was the first to leave and went into the Chaos in search of a way of breaking through to a higher realm.
The other six Saints also felt that it was boring to stay around and so they followed in the footsteps of the Dao Monarch as well.
“The Dao Monarch taught the world the way of cultivation, yet the secret realm he opened was unknown; although Qing Tian Saint Lord founded the Heaven Court, he did not pay attention to worldly affairs, which makes him quite mysterious; The Holy Buddha founded the Fo Sect, the Nature Saint Lord founded the Infinite Being Palace, the Demon Saint Lord fixed the abyss by bringing order to the Abyss; The Supreme Saint Lord established the Taishang Sword Sect and the legacy he left behind was relatively complete; there was also the Demon Saint Palace founded by the Demon Saint, which is also quite powerful. ”
“In addition, there are also those who were born with innate special abilities. Although there were no Saint Lords born in the Dragon Clan which had extremely powerful bloodlines, the clan is huge and has a large number of peerless experts. Hence, it should not be underestimated. ”
There was also the Moon Palace.
The Infinite Alchemy Immortal Sect, Qingyun Immortal Sect, Riyue Sword Sect, Tianlei Immortal Sect, etc of the human race.
In addition, there were some seclusive ancient families. They were too seclusive that even Mountain Master Tianyuan didn’t know much about.
“There is also a legend that in ancient times, there were 10 golden races. Because of the birth of Saints, they could not see the hope of conquering the world and so they all went into seclusion. According to legend, the bloodlines of each race were very powerful and they were born with terrifying special abilities.” Mountain Master Tianyuan explained with a serious tone and continued, “I’ve never checked on them in detail, hence I don’t know whether it’s true!”
“Now that the Heavenly Emperor has fallen, the Abyss has ruined and that the Great Demon Venerate won’t be around for any much longer, I’m afraid these forces will emerge to stir up a storm!”
“By the way, there is also the Infinite Realm Auction House!”
“Ah, the coming days will definitely not be peaceful.”
“Even our place over here might be targeted and they might even make their move.”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan had a worried look on his face.
Jiang Ming smiled indifferently as he looked as though he didn’t care.
Although his cultivation realm wasn’t that high, he had too many means and techniques up his sleeves.
Not taking into account the many one-time pinnacle level special abilities rewarded to him, if he revealed just the remaining Taiyi weapons, Great Overarching items and the likes to the world, even the Heavenly Emperor’s hair would be standing at its end if he were to resurrect himself.
As soon as his eyes narrowed, he became a little more energetic and focused.
He had been paying attention to the Sky Demon’s ‘Status’ on the Human Path Record for quite some time and finally there had been some changes.
‘This time, who knows how many people will be killed!’
Jiang Ming narrowed his eyes, and the dim glare from his eyes was gleaming.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan who was right next to him, suddenly felt inexplicably cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - Into the Abyss, Slashing Down the Roads Ahead (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Into the Abyss, Slashing Down the Roads Ahead (Part 1) Translation
Jiang Ming had a clear understanding of the various forces in today’s world.
In the past, when the Heavenly Emperor was still around, he could control the power of authority and suppress through all directions. However, now that the Heavenly Emperor had fallen, the world plunging into chaos was inevitable.
Who would submit to whom? Taking Buddhism Sect as an example, who would they willingly submit to?
As for the Heavenly Buddha ascension to the throne?
“It’s impossible for him!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan shook his head immediately, “The Fo sect is too deceptive. Once the Heavenly Buddha ascends to the throne, the whole world may be shrouded in the Buddha’s light, and hundreds of millions of races will become bald!”
“What if they force their way onto the ascension?”
“They will surely be attacked by everyone!”
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming nodded, “If the Heavenly Buddha ascends to the throne, the Buddha’s light will gradually penetrate around and the whole world will become full of Buddha. In fact, I still don’t understand one thing.”
“What is it?”
“The Heavenly Emperor has been in power for so many years. It doesn’t matter whether it is openly or secretly, he must have engaged in many businessesor maybe allied with some other forces over the years. Why is it that when the Abyss went up against Heaven and that the Heaven Court was badly attacked, not even one of the forces showed up?”
“This...” Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned, “It’s really a little weird! If you ignore the rest and just focus on let’s say the Moon Palace, it is reasonable to say that they will surely make their appearance, but it turned out that they were only watching on the sidelines. There is also the Infinite Being Palace. Although it is a sacred place of inheritance, it has always been after the leadership of the Heaven Court. When the Heaven Court was attacked, they should have made their appearance, but they did nothing at all. This is weird. This is really weird. Even if they were just dealing with the Heaven Court courteously without sincerity, it would’ve made more sense if they came out and went about. ”
Jiang Ming thought for a little more.
He thought that these might be arranged by the Heavenly Emperor himself. But if that was the case, wasn’t it just too obvious? Moreover, something was not right because the fact that the “Heavenly Emperor” was dead was a publicly recognized event.
No matter how much suspicion there might be, it would all pale out in front of such a fact.
Such a great scheme!
Mountain Master Tian Yuan returned to his manor and continued his cultivation. Meanwhile, Jiang Ming went to lay down on the rattan chair and swayed leisurely.
“Senior Brother!” Phoenix Junior Sister came over and laid on him. She was slowly drawing circles with her tender white fingertips, while her other hand was resting on her chin. She asked softly with innocent eyes, “Why is there the difference between men and women?”
“This question is too strange!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing, “If there is no difference between men and women, how can there be extreme joy in the world? How can you still pester me every day? How can there be harmony between Yin and Yang and the inheritance of all spirits?”
“That’s not right!” Phoenix Junior Sister shook her head and continued, “At the beginning of the ancient times, they were all congenital beings. At that time, there was no harmony between yin and yang and there was no difference between men and women. Those who were Innate Divine Saints, were born with great special abilities and they had been comprehending the laws of heaven. But since when has the distinction between men and women appeared and that the combination of yin and yang to give birth to the next generation of life was acknowledged?”
“This question is very profound!” Jiang Ming pondered, “Perhaps, it’s like entering the bridal chamber. A person might not know everything about it, but upon lying on the bed, the person will understand it naturally. This is when the time has come, it is impossible to not even understand it. I once read a book that told a story about a man and a woman who fought to the death and ended up fighting in close quarters. They were accidentally entangled and their clothes were all torn apart. Throughout fights, frictions among them were inevitable, and a physiological reaction occurred unconsciously. ”
“As a result, the man’s spear went straight into the gate of heaven subconsciously. And that made a wonderful change.”
“The great battle was paused momentarily! Involuntarily, another great battle began!”
“Perhaps, at the beginning of the ancient times, a similar event also occurred. After one time they enjoyed the wonders of converging yin and yang, they went on with it again and again. This wonderful event then spread around, and formed the real union of yin and yang. Following the beauty of the Great Dao, the great event of producing the next generation was formed!”
Jiang Ming said in a straightforward manner.
Phoenix Junior Sister pouted her mouth and muttered, “You really know how to say silly things! Hehe! However, you also had some reactions to the story. Senior Brother, are you excited again? Should we go for one round?”
“I still have something to do!”
“I’m so great at it that I’ll be able to knock you down very soon! Let’s hurry up!”
“Alright! Let’s start up the board! This time, I will definitely put on a huge dragon and take you down seven times out of seven!”
“Senior brother, don’t you know that I like to slay huge dragons the most?”
The human world was the most joyful of all
Two days later, Jiang Ming conjured a clone of himself. Although the clone gave people a feeling of weakness, it paced in the air to the Tianyuan Sea.
Riyue Changfeng was still sipping tea silently above the auction palace. Right beside him was the Demon Venerate Bi Jiu. Seeing Jiang Ming coming over, he couldn’t help laughing, “Brother Jiang, although I can’t see through the Tianyuan Realm, I notice that this clone of yours is covered full with pink desires! Such joy!”
“I don’t have a choice. I have an uneasy worrying wife!” Jiang Ming replied as he didn’t mind about it at all and continued, “Speaking of which, Brother Riyue, don’t you have any confidante?”
“I have quite a few confidantes, but there are pitifully few confidantes who really understand me.” Riyue Changfeng sighed faintly, “I used to have one too. When we were side by side, we felt that time passed too quickly. How happy it was to travel around the mountains and waters, cultivating together, and travel the world. During that time, I really hoped that time would stop. Looking back now, it is still a sweet memory. It’s a pity that fate really plays games on people. I didn’t cause people any trouble yet disasters fell. I went on a killing spree massacring more than 3.2 billion demons in the world. I almost went crazy and the aura of death on my body even started to condense and materialized. I hid myself in the library for 30,000 years! During that period, I didn’t cultivate, but was only just reading, drinking tea, playing the instrument, painting and writing calligraphy. It was then that the aura of death was dispelled from me. ”
“In most cases, things in life are unsatisfactory.” Jiang Ming sighed, “The past becomes a treasure, and also serves as a memory of the past. We live in the present while looking into the future. Ever thought of finding another one? I won’t believe that no one meets your eyes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - Into the Abyss, Slashing Down the Roads Ahead (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Into the Abyss, Slashing Down the Roads Ahead (Part 2)
“Of course there is!” Riyue Changfang held up the teacup, as his facial emotion was submerged in reminiscent, “I once met a person who was extremely elegant and amazingly talented. Unfortunately, in order to find or wait for her brother’s reincarnation, she didn’t want to care about any other things at all. I wanted to take her away from that broken world, but unfortunately wasn’t able to do so. ”
“What’s her name?” Jiang Ming’s heart skipped a beat as it was inexplicably familiar.
“In that world, her name is Emperor Fei Xian!”
“Fei Xian? Such a weird name!” Jiang Ming breathed a sigh of relief.
The two continued to sip on the immortal tea and chatted about some other interesting things.
“Have you really not thought of leaving a descendant? Once you sanctify your way of Dao and become a Saint, I’m afraid it will be really difficult to leave an heir by then!”
“It’s still possible at the Saint Realm, but would just be really difficult! Moreover, as we’ve reached such a realm, we tend to always put ourselves first. When we have all the abilities within our grasp, and we even can cover the sky with a snap of our fingers, what would we want descendants for! Descendants are something that we yearn for only when the road ahead is cut off. As so, leaving a descendant to inherit our own way of Dao in hope that they would exceed themselves in life. For the mortal worlds, a hundred years would’ve passed hurriedly and there would be a need for descendants to continue the legacy. But do we need it? There’s no need at all! Descendants would be nothing but a drag. Taking the Northern Emperor Kunpeng as an example. He got himself a son and what was the result? He was brought to death because of it. ”
Jiang Ming was speechless upon hearing his explanation.
“Having yet to fully comprehend the great way of Dao, you want to get yourself a son and cause more worries for yourself? Wouldn’t it be a pain in the ass?” Riyue Changfeng said again, “Brother Jiang, could it be that you have such a plan? Then you must be mentally prepared! Before birth, you must think about preparing a supreme foundation for him. After birth, you have to take great care of him for fear of any accidents. Then, there is growth, teaching and cultivation. As for all of these, it would just consume some time and effort. But what about once they become an adult? There would be a rebellious phase where they go against you every time. Truth be told, these are actually harmless. Brother Jiang, you should know what we should be afraid of most! ”
“What should we be most afraid of?” Jiang Ming asked in confusion.
“The thing we would be most afraid of is our son provoking some existence that we would not be able to deal with. Take Kunpeng for example, his son provoked you and as a result, both the father and son died in your hands. Don’t you think Kunpeng is wrong? Being brought to death because of his own son. Who could he have asked for reasoning?”
“If everyone thinks like you, wouldn’t the continuation of life be cut off?”
“This is only for the cultivator! Cultivators comprehend the way of great Daos and enjoy the pleasure of peeping at the supreme and wonderful truth of life. Wouldn’t this be enough? Only the mortals would get married, have children, and continue their bloodline.”
“What about you? Did you come out of the mortal world?”
“Certainly!”
“Your grandfather has a son, your father has a son. Do you have a son?”
“I can live forever. As long as I am around, the bloodline of my Riyue family will always be there and it will not be cut off. Therefore, why would I want a son!” Riyue Changfeng smiled strangely, “Brother Jiang, in such a way of life, I am at a perfect defense!”
“Really?”
“Really!”
“Then I won’t be holding back then!”
“I really don’t believe you can persuade me!”
“Your father’s grandfather has a grandson, your grandfather has a grandson. Does your father have a grandson?”
“Brother Jiang...” Riyue Changfeng was slightly startled. He couldn’t help grinding his teeth, and then took a sip of tea. He raised his head, looked at the vast clouds and his tone was a little solemn, “If I hadn’t come from the mortal world, this wouldn’t have swayed my mind at all. Alas, I’m from the mortal world! I still remember when my father sent me off to escape, he told me not to think about revenge, but to start a family and get more wives, to bear more children so that my Riyue family bloodline would continue on.”
As he said all these, he shook his head.
“To think that you still remember what happened after such a long time!”
“That is the warmth and the memory of the years that I miss the most. It is the imprint that enabled me to retain humanity all the time, the driving force for me to move forward.”
“Has your heart swayed?”
“No, when I grow to a certain level, I will try to see if I can reverse nature and resurrect them all!”
“Memories of the past, motivation to move forward!”
“Of course!”
The two raised a toast with tea for alcohol.
Jiang Ming stood up and said, “I’m going to go to the Abyss to have a look. Want to go?”
“The Abyss is chaotic and it’s hard to see through it even with my precious mirror.” Riyue Changfeng also stood up, “I’ll also go and take a look at how this realm’s Sage Venerates Dao Square looks like.”
“Let’s go then!”
Jiang Ming jumped off into the air and flew towards an Abyss gate.
“How is your clone’s combat power? Hopefully you won’t be destroyed in a snap of your fingers when you get targeted by Yu Fei. Your real self’s face would turn really sour from this!” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile.
“It’s enough to take a look at the whole commotion!” Jiang Ming said, “That Yu Fei! I really don’t know if her mind is full of water!”
“Haha! It might be almost there! Even I can’t imagine that a demon like her can cultivate up to the realm of Quasi-Sage. She has even gone a long distance as well!”
“Who would have thought of it? Perhaps, she is lustful to the extreme, taking desire as her Dao and the carrier of desire. This is the only way that her path has gone on so smoothly!”
“That makes sense! I even had a theory that if she sleeps with up to 3,000 people from every race in this world, will this allow her to sanctify the way of Dao?”
“Haha, Brother Riyue, you can talk to her about this idea of yours. Maybe she’d thank you by directly recommending herself to you!”
“Hey, I don’t want to be polluted!”
“The word ‘polluted’ is wonderfully used! Brother Riyue, aren’t you afraid of being targeted when you go forth with your true form without taking the auction palace with you?”
“I on the other hand hope to be targeted, so that I can move about a little!”
As the two chatted, they arrived at the gate of Abyss.
There were no longer any demons gushing out from it.
This cross-dimensional gateway had not been destroyed and was perched here all alone.
The two of them didn’t care whether there was an ambush on the other side and went straight in.
As the two reappeared, they were already in the abyss.
The earth was desolated, while the sky was gray and gloomy. The whole world gave people a feeling of extreme depression.
Beneath their foot was an altar and above it was a portal, which was the cross-dimensional gateway. The altar was still running. However, there were no longer any demons around.
No, there were a few left, a few demon corpses.
Grieving howls could be heard from afar as the demonic flames shot through the skies.
“This is just too miserable!” Jiang Ming looked into the distance and probed a little, but couldn’t help grinning, “It’s all the fault of the Great Demon Venerate! If he wanted to sanctify the way of Dao, he could have just comprehended the Dao of Enlightenment or head towards the Chaos to explore. Why would he need to take a bet on this? As a result, he lost the bet and the origin of the abyss was attenuated, their fortune plummeted and are now under the backlash of the Dao. All the creatures in the Abyss are now condemned with bad luck!”
He saw a demon cultivating on the mountain in the distance. Suddenly the demon’s body was ignited in flame and directly burned into ashes.
There was another one who was flying, but was hit by another expert who suddenly appeared next to him. As a result, the two evoked their abilities at the same time subconsciously and the both of them ended up dead.
As he glanced through the place, these abyss demons were dying in extremely strange ways.
Most of them had their mana collapsing, or that their cultivation method went wrong and blew themselves up, crippling themselves.
“This is the consequence of defying the heavens!” Riyue Changfeng said, “If you induce great damage to the world before your transcendence, this would be your result. Alas, the Great Demon Venerate. Even if he is able to enter the secret realm of the Saint Lord, he won’t live long. Being targeted by heaven and earth as well as by all beings, how can he live for long?”
As the two of them chatted, they had already found the passage to the next layer and continued to shuttle away.
Through every layer abyss, similar tragedies were unfolding themselves.
If this went on, the abyss would be destroyed, leaving no survivors even without the invasion from the many forces from the Heavenly Realm.
But how could the billions of forces in the Heavenly Realm let go of such a good opportunity?
They absolutely won’t! It’s just that they were yet to react to such a phenomenon. Once the Heavenly Realm made their move, the Abyss would be completely over.
As the two of them moved forward, there were also many demons desperately throwing themselves on them, trying to slaughter the two, but were all killed by Riyue Changfeng with ease.
The further they entered, the greater the pressure became.
There were also waves and waves of auras that weren’t supposed to appear in the depth emerging, as all of them were rushing towards the same place.
Not long after, they reached the bottom of the Abyss.
It was an extremely vast area.
Some areas had flowing magma that formed a sea. In the sea were demons such as fire demons, balrogs and so on. Meanwhile, some areas were shrouded in fog, where lots of fog demons could be seen inside.
The abyss was vast, breeding countless miracles.
But now, it was permeated with a dense aura of death.
In the northwest corner, there was a large amount of immortal luminance shining, illuminating half of the sky. There were also auras that were trying to crush the void permeating through the universe.
“Those who should come have all arrived!” Jiang Ming looked over with a smile on his face.
“Yeah, they’re all here!” Riyue Changfeng also said the same thing, “Fortunately, we’re not too late to watch this big show!”
Over in that direction was the entrance to the small chiliocosm of the Saint Demon Lord. It was now forced out by many powerful experts. Of course, this was also the credits of Yu Fei.
“Let’s go!”
The two didn’t stop as they crossed through the void.
However, before the two could go near, a sword light could be seen heading towards them from the void, directly slashing at Jiang Ming.
“A special ability of the Sword Dao that contains the power of Karma. Is this trying to slash through my primal soul?”
Jiang Ming squinted his eyes as his murderous intent grew.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 1)
With a single sword slash, the sky was split apart, tearing through the Abyss as it charged at them quickly.
Jiang Ming saw the person behind the sword slash with just a glance and raised his finger. He evoked the extremely powerful special ability which was the Return of Infinite Law Finger, shattering the sword slash. However, his whole person also exploded, leaving only a trace of soul remnant, before disappearing without a trace.
Riyue Changfeng who was next to him moved a little, but he didn’t take any action.
Feeling that Jiang Ming’s soul remnant disappeared out of thin air, he couldn’t help frowning as he was quite puzzled himself, “How did he leave? I couldn’t even find any clue! Such a mysterious person!”
“Clone?” Tai Jian stepped into the air, frowning as he looked at Jiang Ming’s disappearance, “Even his soul remnant has disappeared without a trace. He really deserves to be called the most legendary child among the human world. Tsk tsk tsk! Since I provoked this person now, I should be in quite some trouble in the future.”
“The troubles will definitely not be small!” Riyue Changfeng said with a smile.
“Brother Changfeng!” Tai Jian clasped his fists and cupped his hands, “It doesn’t matter if it’s a small problem or not. He is just a human child that will only stay in his old nest and not make any moves. Even if his old nest is the Sage Venerates Dao Square, it will eventually be destroyed one day.”
“That day should be a long, long time to go!” Riyue Changfeng narrowed his eyes and smiled casually.
How could he not understand that when Tai Jian was commenting on Jiang Ming, he was actually alluding to him?
“It doesn’t matter if there’s a long time to go!” Tai Jian slammed his sword and groaned, “Brother Changfeng, what would happen if the sword slash just now was actually headed at you?”
“I’m actually quite curious myself!” Riyue Changfeng’s smile suddenly triumphed, “Would you like to try it out?”
“I won’t dare to do so before I’m sure of myself!” Tai Jian shook his head honestly, “I’m not like that idiot Bi Jiu. He made a rash move before even figuring out your true details. In the end, he was suppressed and rendered to become a beast guarding the gate.”
“Enough chatters! I’m off to snatch the head of the Great Demon Venerate. I can’t say that I’d have the opportunity to ascend to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor, but I can at least try out my swordsmanship so that I may be able to sanctify my path of Dao.”
At this time, he was extraordinarily high-profiled and flamboyant, showing his sharp edges, just like his sword.
Just as he turned around and was about to leave, Yu Fei could be seen pacing over and landed right next to him, smiling softly: “Jian, it’s such a pity that you couldn’t kill that little brute! I thought you would hunt him directly into the Tianyuan Realm and kill him!”
By just standing there, there were thousands of amorous feelings permeating the surrounding that made even the air gulping with greed and lust.
“Do you think I’m doing this for you?” Tai Jian smiled strangely.
“Aren’t you?” Yu Fei paced over lightly as though she was on a lotus leaf, swaying her hips around as she took each step. In the blink of an eye, she was already in front of him before holding up a jade seal and placing it in front of Tai Jian’s face.
Taijian didn’t dodge, but grabbed onto her jade-like hand and sniffed them in front of his lips before saying, “It’s both a yes and a no! I have long been very curious about this mortal human. That was why I wanted to test my swordsmanship on him and also to test on his capability. Of course, since you’ve requested, I will have to do something. After all, you are famous for being the most beautiful, the most coquettish and the most pleasant person in the Honggu world. With your ever-changing postures and fluctuating temperament, I would also like to have a taste of your beauty. After all, the ones who were able to get ahold of you were of the most outstanding people in the world. Examples are the Great Demon Venerate, the Demon Saint Lord and also the Heavenly Emperor who is not known to outsiders.”
Yu Fei was not angry at all, but raised her chin as her eyes swirled, and was gleaming full of amorous feelings. Her jade-like hand gently shook Tai Jian’s palm away before holding onto his chin.
She looked straight into Tai Jian’s eyes and said with a smile, “Because I am the darling of the world and the carrier of the great Dao of Yin, getting ahold of me will not only show others of your great status, but also help to improve your cultivation realm. Jian, if you really want me, then help me kill the Great Demon Venerate or Jiang Ming!”
“Haha!” Tai Jian laughed out loud and hugged her waist, “Would you like to stay by my side and let us kill the Great Demon Venerate together?”
“He’s going to go mad!”
“No matter how mad he comes, he’s still but only a lost dog!”
“The others will be mad as well! I’m afraid you can’t bear it!”
“Oh, who else is there?”
Upon asking so, Tai Jian immediately felt the evil gaze from various experts.
He smiled, then shook his head, “Yu Fei, you really are the number one pet of the world!”
“I’m the pet?” Yu Fei smiled coquettishly, “You should say that you’re the actual pet!”
*Clap clap...*
Tai Jian applauded and couldn’t help admiring, “It’s because of your shameless nature that you have the hope of sanctifying the way of Dao!”
Upon saying that, Tai Jian turned his head suddenly.
Yu Fei also looked into the distance at the same time.
“Brother Jiang, I didn’t expect you to come in person!” Riyue Changfeng also turned around, looked at where he came from, and smiled, “Don’t blame me for not making a move. Limited by the rules here, there is nothing I could’ve done! Also, why do you dare to come in person? ”
“Everyone in the world thought that I was relying on the Tianyuan Realm to protect myself, hence wanted to try and bully me. This is why I come forward in person and also to let the world know a little more what’s under my sleeves!” Jiang Ming’s voice echoed in all directions.
As soon as his clone was destroyed, Jiang Ming sensed it immediately.
Through the eyes of the clone, he also saw Tai Jian and learned about his basic situation.
Of course, understanding him was secondary.
The main thing was why would this bastard dare to make his move against Jiang Ming himself without any injustice or hatred to begin with.
It was a finishing move at that.
Since it was a finishing move, that means he has become the mortal enemy of his.
From Jiang Ming’s point of view, mortal enemies must be killed.
He didn’t want to cause trouble casually but was not afraid of trouble either.
Jiang Ming also understood that the previous successive great battles, the killing of the Venerates, obviously did not form a strong deterrent. Otherwise, how would Tai Jian dare to provoke him?
Jiang Ming went through the Human Path Record.
Name: Tai Jian (Nine Leaf Sword Grass).
Race: Innate Saint Spirit.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation: Quasi-Sage
Background: The Supreme Elder of the Taishang Sword Sect of the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Relationship: -78
Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status: At the beginning of Heaven and Earth, at time immemorial, the world had undergone countless creations, giving birth to countless miracles. Among which there was a spirit that bore the innate swordsmanship since birth.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 2) Translation
: It took 100,000 years for a piece of leaf to grow, carrying one type of Sword Dao in it.
: After 900,000 years, all nine leaves were completely grown. Hidden deep within them were nine types of Sword Dao, hence called the Nine Leaf Sword Grass.
: By chance, the three rays of light of the sun, the moon, and the stars met, producing a drop of the Triple Divine Luminance Water which fell onto the Nine Leaf Sword Grass. Hence, the grass was given wisdom and the legend of the grass began.
: Nine Leaf Sword Grass had opened up to a path of rapid growth. Although it was a mere grass, it had the power to cut through the void of the sky and cut down the edges of the stars.
: While growing quietly, it also killed some creatures that coveted its body and discovered that swallowing the blood essence of these beheaded creatures with its roots allowed it to quickly improve itself. Hence, it started a crazy hunting spree.
: Then it met a peerless expert with a terrifying Sword Dao, who suppressed it easily. The expert wanted to kill it at first, but pitied its great talent in Sword Dao and thus accepted it as his disciple, bestowing it the name Tai Jian.
: The expert was the Taishang Sword Master, who later became the Taishang Saint Lord, the master of swordsmanship, finally realizing the Sword Dao of Heaven and broke through to the Saint Realm.
: Being brought around by the Taishang Sword Master, it was able to see the vastness of the world, broaden his horizons, and listen to a deeper level of Sword Dao teachings. These allowed it to understand its own inadequacies, continued to absorb the essence and grew step by step.
: After its metamorphosis and the growth of billions of years, his sharp edges were gradually erased. After the Taishang Sword Master sanctified his way of Dao and founded the Taishang Sword sect, Tai Jian managed it on his behalf.
: The world was chaotic with various ups and downs. However, as the great disciple of the Saint Lord, he was naturally able to stay away from these. In fact, he could sit high above the heavens, overlooking the vicissitudes of life in the world.
: After the Saint Lord left, he alone was in charge of the Taishang Sword Sect and was at hold of total authority.
: During the last battle to destroy the Heavenly Emperor, he participated. He had the intention of taking over the throne, but was defeated by Tai Yuan, leaving him no choice but to retreat and admit that Tai Yuan was qualified to be the next Heavenly Emperor.
: This time around where the Abyss turned against the heavens, Tai Jian contributed a lot to the whole ordeal.
: When he saw the Great Heavenly Venerate evoking a blow onto the world, he was shocked; when he saw the Great Demon Venerate had 12 hidden Venerates in his sleeves, his heart skipped a beat and he couldn’t help but scolded: This old man had so much to hide! Damn this bastard! When I kill you in the future, I must fondle Yu Fei!
: Upon watching the Heavenly Emperor’s outburst and the many hidden tricks up his sleeves, he was even more terrified. He suddenly discovered that it was better for him to just stick to cultivating his Sword Dao. The position as the Heavenly Emperor and competition that goes along with it were all bullshit!
: To not compete for the throne? He is not willing to do so! However, he could take this opportunity to test and hone his swordsmanship, in hope of going further and entering the realm of Demi-Sage.
: There is also that little brat of Yu Fei! He wouldn’t be able to reconcile without getting a chance to play with her!
: The Heavenly Emperor has fallen and it’s the Great Demon Venerable next!
: This guy actually escaped into the Abyss. It turned out that he actually found the Dao square sealed by the Holy Demon Venerate. So what if he does get inside? He is still a sitting duck!
: A lot of old experts were pursuing him!
: No matter if it’s the Holy Weapon of the Great Demon Venerate, the Heavenly Emperor’s imperial order or the Sage Venerates Dao Square, they were all treasures that would make people go crazy for and no one would be willing to fall behind!
: On the way here, Yu Fei actually seduced me.
: Haha, this little brat is interesting! Wanting to let me deal with Jiang Ming from Tianyuan Realm? Just because the Jiang Ming did not warm up to her and almost blew up her two hums?
: Heh! However, she really is beautiful. With every frown, smile, and every move, she fascinates people and even my heart of Supreme Sword has been ignited in an unknown flame!
: Well, anyway! I’ve wanted to try what Jiang Ming has for a long time. If he does come, I’ll give him a sword slash!
: To think that he’s actually here! A clone that could block my sword slash and escape with the soul remnant intact. This Jiang Ming should not be underestimated.
: The fool Riyue Changfeng! How can I get rid of him! Alas, forget it! This guy is even more mysterious and shouldn’t be provoked easily.
: Hehe, Yu Fei is also here now and she is still seducing me.
: Well, let’s wait for another day and I’ll show you the power of my long sword.
: Hey, Jiang Ming actually comes over in person. Is he trying to provoke me? Anyway, I shall take this opportunity to kill him.
This was Tai Jian’s ‘Status’. Although it was simple, it also summarized the first half of his life.
He was the Nine Leaf Sword Grass obtaining the path of Dao and the great disciple of Taishang Saint Lord.
This guy was still relatively naive. In terms of conspiracy and tricks, he obviously was incomparable to the Great Demon Venerate and the Heavenly Emperor, but his strength was very powerful.
He was a proper Quasi-Sage of the later level.
“What can you do?” Hearing Jiang Ming’s words, Tai Jian sneered, “It’s just detonating Dao vessels to explode their energy, isn’t it. How many times can you detonate them? And how many Dao vessels do you even have?”
Riyue Changfeng had a strange look on his face.
‘How many Dao vessels does he have? You’d be scared to death if you found out.’
At the same time, he also felt a little gloating that this guy was going to be unlucky!
“It’s not a problem to kill you!” Jiang Ming said, “Dang, you eunuch! You don’t have the sacks that make a man. How will you be able to let Yu Fei crawl in front of you?”
Taijian was slightly startled.
However, Yu Fei’s eyes lit up, licked her lips, and smiled indifferently, “Jian, he said that you are a eunuch of the mortal dynasty. That is, a man without his balls!”
Taijian raised his eyebrows as they burst out with two sword beams, and sneered, “A mere feeble being, eloquent with words!”
“Why do you call it eloquent? I’m simply telling the truth!” Jiang Ming said sincerely, “Are you of the Nine Leaf Sword Grass Dao?”
“Of course!”
“Is the Nine Leaf Sword Grass Dao considered grass?”
“This… It counts! But it’s the supreme existence of the grass!”
“That’s also still grass!”
“Why do I feel like you’re scolding me?”
“Grass, aren’t you a grass! Listen again, your name is Tai Jian (A homophone in Mandarin, which can mean Eunuch), did I say it wrong?”

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Nine Leaf Sword Grass, Silver Luminance Battle Armor (Part 3)
“I am Tai Jian, not a eunuch!”
“A eunuch is a eunuch!”
“You’ve completely angered me!” Tai Jian inexplicably became furious and he was done talking about it, “I’ll kill you first and then the Great Demon Venerate! Yu Fei, watch the battle for me!”
“Alright! If you kill him, I will accompany you for 1,000 years!” Yu Fei said tenderly.
“Haha! Wonderful!” Tai Jian chuckled twice before his long sword turned and an aura that could pierce through heaven rose into the sky, causing the Abyss to tremble and the nine illusionment to howl.
“I still remember when my master once said that a grain of soil can fill the sea, and a single blade of grass can cut down even the moon!”
“This first slash is called the Moon Slash!”
Clang!
The sword qi was of extreme Yang and rigidity. It was invincible and seemed as though it existed specifically to destroy the Extreme Yin Stellar that represented the land of extreme yin.
As Jiang Ming moved his foot, an illusory long river appeared, mighty and surging. It was the long river of history.
At the beginning of the long river, a figure could be seen walking out of it. It was the Past Body.
At an unknown distance following the flow of the river, another figure could also be seen walking out of it. It was the Future body.
The Present Body on the other hand appeared directly, raising one finger of his hand. The three fingers combined the power of destruction of body, destruction of soul and destruction of heart into one and exploded into a devastating blow of Dao energy that smashed through the sword slash.
The three clones launched their attacks at the same time.
“This special ability is amazing!” Tai Jian exclaimed. Billions of sword lights spewed out of his body, turning into a performance of a world of swords, distorting even the laws of the Abyss.
How terrifying was that of a Sword Dao this was?
However, the three clones were not afraid at all.
Boom...
The great battle broke out as the sky of the Abyss was drowned by the surging powers in an instant.
The sword slash that cut through anything and everything.
The technique that destroyed the infinite laws.
These two powers continuously intertwined with each other.
In an instant, the radius of 100,000 miles was smashed into chaos. Void vortices, black hole cracks and the likes appeared from time to time.
The Abyss was under great damage again.
The earth cracked and the sky collapsed.
A group of experts who came to the Abyss to decimate the Great Demon Venerate also gathered around to watch this peerless great battle.
Jiang Ming stood on the long river of history and watched silently.
If Tai Jian had no other means up his sleeves, he would be able to suppress the opponent with his three clones.
However, knowing the background of this opponent of his, it was almost impossible to win the fight easily.
Whether it’s his status as the great disciple of the Saint or the supreme elder of the Taishang Sword Sect, his background was absolutely terrifying.
He felt some vague murderous intent.
Without having to look for it carefully, he could also guess that they were very likely coming from the Venerates of the Taishang Sword Sect.
Being a Sacred Land, it’s unjustified not to have a few Venerates among them.
Boom...
The great torrent exploded and Tai Jian was blasted thousands of miles away. Blood dripped from the corner of his mouth and the look on his face was extremely bad.
At this moment, a piece of armor appeared on his body, shining with silver luminance and flowing with endless scriptures, protecting his whole body.
“You actually forced out my Silver Luminance Battle Armor!” Tai Jian’s voice was solemn and the sword qi that revolved around his body kept disillusioning, “This is the life-saving item that Master specially refined for me before he left. I didn’t even evoke it when I was against the Great Demon Venerate. I didn’t expect to be so embarrassed by you, a little guy who is not yet of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm!”
“If it wasn’t because of this armor, you’d be dead!” Jiang Ming snorted, “Tai Jian! Just retreat and we’ll let this skirmish be over!”
“Haha...” Tai Jian laughed wildly in the sky, “I am a disciple of the Saint Lord, the supreme elder of the Sacred Land. To think that I’ve been given alms of retreat? This is a humiliation to me. Jiang Ming, in this Abyss today, if it’s not the burial of yours, then it would be of mine!”
“Then die!” Jiang Ming howled as he launched his attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - Heavenly Dao Sword Technique, a Killing Spree
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Heavenly Dao Sword Technique, a Killing Spree
The river of history trembled, setting off monstrous waves.
The three clones began their attack again.
This time, a pair of fist gloves appeared on the Past Body. They gave off bluish glow, and they seemed to be holding intense power. They were the Canglan Fist gloves, a pair of Quasi-Sage Weapons he got from the Supreme Pagoda.
His defensive capability grew and the power of the Killer Civilization Punch Technique increased by leaps and bounds.
The God Crusher on the finger of the Present Body was a Quasi-Sage Weapon as well. It was a powerful weapon that could crush one’s body and soul in a single strike, and Tai Jian was confident that he couldn’t guard against an attack from it even with his Silver Luminance Battle Armor.
As for the Future Body, while he was casting the Entombing Sky Illusory Palm, his palms formed into two black holes. Inside the black holes there were seven needles. Each needle was Great Overarching Dao Vessels, and the power of the formation they formed into was no inferior to that of a Quasi-Sage Weapon.
“They are only clones but they could use such powerful Dao Vessels?” Tai Jian’s face was dark.
With his Silver Luminance Battle Armor, the tide of the battle should be on his side, but the three clones were too powerful.
The three clones ignored him. They continued to surround and attack him.
“Three-Talented Formation is done!” The Present Body said with a confident smile.
While the three of them were attacking him, they were adjusting their locations, and it was only now that they successfully trapped Tai Jian in the Three-Talented Formation.
The Three-Talented Formation was simple. Even though it was simple, it still sent a chill down Tai Jian’s spine.
He thought of his ability to detonate Dao Vessels, and the three surrounding him were just clones.
For a moment, his heart sank.
“What are you still waiting for? If you’re not coming at me, then I’ll be coming at you!” Tai Jian shouted angrily. He activated the Holy Dao Sword Technique, and in that second, he gave off a feeling that he had disappeared from everyone’s vision.
It seemed as if he had become the Dao himself, and the aura around him surged by leaps and bounds.
However, the three clones looked at him indifferently.
With a cold smile tugging at the corner of his lips, the Present Body said, “What are we waiting for? We’re waiting for you to ask for help!”
“Waiting for me to ask for help?” Tai Jian was stunned and he nearly deactivated his skill. Apparently, he had noticed something.
“You want me to lure all of the experts in the Taishang Sword Sect so that you can get rid of them as well?”
Since you’re my enemy, then I should just kill all of you,” the Present Body said coldly as he pointed his finger at Tai Jian’s forehead.
“Hah, kill all of us?” Tai Jian scoffed, “I suggest you not count your chickens before they hatch!
“Heavenly Dao Sword Technique!” Tai Jian shouted as countless sword energies erupted from his sword.
However, just as all of the sword energies were homing toward their target, they stopped midair.
The Past Body and the Future Body had cast a restriction spell on them as well as Tai Jian. he couldn’t control his sword anymore and his attack failed. Even the Silver Luminance Battle Armor had lost its brilliance and he was shocked.
Before he could do anything, Present Body had placed his finger on his forehead. Even though the Silver Luminance Battle Armor was a Demi-Sage Weapon and its defensive capability was unparalleled, it had lost half of its defensive ability due to the restriction spell the Past Body and the Future Body placed on Tai Jian. The Present Body seized his chance and pierced through Tai Jian’s forehead.
However, in the next second, a wooden doll materialized itself in front of Tai Jian. It gave off a brilliant glow and the sword energies began to surround Tai Jian.
The wound on his forehead began to heal at a rapid pace and his Primal Spirit was restored. Life began to return to his body and then he disappeared from everyone’s sight.
At the same time, a hole appeared on the wooden doll. It began to crack and crumbled into pieces.
The three clones were shocked.
A hundred thousand miles away, Tai Jian appeared. He looked toward the direction of the Clones, his face fully written with fear.
“What kind of attack was that? It can even affect my Demi-Sage Weapon!
“He’s not even a Great Overarching, but he has the power to fight toe-to-toe with me. Who is he? Had it not been for the wooden puppet, I would’ve been dead by now. That wooden puppet was forged by my master with supreme sacred wood and it got destroyed just like that. Master, can you sense it?
“Wait a second! This isn’t right. Yu Fei has fought with him before, so she should know about his power. D*mn it, how could she not tell me about that?”
On the other side, Tai Jian had sent out help as soon as the three clones completed the Three -Talented Formation. Two venerates from the Taishang Sword Sect that had been watching the fight from the sideline stepped in without any hesitation. They knew that Jiang Ming was the true body, and as long as they killed him, everything would be over.
One of the venerates was a woman named Tai Shu who cultivated the Water Dao. Drawing water from the surroundings, she formed them into a barrage of water swords and threw them all toward Jiang Ming.
Another one was named Tai Jin. He cultivated the Metal Dao. The sword energy he formed was able to slash through the sky and was unbreakable.
Jiang Ming stood on top of the river of history with his hands clasped on his back. He was unperturbed at their presence since this was something that he had expected.
“Finally decide to show yourself? I’ll kill all of you from the Taishang Sword Sect today!” Jiang Ming said, his expression blank.
Four clones appeared beside him. The two on the left activated the restriction spell and dispelled the attacks of Tai Shui and Tai Jin, stunning both of them.
In the meantime, the remaining two clones on his right side cast the time-and-space restriction technique and restricted both Tai Shui and Tai Jin’s movements.
However, both of them soon broke themselves free of the restriction. Just when they were going to fight back, a river consisting of a total of 81 Taiyi Weapons and three Great Overarching Dao Vessels surrounded them.
“Explode!” Jiang Ming barked out his order, and all 81 Dao Vessels exploded at the same time. At the same time as the weapons exploded, he called back the imprintment on the Taiyi Weapons.
This was the extended ability of the Sacrificial Artifact Judgment after he had developed it.
It was just that he couldn’t retrieve the souls of the Great Overarching Dao Vessels right now, and this kind of devastating damage was nothing to him.
The explosion ripped the space apart and engulfed everything in it. Nothing could survive the explosion.
At the same time, Tai Jian turned his head around and looked toward this direction.
Jiang Ming turned his head away from Tai Jin and Tai Shui as he knew both of their fates were sealed.
He looked at Tai Jian and a grim smile broke across his face. “Now, it’s your turn!”

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - I’m the Heavenly Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: I’m the Heavenly Dao
The Dao vessels that Jiang Ming evoked, formed a large array formation. Upon detonation, its power surged and collapsed into the middle, rendering its destructive power to be even more terrifying and lethality stronger. The ripple from the explosion that spread throughout the place was correspondingly reduced a lot, hence a much smaller scope of impact.
Even so, the Abyss below was still torn apart by the bombardment.
The other experts who watched the battle from a distance were shocked. They were all asking themselves what would happen to them if they were to face such an explosion.
Death was imminent.
When they looked at Jiang Ming again, their impression of him had changed greatly.
The two were Venerates and yet Jiang Ming killed them both indifferently.
Although he was quite famous in the past, the fact that he had not yet reached the Great Overarching Realm led to many experts speculating it as just a glorified rumor. After all, how could he kill the Venerate if he had not even entered the Great Overarching Realm?
Wasn’t this just pulling people’s legs?
However, they had to believe it now, whether they liked to or not.
Some even gave Jiang Ming more credit than he already had.
The power of destruction was quickly engulfed by the torn space fissure. Looking over at Tai Jin and Tai Shui, there were no longer traces of the two left but only some fragmentary remnants.
Those were the scattered fragments of the Dao vessels that were destroyed.
Even Quasi-Sage Weapons were destroyed?
Such a scene was even more frightening than it already was.
Even Riyue Changefeng thought that the whole battle was filled with splendid events. He was secretly amazed at Jiang Ming after witnessing the great battle.
