It might have seemed that Jiang Ming did not have much under his sleeves, each of them were unexpected and powerful enough to make people’s souls tremble.
‘Once he goes a step further and his inner world sublimates, what extent would he reach?’ Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help pondering again, ‘This world will no longer be enough for him. When the time comes, only the Sea of Chaos can be the stage for him to show his peerless elegance.’
Jiang Ming naturally sensed various looks with different intentions from many but he ignored all of them. As he stepped on the long river of history, he looked at Tai Jian.
On the upper left, the Human Path Record was opened, and new information about the other person’s ‘Status’ was updated.
‘Puppet Substitution. His master Taishang Saint Lord made the Puppet Substitution from the Saint wood, which could be used to help receive an instance of a fatal blow and then teleport the user to another place!’
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but marvel in his heart. He was indeed a disciple of the Saint Lord to even possess such a life-saving treasure.
This was equivalent to an extra life.
“Do you have a second life-saving treasure?”
Jiang Ming paced onwards on the long river of history.
The three clones jumped and landed on the long river, undulating with the waves. Anyone who saw it would’ve thought that this was a real river.
“Jiang Ming, how dare you kill the two elders of my Taishang Sword Sect!” Tai Jian was extremely furious. Flames could be seen flaring in his eyes, scorching the void and burning small holes all around.
“Just look at what you’re saying. You want to kill me; they want to kill me. Why would I not dare to kill them? Are they the Gods from heaven?” Jiang Ming sneered, “You damn eunuch. Not only did I want to kill them, but I’m also killing you as well, killing everyone who wants to kill me!”
“You die once! I’ll let you die a second time!”
“Die!”
Jiang Ming took the initiative to charge over.
His three clones went along with him, staring down at Tai Jian.
“Jiang Ming, now that I know of your tricks! I don’t believe that you are invincible!” Tai Jian opened his mouth and spat out eight divine swords, each of which was a top-grade Great Overarching Golden Immortal Dao vessel. The swords were dazzling in brilliance while the swords aura shocked the sky.
“Sword Body Sacrificial, Body Sword Consolidation!”
The eight swords formed a sword array formation. In a glimpse, they merged into his body, allowing his power to suddenly skyrocket, triggering the various rules of Sword Dao!”
Within a million miles, the sword energy vibrated.
Its sharp lethal power caused dense cracks to appear in the space. Even the bystanders retreated into the distance.
Looking through the world, there were only a few who can compare to Tai Jian’s strength.
There were even fewer who were truly sure of defeating him.
Even the Lord Buddha was not sure if he could emerge victorious.
However, he didn’t stop there.
The Quasi-Sage Sword suspended in front of Tai Jian’s body burst out with a more powerful sword intent, splitting the earth and reaching the heavens.
As he turned around, he merged into the long sword.
The sword’s light shone, but its power remained dormant. As soon as the sword tip turned to face Jiang Ming, even the void trembled. In an instant, three trillion strands of materialized sword energy were condensed out of thin air.
Each of the sword strands was infused with rules of Sword Dao.
“Sword of Heavenly Dao. I am Heavenly Dao! Kill!”
Tai Jian’s voice turned into deafening thunders, rumbling in the sky like tidal waves. The long sword jumped, got before Jiang Ming in an instance and headed straight at his eyebrows.
Three trillion swords were also encircling and suppressing Jiang Ming at the same time.
Upon seeing this scene, all of the bystanders were astounded.
“Such a great Sword Body Sacrificial, Body Sword Consolidation. This special ability is legitimately of the Saint Law!” Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help applauding in admiration, “By merging the sword array formation into his body, not only does it stimulate the power of the eight Dao vessels, but also builds up terrifying power of the great array formation, all of which are merged into his own body. It didn’t end there. The body is integrated into the Dao Vessel that sanctifies the way of Dao, so that his power can be further improved, reaching the very limit. Such a Saint-level technique has unparalleled power. However, with the whole volume of power being overwhelming, it is a great burden for one’s own body and will. A slight mistake would have resulted in his primal soul destroyed. ”
‘It seems that he is really giving it his all! Brother Jiang, how are you going to deal with this?’ Riyue Changfeng pondered.
On the other side, Yu Fei’s beautiful eyes flashed.
As she looked at Jiang Ming and then at the long sword, she placed her jade-like finger near her lips with a silly smile on her face.
Slightly opening her petite mouth, she licked the tip of her fingers and muttered, “Who will be the winner? Who will be the loser? No matter who wins, they will still end up under my skirt! I really look forward to that scene!”
Yu Fei had already begun to fantasize.
She wanted to ride her lips like a horse.
In a distance not far away, the Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch and Vermillion Bird were standing quite close to each other.
Such a scene made them nod their heads inexplicably thinking that they wouldn’t be able to even withstand such a blow themselves.
They might even be severely injured or even end up getting killed if they were not careful.
“As expected of Tai Jian, the number one swordsman in the world today. This Saint-level technique that he has evoked could be said to be at the pinnacle of combat power. I wouldn’t even be able to withstand such an attack even with the strongest defensive special ability that I know of!” The Dragon Monarch was amazed as he commented through telepathic transmission.
“Who’s to say the opposite?” Vermillion Bird said as well, “We all know of Tai Jian’s capabilities, but this mortal human Jiang Ming is a mystery. Can you all learn anything from looking at him?”
The four of them were connected by consciousness and were telepathically transmitting their thoughts at an extremely fast pace.
“Amitabha, the illusory long river that he has conjured has the shadow of fate and the power of fate. The three incarnations were all conjured through powers of different natures. They can exert at least 80% of the power of his real self. This itself is very sky-defying already, but every incarnation even has special abilities that are comparable to the Saint-level techniques. This is both unthinkable and unheard of!”
“This kind of special ability has a shadow of transcendence. I am afraid that the ordinary Saint-level techniques can’t even compare to this! The Saint-level special techniques of my Demon Holy Palace are not weak in terms of might. However, the foundation and underlying potential seems to be falling a little bit short when compared to his. This is unimaginable! What’s even more unimaginable is that not only can he detonate his own Dao vessel, but he can also even control other people’s Dao weapons! How unthinkable is that! It’s like I’ve become a Buddha myself!”
“Amitabha, I, the Buddha, is here!”
“Bald donkey, you’re looking for a fight!”
“*Cough* Amitabha! This special ability of his is truly incredible! Alas! A Dao Weapon is supposed to be an item that directly relates to the person. How can he affect such an item? It’s no wonder that Tai Jian almost died and two old guys from Taishang Sword Sect died tragically. Not to mention there’s also the previous Demon Venerate, Northern Emperor and the likes! Alas, this mortal human child is really a freak!”
“Let’s hope that Tai Jian can manage to kill him. Otherwise, once this kid’s cultivation realm improves, who else can deal with him? I know that I myself as an old dragon can’t do it!”
“The Heavenly Emperor just died! The Buddha said that he cannot be let alive!”
“He killed the Thousand Snakes Venerate and must be killed!”
“In today’s world, great experts should be standing side by side. There is no need for an existence that reigns above all living beings!”
The three of them quietly reached an agreement. As for the real reason, it seemed that only they themselves knew.
A technique to control Dao vessels?
The three clones conjured from the long river of history?
The mystery of Tianyuan Realm?
Who knew!
However, the very next scene caused even the three peak-leveled experts to have a look of shock on their faces.
In the center of the great battle, everyone had in mind that they would’ve had to desperately stand their ground in the face of Tai Jian’s blow,
Surprisingly, Jiang Ming didn’t do anything when faced with such an attack.
The sword that was aimed at piercing between the eyebrows was resisted by an invisible force, making it difficult for it to inch onward.
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!”
The Past body, the Present body and the Future body, all three of these clones evoked the same special ability at the same time. The powers produced were superimposed, allowing their effects to reach an extreme height.
Right this very moment, Tai Jian was also mind blown when he saw how Jiang Ming blocked off his attack.
After all, he could ‘see’ clearly that Jiang Ming didn’t manipulate his immortal origin, nor did he use his special ability or had a Dao Vessel to protect himself.
Even if there was, he had the confidence to kill his enemy in one slash.
But what was the result? Was it blocked off? It was indeed blocked off!
Even if a Saint were to come in person, the Saint would’ve been injured in the face of this sword slash.
However, his opponent was able to block it? Tai Jian felt confused, shocked and mind blown.
At that very moment, he was affected by the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. Even though he had already anticipated and even thought of a way to deal with the technique by connecting all his Dao vessels into one body, the slight slip of mind caused the several Dao vessels to be affected at the same time.
Boom...
As the sword luminance exploded, a long sword was separated from his body.
Tai Jian was damaged by the techniques backlash as he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood. His face was pale, while his qi and blood were weakened.
“Die!”
Seemingly to have expected the outcome long ago, Jiang Ming lifted a finger of his and evoked the Return of Infinite Law Finger.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - Besiege me? I’ll Annihilate Your Entire Sect and Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Besiege me? I’ll Annihilate Your Entire Sect and Clan
Currently, Tai Jian, the Great Monarch of Taishang Sword Sect was a peerless being in the late stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm. He was Nine Leaf Sword Grass who obtained Dao and used to be brought around by Taishang Saint Lord.
His nature was sky-defying as his talent was unparalleled.
With his peerless swordsmanship, his attacks were unparalleled.
From the sword slash that he performed just now, even Saint Lord would’ve had to temporarily retreat when faced with such an attack. Who in the world could withstand it head-on?
However, the result was not only beyond Tai Jian’s expectations, but also caused many experts who were watching the battle to be dumbfounded.
Not only did Jiang Ming fight head-on, he also did not put up any defense.
In the end, nothing happened to him at all.
This completely subverted the expectations of all the experts.
Not only Tai Jian’s mind was sent trembling.
Even a great existence like the Heavenly Buddha almost cursed out of shock.
However, the Heavenly Buddha was quick to react. Seeing that Tai Jian was about to be killed, he pointed a finger, which pierced through the void, and appeared?in front of Tai Jian as a golden yet thick finger, blocking off the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique.
Boom...
Blinding golden luminance exploded as the torrents swept through the surrounding area.
Tai Jian, who was also startled by the sudden exchange, retreated himself quickly.
Heavenly Buddha’s finger had some cracked on it. The finger that he had used to block off the attack had golden blood on it as the finger returned to its owner. As he lifted his hand and looked at his finger, the index finger on his right hand was full of cracks. He was unable to help but marveled, “What I have here is the finger of the Immortal King Kong Buddha. To think that it was almost cripple. Little friend Jiang Ming...”
He sat cross-legged on the golden lotus, swept across the void and soon came to Tai Jian’s side. As he looked at Jiang Ming, he smiled compassionately and muttered, “That one finger attacking technique of yours just now, had three thousand Daos, three thousand laws, and the rules of the universe integrated into one. If you were in the Great Overarching Realm, with one finger just now, you could’ve pierced through the Abyss and the heaven at the same time. Such special ability can no longer be described as mind blowing, but should be described as a single finger pointed out marks the end of the era, unparalleled by anyone! ”
Such an evaluation of a person’s technique that came out directly from the mouth of the Heavenly Buddha, was simply too high.
“Flattering me? Well, it doesn’t matter. However, you actually stopped me from killing my sworn enemy.” Jiang Ming looked at the Heavenly Buddha with a very solemn expression, “Do you know what this means?”
“It’s easier to make enemies than to resolve a grudge!” Heavenly Buddha smiled as he continued, “With the Heaven Court fallen and the Heavenly Emperor perished, coupled with the fact that it’s time to take care of the catastrophe in the Abyss, why should we cling to such a family feud and give the Great Demon Venerate a chance to snicker?”
“Tai Jian, how about putting all these down?”
He turned to look at his old friend.
“Thanks a lot just now!” Tai Jian clasped his fists and cupped his hands with an inexplicable look on his face.
Even until now, he still felt palpitations.
His unwavering will that stood strong for eternity even started to sway.
He almost died just now. He was really going to die. If it weren’t for Heavenly Buddha’s intervention, he would’ve definitely died.
To think that he, the monarch of the Taishang Sword Sect, the disciple of the Saint Lord, who ran rampant through the archaic, ancient modern and even current time was almost killed by a younger generation.
Humiliation and despair suddenly filled his heart, leaving a disgusting taste in his mouth.
However, he quickly suppressed the many thoughts of his.
As his eyes gleamed, Tai Jian was able to clearly see the hidden meanings behind the Heavenly Buddha’s eye, but muttered with great hatred, “Since the Heavenly Buddha has spoken, I’ll let go of it this time and settle with him next time around!”
“Great virtue!!” Heavenly Buddha smiled and nodded. He then looked at Jiang Ming again, “Little friend, how about you?”
“Little friend?” Jiang Ming sneered, “You stopped me from killing my mortal enemy, leave me a peerless expert who may kill me at any point and still condescendingly call me a “little friend”. Heavenly Buddha, who gave you such confidence?”
“Little friend, the human world has already suffered endless catastrophe, why do you need to cause more?” Dragon Monarch, who was wearing a golden robe, also paced over with his hands behind his back. His eyes were cold and indifferent, “If you are not willing to give face to Heavenly Buddha, then give face to me and let this skirmish be done with!”
“Ha! Ha! Ha!” Jiang Ming laughed three times and stopped abruptly. His facial expression was extremely indifferent as he muttered, “To even refer to me as a ‘little friend’, are you perceiving me as a young person that is easy to be deceived or did I kill too few Venerates? You, as an old dragon, only know to use your age to feel superior. Give face to you? What do you even amount to? Sooner or later you will be my meal on a plate!”
“What a short temper!” Dragon Monarch’s anger flashed through his face.
If it wasn’t for himself having great self-restraint, he would have already made a move.
Of course, what he felt more was fear.
However, considering that he was the Dragon Clan’s monarch, his status had always been high since ancient times, even to present. Even the former Saint Lord had to treat him with courtesy, but now he was publicly humiliated by a human child. How was he not to be angry!
His killing intent grew even more intense.
“I’m sure that you will die sooner or later because of this!” Dragon Monarch gave his verdict.
Jiang Ming ignored him and instead looked at Vermillion Bird who was also pacing over, “You want to stop me too?”
“Young man, it’s easy to burn into ashes by the flame of anger!” Vermillion Bird was clad in a red coat, with flames burning behind her. She looked like a mere 18-year-old young maiden, but her eyes were of extreme vicissitudes.
No warmth could be felt from her smile.
Tai Jian watched silently, with a look of surprise.
The Heavenly Buddha remained cheerful while being covered in golden luminance.
A stream of light flickered above Dragon Monarch’s head before materializing into thunder for a split second, transforming into vast ocean and even became a scene of pure chaos, as though he was someone not to be messed with.
Yu Fei who was in the distance on the other hand, couldn’t help twisting her waist as she raised her jade-like finger and sucked it in her mouth.
It looked as though she was sucking on a stiff hard lollipop, savoring its great flavor.
“What will this kid choose?” Yu Fei whispered to herself with a look of excitement, yearning to have a go at him, “If he does, it might even make me shudder! But this is so worth looking forward to!”
“Such a juvenile young face, such exuberant vitality, such a powerful cultivation base, such peerless techniques. To top it off, he is even an elegant and handsome human race. Tsk tsk tsk! He’s really tantalizingly mouth-watering!”
“I can’t help it!”
She twisted her body around as if she was suppressing some kind of flowing crystalline from oozing out of her.
Riyue Changfeng on the other hand, placed his hands behind his back, as he allowed the windy breeze to caress himself.
He looked over at Jiang Ming with amazement.
He then took a glance at Heavenly Buddha and the other experts again, with a hint of ridicule in his eyes.
‘This is becoming interesting!’
A futon suddenly appeared behind him. As he sat down, a low stool appeared in front of him and even had cups with teapots appearing on top.
The great aroma of the tea had already lingered around the surrounding area as he poured himself a cup and took a sip.
“Yummy!”
Riyue Changefeng continued slurping and sipping away.
He was preparing to honestly watch a big play.
Jiang Ming took a glance around. With his intelligence, how could he not see that these few were bullying him and even wanted to trigger him into acting violently before taking the stand and killing him in the name of justice?
Their intentions were also clearly recorded on the Human Path Record.
Heavenly Buddha was now the Lord Buddha of Buddhism.
Back then, he was an extremely cruel Six-winged Golden Cicada. Having hunted and killed who knew how many creatures, he even fought against the Lord Buddha who had yet to become a Holy Buddha Venerate at that time. He wanted to swallow his opponent whole, but ended up being subjugated as expected.
After he was being forcefully subjugated, the Lord Buddha used the Buddhism and Taoism techniques to remove his aura of death before accepting him.
Later, he followed the Holy Buddha Venerate who founded the Fo Sect and became the second Lord Buddha himself. He was now the only Lord Buddha left.
He came here because he found out that Jiang Ming was growing too fast and that he would become a great threat to him. He also wanted to find out about the secrets of Jiang Ming and wanted to find an excuse to kill him.
As for Dragon Monarch, there wasn’t much to say about him. Other than being yet to sanctify his way of Dao, his life was filled with moments of brilliance. The Dragon Clan was the most prosperous and powerful in the world. Very few dare to provoke them.
As for Vermillion Bird?
Jiang Ming saw some weird information.
For example, the former Princess of the Demon Holy Palace was injured when she tried to kill the former Heavenly Emperor. When she was on her way back to heal her injuries, she was plotted and died. As a result, Vermillion Bird took over the Demon Holy Palace.
The Demon Holy Palace was very strong and it was a Sacred Land for all the demons in the world.
But they had now lost two Venerates, namely Bi Jiu and Thousand Snake Demon Venerate.
“You are all just afraid that I will advance further and threaten your status. So you all are joining forces to kill me!” Jiang Ming sneered, “I will give you a chance today to see if you can actually kill me!”
“However, I have a suggestion for you all as well! I am the person who holds grudges the most, and I will even make sure to avenge my revenge. Think about it. Once you make a move, then it’s till death we shall part!”
“If you can’t kill me, I will make sure to annihilate your entire sect or clan in the future. Don’t you ever doubt that I can’t do so! But if you kill me, everything will be over!”
“If you don’t want to be my enemy, then retreat! Otherwise...”
Jiang Ming smiled, revealing the two rows of his white teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - Alone Against the World, Saw the Heavenly Emperor, It’s a She!
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Alone Against the World, Saw the Heavenly Emperor, It’s a She!
Heavenly Buddha, Tai Jian, Dragon Monarch, and Vermillion Bird were the four that stood on the top of the list in the current Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Everyone had the ability to suppress the world.
With them currently on the chase for the Great Demon Venerate, who would dare threaten any one of them?
Who would even dare?
However, Jiang Ming not only made his threat, but also threatened all four of them at the same time.
In the eyes of others, what he did was pure madness, arrogance and lawlessness. A mere idiot that was on the path towards death and had enough of what life had to offer.
“Interesting!” Vermillion Bird laughed instead upon hearing so.
“It’s really interesting!” Dragon Monarch revealed a playful look on his face.
“Alas!” Tianfo sighed faintly, “With you being well and us being well, would it be great if we can all be well?”
“Let’s just kill him straight off!” Tai Jian sneered, “What he’s doing here is he’s wanting to step on us, and I am now even speculating that he might be in a close relationship with the Great Demon Venerate. Otherwise, he has no need to obstruct us here as we come to besiege the Great Demon Venerate. Now he is threatening us in turn, wanting to make our sect and clan extinct. If we don’t make a move, we will become the laughing stock of the world. We might not care, but what about the disciples? They would’ve lost their pride and of their fortune! ”
“Let’s kill him then!” The Dragon Monarch nodded, “This kind of person is really an eyesore!”
“Alright! Let’s kill him then!”
Vermillion Bird’s tone was calm.
With the four of them joining forces, who in the world could even resist them? Maybe only the fallen Heavenly Emperor.
However, he was now dead. Therefore, in the current world, they were the masters of all.
The four of them currently joining forces also showed their intention to divide the world and dominate the lands.
“Kill me?” Jiang Ming sighed, “I was originally a leisure visitor, who was just watching the flowers bloom, watching the clouds float by and didn’t want to pay attention to the disturbances of the world. Yet, why does trouble always come to me? Brother Riyue, what is your opinion on this? ”
“Because the people in the world are just so greedy!” Riyue Changfeng took out another cup, filled it twice as much, waved his sleeve lightly, and sent it over. At the same time, he added, “Although Tianyuan Realm is a human planar, it has an extremely big secret; also, you have a lot of supreme techniques and special abilities which make people jealous. These are the causes of human sin!”
“Those are my things!” Jiang Ming took the teacup and drank it all in one gulp!
“When you die, it is now longer yours!”
“Makes sense!”
“Brother Jiang! Based on the current situation, if you don’t retreat now, you will become an enemy of the whole world. How will you choose?”
“Retreat?” Jiang Ming shook his head with a smile, “Although people do say that if you take a step back, it opens up the sky. You can take a step back, but your family will also be destroyed and you will end up without a place to go back to. If that’s the case, what is there about being the enemy of the whole world? Of course, they don’t represent the world either. In the future, I will enslave the Dragon Clan, keep the Demon Clan in captivity, and look for a good cook to eat them all. As for those two? I’ll just make their sects go extinct once and for all.”
“Such maddening arrogance!” Tai Jian narrowed his eyes as the power of Sword Dao was fuming out of him, “Jiang Ming, any last words?”
“A mere defeated general dares to bark in front of me?” Jiang Ming snorted coldly.
“You’re courting death!” Tai Jian was furious, “Guys, let’s attack together and bury him!”
“Amitabha!” The Heavenly Buddha whispered his chants.
“Alright!” The Dragon Monarch nodded as he raised an arm. His strength was condensed as his claws could be faintly seen with its hidden power trembling the space itself.
“It’s a pity to just kill him like this!” Vermillion Bird sighed as a sword appeared in her hand, red as flame.
Just when they were ready to make their move, all of them were stunned in place.
“Go ahead!” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
In front of him, a long river of Dao Vessels appeared. This time however, it was a really long river.
After his trade with Riyue Changfeng, he still had a lot of Dao Vessels left. A very big amount at that.
After all, the value of the many strange things that he obtained was far beyond expectations, allowing him to save up a lot.
In addition to the original surplus of Dao Vessels, it was enough for him to protect himself.
How was it not so?
He took out a total of eight Quasi-Sage weapons, 72 Great Overarching Dao Vessels and 360 Great Overarching weapons and they were flying around him.
The aura that these weapons were emitting were earth shattering.
‘It’s still too little!’ Jiang Ming was a little dissatisfied, ‘In the near future, I must get 300 Quasi-Sage weapons, 30,000 Dao vessels and 30 million Taiyi weapons. Only then can I feel safe. I can blast and kill whoever dares to face off with me directly. With only these few Dao vessels in front of me, I still feel quite insecure.’
‘If I detonate these recklessly, I should be able to directly destroy the Abyss and bury them here and now!’
While thinking about it, Jiang Ming also looked at the opposite side and said cheerfully, “Aren’t you going to kill me? Make your move! Why are you standing still? Don’t you all just kill whoever you want? Didn’t you all want to dominate and suppress the world? Why are you not making your moves now?”
To hell with that
Dragon Monarch’s face was extremely dark. He wanted to roar as he opened his mouth, but ended up not saying a word. He ended up just flicking his sleeves, snorted, turned around and left, “I’m off to kill the Sky Demon!”
He turned into a stream of light and went off.
“Fellow Cultivator! Wait for me! Let’s go to destroy the Sky Demon together and create a brighter future for our world!” The Heavenly Buddha gave Jiang Ming a meaningful look and looked at the long river of Dao Vessels. The corners of his mouth twitched as he cursed Jiang Ming as a ‘bastard’ furtively before he went away as well.
“Don’t leave me!” Vermillion Bird didn’t stay either.
Tai Jian’s face was extremely dark and he was even trembling all over.
Upon seeing the killing intent in Jiang Ming’s eyes, he directly tore apart the space and ran away.
The peerless experts who were watching the battle from a distance, gasped in horror.
God damn it!
How could a human child who was not even in the realm of Great Overarching possessed so many powerful Dao Vessels?
Did he refine all of them?
He lined all of them in an array formation?
He could detonate all of them at any time?
What if he detonated them?
God damn it!
Wouldn’t I myself get caught in the skirmish and end up dead?
Many of the peerless experts thought of these and wanted to tear the space to flee. However, when they thought about if Jiang Ming were to detonate them there and then, it would’ve been too late to leave already.
Besides, unless Jiang Ming was brain-dead, how could he detonate them?
Keeping them from detonating would be a deterrent to others. Otherwise, detonating them would cause a terrifying result, but it would make others lose their fear.
“With this long river of Dao vessels, as long as Jiang Ming doesn’t provoke the wrath of everyone and anyone, I’m afraid no one will dare to stretch their claws towards him.”
“Unless that person is just tired of life, who would even dare? Or if they are certain that they could create a situation where they can surely kill him.”
“Alas, as strong as the Dragon Monarch, the Palace Master of the Demon Holy Palace, the Great Monarch of the Taishang Sword Sect and the Lord Buddha left with their tails between their legs. They were thoroughly embarrassed today.”
“Hehe! It can be considered that I have finally seen their true faces.”
“Be careful of being silenced!”
“Ha ha!”
There was a lot of discussion, and gasps of amazement.
“It’s such a sham!” Riyue Changfeng paced over from the sky and sighed, “I wanted to watch the grand fireworks, but they were too much of a scared cat and ended up walking away like this.”
“It’s really a pity!” Jiang Ming said the same thing, “If it weren’t for the fear of destroying the Abyss and leading myself to the backlash from the great fortune, I really wanted to try and see if I can bury them altogether!”
“Great!” Riyue Changfeng raised his thumb, “What’s your plan? Continue to be the enemy? Let them be as it is? Make light of it?”
Jiang Ming smiled and did not respond. Nevertheless, he thought, ‘Let them be as it is? Make light of it? To hell with that! They’ve provoked me, and I don’t know when they’ll plot against me. How can I let them live? Of course it would be better to let them die early and he could be rest assured.’
“Come on! Let’s go and have a look!” Jiang Ming pointed to the distance.
“Let’s go!” Riyue Changfeng drifted forward towards the distance.
At the entrance outside the small chiliocosm Dao Square that the Saint Demon Venerate once opened up, there were a large number of peerless experts gathered.
It was obvious that this entrance was forcefully blasted out. After all, the remaining Dao fluctuations could still be seen in the void.
At the front were the four peerless experts of Dragon Monarch and the likes. They were surrounded by people that stood at the pinnacles and many others.
The weakest of them all were even of the Great Overarching Realm.
Not less than a few hundred of them were there.
Just counting the Venerates that were present, there were nearly 20 of them.
There were too many peerless experts.
“If we just finish off all these people in one go?” Jiang Ming said via voice transmission, “Brother Riyue, what do you think would happen?”
“You will be able to easily win the position as the Great Heavenly Venerate. Do you want to give it a try?” Riyue Changfeng transmitted his thoughts telepathically.
“Forget it!” Jiang Ming quickly shook his head.
In fact, he really felt some impulsiveness for it.
They didn’t go any closer though they were standing in the distance. Meanwhile, they were listening to the discussions over there: Are they preparing for a forceful frontal assault or to directly go in and explore?
Arguments and discussions were never-ending.
However, most of them thought that it was better to attack by force. After all, no one knew if there were any dangers inside. Moreover, the terrifying Great Demon Venerate was in there.
Even so, there were also many who insisted on taking the initiative to enter. This was because it was the Saint Venerate Dao Square, hence there must be great fortunes in it.
As Jiang Ming listened on, he also glanced at each of the peerless experts, flipped through the Human Path Records and had a general understanding of the peerless experts in the entire Honggu Heavenly Realm.
When he saw one of them, a strange look flashed through his face.
“She’s the Heavenly Emperor’s avatar!”
Jiang Ming was looking at Venerate Tai Yin.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - Wanting me to be the Human Emperor Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Wanting me to be the Human Emperor Again
Jiang Ming was very surprised, extremely surprised at that.
He knew that Tai Yuan had three avatars. One was the Heavenly Emperor, who had fallen. As for the other two he didn’t even know anything about them.
Never did he expect to see one in the Abyss and was a woman at that. No, she shouldn’t be considered as a woman but should be called the body of the Saint Spirit.
Back then, Tai Yi extracted some power of origins from the Extreme Yin Stellar. He wanted to refine it into an avatar and harness the power of Taiyin, but he died on his way towards sanctifying Dao. Hence, he left the legacy to Tai Yuan.
Later on, Tai Yuan quietly condensed his avatars, and taking the origin of the stellar as the framework, he directly settled in the Extreme Yin Stellar, becoming the innate lunar spirit. He introduced it into the stellar’s origin to protect himself, and comprehend the great cycle of Dao.
Tai Yin stayed very low-profile and grew silently. He had been going through great transformations on the Extreme Yin Stellar, overlooking the world.
He also furtively cultivated some disciples.
In addition, he had discussions with many Venerates about the mystical and philosophical Dao and became the best of friends with people such as the Great Monarch Tian Song.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming’s eyes gleamed.
At the entrance of the small world opened by the Saint Demon Lord, many peerless cultivators had already come to a conclusion from their discussion to forcibly enter the small chiliocosm. They wanted to kill the Great Demon Venerate, and fight for the great fortunes inside simultaneously.
After all, the so-called way of sanctifying the Dao might be hidden there.
“They’ve all gone in!” Riyue Changfeng whispered, “Brother Jiang, are you going in?”
“What about you?” Jiang Ming asked back.
Riyue Changfeng shook his head, “If it’s a secret realm, I won’t enter if I have a choice. Otherwise it will damage my luck. Besides, even if there is something left in it, it might not even meet my eyes.”
“To look down on the things left by the Saint Lord, you are really something!” Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up. When faced with the belongings of the Saint Lord, how many people in the world wouldn’t be moved from it?
Even the Heavenly Emperor would not be exempted.
However, this guy was knowledgeable and had amazing wealth. He even had Saint Weapons. Therefore, he could not be taken with common sense.
“I can’t be exempted, but some rules can’t be violated!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “It seems that you are not ready to enter?”
“Yeah! I’m going back!” Jiang Ming nodded.
“Go back?” Riyue Changfeng had a puzzled look on his face, “It’s fine if you don’t go in, but why do you have to go back? This is a once-in-a-lifetime great battle! Besides, this is also a good opportunity to kill all of them! Aren’t you moved?”
Jiang Ming smiled but didn’t explain as he turned around and left, “Brother Riyue, let’s get together another day!”
“Strange person!” Riyue Changfeng was puzzled.
He couldn’t understand Jiang Ming even more.
Shaking his head, he sat cross-legged in the air, sipping tea, while waiting silently at the entrance of the small chiliocosm.
Venerate Tai Yin in the distance glanced over at their direction. Inexplicably, she had a strange feeling, but she didn’t pay much attention to it. Instead she barged in with the other peerless experts.
…
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming had finally returned.
The Human Path Record was suspended in front of him, as he constantly flipped through pages, checking the dynamics of the different peerless experts while waiting for an opportunity to make his move.
“Brother!” Mountain Master Tianyuan sensed Jiang Ming’s aura and rushed over immediately. With a strange and solemn expression, he asked, “I received news just now that you killed two Venerates in the Abyss to intimidate Heavenly Buddha, Tai Jian, Vermillion Bird and Dragon Monarch? You even caused them to retreat on their own accord?”
“Senior brother, are you so powerful?”Junior Sister Phoenix had a look of shock on her face.
“It’s just under the guise of foreign objects!” Jiang Ming muttered as he told them about the long river of Dao vessels.
The corner of Mountain Master Tianyuan’s mouth twitched as he sighed and continued, “This is also your ability! If the Saint Lord doesn’t reveal himself, with you in procession of the long river of Dao vessels in your hands, who would dare to target you in this world?”
“Old brother!” Junior Sister Phoenix looked at Mountain Master Tianyuan, “If all of those Dao vessels were detonated, what would the power be like?”
“Eight Quasi-Sage weapons, 72 Great Overarching Dao vessels, 360 Great Overarching weapons, were all used to form a large formation. If it is detonated in an instant, it can completely destroy the Heavenly Realm. Even if the Heavenly Emperor is reborn, only death awaits.” Mountain Master Tianyuan answered, “Therefore, this here is the strongest deterrent. From now on, Tianyuan Realm will be worry-free! It can’t be said to be truly worry-free. At least until Tai Jian and others find a way to crack through this deterrent, they will definitely not make any moves easily.”
“But once you make a move, then it would be life and death!” Junior Sister Phoenix frowned and sighed, “It’s still because of my lack of strength. Otherwise, if I kill them all, my Senior Brother will be able to always enjoy the peacefulness.”
“Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming smiled, “I will kill them before they can even deal with me!”
“You are this!” Mountain Master Tianyuan gave him a thumbs up and changed the subject, “Brother, do you know how I got the news of the Abyss?”
“I’m also very puzzled. After all, I got back right after the incident over there!” Jiang Ming looked at him, puzzled and continued, “You shouldn’t have known about it so quickly! Could it be that the Venerate of the human race sent the message?’
“That’s right!” Mountain Master Tianyuan admitted, but was still in a dilemma as he continued, “They watched your battle in the Abyss where you beheaded the twoTaishang’s Venerates and even almost killed Tai Jian. They say that you also deterred the top-ranked peerless existence in the world. Therefore, they wanted to wait for the Great Demon Venerate of the Abyss to be executed and immediately return to jointly recommend you as the Human Emperor and let you rule over the human race of the world!”
Jiang Ming had a sarcastic expression on his face: “They finally thought of me at this time!”
“Why would you say that?” Mountain Master Tianyuan frowned.
“On my journey to the Abyss, my clone was cut down at first. It was later on that I went there personally. Upon reaching there, I was besieged by the three Venerates of the Taishang Sword Sect, yet none of them appeared. Afterwards, the Heavenly Buddha and others tried to attack me, but they still did not reveal themselves. They didn’t make a move when I was in danger, yet they still want me to stand up for them when I’m invincible? They’re just dreaming! ”
Mountain Master Tianyuan smiled bitterly.
“If you refuse, will they say that this is a test for you?” Junior Sister Phoenix chuckled, “Will they also say that if you want to wear a crown, you must first bear the weight and that this is the test to measure your courage? No wonder the human race with a number of hundreds of millions of people that was recognized as the number one race still remains scattered as it is. It is not that the human race is not good, but that these old people are too old.”
Jiang Ming picked up the teacup and took a sip. He then laid back as he fiddled with the teacup, gazing at the fleeting clouds. He muttered indifferently, “If the Saint Lord was around, it’s alright if the human experts didn’t stand up, because there is no way for them to compete. However, what happens after the Saint Lord has gone? It doesn’t make any sense if they still aren’t willing to come out yet! After hiding for a long time and in the depths, they no longer have the courage to stand up.”
“Old brother!” He said in a serious voice, “Tell them that my Tianyuan Realm only enjoys serenity, and it’s best not to disturb me. Otherwise, don’t blame me for not respecting them! You should know that those that disrupted my peace should be dead and are so.”
Mountain Master Tianyuan felt a chill in his heart as he nodded and said with a smile, “I’m used to the place being quiet too. Now that this place is peaceful, how can we allow others to disturb it? I’ll send the message right now!”
As he swiped his arm in the air, a rune formed itself. He then shot the rune into the void before returning to his residence to continue comprehending the great Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - Killing Tai Jian
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Killing Tai Jian
The clouds fleet through the sky as the sun and the moon rotated in shifts.
Even though hundreds of millions of years had flown by, its color seemed to be never-changing for eternity.
As the sun was changing its shift with the moon, the crimson sunset tinted the horizon in a warm red glint. It was a magnificent view that no one could shift their gaze away from.
As the cloudy wind was ushered by the soft breeze, Jiang Ming was preparing dinner on top of the roof.
“It’s so fishy and so fresh!” As Junior Sister Phoenix sniffed her nose, her eyes were gleaming and saliva flowed from the corners of her mouth. Her drooling saliva was crystal clear, as it even reflected seven-colored rays of light under the evening sun.
They were like elongated silk thread, swaying in the wind.
“Doesn’t it taste like you?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“Senior brother, how are so naughty!”
“Speaking of naughty, how can I be compared to you?”
“Of course you’re not as naughty as I am! Hee hee! Senior Brother, I’m coming!”
“Don’t, don’t, don’t!”
Whoosh...
Junior sister Phoenix leapt up and fell right onto him.
Jiang Ming stumbled as he started feeling a little unsure of himself. He then shook his waist and straightened his chest.
He was enjoying the seafood while watching the sunset.
There were even melodious whispers lingering in the air.
Such freshness!
Such fishy taste!
Such fragrance!
As the sun slowly set, giving way to the rising moon, the stars started shining bright.
The melodious whispers became even more passionate.
If you were to listen closely, the whispers might be as high as the tide, surging and rushing; but if you were to listen again, it seemed to have turned into a rather charming and mellow tone, as though it was just a dream.
As the moon ended its shift, giving way to the rising of the sun, Jiang Ming shivered suddenly as his body froze. He remained still for a long time.
“Such comfort!” After a while, he looked over at the sunrise and couldn’t help but praise, “Beautiful!”
“The sunrise and sunset every day are just so beautiful!” Jiang Ming sighed again.
“Are you saying that it’s a good day?”
“No, I’m talking about the sun!”
Under the soft caress of the sun, the two chatted and admired the beautiful scenery.
Jiang Ming cooked breakfast again.
This time it was a very simple meal, Seafood congee.
As they ate and cleaned up, a reminder suddenly rang in Jiang Ming’s subconscious.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for enjoying a delicious breakfast. Rewarded with a Taiyi Seed of killing law!”
Jiang Ming was slightly startled.
‘To think that I am rewarded with such a thing. Is it indicating for me to break through?’
It was actually quite the right time for a breakthrough.
In the Supreme Pagoda, it had become almost impossible to get more points already.
Therefore, it was now meaningless to continue staying in the Golden Immortal Realm.
‘I’ll just wait for a little longer!’ Jiang Ming pondered, and threw the Junior Sister Phoenix who was entangling him to the side, “Go and cultivate!”
“Senior Brother! You bastard! You threw me away soon after you finished enjoying me!” Junior Sister Phoenix complained.
Jiang Ming pursed his lips, waved his hand and sealed off his surroundings, so that he could enjoy the purity and peace.
This clone of his Junior Sister’s was difficult to deal with! No! It was just that she didn’t want others to relax even for a moment.
‘Alas! It’s so frustrating. She’s even more mischievous than a spirit itself. What a happy trouble!’
Jiang Ming laid down on a rattan chair and let out a sigh of relief.
As he swayed gently on the chair, he took another sip of tea and ate some fruits.
Such a beautiful day it was!
At the same time, he was also looking at the records in the Human Path Record.
…
In the blink of an eye, a few days passed.
The opening day of the Infinite Realm Auction House was getting closer and closer.
On one noon, Jiang Ming, who squinted his eyes, suddenly became a little bit more energetic.
‘I finally got the chance!’
Two clones appeared next to him, handed two jade talismans at the same time, and then put them into the Human Path Record.
In the Abyss where the secret realm of Saint Demon Lord was, Tai Jian entered the secret realm together with Heavenly Buddha and the other experts. Although there were some effects from the array formation in the secret realm, their cultivations were strong enough to tremble the world, hence it did not affect them much.
After all, the array formation was not a killing formation.
They went on to explore and encountered many exotic flowers and plants, which would make a Golden Immortal become ecstatic upon seeing them. However, Tai Jian and others didn’t care much about these.
At their level of cultivation, there weren’t many items that would intrigue them already.
As they went onwards, they were also comprehending the Dao marks left by the Saint Demon Lord.
“Taoist Heavenly Buddha, is there a difference between these stigmata and the legacy of the Holy Buddha?” Tai Jian asked.
“There are!” Heavenly Buddha answered without hesitation, “We all possess the inheritance of the Holy Dao. It is considered a secret to the outsiders, but to us, they are nothing much! Alas! The Holy Dao! The Holy Dao is to comprehend the mind of the heavens, the origin, and the laws. It is to reflect the mind of the heavens with one’s own mind, and to transcend heaven and earth. It promotes the thought of being the center of the world where all laws return to its origin, becoming the source of oneness. Each type of the Holy Dao is different. Although each of them can mobilize the power of the origin of heaven and earth, their forms are also very different. ”
“That’s right!” Vermillion Bird nodded, “The path of the Holy Dao is ultimately a path towards detachment. It first integrates the heart of heaven, touches the origin, followed by cutting off the shackles and detaching from heaven and earth. From then on, the person can fully control his life and become another form of life. The essence of the Holy Dao is very clear and apparent but what can we do to achieve it? Alas! That’s the difficult question!”
“The path of Holy Dao is difficult! More so than ascending into the blue sky!” Tai Jian sighed, “Being able to see the path of Holy Dao, yet it remains hazy and out of reach.”
The three of them chatted happily.
Dragon Monarch on the other hand, was somewhat confused.
Although he was powerful, he did not have the inheritance of the Holy Dao after all.
“Holy Dao! The Holy Dao!” Dragon Monarch lamented in his heart.
He quietly listened to the three of them talking in detail.
These were obviously not something too much of a secret and they did not hide from him.
Along the way, they broke through many restrictions and saw many stigmata.
There were either on comprehension or imprint, line after line.
Although there were some fights along the way, no one dared to make a move against them.
As for the Great Demon Venerate?
He was yet to be found.
Finally, they found themselves in a peculiar place.
Clouds of black fog were gathering or drifting away from time to time, as various strange and wonderful illusions evolved.
“That’s...” the Heavenly Buddha looked forward, froze for a moment, and said excitedly, “Each black fog is composed of countless stigmata, which are scattered and combined. They are extremely random, like real clouds. *Hiss!* This is equivalent to the random combination of laws, and the random dispersal of them! The Holy Dao of the Saint Demon Lord is really incredible.”
“Stimata transforming into shapes and combining with each other. Every combination can evolve into infinite wonderful results. I’m afraid that there will be different inheritances of the Holy Dao inside!” Tai Jian was a little excited, “In order to train me, Tai Shang once performed such a feat for me! The situation is almost similar! Everyone, I’ll go check it out first.”
He turned into a sword light and rushed over, disappearing without a trace as he touched a black cloud.
Strangely, this black cloud was not dissipating, nor was it merging. It was merely floating inside.
“I’m afraid the Great Demon Venerate is here!” Heavenly Buddha had a thought. “The outside had also been properly arranged. Once he appears, we will definitely sense it as soon as possible. With our cultivation base, it shouldn’t be difficult for us to break through the Saint Demon Venerate’s holy stigmata. Everyone, since we’ve encountered such a thing, let’s take a look!”
“Alright!” Vermillion Bird also flew onwards.
Dragon Monarch also didn’t hesitate to do the same.
Heavenly Buddha however, waited for a while. As a pair of Buddha eyes pierced through the false void, trying to see through the secrets of the black cloud, he unfortunately couldn’t get much from it.
He slapped in the air, hitting the black cloud that Vermillion Bird had submerged into.
The power of his Buddha’s Palm had been condensed to the extreme that it dissipated the black fog and Vermillion Bird fell out of it.
“Heavenly Buddha, are you trying to kill me?” Vermillion Bird was furious.
“Fellow Taoist! It’s merely a misunderstanding!” Heavenly Buddha smiled, “I just want to test the power of this black cloud and now it seems that it really can’t trap us. It should be the training ground and a place of enlightenment set by the Saint Demon Venerate. Please continue!”
Vermillion Bird snorted coldly as she sensed the surroundings for a little, before disappearing into another black cloud.
The Heavenly Buddha also turned into a trickle of light and went into one of them.
Inside one of the black clouds, which looked rather small. Tai Jian had got to a vast area with many stone monuments standing. Every stone tablet was like a sword, impaled straight into the sky, echoing the supreme sword intent.
‘All of these are the evolution of stigmata and every sword tablet represents a kind of Sword Dao!’ After Tai Jian was done getting excited, he couldn’t help but sigh, ‘Alas, the Holy Dao! Although the Holy Dao is but just one path, there are more than ten thousand methods to them. Even though these are not as good as the master’s Sword Dao, each of them is no worse than the ones that I’ve realized!’
‘By comprehending the path of Sword Dao here, and combined with what the master has taught me, it will definitely allow me to take a step further in the way of Sword Dao. Hopefully I can enter the realm of Demi-Sage through this!’
‘Demi Sage!’
‘Saint Lord!’
‘Jiang Ming!’
As Tai Jian thought, he inexplicably thought of Jiang Ming and gnashed his teeth in anger.
The humiliation by Jiang Ming to him was too great.
He had made him the laughing stock of all the beings of the Heavenly Realm.
“Just you wait!”
Tai Jian felt the stability of this space first. When he found that his best strike could easily break it, he felt relieved.
He went over to a sword monument, observed it carefully and started to comprehend it wholeheartedly.
Soon, he closed his eyes and slowly comprehended it carefully.
However, he suddenly opened his eyes right this very moment and saw two figures appearing in front of him, along with the eruption of the light of destruction.
“Damn it! This is the Thousands Buddha Palm of the Heavenly Buddha!” Tai Jian couldn’t help exclaiming.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - Snatching the Natural Treasure (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Snatching the Natural Treasure (Part 1)
There wasn’t anything else to talk about Tai Jian for he had to be killed. After all, the enmity between them was so intense that either one party must die. Hence, the only thing to do was to grab the opportunity and kill.
Jiang Ming had been checking on Tai Jian all the time. When he discovered that he was alone, he conjured two clones over. Just in case, he gave each of them one jade amulet with the peerless special ability of the Heavenly Buddha sealed within.
In this one year, he received quite many similar jade amulets as rewards for his daily cooking. Now he finally could put them to good use.
He sent the clones directly there through the positioning of Human Path Records. Immediately when they arrived, one of the clones evoked a special ability at Tai Jian.
The special ability was the Thousands Buddha Palms of the Heavenly Buddha.
The instance when the special ability was evoked, void trembled and a swarm of great Buddhas were sitting cross-legged in mid-air. They were surrounded by golden luminance. As they were chanting, mantra trickling and even invoking laws of heaven and earth to strike a stunning palm towards Tai Jian.
The merging of thousands of palms generated shocking energies.
After this clone invoked the jade amulet, it burned its mana to evoke the Infinite Vessels Manipulation Technique to affect the Silver Luminance Battle Armor, a type of Demi-Sage Defensive Artifact, Tai Jian was wearing.
Buzz…
Meanwhile, another clone also invoked the jade amulet, which also contained the Thousands Buddha Palms, and evoked the Infinite Vessels Manipulation Technique.
The two’s powers superimposed, induceding a terrifying qualitative change.
“Heavenly Buddha, why are you attacking me?” Tai Jian questioned unbelievably. Just when he was about to evoke his Silver Luminance Battle Armor to defend himself, he discovered its inner core was in chaos.
“This is…Jiang Ming!”
With a flash of astonishment on his face, layers and layers of luminance surged from within his body. Unfortunately, he had lost his footing at the start in addition to the malfunctioned Silver Luminance Battle Armor.
The successive Thousands Buddha Palms beat him into explosion directly, annihilated his primal spirit and he died tragically on the spot.
He died in extreme grievance indeed.
In the enlightening area of the Saint Demon Lord, who would expect for the sudden appearance of an expert?
Hence, he was sneakingly being attacked when his mind was in a relaxing state.
In fact, it was almost impossible that he was killed in an instant even if it was a sneak attack.
But because of the malfunctioning of his defensive treasure during the critical moment when he was under the attack of Heavenly Buddha’s strongest special ability, he was left no chance to survive.
Under the effects of powerful waves, this little space instantly exploded. This allowed the spreading of Buddha’s luminance and the rampant destructive force almost destroyed the entire black clouded area, causing Vermillion Bird and the likes to fall out.
It was also at this moment, the two clones, which had no much energy left, pointed with their fingers to manipulate the Human Path Records in drawing in both the sword and the Silver Luminance Battle Armor of Tai Jian.
Then they plunged into the Record, and disappeared.
Boom!
The oscillating power swept out to all directions like a torrent of destruction.
But this peerless power surprisingly was carrying the peaceful Buddha fluctuations which contained the supreme mantra of Buddha.
Of course, there were also dispersed resentment of Tai Jian’s tragedy.
As soon as the Vermillion Bird fell out, she felt the surrounding atmosphere slightly. She immediately squinted her eyes, lifted her hand and pressed downward. Gushing energy she released suppressed torrents that gushed in her direction.
Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, Venerate Tai Yin, Great Monarch Tian Song and the likes, also took actions to completely overwhelm the torrents. Then, many of them turned to Heavenly Buddha.
“Tai Jian is dead. And he’s killed by the power of your Fo Sect!” Vermillion Bird interrogated in a frosty tone, “Heavenly Buddha, explain yourself!”
“It wasn’t me!” Heavenly Buddha shook his head, “All of you saw that I just fell out from the enlightenment area, just like you all. It wasn’t the other Buddha Venerates of my Fo Sect too. After all, who could kill Tai Jian?”
“But it’s the fact that he’s died. His soul and aura have all disappeared and he was killed by the special ability of Fo Sect.” Vermilion Bird grabbed over a wisp of blood mist, evoked a mysterious method and Buddha luminance penetrated from inside out. She then added, “It’s the purest Buddha luminance containing the supreme mantra. Heavenly Buddha, who else other than your Fo Sect can do so?”
“Taoist Heavenly Buddha!” Dragon Monarch approached with intimidating and frosty luminance emitting from within the pair of his golden eyes, “When you can kill Tai Jian while we are besieging the Great Demon Venerate today, you will kill us the other day. I assume that you killed him because you wanted to remove a competitor for the throne of Heavenly Emperor right?”
*Claps* Yu Fei clapped her hands, “Old dragon, you hit right on the point! It’s Tai Jian today, we’ll be the next target tomorrow. Don’t forget that the Great Demon Venerate is still alive. Once we’re injured while besieging him, this Heavenly Buddha will definitely take his advantage on us, the worst thing is that we all lose our life.”
Her melodious voice, reverberating through the ears into the depth of consciousness, letting the soul rejoice.
Her words also invoked many antagonistic glares at Heavenly Buddha because they were too exasperating!
Heavenly Buddha smiled wryly, “Ladies and gentlemen, it truly wasn’t me! Frankly, I am not up to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor. My Fo Sect cannot be in that position or we would draw the attention from all forces in the world. You all understand, and I understand better. Moreover, if I were to kill him, why would I kill him here? Am I that stupid?”
Vermilion Bird frowned.
The Dragon Monarch’s eyes flickered.
The Heavenly Buddha was right.
If it was during normal times, they would make sure that the Heavenly Buddha was the culprit even if they knew that he was not. But because they were in the midst of trying to besiege the Great Demon Venerate, they had to remain united to prevent him from escaping. Otherwise, they would be in great trouble.
If it was not the act of the Heavenly Buddha, who was the real culprit then?
What was his cultivation base when he could kill Tai Jian in an instant, leaving him no chance of escaping?
That’s terrifying!
“Ladies and gentlemen, I suddenly recalled one thing!” Heavenly Buddha again spoke as if he thought of something, “What was the main reason the Abyss went against heaven? It wasn’t the Great Abyss Trial but because of the Heavenly Emperor who punched through the Abyss and killed three venerates, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 327
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Snatching the Natural Treasure (Part 2)
“The one punch of the Heavenly Emperor forced the Great Demon Venerate to go against heaven.” Vermilion Bird nodded and came to enlightenment as she said, “Do you mean that punch wasn’t the act of the Heavenly Emperor?”
“He had no reason to do so, hadn’t he?” Heavenly Buddha said, “It is clear that the Abyss is under the govern of the Heaven Court. Hence, what reason did he have to do so? And why did he only kill three venerates? When the Abyss rebelled, the Heavenly Emperor was forced to resist it until the Heaven Court was destroyed at the end of the day. If the Heavenly Emperor were to force the Abyss’s rebellion, he should have destroyed the entire Abyss soon after that punch instead of waiting for the Great Demon Venerate to fight his way into the Heavenly Realm. This is not logical!” Heavenly Buddha analyzed in detail.
“But it was obvious that that punch had invoked the authority and order of heaven and earth. Who else other than the Heavenly Emperor can do so!” Vermilion Bird added, “And regarding the death of Tai Jian, where have his treasures gone? Why have they disappeared all together?”
The many experts around were disappointed once again.
“If!” The Dragon Monarch questioned, “If the punch wasn’t the act of Heavenly Emperor, and the death of Taoist Tai Jian was not the act of the Fo Sect, who else could do so?”
Only an answer popped-up in their mind simultaneously, that was the Saint Lord!
The Saint Lord absolutely could make it. But there were even less reasons for him to do so!
“Guys, I’ve discovered the Sky Demon!” An urgent voice rang out, “Come here fast, he’s running away!”
The experts also sensed the aura of Heavenly Buddha but none of them moved.
“Let’s just kill him first!” Vermilion Bird suggested.
“Taoist Heavenly Buddha shall go first, but must not kill him!” Dragon Monarch suggested.
“Seconded!” The Great Demon Concubine nodded.
Venerate Tai Yin and the others were all looking at Heavenly Buddha.
“Sure!” He was left with no choice other than accepting their request to be the vanguard. What a grievance!
The group of experts went over.
As for the Dao enlightenment? Who else wanted to continue? Tai Jian was killed when he was comprehending Dao.
The matter of culprit identification was put aside because they had too much confusion.
Who was the culprit responsible for Tai Jian’s death?
Where was the Silver Luminance Battle Armor of his? It certainly wouldn’t be scattered after all.
…
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming remained lying even after he absorbed back the soul of his clones.
‘Unfortunately the Heavenly Buddha is not besieged! The imputation isn’t really a successful one, but well, let it be then!’
‘Along with the improvement of my cultivation base, the Human Path Record is getting more useful!’
Jiang Ming exclaimed to himself.
Its function which allowed his clones to be projected over was indeed very practical.
It was a pity that he was an unambitious man. Else, he would have discovered more usage of the record.
He called up the Human Path Record to continue checking on.
As for the Silver Luminance Battle Armor and the Taiye Sword, the top grade Quasi-Sage weapon of Tai Jian, he totally omitted them after putting them into the space of the Record.
He would refine them during his leisure time.
He would not use them for the time being because using them would cause great troubles if being recognized.
‘Can this Sky Demon be discovered so easily? That’s the seclusive cultivation place of the Saint Demon Lord, somewhere he has been to for numerous times!’
Jiang Ming was rather dubious.
‘Can it be a trap?’
As expected, he managed to make a presumption based on the ‘Status’ of many experts.
Because the Great Demon Venerate knew that he was unable to hide anymore, he showed himself to attract quite a number of experts into a killing formation, where eight Great Overarching experts and a Quasi-Sage expert were instantly garrotted.
It was strange that nobody actually knew who the Quasi-Sage expert was.
After he was killed, he transformed into a giant golden beast, dotted with starlights, emitting the power of stellars’ origin.
It was the Star Beast.
However, there weren’t many experts who cared about it.
In fact, they joined hands to break the great formation. Unfortunately the Great Demon Venerate went into hiding again.
However, the secret realm was, after all, limited in space.
Soon the Great Demon Venerate was again discovered, and was beaten badly. Yet because he had a Saint Weapon, he managed to escape by forcibly evoking its power.
In the depth of the secret realm opened up by the Saint Demon Lord, there was an area shrouded with fog. Quite a number of palaces could be seen vaguely in it.
At this moment, Heavenly Buddha and the others had arrived there.
“The Sky Demon has escaped into it. It’s the innermost part of the secret realm, hence he’s no place to run to anymore!” The Dragon Monarch was excited. “And he has been crippled and badly injured! Guys, how shall we kill him?”
His expression turned frosty.
Behind him were three experts. Each of them had an aura as deep as abyss, powerful and terrifying. There were obviously the venerates from the Dragon Clan.
They were the strength of the Dragon Clan. Their presence made the Dragon Clan comparable to the Sacred Land although the clan had no Saint Lord itself.
“Kill him and you’ll get the title of Heavenly Emperor!” Vermillion Bird’s eyes glimmered and looked at Heavenly Buddha, “He still has the Blood Banner with him. Taoist, what would you suggest on dividing the trophy?”
“Err…” The Heavenly Buddha looked at Vermilion Bird with a passionate smile remaining on his face. But he secretly gritted his teeth, ‘This b*tch is adding fuel to the fire. Now that I’m being questioned, how can I publicly seek for benefits? If I don’t say anything now, I can still snatch later. However, if I were to snatch after expressing my position now, I’ll lose all my credibility and image. But there are the Saint item, Demi-Sage weapon and the throne of the Heavenly Emperor. Shall I just snatch them regardless?’
‘No, no way, I must not. Once I do so, my Fo Sect would be publicly targeted. It’s unfortunate that we don’t have overwhelming power against all influences in the world yet. Otherwise, I shall make them all monks, and make them prostrate beneath the golden lotus. By that time, I’ll certainly be capable of sanctifying my Dao with ease. However, shall I just give up on the Saint items just like that? Can I still get another one after losing this opportunity?’
As Heavenly Buddha thought, he replied quickly, “It’s alright that I don’t kill the Sky Demon but how are you guys going to separate the Saint item and the Demi-Sage Weapon?”

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - Snatching the Natural Treasure (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Snatching the Natural Treasure (Part 3)
“Er…” Even the Dragon Monarch was troubled. He couldn’t say that he wanted to kill the Great Demon Venerate and own the Saint item. He wouldn’t be allowed.
“My Dragon Clan will take the Saint Weapon!” The Dragon Monarch decided to voice out his second best plan, “We’ll do our best to help you all in killing the Great Demon Venerate!”
“You’ll take the Saint Weapon?” Vermilion Bird sneered. “I want the Saint Weapon too and only the Saint Weapon!”
“Guys, this place looks like the Saint Demon Lord’s place, also a place where I used to stay. Not only you all come over here to fight without my consent, how dare you all wanna snatch my stuff?” Yu Fei was unhappy, “The Saint Weapon is of the Saint Demon Lord, hence belongs to my Abyss! Moreover…”
With a wry smile, she said, “I can also invoke some remaining power of the Saint Demon Lord here!”
“You’re able to invoke the power of the Saint Demon Lord?” The Heavenly Buddha’s eyes lit up. “In this case, you are the culprit over Tai Jian’s death? You were the one who conjured that punch earlier by invoking the power of the Saint Demon Lord? A Saint Lord only needs to know a method and he can conjure various types of power with ease.”
He purposely explained.
The other experts looked over.
Vermilion Bird pouted to herself.
The Dragon Monarch was rather speechless.
Yu Fei was not annoyed at all. Instead she chuckled, “Heavenly Buddha, if I were to have such a power, why would I’ve to wait for you all? Why would I wait for you all to barge into my Abyss as though it’s desolated? You’re trying to look for yourself a scapegoat, aren’t you?”
She snorted softly, glanced around, and her eyes squinted into crescents. She looked so alluring that many yeared to hug her tight in their arms.
“Since you all wanted to kill the Great Demon Venerate and take the Saint Weapon, what about…” Yu Fei suggested, “Snatching them based on your own ability? As for the position as the Heavenly Emperor, we shall elect whoever can kill the Great Demon Venerate. How’s it? With all of you here, the greatest in the world, let’s make known your stand, shall we?”
“I agree!” Heavenly Buddha was the first one to declare.
This suggestion was obviously to his advantage. The other two of his followers nodded their heads in agreement too.
“We’ve been competing all these while. Of course we need to compete too in grabbing this great encounter. Let’s just do it based on our abilities then. It’s also fair enough because it gives everyone of us an opportunity!” Venerate Tai Yin made her stand.
The more chaotic it became, the better it was for her. Therefore, she was pleased with the suggestion of Yu Fei.
Other experts too, voiced out their stands.
Vermilion Bird and Dragon Monarch had to follow the majority although they disagreed upon the suggestion.
None of them dared to provoke the others, after all.
“In this case, let’s just enter the place!” Yu Fei turned into a stream of light and barged in.
“This son of the b*tch!” Dragon Monarch gritted his teeth but he hesitated because he was afraid of the potential danger.
“Ladies and gentlemen, let’s enter together!” Heavenly Buddha invited.
“Let’s go!” Vermillion Bird was surrounded by burning destructive flames. She also evoked a defensive treasure before she plunged in.
The others followed after.
With so many experts together, they no longer were afraid even the formations of the Saint Lord were very terrifying.
They would even have incomparable fighting strength if they were to face the Saint Venerate.
…
On Chuyang Peak.
“I mustn’t wait any longer!” Jiang Ming rose to his feet, and called up his Human Path Record to lock the target at the Great Demon Venerate. “This time I shall go personally to send the Great Demon Venerate to his death and snatch away his Saint Weapon!”
He turned into light and entered the Human Path Record. The Record then made its way into the void and disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - Who’s He (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Who’s He (Part 1)
There were no foolish men among the Great Overarching experts.
Of course, some like Beiming Hai were exceptions.
It should be said that those who could become Great Overarching experts were extremely intelligent.
They knew that the task of besieging the Great Demon Venerate was a battle only the Venerates could join.
However, there were many Great Overarching Golden Immortals around, an enormous number of them.
They entered the secret realm of the Saint Demon Lord, and did their best in invading the forbidden area even though they knew they might die due to unforeseen danger.
Why did they do so? It was for the sake of encounters.
It was a place of a saint, hence there must be numerous hidden treasures and legacy being left behind.
If they were to get some of them, they would be able to reap lots of benefits from it.
Particularly for some of the Great Overarching Golden Immortals, who had been cultivated for millions of years yet without improvement, would definitely be ecstatic when they could easily enter the secret realm of the Saint Lord.
Therefore, f*ck the potential dangers! If they survived, they would live for another millions years after all.
Moreover, if they were unable to sanctify their way of Dao, their life would be meaningless.
Power? Beauties? Beautiful scenery? Scrumptious delicacies? They had enough enjoyment, play, perception and taste of that.
The only thing that they remained passionate about was to sanctify their ways of Dao.
In fact, comprehending great Daos and improving cultivation base were the obsessions of many experts.
Therefore, there were extraordinarily many Great Overarching Golden Immortals around in the secret realm of the Saint Demon Lord. Many among them were top notch people from middle chiliocosms and some audacious Taiyi living things.
They were restraining themselves at the beginning. But as they went deeper with the group and many treasures were snatched away, they were getting more impatient, hence more fights.
Whenever there was desire, there was competition.
In fact, it was the same whether it was in the immortal world or the mortal world.
Heavenly Buddha and the other experts were accustomed to it already. Hence, they just let them be.
Top experts like them had got into the last palace complex to find for the Great Demon Venerate. They wanted to kill him to obtain the qualifications to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor and to snatch Saint Weapon.
…
In one of the palaces.
The Great Demon Venerate was seen standing at the entrance looking out.
Although he looked miserable, he remained lofty.
‘I can’t believe that I’m in this situation!” He sighed, “I’ve hid 12 venerates, and own Saint Weapon in addition to sacrificing many worlds at the cost of sacrificing the fate of the abyss. I thought I could easily cause the collapse of the Heaven Court and kill the Heavenly Emperor. Yet, even though I’ve achieved my target, I’m left alone. I’m under attack, so much so that I need to go into hiding, and now I’m cornered!’
A sigh of unending sadness.
His breath too, had been weakened to the extreme.
But he still sneered, “Wanna kill me? Ha…”
“Although I’m at this stage of abjection, I’m not that easy to be killed.”
“Once they get here, I shall get a few companions to die with me.”
“I came here a few times before, so I know some transparent formations here.”
“Moreover, I’ve Saint Weapon with me!”
The Great Demon Venerate reached out to grab, and a Blood Banner appeared in his hand. As the banner was opened up, it was bloody red in color, just like it had been immersed in endless blood.
As the banner flattered slightly, even without any evocation, it emitted endless tides of power.
At this moment, he suddenly turned and saw someone he knew.
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!” Jiang Ming immediately made his move.
He was not the one who acted but the 10 clones he quickly conjured at arrival. All were aiming at the Blood Banner in the Great Demon Venerate’s hand.
It was the Saint Weapon, hence it was worth the attention regardless.
Meanwhile, “Celestial Heart Sword, slash!”
With a flicker on Jiang Ming’s forehead, his spiritual will turned into a sword light which broke the shackles of space, shuttled through the long river of time and eventually pierced into the other party’s sea of consciousness with a flicker.
The Great Demon Venerate’s rapid reflex response usually allowed him to counteract even if he was taken by surprise attack.
In fact, the moment he saw Jiang Ming, he subconsciously wanted to evoke the Blood Banner but he discovered the speed he could evoke the Saint Weapon in his hand had greatly been reduced.
It was at that one thousandth second that the winner had been decided.
Puft…
The invisible sound cut through the defensive luminance surrounding the Great Demon Venerate’s soul, directly cutting the soul into two.
The Great Demon Venerate gave a start and his complexion suddenly darkened.
Jiang Ming lunged himself forward, blasted his opposition’s hand with a punch and collected the Blood Banner into his Human Path Record.
He thought it would be difficult.
He also felt the involuntary struggles of the Blood Banner itself. But the struggle was in vain with the present of the Human Path Record.
Therefore, he gave a sigh of relief.
Without the Blood Banner and the divided soul had destined the death of the Great Demon Venerate.
“Do you have any final words?” Jiang Ming paused.
The Human Path Record was suspended above them, emitting waves that were concealing all of the karma.
Ten clones too, were encircling him while evoking the Space-Time Sealing technique to seal the surroundings.
“Jiang Ming, I can’t believe that you have such a strong spiritual will, so much so that you have the power of soul akin to a Demi-Sage even though you’re just at the Great Overarching Realm. No, the attack just now was beyond the Demi-Sage.” The Great Demon Venerate exclaimed, “Who can ever think that you still have such a trump card up your sleeves even after you’ve killed many venerates!”
“If I don’t do so, I’ll be easily schemed!” Jiang Ming laughed, “And you’re an example of being schemed by the Heavenly Emperor!”
“I’m schemed by the Heavenly Emperor?” The Great Demon Venerate was confused.
At this time because he knew he was about to die, he had let go of all he had.
“He’s been acting?” The Great Demon Venerate shook his head and said, “No, I saw him die with my naked eyes. And I felt the disappearance of the curse he had casted on me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - Who’s He (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Who’s He (Part 2)
Chapter 298
“He knew everything about you but you didn’t. He’s been seeing you as a fool when you’re leading your Abyss to go against heaven!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“Can you elaborate further since I’m about to die? The Heaven Court collapsed, many Venerable Immortals died tragically, even him…was that his avatar? One had died after all. And he paid such a great cost just to frame me? He can in fact, destroy my Abyss easily even without scheming. I don’t get it!”
“Let me explain to you then! The Sky-defying Boundary Breaking Formation of yours, the Heavenly Emperor knew about it; the 12 venerates you’ve been hiding, he too knew about them.” Jiang Ming looked at him with somewhat sympathy and continued, “Even the battle of Abyss felling heaven that you initiated, he was the one who furtively promoted! As for the collapse of Heaven Court and the others incidents, he allowed it to remove betrayers through you. Prior to this, he had shifted most of his loyal followers away! Another thing he wanted to do was to cut off the Abyss’s luck so that he could thoroughly reign over the Abyss. Through his so-called death, he knew the Heavenly Buddha and the rest would hunt you down and then they’d scramble for your treasures. Then he’ll want to have these old geeze all killed. By the time when he ascends the throne again, he’ll have his orders strictly enforced in heaven and earth!”
“Oh yes, he’s got three avatars! The Heavenly Emperor was one of them! Another one is the Venerate Tai Yin! But I don’t know the third one! Hence, the Heavenly Emperor is someone very discreet, while you’re merely like a kid!”
As Jiang Mind explained, he somewhat had a strange feeling, and of course, some inexplicable pleasure.
He knew too much. Thus, when he was able to reveal some, he felt great.
‘Do I look like an antagonist? Well, let it be provided I’m happy about it.’ Jiang Ming could not help but ponder.
“The Heavenly Emperor knew about the Sky-Defying Boundary Breaking Formation, the 12 venerates and all my arrangements? And he has three avatars? How’s it possible?” The Great Demon Venerate could not help but be dumbfounded.
His look suddenly distorted. It was as if he suddenly realized that his sworn enemy was someone far more superior than him.
Such a contrast was unbearable for someone aloof like him.
