“No, when the Heavenly Emperor managed to deceive me and the world, how did you know that? And how did you manage to come here quietly?” The Great Demon Venerate grasped the key points.
“Because this is my secret!” Jiang Ming took a glance at the distance and his 10 clones simultaneously casted a great sealing technique, sealing up the Great Demon Venerate.
With a wave, Jiang Ming took away all the Great Demon Venerate’s treasures such as the Sky Demon Saber.
Without further checking, he grabbed on his neck, unsealed many of the seals, and left only a part of his soul before he threw him out.
He also gave the Great Demon Venerate a palm filled with demon qi and at the same time, he adjusted his voice to shout in the Great Demon Venerate’s voice, “Yu Fei, you bi*tch! You brought me to this point, die!”
Yu Fei was the first to get here.
After all, this was her so-called home. Hence she knew the structure here better than anyone else. Moreover, she detected the residual aura of the Great Demon Venerate and rushed over.
She was meticulous to evoke her special ability and hold it just in case.
At this moment, she heard the Great Demon Venerate and saw his attack. Without much consideration, she threw out her Seven-colored Scarf, which penetrated the black mist, entangled the Great Demon Venerate and strangled it into six or seven sections.
“Something’s not right!”
Yu Fei immediately realized something was wrong because she didn’t feel any resistance at all.
With a simple wave of her hand, she dispersed the demon qi.
She saw the Great Demon Venerate fall on the ground, scattered into pieces. Blood was everywhere.
If a drop of his blood were to fall on a mortal world, it would become a sea of blood. But because he died at the cultivation area of the Saint Demon Lord, nothing special happened.
It was, however, such a tragic death. The Great Demon Venerate was cut into seven pieces. He had two bug-eyes, a hideous face and he was no longer breathing. There’s not even the undulation of his primal spirit.
“Dead?” Yu Fei stared at the bodies with surprise.
Meanwhile, all the other experts who sensed the movement and who had been paying attention to Yu Fei, rushed over.
“The Great Demon Venerate is dead?” The Dragon Monarch landed beside and saw the situation in a glance. He could not help but caress his head before he stepped forward to examine carefully. Then he verified, “He’s dead, thoroughly dead! His primal spirit crushed, his soul dried up and his life dispersed. He’s utterly dead.”
He turned to Yu Fei, and said with an inexplicable expression, “I can’t believe that you’ve such capability to kill the Great Demon Venerate in such a short while!”
“He’s got Saint Weapon, even if he’s dying, he shouldn’t have died without noise at all!” The Heaven Buddha frowned because he felt something was wrong. He even looked around with his Buddha eyes but found nothing.
“Taoist Yu Fei, how did you kill him? And you even chopped him into seven pieces!” The Heavenly Buddha was furtively shocked.
He looked at the scarf surrounding her body and sensed the rich residual aura of the Great Demon Venerate on it.
“I thought this treasure of yours was merely just to cover your body, I can’t believe that it can be this strong, so much so that it cut the Great Demon Venerate into pieces!” Vermillion Bird said indifferently, “It’s indeed akin to the saying that even a pair of birds living in the same grove depart to different directions upon imminent disaster!”
“Ha…” Yu Fei was not angered but twisted her waist as she replied, “Anyway, I used to have a man. What about you? A billion-year-old virgin!”
“So what if I’m an old virgin? I’m still innocent. But you, I wonder how many you’ve slept with!” The Vermillion Bird sneered, “I used to learn a saying in the mortal world that best describes you, that is the mouth has been kissed by many, so do the arms!”

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - Who’s He (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Who’s He (Part 3)
“This can only prove how outstanding I’m. Unlike you who have not even a single man!” Yu Fei smirked, “No wonder you’re so angry. It turns out that you’ve been restraining yourself for too long! Shall I get you 100,000 demons, each of which has a height of at least 1,000 feet, absolutely strong enough for you!”
“F*ck you!” The Vermilion Bird was furious.
“Nah, I’m not afraid of you!” Yu Fei snorted coldly.
The two of them were glaring at each other.
Meanwhile, Heavenly Buddha and Dragon Monarch looked at each other, rather speechless. Venerate Tai Yin, Great Monarch Tian Song and the rest only looked into the sky.
“Ahem!” Dragon Monarch coughed softly and asked, “Yu Fei, were you the one who killed the Great Demon Venerate?”
“Did I?” Yu Fei was uncertain, “As soon as I got here, I saw a strong demon qi gushing in my direction, hence I counteracted. But because the opposition was merely swashbuckling, I gattored the Great Demon Venerate into seven pieces. He s-seemed like he had already died. No, I felt he was still alive and I was indeed the one who killed him. B-but he should have been extremely weak, as though he was thrown over by another expert for me to kill him.”
“When we got here, we didn’t see any other expert!” Vermilion Bird smirked, “Yu Fei, can it be that you wanted the Saint Weapon for yourself?”
“Are you blind?” Yu Fei reprimanded, “It’s common knowledge that refining a Saint Weapon is very difficult. And how can one keep it in the body without refinement? Do you see any Saint Weapons around?”
As for keeping it in the storage space, it was impossible. In fact, there wasn’t any storage item which could store Saint Weapon in the world. Others might not know but those who were around clearly knew about it.
“Perhaps you’ve hid it!” Vermilion Bird scanned through the place.
The Dragon Monarch and the others too, were probing.
“Shall I take off my clothes so that everyone of you can check meticulously?” Yu Fei smiled coquettishly. She also turned around twice, emitting invincible waves. The Great Overarching Golden Immortal who had just entered was seduced. He had a horny look as he muttered, “This is good, very good. Take off quickly!”
“F*ck your mom!” Yu Fei pointed at the man, and her scarf straightened and penetrated through his head, exploding his head and body into a bloody mist with a slight shiver. “Dirty, lowly thing. Not deserve to look at my body, not at all!”
Dragon Monarch and the others remained indifferent. After all, the man was merely at the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm.
“Should not be on Yu Fei!” The Heavenly Buddha said, “There isn’t any area suitable for hiding as well! We all knew the Great Demon Venerate. He’s lofty and proud of himself, hence he won’t commit suicide. But why isn’t there any traces of battle here at all? We’ve examined and found no Saint Weapon around. This case reminded me of Tai Jian’s death.”
“Tai Jian died in a strange way. All his Dao weapons disappeared though he died due to the special ability of my Fo Sect! Now that the Great Demon Venerate is dead, and his Saint Weapon too, disappeared! There must be someone terrifying behind these matters!”
“But who’s he? Who can evoke the peerless special ability of the Heavenly Emperor and invoke the power of authority of heaven and earth? Who can easily kill Tai Jian, protected by a Demi-Sage Defensive Item, with the special ability of the Fo Sect? Who can suppress the Great Demon Venerate with Saint Weapon, let him be killed by Yu Fei when he was dying and snatch away the Saint Weapon? Who has such power? If he’s a Saint Lord, it wouldn’t be so troublesome for him to do all these! But can a Demi-Sage do all these?”
As the Heavenly Buddha said, he could not help to ponder, “I can think of only one person!”
“Is it him?” Dragon Monarch frowned.
“I think so!” Burning flames ignited in Vermilion Bird’s eyes.
“Punched through the Abyss, killed Tai Jian and suppressed the Great Demon Venerate, are any of us here capable of doing so? It’s a resounding no!” Yu Fei’s eyes were ignited with hints of unrestrainable lust. She could not help but licked her lips and muttered, “It’s only him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - Dao Sanctified, Besieged Riyue
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Dao Sanctified, Besieged Riyue
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming had returned. He laid comfortably on the rattan chair, swaying.
With a snap of his fingers, Hua Huo brought him immortal tea, Hua Yu brought him a fruit plate, Hua Rui gave him a shoulder massage while Hua Jing gave him a legs massage.
He was enjoying the sweet smell of flowers, drinking immortal tea and occasionally having a piece of fruit.
Perfect!
“Fighting and killing is not as comfortable as this!” Jiang Ming exclaimed earnestly.
Then he called up the Human Path Record to check the items in it.
There were Demi-Sage Weapons which included the Silver Luminance Battle Armor, Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, Emperor Crown, and Sky Demon Saber; Saint Weapon which included the Blood Banner; and not to mention other items of lower levels like the Taiye Sword, a Quasi-Sage Weapon at its pinnacle.
Jiang Ming felt even greater looking at his collections.
After he threw the dying Great Demon Venerate to Yu Fei, he immediately returned through the Human Path Records. As for what would happen next?
He did not care!
Flipping through pages.
‘What!’
Jiang Ming stared at the ‘Status’ of Heavenly Buddha as he read.
Heavenly Buddha thought it was Riyue Changfeng who killed the Great Demon Venerate.
Even the death of Tai Jian and the punch that punched into the Abyss were the acts of this foreigner.
Anyway, their analysis was logical. Only the Saint Lord could easily achieve those three situations depicted.
Nevertheless, the Saint Lord had long left. Even if he was still around, why would he do such nonsense? He was, after all, overweening and domineering.
Other than the Saint Lord himself, who else in infinite realms could do it? Not even the former Heavenly Emperor. What’s more the Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch and the rest who were of lower level?
There was also Jiang Ming. Even though that kid’s combat strength was strong, he used the method of Dao vessels detonation. It was impossible for him to punch through the Abyss.
The death of the Great Demon Venerate surprisingly didn’t create any noise at all.
Hence, after filtering out irrelevant suspects, only Riyue Changfeng, whoseability was unknown, was the only suspect left.
This man was, after all, from foreign space. It was the legendary Sea of Chaos. It was said that this was the source of Dao, the ultimate destination of all cultivators. Even the Saint Lord could not help going there to chase for higher achievement.
In this case, how would an expert coming from that place be that simple?
Look at how Demon Venerate Bi Jiu from the Demon Holy Place was suppressed in an instant. This intimidated the Demon Holy Place from taking their revenge.
This proved how strong he was. In particular, he not only suppressed but also enslaved and twisted the mind.
Such a capability was achievable by the Heavenly Buddha and the likes only if there was a gap of 10 millions of years in between the suppression and enslavement. Yet, he did it almost simultaneously.
‘It’d be interesting if Riyue Changfeng was to be besieged!’ Jiang Ming gloated.
They were merely common friends. Their relationship wasn’t up to the stage whereby they could entrust their life to each other.
Moreover, there were barely any trustworthy adults considering the number of confidants was only fewer than expected.
In fact, more than 99% of adults faced difficulty in having any confidant, be it from the same gender or different gender.
Jiang Ming was continuously flipping through the Human Path Records to check on the Status of Heavenly Buddha and the likes. Based on what he was reading, he could make assumptions on what was happening in the Abyss.
At this time, a powerful force was surging from the back of the mountain.
The aura was familiar to Jiang Ming. So he turned to look in the direction.
He saw Xi Yao subconsciously floating up to 10 meters high. She was surrounded by indifferent rays and immortal spiritual qi overhead turned into whirlwinds and poured into her head.
Her aura was surging continuously.
“Finally she’s a breakthrough!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
It was followed by a startle because he was wondering why he used the word ‘finally’. After all, it was merely a year since they got here.
‘It’s considered fast that under an extreme situation, she still manages to step into the immortal realm in just a year.’
‘No, I think it’s me who’s too fast!’
Jiang Ming felt rather melancholy.
He again recalled that his Junior Sister used to tease Xi Yao for her incapability to resist even a drop of liquid. It didn’t seem that she could now either!
What a nasty thought.
Jiang Ming immediately cut it off with the sword of his will.
After some thoughts, Jiang Ming threw an extreme Yin spiritual bead, which was appropriate, into Xi Yao’s body.
He then extracted an innate spiritual qi to be fused into her body.
In just a while, Xi Yao had successfully broken through. Even if she just had a breakthrough, her aura was much stronger than a common immortal at pinnacle.
Xi Yao began consolidating her cultivation base and converging her aura.
‘She’s gotten more beautiful!’
Jiang Ming was looking at her, full of admiration. He was merely admiring her without any ill-intention. Neither did he evoke his divine eyes to have a peek at her.
‘Sigh. I’m such a hypocrite.’
…
In the Abyss.
Riyue Changfeng was enjoying his tea. He was anticipating a splendid drama of battles among many experts that started from the Abyss inside out, and eventually broke through the Abyss.
He didn’t expect to see the Heavenly Buddha and the other experts to approach him as soon as they got out.
Yu Fei flattered her sleeves, bringing along with her, the pink mists, when she stared at Riyue Changfeng. With an alluring smile on her face, she said in a mellow voice that drove the soul crazy, “Brother Riyue, did you kill the Great Demon Venerate?”
“I killed him?” Riyue Changfeng showed no hint of fear but was startled when he heard Yu Fei’s words. Meanwhile, wisdom thoughts ran wildly through his mind, collided and detached until he reached a conclusion: the Great Demon Venerate was killed by an inexplicable expert. None of them knew who the expert was, just like the punch that suddenly appeared in the Abyss.
He shook his head, “I must abide by the rule that prohibits me from entering a secret realm without being invited. Because this secret realm is owned by the Saint Demon Lord, who’s still alive, I can’t go in at all!”
“There’s actually such a rule!” Yu Fei was surprised.
“The great Dao can revolve on rules. Else, the Chaos would have gone chaotic.” Riyue Changfeng rose to his feet and smiled rather indifferently, “You don’t believe?”
“It’s difficult to!” The Heavenly Buddha chimed in, “Because the mean you used against Bi Jiu was too strong, and too strange. Even though Bi Jiu is a Demon Venerate, it took you just a moment to suppress him, so much so that his mind and will were twisted. This isn’t achievable even by the Saint Lord himself!”
Vermilion Bird looked grave while she was listening. Bi Jiu was, after all, an elder of her Demon Holy Palace.
“The Abyss was punched prior to the act of Abyss going against the Heaven Court. We thought it was from the Heavenly Emperor. But as we dwelled on it, we couldn’t believe that it was the act of the Heavenly Emperor himself!” The Heavenly Buddha continued, “In the secret realm of the Saint Demon Lord, Tai Jian was killed by the special ability of my Fo Sect. It was so fast that it left Tai Jian no opportunity to escape nor could we help him. Who can actually kill him easily when he has a Demi-Sage level defensive Dao vessel? There’s none in the Honggu Heavenly Realm.”
“Moreover, even though the Great Demon Venerate was dying, we were in the secret realm of the Saint Demon Lord located in the Abyss, his territory and he had the Saint Weapon. Yet, he was killed in silence!”
“Both the defensive Dao vessel of Tai Jian and the Saint Weapon of the Great Demon Venerate have disappeared”
“Based on all these, we assume that only someone mysterious like you can do that. Hence, it’s natural that we doubted you’re the culprit. We apologize if we’ve made a false assumption!”
“Please enlighten us too if you aren’t the one!”
The Heavenly Buddha was a wolf in sheep’s clothing indeed.
‘Both the Great Demon Venerate and Tai Jian had died? All Dao vessels are gone before all of them just like that!’ Riyue Changfeng could not help but frown. ‘Who can achieve that?’
Inexplicably, he thought of a person.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - The Restless Xi Yao
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: The Restless Xi Yao
‘Jiang Ming’ was the person Riyue Changfeng thought of.
He couldn’t see through Jiang Ming, really couldn’t.
He had been traveling through infinite realms, for so many people below the Saint Lord he had met, there weren’t many that he couldn’t see through.
Whoever he couldn’t see through would have a sky-defying and terrific foundation.
Riyue Changfeng certainly wouldn’t share his suspicions. Even if he knew it was the act of Jiang Ming, he wouldn’t tell, what’s more he was just suspecting.
His job required him to remain in a neutral position, and merely be a guest of space.
Hence, Riyue Changfeng shook his head, “I have no idea! But I’m not the one who did it. I’m not capable of killing Tai Jian and the Great Demon Venerate quietly with you guys around!”
“Who else can it be if you weren’t the one?” Vermilion Bird snorted, “Unless you make a vow!”
Riyue Changfeng smiled, “I won’t do that for sure. Anyway, whether you believe it or not, it’s not my problem!”
“Making a vow won’t affect you at all. It’s just a few sentences that you’ve to say. But you refuse to. Hence, it proves that you have a guilty conscience!” Vermilion Bird was implacable.
Riyue Changfeng remained smiling but it turned into a sneer. “Ladies and gentlemen, if you can trust me, please leave. And you are welcome to the auction which is just around the corner. Otherwise, you may attack me!”
One of his hands was put behind his back while the other one held a tea cup. He remained calm as though he was not afraid of any of the experts in his surroundings at all.
“Guys!” The Vermilion Bird was not stupid to stand forward alone without soliciting the other experts to act together. She sent a message to them through telepathy, “With all the strongest experts gathering here today, why don’t we defeat him together? The treasures available in the auction house, I believe, are thousand times more valuable than the secret realm of the Saint Demon.”
The Dragon Monarch, Great Monarch Tian Song and even the Heavenly Buddha were moved.
However, when the Heavenly Monarch thought about the ability of Riyue Changfeng to travel the Chaos and descend to various worlds, he became afraid. Moreover, he thought Riyue must be protected by someone of the Saint Lord Realm. Hence, he might be in trouble if he were to provoke his protector.
“Taoist Riyue!” Thoughts flew through Heavenly Buddha’s mind in a mere second only. He didn’t respond to the Vermilion Bird’s question but he smiled as he said, “We’re just being dubious, and we’re too desperate for an answer. Since you’ve denied it, I’m sure you mean it. On the day of the auction, my Fo Sect’s members and I will be going! See you then!” He left quickly together with his Fo Sect’s experts.
He thought it had become meaningless to further investigate because it would be even difficult to identify the culprit when they failed to do so in the secret realm of the Saint Lord! Besides, he would never agree with the lecherous demon woman to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor. Hence, it was better that he leave.
Vermilion Bird had an even darker expression etched on her face.
“Taoist Riyue, bye!” The Dragon Monarch left too.
Venerate Tai Yin, Great Monarch Tian Song and the others followed after.
This had further enraged Vermilion Bird, so much so that her face had turned into crimson color and her hairs burning with flames.
Yu Fei couldn’t help but chuckle at her response.
“You lecherous woman!” Vermilion Bird could no longer hold back.
“You old virgin, an old bag nobody wanted.” Yu Fei became more energetic, “Look at the two hump in front of you, none of them actually attracted men. They must be covered with pimples and pus!”
“Damn!” Vermilion Bird exploded with rage and she almost attacked.
“Hahaha!” Yu Fei laughed even more smugly. She began hugging herself and swinging her waist, turning the air into pink color. Many Great Overarching Immortals nearby were allured and a few even came over unconsciously. There were also a dozen of Taiyi Golden Immortals who flew over and crawled before her. She sat on one of their heads while putting her legs on another’s back
“Vermilion Bird, can one be called a woman when no man likes her?” Yu Fei was full of herself, “Look, many geniuses from all over would come crawling even if I don’t move. And look at you, you don’t even have a man. As a woman, you’re indeed a loser!”
“I’m not human!” Vermilion Bird gnashing her teeth.
“Hehe, this person, is not a human but the three elements: qi, yin, and yang, which represent all beings.” Yu Fei pouted, “Old bag, without men to vent on, no wonder you got so heaty that it burns your eyes, your hairs and even your senses. Shall I turn into a man for you?”
“I-I-I…” Vermilion Bird almost exploded in rage.
Riyue Changfeng was startled, inexplicably looking at the two women arguing. He wanted to see how Yu Fei would turn into a man and…
‘Damn it, since when have I become so evil and disgusting!’ He shook his head and sped away. His thought would have been polluted if he was to stay any longer.
Meanwhile, on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming almost cursed.
‘Yu Fei is such a good teaser! If she was here, my life would be interesting and…’ He suddenly shuddered and rubbed his waist.
‘Does she have no shame at all?’ Jiang Ming had a strange thought. But when he thought that she was a demon, a demon of desire, he was enlightened. Demons were shameless, hence what Yu Fei did was merely part of her daily activities.
As he thought further, he felt the first half of Yu Fei’s life was really amusing. She had so many men such as the Saint Demon Lord, the first Great Demon Venerate, Heavenly Emperor, the second Great Demon Venerate, Demon Venerate, Venerable Immortal, Dragon Venerate, and Buddha Venerate.
‘Getting Yu Fei is a sign of becoming an expert?’ Jiang Ming had another strange thought.
At this moment, Xi Yao was pacing over through the air after she had done simple consolidation of her cultivation base.
Stepping in the void, she dimpled waves of immortal spiritual qi.
While being surrounded by immortal luminance, it was obvious that she was wearing a colorful dress. Her legs were as white as snow, her wrists were delicate and tender and her waist was slander.
“Brother Jiang!” Xi Yao landed beside him and with excitement, she said, “I’ve finally become an immortal. It’s the greatest dream that I have. I can’t believe that I can fulfill it in such a short while!”
“This only proves that you’re a genius, and you’re blessed by heaven and earth!” Jiang Ming beamed. He then directed Xi Yao to sit on the nearby bench and pour her a cup of tea.
Xi Yao made herself at home as she said, “Genius? I’m nothing when compared to you. I’m blessed by heaven and earth? We’ve lost our heaven and earth!”
“C’mon, don’t be so pessimistic!”
“It’s the truth!”
“The truth is that you’re now an immortal and you have got prettier!”
“Really?” Xi Yao’s eyes lit up, “Brother Jiang, I didn’t know that you are good at sweet talking!”
“How did you know that?” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Know what?”
“Know that I’m good at sweet talking!”
“Brother Jiang, you’re such a rascal!”
“How can you call me a rascal? I’m just telling the truth!”
“Humph!” Xi Yao snorted. Then, she looked into the sky, with some inexplicable expression.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record to check on Xi Yao.
Status: …Is Jiang Ming teasing me?
: He wanted to let me try on his mouth, Does it mean he wanted to kiss me?
: T-this…
: Why is my heart beating faster and faster?
: Do I really want to try?
: I…
: His lips should be sweet I think?
: What am I thinking about?
: Wait, does he have feelings for me?
: What to do if he suddenly leans in, letting me try whether his lips are sweet?
: Shall I push him away?
: Why would you!
: What if, what if, he leans in further?
: Why am I looking forward to it?
: Is that feeling of having sex wonderful?
: Maybe!
: Otherwise, why would he do it with Linglong every day and night!
: Why do I feel a heat current surging within me?
Jiang Ming felt rather hot reading the Status.
‘If at this hour…’ He quickly suppressed his thoughts and sighed that he was a good gentleman. He swore it was not because of the presence of his Junior Sister Phoenix but because he was an honest man.
“Brother Jiang, thanks!” Xi Yao muttered with her head lowered, trying to hide her blushing face.
“Thanks what?” Jiang Ming pretended as though he didn’t understand, and gave a dubious expression.
“For your gift!” Xi Yao’s voice was even softer. “The gift of Extreme Yin treasures. Through them, I completely understand my path and I believe that it will make my cultivation easier in the future!”
“Oh, don’t mention it!” JIang Ming said as he waved his hand, “We’ve been together for a long time already. And because I have those items, it’s better that I give them to you than wasting them!”
“Brother Jiang, it’s so kind of you!” Xi Yao seemed to be footling.
“As always! Ha, haha!” Jiang Ming laughed rather unnaturally.
Name: Xi Yao.
Status: …Yes, his gifts were all very precious and rare. The Dao of Extreme Yin concealed within it was extraordinarily pure and strong, hence pointed out my future path.
: B-but, he injected them into me, does it mean he had seen through my body?
: Oops, I’m blushing!
: Alas, does it mean that I’m no longer a secret to him from inside out and vice versa?
: Did he take the advantage of giving me the gift to ‘see’ me?
: Did he look at me every day?
: Is he looking at me now?
: Would he lose control of himself and throw himself at me?
: Shall I take the initiative to throw myself at him instead?
Xi Yao became red in the face and tightened her legs.
Jiang Ming felt rather restless too.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 1)
The atmosphere got rather ambiguous to the point that some pinkish mist was produced.
Xi Yao had been facizing. It was uncontrollable. Even if she had tried evoking the sword of wisdom to cut off the love, she bagan facizing again immediately after she had cut it off.
Jiang Ming was restless while reading the Human Path Record.
It was at this time that Junior Sister Phoenix paced over through the air and landed aside. When she took a glance at the flustering Xi Yao and looked at Jiang Ming who appeared to be calm, she pouted.
Without any scruple, she lay beside Jiang Ming. While pointing to the other side of Jiang Ming, she said generously, “Xi Yao, you can take the place at that side of Senior Brother!”
“What are you talking about!” Xi Yao forcefully suppressed her restlessness and glared at Linglong, “That’s your man!”
“I can share him with you!” Junior Sister Phoenix snickered, “He’s a donkey after all. Do you want to have a ride?”
“Linglong!” Xi Yao suddenly rose to her feet and blushed. She raised her voice before abruptly lowering it, “If you do it again, I won’t care about you anymore!”
“It’s up to you!” Junior Sister Phoenix pouted, “I’ve given you a chance after all!”
Xi Yao snorted but she couldn’t help taking a glance at Jiang Ming.
Junior Sister Phoenix rolled her eyes and had her head pillowed on Jiang Ming’s chest.
“You little girl is so mean!” Jiang Ming said helplessly.
“Don’t you think I don’t know what you are thinking about!” Junior Sister Phoenix snorted, “You must be thinking: I have my Junior Sister in my left embrace but my right hand is empty. Xi Yao, quickly come to my right embrace.”
Jiang Ming was left speechless. He felt somewhat embarrassed too because he had the thought indeed. It was every man’s dream to be able to have two beauties on both sides.
Although he had 10 Junior Sisters, they were still his one Junior Sister.
Xi Yao gnashed her teeth, stamped her feet and left through the air, “Linglong, are you trying to chase me away?”
“How can I do that?” Junior Sister Phoenix raised her voice, “Xi Yao, I’ve given you the last chance. I won’t help you from now onwards. This is my man and you don’t even appreciate it even though I’m trying to share with you. Sigh!”
Xi Yao didn’t respond. She returned to her home and activated some simple formation she had built to disconnect the external area with a wave.
Her home was covered with mist and surrounded by immortal luminance in an instant.
She sat on a stone bench in her courtyard and her face looked even red. She stared blankly while holding her head and pouted.
“What can I do?”
“Ahhh…”
After a while, she rubbed her hair irritably. She wanted to just go away but she didn’t know where to go. Moreover, she didn’t want to leave here.
Life was indeed full of confusion.
…
In the balcony on the roof was an interaction between souls.
“Senior Brother, do you really like her?” Junior Sister Phoenix asked.
“My heart can only accommodate 10 people!” Jiang Ming replied honestly.
“Really?”
“Really!”
“The main body and the nine of us?”
“You’re talking shit, aren’t you?”
“Can shit talk?”
“Why don’t you smell it?”
“Senior Brother, you’re so shameless!”
“Alas, it’s not that you haven’t smelled it before.”
“Be careful that I’ll sit on your face again!”
Life was that boring. They were having another type of feeling while enjoying their intimacy.
In just a blink of an eye, it was eventually the auction day.
When the sun rose from the east, Jiang Ming woke up from his cultivation. It was important to cultivate but he could do it after he enjoyed such a beautiful morning.
He cooked some porridge with some simple dishes, and ate them alone.
As for his Junior Sister Phoenix, she was too tired due to the heavy exercise yesterday night. Hence, she had gone cultivating.
He wanted to call Xi Yao but he was afraid he couldn’t hold back his restlessness, and started exercising again. He was also afraid of his waist condition if his Junior Sister found out and joined in.
Alas! He had no choice but to take care of his own body.
After he had a satisfying meal, he received the rewards.
“DIng: Congratulations to the host for finally having a quiet breakfast. You are rewarded with the three-minutes scream of Yu Fei (Note: you can send it to a specified location without others noticing).
Jiang Ming was startled and then rather speechless at the reward he had received.
The three-minutes scream of Yu Fei? He was wondering why the system would be so unserious.
‘But…’ As he pinched his chin, he thought of an idea and couldn’t help but smile.
He looked above the Tianyuan Sea and saw a great amount of experts. There were even hundreds of Great Overarching Golden Immortals. It was obvious that they were here to join the auction.
‘I’m afraid that they aren’t coming from the Heavenly Realm only!’ Jiang Ming pondered. He expected that there were strong experts coming from some middle chiliocosms too. They were of the largest group of people, even the number of humans among them was high too.
The auction house had yet to open its door.
Jiang Ming was not in a hurry. He brewed a cup of tea and was enjoying it slowly. He lay on a rattan chair, leisurely swaying while calling up the Human Path Record to check out various conditions.
In general, the Honggu Heavenly Realm was still in a peaceful state. However, Yu Fei was trying to get supporters to have her enthroned as the Heavenly Emperor. She even allured many old stagers.
‘She even counts me in her plan!’ Jiang Ming was rather speechless. He didn’t care how lecherous she was, but he cared that she was full of men’s aura. By just thinking of her having sex with different men, he was disgusted.
‘She even thought of trying out Riyue Changfeng after the auction? She wants to buy off the Fo Sect?’ Jiang Ming felt funny. He thought it would be easier if Yu Fei set up a stage so that she would get the top 10 to date her.
He continued flipping the Human Path Record.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 2)
Jiang Ming was looking at some secrets and prying into something weird. When he flipped to a page, he frowned.
It was a page about Ye Qingxian.
‘She’s actually returned to reality!’
She had stayed in the Supreme Pagoda for almost a year, which was akin to about a thousand years inside.
Jiang Ming didn’t expect her to return to reality.
Based on her Status, she seemed to have accumulated to an extreme after she activated the Dao Enlightenment Mode. She had been tempering herself for a long time before she returned to her reality to look around. She planned to continue only after that and tried her best to go through more levels to get herself into the group chat.
However, she was in danger.
‘Life-and–death crisis?’ Jiang Ming frowned.
He knew it was easy for her to escape because of the presence of the Supreme Pagoda. But because of her temperament, he was afraid that…
Moreover, he knew that if the Supreme Pagoda was to be evoked during a battle, it would have a few seconds delay. It was the rule that desperation might be present amidst life.
In fact, a short while was more than enough to determine one’s life to experts.
‘It’s fate that we met. Since I’ve learned about her condition, I shall try to save her. I’m just wondering if the time flow over there is the same as mine?’ As Jiang Ming thought, he conjured a clone which made its way into the Human Path Record to be projected to that world.
Projection that traversed different worlds was energy consuming. But he managed to endure it this time. He had, after all, become stronger with his improved cultivation base, foundation and energy.
He briefly calculated that the energy spent this time was less than one third of the energy of the main body, excluding the power of his inner world.
‘I think I can bear it if I go in person!’ As Jiang Ming thought, he closed his eyes to feel the condition of his clone.
When the main body and its clone were being separated by great chiliocosm and even the Chaos, even if the telepathy existed between them, it would be greatly reduced.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming had the Human Path Record as the medium.
He knew that his clone had got to a great chiliocosm of unknown size. There was a force called the Stone Mansion, dominating a territory.
After the transcendence of Ye Qingxian, she joined the Stone Mansion and was specifically trained.
Jiang Ming’s clone was about 100 miles away from Ye Qingxian. He was concealing himself in the void.
The moment he got there, Jiang Ming sensed the difference in the world. ‘What’s the difference?’ He frowned, ‘It’s the difference in the origin!’
He immediately had a judgment. A different origin would cause an imperceptible change in the laws.
A foreigner needed to breathe in the aura here to adapt to the world. He sealed himself with the Human Path Record while absorbing the aura of the world. In no time, his breath had been assimilated.
Besides, with the Records to chop off his karma, no one could calculate his origin.
Then, Jiang Ming began to observe his surroundings. Beneath him was a massive God City. It was 80 thousand miles from east to west, and 30 thousand miles from south to north. It was so massive beyond imagination.
However, there was a great war in the city. The city protecting formation was broken. Everywhere in the city was massacre, collision of special abilities, and the flying immortal weapons. There was a continuous rain of blood too.
‘The intruders were merely three Golden Immortals, two of which are only at the initial stage, only one is at the later stage. Hence they aren’t that strong!’ Jiang Ming had already analyzed the situation here, ‘There are only two Golden Immortal defenders. One at his initial stage while another at the middle stage. In short, this was just a common battle.’
It was known as a common battle because the battle did not involve any brilliant expert or genius. Hence, the situation whereby an expert could fight against someone of a higher cultivation base would not exist.
Besides, it was difficult for an expert to kill another expert of the same cultivation base. Hence, it would take a long time to determine the winner.
Such a situation was very common in infinite realms.
Jiang Ming saw Ye Qingxian. Because he found out that she was safe for now, he didn’t show himself. Instead he invaded the sea of consciousness of some immortals to find out the details of the world here.
The world where he was, was called the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm. There was a Heaven Court dominating the world even though it was not as strong as the Heaven Court of the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
The immortal land was divided into 81 provinces. He was currently in Cloud Province, located in the south east direction.
In Cloud Province were 72 mansions, and this city belonged to the Stone Mansion. The Mansion Master was called Shi Lei, a relatively famous human being.
‘The cause of the battle is rather ridiculous!’ Jiang Ming had a strange feeling when he learned about the cause of the battle.
Shi Lei had a younger brother called Shi Han. When he died many years back, he left behind his son, Shi Fang.
Shi Fang had many bad habits because of him abusing his social status. But he was clever enough not to provoke people with status in the Stone Mansion. He had been lecherous since young. When he first met Ye Qingxian, he was eager to hit on her. He gave up when he learned that Shi Lei valued Ye Qingxian.
Not long ago, there was a beautiful lady who came to the Stone Mansion. Shi Fang was attracted when he saw her. Before he took action, he secretly inquired about her. He found out that the woman was a foreigner. She had no guardians and she was not strong, only at True Immortal Realm. Hence, he got her into the mansion.
But he fell for her. Hence, he began pursuing her. He had been sweet talking to her, and even gave her a Mystical Immortal Weapon as a gift. Yet, all his efforts were in vain, and he was scolded instead.
Shi Fang had finally lost his patience, and raped her.
The girl was heartbroken.
Half a month later when Shi Fang was getting more relaxed, the girl managed to escape. And she was now back to take revenge.
The girl was called Lan Shuirou, the daughter of the Mansion Master of the Misty Mansion next door. She had been trained in secret all these while.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Descended into the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm (Part 3) Translation
Seeing her daughter’s outstanding temperament and unparalleled appearance, he planned on giving her to an Immortal King for promotion.
Nevertheless, Lan Shuirou learned about the plan. She got exasperated and sneaked out. To hide from her father, she didn’t even take protective treasure with her and she was desecrated by Shi Fang.
She was a tough girl. After she was being humiliated, she escaped, returned to her mansion and told her family members about her misery.
Lan Qianfan, the Mansion Master of the Misty Mansion was furious. Hence, he sent a troop to the Stone Mansion.
While confronting the Stone Mansion, Shi Lei learned about the cause and exploded in rage. He immediately caught his nephew so that he kneeled down in public. Then he told Lan Qianfan that he was willing to spend half of his wealth as the betrothal gift for his nephew to marry his daughter.
Lan Qianfan rejected the offer because he wanted Shi Fang dead in order to vent his anger.
Shi Lei was a rather merciless man. He said he would imprison Shi Fang for 100 thousand years and compensate Lan Qianfan with half of his wealth.
Lan Qianfan rejected again because he only wanted Shi Fang dead.
Shi Lei was irritated.
As a result a war broke up.
However, the Stone Mansion was weaker in foundation. Hence, it was suppressed and its city’s protective formation was broken.
The effects of the war were extremely horrifying. They had been slaughtering to the stage that they lost their mind.
Ye Qingxian returned during the war, hence she had to join in. Although she was only at the Heavenly Immortal Realm, she was strong enough to resist a Mystical Immortal. Hence, she was considered one of the main contributors.
However, the war sided with the other party.
“Qingxian, get out of here, quick!” After forcing the opponent to retreat, the woman at the later stage of the Mystical Immortal Realm got to Ye Qingxian and urged, “The Stone Mansion is finished, so do we. Qingxian, get out of here. You are the only one with the highest potential in our Stone Mansion. Provided you escape, you can take revenge for us in the future. Get out of here quick before it’s too late!”
“Sister Yun!” Ye Qingxian shook her head while smiling, “At that time when I’ve just transcended, for many times I was at the verge of death, it was because of you and the Mansion Master that I survived. Now that the Stone Mansion is having difficulty, how can I leave just like that?”
“You kid, don’t you want to die together with us?” Sister Yun forced a smile.
When Ye Qingxian saw a Golden Immortal was coming towards them, she took out a Taiyi Weapon without hesitance. It was the Taiyi Immortal Sword that she bought with the points she received from Jiang Ming, as a protector.
Along with a slash, she threw the opponent away but she couldn’t badly injure him. After all, her cultivation base was too low. She could kill a Mystical Immortal but she was far from Jiang Ming’s capability.
The aura radiated from the sword was intimidating. The unparalleled aura had drawn all experts’ attention in an instant.
“Taiyi Weapon?” After Lan Qianfan forced the retreat of Shi Lei, he turned to Ye Qingxian. His eyes lit up and couldn’t help smiling, “I can’t believe that I’m so lucky here in the territory of the Stone Mansion! Shi Lei, thanks for this Taiyi Weapon. I’ll then kill you and take over your territory! Li Feng, kill her!”
“Don’t worry, big brother. She wouldn’t be able to escape!” The Golden Immortal Li Feng accepted the command. He then lunged himself towards Ye Qingxian and said, “You as a Heavenly Immortal, not only can resist a Mystical Immortal but also have a Taiyi Immortal Weapon. Yet you only originated from the Stone Mansion. You must have obtained a sky-defying encounter! If we don’t kill you today, you’ll be a great trouble to us. Sigh, because of the scum of your Stone Mansion, you lose your bright future too.”
“Spear’s shadows, kill!”
Along with a jerk of the spear in his hand, millions of the spear’s shadows were formed. He gathered unparalleled energies and threw Ye Qingxian out.
“Get out of here, I’ll stop him, go!” Sister Yun blocked the attack and at the same time, she cried.
However, she only managed to resist for a moment and she was thrown out. Her left shoulder burst and almost was almost killed.
“What a pitiful beautiful lady!” Li Feng paced in the air, as he wielded the Golden Immortal Weapon which radiated an aura that could pierce through all things. “Die!”
Destructive energy burst out from the tip of the spear and was directed towards the forehead of Ye Qingxian.
It was so fast and barbarous.
Ye Qingxian sighed because she knew that even though she could resist it, she would be badly injured.
Then, she was not sure if she should just leave like that.
She sneered at herself, ‘So what if I’ve obtained such a sky-defying encounter? I can’t even overcome such a challenge, but I have to figure out how to sneak off. I’m so unreconcile to defeat…’
When she was preparing to resist the attack with her best, she found out that someone was standing before her, blocking the tip of the spear with his finger.
Yes, it was the fingertip vs the spear’s tip.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - It’s Amazing (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: It’s Amazing (Part 1)
As Ye Qingxian looked at the familiar back and felt the familiar aura, she was stunned. She rubbed her eyes with disbelief before she expressed excitement.
She was looking open-mouthed, confused. However, she smiled with a sigh of relief.
In front of her was Jiang Ming. He appeared because he saw Ye Qing Xian was in danger. He came and blocked the spear merely with his finger.
The spear which radiated the aura that could pierce through all things, was completely blocked.
“What…” Li Feng was stunned.
He was stupefied at the ability of this man to block his Golden Immortal Weapon with just a finger. He was wondering about the identity of Jiang Ming and how he could be so strong.
Following that,his face was ashen. His long spear started scattering from its tip. He felt a stream of energy that trembled his soul, sealing the space and condensing the time, restraining him from moving.
He couldn’t do anything but to stare at the shattering of his long spear, his arm and then his body. He wanted to cry for help but he discovered that even his primal spirit was being annihilated. Hence, with desperation, he reluctantly took a last glance at the world.
With just a mere finger, Jiang Ming had killed a Golden Immortal.
Then, Jiang Ming turned to Ye Qingxian and smiled, “Ms. Ye, I’m not too late, am I?”
“Just in time!” Ye Qingxian laughed.
She had thought a lot at this moment. She was wondering whether Jiang Ming as the Group Admin had the capability to locate the members of Supreme Pagoda and receive notification when the members were in danger? Or did he have other abilities? Either one showed that it was definitely sky-defying.
Yet, his willingness to take risk of exposing this information and coming over meant that he saw her as his friend. Ye Qingxian was very personable. She would just keep it in her heart when she thought she knew it.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian clasped his hands, “I got here after my transcendence. And I owe this place a lot. With this place facing its disaster, I can’t leave just like that. However, because of my limited ability, I beg for your help. I’ll count, count it as I owe you my life twice. Other than selling my life to you, I’ll not refuse to do whatever you requested.”
“You’re too polite, aren’t you?” Jiang Ming took a glance around and said casually, “It’s nothing much. As for you owing me your life, others may not know, but I know it clearly that you can leave at any time! Since I’m here, I’ll definitely help you to settle your troubles. After all, our friendship goes beyond borders!”
“Rout them out or kill them?” Jiang Ming laughed as he asked.
“Kill them!” Ye Qingxian answered without a single hint of hesitation nor hypocrisy.
They had witnessed lots of death, hence their morality had gone beyond good and bad. The only thing that affected their decision was merely their personal standpoint.
“Sure!” Jiang Ming replied.
With just a point, he casted out the Return of Infinite Law Finger, and killed another Golden Immortal.
“Who’re you?” Lan Qianfan was shocked. As soon as he forced Shi Lei from retreating, he looked at Jiang Ming with complete surprise. “You aren’t a member of the Stone Mansion but why do you come against our Misty Mansion? Sir, whatever the Stone Mansion can give you, I’ll give you 10 times more than that. I can even transfer to you my position as the Mansion Master.”
“Thank you!” Shi Lei clasped his hands. He was truly grateful.
Jiang Ming ignored him and walked towards Lan Qianfan instead. He felt a special aura and couldn’t help but ask with curiosity, “This is so strange that you have an imprint of the other expert in your body!”
“Imprint?” Lan Qianfan didn’t understand, “What do you mean?”
“You didn’t know that? This is interesting!” Jiang Ming laughed, “The aura of this imprint has the cultivation base of Taiyi Realm and you didn’t realize it at all. Ha, even if you are not dead today, you’ll be suffering tomorrow anyway.”
“The imprint of a Taiyi Immortal King? It’s him!” Lan Qianfan responded immediately and said, “Sir, I’m a friend of the Immortal King in the Heaven Court. He has long stepped into the later stage of the Taiyi Realm.”
“Are you sure both of you are friends?” Jiang Ming had a strange look.
Lan Qianfan had a hint of hatred.
Jiang Ming discovered something strange in his Status: For three years, his previous partner used to be raped by the Immortal King before him. Nobody knew about it and he could only bear it himself.
When he had a daughter, he wanted to give her to that Immortal King so that he could be promoted and at the same time, took his revenge.
His plot was heartless, malevolence and insidious.
Jiang Ming suddenly lifted his head and saw a human figure rushing over.
“He’s here!”
“Who?”
“The person who left an imprint on you. Another one is here too. They are both of the Taiyi Realm. They seem rather difficult to deal with.”
“He?” Lan Qianfan had a hint of a gloomy look.
In just a short while, the two figures had gotten closer.
One was wearing a golden robe and a crown on his head. His aura was magnificent, and was not concealed in slightest. His hands were behind his back, his chin raised, and his eyes were looking down on all things.
“Mansion Master Lan, how are you doing? I miss you so much!” He smiled.
“It’s an honor to meet you, my Lord Immortal King Gou!” Lan Qianfan clasped his hands as he bowed.
Shi Lei at the side also paid his respect.
“We’re close friends, how can you pay me such respect?” Immortal King Gou remained smiling. And he had no intention to go forward.
“It’s a courtesy to stay polite!” Lan Qianlan said. Then, he paid his respect to another eccentric young man, “It’s an honor to see you, Senior Bu Cheng!”
“Just address me as your brother. Don’t call me senior, it sounds too old!” Bu Cheng looked young but he had a head of shaggy and unkempt long hair. And he smelled alcohol too.
“Little brother Lan, you actually know Mr Gou! No wonder, no wonder!” Bu Cheng seemed to be rather surprised, “This time when I met him, we went on the road together and he has been boasting that your Mist Mansion has many beauties and he had enjoyed it a lot that time!”

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - It’s Amazing (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: It’s Amazing (Part 2)
Lan Qianfan was smiling but it was a forced smile.
“Oh, little brother Lan, why did I hear that you’ve been preparing a beauty for me? Did you come here to the Stone Mansion to snatch one just because you don’t have it in your mansion?” Bu Cheng sneered.
“Mansion Master Lan, you shouldn’t have done that!” Immortal King Gou pretended he was angry as he said, “We are old friends who used to enjoy the meal under the same roof together. Why didn’t you tell me when you have beauties?”
Jiang Ming was enjoying being an onlooker. He stopped attacking for the time being.
The two men were rascals. When the Immortal King Gou passed by the Misty Mansion, he received Lan Qianfan’s hospitality. Not only he did not appreciate, he raped Lan Qianfan’s partner.
While raping Lan Qianfan’s partner, he sealed him and put him beside the bed because he didn’t know that Lan Qianfan had some special ability which allowed him to sense what was happening.
After that, the Immortal King Gou merely told him the reason why he sealed him up was to test his ability. Hence, he was greatly disappointed.
The Immortal King Gou had stayed in the mansion for three years. Lan Qianfan was good at endurance but he almost went crazy because of that.
Not long after the birth of his so-called daughter, he had his partner die in an accident and then, he took care of his so-called daughter whole-heartedly.
This time the Immortal King Gou was bored and recalled his old lover. Hence, he was coming to meet her. On his way here, he learned about the death of his lover, and also about the daughter she left behind. Hence, he came over with the aim to rape her.
‘Lan Qianfan is not that heartless, after all!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but exclaim after he read the information on the Human Path Record. He thought things would turn out more interesting if he was heartless enough.
As for Bu Cheng, he was under the protection of a venerate. He not only had high social status, he was also strong. He traveled a lot and had many friends.
He heard a lot about the Immortal King Gou while drinking. Hence, he tagged along when he accidentally met him.
He was not interested in the resentment between them. But when he learned that the Immortal King was going to the Misty Mansion, he recalled the inside story and also what his men had told him about the intention of the Mansion Master to have his daughter with outstanding temperament to serve him by his side.
‘This guy is here to be an onlooker, and he’s a rascal too.’ Jiang Ming pondered, ‘He knew the grievance of Lan Qianfan yet he voiced out on purpose.’
“Immortal King Gou, Senior Bu!” Lan Qianfan remained expressionless as he clasped his hands, “That girl of mine, she almost died because she was framed by the young master of the Stone Mansion. That’s why I’m here to seek justice. However, I never expected that the casualties would be this high. I can’t afford to offend any of you but I’ve only got a daughter. Since the two of you are interested in my daughter, can I suggest that I give my daughter to the one who managed to destroy the entire Stone Mansion?”
“What a good suggestion. Competing to win is fair enough!” Bu Cheng took the lead to accept the suggestion with a smile. He was carefully observing Lan Qianfan and found something interesting.
“Destroy the Stone Mansion?” Immortal King Gou frowned. “The entire territory of the mansion? It’s possible to cover it but…”
He turned to Bu Cheng, “If you were to do it, you’ll break the rules of heaven!”
“Mr Gou, just do it if you want to. I’ll do it if you can’t. By that time, I’ll show off by saying, ‘Haha, look at this girl. She’s so curvy, temperamental and beautiful. I snatched her from Mr Gou.’ Once I tell others, they’ll definitely think highly of me because I defeated you!” Bu Cheng snickered.
“You’re forcing me to attack, aren’t you?” Immortal King Gou snoted, “Well, I shall do it. After all, I can’t let others know that I’m the loser, can I?”
Bu Cheng shrugged, but he had been focusing on Lan Qianfan. He discovered he had a hint of struggle which eventually turned cold. Then, he lowered his head, remained unmoved and quiet.
The Immortal King Gou turned to Shi Lei. He flicked his sleeves behind and his eyes revealed his domineering character as he snorted, “Shi Lei, you are the Mansion Master but because you allow your son to commit a crime, you are a heinous person, and shall receive death penalty. However, because I’m always kind and I can’t bear it when your sin implicates everyone in your mansion, I’ll give you a chance of redemption. Take your son and your subordinates together, and kill yourself!”
He thought the young master was the son of Shi Lei.
As soon as he finished his words, his imposing aura had enveloped the entire Stone Mansion.
As the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm expert, he had the strength to despise Shi Lei. He wouldn’t care about him either.
“Immortal King Gou, My Stone Mansion belongs to the Heaven Court. Are you sure that you wanted to destroy my Stone Mansion without knowing the entire story?”
Shi Lei was enjoying himself while listening to the story but he was stunned when the Immortal King had shifted his focus on him.
‘F*ck. You wanted to destroy my Stone Mansion just for a woman? You two are the Taiyi Golden Immortal but how can you be so f*cking shameless? Not only you two are going to compete openly, but you wanted to destroy a mansion just for the sake of a girl you have never seen? F*ck! Am I too naive or the world is too crazy?’ Shi Lei complained to himself.
“Your Stone Mansion is too heinous. Hence, I, as the Immortal King, have the authority to punish you!” Immortal King Gou snorted. As he lifted his hand, the dark clouds rolled over the sky, the thunder condensed, and the terrifying coercion had terrified Shi Lei and others.
It was an irresistible force.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - It’s Amazing (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: It’s Amazing (Part 3)
Only Ye Qingxian remained calm and collected.
Jiang Ming sneered, “Mr. Gou, do you know the real identity of Lan Qianfan’s daughter?”
“Kid, I can hear it, your ill intention. It’s indeed rare that you aren’t afraid of my confrontation.” The Immortal King Gou became even more serious as he was strengthening the aura he emitted.
“Her identity? What else does she have to hide? Did she acknowledge someone tip-top as her master?” He was no longer in a hurry to attack.
Shi Lei turned to look at Ye Qingxian, followed by Jiang Ming and sighed inexplicably. The only thing he could do was to let go.
Meanwhile, Lan Qianfan’s heart skipped a beat. He looked at Jiang Ming with his eyes revealing his confusion. He was undecided. He was anticipating but at the same time, didn’t want to.
It was only Bu Cheng who remained indifferent. He was just an onlooker.
“Have you not thought that her daughter is actually yours?” Jiang Ming said.
“How’s it possible? H-how can his daughter b-be…” The Immortal King Gou subconsciously denied but as he said, his voice became softer. Following that, he frowned, he had hints of anticipation and some apprehension simultaneously. He felt strange.
“I’ve been going around the world freely for hundreds of millions of years. When I began to feel lost, I started immersing myself in sex and have experienced all types of women. I think there are at least 30 million of them but none bear me a child! Hence, I’ve become kind of numb regarding this matter!”
“It’s indeed extraordinarily difficult for an immortal to have a child. I don’t have such a hope either. But now you say that she’s possibly mine, how can it be possible? After all, we only had sex for only three years!”
The voice of the Immortal King Gou became lower as he said.
“Enough!” Lan Qianfan could no longer hold back and roar.
His eyes had turned red. He could endure it when nobody talked about it. Even though he had to stare at them for three years, he still managed to endure it because no one else knew about that.
Now that it had been made clear, he f*ckingly didn’t want to hold back any longer.
“Lan Qianfan, is she truly my daughter?” Immortal King Gou couldn’t hold himself back and asked unabashedly, “You seem to have known it long ago?”
He had a hint of unnatural feeling which quickly disappeared.
“Yes, I knew it that year. You son of the bitch. You shake the sheets on my bed for three years, f*ck you!” Lan Qianfan had totally let go of himself, directly reprimanding the Immortal King Gou.
“Haha, Mr Gou, you’re a fucking playboy!” Bu Cheng couldn’t help but guffawed while giving him a thumbs up, “You’re fantastic indeed, I give in!”
Shi Lei tittered because he felt rather embarrassed. He looked at Lan Qianfan with pity. He thought if he were Lan Qianfan, he wouldn’t be able to endure watching his partner having sex with another guy.
Ye Qingxian had a strange feeling and she became more curious about Jiang Ming, wondering how he learned about it.
Immortal King Gou was embarrassed. He got serious and was filled with murderous intent as he said, “Lan Qianfan, do remember your position!”
“F*ck you!” Lan Qianfan’s eyes were burning with flames, “I’ve got another question that I want to ask you. Why did you leave an imprint on me?”
“I wanted to look for a chance to kill you!” Immortal King Gou told the truth. After all, there were too many scandals about him already.
“But I’ve forgotten. Fortunately, I’ve forgotten. Otherwise…” The Immortal King Gou said to Lan Qianfan friendly, “Oh Mr Lan, is she really my daughter? Don’t worry, I won’t kill you. You have, after all, raised my child for so long!”
Lan Qianfan shook with fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - Let’s Put an End to Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Let’s Put an End to Life
Lan Qianfan had almost gone insane. He wanted to go crazy because he could sense clearly that millions of eyes were on him. They were filled with disposal, sneer, gloat, etc.
Even Jiang Ming rather sympathized with him. He felt Lan Qianfan was quite miserable and he even felt sorry for him.
“Lan, tell me, is she my daughter?” Immortal King Gou asked again with hints of annoyance, “Even if you don’t tell, I’ll learn about it soon.”
“I-I-I…” Lan Qianfan stammered. However, each time he opened his mouth to speak, he was filled with burning flames of extreme anger.
He had been marinating in resentment as he vividly recalled those three years. At that time, while he was sealed, he was placed standing facing the bed. Quietly he stood, as though he was a drawing. Quietly he had to watch all those positions on his bed that made him mad.
Flame of anger licked through him. But because he was not supposed to know as he was sealed, he pretended he didn’t know. He smoldered with resentment and endured the unbearable weight that a man couldn’t.
If the others had not known, if it had not been revealed in the public, he might still be enduring it alone while looking for ways to take his revenge. Even though he was burned in anger, he hadn’t found the most malicious way to take his revenge.
But now Lan Qianfan felt somber. He realized that he was wrong, way too wrong. He thought, ‘My reputation, my honor, my dignity as a man, and my bottom line have been completely trampled in the stinking mud ditch and the abyss. What’s the point of being alive? I’m purely a joke. This son of the bitch, actually wanted to kill me after he had his fun? And I survived just because he had forgotten? My god, why are you doing this to me? In this case…’
Sadness had turned into a melancholy river, but it could not carry his sadness.
Lan Qianfan laughed madly and snickered, “Since you wanted to know, I’ll tell you. Yes, she’s your daughter.”
“She’s truly my daughter? I’ve an offspring now?” The Immortal King Gou couldn’t help but was ecstatic.
“Yes, she is!” Lan Qianfan smiled coldly, “But did you know that not long ago, in the mansion of this city, she was raped just like how you raped her mother that year. Haha, mother fucker, are you happy? You daughter was fucked. Haha, are you happy? Are you surprised?” He laughed out loud like a psycho and with hints of smugness.
“Damn, why didn’t you protect her!” The Immortal King Gou was enraged. He threw Lan Qianfan out with a slap that resulted in his splash of blood colored the sky.
“Hehe!” Lan Qianfan returned and stared at Immortal King Gou. Meanwhile, he wiped away the blood stain at the corner of his mouth, and expressed a cruel smile, “I’ve been taking good care of her all these years. I even thought of giving her to you but I eventually changed my mind. I plan to send her to Bu Cheng so that the two of you would fight against each other.”
A dark expression etched on Bu Cheng’s face.
“Damn you!” Immortal King Gou got even more furious. Rage overtook him as he lifted up his hand to condense millions of thunders to kill Lan Qianfan.
However, Lan Qianfan was not afraid. Instead, he snickered, “She’ll die if you kill me. Because I’ve planted a curse in her. You may try if you don’t believe it.”
Immortal King Gou felt he was about to go nuts. He thought, ‘F*ck. I’m here just for fun, just to experience the excitement again. But my old lover has died. I thought the seal was a perfect plan but it turned out that he could sense clearly what was happening. Does it mean that he’s watched the show for three whole years? Anyway, I don’t care. F*ck. I’ve got an offspring, a-and…’
The Immortal King Gou shuddered at the thought of the karma. His face turned gloomy.
There were many people around, enjoying the extraordinary drama. Although many knew that this immortal city might be destroyed at the end of the show, they just couldn’t help it. The drama was, after all, too exhilarating.
At this moment, a stream of light came over and landed on a side. It was Lan Shuirou. She took a glance at Lan Qianfan and then the Immortal King Gou with affliction.
“Father, is what you’ve s-said the truth?” Her voice, which was originally melodious, was now hoarse.
Lan Qianfan opened his mouth, wanted to say something, but he eventually gave a wry smile and looked into the f*cking sky.
He couldn’t help it. But when he thought of having his so-called daughter returning to his sworn enemy and called him father while he had to die tragically, anger welled up in his chest.
“What is the point of being alive? It’s either I being teased or being killed by this mother fu*cker. And I’ve even offended Bu Cheng, another Immortal King. Alas, I’ve come to a dead end!”
“Since I’ve to die, let’s die together!”
He had utterly lost his mind.
“F*ck, f*ck you all!”
Lan Qianfan directly self-destructed.
At that moment, the agitated Immortal King Gou was on his left while Lan Shuirou was on his right. Bu Cheng was holding his arms not far away while Shi Lei and the others too, were not far away.
Jiang Ming was standing afar. But at this moment, he was pulling Ye Qingxian to escape at high speed. He simultaneously evoked his Great Protection Technique to protect them in the middle.
It was quickly followed by a deafening blast. The God City shattered in an instant, killing an uncountable number of living things tragically.
The light burst into the sky, and the torrent raged.
In the distance away, Ye Qingxian was dumbfounded.
“I’m only a clone here!” Jiang Ming explained. The clone had not carried any treasures nor had time to transfer them over.
“Brother Jiang, I’ve been very grateful for your willingness to come over!” Ye Qingxian smiled wryly as she said, “This city can withstand the general attack of Golden Immortal but not self-destruction, particularly the self-destruction of Lan Qianfan. In the human world, the mortals suffered during the war, and in the immortal world, it is still the same. The strong are always strong, and the weak can only submit to fate.”
“In this world where power is the ruler, we can only improve our cultivation base continuously if we want to be the master of our life.” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
There were more than 10 million people in this God City. But more than 99 percent of them died tragically in just a second.
“F*ck, Lan Qianfan, you mother f*cker!” The roaring voice of Immortal King Gou rang out. With the appearance of immortal luminance, he was seen standing in mid-air miserably. His body had cracks as if he had almost burst into bloody mist.
In his embrace was a dull flag. It obviously was a protector.
“He’s indeed a mother f*cker!” Bu Cheng looked very miserable too. He was surrounded by sword qi, and it was obvious that he was injured.
As for Shi Lei and Lan Shuirou, they had gone, completely disappeared. Shi Lei was too near to the explosion point. Moreover, because he had yet to fully recover from the battle, it was impossible that he survived. Even those experts participated in the battle, almost all of them had died.
As a result of the battle, the Stone Mansion had vanished.
“I’ve just learned that I’ve got a daughter of my bloodline. She is my close relative and my hope, but she died in a blink of an eye. Lan Qianfan, I want you to die with a grievance. I want to slaughter all people related to you!” Immortal King Gou howled like a raging lonely wolf.
“My daughter is dead but why are you two still alive?” The Immortal King Gou saw Jiang Ming and Ye Qingxian as he shifted his focus from the torn city and the howling living things in the distance, and was enraged.
“Die!” He raised his hand and cast a lightning strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - The Laws Net, The Heaven Court’s Best God of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: The Laws Net, The Heaven Court’s Best God of War
In the old days Immortal King Gou aimed to sanctify Dao by breaking through to the Venerate Realm. However, because he was incapable of breaking through for a long time, he knew he had spent all his potential. Hence, he planned to do networking and to bring up his own offspring.
Unfortunately, it was extremely difficult for him as an immortal to produce an offspring. After years of trying, his efforts were in vain. Hence, he gradually let go of himself and became a playboy, who did both good and bad.
He had never expected that someone else’s partner would give birth to his offspring. But she died not long after he learned about it. He couldn’t even take revenge for her.
Such a tragedy had enraged him up to the point that he lost his mind. Hence, when he saw Jiang Ming and Ye Qingxian, he naturally wanted to vent his anger. And the best way of doing it was to attack them.
Jiang Ming dismissed the thunder merely with a lift of his hand. He ignored Immortal King Gou and looked at Ye Qingxian instead, “Shall I kill him?”
“Brother Jiang, just do it your way!”
“He’s the Immortal King of the Heaven Court. Once I killed him, we’d be in a position that goes against them.”
“So what if we’re!”
“Haha, alright!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh because such a response was an expected one from her.
“You two feeble people, how can you ever kill me?” The Immortal King had an angry guffaw, “I’ll show you today the power of an Immortal King of the Heaven Court!”
“Laws Net, appear!” With his Primal Spirit, he communicated with the unseenable power. The void trembled, illusionary and blurry lines that traverse the universe appeared out of thin air.
Upon the appearance of these lines, Jiang Ming felt vividly the imprisonment of his body. It was as though he had taken into a certain domain to face the extremely terrifying power.
Therefore, he raised his head and evoked the Dharma Eyes. He discovered that these lines traverse heaven, earth, sun, moon, longitude and latitude. It was omnipresent and all-inclusive. It had included all living things, and non-living things into it.
“It literally shows the vast Laws Net would keep everyone from escaping.” With two hands behind his back, the Immortal King Gou’s figure had become magnificent. He was like the god of immortals and the saint of gods.
“Under the Laws Net, you’ll have to kneel down regardless of who you are!” As he said, he grieved, “Unfortunately, I was too slow to respond. Otherwise, h-how would my daughter be killed by that f*cking Lan Qianfan. I hate, I hate him so much. Hence, all of you have to die!”
“Am I included as well?” Bu Cheng said gloomily. Above his head were sword qi circling, which shielded him from part of the lines.
Immortal King Gou snorted.
Bu Cheng chuckled, “The Laws Net is capable of shrouding all parts of the universe. Whoever belongs to the Heaven Court can evoke the power of the Laws Net to suppress the opponents and strengthen himself. With your position as an Immortal King, you’ll be able to suppress 10 percent of your opponent of equal level and strengthen yourself by 10 percent. This will create a great gap of power in between you and your opponent.”
“Bu Cheng!” The Immortal King Gou roared.
“Hey, this is not an open secret. Why can I talk about it? Mr Gou, don’t you mind that!” Bu Cheng smiled. Then, he smiled at Jiang Ming before he retreated afar.
‘Laws Net which can suppress and strengthen?’ Jiang Ming frowned to himself, ‘This great chiliocosm is indeed different. No, it’s the Heaven Court that is stronger and more terrific.’
Nevertheless, he didn’t really care much provided the Saint was not around.
Moreover, based on the memory he acquired, the presence of Saint here had become a legend. Even the Immortal King Gou didn’t know if Saint was still available in this world.
Suppressing the various thoughts that run through his mind, Jiang Ming continued analyzing this so-called Laws Net.
Even though this was merely a clone of Jiang Ming, it was capable of evoking Dharma Eyes to observe its nature. This Laws Net was made up of layers. The Immortal King Gou was capable of utilizing only one of them. Perhaps it was his authority. When he slightly checked onto the inner part of Laws Net, he was surprised.
“Under the Laws Net, how dare you ignore me! Kid, you’re so good, really good!” The Immortal King Gou smiled coldly, “I shall first suppress you before I capture that girl. Then, I’ll treat you like I did to Lan Qianfan. I’ll make you see, see…”
“Die!” Jiang Ming frowned and lifted his finger to cast the Return of Infinite Law Finger. The power which was capable of containing all laws and condensed them into a sharp ray which penetrated through the void, tore the Laws Net and killed the Immortal King Gou who was trying to evoke his defensive treasure.
“You could have survived, but why did you provoke me?” Jiang Ming shook his head and sighed helplessly as he saw the disappearance of those lines.
But Cheng, who was in the distance, was shocked. He forced a smile as he said, “Taoist, I’m sorry that you have caused trouble, a big one. Whoever wants to kill anyone from the Heaven Court shall cover up the heaven’s formation, avoid the heaven prophecy and temporarily shield the power of the Laws Net as some safety precautions. Now that you killed Mr Gou without any advanced preparation, the Heaven Court has learned about it and will send troops over soon. Taoist, I can’t afford to provoke the Heaven Court, so I’ll have to leave now. Bye!”
Following that, he left in a stream of light.
Jiang Ming was left speechless. He didn’t know of such a function of the Laws Net because it was not shown in the Status of the Immortal King Gou and Bu Cheng.
“It turns out that we’ve provoked the Heaven Court!” Ye Qingxian smiled, “Brother Jiang, if the Heaven Court was unwilling to give up, I shall set a small goal to overturn the Heaven Court.”
“Overturningthe Heaven Court is a mere small goal, you’re indeed Ms Ye!” Jiang Ming laughed, “Let’s see how the Heaven Court would react. If they insist on their way, let’s overturn heaven!”
“Sure!” Ye Qingxian nodded.
The two didn’t care if they had provoked the Heaven Court because they could escape into the Supreme Pagoda.
Ye Qingxian really didn’t care because of the points she had in hand. Moreover, why would she be afraid when Brother Jiang was around?
Ye Qingxian looked at the ruin at the bottom, and sighed. When she was about to do some cleanup, i.e. to bury or cremate, an unimaginable force was befalling from above heaven, shrouding the area in an instant.
Dense lines appeared again and condensed into a gate. From within the gate came out a handsome man. He was silver-armored, held a three-point double-edged knife and had a third eye growing on his forehead.
Jiang Ming was startled as he saw the man because he looked very familiar. He was wondering if he was the God Erlang and thought it would be interesting if he was.
Hence, he quickly called up the Human Path Record to check on him.
Name: Yin Zhan
Race: Half-God
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: Great Overarching Golden Immortal
Background: The best god of war of the Immortal Emperor from the Tianchang Great Chiliocosm’s Heaven Court.
Relationship: -72
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status: There was a Sacred Sect a long time ago. The sect only recruited the members of the Congenital Spirit Clan, or also known as the God Clan. They are born with knowledge, powerful special abilities, and they are inherently powerful.
: In the sect was a woman, born from the heart of congenital chalcedony. She was highly intelligent, and her cultivation speed was fast. Hence, she became popular among the other male gods.
: However, she omitted them.
: One day while she was out, she met a man of the human race. She was attracted by his spirited and romantic temperament, particularly his ability to poetise peerless poetry.
: She fell in love and gave birth to a son, called Yin Zhan.
: However, the Sacred Sect had a rule that prohibited all its disciples from copulating with other races because it was a humiliation and a tarnish to their Innate Sacred Bloodline.
: When the sect learned about it, they sent experts to kill her lover and son.
: The woman naturally wanted to protect them.
: While they were escaping and counter-acting, it was unfortunate that Yin Zhan’s parents were killed. Yin Zhan was, however, being secretly saved by the current emperor. His identity had been erased and was raised in secret to be utilized as a pawn in confronting the Sacred Sect in the future.
: Yin Zhan had a Half-God Body and an Innate Divine Eye due to the mutation. He was highly talented and under the Heavenly Emperor’s efforts, he achieved the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm in just three millions years. The news was sensational at that time.
: Then, he began fighting against unroyal subordinates with the identity as the god of war. In just a short while, he had become famous.
: His top three records were that he killed the later stage of Great Overarching while he was at his initial stage of Great Overarching, killed the perfect stage of Great Overarching while he was at his middle stage of Great Overarching, and resisted a Venerate while he was at his later stage of Great Overarching.
: Therefore, he became the best god of war of the Heaven Court and led the Royal Troop fighting against external warfare and suppressing the disobedience.
: The Immortal King Gou was his subordinate. Although he knew about his absurd act, he wouldn’t mind provided none of what he did was against heaven’s rules.
: When he was in seclusion to break through to the perfect stage of Great Overarching, he sensed the vibration of the Laws Net and discovered that Immortal King Gou had been killed. He was furious. Hence, he evoked the power of the Laws Net to come over so that he could punish the killer.
: Upon arrival, when he saw a man and a woman, he was confused. He was attracted to the woman’s unique temperament but he didn’t think she was a match to him because of her weak cultivation base, which was only at the Heavenly Immortal Realm. The man he couldn’t see through. Hence, he suspected that the man was the killer.
: He was dumbfounded by the ruin beneath him. Hence, he evoked the power of the Laws Net. ‘What the f*ck, what had this b*stard done, even I’ve the intention to kill him.
: ‘F*ck, even though Immortal King Gou had evoked the Laws Net, he was still being killed by the opponent with a finger. I wonder how strong he is?’
: ‘Anyway, it’s good that he’s strong. Haha. I’ve been worrying that I don’t have a match, hopefully I’ll be enjoying myself fighting against him.’
While Jiang Ming was reading information about Yin Zhan, he had his three-point double-edged knife pointed at Jiang Ming as he said, “You were the one who killed Immortal King Gou right? Since you’ve killed my Heaven Court’s minister, you’ll never escape Heaven Court’s judgment regardless of your reason. Come, let’s have a battle. You die if you lose, and I’ll give you a chance of survival if you win!”
“What an arrogant and overbearing god of war!” JIang Ming said gloomily.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - Turned My Back on All Beings, the Master of the Great Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Turned My Back on All Beings, the Master of the Great Dao
Yin Zhan was not only arrogant, he had a strong background too. He had the body of half human and half god, a mutated divine eye. He had lost his parents and had a terrific force of enemy but he had been taken as a disciple of the current Heavenly Emperor to be a god of war.
