The way he acted was neither righteous nor evil. He saw maintaining the heavenly rules as his responsibility but he would omit the others. For instance, he wouldn’t care how messed up his subordinates were.
Yin Zhan was combative. He was not vigilant over the death of Immortal King Gou but excited.
Through his Status, Jiang Ming was able to speculate that the Laws Net could provide detailed information about the past and that the Heavenly Emperor was not capable of suppressing all things. Yet it was strange that the Heavenly Emperor had the Laws Net.
Unfortunately, the information given was not comprehensive. There wasn’t any information about the Heavenly Emperor nor the Saint.
‘This guy really wanted to kill me!’ Jiang Ming knew that Yin Zhan would definitely kill him whenever possible because of the value of the Relationship, which was -72.
While he was still pondering, Yin Zhan had already made his move. He wielded the three-point double-edged knife to cut through Jiang Ming’s head. The knife held along with it the power as vast as the galaxy, unbearable by the void. This slash was peerless and overbearing, even Ye Qingxian was taken in.
“How dare you!” Jiang Ming said with killing intent.
He somewhat admired Yin Zhan, but now…hehe…He shall kill him!
As he moved, the aura of civilization surged out, and he was surrounded by fishermen, woodcutters, farmers, scholars, sun, moon and the stars. It was the peerless special ability known as the Holy Civilization Fist.
His fist forced the retreat of the three-point double-edged knife but he frowned.
‘I don’t think I can kill him!’
That was, after all, Jiang Ming’s clone. Without the support of his inner world and extremely strong physique, the clone was merely maneuvered by a wisp of soul manna. Therefore, each strike consumed a lot of his energy.
But Jiang Ming was not afraid.
Jiang Ming, who was on top of Chuyang Peak, frowned when he felt what was happening to his clone there.
‘It’s good that the time is akin to the time here. I’ve to go personally to confront the expert there. I myself need a battle for self-tempering and experience accumulation too!’
While Jiang Ming was contemplating, he cooked a meal. He had it alone but he received no rewards because it was the second meal of the day.
After he had a satisfied meal, with a thought, he traversed the great chiliocosm and chaos through the Human Path Record without restriction at all.
Jiang Ming was still surprised at the capability of this Record. He even felt that the system was the accessory of the Human Path Record.
He shook his head to stop his wild thoughts, checked himself to make sure he was well-prepared before he plunged himself into the Human Path Record.
Meanwhile, in the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm.
The clone was on par with Yin Zhan at the beginning but was getting weaker as time passed by. Not only Yin Zhan had discovered the abnormality of the clone, even Ye Qingxian was aware of it.
“A clone?” Ye Qingxian was bewildered at the capability of the clone.
When they were still in the mortal world, they were of similar strength at that time. But now his clone alone could fight against the best god of war of the Heaven Court?
‘It’s expected of Brother Jiang, the peerless genius that is hard to see in billions of worlds!’ Ye Qingxian exclaimed to herself.
Meanwhile, Yin Zhan stopped.
“You’re merely a clone!” When he was looking at the clone of Jiang Ming that was getting more transparent, he couldn’t help but gnash his teeth and his face turned gloomy, “You’re despising me, aren’t you?”
“Indeed I am!” The clone sneered, “How can I see highly of you when you can’t even defeat my clone in a short while?”
“You…” Yin Zhan was further enraged, “Do you think that I’ve done my best? I’m the best war god of the Heaven Court. I can utilize the power of rules far more than what the Immortal King Gou can. Once I evoke authority and manipulate the laws, I can kill you in an instant.”
“If my main body is here, I can kill you in an instant too!” The clone said.
Yin Zhan’s heart skipped a beat and his face turned even darker.
“Taoist!” The clone smiled, “We aren’t sworn enemies, why should we fight ourselves to death?”
Yin Zhan remained silent but he looked even more gloomy. He thought, ‘You killed my subordinate and now you’re telling me that we aren’t sworn enemies? What you did is a deadly sin.’
“Taoist!” The clone said, “I wonder whether this Heavenly Net of Laws was established by Saint Lord?”
“Didn’t you know that?” Yin Zhan frowned, “With your clone having such combat power, your main body must be at the Venerate Realm. As a venerate, even if you remain in seclusion, it’s impossible that you don’t know about the past history of the Heaven Court. Unless, are you from the Chaos?”
“Bravo! You got my identity right so quickly!” The clone exclaimed.
“This is impossible!” Yin Zhan self-denied, “The Chaos is so vast that you won’t know your direction and the time. Although it has endless encounters, it is terrifying too. According to the records, there used to have venerates traveling to the Chaos. There were three venerates who first explored the Chaos but only one returned. Later there were 12 venerates who joined hands in exploring the Chaos, but only four returned in the end. Since then, the Saint advised that it’s better for all experts below the Saint Realm not to go to the Chaos because of the high death rate. Your clone is very strong but your main body has yet to achieve the Saint Realm. So it’s impossible for you, as a non Saint expert, to traverse the Chaos from another world.”
“How did you know that there are other worlds?”
“This is such a simple question. Of course it’s because of the Saint Lord who testified to it!”
“He saw it and returned?”
“Aren’t you talking nonsense?”
“Taoist, do you know whether the Saint Lord exists today in this world?”
“You don’t even know about this?” Yin Zhan frowned, “Who are you actually? What’s your identity?”
“Well, since we’re talking about this, let me tell you the truth.” The clone said with vicissitudes, “I once turned my back on all beings, suppressed the unknown; I once attack the heaven, and cut off the will of heaven; I once incarnated into the immortal gate, and created thousands of worlds; I once held a Pangu Ax in my hands, and created the world and great fortunes; I have also fought the world alone, suppressed the Taoist ancestors of different races and so on. I have billions of incarnations. Wherever there are living beings, there are legends about my name.”
“Hiss!” Yin Zhan was annoyed, “Do you think that I’m a three-year-old kid? Tell me your name so that I can kill your main body and take it as a memory.” He was enraged. Obviously he thought Jiang Ming was teasing him.
The clone sighed as he pointed at him, “Look at yourself kid. Look at how immature you are without the steady temperament when the universe collapses and the heroism when the Heaven Court collapses. If this persisted, your achievement will be limited. Kid, meeting me is your encounter. Do kneel and kowtow, I’ll bless you with an encounter so that you can kill all congenital spirits.”
“You…” The first half further enraged Yin Zhan but the second half was like a bowl of cold water being poured onto him because it sent chills down his spine.
He was utterly shocked, “How did you know that?”
This was the memory he unlocked not long ago and confirmed only after he asked the Heavenly Emperor. The Heavenly Emperor also told him that they were the only two people in the universe who knew about his real identity.
Yet, this man before him revealed it. He wouldn’t believe that his master would tell him.
“I’ve told you earlier!” The clone’s face turned darker, “I’m the origin of the Chaos, the ultimate of the Great Dao, the ruler of Hongmeng, the infinite realms and all generations called me the Master of the Great Dao.”
“F*ck! I don’t care who you are, I want you dead!” Yin Zhan had lost his mind. He wanted to kill the clone first for teasing him, and interrogate for Jiang Ming’s real identity only after he got his main body. He felt if he was not venting his anger, he would be obsessed.
Hence, he wielded his three-point double-edged knife, slashing towards the clone.
Nevertheless, at this moment, Jiang Ming had arrived himself. The clone smiled and returned to the main body.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - Heavenly Southern Gate
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Heavenly Southern Gate
The clone was merely dragging time. If it was killed, Jiang Ming would lose part of his consciousness. Though it was minimal, it was painful.
Therefore, as soon as he arrived, Yin Zhan couldn’t help but launch his deadly attack.
Jiang Ming blocked the attack merely with his bare finger.
“Impossible!” Yin Zhan screamed in shock. With his ability, he naturally could see clearly that within Jiang Ming’s finger had no Dao vessel. Neither did Jiang Ming evoke any special ability or immortal origin. Hence, Jiang Ming blocked his attack merely with his bare finger.
“This three-point double-edged knife of mine is of the perfect Great Overarching Dao Vessel, a peerless offensive weapon. How can your physique block it without being injured?”
He had gone mad, wondering which level his physique was. He thought it was incredible and unbelievable.
Ye Qingxian, who saw it from a distance away, had a twitch on the corner of her mouth. ‘So this is the peerless genius of the infinite realms? He seems like a mere Golden Immortal expert, yet he could block off the attack of Yin Zhan with his bare finger. This is so unreal.’
“If I can’t block it, I’ll be sorry for my identity!” Jiang Ming laughed.
His physique was extremely strong. Else, how could he become the Group Admin? At his current level, he had to take it seriously if he was to confront a venerate. A Great Overarching Golden Immortal was a piece of cake to him. He was, after all, the Group Admin of the Supreme Chat Room, the strongest of all infinite realms.
“Kid, are you regretting now?” Jiang Ming said in a vissitude manner, “You were given a sly-defying encounter but you don’t believe in me. Instead, you wanted to kill me. Ha, now you’ve lost your encounter and made me detest you. So, tell me, what shall I do to you?”
“Although you are strong, you aren’t a Saint yet. How dare you call me kid when you are not a Saint?” Yin Zhan smirked and his killing intention soared.
“I’ve never been afraid of a strong opponent but a weak one!”
“Since you’re very strong, I’ll suppress you with my best!”
“Great Overarching Laws Net, befall!”
As Yin Zhan wielded his three-point double-edged knife, densed and intertwining lines appeared out of thin air. They filled the air, shrouding a vast area. It was as though the entire area was a chessboard.
In the instant these lines appeared, terrific power of suppression, imprisonment, weakening, etc appeared simultaneously. These powers instantly caused Ye Qingxian to tremble intensely. She wanted to evoke special abilities to defend herself but her efforts were in vain. Following that, she was stiffened.
She was suppressed almost in an instant.
“Under the Laws Net, I can easily suppress all existence below the Taiyi Realm!” Yin Zhan took a glance at Ye Qingxian and shifted his focus to Jiang Ming as he continued, “I can even weaken a Taiyi Golden Immortal’s power by half. In addition to my might, he won’t even have the courage to raise his head. As for a Great Overarching expert, I can even suppress his power by 10 percent and because of the increment in my personal power, do you think I can suppress you as well?”
“Indeed a powerful Laws Net. It shrouds heaven, and traverses the universe. It’s omnipresent and airtight. Beneath the Laws Net, all living beings are mere fishes. This is really suffocating!” Jiang Ming exclaimed, “The power of Heaven Court has indeed reached an unprecedented peak. But it’s not enough to deal with me.”
“Lier!” Yin Zhan snorted.
“Whether I’m a lier, you should have known a bit.” Jiang Ming chuckled. As he continued observing the Laws Net, he said, “This must be created by the Saint Lord. Otherwise, if it were created by the Heavenly Emperor, how can you not get your revenge?”
Then, with a wave, he protected Ye Qingxian with Great Body Protection Technique and at the same time, he transmitted his message to her, “Do prepare to get into the Supreme Pagoda at any time.”
Ye Qingxian heaved a sigh of relief and nodded her head. She had no idea what Jiang Ming was talking about. But she could guess that Jiang Ming had pointed out the unspeakable truth of Yin Zhan. She didn’t understand how Jiang Ming learned about it, hence she merely played her role as an onlooker.
“How did you know that?” Yin Zhan asked with a gloomy expression etched on his face. He had not expected others to learn about his greatest secret and he felt bad about it.
“Why don’t you tell me the origin of the Laws Net and I’ll tell you how I know about it?” Jiang Ming suggested.
He had discovered a few clues about the Laws Net. It seemed to have evolved from a formation, which had merged into the heaven’s rules. It was divided into layers such as the Heavenly Immortal Laws Net, True Immortal Laws Net, Great Overarching Laws Net, and so on.
Each layer was positioned deeper than another, and each layer was stronger than another. Each layer had the corresponding power of authority, and was able to evoke the power of the world.
‘What type of formation can be this strong?’ Jiang Ming felt that it was terrifying. He was assured that it was impossible for a non-Saint to establish such a Laws Net. In fact, it might not be possible for a Saint to do it too.
“Okay!” Yin Zhan was a decisive person. He quickly agreed, “I only know that the Laws Net was established by Saint Lord but I have no idea about its details!”
“That’s all?” Jiang Ming was speechless.
“Yes, that’s all!” Yin Zhan nodded his head in a serious manner, “It’s your turn!”
“I saw it in a book!” Jiang Ming replied.
“A book? Impossible!”
“Why is it impossible? Do you think I’d lie to a kid like you?”
“You…” Yin Zhan showed hatred. He naturally thought that Jiang Ming ridiculed him.
“In this case, die!” Yin Zhan had lost all his patience. He wielded his three-point double-edged knife which carried his boundless fury and cut through heaven along with the befalling power of Laws Net. This strike was akin to the attack of a venerate.
‘The power of the Laws Net is indeed unusual!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed again. Following that, he sent the three-point double-edged away with a punch and had his finger on his opponent’s forehead.
The punch was the Killer Civilization Punch Technique that evolved from the Holy Civilization Fist. Meanwhile, the finger was referring to the Soul-Destroying Finger, which was capable of destroying the opponent’s soul with just a finger.
The finger directly pierced through Yin Zhan’s forehead. Jiang Ming thought he would die instantly on the spot but a burst of golden luminance exploded out of his sea of consciousness, and evoked a more terrifying power of orders. Besides, the power of Demi-Sage surged out, and blocked off the power of Jiang Ming’s finger.
The Laws Net trembled, forming a black hole behind Yin Zhan that engulfed him.
Jiang Ming frowned, looking through the void with his Dharma Eyes. He saw a pair of indifferent, dignity, and overbearing eyes appearing at the opposite of the black hole.
“Heavenly Emperor!” Jiang Ming revealed the identity of the opponent. Immediately followed after was the disappearance of the black hole.
“Interesting!” Jiang Ming’s fighting spirit was lifted high. He could expect the Heavenly Emperor would send heavenly troops to besiege him in near future. In fact, he was assured of it.
After all, he had killed an Immortal King and almost killed the best god of war of the Heaven Court.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian walked over, “Shall we go there together?”
“You go first!” Jiang Ming laughed, “I want to stay back and see how it goes!”
“Are you preparing to?” Ye Qingxian was clever enough to have learned about Jiang Ming’s plan. She couldn’t help but smile wryly, “Do take it easy. It’d be troublesome if you provoke a Saint Lord!”
“No worries!”
“Provided you’re prepared. I’ll stay too. Although I can’t help anything, I can at least be a witness and a spectator!”
“Alright!”
The two chatted.
Ye Qingxian began to clean up the area. She sighed as she looked at the numerous broken limbs. She eventually gathered all of the corpses together and cremated them.
As for the great amount of items, she kept them because Jiang Ming was not interested in them.
…
In the main hall of the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm’s Heaven Court, Yin Zhan was seen falling on the floor. He staggered while trying to stabilize himself. Then he touched his forehead, where his third eye was located.
He felt fortunate that the eye was still around and his forehead was not pierced through. It was followed with a wry smile.
“Thank you master for saving my life!” Yin Zhan knelt down on one knee and said in a sonorous voice. He knew he would have died if it wasn’t because of his master.
“Retreat immediately or ask for help if you think you can’t make it. This is not something embarrassing!” The Heavenly Emperor was sitting on the highest place, looking majestic. “If you were to meet such an enemy again, you might call for the Heavenly Southern Gate directly. Now, activate the Heavenly Southern Gate, and besiege.”
…
Jiang Ming at the Stone Mansion, had already called up his Human Path Record.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - Tai Xuan, Saint Spirit, God Clan, Origin of the Laws Net (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Tai Xuan, Saint Spirit, God Clan, Origin of the Laws Net (Part 1)
Upon glancing through the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming’s eyebrows were tingling uncontrollably.
Name: Cang Xuan.
Race: Congenital Saint Spirit.
Gender: Male.
Cultivation: Demi-Sage
Background: Heavenly Emperor of the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm.
Relationship: -33.
Talent: Demi-Sage
Status
: At the beginning of the ancient times, when heaven and the earth were first beginning its cycle, a stone imbued in chaotic energy fell from the sky. Taking the opportunity to absorb the energy from the evolution of heaven and earth, it merged with the clear air of the sky, tainted the Xuanhuang Origin Essence, and finally emerged itself.
: He took Cang as his surname to depict his origin and Xuan as his last name to determine his goal of pursuing the Mystical Dao.
: In the ancient times, where all spirits were initially born, there was no order to the world. The world was filled with countless murders and the world was in chaos. Cang Xuan built the Mystical Palace, sheltered the people around the place and made a name for himself.
: As his influence was getting greater and greater, he somewhat realized the will of heaven: When he unifies the universe, he will be able to sanctify the way of the great eternal Dao and enter the Saint Realm.
: Being excited with the fact, he began taking radical actions in managing his influence and competing to dominate the world.
: Because of his overbearing behavior, he was targeted by many, and as a result, his force was besieged and suppressed. He ended up with injuries and managed to escape.
: Although there was no decisive result from their fight over world dominance, there were a few peerless individuals who managed to embark on another path down the road of cultivation, and those of the Saint Realm were born one after another.
: Upon Cang Xuan’s full recovery from the injuries, all the positions for Saint were already full.
: Cang Xuan screamed in grief and indignation, yet what else could he do?
: Among the seven Saints, some were enjoying the peace it brought, some were in pursuit of a higher realm, while some established sects of their own. Unknowingly, the seven of them had divided the world into pieces, treating the universe as the chessboard and using the living beings on it as the chess pieces, to play a game.
: Years after years had gone by, yet Cang Xuan’s cultivation base remained stagnant. Though he was at the pinnacle of the Quasi-Sage Realm, he was unable to enter the Demi-Sage Realm. Because of the seven Saints, he could only hide in a corner and watch as the world changes.
: He even went into the Chaos in search of great opportunities. However, it was too dangerous in the Chaos. He managed to return from the brink of death but was injured. It took him another hundreds of millions of years to recover.
: On one day, the sky suddenly trembled while the sun and moon did not shine that day. The fetal membrane of the world was torn apart, and 49 Chaos Beasts forcefully descended from the outside. Each of them had the terrifying strength of a late Quasi-Sage and even possessed the innate special ability of devouring all living beings. Their physiques were also extremely powerful.
: Upon their descent, they proceeded to devour the starry sky and destroy all living beings.
: What was shocking was that every one of these beasts could fend themselves a little from the Saint Lord. Moreover, these beasts weren’t even from the same place. Whenever these beasts were about to be killed or suppressed, they would self-destruct.
: That day, the sky turned pale as the heaven collapsed along with the destruction of the starry sky: Who knows how many living beings were killed? Even the heirs of the Saint suffered heavy casualties.
: After finally taking down every one of them with great effort, there came four Saint Lords from the outside worlds, who launched their attack forcefully.
: He saw with his own eyes how extremely powerful the four Saint Lords were. There were even two Saint Lords that were blown up even while they were still in their own world. Fortunately, their primal spirit remained immortal in this world. Hence they could be reincarnated after a period of time.
: Seeing that their defeat was inevitable and that they would all be killed. If it was to happen, the Saint Lords would need ample time to recover, and the whole world might fall completely.
: Several Saint Lords chose to self-destruct, directly dragging the other two opposing Saint Lords to their deaths, leaving the other two severely injured as they fled the scene.
: At the end of the battle, only one Saint Lord survived.
: At that time, the bloody rain didn’t fall from the sky, nor was there the wailing of the ghosts or gods. Because the entire Tiancang Great Chiliocosm was crippled, and almost all living beings were wiped out.
: Even Cang Xuan was at the brink of his death.
: The only surviving Saint Lord evoked a mystical technique to repair the world while the remaining six Saint Lords were reborned in the origin of the world.
: Due to the fact that the world was seriously damaged from the invasion, the recovery of Saint Lords was relatively slow. Even so, they managed to gradually return to their positions within 100 million years. Heaven and the earth had almost recovered and the living beings of the world had become extremely prosperous and abundant.
: At that time, there were only the incomparably vast Heavenly Realm, the vast starry sky, and innumerable mortal planar worlds.
: Cang Xuan had already recovered. He managed to grab the opportunity to comprehend the changes of Dao fluctuation during the origin’s recovery period and leapt into the Demi-Sage Realm.
: One day, the seven Saints Lords suddenly requested a meeting and those who attended were all peerless experts above the Quasi-Sage Realm.
: At that time, there were very few peerless Quasi-Sage experts. There were only 18 of them in total and basically all of them had experienced the cruelty of the war.
: The Saint Lords proposed to erase the traces of the previous war and no one rejected the proposal whatsoever.
: It was also said that because of the dangerous Chaos, and the potential that they might be invaded by foreign experts in the future, they were prepared to block off the portals, create a unified force to govern the universe and thus the Heaven Court was formed.
: To strengthen the combat power of this world and greatly increase the world’s self-defense, the seven Saint Lords worked together to deduce theLaws Net of Holy Dao and spread it to every corner of the universe.
: With the establishment of the Laws Net, even if the former four Saint Lords were to descend again, they would definitely be able to kill them.
: The ultimate secret of the Laws Net was only in the hands of the seven Saint Lords. In addition, the Heavenly Emperor held the greatest authority and could exert the combat power of a Saint Lord at his initial stage.
: Also for the sake of fairness, they allowed the Quasi-Sage experts themselves to select a Heavenly Emperor. Due to Cang Xuan’s ancient status, the extensive contacts that he had, his relatively modest personality and ample strength, the honor of becoming the Heavenly Emperor naturally fell on him.
: From then on, the Tian Cang Great Chilicosm entered the era of the Heaven Court.
: Cang Xuan was extremely conscientious and diligent. He was able to maintain the Heaven Court in good order. The living beings lived prosperously and the number of experts increased greatly.
: The seven Saint Lords were very satisfied with the result.
: After hundreds of millions of years had passed, the seven Saint Lords had no improvement in their cultivation base. Hence, they were prepared to enter the Chaos in search of the Sea of Chaos that they heard from the four Saint Lord invaders.
: Initially, they went into the Chaos in pairs and then returned after their exploration of the place.
: In the end, they finally found the Sea of Chaos.
: All of them decided to first return and had a discussion among themselves. From the discussion, they deemed that the Sea of Chaos was indeed a holy place for the Saint Lords to practice their cultivation and were ready to head on. However, the Tiancang Great Chilicosm was the foundation of their birth, their motherland and their homeland after all. As such, they planned to arrange one of the Saint Lords to stay and guard their great chiliocosm from unexpected events. At the same time, it was stipulated that the position would be replaced every billion years.

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - Tai Xuan, Saint Spirit, God Clan, Origin of the Laws Net (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Tai Xuan, Saint Spirit, God Clan, Origin of the Laws Net (Part 2)
: With the leaving of the six Saint Lords and only one stayed, Cang Xuan’s calm heart began to become restless.
: The positions for Saint? There should be a seat for myself.
: During the time when the only Saint Lord who stayed back, spent years in seclusion to focus on his comprehension of the heavenly Dao, Cang Xuan began to actively build up his own influence and secretly cut off the peerless factions who would not abide to his orders or had different intentions.
: Once the world is unified and that whatever he speaks of becomes the constitution of law itself, great luck would surely converge on him. Cang Xuan believed that he would be able to break the shackles of fate and take over the position as a Saint forcefully.
: However, there were three obstacles in total:
The first was the Tai Xuan Gate, which was the inheritance of the Tai Xuan Saint Lord. Although it belonged to the Heaven Court faction, it ignored Cang Xuan as the Heavenly Emperor;
The second was the Sacred Sect, or the Saint Spirit Palace. During the last invasion, the sect did not give in their all and retained quite a bit of their combat power. At that time, two Quasi-Sages from the sect survived. They later grew at a very fast pace. They seemed to be obeying the Heaven Court, but they were always treating major events with reconciliation.
: The third obstacle was the God Clan. They were the remnants of the ancient powerful races, collectively known as the God Clan. They were very faithful at the beginning but since the departure of the six Saint Lords and that six Quasi-Sages were born in the clan, they no longer paid attention to him, the Heavenly Emperor.
: Cang Xuan secretly monitored and observed while plotting at the same time.
: He discovered that the Tai Xuan Gate was gradually dominated by people from the human race. While the God Clan being an ancient race, they enjoyed consuming flesh and blood, especially the flesh and soul of human beings. Hence, he took this contradiction as a chance to promote the war between Tai Xuan Gate and the God Clan.
: After several battles, the two forces had become sworn enemies. Cang Xuan waited and observed the changes in between them while he plotted against the Sacred Sect.
: The members of this force were all congenital spirits, or were gods born naturally. They were all born with special abilities and were extremely proud of themselves, considering themselves to be of the noblest bloodline. Of course, the Saint Lords were an exception.
: There were even many newborn gods of nature that proclaimed that the bloodline of the Heavenly Emperor was not as noble as theirs.
......
: However, this force was extremely xenophobic, as they operated on their own. They did not have too powerful enemies. In addition to them being very powerful themselves, it was difficult to scheme against them.
: Finally, he found an opportunity.
: The Sacred Sect had a female Saint Spirit named Yu Xin. She was arrogant and sought to be the strongest of all. However, she also was curious about the outside world. When she went out for her practice, Cang Xuan had his wisp of consciousness reincarnated. With his authority as the Heavenly Emperor, he suppressed the karma effect, interfered with the heaven’s prophecy and gave his reincarnated body a clean background.
: His reincarnated body improved in cultivation at a very fast pace. He was also knowledgeable and was known as one of the rare geniuses in the local area. By ‘accident’, Yu Xin met him and they traveled together.
: Yu Xin fell in love with him. Soon, a child named Yin Zhan was born. Under the intentional arrangement of Cang Xuan, the Sacred Sect learned that Yu Xin fell in love with a man of the human race and gave birth to a son. All members of the Sacred Sect were furious and began their chase to kill the man.
: Cang Xuan’s reincarnated body intentionally led the Sacred Sect to the sects and main cities of the human race one after another. Due to the battles, many of the human race were either dead or wounded, and it also set ablaze the rage of the peerless experts from the human race, as they proceeded beheading many gods of nature.
: After all, the human race was the largest race in heaven and earth, and their potential was boundless. If the Sacred Sect provoked the human race were to be provoked, the sect would definitely be isolated.
: Their seeds of hatred were deeply planted.
: As the chaos was getting bigger and bigger, Cang Xuan knew that it was time to end all these. After he secretly allowed the child to escape by faking his death, both his reincarnated body and Yu Xin died in battle.
: As for Yin Zhan, Cang Xuan had a complicated feeling about him because he was his son after all. Hence, he secretly accepted him as a disciple and began to nurture him as best as he could.
: He was planning to use Yin Zhan as an excuse of righteousness to forcefully intervene with the Sacred Sect in the future. Also, by guiding the human race into the battle, it would not be difficult for him to subdue the Sacred Sect in the future.
: With the whole plan finalized, he would only have to let the world run its course, coupled with occasional intervention in secret. He was sure to be able to take down the three forces to unite the entire universe as one, and even to completely control the Saint Lords’ Laws Net.
: What if he were to suppress the Saint Lords with the Laws Net? He knew he must not have such a thought now! He had to cut it completely!
: He sat high above heaven, overlooking the civilization of the commoners.
: Many years passed, yet time remained boundless.
: He also continued his cultivation in hope of a miracle that will allow him to enter the Saint Lord Realm. Even if it didn’t work, he could also comprehend special abilities, deduce mysterious techniques and accumulate himself to an unprecedented level.
: On this day, when he felt the tremors from the Laws Net and discovered that it was Yin Zhan who made some movements, he hurriedly paid attention to the whole event. Although he had left life-saving means on Yin Zhan, he felt that it was better for him to pay attention in time for anything.
: He was extremely surprised upon seeing what had happened.
: Who is this person? He actually blocked the three-point double-edged knife with only one finger? Although that was only a Great Overarching vessel, its blade extremely sharp, yet this human actually blocked the attack? He might not be capable of blocking such an attack with his own physique without being injured. This human was no trivial matter.
: When did such a peerless existence appear in the Heavenly Realm?
: Did the Saint Lord nurture him in secret? Could he be an ancient being who has been reincarnated? Or maybe he came from the Chaos?
: His origin was unknown, but he was certain that this human was a variable to his plan.
: Just as he was about to intervene, he discovered that the human child had launched his attacks with the intention of killing Yin Zhan. He was furious and evoked the secret technique that he had left on Yin Zhan to protect him, and then teleported him back with the Laws Net.
: How dare you kill my son, my disciple, and destroy my plans! No matter who you are, there is only an ending for you!
: In today’s Heaven Court, there are five great emperors and 12 immortal venerates other than myself. These are all powers I can utilize other than the power of the Laws Net. Hence, if the Saint Lords were not intervening, who else could even compete with me?
: He activated the Heavenly Southern Gate and descended directly into the world. If this human child was wise enough to resign himself, it would be fine. Else, I’ll forcefully suppress him. At the same time, I can show off the Heaven Court’s power.
The information from the Human Path Record came to an abrupt end.
Jiang Ming however, was not at peace. As a whole, this world wasn’t special, yet the events that the world had experienced were extraordinary.
When the seven positions for Saint Lords were filled, there was the attack from the Chaos Beasts and also four incomparably powerful Saint Lords. It was obvious that those Chaos Beasts were controlled or driven by the four Saint Lords.
‘Doesn’t this mean that any Great Chiliocosm may be invaded by foreign peerless experts?’ Jiang Ming was shocked by such a revelation.
What if the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm was invaded before the appearance of the seven Saint Lords?
The answer was clear. It was complete annihilation!
‘Can those of the Saint Lord Realm invade any world at will? Can’t the great chiliocosm’s self-defensive measures stop them?’
Jiang Ming had no answers to these questions because he had not reached the corresponding height.Hence, he could only keep these thoughts in his heart and look for answers later on.
‘There are seven Saint Lords in the Honggu Heavenly Realm, the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm and even the legendary Primitive Chaotic World. Could it be that this is the limit of the great chiliocosm?’
Jiang Ming had such a thought. It might be a mere coincidence, or the truth. Who knew?
‘In the beginning, the seven Saint Lords started by treating the universe as their chessboard, and all living beings as chess pieces, while they played against each other. After experiencing a great disaster, they were united and unified into one. This led to the creation of the Laws Net, a terrifying formation.’ Jiang Ming lamented at what had transpired.
This was also corresponding to the saying united we stand.
Because of the Laws Net, all parts of the world had been made into a well-connected world. Although this worked well in the beginning, it would eventually lack a bit of vitality along with progressions because all beings would end up being suppressed by the Heaven Court.
‘Is the Saint Realm the limit within the world?’ Jiang Ming thought that it might be the reason that the six Saint Lords left.
Even though they discovered great opportunity in the Sea of Chaos, they still had to leave one Saint Lord to guard their world.
For this reason, he gave them a thumbs up. He agreed with their act of not forgetting their homeland no matter how high they soared.
‘This Heavenly Emperor Cang Xuan’s way of doing things was also very good. Almost comparable to Tai Yuan!’
He had begun competing for a chance to sanctify his way of Dao since ancient times, but was defeated. Nevertheless, he was not discouraged, but became dormant. He was even capable of standing up to defend his world from the invading foreign enemies.
After successfully winning the position as the Heavenly Emperor, he hid his wild ambitions from the seven Saint Lords. Instead, he worked diligently as ever, never complaining about anything, only to maintain the general order.
He did not lose his virtue indeed.
When the six Saint Lords left, it was only natural for him to think about sanctifying the way of Dao.
As for the suppression of Tai Xuan Gate, the Sacred Sect and the God Clan, whether it was for the purpose of trying to attain the way of Dao, it was still his duty as the Heavenly Emperor. Hence, he wasn’t wrong.
After all, they were too outrageous for not obeying the rules of the Heaven Court.
“It’s just that the methods he used to deal with the Sacred Sect are rather contemptible. Although that was his incarnation, Yu Xin was also still his wife, yet he watched her die.”
It was not supposed to be an act of a gentleman. But he was not wrong of him to do so, for he was not human after all.
“If this guy Yin Zhan knew of the real situation that he was in, would he go crazy?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help having such strange thoughts in his mind.
Right at this very moment, he raised his head and saw a golden gate materializing high in the sky not far away from him. In an instant, a supreme and majestic aura poured down from the gate as if it was the wrath of the gods themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - Verdant Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Verdant Emperor
The Heavenly Southern Gate was a Quasi-Sage Weapon. When it was integrated into the Laws Net, it could travel through space and descend to any places of the world.
In any occurrences of wars, the soldiers of the Heaven Court would be able to arrive at any time.
This was also one of the terrifying things about the Heaven Court.
Sometimes, even escaping was considered a blessing when you go against the Heaven Court.
“Ms Ye, you should leave first!” Jiang Ming looked at the golden Heavenly Southern Gate and telepathically muttered to Ye Qingxian.
“Alright!”
Ye Qingxian did not falter, nor did she hesitate. She secretly connected with the Supreme Order and with that her whole figure disappeared out of thin air, entering the Supreme Pagoda.
As long as she stayed there, she would be absolutely safe.
The Southern Heavenly Gate was a thousand miles high and a hundred miles wide. A large number of Heavenly soldiers and generals were pouring out from it. They stood atop the accumulated clouds, clad in golden helmets and golden armors, giving off an immeasurable majestic aura with imposing manners.
In the blink of an eye, one hundred thousand Heavenly soldiers and generals had formed a large array formation and integrated into the Laws Net.
The heavenly soldiers were cannon fodder to begin with.
However, Jiang Ming saw something different here: these Heavenly soldiers formed a great array formation, turning themselves into a medium, and could communicate with a very terrifying power.
Standing in the very center was an old man with white hair and silver beard, holding a whisk in his hand. A simple glance and you could tell that he was a real deal. There were four Great Overarching Golden Immortals standing to his left and right, an extremely luxurious front indeed.
......
“Fellow Taoist, how should I address you? From which immortal land do you originate from?” The old man shook his whisk and asked with a smile.
“Fellow Taoist, don’t you introduce yourself before asking others?” Jiang Ming stood up in the air, looked at the old man at the same level as him. He then sat back and a supreme chair naturally appeared under him, with three thousand divine beasts carved on it, gleaming with an immeasurable majestic aura.
“Don’t you ever know of me?” The old man was a little shocked but he believed that the young man in front of him was not from this realm. Otherwise, how could he not know the existence of the Emperor of the Heaven Court?
Moreover, this person in front of him was obviously from the human race.
All the peerless beings of the human race had already been recorded by the Heaven Court, and there was no record of such a person.
“I am the Verdant Emperor, one of the five emperors of the Heaven Court. My name is Dongfang Changqing. I assist the Heavenly Emperor with trivial matters.” The old man smiled and said, “Fellow Taoist, can you tell me your name and origin?”
“You should have guessed it!” Jiang Ming responded with a smile.
“I’m Jiang Ming of the human race, originating from the other realm!”
“I had a certain fate with someone of this world. However, that someone was almost being killed and I had no choice but make a move all in the name of saving this person!”
“By the way, I killed the Immortal King Gou who was under Yin Zhan’s command. After doing all the evil things he had done, in order to vent his anger, he even made a move on me. Such was the source of the grievances between us!”
“Fellow Taoist Changqing, as he wants to kill me for no reason, do you think I should fight back?”
Jiang Ming went straight to the point, pointed out the cause and effect of what had transpired, and threw the question over to the old man.
“I have already understood what happened. The way Immortal King Gou acted was not in accordance with the law.” Dongfang Changqing admitted without hesitation. “Of course, there are thousands of living beings, each of which is a separate individual, has independent character and different desires. This also creates the complexity of life. There are good and evil, and therefore there must be laws to keep them restrained. Otherwise, the world will fall into chaos. For any influence, whether it is a clan, a sect, or even the Heaven Court, there will inevitably be some scums. Such is inevitable. If they are found, they must be dealt with; if they are not found, they will continue to ruin their influence’s reputation.”
“Immortal King Gou is such an existence!”
“However, there are bound to be those that manage to escape the legal network but will eventually be punished. They are to be punished under the legal laws, instead of killing them off based on whether they are good and evil. If everyone does so, wouldn’t the world be in chaos? Wouldn’t the legal laws of the Heavens be useless?”
“If a person violates the rules, they should be dealt with based on the Heavenly Laws, rather than lynching.”
“Fellow Taoist Jiang, am I right?”
Dongfang Changqing analyzed the truth with great reasoning.
Jiang Ming was speechless.
Was what Dongfang Changqing said, something true? Of course.
Completely standing on the righteousness of reason, what he had spoken of were irrefutable.
The Heavenly Law was the rule, the legal law.
If this wasn’t the case, the world would definitely be chaotic.
Jiang Ming smiled, “Fellow Taoist Changqing, he attacked me with the intention of killing me, but I was so powerful that I ended up being the one that killed him. This should be considered self-defense if I may say so myself!”
Jiang Ming had checked the Human Path Records on this person. Dongfang Changqing was born of a congenital spirit. He had a strong foundation, coupled with great resources and adhered to the principles of the law.
He came here this time because he was on duty to guard the Southern Heavenly Gate.
Dongfang Changqing startled for a moment before he couldn’t help laughing and replied, “It counts! Of course, it counts!”
He wanted to talk about Yin Zhan, but when he thought about it, it was completely untenable in theory.
After all, it was Yin Zhan who made the first move.
“However...” Dongfang Changqing’s tone suddenly changed, “You’ve killed Immortal King Gou and almost killed our Heaven Court’s best god of war after all. It is impossible to justify this without some investigation. The outsiders don’t know the reason and the city below was also destroyed. This requires you to come forth to the Heaven Court to not only explain what happened but also confirm what has transpired. After doing so, we will be able to turn over this article. At that time, I’ll invite you to travel around the Heaven Court and the Heavenly Realm. I’ll also be inviting a few fellow Taoists to discuss and verify Daos together. Would that be alright?”
“I’ve always been a person who is open to persuasion, but not coercion. With you treating me with such courtesy, how can I not appreciate your goodwill?” Jiang Ming smiled, “Taoist Changqing, please lead the way!”
“You are really a straightforward person! Be my guest!” Dongfang Changqing couldn’t help but be overjoyed.
He initially thought that Jiang Ming would be difficult to deal with, but didn’t expect that he was so easy to talk to.
It’s just that he was able to pick up from the conversation that Jiang Ming had the confidence. He knew Jiang Ming meant that he was able to go with him to the Heaven Court, and would cooperate well only if the Heaven Court was reasonable. Else, they should be the one to watch out.
However, Dongfang Changqing was confused about his confidence in going to the Heaven Court. He didn’t know what gave Jiang Ming the confidence after seeing the Laws Net and being alone himself, but he didn’t think much about it.
Anyway, he thought It would be great if everyone could settle things peacefully. Besides, the other party was from the outer territory. and since he didn’t have many details on the person, how would he risk provoking him into anger and become enemies?
The two walked towards the Southern Heavenly Gate in parallel.
The rest of the Heavenly soldiers followed suit. Many of them had their faces flashed with anger. They thought it was ridiculous to treat Jiang Ming, who killed the Heaven Court’s Immortal King, with courtesy.
If Jiang Ming was released, the Heavenly Court would lose its majesty and the other officials might be disappointed.
As for being right or wrong? The Heaven Court was never wrong!
A strange smile flashed across Jiang Ming’s face. He presumed that this visit of his to the Heaven Court would not be a peaceful one. However, he didn’t care one single bit.
This was not his own world after all. It wouldn’t matter how much of a scene he might make. Even if the peerless Saint Lord was provoked in the end, it wouldn’t be a big deal as he could just leave just like that.
Jiang Ming thought it would be best if the Heaven Court would treat him with courtesy. If he was good, everyone would be good too. Otherwise, he would just turn the Heaven Court upside down.
As he stepped into the Southern Heavenly Realm, Jiang Ming felt the vibration of the spatial force. At the very next moment, he found himself appearing in an incomparably wide square.
Auspicious clouds fluttered above as the rainbows hung horizontally through the horizon. There were even echoes of immortal fluctuations that sublimated the soul. On both sides, there were many pillars with coiled dragons, gleaming with golden luminance and with immortal powers kept dormant.
The pavement that was under their feet was platinum jade, which was a rare treasure in heaven and earth. It automatically absorbed Dao fluctuation and condensed the essence of the immortal spirit. Only places like Heaven Court would be rich and powerful enough to use them to lay the ground.
Just simply chipping away one small piece of it would’ve made everyone in places like the Stone Mansion scrambling for it with great madness.
“We’re now at the reception area for immortals outside of the Heaven Palace. Right in front of us is the main hall of the Heaven Court, where the Heavenly Emperor handles government affairs. The other three directions lead to all parts of the Heaven Court.” Dongfang Changqing introduced as he noticed Jiang Ming was looking around the plac, “This is also the center of the Heaven Court, radiating into all directions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - Double Kill in the Heavenly Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Double Kill in the Heavenly Palace
Outside the Heavenly Palace were two rows of guards standing. They were armed with long spears while being shrouded in immortal luminance, radiating murderous aura.
There were four of them on each side, all of the Golden Immortal Realm. Their cultivation base was neither high nor low. An appropriate level to be a guard.
When they looked over at Jiang Ming, faint bursts of thunderous rage could be seen in their eyes as their killing intent rose.
Upon seeing such a scene, the Verdant Emperor frowned slightly.
After stepping foot past the palace gate, the extremely vast main hall was right inside.
Above their heads were the sprinkles of Xuanhuang’s aura. The atmosphere was filled with endless clouds with a dense Divine Aura.
Immortal officials could be seen on the left and right sides, where most of them were standing.
On the furthest end on both sides, there were a total of 24 esteemed seats. Currently, there were only two of the seats taken. Their figures remained blurry to the eyes, hence it was difficult to see their appearance. However, right above their heads, one could see the orders of the Dao being evoked, imbued with the supreme law and the power of divinity.Even a Great Overarching expert had to bow their heads in their presence.
Right at the center which was also the innermost part was an incomparably huge seat of honor.
It was 81 feet high, and sitting on it was a 108 feet tall giant. This person was the Heavenly Emperor.
The Heavenly Emperor was of the highest status, the greatest, the most holy, the most majestic, the most noble, the most dignified, representing the highest position and of the highest authority.
Below him were all Daoist bodies in human form.
This was the prestige of the Heavenly Emperor, with peerless dominance, so much so that no one would have a higher status than himself.
......
“Your Majesty!” Dongfang Changqing came over to the center, bowing his head slightly, “Fellow Taoist Jiang Ming has arrived as invited.”
The fact that he used the word ‘Invite’ was to show respect to Jiang Ming.
“Verdant Emperor, please take a seat!” The Heavenly Emperor nodded slightly. His voice echoed through the hall, imbued with supreme power.
Dongfang Changqing hesitated a little, and said to Jiang Ming, “Fellow Taoist, please be more patient!”
Jiang Ming merely smiled in response, declining to comment. He had already ‘seen through’ the Heavenly Emperor’s plan based on the Human Path Record.
Name: Cang Xuan.
Status:
: To think that this Jiang Ming was so courageous to come over. Even I myself admire his valiantness a little.
: Does he have great confidence in his own strength? Or is there some sort of peerless person backing him up, giving him the confidence that no one would dare to lay a finger on him?
: Even if he was nurtured by a Saint Lord himself, it is impossible for him to silently cultivate to such a height. It is certain that this Jiang Ming basically originates from the Chaos.
: Alas! The means to shuttle the Chaos! No matter how he did it, it is still worth exploring.
: Now that he’s here, this is just the right timing. I’ll use him to push forth with my plans.
: There are many immortal officials from the Tai Xuan Gate, Sacred Sect, and God Clan in the Heaven Court. Trying to use them to impede me? Hehe! No one knows that some of them have already submitted to me. I’ll let them come forward to persecute Jiang Ming. Let this ignorant peerless expert entangle himself with these three forces. I will sit back and watch them from afar, adjust my strategy according to the outcome to suppress all these three forces.
Jiang Ming secretly sighed.
This Heavenly Emperor was really an old cunning fox. Just as Jiang Ming arrived at the Heavenly Palace, the Heavenly Emperor had already hatched a plan.
‘Using me as the fuse?’ Jiang Ming smiled secretly to himself.
Dongfang Changqing was seated on the first seat on the left.
The Heavenly Emperor portrayed a smile on his face, as if to express his goodwill. However, before he could speak, a young man with a height of 30 feet and a face filled with blood-colored lines standing below took the lead, “His Majesty is the Heavenly Emperor, the most venerable, the most holy and the most noble. And you, a mere mortal, how dare you not even bow down in respect in the presence of His Majesty? You really are a shallow being, incapable of comprehending honors and humility.”
Jiang Ming merely took a glance at him.
He was a Great Overarching expert from the God Clan, named Hu Sanpao. He served as a general in the Heaven Court and acted as a guard in one of the places. In fact, he had been secretly made to submit to the Heavenly Emperor.
“Jiang Ming!” A slender young man dressed in white said indifferently, “To have killed our Heaven Court’s Immortal King and defeated the best god of war, you have committed treason against heaven. This is a heinous crime. Hence, he should be executed at theImmortal Guillotine, to have his body severed in pieces, his soul destroyed, so that he never will be reincarnated, so as to show the supremacy of our Heaven Court!”
Upon hearing his words, many Immortal officials were very well aware of what was happening.
Hu Sanpao originated from the God Clan. The person just now, Bai Liu, was from the Sacred Sect.
These two forces had nothing to do with each other, but they had a tacit agreement just now to make a move against Jiang Ming. Hence, it was obvious that they saw through the intention of the Heavenly Emperor to recruit this human. As such, they rushed to speak up first to cut off the possibility of him being recruited.
“Are the Sacred Sect and the God Clan really wanting to go against His Majesty?”
Many immortal officials had doubts in their hearts.
By publicly robbing His Majesty of his words, it was akin to refuting His Majesty’s in public. Although it was not a direct confrontation, it was already obvious enough.
Normally, such a thing wouldn’t have happened. After all, although the two forces had been growing bigger, there was still too much of a gap when they were compared to the Heaven Court.
Could it be that the two forces were joining hands to break away from the Heaven Court?
There were a lot of doubts lingering in the hall, yet no one understood what was going on in the end.
Jiang Ming’s face turned gloomy, “Is this the hospitality shown by the Heaven Court towards a guest? Before the owner even speaks, the dogs have started jumping out and barking wildly. Haha! This is really insightful.”
“How dare you!” Hu Sanpao yelled.
“Presumptuous!” Bai Liu was furious.
“To first kill our Heaven Court’s Immortal King, followed by desecrating our Heaven Court in the main hall. According to the laws of heaven, you are to be killed and your soul destroyed!” Hu Sanpao sneered again, “No matter what’s your identity or where you originated from, if you commit a capital crime, you will be executed. Tell me scumbag! Will you end your life yourself? Or do you go to the Immortal Guillotine for a walk?”
“What did you say?” Jiang Ming finally got angry.
Jiang Ming didn’t mind going along with them when they put up such an act but he was enraged when he was being insulted.
‘God damn it! Do you think I don’t have a temper? I’m done with the acts. I want to flip the tables over right now.’
“Hehe! A mere beast that is ignorant to the world...”
Before Hu Sanpao even finished speaking, Jiang Ming suddenly made a move.
Hu Sanpao’s pupils shrunk immediately. In an instant, a thought ran through his mind and the Laws Net appeared. It drew upon the supreme and mighty force to form 720 layers of defensive luminance in front of him.
“Getting aggressive in the Heavenly Palace? Insolence!” Hu Sanpao sneered, “Didn’t anyone tell you that the Laws Net in the Heavenly Palace is the strongest in the world and can double up our combat power?”
As soon as his words trailed, he saw a scene that terrified him. The 720 layers of defensive luminance were wiped out in the blink of an eye. A single finger also landed between his eyebrows.
Puff…
A soft sound could be heard before a hole was seen between his eyebrows. Hu Shanpao’ primal spirit was directly destroyed and his vitality was cut off in an instant.
A peerless Great Overarching expert was killed right in the Heavenly Palace.
The many Immortal officials were dumbfounded with a face filled with disbelief, followed by endless shock.
‘God damn it! How arrogant and fearless is this guy? Has he grown tired of living?’
There was a saying in the world that even a Saint Lord might be suppressed if he were to step foot into the Heavenly Palace.
“You said you wanted to destroy my very soul so that I can no longer be reincarnated? I shall fulfill you!” Jiang Ming looked over at Bai Liu and launched his attack yet again.
“Presumptuous!”
“How dare you!”
“Such arrogance!”
Loud shrieks from many of the Immortal officials reverberated in the palace. In an instant, endless thunder appeared out of thin air, as though it was a materialized representation of their boundless anger.
Even the Heavenly Emperor stood up with his face cold and pale. However, he did not make a move.
Dongfang Changqing also frowned and was extremely puzzled, ‘Could this person be a fool? There is also Hu Sanpao, who has always been a transparent person in the past. Why is he so abnormal today?’
He noticed something was amiss, but when Jiang Ming began killing in public, his heart was set ablaze with anger as well. After all, this was the Heaven Court. It was the most sacred place, the most disciplined place, and a place that should never ever be trampled over.
Unfortunately, Jiang Ming totally ignored it.
Although Bai Liu had already taken out his Dao weapon, evoked his peerless special abilities and even triggered the Laws Net, he was still being killed by Jiang Ming with just a punch.
All the immortal officials in the Heaven Court were enraged, but the strange thing was that none of them took action directly.
“Jiang Ming!” Dongfang Changqing finally couldn’t bear it anymore as he stood up and released an immeasurable divine might, “Why did you get physical?”
“That’s very simple! It’s to cooperate with the Heavenly Emperor himself!” Jiang Ming flicked his shirt and said with a big smile.
“To cooperate with Your Majesty?” Dongfang Changqing suddenly had a bad premonition.
The Heavenly Emperor put on a straight face. He was a little puzzled as well.
However, Jiang Ming continued, “As of today, the six Saint Lords have gone towards the Sea of Chaos to realize the realm above the Holy Dao, leaving only one Saint Lord to stand guard, yet he ignores the trivial matters of the world!”
“As an ancient existence, the Heavenly Emperor wanted to sanctify the way of Dao back then, not to mention now.” Jiang Ming spoke swiftly.
The Heavenly Emperor listened quietly.
“Do you still want me to continue?” Jiang Ming paused and looked at him.
“Alas! To sanctify the way of Dao! Who wouldn’t want to!” The Heavenly Emperor sighed emotionally, “Go ahead, I want to know whether you, a newcomer from the foreign realm, really understand the situation in our world?”
“Great tactic!” Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up, “Your words have planted the seeds of doubt in the hearts of everyone present. After all, I am but a foreigner. No matter what I say, it is not worth believing and that they would have to embrace what I say with a doubtful attitude.”
“Just go ahead! No matter what you say, you won’t be able to leave today!” The Heavenly Emperor sat down slowly, with grandeur, “I also want to know how much you know about our world!”
Although the rest of the immortal officials were very angry, because the Heavenly Emperor had spoken, they could only listen and showed curiosity at the same time.
“I’m guaranteed to satisfy you!” Jiang Ming smiled brightly.
He was sure that his next words would definitely make the Heavenly Emperor go crazy and satisfy his wish for a great battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - Intimidating the Immortals
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Intimidating the Immortals
‘If you don’t mess with me, I won’t mess with you. If you provoke me, then I will make heaven and earth despise you!’
“In the Great Chiliocosm, there is a limit to the number of Saint Lords. Once the number is filled, it will be almost impossible for others to try sanctifying the way of Dao. However, there is always a chance in the universe. Such a chance is to gain completely and utmost control of the universe that he is in. To be able to reach the point where your words represent the worlds of the Heavens, where your words reflect the law itself and to have total dominance over the world with it.” Jiang Ming paced in the hall, preaching as though no one else was around.
The immortals in the Heaven Court who were still angry and restless, when they heard him mention about the method of sanctifying the way of Dao, their eyes suddenly brightened, listening carefully and quietly.
Even Dongfang Changqing was not exempted from doing so. And the Heavenly Emperor pricked up his ears.
Alas, the way of sanctioning the Dao! This was the ultimate pursuit of a cultivator.
“As the Heavenly Emperor, you are already at the very limit under the Saint Realm and it is reasonable that you would want to sanctify the way of Dao. Cang Xuan, in the ancient times, before the Saint Lords appeared, you have also comprehended the secrets of heaven. You knew that by ruling all races and dominating the world, you would be able to sanctify the way of Dao. Am I right?” Jiang Ming looked at the Heavenly Emperor.
In the hall, breathings were left in stagnation.
To think that there was such a secret in the distant ancient times that by dominating the universe would lead to the sanctification of Dao, and the role of the Heaven Court in unifying heaven and earth, they had a somewhat strange feeling when they thought of the return of the seven Saint Lords.
“That’s correct!” Cang Xuan nodded, “I didn’t expect you to know of such a hidden secret.”
“What kind of secret is this? It’s just common sense. After knowing some of the details about you, plus the various past events, it’s not difficult to confirm about it through some deduction.” Jiang Ming said calmly.
Cang Xuan’s pupils shrank slightly.
‘Common sense? Not difficult to confirm about it? To hell with your common sense! To hell with it not being difficult to confirm about it! For matters of the ancient times which were especially related to the secrets of the past, only the seven Saints knew about it apart from him. Even if there were one or two other people who knew of such details, they would definitely not tell others. Such is a real secret. How did he know? Deduction? Went back to the past?’
Cang Xuan had become restless as he thought. The guy before him seemed to be of some background!
“He fought for the Saint Lord’s position back then, but unfortunately ended up with failure. Now that he’s sitting on the throne of the Heavenly Emperor, how would he not eye on the position?” Jiang Ming then continued, “When the seven Saint Lords were all present, the Heavenly Emperor knew that he was almost insignificant in their presence. However, six of them went on into the Chaos, leaving only one of the Saint Lords to stay guard. With this Saint Lord having retreated into seclusion to comprehend the way of Dao all year round, it gave him the opportunity.”
“When the opportunity comes, it is natural for him to start planning and put his plans to work!”
“However, there are three major obstacles that he had to face if he were to truly reach the point where the Heavenly Emperor’s decree is unimpeded, where his words would become the law and that he could give orders to all sentient beings in the world!”
“Number one, the Tai Xuan Gate. Because it is the inheritance of the Saint Lord, it has a special status. Hence, it has never paid much attention to the Emperor’s decree.”
“Number two, the Sacred Sect that is based on the gods of nature and innate Saint Spirits. They see themselves as noble in identity and bloodline, with higher status compared to others. After all, the seven Saint Lords are also strictly speaking, considered Saint Spirits as well. Naturally, they dislike the Heaven Court to loom above their heads and even oppose them very much. ”
“Number three would be the God Clan. This is a powerful race that has been inherited from ancient times. It has a peerless bloodline coupled with long-standing inheritance consisting of countless special abilities and secrets. They have many strong experts and that they were also self-contained, hence, they tend to be an independent force from the Heaven Court!”
“If the Heavenly Emperor wants to truly and completely take control of the universe, he would naturally want to eradicate or subjugate these three forces!”
“Aiming for the position as a Saint Lord, he had long put his plans into action!”
“An example would be Hu Sanpao. It might seem that he is a spy of the God Clan in the Heaven Court. But, he has in fact already been subdued by the Heavenly Emperor. And Bai Liu is the same too.”
“The two of them stood up just to find out about my background and at the same time, lead me towards conflicts against the God Clan and the Sacred Sect.”
“Am I right, Heavenly Emperor?”
Jiang Ming gave him a squinted smile.
Cang Xuan’s expression did not change the slightest and there was even a smile on the corner of his mouth. However, he was greatly shocked in his heart.
‘God damn it! Can this kid read my mind? How does he even know of my plans? There should be no one that knows of this except myself! Could it be that he really has a terrifying deduction ability? That’s not right. I’ve cut off the potential for prophecy and suppressed the karma effect with my status as the Heavenly Emperor. Even if the Saint Lord had deliberately deducted these, he wouldn’t have found out. Yet, how does he know all these? I must not admit to these! Never! Otherwise, the Sacred Sect and God Clan will know that I wanted to deal with them. They will definitely be united against me. Although I am not afraid, it will definitely be troublesome to deal with.’
As thoughts ran through Cang Xuan’s mind, he shook his head as though he looked rather helpless and said, “Fellow Taoist, you are after all, coming from the foreign realm and don’t know the details of the God Clan and the Sacred Sect. All their experts are tenacious, strong-willed, and adhere to their beliefs. I’m afraid that it’s difficult for even the Saint Lords to change them, let alone myself? This is an accepted fact!”
“Therefore, if you were to say something different, it would’ve been really easy for people to believe in you. But to say that I control them? Haha!”
“As for the position as a Saint Lord? I won’t deny that I hope to reach that point in life.”
“As for decrees being unimpeded, where words become the laws and the unification of all sentient beings? Isn’t that the present case of the Heaven Court? Whether it is Tai Xuan Gate, the Sacred Sect or the God Clan, they are all under the ruling of the Heaven Court already!”
“To sanctify the way of Dao by unifying the universe? It might have been possible a long time ago. But now, such a path is dead!”
“Alas, the Saint Dao can possibly be achieved only by comprehending the mind of heaven, and understanding the way of heaven, to break the world’s imprisonment and restrictions and cut off the self-shackles of karma. ”
“The Saint Dao that I am planning is to attribute great power of the heavens to myself so that the pinnacle of power can break the shackles, shatter the confinements and allow me to ascend to the position of Saint. This is the true path of Saint Dao. Sirs, although this path of the Saint Dao is only a general concept, such information cannot be spread out! ”
The Heavenly Emperor explained the whole thing in a very peaceful manner, but his tone became a little harsh when it came to that last sentence.
“We will remember His Majesty’s teachings!” The officials bowed and saluted in respect.
Although they were shocked by Jiang Ming’s remarks prior to this, the Heavenly Emperor’s explanation which included the natural characteristics of the God Clan and Sacred Sect had turned them away from Jiang Ming.
After all, they had trusted the Heavenly Emperor, their master, the ruler of the entire world for hundreds of millions of years.
Moreover, the critical point was that if Hu Sanpao had really submitted to Cang Xuan, why didn’t he rescue him?
Hu Sanpao was an officer of the Heaven Court after all! As a Great Overarching expert, he was much more valuable being alive than dead.
Of course, another reason was because of Jiang Ming’s identity that he might be coming from forreign region. That made him their foreign enemy, who couldn’t be trusted easily.
*Clap clap...*
Jiang Ming applauded as his face was filled with admiration, “I have met another Heavenly Emperor of a Great Chiliocosm. To be honest, his plan is far better than yours.”
“In order to become the true master of the universe! He took the initiative to let the Heaven Court collapse and fall by exposing the great array formation that could’ve trapped the Saint Lords! He even took the initiative to let all the major legions who were loyal to him to die! He himself was even killed!”
When he thought of Heavenly Emperor Tai Yuan, Jiang Ming really admired him.

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - Finally, The War Broke Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Finally, The War Broke Out
Everyone in the Heavenly Palace was silent. They had a shocked look on their faces.
To intimidate the Immortals with just a few words. Who could’ve done so?
Jiang Ming did it.
“That’s not right!” An immortal official frowned. “The Heavenly Emperor on your side let the Heaven Court fall in order to plot for the position as a Saint? Sacrificed those who were loyal to him? Even he himself was killed? If he has been killed, what more would his plans be? Isn’t this contradictory? ”
Everyone else looked at Jiang Ming, waiting for his answer. Even if it was merely a story, they thought it was very exciting to just listen to it.
“It’s not contradictory! This is because there are too many peerless forces over there and the experts are even more abundant!” Jiang Ming explained calmly, “In addition to his main body, the Heavenly Emperor has three avatars, and the one who died was just one of them. As for the fallen Heaven Court? It was merely to take the opportunity to wipe out all the spies of the other forces in the Heaven Court. As for his own royal followers? He has hid them earlier, awaiting for an opportunity to strike. ”
“He used his own death and the fall of the Heaven Court as a lure to pull all the forces into conflicts and only had to wait for his chance to emerge as the last one standing!”
“In comparison, aren’t your so-called plans too petty, Cang Xuan?”
Jiang Ming’s voice was sonorous, with hints of contempt.
His remarks were shocking.
“Something’s not right!” Dongfang Changqing shook his head immediately, “If you want to convince all the experts of the world about the death of one of the three avatars, the avatar itself must have the corresponding strength. If one avatar was already so powerful, what about when there’s three of them? What about that Heavenly Emperor’s main body? Equipped with various hidden strengths, plus an eruption of a formation array that could even trap a Saint Lord, what terrifying level of power would that be? Why would he even need to plan such plots to attain the position? He could’ve just forced his way through!”
All the other Immortals nodded in agreement.
‘Such a Heavenly Emperor was too terrifying. Even if he was to confront a Saint Lord, he might be capable of fighting against him. Why would he need such deliberate plans to win over the position? It would be ridiculous for that Heavenly Emperor to do so, unless he was insane.’
Even Cang Xuan thought so.
“Because there are at least hundreds of Venerates that are made known to the world!” Jiang Ming explained.
Upon hearing his remark, Dongfang Changqing was startled. Their great chiliocosm had probably as many Venerate as the world Jiang Ming was referring to. However, most of them were not in the Heaven Court, nor would they enemized Heaven Court.
What if hundreds of Venerates bore different intentions towards the Heaven Court? That would not be easy to deal with at all.
Right this very moment, a loud laughter could be heard echoing. A Great Overarching Golden Immortal came out of the crowd and made his way not far from Jiang Ming. After he greeted Cang Xuan with respect, he looked at Jiang Ming and snorted coldly, “Even if the situation you brought up exists, with the capability of the Heavenly Emperor to control over the general situation of the universe, it is completely possible that he utilize his power to overwhelm the people, divide and deal with the forces one by one. Why would the Heavenly Emperor plan to destroy the forces under His Majesty’s own control? After all, His Majesty would be all mighty. If such a Heavenly Emperor really exists, then he’s an idiot for sure.”
“However, I’m sure your remarks are fake! You are just trying to divert your heinous crime with such a shocking and mind blowing story!”
“You first killed the Immortal King Gou and almost killed the god of war Yin Zhan.”
“In the Heavenly Palace, you even lawlessly kill Hu Sanpao and Bai Liu. What arrogance and madness is this?”
“Jiang Ming, do you really think that with just a few words, you can negate your guilt? You’re just thinking too much!”
“We listened to all that you had to say just for mere entertainment.”
“You’re just a mortal who’s about to die! A lowly creature barking wildly like a dog! Ridiculous!”
“Your Majesty, please allow me to kill this person in order to justify the majesty of the Heaven Court!”
This person was careless and eloquent. Right after he finished speaking, he bowed down with respect to Cang Xuan.
Jiang Ming looked over and learned that he was called Shi Xiangtian. He got a hold of his Dao from a divine mountain and was a loyal subordinate of Cang Xuan. He naturally stood up when he saw His Majesty being humiliated.
The rest of the Immortal officials also condemned Jiang Ming one after another and more came forward wanting to put down Jiang Ming on the spot.
Cang Xuan said, “Jiang Ming, what you said is reasonable and well-founded, but it is too far from reality. If there is such a Heavenly Emperor in the world who cannot sanctify the way of Dao, this means that the path of the Saint will be a dead end for us. There is no need for you to argue any more. Killing the Immortal King and beheading the two Immortal Officials are heinous crimes and you should be punished with death penalty. Do you plead guilty? ”
In fact, Cang Xuan was very restless himself. He inexplicably believed that Jiang Ming’s remark was true.
To think that such a powerful Heavenly Emperor, who even damaged himself into the plot of achieving the Saint Realm, was simply incredible.
‘Alas, the road towards the Saint. Is it really that difficult? Fortunately, there are not that many forces on my side that I have to deal with. I’m very lucky. Very lucky indeed. However, why does this kid remain so calm? This is not normal! Anyway, to prevent having too many nightmares at night thinking about this kid, and to prevent him from exposing my other secrets, I’d better kill him first. But as the Heavenly Emperor, I need to remain calm and collected.’
“If you want to kill me, then I’ll kill you in return. Where is the guilt in that?” Jiang Ming continued with a smile. “Cang Xuan, I haven’t finished yet. Are you getting impatient already?”
“Fellow Taoist Jiang, please refrain from your lies. You’ve caused us to take you much lighter.” Dongfang Changqing said solemnly, “What is your intention?”
“I don’t have any intention!” Jiang Ming said, “It’s just simple. Because Cang Xuan wants to deal with me, I’m exposing his secrets. For example, the conflicts between Tai Xuan Gate and the God Clan was all because of his secret intervention. Tai Xuan Gate is dominated by the human race, and the God Clan likes to eat humans. As such, there’s the contradiction. ”
Cang Xuan’s brows suddenly twitched, as his heart skipped a beat.
‘How does he even know about this? God damn it! Why do I get the feeling that I’m stark naked in front of him? I can’t let him continue talking any longer. If this goes on, he might even spill out the number of the Immortal Kings’ wives that I had affair with! However, I’m the Heavenly Emperor! If I become impatient now and give out the order to kill him right now, wouldn’t it look like I’m actually admitting to it? Damn it! This is mind numbing! Why aren’t they taking any action but instead enjoy listening to the whole story? Damn it!’
Jiang Ming continued, “The Sacred Sect is relatively united, hence difficult to deal with. However, you still managed to find an opportunity. Upon discovering Yu Xin of the Sacred Sect journey around the world, you divided your soul into creating a reincarnation of yourself, got her to fall in love with you and gave birth to a son called Yin Zhan. After making him escape by faking his death, you secretly took in Yin Zhan as your disciple, so that you could intervene with the Sacred Sect in the future. It’s such a pity! For the sake of your scheme, you even led your wife to death! ”
“Tsk tsk...Such ruthlessness!”
“When the Sacred Sect was hunting down Yu Xin, you secretly led them into making enemies with the human race so that it’d be easier for you to deal with them in the future. After all, although the human race is relatively scattered, there are a lot of them in numbers and there are also many experts among them!”
“Cang Xuan, am I right?”
The moment when Jiang Ming finished his sentence, the Immortals in the hall were in an uproar.
The incident about Yu Xin back then had been widely spread. Although it had been a long time, the incident was still brought up from time to time as people lamented her tragic encounters.
If what Jiang Ming had said was the truth, then that would make Yin Zhan the son of the Heavenly Emperor.
This seemed to make quite some sense.
The origin of Yin Zhan was a mystery. He was very powerful from birth and his cultivation base improved quickly as well. He had always been placed in the Heaven Court’s departments that held great authority and he was especially favored by the Heavenly Emperor.
‘This may be true!’
Dongfang Changqing knew of more secrets than the rest. He knew how big of a trouble it was back then.
Even the human race dispatched several great monarchs to fight against the Sacred Sect, but the Heaven Court was merely observing the battle.
Furthermore, Yu Xin was just one person. With the Sacred Sect’s resources, they could’ve easily captured her. Yet, why was it that the trouble was made known throughout the world? The Sacred Sect ended up having their pride grazed and even formed a deadly feud with the human race.
He didn’t think much about it when it happened. Now when he started to think about it, perhaps it was indeed His Majesty who was the culprit behind the scene.
