‘If this matter is true, then the other things that fellow Taoist Jiang has said… Could they be…?’
Dongfang Changqing’s expression changed instantly.
“How dare you!” Shi Xiangtian was furious. “You brat! It seems that you know you are done for and so you are deliberately slandering His Majesty. With His Majesty’s nobility as the Heavenly Emperor, how could he have done such a filthy deed? In my opinion, you are not a foreigner at all, but a suicidal soldier secretly nurtured by some secluding forces. You’re just showing yourself now to break down the unity among us, to discredit His Majesty and to render the world in chaos! How malicious can your heart be! ”
“Your Majesty, I will kill him first and then plead guilty later!”
A divine ax appeared in Shi Xiangtian’s hand as he immediately slashed towards Jiang Ming.
“Your subordinate is requesting to engage in battle!”
“Your subordinate is requesting to engage in battle!”
...
In a blink of an eye, more than ten voices echoed throughout the palace as they charged forward along with Shi Xiangtian to attack Jiang Ming ruthlessly.
The Heavenly Emperor watched the whole exchange indifferently with immense killing intent already boiling in his heart.
‘This kid must die!’

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - A Realm Formation, Hit Through Heaven Court
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: A Realm Formation, Hit Through Heaven Court
He was in a hurry. He couldn’t hold back anymore.
If it wasn’t because of Cang Xuan’s insinuation, how would these immortal ministers dare to attack Jiang Ming directly in the Heavenly Palace? They definitely wouldn’t dare to do so.
Even Dongfang Changqing was aware of the incipient tendency, while the others were observing silently. They didn’t care whether Jian Ming was telling the truth, they were merely taking it as a story. Hence, they didn’t care about the plot of the Heavenly Emperor as well.
“Haha…” Jiang Ming suddenly guffawed with hints of sneer. As he moved, he evoked the long river of history and three clones of his appeared simultaneously. They cast three different special abilities at their surroundings, blocking off waves of attack one after another.
“Cang Xuan, you’re really in a hurry!” Jiang Ming said, “When you can’t wait to let them attack, it only proves that you’re feeling guilty. Sigh, frankly, you’re far worse than that Heavenly Emperor, whether your wisdom or your strength!”
“But I think I know what’s happening!”
“Since the leaving of those few Saint Lord in that world, the Heaven Court collapsed as a result of the collaboration among various forces. The new Heavenly Emperor won the position only after he overcame a series of dangerous obstacles with his endless plots, furtive means, artifice, and etc.”
“And you! You are the one who is selected by the Saint Lords to be their representative only after they have built the Laws Net! You had no difficulties in taking up the position at all. Correspondingly, your artifice is a lot weaker!”
“If you were to respond with a calm smile when I was revealing your secrets, people would believe that I’m a liar. But now you have made more people believe that I’m telling the truth instead.”
“You are not qualified to be a Heavenly Emperor indeed! Hence, you’ll be killed on another day even if I don’t show up today!”
“Oh yes! I finally understand the reason why those three forces have always been ignoring you! You’re really lousy! You are only relying on the Laws Net and taking the advantage of the power of the Saint Lord to be powerful!”
Every word Jiang Ming had said was forthright.
He no longer held back himself in revealing all the Heavenly Emperor’s secrets because the Heavenly Emperor had taken the initiative to become his adversary.
......
Nevertheless, the Heavenly Emperor smirked, “Regardless of how eloquent you have been expressing yourself, you can’t change the fact that you’ve been making up lies. I’m just disdaining you for what you’ve said. There are just too many loopholes.”
“I learned from the Laws Net that you’ve just descended to our world, not long before you killed the Immortal King Gou!”
“How may you learn about so many secrets when you have descended to our world not long ago? You may have learned about the seven Saint Lords and the Laws Net through the Primal Spirit of the Immortal King Gou. But you talked about me causing the great war between the Tai Xuan Gate and the God Clan? And you talked about me furtively subordinating Hu Sanpao, and dividing a wisp of my soul to seduce Yu Xin, giving birth to Yin Zhan?”
“Verdant Emperor, have you heard of all these?”
The Heavenly Emperor suddenly turned to Dongfang Changqing.
“No, Your Majesty. I have never heard of any of these!” Dongfang Changqing replied honestly.
“Look, how could you, a foreigner who has just descended to this world, learn all about these things when the Verdant Emperor didn’t even know? It might be possible that you deduced them. But if those things were real, I can completely suppress the karma and wipe out all traces with my personal means and the capability of the Laws Net. In that case, not to mention that you are not a Saint Lord, even if you were a foreign Saint Lord, it is impossible to detect them in a short time.” The voice of the Heavenly Emperor gradually became colder as he said, “Yet you know about them. Isn’t it ridiculous?”
He made a pause. His words convinced many Immortal Ministers, including Dongfang Changqing. They nodded their heads in agreement. They thought it was ridiculous for Jiang Ming, a newcomer, to know about the secrets that they didn’t even know.
“You humans have a saying that people always leave traces and no person is without a shadow!” The Heavenly Emperor rumbled, and his voice filled with might, reverberated in the Heavenly Palace. “With the presence of the Laws Net, all things can be traced. When did you come, and what have you done here, all have been recorded! You were supposed to have come here to protect a girl of your human race. Her name is Ye Qingxian, a genius of the Stone Mansion. She owes the Stone Mansion a big favor. Later when the Stone Mansion had a disaster, thousands of people had died, including Ye Qingxian’s close friends. You were capable of saving them but you didn’t do so. Hence, you aren’t here to help at all!”
“Ye Qingxian is very weak, too weak to have any relationship with a foreigner like you. The most reasonable explanation would be you suddenly descended to the world and controlled someone to take it as a starting point in intervening in our world!”
“You killed the Immortal King Gou, and defeated Yin Zhan so that you’ll be invited or taken into the Heaven Court! In this case, you’ll be able to give a speech of your opinion like you have just done!”
“As for your motive? It’s very easy to infer, isn’t it? You wanted to create chaos in our Tiancang Great Chiliocosm so that you all foreigners could invade right? Otherwise, how can you shuttle through the Chaos with your current cultivation base?”
“If you were not here to create chaos, why would you kill our Heaven Court’s Immortal King and the war of god? It’s obvious that killing them wouldn’t do you any good but only cause troubles after all!”
“If you were to reach here accidentally, you should have kept low-profile and acted only after you have learned about our world. You wouldn’t have deliberately acted in a conspicuous manner, dividing the Heaven Court!”
“Jiang Ming, you not only have looked down upon me and many other Immortal Ministers, you have highly overestimated yourself!”
The Heaven Emperor analyzed in a profound manner, and supported his own presumption with logical explanation. Hence, he managed to convince many.
“Nothing that you’ve said I’m able to refute!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile. He was indeed incapable of refuting because he couldn’t show any proof at all. He could not take out the Human Path Record. Even if he could, no one would believe either.
“Believe it or not, it doesn’t matter.” Jiang Ming stretched himself, and the imposing aura of his three clones was already at their strongest point. “The reason why I forcefully attack is to get a chance to temper myself!”
“C’mon, do you all want to attack me together or one after another? I think because we’re at your Heavenly Palace, where the Heaven Court of your Tiancang Great Chiliocosm is located, you all wouldn’t besiege me, would you? After all, I can’t escape at all! If you were to come forward one after another, and is capable of suppressing me to the point that I can’t do anything else, I’ll tell you all things about my world, the method I used to come here, the Sea of Chaos, and the few methods to sanctify your Dao!”
“What do you say?”
Jiang Ming said smilingly.
This was his main objective. If they were to attack him simultaneously, he was incapable of killing all before the Saint Lord revealed himself. By that time, he could only detonate Dao vessels other than escaping. In this case, he wouldn’t be able to temper himself.
“Interesting!” The Heavenly Emperor couldn’t help but smile. “I can’t figure out what you have been relying on to act arrogantly? We’re here in the Heavenly Palace. With the Laws Net’s imprisoning function and activation of the stigmata, you won’t be able to escape at all. Not even a Saint can!”
The Heavenly Emperor truly didn’t understand. He couldn’t see any fear in Jiang Ming expression but only the eagerness to try, and the rising fighting spirit.
In fact, he was not the only one who didn’t understand. The Verdant Emperor and the other Immortal Ministers too, didn’t understand.
However, those who were in the Heaven Court, were all powerful with authority. They were also arrogant. Hence, they couldn’t endure it when they were despised by Jiang Ming!
“Your Majesty, I’d like to request to fight with Jiang Ming!” Shi Xiangtian was the first one who came forward.
“Your request is granted!” The Heavenly Emperor said. Then, with a wave, the main hall suddenly expanded into a separated realm for the battle. It was separated by dense silk thread as a result of the Laws Net being materialized.
Meanwhile, all Immortal Ministers stayed within the silk threads, and watched by growing themselves to 1,000-feet high. Heavenly Emperor, on the other hand, had grown up to 10,000-feet high, overseeing the battle realm.
“Kid, you’re honored to have His Majesty to make you a battle realm! But at the same time, it’s such a pity that you’ve overestimated yourself. Your arrogance would lead you to endless regrets!” Shi Xiangtian smirked. He then threw out the divine ax in his hand as he yelled, “Splitting starry sky!”
At the same time, he evoked the maximum power of the Laws Net he could manage to. Because he knew he might not be a match for Jiang Ming, who had defeated Yin Zhan.
“He’s at the late stage of Great Overarching!” Jiang Ming saw through his cultivation base. He withdrew his special ability and lunged himself forward at the disappearance of his three clones. At the same time, as he threw a punch, he created a scroll of civilization, which hit on the divine ax, and the ax was thrown out at the impulse of force.
The evolution of civilization generated an endless power of morality, suppressing Shi Xiangtian.
“Die!” Jiang Ming threw another punch, which got through the Laws Net, into Shi Xiangtian’s chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - Domineering the World with a Great Polearm
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Domineering the World with a Great Polearm
The punch was incredibly strong. It was strong enough to strike down Shi Xiangtian. But it was at this moment that stronger layers of Laws Net appeared before him. The power of the punch was weakened through these layers, hence it failed to create any destructive impact against Shi Xiangtian.
“Cang Xuan, this isn’t interesting, is it?” Jiang Ming looked helplessly at the Heavenly Emperor, who was sitting at the highest place in the center, and said in an icy tone.
“You are the criminal here!” The Heavenly Emperor replied in an icier tone.
In addition to the attack that killed Hu Sanpao and Bai Liu, the punch earlier had shown him how terrific Jiang Ming was. However, he was also confused.
The Dao fluctuation Jiang Ming had emitted was obviously revealing his cultivation base at the Golden Immortal level. Hence, he couldn’t believe that a Golden Immortal could kill a Great Overarching expert because of the large gap in between each level. Moreover, logically it was impossible for a Golden Immortal to kill someone of a higher level unless he was at Great Overarching level. Because a Great Overarching expert had been considered to have transcended fate.
‘This guy is weird!’ As the Heavenly Emperor thought, he asked, “Do you still want to battle?”
“Of course!” Jiang Ming was not enraged but asked, “Are you going to keep stopping like this?”
“This is the Heaven Court!” The Heavenly Emperor emphasized. He would allow battling here in the Heaven Court but not killing.
“Really?” Jiang Ming sneered. “Heaven can preside over justice, punish evil and encourage good, and retribution is clear. Do be careful with too much accumulation of evil deeds, you might not endure the punishment later!”
“Nonsense!” A young expert who was at the entrance, reprimanded. He was armed with a golden helmet, golden armor and held a golden Great Polearm. He looked dignified and majestic.
It took him only two steps to get to the center of the hall. He paid his respect to the giant sized Heavenly Emperor, “Your Majesty, I am Jin Gang. I heard that a naive and arrogant man has come to the Heavenly Palace to challenge all Immortal Generals, and he has defeated Yin Zhan. Therefore, I’m here to suppress him, to show him our might. Hence, I’d like to request your permission.”
“Your request is granted!” The Heavenly Emperor granted permission.
“Thank you, Your Majesty!” Jin Gang bowed again before he turned to Jiang Ming and sneered. “I heard that you’re a foreigner. You first killed an Immortal King, defeated Yin Zhan, and then killed Hu Sanpao and Bai Liu directly in the Heavenly Palace. You are such a ruleless and arrogant man, hence, must be killed!”
......
“Jin Gang, who’s known as the second war of god! The best one is not my match, do you think you can?” Jiang Ming laughed.
“How did you know that?” Jin Gang frowned. But his imposing aura remained surging as he snorted, “I lost to him in that battle merely because I wasn’t focusing! C’mon, let me find out how strong you are!”
“Great Polearm Tyrant dominating the world!”
With a turn of his wrist, endless imposing rays surged out of the polearm, striking towards Jiang Ming. At the same time, he spat out a golden net, directed it to hover over Jiang Ming before it fell on him to entangle him.
The net wasn’t an ordinary fishnet. When it fell, it formed a suppressive force that also confined Jiang Ming’s surroundings. It was like a fishnet that prohibited fishes from breaking loose.
Besides, Jin Gang also called up the power of the Laws Net to form a terrific suppression.
It was the best strike he could do.
“This is slightly interesting!” Jiang Ming was excited. He shook, and endless frantic power surged from within his body, shattering the imprisonment of the Laws Net. He reached out with his left hand, and evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
The golden net suspended in the sky shook, and its luminance was scattered in an instant, causing Jin Gang to lose control over it. Jiang Ming took the opportunity to grab hold of it and put it into the Human Path Record.
Meanwhile, he clenched his right hand into fist, and punched onto the Great Polearm.
Boom…
In a sudden, the torrent produced by the clash, swept out to all directions. But it was weakened by layers of Laws Net one after another, until it became a gentle wind.
Jin Gang had to retreat. He was in disbelief as he said, “How’s it possible?”
Not only Jin Gang was in shock, other Immortal Ministers, Dongfang Changqing and even the Heavenly Emperor, were dumbfounded. They saw clearly how Jiang Ming suppressed and took over the golden net of Jin Gang with his special ability instead of an item. They were surprised particularly when they knew that the golden net was of the Great Overarching level, how terrific its power of imprisonment and its entanglement.
They were also bewildered at the last punch of Jiang Ming in countering the great polearm. There was only a white mark left on Jiang Ming’s hand. They wouldn’t believe it if they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes. After all, it was the attack that even Dongfang Changqing didn’t dare to counteract directly.
“It isn’t a big deal. Come again!” Jiang Ming roared and took the initiative to lung himself forward. He threw punches full of destructive power at Jin Gang. But the punches were surrounded by numerous drawings of civilization, within the holiness was filled with killing intention. It was the Killer Civilization Punch Technique.
“Here I come!” Jin Gang was in a state of frenzy. However, it was obvious that he no longer was that domineering, because of his fear.
As the great polearm turned, it was radiating an intimidating aura. At the same time, a clock appeared hovering above him, rang out on its own.
Dong! Dong! Dong!
The sound of the clock was oppressive because it directly hit one’s mind. As the vibration of the sound reverberated to all directions, it was weakened by layer after layer of Laws Net, without causing any impact to the onlookers.
Jiang Ming was not affected either. He had evoked the Nine Level Stellar Tower in his mind, which radiated yellowish luminance that protected his soul and mind.
It was a type of Spiritual Special Ability.
Even if he had no such a Spiritual Special Ability, he wouldn’t be affected too because of the protection from his inner world.
Jiang Ming crashed the wave of sound, scattered the power of Laws Net’s layers, and forcefully repulsed the great polearm. It even burst the two arms of Jin Gang, causing him to spurt blood.
He was in great shock.
“Die!” Jiang Ming didn’t stop there. He was filled with killing intention and he threw his invincible punches at Jin Gang.
It was at this time that a total of 49 layers of golden Laws Net appeared before Jin Gang, blocking off the attack.
“What a defense!” Jiang Ming shifted his attention to the Heavenly Emperor. “What an awesome Laws Net established by the seven Saint Lords. The Laws Net looks akin to array formation and special abilities. Cang Xuan, since you’re very skillful in utilizing the Laws Net, I’m afraid that your combat power is up to the level of a Saint Lord here in this main hall!”
“This is to deal with foreigners like you!” Cang Xuan said indifferently. “Do you want to continue the battle or admit defeat?”
Jiang Ming guffawed, “It seems like I have won two consecutive battles!”
“The fact that you weren’t able to break through the Laws Net just now, has destined your fate. Hence, what’s the point of us continuing?” Cang Xuan asked, “Are you sure you want to continue?”
“Your Majesty, let us do it!” Before Jiang Ming could answer, three experts in three different forms walked in from the entrance. Each and every one of them had an aura as deep as the abyss. Their aura was terrifyingly profound, far stronger than Jin Gang.
All three of them were Venerates from the God Clan.
As Jiang Ming saw them, he couldn’t help but laugh. He thought, ‘Here comes my opponents. I wonder if Cang Xuan would stop me from killing them?’

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 1)
Through the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming knew that these three were the venerates from the God Clan. They were Scorpion Thousand Miles, Bear Tyrant, and Mo Hei.
Their names were very personal.
Scorpion Thousand Miles was the Scorpion Monarch. He was in the initial stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm. He was strong with terrific innate talent, vicious, and arrogant.
Bear Tyrant was the Great Monarch of the Tyrannical Blood Barbarian Bear, also the ancestor of the bear. His bloodline was even stronger, especially with his brute force. He was capable of moving mountains and reclaiming seas. He was in the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm.
Mo Hei was a Qilin, the remnant of the ancestral Qilin Clan. He was of the later stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm.
‘They are all of the demon clan, but they are actually known as the God Clan here!” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
Hu Sanpao, who had been killed earlier, was a Tiger Demon.
F*ck! These demons became a noble clan in another place.
Through their Status, Jiang Ming also learned about some of their secrets. For example, the Bird Clan with declining power, the Dragon Clan that dominated the ocean, etc., were far inferior to the God Clan dominated by terrestrial beasts.
In fact, the God Clan was one of the powerful forces after the Heaven Court.
The arrival of the three was followed by the arrival of a dozen strong existences. After they paid their respects to the Heavenly Emperor, some merged into the Laws Net, while others were merely standing in different corners of the hall.
Obviously, those who didn’t merge with the Laws Net were not members of the Immortal Ministers.
The Heavenly Emperor had to treat many of them with respect. Hence, it revealed their identities as someone powerful or with a powerful background.
......
“Taoist Scorpion, do you really want to join the battle?” Cang Xuan asked for assurance.
“This brat is arrogant and presumptuous, despising all of us in this Tiancang Great Chiliocosm. Hence, it’s a shame to us. Moreover, although Hu Sanpao was a warrior of the Heaven Court, he is a member of our God Clan. Since he has killed an expert of our clan, we definitely have to take revenge for him. Repaying animosity with animosity and repaying kindness with kindness is our objective. Therefore, I beg Your Majesty to grant my request!” Scorpion Thousand Miles said in a sonorous voice.
While bowing his head to the emperor, his tone was also somewhat tough.
“Granted!” The Heavenly Emperor naturally wouldn’t disagree.
“Thank you, Your Majesty!” Scorpion Thousand Miles clasped his hands. Then, he turned to Jiang Ming, looking at him with his dark eyes filled with cruelty. He used his lips filled with bloody aura to demand, “Tell me all about the Sea of Chaos, and I’ll make sure you die without much pain. Otherwise, I’ll swallow you, imprison your Primal Spirit, and refine you for millions and millions of years so that you’ll be in great agony!”
“A mere scorpion actually acts so arrogantly in the main hall of the Heavenly Palace. Heavenly Emperor, you’re so lousy indeed.” Jiang Ming shook his head as he sneered. “In many great chiliocosms, they are the demon clan, the beasts, and the barbarians. They are disposable, lowly creatures slaughtered by thousands of races, and the food on the plate. But it’s so ridiculous to know that they are being known as the God Clan here.”
“F*ck you!” Scorpion Thousand Miles was furious. The longsword in his hand radiated gloomy radiance, and a bloody aura permeated the air. Obviously, it was the poisonous mist.
Both the Bear Tyrant and Mo Hei had killing intent flashing across their faces before disappearing at their control.
The other experts were surprised by the courage of Jiang Ming, who dared arrogantly despise the God Clan’s three venerates, wondering if Jiang Ming wanted to commit suicide.
Dongfang Changqing furtively sighed as he thought, ‘Why does Taoist Jiang Ming act so arrogantly when he is not someone like this?’
“Hold on a minute!” Jiang Ming waved to stop Scorpion Thousand Miles from attacking. Then, he turned to the Heavenly Emperor. “Cang Xuan, he isn’t a member of your Heaven Court. Would you save him when he loses?”
Through the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming had learned that Cang Xuan wanted to watch their battle, two evenly matched opponents. Cang Xuan could take this opportunity to find out how strong Jiang Ming was, and he wouldn’t save Scorpion Thousand Miles if he were to lose the battle because it was an opportunity to weaken the power of the God Clan.
As for the three venerates, they had their own agendas as well. They were here to take the opportunity to kill Jiang Ming in the name of taking vengeance for Hu Sanpao. In this way, they not only further increased their God Clan’s prestige, but they could also weaken the majesty of the Heaven Court as they were the ones who resolved the Heaven Court’s trouble when the foreigner came creating chaos in the Heaven Court!
Because Jiang Ming had learned about their agendas, he brought them out so that he could kill them without being stopped.
Cang Xuan acted as if he was pondering.
On the other hand, Scorpion Thousand Miles guffawed, “You wanna kill me? You’ve been overestimating yourself! Your Majesty, this is the battle of my God Clan. Hence, please don’t intervene!”
“Alright!” Cang Xuan frowned as he agreed. He looked like he was rather unhappy.
In the battle area, all onlookers, particularly the experts from the Tai Xuan Gate and the Sacred Sect, had rather sophisticated thoughts. Regardless of the results, their conflicts would tend to intensify.
“This is interesting!” Jiang Ming laughed. “Do you want to fight with me all together or one after another?”
“Do we have to join hands to kill you? Jiang Ming, you’ve been overestimating yourself!” roared Scorpion Thousand Miles. His roar broke numerous lines of the Laws Net. He wielded his long sword, and black-colored mist permeated over rapidly.
He moved and fused into the mist.
“Great Purifying Technique!” Jiang Ming incanted while making hand seals. A golden light lighted the surroundings and melted the black mist diffusing through the air. It was as if the scorching heat of sunlight was melting the snowflakes.
The Great Purifying Technique was the result of the fusion of the power of light, scorching sun, thunder, etc. It specialized in restraining demonic power.
Based on Jiang Ming’s cultivation realm, he couldn’t cast a potent power with merely the manipulation method. Hence, the fusion of various powers was the way to go.
“What an amazing special ability!” The moment Scorpion Thousand Miles’ voice rang out, his long sword had got to Jiang Ming. It was radiating with gloomy radiance, like the curse from hell.
At the tip of the sword had gathered a layer of black luminance.
Jiang Ming thought of hitting it with his bare punch but suddenly had an inexplicable bad feeling. Hence, he had a glove appear on his fist, blocking the sword tip in a hurry. He also retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 2)
When Jiang Ming looked at the glove, he saw a black dot on the glove’s luminance, which was corroding the power of the gist glove.
When carefully observed, Jiang Ming found out that the little black dot was formed by numerous little scorpions. They were doing their very best in tearing and destroying the defensive power of the glove.
“Brat, you actually block off my strike!” exclaimed Scorpion Thousand Miles. Immediately following that, he sneered. “Let’s see how many times you can block off my attacks! Venerate Law Domain, appear!”
Invisible waves pushed their way through space and hovered over a 1,000-mile area in an instant. The domain also hovered over Jiang Ming.
“Your combat power is strong, but your cultivation base is too low. So, I’ll be suppressing your cultivation base!” Scorpion Thousand Miles smirked. “This common special ability of the venerate is a peerless means to you!”
It was a domain. Amidst the waves was a great amount of black mist made up of the little poisonous scorpions formed by evoking the power of orders. Each of them was of the size of a cell and grouped together to become the black mist.
When observed with divine eyes, their number was large, probably millions and millions of them. The clusters were so dense that they would make people experience trypophobia.
Currently, they were all roaring and making their way toward Jiang Ming.
“The terrifying Venerate Law Domain is formed by conjuring personal Dao in the venerate domain and merging it with laws of heaven and earth.” Jiang Ming had seen such a domain before. Yet, he continued looking very gloomy.
He was capable of killing a Great Overarching Golden Immortal easily but other than a few special abilities he had, he was not confident in confronting a venerate at all, particularly now that he was under the watch of many experts.
“Peerless means?” Jiang Ming tittered. “I think you misunderstood the meaning of peerless means!”
“Oh, why do you say that?” Scorpion Thousand Miles was no longer rushing to attack.
“To me, the grade of this peerless means of yours is too low. Even though my cultivation base is far lower than yours, the special ability I’ve been comprehending is beyond your imagination!” As Jiang Ming spoke, a long majestic river appeared beneath his feet. It was a river that evoked history, communicating the past, suppressing the present, and deducing the future.
......
The moment when the long river of history appeared, three of his clones appeared too.
“What do you think about this special ability of mine?” Jiang Ming asked as he laughed!
“This…” Scorpion Thousand Miles was shocked looking at it. He was, after all, a venerate. Hence, with his high cultivation base, he was able to see through its intrinsic quality.
“The long river seems real and illusory, but it condenses the power of many civilizations, communicates the past and the future, accommodates all laws, and includes the heavens!” Scorpion Thousand Miles exclaimed, “What a terrific special ability! It seems to accommodate millions of laws within one river. Did you deduce this special ability yourself? No, I can’t believe that because it’s impossible!”
“What a frog at the bottom of a well!” Jiang Ming laughed. “So what if you are strong within a world? You can’t go past the barriers of your world; hence, it is difficult for you to truly transcend!”
Scorpion Thousand Miles didn’t care about the despisal he received from Jiang Ming. He asked with excitement instead. “Transcendence? What is transcendence? The Saint?”
“The Saint is considered to have transcended!” Jiang Ming said, “You have limited potential. Achieving the Venerate Realm has completely consumed your foundation. It’s impossible for you to go further. Hence, don’t think about becoming a Saint. Oh, yes. Since you’ve become my enemy today, it’s destined that you no longer have a future. It’d be a waste of my energy to explain further!”
“Since you want to die faster, as you wish!” Scorpion Thousand Miles was filled with killing intent. His long sword emitted black luminance, caused the black mist in the law domain to boil, and turned the domain into total darkness. Meanwhile, he merged into it as well.
“Just a small trick!” Jiang Ming said sonorously and with disdain.
He didn’t move at all while standing on the long river.
“Killer Civilization Punch Technique! It accommodates all things in the past and carries all powers that existed to transform into the strongest killer punch!”
The Past Body burst the void with the punch and evoked various Dao of civilization in a more refined way. The punch also crushed into the black mist instantly.
But the Past Body himself had been corroded too.
“Entombing Sky Illusion Palm, burying the future!”
The Future Body also cast his attack. But the black mist remained. It only turned into an illusionary form, which appeared to be strange.
“Dao destruction!”
The Present Body jumped and pointed to his left.
A long sword appeared from that direction. It was Scorpion Thousand Miles who had merged into the black mist. He was preparing to kill Jiang Ming at that moment, and he had not thought he would be discovered.
“What a good method indeed! But how can a mere clone deal with me? Die!” Scorpion Thousand Miles smirked. His power surged out, fusing into his own poison. The tip of his sword instantly appeared right on the fingertip of the Present Body.
The Present Body exploded.
The long sword was also blasted out. The terrifying power transmitted to the right arm of the Scorpion Thousand Miles and scattered it directly.
“I could see the extreme destruction in that finger just now!” Scorpion Thousand Miles was extraordinarily astounded. At the same time, a scorpion tail appeared on his back. The sharp spike twisted the void, inexplicably appeared right behind Jiang Ming, and stabbed directly at the back of his head.
It was the attack of his main body.
The attack was akin to the strike of a Quasi-Sage Weapon. Moreover, with his own poison contained within the attack, it would kill even a Quasi-Sage.
However, Scorpion Thousand Miles suddenly stiffened at this moment. He found out that the other two clones of Jiang Ming were casting an imprisonment technique on him.
The power was about to surge out of his body, but he was horrified.
“How is it possible?”
Scorpion Thousand Miles struggled to break through the imprisonment. As soon as he released a sound through his soul, he had been pointed directly at the back of his head, which pierced through his skull, and destroyed his Primal Spirit.
It was the Present Body who did that.
When the Present Body exploded, Jiang Ming immediately conjured another.
In fact, Jiang Ming was capable of conjuring clones one after another, provided his main body was still alive and his special ability was still being activated.
If Scorpion Thousand Miles knew that, he might be able to resist. However, because he was arrogant and had never seen such a special ability before, he was killed on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Turn the Heaven Court Upside Down (Part 3)
??
The black mist dispersed, revealing the corpse had been transformed into a black-colored scorpion, as giant as a hill. It was its main body.
“Thousand Miles!”
“Scorpion!”
Both the Bear Tyrant and Mo Hei screamed simultaneously. They were filled with disbelief too. They couldn’t believe that Scorpion Thousand Miles would die just like that.
Scorpion Thousand Miles was, after all, the elder of their God Clan, the old monarch of the Scorpion Clan. He was so strong, particularly his tail and his poison were something even they were afraid of. Yet, Scorpion Thousand Miles was killed like that.
Scorpion Thousand Miles was a venerate. Usually, the battle between the venerates would take a few years, even up to a few hundred years. Yet, it might still be difficult to distinguish the winner, let alone kill the other party.
However, the death of Scorpion Thousand Miles was too sudden, straightforward, and fast, so much so that none of the onlookers could react.
In fact, the Bear Tyrant and Mo Hei were not the only two shocked; even the Heavenly Emperor and all other onlookers were terrified too.
‘He is capable of killing a venerate!’ Cang Xuan was shocked as he spoke to himself. ‘And this special ability of his not only evoked the past, present, and future bodies that include the universe, but each clone can cast a terrific special ability. Based on my experience, this special ability is no weaker than the Holy Dao technique. This is unbelievable! This kid should not be someone with a simple background. But this is our territory. Regardless of his background, he’ll have to be submissive!’
Jiang Ming naturally didn’t know the Heavenly Emperor’s current thoughts. Even if he did, he wouldn’t mind.
Jiang Ming kept the corpse of Scorpion Thousand Miles and his weapons with a wave. He believed that being the Scorpion Monarch, Scorpion Thousand Miles must be delicious!
“Stop it!” The Bear Tyrant roared. “How dare you keep Scorpion Thousand Miles’s body after killing him? You’re such a bully. I must kill you today!”
“Universe Cloth, go!”
As he pointed, a yellow cloth flew out and got bigger as it flew to the wind. Then, it hovered over Jiang Ming and imprisoned the void beneath it.
It was an imprisonment Dao Vessel. It even imprisoned the three clones.
“Die!” The Bear Tyrant had a giant hammer in his hand and hammered directly on the cloth. He wanted to utilize the collision force between the two Dao Vessels to kill Jiang Ming.
This was what he was good at.
“It’s good to use this cloth as the steamboat’s pot!” Jiang Ming maintained his smile.
The Future Body lifted his hand when the cloth was about to drop on Jiang Ming. Following that, the cloth trembled, splashing out its divine luminance and losing its might.
It was because the Future Body had evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
As Jiang Ming grabbed and pulled, the cloth fused into the long river beneath him and disappeared. He transferred it into the Human Path Record to be suppressed.
Fortunately, it was because the cloth was near to him and was merely a normal Quasi-Sage Weapon. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be that easy for Jiang Ming to suppress it.
Meanwhile, both his Past Body and Present Body lunged themselves toward the Bear Tyrant and fought with him.
But they were, after all, merely clones. Hence, they could barely resist the Bear Tyrant.
The Future Body joined in the battle too. With him joining, the battle had become very intense.
The clones, in particular, could cast various special abilities. They had cast millions of different special abilities in just a few seconds. And this stunned many onlookers.
The key point was that these special abilities were all superb.
Hence, if the Bear Tyrant were of the same level as Jiang Ming, he would have been killed.
‘The pressure given is still insufficient!’ Jiang Ming frowned.
He wanted to utilize his match to temper his Infinite Transcendence Technique and improve it further. Unfortunately, the Bear Tyrant was still too weak for him.
‘There is still Mo Hei, huh?’
As Jiang Ming pondered, another two clones appeared beside him. They were conjured with mana.
The moment they appeared, they cast a Space-Time Sealing at the Bear Tyrant, causing Mo Hei, who had been on guard, to be shocked. He roared, lunged himself toward the three clones, and solved the crisis of the Bear Tyrant.
‘Got it!’ Jiang Ming smiled. Then, he looked around and thought, ‘I’ll bury all of you here when I improve further. I want to find out if I’m capable of turning the Heaven Court upside down on my own. The best is to lure the Saint of this world out so that I can identify how strong a Saint is!’

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - Shocking a Great Chiliocosm
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Shocking a Great Chiliocosm
Jiang Ming was overjoyed with Mo Hei’s intervention.
His three clones started to bombard the opponent with a barrage of attacks.
On the other hand, he stood on the long river of history and watched as the battle progressed. Apart from keeping a small part of his concentration to be vigilant of his surroundings, his concentration was completely integrated into the three clones as he frantically fought Mo Hei and the Bear Tyrant.
These two were, after all, experts of the Quasi-Sage Realm, with one being in the middle stage and the other in the later stage. Armed with peerless Dao weapons, powerful bloodlines, and overwhelming special abilities, they weren’t easy to deal with.
It didn’t take long before the three incarnations were killed one after another.
However, a clone was after all merely a clone. As long as the main body did not move and remained in the state of constantly evoking the special ability, more clones could be conjured continuously, forcing the two venerates to be entangled in the fight.
At first, the onlookers only sighed at the overwhelming power of Jiang Ming’s special ability. However, as the clones were continuously taken down, their faces of confusion were slowly taken over by shock.
“Your Majesty, are you able to see through him?” Dongfang Changqing conversed with the Heavenly Emperor telepathically.
“His mana pool seems to be endless!” Cang Xuan responded, “This shouldn’t be possible! It’s not hard to see from the Dao fluctuations that permeate his whole body that he hasn’t even reached the realm of Taiyi, let alone the Great Overarching Golden Immortal. How can he have such a terrifying mana pool? How can he have such monstrous combat power? This is just unbelievable!”
“He’s really of the Golden Immortal Realm!” Dongfang Changqing exclaimed, “I can see it too, but I just can’t believe it! No matter how strong a Golden Immortal is, the mana of the Immortal Realm is limited. Yet, what he’s showing is just…. difficult to understand!
“Putting this aside, what about his special abilities? His three clones with one communicating with the past, another interpreting future, while the third suppressing the present. These three incarnations use the long river that has been conjured below his feet as their core but are still immensely powerful. To think that they can actually entangle two venerates!”
“As long as the main body remains, his clones won’t have to worry about anything!” Cang Xuan remarked and continued. “The Dao of Bodies of Three Lifetimes that he evoked was originally an unparalleled special ability, to begin with. However, each of Jiang Ming’s clones has supreme special abilities that are compatible with his own Dao! That is even more terrifying!”
“Your Majesty, may I take a guess?”
“Tell me!”
“Could he be from the legendary Sea of Chaos?”
“The Sea of Chaos?”
“Yes! How could he descend into our world if he weren’t from the Sea of Chaos? If he weren’t from the Sea of Chaos, how could he have such a terrifying accumulation of mana? If he weren’t from the Sea of Chaos, how could his physical body be as terrifying as the top-grade Dao Vessels or even the supreme-grade Dao Vessels? Also, those special abilities that he evokes at will in the battle seem to be directly leading toward the great Dao. However, he managed to evoke more than 10,000 kinds of them. How incredible is this?”
“From the way you interpreted it, this seems to be a reasonable explanation. Only such a place can nurture a monster of such caliber. A genius that shatters common sense and exceeds cognition! But what is his purpose here?”
“For training?”
“Maybe so!”
After some analysis of the situation, the two got a hold of the most logical explanation of Jiang Ming’s capability.
At that moment, the situation changed.
Just when the Past Body was killed through a sudden explosion, the Bear Tyrant entangled the Present Body and the Future body, allowing Mo Hei to sacrifice an orb, emitting a yellow luminance as he volleyed it to the top of Jiang Ming’s head.
Its luminance felt heavy and trailing as it seemed to condense the power of 10,000,000 sacred mountains. When it fell upon him, Jiang Ming’s body sank as the long river of history under his feet set off endless waves.
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique!”
Seemingly to have expected all this to happen, Jiang Ming raised his left hand and cast a peerless special ability towards the sky.
The luminance of the orb was slightly scattered but still continued to fall. Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank as he quickly turned his palm into a fist and bombarded right back at the luminance.
Boom!
With a loud bang, Jiang Ming was slammed down from the air. There were even crackling sounds coming from his arm. If he hadn’t weakened the attack with the Gloves of the War God and the venerate-level defensive armor that he was wearing, this blow would’ve surely blown off his entire arm.
He might have even been bombarded to death from the attack.
However, he was also completely released from the state of the Infinite Transcendence Technique, causing his Present body and Future body to disappear immediately.
“Die!”
The Bear Tyrant, who was already raging in a fury, seized the opportunity. As the Divine Hammer in his hands finished charging itself with supreme energy, he evoked the Chaotic Divine Hammer Technique.
Such a blow from this attack could even destroy the world.
“Die!”
Mo Hei, who was also enraged, sacrificed another two orbs again. The two additional orbs were actually attracted to the one just now, which allowed the Dao connection to be established, leading to the continuous rise of accumulated power.
It seemed that the hall conjured by the Heavenly Emperor from the Heavenly Palace Main Hall wasn’t able to withstand such a force. Even the threads of the Laws Net kept breaking apart.
As the Heavenly Emperor casually waved his hand to suppress the force, the Laws Net solidified itself, stabilizing the restless battlefield.
On the other hand, Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank.
He opened his mouth, spewed out three Great Overarching Dao vessels, and immediately detonated all three without hesitation.
Boom!
The destructive torrent erupted instantly, resisting and dispersing the attacks from the Bear Tyrant and Mo Hei.
He also took the chance to retreat into the distance while his body was covered with luminance, barely blocking the explosion’s aftermath.
The Heavenly Emperor, however, stood up suddenly as he waved his hands, forcibly suppressing the battlefield’s space so that the explosion’s ripple would not spread throughout the place. His face was filled with shock.
He wasn’t the only one left in shock. Dongfang Changqing and the others who had just witnessed such a scene were also shocked.
They initially thought that Jiang Ming would definitely be killed under the combination of attack by the Bear Tyrant and Mo Hei. Who would’ve thought that he would counter the attack as he did?
“To be able to detonate Great Overarching Dao Vessels, three pieces at a time and even doing it in an instant. What kind of special ability is this?” the Heavenly Emperor muttered to himself with a solemn expression.
In an instant, various thoughts ran through his mind.
What if there were ten Dao Vessels instead of three?
Would the Heavenly Palace be able to withstand such an attack?
What if a Quasi-Sage Weapon replaced it?
Just the thought brought chills down his spine. However, he also speculated that detonating Dao Vessels would probably take a great toll on him.
Mo Hei withstood the aftermath of the destruction as he looked at Jiang Ming and asked, “You actually detonated the Great Overarching Dao Vessel? How did you do it?”
The Bear Tyrant’s eyes were blood red. Even his killing intent was starting to materialize.
He was almost killed just now.
How could he not be as angry as he was?
After all, the little b*stard in front of him was merely a feeble ant in his eyes that he could crush to death at will. Who would’ve thought that from the few exchanges in battle, he would have been killed if it weren’t for Mo Hei’s help?
For the Bear Tyrant, it was a great disgrace.
He had joined forces with Mo Hei but was actually entangled by Jiang Ming’s clones?
How incredible was that?
After the two joined forces, they seized an opportunity to destroy Jiang Ming with a fatal blow directly.
There was even a chance for them to kill a Heavenly Emperor with such an attack. However, what was the result?
He got half his body blown up instead and almost even lost his life.
God damn it! What disgraceful day it had become!
However, the Bear Tyrant didn’t rush in to attack but instead listened to Jiang Ming’s answer. He wanted to know what special means he had to be able to detonate even Dao vessels.
“It’s very easy to do so!” replied Jiang Ming, looking at the three orbs suspended over the Bear Tyrants’ head. All three of them were gleaming with a dark yellow luminance, condensing into a boundless sense of heaviness.
If they hit the ground, they would literally smash through the ground.
Even the universe might not be able to withstand their weight.
“The three orbs are all of Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels. They are of very high quality and look almost like they were one body, to begin with.” Jiang Ming asked, “Could it be that these are inheritance items?”
A sullen expression flashed through Mo Hei’s face.
Jiang Ming suddenly had a general understanding of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - Great Monarch Hongyun
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Great Monarch Hongyun
By looking through Mo Hei’s ‘Status’ in the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming knew of the origin of the other party’s three orbs.
In ancient times, although Kirins were considered rare, there were quite a few of them around.
There were nine of them who were particularly the most powerful and terrifying of all. These nine Kirins were also known as the nine ancestors of the Kirin, the nine emperors of the earth.
As they fought in the battles of the Holy Dao, three of them had fallen.
Later on, the Saint Lords from the outside world invaded, causing yet another four of them to fall.
In the end, only two of them remained. One was the emperor of the God Clan, while the other was him.
As for the three orbs?
One was the weapon of enlightenment that he tempered himself, while the other two were the two left over after the fall of the former Kirin ancestor.
After acquiring the other two orbs, he had been tempering them for hundreds of millions of years, finally turning them into his own Dao Weapon. These three orbs had become a set, being able to be on the offensive and defensive state at the same time.
When Mo Hei saw Jiang Ming controlling the Bear Tyrant’s cover, he knew that this foreigner was able to influence or even control other people’s Dao weapons. As such, he was extra vigilant and even thought of a countermeasure, which was to use the force of attraction between the three Kirin Orbs to block off the technique.
Sure enough, it worked.
“This is a gift from my brothers!” Mo Hei nodded, and then asked a question in return, “How were you able to detonate the Great Overarching Dao Vessels?”
“By using a special ability!” Jiang Ming gave a simple answer, but couldn’t help and sighed, “I wanted to use the both of you to hone my Transcendence Technique, so that my Bodies of Three Lifetimes could improve further. Sadly, you didn’t follow the normal script!”
In fact, he was trying to use the abilities of the two to see if he could fuse the Bodies of Three Lifetimes into one. Unfortunately, he couldn’t do so with his current abilities.
His mission’s objective was a failure.
“Script?” The Bear Tyrant was furious, “To treat the both of us as a whetstone to hone yourself, who gave you such confidence?”
“Didn’t I almost kill you just now?” Jiang Ming responded with a smile.
The Bear Tyrant’s breath stagnated upon hearing the reply.
Jiang Ming no longer paid attention to him, but looked at the Heavenly Emperor and muttered indifferently with a lack of interest, “Fellow Daoist Cang Xuan, what do you think if we end this farce now?”
“End?” Mo Hei directly intervened before Cang Xuan could even speak, “You first killed Hu Sanpao and then Scorpion Thousand Miles who were both of our God Clan. Do you think you can still walk away?”
“I want to leave, who can even stop me?” Jiang Ming waved his hand, and ten Great Overarching Dao weapons suddenly appeared in front of him.
Mo Hei’s expression suddenly turned ugly.
“You bastard, you are so unruly!” The Bear Tyrant yelled, “I won’t believe that you can detonate them all at the same time. If you detonate all of them, the damaged soul imprint caused by the detonation of your own Dao vessels might turn you into an idiot right there and then! ”
“I don’t believe he can do it either!” An old man with red hair and red beard clad in a red robe walked out of the crowd. He stroked his beard with a cheerful smile on his face while looking at Jiang Ming, “Fellow Taoist, this is the Heaven Court. How is it a place where you can come and leave as you please? What’s more, you even beheaded our Heavenly Officials here in the presence of His Majesty. You’re already trampling on the Heaven Court’s face with dirt. If you are allowed to leave, the Heaven Court’s majesty will also be lost in one day! ”
“Besides, this is Heaven Court. Even if you could detonate all of them, can you really threaten us?”
“You underestimate Your Majesty, the Laws Net, and the Heaven Court too much!”
The old man was relatively sluggish and slow. However, the remark that he just made not only blocked Jiang Ming from any further explanation but also completely cut off the possibility of the Heavenly Emperor recruiting Jiang Ming onto his side.
Two experts walked out from behind him as they stood by his side.
“Great Monarch Hongyun!”
Jiang Ming looked at the other party with a strange expression on his face.
This person was of the Sacred Sect. He initially gained his Dao from the first red cloud of the world, establishing himself with a deep cultivation foundation. He was different from others of the Sacred Sect because he had a wide range of contacts throughout.
When he learned that Bai Liu was killed and discovered about the situation here, he took the initiative to come forth.
The two beside him were also from the Sacred Sect and were both Venerates.
Looking at him, Jiang Ming remembered another legendary Great Monarch Hongyun who also acquired his Dao from the Red Cloud.
‘Such a warm and kind smile that makes people unconsciously feel intimate with them. It seems that this is also a wise old man!’ As Jiang Ming thought about it, he looked over at the Heavenly Emperor and said with a smile, “Fellow Taoist Cang Xuan, you can see that neither Mo Hei and the Bear Tyrant of the God Clan nor the Great Monarch Hongyun of the Sacred Sect will take you seriously. They have long been self-reliant and wanted independence. Now, they are both attacking the Heaven Court today to promote their prestige as their first step. Why don’t we join forces and keep them all here? ”
Mo Hei’s pupils suddenly shrank.
Great Monarch Hongyun’s smile did not change the slightest, but a murderous intent flashed through his eyes.
Dongfang Changqing had a melancholy expression on his face.
The other experts all had different expressions on their faces.
The Heavenly Emperor’s expression however, remained the same. He merely muttered, “Jiang Ming, you don’t have to try and stir us up anymore. You won’t be able to walk away today! However, I will allow you all to settle your grievances first. I’ll be handing over the battlefield to you.”
Jiang Ming was delighted upon hearing so.
This Cang Xuan seemed to be very shrewd by allowing them to fight and was planning to take this opportunity to weaken both sides. However, what was the reality?
The majesty of Heaven Court was deteriorating.
After all, this here was the Heavenly Court. How can he, as the Heavenly Emperor, be just a spectator?
Wasn’t this just pulling on people’s legs?
“Haha! Great!” Jiang Ming laughed out loud in response. He then looked at Mo Hei and Great Monarch Hongyun, “I’ll give the both of you one last chance. Just leave!”
“Leave? God damn it! Do you really think you can threaten us? Die!” The Bear Tyrant couldn’t bear it any longer. Now that he saw the experts of the Sacred Sect standing up to Jiang Ming, there was no hesitation in his mind.
The giant hammer in his hand was directly evoked. As the hammer was volley into the air, it suddenly turned into a monstrous size before bombarding down onto Jiang Ming
That was a Venerate-leveled Dao weapon.
Its power was overwhelmingly terrifying to begin with.
Even Jiang Ming felt the terrifying pressure.
He was confident that he could stop the attack, but what would he be able to do next?
The experts such as Mo Hei and Great Monarch Hongyun were still staring down at him, waiting for a chance to pounce.
Even Yin Zhan, who was watching the battle, was eager to try his hands on Jiang Ming. He wanted to beat the underdog, but at the same time, his eyes glanced at the Heavenly Emperor from time to time, yearning to ask: Are you really my father?
Unfortunately, it wasn’t a good time to ask such a question in such critical moments.
Jiang Ming sighed faintly, sent a punch towards the top of his head, barely resisting the opponent’s blow, and said, “I can travel through Chaos to descend to this realm, which meant that I have supreme means and methods; I killed the Immortal King of the Heaven Court, but still dared to come forth into the Heavenly Palace. These show that I have absolute confidence. Can’t you see it?”
“Do not!”
“You saw it! However, the things I possess were too valuable to all of you! Bodies of Three Lifetimes, the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, the method of descending into great chiliocosms, the situation of the Sea of Chaos! Alas, desires. It’s the thing that causes people to lose their sanity the easiest.”
Jiang Ming sighed again and again. He realized that he liked to lament on things more and more.
“You are too confident and the result of overwhelming self-confidence is death!” Yin Zhan finally couldn’t help himself and said, “This is the Heaven Court, the core of the Laws Net. Even a Saint Lord that descends here would be trapped, let alone you. Jiang Ming, today marks your death.”
“Is that so?” Jiang Ming smiled and looked over at him with a weird smile on his face, “Would you like to know who your biological father is? Do you want to know how your mother was tricked to death by your biological father?”
Yin Zhan’s eyes widened and erupted with boundless killing intent.
He then looked over at the Heavenly Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - Master, Are You Really my Father?
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Master, Are You Really my Father?
The Heavenly Emperor was quite baffled. Never could he have imagined how Jiang Ming knew what happened back then.
That was a secret among the secrets.
It was exactly as what he had remarked, if he had the intention of hiding the secret, no one except the Saint Lord in the world would be able to find out!
There was absolutely no one else.
However, this young man of the human race who had just descended to his realm was able to expose his secret to its core.
As if that was not all, the key thing was that his son was right by his side.
Cang Xuan looked over at his son.
Admitting if he was his father was a different matter. The important thing was that the death of his son’s mother was indeed driven by him back then.
This was a fact.
Deny the accusation? It was difficult for him to do so when faced with his son’s gaze.
“Master, are you really my father?” Yin Zhan’s tone was a little hoarse.
In the battlefield where the Heaven Court Main Hall was conjured, it was extremely quiet and silent for a brief while.
It was supposed to be an earth-shattering battle, yet who would have known that it would evolve to such ethical kinship of recognition?
However, no one dared to laugh.
Conversely, they even had an extremely serious expression on their faces. Many lowered their heads to count the ants on the ground while some others looked up at the fluttering white clouds, as if they didn’t hear them.
God damn it!
Ants?
Fluttering clouds?
Who would even dare to see the Heavenly Emperor as a joke?
Even Mo Hei, the Bear Tyrant, and Great Monarch Hongyun, who were oozing with murderous intent were silent.
They were also paying attention to the Heavenly Emperor, to see how he would answer Yin Zhan.
If he was to admit to it? This would mean that this Heavenly Emperor was really scheming on the Sacred Sect, the God Clan and the Tai Xuan Gate.
What if he was to deny it? However, looking at the Heavenly Emperor’s expression, he seemed to have acquiesced to it.
“Cang Xuan, don’t make me look down on you!” Jiang Ming’s voice suddenly erupted, breaking the silent battlefield. He laughed and said, “Now that you’re already at such a level of cultivation, plotting for the unification of the heavens, scheming for the Saint position, is a matter of course. No one can blame you for them. A scheme is a scheme. It’s fine if no one knew about it. However, if they’re spilled and you still deny it, you’ll be trampling on your own identity and even lose your own temperament. Perhaps, such a thing might even leave a scar deep in your heart. If so, how can you still ascend to the Saint position in the future? It would be impossible!”
Dongfang Changqing, who was watching silently, was a little surprised.
This kid was really malicious. With just a few words, he sealed the Heavenly Emperor’s way of escaping.
If the Heavenly Emperor were to deny the accusation?
There might be an obstruction in his mind toward his path of Dao. Moreover, to have denied it in front of such a large audience, it might really leave a scar on the temperament of his mind. How would he be able to step into Saint Dao in the future?
What if he was to admit to the accusation?
He would definitely be faced with hostility from the Tai Xuan Gate, the Sacred Sect and the God Clan. The influence of the Heaven Court would form cracks and deviation for sure. Although they won’t be opposing the Heaven Court openly, the Heavenly Emperor’s decree from then on would be akin to a blank sheet of paper.
‘I admired him quite a bit. However…sigh. He is completely on the opposite side of the Heaven Court and he is also a person from the outer realm. If he can’t be an ally and wants to disrupt our world, he is destined to be an enemy.’ Dongfang Changqing sighed in his heart.
As a person who had reached such a stage of cultivation, he had already seen through most of the trivial matters of the world. He would kill even his own disciples if he needed to, let alone the admiration towards someone.
Yin Zhan’s expression was the most complicated.
‘God damn it! I’m a Great Overarching Golden Immortal for crying out loud! Who would’ve thought that my biological father would appear all of a sudden that he would be my master in name?’
As if that wasn’t enough, what made him feel worse was that his birth seemed to have been the result of some other person’s scheme towards a different objective.
When he thought of this, Yin Zhan, who was always prideful and arrogant, really wanted to die right there and then.
Cang Xuan stood up. His incomparably huge figure naturally evoked the boundless power of order, the power of the Laws Net, the power of authority, and the invincible power emanating naturally, made even the hearts of peerless experts such as Great Monarch Hongyun to tremble.
“I don’t understand, how did you know?” Cang Xuan did not answer the question directly, but it was also a definite answer, “You are not a Saint Lord, and you have only just descended into our chiliocosm. It is impossible for you to know about this. You shouldn’t be able to know of all my plans, yet you knew everything. That shouldn’t be possible. If that’s the case, then there’s only one possibility. Whether they are currently within our chiliocosm or on the outside of our chiliocosm, there are Saint Lords from your world who have infiltrated into ours, constantly monitoring the movements of our Tiancang Great Chiliocosm. Now that you all feel that the time is ripe, you emerge to the surface with the intention of breaking the Heaven Court apart and lead us to fight within ourselves. Right when we are seriously damaged, you would take advantage of the situation to invade us. Isn’t that right? That must be it!”
“You’re thinking too much. Also, don’t you try to divert people’s eyes with such words.” Jiang Ming was rendered quite speechless. “Do you think that my strength would even be of use if I wanted to invade a chiliocosm? Would Demi-Sage Cultivation Realm be of use? All of these are useless!Only the Saint Lords can dictate the victory or defeat of such a feat. The rest are merely incidental objects. Although the Laws Net is peerless, to trap a Saint Lord? You’re just thinking too much!”
“Cang Xuan, is it really so difficult to admit to your own doings?”
“You are the Heavenly Emperor, the one who stood at the highest pinnacle of Tiancang Great chiliocosm, the man among men. You should just admit it if you’ve done so!”
“Besides, now that you have a son, it’s actually a gratifying event. You should be opening up the gates of the Heaven Court and accept all guests from all directions. To be able to identify your relatives under their witness. Can’t you see how perfect that would be?”
God Freaking dammit! Cang Xuan almost blurted out vulgar words. He was really pissed off.
“Fellow Taoist Mo Hei, Fellow Taoist hongyun, please kill this foreign bureaucrat!” Cang Xuan ordered.
The expression on his face became very gloomy. There seemed to be a power of destruction all around him, yearning to erupt anytime soon. The entire battlefield was extremely terrified by the suppression of his aura.
Great Monarch Hongyun and Mo Hei were rather hesitant.
They saw that the Heavenly Emperor was at the verge of erupting in fury at this time.
They were wondering if they were not obeying his order, will this be the end of them there and then?
They eventually decided that it was better to just do it! After all, this bastard Jiang Ming really deserved to die.
Right this very moment however, Yin Zhan asked again, “You haven’t answered yet. Are you my father?”
The tense atmosphere suddenly became chaotic.
Cang Xuan’s mouth seemed to even twitch a little.
‘Damn it! I finally managed to temporarily suppress the restlessness with great difficulty by force. After suppressing Jiang Ming, I’ll be able to get my hands on the secrets of the outer world and share them with the others. Maybe then, I can escape this crisis. Yet, you unfilial son! I know that you are stubborn and unbending. But can you not be so stubborn at such critical times?’
“Yes!” Cang Xuan responded.
“You killed my mother?” Yin Zhan’s complex expression froze for a moment, before his face turned gloomy.
“No!”
“But she was killed by your scheme!”
Cang Xuan was silent this time.
Should he reveal that she was killed by the Sacred Sect?
Right that very moment, there and then, such a thing must not be said.
Cang Xuan looked at the two experts standing beside Great Monarch Hongyun. His voice was rumbling, containing the supreme power of Dao fluctuation, “Suppress him! I will personally strip his memory and show it to all of you!”
Great Monarch Hongyun’s eyes lit up and his heart skipped a beat.
As for the Heavenly Emperor’s scheme?
It had already been pointed out and revealed. Why would he still care about it? It would be something to deal with in the future.
Mo Hei, on the other hand, laughed!
“Kill!”
The Bear Tyrant was very decisive.
He had already suppressed himself to the limit. After all, he had lost all his pride today. Luckily, the Heavenly Emperor also lost his pride today.
This was good. Very good indeed.
He made his move at the very moment he heard the promise of the Heavenly Emperor.
After all, Cang Xuan also had another meaning behind his words: For the suppression of Jiang Ming and to have his memory shared, he himself would also make a move at the critical moment. They just had to suppress him.
Boom!
The Bear Tyrant evoked the Divine Hammer in his hand, striking down with a supreme mighty power that could even blast through the stars.
However, his pupils shrank right that very moment as he couldn’t help but blurt, “Jiang Ming, you are so unruly!”
He was not the only one. Mo Hei, Great Monarch Hongyun, Yin Zhan, and even the Heavenly Emperor were terrified.
As for the other experts, their faces were as pale as paper, overwhelmed with horror as all of them had a terrified look on their faces.
“To hell with your so-called rules!”
Jiang Ming sneered, but remained still. A series of Dao vessels appeared around him where all of them were Great Overarching Weapons. In addition to the previous Dao vessels he had taken out, there were 49 of them ready.
These 49 Great Overarching Dao vessels even formed a large formation array.
“Fellow Taoist! Please hold on!”
Cang Xuan was extremely anxious as he shouted quickly and at the same time evoked the power of the Laws Net to form a heavy defensive barrier.
“Hehe!”
Jiang Ming merely smirked. Without any hesitation, he evoked Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, detonating all 49 Dao vessels at the same time.
Boom…
Along with a deafening sound, the blast wave of the explosion, drowned all things.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - The Anger of the Heavenly Emperor, the Formation of the Eyes of Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: The Anger of the Heavenly Emperor, the Formation of the Eyes of Tribulation
How would the destructive might of the detonation of the 49 Great Overarching Dao Vessels be?
Jiang Ming finally witnessed it.
The intensity of such power shocked him. There was even a sense of despair that loomed over his heart. If it wasn’t for the privilege of consuming points as the group admin of the Supreme Pagoda chat group, he wouldn’t have done such a thing and would instead have fled long ago.
As for the waste of Dao vessels?
They were merely some Great Overarching Dao Vessels, not considered to be of great expense to his net-worth.
Since Jiang Ming began cultivating, he had barely done anything and would try to avoid them whenever he could.
As for the battles in the Supreme Pagoda? They were just to pass through the levels after all.
As for reality? He also wanted to keep participating in great battles and completely releasing himself from his own shackles. However, there were very few occasions that allowed him to.
Now that he had descended into another chiliocosm and the shackles on himself were all gone. When would it be best to cause a scene if not now?
Standing in the middle of the torrent, Jiang Ming saw the layers of the Laws Net’s defensive barriers being destroyed.
He also saw the power of the Heaven Court’s great formation array evoked by Cang Xuan being destroyed.
He even saw that the power of authority triggered by Cang Xuan collapsed quickly under the bombardment of the destructive torrent.
Of course, he saw the Bear Tyrant’s tragic death on the spot.
Mo Hei evoked his three orbs to defend himself but was also torn apart by the eruption while his figure drowned in the divine luminance.
Great Monarch Hongyun was not much better himself.
The Immortals Officials of the Heaven Court who were watching the battle and the experts who came here later, all evoked their life-saving special abilities, sacrificing their supreme Dao vessels, but were all submerged in the torrent of destruction without exception.
If you looked at it from the Heavenly Realm, you would discover that above the heavens, between the sun and the moon, space was suddenly distorted and a huge world appeared itself.
Immortal luminance was flowing in the huge world and there were sacred lands everywhere. The many palaces spread to the end of the sky, and there were even places such as the Immortal Medicinal Garden.
Such a scene was simply beyond imagination.
However, many experts of the Heavenly Realm recognized it at first sight: This was the Heavenly Court.
Why did it manifest itself? The drastic change in the very next moment shocked all sentient beings of the Heavenly Realm.
To think that a torrent suddenly erupted right from the very middle of the mighty and domineering Heavenly Court, which later swept through the entire Heaven Court as well.
It didn’t matter whether it was the Immortal Palace, array formation or even the Laws Net. Everything was destroyed in an instant.
The whole Heaven Court was blown into pieces. Billions of years of accumulated resources, arrangement, wealth, billions of Immortal Soldiers and Immortal Generals, were blown into ashes.
The sky became distorted from the eruption, as the laws collapsed. High above in the sky, it was as if a hundred thousand suns exploded at the same time, drowning the world in its luminance. Even the sky was also torn apart, forming countless spatial black holes, as the destructive power was sucked in.
All of the sentient beings on earth were stunned by the whole ordeal.
It took a long time before the torrent of bombardment gradually dissipated, followed with hundreds of millions of fragments falling from the sky, turning into meteors as they crashed in all directions.
Most of these fragments however, were sucked into the spatial torrents.
“The Heaven Court was blown up?”
“It seems like it. It looks like it. Is it really blown up?!”
“I rubbed my eyes three times and shocked my primal spirit nine times to see if I’m awake. Damn it! The Heaven Court has really blown up!”
“How can that be possible?”
“I know right? How is that possible! That’s the Heaven Court. It’s the place with the highest number of experts and also the place with the strongest defense. There is no place in the world that is more powerful than Heaven Court. How could it have exploded?”
“Who knows? But it is certain that the world is going to be in chaos.”
“With the Heaven Court in ruins, there’s no reason why the world wouldn’t fall into chaos!
“What you said left me speechless!”
“I don’t care if you’re speechless! What I want to know most now is, why did the Heaven Court blow itself up, and who was behind it?”
“Who can even destroy the Heaven Court? I’m afraid there’s only the...”
“Saint Lords!”
Many experts on earth had the same speculation and all their expressions changed before falling into silence.
When it involved such a high cultivation level, what else could they do other than remaining silent?
The Saint Lords dominated the vast sky and earth. The hundreds of millions of sentient beings were just pieces on a chessboard.
They had no control over their own destiny and could only follow what’s coming for them. They could only cry out in despair that their fates wereup to the heavens, rather than themselves.
High up in the sky, a figure finally appeared from the explosion. He stood in the torrent with his body straight and a strange power seemed to have surrounded him. The power blocked the torrents from injuring him regardless of how much the torrents raged on.
In his surroundings, many figures gradually appeared, all in dire straits.
Among them were the Heavenly Emperor and Yin Zhan, who were in the best state. It seemed as though they were not affected in any way.
Yin Zhan was, of course, sheltered by the Heavenly Emperor himself. Otherwise, it would be unreasonable for him to stay alive with his level of cultivation.
Dongfang Changqing was also alive. After all, he was the Verdant Emperor. He could control the Laws Net and also held a part of the power of authority. Even so, he was also in dire straits.
There were about a dozen people around him. They were all the Heaven Court’s warriors who were barely sheltered by him, all who were above the Great Overarching Immortal Realm.
There were also two other Heaven Court’s Venerates who survived the explosion. Not only were they unable to shelter any Immortal officials, they themselves were also in an extremely dire strait that even their breath were unstable.
As for Great Monarch Hongyun, Mo Hei and the likes, all of them ended up dead.
They were at the dead center when the Dao Vessels were detonated. Unable to control the power of the Laws Net or mobilize the power of the Heaven Court, it was impossible for them to survive the explosion.
Putting them aside, there were still a number of experts on the edge of the Heaven Court who survived, but their total number was not more than a thousand.
The power from the detonation eventually dissipated completely, leaving only the howling winds raging all around.
High above the sky, it was dead silent.
The surviving experts had a gloomy and terrifying look on their face as they stared at Jiang Ming with immense anger, an anger that could not be put out even when they were to die.
Dongfang Changqing was the same.
“How are you still alive?” Cang Xuan finally spoke.
Who was the angriest among them? It was none other than the Heavenly Emperor himself.
As the Heavenly Emperor, the Heaven Court was his domain. It was his territory where most of his most loyal subordinates reside. But what of it now?
Everything had gone.
His anger, his rage, his fury, his madness, his resentment. All of them were suppressed by him.
“How would I kill myself with my own technique?” Jiang Ming smiled, “I told you again and again not to mess with me. There was always room for discussion. In the end, all of you still wanted to mess me up. Especially you, Cang Xuan! You still wanted to scheme on me and use me in your plan of taking over the world. How did that end up? It’s a dead loss for you now! Happy now? Go mad!”
“I...” Cang Xuan pointed at Jiang Ming and almost cursed out loud.
Fortunately, he held back as he wanted to protect his pride as the Heavenly Emperor.
The extreme anger in his eyes however, materialized as it burned through the void in front of him, creating countless holes.
“Now that it has come to this. I must kill you even if I didn’t want to!” Cang Xuan took a deep breath and suppressed the monstrous anger in him and sighed.
“That’s right! You must be killed now.” Dongfang Changqing sighed as well. He looked at Jiang Ming and said, “Why did you do this?”
“Well brother Changqing, if I don’t do this in the main hall of the Heavenly Palace, are you suggesting for me to reveal my neck to be slaughtered instead?” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
“Haish...” Dongfang Changqing sighed, “If it were me, I might’ve done the same thing without any hesitation. Yet after all this, I am still the Verdant Emperor of the Heaven Court. Fellow Taoist Jiang, I will be your enemy rather than a friend from now on!”
“I have a very good impression of you, Taoist Changqing. My advice to you would be not to be my enemy. You really shouldn’t. You’ll die!” Jiang Ming sincerely exclaimed.
Dongfang Changqing was horrified upon hearing his words. The current him couldn’t be more serious about Jiang Ming’s remark.
He began wondering whether Jiang Ming meant it and that he really had the capability to kill him?
Jiang Ming was, after all, being targeted by the Heavenly Emperor. The other experts from Tai Xuan Gate, God Clan and also the Sacred Sect were rushing over as they spoke.
Now that Jiang Ming no longer had as many Dao vessels as he did, Dongfang Changqing was wondering what was the source of his confidence? Perhaps he still had other cards under his sleeves?
“After all this, I am still the Verdant Emperor!” Dongfang Changqing was also very serious as he spoke, “Fellow Taoist Jiang, detonating Dao vessels while you are still at the Great Overarching Cultivation Realm is a taboo technique and I believe should come with a great price. When you evoked the detonations, the soul imprint on the Dao vessels will also be annihilated. Those were all Great Overarching Dao vessels after all. To be able to refine all of them, the soul imprint left on them must’ve been extremely strong. To be able to detonate so many of them at the same time, it stands to reason that you wouldn’t be able to bear the backlash. Yet, why do you still seem fine, as though nothing has happened?”
He was really puzzled.
Even the Heavenly Emperor himself was puzzled.
Jiang Ming merely smiled. Would I be telling you that when I detonated the Great Overarching Dao Vessels, I would be able to avoid my Primal Spirit from getting destroyed by using the Human Path Record?
“I naturally have my own ways!” As he replied, he asked a question instead, “The Heaven Court was founded by the Saint Lords. Now that it has been destroyed, why doesn’t the Saint Lord show himself?”
Dongfang Changqing fell silent.
“He didn’t show up because I am enough to kill you!” Cang Xuan couldn’t answer either. As he waved his hand to teleport Yin Zhan over to the ends of the world, he then walked towards Jiang Ming with a murderous look on his face. “You brought my Heaven Court to ruins, shattered the backbone of my great chiliocosm and stomped all our dignity onto the ground. Today, it’s either your death or mine!”
As he raised his hand and pointed upwards, the sky went on riot. Endless thunderclouds gathered above, turning into an eye of tribulation, aiming directly at Jiang Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - Nine-Nine-to-One Infinite Array Formation
