chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Nine-Nine-to-One Infinite Array Formation
Cang Xuan’s killing intent was raging unprecedentedly.
Even since his birth, there had been very few instances where he had such terrifying murderous intentions.
The foundation that he had been managing for hundreds of millions of years had been destroyed in just a glimpse of an eye.
Moreover, that was his chance of sanctioning the way of Dao as well.
Anyone would’ve gone crazy if they were in the same shoe as him.
As he pointed into the sky, the sky started to tremble as the tens of thousands of laws were in resonance. The peerless Laws Net was seemingly materializing, entrapping Jiang Ming in the middle layer by layer.
Right on top of Jiang Ming’s head, the thunderous storm formed an eye of tribulation.
“Heavenly Punishment Thunder Tribulation! The judgment of good and evil! Fall!” Cang Xuan swiped down, as if slashing the sky and revealing the injustice. At the same time, his primal spirit vibrated, radiating with the essence of this special ability. “This technique is the pinnacle of strength and Yang. It integrates the laws of heaven and earth, mobilizes the power of authority, judges the good and evil of the living beings in the world. If deemed to be of the good, not only does it bring no harm to the person, the technique will temper the person’s body, strengthen the person’s essence and enhance the person’s aptitude as well; as for the ones deemed evil, the destructive energy will naturally destroy the person’s body, annihilating their very soul. Its power varies with the degree of evil deeds the person has committed. Jiang Ming…”
Schadenfreude flashed through Cang Xuan’s face as he remarked, “You destroyed the Heaven Court and slaughtered more than ten thousand Immortal officials. Your crime is of the extreme that even heaven couldn’t tolerate without punishment. All the evil in the world is not enough to describe your sins. As such, this blow to you is comparable to the power of destroying a whole world in one strike!”
The voice reverberating from his primal spirit was so fast that it spread throughout in the blink of an eye.
However, when he thought of Jiang Ming being safe from the detonation of so many Great Overarching Dao vessels, his heart sank.
‘This is the law of order, the law of rules, and the law of heaven!’ Jiang Ming raised his head and looked at the terrifying eyes of tribulation, his heart trembled.
An inexplicable thought flashed his mind.
What would happen if he rushed into it and refined his body with the power of the thunder tribulation?
He would become ashes. There would be absolutely no other possible outcome.
To block it off with his accumulated points from the Supreme Pagoda?
God damn it! He had already wasted ten thousand points already.
Was there any benefit for staying here any longer?
There was none!
If he were to fight against the Heavenly Emperor, it would be meaningless because the other party was too strong and that he was too weak himself.
Apart from self-destructing the Dao vessels, what else could he do?
After all, there was still the Laws Net here.
His opponent would have at least a Demi-Sage level weapon as well.
“Cang Xuan! I will definitely kill you when I return to this place!” Looking at the power of thunder tribulation still brewing above his head, and feeling the solidification of the surrounding space, Jiang Ming also understood that the normal method of escaping was futile.
Not only was the surrounding area sealed, even his body was locked on by the technique.
He looked at Cang Xuan indifferently.
“Do you think you can still escape...” Before Cang Xuan even finished speaking, Jiang Ming disappeared into thin air, leaving no traces behind.
‘He’s gone?’ Cang Xuan was bamboozled.
‘This is the Heavenly Punishment Thunder Tribulation that has already been evoked and brewing. He was even locked on by the power of the heavens. How can he still escape?’ Cang Xuan was shocked.
The Eye of Thunder Tribulation also began to dissipate quickly. This meant that all traces of the target had been lost.
Cang Xuan was not the only one that was soaked, so were Dongfang Changqing, and all the experts who arrived.
For a brief moment, they were in dead silence.
“Everyone!” After a long time, Cang Xuan glanced at those of the Tai Xuan Gate, Sacred Sect and the God Clan that rushed over and said solemnly, “The Saint Lord is in cultivation retreat, and he won’t be coming out of it unless it is the last resort. But now, we are facing a powerful enemy from the outside world. Although he is merely of the feeble generations, he destroyed the Heaven Court in one blow. Moreover, he even managed to silently flee even when he was locked on by the power of heavens. This shows a fact that the opposing party has terrifying special abilities and are of great background. It is likely that he will be returning in the future, leading an army to attack our chiliocosm!”
“I need to rebuild the Heaven Court! I also need the help of fellow Taoists!”
Cang Xuan cupped his hands.
“The ministries are with Your Majesty!”
Dongfang Changqing was the first to make a statement.
The experts of the three major forces pondered for a long time, took in various information of what had transpired and finally nodded in agreement.
…
Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak.
As he stood on the balcony and looked at the sunset, he let out a breath of relief.
To go out in the early morning and return in the evening.
What happened that day was quite eventful.
Originally, he felt that Ye Qingxian was in danger. Upon arriving there, the Stone Mansion that was located over there was destroyed; he was then invited to the Heaven Court, but ended up destroying the Heaven Court.
“I’m really a star of disaster!”
A strange expression flashed through Jiang Ming’s face.
As he looked into the sky, he saw the Auction House on top of Tianyuan Sea. There were many experts who came out of it one after another. Some were happy and nervous as they turned into light streams, swiftly leaving the place right after. Some of them were gloomy, as they locked on to those who initially left and went on a chase.
“The auction has actually ended!” Jiang Ming was speechless.
“Senior Brother!” Junior Sister Phoenix came over and hugged his arm, swaying his arm between her two humps as she pouted, “Why did you go off so long this time? I’ve been waiting for you and didn’t even attend the auction! You have to compensate me!”
“What sort of compensation?”
“Senior brother, you know well how to!”
“I don’t!”
“You do!”
“I really don’t!”
“Then I’ll teach you how!”
Junior Sister Phoenix’s eyebrows perked up. Just as she was about to sit on top of Jiang Ming like Yu Ji on a lotus, she saw Mountain Master Tian Yuan rushing over with a shocked expression on his face.
She pouted in dissatisfaction, turned her head and returned to her room.
“What’s the matter with your Junior Sister today?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan didn’t know what happened, “Brother, could it be that you two are in a fight?”
“She’s just throwing a tantrum. Just ignore her!” Jiang Ming smiled, motioned for him to sit down. He brewed a pot of Immortal tea, poured two cups, and asked, “Big brother, I didn’t go up into the auction house. How was it?”
“Brother, to think that you didn’t attend such a big event! This surprised me!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan knew that Jiang Ming was mysterious and unpredictable. As such, he didn’t ask any further questions, but smiled and said, “The items auctioned are really unique. Some of them are unheard of, some of the elixirs auctioned had unimaginable effects and they even took out a Demi-Sage weapon. Unfortunately, there weren’t any forces that could afford the price.”
He continued to slowly explain while drinking the Immortal tea.
For example, there was the Nine-Reincarnation Golden Pill. Once a person consumed the pill, it would allow the person to directly reach the Great Overarching Realm but the person could never improve further after that. His cultivation realm would stop there for the rest of his life and would be the weakest Great Overarching Golden Immortal at that. Even so, it made many experts go crazy for it.
There was also the enslaved Bi Jiu. Although he was a demon Venerate, he was still placed in auction and was bought off by the Vermillion Bird with great hatred.
“The most special item of all was a set of Nine-Nine-to-One Infinite Array Formation. Based on the introduction, it is necessary to use complete sets of Dao Vessels to be evoked and that the units need to be in the multiplications of nine. The more Dao vessels used to evoke the array formation, the greater the power it produces. If nine Great Overarching Dao Vessels were to be used to form the array formation and that they fit perfectly, there is even the possibility of killing a Demi-Sage with it; if 81 Great Overarching Dao Vessels are used to evoke the array formation, it can entrap those of the Saint Lords; if nine Venerate Dao Vessels are used, then it can even kill a Saint Lord!” As Mountain Master Tian Yuan explained, his face was filled with shock. “I don’t know whether the specific effect is true, but it was auctioned off to the Heavenly Buddha.”
“By the way, Yu Fei asked me to send you a message that there will be a Venerate Conference held tomorrow on the Southern side of Tian Yuan Sea. She was hoping that you will attend!”
As he passed the message, Mountain Master Tian Yuan had a weird look on his face.
“Yu Fei?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing, “Why? Is she going to be inheriting the throne of the Heavenly Emperor? Will those old people even agree to it?”
“From the looks of her confident demeanor, they might really agree!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled. “After all, Yu Fei is recognized as the number one beauty in the infinite worlds and has many great friends in the Fo Sect, the Dragon Clan, the Demon Holy Palace and many more!”
He emphasized the word “great friends” a lot.
“If that’s the case, let’s just go and enjoy the fun!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile.
If Yu Fei really ascended onto the throne of the Heavenly Emperor, it would be a great joke to the world.
No, it should be that there would be loads of eventful happenings from it.
“Haha! It will definitely be very lively!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan couldn’t help laughing.
They agreed to go together tomorrow and Mountain Master Tian Yuan returned to his residence.
‘Ascending to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor by throwing yourself to the world?’
As he thought of this, Jiang Ming couldn’t help shaking his head even with his temperament.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - Three Thousand Chiliocosm Palm Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Three Thousand Chiliocosm Palm Technique
??
Just as Mountain Master Tian Yuan left, Junior Sister Phoenix came over. Without uttering a word, she leaped and landed on him.
Jiang Ming waved his hand; a thin mist loomed over and covered the entire balcony.
Within the turbulence in the mist, the air was surging with the smell of the ocean.
At dawn the very next day, Jiang Ming made breakfast while holding Junior Sister Phoenix in his arms.
Hence, he was left with only a hand while cooking and eating.
“Ding! Congratulations to the host for learning to cook with one hand. Rewarded with the special ability, Three Thousand Chiliocosm Palm Technique!”
As Jiang Ming took in the information on the special ability, he couldn’t help but be impressed.
After comprehending the Three Thousand Chiliocosm Technique, he could conjure 3,000 arms and launch palm attacks simultaneously. Each palm would contain a different kind of Dao.
In other words, it was 3,000 hands equipped with a total of 3,000 Daos.
That was not all. Even more frightening was that the 3,000 Daos were interconnected, complementing each other and forming a superimposed power.
As the special ability was evoked, there was nothing rivaling it.
‘This is definitely a special ability above Saint Dao!’ Jiang Ming had made his own judgment on the technique.
This special ability was too powerful. For the time being, this special ability even exceeded the power of the Infinite Transcendence Technique.
However, this was only temporary.
‘I’ll try to exercise and cook with ten junior sisters in one go next time. The reward at that time should be at least of the great Dao!’
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but look forward to it.
As the slap fell, the surrounding mist trembled.
“Are you full yet?”
“Yes, I am!”
“Then why aren’t you leaving?”
“Hmph! I’m still eating!”
“Oh! You’re still thinking of having the next meal after eating the last meal. Are you trying to exhaust me to death?”
“If you’re dead from exhaustion, I’ll just find another one!”
“You’re looking for a beating!”
“Hehe! Please do!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He reluctantly threw her out.
Junior Sister Phoenix ignited a ball of flame in the air. Standing in the middle of the ball of flame, she looked like a flame elf, twisting and turning her hips.
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up.
“Senior Brother, do you want to try it in flames?”
“It seems good!”
“Come on then!”
“Ahem. Let’s make it another day! Another day!”
Jiang Ming turned around and looked in the direction of the Tianyuan Sea.
However, various images appeared one after another in his mind.
Junior Sister Phoenix smiled. As the flames subsided, turning into a red dress, she landed in the Immortal Medicine Garden. She just looked over at the residence where Xi Yao was, shook her head, and whispered, “Why torture yourself!”
After landing in the garden, she quickly began her cultivation practice.
Jiang Ming, on the other hand, rose into the air.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan could be seen coming over toward him.
The two walked together and soon came to the Auction House.
High above the Auction House, Riyue Changfeng was, as always, still drinking his tea. As he looked at the two of them arriving, he couldn’t help but raise his glass and smile. “Brother Jiang! I’m so disappointed that you didn’t come to my auction yesterday!”
“I was delayed!” Jiang Ming landed next to him and then said to Mountain Master Tian Yuan, “Big Brother, please go there first. I will join you later!”
“Alright!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan cupped his hands at Riyue Changfeng and left. However, he was a little uneasy at heart as he thought, ‘The relationship between these two is definitely not ordinary!’
Jiang Ming sat on the opposite side as if he was used to the place, picked up the teapot, and poured himself a cup of tea. “Brother Riyue! Now that the auction is over, when will you be going back?”
“There’s no hurry! No hurry at all!” Riyue Changfeng swirled the cup in his hand, and purple clouds could be seen rising above it. “Life is a long journey. Naturally, you have to find ways to enjoy it more. What’s more, I’ve exceeded the mission I was on with this trip of mine to the Honggu Great Chiliocosm. As such, it’s no hurry for me to return at all.”
“I really envy you. You can enjoy it freely after the completion of your mission!” Jiang Ming sighed.
Riyue Changfeng rolled his eyes. “Did I enjoy it as much as you? How many Venerates have you done for your enjoyment!”
“I just want to take it slow and bask in the sun. Unfortunately, things are never what I want!”
“Brother Jiang, why do I have the urge to beat someone up by listening to your words?”
The two chatted casually.
As for the meeting held by Yu Fei, Jiang Ming didn’t have much interest in it.
Riyue Changfeng suddenly swept his hands across the sky. A divine luminance circulated around, sealing off the surroundings. Even after doing so, he still transmitted his messages telepathically. “Brother Jiang, the most valuable things I have here with me are items that contain the origin of the world, items that hold authority, items that symbolize status, and items that carry status. Do you want to trade for them?”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing.
Jiang Ming knew from Riyue Changfeng’s tone of voice that he was trying to test him again. But Riyue Changfeng did have the intention to make a trade as well.
Jiang Ming didn’t care either.
“What are you trading with?” Jiang Ming picked up the teacup and drank it all in one gulp.
“Well…”
Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help trembling in his heart.
From Jiang Ming’s words, he understood that Jiang Ming had obtained the various artifacts after the so-called falling of the Heavenly Emperor.
He trusted that the palm of the Heavenly Emperor, which hit through the Abyss, came from the person in front of him. And he believed that the death of the Great Demon Venerate and Tai Jian in the Saint Demon Lord’s secret realm was most probably his doings.
Riyue Changfeng had no idea how he did it. But he immediately thought of Jiang Ming’s identity as the inheritor of the Supreme Pagoda, which was a place of wonder.
Suppressing the waves of emotions in his heart, Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help but smile bitterly. “It seems that it is really difficult for me to name a price. However...
“Brother Jiang will not be disappointed with our next transaction.” Riyue Changfeng said, “I can give you at least five times the equivalent worth in exchange for these items. The more, the better.”
“The more, the better?” Jiang Ming thought of the Heavenly Emperor of the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm.
“Of course!” Riyue Changfeng was excited. This person was, sure enough, a big customer of his.
“In that case, you’ll have to sanctify your Dao as soon as possible and gather more treasures!” Jiang Ming smiled. “You should know what I need—Saint Weapons, long river of innate vital essence, long river of chaotic vital essence, Hongmeng’s essence, innate spiritual roots, Chaos spiritual root, Top Grade Immortal veins, and such.”
“Listening to the tone of your voice, it seems that I won’t necessarily be able to sanctify my Dao before you.” Riyue Changfeng looked at Jiang Ming with a complicated expression.
Looking at this little fellow in front of him, he was only a few decades old in reality. What about Riyue Changfeng himself?
Putting that aside, what about the cultivation realm?
Jiang Ming was of the Golden Immortal Realm, and yet how many Venerates had he slain? Even Tai Jian, the Great Demon Venerate, the Supreme Treasure of the Heavenly Emperor, and such. Nine out of ten of them might have been of his doings.
How incredible were these?
Once Jiang broke the shackles of his inner world and improved a step further, there would be no obstacle for him toward Saint Dao. He would almost be able to directly reach such a level.
In addition to his background, it didn’t seem to be difficult at all.
“Let us compete then!” Jiang Ming suddenly blurted.
Jiang Ming had never thought that he couldn’t achieve the Saint Realm. It was just a matter of time for him.
“Haha! Alright!” Riyue Changfeng laughed. “Let’s make a gentleman’s agreement! Let’s see who is faster on the road toward Saint Dao!”
After chatting for a while longer, Jiang Ming left.
The South wasn’t far. It was just at the coast of the Tianyuan Sea.
Many Venerates had gathered there. There were those who Jiang Ming knew of and those who he didn’t. Among them was the Immortal Venerate Tai Yin.
When Jiang Ming saw one of them, he couldn’t help but feel weird.
‘Yet another avatar of the Heavenly Emperor. To think that he has been hiding so well. I really didn’t think of it! As expected of Immortal Emperor Tai Yuan! I admire you! I truly do! You haven’t sanctified the way of Dao not because you can’t do it yourself but because of the world’s shackles. If I wasn’t here, you might be able to break the world’s shackles and step into the Saint Realm with your plans!’
Jiang Ming lamented. He really admired this Immortal Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - Hall of Human Emperor: Entanglement in the Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Hall of Human Emperor: Entanglement in the Past
Jiang Ming flipped through the Human Path Record.
Name: Chong Shan (one of Tai Yuan’s avatars)
Race: Purple-eyed Demon Cow
Gender: Male
Cultivation: Quasi-Sage
Background: One of the avatars of Tai Yuan in the Honggu Heavenly Realm, the Great Monarch of the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan
Relationships: 48
Innate Talent: Quasi-Sage
Status
: At the beginning of time immemorial, a demonic bull known for its strength was born. Born with the innate power of controlling the law of power, he was equipped with infinite strength and invincible defense.
: Born with purple eyes, he could see through illusions. The two horns on his legs could penetrate even the sky.
: He was born with the information in his mind that he was a Purple-eyed Demon Cow and that his name was Zhi Jin.
: In ancient times, he fought throughout the world and even fought against the Saint Lords who had not yet sanctified their Daos, making a great name for himself. Later on, he created the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan with his own blood by chance and became their Great Monarch.
......
: He later failed to snatch the great encounters of sanctifying Dao and was severely injured. As he was on the verge of death, he announced that his retreat into seclusion was to search for a way for the further breakthrough of his cultivation in order to preserve the inheritance of the Purple-eyed Demon Cow. However, he unexpectedly discovered the birthplace of the innate Yin and Yang energy. As such, he integrated his own blood essence and soul remnant to form an unborn child, hoping that the fusion of the innate Yin and Yang energy would allow him to be reborn.
: Who would have thought that when the opportunity for his rebirth was near, Tai Yuan would discover the traces of his rebirth? When Tai Yuan saw the two energies of Yin and Yang, his heart was in great shock, and a scheme was formed in his heart. He directly destroyed the will of Zhi Jin in the primordial embryo and cut out a portion of his own soul. He merged the portion of his soul into the embryo, using it to create an avatar of himself. His main body used a supreme technique to help his avatar integrate the Yin and Yang energies.
: After a long time, Tai Yuan’s avatar was born and named Chong Shan. Not only did his avatar inherit Zhi Jin’s heritage, but he also integrated the innate Yin and Yang power, giving him control of innate Yin and Yang special abilities.
: Even the pair of purple eyes became even more mysterious. They were able to pierce through the void and see through a person’s essence. Looking through the nine heavens and peering into the abyss were nothing of difficulty.
: The two horns on the top of the head, one black and the other white, represented the attributes of Yin and Yang. They contained terrifying power and bore the powers of Yin and Yang.
: With the help of his main body, Chong Shan’s cultivation soared rapidly, allowing him to reach the Quasi-Sage Realm after hundreds of millions of years. He then returned to the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan.
: Around that time, Zhi Jin’s disappearance was far too long, and his aura imprint in the world had disappeared without a trace. Some peerless experts speculated that this incomparably powerful great monarch had fallen. This in turn caused many forces and races who Zhi Jin had oppressed prior to his disappearance to become restless. After testing out their speculations a few times, they launched a genocide war against thePurple-eyed Demon Cow Clan.
: Upon seeing the imminent danger that loomed over his clan, Zhi Jin rushed back, annihilated the intruding enemy in one fell swoop, and at the same time evoked his bloodline to reveal his identity to the public. As such, he naturally became the Great Monarch of the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan.
: However, with the increasingly prosperous ruling of the Saint Lord’s lineage, these ancient clans had less and less space to survive. In the end, they resorted to hiding from the world together with the other nine ancient races under the impetus of Chong Shan. They then secretly accumulated their strength, waiting for the opportunity of their reemergence.
: The ten ancient races expanded all over the world. Not only were they helping each other, but they were also wary of each other.
: Chong Shan, however, had a different plan of his own. He wanted to tie the remaining clans onto his war chariot.
: He used alchemy, tool refinement techniques, preaching of special abilities, great skills, and overwhelming courage to overwhelm the other nine major races one after another. Although they did not fully submit to him, they still regarded him as their leader.
: With the ever-changing shifts of the sun and moon, time flew by.
: The ten major races remained dormant throughout. Although their cultivation resources had decreased, their growth was not slow at all as many experts were brought to the world in large numbers. The experts of the clan were also beginning to become eager but were all suppressed by Chong Shan.
: This phenomenon continued right until now. With Tai Yuan’s scheme to dominate the world, their time had come.
: During the effort of hunting down the Great Demon Venerate, they did not hurry to make their appearance as they were afraid of the Abyss and the other schemes by other forces. They unexpectedly found out the news about two Taishang Sword Sect’s Great Monarchs being killed by Jiang Ming. This surprised Tai Yuan. As such, he continued to keep this avatar of himself hidden and continued waiting. He then overheard about Tai Jian’s death in the secret realm of the Saint Demon Lord, the news about the Great Demon Venerate dying tragically, and the sudden disappearance of the Holy Dao Vessels. Feeling weird from these occurrences, he started suspecting that there might be other peerless experts lurking in the dark and was prepared to investigate further before making a move.
: However, neither his true self nor his avatars, Venerate Tai Yin and Chong Shan, were able to find out who was the one who had killed Tai Jian in the secret realm of the Demon Saint Lord.
: After the auction, Yu Fei convened a meeting of the Venerates to discuss the candidates for the Heavenly Emperor. He knew that his opportunity had arisen.
: The peerless experts of the ten great ancient races quietly arrived at the meeting venue.
Upon reading this, Jiang Ming was greatly shocked. He didn’t expect that Tai Yuan’s third avatar would be of such a big background.
The Great Monarch of the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan competed with the Saint Lords back then and died tragically. Just as he was about to merge with the innate Yin and Yang energy to live a second life, Tai Yuan snatched this great opportunity of his.
With that said, Chong Shan’s heritage and potential were much stronger than that of Zhi Jin.
After all, he had inherited everything from the other party and merged with the innate Yin and Yang energy.
‘There is also the Dao of the law of power!’ Jiang Ming sighed.
Alas, to think that the law of power actually existed.
In the mythology of the prehistoric world of the Honggu Realm, the law of power was a Dao that overwhelmed time and space. Hence, the strongest and most invincible. Even Pan Gu had used this power to split open the sky and break all laws.
‘Cang Xuan, the Heavenly Emperor of the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm, is lacking a lot comparatively speaking.’
Just when he was thinking about this, he discovered Chong Shan looking over his way.
He had a burly physique, black and white horns on the top of his head, and a pair of purple eyes. At first glance, he didn’t look like a good person, but his aura was restrained, which caused others to find it difficult to see through him.
Chong Shan smiled and nodded at Jiang Ming in a very kind manner.
Jiang Ming later paid tribute as well.
At that moment, Mountain Master Tian Yuan paced toward Jiang Ming in the air. His expression was a little unnatural as he hesitantly called out, “Brother!”
“Big Brother, with our friendship that exceeds the shackles of life-and-death, there’s nothing that we can’t discuss!” Jiang Ming laughed.
He already had some guesses in his heart.
“In the world of life, there are always some entanglements in relationships.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan did not dawdle anymore and said directly, “Some peerless experts of the human race invited you over. They’re just right there!”
He glanced in the southeast direction.
“Why didn’t they come over themselves?” Jiang Ming asked in confusion.
“Why else if not because of your previous unyielding attitude? They are afraid that they might cause you to feel disgusted if they come over.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan almost rolled his eyes in response.
Jiang Ming smiled, “Let’s go, Big Brother! Such is inevitable!”
“Alright!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan led him over in the air.
More and more peerless experts gathered, forming small groups in twos and threes.
There were even some Great Overarching Golden Immortals who overheard the news and came over. However, no matter how profound their backgrounds were, they never stepped into the circle of the Venerates.
After all, they would be rejected to join them as they hadn’t reached the level.
It didn’t take long for the two of them to arrive near the human experts. There were three of them.
As soon as Mountain Master Tian Yuan waved his hand, he sealed off the surrounding area before he began to make introductions. “This is the Great Monarch Wan Lian. The Infinite Alchemy Pavilion in the human realm is his inheritance!”
The other two were Immortal Venerate Tai Xu and Immortal Venerate Qing Yun.
“Good to see my fellow Taoists!” Jiang Ming cupped his hands and greeted.
However, his heart slightly skipped a beat.
In the former human realm, there was an Infinite Alchemy Pavilion, and here in front of him was the Great Monarch Wan Lian.
In the human world, there were the Taixu Sect and Qingyun Sect. In front of him now were Immortal Venerate Tai Xu and Immortal Venerate Qing Yun.
Jiang Ming was surprised at the coincidence.
Seemingly to have anticipated Jiang Ming’s doubts, Mountain Master Tian Yuan continued to explain, “The Taixu Sect and Qingyun Sect of the human realm can be regarded as the inheritance of these two. However, with their forbearance characters, you might not have paid attention to them!”
“Do the other sects also have Immortal Venerates?” asked Jiang Ming.
“If there were so many Immortal Venerates, how could our human race still be as scattered!” Great Monarch Wan Lian smiled. “We’ve met before!”
Jiang Ming cupped his hands yet again.
This person did appear back then but remained in the shadows. Although he did not make a move that time, he was also a deterrent to the situation. “You were the one who destroyed my inheritance in the Human Realm?” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s tone was a little indifferent.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned, while Great Monarch Wan Lian’s face turned gloomy.
“What? Do you want revenge?” Jiang Ming laughed instead.
He was actually a little curious about Immortal Venerate Qing Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - Jiang Ming: I spat a mouthful of blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Jiang Ming: I spat a mouthful of blood
Looking at the three people in front of him, Jiang Ming had a general idea of them.
They were the elders of the Hall of Human Emperor.
Alas, the Hall of Human Emperor, an existence since ancient times. They wanted to integrate the forces of the human race into one. In the past, the Hall of Human Emperor was one of the most powerful forces in the world. However, they were targeted by the Saint Lords and quickly disintegrated before disappearing into history.
The only thing about the Hall of Human Emperor that remained was its will.
Some human experts secretly banded together. As they stayed hidden from the world and focused hard on their cultivation, they were patiently waiting for their opportunity to reappear in the world and integrate the forces of the human race.
When the Saint Lords left for the Chaos, the Heaven Court was already established. During that time, the Hall of Human Emperor re-emerged in the world but was severely suppressed. Most of the experts they manage to gather ended up dead as well, causing them to stay dormant from the world.
A hundred million, billions, and tens of billions of years passed. It was to the point that people had already lost track of time.
During their ascetic cultivation, the great monarchs such as Wan Lian were not willing to be cooped up like this. As a result, the few of them left their inheritance in every planar world, hoping to unearth some geniuses of the human race.
Many forces, such as the Infinite Alchemy Pavilion of the Tianyuan World, originated from this.
Of course, some forces of the Heavenly Realm left their inheritance in the human realm as well.
This continued until one day when an earth-shattering battle took place in the Infinite Realm Battlefield: A boy of the human race defeated the Northern Emperor Kun Peng and was even placed on a 100-years trial by the Heavenly Emperor. Upon passing the trial, he would be able to succeed the authority of the Northern Emperor.
Upon receiving such news, they immediately wondered if there was a force that was targeting their Hall of Human Emperor and was trying to lure them out to catch them all in one swoop.
Great Monarch Wan Lian confirmed that the rumors were true.
Upon the confirmation, they were immediately excited and were prepared to invite Jiang Ming to join the Hall of Human Emperor. In addition, there was also Mountain Master Tian Yuan to be invited as well.
However, being secluded from the world for such a long time had caused them to become extremely conservative. They continued to observe Jiang Ming from the sides.
Later on, Yu Fei gave Jiang Ming a hard time, leading to his great battle that shocked the world.
His capability finally tempted them. As such, they contacted Mountain Master Tian Yuan to use him as a middleman and informed Jiang Ming about their decision to elect Jiang Ming as the Human Emperor in the future.
To elect Jiang Ming in the future? Not one of the elders of the hall of Human Emperor came forward when he was in trouble at that time. Hence, Jiang Ming turned down the offer immediately.
In the Abyss, Jiang Ming had fought against the three Great Monarchs of the Taishang Sword Sect. As a result, two of them were killed, and even Tai Jian was almost killed too.
They knew that they couldn’t wait any longer. They had to directly elect Jiang Ming as the Human Emperor now.
To directly elect Jiang Ming by just passing the message to him? Jiang Ming refused the offer sternly and even warned them not to disturb his life again.
Even Jiang Ming didn’t expect that during this Venerates Conference held by Yu Fei, three Venerates of the Hall of Human Emperor would turn up and were of unfathomable cultivation realm.
According to the Human Path Record, there were another two Venerates, making up a total of five Venerates in the Hall of Human Emperor.
As for those of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal? There were quite many of them.
Hence, the Hall of Human Emperor was already an extremely terrifying force.
However, the strongest among them were but only of the later stage of the Quasi-Sage. As for the three in front of him now, they were merely in the initial stage of the Quasi Sage Realm.
“It’s not about revenge!” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s tone was still very indifferent. “The purpose of establishing sects and leaving inheritance was to nurture experts of our human race. During such a period, combat and death is unavoidable and is also the only way to lead a person onto the path of the peerless. However, you should not have killed all of them.
“It’s alright to kill, but you should’ve at least ensured their inheritance or legacy remained!
“A legacy is like a ball of flame. As long as the flame remains ablaze, civilization will never be extinguished. Our human race will then have the opportunity to continue to rise!
“A ball of flame might be little, but once many gather, it can even burn down the sky, turning into an unstoppable force!
“To unite with others in fights and to fight in between unity!
“Jiang Ming, now that your strength is among the best, it’s time for you to contribute some back to our human race!
“You are of the human race, after all. Human blood flows in your body!
“It’s fine when you didn’t have the ability back then. But now that you do, you naturally have to stand up!”
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun couldn’t stop as soon as he started preaching.
In response to Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s remark, Jiang Ming merely smiled and said, “You have so many great remarks one after another. So let me ask you. Have you stood up yet?”
Through Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s Status, Jiang Ming learned that this person wasn’t of bad interest to him and was taking the rise of the human race as his responsibility.
However, Immortal Venerate Qing Yun wanted the rise of the human race to be based on the inheritance of the Hall of Human Emperor as its foundation and principle. And based on the will of the Hall of Human Emperor.
He came forth this time to persuade Jiang Ming to take over the authority of the Hall of Human Emperor and inherit the will of the Hall of Human Emperor. At the same time, he would be restrained by a group of elders.
In short, he just wanted Jiang Ming to stand in the limelight.
As for the other things to be taken care of? The elders had already made plans.
As for the way to convince him? It was by oppressing him with righteousness.
In the face of righteousness, could he still disobey and not comply? It would be outrageous if he was to do so.
However, Jiang Ming also discovered something.
There were actually two different views among them on him taking on the throne of the Human Emperor.
One of them was led by Elder Yuan, who was at the later stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm. He wanted Jiang Ming to inherit the throne of the Human Emperor and then act according to the will of the inheritance.
Another was led by Great Monarch Wan Lian. He thought that since they wanted Jiang Ming to take over the throne as the Human Emperor, they should submit to Jiang Ming as their leader, although with some resources that were restricted from him.
Unfortunately, this influence of Great Monarch Wan Lian was far too weak to the point that in so many instances where he wanted to take the initiative to invite Jiang Ming over, he had to request Mountain Master Tian Yuan to speak on behalf of him to be safe.
“In the past hundreds of millions of years, I have nurtured three Great Overarching Golden Immortals and countless Taiyi and Golden Immortals!” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun looked gloomy. He was very displeased with Jiang Ming questioning him.
“That’s it?” Jiang Ming chuckled lightly.
“Isn’t that enough?” Immortal Venerable Qing Yun flicked his sleeves and snorted coldly. “I also secretly sheltered at least a trillion of the human race!”
“To be complacent with only this little achievement through hundreds of millions of years. I feel ashamed for you!” Jiang Ming’s smile gradually became indifferent. “If you want to oppress me with reasons and righteousness, then you must first stand on it yourself. Come then. Let me ask you. What have I achieved?”
“Your achievement?” Immortal Venerable Qing Yun frowned. “Destroying the Tian Yuan Realm. That should count as your achievement!”
Great Monarch Wan Lian grinned and couldn’t help but turn his head.
Immortal Venerate Tai Xu, on the other hand, looked down at his feet.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan gave a wry smile and thought, ‘Qing Yun, oh Qing Yun! I know you are old-fashioned and narrow-minded, but not to this extent!’
“I killed the Devil King of the Abyss and fought off the invasion of the Immortals in the Human Realm!” Jiang Ming lost his interest and said bluntly, “After I ascended into this realm here, I joined hands with Brother Tian Yuan and killed Bei Minghai, took down Kun Peng, destroyed the Demon Venerate of the Abyss, and many more. From the several battles, the number of Venerates that I’ve killed might be at least six! Qing Yun, how many Venerates have you killed? How many Venerates has the Hall of Human Emperor killed from ancient times to the present? Come on! Tell me!”
Jiang Ming gradually increased his voice as he spoke.
Great Monarch Qing Yun’s face suddenly turned ugly. He realized that he had miscalculated about Jiang Ming. He really did.
This junior was too disrespectful to the seniors and didn’t take them seriously.
He originally wanted to suppress Jiang Ming with righteousness. As a result, he was instead suppressed.
Upon looking at Jiang Ming’s expression, it seemed that he might have perhaps made things worse.
‘God damn it! This is just a strategy of mine! Why is such a junior like you overreacting!?’
“That is why we are inviting you to become the Human Emperor!” Great Monarch Qing Yun suppressed his rage and responded honestly.
Jiang Ming opened his mouth and almost spat out a mouthful of blood at the remark.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - Tai Wuji
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Tai Wuji
Invitation to become the Human Emperor.
Such few words were as heavy as hundreds and thousands of mountains, words that hit directly at the core.
Jiang Ming was not the least surprised.
What was their intention to look for him? Wasn’t it just to make him the Human Emperor?
“For me to be the Human Emperor?” Jiang Ming showed a slight smile on his face and continued. “Are you for real?”
“Of course!” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun also had a smile on his face.
‘Little guy! Can’t hold back anymore, can you? Alas, the Human Emperor! The emperor of billions of human beings! What glory! What authority! What status! Who can resist such a temptation? No one! Absolutely no one. Not even himself.’
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun believed that Jiang Ming had turned down the offer last time to show restraint. It was mostly because Jiang Ming thought he understood his lack of strength and knew that he didn’t qualify for the throne. Jiang Ming knew he lacked the courage to take on the corresponding responsibility that came with the throne.
But now?
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun personally invited him! How prestigious was this?
If Jiang Ming still didn’t clearly see what was happening and allowed himself a way out of the skirmish, he might really miss this opportunity! How could Jiang Ming not be anxious?
Jiang Ming was young and, thus, not steadfast enough. Hence, Immortal Venerate Qing Yun would just wait till he became the Human Emperor to be mentored.
Jiang Ming’s expression became stranger and stranger.
......
The Human Path Record was suspended on the Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s forehead, showing his Status, or to be exact, his thoughts.
The Human Path Record was being mischievous.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun even more so.
“Are you sure?” Jiang Ming asked again, smiling brightly.
“I’m very sure!” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun nodded solemnly, but he almost laughed out of his heart.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun wondered how this little guy could be so child-like. But that made it even more interesting.
A hint of doubt flashed across Great Monarch Wan Lian’s face. From his understanding of Jiang Ming based on his series of actions, he should not have agreed so easily.
Immortal Venerate Tai Xu was wondering why the uneasy feeling in his heart became stronger.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan secretly sighed. Based on his understanding, the more this Little Brother of his acted like this, the more indifferent he actually was in his heart. Just watch. He would definitely turn against Immortal Venerate Qing Yun next.
“Since you really want me to be the Human Emperor, that’s great!” Jiang Ming put his hands behind his back, restrained his smile, and showed a cold look on his face. “The Human Emperor is the supreme ruler of the human race, the sovereign, and the person above all. Within the human race, his words would be akin to laws that were to be followed. Immortal Venerate Qing Yun! Please make a move against the Taishang Sword experts now.”
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s face turned gloomy. He looked at Jiang Ming, and after a long time, he said, “The Taishang Sword Sect no longer has an Immortal Venerate. If I attack them, I will be the bully!”
“There isn’t any? The Hall of Human Emperor was established in ancient times and has barely maintained itself to this day. Although you have all shunned the world and cultivated in seclusion, you wouldn’t really shy away from the world and ignore the outside world at all, right?” Jiang Ming sneered. “Other than Tai Jian, the Taishang Sword Sect also has a Venerate who is already here. Did you see it? It’s the silver-haired man from the west. His name is Tai Wuji.”
Great Monarch Wan Lian suddenly chimed in. “Tai Wuji? I’ve heard of him. According to rumors, he is the last disciple of the Saint Lord and extremely talented. In terms of his talents in the Sword Dao, he is no weaker than the Saint Lord himself. His aptitude is terrifying.
“He had always been cultivating silently. In the very few times he had made a move, he already had a monstrous reputation. He killed a Taiyi expert when he was a Golden Immortal, killed a Great Overarching expert when he was a Taiyi Immortal, and even beheaded a Venerate when he was at the pinnacle of the Great Overarching Realm. It is said that after he reached the realm of the Venerate, he was already well above Tai Jian.
“There are rumors that when the Saint Lord left, he followed along as well. He has not appeared for hundreds of millions of years. Everyone thought that he had left! Why is he still staying in the sect?”
Great Monarch Wan Lian had a solemn look on his face.
“Is it really him?” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun didn’t look good.
“Since my brother said so, it must be true!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s tone of voice was very affirmative. This also hinted to the few in front of him that: This here was his old brother. A person that would be advancing and retreating together with him.
“Immortal Venerate Qing Yun, please!” Jiang Ming said again.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun’s face turned even uglier and even showed a bit of annoyance. “Aren’t you just trying to humiliate me?”
“How is this humiliating you?”
“I’m obviously no match for him. Asking me to kill him, aren’t you just sending me to my death and humiliating me?”
“Heh! Aren’t there three of you Venerates?”
“Tai Wuji is the direct descendant of the Saint Lord. If we kill him, what will happen to us when the Saint Lord returns in the future? You won’t even need to think about what would happen! Jiang Ming, you are pulling my leg, aren’t you?”
“Hehe!” Jiang Ming sneered and said with a stern tone, “Pulling your leg? Qing Yun! When you didn’t know of Tai Wuji, I ordered you to kill the experts of the Taishang Sword Sect. You started to push away the responsibility for many reasons and even said you’d be a bully. What are you making of myself as the Human Emperor? You invited me to be the Human Emperor. Well, I agreed. This is my first request rather than an order, yet you refute it without hesitation! Now that you know of Tai Wuji, you are saying that I’m humiliating you!
“If you really see me as the Human Emperor, you will obediently die if I ask you to. This is the authority of the Human Emperor. If you really see me as the Human Emperor, then I will watch you march toward your own death!
“I killed two Venerates of the Taishang Sword Sect in the Abyss, and Tai Jian even almost died in my hands. As the “Human Emperor”, I’m not afraid of it myself, yet you are! Haha! You even said that you want me to be the Human Emperor! Qing Yun, you are the one pulling my leg!”
Killing intent could be seen ablaze in Jiang Ming’s eyes.
“Qing Yun!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan also sneered. “You’ve invited my brother to be the Human Emperor a few times already. What makes a Human Emperor? A person whose words carry supreme weight, a person with great prestige that can mobilize the forces of the human race with mere words. My brother has already agreed to it. Yet what did you do? As soon as the Human Emperor gave his decree, you refuted it and are now saying that you are humiliated. At the same time, you are afraid of the inheritance of the Saint Lord!
“Hmph! I didn’t join the Hall of Human Emperor back then because I saw that you guys have been hidden like tortoises for too long. So very long that you no longer have the overbearing prestige that we cultivators should have. You no longer have the confidence to really push the human race to the pinnacle!
“On the other hand, just look at my brother. In order to defend the Tianyuan Realm, he beheaded the Immortals and took down the Devil King. Where has he ever been afraid at all? Back then, it was still the mortal realm. What of the Immortals? High above!
“What about after descending into the Infinite Realm Battlefield? He slew Kun Peng, the Northern Emperor of the Heaven Court! Alas! Who would dare to provoke the Heaven Court? My brother did and even slew one of them!
“As for the Venerates of the Abyss? They were very united and could even stand up against the Heavenly Realm. But what of that? How many of their Demon Venerates were slain by my brother? More than half of them were killed by my brother. Even the Great Demon Venerate had to leave helplessly when he tried to intervene!
“When he was in the Abyss, he even forcibly cut down two Venerates of the Taishang Sword Sect! What strength has he shown? How courageous was he? Who can even compare to him among our human race?
“I’ll be blunt with this. Can the Hall of Human Emperor’s achievement from the past even compare to that of my brother here in just this year? It’s not even worth comparing!
“Besides, the relationship between my brother and the Taishang Sword Sect is already that of mortal enemies. Yet what about you? You are still afraid of the sect’s Saint Lord. If the Saint Lord returns, will you push him upfront to put up with the disaster?
“Hehe! Qing Yun, I’m ashamed to even side with you! From now on, this marks the end of the friendship between you and me!”
As Mountain Master Tian Yuan finished speaking, he turned his palm into a knife, slashing through the air and cutting open a void.
The expression of Immortal Venerate Qing Yun, as well as the other two, drastically changed.
“Remember! Never disrupt my life from now on. This also serves as the last reminder!” Jiang Ming’s indifferent tone changed as he smiled and added, “Big Brother! Let’s leave!”
“Alright!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - Yu Fei: Who Concurs, Who Opposes
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Yu Fei: Who Concurs, Who Opposes
In the end, Jiang Ming and Mountain Master Tian Yuan left.
Great Monarch Wan Lian opened his mouth and finally let out a long sigh. He was feeling somewhat disappointed. “The mortals often say that if you treat people with sincerity, people will treat you back with sincerity as well. If you are insincere, how do you expect people to treat you well?”
“What Jiang Ming and Mountain Master Tian Yuan said just now is true. We have been silent for far too long. We’ve long lost our fighting spirit and our motivation to improve. In fact, we no longer even dare to stand out in front of others!”
“What was the purpose of you wanting to invite Jiang Ming to be the Human Emperor? Did you really want him to be the Human Emperor? No! You just wanted him to stand in front of the stage and block off everything from the outside world. All so that you can continue hiding in a dark corner, a place where you feel you can charge forward or retreat as you wish to!”
“Yet, how many fools would there be in this world? Jiang Ming was only testing the waters with us. Yet, you’ve revealed the ugly side of you, Qing Yun!”
“From now on, there’s really no turning back!”
“Alas! The Hall of Human Emperor. Since it has remained coveted for such a long time, it might be better off to allow it to truly become a part of our history, a legend!”
“As long as Jiang Ming is around, even if he doesn’t take the initiative to do anything, our human race will still gradually straighten our spine because of him!”
“Guys…I won’t be going back to the Hall of Human Emperor anymore!”
Great Monarch Wan Lian’s body radiated light and soon enough, reached the other side. He was somewhat perplexed, yet inexplicably relaxed at the same time.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun opened his mouth and smiled bitterly. He looked at Immortal Venerate Tai Xu and asked, “Are we really wrong?”
“Whether we’re right or wrong, it doesn’t matter anymore. Does it?” Immortal Venerate Tai Xu’s voice became extremely ethereal. “Qing Yun, haven’t you realized it yet? Whether Jiang Ming admits to it or not, he has already stepped up onto the stage. He is already standing at the pinnacle, placing himself at the center of the storm. He has already become the idol to the hundreds and billions of our human race. It no longer matters whether he chooses to follow the flow of civilization or actively participate in the dispute. He will no longer be at peace!”
“He has already stepped forward! Didn’t he? To be or not to be the Human Emperor, is there still any meaning to it?”
“Alas! The Hall of Human Emperor! Since it has remained coveted for such a long time, let’s just allow it to sink into the depths and become the heritage to our human race. We’ll consider it as a precaution if anything happens!”
“That’s also the reason why I didn’t dissuade you just now, knowing that you would anger the two! Our goal has not failed!”
Immortal Venerate Tai Xu saw the matter from another perspective.
“That’s right!” Immortal Venerate Qing Yun nodded suddenly, and then sighed, “Now that you mention it, this makes me even more stupid!”
“Do you care?”
“Do I care? Haha!”
At a distance far away, Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled as he asked Jiang Ming, “Are you still angry?”
“I’m actually quite angry!” Jiang Ming said helplessly, “It didn’t matter whether I become a Human Emperor or if they show up. In fact, their goals can be achieved easily!”
“As expected of my brother, you’ve seen through such levels!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan nodded in relief. “Through the several great battles, you have really gained a firm foothold in the Heavenly Realm. Unless the Lord Buddha, Dragon Monarch and the likes join forces, they might only dare to make a move on you. Even so, they would be extremely cautious as well.”
“In this current time, you’ve become the strongest existence of our human race. You are the idol now, the legend, the myth!”
“Whatever the case is, you are already standing at the frontmost! Also, it won’t matter if you want it or not. You’d directly or indirectly influence many things in the future! Haha brother! You wanted to enjoy tranquility, yet you were so high-profiled when doing things. Let’s see how you’ll be able to enjoy tranquility in the future!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan couldn’t help gloating.
“Big brother!” Jiang Ming muttered softly, “You are also a member of the Tianyuan Realm. If something happens, you must be the first one to charge forth!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s breath suddenly stagnated as he said, “We must always respect the old!”
“And care for the young!” Jiang Ming retorted.
“You Jiang Ming! You must have schemed against me a long time ago!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was furious.
“Hehe! You’ve boarded the same pirate ship as I’m on. It’s difficult to disembark now!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“It’s really a pirate ship!” Mountain Master Tian yuan shook his head helplessly.
“Big brother, why did you have to completely sever your relationship just now?”
“I don’t want to be entangled in these trivial problems in the future! Even Great Monarch Wan Lian, who seemed to be annoyed and left, had also come to the same conclusion. Even Immortal Venerate Tai Xu saw through what happened. That was why he didn’t intervene at all. In the Hall of Human Emperor, there’s inevitably some peerless experts who are prideful, hiding in seclusion. If they heard about you not recognizing what’s good for you, there’s bound to be some among them that would go to the extreme. If such a time comes, I’ll be able to directly suppress the problem, without needing to scruple!”
“As the saying goes, an old man in the family is akin to a treasure! It’s really true!”
“Music to my ears!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan stroked his beard. He suddenly became serious and said, “Now that Tai Wuji has emerged, he will definitely cause trouble for us. Are you going to kill him?”
“Of course!”
“Alright then! Let’s take the initiative to attack. Find a chance to kill him entirely. We’ll then uproot Taishang Sword Sect after. Since they are the enemy, it’s better to not leave any behind. Wait till you step into the Saint Lord Realm, we’ll even kill the sect’s Saint Lord as well!”
“Big brother, you really dare to say such things!”
“It’s not that I dare to say so, but that I believe in you!”
“Alright then! In order to be worthy of your trust, big brother, I will have to reluctantly sanctify my Dao quickly.”
“Now that’s the right way to do it!”
The two chatted and laughed together.
As for the return of the Saint Lord of the Taishang Sword Sect? The both of them didn’t take it seriously at all.
If he were to return, they would just flee into the Chaos.
If they couldn’t escape, then it would just be death that awaits them. What was the big deal?
As time went by, numerous experts gradually arrived at the scene.
Among them were the Dragon Monarch, Heavenly Buddha, Vermillion Bird and many others.
One after another, the auras that shot through heavens had caused the time-space torrents outside of the domain to tremble non-stop. The vibration even created a million mile distance of area with pure vacuum.
The ground beneath their feet was seeming unable to withstand the gathering of so many peerless beings.
“Good gracious! There’s so many Venerate?” With just a glance, Jiang Ming could see that there were already more than a hundred people already.
However, it was clear that this was far from the limit.
Take the Dragon Clan for example, there were three Venerates that had arrived. And there were at least another three who didn’t come.
As for the rest of the ten great ancient races, how many Venerates would they have?
“The Heavenly Realm is way too vast, hidden with many peerless beings. Even I myself don’t know how many of these terrifying existences are hidden in the world!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan lamented and continued, “Take the Great Demon Venerate for example, who would’ve thought that he actually had twelve Venerates hidden under him. If it weren’t for the Heavenly Emperor, with the resources from the Abyss, even the Fo Sect could’ve been overturned!”
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement.
In fact, the Great Demon Venerate’s plans were already quite remarkable.
If he was in the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm, he could’ve fiddled the Heavenly Emperor Cang Xuan to death easily. It was unfortunate that he stumbled upon such a terrifying existence like Tai Yuan.
Looking across the vast world, Jiang Ming was afraid that other than himself, there was no one else who knew that the one that had died was merely an avatar, an avatar among three others.
Even Jiang Ming himself felt his scalp tingle from time to time thinking of this.
When everyone could no longer feel that there were other Venerates coming through the torrent of time and space, Yu Fei came out of the crowd.
Clad in a wide-sleeved immortal skirt with her blushed face and bare-footed, every sway of her body seemed to be able to evoke the “Law of Temptation”. Even the Venerates could feel their hearts trembling slightly.
Such beauty! Such deliciousness!
As everyone looked over at her, they could see different temperaments from her appearance that fit a perfect image of her deep in their subconscious.
She was like a beauty incarnate.
“Everyone, according to the Heavenly Emperor’s decree, the throne of the Heavenly Emperor belongs to whoever kills the Great Demon Venerate!” Yu Fei glanced around with a smile on the corner of her mouth. Her tone of voice was tactful and didn’t seem forceful at all, making the others feeling itchy at heart, “The Great Demon Venerate has fallen in my hands. Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch and Vermillion Bird can attest to that! I will now take up the position as the Heavenly Emperor. Who concurs and who opposes it?”
After hearing so much of what she had to say, Jiang Ming’s face couldn’t help revealing a little bit of astonishment.
That was just too direct! Wasn’t it?
However, with the alluring charm of Yu Fei, speaking directly like that was conversely even more charming.
“This woman! If placed on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, it would be enough to...”
A strange thought flashed through Jiang Ming’s mind.
He then looked over at Chong Shan.
It seemed that a great show was about to start soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Ten Ancient Clans: Xue Bing, Niu Er, Giant, Jin Hao, Shi Kuang
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Ten Ancient Clans: Xue Bing, Niu Er, Giant, Jin Hao, Shi Kuang
Yu Fei looked very arrogant. She stood at the center looking around with her eyes seemingly conveying different emotions to each expert. She was as though warning them not to object or she would punish them!
Many experts were disgusted but none of them spoke.
The venerates without a strong background were here as mere spectators. They were incapable of competing for the position as the Heavenly Emperor and they had no intention to do so either.
As for those strong forces? They didn’t want to be the first one to stand up against Yu Fei because she was of the righteousness this time. However, they wouldn’t let her become the Heavenly Emperor regardless.
“Are you guys acquiscented?” Yu Fei smiled. “All of you are indeed affectionate, and do obey morality and the power of order. In this case, from today onwards, I’ll be the…”
“Hold on!” Someone intervened Yu Fei before she could finish.
A woman was seen to have come forward. She was surrounded by green luminance, and perfectly grown. Her calm face looked as though she was extremely pure and cold at the same time.
“Are you having a different opinion?” Yu Fei frowned. She felt like scratching the woman’s face while she was looking at it.
“Of course!” The woman replied in an extremely indifferent voice. “You are a demon. Yet you wanted to call yourself an emperor. This is super ridiculous!”
“Demon is part of the world, the living things under the governance of the Heaven Court!” Yu Fei said.
“The Abyss has just betrayed the Heaven Court not long ago, and caused the death of the Heavenly Emperor. Demons are rebellious and sinful. Hence, must be punished with death penalty. Whether it is for the sake of justice or for taking revenge for the Heavenly Emperor, we have to thoroughly destroy the Abyss to maintain the righteousness of the Heaven Court. In this case, that person can only inherit the will of the Heavenly Emperor.” The woman sneered, “Look at what’s happened now? No one actually objects a demon from becoming a Heavenly Emperor? Haha, this is absolutely unbelievable!”
“The battle was initiated by the Great Demon Venerable, who insisted on doing his own thing. Now, the people of the abyss have set things right!” Yu Fei was not enraged but laughed. “I was the one who killed the Great Demon Venerate. Hence, I’ve represented the righteousness of the Heaven Court. Moreover, the Heavenly Emperor also said that whoever killed the Great Demon Venerate would be able to inherit the position as the Heavenly Emperor. And this is witnessed by millions of living things in the world and the universe!”
“Regardless of how eloquent you are, you can’t change the fact that you are essentially a demon of the Abyss yourself, nor can you change your evil innerself. Of course, you can’t even change the fact that you’ve caused miserable massacres across infinite realms when you pressured the demon soldiers of the Abyss to do so for you.” The woman pointed at Yu Fei and said sternly, “You are the demon of great sin, and should be castigated by all.”
......
“Yet, such a demon wanted to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor. Did you want to convert the land of infinite realms into a demonic domain so that nothing but massacre occurs throughout infinite realms?”
“Ladies and gentlemen, if you keep silent now, don’t complain when your sect, your clan or your other properties are being invaded by demons and transformed into a demonic domain!”
“The most critical question I have here is that if the Heavenly Emperor himself was able to anoint a successor himself, wouldn’t it be equivalent to the world of the mortal dynasty?”
“Haha! This is even more ridiculous, isn’t it?”
“The position as the Heavenly Emperor is the position of the most high, greatest, and most noble in the universe. Hence, he must have virtue, be convincing and powerful enough to take over the position!”
“Yu Fei, which of the three do you think you have?”
The woman spoke sonorously, and her voice turned into an incessant sound of killing.
She thereby attracted much attention, who nodded in agreement.
Although none of them spoke up, they naturally ostracized the Abyss, devils and demons. Moreover, they particularly agreed with the critical question she had thrown out regarding whether the Heavenly Emperor could anoint his successor. If this was the case, none of them thought they would be convinced themselves.
Yu Fei had a glimpse of killing intention. She roared, “I’ve used to travel through the universe, and I’ve seen all the venerates here before. But why didn’t I have any impression of you?”
“You’re such a frog at the bottom of the well!” The woman said while having a change in her temperament. She looked even more ethereal and holy as the green luminance around her turned frosty, and snowflakes encircled her.
The extreme cold had frozen the space to the point that the chain of frosty orders could be vaguely seen.
These incidents showed that the woman had chosen the Dao of Extreme Cold.
“I’m Xue Bing from the ancient Snow Spirit Clan!” The woman introduced herself.
Some experts were enlightened while some others became highly vigilant.
“I know about the Snow Spirit Clan. I thought you guys have gone into seclusion? Do you show up today because you want to compete for the position as the Heavenly Emperor?” Yu Fei revealed a cruel smile as she continued, “In the ancient time, your Snow Spirit Clan and other ancient clans had killed many experts of the current Sacred Lands. And I know that, Heavenly Buddha, Zhi Neng from your Fo Sect, was actually killed by the Snow Spirit Clan’s great monarch!”
“Amitabha!” Heavenly Buddha chanted before he turned to Xue Bing and said, “The fight that time had ended just like that because your entire clan has gone into seclusion. Now with your return, do you plan to take up the karma?”
“Haha!” A laugh rang out and a golden luminance abruptly blasted in the void, turning into a giant man. While having his arms crossed across his chest, he said to the Heavenly Emperor, “Without the Saint Lord around now, do you all want to dominate the world? Heavenly Buddha, do you know that we’re no longer in the old days? It’s now the period without any Saints! By the way, I’m Jin Hao from the Golden Spirit Clan!”
“The new should be replacing the old!” Along with the voice was a horrifying and deterrent aura transmitted over. A boundless and gigantic giant, who’s head touched heaven and his feet on the earth, came over in just a step. “I’m Giant from the Heaven Giant Clan, which is one of the ten ancient clans.”
“I’m Shi Kuang from the Three-Headed Golden Lion Clan, which is one of the ten ancient clans.”
“I’m Niu Er from Purple-eyed Demon Cow!”
The venerates from the ten ancient clans introduced themselves one after another.
In just a short while, a total of 10 experts, including Xue Bing, appeared. Their number corresponded to the ten ancient clans.
They stood in the middle of the crows as soon as they appeared. They looked around with disdain, enraging many experts present.
“Shi Kuang, you these fellas have actually shown up. Are you all not afraid that your clan would go extinct?” Dragon Monarch snorted.
“My clan goes extinct? Haha!” Shi Kuang guffawed as his golden hairs fluttered along with the wind. “Even the Saint Lord could do nothing to us in the old days, what’s more now!”
“Shameless!” Vermilion Bird said, “If you hadn’t gone into seclusion that time, where would there be the ten ancient clans! Shi Kuang, you were merely a little lion at that time. I thought you were being eaten up. I’ve never expected that you could grow up to the current realm. Do you think that you can be arrogant and presumptuous as a venerate? I’d just need to use a hand to kill you!”
“Vermilion Bird, you’re indeed very strong but…” Shi Kuang sneered, “The Holy Demon Palace, which was established by the Demon Saint, was so strong and glorious at that time. But as time passes by, how has it become? The Demon Venerate Bi Jiu was enslaved and even auctioned. Yet you this Palace Master couldn’t do even a thing. And when the Thousand Snake Demon Venerate was killed by Jiang Ming, did you do anything as the Palace Master?”
“Haha, a Palace Master of the Holy Demon Palace is actually hiding herself when her experts are killed one after another. Vermilion Bird, do you know that you’re far weaker than the Phoenix? What a shame! Even I myself feel ashamed of you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - The Domineering Jiang Ming was Killing as He Wished
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: The Domineering Jiang Ming was Killing as He Wished
Vermilion Bird was one of the top experts in the current world. She was of the same level as the Dragon Monarch, Heavenly Emperor, and the likes. She was domineering and strong, hence no one would dare to tease her like this.
“You’re looking for death yourself!” Vermilion Bird was furious. Her eyes turned red and she was burning with anger.
What Shi Kuang had pointed out was Vermilion Bird’s emotional scars. She couldn’t do anything even if she was to spend all the resources of her Holy Demon Palace because the man Demon Venerate Bi Jiu had offended was Riyue Changfeng. As for Jiang Ming, she couldn’t do anything too while confronting the long river of Dao vessels of his. Hence, she could only sulk herself.
That was why rage overtook Vermilion Bird when Shi Kuang brought up the matter.
In the distance!
Jiang Ming became curious as he was watching. So he asked Mountain Master Tian Yuan, “Big brother, I thought the 10 ancient clans are 10 golden clans?”
“Yes, they are of the Golden Clans!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan assured.
“How can the Snow Spirit Clan and the Heaven Giant Clan be the Golden Clans?”
“Haha, brother, you’re judging the book by its cover!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan startled before he couldn’t help but laugh. “Golden represents heaven, the nobility, and the everlasting. Golden Clan is a title they give themselves to show that they are the noble and everlasting clans!”
“What the f*ck!” Jiang Ming was absolutely speechless. He had never thought that the Golden Clans had such a meaning. Instead, he thought that they would be clans like the Golden Human-Lion Clan, and the Golden Peak Clan!
Anyway, Jiang Ming did think that the explanation of Mountain Master Tian Yuan was logical.
“Brother, the three words you’ve just said sounded very exciting, but after all, they are too vulgar!” As Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, his face became gloomy, “When these ancient clans show up during the occurrence of big events such as the fallen Heaven Court, the death of the Heavenly Emperor, and the great change in the Abyss, I’m afraid that the world is no longer peaceful.”
“Since when has the world been peaceful?” Jiang Ming laughed, “We’d just have to protect our Tianyuan Realm and watch this as a show. However, if they were to provoke us, we’ll give them no chance to return to where they’re coming from!”
“You’re domineering indeed!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up. “You’re right, we shall just enjoy the show! The greater the change, the less forces will dare to provoke you. Because whoever provokes you would be killed!”
“Let’s just enjoy the peace and not get involved in any conflicts!” Jiang Ming said, “I’m the one who would repay others’ respect with a tenfold return. But if it’s the other way round, I’d pay it back with 100 million times return!”
“Great, let’s pay it back with 100 million times return!” Even Mountain Master Tian Yuan was getting ecstatic.
When they were chatting, they didn’t transmit their voice through telepathy, nor did they isolate themselves. Hence, every expert had heard of their conversation.
They looked at them with a strange look.
What the f*ck! They had never expected that a broken piece of the mortal world, which had descended to their Infinite Realm Battlefield, would be so strong. It was strong enough to have killed a few venerates.
There were a few incidents that had happened regarding the Tianyuan Realm. Examples were the failed attack of Great Demon Venerate against Tianyuan Realm, the fear of Vermilion Bird to provoke, the almost destroyed Taishang Sword Sect, as well as the failed attack of Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, Vermilion Bird and other experts because of the long river of Dao vessels. These had somewhat created the legend that the Tianyuan Realm was a forbidden place because it was the burial place of venerates!
Tai Wuji looked over, and his eyes were filled with sword luminance. But he remained silent.
Vermilion Bird looked over, and burning flames in her eyes increased in intensity.
Immortal Venerate Tai Yin had a different expression while Chong Shan looked pensive.
Yu Fei walked over, and smiled. “Brother Jiang, you’re the Northern Emperor while I’m the Heavenly Emperor. Hence, we are a family and should get closer from now onwards.”
She winked and mobilized the order of charm which was directed to the depth of Jiang Ming’s heart. Even with his temperament, he couldn’t control his heart from beating fast twice for a moment.
It was only twice. With Jiang Ming’s will, there weren’t many who were comparable to him. Perhaps only the Heavenly Emperor and the Heavenly Buddha could be his match.
“I’m afraid that you’ll have a lot of troubles as a Heavenly Emperor!” Jiang Ming was smiling but it was a forced smile. He didn’t like Yu Fei at all. He would poke her without hesitation whenever he had opportunities.
Jiang Ming also understood what Yu Fei had said. The Heaven Court used to declare that he could take over the position as the Northern Emperor when he killed Beiming Kunpeng, who was the Northern Emperor at that time. Yu Fei was merely obeying the Heavenly Emperor’s order.
In fact, both Jiang Ming and Yu Fei were of the same line.
“Your sister, I, am the orthodox, whoever opposes me taking over the position as the Heavenly Emperor are heretics!” Yu Fei said naturally.
Jiang Ming felt speechless when Yu Fei changed how she called herself just to win him over.
“Orthodox?” Shi Kuang couldn’t help but laugh. “If you, the Desire Demon, are considered to be the orthodox, all living things in the world are the orthodox! Guys, just as Xue Bing has said, do you all obey the former Heavenly Emperor to allow her to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor? If this is the case, the position as the Heavenly Emperor would become inherited, regardless of morality, righteousness, people’s wills, and the Natural Laws of Heaven!”
“Little lion, you’ve finally said something a man would!” Vermilion Bird eventually had suppressed her anger.
“I’m not a man, don’t you use such a lowly clan to slander me!” Shi Kuang was furious.
“Die!” Jiang Ming was enraged in an instant. He spat, and a Venerate Dao Vessel whistled towards Shi Kuang and was detonated in an instant.
Boom!
Destructive torrent immediately blasted the entire body of Shi Kuang except half of his skull was left.
Jiang Ming immediately conjured a clone of himself, and directed it to the skull to wipe out Shi Kuang’s soul with a finger before he could escape.
“A beast is a mere food. Yet how dare he scold my human race as a lowly race!” Jiang Ming kept his clone and paced into the air. He roared and grabbed, a piece of burned meat fell on his hand. With a wave, he removed the burned part, revealing the unburned cooked meat, and ate it. “Three-Headed Golden Lion Clan? A lion is just a lion, which is a beast!”
Many were shocked witnessing what had just happened.
That was Shi Kuang, who was of the ancient bloodline, and a venerate. He was so strong that he dared to confront Vermilion Bird. Yet Jiang Ming had killed him in just a second and consumed his meat just because he wanted to.
Anyway, it had also proved that Jiang Ming was capable of detonating a Venerate Dao Vessel.
Many experts were wondering if Jing Ming would feel heart ache detonating a Venerate Dao Vessel. But when they saw Jiang Ming kept the Venerate Dao Vessel of Shi Kuang, all of them were reminded of Jiang Ming’s record and thought that he might have quite a number of Venerate Dao Vessels as his plunder.
F*ck! This man was not someone they could provoke!
Even Vermilion Bird and Heavenly Buddha were looking at Jiang Ming with fear. Dragon Monarch, on the other hand, looked rather gloomy.
Only Yu Fei was smiling. But in her eyes, there was greed as she thought if this man couldn’t be her guest of honor,her efforts as the Desire Demon would be in vain.
“Awesome!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan exclaimed.
“Awesome!” Great Monarch Wan Lian was also excited.
However, the faces of Giant, Xue Bing and the likes were darkened.
“You low…” Jin Hao was enraged.
Jiang Ming shifted his focus to Jin Hao, and looked at him gloomily. He said in an even icy cold voice, “If you dare to continue, I swear, I’ll definitely bring your entire clan into extinction!”

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Who Dares Humiliating Humans
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Who Dares Humiliating Humans
Jiang Ming’s voice was extremely cold, with horrifying deterrent. Because he had killed a venerate, who was very arrogant.
“You may humiliate me but not my human race!” Jiang Ming spoke sonorously, and his voice filled with killing intents. “Human race is my root, my origin, the source of my blood, and my mother. Whoever dares to humiliate, shall be killed!”
“Whoever dares to humiliate, shall be killed!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said in a rumbling voice, spreading out to all directions like thunder. He too was filled with killing intention.
“Whoever dares to humiliate, shall be killed!” Great Monarch Wan Lian paced over through the sky and stood beside Jiang Ming.
“Whoever dares to humiliate, shall be killed!” Another venerate of the human race came forward. He was a white-clad young man, carrying a long sword behind his back. He had an intimidating, and frosty aura.
“Whoever dares to humiliate, shall be killed!” Dozens of Great Overarching Golden Immortals came to stand behind Jiang Ming from a distance. They were from various sects. Some of them were even from middle chiliocosm. Yet, all of them stood up without hesitation.
“Although I’m not of the human race in this realm, I’m still a human!” Riyue Changfeng walked over while carrying a cup of tea with him. He looked gloomy, giving off the feeling that he was extremely treacherous.
At this moment, the attitude of the human race surprised many other experts. After all, humans were divided. Although the human race was known as the first among all, many forces were not taking the human race into consideration just because they were greatly divided.
Nevertheless, the situation seemed to have changed. Even the Immortal Venerate Qing Yun, who had been staying low-profile, stood up. There were other venerates too doing the same.
The change made many experts startled, wondering whether the human race was going to be united under Jiang Ming’s leadership?
