Moreover, there were still many Great Overarching Golden Immortals rushing over one after another. Some venerates of the human race, who had been concealing themselves, were also rushing over when they heard of the news.
“Humans should be standing tall and strong, supporting each other so that we remain standing firm!”
Jiang Ming said, and his voice filled the space.
“I don’t fight, I don’t rob, I don’t want to cause trouble, I don’t want to get into disputes!” He continued, “Since I’ve descended to this world, I’ve never taken the initiative to create troubles. However, whoever provoked me, most of them have died! It was so in the past, so it is now. And in the future, whoever messes with me, I will want all of them dead! Whenever you are humiliating the human race, you are humiliating my origin. If I were to learn about it, I will kill you even if you escape to the Sea of Chaos!”
Jiang Ming fluttered his sleeves and looked at Jin Hao, “Do you have any opinion on me killing Shi Kuang?”
At this moment, Jiang Ming had become the focus of all experts. His domineering temperament was very impressive. His monstrous killing intention and his desire to exterminate the race that disagreed with him was not disgusted but admired. Because he was protecting his race’s dignity without compromising.
“Amitabha!” An old buddha behind the Heavenly Buddha chanted while he was in agony because he used to be a human.
“Amitabha!” The Heavenly Buddha also chanted and the luminance of compassion hovered over the old buddha. At the same time, he told the old buddha through telepathy, “Buddha is great awareness, great comprehension, great wisdom, great intelligence, sublimation, compassion, salvation, and it’s not about self but all beings! Junior brother,don’t get caught up in it.”
“Amitabha!” The old buddha muttered and he stopped struggling, and entangling himself. He closed his eyes and sat cross-legged on the lotus platform.
The Heavenly Buddha slightly nodded. He then turned to look at Jiang Ming with unprecedented coldness flashed through his eyes. Following that, it was replaced by peace and compassion.
As Vermilion Bird blinked, there were killing intentions flowing out. However, she didn’t take any action. She would not take risks before she found a way to deal with Jiang Ming.
Tai Wuji had Sword Sambodha surging in his body. He had been afraid of Jiang Ming, and his fear had intensified.
‘If this kid is not killed, my Taishang Sword Sect would be exterminated one day!’ Tai Wuji had a deeper insight about the incident.
After all, it was obvious that Jiang Ming had become the crown of the human race. His courage, strength and prestige had justified that. Hence, even if Jiang Ming didn’t do anything, other experts of the human race might be initiating a war against the Taishang Sword Sect to demonstrate their loyalty.
‘The human race has been the food of ancient races. Even though they have gotten a lot stronger in this era, they are still synonymous with weakness. The living things in my sea hunt humans for food from time to time, and even raise a lot of them in captivity. It will be troublesome in the future, I am afraid there will be big trouble!’ The Dragon Monarch was thinking too. ‘If this kid is not killed, I’m afraid that he’d be much more threatening than the Great Demon Venerate!’
Chong Shan, who had been observing, frowned slightly as his killing intention began brewing.
It was a great opportunity for the ten ancient clans to take this advantage to show up and they would definitely stir up chaos. But because of Jiang Ming, Chong Shan’s arrangement had been messed up.
Jiang Ming had a very low cultivation base but his combat power was horrifying. No one could resist his special ability that could detonate Dao vessels except for Saint Lords.
‘Why didn’t I realize that this kid is very troublesome at that time? Otherwise, I should have decreed an Imperial Order to besiege him when he killed the Northern Emperor!’ Chong Shan thought helplessly.
‘Once he managed to integrate the human forces, it’d be even more troublesome, or even more troublesome than the Great Demon Venerate! I shall look for an opportunity to kill him later!’ Chong Shan was filled with endless killing intentions as he thought but he took no action.
On the other hand, Yu Fei was surprised and ecstatic. She almost wanted to clap hands and shouted, ‘Jiang Ming, you’re indeed the man that I lionize! Such a bold and courageous man who makes me feel more excited than the Heavenly Emperor did!’
Many experts had their different thoughts.
Jin Hao’s face was the most gloomy. “Our ten clans are of the same spirit, do you think I have any opinion? Jiang Ming, you are too arrogant and presumptuous. Do you think that you can omit laws and do whatever you want by just detonating Dao vessels?”
“Killing Shi Kuang is akin to initiating the war against us. Let’s work together to kill him!” Rage had overtaken the Giant of the Heaven Giant Clan. His ferocious aura surrounded him caused heaven to tremble and the earth to wail. This mysterious yellow qi of him, made many people nearby suffocate.
“Kill!” Xue Bing was even more icy cold.
“Jiang Ming!” The pair of Niu Er’s purple eyes were shooting out shocking killing intentions.
The other venerates came forward.
A total of nine Quasi-Sage experts surrounded the area. Just their aura emitted, suppressed the universe and made all living things to be in fear.
The other experts in the surrounding area were stunned and retreated.
“So you guys wanted to fight me, right?” Jiang Ming was not afraid at all. He only had chill and gloomy killing intentions. In fact, he was not afraid of anyone provided there wasn’t any Saint Lord around.
“Brother, you’re wrong. Fighting you is equivalent to fighting me as well!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said without hesitation. The sword in his hand had been emitting peerless sharp luminance.
“How can you not count me in?” The Great Monarch Wan Lian had his hands behind his back as he stood straight and looked at them with despisal.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun, Immortal Venerate Tai Xu and the other experts went to stand behind Jiang Ming. They took action as a demonstration of their attitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Exposing the Heavenly Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Exposing the Heavenly Emperor
The ten ancient clans and the Human Race were now confronting each other.
There were dozens of venerates. If the war was to break out, they would definitely collapse the Infinite Realm Battlefield, and even destroy the boundless torrent of space and time.
This was the power that would destroy heaven and earth. Hence, the experts in the surrounding retreated as they didn’t want to be affected.
Particularly with the existence of Jiang Ming, they might not be able to escape in time if Jiang Ming was to detonate Dao vessels.
However, there were many experts who had hints of excitement.
‘Fight, just fight. It’d be best if all of them fight to death!’ Vermilion Bird almost shouted, ‘You all are the ten ancient clans, known as the noble Golden Clan, are you even afraid of the human race? Jiang Ming has killed Shi Kuang right before you. If you all aren’t attacking him back, you’ll lose your dignity, and be sneered at forever. Fight, and use up all Dao vessels of Jiang Ming. By that time, I’ll be able to take my revenge.’
Vermilion Bird was not the only one who had such a wish, even Dragon Monarch, Tai Wuji, Heavenly Buddha and many others hoped that they would fight against each other too.
Yu Fei also had such a thought.
No one wanted to see the united human race. They didn’t even want to see the arrogant ancient clans. Hence, the best was to see the two parties wearing each other out.
“Shall I join in?” Riyue Changfeng suddenly spoke. In his hand was a little saber of merely three inches. It was an exquisite one.
Unknowingly, he had kept the tea cup, and was using that little saber cutting his nails.
However, when the experts saw the little saber, all of them felt chill run down their spines.
It didn’t emit any intimidating aura, energy wave nor the sharp luminance that could cut through all things. Yet, one would have his personal Primal Spirit cut and destroyed if he was to slightly scan with his consciousness.
They would see the sharp luminance that could cut through all things, turned into a millions feet long saber, which would cut open the world, the starry sky and the universe, and destroy the world. It was terrifying.
“That’s a Saint vessel!” Heavenly Buddha blurted.
All other experts were stunned. A Saint vessel was a supreme vessel that could be manipulated by a Saint Lord only. The legend had it that if a Saint vessel’s might had completely recovered, it meant someone had become a Saint Lord. And he was so strong that left others in despair because no one could resist him.
“Brother Jiang, do you think I shall join in as well?” Riyue Changfeng added, “After all, that brat Shi Kuang has humiliated the human race. Even though I’m not from this realm, I’m a human! Moreover, these venerates said that they’re of one body with him. Does it mean that they’re my enemies too?”
“Brother Changfeng, this is the controversy of this realm of ours. It’s better that you don’t join in!” Jiang Ming smiled as he rejected.
Jiang Ming understood clearly the intention of Riyue Changfeng, who was trying to give him a reason to retreat. After all, the number of experts of ten ancient clans must be higher than the number who were currently present. Hence, if a war was to break out, Jiang Ming and the human race would suffer great losses.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming did not care. So what if there were many experts? He could just blast them off. If he failed to, he could just return to the Tianyuan Realm, where no one would dare to follow after.
With his current cultivation base stronger than the time when he had to confront the Northern Emperor, he was capable of injuring the Heavenly Emperor if he would dare to enter the Tianyuan Realm.
Of course, even he himself did not want to fight yet, at least for now. But it must not be because of Riyue Changfeng, or his temperament would have changed.
With a simple wave in the following moment, there were Dao vessels, which had formed a long river before Jiang Ming. Most of them were of Taiyi Dao vessels and a few Venerate Weapons.
When Jin Hao heard Jiang Ming refusing Riyue Changfeng, he furtively took a sigh of relief. He was afraid of the owner of the Auction House because he had no idea how strong Riyue Changfeng was. Especially when Riyue Changfeng took out the little saber, he felt he could be easily killed when Riyue Changfeng scanned through them.
Nevertheless, before Jin Hao could relax completely, he saw the appearance of the long river of Dao vessels and his mouth twitched. Yet he still forcefully said, “Do you think you can do whatever you want by just relying on your ability to detonate Dao vessels?”
“You may try to see if I can do whatever I want!” Jiang Ming smiled.
Jin Hao went silent.
Xue Bing opened her mouth but she eventually said nothing. She was, after all, not stupid. She knew if these Dao vessels were detonated, she would definitely die.
Even that restless Giant of the Heaven Giant Clan, remained silent.
“Jiang Ming!” Chong Shan could no longer endure it and walked out.
He had to come forth because Jin Hao and the others had learned about his presence. If he didn’t, his prestige in the ten ancient clans would be reduced.
“If you dare to detonate all these Dao vessels, I’ll promise you in the name of ten ancient clans that I’ll kill all humans of at least Immortal Realm in the infinite realms!”
Chong Shan was extremely tough. His intimidating aura had been rolling out to all directions, emitting boundless power that suppressed heaven. The black and white horns on his head in particular, were spinning the two qi of Yin and Yang in accumulating terrifying power.
His aura was so strong that even Heavenly Buddha and the others were all overwhelmed.
“Perfect stage of Quasi-Sage!” Vermilion Bird looked grim.
“He even has a treasure guarding in his body that even I’m afraid of!” Dragon Monarch looked extraordinarily grim.
“It looks like he is representing the 10 ancient clans. This depicts that they have united!” Heavenly Buddha’s voice rang out in a few experts’ ears.
They were all silent.
They didn’t care about the showing up of the ten ancient clans. They weren’t very afraid even if they were united.
However, when they saw how strong Chong Shan was, and the support he had from the ten ancient clans, they began to worry. Because, they were no longer weaker than any forces in the world. In fact, they were a lot stronger than most forces.
“What shall we do?” Dragon Monarch asked worryingly.
“Wait!” Heavenly Buddha only replied with a word. As the leader of a Sacred Land, he was quite confident of himself.
At this time, all experts turned to Jiang Ming.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan and Immortal Venerate Qing Yun didn’t utter a word, but remained standing firmly behind Jiang Ming. They had been demonstrating their attitudes towards Jiang Ming with their actions. In other words, they would support whatever decision Jiang Ming would make.
“Kill all my human race’s experts of at least Immortal Realm and above?” Jiang Ming laughed, very coldly. He suddenly exclaimed, “Oh Chong Shan, if you aren’t provoking me, I don’t even want to intervene in your petty matters at all. But why do you want to do so?”
“Haha!” Chong Shan guffawed arrogantly. “Jiang Ming, you’re just a little human, who has received some encounters. Yet, you’ve become so presumptuous. My ten ancient clans used to be known as the Golden Clan, and we used to go around the world unhindered. We went into seclusion only because of the appearance of Saint Lords. If you don’t believe we have such power, you may try us!”
“I don’t believe it because I’d have killed all of you before you all could take any actions!” Jiang Ming smiled. Then, he turned to a woman venerate who was in the distance. “Immortal Venerate Tai Yin, do you believe it?”
Immortal Venerate Tai Yin’s pupils shrank, while Chong Shan’s heart skipped a beat. At that moment, they understood that Jiang Ming had learned about their identity.
Especially Chong Shan, who suddenly understood what Jiang Ming meant when he said he didn’t want to intervene in the petty matters of his.
Besides, when Jiang Ming purposely pointed out Immortal Venerate Tai Yin, it was obvious that Jiang Ming was telling him that Jiang Ming knew that they were one.
There was no need to say much for smart experts like them. They could understand a lot of things with just a look and a sentence.
“It doesn’t seem useful whether I believe it or not!” Immortal Venerate Tai Yin smiled. “Of course, I don’t suggest that both of you got into fights. The world needs peace and millions of spirits need orders. Just look at the Great Demon Venerate who went against heaven, what has eventually happened to him? He died even with the protection of the Saint Weapon! Both of you are great experts of the world. Hence, you two should maintain the peace, the orders and the operation of Natural Laws of Heavens. Fellow Taoist Chong Shan, what Shi Kuang did was indeed wrong. To humiliate the race of Taoist Jiang indeed would induce lethal hatred. Hence, it’s reasonable that Taoist Jiang killed him!”
“Fellow Taoist Chong Shan, you and your ten ancient clans showing up today, isn’t it for the prosperity of your clans and to maintain the order of heaven and earth? If there is a war, heaven will collapse and the earth will sink, is it really what you want to see?”
“With Taoist Jiang’s capability, even if he can’t kill all of you, he could at least kill half of you! Do you want it to really happen?”
“Since the price of the wrong deed has been paid, please do not continue dwelling in it! The past is over, why don’t you just let it go?”
“Fellow Taoist Jiang and Taoist Chong Shan, we should make peace! Let’s not mention the past, but respect each other from now onwards. Let’s look into the future! How about that?”
Immortal Venerate Tai Yin said sincerely.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Rebuilding the Heaven Court
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Rebuilding the Heaven Court
Jiang Ming’s strength stunned all of the experts.
However, the power of the ten great ancient races also caused fear to many forces who were present.
They were particularly afraid of Chong Shan, who was already at the pinnacle of the Quasi-Sage Realm. He was even equipped with Dao vessels unknown to others.
However, this Heavenly Emperor avatar’s heart was filled with unprecedented murderous intent right this very moment.
He didn’t understand how Jiang Ming knew about his identity. Even the true identity of Immortal Venerate Tai Yin wasn’t hidden from him.
Could he have seen something irregular from my indistinct connection with Immortal Venerate Tai Yin from time to time? Could it be that he in fact, didn’t really know about my secrets?
Chong Shan didn’t dare to gamble.
This plan of his had been in place since ancient times. The resources expended were countless. Hence, he couldn’t allow any variables to his plan.
From Immortal Venerate Tai Yin’s remark, Chong Shan understood that this was a chance given for him to step down from the skirmish.
He couldn’t make a move for now. Absolutely not!
However, such a chance for him to take a step back was still insufficient.
Chong Shan’s expression was stone cold. He telepathically transmitted his thought over to Xue Bing and the likes. “We re-emerge into the world in order to attain the throne of the Heavenly Emperor. Even if we can’t contest it, we must still become one of the strongest forces in this world, to reap the resources of the infinite realms in hope of advancing further!”
“You’ve also seen the situation in front of us! If we break into a war with Jiang Ming, unless you have the ability to protect yourself, every one of you might die! Even if we look at this positively, more than half of you will die.”
......
“From the chain reaction effect of the detonation of Venerate Dao Vessels, it doesn’t matter if there’s any defensive special ability, spatial energy or Dao of time. They will all be useless!”
“If we really reach such a point, the purpose of our trip this time will be completely failed. This might even attract the attention of several major forces such as the Fo Sect. It is very likely that they will take this opportunity to besiege us!”
“My opinion is to temporarily let Jiang Ming go this time and seek another opportunity. I will set up a great formation array to refine and destroy his whole Tianyuan Realm.”
“Then, we will kill all the human race’s experts that are above the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm. We will leave no one alive and also deter the world with this.”
“Everyone, what do you think?”
Chong Shan transmitted his voice with his primal spirit swiftly.
Xue Bing and other Venerates were silent.
Although Shi Kuang was not of their clan, they were of the same spirit. Now that he was killed, they would definitely take revenge and go on a killing spree according to their temperament.
However, the current situation was just like what Chong Shan had mentioned. They shouldn’t break into a battle now or both sides will end up badly injured. It might also lead to the joint encirclement and suppression of the Demon Holy Palace and other forces. If that was to happen, could they ward them off?
It was likely that it would end with genocide.
“It is imperative that we kill him after this whole incident. We must kill all the humans of the Tianyuan Realm, kill every single one of them!” Xue Bing replied, ‘But there must be a time limit to this. If this goes by for too long, we will become the laughing stock for others!”
“Brother Chong Shan, how about a hundred years’ time?” Niu Er suggested.
“Alright! The time limit is 100 years. When the time comes, we will discuss among ourselves, dispatch our forces together and directly finish him off. Even if he is able to detonate Dao vessels, we will let him blow himself up!” Chong Shan nodded and made a decision.
Such a conversation between them was completed in a mere breath of time.
Chong Shan’s face was gloomy. He glanced around and looked at Immortal Venerable Tai Yin. After pondering for a moment, he seemed to have analyzed the pros and cons to the situation and then said, “Fellow Daoist Tai Yin, with such a remark from you, I’ll have to respect you for this! After all, Shi Kuang was the one who was wrong. However, the seed of hatred that has been planted cannot be so easily erased. We will not discuss this as of now but will continue with this later on.”
Chong Shan looked at Jiang Ming and continued, “If you can’t give me an explanation for this, then we will be mortal enemies from now on!”
“So be it!” Jiang Ming replied without hesitation.
As Jiang Ming stared back at Chong Shan with eyes glistening. It was as though there was another meaning behind his stare that caused them to be even more afraid.
“Alright!” Chong Shan nodded his head heavily, and looked over at Yu Fei, Heavenly Buddha and other experts, “Ladies and gentlemen, let’s now discuss the position as the Heavenly Emperor! We do not recognize the last Heavenly Emperor’s preposition on handing over the position and I believe that all of you do not recognize it either. Currently, the Heavenly Emperor is dead, the Heaven Court is in shambles, the soldiers and the generals of the Heaven Court have almost been completely wiped out, if not severely injured. The current state is like a cloud of smoke, attributed to the vicissitudes of history.”
“The past has been buried. Now, how to designate the present? How do we plan for the future? The present is our present, and the future is our future!”
Chong Shan announced eloquently, rejecting everything of the past.
“Of course!” Vermillion Bird was the first to agree.
She was long tired of Yu Fei. What’s more, she also had her own ambitions. She also wanted to have a go at the position of the Heavenly Emperor.
“What you just said is very true!” Dragon Monarch also nodded in agreement
There were some other Venerates who also followed suit and agreed to Chong Shan’s notion. After all, no one wanted the Heavenly Emperor that domineers over them to be someone that originated from the Abyss and that it would be a devil, a female devil who would sleep with anyone in the infinite worlds. If she were to ascend onto the position, everyone would panic.
Yu Fei was extremely angry at their notion, but there was nothing that she could do.
‘God damn it! If it weren’t for the so-called Ten Great Ancient Races, I would almost be sure to have attained the position!’ She was fuming with anger.
As she then looked over at Jiang Ming again, thoughts rapidly ran through her mind.
“In that case, who should sit on the throne of the Heavenly Emperor then?” Yu Fei suppressed the many thoughts in her mind and suddenly asked the question loudly.
As her voice fell, there was a moment of silence.
Now that the Heaven Court had fallen, any other experts would be unwilling for anyone to take on the Heavenly Emperor’s position.
“In that case, what if...” Jiang Ming suddenly smiled and said, “We’ll just maintain the current situation! The Heaven Court has fallen, while the soldiers and generals of the Heaven Court are almost completely wiped out as well. Based on the current situation, there’s the Demon Holy Palace, Fo Sect, Dragon Clan, Moon Palace, Infinite Being Palace, Taishang Sword Sect, the 10 ancient races and more. With all of them having peerless experts looking over them, how would any of them be willing to allow the others to take over the throne? It’s better for everyone to govern their forces independently until the emergence of a peerless expert who can suppress all the other experts of the world. From then off, the Heaven Court can be rebuilt!”
“This is a good proposal!” Dragon Monarch’s golden eyes were suddenly gleaming with infinite luminance.
The Dragon Clan were of deep and terrifying background.
Although the Dragon Clan had never been any Saint Lords, it was obvious that they were not of the ordinary considering that the clan was able to become one of the top forces in the world.
“I don’t think that’s a good idea!” Great Monarch Tian Song shook his head in disagreement. “If everyone becomes independent, there will no longer be any order and the final result will be infinite chaos and bloodshed.”
“What fellow Taoist Tian Song said is right!” Chong Shan responded. “Being the Venerates ourselves, when we want to maintain the order of heaven and earth, to uphold justice and also to create an environment with basic fairness and laws, there is nothing more suitable than through the Heaven Court! The Heaven Court must be rebuilt, not only for all the living souls, but also for ourselves.”
“After all...” He took a glance at Riyue Changfeng, “The Chaos is vast and there are many realms as well. If our world were to be in chaos and were to face an invasion, how could we even stop it from happening?”
“As expected of my fellow Taoist to be able to have such profound views and thoughts!” Immortal Venerable Tai Yin exclaimed in admiration, “On behalf of the Moon Palace lineage, I would like to express our agreement to the notion of rebuilding the Heaven Court!”
“On behalf of Infinite Being Palace, I concur with the rebuilding of the Heaven Court!” Great Monarch Tian Song agreed at the same time.
Immediately afterwards, some other Venerates from small forces and some idle Venerates also expressed their agreement towards the notion.
From their perspective, it would be easier for them to mingle when there were orders. Otherwise, anyone could be bullied just like that within a chaotic state.
Jiang Ming remained quiet as he watched from the sidelines. He knew that the Heaven Court would definitely be rebuilt. This was because it was all part of Tai Yuan’s plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - Incarnation Engraving, Bai Yihou’s Sky-defying Luck
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Incarnation Engraving, Bai Yihou’s Sky-defying Luck
A consensus had been reached on rebuilding the Heaven Court. However, who would be the one to sit on the throne of the Heavenly Emperor? This stumped all the experts present.
In the end, the meeting was over without confirming who would take on the throne.
Chong Shan proposed that they shall discuss the issue among themselves privately and to meet here again after 100 years. By then, they would come up with a reasonable way to determine this matter.
A hundred years would be a very short time span to experts such as themselves. Yet they would still be able to do many things, such as to destroy the Tianyuan Realm.
The various experts gradually left the meeting after it was adjourned.
“Little brother Jiang!” As Yu Fei walked over, her alluring body scent was swept over by the soft breeze, directly drowning Jiang Ming face’s, seeping into every pores on his skin.
Thousands of different thoughts instantly ran through Jiang Ming’s mind.
“Why are you always ignoring me!” Yu Fei’s tone of voice was somewhat resentful.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan who was right beside Jiang Ming turned away expressionlessly, placed his hands behind his back and looked into the distance.
Great Monarch Wan Lian however, suddenly frowned and was a little wary of her.
“You wanted to besiege and kill me back then!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “I’m already considered polite to not kill you when I first see you now.”
“Little brother! I didn’t have a choice because of the Great Demon Venerate back then!” Yu Fei said aggrieved, “You are a man! A man who is courageous and upright! Can’t you be more tolerant towards me?”
Just as she finished her words, she continued to lean forward, trying to lean on Jiang Ming’s shoulder.
......
Jiang Ming’s face immediately turned gloomy. He raised his finger and condensed a sword edge formed of luminance. This in turn caused Yu Fei’s heart to skip a beat, as she quickly stopped her actions and had an even more aggrieved look on her face. “Little brother! Is this how you treat me?”
“There are too many smells on you. I don’t like it!” Jiang Ming pointed to the distance. “Please!”
“If you really don’t like it, how about if I offer you an avatar of mine?” Yu Fei didn’t leave, but instead continued asking, “If one is not enough, then make it ten! A hundred or ten thousands will do as well! Looking through this world, there’s no woman who has as many tricks as me. I promise to let you taste the joy of the world!”
“Scram!” Jiang Ming was furious. “Am I such a person?”
However, thousands of thoughts flashed through his mind and there were even many visions formed.
A vision where he created 10,000 avatars as well as they went one-on-one with Yu Fei with millions of combinations. A scene where they fought together, experienced bliss together and sublime together.
When he thought of the sudden gush right that very moment, who knew what it would taste like when they intertwined together.
“Little brother is just not honest with your words! Hehe! You’re so naughty!” Yu Fei was not angry, but she seemed to have sensed Jiang Ming’s mood changes, as she smiled and left.
“This devil is difficult to deal with!” Jiang Ming sighed as he lamented. He was shocked as well
Just now, he seemed to have been unknowingly influenced by Yu Fei. That was very bad. Very, very bad indeed.
“Brother! She’s a being who can devour a person without even spitting out bones. I suggest that you directly kill her and be done with it if there is such a chance in the future, saving you from having to be cautious day and night. You wouldn’t want yourself falling into her traps in the end!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan solemnly advised.
“Don’t worry, big brother! That lady? She’s way too dirty!” Jiang Ming laughed.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was left speechless.
‘If she wasn’t dirty, were you ready to hop on then? Should I return and inform Ling Long about this? Forget it. I can’t be involved in such a matter.’
Right this very moment, Great Monarch Wan Lian cupped his hands as he left the place.
Immortal Venerate Qing Yun and Immortal Venerate Tai Xu followed suit.
“Brother Jiang! I’m Bai Yihou! I will be cultivating in the Infinite Realm Battlefield from now on. If anything comes up, just call for me at any time!” The Bai Yihou of the human race, who had a long sword on his back, cupped his fists before turning into a sword luminance and left the scene.
This person went off as swiftly as he came.
“Bai Yihou!” Jiang Ming looked in the direction that he left for with a strange expression on his face.
“To think that I don’t recognize this person at all!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan frowned. “Where did he come from?”
“Who knows? It’s alright as long as he’s an expert in our human race!” Jiang Ming laughed.
In actuality, Jiang Ming knew of this Bai Yihou.
The ‘Status’ of this person named Bai Yihou was simply unbelievable.
Originally a human child from the mortal planar, he fell into a cave at the age of six, accidentally ate a Skeletal Sword Pill, which resulted in the restructure of his body’s constitution, turning him into a body of the Skeletal Sword.
Practicing under his father, who was a guardian of the Sky Army, Bai Yihou was able to comprehend any swordsmanship that he had seen at a glance. His cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds.
At the age of eighteen, he was defeated during his effort to capture a thief. He fell into a lake, but found himself accidentally entering a secret realm, obtained the inheritance of the supreme sword Dao, and also obtained the Immortal Sword.
After several years of cultivation, his sword aura roared through the world as soon as he came out of his seclusion. Since he liked to wear white clothes and was also bestowed the status as a marquis due to his merits at that time, he was called Bai Yihou, which meant ‘a marquis in white clothes’ by the world.
This later on became his name.
Bai Yihou used his sword to dominate throughout, and became famous across the world.
After many years went by, his cultivation directly broke through the boundaries of the mortal realm without any difficulty. Right when he was about to ascend, he was accidentally swept into the torrent of time and space.
With his cultivation base at that time, he should have died tragically on the spot. However, he was swept into an Immortal Realm by chance and obtained a cave mansion as well as an inheritance. It belonged to one of the ancient supreme venerates that fought against Saint Lord Taishang in ancient times.
This person was the Samsara Sword Venerate who once fought off Saint Lord Taishang but unfortunately he was defeated. Just when his true spirit was about to crumble, he left behind a legacy of himself.
Bai Yihou directly integrated the cultivation sealed by the Samsara Sword Master into himself and even evoked the Reincarnation Law Engraving special ability, allowing Bai Yihou to directly reincarnate into the infinite world.
At the end of his reincarnation, Bai Yihou’s cultivation base directly shot into the Venerate Realm.
His great opportunities were sky-defying.
On one hand, Bai Yihou had an astonishing ability of comprehension, while he was a terrifying Samsara Sword Venerate on the other hand.
It was a shame that the Samsara Sword Venerate died early.
After Bai Yihou came out of his seclusion, he used the Reincarnation Engraving to seal himself and began to travel through infinite realms and to witness many miracles. He also changed his appearance to temper himself through the journey.
As a result, almost no one knew of his existence.
It was until Jiang Ming stood up for the righteousness of the human race that led him towards admiration and he finally decided to step forward.
“What amazing luck!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh to himself.
A large number of Great Overarching Golden Immortal experts from the human race gathered around. Many of them brought up their intention of following him on his journey towards the practice of cultivation and also requested to live in Tianyuan Sea.
It was obvious that they were implying that they had submitted to Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming shook his head as he did not allow them to do so. Instead, Jiang Ming suggested that they live on top of Tianyuan Sea, which was already considered a step back for him.
“Brother Changfeng, thank you!” On the way back, Jiang Ming landed above the auction house and cupped his fist at Riyue Changfeng.
“The ending would be the same, with or without my presence!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “It’s alright if they insult you. To dare insult the human race, that’s a crime that deserves death!”
“Why am I getting so angry from this remark of yours?” Jiang Ming said speechlessly.
“Haha!” Riyue Changfeng laughed, and then said solemnly, “That person, Chong Shan, is no simple man. I don’t understand him clearly, but I am sure that he will come to you in the near future. Once he makes a move, it will be something of great surprise. It’s very likely that your technique of detonating Dao vessels would be rendered useless! You need to be careful!”
“If he really dares to make a move, I will give him a surprise. In fact, the best time for him to go against me had passed!” Jiang Ming didn’t care much about Chong Shan.
During the confrontation just now, he was quite afraid if Chong Shan made a move on him.
It would be fine if Jiang Ming was all alone. However, there were too many Great Overarching Golden Immortals of the human race who stood up, as well as Bai Yihou and the likes.
If such a war were to break out, there would definitely be heavy casualties.
What then? There won’t be anything left!
“It’s alright as long as you are confident!” Riyue Changfeng didn’t worry too much. He knew how terrifying Jiang Ming was.
After chatting for a while longer, the two parted ways.
Jiang Ming went back to Chuyang Peak.
“Brother, are you sure you can compete against the ten ancient races?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan asked worriedly, “Based on my estimation, there are probably twenty or thirty Venerates among these ten great races combined.”
“Be at ease, big brother! They are merely a group of people who are placing their heads on the plates!”
“From what you just replied, I’m relieved!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan then returned to his courtyard.
Standing on top of the balcony, Jiang Ming made himself a meal. After eating silently, he evoked the Supreme Order and entered the Supreme Pagoda. “It’s high time for me to prepare myself. Tai Yuan, I’ll be giving you a big surprise!”

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - How Can You Walk Alone on the Path Towards the Great Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: How Can You Walk Alone on the Path Towards the Great Dao
Upon entering the Supreme Pagoda, Jiang Ming took a glance around and spotted Ye Qingxian.
She was sitting in a corner, with a coffee table in front of her. The fragrance of tea lingered in the air as she silently enjoyed the tea from her teacup.
She was also immersed in the scroll in her left hand.
“A demure lady enjoying tea while being immersed in the books within the bustling street. Such elegance!” Jiang Ming landed on the opposite side. He sat cross-legged and filled a cup for himself.
Ye Qingxian kept the teacup and smiled bitterly. “I’m just forcibly calming myself down! Brother Jiang, how is the outside world now? Don’t tell me you have overturned the Heaven Court.”
“Haha!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing, and gave her a thumbs up. “You are awesome! You’ve correctly guessed the situation outside.”
“Brother Jiang, are you for real?” Ye Qingxian had a shocked expression on her face.
Ye Qingxian couldn’t believe that Jiang Ming had overturned the Heaven Court. She thought Jiang Ming was way too extreme and was wondering how he did that!
It was the Heaven Court, a place that represented the pinnacle of forces within a great chiliocosm. It was equipped with the best combat power, representing the order and rules as well as the orthodox of the realm.
Jiang Ming explained the cause and effect of everything that had happened. He also highlighted the distribution of forces in Tiancang Great Chiliocosm.
“Entered the Heaven Court and killed Immortal generals, beheaded the Immortal Venerates, and then brought the Heaven Court into shambles, buried hundreds of millions of Heavenly Soldiers and Heavenly Generals right in front of the Heavenly Emperor?” Ye Qingxian was stunned by the whole explanation.
Although she was only of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, she knew how terrifying the Heaven Court was. Hence, she couldn’t believe that the Heaven Court could be scattered so easily.
“I have a technique that allows me to detonate Dao Vessels!” As Jiang Ming explained, he pointed at Ye Qingxian’s forehead, passing over this technique of his to her.
......
Jiang Ming was transferring the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique that had yet been completely perfected.
Ye Qingxian was dumbfounded from all this. It took her quite some time to digest all this information before her face was filled with shock again, exclaiming, “Such terrifying forbidden technique! To be able to detonate one’s own Dao Vessel and affect other people’s. With such a technique in your disposal, your combat power would increase by several folds! No wonder! No wonder you are that powerful! With all that said, you’ve really put me in trouble!”
Although that was her remark, there wasn’t the slightest hint of blame from her tone of voice.
“You can continue practicing your cultivation here for the time being. You can return after I’m capable of fighting against Saint Lords. When the time comes, I will even help you ascend to the Heavenly Emperor’s throne!” Jiang Ming proudly promised.
Ye Qingxian rolled her eyes. “The Emperor’s throne? I’m not interested at all!”
She raised her head and sighed softly. Then, with a smile, she waved her hand in the air, as if she was cutting off the past.
Following that, she said, “Let the bygones and karma be submerged into history from this point on. Now that I no longer carry much burden, I’ll be able to fully immerse myself in cultivation from now on.”
“Saint Dao!”
“Great Dao!”
“I will pry into the pinnacle of Dao!”
She stood up and bowed to Jiang Ming. “I’ll still need Brother Jiang’s support!”
“Rather than walking alone on the path towards the Great Dao, it is better for like-minded people to support each other and move forward together.” Jiang Ming helped her up and continued. “To be able to have companions when we stand at the top of the path of Great Dao. I think that would be the greatest blessing of all. ”
The two looked at each other and smiled.
“Brother Jiang, Ms. Ye! Long time no see!” A surprised voice came from a distance. In a blink of an eye, Luo Heng could be seen approaching them as he sat down unceremoniously.
His face was filled with a look of surprise.
“Haha! It wasn’t that long!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing.
This was the joy of seeing an old friend. Jiang Ming didn’t have many friends in the real world, yet he had quite a few in the Supreme Pagoda.
It was also due to the fact that there were no conflicts of interests among them that allowed him to not be cautious all the time. Conversely, they were more open to each other, and it was easier for them to chat around.
The last time he saw Luo Heng was when Luo Heng just arrived in the Supreme Pagoda of the Immortal Realm.
“Brother Luo!” Ye Qingxian smiled as well, “You have a lot of fine wine over there! Hurry up! Let’s taste them!”
“I don’t have much of the other stuff, but I sure have a lot of fine wines!” As Luo Heng waved his hand, a wine table appeared in front of him. The table was full of various alcoholic drinks and different types of cups.
Just looking at them was a pleasure itself.
“Try them all and see if you like any of them in particular. I’ll prepare more for you in the future!” Luo Heng introduced the drinks one by one.
“In the era of the big universe, the liberation of the labor force has brought the quality of life to an extreme height!” Jiang Ming lamented, “That’s the place to enjoy life!”
Luo Heng shook his head: “To be able to enjoy life back at my place, one must have the corresponding strength. Otherwise, you’d only be able to hide in the shadows and drink yourself away. It will be difficult for the person to see the true prosperity of the universe. We are always competing with the Zergs, the Demon Clan, the Divine Beings, Spirit Clan and the likes for the resources of the universe. There’s practically a Great War happening every day. If a person like myself were to be placed on the frontier of the battle, I’d merely be a cannon fodder!”
“Is it that cruel?” Ye Qingxian was surprised by Luo Heng’s remarks.
“Yeah!” Luo Heng nodded, “I was weak in the past and only knew of cultivation. It was difficult for me to see the true side of the universe. The current me can be considered to have slight achievement and qualified to know some secrets. The universe is too vast and there are countless races in existence. If you want to preserve for yourself a quiet and peaceful living place, you can only keep fighting on. The people in the back will never know the cruelty of the struggle at the frontline. Therefore, the strong will be able to enjoy everything. ”
“As people compete themselves in the great universe, is there a level of enjoyment based on strength?” Ye Qingxian asked again.
“Something like that!” Luo Heng answered, “Actually, the mortals that are living behind my factions are living quite a good life. However, they are still lacking when it comes to some rare treasures, cultivation resources and the likes. As long as you don’t find trouble for yourself, you can live a happy life. Of course, as a person’s strength slowly increases, only then would they be able to gradually see the true side of the great universe and to continuously increase their lifespan.”
“The advantage of cosmic civilization is that it allows the ordinary people to live in a relatively fair environment!” Jiang Ming brought up his thoughts.
“Yes! Compared to your respective worlds, the mortal beings back at my place are really blessed. The door that leads to the upper floors is always open.” Luo Heng smiled.
“I’m a little envious already!” Ye Qingxian sighed. “In your world you don’t have transcendence? In this case, how far can you improve your cultivation base?”
“No!” Luo Heng pondered as he said, “As for how far I can improve my cultivation realm? I don’t know either! However, I heard that some experts would be able to tear apart the universe and go forth Into the Chaotic Realm outside. My cultivation base is still too low. At present, it is difficult for me to truly see the full face of the universe!”
“The fact that you are able to set foot here into the Supreme Pagoda, you are destined to stand on the top of the universe back in your world!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“It’s really difficult!” Luo Heng turned to look at the Battle Towers. “I can only pass the first Battle Tower and stop at level 2 of the second Battle Tower!”
“Wao, you’re amazing?” Ye Qingxian was shocked.
“Am I? I haven’t even entered the Chat Room yet!” Luo Heng continued to explain helplessly, “For my level of genetics, I can at most reach the 30,000 folds. It’d be even more difficult to improve further then. I sometimes feel hopeless when I gaze at the Battle Tower. If I don’t even have the qualification to join the chat group here, how can I even talk about soaring through the universe in the future? I have a long thought after my previous encounter with Brother Jiang. I finally returned to reality after my cultivation retreat and started to travel around the world. As a result…”
A depressed look could slowly be seen from his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - Refining Innate Supreme Treasures
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Refining Innate Supreme Treasures
“What happened?” Jiang Ming gulped down the glass of wine. He changed a new glass, looked through the assorted wine and found a type of wine that was set ablaze. He then poured a glass, swirled the glass and watched as the flame rose into the air. It was not hot whatsoever, but on the contrary, gave off a kind of cold chilling sensation. It felt very magical.
“I wandered into a secret realm in the universe and ended up being trapped inside.” Luo Heng scratched his head as he explained what happened.
It was actually quite simple.
After cultivating in the Supreme Pagoda, Luo Heng learned all kinds of secret techniques, countless special abilities and even challenged the Battle Towers countless times, he still could not meet the qualifications to join the Chat Room.
He knew that he was still far behind. However, he also felt that he had reached his current limit.
Feeling that there was no longer any point in continuing to cultivate, he returned to reality, went through the scrolls, flipped through records and finally locked on to a few secret realms that had great opportunities in them. He was prepared to go out and test his luck.
Unexpectedly, Luo Heng encountered a squad of demon army and as expected, a great battle broke out.
Luo Heng was defeated and so he went deeper into the secret realm. He was accidentally led into a secret place of inheritance.
It was both a great encounter as well as a dead end to him. Even the signal connecting him to the virtual network was blocked and it was impossible for him to call for help.
The only good thing about the place was that violence was prohibited in that secret realm. Those who entered could only try comprehending the secret technique of inheritance and couldn’t even leave until the person reached a certain level.
Fortunately for Luo Heng, it wasn’t difficult for him.
However, with his way of escape at the back being blocked off, what could he do? Luo Heng tried his luck and was unexpectedly able to enter the Supreme Pagoda.
He was prepared to think of a way of escaping his predicament in the Supreme Pagoda. If that didn’t work, he would try breaking through into the next cultivation realm. That was until he saw Jiang Ming and Ye Qingxian.
“Since you were able to escape, it seems the other party isn’t too strong, right?” Jiang Ming asked after hearing the story.
“They are far stronger than I am! If it weren’t for my life-saving treasure, I wouldn’t be able to see you two anymore!” Luo Heng smiled wryly. “In terms of the cultivation system here, the strongest person among them should be equivalent to that of Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm. It was a fluke that I was able to escape!”
“It shows that you have great luck!” Jiang Ming smiled. “Can your genetic level continue to improve?”
“Yes! But it’s too difficult. Even raising it by a small degree, the difficulty is akin to ascending into the sky!” Luo Heng sighed.
“What’s so difficult about it?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“There’s three difficulties in total. One, there must be a secret technique used. Back where I’m from, special techniques that help to improve a person’s genetic level are extremely rare. The one that I got my hands on can raise a person’s genetic level up to 10,000-folds. It’s one of a kind even throughout the whole universe.” Luo Heng wasn’t holding back at all about the fact that he had such a treasure. “Perhaps, getting my hands on such a secret technique has exhausted all my luck. This might have been the reason behind the catastrophe I’m facing now!”
“Secondly, the method of raising the level of genes is self-reorganization. If there were to be even the slightest error, the person’d die because of his genes collapsing. I used to practice my cultivation in the sacred land of cultivation in the secret realm of my human race. There is a supreme divine power that helps to suppress myself. Even if I were to make a mistake or two, I can still be saved.”
“The third would be that I need the support of a cosmic treasure. However, because I’ve exhausted my treasures, and that my strength has reached a higher level, I need to travel out to further temper myself. As such, I went off to explore the secret realms of the universe, yet ended up stumbling upon a squad of demon army. I suspect that some spies had leaked news about my travels. After all, I am a relatively well-known peerless genius of the human race and has already been on the wanted list among other races. I was caught in such a predicament not long after I embarked on my journey.”
Luo Heng told of his current predicament.
To improve the genetic level of a person was not the same as improving a person’s cultivation realm. This was equivalent to bloodline evolution.
“Currently, there’s two difficulties that you are facing. One would be getting your hands on a powerful Dao vessel that can suppress yourself. The second would be a cosmic treasure. Is that right?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Yeah!” Luo Heng nodded, “I wanted to travel around, hoping to obtain some great encounters to accumulate wealth, so as to further improve my genetic levels! However, life doesn’t always go your way!”
“What is such a misfortune?” Jiang Ming replied in a happy tone, “Here, see if this thing is of any use to you.”
Saying so, Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed mid-air. A wisp of innate vital essence fell into his hand. Although it was only a single wisp, it was as heavy as a huge mountain.
“This is...” Luo Heng frowned as he observed the object, sensing it carefully. He couldn’t help but be shocked by the treasure, “This is the power of the origin of the universe! This is a rare cosmic wonder!”
“The power of the origin of the universe?” A strange look flashed through Jiang Ming’s face, “Back where I’m from, this is the innate vital essence, which can only be found at the beginning of the birth of the world! Can it help you in improving your genetic level?”
“Of course it can, but...” Luo Heng also understood what Jiang Ming meant when he took out the essence, but immediately shook his head. “Brother Jiang, this is too precious! Besides, it is of great use to you as well!”
“I have more!” Jiang Ming stretched out his hand and grabbed midair yet again. This time, a round ball appeared, sealed within was a large amount of innate vital essence as he threw the ball over at Luo Hong. “Being able to meet each other and become friends whilst separated by countless worlds is a heaven-defying fate. This thing is not of much use to me, and I still have a lot of them left. Brother Luo, just think of it as my investment in you. When you achieve something great in the future, don’t you forget about me!”
“Brother Jiang!” Seeing Jiang Ming’s sincere eyes, Luo Heng put the ball of essence away. “No point for me to say anything courteous. If there comes a time where I can be of great use to you, just call out for me!”
“That’s more like it!” Jiang Ming replied. He then took out another cauldron and threw it over at Luo Heng. “This is an ultimate Great Overarching Dao Vessel. It has the ability of self-suppression and it may be useful for your cultivation!”
Luo Hong gasped in awe.
“Just accept it! Brother Jiang is a nouveau riche!” Ye Qingxian said with a smile.
“What nouveau riche? We are the rich generation!” Jiang Ming said, “Looking through the infinite realms, who can compare with me in terms of wealth?After overturning Heaven Courts, I got a hold of many great treasures. Just by counting Venerate Dao Vessels, I’ve got more than ten of them already!”
Back then in Tiancang Great Chiliocosm, he detonated many Dao vessels to bombard the whole Heaven Court, at the same time killing an unknown number of experts.
There were of course still many Dao vessels that had not been destroyed. Jiang Ming, who was at the center of the Heaven Court, kept them all away.
Other than Quasi-Sage Weapons, there were still many more Great Overarching Dao Vessels left. These were all treasures obtained from those experts that were present on the edges of the Heaven Court during the skirmish.
The owners had died, and their Dao vessels were what was left of them.
All of which had become Jiang Ming’s trophy.
“You are the bomb!” What else could Ye Qingxian say, but to give him a thumbs up.
“Brother Jiang is still one of a kind! You’ve convinced me!” Luo Heng exclaimed.
“Alright then! I’m off to cultivate now! Ms. Ye, Brother Luo! If you need me for anything in the future, just wait for me here!” Jiang Ming said as he flew towards the Dao Enlightenment Sea, and landed on a lotus platform.
“To be able to come to this place is a great encounter; to be able to know Brother Jiang is a sky-defying encounter!” Luo Heng remarked emotionally.
“I know right!” Ye Qingxian nodded, “Great comprehensive capability, great talent, courage, and such forthrightness! Among the people that I have met, brother Jiang is without a doubt the number one on the list!”
Back then, Jiang Ming gave her 1,000 points as remuneration for her help. No one would’ve even believed her for the value was too great.
Sitting on top of the lotus platform, Jiang Ming spent a point to accelerate time to the speed of 10,000 years in a blink of an eye.
“I’ve three goals to achieve in this round of cultivation retreat!” Jiang Ming thought to himself. “One is to refine all Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels that I’ve obtained, just in case anything happens! This is especially for the Saint Weapon Blood Banner that I obtained from the Great Demon Venerate. With this Saint Weapon, I will have more confidence!”
“The second goal is to continue deducing the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique and the Infinite Transcendence Technique!”
“The third will be to comprehend the Taiyi Laws, improve my cultivation realm, and prepare for the evolution of my inner world!”
After Jiang Ming had a simple plan on his cultivation retreat, he evoked the Human Path Record.
Suppressed within the Human Path Record were weapons such as the pinnacle Saint Weapon, Taiye Sword and the likes.
For the Demi-Sage Weapons, there were the Silver Luminance Battle Armor, Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, Emperor Crown and the Sky Demon Saber.
There was also the Saint Weapon Blood Banner, which was the most powerful Dao Vessel among them.
Jiang Ming immersed himself as he refined the Dao vessels one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - The Sky-Defying Efficacy of the Chaotic World Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: The Sky-Defying Efficacy of the Chaotic World Tree
It was not difficult for Jiang Ming to refine a Quasi-Sage Weapon. After all his will and mind had reached the Demi-Sage Realm, and even had some traits of the Saint’s soul.
Nevertheless, it was very difficult to refine a Saint Weapon. Jiang Ming had taken 100 years just to add an imprint on the Blood Banner. Hence, he was able to evoke part of its power.
“That’s enough!” Jiang Ming was not disappointed for he was merely at the Golden Immortal Realm.
“Next, I shall be comprehending the laws of Taiyi to increase my cultivation!” He didn’t want to stay in the same realm because it would be meaningless even if he were to continue accumulating his power. He was considered to be at the pinnacle of the Golden Immortal Realm.
As he entered his inner world himself, it was huge and vast with a seedling in the middle of it. The seedling had a few branches and a total number of 33 leaves. However, each leaf had been accumulating mysterious yellow luminance. Wisps of mist emitting from them had supreme Dao fluctuation.
*There are only 33 pieces of leaves!” Jiang Ming was speechless. The seedling had absorbed many items he had traded in such as the World Heart, and a long river of innate vital essence, but only a few pieces had grown.
“Not to mention its maturity, it’d take an unknown amount of time just to grow 3,000 pieces of leaves!” Jiang Ming felt rather disappointed.
However, along with the growth of each leaf, his soul and mind would get stronger, and his inner world would be benefited as it went a step further into the middle chiliocosm.
If there weren’t because of these benefits, he might have thrown the seedling away. It might be a waste just to throw away like that, perhaps he should just gulp it.
Jiang Ming conjured a clone, suspended mid-air, looking in the distance. There were mountains and valleys, rivers and streams, deep abyss, vast sea, and etc.
It was a real world. It even nurtured numerous insects and small size animals. But there weren’t any intelligent beings yet.
‘Is it because of the Chaotic World Tree that lives are nurtured this fast?’ Jiang Ming was ecstatic when he pondered.
It was his own world. He was the sovereign, the Natural Laws of Heaven, the god of creation.
In fact, the inner world was himself. Even the external Chaotic World Tree’s seedling he had refined.
He landed beside the seedling. Its surroundings were planted with numerous spiritual roots and immortal medicine, so much that a rich aura of life had hovered over them, covering up the sun.
If one was to cultivate here, his cultivation would improve at a fast pace.
Jiang Ming suddenly had an idea. He took a step forward to merge himself into the Chaotic World Tree’s seedling. In just a moment, he felt the endless Dao fluctuations, and various rules overflowing in his heart.
The roots of the seedling had been growing slowly by absorbing the power of the World Heart. It was like the great Dao had been rearranging themselves. Jiang Ming couldn’t help but immerse himself in it, difficult to withdraw.
It was like Jiang Ming was comprehending Dao.
After a while, Jiang Ming recollected himself and got a shock on his face.
‘To think that the Chaotic World Tree can assist in cultivation?’ Jiang Ming was stunned.
‘And Riyue Changfeng didn’t know about it? He shouldn’t have known it. Else, he wouldn’t have traded it. Perhaps it’s because I’ve refined it. Hence, I’m capable of merging my mind into it and realize the changes in the Chaotic World Tree’s growth. Anyway, it’s still because of the Human Path Records!’ Jiang Ming exclaimed and retrieved his mind.
When he was about to switch on his Dao Enlightenment Mode, he again divided a wisp of his consciousness to be merged with the Chaotic World Tree’s seedling in his inner world.
With the guidance given, Jiang Ming directly comprehended Dao of Taiyi. In just less than an hour, a strong power surged from him. At the same time, there was rich water vapor permeating the air. In just a moment, Jiang Ming seemed to have been surrounded by a vast sea, which later condensed into a chain.
It was the external manifestation of the Taiyi Water Dao.
With this, Jiang Ming had broken through to the Taiyi Realm. His mana had been transformed, his body had been reorganized, and even his soul had been sublimated. Unfortunately, the transformation of his soul was insignificant, far from reaching the level of qualitative transformation.
Jiang Ming opened his eyes, and he was ecstatic.
‘The accumulated effects of switching on the Dao Enlightenment Mode and the merging of a wisp of my consciousness into the Chaotic World Tree’s seedling had accelerated the speed of my comprehension to a terrific degree! Hence, I managed to comprehend the Taiyi Water Dao in a short time span of an hour! If I were to tell others, who’d believe it!’
Jiang Ming suppressed his excitement and continued cultivating.
The reason why he continued cultivating was for the sublimation and transformation of his inner world. If his inner world was not improved, he could only stay in the Taiyi Realm.
Jiang Ming had already a plan on transforming his small chiliocosm into middle chiliocosm.
Firstly, he had to comprehend 3,000 Taiyi Laws so that he could promote the transformation of his inner world’s laws outside in.
Secondly, he had to strengthen the origin of his inner world up to the edge of transformation.
Thirdly, he had to transform his soul and mind to the Saint Realm.
The first two steps were simple. After all, he had the Supreme Pagoda. Provided he had the Enlightenment Mode switched on continuously, he was able to comprehend Taiyi Laws. And it was even easier for him to accumulate the origin of his inner world.
However, the third step was extremely difficult. Transforming his soul and mind to the Saint Realm was the capability unique to Saint Lords only.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming focused on what he could do in cultivation, and omitted the rest. He managed to comprehend Taiyi Laws one after another. Each time he succeeded, his immortal origin would cohere, his body received baptism, and his soul strengthened slightly.
The more Taiyi Laws he comprehended, the power he accumulated got stronger. However, it was inevitable that the more Taiyi Laws he had comprehended, the repulsive force among them grew stronger as well, hence increasing the time taken to comprehend a new Taiyi Law.
Jiang Ming cultivation speed remained at a fast pace regardless.
In just a blink of an eye, 10,000 years had passed. Nevertheless, it was just a short while outside the Supreme Pagoda.
The mists had dissipated, and the space evoked had been replaced.
Jiang Ming opened his eyes, and rose to his feet only after he remained in a cross-legged position for a while.
He was no longer as indifferent as he used to be.
He stretched, and sighed, “It took me 10,000 years to comprehend 300 Taiyi Laws. This is too slow!”
Jiang Ming was unsatisfied with himself because he had the help of Enlightenment Mode and the Chaotic World Tree. In this case, it would get even slower in the future.
Jiang Ming thought of asking others about it. He had his mind entering the Supreme Order.
It was very quiet in the Chat Room. Hence, Jiang Ming initiated the chat with the question he had in mind.
[Jiang Ming: Is it too slow to take 10,000 years just to comprehend 300 Taiyi Laws?]
[Di Huo: …]
[Feng Wu: …]
[Tian Fozi: …]
[Ao Jiu: Are you talking in a human language?]
[Di Huo: Are you talking in a human language?]
[Huang Quan: Are you talking in a human language?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Hehe, big brother Jiang Ming, Are you talking in a human language?]
[Jiang Ming: I’ve been in Enlightenment Mode all the time. I thought I could comprehend all 3,000 Taiyi Laws in 10,000 years. But it turned out to be only 300 of them. This is too disappointing!]
[Jiang Ming: Don’t tell me that it’s too fast?]
[Ao Jiu: I’m no longer capable of complaining. The way you are showing off, I shall give you 100 marks for it!]
[Di Huo: 100 marks is too little. I think 10,000 marks shall be given instead.]
[Hong Yi: When I managed to comprehend 300 Taiyi Laws, I had activated the time accelerator 18 times, and had switched on Enlightenment Mode many times too. My comprehension ability is that rare in the world, but can be considered as one of the top. It’s also in the top three in this group. Nevertheless, if it’s to be compared to yours, I found out that the comprehension ability of mine that I’m proud of, is utterly nothing!]
The members of the Chat Room had been complaining.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - Does Owning the Saint Weapon Made Me Arrogant
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Does Owning the Saint Weapon Made Me Arrogant
Jiang Ming felt funny looking at those messages. Yet the group members hadn’t finished complaining yet.
[Hong Zhan: I’ve the urge to beat up our Group Admin! It’s well-known that the repulsive force among the laws make it more difficult to comprehend when more laws are comprehended. The difficulty can even increase exponentially! Brother Jiang, I can predict that you’ll be able to step into the Great Overarching Realm soon. Haha, I can definitely wait to take over the position as Group Admin.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, tell me what you need. I’ll try my best to help you!]
[Hong Zhan: Oh, don’t forget to challenge the heavenly ladder to temper your will, which is the hardest one. Once you have a breakthrough, you’ll have only two endings, either you successfully break through or you die!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: So dangerous?]
[Hong Zhan: The World Dao is the most powerful Dao throughout infinite realms. However, when you get to a certain level, its difficulty in breaking through is beyond your imagination. The World Dao is also the most mysterious and may take away your life. Perhaps this is the shackle of the powerful Dao.]
[Hong Zhan: However, based on brother Jiang’s ability, you should be able to go through it. If you were to fail, I don’t think anyone else would!]
[Hong Zhan: As for you, Dongfang Chenxi, unless there’s any great change or sky-defying encounter, small chiliocosm is your limit.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, a tip for you. Please don’t forget to use the privilege as a Group Admin. It’s a sky-defying encounter for us. I’m not joking. Because you took the position as the Group Admin away from me, I’ll do my best to kill you if there’s any possibility.]
[Wang Ye: It’s been proved that the Group Admin will be blessed!]
[Hong Yi: Is the privilege of the Group Admin that sky-defying?]
[Hong Zhan: Fellow Taoist Hong, it’s worth your wait even if it’s billions of years if you aren’t facing any perilous situation! Guys, such info is limited to us only, please don’t spread out.]
[Hong Yi: Thank you!]
......
[Wang Ye: Thank you!]
[Ao Jiu: Thank you! Unfortunately, I wouldn’t have that opportunity!]
[Jiang Ming: If you were to become a Group Admin, I think it wouldn’t be that difficult to achieve Saint Realm provided you have enough points.]
[Hong Zhan: Group Admin, you can now relax yourself. I’m serious. I’m utterly speechless with the points that you have now! Damn it!]
[Huang Quan: I’m so jealous that it’s a pain in the ass!]
[Ao Jiu: Do you have an ass?]
[Huang Quan: You may try it. I promise that your ass will be in great pain!]
[Di Huo: A scene has been appearing in my mind, a skeleton and a dragon…Perfect!]
[Tian Fozi: Perfect!]
[Feng Wu: Dirty-minded men!]
[Ming Fei: Smelly!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Nasty!]
[Jiang Ming: Guys, stop it! Don’t forget that we have ladies here!]
[Jiang Ming: Buying rare immortal grasses, immortal grade spiritual roots, immortal veins, and innate vital essence. Ladies and gentlemen, don’t miss the chance to sell them in exchange for points!]
[Jiang Ming: Brother Hong Zhan, I need as many innate vital essence, chaos vital essence, immortal veins and so on. Don’t worry that I don’t have enough points, just that you don’t have those things!]
[Jiang Ming: By the way, I’ve got a Saint Weapon and a few Demi-Sage Weapons already!]
Jiang Ming’s series of information had silenced the entire group.
After only a while, they began replying, expressing their shock.
[Ao Jiu: To think that you little Golden Immortal has a Saint Weapon and a few Demi-Sage Weapons? Brother Jiang, my Group Admin, are you the one who’s dreaming or I’m the one?]
[Di Huo: I’m dreaming too!]
[Huang Quan: You ain’t a human indeed!]
[Feng Wu: I’ve done my best yet I couldn’t get my hand onto a Quasi-Sage Weapon. And you even have got a Saint Weapon already! Brother Jiang, you’re still amazing, just as always!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Big brother Jiang, you’re the best!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, I’m in awe!]
[Hong Yi: For so many years I’ve been traveling across heaven and earth, I have been blessed with endless blessings and opportunities. Even when I’m walking, I’d be blessed with some encounters that I’d just need to pick up. Nevertheless, I didn’t get any Saint Weapon but only about three Demi-Sage Weapons!]
[Tian Fozi: I feel that you two are showing off!]
[Ao Jiu: This show-off of you two has been so conspicuous that I’m jealous and envious! Damn, why do I feel like beating the two of you up?]
[Huang Quan: Me too! It isn’t long since our Group Admin first joined us. I can still remember he planned to get a Quasi-Sage Weapon, but he has even got a Saint Weapon now. Guys, what do you say about the sky-defying luck of Group Admin? I doubt that he’s the real son of the great Dao. otherwise, this is unexplainable!]
[Hong Zhan: I’m sure that he’s the son of the great Dao! I shall be relying on him from now onwards!]
[Ao Jiu: But you’re the arrogant Hong Zhan, aren’t you?]
[Hong Zhan: Arrogance is nothing before the son of fortune!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, I’ve already prepared lots of stuff that you need! Haha, I don’t have to worry about insufficient points anymore. I shall try to accumulate enough points for two times!]
[Di Huo: For the sake of points, I shall do my best!]
[Ao Jiu: I’ve conquered a world here!]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha, Buddhist luminance has been shoned on numerous beings.]
[Huang Quan: The demon army is attacking in all directions!]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Jiang Ming: Why do I feel guilty?]
[Jiang Ming: Guys, I’m a human after all. And all these are happening because of me. Hence, please treat humans nicely in your respective worlds!]
[Di Huo: Haha, don’t worry, Group Admin. We’re attacking worlds not for massacre but to gain benefits. After conquering a region, we’ll definitely allow the humans there to be autonomous, creating a relatively fair environment!]
[Ao Jiu: Don’t worry, Group Admin!]
[Jiang Ming: Great!]
[Jiang Ming: Please take note that those Great Overarching Dao Vessels, and even Quasi-Sage Weapons may no longer be useful once my inner world has evolved to the middle chiliocosm level. However, I’ll take in all immortal medicine and spiritual roots!]
[Di Huo: Let’s just do some transactions now!]
Jiang Ming accepted all items from the members. In just a short while, he had got more than 100 Great Overarching Dao Vessels. Though they were merely the common ones, they were quite good.
He had also traded many immortal veins and spiritual roots, all of which he merged into his inner world to strengthen his origin. The immortal medicine and spiritual roots in particular, were not only beneficial to the growth of the Chaotic World Tree, it could promote the evolution of his inner world and strengthen his origin.
After the trade, Jiang Ming pondered for a while and decided to sit cross-legged again. He activated the time acceleration mode.
He wanted to arrange all these items he had just obtained while continuing the comprehension of Taiyi Laws.
Time flew by, and 10,000 years had gone. It was just a moment that he had sat on the lotus platform.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet again. While staring at the Dao Enlightenment Sea, his aura was rather indifferent. But Jiang Ming gradually converged his aura till it had vanished.
“This time, I’ve managed to comprehend 200 Taiyi Laws!” Jiang Ming sighed, but he could do nothing.
“There’s a long time to go!” After Jiang Ming recollected himself, he turned and looked at the Battle Towers. He thought he had to gain experience from battles after he had an improvement of his cultivation base and had become more powerful.
The Battle Towers were the best place to do so after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - Hunting for the Heavenly Emperor, Checking Personal Inventory
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Hunting for the Heavenly Emperor, Checking Personal Inventory
??
Jiang Ming didn’t go immediately but checked on the items he had.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base Taiyi Realm
Cultivation method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Special ability: Infinite Transcendence Technique, Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, Return of Infinite Law Finger, Holy Civilization Fist, Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique, etc.
Innate talent: Holy Dao (Tertiary Daoist Body)
Item: Human Path Record, Supreme Order; Chaotic World Tree’s seedling, Saint Province Dao Square, Blood Banner, Sword Tome, Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed; Demi-Sage Weapons: Silver Luminance Battle Armor, Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, Emperor Crown, and Sky Demon Saber; Quasi-Sage Weapons: 16 pieces; Great Overarching Weapons: 266 pieces; Taiyi Weapons: 1888 pieces. Three pieces of Dragon Monarch’s Special Ability Card, four pieces of Vermilion Bird’s Special Ability Card, six pieces of Heavenly Buddha’s Special Ability Card, six pieces of Heavenly Emperor’s Special Ability Card, and etc.
Support: Primary level training zone
‘To think that I’ve got so many good things now!’ Even Jiang Ming was surprised to see the long list of items he had obtained.
‘With so many good things, who am I to be afraid of upon return? Even if the so-called 10 ancient clans dare to provoke, I shall just wipe them all out. However, I shall make a plot so that they’d have an internal strife upon return!’
At the same time Jiang Ming was pondering, he communicated with the Battle Towers to send him in.
He was sent directly to the seventh Battle Tower, where he started from level 1. He actually had passed level 4 but stopped at level 5.
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Level 14 (Golden Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 22166888
Achievements: [Heavenly Immortal Realm: Battle Tower level 37, Heavenly Ladder step 42], [True Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower, level 2 to 5, Heavenly Ladder step 43 to 45], [Mystical Immortal Realm: Fifth Battle Tower, level 6 to 9, Sixth Battle Tower, level 1; Heavenly Ladder step 46 to 48], [Golden Immortal Realm: Sixth Battle Tower, level 2 to 9, Seventh Battle Tower, level 1 to 4; Heavenly Ladder step 49 to 63]
Inside level 1 of the Seventh Battle Tower.
It was the White Dwarf Star in the starry sky. It had been emitting incomparably powerful tearing pressure against him, but Jiang Ming was not affected at all.
If Jiang Ming were to be replaced by another Heavenly Immortal, he would have crashed and died in an instant.
Jiang Ming smiled at a glance of his personal achievement in the Supreme Pagoda.
“With points accumulated over 20 millions and items so cheap, I wonder when I can spend all the points!” He couldn’t help but lament.
“This is utterly the attitude of a tycoon!” Jun Sanqian who appeared opposite Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh. “Why aren’t you going to the Hongmeng Primordial Land?”
“Is that place really important?” Jiang Ming asked.
It wasn’t the first time Jun Sanqian had been mentioning the Hongmeng Primordial Land.
“That’s for sure!” Jun Sanqian said meaningfully, “You’ll never regret going!”
“Let’s just wait a little bit longer, I’m still young after all!”
“You brat!” Jun Sanqian was speechless as he thought, ‘Damn it, young? How many young cultivators are there? But it seems that this kid is indeed very young, not even a fraction of my age.’
“Big brother, do I have to achieve Saint Soul in order for my inner world to evolve to middle chiliocosm?”
Jiang Ming had obtained much information prior to him asking this question. Jiang Ming even had Riyue Changfeng to give him a comprehensive analysis, but he still felt that Jun Sanqian’s words were more trustable.
“As long as you achieve all three of these requirements: 3,000 Taiyi Laws, the accumulation of the inner world to a certain degree, and the Saint Soul, you’d most probably achieve the middle chiliocosm unless you are an idiot!” Jun Sanqian explained, “Of course these three requirements are difficult. It’s probably easy to comprehend the first 2,000 Taiyi Laws but not the rest. The repulsive force among the laws, and the burden of comprehending laws can drive people crazy.Generally, geniuses like Ye Qingxian would need hundreds of billions of years to achieve it provided no accident occurred in between!”
“As for transforming your soul to the Saint Realm, you should know how difficult it is! If the difficulty of comprehending 3,000 Taiyi Laws is one, the difficulty of transforming your mind and will to the Saint Soul would be 100 million!”
“You may also have a breakthrough prior to the transformation of your soul, but the risk is too high! Your soul should be at least at the Demi-Sage Realm to have a higher chance of success. Else, you’ll certainly die!”
“Brother, your current soul has hints of Saint Soul’s traits. Hence, it’d be relatively easy for the transformation in the future. Don’t rush for now!”
Jun Sanqian said.
“Thank you big brother!” Jiang Ming cupped his hands as he bowed. Then he asked again, “Big brother, is there a higher realm on top of the Sea of Chaos?”
Jun Sanqian couldn’t help but guffaw. “You are very ambitious indeed. C’mon, fight me. Let me help temper you!”
“Big brother, please!” Jiang Ming didn’t dwell on the question, and fought Jun Sanqian directly.
This time, he didn’t conjure any clones nor evoke Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. He merely fought with his personal strength. He eventually had to evoke Infinite Transcendence Technique to take Jun Sanqian down.
Jiang Ming passed then passed level 2, level 3, and level 4, one after another. He even passed level 5 with difficulty, but failed at level 6.
Although he had a breakthrough in his cultivation base, his combat power didn’t improve a lot. It was considered excellent with such an achievement.
Unfortunately, because Jiang Ming had just passed a level, and he was already at the Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm, he only obtained 10,000 points as his reward.
…
On the main square, Jiang Ming landed beside Luo Heng and Ye Qingxian.
Jiang Ming didn’t spend a long time in the Battle Towers this time.
“Which level?” Ye Qingxian asked. She saw Jiang Ming had just come out from the Battle Towers.
“Only passed level 5!” Jiang Ming said helplessly, “It’s been too difficult!”
Ye Qingxian rolled her eyes. “The level 5 of the seventh Battle Tower and it’s too difficult? Brother Luo, do you think this guy deserves a beating?”
“More than that!” Luo Heng was gnashing his teeth.
The level 5 of the seventh Battle Tower? Such a combat power was astounding indeed.
“Stop, just stop talking about it!” Jiang Ming quickly changed the topic. He looked at Luo Heng and said, “Brother Luo, I’ll help you out after you join the Chat Room!”
“Can you help me?” Luo Heng was startled. Then, he smiled wryly, “My ability is limited. I can’t manage to utilize any strong artifacts!”
