“You only have to remember that I am going to help you out when you join the Chat Room, and stop thinking about the rest!” This time, Jiang Ming talked to Luo Heng telepathically, “Don’t tell anyone other than Ms. Ye and I!”
Luo Heng was alarmed, and nodded seriously.
Jiang Ming requested for Ye Qingxian’s help again. “I still need your help. Please help me to continue buying immortal medicines, spiritual roots, immortal veins, and so on!”
Then, Jiang Ming immediately transferred 500,000 points to Ye Qingxiang.
“You are indeed a tycoon!” Ye Qingxian grinned.
There were so many geniuses in the main square, working hard and even spending all they had just for the sake of a point or two. However, this Jiang Ming had immediately transferred her half a million.
Jiang Ming was totally not a human being at all.
After Jiang Ming chatted with the duo for a while, he returned to the Chuyang Peak.
He laid on the rattan chair and swayed leisurely.
“It’s still more peaceful here!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
He then checked on the Human Path Records for Chong Shan, and found out that Chong Shan was still rushing back to his clan along with Jin Hao and other Venerates.
‘It’s not a good time yet!’ Jiang Ming suppressed the thought of attacking them. He had to wait longer.
Days had returned to normal. Jiang Ming continued drinking and eating, receiving many rewards. In fact, he had been spending more time enjoying sex with his Junior Sister Phoenix. They had left signs of them everywhere in the manor.
Besides, Jiang Ming would enter the Supreme Pagoda to comprehend Taiyi Laws from time to time, in preparation for the evolution of his inner world.
…
Numerous years had passed.
On this day, after Jiang Ming checked on the Human Path Record, he smirked. “It’s finally a chance!”
“Chong Shan, Immortal Venerate Tai Yin, Immortal Emperor Tai Yuan, I’m going to present you all with a super big gift!”
“Oh Tai Yuan, since ancient times you’ve been plotting but unfortunately, you shouldn’t have been cooperating with the 10 ancient clans in provoking me!”
Jiang Ming rose to his feet, overflowing with killing intentions.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - Consecutive Slaughtering of Nine Venerates
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Consecutive Slaughtering of Nine Venerates
Although the Status recorded on the Human Path Records wasn’t that detailed, the information given was more than enough. Examples were the current Status given.
Chong Shan: Began cultivating in seclusion. He planned to spend about six years deducing his personal special ability with the hope of improving and sublimating it further to the extreme.
Immortal Venerate Tai Yin: Cultivating alone in the Moon Palace.
Heavenly Buddha: After preaching, he furtively arranged many of his disciples to be the spy in various parts of the world.
Vermilion Bird: Entering the deepest area of the Demon Holy Palace with the hope to obtain the strongest item left by the Demon Saint.
Dragon Monarch: With the hope to improve himself, he continued tempering the dragon carved pillar so that it would merge into the world upon completion. At the same time, he had been contacting some elders to form an alliance.
Jin Hao: Had just enjoyed life with 18 female scorpions and was figuring out ways to deal with Jiang Ming, and hunt for human beings.
Giant: Enjoying a deep sleep, the most meaningful thing to do, in his nest located in an abyss he built himself.
…
Because it was the golden chance to take actions, Jiang Ming was ecstatic.
‘Threatening me with human massacre? Ha! I won’t be able to sleep in peace without making you all go extinct!’ As Jiang Ming thought, he conjured out nine clones.
Each of them held a jade amulet with a different special ability such as the special abilities of the Dragon Monarch, Vermilion Bird, Tai Wuji, Great Monarch Tian Song, among others.
One of them plunged into the Human Path Record and got to a realm privately opened up. Although it wasn’t a complete one, it could carry experts cultivating in it. It was where the Golden Spirit Clan was located.
......
In an ancient palace, which was the most powerful and mightiest, was where Jin Hao, who was sitting cross-legged on an immortal gold, could be seen. While he was practicing breathing, he was thinking on how he could deal with Jiang Ming and destroy the Tianyuan Realm.
It was at this moment that he suddenly felt something and opened his eyes. He was shocked to see a human figure enveloping in golden luminance appearing before him.
Before Jin Hao could react, he was stiffened under an imprisonment power. Following that, a golden luminance of a finger was directed at his forehead, destroying his Primal Spirit which was trying to evoke special ability in an instant.
Pff…
A finger penetrated Jin Hao’s skull, and destroyed his soul. It was at the last moment of his life that his Primal Spirit vibrated, sending out doubts in despair.
“This is my palace! It’s surrounded by 72 layers of array formations! Even the palace itself is a Great Overarching Dao Vessel. Alas, it’s supposed that no one can enter without my permission! How can you come in quietly?”
“This is the finger of Lord Buddha! Heavenly Buddha, why are you doing this to me? Why…”
Jin Hao’s voice of despair reverberated in the void, and eventually stopped with resentment.
The clone smiled, and quickly rummaged through the palace for treasures and Dao vessels. After he had collected all of them, he returned through the Human Path Record.
On Chuyang Peak.
When the first clone had returned, the second one left.
Xue Bing, Giant, Niu Er…and the last one was Xiang Ba. When he was killed, the commotion created was extraordinarily loud. A sword qi split the heaven, smashed the earth, and even divided the small world opened up by the ancient Mammoth Clan into two.
It was indeed earth-shattering that all experts of the clan were surprised. Unfortunately, they only discovered the divided corpse of Xiang Ba, and the remaining terrific Sword Sambodha.
“This is the Taishang Unemotional Sword Sambodha of the Taishang Sword Sect!” A great monarch of the ancient Mammoth Clan was burned with rage after he investigated. “How dare the Taishang Sword Sect trespassed our forbidden land and killed the elder! They have gone too far, gone too far indeed!”
“Great monarch, are you sure that the culprit is the Taishang Sword Sect?” A relatively young expert muttered, “The Venerates of the Taishang Sword Sect have died tragically one after another. Even Tai Jian had died in the Abyss. I think Tai Wuji is the only Venerate left currently. Do you think he alone would dare to provoke us? I feel something seems not right.”
“Logically the Taishang Sword Sect should be in hiding. But why do they want to provoke us?” The great monarch frowned. “This is indeed illogical. Could it be a scheme? However, are there any other Venerates who master the Unemotional Sword Sambodha in the world? The answer is a resounding no!”
It was at this moment that a stream of light came penetrating the void. The great monarch caught it. When he learned about the information in it, his facial expression changed in an instant.
“Fellow Taoist Xue Bing has been killed!” The great monarch’s face was very gloomy.
“Xue Bing?”
“Yes, she is killed by the special ability Heaven Splitting Claw unique to Dragon Monarch. It has been confirmed!”
“How could it be?”
All the experts in the surroundings felt that something was not right.
Immediately followed after were streams of light coming.
“Jin Hao is killed by a great special ability of the Fo Sect!”
“Niu Er died in the inextinguishable flame. It was the special ability of Vermilion Bird!”
“The godly body of Giant has been transformed into a forest. It’s the special ability of Great Monarch Tian Song.”
…
The great monarch of the ancient Mammoth Clan had almost gone crazy. The experts nearby felt chill down their spines.
“Great monarch, does it mean that we are targeted by all forces in the world?” A middle-aged expert said with fear, “Otherwise, they wouldn’t attack in unison. But why do they kill only one Venerate in each clan? All these nine Venerates in addition to Shi Kuang, who was killed by Jiang Ming, were those 10 Venerates who went out the last time. Could it be that these incidents are merely a deterrent?”
“If they were to besiege us, they should have struck us all. This is weird!” The great monarch was confused, but the killing intentions shown in his eyes had got stronger. “Anyway, they’re initiating a war against us. Because they have insulted us, we’ll have to take our revenge, or we, as the 10 ancient clans, would be facing our downfall and extinction!”
At this time, there were streams of light coming again, bringing the news from within their own clan, and the other clans.
After the great monarch read the news, his face changed drastically again.
“Great monarch, what’s it?”
“There have been a lot of rumors outside, saying that Chong Shan of the Purple-eyed Demon Cow Clan is the avatar of the Heavenly Emperor Taiyuan!”
“H-how is this possible?”
“Yes, how is this possible?”
“Great monarch, does the rumor explain how the Heavenly Emperor becameChong Shan? If Chong Shan is the Heavenly Emperor, why didn’t he lead us to assist when the Heaven Court was collapsing? This is not logic, isn’t it? I think they are trying to divide us before they round us all up!”
“I’ve the same thought too! Hold on, let me go looking for Chong Shan to initiate a meeting involving all 10 clans to discuss countermeasures!”
The Mammoth Clan was not the only one who did so, the other ancient clans too. They called out Chong Shan, who had just gone into his seclusion.
“What? Niu Er has been killed? And the suspect is Vermilion Bird?”
“What? The other nine clans have one Venerate being killed? And they are all the venerates who went out last time?”
“What? They are killed by the special abilities of Heavenly Buddha, Vermilion Bird, Dragon Monarch, Tai Wuji, and the Great Monarch Tian Song?”
“What? They said that I’m an avatar of the Heavenly Emperor?”
Chong Shan was extremely shocked. He first thought of Jiang Ming because Jiang Ming knew about his identity. Hence, he might be spreading it out. However, he couldn’t explain how Jiang Ming was capable of killing Niu Er and the other Venerates with different special abilities of other Venerates.
‘Can it be that he works together with the Heavenly Buddha and likes to besiege us? Or the other forces unite because they are afraid of our 10 clans? And Jiang Ming took this opportunity to spread out my details? However, if they are besieging us, why only one of each clan is killed?’
Chong Shan remained calm as thoughts ran across his mind as he was trying to analyze their situation. However, he didn’t manage to convince himself with a logical explanation for each assumption that he had made. Hence, he became very irritated.
Then, he was invited to join the meeting with great monarchs of the ten clans.
…
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was standing with hands behind his back, smiling.
‘I’ve finally taken my revenge after all those 10 Venerates are all killed! Spreading out the details of Chong Shan has made this action imperfect. Anyway, let it be a reminder for Tai Yuan!’
As Jiang Ming pondered, he called out the Human Path Record to check on Chong Shan’s response.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - The 50-Year Period Is Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: The 50-Year Period Is Up
The 10 ancient clans had called up a meeting and had a few conclusions.
First, the Demon Holy Palace and the other forces had been united to fight against them.
Second, they didn’t initiate a great war but killed one of each clan as a warning because they were afraid of the 10 ancient clans’ revolts.
Third, the reason why they were spreading news about Chong Shan as an avatar of the Heavenly Emperor was to divide the 10 ancient clans. Once the plan was succeeded, the 10 ancient clans wouldn’t be far away from being exterminated. After all, the 10 ancient clans had massacred a lot in ancient times.
Fourth, the 10 ancient clans shall mobilize all their powers to monitor external situations.
Fifth, the 10 ancient clans shall be closing their doors, acting in low-profile and stop provoking any issues.
Sixth, the 10 ancient clans shall work more closely together.
As for fighting against the Tianyuan Realm? The idea was suppressed in an instant when one Venerate raised it up. After all, the 10 ancient clans had to weasel out of the predicament first.
Jiang Ming laughed.
He continued flipping through the Human Path Record to check on Heavenly Buddha and the likes. It was as expected, these oldies were all stunned after they learned about the news.
They were certain that they were not the one who did the slaughtering, and were wondering why their special abilities had been applied. They thought someone might have put the blame on them or some forces might have united to stir up chaos in the world.
The Heavenly Buddha was magnanimous enough to take the initiative in contacting experts such as Vermilion Bird and Dragon Monarch. Heavenly Buddha couldn’t believe that all of them told him they were not the culprits.
The seed of doubts had thereby planted in all their minds. With their unstable and improbable relationships, they became doubly vigilant against each other.
......
These findings had made Jiang Ming guffawed.
“Just give me another 80 years, and I’ll grate all of you on the ground, harshly!” He reached out and grabbed with a firm grip. If it wasn’t because of the requirement of the system that limited his movement, he would have gone to cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land of the Supreme Pagoda. He was merely waiting for the time to pass.
Even though he didn’t care about the forces of Vermilion Bird and the likes, he didn’t want to be disturb. Now that he had taken his move, he would have a relatively long period of peace. Moreover, with his particularity, who would dare to simply fight against him?
“Little Phoenix!”
“Senior Brother, anything?”
“Life is too boring!”
“Humph, you want to bully me again. Anyway, what about me taking the initiative this time?”
“You taking the initiative? Don’t tell me you know some special position?”
“I’ve just learned 72 methods in total. They’re just nice to be applied to you!”
“You are murdering your husband, aren’t you? C’mon, I’ll just standstill!”
“Lay down!”
“Sure!”
Jiang Ming had been very docile. However, he felt somewhat miserable at the end of the day.
Time flew by quickly because it waited for no one.
Things were fickle. In the Jiuyang Sect, there were people breaking through almost every day. Hence, the sect was getting stronger as more people became immortals.
Even though they didn’t go out, they would have a large amount of cultivating resources. They could even temper themselves in the various types of space evoked by the Dao vessels provided by Jiang Ming.
Hence, there were more and more experts in the sect, even in the entire Tianyuan Realm.
The first to achieve the Golden Immortal Ream, was unexpected even by Jiang Ming. He was neither Xi Yao nor Hao Chen, the Peak Master of Shaoyang Peak, but Ye Ming, who had joined Jiuyang Sect.
This former peerless genius of Tianyuan School, had Space Illusion Divine Body. Under such a perfect cultivation environment, his potential had been excitated, and he improved himself at a fast pace, faster than everyone else.
His breakthrough was followed by Xi Yao, Hao Chen, Sect Leader Yan Yan, Liu Changkong, and others.
As for the Immortal Realm? More than half of the Tianyuan Realm’s residents had become immortal. It was in fact, due to many of the commoners starting late.
Every resident had actually started cultivating long ago. What’s more surprising was that many of the new born babies had strong special body types. Some even had the Innate Dao Body. Such was extremely unbelievable.
Even when Mountain Master Tian Yuan witnessed all of these, he couldn’t help exclaim joyfully that this Tianyuan Realm was indeed blessed by great Dao, and fate.
Jiang Ming only smiled when he heard the remarks. It was because he knew it was due to the system, not fate.
Time had never stopped. Day after day, the sun and moon had been taking turns to carry out respective responsibilities.
On this day, Jiang Ming did a stretch after he had a good sleep. He looked at the sun in the east, feeling good.
“Thirty years have gone in a blink of an eye. Time has passed really fast!” Jiang Ming lamented.
It was only about a month before the 50-years period was up.
He had also turned 68 years old. He was already an old man if it was based on the calculation of the mortal world. Hence, he was supposed to be enjoying spending time with his family of three generations. Nevertheless, he didn’t only have a child, his Junior Sister Phoenix had left.
His Junior Sister Linglong came back ten years ago. Because of the competition in the Inheritance Space, she needed to cultivate whole-heartedly. Hence, she brought away all nine clones along with her after her stay for a period of time.
He was currently living in serenity, purifying his mind and diminishing his desires. Nevertheless, he wasn’t very free because he had to cultivate inside the Supreme Pagoda often.
Currently, he had comprehended all 3,000 Taiyi Laws, and had accumulated the inner world’s origin to the unprecedented limit. Hence, he had achieved two requirements out of three to evolve his inner world.
It was only his soul that had yet to transform into the Saint Soul. Although he had gone half way through, the last step was too difficult.
Jiang Ming did feel he could go for the middle chiliocosm at any time, and had a higher percentage to break through smoothly. But he didn’t want to gamble with his life. He had, after all, sufficient time to do so. Therefore, he thought it would be better that he broke through only after he was 100 percent confident about it.
“Brother!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan paced over through the sky and landed beside Jiang Ming. He sat directly on the bence, and picked up the teapot. As he pulled, a fresh spring water was injected into the teapot.
Flame was ignited beneath the teapot automatically, and in a blink of an eye, water vapor began surging.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan grabbed a few tea leaves and put them into the teapot, boiling them. In just a moment, the fragrance permeated the air.
“Your tea leaves here are still the best!” As Mountain Master Tian Yuan smelled the tea fragrance, he complimented. Then, he poured himself two cups.
“Big brother, it’s not that I didn’t give you, yet you still come here for it!” Jiang Ming sat opposite him, speechless.
“Isn’t it too lonely to be alone?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan picked up a teacup, blew it, and took a sip, which filled his mouth cavity. “Brother, do you know the intention of coming over?”
“Are you preparing to break through to the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm?”
“Haha, I know I can’t hide it from you. I thought I won’t have a chance for the breakthrough anymore. I didn’t expect to have such promising improvement since I got here, and I’m about to break through to the middle stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm.”
“Congratulations!”
“C’mon, don’t just say it!”
“What do you need?”
“Tea leaves!”
“I knew it!” Jiang Ming said helplessly, “It’s on the rack there, isn’t it? You can take it anytime.”
“I’m stealing if I take it without asking!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan grabbed, and two bottles of tea leaves fell on his embrace, and then disappeared. “These are enough for a few years.”
“You’re too polite, aren’t you? Anyway, there’s something else right?”
“Aren’t you aware of it?”
“I do!” Jiang Ming took a sip, and rose to his feet looking around. “There are more immortals in the Tianyuan Realm but our Tianyuan Realm appears to be too small that many wanted to go out exploring.”
He had been aware of it a long time ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - The Opening of the Tianyuan Realm, Ming, Please Cook
chapters.content:
Chapter 378:
The Opening of the Tianyuan Realm, Ming, Please Cook?
When the people learned about the vastness of the world outside, many would want to witness for themselves. It was particularly when they got stronger, they would feel that their home world was too narrow. Hence, they would hope to go out, enhancing their knowledge and experience.
However, all of them knew the difficulty to maintain the stability of the Tianyuan Realm. Hence, nobody dared to voice out.
The Mountain Master Tian Yuan had felt it a long time ago.
“It’s not a long term solution to stay here all the time.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said, “Brother, are you afraid that they would be targeted when they are out, right?”
Jiang Ming nodded. “We’ve many enemies. The Abyss, although dilapidated, and has only few experts, once they manage to seize opportunity, they would take on their attack. After all, I did kill many of their Venerates. And because almost all of the Taishang Sword Sect’s Venerates died in my hand, Tai Wuji and the other disciples of the sect must be hating me. Another one is the 10 ancient clans. Because I forcefully killed Shi Kuang that day, they may take their revenge whenever there’s any chance even though they’ve been hiding recently.”
“I can protect them if they remain in the Tianyuan Realm. If they were to go outside, I can’t do anything already! Besides, because of the special situation here, once the Tianyuan Realm is opened, we can no longer prevent it from being infiltrated from the outside. There will definitely be a lot of mess at that time.”
Jiang Ming voiced his concern.
“You are right!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan nodded. But he smiled as he said, “Brother, you’ve been worrying too much! Everyone has their own fate, just like the former Tianyuan World which was divided into the east, west, south, north and the sea. But what happened to the world eventually? All had collapsed except the Eastern Region. This is called life and also luck. You can protect them for some time, but can you protect them forever?”
“Moreover, the residents of Tianyuan Realm used to be commoners, who would die within 100 years. Yet many of them have become immortals, and it wouldn’t be too difficult for the rest to become one too!”
“It’s such a luxurious wish to become immortal but because of you, their life span has been lengthened a lot. This is already a great blessing, isn’t it? Those who are satisfied with their current situation would stay back to enjoy their wonderful life. But those with great ambition would leave eventually. Hence, why shall you lock the realm all the time? As for the mess after reopening, it’d be easy to deal with. You just need to set a rule whereby whoever leaves can never return!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan gave a reasonable and well-rounded analysis, which shocked Jiang Ming.
“I always have a feeling that you seem to have persecutory delusion disorder.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan added, “Based on your power currently, who would dare to provoke you? Who would dare to confront our people? When you killed Shi Kuang, you’ve shown the world that you are protective of your people. Hence, if anyone was to attack, they’d definitely take into consideration the revenge from you.”
Jiang Ming gave a wry smile as he retorted, “I’m not having any persecutory delusions, I’m just being stable.”
“Ha!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan sneered, “Stable? How old are you? Look at me, I’m already millions of years old, and you’re being more stable than I do? No, you aren’t being stable but thoughtless.”
Jiang Ming was left speechless. He eventually let out a sigh. “Big brother, you’re right that everyone has their own fate. I’ve helped them to become immortals, and taken good care of them. When I open up the Tianyuan Realm, it’d be their fate if they were to go out. After all, I owe them nothing!”
“It’s best that you can have such a thought!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan guffawed. “In the past, I didn’t want to build a force just because I thought it’s troublesome. If you were to take in disciples, you’d have to train and take care of them. When they’re out, you’ll have to give them protective items and worry for them. If they were to be killed, you’ll have to take revenge for them. These are very troublesome, aren’t they? And that Kunpeng died because of his problematic son, didn’t he?”
“Big brother, you are just lazy!” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Aren’t you the same?”
“Yes, me too. Haha, I’m lazier than you do.”
The two guffawed.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan left. He didn’t return to his residence but directly flew out of the Tianyuan Realm, above the Tianyuan Sea.
Jiang Ming looked over. There were many palaces suspended mid-air. Each palace represented a Great Overarching Golden Immortal expert.
There was also a floating island. It was surrounded by flowing luminance, and had a rainbow hanging on it. That was the island built by many Great Overarching experts for the purpose of communication and trading.
Even Great Monarch Wan Lian was living on the Tianyuan Sea.
The Infinite Realm Auction House was still around, proving that Riyue Changfeng had yet to leave.
Jiang Ming stepped into the air, looking around before he spoke in a voice that could be spread throughout all corners of Tianyuan Realm. “From today onwards, Tianyuan Realm is open. Everyone of you can exit and enter the realm freely. However, if you were to go out, your life is your own responsibility!”
Jiang Ming returned to the balcony as soon as he finished speaking.
In fact, the Tianyuan Realm was not closed. It was merely because the outside world was too dangerous as soon as they descended to this world. Hence, no one dared to go out. Over time, It had become an unspoken rule. No one dared to go out without the decree of Jiang Ming.
Now that Jiang Ming had spoken, the unspoken rule had become ineffective.
Some immortals in various parts of the Tianyuan Realm were ecstatic when they heard Jiang Ming. After they bowed in the direction of Chuyang Peak, they started packing. Half way through, they hesitated.
They began contemplating whether they should go out. Tianyuan Realm was the safest sacred land for cultivation. Because they heard that it was the chaotic Infinite Realm Battlefield out there, they were wondering whether they would survive with their personal strength if they were to go out.
Those impulsive experts thought of this, and became indecisive.
Nevertheless, there were some experts who left eventually. After all, they were curious about the outside world, and hoped to witness the bigger world outside.
…
In the main hall of Taiyang Peak.
Sect Leader Yan Yan glanced at the direction of Chuyang Peak before he returned to the main hall, where the other First Seats were sitting. He said, “The Realm Master has voiced out. Hence, we need to make a change too. Shall we allow our disciples to go out as well?”
The Realm Master was the title given to Jiang Ming.
“Sect Master!” Dongfang Lie, the First Seat of Lieyang Peak was the first one who voiced out. “Others may not know about the dangers out there but we do. With our current strength, we’d mostly be killed if we were to go out. However, since the Realm Master has spoken, we can’t stop our disciples from going out. We can set some rules instead. What about taking the Mystical Immortal Realm as the minimum requirement? Only those who have achieved the Mystical Immortal Realm can choose to travel out there, tempering themselves.”
“Would the Mystical Immortal Realm be too low?” Hao Chen, the First Seat of Shaoyang Peak, frowned. “The current Tianyuan Sea is famous throughout the infinite realms. Hence, there are many experts, including spies who come here. Moreover, we seem to have a lot of enemies. If the weak were to go out, they could be killed easily. Just look at the Tianyuan Sea, how many Great Overarching Golden Immortals are there?”
“Yes, the weak would be killed if they were to go out!” Chang Ming, the First Seat of Laoyang Peak, nodded in agreement. “Tianyuan Realm is the sacred land of cultivation and has a lot of spaces conjured by various supreme Dao vessels for self tempering. If one is restless, and wants to go out, we shall throw them directly into the Reincarnation Tower for training!”
“This is too much!” The First Seat Dong Fanglie shook his head. “It’s our natural tendency to explore the wider world. I am even looking forward to it. We shall just set a limit, which can also be a motivator.”
All First Seats gave their own opinions.
“Junior Brother Gu, what do you think?” Sect Leader Yan Yan turned to Gu Hai.
“It’s simple!” Gu Hai smiled. “We shall just let whoever wishes to go out but we limit the region where they can go! The Tianyuan Sea itself is very huge, far bigger than our Tianyuan Realm, and even more than 100-times bigger than our former Tianyuan World. Hence, it’s bigger enough for them to explore and temper themselves. Moreover, because the Tianyuan Sea consists of experts from our human race, it is not dangerous. Since we can kill two birds with one stone, why not?”
“Alright, this would be our conclusion then!” Sect Master Yan Yan immediately made the decision.
As soon as the meeting had ended, Gu Hai couldn’t wait to return to Chuyang Peak.
“Old man, you still know how to come back!” Jiang Ming shouted from a distance.
“You brat, I’m the First Seat, the Peak Master, and your master. Are you not happy that I’m back?” As soon as Gu Hai landed on Chuyang Peak, he pushed Jiang Ming away so that he could lay on the rattan chair and sway leisurely. “Quick, serve me!”
Gu Hai was pointing at the teapot.
“Sure, please wait a moment.” Jiang Ming could do nothing else other than serving Gu Hai with tea.
Gu Hai took a sip and enjoyed the tea flavor. Then, he requested, “Ming, I’m hungry. You don’t have to cook a lot, just 108 dishes will do.”
Jiang Ming scratched his head. If Gu Hai wasn’t his master, he would have slapped him. But because Gu Hai was his master, and he as the disciple had to do what was requested.
“Alright, please wait for a while. You’re my master, after all!” Jiang Ming said helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - Gu Hai: Am I in a State of Exaltation? Hehe, Indeed I Am
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Gu Hai: Am I in a State of Exaltation? Hehe, Indeed I Am
??
It was a large table. It was a new one because the old table couldn’t accommodate 108 dishes.
It had to be 108 dishes as per master’s request.
“Ming, you’re a filial disciple indeed!” Gu Hai was even more happy than drinking the immortal wine when he saw a table full of delicacies. He rubbed his hands, grabbed the chopsticks from Jiang Ming, and when he wanted to pick up food, he was startled.
He stared at the chopsticks and asked with surprise, “Is this an immortal weapon?”
“It can be known as the Golden Immortal Weapon!” Jiang Ming replied. “In fact, this table, and these bowls and plates are all of the Golden Immortal Weapons. They are of one set, my friend gave me!”
It was indeed given by his friend, Hong Zhan. In fact, he had too many little gifts from Hong Zhan because Hong Zhan had earned a great amount of points through many trades between the two in the last few decades. Hong Zhan was on top of the world, and said that it was a sky-defying encounter to have met Brother Jiang. Hence, Hong Zhan would occasionally give him some little gifts.
For Hong Zhan and Jiang Ming, a set of Golden Immortal Weapons, which were merely utensils, were indeed little things.
“These are all Golden Immortal Weapons? These 108 plates and many little bowls?” Gu Hai’s eyes popped out, expressing an unbelievable look. “What encounter have you actually got? Are you the child of the Natural Laws of Heaven? No, don’t tell me, you must not tell me. I’m afraid that my heart can’t take it, and explore.”
“These are just some little things. Master, if you like them, just take them all after mean!” Jiang Ming picked up the chopstick to pick up a ball and put it in his mouth, and said with his mouth full, “Master, these delicacies are good. Try?”
“Sure!” Gu Hai also picked up a ball and gobbled it. He was amazed. “The taste is too wonderful with layers of taste. Ehh…”
He suddenly closed his eyes as his aura began to condense, and his power became stronger. After he opened his eyes, he said with amazement, “To feel the sudden increment of my mana, and further condensing my Primal Spirit, Ming, is this ball the immortal pill?”
“It’s just some food ingredients my friend gave me!” Jiang Ming simply explained.
“What ingredients?”
“The bodies of Golden Immortal, Taiyi, and Great Overarching little demons. There were also many immortal medicines, immortal fruits and immortal seasonings!”
“What the f*ck, the body of the Great Overarching little demon?” Gu Hai was stunned.
“Barely good to serve!”
“Baerly?” Gu Hai was speechless. He squinted at Jiang Ming, his own disciple, as he snorted, “You brat have started to be pleased with yourself, haven’t you?”
“To think that you’ve just realized!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but guffaw. “Of course, these are nothing to me! Master, if you were to stay here for a year, you will definitely achieve the Golden Immortal Realm!”
“A year and I’ll achieve the Golden Immortal Realm?” Gu Hai pointed at his own nose.
Gu Hai hadn’t been cultivating frequently in the past few years. However, because of Jiang Ming giving special treatment, he had achieved the True Immortal Realm. Even the Sect Master Yan Yan said that he had been admiring Gu Hai for having a good disciple, who would help Gu Hai without the need of Gu Hai doing anything.
“I’m also confident that you can achieve even the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, let alone the Golden Immortal Realm!” Jiang Ming patted his chest. “How’s it, do you want to stay on the mountain?”
“Life is too bitter here.” For some time Gu Hai hesitated, he eventually shook his head. “Forget about it, I still prefer life in the city. It’s more lively.”
“I think you want to be with Junior Uncle Yin Yue right?”
“Aren’t you talking nonsense?”
“When would you give me a Junior Sister?”
“F*ck off!” Gu Hai was enraged. “I’ve only got a female disciple, and you have taken her. Yet you want me to give you my daughter to be your junior sister? Are you looking for a fight?”
“Master, you’re so dirty-minded!” Jiang Ming pouted. “I’ve got too much good stuff here. When you’ve got a child, I can take care of him, and train him to the Great Overarching Realm so that he can lead the Jiuyang Sect to be famous throughout heaven and earth. It’s wonderful, isn’t it?”
“Nah.” Gu Hai was still furious. He rose to his feet, fluttered his sleeves to roll up the entire table and left. “Since you have got too much good stuff. Don’t eat all these, let me share them with my brothers instead.”
“You just want to show off, don’t you?”
“What? Do you have an opinion?”
“How would I dare to have any?”
Jiang Ming cupped his hands and bowed toward the figure, which had flown away. As the figure disappeared, Jiang Ming laughed. ‘This old man has been so old now, yet he still likes to show off. Anyway, it’s best that he can live a worriless life. You used to protect me, now you shall enjoy your life while I protect this place.’
Jiang Ming laid on the rattan chair, and swayed leisurely. A tablet appeared in his hand, and he started watching the people singing, dancing, having fun, moaning, and various others with excitement.
As for cultivation? He was not in a rush, truly not in a rush.
…
In the main hall of Jiuyang Sect, Gu Hai flew in while controlling the large table.
“Old fellow Gu, you actually brought here a table of dishes, looking so delicate!” Dong Fanglie, the First Seat of Lieyang Peak pouted. Then, his eyes lit up as he said, “Don’t tell me you got them from there? If it’s real, it’d be a great encounter! Haha, old fellow Gu, I’ll have to take advantage this time.”
“Little Dongfang, I won’t give you because you called me an old fellow!” Gu Hai snorted, and put down the table. Then, he fluttered his sleeves, put his hands behind his back, and raised his chin. “Gentlemen, observe and tell me what’s so special about this table of delicacies!”
“Senior Brother Gu, are these plates, bowls, and chopsticks the Golden Immortal Weapons?” The First Seat Hao Chen made his way near the table. His icy cold face had been replaced by surprise. “These are all Immortal Golden Weapons indeed. I’m sure.”
“What? All of them are the Golden Immortal Weapons?” Sect Leader Yan Yan came over. He stared at them while evoked his divine eyes, carefully observing them. Then, he gasped. “Yes, all of them indeed. H-how is it possible? T-this is too luxurious, isn’t it?”
The Sect Leader Yan Yan wasn’t the only one in shock, all First Seat in the main hall too. ‘Damn it, we can’t even get a Golden Immortal Weapon yet you use them as utensils. Look at their numbers, there were more than 100 of them already.’
“These are nothing but utensils! Just wait until you taste these foods. They are all made up of Golden Immortal, Taiyi and Great Overarching demons, and are seasoned with immortal medicines and spiritual roots. Just eating a mouth will strengthen your mana, increase your power, and temper your Primal Spirit. After this meal, one may even have a great breakthrough.” Gu Hai said with disdain.
“What the f*ck, Great Overarching demon as the ingredient?” Dong Fanglie was completely stunned. He was not new to cultivation, hence he knew how strong a Great Overarching expert was. He was surprised to see that a Great Overarching demon would be used as an ingredient.
“Junior Brother Gu, are you sure?” Yan Yan was shivering.
“Have I ever lied before?” Gu Hai smiled. “I went back there and Ming purposely cooked 108 dishes for me. But because I think I can’t enjoy it alone, I moved the entire table here. Ming also gave me all these Golden Immortal utensils for my daily use but when I told him I can’t take them, do you know what he replied? That kid replied in a tone of complete indifference: It’s all little things that I’d be embarrassed to give you as a gift. Master, since you like them, just keep them!”
All the people present in the main hall pouted. They were envious of Gu Hai, and when they shifted their focus to the food on the table, they couldn’t wait to taste them.
Gu Hai stroked his beard with pride as he thought, ‘I shall go back there once in a while!’

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - The Return of Junior Sister: 10 of Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: The Return of Junior Sister: 10 of Them
??
On Chuyang Peak.
With a scan of Jiang Ming consciousness, he had discovered the situation in Jiuyang’s main hall. He couldn’t help but laugh when he saw his master in the stage of exaltation. ‘This old man is still the same.’
Then, Jiang Ming heard the Sect Master asking Gu Hai regarding the matter of the reopening of the Tianyuan Realm.
Gu Hai patted his head, and replied with chagrin that he had forgotten to ask about it. Nevertheless, he said that it would be better for all the First Seats of Jiuyang Sect to stay in the Tianyuan Realm so that they wouldn’t trouble Jiang Ming if they were to be targeted outside.
All First Seats nodded their heads in agreement. After all, they were all satisfied with their current condition. They felt they enjoyed cultivating quietly, improving their cultivation base from time to time, and obtained great encounters occasionally.
They were no longer young and stubborn but old men with experience. Hence, they were appreciating the benefits of having a peaceful cultivating environment instead of fighting and looking for encounters out there than anybody else.
“My master is still the best!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
He then called out the Human Path Record and checked on Chong Shan.
After more than 20 years of hiding, Chong Shan was now prepared to stir up chaos in the world, and to destroy the Tianyuan Realm. Chong Shan was currently trying to persuade the other nice clans to go out of their clans again.
“If you dare to come, Chong Shan, and Tai Yuan, I’ll kill the two of you!” Jiang Ming snorted, but he didn’t take any immediate action. To him the longer the peaceful time the better. He needed time to evolve his inner world into middle chiliocosm. By that time, he would be on top of the chain. He could easily kill Chong Shan and Tai Yuan.
The Heavenly Buddha was figuring out how he could take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor. Both Vermilion Bird and the Dragon Monarch had similar thoughts as the Heavenly Buddha too.
Tai Wuji, on the other hand, had no such thoughts as he was cultivating quietly. His Status showed nothing about his intention to take revenge. However, Jiang Ming remained paying attention to him because of the strong hatred Taishang Sword Sect had for Jiang Ming. If it wasn’t because he had to wait for his inner world to evolve, he would have killed Tai Wuji first.
Yu Fei had been traveling, getting more experts to support her.
Great Monarch Tian Song didn’t have his personal thoughts but he had been visiting Immortal Venerate Tai Yin very often. It was obvious that he was interested in her besides discussing Dao.
Immortal Venerate Tai Yin too, knew about Great Monarch Tian Song’s intention. Yet she still welcomed his visit.
‘I wonder what would the Great Monarch Tian Song think when he learned about the real identity of Immortal Venerate Tai Yin?’ Jiang Ming had a funny thought.
Many experts were afraid of Jiang Ming. But Chong Shan was the only one who intended to target him. Chong Shan was getting ready to take the reason of hunting Jiang Ming as the main reason to convince the reappearance of 10 ancient clans.
He also intended to seize the position as the Heavenly Emperor by utilizing the ten ancient clans to fight against other forces like the Holy Demon Palace and the likes. After all, the 10 ancient clans had grudges against them because they thought those forces were the culprits for the death of their nine Venerates decades ago.
Hence, they shall reappear to take their revenge before they could dominate the world.
Jiang Ming continued flipping the Records and found out that both Ye Qingxian and Luo Heng remained cultivating in the Supreme Pagoda. They had great improvement, and had successfully joined the Chat Room.
Lastly, Jiang Ming checked on the situation of his Junior Sister and he was surprised to see the information. He became ecstatic and then he rubbed his waist, and suddenly wondered if he should take some supplement in advance.
…
In the Inheritance Space, Zi Linglong had been sitting cross-legged on the Dao Enlightening Platform located in the supreme sacred land of cultivation. Sitting cross-legged on the platform would empty the mind, and it was easy to fall into a state of enlightenment.
Suddenly, a sword luminance surged from Linglong’s head. It was capable of splitting heaven above and the abyss below. It seemed that there were all kinds of laws, and the avenues of the heavens were all in it. This sword’s luminance was like the vastness of the starry sky, like the sea, and it was extremely sharp, capable of slashing through all things.
Accompanied with it was the surging aura of Linglong. Meanwhile, endless innate vital essences from all her surroundings had been injected into her, and were refined speedily. Both her mana and her Primal Spirit had been improving at a surprising speed too.
She finally broke through the realm, sublimated it to the extreme, and entered a brand new world.
Finally, all had gone, returning to peace. Linglong opened her eyes, which shot out two streams of chaos-colored sword ray.
“I’ve finally broken through to the Quasi-Sage Realm!” Linglong was excited.
She had been working hard just to cultivate. It was a piece of cake for her to achieve the Great Overarching Realm. Then, because she and her nine clones had to compete for resources, they fought with other disciples. They eventually managed to suppress all other Great Overarching experts, and were rewarded with a great amount of resources.
One of them was the Time House, which had saved her a lot of time. A thousand years in the Time House was akin to a day outside. Although it wasn’t comparable to the 10,000 years akin to a few seconds in the Supreme Tower, it was also very remarkable.
Inside the house was suitable to accumulate one’s origin while the outside suitable to comprehend great Dao.
“Finally I can truly fight together with my Senior Brother!” Linglong was ecstatic.
At this moment, her other nine clones had flown over. They had accumulated enough but they couldn’t improve their cultivation base yet because of the limitation of the main body.
Now that the main body had a breakthrough, their limitation had been dispersed. The nine clones had started to have their breakthrough, without much difficulties. They only needed time.
Linglong walked out of the retreat. As she looked into the distance, there were numerous heavenly monuments shrouded in clouds.
Since she got here after achieving the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, she learned how terrific the place was. For instance, those heavenly monuments actually carried various Daos, including Holy Daos.
Cultivating before the heavenly monuments, it was similar to Dao enlightenment, even the road ahead would become clear.
Such an encounter didn’t only shock Linglong but also excited her. Then, based on the rules here, she began challenging the heavenly path to earn points in exchange for cultivation time. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be able to improve herself so quickly.
Not long later, Junior Sister Five Elemental, Junior Sister Yin Yang and the others walked out of their retreats one after another until the last Junior Sister Time had completed her breakthrough.
The main body and the nine clones of Linglong had all stepped into the Quasi-Sage Realm. If she was to share her achievement to others, there wouldn’t be many people who would believe in her words. Even Tai Yuan would be dumbfounded.
It was at this time that she was shocked as she was confined by a sudden mighty power beyond imagination. She couldn’t resist it at all. Then, the power collapsed the space in her surroundings and she was taken to a mountain peak.
She was standing on a square facing a luxurious palace. The palace was surrounded by immortal luminance, shrouded in mystical yellow qi, permeated with immortal sound, and had chains of fortune across the space.
Immediately following after was a stream of information entered Linglong’s mind. And she realized that she could obtain an independent cultivation area, and become the Peak Master as soon as she broke through to the Quasi-Sage Realm.
The palace had the Time House, Dao Enlightenment Platform, Tempering Tower, and etc. She would be rewarded with points too.
At the same time, she was told that if she was to have the combat power of the Saint at Quasi-Sage Realm, or she could directly become a Saint, she would be able to meet the Heavenly Venerate and become the true disciple.
“I still can’t become a true disciple even up to this level?” Linglong was overwhelmed.
However, Linglong had bigger authority, and more methods to earn points. She could also purchase some items using her points, and even accept some tasks.
‘Task?’ Linglong began to ponder whether she was now in the Sea of Chaos. She was not assured but she thought she should be able to find out by asking around.
‘Anyway, I’m not in a rush. I shall go back to share it with my Senior Brother first!’ As she thought, she communicated with the Heavenly Order and disappeared along with her nine clones.
Linglong and her clones reappeared on Chuyang Peak.
“Finally you’re back! I’ve been missing you so much!” Jiang Ming was ecstatic as soon as he saw Linglong and the other nine clones. He rose to his feet and opened up his arms.
“Senior Brother, we miss you too!”
Junior Sister Phoenix yelped, and jumped on Jiang Ming’s back. The other eight clones too plunged themselves toward and surrounded Jiang Ming.
As Linglong got to the front of Jiang Ming, Jiang Ming had disappeared. They reappeared on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed in the room.
Jiang Ming gasped, “Ouch, slow down, lighter…”

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Xi Yao Traveled; A Bell, A Sword, A Battle Suit
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Xi Yao Traveled; A Bell, A Sword, A Battle Suit
At the back of the Chuyang Peak, as Xi Yao came out of her retreat, she was just in time to see 10 Linglong surrounded Jiang Ming. Then, she could no longer see a thing because her view had been blocked by the mist shrouding the area. Nevertheless, she had various sophisticated scenes running through her mind.
She shook her head and sighed. Alas! She looked up to the sky, the white cloud suspended in the sky could not carry away her melancholy.
‘Cultivating here is like wandering in the great Dao. I can enter a state of enlightenment from time to time, and the immortal qi has almost turned into a fog state. Cultivating here is unbelievably fast. I’ve reached the pinnacle stage of the Golden Immortal in just a few years. However, I think it’d be difficult to grow further in a short while. If I was to remain here, it’d be difficult for me to stay calm and collected. Perhaps I shall go out. If I was to feel the same upon return, I shall, I shall just let go of all my burdens!” Xi Yao had reached her conclusion.
She lifted her finger, drew a hook in the air to leave a message imprint before she paced into the air. Because Xi Yao had learned that the unspoken restriction had been uplifted, she went directly to the Tianyuan Sea.
The vast world had opened up her heart in an instant, and she felt her depressed mood had gotten better.
Three days later, Jiang Ming had finally walked out of the room. He actually felt rather fatigue and staggery.
“Alas, it’s been a whole 3,000 years!” Jiang Ming wailed. He felt that his semen had been drained, truly depleted.
Although it was only three days outside, Junior Sister Time had reversed time and turned a day into 1,000 years.
Hence, he almost died in exhaustion. After all, no one could endure having sex continuously without a moment of rest for 3,000 years.
He almost forgot to cook a meal each day. As he came out to cook, they continued in the balcony, and even the various parts in the manor.
As he glanced around, he discovered the message Xi Yao had left. Xi Yao merely told him that she was out for a walk.
“That girl is irritated.” Linglong laid beside Jiang Ming. “Senior Brother, you’ve after all, used to kill the Venerates. Yet you can’t even bear it after only 3,000 years. I’m rather disappointed!”
“I-I-I…” Jiang Ming gnashed his teeth but he eventually didn’t say anything harsh.
......
It was because he didn’t dare to. If he were to say he could go on for another 10,000 years, he might be pulled back into the room.
Looking at Jiang Ming’s response, Linglong couldn’t help but smirk. “Senior Brother, I’m now at the Quasi-Sage Realm. Do we have any enemies that we need to kill? I shall kill a few to vent our anger.”
“No rush!” Jiang Ming said, “I’ll let you kill as many as you want soon.”
“Really?” Junior Sister Five Elemental walked over and embraced Jiang Ming’s neck. “Senior Brother, who else would dare to be your enemy? What about the ten of us attacking and killing all Venerates together so that you’ll be the Heavenly Emperor and we be the Heavenly Queens?”
Jiang Ming was speechless, but he said solemnly, “Are you proud of yourself upon achieving the Quasi-Sage Realm? The ten of you are all Venerates, sharing the same mind, and each of you are cultivating different peerless special abilities. Like one body, you can burst out terrifying special abilities. However, don’t forget that this world has Demi-Sage, and Saint Weapons. We don’t even know if the Saints would come back. Therefore, we shall remain low-profile. If we were to attack, we shall be confident that we’re capable of suppressing the entire world.”
“Senior Brother, you’ve been underestimating us too much!” Junior Sister Space was squatting on Jiang Ming’s left, massaging his legs.
“Underestimate?” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Even I myself am capable of suppressing you all!”
As soon as Jiang Ming finished his words, he released his incomparable power of will to all directions, shrouding the entire balcony. In just a moment, Linglong and the other nine Junior Sisters were shocked as they couldn’t move at all in an instant.
The next moment, from Jiang Ming’s forehead, he released a luminance which turned into a mini-sized sword. Jiang Ming had the mini sword passed through the foreheads of all ten Junior Sisters in a flash before he retrieved back his power of will.
“How’s it?” Jiang Ming grinned.
“Senior Brother, you’re so amazing!” Linglong was stunned. “The power of will just now seems to have completely transcended the Venerate’s soul and reached an unpredictable level. It made me unable to move for a while. Besides, the soul special ability of yours is too terrifying. I felt the aura of death.”
“Well, it’s not as strong as you’ve imagined.” Jiang Ming said, “It’s because all of you aren’t taking any measures to guard against me, you can’t react in time. But I’m indeed capable of killing all of you with my soul’s special ability. Yet, I’m not confident to truly overwhelm the world nor I’m confident to win the battle against Riyue Changfeng of the Infinite Realm Auction House.”
“Anyway, you’re still truly an existence at the pinnacle of the world, aren’t you?” Linglong exclaimed, and frowned as she said, “I’ve been focusing on improving my cultivation realm and omitted the strengthening of my soul. I shall find ways to catch up soon.”
“I prepared it for you a long time ago!” Jiang Ming pointed at Linglong’s forehead, and transferred the Stellar Tower and the Celestial Heart Sword that he had comprehended over to her.
The Stellar Tower and the Celestial Heart Sword were the defensive technique and offensive technique respectively. Both of them had reached their pinnacle stage after years of deduction and perfection.
“What abstruse special abilities!” Linglong was in awe after she absorbed the information. “My Senior Brother is always amazing, even though I’ve achieved the Quasi-Sage Realm, I’m still far behind.”
“At least your cultivation base is higher than mine!” As Jiang Ming said, he waved his hand, taking out one Dao vessel after another for all ten Junior Sisters.
Before each Junior Sister were a Battle Suit, a bell, and a sword. All of them were completely the same. The only difference was the Dao contained in them.
“Senior Brother, t-these…” While looking at those items, even Linglong couldn’t help being shocked. She couldn’t believe it. “These are all top grade Quasi-Sage Weapons, and they contain Dao that correspond to each one of us.”
“Senior Brother, did you refine them for us?” Junior Sister Phoenix jumped on him in surprise. “You’re still the best. These things will enhance our combat power by a few folds!”
“I don’t have such ability. I got my friend to refine these vessels!” Jiang Ming laughed. “They are refined based on each of your Dao. The battle suit is for your defense, the bell can be used to defend your soul and to attack other souls, and the sword is the offensive weapon. After refining them, you just have to pour your Dao into them, and you’d be able to manipulate them easily. Because of my special requirements, the strength of all these ten battle suits, bells, and swords, can be connected and integrated. Hence, it would be stronger if they are arranged into a large formation after being evoked!”
These Weapons he requested the expert behind Hong Zhan to refine for him. Based on the group’s market price, a top grade Quasi-Sage Weapon cost only 1,500 points. However, because of Jiang Ming’s special request, the difficulty to refine them increased, and also because of their sky-defying efficacy, each weapon cost 4,000 points. Hence, the total was 120,000 points.
The total cost was not a lot to him anyway. Hong Zhan even said that only a rich man like Jiang Ming could afford to be so generous. He also added that if these items were to be used simultaneously, it was possible to kill even a Saint Lord.
Linglong was dumbfounded, and she was so touched that her eyes turned red. “Senior Brother, it must be very costly right?”
“For the sake of you all, it’s worth it regardless of the price!”
“Senior Brother, it’s so kind of you. How shall I repay you? What about we have another 3,000 years?”
Pfff…

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Heading to the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Heading to the Universe
Jiang Ming demanded that all Junior Sisters refine their Dao vessels. Hence, he became free.
‘One is just right, two are better, three are ecstasy, if four...that’s a bit more, but ten?’ Jiang Ming felt it was terrifying to think of it. But when he recalled the ecstasy feeling, his lips moved.
‘The saying that even man falls for beauty is indeed accurate.’ As Jiang Ming was lamenting, he remembered Xi Yao. And he couldn’t help thinking if she was to join them, would it be…
Jiang Ming shook his head, trying to shake off the thought.
At this moment, he felt the vibration of the Supreme Order. He communicated with it and found out that it was Luo Heng, who was contacting him through a private message.
‘Can’t he wait any longer?’ As Jiang Ming thought, he called out the Human Path Record to check on Chong Shan. When he discovered that Chong Shan was still in the plotting process, and wouldn’t take any action in about three days, he was slightly relieved.
He rose to his feet, cooked for himself a simple dish, and communicated with the Supreme Order to enter the Supreme Pagoda.
In a corner of the public square. Luo Heng was using the tablet, while Ye Qingxian was reading beside him.
The two seemed to be telepathic so they raised their heads simultaneously.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian put down the book roll, rose to her feet and welcomed Jiang Ming with a big smile on her face.
“Brother Jiang, it’s been a while!” Luo Heng was rather excited.
It had indeed been a long time. After all, a year outside in reality was akin to 1,000 years in the Supreme Pagoda. Hence, 30 years outside was equivalent to 30,000 years in the Supreme Pagoda.
“Long time no see!” Jiang Ming realized that Luo Heng had become more mature and steady. He had become a lot stronger than before.
......
“You can’t wait anymore, can you?” As Jiang Ming asked, he sat at a side.
After years of cultivation, the genetic level of Luo Heng had reached 100,000 times. Hence, he managed to pass the minimum requirement of the Chat Room. Luo Heng had even achieved the stage akin to the Golden Immortal Realm.
Ye Qingxian too, had achieved the Golden Immortal Realm. Although she was ambitious, she knew she had a weaker aptitude. Hence, she continued working hard in improving her cultivation base even after she managed to join the Chat Room.
“Yes, I can’t wait any longer!” Luo Heng smiled wryly. “It’s my first time to have stayed in the same place for so long. Hence, I gradually become restless. Moreover, without connecting the outside world for almost 30 years, I’m afraid that they would characterize me as dead. If that’s the case, I’m afraid that my close kins and friends would be in danger. Therefore, I plan to return to reality. With my current strength and the Dao vessel you gave me, I think I should be able to escape easily even though I may not be capable of slaughtering all members of the demon clan.”
Luo Heng told Jiang Ming his plan.
“It’s understandable that you can’t travel too far with your kin around!” Ye Qingxian lamented, as she felt somewhat melancholy. She couldn’t return to her home now. To be more exact, she had lost her home. She didn’t have any relatives either. It was considered that she cut the relationship between her and her kin after the transcendence.
“I’ll help you back in a short while!” Jiang Ming promised Ye Qinxian.
“Brother Jiang, no rush!” Ye Qingxian smiled helplessly. “What can I do even if I can return? It’s better that I continue my cultivation here. I shall settle down for a bit, and strive to clear the Battle Tower for Taiyi Realm in the future. By that time, it will not be too late to go back.”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming nodded. He didn’t comfort her because he knew Ye Qingxian didn’t need it.
He turned to Luo Heng, and said, “Let’s just return to reality!”
“Okay!” Luo Heng nodded. Before he left, he gave Ye Qingxian all the alcoholic beverages, food, books, and other stuff.
“Contact me at any time if you need anything.” Jiang Ming offered Ye Qingxian before he returned to reality.
As Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak, he called out the Human Path Record to lock on Luo Heng’s location, before he plunged into it.
In a secret realm located in the galaxy and universe, there was a massive mountain peak with a staircase that connected the bottom of the mountain to the top of the mountain. At an interval of 99 steps, there was a platform. Whoever stepped on the staircase would have to reach at least a platform to leave or he would have to stay forever.
This was the risk one must take to enter an inheritance place.
At this moment, Luo Heng appeared on one of the platforms. In fact, he had returned to reality soon after he achieved the Golden Immortal Realm. After he obtained the inheritance, he climbed up the staircase to the platform. Hence, he was qualified to leave.
As Luo Heng raised his head looking at the steps that spiraled into the distance, he exclaimed, “I still feel that this place is unshakable even until today.”
As he focused, he only could see a vague statue at the top of the staircase. As he turned around to look at the bottom, he couldn’t see anything clearly either as it was shrouded with mist. Nevertheless, he saw some motionless figures on some steps. He knew they had died while comprehending the inheritance.
“Encounter, encounter, it always comes after dangers!” Luo Heng muttered.
One had to go through dangers to obtain encounters. Else, it would be an utter disaster.
As soon as you stepped on the first step, there was a magic sound that would penetrate your brain. You would have to clearly comprehend the mystery of inheritance in the magic sound before you can move forward in disturbance. You wouldn’t move a bit if you couldn’t comprehend it.
It was at this time that Luo Heng suddenly turned to see the descendent of Jiang Ming. He was stunned. Although he had guessed that a Group Admin was capable of descending to other worlds, when it had been confirmed, he still barely could believe in it. They were, after all, from a different world, and a different galaxy.
He couldn’t understand how Jiang Ming could descend into his world, whether it was Jiang Ming’s privilege as the Group Admin, or his personal power. However, he had finally understood how Jiang Ming could help him.
“Brother Jiang!” While thoughts flowed through his mind, Luo Heng was still ecstatic. “I’m now completely relieved with you here!”
“Provided you aren’t afraid!” Jiang Ming landed beside him.
“Afraid?” Luo Heng startled for a moment before he recollected himself. He said with a smile through telepathy, “Afraid of your invasion? Would you care about all these as a Group Admin? I think you’re simply curious about my world here.”
“Alas! I’m indeed very curious about this universe.” Jiang Ming sighed inexplicably and looked up at the top of the steps. “I feel the power of confinement here. But this power is of the Great Overarching Realm at max! Shall I get you the inheritance?”
“No!” Luo Heng shook his head. “Since it’s just of the Great Overarching Realm, I’ll be able to strike it through in some time. I thought the power was incredible!”
“Yes, with your current strength, you’re indeed not far from it.” As Jiang Ming grabbed with his hand, there was a booming sound from the void, and the statue at the end of the steps seemed to come alive.
He slapped the back of his hand, and the statue trembled before it became immobilized.
Jiang Ming grinned, “Shall we leave now?”
“Sure!” Luo Heng paced into the air with excitement. To think that he had not met with his master, his family, and friends for almost 30,000 years, he had been missing them a lot. He didn’t want to stay here any longer.
Luo Heng had accomplished the requirement to leave the place, hence he was not limited. Jiang Ming, on the other hand, forcefully broke through the limitation.
In just a blink of an eye, the two had got to the bottom of the mountain, and there was fog ahead. Luo Heng explained, “There are instructions on the outside of the fog that whoever steps into this place must accept the test of inheritance. Because of the danger of inheritance, none of the demon clan’s experts who were besieging me, didn’t come in. I think they are still waiting outside. Decades are not long for them. After all, it will be a great achievement for them if they can kill a human genius like me.”
Luo Heng laughed at himself.
“If they were to be staying outside, it would be their misfortune. We shall just kill all of them!” Jiang Ming took the lead to walk out.
“Haha, let’s just kill all of them!” Luo Heng was bursting with pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Killed the Star Field Leveled Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Killed the Star Field Leveled Expert
Jiang Ming had learned about the division of cultivating realms here in Luo Heng’s world. It was basically divided by the planet.
On the planet were apprentices of up to grade nine Warriors. It was corresponding to the ten realms of the mortal world where Jiang Ming came from. After the Grade nine Warrior was followed by level Planetary, Stellar, Galactic, Star River, Star Field, Star Sea, Cosmic, and Supreme.
Based on Luo Heng explanation, and the condition of the Supreme Chat Room, Jiang Ming calculated that level Planetary, Stellar, Galactic, Star River, Star Field, Star Sea, Cosmic, and Supreme were corresponding to Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, Mystical Immortal, Golden Immortal, Taiyi, Great Overarching, Quasi-Sage, and Saint respectively.
Whether it was the Quasi-Sage or Saint, Luo Heng only heard about them. However, because Luo Heng himself was currently at level Star River, he was strong enough to traverse the galaxy, open up and develop a world and be the ruler.
After they walked through the fog, they arrived at the bottom of the mountain.
In fact, they were in an incomparably massive abyss. In the abyss were mountains, the place ofinheritance.
As soon as Jiang Ming and Luo Heng got to the bottom of the mountain, a 100 meters long spaceship a thousand meters away had discovered the movement here in an instant. They sent out an alert.
“This is the level 4 spaceship, corresponding to the Golden Immortal item.” Luo Heng explained. “Brother Jiang, I’ll first attack. But if I’m defeated, please help me!”
Luo Heng was eager to try. His fighting spirit was high.
When Luo Heng was being chased at first, he had to use up the life-saving items given by his master, and finally had to enter the land of inheritance for a chance to survive. If it wasn’t because of Jiang Ming, even if he had the Supreme Order, he didn’t know if he could survive this tribulation.
Therefore, he was filled with hatred. With the improvement of his cultivation base and his strength, he wouldn’t want to miss the opportunity to vent his anger.
Luo Heng flew over.
A void projection appeared in front of the spaceship, forming a figure. It was wearing armor, and had vertical pupils and scales on his face, just like a real person. Meanwhile, the surrounding had a terrifying power that imprisoned the void.
“Luo Heng, I’m here representing the Demon Clan to welcome you to join us!” This expert of the Demon Clan spoke in a loud and resounding voice. “If you were to stay on the mountain, you may be able to survive. However, now that you have come out, you are in a desperate situation. Hence, joining my Demon Clan is your only hope to survive. It’s also because you’re a super genius to be given such a privilege.”
“She Luo, if I were to join the Demon Clan, do I have to transform my bloodline?” Luo Heng asked.
“That’s for sure!” She Luo nodded. “You’ll have to transform your bloodline to my Demon Clan’s bloodline before you can be part of us. Otherwise, why would we need you? Anyway, based on your talent, you can undertake the bloodline of my Demon Clan’s ten emperors and you’ll be much stronger than your current self. With the royal bloodline of my Demon Clan, your physical weakness will be overcomed and you’ll be perfect from then! If you were too afraid that you’ll trouble your family, we can take them all in to be your company. Luo Heng, it’s rare for us to take the initiative to invite a member of a foreign clan to be one of us, and even have his bloodline to be transformed to our royal bloodline. Hence, if you reject my offer, you’ll not only lose your sky-defying encounter, you’ll also lose your life.”
“Oh, I just recalled that Koizumi Ichio, the genius of your human race, took the initiative to join my demon race three million years ago. A Star Sea leveled expert of my Demon Clan transformed the Koizumi Ichio bloodline to that of the Golden Divine Dog. He became a lot stronger and later became one of the most powerful beings in the universe. It was unfortunate that he was killed and eaten by Bai Deng, that old man. Else, he would overwhelm all Star Sea leveled experts!”
“Luo Heng, you’ll definitely have a greater achievement than him because of your better talent. Hence, stop hesitating and join us!”
She Luo was trying to tempt and convince Luo Heng.
Luo Heng smirked, “Do you want me to betray my human race? Ha, thanks for thinking of that. She Luo, take your move and show me how strong you are as a Star Field expert!”
“Wanna fight me?” She Luo smirked. “Since you aren’t taking my offer, you shall die! Domain Tribulation, destroy!”
Black lightning appeared out of thin air, striking directly at Luo Heng. Its coverage was relatively huge, hence Jiang Ming was included in the strike area.
A sword, a Great Overarching Weapon appeared in Luo Heng’s hand. Luo Heng was currently capable of exerting most of the sword’s power. The moment the sword emitted its luminance, Luo Heng resisted the black lightning. He lunged himself towards the spaceship.
Jiang Ming didn’t move. He resisted the attack merely with the surging luminance.
Jiang Ming looked around and smiled. ‘It’s the Domain Law. Although the rules are different in a different world, its principle is still similar!’
While Jiang Ming was analyzing the situation, he was absorbing the world’s aura and merging into the world so that he could better feel the difference.
‘I wonder if the world is contained in the Sea of Chaos. I may need to find out!’ While pondering, he discovered that Luo Heng had clashed through the domain. Then, he directed his sword to slash through the spaceship into two, resulting in a heavy casualty.
“How can you be so powerful in merely about 20 years? Inheritance? Impossible, it’s impossible!” She Luo’s true self flew out of the spaceship. He looked rather miserable.
In fact, She Luo was in great shock. He remembered Luo Heng was very weak at that time. Although Luo Heng had boundless potential, he was so weak that he was no match even to his subordinates if it wasn’t because of the protective thing Luo Heng had. He couldn’t believe Luo Heng could be this strong in just a short period of time.
“Nothing is impossible!” Luo Heng smirked. He lunged himself towards She Luo.
At this moment, Luo Heng was high-spirited, full of fighting intent.
The battle broke out, affecting the surrounding areas in an instant. Robust force emitted even scattered a great amount of hard mountain rocks.
The few surviving subordinates of She Luo, lunged towards Jiang Ming with surprises. They couldn’t identify the strength of Jiang Ming but they assumed that Jiang Ming was not that strong by looking at his rather thin appearance.
“Die!” A man with two horns on his head was the first to reach. He instantly chopped on Jiang Ming with his war saber while evoking the power of order. The violent saber qi surging seemed capable of chopping the abyss into two parts.
“I may omit you if you were to retreat. But it’s you digging your own grave when you want to kill me!” Jiang Ming sneered. Then, he spat out the Great Thunder Technique, which wiped out the few experts. When they died, they transformed back to their true bodies, giant bodies of the Demon Clan.
‘They are different from the Demon Clan in my world!’ Jiang Ming discovered a difference in their cells as he observed them. As for the other differences, Jiang Ming didn’t investigate further because he wasn’t free to do so.
On the other hand, Luo Heng had completely suppressed his opponent. Luo Heng was capable of doing so because all his genetics, special abilities and spells, and Dao vessels were strong enough to overwhelm She Luo. Hence, Luo Heng managed to slash She Luo into half after a moment.
“Luo Heng, you’re on the Wanted List of my clan. I’ve just sent out the message. Hence, you’ll definitely die, I’m sure!” She Luo cried. He tried to escape but was killed on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Traverse the Universe, Transformation of Saint Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Traverse the Universe, Transformation of Saint Soul
“Awww…” Luo Heng howled after he killed She Luo. His void shook heaven, reverberated in mountain ranges and shook the mountain peaks, causing landslides.
Luo Heng stopped only after a while.
“I’ve never thought that I can grow to this extent within 30 years!” Luo Heng felt as though he was dreaming. “To think that I could kill a Star Field expert!”
“This is nothing surprising!” Jiang Ming walked towards Luo Heng with his face glowing with pleasure. “As a member of the group, you’re destined to be one of the top experts in the future. Hence, this is just your beginning. You’ll be able to suppress the universe and overwhelm millions of clans in the future.”
“I don’t dare to think that I’m able to suppress the universe, but it’s my aim to overwhelm millions of clans!” Luo Heng was ecstatic. “Brother Jiang, let me just contact my friends and families first before anything else!” Luo Heng was indeed very worried. He was afraid of getting unpleasant news.
Jiang Ming nodded.
Luo Heng communicated with the virtual connector, sending a part of his consciousness into a virtual world. The virtual world was the ultimate result of network development. It had millions of wonders.
In just a second, Luo Heng received thousands of mails, which he read all in a short while with his consciousness. Most of them were asking for his conditions, his whereabouts, and the reason for not replying. When he found out there was no bad news, he took a sigh of relief before he replied to all of them.
“Brother Jiang, since you’ve got here, what about I arrange a trip for you?” Luo Heng asked after he was done with his matter.
“Sure!”
“Let’s first visit our human race’s territory, and check out our culture before I take you around the universe. But I’m afraid that there would be some troubles.”
“Do you think that I’d be afraid of trouble?”
“Haha, in that case, I shall take advantage of your power now then!”
......
As Luo Heng spoke, he took out a spaceship from his storage space. The spaceship was only 30 meters long, far smaller than that of She Luo.
Luo Heng opened the door and the two entered.
“Master, is there any order?” Although it was the electronic voice, it was gentle with hints of flirtation.
“Return via the same route!” Luo Heng demanded. Then, he opened the wine cellar, took out his precious good wine and poured Jiang Ming a glass. “Brother Jiang, since you are from the other world, are you curious about this spaceship?”
“Yes, I somewhat do.” Jiang Ming looked somewhat strange but he was indeed curious. It was, after all, the universe which was capable of traversing the universe.
“In my world, we’ve various flying artifacts. But they are antiques to your world. They aren’t slower than your spaceship but they are very different in appearance!” Jiang Ming depicted. “Your world has intelligent items, projectors while we have puppet with intelligence, and Iridescent Mirror and the likes. The millions of great Daos are expressed in different forms but their cores are similar! Anyway, because of the numerous stars with life in the vast universe, your world has incredibly abundant materials. My world, on the other hand, is generally made up of only one continent, and the stars are often very desolated.”
The two were discussing the similarity and differences of their own world before they probed into the essence of great Dao.
Their spaceship left the Abyss in just a while. When they were a distance away, they looked back to see the Abyss was just a giant crack that appeared deep in the starry sky. It looked like a giant beast of starry sky, with millions of miracles in it.
“Is this the miraculous scene of the universe?” Jiang Ming was rather shocked.
“Yep. You are not alone to be in shock. I felt the same when I first saw this scene.” Luo Heng said. “The universe is so vast that it has created numerous miracles.”
At this moment, the spaceship trembled and stopped.
“Here comes the person digging his grave!” Jiang Ming sneered.
“Digging grave?” Luo Heng was startled for a second before he said with shock, “To think that my spaceship and I failed to detect his existence, his must be more terrific than She Luo!”
“He is of the Great Overarching Realm, aka the Star Sea leveled expert!” As Jiang Ming said, he grabbed Luo Heng, and got out of the spaceship to a distance.
“What’s this?” Luo Heng was surprised to see what was happening before him. The laws of void condensed and turned into a giant palm as big as a planet, which held on the spaceship.
In fact, it was not considered a palm but a claw.
In the distance, the void cracked, and a creature walked out of it. He was covered with black hair, similar to an ape, but had eight hands.
“Black Divine Ape Clan!” Luo Heng revealed the creature’s identity.
“Luo Heng, the young genius of the human race. It’s you, no, it should be this man beside you, who has killed She Luo, right?” The expert of the Black Divine Ape Clan spoke in an extremely icy cold voice. “She Luo said you are incredibly powerful and that he’s not your match. But before he could explain further, the message’s been cut! I’ve checked on you before I came. You’re merely a little kid. Even if your aptitude is the best in millions of epochs, it’s impossible that you can improve up to the stage where you are capable of killing She Luo in just a few decades. Hence, the only possible culprit is this man beside you!”
“By the way, I’m Yuan Qi. How may I address you?” Yuan Qi looked at Jiang Ming.
“Jiang Ming.” Jiang Ming didn’t hide his real identity because he didn’t think he had to.
“However, you were mistaken. I didn’t kill She Luo but Brother Luo himself.” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
“How is it possible!” Yuan Qi had shock on his face. “I thought it’s been too much for me to come personally. Yet I’ve never expected to be able to meet with such a terrifying young expert of the human race. It’s not a loss for me indeed.”
“No, it’s a great loss for you!” Jiang Ming said. “Yuan Qi, do you know whether your Demon Clan has any supreme expert?”
“You don’t even know this? You shouldn’t be that strong then!” Yuan Qi took a deep breath to suppress his shock before he took his move. “I don’t care about your background and how genius you are, having to meet me is akin to your death!”
As Yuan Qi clasped his giant illusion palm, he crashed the spaceship instantly. Then, he ferociously slapped with his giant palm as big as a planet. His palm was strong enough to crash a planet.
Luo Heng was terrified at the terrific power.
“Would you like to try?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
