“Forget about it!” Luo Heng smiled wryly. “I don’t want to oppress myself!”
“It should be easy for a Golden Immortal to slaughter a Great Overarching expert. But now that you aren’t confident at all, it means you haven’t accumulated enough!” Jiang Ming said, “From now onwards, I think you shall not think about breaking through to Taiyi Realm but try to pass the Battle Towers!”
As Jiang Ming said, a bright ray of light emitted from his forehead, scattering the giant palm. With just a flash, it seemed to have penetrated space and time, reached Yuan Qi, confined him, and fused into his mind.
“Brother Jiang, this attack of yours is t-t-too terrifying!” Luo Heng said with shock, “To which level the power of your soul and your will have reached? You can actually suppress a Great Overarching expert so easily!”
“The extreme of Demi-Sage, or it can be sad that it’s half a step away from the Saint Soul!”
“Gosh, Brother Jiang, you’re amazing.”
“Alas, I’ve always wanted my soul to transform into the Saint Soul but I always fail to. I feel that I’d need another 10,000 years if I were to temper it without taking any shortcuts.”
Ten thousand years to transform into Saint Soul? Alas, this is too amazing. Does it mean that the Saint Soul is akin to the Saint, the Supreme Expert?”
“Yes! But if I were to spend my resources, I’ll definitely achieve the transformation in one or two years or in less than 100 years!”
“Damn!” Luo Heng was utterly astonished. When he regained his calmness, he rolled his eyes as he said, “Brother Jiang, are you trying to show off here?”
Jiang Ming laughed nastily.
Meanwhile, he had a peak of Yuan Qi’s memory.
Yuan Qi knew far more than Luo Heng. Therefore, as Jiang Ming read, he learned more about the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - The Origin of the Universe: Specter Secret Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: The Origin of the Universe: Specter Secret Realm
In the universe was a place where various clans and races competed against each other. Not only that, experts were competing to transcend as well.
The Demon Clan had supreme experts but they seemed to have gone to the Chaos outside the universe, in the search for an encounter to transcend.
It also seemed that most supreme experts would head to the Chaos. Many Universe leveled experts too would try their luck in there.
‘The Chaos here doesn’t look like the Chaos in my world.’ As Jiang Ming thought, excitement glowed on his face.
The universe here was more suitable for exploration. He even thought of exploring the Chaos.
Luo Heng had already regained his senses, and had a somewhat sophisticated feeling.
Jiang Ming was, after all, of the same level as Luo Heng at the beginning. However, Jiang Ming had reached a stage that was far out of his reach in just a short while.
Luo Heng felt fortunate that Jiang Ming was not arrogant.
“Brother Jiang, why are you so excited?” Luo Heng suddenly saw the joy expressed on Jiang Ming’s face, and Yuan Qi, who was standing still. Hence, he made a wild assumption. “Don’t tell me you’re probing into his memory? It’s totally impossible to check on the Star Sea level expert, isn’t it? His will is incredibly strong, isn’t it?”
“Yes, I’m indeed probing his memory!” Jiang Ming grinned.
“What! Damn, how’s it possible!” Luo Heng almost jumped out. “It’s very difficult even for a Saint to probe into the memory of a Star Sea leveled expert, isn’t it?”
“Just some techniques.” Jiang Ming pointed at Yuan Qi as he said, “Do you want to submit him in exchange for your merit?”
“I do have the intention!” Luo Heng hesitated for a moment and smiled. “Hence, it’s better to take action. After all, it’s better to exchange the Star Sea leveled expert of the Demon Clan for merit than wasting this chance. By that time, I’ll get you top-grade wine.”
......
He made a pause to ponder before he continued, “Brother Jiang, what about you say that you’ve been cultivating at the border of the universe. You started traveling around recently and met me while I was besieged by the Demon Clan. Hence, you capture Yuan Qi so that you can get yourself a name in our human race. A live Yuan Qi has infinite value. Not to mention that you’ll get trust, at least you won’t be troubled by any member of the human race.”
“That’s just a waste of time!” Jiang Ming shook his head.
Luo Heng smiled wryly. “Well, nobody would believe that I’m capable of killing an expert of the Star Sea level. Hence, I’d need to take the guise of you as a ‘senior’.”
“You can just arrange it on your own!” As Jiang Ming said, he took out the spatial bracelet of Yuan Qi. The space inside was incomparably vast, which was comparable to dozens of planets.
Jiang Ming forcefully wiped out Yuan Qi’s imprint on it, and probed with his consciousness. His eyes lit as he was surprised. “There are too many good things in there!”
“The bloodline of the Demon Clan is strong, and the individuals are also extremely huge in size and powerful. Many of them even have bloodline inheritance. Their population is small but they have many affiliated clans. Hence, all experts of the Demon Clan are very rich.” Luo Heng explained. “Brother Jiang, what are the items in it?”
“Hold on!” Jiang Ling turned to Yuan Qi, and added another layer of confinement. Then, he threw it to Luo Heng. “No worries, just take it. No one below Cosmic level can release him.”
“Sure.” Luo Heng kept and suppressed it directly in his storage space before he looked at Jiang Ming.
The next moment, dense dots suddenly appeared in front of them, darkening their view. There were uncountable rows of spaceships, numerous artifacts and weapons, precious minerals and stones, various materials and so on. The amount of these things was so great that they could fill two planets.
“Two sixth grade spaceships, 32 fifth grade spaceships, 800 fourth grade spaceships and 30 million third grade spaceships. Gosh!” Luo Heng was astounded as he scanned through with his consciousness. “I know that the members of the Demon Clan are rich, but they are incredibly richer than I expected.”
“I think it’s not suprising!” Jiang Ming grabbed out and kept a sixth grade spaceship, half of the fifth grade spaceship, and some precious minerals. “The rest are yours!”
“Brother Jiang!” Luo Heng shook his head. “Taking Yuan Qi is the greatest benefit I’ve got. Hence, I can’t take these!”
“I’m not interested in all of them!”
“Well, alright then. You are indeed so rich that I’m jealous!” Luo Heng kept them while giggling.
Then, they continued their travels on the sixth grade spaceship of Yuan Qi. It was faster and more luxurious. More importantly, it was so tough that it could crash planets easily.
Before they entered the dark universe, Luo Heng shared a message which he had just received.
“The appearance of the Specter Secret Realm?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“Yes, it’s the Specter Secret Realm!” Luo Heng nodded. “It’s the message that I received from my senior brother. It’s also been shared on the intranet, causing an uproar. It just appeared at the border of the human race. Brother Jiang, do you want to go?”
“Do you want to go?” Jiang Ming asked back.
“Of course!” Luo Heng nodded and then shook his head. “But I’d be a small fry only if I were to go! Alas, the appearance of the Specter Secret Realm is akin to an adversity. Even with my current cultivation base, I can merely be a spectator at the outer circle!”
“Indeed!” Jiang Ming hesitated.
He wanted to visit the human race’s region, and gain knowledge and experience about the wonders of the universe. But at the same time, he wanted to go around the Specter Secret Realm too.
He learned from Yuan Qi’s memory that the Specter Secret Realm was a peculiar secret realm. Each time it was opened, its location would be different. It would also produce a great amount of rare items of the universe, hence attracting millions of clans competing against each other to enter into it.
Of course, such a great encounter was accompanied by great dangers. Each opening would take away the life of more than half of the living beings who entered into it. The worst death ratio was even up to 95 percent, which was horrifying.
Each opening lasted only for 1,000 years. Everyone entering would be expelled out when time was up.
Luo Heng collected more information and shared some of the secrets he had found. “The Specter Secret Realm only prohibits the entrance of the Supreme experts, and nothing else. The secret realm would have many rare items of the universe, and peerless divine weapons. A Supreme vessel used to be found, and that created a massive uproar. Some inference said that the Specter Secret Realm is connected to the origin of the universe or it wouldn’t have so many precious items of the universe.”
“Of course, the strongest evidence for this inference is that the location of the Specter Secret Realm is different each time. Based on the statistics, its locations are distributed throughout the universe. Moreover, there is no place other than the origin of the universe that is capable of producing such a great amount of treasures of the universe.”
“Alas, that’s a desirable place! The time interval between each appearance would take at least millions of epochs. An epoch is equivalent to 129,600 years. Sometimes, it’d even take 10 billions of epochs!”
“The next opening after this would take a very long time! Alas, it’d be best if it opens only after 10,000 years. By that time, I’d have a higher competence to enter!”
Luo Heng sighed as he said.
“I think this inference is most likely the truth.” Jiang Ming nodded. The various conditions of the Specter Secret Realm itself were pointed at the origin of the universe. He beamed, “Since it can produce supreme weapons like the Supreme vessel, its fortune must be extraordinarily terrifying. Fortunately, it prohibits the entrance of Supreme experts. Brother Luo, let’s go find out since you want to go.”
“This is awesome, Brother Jiang! Appreciate that!” Luo Heng was ecstatic.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Traverse the Star Sea, Strong Enemy Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Traverse the Star Sea, Strong Enemy Attack Translation
The spaceship turned towards another direction, and began to accelerate. Upon reaching lightspeed, it tore through space, entering into the dark universe.
The dark universe was a vast open space without any materials or objects. Hence, the spaceship could accelerate at an almost infinite speed. There wasn’t any limitation.
The speed of the sixth grade spaceship which Luo Heng and Jiang Ming had boarded, had quickly been increased up to 300-times of lightspeed. Such was absolutely unbelievable. Moreover, it was very magical here. One mile here corresponded to 480 million miles outside.
“Wouldn’t two spaceships collide head-on under such high speed? I think the collision would even kill a Golden Immortal!” Jiang Ming doubted.
“Such a probability is extremely low.” Luo Heng giggled. “The dark universe is of a similar size to the vast and infinite universe. Moreover, the number of spaceships that could traverse the dark universe is just like a sand grain in the vast sea. Simply put, it’s two sand grains crawling like snails in the vast sea. Tell me, do you think they would collide?”
“Well, the universe is indeed too vast!” While checking out the map of the human race’s region projected out by Luo Heng, Jiang Ming was extremely shocked even though he was very knowledgeable.
A star was akin to a sand grain. In fact, it was smaller.
The Star Galaxy, Star River, Star Sea, and Star Field.
The region of the human race was extremely vast for it consisted of 3,600 Star Fields. A Star Field had a universal empire, which ruled over dynasties, kingdoms and live planets. A mere universal empire could occupy numerous live planets.
“How long does it take to reach that place?” Jiang Ming sat with his leg-crossed, picked up a glass of wine and enjoyed it.
Inside the spaceship had various types of entertaining facilities. It was in fact, almost all types.
“I think it’ll take about 30 years.” Luo Heng roughly calculated. “Based on the coordinates, we would just need to go in this direction.”
“So long?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
......
“The universe is too huge. If it wasn’t for this spaceship, we’d need to travel for up to 1,000 years!” Luo Heng smiled wryly. “Brother Jiang, what about we check out the virtual world of the human race first?”
“Hold on!” Jiang Ming said. “Let’s just return to the universe. I’ll try if I can tear space to reach the place directly.”
“Alright!” Luo Heng nodded.
The spaceship gradually slowed down. After some adjustment, it went into a barren area based on the coordinates. Then, it was slowed down to below lightspeed, allowing the spaceship to take a leap back into reality. Then, it was completely halted.
The duo walked out of the spaceship, into the dark and icy cold space. There was a star burning with eternal flame in the distance, and some barren planets nearby.
Jiang Ming grabbed, and a planet flew over swiftly. Meanwhile, it shrank at fast speed to the size of a marble upon landing on Jiang Ming’s hand.
Jiang Ming flicked, and the marble was shot out at fast speed. In just a while, the star in the distance abruptly exploded, producing a massive fireworks display.
It was fortunate that no living things were around the region.
“Brother Jiang, you’re merely a realm higher than mine. But why do I feel that the gap between us is so huge that I’m ashamed of myself!” Luo Heng lamented.
“I’m just accumulating more.” Jiang Ming smiled. “The future you will be capable of suppressing the entire universe without much effort.”
“Suppressing the universe?” Luo Heng was longing to achieve it.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming closed his eyes, releasing his consciousness to merge into the void, and permeate through layers of space.
In just a moment, his consciousness had traversed the Star Galaxy,Star River, Star Sea, Star Field, and extended to the boundless distance.
At this moment, some experts in the human race’s region sensed such a supreme might. They were all stunned, but when they tried to sense it further, they discovered that it had utterly gone.
Especially Luo Heng, who was nearby, his body froze, unable to move a bit. The power of this power made Luo Heng’s thinking seem to stop, and his soul extremely horrified.
‘It’s unbelievable that Brother Jiang has such a strong power of soul!’ Luo Heng had truly felt the terror of Jiang Ming this time. He believed that Jiang Ming was capable of conquering the world and being invincible with his power of soul alone.
‘The spirit, will, and soul!’ Luo Heng was somewhat enlightened. He had also found a way to improve in the future. He learned that these three elements were one.The heart was the root, the soul was the carrier, and the will was the use.
Jiang Ming opened his eyes, withdrew all his power and beamed. “I’ve understood the rules of Dao of your world. I can manipulate the space to teleport. However, further detailed coordinates are needed for comparison before taking a detour. The more detailed the star map, the better.”
“Okay, I’ll get one from my master.” Luo Heng responded immediately. With a thought, he entered the virtual world. He not only contacted his master but also his senior and junior brothers.
Many of his senior brothers were of the Star Field level, some had even entered the Star Sea level.
In just a while, Luo Heng had obtained a star map with more details.
Luo Heng withdrew his consciousness, and immediately projected it out, forming a 3D map.
Jiang Ming scanned through the map to identify the coordinates of their location, and identified a road. Jiang Ming had Luo Heng keeping the spaceship, rolled him and teleported.
Teleportation meant that he merged into a spatial node, and leaped from one to another. When they reappeared, they had traveled over 300 Star Fields.
They eventually halted after a few leaps. Luo Heng stood beside Jiang Ming, feeling very dizzy. He felt that the teleportation was somewhat unbearable. If it wasn’t because of Jiang Ming’s protection, he would be torn to pieces by the power of the space backlash.
After he recollected himself, he looked into the distance, and was surprised. “Is that the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm?”
“Yes, we’ve arrived!”
“So fast?”
“No, it’s too slow. If I can further familiarize the Time and Space Law of your world, we’d just need to teleport once to get here.”
“You’re amazing!” What else could Luo Heng do? He directly gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up.
It was a barren Star Field, the surrounding was extremely empty with merely few planets around. However, there was a meteorite belt on the left side, which was tens of millions of miles long, and was moving rapidly.
At the front was an incomparably huge colorful vortex. It was overflowing with flowing lights of various types. The diameter of the vortex was one lightyear big.
Jiang Ming knew that the vortex was the entrance to the Specter Secret Realm.
It had yet to open officially. But it had been surrounded by a great number of experts. Each and everyone of them had intimidating auras, some of them had a weird physical shape but most were in the form of a human.
They were obviously waiting for the opening of the secret realm.
Before Jiang Ming and Luo Heng went forward, a sweeping glance was casted at the duo, and was locked at them after a short pause. The next moment, someone dashed towards the duo, and stopped somewhere in front of them.
The comer had a tiger head and a human body, an expert of the Demon Clan.
Many of the experts of the Demon Clan thought that having the head of the beast and human body indicated they were of higher status than the human race.
“You are Luo Heng from the Human Race!” He spoke in a very loud voice without any concealment. Hence, his voice was spread out even though they were in free space.
Divine power oscillated, and the void rippled.
As he used an affirmative tone, it was obvious that he used to see Luo Heng’s portrait. “She Luo sent a message that he was about to be killed by Luo Heng of the Human Race. Then, Yuan Qi went and his life imprint disappeared shortly after that. Tell me, how did Yuan Qi die?”
Beside him many experts of the Demon Clan gathered. Every one of the expert was no weaker than level Star Sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Flabbergasted Thousands Clans, All Slaughtered
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Flabbergasted Thousands Clans, All Slaughtered
Jiang Ming and Luo Heng were besieged by the experts of the Demon Clan. Every member of the clan were staring at Luo Heng, yearning to swallow him whole.
Their invincible might emitted naturally had confined the void around, attracting other experts’ attention in the distance. Unfortunately, none of them knew Jiang Ming nor Luo Heng, who was after all, a little kid. Even though Luo Heng was a genius of the Human Race, he wasn’t recognized by the strong experts in the Human Race because he was still too weak.
“Brother Jiang, I used to see this person in the map of other clans’ experts. He is Shi Kuang, the great demon at the pinnacle stage of Star Sea leveled!” Luo Heng introduced openly as if nobody was around. “The rest are the experts of the Demon Clan. Cosmic experts may be present among them I’m afraid. What do you think, Brother Jiang?”
“Shi Kuang?” Jiang Ming felt rather strange. He used to kill a demon, who was also called Shi Kuang in his world. And that demon was of the Quasi-Sage Realm. Yet the Shi Kuang in front of them was merely of a Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm, a small fry.
“Nothing!” Jiang Ming laughed. “They’re just merits.”
Luo Heng guffawed. He even felt rather high spirited. Previously when he met such experts, he had to be a coward. But now with the presence of Brother Jiang, these great Demons in front of them were merely merits.
He felt it was so exciting. He believed that he would become more prestigious after the battle later.
Any young man would want to be prestigious whenever given a chance.
In fact, Luo Heng thought that he was still young, had time to further improve himself.
Of course, he liked the feeling of being prestigious too. Even though he was mature, and kept relatively low-profile most of the time, he felt high-spirited with what was happening.
“I’ll be a spectator!” As Luo Heng said, armor appeared on his body. He then shook his head, “No, this isn’t sufficient. I’ll die instantly in such a battle regardless of how strong my defense is. But I wish to watch it. Brother Jiang, do you have a perfect solution?”
“You’ll just need to stay with me, I’ll ensure your safety. If there’s any danger, just go there.” Jiang Ming said.
“Great!” Luo Heng took two steps forward. Nevertheless, Luo Heng remained worried.
......
Shi Kuang went into a frenzy. He was, after all, a strong Star Sea expert of the Demon Clan. He was also a notable influential person in the entire universe. But Shi Kuang was disregarded completely by the two kids in front of him, who also despised Shi Kuang and the other experts of the Demon Clan.
“You brats of the human race, I’ve never seen such arrogant people like you two. I’m respected by even Pan Wang, but you two have seen me as a fish on a chopping board.”
“Yes, you’re a fish yourself. No, you are a lion instead!” Jiang Ming looked at Shi Kuang as though Shi Kuang was his food. “The Yuan Qi you mentioned earlier, was killed by me. Oh, no, I haven’t killed him yet. I’ve just imprisoned him. I’ll cook him when I’m free. Would you like to taste some? No, I think both of you should be each other’s company instead. I’ll use him as an ingredient of a dish while you another.”
“F*ck!” An expert with an eagle head by the side of Shi Kuang, was the first to be enraged. He immediately took his move. He distorted the space with a wave, forming an arc which cut directly on Jiang Ming and Luo Heng.
This strike didn’t look powerful but it was extremely terrifying.
The eagle headed demon was also a great demon of a Star Sea, but he was at the initial stage only.
Jiang Ming lifted his hand and burst the eagle headed demon in an instant. The eagle headed demon died tragically on the spot, his body scattered into pieces and his blood permeated the air.
Shi Kuang and the other great demons were frightened at what they had just seen. They could barely believe that Jiang Ming could kill a Star Sea expert with just a strike.
“Since I’ve taken my move, I shall let everyone of you to go accompany him!” As Jiang Ming said, his body grew taller ato about 100-feet in just a blink of an eye.
Although Jiang Ming height wasn’t considered very tall, his outburst aura was like the torrent, poured out to all directions, distorting the void, causing lightning and thunder. It seemed that even the space couldn’t bear Jiang Ming’s majestic force, which also shocked all other experts watching him.
“That’s purely the power of physique!” Shi Kuang was forced to retreat, and his expression horrified.
The demons were proud of their physique. They had strong bloodlines, particularly the bloodline of their royal family, whose genome was far better than that of the human clan. They might be unable to suppress the human expert of the same level, but they had a huge advantage.
However, Shi Kuang realized that Jiang Ming’s physique was more horrifying than his. In fact, it was incomparable.
“Die, all of you!” Since Jiang Ming had made his move, he didn’t want to show any mercy.
As Jiang Ming punched, the heaven and earth roared, and a void vortex formed directly in front, which seemed to be capable of indrawing all stars. There were also people of different roles such as fishermen, woodcutters, farmers and scholars, and nature such as hills, mountains, and rivers. It was the Holy Civilization Fist.
Controlled by the strongest physical body, and the boiling blood, had made the power of this punch extremely terrifying.
“Golden Shield, defend!”
“Nine Level Thunder Pagoda, defend!”
Shi Kuang was extremely terrified. He wanted to dodge the attack but he realized the sticky surroundings had prevented him from tearing the space, let alone to escape. Hence, he quickly took out his defending treasures and evoked supreme defensive means simultaneously.
Unfortunately, all his efforts were insufficient to block out Jiang Ming’s punch. The Golden Shield glittering with golden luminance was scattered. Even the defensive thunder Shi Kuang condensed, failed to withstand the punch. Hence, Shi Kuang was punched to death instantly.
Shi Kuang was not the one who died tragically on the spot, about five Demon Clan’s experts nearby too were killed. Their incomparably strong physiques were drawn into the vortex and were crushed by the strong grinding force. Even their souls didn’t manage to escape.
Jiang Ming didn’t stop after the first punch. He punched continuously until he bashed all Demon Clan’s experts in the surroundings to death.
“Damn, stop it!” A cry was heard. A giant jaw that filled the space was directed at Jiang Ming.
“It’s become more interesting with the arrival of a stronger one!”
With a thought, Jiang Ming sent Luo Heng to his shoulder so that he could better protect him.
“Be careful Brother Jiang!” Luo Heng reminded Jiang Ming. But he was frightened. The giant claw hitting towards them, had condensed a supreme power of destruction. This made Luo Heng feel like he was collapsing. Fortunately, he had Jiang Ming’s protection.
“Don’t worry!” As Jiang Ming said, he punched and burst the giant claw.
“How’s it?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“Wao, this is so amazing!” Luo Heng gave his thumbs up, and exclaimed, “Based on the power of the claw just now, it’s from the Cosmic expert. I think it’s the Goldwing Grand Roc of the Demon Clan. It’s a terrific expert called Jin Diao. Its speed was incomparable, its physique invincible. Its pair of jaws in particular, could tear all things. It was the strongest and the most terrific existence in the entire universe. Yet you blasted its jaw it took pride in with a punch. Amazing, you’re truly amazing.”
Luo Heng was sincere in his compliment.
“I’ll kill him later!” Jiang Ming was satisfied with the punch.
Jiang Ming’s physique was surely strong. In fact, cultivating Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra would temper and strengthen his physique but not up to this stage whereby he could defeat a Quasi-Sage expert.
But Jiang Ming was different. He had comprehended 3,000 laws. Each law he comprehended would strengthen his physique by a little. Especially at the end when he managed to comprehend 3,000 laws, 3,000 Dao maps would be imprinted in his flesh, transforming his physique into a truly terrifying level.
Even Jiang Ming couldn’t estimate how strong his physique was. But he knew that his physique was absolutely no weaker than his cultivation base of his inner world. The punch just now was proof.
‘When my inner world is sublimated to the limit and evolved to the middle chiliocosm, my cultivation will skyrocket, and my physique will undergo a new baptism. By that time, it’s time to really rise.’ As Jiang Ming thought, he saw the furious Jin Diao flying over.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Killing Cosmic Experts
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Killing Cosmic Experts
Jin Diao’s smashed claw was regrowing. As he morphed into a human form, he was engulfed with anger.
A long spear appeared in his hand, laced with an aura that radiated its sharpness. The burst of power radiating from it tore up the space around layer by layer, rolling up into a storm.
“Lowly human!” Jin Diao’s tone of voice was extremely cold. As he paced forth in the void, every step he took created a black hole underneath his feet. His power rose to the extreme. Its intensity felt as though it shook the Star River and oppressed the universe.
Jin Diao’s overwhelming aura traversed into the vast surrounding, causing the meteorites in the distance to suddenly solidify and explode into a pile of dust.
“With this remark of yours, I’ll kill you for sure even if you escape into the Chaos!” Jiang Ming’s expression turned cold.
To Jiang Ming, the human race was not lowly but of the greatest race of all! It was a race incomparable by any other races or clans throughout infinite realms, not even the Innate Saint Spirit!
The greatness of the human race could be proved by looking at the other races or clans living in the billions of realms across infinite time and space. Which of them didn’t morph into human form in the end?
As a member of the noble human race, Jiang Ming was not being arrogant and yet Jin Diao belittled the entire Human Clan. Jiang Ming resented Jin Diao’s despisal and wanted to kill him as a punishment.
“Brother Jin is right! How dare such a feeble human kill the sons of my Demon Clan! How can we let him live!” Another expert of the Demon Clan made his arrival, tearing apart the space. The aura that was radiating from this expert was no weaker than that of the Jin Diao.
His pair of eyes in particular was actually radiating with a gray luminance, corroding the space into numerous potholes.
“It’s not only him that must die! We shall kill the other human experts in the surroundings one by one!” This expert of the Demon Clan was even more ruthless.
“Xiang Mang! Let’s see who will be killing who today, shall we?” A stream of luminance shot over their direction, landing right beside Jiang Ming.
This person was clad in silver armor, and had long wavy hair that gave off a feeling of graceful demeanor. The aura radiating from his body however, was not weak at all.
......
As he rebutted the opposing party’s remark, he cupped his fist at Jiang Ming and introduced himself. “I’m Zhao Changkong. How should I address you?”
“Jiang Ming!” After giving his name, Jiang Ming smiled and said, “Brother Zhao, this is my battlefield. You can just watch the battle on the sidelines!”
“No!” Upon hearing Jiang Ming’s remark, Zhao Changkong frowned. “Jin Diao, this bird person has slandered our human race. Hence, this is no longer the matter of you alone!”
Such a remark from Zhao Changkong increased Jiang Ming’s likability of him. Jiang Ming then said, “Let’s kill him then!”
“Yes!” A silver spear suddenly appeared in Zhao Changkong’s hand. “I’ve long disliked this bird person, but unfortunately didn’t have a chance to make a move. With you around today, let’s kill him! There’s also that Xiang Mang. This beast cub is even more damn! Back then, he secretly intruded into the territory of our human race and swallowed a galaxy of humans in one go. He was hunted down by our peerless experts, but managed to hide himself back in the Demon Clan’s lair. Although there was a big battle, we weren’t able to kill him off. Never would I have expected that he dares to show his face here. Let’s kill him off as well!”
“Kill us off?” Jin Diao sneered, “Zhao Changkong, let’s see who’s killing who today, shall we?”
“Zhao Changkong! Because of that remark of yours, after killing you here, I will head on to the territory of the human race and swallow up at least a whole empire of human beings.” Xiang Mang revealed his cruel and ruthless self. “With the power from the human race’s bloodline, it will help me to improve my cultivation even further.”
“Die!” Jiang Ming couldn’t put up with them any longer as he went ahead and launched his attack.
This time, a sword could be seen appearing in his hands from thin air. It was the Demi-Sage weapon, the Heavenly Emperor Sword.
As soon as Jiang Ming brandished the sword, the color of sky changed immediately. It was followed by the universe trembling.
Jiang Ming fully integrated the power of cultivation as well as physique into the sword.
The sword split through the sky and landed on top of Xiang Mang’s head. At the same time, with a flash of thought, Jiang Ming evoked the Celestial Heart Sword, initiating the Soul technique.
Jiang Ming was really giving it his all this time.
“Die!” On the other side, Zhao Changkong also made his move as the flick of the spear sent off a shocking blow at Jin Diao.
“Just like you, I use a spear as well. Let’s see who’s spear will be meeting its end here!” Jin Diao snorted as he stabbed onwards with his spear, penetrating into the void.
As the tips of the spears collided, the exchange set off an endless torrent into the surrounding, tearing open a spatial fissure that went on thousands of miles away.
The two were shaken back by the collision at the same time. While they were preparing to take their second move, they turned to another direction at the same time, with a face filled with shock.
The mighty Xiang Mang, a supreme Quasi-Sage expert of the universe, was hacked from the ground up by Jiang Ming’s sword and died tragically on the spot.
It didn’t matter which defensive tool or any supreme treasure Xiang Mang had used. They were all useless against Jiang Ming’s attack.
“To think that such a puny beast still dares to eat humans!”
The look on Jiang Ming’s face was ice cold.
Xiang Mang who was standing in front of him had already returned to his true form. It was a terrifying figure that extended into millions of miles away.
“Such a great ingredient! This can be eaten for a long time. If I take it back to the sect, this will definitely help their cultivation to improve rapidly!”
Jiang Ming chuckled as he kept Xiang Mang’s corpse. He then turned over towards Jin Diao.
Jin Diao felt a chill run down his spine. Without even thinking about it, he tore open the space around him, wanting to escape.
“Trying to leave?” Jiang Ming sneered. His Celestial Heart Sword transcended time and disappeared into Jin Diao’s mind.
Jin Diao trembled, and all of his seven orifices were bleeding.
‘This is a spiritual attack?’ Jin Diao thought.
At the same time, the Celestial Heart Sword had shattered the soul defensive Dao vessel in his mind which caused his heart to almost shatter from fear. However, before his soul could escape into the cracks of time and space, the Heavenly Emperor Sword proceeded to split him in two.
As a result, Jin Diao died.
The two halves of his body also turned back into his original form of millions of miles long. His corpse was as huge as a planet, and his blood as much as sea.
Jiang Ming grabbed and kept Jin Dao’s corpse.
“Brother Zhao, are there any other experts of the Demon Clan around? I shall kill all of them together!” The killing intent in Jiang Ming’s heart was set ablaze and it was difficult to restrain himself.
Being here, the thought of restraining himself never went through his mind and he never had the intention of laying low either. He would kill those who mess with him.
“There was one just now. As soon as he saw you kill Jin Diao, he fled off immediately. We can’t catch up on him anymore!” Zhao Changkong’s face was still filled with shock.
Never would he have imagined that Jiang Ming would be so terrifying.
Those two were two Cosmic experts, the strongest among all provided the Supreme Expert didn’t show himself.
This was especially true for Jin Diao. His speed was unparalleled and was almost considered the best in the universe. If he were to intend to escape, even the Supreme Expert might not be able to catch up on him.
Yet, Jin Diao was slaughtered by Jiang Ming in a blink of an eye. So did Xiang Mang.
‘When did we have such a ferocious character within our human race? I’ve never heard of him at all. Could he have been cultivating in the Chaos all this time and have only returned not long ago? That’s probably it.’
Numerous thoughts kept running through Zhao Changkong’s mind. “Brother Jiang! With this battle, you will become famous across the universe. I am afraid that you will also be targeted by many in the future. There are countless peerless experts among the Demon Clan and they have many alliances as well. We human race also have quite a few enemies of our own. You must be very careful after entering the Specter Secret Realm. When you come out of the secret realm, you should immediately return to the territory of the human race. Otherwise, the Supreme Expert of the Demon race will be putting their hands on you.”
“Being besieged is the thing that I’m afraid of the least!” Jiang Ming said indifferently, “If the Supreme Expert of the Demon Clan makes a move, won’t those of our human race do the same as well?”
“They definitely will!” Zhao Changkong said with a smile, “It’s just that when the time comes for everyone to make a move, it would be troublesome if you get caught up in it. Brother Jiang, I suggest that you return to our human territory now. You will be absolutely safe once you get there. If the Supreme Expert among the Demon Clan rushes over to our territory, it will serve as a declaration of war on our entire human race, the kind of war that never ends till one side is completely annihilated.”
“The Supreme Expert making a move would lead to such an implication?”
“Of course! This is because the Supreme Experts are too terrifying. Once they attack, the resulting fluctuations from their clashes can easily destroy a Star Sea and annihilate a Star Field. Who would even dare to act at will? There is also a common agreement among the Supreme Experts of the universe that they will never intervene in the matters of the universe unless their race is at the brink of extinction! ”
“If that’s the case, will the Demon Clan’s Supreme Experts still launch their attacks?”
“Well, it’s better to be sure than sorry! Furthermore, the Demon Clan has always had no credibility. If they secretly attacked you, who can you even look for to reason with? If they really forcefully attack you, who can stop them?”
“That makes sense!” Jiang Ming nodded.
It was not a possibility but rather a certainty. Agreement was worthless at times.
He killed two Cosmic experts of the Demon Clan. This had already shook the foundation of their race. How would they let this be swept under the rug?
“The Supreme Expert of the universe! I really want to try meeting one.” Jiang Ming muttered.
Zhao Changkong raised his brows and was almost scared to death. He quickly said, “Please don’t, Brother Jiang! The Supreme Experts can easily kill those peak Cosmic existence. Don’t even try, let alone think about it.”
“Brother Jiang, it’s not time yet! Also, it’s not too late to try and do so after you improve further!” Luo Heng was also startled and quickly persuaded Jiang Ming not to act irrationally.
“Don’t worry! I don’t want to die yet!” Jiang Ming chuckled.
Right this very moment, something changed at the entrance to the Specter Secret Realm in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - Invincible below Supreme Experts: Long Jingang
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Invincible below Supreme Experts: Long Jingang
??
In the distance, the void was split open. An old man clad in purple robe walked out of the rift as he landed on one of the nearest planets.
He closed his eyes slightly, as if he was receiving transmission of information.
“During the besieging of the Human genius Luo Heng, She Luo was killed. Yuan Qi who went forth was beheaded as well. Shi Kuang and the likes discovered traces of Luo Heng near the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm and were prepared to surround and kill him off. The result however, was that they were killed themselves. Jin Dian and Xiang Mang also made an appearance but were killed off as well.”
“The killer was Luo Heng’s companion, Jiang Ming of the Human race!”
“How did such a peerless existence suddenly appear from the human race? There isn’t any information or record prior to this.”
The old man continued to murmur as his brows were furrowed.
Based on the information that he had obtained, a slight deduction led him to the conclusion thatJiang Ming of the Human race was probably the peak Cosmic expert. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to kill Jin Diao and Xiang Mang with such ease.
‘Alas! My two old friends! To think that both of you died together!’
‘Humans! Humans!’
‘If we do not take revenge this time, the prestige of my Demon Clan will surely be greatly reduced! It will even shake the foundation of my Demon Clan!’
‘I’m afraid it will be quite difficult to kill this child.’
‘I’ll first contact the few rulers of my Demon Clan and then form an alliance with the other factions that are enemies of the Human race to besiege Jiang Ming. He mustn’t be allowed to leave the Specter Secret Realm. Also, there’s that person as well.”
As the old man’s thoughts were running through his mind, his consciousness penetrated into the void and sent out messages one after another.
Among all the races in the universe, all of the top ranking races knew the situation of the battle outside of the Specter Secret Realm.
Many experts couldn’t help but sighed. In the past years, Cosmic experts usually wouldn’t participate in a battle no matter how intense it was. There might not even be any such an expert in the entire universe who would die in an average of hundreds of millions of years. Yet two died today. The world would soon be in chaos!
At the Specter Secret Realm, blinding luminance could be seen swirling as Dao fluctuations rose into the sky, finally turning into a portal that spanned hundreds of millions of lightyears.
It was extremely vast and could be entered from all directions.
Many experts knew that this signified the opening of the Specter Secret Realm. Right that very moment, it was already possible for them to enter into the rift.
However, Zhao Changkong and Jiang Ming didn’t move at all. The two continued to chatter.
“Brother Zhao, how many Supreme Experts are there in the Demon Clan?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Three!” Zhao Changkong replied, “They are all terrifying beings. They are invincible in this universe.”
Although he replied Jiang Ming, Zhao Changkong actually felt weird. He wondered why Jiang Ming, who was able to slash down Cosmic experts, didn’t know how many Supreme Experts the Demon Clan had.
Although he was in doubt, he did not ask any questions. On the contrary, he answered every question Jiang Ming raised.
After a simple chat, Jiang Ming also learned a lot of information.
For example, the Demon Clan here specifically referred to beasts. The Botanical Race was an incomparably strong faction. The Star Beasts were also not considered the Demon Clan. These two major factions also had their own Supreme Expert. Although they each had only one Supreme Expert, they were also among the top beings in the universe.
According to Zhao Changkong, only one of the three Supreme Elders of the Demon Clan stayed in the clan all year round to prevent unforeseen incidents. The other two would be searching for great encounters in the Chaos. This had been going on for hundreds of millions of years.
The rest of the other factions were somewhat the same.
The Human Race also had three Supreme Experts with Pan Wang being the strongest among them. In fact, Pan Wang was even recognized as the strongest in the universe. He had made a name for himself as the strongest with his pair of fists that had beaten various peerless experts of the universe.
‘According to Zhao Changkong, there’s at least 30 Supreme Experts here!’
Upon hearing the answers to his questions, Jiang Ming couldn’t help but be in awe. Jiang Ming couldn’t believe that the number of Supreme Experts, which was equivalent to the Saints, was a total of 30.
Based on his speculation, a great chiliocosm could at most produce seven Saints in total. However, there were more than 30 of them here, which was obviously abnormal.
“Brother Zhao, is there such an existence that surpasses the Supreme Expert?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“It is rumored that by breaking the shackles of fate and escaping out of the Chaos, they can sanctify their Dao to a higher level. However, whether such an existence exists or not, no one knows, not even Pan Wang himself.” Zhao Changkong shook his head.
As he looked at Jiang Ming, his expression became more and more strange. He wondered why this person in front of him knew nothing?
Luo Heng, who was standing right next to Jiang Ming, lowered his head and smiled. He thought, ‘Oh Senior Changkong! Even if you break your head thinking about it, you will never understand. That’s because Jiang Ming actually originates from another universe!
“Brother Jiang, shall we?” Zhao Changkong pointed to the front. “Although the treasures inside will continue to be revealed into the world, the sooner we start exploring the place, the more great encounters that we will be able to attain.”
“Alright! Let’s go!” Jiang Ming nodded. He wanted to find out the wonders of the Specter Secret Realm as well.
Zhao Changkong suddenly paused as he looked over at Luo Heng. He frowned, “Luo Heng, I understand that you are the peerless genius of our human race. However, the chances of you surviving in the secret realm are very slim!”
“He’ll follow me!” Jiang Ming said.
Zhao Changkong shook his head. “The Specter Secret Realm has an open secret, that is, you will be randomly placed in different locations upon entering.”
“Is there such a thing?” Luo Heng was shocked.
Jiang Ming was also surprised.
There was no such thing recorded in the memory that he took in.
“This is not a very secret type of secret.” Zhao Changkong explained, “There is no record on the intranet! If you really want to enter, there is only one way, which is to keep the person in a supreme spatial vessel. After you get inside, you can let the person out again. However, with your current strength, it’s too difficult for you to acquire great encounters inside. I fear that you may lose your life if you randomly encounter those of other races.”
“Brother Luo! I can only aggrieve you for the time being!” Upon listening to Zhao Changkong’s remark, Jiang Ming apologized to Luo Heng.
“Alright! Thank you!” Luo Heng hesitated for a while, but agreed in the end.
Luo Heng hesitated not because he was unwilling to be put away by Jiang Ming. He was afraid that he might be troubling Jiang Ming down if he went along. However, if he was not following them inside, he would be in real danger here on the outside as well.
As the three discussed among themselves, they were flying towards the portal that leads to the Specter Secret Realm.
Right this very moment, a terrifying aura could be felt behind them. It was accompanied by a thunderous roar. “Wanting to leave? Have you even asked my permission?”
Jiang Ming turned around abruptly, as his body turned into a giant again. At the same time, a stream of air flew out of his body, pushing Luo Heng over to Zhao Changkong’s side.
A fist could be seen coming right towards them. It punctured the void and even formed black hole. The force set off storms that were sweeping through thousands of miles, distorting the void around the area.
“Inch Strength Thousand Punch!”
Jiang Ming let out a punch but was blasted three thousand miles away from the impact. He could feel the tremors in his chest and the numbness in his arms.
“What terrifying power!” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
“Long Jingang! It’s you!” Zhao Changkong blurted out when he saw a huge nine-feet-figure walking towards them from the depths of the universe. The figure had two horns on his head, and his vertical pupils emitted a gloomy luminance.
This person’s naked arms were tangled with muscles that looked like steel cable, where the might that could even destroy the Star River was contained within them. Vague sounds of blood pumping through his blood vessels as though they were the turbulence of the Milky Way could be heard. His heartbeat felt as though it could collapse the starry sky.
“Of course it’s me!” Long Jingang’s voice was like a deafening bell.
“Long Jingang, known to be the strongest of the Demon Clan below Supreme Experts.” Jiang Ming also recognized him.
Among Yuan Qi’s memories, the information about this person here was particularly abundant.
Long Jingang was originally of the Dragon beast. His physique had been tempered to an incomparably terrifying level, and was known to be invincible below Supreme Experts. His genetic level had also broken through the iron laws. Armed with only his pair of fists, he fought off with many peerless opponents all over the world.
He was a peak Cosmic expert. What’s even more terrifying was that he even had an innate special ability.
“Now this is what I call a rival!” Jiang Ming let out a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - The Pinnacle of Cosmic Leveled; Huo Shen, Hong Ying
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: The Pinnacle of Cosmic Leveled; Huo Shen, Hong Ying
Long Jingang’s aura was on a rampage.
With every step he took, the space itself shattered. At the same time, his whole body began to grow bigger until 10,000-feet high before coming to a halt.
The dragon horns on his head, and his eyes were akin to the sun and the moon.
His single breath emanated special ability, which sealed off the surrounding area, forming an area of confinement. Even the Specter Secret Realm that was at a far distance was affected by it, creating ripples of energy.
The many experts that rushed over to the scene were all trembling in fear. They were afraid of being dragged into the skirmish.
Upon seeing Long Jingang, all of them took a detour to avoid him, entering the Specter Secret Realm from another direction.
“When I heard that you were the one who killed Jin Dian and beheaded Xiang Mang, I didn’t believe it at all. It’s unheard that a human could kill the two of them.” As Long Jingang clenched his fist, the compressed air in his palm exploded, as though tens of thousands of thunders were striking at the same time.
He looked at Jiang Ming as if he was looking at a dead man.
“It’s you! Jiang Ming of the Human race! The one who killed them both!” Long Jingang’s rumbling voice was filled with incessant killing intent. “I can’t believe it, even right now.”
“From this day forth, you will realize that there’s a lot more that you won’t be able to believe!” Jiang Ming chuckled softly. However, his gaze was completely solemn.
This person in front of him was putting a lot of pressure on him. At the same time, Jiang Ming’s body was also growing up to 10,000feet high, on par with his opponent.
His aura however, was obviously much weaker than Long Jingang’s. After all, there were still quite some differences between the two.
“To dare admit to your doings in front of me and not escape! I must say, Jiang Ming, you’ve got balls.” Long Jingang sneered, “Since you’ve killed my two brothers, I’ll kill you even if Pan Wang comes over today! No one can stop me!”
“Such shameless remarks!” Zhao Changkong snorted coldly.
“I’ll kill you after Jiang Ming, you little hatchling!” Long Jingang merely took a glance at Zhao Changkong, obviously ignoring him.
Zhao Changkong’s expression turned gloomy, but he didn’t rebut the remark. That was because he knew he was way inferior compared to Long Jingang.
“Tell me, did you come from the Chaos? It’s impossible for me to not know you if you’ve been cultivating in the human territories!” Long Jingang asked.
“Jingang, why bother yourself with him? Just kill him and be done with it.” A deep voice could be heard coming from the end of the sky. A star could be seen swiftly approaching from an infinite distance.
In a blink of an eye, the star had already closed their gap, being millions of miles away. In fact, that wasn’t a star, but clearly a large giant that was engulfed in boundless flame. As the giant took a few steps more, he came face to face with Jingang.
This giant was also a terrific existence with a height of 1,000-feet tall. However, it had a strange body formed from rocks. These rocks looked as though they were red crystals of extremely pure quality, burning with the strongest of flames.
“Kill him? There’s no rush! No rush at all.” Long Jinggang replied, feeling as if victory was already within his grasp. “Now that I’ve already locked my target on him and I’m practically in front of him, do you think he can still escape? I’m just curious, that’s all. A person who’s capable of killing Jin Diao and Xiang Mang, yet unheard of all these while. It felt as though he just popped out of nowhere. It just doesn’t make sense!”
“He’s either someone secretly nurtured by the human race or someone that’s been out cultivating in the Chaos. There’s only these two possibilities!” The flame giant continued, “Rather than wasting more time, why not just kill him and be done with it. We’ll take this opportunity to join hands and kill off all the human experts that have entered the Specter Secret Realm!”
“Haha! This’s a great suggestion!” Long Jingang couldn’t help laughing. He looked at Jiang Ming and said, “Do you know who this is?”
“It doesn’t matter who he is. Just by the remarks he made just now, his fate has been decided. It’s death!” Jiang Ming replied with an affirmative tone.
“Death? Me?” The flame giant raised his huge palm and pointed to his nose, as if he had heard a big joke. “This puny human here is so ignorant. You’ve angered Long Jingang and also wanted to kill me. Where does such courage come from?”
“He is merely an arrogant person! Huo Shen, I will kill him while you can go kill Zhao Changkong!” As both Long Jingang’s fists touched, the burst of power directly formed a black hole out of nowhere.
“Haha! Alright then! The humans had long been eye sore to me anyways.” As Huo Shen laughed, the flames around him suddenly expanded, reaching millions of miles above the sky. When seen from a distance, it looked as though it was a star.
In fact, the aura emanating from his body was much stronger than that of the star. With just a huff from his breath, he could probably shatter meteors into pieces.
“Huo Shen of the Flaming Giants! How dare you strike?” This domineering voice was radiating with boundless killing intent. “If you dare make a move, I’ll first kill you, and then wipe out your Flaming Giant Clan. There won’t be any survivors left as I’ll let you all go extinct!”
As the last sentence fell, a lady could be seen approaching from afar, landing right beside Zhao Changkong. This red-haired woman clad in red clothes looked like a ball of flame. Her face however, was very pale, with streaks of red blushes on her cheeks. With that thin waist and voluminous chest of hers, she looked like a really hot little girl.
“Hong Ying! I’m relieved now that you’re here.” Zhao Changkong let out a smile. “From my understanding of your character, you shouldn’t have come so quickly.”
“You really know me!” Hong Ying replied with a smile and continued, “Well, I just returned from my training in the Cosmic Secret Realm. When I have my 3,000 favorite concubines singing and dancing for me, I heard that the Specter Secret Realm has been opened, but I don’t care about it. When I heard that Jiang Ming, a rising star of our human race, killed two Cosmic experts of the Demon Clan, I was so excited that I almost… Ahem…Well, I’m afraid that the Demon Clan might scheme on him and so I hurried over.”
The corner of Zhao Changkong’s mouth twitched.
A strange look flashed through Jiang Ming’s face as he thought, ‘This little girl is no ordinary lady. She can become a buddy of mine! After all, she’s also the master of a harem.’
“Hey! I just got here and I heard the howling and screaming of this blotch Huo Shen. He’s really courting death!” As Hong Ying stared at Huo Shen, her immense killing intent was brought to flames.
“Hong Ying, you slut! Why would I be afraid of you?” Huo Shen sneered, “Would you like to have a taste of a man? I am the Venerate of the flames! I guarantee your satisfaction.”
Upon hearing such remarks, Hong Ying’s expression turned cold. She looked over at Jiang Ming and asked, “Can you fend off Long Jingang?”
“As long as he’s not one of the Supreme Experts, I’m not afraid of anyone.” Jiang Ming clasped his fists. He understood what she meant and said with a smile, “Just kill if you feel like it!”
“Haha! That’s great! I recognize you as my brother! After I slaughter Huo Shen, the two of us will join forces and finish off Long Jingang.” Hong Ying laughed. She then turned around and threw herself at Huo Shen, “Playing with fire? I’m practically your ancestor. Flame of Desire, Flame of heart, Flame of Demon, Flame of Calamity, Flame of Soul! Explode!”
As she raised her hand and grasped midair, a type of energy that was in Huo Shen’s body suddenly exploded, causing flames to burst from his body.
“You bitch! You’re courting death!” Huo Shen’s aura got slightly disoriented. He was also abnormally enraged.
The two started to trade blows in an instant.
Jiang Ming heard the swift introduction by Zhao Changkong. “Hong Ying is the top peerless expert of our Human Race. The Cosmic level is divided into elementary-tier, mid-tier, high-tier, peak and the pinnacle. She is of the peak tier, stronger than Huo Shen. She’s bold and straightforward with great masculine traits. Although she may look improper, she takes friendships very seriously. You don’t have to worry about her fight against Huo Shen. Long Jingang is at the pinnacle of Cosmic leveled, hence he is practically invincible below Supreme Experts. If you really break into a fight with him, be sure to be careful. I’ll look for an opportunity to attack and try inflicting heavy damage on him.”
“Brother Zhao, you can just watch us fight with peace of mind. I’ll be handling Long Jingang myself!” Jiang Ming replied to Zhao Changkong telepathically.
Jiang Ming proceeded to pace forward as he walked over to engage his opponent.
“First there’s Jiang Ming and then Zhao Changkong. Now comes Hong Ying as well. When I kill off the three of you, I’m afraid the Human Race will probably fall into despair for quite some time.” Long Jingang also made his way towards Jiang Ming. “I shall take advantage of the opening of Specter Secret Realm to slaughter all the top ranked experts of your human race. ”
“Let’s see who the final victor is then, shall we?” Jiang Ming’s fighting spirit has risen to an unprecedented level that even his primal spirit was gleaming with luminance.
The pinnacle of the Cosmic leveled when compared with that of Honggu Great Chiliocosm, was obviously corresponding to the Demi-Sage realm.
He might have been frightened to go against experts of such level before, but now, he was fearless.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - Sea of Chaos, Two Broken Universes (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Sea of Chaos, Two Broken Universes (Part 1)
??
Jiang Ming was ecstatic, excited, and high-spirited. It was because his opponent didn’t have absolute power to suppress him. Hence Jiang Ming was able to do his best in the battle.
It was a battle, which Jiang Ming had been yearning for.
“Let’s see who the final victor is?” Long Jingang chuckled. At the same time, armor appeared on his body. It had numerous divine luminance flowing out, and turned into incomparably sophisticated lines imprinted on Long Jingang’s body, abruptly obscuring his aura.
As both of his fists touched each other, it set off a boundless torrent. He said, “You’re the first one to confront me fearlessly. Hence, I’ll give you a quick one. I’ll blast your head directly. No, I shall crush you into pieces to be divided among my clan’s members. As for your head? I’ll make your skull into my glass wine so that I can drink wine with it.”
“What a good idea!” Jiang Ming smiled indifferently. His sight, however, was staring at Long Jinggang’s armor. He could determine based on its aura that the armor was at least of a peak Quasi-Sage defensive treasure, and might even be of the Demi-Sage Weapon.
The defensive-leveled armor must be very terrifying.
Long Jingang was indeed very meticulous. He first evoked his defensive item even though he had an invincible physique. Hence, it was obvious that Long Jingang was not someone reckless but he was absolutely haughty.
“Long Jingang, may I ask if you are a True Dragon?” Jiang Ming asked with a beaming face.
Jiang Ming had armor appearing on his body as well. It was glittering with silver luminance, flowing with immortal fluctuations, and breaking forth inscriptions that revolved around Jiang Ming before disappearing.
The armor could defend him from all directions. It was the Demi-Sage Silver Luminance Battle Armor which Jiang Ming got from Tai Jian.
Long Jingang’s pupil constricted, and his eyes were burned with flames of anger. He didn’t rush to attack but stared at Jiang Ming’s armor as he asked, “The grade of your armor is definitely no weaker than mine. But why haven’t I heard it before? There are just a few peak Cosmic defensive armor among millions of races and clans in the entire world, and I know all of them. However, I’ve never heard nor seen yours before. Now I’m even more assured that you are from the Chaos and this armor you got from the Chaos as well!”
He made a pause before he continued asking with curiosity. “Is this the plot of Pan Wang? Train members of the human clan in the Chaos? Or discovered another universe?”
“Another universe?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“Didn’t you know that? Although it’s quite secretive but based on your background, you should know about it.” Long Jingang became even more doubtful. “Well, since you don’t want to tell me, I’ll slaughter you to get your defensive treasure. With it, I’ll definitely exchange it for a supreme offensive weapon.”
“Wait!” As Jiang Ming saw Long Jingang was about to take his move, he waved his hand. “Long Jingang, you haven’t answered me yet. Are you a True Dragon?”
“Do you want to die faster?” Flames again were burning in Long Jingang’s eyes.
Jiang Ming snickered. He wanted to further enraged Long Jingang.
Jiang Ming had already called up the Human Path Record.
Name: Long Jingang
Race: Demon Clan (Dragon Clan? Golden Pangolin Clan? Dragon Pangolin Clan?)
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Pinnacle Cosmic (Demi-Sage)
Background: An elder of the Demon Clan in the Star River
Relationship: -93
Innate talent: Supreme
Status: Upon the formation of the universe, a strong being was born. He traversed Star River, and soared through Star Sea with his tyrannical body, and immense divine power. He was a True Dragon.
: As the universe evolved, and the Star River revolved, boundless great fortunes were made available. Hence, numerous clans were born.
: Fighting for hegemony, slaughtering, and occupying territory, were the norm even in the era of the universe.
: True Dragon was tyrannical, hence he gradually made a name for himself, and managed to be one of the top in the universe. He also attracted numerous experts of his kind, and founded the Demon Clan.
: At the beginning, the True Dragon wanted to include the rare Star Beast and Botanical Race, but he failed to do so.
: As the Demon Clan grew bigger, he tried to create a clan of his own bloodline but to no avail. He had an idea, and began to put it into action. He looked for an extraordinarily strong clan in the universe, kidnapped a female with a high cultivation base, and started working on it.
: The True Dragon was ecstatic that he managed to have his offsprings but he was enraged that these offsprings were of weird shapes, low intelligence, and spiritualism. He almost killed them.
: The True Dragon ignored them, and was later regretted that his offsprings became incestuous, producing a group of dragon beasts almost without wit. The most well-known lineage among them was the dinosaurs, which used to become food for many clans.
: Feeling dispirited, he gave up to build a clan out of his own bloodline. He shifted his focus to compete for hegemony in the universe, snatch resources and luck to become the strongest in the universe.
: He called himself Long Qian. Long referred to his original self as a dragon while Qian meant greatness, alleging that the True Dragon would dominate the world, and roar in the universe.
: As his territory grew bigger, he eventually had to deal with the extraordinarily strong human clan. After 30 million years of wars with the human clan, he had accumulated endless hatred, leading to a genocide.
: That war had exhausted many experts of the Human Clan and the Demon Clan. The war had resulted in the collapse of Star River, transformation of Star Field into Chaos, and the expansion of the war location to numerous Star Sea.
: It ended up with the sudden rise of Pan Wang from the Human Clan, who crippled the True Dragon with unparalleled power. The True Dragon would have been killed if he didn’t fall into a secret realm while escaping.
: Nevertheless, Long Qian was so severely injured that he was dying. He was fortunate to be saved by Jia Wan, a mutated strong woman from the Golden Pangolin Clan. When she learned about the identity of Long Qian, she began to think whether she could produce an incomparably strong offspring by combining her mutated blood with Long Qian’s bloodline.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Sea of Chaos, Two Broken Universes (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Sea of Chaos, Two Broken Universes (Part 2)
??
: She was moved, so she took action, and succeeded.
: Long Qian did the greatest thing while he was still in a coma.
: He found out Jian Wan became pregnant only after he woke up. His face was gloomy and he felt ashamed of himself. As the first True Dragon of the universe, and the general of the Demon Clan, he was actually, actually being…
: However, because Long Qian later learned about the strong bloodline of Jia Wan, he had a hint of hope.
: While he was still in the recovery phase, his son was born. His son was a mutated individual with a dragon head and a Golden Pangolin’s body. He was a dragon beast in fact.
: Long Qian was furious, wanted to kill his own son but he was stopped by Jian Wan. Hence, he severely injured Jia Wan, and left furiously.
: Jia Wan raised her son on her own. But because she found out her injuries were too severe, and she wouldn’t live long, she sacrificed herself with her clan’s inheritance method. She merged boundless fortunes into her son’s body, inducing mutation.
: Long Jingang was born.
: Prior to the death of Jia Wan, she passed her son an obsession to take revenge. She requested her son to temper the dragon head of Long Qian, who was ungrateful, ruthless, and cruel to even kill his own sons.
: Long Jingang had it memorized in his soul.
: In the secret realm of the universe, he grew up at fast speed. When he had grown up to a certain level, he took his mother’s item and returned to the Golden Pangolin Clan. However, he was seen as a cross-breed and was almost beaten to death.
:While lingering on and growing silently, he also awakened a talent, which was devouring.
: The talent allowed him to devour other living beings’ origin to grow himself. Since then, he had revealed his cruelty.
: After numerous years, the entire Golden Pangolin Clan had been wiped out. All of them had become the food of Long Jingang, strengthening himself.
: As Long Jingang looked back, there were countless bones and skulls. He then looked into the universe and cried, “Long Qian, I’ll not only temper your head, I’ll devour you too.”
: As Long Jingang walked out of the secret realm of the universe, he was discovered by Long Qian through the connection between their bloodline. Long Qian got to him immediately. When he found out about the strong cultivation base, and intelligence of Long Jingang, he was ecstatic. He said, “I, Long Qian, have finally got a proper son. My good son, I’ll take you traversing the universe from now onwards, and build you 30 million harem. I’ll get you women from thousands of clans so that you can produce a clan.”
: Long Jingang was speechless but he showed his obedience.
: It was not the time for him to rebel yet. He wanted to rely on Long Qian to grow until he was capable of revealing his true intention.
: Long Jingang would act as a good son temporarily.
: Long Jingang grew even faster under Long Qian’s cultivation. Both his divine power and physique were almost at the peak for each realm.
: His innate talent was terrifying, his comprehension was supreme, and his bloodline was unparalleled. Hence, he became the genius of the Demon Clan, who surprised the universe.
: He was capable of resisting Cosmic experts while he was at the Star Sea level.
: Because of Long Jingang’s strength, he had quickly built his credibility and might in the Demon Clan. He also conquered surrounding territories, bringing honors to the Demon Clan.
: When he was of the Cosmic level, he became an elder of the Demon Clan, got his hand on the true authority.
: The matter that the father was a Supreme Expert and the son the Cosmic expert, had become a beautiful story in the universe.
: Long Jingang remained growing quietly. He would devour experts from other clans to strengthen his personal origin. He even went to the Chaos and grew at a faster rate under his father’s lead.
: He learned from Long Qian that the Chaos was also known as the Sea of Chaos, and their universe was not the only one in it.
: They discovered two of the other universes but he had no idea why they had been broken. As for whether there were other universes? Long Qian was assured that there were. It was because the Sea of Chaos was too big that no one knew how big it was. Moreover,there were numerous dangerous areas that even Long Qian, a Supreme Expert, didn’t dare to enter.
: As Long Jingang returned from the Chaos, he had stepped into the pinnacle stage of Cosmic level.
: He wanted to break the shackles to become a Supreme Expert so that he would have a certain degree of certainty in his own universe.
: He started cultivating quietly from the basics but it was unfortunate that the breakthrough was so difficult that he didn’t know what to do. Hence, he decided to continue snatching others’ origins in further strengthening himself.
: He believed that he would have a breakthrough when he had accumulated to a certain level!
: When he was about to take action, he heard about the opening of the Specter Secret Realm. He was excited. ‘Even God’s helping me. Alas, I heard from Long Qian that this Specter Secret Realm is the place of fortune which is connected to the origin of the universe. I may be able to break through provided I’ve got some fortune in there. That old Dragon is still in the Chaos. After my breakthrough, I shall go to him, severely injure him, and devour him.’
: Following that, he heard about Jian Diao and Xiang Mang being killed by an expert of the Human Clan, who had never shown himself. In addition to his curiosity, he wanted to obtain the origin of Jin Diao and Xiang Mang to enrich himself, and kill a few experts of the Human Clan to snatch their origins in the preparation of his breakthrough. Hence, he rushed towards the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm without hesitation.
Jiang Ming learned much information about Long Jingang, but they were mostly insignificant.
However, there were two points that surprised Jiang Ming. He didn’t expect Long Jingang to be a son of the Supreme Expert, the only True Dragon in this world. Meanwhile, the other dragons were obviously being categorized as the Dragon Beasts.
Long Qian was indeed very cruel. He didn’t only want to kill his own son, he even severely injured Jian Wan, who saved his life and gave birth to his son. Jia Wan died eventually. Long Qian was absolutely someone ruthless.
Another one was about the universe being surrounded by the Sea of Chaos. And they discovered two broken universes?
Jiang Ming felt that it was very weird, and guessed, ‘The Sea of Chaos outside the Honggu Great Chiliocosm is a supreme world but the Sea of Chaos here is indeed a Chaos. It seems that the Supreme Experts here don’t know about the Sea of Chao. Can it be that we are not in the same Chaos?’
As soon as this idea appeared, Jiang Ming was agitated and quickly suppressed the thought.
While looking at Long Jingang opposite him, Jiang Ming smiled. “Long Jingang, why are you so furious when I ask whether you are a True Dragon?”
Jiang Ming also took a sweeping glance at another side. He saw Hong Ying was still fighting against Huo Shen. However, this peculiar lady had overwhelmingly suppressed Huo Shen.
‘The Human Clan here is extremely united!’ Jiang Ming lamented.
“I’ve decided. I want to devour you myself!” A pair of gloves appeared on Long Jingang’s hands. “Since you’re capable of resisting my punch and confronting me fearlessly, you must be extraordinary. Hence, you deserve my best attack. In the universe, who else can make me do my best other than the Supreme Expert? Alas, I’m feeling so lonely!”
“Lonely? Since you’ve met me, your life from now onwards. No, not your life as a dragon and pangolin hybrid, you would never feel alone!” Jiang Ming snickered.
Long Jingang’s pupil constricted. Nobody knew his real identity other than his father, Long Qian. After all, he had devoured the entire Golden Pangolin Clan.
“You want to kill Long Qian, right?” Jiang Ming said without concealing, hence his voice had been spreaded out into the distance.
Long Jingang seemed to have heard a joke that he couldn’t help but guffaw. The vibration of his laugh vibrated out, crashing a star millions lightyears away. Then, he abruptly stopped guffawing, and sneered, “Everyone knows that Long Qian is my father. Without him, I won’t be here today. In this case, why would I want to kill him? Jiang Ming, the way you’re trying to sow dissension between us is so low grade that even I feel ashamed of you.”
“Really?” Jiang Ming said with relish, “But why did I hear that Long Qian was the one who had killed Jia Wan. Jia Wan is your mother, a member of the Golden Pangolin Clan. Prior to your mother’s death, she wanted you to temper the dragon head of Long Qian, right? When I asked earlier whether you are a True Dragon, you were enraged just because you aren’t. You are the hybrid between dragon and pangolin. Hence, it’s more appropriate to call yourself a member of the Dragon Pangolin Clan!”
“F*ck off!” As Long Jingang’s scars on his heart had just been exposed, his rage hidden deep in his heart surged, and overtook his senses. He took his move without hesitation.
“You’re so easy to be furious, aren’t you? A beast is indeed a beast!” Jiang Ming smirked. His expression turned solemn, his power has been evoked to the extreme, and cast a peerless special ability at Long Jingang.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - Jiang Ming was Jealous: Glove, Ax, Fighting Intent, Bell, Pagoda (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Jiang Ming was Jealous: Glove, Ax, Fighting Intent, Bell, Pagoda (Part 1)
??
Jiang Ming had exposed Long Jingang with just a few sentences.
It wasn’t a secret that Long Jingang’s father was Long Qian. The matter whereby the father was a Supreme Expert and the son at the pinnacle stage of the Cosmic level, had been spread out as a beautiful story in the universe because of its incredibility.
Nevertheless, nobody knew about Long Jingang’s mother. Now that her mother’s identity as a pangolin had been revealed, all experts paying their attention here, had a strange look. They had never thought that Long Jingang was a hybrid between the massive True Dragon and the pangolin, a mountain driller. They couldn’t even believe that Long Jingang intended to take revenge for his mother’s behalf when they heard that Long Qian was the killer of Long Jingang’s mother. But they had to believe it when they saw the furious Long Jingang, who was filled with concentrating killing intentions, terrifying power and deterrence.
‘Would Long Jingang kill us all if it was true?’ Many experts were fearful when they thought of such a possibility. Hence, they immediately plunged into the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm.
It was their nature to be a busybody, enjoying watching the incident. However, when the incident became a threat to their safety, they wouldn’t be enjoying it anymore.
“Long Jingang, I didn’t know that you’ve such a past. Haha, I’ll support you to take revenge on your father!” Hong Ying had utterly suppressed Huo Shen. Hence, she couldn’t help but tease Long Jingang when she heard Jiang Ming.
“Damn! All of you should be killed!” Rage had completely overtaken Long Jingang.
Boundless power rolled out, setting off layers of ripples like the water waves in the thousand of miles of space. There were even numerous long spatial rifts across the space, extremely terrifying.
As soon as Long Jingang finished his words, his blow crushed into Jiang Ming’s.
Boom!
The space collapsed. The aftermath of the two people’s blows turned a million miles of space into a black hole.
Jiang Ming was thrown out by the exchange too.
Zhao Changkong immediately grabbed Luo Heng and retreated afar. At the same time he asked, “How did you know Jiang Ming? Both of you look like good friends.”
“Jiang Ming is very strong but he is kind and humble.” Luo Heng explained, “I’ve been cultivating in the headquarters until I went on an adventure. But I was being chased after by a small team from the Demon Clan that I accidentally entered a secret realm, where I was saved by Brother Jiang. It attracted a series of revenge from the Demon Clan, and brother Jiang was the one who killed all of them. Hence, such a situation appeared.”
In fact, Luo Heng was in a great shock. He knew Jiang Ming had just got to his world but he didn’t know how Jiang Ming learned in great detail about Long Jingang. Through the facial expression of Long Jingang, it was obvious that those details were absolutely secretive.
‘Could it be the privilege of the Group Admin?’ Luo Heng thought but he was not assured. After all, Jiang Ming had given him too much shock.
“I can see that brother Jiang is kind even though I’ve just known him.” Zhao Changkong nodded. “What’s more he is really strong, extraordinarily strong. I think his strength is about the same as Long Jingang. Luo Heng, be prepared, I’ll keep you whenever there’s a chance for me to attack.”
“Okay!” Luo Heng nodded.
“Hahaha…” The guffaw of Jiang Ming was heard. He made a turn, and plunged himself forward. “Great, this is so great. Long Jingang, come again.”
Jiang Ming felt wonderful when their power collided during the body combat. It was totally different while staying together with his Junior Sister. It belonged to men’s romance, and showed men’s toughness.
“I’ll hammer you to death!” Long Jingang was full of killing intentions. Hence, he released all his powers as he roared, “War Hammer!”
Long Jingang slammed his fists and smashed forward. The power like the whistling and roaring tsunami surged towards Jiang Ming, causing him to frown, and cast his Killer Civilization Punch Technique without any hesitation.
Jiang Ming was trying to use the Dao of Civilization as a means of killing.
Boom.
Jiang Ming was still a lot weaker than Long Jingang. If it wasn’t because of the Silver Luminance Battle Armor, his shoulders would have been blasted.
“In this case, I shouldn’t hold back any longer!” Jiang Ming paced into void, radiating out Dao fluctuations layer after layer, which formed an illusional river at his feet. And he condensed three clones: the Past Body, the Present Body, and the Future Body.
Immediately after the appearance of the three bodies, they evoked three different peerless special abilities. They were the Killer Civilization Punch Technique, Three Thousand Cataclysm Fingers, and Entombing Sky Illusory Palm respectively, all exerted the best combat power of Jiang Ming combined. But Jiang Ming was shocked that none of his techniques worked on Long Jingang.
“What a showy technique. Are you trying to tickle me?” Long Jingang smirked. His head flickered, and turned into a golden dragon head. He roared and cast his natal special ability, the Soul-Destroying Dragon Roar.
When Zhao Changkong at a distance saw the action of Long Jingang, he was shocked. A palace appeared before him, where he dragged Luo Heng into it. At the same time he told Jiang Ming telepathically, “Brother Jiang, this is a means of soul attack, irresistible by human power alone.”
As waves of sound were roaring over, they were wiped out by the luminance emitted out of the palace. Fortunately, the sound waves were not directed at them. Yet, it was still terrifying.
