Naturally Jiang Ming found out what was happening but he was not afraid. After all, the soul attack was the best attack of Jiang Ming.
In his mind, he directed the power of his inner world to act as a defense mechanism. At the same time, he evoked the Stellar Tower, a means of soul attack, up to level 10, its maximum capability.
The sound waves directed at Jiang Ming, merely caused the Stellar Tower to vibrate but not shake. Nevertheless, the three clones of Jiang Ming were wiped out.
Jiang Ming frowned.
So did Long Jingang. “To think that you can resist my natal special ability, I’ve indeed looked down upon you. Hence, I’ll see you as my opponent. True Dragon Battle Body, out!”
With a flicker of flowing luminance on his body, his body had changed. Dense dragon scales grew out, and there was even one on his forehead. His dragon head remained, and his hands turned into dragon claws.

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - Jiang Ming was Jealous: Glove, Ax, Fighting Intent, Bell, Pagoda (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Jiang Ming was Jealous: Glove, Ax, Fighting Intent, Bell, Pagoda (Part 2)
This was a terrific battle body. Long Jingang’s power increased by another fold.
“Dragon fighting stars, die!” Long Jingang got before Jiang Ming in a flash. As he swiped with his hand, his claws split the void, broke the chains of orders and tore Jiang Ming apart. He turned around, and kicked Jiang Ming out who appeared on the other side with a burst of his strength.
“How can you cheat me with your mere Dao of clones? Die!” Long Jingang had completely blasted.
Long Jingang was extremely experienced in fighting, far surpassing Jiang Ming.
“Indeed a terrific opponent!” Jiang Ming’s blood surged, so did his fighting intent. He directly confronted Long Jingang.
Their exchange of punches and kicks made the surroundings into a mess. Dazzling divine lights, and blackholes occurred consecutively.
The aftermath of their exchanges overwhelmed many spectators, who retreated into the distance.
Zhao Changkong wanted to help but he was given no chance to do so. Even the battle field of Hong Ying and Huo Shen had been shifted into the distance.
The destructive torrents burst out from the two battles had swept out to all directions, causing all stars within hundreds of millions of lightyears to burst into pieces.
Boom…
Jiang Ming was blasted out again. Blood dripped out of the corner of his mouth even though he had the protection from the Silver Luminance Battle Armor.
‘This is the real opponent!’ Jiang Ming felt excited. While he was in the Battle Towers of the Supreme Pagoda, his opponent only confronted him with special abilities. Hence, there weren’t many changes and lacked extremely strong Dao vessels.
“Infinite Transcendence Technique!” Jiang Ming again conjured the long river of history, evoked three clones, which cast peerless special abilities upon their appearance. Meanwhile, he conjured another six clones beside him. All of them evoked Space-Time Sealing, which stopped Long Jingang from moving.
......
The Past Body and the Future Body evoked another special ability, the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to disturb the luminance of his armor, greatly reducing its defending capability.
“Daos Extinction Finger!” Daos Extinction was made up of the extinction of the body, the soul, and the heart all together. The Present Body was evoking the supreme finger on the forehead of Long Jingang’s dragon head.
Bang!
Although Long Jingang’s armor was greatly affected, he still had layers of defense. Yet, they were all easily torn apart by the finger of the Present Body, allowing his finger to touch the dragon scale on the forehead.
Crack…
The dragon scale was cracked. Nevertheless, the finger was still greatly obstructed. Especially when the finger touched the head, it was scattered by the incomparable strong power that surged out from the body of Long Jingang.
Long Jingang had freed himself. He whistled and destroyed the Present Body in an instant. As he touched his forehead, there was a flash of divine luminance which recovered the cracked dragon scale. A pair of his eyes shot out even angrier luminance.
“You do have many special abilities, don’t you?” While looking at Jiang Ming, Long Jingang gnashed his teeth.
“You have even more divine vessels!” Jiang Ming was rather speechless. He had never thought that Long Jingang had a supreme divine weapon in his mind that blocked the finger of the Present Body. Besides, Jiang Ming had also discovered the fact that he couldn’t kill Long Jingang with his current strength. Long Jingang’s physique was, after all, too strong. His dragon bone in particular, was even stronger.
“If I didn’t have any divine vessel, I’d have been severely injured!” Even though Long Jingang’s eyes were still burning with rage, he said in a calm tone. “Your special abilities are weird. They are somewhat obstructed from fitting with heaven and earth, and they aren’t like the common cultivating methods of the human clan. Jiang Ming, you should be a human coming from another universe in the Chaos, right?”
Long Jingang said in an affirmative tone.
“Is there any difference?” Jiang Ming smiled. “But I do feel that you haven’t done your best, have you?”
Long Jingang abruptly guffawed. “Bingo! Jiang Ming, you’re amazing. In that case, I shall kill you. Let’s find out whether your special abilities are better or my means are?”
“The eight steps of dragon, with each step a world, and the eighth step burying heaven!”
Just when Long Jingang finished his words, a peculiar aura permeated out of his body. As he took a step forward, he distorted the space, forming a terrific force field, shrouded all things in the surroundings.
Jiang Ming felt the pressure coming from all directions, trying to suppress him as well. The restriction of laws and the restructuring orders made him feel as though he was sinking into the swamp.
Long Jingang was walking very slowly. However, each step he had taken increased the weight of the pressure by one fold.
‘This special ability…” Jiang Ming looked solemn. He directly retrieved his Infinite Transcendence Technique, and his Past Body and Future Body.
His body shook, and his blood boiled as he mobilized his power at a fast speed to resist the pressure.
However, when Long Jingang had taken the eighth step, the surrounding space and time had been distorted to the stage that the heaven and earth became hazy. It was like the pressure of the entire universe that had been pressing against Jiang Ming, causing his body to creak, and there was a tendency of collapse.
“It’s indeed a surprise that you’re capable of resisting it!” Long Jingang was somewhat surprised.
He knew his move couldn’t kill Jiang Ming but he thought he could severely injure Jiang Ming because these eight steps of dragon could evoke the supreme power of orders. He had never expected it to merely limit Jiang Ming’s movement. Nevertheless, when he thought of the armor Jiang Ming was wearing, he was relieved.
“Let’s see how long you can resist it!” As Long Jingang said, an ax appeared in his hand. It released the power of splitting the universe and destroying all things in an instant.
“Go die!” Long Jingang chopped directly on Jiang Ming, like he was splitting heaven and earth.
Jiang Ming was in a complete shock. He knew he couldn’t resist the strike even with the Silver Luminance Battle Armor. Moreover, he was still being suppressed by the power from all directions, hence it was difficult for him to move.
“Do you think that you’re the only one with supreme treasures?”
“Emperor Crown, out!”
“Heavenly Emperor Seal, out!”
A crown appeared on Jiang Ming’s head, bursting forth a noble aura. As it connected to the Silver Luminance Battle Armor, they shook away all the power suppressing Jiang Ming.
A jade seal flew out of Jiang Ming,and hit at the ax.
These two Demi-Sage Weapons were from the Heavenly Emperor Tai Yuan.
Boom…
When the Heavenly Emperor Seal and the ax collided, it set off another boundless and destructive torrent.
The power of the aftermath sent Jiang Ming backward. Even though he had the protection from the two treasures, the power that hit on him, caused him to have an urge to spit blood.
Jiang Ming knew that his physique was far weaker than that of Long Jingang. He thought of taking out the Blood Banner but he held back. He was not confident if he could defeat Long Jingang even if he was to use the Blood Banner. Moreover, he was unsure if Long Jingang was to have other means to protect himself because he was the son of Long Qian after all.
‘In that case…” Jiang Ming squinted his eyes as his soul radiated out luminance, and released the light of will. He was evoking the Celestial Heart Sword, a type of spiritual special ability!
In just a flash, the sword traversed the destructive torrent, and into the mind of Long Jingang. As expected, there was a supreme treasure defending his mind. It was a bell.
The Celestial Heart Sword cut on it, releasing a soul-terrifying sound of bell.
This sound caused Long Jingang to shudder, and blood flowed out of his seven orifices. Long Jingang managed to defend himself but he was still injured by the vibrations of the power.
“It’s now! Return of Infinite Law Finger!” Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up. He traversed the void and got to the front of Long Jingang in a second.
He raised his finger to condense a point of dazzling luminance at his finger tip. This point of luminance contained 3,000 laws and 3,000 Daos.
It made his finger unbearable, and even the Gloves of the War God he was wearing made an overwhelmed groan, as though the gloves were about to scatter. In fact, the Gloves of the War God was a Quasi-Sage Weapon, even though it was an average one.
The finger hit on the forehead of Long Jingang, shattered the defending luminance of his armor, and the dragon scale, and pierced through his skull. When the finger was about to kill Long Jingang, a black light surged out of his body. The black light crashed the Gloves of the War God, and blasted the finger. The explosion sent Jiang Ming flying backwards, and caused him to spit out a long river of blood.
Jiang Ming stabilized himself, and he looked rather miserable. “You fucking dog! You not only have armor, a pair of gloves, an ax, and that soul defensive weapon in your mind, which I think is a bell, you also have a supreme treasure in your body.”
He felt like having a mental breakdown. He had been plotting a lot before he could get a hold of his current possessions. Yet, Long Jingang had all types of Dao vessels of the pinnacle stage, not weaker than his possessions.
At this moment, Jiang Ming was jealous. And his killing intentions got even more intense.
“Since you have forced me up to this stage, you must die!” A pagoda appeared on Long Jingang, and he struck it at Jiang Ming directly.
Jiang Ming’s face darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - Supreme Expert Intervenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: Supreme Expert Intervenes
Long Jingang was furious as his rage reached the limits.
If it wasn’t for the treasure hidden in his body, he would’ve ended up badly injured from the exchange just now.
Jiang Ming’s special ability was so overwhelmingly terrifying, that it made his soul tremble and his will to crumble. As such, he did not hesitate to evoke the secret treasure that he hid the deepest within himself, the Supreme treasure, Zhentian Tower.
It was a defensive treasure that Long Qian gave him when they were in the Chaos. He once told him to never use it unless it was a last resort. Else, he would be targeted by many other Supreme Experts.
A Supreme treasure was a treasure that would even cause a Supreme Expert’s eyes to turn red from greed.
As soon as the Zhentian Tower made its appearance into the world, its oppressive aura spread through the vast surrounding, dispersing into all directions of the world. Its overwhelming aura swept across the entire galaxy, traversed the Star Sea and swept through countless Star Fields. It even altered the look of the sky as the boundless qi in the air became disoriented. Even the entrance portal of the Specter Secret Realm was fluctuating from the ripple of energy.
Right this very moment, every one of the experts who rushed over for the commotion had a surprised look on their faces.
Even Hong Ying and Huo Shen paused their great battle as they both looked over Long Jingang’s direction, gasping.
“He actually has a Supreme Treasure!” Hong Ying’s little red mouth was trembling as various terrifying thoughts ran through her mind. ‘What if she was involved in a great battle with some enemy in the future and that person suddenly evokes such a level of treasure? How will she be able to withstand its power?’
She knew how terrifying a Supreme Treasure was. If she wasn’t able to block off its power, then death was the only thing that awaits.
“He was born with a great father!” Huo Shen’s face was filled with envy.
He also had an extremely complicated expression on his face. Taking advantage of the sudden pause, he created some distance between Hong Ying and himself and continued saying, “With him in possession of such a Treasure, you are doomed! You are all doomed! If your Human Race’s Supreme Experts do not act, who can even stand against him? Or rather, even if the Supreme Experts do emerge, they won’t be able to stop him. After all, with the presence of the Demon clan and the Zergs, they wouldn’t just stand at the sideline, allowing the human Supreme Experts to interfere. Haha! Hong Ying! You are going to die! You are really going to die this time!
“Die? Heh! Don’t you worry! Even if I die, I’m pulling you down with me!” Hong Ying sneered.
Huo Shen’s expression turned ugly.
Long Jingang was as pale as a sheet upon evoking the Zhentian Tower.
Evoking such a level of treasure was extremely taxing. Coupled with the great battle that he was in just now, the exhaustion was even greater.
“Jiang Ming! You are the first person to ever force me to reveal my Supreme treasure! To die under the Zhentian Tower, you can rest your eyes now.” Long Jingang roared, “After killing you as well as Zhao Changkong and Hong Ying, I’ll be visiting the Cosmic Experts of your human race one by one!”
As his voice fell, Zhentian Tower was already on top of Jiang Ming’s head.
Its infinite boundless power of divinity was twisting the void, imprisoning the power of laws and reigned above the orders of the world. The earth-shattering power outburst was aimed directly at Jiang Ming.
“Do you think you are the only one who possesses the Supreme Treasure?” Jiang Ming’s shattered fingers have recovered to their original state. With a loud roar, he evoked the Blood Banner. It was a Saint Weapon which corresponded to the level of Zhentian Tower in this universe.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help sighing inside. In the Status of Long Jingang, it was not stated that he had any Supreme Treasure. Otherwise, he would’ve temporarily avoided the limelight when he appeared.
The universe’s limit was the Demi-Sage Realm. Jiang Ming had finally witnessed how terrifying the power of a Saint Weapon was when evoked. It was akin to the proper attack of an ordinary Saint expert.
As soon as the Blood Banner appeared, it fell in Jiang Ming’s hands, as he proceeded to shake the banner violently. The flag unfolded itself, sending waves of bombardment towards the Zhentian Tower. The impact instantly erupted into a destructive storm across the surrounding area.
Zhao Changkong’s expression changed wildly. He was standing in a palace far away. He immediately transmitted his thoughts telepathically. “I can’t withstand such an impact between two treasures of such level. I’ll be taking refuge in the Specter Secret Realm for now. I see that you possess a Supreme Treasure as well. However, for treasure of such a level to be revealed in the hands of a non-Supreme Expert would be a curse rather than a blessing. Hence, you shouldn’t enter the Specter Secret Realm anymore to prevent yourself from being hunted down by the Supreme Experts of the other race. You should quickly shake off Long Jingang and rush back to the core territory of our human race. I’ll be taking Luo Hong with me for now. Don’t worry!”
Zhao Changkong transmitted his thoughts in just a glimpse as he led his palace directly plunging into the Specter Secret Realm.
The two of them weren’t the only ones who ran. The many other experts that rushed over to the scene also scampered into the Specter Secret Realm to escape the terrifying destructive storm.
Those who were further from the Specter Secret Realm directly fled away.
There were some Star Sea experts who didn’t manage to make their escape and were dragged into the chaos. Their bodies were smashed into pieces on the spot, dying tragically there and then.
Bang…
As Jiang Ming waved the Blood Banner around, he could feel the terrifying force coming at him. The defensive power of the Silver Luminance Battle Armor shattered almost immediately. Both his arms were unable to bear such an explosion as they exploded into blood mist.
Fortunately for Jiang Ming, such an explosion of power was actually a rebound of the explosion and wasn’t an attack infused with Dao fluctuation. Otherwise, his two exploded arms might not be able to recover.
Jiang Ming was also flown off millions of miles away from the exchange, while the Zhentian Tower was thrown out into the distance.
“You actually possess the Supreme Treasure as well!” As Long Jingang retracted his treasured tower, he stared at Jiang Ming with an ugly expression on his face. “I’m now even more convinced that you’re a being of other universes in the Chaos. I even suspect that you have a whole cosmic of treasures hidden in you.”
“Your words make me belittle you even more.” Jiang Ming sneered. As he cycled through the power within his body, bloody mist vibrated in midair as both his arms quickly regenerated themselves.
Regeneration of flesh and blood was a simple feat to Jiang Ming.
He reached out for his Blood Banner again. The flag unfolds itself. Its slight vibration felt as if it could crush everything.
“Those remarks of yours. You’re just trying to get the other experts to target me. This also shows that you can’t deal with me.” Jiang Ming’s gaze were sharp as swords as each of his words was like a knife, “Even if you cannot do anything against me for now, you should think about how to deal with me in the future. This is the attitude that a real peerless expert should possess instead of trying to pitch other experts against me.”
Long Jingang’s face turned even uglier.
“Haha! This little guy is right! However, you won’t be able to keep this Supreme Treasure. Rather than dragging yourself down, it’s better if you leave it to me for keeps! I’ll protect you from now on.”
Right this very moment, a voice traversed the sky, followed by a huge arm that covered the Star Sea. The size of the palm was so huge that it looked as though it was a galaxy itself.
The palm was filled with criss-crossing scriptures that interpreted into great formations as it grabbed onto the Blood Banner.
The cohesion of supreme divine power froze the surrounding area and even stopped time itself. Even the power of the Blood Banner was almost sealed off.
‘So this is the might of a Saint?” Jiang Ming’s face was filled with shock.
In the face of this palm, he had a feeling that he was a feeble ant, standing still against giant mountains.
Without any further hesitation, he took out a bell shaped Dao vessel and launched it against the huge palm. Right the very next moment, this Quasi-Sage-level Dao vessel abruptly exploded. The energy storm that was contained in it instantly exploded, forcibly shattering the huge palm into pieces.
As Jiang Ming broke free of the shackles, he turned into streams of light, plunging into the Specter Secret Realm without any hesitation, leaving a stern voice at the same time. “How dare you, a Supreme Star Beast, attack me! Just you wait! When we meet again, I will be sure to slaughter your Star Beast lineage. Also, I’ll be hammering you to death the next time we meet, Long Jingang!”
Right as Jiang Ming’s voice fell, his figure was already nowhere to be seen.
Long Jingang was left with a face full of shock.
“To think that he didn’t use all his strength in the battle just now.”
“He can actually trigger the self-destruct of a Cosmic treasure. What sort of forbidden technique is that? It must’ve come from the other universe! If I get my hands on such a technique… it’s no less than a Supreme treasure!”
“No! I can’t stay here any longer!”
Right as such thoughts ran through Long Jingang’s mind, he felt a series of evil thoughts directed at him. He immediately evoked Zhentian Tower, flying right towards the Specter Secret Realm.
As for Jiang Ming’s threat? He didn’t take it to heart at all.
Not only Jiang Ming and Long Jingang rushed into the Specter Secret Realm, the other experts such as Hong Ying and the likes rushed in one after another as well.
However, they were also very shocked by Jiang Ming’s techniques. They couldn’t believe that Jiang Ming actually resisted a blow from the Supreme Expert, which was too incredible!
In a blink of an eye, the surrounding experts disappeared from the scene.
Even so, there were many traces left around the battleground. Those were Dao marks that contained various destructive auras that imprinted on the void. Even hundreds of millions of years might not be enough time for these marks to dissipate.
“This young individual of the Human Race! Such great techniques!”
A middle-aged man in a golden robe appeared at the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm, sighed emotionally as he sat himself down.
However, he could hear various sneers between his ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Chaotic World Tree’s Final Metamorphosis
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chaotic World Tree’s Final Metamorphosis
With that, a terrifying battle came to an end.
News of the whole battle spread around like wildfires.
Jiang Ming of the Human Race slaughtered two Cosmic experts, went up against Long Jinggang and emerged undefeated.
The battle between them was mind blowing and the both of them even evoked Supreme treasures at the end.
How incredible it was.
Alas, the Supreme treasures! These were the supreme weapons that could suppress the fate of a whole race. Just having one of these weapons would’ve allowed the race to be ranked in the forefront of all races in the universe.
Generally speaking, it was impossible for non-Supreme Experts to possess such a treasure. Even the Supreme Experts did not necessarily have one in their hands.
It didn’t matter if it was the Human Race, Demon Clan, Star Beast, Botanical Race, Machine Race, Zergs, Pantheons, Angels, Divine Beings and the likes. All of them leapt into action upon hearing the news.
Especially when they found out Jiang Ming and Long Jingang had entered the Specter Secret Realm, even more Cosmic experts rushed over.
All of them had a thought that they might get a chance to obtain a Supreme treasure in addition to the sky-defying great encounter in the Specter Secret Realm.
Even some of the Supreme Experts sprang into action upon hearing such news, let alone the Cosmic experts.
With a flash of light, Jiang Ming directly entered the Specter Secret Realm. He passed through a layer of membrane, as if he had traveled into another world.
Jiang Ming found himself appearing right beside a lake. Surrounding him was a lush forest that was filled with constant howling of beasts, cries of the insects and the fragrance of the flowers.
......
He breathed a sigh of relief.
That huge palm that appeared in the end made him feel very helpless. If he was pitted against a Demi-sage, he could still trade a few blows. However, when facing a Supreme Expert, escape was the only option.
By merely using one hand, a Supreme Expert was able to cover the entire sky and even confine time and space. This scene really showed Jiang Ming how terrifying the Supreme Experts were.
‘”That Supreme Expert definitely didn’t try to catch me with all his might. He didn’t even evoke divine weapons. If he really did that, I’m afraid I would’ve never been able to escape like this!’ Jiang Ming sighed.
He was still too weak after all.
‘Although I was able to overturn the Heaven Court back in Ye Qingxian’s world, I still had to run off in a dire state; even coming into this universe, the result is still not satisfactory.’
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but shake his head thinking of this.
Although he had always seemed negligent, he was very competitive at heart.
‘Just you wait!’
Jiang Ming suppressed the many distracting thoughts in his mind as he began to assess the situation of this Specter Secret Realm.
Before coming in, he had already learned more or less about the Specter Secret Realm through Zhao Changkong. Zhao Changkong was after all a Cosmic expert and even came into this place once before. He knew quite a lot about the place here.
According to Zhao Changkong, the Specter Secret Realm was like a superposition of many small chiliocosm. Each of the domains existed independently but there were channels connecting to them.
Through these channels, a person would be able to go to other places.
If anyone wanted to leave Specter Secret Realm, the person would only have to fly thousands of miles above the sky in a bee line to exit.
However, the higher the person reached, the greater the pressure the person would have to face and the slower their speed would become.
Even with the strength of a Cosmic expert, it would take the person a few breaths to escape the place.
Merely a few breaths of time? Well, this was already considered a very long time to experts of such level.
Jiang Ming looked up into the sky. He turned around and grabbed towards the lake. A waterline fell into his hands yet he didn’t grab onto it.
This line of water transformed into streams of air before merging into the void.
Looking at a tree right beside him, Jiang Ming reached out and plucked a single leaf. However, the leaf suddenly vanished into thin air in the blink of an eye.
When he looked back at the place he plucked the leaf, the leaf had reappeared again.
‘It’s as what I’ve expected! Other than the treasures, nothing can be removed into the outside world. Once a native object is destroyed, it would still be restored into its original state in a blink of an eye.’
As such a thought ran through Jiang Ming’s mind, he pushed forward with his palm, resulting in all the trees within a hundred meters radius to be shattered.
‘The suppressive force here is also very high. With that blow just now, a whole planet would’ve been destroyed, yet it only damages objects within a fixed radius.’
As he compared the degree of destruction between the inside and the outside world, he discovered that the deep pits and damaged trees were recovering rapidly into their original state.
‘Interesting! That’s right! There are also beasts without any wisdom. I’ll be able to get my hands on some good treasures if I hunt them down. This is akin to playing games and hoping for treasures to drop.’
Jiang Ming smiled.
He radiated his consciousness into all directions to have a sense of the surroundings. He realized that the coverage area was not large, spanning only a thousand miles.
His Consciousness’s strength was akin to that of the Demi-sage’s pinnacle.
Right this very moment, the lake suddenly erupted and out came a long and skinny neck. There was a huge mouth revealing two rows of deep-cold teeth as it launched forward to engulf him.
It appeared all of a sudden and quickly attacked Jiang Ming.
What followed was that the temperature of the surrounding space suddenly fell, creating a phenomenon as though the place was frozen solid. Even Jiang Ming’s body became slightly stiff. The lake water however, didn’t show any signs of freezing at all.
It was rather mysterious.
Jiang Ming raised his hand, formed a palm and slashed down the beast’s head along its neck, cutting its body in half. The beast died tragically on the spot and the blood splatter disappeared almost instantly.
Its corpse disappeared soon after as well.
What’s left were the ripples on the lake with a bracelet floating on the water’s surface.
‘A treasure dropped?’
Jiang Ming raised his hands and grabbed on to the bracelet to take a closer look. He didn’t notice any traces of refinement nor were there imprints of it being used before. It was as if the item formed naturally from heaven and earth.
‘Weird!’ Jiang Ming’s eye brow furrowed.
As he poured his energy into the object, the item was refined in an instant.
This item was akin to a Great Overarching Dao vessel where there were a million cubic kilometers of space inside. It wasn’t large, but the bracelet also had its own gravitational special ability.
Once evoked, a gravitational field would be formed.
‘This is not bad!’ Jiang Ming put the bracelet away.
‘Trees, dirt, lake waters, beasts and items born of nature! From the ‘Status’ of Long Jinggang, this place is connected to the origin of the universe. Is this bracelet really conceived by the universe itself? Are all of these around here conceived from the origin of the universe?’
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but wonder.
‘The power of the universe’s origin. Origins!’
He pursed his lips, as his eyes were filled with excitement.
As he squats down, he pressed his palms onto the ground. A strand of root suddenly emerged from his palms, plunging into the soil.
It was the root of the Chaotic World Tree.
This strand of root was radiating with a gluttonous devouring power almost instantly. As waves and waves of energy were absorbed by the root, the soil beneath his hand was disappearing rapidly.
At the same time, Jiang Ming could feel malicious intent from all directions. The air became thicker and thicker and the pressure he felt became even stronger. There was even a repulsive force acting on him.
There was no other damage to him besides those.
‘I absorbed the power of the origin. The natural order of the universe naturally went into defensive mode? However, the origin of the universe is meaningless and can only respond passively based on natural order?’
As these thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind, he could hear the sudden increase in the roars of the beasts as they were gathering towards him from all directions.
Waves after waves were formed by the lake beside him as marine beasts leapt out of the waters one after another. They were all charging directly at Jiang Ming with some spewing ice arrows, some spurting poisons and many other forms of attacks.
An illusory long river of history appeared under Jiang Ming. The Past body, the Present body and the Future body materialized at the same time. As they blocked off the attacks, these three clones began their hunt.
Jiang Ming remained rooted on the ground with his palm against the ground, absorbing the energy.
He segregated a part of his consciousness into his inner world and discovered that the Chaotic World Tree which was already very mighty was emitting waves and waves of luminance. Its branches were swaying and its leaves rattling.
Atop the Chaotic World Tree, there were already 2,997 leaves formed and there were only three leaves left from reaching three thousand leaves.
In order for the tree to grow, Jiang Ming spent quite a lot of resources over the past years. The Saints would’ve gone crazy if they knew how much resources he poured in.
What left Jiang Ming feeling helpless was that the further the tree grew, the slower the leaves were formed.
Even till this day, there were still three leaves that hadn’t grown out yet.
However, Jiang Ming had a feeling that once all 3,000 leaves were all grown out, the Chaos World Tree would inevitably undergo great changes, resulting in a qualitative transformation for sure.
He even had a hunch that his own soul’s metamorphosis would depend on this World Tree.
“The world’s origin is growing stronger as it absorbs the power from the outside world. These energy absorbed are almost completely taken in. The 2,798th leave is being conceived.”
Jiang Ming let out a breath filled with turbidity, revealing a joyous look on his face.
He was also more certain that the soil, trees, lake water and the likes outside were definitely conjured by the power of the origin of the great universe.
Right this very moment, the Present body threw over a piece of crystal.
The beasts in the distance were already rushing over like tidal waves.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - Threatening the Will of the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Threatening the Will of the Universe
It was a large area of sand.
As soon as Zhao Changkong arrived, he noticed that there weren’t any dangers around and let Luo Heng out. At the same time, he said, “I really can’t resist the explosive force from the collision between the Supreme treasures just now and can only escape into this place.”
He had a helpless smile on his face.
In the face of the aftermath of such power, what could he have done with the power that he had? There was nothing he could’ve done.
“It was really terrifying.” Luo Heng was still in shock. He saw the whole exchange clearly from the palace.
The collision of such powers was more than enough to destroy the heavens and earth. It could’ve eradicated anything and everything in its path. If it wasn’t for Zhao Changkong protecting him, Luo Hong would’ve definitely ended up dead with no remains behind.
“Yeah, it was too terrifying.” Zhao Changkong sighed emotionally, “Brother Jiang has Supreme treasure, so it’s not difficult for him to keep himself safe. We don’t have to worry about him. From here on out, you must remember to follow my footsteps closely and never run off by yourself. Within this Specter Secret Realm, you might be sent off to other dimensions if you take a wrong step. There are various dangers in the Specter Secret Realm. For example, the outside world beings would kill off any other beings of other races if they stumbled upon them. If you can’t kill them, then run. Also, there are a lot of terrifying beasts. These beasts do not possess any wisdom and will attack in a frenzy when they encounter creatures from the outside world.”
Zhao Changkong explained the situation in the Specter Secret Realm to Luo Heng again.
As Luo Heng listened quietly, he separated part of his consciousness at the same time to communicate with the Supreme Order, and left a message to Jiang Ming. “Brother Jiang, Zhao Changkong and I are together, safe and sound. Once you’re safe, please return the message.”
Over on the other side, Jiang Ming carefully examined the crystal that his clone threw at him. Upon closer inspection, his eyes lit up.
...
The crystal was condensed from a kind of extremely pure and extremely high-quality energy.
‘This is definitely the power of the origin of the universe!’
As Jiang Ming thought about it, he proceeded to throw the crystal into his inner world. It was not absorbed by the World Tree, but was integrated into the world. The crystal was decomposed by the forces of order and converted into the resources of the world.
‘This allows my inner world to actually experience slight improvement!’ Jiang Ming was very surprised.
His inner world had already reached the limits of the small chiliocosm and it was almost impossible for him to improve further for now.
Such a strand of improvement was equivalent to him breaking the limits.
‘This is really a land of treasures!’
Jiang Ming lamented emotionally and rose to his feet.
The roots of the World Tree had already been driven into the ground through both his feet. The roots were embedded deep into the ground and began to swallow the energy from below.
Looking towards the sky, he could see gigantic beasts flying towards him from a distance.
His three clones were standing high above the sky, evoking one special ability after another, slaughtering the ferocious beasts. Their corpses disintegrated and formed streams of air that disappeared into the void. However, various different objects were left behind on the ground.
There were origin crystals, immortal treasured ores, divine weapons and the likes.
Dark clouds swept through the top of his head as thunder began to flash.
One after another, the thunder flashed across like dragons, brewing storms of destruction.
“That’s so petty! I’m just taking some things from you. It’s not even a drop of water in the bucket to you anyway!” Jiang Ming murmured.
Click...
A thunderbolt landed and fell straight onto the top of Jiang Ming’s head. Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He shattered the thunder strike with just one palm.
Seeing the lightning flash again, he couldn’t help being annoyed.
With a wave of his hand, a long river of Dao vessels appeared. There were Demi-Sage Weapons, Quasi-Sage Weapons, Great Overarching Dao Vessels and the likes, all of which were densely packed and really formed a river.
“Believe it or not, I’ll detonate all of them?” Jiang Ming snorted coldly, and then took out the Supreme Order as well. By slightly evoking the Supreme Order, faint luminance could be seen radiating from it and an extremely obscure aura swept into the surrounding area, “You won’t be able to do anything to me!”
Click...
The lightning flashes, frozen for a moment, before dispersing abruptly.
After a while longer, the dark clouds above his head dissipated while the thunder went into hiding.
Jiang Ming suddenly furrowed his eyebrows.
‘Could it be that the universe gave birth to its consciousness?’
With him absorbing a little bit of the origin, the universe shouldn’t have caused such a big reaction at all.
There were way too many strange treasures unearthed here after all. There were even Supreme Treasures. The energy that he devoured was comparatively very insignificant.
There were also thunders just now. It would’ve been fine if it was just a natural defensive response of the universe. However, for it to dissipate quickly after being threatened was completely unreasonable.
“If the consciousness of the universe is born, how can it be threatened by me? This river of Dao vessels of mine should’ve been insignificant to a universe that can give birth to dozens of Supreme Experts.”
Argh! It was giving Jiang Ming a headache. He thought he should forget and stop pondering about it. Instead, he shall just take advantage of the things here first and talk about it later. After all, there was a saying that a person who doesn’t take advantage of the situation is a bastard.
Jiang Ming was, however, still a little sensible. He didn’t take out the Chaotic World Tree, but instead spread its roots through his feet into the grounds below him.
The World Tree was also a very terrifying existence. Its roots crept deep below rapidly, turning into a black hole as it swallowed the origin of the universe greedily.
The fierce beasts in the distance stopped howling, but still continued to charge at him rapidly. However, just when they got close, these beasts collapsed without even needing the clones to attack. Bulks and bulks of crystal continued to pile up.
“Old brother! Now you’re speaking my language!”
Jiang Ming opened his mouth for a bit and finally smiled as he gave a thumbs up and complimented.
However, he was actually in extreme panic at heart.
‘God damn it! Does this great universe really give birth to its own consciousness?’ Jiang Ming shook his head. Who cared?
The energy crystals were put away and integrated into his inner world, so that the origin of his inner world would be gradually strengthened. Gradually as time progressed, his inner world slowly underwent metamorphosis.
Jiang Ming began to inspect the spoils left after he killed the two Cosmic experts, Jin Diao and Xiang Mang.
Good gracious! Just putting the other items aside, the energy crystals stored in their storage were piled into mountains. Its quality however, was far from being comparable to that of here. The difference was incomparable.
However, they were still useful items and he kept all of them into his inner world to be integrated within.
Far in the distance, a Zerg’s expert descended. As he stood atop thousand meters up in the sky, he gazed into the distance and suddenly discovered that a large number of ferocious beasts were all rushing towards a certain direction.
The waves of loud roars coming from that direction even caused the ground to tremble. Soon after, a mountain that was not far from him suddenly collapsed.
‘The mountain really collapsed! It didn’t recover to its original state?’ This Zerg expert was shocked at first, followed by a feeling of ecstasy.
‘Can it be that a great Treasure has emerged itself? It’s certainly not an ordinary one to be able to set off such a huge ruckus. Can it… can it be a Supreme treasure?’
As such a thought ran through his mind, he was flushed with excitement and turned into a stream of light, rushing over to the scene.
It didn’t take long for him to reach the place and discover that there was a young man of the human race standing midair above a huge pothole. The grounds below his feet continued to collapse. The lake beside him had already disappeared out of sight.
“Human, what happened here?” the Zerg expert asked.
Jiang Ming took a glance at him and ignored him completely. With his hands behind his back, Jiang Ming silently observed the situation here. At the same time, part of his consciousness merged into the World Tree, realizing the changes that it was undergoing.
As for the roots below his feet? It has long since vanished, merged into the void and took root in the ground.
“Human, I’ll ask once more. What happened here? Was a Supreme Treasure revealed here?” The Zerg expert asked again.
A strange expression flashed through Jiang Ming’s face. “Supreme Treasure?”
A loud roar could be heard as a spaceship flew over from the other side.
This spaceship was golden in color. Although it was only around 20 meters long, it gave off a terrifying feeling to the people nearby. As soon as it got close, the spaceship quickly turned into a robot.
This was actually an expert of the Machine Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - The Zergs, and the Machine Race are Samaritans. Hehe
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: The Zergs, and the Machine Race are Samaritans. Hehe
‘The Zergs, and the Machine Race.’
Jiang Ming looked left and right, somewhat curious. It was the first time he saw a Zerg. However, he had heard quite a lot about them in his past life. He heard that they were a ruthless, greedy and terrifying race that only knew how to plunder, just like a real insect.
‘But as far as the universe is concerned, aren’t all races insects?’
As such a thought crossed Jiang Ming’s mind, he suddenly discovered that there was an illusory and incomparably huge nest appearing behind the Zerg expert.
An insect’s nest was the foundation of the Zergs. They could nurture a huge amount of Zerg warriors in a short time.
The Machines on the other side pitched his curiosity even more. He couldn’t believe that the Machines, which were machinery, would have souls. It was ridiculous.
‘Alas, the universe is just that mysterious.’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh emotionally yet again.
“Human, Zerg, why is there such a big commotion here? Could it be that a Supreme Treasure has been unearthed? Where is it? Why can’t I pick it up from my scans?” As the Machine expert said so, both his eyes were gleaming, scanning the surroundings again.
His eyes were the eyes of machinery, a pair of eyes that could see through the object’s essence.
“There is no Supreme treasure here. Go away, before I decide to take action!” Jiang Ming’s tone of voice was a little indifferent.
He really didn’t want to get into a fight right that very moment. It was a real waste of time.
...
“Little brat! You are really crazy! Crazier than I am!” The Machine expert sneered, “How dare you clamor in my presence? Do you think you are Jiang Ming? With such a big commotion here, a great treasure must’ve been unearthed. Come, tell me. Did you take the Supreme treasure?”
“It must be this human who snatched it.” The Zerg expert suddenly said, “Qi Ling, destroy him?”
“Hey, Chong San! You go first!” said the Machine expert.
“You first!”
“You came here first, you should go first.”
“God damn it Qi Ling! Could it be that you knew who he was?”
“Heh! You must’ve known.”
“Should we?”
“Of course! This is a chance of a lifetime! That’s two Supreme treasures! Two of them! One for you, and one for me.
“Two?”
“Are you stupid? He has one, and he obtained another one here. Isn’t that right?”
“You’re right!”
The two continued chatting as if there were nobody else around.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing. “You know who I am, but you still have the guts to plot against me? Who gave you the courage?”
“Strength of course!” Qi Ling sneered, no longer looking as unreliable as before. “It’s also because we’re all done with our preparation.”
“It’s that sneaky arrangement from just now?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile on his face.
“Of course!” Qi Ling twisted his mechanical neck and actually made a creaking sound. “It still makes such a pleasant sound. By the way, do you know of the arrangements I made? You mustn’t. That’s the ultimate weapon of my race’s research, Two dimensional foil, Three Measuring Needles, Four Empty Realms, Five Elemental Destruction!”
“Show yourself, my children!”
“Two Dimensional Foil, destroy him!”
“Three Measuring Needles, penetrate him!”
“Four Empty Realms, annihilate him!”
“Five Elemental Destruction, kill him!”
He roared at Jiang Ming as he waved his arms around.
Mechanical weapons suddenly appeared in the void, one after another. Each of them were strangely shaped and were all emitting rays of destruction.
Qi Ling quickly transmitted his voice at the same time. “Two Dimensional Foil can destroy galaxies; Three Measuring Needles is even more powerful, capable of pin point attacks that can even penetrate Cosmic-level mechanical body such as mine; Four Empty Realms is even greater, where with a flash of its luminance, everything will be reduced to nothing; as for Five Elemental Destruction? It can really annihilate everything.”
“Jiang Ming! I’ve revealed all of my trump cards in order to deal with you. I won’t believe that I can’t kill you!”
“Even with your combat power comparable to that of Long Jingang, how much power are you left with after you’ve just had a great battle with him? You must be extremely weak already! Haha! What’s this called? Oh right! It’s like what you humans say, to covet gains ahead without being aware of the danger behind!”
“Die!”
Ling Qi’s voice was filled with incomparable excitement.
On the other side, Chong San also launched his greatest attack of all.
His attack was much simpler.The tens of thousands of Zerg Warriors that emerged from the nest behind him were all extremely powerful, where the weakest among them were of the Star Field level.
They band together into teams, launching spiritual attacks at the same time. Their attacks formed a resonance, condensed into a point, and was amplified by a spiritual weapon evoked by Chong San, allowing the attack to reach a terrifying level.
Chong San and Ling Qi were casting their destructive attacks from each side of Jiang Ming. However, he didn’t take them both seriously at all.
Jiang Ming slashed towards Chong San with the Celestial Heart Sword.
Bang…
As invisible ripples swayed in the void, Chong San trembled and his seven orifices bled. His aura was instantly wilted to the extreme, and his face was as pale as death. The 10,000 Zerg warriors behind him all had their heads exploded as they died tragically on the spot.
On Jiang Ming’s right, he raised his hand and swiped across. The special ability, Great Protection Technique was evoked, blocking off the boundless attacks of Ling Qi.
“Why is it that you two like to court death?” Jiang Ming sighed emotionally.
Chong San and Qi Ling didn’t mutter a single word as they turned and fled. If even their strongest attack combined was ineffective, then staying here any longer would only mean death for them.
“It’s too late to think of escaping now!” As Jiang Ming said so, the long river of history appeared again under his feet. He evoked the Infinite Transcendence Technique, which he hadjust dispersed.
After all, the beasts were self-destructing which meant that it didn’t make sense for him to continue maintaining the technique. As he evoked the technique again, his three clones reappeared.
“Daos Extinction!”
The Present Body pointed at Chong San.
Destruction of the physique, the heart and the soul became the extinction of Dao when combined. With the might of the Daos Extinction Finger, there’s nothing that the technique couldn’t destroy.
Chong San was killed on the spot.
On the other side however, the Past Body raised his hand and grabbed midair, evoking the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. Qi Ling who was trying to escape suddenly trembled with rays of light bursting out from his body as he struggled violently.
“Does it actually work?”
A weird expression flashed through Jiang Ming’s face.
His Future Body also evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique at the same time.
The glimmering light around Qi Ling’s body suddenly lit up before going up abruptly. His body was then flown backwards.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help laughing, “The Machine Race is after all machinery. If it’s a machine, it will still be restrained by the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. Doesn’t this mean that I am the nemesis of the Machine Race?”
After manipulating Qi Ling to walk over to him, Jiang Ming carefully observed him and discovered the mystery behind its existence. The Machine Race had souls in them.
In Jiang Ming’s point of view however, these souls were equivalent to Dao vessels that had given birth to their own spiritual wisdom.
“If I manage to control Cosmic or Supreme Machine experts in the future, that means…” As such a thought came into his mind, Jiang Ming couldn’t help from getting excited.
It would be akin to an actual long river of Dao vessels that would be deterring even the heavens.
Jiang Ming quickly suppressed the many thoughts in his head.
He didn’t send away his three clones because there were many more experts that were coming his way, group after groups.
Many of them knew about Jiang Ming’s strength, being capable of fighting to the death with Long Jingang and to be equipped with a Supreme Weapon. However, most of these experts had the same thought as Chong San. They thought that Jiang Ming of the human race must already be exhausted after a great battle with Long Jingang earlier and even received an attack from a Supreme Expert.
However, the result was that all these experts had their life ended there.
Boom!
The earth sank and the mountains collapsed. It seemed that this small chiliocosm was approaching its destruction soon.
In Jiang Ming’s inner world however, the 2,998th leaf was gradually taking shape.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - The 3,000 Daos and Laws, Saint Soul Finally Formed, Revenge Alliance (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: The 3,000 Daos and Laws, Saint Soul Finally Formed, Revenge Alliance (Part 1)
??
The entire space had collapsed, forming into a grayish domain. There wasn’t any land, heaven, forest, and the lake was left. One couldn’t even distinguish the direction, just like a unique space of Chaos.
“Thanks bro! I’m about to have a breakthrough, hence I’d need another three to four places like this. Please allow me to do so.”
When Jiang Ming felt the formation of a leaf of the World Tree in his inner world, he felt ecstatic . He immediately waved and shouted to voice out his request.
Above Jiang Ming seemed to have flickering thunder, which disappeared after his request. He felt his heart miss a beat as he was rather nervous.
Because he didn’t feel any repulsion, he furtively took a sigh of relief, and felt grateful that the universe seemed to have agreed upon his request.
He wondered whether it was the will of the universe. But who cared?
Other than a new leaf had been nurtured, he had also slaughtered hundreds of experts of the other clans, most of which were of the Star Sea level or the Great Overarching Realm. Hence, he obtained various good things. Examples were the Dao vessels, divine crystals, divine veins, peculiar mineral ores, and rare items of the universe.
He fused all of the Energy Crystals and rare items of the universe into the inner world, to be digested and accumulated as the resources for the imminent evolution of the world.
Besides, he had also collected a great amount of good things when the various ferocious beasts committed suicide before him.
‘What an amazing place, full of fortunes and luck.’
Jiang Ming clasped his hands towards the sky again.
...
As he looked around, he discovered the membrane of this space. He paced through the void to an edge. He probed with his hand, and saw a layer of film which looked like the water ripples.
The layer of film was very fragile as it could be poked through easily. Yet, it was the one that isolated the space from the other.
Without hesitation, Jiang Ming plunged into it.
He felt a feeling of warmth spread all over his body. The hot air turned into billowing waves, filling every inch of space. Red rays of lights and burning flames could be seen surging into the sky.
It was a space of magma. The magma under his feet was turbulent. In some places, when magma erupted, a pillar of fire shot up to the sky. There were also huge rocks that form islands floating in the magma. Some red plants were seen growing on those rocks, and within them were an endless source of fire.
A person was suspending mid-air in the distance. He was currently fighting against a beast rushing out of the magma.
At the moment there were numerous other beasts, which looked as if they were formed by rocks, shot up into the sky. They besieged the person and killed him.
Following that, these beasts turned to Jiang Ming. They exploded when they got near and disappeared, leaving only origin crystals behind.
.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile. Then, he clasped his hands towards the sky. “Elder brother, thank you for your generosity!”
Jiang Ming fluttered his sleeves and collected all of them. Then, the root of his World Tree grew out from beneath his feet into the magma, and began devouring gluttonously the magma transformed by the power of origin.
In the meantime, fighting was inevitable. Hence, he killed many experts of the other clans.
The magma space had been destroyed. The 2,999th leaf, however, was not grown completely.
Jiang Ming was not surprised because he had known that the difficulty of nurturing a leaf increased with its total number. If he had not thought of taking the bet, and cultivated it, he would have ingested it.
The third space was a dessert. The leaf grew out after consuming a third of the space’s origin.
Jiang Ming was rather excited that there was the last piece of leaf left.
He went on with the fourth space, and the fifth. As he got to the sixth, he looked rather gloomy. He knew it would be difficult to nurture the last leaf but he had never expected that the difficulty would go beyond his expectations.
The leaf now contained energy equivalent to the Demi-Sage, but it hadn’t yet formed. Hence, Jiang Ming felt like cursing.
“Elder brother, I think this will be the last!” Jiang Ming felt rather sorry. But he didn’t get any response.
When he was preparing to begin devouring again, he heard an exclamation. “Jiang Ming of the Human Race!”
“Where’s he? I heard that whenever he goes, he would wipe out all things by devouring the entire space. Damn, no one can ever destroy this place for billions of years, yet he made it.” Another one came forward.
.
In just a blink of an eye, there were a few experts who stopped at 10,000 meters away. They dared not go further but only watched from afar.
Beneath them were the ripples of oceans which might occasionally turn into a bigger wave.
It was a water world with many islands. The islands were filled with greeneries and the chirping sounds of water birds.
“You all know about it?” Jiang Ming greeted them with a smile.
“Of course we do!” An expert with many arms took a few steps forward. He said excitedly, “Brother Jiang, how did you do that? It’s assumed that this is the place evolved by the origin of the universe. None of us can destroy this place with even Supreme Treasure or even take out anything from here. Yet, you can devour them. This is unbelievable.”
“It’s simple!” Jiang Ming laughed. “The universe is my elder brother, hence I’m considered as the master of this place. There’s naturally no limit for me to take things from my own family, isn’t it?”
Some experts of the other clans might have realized what was happening to Jiang Ming, hence they sent out messages before they were killed by Jiang Ming.
Many even fled to other spaces when they saw Jiang Ming’s might.
Therefore, experts in the entire Specter Secret Realm had learned about Jiang Ming’s cruelty and terrific acts.
Jiang Ming’s capability of being a match of Long Jingang, to resist Supreme Expert, the fact that he owned a Supreme Expert and his ability to devour the spaces of the Specter Secret Realm, had been made known to the top experts of all clans in the universe.
With that, Jiang Ming had become a well-known man in the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - The 3,000 Daos and Laws, Saint Soul Finally Formed, Revenge Alliance (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: The 3,000 Daos and Laws, Saint Soul Finally Formed, Revenge Alliance (Part 2)
?
“The universe, your elder brother?” The Dobby Clan’s expert with many arms twitched his mouth but he scolded within himself. ‘Damn, such an unashamed guy.’ However, he didn’t go forward because he knew how terrifying Jiang Ming was.
Some experts even calculated roughly that Jiang Ming had killed at least 10 Cosmic experts. As for the Star Sea experts? He should have killed at least 200 of them.
This number was extremely terrifying. Some experts of other clans like the Zergs, the Demon Clan, and the Machine Clan wanted to take revenge but none of them dared to do so.
“Brother Jiang, do you know that Long Jingang is looking for you?” The Dobby Clan’s expert revealed a furtive message.
“I’m afraid that it’s difficult for him to find me.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “We can’t send our location, and we’d be sent to a random space when we traverse. In fact, I wish to find him and kill him here. After all, I’m a master of this place.”
“Brother Jiang, can you control the power of this place?” The Dobby Clan’s experts inquired.
The others in the distance were listening carefully as well.
“Didn’t you see it?” Jiang Ming pointed at the sea water beneath them. The sea water level had been reduced by 10-feets.
The Dobby Clan’s expert had a twitch of his mouth.
“Brother Jiang!” A familiar voice rang out, and Hong Ying got beside him in a stream of light. Her face was filled with surprise as she beamed, “I’ve never thought to have met you here. Brother Jiang, do you know that your name has been spread throughout the universe. You’ve made many other clans to be in fear, and my heart skips a beat.”
“Stop, your heart better don’t skip any beat!” Jiang Ming quickly stopped her. He thought Hong Ying seemed to have a different sexual orientation.
...
Hong Ying gave him a wink, and altered her voice to a coquettish sound as she said, “I’ve got 81 harems, and each harem has 3,000 beautiful ladies of the other clans. What about you make me yours, and they become our companions in bed?”
“No, no, no, I can’t afford to do so!” Jiang Ming rejected. He even retreated a few steps as though he was confronting a ferocious beast.
“I thought you were a man with your capability of suppressing foreign clans. Yet, it turns out that you are useless.” Hong Ying pursed her lips and exclaimed, “Alas, when can I find my prince? Sigh, I shall continue collecting foreign beauties.”
Jiang Ming was speechless.
After they were talking nonsense for a while, Hong Ying told Jiang Ming a message. Because Jiang Ming had slaughtered too many members of the foreign clans, many experts of different clans had formed a Revenge Alliance. They were moving together to besiege and kill Jiang Ming whenever possible.
“Besiege and kill me?” Jiang Ming was not very surprised.
“Of course!” Hong Ying grinned, “Because you are too cruel, terrifying, and have killed too many beings. Hence, you’ve drawn yourself too much hatred. Of course, the main reason is because of the many treasures that you have. Not to mention your Supreme Weapon, how many treasures did you get by killing so many experts? I’m afraid that even a Supreme Expert isn’t as rich as you are. Another reason is that they wanted to know how you destroy this place? There’s a hearsay that whoever can get the secret of how you can destroy this place, he may be able to absorb the universe’s power of origin and further improve his cultivation base. Brother Jiang, who would not be jealous of you having so many benefits? I bet even the Supreme Experts are tempted to attack you if you were out there.”
“I welcome their attacks. After all, I haven’t killed enough yet!” Jiang Ming smiled.
Hong Ying was speechless.
There were more experts gathered around but none of them took any action. This made Jiang Ming feel rather disappointed.
Jiang Ming was, after all, a good man. He was too shy to kill them all if they were not taking the initiative to attack him first.
There wasn’t anyone who dared to step forward even until the sea water had dried up. Even the experts of the Demon Clan and the Machine Clan were watching from afar.
It was indeed an amazing scene.
As the sea water dried up, they got to the seabed. In fact, there wasn’t any seabed. It was merely emptiness, connecting to another space.
“Done!” Jiang Ming was excited. He immediately closed his eyes, and had most of his consciousness into his inner world.
Hong Ying saw the changes on Jiang Ming’s face, and she quietly started to stay alert of the surroundings. Meanwhile, she had a different guess.
In the inner world, Jiang Ming had his consciousness merged with the World Tree to comprehend its changes.
When the 3,000th leaf of the Chaotic World Tree was grown out, the entire seedling had an earth-shattering change. The 3,000 leaves simultaneously emitted luminance, which shot out incredibly profound chains of orders. The chains were united into one 3,000 Great Dao Chart, shrouding the World Tree.
.
The changes of the 3,000 Daos and the Laws that occurred right at this very moment was indeed earth-shattering.
Even Jiang Ming had never expected that the World Tree actually deduced a Great Dao Chart, which was similar to the Million Dao Chart he used to comprehend in the Supreme Pagoda.
The chart contained boundless mysteries, and vast special abilities. It was as if leading directly to the great Dao, and evolving the changes of the various heavens.
At the same time, the World Tree shot up into the sky as it grew up to 48,000 feet high. The 3,000 leaves had also turned into 3,000 giant branches. Each branch had 3,000 twigs, and each twig had 3,000 leaves.
Such a change was intense and rapid.
The aura of the World Tree had been surging consecutively, up to an unimaginable stage. It seemed to be more terrifying than the Star Beast’s Supreme Expert, who used to attack Jiang Ming.
‘Is this the metamorphosis after a gluttonous devouring of the universe’s origin? I think it must be. From now onwards, the World Tree has finally entered its growth period!’ Jiang Ming was enlightened.
The changes of the World Tree had finally given Jiang Ming the endless good fortune.
His soul which had been transformed to its extreme, had sublimated to the limit along with the World Tree. It had also undergone a qualitative change, rapidly transforming towards the Saint Soul.
His body was affected, and had started restructuring.
The luminance of fortune radiated out of the World Tree had also changed his inner world.
Outside.
Hong Ying, who was quietly guarding Jiang Ming, discovered the luminance radiated out from Jiang Ming.
There were the luminances of Chaos, great Dao, fortune, holiness, boundless, and wisdom. By just taking a look, one would be capable of discovering the boundless laws, and Daos, hence unconsciously fell into the stage of Dao enlightenment.
Hong Ying’s eyes were blurred. She was instantly shocked, and astonished. ‘Why did I feel like confronting the origin of the universe when I look at the luminance Jiang Ming has been emitting?’
As soon as she focused, the divine light burst out. It allowed her to discover the rapid metamorphosis of Jiang Ming flesh. Every inch of his skin, every strand of his muscles and even every cell of his body were restructuring. When she intended to probe further, she felt her eyes ache, and shed two lines of bloody tears.
‘The auto defense has actually caused me to suffer from the backlash!’ Hong Ying gulped in fear.
She also felt the surging aura of Jiang Ming although it was very obscured. Jiang Ming’s mana, bloodline, and soul were all on the rise.
‘Has he got a breakthrough? But how can he have such a terrific improvement? Being shone by the luminance emitting out of his body and inhaling the aura radiated out while standing beside him, I actually feel like having a breakthrough as well.’
This was what horrified Hong Ying. She was, after all, a Cosmic expert at the pinnacle. She was considered as one of the top experts in the universe. She could even fight against Long Jingang if she was to confront him.
However, she inexplicably felt the current Jiang Ming was inscrutable.
In the distance.
When many experts saw Jiang Ming finish devouring the sea water, they were shocked and fearful. They thought Jiang Ming was a freak, hence must not be provoked.
When they were about to leave, they saw Jiang Ming close his eyes. Then, luminances were radiated out of Jiang Ming, who’s aura seemed to be getting stronger.
They wondered if Jiang Ming was about to have a breakthrough. However, they were horrified when they felt the boundless Dao fluctuations hidden in the luminances upon careful observation.
“Who’s he actually?”
“Why do I feel like I was confronting the origin of the universe by looking at the luminance emitting out of Jiang Ming?”
“Can it be that he’s indeed the younger brother of the universe?”
“No, I think he should be the universe’s own son.”
“No, he should be formed by the Will of the universe!”
The more they talked about it, the more nonsense the explanation became. Nevertheless, all of them admitted that Jiang Ming was superb.
At this moment, the membrane of the space in the distance abruptly split open. Out of it was a Demon Clan’s expert, who was startled when he saw what was happening nearby. Following that, he discovered Jiang Ming, and revealed his ecstatic expression.
“Haha, it’s indeed corresponding to the saying that one will search high and low only to find it when one least expects it to. Jiang Ming, I’ve finally found you!” This Demon Clan’s expert was extremely excited. It was as though he had discovered a Supreme treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - Sanctified Dao to the Supreme Expert (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Sanctified Dao to the Supreme Expert (Part 1)
??
The Demon Clan’s expert was delighted, truly delighted.
He knew Jiang Ming was strong, not even defeated by Long Jingang. He also knew that Jiang Ming resisted a strike of the Supreme Expert and had a Supreme Treasure. He even knew that Jiang Ming could destroy the spaces of Specter Secret Realm, and had numerous treasures because Jiang Ming had killed many Cosmic experts.
But he didn’t care, really didn’t care. It was because among the experts they had cooperated with, there were 18 Cosmic experts from different clans. Although some wanted to take revenge, many wanted to take advantage.
When they were together, they weren’t even afraid of the Supreme Expert, let alone Jiang Ming of the Human Race. The only pity was that they didn’t find Long Jingang. Else, they would be more confident.
When Hong Ying saw the exciting face of the Demon Clan’s expert, her heart sank.
‘It’s been troublesome! Indeed! Another group of experts are here! The surrounding experts may take advantage of the situation, how am I going to resist them?’
Hong Ying cringed but she didn’t leave. She looked at Jiang Ming, and as she sensed his aura that was getting more obscure and terrific, she couldn’t help but smile wryly. ‘Oh my, please have your breakthrough quick or we would be killed. No, I think even after your breakthrough, we’d be killed as well.’
In the inner world of Jiang Ming, the World Tree had completed its metamorphosis. Jiang Ming, as its master, had received great fortunes. His soul had been transforming at a fast rate. It was the sublimation, the improvement of the quality, and the transition of life.
Due to the World Tree, even the inner world had broken the shackles, improving its origin towards the middle chiliocosm.
Jiang Ming merged his mind with the World Tree and the inner world, metamorphosed in the metamorphosis, and sublimated in the sublimation.
Upon completion, his strength would truly have a qualitative change.
...
Rumbled!
The space of the inner world was rapidly expanding. The heaven and earth had been changing greatly, and thousands of laws had been deducing.
Externally, the members of the Revenge Alliance had been arriving one after another. More than hundreds of them had been gathered in just a short while.
Most of them were the Star Sea experts, led by 18 Cosmic experts in front of them.
Such a group of power was capable of stirring the entire heaven and earth.
Many of those who had been watching the changes in Jiang Ming eluded but some others joined in the alliance.
“Hong Ying, I’ve not expect you’re here as well!” A Zergs expert who was standing at the most front of the Revenge Alliance saw Hong Ying when she was gazing in the direction of Jiang Ming.
The Zergs expert was a woman with two blue antennas on her head. Her capability of standing at the front of the Revenge Alliance had proven her strength.
“Cai Die!” Hong Ying slightly frowned. “Is this the alliance that you initiated?” Hong Ying was familiar with this Zergs expert, because she had dealt with her many times.
The Zergs were already strong, and a Zergs expert could become an army. Cai Die was one of the strongest among all, and was much stronger than Hong Ying, hence a terrific Cosmic existence at the pinnacle. Many Supreme Experts even said that she had the potential to become a Supreme Expert.
It was difficult for Hong Ying to deal with Cai Die alone, what’s more the many other experts behind her.
Hong Ying felt helpless, and had the urge to turn and elude.
“Not me!” Cai Die paced the void and stopped 1,000 meters away. This distance was very short, but none of them cared.
“It’s forced by Jiang Ming.” Cai Die grinned. “This brat is too arrogant, too domineering, too unscrupulous, too unreserved, and exterminative. That’s why we’re forced to unite to kill him. We’ve been looking for him everywhere. We thought it would take us years to find him but surprisingly, it took us only a day. Haha, what does it call? This is called fate. Even god hates him!”
Hong Ying remained calm and collected. She smirked, “Do you know the background of brother Jiang?”
“He must die today even if he’s the own son of Pan Wang.” Cai Die sneered, “Thousands clans of the universe have been killing each other continuously. Hence, your threat is useless!”
Cai Die’s glance swept through Jiang Ming. “Is he having a breakthrough? You are trying to delay time.”
“Even if he’s having his breakthrough, you won’t be afraid, will you?” Hong Ying sighed, “About 20 Cosmic experts and hundreds of Star Sea experts can defeat even a Supreme Expert when united right? Sigh, since death is inevitable, let me just share with you his background so that all beings of the universe would know. After all, brother Jiang used to be in the limelight. Hence, he shall leave some traces behind. Can I?”
“No!” A Machine expert came over. “We should kill him directly just in case. Cai Die, attack!”
As soon as he finished his sentence, nine pagodas appeared behind the Machine expert. Each had supreme destructive power agglomerated, and the rays of light were connected together, forming a void cannon that was aimed at Jiang Ming.
“Tian Qi, is this the Space-Time Obliteration Cannon?” Hong Ying gasped with surprise.
“You got it right!” Tian Qi nodded. “This is the strongest weapon my Machine Race has ever invented. When it fires, it can even kill you!”
“Amazing, it’s truly amazing. My Human Clan is still weaker than your Machine Clan in weapons invention.” Hong Ying sighed, “If our two clans join forces to make up for each other’s shortcomings, we can dominate the universe.”
“It’s possible indeed. Unfortunately, we have too many unsolvable grievances and hatred between our two clans!” Tian Qi also lamented. “Hong Ying, just leave and you will live. Else, you’ll die here as well!”
“I can’t see him die here.” As Hong Ying said, a shield flew out of her body, blocking in front of her. It evoked the power of orders and turned into an indestructible defense.

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - Sanctified Dao to the Supreme Expert (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Sanctified Dao to the Supreme Expert (Part 2)
??
The shield was flickering with divine lights and had boundless power.
Boom.
With a flash of the Space-Time Obliteration Cannon, the luminance emitted by the shield was shattered and the shield was then blasted out.
“It can’t even resist a single fire of the cannon!” Hong Ying frowned. But when she saw the nest behind Cai Die, she couldn’t help but grin, “Sister Cai Die, how can you be so ruthless since we’ve known each other for so many years?”
“Hehe, we are the friendship of death!” Cai Die smirked, and a spiritual ray of light was shot out of the nest.
It was her best and the strongest special ability. While gathering numerous Zergs warriors’ power of soul in addition to her special ability, even Long Jingang dared not resist it directly, let alone Hong Ying.
Hong Ying had a hint of helplessness on her face. The best method was to dodge it but behind her was Jiang Ming.
She wanted to call back her shield but she realized that it had been confined by other experts. Hence, she was left with no other alternatives other than fighting her best. The last resort was merely death, after all.
A war saber appeared in her hand. When she was about to slash to resist the attack, a figure abruptly appeared before her that forced her to stop slashing. She revealed excitement on her face and exclaimed, “Brother Jiang, be careful!”
“No worry!” Jiang Ming responded. He reached out and grabbed the materialized soul attack. Then, he grasped and there was a shrill scream from the nest.
The next moment, the nest exploded. Millions of Zergs warriors were all dead inside.
...
Cai Die shuddered, and spat out a mouthful of blood. Her ears, nose, and eyes too were bleeding. She looked horrifying.
“Impossible!” She screamed, “My nest’s defense is so strong that even the soul attack of the Supreme Expert may not go through. Yet, y-you burst it with just a strike.”
“I’m now considered a Supreme Expert, the Supreme Expert of soul!” Jiang Ming responded. With a flash in his eyes, the skull of Cai Die immediately burst, and her soul wiped out. She died tragically on the spot.
This surprised all the surrounding experts. They couldn’t believe that Cai Die, the pinnacle stage Cosmic expert who might be capable of fighting against a Supreme Expert, was killed just like that.
They knew that Jiang Ming was strong but not stronger than Long Jingang. Hence, they didn’t understand why Jiang Ming could kill Cai Die in an instant. Moreover, Jiang Ming didn’t seem to have the sign of breaking through to the Supreme Expert.
“Jiang Ming, how did you do that?” Tian Qi said in a passive voice. “Can it be that you have the soul type Supreme Treasure?”
His words attracted all experts to stare at Jiang Ming. Many experts even had retreated to the space membrane, ready to elude at any time.
Hong Ying was curious too. She thought the breakthrough was too fast, and the improvement too horrifying.
“You aren’t qualified to know.” Jiang Ming looked at Tian Qi, with a strange look.
He learned that Tian Qi was a Demi-Sage Machine, who had a good main body. With a flash of his eyes, an invisible sword qi was cast into the core of Tian Qi, wiping out his soul and will in an instant.
The soul of Jiang Ming had completely transformed into the Saint Soul. His mind, and will too, had also been sublimated. Only then he learned how terrifying a Saint Soul was.
When his soul was at the edge of transformation, there was a great difference between then and now.
Taking the case of Cai Die as an example. Prior to his soul transformation, Jiang Ming might not be able to severely injure Cai Die even if he was to evoke the Celestial Heart Sword. After all, Cai Die was good at manipulating souls. Moreover, the special ability she mastered shouldn’t be of low grade, and with the support from numerous Zergs warriors, it was almost impossible for Jiang Ming to kill Cai Die with the Celestial Heart Sword alone.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming managed to kill Cai Die with just a strike.
After the soul transformation, Jiang Ming was aware of the situation he was in externally. Hence, he directly took his move even though his inner world was still evolving.
As Jiang Ming grabbed, the massive body of Tian Qi flew towards him, and he kept it in the storage vessel.
Tian Qi himself was a Demi-Sage vessel. Together with his collection, it was definitely a shocking wealth.
.
“Even Tian Qi is dead?” All experts of the Revenge Alliance were horrified, and began to flee. They knew they were feeble against Jiang Ming since the strongest two among them had been killed just like that.
“It’s too late to escape now!” Jiang Ming smirked. “All are great wealth, hence it’s a great sin to have let you all escape!”
Jiang Ming unscrupulously evoked the Celestial Heart Sword and swept through them. Whether they were of the Star Sea or Cosmic leveled, they died row after row. None of them could resist Jiang Ming’s Celestial Heart Sword even if they had any soul defending treasure.
Jiang Ming was too strong and too horrifying.
Eventually among all the experts of the Revenge Alliance, there were only about three Cosmic experts who managed to escape.
“This is imperfect!” Jiang Ming lamented.
“Imperfect?” Hong Ying asked back subconsciously. In fact, she was still in a state of shock.
“A few escaped. I can’t kill all of them!” Jiang Ming said frankly, “Those few were too fast!”
Hong Ying was rendered speechless. But she asked curiously, “Brother Jiang, are you truly a Supreme Expert now? Why aren’t you being repelled out?”
In fact, Hong Ying was not the only one who was curious. Other experts, who were not a member of the Revenge Alliance, and had retreated to the space’s boundary, were curious too.
“It’s only my soul that’s of the Supreme level. My body and cultivation base are still far behind.” Jiang Ming explained, “As for the reason why I’m not repelled out of this place? I have said earlier, right? This universe is my elder brother. This place is like my house. Hence, who would be repelled from their own home?”
Hong Ying had an urge to roll her eyes. She thought if the universe was Jiang Ming’s elder brother, then she herself would be the mother of the universe.
“Even if it’s only your soul which is of the Supreme level, it won’t be so scary, right? Even it’d take a Supreme Expert some hard work just to kill an expert like Cai Die. But you…”
Although Hong Ying was still doubtful, she didn’t ask further because it involved personal privacy.
