Jiang Ming merely smiled without any explanation. If he was to merely attack with his own Saint Soul, it would be difficult to achieve the effect just now. It was because of the terrific Celestial Heart Sword he knew. Besides, he also combined the power of the Chaotic Tree, which doubled the attack of his soul.
Doubled of the Saint Soul? It was extraordinarily terrifying indeed. The power would allow Jiang Ming to kill even an ordinary Supreme Expert.
The soul attack would result in either death or disability.
Moreover, sanctifying the soul was extraordinarily difficult. Hence, most of the Supreme Experts in this universe were transformed in the flesh and sublimated in their genes, which then led to the transformation of their souls. Nevertheless, Jiang Ming became a Supreme Expert with his soul, which was akin to the sanctification of Dao through soul.
Jiang Ming’s mind and will went through the transformation too.
Jiang Ming took a glance at the corpse, and put them away with a wave. But he left behind two Cosmic peak-leveled treasures. They were the palace, a defensive divine weapon, and the bell for soul defense.
Jiang Ming sent them over to the front of Hong Ying.
“Brother Jiang, these are too precious!” Hong Ying was startled. She then shook her head. “I didn’t help much. If I was to accept them, I’d feel insecure. I’d be afraid that you’re planning to hit on me.”
“Are you sure you don’t want them?” Jiang Ming felt like whipping her.
“Ahem, how can I reject the kindness of you as a Supreme Expert just like that? Of course I want them!” Hong Ying kept the two after some hesitation. Following that, she said happily, “With these two treasures, I’m definitely safe provided I’m not confronting a Supreme Expert. Even though I’m not a match of Long Jingang, I can easily escape.”
“Brother Jiang, what’s your next plan? Continue pillaging?” Hong Ying asked while pointed at the bottom of her feet.
“I’m going to look for Long Jingang to kill him!” Jiang Ming said, “Then, I shall try to look around for the Supreme treasure.”
“Since you’re the master here, are you still afraid of not getting it?”
“Ha, there’s even money disputes between siblings. Moreover,the Supreme treasure doesn’t show up during each opening of this secret realm, does it? If it does show up this time, it’d definitely be mine.”
“In that case, I congratulate you for getting it in advance!”
After the two chatted, they departed in a different direction.
Jiang Ming entered the following space. It had a large mountain range with forest rippling along with wind.
‘What a great place!’ Jiang Ming slightly looked around, and landed on a side of the stream in the forest. While standing on a rock, a clone appeared beside him while he himself had vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - The Three Seconds Experience Card (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: The Three Seconds Experience Card (Part 1)
??
On top of the Chuyang Peak...
Jiang Ming’s true self had returned. It was almost midnight.
“I almost miss it.” Jiang Ming felt quite afraid. It was another hour to midnight. If he got back later, his 50 years of effort of cooking a meal daily would have gone. If it were to happen, he would be very regretful.
He stopped his Junior Sister from going towards him with a wave, and quickly cooked himself a meal. It was a simple meal of a fried egg, and a bowl of egg soup. He finished the meal in a shorter time than his cooking time. Then, he washed his dishes. All was done.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for cooking and eating a quick and urgent supper. You are rewarded with a three-seconds Tenfold Soul Booster Card, the use is limited to the Star Sea of the Universe only.”
In the system space, a card appeared.
Tenfold Soul Booster? Even if it merely lasted for three seconds, it would make one invincible. The only unfortunate thing was that it was usable only in the Star River of the Universe.
“Senior Brother, what’s happening?” Linglong came forward, wrapped around his arm, and asked confusedly.
“I’m used to having a meal a day. I almost missed it today.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Aren’t you refining Dao vessels? Why are you out now?”
“It’s because I sensed that you’re back!” Linglong leaned against Jiang Ming’s shoulder. As she looked into the darkness of the night, she said in a lower voice, “Senior Brother, don’t you think that our mountain here is too desolated?”
“Desolated?” Jiang Ming replied in a surprising tone, “With us here, why is it desolated?”
...
“I just want to have a kid.”
“You’re still a kid to me.”
“Humph! Senior Brother, can we have one?”
“We aren’t taking any preventive measures, are we? Just let nature take its course. You should know that it’s very difficult for us of this level to have kids.”
“It’s difficult because you aren’t diligent enough.” Linglong chuckled. “From now onwards I shall live here, and let’s have sex once per day. No, 100 times a day. I don’t believe that I won’t get pregnant.”
Jiang Ming frowned, and pointed out. “Please don’t be too flirtatious.”
“I think you are afraid that you’d be suffering from waist pain, right?”
“Ahem, I’m strong as iron. How would I suffer from waist pain?”
“It’s in the middle of the night. Shall we do it?”
“C’mon. Beware that I’d be stirring up storms, making your squirt and quiver.”
It was a beautiful night, the perfect time for the copulation of Yin and Yang. They were entranced until dawn.
“Senior brother, it’s too short this time, isn’t it?”
Jiang Ming’s face darkened when he heard Linglong. He patted on her butt and squeezed three times.
“Because I’m after quality.”
“Hehe, I know.”
As the sky began blushing at dawn, Jiang Ming started making breakfast.
When the duo were enjoying a simple breakfast, Jiang Ming was rewarded with a low grade immortal vein, which he merged into his inner world.
Jiang Ming’s inner world was still undergoing metamorphosis and sublimation. It would take a long time because it was the upgrading of the world. It was impossible for the expansion of space, evolution of orders, operation of nature, and the changes of all beings to be done in a short period of time, after all.
The evolution of the inner world was done automatically. Jiang Ming merely had to divide part of his consciousness to be in it, feeling its changes and comprehending the natural laws of heavens.
Jiang Ming then rose to his feet, and paced towards the Tianyuan Sea.
The current Tianyuan Realm had many experts begin their adventure outside the realm. After all, the Tianyuan Realm was too small for the immortals, especially for the younger generation. They would feel like living in a jail after being in the realm for a long time. After all, everyone had the natural tendency to go out exploring.
Many went out in groups, and their first station was naturally the Tianyuan Sea.
“I wonder how many would die out there, or decide to emigrate after they leave.” Jiang Ming lamented, but he didn’t dwell on it further.
Everyone was an unique individual and was free to live their way. Hence, each individual would merely need to be responsible for themselves.
The Tianyuan Sea was a vast ocean. Although the original Tianyuan Sea was large when compared to the Tianyuan World, it was only the size of a small lake when compared to the entire Infinite Realm Battlefield.
However, after a few wars, the southern part of the Tianyuan Sea had been extended by more than 100 times. Hence, it had now become a truly vast ocean, with no edge.
On the sea were suspended points of lights from palaces or mountains. Because of Jiang Ming’s great power and his efforts in maintaining human’s dignity, he had attracted many experts of the Human Race. In particular, the young people had been trying hard to come here to live on the Tianyuan Sea.
As Jiang Ming scanned with his consciousness, he found out there were many Golden Immortal experts, at least 300,000 of them. There were many Taiyi and Great Overarching experts, as well as a few Venerates. The venerates were theGreat Monarch Wan Lian, Bai Yihou, and a few others.
Jiang Ming didn’t greet any of them but he went directly to the Auction House.
“Brother Jiang, welcome!” Riyue Changfeng was sitting cross-legged above the palace. When he saw Jiang Ming, he didn’t rise to his feet but he pointed in the direction opposite him.
Jiang Ming went over to take his seat.
While Riyue Changfeng stared at Jiang Ming, he had a hint of confusion flashed through his face. However, he didn’t ask anything. He brewed tea, poured a cup of tea and handed it to Jiang Ming. “This is the Violet Propitious Tea I’ve got from your world!”
“Violet Propitious Tea?” Jiang Ming lifted the cup, and saw the purple tea leaves. There were wisps of purple mist that condensed into a cloud at the edge of the cup, which actually absorbed Dao fluctuations.
Jiang Ming took a sip and after he tasted it, he couldn’t help to compliment, “It contains vigor and vitality. Upon drinking, it feels like the morning breeze, filling the entire body with the mighty yang energy, and removing all fatigue and evil qi. It’s good, very good indeed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - The Three Seconds Experience Card (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: The Three Seconds Experience Card (Part 2)
“Its efficacy isn’t useful for us but it’s interesting.” Riyue Changfeng beamed. “You’ll feel warm at the beginning. Then, you’ll feel the cool air being transferred throughout your body, before the air turns hot and gathers in your mind like a sun. The sun will then explode, and the fiery aura will sweep through your entire body.”
The two were enjoying tea while chattering.
“The auction has long ended, and you’ve been here for a few decades. Why are you still here?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but ask.
“There’s soon a great change here in your world. Hence, how should I miss the show?” Riyue Changfeng chuckled. “Alas, when you’ve been living too long, you’d naturally want to enjoy it whenever you encounter something interesting, wouldn’t you?”
“To think that you still have such curiosity.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Tell me, what have you discovered? Who do you think can be the next Heavenly Emperor?”
“I’ve discovered a lot I’d say!” Riyue Changfeng said, “Yu Fei has been connecting with experts of various factions. Tsk tsk tsk, her network should be the largest amidst the Honggu Heavenly Realm. Unfortunately she, as a demon, definitely won’t be given a chance to take over that position. Regardless of how active she’s, all her efforts would be in vain. The Fo Sect is special but unless the sect has overwhelming strength, Heavenly Buddha won’t have his chance. Nevertheless, the Heavenly Buddha has been working hard for that. The Dragon Sect and the Demon Holy Palace too have their respective limitations.”
“As for the so-called ten ancient clans, since the death of the 10 Venerates, they have stayed quiet for some time. However, they seem about to start making trouble. It looks possible that one of them would take up the position because of their great influence but it’s unfortunate that if they were to take any impactful action, the Fo Sect, Dragon Clan, the Demon Holy Palace and the likes would join forces to eliminate them all together.”
“Therefore, the current factions are the rottens ones. They are incapable of dominating the world. If they were to do so, they’d merely be self-destructing. In fact, there weren’t any experts who could overwhelm the world in history. You are the only one who can take over that position. No one else!”
Riyue Changfeng did a complete analysis from his understanding.
“I’m not interested.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “That position attracts many but it’s completely meaningless for me. I won’t be benefited yet my life would be filled with responsibilities and annoyances.”
“No, it’s not as you’ve thought!” Riyue Changfeng shook his head. “If you were to be in that position, you can get the experts of this world to collect resources for you in accelerating the evolution of your inner world. Don’t underestimate the things in the world. For example, you can arrange the Astral Orb Formation to condense the power of countless stars into crystals. Another example is that you can arrange in advance prior to the destruction of various worlds to collect World Heart. And there are many other benefits too.”
...
“But…” Riyue Changfeng slightly hesitated before he asked, “Brother Jiang, have you just got your breakthrough? You actually make me feel supreme pressure from my soul, which I can only feel from a saint.”
“Brother Riyue, I’ve not expect you to be so sensitive.” Jiang Ming said with surprise, “I’ve in fact, converged all my aura.”
He was rather attracted by the words of Riyue Changfeng. If he was to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor, he wasn’t interested to overlook infinite realms and manipulate people’s fate but he was interested to lead various factions in collecting resources for him.
The power of the astral was a great wealth. By just looking at the number of middle chiliocosm, one would know how astonishing the wealth of a great chiliocosm was.
“Brother Jiang, have you really had a breakthrough?” Riyue Changfeng was so surprised that he couldn’t believe it. Nevertheless, he managed to quickly recollect himself, and asked eagerly, “Because of your special condition, it’s difficult for your inner world to upgrade in a short while. In that case, it’s your soul that has transformed into the Saint Soul, right?”
“As expected of brother Riyue with long travel experience.” Jiang Ming said, “You’ve just made a correct presumption.”
Riyue Changfeng was rendered speechless. “Other than the transformation of your soul, I can’t imagine what else you can have a breakthrough. Moreover, the feeling of pressure you gave me is the inexplicable feeling from the soul. Alas, I’ve never thought that you really got a breakthrough earlier than I do.”
“It’s the most difficult to have your soul transformed to the Saint Soul. Yet, you achieved it in merely a short period of time. As expected from the genius among geniuses from numerous great chiliocosms. Brother Jiang, you have my admiration and respect.”
Riyue Changfeng was truly lamented. He had, after all, met a lot of geniuses. Even he himself was one of them. But he was absolutely nothing when compared to Jiang Ming. it was particularly so as he knew Jiang Ming was younger than 100 years old.
Jiang Ming just smiled.
“Brother Jiang, with your current ability, what are you waiting for? Go and suppress the world to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor, and start collecting resources as a preparation for the evolution of your inner world to great chiliocosm.” Riyue Changfeng began to convince Jiang Ming.
Riyue Changfeng didn’t say middle chiliocosm because he knew it was a piece of cake for Jiang Ming to upgrade his inner world to the middle chiliocosm. After all, Jiang Ming had achieved the most difficult task, that was to transform his soul to Saint Soul.
“To take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor?” Jiang Ming shook his head. “I’m not considering it now. Let’s see what’ll happen in the near future. As you have said, the great changes are in the corner. Hence, it’s better to watch the show first, isn’t it?”
“Haha, alright, let’s watch the show first!”
The two chatted, and also discussed the secrets of Saint Dao, which lasted for a couple of hours. Jiang Ming left gleefully just like when he came.
On his way back to Tianyuan Realm, he discovered a huge island with many experts living on it. There was a trading market, obviously a place for people to connect. The Great Monarch Wan Lian was on that island but he was not in charge of anything. Hence, it was obvious that he was there merely to act as a deterrent to prevent any chaos.
.
When Jiang Ming got to the Chuyang Peak, he laid on the rattan chair and swayed leisurely while Linglong laid beside him.
“Girl, do you think I’m old already?”
“Senior brother, why do you think so?”
“I’m not interested in many things. For example, the position of the Heavenly Emperor and the excitement of the outside world.”
“You aren’t old but lazy.”
“Am I that lazy? I don’t think so!”
“Hehe! Most of the time during our Yin-Yang copulation, you only lay on bed for me to take the initiative. Tell me what it is if you are not lazy?”
“I-I’m just giving you the chance to give full play to your abilities.”
Jiang Ming felt rather embarrassed.
Linglong pursed her lips, and returned to the room to continue refining her Dao vessels.
Hence, Jiang Ming was left alone on the roof. He didn’t stay idle but communicated with the Supreme Order. He found out the message he received from Luo Heng, and replied, ‘Received. Let me know immediately whenever you’re in danger. Also do let me know whenever you meet Long Jingang.’
Then, he entered the Supreme Pagoda, and went towards Ye Qingxian who was reading in a corner alone.
“It’s still your place here which is serene.” Jiang Ming sat opposite Ye Qingxian.
“I’m used to the serenity.” Ye Qingxian put down the book roll, and said with a grin, “Has the matter over there at Luo Heng’s solved?”
“Have just slaughtered about 20 Quasi-Sage.” Jiang Ming said casually.
Ye Qingxian opened her mouth in shock, and eventually said, “Brother Jiang, you’re amazing. I’d believe it even if you were to tell me that you’ve become a Saint.”
“I’m considered a Saint already!”
“What? For real?”
“Yes! My Soul has transformed into the Saint Soul.”
“Brother Jiang, y-y-you’re indeed amazing!”
Ye Qingxian gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up before she said glomily, “And you’re here to show off.”
“I’ve finally had a breakthrough, of course I need to show off a bit.” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but guffaw. “This feeling is good. It’s wonderful.”
Ye Qingxian rolled her eyes. “I never expected that you’d be so mischievous. By the way, is having a Saint Soul akin to a Saint?”
“More or less.” Jiang Ming nodded. “I’m the invincible after Saints.”
“You’ve my admiration!” Ye Qingxian said, “In this case, can your inner world undergo transformation too?”
“It’s in the process of transforming to the middle chiliocosm.”
“Awesome..” Ye Qingxian suddenly felt somewhat in a trance. “I feel I’ve been improving at a fast rate. But when compared to you, the gap between us is getting bigger. So are you going to leave here soon?”
Ye Qingxian was rather upset.
“Not for now.” Jiang Ming was somewhat hesitant. Once his inner world had completed its transformation, he would be able to comprehendthe Great Overarching laws directly. After all, it was a piece of cake for him to break through to the Great Overarching Realm.
However, if he was to break through to the Great Overarching Realm, he would have lost his membership in the Chat Room. So he thought he should go to Jun Sanqian to make an inquiry.

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - The Chaos Long River of Fate (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: The Chaos Long River of Fate (Part 1)
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation: Level 15 (Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 20110088
Achievements: Seventh Battle Tower, Level 8, Heavenly Ladder step 63
The changes of Jiang Ming’s condition in the Supreme Pagoda were insignificant. He still had about 20 million points. He had used up more than three million for his personal cultivation, and purchasing of goods from the other members in the Chat Group. Everyone was so grateful that they complimented Jiang Ming as the great man they had never met before.
The Seventh Battle Tower, he had yet to conquer the last level. Meanwhile, he had long been stagnant at the Heavenly Ladder. The step 63 was akin to the will of the Demi-Sage. The following step was akin to the will of Saint Dao. Hence, he would need a Saint Soul to achieve that.
Jiang Ming went directly to the Battle Tower after the chat with Ye Qingxian.
On level 9 of the Seventh Battle Tower, it was a big star with a radius of thousands of miles, but it was very barren and lifeless. Jiang Ming landed on one of the mountains.
After a while, Jun Sanqian appeared opposite Jiang Ming and got to his side.
“Awesome!” He looked at Jiang Ming, and he couldn’t help showing surprise and a little shock. “Your soul has transformed into a Saint Soul in such a short period of time. Brother, it’s amazing, truly amazing. It is absolutely rare to have any other person who can be compared to you throughout the great chiliocosm.”
“Big brother, it’s all because of the great fortune here.” Jiang Ming smiled. “With the training in the Battle Tower, the tempering of soul in the Heavenly Ladder, and some other encounters, my soul has been sublimated and condensed into Saint Soul!”
Some encounters?” Jun Sanqian couldn’t help but shake his head. “If it’s because of some encounters, there’d be many experts with Saint Soul everywhere. I thought you’d need to listen to a few sermons in addition to cultivating in the Hongmeng Primordial Land to have that transformation. Anyway, having a Saint Soul can be regarded as a transition of lifeform. Hence, you’ll have authority over your own life from now onwards.”
“You’d need to have Saint Soul only to have authority over your own life?”
......
“Of course! This is only relative. The great Dao is infinite. In fact, Saint Dao is just a starting point!”
“Starting point?” Jiang Ming was stunned. But he changed the topic. “Big brother, logically I’m regarded as a Saint expert after the transformation of my soul to the Saint Soul. But why am I still capable of entering this Supreme Pagoda? On which standard is this place based on?”
“It’s based on your specialization!” Jun Sanqian explained, “Taking you as an example, you mainly specialize in the Dao of world and laws. Hence, the cultivation base would be counted based on that. With Saint Soul, yes, you are considered as a Saint. But because that’s not your main specialization, it’s considered a special case. However, if you were to specialize in the cultivation of spirit, soul, mind and the likes, you’d be considered a Saint, and would be repelled by the Supreme Pagoda. There are also people who are specialized in the power of physiques, among others.”
“If this is the case, there’s a possibility to take advantage of this, isn’t it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“To take advantage?” Jun Sanqian laughed. “If you weren’t specializing in World Dao, do you think that your soul can undergo transformation first? Taking the case of Luo Heng as another example, if a Saint expert were to take the initiative to temper his physique up to the Quasi-Sage Realm, his cultivation base would be based on his physique. In fact, this place is the best for people who specialize in World Dao to a certain extent.”
Jiang Ming was enlightened. The World Dao mainly focused on evolving the inner world. Hence, both the physique and the soul were secondary. Even if they were improving faster, they wouldn’t affect the level of the inner world.
Even though Jiang Ming was still somewhat confusing, he didn’t dwell on it any further. Because it would be too difficult for him to understand further.
“Big brother, what would happen when my inner world has completed its transformation, and I manage to comprehend Great Overarching Laws, becoming a Great Overarching expert myself?” Jiang Ming asked in a solemn manner. Because it was relevant to his future and about his personal plan.
“When I become a Great Overarching Golden Immortal, can I still enter the Hongmeng Primordial Land? Do I still have the special privilege as the Group Admin?” Jiang Ming continued.
Jun Sanqian suddenly chuckled after a moment of pondering. “Well, I can reveal some to you based on your condition!”
He pointed at his feet. “In the Supreme Pagoda, it’s just a means of nurturing whether you are in the mortal or immortal level. The ultimate goal is to select a real genius.”
“So what’s a real genius?”
“Whoever passed the Seventh Battle Tower or made it to step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder before becoming a Great Overarching expert is considered to have passed the entry level exam, and become a named disciple of the Supreme Pagoda. When he achieves the Great Overarching Realm, he’d receive relevant information.”
“If he managed to achieve both, he’d become an inner disciple, and a core disciple if he made it to step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder. Once becoming a core disciple, his privilege as a Group Admin remains effective, and he can even stay in the Chat Room prior to him transcending the great chiliocosm. However, he will have to step down from the position as the Group Admin when he breaks through to the Great Overarching Realm.”
“His benefits remain. Anway, please don’t share these secrets.”
Jun Sanqian casually revealed the secrets of the Supreme Pagoda.
Jiang Ming was greatly astounded.
To pass the Seventh Battle Tower was akin to having the combat power of a Demi-Sage without the help of any special Dao vessels at Taiyi Realm.
To make it to step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder was akin to having the will of a Demi-Sage at Taiyi Realm. Besides, one had to have a terrific manual of soul or one couldn’t have stepped stably on step 63.
Yet, achieving either one could only be a named disciple.
Damn. If one were to achieve either one, he would have the talent of the Saint Dao He would be capable of sanctifying his Dao and become a Saint if there wasn’t any unforeseen accident.
One could be an inner disciple only if he was capable of achieving both. And such a person would undeniably have a combat power akin to a Demi-Sage, hence basically invincible under the Saints.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - The Chaos Long River of Fate (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: The Chaos Long River of Fate (Part 2)
When he became a Great Overarching expert or even the Quasi-Sage expert, he would be properly capable of resisting against a Saint expert.
As for the core disciple, he would be capable of resisting a Saint.
“Do you think it’s tough?” When Jun Sanqian saw the changes in Jiang Ming’s expression, he couldn’t help but laugh. “This is already a privilege. Else, do you think you can become a core disciple with your Saint Soul? Nonsense!”
“What’s the origin of the Supreme Pagoda?” Jiang Ming was again astonished. Hence, he couldn’t help but ask, “Is it something beyond the Sea of Chaos?”
Jun Sanqian merely responded with a smile.
Jiang Ming took a deep breath, paid his respect to Jun Sanqian, and said, “Thank you for telling me. May I ask whether there’s any other status above the core disciple such as the true disciple or the Holy Son and Holy Daughter?”
“You will know when you achieve the Great Overarching Realm or make it to step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder.” Jun Sanqian didn’t answer but said smilingly, “Any other question?”
“Yes, one last one.” Jiang Ming felt rather embarrassed. “Will the points be useful in the future?”
“Yes, they would become more useful and valuable.” After Jun Sanqian answered the question, he waved his hand and said, “Brother, I’ve revealed enough. I’d be going against the principle if I were to share more!”
“Thank you, my big brother!” Jiang Ming bowed. He clearly knew the reason why Jun Sanqian was treating him better each time. It was because of his personal potential. He also knew that the strength of Jun Sanqian, who had been his opponent all these while, was definitely way stronger than he could imagine.
“You are welcome. I think we may meet face-to-face soon.” Jun Sanqian smiled, and a long sword appeared in his hand.
The white robe Jun Sanqian was wearing had waves of fluctuation rippling out. In his mind was a bell guarding his soul. Jiang Ming knew that it was a Demi-Sage Vessel.
With the long sword as the offensive weapon, the armor as the defensive vessel, and the immortal bell as the soul guardian, Jun Sanqian was an all-round Demi-Sage without any shortcomings. He could be known as the invincible or at least wouldn’t be defeated by any opponents below the Saints provided no Saint vessel was used.
......
Jiang Ming had tried to defeat Jun Sanqian of this level a few times but to no avail. However, Jiang Ming was no longer afraid of Jun Sanqian now.
“Celestial Heart Sword, slash!” Jiang Ming immediately evoked the strongest special ability he had by condensing the power of soul into a long sword. It instantaneously pierced through the defensive armor of Jun Sanqian and his mind.
Along with the bell abruptly rang out, the Soul Defending Treasure had been blasted out of Jun Sanqian’s body.
Jun Sanqian, who was about to strike, shuddered. All his seven orifices were bleeding, and his primal spirit was extremely weakened.
Jun Sanqian survived the first strike. It also proved how strong a peerless genius of infinite realms was.
However, Jun Sanqian couldn’t survive the second strike. He died immediately under the second strike of the Celestial Heart Sword.
“Brother, do work harder to evolve your inner world up to the great chiliocosm as soon as possible. Don’t forget to cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land. Go as early as possible.” Jun Sanqian vanished into the thin air after he said so.
Jiang Ming had an inexplicable feeling that he wouldn’t be seeing Jun Sanqian in a while after this.
“Jiang Ming, congratulations for having passed the seventh Battle Tower!”
A voice rang out in the air, and that was it.
Although there wasn’t any surprise, Jiang Ming was not disappointed. With a thought, he left the Battle Tower.
Upon reentering, it was a stranger who appeared to be his opponent. This made him feel lost. He returned to the public square of the Supreme Pagoda after he defeated the opponent with the same Celestial Heart Sword technique.
“Brother Jiang, why did you disappear immediately after your reappearance just now? Don’t tell me you’ve failed the test.” Ye Qingxian chuckled. “Can it be that you’ve just discovered some secrets?”
Jiang Ming nodded. He looked at Ye Qingxian and said, “It’s better that you pass at least one of them.” Then, he turned around to look at the Battle Towers, and then the Heavenly Ladder.
Ye Qingxian was startled. When she recollected herself, she solemnly clasped her hands as an appreciation.
“I want to challenge the Heavenly Ladder, talk to you later!” Jiang Ming communicated with the Heavenly Ladder, and disappeared from the public square. He reappeared directly on the step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder.
Jiang Ming felt the massive pressure in the past when he stepped on here. However, it was different now. He no longer felt any hints of pressure from his soul.
Jiang Ming calmed himself, and took a step up. When he had his feet on step 64, a sword ray of light appeared in his mind. It pierced through heaven, and traversed 300 billion miles. It was immense and strong. It seemed to have traveled from the end of the universe, landed on Jiang Ming’s mind and revealed itself in an instant.
Pff…
The Ten Level Stellar Tower appeared automatically, forming a defense. Nevertheless, it managed to slightly paused the sword ray before it was slashed through.
It was also at this moment that Jiang Ming had cast his return blow. It was the Celestial Heart Sword that was his best spiritual technique.
Jiang Ming counteracted with an offensive technique.
Bang…
The two sword rays collided. Its aftermath trembled infinite realms, causing Jiang Ming to feel that his soul was greatly threatened.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming managed to block and weaken the sword ray.
“Again!”
The figure of Jiang Ming’s soul abruptly grew bigger to the size of an universe. It also shot out sword ray to slash at the sword ray casting at him.
The entire scene was a mere continuous collision between sword rays. The power of the aftermath, if it were to happen in reality, could possibly destroy the entire Honggu Heavenly Realm.
It was extremely terrifying.
Eventually when Jiang Ming managed to destroy the sword ray cast at him, the figure of his soul had got very dim, as though it would vanish at any time.
“I’ve made it!” Jiang Ming retreated his consciousness, and heaved a sigh of relief.
Jiang Ming felt intense tiredness, but it was gone completely in the next moment.
Jiang Ming lifted his head and looked around to discover that he had got to the end of the Heavenly Ladder.
At the same time, the Supreme Order flew out of his body, gleaming as though it was undergoing an inexplicable change. One message after another got into his mind.
“Jiang Ming, congratulations for having passed the Battle Towers and made it to step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder. Hence, you have achieved the requirement to be a Supreme Core Disciple. Do you accept it?”
“Reminder: Because you have achieved the requirement in the Supreme Pagoda, and also your role as the Group Admin in the Chat Room, you can still enjoy the privilege as a Group Admin prior to transcending the Chaos Long River of Fate if you are willing to accept it.”
“Reminder: If you aren’t willing to accept it, you can still enjoy the privilege before you step into the Great Overarching Realm. Else, you’ll be given a special opportunity to spend all your points in exchange for items in a special market. Then, your Supreme Order will be taken back.”
“Jiang Ming, are you willing to accept it?”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming replied without hesitation. He thought only the fool would reject such an offer and opportunity.
“Jiang Ming, you are the Supreme Core Disciple from now onwards!” The divine voice rang out again. “You get to enjoy the following privileges. First, you are still the Group Admin with the same privilege prior to you becoming a Great Overarching Expert. Second, you’ll be automatically removed from the position as the Group Admin upon becoming a Great Overarching Expert. But you get to enjoy the same privilege and you can still enter the Supreme Pagoda freely. Third, you are rewarded with 10 million points for making it to step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder. Fourth, you will be given the privilege to enter a special cultivating space. Fifth, you can communicate with the Supreme Order to go to the real land of inheritance at any time.”
The sound stopped.
Jiang Ming was surprised. He had never expected that he would be rewarded with 10 million points, and wondered if he would still receive the reward if he were to reject the offer as a core disciple. He was also surprised that there was a special cultivating space.
“Interesting!”
While looking at the Supreme Order that had landed on his hand, Jiang Ming communicated with it and discovered the changes of his condition.
Name: Jiang Ming
Race: The Human Race of the Honggu Great Chiliocosm in the Chaos.
Cultivation Base: Level 15 (Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm)
Points Accumulated: 30120088
Identity: Core disciple
Jiang Ming frowned because he thought of the voice which had mentioned the ‘transcending the Chaos Long River of Fate’. The phrase had been too overwhelming that sent chills down his spine.
He shook his head because he knew that there were things that he wasn’t supposed to be thinking of.
He communicated with the Supreme Order. He disappeared and reappeared in another space. It was still located in the Supreme Pagoda but it was empty. He was the only person in that space.
Beneath his feet was an altar. On his left was a nine-level tall pagoda, and on his right was a Heavenly Ladder with only nine steps.
Jiang Ming understood that the altar beneath his feet was the Dao Enlightenment Platform. He only had to cultivate by sitting cross-legged on it to enter the perfect cultivation mode, and even enter the Dao enlightenment condition without the need of spending a single point. The pagoda on his left was the Battle Tower and the ladder on his right was the Heavenly Ladder. They were the training area, where he would be rewarded as he passed through each level or step.
“Since I’m now the core disciple, I wonder if they have a group for core disciples to communicate or the market for trading?” Jiang Ming communicated with the Supreme Order but he didn’t receive any answer.
“What about the other members who have passed all seven Battle Towers?” Jiang Ming asked again but still received no answer.
This made Jiang Ming feel rather upset.
‘Can it be due to the fact that I’m still considered an outsider because I haven’t got to the real land of inheritance yet?’ As Jiang Ming thought, he laid down and started slumbering.
It was still 10,000 years every second in here.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Descending Again into the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Descending Again into the Universe
The following was Jiang Ming personal inventories in the Human Path Record’s system:
Name: Jiang Ming
Cultivation Base: Taiyi Realm
Major Cultivation Method: Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra
Special Abilities: Infinite Transcendence Technique, Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, Return of Infinite Law Finger, Holy Civilization Fist and etc.
Innate Talent: Peerless Heavenly Dao (Tertiary Daoist Body).
Item: Human Path Record, Supreme Order, Saint Province Dao Square, Sword Tome, Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed; Saint Dao Vessel Blood Banner, Demi-Sage Dao Vessels: Silver Luminance Battle Armor, Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, Emperor Crown, Sky Demon Saber, etc.
The following was Jiang Ming personal information in the Supreme Order:
Name: Jiang Ming
Race: The Human Race of the Honggu Great Chiliocosm in the Chaos
Cultivation: Level 15 (Taiyi Golden Immortal)
Points Accumulated: 30120088
Identity: Core disciple of the Supreme Pagoda.
......
Jiang Ming’s status did not undergo much change.
After waking up from his long slumber in the cultivation space, he continued deducing many different special abilities and evoked different laws. He managed to comprehend many supreme laws, whether it was the Swords Dao, Knives Dao, Buddhism Dao or the many other special abilities.
He didn’t end this session of his cultivation until his inner world had completely completed its evolution and reached the middle chiliocosm level.
Times slipped by between his fingers as a time that seemed like forever had passed by. However, it was similar to taking a few breaths of air to the outside world.
Jiang Ming returned directly to Chuyang Peak. He made himself a pot of tea, sat on the reclining chair and swayed slowly.
He began to think about what he was going to do from now on.
With his soul already transformed into the Saint Soul, it was not realistic for him to want to improve further in such a short time. He was in no rush to comprehend the laws as well.
It wouldn’t even be late to begin comprehending the Great Overarching Laws only after his inner world completely settled down and finished strengthening its core.
‘The limit of the middle chiliocosm is that the origin of the world can be raised to the power equivalent to the peak of the Saint Realm. The strongest lifeform that can be nurtured in it would be equivalent to that of the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm.’
This was the situation for a middle chiliocosm.
That Bei Chenxing that Jiang Ming beheaded came from a middle chiliocosm and was in the later stageof Great Overarching Golden Immortal.
The limit of life that a world could nurture and the source of origin of the world were two different things.
A great chiliocosm could nurture the peerless Saint Realm Experts. As for the power of its origin? Even Jiang Ming didn’t have a clue how strong it would be.
‘Alas, the great chiliocosm. It shouldn’t be possible for me to reach such a level in a short time.’
With a slight thought, he started exploring his inner world.
Although his inner world had evolved, it was still equivalent to the initial stage of a middle chiliocosm. The laws of origin were rapidly digesting the various divine crystals, immortal veins, and the other treasures that Jiang Ming had stored in it.
In addition, Jiang Ming had many other storage spaces too.
‘In order to improve my inner world quickly, I’ll still need to resort to plundering.’ Jiang Ming thought of the universe.
That place far exceeded any ordinary great chiliocosms. With a vast starry sky, boundless universe and the Sea of Chaos outside of the universe, it was definitely a place of great supremacy.
Jiang Ming thought he shall wait for a while longer, at least till midnight.
He then called up the Human Path Record to skim through the record. He didn’t see anything major happening.
He learned that Xi Yao had already arrived at the Tianyuan Sea and was strolling through it. She was enjoying a different kind of freedom, but she was also very confused at the same time.
Jiang Ming merely gave it a glance and placed it behind his mind. He didn’t have time to worry about other people’s affairs now.
As the night looms, the radiance of the lunar star fell and the ancient stars illuminated the skies.
Jiang Ming looked up and sighed, “Alas, Tai Yuan!” He shook his head and put away his various thoughts.
He used to be afraid of this person, yet now? Even if this enemy of his wielded a Saint Weapon, he wasn’t afraid anymore. He could now easily suppress him.
Jiang Ming no longer cared about Tai Yuan. He didn’t care if Tai Yuan would continue causing any ruckus, but the more ruckus he would cause, the faster he would die.
Midnight was the time where Yin and Yang intersected, which also was the time where a day was fully changed.
Jiang Ming got up and cooked himself some food. Other than a bowl of rice and a piece of pancake, he sautéed another two plates of vegetables. Then, he silently enjoyed his meal under the lunar luminance.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for eating at a time where Yin and Yang meet and to really have a meal of breakfast. You’re rewarded with a long river of innate vital essence.”
Jiang Ming’s eyes suddenly lit up, especially when he felt the length of this river of Innate Vital Essence in the system’s space. He was euphoric.
The long river of the innate vital essence was formed from the liquefaction of the innate vital essence fluid. The river was 490,000 kilometers long and 36 kilometers wide.
It was a really sky-defying river.
If Jiang Ming’s inner world was able to completely digest the energy from it, he would be able to at least enter the middle stage of the middle chiliocosm.
“The System is still the best.” After Jiang Ming exclaimed, he transferred the long river into his inner world.
The World Tree felt the aura from the innate essence and immediately sent roots towards the void one after another. Just when it was about to be embedded into the river, Jiang Ming sent a thought through and the countless roots retracted.
Jiang Ming didn’t want to give it to the World Tree. At his current stage, his main goal was to improve his inner world.
Moreover, the World Tree had already reached its growth stage. Its roots could now penetrate through the barriers of the Inner World into the boundless void to directly absorb energy to promote its growth.
Of course, such a method was not as fast as directly feeding the World Tree, but it wasn’t slow either. The World Tree was still growing continuously.
‘With it being in my inner world, it’s equivalent to it being inside my body. How can its roots be extended into torrents of the vast void?’
As soon as Jiang Ming integrated the river of innate vital essence into the ley lines, he felt the world’s origin tremble, followed by the power of order pouring into the river, and began to absorb energy from it, strengthening the world and improving its core.
Jiang Ming then integrated himself with the World Tree and discovered that these slightly twisted roots almost look like illusions. They were not hindered by anything in its path and went straight into the torrents in the void. Upon reaching the place, it took root and began to devour the power there, allowing the World Tree to grow.
The World Tree also exuded auras of good fortune and integrated them into the inner world, kick-starting the world’s cycle and strengthening its origin.
‘If I’m able to thoroughly comprehend such an ability, it will surely become an overwhelmingly terrifying special ability.’
Jiang Ming was getting more excited, but managed to hold back his thoughts.
He knew it was not the time for him to do so yet. He shall start to analyze the World Tree and understand its operating mechanism the other time.
He was assured that the World Tree was a sky-defying great treasure. In fact, an illusory outline of the world had formed between the branches and leaves.
Jiang Ming detached his spiritual imprint and discovered that his inner world was growing rapidly along with the rapid perishing river of innate vital essence. All kinds of life were bred in all parts of the world, many of which were intelligent creatures and even powerful creatures.
Jiang Ming was rather hesitant but he didn’t kill any of them.
‘Alas, it’s the breeding of life!’ He inexplicably felt rather disconsolate. He felt as though he himself was the Heavenly Dao, overseeing the changes in the inner world, as well as the birth and death of beings.
Hence, he began wondering about the outside world. Could it be that there was a being like him overseeing the whole scene? Would it be similar to that of the universe? Could it be that he was being monitored now as well?
As such thoughts ran through his head, various incredible hypotheses followed.
Jiang Ming withdrew his consciousness. As he lifted his head and gazed at the sky full of stars, he felt very complicated.
Then he turned to the Jiuyang Grand Hall, he saw his master and the rest were still enjoying their meal. That table of feast was akin to supreme fortune to them. It would take them a long time to digest just a piece of meat.
Anyway, they didn’t mind and continued doing so as they had ample of time. From their conversation, it seemed that they were planning on using a whole year to finish up this great feast. They were not in a hurry as there wasn’t any danger anyway.
Jiang Ming had a hearty smile on his face, especially upon seeing his Master Gu Hai circling around the table with his hands behind his back. That proud and smudge look on his face really made Jiang Ming feel inexplicably relieved.
‘For the sake of my inner world, it’s time to go there.’ As Jiang Ming thought about it, he called up the Human Path Record and went off crossing universes.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - Besieged by Supreme Experts
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Besieged by Supreme Experts
Jiang Ming appeared right beside a stream in the forest. Upon appearance, he retrieved his clone which was about to dissipate and had obtained quite a lot of treasures.
Jiang Ming lifted his head, looked up into the sky and couldn’t help but smile.
His clone didn’t stay there the whole time but when around. Upon realizing that many of the ferocious beasts no longer committing suicide before him but became offensive against him, the clone killed many of them, and used up much of its energy.
“Big Brother!”
Jiang Ming clasped his hand and greeted the sky. He knew that the preferential treatment he was given was over. He didn’t test it out and began his hunt.
Under the great pressure here, his speed was greatly affected and even the reach of his consciousness was limited.
However, Jiang Ming had the Saint Soul and the Saint Will. In fact, from a certain point of view, he was already considered to be of the Supreme Expert and yet he wasn’t rejected from the Specter Secret Realm.
A single scan of his Saint Will, he could probe almost the entire space.
Hence, for each new space he entered, he would first scan through the space before hunting down beasts to collect items. Following that, he would begin hunting for experts of other races. He would kill all experts of the Great Overarching Realm and above.
Because of his overly powerful Saint Soul, Jiang Ming didn’t even need to show himself when he killed those experts he encountered in mere seconds. He was too fast at slaughtering to the point that no news could be spread out.
With every one of these experts Jiang Ming had killed, it was equivalent to him gaining yet another treasure trove.
He didn’t care about the other treasures. What he cared about were the divine crystals, energy crystals and likes. These were considered great resources for his inner world.
As Jiang Ming stretched out his hand and grabbed, a newly unearthed saber fell into his hand. It was equivalent to a middle range Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel.
......
He had quite a good harvest.
As soon as Jiang Ming was almost finished plundering in one space, he would go on to the next one. Wherever Jiang Ming went, it was as though the space was invaded by locusts.
Jiang Ming took away all the unearthed treasures, and the treasures of the experts of other races. Of course, he didn’t touch a single human expert.
Outside of the Specter Secret Realm, several Supreme Experts had already gathered. They paid no attention to the opening of the Specter Secret Realm initially because they couldn’t enter the place. They wouldn’t care about plundering the treasures from those that came out unless it was a Supreme Treasure.
The reason that they were gathered here this time was because both Long Jingang and Jiang Ming had brandished their Supreme Treasures.
To think that there were two pieces and that they were both in the hands of the younger juniors,who wouldn’t be attracted to snatch from them?
There were even some Supreme Experts who were eyeing Long Jingang’s Supreme Treasure. They presumed that they would have the ability to go against Long Qian if they managed to fall back into seclusion to refine the Supreme Treasure which they had snatched from Long Jingang after killing him.
Even if they were to fall short in the battle, they would be able to hide themselves in the Chaos. They believed that it would be very difficult for Long Qian to capture them there.
As for some others who were concerned about their respective clans, they had a lot of scruples and wouldn’t even dare to snatch Long Jingang’s Supreme Treasure. Hence, they were eyeing the Supreme Treasure of Jiang Ming instead. After all, they weren’t afraid of the Human Race going after them for revenge at all.
The reason was because of the large territory and population of the Human Race as a strong faction, it would be quite troublesome for them to counteract if the Supreme Expert was annoyed and wanted to retaliate.
Right that moment, these few Supreme Experts had received the information one after another.There were from the Star Beast Clan, Demon Clan, Machine Clan, Zergs, Blue-blooded Clan, Congenital Spirit Clan and the likes. Although they had always been hostile towards each other, it didn’t hinder them from communicating.
“That human Jiang Ming can actually destroy the environment of the Specter Secret Realms. I wonder how he does it? I’ve looked into this before and even the most powerful Supreme Treasures couldn’t destroy the place!”
“I don’t know. From my investigation, this Jiang Ming has a mysterious origin and is of great strength. He can even exchange blows with Long Jingang and emerge undefeated. However, there is no information about him in the universe, not even within the human race. I suspect that he should be from the Chaos.”
“Humans from other universes? If that’s true, then this would be quite interesting. We’ll need to catch him and take a good look at his memory. To think that he is a creature of another universe! The cultivation system, knowledge and the likes that he has are invaluable treasures.”
“Jiang Ming just killed Qi Ling of the Machine Clan and Chong San of the Zergs.”
“This kid is really crazy. He had already provoked the Demon clan and even placed his hands on the Machine Clan and Zergs. Heh! It seems that he doesn’t want to continue living any longer.”
The Supreme Experts of the Machine Clan and Zergs were all flashing with overwhelming murderous intent.
However, the next piece of information left all of them in shock.
“What did you say? Jiang Ming took only a few seconds to kill Cai Die and the other experts?”
” He slaughtered more than 20 Cosmic experts and more than 100 Star Sea experts in merely a few seconds? How is that possible?”
“He was trying to break through before. Could it be that he is now a Supreme Expert?”
“Even if he is now a Supreme Expert, it’s still impossible for him to kill off Cai Die and all other experts in just a few seconds. That’s right! He still has that Supreme Treasure with him. Could that be the reason behind this?”
“It’s certain that he is now a Supreme Expert. However, why wasn’t he ejected from the Specter Secret Realm? Perhaps he has a way of communicating with the origin of the universe.”
.
“Whatever the case is, this Jiang Ming must die!”
“Yes, he must die!”
The many Supreme Experts who were present, reached an agreement in a short period of time.
After all, Jiang Ming had killed many of the experts of their clans. For him to be so powerful upon breaking through, they couldn’t imagine how strong Jiang Ming would be in the future. Hence, they thought they should take this opportunity, the golden opportunity to kill him directly.
If they didn’t join forces, none of them had the confidence to do anything to Jiang Ming.
However, one after another, these Supreme Experts received information about the disappearance of the imprints of their clans’ experts who went into the Specter Secret Realm.
All of them were furiously enraged.
After a slight exchange of information, they had come to a conclusion that Jiang Ming was the culprit. Otherwise, who else could’ve killed so many experts in such a short time?
“He’s trying to wipe out all the experts of our clans in one go!”
“No! This is the Human Race waging war against all clans and races of the universe. They want to dominate the universe!”
“Hehe.. Human Race… What a Human Race!”
All of these Supreme Experts had a cold murderous look on their faces.
They were even planning to kill off every single one of the Human Race’s experts that come out of the Specter Secret Realm. None shall be left alive.
Jiang Ming didn’t know that there was already a trap laid for him in the outside world. Of course, he wouldn’t have minded even if he did.
He was currently filled with ecstasy. Because of his Saint Soul, he was able to travel through the spaces one after another at an extremely fast pace.
As such, he was at an extremely fast pace killing off his enemies. The treasures that he plundered off them had piled up so much that there was almost a whole galaxy of these spoils of war. Merely the energy crystals and divine crystals had already amounted to the size of several planets.
These were all trophies from slaughtering the non-human experts.
“There’s just too many great treasures!” Jiang Ming was extremely excited.
However, Jiang Ming also understood that the great treasures of the universe were more or less concentrated in the hands of the experts. Hence, he had been killing off those experts. It also meant that he was akin to have plundered the entire universe already.
‘It would be even better if I could pack up the whole Specter Secret Realm and take it with me.’
Such a discontented thought ran through Jiang Ming’s mind.
He didn’t lose track of time. When the time came, he would head back to Chuyang Peak to cook up a meal.
On this day, he had a sudden feeling to communicate with the Supreme Order. It was Luo Heng who left a message: “Brother Jiang! Your killing spree is too ruthless! Seems like you’re bloodletting the other clans.”
“Well, who told them to mess with me? How’s it going at your side?”
“I’m staying by Zhao Changkong’s side. Although there have been a few twists and turns, there is no major danger. However, I’ve heard some news. Since you’ve killed too many and angered many Supreme Experts of the other clans, they are all outside the Specter Secret Realm. They’re planning to kill you as soon as you go out.”
“Supreme Experts of the other clans?” How many of them?”
“At least five or six of them, maybe more.”
“That’s great!”
“Brother Jiang, have you really broken through? Are you now a Supreme Expert? This shouldn’t be right? Oh right, it’s your soul that has undergone transformation right?”
“That’s right!”
“You are still as amazing as ever. You must never go out. If you can’t stay in the Specter Secret Realm any more, just return to your world. Don’t worry about me here. A thousand years is still a very long time to go. After your inner world advances into the great Chiliocosm, take me out on a killing spree when the time comes.”
“Haha! I won’t let you wait for long.”
“Alright! Oh no! I saw Long Jingang. He discovered us as well.”
“Long Jingang? I am planning to use a special method to locate him and directly kill him. Never did I expect you all to have discovered him first. Oh well! I’ll go deal with him now then.”
It would’ve been very easy for Jiang Ming if he wanted to look for Long Jingang. He could’ve just descended to his location through the Human Path Record.
However, he didn’t do so. Because he thought it was better for him to sweep through as many spaces and plunder for more treasures.
Now that Long Jingang had met up with Luo Heng, there wasn’t any else to say about it.
Jiang Ming evoked the Human Path Record and descended over to their location.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - Obtaining the Supreme Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Obtaining the Supreme Treasure
It was a vast glacier with snowflakes dancing around in the air and land made entirely of ice.
Ten or more snow wolves could be seen constantly pouncing and attacking a person in the snow.
Armed with sharp claws, coupled with the ability to spew icicles that could even pierce through Golden Immortal Dao Vessels were clear indications of how powerful the pack of wolves were, but did little damage to the ice layers in the surrounding.
Zhao Changkong wielded a long spear with his bare hands and slaughtered the snow wolves one by one.
It didn’t take long before all of them were annihilated.
After a short while, the corpses were nowhere to be seen. What was left were the many Snow Crystals, Dao vessels and other treasures scattered on the ground.
Zhao Changkong, who seemed to be used to such a scene, put away the items and took a look around the place. After sensing around the area for a brief moment and realizing that there weren’t any dangers lurking, he let Luo Heng out.
“It’s so cold.” Luo Heng shivered just as he stood firm.
Zhao Changkong couldn’t help laughing. “This is Ice of Extreme Coldness. The ordinary people wouldn’t be able to withstand the cold air here. How about it? Can you manage?”
“I’m alright.” Luo hang nodded his head, but said embarrassedly, “Brother Zhao, I have always been a burden to you throughout this journey.”
“Haha! It doesn’t affect my battle, so it’s fine.” Zhao Changkong couldn’t help laughing out loud. Immediately after, his smile faded and said, “There’s constantly been news about Brother Jiang coming from the outside world. Do you want to hear about them?”
“What news? Could it be that Brother Jiang has caused some big commotion again?”
“Heh! That’s right. Some time ago, he annihilated the alliance of more than 20 Cosmic experts who wanted revenge on him. Among them were Cai Die of the Zergs, who was already at the pinnacle of the Cosmic Realm. With that battle, Jiang Ming had become famous and was recognized as a person who had broken through to a Supreme Expert. I thought he would be ejected by the Specter Secret Realm but he didn’t. He didn’t settle down either, but instead went on a killing spree, bringing fear to all experts of the other clans.”
“Brother Jiang has made a cultivation breakthrough?” Luo Heng had a shocked look on his face.
“He must’ve made a breakthrough. Otherwise, how could it be possible for him to first end his great battle with Long Jingang in a draw, and later went on a killing spree, killing more than 29 Cosmic experts? If he didn’t make a breakthrough, it would’ve been impossible.”
“Brother Jiang is amazing! Big brother Zhao, how many did Brother Jiang actually kill?”
“According to the news from the outside world, the preliminary statistics stated that Jiang Ming has killed more than 50 Cosmic Experts since he entered this Specter Secret Realm. As for the Sea Star Experts? Who knows how many.”
“Oh fuck!”
“It’s not just you. I had that same reaction! However, there’s also news from the outside world that because Jiang Ming has killed too many, the many Supreme Experts of the various clans have already formed an alliance to block him off outside the Specter Secret Realm. They will be besieging to kill Jiang Ming as soon as he leaves this place.”
“This…”
“Alas! It’s such a pity that Pan Wang, the Supreme Expert of our Human Race is still in the Chaos. He won’t be able to rush back in such a short time. The other two seniors of ours are after all only ordinary Supreme Experts. It would be hard for them to protect Jiang Ming.”
“This…”
Luo Heng was shocked and quickly sent Jiang Ming the news.
Just when Luo Heng was halfway through chatting with Jiang Ming, he noticed a person flying over from a distance. He was Long Jingang.
Right when he noticed him, Long Jingang looked over at his direction as well.
“Haha! To think that I actually stumbled upon the two of you.” As soon as Long Jingang discovered the two, he laughed out loud and was in extreme euphoria. “Jiang Ming slaughtered many experts of my Demon Clan. Hehe! Now that I’ve met the two of you here, I’ll first kill you two and let him taste the pain and know the consequences of being revenged upon.”
He paced over in the void towards the two, one step at a time.
“Although I am no match for you, you may not really be able to kill the both of us.” Zhao Changkong’s spear flicked, and a sharp aura pierced through its tips, bursting out into the surrounding. He stared at Long Jingang with eyes like knives. “Long Jingang, you are still lacking quite a bit when compared to Brother Jiang. He slashed down dozens of Cosmic Experts and among them was Cai Die who is no weaker than you. However, what about you? You are such a coward, not daring to even show yourself.”
“He’s just a wimp.” Luo Heng sneered, “No, he’s worse than a wimp. He’s a bastard.”
“You’re courting death!” Flame of anger could be seen set ablaze in Long Jingang’s eyes. Gloves suddenly materialized on his fists, and even an ax appeared in front of him, as he grabbed ahold of it.
It seemed that he was prepared to go all out and kill them both.
“My younger brother, you’re talking nonsense but telling the truth. Remember to not slap a person on the face. It’s just that his mother was killed by his own father. He then wanted to live his life and reap the benefits from his father to grow up, and then he will kill his father then. That is all.” Zhao Changkong lowered his voice, “This is his deepest secret. Don’t ever bring this up anywhere.”
“Big brother, I will remember!” Luo Heng nodded honestly.
The two of them were really not ordinary trash talkers.
“Damn you two!”
Long Jingang’s flame of anger was burning ferociously. How could he not understand that the two were teasing him, and even deliberately angered him to confuse his mind? It was just that he couldn’t bear it any longer. Nor was there a need for him to do so. This was because he was confident that he could slash down Zhao Changkong.
As for Luo Heng? Long Jingang despised him as something even incomparable to a feeble ant.
Long Jingang raised the ax that was equivalent to a Demi-Sage Dao Vessel. Great destructive power erupted from the ax as though it was trying to destroy the universe. Even though they were in the Specter Secret Ream, the power even caused the power of order here to go into turmoil.
“Do you think I’m afraid?”
Zhao Changkong stood in front of Luo Heng. A defensive shield appeared in front of him as his whole body was emanating with waves of divine luminance, giving off a mighty aura.
Just as he was about to keep Luo Heng back into the palace, a human figure could be seen from the distance rushing over. He couldn’t help from being overjoyed and yelled out, “Brother Jiang! You’re just in time! Haha! Just in time!”
It was Jiang Ming heading in their direction. He didn’t appear right beside Luo Heng, but appeared hundreds of miles away and made his way over.
“Brother Zhao, leave this Long kid to me.” Jiang Ming rushed over to their side in a blink of an eye. He then looked at Luo Heng with a smile and asked, “I wasn’t late, was I?”
“Just in time!” Luo Heng smiled right back, “Now that you’re here, I can rest assured. We’ll have to leave this to you now!”
“Don’t you worry!”
Jiang Ming finally turned around and looked at Long Jingang.
He was all smiles and as relaxed as he could be.
Long Jingang however, looked as though he was confronting a great enemy. He even had the Zhentian Tower, the Supreme Treasure to appear above his head.
“Have you really become one of the Supreme Experts?” Long Jingang couldn’t believe it.
He knew how difficult it was to become one. Even breaking through to the Supreme Realm would require a long time of preparation. The time it took for the breakthrough process itself would be long as well, yet what had this person in front of him achieved? Just how long had it been?
Wasn’t this just pulling on people’s legs?
“Of course! It wasn’t that difficult.” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “If it wasn’t for you forcing me to unveil my Supreme Treasure, which attracted all the factions over and placed me under immense pressure, I’m afraid it would’ve taken me a few years to break through.”
Long Jingang opened his mouth and almost scolded, ‘To hell with your mother.’
Jiang Ming had a breakthrough because of great pressure? Else, it would take him another few more years to break through? Was that even something a human would say?
God damn it! Jiang Ming must be a type of plant. If he was an animal, he would have long submitted.
“I don’t believe it!” Long Jingang licked his lips, and the ax in his hand slashed onwards, “I’m keen to see if you’re really as you said or this is just a huge bluff.”
Boom...
The ax split open the void, severed the shackles of order and opened up the heavens and earth. This swing was of extreme strength. After all, Long Jingang had mustered all of his strength into the swing, bringing its might to the extreme.
Jiang Ming stayed focused on the strike. In response, he pointed his fingers into the void, and a small flicker of luminance could be seen on his fingertips. It was the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique, which pierced through and blasted the ax into a distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - Return from the Chaos, the Wine Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Return from the Chaos, the Wine Clan
Along with the great improvement of his inner world, and the great increment of its origin, Jiang Ming’s own strength had been improving exponentially too. Therefore the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique which Jiang Ming had just evoked, was far stronger than before.
Long Jingang was forced to retreat to 100-meters away, leaving a long crack on the iceberg under him that stretched into the distance. However, it didn’t take long before the iceberg quickly returned to its original state.
Rather than being annoyed, Long Jingang was instead in euphoria. He even laughed out loud due to pure joy.
“Haha! Jiang Ming, they all said that you’ve had a breakthrough on your cultivation. Yet now, you are showing me with your actions that you absolutely haven’t broken through. There are absolutely no traces of the supreme Dao fluctuation, techniques and secrets emitting from your body that a Supreme Expert should have had.” Long Jingang’s fighting spirit rose to a monstrous level. “I’ve seen so many Supreme Experts in the past, yet you don’t have the slightest characteristic of a Supreme Expert. I’m guessing that you probably have a type of Supreme Treasure related to soul that allows you to be so overwhelming over others. However, with me as your current opponent, what can you do against me when I have a Supreme Treasure myself?”
The treasured Pagoda on top of his head hung down with rays of luminance, protecting him within. There was also the silhouette of a bell in between his eyebrows. This was a treasure at the pinnacle of the Cosmic Realm, a special Soul Defensive Dao Vessel.
“You’re again thinking that you are capable of taking me down.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Well, since you are so eager to die, I will fulfill you!”
In order to go for a one-hit kill, Jiang Ming combined his consciousness with the World Tree as he evoked the Celestial Heart Sword technique. A blinding sword luminance could be seen coming out between his eyebrows as it directly penetrated the defensive barrier of Long Jingang’s Zhentian Pagoda.
“This is the power of the Saint Soul!” It was at this moment that Long Jingang realized that he was very wrong about Jiang Ming. He was so very wrong that despair was all that was left.
“I should’ve believed the rumors from the outside world. After all, he killed dozens of Cosmic Experts already. If he were not of the Supreme Expert, how could he have killed them in the first place? The moment I saw him, I should’ve fled...”
As such thoughts ran through Long Jingang’s mind, the bell protecting his soul did not manage to block off this sword luminance from Jiang Ming as the attack penetrated the barrier easily and slashed apart his soul.
With one blow, Long Jingang was now dead.
His soul had been annihilated, yet his body seemed to be normal from the outside. However, the will of the body was wiped out.
Zhentian Pagoda trembled and just when it was about to turn into a streak of luminance and flee the scene, Jiang Ming suppressed the treasure using his will and transferred the treasure into the Human Path Record, to be refined later on.
Such a defensive treasure was exactly what he needed at the time.
Jiang Ming went over to Long Jingang’s corpse and scraped out all of his many treasures. There were quite a few Demi-Sage Weapons such as the armor, gloves, ax and a divine bell.
Coupled with the Zhentian Tower, these treasures were extremely luxurious to say the least.
If it wasn’t for the power from the Chaos World Tree, Jiang Ming didn’t have the confidence to kill his opponent with one blow.
“Brother Jiang, did you kill him in one blow?” Luo Heng widened his eyes in shock as his mouth was opened in awe.
He had long heard of Jiang Ming’s capability. However, no matter how good Jiang Ming’s combative records were before, nothing would compare to seeing him in combat first hand.
To think that he had just killed Long Jingang, an expert with a Supreme Treasure, right in front of him. This feeling that Luo Heng experienced was unprecedentedly strong.
“Brother Jiang, I’m amazed!” Zhao Changkong also said in a shock, “From now on, our Human Race finally has the fourth Supreme Expert! Hence, we are going to become mightier. Such a wonderful occasion really requires at least 30,000 toasts of celebration.”
He then took out three bottles of wine and threw them over to Jiang Ming and Luo Heng each.
“Is this the Boundless Spiritual Wine?” As soon as Luo Heng caught the bottle of wine in his hand and took a closer look, his face was filled with a shocked expression. “Rumor has it that this wine is brewed using 10,000 types of the universe’s spiritual objects for 10,000 years. Such a wine is one of the three most famous wines of the universe. There are even more rumors that the taste of this wine not only gives off an endless aftertaste, but also can enhance the level of a person’s genetics with just a pint.”
“Yes, this is the Boundless Spiritual Wine!” Zhao Changkong nodded and continued, “This is the reward that Pan Wang had given me when I advanced into the Cosmic level. He gave me nine bottles but now, these are the last three.”
“This… This is too precious!” Luo Heng hesitated to accept the wine.
“Haha!” Zhao Changkong laughed, “No matter how precious it is, it’s still a beverage to be drunk. Today, I witnessed Brother Jiang killing Long Jingang, marking the emergence of the fourth Supreme Expert of our Human Race. Is there even anything happier than this? No. Only such a wine can add to such a prosperous moment. You don’t have to be too courteous about it.”
“Alright!” Luo Heng didn’t refuse his offer.
On the other hand, Jiang Ming directly opened the bottle of wine and took a sniff. As the countless types of aromas came rushing into his nostril, it circulated within his body and even caused his body to emanate the fragrance of the wine.
.
“Good wine!” Jiang Ming exclaimed in amazement. “Just smelling it makes me feel intoxicated. There are many kinds of aromas within this wine, but they are harmoniously matched and do not conflict with each other at all. The taste is absolutely amazing! As for the other effects that come with it, it didn’t even matter anymore.”
“The good thing about this wine is that it can stimulate the aroma of all kinds of spirits, and the fusion is just right. As for purifying the soul and improving the level of genes of an expert, such effects are useless for the strong like us!” Zhao Changkong laughed, “Brother Jiang, please!”
“Please!”
The three drank with each other.
The boundless smell of wine and its rich aromatic essence caused even a person’s soul to flutter. It was as if the wine was clearing the thousands of troubles and even gave the person a feeling as if he was witnessing the sanctification of a great Dao.
The flow of essence of great fortune contained within the wine circulated the whole body, causing even Jiang Ming’s physique to slightly improve. This showed how terrific the wine was.
“Not bad! This is not bad at all!” It took a while before Jiang Ming recollected himself from the aftertaste. He looked at Zhao Changkong and asked, “Where can I find more of such wine?”
“There is a clan in the universe that is best at brewing wine.” Zhao Changkong laughed, “They are called the Wine Clan, but they are actually a kind of plant life. They were originally known as the Wine Vine Clan. But because the wines they brewed became famous throughout the universe, they began calling themselves the Wine Clan. The Boundless Spiritual Wine is one of their products. However, it’s very difficult to get your hands on them. No, that’s not it. It might be very hard for people like us, but it shouldn’t be that difficult for Brother Jiang. After all, you’re now a Supreme Expert. The Wine Clan will definitely treat you well. If Brother Jiang enjoys fine wines, then go to the Wine Clan. You will definitely be able to get a lot of them.”
“Alright! I’ll remember this!” Jiang Ming remembered this at heart.
To Jiang Ming, fine wine was a kind of enjoyment. Alas, his lifespan was a long journey. Hence, how could he not have any hobbies of some sort? If he could drink and have sex together with his Junior Sister! He wondered how enjoyable that would be.
After the three continued to chat for a while, the three of them began their exploration of this space to reap more treasures together.
However, when they saw Jiang Ming’s terrifying treasure hunting capability, they were really astonished.
“At this rate, it won’t be long before Brother Jiang scrapes all the treasures of the Specter Secret Realm.” Zhao Changkong said with surprise.
With Zhao Changkong’s ability, it would take him more than ten years of effort to completely search through a space of the Specter Secret Realm.
What’s more, there were powerful beasts, many of which were comparable to the Cosmic level, and even the occasional appearance of terrifying beings comparable to the pinnacle of the Cosmic level. In addition to guarding himself against foreign clans, it would take a long time to search through a space.
However, Jiang Ming had obviously broken the norm.
The three of them began to traverse the space non-stop.
At the edge of the universe, a middle-aged man clad in a golden robe had just returned from the Chaos. Upon his return, he was immediately stunned.
“Jingang’s life imprint has actually disappeared.”
“He died?”
“How could he have died?”
“Who among those with the capability of killing him within this universe dare to not give face to me? Even Pan Wang, the strongest of the universe, would not dare lay hands on him if he were to stumble upon Jingang!”
“Who among those below the Supreme level would be capable of killing him?”
“He even has the Supreme Treasure Zhentian Pagoda that I gave him. Its defense is impeccable, and its offensive capability is not far off.”
“No matter who killed my son, he must die!”
“I’ll not only slaughter all your relatives and friends, I’ll also massacre your clan! I’ll then confine and refine you for tens of billions of years! I’ll let you taste all the tortures the universe has to offer.”
The middle-aged expert looked indifferent. Finally, an extremely cold smile hung on his face as he started to collect information on what happened to Jingang.
This person was none other than Jingang’s father, Long Qian, the strongest expert of the Demon Clan. He had been around for billions of years and was terrifyingly powerful.
“Specter Secret Realm, Human Race, Jiang Ming. It’s most likely him. Good! Great! This is very great!”
It didn’t take long for Long Qian to obtain all the information he wanted. He then tore through the void and left the scene, heading towards his destination, the entrance into the Specter Secret Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - The Core of the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: The Core of the Universe
Jiang Ming shuttled back and forth between the Specter Secret Realm and Chuyang Peak every day.
After more than ten days of work, he had almost finished visiting every corner of Specter Secret Realm, and the treasures that he reaped have long made Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng numb to it. Even by just picking the leftovers from the haul, the two of them were ecstatic.
Of course, there were even more experts of the foreign clans slaughtered. In total, Jiang Ming had killed almost 100 Cosmic Experts.
Zhao Changkong even presumed that Jiang Ming might have killed one third of the top experts of the universe by now.
It was simply incredible.
“Brother Jiang, you are making our Human Race an enemy of the entire universe.” Zhao Changkong smiled bitterly.
“Don’t worry! I will solve the troubles I caused myself!” Jiang Ming didn’t care.
He came to this world to plunder resources. How could he not cause trouble if he wanted to gain these benefits?
The treasures that he obtained throughout these days were far more than what he had in the past few decades. If he was to settle down after this, his strength would definitely improve even further.
On this day, they passed through the membrane and reached another space. As soon as they arrived, an overwhelmingly heavy suppressive pressure had caused Luo Heng to sway and fall.
“Such terrifying oppressive force!” Luo Heng was shocked. He felt extremely difficult to breathe. It was even difficult for him to stand up. It was as if there was a ten-thousand-feet high mountain pressing against his body, making it difficult to even take a single step.
“The oppressive force is really terrifying indeed.” Jiang Ming frowned. “Even a Star Sea expert wouldn’t be able to perform well here, let alone fly in such conditions. No! The Star Sea expertwouldn’t even be able to fly here. Brother Zhao, how can there be such a terrifying place?”
“This is…” Zhao Changkong rose into the air, but at an extremely slow speed. It took him two breaths to fly to a height of 100 meters, and his speed moving forward was still extremely slow. He investigated for a while before he returned to the ground.
......
On the other hand, Jiang Ming lifted his feet and was already 1,000 meters up in the air, looking in all directions.
The rivers and mountains there were vast, and the land was so enormous that it seemed to be borderless at sight. It felt as though the place was an actual world by itself.
