In the distance, there were ferocious beasts galloping on the ground, and there were also many experts who seemed to look like the martial artists of the mortal realm, tossing and turning, a funny sight to behold.
“It’s too unusual here.” Jiang Ming returned and asked again, “Brother Zhao, is there anything you can think of?”
“Legend has it that there is a core location within the Specter Secret Realm. This core does not appear every time the secret realm is opened, but once it does, there will definitely be a bloody killing spree, and the death rate will sky-rocket. In the core, the oppressive force is strong, and it is difficult for non-Cosmic Experts to cross the void. Even if the Cosmic Expert wants to pass through this space, he would need to spend at least 100 years to do so.” Zhao Changkong pondered, “It seems that based on the records, every time the core appears, there will inevitably be the emergence of a supreme great Dao vessel, either a set of top Cosmic Treasures, or a Supreme Treasure.”
“This should be the core of the Specter Secret Realm.” Zhao Changkong said with a wry smile. “Within the core, there are countless great opportunities that await. There will also be the emergence of many great treasures but accompanied with many great dangers. If a Star Sea Expert was to enter this place, his chance of survival is almost zero. Even a great number of the Cosmic Experts would die here. No, because the current surviving Cosmic Experts are all struck with terror from your killing spree, I’m afraid that they have long left the place.”
“If it is really the core of the secret realm, wouldn’t that mean that we’re getting rich?” Jiang Ming was very excited.
Luo Heng and Zhao Changkong looked at each other and smiled helplessly. They saw the core as a forbidden place. But in Jiang Ming’s eyes, it was a real treasure trove.
*Yin yin yin…*
A ringing chirp could be heard across the sky. A flying eagle could be seen soaring towards their direction. As its wings flapped, gusts of wind actually rolled up as it shot forwards at a terrifying speed. Its talons revealed, causing Zhao Changkong’s scalp to tingle in fear. “My speed is not as fast as this eagle in such a place.”
As Jiang Ming’s eyes narrowed, the head of the flying eagle suddenly exploded before dissipating in plain sight. A crystal of origin that was the size of a human being fell from above.
“Incredible!” Zhao Changkong opened his mouth, but all he managed to do was give Jiang Ming a thumbs up.
.
That flying eagle just now clearly had the strength of a Cosmic level. In addition, to be able to dominate the air in such a place, its strength was not of the ordinary.
Zhao Changkong didn’t even have the confidence to go against such a beast. However, Jiang Ming was able to easily take it down.
“Brother Jiang, when will I be able to be as powerful as you?” Luo Heng was jealous.
“It won’t be long.” As Jiang Ming replied to him, he kept the divine crystal into his inner world. He then extended his consciousness into the surroundings but could only cover a radius of ten thousand miles.
He couldn’t believe that his consciousness, which was of the Saint level, only managed to cover such a distance. He then merged his consciousness with the Chaos World Tree, and expanded the coverage to twenty thousand miles.
It was enough already.
After all, Zhao Changkong would’ve been able to only cover a hundred miles radius with his consciousness. Luo Heng on the other hand, even walking by foot was a great feat to him. He could only rely on his own eyes here.
“So many great treasures!” Jiang Ming was overwhelmed with joy.
He discovered quite a number of treasures through his Saint consciousness. Some of them were under the layers of soil beneath while some only had sharp corners protruding into the surface. There were even treasures that were hidden within the trees and the rocks. All of these treasures were “growing” at an extremely slow pace, reaching outwards.
As Jiang Ming stretched his hands and grabbed on, pieces of divine crystals as well as rare Cosmic level ores and wonders could be seen flying over towards them.
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng had long been numbed from such a scene. This was because Jiang Ming did the same thing in the past. Wherever he went, almost no stones were left unturned.
While Jiang Ming was collecting these items, he distributed some of them to the two from time to time. Most of these are of course Dao vessels.
They went about while taking frequent stops to collect treasures and continued their journey. Soon, they came across a valley in front of them. Waves of deafening roars that shook the sky could be heard from inside the valley.
“Brother Jiang, why do I get the feeling that something is wrong?” Zhao Changkong suddenly stopped. “I feel as though it was a dragon’s lair or a lion’s den in front of me. It seems that there are grave dangers ahead.”
“That’s because there’s a herd of cows hidden ahead.” Jiang Ming explained. “There’s a total of 360 cows, where 345 of them are of the Star Sea level, 15 Cosmic level and their Bull King is an existence equivalent to the pinnacle stage of the Cosmic level.”
“God damn it! Isn’t that terrifying?” Zhao Changkong was shocked.
Luo Heng was surprised again.
Jiang Ming nodded and said inexplicably, “Logically there should not be so many terrifying creatures gathered together. Under such a circumstance, even Long Jingang would not be able to return alive.”
“Perhaps this is the horror of the land of core.” Zhao Changkong said, “Also, perhaps there are treasures hidden inside.”
“There are treasures for sure. Let’s go and have a look.” Jiang Ming walked forward. “It’s just a herd of cows. However, it’s such a pity that they will dissipate after being killed. I wonder what they would taste like?”
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng were rendered speechless yet again.
“Actually, what piqued my curiosity even more is that such a terrifying existence that is at the pinnacle stage of the Cosmic level can be conjured here. This is unbelievable” Jiang Ming said again.
“This is a miracle of the universe.” Zhao Changkong lamented.
Jiang Ming was not the only one who was curious, but so were all the experts of the universe. The Specter Secret Realm was just too amazing. It was said to be conjured from the origin of the universe. However, there was never any evidence, but mere speculations.
As of now, it was impossible to determine whether such remarks were true.
Soon after, Jiang Ming had already reached the entrance of the valley. All of the bulls that were inside perched up and looked over at his direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - Pan Wang, the Strongest in
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Pan Wang, the Strongest in the Universe, The Fruit of Immortality, The Wings of Freedom
The monstrous-sized bulls were all black in color.
The moment they saw Jiang Ming, all of them lowered their heads, arched their front hooves slightly, pulled their back hooves to the ground, and proceeded to charge towards him.
Jiang Ming was not interested in dealing with the herd at all. He evoked his Saint Soul, sweeping directly across the herd.
In just a moment, all the bulls were slaughtered, including the one big black bull which had reached the pinnacle stage of the Cosmic level. Not even one of them was spared.
When the corpses dissipated, what was left was myriads of treasures scattered across the land.
“Brother Jiang! We’ve hit the jackpot!” Luo Heng couldn’t help but exclaim when he saw all the treasures that were bursting with brilliance, especially the many Divine vessels that made him feel extremely palpitated.
“Those swords seem to be a set.” Zhao Changkong was also extremely enthusiastic, but he had a strong will after all. He glanced at a few special long swords and pointed to them.
As Jiang Ming stretched out his hand, the swords were pulled directly in front of him.
These were nine long swords. Each one was a supreme Divine vessel, equivalent to a high-level Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel. What’s more, they were one whole set, which made them even more terrifying.
“Perhaps they can be used to form a sword formation. Its power will definitely be comparable to that of a Supreme Treasure!” Jiang Ming blurted out.
“Supreme Treasure?” Zhao Changkong had the urge to grin.
This Brother Jiang in front of him was in possession of too many great treasures. He already had two Supreme Treasures. If these nine swords could really form a sword formation, then it was definitely comparable to a Supreme Treasure! And that would mean Jiang Ming had three Supreme Treasures already.
‘God damn it! Why am I starting to feel jealous of him? No! I’m starting to have the urge to cut him down.’ Zhao Changkong took a deep breath, trying to suppress the many thoughts in his mind.
......
Jiang Ming put the nine swords away and threw one armor to Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng each, both of which were Cosmic level defensive divine vessels.
The two happily put the armours away.
Jiang Ming told them that finders got a share. They were embarrassed to take it at first but were now used to it already.
Finally, a golden key appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand. The moment he grabbed onto the golden key, a message appeared in his mind: Collecting all five golden keys will unlock and unearth the Supreme Treasure.
Good heavens! To think that there’s such a hidden secret. Jiang Ming was really taken aback.
“Brother Jiang, what’s wrong?” Luo Heng asked, “Is there something special about this key?”
“It looks like an ordinary key. However, for it to appear in such a place, it is definitely no ordinary key.” Zhao Changkong said.
“Collect all five keys, and the Supreme Treasure will be unearthed.” Jiang Ming didn’t hide from them at all.
“What?” Zhao Changkong was taken aback.
Luo Heng was also surprised.
Jiang Ming then threw the key over to Zhao Changkong. The moment Zhao Changkong caught the key, he received the same message as Jiang Ming did.
His face changed wildly at first, and finally said hesitantly, “Could it be that the Supreme Treasures that were unearthed in the past, were also under such circumstances? That should be it! Since the golden key is directly related to the Supreme Treasure, those who got a hold of golden keys in the past probably kept the news to themselves.”
“Come on! Let’s go and look for the other keys.” Jiang Ming was a little excited.
“Alright!” Zhao Changkong was also in high spirits, and said at the same time, “Brother Jiang, how about I upload this news to our Human Race Knowledge Hall after this event? Only the Cosmic Experts can view this information.”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming nodded.
“Thank you!”
“Brother Zhao, you’re being too polite.”
Jiang Ming started to feel that they were moving too slowly and decided to directly fly them over.
As he flew through the lands, he didn’t stop his hauls of various rare treasures. Of course, he discovered some of the foreign clans’ experts that were hunted down by the ferocious beasts. Some of them managed to escape the beast but ended up being killed by Jiang Ming instead.
He felt sorry for himself if he didn’t cut down these experts of foreign clans whenever he discovered them.
“Brother Luo, here!” Jiang Ming threw over a fruit he just obtained. “It should be able to improve the level of your genetics.”
“This is the Fruit of the Thousand Flowers of Life. With Brother Luo’s current strength and level of genetics, it should be able to improve his fundamental genes by a thousand times. It is a rare treasure of the universe.” Zhao Changkong took a glance at it and told them its origin.
“Alright! I’ll be helping myself.” Luo Heng caught the fruit. He had eaten various good things along the journey. Before he knew it, his strength had already increased by several folds.
This fruit was useless to Jiang Ming and Zhao Changkong. Luo Heng also knew that he couldn’t participate in the battle. As such, he directly ate the fruit and quickly refined it, in order to improve his strength.
After quite some time, Jiang Ming managed to discover a litter of Three-headed Golden Lions, many of which were terrifying beings that were of the pinnacle stage of Cosmic level. However, none of them were able to withstand his sharp edges.
After slaughtering them, in addition to the many other treasures, there was a divine vessel at the pinnacle stage of the cosmic level. It was a pair of wings called the Wings of Freedom. Once it was refined and evoked, the person would possess invincible speed.
When the pair of wings are placed together, it could even form a defensive barrier that even had attacking means at the same time. It was truly a supreme treasure among the rest.
Of course, there was also a Golden Key among the haul of treasures.
The third key was from destroying a group of Rock Giants. Jiang Ming also got a hold of nine God Sealing Tablets, where each of which was comparable to that of a high-level Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel. When placed inside oneself as suppression, not only did they form an invincible defensive barrier, but it also enhanced the individual’s strength. Such capability that could suppress a Cosmic Expert was truly terrifying.
In a vast lake over at the northern area, Jiang Ming annihilated a group of plant life. Its vines were akin to slithering snakes, where the giant trees covered the blue sky. This was considered one of the most difficult groups to kill, yet it didn’t stop Jiang Ming at his feet.
This time, Jiang Ming acquired a special fruit apart from the normal treasures and the Golden Key.
“This is the legendary Fruit of Immortality.” As Zhao Changkong looked at the golden fruit in Jiang Ming’s hand, his face changed wildly. He couldn’t help himself from becoming agitated as he continued, “This is a legendary item! To think that it actually exists here.”
“You know of this fruit?” Jiang Ming asked.
The fruit wasn’t huge and looked like a golden apple. However, the 3,000 scriptures imprinted on its surface contained a terrifying aura of life as well as the incomparable mysterious power that even brought shivers down his spine.
“Yes!” Zhao Changkong nodded, as his eyes looked as frenzy as ever. “The physique and bloodline of our Human Race are the weakest among all races. If it weren’t for our strong comprehensive capability to be able to understand the supreme laws, and the capability of tempering various magical weapons and technologies, we wouldn’t even stand any chance among the many races of the universe.”
“Among the same level, our human genetics level is far below the average. However, Pan Wang is able to overwhelm the infinite clans and emerge as the strongest in the universe by merely relying on his physique, becoming the crème de la crème. He once said that while he was venturing through the Chaos when he was at Cosmic level, he obtained the Fruit of Immortality by chance. It allowed his genetics to undergo great evolutions, causing his physiques to become incomparably strong with immortal characteristics. It also sky-rocketed his survivability as well. Such improvements laid the foundation towards his unparalleled strength. His cultivation improved by leaps and bounds upon entering the Supreme level. Later on, he obtained other great encounters and is finally ranked as the strongest of the universe.”
“He had described and recorded the details on the Fruit of Immortality. Although our Human Race has been secretly searching through the universe, we never ever discovered the fruit.”
“It’s gold in color, looks like an apple, and has 3000 scriptures imprinted on its surface”
“This fruit is exactly as described. In addition to the fact that this fruit appeared in such a place, this is no doubt the Fruit of Immortality. Only here, the origin of the universe, can such a treasured item be bred and nurtured.”
Zhao Changkong spoke with great excitement.
“This fruit so miraculous?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
.
Pan Wang could be this strong just because of such a fruit? Jiang Ming believed that the reason why Pan Wang could be such a very powerful being, was definitely not solely because of the Fruit of Immortality.
“It should be true. After all, it was Pan Wang who said so.” Zhao Changkong remarked.
“I’ll have a good taste of it later on.” Jiang Ming kept the fruit and didn’t share it with the other two as there was only one such fruit after all.
They didn’t stop in their tracks and continued in search of the fifth Golden Key.
This time, it was a group of big-eyed monsters, where each of them had unparalleled spiritual power. One of them was especially powerful to the point that it had grown to the pinnacle stage of the Cosmic level. Its spiritual attacks were comparable to that of Cai Die of the Zergs.
However, the monsters ended up all dead.
Jiang Ming without a doubt, obtained the fifth key. He even obtained a palace-type Cosmic level Divine Vessel, the Stellar Palace.
Jiang Ming didn’t even bother with this Divine vessel. Instead, he took out the other four Golden Keys and placed them together.
“Will a Supreme Treasure really unearth itself?”
Even Jiang Ming couldn’t hold back his excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - The Unearthed Congenital Supreme Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: The Unearthed Congenital Supreme Treasure
Translation
As the five keys were gathered, they quickly merged into one and then turned into a stream of light, flying into the distance.
“It’s not here?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
He thought that after the activation, the Supreme Treasure would unearth right in front of him. Never did he think that it would be totally different.
As Jiang Ming reached out his hands and grabbed mid-air, Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng involuntarily followed him, dashing through the air. Before they could even catch up to the stream of light, they saw the light streak landed on top of a 1,000-meter high mountain, penetrated the mountain, and disappeared out of sight.
Immediately afterwards, the mountain peak trembled. A divine light could be seen at the top of the peak rushing straight up into the sky and exploded. The aura of Supreme Treasure instantly filled up the whole realm with its vast suppressive force.
It didn’t matter if the experts had just arrived at the scene or were around the place all along. All of them were startled as they looked towards the mountain peak. Their shock quickly turned into ecstasy.
“This is the aura of a Supreme Treasure! It can’t be wrong! There’s no doubt about it!”
“My God! A Supreme Treasure is actually unearthed! Hurry up! Let’s go”
“Hopefully Jiang Ming of the Human race isn’t there. If he is, we will end up with misery. Not only will we not reap any benefit from the emergence of the Supreme Treasure, we might even end up dead here!”
“That beast! No! He’s much worse than a beast. Hurry! Hurry! Run!”
Some of the experts started to flee in a hurry. However, they were very slow.
Jiang Ming had already landed on the mountain top.
A ray of golden luminance could be seen right at the very top of the mountain. There was a silhouette within the golden luminance that couldn’t be seen clearly.
......
Jiang Ming reached out and tried to grab the golden luminance but was instead blocked by it.
“This is because the Supreme Treasure has yet to be fully unearthed.” Zhao Changkong explained, “Brother Jiang, items that are generally in a semi-unearthed state in the Specter Secret Realm cannot be obtained by force.”
As he explained, he couldn’t help but smile bitterly as he recalled Jiang Ming’s rampant and domineering ways throughout the journey. It didn’t matter if the item had been unearthed or not. All of them were forcefully acquired by him, which really went against common sense.
“You can have a go at it again. If it doesn’t work, then this is probably the specialty of a Supreme Treasure.” Zhao Changkong continued.
Jiang Ming nodded his head.
As he pointed his finger, he evoked the Return of Infinite Law technique, converging three thousand great Daos into one. Although the overall structure of the technique was still quite unpolished, its offensive power was absolutely terrifying. Yet it failed to affect the Supreme Treasure in the slightest.
He also tried attacking with his Saint Soul but the result was the same.
“Big brother, why bother with this?” Jiang Ming raised his head and clasped his hands towards the sky, “Since this is something you are giving me, is there a need for such a test?”
Jiang Ming received no response, and felt slightly embarrassed.
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng, on the other hand, were confused by his actions.
“Big brother, are you sure you don’t want to give me your response?” Jiang Ming rubbed his hands, and a root of the Chaos World Tree appeared in his palm.
This root of the Chaos World Tree was obviously different when compared with its previous state.
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng were both puzzled. They had no idea what Jiang Ming intended to do. They wondered whether Jiang Ming was threatening the Specter Secret Realm. Could it be that the Specter Secret Realm had a master? But wasn’t this just pulling on people’s legs?
However, what happened next really caused their expression to change wildly as the golden luminance disappeared.
The golden luminance disappeared, just like that. A small needle tip suddenly flew out of the luminance and landed in front of Jiang Ming.
This was a single needle. A gray needle. It looked somewhat unreal as if it was existing in between the rift of reality and illusionary, giving off a sense of unreality.
When Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng looked at the needle, both of them gasped, and they couldn’t help but tremble.
With a confused face, they looked at Jiang Ming, the divine needle and then looked up into the sky again. They didn’t know what was happening.
Jiang Ming on the other hand, had overwhelming joy on his face. As he kept the divine needle into the Human Path Record, he looked up into the sky and smiled: “Big brother! You’re still the generous one!”
“I recognise you as my big brother!”
“This vast space doesn’t seem useful to you. How about giving it to your younger brother?”
Jiang Ming asked shamelessly.
*Clank…*
A black thunder that contained the power to destroy a whole world streaked across the top of his head.
Jiang Ming’s heart trembled.
The power of that thunder strike was a thousand times stronger than that Return of Infinite Law technique that he just evoked. It had the power to kill him.
“Big brother! You’re quite stingy!” Jiang Ming smiled.
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng’s faces were further darkened.
The Specter Secret Realm had a master? Or did the universe give birth to its own will? They knew it was still a shocking event no matter what the situation was.
“Brother... Brother Jiang…” Zhao Changkong transmitted his thoughts telepathically with a trembling voice, “What’s going on here?”
“I don’t know either!” Jiang Ming hesitated a little and continued, “But…”
He pointed above his head into the sky. “This realm should have a master. I’m not sure, but since it bears no hostility to us, that’s enough.”
“That’s enough! Yes, that’s enough!” Zhao Changkong felt chills down his spine.
It would be alright if the Specter Secret Realm had a master. The master would be just a peerless expert of unimaginable power, after all. Nevertheless, if the origin of the universe was to have a consciousness, then he didn’t dare to imagine, and didn’t want to imagine…
Jiang Ming turned around and looked into the distance. He couldn’t help laughing. “Brother Zhao, the foreign clans are here. I will take the two of you to the bottom of the mountain first and then I’ll go on another wave of killing spree.”
“You still want to go on a killing spree?” Zhao Changkong grinned.
“Go for it!” said Luo Heng who was already numb from seeing Jiang Ming’s actions. He pitifully said, “However, you need to help with the troubles outside the secret realm later on. Otherwise, I’m too weak to handle them.”
“Relax!” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “Those are not foreign clans, but wealth! Endless wealth!”
Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng were speechless yet again. However, they knew that the two of them were not of such a level at all. They should just listen on and then follow the arrangement of fate, or rather, the arrangement of Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming brought the two of them to the foot of the mountain, placed them in a remote location and sped off into the air.
“The foreign clans are really unlucky!” Luo Heng smiled as he continued, “This time, Jiang Ming is really going to slaughter them until chills run down their spines. Alas the infinite races of the universe. With them being killed here, the strength of all these factions they originate from, will be greatly reduced.”
Zhao Changkong shook his head and said worriedly, “It won’t work. As long as their Supreme Experts are still alive, the death toll of each clan has little impact towards the overall situation. Instead, it will have an adverse effect, and will only lead to the hostility of all clans towards the Human Race. Or rather…”
His expression was solemn, with a hint of bitterness. “These thousands of clans will form an alliance and besiege the Human Race. If that situation were to happen, what can we do? Even Pan Wang won’t be able to deter such a situation. After all, Pan Wang wouldn’t be able to stand against the alliance which has united many powerful Supreme Experts from different clans.”
Luo Heng’s heart sank. He had already thought of this. However, he had confidence in Jiang Ming. Since Jiang Ming has promised to solve the problem, Luo Heng believed that he definitely would be able to do it.
“Brother Jiang should have the means to solve this. No, he surely has the means to do so.” Luo Heng said, “Brother Jiang managed to advance into the Supreme level in such a short period of time. Also, don’t forget…”
He then pointed to the top of his head.
.
Zhao Changkong was shocked.
In the distance, Jiang Ming had started his hunting trip once again. Every one of them here were treasure troves to him.
Experts with a cultivation base of at least Star Sea level would already have countless great wealth with them already. Coupled with the benefits that they reaped from the Specter Secret Realm here, they were all fat pigs ready to be slaughtered.
Moreover, since he was killing foreign clans, he felt no burden in his heart at all.
“The number of experts gathered here is quite a lot.”
As Jiang Ming scanned through the surroundings, he was greatly delighted. There were just so many great treasures that he had plundered. Even the corpses of these experts Jiang Ming hadcollected and incorporated into his inner world as nutrients.
These were, after all, beasts.
As he turned around and looked in the direction of Luo Heng and Zhao Changkong, he left a clone of himself, and his figure quickly disappeared.
Jiang Ming headed into the Supreme Pagoda and was ready to settle himself down from the plunder.
There was still a great battle that awaits him in the outside world!

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - The Exponential Increment of Power, The Change of Group Admin, Taixu God Slaying Needle
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: The Exponential Increment of Power, The Change of Group Admin, Taixu God Slaying Needle
In the unique cultivation zone exclusively for Jiang Ming in the Supreme Pagoda. Jiang Ming had appeared on the altar. He could cultivate for as long as he wished because of the almost unmoving time.
Jiang Ming was making an inventory of his plunder. He had got almost a thousand pieces of Quasi-Sage Vessels, many pieces of Demi-Sage Vessels, and a few pieces of Supreme Vessels.
The Supreme Vessels that Jiang Ming had were the Blood Banner, Zhentian Tower, and the Taixu God Slaying Needle that he had just obtained. He also had a set of high-graded Dao vessels, the nine Universe Swords, which could be equivalent to a Saint Weapon if they were arranged into a formation.
Who would believe that Jiang Ming had got himself so many items?
He had even more other items, so much that they had been piled up into the size of planets.
Jiang Ming transferred all divine crystals, and energy crystals into his inner world for absorption and improvement of its origin. He also had transferred various spiritual objects, and spiritual plants into his inner world.
After the stock count, Jiang Ming took out the Fruit of Immortality. According to Zhao Changkong, it was a type of rare fruit that had built the strongest foundation of Pan Wang.
Jiang Ming gobbled the fruit up without any hesitation. The next moment, a glob of golden luminance was radiated out of Jiang Ming, merged into his bone marrow and bloodline. It also evoked the power of 3,000 orders, and even got some power of the origin of his inner world to fuse in.
His physique that had been strong, actually evoked the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra to revolve on its own in restructuring and transforming his physique to an even stronger one at this moment.
The majestic waves of aura swept through the cultivation space. In fact, the aura was capable of sweeping through numerous galaxies if Jiang Ming was to consume the fruit outside.
Such a reaction lasted a long time, before waves of aura gradually dissipated.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet. As he clenched a fist, a little black hole appeared on his palm.
“This’s strong!” Jiang Ming was shocked.
He felt that it was unbelievable to realize that his current physique had gotten at least 10 times stronger than before.
“It’s indeed the top rare item of the universe.” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
PLease reading on Mybo x no v el. com
He became more interested in the universe. He wanted to travel the universe and the Star Sea to scrape as many treasures as possible. After all, there were too many foreign clans and good stuff. He also wanted to travel around the Chaos.
After slightly settling down, Jiang Ming began to refine the Zhentian Tower, Universe Sword and the Taixu God Slaying Needles. He had also refined many Demi-Sage Weapons and Quasi-Sage Weapons just in case.
Beside, he also went on comprehending the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique and the Infinite Transcendence Technique, as well as deducing many other special abilities.
Jiang Ming didn’t pay much attention to his inner world, but it was digesting the items given to expand its space, and improve its core at a fast rate.
Sometimes, Jiang Ming even slumbered for thousands of years.
The time was passing by quickly. In just a short while, 100 years, 1,000 years, and even 10,000 years had passed by.
Jiang Ming’s aura had been growing stronger too.
On this day, he stood up and stretched. His aura had however, become rather icy and indifferent. His cultivation had been too long.
He looked at the Battle Tower and the Heavenly Ladder exclusively for him, and vanished into thin air. By the time he reappeared, he had got to the public square of the Supreme Pagoda.
Ye Qingxian was still seen reading in a corner. It was how she would spend her leisure time.
She seemed to have sensed something. She lifted her head to see Jiang Ming who had got in front of her. Hence, she couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Brother Jiang, why are you here again soon after your last visit? Hold on, there’s something wrong with your aura.”
“I’ve gone into a seclusion for too long!” Jiang Ming sat opposite Ye Qingxian.
“Seclusion?” Ye Qingxian was confused.
“I’ve improved further.” Jiang Ming didn’t explain in detail. But he called out the Supreme Order, and a message after another flew into his mind.
Ye Qingxian took out the Supreme Order too. After a while, she said with surprise, “Brother Jiang, how is it possible that you’ve lost the position as a Group Admin? Have you advanced into the Great Overarching Realm? But you should have left here if you were. What’s going on actually?”
“My situation is special!” Jiang Ming laughed.
The time of the unique cultivation zone, which Jiang Ming was cultivating in the unique cultivation zone, passed by very slowly although it wasn’t stopped completely.
Hence, Jiang Ming got the updates of the Chat Room only after he had got to the public square.
In the Chat room.
[Ao Jiu: What the f*ck, why is our Group Admin changed? Hong Zhan, my boss, you’re now the Group Admin for the second time!”
[Dongfang Chenxi: What’s happening? Brother Jiang Ming, why did you lose the position as the Group Admin? I can’t believe it. After all, your achievement is far better than any one of us!]
[Di Huo: Something is indeed not right. Jiang Ming’s achievement is still the highest. The fact that he’s still in the group has shown that he has yet to break through to the Great Overarching Realm. But he’s lost the position as the Group Admin.]
[Hong YI: Why has our Group Admin become Hong Zhan again? Jiang Ming, Hong Zhan, explain yourself.]
[Luo Heng: Brother Jiang, what’s happening?]
Feng Wu, Ming Fei, and the others had also voiced out. But they were sure that Jiang Ming must have done something.
[Jiang Ming: I’ve received some special rewards after I passed the Battle Towers and made it to the step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder. Because I’ve just advanced into the Great Overarching Realm, my position is taken away based on the rules. It’s considered a privilege that I’m still allowed to be in the group!]
[Hong Zhan: F*ck, you actually passed the Battle Towers and made it to step 64 of the Heavenly Ladder? F*ck, f*ck, f*ck, brother Jiang, you’re f*cking amazing. Even today I’m still stuck at the level 5 of the seventh Battle Tower, and the step 61 of the Heavenly Ladder. Hold on, step 64 of the Heavenly ladder is corresponding to the Saint Soul, isn’t it? By the way, since you have advanced to the Great Overarching Realm, does it also mean that your inner world has evolved to the level of middle chiliocosm?]
[Hong Yi: I think so. Brother Jiang, this is amazing, and you have my respect!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: This is so great to know that your inner world has evolved. You’re indeed my big brother, my idol, and my aim.]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha, I respect you. You’re indeed amazing!]
[Feng Wu: The World Dao is known as the hardest cultivating method. But why do I think it’s a piece of cake for brother Jiang? I’ve just heard of brother Jiang’s inner world transforming to the small chiliocosm not long ago, and it’s now the middle chiliocosm. T-t-this is utterly a miracle!]
[Ming Fei: I think that brother Jiang is the son of great Dao.]
[Huang Quan: Agree. If he’s not, how can he be so terrific? By the way, brother Jiang, what are the benefits of passing the Battle Towers?]
The Chat Room had become quiet. Everyone was curious. Although they had heard some hearsays, they weren’t as reliable as the first hand message they could get from Jiang Ming, who had just experienced it himself.
[Jiang Ming: It’s greatly beneficial. Hence, just work hard because the world is too vast!]
[Hong Yi: Understood. Thanks!]
[Hong Zhan: Alas, the world is too vast! Brother Jiang, we’ll definitely meet one day. Because I’m currently the Group Admin, and the accumulation of millions of points, I can go to that place now. Then, I’ll certainly be capable of passing the Battle Towers and even make it to step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder.]
[Hong Yi: Are the benefits of becoming the Group Admin this great? I still couldn’t help but ask.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Hong, you can wait patiently for some time. Because I won’t stay in this position for a long time. Take the opportunity to accumulate more so that you won’t be defeated by other latecomers. Damn it, I realize that since brother Jiang has been joining us, we can plot for the position as the Group Admin one after another. Moreover, with enough points, we can all obtain that sky-defying encounter.]
[Hong Zhan: You’re our lucky star.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, I’ve decided to call you my big brother when we meet in the future.]
[Di Huo: Is this still the arrogant Hong Zhan that I’ve known?]
[Ao Jiu: Am I blind?]
[Feng Wu: This is trying to take advantage of brother Jiang, isn’t it?]
[Hong Zhan: It’s not shameful to take advantage from someone like brother Jiang.]
.
[Jiang Ming: Being taken advantage of by a man? I shiver with goosebumps all over my skin.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: hehe…]
[Feng Wu: Haha…]
After they chatted for a while, Jiang Ming withdrew his consciousness.
Ye Qingxian looked at Jiang Ming with a sophisticated feeling. But she still clasped her hands. “Congratulations to you, brother Jiang!”
“Try to compete for the position as a Group Admin.” Jiang Ming reminded her.
“Surely I will!” Ye Qingxian smiled. She finally learned about the indifferent aura of Jiang Ming. It was because the time Jiang Ming had been cultivating was too long.
After the two chatted for a while, Jiang Ming left.
Jiang Ming first returned to the Chuyang Peak to cook himself a meal. Then, he hugged and hit on his Junior Sister for a while before he rubbed his waist and returned to the Specter Secret Realm, preparing for his next step.
‘It’s time to solve the issues here. I wonder if I can kill those Supreme Experts. Alas, to fight against the universe alone, why do I feel so excited?’

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Ye Hao, Jiu Yuan, the Supreme Experts Courting Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Ye Hao, Jiu Yuan, the Supreme Experts Courting Death
??
Jiang Ming found Zhao Changkong and Luo Heng.
Luo Heng looked at Jiang Ming with surprise, but he didn’t ask anything. After all, there was an outsider around.
“I’ve prepared to leave this Specter Secret Realm.” Jiang Ming shared his plan. “I’ve slaughtered too many here. If I was not out, I’m afraid that the Supreme Experts waiting outside would shift their target to our Human Race. Instead of being passive, it’s much better to take the initiative to attack and kill all of them.”
“No way.” Zhao Changkong immediately objected. “Based on the news that I’ve got, there are about eight Supreme Experts out there now, including Long Qian. If you were to go out, you’d definitely be besieged. How can you resist by then? You’re greatly potential, and it’s time for you to improve yourself as soon as possible. Why don’t you cultivate here for a thousand years first? By that time, Pan Wang may have returned from the Chaos, and we’ll have a better winning rate.”
“Brother Jiang, just wait for a little longer!” Luo Heng knew that the inner world of Jiang Ming had evolved to the middle chiliocosm level but he was still worried for Jiang Ming’s safety. After all, there were too many Supreme Experts out there. If there were Supreme Experts who had yet to show up, there would be more than 10 of them. To fight against more than 10 Supreme Experts was something terrifying even by just thinking about it.
“No worries.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Since I dare to go out, I’ve a certain degree of certainty. They are just a few Supreme Experts after all.”
Zhao Changkong was rendered speechless, while Luo Heng almost rolled his eyes. The two were helpless, and they couldn’t stop Jiang Ming either.
However, they didn’t go out of the secret realm, but requested that Jiang Ming take them to another space. After all, Jiang Ming had scraped almost all things in this space. Moreover, because of the huge area, it would take years to get out of it. In addition, If they were to be besieged by Cosmic Experts of foreign clans, it would be difficult for them to escape too.
Jiang Ming had no comment. He brought the two out of the core. Based on the function of the Human Path Record, he directly locked his target at Hong Ying. He took them to her by just going past a few spaces.
“Take care!” After Jiang Ming said, he went up to the sky, and was repelled out.
It was the way to exit.
On the ground, Hong Ying was still dumbfounded. “Brother Jiang leaves just like that? He left immediately after he got here, I wonder if he’s afraid of me disturbing him? If this is the case, brother Jiang is too narcissistic. Women are better, aren’t they? Why should I like a smelly man?”
Luo Heng frowned.
Zhao Changkong smirked. “Sister Hong Ying, brother Jiang leaves here to fight against the Supreme Experts of the foreign clans out there.”
“Fight against the Supreme Experts of the foreign clans?” Hong Ying screamed, “Zhao Changkong, this joke is not funny!”
PLease reading on Myb ox no ve l. com
“I myself hope that this is a joke too. But this is real. You’ve also seen for yourself that brother Jiang has left.” Zhao Changkong sighed, “You should have heard that brother Jiang has been massacring experts of other clans overwhelmingly, haven’t you? There are at least 100 Cosmic Experts he has killed.”
“I know that brother Jiang has advanced into the Supreme level but there are not just one or two Supreme Experts of the other clans out there. How can he fight against them while he has just had a breakthrough?” Hong Ying stretched her neck, and said, “Has he gone nuts?”
Zhao Changkong smiled helplessly.
“The number of the foreign clans’ experts he has killed sends chills down their spines. However, since he’s just got a breakthrough, he should stay here and settle down with the resources provided here. Then, it’s still not too late for him to annihilate thousands of clans of the universe, isn’t it?” Hong Ying added, “Does he think he can overwhelm the Supreme Experts just like he did to the Cosmic Experts?”
“We can just wait for the updates about him now.” Zhao Changkong said in a low tone.
New novels chapters are published ᴏn !
“Yea, that’s the only thing we can do.” Hong Ying nodded helplessly.
Luo Heng looked into the sky. He felt feeble. Just like Jiang Ming, he had received the inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda. But he was far weaker than Jiang Ming.
At the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm.
Jiang Ming appeared on top of it with a flash. And his appearance instantly received attention.
“Jiang Ming, why’re you out now. Quickly go back in because there are too many enemies here.” Jiang Ming had just glanced around when a voice filled with worries and urge, was sent telepathically to him.
“Jiang Ming, quickly go back into the Specter Secret Realm.” Another voice was sent to him.
Jiang Ming smiled, and felt comforted. He knew that they were the two Supreme Experts of the Human Race. They were Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan. The third one was Pan Wang, who was still in the Chaos.
As Jiang Ming’s figure fluttered, he left the Specter Secret Realm, and stopped somewhere millions of miles away in just a while.
Meanwhile, he had been targeted by a few qi. But none of them came besieging Jiang Ming immediately. Because they believed that it was almost impossible for Jiang Ming to escape as he was being targeted by so many experts.
“Brother Jiang. ” Ye Hao got to Jiang Ming in a stream of light. A wry smile flashed through his fortitudinous face as he said, “I think you should have learned about the situation here, right?”
“He should have known.” Jiu Yuan came over too. His face looked icy. “Jiang Ming, have you ever thought of the consequences of massacring the experts of thousands of foreign clans in the Specter Secret Realm?”
“I’d just have to kill again.” Jiang Ming clasped his hands at Ye Hao before he turned to Jiu Yuan, and promised, “Don’t worry, I’ll solve the troubles that I’ve caused myself.”
“How can you solve them?” Jiu Yuan was trying to suppress his anger. “There are already about 10 Supreme Experts in the surroundings. Sigh, what’s been done can’t be undone. Jiang Ming, Mr Ye and I will be defending you so that you can return to the territory of our Human Race. Do try to stay safe, and we’ll see what to do next.”
Jiu Yuan had prepared for the worst.
“Just go, Jiu Yuan and I will be backing you from here.” Ye Hao also said, “If we were to do our best, we can at least kill two Supreme Experts by committing suicide. This will make them a little bit more afraid, dare not be too presumptuous, and buy you more time. Provided you survive, you will be able to do something greater in the near future while waiting for the return of Pan Wang.”
“You two aren’t believing in me, are you?” Jiang Ming said helplessly.
“How can we believe in you when you have just advanced into the Supreme level?” Jiu Yuan said annoyingly. “For the sake of the current condition, our Human Race, and the continuity of our bloodline, please stay alive regardless of which universe in the Chaos you are from.”
“Let me solve the issue I’ve caused myself!” The Zhentian Tower appeared atop Jiang Ming, which was radiating rays of lights, shouldering him in the center. “Since I’ve massacred thousands of clans, I’m certain that I can fight against the universe alone. Just witness it on your own later!”
“Fighting against the universe alone?” Long Qian took the lead to pace over. He stopped somewhere 10,000 miles away from the three.
Ten thousand miles away was considered very close. The pair of his golden eyes, was shooting out ruthless luminances. Particularly when he saw the Zhentian Tower, his killing intention burst out trembling the starry sky, and even causing the stars in the distance to explode.
“Fighting against the universe alone is such an arrogant proclamation that even Pan Wang dare not say himself.” Long Jian’s killing intention had formed a one billion-feet tall dragon-shaped illusion above his head. It was roaring and overlooking the universe.
“There’s such a brat in the Human Race who’s more arrogant than Pan Wang. Can it be that this brat is courting death?”
Those Supreme Experts who planned to be the onlookers first, couldn’t hold back from stepping forward one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - A Finger Piercing through the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: A Finger Piercing through the Universe
The strength of a Supreme Expert was completely beyond logic. By just releasing his aura, he was capable of collapsing void, confining a large area, solidifying laws, and even revealing chains of orders, which might have cracked.
A Supreme Expert was extraordinarily terrifying.
Some Star Sea Experts, which were equivalent to the Great Overarching Golden Realm, who had just rushed over, and stayed not far away, exploded and died tragically on the spot under the effects of Supreme Experts’ aura.
The few Cosmic Experts who wished to be the onlookers were so terrified at the ordeal that they tore spaces and eluded. It was simply too terrifying for them.
“Long Qian, your Demon Clan should be annihilated indeed!” Jiang Ming didn’t even care about the ordeal, and lamented.
“Why do you say so?” Long Qian was not in a rush. After all, he believed that Jiang Ming would die for sure. Even Ye Wu and Jiu Yuan could not stay out of the ordeal.
It was because he believed that the other Supreme Experts would join forces to kill the Supreme Experts of the Human Race if he was to raise the suggestion. It would be an unprecedented scene because it was difficult for them to meet, let alone join forces. Moreover, many of the Supreme Experts didn’t wish to provoke the Human Clan too.
The situation, however, had changed. It was because of Jiang Ming, this little fella, who was trying to court death by hunting down Star Sea Experts and Cosmic Experts of thousands of clans. Therefore, Jiang Ming’s actions had enraged many Supreme Experts, and naturally united them to take revenge.
“When I killed a Star Field demon of your Demon Clan, a Star Sea Demon showed up. After I killed him, another two Cosmic levels appeared. When they were dead as well, your son Long Jingang turned up. I couldn’t kill him in the first battle, but I later managed to kill him in the Specter Secret Realm.” Jiang Ming smirked, “Long Qian, based on the pattern that a stronger one appeared after a weaker one was killed, and an older one appeared after the younger was killed, as well as the fact that whoever turns up is killed, who would die if it’s not you?”
Jiang Ming’s speculation had caused the experts in the surrounding to chuckle. It was indeed logical.
“Do you think that you’ll still win this time?” Long Qian was not annoyed. “You’ll lose all things if you are defeated only this one time. Not only you’ll die, Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan will be implicated as well. In fact, your entire Human Race will become extinct just because of your defeat.”
“The Human Race is the Lord of infinite realms. Do you think you can wipe us all out?” Jiang Ming sneered. “In contrast, your Dragon Clan can only become a dish on the table whenever you are.”
“A dish on the table?” Long Qian shook his head as the intimidating luminance gleamed on his eyes. “Because of your words, I’ll annihilate your Human Race. No, I shall put you humans in captivity to become our food instead.”
......
“Very well!” Jiang Ming nodded. He didn’t dwell on the topic further. He took a glance around and turned to other Supreme Experts. “Are you all here to kill me as well?”
“Of course!” Huang Tian, a Star Beast Supreme Expert with a pair of golden horns said, “You’ve killed five Cosmic Experts of my Star Beast Clan. Alas, it’s a total of five, without even adding the total death of the Star Sea Experts. Unlike your Human Race, it’s a billion times more difficult for us to give birth to a new life, and it’s even more difficult to grow up to the Cosmic level. However, you’ve killed almost all of the high ranking members in the Specter Secret Realm. Hence, do you think I should kill you?”
Jiang Ming nodded. “But you were the one who attacked and forced me into the Specter Secret Realm earlier, weren’t you?”
“Yes, it was me.” Huang Tian confessed.
“That’s why it’s right and proper that I kill the members of your clan!”
“Haha, what a right and proper! Long Qian, shall we join forces and annihilate the Human Race?” Huang Qian turned to Long Qian.
“Sure!” Long Qian accepted the offer.
“Jian Ming has almost slaughtered all of my clan’s experts in the Specter Secret Realm. Therefore, my Machine Clan and the Human Race are irreconcilable. Count me in to annihilate the Human Race!”
“Count my Zergs in as well!”
“We Pantheons are supposed to stay away from all conflicts but Jiang Ming has been too ruthless, massacring almost all of my experts. Pan Wang did it once, and now Jiang Ming. Who knows whether there’d be another expert of the Human Race rising up, and be the other bane to us. Hence, it’s better to prevent it from its root, wiping out the Human Race once and for all!”
“Haha, to annihilate the Human Race, my Angel Clan is joining too!”
“Titan Clan is joining!”
“Dark Spirits is joining!”
“Spiritual Plant Clan is joining!”
A Supreme Expert came forward one after another. Some even came out from behind the scene. Other than Long Qian, there was another Supreme Expert from the Demon Clan, who showed up too.
In just a short while, a total of 16 Supreme Experts had surrounded Jiang Ming, Ye Hao, and Jiu Yuan. The number actually comprised half of the total Supreme Experts available in the entire universe.
Alas, to think that half of the total Supreme Experts were besieging Jiang Ming and the other two.
Ye Hao, and Jiu Yuan opened their mouths, but they were unable to utter even a single word. After all, there wasn’t anything that they could say other than fighting with their best.
When they were prepared to step forward, they were stopped by Jiang Ming.
“I’ve said that I’m going to solve the troubles that I’ve caused on my own.” As he said, he glanced at the group of Supreme Experts. He had no single hint of fear but his fighting spirit surged to the stage that it could sway the Star River.
“Are you coming together or one by one?” Jiang Ming said while emitting an intimidating and domineering aura. He was oppressive and confident while confronting the Supreme Experts of the entire universe.
“You’re courageous indeed!” Long Qian complimented. “You’ve been too arrogant to think that you are capable of resisting us altogether. Killing my son is akin to you wasting my years of efforts, cutting off my emotional sustenance and hope. So, let me end your life, and then slaughter every single human expert of level Star Field and above in the universe.”
“Alright, c’mon.” Jiang Ming struck directly.
As Jiang Ming paced through the void, he pointed out, casting the Return of Infinite Law Technique. His finger condensed a supreme power of penetration, gathered 3,000 Great Overarching Laws, and reached an unprecedented degree with the support of the origin of his inner world.
In the numerous years of Jiang Ming slumbering in the unique cultivation zone of the Supreme Pagoda, the origin of his inner world had been improving greatly, which in turn promoted the birth of laws.
All 3,000 laws were produced.
Although Jiang Ming’s middle chiliocosm had yet to reach its pinnacle stage, it was not far from it since Jiang Ming had fed it with a tremendous amount of resources. And this was one of the main reasons that Jiang Ming was confident in himself.
The finger, which was evoked by the origin of the inner world akin to the power of Saint. It was integrated with 3,000 Great Overarching Laws, and was so dreadful that its power was up the limit of imagination.
“Myriad True Dragon Silhouette!” Long Qian felt heart-throbbing while confronting the finger. Hence, he didn’t confront it directly but with a flutter, he formed a myriad of silhouettes, densely covering the void.
Long Qian thought with every silhouette having its own aura, he would avoid being locked as a target. However, he had belittled this finger of Jiang Ming.
Pff…The myriad silhouettes had disappeared as the finger of Jiang Mig pierced through the defensive armor of Long Qian. Although the armor wasn’t the Supreme Treasure, it was a divine vessel of the Cosmic level. Yet, the finger penetrated the armor, and Long Qian’s shoulder. It didn’t stop there. It also pierced through the void, traversed to the edge of the universe, pierced through its membrane and into the Chaos.
A finger piercing through the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - The Merging of Saint Province and the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: The Merging of Saint Province and the World Translation
The might of this finger had surprised all the Supreme Experts who were present. It was simply too strong that it traversed the universe, and pierced through it.
Long Qian, on the other hand, had its shoulder exploded, his arm shattered, and half of his face disappeared. He himself was flown out a million meters away.
“Die!” As Jiang Ming focused, a Taixu God Slaying Needle traversed the space with a flash. In an instant, it reached Long Qian, and was directed to his forehead. It was a Soul Dao Supreme Weapon, which was completely in line with the Soul Dao method.
Before Long Qian could focus on recovering his arm and half of his face, he had to protect himself with a bell, which appeared atop him. Its emitted layers of golden luminance, which revolved around him like the planets of the galaxy. There were a total of 300 million layers of luminance, which were surrounding him.
However, the Taixu God Slaying Needle pierced through these layers one after another, and got near Long Qian in a blink of an eye.
“What a strong attack!” Long Qian had hints of surprise flashing through his face. He spat out a golden torrent, which turned into various types of attack to resist the Taixu God Slaying Needle, but to no avail.
“Open up!” Long Qian roared, and a dark black long blade, which had been suppressing in his body, suddenly appeared. It slashed on the tip of the Taixu God Slaying Needle, and threw it out.
Long Qian then quickly recondensed the blasted arm and half of his face. However, his aura had been greatly weakened.
Jiang Ming paced through the void, and went near Long Qian. With a flash, the Taixu God Slaying Needle merged into Jiang Ming body. He looked at Long Qian as he said, “In addition to the Zhentian Tower on my head, you actually have got three Supreme Treasures. A common Supreme Expert doesn’t even have one yet you have got so many. Long Qian, you’re indeed amazing.”
“Regardless of how amazing I am, I can’t be killed by a new Supreme Expert like you.” Long Qian had been acting very carefully. He despised Jiang Ming at first because Jiang Ming had just broken through to the Supreme level. Yet, it turned out that Long Jiang himself had almost been killed.
“That needle you should have obtained in the Specter Secret Realm right? In addition to the Zhentian Tower and your big bloody flag, you have got three pieces too. And yet, you are just a new Supreme Expert. This is truly unbelievable.” Long Qian’s eyes were glimmering with seriousness as he revealed all about Jiang Ming. “And that special ability of yours just now, that one finger of yours almost killed me. This is such a sky-defying special ability, which is beyond imagination. Logically, it’s impossible that you have such a strong special ability. Yet you have it, and you’re so skillful in applying it. Hence, the assumption of you coming from the other universe in the Chaos should be correct. In that case, you have the inheritance of a universe, right?”
“No!” Jiang Ming shook his head and answered honestly, “I’ve the inheritance of numerous universes. In fact, you don’t have to stir up tensions, nor you have to say that I’ve immense value to encourage other Supreme Experts to take actions against me. Because it’s destined that I’ll fight against the entire universe alone today.”
“You’re so arrogant yet you’ve earned my admiration.” Long Qian lamented. Then, he shuddered, and his aura was surging. The bell on his head buzzed, and the light from the sword in his hand shattered the galaxy. “C’mon, let me see which other methods you have.”
......
As he finished, a wave of vibration rolled out to all directions.
All the spectators retreated millions miles away, giving way for the battle of the two.
Meanwhile, the center had turned into a golden kingdom. That was a Dao Province of the Supreme Expert, which could also be known as the Saint Province. It was formed by the Dao of the Supreme Expert himself, which allowed him to alter laws, and manipulate orders just like a true ruler.
Inside the golden kingdom, was the roaring thunder, and the shuttling lightning.
Jiang Ming felt the pressure and frowned. He was quite familiar with the power because he had deduced it in the unique cultivating zone of the Supreme Pagoda. He knew he could manipulate all rules, and even altered its nature in the Saint Province.
“But…” A luminance emitted out of Jiang Ming’s forehead, swept across heaven. It isolated Jiang Ming from the thunder and lightning, and formed his own Soul Saint Province. However, its range and strength were still far weaker than that of Long Qian.
“I thought yours can be as strong as mine upon becoming a Supreme Expert. Now you’ve obviously shown your real level.” Long Qian smirked.
The size of the Saint Province represented the strength of a Supreme Expert. When Jiang Ming’s Saint Province was not as big as one-third of his, Long Qian believed that Jiang Ming was incapable of resisting him. He believed that he was almost defeated earlier because he didn’t pay much attention. Now that he got serious, he was confident that he could kill Jiang Ming.
“Really?” Jiang Ming beamed. The next moment, the World Projection appeared, merged with his Soul Saint Province, and expanded in an instant. It repelled the Saint Province of Long Qian, and got tit-for-tat with each occupying half of the side. It was just like a vast universe was divided into heaven and earth.
“You really have other means.” Long Qian frowned. “But so what!”
“Kill!” With a bell on his head, Long Qian lunged himself towards Jiang Ming with a saber in his hand.
As the saber light rolled up, the power of thunder and lightning rushed in, repelling the order of the universe, and forming the supreme forces of his personal laws and Dao. The rolling up saber light was like a galaxy.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming was radiating with divine luminance. He evoked Infinite Transcendence Technique, a long river of history appeared beneath his feet, and bodies of three lifetimes appeared simultaneously. Supreme Weapons merged into the clones one after another too.
The Past Body had nine God Sealing Tablets in him, allowing his power to surge exponentially. At his back was a pair of wings that allowed him to fly at an incomparably fast speed, absolutely the fastest in the universe. Even on his hands were a pair of Demi-Sage Gloves Jiang Ming obtained from Long Jingang.
The Present Body was wearing the Demi Sage Armor Jiang Ming got from Long Jingang, and he was surrounded by nine Universe Swords. With the presence of these two supreme divine vessels, his aura had reached his peak.
The Future Body was even better. He held a Blood Banner and wore a Silver Luminance Battle Armor.
The three bodies were fully armed. Even Jiang Ming had Zhentian Tower on his head, had a Taixu God Slaying Needle and a Demi-Sage Treasure.
“Kill!” Jiang Ming roared.
The three clones confronted Long Qian simultaneously. Jiang Ming’s Taixu God Slaying Needle too was shot out.
Long Qian shuddered, and became more ferocious.
In just a moment, their exchanges collided. Divine luminance surged, covering the galaxy. The powerful torrents of the aftermath, swept across billions of lightyears, shattering an unknown number of stellars, and galaxies.
Even the entrance of the Specter Secret Realm was trembling violently. The spectators of Supreme level had retreated again and again. They even had to evoke their respective special abilities to protect themselves.
The battlefield was shrouded with luminances and turbulence, obstructing spectators’ views.
Meanwhile, in the middle of the battlefield.
Long Qian had been carefully defending himself under the strikes of the Taixu God Slaying Needle.
The Past Body evoked the Wings of Freedom, to fly around Long Qian, looking for opportunities to attack him with Killer Civilization Punch Technique. He even brought the power of the God Sealing Tablets into full play, allowing him to threaten Long Qian.
The Present Body merged the Universe Swords with his body. As he pointed with a finger, it was the strike of Dao destruction, which also contained a boundless sword qi that could destroy an era.
The strike of Future Body was simpler. He directly waved the Blood Banner, which induced a sea of blood that drowned all things in an instant.
Merely the three bodies, and the Taixu God Slaying Needle, had been exhausting Long Qian.
“It’s time.” Jiang Ming muttered, and started to slaughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - Three Seconds Activation, Revealing the Chaos Tree, Extreme Massacre
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Three Seconds Activation, Revealing the Chaos Tree, Extreme Massacre
The five great weapons: nine God Sealing Tablets, nine Universe Swords, Blood Banner, Zhentian Tower, and Taixu God Slaying Needle, were all cast at Long Qian.
How terrifying the power was. it collapsed the ancient, and the universe. All things couldn’t resist its power regardless of laws, orders, rules, and the likes.
“Damn, this is so strong.” Long Qian was shocked. The bell atop him abruptly trembled, releasing boundless rays to form a defense. As he wielded the saber to cast the True Dragon Slash, his saber suddenly shivered. The origin power of his saber was disturbed, its rays shattered, as though it was flying out. This terrified Long Qian.
In fact, even the luminance of the bell atop his head abruptly turned dim.
“What’s the special ability he’s been evoking that can actually affect my treasures? I’m gone!” Long Qian screamed, and he was drowned by the few Supreme Treasures.
Jiang Ming was watching quietly from afar. Beside him were four clones, which dissipated after they evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
It was because they had used up their energies. In fact, Jiang Ming was looking pale too. He had spent an extreme energy to sustain the long river of history, while evoking various treasures, as well as doing his best to conjure four clones.
As he took a deep breath, the power of his inner world replaced his energy, allowing him to recover to his peak state in an instant. He could do so because his body was filled with the power of Saint, even though he comprehended only the Great Overarching Dao.
Jiang Ming put away his clones, and dissipated the long river of history.
As the destructive torrent was gradually dissipated, Long Qian’s voice could no longer be heard, only his saber, and a bell were left. All others had been dissipated. In fact, the luminance of the two Supreme Treasures were dimmed too.
Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Record, and threw the two treasures into it to learn that they were the Golden Obsidian, and the Abstral Golden Bell respectively. Jiang Ming felt great to have two Supreme Treasures which were akin to the Saint Weapons.
When all the torrents were dissipated, and Jiang Ming put away his Saint Province, he manifested himself.
“Did you kill Long Qian?” Huang Tian, the Star Beast, turned to Jiang Ming, and exclaimed with disbelief.
......
“How’s it possible?” The Queen of the Zergs was extremely astounded. “Alas, Long Qian is someone who can be ranked top five, and even top three among all Supreme Experts in the universe. How can he be killed in such a short while?”
There were battles among Supreme Experts in the past. But each battle would last for numerous years. Even if the winning party could be identified at the end, it would be extremely difficult to kill the other party. After all, one could elude prior to being killed.
Yet, the battle between Jiang Ming and Long Qian had not only ended with a winner in less than a minute, the loser was killed too. Moreover, because the battle was conducted between a senior Supreme Expert at the later stage and a new Supreme Expert, the result of the battle should be as expected. However, the result showed the other way round. Even Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan were surprised too.
“To think that he’s actually that strong.”
“Yes, this is too surprising. I’ve prepared to die, yet it turns out to be so surprising. Haha, our experience has now turned from shock to surprise. Perhaps, we can get over this ordeal.”
“Ye Hao, you’re too optimistic. Look at the number of the Supreme Experts in the surroundings. With the death of Long Qian, the other Supreme Experts would be even afraid of Jiang Ming. Hence, they will join forces to kill him because they don’t want to have another existence like Pan Wang amidst our Human Race.”
“Perhaps, Jiang Ming can create another miracle. Let’s see. If he hasn’t any other means, let’s use the means of committing suicide, so that he can escape.”
“Alright.”
The two exchanged messages and opinions telepathically. They were surprised at the death of Long Qian, but it was far from the ability to be optimistic.
“Don’t you see it?” Jiang Ming smirked. “Huang Tian, do you and the rest of you want to leave now or continue? If you all decide to attack, then there won’t be ways of turning back. I’ll fight until either I die or your clans have been annihilated.”
“You’re indeed ruthless!” Huang Tian was enraged, and he smirked, “Jiang Ming, do you think you are invincible after you have killed Long Qian? You’re merely dreaming! Ladies and gentlemen, this guy is lawless, unscrupulous, and fearless. He is a bigger threat than Pan Wang. If we allow him to grow further, all our clans will be suffering miserably. He managed to kill Long Qian shortly after his breakthrough, hence we must not give him a single chance to grow further. What about we join forces to kill him?”
“It’d be impossible if we miss the opportunity today. Of course, we shall do it together, giving him no other chance to survive.” The queen of the Zergs said in a voice filled with boundless killing intentions.
“Kill!” The emperor of the Machine Clan said in an icy cold voice, “I feel insecure if he is not dead!”
“Let’s just have him killed then!”
The other Supreme Experts were clamoring too.
They simultaneously evoked their respective Saint Provinces. Although they were incompatible with each other, the forces fell on Jiang Ming, and the resulting storm was still extremely terrifying.
“Since you all are courting death, I shall fulfill your wish!” Jiang Ming roared in an unparalleled imposing manner and vast coercion.
A card appeared in front of Jiang Ming, which immediately fused into his body. It was the Three Seconds Experience Card, which would increase his Saint Soul by ten folds.
Instantaneously, Jiang Ming felt the power of his Saint Soul had reached an inexplicable state.
In the unique cultivation zone of the Supreme Pagoda, his Saint Soul had been improving continuously along with the strengthening of the origin of his inner world. Although his Saint Soul had yet to achieve the pinnacle stage, it was already approaching the later stage.
How terrifying it was to have his Saint Soul improved by tenfold.
At the same time, Jiang Ming had called out the World Tree in his inner world. It had been suspended atop him, with its canopy appearing like a galaxy.
The current Chaotic World Tree had grown up to a billion kilometers high after its growth. It was utterly unbelievable.
The expansion of his inner world, and the growth of the World Tree, had again used up all his resources Jiang Ming had collected earlier.
The moment the Chaotic World Tree appeared, it formed a world domain. It had qi of fortunes flowing, myriad stars, and boundless luminance. The showering divine luminance formed chains of orders, automatically confining the void to form a forbidden domain.
Jiang Ming merged into it, and the power of his soul grew another five times. Hence, his Saint Soul became 50 times stronger than his real strength.
How strong would his Saint Soul be after multiplied by 50? It was something that even Jiang Ming couldn’t estimate. But he somewhat felt that if he were to release all the power of his Soul, it would be strong enough to cover the entire universe.
Such ability was incomparably strong. In fact, it was beyond limitation.
A second had passed, two seconds were left. But two seconds were enough for Jiang Ming.
The forbidden domain formed by the appearance of the World Tree, frightened Huang Tian, and all other Supreme Experts. Their bodies were stiffend too.
“Third Killing Heart Sword! Die!” Jiang Ming evoked the strongest soul secret method. It was the new deduction from the Celestial Heart Sword, which he divided into the First Sword, Second Sword, and the Third Sword.
The Third Sword merged all the power of Soul, endless aura of death, andkilling intents, as well as the invincible conviction that he would be capable of slashing his enemy.
With a flash which seemed intangible, it pierced through time and space, and into the forehead of Huang Tian. It directly crashed the Demi-Sage soul defensive weapon protecting his soul, destroyed his soul, and wiped out his will.
As a result, Huang Tian, the great ancestor of the Star Beast, was dead. Jiang Ming had killed him in less than 0.1 second, who died quietly.
The ray of Heart Sword didn’t disappear or weaken at all. Instead, it pierced into the forehead of the queen of Zergs.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - A Light Year Tall, Overwhelming Universe, Peerless God
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: A Light Year Tall, Overwhelming Universe, Peerless God
There were many corpses suspended in the void. All those corpses were of the Supreme Experts such as Huang Tian, the queen of the Zergs, the emperor of the Machine Clan, etc.
Jiang Ming appeared beneath the Chaotic World Tree, and his aura had been reduced to the original level. No one realized the difference as his aura was concealed by the Human Path Record.
“Alas, it’s imperfect!” As his pair of divine eyes pierced through the void, he saw a miserable figure was leaping from a layer of space to another. He sighed.
Jiang Ming managed to kill 15 of the Supreme Experts, but one eluded. The one who escaped was the peerless god of the Angel Clan. He had two Supreme Treasures, and one of them was for the defense of his soul. That Supreme Treasure helped him to resist Jiang Ming’s attack, giving him the opportunity to escape.
Anyway, Jiang Ming was surprised at the result of the battle. He thought it would be great to only kill half of the Supreme Experts present. In addition to the extreme increment of his power of soul, he didn’t expect that the suppression of the Chaotic World Tree would be this terrifying. These two factors had led to the unbelievable result.
Even Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan were still dumbfounded. They were totally stupefied.
They thought Jiang Ming, as a new Supreme Expert, was considered great for his capability of resisting Long Qian. They didn’t expect to see Jiang Ming killing the true dragon at the end of the day, let alone fighting against the world alone.
Both Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan thought, ‘Damn, you little fella are too proud of yourself, aren’t you? Having killed Long Qian has proved your strength, but the other remaining Supreme Experts are equivalent to a few of Long Qian. Moreover, with the number of Supreme Treasures that they have, how can you resist all of them?’
However, Jiang Ming did the other way round. With the appearance of a tree, Jiang Ming managed to kill more than a dozen of Supreme Experts in just a few seconds. This was unbelievable, so much so than their universe being destroyed. It was simply more than a miracle.
They took a deep breath to recollect themselves. Then, they looked at each other with ecstatics. With Jiang Ming as the member of the Human Race, it wouldn’t take long for the Human Race to be one of the top races in the universe. In fact, the Human Race could even dominate the universe.
By just merely thinking of dominating the universe had excited the two of them.
When Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan thought of stepping forward, they saw a terrifying scene. The roots of the Chaotic World Tree wiggled, shrouded the corpses of those Supreme Experts and their vibrating Supreme Treasures, and merged them into its body.
Jiang Ming too, was startled. Although he had refined the Chaotic World Tree and made it akin to his clone, it had its spirituality to act on its own will. Hence, it was better recognized as Jiang Ming’s pet.
......
Jiang Ming wanted to merge those corpses into his inner world to strengthen its origin. But he had not expected that the Chaotic World Tree acted faster than he himself. Upon sensing it carefully, Jiang Ming’s face was filled with surprises.
He discovered that the World Tree had been rapidly digesting the corpses of Supreme Experts. It even captured the origin of more than a dozen of Supreme Treasures to improve itself. The World Tree didn’t only digest the Supreme Treasures, but also refine all resources of the Supreme Experts to be its food.
‘To think that the World Tree can even devour the Supreme Treasures.’ Jiang Ming was surprised. He had greatly underestimated the World Tree.
Following that, the World Tree began growing exponentially. Its roots had been extended out like strands of Star River, while its canopy filled the space like a Star Field. Its divine luminance contained immense life and fortunes.
Jiang Ming had his consciousness merged into it to sense its changes. His consciousness, will, soul, and spirit, improved along with the growth of the World Tree. At the same time, the boundless fortunes that had been hidden in World Tree, had been refining his soul, condensing his will.
Ye Hao and Jiu Yuan, who were not far away, were again shocked by the scene.
“What’s this tree actually?” Ye Hao was astounded.
“No idea!” Jiu Yuan shook his head as he looked at the main trunk of the tree, where an illusional world was materializing.
“Does it look like the legendary World Tree?” Jiu Yuan said with hesitation.
“The World Tree?” Ye Hao frowned. “Pan Wang used to say that he discovered other universes while he traveled around the Chaos. One of them was actually formed by a tree. Its trunk acting as the carrier, its branches as the Star River, and its leaves as stars, forming an immensely vast universe. He said that the universe had withered and destroyed, even the tree, which had withered and died, was decaying. His description is kind of similar to this tree here.”
“If it’s true, does it mean that this tree here can form a universe as well?” Jiu Yuan was shocked.
“Perhaps!” Ye Hao was uncertain.
The two were standing there, looking at the scene quietly.
While the World Tree was growing, it released terrific suction, absorbing the power of this world. The suction had been extended to thousands of light years away.
One after another, the vital essence became a river, which turned into a galaxy and flowed over. It was colorful and full of dreamy colors. Stars that were relatively near, were shattered into particles of torrents. Even the planets were blasted into a stream of flame, flowing across the void.
Such a scene was too magically mystical, and beyond explanation.
In just a few hours, the Chaotic World Tree had stopped growing. Jiang Ming withdrew his consciousness. As he raised his head to look at the tree, he exclaimed to himself, ‘Its height has actually grown up to a light year!’
A light year was about ten trillion kilometers. It was a length that was difficult for an ordinary person to imagine.
Jiang Ming saw that its trunk had formed a Star River, and its leaves had become stars. It was immensely vast.
“Brother Jiang, this is amazing!” Ye Hao came over. His eyes were glittering with flames of excitement. “This battle of yours is surprisingly　earth-shattering! I believe that many other factions like the Demon Clan, and the Machine Clan will be inevitably weakened, and our Human Race can finally be expanded.”
“It’s better that we advance slowly for now.” Jiu Yuan said, “if we were to be too ruthless, the remaining experts of the other clans may do whatever they can to cause troubles in our human territory. In that case, it will not be worth the loss.”
The two had started thinking about the future. Jiang Ming, on the other hand, was just smiling. In fact, the expansion was to his liking. The Human Race should top the world.
Jiang Ming believed that nobody would dare to obstruct their expansion as he would be well-known throughout the universe after this battle. Moreover, they had another peerless Pan Wang. Hence, it was unstoppable for the Human Race to expand their territories.
With a thought, Jiang Ming kept the Chaotic World Tree back into his inner world. The World Tree was so huge that his inner world almost failed to accommodate it.
Upon returning, the World Tree rooted on the ground. The fortunes it was exuding merged into the inner world, improving the laws of operations of the inner world by numerous folds, and increasing the origin.
“The World Tree is complementing the inner world.” Jiang Ming revealed his happiness. He knew that if such a situation persisted, it wouldn’t take long for his inner world to achieve the limit of the middle chiliocosm which was akin to him advancing into the pinnacle stage of the Saint Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - Traveling the Universe, People from the Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Traveling the Universe, People from the Chaos Translation
After Jiang Ming chatted with Ye Hao and Jiu Hao for a while, he communicated with the Supreme Order to send Luo Heng a message. “I’ve solved the troubles out here, do you want to come out and traverse the universe together?”
Luo Heng: “You’ve solved the troubles? There are at least 10 Supreme Experts out there, and you’ve actually solved it.”
Jiang Ming: “It’s not 10 of them but 16. I killed 15 of them. It’s unfortunate that one managed to escape, making it an imperfect battle.”
Luo Heng: “What the f*ck, are you for real?”
Jiang Ming: “Of course it’s real!”
Luo Heng: “Brother Jiang, you are amazing. I’ll have to closely rely on you. Hold on, I’ll go out immediately. After all, I can’t get any good things here anymore.”
