Not long later, three people were seen coming out from the secret realm. They were Luo Heng, Zhan Changfeng, and Hong Ying. They got near to Jiang Ming, and the other two Supreme Experts in just a short while.
“It’s my honor to meet you Mr. Ye Hao, and Mr Jiu Yuan!” Zhan Changkong and the other two greeted the two Supreme Experts first before they turned to Jiang Ming, looking at him in disbelief. “Brother Jiang, did you really kill 15 Supreme Experts?”
“I can’t believe it at all when brother Luo told us. How did you do that?” Hong Ying’s eyes were wide in disbelief.
“It’s true!” Ye Hao assured with his voice still trembling. “Changkong, Hongying, you two didn’t see how brother Jiang mightily killed Long Qian before the group of Supreme Experts, and then slaughtered 14 of them in a few seconds. It was truly unbelievable, and I still can’t believe it even until now.”
“Yes, that’s truly unbelievable.” Jiu Yuan lamented, “In the past years, there weren’t any Supreme Experts who died in the universe. Even if there were, they died in the Chaos. Yet this battle has caused the death of 15 Supreme Experts.”
Zhao Changkong gapped, feeling unreal. He remembered he first met Jiang Ming around here. At that time, he stood up because Jiang Ming was being persecuted by Long Qian and the likes.
Even though Jiang Ming was strong at that time, it was understandable. However, Jiang Ming actually became one of the Supreme Experts not long after entering the Specter Secret Realm. What was beyond common sense was Jiang Ming’s ability to destroy the Specter Secret Realm. What’s more unbelievable was Jiang Ming’s ability to have the Supreme Treasure delivered to him with a roar.
......
Damn! Zhao Changkong was dumbfounded at that time. Yet, not long after that he learned about Jiang Ming slaughtering more than a dozen Supreme Experts.
“This is truly unbelievable.” Zhao Changkong could only lament.
Jiang Ming merely smiled in response. He turned to Luo Heng, and said, “Brother Luo, would you like to accompany me traveling the universe?”
“Absolutely!” Luo Heng nodded his head immediately.
“Count me in too!” Hong Ying paced forward. “Brother Jiang, let me be your driver!”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming was rather reluctant. He had a rather awkward feeling towards this red hot young lady here even though she looked sweet and lovely. After all, she was a master of a harem, even though the members of the harem were all beautiful girls.
Jiang Ming took out a spaceship, boarded with Luo Heng and Hong Ying, and left.
Outside the secret realm, Ye Hao, Jiu Yuan, and Zhao Changkong stood silently while looking at the spaceship disappearing from their sights. Ye Hao felt lost. “We should have invited him to join our Human Race’s headquarters. Then we can plan upon the return of Pan Wang to overwhelm the universe, and unite millions of clans to build an unprecedented undertaking of our Human Race!”
“No rush, no rush.” Jiu Yuan said, “Although I’ve just met Jiang Ming once, I can see that he is decisive in killing, particularly the way he’s treating the foreign clans like cattles. Hence, I’m sure that he will join when our Human Race truly overwhelms the universe.”
“I’m looking forward to that day indeed!” Ye Hao couldn’t help but guffaw. He thought it was a life-and-death battle, but it turned out to be a shocking reverse. He believed that this battle had thoroughly built an absolute foundation of the Human Race as the first clan in the universe.
Zhao Changkong felt rather disconsolate. He could fight side-by-side with brother Jiang at that time, but now his strength was far weaker.
On the spaceship.
“Brother Jiang, where do you plan to go?” Luo Heng asked.
“Let’s first go to the Wine Clan to get some good wine. Then, I think we can go anywhere.” Jiang Ming replied as he pondered. Good wine was something that could enhance the enjoyment of life. Hence, Jiang Ming thought he shouldn’t miss it since he had got here.
“Wine Clan?” Hong Ying’s eyes lit up as she slurped. “I have been wanting to go there. Brother Jiang, the Wine Clan is known as the greatest wine brewing clan. If you were to go, they would definitely take out all the good wines they have to serve you.”
“What if they don’t?” Luo Heng sneered.
“Do they dare to do so?” Hong Ying sneered too, but with hints of evil. “In fact, I wish that they don’t so that we can take this opportunity to take all wines away! Brother Jiang, after we get good wines, let me take you to my harem, you will definitely enjoy your life there.”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He thought Hong Ying was simply a hoodlum.
The spaceship’s cabin was extremely luxurious. It was divided into a living room, a leisure room, a retreat room and so on. All of them could simulate the scene outside.
As Jiang Ming watched, there was a slight distortion around him as his true self had returned to the Chuyang Peak via the Human Path Record. Meanwhile, he had his clone to replace him in the spaceship.
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming did a stretch, laid on the rattan rocking chair, swaying leisurely.
He had a full harvest during this trip to the universe. His inner world had evolved to the middle chiliocosm level, and it was not far away from its perfect stage. His Saint Soul had been enhanced too. Based on his presumption, it was akin to the middle end stage of the Saint Realm.
The extreme growth of the Chaotic World Tree, the level of its terrific power was something even Jiang Ming was unsure of. In particular when it had been rooted in the void, devouring the powerful torrent every second. It had unbelievably gathered enough fortune akin to a small chiliocosm.
The other benefits Jiang Ming had reaped was the many Supreme Treasures he had obtained. They were the Zhentian Tower, Taixu God Slaying Needle, Long Qian’s Golden Obsidian and Astral Golden Bell, and the nine Universe Swords, and nine pieces of God Sealing Tablets which were akin to a Saint Weapon when all nine were combined together.
Besides, he had also obtained dozens of Demi-Sage Weapons such as the Wings of Freedom, Stellar Palace, Jingang Bell, Jingang Ax, Jingang Gloves, and Jingang Armor. There were even more Quasi-Sage Weapons.
‘The wealth of the universe itself is far greater than the Honggu Heavenly Realm indeed.’ Jiang Ming lamented to himself.
He had eventually relaxed himself. After all, he was a man who used to slaughter the Saints. Moreover, without even a Saint Lord around in the Honggu Heavenly Realm, what else to fear?
‘Finally I can truly enjoy life!’ Jiang Ming finally felt peaceful without a sense of crisis.
However, he was also pondering about the current situation in his world. Chong Shan, the avatar of Heavenly Emperor Tai Yuan, was preparing to lead the 10 ancestral clans out to stir up chaos again. He planned to involve various forces into the chaos so that he could take the advantage to destroy them all.
‘Hopefully you don’t come looking for my troubles!’ Jiang Ming shook his head.
Jiang Ming used to be afraid of Tai Yuan, who was capable of taking over the position as a Heavenly Emperor, and befuddling all experts of the world merely with his avatar. This showed how terrifying Tai Yuan was. Nevertheless, Tai Yuan was no longer a threat to Jiang Ming, who was now capable of killing Tai Yuan in a few seconds.
“There isn’t any great matter in the world anymore!” Jiang Ming chuckled.
‘I shall just wait quietly for the arrival of the 50-years period, which is just a few days left.’ Jiang Ming was absolutely looking forward to the 50th year reward from the system. As he thought, he suddenly raised his head. His pair of divine eyes had gone through the Infinite Realm Battlefield to the depth of the vast starry sky of the Heavenly Realm. He saw the end of heaven, where the membrane of the world was located.
There, it was a crack.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 1)
?
Through the crack of the world membrane, an elder came in. He looked into the boundless starry sky, and with his divine eyes, he scanned through the entire universe. In just a while, his Saint Consciousness had scanned through infinite realms, absorbed numerous information, and had a basic understanding of the world. With an intuition, he turned to see the sight of Jiang Ming which went past layers of space.
The elder clasped his hands as he said, “I’m here to temper my disciple, apologize for any inconvenience caused. By the way, I’m Yun Zizai, from the Sea of Chaos.”
His voice was sent through layers of obstruction, reached the outside of Tianyuan World, and was received by Jiang Ming.
“Brother Yun, help yourself provided you are not here to destroy!” Jiang Ming clasped his hands too. The moment Jiang Ming retrieved his sights, he saw a woman appearing beside the elder. She was wearing a pleated skirt, and clothes as white as snow. She was surrounded by divine light, and with a glance, she looked like a naive angel.
‘What a sensitive person to be able to discover my sight, as expected of a Saint Dao Expert. Did he say he’s from the Sea of Chaos?’ Jiang Ming frowned.
He called out the Human Path Record, and quickly flipped to the page about Yun Zizai.
Name: Yun Zizai
Race: Innate Human Clan
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Later stage of Saint Realm
Background: The elder of Yun Clan in the Chaos
Relationship: 58
Innate Talent: Saint Realm
Background: Yun Clan was an ancient clan with the guardian of a King Saint. It was a perpetual clan, which dominated a world. Its inheritance was long-lasting.
: Because Yun Zizai was born in the Sea of Chaos, he had an innate Daoist Body. With the awakening of his Chaotic Violet Thunder Origin Power being awakened, all the members of Yun Clan were ecstatic. Even the Great Monarch voiced out personally that Yun Zizai had the talent of becoming a King Saint.
: When Yun Zizai was at the age of six, a war with Yun Clan’s enemy broke out. Many experts, including the Great Monarch were sent out, hence greatly reducing the power of the Yun Clan.
: A Quasi-King Saint furtively headed to the Yun Clan for Yun Zizai. He extracted the Chaotic Violet Thunder Origin out of Yun Zizai and left. When Yun Zizai was discovered, he was dying.
: Yun Clan was enraged, and investigated.
: The Great Monarch was enraged, and evoked a secret manual to badly injure the culprit. Upon return, the Great Monarch roared so loud that it collapsed the heaven. At a huge cost, he found traces of the expert who extracted the origin of Yun Zizai.
: The Great Monarch went personally to slaughter the Quasi-King Saint, and his clan.
: Unfortunately, the Chaotic Violet Thunder Origin had been merged into another child. Even though it was forcefully extracted, it was broken, and became defective.
: The Great Monarch of the Yun Clan was mad with hatred. He later found out that it was the Clan Master who exposed the news about Yun Zizai with the aim to prevent him from competing for the position of Clan Master in the future.
: The Great Monarch was filled with hatred that he slaughtered everyone in the family line of the Clan Master. He reiterated the clan’s rules that whoever with capability would take over the position of Clan Master, and whoever colluded with outsiders to plot against any members of the clan, would be killed upon discovery. These had terrified all members of the clan, and the Yun Clan was united ever since.
: After Yun Zizai was saved, he remained highly talented and peerless even though he had lost his Chaotic Violet Thunder Origin.
: He had been bathing with medicine, and consuming pills, hence becoming a Golden Immortal upon becoming an adult. Although he had been accumulating all the while, he still advanced into Taiyi Realm at 30 years old, and the Great Overarching Realm at 40 years old.
: He advanced into the Quasi-Sage Realm in less than 1,000 years but he used a million years to advance into the Demi-Sage Realm.
: Time flew by.
: In order to advance into the Saint Realm, Yun Zizai had been going out to temper himself, fight against the world, explore secret realms, and compete for encounters. He had even almost lost his life a couple of times before he eventually advanced into the Saint Realm.
: Unfortunately because of the incident when he was young, he had basically spent all of his potential. It was extremely difficult for him to further improve his cultivation base.
: Afte tens billion years, hundreds of billions years, and even trillions years had passed only he managed to gradually improve his cultivation base to the later stage of the Saint Realm. Following that, he was no longer capable of improving his cultivation base.
: Because he was almost cut off from the great Dao, he felt that both his cultivation and life were tedious. He even felt like transforming into Dao.
: In the end, he discovered that one of the disciples in the clan had an amazing and peerless talent, and was diligent. Because he felt that the disciple was similar to him, he decided to cultivate this disciple himself.
: He wanted to help this disciple to build a strong foundation based on his experience and knowledge. He knew that cultivating in the clan would improve one’s cultivation base swiftly, but it was not ideal to build a strong foundation, nor enhance one’s knowledge and wisdom. Hence, he took the disciple to travel in the Chaos, and descend to various great chiliocosms.
: Although it was perilous to travel in the Chaos, his cultivation base allowed him to cope rather easily. As they went from one great chiliocosm to another, they eventually arrived at the Honggu Heavenly Realm.
Jiang Ming was astounded at the Status of Yun Zizai.
Jiang Ming had never thought to have met Yun Zizai who was from the Sea of Chaos. He was horrified to learn that all newborn babies in the Sea of Chaos seemed to have an Innate Daoist Body, who were known as the Innate Human Clan.
Jiang Ming yearned to go to the Sea of Chaos one day.
‘I wonder whether King Saint is a realm higher than the Saint?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but ponder. Even though the content revealed in the Status wasn’t long, the history it depicted covered an extremely long span of time. Hence, Jiang Ming had acquired a lot of information.
Yun Zizai was indeed brilliant. It was terrific that Yun Zizai could cultivate up to the later stage of a Saint even after the Chaotic Violet Thunder Origin was extracted from his body. If his origin were not defected, he would make it to the King Saint Realm.
‘I admire the Great Monarch of Yun Clan the most. He is extremely ruthless to have slaughtered the entire family line of the Clan Master. However, it’s also because of that incident, the members of Yun Clan are united. None of them would dare to harm anyone in the clan. Even if they did, they would be killed by the people around them.’ Jiang Ming was in awe.
The Great Monarch was indeed decisive and ruthless.
‘A later stage of the Saint Realm, I wonder if I can deal with him without the Booster Card?’

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 2)
??
Jiang Ming was uncertain. He was confident that he would be a match to a later stage Saint from a great chiliocosm. However, he was not sure if he could do the same to the elder, who might possess any unexpectedly great special ability or even peerless Dao vessels because the elder was from the Sea of Chaos.
‘Anyway, it’d be easy for me to mistreat him badly.’ Jiang Ming smirked.
Jiang Ming flipped the pages of the Human Path Record to the page of the pretty woman, Yun Zizai brought along.
Name: Yun Feiyan
Race: Innate Human Clan
Gender: Female
Cultivation base: Peak of Great Overarching
Background: The disciple of Yun Clan in the Chaos
Relationship: 0
Innate talent: Saint Realm
Status: Because Yun Feiyan’s mother was of the Violet Swallow Clan, she manifested the vision of a Chaotic Violet Swallow upon her birth. Hence, she was called Feiyan.
: With great vision, and a peerless body, she received much attention and resources. She was highly intelligent, and had excellent comprehension. She was even valued by the Senior Elder Yun Zizai, who taught her personally.
: At the early cultivation stage, her Violet Swallow bloodline had been awakened.
: With the comprehension capability of the Human Race, and the body of Saint Beast, she still grew very swiftly even though Yun Zizai tried to reduce her speed. This had made many other disciples jealous of her. Even her parents received special treatment.
: After she had advanced to the pinnacle stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal, her Master Yun Zizai brought exploring the Chaos, and went to various great chiliocosms.
: Based on her peerless innate talent, she had defeated experts of the same realm. All from the Bronze Bloodline,Celestial Tyrant Body, Ancient Saint Body, Infinite Divine Body, and the likes, were not to her match.
: She also defeated many experts of the Great Overarching Realm, and even new experts of the Quasi-Sage Realm.
: As a result, Yun Feiyan had gradually become arrogant, depising infinite realms, and even feeling that she was invincible.
: After she went to nine great chiliocosms, she had accumulated her cultivation base to its extreme stage. Hence, she began to break through, and advanced to the Great Overarching Realm in just a short while.
: With the assistance of Yun Zizai, she advanced directly to the peak stage of the Great Overarching Realm. After all, her master said that it was not too late to start accumulating from the peak stage of the same realm. Without the need to break through them one by one, it would be more efficient.
: After she had stabilized her cultivation, she descended into another great chiliocosm again. This time, she was even more arrogant, and disdained all her opponents.
: After all, there weren’t any Great Overarching Experts, who were her match. She barely had any match among the Quasi-Sage Experts, and could even resist the perfect stage of a Quasi-Sage Expert. Her Master Yun Zizai advised her not to be haughty because the Quasi-Sage Experts of a great chiliocosm had body, Dao vessel, secret manuals and other resources far weaker than those in the Chaos.
: However, Yun Feiyan was still being haughty.
: When she visited the 12th great chiliocosm, she heard about a peerless genius. However, when she learned that the genius was only of the Taiyi Realm, she pursed her lips and stopped paying attention to the genius.
: Not long later, she defeated numerous Quasi-Sage Experts, and was a match to some perfect stage Quasi-Sage Experts. She was arrogant, dismissive, and hated by many.
: If it wasn’t because of the presence of her Master Yun Zizai, she might be besieged and killed.
: When she was about to leave, she even sneered that they were merely the disappointing aborigines.
: Her words enraged many experts.
: A young man from the Human Race finally turned up. In fact, he was, but forced to show up. He was rather dumbfounded when he was facing Yun Feiyan.
: Yun Feiyan took a glance at the young man, and sneered, “As a mere Taiyi, who are you to challenge me?”
: The young man sighed, lifted his hand and punched. His punch, which evoked boundless civilization with supreme power, made Yun Feiyan shudder, and her fighting spirit surged.
: The battle immediately broke out between the two.
: In just a short while, the arrogant and strong Yun Feiyan was defeated thoroughly.
: She began self-doubting by her defeat. She even thought that she was defeated by a Saint who pretended to be a Taiyi Expert, and asked her master for affirmation. Yun Zizai replied in a serious manner, “This young man is of the top genius if he is compared to the geniuses from the Sea of Chaos. In fact, there aren’t many who can be compared to him.”
: Yun Feiyan was stunned. She had also finally restrained from being arrogant. But she still refused to admit defeat. She stayed in that world, comprehended special abilities, and deduced secret methods.
: Every two weeks, she would challenge the Taiyi Expert. But each time she would be defeated, and the time she was defeated, was getting shorter and shorter.
: For ten whole years, she didn’t win even a single battle. This had utterly stopped her from being arrogant.
: She asked, “I’m the peerless genius of the infinite realm, but why aren’t you having a breakthrough when you can easily defeat me with your cultivation base one realm lower than mine? Don’t tell me that you want to comprehend 3,000 laws and merge them all together? Alas, this is difficult to achieve even by a Saint.”
: The young man merely smiled as he said that he hadn’t accumulated enough, and that there were at least two others who were stronger than he was.
: Yun Feiyan couldn’t help but laugh at the young man. She couldn’t believe that there would be any other experts of the same realm, who were capable of defeating the young man. There might be a few who might be on par with him, but they should be from the Sea of Chaos. In fact, even Yun Zizai was unsure if anyone of the same realm was capable of defeating the young man.
: Because Yun Feiyan knew that she wouldn’t improve any further for staying any longer, hence she went on her journey. Prior to her leaving, she sincerely said to the young man, “Hong Yi, I’ll wait for you in the Sea of Chaos in the future. By that time, I shall defeat you once.”
: Following that, even though she won almost all battles she had in various other great chiliocosm, she was no longer that arrogant. Instead, she remained calm as she absorbed the numerous wisdom of civilization to build herself.
: On this day, she was brought to the Honggu Heavenly Realm by Yun Zizai.
Jiang Ming had a strange look. He was surprised to learn that Yun Feiyan was taken to explore various great chiliocosms to be tempered. And she met Hong Yi.
Jiang Ming was suddenly reminded of a matter. Tian Fozi used to say that a woman used to descend to his world, who defeated all Great Overarching Golden Immortals at the Taiyi Realm. Tian Fozi even said that her name was Yun Feiyan, as he was trying to ask the members of the Chat Room if anyone had met her before.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: She came from the Sea of Chaos, King Saint (Part 3)
‘I think it’s this Yun Feiyan. In this case, we’re in the same Chaos! By the way, I wonder if the world of Luo Heng is also located in this same Chaos? If it’s, I’m afraid that the part of Chaos his world is located in, should be confined. If it’s not…’ Jiang Ming forced himself from thinking.
He planned to look for an opportunity to talk to Yun Zizai, and Riyue Changkong instead.
“Anyway, I think this Yun Feiyan is truly amazing. I think she’s more terrific than some of the geniuses in the Supreme Chat Room. No one else can definitely defeat her other than Hong Zhan, Hong Yi, Xu Wuji, and I. Alas, great chiliocosms do have lots of experts indeed!” Jiang Ming lamented.
Following that, he communicated with the Supreme Order and entered the Chat Room.
[Jiang Ming: Brother Hong Yi, are you around?]
[Hong Yi: Yes, brother Jiang. Anything?]
[Jiang Ming: Do you have a lover?]
[Hong Yi: A lover? Scratching my head. I am dedicated to cultivating, aiming at the great Dao, and I have no time to find any lover. Brother Jiang, why do you ask so suddenly? We are of the two great chiliocosms. It’s impossible that we have mutual friends other than the members of this Chat Room. In that case, the only possibility is that you’ve met Yun Feiyan, right?]
[Jiang Ming: Brother, you are so clever. I’ve just asked a question, and you got the answer yourself.]
[Hong Yi: It’s just simple reasoning. The only person who can connect us both is her because she’s exploring the Chaos. I’ve never thought that she actually has descended to your world. Haha, she’s got into trouble again this time.]
[Jiang Ming: Are you sure that she’s not your lover? Don’t you feel heartache when I bully her later.]
[Hong Yi: Jeez, the Dao is all I have in my heart, not a woman. Just bully her without any worry.]
[Jiang Ming: Haha, alright then.]
......
[Tian Fozi: Both of you can bully her, but I was bullied by her instead. We are of the same group, but why is the difference among us so huge?]
[Ming Fei: I remember that Tian Fozi used to mention the name of Fei Yunyan. I’ve not expected that she has actually been to so many great chiliocosms. Does she have a guardian by her side? How genius is she?]
[Hong Yi: She has a guardian, who is an extremely strong Saint. As for her, she would only pass the first level of the seventh Battle Towers at most. The most secure description of her strength should be akin to the level seven or eight of the sixth Battle Towers. Although she’s capable of resisting the ordinary perfect stage of Quasi-Sage Experts, those experts are after all, ordinary perfect stage of Quasi-Sage.]
[Hong Yi: The combat power of the Quasi-Sage Experts of my great chiliocosm are generally akin to the Great Overarching Experts in the sixth Battle Tower regardless of foundation, special abilities, bloodline, and the likes.]
[Hong Yi: Although I don’t want to admit that, it’s the fact.]
[Hong Yi: After all, it’s considered a miracle for a great chiliocosm to have nurtured an existence like me.]
[Ao Jiu: I like what you’ve said. Brother Hong, I personally think that you should have just made her your lover so that you’ll have support when you get into the Sea of Chaos, won’t you?]
[Di Huo: You’re right! Because the woman has fought numerous great chiliocosms, she must be very arrogant at that time. Defeating her will greatly impress her. Therefore, provided you just take some initiative, you’ll definitely manage to hit on her.]
[Hong Yi: That’s the reason why the two of you are always weaker than I do.]
[Ao Jiu: Brother Hong, I’m badly hurt by your words.]
[Di Huo: I spat out a flame of burning fire.]
[Ye Qingxian: What is the Sea of Chaos like? Is it a place filled with Saints? What’s the realm higher than a Saint?]
[Ao Jiu: I think Hong Zhan is the only one who knows how to answer your questions. But I think this guy should have gone to spend his points after he regained his position as the Group Admin. What a lucky guy.]
[Hong Yi: Hopefully he can obtain the sky-defying encounter as soon as possible and break through to the Great Overarching Realm. In that case, I’ll be the next Group Admin! And that would be wonderful! Ms. Ye, I know what’s the realm above the Saint. It’s the King Saint Realm. She didn’t tell what’s above the King Saint Realm.]
Jiang Ming read through those messages silently. With an intuition, he looked up to discover that Yun Zizai had torn the void, and got to the Infinite Realm Battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - Linglong’s First Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Linglong’s First Battle
On the Tianyuan Sea, Yun Zizai descended alongside Yun Feiyan.
“Master, would this world have my opponent?” Yun Feiyan asked in a melodious voice as she looked around. She frowned. “What a rich death aura shrouding the entire place. It seems to have condensed into evil cloud mist. This world must have experienced the deadliest massacre in which even many Quad-Sages, and an unknown number of living things were killed.”
“I’ve just probed into the past by reading the core of the world and learned that the Abyss attacked the heavenly realm a few decades ago. It has caused the collapse of the Heaven Court while the Abyss is almost destroyed.”
Yun Zizai could only check the major events that happened in the past but not the details. He could deduce the details only with his Saint Dao method if he was to understand some people and things.
Yun Zizai also learned that the Saints of this world had left for the Sea of Chaos a long time ago. Yet, because he discovered a Saint around, he was confused.
“The Heaven Court has collapsed?” Yun Feiyan was startled. Because of her experience travelling through various great chiliocosms, and witnessed the many ruling organizations like the Heaven Court. Hence, she was not surprised.
“Could the Abyss contend with the Heaven Court?” Yun Feiyan asked curiously.
“This world is monopolized by the Heaven Court alone. As the Abyss is under the governorship of the Heaven Court, logically, it’s impossible for the Abyss to overthrow the Heaven Court in just a short while after a billion years of peace. Yet, it happened.” Yun Zizai chuckled, “Anyway, it’s not our business as we are justpasserbys.”
As Yun Zizai focused, he saw the palace on the Tianyuan Sea. He couldn’t help but exclaimed, “The Infinite Realm Auction House is actually here in this world! I wonder who’s in charge.”
“The Infinite Realm Auction House?” Yun Feiyan was surprised. “Master, is the Auction House one of the strong factions in our Sea of Chaos?”
“Exactly.” Yun Zizai nodded. “This palace has the aura of the infinite realm, and the unique Dao fluctuations from the Sea of Chaos. Nevertheless, there aren’t any good things in the Auction House touring about great chiliocosms.”
“Sir, there aren’t good things for you indeed.” Riyue Changfeng sensed, and discovered the two upon their descent. He couldn’t help but smile as he heard Yun Zizai. He paced over to bow and greeted, “It’s truly an honor to be able to meet people from the Sea of Chaos. I’m Riyue Changfeng. Sir, it’s my pleasure to meet you, and greetings to you too, Junior Sister.”
Yun Zizai nodded his head as he looked at Riyue Changfeng. His eyes widened with surprise as if he had discovered some rare treasures.
......
“Did you call me Junior Sister?” Yun Feiyan frowned. A fiery look flashed across her face, and a sharp aura rushed out from the top of his head, stirring up torrents.
Meanwhile, her battling intent surged, sweeping through the entire Tianyuan Sea. She was obviously acting in a very high-profile manner.
All experts on the Tianyuan Sea were alarmed, and looked in their direction. However, none of them came forward. In fact, they retreated afar. It was because they knew how terrifying Riyue Changfeng was. Hence, the person who was capable of confronting Riyue Changfeng, must be someone of great strength.
Nevertheless, the Great Monarch Wan Lian got nearer, but with vigilance.
Riyue Changfeng merely responded with a smile.
Yun Zizai said, “Feiyan, you aren’t his match.”
“A Demi-Sage?” Yun Feiyan became interested instead. “Master, I’m not looking for a match. If I do, I won’t be tempered! Please initiate a battle arena, I want to fight him.”
Yun Zizai didn’t respond, but looked in another direction.
Jiang Ming was seen pacing over. He had to turn up because the two had got to his home area.
“Fellow Daoist!” Yun Zizai clasped his hands, obviously becoming more respectful. At the same time, he sent a message to his disciple telepathically, telling her that Jiang Ming was a Saint.
Yun Feiyan slightly bowed at Jiang Ming to pay her respect.
“Fellow Daoist!” Jiang Ming returned the respect. He took a glance at Yun Feiyan before he turned to Riyue Changfeng, “Brother Riyue, it’s rare to meet visitors from the Sea of Chaos, your hometown. Yet, it’s your compatriot challenging you, how can you disappoint the good intentions of the lady?”
“Brother Jiang, we are all from the Sea of Chaos. Hence, I don’t think it’s good and right to compete at your place.” Riyue Changfeng smiled wryly.
“Why do you care when I don’t?” As Jiang Ming said, he turned to look in the northwest, and sighed, “Those who’re courting death, are coming.”
Riyue Changfeng was startled and turned to look at where Jiang Ming was looking. A strange look flashed across his face, and he couldn’t help but sigh, “They are indeed courting death. Brother Jiang, do you still want to remain silent?”
“I’m deeply annoyed!” Jiang Ming felt rather helpless. The killing intention had now surged in him.
“Does that group of experts want to besiege and attack this place?” Yun Feiyan asked. When she saw both Jiang Ming and Riyue Changfeng nodding, she was astounded. “How dare they?”
Following that, she was enlightened and asked, “Sir, did you just sanctify your Dao?”
“Yes, I did not long ago. Because I act low-profile, none of the outsiders know.” Jiang Ming admitted. “There are some conflicts between us. I thought they would stay quiet for some time, and I didn’t expect that it would be so short.”
It was indeed beyond Jiang Ming’s expectation. He thought the ten ancient clans would have a long discussion to decide on strategies before they strike again. He had not expected that they would quickly take their action after only half a day of discussion.
They were not only impatient, they were reckless too.
Riyue Changfeng sent a voice telepathically, “Brother Jiang, why did you tell them that you’ve just sanctified your Dao. They are from the Sea of Chaos after all. What if they’re here for trouble?”
“No worry!” Jiang Ming replied with only two words.
Riyue Changfeng’s heart skipped a beat. Damn, how confident Jiang Ming was when he said the two words.
Anyway, when he recalled Jiang Ming’s deeds, he thought perhaps Jiang Ming was indeed not afraid of the two. Because brother Jiang was unbelievably growing too fast. Moreover, although the two were from the Sea of Chaos, they were traveling around great chiliocosms for training. Hence, they might not take the initiative to create trouble.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang!” Great Monarch Wan Lian came pacing in the air. “Chong Shan and the likes are coming for no good. Shall I get help from Immortal Venerate Qing Yun and the likes?”
“They are here for no goods!” Mountain Master Tianyuan got here too with a grave expression.
“Don’t worry, they are just a group of jerks!” Jiang Ming responded. Following that, he yelled at the Tianyuan World direction, “Junior Sister, have you done refining?”
“After accelerating the time by 10,000 folds, I’ve successfully refined them!” Linglong’s voice was sent from afar. Then, she was seen to pace through the void, and got to the side of Jiang Ming in just a blink of an eye.
Linglong saw Yun Feiyan at first sight, and immediately thought, ‘What a beautiful lady, who’s still very young. Senior Brother definitely would wish to hit on her. But he’s kind of a hypocrite as he won’t take any action even if he’s the intentions. He’d only lay passively.” Linglong immediately cut off her thought.
Yun Feiyan also saw Linglong, and her eyes lit up. ‘What a beautiful lady, as beautiful as I’m.’
Jiang Ming naturally had no idea about the thoughts of the two. But he asked as he was looking at his Junior Sister, “Do you want to attack?”
“Leave them to me!” Linglong was ecstatic. “Senior Brother, just watch. I want to declare to the world through this battle that it’s my era!”
As soon as Linglong finished her words, she rushed out. The Sword Sambodha surged out of her, slashing heaven and earth.
“Can she do it alone?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said with worries.
“There are about a dozen Venerates after all. Even if I were to confront them, I’m not sure if I can win. No, I don’t think I can win at all.” Yun Feiyan said as well.
“Just watch!” Jiang Ming smiled as he pointed. There were nine figures appearing beside Linglong.
“The nine of them look so similar, even their aura…” As Yun Feiyan said, she was shocked. “Everyone of them is of the Quasi-Sage Realm. Can it be, can it be…but how’s it possible?”
Yun Feiyan was not the only one who was astonished, Yun Zizai too.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - The Best Warrior Body in the Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: The Best Warrior Body in the Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In fact, all the experts were astonished. Because it was too terrifying.
“A main body with nine clones.” Yun Zizai looked rather grave. “All are with special constitutions, and different Dao fluctuations. There are even space and time clones. The most unbelievable is that the cultivation base of the main body and all the clones are the same, and there aren’t any traces of losing control over any clone. How did she do that?”
“Are they truly clones and not avatars?” Although Yun Feiyan had a guess, she was still extremely shocked. An avatar was temporary, hence had a minor requirement of one self. Meanwhile, a clone required a part of one’s soul, which would greatly harm one’s origin. Moreover, it was necessary to synchronize thinking from time to time to prevent the clone from being out of control, and this would obstruct one’s cultivation.
Therefore, it was challenging just to create a clone, let alone nine clones.
Even the origin of the soul didn’t collapse, Yun Feiyan thought by dividing the soul into too many parts would lead to a serious damage of one’s origin. Relatively speaking, it would cut off one’s future in cultivation. Even if cultivation was possible, she was wondering whether the nine clones would interfere with each other if they were to cultivate individually, whether the thoughts formed would be conflicting against each other when each clone was to act on their own, and many other questions.
“They are clones.” Yun Zizai nodded. “Alas, even great chiliocosm is full of miracles! Even though we have treasures and the likes to suppress souls in the Sea of Chaos, there aren’t many who dare to do so.”
“It’s indeed a miracle to think that the main body and all the clones have improved to the Quasi-Sage Realm, with each mastering a Dao.” Riyue Changfeng too, was lamenting. However, he didn’t voice out that the most miraculous one was brother Jiang.
Riyue Changfeng knew without thinking much that Linglong’s achievement must be relevant to Jiang Ming. Perhaps Yun Zizai and Yun Feiyan might think that he was the one who provided the thing that assisted Linglong in creating her clones, but he clearly knew that it was the other way round. It should be the blessings from the Supreme Pagoda of Jiang Ming.
Of course, the most shocking was the Great Monarch Wan Lian. Mountain Master Tian Yuan was better because he knew how brilliant Jiang Ming was.
Great Monarch Wan Lian shuddered by just thinking that Linglong and her clones were equivalent to 10 Quasi-Sages, with their minds interconnected. Hence, he knew it would be extremely terrifying once they joined forces.
Great Monarch Wan Lian also understood that both the elder and the lady were coming from the Sea of Chaos. It was unbelievable indeed.
“Alas, miracles!” Yun Feiyan was even more lamenting. “While traveling across great chiliocosms, I can defeat a Quasi-Sage with my cultivation base at Taiyi Realm, and then contend a perfect Quasi-Sage when I’m at the Great Overarching Realm! However, I met a Taiyi Expert, who defeated me, a perfect Great Overarching Expert. Alas, I’m someone who can compete with a Perfect Quasi-Sage Expert. Relatively speaking, does it mean that the Taiyi Expert is capable of competing against a perfect Quasi-Saint Expert?”
“At that time, I felt that that Taiyi Expert is the first miracle since the beginning of the journey across great chiliocosms!”
“Now I’ve met another person who is capable of creating nine clones with special constitutions each. All of them also have advanced to the Quasi-Sage Realm, each mastering a Dao. How unbelievable this is!”
“Frankly, the fact that shocks me the most is that they seem young based on their extremely young breath of life!”
Yun Feiyan couldn’t stop exclaiming.
“Other than cultivating in a place similar to the time house, I’m afraid that her actual age is less than 100 years old.” As Yun Zizai said, he looked at Jiang Ming, and he was even more surprised.
‘The Junior Sister is younger than 100 years old, what about the Senior Brother? What the f*ck, a Quasi-Sage younger than 100 years old, and all her nine clones are at Quasi-Sage Realm too. The Senior Brother has even sanctified his Dao. Damn!’
It was at this time that Yun Zizai had finally recollected himself and felt tingling in the head.
In fact, the achievement of Jiang Ming and Linglong was extremely incredible even in the Sea of Chaos. There weren’t many such geniuses except for those Innate Divine Saints.
‘What world is this? How can it nurture such incredible existences? Can it be that they are the members of the Reincarnation Hall or the Lord God Space?’
Yun Zizai was assured that someone incredible must be supporting the duo. Else, it was impossible that a great chiliocosm could nurture such existence alone. What’s more there were two of them.
Jiang Ming nodded. His Junior Sister was indeed younger than 100 years old. In fact, she was merely about 50 years old.
“Are you sure?” Yun Feiyan gasped in shock. A pinkish lump could be seen on her throat, contracting and relaxing continuously. This showed that Yun Feiyan was truly astonished.
In fact, she was not the only one who was shocked, even the Mountain Master Tian Yuan, Great Monarch Wan Lian, and Riyue Changfeng too.
They were in shock again when they saw the Dao vessels taken out by Linglong and her nine clones. All ten of them had a set of armor, bell, and divine sword, all of which were highly graded Quasi-Sage Weapons. There were 30 pieces in total.
“All armors, bells, and the divine swords are refined with the same technique, and are interconnected. If they are arranged into a great formation, it’d be akin to three pieces of Saint Weapons. In that case, she’d be invincible if the Saints weren’t around.” Yun Zizai blurted out after he slightly observed them. He was, after all, a Saint. Hence, his discernment was far beyond ordinary imagination.
“Akin to three pieces of Saint Weapons?” Riyue Changfeng had a twitch at the corner of his lips.
‘Damn! How can Jiang Ming get so many good things in such a short while?’ Riyue Changfeng could remember that Jiang Ming purchased a sword formation from him, which was merely a Great Overarching Dao Vessel, to protect Tianyuan Realm 30 years ago. But now Jiang Ming had so many good things. Riyue Changfeng believed that with Jiang Ming’s Junior Sister being so ostentatious, Jiang Ming would definitely possess a few Saint Weapons.
Riyue Changfeng was startled, so was Yun Feiyan. The most shocking wereMountain Master Tian Yuan and Great Monarch Wan Lian. In fact, the two of them were rather confused. They didn’t understand why there would be so many sets of Dao vessels which were akin to Saint Weapons when arranged into a great formation.
“Why do I feel so familiar with the technique that these Dao vessels are refined?” Yun Zizai couldn’t help but frown as he was trying to recall the past. His memory was so vast that he couldn’t remember it for a while.
“It’s from the Hong Clan!” Jiang Ming hinted. As for hiding? There truly was no need for him to do so.
“Hong Clan?” Yun Zizai was startled, and expressed his astonishment. He even deliberately lowered his voice as he asked for verification, “Which Hong Clan?”
“Hong Zhan’s Hong Clan!” Jiang Ming revealed a mysterious smile.
“Hong Zhan?” Yun Zizai’s pupils dilated in shock. “Are you referring to the legendary Hong Zhan with an innate Hongmeng Warrior Body? And he’s known as the top genius among the young generation in the Chaos?”
“Who else can it be? These are the customized Dao vessels I’ve requested him to make for me.” Jiang Ming ginned.
Yun Zizai gasped. ‘Damn! Requesting Hong Zhan for customization?’
Hong Zhan was known as the top genius of the Chaos, the apple of the Hong Clan’s eye. There were even many hearsays that Hong Zhan was someone who could advance to the King Saint Realm and even to a higher realm. After all, Hong Zhan was a peerless genius with the Hongmeng Warrior Body.
Yun Zizai was wondering how Hong Zhan connected to a little kid from a great chiliocosm when it was difficult for even a Saint from the Sea of Chaos to meet Hong Zhan. To be exact, it was impossible for any outsiders to meet Hong Zhan because of the Hong Clan’s protection.
If he were to visit Hong Zhan, the Hong Clan would definitely think that he came with ulterior motives. Hence, he might be killed on the spot or being confined to have his Saint Soul extracted and his memory investigated.
‘Is it through the Reincarnation Hall or the Lord God Space? No, the Hong Clan is no weaker than the two organizations. It’s impossible that they would send Hong Zhan there to be tempered under life-and-death situations. How are they connected? Can it be that they are connected through the Heavenly Inheritance Space or the even more mysterious Supreme Pagoda?”
Thoughts swiftly run through Yun Zizai’s mind. Regardless of how Jiang Ming and Hong Zhan were connected, it proved that Jiang Ming was supported by someone extraordinarily terrific.
Yun Zizai even came out with an evil thought, which he quickly cut off. He knew he couldn’t plot against Jiang Ming, who was now a Saint, even if Jiang Ming had any peerless inheritance. Hence, the only thing he could do was to be a friend of Jiang Ming instead.
“The legendary Hong Clan has a Hongmeng Warrior Body?” Riyue Changfeng was even more astonished.
“Hongmeng Warrior Body?” Yun Feiyan was shocked.
It was obvious that Riyue Changfeng and Yun Feiyan didn’t know about Hong Zhan.
“It’s in recent years that the Hong Clan has a peerless genius. Hence, the genius is under strict protection.” Yun Zizai couldn’t help but sigh as he was recalling his past experience. If he didn’t experience the adversity, he would have advanced into the King Saint Realm. Suppressing his thoughts, he asked, “Even if he isn’t being protected well, with the might of the Hong Clan in the Chaos, no one would dare to take his advantage anyway.” He stopped without explaining further.
RIyue Changfeng understood better. He knew that Jiang Ming was connected to Hong Zhan through the Supreme Pagoda, and their relationship was good. Riyue Changfeng felt rather sophisticated. Brother Jiang didn’t only have sanctified Dao, he would be protected when he got to the Sea of Chaos in the future. Even if Jiang Ming was not related to the Hong Clan, based on his capability, he would become famous throughout the Chaos in a short period of time.
Meanwhile, Great Monarch Wan Lian and Mountain Master Tian Yuan were rather dumbfounded. They had no idea what the Hong Clan and the Hongmeng Warrior Body were about. But they somewhat learned that Jiang Ming had connections with a faction in the Sea of Chaos even though they didn’t know how Jiang Ming did that. At the same time, they were enlightened on the root cause of Jiang Ming rapid improvement and growth.
“Is the Hongmeng Warrior Body very strong?” Yun Feiyan asked again.
“Alas, the Hongmeng Warrior Body is recognized as one the strongest warrior bodies in the Sea of Chaos.” Riyue Changfeng explained, “The record we have here states that such a warrior body is naturally close to the origin of the Chaos. Even if the carrier didn’t cultivate, the body would continuously grow stronger until the stage whereby it won’t be invaded by all laws, worn and destroyed forever. Hence, the carrier had the potential to become the top in the Chaos. Moreover, it isn’t difficult for the Hong Clan to assist his growth.”
Yun Feiyan silenced. She knew she was incomparable to one of the strongest warrior bodies in the Chaos even though she was proud of himself.
“Brother Jiang, can it be, can it be that…” Riyue Changfeng suddenly recalled a matter, and turned to look at Jiang Ming with extreme shock. He recalled that Jiang Ming used to tell him that Jiang Ming was a Group Admin.
What was the Group Admin about? Based on Riyue Changfeng’s experience in traveling infinite realms, he knew that one had to be the greatest in order to become a Group Admin. Hence, Jiang Ming was obviously stronger than Hong Zhan.
‘Damn! I only knew that you were strong, but I didn’t know that you could be this strong. Now I finally understand the situation.’
It was certain that Hong Zhan was an arrogant man based on his identity as the peerless genius. Hence, it was obvious that Hong Zhan was convinced of Jiang Ming’s capability when Jiang Ming managed to get Hong Zhan to refine Dao vessels.
The only way to convince Hong Zhan was through suppression! When Riyue Changfeng thought of Jiang Ming’s capability of suppressing the Hongmeng Warrior Body, he felt he was about to go nuts.
While forcefully suppressing his shock, Riyue Changfeng had a sense of unwillingness to admit defeat. He thought he might be capable of contending against Jiang Ming as he was a peerless genius himself.
Jiang Ming winked at Riyue Changfeng, and Riyue Changfeng was tactful enough not to continue.
On the other side of the Tianyuan Sea.
Linglong blocked the experts of ten ancient clans. There were a total of 16 Quasi-Sage who came with full killing intentions, under the lead of Chong Shan.
“I’ll remove all your ten ancient clans from the world for daring to plot against Tianyuan Realm and my Senior Brother.” Linglong was filled with killing intents as her nine clones were separated in order, forming an indestructible defensive barrier.
Meanwhile, there were many experts in the Honggu Heavenly Realm, who were aware of the situation here. Hence, they came one after another by tearing spaces.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 1)
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The movement on the Tianyuan Sea had already alarmed all parties in the Heavenly Realm. After all, the various forces in the current realm were either busy fighting for the position as the Heavenly Emperor or monitoring the movement of each other’s forces, as well as the troubles created by the ten ancient clans.
Every major force had arranged an unknown number of spies everywhere.
The descent of Yun Zizai didn’t cause much attention until Riyue Changfeng paid his respects. Riyue Changfeng’s action had led many experts to behave solemnly.
Alas, how powerful Riyue Changfeng was. He was capable of suppressing an ordinary Quasi-Sage Expert as though the expert was a feeble chick. Therefore, when Riyue Changfeng was willingly paying his respect to the other person, it proved that the person was no weaker than him. The person might be a Saint or came from the Sea of Chaos.
Following that, the incident whereby the ten ancient clans made their way into the Infinite Realm Battlefield, and towards the Tianyuan World, had alarmed many experts.
They thought it would be a good show to watch the ten ancient clans trying to destroy the Tianyuan World. Hence, many experts had arrived prior to Linglong taking action against the ten ancient clans.
As soon as the experts like the Heavenly Buddha arrived, they were all astonished to discover ten Linlongs, all of which were of the Quasi-Sage Realm. Especially when they saw all ten Linglongs were alike and were all clad in high-graded Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels, they couldn’t help but fall in reverie.
“Who are you?” The most fearful one was none other than Chong Shan.
Damn! Just Jiang Ming alone had spoiled his plan one after another. The last time they met, Jiang Ming killed a Quasi-Sage Expert before him. It was followed by a Quasi-Sage Expert of each clan being killed one after another upon return.
Chong Shan later pondered carefully and realized that Jiang Ming was most probably the culprit. Because he couldn’t understand only two people in the entire realm. One was Riyue Changfeng, who had just got here. But he thought Riyue Changfeng shouldn’t be the culprit because of the limitations of rules.
The other one was Jiang Ming. Especially after Chong Shan learned more about Jiang Ming’s growth, he was extremely terrified. Jiang Ming had been growing too fast beyond understanding. It was even inexplicable by miracle, thus unbelievable. Chong Shan wouldn’t believe that Jiang Ming could grow from a planar world to a peak Quasi-Sage Expert in a short time without any incomparably strong inheritance.
Therefore, Chong Shan had to take quick action. He invited the great monarchs at Quasi-Sage Realm from the other nine clans to lay out a deadly, and peerless formation, which would directly refine the Tianyuan Sea and Tianyuan World.
However, Chong Shan didn’t expect that they would be obstructed as soon as they got here. Ten women looked alike, all of which were at the Quasi-Sage Realm, and each had three pieces of Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels.
‘Damn, can anyone tell me what’s happening? Why didn’t I know that there are so many Quasi-Sage Experts appearing in the Heavenly Realm? Although the Heaven Court has collapsed, I’m still in control of all things happening throughout infinite realms, yet I’m not aware of this at all.’
‘Alas, since the Heaven Court collapsed, all things are beyond my control! Not only the Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, and Emperor Crown have inexplicably disappeared, even the death of Great Demon Venerate is a mystery. His Supreme Treasure too, is untraceable at all so far.’
‘The last time when I led the appearance of ten ancient clans, I was assured to involve all forces, so that I could kill them all. Yet, I had to leave the place with my tail in between my legs.’
Chong Shan felt f*cking miserable. As thoughts swiftly ran through his mind, he had a presentiment that something bad would happen.
“I’m Zhi Linglong, the Junior Sister of Jiang Ming.” Linglong said indifferently, “All of you are not qualified to confront my Senior Brother yet. Chong Shan, the clone of Tai Yuan, we don’t care if you were to stir up chaos in the world, but why are you provoking us? I wonder if you are hated by the Natural Laws of Heaven or your luck has been used up that you’d select this path of death.”
“Me the clone of Tai Yuan?” Chong Shan startled, and couldn’t help but guffaw. “You look up to Tai Yuan too much. Moreover, it’s publicly recognized that Tai Yuan is dead. If I were his clone, how can I still be alive? By the way, the last rumor about me as a clone of Tai Yuan came from your side, right? You are to destroy our relationship by hook or by crook, aren’t you?”
Chong Shan was filled with killing intentions. He made a pause before he said as though he was enlightened, “Even after we returned to the clan, nine of our Quasi-Sages were killed. It was your deeds, right? It must be. Jiang Ming was also the killer of the Great Demon Venerate. Because it’s unbelievable that both you and Jiang Ming could grow up to the Quasi-Sage Realm in merely a few decades. And the death of Tai Jian. Only you two as the Human Clan could grow up to the peak of Quasi-Sage Realm, and have the combat power of the Demi-Sage within a few decades. Then, it is not surprising that you can comprehend the special abilities of various other sects and forces.”
“Oh, that punch that punched through the Abyss was the attack cast by Jiang Ming right? At that time, the Heavenly Emperor wouldn’t launch the attack regardless. If he were to attack, he would launch the targeted attack at the Great Demon Venerate instead of merely provoking him with a punch!”
“Jiang Ming is the main culprit. Because of his punch, the Abyss fought against the Heaven Court, leading to the collapse of the Heaven Court, and stirring up chaos in our Honggu Heavenly Realm.”
“I’m even doubting now that the two of you must have obtained the inheritance from the experts of the other realm in the Chaos. That’s the reason why you manage to grow mysteriously fast in cultivation. Following that, the two of you will be stirring up chaos in our world as per requested so that the foreigners can invade our world.”
“Linglong, Jiang Ming, am I right?”
Chong Shan roared, voicing out his justified analysis. Then, he turned to Jiang Ming who was in the distance.
“You got some right!” Jiang Ming smiled. “That punch in the Abyss is indeed from me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 2)
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming paced towards the side of Linglong with flowing luminance beneath his feet. He looked at Chong Shan and also swept through the observing experts like the Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, and Vermilion Bird.
“I originally am living happily in the mortal planar world. Yet, the descent of immortals and the invasion of devils had caused consecutive disasters, leading to the death of millions of living things. Fortunately with the operation of the great Dao, and the limitation of the orders, I was able to counteract and kill all of them.” Jiang Ming depicted his past without worrying about being exposed. Neither did he care for the vigilant gazes from Heavenly Buddha and the likes.
“Nevertheless, the world that I was in, was eventually destroyed. Fortunately, it was led by Bei Chengguang, who wanted to plot against my place, to the Infinite Realm Battlefield. At the end of the day, I was the one who beat Bei Chengguang to death. His father, Bei Chengxing, turned up, and I killed him too.”
“At that time, Bei Mingai, the son of the Northern Emperor of the Heaven Court appeared, and wanted to take our advantages. Ha, he was too arrogant and presumptuous, thinking that he could provoke everyone. Hence, he was killed.”
“Kunpeng, the Northern Emperor, arrived, and died too. His death had led to the appearance of the Abyss’s experts who wanted to save the Northern Emperor. Haha, whoever saves my enemy is my sworn enemy. That’s how a feud was formed with the Abyss.”
“After the death of the Northern Emperor, the Heavenly Emperor plotted against me. How could I go according to his plan? I eventually went to the Abyss furtively, cast that punch which pierced through the Abyss, killed a few Demon Venerates to put blame on him. That had caused the Abyss to fight against the Heaven Court!”
“Chong Shan, in fact it’s your plan that the Abyss fight against the Heaven Court. Every move the Great Demon Venerate took was actually under Tai Yuan, your plan. You or the Heavenly Emperor, even furtively promoted every move of Yu Fei! The collapse of the Heaven Court was also the plan of the Heavenly Emperor to kill all betrayals. Of course, the Heavenly Emperor had furtively transferred all the royal ones away before the incident.”
“The collapse of the Heaven Court, and the destruction of the Abyss, all these incidents were aimed to induce fights among the Fo Sect, Dragon Clan, Demon Saint Palace, and the likes in order to compete for the position as the Heavenly Emperor.”
“Meanwhile, the clone Chong Shan would lead the ten ancient clans stirring up chaos in the world. When the main body Tai Yuan reappeared again, many would have died or seriously injured. Hence, he would be able to easily cut off all unsubmissive forces. By that time, he will truly be able to rule and dominate the world without any objections.”
“Oh, by the way, Chong Shan, after the death of this Heavenly Emperor, I’ve gotten all his treasures! You must be able to recognize them!”
As Jiang Ming depicted the past, he took the Heavenly Emperor Sword, Heavenly Emperor Seal, and the Emperor Crown.
“I’m the one who killed Tai Jian too! Ha, this idiot actually overrated his capability and wanted to kill me. Hence, I killed him in the secret realm of the Saint Demon Venerate. I killed that Great Demon Venerate too. No, it wasn’t considered that I killed him because it was Yu Fei who finished him off! And I was the one who killed those idiots from the ten ancient clans, who were cheated by you.”
Jiang Ming smirked while looking at Yu Fei, who was rushing her way here. At the same time, three great vessels appeared before him. There were the Silver Luminance Battle Armor of Tai Jian, the Saint Weapon Blood Banner and the Demi-Sage Weapon Demon Saber of the Great Demon Venerate. These weapons were emitting an intimidating aura.
All the experts around were attracted by these Dao vessels, revealing their greed. Following that, all their expressions changed greatly.
Especially Chong Shan, whose face was even more darkened. Because he had discovered that many experts had been looking at him with vigilance.
Since Jiang Ming had revealed such hidden secrets, why would he lie in other aspects? In that case, Chong Shan was the clone of Tai Yuan, so was the Heavenly Emperor, and Venerate Tai Yin.
If what Jiang Ming said was real, Tai Yuan was indeed too terrifying. With just a clone, he had all living beings in control. He not only had the Great Demon Venerate killed, but also destroyed the Abyss, and almost inducing war among forces in the realm for the position of Heavenly Emperor.
If it wasn’t because of Jiang Ming, what would happen with Chong Shan turning up along with the ten ancient clans? The answer was obvious. All would be killed.
As those experts thought of it, even the Heavenly Buddha, shivered in fear. But they were even more frightened while looking at Jiang Ming.
None of them knew Tai Yuan’s plot but Jiang Ming knew everything. What kind of genius Jiang Ming was? Tai Yuan was terrifying but Jiang Ming was frightening. Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, Vermilion Bird and the likes felt chills down their spines. They had been calculating and plotting to dominate the realm but resulted in them being manipulated.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was even more dumbfounded. ‘Since when did my younger brother do so many things? Plotted against the Heavenly Emperor, killed Tai Jian, and the Great Demon Venerate? What the f*ck! He’s been by my side, yet he furtively has done so many things. Damn! But why do I feel goosebumps and ecstatic?’
Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled after he recollected himself from shock. He also had a simple conclusion that the stronger Jiang Ming became, the more peaceful the Tianyuan World, and the more stabilized the status of the Human Race would become.
As for whether Jiang Ming would be besieged and attacked after him revealing all the secrets? Haha, Mountain Master Tian Yuan knew Jiang Ming well. He knew Jiang Ming wouldn’t reveal all these if Jiang Ming was not completely confident that he could compete against the world. Moreover, Mountain Master Tian Yuan could roughly guess Jiang Ming’s thoughts by just looking at Linglong’s cultivation base and her equipment.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Calling Jiang Ming as Uncle Jiang Shocked Infinite Realms (Part 3)
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
“Wan Lian, how is it? It’s still me who’s better at identifying one’s potential right!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan said proudly via telepathy.
“I’m still dumbfounded.” Great Monarch Wan Lian was truly dumbfounded. He thought Jiang Ming was still growing up. He didn’t expect Jiang Ming could be as ferocious as a beast, devouring all things. This was indeed incredible.
“It’d be weird if you’re not dumbfounded.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled.
Great Monarch Wan Lian shook his head, looked at Jiang Ming, and then the few supreme great vessels suspended mid-air to realize that he was not dreaming.
“Awesome!” He blurted out, and excitement was shown on his face. The stronger Jiang Ming was, the stronger the Human Race would become.
Yun Feiyan, who was also rushing over, was rather surprised. She observed Jiang Ming and felt incredible. ‘He actually managed to sanctify his Dao in just a few decades?’
Yun Feiyan didn’t care how good Jiang Ming was in plotting. Because she had seen many skillful shemers while touring great chiliocosms. She also knew that one’s strength was the determining factor on the success of the scheme. What shocked her was the short time Jiang Ming took in sanctifying Dao.
“It’s also a miracle in the Sea of Chaos for Jiang Ming to sanctify Dao and advance into the Saint Realm within a few decades.” Even Bai Zizai was stunned. He could guess that Jiang Ming was young, but he had not expected that Jiang Ming could be this young.
“That makes Jiang Ming a real miracle!” Riyue Changfeng exclaimed.
Between them had formed a confinement so that their sounds were not heard but anyone outside the confinement.
“He’s indeed a real miracle.” Yun Zizai nodded. Even those who were born as a divine saint, couldn’t advance into the Saint Realm in merely a few decades.
“Great chiliocosms are indeed full of wonders.” Yun Zizai was truly lamenting. It was as though he had just gained new knowledge.
“Tai Yin, are you truly a clone of Tai Yuan?” A loud shout was heard from the other side.
......
There were two experts standing, namely the Venerate Tai Yin, and the Great Monarch Tian Song. At this moment, Great Monarch Tian Song was looking at Venerate Tai Yin with disbelief.
“Do you really think that I’m a clone of Tai Yuan?” Venerate Tai Yin was angered.
“I’m the innate expert nurtured by the origin of Taiyin. Yet you actually see me as a clone of another living being. Tian Song, our friendship for hundreds of millions of years is actually in vain. It can’t even stand other people’s gossip.” Venerate Tai Yin was truly enraged.
“But…” Great Monarch Tian Song hesitated.
“Stop it!” Yu Fei paced over. “You still don’t believe it even until now? How could Brother Jiang lie when he has even revealed the secret that he has snatched away the Heavenly Emperor Seal, and the Blood Banner? Alas, Tian Song, I’ve never thought that you’d fall in love with a man.”
“Shut up!” Tian Song was enraged.
“Looking at you getting angry, it’s obvious that you’ve believed in it!” Yu Fei chuckled and walked towards Jiang Ming. Every move she took was coquettish and alluring. She said coquettishly, “Brother Jiang, it turns out that you were the one who sent the Great Demon Venerate to me so that I could take my vengeance!”
“Who allows you to call brother Jiang!” Linglong eyes turned icy cold, as her sword exuded boundless killing intentions. Meanwhile, all the divine swords in the hand of the other nine clones were radiating luminance.
As the aura of the ten swords was connecting with each other, the condensing sharp rays, which had yet formed a great formation, made Yu Fei tremble in fear.
“Then I won’t call him brother Jiang.” Yu Fei pouted with grievance. “I’ll call him uncle Jiang instead!”
Linglong snorted, while Jiang Ming was stunned. Other experts in the surroundings had twitching lips.
“I’ve never expected to see such an odd woman in the world.” Yun Feiyan was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - The Strongest Trump Card of the Heavenly Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: The Strongest Trump Card of the Heavenly Emperor
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming thought that he already knew Yu Fei very well. Yet today, it seemed that she was refreshing his understanding of her again.
‘Damn it! First it is Brother Jiang, then it becomes Uncle Jiang. Would Grandpa Jiang be next? No, Daddy Jiang would be better.’
“As expected of a demon.” Linglong gritted her teeth and sneered, “You don’t have to waste your time. Senior brother has no interest in you because you have too many smells on you.”
Since she was being shameless to begin with, Linglong did not feel the need to give her face.
Yu Fei’s expression however, didn’t change at all as she said, “I can just reincarnate myself. Maybe, I can even be like you and create several clones of myself?”
“Why are you so thick-skinned? You really opened my eyes.” Linglong felt her scalp tingling.
It was said that people who are shameless would be invincible. The saying was really true. When faced with this kind of person, what else could you do other than to maul her?
“My skin is very thin and can be broken by simply blowing on it. If you don’t believe me, you can touch and feel it for yourself.” Yu Fei showed her purest and innocent look which made Linglong feel inexplicably ashamed. She immediately became alert and cut off her distracting thoughts.
“A demon is really a demon indeed!” Linglong became alert, but sighed to herself inside.
“This is me! The sincere me without the slightest bit of hypocrisy, unlike the people in this world who all wear a mask. No, it’s layers of masks.” Yu Fei lowered her voice and continued, “What I did, I didn’t cover up; everything I did was sincere at heart.”
“Sigh…” Yu Fei sighed again. As she looked at Jiang Ming, she was very disappointed. She stopped her steps in the end and didn’t advance further.
“You are the first man who made my heart flutter and refused my feelings without hesitation.” Yu Fei naturally became very aggrieved. She wanted to cry and it caused the atmosphere around her to turn a little depressed.
Some of the onlookers looked at Jiang Ming with anger in their eyes.
......
“Clamor in front of me again and I’ll kill you immediately!” Jiang Ming’s expression was indifferent. He thought Yu Fei, a demon, was courting death for having interest in his body when she had slept with so many in the infinite realms.
As she felt Jiang Ming’s cold indifferent gaze, Yu Fei felt trembles from her very primal soul. Her face was flushed as she clenched her legs and quickly retreated into the distance.
Linglong suddenly had a raging urge to kill her off. To think that just because of that forceful remark that senior brother made, she actually… actually…
If senior brother really was to fall for her temptation, he would become contaminated with who knows how many different smells of unknown creatures and then pass it on to herself…
Damn it! Linglong immediately felt goosebumps all over.
‘This woman must be killed.’
“Senior brother, I’ll kill them all.” Linglong’s killing intention was bubbling as she stared at Chong Shan and the other experts. She couldn’t hold back any longer.
After taking care of all these enemies today, she wanted to quickly drag her senior brother back into the mountain, turn on the time acceleration and go crazy with him for a whole million years. She wanted him to shiver when he saw another woman after this.
“So be it!” Jiang Ming nodded.
He was actually not interested in dealing with them. Wouldn’t it be nice to take this time and bask in the sun or hold junior sister in his arms?
It was a pity that junior sister wanted to try her hands for a little. If that was the case, so be it.
“You’re just courting death!” Before Linglong even made a move, Chong Shan who had been silent all the while, was already in fury. He shouted, “You slandered me again and again, even going on a killing spree cutting us down. Do you really think we are molding clays that you can simply trample upon? Go forth! Kill them!”
The ten other ancient clans had long been unable to bear their raging anger. After all, Jiang Ming had already admitted that he killed those of their clans.
It didn’t matter if it was the old or new grudges, they wanted to settle both in one swift go. Following Chong Shan’s loud remark, more than a dozen of Quasi-Sage experts evoked their Dao vessels, launching their bombardment of attacks towards Linglong. They even encircled Jiang Ming in the middle.
With more than a dozen of Quasi-Sage experts attacking at the same time, what terrifying might that would be. The many other experts who were closer to the vicinity, were shocked as they immediately retreated into the distance.
Even Riyue Changfong also retreated far off. Yun Zizai however, didn’t move an inch.
“Attacking together? You are all smearing the pride of the Quasi-Sage experts!” Linglong merely sneered, with a dignified expression on her face.
She had long anticipated this scene unfolding in front of her. The Immortal Essence in her body started to flow throughout her body as she evoked the advanced-level Quasi Sage Dao vessel Immortal robe. In an instant, immortal luminance shot through the sky, enveloping her within.
It didn’t end there.
With nine clones coupled with her true self, the luminance from all ten of their battle armor merged together without any interruption as they communicated with each other. The connection of their origin rendered the battle armor’s power to soar by leaps and bounds in an instant.
The luminance formed a barrier around them, blocking off the countless attacks from the outside world.
Such a scene was a really shocking scene to the onlookers.
“With the ten immortal armor’s power merging into one, the defensive barrier formed is equivalent to that of a Holy Dao vessel already. Coupled with the fact that the ten of them are all of the Quasi-Sage Realm, evoking the armor at the same time allowed its defensive capability to be pushed to the extreme. Hence, it’s just natural that they can block off such a wave of attack.” Riyue Changfeng commented.
“It makes sense.” Yun Feiyan nodded in agreement, “They’re finished.”
“They’re really done for!” Riyue Changfeng agreed. Without even needing Jiang Ming to make a move, Linglong could kill them all by herself.
This was because of the fact that her equipment was top notch and that the ten of them were originally one entity to begin with.
The Heavenly Buddha, Dragon Monarch, Bird Vermillion and the other experts had an ugly expression on their faces.
If just this Linglong person was so terrifying, what about the Jiang Ming now? They couldn’t imagine and wouldn’t even dare to imagine.
“The attack is good. It almost broke my defense.” Linglong said softly, “You have attacked, and it’s my turn now. I hope you all can block this attack of mine!”
“Celestial Soul Bell, out!”
As her voice fell, ten bell treasures appeared at the same time. They were all afloat above her head, merging together quickly and turned into a heaven shattering supreme divine bell.
Although there weren’t any Dao fluctuation unique to that of the Saint Weapons emanating from it, the energy that radiated from it was as terrifying, powerful and despairing than the common Saint Weapons.
After all, this was from the fusion of ten Quasi-Sage Dao vessels.
“That’s not good!” Chong Shan’s expression changed wildly.
He knew that he definitely couldn’t block off this attack.
If the dozen or so Quasi-Sage among them were connected at heart, such an attack wouldn’t have been a problem at all. However, the problem was that they were not connected at heart at all. They didn’t even have a tacit understanding among them.
What would happen if they couldn’t withstand the attack? Well, very few among the experts here could survive from the blow.
Coupled with Jiang Ming revealing his trump card, Chong Shan was starting to feel despair.
‘Is this the end of the tens of thousands of years of my plan?’ Chong Shan smiled bitterly. He also felt that his real self was making a move now. If his real self didn’t make a move, then he would be done. Even if Linglong couldn’t kill him off, Jiang Ming wouldn’t let him off the hook for sure.
Right this moment, Bai Zizai suddenly raised his head and looked into the depths of the void.
Riyue Changkong also felt something was off and couldn’t help but blurt out, “To think that it’s actually a Saint Weapon!”
“This Saint Weapon is still decent. It’s such a shame that the user is quite weak.” Bai Zizai saw through the weapon’s detail with just one glance.
Immediately afterwards, a sharp streak of luminance tore through the sky, breaking open the great chiliocosm’s membrane. It punctured the heavenly sky as though it originated from the boundless chaos.
It was a pitch-black long spear. A spear that contained terrifying powers that could puncture a whole great chiliocosm.
The spear came to Linglong’s head in a flash.It was apparent that the spear was sent to kill her off.
“Tai Yuan, you couldn’t bear it anymore right?” Jiang Ming smiled lightly, then stretched out his white-jade-like palm and reached out to grab it.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - Collapsing of the Heart of Saint Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Collapsing of the Heart of Saint Dao
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
As Jiang Ming stretched out his hands and grabbed on, the black spear merely trembled before coming to a sudden halt, caught in his grip.
This was the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
Even if he didn’t evoke this technique, it wasn’t difficult for him to suppress the long spear. Evoking the technique merely made it looked as though he was doing an unimaginable feat with ease.
“Great technique!” Bai Zizai’s eyes lit up and he couldn’t help exclaiming.
“Brother Jiang is really amazing!” Riyue Changfeng lamented emotionally.
This spear was obviously a Saint Weapon. It was infused with supreme power that almost awakened all its power, but was suppressed by Jiang Ming as though it was nothing.
How incredible was that?
“It’s just small trickery!” Jiang Ming smiled indifferently. His gaze suddenly focused, integrating his supreme will into the spear. It turned into a sword luminance, breaking through layers of barriers, cracking the infinite restrictions and reaching the internal core of the spear, wiping off the imprint that Tai Yuan had left inside.
The Dao of Soul was very effective against Saint Weapon.
Tai Yuan, who was in the depths of the endless starry sky, had a shocked expression on his face. His body froze as he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood.
His eyes widened immediately.
“How is this possible to grab a Saint Weapon bare-handed, and to destroy my imprint with just a thought? Has he sanctified Dao already? Why is there no heteromorphism to it? Such might…”
Tai Yuan had a look of despair on his face.
He was also decisive. As soon as he turned around, he tore apart the void and went straight towards the World’s fetal membrane, ready to escape into the Chaos. Right that moment, he felt a supreme will descending onto him, directly suppressing him and forcefully moved him towards their direction.
Over at the battlefield, Linglong suddenly shivered as her face turned extremely pale.
Visit /Myb o x nove l. com/ to read, pls!
She was locked on just now. That streak of luminance made her seem as though she had just witnessed death. A sense of enlightenment suddenly rose in her heart as she couldn’t withstand or even defend herself from that attack.
She failed to react to the attack as soon as possible and was initially done for.
However, she immediately realized that Jiang Ming already suppressed the long spear. She let out a breath of relief and her eyes were red in anger. “Damn it! All of you! Die!”
Linglong evoked the Celestial Soul Bell with all her strength. The ten Quasi-Sage, ten bodies of a single entity flared out at the same time, bringing their power to the peak.
The Celestial Soul Bell that had merged together shook suddenly. It emanated waves of ripples, followed by a deafening ringing of the bell.
Thump…
With a deafening thump, the void cracked open, and was suppressed again. It felt as though the void became a shattered mirror that had countless cracks on it but remained in place. Only the deafening sound and ripples of energy quickly spread towards the enemy.
Boom…
The dozen or so Quasi-Sages in front were all blasted into a distance.
There were eight of them whose head directly exploded from the attack and their primal spirit annihilated on the spot. The rest of the experts other than Chong Shan, all bled from their seven orifices. All of them had an ugly expression on their faces. They immediately turned into streams of luminance and quickly fled towards the distance.
“Trying to escape? Too late! Die!” Linglong went into a frenzy.
She evoked the bell again, setting off endless waves of torrents. The attacks directly locked onto the experts’ primal spirits. Bloodcurdling shrieks could be heard as one by one, their head exploded or their body stiffened, falling to the ground.
