In the end, only two people were still alive from the attack. One of them was Chong Shan, while the other was a later stage Quasi-Sage old man who had a primal spirit defensive Dao vessel.
“Die!” Linglong, who was in a frenzy, was especially terrifying.
She didn’t use other Dao vessels but evoked the Celestial Soul Bell again. The soul vibration echoed through, piercing through the layers of void and killing the old man with one swift blow.
As for Chong Shan? He didn’t escape and simply had a look of despair on his face.
It was also right this moment, Tai Yuan appeared out of thin air and landed right beside Chong Shan.
“Main Body!” Chong Shan opened his mouth, but his face was filled with bitterness.
Now that the situation had come to this point, he knew that everything had been exposed. He knew that he was finished.
Tai Yuan could feel the energy that was shackling him disappearing. He glanced at Chong Shan and then looked over at Jiang Ming. With a complicated expression, he asked, “Have you sanctified Dao?”
“Should be!” Jiang Ming nodded and asked with curiosity, “I still couldn’t understand. Why do you keep eyeing the Tianyuan Realm all this while?”
More and more experts were gathering around to watch the battle. However, they were all in a state of shock. They were shocked by how terrifying Linglong was, to be able to kill off dozens of Venerates at the flick of a finger. Those were the heritage of the known ten great ancient clans and they were now gone just like that.
They were also shocked at how terrifying Jiang Ming was.
That long spear was obviously a Saint Weapon! Who could even stand against it? Yet, Jiang Ming actually grabbed it in his hands?”
Damn! They were wondering whether this was just a dream?
Soon after, Tai Yuan himself emerged. This was his true self. His appearance was the same as the Heavenly Emperor. Many of the experts recognized him from his look and were all horrified and grimaced wryly.
It turned out that Jiang Ming’s remarks were all true. The Heavenly Emperor was not dead, but was hiding in the dark, plotting everything, in an effort to completely grasp all of the infinite realm in his hands.
Damn it! This old fox! If it weren’t because of Jiang Ming, who would’ve been able to stop him?
Also, that Great Demon Venerate really died in vain! Who would’ve thought that the dignified Great Demon Venerate, who had such high ambitions, would be plotted against and brought to the ground?
As if these weren’t enough, what did Tai Yuan just say? Jiang Ming had sanctified the path of Dao? Every expert, including the Heavenly Buddha, was instantly shocked.
“My younger brother has sanctified Dao already?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan’s voice was trembling.
Alas! Sanctifying the path of Dao meant that Jiang Ming was now a Saint! The Human Race finally got a Saint?
“Sanctified Dao and became a Saint?” Great Monarch Wan Lian was rather lost.
“Senior brother! Have you really sanctified Dao?” Linglong was very shocked and later turned ecstatic.
Right this very moment, all eyes were on Jiang Ming, where some were filled with shock and apprehension, while others were filled with envy, jealousy and fear. Most of them however, were very fervent about Jiang Ming’s achievement.
Yes, it was the fervent of Jiang Ming advancement into the Saint Realm.
This was because ever since the birth of the seven Saints, there wasn’t another Saint that appeared in their world from that point on.
Even though the seven Saints had left the place for who knows how many years, there was still not a single Saint that emerged. This led to many experts’ despair.
Now that there was a Saint emerging into the world, would this mean that the path towards the Saint was still viable?
Tai Yuan’s eyes suddenly lit up, and he frowned. “Based on my understanding, seven Saints is the limit of a Great Chiliocosm. Otherwise, I would have been able to sanctify the path of Dao a long time ago with my foundation. If that was the case, I wouldn’t have to dogmatize the world, and make my words the law, so that I’ll have all the fortune of the heavens to break into the Saint Realm, which caused me to reach such a point in time.”
“What you said is correct, yet incorrect at the same time.” Jiang Ming explained slowly.
The surrounding experts all perked up their ears to listen. After all, this was a secret regarding the path of Saint Dao.
“Generally speaking, there can only be seven Saints born in a great chiliocosm. The realm wouldn’t be able to handle the pressure if there was any more than that.” Jiang Ming then continued, “This is considered a self-restriction mechanism of the realm. If there’s a restriction, then breaking them apart would mean that we can lift the restriction, naturally allowing us to sanctify the path of Dao. Am I right, Brother Bai?”
“Almost.” Bai Zizai said with a smile, “There is a limit to what the great chiliocosm can carry after all. Once the Throne of the Saint is completely filled, unless one of the Saints is dead and his Heavenly Heart Imprint in the realm disappears, it will be difficult for another person to advance into the Saint Realm. It’s hard, but that doesn’t mean it’s impossible. For example, a person can enter the Chaos and sanctify the path of Dao with strength; another example would be to forcibly break the worlds’ shackles and leave your imprint on it; a third example would be to embark into the Sea of Chaos.”
“I have tried the first two methods, but they were both useless!” Tai Yuan had a confused look on his face as he continued, “The Chaos is full of chaotic torrents so violent that it is impossible for a person to comprehend their Dao there, let alone to improve their cultivation base. I also tried fusing my clones together and forcibly breaking through my cultivation base, but it was still useless; the same is true within the realm. With my foundation and my accumulation of resources over the years, if it was feasible, I would’ve been able to sanctify the path of Dao.”
“You are too arrogant.” Jiang Ming laughed. “You have created three clones and it can be said that you are extremely talented. However, your foundation is still too poor, your vision is too short, and your accumulation is still insufficient. All in all, you still haven’t accumulated enough. To sanctify the path of Dao in the Chas is to forcibly break through with your physical body and forge an immortal body. To break free the shackles of within the realm means being able to comprehend the terrifying techniques that could pierce through the whole realm itself. This is also considered another way for sanctifying the path of Dao with strength.”
“That’s right!” Bai Zizai nodded, “In this realm, your accumulation seems to be terrifying, but compared with a real genius, you are still far behind. If you want to forcibly sanctify the path of Dao and break the rules of the iron law, you must possess the strength to fight against the ordinary Saint and emerge undefeated while you are still in the Demi-Sage Realm.”
“Let’s take the current you as an example. If you were to fight head on against Ms Linglong, you might not be able to defeat her even if you have a Holy Weapon at hand.” Bai Zizai commented unceremoniously and continued, “It might seem that you almost killed her just now, but it was a sneak attack. When she was facing a dozen Quasi-Sage Experts, her mind was already highly concentrated in the battle. You merely took advantage of it.”
“My accumulation is still insufficient?” Tai Yuan opened his mouth. Confused in everything, there were more doubts forming in his mind.
“It’s far from enough!” Jiang Ming intercepted and continued, “While I was in the Taiyi Realm, I was already able to cut down a Demi-Sage Expert. If that’s the case, do you think your accumulation is enough?”
“Slaying the Demi-Sage Expert at Taiyi Realm?” Tai Yuan’s eyes instantly widened.
“That’s impossible!” Yun Feiyan also exclaimed.
Jiang Ming smiled and did not explain further.
“It’s possible.” Bai Zizai had a solemn expression on his face as he continued, “Even if we are unable to do so, it doesn’t mean that others can’t. It seems that I am starting to understand now.”
He looked at Jiang Ming with his eyes blazing. “Hong Zhan was overwhelmed by you!”
In response, Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up.
Bai Zizi grinned.
His heart of Saint Dao trembled and almost collapsed.
Who was Hong Zhan? The contemporary most talented expert of the Hong Clan in the Sea ofChaos. Equipped with the Hongmeng Warrior Body, he was an existence who had great chances to advance into the King Saint Realm in the future, and even had the chances of breaking through into much higher realms than that.
However, to think that this normal human being was able to actually suppress him? Yun Zizai felt very surreal.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - The Enemies of Linglong’s Parents
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: The Enemies of Linglong’s Parents
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This single remark of a Taiyi Expert beheading a Demi-sage, shocked all of the experts present.
Even Yun Zizai was shocked. He knew too well what it meant.
The other experts however, were very puzzled. As of the world today, were there any other Demi-Sage Experts? They then thought of the same person.
“You mean the Great Demon Venerate?” Tai Yuan asked.
Jiang Ming shook his head, and didn’t continue further. Instead, he asked, “You haven’t answered me yet. Why have you been having trouble with me? You clearly know that even when the Great Demon Venerate came here in person, I was able to force his retreat. However, you still wanted to deal with me. Could it be that I am a variable that will affect your plan?”
“You are a variable, and you are the least involved among all the factions. Killing you will also serve as a way of showing my influence over the ten great clans. Although you are able to detonate many Dao vessels and that might seem like a great threat, it is not a big problem once the proper arrangements are done.” Taiyuan explained his original plan and sighed, “The original plan was that Chong Shan would immediately set up a great formation upon descending to this place. The whole Tianyuan World was to be moved into the peerless killing formation that had been set up in advance and kill you in it. Who knew that we would be stopped upon arrival?”
Jiang Ming nodded. It seemed that this was the only excuse for it.
“Can you let me go?” Tai Yuan asked in a calm tone, without the slightest hint of beseeching for mercy.
“No!” Jiang Ming shook his head, “Now that we are enemies, it’s either life or death!”
“Then die!”
Chong Shan rushed over immediately. His body immediately swelled, and energy within his whole body was violently surging through It was as if 100 million nuclear bombs in his body were about to explode.
“Trying to self-destruct?”
Jiang Ming sneered, but he didn’t move a muscle. Chong Shan could be seen suddenly frozen on his feet and the violent energy extinguished in an instant.
......
It was at this moment, Venerate Tai Yin turned into a full moon and came over. She also evoked the supreme special ability with the intention of perishing together with Jiang Ming. Unfortunately however, his opponent was Jiang Ming.
With just a slight thought, Tai Yin was silently killed.
Tai Yuan let out a long sigh. “Jiang Ming, how did you manage to sanctify the path of Dao in this current state? Why is there no heteromorphism to it?”
“Didn’t I say it just now? Although the world is shackled, it can be broken. Sanctifying the path of Dao is actually very simple.” Jiang Ming smiled, “Whoever stipulated that there must be heteromorphism when sanctifying the path of Dao? The universe is too big, and the world is too vast. There are so many amazing things out there.”
“Sanctifying the path of Dao is easy?” Tai Yuan opened his mouth. Under the current situation where he was about to be killed, his heart of Dao didn’t fluctuate much. However, after hearing such a remark, he had the urge to scold vulgar words already.
‘Damn it! To think that I’ve spent tens of thousands of years plotting my plans to sanctify the great Dao but ended in vain. However, you said that it was not a big deal. God damn it!’
Besides Tai Yuan, everyone else such as the Heavenly Buddha and Dragon Monarch had a much distorted face and that they had an urge to go frenzy.
Even Tai Yuan seemed to have no hope of sanctifying the path of the Dao, let alone the rest of them.
They thought Jiang Ming was really not giving any respect to them with his remark that sanctifying the path of Dao was simple.
Damn it! Some even cursed Jiang Ming.
Riyue Changfeng chuckled and secretly said, “Brother Jiang, you really did it.”
He had traveled through various great chiliocosms. He knew how difficult it was to sanctify the path of Dao. Few living beings could break the shackles of confinement of Heaven and earth.
However, Jiang Ming right in front of him was amazing for sure. His ability to sanctify the path of Dao and advance into the Saint Realm in just a few decades, who among the Sea of Chaos could even compare to him?
In fact, even Bai Zizai couldn’t help feeling emotional.
“Tai Yuan, you shall return to ashes!”
As Jiang Ming’s word fell, his primal spirit directly broke into the Tai Yuan’s sea of consciousness, destroying his primal spirit, cutting down his true spirit and erasing his will.
Tai Yuan was very strong. He was very formidable indeed. However, he was a feeble being in the eyes of Jiang Ming. Tai Yuan had reached the Demi-Sage Realm and was unable to break through the world’s shackles of restrictions. He didn’t even dare to go forth into the Chaos to find the Sea of Chaos. Hence, Tai Yuan was known to be an ordinary expert.
Both Chong Shan, and Venerate Tai Yin had died and Tai Yuan did not resist as well.
The experts who saw the whole ordeal were feeling very complicated. Alas! The Heavenly Emperor who had been plotting for almost an eternity, died just like that. What about the rest of them who were inferior to the Heavenly Emperor? What else could they do now?
They could only sigh, and were confused about their very own future.
They were originally plotting for the position as the Heavenly Emperor, hoping that there would be a sliver of chance to break into the Saint Realm.However, with the Heavenly Emperor failing today and that Jiang Ming was now suppressing them, would they even have a chance to shine?
The person who felt the most complicated at heart was none other than Great Monarch Tian Song.
Looking at the corpse of Venerate Tai Yin with his eyes filled with complication, his face was distorted, and he felt disgusted. ‘God damn it! I’ve been fawning over a… a…’
It was then that Jiang Ming turned around and looked at Linglong. “Do you want me to avenge you?”
Ever since Jiang Ming left Tianyuan Realm to meet up with Bai Zizai, he had already started to merge his heart with the heavens, probing into various things. In fact, what he cared most about was Linglong’s past.
He had nothing much to say about himself. He was rescued by his master from that incident back then. He knew well that the past had long become clouds, drifting away.
Linglong’s life experience however, was a mystery. After making some deduction and probing into the past, he learned of the details.
“Senior brother, you knew.” Linglong became slightly depressed. Upon seeing Jiang Ming nodding, she said again, “I’ve actually known about it for a long time but didn’t have the capability to take revenge. I could only wait in silence.”
Suddenly, Linglong was filled with vigor. While her eyes were gleaming, the killing intent radiating from her shot through the clouds. “It’s different now! Senior brother, I now have the capability to take my revenge. Leave it to me.”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming nodded.
In fact, Linglong’s life experience was very simple.
In the past, when the last Heavenly Emperor was still sitting on the throne, Phoenix Fengli was the master of the Demon Holy Palace. She felt that it was immensely difficult for her cultivation realm to improve further. After thinking it through, she was ready to head towards the Chaos to explore.
However, when she reached the Chaos, she encountered a great storm in the Chaos and was swept into it. With her life hanging on the line, she was saved by a human that dwelled into the Chaos to escape himself from the many others plotting against him.
He was Zi Xiao.
The two of them worked hand in hand, endured various hardships together through life and death. When they finally returned from the Chaos, the two of them were already in love.
Although Zi Xiao returned from the Chaos, he hid in the dark and was planning for the future of the human race.
After besieging the previous Great Demon Venerate, while Zi Xiao was dealing with the previous Heavenly Emperor, he appeared just because Phoenix Fengli was about to be in danger. However, being of the human race himself but stepped into the later stage of the Quasi-Sage, he was targeted by Tai Yuan and the Dragon Monarch. In the end, he died on the battlefield.
Phoenix Fengli went mad but was severely injured.
During that period of time, she was already pregnant with a child. Upon her return from the battlefield, she had an uneasy premonition and gave birth to the child ahead of schedule. After much hesitation, she extracted the Phoenix bloodline from her child, leaving only a hidden trace of it. If there were no accident in the future, it wouldn’t be too late to integrate the bloodline back into her child in the future.
Phoenix Fengli sealed her own memory into the depths of the child’s bloodline at the same time, not allowing the memory to surface until the child reached the Quasi-Sage realm.
Her uneasy premonition really came true and she died soon after.
Endless years had passed and the land that was sealed by her finally collapsed. The defensive measures that she left behind allowed the newborn to be descended into the mortal world and was met by Gu Hai.
Although her current body had become Junior Sister Phoenix, she was still able to reopen the sealed information of her past when she stepped into the Quasi-Sage realm, telling her of her identity and enemies.
Linglong was afterall a person that lived through two past lives and was merely emotional for a while. All she could do was to take revenge. What could she do other than that? To cry out loud?
Putting aside the fact that she was already a Quasi-Sage Expert by then, even if she was a normal mortal, would she have cried if she knew of the situation of her parents which she had never even met throughout her life?
It was sensible that she didn’t cry about it.
As Jiang Ming saw his junior sister walking calmly towards the enemy, he was very emotional. He suddenly remembered the film and television drama of his past life: Childhood playmates separated when they were still young yet still remembering each other after more than ten years and even falling in love with each other.
Such a story was pure bullshit.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - Invasion from the Chaos Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Invasion from the Chaos Realm
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Linglong stopped on her tracks not far from Vermillion Bird, the palace master of the Demon Holy Palace. She looked indifferent on the surface but her murderous intent was already raging within.
Standing beside her were nine of her clones.
“Fellow Daoist Linglong, there shouldn’t be any grudges between the two of us right?” Vermillion Bird frowned, feeling extremely uneasy.
After carefully combing through her memories of the past, she confirmed that other than the slight contradictions she had with Jiang Ming, she didn’t have much interaction with this junior sister of his.
It was when she suddenly looked over at Junior Sister Phoenix that her expression changed. The memories of the past started to resurface from the back of her mind. She remembered now. Back then, Phoenix Fengli was pregnant. Vermillion Bird found out that Phoenix Fengli had already given birth to the child at some point yet she was unable to find the child however she tried.
She was irritable for quite a long time back then, but gradually forgot about it as time passed. The newborn was merely a child. Even if the child did grow up well, would the child even be able to reach her level?
It was impossible.
“You finally recognized me, haven’t you?” Junior Sister Phoenix smiled slightly. A pair of wings appeared behind her, covering the sky and the sun as it was engulfed in the flame of the Phoenix. The scorching aura swept throughout like tidal waves.
“Phoenix…” Vermillion Bird’s pupils dilated. “You’re her child?”
“Yes!” Junior Sister Phoenix’s face was darkened. “I am the daughter of Phoenix Fengli, previous Palace Master of the Demon Holy Palace. Back then, my mother was severely injured. She felt that there was a grave crisis pending and so she gave birth to me ahead of schedule. She sealed me in the endless spatial torrents and left her last words. She said that if she was killed, Vermillion Bird must be the culprit.”
“We were like sisters! How could I have killed her?” Vermillion Bird snorted coldly. “You’re really making me wonder if you’re just making excuses to kill off us all. Now with the ten great ancient clans being done for, Tai Yuan killed, Taishang Sword Sect ruined and the Abyss done for, the few of us here are up next. Once you remove the rest of us, this world will belong to the Tianyuan Realm then.”
Dragon Monarch and Heavenly Buddha’s expressions suddenly became stiff.
Junior Sister Phoenix merely sneered, “Do I even need to make up such an excuse to do so? My senior brother has already sanctified the path of Dao. If he wants to kill you all, it would be just a snap of the finger. Vermillion Bird, you coveted the position of the Palace Master back then. However, be it your reputation or cultivation base, you were far inferior than my mother. You never disputed and could only endure it.”
......
“With my mother being severely injured from that battle back then, you saw the opportunity and killed her in the Demon Holy Palace. Otherwise, with her being the Palace Master of the Demon Holy Palace, how could she have died silently?”
“Vermillion Bird! There’s no point in denying it.”
The long sword held in the hands of Junior Sister Phoenix burst out with waves of destructive sword energy. At the same time, the other clones also evoked immeasurable powers, confining the void.
“It seems that you are going to kill me regardless.” Vermillion Bird was depressed and proceeded to reveal, “I’ll admit. I was the one who killed the Palace Master back then. That was because she was blocking my path! How can I even plan on my path towards the Saint Realm without becoming the Palace Master? In fact, I never thought of killing her at all. Yet, what did she do? She actually offered herself to a human being. She was the Palace Master of the Demon Holy Palace, the master of the thousands of beings of the Demon Clan. The thought that she was actually pregnant with a human child, tainting the noble blood of our supreme demon bloodline. This is just unbearable.”
“As such, she can only die. She must die. However...” She paused, then turned to look at Heavenly Buddha and the likes, “I killed Palace Master Fengli, but you two were involved in the death of Linglong’s father.”
“She wants to take revenge for killing her mother, but what about the revenge for killing her father? Do you think she would take revenge on you two?” There are only two paths in front of us, wait for our death, or fight all out.”
Ending that last sentence of her, a savage expression could be seen on Vermillion Bird’s face.
“Go all out?” Linglong had a strange smile on her face. She didn’t let her clone ‘Phoenix’ make the first move.
“Jiang Ming!” the Dragon Monarch suddenly opened his mouth. His voice was deafening, like a thunderous befalling. “There is no right or wrong in the skirmishes of the past. Are you holding on to such trivial matters and wanting to settle it now?”
“This is none of my business. It’s useless for you to tell me so.” Jiang Ming smiled and shook his head.
The Dragon Monarch gasped and looked at Linglong. “Must this be to the death?”
“No doubt about it.” Linglong said in a sonorous voice, “Just come at me together! All of you!”
The Dragon Monarch remained silent while the Heavenly Buddha was speechless. Vermillion Bird merely smiled.
“Not making the first move?” Linglong raised her eyebrows and slashed her sword into the air, “Then just die!”
As soon as she attacked, her nine clones went forth to attack at the same time.
With the ten of them connected through the same mind and primal spirit origin merged into a single Quasi Sage during the attack, it was immensely terrifying, instantly enveloping the three of them.
The other great experts of the Dragon Clan and the Fo Sectt who came forth couldn’t help but rush towards Linglong.
Jiang Ming merely glanced at them. All of them become frozen in place, no longer showing any signs of life. Their will were directly erased, leaving behind just empty carcasses.
“That’s the way to do it!” Bai Zizai said, “Since they are the enemies, just take your actions directly. Kill, and wipe out those that needed to be killed.”
“That’s the truth!” Riyue Changfeng nodded, “If you don’t kill your enemies, it would be an annoyance if left around. Brother Jiang, what are you going to do next?”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan and Great Monarch Wan Lian all looked over eagerly. Never did they expect Jiang Ming to have sanctified the path of Dao. It was even more unexpected that Linglong would wipe out all the greater factions in one fell swoop. Wouldn’t this mean that the Human Race would be the domineering faction from here on out?
Good heavens! Had the hundreds of millions of years of expectation finally come true?
The Great Monarch Wan Lian was so excited that he started to tear up.
“I’ll let Linglong take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor.” Jiang Ming said without any hesitation.
“You are going to be the man behind the Empress now.” Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help but laugh out loud. “Those who don’t know you would’ve thought that you are… *Cough*”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. Well, what’s wrong for me to be a pretty boy? Others wouldn’t even have the chance to be one even if they wanted to.
“It’s actually quite befitting for her to be sitting on the throne. She will be able to gather the luck and fortune. At least she will be able to improve faster in her cultivation base and might be able advance into the Saint Realm in the future.” Bai Zizai very much agreed to the decision and continued, “The position as the Emperor of a great chiliocosm is not of much attraction to a Saint anyways. Brother Jiang, I have something to tell you.”
He had a solemn look on his face.
“Fellow Daoist Bai, what’s the matter?” Seeing the change in Bai Zizai’s expression, Jiang Ming inexplicably felt a little uneasy.
“On my way over here, I discovered a great chiliocosm that was heading towards total destruction in the Chaos. It was being ushered over towards this direction by several Saint Experts.” Bai Zizai then continued. “I have a bad feeling about that chiliocosm and so I didn’t go there. I merely observed for a little and carried on with my way. Based on my estimation, it may take a few decades at least, or hundreds of years at most, before the chiliocosm reaches here.”
“A great chiliocosm on the verge of destruction is ushered towards our direction?” Jiang Ming was taken aback by the news.
He knew that a chiliocosm would eventually meet its death at one point, even if it was a great chiliocosm. Hence, he wasn’t surprised that the chiliocosm was dying. However, he was afraid that for the dying chiliocosm to be ushered towards their direction because it would only mean one thing.
“Are they trying to merge the chiliocosms to strengthen its origin, restore its vitality and delay the world’s demise?” Riyue Changfeng frowned and continued, “Such a feat should seem to be unnecessary for a Saint Expert.”
“Whether it is necessary or not, since it is now being pushed over despite the risk of the destruction of the great chiliocosm, the outcome is already fixed.” Bai Zizai who was equally confused continued, “I actually don’t understand it myself. What’s the point of them doing something so time-consuming, laborious and even putting themselves at risk of backlash?”

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - “I Became the Heavenly Emperor’s Man”
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: “I Became the Heavenly Emperor’s Man”
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Generally speaking, whether the world was destroyed or not had little to do with the Saint Experts. After all, they could travel to the Chaos and head for the Sea of Chaos. Even if they had relatives and friends, a Saint could just break the shackles of the world and take them away together.
Jiang Ming pondered about it for a long time and couldn’t find the reason behind it. As such, he temporarily calmed his mind. He thought he would have enough time to prepare dealing with it since he still has decades to go before that happens.
However, Jiang Ming still couldn’t help but ask, “Fellow Daoist Bai, will there be any King Saints descending?”
“No, there won’t be any.” Bai Zizai shook his head. “In the Sea of Chaos, a King Saint is also considered a magnate among all. When compared to the great chiliocosm, a King Saint is equivalent to that of a Demi-Sage. Why would an existence of such a level even descend to this place?”
“That makes sense!” Jiang Ming was relieved. If there weren’t going to be any King Saints descending, then what was there to be worried about?
The great battle in the distance didn’t last long as Linglong had killed Vermillion Bird and Dragon Monarch before coming back to his side.
“Do you still want more?” Jiang Ming’s heart ached a little when he saw that murderous expression on his junior sister’s face and looked over to the distance.
He was referring to the Dragon Clan, the Demon Holy Palace and the likes.
“Senior brother, there’s no need anymore.” Linglong stood beside him and sighed softly, “I’ve basically killed those who were involved in the plot in the past. Hence, I’ve given an account to the past. Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. Let the past be buried in history. From now on, we’ll look into the future.”
“Haha! Great! Look into the future.” Jiang Ming laughed out loud as he pulled her into his embrace. The fact that his junior sister was able to completely let go of the incident made him happier than obtaining any Saint Weapons.
Yu Fei walked over towards them as she looked at the two with complicated eyes. One had quietly sanctified the path of Dao. The other actually killed Vermillion Bird, the Dragon Monarch and the Heavenly Buddha, who joined hands in resisting her. She was far inferior than the two. There was no way that she was comparable to them. Hence, she decided to cut off those impure thoughts.
“Fellow Daoist Linglong, Brother Jiang, can you let me go? After all, I didn’t participate in it at the beginning, and I didn’t cause any damage to Tianyuan Realm either.”
Her voice was soft and timid, as if she was pleading. Her pair of watery eyes lingered around Jiang Ming as her heart was beating fast. She thought, ‘How great would it be if I am able to spend a night of joy with him. He’s much better than that Saint Demon Venerate bastard.’
......
Unfortunately, she could only have thoughts about this. ‘Alas! The Humans. Why are you so dedicated? The weak serves the strong while the strong dominates the weak. Isn’t it the right and proper way? Yet…’
Jiang Ming thought for a while, then looked at Linglong and said, “Now that the overall structure of the heavens and earth has changed dramatically, the fact that the Human Race being the dominant factions among all is already set in stone. Whether it’s done or not, Tianyuan Realm will be in an absolute hegemonic position anyways. Junior sister, do you want to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor?”
“Senior brother, you don’t want to?” Linglong hugged his arm.
“No, I don’t.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “It’s boring. It’d be better for me to just bask in the sun.”
“You’re just being lazy.” Linglong sneered at him coquettishly and continued, “Then shall I take over? I’ll also be able to gather the boundless luck and fortune to help speed up my cultivation. We’ll be able to integrate the orders of the infinite heavens and truly create a peaceful environment. You can then bask peacefully in the sun.”
“Haha! As long as it pleases you, then it’s good.”
“Hehe! Thank you, senior brother.”
The two of them decided on who would be taking over the position as the Heavenly Emperor themselves as though nobody was around.
All of the experts around the vicinity had a complicated expression on their faces.
This was especially true for Yu Fei. She was roaring continuously to herself, ‘Why can’t I meet such a great guy? Why? I have the most beautiful face, the sweetest voice, the most alluring figure and the most unique temperament! I’ve gathered all the mystifying charms from all over the infinite realm. I’ve been favored by the Saint Demon Venerate, fiddled by the two Great Demon Venerates, imprisoned by the Heavenly Emperor and even given myself to various experts. Yet, not only did I fail to achieve my goal, I even ended up with such a dismal situation.’
“Sigh.” A faint sigh could be heard, giving off a sense of eternal loneliness.
Yun Feiyan’s expression was also slightly complicated. Although she sought the path of Dao with all her heart, she was, after all, a woman. She had her own past and longings as well.
“Men? Hmph! They’ll just affect the speed of my cultivation.” Yun Feiyan suppressed her thoughts.
The happiest of all right at the moment were none other than Mountain Master Tian Yuan and Great Monarch Wan Lian.
“Linglong taking over the position as the Heavenly Emperor?”
“Does that mean that our human race has truly reached the top of the infinite realms?”
“There will no longer be suppression and hidden schemes behind. With the foundation and the comprehensive ability of our human race, we will definitely improve drastically.”
“It’ll only take 100 million years, no, it’ll only take 10 million years! The number of Quasi-Sage among our Human Race will exceed those of the other races combined!”
“If the resources are tipped towards us, coupled with the Heavenly Emperor and Jiang Ming preaching of Dao, then…”
As soon as they reached such a thought, the two of them shuddered in pure excitement.
Just as Jiang Ming was about to leave, Yun Feiyan suddenly spoke, “Sister Linglong, can I spar with you?”
“My cultivation base is higher than yours.” Linglong shook her head.
“I’m from the Sea of Chaos and I can be compared with a peak Quasi-Sage.” Yun Feiyan didn’t back down and continued, “I’ve traveled with my master across the infinite realm and challenged countless experts. I already have a rudiment on integrating the infinite laws into one. With my Dao, I’ll definitely not disappoint you.”
As Yun Feiyan made her remark, she looked over at Bai Zizai and said, “Master, please evoke the battle arena.”
“Alright!” Bai Zizai replied. He casually swung his arm and a great luminance could be seen falling from the sky, expanding almost instantly, forming a ten-thousand feet wide arena.
At the same time, he explained to all, “This is a Saint Weapon. Its suppressive power is great and can withstand the bombardment of powerful attacks. It will refrain the ripples and aftermath of the great battle from spreading to the outside and is enough for those below the Saint Realm to carry on their battles inside!”
“By the honor of a Saint, I now make a declaration! My disciple, Yun Feiyan, is at the peak stage of the Great Overarching Realm. She has the capability to compete with that of a peak stage Quasi-Sage. Now, she would like to challenge the various experts of this realm. The victor will receive a peak-level Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel.” Bai Zizai transmitted his voice in all directions.
Jiang Ming however, shook his head and said, “Fellow Daoist Bai, given the current situation of my realm over here, there are not many experts who can train with Miss Bai. Rather than wasting time, it’s better to just collect all kinds of special abilities to be comprehended.”
“The battle feeds itself. That’s her cultivation path!” Bai Zizai gently replied.
Jiang Ming merely gave a smile.
After pondering for a little while, Linglong decided to go for it. “Alright then. I’ll try you out!” As she gave her reply, Linglong flew towards the arena.
“Thank you!” Yun Feiyan was overjoyed. She also landed in the battle arena, stopping a hundred meters away from Linglong.
The suppressive force in the battle arena was more than 10,000 times that of the outside. It was just right for experts like them to exchange blows.
“Linglong, why did you not bring along your clones?” Yun Feiyan frowned and continued, “I’m from the Sea of Chaos and have traveled through various great chiliocosms. I have special abilities and techniques that surpass the ordinary great chiliocosm, coupled with a supreme divine body.”
“My inheritance isn’t weaker than yours.” A strange look flashed through Linglong’s face as she continued, “For this battle of ours, it should be me bullying you. Feiyan, make your move. Let me see how powerful the special abilities from the Sea of Chaos can be.”
With a long sword held in her hand, the Sword Sambodha gushing on top of her head materialized itself. It was as though the whole battle arena was going to be ripped apart. As for the Immortal bell, she put them away.
“As you wish!” Yun Feiyuan replied. A long sword suddenly appeared in her hand as well. Its immortal luminance burst forth with ten thousand sword qi. With a wave of her hand, thousands of sword qi swarmed towards Linglong.
Linglong wielded her sword horizontally across the sky, as if she was cutting the world in half, blocking all of the sword qi outside.
With that, the great battle between the two erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Chenxi in Danger, Jiang Ming Enraged
chapters.content:
434  Chenxi in Danger, Jiang Ming Enraged
Jiang Ming started to become annoyed as he went on a frenzy from his anger and went all out. As such, junior sister fell asleep during the afternoon from exhaustion.
"Phew." Jiang Ming laid back on his reclining chair and let out a long breath.
'It becomes monotonous as time goes by.' He wasn't bored or frustrated, but was actually numb from doing it.
Jiang Ming secretly communicated with the Supreme Order, entered the Supreme Pagoda and came to his exclusive cultivation space. After slightly checking his own status, he sat cross-legged directly and adjusted his mental state to its peak.
He then took out the Heavenly Dao Sacred Heart Fruit and swallowed the whole thing in one bite. It had a tingling sweetness to it and tasted like cherry. As soon as he ate the fruit, it turned into a mysterious energy that went straight into his subconscious, fusing into his soul. Immediately after, Jiang Ming felt a black cloud of smoke evaporating from his soul that seeped through his subconscious and dissipated as soon as it was out of his body.
The shrunken soul began to swell. In a blink of an eye, his power began to sky-rocket as though it was never ending.
He progressively underwent sublimation, transformation and condensation of cultivation. Vaguely, Jiang Ming felt as though he had stepped into the next level, but hadn't fully advanced into the level just yet.
It was akin to that first night of the bridal chamber. Because of it being too short, the guy could only linger around the entrance and didn't even manage to penetrate through the membrane.
'Does this count as breaking and entering? Maybe? Maybe not. Who knows?'
After a very long time, Jiang Ming finally opened his eyes and he was brimming in happiness.
'The volume and quality of my soul has reached the limits of Saint Dao. No, it has surpassed the limits and now even has some of the characteristics of the King Saint's. This here is a Quasi-King Saint level soul. It's truly immortal, indestructible and incorruptible throughout the great chiliocosms. Even if I were to release my soul into the open, a full force attack from a Saint Weapon would find it difficult to destroy it.'
Jiang Ming was pleasantly surprised.
This wasn't just an ordinary improvement, but a huge improvement at that. He felt that his current soul's strength was equivalent to that of when he activated the Three World Tree back at the galaxy.
09:47
Seconds Tenfold Soul Booster Card and merged his subconscious with the Chaos World Tree back at the galaxy.
That was a true power that can really sweep through the entire world.
He was able to be under such a power spike for 3 seconds before this, but he finally could maintain it indefinitely now. Or rather, what if he was to merge his subconscious with the Chaotic World Tree now?
'How powerful will it be? Would it allow me to even go up against those of the King Saint Realm?'
Jiang Ming's heart was beating furiously.
Power sourced from a person's self-confidence. It was the cornerstone of a person's courage and a favorite trait of men. From a certain point of view, it was charming to be all powerful. After further consolidating his cultivation, he strived to fully master his soul power that sky-rocketed from ingesting the fruit. Only then did he merge the Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos into his inner world, placing it under the Chaotic World Tree. It was apparent that this Long River of Innate Vital Essence was prepared just for his Chaotic World Tree.
As for the Heart of the Middle Chiliocosm? He merged the heart into the core of his inner world.
Finally, Jiang Ming began to refine the Heaven-Shattering Spear and took stock of the various Dao vessels that he had.
The path of cultivation was extremely dull and boring. However, he managed to have his inner world to improve a lot.
After he finished refining the Heaven-Shattering Spear, Jiang Ming continued to perfect the various special abilities that he had, especially the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique. Although he couldn't completely take control over the enemy's Saint Weapon, he was now capable of affecting them with ease. As for detonating a Quasi-Sage Weapon, it no longer affected him at all.
However, the Infinite Transcendence Technique was different. Even though the prowess of this technique increased along with his improvement in cultivation base, it still didn't improve further.
As for the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique, it was constantly improving and its power was increasing rapidly. This technique was a supreme special ability that merged three thousand laws and three thousand Daos into a single body. With every restructuring and merging of these laws and Daos, its power increased substantially.
Jiang Ming had a feeling that even if this technique of his was merging only the Great Overarching Laws, he believed that he could destroy a whole great chiliocosm with just this finger of his when fully evoked.
Just like the ten numbers having at least 100 million combinations, what about three thousand laws then? Also, there were at least trillions of variation to each of the laws. Which type of fusion would allow this technique to achieve its perfect state?
Jiang Ming didn't know either. However, Jiang Ming had the inner world as reference. He was able to gradually move forward with the fusion of these three thousand laws towards its perfect state. One day, Jiang Ming finally stood up.
'The Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos has been completely absorbed by the World Tree. Its height has directly reached the level of a thousand light-year. This is simply incredible! Just a single tree turned into a whole galaxy. Fortunately, the starry sky of a middle chiliocosm is enough to withhold the power. Otherwise, my inner world would've been busted apart. The middle chiliocosm has also reached its current limit already. If I were to improve further, I'll have to advance into the great chiliocosm!'
Throughout this session of cultivation, Jiang Ming's improvement was by no means a little, but a huge one at that.
By only taking into account the benefits reflected from the growth of his World Tree, those resources were already enough to allow his Half-King Saint level soul to go a step further. It seemed that he would be able to really step into the King Saint Realm anytime soon.
His current state was equivalent to having pierced through a small part of the membrane, but yet to have completely broken through. By slightly pushing through with just a little bit more, that membrane would've been pierced through with a "pop".
Even his physique also received beneficial reflection from his inner world's improvement as his body was constantly undergoing transformation, allowing him to continuously strengthen himself. "Sigh, I'm improving too fast this time." Jiang Ming let out a narcissistic sigh.
With a thought in his mind, he appeared at the lower level of the Supreme Pagoda, landing right next to Ye Qingxian. This fairy-like lady was still reading books with great interest here as she always did.
Some of them were left by Luo Heng, but the majority of it came from the friends of the Chat Room. She was ready to learn from the strength of the others and walk on her own path.
"Brother Jiang, long time no see!" Ye Qingxian became extremely delighted as she put down her books and hurriedly made tea.
"It's been a while." Jiang Ming sat across from her. After all, a thousand years in the outside world was equivalent to a day in the Supreme Pagoda. Jiang Ming hasn't visited her for a few days already.
"How is it?" Jiang Ming accepted the cup of tea from her, took a sip and asked with a smile.
"Same old same old." Ye Qingxian replied, "I read books in my spare time, practice my cultivation occasionally and chatted with the other members from the Chat Room from time to time. How about you? I've heard from Luo Heng that you've been showing off back at his place, destroying dozens of experts whose cultivation bases are equivalent to the Saints in just one battle. That was really unimaginable."
It was more than unimaginable. When Luo Heng told this story, almost no one among their Chat Room believed him.
After all, it might've been possible that Jiang Ming had ascended into the Saint Realm. However, to be able to destroy dozens of Saints right after just advancing into the Saint Realm itself?
Wasn't that just pulling on people's legs? Luo Heng's words were so convincing that they had to believe it was true. This was especially the case when it was about Jiang Ming, their former Group Admin who had realized so many miracles before already.
In Dongfang Chenxi's words, 'I would've believed it even if you said that Brother Jiang has sanctified the great Dao.'
"You can do it in the future too!" Jiang Ming smiled. As for Luo Heng exposing these stories? Luo Heng had already asked the avatar from over his universe, saying that it was too torturous not to share such an overwhelming the future. Even better if you bring over something good to eat and drink!"
09:48
"Alright then. If you do want to return, just tell me anytime!" As Jiang Ming replied to battle record of his.
Jiang Ming himself no longer minded if the others knew that he could descend into the other realms. He had been hiding about it long enough. Moreover, now that he had advanced into the Saint Realm, there was really no reason to continue hiding about it. "Me too?" Ye Qingxian smiled and shook her head, "I don't have the slightest confidence!"
"As long as you stay here and keep accumulating, improving, and advancing further, you will be able to advance into the Saint Realm sooner or later." Jiang Ming pointed towards the Battle Towers.
Ye Qingxian nodded her head in response. "If it goes on like this, I might really have hope of doing so." After a slight pause, she became extremely prideful as she remarked, "It's just a few Saints! If Brother Jiang can kill them, so can I!"
"Haha! That's the self-confidence and pride that you should have!" Jiang Ming laughed out loud and continued, "Would you like to return? The troubles back in your world can be resolved already."
Ye Qingxian hesitated at first, but finally shook her head and said emotionally, "Now that there's no longer anything that I hold dear there, does it even matter if I return? It's better for me to continue my cultivation here. It's much quieter here and I feel at more ease. It's just that I would like Brother Jiang to come to see me every so often in the future. Even better if you bring over something good to eat and drink!"
"Alright then. If you do want to return, just tell me anytime!" As Jiang Ming replied to her, he could feel his Supreme Order vibrating and realized that it was a private chat prompt from Dongfang Chenxi. "Brother Jiang Ming, did you really advance into the Saint Realm? Can you really take down a Saint now?"
"Of course, Chenxi. Did something happen?" Jiang Ming's heart couldn't help but sink as he quickly replied to the message.
The person who was the closest to him within the chat group was indisputably Dongfang Chenxi. She was the one who offered help when he was still weak. Although Dongfang Chenxi didn't descend over his realm to help him out, Jiang Ming had always remembered her kindness in his heart.
Hearing her asking such a question now, Jiang Ming had a bad feeling in his heart. Dongfang Chenxi: "Sob, sob. Brother Jiang! My father was targeted by the Saint Sect and is now being trapped in a huge formation. Everyone said that he will be killed soon. Brother Jiang Ming, can you come over? Ah! That's not good! The palace gate over at my place has been breached…" Upon hearing her words, Jiang Ming's expression took a dive.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - The 50th Year Anniversary had Come
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: The 50th Year Anniversary had Come
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
There were more and more spectators. However, most of them were human experts. After all, the battle arena was located in the Tianyuan Sea.
Great Monarch Wan Lian had also sent out messages one after another, beaconing the Human experts of the Hall of Human Emperor in seclusion all this while so that they would come out and to assist Linglong.
Jiang Ming sat cross-legged in heaven. Sat beside him were Bai Zizai and Riyue Changfeng. As for the others, simply sensing their aura had caused them to tremble uncontrollably, let alone coming near them.
“You’re good. You already have the spirit of a Saint Realm while you are still at the Demi-Sage Realm. Seems like you’re not far away from sanctifying the path of Dao yourself.” Bai Zizai commented as he looked at Riyue Changkong. “The path of Dao cultivation of the Infinite Realm Auction House is mysterious indeed.”
“The path of Dao cultivation is indeed mysterious.” Riyue Changkong admitted and continued, “It’s just that I’m still slightly lacking at it. Senior, who do you think is stronger between the two?”
“The two of them have similar physiques. Their sword Dao power is similar as well. However, one is of the Great Overarching Realm, while the other is a Quasi-Sage.” Bai Zizai smiled as he said, “This little girl Feiyan has finally met a good opponent.”
Jiang Ming who was sitting right next to him had a strange look flashing through his face. He knew how powerful his junior sister’s true self was.
Not only did she inherit the legacy of the Heavenly Order, she had also comprehended various special abilities that Jiang Ming imparted to her which even included the Sword tome. Hence, her swordsmanship had reached a very high level already.
When she was fighting against Chong Shan earlier, she mobilized the power of the Dao vessels. After that, when she fought against Vermillion Bird and the likes, she evoked Dao vessels for quite a few times to quickly finish up the battle. Also, she had nine other clones with her.
It could be said that neither her clones nor her true self had fully extended all of their powers.
Was Yun Feiyan strong? Yes, she was much stronger beyond common sense. However, when compared to Linglong, she was far from it.
Sure enough, it didn’t take long before Yun Feiyan could be seen thrown off into the distance.
......
“This is strong!” Yun Feiyan’s eyes suddenly lit up. Her fighting spirit sky-rocketed. Power of divinity burst out of her body, surrounding her, and distorting the air around the place.
“Linglong, I have a sword called Samsara. It allows the fusion of various laws, contains thousands of Sword Sambodha,and adopts the boundless wonders of Reincarnation.” Yun Feiyan roared, while thousands of laws appeared along with the sword, forming a sword formation.
The sword qi fluctuated between reality and illusion, going in an endless cycling. With each cycle however, the sword qi became stronger.
“What great power of reincarnation.” While exclaiming, Linglong continued to withstand the attack before finally putting on a serious look on her face. “I have a sword as well. As the sword unsheathes, tens of thousands of laws will be decimated. It’s called the Lawless Sword!”
A mysterious fluctuation rippled out of her body. It contained the will that annihilates all laws. As the sword luminance rose above, Yun Feiyan’s special ability was easily laid bare. The overwhelming momentum from the slash rolled over, as though the orders of law had collapsed and the infinite laws had come to an end.
“Such domineering power!” Yun Feiyan kept retreating with an astonished look on her face. As she turned her wrist the other way, she evoked another special ability, “The End.”
The end of all beings, the final destination of all time and space was none other than the end.
“The End, what a great technique! Daoless Sword!” Linglong’s Sword Sambodha was even stronger as it annihilated the infinite laws, destroying the great Dao. Under the destructive power of the long sword, the power of Dao and Laws became non-existence, as if everything ceased to exist.
This technique was a higher level than that of The End technique. It slashed toward Yun Feiyan, blood could be seen trickling from the corner of her lips.
“Saintless Sword.” Linglong’s imposing momentum rose once again. Vaguely, it seemed to have entered another level, transcending oneself, the realm and the Great Dao. As the sword unsheathed itself, even Saints were forced to bow under such oppression.
The long sword fell, directly suppressing Yun Feiyan. No matter how much she tried to struggle free, it was difficult for her to resist such an oppressive force.
She thought of evoking the Dao vessel that was suppressed inside her body. However, seeing that Linglong was able to completely suppress herself with just a single sword, she gave up the idea of doing so.
The sword’s luminance slowly dissipated, followed by the convergence of their aura.
“I’ve finally met a worthy opponent!” Yun Feiyan let out a sigh of relief as she looked at Linglong with fiery eyes, “I once met an opponent who defeated me when he was only of the Taiyi Realm. That person appeared to be humble and gentle from the eye, but was extremely prideful on the inside. He merely entertained the challenges that I waged against him, yet I was helpless about it.”
“He made me gradually grind away my arrogant thoughts. However, fighting with him never once felt exhilarating.”
“Wandering through the infinite realms, there were too few that could contend with me at the same cultivation realm. It was close to none. But now, I’ve met you!”
“Linglong, from this battle of ours, you’ve really ignited my spirit and passion.”
“I’ve made up my mind. From now on, I will always see you as my rival, right till the day I defeat you! As for the compensation? I’ll share with you all the special abilities that I’ve collected from traveling across the infinite realms.*
Yun Feiyan was very excited about the battle.
Linglong took a glance at Bai Zizai who was standing right next to Jiang Ming, then pointed to her nine clones and said, “Each and every one of them has similar combat power to mine. If you would like to fight me in the future, just look for them.”
“Your clone’s combat power is similar to that of yours?” Yun Feiyan was shocked, “All nine of them?”
“Of course!”
“Linglong, you’re truly amazing!”
Yun Feiyan sighed in amazement, but her eyes lit up even more. The fighting spirit was oozing out of her body like a gushing fountain as she said excitedly, “Just wait till I recover a little, I’ll challenge them one by one. Haha! This is great! Never have I thought that I’d meet such a strong expert like you after traveling through so many realms. You are all of a different body but of the same mind. Fighting with each of you would mean that I’ll be up against different special abilities. On the other hand, you would be able to learn of my techniques and abilities, gradually forming tactics to counter my attacks. This will also help me to quickly learn of my own weaknesses.”
Linglong was rendered speechless from her remarks.
On the other side, Jiang Ming and the other two were discussing among themselves.
“One true body with nine clones. If all of them have similar combat power, she’ll definitely be able to go against the Saint upon entering the Demi-Sage Realm.” Riyue Changkong exclaimed, “She wouldn’t even need a Saint Weapon to exchange blows with the Saints! Senior Yun, there aren’t many of such existence in the Sea of Chaos, right?”
“She doesn’t even need to achieve the Demi-Sage Realm. She’d be able to go toe to toe with the Saints already once she is at the peak stage of the Quasi-Sage realm.” Yun Zizai was also astonished as he continued, “Her Sword Dao’s special ability has completely reached the level of the Saint Dao already. With all ten bodies sharing the same mind, their teamwork would be as though they were the same person. Once she advances into the Demi-Sage Realm, she might even be able to kill an initial stage of a Saint Expert, stronger than you are.”
“I’m afraid she’s already stronger than me.” Riyue Changfeng smiled wryly, then looked at Jiang Ming and said, “You two are both monsters.”
“We’re just lucky to have some great encounters. That’s all!” Jiang Ming replied.
From there, Five Elemental Junior Sister headed towards the Heavenly Realm, accompanied by Mountain Master Tian Yuan, Great Monarch Wan Lian and a group of Great Overarching Golden Immortals. They were going to rebuild the Heaven Court.
As for Linglong’s real self? She was brought back to Chuyang Peak by Jiang Ming.
It was safer here. Her clones could do all the work for her, just in case anything happens. Linglong wouldn’t need to be there for it. As for the remaining eight clones, they remained above Tianyuan Sea and fought against Yun Feiyan respectively.
This arrogant lady from the Sea of Chaos continued to suffer defeats one after another.
Back on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was laying on a reclining chair.
“Senior Brother, let’s squeeze over abit.” Linglong squeezed herself a small space and lay beside Jiang Ming. “You’re just leaving a Saint outside Chuyang Peak like that?”
“Well, I’ve invited him to come inside, but he didn’t want to. I’m not to be blamed for this.” Jiang Ming smiled as he said, “Maybe he already sensed the difference inside and was afraid that he would never be able to leave if he came in.”
“That should be it.” Otherwise, he would’ve respected you when you invited him.” Linglong placed his senior brother’s arm under her neck and used it as her pillow. She looked at the white clouds in the sky and said, “I can’t believe that I was able to take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor one day, becoming the supreme almighty Heavenly Emperor.”
“How do you feel?”
“Prideful and heroic! Haha! You’ve seen it as well. When I said that we will be rebuilding the Heaven Court, many of the Great Overarching Golden Immortals of our human race were dancing with joy. There were more than a thousand of them who went forth with me to rebuild it. Just wait till the Heaven Court becomes completely rebuilt, there will no longer be any factions that would be able to shake the status of us Human Race.*
“That’s for sure! Little girl! As for the ten ancient great clans, Dragon Clan, Demon Holy Palace, the Abyss and the likes, how are you planning to go about with them?”
“Senior Brother, do you have any idea?”
“I don’t. You can do whatever you want!”
“Is that so? Then just wait till I officially take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor. I’ll order for the extermination of the so-called ten ancient great clans. I’ll keep a few of the young ones in captivity as our mascots. There’s also the development of the Abyss into a training ground for the Heaven Court. As for the Demon Holy Palace? I’ll exterminate them; the Dragons? I’ll keep them in captivity for you so that you can conveniently use them as cooking ingredients; as for the Fo Sect? Let’s see if they behave themselves.”
“Little girl, you are such domineering!”
“Hehe! Of course! I’m the almighty supreme Empress!”
“So what if you’re an empress? You are still below me!”
“Hehe! I’ll want to be on top from now on!”
“How bold of you to rebel!”
“Senior brother, it’s because you’re too lazy to even move.”
After a few days went by, Jiang Ming welcomed the 50th-year anniversary.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - The Great Reward of the 50th Year
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: The Great Reward of the 50th Year
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
It was the middle of the night.
Jiang Ming raised his head and gazed at the twinkling stars above.
The quiet peaceful night sky was the same as it has always been for eternity. The night gave off a feeling of loneliness and desolation.
Jiang Ming continued laying down quietly. His right arm was used as a pillow by Linglong as she was squinting her eyes like a little kitten, taking sniffs of his smell and enjoying the tranquility of their world in solitude.
Back in the Battle Arena above Tian Yuan Sea, Yun Feiyan was in the midst of a great battle with Junior Sister ‘Reincarnation’. The two of them had been going at it for a whole full day and it was apparent that junior sister had been taking it easy on her. However, this was also equivalent to junior sister tempering herself.
Jiang Ming withdrew his gaze and was slightly excited at heart. The time has finally come. It was the 50th year since the System began operating.
As midnight struck, the daily prompt of the system sounded yet again.
“Ding: “Congratulations to the host on living for fifty consecutive years on Chuyang Peak, insisting on taking a meal a day here. You’re rewarded with a complete Heart of Middle Chiliocosm, Heavenly Dao Sacred Heart Fruit, Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos and the Heaven-shattering Spear.”
There weren’t that many rewards this time around. There were only four of them. However, each and every one of them made Jiang Ming ecstatic.
A complete Heart of Middle Chiliocosm was equivalent to the condensation of an intact middle chiliocosm without any losses whatsoever. Once it was integrated into his inner world and was completely digested, it would definitely improve his middle chiliocosm to its pinnacle stage.
The remit from his middle chiliocosm reaching its pinnacle stage would allow his Saint Soul to directly reach the perfect stage of a Saint. His many Laws of Great Overarching would also be fully conceived.
As for the Heavenly Dao Sacred Heart Fruit, the Heavenly Dao referred to the Heavenly Dao’s origin of the great chiliocosm. Jiang Ming consumed Saint Heart Fruit before, but this one was obviously much stronger.
Consuming it would further condense Jiang Ming’s soul, up to the level of a King Saint Realm. This was more than amazing. It was simply unimaginable to think that a single piece of fruit would improve one’s soul up to such a level. Looking through the great chiliocosms, who would even believe this? Absolutely no one would because this was too sky-defying.
......
As for the Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos? Well, this was a real river that spanned into the distance.
Previously when it was the 20th anniversary of the System’s operation, the reward was a stream of such a river. This time however, it was a whole stretch of river. A Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos that stretched 200,000- kilometers long.
The power contained within the flowing river was more terrifying than that of the Heart of Middle Chiliocosm.
If there weren’t any restriction for a middle chiliocosm to advance into a Great chiliocosm, Jiang Ming believed that his inner world would directly advance into the great chiliocosm level by simply relying on this Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos.
‘This can be absorbed by the Chaotic World Tree!’ Jiang Ming had already hatched a plan.
He had decided to let his inner world digest the Heart of a Middle Chiliocosm, while the Chaotic World Tree absorbs from the long river. With the two growing simultaneously, Jiang Ming’s cultivation base would improve rapidly.
This was especially the case when it came to the Chaos World Tree. Once it completely absorbed the Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos, it might even reach its real matured state.
A matured World Tree. Just thinking about it made Jiang Ming yearn for it even more.
The last item which was the Heaven-shattering Spear caused Jiang Ming to be even more excited. It was a supreme Dao vessel that was beyond his imagination, a King Saint weapon.
King Saint was a level beyond the Saint and was equivalent to the Heavenly Dao of a great chiliocosm. A King Saint Weapon was naturally a supreme and terrifying weapon that contained a King Saint’s power.
“It would be nice if it was a whole set.” Jiang Ming muttered to himself.
“Senior brother, what whole set are you talking about?” Linglong raised her little head as she continued, “We’ve tried out every position there is to try just then. Isn’t that a whole set already? Senior brother, could it be that you’ve developed some new poses?”
Linglong’s eyes were sparkling like the twinkling stars.
Jiang Ming was puzzled momentarily. After coming to his senses, his face was trembling as he asked, “Haven’t you had enough?”
“Well, this is the most primitive, most instinctive, greatest, most sacred, most joyful and most nostalgic sport. How would there be enough of it? How can that be?” Linglong remarked as though it was all natural to be so and looked over at his senior brother with a grinning face. With a cold-shouldered look, she continued, “Could it be that you can’t already?”
“Hmph! It’s no use aggravating me! I’m already used to it!” Jiang Ming sneered.
“Heh! You’re done for!” Linglong pouted. “To think that you are not even comparable to a little girl like me at such acts of intimacy. To think that you’re even at the Saint Realm.”
“You’re looking for some spanking!” Jiang Ming became furious.
“Well, walk the walk then!” Linglong was eager to try him.
The two engaged in the nightly sports yet again.
At dawn the next day, Jiang Ming massaged his waist as he started to prepare breakfast.
In reality, Jiang Ming’s primal spirit was of the Saints, but his physical body was far from evolving into the pinnacles. He was still lacking and it almost made him fail to satisfy his junior sister.
It was a simple breakfast, eight cold and eight hot dishes, coupled with eight nourishing soup.
The two of them happily enjoyed their breakfast.
“Oh yeah! Senior Brother! Aren’t you going to bring Xi Yao back with us?” Linglong naturally placed the Dragon’s Whip into Jiang Ming’s bowl, as she drank a bowl of clear soup instead.
“What? Are you really pushing your senior brother over to others?” Jiang Ming said speechlessly, “Better yet, what if I ask for Yu Fei to come over then? I’ll only have to extend an invite and she’ll definitely rush over.”
“If she really does come over, you’d die from exhaustion for sure.” Linglong said indifferently, “You can’t even deal with me and yet you’re still thinking of looking for her? Heh! Besides, you’d be disgusted.”
“Then why did you bring her up then?”
“You’re the one who brought her up!”
“Did I? That’s not it! You were the one who brought up Xi Yao!”
The two of them continued to bicker as they slowly enjoyed their breakfast.
“Sigh…” Linglong suddenly let out a sigh and Jiang Ming looked over at her.
“You’ve already advanced into the Saint Lord Realm and I’m about to ascend onto the Throne as the Heavenly Emperor. Now that we are standing at the peak of this Honggu Heavenly Realm, we no longer feel any pressure. Yet, I’m suddenly feeling at a loss.” Linglong muttered softly.
“Just wait for a little more!” Jiang Ming paused as he replied. He knew what his junior sister was talking about.
The fact that there were only the two of them made it quite lonely after all. Even the mountain was too quiet.
In the past, the two of them had to desperately improve their cultivation due to various pressures from different factions. They put everything else on hold and focused on their cultivation. Now that the pressure was gone, they no longer had to cultivate with grit. Hence, they started to feel that life had become somewhat boring.
Or rather. Junior sister wanted to have children of their own.
“Do we still have to wait?” Linglong pouted.
“There’s still the Sea of Chaos.” Jiang Ming raised his head and gazed into the depth of the torrents of space and time. “Wait till we stand at the pinnacle there. We’ll work harder on it then.”
“Who knows how long it would take for us to reach that day? Even if that day has come, I’m afraid it would be even harder for us to do so already. Senior brother, we are both humans. A life without a child is an incomplete life. As for worrying about the child being your weakness if we had one, are you really afraid of that? I won’t believe it. After all, you have that inner world of yours. Senior Brother, are you actually just making light of me all this time?”
“How could I make light of you?” Jiang Ming sat himself next to her and hugged her in his arms, “It’s just that I’m still a little nervous of the future. I’m still a little confused and uncertain. I’ve said this before, so let’s just let the course run naturally. If we do bear a child, so be it. If we don’t, there isn’t a need to force it.”
“But you almost never let loose.”
*Cough*
What more could Jiang Ming say other than replying, “I’ll try my best from now on. Or rather, I’ll give it my all next time and strive to cover the whole galaxy in one go.”
“You said it!”
“Of course!”
“Senior brother, stop eating. Let’s go for another round.”
*Pfft…*
Jiang Ming almost spat out a mouthful of blood upon hearing her request. He continued to eat his breakfast slowly.
Linglong was very dissatisfied. She opened her mouth wide and swallowed all the food in one gulp. Then, she stared at her senior brother with her glistening eyes, as if to say: Senior brother, are you afraid? Are you not a man anymore?
“Bring it on then!” Jiang Ming went all out. How could he be afraid of a little girl! Alas! Human life was but the process of sports.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - Descending into the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Descending into the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming always remembered Dongfang Chenxi in his heart. She was a person who had always worshiped him and helped him selflessly. In fact, he himself was also planning to give her a visit to at least help her evolve her inner world into the small chiliocosm.
When he heard her plea for help, Jiang Ming didn’t hesitate at all. He said his goodbyes to Ye Qingxian and swiftly returned to Chuyang Peak.
Immediately after, he locked on onto Dongfang Chenxi coordinate and descended into another great chiliocosm.
It was the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, where Dongfang Chenxi was residing. His father was Great Emperor Dongfang, a great Quasi-Sage expert.
In the depths of the endless starry sky, a palace that appeared out of thin air was attacked by many experts. Various large formations enveloping the palace were breached one after another as the restraints were destroyed layer after layer.
Deep in the palace, Dongfang Chenxi sat on the palace throne. She was pale as a ghost, but kept her composure, pretending to be calm.
Many of the palace maids were in a panic, while the guards were standing guard outside, evoking the formation to defend themselves.
‘Father has been entrapped. His last message transmitted was for me to escape into the torrents of the void. Yet it’s still too late! My father is Great Emperor Dongfang! To think that they dare blatantly go against him like this! Sacred Lands! The Sacred Lands have a bunch of really lawless beings! And the Heaven Court, why aren’t they taking any actions? What should I do?’
Dongfang Chenxi was feeling extremely helpless. Feeling the constant fluctuations of the great formations and the layers of restraint collapsing rapidly, her heart was full of despair. She suddenly thought of Jiang Ming.
‘Can brother Jiang really cross worlds?’ Such a thought suddenly appeared in Dongfang Chenxi’s mind.
A few days ago, Luo Heng even told of Jiang Ming’s deeds back in the group chat where he took down more than a dozen of Saint Experts by himself. It was a truly sky-defying feat.
As soon as such a thought crossed her mind, she communicated through the Supreme Order.
When she heard Jiang Ming replying, she was overjoyed. Yet, just when she was sending the messages, a deafening explosion erupted right outside her palace. The great formations had been completely breached and the palace was collapsing. Dongfang Chenxi’s little face instantly turned as pale as ghosts.
......
“It’s over!” Her eyes were full of despair. Even if her brother Jiang Ming could cross over to her world, it would definitely take a long time to travel through the endless Chaos to get to her.
A group of experts rushed in and slaughtered many of the guards. Many of the palace maids died, while the rest of them retreated into the palace.
“Chang Yang, stop this instance!” Dongfang Chenxi stood up and shouted at the intruder as she suppressed the fear in her heart. She waved her hands at the same time, luminance covered the entire palace hall, protecting the remaining maiden from harm’s way.
There were twenty to thirty experts who broke into the palace. The weakest among them were of Taiyi Realm. Most of them were Great Overarching Golden Immortal Experts. One of them was even a terrifying Quasi-Sage who was wielding a long sword that was comparable to Chenxi’s father’s own Dao vessel.
“Stop?” Chang Yang who stood at the very front gave her a cold smile. His chin was perked a little, giving off a feeling of utmost arrogance. He had a very young appearance. The set of Dao Vessels that he was equipped in were glimmering with all sorts of divine luminance, intertwining with each other to form a halo behind him, setting off his supreme status.
“I’m paying you back a thousand times for the shame that you’ve all trampled upon us!” Chang Yang’s tone of voice was filled with endless pleasure. “The Heaven Court? Great Emperor Dongfang? They are nothing in the face of the Sacred Lands! Dongfang Chenxi, do you regret it now? You could’ve had a future with infinite possibilities! Status above all! Yet now? Haha! I’ll imprison you and use you to my likings. Alas! The Innate Saint Daoist Body! Who would’ve thought that you’d have such a supreme Daoist body? I’ll be draining your blood dry, siphoning your fortunes and sucking dry your very soul.”
Dongfang Chenxi was extremely furious. Her eyes were blood-shot red. Although she was feeling helpless at heart, she was forcing herself to remain calm. However, she felt something tingling in her heart right this very moment and turned her head over, only to see a person appearing right beside her.
“Brother Jiang Ming!” Stunned by his sudden appearance, Dongfang Chenxi exclaimed as she threw herself over at Jiang Ming, immediately bursting into tears. “Brother Jiang Ming! I thought…I thought I would never see you again! I was even ready to self-destruct!”
“I’m here now. Leave it to me.” Jiang Ming patted her shoulder softly, feeling sorry for her.
They’ve long met each other back in the Supreme Pagoda.
“Did I cause you trouble?” Dongfang Chenxi raised her little face and looked at Jiang Ming with her face filled with tears. It was really heartbreaking.
“Trouble?” Jiang Ming shook his head and smiled. “You’ve heard from that guy Luo Heng before. I’ve killed more than a dozen Saints not long ago. I am now even stronger than I was then. You can just be at ease!”
“Brother Jiang Ming! I knew it! I just knew that sooner or later, you would grow into an upstanding man! I didn’t think that it would be so soon!”Dongdang Chenxi burst into tears and smiled. “I’ll…I’ll leave it to you then.”
“Killing more than dozens of Saint Experts?” Chang Yang, who was a little surprised, couldn’t help himself from bursting into laughter. “Are the braggarts nowadays this wild and unscrupulous? Who are you, you little brat? How dare you intervene in the affairs of our Five Elemental Sacred Land?”
Jiang Ming merely took a glance, before completely ignoring him. Instead, he looked at Dongfang Chenxi and asked, “What’s going on here? Isn’t your father the Great Emperor Dongfang? Why would you all be afraid of them?”
“The Five Elemental Sacred Land has Saints behind their back.” Dongfang Chenxi gave a wry smile. Just when she was about to explain what happened, Chang Yang couldn’t help himself and sneered, “How dare my future girl slave being so chummy in front of me? You’re courting death!”
A gourd suddenly appeared on top of Chang Yang’s head. As soon as it was opened, the mouth of the gourd was directly aimed at Jiang Ming as thousands of black needles were sprayed out, each of which contained auras of destruction. It was apparent that the gourd was a Quasi-Sage level Dao Vessel.
“Be careful Brother Jiang!” Dongfang Chenxi subconsciously exclaimed.
“These are merely worthless little tricks. Worry not!” As Jiang Ming smiled at the attack, the divine needles that were shot at him suddenly froze in place. They dissipated into thin air right after, turning back into its most primitive forms of particles and disappearing into the void.
The gourd above Chang Yang’s head exploded into pieces as well.
Chang Yang, who was akin to a later stage Great Overarching Expert was immediately shocked.
“Big Brother Hei Ze! Quickly! Take me away!” He was also a very decisive person.
However, before Hei Ze, the Quasi-Sage Expert could make his move, the surroundings suddenly froze in place. Dozens of experts including Hei Ze were suppressed on the spot, unable to lift a single finger.
“It’s done. Chenxi, you can go on now.” Jiang Ming no longer paid any attention to these maggots on death tolls.
“Brother Jiang Ming! They…They…” Dongfang Chenxi was taken aback once again.
“I’ve suppressed them temporarily. We’ll deal with them later.” Jiang Ming said with a smile.
“Brother Jiang Ming is truly mighty!Brother Jiang Ming is truly awesome!” Dongfang Chenxi cheered.
It took some time before she calmed herself down and continued to explain to Jiang Ming what happened here in the past.
In this very world, there was once a Dao Monarch with six disciples, a total of seven of Saints. They had total control over all beings, capable of manipulating other people’s fate.
