They saw the Heavens and Earth as their chessboard and the sentient beings as chess pieces, altering and staging the people’s destiny.
There was also the Heaven Court. This was the supreme authorial force established by that Dao Monarch that held the utmost authority over the infinite galaxies. Unfortunately, it was controlled by the six other Saints. The power of authority of the Heaven Court was divided among the disciples of the six Sacred Lands.
Dongfang Chenxi’s father, the Great Emperor Dongfang, who was also known as the Verdant Emperor, was not a disciple of the six great Saints, but the Heavenly Emperor’s confidant. However, because of his overwhelming cultivation base, he was later given the throne of Verdant Emperor.
The Heavenly Emperor had great ambitions, yet he was unable to advance into the Saint Realm. He could only swallow his anger and continue acting in a low-key manner.
With the position as the Verdant Emperor, Chenxi’s father had status so noble that even the six great Sacred Lands would’ve given him face. However, this incident had made it known to the world. In the face of the Sacred Lands, even the Verdant Emperor was nothing!

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - The Dao Patriarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: The Dao Patriarch
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The cause of this whole incident was quite simple. The ancient Lunar God called for a puja not long ago. The Verdant Emperor brought his daughter along.
Chang Yang went for the puja as well. With his special status, coupled with the treasures that he was equipped with, he discovered that Dongfang Chenxi’s body was of the Innate Saint Daoist Body. He was taken aback by the discovery and went directly to Dongfang Chenxi to ask her to be his partner.
How would Dongfang Chenxi pay him any attention? After hitting dead ends several times, Chang Yang became annoyed. Not long after, he went directly to the Verdant Emperor’s Palace to ask for her hand in marriage but was directly rejected by the Verdant Emperor right there and then.
Chang Yang was extremely enraged. He immediately threatened the Verdant Emperor that if he didn’t accept this marriage proposal of his, he would bring down this lineage of the Verdant Emperor.
Verdant Emperor was after all an emperor of the Heaven Court. He had his own pride. He immediately suppressed Chang Yang there. If it weren’t for the fact that he was concerned about the faction behind Chang Yang, he would’ve directly killed him.
Everyone thought that this was the end of the whole incident.
Unexpectedly, the Verdant Emperor was invited over by the White Emperor a few days ago. It was actually a trap and he ended up entrapped by the pre-arranged large formation.
The Verdant Emperor was also quite amazing himself. Although he didn’t manage to break free from the entrapment, he managed to send out two messages, one to request for help from the Heavenly Emperor, while the other to inform his daughter to quickly escape into the endless torrent of void.
The Heavenly Emperor didn’t make any movement.
Dongfang Chenxi was restrained by a group of experts led by Chang Yang before she even managed to escape.
This was what had happened.
“Chenxi, your Heaven Court here is really useless.” Jiang Ming complained.
He understood what had happened. All in all, it was that Chang Yang took a fancy to Dongfang Chenxi’s special physique, wanted to marry her and give birth to more peerless offspring. He would be able to absorb the great fortune from the Saint body as well to improve himself.
......
Engulfed in anger upon being rejected, he went on to forcefully snatch Dongfang Chenxi by relying on the powerful faction behind him. He didn’t even pay any respect to the Heaven Court.Even the Verdant Emperor’s rank was unable to scruple them.
This was because Chang Yang’s parents were both the direct disciple of the Five Elemental Saint Lords. One of them was the first disciple, Chang Tai, a perfect Quasi-Sage Realm Expert, while the other was the seventh disciple, Bing Yue, of the middle stage Quasi-Sage.
The two of them ended up together. They got a hold of a Yin Yang Summation Flower. They managed to give birth to a child, who they named Chang Yang only after consuming it.
Chang Yang was the child of two Quasi-Sage and also the first descendant of the Five Elemental Saint Lord. He was of extreme nobility and was heavily favored by the second generation of the Five Elemental Sacred Land.
When he brought up his intention of forcibly subduing Dongfang Chenxi, several of these second generation descendants objected to it. However, upon hearing about Chenxi’s special physique, every one of them immediately changed their opinions. In their words, if a person of such physique did unite with their nephew Chang Yang, the most powerful post-celestial physique of all time would inevitably be born. The child would surely surpass their parents, reaching a new height.
Therefore, they were actually all scheming behind their backs. If it weren’t for the fact that they were worried about their status, they would’ve barged their way through already. They had also made up an excuse to be told to the public that the Verdant Emperor had once beaten Chang Yang. With such a reason, it also opened up a valid excuse for the Heavenly Emperor to not intervene in the matter.
“We initially thought the Heaven Court could serve as a good backer. Unfortunately for us, the Heavenly Emperor didn’t even lift a finger regarding this matter.” Dongfang Chenxi gritted her teeth angrily and was extremely disappointed. After slight hesitation, she asked, “Brother Jiang, the person behind the Five Elemental Saint Lord is the Dao Patriarch. I’m afraid he would be at least at the pinnacle of the Saints. Are you confident you can go against him?”
She was extremely worried for the well-being of her father, but she also didn’t dare risk Jiang Ming’s life. After all, this would drag him into many problems as well.
“As long as he’s not the Saint King, I’m not afraid at all.” Jiang Ming replied confidently and continued, “Chenxi, don’t you worry about it! Now, what do we do with them?”
“I want them killed!” Dongfang Chenxi showed incomparable hatred. “They had almost killed all of my immortal soldiers, generals, and the young maidens around me.”
“Sure, we’ll just kill them all!” Jiang Ming raised his arms and clenched his fist. The various experts including Chang Yang were all annihilated, turning into dust.
“Brother Jiang! You’re great!” Dongfang Chenxi held his arm and swayed around.
“If it wasn’t for you back then, how could I have grown so fast?” Jiang Ming said. He brought her to the outside of the palace hall with just a wave of a hand.
With a slight thought, layers upon layers of formations were formed outside of the great palace, recreating the barriers to protect the palace within.
“I’ll bring you over to rescue Great Emperor Dongfang!”
Jiang Ming’s subconscious merged with void here. As he familiarized himself with the laws of this world here, he also discovered the destination that he was headed for and directly broke through the void.
…
A palace that was within the world’s fetal membrane could be seen in the endless void. Half of the palace was within the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm while the other half was situated within the Chaos. The Dao fluctuation that radiated from it distorted the laws of orders. Even Quasi-Sages who stumbled to this place wouldn’t have been able to discover the palace.
Over on the other side, the air of the Chaos was directly discharged millions of miles away.
There was a bed of clouds deep within the depth of its main hall. An old man sat cross-legged on the bed as supreme chains of order containing terrifying boundless storms could be seen surrounding him.
The whole surrounding suddenly froze in place. It didn’t matter if it was the power of laws or the laws of space and time. As the old man opened his eyes, all of them stopped their cycles and dissipated right after.
There was a Chaotic color in the eyes of the old man. It looked like the long river of fate that ran through all parts of the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm. As his eyes turned, he looked over at the direction of the Verdant Emperor’s Palace.
“A foreigner?” His deep voice was seemingly infused with supreme power. “Does he come from the other chiliocosm or the Sea of Chaos?”
“He didn’t go through the world’s fetal membrane. Otherwise, it would’ve definitely alarmed me. However, how did he descend to this great chiliocosm then? Even the Infinite Realm Auction House descending here would’ve left traces that can be tracked down. Yet this person…”
“Weird indeed! Let’s just watch what happens then.”
This person was none other than the Dao Patriarch of the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm.
…
Jiang Ming arrived right outside of the White Emperor’s Palace. He suddenly raised his head as though something came up in his mind before ignoring it completely.
“To think that we’ve arrived at the outside of the White Emperor’s Palace so soon!” Dongfang Chenxi was taken aback.
This was from the far east crossing the vast lands into the far west. The distance between them was more than trillions of light-years away. Yet, the two of them traveled through it in just a snap of a finger.
“Just wait till you get to this point in your cultivation. You’ll also be able to do it with ease.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Now, watch carefully!”
“Alright!” Dongfang Chenxi nodded obediently.
Jiang Ming raised his hand and pressed down. Layers upon layers of the White Emperor’s Palace’s formations could be seen being evoked one after another, dissipating rapidly right after and the entire palace began to collapse.
In just a few seconds, who knows how many of the White Emperor’s Palace’s great formations had collapsed just like this? These were defensive formations that could even entrap a Quasi-Sage Expert.
Even the palace itself was quickly dissipating layer after layer.
“Such terrifying power!” Dongfang Chenxi exclaimed in shock.
She knew that this White Emperor’s Palace was no worse than the Verdant Emperor’s Palace. Once the defensive formations were activated, even the ordinary Quasi-Sages wouldn’t have been able to break through the barriers.
Verdant Emperor’s Palace was broken through because Chang Yang brought along a Quasi-Sage Expert who wielded a supreme Dao vessel.
“Who dares to attack my divine palace?” An enraged roar could be heard coming from the depths of the hall. Dozens of experts could be seen rushing out of the palace.
The three leading experts were all of the Quasi-Sage Realm while the rest were of the Great Overarching Realm.
“Who are you, and why are you attacking my palace for no reason?” The White Emperor carefully scanned through the surrounding situation, and his heart sank. Although he was extremely furious, he forcibly suppressed his anger and asked with great vigilance.
The fact that this intruder was able to easily break through his defensive formations had already explained a lot about the person.
“Dongfang Chenxi!” The White Emperor turned his gaze over and saw the Daughter of Dongfang right next to Jiang Ming, “Why did you come here?”
“White Emperor! I was about to ask you myself! You and my father are both palace lords and even regard each other as brothers. Why did you harm him?” Dongfang Chenxi was initially quite afraid of this White Emperor but when she saw Jiang Ming standing right beside herself, her courage immediately grew strong. The burning anger that was suppressed in her heart erupted as she pointed her finger to question the White Emperor.
“My father treated you as a brother, a fellow Daoist and a confidant! Who would’ve known that you’d be of such wild ambition as to deceive and besiege him! You even wanted to kill him, to bring our entire Verdant Emperor lineage to the ground. White Emperor! You are not even worthy of being the Western Emperor of the Heaven Court!”
Dongfang Chenxi bombarded the White Emperor, questioning him. Her deafening voice spread throughout like tidal waves, even spreading to all parts of the Heaven Court.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - Were The Saint Invincible and Immortal?
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Were The Saint Invincible and Immortal?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was actually quite surprised. He didn’t expect Dongfang Chenxi to have such a provocative side of her. She had always given him the impression of a person who was sweet and innocent in the past, a carefree and kind-hearted little lady. She was totally different today.
However, Jiang Ming understood her. Her father was entrapped, whereas she almost fell into the enemy’s hand herself. If it wasn’t for him, her fate would have been extremely miserable. Such great changes was probably what made her become a little bit more mature.
Jiang Ming felt sorry for her instead.
“Chenxi! What do you even know? I’m doing it all for both of your own good.” White Emperor’s face was extremely solemn.
An expert, who had been standing right beside the White Emperor, had been frowning. He suddenly asked, “Dongfang Chenxi, where is Chang Yang?”
“Who are you?” Dongfang Chenxi felt an extremely dangerous aura and hurriedly embraced Jiang Ming’s arm.
“I’m Hong Liu of the Five Elemental Sacred Land.” Hong Liu revealed his identity and asked yet again, “Tell me, where is Chang Yang?”
“Where is Chang Yang?” Tens of thousands of thunderclouds could be seen forming on top of another Quasi-Sage’s head, ready to strike them with a devastating blow at any time.
This person was also from the Five Elemental Sacred Land.
It was apparent that the White Emperor colluded with these two to besiege the Verdant Emperor.
Dongfang Chenxi looked at Jiang Ming.
“What are you afraid of? I’m not afraid even if the Dao Monarch is here.” Jiang Ming smiled, “You call all the shots here today. Even the King of Heavens falls second.”
Dongfang Chenxi’s eyes squinted into crescent moons from happiness. When she looked over the White Emperor and the likes, her face was filled with hatred as she remarked, “That bastard Chang Yang is already dead. He has been completely annihilated, with his soul scattered. Not even a slight scum is left of him.”
......
“Chang Yang was killed?” Hong Liu’s brow furrowed even more. He couldn’t believe that Chang Yang was murdered. After all, he had a Quasi-Sage Weapon with him and was even equipped with various life-saving treasures. Coupled with the fact that he was accompanied by the Elder Hei Ze, how could he be killed when dealing with just a mere Dongfang Chenxi?
However, Dongfang Chenxi was in fact right in front of him. The man right next to her made his heart tremble. Hence, he thought it might have been true.
If Chang Yang was really killed, then the place would fall into chaos.
“Well then, come over here, you!” Hong Liu lifted his hands, solidifying the void and shrouding Dongfang Chenxi within. He was planning on capturing her first and also took the opportunity to test Jiang Ming’s reaction.
Nevertheless, before his palm even fell on Dongfang Chenxi, the power suddenly collapsed.
“Who exactly are you?” Hong Liu’s expression showed even more vigilance.
The White Emperor and the likes also stared at Jiang Ming. Such a test of strength already made them understand how strong Jiang Ming was.
“Chenxi, why don’t we just kill them all?” Jiang Ming started to lose interest in the skirmish and asked.
“Brother, Hong Liu and this other person are both the disciples of the Saint Lords. If we kill them, I’m afraid there will be no turning back.” Dongfang Chenxi replied with hesitation.
“No turning back?” Jiang Ming had a strange smile on his face. “You should ask Ye Qingxian and Luo Heng to see how I do things.”
Dongfang Chenxi thought of what Luo Heng once said, “He killed dozens of experts as strong as the Saint Lords in a battle.”
She immediately contacted Ye Qingxian and the answer she got left her mouth wide open from shock. Ye Qingxian told her that brother Jiang went to her world and directly overturned the entire Heaven Court many years ago.
“Brother is truly almighty!” Dongfang Chenxi was first shocked and then became extremely excited. “Brother, kill them all then.”
“That’s the way to do it!” Jiang Ming smiled.
“Kill us?” Hong Liu’s expression turned even uglier. Even though he doubted that Jiang Ming possessed such capability of killing them, he was still cautious about it and asked, “Fellow Daoist, what is your true identity? I am from the Five Elemental Scared Land, a direct disciple of the Saint Lord, the grandson disciple of the Dao Monarch. Have you thought of the consequences if you go against me? Besides, what we did was just to allow the marriage between Chenxi and Chang Yang, so that we can all be one big family. This is supposed to be a happy event. Why is there a need for us to bear grudges among us?”
“You tried to forcibly kidnap a person and yet you made it sound so dignified.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Well, this is after all a world where the strong are to be respected, so this is nothing much. However, you are all quite unlucky to have provoked an existence that you shouldn’t have. You will have to bear the karma for it. Are Saint Lords immortal? Is Dao Monarch invincible? Haha! I really want to try them. I want to see if a Saint Lord can be completely annihilated in a Great Chiliocosm. Alas, Hong Liu. It’s because of Chang Yang that all you second generation disciples will have to die. Your Saint Lord Masters are going to die too.”
“Such arrogance!” Liu Hong erupted in fury. He was also extremely terrified.
Jiang Ming would either be a lunatic or a fool to dare say such a thing in public. It was obvious that he wasn’t either, which meant the most probable possibility. He was a real genuine peerless expert.
Liu Hong didn’t recognize him and the only possibility was that Jiang Ming came from the Chaos.
‘God damn it! Chang Yang, you bastard! How could you provoke such a terrifying being? I’ve never heard of the Verdant Emperor having such an overbearing background before. No, he went into the Chaos before.’
“Could it be…” Liu Hong still wanted to continue defending himself. However, his whole body suddenly tightened as he felt an extremely terrifying force looming towards him. It instantly suppressed him to the point that it was even difficult for his thoughts to cycle.
He could clearly see himself disintegrating. Yes, he was slowly disintegrating. It could also be said that he was being decimated.
Even the White Emperor and the other Saint Lord disciple had the same ending.
‘Damn it! We’re done by Chang Yang! What a fool!’
Such a thought went through Hong Liu’s mind before his body completely disintegrated. However, his Dao vessels and other treasures all remained intact. Jiang Ming brought them over to Chenxi.
“Brother, these are your trophies!” Dongfang Chenxi shook her head and continued, “You’ve already helped me too much!”
“You little girl. I can easily kill them as such. Do you think these treasures are still useful to me?” Jiang Ming smiled as he lifted his hand and tapped in the air. The whole palace in front was brought into ruins. Immediately afterwards, a middle-aged man could be seen rushing out of it.
This person was none other than the Verdant Emperor, the Great Emperor Dongfang of the Heaven Court.
The moment he saw Chenxi, both his eyes turned red as he rushed over. Upon sensing no danger around, he was a little more relieved. He took a glance at Jiang Ming before quickly asking Dongfang Chenxi, “Chenxi, why are you here? What’s happened? Where is the White Emperor? Could it be that the Heavenly Emperor has intervened? ”
“Father! To think that you’re still bringing up the Heavenly Emperor.” Chenxi let out a sigh of relief before she pouted. “The White Emperor has died and Hong Liu has been killed. Father, this is the Brother Jiang Ming that I told you about. It was I who asked him for help and he came to rescue your trapped daughter. We rushed here immediately afterward and killed off the White Emperor and the likes.”
She continued chattering as she quickly explained all that had happened.
“Jiang Ming?” The Great Emperor Dongfang had a shocked expression on his face. His eyes were full of disbelief. “That friend of yours, Jiang Ming?”
Chenxi nodded her head profusely.
“This… How is this possible?” The Great Emperor Dongfang couldn’t believe it.
Unlike his daughter, he knew too well how difficult it was to cross great chiliocosms. It could be said that it was impossible.
The Chaos was boundless and vast. Who knew how many trillion light years would it take for there to be another chiliocosm in their view. In order for the person to descend into the chiliocosm, he would first have to locate the coordinate of the place, travel through the Chaos and eliminate the various dangers along the way before being able to successfully cross over.
This was under the pretense that the two chiliocosms were adjacent to each other.
He once explored the Chaos himself, but he couldn’t find any adjacent chiliocosms at all. He believed Jiang Ming was definitely not a peerless expert from the adjacent chiliocosm, and wondered how Jiang Ming could descend to this chiliocosm so soon?
Could it be that this was a special feature of the legacy of the Supreme Order? The Great Emperor Dongfang was pretty assured that he got the right answer. After all, the fact that it allowed her daughter to enter that place naturally means that it would allow others who received the same inheritance to come over to this chiliocosm.
“F-Fellow Daoist Jiang. Thank you very much!” The Great Emperor Dongfang sincerely thanked Jiang Ming.
He looked at Jiang Ming with extremely complicated thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - Destroying the Sacred Land with just a Palm
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Destroying the Sacred Land with just a Palm
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Great Emperor Dongfang had never thought of such a day.
This little guy was but a mortal who had yet to even enter the Immortal Realm back then. But because he learned that Jiang Ming was taking on the path of the World Dao, he asked his daughter to take care of him a little. It didn’t take long for Jiang Ming to become capable ofkilling experts such as White Emperor and the likes easily.
The White Emperor was a Quasi-Sage Realm Expert, and he wasn’t alone.
A kind gesture back then was in return to a life-saving event today. The Great Emperor Dongfang was certain that even if Jiang Ming had the support of that land of inheritance, Jiang Ming definitely had to pay a great price to descend into this great chiliocosm.
Taking a look back at his daughter in comparison, had she descended into another chiliocosm before? It was a resounding no.
The Great Emperor Dongfang raised his head and looked in the direction of the Heaven Court, his expression became even more complicated.
‘Alas, the Heavenly Emperor! I went through life and death for you. Yet, now that I’m faced with such calamity, you did not even show up to defend me. What’s more, I am the Verdant Emperor of the Heaven Court, a respected status among many. If I really die, what a blow would it be to the majesty of the Heaven Court? Ha! To think that you wouldn’t even dare provoking a third generation disciple of the Sacred Land, you’re really worthless.’
“Brother Jiang, you should leave as soon as possible. Now that you’ve killed the disciple of the Dao Monarch, that person might show himself!” The Great Emperor Dongfang advised. “I’ll take my daughter into the Chaos immediately as well. When everything becomes safe in the future, I will thank you again for the help you’ve given.”
“Father, there’s no need!” Dongfang Chenxi shook her head. Then, she telepathically sent a message to his father. “He has already sanctified the way of Dao. He had even killed more than a dozen Saints in another chiliocosm prior to this!”
“What?” The Great Emperor Dongfang’s eyes instantly widened.
‘Sanctified the path of Dao? God damn it! He wasn’t even as powerful as my own daughter decades ago, yet he has already sanctified the path of Dao now? Isn’t this just pulling people’s legs? And he even killed more than a dozen Saints? Am I dreaming or this an illusory world to begin with? This is no longer just incredible, but akin to fantasy already.’
“Father, it’s true.” Seemingly to have guessed her father’s thoughts, Dongfang Chenxi quickly added. “Brother Jiang is really powerful. We all say that he is the favored son of the Great Dao.”
“If it’s true, then he must really be the favored son of the Great Dao.” Worthy of being called a peerless figure, Great Emperor Dongfang quickly calmed himself down. His eyes, however, were glistening with eagerness.
......
When he looked into his daughter’s eyes, his heart was feeling complicated yet again.
“Uncle Dongfang, it’s true. You don’t have to worry!” Jiang Ming suddenly chimed in as he smiled.
“Don’t, don’t! Just refer to me as a Fellow Daoist will do. Let’s make each other acquaintances ourselves.” The Great Emperor Dongfang was excited and quickly waved his hands.
The Great Emperor Dongfang was frightened to have a Saint to address him ‘uncle’ although he knew Jiang Ming was sincere.
The Great Emperor Dongfang was also relieved at the same time. He knew this little guy in front of him was genuinely here to help him, or rather, to help his daughter. Hence, his daughter would have someone to rely on even if he were to be caught in any mishaps in the future.
“Uncle Dongfang, you don’t have to be too polite!”
“No! It’s better for you to address me as a fellow Daoist. Else, my heart of Dao might even collapse!”
“Alright then, fellow Daoist Dongfang.”
“Now this wouldn’t be as frightening.” Great Emperor Dongfang let out a smile. Following that, he said solemnly, “Now that Hong Liu has been slain, I’m afraid the Five Elemental Saint Venerates wouldn’t let go of this. They haven’t appeared yet and are probably still in their cultivation retreat comprehending the laws of the Saints. With his temper of smothering his young ones, once he emerges from retreat, he will definitely go on a frenzy. There’s also the Dao Monarch behind him. Fellow Daoist Jiang Ming, what should we do next? In my opinion, we should still head into the Chaos. It’s boundless there with many hidden great encounters. Even the Dao Monarch would find it difficult to find us there, though the Chaos might be a little dangerous.”
“Fellow Daoist Dongfang, in addition to saving Chenxi, I’ve descended here with the intention to meet the Saint Experts of this realm and see if they can be killed.” Jiang Ming said, “Don’t worry! I won’t leave before taking care of everything.”
The Great Emperor Dongfang opened his mouth, but did not dare to persuade Jiang Ming anymore. A Saint’s mind was without a doubt as firm as it could be. Since Jiang Ming had already said so, he couldn’t persuade him to leave with tails between his legs, could he?
“Alright, we’ll follow you!” Great Emperor Dongfang was very honest.
Jiang Ming smiled. “Let’s head towards the Five Elemental Sacred Land then. He’s in a cultivational retreat? Heh! That’s not up to him!”
With a simple wave of his hand, Jiang Ming shattered the void, directly reaching the Five Elemental Sacred Land.
To Jiang Ming, this chiliocosm no longer had many secrets that he didn’t know of.
In front of them, Jiang Ming saw Immortal luminance flowing around, illuminating the surrounding with a majestic brilliance. The tens of thousands rays intertwined into an infinitely wondrous scene.
There were five mountain peaks that were millions of feet high. Each peak had different colors, contained a different Dao fluctuation, and flowed with the power of the corresponding element.
In between these mountain peaks were countless smaller mountains, valleys, forests and other geographical features. Great luminance could be seen from every corner.
The clouds and mists floating through the air were all condensed from spiritual energy. Some of the rivers that flowed below were formed from the liquefaction of spiritual energy.
This was a place of great fortune, a supreme Sacred Land for cultivation. This was the Five Elemental Scared Land.
“Brother, how are we doing this?” Dongfang Chenxi asked, ‘Should we attack directly? Or declare war instead?”
Great Emperor Dongfang stood honestly behind his daughter. He hadn’t had any questions nor advice for Jiang Ming at all. If worse comes to worst, he would request that his daughter give up everything else and head into the place of inheritance. If his daughter didn’t want to do so, he’d kill himself there and then.
“Whether it’s directly attacking them or declaring war, both are too slow. It’s better to just directly destroy this Sacred Land.” Jiang Ming said, as he raised his palm.
Dongfang Chenxi looked stunned, and then hesitantly said, “Brother, isn’t it not that suitable to do this? There are still many innocent people inside the Sacred Land.”
“Innocent?” Jiang Ming shook his head. He looked at Dongfang Chenxi and said, “You must get rid of such a thought. In the world of cultivation, there’s no such thing as innocence. Whether it’s me or you, we are all in fact the worms of the world. We’ll put this aside and just talk about what’s currently happening in front of us. If I didn’t show up, what would’ve happened to you? In times of desperation, you could enter the land of inheritance. However, what about the maidens and guards around you? I’m afraid not one of them would’ve survived this. What about your father? If he were to be captured and used as a hostage to threaten you, what would you do then? The best outcome from that would’ve probably been a swift death and be done with it.”
Dongfang Chenxi’s face suddenly turned pale.
“Let’s talk about the Sacred Land in front of you. Which one among them didn’t enjoy the resources here, and which one didn’t reaped the benefits from the place here? Since they’ve enjoyed the place, they’ll have to bear the corresponding karma that befalls. It’s not as what you’ve just said, whether a person has ever done killing or not; whether the person is good or bad. How can the cycle of Karma be that simple?” Jiang Ming explained patiently. “Having enjoyed the benefits, can you say that you have nothing to do with them when calamity hits? Putting enemies aside, even family members would’ve killed you in a heartbeat.”
“Fellow Daoist Jiang is right!” The Great Emperor Dongfang totally agreed with Jiang Ming’s remarks. “The cultivation world is just that cruel. There’s no right or wrong, but only cultivation matters. Take this incident for example, what wrong did you do? There isn’t any. Yet, it resulted in you being straight up bullied. You should know that I’m actually a Great Emperor of the Heaven Court. However, they are still unscrupulous with their actions. It shows how arrogant and domineering they actually are. Chenxi, you have to remember this. You can remain kind-hearted but never towards your enemy.”
The Great Emperor Dongfang couldn’t bear to tell her this, but he had to do it now. He was still able to protect her own daughter before all these happened. However, after going through all that had transpired, he knew it’s time for his daughter to grow up.
“Brother! Father! I’ll remember this!” Dongfang Chenxi nodded her head seriously.
In fact, she had already received much of such information from the chat group prior to this. However, having yet to experience such an ordeal personally, it was inevitable for her to feel slightly pitiful of her enemies.
Jiang Ming nodded his head in agreement. Following that, he raised his palm and forcefully slammed down.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - Innate Supreme Treasure, Twelve-Graded Green Lotus
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Innate Supreme Treasure, Twelve-Graded Green Lotus
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming raised his palm and slammed down. A large hand that could even cover the sky appeared in the void. It was the Divine Hand technique that he had deduced.
The huge Divine Hand covered the sky, containing boundless power.
Although Jiang Ming only mastered the Laws of Great Overarching, the power generated was a pure and unparalleled power of the Saint, the Saint power of a peak Saint Expert.
The Divine Hand had also incorporated 1,200 laws of Great Overarching and was evoked with Saint Power. This rendered the power of this special ability to be no weaker than any laws of Saint Dao.
As the hand fell, it also imprisoned the surrounding space and time, turning this side of the sky into a cage of imprisonment. Such an act immediately triggered the defensive power of the Five Elemental Sacred Land. Various divine luminance shot into the sky as its great formation began its cycle, revealing the terrifying depth of resources that the Sacred Land possessed.
However, these divine luminance were completely dispersed and the great formation collapsed under the might of the Divine Hand.
The five Sacred Mountain Peaks immediately turned into pillars that supported the sky, spewing out a vast amount of Saint Energy, but they still could not stop the falling palm.
Who knew how many great experts within the Sacred Land were alarmed by this sudden bombardment. There were at least a million disciples here who tilted their heads to watch the whole ordeal. They were initially shocked but became indifferent soon after.
“This must be the special ability evoked by the Patriarch! Awesome! This is truly amazing! A palm that covers the entire sky! Even my divine eyes can’t see any edge of this palm! Who could’ve done this besides the Patriarch at the Saint Realm?”
“This must be a supreme Saint Law that the Patriarch has comprehended.”
“It seems our Patriarch is getting quite naughty. Ahem…”
“How dare you make fun of the Patriarch? Are you sick of living anymore? Still, it also makes sense. He’s trying to scare us, but also to broaden our horizons.”
“No, this is not right. Why did the sect’s protecting formation activate itself?”
......
“Is this the Patriarch wanting to test out the power of the sect’s protecting formation? That shouldn’t be! We are here in the Sacred Land. Who even dares to attack us? Even the Heaven Court is but a little brat to us. They wouldn’t dare to do anything either.”
“That makes sense! Hey, I’ve heard that Senior Brother Chang Yang is going against the Verdant Emperor. In the end, the Verdant Emperor is besieged yet the Heavenly Emperor doesn’t even dare to let out a fart in response. There isn’t any movement at all from him.”
“Heavenly Emperor? Heh! What a joke!”
“Something’s wrong! Guys, look! The great formation has collapsed!”
“Crap! Even the five Sacred Mountains are manifesting themselves at the same time! What’s going on? Even if they are experimenting, it shouldn’t have come to this!”
“Damn it! The Sacred Mountains have collapsed!”
“This is definitely not some experiment! It’s an enemy attack! The enemies are attacking!”
“What kind of person would dare attack our Sacred Land? Is he tired of living already? Could it be that this is a Sacred War?”
*Dong Dong Dong…*
The sect’s alarm bell suddenly rang hastily, coming to 12 rings in a blink of an eye.
Ning rings would mean that the sect had a great enemy and requires everyone to go all out to protect the sect. The only time this had happened was when they were at war with another Sacred Land back then.
As for the 12 rings? It was a legend, yet it rang today. This made all of the disciples shocked.
“To all the disciples of the sect, a great enemy has invaded and the sect is in danger of annihilation. Quickly take your position and evoke the great formation. Protect our sect as we await our Patriarch to exit his retreat. Hurry! Hurry! Hurry!”
It was Chang Tai, the first disciple of the Five Elemental Saint Lord who made the announcement. Usually, he was the one who managed the sect’s affairs and held great power of authority. As he gave out the orders, he also evoked waves and waves of special abilities towards the surroundings, evoking the hidden grand formation. He was trying to block off the attack but it was all in vain.
The five Sacred Mountains had all collapsed. As the overwhelming power poured down, many disciples couldn’t block the emanation of such supreme destructive power. In an instant, many exploded immediately, while their souls dispersed into the void. In just a snap of a finger, 90 percent of the disciples of the Five Elemental Sacred Land were killed.
“Damn it! Who in the world is attacking us? Is it the Heavenly Emperor? No, it’s definitely not him. This is the doing of a Saint. Could it be the expert who killed my son? My son only went to deal with a single Verdant Emperor. How could he have provoked such a peerless being? This shouldn’t be!”
Chang Tai was so overwhelmed in anger that his eyes almost popped out of its socket. As thoughts cycled through his mind, a green lotus could be seen rushing out from the top of his head. Green luminance could be seen blossoming from it as it shot into the sky, blocking the falling palm.
The green lotus was the Twelve-graded Green Lotus. Based on the grades in this world, it was known as the Innate Supreme Treasure, which was akin to the Saint Weapon. It was mainly used for defense and was stronger than the average Saint Weapons.
The green lotus spun around, spewing an infinite amount of lights of orders. It invoked the powers of the Heavenly Dao, forming into an incomparably solid defensive barrier.
This was the supreme treasure given to him by the Five Elemental Saint Lord as a preventive measure. Even he himself did not expect to use this supreme treasure on this day.
The Divine Hand above the sky suddenly paused. Nine stone tablets could be seen appearing in the middle of the palm, forming a large formation. Divine power was spurting out of it, shattering the defensive luminance of the Green Lotus.
The nine stone tablets were the God Sealing Tablet. With nine pieces combined, it was comparable to a Saint Weapon already.
Witnessing his defensive barrier shattering into pieces, Chang Tai’s expression quickly changed. A streak of Saint Energy could be seen accumulating between his eyebrows. Just as he was about to continue evoking the Green Lotus, the Green Lotus trembled, and he actually lost control of the Green Lotus all together.
The Green Lotus could be seen involuntarily absorbed into the palm, disappearing out of sight.
“That’s impossible!” Chang Tai looked as though he had seen a ghost. His face was filled with disbelief.
That was an innate supreme treasure. No one other than the Dao Patriarch could easily take it away from him throughout the vast world. Even though he was only at the perfect stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm, he was confident that it would be difficult for any Saint to snatch this supreme treasure away from him in such a short time. He wasn’t blindly confident at that because he was assured by the Five Elemental Saint Lord.
Yet, it happened right in front of him. The Divine Hand however, also disappeared without a trace.
Following that, Chang Tai saw three figures pacing towards him in the air. The three stood atop the Five Elemental Sacred Land, overlooking them as if they were feeble creatures.
His heart was blazing with fury, yet his body trembled.
“Verdant Emperor!” He recognized the Great Emperor Dongfang at a glance. As for Chenxi, he only took a glance at her before he shifted his focus to Jiang Ming. It was obvious that this person was the leader among the three.
At this point, the Verdant Emperor should have been besieged and Dongfang Chenxi should’ve been captured by his own son. However, his son had died and these two appeared in front of him. Without even needing to think, he knew that his son had been killed by this unfamiliar expert. It even implicated the whole sect into the mess.
Brimming with hatred, he had an extremely sophisticated feeling.
‘Does this count as myself being pitted by my own son?’
Such thoughts ran through Chang Tai’s mind as he was growing taller and taller to be face-to-face with the three at the same time. Meanwhile, a group of disciples appeared behind him. Each of them was vigilant and was preparing to go all out in confronting great enemies.
“Who are you? Why are you attacking our Five Elemental Sacred Land?” Chang Tai forcefully suppressed the ripples in his mind and was extremely alert to what was coming next.
His master had yet to come out of his cultivation retreat. Hence, he had to stall for time.
“I’m here to destroy this Sacred Land of yours!” Jiang Ming replied with a smile.
When Jiang Ming evoked the Divine Hand, he didn’t expect to wipe the whole Sacred Land with just a single special ability. However, the fact that the Five Elemental Saint Lord hadn’t shown himself really surprised him.
‘Still not showing yourself? Heh! I’ll force you out whatever it takes.’
When he saw Chang Tai evoking the Green Lotus, Jiang Ming took this opportunity and evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, taking away that weapon of his. He kept it within the Human Path Record, suppressing it inside before pacing over here with Chenxi and the Verdant Emperor.
‘Sacred Land? Well, I’m standing right above you.’
“You are Chang Tai, Chang Yang’s father, right? When he died, you should’ve sensed it through the power of bloodline. Why didn’t you do anything?” Jiang Ming inquired curiously.
The corners of Chang Tai’s lips were twitching uncontrollably. He still answered earnestly,”Those who are able to kill my son Chang Yang know that he is my son. Even if he were to rile up sky-defying troubles, most would’ve given him way for my sake. They wouldn’t go as far as to kill him. However, he is now dead and this happened when there was even a Quasi-Sage right by his side. Such a scenario could only mean that the killer is not afraid of the existence of our Five Elemental Sacred Land. Seeing this, it’s natural that I wouldn’t take actions hastily. If I can afford to provoke this person, then the killer would be dead either way. It wouldn’t matter much if I waited for a few days to do so. If I can’t afford to deal with this killer, then there is no point in rushing. Chang Tai is already dead after all.”
“That’s a good temperament you have there.” Jiang Ming nodded approvingly. “I thought that when an expert like you who lost his beloved son, he would be the first to go berserk!”
Chang Tai smiled wryly as he replied, “I’m actually furious. After all, it’s very, very difficult to bore a child now that I’ve reached such a cultivation realm. After Chang Yang was born, I doted on him and he even received blessings from my master. Because of this, he has developed a lawless character, so much so that he now suffers from a calamity today.”
Alas…

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - Truly Slaughtering a Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Truly Slaughtering a Saint
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This sigh of Chang Yang was filled with indescribable complex feelings. There were both hatred and regrets, as well as that deep feeling of resignation.
It was considered that Chang Tai was blessed with a child in his old age. Although he didn’t pour all his heart and soul into his son, he had been doing his best for his son. It was also because of his son, his cold heart of Dao was given a slimmer of warmth. As such, he took extra care of his son.
He originally thought with his own strength, coupled with the background of the Five Elemental Sacred Land, he would be able to set it right in the end regardless of how great the trouble his son had caused. It wouldn’t be a problem as long as his son wasn’t targeted by the several other Sacred Lands.
This was because Chang Tai knew well about the truth that the fist wields power. There weren’tmany experts in this realm, who were able to block off his fist.
As such, the troubles that his son caused, wouldn’t be called trouble, but instead the right to enjoy supreme authority. In the end, he had now met with someone troublesome. Such was fate. Such was life.
“You’re from the outside world, aren’t you?” Chang Tai was a perfect stage Quasi-Sage Expert after all. The fact that he didn’t recognize Jiang Ming meant only such a possibility.
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming nodded. “You allowed Chang Yang to do whatever he wants in this world because Chang Yang’s strength was quite enough and also the fact that you would be able to right any trouble that he might cause. It is so unfortunate that you didn’t imagine there would be those from the outside world.”
“Yes! If I had known this, I would have disciplined him well. He wouldn’t have died today, and wouldn’t have also provoked such a terrifying existence like you to the sect!” Chang Tai sighed. Then, he said, “Senior, this is our Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm. With the Dao Patriarch at the top, there are also six disciples of Saints below him. To assault our Five Elemental Sacred Land in such a lawless manner, are you not afraid of being targeted by the Six Saints? They may be conflicting against each other internally but they will definitely unite when facing external forces.”
“Haha! You’re threatening me in return I see.” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but burst into laughter. “Ask your master to show himself. I want to try and see if I can slaughter a Saint!”
“Slaughter a Saint?” Chang Tai’s heart sank.
Right this moment, a streak of luminance shot across the sky and came to Chang Tai’s side in a blink of an eye. This was a woman with the posture of an immortal and gave off a feeling of peerless temperament.
“Senior Chang Tai, who actually killed our child? Why is the Verdant Emperor here?” It was apparent that this lady was Bing Yue, the Seventh Disciple of the Five Elemental Saint Lord. She was also the mother of Chang Yang, and the wife of Chang Tai.
“I’ve only gone to Heaven Court for a while, and I sensed from the bloodline that our son has lost his life.” Bing Yue’s expression was extremely cold, “Tell me, are these his killers?”
......
She pointed towards Jiang Ming.
“Stop making a scene!” Chang Tai hushed her in a rush.
“Stop making a scene?” Bing Yue was infuriated. “Our son has died and you’re asking me to not make a scene? Haha! Chang Tai, you coward! No matter who killed my son, I’ll make him pay dearly!”
“By the way, our son went off to capture Dongfang Chenxi. Why is she still safe and sound? Why is she here? Why didn’t you kill her? No. You should suppress her. I want to simmer her with the Nine Fiery of the Netherworld for ten billion years!” Bing Yue was shrieking neurotically.
“Was he killed by the Verdant Emperor?”
“Or is it this person here?”
“Chang Tai! Tell me! Did this wretched-looking man kill our son? What are you actually afraid of?”
A bright moon could be seen rising on top of Bing Yue’s head. Its clear luminance lit up the world. The chilling cold aura emanating into the surrounding made even Great Overarching Golden Immortals to tremble.
Jiang Ming actually enjoyed himself listening to the duo. He felt that Bing Yue’s mind was in complication. A Quasi-Sage Expert should never lose their rationality, even when enraged. However, Jiang Ming speculated that she had seen their sect under calamity and Chang Tai’s current expression as though he was facing a great enemy. She should be able to guess how strong he was.
She wanted to strike, but there were still some scruples. To not do anything however, her blazing anger seemingly burned off her rational thoughts. That was what made her become this neurotic. Her last sentence however, was obvious that she couldn’t bear it anymore.
“Wretched-looking man?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh. Following that, he focused his gaze, and Bing Yue’s body suddenly stiffened. With a thump, her whole body exploded, and died tragically on the spot.
“Stop! Don’t…” Upon hearing her wife’s last sentence, Chang Tai felt that something was off. He hurriedly exclaimed but it was still too late.”
“You’re a Saint! How can you lay your hands on the juniors?” Chang Tai’s body was trembling. His eyes were set ablaze with anger.
“You knew that I’m a Saint. She was insulting a Saint. For her to die and for her soul to perish is already considered the lightest punishment! Jiang Ming glanced at a distance and couldn’t help but sneered, “Your master is really a coward. He still hasn’t appeared by now. There’s also the few other Saint Lords cowering. Haha! Interesting. Since he doesn’t want to show himself, I’ll force him to!”
“Death to all of you!” Jiang Ming’s face turned cold as he struck out forcefully.
A bell could be seen appearing on top of his head. It was the Saint Weapon, Astral Golden Bell. Just as he was about to evoke the Saint Weapon, the void sank steeply. A terrifying aura swept through the air, falling upon them.
The heaven cracked open as Five Elemental Dao Fluctuation swept across the land, pervading the entire great chiliocosm.
Immediately after, five different colors of divine luminance bloomed, covering the lands and encompassing the sky.
It was then followed by three million miles of purple coloured aura pouring out of it. Deafening immortal tones swept through. It even felt as though the sky was collapsing onto them.
As the Saint emerged, purple auras followed.
An old man could be seen appearing not far away. The top of his head was a five coloured wheel of luminance. An illusory world could be seen behind him, with a Five Elemental Treasure Tree growing inside.
This person was none other than the Five Elemental Saint Lord.
“A dignified Saint bullying the juniors. Fellow Daoist, you’re disgracing our pride as Saints!” There wasn’t a trace of anger on Five Elemental Saint Lord’s expression but her voice was filled with boundless chills.
“I thought you’d continue to cower and stay out of it!” Jiang Ming merely laughed, unimpressed by this Saint Lord.
‘The dignity of Saints? Sorry, I’m not a Saint! I’m just a Great Overarching Golden Immortal, comprehending the Great Overarching Laws and the fruits of Great Overarching Dao.:
“Fellow Daoist. You’re thinking of destroying my whole Dao lineage just because of the skirmishes between the juniors?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord’s expression suddenly turned ugly. He waved his hands in between words and his many disciples bowed and retreated into the distance.
Chang Tai’s gaze at Jiang Ming carried obvious hatred towards him. If not for his strength, he would have rushed up to Jiang Ming.
“Juniors?” Jiang Ming shook his head, “Chenxi is my sister, a person comparable to my real sister. Your disciples are bullying my sister. Is it not natural for me to exterminate this Dao lineage of yours?”
“To think that a little third-generation disciple is lawless enough to openly besiege and kill the Great Emperor Dongfang of the Heaven Court, to even go up into the Great Emperor Dongfang’s palace to plunder and bully a woman. Heh! You call yourself the Sacred Land, yet reckless to such a degree. You can see how arrogant your so-called sect is. Lawless, virtueless, immoral and corrupt. That’s why they all deserve to die!”
Jiang Ming’s voice rumbled and spread throughout the world.
With a thought, he took the two complicated-looking Dongfang Chenxi and Great Emperor Dongfang into his inner world. It wasn’t suitable for them to watch the upcoming great battle.
“Sharp-tongued.” The Five Elemental Saint Lord snorted coldly. “To be so rampant as you descend into our chiliocosm. What of it? Is your chiliocosm planning on invading us here?”
“Calling me an intruder so that you can take the moral high ground? There’s no need!” Jiang Ming shook his head and said, “My purpose was initially to save my sister. However, I discovered the doings of your Sacred Land disciples which gave me a different idea…”
A blade appeared in his hand. It was a Saint weapon, the Golden Obsidian. As he held onto the Saint blade, his aura rose continuously.
“I want to see if I can kill a Saint within a Great Chiliocosm. Truly to…” Jiang Ming said word by word, “Slaughter a Saint!”
The Five Elemental Saint Lord’s expression changed drastically.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - Great Fortunes that even the Dao Patriarch was Coveting
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Great Fortunes that even the Dao Patriarch was Coveting
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Within the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, there were a total of seven Saints. There were the Dao Patriarch, Yin Yang Saint Lord, Five Elemental Saint Lord, Creation Saint Lord, Reincarnation Saint Lord, Verdant Sky Saint Lord and the Inversion Saint Lord.
In fact, when Jiang Ming rescued the Verdant Emperor and killed the White Emperor as well as other experts, he had already alerted many Saint Lords. They were just furtively observing.
It was a norm for those Saint Lords not to be the first to show up. It didn’t matter if the killer was of mysterious origins or if he was slaughtering the Quasi-Sages. Of course, they wouldn’t be fazed when these Quasi-Sage, who were killed, weren’t of their lineage. Even if they were, they wouldn’t feel fave either.
Example was the Five Elemental Saint Lord, who was forced to show up only when his sect was about to be completely wiped out.
In fact, the real reason why he showed up was because of the disappearance of the Twelve-Graded Green Lotus. Even he himself couldn’t sense the Saint Weapon’s presence, which was how he knew that things had gone terribly wrong.
He learned that this invader was not here to vent his anger at all, but to fight to the last gasp here. Sure enough, this outsider was going to strike him down without much words.
‘Haha! This is my chiliocosm, my territory! To think that a foreign mutt like you still dares to bare your fangs here? Today, I’ll kill you, suppress your Saint physique, and exterminate your Saint Soul! Even if you have an imprint back in the core of your original chiliocosm, I’ll make sure you won’t be able to recover for billions of years!’
A treasured tree appeared above the Five Elemental Saint Lord’s head. Hanging down from the tree were tens of thousands of threads. These were actually the chains of order, the luminance of the Heavenly Dao, protecting him in the middle.
This treasured tree was actually his true body, a Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree. It was of the supreme-graded Innate Spiritual root. Upon stepping onto the path of Dao, it had stripped off from its original body and was refined into a treasure for defense and protection.
At the same time, a horsetail duster could be seen appearing in his hand as well. This was merely a Demi-Sage Weapon that contained the Dao Fluctuations of the Saints. It was a pity that the weapon had not completely sublimated and was still a little lacking.
“That’s the way to do it!” Seeing his opponent’s aura sky-rocketing, Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile as he bellowed, “Try this slash of mine! Great Destructive Technique!”
The Three Thousand Laws technique was a technique he had been comprehending without fail. The Great Destructive Technique was not just the Law of Destruction but a fusion of Law of Devastation, Law of Death, Laws of Ruin, Art of Withering, Power of Decay, Wonders of Dissolution, Mystery of Power, Shackles of Space and so on.
This allowed the Great Destructive Technique’s capability to reach an extreme realm. When it was evoked through the power of Saints, embodied with the Saint Weapon Golden Obsidian as the carrier, Jiang Ming struck an ultimate blow towards the Saint Lord.
......
“Great special ability!” The Five Elemental Saint Lord exclaimed in admiration. With a wave of his hand, the duster emitted tens of thousands rays of light composed of five different colors. The lights drew on the five elemental origins between the heavens and earth, forming a curtain of light in front of his body.
Although it was immediately shattered, the curtain of light blocked off the slash.
“The Second Form of the Great Destructive Technique, Third Form …”
Jiang Ming’s eyes suddenly lit up as he turned his blade over, darting forward. The luminance of the blade formed a barrage of slashes. In the snap of a finger, Jiang Ming had slashed 81 times altogether. But because the blades were so fast, it was as if the whole attack was just a single slash.
“Five Elemental Cycle! Great Dao within!”
The Five Elemental Saint Lord quickly waved his duster, and the Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree that was already high above his head also blossomed with immortal luminance, incorporating streams of Dao energy into it. This caused the potency of his special ability to soar, surprisingly blocking the attack.
“You have the Saint’s power in your body, but you don’t have the Saint Dao Fruit. This is indeed very strange, weird, and unbelievable!” The Five Elemental Saint Lord had already discovered what was bizarre about Jiang Ming.
The strength of the special abilities that he had evoked clearly had the quality of the Saint’s power. Or rather, it was purer and more powerful. However, the Dao Fluctuation that was radiating from his body was not even of the Quasi-Sage, let alone the Saint Realm. The subtlety of his special abilities were merely fusions of the Great Overarching Laws. It was really weird indeed.
“If I had really mastered the Saint Dao Fruit, I could’ve cleaved you in one swift slash already!” Jiang Ming snorted coldly. His attacks however, did not stop in the slightest.
What Jiang Ming said was true. If he manages to master the Saint Fruit Dao, his inner world would have at least evolved into the level of the great chiliocosm already. With such power by then, putting special abilities aside, he would be able to forcefully suppress the Five Elemental Saint Lord by just using his World Projection.
In fact, Jiang Ming’s shortcomings were very obvious now. He only had the powers of a Saint, but did not possess the Dao of a Saint. He could only rely on supreme strength, Saint Weapons and the fusion of different special abilities.
Nevertheless, the Five Elemental Saint Lord, his opponent, also had Saint Weapons, and Saint’s power, even though the Five Elemental Saint Lord Saint’s Saint’s power was slightly weaker and limited than Jiang Ming.
As for the special abilities, the Five Elemental Saint Lord must have mastered the Saint Laws, whereas Jiang Ming could only evoke Great Overarching Laws and constantly improve his special abilities through the wonders of fusion, forcibly increasing the mights of his special abilities up to the Saint Daos.
All in all, he was no stronger than his opponent if he didn’t evoke the techniques of Soul Dao.
“That’s it?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord snorted coldly. He channeled the powers of the origin and the laws of the Heavenly Dao, forming a Five Elemental Great Revolution, deflecting the attack in its entirety, “To think that you were thinking of slaughtering Saints! Heh! I don’t know where you got the courage to do so. Do you really think that by having the Saint’s power, special abilities of the Saint Daos and Saint Weapons, you will be able to do whatever you want and lawlessly take control of anything and everything? Kid, you’ve met your maker this time.”
The Saint Lord had changed from being cautious to feeling contempt.
“Is that so?” Jiang Ming was not annoyed in the slightest, and with a twist of his blade, he cast the Heavenly Battle Nine Decimations, the terminating 36 slashes, and the 72 techniques of heaven decimation.
Each special ability was so powerful and terrifying that it even caused the Five Elemental Saint Lord to be incomparably horrified. If he hadn’t been able to invoke the power of the world’s origin within the chiliocosm, he wouldn’t have been able to block the attacks.
“Tell me, where do you come from? Why did you descend to this chiliocosm and go on a killing spree?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord didn’t return the exchange. While blocking off the attacks, he couldn’t help asking questions.
“I also want to know why you Saints still stay within the great chiliocosm. Why don’t you all head into the Sea of Chaos?” Jiang Ming wondered earnestly.
When he descended into Ye Qingxian’s chiliocosm, there was only one Saint Lord who stayed back to shelter the chiliocosm. As for the Honggu Ancient world that he came from, all seven of Saint Lords had already left their chiliocosm.
However, it was different here. Even the Dao Patriarch was still around. This was obviously abnormal.
“What’s this Sea of Chaos?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord asked, looking puzzled.
Jiang Ming merely narrowed his eyes. He didn’t believe that the Five Elemental Saint Lord didn’t know about the Sea of Chaos. It was possible for Quasi-Sages not to know of that place. However, a Saint not knowing about the place was a little outrageous.
While attacking vigorously, Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record to check on the Five Elemental Saint Lord’s ‘Status’.
Great guy. This person was actually lying with his eyes wide open.
Name: Five Elemental Pine Needle.
Status:…
:Good lord! This person actually knows about the Sea of Chaos as well. He should, actually.
: Alas, the Sea of Chaos. Why would I not think of going there? Heading towards the Sea of Chaos would definitely improve my cultivation a lot faster. However, it is insignificant when compared to the great fortune over here.
: Who would’ve thought that there is a hidden treasure over on the side of our chiliocosm. Even the Dao Patriarch didn’t dare to forcibly barge in for the treasure with his current cultivation realm. The formation inside is beyond our imagination. Even Saints such as myself don’t understand the formation there.
: However, according to the speculations of the Dao Patriarch, this array formation has its cycle. Once it reaches the cycle node, it will be correspondingly weakened by a lot. That will be the best time frame for us to enter.
: The Dao Patriarch also speculated that there must be techniques far stronger than Saints, coupled with supreme treasures and supreme spiritual objects of Chaos.
: If I manage to get my hands on the Five Elemental Chaos Spiritual Roots and integrate it into myself, I’ll definitely manage to take another step forward in my cultivation realm. By then, my cultivation would reap twice as much success with half the effort and even have the opportunity to surpass the Saint Realm.
Jiang Ming was greatly stirred. ‘There is actually a hidden supreme formation that makes even the Dao Patriarch powerless to it? This is interesting. Hehe! Really interesting indeed.’

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - Heavenly Authority, Besieged by Six Saints
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Heavenly Authority, Besieged by Six Saints
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming didn’t tell the Five Elemental Saint Lord about his origin.
The Five Elemental Saint Lord didn’t say anything either. However, Jiang Ming already knew the answer plain and simple.
“You’re no more than that.” The Five Elemental Saint Lord sneered and snickered, “Although your special abilities are strong, you have not mastered the wonders of the Saint Dao after all. You are only relying on brute strength. I’ll ask you one last time, where do you come from? Why did you descend to this world? Don’t ever tell me it’s just to save a little lady.”
The Five Elemental Saint Lord thought that Jiang Ming would descend into another chiliocosm just to save a life was just pulling on people’s legs! He knew from his experience that it wasn’t that easy to descend here when they were separated by the Chaos. In his past experience in the Chaos, he couldn’t even teleport around, let alone rip through space. He was only able to fly at a rapid pace to move around. After all, the Chaos Laws overwhelmed everything.
“Nonsense!” Jiang Ming grunted, he didn’t diminish the power of the Golden Obsidian in his hand at all. At the same time, he was contemplating which Saint Weapon he should evoke next to fight against the Five Elemental Saint Lord.
Based on the current situation, it would be difficult to defeat Five Elemental Saint Lord without using the Soul Dao method.
Jiang Ming had quite a few Saint Weapons in his hands: the Blood Banner, the Zhentian Tower, the Taixu God Slaying Needle, the Golden Obsidian, the Astral Golden Bell, the Spear of Judgment, and weapons that were comparable to Saint Weapons when fused such as the nine Universe Swords, nine God Sealing Tablets, as well as the Twelve-Graded Green Lotus that he recently just suppressed.
It was very unfortunate that the many supreme treasures that had been devoured by the Chaotic World Tree back in the galaxy. Although they allowed the Chaotic World Tree to grow to a terrifying level, it had also caused him to be in great pickle.
The other option he had was the Heaven-Shattering Spear, a King Saint Weapon.
“Nonsense?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord was furious but delighted at the same time. “Don’t want to talk? I’ll suppress you first, deprive your soul and reveal all of your memories!”
“Let me show you what terrifying power a Saint can exert within his native chiliocosm!”
“Saint Dao Fruit, Heavenly authority, empower my body!”
As the Five Elemental Saint Lord finished his words, a strange aura emanated from his body. In an instant, he invoked the power of the Heavenly Dao’s Origin Law of order, allowing his power to sky-rocket.
......
This was the enhancement by the origin of the chiliocosm, giving him the ability to harness the power of the chiliocosm itself. That’s what made the Five Elemental Saint Lord truly powerful and immensely terrifying.
Jiang Ming frowned. He had heard of such a situation before, but he didn’t pay much attention to it.
When he was back in the galaxy, the many experts there did not have this ability to draw on the origin of the Chiliocosm. He wondered if it was because of the special nature of the chiliocosm, or was it because that chiliocosm had its own consciousness already.
“Innate Five Elemental Great Grinding Wheel!”
As the Five Elemental Saint Lord pressed with his palm down, the void immediately trembled. The five elemental chains of order manifested itself. The chain which ran through the void itself seemed to have extended out from all of the matter of the chiliocosm, accumulating into a supreme power.
Between the intertwining luminance, it formed a grinding wheel and quickly descended upon Jiang Ming.
The void was frozen in place and time stood still. Under the area covered by the grinding wheel, everything around Jiang Ming stopped its cycle.
The laws and reasons, Dao and virtue, all seemed to have turned into nothingness. What’s left was only the grinding wheel carrying the power of destruction, rotating itself, aiming to destroy Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming’s body sank. He surprisingly found that it was difficult for him to move for a while.
‘So this is the power of the Saint within their native chiliocosm?’
This time, Jiang Ming was able to truly experience the power of a Saint himself. However, he wasn’t afraid at all.
“Zhentian Tower! Reveal yourself! Lend me your support!”
*Rumble…*
The supreme tower rushed out above his head. It was a nine-storey high tower that was oozing with Xuanhuang chiliocosm aura. The supreme power that was contained within it erupted right this moment, forming a heavenly barrier that covered the entire sky, resisting the falling Five Elemental Great Grinding Wheel.
The Zhentian Tower barely resisted the impact, but it was still coming down on him.
“Go forth!”
The Five Elemental Saint Lord frowned. His supreme treasure, the Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree turned into a stream of light, merging into the Five Elemental Great Grinding Wheel. At the very next moment, the whole void shuddered, and the Heavenly Dao trembled.
Zhentian Tower was swiftly suppressed by the impact.
“Astral Golden Bell, come out!”
“God Sealing Tablet, merge with me!”
Jiang Ming suddenly went all out.
He evoked another supreme treasure. This treasured bell directly lined itself right next to Zhentian Tower when it was evoked, spewing out trails of golden luminance. Even so, these supreme treasures weren’t able to completely defend against the Five Elemental Grinding Wheel.
But with the God Sealing Tablet merging into his body, his power soared rapidly. He raised the blade in his hand, launched himself up and slashed midair.As though he was opening up heaven and earth, he forcibly split the Five Elemental Great Grinding Wheel in half.
The Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree was blown away from the impact.
“To think that you are able to fend off this attack of mine!” The Five Elemental Saint Lord was taken back. However, his pupils constricted when he saw the luminance surrounding Jiang Ming’s body. A pang of jealousy suddenly loomed over him.
‘God damn it! That’s three supreme treasures! No, that’s not it. He seems to have another one still suppressed in his body, plus the Twelve-Graded Green Lotus that he had plundered. That’s five pieces of supreme treasure already! Damn! I need to wrap up this battle quickly. Otherwise, if those guys can’t help themselves from joining in, this will become even more troublesome.’
As such a thought ran through his mind, the Five Elemental Saint Lord began to go all out.
“Heavenly Authority, enchant my body!”
“Saint Dao Law Domain, suppression!”
“Reversal Innate Five Elemental Life and Death Formation, out!”
He was revealing all his triumph cards this time.
The power of the Heavenly Authority made him seem as though his body was forged of gold. Once his Saint Dao Law Domain was evoked, it completely turned the whole surrounding area into his domain.
He even revealed his most secretive technique where he had arranged an ultimate formation under the five Sacred Mountain beforehand as a preventive measure. He never thought he would have to use this technique of his, but he had to this time.
In an instant, the five tattered Sacred Mountains could be seen shooting divine luminance of green, red, yellow, white and black colors into the sky. As the five elemental colors intertwined, they transformed into a supreme formation.
This technique came to fruition based on his own power of origin coupled with the guidance of the Dao Patriarch as well as the Innate Great Array that he was born with.
When these two groups, Positive Five Elements and Negative Five Elements, merged together, they transformed into a great life and death formation array that dominated all life and death.
Whoever fell into the formation would lose the control over his life.
This time, Jiang Ming’s expression finally took a turn, revealing a grave look on his face. He felt his body was extremely heavy. With the suppression of the Saint Domain and the Heavenly Authority, coupled with the great formation, he couldn’t even lift a finger.
“Kid, what else are you capable of?” With victory within his grasp, the Five Elemental Saint Lord waved his hand, sending the Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree to merge into the great formation.
“You’re really forcing my hand!” Jiang Ming said in an icy-cold tone.
‘Return of Infinite Law Finger? That might not be enough to break me free. Infinite Transcendence Technique? It wouldn’t be effective enough. Perhaps the only thing I can do is to evoke the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to break free of the confinement with just one blow. Shall I detonate the Wind God Tablet, a Saint Weapon or a stream of Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels?’
Thoughts raced through Jiang Ming’s mind.
Just as Jiang Ming was about to detonate the nine Universe Swords, the whole great formation suddenly shook violently. This caused the Five Elemental Saint Lord to turn pale as he became furious. “Damn it! The five of you! Stop it! Stop! Are you trying to become a traitor to our chiliocosm?”
His anger almost shot through the heaven, burning it into ashes. As he continued to shout furiously, he was trying his best to evoke the great formation and resist the trembles.
But in the end, it wasn’t enough.
*Rumble…*
As a deafening explosion erupted, the great formation blew up. Five Saint Experts could be seen breaking through the void and arriving at the scene.
“Five Elemental! You still couldn’t take down this feeble foreign thief after so long. You’re really tarnishing the dignity of us Saints.” Yin Yang Saint Lord gave him a meek smile and continued, “We’re here to lend you a hand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - Rascally Saints
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Rascally Saints
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming thought of giving the Five Elemental Saint Lord a harsh retaliation, but the great formation was destroyed by another five Saint Lords from the outside.
All the Yin Yang Saint Lord, Creation Saint Lord, Reincarnation Saint Lord, Verdant Sky Saint Lord, and the Inversion Saint Lord had got here.
This made Jiang Ming sniggered. It wasn’t difficult for Jiang Ming to speculate what the five Saint Lords were up to after all.
They thought Jiang Ming was trapped, and had revealed all his means. Hence, they deemed that Jiang Ming could be easily manipulated, and showed up together to prevent the Five Elemental Saint Lords from taking all the benefits away.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record, checked on the ‘Status’ of the Yin Yang Saint Lord, and validated his speculation.
Status: The pagoda, bell, blade, and the peerless great vessel in him, I wonder where this rich guy comes from?
: He’s too rich indeed.
: I only have got two Saint Weapons.
: Other than Five Elemental and I, all the other four only have one each.
: Yet this guy actually has five pieces. This is unfair.
: Damn, Five Elemental actually has such hidden means. Does he plan to give me a harsh strike in the near future? Haha, very well.
: If I were to fall into this great formation, it’d be a great trouble. I may be injured as well. Five Elemental, you this geezer are truly vicious.
: This foreign brat is really weak!
......
: Even though he has the Saint’s power, Saint’s Laws and the Saint Weapons, without the Saint Physique and Saint Soul, he’s utterly incompetent. I thought he’s strong for being boisterous at the beginning. But it turns out that he doesn’t even know his ass from a hole in the ground.
: He can’t block the ruthless strike of Five Elemental for sure. If he was to be suppressed, the Five Elemental would definitely take all the great vessels of him, wouldn’t he? No way, absolutely no way that I’ll let this geezer take away all the benefits.
: If I were to strike, I’ll definitely won’t get all the benefits. In this case, I shall work together with the others while minimizing the effects of the skirmish.
: Moreover, if all five of us were to strike together, this Five Elemental geezer wouldn’t be able to do anything regardless of how infuriated he is.
: Haha, let’s enrage him.
: As expected, Creation and the others are coveting this brat’s wealth as well.
: Alright, let’s just attack and destroy the great formation together. At the same time, we shall find out how tough this formation of Five Elemental is. The best is we destroy its base directly.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but feel funny as he read. Anyway, he could understand the Yin Yang Saint Lord’s intention. After all, the inequitable distribution of wealth was always an issue.
If all the treasures of Jiang Ming were to be obtained by the Five Elemental Saint Lord alone, the possibility of the Five Elemental Saint Lord to be besieged by the other five would be very high, irrespective of their relationships.
When the Five Elemental Saint Lord saw that his great formation, including the base was destroyed, and heard the others teasing him, he blushed, and in his eyes were burning with flames. The Five Elemental Saint Lord was infuriated even though he was a Saint, who was supposed to have the Saint’s frame of mind.
“All five of you are f*cking shameless bastards.” Five Elemental Saint Lord was raging with fury as he was pointing at Yin Yang Saint Lord. “Saying that I’m tarnishing the dignity of us Saints? Aren’t you ashamed of yourself? Lend me a hand? Are you blind? Didn’t you see that I’ve trapped him? If you wanted to help, why didn’t you help earlier when my sect was destroyed? Why didn’t you help when my disciples were killed? Get out of my way now!”
He wanted to say ‘f*ck off’ but when he saw the hostility in the eyes of the five, his common sense triumphed in the end.
“Oh my Junior Brother Five Elemental, it’s not right to do so.” Yin Yang Saint Lord remained smiling as he said, “I’m your Senior Brother. And I’m here to help you just because I see that you can’t end the battle fast. Why are you condemning my kindness? Five Elemental, why are your temperament getting worse along with your improvement in your cultivation base? Can it be that you are enchanted by the foreign devil, and become a devil yourself?”
Yin Yang Saint Lord’s expression gradually calmed down, and even showed hints of sternness. “Would you like me to invite you to the master’s?”
“Yin Yang!” Five Elemental Saint Lord gnashed his teeth and eventually he smirked coldly, “Aren’t you plotting against that brat’s Supreme Treasures? Such a hypocrite to make it sound so noble. You’re so shameless, and disgusting that even I’m ashamed to be your junior brother!”
Five Elemental Saint Lord was truly furious. ‘Damn it. Just tell directly if you are here for the benefits. Or you can tell indirectly. Mother f*cker! You actually slandering me for becoming a devil myself and that you want to get our master to be the judge? F*ck! Such a hypocrite!’
“Five Elemental!” Yin Yang Saint Lord was startled, and his expression instantly became grave. “You’ve misunderstood me too much.”
“Ha!” Five Elemental Saint Lord scorned, “I feel shameful to have you as my Great Senior Brother.”
“No manners and disrespect. Five Elemental, I’ll have to teach you on behalf of our master.” Yin Yang Saint Lord began feeling ashamed.
A pagoda with 81-storeys, shot out above his head. It had millions of Xuanhuang Qi exuded, covering the sky. As Yin Yang Saint Lord grabbed, a long sword appeared. Its sharp aura pierced through heaven and earth, showing off its supreme might.
“Alright, alright. The two of you are of the same clan yet you are making a fool of yourself here. Aren’t you two ashamed?” Inversion Saint Lord came forward to stop the two. “Great senior brother, although we acknowledge Dao Patriarch as our master almost simultaneously, you’re still our great senior brother, aren’t you? No matter what, you should be more tolerant of your junior brother.”
“Senior Brother Five Elemental, you know that our great senior brother needs to be respected. Even if you’re angered, you should just furtively complain and not mock him?” Inversion Saint Lord said.
Both Five Elemental Saint Lord and Yin Yan Saint Lord abruptly turned towards Inversion Saint Lord with their eyes filled with burning flames.
‘Damn it. Are you trying to stop us? No, you’re worsening it.’
The other three saint lords were watching happily. Even Jiang Ming was smiling too.
Jiang Ming had finally learned that these six saint lords weren’t brothers but rivals. He even learned from their ‘Status’ that they didn’t even really respect their master, the Dao Patriarch.
In fact, they had been fighting against each other since the beginning. They even almost killed the other just to be the first in santifying Dao. In the end, Dao Patriarch became the first one to sanctify the way of Dao, and overwhelmed the six of them with his own strength. Hence, they had no choice but perfunctorily acknowledge Dao Patriarch as their master.
