Because Yin Yang Saint Lord had innate Yin-Yang qi, and better foundation, he became the great senior brother. He eventually managed to sanctify his way of Dao and became the Yin Yang Saint Lord.
The conflicts and fights persisted even after the six of them had sanctified their ways of Dao. Most of the time, however, they didn’t fight personally. It was their disciples who fought against each other.
With the Sacred Lands competing against each other, the Heaven Court was thereby losing its dignity. The Heavenly Emperor could only act perfunctory.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but shake his head. He knew if it wasn’t because of the Dao Patriarch, the chiliocosm would have collapsed from their fights.
At this moment, the Creation Saint Lord chimed in. “Don’t fight in front of the outsiders.” The Creation Saint Lord was a woman. She had excellent demeanor and unparalleled temperament. Each word she said contained the emotions that would make all living beings’ hearts skip a beat. “We all know clearly what we are up to. Don’t talk nonsense. We should talk only after we deal with this foreign guy. Look, he’s watching us making a fool of ourselves. He’s not having even a hint of nervousness, obviously showing that he hasn’t played his own trump card. Hence, he may be able to protect himself.”
“Let’s just suppress him first!” Reincarnation Saint Lord had a wheel appear above him, radiating luminance that formed a pitch-black black hole on top of Jiang Ming’s head. It was emitting the great power which could gobble up heavens, trying to pull Jiang Ming in.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - Killed Reincarnation in a Second
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Killed Reincarnation in a Second
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
“I still have to continue killing as expected!” Jiang Ming sighed helplessly.
With the appearance of all six Saints, Jiang Ming knew that he would be slaughtered if he was to go according to his previous strategy.
Along with Reincarnation Saint Lord taking his move, the other Saints had stopped their quarrel. They looked over to Jiang Ming while confining the void around him so that he was given no way to escape.
It was obvious that they were quarreling because they belittled Jiang Ming, and thought that it wasn’t difficult to have Jiang Ming killed.
Buzzzz!
The suction of the black hole was extraordinarily horrifying. It would be difficult even for Tai Yuan to resist the force if he were around.
However, Jiang Ming wasn’t afraid of the suction force at all. With the surging immortal luminance of the Zhentian Tower, and the Astral Golden Bell’s might, Jiang Ming easily blocked the suction force of the black hole.
Although Jiang Ming was holding the Golden Obsidian, he didn’t slash with it. But with a flash across his forehead, he thrust the Taixu God Slaying Needle into the forehead, and into the sea of consciousness of the Reincarnation Saint Lord.
Jiang Ming’s action was so fast that even the Reincarnation Saint Lord couldn’t react in time.
Pff…
The Taixu God Slaying Needle pierced into the forehead of the Reincarnation Saint Lord, and went out from the back of his head. It brought out wisps of golden blood, and pieces of broken Saint Soul.
Jiang Ming wiped out the Saint Soul of Reincarnation Saint Lord with just a thrust.
“To think that I’m killed!” The Reincarnation Saint Lord looked stiff. Both his eyes were filled with disbelief. “He actually has another Saint Weapon, an offensive Soul Dao Saint Weapon. Besides, his Saint Soul is stronger than mine. In fact, it’s a lot stronger. Beware that he’s the dark horse.”
......
As a Saint, the Reincarnation Saint Lord was able to forcefully leave some words even if he was dead.
As soon as he finished his words, he was no longer breathing.
All the other five saint lords were stunned, expressing their horror.
Following that, a chilling wind appeared out of thin air, blowing past all corners of the chiliocosm. It was even raining with blood, lightning strokes and thunder roared, as a means to mourn over a Saint’s death.
All living beings simultaneously had a somber feeling. It was at this moment that all experts who were relatively successful in their cultivation, somewhat knew that a Saint had died.
‘Damn it, a Saint is dead? This is f*cking good. I want to celebrate continuously for three days. Nonono, not three days but 3,000 years.’
There were an unknown number of experts having such a thought.
As Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed, he grabbed hold of the Innate Supreme Treasure Reincarnation Disc, and the Saint Body. He immediately suppressed them as his winning trophies.
The Five Elemental Saint Lord was staring at Jiang Ming as though he hadn’t recovered his senses.
Yin Yang Saint Lord, “Did he die just like that?”
Five Elemental Saint Lord, “You geezer are right. He died just like that. But how can he be dead?”
Creation Saint Lord, “He only took out his Reincarnation Disc to attack. He didn’t evoke any defensive special ability, and he didn’t even have a proper defensive supreme treasure.”
Verdant Sky Saint Lord, “No, the main reason that he died is because of this Daoist, who has a terrific Saint Soul. He even evoked an Innate Supreme Treasure specializing in soul attack. Not to mention Reincarnation, even us would die if we weren’t meticulous enough.”
Inversion Saint Lord, “All would die!”
Jiang Ming had a strange look on his face. He somehow felt that these Saint Lords were quite abnormal. They didn’t look like Saints at all.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record again to check on Yin Yang Saint Lord.
Status: Dead, Reincarnation is killed just like that.
: Damn, how can this brat be so terrifying?
: Even if he made his move by surprise, and has the Soul Dao Innate Supreme Treasure, he shouldn’t be capable of killing Reincarnation that quickly. In this case, the only explanation is that he has a strong Saint Soul, an incomparably strong one.
: He’s here with ill-intentions indeed. He must have other unknown abilities.
: It’s troublesome, truly troublesome.
: Even if all five of us are working together, we may not be able to defeat him. If he were to have other unknown trump cards, we’d be in danger.
: I shall not take my move but let one of the other four try first. The best is to have Dao Patriarch, that geezer to attack.
: Nevertheless, this brat has too many supreme treasures, doesn’t he?
: A bell, a pagoda, a blade, a needle and the great vessel suppressing within his body. There’re also the Twelve-Graded Green Lotus of Five Elemental, and the Reincarnation Disc of Reincarnation. Hiss…If I were to obtain all of them, I’d be able to win over Dao Patriarch.
: I’m filled with envy, jealousy and hatred. Hence, I must figure out a way to kill this brat.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless reading the Status. He thought Yin Yang Saint Lord was a schemer who didn’t even look like a Saint. And Yin Yang Saint Lord didn’t really respect the Dao Patriarch.
In fact, the other surviving Saint Lords were similar too.
‘I’ve learnt something new indeed.’ Jiang Ming had his horizon truly broadened.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming understood the reasons behind through reading all their ‘Status’. The reason for such a situation was that the resentment they had towards each other was too deep when they fought with each other back then. The hatred remained although they had all sanctified their way of Dao.
Besides, because they couldn’t kill each other as a Saint, they could only fight against each other furtively.
The Yin Yang Saint Lord in particular, hated the Dao Patriarch even more. Because the Dao Patriarch had stopped him from slaughtering Five Elemental, Creation and the others when he sanctified his way of Dao. Yin Yang Saint Lord preferred to have them all dead.
“Great senior brother, he killed Reincarnation.” Inverse Saint Lord turned to Yin Yang Saint Lord and said, “You’ll have to take revenge for our junior brothers!”
“Yes, he’s too strong. Only you as our great senior brother are capable of confronting him!” As Verdant Sky Saint Lord said, an Apocalypse Great Grinder appeared atop him, protecting him. “Your Xuanhuang Exquisite Supreme Pagoda is known to be the best defensive supreme treasure in all realms. Together with your Relentless Sword, it’s certainly not a big deal for you to defeat this brat.”
“Great senior brother, take your move!” Creation Saint Lord urged too.
“Senior brother, no one else is better than you do!” Five Elemental Saint Lord said.
“I-I…” Yin Yang Saint Lord knew that he had to launch his attack. He bellowed, “This brat has an unknown background and has unpredictable means. Hence, I’m afraid that he has other means. Creation, Five Elemental, Verdant Sky, Inversion, let’s work together to make sure that we can suppress him as soon as possible without fail. This is to prevent any of us from following Reincarnation’s footsteps!”
“Sure, I’ll listen to you!” The Creation Saint Lord nodded without hesitation.
The meaning of what the great senior brother had said was obvious. He wanted all of them to let go of the grudge temporarily in the face of their mutual enemy for it was the critical moment of life-and-death.
The other three Saint Lords also nodded their heads in agreement.
However, before they could make their move, a total of 18 Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels appeared before Jiang Ming. Each emitting unparalleled strong aura, containing Dao fluctuations. Their divine luminance radiated out, and were intertwining. And they actually formed a great formation.
“What do you mean?” Yin Yang Saint Lord was very meticulous as he asked confusedly. “You’ve evoked so many Saint Weapons, how long can your strength last? Why are you taking out so many Dao weapons? Other than spending more of your energy, evoking them isn’t useful at all, is it?”
Although Yin Yang Saint Lord said so, he acted very meticulously. There were more Xuanhuang qi emitted out of the pagoda atop his head to shroud him. The Xuanhuang qi shrouding him was even more materialized as a means to protect him. The bad feeling rising up from his stomach pit inexplicably got stronger.
“Useless? Which thing among all things in the world is useless?” Jiang Ming grinned. “Take a grass as an example, it can be so strong that it could slash stellars. Even if it’s as weak as a common grass in the mortal world, it can be the producer and the base of food chains and complex food webs. How can you say that it’s useless? Ha, these Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels are in fact the killing machine to kill all of you.”
“Detonate!” Jiang Ming evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique bluntly.
‘Since you all are intriguing against each other, and not take your initiative, I’ll make you all fully regret your action!”
Boom!
In an instant, all 18 Quasi-Sage Weapons were exploded simultaneously.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - Imperial Concubine: Emperor, Can You do it?
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Imperial Concubine: Emperor, Can You do it?
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
No one had ever expected that Quasi-Sage Weapons could be detonated. Because even the Saint Lords couldn’t make it. It would take a long time even for a Saint Lord to destroy a Quasi-Sage Weapon, let alone detonating all its energy in an instant. What’s more there were a total of 18 pieces.
This was beyond the expectation of all five Saint Lords.
“Damn it, this brat isn’t a human. I’m done for!” Yin Yang Saint Lord cried. He couldn’t manage to tear space and elude at all. He could only evoke the 81-storeys pagoda atop his head to its maximum capacity. Billions of Xuanhuang qi shrouded and protected him in the middle. At the same time, various divine luminance glittering on his body. They originated from either his defensive special abilities or other defensive vessels.
He had pushed himself to the extreme in defending himself at this moment. He was confident that he could resist a few waves of Dao Patriarch’s attack yet he didn’t have any sense of security now.
‘That is after all, the detonation of a total of 18 pieces of Quasi-Sage Weapons. It isn’t one or two pieces but a total of f*cking 18 pieces! Holy shit! Who can block such an impact? Not even the Dao Patriarch can! But what’d happen to that brat at the center of the explosion?’ Thoughts run through Yin Yang Saint Lord’s mind. It was immediately followed by him drowning in the endless power of destruction.
The situation of the other Saint Lords was about the same. All of them evoked their supreme treasures to defend themselves immediately.
Rumble…
Torrent of destruction exploded, destroying the Five Elemental Sacred Land in an instant. The power of destruction extended out unceasingly to all directions, up to billions of miles in just a blink of an eye.
The torrent had led to the sinking of the earth, and the collapse of heaven. All the rules and laws crumbled, and the chains of rules broke. All tangible and intangible things were wiped out.
Because of the horrifying power at the center of the explosion, all things had returned to Chaos. The four elements of matter, earth, fire, wind, and water, were continuously producing and annihilating.
The entire scene was extremely terrifying.
Jiang Ming, who was at the center of the explosion, spent 10,000 points to activate his privilege, the invincible defense mode. Even though he had no such privilege, he was able to leave through the Human Path Record the moment he had detonated all those Dao vessels.
At this moment, the chiliocosm, including all things, went silent. All experts in the world felt the extraordinary terrifying waves of destruction, causing an unknown number of them to walk out of their seclusion’s place, staring towards the Five Elemental Sacred Land with shock filled their faces.
......
Alas, such waves seemed to have gone beyond the power of a Saint! Following that, the world abruptly darkened, a howling and chilling squall accompanied by bloody rain, leading to all beings having a feeling of melancholy. Such a feeling was abrupt, and unexpected.
Most experts knew that it was a sign that a Saint had just died. They were startled at first, and then they were ecstatic. The Heavenly Emperor of the Heaven Court was especially excited that he leaped from the Imperial Concubine.
The Heavenly Emperor abhorred himself because he was threatened by Leng Yue, a disciple of the Five Elemental Saint Lord, not to save the Verdant Emperor. What’s worse was he couldn’t expose his feelings, he could only obey.
The Heavenly Emperor was so frustrated that he even smashed a few immortal treasures into pieces, and ended up letting out a helpless sigh.
However, as he investigated, he discovered that the Verdant Emperor was saved but the White Emperor was killed.
The Heavenly Emperor was instantly dumbfounded, followed by an extreme ecstatic. Since then, he had been checking on the situation of the world, and discovered Jiang Ming went to the Five Elemental Sacred Land along with the Verdant Emperor and his daughter.
Not long later, he saw Jiang Ming destroy the Sacred Land, and confronted the Five Elemental Saint Lord. He happily slapped on his thigh and howled in the empty hall, “Brother, to be daring to fight against the Saint Lord, you’re awesome, and you have my respect. If you survive, I’ll definitely be interested to know you.”
But when he learned that Jiang Ming was trapped in the Sacred Land, he sighed as he knew Jiang Ming wouldn’t survive the ordeal.
Following that, he saw the arrival of the other five Saint Lords, and they had been chattering for a while. The Reincarnation Saint Lord took his move, but he was killed in a blink of an eye.
The Heavenly Emperor, who had been peeping at the scene, couldn’t help but leap up.
“Hahaha…oh my Reincarnation, you have your day too. Haha, it’s good, and awesome that you are dead. I’m so f*ckingly excited. Damn, I’ve endured you for millions of years already. Not only you, even your disciples have been bullying me, now it’s great that you’re finally dead.”
“Just kill as many as you can. I don’t care where you are from and why are you doing so, if you are able to kill the other five Saint Lord, I’m even willing to abdicate the throne for you!”
“After you kill all of them, hehe, I’ll destroy all the six sacred lands. I’ll slaughter all the disciples, and sever all the inheritance. Even if they manage to resurrect later, that’d be in the future.”
“I’m truly happy, extremely excited!”
“No way, I shall celebrate by loving my lovely concubine.”
With the Heavenly Emperor reaching out and turning his hand, he teleported a concubine over to where he was. Following that, he enjoyed sex with her while peeping the battle.
When the 18 Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels were detonated, he was so horrified that his penis actually weakened.
When there was a squall accompanied by a bloody rain, the Heavenly Emperor knew clearly that there was another Saint Lord who was killed.
While leaping for joy, he discovered his penis again was erected even before his landing. Hence, he decided to celebrate again without further ado. He landed directly on his lovely concubine and went on.
Following that, there was another squall accompanied by a bloody rain.
“What the f*ck, another is dead!” The Heaven Emperor was dumbfounded, and ejaculated with a shiver.
“Emperor, this’s so fast…”The Imperial Concubine felt rather unsatisfied. As she was wriggling, she said coquettishly,”Oh my emperor, I want a long one!”
“Sure, I’ll give you a long one, and make sure you’re satisfied!” The Heavenly Emperor opened his mouth wide, and then fluttered in the air with his arms around his concubine. “Haha, it’s so beautiful, it’s so wonderful, it’s such a relief.”
“Emperor, I’ll make you feel relief forever!” The Imperial Concubine felt so great that her eyes were filled with flames of satisfaction.
“Haha, great!” The Heavenly Emperor guffawed.
…
On earth, the power of destruction gradually dispersed. The whereabouts of the Five Elemental Sacred Land was no longer seen. All the disciples vanished. Even Chang Tai, the eldest disciple wasn’t leaving any trace of his body behind, let alone the other disciples.
The earth was in an utter mess. The entire western land of the chiliocosm was destroyed, hundreds of millions of mountains collapsed, and ley lines cut off, leaving no life on earth at all.
This piece of land that spread at least 100 billion miles had become a barren territory.
Jiang Ming, on the other hand, was standing at the center of all. He took a glance at the scene and sighed to himself, but it quickly was replaced with indifference.
He was mentally prepared ever since he was confronting the immortal devils’ invasion in his mortal world. In the cultivation world, there was no need for sympathy, no need for mercy, no need for kindness, no need for rules, and no need for morality.
‘Perhaps I may die one day silently!’ As such a thought popped out, he cut it off. In fact, he had such an enlightenment a long time ago. He no longer had any sensational feeling as he focused on the three miserable figures a million miles away.
The situation of the Yin Yang Saint Lord was the best. Nevertheless, the luminance of the pagoda above his head was very dim, his face was very pale, his clothes were torn, and his aura was withering. It was obvious that he had almost used up all his energy just to resist the explosion just now. And he felt lucky to have survived the ordeal.
Creation Saint Lord was stepping on a cauldron and wore Saint Clothes. He seemed to be alright, but the bleeding from the corner of his mouth could not be stopped at all. Drops of golden blood dripped, showing that she was greatly injured.
She looked at Jiang Ming with her eyes filled with resentment and panic. She was almost dead after all. If she hadn’t joined hands with Yin Yang and Five Elemental at the critical moment, she would have died.
The Five Elemental Saint Lord was looking even more miserable. The Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree on his head was broken, and the trunk was broken. Even his left shoulder had gone. He was more than miserable, and almost died as well.
The three Saint Lords stood together, looking at Jiang Ming with extreme vigilance, and endless remorse.
They regretted that they attacked too quickly before the Five Elemental Saint Lord had thoroughly tested Jiang Ming’s capability, that they didn’t attack Jiang Ming with their best at the beginning, and that they were blinded by greed.
“Alas, Dao Patriarch, are you still watching?” As Yin Yang Saint Lord thought, he howled towards the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - he Origin of Dao Patriarch, The Fragment of Sea of Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: The Origin of Dao Patriarch, The Fragment of Sea of Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Yin Yang Saint Lord no longer cared about his dignity. In fact, he didn’t really care because he didn’t think it was important nor he would feel ashamed when being discovered by other experts. ‘I’ll just initiate a bloodshed throughout the world after the end of this calamity so that a new group of creatures would replace the old one. This is easy, isn’t it? As for me escaping? F*ck! I’ve basically spent all my energy. Although a Saint can connect the world and recover at a faster pace, can my recovery speed faster than this brat coming over?It’s better to drag time when escaping is akin to courting death.’
“Help us, master!” Five Elemental Saint Lord cried out too. In fact, other than the three Saint Lord who were dead, he was the most miserable among all. Not only was his sect destroyed, all the disciples he had cultivated for hundreds and millions of years were dead. Moreover, he had lost the Twelve-Graded Green Lotus, and the origin of his Five Elemental Pine Needle Tree was destroyed.
‘Damn it, I’m doomed.’ If he hadn’t gone to the side of Yin Yang Saint Lord unashamedly, he would have mostly died just like the Verdant Sky Saint Lord, and the Inversion Saint Lord.
“Do you all think he will show up?” Jiang Ming turned his hand, and grabbed the dimmed Apocalypse Great Grinder, and the Gobbling Gourd over. He didn’t feel much struggle from the two.
“You’re from the Sea of Chaos, aren’t you?” The Creation Saint Lord suddenly spoke while her pair of beautiful eyes intended to see through Jiang Ming. Nevertheless, with her cultivation base only at the Saint Realm, it was difficult even for her to see through Jiang Ming’s nature.
“Oh, why do you say so?” Jiang Ming said as he continued walking towards them. Above him was the Zhentian Tower and in his hand was the Golden Obsidian. His aura remained as intimidating as it was.
“You’ve got the Saint Power, Saint Soul, Saint Laws, and Saint Weapons except Saint Dao. Such a weird situation can only be seen in the legendary inheritance of the Sea of Chaos.” As the Creation Saint Lord said, she slightly startled and blurted, “You’re taking the path of World Dao. Yes, it’s the World Dao. Such a possibility can occur only with World Dao.”
“World Dao? That’s right! Only the World Dao! Why didn’t I think of it!” The Five Elemental Saint Lord expressed his chagrin. “Alas, the World Dao! First opens a world within the body, then transforms it from illusional one to the real one before continuing evolving the inner world. As the origin of the inner world is akin to the Natural Laws of Heaven, he’s using the power akin to the Natural Laws of Heaven. The Great Overarching Laws, and the Saint Power, don’t they correspond to the middle chiliocosm?”
“Did you say the middle chiliocosm? The Natural Laws of Heaven are equivalent to the Saint Power. When the laws are of the Great Overarching Realm, and the soul is nurtured by the Natural Laws of Heaven, reaching the level of Saint Soul, which corresponds completely.” The scales fell from Yin Yang Saint Lord’s eyes, and then revealed a more intense fear. “The Dao Patriarch used to say that the path of World Dao is almost a dead end. Although there are experts who manage to go through, the Dao Patriarch only knew one. To think that you are capable of evolving your inner world to the level of middle chiliocosm, your background must be…”
Yin Yang Saint Lord was trembling. He knew that the World Dao, which was supposed to be a dead end, would definitely leave all beings in despair unless he was to have sky-defying encounters, massive resources, and the support of Supreme Experts.
At this moment, all of them raised their heads. An abrupt sound of immortality rang out from heaven, heavenly flowers fell down, and the violet qi permeated 30,000,000 miles through the sky.
The goddess condensed out of thin air, blowing the big Dharma conch, and beating the Dharma drum. Four sacred beasts even appeared, surrounded by three thousand sacred beasts.
An elder was descending from the sky. Every step he took, a golden lotus appeared beneath his foot. The golden lotus wouldn’t dissipate after he stepped past but imprinted in the void, becoming an unique view.
......
The elder’s hair was fluttering, while his silver whisker was rippling. At a glance, he made people respect from the heart, admire from the soul, and also made people think that he is the Dao, the law, and the starting point of everything. He was the Dao Patriarch.
“Greetings, master!” The three Saint Lords immediately bowed to pay their respects. They were very respectful.
“Alas, the three of you!” The Dao Patriarch pointed at the three, somewhat angrily. “Not knowing etiquette, not loving yourself, intriguing among you, and conspiring before the enemy.”
“Fellow Daoist, I’m sorry for that!” The Dao Patriarch clasped his hands towards Jiang Ming.
“Fellow Daoist, this world, and life, are a joke anyway. You don’t have to feel sorry for that!” Jiang Ming returned the Dao Patriarch’s greetings, beaming.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming’s first impression of the Dao Patriarch was not good. After all, the Dao Patriarch, as the strongest Saint in the world, and the master of the other six Saints, should have appeared immediately when his disciples were in trouble. Yet, he showed up only after the surviving three pleaded. Following that, he gave ambiguous comments to his three disciples.
Jiang Ming didn’t think that the actions that the Dao Patriarch had taken was a responsible one.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Records, and flipped to the page of the Dao Patriarch.
Name: Xing Chen (Hei Tian)
Gender: Male
Cultivation base: Saint Realm
Background: The Dao Patriarch of the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm
Relationship: -88
Status: At the beginning of the birth of heaven and earth, there was an innate spiritual root that was the treasure tree of stars, showing the genus of the astral stars. It had great fortune, luck, and spirituality because it was favored by heaven and earth.
: It bore 365 fruits, each of which contained a kind of heaven and earth’s Dao origin. As they matured, they didn’t fall on their own but being refined into itself.
: Finally, it transformed into a being, and called himself the Daoist Xing Chen.
: Because of his innate talent, he could evoke 365 laws. Besides, he could cultivate at an incomparably fast speed. Soon he became famous among the savage innate saints. He also made a name for himself and became a member of the group of top experts.
: He had been quietly cultivating without fighting and competing against others until he advanced to the peak stage of Quasi-Sage Realm. Then, he reached a bottleneck.
: In order to advance further, he began to fight the world. The struggle was endless, but the road ahead was vast and he did not know how to move forward.
: One day, he was very quiet and thoughtful, so he went for a walk in the Chaos, hoping to get some opportunities. However, he met with the chaotic storm and was dragged into it. Fortunately, he managed to escape and survived. He then discovered a unique place.
: Ahead of him was Chaos Thunder bombarding a land shrouded in green light. Each Chaos Thunder struck was extraordinarily horrifying, and was capable of killing him.
: Xing Chen felt a chill down his spine. When he was about to elude, he discovered that the Chaos Thunder quickly plunged into the depths of Chaos and disappeared without a trace.
: He knew that it should be like a chaotic storm, very erratic.
: The green light ahead turned dim, but Xing Chen couldn:t see it clearly. Even though he was very curious, he knew with his capability, he couldn’t reap anything from it. When he was about to leave, a fissure was seen on the green light. A phantom was seen flying out from it, and merged into his sea of consciousness with a flash.
: Xing Chen was shocked. He also learned that the phantom was a remnant soul. Even though it was just a wisp of it, its essence was so powerful that he couldn’t easily efface it.
: The wisp of the remnant soul wanted to replace him, but it couldn’t do anything about it.
: Xing Chen had spent thousands of years trying to merge the wisp of soul with his innate supreme treasure, and finally succeeded.
: As a result, he learned a lot of things, and his personal character underwent a huge change subtly.
: The wisp of the remnant soul was called Hei Tian. The land which he saw shrouded in green light, was a fragment of a land smashed by a great war in the Sea of Chaos. It was shrouded by the remnant formation, and drifted over. Who knew how many thousands of years for the fragment to get there.
: The wisp of the remnant soul managed to elude only by striking the green light with the Chaos Thunder. Unfortunately after hundreds of millions of years of wear and tear, Hei Tain’s remnant soul was extremely weary.
: Xing Chen also knew that the fragment of the remnant land ahead not only had supreme Sain Weapon, but also peerless inheritance, and even supreme immortal treasures that had been nurtured for hundreds and millions of years. Unfortunately, he would be killed if he was to enter with his own strength.
: The power of the remnant formation was too terrific. Even experts of the Saint Realm would mostly be killed for trespassing.
: After he got the method to become a Saint, he returned to the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm based on his senses. Not long later, he managed to sanctify his path of Dao and became a Saint.
: He wanted to kill the Yin Yang Great Monarch and the other few who had the potential to sanctify their path of Dao. But because he thought that he could take them with him to the place of encounter, and let them block the calamity on his behalf after he helped them to sanctify their path of Dao.
: Therefore, he not only didn’t kill them, he also taught them how to sanctify their path of Dao.
: The six of them gradually sanctified their path of Dao, and became a Saint themselves.
: Xing Chen had been visiting the place of encounter himself frequently. Based on the memory of Hei Tian and his investigation, he discovered the weakness of the remnant formation. He learned that after every period of time, the power of the formation would be inevitablyweakened. He knew this was the critical point for him to break into the land.
: He was not in a rush anyway. He cultivated till the perfect stage of the Saint Realm, and comprehended various supreme laws. He was about to be well-prepared. After a period of time, it would be the moment when the remnant formation got weakened.
: Who knew a foreigner would get here.
: The foreigner appeared out of thin air without even going through the world’s membrane? This was really strange. This kid must be of some strong background. Let’s just see how it went!
: He had the power of Saint, and the Saint Soul yet only mastered Great Overarching Law? It’s easy to guess that he was of the World Dao, and alas, his inner world had advanced into the level of middle chiliocosm!
: He must be of the Sea of Chaos, and his background must be very strong. I wonder if he was related to that treasure land?
: Shall I take my move since he wanted to kill the Five Elemental?
: No, I’m a Dao Patriarch. How can I shamelessly appear in between the fights of the younger generation?
: Yin Yang and the rest indeed couldn’t hold back anymore when they saw the various treasures that kid had with him. These few are full of conspiracy and calculations, and they don’t have much respect for me, yet thinking that I don’t know.
: It’s okay, let them just test that kid on my behalf.
: Damn, he actually killed Reincarnation in an instant.
: Shall I take my move? No, I must not.
: He actually could detonate Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels! Such a technique seemed to be present in the memory of Hei Tian though it was not in detail. Anyway, I’m more assured that this kid comes from the Sea of Chaos.
: Even the Verdant Sky and Inversion are dead. Well, let them be. They are just a few dunderheads.
: This wicked Yin Yang, actually begged me to save him. Such an unshameful brat. Can’t you just hold on a little, and self-detonate to commit suicide while dragging him with you? Even if you fail to kill him, you’d have created better conditions for your master.
: What shall I do?
: Shall I kill him? This kid must be of some great background. Once I killed him, what shall I do if I were to attract the expert behind him?
: Damn it! With his cruel character, this brat wouldn’t let me go anyway. In this case, let’s just take my move first. I shall kill him and refine him to become a puppet of mine. Then, I shall take him to that fragment of ruin of war. Once I’ve obtained the benefits there, I’ll certainly break through the Saint Realm and advance into a higher realm. By that time, I shall venture into the Sea of Chaos.
After Jiang Ming had read the ‘Status’ of the Dao Patriarch, he finally understood the weirdness of the world.
The Dao Patriarch was the main cause of the infighting among the six Saints. The weirdness of the Dao Patriarch was due to him refining, to be exact, it was merging the remnant soul of Hei Tian, hence distorted his characters and will.
Since he hadn’t had righteous motives to begin with, he wasn’t truly sincere to his disciples.
These six Saints should have sensed it in addition to the previous grudges they had against each other, they didn’t really respect their master. However, because they were attracted by the benefits of the secret realm the Dao Patriarch had been promising, they didn’t go into the Sea of Chaos.
‘This is interesting to learn that the remnant of the Sea of Chaos can’t even be broken through by the Dao Patriarch Xing Chen!’
As Jiang Ming had thoughts running through his mind, he turned to the Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. His eyes were glittering with hints of killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - The Hongmeng Violet Qi was Poisonous
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: The Hongmeng Violet Qi was Poisonous
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In just the blink of an eye, Jiang Ming had read through the ‘Status’ of the Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. He couldn’t help sighing in his heart that the Dao Patriarch had indeed went through many obstacles. Nevertheless, Jiang Ming could not tell whether it was the Dao Patriarch himself who had refined the remnant soul of Hei Tian, or it was Hei Tian who took the initiative to integrate into the Dao Patriarch quietly and subtly. But because the name of Hei Tian, which was put in a bracket behind the Dao Patriarch name alone, could explain a lot of things.
“This is just a joke of the world and life?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen couldn’t help but shake his head. “Fellow Daoist, you’re too extreme. Look at all things in this world, every life is trying hard to live, to make progress and to radiate their own splendor of life. All of them are competing to transcend themselves. Hence, how can it be a joke? Even though we are on top of the world, overseeing the world, and even manipulating the authority of the universe, we are in fact, just a member of the hundreds and millions of living things!”
“You are indeed the Dao Patriarch. With the extraordinary heart and attitude of yours, you should really be the model of my generation.” Jiang Ming chuckled.
With their current achievement, what else they couldn’t see through? Debating was merely to show the splendid discussion of Daoism. In fact, it was a petty matter to both the Dao Patriarch and Jiang Ming.
“Do you want to protect them?” Jiang Ming changed the topic of the conversation and turned to look at Yin Yang Saint Lord and the other two.
The three had almost recovered, which was the horror of the Saints in their own world. If it wasn’t because they were injured, they would have recovered to their best state.
Yin Yang Saint Lord and the other two Saint Lords’ hearts missed a beat. They were in fact, afraid of Jiang Ming. They had to pay attention to Jiang Ming whether because Jiang Ming had killed Reincarnation Saint Lord in an instant, or because Jiang Ming was capable of detonating Dao Vessels. They even saw Jiang Ming as an extremely dangerous person when they learned that Jiang Ming had taken the path of World Dao.
“They are my disciples!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen grinned. “What about you letting them go for my sake?”
“Although you are the Dao Patriarch, you’re merely the Dao Patriarch of this world. Moreover, we’ve just met.” Jiang Ming shook his head.
Although the title of Dao Patriarch was of high status, it was not a valid title to Jiang Ming. Moreover, Jiang Ming knew that the Dao Patriarch wanted to kill him, as shown by the relationship value of -88.
“Why do you want to do so!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen sighed. Following that, an aura surged from his body, evoking the power of the world’s origin in an instant to control the authority of the world.
He moved the stars, taking all of them to the endless space. The void distorted, and the laws changed.
“In this Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, I’m the Dao, the god, the law, the morality, the truth, the order, and the ultimate ruler.” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen showed an icy cold expression. He had an incomparably arrogant demeanor, incomparably strong aura, and incomparably icy-cold eyes.
......
“Everything in this great universe is in my control.” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen added, “Yin Yang and the other five were a step slower than I was in Dao sanctification. Even if they were just a step slower, they would be gradually becoming a lot slower than I do. I lured them with the method of sanctifying Dao, and oppressed them with invincible power, so that they had to bow down and recognise me as their master. When they bow down to me, I will take away part of their luck. With the support of their luck after they have sanctified their Daos, in addition to me gathering 40 percent of the world’s luck by preaching throughout the world, do you know what this means?”
Yin Yang and the other two Saint Lords had a change in their expression. Although they had guessed it, they had not heard from the Dao Patriarch himself. Now that they had heard it, they inexplicably felt chills run down their spines, and they felt the Dao Patriarch at this moment was very unfamiliar.
“Luck is intangible yet it exists.” Jiang Ming nodded. “Therefore, you managed to improve your cultivation base up to the perfect stage of the Saint Realm swiftly. Meanwhile, they can’t improve their cultivation base at a fast rate because you have taken away their luck. And for the 40 percent of luck you obtained from the world is akin to you as the child of the world.”
“Exactly.” The Dao Patriarch Xing Chen admitted. He then grinned, “It should be said that I’m of a higher status than the child of the world. I’m considered a representative of heaven, the leader of the world. Nevertheless, it’s still difficult for me to break the shackles of the world to improve further. However, I’m the only ruler here in this world. Even if the six of them were to join hands after all of them had advanced into the perfect stage of Saint Realm, they wouldn’t be my match. Fellow Daoist, do you think you are still confident in confronting me?”
“Why are you talking so much?” Jiang Ming had a strange expression flashed across his face. “I think you aren’t confident enough to deal with me, are you? After all, I’m a complete stranger to you, and you’re afraid of my combat power I’ve shown earlier. Hence, you thought of testing me through language to see if I will be a coward?”
Jiang Ming hesitated before he continued, “These are your secrets that you shouldn’t have told them. Yet, you revealed all of them. I think you want to abandon them, right?”
“Master!” Yin Yang Sain Lord was shocked, and retreated afar. Both Five Elemental Saint Lord, and Creation Saint Lord retreated too. They had a bad premonition when Jiang Ming slightly pointed out. After all, they were too familiar with their Dao Patriarch.
“Master, is what he said true?” Creation Saint Lord asked.
“We’re after all, of the master-disciples relationship. I have given you grace through preaching, but you can’t repay it. However, the principle of heaven and earth says that if you enjoy it, you must repay it.” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen grinned.
“Why? We didn’t do anything wrong, did we?” Five Elemental Saint Lord exclaimed.
“No!”
“Now that the enemy is here, with the three of us, don’t you have a better chance of winning?”
“Of course!”
“Then why are you abandoning us?”
“Because of the three of you, I have a better chance of winning. This kid not only has a mysterious background, his cultivation base is strong and his special abilities peerless. I don’t know what other trump cards he has. Hence, to play safe, I’ve a higher chance with you three around.”
“Then why…” The Creation Saint Lord chimed in but before she could finish her sentence, she realized what the Dao Patriarch meant. Her expression changed greatly. Both Yin Yang and Five Elemental were the same.
They were, after all, the Saints. Hence, they could easily understand why the Dao Patriarch wanted to abandon them with just some thoughts.
“Did you put something on them? Once evoked, you’d be able to completely manipulate them. Following that, you’d be able to use the life of the three to fully test my capability.” Jiang Ming speculated.
“What type of means do you need to manipulate the Saints for your own use?” Jiang Ming frowned as he pondered. “I think you’d have to take action before they manage to sanctify their Daos. Otherwise, it would be difficult.”
“You’re right!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen clasped his hands. “To be able to speculate the means that I’ve used, you’re indeed an expert from the Sea of Chaos. Amazing!”
“Xing Chen!” Yin Yang Saint Lord gnashed his teeth in anger. “When you preached in the Star Palace back then, you said that there are six positions of Saint in the world. As long as we merge with the Hongmeng Qi, we can communicate with the Natural Laws of Heaven and sanctify the Saint Realm. As for the Hongmeng Qi, you said that it’s from the encounters you had after you sanctified Dao, and you prepared them exclusively for your own disciples! It turns out that Hongmeng Qi was your means?”
They recalled such a situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - The Melancholic Saints, The Dao Patriarch’s Cruelty
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: The Melancholic Saints, The Dao Patriarch’s Cruelty
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The three Saint Lords, namely the Yin Yang Saint Lord, Five Elemental Saint Lord, and Creation Saint Lord, were looking uglier than the others. They were truly looking ugly.
“Yes!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen confessed. “The Hongmeng Qi is truly condensed from the essence of the world’s origin. But I also merged in a type of special ability, that once refined, it would allow you to understand the Natural Laws of Heaven, and sanctify Dao easily, but at the same time, you’ll be under my control.”
He suddenly grinned, “Back then, we were competing, fighting, entangling, and holding grudges against each other. Do you really think that I would be willing to help you sanctify your Dao? It’s better that I take in new disciples than to help you all.”
“Love for no reason must be repaid after all! And today, it’s time for you to repay.”
The Dao Patriarch said in a very slow and quiet tone.
“At that time, you’re the Saint, the first Saint of the world. You should have a big heart, generously give to all beings of the world and universe. But why are you conspiring against us? At that time, what’s in it for you to do so?” The Five Elemental Saint Lord expressed resentment.
“A Saint is also a being. All beings are emotional with various emotions including joy and anger, and I’m no exception.” The Dao Patriarch replied to satisfy their quest for discovery.
“At that time when you thought of manipulating us is because of that secret realm in the chaos right? You wanted us to act as your cannon fodders to find a path for you? Other than this, I can’t figure out what other reasons you have to control us.” Yin Yang Saint Lord suddenly figured it out.
“As expected of the five’s eldest Senior Brother, you indeed are more clever. If it wasn’t because of the encounter I had that I managed to sanctify my way of Dao earlier than you did, I’m afraid that you’d be the fist one among us to achieve that. Unfortunately, I’ve had all the luck and the great Dao. A step slower leads to an utterly different fate.” Dao Patriarch beamed.
“Stop struggling, the thing I’ve placed in all of you, has thoroughly merged into the origin of your soul. I can even manipulate the imprints that you all have engraved into the origin of the Natural Laws of Heaven.”
“If I don’t take the initiative to remove it, you will never be able to get rid of the bondage of fate. For so many years you have enjoyed as a Saint to be above many, manipulating all beings and races, it is more than enough for you. Otherwise, you would never have any chance to sanctify Dao because I’d have killed all of you.”
The Dao Patriarch no longer looked at the three Saint Lords, but turned to Jiang Ming and sighed, “I feel so helpless that you coming here has completely changed my plan. I hope that you’ll surprise me, otherwise I’d be losing a lot.”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless and shook his head. The intrigue and infighting among the Saints was actually beyond his expectations. He felt rather unbelievable to see a Saint master conspiring against his Saint disciples.
......
Inexplicably, he thought of the prehistoric world situation he did not know existed or not. The Dao Patriarch passed on the Dharma, received six Saints as his disciples, and also gave them the Hongmeng Violet Qi. Later, in the battle of the gods, the world was almost broken, and the Dao Patriarch gave San Qing medicine pill to take, saying that it was a medicine pill that could poison people to death.
Jiang Ming didn’t believe that a medicine pill could poison a Saint to death, and that San Qing was willing to take the pill without any resistance. That’d be rather absurd unless it was planned ahead.
“The past is the past. Since you all have learned the truth, we shall conclude it thoroughly!” As a luminance radiated out from the Dao Patriarch’s forehead, the three Saint Lords cried miserably.
The immortal light on them suddenly dissipated. While hugging their heads and crying in pain, they also evoked their special abilities to resist.
The Yin Yang Saint Lord was stronger after all. While he resisted with difficulty, he also shouted at Jiang Ming, “Fellow Daoist, attack, attack now. Provided we can free ourselves, we will help…”
Before he could finish his words, his face suddenly turned hideous, and then calm. He looked numb, and then he showed a smile, the same smile as the Dao Patriarch.
Both Creation Saint Lord and Five Elemental Saint Lord had the same situation as the Yin Yang Saint Lord too.
“For millions of years I’ve been conspiring, it’s unfortunate that three have died!” The Dao Patriarch Xing Chen sighed. “In fact, this method has a great flaw. If it wasn’t because of their eagerness to sanctify Dao, they would have discovered some of the flaws through careful observation and thoughts. Unfortunately, they were too eager to sanctify their Dao, and coupled with the fear they had for me, they didn’t have much doubt and quickly refined the Hongmeng Violet Qi. As for giving them the positions as the Saints? Ha, I won’t be so kind for nothing. There must be gains and losses, and this is the way of heaven.”
“You are truly cruel, aren’t you?” Jiang Ming had just witnessed a great show. He felt a chill run down his spine especially when he saw the changes in those three Saint Lords.
Who would figure out such was a conspiracy? Who could believe it? Jiang Ming thought he would be cheated as well if he was one of the six.
“You are still not confident enough to confront me, aren’t you!” Jiang Ming grinned.
“Yes!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen admitted. “If I were confident enough, how would I let you kill the other three and reveal that they are under my control? After all, it is because you are giving me a bad premonition. Hence, I could only use all my trump cards to deal with you.”
Yin Yang and the other two Saint Lords had come forward besieging Jiang Ming in the center of a triangle.
The Dao Patriarch made a pause before he asked with confusion. “The technique that you used to detonate Dao vessels is considered a supreme Saint technique. But I don’t understand how you can remain safe at the center of detonation? With that level of self-destruction, even if I were in your position, I definitely would not be good.”
“So, is this the real reason why you don’t hesitate to expose yourself?” Jiang Ming was not worrying at all.
“That’s right!” The Dao Patriarch didn’t care about showing his prudence either. “You made me feel that you are too mysterious. Hence, I have to be very cautious. Otherwise, I’d lose my life. Just like the three of them, made one mistake and lost the whole game.”
“Make sense. It’s you who are sharp-witted!” Jiang Ming nodded, and pointed at the three around him. “The strongest power they could release is self-destruction, right? Or sacrifice?”
“Yes, I used to teach them the Heavenly Sacrifice Technique, so that they can sacrifice themselves thoroughly in return for a peerless strike. This is much stronger than self-destruction.” The Dao Patriarch grinned, “As for the reason for them to cultivate? It’s simple. The Chaos is too big and too vast, there are other worlds other than our Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, as well as the Chaos Beasts. What if we are incapable of resisting our enemies when our world is invaded? We shall do our best to kill as many enemies as possible. Hence, this is a very bold technique. Once evoked, the person could still recover provided our world is not destroyed.”
“If you really encounter such danger, you can escape into chaos, can’t you?” Jiang Ming said.
“If you really encounter such danger, can you really escape?” The Dao Patriarch had the same smile as he asked, “Fellow Daoist, do you have any last words or any reason for me to let you go? Else, this would be your place of burial unless you have other sky-defying means. Oh, the path you’re taking is the World Dao, hence, you aren’t truly a Saint. Hence, once you die, you’ll truly die without the ability to resurrect.”
“In the face of an enemy like you, to be honest, if I didn’t have the confidence to live, I really didn’t want to be your enemy.” Jiang Ming lamented. Meanwhile, his energy had been surging frantically.
His intimidating aura surged, and his might was terrific. Luminances that hang from the Zhentian Tower and the Golden Obsidian in his hand burst forth the divine power that could split up heaven and earth.
The Dao Patriarch Xing Chen sighed, “Your words made me even more perturbed. But I’ve no other choice other than going forward. It’d be difficult for me to live without having you dead. It’s truly difficult for the world to have a perfect plan for all of us!”
“Go die!” The moment the Dao Patriarch yelled the last two words, he evoked his special abilities to confine space and time, suppress the void, and even evoked the power of authority and order to lock up all things in the surrounding. He left nowhere for Jiang Ming to elude nor avoid.
Meanwhile, the three Saint Lords were simultaneously ignited, and were burning with blazing Saint flame. The next moment, they radiated a bright luminance, and turned into the most horrifying torrents of destruction in the world.
As the Dao Patriarch took his move, it was his ultimate strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - Destroying the Great Chiliocosm
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Destroying the Great Chiliocosm
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Dao Patriarch, who had many accounts to settle with Jiang Ming, was rather unbelievable. After all, the Dao Patriarch was the Dao Patriarch himself. Hence, the absolute ruler of the world. Nevertheless, he had carefully revealed his last trump card so that the three of his ‘lovely’ disciples would obtain supreme powers before he evoked them together.
The Dao Patriarch didn’t evoke one but a total of three of them. God damn it, how careful he had been?
Jiang Ming was, however, shrouded by a luminance. It was the terrifying Saint Luminance of destruction, which could even kill a Saint. If a Demi-Sage was around, they would instantly disperse and disappear if they were to be touched by a bit.
Jiang Ming activated the defensive privilege he had gotten from the Supreme Order without hesitation. After all, 10,000 points was not a big amount to him. Moreover, he dared not gamble with his life.
As he felt the horrifying waves outside, his heart skipped beats. He was now assured that if he didn’t have the defensive means of the Supreme Order to protect himself, he would die regardless of how many Saint Weapons he evoked. The only alternative way to survive was probably to evoke the Chaos World Tree and call out the Human Path Record to escape.
‘This is only within the great chiliocosm, and I already feel tired of dealing with the means cast at me. Once I get to the Sea of Chaos, I’m afraid that it will be even more difficult. Particularly if I were to lose the exclusive protection of the Supreme Order. I shall stay low-profile from now onward.’
As thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind, he hatched a plan.
On the other hand, when the three Saints were evoking the Heavenly Sacrifice Technique, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen instantaneously eluded into the distance. He had traversed numerous galaxies and watched from the other end of the galaxy.
Numerous stars were destroyed in an instant. It was as though various ignited candles were blown out in an instant, becoming a black hole, and it was still spreading rapidly into the distance.
More than half of the vast starry sky had been destroyed in a flick of a finger.
“Oh no!” The Dao Patriarch had somewhat miscalculated.
He found out that the Taiyin Star and the Taiyang Star had been greatly affected and were about to collapse.
“The order of Yin Yang, the innate origin, and the support of heaven, block it!” The Dao Patriarch Xing Chen evoked supreme divine power and formed a great formation for the Taiyin Star and Taiyang Star in the blink of an eye to protect the two stars from the torrent.
......
He didn’t stop there. He began to tear a large rift in the world membrane with the authority he had mastered to direct the destructive torrent out. He only gradually heaved a sigh of relief when he saw the Taiyin and Taiyang Stars were gradually stabilized and when he felt the power of the torrent of annihilating the void and the boundless world curtailed.
‘I think he should have died! Anyone who can survive such terrific destruction should be an existence that transcended the Saint. What if he survived? In that case, he should be a true genius that I can’t provoke at all!’
The Dao Patriarch was nervous, extremely nervous. A pair of his divine eyes penetrated through the galaxy, looking into the center of the eruption. Even the void had been destroyed in that region, let alone the stars. That region had truly become the land of nothingness.
When the three Saints sacrificed themselves, the power they could erupt with was absolutely terrifying. If it weren’t for Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s orderly means to block a wave of the destructive torrent and lead a wave out of the world, this world would have been destroyed. Even so, it was riddled with holes.
99% of the stars in the starry sky had disappeared. If the scene was to be observed from the mortal world, one would notice that on a night with stars and moon, the stars suddenly disappeared, and even the moonlight was moving violently. Such a change had terrified an unknown number of living beings.
In fact, not only the mortal world but numerous forces of the immortal realm were terror-stricken. The Heaven Court, located deep in the starry sky, was affected too. It instantly bloomed like fireworks and then destroyed. It didn’t even fall—it merely dissipated into thin air.
The powerful Heavenly Emperor, who was celebrating joyfully on his Imperial Concubine, evaporated just like that. Meanwhile, all the sects and sacred lands located in the starry sky disappeared, leaving no traces behind.
Whether it was the great sects, the sacred lands, or the Heaven Court, they were basically located in the little world they opened up in the depth of the starry sky. They were currently all destroyed.
The Taiyin Star and Taiyang Star were spared from the catastrophe, while the factions on the earth were only frightened.
The Dao Patriarch, who had been nervous, suddenly cursed, “What the f*ck!
“He hasn’t even died? Not even sustaining any injury and changes to his aura? How is this possible?”
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was flabbergasted. He couldn’t believe what he saw because it had subverted his perception. Even a Saint King who was far stronger than a Saint would be affected as well.
“Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, what a great technique. It almost killed me!” Jiang Ming calmly stood in the middle of the catastrophe.
Along with the dissipation of the destructive torrent, he saw the Dao Patriarch with his eyes traverse across the hundreds and millions of dark starry sky and couldn’t help but smile.
“What a good technique you have!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen had various luminances of Saint Dao radiating from him. His aura was obscured yet terrifying, and even the surrounding void was distorting.
“Can we just forget about this and let it be? You can make a request!” The Dao Patriarch had bowed his head and admitted his defeat. Or rather, he was afraid.
“You were the one who wanted to kill me!” Jiang Ming said, “If you said so earlier, I would have probably agreed. But now? Haha, if you were me, would you accept?”
“No!” The Dao Patriarch shook his head without hesitation. Following that, he roared, “Take this attack of mine, Great Chiliocosm Returning to Ruin Boundless Technique!”
He cast immortal rays toward Jiang Ming. Boundless immortal rays turned into an astral waterfall, enveloping the entire starry sky, receding the darkness, and making the starry sky colorful.
Such a special ability actually affected about half of the galaxy. It was extremely colorful.
On the other side, Jiang Ming frowned, and a Blood Banner appeared above him. The flag fluttered, and as it opened, it rolled in a massive amount of the immortal light and crushed it.
‘Why isn’t it powerful at all?’ Jiang Ming felt rather weird.
The scene created just now was too grand. Moreover, the Great Chiliocosm Returning to Ruin Boundless Technique, when listening to the name and seeing the power, seemed to be extraordinarily terrific.
However, it ended up with…
‘Swashbuckling?’ Jiang Ming instantly reacted. His pair of divine eyes penetrated through the void and discovered the figure of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. He was at the side of the world membrane, had just torn open a crack, and was looking back.
The two strong experts were staring at each other.
“Oh, my fellow Daoist, you have destroyed all things of mine. But I’m still praying that I won’t be meeting you again. All things here, I give them to you. Please be kind to the living beings here.” After the Dao Patriarch said so, he plunged into the crack and entered the Chaos.
“Did he just escape?”Jiang Ming was stunned and wanted to scratch his head. ‘Alas, you are a Dao Patriarch, the master of Saints, and the ruler of the world. To think that you actually escaped even before I made my move? This is too ridiculous, isn’t it?’
Jiang Ming found it both funny and annoying. But he thought about it and understood why Dao Patriarch Xing Chen did so. After all, he was safe and sound at the center of the three saints’ self-destruction. Not to mention Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, who was only a Saint, even a King Saint would be afraid too.
“Run away when you feel bad? But can you run away?” Jiang Ming snorted coldly as he called out the Human Path Record and flipped to the page about Dao Patriarch Xing Chen to check on his Status. It turned out that this Dao Patriarch was truly escaping.
‘The Dao Patriarch is a Saint too. Fighting one on one with him in the Chaos is just good for me to practice!’ Jiang Ming evoked the function of projection to project him toward Dao Patriarch Xing Chen.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - Bombarding the Dao Patriarch,
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Bombarding the Dao Patriarch, The Reappearance of the Lord God
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Upon entering the Chaos, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen slightly took a sigh of relief. He was truly afraid of Jiang Ming because Jiang Ming was too horrifying. Therefore, he thought it was better to avoid Jiang Ming temporarily instead of fighting. After obtaining the encounter, it was not too late to kill Jiang Ming after he broke through to the realm higher than that of Saint.
With a wave, the palace in the world membrane leaped out, fell on his hand, which he kept.
“Alas, the Chaos!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was slightly emotional. In his realm, only the things in the Chaos or the Sea of Chaos were attractive to him. If it wasn’t because of that fragment of the battlefield ruin, he would have left. Now that he was forced to go, it wasn’t considered as a regret anyway.
“Let’s go!” He turned into a stream of light as he left. He no longer was nervous. After all, the Chaos obscured the sky, and it was impossible to deduce traces at all.
However, after the Dao Patriarch had traveled for 300 billion kilometers, he abruptly stopped.
‘How is it possible?’ Dao Patriarch Xing Chen looked forward with surprise, which then turned puzzled.
Jiang Ming was before him, blocking his way.
“The Chaos conceals traces, how can you catch up with me, and appear in front of me? Besides, your appearance is very sudden, as if you appear out of nowhere. But this is Chaos, you can’t teleport here, can you? Moreover, when you descended to our Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, you seemed to have appeared out of nowhere too. Fellow Daoist, what is this method of yours?”
For a while, curiosity took over. Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was really curious because Jiang Ming’s act had completely subverted his present knowledge.
“Can it be that you are an existence who has transcended the Saint? No, this is also wrong!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen couldn’t think of a reason.
“Great chiliocosms are full of wonders. There are too many things that are out of common sense.” Jiang Ming grinned, “Fellow Daoist, what other means you have, I’ll take them all.”
“Great chiliocosms are full of wonders indeed.” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen sighed. Following that, he slightly stood upright, and his aura of suppressing the heavens rippled out, repelling the surrounding chaotic aura. His aura was strong, ancient, and gave people a sense of immortality.
“Fellow Daoist, do you really want to fight ceaselessly until one of us dies?”
......
A mirror appeared above Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, radiating luminance, which seemed to have contained 3,000 great Daos in it. A futon appeared under him, and rays of light rose up to protect him. The immortal cloth on his body was flowing with divine light, and one after another immortal patterns emerged, revolving around him.
Meanwhile, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was holding a book on his left. It had purple-gold lustre, and was exuding aura that made Chaos tremble. On his right was a dragon-headed crutch. While the dragon was swallowing and spitting, it emitted power that could shatter great chiliocosms.
“Awesome!” When Jiang Ming saw the equipment of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, he couldn’t help but gasp. “All of them are Saint Weapons, and they aren’t ordinary ones.”
“I’ve got only five!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen sighed. “The slight increment of their might is due to the injection of the world’s qi of origin which I have refined. Unfortunately, their natural essences can’t be altered to go beyond the Saint Weapon’s level. Although they are slightly stronger than ordinary Saint Weapons, they are still limited.”
“You’re simply showing off!” Jiang Ming said.
“I need to let some people know about my achievement right?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen smiled. “Fellow Daoist, what about you let me go? Provided you aren’t an existence who’s stronger than a Saint, what can you do to me with my top-graded Saint Weapons?”
“Indeed I can’t do much to you!” Jiang Ming had a headache. He might not be capable of killing Dao Patriarch Xing Chen with his Half-King Saint’s Soul. After all, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was at the perfect stage of Saint Realm. Moreover, with his Saint Weapons and his meticulousness, Jiang Ming was afraid that Dao Patriarch Xing Chen had another supreme treasure protecting his Saint Soul.
“I’d still have to try, right?” As Jiang Ming said, along with a flash of his forehead, the Taixu God Slaying Needle flew out at an extremely high speed.
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s pupils constricted, and he was trying to dodge the needle, but he was too late. Hence, he could only exert his own power to form layers of defense.
The Taixu God Slaying Needle pierced through the 3,000 layers of immortal lights surging from the futon beneath Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s feet, tore apart the protective divine light from the mirror, penetrated through the defense of the immortal cloth, and landed on Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s forehead.
Ding… A crisp sound rang out, and spread out 300 billion miles away.
A series of sparks appeared between Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s eyebrows, and then exploded to form a sea of fire. He was pushed back at the impacts, and his seven orifices were bleeding too.
‘What a terrific attack!’ After Dao Patriarch Xing Chen balanced himself, he touched his forehead, and shuddered at the fearful danger he was in. “I almost failed to block that attack even though I have numerous defensive supreme treasures, and a Soul Dao Saint Weapon in my sea of consciousness. Alas, this strike is too amazing, truly amazing! Under the concussion, even my Saint Soul felt like collapsing.”
“Unfortunately, that strike failed to kill you, not even badly injured you.” Jiang Ming shook his head, and sighed.
“Fellow Daoist, since you can’t kill me, shall we just forget about this and go our own ways without interfering with each other?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen said with sincerity expressed on his face.
“Since when did I say that I can’t kill you? That was just a strike after all!” Jiang Ming smiled sinisterly.
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s expression stiffened. “Fellow Daoist, please don’t be ridiculous. Can you really kill me?”
“Of course, I’ve got three methods!” Jiang Ming said frankly.
“Three types?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen shivered, and almost turned around and ran.
‘God damn it. I’m the Dao Patriarch. I’m armed with extremely exquisite Saint Weapons, and there wasn’t anyone among the Saints who could kill me. Yet you said you have three methods! Damn. God damn it. Are you joking? I don’t think so. Oh my god, how can I encounter such a monster? Does heaven want me dead?’
“Fellow Daoist, can you share with me which three methods you are referring to so that I won’t die in vain?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen almost cried.
“You are the Dao Patriarch, aren’t you? How can you be so afraid of death?” Jiang Ming felt rather sorry for Dao Patriarch Xing Chen.
“So what if I’m a Dao Patriarch, I’m still a being anyway.” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen said frankly, “I haven’t managed to see the view as an existence beyond the Saint Realm, and become the Dao Patriarch of the Sea of Chaos. Hence, it’s not worth dying now. Fellow Daoist, do share with me what are your three methods so that I can gain some knowledge as well!” As Dao Patriarch Xing Chen said, his eyes had a faint wisp of black light flowing.
“It’s simple! The first is to detonate a few Saint Weapons. Can I kill you with that?” Jiang Ming said.
“Detonating a few Saint Weapons? Yes, you can, totally can! Detonating a piece is equivalent to a Saint’s self-destruction. With such a special ability of yours, it’s totally workable!” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen said wryly.
“The second method…” Jiang Ming frowned. “Can I kill you if I were to cast the strike earlier at the strength of five times stronger?”
“Five times stronger?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s heart skipped a beat, but at the same time he nodded as he said, “I almost failed to resist that strike earlier. Hence, if the strength of the strike was to be five times stronger, my Saint Soul would definitely crumble!”
‘This kid truly has other Trump Cards. Damn, who’s he? How can he be this terrifying? Can he be the direct disciple of some large faction in the Sea of Chaos?’
“What about the third one?” Dao Patriarch Xing Chen asked as he was thinking.
Jiang Ming took a glance at the Human Path Record, and knew clearly what Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was thinking. He knew Dao Patriarch Xing Chen had figured out a way of escaping, and he was confident at that.
“The third one?” Jiang Ming grinned. “It’s simple. Come and look at this, what’s this?”
A spear appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand. As soon as it appeared, the surrounding space of the void abruptly trembled.
The heaviness of crushing Chaos, the extreme sharpness of opening up the world, and the ancient and powerful aura that shattered the Saint Soul, made Dao Patriarch Xing Chen pale in horror, and couldn’t help but scream, “This is the King Saint Weapon, alas, the King Saint Weapon! How can you have such a supreme treasure?”
“I’m done for!” Thinking of his own life-saving method, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was left in despair. Hence, he turned to run away.
“Do you think you can run away?”
As Jiang Ming mobilized his Siant power, the Heaven-Shattering Spear in his hand burst out with a terrifying might that shattered everything, and the dormant boundless edge of the spear gradually was awakened.
With the terrific power he could hold up a world, Jiang Ming actually felt he couldn’t afford the weight of the spear. With a thought, he merged the power of his Saint Soul into it as well.
Buzz buzz buzz…
The spear trembled as if it was cheering or was thirsty. Wisp after wisp of sharp edge burst forth, tore open the Chaos, and actually evolved into a miniature world. From within, the fire, wind, and water poured out, good fortune burst out, and one by one primitive elves appeared.
Heaven and earth collapsed, all things were destroyed, and returned to the Chaos.
“Out!” Jiang Ming took heavy steps, shouted loudly, and projected the Heaven-Shattering spear that locked at the aura of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. The spear caught up with Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, who had escaped into a distance in a blink of an eye.
The spear pierced through his body easily but it was not the true body of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. It was his Saint Weapon which could replicate his body, and also the undulation of his Saint Soul. Alas, it was unfortunate that the Saint Weapon failed to resist the sharp edge of the Heaven-Shattering spear, and scattered.
In fact, the spear didn’t stop there. It went on tearing the Chaos, and got to the true body of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen with a leap.
‘My Hunyuan Treasure Mirror is actually shattered? No, it’s caught up with me!”
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen showed his despair. As he knew he couldn’t elude anymore, he turned to face the spear, and cast a long river of Dao vessels at the spear which had gotten near him.
They were Quasi-Saint Dao Vessels, and Saint Weapons. There were dozens of them. There were also various supreme Saint Laws.
However, his efforts were in vain. All of his vessels, weapons, and laws failed to resist the Heaven-Shattering spear. They were either being pierced through or thrown out, losing all their power in an instant.
“Alas, I’m the Dao Patriarch, the Dao Patriarch! How can I be killed just like that! No, I’m Hei Tian, the Great Demon Hei Tian, who can kill me!” As Dao Patriarch Xing Chen roared, his eyes were filled with black light, and his body exploded, transforming into a total of 4 trillion kinds of rune, which instantly formed an arrow and shot towards the tip of the spear.
The black arrow was, however, scattered.
“Oh my great Lord God, I’m willing to sacrifice my everything, everything of mine. Just save me!” The Saint Soul eluded out of the body and cried for help. But it was pierced, and wailed mournfully for a long time.
A ravine that spans hundreds of billions of light-years also appeared in the Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - Endless Demonic Waves, Sea of Chaos under Invasion
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Endless Demonic Waves, Sea of Chaos under Invasion
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming evoked the Heaven-Shattering Spear and with a single strike, it depleted all the power of the Saint in his body as well as the Saint Soul.
Between breaths, he mobilized the origin of his inner world which allowed his power of Saint to recover. The Saint Soul however, was slow to recover from depletion.
‘The Heaven-Shattering Spear is too terrifying. It hasn’t fully awakened its might, yet it already has such a terrifying power consumption.’ Jiang Ming marveled in awe.
Jiang Ming frowned when he suddenly felt something in his heart. He evoked the Human Path Record as a medium to directly project himself over, saving the time of rushing over to the scene.
Upon reaching, he saw Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s Dark Saint Soul being pierced. He was screaming miserably, wailing in dismal.
Just as it was about to be completely annihilated, a streak of white luminance suddenly descended, enveloping the Saint Soul and surprisingly repelled the Heaven-Shattering Spear’s attack.
“Lord God! You’ve finally come! If it were any longer, I would’ve almost been killed.”
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, or rather, the now Great Demon Hei Tian coalesced into an illusory form, revealing a look of fear from the aftermath. He turned his head and looked at Jiang Ming, baring his teeth ferociously.
“Kid! Your biggest mistake was not being able to kill me just now! No matter what your origin is, no matter what your background is, your fate has been sealed. The day we meet again will be the day you regret ever descending into this world. Remember, I’m the Great Demon Hei Tian!” The Great Demon Hei Tian delivered a chilling threat.
Jiang Ming’s eyes were flooded with an ice cold gaze. Without saying another word, he launched the Heaven-Shattering Spear directly at the Great Demon Hei Tian.
Bang…
The white luminance barrier trembled violently, but wasn’t broken through.
Jiang Ming frowned even more.
......
The Great Demon Hei Tian shivered a little before laughing out loud, “You brat! You’re still quite lacking after all. This is the power of a Lord God! Alas, the Lord God! Haven’t you heard of him before? He is the real giant of the ages, suppressing the Chaos. He’s invincible and a true man. Now that I’m blessed by him, killing me is just wishful thinking!”
“This divine luminance that descended can protect you for the time being. However, the fact that it traveled across the Chaos to reach this place eventually cost a lot. As such, it’ll take some preparation time before it can teleport you away from the place, right?”
As Jiang Ming spoke of his speculations, supreme Dao Vessels began to appear one after another, right in front of him.
The nine Universe Swords that formed a sword array, the nine God-Sealing Tablets that formed the great formation, the Blood Banner, the Golden Obsidian, and the Spear of Judgment.
These Dao vessels were equivalent to five innate supreme treasures, all of which flew out and surrounded the Great Demon Hei Tian.
“Damn it!” The Great Demon Hei Tian’s expression changed wildly. He hurriedly roared and prayed, “Oh great Lord God. Quickly! Send me away quickly! He’s going to detonate Saint Weapons!”
“Erupt!”
Those Dao vessels were detonated precisely when Jiang Ming’s word fell.
Rumble…
The deafening explosion in the Chaos erupted, setting off billions of raging torrents that completely bombing away this piece of region of the Chaos. It was as though the attack split the sky apart, reshaping the universe.
Jiang Ming stood there in silence. A faint luminance emerged from his body. However much the destructive raging torrent blew through his body, it didn’t affect him the slightest.
Jiang Ming focused his gaze in front of him. Even though he had a pair of supreme Divine eyes, he couldn’t see the situation happening inside.
Therefore, Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Record.
Name: Hei Tian
Race: Congenital Dark Demon Dragon race.
Gender: Male
Cultivation Base: King Saint (Remnant state)
Background: King Saint great demon of the Nine Abysses of the Sea of Chaos
Relationship : -99
Status: There was a Demonic Abyss in the Sea of Chaos, also known as the Nine Abysses. It was rumored to have existed since the birth of the Sea of Chaos, the origin of all demons and the home of all demons.
: Countless demons were bred from the Demonic Abyss.
: The eternal law here was to kill and become stronger.
: In one corner of the Demonic Abyss, there was once a Saint Realm Dark Dragon which died. After billions of years of corrosion, what was left was a whole Saint Dragon Bone. During one of the Devil tides, it merged with a drop of the Nine Abyss Sea of Chaos and gave birth to its own wisdom. He became the innate Demonic Devil. Since he was given birth by a Dark Dragon, he became part of the Dark Dragon Race.
: He named himself Hei Tian.
: With his overwhelming talent, natural wisdom and ferociously cunning ways, he quickly grew up in one corner of the Abyss.
: He advanced into the Golden Immortal Realm before even reaching adulthood. However, he was discovered by a Great Overarching demon who wanted to capture and devour him. With no way to escape and in desperation, he heard an invitation from the Lord God Space.
: Hei Tian then became a beneficiary of the Lord God.
: By relying on the mysterious Lord God Space, he had descended into many chiliocosm, which allowed him to grow even faster to an extreme rate, becoming a Quasi-Sage expert within a short time.
: He finally had a certain right to speak within the Lord God Space but still couldn’t break free from the shackles of the Lord God Space.
: In order to grow quickly and to break free of the shackles of the Lord God space, he took the initiative to take up combat missions in foreign territories.
: There, it was the first time he saw how terrifying the existence outside of the Sea of Chaos was. He also obtained countless great fortunes and grew rapidly. It only took him a hundred thousand years before sanctifying the Saint Demon Realm.
: Due to his viciousness, he was also known as the Great Demon Hei Tian.
: Upon reaching the Saint Realm, he was still shackled as the Lord God Beneficiary. However, Great Demon Hei Tian was not discouraged and continued to grow with the aid of the Lord God’s overwhelming power.
