: He spilt blood over great encounters, grew among the destruction, roared amidst the despair and rejoiced as he grew. It took a hundred billion years before finally he finally broke through the shackles of the Saint and advanced into the King Saint Realm.
: Based on the contracts as the Lord God’s Beneficiary and the ancient agreement of the Sea of Chaos, he had the right to withdraw himself from the Lord God’s contract.
: The Lord God Space invited him to become an elder but he did not agree to it. Instead, he plunged right into the Nine Abysses as soon as the shackles were lifted and created his own supreme demonic domain.
: His endless killing spree and lawless conquering attitude caused the wrath of the experts of the Abyss. He was beaten half to death with a slab and was left with a warning: Act brazenly again and you’ll be dead!”
: Hei Tian went silent from the battle.
: He remained silent for tens of millions of years, quietly thinking it through. He began to wonder around the corners of the Sea of Chaos.
: Due to his overwhelming cultivation base, he was able to evade some of the ancient existence but it was not known how many beings fell prey in his hands. They even formed an alliance in the dark to secretly hunt for the Great Demon Hei Tian.
: The Great Demon Hei Tian was alert and managed to escape several traps that targeted him.
: His cultivation base was also inching towards the peak of King Saint. The more he improved, the more terrifying he became and the more unscrupulous he acted.
: Tens of thousands of years rushed by and something finally broke the norm.
: That day, a three-million miles wide door that led to the foreign chiliocosm suddenly appeared itself up in the sky of the Nine Abyss in the Sea of Chaos. Countless terrifying beings descended into their chiliocosm.
: The foreign army came rushing in, shattering the sky and destroying the earth. Even the Nine Abyss was almost crippled.
: The ancient existence of the Sea of Chaos almost came out and took action.
: That battle turned the place upside down, creating a turbulence of chaos.
: The invading army were finally forced to retreat.
: The Sea of Chaos was left pale and crippled. Vast land was shattered and its pieces drifted into the Chaos. The Great Demon Hei Tian was on one of those pieces of land.
: He was gravely injured. Just as he was about to return to the Sea of Chaos to recover back in the Nine Abysses, he was discovered by his enemy, and a great battle ensued. Even though he evoked countless supreme special abilities, he was still defeated. His body was crushed and his Saint Soul was torn apart.
: In the end, the enemy wasn’t large in numbers and many of them were already gravely injured from the previous great battle. Another fleet of demonic armies came forth to save the Great Demon Hei Tian. Seeing that the Great Demon Hei Tian was about to be rescued and he was facing death itself, one of the dying King Saint, in grief and anger, sealed the Great Demon Hei Tian in the remnants of lands by turning himself into an ultimate confinement cage, vanishing into the endless void of Chaos.
: He left the ultimate great formation within the seal which separated the remnant of the Great Demon Hei Tian from the demonic army that came to rescue him, slowly grinding them away.
: For billions and billions of years, the great formation had constant immensity.
: The other demons were gradually worn out by it.
: The essence of the Great Demon Hei Tian was at the King Saint Realm after all, and that he was a terrifying existence that was about to step into the peak of the King Saint, he persisted for a very long time with the characteristic of being immortal.
: However, he was worn out in the end.
: The Great Demon Hei Tian did not resign to the outcome. He attacked the great formation many times and also discovered that the great formation was constantly decaying, especially during certain periods of time. However, he still couldn’t break free in the end.
: It was until one day, he sensed that the great sealing formation was attacked from the outside. He knew then, that his chance of survival might have come.
: Sure enough, the power of the great formation was weakening.
: The Great Demon Hei Tian was ecstatic.
: He evoked the little remaining power of his Saint Soul and waited eagerly.
: The great formation was seemingly getting weaker and weaker but the attacks from the outside suddenly stopped.
: He felt that something was not right and had a sense in the dark that if he missed this opportunity to escape, he will truly die here.
: He mustered all his remaining strength and managed to desperately tear open a corner of the void, only to discover a little Demi-Sage expert outside. Without any hesitation, he rushed into the person’s sea of consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - Lord God’s Beneficiaries, Attack of the Lord God
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Lord God’s Beneficiaries, Attack of the Lord God
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming paused when he read this part of the Great Demon Hei Tian’s ‘Status’.
What followed clearly overlapped with what he knew from Dao Patriarch Xing Chen yet was somewhat different at the same time.
The Great Demon Hei Tian had depleted all of his remaining soul power. Although he entered the sea of consciousness of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, he wasn’t able to forcibly seize the body.
The Great Demon Hei Tian later realized that this person was trying to refine him within. Hence, he snickered in his heart. However down and out he ended up, he still had the essence of a King Saint. The thought of refining him was just a fool’s errand.
Even if he didn’t try to resist, the person couldn’t do anything to him at all.
However, the Great Demon Hei Tian was a great demon after all. After spying on Dao Patriarch Xing Chen’s memory, he went with the plot and allowed himself to be refined by him little by little. At the same time, he released some of his memories, allowing the Dao Patriarch to peek into the way of sanctifying Dao, to see the view beyond the Saint Realm and to peek into the countless supreme special abilities.
Dao Patriarch Xing Chen eventually ‘refined’ him completely.
The Great Demon Hei Tian followed suit, merging into the depth of the Dao Patriarch’s primal soul. He fell into an extreme state of slumber and used the Dao Patriarch’s growth to restore himself.
He woke up again, only to discover that the former Dao Monarch Xing Chen had become Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, wielding supreme authority within the great chiliocosm. It left him in shock and he didn’t dare to make sudden moves.
Because, once he revealed his true essence, he would likely face the mad revolt by the origins of the great chiliocosm and might even be refined by Dao Patriarch Xing Chen. Because, Dao Patriarch Xing Chen already had the ability to do so by this time.
The Great Demon Hei Tian hid himself even more carefully. At the same time, he also mastered everything about the Dao Patriarch, secretly influencing him so that he would head for the fragments in the Sea of Chaos in search of great fortunes, allowing him to take a step further and advance into the King Saint Realm.
Once the Great Demon Hei Tian could enter the fragment ruins of the Chaos, with the help of the body of Dao Patriarch Xing Chen, he would be able to absorb the residual demonic energy and demonic blood, allowing him to completely seize the body, breaking apart the great formation.
Unfortunately however, he met this variably Jiang Ming.
......
It was especially right after Jiang Ming evoked the Heaven-Shattering Spear, that he felt the aura of total destruction contained within. He immediately recognized that this was a King Saint weapon and was even of the top-grade.
The Great Demon Hei Tian didn’t know if he could resist such a great weapon. When Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was desperate, he took the opportunity to seize control of his body, sacrificed his flesh and blood to strike an overwhelming blow, but he still could not stop the attack.
Seeing his soul remnants that had recovered considerably, was about to be pierced, the Great Demon Hei Tian called on the Lord God with the voice of his primal soul.
He had always retained a trace of Lord God’s imprint on his soul remnant all the while, an imprint that he could erase anytime. It was back then that he thought of the fact that there might be a life-and–death crisis in the future and he might be able to ask for help from the Lord God as the last resort.
In fact, he had tried to ask for help numerous times when he was within the seal but it never worked. He knew that it was the great formation that blocked his call for help. After all, there was only a trace of imprint left on his soul remnant.
Nevertheless, his call this time had received a response.
: The divine luminance that descended surprisingly blocked off the King Saint Weapon. It even suppressed its destructive power at the same time. Amazing! Worthy of the Lord God that I look up upon.
: The capability of traveling through Chaos into this chiliocosm. Such an unbelievable ability!
: Oh Lord God. You are still the great, the invincible, and the all-encompassing. Little demon me will never forget your saving grace. From here on out, I’ll be your servant at your command.
: However, I heard that this sort of help isn’t from the Lord God himself, but evoked from a supreme weapon that was forged by the Lord God himself. I don’t know whether this is true or not.
: I’m afraid it’ll still take some time before I can be sent back.
: I’m safe now.
: I can be at ease now.
: Hmph! Just you wait, you brat! The day I return, I’ll break your body into pieces.
: God damn it! He evoked five Saint Weapons!
: That’s not good! He can detonate them!
: I’m done for!
: Boom…
: Oh Great Lord God, take me away! Take me away quickly!
: Damn it! The divine light is shattering.
: Argh! I’m going to die….
The ‘Status’ in the Human Path Record came to an abrupt end. The color of his name had also turned gray instantly. This meant that the person was dead. Completely and utterly dead.
Jiang Ming frowned even more after looking through the ‘Status’.
The Great Demon Hei Tian had exposed too much information.
‘The Abyss within the Sea of Chaos is the origin of the Demons? Battling against foreign world? Invading the Sea of Chaos? Isn’t the Sea of Chaos the ultimate limit of the Chaos? How can an enemy appear? What is this foreign world?’
These information brought chills down Jiang Ming’s spine.
In fact, Jiang Ming had vague suspicions when he first entered the galaxy of Luo Heng’s world back then. Now that there was more evidence proving that there was a Sea of Chaos beyond the Sea of Chaos.
In fact, what shocked him most was the fact that the Lord God was able to descend power across the Chaos. How high a realm and how strong a cultivation base would that have needed?
Just thinking of this made even his Saint Soul tremble.
In the Great Demon Hei Tian’s memory, this ‘Lord God’ was perhaps not even the original body but a refined supreme weapon?
“God damn!”Jiang Ming couldn’t help but curse.
That was just too powerful, powerful beyond imagination. However, he was assured that the Lord God of the Lord God Space came from the Sea of Chaos.
The destructive torrents gradually dissipated. There was no longer the figure of the Great Demon Hei Tian that could be seen before Jiang Ming.
Even the divine light that descended on the Great Demon Hei Tian was completely shattered, leaving only wisps and an illusory imprint.
Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows again when he saw the scene. He was surprised to see that the divine light was not completely destroyed yet!
‘That was the might of five Saint Weapons! God damn! It is truly terrifying.’
However, it was at that moment that he saw the wisp flew into the illusory imprint and proceeded to emanate blinding luminance. It turned into a huge palm and slapped Jiang Ming.
At the same time a voice rang out. “With the light of the Lord God descending, the contract has been made. Whoever slain the Lord God’s beneficiary won’t be pardoned for his sin.”
The voice was extremely indifferent, as though it was just a cold machine, but it gave Jiang Ming the chills.
The palm of luminance didn’t exude obvious powers, nor did it cause the aura of Chaos to tremble. However, whatever the palm went past, the chaotic aura was directly annihilated.
Yes, it was straight up annihilated from existence.
Jiang Ming wanted to move, but realized that his surrounding had been solidified into a single entity. The sudden exude of pressure on him could even turn his body into dust.
‘This palm attack is much more terrifying than my all-out attack with the Heaven-Shattering Spear just now.’ Jiang Ming was appalled at such abnormality. He didn’t hesitate to evoke his privilege of the Supreme Order and formed a thin defensive film around his body.
Yet, he was still inexplicably uneasy.
This was because the might of this palm attack was beyond his imagination, making him feel as if he was as feeble as mere ants.
As the palm attack fell on his body, it exploded directly from the recoil, turning into a ball of light before rapidly dispersing without a trace.
Looking back at the defensive film around his body, it was still intact and nothing had changed.
‘The Supreme Order is still the best.’
From this encounter, Jiang Ming’s evaluation of the Supreme Tower was once again raised to a huge level.
He released a turbid breath and looked into the depths of Chaos with a cold gaze.
‘The Lord God Space, Lord God! Humph! Very good! Very good indeed! You’ve been targeting me throughout ever since the beginning. Now, you even want to kill me! I’ll engrave this grudge deep in my mind!”
Jiang Ming thought to himself and stayed for a moment longer. Seeing that there was nothing else transpiring, he turned around and started his search for the spoils of war left behind by Dao Patriarch Xing Chen.
As a result, he only found three pieces: a dragon-headed crutch, a futon, and a book. As for the mirror and the immortal cloth that Dao Patriarch Xing Chen was wearing, were blown to pieces by the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
After searching for a few more moments and getting nothing, he stood still and thought, ‘Should I return to Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm or go look for the fragments of the Sea of Chaos?’

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - The Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm’s Aftercare
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: The Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm’s Aftercare
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming returned to the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm. He was going to settle things here before going to search for the ruins in the Sea of Chaos. Since he now had an immortal body, he was not afraid of the dangers that might ensue.
After the ordeal, the starry sky had become pitch black and the earth was silently barren. The vast universe was filled with a boundless aura of calamity.
Jiang Ming released the Verdant Emperor and Dongfang Chenxi from his inner world.
“Brother Jiang Ming, are you okay?” After getting on her feet, Chenxi immediately looked at Jiang Ming and asked with her eyes full of concern.
The corners of Verdant Emperor’s mouth twitched as he looked around and observed all directions, unable to help himself from the shocked expression on his face.
He was, after all, a Quasi-Sage expert. He naturally noticed the difference between heaven and earth today. Even the power of laws had become distorted.
What was more frightening was that a big chunk of the starry sky had disappeared. Even the Heaven Court was nowhere to be seen.
“What exactly happened here?” The Verdant Emperor couldn’t help himself and asked.
Jiang Ming briefly explained the whole ordeal.
As the two of them listened to his story, they kept looking back at each other.
A great battle against the Five Elemental Saint Lord? Besieged by six Saint Lord, but managed to kill the Reincarnation Saint Lord in seconds? Killed yet another two Saint Lords? Dao Patriarch Xing Chen made his appearance but took a huge turn and forcibly controlled the other three Saint Lords before self-destructing? The starry sky was destroyed? Dao Patriarch Xing Chen who tried to escape into the Chaos was killed as well?
“You killed six Saints and Dao Patriarch Xing Chen?” Even the Verdant Emperor’s teeth were chattering.
......
‘Damn. Is this really true? It must have been. There is no point in faking it nor would it stand when investigated. Yet… Yet this was just too unbelievable. It is just too inconceivable. It just feels too fictional, more than a pipe dream. This is simply a miracle.’
Of course, the most shocking thing to the Verdant Emperor was that, how long had Jiang Ming been cultivating for? In fact, he knew the details.
‘God damn! This person is definitely the son of the great Dao. Otherwise, how can he grow so fast? It’s just inhuman!’
“Brother Jiang Ming is the mightiest!” After Dongfang Chenxi was stunned by the story, she couldn’t help but cheer on, “Thank you Brother Jiang Ming, for risking your life for me.”
“It’s just a few saints. Back at Luo Heng’s, I’ve slaughtered a dozen of them.” Jiang Ming laughed. “Since I’m here, I’ll have to relieve you of your worries after all. The six Saints and Dao Patriarch Xing Chen aren’t completely dead yet. Just wait till I extinguish the true soul imprint that they left in the world’s origin.”
Jiang Ming walked the walk.
He wasn’t confident before. However, he now has the confidence to do so. This was because he now had the Saint Weapon, the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
With a spear in his hand, a terrifying power that was enough to shatter the whole great chiliocosm suddenly exuded from his body. Even the Verdant Emperor beside him turned pale as his primal soul was palpitating in shock.
This spear was terrifying, extremely terrifying indeed. Even a wisp of its aura leaking out of it could’ve repeatedly killed the Verdant Emperor a million times.
“It’s a good thing that he has a good heart and has a good relationship with my daughter. Even if anything happens to me in the future, my daughter will have someone to count on!” As such thought ran through Verdant Emperor’s mind, he was feeling both happy and conflicted, finally helplessly smiling.
Jiang Ming carefully sensed the six Saints’ imprints, but got nothing. As such he evoked the power of the Heaven-Shattering Spear, subduing the heavens and suppressed the world’s origin.
His Saint soul surged forth and went straight to the world’s core.
“Found it!”
Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up. By just gently tapping with the spear, the imprint that belonged to the Five Elemental Saint Lord was easily annihilated.
Immediately after that, he tapped six more times, and the imprints of the other five Saint Lords as well as Dao Patriarch Xing Chen were all annihilated as well.
‘The King Saint Weapon is truly powerful indeed. Without it, I’m afraid I would’ve had to resort to using the Chaotic World Tree to find them.’
Jiang Ming sighed with lament and raised his head. An infinite amount of thunderstorm had already accumulated on top of his head, almost drowning the sky. It was as if the descent of an absolute Heavenly punishment was imminent.
But for some reason, it did not come down on Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming smiled and kept away the Heaven-Shattering Spear. The thunderclouds followed suit and dissipated into thin air.
‘Is the world instinctively terrified?’ Jiang Ming thought to himself.
“Next up, I’ll be exterminating the remaining experts of the six sacred lands, one by one!”
As his voice fell, his pair of divine eyes swept throughout the chiliocosm, observing every inch of the vast heavens and earth, the boundless starry sky, the layers of space-time and even the depth of the raging torrents. Anyone within the world couldn’t escape his prying eyes no matter where they were hiding.
There were indeed a few of them who survived the ordeal. Jiang Ming raised his finger and tapped in the air, evoking the Return of Infinite Law Finger.
It tore apart the void, broke down the orders of law and exterminated all of the remaining experts of the six sacred lands that were above the Quasi-Sage Realm. As for experts of the other realms, he simply ignored them.
After all, the experts below the Quasi-Sage Realm were still not a threat to the Verdant Emperor at all.
“Great Emperor Dongfang.” Jiang Ming looked at Verdant Emperor, “You are currently the expert with the highest cultivation base within the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm. From now on, you will be the one to take precedence! I will not be restoring the shattered starry sky. You can gather the many Great Overarching Experts of the infinite realms to rebuild the place with you. This will also establish your absolute prestige. You can choose to rebuild the Heaven Court for heaven and earth, or establish sacred land. All of it can be done as you wish to.”
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, thank you so much!” The Verdant Emperor solemnly said his thanks.
In the past, he would have never thought of such a result, no matter what. By only relying on his own power, Jiang Ming managed to completely change the balance of power of the whole chiliocosm. Even the invincible Dao Patriarch Xing Chen had been killed.
‘I myself have become the strongest of all? God damn! This is as unreal as a dream. No. This is something that no one would’ve even dreamt of.’
“Brother Jiang Ming, are you leaving?” Dongfang Chenxi’s heart trembled and was somewhat reluctant.
“Well! The whole thing is done and dusted, so I’m leaving now.” Jiang Ming replied, “We can always communicate with each other anyways. If you ever miss me, just leave me a message!”
Saying this, Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed the Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels that were left behind from the many Quasi-Sage Experts that he had just killed and sent them over to Dongfang Chenxi. “With these items, it’s enough for you to take your inner world even further, Chenxi.”
“Alright! I’ll definitely practice my cultivation well!” Dongfang Chenxi sniffled and gladly accepted the gift.
Jiang Ming gave her a nod before turning into a stream of luminance and went off, disappearing without a trace.
The starry sky was suddenly dead silent.
It took quite a while before a sigh broke the silence.
“He’s really a strange person.” The Verdant Emperor said, “Chen Xi, how did he grow so fast? He was not even as good as you in the beginning, and I even asked you to take care of him a little more. It’s only been a few decades since. To think… to think that he even killed the Dao Patriarch!”
“Father, it’s not just you. Even I myself can’t believe it.” Dongfang Chenxi said in a slightly complicated manner, “There are also the geniuses from the Sea of Chaos who were all deterred by Brother Jiang Ming. It’s also fortunate that we know him. Otherwise, we would really be in trouble.”
“Yes! It’s fortunate that we know each other!” The Verdant Emperor lifted his spirits and continued, “Chenxi, should we rebuild the Heaven Court next or create a sacred land instead?”
“Father, what do you think then?”
“Let’s rebuild the Heaven Court! After all, you are following the path of the World Dao. The midst of growth will be too resource-intensive. It’s better for me to become a Heavenly Emperor and plan well for you.”
“I’ll listen to you, my father!”
Dongfang Chenxi responded. However, her pair of eyes were still looking in the direction that Jiang Ming left for long ago, not batting an eye.
The Verdant Emperor sighed once again. He couldn’t intervene with such matters.
On the other side, Jiang Ming had already arrived in the Chaos.
‘Based on the direction that Dao Patriarch Xing Chen went, it shouldn’t be too hard to find it.’
After slightly deducing and discerning the direction, he sped forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - Two Pieces of King Saint Weapons
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Two Pieces of King Saint Weapons
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Chaos was vast. There wasn’t any cardinal direction, nor was there a sense of bearing. It wasn’t even always possible to feel the flow of time there. Luckily, there were references to refer to.
Otherwise, one would have to just barge confusedly in the Chaos. The result would either be falling into the terrifying calamity of Chaos or wander in despair for eternity.
‘Alas the Chaos. Is it really true that it’s the root of origin of all things?’ Jiang Ming pondered while he continued moving forward.
This question was destined to be unsolvable. However, he saw the mystery of the Chaos. This was the first time he had ever been in the Chaos to say the least.
The endless gray aura flowed slowly along. Even as a breeze, the aura of Chaos could even pierce and tear through a Golden Immortal Dao Vessel.
There were occasional encounters with storms of Chaos that a Great Overarching Golden Immortal would find difficult to survive for even a short time. Even Quasi-Sage Experts had to be on their toes here.
Boom…
A torrent suddenly exploded in front of him. A ball of flame could be seen appearing in the middle of the raging chaotic vortex. It started off being very tiny before swelling the very next moment, turning into a sea of flame. The flame was then drowned by the chaotic Qi, crushed before disappearing into nothingness.
As he continued walking forth, he saw two groups of chaotic Qi colliding with each other. It was unknown to him what the changes were, but it formed a chilling ball of cold ice. Even his Saint Soul felt the chills from the ice cold aura.
Jiang Ming continued to move forward. The Zhentian Tower appeared above his head and showered with rays of luminance to protect him inside and shield him from any accidents.
He also began to go through the addition in his inventory.
Killing the six Saints, slaughtering Dao Patriarchand exterminating the Great Demon Hei Tian allowed him to know some hidden secrets at most, as well as giving him more insight on how terrifying the Lord God was.
However, the expenses weren’t small either. In order to deal with the Great Demon Hei Tian, he lost five Saint Weapons in total. But he gained a few as well.
The supreme treasures of the first three Saint Lords that he slain fell into his hands, namely: Twelve-Graded Green Lotus, Gobbling Gourd, Apocalypse Great Grinder and the Reincarnation Disc.
As for the latter three Saint Lords self-detonating, their innate supreme treasures were all damaged. Although he collected all of them, they were of no use to him. As such, he directly threw them to the Chaotic World Tree to be absorbed and become its sustenance.
Furthermore, there were also the three top-notch Saint Weapons namely, the Dragon-Headed Crutch, the Dao Enlightenment Futon and the Violet Luminance Treasured Record.
All in all, it was a profit for him.
With a thought, Jiang Ming released the World Tree.
Rumble…
The moment it appeared, the World Tree directly emptied the endless Chaotic Qi outwards, forming a mountainous and tsunami-like storm of chaos that swept destructively in all directions.
“That’s not good!” Jiang Ming was greatly alarmed.
He forgot the fact that the Chaos World Tree was too tall and too violent. If it appeared out of thin air, it would naturally compress the chaos qi flow. How terrifying would the storm formed be?
This area was also relatively close to the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, and the chaotic storm that surged towards it would probably be unstoppable.
Right the very next moment, the World Tree became excited as it started to greedily devour everything.
The leaves that looked like rivers of stars trembled slightly. It was as if they had turned into black holes as they began to plunder the chaotic qi that was flowing around.
There were also the roots that extended wildly in all directions. The storm of chaos that rolled forth was surprisingly rolled back by the roots.
‘This…’ Jiang Ming’s eyes popped up as he couldn’t help that astonished look on his face.
He also had a sudden enlightenment in his heart. The Chaotic World Tree was considered his home!
The Chaos World Tree also began to swell.
As his Saint Soul merged into the tree, he started to comprehend the metamorphosis of the World Tree. His Saint Soul was also slowly empowered, transforming towards the level of King Saint Soul.
Jiang Ming had a feeling that a qualitative change in his Saint Soul was not far away. That was for sure.
After half a day’s work, seeing that the Chaotic World Tree’s rampant absorption had not yet ended, he returned to Chuyang Peak with a thought.
Nothing had changed on this side.
His avatar, located in the Galaxy, was still sailing through the universe with Luo Heng.
After making himself a meal, eating and drinking, he returned to Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm once again and landed under the Chaotic World Tree.
It took another half a day for the Chaotic World Tree’s absorption to slow down significantly. In such a short time, the Chaos World Tree surprisingly surged by a tenth in size. It was simply incredible.
There were still terrifying amounts of power yet to precipitate inside of the tree itself.
Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed with his hand, the Chaotic World Tree actually shrank slowly and became a small sapling as it fell into his hand.
‘Interesting! Does this count as the world tree becoming a spirit?’ He couldn’t help the smile on his face.
Shaking his palm, the World Tree emitted a green luminance that spread in all directions, slowing down the violent chaotic air currents that swarmed over it because of its disappearance.
Upon seeing that there would no longer be a major impact to the surrounding, Jiang Ming kept the World Tree back in his inner world and continued to hit the road.
As he radiated his Saint Soul forward, sweeping across the infinite space of the Chaos, it didn’t take long for him to discover his destination.
What lay ahead of him was a whole parchment of green luminance, enveloping a fraction of Chao’s remnant.
No, this was actually a whole world already. It was extremely huge. The green luminance continued to flicker as it continuously repelled the chaotic air current.
“Even though the Great Demon Hei Tian had already escaped, the formation still continued operating. It seems that the owner of this sealing formation is completely dead already.” Jiang Ming sighed.
Although there weren’t detailed accounts of the evil committed by the Great Demon Hei Tian in his memory, he could simply guess them.
This great demon must have definitely done more than just killing people. To cause the people’s anger and even the heaven’s wrath, there was a high probability that he had committed various indignant means that even ghosts and gods could bear from despising. Otherwise, how else would a King Saint Expert recklessly perform such an act of hara-kiri, sacrificing himself for its means?
However, the past had become clouds of history. The tales were now buried in the history of time and space, turning into a grain of sand in the long river of fate.
As Jiang Ming focused his gaze, the power of his Saint Soul surged forth, trying to penetrate into the distance to investigate further but was blocked off by the green luminance.
The blocking power from the green luminance was not too strong. It definitely did not reach the power of the King Saint Realm. It was obvious that his power dwindled due to the dissipation by the endless time and space.
Jiang Ming nominated and merged his subconscious with the Chaotic World Tree. It caused his Saint Soul power to sky-rocket, jumping directly into another level. Its power was now comparable to that of a King Saint’s Soul. It had really reached such a level. There was no doubt about it.
As Jiang Ming Saint Soul permeated forth, it was slightly blocked off before it completely made its way past the green luminance.
Jiang Ming felt greater resistance as his Saint Soul went deeper and deeper.He even sensed a terrifying fluctuation of aura that was the same as the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
In the core of the green luminance, Jiang Ming discovered a single bead in its center. The green-colored pillar had a slightly dull and vague luminance. Its aura seemed to be fluctuating indefinitely when compared to that of the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
“A King Saint Weapon?” Jiang Ming was shocked at first, before coming overjoyed.
It was apparent that the power of this treasured bead was reduced quite a bit from tens of thousands of years of wear and tear. It was also the one that was supporting the operation of the whole great array formation.
Jiang Ming didn’t act rashly. As his Saint Consciousness continued to turn, it fell towards the land that was surrounded by the green luminance.
Although the place was incomparably vast, it was divided into many smaller spaces by the green luminance. Each of them were filled with endless destructive power that was able to wear down the intelligent life within.
There were a lot of damaged and broken weapons on the ground. There was no shortage of Saint Weapons, where most of them were already broken and some were even corroded.
It wasn’t unusual for Saint Weapons to break, but it was very rare to see one corroding. This was obviously due to the power of this great array formation.
There were also many exotic flowers and grass. Some were even beyond the category of the very best innate spiritual roots, but still didn’t give birth to its spiritual intelligence. Or rather, all of the spiritual grass in here had no spiritual intelligence born.
‘That is…’Jiang Ming’s Saint Consciousness discovered a broken golden pagoda, which surprisingly had the same aura as the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
“Could it be that it is also a King Saint Weapon?’
It was very possible. After all, the Great Demon Hei Tian was previously suppressed here. That person was an incomparably powerful existence among the King Saint Realm.
‘If this is really a King Saint Weapon, I’ll be making a fortune this time!’ Jiang Ming was extremely ecstatic.
Alas, a King Saint Weapon. It would be far comparable from the innate supreme treasures. An example would be the supreme power of the Heaven-Shattering Spear. To possess one would be a great hike in power already.
However, there were two pieces appearing right in front of his eyes.
‘I must obtain all of them!’ Jiang Ming began to ponder how to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - Level Up: The Ultimate
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Level Up: The Ultimate Transformation of Saint Soul
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming again took out the Chaotic World Tree, which turned into the size of hundreds of millions of light-years to surround the fragment of the ruins.
Jiang Ming stood on a branch, took out the Human Path Record to merge it into the green luminance, and got to the core of the green light. The resistance was great but not great enough to stop Jiang Ming’s Saint Soul and Human Path Record from suppressing the bead with Treasured Record.
‘The owner is indeed dead. Otherwise, I can’t get it that easily.’ Jiang Ming took a sigh of relief.
The bead also revealed its genuine appearance. It was the Chaos Emerald Bead, the King Saint Weapon which contained endless qi of creation.
Losing the support of the Chaos Emerald Bead, the green luminance enveloping the fragment of the ruins gradually dispersed. However, it was dispersing at an extremely slow speed that a minimum of hundred and millions of years were needed.
Jiang Ming didn’t really care anyway. He threw it into the Human Path Record along with the treasured pagoda. The pagoda had also revealed itself. It was a King Saint Weapon known as the Chaos Golden Pagoda. It had the terrific might that could suppress the Chaos.
It was unfortunate that the pagoda itself had many cracks. Alas, even the King Saint Weapon was cracked up to this stage, allowing one to imagine how tragic the battle was at that time.
‘This is weird. Why didn’t Great Demon Hei Tian enter the golden pagoda in order to resist himself from being annihilated?’ Jiang Ming was confused but he could speculate that the Great Demon Hei Tian had to be separated from the pagoda due to the tragic battle at that time.
Following that, Jiang Ming led his Chaotic World Tree to begin devouring the ruin, and managed to strip a complete innate supreme treasure and spiritual root out. Jiang Ming didn’t want the Chaotic World Tree to consume them because they would be useful for him.
Under the devouring of Chaotic World Tree, and without the support of the Chaos Emerald Bead, the formation was the first to collapse. The green luminance was gradually consumed, followed by the land.
It was the land from the Sea of Chaos, hence containing endless mystery. It even led to a slight change in the World Tree’s traits.
…
Again, it was midnight. Jiang Ming returned to the Chuyang Peak to make himself some food before he returned to the World Tree. He merged his consciousness with the origin of the World Tree. Along with the growing of the World Tree, his Saint Soul subtly improved as he absorbed the endless creation from the tree.
Jiang Ming’s Saint Soul had eventually improved to its ultimate limit. But with the feedback from the World Tree, his Saint Soul took a leap, breaking the shackles and transforming. It quickly transformed into another form, and at the same time, his power also skyrocketed.
Along with the rapid transformation, Jiang Ming’s Saint Soul was releasing immutable, indestructible, perpetual, almighty, supreme, paramount, and various aura.
It was now the King Saint Soul, or simply known as the King Soul.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming felt ecstatic, free, and transcendent. With a scan of his Saint Consciousness, he discovered the frantic Qi of Chaos was no longer a threat. In fact, he could easily suppress the chaotic airflow within hundreds of billions of miles with just a thought.
Jiang Ming had gotten strong and invincible,on an equal footing with the origin of the great chiliocosms.
‘King Soul is indeed incomparably strong, totally a different concept as the Saint Soul.’
After all, it was a qualitative change, a difference in origin, and a transition in level. Hence, with the current King Soul, Jiang Ming could kill his previous Saint Soul in an instant. This showed how terrific the King Soul was after the improvement.
The best analogy was that Saints were bound by the world within the great chiliocosms, but King Saints were not.
This reminded him of Hong Jun. The six Saints were like pets, which he could knead at will. After the Battle of Apotheosize, San Qing took the Falling Saint Pill, but none of the Saints even had the courage to resist.
This was the difference.
“That’s it, my life is finally up to me!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but grin. But when he thought of the Sea of Chaos, his grin became stagnant, and he helplessly shook his head.
The World Tree, Jiang Ming had evoked with his Saint Soul, managed to gallop the entire fragment of ruin in just a short while. However, most of the fragment was not digested but laid within the World Tree.
‘I should return!’
Jiang Ming looked into the boundless Chaos, which appeared to be the same whenever you went. Hence, even though Jiang Ming was rather curious about the Chaos at the beginning, he would go nuts if he were to stay for a long time.
Jiang Ming turned over, and with a thought, he released the power of King Soul, which swept through the Chaos, and found the suspending Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm in a blink of an eye.
The world had a fetal membrane to protect it from the corrosive Qi of Chaos. It had also the incomparably mystifying power of world origin for its operation.
This reminded Jiang Ming about the Laws Net in the world of Ye Qingxian.
Jiang Ming poured in his power of soul, which was invisible, quietly swept through the entire world. He discovered Dongfang Chenxi, who was sitting beside a stream located in a palace. She was staring blankly at the stream while holding her cheek.
She seemed to feel something, raised her head and looked around with a puzzled expression. She whispered inquiringly, “Brother Jiang Ming, are you here?”
Her face was filled with hope. But she didn’t receive any response.
Dongfang Chenxi pouted, and sighed, “Am I missing him so much that it has become a sickness?”
She rose to her feet, and stretched her body. She was no longer a girl, hence her body had gotten more exquisite and curvy.
“I shall start cultivating now. Otherwise, I’ll never catch up with my brother Jiang Ming. I may not even be able to stand side by side with him. I must cultivate until my inner world achieves the stage of middle chiliocosm, sublimate to the great chiliocosm, and I want to transform to the ultimate state! Chenxi, press on!”
She clenched her fists, cheering herself up.
Meanwhile, in the Chaos, Jiang Ming smiled brightly as he saw. Then, he left, feeling at ease.
…
On the Chuyang Peak.
The moment he returned, he saw the first ray of light radiating from the east.
‘It’s still the best here!’ Jiang Ming laid on the reclining chair, swayed leisurely while checking on what he had got from the fragment of the ruin.
Numerous spiritual roots he had obtained, he transferred to his inner world, further enriching the qi of nature. The inner world became more vibrant, and accelerated the breeding and nurturing speed of all beings. At the same time, it facilitated the reincarnation operation and made up for the deficiencies.
The rest was the Saint Weapons. He had got a total of 12 complete ones.
“Senior brother!” Linglong snuggled up, lying by Jiang Ming’s side with her head resting on his shoulder. “You have been going back and forth. What happened?”
“It’s good stuff!” Jiang Ming took out the Dao Enlightenment Futon, and another nine Saint Weapons, all he threw at Linglong. “These are all Saint Weapons. One for each of you.”
“All are Saint Weapons?” Linglong didn’t feel the robust aura on them, obviously Jiang Ming had sealed them in advance. However, the inscriptions on them, and the Dao fluctuations suppressing the ancients, all showed the horrors of these artifacts.
“Ten pieces! Senior Brother, did you just rob a great chiliocosm?” Linglong was extremely flabbergasted.
“Almost right!” Jiang Ming smiled. “This Dao Enlightenment Futon doesn’t only for defense but also assists in Dao enlightenment. Hence, it’d be of great help to you. By the way, I’ve got lots of good stuff here. I shall give you now so that you can sanctify your way of Dao earlier.”
“Sanctify the way of Dao earlier?” Linglong couldn’t help twitching the corner of her mouth. “Senior Brother, I’ve suffered a lot just to advance into the Quasi-Sage Realm, what’s more sanctifying my way of Dao to advance into the Saint Realm. I’m not confident.”
“You have got me, haven’t you!” Jiang Ming embraced Linglong, and said while looking at a ball suspended before him. “Within it has Innate Vital Essence, Chaos Vital Essence, Great Nature Pill, World Origin Essence, Chain of Saint Dao Laws, and Supreme Saint Fluid.”
Jiang Ming gave his Junior Sister a lot of good things he had plundered, the Chain of Saint Dao Laws he had refined from his own King Saint Soul, the essence of the Chaotic World Tree, and etc.
“If you still can’t make it after you’ve completely digested them, we’ll return to the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed. I’ll help you to sanctify your way of Dao myself. If you can’t do it in a year, we will try for ten years; and if you still can’t do it in ten years, we will go for 100 years. I don’t believe that by lying on the bed for thousands of years, you still can’t sanctify your way of Dao!” Jiang Ming was confident.
“Let’s just go straight to bed!” Linglong eyes lit up, and licked her lips. “In this way, you won’t be bored, and I won’t be suffering from cultivation.”
Saying that, she pulled Jiang Ming and was about to stand up.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - The Real Hongmeng Warrior Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: The Real Hongmeng Warrior Body
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming didn’t go but took a long spear out of the Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel. Then, under Linglong’s doubtful gaze, he wiped the tip of the spear again and again.
It was an everlasting weapon, so sharp that it could pierce through all things.
However, as Jiang Ming wiped, the tip of the spear became slightly blunt, and in the end, the tip was worn down.
Linglong, who didn’t understand at first, suddenly realized Jiang Ming’s implicit meaning and couldn’t help but guffaw. “Senior Brother, are you telling me that you’re purely ornamental, or it’s gone bald?”
“F*ck off!” Jiang Ming’s face darkened. “What I meant is that we must not be yearning for sex too much. Otherwise, we’ll be like this spear, worn down sooner or later.”
“Alright, Senior Brother, you don’t have to explain further. I understand, haha, I understand…”
Jiang Ming bent his arm to slap his Junior Sister from her back, throwing her out.
Nevertheless, Linglong still couldn’t stop laughing.
Jiang Ming snorted coldly, exerted power on the Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel, and turned it into a pile of powder before dispersing them in the air. Following that, he rose to his feet and went to cook himself a meal. He only cooked a simple bowl of ramen.
After Jiang Ming enjoyed satisfying his appetite and just sat down, he sensed something and took out the Supreme Order. He then separated out part of his consciousness, merging it into it.
The group was very lively.
[Hong Zhan: Haha, I’m back as the Group Admin!]
[Hong Zhan: Gentlemen, you guys must be missing me too much.]
[Di Huo: Your position as this Group Admin was taken away and then voluntarily abdicated for you.]
[Ao Jiu: Great guy, Little Huo’s words have stabbed Hong Zhan like a sword.]
[Hong Yi: This stab was awesome!]
[Lan Hai: Let’s give another two stabs!]
[Hong Zhan: It’s fine if you don’t welcome me. But how dare you make fun of your Group Admin? Grrr… I shall not let you know my benefits from utilizing the privilege exclusively for the Group Admin. This seclusion has helped me raise my strength up to a terrific level. I’m sure I can pass all the seven Battle Towers.”
[Luo Heng: Damn, Brother Hong, I’m surprised to know that your improvement can be so great in just a few weeks of seclusion. I bet you can catch up with Brother Jiang soon.]
[Ming Fei: Snicker.]
[Ye Qingxian: Me too.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Giggling…]
[Feng Wu: Little Hong, do you know what our former Group Admin did while you weren’t around? I’m sure that you can never imagine it regardless of how hard you try.]
[Hong Yi: Brother Jiang is indeed very amazing. I’ve never respected anyone except Brother Jiang.]
[Di Huo: He’s such a prodigy who has all my respect.]
[Tian Fozi: My belief has been shifted from the Buddha to Brother Jiang from now onward!]
[Hong Zhan: Scratching my head, what has Brother Jiang done? Your responses are so overwhelming! @Brother Jiang, show yourself and tell me!]
[Luo Heng: Let me explain! Brother Jiang got to my world and slaughtered 18 Supreme Experts, which is akin to the horrifying existences of the Saint Realm in a battle.]
[Hong Zhan: Damn it, he killed 18 of them? Saint Realm? It’s impossible, isn’t it?]
[Hong Zhan: Damn, Brother Jiang only has his soul advanced to the Saint Realm, hasn’t he? In this case, how is he capable of killing so many?]
[Hong Zhan: Faint. We are of a different world, separated by the Chaos. How could Brother Jiang descend over to your place? Even if he managed to, why does the fact that he killed the Saint Experts in your world sound so mystifying?]
[Hong Yi: Even I can hardly believe it now. But this is the fact!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I met with a life-and-death situation, and Brother Jiang Ming came. He killed six Saints and the Dao Patriarch in the battle. Alas, the Dao Patriarch was the master of the six Saints but was killed anyway.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Even my world here almost collapsed.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang Ming is too amazing, peerless, and invincible.]
[Luo Heng: Chenxi, he went to your world and slaughtered another six Saints and the Dao Patriarch? H-h-he has slaughtered more than 20 in just a short while. I’m afraid that the Dao Patriarch should be at least a peak-stage Saint, right?]
Luo Heng had learned that Jiang Ming beside him was Jiang Ming’s avatar.
[Hong Yi: Alas, the Dao Patriarch is the absolute dominator of a great chiliocosm. And Jiang Ming has actually killed such an existence? This is not only unbelievable but simply a fantasy.]
[Di Huo: Incredible, truly incredible! Humans are indeed good at creating miracles, but Brother Jiang is the crème de la crème among all miracles created.]
[MIng Fei: I’m in awe.]
[Feng Wu: Exactly! Brother Jiang wasn’t even stronger than I was at the beginning. Now I can’t even see his trace. Brother Jiang, share with us how you could improve so fast. I don’t mind warming up your bed in return.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Grr… Feng Wu, you’re so shameless!]
[Feng Wu: She is enraged, she has been truly enraged.]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha, I’m now assured that Brother Jiang is the godson of the great Dao, no, he should be the real son.]
[Hong Zhan: To think I was proud of myself for the little achievement I attained. Yet, I’m utterly far behind. Brother Jiang, you’ve my utter respect and admiration.]
[Hong Zhan: Well, I shall stop being mystifying. I’ve used my privilege as the Group Admin to obtain a great opportunity, which has greatly broadened my horizons.]
[Hong Zhan: Previously, I was just a joker.]
[Hong Zhan: The Hongmeng Warrior Body of mine is just a Chaos Warrior Body. It’s far lacking when compared to the real Hongmeng.]
[Hong Zhan: However, this encounter has thoroughly transformed and sublimated my Chaos Warrior Body into a real Hongmeng Warrior Body. Oh no, it should be the pseudo-Hongmeng Warrior Body.]
[Hong Zhan: Even if it’s just the sublimation of my bloodline and the transformation of my physique, my combat power has increased by at least 10-fold. No, it’s at least 100-fold and even 1,000-fold. With the terrifying power contained in my body, I feel like I can kill a perfect Quasi-Sage or even a Demi-Sage with a mere punch.]
[Hong Zhan: There are even some changes toward my soul. It’s changing toward the Saint Soul. Alas, it’s unfortunate that I didn’t manage to successfully transform into the Saint Soul.]
[Hong Zhan: This is a terrific privilege exclusively for the Group Admin! Of course, you first need to have enough points.]
[Hong Zhan: @Brother Jiang, when you are about to break through to the great chiliocosm, that’s the best place for your breakthrough. It can definitely help you to improve your success rate by 30%. No, you may even have up to 50%!]
[Hong Zhan: Damn, with the terrific points accumulated by Brother Jiang, I’m assured that his inner world will advance into the great chiliocosm level!]
[Hong Zhan: With an inner world of the great chiliocosm level, I wonder how strong you will be… F*ck, Brother Jiang, you’ll be able to overwhelm the Sea of Chaos when you get here for sure.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, how many times have you gone there? At least twice, right? Otherwise, your soul wouldn’t have reached the level of Saint Soul!]
[Jiang Ming: Not even once!]
[Hong Zhan: …]
[Hong Zhan: This is impossible, right!?]
[Jiang Ming: I can’t go yet because of some special reason. Maybe I’ll go 50 years later to cultivate. Perhaps, I will have a great breakthrough by then.]
[Hong Zhan: You’ve become so terrifying even before going. Brother Jiang, my heart is trembling, horrified, and palpitating.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, based on your accumulated points, if you were to use your privilege, I can’t even imagine how far you would grow.]
[Hong Zhan: Your inner world might be able to improve up to an unprecedented level and directly evolve into a Chaos.]
[Luo Heng: He is indeed terrifying!]
[Di Huo: Aww, I’m so jealous!]
[Ao Jiu: Are we going to have our chance?]
[Hong Yi: @Hong Zhan, is the improvement so terrifying?]
[Hong Zhan: If you were to go, you’d realize that all the encounters in the past and current ones are nothing, nothing at all.]
[Hong Yi: When are you going to break through to the Great Overarching Realm? I can’t wait any longer.]
[Hong Zhan: A bitter smile. I can have a breakthrough anytime. But once I break through, I’ll have to leave the group. I’m kind of reluctant to go. Of course, I’d miss Brother Jiang.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, when are you coming to the Sea of Chaos?]
[Jiang Ming: At least in 50 years, but it shouldn’t take longer than that!]
[Hong Zhan: 50 years, right? It’s just for a short while. @Hong Yi, you can wait for 50 years, right?]
[Hong Yi: Provided it’s not 50,000 years. I’ll continue to accumulate power and strive my best to achieve the ultimate extreme so that other members won’t surpass me.]
The Chat Group was really lively because the information revealed was too horrific.
Jiang Ming sent Hong Zhan a private message.
[Jiang Ming: Is the Hongmeng Primordial Land a supreme place beyond the Sea of Chaos?]
[Hong Zhan: I have no idea either. But based on my assumption, I’m afraid that it is real.]
[Jiang Ming: I slaughtered a King Saint’s remnant soul from the Sea of Chaos. He said that the Sea of Chaos used to be invaded by foreigners from foreign lands. I wonder if the ‘foreign lands’ are the same as the Sea of Chaos?]
[Hong Zhan: My goodness! Brother Jiang, did you really slaughter a King Saint’s remnant soul? How is it possible? A King Saint, even his remnant soul, is not destroyable by a Saint or a Saint Weapon.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, you have my respect!]
[Hong Zhan: I can only say that the Sea of Chaos is not the only one. I think you have realized that the galaxy of Luo Heng isn’t a Sea of Chaos.]
[Jiang Ming: Can it be that there are more than one Chaos?]
[Hong Zhan: More or less! In fact, I don’t really understand. Sigh, the more I know, the more I feel that I’m a le petite. Brother Jiang, the Sea of Chaos is definitely a huge platform for you. Come over quickly!]
[Jiang Ming: There’s no rush, no rush at all. In my reality here, I’ve just cultivated for a few decades!]
[Hong Zhan: …]
[Hong Zhan: I’ve fallen into a decadent state.]
Jiang Ming grinned. At the same time, he was frowning.
‘The Chaos, the Sea of Chaos, the Galaxy, the Hongmeng Primordial Land, and the Jun Sanqian.’ As Jiang Ming thought, he made some speculations but held back his thoughts temporarily. After all, it wasn’t useful for him to understand if he hadn’t achieved that corresponding level.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet and looked into the distance.
‘I have another three matters to solve: the troubles of Ye Qingxian, the exploration of the galaxy, and the invasion of the other great chiliocosm to my world here. Which one shall I solve first?’

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - The Discussion of the Great Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: The Discussion of the Great Dao
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming went into the Supreme Pagoda, and sat in front of Ye Qingxian. He made himself at home by taking up the teapot to pour himself a cup of tea. Then, he picked it up and took a sip.
“Living without worries, reading and drinking tea when not cultivating, is a good life too, isn’t it?” Jiang Ming grinned.
Ye Qingxian was annoyed and rolled her eyes. “What about you try it yourself?”
“Most of my time I spend staying on the mountain. And I’m never bored. How’s it, and thoughts?” Jiang Ming beammed.
“Thoughts?” Ye Qingxian started, and slightly upset, she said, “Are you prepared to help me solve my problem over there?”
“It’s to be solved eventually!” Jiang Ming nodded. “Shall I kill all the Saints, or shall I force them to be your guardians?”
“Kill even the Saints. Else, I won’t be able to survive if I were to return.” Ye Qingxian said helplessly, “I have a weaker cultivation base but you can’t kill all experts above the Taiyi Realm, can you?”
“In that case, I’ll threaten the Saints and the Heavenly Emperor to be your guardians, and I’ll deduce again to identify only those experts who have karmic relationship with me in the previous battle to kill them all. Then, I’ll leave you a defensive special ability, which would give you enough time to resist and enter here even if a Saint Expert was to attack you. What do you think?”
“Is that so?” Ye Qingxian teased her long hair in front of her ears, emitting a refreshing and light fragrance. “Well, I will only look around at most to broaden my horizon. Most of my time in the future, I’ll be here anyway.”
“Actually there is another way we can take. I can send you to another world.” Jiang Ming said after some hesitation. He could see that Ye Qingxian wasn’t that excited, and it was understandable after a slight thought.
Even if he could threaten the Saints so that they became Ye Qingxian’s guardian, he couldn’t stop them from slandering. After all, he had overthrown the entire Heaven Court previously. And the members of the Heaven Court were from various factions, hence the implications were too great.
If Ye Qingxian was to return, even if she had the help of the Saint, for sure many experts would put their hands on her furtively.
“Can I?” Ye Qingxian’s eyes were lit up.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming nodded. “The world of Luo Heng was the great era of the galaxy. Its starry sky is vast with abundant resources, experts, and races. Hence, there’s no other place to broaden your horizon.”
“Alas, the great era of the galaxy is indeed tempting. But I don’t want to go.”
“What about Chenxi’s place? I’ve killed all the Saints and Quasi-Sage Experts. Her father is currently rebuilding the Heaven Court, hence everything is restarting. It’s safe and the cultivation environment is good enough!”
“I don’t feel like going there either!” Ye Qingxian’s voice got lower.
“Tell me then, where do you want to go!”
“Can I go to your world?” Ye Qingxian looked at Jiang Ming. Her eyes were glittering with hope.
“No!” Jiang Ming shook his head decisively. “I’m afraid that it won’t take me long to go towards the Sea of Chaos there.”
‘In fact, my heart is aching. Alas, with the ten Junior Sisters of mine there, it’d be very troublesome if she was to go there.’
With the temperament of his Junior Sister, she might not care but she would certainly toss him hard on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed. Hence, Jiang Ming couldn’t afford to take the risk.
“In that case, I’ll go to Chenxi there!” Ye Qingxian rose to her feet. Her left hand was placed behind her back, while her right was holding a scroll. A wave of fluctuations flashed in her eyes, as if a sword light flashed, making her eyes brighter.
“Thank you brother Jiang for helping me to cut off the silk of love that has been growing within me!” With a smile, she clasped her hands at Jiang Ming. “My ambition is on the great Dao. Even though there are many fellow Daoists here, I have been stuck here too long. Hence, it is inevitable that I will be troubled. Moreover, you are so brilliant that you can kill Supreme Experts and even the Dao Patriarch. Hence, I’m somewhat attracted to you. Anyway, it’s fortunate that you rejected me directly. I have cut off the silk of love with the Heart Sword. And from now onwards, I’d only have fellow Daoists, the great Dao, and nothing else.”
“I want to tell you that I’ve regretted it.” Jiang Ming smiled helplessly.
“Too late!” Ye Qingxian couldn’t help but guffaw, with hints of boldness.
“Well, let’s climb up to the peak of Dao together!”
“Sure!”
After chatting for a while, Jiang Ming returned to the Chuyang Peak.
Ye Qingxian too, had returned to the Tianchang Great Chiliocosm. She planned to take a look at her world for the last time.
Jiang Ming projected himself to Ye Qingxian’s world.
In the Heavenly Realm. The land was vast, and the heaven was high. The ground beneath their feet was lifeless because of the previous catastrophe not long ago. Nevertheless, many cultivators were going back and forth, in search of encounters buried underground.
“What do you feel?” Jiang Ming asked.
“With the great strength of heaven and earth, all things are fragile.” Ye Qingxian was moved. “Are we chasing after the great Dao, or we’re manipulated by power, becoming the slave of power?”
Jiang Ming felt rather shocked.
Cultivators seemed to be improving their cultivation base for the sake of obtaining an everlasting life. But it all came down to a continuous gaining of power, which required continuous plundering, and slaughtering. For that reason, the cultivator would either grow or die in the slaughter. All of these were reflected in one’s strength.
“The great Dao is too far away, and seems unattainable. Hence, what we can do is merely to improve ourselves continuously so that we can eventually be the master of our own life. By that time, we may understand the nature of the power.” Jiang Ming said in a low voice.
“Brother Jiang, by that time, are we still feeling as a human?” Ye Qingxian sighed. “Alas, as time flies, time will eventually wipe out everything after thousands of years, millions of years, billions of years, and even trillions of years. Look at the mortal world, when the parents pass away, the kids would only be sad for a while. Even if the children are the one who are dead, the parents would only mourn for a while. What about us? Alas, we’ve billions of years. Under the power of infinite time, what can we reserve eventually? Is it truly meaningful that we sanctify the way of Dao, and are capable of seeing all things with a glance? Every time I thought of this, I’d feel icy-cold.”
“Life is short for the mortals, but their life is filled with ups and downs, yet living a wonderful life. Why? Because life is a process! When they were born, they knew they would die in about 100 years. If they were to think that they would die, they wouldn’t have lived a wonderful life. But look at the mortals, how many of them would think of death awaiting?” As Jiang Ming said, he knew Ye Qingxian was having passive thoughts. “What about us? When we are going after power, longevity, and the ultimate capability of mastering our own destiny, we are having our own wonderful life. We don’t have to blame others, we just need to pay attention to our own path.
“Brother Jiang, you’re still better at this!” Ye Qingxian laughed. “Compared to the mortals, we have earned too much, and have a life millions of times more wonderful than the mortals. Yes, the mortals are going after the wonderfulness during the process from birth to death while we shall enjoy a wonderful life during the process of going after the ultimate control of our own destiny.”
Ye Qingxian was not considered having a narrow mindset. She was just lamenting.
It was at this time that the intimidating aura of a Saint overwhelmed where they were.
“It’s here at the end of the day.” Jiang Ming lifted his head, and couldn’t help but smirk.
Although Jiang Ming overthrew the Heaven Court the last time he was here, he had to retreat eventually. However, he was no longer afraid ofthe Saints anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - Scared Away the Saint, the
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Scared Away the Saint, the Meeting of the Two Women
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
At that time the Heavenly Emperor was here. He glared at Jiang Ming, enraged. Alas, his Heaven Court had been destroyed by Jiang Ming detonating his Dao vessels. And more than 99 percent of his immortal servants and maids died.
The entire ordeal was too miserable. Hence, the Heavenly Emperor swore that he wanted to kill Jiang Ming. Unfortunately, when they besieged him, Jiang Ming disappeared without a trace, and couldn’t be detected even evoking the Laws Net. He even invited the Saints cultivating in the Chaos to come back, but neither the Saints could find Jiang Ming at all.
This was very weird. Fortunately, he didn’t have to wait long to sense the familiar aura.
‘Has he appeared? Good, very good, very good indeed. Haha, this is f*cking good.’
The Heavenly Emperor first alerted Zi Yun Saint Lord to confine the world in order to prevent Jiang Ming from escaping again before he went over to Jiang Ming.
“Jiang Ming, you’ve made me wait for too long!” Heavenly Emperor said in an icy-cold expression.
He was holding a battle sword while the laws above his head were intertwining, confining the region. His tone was cold for he was filled with extreme hatred.
“Thanks for missing me!” Jiang Ming clasped his hands while grinning. “The last time you invited me to the Heaven Court, and I went. But it turned out that you all wanted to deal with me, that’s why I destroyed your Heaven Court in return. Am I wrong?”
“Ha, destroying the Heaven Court is a heinous crime. Hence, you must be punished with the ancient punishment.” The flame of anger in the eyes of the Heavenly Emperor had shot out and remained burning outside his body. “And your human race won’t have any Quasi-Sage Expert from now onwards!”
Ye Qingxian who had been listening quietly, her face darkened as she couldn’t help shaking her head. “Brother Jiang didn’t plan to massacre, but why are you courting death?”
“This is the so-called damned fool.” The smile on Jiang Ming had disappeared.
“Damned fool? Haha, who can kill me here in this world!” The Heavenly Emperor laughed his head off. In fact, he did have the capability to be rampant. No one could resist him if the Saints were not around.
“He can kill you indeed!” The Zi Yun Saint Lord paced over. The sight he had on Jiang Ming was extraordinarily vigilant, as if he was confronting a great enemy. Although he didn’t know how strong Jiang Ming was, his intuition told him that Jiang Ming was extremely horrifying.
“Greetings, Saint Lord!” The Heavenly Emperor greeted Zi Yun Saint Lord with respect but hesitated as he said, “He can kill me? Not long ago, he came to the Heaven Court and destroyed the Heaven Court with a peerless special ability that allowed him to detonate Dao vessels only. His true cultivation base is definitely not that high. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have escaped so miserably.”
As soon as he finished his words, he felt his body stiffened, and couldn’t move anymore. A terrifying power that brought shivers to his soul had confined him. Following that, he realized that his body had been disappearing bit by bit. To be exact, it was not disappearing but annihilation.
“What’s happening? Are you the one who did it?” The Heavenly Emperor was in extreme shock. He looked at Jiang Ming, expressing his fright for the first time.
“Didn’t you say that I can’t kill you? So I let you see how you’re killed. Don’t worry, you won’t die so fast.” Jiang Ming smirked.
“Fellow Daoist, this is too much.” Zi Yun Saint Lord frowned greatly but he didn’t take his move.
“Do you want to kill me too?” Jiang Ming turned to Zi Yun Saint Lord, and asked with an intimidating smile.
Zi Yun Saint Lord kept silent. He knew he should be taking his move. Because as a Saint Lord, he was responsible to protect the world. Moreover, it was a provocation, a serious provocation that Jiang Ming had been inducing by killing the Heavenly Emperor before him.
“You are a Saint, and he should die for his sin of defiling a Saint.” Zi Yun Saint Lord decided to trust his instinct. Moreover, the technique that Jiang Ming used to confine the Heavenly Emperor without knowing and annihilating the Heavenly Emperor bit by bit before him, was incredible. He admitted himself that he was incapable of doing so.
“You’re quite a tactful person indeed!” As Jiang Ming said, he released the power of his King Saint Soul. It smashed the void, and shocked all Daos, making all laws to surrender to him.
“What…” Zi Yun Saint Lord was horrified. He felt he could be killed at any time by this power.
“S-sir, are you a King Saint?” He shivered. Obviously, he was more knowledgeable than those Saints of the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm.
“Don’t disturb us!” Jiang Ming waved to signal Zi Yun Saint Lord to go away.
Zi Yun Saint Lord quickly bowed and retreated swiftly.
As for the Heavenly Emperor?
‘F*ck, how can you provoke such an existence and survive till now. This is indeed a miracle. Even if the senior doesn’t kill you, I’ll kill you myself. God damn it, you almost got me killed. Alas, the King Saint! He is an unattainable existence, an expert who can overwhelm the Sea of Chaos.’
The many experts surrounding them retreated as well. None of them dared to stay back because even the Saint was scared away.
Only the Heavenly Emperor himself was staying quietly, feeling his own death. At this time, he could no longer speak.
“You kill the Heavenly Emperor with a thought, and make a Saint retreat with a sentence. Brother Jiang, I’m so envious of you.” Ye Qingxian was truly envious of Jiang Ming. After all, she could only look up to such a level for now.
“You are capable of doing so one day.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Shall we look around further?”
“Sure!” Ye Qingxian responded.
The two went together, went through all mountains, enjoying various views.
Ye Qingxian didn’t talk much along the journey. After a long time only, she said with upset, “After the transcendence, I’ve been staying in the same place all the time. Now that I’m traveling around, I don’t have a sense of familiarity at all. Suddenly I feel that I’m just a traveler without a home to return to.”
“We have taken this path, after all.” Jiang Ming was rather upset too. So he uplifted his spirit, and said, “You have us, haven’t you?”
“Ya, I still have all of you. But once we advance into the Great Overarching Realm, we would have to leave the group chat. By that time, what else can we do?” Ye Qingxian turned to Jiang Ming and asked, “Brother Jiang, can this problem be solved?”
“The communication after leaving the chat room?* Jiang Ming frowned. He could descend to various worlds but the other members were incapable of doing so.
“Perhaps I can. But I need some time to think about how I can do that in detail.” Jiang Ming recalled the Human Path Record, and his eyes lit up.
This supreme treasure had helped him to descend to other great chiliocosms, and even traverse through boundless Chaos to the galaxy. Hence, Jiang Ming thought he might be able to build a brand new chat room with the Human Path Record.
“If it can really be done, we can move forward hand in hand in the future.” Ye Qingxian revealed a happy expression. She somewhat knew Jiang Ming. She knew that it was really possible when Jiang Ming said it was possible.
Once succeeded, even if they would lose the chat room of the Supreme Order, they could continue to communicate, hence her wandering heart could at least be taken care of.
Upon sunset, Ye Qingxian had lost her interest in continuing the trip. It wasn’t a place that she was familiar with after all.
At the end of the day, Jiang Ming took her to the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm.
“Brother Jiang Ming, sister Qingxian, I’m surprised to see both of you here together. This is too great!” When Dongfang Chenxi saw the two, she was so ecstatic that she almost leaped for joy.
“Chenxi, I wish to settle here with you. Do you welcome me?” Ye Qingxian asked while smiling.
“Really? This is great, I will have a friend with me from now onwards!” Dongfang Chenxi was even more ecstatic.
Jiang Ming laughed too.
After Jiang Ming had been staying for a while, he returned to the Chuyang Peak with a feeling of relief. He had, after all, solved a problem.
“The Chaos!” Standing on the balcony, Jiang Ming had his hands behind his back as he looked into the depth of the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - King Saint Imprint, 30 Years Later
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: King Saint Imprint, 30 Years Later
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
With a swift turn, Jiang Ming arrived right next to the world’s membrane. He raised his hands and formed a blade from his hand, slashing down in the air as though he was cutting down on an incomparably tough rubber.
The membrane was torn through layer by layer before he finally tore through the whole thing.
‘The world’s membrane is interwoven from 99 layers of 3,000 great Daos!’
Jiang Ming was no stranger to this. He had already investigated this thoroughly when he was in the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm.
The 3,000 laws were interwoven as they ran through anything and everything in the world. It also converged in the core of the origin before radiating to all corners of heaven and earth.
This cycle was similar to the human body. The world’s core origin would be the heart. Blood would be pumping around, circulating back and forth in an endless manner.
‘The Tiancang Great Chiliocosm’s Laws Net should have been deduced from the world’s membrane back then.’ As Jiang Ming pondered, he stepped foot into the Chaos.
He came to a halt at just ten million miles away, not taking another step further.
He emanated his King Saint Soul, which was enormous yet thin at the same time. Its depth was akin to the ocean which Jiang Ming could’ve entirely engulfed the Honggu Great Chiliocosm with just a thought.
In terms of its power level, it was actually no weaker than a great chiliocosm, but it was still lacking quite a lot overall. However he could easily destroy a great chiliocosm with ease if he wanted to. After all, great chiliocosm could only passively defend itself.
His power of Saint Soul started to radiate into all directions. Everywhere his energy passed, the violent chaotic currents there would be suppressed one after another. Jiang Ming’s eyebrow twitched slightly. His Saint Soul power started to adjust its attributes. It was as though they had truly merged into the Chaos, becoming a part of the Chaos as it went along with the waves.
Without any sound, his Saint Soul had spanned an unknown number of light years away already.
Seeing that he was about to reach his limits of evoking his Saint Soul, he had yet to discover the great chiliocosm, which was heading towards his world as mentioned by Yun Zizai.
“Not far enough?” Jiang Ming whispered to himself. The Chaotic World Tree could be seen appearing right on top of his head. It was but three feet tall but harbored a terrifying and incomparable power.
He merged his subconscious with the World Tree, allowing his Saint Soul to soar and once again spreaded throughout the surrounding area.
No longer after, his eye brows finally twitched. He had discovered the invading great chiliocosm. It was a chiliocosm that was coming to an end, drowned by a boundless aura of calamity.
The mortals were unaffected. Cultivators however, knew that there was great tribulation approaching.
There were seven Saints evoking Saint Laws on the outside, steering the great chiliocosm that was suppressed by the qi of Chaos, towards him.
‘At this rate, it would take a few more decades before they arrive. Should I just destroy it first?’ As Jiang Ming pondered to himself, his pupils suddenly shrank. While probing around, he discovered that this great chiliocosm actually had an imprint of a King Saint. This was obviously abnormal.
‘This is interesting!’ Jiang Ming smiled and turned back into the world he came from.
‘Bring it on. I’ll be waiting for you.’ Several decades was enough for Jiang Ming to prepare himself.
…
Jiang Ming was laying and singing leisurely back in Chuyang Peak.
With a slight thought, the skirmish on Tianyuan Sea became clearer and was incomparably printed into Jiang Ming’s mind.
Yun Feiyan was still in a great battle with the clone of his Junior Sister. She came over almost every other day with slight improvement.
Junior sister’s gains were naturally quite a lot as well. She was still lacking enemies to spar with after all. Moreover, this opponent of hers had such a variety of techniques up her sleeves, coupled with Bai Zizai, a Saint Lord’s guidance. Hence, she was an ideal person to talk to.
The Heaven Court had been rebuilt. In fact, it was quite a simple feat. Jiang Ming took out a Demi-Sage level Palace and directly evolved it into a small chiliocosm. There were countless clusters of palaces, a sea of clouds, suspended mountains and so on.
There was even a portal connected to the outside world.
Linglong even had the intention to let each of her clones to be on the Throne of the Heavenly Emperor one after another, so as to not delay in their cultivation.
Jiang Ming’s days returned to its peaceful routine.
Every once in a while, he would head into the Supreme Pagoda for a deep slumber so as to allow his inner world to precipitate enough for its evolution.
His inner world’s origin was actually strong enough already. However, since it hadn’t been long, the cycle of law and civilization was quite terrible.
This was also considered to be one of the drawbacks of the World Dao. Even with limitless resources at hand, a huge amount of time would still be needed for precipitation. It wasn’t something that could be done in a day or two.
For a lack of a better option, Jiang Ming could only continue his deep slumber in the Supreme Pagoda.
It was a good thing that the time flow would be almost still in the outside world as he retreated himself into deep slumber back in his exclusive space. Hence, he wouldn’t be too disconnected from the outside world.
Time flowed slowly. Thirty years went by in a blink of an eye.
Jiang Ming came out from the room below with his face slightly pale and his hands rubbing his back.
This time, he was together with all ten junior sisters.
He originally planned on cultivating. However, they resorted to great battles for days at the end.
Junior Sister ‘Time’ was the most terrifying of all. She directly reversed time itself, but only enveloping a single room, reversing it directly 100,000 times.
A day on the outside was akin to 100,000 days on the inside, equivalent to nearly three hundred years of age.
To be bombarded by ten junior sisters in turn for three hundred years non-stop. That feeling. Beautiful~ Not!
Of course, his junior sisters had been dragging him back to their room ever so often in the name of helping them with their cultivation over the years.
Thirty years had gone by in the outside world. However, they had spent at least ten thousand years in the room instead.
Junior sister Linglong was satisfied. All of them including her clones had reached the Demi-Sage Realm at this point.
With the terrifying realm of Jiang Ming’s King Saint Soul, coupled with his inner world, it was all too easy to help junior sister with her cultivation.
Moreover, the resources were endless. It was just that he was quite pitiful in the end. If it weren’t for him having an immortal physique, even his skin would’ve been torn off.
‘What is the meaning of life?’ Jiang Ming thought decrepitly.
All men of the mortal world aspire towards having a harem.
To hell with harem! It was already a stretch for him with his current physique, let alone the mortal human body.
‘When there’s no longer passion, what’s left would just be dishevelment!’ Jiang Ming gazed into the sky. His eyes were listless.
On his left, a person was pacing over in the sky, landed beside him and sat down directly. As he picked up the cup of tea on the table, the palm of his hand rose up in flame. A moment later, the spiritual liquid inside was already boiling, as he poured a cup and pushed it over to Jiang Ming. He then poured himself a cup, picked it up and took a sip as well, smiling, “Head Disciple Jiang, are you exhausted?”
“Old Chang! Are you not?” Jiang Ming glanced at him in a bad mood and continued, “I know that you and Momo have often been going into retreat and evoked formations in order to bear a child.”
“You weren’t peeping, were you?” Chang Yiming was taken aback.
“Am I that impudent?” Jiang Ming rolled his eyes.
