“Good to hear that!” Chang Yiming breathed a sigh of relief, placed his cup down and rubbed his hands together, saying, “Head Disciple Jiang! It has been increasingly difficult for me to conceive a child over the years. Do you have any methods for this?”
“You already have nine children!” Jiang Ming was so shocked that he almost flipped the table. He turned his head over and continued, “You still want more? I recall that your eldest has already inherited your former position as the head disciple and even has children himself. You already have grandchildren and you still want more sons? Old Chang, what are you thinking?”
“It’s just that the condition here is too good, isn’t it? The children born are either with Innate Dao Body, Ancient Saint Body, Celestial Tyrant Body, Stellar Dao Body and the likes. That’s just too incredible. According to you, almost all of them have the potential to reach the Great Overarching Realm. Since Momo and I are of such excellence, how can we waste this? Us having more children will also be benefiting the Jiuyang Sect and also the entire human race!”
“To think that your dreams had even reached the height of the races!” Jiang Ming almost spurted his cup of tea.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - I’ll Be Your Little Wifey
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: I’ll Be Your Little Wifey
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
What Chang Yiming did most other than cultivating was bearing more children. After her wife gave birth to the child, they would raise the kid to three years old before sending him over to Laoyang Peak for his master to raise the child.
Chang Yiming said that Chuyang Peak was a place of purity and peace. Its tranquility shouldn’t be allowed to be broken by children. He of course wouldn’t say that he did so to enjoy the tranquility there himself.
Chuyang Peak however, had a special environment compared to the rest. It had Dao fluctuation of supreme quality flowing in the surrounding, abundant Innate Vital Essence in the air, and a King Saint guarding over the place.
There was no place with denser great fortune or greater opportunities throughout the Honggu Great Chiliocosm compared to Chuyang Peak. Children born here were certainly blessed by the heavens. And this was a hidden supreme great fortune.
“I’m contributing to the human race by not wasting my superb bloodline.” Chang Yiming remarked proudly, “Unlike you. You have such a good bloodline but you didn’t even pass down your bloodline yet. By the way, you are a man with ten wives, how are there still no results? Could it be that your cultivation base is too high? It’s quite true. The higher a person’s cultivation base, the harder it is to conceive a child. I have a suggestion. Why don’t you make a harem, cast your nets around and fish for more fish.You can easily find 3,000 great beauties simply by shouting aloud. You can plant more seeds then, and getting one or two pregnant shouldn’t be difficult by then.”
“You’re the one who’s thinking of starting a harem.” Jiang Ming hummed, “Should I inform Momo about this?”
“Hold up!” Chang Yiming quickly shook his head, “I don’t have such thoughts!”
“Are you sure you don’t?”
“I’m really sure!”
“Who are you fooling? We’re both men!”
“Hehe! I occasionally have such a thought but with holy thoughts in my mind, I’ve been easily cutting off such stray thoughts. Brother Jiang, is there a way around it?”
“There are many!”
“Show me one or two?”
“Are you sure you want to know?”
“I’m sure! I want to give birth to 99 Great Overarching Experts.!”
“You have too little confidence in yourself! You should aim for a billion of them!”
“Good lord, Brother Jiang! You’re treating me like I’m a pig! Even pigs can’t give birth like this!”
“Maybe you can!”
As Jiang Ming finished his remark, he casually threw over a flower at Chang Yiming. The left side of the flower was black, while the right side was white. Contained within was an extremely rich aura of life.
“This is the Yin Yang Summation of Abundance Creation Flower. The two of you take one each. It’s extremely effective! From what I understand, you can conceive at least a sextuplet at a time, or even dozens at times. I’m not sure how exactly the effects will be!”
“God damn! That’s so amazing! Why did you not use them yourself then?”
“It’s only effective for those below the Great Overarching Realm. Alas, I’m too strong and you’re too useless. It’s been so many years and you are still in the perfect state of the Golden Immortal Realm.”
“Aren’t I doing this all for the next generation? Haha! Thank you very much, Brother Jiang! You don’t have any children, so I’ll try my best and give you a few more god sons.”
“Scram!”
Watching Chang Yiming leave, Jiang Ming shook his head helplessly.
‘Alas, bloodline inheritance. I wanted to do so as well. Yet, why does it have to be so difficult?’ Jiang Ming had tried many methods but they never worked. He wasn’t sure why.
It was a pain in the balls. Or rather, the shaft.
Jiang Ming stood up and made himself a meal of seafood noodles.
Just as he took the first bite, he sensed a message coming from his clone back in the galaxy. A situation had arisen over there.
Jiang Ming took his time and ate his meal. When he was finally finished, he then evoked the Human Path Record and descended over.
…
In the great galaxy.
This place was situated at the edge of the universe itself. Their airship had long been put away. Luo Heng, Hong Ying and Jiang Ming’s avatar was there.
What was up ahead appeared to be a pitch-black vortex. It looked like a black hole that devours everything. Even lights radiating from an extremely distant star were swallowed by the vortex.
“Brother Jiang, this is the Chaos Passage that connects to the universe beyond. Once you step into it, you will come out the other side into the universe beyond.” Hong Ying explained, “It’s comparatively easy to do it from here. If you were to head into the Chaos from the Universe’s Fetal Membrane, it would be much more difficult. There are a total of 3,000 layers of spatial barriers with each layer containing boundless torrents of special barriers within. It’s extremely dangerous and even Cosmic level experts who enter are likely to be killed. Only the Supreme Experts wouldn’t need to deliberately look for the Chaos Passage but directly tear through the Universe’s Fetal Membrane to reach the other side.”
It was at this moment, Jiang Ming true body descended into the chiliocosm. His avatar merged back into his body, disparaging without a trace.
“Brother Jiang, are you really prepared to go into the Sea of Chaos?” Luo Heng still couldn’t help but ask.
“There’s not much that piques my interest within the universe anymore. I’m ready to go outside and look around.” Jiang Ming nodded his head.
He had also learned about the pitch-black Chaos Passage ahead. There were many of them at the borderlands of the universe. It’s just that they were divided more scarcely where each of them were hundreds of billions of light years away from each other. Moreover, many of them are unstable and would be on the move at any time. It was difficult to even encounter one of them.
“I won’t be able to go!” Luo Heng gave a bitter smile, “In order to accumulate as much as possible, the advancement of my cultivation realm has been extremely slow. With my current strength, I will probably be annihilated by the Chaotic air currents in a matter of moments once I step into the outer universe.”
“What are your plans then? Should I send you directly back to human territory or are you going to continue traveling through the galaxy?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Can you send me directly back to human territory? That place is too far apart from here.” Luo Heng hesitated.
“You’re underestimating me too much, aren’t you?” Jiang Ming laughed.
“You didn’t break through again did you, brother Jiang?” Luo Heng was shocked, “The great chiliocosm? The Saint Soul beyond the Spirit Soul realm?”
“King Saint Soul!” Jiang Ming didn’t hide it.
His Saint Soul had already reached the extreme of the current level and was just one final step away from his transformation.
Jiang Ming might not have seemed to have improved over the past few years but his accumulation had also reached its limits. The evolution of his middle chiliocosm had already reached the edge of transformation. He was only one opportunity away from evolving straight into the next level.
His King Saint Soul had reached the pinnacle of his current realm due to the feedback from the Chaotic World Tree.
If not for fear of his Saint Soul improving further and causing his physical body to collapse, he might have already broken through.
The World Tree had provided extraordinary help towards his spiritual soul’s evolution.
As for the World’s Tree? Her growth had far exceeded that of the inner world already. If she were to release all her power in one go, the inner world would have exploded for sure.
Even the Honggu Great Chiliocosm might not be able to withstand such a force.
“King Saint Soul?” Luo Heng’s eyes popped out and almost fell to the ground, followed by a bitter smile, “Brother Jiang. This advancement of yours is truly inhuman. It’s too terrifying!”
“What’s a King Saint Soul?” Hong Ying was a little confused.
Luo Heng kept quiet.
“It’s the soul power that exceeds the Supreme Expert.” Jiang Ming replied.
“Exceeding the Supremes?” Hong Ying shrieked.
In response, Jiang Ming shrugged his shoulders and released his Soul Power into the surrounding area. The slight ripple started to set off boundless storms over the galaxy. He spread out his Soul power as carefully as he could. In a matter of breath, it had crossed the tens of thousands of galaxies, sweeping through the infinite star sea.
Soon, they arrived back at the hinterland of the human race. As his soul power rolled through, Luo Heng was pulled into a pitch-black Galaxy, appearing over at the other side at the very next moment.
“This is the Blue Stars?” As soon as Luo Heng came out, he surveyed his surroundings and there was a horrified look on his face. “This is a distance that spans over an unknown trillion light years already. To think that you sent me here just with a snap of a finger. Brother Jiang! This ability of yours is beyond my imaginations!”
“Haha! Sooner or later, you’ll be able to do it too!”
“Since Brother Jiang said so, I’m sure I’ll be able to do it then!”
“Well, if there’s anything, just communicate within the group chat!”
“Alright!”
Jiang Ming retracted his Soul Power.
“Beyond the Supremes!” Luo Heng smacked his lips, yearning for it.
Over the other side, Jiang Ming retracted his Soul power and looked over at the beautiful lady in red next to him, “What about you?”
“I’ve decided. I’ll go wherever you go. Even if it’s through mountains of swords or sea of flames!’ Hong Ying patted her sumptuous chest and remarked.
“Is there still such a thing as a mountain of swords or sea of flames for someone like me?” Jiang Ming hushed.
“Well, you’ll always need someone to talk to and relieve you from boredom right? It’s too lonely to go alone.” Hong Ying walked over and directly wrapped herself around his arms, “Bring me along with you. Pretty please. I’ll even let you make me your little wifey!”

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - The Besieged Number One
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: The Besieged Number One Supreme Expert, Pan Wang
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming did not chase Hong Ying away.
How could anyone bear to chase away such a pure, valiant and enchanting lady? Jiang Ming would’ve felt guilty to drive away such a lady.
The two of them stepped into the Chaos Passage. The inside was akin to a black hole. Its suppressive force was terrifying to the extreme that even the Star Sea Expert might not be able to withstand it. Only a Cosmic Expert could’ve passed through the passage unharmed.
“Alas, the Sea of Chaos! This is my second trip there!” Hong Ying wrapped herself around Jiang Ming’s arm. Her eyes were glistening in excitement. “Back then, many of us Cosmic Experts gathered together and chatted about the Sea of Chaos. All of us yearned to head into the Sea of Chaos but dare not venture further. When Pan Wang heard about it, he took us along for the journey. He said after seeing how terrifying it is out there, we will be even more motivated to improve our cultivation base. As such, I’m already at the pinnacle of Cosmic level now and just one step short of advancing into the extreme state of Cosmic Level.”
“It’s already very impressive for a girl to reach such an achievement.” Jing Ming commented from the bottom of his heart.
His junior sister’s achievement couldn’t be compared to Hong Ying’s. Although Linglong’s natural talent was amazing, she improved mostly under his resources and support.
Of course, with junior sister’s talents, she would be able to reach the Demi-Sage Realm sooner or later. It was just that it would take her more time to do so.
“My previous goal was to become a Supreme Expert.” Hong Ying remarked proudly. Her eyes were burning with passion as she stared at Jiang Ming and continued, “However, it’s different now.”
“Oh? How is it different?”
“Because I met you.”
“Met me?”
“Of course! You’ve shown me that there are higher levels above the Supreme. I want to become the only woman above the Supreme level so that I can accompany Brother Jiang when the time comes. Brother Jiang, all 100,000 beauties in my harem are virgins and all of them are the most beautiful from different races. We’ll all be accompanying you when the time comes.”
“Ahem…” Jiang Ming almost spurted out a mouthful of blood.
Her words were too blatant and explicit. Harem of 100,000? Virgins? She was even implying that she was Jiang Ming’s.
To think that a woman of great beauty equivalent to the Quasi-Sage Realm said something like this to him. How could anyone not be moved by it?
However, the corners of Jiang Ming’s mouth twitched. The thought of her junior sister ran through his mind. He remembered his almost bald lumpy skin.
“I’m of the purest of heart!” Jiang Ming huskily replied.
“Cut it off.” Hong Ying grimaced. “I can sense the breath of a woman’s on you and it seems to be more than one person. Hmph! You men’s mouths are all deceitful ghosts; when it comes to dealing with ladies, it’s either sweet talk or shams.”
She paused and continued, “It’s actually supposed to be normal for a talented man like you to have a harem. However, you don’t have that many women’s breath on you. This shows that you are still quite a gentleman and doesn’t mess around that much. In fact, this is very rare, extremely rare. Tell you what…”
Hong Ying chuckled a little before coming over to Jiang Ming’s ears and whispered: “Even our human race’s number one expert, King Pan, has a harem himself. It’s a miracle that you’re already stronger than him yet only have a few women to yourself. This is quite a miracle.”
“Is your nose really that sharp?” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Of course! This is my talent. By using this ability of mine, I can quickly and incomparably discover the purest of heart, most gorgeous and cleanest beauty of a planet or race.” Hong Ying explained proudly. “Brother Jiang, I’ll show them to you when we return. My, no, your harem. It’s definitely of the highest quality of the universe.”
Jiang Ming was speechless again.
What could you do in face of such encounters? It was better to just follow along. Being alone was too lonely anyways.
The Chaos Passage was pitch black and the suppressive pressure was extremely great as well.
There were even occasional terrifying air currents that swept through like wind blades. Even Cosmic Experts would be seriously injured if they were not on their toes.
Jiang Ming however, walked idly along. It didn’t take long before he leapt off and landed into the distance.
The heavens and earth here were pale. The gray that flowed slowly throughout the surrounding felt as though this had been going on for ages.
Jiang Ming understood that this was actually the Qi of the Chaos.
A terrifying gravitational force came from behind them. As Jiang Ming turned over to look, he saw there was a huge vortex behind them. That was the Chaos Passage that connected between universes.
“I often wonder that both the inside and outside of the passage were vortexes. When a universe reaches its demise, could it be that the universe was swallowed through by the vortex of the Chaos Passage?” Hong Ying presented her speculation.
“Just wait till the end of the Universe. You will definitely find out then.” Jiang Ming smiled.
He felt an extremely faint fluctuation from the surrounding and focused his gaze into a distance.
“The end of the Universe?” Hong Ying was slightly dumbfounded. “I’ve often heard of the shattered universes within the Sea of Chaos. Perhaps those are proof of the demise of a universe. Brother Jiang, do you think that I can really be alive till that day comes? Life is never-ending yet I’m a little apprehensive about it.”
“Be confident. You can definitely do so.” Jiang Ming continued, “There are shattered universes in the Sea of Chaos. This had already been confirmed. If that’s the case, there should also be an intact universe here, right?”
“I don’t know the specifics either!” Hong Ying gave a helpless smile, “Some people say there are, while some don’t. Perhaps this is the tacit agreement between the Supremes not wanting us mere mortals to learn of. However, based on the fact that there were previously Supreme Experts that had died in the Sea of Chaos, there should be universes that are intact here and there must also be other supreme beings here. Even Cosmic Experts can survive in the Sea of Chaos, let alone the Supremes. Moreover, if the universe does meet its end, Supreme Experts can still traverse across the Chaos and continue to seek for better places.”
“I’m certain there are Supremes of other universes.” Jiang Ming pointed into the distance.
“Brother Jiang, you discovered them?” Hong Ying was suddenly high-spirited but was also a little nervous.
Jiang Ming nodded his head and continued, “I’ve found Pan Wang. He is now being surrounded by a group of Supremes.”
With his avatar staying here over a decade, Jiang Ming naturally knew of various information. For example, the appearance of Pan Wang. There was a lot of information about Pan Wang on the net as well.
When he sensed the slight fluctuation back then, he radiated the power of his Saint Soul into the surrounding, discovering the origin of the fluctuation swiftly, just in time to see King Pan being besieged by others.
“Besieged?” Hong Ying was stunned for a moment, “The Supremes within our universe still dare to unite together? No, it should be the Supremes from the other universe, right?”
“Maybe they are. I’ll bring you over to take a look!”
Jiang Ming grabbed onto her arms and merged into the chaotic fluctuation, spanning a hundred billion kilometers in the snap of his fingers.
A huge mountain could be seen floating here. Its height reached hundreds of millions of kilometers, spread continuously throughout with countless peaks. It could be said that this was actually a piece of land to be exact.
Between the mountains, a fierce battle was breaking out. Divine line cracked through the chaotic air currents and crossed into the infinite distance. The palm strikes were astounding, capable of extinguishing the whole universe with a single attack. Flashes from ax attacks almost split this huge mountain range into two.
The person with a Divine Ax in his hand was none other than Pan Wang. This person was not only the number one peerless expert of the human race, but also recognized as the number one peerless expert by the infinite races of the Galaxy”
He was currently using an ax-shaped Supreme weapon.
Pan Wang’s bare upper body, coupled with his gnarly muscles and disheveled hair, resembled a savage. However, his body was flowing with an extremely terrifying aura. Jiang Ming could feel that this Pan Wang was even stronger than the Dao Patriarch Xing Chen.
“He is equivalent to a half King Saint already.” Jiang Ming made an initial assessment of his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - Valley of the End, You’re Already
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Valley of the End, You’re Already Dead
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
There were 18 terrifying beings besieging Pan Wang. All were Supreme Experts.
If it were other Supreme Cultivators of the Galaxy in such a predicament, they would’ve been killed off already. However, Pan Wang was absurdly powerful and formidable.
*Poof…*
As the luminance of Pan Wang’s ax flashed through, a purple double-horned expert was split in half and was nearly annihilated. Another being took this opportunity and slashed Pan Wang, only to tear a shallow wound in his back.
This Supreme cultivator was stunned and petrified on the spot.
Putting him aside, even Jiang Ming couldn’t help from grinning when he saw the exchange.
‘This Pan Wang’s physique is too terrifying. It’s even comparable to an extremely high-graded innate Supreme treasure already!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but marvel at him.
Although Jiang Ming’s current physique was strong, he was still far from weaker than Pan Wang’s. In fact, his physical body couldn’t even rival the level of an innate supreme treasure. It was too weak.
This was also Jiang Ming’s weakness. Nevertheless, his cultivation base was still too lacking, and he wasn’t in a hurry to improve either.
“Pan Wang is just way too formidable. To think that he can even forcibly make his counter attacks when he is under a barrage of eighteen experts of the same level as him. Incredible! Such an admirable person!” Hong Ying had an astonished look on her face. She was really dumbfounded upon seeing the battle. However, a thought ran through her mind and she looked back at Jiang Ming. “Brother Jiang! Honestly, you are still the most powerful of all. You were able to take down 18 Supreme Experts all by yourself back then. Who would’ve thought you were able to do so? You had just broken through that time and I was even the one protecting you during your break through.”
With just a slight comparison, it showed how formidable Jiang Ming was back then.
“You’re only realizing this now?” Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows.
“Brother Jiang. Are you trying to make me realize more great things about you?” Hong Ying smiled joyfully.
“Having been together for decades, haven’t you realized them yet?” Jing Ming smiled before turning solemn and said, “I’m afraid Pan Wang will be the one at a disadvantage soon.”
“How so?”
“Although those 18 Supreme Experts couldn’t do Pan Wang in, they were not at all in panic. Instead, they were coping with the attacks and are steadily exchanging blows with him. They seem to have ways of taking down Pan Wang.”
“Indeed!”
“Here! They’re going to strike now!” Jiang Ming focused his gaze and watched carefully.
One of the youth suddenly reached out and clenched his fists. As he raised his arms, an overwhelming sea of black liquid suddenly appeared out of thin air and formed a whole sea in a moment’s time. At the same time, a few Supreme Experts launched their barrage of attack from the other direction and forced Pan Wang into the black sea.
Another few of the Supreme Experts simultaneously launched blood red qi of calamity, pitch black qi of corrosion, gray qi of death, extremely dense ruin returning qi and the likes, towards the black sea, merging them into the waters.
All 18 Supreme Experts proceeded to retreat into the distance.
Pan Wang could be seen in the middle of the black ocean, resisting the corrosion of the waters. Even with his physique that could withstand the attacks from Supreme Weapons, his body began to corrode in the black sea water. Moreover, he was also sucked in by the vortex in the body of water and couldn’t break free momentarily.
“There’s no need to struggle anymore, Pan Wang.” One of the old man cladded in red robe chuckled and said, “This is the Water of Death that we have collected from six universe ruins, coupled with the condensation of billions of trillions of air of death, corrosive qi, devastating qi, cursed qi, sorrow qi and many more. More importantly, there’s also the residual qi of eternal ending from the destruction of the universe. By fusing them together, a supreme venom capable of even poisoning and killing the Supreme Expert is formed. Relatively speaking, this is actually a special Supreme weapon, capable of destroying anything and everything. Even if you manage to break free from the entrapment, all 18 of us are standing guard on the outside. You will still be knocked back inside.”
The red-robed old man paused for a moment before continuing, “All 25 of us are Supreme Experts from different destroyed universes. We’ve lived through countless epochs. The vicissitudes of our heart had long grown old, to the point of decaying into complete silence.”
“In order to win a chance at life.”
“In order to transcend the Chaos.”
“All of us happened to enter the Valley of the End.”
“In fact, there were a great number of Supreme Experts who stepped foot into the Valley of the End. Most of them ended up dead there, returning to heaven and earth.”
“The 25 of us meet up and are all of wild ambitions. We formed a small group and proceeded to invade one of the forbidden territories in search of what’s within. Based on our speculation, what’s inside perhaps contains the ways of transcending beyond.”
“With five of our five fellow Daoists dead on the way there, we were about to succeed but you snatched the great encounter of ours and even killed two of us.”
“Hmph! Pan Wang! You’ve completely pissed off us old devils, old devils that should’ve died along with the destruction of our universe.”
“At that time, all of us swore that we would break you into pieces one day.”
“After chasing you all the way down and knowing the details about you, we surmised the route that you would take to return to your universe and prepared our ambush here in advance.”
“Sure enough, you reached this place and were ready to take the shortcut back to your universe through the Chaos Passage!”
“Pan Wang, hand over the stuff. Otherwise, not only will we annihilate you, we will also destroy all the human beings of your universe, leaving no one alive.”
“Even though there are restrictions from the universe, we have ways to enter your universe. We’ll just have to pay a certain price and that’s all.”
“You should know that with our power, we are definitely capable of annihilating your human race.”
“Pan Wang, hand it over and we’ll give you a swift death.”
The red-robed old man went on and on. It might be due to the long absence of engaging in conversations.
The remaining 17 Supreme Experts watched the whole exchange indifferently.
Time no longer meant anything to them. Since they’ve trapped Pan Wang successfully, there was no hurry.
As for Pan Wang turning the tables? Haha! They weren’t boasting about it. But who could even save Pang Wang from them? No one.
“Do you really think you’ve done me in?” Pan Wang let out a long roar, “Universe Ax, split apart the Chaos!”
A deafening roar set off an endless torrent of chaotic qi. Immediately afterwards, the ax luminance flashed through, surprisingly splitting the black ocean water into two.
Such a terrifying attack made the red-robed old man turn pale. The other 17 Supreme Experts had the same expression.
However, they seemed to have expected him to break free from the black seawater and proceeded to launch a barrage of supreme special abilities towards Pan Wang who was about to rush out of the body of water, forcing him to fall back in once again.
The black seawater swept back in place, drowning him within yet again.
“Pan Wang, don’t bother wasting your strength. You’re not escaping today.” The red-robed old man spoke again, “Hand it over and the karma between us and your human race will thus cut off there and then. Otherwise, we will now send two among us to directly invade your universe.”
*Rumble…*
The black seawater stirred back and forth as Pan Wang continued to cast supreme offensive special abilities, almost exhausting the boundless black sea water.
Unfortunately, there were just way too many opponents and he kept getting forced back into the body of water.
“Brother Jiang, are we still not making a move?” Hong Ying looked a little anxious, “That’s after all Pan Wang, our guardian god.”
“It’s quite the time to make a move!” Jiang Ming nodded in agreement.
Jiang Ming initially expected Pan Wang to be able to force himself out of the predicament on his own but was disappointed in the end. He also realized that Pan Wang had already used his full strength.
As his body swayed, Jiang Ming arrived within the proximity of the great battle.
“Who’s this?” The red-robed old man was the first to be alerted and locked eyes onto Jiang Ming and the likes. He slightly glanced at them and couldn’t help but sneered, “Human being? You’re both full of life, probably from the Galaxy then. Alas, Pan Wang! I can’t believe you are so lucky to actually have someone coming to save you. It’s just a pity that this is a land of desolation. Coming here only means death.”
“Me dying? No, it’s your death. In fact, you’re already dead!” Jiang Ming looked at the old man with a smirk on his face.
Hong Ying continued wrapping around his arm with a strange look on her face.
Why did Jiang Ming say that the old man was already dead? Wasn’t this just pulling on people’s legs?
However, she remained silent while watching the whole scene unravel, watching how Brother Jiang would assert his dominance in front of a beautiful woman like her. She believed that no matter how powerful a man was, they were all of such virtue.
“I’m dead?” The red-robed old man was stunned, before laughing out loud, “Little guy! You really know how to c-c-crack….”
His expression changed wildly all of a sudden, shivering at the same time. This was because he had discovered that his soul was in the midst of disintegrating.

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - Engulfing the Galaxy
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Engulfing the Galaxy
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
How powerful was Jiang Ming Saint Soul. It had reached the limit of the King Saint Soul, a great realm higher than the red-robed old man. Hence, Jiang Ming was capable of destroying the red-robed old man’s soul.
“How did you do that? I have a Soul Defending Supreme Treasure after all!” The red-robed old man howled in despair. Then, his eyes suddenly lit up as he said, “Can it be that your soul has surpassed the Supreme level?”
“You truly did!” The red-robed old man was ecstatic. His soul was still collapsing, he couldn’t even stop it.
Meanwhile, the other 17 Supreme Experts were stupefied. They took a glance at the red-robed old man before they shifted their gaze at Jiang Ming. They looked as if they were nervous, and excited.
“Yes, I’ve surpassed that.” Jiang Ming nodded. At the same time, he sighed within himself.
“So there’s truly a method of transcendence?” The red-robe old man again asked for verification, but he was so excited that he was shivering.
“Yes!” Jiang Ming replied solemnly. At the same time, he revealed the trait of his powerful King Soul so that the red-robed old man could feel it for himself.
“So is this the power which has surpassed the Supreme?” The red-robed old man shuddered, and revealed a smile on his face. “They said we will die after hearing the Dao of transcendence. Now that I’ve also seen a true means of transcendence. There’s a road ahead, there’s a road ahead indeed. Although my road has ended, I will die without regrets.” The red-robed old man breathed his last as he was smiling. His soul was annihilated.
Jiang Ming sighed. Leaving other things aside, this red-robed old man was a pure Dao seeker. Unfortunately, because of a different position, the battle had to be concluded with either the winner surviving or the loser dead.
This was the cruelty of the great Dao. Due to the difference in standpoints, it would end only with a life or death outcome.
“Did you really break the shackles of the Supreme Expert? But if you did break it, you should have seen through the Chaos or perhaps gone to a higher realm or become the ruler of the Chaos right?” This was a black-robed old man who was asking. He looked extremely sophisticated. He didn’t really care about the death of the red-robed old man because at their level, they had already used to it.
The other 16 Supreme Experts were watching nervously.
“Alas, the Supreme Expert. It has another name in another place. It’s called the Saint Realm. Above the Saint, there’s King Saint.” Jiang Ming revealed what he knew without holding back. “The King Saint is almost like the world, or the universe. Above the King Saint, there’s another realm but I’m not sure about it yet. In fact, there’s not only one realm above the King Saint.”
“What?” The black-robed old man was flabbergasted.
“The Saint, the King Saint, and there are other realms above them?” Pan Wang, who had broken free himself from the black sea because no one was blocking him anymore, came over. He didn’t attack immediately but looked at Jiang Ming and said with shock, “How’s it possible? The galaxy in the Sea of Chaos has been reincarnated numerous times, and there were so many Supreme Experts but I haven’t heard of anyone who’s broken through to any higher realm. No, the Valley of the End is probably one.” Pan Wang recalled that place.
“A King Saint is an existence that transcends the Supreme Expert, and that there is more than one realm above the King Saint?” The black-robed old man was dazed and looked a little crazy. Hearing what Pan Wang said, he sighed and nodded. “There should be the legacy of the existence who transcended the Supreme level. Otherwise, how can it be so dangerous and that many Supreme Experts can’t penetrate it? ”
“The reason why I’m sharing it to you all, is to fulfill your wish. Now, let’s get all of you back to heaven and earth.” As Jiang Ming said, the power of his King Saint Soul surged out, transforming into a small-sized sword which flashed through all 17 Supreme Experts’ forehead.
The strike was so powerful that even their Soul Dao Supreme Treasure couldn’t resist.
It was so obvious how strong Jiang Ming’s King Saint Soul was, and how weak the 17 Supreme Experts were. They died tragically on the spot. Some still had expressions of astonishment on their faces, while some looked unwilling to succumb to it. Of course, there were also a few who showed relief as though they had enough of the world.
“Did they just die like that?” Hong Ying was startled, followed by shiver as she said, “Alas, these are more than a dozen of Supreme Experts! They are probably the terrific existences among the Supreme Experts, and yet they were killed by you just like that?” She could hardly believe what she had seen.
“Amazing!” Pan Wang showed shock all over his face. In fact, he even felt chills down his spine.
He was publicly recognized as the strongest of the Galaxy. He was invincible, and he could deal with the predicament calmly while confronting the 18 Supreme Experts. Even in the confinement earlier, he somewhat was still capable of protecting himself.
However, when Pan Wang saw how terrifying Jiang Ming was, he suddenly realized that he was merely a fragile kid when compared to Jiang Ming.
“Pan Wang!” Jiang Ming clasped his hand.
“You are Jiang Ming right. The new peerless expert of our human race, who killed 18 Supreme Experts outside the Specter Secret Realm. I met a few who entered the Sea of Chaos from the galaxy not long ago. When I heard them talking about you, I didn’t believe in them. Now that I witness for myself, it really opened my eyes.” Pan Wang said sincerely. “It’s fortunate for my human race but…”
After slight hesitation, Pan Wang asked, “You aren’t from our galaxy, and even not from this Sea of Chaos, are you? After all, the Saint, and the King Saint you mentioned earlier, I haven’t heard about them before. I’m considered to be quite knowledgeable because I have traveled around the Sea of Chaos for so many years already.”
“I’m from another Sea of Chaos!” Jiang Ming said.
“Another Sea of Chaos?” Hong Ying was struck dumb. “B-brother Jiang, you are kidding, aren’t you!”
She had been thinking that Jiang Ming was an expert that originated from another galaxy in the Sea of Chaos. Now that Jiang Ming said that he was from another Sea of Chaos, she thought it was ridiculous to have more than one Sea of Chaos.
“There’s truly another Sea of Chaos?” Pan Wang’s jaw had dropped too. What he said, he boldly speculated based on his personal experience only. When his speculation was validated, he still hardly could believe in it.
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded. “The world is too huge, so is the universe, and the Sea of Chaos. Just like the Supreme Experts, which is known as the strongest here. The Supreme Experts are, however, just a start in other places.”
“Supreme Experts are just a start?” Hong Ying had gone berserk. “What the f*ck, in that case, what am I as a Cosmic Expert? A baby?”
Jiang Ming’s words had completely broken her cognition, and subverted her common sense. In the galaxy, she was at the peak provided the Supreme Expert was not around. Hence, she was able to traverse across the galaxy. Because of her invincibility, she would be respected as the Very Imported Person wherever she went. No one in the human race, and even the other races, would dare to offend her.
But Hong Ying was told that she was even weaker than the starting phase! She couldn’t accept the fact, and found it ridiculous.
“Fellow Daoist, can you explain to me in detail?” Pan Wang didn’t lose his temper. He was very excited indeed. His eyes were scorching hot.
Pan Wang didn’t ask how Jiang Ming got here because he knew there was no need to. Moreover, it was a taboo to ask too. He knew that it was enough to learn that Jiang Ming was of the human race, hence they were of the same standpoint, and that was all.
“Of course I can!” Jiang Ming beamed. “However, I’d like to have you tell me the situation here first. For example, how many galaxies are there in the Sea of Chaos? Does the galaxy born after another is destroyed or can they be aligned side by side? I heard that the other galaxies explored are basically broken, which is obviously abnormal.”
As Jiang Ming was speaking, he collected the corpses of the 18 Supreme Experts and their Supreme Treasures. These were indeed the sky-defying gain for Jiang Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - Transcendence is Poisonous, the
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Transcendence is Poisonous, the Great Dao is Demonic
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This world had been giving Jiang Ming a strange feeling. The Chaos where Jiang Ming came from, was too vast with numerous great chiliocosms. Above the great chiliocosm, there was the Sea of Chaos, the supreme world. In fact, it was suitable to be called the Sea of Chaos because it was referring to the entire Chaos.
The Sea of Chaos over here, based on what had been found so far, however, had only a galaxy which was operating. The other galaxies had been destroyed, hence lifeless. After an unknown number of years, they might have decayed completely, not even residual would be left.
“Based on investigation, and the historical sites discovered in the Sea of Chaos, we deduced that a new galaxy would be born only after the old one is destroyed.” Pan Wang sat cross-legged, sharing whatever he knew without hesitation. “When the galaxy is being destroyed, a new galaxy would be born in another place. It’s just like a reincarnation. In fact, we have been wondering why the destruction and the rebirth of a galaxy aren’t happening at the same place to make it a complete reincarnation cycle! Perhaps it’s due to the fact that the Sea of Chaos is too huge, or perhaps a destroyed galaxy would emit too much aura of death, which would make it difficult for a new galaxy to form at the same location.”
Even Pan Wang was not assured himself. After all, the past had been too long. Much evidence had gone along with time, hence couldn’t refer to checking for their validity.
“What about the Valley of the End? What’s it like there?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Alas the Valley of the End!” Pan Wang said as he pondered, “That’s the most well-known forbidden area of the Chaos. It’s extraordinarily dangerous. In normal times, even the death rate for Supreme Experts who entered was 40 percent. If it was during the period of disaster, the death rate could even soar up to 95 percent. It was extremely horrible. However, the legend says that there is a method of transcendence.”
As Pan Wang said, he took out a stone tablet. It was extremely torn, filled with cracks, and there were broken parts on top and the bottom of the tablet. It was as if the tablet would be completely torn if it was hit.
“This is what I took out from the Valley of the End!” Pan Wang said as he pointed at the stone tablet.
Pan Wang’s cultivation base was already at the Half-King Saint Realm, hence it was natural for him to look for the method of transcendence. He spent most of his time traveling in the Sea of Chaos. He had checked out many ruins of the destroyed galaxies, and ventured into many dangerous places. Therefore, the Sea of Chaos to him was no longer that secretive.
He had even entered the Valley of the End three times. For once he almost fell into a dead end, the other he was almost killed, and another it was quite smooth but it still took him a million year to get out of the valley.
This was the fourth time, and he learned about the plot of the red-robed old man and the likes. Pan Wang could sense the inexplicable attractiveness of that thing that they were plotting to get. It was as if the thing had a method of transcendence. Hence, he wanted to put his hand on that thing.
The moment the stone tablet appeared, it induced a torrent filled with power of destruction. Thereby he took the opportunity to take his move, grabbed on the stone tablet, and swiftly eluded.
This resulted in him being chased after, which had lasted for tens of thousands of years.
When he heard about what had happened in the galaxy, he was rushing back to meet Jiang Ming. However, he didn’t expect the red-robed old man and the likes to have deduced his traces, and laid out the trap in advance.
“Premature Death!” Jiang Ming saw the words on the stone tablet, which was very unclear due to the decay, and said frowningly, “Are there only two words? What does this mean?”
“I don’t understand either!” Pan Wang also frowned. “If it’s a tablet for recording, it wouldn’t have just two words. However, if you look at its size and volume, it doesn’t seem to be a piece of a set. Anyway, the fact that it’s found there, proves that it shouldn’t be that simple. It’s just that we haven’t discovered it yet. But this stone tablet is very hard. I can’t crack it even with my power.”
“Let me see!” Jiang Ming grabbed it over, and knocked it to hear a dull sound.
Jiang Ming condensed his power, evoking the Return of Infinite Law Finger but didn’t leave any trace on it at all.
Pan Wang revealed a strange look on his face. He didn’t voice out anything but thought, ‘Three thousands laws? These are of very low grade laws, yet they can be condensed into a special ability. How sky-defying is that?’
Following that, Jiang Ming focused his gaze, emitting the power of his Saint Soul, which materialized as it struck against the stone tablet. This one strike actually scattered the stone tablet into pieces.
Pan Wang’s pupils dilated at shock. It was this power that trembled his soul.
“This is…” Pan Wang suddenly discovered a smaller stone which fell out of the stone tablet. It was the size of a palm, and had an inscription containing the everlasting quality imprinted on it. The inscription said, “Transcendence is poisonous, the great Dao is demonic.”
This sentence radiated out endless hopelessness. It seemed like falling eternally into the boundless abyss. There wasn’t hope nor future, not even a single ray of hope could be seen. There was only the cry of despair.
“The future is full of darkness. If it’s only darkness, what’s the meaning of staying alive? What other meanings do we have…” Hong Ying was filled with despair, tears falling from her eyes, and she was shivering when she continuously repeated her last phrase. Meanwhile, the power within her had gone wild.
Jiang Ming had to evoke the power of his King Saint Soul to isolate the Dao fluctuation emitted from the small stone, and at the same time cast an illumination technique at her to calm her mind.
Hong Ying shuddered, and her face full of shock, “I-I-I’m actually affected? I almost wanted to self-destruct in despair just now. What’s the power contained within? Why is it so terrifying? By the way, brother Jiang, thanks.”
“Since I’ve brought you here, I’m responsible for your safety! Don’t worry, you’ll be alright with me around.” Jiang Ming comforted Hong Ying.
“Your words have given me a sense of security. You are so manly.” Hong Ying looked at Jiang Ming with her burning gaze.
This had rendered Jiang Ming speechless. He didn’t believe that Hong Ying was truly complimenting him because she was simply an old witch.
“The Dao fluctuations contained in it have affected me too. I can’t help feeling despair too.” Pan Wang frowned greatly. His power had been surging out of his body, resisting the fluctuations emitted out from the stone. “This is the power stronger than the Supreme Expert in the galaxy. Otherwise, it absolutely wouldn’t tremble my mind.”
Jiang Ming nodded. He wasn’t affected but he could clearly sense that the power of mind imprinted on it was filled with endless despair.
“What does this sentence mean?” Jiang Ming was confused. “The transcendence is poisonous, and the great Dao is demonic? It’s easy to explain that the transcendence is poisonous, it is about transcending the Chaos right? But why is the great Dao demonic?”
Jiang Ming grabbed the stone in hand, releasing his power, but he couldn’t scatter it at all. Even if he applied the power of his King-Saint Soul, he could only leave an imprint or just a faint trace on it. Hence, he believed that it was a supreme immortal gold.
“Transcendence is poisonous, the great Dao is demonic!” Pan Wang also scratched his head. “Does it mean that the external Chaos is a dead end? No, it’s not right, you’re from the external Chaos. But the power on it is obviously the power of the King Saint that you mentioned. What did the owner of this power discover to be in such despair?”
“I’m afraid that it’s related to the uniqueness of your world here.” Jiang Ming muttered. He had discovered the weirdness of the world long ago. And now he felt he was quite sure of it now.

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - Merging Consciousness with the Galaxy
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Merging Consciousness with the Galaxy
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Based on Jiang Ming’s understanding, the galaxy was equivalent to a great chiliocosm. A great chiliocosm generally would have a maximum number of seven Saints. But here in this world there are at least 30 Supreme Experts.
Moreover, something was wrong with the Sea of Chaos here as well. A new galaxy would be born only after the old one was destroyed. There was also the specialty of the Valley of the End, and the strange small stone before them. It was obvious that the stone tablet which was carrying the sentence was hidden on purpose.
Jiang Ming put his doubts away, planning to investigate them only later.
Following that, Jiang Ming shared about the Sea of Chaos in his world.
“In the Sea of Chaos, there were numerous big worlds? Each world can nurture Supreme Experts? In the Sea of Chaos are many existences stronger than the Supreme Experts? What’s after the Saint, and the King Saint?” Pan Wang couldn’t help but shock after he heard Jiang Ming’s sharing.
And the cultivation system was completely different. Pan Wang’s world had either genetic evolution followed by comprehending laws, or purely the Soul Dao these two ways of Dao. But there rarely was anyone taking the way of Soul Dao.
Meanwhile, in Jiang Ming’s world, the mainstream was the unity of vital essence and divinity, comprehending the mysterious great Dao.
“Fellow Daoist, how should I go on the road of the King Saint here?” Pan Wang asked, humbly.
“Different worlds have different sets of rules, hence different routes. Based on my experience…” Jiang Ming pondered as he said, “The Physique Dao is based on the transformation of genetics. However, your level has obviously reached its peak, and you can’t go further, right?”
“Yes, you’re right!” Pan Wang revealed his excitement as he added, “I feel my genetics has achieved the perfect degree, and can’t improve any further. This is obviously impossible, but I can’t find any way to have a breakthrough. Neither can I see my future.”
“Other than the sublimation of physique and the transformation of genetics, I think you may try to comprehend the various laws available in this world. By imprinting the laws in the core of your genetics, you might be able to break the shackles. However, I’m not sure whether it works or not.” Jiang Ming suggested.
“The laws?” Pan Wang frowned. “The various laws? And have to comprehend all of them?”
“Yes. Based on your capability, I don’t think it’s difficult for you! You may forcefully collect the laws of the galaxy and merge them into your body. Just try to see whether it works. Else, we can look for other alternatives.” Jiang Ming said.
“Alright!” Pan Wang agreed. “What about the Soul Dao?”
“You can merge your soul with the origin of the galaxy.” As Jiang Ming said, his eyes were glittering with sparks of wisdom. “Merging your consciousness with the galaxy is akin to heaven is your heart, where you can utilize the stalwart will of the galaxy to evoke your self transformation.”
“Errr…” Pan Wang was surprised. Following that, he shook his head. “I used to try it but I was almost being assimilated by the origin of the galaxy.”
“What about you assimilating the origin of the galaxy in return?” Jiang Ming beamed.
“This…” Pan Wang was stunned. His eyes, however, abruptly burst forth a gleam of refined light while began deducing the possibility. “If I were to merge with the origin, and merge myself with the galaxy. I can definitely utilize the boundless wills of the galaxy to promote the sublimation and transformation of my own will. I should not be in a rush, taking a step at a time so that I won’t be assimilated. Once I succeed, I may be able to break through the shackles, and even further enhance my physique to advance into the King Saint level. In the past, I only tried out a bit and didn’t think about it deeply. But now when I think about it carefully, this is indeed a way.”
Pan Wang made a pause, and continued hesitantly, “Both the Physique Dao and the Soul Dao have to communicate with the origin of the galaxy. Fellow Daoist, what do you think about me going to other broken galaxies, refining the remnant vital essence to nurture my mind, and the law pieces for the absorbent of my physique. When I’ve reached a certain degree, I will return to our galaxy to improve myself.”
“Perhaps it would work but…” Jiang Ming said as he pondered, “When a galaxy is destroyed, it would be filled with an endless aura of calamity, death, and resentment. Hence, it has gathered the negative energies of a galaxy. If you were to make a mistake, you may be defiling yourself.”
“You’re right. But I think I can try. Otherwise, if you were to ask me to merge my consciousness with the galaxy…” Pan Wang smiled wryly as he continued, “I’ll be feeling very perturbed.”
“It’s normal for you to have that feeling.” Jiang Ming laughed. Then, he said with slight hesitation, “I think you should know about the Specter Secret Realm. I’ve been there. Perhaps that secret realm is linked to the origin of the galaxy, it even has its own basic will now.”
“Does it have its own basic will?” Pan Wang was flabbergasted.
Jiang Ming simply explained the situation while he was in the Specter Secret Realm.
It was as though Jiang Ming was a ghost when Pan Wang looked at Jiang Ming. Pan Wang frowned, and eventually smiled wryly as he said, “Fellow Daoist, I’m afraid that the galaxy has truly got its own will. Perhaps it’s another pioneer who has merged his consciousness with the galaxy, and managed to gain some positive results.”
Jiang Ming nodded because he himself had similar thoughts as well.
Following that, the two discussed the path of different worlds. Jiang Ming also told Pan Wang that other than the methods he had mentioned, they could also rely on external vessels such as the supreme liquid, spiritual items, and etc to temper their physiques, and even transform their souls.
However, it was almost impossible that the Sea of Chaos in Pan Wang’s world would have all these things. Even if it was possible, Pan Wang would need the support of alchemy to reconcile all kinds of spiritual things and promote the sublimation of good fortune; or go to the Valley of the End to try his luck, for the valley was extraordinary after all.
Neither of them hid their secrets, hence they talked very happily.
“After a while, I will explore the King Saint, and how to go on the road beyond the King Saint.” Jiang Ming gave Pan Wang an even deeper expectation.
Hong Ying listened carefully from the side. Although the discussed content wasn’t about the detailed cultivation, it was the path to the future. Hence, she knew it would save her trillions of years of work just to listen to Jiang Ming and Pan Wang today.
“Brother Jiang, what is your plan next?” Pan Wang had changed the way he addressed Jiang Ming.
“I’m planning to travel in the Sea of Chaos. If I were to find a broken galaxy, it might be useful for me.” Jiang Ming laughed. “Brother Pan, what about you?”
“I originally planned to go back just to meet you. Since I’ve met you here now, there’s no need for me to return.” Pan Wang laughed as well. “The fact that you killed 18 Supreme Experts in a battle, you’ve intimidated the galaxy and conquered all races. Hence, in a short while, no one would dare to show up and provoke my human race. In addition to my name, your intimidation allows our human race to expand freely in millions of years. Now that it is all right, there is no need to go back. Brother Jiang, how about I accompany you, at least I can be a guide.”
“It’s my honor!” Jiang Ming was ecstatic. After all, with Pan Wang’s guidance, it would be easier for him to look for the broken galaxy.
Hong Ying showed deep resentment. ‘How can I seduce this naive man, who now has another man by his side? Shall I seduce the two together?’
Jiang Ming took a glance at Hong Ying, and he had a rather strange expression as he thought, ‘This old witch!’
Without stopping, the three went on. Pan Wang took out a spaceship, a Supreme Treasure which could traverse the Sea of Chaos at extremely fast speed, so fast that it was 1 light year per second.
It was a speed that even Jiang Ming was extremely surprised about. However, it was not a great deal to a Supreme Expert. Moreover, the Sea of Chaos was too fast with almost to none obstacles, hence allowing the spaceship to move quickly.
Jiang Ming had his avatar remained together with them, while he himself wanted to return to talk to Yun Zizai.

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - The Chaos Primordial Land, the Greatest Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: The Chaos Primordial Land, the Greatest Secret
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The first thing Jiang Ming did upon return, was to cook himself a meal. Even though Linglong had been pestering him for sex, he was firm in his decision.
After he had finished eating a bowl of seafood noodles, he paced out to the Tianyuan Sea.
There were more human experts around. With more Great Overarching Experts around, the Golden Immortal Experts became rather insignificant.
Jiang Ming went directly to the Infinite Realm Auction House. Riyue Changfeng was still around, enjoying his life with a table and a cup of tea.
Opposite him was Yun Zizai, the Saint who came from the Sea of Chaos. The two were enjoying the tea together.
Other than Jiang Ming, Yun Zizai only valued Riyue Changfeng.
On the other side, Yun Feiyan was still dueling with the clone of Jiang Ming’s Junior Sister. This time around was Junior Sister Space.
Yun Feiyan was being oppressed. As time passed by, Yun Feiyan as a genius originating from the Sea of Chaos, had been getting hit harder and harder.
“Brother Jiang!” Feeling the aura of Jiang Ming, Riyue Changfeng rose to his feet to welcome Jiang Ming.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang!” Yun Zizai rose to his feet too. He didn’t dare to be arrogant before Jiang Ming.
“Brother Changfeng, fellow Daoist Yun!” Jiang Ming clasped his hands, and sat aside.
Riyue Changfeng took out a cup and poured Jiang Ming tea. At the same time, he grinned, “You definitely won’t come out here if you don’t need to. Brother Jiang, what are the doubts that you are having?”
Jiang Ming nodded. “What are the characteristics of the realms above the Saint?”
“Brother Jiang, I know that you are an incredible genius who tops the entire universe. But how long have you just sanctified your way of Dao, and you are now planning for the realms above the Saint.” Riyue Changfeng laughed, “Instead, you should calm yourself, and comprehend the wonders of Saint Dao.”
“That’s right!” Yun Zizai nodded. “The road of Saint Dao is extremely difficult to begin with. In fact, 99 percent of the Saint Experts would be stuck in this realm. Those who can sanctify their way of Dao and become Saints, which one is not peerless and stunning in an era, but they are still stuck in this Saint Realm in the end. Therefore, the most important thing to do while you are in the Saint Realm is to precipitate and accumulate as much as you can so that you can go further.”
“The two of you are talking about normality, but I’m obviously not!” Jiang Ming said helplessly.
“Brother Jiang, you are being arrogant for saying this. Don’t tell me that you are at the peak of the Saint Realm already.” Riyue Changfeng laughed.
“Sanctifying the path of Dao with your soul is extremely difficult. Even after the sanctification, it’d be extremely tough to improve. Hence, to be able to advance into the peak of the Saint Soul is more unreliable than having your world suddenly explode.” Yun Zizai laughed too.
Yun Zizai was of the Saint Realm himself. Hence, he knew the difficulty of taking each little step of improvement. It was extraordinarily difficult.
Thinking back then, he was claimed to have the potential to be a King Saint, but how many years did it take for him to advance into the peak stage of the Saint Realm? That was counted in billions of years.
Moreover, Jiang Ming who was only about 100 years old, had sanctified his way of Dao for only a few decades. Hence, logically it was impossible that Jiang Ming would have any improvement by now.
“You two still don’t understand the world of true genius.” Jiang Ming sighed.
Riyue Changfeng couldn’t help but shudder, and said in astonishment, “Brother Jiang, is your Saint Soul advanced to its peak stage? How’s it possible!”
Relatively speaking, Riyue Changfeng knew Jiang Ming better. Since Jiang Ming had said so, it would mostly be real. However, it had totally blown his mind.
On the other hand, it was obvious that Yun Zizai couldn’t believe in Jiang Ming at all.
“It’s not the peak stage of Saint Soul.”
“Oh, you surprised me, I thought you were too ingenious! In this case, are you at the middle stage of Saint Soul now?”
“It’s King Saint!”
“King Saint?” Riyue Changfeng couldn’t immediately come to his senses.
“King Saint?” Yun Zizai was screaming, followed by a smile, “Fellow Daoist Jiang, you’re pulling my leg, aren’t you!”
“King Saint?” Riyue Changfeng was stunned. He looked at Jiang Ming and there was a shock showing his almost collapsed heart in his eyes. “Brother Jiang, are you truly a King Saint now?”
Jiang Ming was helpless. Hence, he released a wisp of his King Saint Soul’s power, which froze the void, and caused all the laws to cry in an instant.
Feeling the power, Riyue Changfeng shrieked as he felt his soul crumbling while his physique was disintegrating. This power was beyond his recognition and his scope of understanding. It was even beyond his enduring limits.
“This is the aura of the King Saint!” Yun Zizai’s face turned pale in horror. He was after all an experienced Saint, hence he was able to resist the power. Nevertheless, his eyes popped out three feet long.
Jiang Ming quickly retrieved his power.
This allowed Riyue Changfeng to take a deep breath, but his forehead had been covered with drops of sweat. He looked at Jiang Ming as though Jiang Ming was a ghost. Following that, he smiled wryly as he said, “When I first arrived here, you were not a match of mine. To be exact, you were far weaker than me, and you even wanted to get some spiritual items from me for your cultivation. But you caught up with me not long later. You were so domineering. Following that, when your soul was sanctified to become Saint Soul, I felt so ashamed but I was confident that I could catch up with you. B-but now you have advanced into the King Saint?”
Riyue Changfeng stretched his neck, having a rather messy thought.
“King Saint, brother Jiang, I still don’t understand how you can achieve it in such a short time?” Riyue Changfeng was rather berserk. “Alas, a King Saint is a tycoon even if it’s in the Sea of Chaos!”
“Indeed a tycoon!” Yun Zizai was still slightly stunned, followed by a wry smile. “Feiyan, Changfeng, and I are publicly known as geniuses. Hong Zhan in the Sea of Chaos is the most brilliant genius among all, and there is even a sky-defying genius who came out of millions of Wonton Era. Yet, when we’re all compared to you, we aren’t considered a genius at all! No, we aren’t even a slag, we are nothing!” Yun Zizai gritted his teeth a little as he said.
“Do you have to act this way!” Jiang Ming said weakly, “I’m just having better encounters and improving faster!”
“Do we have to act this way? Brother Jiang, do you know that I feel like spanking you at this moment!” Riyue Changfeng was even more gritting his teeth.
“Yep!” Yun Zizai nodded his head, dumbfoundedly.
“Unfortunately, the two of you can’t spank me at all!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but guffaw.
Riyue Changfeng and Yun Zizai looked at each other, both still couldn’t conceal the shock in their eyes.
Yun Zizai helped himself with a few cups of tea before he said gloomily, “I’ve learned a lot from being here. Fellow Daoist Jiang, when you go to the Sea of Chaos in the future, you will definitely earn yourself a place in it, and you will even be able to become one of the strongest tycoons. Alas, to think that you took only a few decades to sanctify King Saint, I-I still…can’t help from being shocked.”
“This is normal!” Jiang Ming laughed. “Fellow Daoist Yun, can you please tell me about the situation above the King Saint? Also, is the Sea of Chaos truly called the Sea of Chaos?”
“Sure!” Yun Zizai no longer hesitated. He was willing to share even the secrets, let alone these were merely general knowledge. After all, all people who weren’t stupid would know that Jiang Ming was destined to rise up to the top. In fact, Jiang Ming had risen up.
“Alas the Sea of Chaos. It is actually enveloping the entire Chaos, but it generally refers to the Chaos Primordial Land. The Chaos Primordial Land is the core of the entire Chaos, where the origin gathers. For example, when the incomparably vast world of Chaos has 10 parts of good fortune, nine parts of the good fortune would be found in the Chaos Primordial Region, while other regions, including countless Great Thousand Realms and Chaos, etc., only share a part of good fortune. This shows the horror of the Chaos Primordial Land.”
Yun Zizai had shared the greatest secret of the Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - Three Levels of Saint Realms, A Great Epoch
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Three Levels of Saint Realms, A Great Epoch
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Chaos was vast and boundless. Counting the great chiliocosm alone, there were already countless of them. However, all of this only constitutes one-tenth of Chaos’ good fortune? The Chaos Primordial Land alone constituted the remaining nine-tenth of the good fortune?
This was similar to a piece of land the size of a palm in the vast ocean. However, the palm-sized land was coalescing with nine parts of good fortune, nine parts of the power, nine parts of the wealth, nine parts of the potential while the remaining part was the entire ocean itself.
It felt as though reality was pulling on one’s leg. Yet, it also showed how terrifying the Chaos Primordial Land was. Comparatively speaking, great chiliocosm was but a tiny inferior aborigine.
Even Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh secretly.
“In fact, the Saint Realm that you are all referring to doesn’t specifically refer to the Saints.” Yun Zizai revealed another hidden secret, a secret about the cultivation realm that was only known to the Chaos Primordial Land, “The Saint Realm has three steps, or rather three levels. They are the Saint, King Saint and Lord Saint. Each level greatly differs from each other. For example, the difference between a King Saint and a Saint is equivalent to the difference between an Immortal and the mere mortal. That’s what it means when it is said that one step is akin to a whole heaven!”
“The Saint has three levels, namely the Saint, King Saint and Lord Saint?” Jiang Ming was surprised and continued to ask, “What about beyond the Lord Saint? Is there a higher realm than that?”
“There is!” Yun Zizai answered without any hesitation, “Beyond the Lord Said, is the ultimate existence of the Chaos, known as the Chaos Realm. They are the true tycoons of the Chaos Primordial Land. Each of them possess the supreme power to suppress the Chaos themselves. Perhaps, you might know a few of them.”
“Brother Jiang should know!” Riyue Changkong nodded in agreement.
“For example…” A light flashed through Jiang Ming’s eyes, “The owner of the Infinite Realm Auction House? The owner of the Lord God Space? The owner of the Heaven Reincarnation Hall?”
“You really knew them all!” Riyue Changkong expected much and continued, “Only those who are in possession of heaven-defying great fortune would be in contact with these factions and also the one who can break free from the shackles of fate of the great chiliocosm.”
There’s also the most terrifying heritage of all. Jiang Ming didn’t have a clue where this unknown heritage was from thus far.
“There’s also the Great Monarch of Hong Zhan, the supreme genius of Hongmeng Primordial Land. He is also a great tycoon of a faction.” Yun Zizai interjected, “Other than that, there are many other tycoons in the Chaos. Let’s not continue with these!’
“What exactly is the extent of the power of the Chaos Realm?” Jiang Ming’s voice lowered a few notches.
“This…” Yun Zizai had the urge to scratch his head, but finally spread his hand and replied, “I don’t know either. I guess that a single blow of breath from such a level of existence would probably blow your whole Honggu Great Chiliocosm into oblivion.”
Jiang Ming’s eyelids fluttered furiously.
‘A single breath can decimate a whole great chiliocosm? Are they that strong? That’s already completely beyond my perception. God damn. Doesn’t that mean the current me is nothing but a small shrimp in the vast ocean? However, I seem to have been targeted by the Lord God already. No, how would an existence of such a level target me? God damn it! To think that I am actually still a feeble ant.’
“It’s very easy to attain the Saint Realm in great chiliocosms. As long as one enlightens the heavenly Dao, comprehends the origin of law, the person can ascend to the limits and sanctify into the Saint Realm. From then on, their soul can be imprinted into the origin of the Heavenly Dao. As long as their chiliocosm remains, they are immortal. This is only comparatively speaking of course. For example, you can use King Saint Weapons to wipe off the imprint, or maybe a few other special abilities and the likes.” Yun Zizai began to talk about the characteristics of each cultivation realm.
It wasn’t hard to attain such a level of cultivation in the Chaos Primordial Land as well. As long as the person’s aptitude weren’t bad, powers can undergo metamorphosis, souls can be leapt into higher levels, the body can undergo ascension and many other improvements. All in all, there are always ways to do so. Relatively speaking, it was actually easier to sanctify the Saint Realm in the Chaos Primordial Land.
“The pathway to step into the King Saint Realm is actually relatively simple in the great chiliocosm!” Yun Zizai revealed yet another hidden secret.
“How so?” This was something even Riyue Changfeng didn’t know of. “Isn’t there a shackle in the great chiliocosm? The strongest would only be a Half-King Saint Realm.”
This was also what Jiang Ming was wondering.
“It’s not so!’ Yun Zizai smiled and explained, “Where’s the limit of the Chaos? It’s in the Chaos Primordial Land, the Chaos Realm. The great chiliocosms also have a limit but this limit can obviously be broken. I’ve heard from the great monarch of my Yun Clan that if you want to directly achieve the King Saint Realm within a great chiliocosm, you must first become the chhiliocosm’s preacher, which is the Dao Patriarch and gather the chiliocosm’s boundless great fortune.”
This was equivalent to becoming the son of the great fortune, or more appropriately, the son of the world. With the help of the great fortune of all sentient beings, the person’s Saint Soul could be merged into the origin of Heaven and Earth, gradually replacing the heart of heaven with the person’s heart. From then on, the person’s heart would be the heart of heaven.
Followed by the control over the chiliocosm’s origin, the person could in turn promote his self- improvement, breaking the shackles and advancing into the King Saint Realm.
There was also a life-and-death juncture here. The juncture was that when the person’s will was integrated into the origin of heaven and earth, his will would be easily assimilated. Once assimilated, it would be equivalent to the person transforming into Dao itself or rather, becoming the puppet of the Heavenly Dao.
It was either assimilate or be assimilated.The dangers involved weren’t worth the understanding of the outsiders. However, this was also a clear pathway towards sanctifying Dao and also only valid for sentient beings born of the respective chiliocosm.
However, the Saints within the great chiliocosm were bound by their limited insight, special abilities and so on, as well as the self-imposed confinement by the chiliocosm. To undergo extreme sublimation would be incredibly difficult or even impossible.
However, with guidance, this was the shortcut.
In the Chaos Primordial Land, the sanctification of the King Saint Realm would be extremely difficult. The path of cultivation was nothing more than the essence of the spirit, that was the body, Qi and Soul.
The main path of sanctifying the King Saint Realm was to perceive the heart of the Chaos. It was extremely mysterious and difficult to be described. Upon enlightenment and the power feedback to the person itself, the person’s mana would be transformed into the King Saint Realm.
There were two other pathways as well. One of them was the tempering of the person’s physique. Extreme temperament coupled with the person constantly breaking through the limits would allow the person’s physique to advance into the King Saint Realm. Such a way was through pure incomparable strength.
The second pathway would be the law of the soul Dao. In fact, the path of advancement in the great chiliocosm was the self-sublimation of the soul, which was the path of the soul Dao already.
Whether it was the path of the physique or the path of the soul, they were both too difficult comparatively.
“According to the statistics, 90 percent of the cultivators take the main path of King Saint within the Chaos Primordial Land where seven percent walk on the path of physique temperament and three percent take the soul refinement path.” Yun Zizai slowly explained, “As for the higher level of the Lord Saint Dao, it’s not a secret. One only needs to comprehend a single Law of Chaos and that’s all. As for the even higher Chaos Realm, I don’t know it as well.”
He really had no idea.
Saint, King Saint and the Lord Saint. The information of sanctifying into these three realms were passed on through lineage and was considered an open secret in the Chao’s Origin
As for the Chaos Realm? That belonged in the legend category.
“In reality, whether it’s the Physique Dao or Soul Dao, both are improvements in terms of power level by improving oneself through internal refinement. With sufficient resources, the early stages would be smooth sailing. However, upon the later stages, it would be extremely difficult to go further on.” Yun Zizai looked at Jiang Ming, still with an astonished look on his face, “Those that walk on the path of Soul within the Chaos Primordial Land are very, very rare. However, once the cultivator goes through this path, it in turn becomes easier for the person to comprehend the Laws of Chaos.”
Jiang Ming nodded his head in agreement. This wasn’t difficult to understand. When the soul became stronger, it was naturally much easier to comprehend the Laws of Heavens and Earth. It was just that he didn’t imagine the cultivation methods of the Chaos Primordial Land to be divided as such.
“Are there many Chaos Realm Experts in the Chaos Primordial Land?” Jiang Ming inquired.
“Of course there aren’t many!” Yun Zizai laughed, “It’s known to have only eight of them. As for whether there are any more, I don’t know. There might… No! There should be! After all, I’m still too young myself. My real age is but less than a great epoch. Also, the Chaos Primordial Land has existed for at least hundreds of millions of great epochs!”

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - ongmeng Great Dao Nine
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Chaos Primordial Land had a very special way of recording time. Since time was particularly long, as if it existed eternally, they took duration from the birth of a great chiliocosm until its destruction as a great epoch.
The birth and fall of a chiliocosm as one great epoch.
Based on such a calculation, the specific time frame would be three thousand trillion years. One trillion years was equivalent to one thousand billion years.
How many great epochs had it been since the birth of the Chaos Primordial Land? Even Yun Zizai wasn’t sure himself.
“Saint, King Saint, Lord Saint, and Chaos Realm.” Only now did Jiang Ming have a clear understanding of the cultivation realms.
According to Yun Zizai’s remark, in the Chaos Primordial Land, the Saint was the mainstream cultivation realm, the King Saint was the backbone force, while the Lord Saint the existence that suppressed a whole faction, the lord with utmost power. Their every move suppressed the heavens, whereas their every word governed the world.
As for the supreme existence of the Chaos Realm, they only existed in the legends and wouldn’t usually show themselves.
“My strength is still lacking!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but lament.
Riyue Changfeng and Yun Zizai rolled their eyes at his remarks.
‘God damn it! You’re already a King Saint and you’re saying that your cultivation is still lacking? To top it off, this is only your cultivation for over a mere hundred years.’
“Fellow Daoist Yun, do you know any other Sea of Chaos?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“You even know this?” Yun Zizai was very surprised.
“There are really other Seas of Chaos?” Riyue Changfeng was taken aback.
“Brother Changfeng, even you didn’t know this?” Jiang Ming was surprised. “That shouldn’t be! You’re a superintendent of the Infinite Realm Auction House. It’s understandable if you are hiding such information, but to really not know it is a bit abnormal.”
“That’s actually what’s normal.” Yun Zizai stroked his beard.
As he looked at Jiang Ming, he was more shocked and puzzled in heart.
‘How exactly did this kid improve his cultivation realm? Even if his enlightenment aptitude is heavenly-defying and is the son of the Great Dao, the path of cultivation always requires an infinite amount of resources. However, what can a person get ahold of within a mere great chiliocosm? He isn’t even a Dao Patriarch. In addition, how did he know that there are other Sea of Chaos? This is even more uncalled for.’
“Even within the Chaos Primordial Land, the so-called Sea of Chaos outside of the domain is also a taboo. It’s generally not mentioned, nor will there be any records of it left around.” Yun Zizai explained solemnly, “I also heard of it from my clan’s great monarch. He once said that a very long time ago, our Chaos Primordial Land was under the invasion by a foreign force and our Chaos Primordial Land almost collapsed. Back then, there were many Saints who were killed, so did the King Saints.”
“B-b-but… ” Riyue Changfeng’s face was filled with shock and confusion, “Isn’t the Chaos supposed to include everything and exists as the source of all things in the universe? How can there be another Sea of Chaos?”
“The Sea of Chaos is just a general term.” Yun Zizai smiled bitterly. “In my initial belief, I too thought that the Chaos was everything from the origin of Dao to the mother of all sentient beings, the source and home to all life. However…”
He shook his head and sighed helplessly. “The Great Dao is infinite and its mysteries are endless. Who would be the wiser if our so-called Chaos is actually a small pond in the eyes of the other levels?”
Riyue Changfeng shivered violently.
Jiang Ming fell silent.
This wasn’t a pie in the sky, but a possibility. That’s because there was a whole chiliocosm within him already.
As for the foreign domains, Yun Zizai knew little about them.
After sipping two more cups of tea, Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak.
When his gaze swept through the area, he discovered that the Immortal grasses and the likes planted in the Immortal Gardens behind had already matured.
Jiang Ming made his way over.
Looking at the Immortal Gardens that once brought him great benefits, they now looked somewhat useless to him. Harvesting was the only reward.
Even though he had prepared the best conditions to plant the Immortal Roots, the growth was still very slow.
Moreover, he even used the Verdant Emperor Spirit Transformation Technique. This technique, which he had continuously deduced into the fourth level, could accelerate the growth by up to ten thousand times.
However, it was still incredibly slow when compared to Jiang Ming’s own growth. It was more worthless than wastes.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for harvesting seven acres of Yin Yang Immortal Grass. You are rewarded with Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique!”
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for harvesting eight acres of Reincarnation Immortal Grass. You are rewarded with Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra!”
Jiang Ming had only opened up fifteen acres of Immortal Gardens. The rewards upon his harvest surprised him greatly.
‘This reward, it’s too unexpected!’ He was more shocked than surprised.
