After he took in these two techniques, two golden orbs were formed directly within his sea of consciousness, both of which contained a huge amount of information on the technique itself. He had the feeling that if he absorbed the two of them all at once, his consciousness would shatter from the impact.
‘How can there be such terrifying techniques? My Soul Dao is already at the peak of the King Saint already!’ Jiang Ming was completely taken aback. It took him a while before he calmed himself down.
The Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra that he practiced in the past was no longer of any use to him.
This was especially right after he embarked on the path of the World Dao, this technique was basically abandoned. All was well as long as his inner world continued to undergo evolutions.
The cultivation level of his Soul was also passively raised along with his inner world and the Chaotic World Tree.
In contrast, the power of his physique seemed to have almost been stagnant throughout and had now become his shortcoming instead.
However, now that he had the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique…
The first cycle reached straight for the limits of the Demi-Sage. Deducting based on the technique’s information, once the first cycle was cultivated to perfection, the person would be able to turn the table against Saints, or rather, capable of beheading the Saint directly.
This was too powerful. The technique was completely the cultivation of the Immortal Body.
The next cycle corresponded to the power of the Saints. However, because of the technique itself, the temperament of the physique was extremely formidable. Once cultivated into perfection, the person’s physique would be equivalent to a Half-King Saint Weapon.
Moreover, the technique came with its own special abilities. If he was able to comprehend a few of them, coupled with the Great Dao Combat Body, he would be able to exert a tremendously terrifying combat power.
Just deriving the technique slightly had caused Jiang Ming to tremble.
The third cycle corresponded to the King Saint Realm, and the fourth cycle corresponded to the Lord Saint Realm.
There was only information about these four cycles for the time being.
The Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra only had information of four cycles as well.
As for the rest? They were all in the golden orb itself.
“Ding: Due to the fact that the host had been growing too rapidly, the rewards from harvests are hereby abolished.”
Jiang Ming heard the System beeping yet again. His jaw fell and sighed helplessly.
Perhaps the rewards just now were compensations to him.
‘If it’s abolished, so be it!’
Looking over the Immortal Garden, Jiang Ming’s heart was filled with emotions.
It was the fact that he could rely on the Immortal Garden back then which allowed him to grow up rapidly. Once he had established a certain foundation for himself, he rose step by step bracing through subsequent calamity.
Nevertheless, those that couldn’t keep up would eventually be eliminated.
There were still four Tree People and four Flower Fairies. They had all grown into the Great Overarching Realm already.
Because of their preference to stay restless and the tranquility, they had been taking care of the Immortal Garden daily, and quietly growing day by day.
“From now on, I’m leaving this place to you all. If you ever feel like going into the outside world, you may do so anytime!” Jiang Ming explained to the eight of them.
“Master, we are willing to accompany you forever and ever!” The four Flower Fairies immediately flew over and swirled around him.
Even though they had reached the Great Overarching Realm, they still maintained a three-foot height and their flawless exquisite look.
“Master, we are willing to guard this place forever!” The other four Tree People also expressed their standpoints.
Jiang Ming nodded his head in response.
As long as they like it, let them be.
“The Chaos…” As Jiang Ming returned to the balcony, he gazed beyond the world and frowned slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - Creating a New Chat Group System
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Creating a New Chat Group System
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming gazed into the depths of the Chaos. In an extremely distant place, there was an immense, incomparably huge chiliocosm that was tumbling towards them. As it inched forward, the Chaotic Qi set off endless storms. It even almost rippled to the edges of Honggu Great Chiliocosm already.
However, pushing a whole chiliocosm forward was, after all, a very slow process.
‘Based on my estimation, I’m afraid it will take another 20 years or so for it to completely reach here.’ Jiang Ming made a simple estimation.
The time frame given was very short already. But for Jiang Ming, this would allow his strength to undergo a revolutionary change once again.
“The damned will die sooner or later!” Jiang Ming muttered as he entered the Supreme Pagoda.
In the corners, there was no longer the silhouette of Ye Qingxian to be seen. It was apparent that this mysterious woman was living well over at Dongfang Chenxi’s.
Jiang Ming felt rather depressed for a little while. He shook his head, took out a set of sofa and sat himself down. Then, Jiang Ming took out teapots and tea leaves, poured in some innate spiritual liquid to brew himself a pot of tea. Following that, he communicated with the Supreme Order.
The chat group had always been lively. Although the cycle of time was different between the internal and outside world, observing through consciousness wouldn’t be of much effect.
[Hong Yi: Group Admin, when are you leaving?]
[Hong Yi: Brother Hong, it’s high time to leave already.]
[Hong Yi: Brother Hong! You’re occupying space yet doing nothing. I’m getting irritated waiting for you.]
[Hong Yi: Brother Hong, why wait another 20 years? You can just go straight for a cultivation retreat and it’d be over in a flash.]
[Hong Zhan: “Hong Yi! You’ve made me almost annoyed to death!]
[Hong Yi: Well, I thought it should be easy to wait for 50 years, yet only 30 years had gone by and I realized how wrong I was! A heaven-defying great fortune is right in front of my eyes! It can even change my whole destiny. How can I calm myself down?]
[Hong Zhan: Just wait another 20 years.]
[Hong Yi: I can wait no longer! Alas, Brother Hong! You are useless even if you stay here right?]
[Hong Zhan: However, once I leave this place, how else can I contact you guys? How can I contact Brother Jiang? Alas, I also yearn to break through my cultivation, but life no longer would be meaningful if I leave you guys. You don’t understand. I’m like a young master back in my family. Anyone who sees me will become all respectful to me. It’s too boring!]
[Di Huo: You fool! Showing off again, are you?]
[Hong Zhan: “This is not showing off but instead, cold hard fact. The ones serving me now are all Saint Realm maids.]
[Di Huo: Crap! I’m too envious!]
[Au Jiu: “God damn it! Brother Hong! I’m so envious of you to the point that I have that urge to just castrate you! Damn it! All Saint Realm maids! This is injustice!]
[Tian Fo: Let’s all remove him from the position as the Group Admin, shall we? By the way, Brother Hong, do the Saint maids smell good?]
[Hong Zhan: He He…]
[Feng Wu: Saints willing to become your Saint maiden? Aren’t you afraid they might slap you to death in a fit of annoyance one day?]
[Ye Qingxian: That’s right! Those of which can reach the Saint Realm would all be of iron will. How will they not be condescending?]
[Hong Zhan: That’s because there are just way too many Saints over at my place. Also, I’m of a very high status myself. The biggest reason of course, would be that my innate aptitude is greatly praised by my family’s great monarch. Haha! Saints slapping me to death? That’s not possible. I even have some life-saving triumph cards with me that are left by the great monarchs personally.]
[Di Huo: I’m even more envious now!]
[Jiang Ming: I killed another 18 Saints!]
[Hong Zhan: …]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang is nevertheless worthy of my admiration! Compared to you, I’m nothing at all!]
[Di Huo: This here is the real champion. Brother Hong, you’re just relying on your elders to make the Saints serve you. Yet, look at Brother Jiang! He’s slaughtering them personally. He beheaded 18 of them before, another seven and a Dao Patriarch in another battle, and now he’s taken down yet another 18. God damn! How many Saints has Brother Jiang slaughtered? My scalp’s tingling, my mind’s trembling!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Almighty Brother Jiang Ming!]
[Ye Qingxian: Almighty Brother Jiang!]
[Ming Fei: Awesome! He is definitely not boasting.]
[Au Jiu: Brother Jiang, can you suppress a female Saint and force yourself on her?]
[Jiang Ming: That’s nasty! I’m a decent gentleman!]
[Au Jiu: Come on now, us men are good for nothing.]
[Tian Fo: Amitabha, I’m not a man, but a Buddha.]
[Di Huo: Pooff… I spewed 30,000 miles of flame in one breath because of that.]
[Jiang Ming: Everyone, I have a way where even if the person has left the group chat, we can still communicate with each other unimpeded. However, I will be needing your soul imprint. Are you willing to do so?]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang, you’ve succeeded?]
[Jiang Ming: Yes, I did.]
When he first had the idea, Jiang Ming already began using the Human Path Record as the carrier for deducing the technique. It was extremely difficult at first but once his Saint Soul went through the transformation and advanced into the King Saint Realm, his mastery of this great weapon, Human Path Record grew deeper. He naturally discovered more of its functions.
It was no longer a difficult problem creating a chat group. By just slightly structuring it, the chat room was already tentatively completed.
After all, this supreme great weapon that he had no idea of its level, could even allow him to traverse the infinite realms. Communicating in chat rooms was comparatively much easier than the former. It was just that the process required the participants’ soul imprint.
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang Ming is really almighty! I’m sending my soul imprint over right now!]
[Ye Qingxian: Count me in!]
[Ming Fei: I’m riding on his coattails for sure.]
[Luo Heng: Brother Jiang has already advanced into the King Saint Realm. I will definitely ride on his coattails for sure!]
[Hong Zhan: King Saint? King Saint? King Saint…Luo Heng, did you say King Saint?]
[Luo Heng: Would I be lying to you?]
[Hong Zhan: Hold on! Let me collect my thoughts a little… How long has it been since he sanctified the way of Dao and advanced into the Saint Realm? He’s now a King Saint already? Everyone, could it be that I’m dreaming?]
[Hong Yi: I feel like I’m dreaming too.]
[Tian Fo: No, we’re all caught in the illusion of the Great Demon.]
[Ming Fei: So this is how the Great Dao’s own son is treated? Recalling the past, Jiang Ming was a little brother of mine yet I can’t even see his shadow now. Brother Jiang, what about making me your foot warmer maid?]
[Feng Wu: Count me in!]
[Di Huo: I’ll be your cook.]
[Au Jiu: I’ll be your butler.]
[Hong Zhan: You’re really inhuman! I was going to wait for another 20 years before kicking start my cultivation retreat so as to directly advance into the Saint Realm. I wanted to have a good match with Brother Jiang later on, but now…No, this is no longer a lavish dream of mine, but a heaven-defying greatness that is simply impossible to be accomplished. I’m afraid that when I finally advance into the Saint Realm, Brother Jiang would’ve become a real tycoon of the Sea of Chaos already.]
[Hong Zhan: My haughty pride has been completely struck down and pierced with thousands of holes!]
[Hong Zhan: Count me in. I’m sending my soul imprint over right now!]
Jiang Ming could help his joy reading through the messages in the chat room.
Alas, Hong Zhan. He was supposed to be the son of Great Fortune. It was such a shame that he met Jiang Ming and could only serve as one of the sidelines.
Within a short time, the members of the chat room had sent over their soul imprints one after another. Even Huang Quan and the likes who didn’t communicate with others often, did the same.
This was because they all understood. Existences such as Jiang Ming who had already advanced into the King Saint Realm no longer have anything to covet from them at all.
Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record, and flipped it open. Following that, Jiang Ming incorporated all the soul imprints that he had just collected into one of the pages. The page directly turned into a chat group right the very next moment.
It was extremely similar to the group chat that Jiang Ming was once familiar with. A group chat that was able to upload small videos and other files.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - Heaven Swallowing
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Heaven Swallowing Universalization Technique, the Great Dao Group
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Hong Zhan, Hong Yi, Xu Wuji, Ao Jiu, Di Huo, Dongfang Chenxi, Ye Qingxian, Ming Fei, Feng Wu, Huang Quan, Tian Fozii, Wang Ye, and Luo Heng.
These people were the ones from the chat group, migrating into the new group named, the Great Dao Group.
The name of the group chat was given by Jiang Ming. It was also considered to be a high towering goal set for themselves.
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang Ming! You can actually send pictures here! They are so cute!]
[Ming Fei: You can even upload your own insights, cultivation techniques and the likes into the group chat to be shared around. This is really interesting.]
[Feng Wu: @Luo Heng, Hurry up and upload a hundred thousand movies so I can pass the time.]
[Hong Zhan: Alas, the capability to communicate across the Chaos. Brother Jiang, you are in fact the real son of the Great Dao. It’s now completely validated.]
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, you’re awesome! We can make up a small group in the future and support each other.]
[Jiang Ming: Mutual encouragement towards the Great Dao. Let’s all work hard together and strive to stand at the pinnacle of the Great Dao, achieve immortality and enjoy eternity!]
[Wang Ye: Together!]
[Hong Yi: Together!]
[Xu Wuji: Together!]
…
[Jiang Ming: I have a very impressive cultivation technique that can help cultivators to advance directly into the Saint Realm. It may be of some use to you all! In addition, there are also some of the techniques that I’ve deduced such as the Three Thousand Great Daos and many other special abilities. Take a look and see if they are of much use to you. They’re free to be taken.]
Upon saying so, he then uploaded the techniques such as the Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, Great Yin-Yang Technique, Great Akasha techniques of the Three Thousand Great Dao Technique, both Taiyi and Great Overarching level Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique and many more, into the chat group folders.
As for the Infinite Transcendence Technique and Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, he kept them to himself. These were his fundamental techniques which could not be shown to others just yet.
[Tian Fozi: Almighty Brother Jiang! Little Buddha is completely convicted by you, from inside out and from the body to the heart. Three Thousand Great Dao Technique and Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique merged with three thousand Laws. There’s even this Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra that merges the Physique, Mana and Soul into one. God damn!]
[Tian Fozi: If we were to cultivate these techniques, our combat power would definitely increase substantially!]
[Tian Fozi: Perhaps, we all might even have the chance to go pass all the seven Battle Towers!]
[Hong Yi: It’s not ‘might’ but definitely will! I’m sure I will definitely pass all seven Battle Towers! Alas, the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique! It will definitely bring my Holy Civilization Fist to the next level of sublimation!]
[Jiang Ming: If you are able to pass all the Battle Towers, then try to transform your soul into the Saint Soul right here.]
[Hong Yi: Transform into Saint Soul? Understood. Only, it’s just too hard. It’s so difficult that it’s almost impossible! Smile bitterly..Hold on, I seem to have a chance!]
[Hong Zhan: Of course you have the chance to! No! I can still go again with my remaining accumulated points. These might be of great use in the future. However, should I gamble, Brother Jiang?]
[Jiang Ming: Just bet on it!]
[Hong Zhan: I’m betting on it! Brother Hong, when I return, I’ll withdraw from the position as a Group Admin.]
[Hong Yi: Haha! Alright! It’s an honor to have known you guys.]
[Hong Zhan: No, you should say that it’s our honor to have known Brother Jiang. Otherwise, where would we attain such great fortune?]
[Di Huo: Brother Jiang is awesome! I’m going crazy with envy! What should I do?]
[Ao Jiu: Do I still stand a chance if I give it my all?]
[Wang Ye: It seems that we all have the chance to! Now that we have this group, how about whoever gets the position as Group Admin over the other group chat directly breaks through into the Great Overarching Realm after enjoying the heaven-defying great fortune?]
[Hong Zhan: This should not be a problem. The problem is how we’re going to accumulate points.]
[Hong Yi: Accumulating points shouldn’t be difficult. Now that we have Brother Jiang’s Grand Path Almighty Method Sutra, Return of the Infinite Laws Techniques and many more, if we still can’t get enough points from the Battle Tower or the Heavenly Ladder, then there’s nothing much that can be said already.]
[Luo Heng: Even I see hope!]
Jiang Ming watched the group chat and smiled as well. Nobody was asking to borrow points from him which showed none of them were fools.
However, the idea of taking turns to sit at the position as the Group Admin seemed to be workable. Rather, it was perfectly fine.
[Hong Yi: That’s why those with a low cultivation base and cultivation realm shouldn’t rush to improve themselves, but rather continue accumulating more and more! Now, there’s the hope to at least sanctify the Saint Realm! Brother Jiang, I’m making a statement here. Although I can’t say that I’ll see you as the leader and follow you wherever, but as long as it doesn’t go against morals, just call for me and I’ll put my life on the line for you.]
[Ao Jiu: If I were a woman, I would only marry Brother Jiang or no one else!]
[Ming Fei: Brother Jiang, what do you think of me?]
[Feng Wu: Shut it, don’t compete with me!]
They continued chatting and laughed around in the group chat.
Immediately afterwards, each group member also uploaded their countless powerful and incomparable cultivation techniques. Such a sharing session that wasn’t in the form of exchange made every member become extremely excited.
Jiang Ming was happy to see such a situation unfold itself. Walking alone on the path towards the Great Dao would be an endless solitary. With these groupmates, at least everyone could pass time when they get bored of cultivation from now on.
After a while, Jiang Ming headed towards his exclusive cultivation space. He was prepared to comprehend the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique and the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra.
He was also prepared to systematically sort himself out. With the Mana Dao being supported by his inner world, he didn’t have to worry about it at all. As for his Physique Dao and Soul Dao, he already got both cultivation techniques from the System and the future for these two seemed promising.
Jiang Ming sat himself down and emptied his mind. It didn’t take long before he managed to completely comprehend the first two cycles of the Great Dao Warrior Body Technique and began his cultivation.
The first cycle was effortless. After all, he had the foundation and his physique was incomparably strong to begin with. Coupled with the endless resources at hand, it didn’t take long for him to complete the first cultivation cycle and proceed directly to the second cultivation cycle.
The second cultivation cycle corresponded to the Saint Realm, which was of no ordinary difficulties.
Jiang Ming took out some of the Chaos Vital Essence that he kept as sustenance to temper his physique. However, the second cycle was still of great difficulty and he found it arduous to step foot into the threshold.
As a sudden thought flashed through his mind, he extracted some of the Chaotic World Tree’s sap and incorporated them into his flesh body.
*Rumble…*
Each drop of the World Tree sap turned into a rolling torrent of creation, scouring through every part of his body including his flesh, skin, muscles, tendons, bones, organs, bone marrow, hair nodes and so on.
Jiang Ming began the cultivation of the Great Dao Warrior Body technique, which further promoted the transformation and sublimation of his flesh body.
The whole process was violent and swift. Eventually, the restriction was broken through and a huge leap was made.
His physique had advanced into the next level, truly stepping into the level of the second cultivation cycle. This was equivalent to the power of a Saint, equating his body to that of a Saint Weapon, an innate supreme treasure.
His body was now ten thousand times more terrifying than it used to be. Jiang Ming didn’t stop there, but continued his cultivation process.
Treasures such as the Innate Vital Essence, Chaos Vital Essence, Xuanhuang Origin Essence, Heaven and Earth Pure Essence, Infinite Essence and the likes that he collected from slaughtering many experts were incorporated into his flesh in a single stream.
With that, there weren’t any difficulties as he reached the middle stage of the second cultivation cycle. It was at this point that Jiang Ming realized it would be extremely difficult to continue improving further.
However, he wasn’t disheartened either. This was because the cultivation of the Great Dao Warrior Body Technique allowed him to naturally deduce a type of physique special ability, the Heaven Swallowing Universalization Technique.
This was a technique of using the flesh and blood Qi’s Dao to extract the essence from spiritual items and Dao vessels to strengthen his flesh body. It was obvious that this special ability had traces of the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
He was able to deduce such an ability through similar comprehension and it came naturally into his mind.
‘How powerful can this technique be?’ As such a thought ran through his mind, Jiang Ming took out a Quasi-Sage Dao vessel. As it was hovering in front of him, he grabbed ahold of it and a strange fluctuation instantly enveloped the entire Dao vessel. In an instant, this Weapon of Dao trembled violently and a long river of essence trickled out of the Dao vessel.
In a matter of seconds, the Dao Vessel shattered into fragments right after.

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - A Hundred Times Stron
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: A Hundred Times Stronger
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Within a few seconds, a Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel was turned into ashes. Only a long river of vital essence was left, which Jiang Ming devoured. He then evoked the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique, which helped him digest the vital essence in just a moment, slightly strengthening his physique.
With his physique already at the Saint Realm, the technique was indeed viable to be able to improve his physique.
‘This method is viable!’ Jiang Ming showed his excitement on his face. Following that, he checked on the number of Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels, and he was glad that he had many of them. After all, the experts he slaughtered were either of the Quasi-Sage Realm or the Saint Realm. Hence, they had their own vault with a lot of great stuff. And this had increased his personal collection up to a terrific amount.
‘These things are really useful for me anyway.’ As Jiang Ming thought, a pile of Quas-Sage Dao Vessels appeared before him. Following that, he evoked the Heaven Swallowing Universalization Technique special ability, and began to digest and absorb all these Dao vessels in an insane manner.
At the same time, his physique was improving swiftly.
After Jiang Ming had refined 120 pieces of Quasi-Sage Weapons, his physique had reached the peak of the second mid-cycle, which was equivalent to the peak of a middle stage Saint Realm, and stopped improving further.
‘Is it because the quality of the Dao vessels doesn’t match?’ Jiang Ming stopped, pondering for a long time while deducing his current condition, and easily came out with a solution.
Since the Quasi-Sage Dao Vessels weren’t useful anymore, he changed them to Saint Weapons.
As he flipped his palm, a saber appeared. It originated from the Galaxy, his plunder when he slaughtered the 18 Supreme Experts to save Pan Wang. It was the Supreme Treasure.
Jiang Ming sandwiched the saber between his palms. As he was evoking the special ability, the saber trembled, bursting out a sharp edge that ripped apart everything, trying to escape the fate of destruction.
Jiang Ming had expected such a situation to occur, hence he remained calm and collected. He continued evoking the special ability to disturb the saber’s origin, and forcefully seized the power of creation within it.
The saber whined, but gradually quieted.
This showed how terrific the Heaven Swallowing Universalization Technique was. It not only could manipulate Dao vessels like the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, it could also refine and seize its power. It was absolutely potent.
In fact, it was the upgraded version of the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
Buzz, buzz, buzz…Jiang Ming was merging all the qi of sharpness, qi of creation, boundless power of origin, supreme Dao fluctuation and the likes into his physique to be utilized as the resources for tempering his physique.
The next moment, Jiang Ming’s physique, which had reached the utmost limit of the second mid-cycle, had eventually broken its shackles, and advanced into the second late-cycle.
Jiang Ming thought his physique would advance into the utmost limit of the second late-cycle. But it stopped just after a while.
‘A Saint Weapon only makes such a little improvement?’ Jiang Ming was rather speechless. But he thought he could understand. He was, after all, seizing the qi of creation to mold himself, improve his potential, build his foundation, temper his physique all-around. Hence, the amount he needed was naturally massive.
‘Fortunately I have more than enough Saint Weapons!’ Jiang Ming calmed himself, and paid full focus into his cultivation.
The Dragon-Headed Crutch, Violet Luminance Treasured Record, Xuanhuang Sword, and the likes, all he had refined.
On this day, he opened his eyes. The power within his body surged. Just like three trillions of atomic bombs exploding, it formed a whistling torrent that destroyed everything and raged in the exclusive space.
If Jiang Ming were to be in the Infinite Battlefield, the power he released might utterly destroy the uniquely built place in an instant. The power was too strong, after all.
‘It’s the utmost limit of the second-cycle!’ Jiang Ming smiled, followed by a helpless sigh.
He was glad by the improvement, and was surprised at the great spending as well. He had spent almost all of his Saint Weapons, and had about three pieces left.
‘Is it a loss?’ As Jiang Ming thought of it, he shook his head instantly. After all, he couldn’t evoke many pieces of Saint Weapons simultaneously. Only the power he had within himself, was the fundamental improvement.
‘I wonder if I can advance into the third cycle?’ As Jiang Ming pondered, he continued his cultivation.
He first polished and precipitated his power to the extent that he could completely control it before he began comprehending the content of the third cycle.
Time passed by quickly as the sun and moon took their turns. No, there wasn’t any sun nor moon in the exclusive space.
Jiang Ming had been cultivating for a long time, but he couldn’t advance into the third cycle regardless.
‘Now I’ve two choices, one is to continue seizing the qi of creation of King Weapons, while the second one is to absorb the power of creation from the Chaotic World Tree.’
Other than the two, Jiang Ming would have to slowly temper his physique, in addition to a lengthy cultivation, before he could see the potential to break the shackles for further advancement. Of course, it was even possible that the shackles would be there eternally, and he could no longer improve his physique.
Jiang Ming was rather hesitant. After all, he had only three pieces of King Saint Weapons, namely the Heaven Shattering Spear, Chaos Emerald Bead, and Chaos Golden Pagoda.
‘The Chaos Golden Pagoda is broken, hence I shall use it to try out!’ Jiang Ming eventually decided. He thought it would be worth it even if he had to spend all the three pieces if they would help him breakthrough. He was only afraid that he couldn’t break through even after he used up all the three pieces.
Nevertheless, since Jiang Ming had decided, he no longer was hesitating.
Jiang Ming adjusted his condition to his best self, took out a glob of the Chaotic World Tree’s Heart Resin, and swallowed it before he started melting the Chaos Golden Pagoda.
Because this supreme King Saint Weapon had been refined earlier, it didn’t resist much.
The melting speed this time was very slow. If it was counted according to the time, he had spent 1,000 years before he managed to completely digest the Chaos Golden Tower. Moreover, this was the speed of him utilizing the power of his King Soul. It was too difficult to digest a King Saint Weapon.
In this period of time, the World Tree’s resin had cleared his physique into an incomparably transparent way. The 480 million pores all over his body were spewing divine brilliance, and a dazzling divine luminance hanging. Jiang Ming looked like a supreme Saint herb as he was radiating luminance, and his power raging.
The blood flow within Jiang Ming was like a river of meteorites that traversed the endless starry sky in the big universe. The occasional heart beat could shatter the world. The power was too terrifying, after all.
The physique of Jiang Ming had reached an utmost limit, and was at the edge of transformation, and the last moment before the sublimation.
Jiang Ming evoked the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique in a berserk manner along with him digesting the power of the Chaos Golden Tower. In addition to the promotion of his King Soul, the shackles in his body, and the supreme confinement, abruptly exploded at this moment.
Boundless torrent raged out from within Jiang Ming, transformed his blood and marrow, reorganized his muscles and bones, and trembled his viscera.
His body suddenly swelled, reaching a height of 30 million feet.
It was fortunate that the exclusive cultivation space could change according to needs.
His massive body was like the demonic god in ancient times. In fact, even the demonic god was incomparable to him.
Jiang Ming’s might was still soaring at fast speed, reaching an unpredictable level. His vast aura seemed to have existed since ancient times, and his ancient charm was far older than the world. Taking a glance at his long lasting aura, and eternal Dao fluctuation, it seemed like the Chaos, the light, the future, the great Dao, the source of all, as well as the end of all.
It truly felt like Jiang Ming was the Dao, and the Dao was Jiang Ming.
The soaring aura gradually became gentle, and stopped eventually.
‘This is too strong!’ Jiang Ming returned to his true self. As he clenched his fist, he felt he could burst the entire Honggu Great Chiliocosm with a fist.
It was not delusional but an absolute confidence.
“Alas, it’s the King Saint physique! To think that I’ve advanced to this level!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but lament.

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - The Truth About the Hongmeng
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: The Truth About the Hongmeng Primordial Land, The Upgrading Requirement for a Great Chiliocosm
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
When Jiang Ming’s physique had advanced into the third early-cycle, which corresponded to the early stage of King Saint, it was extremely difficult for him to improve further.
‘Shall I continue to refine King Saint Weapons?’ As soon as Jiang Ming had such a thought, he shook his head, disapproving it.
After all, Jiang Ming had only two King Saint Weapons left. Even if he was to digest them, his physique might not have a small breakthrough. Hence, he thought he might as well let it be. The two King Saint Weapons would help him strengthen his combat power anyway.
The other method was about him continuing to absorb the Chaotic World Tree’s essence of the origin. But it was obviously not worth the loss. It was because the World Tree was too important. Both the transformation of his Saint Soul, and the improvement of his inner world needed the World Tree. In fact, relatively speaking, the Chaotic World Tree was the most important after the Human Path Record.
‘Up next…’ Jiang Ming didn’t stop his cultivation. But he turned to cultivate the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra. Because his soul was strong enough, it wasn’t difficult for him to cultivate the sutra.
Jiang Ming took only a day to achieve the first cycle, and a whole three days for the second cycle. However, it took Jiang Ming 3,000 years to cultivate the third cycle to its perfection. In fact, it was getting more and more difficult towards the end of the third cycle, and the power of his soul was insufficient too. Hence, he had to absorb numerous precious and rare herbs, innate spiritual roots, and even part of the World Tree resin again before he could achieve the perfection stage.
As a result, he had spent almost all of his collection.
‘But after the practice, the power of my King Saint Soul is 100-times stronger!’
This was the real terrifying part of practicing the sutra. Previously, the transformation was a passive one. It was not tempered, nor did Jiang Ming comprehend any great Dao. The transformation was done naturally step by step, up to the pinnacle of the King Saint Realm.
His current soul was like cotton condensing into iron. However, the size of his soul didn’t reduce but remained the same as it used to be. Besides, his soul had been strengthened to its utmost limit, at least 100-times stronger than before.
At the same time, Jiang Ming also managed to comprehend a few other supreme means of Soul Dao.
‘My physique has now achieved the third early-cycle while my soul the third perfect stage. It’d be quite difficult if I want to break through to the fourth cycle in a short time. So the next step is to evolve my inner world! But…’ Jiang Ming frowned.
His inner world had achieved the utmost limit of the middle chiliocosm, and had accumulated enough. His soul was also strong enough to support the burden it had to carry upon upgrading. However, he still couldn’t break through. To be exact, he dared not to break through because each time he wanted to forcefully evolve his inner world, he would have a strong horrified feeling.
‘I wonder why?’ Jiang Ming was confused.
‘I shall just ask around!’ When Jiang Ming made his decision, he left the exclusive cultivating space, and returned to the Chuyang Peak. Fortunately, he was capable of restraining his aura easily now. Moreover,he had also added a seal outside of his body just in case. Otherwise, if his aura was radiated out, the Tianyuan World would be destroyed in an instant. And if his aura was leaked when he was too excited while having sex with his Junior Sister, the result would be…
Jiang Ming felt chill run down his spine as he thought.
‘Alas, there’re also disadvantages to improving my cultivation too quickly!’ He was rather emotional.
In the past, he often heard a saying that dragons do not live with snakes. It was probably describing his current state. His excitement would lead to the death of another party, thereby how could they stay together?
After swaying leisurely on the reclining chair fora while, he regained the familiar feeling.
Following that, he communicated with the Great Dao Group, privately messaged Hong Zhan.
[Jiang Ming: Are you around?]
[Hong Zhan: Yes! I’m adjusting myself so that I can go cultivating in the Hongmeng Primordial land.]
[Jiang Ming: How good is that place?]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, you really didn’t go before?]
[Jiang Ming: Yes!]
[Hong Zhan: You didn’t go before, yet you could improve yourself up to this extent. It is indeed terrifying. Brother Jiang, since you know that place, and are eligible to go, I can talk to you about it. The Hongmeng Primordial Land is filled with supreme Dao fluctuations, allowing you to maintain the state of enlightenment at all times. It’s also filled with the extremely rich power of Hongmeng, which is 10,000 times purer than the power of Chaos origin.]
[Hong Zhan: With our capability, we shouldn’t be capable of absorbing that level of power. But we can actually do it there to transform our physique, and improve our bloodline so that our mana, and soul would transform as well. That’s the comprehensive transformation and sublimation, which allowed my warrior body to sublimate up to its utmost limits and advanced into another level.]
[Hong Zhan: To go there again, I’m 50% confident that my soul can transform to the state of Saint Soul.]
[Hong Zhan: If you were to go, and absorb as much as you can, my god, that fortune you’d get must be at least 1,000 times more than mine. Perhaps it’d help your inner world to grow up to the great chiliocosm.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, I’m f*cking feeling envious of you.]
[Jiang Ming: Damn it! It’s so unbelievable that the Hongmeng Primordial Land has such a level of fortune.]
[Hong Zhan: Yes, it’s indeed unbelievable. By the way, how may I help you?]
[Jiang Ming: I’ve advanced to the utmost limit of the middle chiliocosm, and with my King Saint Soul, I should be having a breakthrough to the great chiliocosm but I couldn’t. Hence, I would like to ask how I can break through to the great chiliocosm? Would you mind helping me ask around?]
[Hong Zhan: It’s so fast that you’re about to advance into the great chiliocosm? Alas, you’re indeed brother Jiang. Hold on, let me ask my great monarch.]
[Jiang Ming: Thanks!]
[Hong Zhan: I should be the one who says thanks to you instead!]
Not long later, Jiang Ming received a reply from Hong Zhan.
[Hong Zhan: I told my great monarch about your condition, guess what he thinks of you?]
[Hong Zhan: He said it’s really a miracle that I’m actually overwhelmed and convinced by you, who comes from the planar world! Even though you are taking on the path of the World Dao, you have started preparing to have a breakthrough to the great chiliocosm in 100 years of reality. Moreover, your soul has advanced into the King Saint Realm in addition to the Supreme Order as your foundation, he said that your future achievement can be comparable to his.]
[Hong Zhan: Alas, to be comparable to my great monarch!]
[Hong Zhan: This is amazing!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, perhaps you may not understand how terrific my great monarch is. He is…]
[Jiang Ming: A tycoon of the Chaos Primordial Land, the Chaos Realm!]
[Hong Zhan: What the f*ck, you actually know that.]
[Jiang Ming: Fortunately I’m protected by the Supreme Order after replacing you as the Group Admin at that time. Otherwise, I’d be killed by your people.]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, this I absolutely admit it. Speaking of which, the owner of the Supreme Pagoda…]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Jiang Ming: Stop it!]
[Hong Zhan: Stop!]
[Jiang Ming: Stop straying away from the topic, tell me quickly!]
[Hong Zhan: Sure! For the breakthrough of the World Dao, there are two critical points. First is the accumulation of resources, and the second is the soul. You’ll have to accumulate enough resources so that you’ll have enough energy to break through, and with a stronger soul, you can lead the process of breakthrough, and control yourself after the breakthrough, or it will lead to a backfire.]
[Hong Zhan: Relatively speaking, the 3,000 laws nurtured in the inner world to ensure the order of the world’s operation is not that important. Because they can be formed automatically with sufficient accumulation and slight guidance.]
[Jiang Ming: I have accumulated enough, and my soul is strong enough too. However, when I wanted tohave a breakthrough forcefully, I’d have a great sense of crisis.]
[Hong Zhan: Be patient! A great chiliocosm can accommodate numerous middle chiliocosm, small chiliocosm, planar world, etc. Even if it’s merely an initial breakthrough, its origin would be hundreds and thousands times far richer than the middle chiliocosm.]
[Hong Zhan: Even the inner world requires incomparably strong accumulation of resources. In other words, you’ll have to prepare at least 100 times more resources than the power of your inner world’s origin so that you’d have enough to support the transformation of your inner world when it undergoes evolution. Brother Jiang, have you gathered enough resources?]
[Jiang Ming: 100 times?]
[Hong Zhan: In fact, this is the lowest number!]
[Jiang Ming: What the f*ck!]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, I can finally be happy once. Brother Jiang, just wait until I’ll catch up with you soon.]
[Jiang Ming: Catch up with me? Haha, have you forgotten my abilities?]
[Hong Zhan: Your abilities? Luo Heng! Damn!]
[Jiang Ming: Hehe!]
[Hong Zhan: I can’t talk to you now, I’m depressed! Brother Jiang, you can come over to the Chaos to look for broken great chiliocosm, and even unbroken one. The path of great Dao is simply a process of seizing. Life is worthless, while the great Dao is ruthless.]
[Jiang Ming: Alas, great Dao is ruthless, ruthless indeed!]
Jiang Ming was truly feeling emotional at this stage. A hundred years was merely a short period in the mortal world. An existence like him would take countless years just for a nap, but the mortal world had been through many vicissitudes.
Life was indeed worthless for certain existence indeed. It was just like a world where massacre occurred, would still be very prosperous after a thousand years.
“Am I still considered a mortal? Yes! Of course I am! Whoever says that I’m not shall be put to death! Hng!” Jiang Ming let out a long sigh of relief.
As he was swaying on the reclining chair, he was pondering at the same time. He temporarily suppressed the urge to understand more about the Hongmeng Primordial Land.
Although Hong Zhan told him that he might be capable of having a breakthrough to great chiliocosm level if he was to go, he couldn’t make it there yet.
‘In that case, I’ll have to look for external power if I want to have a quicker breakthrough!’ Jiang Ming looked into the sky, into the starry sky, beyond the world and into the depth of the Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - Linglong Sanctified the Way of
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Linglong Sanctified the Way of Dao, Group Admin Hong Yi, Wang Ye Climbed to the Top
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming was no longer rushing after he was clear of what he had to do. Because he had spent too much time in cultivation earlier, he felt bored. Hence, he thought of taking a rest and enjoying life.
Moreover, Linglong was here.
“Senior brother, you’ve changed again.” With a leap, Linglong landed on Jiang Ming. As she felt Jiang Ming was rather different, she carefully observed Jiang Ming, and pouted. “Sir, don’t tell me you have improved again!”
“Haha, what a perfect word you used to address me. Why aren’t you quickly kneeling down to show your due respect?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but guffaw.
“Kneeling down to show my due respect? When you stand up, and I look up, it’s…” Linglong pouted. “Filthy.”
“Damn, I only asked you to show me your respect, and you’re actually thinking of this. Which is the one who’s filthy!”
“Of course it’s you because you’re the one who first initiated it. Moreover, don’t you want it?” Linglong licked her lips.
“Of course I want to!” Jiang Ming grabbed and kissed her.
For a long time, heaven and earth were divided. But there was a line of rain curtains connecting heaven and earth, and under the sun, it reflected colorful rays of light.
“Senior Brother, you truly have a breakthrough again, haven’t you?” Linglong was no longer looking shy. She wiped her lips and asked.
“Yes, I have got a breakthrough, and gone beyond the Saint Realm by accident. Alas, girl, you are too weak now. I’m wondering what to do if I’m too excited and cause you to explode?” Jiang Ming said helplessly.
“What? How dare you explode me.” Linglong stared at Jiang Ming as she said, “You wanted to look for another one, right? Go ahead! I’m not limiting you, and yet you wanted to kill me. Senior brother, how cruel you are.”
“You’re acting up, aren’t you!” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Sigh, this is the nonsense I’ve learned after ascending to the throne of the Heavenly Emperor.” Linglong laid on top of Jiang Ming as she said, “Taking over the position as the Heavenly Emperor is not interesting at all. By the way, what’s the realm after the Saint? How powerful is it?”
“For example, I can easily explode this world of ours.” Jiang Ming sensed carefully, and then speculated based on his own situation. “But because a great chiliocosm has the protection of the revolving laws, a common King Saint Expert wouldn’t simply attack! There are the three great realms, namely the Saint, King Saint, and the Lord Saint.”
“To think that there are so many realms above the Saint, when would the cultivation end? Cultivating is so boring, I don’t want to cultivate, truly don’t want to cultivate anymore. Senior brother, what can I do if I want to sanctify my way of Dao?”
“Just tell me directly!”
“Hehe! Come on, let’s have sex so that you can help me to sanctify my Dao.”
“I’m simply a tool.”
“It’s good that you understand that!”
The Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed, a special treasured bed rewarded by the system, had to bear too much. It was fortunate that it didn’t have any spirituality. Otherwise, it might be dazzled by all kinds of extremely difficult poses.
Under the time being accelerated by 10,000 times.
A year later.
“Senior brother, my physique has broken through the shackles, and advanced into the Saint Realm. I feel that I’ve become stronger,tougher, and more powerful. Don’t go, senior brother.”
Ten years later.
“Senior brother, you’re too awesome. My soul has sublimated. Is this the Saint Soul?”
“Senior brother, it’s a brand new me.”
“Quick!”
Pat…It was a deafening slap.
Jiang Ming returned to the balcony, laying on the reclining chair with his face pale as he looked at the white cloud suspended in the sky.
‘Why do I feel tired even with my King Saint physique? With my tyrannical physique, shouldn’t it be more sensitive? Why is it getting more and more numb instead? Why is her condition getting better?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t understand. He was really confused.
However, when he thought about the nine clones of his Junior Sister, he couldn’t help shivering.
“Alas, it’s difficult to be a human, and it’s even more difficult to be a man!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but sigh. He thought life was that boring.
He took out the Supreme Order. He discovered the change among the members of the chat room, that Wang Ye had become the Group Admin. This was the result which no one had ever expected.
Ten years were short but for the group members, it had undergone earth-shaking changes.
At the beginning when Hong Zhan went to the Hongmeng Primordial Land for the second time as the Group Admin, he had advanced into the Great Overarching Golden Immortal before his soul could transform. Hence, he abdicated from the position in an instant.
However, because he came over while he was still the Group Admin, the Hongmeng Primordial Land didn’t expel him. Hence, he was able to continue to take advantage of the fortune, and transform his soul into the Saint Soul. This had made him so ecstatic that he had been showing off in the Great Dao Group.
Hong Yi, who took over the position as the Group Admin, had learned the lesson of Hong Zhan. Hence, he, who was far better in comprehension than Hong Zhan, transformed his soul first after he spent 50,000 points to enter the Hongmeng Primordial Land. Following that, the sublimation of his physique, and the transformation of his mana, had led to an earth-shaking improvement.
Upon returning to the Supreme Pagoda, he passed all seven Battle Towers, stepped onto the last step of the Heavenly Ladder, and became the second core disciple after Jiang Ming.
When Hong Zhan learned about Hong Yi’s achievement, he was extremely regretful. Just because he had a breakthrough unknowingly, he didn’t manage to transform his soul into Saint Soul at the Taiyi Realm. Hence, he lost the opportunity to become the core disciple. He merely could become the inner disciple of the Supreme Pagoda.
One would need to pass either the seven Battle Towers or step on the step 63 of the Heavenly Ladder to be recognized as a named disciple; passing both would become an inner disciple while stepping on the step 64 with the Saint Soul would become a core disciple.
It was just like what Jun Sanqian had said, “It was utterly a miracle to become a core disciple in the Supreme Pagoda.
It was also from that moment, Hong Zhan almost went into depression.
After Hong Yi had obtained all the benefits, he abdicated decisively.
However, the person who managed to take over the position as the Group Admin was not Dongfang Chenxi, who was also taking on the path of World Dao, nor were Di Huo, and Ao Jiu, who had been in the Chat Room for a long time. It wasn’t even Huang Quan and Tian Fozi with strong talent but Wang Ye, who had been very low-profile.
When Wang Ye was still living in the mortal world, this peerless genius had shown infinite talent. After he had become an immortal, he joined the Immortal Supreme Chat Room earlier than Jiang Ming.
However, he rarely voiced out. Hence, many experts in the chat room even omitted his presence. Before Jiang Ming built the Great Dao Group, he merely had a mediocre record. It was because of his ordinary bloodline, common physique, and average background.
Yet, the reason why he was capable of entering the Immortal Supreme Chat Room had proved his sky-defying talent.
In fact, Jiang Ming had checked on him with the Human Path Record, and there was even a phrase describing him that he had talent which even heaven was envious of.
After Jiang Ming had built the Great Dao Group, when he managed to put his hand on various supreme techniques such as the Grand Path Almighty Sutra, Three Thousand Laws, Return of Infinite Law Finger, and the Holy Civilization Fist, his real talent had been maximized.
Fortunately, he had a tenacious temperament. He had refrained himself from having a breakthrough but remained at Heavenly Immortal Realm. It was only after he managed to integrate the various techniques into one, he reversed his physique, and became the dark horse.
His best result in the Battle Towers was that he managed to pass three towers at a time. This result was almost the same as Hong Yi’s.
At that time, all the members in the group were shocked. No one knew if he did it on purpose. After all, Hong Yi was still the Group Admin at that time. If the record of Wang Ye were to exceed that of Hong Yi, Hong Yi would be ousted.
Hence, after Hong Yi abdicated, Wang Ye was the one who climbed to the top.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - The Hongmeng Immortal Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: The Hongmeng Immortal Body
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Supreme Chat Room had returned to its former quietness. No one would show up here much as most were chatting, and talking nonsense in the Great Dao Group. It was because there were unfamiliar newcomers, who had not experienced the trading that Jiang Ming had initiated, which further enhanced the connections among the old members. Therefore, it was natural that many old members were unwilling to accept the newcomers as they hadn’t experienced many things together.
However, Hong Yi did suggest inviting the newcomers to join the Great Dao Group after they were approved by the majority. And Jiang Ming had no comment about it either.
In the Great Dao Group.
[Hong Zhan: Wang Ye should be back soon right? Why does the word ‘Ye’ sound so awkward? Guys, what about we call him little Wang from now onwards?]
[Hong Yi: Haha, I’ve no comment. Every time I call him by his name, I feel that I am at a disadvantage. Calling him fellow Daoist sounds too estranged while calling him Brother Wang doesn’t seem appropriate because this kid is too young. So it sounds more friendly to call him little Wang.]
[Di Huo: All my hands and legs are up in agreement! Alas, my position as the Group Admin has been seized away by that kid. He should be abdicating from his position upon return. I’ll be the next. And I’ll be mad at whoever is competing for the position with me!]
[Ao Jiu: It’s indeed that you should be the one to take over the position. How did I think of the succession of the mortal dynasties, the successors are usually crown princes, ahem…]
[Di Huo: Angry! You’ll be after me. Hehe, Crown Prince Ao, no, you’re my Crown Prince Di.]
[Ao Jiu: F*ck off.]
[Di Huo: Haha…Hong Zhan, I heard that you’re still regretting it.]
[Hong Zhan: F*ck off. My goodness, the great Dao was before me, yet because I was too proud of myself, no, it could be considered that I was unconsciously feeling too proud of myself that I lost the great Dao. Do you guys know how that feels? I’ve almost lost myself!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang had even reminded me of the great benefits of breaking through to the Saint Soul. Yet because of my arrogance, which was rooted in my marrow, I broke through involuntarily. What a painful regret.]
[Hong Zhan: I’m too miserable!]
[Hong Yi: Haha, I should be thanking you actually. In fact, I almost had a breakthrough, hence I sealed my cultivation base directly. Else, I won’t have the opportunity to consider whether I shall go to the Land of Master.]
[Hong Zhan: Even your cultivation base has sanctified the way of Dao?]
[Hong Yi: Yes, all my soul, physique and even my cultivation base has sanctified the Dao! With my talent, after I managed to transform my soul into the Saint Soul, isn’t it a piece of cake for me to sanctify my way of Dao when I go there again? I’m hesitating whether I shall go to the Sea of Chaos or to the Land of Master directly. I’m afraid that I can’t return after going to the Land of Master. Alas, it’s such a tough decision to make, it’s tough indeed.]
[Hong Zhan: Why do I feel that you’re showing off?]
[Hong Yi: Haha, now that you realize!]
[Hong Zhan: F*ck off. I, Hong Zhan, the peerless genius of the Chaos Primordial Land, and the first Group Admin among us, am supposed to have an infinite future. Yet, I’m first ousted by my brother Jiang, who surpassed me. Following that, I’m overwhelmed by you, Hong Yi. I’m truly unwilling to reconcile this result. Mr Hong, just come to the Chaos Primordial Land, I will treat you well, really treat you well. Don’t worry, I will never take out the Lord Saint Weapon, nor I would use the King Saint Weapon.]
Hong Zhan even sent an image while gritting his teeth.
[Hong Yi: Hehe, have you forgotten that although I am not the Group Admin, I have the privilege of being a Group Admin, and I can spend points to be invincible. Haha, even if I go to you, you can’t do anything anyway.]
[Hong Zhan: I can suppress you at least.]
[Hong Yi: I can enter the exclusive cultivation space of the Supreme Pagoda, and get brother Jiang to help me. Haha, it’s the exclusive cultivation space. Hong Zhan, do you have it? It’s such a wonderful space, truly wonderful.]
[Hong Zhan: I-I-I’m so enraged that blazing fire shot up to three trillion feet.]
[Wang Ye: Guys, I’m back!]
[Wang Ye: Mr Hong, who’s made you so angry? What about you sending us a clip to entertain us?]
[Hong Zhan: You brat is so rude. Little Wang, how’s it going?]
[Hong Yi: Little Wang, how’s it going?]
[Di Huo: Little Wang, how’s it going?]
[Wang Ye: Why are you guys calling me little Wang? There must be something that I don’t know. Hold on, let me check out the past record.]
[Wang Ye: I’m just having a single word, Ye, as my name. Do you guys have to call me little Ye?]
[Wang Ye: Anyway, I’m still the Group Admin, which is akin to a senior brother.]
[Hong Zhan: The senior brother is here.]
[Jiang Ming: The senior brother is here.]
[Hong Yi: The senior brother is here.]
[Wang Ye: Alright, it’s good to call me brother Ye, or Mr Wang.]
[Xu Wuji: I used to travel to a sci-fi planar world. There was Mr Wang, who was notorious as a womanizer.]
[Wang Ye: Womanizer? What do you mean?]
[Xu Wuji: When the neighbor is on a business trip, and leaves his wife alone at home, Mr Wang will hook up with her.]
[Wang Ye: What the f*ck! Just call me little Wang then!]
[Xu Wuji: Haha, little Wang! In fact, it’s better to call you Mr Wang because it’s an honor. It proves that you have a stronger kidney, bigger dick, and good at hooking up.]
[Wang Ye: Mr Xu, I did not think that you’d have such a character. You are not only a fake person, but also weak.]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, Mr Xu, you have been retaliated upon, haven’t you? Little Wang wouldn’t put himself at a disadvantage anyway. Let’s not talk about these, brother Wang, how’s it going?]
[Wang Ye: Completed the transformation of my Saint Soul, and comprehended peerless, Soul Dao.]
[Wang Ye: When I was there for the first time, I wanted to create a supreme constitution based on the characteristics there and my personal situation. At that time, however, I’ve only completed one-third of the progress. After the first time, I quickly lifted my cultivation base to the perfect stage of the Taiyi Golden Immortal, and at the same time, I spent a lot of time in deducing so that I could obtain the greatest benefits the next time I go.]
[Wang Ye: This time, I succeeded.]
[Wang Ye: The transformation to Saint Soul has succeeded, and built a Hongmeng Immortal Body. Although it’s far from immortal, my bloodline has utterly transformed. All I need to do is to improve it step by step.]
[Wang Ye: These are my improvements.]
[Wang Ye: I’m now confident to pass through all seven battle towers, and to the top of the Heavenly Ladder.]
[Hong Zhan: That’s amazing! Is the comprehension capability of the Human Clan that sky-defying?]
[Di Huo: Previously we said that the Human Clan is useless other than comprehension. I used to despise humans as well, but all my perceptions had been inverted after I got into the Supreme Pagoda! Hong Yi’s sky-defying talent has made me realize how terrific humans actually are. Moreover, there’s Xu Wuxi as well.]
[Di Huo: Later when brother Jiang came in, he completely changed my common sense. He not only has sky-defying understanding, and peerless talent, he even replaced Hong Zhan, the peerless genius in the Chaos Primordial Land as the Group Admin. What’s more terrifying is that brother Jiang originated from the planar world.]
[Di Huo: Alas, the planar world. I can destroy it with just a blow.]
[Di Huo: Now here comes another Wang Ye. He has an ordinary background, resources, and means. Yet, he is capable of joining the Supreme Chat Room. This reminded me of that phrase, ‘A roc will has its moment to soar up high one day.’]
[Di Huo: With the help of the Great Dao Group brother Jiang has built, Wang Ye hit the jackpot and rose to the occasion. Maximizing his talent, he actually built a Hongmeng Immortal Body with his common physique. This is so unbelievable.]
[Di Huo: Relatively speaking, even Hong Yi and Hong Zhan are lacking behind, only brother Jiang can still overwhelm Wang Ye.]
[Di Huo: Brother Jiang, Hong Yi, Wang Ye, Lu Heng, Ye Qingxian, Xu Wuji, and even Dongfang Chenxi, lookat how many members of the Human Clan we have here. Moreover, three of them used to be the Group Leader.]
[Di Huo: What the f*ck!]
[Di Huo: Are the members of the Human Clan this heaven-defying?]
[Hong Zhan: Alas! There’s a saying that the Human Clan is good at creating miracles, and I’ve finally understood it! There’s even a publicly recognized saying in the Chaos Primordial Land that the Human Clan is truly the largest clan in the infinite realm. It’s undebatable, and it’s even the largest faction in the Chaos Primordial Land. Throughout the ages, even if there have been twists and turns, the Human Clan has not been shaken, and is also known as the darling of the Chaos.]
[Hong Zhan: Now that I have witnessed the capability of you three including brother Jiang, I’d be surprised if the Human Clan is not the largest faction.]
[Hong Zhan: I can predict that in the near future, when all three of them got to the Chaos Primordial Land, they would definitely induce an uproar. Even the situation in the Chaos Primordial Land, which had remained the same for hundreds of millions of years, would be changed. No, I think it definitely will be changed.]
[Wang Ye: I have a feeling of pride! Haha, let’s not mention these. I’m planning to challenge the Battle Towers and climb the Heavenly Ladder. Would you like to be my guest?]
[Hong Zhan: Yes!]
[Hong Yi: Yes!]
[Jiang Ming: Let’s go together!]
As Jiang Ming said so, the members of the group expressed their intention to join as well one after another. Thereby, this was considered a gathering.
Jiang Ming lamented as he was swaying the reclining chair on the balcony. If he wasn’t around, it was possible that Hong Zhan could go to the Hongmeng Primordial Land, and it would be difficult for Hong Yi, and Wang Ye to do so, what’s more the other members.
But it turned out that quite many had gone.
‘I wonder if I’d enrage the owner of the Supreme Pagoda with the change that I’ve induced?’ As soon as JIang Ming had such a thought, he suppressed it. Following that, he entered the Supreme Pagoda with a thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - Cutting up and Eating Jiang Ming
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Cutting up and Eating Jiang Ming
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming went into the Supreme Pagoda. The other members arrived one after another as well.
“Brother Jiang Ming!” A crisp voice with incomparable cheerfulness could be heard. Dongfang Chenxi flew over the moment she saw him. She wanted to jump into his arms but eventually refrained herself to only pulling his arms and swaying them slightly. Her bright eyes that were filled with joy were glued on him.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian walked over as well as she cupped her hands to greet him.
“How have these years been?” Jiang Ming said to Chen Xi, but looked at Ye Qingxian instead.
“It’s great, I’m preparing for my advancement to the Middle Chiliocosm.” Dongfang Chenxi said happily, “Awesome, isn’t it!”
“Awesome indeed, do you need help?” Jiang Ming said.
“No, if I really can’t break through, I’ll ask Brother Jiang Ming for help again.”
“Haha! Alright then!” Jiang Ming was inexplicably happy.
Ye Qingxian merely gave a soft smile. Compared to the beginning both she and Dongfang Chenxi had changed drastically.
It was especially the case for Chenxi. After the last near-death calamity, she had become very mature. She spent her time usually cultivating. However, when she arrived here, she unconsciously showed her side as a joyful young girl.
Ye Qingxian wasn’t bad either. She was regarded as a supreme goddess of the generation. It was just that she was born in quite a bad family background, or rather, extremely worse compared to Wang Ye. However, she still managed to forcibly make her way into the Supreme Chat Room, which showed her unparalleled talents.
Upon joining the Great Dao Group, her cultivation grew even more.
With Jiang Ming intentionally giving her guidance, coupled with Wang Ye selflessly sharing his deduction of the Reverse Immortalization Technique which gave her a supreme Daoist body and also the various supreme physical techniques, all of which were eye-opening to Ye Qingxian as she began to frantically absorb the accumulation, breaking free from her cocoon into a butterfly, waiting to become a phoenix one day.
With her having even modest demure compared to Wang Ye, she would surely amaze everyone in the future.
“Brother Jiang!” Hong Zhan was stout and his physique looked angular with the muscles. He was cladded in a dark golden robe which looked modestly luxurious and was naturally emanating a noble aura from the core of his bones, indescribably giving people a sense of nobility.
“The sight of you makes my fists itch.” He clenched his fist and gave off a proactive hint as if he was going to strike any moment. In the end, he merely let out a bitter laugh, “I’m afraid this wish of mine will never come true anymore.”
“True!” Hong Yi walked over as well, “Brother Jiang’s achievements really makes me envious and jealous. After seeing him, I really wanted to put him on the chopping block and dissect him apart to see what makes him tick.”
“I’d prefer to put him on a barbecue.” Di Huo smiled as he looked at him with the vertical pupils in his eyes. His whole body was in bright red clothing and even his hair was burning with flames, “I even dreamed that if I were to devour Brother Jiang, would I be able to put my hands onto his aptitude? It’s a shame that this wish can never be fulfilled.”
“What I want most is to fuse myself with him!” A golden skeleton walked over as well.
Although he was a skeleton, he did not give off a dark, frightening, vicious and gloomy feeling, but instead was emanating a feeling of holiness. This was none other than Huang Quan.
It was surprisingly bizarre to be able to see the smile from his skeletal face as he continued, “To eat your flesh and blood, absorb your soul and fuse your bones into my body. Gah! I will be able to perfectly copy everything he has. My domination of the great chiliocosm will just be around the corners. However, it is unfortunate that these dreams are dreams after all.”
“Haha! There’s only one Brother Jiang. In such moments at work, he’s already divided among all of you, leaving nothing left!” Au Jiu was laughing out loud as soon as he appeared.
His body was even sturdier, with two blood colored dragon horns growing on top of his head. As a mutated blood dragon, he was very unique back in his world.
He was considered a senior of the Supreme Chat Room already.
“Brother Jiang, does a little girl like me pique your interest?” Feng Wu who was cladded in a white gown, wearing a pair of black silk socks. As she spun around, a sweet fragrance was diffused into the air. The corners of her mouth held a seductive smile, “I’m not asking for the main position, just the position as a consort will do.”
“I’ll take the main position then!” Ming Fei flirted as well.
“Amitabha!” Tian Fozi muttered the Buddhist hymn and continued, “Congratulations to Brother Jiang for reaching a beautiful achievement in life! By the way, where is Wang Ye, why hasn’t he come yet? He should be punished.”
“A penalty of three thousand cups of wine!” Luo Heng also came over as well.
He took out and placed a huge round table, filled with countless dishes.
“As for the wine? I won’t be making a fool of myself on this. I hope the dishes are alright!”
Luo Heng was never ambiguous when it came to food.
“How can three thousand cups be enough? It should be thirty million cups.” Jiang Ming smiled, waved his hand and it opened up a chiliocosm.
Within a stone’s throw distance, the space around them suddenly expanded. There weren’t any changes seen from the outside, yet its inside was incomparably vast. They could even clearly see the outside world.
“Leave the wine to me. I didn’t care much about this stuff before but I’ve killed quite a number of peerless cultivators and accumulated as much!” Jiang Ming explained as he waved his hand. Numerous bottles, jars and gourd reeds could be seen floating mid-air.
All these wine storage vessels were emitting supreme Dao rhythm. Each of them was at least a Great Overarching Dao vessel.
The fragrance of wine emitted into the surrounding was somewhat smoky to Ye Qingxian and a few with lower cultivation base. However, the feeling of vitality in her body suddenly flourished, as though the spirit had undergone baptism.
“These are all the Wines drank by Saints right? “As Hong Yi opened a bottle, the smell of the wine shot up into the sky. The bottle mouth actually evolved a vision of bringing bowed to buy hundreds and thousands of worship.” Great Wine! Brother Jiang. Just this one bottle of wine was worth as much as an ordinary Quasi-Sage Dao Vessel. In fact, what’s your current cultivation realm, Brother Jiang?”
“Sorry for being late!” Wang Ye walked in, just in time to hear Hong Yi’s doubts, and also asked, “Brother Jiang, tell us won’t you?”
The others all looked over curiously.
“Hold on. Let me calm my mind and suppress my heart first. I don’t want to lose my Heart of Dao from shock!” Hong Zhan was no longer prideful and indifferent but instead, suppressed himself with both hands.
The crowd could not help but smile. However, all their burning eyes were glued at Jiang Ming.
“I’m afraid I’ll scare you guys if I tell you!” Jiang Ming said, “My physique is at the early stage of the King Saint, my soul is at the extreme stage of King Saint whereas my inner world is at the limit of the Middle Chiliocosm. That’s all. I haven’t had much breakthrough recently and am quite bothered by it.”
“Is this even the words of a human?” With both his arms behind his back, Xu Wuji had a middle-aged look with two wisps of hair dangling down from his temple as he couldn’t help but roll his eyes as well.
“You’re inhuman! How is this the word of a human?” Ao Jiu grinded his teeth.
“My Heart of Dao almost collapsed!” Di Huo spat out a mouthful of flame. “The body of a King Saint, soul at the extreme stage of the King Saint and your inner world is almost at the great chiliocosm realm already. Holy cow! It’s just too unbelievable!”
“It seems to be as it should.” Hong Zhan sighed, “When placed in the Chao Primordial Land, he would be able to appropriately suppress a whole domain and be considered a tycoon already with that strength of his. Brother Jiang, your cultivation realm is already at such a degree, yet you still say there hasn’t been much breakthrough and is bothered by it? I, I, If I were stronger than you, I would’ve beaten you up for sure.”
“I’d like to as well!” Luo Heng nodded.
This was more than a shock. Even the soul was about to be shocked out of their bodies.
“Brother Jiang Ming is the best!” Dongfang Chenxi had only adoration for him.
“Brother Jiang is awesome!” Ye Qingxian marveled.
“He’s more than awesome. With his physique being of the King Saint, a drop of his blood now can forge up an absolute supreme body already.” Hong Zhan exclaimed and then laughed out loud, “Why don’t we divide him up among us. A mouthful of his blood is comparable to the supreme immortal medicines already. Just one mouthful would be a great tonic!”
The crowd couldn’t help but burst into laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - The Existence of a Higher Cultivation Realm than the King Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: The Existence of a Higher Cultivation Realm than the King Saint
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The crowd gathered, ate, drank, and talked about the cultivation of Dao. However, most of the attention was on Jiang Ming.
After all, he was the strongest, the most demonic, and the most generous among them. It could be said that all these people owed him a favor as well.
After a meal, those of similar cultivation level as Ye Qingxian, all received immeasurable gains from the discussions.
In the end, Wang Ye went off to break through the levels.All seven Battle Towers were barged through.
It took him half a month to complete level 64 of the Heavenly Ladder. He was shaking and looked as pale as a ghost, as if he would die anytime but managed to finally pull through.
“Congratulations to Brother Hong!” Everyone congratulated him.
“Yet another core disciple!” Hong Zhan lamented, “I’m only one step short, one step, just one step short. It’s not yet unreachable, but, but… such a short step is akin to the difference between heaven and earth.”
“Don’t worry, I will be covering you from now on!” Jiang Ming patted his shoulder.
“And me!” Hong Yi laughed.
“And me!” Wang Ye laughed as well.
Hong Zhan’s expression turned even uglier.
After chatting for a while more, each of them went off and promised to gather again next time.
…
Gazing from the balcony on Chuyang Peak, the sun was setting over the mountains, painting the rivers and hills bright red for miles and miles.
Jiang Ming rocked his lounge chair, admiring the beauty of the sunset and was at peace.
His eyebrow suddenly twitched.
“Little Ming!” A call could be heard from afar. There wasn’t any reverence to it but a natural and casual call of his name. Apart from Gu Hai, there was absolutely no one that would refer to him like that.
“Old man, you’re back.” Jiang Ming didn’t get up either. He merely took a glance and pointed to the side, explaining, “You old man. Your cultivation is improving way too slow. You’re only at the perfect stage of Taiyi Realm. You’re bringing shame to your disciple!”
“Taiyi Realm is still poor?” Gu Hai sat down and his voice plucked up a few notches. “I’ve been at the Taiyi Realm ever since we got here a few decades ago. It’s already unbelievable and has broken the iron law of the ages, yet you’re still saying that my cultivation is poor.”
“You’d be gone with just a breath of mine!” Jiang Ming gave him some attitude.
“Try blowing, why don’t you?” Gu Hai blew on his beard and glared at him.
“I’ll exterminate whoever dares to blow at you!” Jiang Ming hastily grunted, followed by a smile on his face as he continued, “Old man. How about I give you a tailor-made cultivation package, so that you can reach the Demi-Sage Realm straight away without even cultivating?”
“Directly reach the Demi-Sage?” Gu Hai was dumbfounded and said in a shock, “Little Ming, let’s not boast about it. You’re at most in the Demi-Sage Realm yourself, right?”
Jiang Ming rolled his eyes and replied, “You really don’t care enough about your own disciple. I’m your oldest disciple, the head disciple of Chuyang Peak. Just look at you. You don’t even know the situation of your own disciples. It’d be embarrassing to say it out loud!”
“You brat! To think that you’re blaming me about this. If I’m stronger than you, I’d beat you up every day and force you to practice your cultivation for sure!” Gu Hai suddenly smiled and rocked the recliner as well. “Little Ming. Tell me. What are your achievements so far?”
“I’m not telling. I fear your Heart of Dao might collapse from this!”
“Heart of Dao collapsing? Hump! My disciple suppressed the immortals and demons, everyone bowed in his presence and is the pinnacle of all. My disciple is sitting on the Throne of the Heavenly Emperor. where countless of my sect’s disciples are going forth to serve the Heavenly Emperor, overlooking the infinite realms. What else could even make my Heart of Dao collapse? The most you can do is reach the Saint Realm, which isn’t a big surprise.”
“In that case, I’ll tell you a little about it?”
“Stop being so long-winded, spill it!”
“Master, listen carefully. Ahem…Let me count and see, how many Saints have I beheaded again?”
“Wait… hold on! What did you just say? Killed Saints? And you’re trying to count? Did I fall deaf?”
“You’re not deaf! I’ve killed a lot of Saints. Well, maybe not a lot, but just forty or so of them. There’s even a Dao Patriarch who was a Perfect Stage Saints among them. By the way, there’s also a remnant soul that surpassed the Saint Realm.”
*Whoosh!*
Gu Hai jumped up. He stared at Jiang Ming with both his eyes almost popping out of their sockets.
“Are you serious, kid?” His voice was trembling.
“One of the disciples is the one and only of the realm whereas the other is sitting on the Throne of the Heavenly Emperor, with the disciples of the sect overlooking the entire infinite realm. Master, how can there still be big surprises? Calm down! Haha! Calm down!”
*Slap…* Gu Hai gave him a slap.
Jiang Ming stared at the heavens, a little lost in thought. To think that he was slapped! And he couldn’t even fight back. This…This was so frustrating! However, he could only take it in.
“You killed forty over Saints and even a soul remnant that had surpassed the Saints?” Gu Hai wanted to give him another slap as he asked rhetorically. He muttered in his heart, ‘If this kid unknowingly reacted and slapped me back. Wouldn’t that mean I’m done for? I can’t hit him any more from now on. The child has grown. He can even take down the Saints already. This is really exciting. Just ask around the infinite realm! Who dares to slap on the back of a Saints head and the Saint couldn’t retaliate! Haha! I’m the only one who can!’
Seeing Jiang Ming nodding his head, he came straight over and said, “Little Ming, you’ve surpassed the Saints? There is even a realm above the Saint? Could it be the realm of the Dao Patriarch? That’s not right either, you have killed a Dao Monarch already.”
“There are King Saints and Saint Lords above Saint. I am now a King Saint and will be a Saint Lord in the future. That’s why, as the master of a King Saint, you old man is only at the Taiyi Realm. Isn’t this a disgrace to the disciple?” Jiang Ming explained briefly.
“King Saints that transcend the Saints?” Gu Hai was dumbfounded
Luckily, he had long been numbed by Jiang Ming’s surprises and managed to quickly calm down. Only his mind was a little dizzy.
“Hmm!” Jiang Ming said, “Maybe in ten or so years’ time, I’ll slaughter a few King Saints for fun!”
Gu Hai raised his palm, wanting to give Jiang Ming another slap, and said, ‘Would you die if you stop bragging?’
But on second thought, this disciple of his was too monstrous. Rather than killing a King Saint, his disciple could even kill the Lord Saint. It was a possibility.
“You’re much more amazing than I am!” Gu Hai sat back down and swayed the lounge chair again. He suddenly became excited and exclaimed, “No! You’re not as amazing as I am! I’ve taught and nurtured a King Saint! What about you? You didn’t, right? Haha! I’m still the amazing one!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless and continued to ask, “How come you old man not smothering with First Seat Ming Yue now?”
“It’s because Linglong is currently sitting on the Throne of the Heavenly Emperor and the disciples of our sect have also gone off to serve her. Now that our territory has become bigger, the sect is thinking of expanding and is trying to ask you for your suggestions!” Gu Hai explained in a serious tone. “You don’t have to give me any thoughts, just explain according to your own thoughts. Linglong is also of peaceful nature. If the sect continues to expand and completely take over the seats over at the Heaven Court, it’s a supreme glory for the sect but a disaster rather than a blessing for the whole human race.”
“The Heaven Court should be above all; and the sects under it.” Jiang Ming frowned slightly. “Both the Heaven Court and the Sect will have to come up with an environment that is fair and yet has the means to allow the disciples of my sect to improve themselves. Under the heavenly law, the disciple of the clan will also be treated equally.”
“It’s great!” Gu Hai couldn’t help but smile. “The stronger the sect becomes, and some of them can no longer stand down, starting to turn arrogant. However, they didn’t think back about the situation that we were facing dozens of years ago where the World was shattered and the dynasty wasn’t safe.
