If it weren’t for you, all of us would’ve digressed back as yellow dirt already. After experiencing the suffering, one should learn to be grateful and also to see how complicated the mortal realm is. Now that they’ve enjoyed the perks, they are still thinking of being the word of law. It’s just that there are some things that’s just inconvenient for us to say. That’s why the Sect Master sent me over to borrow your words to set the iron law and see who dares to disobey them!”
“The Sect Master is full of trickeries up his sleeves. However it’s quite good overall.” Jiang Ming laughed.
After pondering for a little, he took out some materials and casually made a puppet. He then took a drop of his master’s blood and incorporated it into the puppet, saying. “Master, this puppet has the combat power of a Demi-Sage. If you are in any danger, it can even be merged with you. I’ve also left an imprint in its core. The puppet will see you as his master. You can discuss with the Sect Master and see if he should be given a position as a great law enforcer or anything else.
“To be able to refine a Demi-Sage level puppet casually like that?” the corner of Gu Hai’s mouth was twitching.
It was really twitching..
‘God damn! So this is how terrifying a person that surpasses the Saints can become? This is more than awesome, it’s Impressive.’
However, he was still lacking compared to Gu Hai himself. This was good. Very good.
“Alright, I’ll head on over to find that old Sect Master to discuss this thoroughly and iron out a set of iron rules of heavens!
“Master, the iron laws couldn’t go against the ethics of nature!” Jiang Ming reminded him.
“Do you think I’m an old fossil?” Gu Hai replied.
Jiang Ming gave him a smile. It couldn’t be any better to see that his master was happy as well.
‘That old man is still living a more spontaneous life. That is of course not without my credit!’ Jiang Ming laughed again and again.
Alas, human life. Was there anything more fulfilling than making your elders happy?
Suddenly a slight thought rant through his heart.
He stood up and made a quick meal. After eating, he left directly and descended back into the Galaxy!

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - The Hundred-Year Period
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: The Hundred-Year Period
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This was outside a wrecked chiliocosm. It was also the second one found.
The first one was found 10 years ago. At that time, Jiang Ming directly descended from the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed. After discussing with Pan Wang, he allowed the Chaotic World Tree to devour the destroyed chiliocosm.
Back then, Pan Wang was extremely astonished when he saw the tree. It was especially the supreme power that was contained within the World Tree, which rendered Pan Wang dumbfounded and felt that he stood no chance against it.
This was the second wrecked chiliocosm they discovered. As soon as Jiang Ming arrived, he kept his avatar and started examining it.
The universe that should be vibrant, had become all withered, filled with endless aura of decaying and death. If a Great Overarching Golden Immortal were to step foot into it, he wouldn’t even last a quarter of an hour before getting eroded to death by the overwhelming aura of decaying and death.
The universe’s membrane was full of holes. Some of the places even had huge fissures directly torn nearly a light-years size. If it weren’t for the residual power of the universe still resisting and keeping it together, this dead universe would’ve completely collapsed.
“As the universe dies, all the sentient beings perish!” Pan Wang sighed.
There was even the feeling of being on the same boat as that universe.
This universe had fallen. What about their own universe? Wouldn’t there be a day like this too? As the universe marched towards its extinction, how many living beings could even survive inside? Not even one in a billion would be able to. Other than a small number of Cosmic and Supreme Experts, the rest would have to return into the Chaos.
With countless sentient perishing, it also produced the extremely terrifying aura of death, resentment, and curses. Even such a powerful person as Pan Wang dare not provoke these aura.
“What is the meaning behind the existence of life?” Hong Ying had a confused look on her face. “The world is born and all spirits are conceived, yet it will eventually perish and pave towards its destruction. Could it be that it is only for the transcendence of a few existences? What about the meaning of the birth of the world?”
Pan Wang could not answer.
Neither could Jiang Ming.
Some questions were ultimately destined to have no answers.
“Brother Jiang, let’s begin!” Pan Wang finally spoke.
As Jiang Ming nodded his head, he took out the World Tree and it began to expand rapidly. This time however, it did not create a great storm as it did back at Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm. As it expanded, it naturally devoured all the qi of Chaos.
The wind was calm. There weren’t even a single ripple. The entire immensely huge dilapidated universe was surrounded by the tree. Such a scene still shocked Pan Wang.
To think that a whole great chiliocosm was encompassed by a tree. The vastness of the scene and the grandeur of the waves was mind-blowing.
“Seeing this again still makes me feel unbelievable.” Hong Ying marveled, “Brother Jiang, just how powerful have you become? Is this really the power of a King Saint?”
The only thing Jiang Ming could do was to nod his head, as he had already given the same answer a long time ago.
“Unbelievable!” Hong Ying whispered.
“When you get to this point, you will naturally feel that this is normal.” Jiang Ming laughed.
“This point? Can I even do so?” Hong Ying doubted herself.
“If he says you can, you definitely can!” Pan Wang laughed, “At this point in life, his word is his bond.”
Hong Ying’s eyes suddenly gleamed as she walked over to Jiang Ming’s side. She naturally tried to hold Jiang Ming’s arm but was blocked out, making her quite sultry.
Jiang Ming pretended to have not seen it instead.
Didn’t he want to? He did. It’s just that when he remembered his junior sister tossing him around near death, he was about to lose a certain interest already. He almost completely lost interest.
Perhaps…Would there be a change with something fresh? Would he be re-energized? Would this once again reignite the masculinity of him being a man?
As these thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind, he completely suppressed such ideas.
Watching the wrecked universe being wrapped and swallowed by the World Tree in front of them, such a grandeur scene was still too shocking.
The aura of death, grievance, fury, calamity, destruction and the likes that were inside that universe might all be poisonous to the Saints. However, these were instead endless sustenance to the World’s Tree.
It was true that everything in the world was food.
However, the time required to devour a whole universe was naturally not something that can be completed overnight.
“Brother Pan, I will give you help after this. However, I don’t know if it’s enough for your breakthrough!” Jiang Ming’s heart suddenly fluttered and announced so.
“Thanks a lot, Brother Jiang!” Pan Wang was overjoyed.
During the last devouring of a universe, he had obtained a lot of fragments of the Law of Origin. After absorbing and digesting them, although they managed to enhance his accumulation, the chances of him breaking through still felt rather slim.
Now that he heard Jiang Ming saying that he was going to help him out, he was happy for sure.
After Jiang Ming left an avatar in his place, he returned to Chuyang Peak again.
Watching the flowers bloom and fall, the clouds rolling in and out, eating the delicacies throughout the heavens and the earth, and playing…
There was really nothing much to say about such daily routines.
He occasionally remembered many incidents of his previous life, chasing and striving throughout his life, to lose spirits and suffering with grievances with no one to tell but himself. He couldn’t help but lament the days.
This current world was still the better one.
Days and months went by. Time continued flowing endlessly.
Tianyuan World remained as peaceful as always.
There were constantly people breaking through everywhere. There were quite a number of Great Overarching Experts already., and there were even countless Taiyi Experts.
Looking through the entire Tianyuan Sea, it was even more lively than before and filled with Great Overarching Experts.
This was a supreme era for the current human race.
Meanwhile, the other races went into hibernation.
Back in Jiuyang Main hall, Gu Hai could be seen wandering into the place.
There were several First Seats there. They liked to gather there when they weren’t cultivating, and take out a few small mirrors to peep throughout the world. When they spot a beautiful lady, they would quietly give their opinions. ‘This lady seems to be of the norm. Look at her, her chest is low and her hip seems small and skinny. There isn’t much to marvel about. She’s not worth peeking at, not worth at all. If she wore a little less, then there might still be something worthy to look at.’
Wear lesser clothing? The other few nodded in agreement.
Gu Hai who suddenly came in, couldn’t help but grimace, ‘You old bangers! You’re all too unashamed! If word gets out about this, people would think that our Jiuyang Sacred Land is a devil’s cave instead!”
“It’s just too peaceful!” First Seat of Laoyang picked up a gourd and took a sip. “Huh, Mr Gu! You’ve changed a lot. By just taking a look at you, my primal spirit is surprisingly trembling. Could it be that you’ve broken through again?”
The others all looked over at them as well.
“Haha! That’s for sure!” Gu Hai stroked his beard as his eyebrows danced. “I accidentally broke through again a few days ago, directly stepping into the Quasi-Sage Realm. Haha! Alas, the Quasi Sage Realm! I can now suppress all of you with just one hand.”
“Why are you being so smug? It’s just because the two of your disciples are secretly helping you. Otherwise, with your natural aptitude, you might still be pacing around the Taiyi Realm instead.” First Seat of Lieyang Peak said sourly.
“I have two great disciples. Of course I’m smug about it! If you have the guts, you can also nurture a disciple into a Saint as well.” Gu Hai tilted his chin and said proudly.
The First Seat of Lieyang Peak was rendered speechless.
‘Nurture a disciple into the Saint Realm? Isn’t this pulling on people’s legs? Bollocks! What a pile of bollocks!’
Yet another day of Gu Hai’s deceitfulness began in the main hall.
Back in Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was muttering to himself.
“I’m one hundred and seventeen years old now! To think that I’m over a hundred years old already. Does that make me an old person? Perhaps, it does. Haha! Who would have thought I would live to be more than a hundred years old. Ugh, I can’t believe I’m getting happy about this. The System has been running for 99 years now. One year short of the 100-year period. Alas! A single year to go. Who knows what kind of astonishing event that will occur? What’s more, I wonder what changes will come to the System?”
Jiang Ming was both excitedly expectant and apprehensive at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - Devouring Six Great Universes in a Row
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Devouring Six Great Universes in a Row
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming didn’t change much over the past years. He comprehended several supreme special abilities, devoured several great universes, and his inner world had been an accumulation of tens of thousands of light years.
As for the rest? Oh yes! His physique had advanced into the Middle-Stage of the King Saint Realm. But he still thought that it was too darn slow.
His Saint Soul was still at the pinnacle of the King Saint Realm, yet to step into the Lord Saint Realm.
Ugh… Seriously…Such improvement was way too slow to him. He couldn’t adapt to such a slow pace.
*Senior brother, what are you lamenting about again?” Linglong paced towards him in the air and landed directly on him, swaying his body. “Was it that you didn’t have enough fun from the last 100,000 years? My Time Clone had already sanctified the path of Dao. I’ll ask her to accelerate the flow of time by ten million folds and let’s have a close up mighty battle?”
“Get the hell out of here!”
“Hehe…”
“You still dare to laugh! You’re looking for a beating!”
“Beat me up then! No, it’s me who’s beating you up.” Linglong laughed playfully, “Under your nourishment, all ten of us have sanctified the path of Dao already. Senior brother, I’m thinking of retiring from the position as the Heavenly Emperor. It’s just so meaningless.”
“Is there a good candidate for it?” Jiang Ming asked.
“How about the Senior Brother Chang?”
“Him? He’s alright. His cultivation is a little lacking though. He’s currently only at the perfect stage of the Great Overarching Realm.”
“True, a little lacking still. What if we let our Master have a go at it?”
“That old man will certainly be unwilling. He’s now living leisurely, dashing around with his high and edgeless status. He wouldn’t find himself in more trouble.”
“Well, let’s give it to Senior Brother Chang then!”
“Alright. You can arrange it. With the Heavenly God of Law Enforcement in charge and us watching behind the scene, no one will dare to cause trouble anyways.”
With such a brief exchange of words, the next Heavenly Emperor was decided just like that.
If this was known to Yu Fei, there was no telling if she would hit her head on the wall.
“Senior brother.”
“Yes?”
“I heard that Yu Fei had opened up a Drunken Flower Yin on the Tianyuan Sea, specializing in entertaining the peerless Immortals of all walks of life.”
“There’s such a thing?”
“Of course. She used her own special ability to nurture the Immortal ladies of various races and she’s absolutely good at it. They know how to play musical instruments, sing and toss around in beds. Her business is booming!”
“There’s no bed tossing and whatnot, just the musical instruments and singing. Don’t slander the innocence of others.”
“Senior brother, I thought you said you didn’t know about it?”
“Did I say that?” Jiang Ming had a bewildered look on his face, “No I didn’t. I definitely didn’t.”
Linglong puffed up her cheeks and continued, “If you want to go, go ahead. I can easily see through that little devil’s mind. Her yearn for you is still blazing. You should go and have a taste as well. Go ahead! I don’t mind anyways. The worst would be to roast you a few more times with Sacred Flame to purify and cleanse you. That is all.”
Jiang Ming looked up into the sky, speechless. ‘Who did I mess with this time?’
Between the flickers of his eyes, he gazed through into the Chaos. The universe that was heading towards them was already very close.
The Chaotic storm set off by it even caused the World’s fetal membrane to tremble slightly. It’d just take a few more years before it completely arrives.
Right this very moment, there was a sudden hunch in his heart. With a flash of flame in his eyes, he disappeared out of thin air.
“With the Senior Brother disappearing and reappearing suddenly like a ghost, I wonder what he’s been up to all this time.” Linglong mumbled to herself.
However, she understood that it was because of him disappearing and reappearing from time to time that allowed her senior brother to improve so rapidly.
…
Back in the Xinghe Galaxy, they discovered yet another destroyed universe under Pan Wang’s lead. This was the sixth universe they discovered. However, compared to the previous five, this one was relatively intact. It even retained its complete form and that the universe’s fetal membrane had very little damage.
The cycle of Stars could still be seen within. At first glance, this universe was generally the same as an intact universe, just that the aura of death within was immensely dense, the aura of fury was alarming, the aura of grievance permeated every corner of the universe and covered with the terminal aura of calamity.
“This should be the previous Universe.” Pan Wang’s tone of voice was solemn.
The next universe would be the great universe he came from.
“Isn’t there any solution to this?” Pan Wang was somewhat reluctant to accept this.
To him, the Xinghe Galaxy was his home, his roots, his motherland. He naturally didn’t want to see his universe destroyed. Even if his physique had already advanced into the King Saint Realm now, he still felt powerless.
When Jiang Ming devoured the second Great Universe, Jiang Ming gave a single drop of the Word Tree’s Resin of Origin. At the same time, Jiang Ming broke down the structure of his own physique that was of the King Saint Realm, allowing Pan Wang to finally break free from the shackles.
“There might be!” Jiang Ming replied, “It’s to keep breaking through. Once you surpass the King Saint realm, there must be a solution to it. Or rather, travel to the Valley of the End in search of the answer. I feel that the root cause of this special situation on your side of the universe lies there.”
“Surpass King Saint?” Pan Wang smiled bitterly, “That’s just way too difficult. So difficult that I don’t see any hope for it. As for the Valley of the End? Let’s hope that the answer’s there. Wait, something’s not right. There’s quite a number of peerless experts over this universe. Could it be that they are trying to besiege us?”
“They must be!” Jiang Ming had already noticed them when he first descended to the place.
He wasn’t surprised at all. Back when he devoured the third destroyed universe, he was attacked by the Supremes.
The opponent said that for Jiang Ming and the likes, devouring their universe was akin to destroying their last thoughts. This was an irreconcilable feud.
Jiang Ming didn’t know if that really was the reason.
However, the enemies looked at his Chaotic World Tree greedily. As such, there was nothing much that could be said already. They were blown up by a punch from Pan Wang, who had just got a breakthrough.
As for the fourth and fifth universe, they were all attacked by Supremes from the Sea of Chaos. They were all very powerful. Some of them had even reached the later stages of the Supreme and were extremely terrifying.
However, what these Supremes ran into, were even more terrifying existences.
Jiang Ming didn’t even have to make a move at all, as they were beaten and killed by Pan Wang, leaving none behind.
Pan Wang said there were only enemies or strangers in the Sea of Chaos. As long as there was a certainty to kill each other, the experts would not hesitate to strike and plunder the other person’s great encounters. However, there wasn’t much death when it came to the battle between the Supremes because they would all have Supreme Treasures and life-saving triumph cards up their sleeves.
“Let me count and see. Good lord, there are 36 of them! That’s too much!” Even Pan Wang was very surprised.
“Is that a lot? I don’t think so!” Jiang Ming muttered. “In the past, how many universes had been destroyed and how many Supremes would have entered the Chaos? The number should be astronomical.”
Pan Wang shook his head solemnly. “According to my investigation, most of the Supremes would have experienced nine cosmic epochs at most. By then, the great limits would’ve arrived and they would die along with the destruction of the ninth great universe. This is a cycle of reincarnation but also a curse. Coupled with slaughtering each other, the Supremes that are within the Chaos are not as many as you’d imagined it to be. Moreover, they would be scattered everywhere around. For so many of them to be gathered at once is already very remarkable.”
“This might be intentionally directed at us, or many of them are greedy for the World Tree.” Jiang Ming replied, “When they saw the World tree, perhaps they thought that this would be the chance for them to transcend.”
“Alas! Transcending!” Pan Wang muttered in a complicated feeling, “Even I myself would go on a frenzy if I heard of it, let alone the rest of them. We have been devouring the universe all this time and our purpose is clear. It’s obvious that they would be able to set up an ambush in advance. It’s just a pity that they don’t know what kind of opponent they are facing. It would all be for naught.”
“Killing seems to be an eternal topic.” Hong Ying lamented, “Within the universe, it would be the feud for interest first, and then the war between races, resulting in endless killing and struggles. When it comes to the universe outside, what’s fought for would be their own life, for transcendence and also for the unwilling heart.”
Pan Wang was silent.
Jiang Ming was quiet as well.
The Supremes that were hidden and preparing for their ambush had evoked a supreme great formation array that enveloped the three of them in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - The Alliance of the Supreme
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: The Alliance of the Supreme
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Every Supreme Realm Expert had lived for hundreds of millions of years. Not to mention that these were the old monsters of the last great cosmic epoch, some had even gone past six or seven cosmic epochs already. Both their accumulation and insight had already reached a terrifying level.
The comprehended special abilities were far beyond the imagination of the ordinary experts. What’s more, there were thirty-six of them taking planned actions.
Once they were to take their move, it would surely be horrendously terrifying, a situation where death was guaranteed.
Right there and then, a huge formation, which was cast at Jiang Ming, Pan Wang, and Hong Ying, made even Pan Wang feel trepidation. “There’re a total of nine Supreme Sacred Formations that are connected together and mutually propelling among themselves, forming an incomparably terrifying killing formation. Once they are completely evoked, I’m afraid I may not break out in a short time. They are aiming to have us dead.”
If he had faced such a situation before his breakthrough, he would have died without a doubt.
In the midst of the great formation, there were even a total of 36 pieces of the Supreme Treasures empowering the array, allowing its might to reach an unprecedented level.
“Forming time and space itself, imprisoning all orders and sealing off every power of Law, this formation disables the people trapped within it from mobilizing the energy from the outside world. A Supreme Expert indeed can’t do anything to resist the power of this formation.” Jiang Ming nodded, agreeing with Pan Wang’s remark earlier.
The void twisted as the great formation’s divine might pervaded. Everything around the place changed drastically to the point that even the order itself was rebuilt and formed into a single entity.
In front of them, dozens of experts emerged. It was apparent that they still had some questions to ask Pan Wang.
“Pan Wang, who exactly is this person beside you? Why does he have the treasured tree that nurtures three thousand Daos? Could it be that this is the legendary Tree that can give birth to another universe, the World Tree?” A white-haired old man inquired.
He looked very ordinary, except for his pair of golden cold eyes that were very intimidating.
“Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern!” Pan Wang hissed. “What does it matter to you whether it is or not? Aren’t all of you plotting to seize this treasured tree? How can you not know anything about it?”
“It’s because we don’t know, we’re asking now.” Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern was not angry at all as he continued, “Now that we have already set up this great formation, you are all cats in the bag. If you cooperate well, we might still spare your lives.”
“Can you even make the call?” Jiang Ming smiled and asked rhetorically.
“Of course I can!” The Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern turned to Jiang Ming. “Fellow Daoist, can you elaborate more on this? There aren’t any deep grudges between us and I’m sure that you have already guessed the reason for us besieging you. It’s all for the name of transcendence. If it wasn’t for us noticing the glimmer of chance for transcendence from the World’s Tree, why would we even trouble you?”
“You’re indeed a straightforward person!” Jiang Ming said, “Where did you hear of the World Tree?”
“The Valley of the End!”
“Care to tell us more about it?”
“Sure.”
Without any hesitation, the Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern told of what he knew.
Three great cosmic epochs ago, he went into the Valley of the End and was swept into a corridor. In that corridor, there were a series of murals where it depicted a seed at the beginning of the murals.
The Seed was planted within a certain universe and absorbed the universe’s nutrients to sprout and grow. When the universe was destroyed, it then began to devour Chaos.
“The last mural was of the entire Chaos disappearing into thin air, replaced by that tree. This tree had its leaves as stars and branches as the star rivers. On top of its crown was a portal which was connected to somewhere. Its roots were firmly rooted between the darkness. At the end of the mural, there was three Dao wording engraved: “The World Tree”
Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern slowly recounted the past.
“When I heard that a fellow Daoist, who is following Pan Wang around, has been taking out a Treasured Tree to devour a destroyed universe, I recalled this incident. Fellow Daoist, what you have in your hand is the World Tree, right? You’re letting it devour the destroyed universes for it to grow.”
“Alas, the World Tree. There’s nothing it can’t devour! Destroyed Universes are filled with a boundless aura of calamity, grievance, fury, and death. Even if experts such as ourselves were to enter the destroyed universe, we would be infected and will eventually die within it. However, the world tree can actually devour them as its sustenance! How incredible is that? This also means that its essence is beyond the realm of the Supreme. Beyond the realm of the Supreme is akin to transcendence.”
“Fellow Daoist, what say you take out the World Tree and we’ll help it grow together? It has to devour universes right? I know of some locations of destroyed universes. We can even help it to devour the universes’ origin as well.”
The Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern’s eyes were blazing in enthusiasm.
The origin of the universe meant the current Xinghe Galaxy. When Pan Wang heard the Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern’s remarks, he was furious and couldn’t help but become nervous.
If Jiang Ming was to agree with the Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern and devour his universe, he wouldn’t be able to stop it even if he wanted to.
“Your idea is very good indeed. It’s unfortunate that I have a few good friends back in the origin of the universe.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Seeing that you’ve been steadfast, I’ll give you a chance. Leave and you’ll still keep the life of yours, free to enjoy the freedom through the infinite times. Otherwise, this place shall be your tomb.”
“Haha!” The Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern guffawed. “I don’t care if you aren’t willing to submit to us because you’re a Supreme yourself as well. However, you’re still thinking of killing us in return? That’s too arrogant, my fellow Daoist. With you being besieged by 36 of us Supreme Experts, coupled with several great formations, who among the Sea of Chaos could even stand against us? There’s no one!”
“Am I not an existence that transcends the Supreme?” Jiang Ming was amused.
“If you’ve transcended the Supreme, why would you still stay in the Sea of Chaos? This place is akin to a cage, a confinement. If there’s a possibility of transcendence, I would risk everything to break through into the outside world and roam around outside, let alone after successfully transcending.” Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern shook his head and continued, “Fellow Daoist, do you really plan on making pointless resistance?”
“Well, I have the World Tree. Why couldn’t I transcend?” Jiang Ming continued, “I am able to devour a whole universe. If I do not have the power to transcend, how would I be able to do so?”
Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern’s heart suddenly felt clenched as his expression changed slightly. In the end, he shook his head and said, “It’s still that same thing that I’ve mentioned earlier. If you have really transcended, why would you still be struggling within the cage? So be it. Since you’re willing to die for it, I’ll fulfill you then!”
“Hold on!” Jiang Ming interrupted and stopped him.
“Could it be that you’ve thought it through?” Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern was quite pleased.
In fact, Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern wasn’t certain if Jiang Ming had actually transcended the Supreme. All would be well if he hadn’t. However, in the chance in a million that he did, they would be in great trouble. Yet, he still thought that with so many fellow Daoists with him, they should be able to take Jiang ming down even if Jiang Ming had transcended.
Jiang Ming shook his head and said, “Actually, there’s something that I really don’t understand. You are all the most powerful Supremes of different universes throughout the epochs, the most talented genius throughout billions and billions of years from respective universes. Each universe has their own unique cultivation system. With your universe destroyed, you are all wandering through the Sea of Chaos. Hasn’t it crossed your mind to gather yourselves and completely reveal your cultivation techniques to others, so that you can all confer with each other and deduce the path towards transcendence together?”
“There’s so many Supremes within the Sea of Chaos. If everyone were to be organized, I won’t believe that you wouldn’t be able to deduce the path beyond the Supreme! Yet, why didn’t you guys try?”
Jiang Ming asked strangely.
One man might fall short, but when united, we would stand.
Three ordinary Supremes when banded together, would be better than a single Supreme Expert.
Although every one of these Supremes was of the most talented genius of their universe or epoch, each of them would ultimately have their own preferences. Once the wisdom of all the Supremes were gathered, just thinking about it brought chill down Jiang Ming’s spine.

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - Swallowed Whole
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Swallowed Whole
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Supremes making an alliance to deduce the future path of cultivation?
Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern couldn’t help but smile bitterly when he heard of Jiang Ming’s suggestion.
How could they not do such a thing before?
When they did it the first time, everyone ended up intriguing against each other, unwilling to put their true inheritance onto the table. In the end, this small group that had just been formed, disbanded.
The second time they did so was during the ending of the ninth great cosmic epoch. The most ancient remnant of the Supremes formed an alliance and were the first to reveal their cultivation techniques, collecting the ancient secret techniques and abilities. Everything was revealed to the public, which then attracted a large number of Supremes.
Together, they comprehended the past, deduced the future and sought to peer into the path beyond the Supreme Realm. In the end, they managed progress by half a step forward. Right when they thought success was just around the corners, one of the Supremes who combined the strength of the crowd, deduced a terrifying technique that was capable of devouring the origin of other Supremes into his own body as sustenance.
From this, he saw the hope of transcending. He thought if he swallowed every Supreme around him, he would definitely be able to break through the shackles, force through the fetters and set foot onto the higher realms.
He started to hunt furtively.
He killed three Supremes consecutively, yet other Supremes thought that these Supremes had merely gone to other parts of the Sea of Chaos for a break and didn’t keep their disappearance in mind.
However, when this killer killed the fourth Supreme, he was discovered by Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern and a fierce battle inevitably broke out. Although they managed to kill that Supreme, the other Supremes were no longer that united.
For the third time the Supremes gathered, they all made a vow not to hide their cultivation technique and at the same time not to lay hands on each other during the deduction of the future cultivation path.
Everyone had great hopes this time around as they placed great effort to the cause.
However, there were three Supremes who became bored and went around loitering in the Sea of Chaos. The three of them discovered a lone female Supreme Expert. Since they already had conflicts among them prior to this, they struck out to suppress each other after a brief exchange of words.
As if that wasn’t all, one of the Supreme Experts actually had the intention of hitting on the female Supreme Expert. As a result, the female Supreme Expert blew herself up. A few Supreme Experts from the previous universe rushed over and discovered the whole ordeal. Raging with fury, they began to retaliate.
Initially, the alliance didn’t give much attention to the Supremes of the Previous Universe. After all, their accumulations were very undermining.
Never would they have thought that there was a terrifying existence from the Previous Universe. As this expert had been cultivating in the Origin of the Universe all the while, none of the experts in the Sea of Chaos knew about him.
This expert, who was known as the White Carnage, forced his way through and went down a path of blood bath. He forcibly slaughtered his way through the alliance. Although he himself was killed in the end, it led to the collapse of the alliance and everything was for naught.
As Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern was reminiscing about the past, he became gloomy. “I suspect that Chaos’s will is intentionally targeting us. Otherwise, how would all three alliances end in failure?”
Jiang Ming also felt that it was iniquitous when heard the stories.
Alas, the alliance of the Supremes. They even prepared precautions but still failed all three tries.
“When the previous Universe was coming to an end, a few Supremes of the most ancient times charged into the universe in despair. They wanted to try and seek for the silver chance of life within. Universes were initially born into the world and perished at the end. They thought that there might be a great encounter between the edges of birth and death of a universe. This wasn’t just their speculation, but the speculation of every one of us. However, as soon as they rushed in, they were wiped out by a sudden appearance of a terrifying power.”
When Golden Lantern Immortal Venerate talked about this part of the story, fear could be seen in his eyes as he continued, “That power was extremely peerless. It was so powerful that the several Supremes of the pinnacle couldn’t resist one bit and died miserably there and then.”
He watched the whole scene unravel with his own eyes. It was also then that he fell into complete despair.
“Later, a group of Supreme Experts who were in despair, managed to forcibly charge into the Valley of the End. Forty-two of them went in yet only six of them came out at the end. The rest were all dead.” Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern’s face was filled with bitterness. “Fellow Daoist, having experienced so much, what do you think we would do if we come across the legendary World Tree, which could potentially contain the opportunity of transcendence?”
“To plunder it at all cost!” Jiang Ming replied.
Even Pan Wang nodded in agreement.
Anyone of different origin also had the same answer.
“It’s good that you can understand.” Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern said, “We ask for you to bring out the World’s Tree and together we will help it grow so that we can attain enlightenment and transcendence together.”
“I understand you, but I do not sympathize.” Jiang Ming suddenly smirked. “In fact, the emergence of you all is a great meal to me as well. All of you are Supreme Experts, who top your respective universes. As such, your hands must have also been stained with endless bloodshed. I have no qualms killing you all.”
“You’re thinking of killing us?” The Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern sneered. “To use us as sustenance for the growth of the World Tree? Alas, fellow Daoist! You’re thinking too highly of yourself! Such good words and yet it’s still too hard to persuade you. You are really courting death! Whatever! Now that we’ve already come to this point, there’s no longer any need to ramble more. Ten Thousand Calamity Formation, Ultimate Calamity Qi, descend!”
With a wave of his hand, he evoked the Sacred Formation directly. A black lightning could be seen appearing high in the sky, descending towards the top of Jiang Ming’s head in a flash.
“This is the power of Calamity that’s been collected from the destruction of many universes. It’s extremely terrifying. Coupled with the support of a great formation, who among the Supremes can even stand against this?” Just when Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern’s words fell, he saw a scene that completely horrified him.
Jiang Ming could be seen raising his head as he opened his mouth and swallowed the descending black lightning.
“Mere trickery!” Jiang Ming was still munching on the electricity.
“You, you, you…” As if the Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern had seen a ghost, his eyes almost popped out of his socket from shock. “You’ve broken through?”
“Of course!” Jiang Ming admitted, “It isn’t just me. Pan Wang has also broken through as well. It’s a shame that all of you have lost your chance to live. I no longer have the need to keep you all around either!”
*Clatter…*
The World Tree could be seen rushing out on top of Jiang Ming’s head. Its luminance of creation rose into the sky as its endless divine luminance showered the surroundings. The aura that it was naturally emanating propped up the many Sacred Formations. However, without even waiting for them to burst, all of these formations were swept off by a green luminance, suppressing every one of them.
All thirty-six Supremes didn’t even manage to struggle as they were all hung on the branches of the World Tree.
“What kind of power is this?” The Immortal Venerate Golden Lantern was extremely horrified. “Even if you’ve transcended, you shouldn’t be so strong that we can’t even resist at all!”
“You mean its power? It should be the transcendence beyond transcendence I think?” Jiang Ming merely gave such an explanation before evoking the World Tree to expand rapidly to envelope the universe in front of him.
The transcendence beyond transcendence? The Lord Saint?
Jiang Ming felt that the current power of the World Tree was now at least at the peak of the Lord Saint. It might even be beyond the Lord Saint Realm.
As the master, he could feel the horror of the power that was contained within this tree. It even made him tremble with fear. He even used to wonder what if the World Tree was sapiential and turned against him? Fortunately however, he had the support of the Human Path Record.
In just a few moments, the immense universe was swallowed whole by the World Tree.
In fact, it wasn’t swallowed. Rather, it was taken in by the World Tree into its self-evolving space of origin to be digested then.
It looked like the World Tree was keeping items into its storage. However, it was a universe this time around. The universe was so huge and contained such immense power. Yet, it was taken in just like that.
This was also the ability that was deduced by the World Tree as it continued growing and evolving.
“Pang Wang, Hong Ying, I’ll be returning to my place for a while. After this ordeal, I have a feeling that I’m going to make further breakthrough!” Jiang Ming looked at the two of them. “I’ll come back later on to help you two break through the shackles!”

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - Had a Berserk Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Had a Berserk Breakthrough
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
When Pan Wang and Hong Ying were looking at the disappearance of the great universe before them in the Sea of Chaos, they were rendered speechless for a long time.
“Alas, there were 36 Supreme Experts, who were fully prepared, and the few peerless Sacred Formation couldn’t even exert their full potential when they were all being suppressed. Even the universe is swallowed easily just like that. How powerful is this force?” Pan Wang was still in great shock. Even he had known that Jiang Ming was powerful, and that the World Tree was horrifying, but that scene earlier still amazed him.
“Yet he’s about to have a breakthrough!” Hong Ying shook her head as she smiled wryly. “This is truly unbelievable!”
“Yes, it’s indeed unbelievable!” Pan Wang exclaimed. Following that, he asked, “Hong Ying, other than you, who else is he good with?”
“Luo Heng.” Hong Ying said as she pondered. “He first came just to give a helping hand to Luo Heng.”
“Luo Heng?”
“Yes, a kid, very weak, not even up to the Star Sea. No, he’s far behind.”
“How…” Pan Wang was startled. However, he knew what he had to do. He would have to help Luo Heng grow with his best upon return to the galaxy.
Pan Wang and Hong Ying returned based on the route they came without stopping.
…
In the exclusive cultivation space in the Supreme Pagoda. The time in it didn’t move a bit when compared to the external world.
Jiang Ming was sitting cross-legged, unmoved.
Meanwhile in his inner world, the World Tree was rapidly digesting the swallowed great universe, the 36 Supreme Experts, and their Supreme Treasured to be utilized as sustenance for its own growth. At the same time, some sustenance was showered on the inner world.
This was the plan of Jiang Ming: utilizing the growth of the World Tree to promote the evolution of his inner world.
Therefore, he let the World Tree swallow six great universes consecutively, killed dozens of Supreme Experts to get numerous Saint Weapons. All of which he gave to the World Tree.
It was a shortcut.
As for energy crystals and the like, he merged them into his inner world to further enrich its base.
Jiang Ming had his consciousness dived into the World Tree to comprehend the process of the World Tree digesting the great universe, growing, and forming 3,000 Daos. More was to nurture his own Saint Soul along with the improvement of the World Tree.
Along with the digestion process of the World Tree, rays of creation were showered onto Jiang Ming’s inner world, which improved the origin power, promoted change and evolution of the inner world. There were also boundless divine lights which transformed into the light and rain, nourishing every part of the land.
Meanwhile, the World Tree was transforming, swiftly. Usually, it had been rooting on the endless void, absorbing boundless power. In the Xinghe Galaxy, it even swallowed universes. This was extremely terrifying.
Its accumulation had long reached its utmost limits. Hence, it finally had broken the shackles now.
Buzz…
The World Tree slightly trembled, and Creations that were beyond imagination, emitted out from within the deepest origin, and the core by abruptly breaking the shackles. This led to the sudden surge in the essence of the World Tree.
The origin strengthened, and the power increased exponentially. The core of the World Tree in particular, had produced a Chaos Space. Yes, it was Chaos Space. It was not the planar world, the small chiliocosm, middle chiliocosm, nor a great chiliocosm. It was a small Chaos that had been produced directly.
The Saint Soul of Jiang Ming which had been merged in it, was greatly nourished at this moment along with the improvement of the World Tree.
Jiang Ming was also rapidly evoking the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra.
The power of his soul had finally reached the utmost limit.
As mountains collapsed, and shackles broken, his Saint Soul had been extremely sublimated in an instant. His King Saint Soul had finally broken its fetters, and advanced into the Saint Soul of the Lord Saint leveled. It was akin to the Lord Saint Soul, or the Lord Soul.
Such was a terrific improvement. The sublimation of the essence, and the transformation of the origin. The power had skyrocketed.
Meanwhile, the inner world was trembling vigorously. The space which had long expanded to its utmost limit, began to expand in all directions abruptly at this moment. Such an expansion was extremely intense and swift.
The origin of the inner world too was experiencing an intense change.
It was the process of leveling up to the great chiliocosm.
After a very long time, Jiang Ming opened his eyes.
‘Both have actually broken through!’ Jiang Ming was very surprised. He was only expecting that his Saint Soul would advance into the Lord Saint Soul. Yet, to his surprise, his inner world took advantage of the situation, and broke the fetters as well.
The great chiliocosm leveled inner world of Jiang Ming meant that the origin of the inner world was at least of the King Saint leveled, hence capable of nurturing Saints.
‘Is the origin of a great chiliocosm only equivalent to the level of the King Saint?’ Jiang Ming wasn’t assured.
From where he came from, a great chiliocosm could only nurture seven Saints at most. However, in the galaxy where Luo Heng was from, could nurture a great number of Supreme Experts. It was obviously abnormal.
‘Maybe I can ask Hong Zhan, or Jun Sanqian when I manage to see him again in the future.’ Jiang Ming pondered.
It was at this time that Jiang Ming was finally considered to be a King leveled expert.
Although Jiang Ming’s Dao of Laws had just advanced to the Quasi-Sage level, he was capable of mobilizing the power of the King Saint level. In addition, with his middle stage King Saint Physique, and Lord Saint Soul, he was truly a tycoon even in the entire Sea of Chaos.
‘As long as I still can’t advance into the Chaos Realm, I’m not considered to be an expert yet.’ Jiang Ming didn’t become highly conceited. He knew he was still far lacking.
‘But how am I supposed to improve myself from now on?’ Jiang Ming had the urge to scratch his head.
If Jiang Ming wanted to quickly improve his Physique, he had to refine King Saint Weapons. But he had no idea where to get these Dao vessels for they were very precious even in the Chaos Primordial Land.
As for the continuous improvement of his inner world, it was troublesome too. Jiang Ming had to refine the origin of other worlds. But the World Tree needed also a great amount of sustenance to grow.
As for his Lord Saint Soul, he was not worried because he knew he could take advantage of the World Tree’s growth.
‘Let’s just stop here temporarily!’ Jiang Ming suppressed his thoughts of improving further.
With a thought, he returned to the Chuyang Peak. He laid on the lounge chair, gazing into heaven. All the Quasi-Sage laws of the Honggu Great Chiliocosm manifested one after another. As such, the great chiliocosm was no longer secretive to Jiang Ming.
With his Lord King Soul, he could destroy the world. In fact, he had comprehended more than half of the Quasi-Sage Laws. Now with the breakthrough of his Saint Soul, it had become easier for him to comprehend those laws, as easy as drinking water. Hence, it didn’t take him long before he comprehended all 3,000 Quasi-Sage Laws.
Even the great chiliocosm was a process of continuous improvement.
‘Here’s…’ Jiang Ming frowned.
He had discovered the difference. The power of the Honggu Great Chiliocosm’s origin seemed to have exceeded the utmost limit of King Saint level as a whole. But it seemed to have a layer of confinement that limited the great chiliocosm to a certain level.
‘This is interesting!’ As Jiang Ming pondered, his figure swiftly disappeared.
After an hour only, Jiang Ming reappeared.
‘All are the same!’
He had just descended to the Xuanhuang Great Chiliocosm, and then went to the Tiancang Great Chiliocosm, and found out that both the great chiliocosms were having the similar issue.
Both had similar amounts of origin, and the same shackles of heaven and earth. It was obvious that the two great chilicosms could evolve further, but they seemed to be blocked by a layer of diaphragm.
‘Is this the self-restraint of the world itself or?’ Jiang Ming pondered for an answer but to no avail.
‘Even at this stage, I still can’t see through the wonders of heaven and earth, and I don’t even dare to go to the Chaos Primordial Land! The Supreme Pagoda is even more mysterious. Am I too useless?’
Jiang Ming had almost fallen into the loop of self-doubts. Shooting his head to suppress his thoughts, he called up the Human Path Records.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - The Attack from the Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: The Attack from the Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the Great Dao Group.
[Jiang Ming: Brother Hong, are you around?]
[Hong Zhan: Yes. I’m so bored. It’s been getting difficult to improve my cultivation base. Brother Jiang, what can I do?]
[Jiang Ming: How dare you complain that it’s been slow? Would you believe that other members of the group would beat you up?]
[Hong Yi: Beat you up.]
[Di Huo: I, as the Group Admin, agree that Hong Zhan be beaten up.]
[Ao Jiu: The next Group Admin agrees that Hong Zhan be beaten up. By the way, Mr Hong, what’s your current cultivation base? Can it be the King Saint? Hehe, you rent brother Jiang, hence you definitely haven’t achieved it yet.]
[Hong Zhan: I’ve a long spear of the King Saint, which I can initiate an attack towards you even though you are from the other Chaos. Beware of your safety.]
[Ao Jiu: What the f*ck. You won’t be so cruel, will you?]
[Jiang Ming: Don’t worry, he’s just scaring you. A King Saint level can’t do that.]
[Ao Jiu: That’s good, good indeed. I’m so scared that my heart is beating fast. Mr Hong, what a bully you are.]
[Hong Zhan: Just wanted to bully you. If you can, just bully me back. Haha!]
[Ao Jiu: Rolling my eyes! By the way, Mr Hong, what’s your cultivation base now?]
[Hong Zhan: With the help of my great monarch, my physique, cultivation base, and my soul has advanced into the middle stage of the Saint, later stage of the Saint, and the perfect stage of the Saint respectively. These achievements, however, are just passable!]
[Ao Jiu: Damn it!]
[Di Huo: Just passable! Why am I having the urge to beat you up.]
[Tian Fozi: Amitabha, count me in.]
[Wang Ye: And me.]
[Hong Yi: When I get to the Chaos Primordial land, I’d like to fight against brother Hong, and try to beat him up.]
[Hong Zhan: Mr Hong, just you? I think I’ll rub you against the ground.]
[Hong Yi: We’ll see by that time! Let’s just make it clear that we must not rely on any external forces such as the King Saint Weapon, and the likes!]
[Hong Zhan: Sure! I’m lacking a good opponent anyway. Mr Hong, come here quickly. I’ll take you on a tour around the Chaos Primordial Land. I’m almost bored to death staying here alone.]
[Hong Yi: Sure, just wait for me! After we all have met, let’s go to the Land of Master together to witness for ourselves what it’s like.]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, sure!]
[Wang Ye: Count me in!]
[Di Huo: I’ll try to fight for it!]
[Ao Jiu: I seemed to have hope for it!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’ll definitely have hope for it.]
[Ye Qingxian: Working towards it.]
[Luo Heng: For the same of us all sanctifying the great Dao, fight.]
[Ming Fei: Is there still hope?]
[Feng Wu: Alas, it seems sheer, sobs.]
[Tian Fozi: Ahem, sad. Alright, working my best.]
[Xu Wuji: Bemoaning.]
[Huang Quan: I will move mountains.]
[Jiang Ming: When there’s a will, there’s a way. Press on!]
[Hong Zhan: Press on! Brother Jiang, what’s your cultivation base now? Don’t tell me that you have a breakthrough again?]
[Di Huo: Let me guess, the great chiliocosm? It can’t be that fast right? Alas the great chiliocosm, that’s a great fetter, isn’t it?]
[Hong Zhan: It’s not only a great fetter, it’s like finding a needle in a haystack. For example, for the middle chiliocosm to advance into the great chiliocosm is akin to a Heavenly Immortal Expert advancing into the Saint Realm directly.]
[Di Huo: So difficult? Brother Jiang, you must not tell me that you’ve succeeded. If you can succeed in this, oh my, you’re not even a human.]
[Hong Zhan: Impossible! I’ve never doubted that brother Jiang cannot break through but not this time around. His accumulation period is too short, after all. It’s not right though. If he hasn’t had his breakthrough, he wouldn’t show up here, would he? For sure he wanted to show off to make us look like a wimp.]
[Ye Qingxian: Reasonable! Brother Jiang can’t be understood with common sense. Have you had a breakthrough?]
[Luo Heng: I’ve prepared to be shocked. Both my hands are on my heart. No worries, it definitely won’t jump out.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang Ming, do tell us quickly so that we can be happy for you.]
[Wang Ye: Looking forward.]
[Hong Yi: Brother Jiang, tell us quickly so that I’ll be more motivated to cultivate.]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Jiang Ming: Mr Hong, Mr Di, both of you have been looking down on me too much.]
[Jiang Ming: My inner world has just evolved into the level of great chiliocosm.]
[Jiang Ming: My physique is at the middle stage of King Saint.]
[Jiang Ming: My Soul has broken through to the Lord Saint Realm.]
[Jiang Ming: Just passable.]
[Jiang Ming: And so-so.]
The group had gone quiet. For a long time no one sent any messages.
[Hong Zhan: My heart burst.]
[Di Huo: My fourth leg grew out.]
[Luo Heng: My heart forcefully jumped its way out.]
[Ao Jiu: I have a compulsion to do something, which I can barely hold back.]
[Hong Zhan: Me too. But what can we do? Just bear with it!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, I think we aren’t from the same Chaos. You’re too ingenius, aren’t you? Not only has your inner world had a breakthrough, your soul has actually advanced into the Lord Saint Realm.]
[Hong Zhan: The Lord Saint is the strongest combat power known in the Chaos Primordial Land. Whoever was to come forth and stomp his feet, the Chaos Primordial Land would tremble three times. The Clan Master of my Hong Clan is merely of the Lord Saint Realm. Of course, excluding my great monarch!]
[Wang Ye: This guy, Mr Hong, can’t show off himself, and started to show off his clan.]
[Hong Yi: Hong Zhan: Don’t just look at the me who can’t but my awesome great monarch!]
[Hong Zhan: All of you can only be envious. By the way, brother Jiang, you won’t be here just to show off, will you?]
[Jiang Ming: I want to ask you whether the great chiliocosms in the Chaos are limited by certain confinement?]
[Hong Zhan: I heard my great monarch talking about it before. The great chiliocosms in the Chaos are influenced by the Chaos Primordial Land, and limited by the Chaos Laws to have only seven Saints.]
[Hong Zhan: If there weren’t any of these limitations, the origin of a great chiliocosm, which is akin to its overall power, should be able to reach up to the utmost limit of the Lord Saint. As such, the lowest number of Saints it can nurture would be at least 81, and it should be able to carry life of the King Saint level.]
[Hong Zhan: However, even my great monarch has little understanding about the secret behind it.]
[Hong Zhan: He said that the Chaos is very big, and it’s also very small.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, if you aren’t of the Chaos Realm yet, thinking about these would only increase your troubles.]
[Hong Zhan: It’s not right. Based on the speed of you improving your strength, can it be that you will advance into the Chaos Realm in 100 years…Damn.]
[Hong Yi: It is not a possibility, but a great possibility.]
[Wang Ye: Deducing from the time for brother Jiang to improve his strength, it’s not a possibility, but a certainty.]
[Di Huo: Does it say that we will have someone extremely strong to rely on soon?]
[Ao Jiu: He is now extremely strong already.]
[Feng Wu: Brother Jiang, can I hug you?]
[Ming Fei: I’d like to register first.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Shameless.]
Jiang Ming smiled. He had also obtained the answer which was not exactly the answer. However, the galaxy over at Luo Heng side, had become more peculiar. Hence, he thought of taking time to explore the Valley of the End.
Jiang Ming rose to his feet, and while he was cooking, he chatted with the members of the group.
It was indeed a comfortable day.
As Jiang Ming was having his meal, he raised his head and sneered. ‘I haven’t gone looking for your trouble yet, you came here first. Are you planning to check out the situation here in advance? Anyway, it’s time to deal with you all now!’
After cleaning up the dishes, Jiang Ming got into the Chaos with just a step forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - Lying Flat Already
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Lying Flat Already
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Chaos was considered to be the forbidden land to experts below the Quasi-Sage Realm.
The mere air current of the Chaos would’ve been too much for a Great Overarching Golden Immortal to bear. Of course, bearing it for a short duration would still be alright.
However, a slight breeze of the wind of Chaos would roll up into a wild torrent that could tear through a Great Overarching Golden Immortal in a heartbeat.
Even those that had reached the Quasi-Sage Realm would find it dangerous to be here. Just look at the number of Quasi-Sages that were buried in the Chaos. The number was countless.
An endless chaotic storm had been setting off at the edge of Honggu Great Chiliocosm. As they were deflected by the world’s fetal membrane, the recoil formed a variety of storm vortexes.
This kind of vortex was the most dangerous of all. Once trapped within, it would be too difficult to break free from it.
In a land not too far away, there was a great chiliocosm that was rolling its way over. The fact that such a huge chiliocosm that contained such enormous power within was being propelled forward through the Chaos was simply unbelievable.
Wherever the chiliocosm passed, everything in its path was crushed. On its opposite side, there were actually Saints who were evoking thirty-six treasured beads, forming a vast curtain of water that propelled the chiliocosm forward.
Instead of the seven Saint Lords that Jiang Ming saw the other day, there were two dozen of them behind the curtain of water. They were all evoking their techniques, driving the treasured beads to push the entire chiliocosm forward.
Right this very moment, two of the Saint Lords suddenly walked out and turned into a stream of light. It tore through the Chaotic air current and swiftly moved forward.
They were a red-robed old man and a white-robed youth.
“I’m so exhausted!” The red-robed old man complained telepathically. “If it weren’t for these Saint Lords rushing over to give us a hand, all seven of us would’ve been exhausted to death.”
“Yeah! Who knew that pushing a chiliocosm would expend such a terrifying amount of power? Mr Hong, even I’m almost dead of exhaustion, much less yourself. It was still alright at first, but the pushing became heavier and slower as time went on. This is especially when we encounter Chaos vortexes, infinite storms, forbidden fire domains, extreme cold ice fogs and so on. It almost trapped all of us.”
“You said it! I almost wanted to escape into the depth of Chaos, going against that person’s will. It’s fortunate that the thirty-six treasured beads, coupled with those seventeen Saint Lords descended at the critical moments. Do you think they are from the Sea of Chaos? Or are they from the other suppressed great chiliocosms?”
“It’s hard to say! They kept their mouths shut about their origin as soon as they arrived. However, seeing the serious look on their faces, I’m afraid they are not from the norm. Let’s not talk about them already. Our future wouldn’t be better ourselves. To push our own chiliocosm and find other chiliocosm to be fused with. It just feels like this is just pulling on our legs however you look at it. I just hope that our lives won’t be pulled into the mess at the end.”
“His remarks were great. The colliosion between chiliocosm would perpetuate the fate of our near-ending chiliocosm and also strengthen its origin, allowing us to break through the shackles of the Saint Realms. Even if we can’t, it will also bring us towards the Sea of Chaos. Mr Bai, do you believe his words?”
“What does it even matter if we believed him or not. We are all fish meat on the chopping boards. Can we even retaliate? We might still have a chance to leave back then, but look at it now. Putting aside the seventeen Saint Lords, just the thirty-six treasured beads are already all supreme Saint Weapons. They are even a whole set of them that connects one another to form a single entity. The power that it emits is far beyond the limits a Saint. There’s surely the imprint of that person within the Saint weapon that’s constantly watching over us the whole time. The fact that dozens of leaders, who are helping us towards our destination, in all probability the order from that person himself.”
“Alas, it’s not just a probability, but a certainty! Mr. Bai, what do you think is his purpose in doing this? He’s an existence that transcends the Saints, yet he’s asked us to do such a thing. Could it be that once two chiliocosms collide, it will produce some supreme item of great creation?”
“Who knows? Let’s just wait and see. If it endangers our lives, we’ll just escape into the Chaos.”
“True! Escape far away into the Chaos! Thinking of leaving us to die? I’ll bite off a chunk of his flesh before going down!”
The two chatted as they continued walking onwards.
Suddenly, both of them stop abruptly.
The person that appeared in front of them was none other than Jiang Ming who had just arrived.
Just moments ago, Jiang Ming discovered that there were two Saint Lords among those that were pushing the chiliocosm over, rushing towards the direction of his chiliocosm. As such, he immediately rushed over through the Chaos.
Although he had complete confidence to manage the incoming chiliocosm, he still came over to stop them in order to prevent the battlefield from being drawn to his own chiliocosm.
As for the increase in numbers of the Saint Lords, he wasn’t bothered at all. They were akin mere ants however many they were.
Saints were mere ants to him.
“Why did you come here, fellow Daoist?” The red-robed old man’s expression changed slightly as he gave a slight smile, cupping his hand to express a closeness between them.
“Greetings, fellow Daoist!” the white-robed youth gave his greetings as well.
Jiang Ming cupped his hands in response and smiled, “You should be able to guess the reason I’m here. The fact that you are all pushing a near-death Chiliocosm over to my domain, what’s your real intention for this? Who is that person behind you all and what’s his identity?”
The red-robed old man’s eyes narrowed as a fine luminance streak through his eyes. He still continued to smile and said, “Fellow Daoist. I didn’t expect that you’d know of it already.”
“I’ve known about it decades ago and I never bothered with you all.” Jiang Ming replied. “Tell me the name of that person behind you that gave this order and I’ll let you keep your lives.”
He had already evoked the Human Path Record to check the two of them out.
Based on the ‘Status’ of both of them, there was no record of the name of that expert behind them. It had only mentioned that there was a supreme youth who had descended their chiliocosm in the past. He portrayed terrifying strength that was beyond the Saint Realm.
If they were to listen to his command, he would bring them towards the Chaos Primordial Land and also bestow them the great opportunity to break free from the shackles of the Saint Realm.
Under the suppression of both grace and power, they had no choice but to agree. Coupled with the fact that their chiliocosm was near its end, they could only forcibly agree to it. In fact, they were actually very unlucky.
They had gone into the Chaos in search of the Chaos Primordial Land before. At the first time, they mistakenly entered a spatial mists and was entrapped in it for a whole 280 millions of years. It almost brought them to their death.
For the second time around, they were well prepared and set out again. They were trapped in the Tides of Ages and spent 13.6 billion years trapped within. Even their Heart of Dao almost collapsed from this.
Upon their return, it was hard but they managed to recuperate and stabilize their Heart of Saint Dao.
Seeing that their chiliocosm was inching towards its end, they were about to set out into the Chaos again for the third time in search of the future path of Dao, but were threatened by the youth who descended.
This wasn’t the usual bad luck. They were jinxed.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but shake his head as he went through their ‘Status”.
“Fellow Daoist, since you know about that existence behind us, don’t bother resisting.” The red-robed old man sighed and continued, “If you can’t resist, might as well enjoy it.”
“You’re thinking of just lying flat!” Jiang Ming was somewhat speechless.
“Lying flat? This phrase is quite subtle. Yes, I’m just lying flat.” The red-robed old man smiled and continued, “If I can’t resist, what else can I do? Fight to my death? Bulls! Better to just do as I’m told. A day alive is a day spent.”
“Haha! That’s a good use of the word ‘Spent’. Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh, “You really don’t know his name?”
“He didn’t tell me!” the red-robbed old man said helplessly, “Fellow Daoist, what are your plans now? To fight us to the death? Don’t, don’t, don’t…You might want to fight to the death, but we don’t want to ourselves. Moreover, you wouldn’t stand a chance. Even if you are able to kill the two of us, there are still more than twenty of them behind us; even if you are able to kill all of them, there’s also a stronger existence behind us. How are you going to fight against this? Why don’t we all just let nature take its course?”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He was itching for a fight but was slightly ashamed to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - King Saint Xing Yao: This Kid Even
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: King Saint Xing Yao: This Kid Even Broke the Chaos by just Blowing His Horns
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming felt uneasy to strike at the two. Having to have said such remarks, it felt wrong to attack them already.
In the end, Jiang Ming imprisoned the two and tore through the chaotic air current. In a moment’s time, he penetrated the infinite space of Chaos and arrived at their destination.
“We’re back? Just like that?” The red-robed old wan was a little confused.
“Just how powerful is this fellow Daoist?” The white-robed youth wasn’t much better himself.
However, seeing that Jiang Ming placed them aside, they felt slightly relieved.
Following that, they looked at each other, and saw the excitement in each other’s eyes. They thought it would be interesting to see if this person was to think of going against that person behind us.
The Saint Lords that were pushing the chiliocosm onwards noticed Jiang Ming and the two of them as soon as they arrived and everyone stopped pushing.
“Hong Yun Saint Lord, why did you return so soon? Who is this?” One of the middle-aged men frowned and asked.
“Tian Feng Saint Lord, this person is a Saint Lord of the Hongguo Great Chiliocosm. The two of us were stopped by him on our way there.” The red-robed old man answered honestly, “We were of no match and there was nothing we could do.”
“Honggu Great Chiliocosm? It’s our destination isn’t it?” A murderous intent flashed through the eyes of Tian Feng Saint Lord as he immediately gave his order, “Take him down.”
In a flash, eight Saint Lords struck out at the same time without any hesitation. All of them evoked their Supreme Saint Weapons and struck with a destructive explosion.
The power that surged throughout shook the thousands, as the boundless divine luminance seemed to be able to penetrate the Chaos itself.
However, the divine luminance abruptly cracked the very next moment. The raging special abilities were all scattered, forming a peerless storm that swept towards all directions. The expression of Hong Yun Saint Lord and the likes immediately changed as all of them retreated far away.
Immediately after, they saw a scene that greatly horrified all of them.
The eight Saint Weapons trembled one after another and proceeded to fall onto Jiang Ming’s raised palm.
“Supreme-leveled Saint Weapons. They’re not bad!” Jiang Ming simply seized up the weapons and couldn’t help but nodded his head. He then looked over at Tian Feng Saint Lord and continued, “You are all probably from the Chaos Primordial Land.”
“Die!”
Tian Feng Saint Lord’s expression changed. His eyebrows jumped unnoticeably upon hearing Jiang Ming’s remark. Without saying a word, he opened his mouth and spat out a single bead. Instead, the bead abruptly exploded and shot a ball of flame towards themselves.
The moment this ball of flame appeared, a palpitating look flashed through this Saint Lord’s face.
The ball of flame thumped and exploded, turning into a monstrous sea of flame. Its heat which could even melt Saint Weapons terrified all of the surrounding Saint Lords, as they retreated afar. They could all sense that this ball of flame could’ve easily burned them into fleeting ashes, leaving absolutely nothing behind.
“A sealed King Saint flame. This should be your true triumph card already. Interesting!” Jiang Ming smiled. He raised his arms and clenched his fist. Immediately, the sea of fire that was rapidly spreading throughout suddenly contracted and gathered itself into a single ball of flame.
Between the flips of his palm, the ball of fire was refined.
Although the flame wasn’t as strong as a King Saint Weapon, it had the might of a King Saint, which was very terrifying.
He backhanded it into his inner world, allowing the ball of flame to integrate itself into the Taiyang Star in the sky. This allowed the Fire Dao, Light Dao and Taiyang Dao to all skyrocketed.
“You’re a King Saint?” As foolish as a person could be, Tian Feng Saint Lord understood what happened. His face turned incomparably pale.
“What’s the name of the master behind you?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“Senior, forgive me for not being able to tell you this.” Tian Feng Saint Lord immediately saluted, but shook his head.
“If you can’t tell me, then die!” With a slight thought, Jiang Ming’s soul power turned into an invisible needle that penetrated the sea of consciousness of the Saint Lord one after another, directly wiping off his primal soul.
There was no way to block the attack, nor was it possible to evade.
The life aura of the many Saints were instantly wiped out.
In the end, only Tian Feng Saint Lord was left alive, along with the red-robed old man and the white-robed old man.
Realizing the death of the other experts, they were all horrified. Their gaze at Jiang Ming were all filled with a glisten of fear. Even Saints wouldn’t find themselves any better in the face of death. How many people in the world could face death peacefully? There were just very few and far between.
“Do you want to die?” Jiang Ming smirked as he looked over at Tian Feng Saint Lord. Cold sweat actually broke out from Tian Feng Saint Lord’s cold expression.
However, Tian Feng Saint Lord had already secretly evoked the thirty-six treasure beads, which was a set of Supreme Treasure.
The curtain of great luminance that was pushing the great chiliocosm onwards became a stream of light which flew towards him. It merged into one and the imprint that was contained within transformed into a figure of a youth.
By using the Saint Weapon as its bearer, an absolute avatar was formed.
“Lord, this person is from the targeted chiliocosm. He killed all of the other Saint Lords in an instant just now, leaving only the three of us.” Tian Feng Saint Lord saluted with great respect before quickly explaining what happened. “Based on my speculation, this person may be a King Saint Expert.”
“King Saint?” The youth’s hands were behind his back with an indifferent look on his face. His purple coloured eyes swept through Tian Feng Saint Lord, the Saint Lords that were suspended around before being locked at Jiang Ming. “The targeted chiliocosm? That shouldn’t be. It’s extremely difficult to advance to a King Saint among the great chiliocosms. I’ve scouted that chiliocosm in the past and there weren’t any Saints there already. Even if someone managed to break through the shackles and advance into the Saint Realm, it’s impossible for a King Saint to appear in such a short time. You’re from the Chaos Primordial Land, aren’t you? What should I call you? Where are you from? I should have known about you. You should know me right? I’m King Xing Yao!”
“King Xing Yao? I don’t know you and I’ve never heard of you either!” Jiang Ming shook his head, “The chiliocosm in front is my chiliocosm. It’s simply impossible for me to allow you to push this great chiliocosm into colliding with mine. Just back off and I’ll pretend that nothing has happened.”
“You really don’t know me?” King Xing Yao had a strange look on his face, “That shouldn’t be.”
“Are you famous?” Jiang Ming’s expression was even stranger.
A mere King Saint Expert to be so arrogant and overbearing? It’s weird to not know of him?
“Alas, the ignorant knows no fear!” King Xing Yao sighed emotionally as he looked at Jiang Ming, revealing his pity. “Honestly, I’ve killed eight ignorant King Saints such as yourself before this. You are all thinking that you’re invincible upon stepping into the King Saint Realm. You think that your bones are hard enough to hold the heavens yourself and capable of facing anything and everything. Alas, the King Saint Realm. It doesn’t amount to much in the eyes of existence like us!”
“Aren’t you a King Saint yourself? How are you so demeaning about it?” Jiang Ming felt like cracking up.
“How can a King Saint such as myself be compared to you natives.” King Xing Yao snickered. “Lives are different from one another. Take us for example. We are both of the King Saint Realm, but I was born with a Supreme Daoist body, I eat supreme spiritual fruits, drink spiritual liquid of Chaos, cultivate supreme cultivation techniques and learn supreme special abilities. As such, even if we are of the same cultivation realm, I can take down eight of you myself.”
“Only eight of me? You’re awesome!” Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up.
What did it mean that the ignorant know no fear? This was just it!
“Have you ever heard of Hong Zhan?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
“Hong Zhan?” King Xing Yao’s pupils shrank, revealing a slightly serious look on his face. “Although he is a junior, I have to say that he is extremely gifted. Even I myself fall a little inferior to him. It wouldn’t be difficult at all for him to catch up with me in the future! How did you know of him?”
“He was so struck down by me that he could only acknowledge me as his big brother!” Jiang Ming replied honestly.
“Acknowledge you as his big brother? Struck down by you?” King Xing Yao was suddenly stunned and had an exaggerated look on his face before laughing wildly. “Haha! You’d think that you, a mere native could make Hong Zhan acknowledge you as the big brother? Preposterous! From the way you’re blowing your horns, even the Chaos would break! You’re really cracking me up!”
Jiang Ming became speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - The Blow Across the Chaos, Great
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: The Blow Across the Chaos, Great Soul Cursing Technique, Mystic Prime Bead
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Looking at King Xing Yao’s eyes, which were filled with scorn, haughtiness, and stubbornness, Jiang Ming called up the Human Path Record.
‘No wonder he’s so berserk.’ Jiang Ming thought.
The youth was King Xing Yao from the Lagerstroemia Palace. As the innate Saint Spirit born from the fusion between a ray of star and the Saint Stone of light, his aptitude was sky-defying. He was taken as the disciple of the Lagerstroemia Lord Saint. Under the Lord Saint’s training, he reached the Saint Realm without many hurdles. Following that, he spent a long span of time advancing into the King Saint Realm.
King Xing Yao was extremely strong as a King Saint because he had a strong background. Just like he had said, the special abilities, and Saint Laws that he had been cultivating, were far incomparable by the living spirits from great chiliocosms. His accumulation was even more terrifying.
However, it was extraordinarily difficult for King Xing Yao to improve further from the King Saint Realm. He managed to improve a little only even after hundreds of millions of years.
Therefore, King Xing Yao figured out an ancient forbidden method. It was to push a great chiliocosm to collide with another great chiliocosm in the Chaos. This would produce an extremely terrific power of Dao, which might lead to the formation of supreme Dao crystals. The crystal was a supreme cultivating resource even for him, a King Saint.
However, such an act would lead to the backlash of the supreme Dao. One would be either severely injured due to light backlash, or transformed directly into Dao and died.
The best way was to look for a great chiliocosm that was about to be destroyed, convince the Saints of that great chiliocosm to push their great chiliocosm into the other great chiliocosm . In this case, the backlash would be much weaker and bearable.
After a long span of time, King Xing Yao finally had found an about-to-destroy great chiliocosm. Moreover, all seven Saints from the great chiliocosm were still around. Hence, it was the best target.
Based on his capability, it was a piece of cake for him to threaten and lure the red-robed Saint Lord and the rest.
To prevent any unforeseen incident from occurring, King Xing Yao even left an imprint on the great chiliocosm. Following that, in order to speed up the process, he gathered a team of his Saint subordinates to assist the push. Meanwhile, he left behind 36 treasured beads, which were of a set of Saint Weapon. These beads could be evoked in critical time to condense his imprint into an avatar.
“Brat, regardless of how you know about Hong Zhan, it can’t change the fact that you’re an indigenous person. Let me give you a chance now. Submit to me, and I’ll take you to witness for yourself how magnificent the Chaos Primordial Land is. I’ll also show you the unparalleled scenery of the great Dao.” King Xing Yao said with his hands on his back, expressing his presumptuous, and domineering behavior. “Otherwise, here will be your tomb.”
The imposing aura of King Xing Yao surged, arousing the chaotic storm. It was as if he was the one who evolved the boundless Chaos.
“Indeed a King Saint from the Chaos Primordial Land.” Jiang Ming smirked, and gave King Xing Yao his condition. “King Xing Yao, retreat now and you’ll be fine. Else, you’ll definitely die one day.”
Both the red-robe and white-robed Saint Lords were merely listening in silence. Meanwhile, they were quietly retreating as well. They knew if the battle was to break out, they might be affected and killed. No, they knew they would certainly be killed. As they couldn’t afford to provoke either Jiang Ming or King Xing Yao, they could only avoid, and wished that the two of them would be dead as a result.
As for Tian Feng Saint Lord, he was looking at King Xing Yao passionately.
