As for Jiang Ming, he felt disdain for King Xing Yao. After all, for him to confront a mere King Saint, was akin to that King Saint committing suicide.
As if hearing a very ridiculous joke, King Xing Yao guffawed. His laugh was like a tidal wave, bursting the chaotic storm in the distance, evolving the earth, fire, wind, and water. It was extremely horrifying.
Following that, he abruptly stopped laughing, and his look became gloomy. “Definitely die? Such words I have not heard of for hundreds of millions of years already. Truly, it’s been so long that I’ve almost forgotten this phrase. Yet I have never thought that I’d hear it here. Hearing you said that I will die proves how ignorant and presumptuous you are. Brat, do you really think that you can resist me because I’m merely an avatar? Ignorant! Such ignorance! You’re truly ignorant! Although this is just my avatar, it’s carried by a set of top-grade Saint vessels. These 36 Mystic Prime Beads are all peak Saint Weapons, and when fused together, they would be leveled up to the King Weapon! Moreover, because it carries my will, evoking my special ability would allow me to use 60 to 70 percent of my true strength! Not to mention 60 to 70 percent, I’d just need 20 to 30 percent of my true strength just to kill you! Brat, I’m a person who cherishes talent. Therefore, let me ask you for the last time, are you willing to submit yourself?”
King Xing Yao was extremely arrogant and confident. Even his avatar looked down on Jiang Ming.
“Alas, confidence is the most important characteristic of an expert!” Jiang Ming didn’t care. Instead, with a focused gaze at King Xing Yao, he said, “Well, since it’s been destined that we are enemies, I shall just kill you!”
A Heaven-Shattering Spear, which was the King Saint Dao Vessel, appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand. As soon as it appeared, the endless might contained in it, instantaneously recovered.
Jiang Ming current power was sufficient to completely mobilize all power of the King Weapon. After all, Jiang Ming’s inner world had evolved into a great chiliocosm, and the power of his origin had reached the King Saint Realm. Besides, his physique was of the middle stage King Saint Realm, and his soul at the Lord Saint Realm.
Jiang Ming’s power was even beyond the imagination of King Xing Yao himself. The destructive aura and the terrific waves of power, had directly overwhelmed Tian Feng Saint Lord to the point that he barely could withstand it. His physique had cracked while his seven orifices were bleeding. His eyes showed he was terrified because he couldn’t even escape.
“King Weapon?” King Xing Yao’s eyes dilated, and revealed his expression of disbelief. “How can you have a King Weapon? Hold on, why is your aura so strong? Even stronger than my true body. It’s impossible, absolutely impossible. You’re a mere indigenous person, and it’s extremely sky-defying for you to have advanced into the King Realm. But how can you have such a terrifying aura?”
King Xing Yao looked rather messy, but he responded quickly too. As he waved his hand, boundless luminance condensed, materializing into a ray of sword light that tore the Laws of Chaos, and cut off all causal orders. This sword was extremely horrifying.
The slash was just around the corner. Jiang Ming responded even faster. As he wielded the long spear, he blasted the sword luminance.
“King Xing Yao, you’re such a braggart. Is that all you’ve got? Die!” Jiang Ming thrust his spear, which penetrated the Chaos. At the same time, he evoked the Return of Infinite Law Finger with the Heaven-Shattering Spear as its carrier, maximizing the power of the special ability to its utmost limit.
Even the Chaos Space that the spear had passed through, couldn’t bear it and was destroyed in an instant.
“What’s this special ability?” King Xing Yao’s eyes dilated. Following that, he said with enlightenment, “It condensed 3,000 low-grade laws altogether. Alas, it’s 3,000 laws stacked in layers. Even if they are low-grade, fusing them altogether would improve the grade by a few realms. You are so talented, with high comprehension capability, and very terrifying. In this case, I confess my defeat.”
Just a special ability of Jiang Ming had made King Xing Yao understand that he was unable to resist it.
At this moment, the sharp power had scattered the luminance layer surrounding him. Even though King Xing Yao knew he couldn’t resist it, he didn’t resign himself to death. He roared, “Thirty million star palms, break it!”
With a change of his will, the boundless rays around him rippled. Following that, it condensed into countless figures densely packed together as if it had infinite power. Along with him slapped with his palm, all of these figures gathered together, trying to resist the Heaven-Shattering Spear.
Just as expected, the palm, which condensed boundless special ability, crashed. The spear remained in its direction, piercing through the body of King Xing Yao.
“To think that I’ve been defeated. Haha, I’ve lost. Well, it reignited my excitement which has long since subsided!” King Xing Yao’s body cracked, emanating luminance. Following that, his body dispersed while he was guffawing, leaving only 36 treasured beads behind. As they were shooting out towards the distance, Jiang Ming grabbed them by hand, and put them before him.
As for Tian Feng Saint Lord, he had been wiped out by the impact of the battle.
Even the red-robed and white robed experts had eluded into the distance, they almost died because of the impact. They were looking at Jiang Ming with shock and fear. “The supreme King Saint from the Chaos Primordial Land has been killed just like that?”
Jiang Ming ignored the two of them. He merely snickered. “King Xing Yao, I’ve reignited your excitement? Ha, I’ll make you excited to the extreme!”
Jiang Ming mobilized the power of his Lord Saint Soul to refine out all the remnants of the King Xing Yao’s imprints in the 36 treasured beads, and fused them together.
“Taking the soul as the guide, let me cast this Great Soul Cursing Technique which can go across time and space!” Jiang Ming evoked the power of his soul, and cast a special ability into the piece of King Xing Yao’s imprint.

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, the Big
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, the Big Brother at that Time
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On a divine mountain located in the Chaos Primordial Land, a palace was suspended mid-air. It had boundless star luminance condensed on top of it, surrounded by Xuanhuang Qi in the middle, and hundreds of millions of divine luminance hanging at its bottom. It was also shroudering by supreme Dao fluctuation. All these were showing the noble and extraordinary of this place here.
Deep in the palace were packed with little worlds evolved. One of them was an ocean with calm ripples, giving a feeling of vastness and tranquility. The water was condensed by innate spiritual qi, and there were blooming lotus, called the Innate Dao Lotus. On one of the Thirty-six Grade Lotus’s platforms, there was a man sitting cross-legged. He was King Xing Yao.
As King Xing Yao inhaled, numerous black holes appeared in his surroundings. Out from those black holes were massive amounts of Creation Qi, which flew into his body. Upon exhaling, King Xing Yao released chains of orders and pieces of Dao Laws.
At this moment, King Xing Yao suddenly opened his eyes, and he frowned as he thought, ‘To think that the avatar which was formed from the Mystic Prime Beads carrying my will, is killed. It’s so amazing to have seen such a terrific person from a great chiliocosm in the Chaos. He doesn’t only have the King Weapon, he also has terrific special ability. He should have had a great encounter. This is interesting! However, I must not let him live because he’s failed my plan!’
As King Xing Yao thought of standing up to arrange, his expression changed greatly.
“Damn it, he’s actually mastered the cursing method which can traverse time, space, and the Chaos!” King Xing Yao exclaimed, and rays of luminance appeared outside his body.
However, it was too late for King Xing Yao to react, and the defense he initiated was rather weak. The unseeable power directly fell on the origin of his soul like a sword ray, and the saber ray, which ripped his mind.
“No!” King Xing Yao cried in despair. The strike was far beyond his expectation. In just an instant, his seven orifices had been bleeding, and luminance had been shooting out from all over his body. Rich aura of creation and death fills this little space here.
King Xing Yao had been trying to resist it with his overwhelming power but to no avail. His twisted skull abruptly blasted into bloody mist. His soul was exposed, twitching vigorously, and he also evoked special abilities. It could be seen that the supreme vessel suppressing his soul, had been cracked, and turned dim, losing its power.
At the moment when King Xing Yao was about to be killed, a powerful power descended, forcefully suppressing King Xing Yao’s soul, which had torn into more than 200 pieces.
“Destroy!” A sound of Dao rang out, and mighty power surged, crushed and dissipated the power of the curse.
A purple-clad middle-aged man appeared at the side. While he was frowning greatly, he cast a luminance, which recondensed the soul of King Xing Yao.
“Thank you, master!” Although King Xing Yao was in the soul-form body, it didn’t appear different from the physical one. King Xing Yao looked pale, and his eyes frightened, full of fear. After all, if it wasn’t because of his master who appeared in time, he would be killed.
“I felt that your soul weakened abruptly, hence I rushed here. Fortunately, I didn’t hesitate, or you’d have died.” The purple-cold middle-aged man said in a rather indifferent tone. “What’s happened? How can you provoke such a strong enemy? The curse attack just now has the power of Lord Saint Soul.”
“Lord Saint?” King Xing Yao trembled, and his expression looked even grave. “How’s it possible?”
King Xing Yao quickly talked about what had happened.
“An indigenous person from a great chiliocosm in the Chaos?” The purple-clad middle-aged man frowned again.
“Master, it’s most like it!” King Xing Yao wasn’t sure as well. “Based on my observation and speculation, he can be identified as an indigenous person because he didn’t have any aura from the Chaos Primordial Land but rich with the imprint from the great chiliocosm!”
“An indigenous person can actually kill the avatar of yours carried by the 36 Mystic Prime Beads, cast a soul cursing attack across the Chaos, and his power is of the Lord Saint Realm. This is interesting, truly interesting!” The purple-clad middle-aged man said slowly. “I wonder how big the encounter he’s got? I’ll go and take a look since I’m free now. Xing Yao, with your physique gone, you’ve greatly injured your origin. Although you are safe now, I’m afraid that you’d need to spend hundreds of millions of years to fully recover. So you should just stay here till then.”
“Yes, master!” King Xing Yao obeyed obediently because he no longer dared to continue being presumptuous. He was too frightened by this incident, after all.
The purple-clad middle-aged man nodded, and his figure and voice faded away.
…
In the Chaos.
‘I wonder if I’ve killed him?’ Just after Jiang Ming cast that special ability, he turned to the two remaining Saint Lord, and ordered, “Pull your world away and out of here!”
“Yes, senior!” Neither the red-robed old man nor the white-robed young man dared to refuse. Both of them quickly responded respectfully instead. In fact, they even felt rather fortunate that they survived.
Jiang Ming turned and returned to lay on the lounge chair at Chuyang Peak.
‘King Xing Yao, the Lagerstroemia Palace, and Lord Saint Lagerstroemia. I wonder if this incident will lead this old guy here?’ Jiang Ming furtively pondered.
He learned about the Lord Saint Lagerstroemia from King Xing Yao’s Status. The Lord Saint from the Chaos Primordial Land, was undoubtedly a real Lord Saint, a supreme tycoon.
‘Even if he comes here, unless it’s his true body, I’m not afraid of him. If it’s his true self, it would take a long time for him to traverse the Chaos to get here. If he’s here? I think it’s not an issue for me to confront him, but I’m not sure about it!’ Jiang Ming slightly frowned.
‘It seems quite unrealistic to continue improving in a short time. No, there’s still hope.’ The moment Jiang Ming’s thoughts was running in his mind, he had disappeared.
Jiang Ming again went to the Xinghe Galaxy, where Luo Heng was located. The last time Jiang Ming was here, he was traveling across the Sea of Chaos with Pan Wang. He had his Chaotic World Tree devouring many broken universes, which allowed him to take advantage of the World Tree’s transformation and had a breakthrough.
This time, Jiang Ming was going to investigate the special condition of the world. The qi of Chaos was still turbulent, just like usual. When gazed into the distance, there wasn’t any direction, nothing but chaos.
Jiang Ming released the power of his Lord Saint Soul. With slight vibration, it merged into the trembling Sea of Chaos, and spread hundreds of billions of light-years away in just an instant.
In fact, the speed was still very slow. Under the full exertion, the speed of the expansion of the soul power reached the extreme. In an instant, it swept across the Xinghe Galaxy. When his soul was about to move away, Jiang Ming slightly paused, and couldn’t help showing a playful look.
Along the way, he saw the returning Pan Wang and Hong Ying, as well as Luo Heng, who was in the Xinghe Galaxy. These weren’t surprising but he actually saw a strong soul of King Saint Realm. Moreover, it wasn’t at the early stage but the mid-stage of King Saint Realm.
Jiang Ming recalled the situation in the Specter Secret Realm, and couldn’t help but smile. ‘I thought that it’s because the universe has grown to have its own will. It turns out not but a strong pioneer!’ As Jiang Ming thought, he directly condensed an avatar with his soul in the Xinghe Galaxy. Meanwhile, a figure appeared.
“Big brother!” Jiang Ming said sinisterly.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - Taking Over The Universe, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Taking Over The Universe, The Mastermind Behind the Curtains
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Back when Jiang Ming first entered the Specter Secret Realm in the Xinghe Great Universe, he had already discovered various oddities about the place.
Based on the situation, he speculated that it was either the universe itself had given birth to its own consciousness or there was a certain expert at work.
Now, his speculation was finally confirmed.
In front of Jiang Ming’s soul avatar was an old man. Right that moment, the old man’s face was full of surprise and astonishment as he shook his head and laughed bitterly. “I can’t even consider myself to be your big brother. Back then, I witnessed Daoist Jiang become one of the Supremes. It hasn’t been that long ago yet you’ve already improved so much, leaving me far behind. Unbelievable. It’s simply a miracle.”
“If it wasn’t for the help of fellow Daoist back then, I wouldn’t have improved so quickly myself.” Jiang Ming laughed.
He had to acknowledge the favor given. Back when he was in the Specter Secret Realm, the blessings that he received were abundant. It wouldn’t even be an overstatement to describe it as him getting rich overnight.
“Why did you help me back then?” Jiang Ming inquired. This was something he couldn’t wrap his head around.
“That’s simple!” The old man smiled and continued. “It’s because you’re from the outside world! I wasn’t able to detect the aura belonging to our native domain from your body, not even a strand. You’ve befriended Luo Heng. Logically thinking, the two of you shouldn’t have become the best of friends for the gap between your strength is far apart. However, the two of you were like brothers, which was very abnormal. I also learned that Luo Heng carried great fortune and occasionally took out objects that weren’t of our universe. Excluding all the possibilities, the final conclusion was the answer.”
“Amazing!” Jiang Ming gave him a thumbs up.
He also evoked the Human Path Record to take a closer look at him.
This person in front of him was named Xi, one of the most ancient humans. He once obtained boundless power of creation and advanced into the Supreme Realm. In his later years, he traveled through the Sea of Chaos in search of great opportunities to advance even further.
He had great wisdom, great perseverance, great talent, and great fortune as well. By exchanging with countless other Supremes of the past cosmic epoch, fusing many cultivation techniques, and gaining benefits from the Valley of the End, he finally broke through the confinement and advanced into the King Saint Realm after boundless hardships and sufferings.
It was also at that time that Xi somewhat felt a power of attraction. With that he would be able to follow his senses and advance into the higher world, to peek into the supreme myths and witness the ultimate mystery of the universe.
Just as he was about to go forth, there was a pang of fear in his heart for no reason. Such was his natural premonition ability.
It seemed that if he was to go do it, he would die. Xi was shocked and forcibly suppressed the attraction that almost affected his will itself. However, such a force of attraction became stronger and stronger, causing him to involuntarily ascend upon the higher realm. He forcibly suppressed himself, putting himself into a state of thoughtlessness and hollowness.
Right that very moment however, the whole universe trembled abruptly. Over his head, a vortex that covered billion star streams appeared and a beast’s claw poked out, grabbing towards him. It was too overwhelming.
Even Xi, who had advanced into the King Saint Realm was unable to make any resistance. His flesh had even started to disintegrate.
Seeing such a scene, he fell into despair. Luckily. The Origin of the Universe trembled, emanating a divine might that blasted the beast’s claw into pieces, destroying the vortex with it.
Xi was able to survive the disaster. However, he had lost his physical body, leaving only his soul spirit intact.
The force of attraction towards the higher realm did not disappear, but instead was increasing little by little. It shook his will and affected his mind.
Xi understood that if this continued, he would fall for it sooner or later. As such, Xi thought of a way to integrate his Saint Soul into the origin of the universe.
While Jiang Ming was checking up on Xi’s ‘Status’, Xi slowly told of his past.
“I’ve long come into enlightenment that once a person’s will is integrated into the origin of the universe, he would be faced with two situations. It’s either he takes over the entire universe, replacing it at its place or being assimilated by the universe’s origin instead.” Xi slowly continued, ‘However, how can the Sacred Soul of mine that had just advanced into the King Saint Realm be able to affect the overwhelming origin of the universe? Soon after the integration, my will began to be affected and assimilated by the origin. If this went on, I would become a part of the universe’s origin.”
At that critical moment, he achieved enlightenment. He comprehended a heaven-defying special ability – The Universe in A Single Thought. The special ability enabled him to fuse himself with the origin of the universe but also remained independent, maintaining his true self. This was akin to the state whereby he was the universe but the universe was not him.
“I incarnated into the Origin of the Universe, peer through the heavens and earth but was also subjected to great restrictions. I couldn’t really make a move and wasn’t able to exert powers that are too strong. Otherwise, I would be rejected by the origin of the universe or even worse, the divine hammer of calamity would’ve turned me into ashes!”
Xi was slightly emotional. For his current state of existence, it was both great and bad. He could only be the witness to history.
However, he had also secretly guided the human race, allowing their technology to advance rapidly to the point that they were no weaker than the Machines. He even guided Pan Wang, allowing this person who was known as the number one peerless expert to rise above rapidly.
He did a lot of other things in secret as well.
During this period of time, Xi continued to comprehend the origin of the universe. He had a greater ambition of replacing the origin of the universe himself, one step at a time.
This was the only path left of him.
Otherwise, once the universe inches towards its destruction, it would also be his demise. This was because he was too deeply intertwined with the universe’s origin already.
“The fact is, this path was also a dead end as well.” Xi smiled bitterly. “Alas the origin of the universe. It’s as vast as the ocean while I’m merely a drop of water within. A single drop of water assimilating the entire ocean? It’s a fool’s errand! However, I found you! I saw a glimpse of hope in the midst of despair.”
This was also the reason why he helped Jiang Ming in the Specter Secret Realm back then.
Xi said that the Specter Secret Realm was a product of the self-evolution of the origin of the universe. It was a gift for the people of the universe.
In fact, he understood this universe quite thoroughly. Whether it was the current universe or the Sea of Chaos, and even the reason why there were so many Supremes who were trapped in their current realm?
A big reason was because of that beast’s claw. Whenever a person achieved the King Saint Realm, he would either be picked up or killed.
“What’s even more, the inevitable shackle that deterred the sentient beings from advancing further was from that beast’s claw itself!” Xi had a solemn look on his face as he continued. “If I hadn’t obtained the great fortune back in the Valley of the End, I wouldn’t have been able to break through and would stay at Half-King Saint Realm at most!”
Based on what had happened in the past and also the previous great calamity, Xi came to a conclusion that this universe was abnormal because it had been manipulated.
“The universe is akin to a prison!” Xi sighed. “That beast’s claw is so overwhelmingly strong that it just brings people into despair. I’ve speculated countless possibilities and the only way of transcendence is to take over the universe itself. Otherwise, we would all eventually inch towards our destruction.”
However, he had the same obstacle to overcome, because it was a task that was almost impossible to complete.
“Now you’re here!” Xi looked at Jiang Ming with a burning gaze. “The speed at which your strength has been increasing is unimaginable. The cultivation realm that you’ve advanced into, has given me a profound and unpredictable feeling. It’s the feeling that I used to have when I was facing the beast’s claws back then. I’m afraid that you’ve also discovered the abnormality of our world here. I suppose that you’re here today scanning through the area with your supreme soul power because you wanted to explore the secret of the universe, right?”
Jiang Ming nodded.
It was just that Jiang Ming was shocked at heart as well. To think that there was a mastermind behind the curtain? A person that could fiddle with the Sea of Chaos between his fingers?
It was just unbelievable. The shock was also tinged with the yearn to try finding out the truth.
“Fellow Daoist, are you planning to continue your exploration?” Xi asked, filled with hope.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming naturally knew about the reason why Xi would have such a hope. He couldn’t help but smile, “Whether it’s for my best friend Luo Heng or your support back then, I will still continue my exploration and uncover the person behind the curtain!”
Of course, the greatest reason of all was that there was the legend about the World Tree here.
“Many thanks to you!” Xi gave him a sincere salute and couldn’t help but ask, “Fellow Daoist, how is it like beyond the heavens?”
“Beyond the Heavens?” Jiang Ming sighed. “It’s bigger and stronger than his place here. Other than that, there isn’t much difference. Fellow Daoist, allow me to continue probing and see what that beast’s claw truly is.”
Jiang Ming dispersed his avatar as the power of his Soul continued to sweep across the vast universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - The Chaos Universe Annihilation
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast, My Dao has Formed
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
This was the first time Jiang Ming released the power of his Lord Saint Soul without holding back. His power was boundless and limitless, as vast as the might of Heaven itself.
The whole Sea of Chaos was suppressed by him.
There was a mountain that was a light-year high, where Jiang Ming discovered a large number of ferocious beasts of the Chaos. Each of them was hideously terrifying. If they were loose, they would cause irreparable trauma to the origin of the universe or even its death.
Jiang Ming’s soul power slightly shook, completely annihilating the whole fleet of ferocious beasts and the mountain itself with it, leaving nothing behind.
This was one of the terrifying aspects of the power of a Lord Saint Soul. It didn’t matter if it was the mountain or the tsunami, none could attest to it.
Eventually, Jiang Ming had his soul power to cover the entire Sea of Chaos and he discovered the anomaly.
“Found it!” Jiang Ming stood up expressively in the Sea of Chaos. His divine eyes emanated boundless luminance.
From his inception, he discovered a hidden layer of space. It was in the depths of the Chaos, above the Chaos itself, seemingly integrated into the frequency of the Chaos.
It was a profound mystery.
“Open up for me!” Now that he had discovered a hidden secret, how could Jiang Ming not take a peek?
A streak of sword luminance blossomed in between his brows. In a flash, it penetrated time and space, ripped through the void and landed onto the seemingly vague door. With just a single hit, the shackles cracked and the membrane was slashed open.
Rumble…
It was also at this moment that the explosive sound spread throughout the Sea of Chaos, setting off boundless storms.
However, what appeared in front of Jiang Ming was a mysteriously vast space. It was incomparably dark at one side and filled with an infinite amount of creation Qi at the other. The darkness occupied only one percent of the space, but it was eroding the ocean of green luminance on the other side.
Right the very next moment, a pair of golden eyes abruptly looked over at Jiang Ming’s direction. The gaze harbored an incomparably powerful force of will that came crashing down, causing Jiang Ming’s heart and soul to tremble.
‘The will power of the Lord Saint level. It’s much higher than me! Very much higher!’ Jiang Ming’s heart trembled.
“Feeble creature!” The voice of a will relayed, containing boundless coldness and killing intent, followed by a beast’s claw that penetrated through space and time. It was as if it came from an endless distance, yet appeared right in front of him, slapping down towards his head.
The beast’s claw contained an immense amount of power. It suppressed all the order of the Sea of Chaos.
‘This is an attack that surpasses that of a King Saint!’ Jiang Ming’s heart jumped wildly.
As he raised his arm, Jiang Ming pointed his finger. It was the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique that integrated 3,000 Daos and 3,000 laws. He incorporated his power of cultivation as well as his physical power into the technique, striking the most terrifying blow of all towards the beast’s claw.
Boom…
As a deafening explosion erupted, the Chaos seemed as though it had lost its colors, as boundless beings withered. The rolling torrent that was set off by the attack, submerged an unknown area of Chaos.
Jiang Ming was also sent flying with that single blow. His fingers and arm couldn’t withstand the terrifying power that was passed through it and exploded one after another.
His flesh body which was at the middle stage of the King Saint also erupted.
A look of shock flashed through Jiang Ming’s face as the power of his Lord Saint Soul surged outwards, finally suppressing the force.
When he looked ahead and saw the beast’s claw raised yet again, his pupils shrank again.
The beast’s claw gripped and a billion-mile long black lance appeared. It was emanating an endless sharpness, where the power of destruction could pierce through the chaos. It caused Jiang Ming’s heart to skip a beat and his mind froze for a moment.
‘It’s the Dao vessel that’s above the Lord Saint!’
Jiang Ming was left horrified. He could no longer care about anything else, as he immediately evoked the Human Path Record and leapt inside, disappearing without a trace.
The lance gave lurch and the Sea of Chaos was surging.
A pair of ferocious eyes of the savage beast from the unknown, scanned through the entire Sea of Chaos but was unable to find any traces of Jiang Ming. His gaze finally fell onto the Xinghe Universe. As it lifted the lance, it didn’t strike down but cowered back at the end.
…
Back in Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming wiped off the cold sweat from his forehead.
God damn it! What in the world was that? It was too terrifyingly powerful. Putting its strength aside, it even had a supreme Dao vessel that could destroy the entire Sea of Chaos. It was just too unbelievable.
Jiang Ming looked over at his right arm. Although he had recovered, he could still feel the pain. He then laid back on the rattan chair and quickly calmed down.
Swoosh…
The Human Path Record was floating in front of him. Jiang Ming flipped through and the information on the savage beast appeared.
That was the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast. It was an anomaly of the Chaos that was born into the Saint Realm and grew by devouring universes.
It was born with intelligence and continued to grow in the shadows silently. When it surreptitiously devoured one universe after another, he inevitably fought off with other Saint Realm Experts and also the other savage beasts of the Chaos. He gradually grew into the limits of the King Saint.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast discovered a great chiliocosm. It had the feeling that if it was to devour that chiliocosm, it would definitely advance into the Lord Saint Realm.
Great Chiliocosms were of no danger to it either. It evoked its special ability to imprison the entire chiliocosm. Just when he began devouring the chiliocosm, plundering its origin and also the creation Qi of the sentient beings, it was discovered by a Lord Saint that originated from the chiliocosm, who quickly returned to the chiliocosm.
A great battle broke out unexpectedly.
Although the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was only at the pinnacle of the King Saint Realm, it was the Demonic God of the Chaos with peerless talents and invincible special abilities. It actually managed to fend off the expert but fell short at the end.
The great battle was terrifying and stained the Chaos in blood. It was forced to escape.
However, how could it escape easily? Just as it was about to face its ordeal, there was a destructive chaotic storm that had been around for who knows how many billion light years looming over. This was a terrifying force that was capable of destroying anything and everything. With no way to escape, the beast dove headfirst into it.
However, the chase by the human did not stop.
In desperation, the beast came to the center of the storm. There was an incomparably dark and unstable passage which was emitting an incomparably terrifying aura.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast gritted its teeth and plunged right in.
The passage was destroyed.
It narrowly escaped death and came out from the other side of the passage. The place there was still filled with chaotic air flow but the passage that was behind it had disappeared without a trace.
The beast’s body had ruptures and was riddled with holes. It was barely clinging to its life. It took a full three and a half billion years’ time to recover. The beast also discovered that the place was another Sea of Chaos.
The beast traveled through the Chaos and found the oddity. There wasn’t any chiliocosm around. There wasn’t any small chiliocosm, let alone great chiliocosm.
Months and years went by as it continued to travel through the Chaos. On one fateful day, he stumbled upon a scene that shook him.
In front of him was entirely of shadow. As it moved forward, it discovered that this shadow was getting bigger and bigger, as if it was covering the entire Chaos.
Even though the beast was of the King Saint Realm, it was still difficult for it to peep through the shadows and take a general view of the thing. He discovered that this so-called shadow was an immensely huge tree.
Each leaf evolved into a small chilicosom, while each root formed a long river of Chaos. However, the tree had withered. Its branches and leaves wilted and an aura of death filled the air.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was shocked. It was able to recognize that the tree was the legendary Chaotic World Tree. It was a World Tree that was at its peak. The single tree was able to support the entire Sea of Chaos. However, for some reason,the tree had withered.
Nevertheless, the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was euphoric. If it was able to steal the origin of the Chaotic World Tree, it would definitely grow to a terrifying degree.
However, entering the space of the Chaotic World Tree’s origin was very difficult. By relying on its own innate special ability, he spent 10.8 billion years before succeeding. However, it was almost being assimilated by the vast power of origin within.
By relying on his special ability to devour, it slowly devoured the origin little by little to strengthen itself. He also discovered that there was a smaller version of the Chaos. Within the small Chaos, there were many chiliocosms revolving within, containing vibrant life.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was appalled. It speculated that this was perhaps the Chaotic World Tree’s silver lining. As the internal Chaos continued its cycle, it would allow the World Tree to come back to life.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast wanted to destroy the internal Chaos but realized that it simply couldn’t.
Through devouring the origin however, its strength soared and it gradually grasped a trace of authority over the chiliocosm. It had been attracting the King Saints who were struggling to transcend within the internal Chaos and devoured them one after another.
As time passed and the life cycle continued, its cultivation had gradually advanced into the Lord Saint Realm, and even reached a profound and unfathomable degree.
During this period of time, a King Saint Expert from the Xinghe Universe managed to resist his power of attraction.
In order to avoid any unforeseen accidents, the beast was ready to forcibly kill that King Saint but was met with the resistance from the will of the universe. It also triggered the revival of the dormant power of the Chaotic World Tree, which forced the beast to retreat temporarily.
As time flew by, the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast managed to accelerate its devouring speed of the Chaotic World Tree’s origin. It even speculated that it would take less than ten billion years for it to completely plunder the origin and by then, it would undergo the ultimate transformation itself.
Unexpectedly however, a Lord Saint Expert appeared within the Sea of Chaos. The beast was greatly shocked and was prepared to forcibly kill that expert.
It even went as far as to evoke the Chaos Dao Vessel that it obtained from the space of the World Tree’s origin. However, the expert’s sudden disappearance overwhelmed the beast. It vaguely felt the impending danger and was prepared to speed up the pace of devouring the World Tree’s origin.
Jiang Ming carefully read the information of the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast. The contents had surprised him greatly.
‘There’s actually another World Tree? Moreover, it’s the World Tree that’s grown to its ultimate stage? How powerful would its power of origin be, that it could render a Lord Saint, or rather a peak stage Lord Saint Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast to temporarily be unable to devour it completely? And how could the World Tree wither?”
Jiang Ming had numerous doubts. But most of all, he was still ecstatic. He had even welled up with a thought, ‘My Dao has formed!’

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - The 100th Year of the System,
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: The 100th Year of the System, Amazing Explosion of Rewards
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
As for the Xinghe Universe, Jiang Ming took it to heart. He couldn’t deal with it today. Yet, he vowed to revisit the place again in the future.
In the following days, Jiang Ming occasionally went into his exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda to give himself time to settle down. Every now and then, he would have an amazing primitive sport with his junior sister as well.
Most of his time was spent lying on the rattan chair, comprehending the laws to promote the growth of his inner world even though this method was far inferior compared to having a deep sleep in the exclusive cultivation space to promote the evolution of his inner world with the power of origin.
However, it was better than nothing.
Of course, Jiang Ming also chatted around with the groupmates from time to time.
Such days were actually quite comforting to him.
In a blink of an eye, the night had come. The starry sky looked as though it was a stream of river as the glistening old moon hung high.
Jiang Ming stood on the balcony, gazing over the thousands of mountains and hills.
It was at this moment, he turned over to look at the residence of Mountain Master Tian Yuan, revealing a smile on his face.
Moments later, a powerful aura shot up into the sky from the residence, stirring up the wind and clouds, causing immeasurable changes of phenomena. Spiritual Energy of the Heaven and Earth also swarmed over to the residence.
In just a breath time, it actually swept away all of the spiritual energy around the area.
With a flick of a finger, Jiang Ming sent off the 36 Mystic Prime Beads. Through the cycle of Yin Yang, it defined the Heavens, Earth and People, stabilizing all directions and evoked the cycle of the five elements, flying into every direction of the Tianyuan Realm, finally integrating itself into the laws and reasoning of the little realm.
Instantly, the great formation was completed. Right the very next moment, an infinite amount of spiritual energy came rolling over, turning into rivers, waterfalls and ocean, barging through. These were innate spiritual energies. Almost the whole Tianyuan Realm was filled to the brim in a moment’s time.
Eventually, the spiritual energies turned into mist that filled the air, rain water that fell on the ground, which formed rivers and traveled over every corner of Tianyuan Realm. Immeasurable Dao Fluctuation rained down on Tianyuan Realm, materializing the power of law.
Such a commotion had shocked numerous living beings of the Tian Yuan Realm. Many of them grabbed, and the droplets that were gathered on their palms were so heavy that the droplets almost penetrated through their palms.
With only the slightest induction of the spiritual droplets, they were all flushed with excitement to the point of almost fainting.
“These are innate spiritual fluids. Innate Spiritual Fluids that contain supreme Dao Fluctuation and supreme laws of heaven and earth! To think that it’s pouring down like that!”
“Haha! This is really the power of Creation! The supreme power of Creation!”
“I bow to the Saint Lord of Chuyang Peak for bestowing such a blessing upon us!”
Everyone in Tianyuan Realm knew well that everything here today came from that person from the peak of Chuyang Sect. Every change that took place here definitely originated from Chuyang Peak. The supreme transformation that was taking place right this instance could only come from there as well.
In the dark night, there were countless ecstatic immortals bowing respectfully towards the direction of Chuyang Peak. Some even knelt down in worship.
Back in Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was nodding his head with satisfaction. “The great formationlaid with Mystic Prime Beads is really not bad indeed!”
The extraction of the energy from the void to form innate spiritual energy was only one of the functions of the great formation array. In fact, it wasn’t even excessive to say the least that it was an insignificant function of the formation array.
After all, the set of treasured beads used to set up the great formation was comparable to that of the King Saint Dao Vessel.
King Saint Dao vessel? Items of such level were no longer useful to him.
‘Alas, cultivating too fast has its drawbacks as well!’ Jiang Ming thought to himself helplessly. Saint Weapons were no longer of much use. Neither were King Saint Weapons. Only Dao vessels of the Lord Saint Realm would be of use to him, yet he didn’t have any of them unfortunately.
The residence next to Jiang Ming’s, a figure could be seen rushing out of it, and landed right next to Jiang Ming swiftly. It was none other than Mountain Master Tian Yuan. He was full of smiles and was a little shocked. “Brother, this act of yours is really beyond imagination! It’s too unbelievable!”
“Alas, Innate Spiritual Energies! To think that it actually formed mists, condensed into rain drops and accumulated into rivers!”
“Tsk, tsk, tsk. After tonight, our Tianyuan Realm will become the number one Sacred Land of the infinite realms for sure!”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan was very emotional.
“It has long been the number one Sacred Land!” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Congratulations old brother! For advancing into the perfect stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm!”
“Haha! I’m still far behind compared to you!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan smiled. “However, being here has sped up my cultivation. I have a feeling that in less than ten years’ time, I would be able to advance into the Demi-Sage Realm already!”
The higher the realm, the longer the cultivation process would become. On the contrary however, the cultivation speed of Mountain Master Tian Yuan was getting faster instead. It was so fast that it was beyond words.
When Mountain Master Tian Yuan first came here, he was only at the early stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm. It wasn’t long for him to have advanced into the perfect stage.
“What does Demi-Sage even amount to? Strive for enlightenment into the Saint Realm!” Jiang Ming encouraged.
“Wishing for your blessings to come true!” Mountain Master Tian Yuan was rather excited. “Alas, the Saint Realm! I didn’t even dare to think about it back then, yet now? I actually feel like the Saint Realm is beckoning to me!”
Jiang Ming smiled.
After chatting for a while longer, Mountain Master Tian Yuan returned to his residence to consolidate his cultivation.
Jiang Ming on the other hand, stood still quietly as he enjoyed the night breeze. He finally stretched his body a little before laying back on the rattan chair and started swaying leisurely.
‘The hundredth year duration is coming up soon. Such anticipation! I’m also 118 years old now. Haha! Hundred-years-old old man! Old birthday boy!’
Thinking about it, Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile.
If it was his previous life, this was a proper life of longevity. However, in this current life of his, he was still considered extremely young.
A hundred or so-year-old Lord Saint. Nobody would’ve believed it if such a remark was made aloud.
For some reason however, Jiang Ming had the feeling that time passed very slowly that night, extremely slowly.
He hadn’t had such a feeling for quite a long time. He wondered whether it was the feeling of anticipation. It should be.
Finally, midnight came.
A long-lost voice sounded in his subconscious.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for living on Chuyang Peak for one hundred years continuously and sticking to a meal a day as well. Rewarded with ten hearts of great chiliocosm of the perfect state, one heart of chaos of the perfect state, a Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda, a Chaos Defensive Garment and a Chaos Dao Slashing Sword.”
“Ding: The primal spirit of the host has reached the Lord Saint Realm. The rules and regulations will be changed.”
“Ding: Being ordinary doesn’t mean being useless. To enjoy the life of the ordinary without any worries, you would need the strength to push across anything and everything. The host has initially gained a certain amount of combat power. However, there are many things you don’t need to do yourself. You can delegate them to your disciples.”
“Ding: With what the host have done in the past, Tianyuan Realm is delineated as the host’s origin, the base and the land to sanctify the path of Dao!”
“Ding: Your missions are as follows!”
“Ding: For the following years, the host must ensure the absolute safety of the Tianyuan World from being destroyed.”
“Ding: The host needs to take in ten disciples within the Tianyuan Realm and nurture them into Saints.”
“Ding: Rewards will only be given upon the completion of the mission.”
“Ding: If the host was to fail to nurture ten disciples up to the Saint Realm, the System will be silenced for eternity.”
There was a lot of information from the System this time around, which made Jiang Ming frown.
‘The rules have changed?’ Jiang Ming felt rather sad.
He was confident that he could ensure the peace and stability of Tianyuan Realm but nurturing ten disciples up to the Saint Realm would be an extremely difficult task. After all, not everyone was like himself.
However, he thought of taking a shortcut to it. If he were to take in ten female disciples, he was confident that the Sexual Cultivation Technique would work well on the Dragon Phoenix Heavenly Heart Bed…
Jiang Ming immediately cut off that idea.
“Alas! Gone are the days of the past where I could just lay around, prepare meals daily and await for the date of abundance rewards!” Jiang Ming sighed.
There was also a benefit to such a change. He no longer had to stay on Chuyang Peak every day and was free to go everywhere as he wished.
He now had plenty of time to himself.
‘It’s only nurturing ten disciples into the Saint Realm. How can that trouble me? If I was to complete it, the rewards would be…”
As Jiang Ming thought of it, his eyebrows were twitching excessively.
He was assured that the rewards would definitely be a lot better than the current one when the time comes!
As for the current rewards? The heart of the great chiliocosm of perfect state was equivalent to a great chiliocosm condensed into one, containing overwhelming power of creation within.
To think that there were ten of them in total! However, Jiang Ming understood that this was instead the worst reward this time around.
Based on the instruction provided by the System, the Heart of Chaos of the perfect state was the condensation of a whole Sea of Chaos, concentrating into a supreme treasure of the Creation of the Great Dao.
It was incredible and unbelievable. Even with Jiang Ming’s nature of heart, he couldn’t help but be moved.
‘Alas! A whole Sea of Chaos!’ Jiang Ming was at a loss for words.
A whole Sea of Chaos. How many great chiliocosms were contained within? Based on Jiang Ming’s speculation, there would’ve been at least three thousands of them. However, the three thousand great chiliocosm would only amount to a small portion of the Sea of Chaos.
If it was a whole, then he was afraid there would be millions? Ten million? Hundreds of millions? Trillions of great chiliocosms? Just thinking of it sent chills down Jiang Ming’s spine.
Just taking the current Sea of Chaos where Jiang Ming was in. How terrifying was the Origin of Chaos? It was ten thousand times more terrifying than the power of creation of the whole three thousand great chiliocosm combined.
‘This is what great Creation looks like! However, this isn’t the ultimate Creation yet!’ Jiang Ming was dumbfounded. He had been wondering what exactly was the origin of the System?
It was apparent that the System was beyond the Sea of Chaos, and the Chaos Realm.
As for the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda, Chaos Defensive Garment and the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword, all three of these Dao vessels were the best Chaos Realm Dao Vessels. These were all terrifying Weapons of the Great Dao that were beyond the Lord Saint Dao Vessels.
To think that three whole pieces were given.
‘The System is too generous!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but feel the urge of guffawing.
These rewards were giving him the feeling that his path of Dao had been completed.
‘Now that I’m free from the shackles, I can now head towards the Hongmeng Primordial Land in the Supreme Pagoda to check the place out. Who knows if that place would help my cultivation even further?’
Jiang Ming was unsure. After all, his cultivation realm was too low before this. However, hissoul had already advanced into the Lord Saint Realm. Overlooking the entire Chaos Primordial Land, he was already considered to be a tycoon.
“After waiting for so long, I shall take this opportunity to take a look!”
As Jiang Ming thought this through, he evolved an avatar at the same time to be left on the Chuyang Peak. He then communicated with the Supreme Order and disappeared without a trace, heading towards the Hongmeng Primordial Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - The Hongmeng Primordial Land,
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: The Hongmeng Primordial Land, Terrifying Improvements
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
It was a hazy space with heavy suppressive force that even Jiang Ming felt affected by. The air was filled with wisps of Violet currents.
‘Hongmeng Violet Qi?’ Jiang Ming was shocked. He was surprised to see the presence of such a thing which only existed in the legends.
‘So is this the truth behind the Hongmeng Primordial Land?’ Jiang Ming pondered.
He also discovered that it was a platform beneath his feet, as if it was an altar. With a circumference of only ten thousand meters, it was very small to an expert such as himself.
Outside the platform was a hazy void, which appeared unreal. Only wisps of violet air current flowing through.
In addition, the Supreme Dao Fluctuation filled every inch of the place.
Sensing it slightly, Jiang Ming could effortlessly sense the various types of great Dao as well as hundreds and thousands of techniques. It was as though he had fallen into enlightenment.
Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed, a wisp of air current fell onto his hand. He could feel its heaviness even with his power.
‘It’s a billion times better than Chaos Vital Essence!’
He was shocked but also puzzled at the same time. He doubted the capability of Hong Zhan to absorb and digest such heavy suppression and supreme quality of the Hongmeng Violet Qi.
He evoked his cultivation technique and directed the qi into his body. The qi immediately turned into a torrent of creation and dissolved into every part of his body. Yet, he didn’t feel any heavy pressure from it. It felt exactly the same as absorbing immortal essence.
Jiang Ming understood that this should be the restriction made by someone behind it.It allowed every creature who could come here, could safely absorb the qi and cultivate.
As Jiang Ming evoked the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique, his physique actually was slightly enhanced.
His physique was of the King Saint Realm. Hence, just enhancing it by a tiny fraction was extremely difficult. However, his physique had slightly improved by justabsorbing a single wisp of the qi.
It was simply incredible.
‘This here is truly the Sacred Land of Cultivation!’ Jiang Ming was overjoyed.
He hurriedly tapped into his inner world, wanting to release his Chaotic World Tree. However, it turned out that he wasn’t able to do so.
This might be the restriction to the place. Jiang Ming could only shake his head helplessly.
Jiang Ming released his soul power, wanting to take a peak of the world outside the altar. However, he was blocked in and was unable to shake the invisible barrier at all.
‘Fine. Since I can’t peer into the secrets, I’ll start cultivating instead!’
Jiang Ming sat cross-legged and pondered for a moment, before he decided to evoke the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique. He was prepared to temper his physical body first.
With strong physique, his body would be able to carry more power, allowing his abilities to be evoked with ease.
As soon as Jiang Ming started the cycle, both drifting invisible Hongmeng Qi and the visible Hongmeng mist swarmed at him, creating a vortex around Jiang Ming.
Rumble…
Inside Jiang Ming’s body, terrifying torrents of Creation exploded in successive instances. As the cultivation technique continued its cycle, the Hongmeng Violet Qi was rapidly absorbed by his muscles, bones, organs, bone marrow, etc.
Jiang Ming’s physique was improving without any limitation whatsoever.
‘Such improvements…’ Even Jiang Ming had a look of shock on his face.
This was simply incredible! Alas, the tempering of the physique! It was supposed to be the most difficult yet it was getting stronger without reasoning.
Jiang Ming had his mind dived into his body, performing the cycle of the technique with full force.
His whole person seemed to have transformed into a black hole as the vortex swept through, enveloping all the space above the altar. Meanwhile, Jiang Ming had been plundering all Hongmeng Qi that was around the area, and even imbibing the endless Hongmeng Qi outside the barrier.
His strength surged and his aura rapidly improved. It was as though the improvements were never ending.
After five days, Jiang Ming paused slightly. He had an astonished look on his face.
‘In just five days-time, the cultivation level of my physique has directly advanced from the middle stage of King Saint Realm into the perfect stage! This is simply unbelievable!’
Such improvement was akin to a pie in the sky. After all, his physique was of the King Saint Realm, a realm that was higher than the Saint Realm!
‘This is truly the Sacred Land of Cultivation, the land to sanction the path of Dao, and the land of immensity.’
However, Jiang Ming also understood that the reason why he was capable of having such great improvement was because of his cultivation technique being terrifyingly powerful.
The great Dao of Hongmeng…It was quite evident.
The stronger the cultivation technique was, the faster the cultivator could plunder the Hongmeng Qi, and the faster the cultivator could refine it.
Jiang Ming sensed for a moment the situation of his avatar that he left in Chuyang Peak. When he realized that nothing had happened to the avatar, he continued his cultivation.
For another five days, his aura surged rapidly, reaching an even more terrifying state.
‘I’ve broken through! My physique has now advanced to the Lord Saint Realm!’ Jiang Ming opened his eyes, once again showing the shocked look on his face.
‘I cannot waste my time even though I have a lot of points!’ He closed his eyes and went back to his cultivation.
In a blink of an eye, another five days had passed. A reminder could be heard transmitted by the Supreme Order into Jiang Ming’s mind. “Jiang Ming, after deducting 500,000 points, you have spent 15 days in the Hongmeng Primordial Land. It is detected that you still have many points left. Do you want to continue your cultivation?”
“Continue my cultivation. Set it to automated deduction of points. There’s no need to remind me again!”
“Noted, Jiang Ming!”
Jiang Ming blinked his eyes. For some reason, this reminder gave him a slight feeling of emotional wavelength. However, he didn’t dwell on it and continued his cultivation.
Another fifteen days passed and Jiang Ming finally paused for a while.
‘My physique is at the perfect stage of the Lord Saint Realm!’ Jiang Ming suppressed his excitement by taking a deep breath.
Even now, Jiang Ming still had a feeling of trepidation. Such improvement was even more terrifying than his cheating System. It gave him a dream-like sense of unreality.
In just 30 days, his physique had been improved to the perfect stage of the Lord Saint Realm. The cost was one million points. However, he had a total of 30 million points prior to his cultivation in Hongmeng Primordial Land. After one million points had been deducted, he still had twenty-nine million left.
‘When I used up my points here, wouldn’t that mean I would be able to advance into an unprecedented realm?’ Jiang Ming was ecstatic.
However, when he continued his cultivation for another five days, he didn’t have any breakthrough. After ten days, he didn’t experience any improvements. It was still the same even after he had used up 15 days.
Jiang Ming was feeling rather numb. He began wondering whether it was really difficult to advance into the Chaos Realm or there was a limitation.
Jiang Ming didn’t know. He secretly sighed to himself and accepted the fact that he failed to break through this time around. After all, the improvements that he had were already mind-blowing.
Jiang Ming switched to cultivating the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution True Soul Sutra instead. Not surprisingly, when his soul had advanced into the perfect state of the Saint Lord Realm, it stopped and became difficult to advance any further.
Jiang Ming wasn’t discouraged. Instead, he began to plunder Hongmeng Qi into his inner world. He wanted to give it a try and see how far his inner world could improve.
When the Hongmeng Qi entered his inner world, the origin began to rapidly increase. Even the transformation process of his laws had been accelerated. Besides, the ten hearts of great chiliocosm that he had integrated into his inner world began to melt off rapidly, releasing immense amounts of supreme Qi of Creation, Qi of Origin, Shackles of Law and many more.
The combination of the external Hongmeng Qi and the internal Qi of creation, origin released by the ten hearts of great chiliocosm, had allowed the laws of Jiang Ming’s inner world to evolve into an extreme state. Meanwhile, the origin of Jiang Ming’s inner world was also rapidly improving.
Jiang Ming was excited and completely immersed in his body. All 3,000 of Quasi-Sage Laws had been formed. Following that, the 3,000 laws began to transform towards the laws of Saint Dao.
One after another, laws of Saint Dao started to appear. They permeated into every corner of the inner world, merging into everything. The process continued until all 3,000 laws of Quasi-Sage had been transformed into the laws of Saint Dao.
The origin of Jiang Ming’s inner world had also been raised to the utmost limit of the King Saint Realm. At this time, Jiang Ming could clearly feel that his inner world could accommodate up to seven Saints by now. It seemed that it was almost the same as the Honggu Great Chiliocosm.
Jiang Ming frowned. He could feel that his inner world had yet to reach its limits and could continuously be improved until it reached the level akin to the Xinghe Universe.
Sure enough, his inner world trembled but it did not stop improving. Its space was still expanding, and its origin was still strengthening. Only the laws remained unchanged, still at the Saint Realm.
Jiang Ming entered his inner world with his subconsciousness. He could sense the evolution of his inner world.
Currently, in addition to his original space, there were a great number of middle chiliocosms, small chiliocosms and planar worlds attached to his inner world.
The world was limitless and so was his growth. The origin of his inner world had slowly advanced into the utmost limit of the Lord Saint Realm.
The ten hearts of the middle chiliocosm had long been completely refined. However, for some reason, the heart of Chaos which had been integrated into his inner world was being digested at a very slow pace.
He didn’t pay much attention to this anyway.
Jiang Ming also realized that his current inner world was able to accommodate 81 Saint Experts.
‘Is this the limit? No!’ Jiang Ming furtively shook his head.
He still remembered that when his inner world first broke through from the middle chiliocosm into the great chiliocosm, the amount of resources needed were extremely terrifying.
Therefore, he planned to take the advantage of this opportunity to accumulate resources up to the extreme limit, so that he wouldn’t need to worry about the transformation of his inner world in the future.
As expected, his inner world could still absorb and digest the accumulated Hongmeng Qi. Only, its space stopped expanding, and its laws stopped evolving. Its Origin, however, was still improving without any qualitative metamorphosis in sight.
With a thought in his mind, he channeled a portion of the Hongmeng Qi that he had absorbed into the World Tree. This treasured tree immediately got excited by moving its branches. As the Qi of Creation loomed over, the World Tree began its growth.
Only the speed of growth was obviously very slow.
Time flowed slowly like the river, streaming ever so gently.
The accumulation of his inner world had also reached its utmost limit and could no longer be increased nor could it undergo its transformation.
Jiang Ming pondered and decided not to leave the Hongmeng Primordial Land. Instead, he continued to absorb the Hongmeng Qi and channeled them into his Chaotic World Tree to allow this precious tree of his to continue growing.
He had a feeling that it wouldn’t be long before he could use his World Tree to induce the transformation of his Lord Saint Soul. Even more so, it would allow his inner world to sublimate up to its limits, advancing into a higher realm.
On this day, a slight feeling struck in Jiang Ming’s heart as he directly communicated with the Supreme Order and left the Supreme Pagoda.
He reappeared on Chuyang Peak, kept his avatar and looked beyond the world’s fetal membrane. There was an obscure and powerful aura that was rushing over in a hurry.
‘I wonder if he’s the person supporting King Xing Yao?’
With just a single step, Jiang Ming had got to the Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - Killing the Lord Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Killing the Lord Saint
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming had his hands behind his back in the Chaos. While looking into the distance, he pondered the situation about himself.
He had spent more than a year for this seclusion, spent 18 million, and had 12 million left. As a result, both his physique and soul had advanced into the utmost limit of the Lord Saint Realm. Meanwhile, his inner world had advanced into the utmost limit of the great chiliocosm. Such an achievement in just about a year was an utterly incredible achievement.
‘Now I know why Jun Sanqian had been urging me to go cultivate in the Hongmeng Primordial Land. This is not only a fortune, but a miraculous encounter.’ Even now Jiang Ming was still exclaiming the benefits he had received from the Hongmeng Primordial Land. At the same time, he was in awe of the owner of the Supreme Pagoda.
In just a short while, a figure appeared in front of Jiang Ming. Wherever the figure had passed, the Chaos would retreat. He was stepping on an illusionary long river, which would traverse an infinite distance with a slight movement.
Fortunately, the avatar that I left behind, had been monitoring the Chaos all these while. Otherwise, it would be difficult to spot this guy here.
“To think that you’re waiting for me here.” The figure was Lord Saint Lagerstroemia. He stopped and observed Jiang Ming with hints of curiosity. But his eyes remained indifferent. “You’re restraining your aura to the point that even I can’t see through. I wonder whether it’s because you’ve cultivated a supreme special ability, or you’ve a supreme treasure suppressing your aura in your body? The fact that you’re capable of blasting the avatar of King Xing Yao and almost killing him by cursing through the Chaos has proven the unusual encounter you’ve obtained.”
“Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, do you have to do this?” Jiang Ming snorted. “It’s natural for me to deal with your disciple who’s been trying to invade my world. It’s a normal confrontation, yet you intervene. You’re even willing to traverse the Chaos just to come here. Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, you’re indeed very narrow-minded.”
“No, you got me wrong!” Lord Saint Lagerstroemia shook his head as he smiled. “I’m here just to identify the type of encounter a sentient being of a great chiliocosm has gotten to be able to kill my disciple. After all, life is just too boring. Since my curiosity has finally been aroused, I’ll have to come around.”
“You’re indeed f*cking boring!” Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
“Haha, this is due to the fact that I’ve cultivated and lived for too long. When you’ve lived hundreds of millions of chaotic epochs, you’ll realize how precious it is to be curious,” Lord Saint Lagerstroemia exclaimed. “With my current realm at the Lord Saint, it’s so difficult to improve further that I’m in a state of despair. As a result of living too long, and experiencing too much, the world is no longer that secretive to me. The vicissitudes of life, the reincarnation of the era, and the grievances, are all insignificant. For a couple of times I even have the thought to transform myself into Dao. Alas, the long years have made life boring.”
Jiang Ming heard the unspeakable loneliness, the eternal solitude, the long-lasting desolation, and the pain of living.
“Why don’t you just transform yourself into Dao, and all your issues would be solved. In this case, you no longer have to endure the torment of time.” Jiang Ming smirked.
“There are always some interesting things in this world. For example, I get to challenge the Chaos Expert and discover a person with sky-defying encounters like you.” Saint Lord Lagerstroemia laughed as he said, “Kid, it’s rare that I’m interested in coming. Hence, I’ll give you a chance to acknowledge me as your master, and all the past resentment shall be forgotten.”
“What if I refuse?”
“If you refuse, you’ll be my enemy. It’d be either you die or I die if you were to be my enemy.”
“In that case, let’s just try it out. Let’s see if you’re stronger, or I’m better.”
There was nothing else to say at this point. Jiang Ming knew that Saint Lord Lagerstroemia wouldn’t give up since Saint Lord Lagerstroemia had come all the way here. Even if Saint Lord Lagerstroemia was to give up, Jiang Ming wouldn’t let him go anyway. Since they had become sworn enemies, Jiang Ming felt safe only with the death of Saint Lord Lagerstroemia.
Jiang Ming took a step forward and stopped moving for a while. He saw Saint Lord Lagerstroemia open up his palm to release a Chaos Beast with a body length of 30,000 kilometers. Jiang Ming knew that it was not the real size of the Chaos Beast yet.
“You’ve been too meticulous, haven’t you?” Jiang Ming looked at Saint Lord Lagerstroemia with disdain. “To think that you let a beast to test me, I doubt whether you truly are a Lord Saint?”
“Being meticulous is the secret to a longer life. This is the eternal rule!” Saint Lord Lagerstroemia said smilingly, “This is the King Saint Golden Dragon Bast that I’ve enslaved on my way here. Through it, let me see how good you are.”
“You’ll be in despair after you see my power!” Jiang Ming shook his head, and punched at the beast. Meanwhile, he said, “This is boring!”
Along with the punch, boundless power that had surged out, blasting the surrounding space of Chaos in an instant. The incomparably tyrannical power, which was suppressing the eternity had caused a change on the Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s face, revealing a great shock. “This is the power of Lord Saint Realm. And it’s the power of the physique! This is impossible!”
Rumble…
With merely a punch, Jiang Ming had blasted the Golden Dragon Beast into a bloody mist, which was then dispersed as ashes. Meanwhile, the region where they were at, had become a vacuum. Even the supreme laws and rules of the Chaos were about to rupture.
“You must be somebody to be this strong.” Saint Lord Lagerstroemia had become unprecedentedly solemn. “Who are you?”
Meanwhile, battle armor appeared on him, a lance appeared in his hand, and a bell suspended on his head. It was obvious that Saint Lord Lagerstroemia was about to do his best.
“I’m Jiang Ming. Do remember that you’re killed because of your own disciple.” Jiang Ming launched the attack as soon as he finished his words.
With a couple of swift punches, Jiang Ming had blasted the Chaos. The pure yet horrifying power that condensed naturally, had made the space stagnant.
“How arrogant!” Saint Lord Lagerstroemia snorted coldly. At the same time, the bell on his head rang out, emanating Dao fluctuation, which was directed towards the origin of Jiang Ming’s soul.
However, Saint Lord Lagerstroemia was stunned in the next moment. His attack had not affected Jiang Ming at all, not even caused Jiang Ming to frown a bit.
He had a bad feeling.
“Just a small trick!” Jiang Ming howled as he punched through the eternity, and into Saint Lord Lagerstroemia.
As for the attack of the bell? It was merely a Lord Saint Dao Vessel, which couldn’t even affect his unparalleled soul. Moreover, he had his inner world as the barrier, and the Chaotic World Tree as the barricade.
With a flutter, Saint Lord Lagerstroemia had produced thousands of figures. Each figure was seen in a layer of space, making the thousands of figures looked as though they had fallen into thousands of worlds.
“The law of Chaos Space? Regardless of how fantastix your special ability is, you won’t be a match for my super power.” As Jiang Ming punched, he blasted layers of space and his last punch got to the tip of the lance.
Boom…There was an explosion of power, which led to the surging of earth, fire, wind, and water, directly opening up a space which was instantly destroyed by the destructive torrent.
Saint Lord Lagerstroemia was sent backwards at the impact of the explosion. He exclaimed, “This is the Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasure. Yet, you’re capable of resisting it with your naked punch?”
This time around, Saint Lord Lagerstroemia had hints of despair flashing across his face. He was only at the middle stage of King Saint Realm, and he got this supreme treasure by chance. He rarely would take it out, but each time he used it, he would definitely kill his opponent.
Taking out the supreme treasure this time, Saint Lord Lagerstroemia didn’t expect to kill Jiang Ming, but he expected to be able to safely retreat with it. However, the punch just now had left him in despair.
“Are you in the Chaos Realm? No, you’ve the physique of the peak stage Lord Saint Realm!” Lord Saint Lagerstroemia was in a greater despair.
The difference between the middle stage and the peak stage of Lord Saint didn’t seem to be big, but each advancement was not only extremely difficult, it would also cause a tremendous change in power after each advancement.
With a flutter, Lord Saint Lagerstroemia formed thousands of figures again. This time however, all his figures merged into the Chaos fluctuation and eluded into the distance. Lord Saint Lagerstroemia had made a decision to escape since he was no match to Jiang Ming. After all, it wasn’t a shameful thing to do to save his own life.
“Trying to escape?” Jiang Ming laughed, but in a cold manner.
The next moment, a world projection suddenly appeared and swept through hundreds of millions of light-years away in an instant. It stopped Lord Saint Lagerstroemia from escaping.
“World projection? Are you taking on the World Dao? Is such a strong pressure the utmost limit of a great chiliocosm? How’s it possible!” Lord Saint Lagerstroemia was shocked with hints of an incredible sense of absurdity.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - Chaos Supreme Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chaos Supreme Treasure
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Lord Saint Lagerstroemia was shocked. He understood about the World Dao. He knew that it was a path that was extraordinarily tough. The availability of sufficient resources might allow the cultivator to grow quickly at the beginning, but the growth would become very slow at the later stage.
Even in the entire Chaos Primordial Land, Lord Saint Lagerstroemia only knew one expert in the World Dao who managed to evolve his inner world into the level of great chiliocosm. In fact, he was one of the few who knew about the existence of this expert.
Damn it. Lord Saint Lagerstroemia actually met Jiang Ming, an expert in the World Dao here. Yet, Jiang Ming had advanced to the unprecedented utmost limit of the World Dao. Jiang Ming even managed to stop Lord Saint Lagerstroemia from escaping. How unbelievable was it?
What was more unbelievable was that Jiang Ming’s physique was actually of the utmost limit of Lord Saint.
‘My goodness. Are you pulling my legs?’ Lord Saint Lagerstroemia came out just to check out the type of encounter the sentient being from the great chiliocosm had obtained that made the sentient being capable of almost killing his disciple. But it resulted in…
Lord Saint Lagerstroemia actually had met someone more ferocious than he was, and he had fallen for it.
“Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, why are you eluding? C’mon, let’s battle for 30 million rounds!” Jiang Ming roared and lunged forward. Jiang Ming saw Lord Saint Lagerstroemia as a good opponent. Hence, he wouldn’t let go easily.
“Damn!” After Lord Saint Lagerstroemia was stunned, he became enraged.
Although Lord Saint Lagerstroemia knew that his combat power was weaker than Jiang Ming, he believed that he had chances to win.
“Space Thunder!” The treasured bell above Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s head had been trembling, continuously casting attacks. Meanwhile, he thrust with the lance in his land, evoking the space tide, bursting out the power of thunder that was directed at Jiang Ming from all directions.
“Good job!” Jiang Ming laughed. Following that, he opened his mouth to devour the black thunder containing the power of space. After a slight pause, Jiang Ming went on and spat out a wisp of black smoke simultaneously. “It’s a great one!”
“F*ck it!” Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s heart skipped a beat. He was dumbfounded to see Jiang Ming devouring the special ability that he had evoked. Yet, Jiang Ming enjoyed it?
Lord Saint Lagerstroemia didn’t know what else he could do to resist. A glint of hope, which had just arose, had been scattered in an instant.
At this moment, Jiang Ming’s attack was inches away. It was an attack without any extravagant means. It was merely punches with supreme power.
Rumble…The void blasted, and the Chaos shook.
Lord Saint Lagerstroemia tried his best in resisting Jiang Ming’s attack. However, the supreme treasured armor he had been wearing was scattered in an instant.
‘I’ll die if I don’t do something else!’ Lord Saint Lagerstroemia spat out a stream of light and with a thought, thousands of figures had formed and merged into the undulations of the Chaos space again.
This time around, he didn’t elude. He was heading to the Honggu Great Chiliocosm instead.
“F*ck you!” Jiang Ming squinted his eyes, evoking the World Projection again. The extreme pressure that had been suppressing the undulation of the Chaos had forced Lord Saint Lagerstroemia out of the Chaos space again.
At this moment, Lord Saint Lagerstroemia had gotten very close to the Honggu Great Chiliocosm. Hence, with a flash appeared on Jiang Ming’s forehead, he immediately cast the sword of soul at Lord Saint Lagerstroemia.
The slash spanned space and traversed time, directly blasted the treasured bell atop Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, torn apart layers of protective divine luminance and penetrated his consciousness.
Pff…Lord Saint Lagerstroemia shuddered and all his seven orifices bled. Fresh blood oozing out was struggling distortedly as if it was about to transform into Innate Saint Spirit.
“You want to kill my great chiliocosm so that I’d be scrupulous not to kill you, right? Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, you are wishing to die quicker, aren’t you?” As Jiang Ming said, he evoked a finger which traversed the void, towards Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s forehead.
As a result, Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s skull blasted in an instant. However, every piece of his flesh and blood had been wiggling rapidly into the void and disappeared without a trace.
“What a good technique!” Jiang Ming snorted coldly. He evoked the World Projection and a gigantic pagoda abruptly appeared in it.
The moment the pagoda appeared, its majestic force that suppressed all Daos and laws made the Chaos tremble and stop. Even the Honggu Great Chiliocosm had been completely stopped. It was as if space had become stagnant and time had stopped.
The pagoda was the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda, a type of Chaos Supreme Treasure. With a slight tremor and the luminance flowing, Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, who had been integrated into the space, was shaken out.
The skull of Lord Saint Lagerstroemia had been recovered. It was just that he was white as a sheet. When he evoked his supreme Saint power, he failed to resist the power of the pagoda’s suppression at all. Thereby, he looked at Jiang Ming with shock on his face. “Is this the Chaos Supreme Treasure? How can you have such a supreme great vessel? This is impossible, absolutely impossible that you can own it. There’s only a few of them even in the entire Chaos Primordial Land!”
“How can it be impossible when you’ve witnessed it yourself?” Jiang Ming snorted coldly. “Lord Saint Lagerstroemia, in fact, I never expected that you’d want to destroy my world.”
“I don’t have any chance to defeat you at all. Hence, I can only look for a silver lining!” The shock on Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s face had disappeared. It was replaced with helplessness instead. “I’m afraid that your inner world has evolved into its extreme stage right? It’s been difficult for me to resist just that World Projection of yours. Hence, it must not be of an ordinary great chiliocosm. If all the torrents in your inner world were to erupt, I am afraid that I would be annihilated in an instant. Moreover, it’s absolutely unbelievable that not only your physique has advanced into the utmost limit of the Lord Saint Realm, but also your soul has advanced into the profound stage of Lord Saint Realm. It’s just that your techniques are jerky. Otherwise, you can suppress me even without the use of such a great vessel.”
Lord Saint Lagerstroemia lamented. He had seen through Jiang Ming’s weakness. He thought it was rather unbelievable and abnormal that a powerful expert like Jiang Ming, actually didn’t have any strong techniques, nor did he have many of them.
“You’re indeed a Lord Saint Expert. You actually managed to see through my weaknesses.” Jiang Ming exclaimed.
It was just as Lord Saint Lagerstroemia had said, Jiang Ming had too few techniques. The best special ability he had now was only the Return of Infinite Law Finger. The other techniques were completely outdated.
This was due to the fact that his cultivation base had been advancing too fast. Besides, Jiang Ming had yet to finish refining the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda.
Without talking further, Jiang Ming killed Lord Saint Lagerstroemia by just slightly evoked the pagoda. Even a Lord Saint Expert who seemed to be immortal, couldn’t resist the killing power of such a level of supreme great vessel.
‘If I didn’t have a Chaos Supreme Treasure, I’m afraid that it’d be difficult for me to kill him!’ Jiang Ming pondered.
