Jiang Ming noticed it when he pointed at and blasted Lord Saint Lagerstroemia’s head, and all the flesh and blood escaped into the void.
The techniques of Lord Saint Realm were indeed beyond imagination.
‘If it wasn’t because of my overwhelming power…’ Jiang Ming shook his head.
Now that he had discovered his weakness, what he could do was to strengthen it to fill the gap.
Jiang Ming put away the bell and the lance.The lance was known as the Deity Killing Lance, which was a Chaos Supreme Treasure and the Nine Heavens Soul Suppressing Bell, a Lord Saint Supreme Treasure. These two Supreme Treasures were considered good.
Jiang Ming tore the space in the body of Lord Saint Lagerstroemia and took out a great amount of plunder.
Lord Saint Lagerstroemia not only had a dozen of King Saint Weapons, he also had hundreds of Saint Weapons and countless of precious and rare items. He even had a long river of Chaos Vital Essence.
‘I’d be overjoyed with such amounts of plunder obtained in the past. But now…it’s nothing much.’ Jiang Ming put away the Chaos Dao Suppressing pagoda and returned to Chuyang Peak.
Standing on the balcony, he gazed at the mountains in the distance. Inexplicably, he felt peaceful.
‘Alas, it’s still the best here!’ Jiang Ming felt more comfortable at a familiar place.
As his eyes glistened, Jiang Ming had seen through the void and peered throughout the entire Honggu Great Chiliocosm with a glance.
While suppressing his various thoughts, Jiang Ming lay on the rattan chair and began to ponder what to do next.
Jiang Ming planned to go to the Xinghe Universe again. In fact, he had to go but not that soon. He had to settle his improved power and deduce some special abilities before he could go. Because it was rather dangerous for him to go now.
Another mission he had to accomplish was to nurture disciples up to the Saint Realm. This was quite a difficult mission.
‘Shall I just recruit all female disciples? But I wonder if my little junior sister would kill me?’ Jiang Ming was annoyed.
At this moment, he revealed a smile.
“Senior brother!” A coquettish voice rang out. In fact, it was the voice of ten junior sisters, who called out in unison.
Following that, all ten junior sisters paced towards Jiang Ming. When they were about to drown him, Jiang Ming had a thought. He condensed nine avatars so that each of his avatars would have one to hug.
“Senior brother, you’re being too shameless, aren’t you?” Linglong couldn’t help but snorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - Created Heavenly Ladders, Great
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Created Heavenly Ladders, Great Dao of Fifty
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On the balcony were 10 Linglong and 10 Jiang Ming.
“Can you tell which is the real me and which are my avatars?” While hugging Linglong, Jiang Ming laughed as he asked.
“Well, I think I can’t.” Linglong tilted her head as she carefully observed. She even evoked Saint Dao Special Ability, yet she couldn’t tell the difference between the real Jiang Ming and his avatars. Hence, Linglong couldn’t help but whine, “Senior Brother, what’s this special ability about?”
“It’s just a small trick!” Jiang Ming laughed. “Upon reaching my cultivation realm, the avatar that I form can’t be easily differentiated by even a Saint Expert.”
“Don’t tell me you have another great breakthrough? I think you did. Else, you wouldn’t have left an avatar here for more than a year.” Linglong blinked her beautiful eyes as she looked into Jiang Ming’s eyes with her hand holding her chin while laying on Jiang Ming. She asked interrogatively, “Senior Brother, which cultivation realm has you advanced into?”
“The ultimate limit of the Lord Saint?”
“So the cultivation base of your Soul has advanced into the ultimate limit of the Lord Saint? You’re indeed amazing, mighty and awesome!”
“You’ve been looking down upon me, haven’t you?”
“Senior brother, you’ve been showing off again, aren’t you? Don’t tell me that both your physique and inner world have broken through as well?”
“Bingo! My inner world has advanced into the utmost limit of great chiliocosm, while both my physique and soul have advanced into the utmost limit of Lord Saint. Little girl, it’s amazing, isn’t it?”
“Superb!”
“Pfft…” Jiang Ming snickered and couldn’t help but snorted. “You’re looking to be beaten up, aren’t you?”
Pat pat pat…A total of ten sounds were heard in unison.
“Senior brother, there are 10 of us each. Shall we try?”
“Let’s try!”
Mist rose up from the balcony, isolating the balcony from the external surroundings. The duo, who became 10 pairs, were enjoying the most wonderful experience in the world. They were doing it for a total of 10 days, before a unison exclamation was heard after the ultimate sublimation.
“How’s it?”
“Senior brother, it was too wonderful. I’ve decided. I want to condense 10,000 avatars for the next time. I think that’d be wonderful.”
“Are you not afraid of going to heaven?”
“I’m the heaven myself. Hehe, senior brother, are you afraid?”
“How can I be afraid of you? Haha!”
The duo began to argue.
At the end of the day, Linglong left. She had to make the final preparation to abdicate from her position as the Heavenly Emperor. The position had become useless for her.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming went to the Tianyuan Sea with a flutter.
Riyue Changfeng was still around. He remained enjoying his tea atop the Auction House. Sitting opposite him was Yun Zizai.
Yun Feiyan, on the other hand, was fighting against Bai Yihou, a Quasi-Sage Expert of the Human Race.
“Brother Jiang, it’s been a while.” Riyue Changfeng rose to his feet, poured a cup of tea and handed it over to Jiang Ming. Following that, he frowned as he looked at Jiang Ming. “Brother Jiang, you seemed to have changed again. Don’t tell me that you have a breakthrough again in your cultivation base?”
As Riyue Changfeng was asking, the corner of his mouth twitched. He had already assured that Jiang Ming, a super genius, must have broken through.
“Broke through again?” Yun Zizai also rose to his feet when he heard Riyue Changfeng. He inexplicably felt jealous of Jiang Ming, which he cut off immediately.
“Yes, I’ve made a breakthrough!” Jiang Ming nodded. Following that, he sighed. “Unfortunately, I’m not that happy with it.”
Jiang Ming beckoned them to sit down.
“Why are you not happy with it when you’ve made a breakthrough?” Riyue Changfeng looking up into the sky. He felt like smashing Jiang Ming into his face. If it wasn’t because he knew he was not a match to Jiang Ming, Riyue Changfeng would have pulled Jiang Ming’s pants down and beat him.
Damn it. Jiang Ming’s words were so irritating.
Even Yun Zizai was rendered speechless. “How can you feel bad about yourself when you have a breakthrough? Alas, fellow Daoist Jiang, you’re making us so envious of you!”
Yun Zizai was holding his cup of tea, but he didn’t feel like drinking it.
“I’m just half-a-step away from the Chaos Realm. But this half-a-step is like a roadblock that I can’t pass through regardless!” Jiang Ming said helplessly. Following that, he blew his tea and drank slowly.
“W-w-what did you say? Did I hear wrongly?” The eyes of Riyue Changfeng were almost stuck out of its sockets.
Meanwhile, the teacup in Yun Zizai’s hand was shattered. He shivered as he said, “Half-a-step away from the Chaos Realm? Fellow Daoist Jiang, it’s not funny.”
“Why would I lie?” Jiang Ming retorted. “Because I failed to advance into the Chaos Realm, this seclusion is considered a failure.”
Both Riyue Changfeng and Yun Zizai were rendered speechless as Riyue Changfeng lowered his head while Yun Zizai looked into the sky.
“Feel defeated?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh. “C’mon, I’ve got a bottle of good wine, which I got from killing the Lord Saint Lagerstroemia. Let’s taste it together.”
“What, did you say you killed Lord Saint Lagerstroemia?” Yun Zizai felt shiver down his spine and jumped up from his seat. He was in great shock.
“It was 10 days ago!” As Jiang Ming said, the Nine Heavens Soul Depressing Bell appeared suspended before him. “This is his Lord Saint Dao Vessel, the Supreme Treasure which is considered not bad!”
As Jiang Ming said, he waved his hand. Three glasses appeared in front of him and each emanated the supreme power of Saint Weapon. Following that, Jiang Ming opened the cap of the bottle and filled the three glasses with the nine colors wine. Each color had the endless fortune of great Dao.
“Alas, the Lord Saint Lagerstroemia. I heard that he’s a tycoon!” The expression of Riyue Changfeng got more complicated.
Riyue Changfeng took a look at the bell before he shifted his focus to the glass of wine. Just a glance, his mind had been attracted to it as though he had fallen into the sea of great Dao.
“This is indeed his Supreme Treasure. I used to see him from afar.” Yun Zizai looked at Jiang Ming with fear. Following that, he lowered his head before he turned to look at the glass of wine. His pupils were dilated in shock. “This is the legendary Nine Spirits Precious Fluid, which contains nine types of delicious great Daos. Even a King Saint would benefit from it by just taking a sip. It is said that a Demi-Sage Expert can advance into the Saint Realm by just taking a sip. T-t-this is too luxurious.”
“It’s just a plunder. Do help yourself!” Jiang Ming took up a glass of the wine. He had a total of 49 bottles. Hence, it didn’t matter much to give each of them a glass of the wine.
The power in Jiang Ming’s voice sent a chill to Riyue Changfeng, which brought him back to his senses. He said with shock, “To think that I fell into it by just taking a glance at it! I felt like I was enjoying the great Dao and I’d be advancing into the Saint Realm anytime. If I drink it…”
Even though Riyue Changfeng was knowledgeable and experienced, he was astonished.
“Just help yourself with it!” Jiang Ming gestured.
“Thanks, brother Jiang!” Riyue Changfeng took a deep breath, clasped his hands and took up the glass of wine.
Correspondingly, Yun Zizai was more formal.
After drinking a glass of wine, Riyue Changfeng’s face flushed and his eyes blurred. Following that, he closed his eyes and fell into enlightenment. His blood was billowing like a tide, soaring into the sky, submerging into the torrent of void. The powerful power made the entire Infinite Realm Battlefield tremble.
“Thank you!” After Yun Zizai had drank the wine, he only managed to express thanks before his eyes were closed for enlightenment.
Jiang Ming smiled as he looked at them. Following that, he waved to put away the glasses and left.
Jiang Ming shared some of the fortune he got with them since they were considered as his friends.
Jiang Ming discovered the wine when he was checking his inventory while enjoying sex with Linglong. He had also obtained many other spiritual fruits, medicine, etc. These items had given him more confidence in nurturing disciples up to the Saint Ream.
…
On the Chuyang Peak.
By simply pointing with his hand, a giant arena appeared in the eastern sky of the Tianyuan Realm. Following that, there was a white jade ladder, which was extended into heaven. There were the same things appearing in the western sky as well.
These things were formed by Jiang Ming evoking his special abilities. With the current means available, he was capable of creating great Dao easily.
“The ladders at the east and the west are the heavenly ladder. The ladder at the east tempers one’s will while the one at the west tests one’s comprehension ability. Whoever can climb up to the 50th step of both ladders will be my disciple but I’ll only take in ten disciples.” Jiang Ming’s figure was appearing up in the sky, overseeing the entire Tianyuan Realm.
Jiang Ming’s rumbling voice was sent out to everyone in the realm. “The only limitation is that all my disciples have to be originating from the Tianyuan Realm.”
Jiang Ming smiled and lay back on the rattan chair.
One needed a strong will and comprehension ability to sanctify the way of Dao. The so-called foundation and combat power were not important at all.
‘I shall go back to the Xinghe Universe!’ Jiang Ming scanned through the Tianyuan Realm and found out that it was in a state of restlessness. There were already a great number of experts, who had been pacing towards the platform.
Jiang Ming ignored them, took out the Human Path Record and plunged into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - The Ultimate Transformation of
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: The Ultimate Transformation of the Chaotic World Tree
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Back in the Xinghe Universe, the lotus flowers were swaying with the rhythm of the wind back in the pond of an estate, permeating fragrances all around.
Luo Heng was drinking tea as he sat on the gazebo in the middle of the pond.
“Alas, the improvement of my cultivation is getting slower. How can I make my accumulation go a step further?” Luo Heng sighed.
Luo Heng was also envious of the position as the group admin. In order to get the chance of taking on the position and gaining the supreme great fortune, he hadn’t been improving his cultivation base all this while.
However, if Luo Heng didn’t improve his cultivation base, it would be far too difficult for him to seek other fortunes. By now, there was almost no improvement that he could work with in his current cultivation base.
Luo Heng was wondering what else he could do. Alas…Luo Heng let out yet another sigh of desperation.
“Why are you sighing around?”
The sudden voice startled Luo Heng and a full set of battle armor could be seen emerging around his body. However, when he saw the person opposite him, he couldn’t help but rejoice. “It’s brother Jiang! Have you finished your cultivation seclusion?”
“It’s done!” Jiang Ming made himself at home. He picked up the teapot and poured himself a cup of tea. “What about you? Why the long face?”
“Well, that’s because my cultivation has been stagnant!” Luo Heng shrugged. “I feel like my accumulation has already reached its limits. The truth is that it’s still a billion light years away from the limit, yet I don’t know how to improve anymore.”
“Stagnant?” Jiang Ming focused his gaze on Luo Heng, inspecting Luo Heng thoroughly. With a casual tap of his finger, a genetic map suddenly appeared right in front of him.
It contained a lot of information. Just the textual analysis was already ten billion words in total.
“This will allow your life genetic level to be raised another three million six hundred and fifty thousand times the basic foundation. Before advancing into the Supreme realm, this is already the limit. Once you successfully cultivate this, getting through the seven Battle Tower wouldn’t be difficult at all.” Jiang Ming took a sip of tea and continued, “As for the Heavenly Ladder?”
After a slight moment of thought, a fruit appeared in front of Jiang Ming which he handed it over to Luo Heng. “This is the Nine Cycles Soul Refining Fruit. It’s good for raising the power of will. Coupled with the tempering of the heavenly ladder, you might have the chance to reach the top.”
“Brother Jiang, this… this…” Luo Heng looked at the genetic map right in front of him and was long frozen in shock. His face was riddled with the look of shock as he muttered in confusion, “The utmost limit of our life genetic level is three hundred thousand times, isn’t it? How is it more than three million times when it comes to you?”
“I’ve just analyzed your physique and deduced a little before coming to such a conclusion and at the same time, I depicted how it can be further evolved.” Jiang Ming said with a smile, “I’m much stronger than your Supreme Expert Pan Wang. Just cultivate accordingly and you’ll be fine.”
“Brother Jiang, you’re awesome!” Astonished, Luo Heng could only give him a thumbs up. When he looked at the fruit in front of him that was emitting an aura that made even his soul tremble, he stood up and gave a respectful salute to Jiang Ming. “Brother Jiang, thank you!”
“You’re being too polite.” Jiang Ming waved.
“This isn’t being polite. This is the grace of bestowing Dao!” Luo Heng gave a wry smile. He then adjusted his emotions and asked interrogatively, “Brother Jiang, what’s your level now?
“I’m already at the perfect stage of the Lord Saint Realm!”
“Perfect stage of the Lord Saint Realm? All your physique, soul and inner world?”
“Yes!”
“God damn!”
Luo Heng’s eyes popped as his face was filled with incredulity. “All three paths are actually at the perfect stage. How long have you retreated into seclusion for? One year? Brother Jiang! It’s absolutely true that they say you’re the son of the great Dao!”
“Haha! I want to be the father of the great Dao in the future.” Jiang Ming laughed out loud as he left. At the same time, he left Luo Heng a message. “Brother Luo, hurry up with your cultivation. I’m too lonely to go forward alone.”
“Brother Jiang, don’t worry!” Luo Heng stood up and replied with an unprecedented serious tone.
After quite some time, he finally sat himself down. Looking at the genetic map in front of him, he was still extremely astonished.
“Brother Jiang, oh brother Jiang. If it weren’t for you, my achievement would only allow me to traverse the universe at most. But now…” Luo Heng raised his head and there were sea of stars in his eyes.
…
Jiang Ming got into Chaos once again. With just a glance, he saw through the illusions and discovered the ultimate Land of Origin of this universe behind layers and layers of space.
Raising his hand, he sent off a punch, opening a door into it. The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast that was devouring the origin of the Chaotic Tree was awakened almost immediately.
This was followed by a deafening roar before he discovered Jiang Ming.
“Feeble ant! You’ve finally appeared again! If I can’t kill you this time, It’d be such a shame for me to be called the Chaos Deity Demon!”
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast’s anger did not subside.
However, Jiang Ming didn’t dilly dally. He directly evoked the Chaos Dao Suppression Pagoda. With a flash of luminance, it instantly appeared on top of the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast. The supreme might that could subdue the Chaos and suppress the great Dao had caused the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast to tremble as its flesh began to crumble.
The power was too terrifying.
The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was terrified. A long lance emerged from its body, barely resisting the suppressive power with great difficulty.
“You actually have a Chaos Supreme Treasure! This aura… It’s definitely a top-notched Chaos Supreme Treasure. You feeble ant! How could you have such a great weapon?” The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast shrieked.
A chill ran down the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast spine inexplicably. It knew that if it wasn’t currently staying in the Origin of the Chaotic Tree and was able to mobilize some of its power, he would’ve been killed even if he had a Chaos Supreme Treasure as well. However, it knew that it couldn’t last long.
“Not bad. You still have some insight.” Jiang Ming snorted coldly. “Feeble ant? Well, I’ll let you see how an ant kills a Chaos Deity Demon! Die!”
Right this very moment, a sword appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand. Its aura of decimation oppressed even the infinite Dao of Chaos, causing this small space in the Chaos to stop operating.
“Another Chaos Supreme Treasure?” The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast shrieked in despair. “Wait, wait! We can talk it out…”
Pfft…Talk? What’s there to even talk about? The Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast was but only a beast. The only fate it deserved was to be served on a plate.
As the sword severed through the air, it cut through all orders and laws and slashed onto the head of the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast.
With the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda’s suppression on top, the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast wasn’t able to dodge at all.
The beast wasn’t able to resist at all. He could only evoke yet another Lord Saint Dao Vessel but was slashed right through with one fell swoop. Its head was split open and its enormous body the size of a few light years was split in half.
When faced with the killing power of a Chaos Supreme Treasure, even the Lord Saint Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast who had all kinds of eternal means of immortality had ended up being decimated cleanly and thoroughly.
The beast was completely and ultimately dead. There was no doubt about it.
“In the face of a higher level of power, the so-called longevity and eternity would all be mere false propositions.” Jiang Ming muttered.
Jiang Ming was still worried that the beast was yet to have died completely. Hence, he evoked the Human Path Record to be assured of its death.
As Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed with his hand, the various spoils of the battle that were in the enormous body of that Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast flew over to him one after another.
Following that, Jiang Ming kept the beast’s body in his inner world to be temporarily suppressed there. It was a great ingredient and must not be digested by his inner world.
‘Good gracious, so many Dao Vessels!’ After checking the loot, even Jiang Ming was taken aback.
Not to mention those Saint Weapons which were in the ten thousands, there were hundreds of King Saint Weapons. There were even quite many Lord Saint Weapons, totaling up to 36 of them. Besides, there was also the lance that was used by the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast. It was clearly the Chaos Supreme Treasure, the Dao Exterminating Lance.
Needless to say, there were many other kinds of stuff as well.
“So this is the horrifying being that terrorized a part of the Chao’s Origin?”
However, Jiang Ming shook his head at his own question. It was apparent that it wasn’t. After all, the beast only had one Chaos Supreme Treasure.
After putting away the many spoils, his pair of divine eyes peered through the illusions and looked over at the Chaotic Tree from the inside, analyzing it.
Sure enough, the Chaos Tree was in a withering stage and only a huge amount of power of origin would shine a ray of life to it. In fact, this was also the real reason why it was very difficult for the Xinghe Universe to accommodate a King Saint.
“Go!” After some hesitation, Jiang Ming released the Chaotic World Tree from his inner world and directly integrated it into the Origin of this galaxy’s Chaotic Tree.
His precious tree immediately emitted a greedy divine luminance. Its roots and whiskers swayed around before embedding into it. Each leaf seemed to have transformed into black holes. Asthe leaves were expanding rapidly, they were absorbing the power of origin frantically.
This was a plunder.
Jiang Ming however, sat down and merged his subconscious into it to prevent any accidents.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - Sanctifying the Dao of Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Sanctifying the Dao of Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The Chaotic World Tree was too huge that if it were to manifest itself, it would’ve burst his inner world. The power contained in it was naturally terrifying as well.
It was currently plundering the World Tree of this Sea of Chaos at an extremely rapid pace.
Jiang Ming remained seated. His mind was integrated into the process. As the World Tree grew rapidly, his own mind and will was also nourished and enhanced at the same time. The enhancement was above the limits.
This made Jiang Ming become even more excited. With a swift turn, he integrated himself entirely into the origin of his World Tree.
As time flowed, Jiang Ming’s heart shook and revealed a joyful look on his face.
The shackles of his soul had been shattered. He had broken through the confinement and elevated into a higher level, the Chaos Realm!
This elevation was alongside the nourishment of the World Tree. However, even though the World Tree was still rapidly growing, the improvement of his primal soul had become extremely slow.
‘I thought that it would be extremely difficult to advance into the Chaos Realm!’ After the exhilaration, Jiang Ming even had a feeling that this was somewhat a child’s play.
He didn’t manage to improve even when he was in the Hongmeng Primordial Land. However, he was able to surpass the limits here instead.
‘Alas, the Chaotic World Tree! It’s truly my supreme treasure of Dao Enlightenment indeed!’
Jiang Ming still didn’t get up but instead, comprehended the growth and changes that were brought upon the World Tree.
Time passed by slowly before the World Tree finally swallowed the entire Chaotic Tree of the galaxy here.
‘It’s been one whole decade.’ Jiang Ming finally stood up and couldn’t help but lament. To him, ten years of seclusion in the real world was already considered a very long time.
As he focused his gaze, he discovered that his World Tree had replaced the original World Tree here. In the midst of the endless space of the Sea of Chaos, its countless incomparably green branches were swaying around. A single tiny branch was already reaching more than a trillion light years in length. Such an enormous tree had almost occupied one percent of the Sea of Chaos already. This was extremely terrifying.
‘With the volume of the World Tree, it’s definitely thousands of times or even ten thousand times stronger than other sentient beings of the same level.’
Jiang Ming was extremely shocked himself. On the contrary, when Jiang Ming looked at the small Chaos, where Xinghe Universe was located, in front of him, he already knew that it was actually a chiliocosm that had been nurtured by the former World Tree. It used to be located within the internal space of the World Tree all the while but it had now been integrated into his own inner world.
Because of Jiang Ming, the small Chaos remained undisturbed.
‘If the World Tree wants to complete itself perfectly, it will still need to nurture its own chiliocosm. What about the Xinghe Universe?’ Jiang Ming frowned as he pondered.
With a slight thought, Jiang Ming directly teleported Pan Wang, who was meditating back in the galaxy, to where he was.
This expert noticed it almost immediately and had a shocked look on his face. Just as he was about to strike, he realized that the person in front of him was Jiang Ming and that the surrounding area was filled with chaotic air currents. He couldn’t help but become shocked as he said, “Fellow Daoist Jiang, did you just teleport me into the Chaos?”
“I have something to discuss with you.” Jiang Ming smiled. “I’ve brought you over on my own accord. Please excuse me for my actions.”
“I don’t even dare to!” Pan Wang who was still shocked, couldn’t help but ask, “Fellow Daoist Jiang, may I ask what realm are you currently in?”
“Glancing through the entire Chaos would be a mere thought.”
“A mere thought and you’ll be able to see through the entire Chaos. Hiss… this is really unimaginable!”
“With your talents, you’ll be able to reach such a stage in the future as well.”
“Can I?” Pan Wang shook his head. “When I advanced into the King Saint Realm, I could already feel that my potential had been exhausted. I can no longer go further, even if it’s just a subtle improvement.”
“Well if that’s the case, I’m here to bestow a great fortune upon you.” Jiang Ming smiled.
“Fellow Daoist, what great fortune are you saying?” Pan Wang became excited. The greatest intention he had now was to improve his cultivation base and check out the world of the higher level. He had long lost interest in the cycle of the mundane world, grudges and feuds. Hence, apart from protecting his own race, what he thought of most was to improve himself.
“This small Chaos in front here is the internal space of the World Tree. With the great Dao being shackled in there, it’s natural that the improvement of your cultivation base is limited.”
“Hold on, fellow Daoist Jiang. Are you saying that this here is the internal space of the World Tree?” Pan Wang was flabbergasted.
Wouldn’t this be equivalent to having opened an internal world and breed living beings within? Even with his temperament, Pan Wang was feeling confused as well.
“Yes you’re right.” Jiang Ming guffawed. “This World Tree is at the supreme Chaos Realm. It has truly reached the limits of the Chaos Realm. It wanted to transcend the Chaos and sanctify the supreme great Dao but instead suffered a backlash and died. Its original self was withering and the internal spaces within were naturally shrinking gradually. That is why there are limits towards your cultivation base. It’s also the reason why there can only be one universe in this galaxy of yours. It’s the last ray of life after its death. However, if this ray of life was to fail, this place will become a place of extinction, a place of death.”
These were some of the information that Jiang Ming had come to understand after his own World Tree had devoured the World tree of the galaxy here.
If he hadn’t come here, there would only be two scenarios unfolding here. One of them would be the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast completely devouring the entire Chaotic Tree and the Xinghe Universe would be destroyed. The other scenario would be the Chaotic Tree lost its vitality and the galaxy here destroyed.
Whichever the scenario was, it basically meant the end of this place.
Jiang Ming also understood what had happened to the Valley of the End here. It was because when the Chaotic Tree was suffering a backlash and withered, the ripple effect had affected the Valley of the End. Hence, it caused the area which was originally opened near to the origin of the World Tree to shrink. It became a huge valley in which all experts that were beyond the King Saint Realm died, leaving only a relic behind.
Upon hearing Jiang Ming’s remark, Pan Wang was once again in a daze. The Valley of the End, the Chaos Universe Annihilation Beast, the World Tree transcending and withering, and the inner world. Even a person with insight like him had a feeling that he was listening to myths and legends.
“The original withered Chaotic Tree is now replaced by my World Tree. This place here will also be transformed into a small Chaos space, where no living beings can exist. I’m thinking of moving the Xinghe Universe of yours into the real Sea of Chaos. From there on out, the shackles of the great Dao would be unraveled and there would no longer be a restriction. Whoever has the ability would be able to advance into the King Saint, Lord Saint or even the Chaos Realm. Fellow Daoist, what do you think?” Jiang Ming asked.
“Fellow Daoist, let it be as you’ve said!” Pan Wang gave a jolt and hurriedly nodded his head.
Pan Wang knew that it was a gesture of politeness that Jiang Ming would ask for his opinion. Hence, how could he still not know what was good and what was not? Moreover, once his universe was moved over, he would be able to continue improving his cultivation base.
He cheered inwardly but asked with hesitation, “Will there be a difference between the internal and external Chaos? Once we move to the external Chaos, will our universe be able to withstand the invasion from the Chaos?”
“Don’t worry.” Jiang Ming said, “I will place your universe under the World Tree, which will provide a certain amount of protection.”
As Jiang Ming said so, the immense power of his Chaos Soul had surrounded the Xinghe Universe with just a thought. Everything leapt through in the air, going through barriers. Even Pan Wang and his own figure was quickly turning into illusions.
When they reappeared, they were already standing atop of an incomparably wide and endlessly long river of stars. In fact, it wasn’t a river of stars, but a single tree branch.
After Jiang Ming stood firmly, he raised his arms and pointed with his finger. A bubble appeared in the distance and it began to swell rapidly, stirring up an infinite amount of chaotic airflow in a blink of an eye, before ending up transforming into a terrifying Great Universe.
However, the chaotic airflow was incomparably violent. It was trying to annihilate the universe but was blocked off by a green luminance. The ranging chaotic airflow quickly calmed down and became gentle.
Pan Wang who appeared right next to Jiang Ming, saw the whole process. He couldn’t help exposing the shocked look on his face.
After quite some time, as Pan Wang looked up and down, he couldn’t help twitching the corner of his mouth fiercely.
‘This right below me is a branch? The universe that I am in is just a tiny ball below this tree? I can’t see the entire appearance of the tree even with my current cultivation base? The branch beneath my feet contains thousands of times more power than me?’ Pan Wang’s perception of the universe was completely turned upside down.
“Only now can I be considered to have opened my eyes, to have seen the great Dao!” Pan Wang sighed continuously. There was a joyful look on his face. “I feel the disappearance of the supreme shackles which have been suppressing my cultivation base. It has completely disappeared! This feeling… It feels like I’m a dragon cruising through the void.”
Buzz… Right this very moment, Pan Wang’s aura actually began to soar, directly breaking through the limits of the early stage of King Saint, advancing into the middle stage. Surprisingly, it didn’t end there, but continued rising rapidly.
Because of the elevation of his cultivation base, Pan Wang had also attracted a large volume of chaotic air flow towards his body, becoming sustenance towards his improvement.
Jiang Ming waved, directed a wisp of the creation qi from the World Tree infusing into Pan Wang’s body, causing his aura to sky rocket up to the peak of King Saint Realm.
Jiang Ming nodded his head and smiled. This explosive elevation of power was due to the accumulation of Pan Wang all these while. In other words, it was because of Pan Wang’s incomparable talent and aptitude.
Following that, Jiang Ming shifted his focus towards another truly talented person of the ages walking out of Xinghe Universe. He was Xi.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - The Eternity In a Moment
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: The Eternity In a Moment
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Back in Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming was lying down on a rattan chair, swaying leisurely.
Jiang Ming had just returned from the Xinghe Universe. He didn’t bring back the World Tree as it had entered the state of ultimate transformation and was still continuously growing and evolving.
Jiang Ming had also settled the issues of the Xinghe Universe. Meanwhile, Pan Wang had attained the peak stage of King Saint Realm.
Xi, the supreme expert of a generation, who came out of the galaxy, had taken the initiative to detach from the original galaxy’s origin. He condensed himself a physical body, grew rapidly and leapt into the Lord Saint Realm. Xi was truly terrifying. He was a person with both unparalleled wisdom and talent as well as the potential of advancing into the Chaos Realm.
Jiang Ming had a long chat with him before leaving.
“Senior Brother!” Linglong landed right next to him with a grumpy look on her face. “This cultivation retreat of yours is way too long. How many years has it been since you left? The avatar that you left behind wasn’t that much of a use.”
“It’s only been ten years or so, hasn’t it?” Jiang Ming was at a loss for words. “You little brat. You’re just yearning for a beating. Just look at you! It’s been years’ time and your cultivation hasn’t improved much.”
“I’m just waiting for you. When you’re here, my cultivation will soar by leaps and bounds. Cultivating myself is too laborious and slow.” Linglong directly lay herself right beside him and she squeezed through with all her might. “Hurry up and give me some space.”
“You’ve grown fat.”
“What did you say? How dare you call me fat!”
The two of them continued bickering, whispering in private.
She had abdicated from the position as the Heavenly Emperor. Chang Yiming took over. Backed by the Tianyuan Realm, he didn’t need to worry about his weak cultivation realm.
Riyue Changfeng who was still at Tianyuan Sea had already advanced into the Saint Realm. Since he had already sanctified his way of Dao, he was in even less of a hurry to leave. He even said that the great fortune that he might gather by wandering the infinite world, was not even greater than Brother Jiang’s slight guidance and blessings. Hence, leaving would make him a silly billy.
In ten years’ time, a lot had changed within the Tianyuan Realm. Many experts had emerged. However, most of the cultivators would still go to the east and west sides to challenge the two heavenly ladders for a breakthrough. Yet, it was unfortunate that none of them have reached the top so far.
“Too useless.” Jiang Ming sighed.
“Useless?” Linglong pouted her mouth. “Just look at the difficulty that you’ve set up for the heavenly ladders. Take the heavenly ladder that tests the will for example, you’d need to be at least at the Saint Realm in order to reach the top. Overlooking the entire world, how many have reached such a realm? Although the cultivation condition of our Tianyuan Realm is very good already, the time we have is still too short. From my estimation, it would be quite good if you manage to take in one disciple in a thousand years’ time.”
“One in a thousand years?” Jiang Ming had the urge to scratch his head.
“No! The heavenly ladder is not only a test but also a training. If the person manages to seize the great fortune that I’ve left in the heavenly ladder, it wouldn’t be difficult.”
“It’s not difficult for you maybe.” Linglong rolled her eyes.
Jiang Ming took a glance and didn’t pay further attention to it. With one’s will not even reaching the Saint Realm, how would it be possible for oneself to sanctify the path of Dao? It would be simply impossible. As for the comprehension capability? One would at least need to be at a heaven-defying level.
Therefore, Jiang Ming had decided to ignore them. After all, with Jiang Ming’s current cultivation base at the Chaos Realm, the four Chaos Supreme Weapons that he possessed and also the World Tree as his ultimate weapon, it was already enough for him to traverse the vast and endless Sea of Chaos. At least, he could enjoy an efficiable life.
“Senior brother.”
“Hmm?”
“Over at my inheritance, there is news about a huge event taking place in the Chaos Primordial Land in a hundred years’ time. There will be great fortunes within and I’m asked to go for it and also return to the land of my true master.”
“A huge event? Is there no details?”
“There aren’t many details about it. Senior brother, should I go? This is an order from the sect. If I don’t go, I’m afraid my inheritance will become difficult.”
“You’re still caring about the inheritance?”
“Hehe! You are my greatest inheritance.”
“Haha! Good that you know. A hundred years’ time you say? It’s still early. We’ll talk about it when it comes.”
“Even with guidance, a hundred years’ time to reach the Chaos Primordial Land would be quite hasty. However, it isn’t much of a problem to you anyway. I’ll listen to you on everything.”
“That’s the right way to do it! This is what it means by you being the head of internal affairs while I as the head of external affairs.”
“You’re more of the head of internal affairs.”
“Huh? How so?”
“Well, haven’t you been entering the internal part of me daily?”
Pfft… Jiang Ming couldn’t hold back himself anymore. He directly conjured 10,000 avatars. When Linglong saw this, she couldn’t help but cover her mouth and laughed. She also conjured many avatars and summoned her nine other clones as well.
All of a sudden, an earth-shattering battle broke out. Stars exploded, black holes collapsed as a devastating fluid of pure Yang came gushing out, flooding the vast starry sky…
This great battle lasted for a full century in a small space that they had created before coming to an end.
Coming out of the space of reversed time, Jiang Ming lay down again. He rubbed his back, which was quite sore and soft.
However, Jiang Ming smiled. It was because Linglong had fallen asleep.
As the sun was setting in the west, its luminance painted the entire sky scarlet red.
Jiang Ming stood up and stretched himself. When he looked over to the other side and saw the many cooking utensils, he smiled and made himself a meal.
Eating had become a habit of his.
In just a short time, ramen, knife-cut noodle, fried noodle, minced-meat noodle and the likes… All 81 noodle dishes had appeared on the table.
‘Now this is life!’ Jiang Ming ate with great satisfaction.
Following that, Jiang Ming lay back on the rattan chair while patting on his stomach and looking at the hazy night sky. Inexplicably letting out a sigh, he recalled his previous life that was a long time ago.
‘Where exactly did I come from?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but ponder.
Did this so-called past life of his really exist? Or was it all a dream? When he thought about it carefully sometimes, he would become confused.
Finally, Jiang Ming shook his head and suppressed the thoughts.
‘Alas, the Chaos Primordial Land. I must go there and take a look someday, now…’ Jiang Ming paused the thoughts running through his mind.
Jiang Ming didn’t ask Hong Zhan about the great event that was about to happen in a hundred years’ time. With a thought in his heart, he directly entered the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda.
Jiang Ming’s strength had sky-rocketed and his cultivation base had greatly improved. Hence, he thought it was time for him to settle his cultivation. After all, even though he was strong, his various special abilities couldn’t keep up the pace and became the short end instead.
Sitting down cross-legged, Jiang Ming was pondering where he should start.
‘The Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique has unlimited potential and cannot be discarded. I just don’t know if I am able to deduce it to the level of manipulating supreme Chaos weapons? There’s also the Infinite Transcendence Technique. I used to think that I have to merge the past body, present body and future body into one to improve. Although this is a way of improvement, it would be incredibly difficult to go beyond the three bodies. However…’
Between the flows of thoughts, various ideas flooded Jiang Ming’s mind. Other than these two techniques, the other technique he had was the Return of Infinite Law Finger technique.
‘I’ll need to deduce a pure Soul Dao technique and Physique technique as well.’
This was also a direction for Jiang Ming. He had been mainly focusing on his cultivation path previously.
However, now that Jiang Ming had advanced into such a level, his special abilities needed the corresponding laws of Dao in order for him to bring out his real power. His control of the laws was still too low and the only special ability that was presentable was the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique.
‘And I’ll need to figure out a way to further improve my great chiliocosm…’
Jiang Ming had a bit of a headache. Based on the norm, great chiliocosm was the maximum level for one’s inner world. However, Jiang Ming knew that this was extremely far from the end. When his World Tree engulfed the Chaotic tree, he already had a vague assumption but he wasn’t sure about it. He still needed to seek some validation.
Even if Jiang Ming knew that there was a way forward, he didn’t know how he could go on. He found it difficult to go through it as well.
‘The great Dao knows no bounds. I shall just seek it slowly.’ Jiang Ming lamented. Following that, he closed his eyes for self-precipitation of his cultivation.
Whether it was the accumulated precipitation of his inner world or the sorting of his own power, he needed to analyze them all thoroughly.
A moment of eternity went by in a snap of a finger. Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak once again. It had just been a blink of an eye since he left. However, his aura had become extremely cold. It felt as cold as ice, as rigid as the rock from the eternal times.
‘Alas, long cultivation really makes it easy for one to forget about oneself’s emotions and about himself. This would eventually lead to the coldness of reasoning step but step. Once the person loses his life goal, one would either fall into a demonic state or turn into Dao.’
Jiang Ming didn’t lay down but instead, he went over to his kitchen and started making himself a meal.
A drink and a meal were the warmth of the human realm.
After Jiang Ming had taken ample food and drinks, coupled with the readjustment of himself, he cut away a lot of false memories and his indifference aura had mostly dissipated.
Following that, Jiang Ming brewed himself a pot of tea, lay on the rattan chair and swayed leisurely. After taking a sip of tea, his subconsciousness entered the Great Dao Group.
He was ready to find Hong Zhan to ask about the Chaos Realm and also how to allow his inner world to advance further.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - The Ultimate Evolution of Inner World
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: The Ultimate Evolution of Inner World
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the Great Dao Group.
[Jiang Ming: Are you guys around?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I am, I’m around. Brother Jiang Ming, why is your seclusion this time taking so long? It’s been more than 10 years already.]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang, I’m around.]
[Jiang Ming: Greeting to you two, my dear sisters! I somewhat felt like it, hence I continued for a longer time.]
[Hong Zhan: It’s not considered long for a Lord Saint. That Lord Saint in my clan would take thousands of years as a unit even if he’s just taking a nap.]
[Ao Jiu: You’re here to show off again.]
[Di Huo: What to do when he’s extremely lucky? He’s not only born in a tyrannical clan, but also has a sky-defying physique. I’m not only feeling envious and jealous, but also hateful.]
[Hong Zhan: Haha, in that case, just be envious.]
[Hong Yi: Mr Hong, you’re getting more shameless of yourself.]
[Wang Ye: Shouldn’t you pay attention to Brother Jiang? It’s fine if he doesn’t show up. Once he does, he’ll be even more aggressive than Lao Hong.]
[Ao Jiu: Brother Jiang is indeed an exhibitionist. However, I respect him because he deserves it.]
[Di Huo: Brother Jiang is truly the exhibitionist.]
[Tian Fozi: Brother Jiang, what’s your current cultivation base? Don’t tell me that you are already at the Chaos Realm.]
[Hong Zhan: Chaos Realm? How’s it possible? Even in the entire Chaos Primordial Land, it’s been so many great epochs since ancient times, but there aren’t many Chaos Experts at all. There are only eight Chaos Experts, who are known. Hence, on average, there’d be only one Chaos Expert every thousands of great epochs. A great epoch is akin to a life cycle of a great chiliocosm from the time it was born to it was destroyed. What a vast torrent of time it is, isn’t it? It’s long enough to make all living beings despair.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: But brother Jiang is an exception.]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang is indeed an exception.]
[Luo Heng: We have to admit that brother Jiang is an exception. Look at the total time he has used to advance into the Lord Saint. Hence, it’s utterly possible for brother Jiang to advance into the Chaos Realm in this more than 10 years of seclusion even though it’s beyond my cognition.]
[Feng Wu: Alas, the Chaos Realm. It’s the realm that I learned not long ago. Brother Jiang, you haven’t really advanced into this realm, have you?]
[Hong Yi: Based on what Mr. Hong has said, the Chaos Experts are the supreme beings who overwhelm the Chaos. One would never achieve it if he had no sky-defying fortune, enlightenment, will and the blessings of the great Dao. If he were to be someone else whose talent is astonishing, I wouldn’t believe it. However, if he was brother Jiang… It’s hard to say, really hard to say.]
[Wang Ye: Yes, it’s too hard to say. Brother Jiang, do quickly reveal the answer to whether you have truly advanced into the Chaos Realm.]
[Xu Wuji: Looking forward to the answer. I’m waiting to ride on brother Jiang’s coattails.]
[Ming Fei: Looking forward to the answer. I’m waiting to ride on brother Jiang’s coattails.]
[Di Huo: Looking forward to the answer. I’m waiting to ride on brother Jiang’s coattails.]
[Ao Jiu: Mr. Huo, do you believe that brother Jiang would kick you away if you were to ride on his coattails? After all, your name means fire in Mandarin. Hence, you’d burn brother Jiang easily if you were to ride on his coattails.]
[Di Huo: Pfft…Spitting blood 3,000 feet long.]
[Tian Fozi: This guy has never said anything good. However, what to do when my mind has been visualizing it already?]
[Jiang Ming: …]
[Jiang Ming: I’ve just sanctified the Dao of Chaos Realm.]
[Jiang Ming: Don’t think too much, you guys can’t even reach my coattails to ride on it.]
[Di Huo: What the f*ck, are you truly in the Chaos Realm?]
[Hong Zhan: What the f*ck, are you truly in the Chaos Realm?]
[Hong Yi: My goodness, are you truly in the Chaos Realm?]
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, are you serious?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang is amazing.]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang, I can’t spot your back even if I lifted my head to look into the vast milky way.]
[Luo Heng: Can’t spot him even traverse the Chaos! How long has it been? To think that brother Jiang has advanced into the Chaos Realm is indeed unbelievable and incredible.]
[Tian Fozi: Shouldn’t you pay attention to not being able to even reach brother Jiang’s coattails? By the way, I wonder if one of the leg hairs of brother Jiang is comparable to a Saint Weapon?]
[Ao Jiu: Ffft…]
[Ao Jiu: What an interesting focus point. Since brother Jiang is also tempering his physique, a leg hair of his may be comparable to the Saint Weapon.]
[Hong Zhan: You guys have been undervaluing the Chaos Realm too much. Even if the physique of brother Jiang is just in the Lord Saint Realm, a leg hair of his is probably capable of subduing a Saint Weapon.]
[Hong Yi: Does it mean that we aren’t even comparable to one leg hair of brother Jiang?]
[Wang Ye: Can we stop talking about hair? We should be happy for brother Jiang, who’s advanced into the Chaos Realm. After all, we have a real tycoon to be our support!]
[Wang Ye: Brother Jiang, when will you come to the Chaos Primordial Land so that we can traverse the world with your name.]
[Di Huo: This is a great idea indeed!]
[Hong Zhan: Now I have the support of two supreme Chaos Experts already. Haha, who else can be comparable in this Chaos Primordial Land.]
[Hong Yi: We don’t have to be afraid of being bullied from now onwards. Mr. Hong, you said that you’re coming to pick me up, a long time has passed but why aren’t you here yet?]
[Hong Zhan: Almost there. Don’t worry, I’ll be arriving soon.]
[Wang Ye: Mr. Hong, when you get him, I’ll immediately ascend to great chiliocosm. By that time, you two can come to pick me up together.]
[Ao Jiu: And me too!]
[Di Huo: Count me in!]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang, when do you plan to go to the Sea of Chaos?]
[Wang Ye: Looking forward.]
[Di Huo: Looking forward.]
[Jiang Ming: I’ll just wait a little bit longer. However, you guys can go first if you want to. Immediately let me know when any of you is in danger. I’ll protect you!]
[Ye Qingxian: You’re awesome. I’m not in a rush yet.]
[Di Huo: Wao, with the promise of a supreme existence in the Chaos Realm, I’m safe.]
[Ao Jiu: Safe!]
[Hong Zhan: Since our safety won’t be an issue, we’ll definitely sanctify the path of our great Dao.]
[Jiang Ming: Brother Hong, do you know how to sanctify the Dao of the Chaos Realm? How to further improve the inner world of great chiliocosm?]
[Hong Zhan: I thought you have sanctified the Dao of the Chaos Realm already?]
[Jiang Ming: It’s only my soul that has completed its passive transformation and advanced into the Chaos Realm.]
[Hong Zhan: What the f*ck, is that workable too?]
[Hong Zhan: Unbelievable.]
[Hong Zhan: The soul can undergo passive transformation up to the Chaos Realm?]
[Hong Zhan: I haven’t heard about it before.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, how great is the encounter you have got? No, it must be the fortune the great Dao has personally given to you. Otherwise, it’s definitely not possible to do so.]
[Hong Zhan: I’ve indeed learned something new.]
The other members were in a state of confusion. But none of them chimed in. They were only checking the messages quietly.
[Jiang Ming: Isn’t it a norm for me to break the rules and laws?]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, others are usually a braggart but you’re indeed amazing.]
[Hong Zhan: When you said you’ve advanced into the King Saint Realm, I’ve inquired about the characteristics of the corresponding realm. Let me just briefly explain its general framework.]
[Hong Zhan: In great chiliocosms, the proper cultivation of Dao is to comprehend the so-called Natural Laws of Heaven. Meanwhile, outside of great chiliocosm, it’s about comprehending the rhythm of Chaos or the heart of Chaos.]
[Hong Zhan: To advance into the Lord Saint Realm, one would have to comprehend a law. The deeper the comprehension, one would be able to go further as a Lord Saint Expert. When one managed to comprehend a Chaos Law thoroughly, he or she would have achieved the perfect stage of the Lord Saint.]
[Hong Zhan: As for advancing into the Chaos Realm? Based on my clan’s great monarch and some written records, it’s to master a Chaos Law.]
[Hong Zhan: Guys, although these are just a few sentences, they are great secrets. Hence, please don’t simply leak out, or you may be killed just because of the secret quite easily.]
[Hong Zhan: In general, sanctifying Dao is a step-by-step process. But you…]
[Hong Zhan: Scratching my head.]
[Hong Zhan: To think that you are not becoming a Dao Patriarch of Soul by mastering the Chaos Law of Soul but directly transforming the essence of your soul into the Chaos Realm, it’s what I can’t understand. It’s gone beyond my understanding indeed.]
[Hong Zhan: As for the Physique Dao? One can comprehend the Chaos Law of Power, the Chaos Law of Material, the Chaos Law of Infinitude and the likes to strengthen one’s physique. As for the method of purely tempering the physique, it’s extremely difficult to advance into the Chaos Realm. And I have not heard about anyone using this method at all.]
[Hong Zhan: For Soul Dao, one can just comprehend the Chaos Law of Soul.]
[Hong Zhan: As for improving the inner world up to the ultimate limit of the great chiliocosm, I’m not sure about it. But I assume that it should be about evolving the Chaos. Because there isn’t such a person who’s achieved that in the Chaos Primordial Land, I’m afraid that even my clan’s great monarch doesn’t even know how to achieve that. Brother Jiang, after I’ve picked up Hong Yi, I’ll ask my clan’s great monarch for you.]
[Hong Zhan: I personally think that it’s all about comprehending the Chaos Law regardless of which path you’re taking!]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, with your soul has directly undergone the transformation and the ultimate sublimation to advance into the Chaos Realm, I think it’d be very easy for you to reverse the sequence and comprehend the Chaos Law of Soul now. I’m just wondering if your soul would undergo another transformation again and whether your soul would become even stronger?]
[Hong Zhan: In fact, I’m still in shock.]
[Hong Zhan: Of course, what I’m looking forward to most is that if you have evolved a Chaos in your inner world and master the 3,000 Chaos Laws. What the f*ck, I wonder how terrifying you will be?]
This expert from the Chaos Primordial Land had revealed all things he knew without holding back.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - The Dao Patriarch of Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: The Dao Patriarch of Soul
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming had a systematic understanding of the Chaos Realm. It was just about comprehending the Chaos Law.
‘Chaos, Chaos, I wonder if it’s Hongmeng Realm after Chaos Realm?’ As Jiang Ming was thinking, he had one billion thoughts running through his mind in just an instant.
Thinking through with wisdom, Jiang Ming had hatched a rough future plan based on his personal condition, the information he had gotten from devouring the Chaotic Tree, and the enlightenment he had obtained after the transformation of his soul.
…
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming took a glance at the heavenly ladders of both west and east sides and shook his head helplessly. If such a situation remained the same, it would take a long while for him to nurture ten Saint Experts.
Therefore, he had been thinking about whether he should give them some fortunes. With his means, it was absolutely a piece of cake for him to nurture ten Saints in a short period of time. However, because these ten people were to be his disciples, he had to be serious about it.
‘Well, let’s just use some other methods!’ As Jiang Ming was pondering, he waved his hands and a total of 49 stars appeared in the sky. Following that, he sent a thought to the mind of all beings in the Tianyuan Realm. “There are a total of 49 Saint Weapons, which have evolved into 49 worlds. Within them are life-and-death dangers and also great fortunes. You are free to choose.”
In the Heaven Court, Chang Yiming who had just taken over the position as the Heavenly Emperor, shifted his focus to the Tianyuan Realm. He couldn’t help but shake his head as he smiled wryly. “Forty-nine Saint Weapons! Alas, Head Disciple Jiang, your action is truly earth-shattering.”
Chang Yiming left an avatar of him back in the Chuyang Peak. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have learned about it.
‘I wonder if it’s a mistake that I take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor?’ Chang Yiming couldn’t help to think about it.
…
On the arena outside Jiuyang’s great hall. It was paved with immortal jade, flowing with innate qi and Dao fluctuations of creation. Even Jiuyang’s great hall had long become a palace of Demi-Sage Dao Vessel.
At this time, the Sect Master, Gu Hai, and the others were all there. When they looked up into the sky and saw the 49 blinking stars, they were excited and at the same time, they felt sophisticated.
“A total of 49 training grounds formed by Saint Weapons, it’s absolutely beyond our imaginable limit.” The Sect Master was lost for words. “Mr. Gu, what cultivation base has the Saint Lord achieved?”
The Lord Saint was used as the honorable title for Jiang Ming. Even the Sect Leader was not exempted to address Jiang Ming with this title.
“Who knows.” Gu Hai shrugged while his face filled with a smile of pride. “As long as he’s my disciple.”
The Sect Leader pouted, feeling rather jealous. How great it would be if Jiang Ming was his disciple. Even though this old brat Gu Hai didn’t cultivate much, his cultivation realm had been improved up to the perfect stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm with various spiritual items. If he were to be Gu Hai, he would have sanctified his way of Dao.
As these thoughts popped up in the Sect Leader’s mind, he immediately cut off these improper thoughts. He furtively shook his head. ‘With my personal achievement currently, there aren’t many people in infinite realms who can be compared to me. Yet, I actually have these evil thoughts.”
…
On Chuyang Peak.
Jiang Ming slightly moved his soul, the invisible and intangible power radiated directly to the sky and came to the Chaos. With just a thought, the soul power extended out to 30,000 trillion light-years away. It had gone through countless numbers of great chiliocosms, and Jiang Ming began to comprehend the operation of Chaos’s creation.
While comprehending, the soul power continued to spread out. It didn’t take long to reach a massive land. The land was so huge that it was measured in light years. Inside it was filled with innate spiritual qi and many strong aura. Jiang Ming realized that it was the Chaos Primordial Land.
Jiang Ming didn’t explore further, but he carefully comprehend the changes in the Chaos. In no time, he felt the rhythm of the Chaos.
The Chaos was so vast and boundless that even a Chaos Expert might not find its end. In such a massive Chaos, it was natural that it had an extremely complex structure. However, amidst the Chaos was a source of power and the intersection of order. This was commonly known as the heart of the Chaos, or the rhythm of the Chaos.
One generally needed to comprehend the rhythm of the Chaos to advance into the King Saint Realm. However, it was another way round for Jiang Ming. With the supreme soul quality, it was naturally a piece of cake for Jiang Ming to comprehend the rhythm of the Chaos.
Through the rhythm of the Chaos, Jiang Ming gradually discovered the order of the Chaos which was the most compatible with himself. It was the Chaos Law of Soul.
Jiang Ming fixated on it. On this day, his figure suddenly disappeared. When he reappeared, he had got to a space 100 billion light years away from the Honggu Great Chiliocosm.
At this time, a supreme aura emanated from Jiang Ming. Meanwhile, there was another supreme Dao fluctuation descended from within the Chaos, fused with the aura of Jiang Ming and merged with his soul. In an instant, it had spread to the entire Chaos.
The Chaos trembled leading to a pause in the operation of all great chiliocosms. But those sentient beings within great chiliocosms didn’t feel it.
Only those Saint Experts traveling across the Chaos, numerous ferocious beasts, innate deity demons and the likes, fell by a sudden boundless divine might. All of them were shocked.
In the Chaos Primordial Land, the heaven trembled, violet qi permeated the entire heaven and an extremely thick chain traversed the sky.
Aura of boundless, divine, ancient, eternal, long-lasting, supreme, noble, great and the likes poured down like a river. The intimidating aura had made all living beings worship it.
Even an ancient tycoon was awakened from his retreat. When he looked up, he was shocked when he saw the Hongmeng Violet Qi which had permeated the entire sky and the thick chain.
“There’s another being who’s sanctified the Dao of Chaos Realm.”
“Who’s he?”
“He’s not located in the Chaos Primordial Land.”
“This is the Soul Dao, the Dao Patriarch of Soul has appeared. We’ve now lost another path to the great Dao.”
“The Hongmeng Qi has reappeared. Unfortunately, it’s an illusion just to congratulate the new Dao Patriarch and can’t be refined for absorption.”
“Have you all got it?”
“No!”
“Any target?”
“Those who are at the ultimate limit of the Lord Saint Realm and are able to sanctify their Dao, are still cultivating in the Primordial Land. Hence, this new Chaos Expert is definitely not one of them.”
“It’s weird then.”
Those ancient beings were communicating silently.
On the other hand, Hong Zhan and Hong Yi had gotten together. The intimidating might had also made the two fall on the ground. They looked up with difficulty.
“This is a vision of someone sanctifying the supreme Dao of Chaos Realm. I’ve seen its description from the records in my clan.” Hong Zhan revealed a shock on his face. “It’s difficult for this Chaos Primordial Land here to have a vision, let alone a vision which encompasses such a vast area.”
“Can it be coming from brother Jiang?” Hong Yi suggested. “It’s probably his second time sanctifying the Dao.”
“It should be him, definitely him. Brother Jiang is indeed, indeed a creator of miracles!” Hong Zhan smiled wryly. “It’s such a joke that I wasn’t convinced and even wanted to challenge him!”
“Both of us are peerless geniuses, but he’s the son of the great Dao. Hence, we can’t be compared at all.” Hong Yi laughed. “Let’s just ask him!”
In the Great Dao Group.
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, are you the one who’s sanctified the Dao?]
[Hong Yi: Brother Jiang, we’re looking for clarification.]
[Jiang Ming: I’m in the Chaos, sanctifying Dao.]
The members of the group were shocked.
Not long after that, the vision had disappeared thoroughly. However, the Chaos Primordial Land was in an uproar.
Meanwhile, in the Chaos, Jiang Ming opened his eyes and smiled. Sanctifying the Dao again had strengthened his soul by a large margin. At the same time, he truly understood the condition of the Chaos Realm.
The Chaos Law of Soul Jiang Ming had mastered, was in fact a portion only. Along with his improvement, he would be able to master more and more until he managed to completely master the Chaos Law of Soul.
Only by that time could Jiang Ming become the real lord of soul, the master of soul, the source of soul and the haven of soul. He could even manipulate the souls of all sentient beings in the Chaos. And this was extraordinarily horrifying.
Jiang Ming was thrilled because it wasn’t an ordinary improvement.
With a thought, Jiang Ming checked out his inner world. It was trembling. The comprehended Chaos Law of Soul had almost led to the collapse of the inner world. Although the inner world had shut itself, the law of soul of the inner world was still transforming towards the Chaos law.
This transformation was a prelusion. Jiang Ming was able to promote the evolution of his inner world to a higher realm. However, it was unfortunate that he had yet to understand what he could do to further improve his inner world.
When Jiang Ming didn’t know how, he couldn’t break through. Otherwise, it would be a disaster if he was to make a mistake. Nevertheless, he was not in a rush because he knew he had a lot of time.
Jiang Ming accidentally found out that the heart of Chaos, which had been staying in the origin of his inner world, was being refined rapidly. Even though the word rapid had to be measured in units of hundreds of millions of year, the refining speed had at least been accelerated.
‘The heart of the Chaos, the inner world, the Sea of Chaos, the World Tree…’ Jiang Ming had been pondering for a long time. But he eventually held his thoughts. He was not in a rush, after all.
Jiang Ming closed his eyes again to comprehend the Soul Dao and to adapt to the expanded power.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - Descended to the Chaos Primordial
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Descended to the Chaos Primordial For the First Time, Ao Jiu Showing His Colors
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
As time passed by, a few dozens of years had gone in a blink of an eye.
Jiang Ming had returned to the Chuyang Peak.
It was already 50 years since the last significant change of the system.
“Time passed by truly fast to be on a retreat outside. This is far incomparable within the Supreme Pagoda.” Jiang Ming lamented.
Jiang Ming was in the Chaos. He hadn’t cultivated much yet he had spent a few dozens of years. In fact, he didn’t dare to be in seclusion for a long time. He was afraid that he would have spent thousands of years if he was to fixate on his cultivation. After all, he didn’t want his junior sister to be worried about him.
‘But I think I may need to spend a long time out there in the near future.’ JIang Ming pondered. After all, he had to go on comprehending the Chaos Law of Soul to completely master it.
‘If my inner world was able to be further improved, I’d be able to cultivate inside out.’ Jiang Ming frowned.
Although Jiang Ming had a couple of hypotheses for the next step of his inner world, he had yet to reach a conclusion. Hence, it was not suitable for him to take a leap.
At this time, there was a message from the Great Dao Group.
[Ao Jiu: Brother Jiang, help, help me!]
[Ao Jiu: I’ve just got to the Chaos Primordial Land. When I’m about to look around, I’m besieged. Hong Zhan is still a far distance away from where I am. Hence, I can only rely on you.]
[Ao Jiu: I’m besieged by three Saint Experts.]
[Ao Jiu: Damn, I’m about to be badly bullied.]
[Ao Jiu: Brother Jiang, don’t tell me you’re still in seclusion.]
[Ao Jiu: I’m done.]
[Ao Jiu: I’m about to become their meal.]
[Ao Jiu: My life as a dragon is too miserable. I haven’t managed to check out the ladies here in the Chaos Primordial Land.]
[Jiang Ming: With you being long-winded, I suppose you’re able to hold on.]
[Ao Jiu: I’m currently dealing with them with difficulty. Brother Jiang, they’re discussing how they are going to eat me.]
[Di Huo: It’s too miserable. You as a dragon are truly too miserable. Brother Jiang, you must get there late. Better to get there only after he’s been cut into pieces. By that time, we’ll get to taste the dragon meat as well.]
[Ao Jiu: Damn you. Be careful that I’ll pull out all your feathers.]
[Ao Jiu: Oh no, I’m done. Brother Jiang, my life is in your hands.]
[Jiang Ming: Hold on!]
On Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming smiled because Ao Jiu had finally headed for the Chaos Primordial Land. In fact, he had long known that Ao Jiu, who used to become a Group Admin, used to obtain supreme fortunes from the Hongmeng Primordial Land. Hence, Ao Jiu’s combat power had been greatly improved.
Following that, Ao Jiu had been improving his cultivation base and was detached from the Supreme Chat Room. He was being taken away only after he had been running rampant in his own world for a long time.
‘There are two ways of going to the Chaos Primordial Land. First is to descend there directly with the Human Path Record, while the second one is the use of the radiation sensing of Soul Dao to lock the target at Ao Jiu and then get to Ao Jiu through the Law of Soul, projection, or traverse towards Ao Jiu directly.’
Jiang Ming had been pondering, looking for the best methods. Following that, he called out the Human Path Record, left an avatar behind and plunged into it.
…
The Chaos Primordial Land had a very beautiful scenery. If one was to take a careful look, one would discover that all things including the trees, grasses and flowers were spiritual items. Even though their grades weren’t high, they were at least spiritual items.
Even the mountain peaks were glittering with various luminances of rare metals. The flowing waterfalls contained a lot of spiritual qi. In fact, almost all of them were spiritual fluid, and there were even mixed with innate spiritual qi in them.
These were the fortunes of the Chaos Primordial Land.
However, it was at this moment that Ao Jiu was besieged by a group of experts.
“Mr. Lan, there isn’t any enmity between us, do we? Why would you force me and want to kill me?” Ao Jiu had a burly body and he even exposed the upper part of his body, revealing his muscular muscles. He had an aura as deep as an abyss, but it made people feel like he was arrogant.
“There isn’t any enmity?” Mr. Lan looked like an old man, but his aura was even stronger, obviously a Saint Expert.
However, the face of Mr. Lan at this moment looked rather contorted. He looked at Ao Jiu and his eyes were burning with rage.
Beside Mr. Lan was an extremely pretty and coquettish woman being confined. She was kneeling on the ground, her hairs hanging down and her face was filled with despair.
“I want you dead without a place of burial!” The burning flame even surged on top of Mr. Lan’s head. He was burned with anger and filled with extreme killing intent.
“Kill him. No, seize him so that I can cut off his flesh piece by piece until he is dead!” Mr. Lan pointed in front and demanded that Ao Jiu be killed.
“Yes!” Two Saint Experts beside Mr. Lan took their moves. One held a helbert with an extremely sharp edge that split the sky. The other one held a saber which could cut all things.
When the two Saint Experts were launching their attacks, they were supposed to shake all heavens, intimidate all things and destroy hundreds of millions of miles of land even with just a slight move. However, the impact they could cause was rather mild here. To be exact, it was extremely mild. It was akin to the destruction a Great Overarching Golden Immortal could make in the Honggu Great Chiliocosm only.
Such a mild impact was due to the supreme pressure formed by the Chaos Primordial Land.
“Damn, do you have to go so far?” Ao Jiu was indignant. As he cursed, the battle armor on him was emanating dazzling luminance, which formed into 81 rays of defense. Meanwhile, the long sword in his hand was spurting destructive aura as well.
These were two pieces of Saint Weapons Ao Jiu got from Hong Zhan. After all, based on Hong Zhan’s current status and strength, it was too effortless for him to get someSaint Weapon.
With his might burst forth, and his sky-defying special abilities, Ao Jiu barely resisted the attacks of the two Saint Experts. In fact, if it wasn’t for his terrifying combat power, he wouldn’t be able to survive till now. He would have been caught as soon as he was besieged.
Mr. Lan was witnessing the skirmish indifferently. Meanwhile, an awl appeared in his hand. It looked bluish. As if it had gathered the poison of the heavens and the world, it caused the air to whimper.
Mr. Lan looked at the pretty and coquettish immortal kneeling on the ground and snorted with rage. “Bitch.”
Following that, he looked at Ao Jiu again. His eyes were flowing with rays as he was pondering. ‘Where does this dragon come from? Why is his combat power that terrifying? Is he a Sky Dragon? No, if he’s a Sky Dragon, he can’t be this strong and he wouldn’t travel alone. It wouldn’t be a big deal if it was about the other matter. But if I were to forgive him on this matter, I’d be ashamed.’
As Mr. Lan was thinking, he threw out his blue awl simply by a jerk. In just a flash, it had pierced through the external defensive luminance of Ao Jiu.
It was also at this moment that Ao Jiu was attacked by the two Saint Experts from his two sides, giving him no chance to resist the awl.
“Alas, my life is ending! I shouldn’t have messed up. Brother Jiang, why aren’t you here yet!” Ao Jiu had sensed the awl, but he couldn’t resist it. He could only cry in despair.
“You this dragon are actually good at messing up, aren’t you!” A smirk rang out and the blue awl got into the hand of a man. The man was no other but Jiang Ming.
“Brother Jiang, haha, you’re just in time. It’s great, it’s too great, I’m safe. I’ll bully the Lan Mei Clan everyday from now onwards.” Ao Jiu was ecstatic. He forced the withdrawal of the two Saint Experts and couldn’t help but guffaw. He even bent his hips and patted his abdomen. This complacent energy of Ao Jiu was very irritating.
Jiang Ming took a glance at the woman kneeling before Mr. Lan. He felt the alluring extent of this woman was no weaker than Yu Fei, hence absolutely a source of trouble.
With just some investigation, Jiang Ming learned about the cause of the skirmish. It was actually very simple.
Ao Jiu wanted to come to the Chaos Primordial Land. Hence, he gave Hong Zhan a drop of his blood essence to be fused with a great vessel. Through the unseen power, he was led to the Chaos Primordial Land.
And that great vessel was a Saint Weapon. Nevertheless, it took Ao Jiu a couple of years before he could reach the Chaos Primordial Land.
However, the rules of the Chaos Primordial Land were too terrific. As soon as Ao Jiu got here, he fell into a city, which was the territory of Lan Da or Mr. Lan. He was of the Lan Mei Clan, which was considered as a demon clan.
Two of Mr. Lan’s disciples had sanctified their Dao and they were famous within a million miles around the city.
Not long ago, the two disciples went out on a task while Mr. Lan was in a retreat.
After Ao Jiu got to the city, he began to familiarize himself with the city while waiting for Hong Zhan. One day, he coincidentally saw the concubine of Lan Da and was attracted to her. With his techniques and the power no weaker than a Saint Expert, Ao Jiu managed to hook up with her through temptation and coercion. The two really hit it off and they got out of control.
However, when Ao Jiu learned about the woman’s background with three Saints, he felt tingling on his scalp. He thought of killing Lan Da, who was in a retreat, before the two disciples just in case.
Nevertheless, Ao Jiu had lost his chance when the two disciples managed to get back in time. Hence, a great battle broke up as expected.
Ao Jiu lost miserably and eluded. But he ended up being caught up.
“You brat, haven’t you enjoyed it enough back in your world?” Jiang Ming was extremely speechless.
“How can it be enough for a man! Moreover, this alluring woman is supposed to belong to everyone. How can you let Lan Da enjoy alone? This old guy is too useless to leave her alone every day. Hence, I’m here to rescue her.” Ao Jiu showed his colors. “Brother Jiang, when you meet such a peerlessly coquettish lady and not to save her from her trouble, you’d be punished by heaven.”
Jiang Ming rolled his eyes.
Meanwhile, fury had overtaken Lan Da.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - The Dao Patriarch of Thunder,
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: The Dao Patriarch of Thunder, Supreme Sacred Land
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Ao Jiu was indeed bold enough to take risk for sex. He even dared to hit on the woman of a Saint, which could no longer be described as bold.
That seductive woman too, wouldn’t even care about anything else when she had the desire.
They didn’t think about how terrible a Saint’s anger would be. Moreover, there wasn’t only a Saint but three.
“Fellow Daoist, are you going to intervene?” Lan Da looked at Jiang Ming. His pupils had been constricted to the size of a needle tip, particularly when he saw his Saint Weapon stayed quietly in Jiang Ming’s hand. He felt a chill down his spine.
In fact, he had tried to evoke his awl furtively for a few times, but he failed to regain his control over his Saint Weapon at all. Hence, he knew Jiang Ming, who had just appeared, was definitely horrifying.
“He’s under my protection.” Jiang Ming pointed at Ao Jiu. “What about you give her to him and forget about the enmity between the two of you?”
“This is going too far.” Lan Da was furious and his rage surged up hundred feets high above him. He threw his sleeves viciously and said, “I’ll forget about it for your sake.” Following that, he left.
Jiang Ming was startled for a moment before he couldn’t help but laugh, thinking that this old man was a wise man indeed.
Well, there wouldn’t be many fools among the Saints anyway. It would be ridiculous for Lan Da to risk his life just for the concubine who brought disgrace on him.
Since Jiang Ming was unfathomable, Lan Da thought of retreating temporarily and taking his revenge only when he was confident enough.
Jiang Ming grabbed hard and shattered the awl, a Saint Weapon of Lan Da. It caused Lan Da, who had gone afar, to shiver and spat out a mouthful of blood. Fear flashed across Lan Da’s face and he increased his speed to get away.
Ao Jiu couldn’t help but laugh. But when he saw the seductive woman, who was still kneeling, looking at him with affection, he felt his head tingling. Hence, he asked Jiang Ming through telepathy, “Why did you leave her here?”
“Is she not your woman?”
“Brother Jiang, this type of woman is just for fun. How can you take her with me? If I were to keep her, she would definitely bring disgrace to me in the future, and make me mad.”
“She’s yours after all. So it’s up to you what you want to do to her. I’ll go to Hong Zhan and then meet his great monarch. Do you want to come with me or do you want to enjoy yourself here?”
“Of course I’m going with you.”
“What about her?”
“Ahem, of course I’ll let her go so that she can be herself and be free forever.”
“Mr. Dragon, you’re this!” Jiang Ming gave Ao Jiu a thumbs up. Following that, he pointed to release the seductive woman from the confinement, took Ao Jiu and left.
In just a blink of an eye, they had traveled through stars.
…
There was a spaceship surrounded by divine luminance that contained horrifying killing intent, deterred evildoers away.
In the front of the spaceship, stood a purple-robed young man. He was tall and slender, and he had an indifferent expression.
