It was at this moment that he suddenly turned his head and saw two people appeared by his side. A bright smile had replaced his indifferent space as he said, “Brother Jiang, Mr. Dragon, I knew that both of you would come here together.”
It wasn’t difficult for the young man to guess it. Jiang Ming would certainly go to save Ao Jiu when Ao Jiu was asking for help. After that, Jiang Ming, who was currently a Dao Patriarch of Soul, would definitely want to meet the great monarch of his clan through him.
“Brother Jiang, Mr. Dragon!” Hong Yi, who was sitting at the back, paced towards them. “Haha, finally we’re meeting here in the Chaos Primordial Land. We can finally grow together, fight together and even be in the highest position overseeing infinite realms.”
“Haha, this is possible.” Ao Jiu guffawed. “With brother Jiang as our support, our safety can be guaranteed provided we aren’t committing suicide. With our guaranteed safety and the assistance of the Supreme Pagoda, it is definitely not difficult to cultivate.”
“For sure it’s not difficult.” Hong Zhan laughed as well.
The friends were very happy to get together. In the spaceship was a great hall where they held a banquet. During the banquet, there was a group of immortals dancing to lighten up the atmosphere even though their cultivation base was at the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Realm.
“Wao, they’re all the Great Overarching Golden Immortal Experts. This is too luxurious, isn’t it?” Ao Jiu exclaimed with his eyes brightened up.
“There are women with free will. Hence, you may not be able to force them.” Hong Zhan snorted. “You brat has completely inherited the nature of the dragon, hasn’t you. Be careful that brother Jiang can’t manage to save you in time the next time.”
“Haha, don’t worry. I never force any woman but conquer them with charm, so that I can show my manliness.” Ao Jiu laughed.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but shake his head.
Ao Jiu turned to Jiang Ming and raised his eyebrows. “Brother Jiang, I’ve hit on 3,000 women, what about you?”
Hong Zhan got interested as well. “Brother Jiang, you’ve got better than us in cultivation and strength, don’t tell me you’ve low sex drive.”
“Ahem, of course I’m good at this.” Jiang Ming stirred the glass of wine. “I used to hit on 10,000 women at the same time.”
“Ten thousand women at the same time? What the f*ck, how did you do that? Did you do it with your avatars? This is a good idea, I must try it out.” Ao Jiu’s eyes brightened. “To have endless avatars achieving orgasm simultaneously, which eventually gathered together, hiss… Just thinking of it makes me shudder. Brother Jiang, it’s still you who knows how to enjoy life. You have my admiration and respect!”
“You have mine as well!” Hong Zhan also exclaimed.
“Is it not boring?” Hong Yi shook his head. “Cultivation is still the most enjoyable, isn’t it? To be able to swim in the sea of great Dao and explore the origin of a million laws, that’s the true satisfaction.”
“You should become a monk.” Ao Jiu laughed. “That’d make you pure.”
“There’s also Yab-Yum among the monks.” Hong Zhan added.
“Yin and Yang is also one of the great Daos.” Jiang Ming said.
“Vulgar.” Hong Yi lay back and looked at Jiang Ming. “What’s your next plan?”
“I’m about to ask too.” Hong Zhan also turned to Jiang Ming. “Do you want to return to your chiliocosm or do you want to open a Sacred Land here? With your cultivation base, it’s easy for you to divide a territory of a billion of miles.”
“No rush.” Jiang Ming shook his head. “Through the relationship with you, I plan to visit your great monarch in your Hong Clan and then to take a look at your library.”
“My great monarch will absolutely welcome your visit.” Hong Zhan said happily. “As for the library? With your capability, the entire library would be opened to you.”
“Brother Hong, please lead the road. I’ll take you guys back directly!” Jiang Ming rose to his feet.
“Sure!” As Hong Zhan pointed with his finger, a map appeared out of thin air. The map was also marked with distance.
As Jiang Ming waved his hand, he distorted the void and took the spaceship along.
Upon appearance, they had got to an endless mountain range. This mountain range was huge and vast, with endless divine light being emanated everywhere, and the supreme divine might that permeated the air.
This was the estate of Hong Clan, a supreme Sacred Land located in the Chaos Primordial Land.
Dong dong dong… It was at this moment that a bell on the main peak as high as 100 million feet, rang out. Each ring would clean the soul and temper the will. There were also boundless immortal luminances which gathered together, turned into a golden avenue to pave the sky, and quickly spread out to the spaceship.
The bell rang a total of 81 times. And there was an old man, who paced through the air to the end of the golden avenue.
“I apologize for not being able to welcome you from afar.” The old man clasped his hands together to greet Jiang Ming.
“Good to see you, fellow Daoist.” Jiang Ming returned the old man’s greeting with a smile.
“Grandpa!” Hong Zhan revealed a joyful look and quickly introduced the old man to his friends.
The old man was Hong Lei, who was the great monarch of the Hong Clan. As he mastered the Chaos Law of Thunder, he was the Dao Patriarch of Thunder.
Following that, the clan leader and the other figures of the Hong Clan came one after another. They greeted Jiang Ming and the group with the highest level of etiquette. In fact, with the appearance of Hong Let, the Hong Clan had shown their attitude towards Jiang Ming.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, please!” As Hong Lei looked at Jiang Ming, his emotion fluctuated a little for the first time after a long time.
Back then, there was a shocking vision in the Chaos Primordial Land, showing that someone had sanctified the Dao of Chaos Realm. Through Hong Zhan, Hong Lei immediately knew that it was Jiang Ming who had caused the vision, but he could barely believe it.
Now that Hong Lei had finally met with Jiang Ming, he was still feeling shocked. He knew the actual age of Jiang Ming. Jiang Ming was too young, a lot younger than Hong Zhan, his grandson. Moreover, Jiang Ming was born in a planar world.
Even though Jiang Ming had such an identity, he had actually sanctified the Dao of Chaos Realm. It was indeed incredible. Nevertheless, Hong Lei saw another possibility from Jiang Ming. It was the possibility of transcendence.
“Fellow Daoist, I’m sorry for disturbing you.” Jiang Ming said apologetically.
It was followed by the welcome banquet. Following that, Hong Lei invited Jiang Ming to give a sermon to the members of his Hong Clan, and Jiang Ming accepted the invitation. After all, Jiang Ming knew that he had to give first if he was to make a request.
Jiang Ming reversed the time and evolved the Soul Dao. This had allowed the members of the Hong Clan to gain a lot from Jiang Ming’s sermon and made Hong Lei to become more friendly towards Jiang Ming. It was because Jiang Ming had proven that he was no weaker than Hong Lei.
After the sermon, the two Supreme Experts left.
In a palace located on the tip of the Mountain Hong.
“Fellow Daoist Hong, would you like to explain about the World Dao?” Jiang Ming voiced his real intention of visiting the Hong Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - The Eldest Disciple of the Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: The Eldest Disciple of the Head Disciple: Fengyun Wuji, The Library, The Armory
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Back on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming lay down as he contemplated his upcoming plans. He had only just returned from the Hong Clan in the Chaos Primordial Land.
While he was there, he and Hong Lei had a discussion about Dao, which allowed him to have a more systematic and complete understanding of the Chaos Realm. He now had ample understanding of the Chaos Primordial Land as well.
There were eight Chaos Experts who were widely known in the Chaos Primordial Land, but there were three others who weren’t made known. If Jiang Ming was to be counted as well, there were a total of twelve Chaos Experts.
Hong Lei said that this was a great thing. After all, with more peerless experts around, the safety of the Chaos Primordial Land would be more secure.
“Alas, the Sea of Chaos. Even Hong Lei didn’t know their exact number.” Jiang Ming lamented.
Although he had long known that there were many Sea of Chaos, the fact that Hong Lei didn’t know how many there were, was very strange. After all, Hong Lei was an ancient peerless existence. Overlooking the entire Sea of Chaos, there would probably be no secrets that could be hidden from him.
Yet, even Hong Lei didn’t know the exact number of Sea of Chaos. He only knew nine of them.
‘Being of the Chaos Realm is still not safe.’ Jiang Ming continued to ponder to himself.
Hong Lei had told him that there used to be Chaos Experts, who were killed in the past. Although it was somewhat unbelievable, it really happened before.
‘It’s still safer for me to keep a low profile.’ Jiang Ming had originally intended to go forth into the Chaos Primordial Land but had to put this thought aside for the time being.
After the discussion of Dao with Hong Lei, Jiang Ming went over to the library of Hong Clan. It was when he reached the library that Jiang Ming finally knew the term “sea of books”. The library was an incomparably huge pavilion, but the interior of it was even bigger.
The first level was already a chiliocosm itself. The books were counted in the trillions. Even for a person like him, Jiang Ming couldn’t even see every one of the books in a single glance.
The collection contained all kinds of knowledge and information of infinite realms and the Civilization Dao. It was definitely a huge treasure to Hong Yi, who was taking on the path of Civilization Dao.
The second level was also a chiliocosm, which contained countless secret methods and powerful cultivation techniques.
The third level however, had only millions of books, where each book had transformed itself into a star. This was a collection of various special techniques and abilities of the Chaos Primordial Land from the ancient times up till the present. Each book would create a huge uproar if it was to be made public.
It was just as Hong Lei’s remarks, for experts who had reached a stage such as themselves, the cultivation techniques and special abilities were all of not much use to them. What was useful was the comprehension of the Chaos Laws.
Jiang Ming browsed through all of the books before finally heading back.
‘This trip was a huge harvest to me!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but lament to himself.
Right then, a large part of his subconscious mind was deciphering the knowledge that he had gained and rapidly turning them into his own accumulation. They were processed as his wisdom, his wealth and further on, into sustenance to him.
At the same time, Jiang Ming was also deducing the next evolution towards his inner world. Whilst he was doing so, he suddenly turned his gaze over in the direction of the heavenly ladder.
There was a young man that had ascended onto the pinnacle there.
“Interesting!”
As Jiang Ming focused his gaze, he backtracked that young man and checked through his past before sighing emotionally.
This person was named Fengyun Wuji. He wasn’t of the Jiuyang Peak but rather an ordinary disciple under the jurisdiction of the sect. He followed the cultivation techniques and worked his way up one step at a time.
After the youth had stepped into the Immortal realm, he entered the forty-nine spatial world and wandered through them. He faced countless dangers, but also obtained various great fortunes.?He grew at a solid pace one step at a time before his soul finally advanced into the Saint Realm. Even his comprehension capability was amazing.
Jiang Ming reached out and grabbed hold of him. With that Fengyun Wuji was brought over to him.
Fengyun Wuji was stunned at first. However, when he saw Jiang Ming who was laying on the rattan chair, he was in a slight trance before revealing a look of excitement. He immediately kneeled down to pay homage. “Saint Lord, greetings to you!”
“Stand up!” Jiang Ming let the youth stand back up as he looked at him up and down. He couldn’t help but nod. “Not bad. You’re of the ordinary background, yet you are able to surpass the others of your realm. Your will has advanced into the Saint Realm,and your soul has transformed. You’re just like me back then, going through evolution one step at a time. This is what a true genius should be.”
“Fengyun Wuji, are you willing to become my disciple?”
Jiang Ming sat himself up.
“It’s my honor!” Fengyun Wuji was even more excited as he hurriedly knelt down. “Greetings, Master!”
“Haha! Good! You are now my eldest disciple.” Jiang Ming was quite happy himself. “Although you haven’t been through much, you have wandered through various dangerous places. Your will is firm and your cultivation realm is still somewhat acceptable, so there will no longer be the need to test you. As for your cultivation techniques…”
After slightly pondering, Jiang Ming pointed his finger and a black dot appeared right in front of them. It then turned into a streak of luminance, expanding abruptly to a mere one meter radius of size.
On the inside however, a rapid evolution was taking place.
The Chaos was opened up as elements of earth, fire, wind and water gushed through. The elements rinsed through the area, clearing the turbidity before turning the place into a world itself. Swiftly after, books began to materialize one after another within the world.
In just a blink of an eye, there were already trillions and trillions of books within. They were divided into the different categories, namely the mortals, Immortals, Saints and the likes.
“The books here include most of the knowledge of the entire Sea of Chaos, as well as countless special abilities, cultivation techniques and many more. For your cultivation, you can make your own decision. My advice would be for you to read more and accumulate more.”
As Jiang Ming said so, he waved his hand and a ball of light fell onto the back of the mountain, creating a pagoda. On top of it, the signage of “Library” appeared.
“I’ve evoked a special ability which allows a person to keep himself in the ethereal state at all times. This will help with absorbing knowledge and information.”
“It also reversed and altered time to the ratio of one to ten thousand. This will be the norm.”
“Moreover, I will create another armory and put various Saint Weapons in it. Following that, you can personally choose three weapons from within for your own protection.”
As Jiang Ming waved his hand again, an armory appeared right next to the library, where he placed various Saint Weapons in it.
Fengyun Wuji, who was watching all of this unfolding before him, was in great shock. He also understood that the great Dao had opened a path for him.
“You are my eldest disciple after all, so these are still insufficient.” Jiang Ming pondered and continued, “Now we aren’t lacking in cultivation techniques and Dao vessels, and I wouldn’t need to be worried about your tempering as well. In that case, I’ll bestow you with a supreme constitution.”
As Jiang Ming raised his palm, he patted down on top of Fengyun Wuji’s head.
Boom… With a deafening explosion, Fengyun Wuji’s physique exploded abruptly, turning into a sky full of blood mist. However, his soul remained intact and complete, without the slightest change.
Jiang Ming took out a crystal, probed a streak of green luminance into the blood mist and proceeded to evoke a special ability to restructure his physical body.
A few moments later, a grand new body of Fengyun Wuji appeared.
Jiang Ming didn’t stop there. He raised his hand, pressed onto Fengyun Wuji to merge his soul into Fengyun Wuji and evoked the supreme special ability to fit Fengyun Wuji’s soul and physique perfectly.
“How do you feel?” Jiang Ming stopped, looked at his eldest disciple and asked.
“Powerful! It’s too powerful!” Fengyun Wuji sensed the changes towards his body and revealed a look of surprise on his face. “Although my cultivation realm remains the same, yet I feel that my foundation has been improved more than a thousand folds. My Qi and blood are boiling through like the sea of stars. Master, what kind of physique is this? This is beyond imagination! It’s too incredible!”
“This is the Chaos Daoist Body.” Jiang Ming smiled as he said, “Even when ranked within the Chaos Primordial Land, this physique is still the best of them all. Only your master with such supreme cultivation and also in possession of such a rare treasure of creation that made it possible to create such a physique for you. Wuji, you are my eldest disciple, so you must not be weak from now on. You are required to uphold your master’s pride high.”
“I will not let you down, master!” Fengyun Wuji knelt down yet again.
Jiang Ming merely waved his hand and continued, “From now on, you are allowed to wander anywhere here with the exception of my residence. Now go over to Jiuyang’s main hall to register yourself. Following that, do pay respect to your grand master, the sect leader and the other First Seats. Don’t forget your manners. You may go now.”
“Yes, master!” Fengyun Wuji retreated.
Jiang Ming stretched his back. Now that he had one disciple, would the remaining nine even be far away? Definitely not!
If it were to be the normal development, Jiang Ming was afraid that it would take a very long time to go. However, with the various tests and great fortunes available, it became relatively much easier.”
‘Just wait till I take in ten disciples and lead them into the Saint Realm. Who knows what kind of rewards there will be?’ Jiang Ming was looking forward to it.
After resting for a moment, Jiang Ming entered the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda with just a thought.
He needed to accumulate further. After all, he had already taken in a huge amount of knowledge and his foundation was already ample.
Within the exclusive cultivation space, Jiang Ming raised his finger and pointed, creating a bed in the middle. As he lay down on the bed, he began to sort himself out, allowing his knowledge to be digested into wisdom.
Especially regarding the ideas about the evolution of the worlds, Jiang Ming comprehended them one after another. Based on the situation of the Sea of Chaos and also the evolution of the World Tree, he deduced what to do next to improve his inner world of great chiliocosm.
Time had been passing by slowly within the exclusive cultivation space. It took a whole hundred thousand years before Jiang Ming was able to truly determine how his inner world should be evolving next.
‘Now that I’m sure of it, let’s just begin! Once my inner world evolves, I’ll be able to control the 3,000 Chaos Laws inside out. By then, I may be able to try peeking into the realm above the Chaos.”
As these thoughts went through Jiang Ming’s mind, he began his cultivation once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - The Ultimate Inner World, The
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: The Ultimate Inner World, The Role of Junior Sister
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming’s inner world had long reached its limit of accumulation. If he knew what he could do next, his inner world would have already transformed.
Now that Jiang Ming had a clear goal and the catalysts, namely the Chaos Law of Soul and the heart of the Chaos. He just had to make a slight push to improve his inner world further.
Jiang Ming induced the Chaos Law of Soul into his inner world while rapidly refined the heart of Chaos to provide energy for the transformation process. It was at this moment that his inner world began to revolt.
The moment when his Soul Law began to transform, it suppressed 10,000 Daos, leading to an imbalance in the inner world and the direct manifestation of the Chaos Law of Soul. The Chaos Law of Soul traversed the horizon, permeated into every corner of his inner world.
This law got stronger than all the power available. It was still slightly stable in the beginning, but as time passed, his inner world began to tremble violently, setting off an endless storm of wild currents.
Mountains began to crumble as the seas began to flow backwards. The vast starry sky fell below as the great earth sank deeper.
His whole inner world had plunged into an apocalyptic destruction.
Jiang Ming had his mind completely enveloped the entire area and closely observed the changes to his inner world, just in case there were any unexpected changes. At the same time, the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda appeared on top of the inner world, radiating a gloomy glow that trapped the inner world within.
The collapse of his inner world became even more abrupt.
However, the place was so huge that even if a chain reaction took place, it would still take many years for his whole inner world to be in a complete Chaos.
At this point, his entire inner world had completely collapsed.
Jiang Ming didn’t pay any attention to the collapse. Instead, he had a part of his subconscious observing the changes while another part of it merged into the chaotic inner world.
It was only after the collapse, Jiang Ming’s inner world could be rebuilt. Breaking down the shackles of the past and rebuilding a brand new order was the process that Jiang Ming had deduced. Hence, it was still within his control.
‘But this is not enough!’
Jiang Ming’s subconscious was without a shred of emotion, as if he had become the embodiment of rationality.
His speed of thought went into overdrive and the torrent of deduction could even cause a great chiliocosm to burst.
“Shatter!”
His inner world had become a huge, turbulent inner world with endless torrents of storm. It was followed by a deafening explosion. Then, a single streak of sword luminance suddenly appeared in Jiang Ming’s inner world and completely shattered the heart of Chaos that was located at the origin.
It was the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword that Jiang Ming had evoked to shatter the heart of Chaos.
A step further after the great chiliocosm was to evolve into the Chaos. However, how could it be done? Could it be done just by shattering the inner world? Once shattered, what terrifying torrent of power would that release?
Even a Chaos Expert might not be able to suppress such power and would end up being exploded and die from the backlash.
This was also the reason why Jiang Ming forcibly suppressed his inner world with his Chaos Soul, and also guarding it with the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda. It was all done for assurance.
Would shattering of the inner world mark the start of evolution? If it were that simple, the entire Chaos Primordial Land would have at least an expert who managed to evolve his inner world to the extreme already.
In addition to using the Chaos Law as a catalyst, Jiang Ming needed a much larger torrent of power to drive the process along. This was the reason why Jiang Ming shattered the heart of Chaos so that its boundless Chaos essence would be completely released.
Rumble… The torrent of energy contained within the heart of Chaos had completely exceeded the limits of the inner world. Such an impact was akin to ten septillion atomic bomb explosion, forming a frenzy so devastating that it even turned Jiang Ming pale.
The whole deranged inner world began to expand. It was difficult to be suppressed with his Chaos Soul. Even the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda was trembling violently.
“I’m in trouble!” Jiang Ming was horrified.
“Chaos Defensive Garment! Suppress!”
He evoked yet another Chaos Supreme Treasure to turn into a membrane and envelope the entire inner world. At the same time, he evoked the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda to release waves and waves of Dao suppressing fluctuation. Moreover, Jiang Ming had his entire subconscious integrated into it.
It took who knows how long before the rioting inner world finally stabilized. Only at this point did Jiang Ming breathe a sigh of relief. To him, it was good that his inner world stabilized. What he had to do next was to allow the inner world to evolve on its own.
As the flower of eternity blossomed, an eternity went by with a snap of a finger.
On this day, Jiang Ming finally opened his eyes. His aura was extraordinarily cold. It was icy cold, and as indifferent as the ancient tenacious rock. There wasn’t even a trace of emotion that could be seen in the lights flowing from his eyes.
It was after a long time before Jiang Ming finally blinked his eyes and a sliver of warmth finally returned to him.
Jiang Ming closed his eyes once again. He was whispering and murmuring under his breath.
“How long has it been? One hundred million years? Ten billion years? Trillions of years? That’s such a very long time. An extraordinarily long time. Long enough for me to almost lose myself and wanting to become the Dao, fleeting away.”
“Slash!” Jiang Ming suddenly roared explosively. His will and wisdom formed a streak of sword luminance, slashing through all the false memories resulting from the cultivation retreat. With that, the temperature belonging to his humanity had also returned rapidly.
Jiang Ming had spent too much time on this retreat. It was far longer than he had expected.
After his inner world had been stabilized, it started to evolve on its own. Starting off from a deranged space that was filled with infinite storms, it slowly began to calm down, before having a trace of order and finally began to run its cycle with the order. It took such a long time that even Jiang Ming’s mind went numb.
He felt as though he himself had become a part of the Chaos Inner world.
By now, his inner world had completely transformed into a Chaos. Other than the powerful Chaos Law of Soul, there were also seeds of other Chaos Laws that were produced due to the heart of Chaos. They were just waiting to thrive and truly make the inner world a Chaos.
By now, his inner world was considered to have completed its sublimation, truly breaking the shackles of the great chiliocosm.
‘Now, just a wave of my hand would set off the power of the Chaos Origin. In terms of cultivation realm, I can be considered to have advanced squarely into the Chaos Realm.’
This Chaos Realm of Jiang Ming which seemed to have just been attained, was powerful beyond imagination. After all, his cultivation realm was supported by a Chaos within.
‘Now that my inner world is of the Chaos and my soul has gone a step further into the later stage of the Chaos Realm, my physique is now the weakest link for now.’
Jiang Ming closed his eyes again as he thought about it.
This time, he evoked the Hongmeng Great Dao Nine Revolution Warrior Body Technique, mobilizing the power of Chaos Origin as a support and began tempering the Dao of physique.
The breakthrough of a cultivator’s physique was supposed to be of the utmost difficulty. However, because of his inner world and his soul, it didn’t take long before he broke through the shackles, allowing his physique to become the real full fledged Chaos Divine Demonic Body.
After his cultivation breakthrough and the adaptation of his power, Jiang Ming returned to Chuyang Peak.
What’s been trillions of years that had gone by in the exclusive cultivation space was a mere snap of a finger in the outside world.
At that time, Jiang Ming had just accepted Fengyun Wuji as his disciple and sent him off.
“Senior brother, your aura…” Noticing something was wrong with Jiang Ming, Linglong who had been in meditation paced through the air towards him. She hugged Jiang Ming’s arm and asked with a grave expression on her face, “How long have you been in seclusion?”
Even her heart was trembling.
“So long that I can’t even recall.” Jiang Ming took a glance at Linglong with an indifferent gaze.
In a tremble, Linglong waved her hand, enveloping the surroundings in a fog and isolated the inside from the outside world.
At the same time, the space in front of them expanded abruptly, forming a spatial world that was filled with divine luminance and sea of flowers. Fragrance filled the air of the alluring environment.
Linglongs appeared one after another around them. They were of all sorts of personalities, being enchanting, petite, flirtatious, matured, cute, sweet, plump, indifferent and many more.
There were a total of 100,000 Linglong altogether.
“Senior Brother…” The 100,000 Linglongs called out softly at the same time.
Jiang Ming’s indifferent expression was gradually replaced with a slight smile. The corners of his mouth in particular were curled high. His figure had also started to appear one after another, a total of a hundred thousand as well.
Time was reversed and altered. A thousand years there was akin to a day on the outside world.
Finally, the fog that covered Chuyang Peak had dissipated.
Jiang Ming was feeling refreshed as he repositioned himself on the rattan chair, swaying leisurely.
The indifferent aura of him had dissipated completely.
“Senior brother, you were very amazing this time around. My body almost fell apart.” Linglong lay beside him. Her wintry eyes were silk-like as she looked rather weak.
“Of course! We are of the Chaos physique.” Jiang Ming smiled, “I’ll make you more and more honest in the future.”
“Finally! The real man has returned!” Linglong smirked.
Jiang Ming’s face suddenly became stiff. As he raised his palm, a loud smack can be heard.
Linglong rolled her eyes and asked, “Senior brother, with your cultivation realm, even if you’ve been in seclusion for a long time, there shouldn’t have been such great changes. When I saw you, it was as if I was looking at a chaotic piece of rock that had undergone the baptism of eternity. You almost scared me to death!”
“The cultivation retreat this time was too long.” Jiang Ming sighed. “So long that I almost became the Dao itself.”
“How did that happen?”
“That’s because my inner world has taken a step further, evolving into the Chaos. This process was too slow. So slow that it almost drove me crazy. Even by deducing various different special abilities, comprehending the supreme techniques and sometimes even leaving a part of my subconscious to fall into deep slumber, it still feels so long that my previous memories become bits and pieces.”
“It’s a good thing you have me. Otherwise, you are done for!”
“Haha! I have a great junior sister!”
“Hmph, that’s all I seem to be good at. This is so infuriating!”
“You don’t like it? Take a look! Through this session of extreme sports, your physique, soul and cultivation realm had all advanced into the Half-King Saint Realm. Slightly settle yourself and you will certainly be able to break through. It’s just a matter of time.”
“What about if we go for another round and you directly help me break through?”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless when he heard her remarks. He pinched his chin and thought to himself.
It seemed that he didn’t have much to do next. It was not feasible for him to raise his cultivation realm again in such a short time. If that was the case…
“Let’s go. We’ll head for the Chaos! We won’t be altering time this time. I’ll directly help you comprehend the rhythm of the Chaos.”
“Hehe! We’ll have to really work it out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - The Set Up of the Reincarnation,
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: The Set Up of the Reincarnation, The Fifth Immortal Moon
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After leaving an avatar on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming brought Linglong into the Chaos. Pausing slightly, he evoked the Human Path Record with just a thought and directly went across the Chaos, reaching the other side.
Here, there was an immensely huge Chaos World Tree that stood tall. This was none other than Luo Heng’s galaxy.
Jiang Ming landed onto a branch with Linglong in his arms. With a sweep of his consciousness, he discovered that the World Tree had grown to the extreme, occupying one fiftieth of the space over in this space of the Sea of Chaos. It was unbelievable.
The power contained in the World Tree was even more terrifying to the extreme, that even Jiang Ming, who was the master, was greatly shocked.
‘The extreme of the Chaos Realm.’
Jiang Ming knew the extent of the World Tree’s growth.
Coupled with the internal space and its huge size, it was definitely more powerful and terrifying than an ordinary Chaos Expert.
‘If a big battle breaks out, I’m afraid that even the current me might not be a match.’
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile when he thought about this. With such support, who would he even fear amidst the Chaos? It was enough for him to traverse the endless Sea of Chaos already.
“Senior brother, what is this place?” Linglong was very astonished.
Raising her head, the shade of the trees covered the entire sky. The surrounding was filled with endless Qi of Creation. The quality of this airflow was surprisingly higher and many times more powerful than the Saint energy within her body. Moreover, it contained a vast power of vitality.
Merely inhaling a breath made her cheer from her soul down to her physical body.
Through her consciousness, she was surprised that she was unable to penetrate the immense and incomparable shadow. Moreover, she also saw many rivers of stars, countless planets, which were clearly branches and leaves of trees. Upon further inspection, the massive tree trunk brought her a sense of despair.
“This is my World Tree.” Jiang Ming explained with a smile. “What do you think? Your Senior Brother is amazing right?”
“Senior brother, this is yours?” Linglong was astonished once again.
“Of course. From now on, you can just cultivate here. It will definitely be half the effort. Coupled with my nourishment, it definitely won’t take long for you to advance into the King Saint Realm or even the Lord Saint Realm.” Jiang Ming smiled. “Come on. I’ll take you on a tour around this foreign scenery.”
Linglong rolled her eyes, but her heart was still in shock.
The two of them wandered throughout the World Tree to their leisure.
After all, this place was tens of thousands of times bigger than the Xinghe Universe. There were countless wonders as well.
Jiang Ming also brought along the nine clones of Linglong with them. It was more fun to travel around with all of them.
In the end, they also went on a tour around the Universe, to see the various landscapes of the technological universe. This was a real eye opener to Linglong and her other clones.
In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
After going a whole circle, the eleven of them came directly to the core of the World Tree and began their Yin Yang Dao cultivation there.
This time, Jiang Ming evoked the supreme creation and also allowed his junior sister to absorb the power of Origin of the World Tree. Under his full assistance,Linglong’s cultivation realm soared.
Few decades passed by in just a flick of a finger. There was still one year left before the great event of the Chaos Primordial Land.
The two of them finally came out of seclusion and returned to Chuyang Peak.
“Senior brother, it’s still this kind of cultivation that’s the best. In just a few decades, my cultivation realm has actually advanced into the Lord Saint Realm.”
Linglong sat beside the reclining chair, still excited.
As for the nine clones, they stayed back at the World Tree to continue their cultivation.
In just a few decades, Linglong’s cultivation realm had soared from the pinnacle of Saint Realm directly into the Lord Saint Realm.
Physique: Early stages of the Lord Saint
Cultivation base: Early stages of the Lord Saint
Soul: Pinnacle Stage of the Lord Saint
It was simply extremely incredible.
However, the nine clones of Linglong were rather lacking. They were still at the pinnacle stage of the King Saint Realm.?After all, with her playing the main part in this cultivation session, her clones didn’t dare to make a fuss either.
“It will be much more difficult to improve further.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Through the merging of the Soul, coupled with various treasured items and the fortune of the World Tree, it allowed your Soul to reach the pinnacle stage of the Lord Saint. However, your physique and cultivation realm would require your own effort already.”
“This is already enough.” Linglong stood up. She was in high spirits. “I will rely on myself to sanctify the Chaos Realm!”
“Ambitious!”
“However…”
“What is it?”
“I’ll be taking some lessons from you often of course.”
“Didn’t you say that you want to rely on yourself?”
“Humph! Senior brother, you’re too dirty-minded! What I meant is to ask you for more advice!”
“Come on! Do you think I don’t know that devious mind of yours?”
“Hehe! Senior Brother! You’re still the one who understands me well. Those are the best wonders of Chaos! It can’t go to waste!”
“Ahem…”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless.
The white clouds continued to float along, never changing for tens of thousands of years.
Jiang Ming pondered for a moment before he said, “With our cultivation realm, it’s a bit inappropriate for us to continue staying in the great chiliocosm. I’m planning to bring the whole Tianyuan Realm with us when we go to the Chaos Primordial Land this time. What do you think, girl?”
“That’s very good.” Linglong smiled and said, “It’s true that I can’t exert myself here. For example, when I do the business with you, a leak of aura from the slightest excitement would’ve probably wiped out the entire chiliocosm already. When we get to the Chaos Primordial Land, I’ll be able to see that Master of mine that I’ve never met. Let’s see if his cultivation realm is as high as mine? Haha! It will definitely be interesting then!”
“It will be interesting indeed.” Jiang Ming laughed as well. “It’s decided then!”
He suddenly frowned. Just a moment ago, Jiang Ming sensed a call that came from his Soul. It was from the Fifth Immortal Moon of the Reincarnation Hall that he once enslaved.
In the beginning, he was able to utilize the Fifth Immortal Moon to descend into the many worlds and plundered resources. He was able to rake in a lot of benefits in the beginning. He had also helped the Fifth Immortal Moon to grow rapidly, and she had now advanced into the perfect stage of the Quasi-Sage Realm.
However, Jiang Ming was now hearing the Fifth Immortal Moon’s plea for help from his own Soul.
Jiang Ming stood up and a frown could be seen on his face. Inexplicably, he felt that something was wrong. There seemed to be a murderous intent that was targeted at him.
“Senior brother, what is it?” Linglong inquired. “What can make you frown these days?”
“There will perhaps be some ploy later on.” Jiang Ming suddenly laughed. “With my current strength, I’m not afraid of any conspiracy and trickery. Don’t worry.”
“I can only rest assured.” Linglong let out a soft sigh.
It was only at these times that Linglong felt helpless. She couldn’t help her senior brother and was unable to stand side by side with him. What she could do was to conjure up more clones.
She planned to conjure up 300 billion clones the next time so that she could help Jiang Ming to relax more. She was also thinking about how to sanctify the Chaos Realm in the future.
Jiang Ming on the other hand, evoked the Human Path Record to check on the Fifth Immortal Moon’s situation.
She was still in the Reincarnation Space, accepting some missions occasionally to obtain resources for her cultivation.
This time, it was a trip to a great chiliocosm which had long been destroyed. It was filled with endless qi of calamity, destruction, death, resentment and the likes. However, a beast of destruction was born within the core.
Her mission was to kill the beast.
This mission could be described to be extremely dangerous. If it wasn’t for the fact that it was a mandatory mission, she wouldn’t have gone for it at all. After all, this was a remnant of a great chiliocosm that had been destroyed. Even a Saint would be in a pickle upon entering the place.
Right after the Fifth Immortal Moon had descended, she was gravely injured to the point of nearly losing her life. This led to her asking for help as the last resort.
“There are four Quasi-Sages heading towards her, yet it’s giving me a bad feeling about it. Interesting.”
A cold expression flashed through Jiang Ming’s face as he then said, “Girl, I’ll return in a short while.”
“Be careful, senior brother.”
“Don’t worry.”
After saying so, Jiang Ming didn’t want to trouble himself and directly descended over through the Human Path Record. Regarding this Human Path Record, he had long understood that this was a supreme great vessel that surpassed the Chaos Supreme Treasures.
Even as it was today, he could still hardly glimpse its true level, which was unbelievable.
As soon as Jiang Ming appeared, he saw a dark luminance descending which soon dissipated. This was a sign of invincibility.
In front of him was a Nine Death Beast. It had nine hideous heads and was up to 30,000 feet long. Being enormous as it was, its aura was even more terrifying with the power of a Demi-Sage Realm.
The surroundings were the darkness filled with qi of calamity, death, curse and the likes. This was a place of catastrophe.
Right beside Jiang Ming, the treasured bell that was on top of Fifth Immortal Moon’s head already had three cracks on it. Her face was pale and her aura was unstable. It was apparent that she was on the defense and it looked like she couldn’t hold on much longer.
“Master!” When the Fifth Immortal Moon saw Jiang Ming, her eyes just lit up and she became relaxed.
Jiang Ming nodded and said, “There’s no need for words. I understand everything.”
The Fifth Immortal Moon encountered a crippled sacred array formation. Coupled with the attack from this fierce beast, she ended up as such.
Jiang Ming merely took a glance and the Nine Death Beast in front of him was instantly destroyed into oblivion. He then shouted, “Reincarnation, you’ve laid this down as an invitation to me. Why aren’t you showing yourself? This is not the way to treat guests.”
When Fifth Immortal Moon heard Jiang Ming’s remarks, she immediately understood what was going on as her expression changed wildly and she couldn’t help but tremble.
“Master, I… I… I…didn’t.” She hurriedly explained herself with a trembling voice.
“If you were, how would you even survive until now?” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “Anyway, let’s take this opportunity to cut off your connection with the Reincarnation Hall!”
With a gaze of his eyes, he severed the karma, cutting through the connection between the Fifth Immortal Moon and the Reincarnation Hall. With another casual wave of his hand, he sent her over to Tianyuan Realm, to settle her down properly.
Clap, Clap, Clap… As the applause sounded, the surrounding heaven and earth trembled. The qi of death melted away whilst the qi of destruction and calamity retreated. The darkness was overwhelmed by the bright luminance.
A person could be seen walking out of the luminance as if he was coming from the source of the long river of destiny. The figure still looked infinitely far at first glance, but had already crossed the long river of time in a blink of an eye.
This was a young man with long silver-white hair. With a smile on his face, he appeared to be friendly. His pair of eyes however, were indifferent as if they were stubborn rocks that lived through eternity.
“Dao Patriarch of Soul, although we are meeting for the first time, we shouldn’t be considered strangers to one another.” The silver-haired youth smiled. “I’m the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation.”
“Not exactly a stranger.” Jiang Ming the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation’s remark. “Why doesn’t the other person come out as well?”
The light in the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation’s eyes flickered slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - The Secrets of the Supreme Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: The Secrets of the Supreme Pagoda
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Even before arriving, Jiang Ming had already expected that this was a trap.
Needless to say, the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was behind this. After all, the Fifth Immortal Moon was from the Reincarnation Hall.
When he saw the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation, he had already understood the details about him.
In addition to that, there was also the alliance of another person, which was none other than the Dao Patriarch of Space known as the Lord God.
An old man walked out from the other side. When he looked at Jiang Ming, there was a slightly grave expression on his face. “You actually discovered me. Dao Patriarch of Soul! Remarkable!”
“Remarkable indeed. By hiding with your Spatial Dao, even I myself would have a hard time looking for you.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation nodded.
The two of them emitted their aura, forming all kinds of forces to imprison the area, forming an absolute domain.
As for the crippled great chiliocosm? It didn’t matter if this battle would take place, the chiliocosm would definitely be shattered into ashes when they left.
“Why are you all targeting me?” Jiang Ming asked with a smile.
His gaze swept across the surrounding area. Other than these two, there was also a terrifying Chaos-level great formation that was attached to this crippled great chiliocosm. Once activated, it would explode with a supreme power.
“That’s easy. Transcendence!” Dao Patriarch of Space replied bluntly.
“You’ve reached the pinnacles of the Chaos Realm?” Jiang Ming asked oddly.
“I haven’t.” Dao Patriarch of SpaceSpace shook his head. “Although I haven’t, I can look for the opportunity of transcendence in advance.”
“That’s right.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation responded. “Alas, the Chaos realm. We have been stuck in this realm for far too long. So long that our minds have grown weary, and our emotions have long lost.
It’s been so numbingly long that we even started to feel like we aren’t living beings and only have thoughts about turning into the Dao itself. If I’m not thinking about transcending the Chaos to witness the supreme scenery above the Chaos, I would’ve long returned to the Dao as one.”
His tone of voice was solemn with sincerity. “Take the Reincarnation Hall for example. It’s just a small thing that I’ve created by incorporating the Reincarnation Dao within, allowing me to descend into the various great chiliocosms through the Chaos Laws and take in some so-called geniuses. I’d only take a few glances at them occasionally just to pass the boredom.”
The Dao Patriarch of Space also smiled. He had the same thought as well.
Otherwise, with their capability, why would they still need to nurture talents? There didn’t have to and there wasn’t a need to.
The two of them were just too bored. Hence, they refined a great vessel, gave it certain spirituality and allowed it to operate on its own. Occasionally taking a look at their work, they were hoping to maybe spot some interesting things along the way.
“When the vision of someone sanctifying the Dao appeared, the fact that you weren’t in the Chaos Primordial Land made me feel very strange about it when I woke from my deep slumber.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation continued, “If you weren’t in the Chaos Primordial Land, then how could you have sanctified the Dao? Soon after, I heard that you visited the Hong Clan and so I started investigating. Who would’ve thought that I found out about you? You are actually involved with one of my reincarnators and you have taken a mere few hundred years from your birth to sanctifying the Chaos Realm.”
Although his tone of voice was calm, his expression was somewhat contorted.
“Alas, a few hundred years’ time!” The Dao Patriarch of Space couldn’t believe it. “Even if I was beaten to death, I still find it difficult to believe so. A few hundred years would be a mere snap of a finger for existence such as ourselves. To think that it would be enough for you to sanctify the path of Dao within this duration of time. Even the son of the great Dao wouldn’t be able to do so, would he?”
“Even the son of the great Dao couldn’t!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation chimed in. He looked at Jiang Ming and said sincerely, “Fellow Daoist, when I discovered you, I exhausted all my special abilities, yet was unable to deduce the process of your growth. Even after joining hands with the Dao Patriarch of Space, we were unable to do so. Can you tell us how you sanctified the path of Dao? Could it be that you’ve obtained the inheritance of those that have advanced into the Chaos Realm? Or could it be that you’ve obtained supreme Chaos treasures of transcendence? What exactly is above the Chaos?”
“We are not asking for much, just for the path above the Chaos.” Dao Patriarch of Space butted in. “The meaning of our lives, our purpose and our obsession is only this one thing. Fellow Daoist, can you grant us?”
The two of them stared straight at Jiang Ming with blazing flames in their eyes.
“Couldn’t it be that it was my effort of cultivation?” Jiang Ming replied with a sigh.
“Fellow Daoist, don’t joke around, alright? We’re serious here.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation frowned slightly. “If you didn’t have the support of power that transcends the Chaos, how could you have grown so fast? It’s impossible, absolutely impossible. In fact, not only the Dao Patriarch of Space and I, the other Dao Patriarch also think the same thing.”
“That’s why the two of you set up such a ploy. If you can’t get the answer out of me, you would suppress me?” Jiang Min laughed and retorted instead of answering them.
“That’s right!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation admitted directly. “When opportunity rises, we should seize it by all means.”
“I understand.” Jiang Ming nodded.
He really understood them. Back when he was in the exclusive cultivation space, he spent so much time there that he even almost transformed into the Dao himself. However, he eventually persevered.
What about the two in front of him? How long had they lived for? It was absolutely impossible to calculate. The only thing that had remained in their heart was only the possibility of further transcendence.
As for the rest? They wouldn’t even put them at heart. They wouldn’t even be too concerned about their own death.
“There’s another place that’s clearly beyond the Chaos Realm. Why didn’t the two of you pursue it?” Jiang Ming asked oddly.
“Why do you think we didn’t pursue it?” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation smiled bitterly.
“How could we not pursue it?” The Dao Patriarch of Space sighed.
It was clear that they knew what Jiang Ming was referring to.
“Alas, the inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation tilted his head high, with a complex expression on his face that was mixed with a sense of longing, boundless bitterness and incomprehension. “That is an open secret. The inheritance is unparalleled and there is even the chance of transcendence within. Back then, we tried to uncover the hidden secret of the Supreme Pagoda to the point that two Dao Patriarchs had died, but it didn’t even shake the inheritance the slightest. Or rather, we couldn’t even step into its door.”
The past was too tragic and saddening. Whenever they thought about it, it brought back an endless feeling of resignation.
The inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda had naturally brought upon the prying eyes of many experts of the Chaos Primordial Land. However, it turned out that only those of the lower cultivation base could enter the Supreme Pagoda.
Who knew how many experts wanted to forcibly enter the Supreme Pagoda through the Supreme Order, but it was all for naught. Some of them even enslaved others to attain the Supreme Order and tried to force their way in. In the end, they received the backlash of the supreme power and died.
No matter what method they used, they couldn’t enter the Supreme Pagoda.
Later on, two Chaos Experts used a special method and gathered a total of 108 beings who were blessed with the Supreme Order. They gathered them to be placed under observation in order to find a way into it.
The two even went as far as to nurture this group of experts. Two of them passed the tests of the Supreme Pagoda and obtained the status as a registered disciple. Upon ascending into the higher realms, they disappeared into thin air without a trace.
The two waited for them for countless years, but still they didn’t return.
Later on, they manage to nurture one of them into a Group Admin and learn of the existence of the Hongmeng Primordial Land.
The two Chaos Experts gathered the other beings and the group admin to refine them and merged the many Supreme Orders to pry deeper. As a result, the two Chaos Experts died tragically on the spot. Only the Group Admin emerged unharmed.
As Jiang Ming listened to the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation’s remarks, he couldn’t help but reveal an odd expression on his face.
Refining a Group Admin? Haha! He was sure that this group admin definitely didn’t reveal the fact that the group admin possessed an invincible defensive means.
“Refine the many Supreme Orders resulting in a backlash?” This was something that Jiang Ming didn’t even know of.
Perhaps the two Chaos Experts had gone crazy. Their endless testing and prying to the point of no regards had triggered the wrath of the Supreme Pagoda.
“There is no rule whatsoever for the Supreme Pagoda at selecting its members.”Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation continued with a lowered voice. “Even the Supremes couldn’t pry into it and could only observe silently. However, it is certain that there is a transcendental opportunity within. It can even be said that the Supreme Pagoda is something a transcendental had left behind. Otherwise, how can it be hidden from our probing? How can it even kill two Dao Patriarchs?”
It was apparent that the two of them knew all that they could’ve known about the Supreme Pagoda. For example, they knew that passing the test within the Supreme Pagoda would grant them the opportunity to go forth into the real land of inheritance.
“Throughout the ages, there were many experts who entered the Supreme Pagoda and there should be a few of them who have been accepted as disciples as well. However, they never returned after heading towards the real land of inheritance?” Jiang Ming suddenly asked.
This was what Jiang Ming felt suspicious about their remarks. From what they said, there didn’t seem to be any. Jiang Ming felt this shouldn’t be.
After all, there weren’t a few who had managed to pass the test and became registered disciples at this point in time. It should’ve been the same in the past. There should be a lot of them. But to never return after?
“There is!” A weird expression flashed through the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation’s face. “We know of only one person and that person even became a Dao Patriarch.”
“As for the Supreme Pagoda, you seem to know quite a lot about it. We’ve speculated that you obtained the inheritance within and now we are sure of it.” The Dao Patriarch of Space suddenly spoke, “However, you must surely be in possession of some other terrifying inheritance other than the Supreme Pagoda. Otherwise, it would be impossible for you to grow that fast, even with the Supreme Pagoda inheritance. Alas, the opportunity for transcendence is not just a single one! Wonderful!”

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - Burst the Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Burst the Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Jiang Ming had learned a little bit more about the Supreme Pagoda.
The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation even said that he later found out the inheritance of the Supreme Pagoda was discovered in the other Sea of Chaos as well. Jiang Ming had validated this fact through Luo Heng.
‘Would the Human Path Record and the Supreme Pagoda of the same level? What’s the origin of the system?’ Jiang Ming had been pondering but he couldn’t find the answers to the questions that he had. The only thing he knew was that these two great vessels were beyond the Chaos Supreme Treasure. However, he was unassured to what extent the two great vessels had achieved for the time being.
The Human Path Record, the Supreme Pagoda, Hongmeng Primordial Land, and Jun Sanqian.
Jiang Ming thought a lot as thoughts were running through his mind.
However, the Dao Patriarch of Space was assured now that Jiang Ming owned the other inheritance that surpassed the Chaos Realm.
“Can you please tell us what’s beyond the Chaos? Is it the so-called Hongmeng?” Dao Patriarch of Space said in a sincere tone with his two eyes lit up.
When the Dao Patriarch of Space and Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation thought of the capability of Jiang Ming advancing into the Chaos Real, they were assured that the inheritance Jiang Ming had put his hands on, was extremely terrifying. After all, there was currently an inheritor of the Supreme Pagoda in the Chaos Primordial Land, but the time he used to advance into the Chaos Realm was a billion years. Yet, what about Jiang Ming here? Damn, he only used a span of a few hundred years. Even the time to take a sip of tea was way longer than that.
The Dao Patriarch Space even recalled the time when he tried to find out how many worlds his pee would penetrate, he used a total of 300 years to do that. At that time, his urine almost penetrated the membrane of the Sea of Chaos. Even though his actions could be considered to have blessed the infinite realms with endless fortunes, he was being teased by the other Dao Patriarchs.
‘Damn, does it mean that the amount of time I took to pee is the same amount Jiang Ming has taken to advance into the Chaos Realm? F*ck!’
“I’m sure that there’s other realms above the Chaos…” Jiang Ming made a pause before he added. “But I have no idea about the details of the other worlds. What about you two leave now? I’ll take it as nothing has happened. Otherwise, it would be a fight that would end only when either party is dead.”
Jiang Ming was no longer that aggressive he used to be. Otherwise, for him being plotted, he would have killed the culprit even if the culprit didn’t intend to to kill him.
“You are talking nonsense, aren’t you. It’s definitely a higher realm above the Chaos.” The Dao Patriarch of Space snorted. “Dao Patriarch of Soul, what about you share to us the secret of the world above? You can make any request.”
“In order to go after the higher realm, in order to take a look at what we’ve thought of as the great Dao, we can truly sacrifice anything.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation said sincerely.
“Are you sure?” Jiang Ming laughed.
“Yes!” The two Dao Patriarchs nodded in unison.
“Haha, alright!” Jiang Ming laughed. “In that case, give me your Dao Sanctifying Supreme Treasure and I’ll tell you whatever I know.”
“Fellow Daoist!” The face of the Dao Patriarch of Space darkened and his eyes were burning with flames. “You are joking, aren’t you. The Dao Sanctifying Supreme Treasure is about our future. How can we sacrifice it?”
“Fellow Daoist, doing so is akin to saying you don’t want us to go further and you want to cut off our path of Dao, do you?” The tone of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation had abruptly turned indifferent.
“Haha!” Jiang Ming guffawed and the aura he leaked, had destroyed the broken great chiliocosm where they were in and revealed the great formation which had enveloped them.
Jiang Ming didn’t care about it but he suddenly stopped laughing as he said, “A joke? You just told me that you’re willing to sacrifice all things for the sake of the great Dao. Yet, when I just make a request, you aren’t willing to admit it.”
“Well, you two aren’t sincere at all. You are just trying to make bricks without straws. In that case, we should stop being long-winded. What about we just have a match to decide who’s the ultimate winner? If you two were to kill me, all of mine would naturally become yours.”
Jiang Ming’s supreme and invincible aura had distorted the void so much that even the laws of Chaos couldn’t withstand it. Hence, all laws had avoided Jiang Ming’s aura, creating a vacuum in his surroundings.
The vacuum had no materials nor rules. It was a completely empty space. If a Saint was to enter it, the power of nothingness could shatter the Saint into ash in an instant. It was the horrifying power exclusive for the Chaos Realm.
“Slash!” With a flash across Jiang Ming’s forehead, the power of soul had turned into a ray of sword and cut open the external protective divine luminance of the Dao Patriarch of Space. Following that, it cut through the skin of his forehead and a loud bang was heard before it could go further.
Rumble… The sound seemed like opening up heaven and earth, unleashing an endless torrent of mighty power.
The Dao Patriarch of Space was blasted out. There was a bell suspended atop his head, but its luminance had dimmed, and there was actually a crack on it. The Dao Patriarch of Space looked very gloomy.
“Dao Patriarch of Space!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation instantaneously took his move. As he leaped into the air and slapped, there was a channel of nothingness shrouded the place. Inside, there were layers of strange forces that revolved and reverberated constantly, capable of tearing apart all visible and intangible things.
Jiang Ming shattered the channel with just a punch. “It’s nothing more than that!” Jiang Ming laughed and was slightly relieved.
“Brassy silly!” The Dao Patriarch of Space was furious. If it weren’t for the fact that he had specially prepared a Quasi-Chaos Treasure Bell to guard his consciousness, he would have been severely injured with a single blow just now. Even so, his mind was still suffering from concussion.
“Sea of 3,000 Realms!” The Dao Patriarch of Space suddenly vanished. Following that, the gate of space appeared one after another in the surroundings with each seemed to be between reality and illusion. It was unpredictable. Moreover, the scene behind each gate was utterly different.
“Alas, the Sea of 3,00 Realms that take Space Dao as the carrier to evoke 3,000 special abilities. Even if I face it, I can only defend.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation lamented before he revealed a smile on his face. “Well, let’s just suppress him with this strike!”
“Chaos Reincarnation Formation, activate!” With just a thought, the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation activated the formation which he had laid earlier in an instant. The area abruptly darkened, filled with strange power, and distorted.
“This formation is formed by the nine pieces of Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasures that the Dao Patriarch of Space and I have obtained by spending all our treasures. We reversed time for three trillion years to readjust them and finally build them into a set of real artifacts. Hence, once this formation is laid, no Dao Patriarch from the Chaos Primordial Land can resist it at all.” The voice of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation echoed. “Moreover, there’s the Dao Patriarch of Space around.”
“Suppress him directly.” The voice of the Dao Patriarch of Space was filled with boundless killing intention.
In the next moment, the 3,000 gates of space were emanating luminance simultaneously and different special abilities spew out of it. Each special ability was intertwined by the terrific power of reincarnation.
“Alas, this is to kill me with a strike!” Jiang Ming frowned greatly.
Jiang Ming believed that he was capable of resisting the simultaneous attack of the Dao Patriarch of Space and the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation. However, when the attack was supported by the great formation’s power, Jiang Ming had felt the danger.
The next moment, the Chaos Defensive Garment appeared on Jiang Ming’s body and the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda appeared right above him. Meanwhile, Jiang Ming held a Dao Exterminating Lance in his left hand and a Chaos Dao Slashing Sword in his right hand.
“I’ll just kill them!” As Jiang Ming roared, he unleashed his boundless power. The lance trembled as it was thrust through the Chaos. The light of the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword circulated, cutting through everything. As the pagoda on Jiang Ming’s head was buzzing and shaking, it greatly increased the power of soul, transforming the power into a terrific offensive technique.
Rumble! In just a moment, the entire territory had become a mess. Jiang Ming had successfully resisted the joint strike of the two Dao Patriarchs.
“The pagoda, the battle armor, the lance and the divine sword! How is it possible that you actually have a total of four supreme treasures?” The Dao Patriarch of Space shrieked.
“He sanctified his Dao with his soul, yet how can his physique also achieve the Chaos Realm? Even his cultivation base is the power of the Chaos Origin. T-t-this… This is impossible.” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation couldn’t believe it. “He has sanctified three laws and owned four Supreme Treasures. How can we fight against him!”
The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was in despair at the same time he felt incredible. Even with the support of the great formation and the joint strike of two Dao Patriarchs, the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation knew that he could do nothing to confront such an opponent.
“My turn!” At this moment, Jiang Ming grew taller and taller. Even though he had to endure the pressure of the great formation and was shrouded in the boundless might of the two, the supreme Chaos Divine Demonic Body of Jiang Ming had grown up to the size of a light year.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - Bombarded and Killed Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Bombarded and Killed Dao Patriarchs
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Invincible power, unbreakable defense and the immortal soul had made Jiang Ming invincible. Jiang Ming had many special abilities and techniques but only a few could be utilized to resist the Chaos Experts. Even though he had comprehended many special abilities for many years, he was after all, tried them in the exclusive cultivation space only.
However, Jiang Ming managed to comprehend one special ability to its ultimate limit. It was the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique.
Taking his inner world as the foundation and the Soul Dao as support, Jiang Ming had evolved this technique to the current extreme, capable of detonating a Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasure. However, he was not capable of detonating a real Chaos Supreme Treasure yet.
Anyway, Jiang Ming was currently overflowing with fighting spirit, and the excitement that had been dormant was revived. His surging fighting spirit shook the Chaos, and the battle even shook violently.
With just a move of Jiang Ming’s soul, it had permeated through layers of laws. The strong soul of Jiang Ming pressured the two Dao Patriarchs and forced them out of their hiding. If it weren’t because of the support of the formation, the two Dao Patriarchs would absolutely be even more miserable.
“Die!” Jiang Ming roared as the lance in his left hand pierced through the void while the sword in his right hand could slash all things.
The vast power of divine luminance had all things covered while the invincible power of destruction had disturbed all the order.
“Kill!” The two Dao Patriarchs of Reincarnation and Space had got anxious. The two evoked their special abilities and approached Jiang Ming from the two sides.
They had investigated Jiang Ming, and they knew that Jiang Ming was a ruthless man who would never let them go once they became his enemies. Since Jiang Ming had said that the winner of the battle would be decided through life and death, they would die if they were to lose the battle.
In that case, they would just have to suck it up. They might still have a chance to bombard and kill Jiang Ming even though he had four pieces of Supreme Treasures and sanctified three ways of Daos.
However, because the two Dao Patriarchs were facing Jiang Ming, who had been unleashing his best self, it was difficult for them to inflict any injury on Jiang Ming. Yet, they had to defend themselves against the pervasive soul attack that could pose a great threat to them.
To the two Dao Patriarchs, this battle was extremely tough. When they were forced into retreat, they directly vanished into thin air.
“Extreme Reincarnation!” The sound of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation suddenly rang out. The great formation he had laid, abruptly constricted and trapped Jiang Ming in the center. In fact, it was still constricting.
“Are you trying to overwhelmingly suppress me?” Jiang Ming released billions of light all over his body, resisting the supreme power of the nine Quasi-Chaos Vessels, making it difficult for the formation to continue to constrict and trap him to death.
Buzz, buzz, buzz… The Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda had been shaking to hold on. Even the Chaos Defensive Garment had various laws intertwining to form an invincible defense, which made it more difficult for the formation to constrict further.
‘However, it’s quite difficult to break through the formation!’ Jiang Ming frowned.
Jiang Ming also felt it was troublesome to deal with the desperate means of the two Dao Patriarchs.
It was at this time that a sound rang out again from within the formation. It originated from the Dao Patriarch of Space this time. “Dao Patriarch of Soul, we have never thought that you would have such a terrific foundation. The four pieces of Supreme Treasures and three ways of Dao that you’ve sanctified, can be made possible only with the availability of supreme encounters beyond Chaos Realm. Hence, it has further strengthened our determination to suppress you!”
“Alas the nine pieces of Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasure!”
“Let’s use their power to have you destroyed completely!”
“Space as the carrier to sacrifice Hongmeng. Die!”
Rumble…
The nine pieces of Chaos Dao Vessels that had combined into a great formation were all radiating extreme luminance, and energy surged out from within. With the support of the formation, the power transformed into special ability had reached an unimaginable level.
“It’s a pity of the nine Supreme Treasures!”
“There’s nothing to be pitied about. This is the only method we can utilize to kill him. Otherwise, what else can we do? The Dao Patriarch of Soul is too terrifying. He’ll one day dominate the Chaos Primordial Land.”
“Yes, who has ever thought that he can be this strong right? Unbelievable! Beware, the power that’d burst forth may even affect us. Spatial ball of divinity, transferring infinite realms!”
Atop Dao Patriarch of Space was a ball emanating a whitish luminance. As he evoked, pitch dark passages appeared around them to lead the power away from them.
“Do you think it can kill him?” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was not confident. “Unfortunately I failed to comprehend the special ability which could detonate the Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasure. Otherwise, I’ll be certained about it.”
“He’ll die for sure.” The Dao Patriarch of Space was very confident. “After all, there are nine pieces of Supreme Treasures. Almost all of their power would be released even if it would damage their origin. The destructive power that burst forth would be more terrifying than both of us self-detonating together. Hence, who can resist it? There absolutely isn’t anyone in the Chaos Primordial Land who can resist it, not even anyone who has the Chaos-leveled defensive armor. No way, definitely not!”
The two also fell silent as they watched the light blooming three trillion light-years away. The power of destruction from radiation that had gotten near them could still easily kill the King Saint Experts and even the Lord Saint Experts might be annihilated.
What about the center point? Nothing could ever live at all.
In the previous moment when Jiang Ming was looking at the formation that had sealed him was about to thoroughly explode, he hesitated.
In fact, it wasn’t difficult for him to break it. Jiang Ming merely had to evoke the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to affect the core of the formation and deactivate the formation.
Another method Jiang Ming could do was just to resist it. He had a Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda and Chaos Defensive Garment, which were the Defensive Vessel of the Chaos Supreme Treasure and they were of the highest quality. Moreover, Jiang Ming had a physique of Chaos Realm, hence he himself was comparable to a Chaos Supreme Treasure.
Jiang Ming still had a small-scale Sea of Chaos within his inner world. With all these added up together, it wasn’t difficult to resist the explosion of the formation. It just consumed too much.
The moment the formation exploded, Jiang Ming abruptly disappeared through the Human Path Record. He actually got to the World Tree in a Sea of Chaos where Luo Heng’s world was located.
Jiang Ming stayed there for a while before he returned.
This time, Jiang Ming went directly on top of the Dao Patriarch of Space’s head. The Dao Patriarch of Space was looking at the destruction in front and was slightly relaxed.
Even though the Dao Patriarch of Space had sensed Jiang Ming the moment Jiang Ming appeared, he was too late.
“Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, disturb!”
“Soul Sword, slash!”
“Dao Extermination Lance, exterminate!”
“Chaos Dao Slashing Sword, die!”
Jiang Ming had utterly unleashed his power. Jiang Ming evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to stir up the origin of the space ball, a Chaos Supreme Treasure of the Dao Patriarch of Space, greatly reducing its might and preventing it from forming an effective attack and defense. Jiang Ming couldn’t detonate it but could affect it.
Immediately following after, Jiang Ming evoked his Soul Sword with full force. It directly broke open the defensive great vessel, a Chaos Supreme Treasure which was defending the consciousness ofDao Patriarch of Space, shook his soul and caused the Dao Patriarch of Space who was about to counteract to tremble and bleed out of all his orifices.
The Dao Patriarch of Space had lost his final chance.
Rumble! Both the Dao Exterminating Lance and the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword had been cast at the Dao Patriarch of Space simultaneously. The lance pierced through his skull while the sword thrust into his heart.
If the Dao Patriarch of Space was an ordinary opponent, he would have died. However, he was a supreme being of the Chaos Realm. Even though his aura had turned icy-cold in an instant, he was not killed completely yet. He began struggling instead.
“Dao Patriarch of Soul, how did you appear here?” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was shocked. At the same time he asked, a point of light appeared abruptly on his body, formed into a palace and bombarded towards Jiang Ming. It was the Chaos Supreme Treasure, which was known as the Reincarnation Hall.
Jiang Ming didn’t care about the attack of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation. He merely turned around with his back facing the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation. Meanwhile, the Chaos Defensive Garment emanated the invincible and immortal aura and layers of luminance, which resisted the strike of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation.
Following that, Jiang Ming took out the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda. He evoked its supreme might to release the horrifying power that could suppress the Chaos and trapped the dying Dao Patriarch of Space within.
‘He should be a great supplement.’ Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up and kept the slightly trembling pagoda into his inner world.
In his inner world, Jiang Ming was confident to even suppress ten Dao Patriarchs of Space, let alone there was only one Dao Patriarch of Space.
Following that, Jiang Ming turned to look at the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation who had been bombarding him with 36 strikes, leading to his physique trembling and his soul roaring. Jiang Ming grinned. “Now it’s your turn!”

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 30,000,000 Clones
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: 30,000,000 Clones
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
An expert who had mastered the Spatial Dao was very terrifying at any time. It was also the reason why Jiang Ming chose to kill the Dao Patriarch of Space first. Provided he had killed the hardest one, it would be easy for him to kill the other one.
The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation had naturally thought of it. Even though he had no idea how Jiang Ming could appear abruptly from within the center point of destruction, it didn’t prevent him from reacting immediately.
“Infinite Reincarnation!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation evoked his Reincarnation Hall to strike a blow. The repetition of Chaos, the rotation of sun and moon, and the mess of time had all become hazy in the Reincarnation Dao, causing the mind and body to sink into the slough of despond.
Following that, the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation took the advantage to escape. However, it was unfortunate that his opponent was Jiang Ming. If his opponent were other Chaos Experts, he would be able to escape easily.
“Die!” The moment Jiang Ming descended in front of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation via the Human Path Record, he had evoked the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique to affect the Reincarnation Hall so that it was difficult for this supreme vessel to exert its full force.
At the same time, Jiang Ming had cast his soul attack, the Dao Exterminating Lance and the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword at the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation. Just this one blow had severely injured the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation.
“Reincarnation of 10,000 Shadows!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was prepared after all. Hence, he was still capable of reacting even though he was severely injured.
With a flutter of his figure, there were pitch black channels connected to an endless distance appearing one after another. It was the method for the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation to escape.
“You are not the Dao Patriarch of Space, after all. Otherwise, it’d be difficult for me to have you captured.”
Jiang Ming sensed that the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was differentiating his body, allowing him to escape as long as one of his shadows managed to elude. Jiang Ming immediately grabbed and the Chaos Defensive Garment detached from him. Following that, he flicked into the void while his Chaos Defensive Garment merged into the Chaos Void. In just an instant, Jiang Ming knew that the channels were leading to an ever-lasting end. Hence, he cut off all the power of reincarnation, turned the surroundings into a forbidden area, which quickly shrank.
“Who are you actually?” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation was forced to reveal himself. His look was extremely gloomy but he remained evoking his mighty power. “Heavenly law of Reincarnation, support me!”
Rumble! The order of reincarnation was in an uproar. It was supposed to be the supreme power that could shake the entire Sea of Chaos, but the power was only confined in the law domain, making the face of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation to become gloomy again.
“To think that it can actually cut off the rules of Chaos!” The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation exclaimed. Following that, he couldn’t help but sigh. “It’s now difficult for me to escape. Dao Patriarch of Soul, would you like to tell me who you actually are? Are you from Hongmeng? Otherwise, why would you have so many Chaos Supreme Treasure and how can you suddenly disappear from the annihilation great formation that the Dao Patriarch of Space and I had laid? And how can you descend to the space where the Dao Patriarch of Space and I are located quietly? After all, we are all at the Chaos Realm. Wherever we are, all laws retreat and all special abilities wouldn’t show up. We can even sense it immediately when anyone was to make a breakthrough.”
These were what confused the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation the most. The region where a Chaos Expert was, would automatically form a law domain. In the law domain, no one could go near the Chaos Expert without being discovered, not even any expert who mastered the Concealment Dao.
