However, Jiang Ming who mastered the Soul Dao did it effortlessly. Hence, the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation couldn’t understand the reason why.
“I’ve my own Dao of course.” Jiang Ming said indifferently. “It’s understandable if the two of you plot against me when you’ve already achieved the utmost limit of the Chaos Realm. However, both of you are merely at the middle stage of the Chaos Realm. Both of you are in over your heads to seek for a higher-level power when you aren’t even at the utmost limit of the Chaos Realm.”
“However, because it came from the two of you, I am not surprised at all. After all, the two of you are so bored that you built the Lord God Space and the Reincarnation Hall to pick geniuses from billions of worlds to struggle within the rules you dictate just to please yourself occasionally.”
“You two said that it’s because you’re too bored with the long cultivation time. But I think it’s your self-distortion!”
“Anyway, now that the two have provoked me, I shall send you to hell.”
“As for the saying that a Chaos Expert is immortal? It’s just nonsense to me!”
As Jiang Ming said, he took his move again.
In addition to the fact that Jiang Ming owned a few Chaos Supreme Treasure and his higher cultivation base, the situation of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation whereby he had been severely injured and imprisoned, the entire skirmish had reached its conclusion.
After Jiang Ming had transferred the suppressed Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation to his inner world, he put away the Chaos Defensive Garment and also felt the gazes projected at him.
These gaze which were filled with shock, disbelief and incredibility, were from the other Chaos Experts in the Chaos Primordial land. One of them was Hong Lei.
Jiang Ming didn’t care and his figure abruptly disappeared. He had returned to the exclusive space in the Supreme Pagoda for his cultivation.
This time, Jiang Ming wanted to refine the two Dao Patriarchs and extract their Spatial Dao and Reincarnation Dao to expand his inner world.
Relatively speaking, this retreat didn’t take long. It had just taken a million years.
The refinement of the two Dao Patriarchs had greatly expanded the inner Chaos World of Jiang Ming. Moreover the Chaos Laws of Space and Reincarnation had been utterly transformed from the seed into the Chaos Laws.
Under the three Chaos Laws of Soul, Space and Reincarnation, the transformation of Jiang Ming’s inner world had been accelerated. It was more than 100 times faster than before.
‘I’m now considered to have mastered three laws. Although they have not reached the extreme level, it can be regarded that I’ve sanctified three laws of Dao.’ Jiang Ming opened his eyes, and had a look of happiness on his face.
Jiang Ming’s combat power had been improved again.
However, Jiang Ming didn’t stop his retreat. He inventoried the collection of the two Dao Patriarchs, particularly the manual of their special abilities, the hidden inheritance in their respective great Dao and the likes. Jiang Ming absorbed all of them and made them his own resources.
These were far stronger than the Soul Technique Jiang Ming had comprehended himself. After all, the Soul Dao and the special abilities he had deduced, were far less mature. He was merely overwhelming others with his power.
Now that Jiang Ming had the two Dao Patriarchs as templates and reference, it was easier for him to deduce himself.
Time had been passing by quickly.
Jiang Ming was again returned to the Chuyang Peak. This time he didn’t have much change in his emotion. After all, he used to have the experience of billions of years. Nevertheless, he still pulled his junior sister into a space he condensed, reversed the time thousands of times to be intimate with her.
This time around, Jiang Ming and his junior sister did it together with their 30 millions clones respectively. They also reached orgasm simultaneously. That pleasant sensations from all the clones being superimposed had almost made Jiang Ming lost in it even with his current heart of Dao.
Jiang Ming said he f*cking enjoyed that feeling.
On the Chuyang Peak.
Linglong lay on Jiang Ming while drawing circles on him with her finger. She snorted, “You’re my greatest fortune indeed. After making love with you, my cultivation base has greatly improved again. I’ve made up my mind not to cultivate anymore. Whenever I want to improve my cultivation, I’ll just copulate with you to collect endless creation substances. After I absorb them, I’ll naturally improve.”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. However, as he thought of it, what Linglong had said actually made sense. That was his essence after all.
“Let me go to give a greeting!” Putting Linglong aside, Jiang Ming stood up and stretched. Following that, he separated an avatar towards the Jiuyang Great Hall while he himself went to the Tianyuan Sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - The Inheritance of the Human Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: The Inheritance of the Human Clan
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
On the Tianyuan Sea.
The Tianyuan Sea had formed the true Sacred Land of the Honggu Great Chiliocosm. It was the Sacred Land dominated by humans. Great Overarching Experts were everywhere, and there were also a lot of Quasi-Sage Experts. Most of the Quasi-Sage Experts originated from the Tianyuan Realm.
Atop the Infinite Realm Auction House, Riyue Changfeng was still leisurely enjoying his tea. He had sanctified the Saint Realm and had long not been in a rush to go back.
“Brother Jiang.” Upon seeing Jiang Ming, Riyue Changfeng was ecstatic. He stood up and clasped his hand. “You’ve become a rare guest indeed.”
“Upon my level, each seclusion would take at least a million years. I’d come here once every short while, yet I’m called a rare guest.” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but tease, “So are you planning to stay here forever?”
“Fellow Daoist Yun!” Jiang Ming greeted Yun Zizai by clasping his hands before he sat down.
“This is the land of encounter and the place where I sanctified my Dao. If I were to leave, I’d be punished by the thunder of heaven.” Riyue Changfeng was familiar with Jiang Ming’s character, hence he asked straightforwardly, “By the way, are you here to show off again?”
“The word ‘show off’ has been used perfectly indeed.” Yun Zizai laughed. “Fellow Daoist Jiang, have you improved further already?”
“Barely made some progress. But I just came back from the depths of Chaos, where I killed two Dao Patriarchs of the Chaos Realm.” Jiang Ming said casually.
However, it was shocking news to both Riyue Changfeng and Yun Zizai. They were dumbstruck and in a complete daze.
They used to see many Dao Patriarchs. Even though there might be a Saint who called himself a Dao Patriarch in a little great chiliocosm, the Dao Patriarch of the Chaos Realm represented the immortal, eternal, invincible and the strongest being in the Chaos Primordial Land.
To think that Jiang Ming had killed two Dao Patriarchs of the Chaos Realm, they thought Jiang Ming must be pulling their legs. Hence, they didn’t believe it at the beginning. But when they thought of Jiang Ming’s situation and the fact that Jiang Ming had never lied, they couldn’t help but feel chills down their spines.
“Did you really kill two Chaos Experts?” Even the teeth of Yun Zizai were chattering.
For Yun Zizai, a Chaos Expert was the legendary expert. Not to mention having seen one of them, being able to hear about them was a luxury itself. In fact, the hair of such a being could crush him to death thousands of times.
“Which two?” Riyue Changfeng was shivering as well. But he couldn’t help but ask curiously.
“The Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation who controls the Reincarnation Hall and the Dao Patriarch of Space who controls the Lord God Space!” Jiang Ming sighed. “These two Dao Patriarchs learned about my cultivation speed and wanted to snatch away my encounters. As a result, I killed them all. They are too discontented. Although they are among the strongest, they are still very greedy. Therefore, they eventually lost their lives.”
Riyue Changfeng was rendered speechless. Jiang Ming was f*cking too proud of himself. However, the way Jiang Ming had been showing off was indeed shocking.
Alas, the two Dao Patriarchs, who were high above anyone else. Yet, they were killed by a being from the great chiliocosm. This was so unbelievable.
“Brother Jiang, can you give me a hair of yours?” Riyue Changfeng suddenly requested.
“Huh?” Jiang Ming revealed a confused expression.
“A hair of you is certainly comparable to a Saint Weapon. Coupled with the endless will and immortal power contained in it, I can go through Chaos with your hair.” Riyue Changfeng explained with a slight excitement.
Yun Zizai wanted to laugh but couldn’t. It was, after all, a fact. If possible, he would like to have the hair of Jiang Ming as well. A single hair of Jiang Ming, who had killed two Dao Patriarchs ruthlessly, symbolized the life-saving talisman.
“I have a chill.” Jiang Ming was speechless. “I plan to go to the Chaos Primordial Land, do you guys want to go back with me?”
Jiang Ming voiced his true intention.
“You’re going to the Primordial Land?” Riyue Changfeng didn’t expect that, but he knew it was a matter of course. “With your current level, you should be going to the Primordial Land indeed. Otherwise, you may accidentally destroy the entire great chiliocosm here. Brother Jiang, take me with you. I should return as well and it’d be time for me to show off as well.”
“You showing off?” Jiang Ming was disgusted. “I’ve been giving you a lot of advantages, yet you’re only at the peak of Saint Realm, not even advancing into the King Saint Realm. Beware that it’d turn out to be a slap in the face.”
Riyue Changfeng gnashed his teeth.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, take me along as well. It’s enough to have traveled around the Chaos for numerous years.” How could Yun Zizai not join them? Jiang Ming was, after all, a super big coattail that Yun Zizai must ride on. Even if he was to be seen being together with Jiang Ming only for a short while, he would be labeled as someone close to a Dao Patriarch.
Jiang Ming returned to the Chuyang Peak after he let them go towards the Tianyuan Realm.
On the other hand, when Jiang Ming’s avatar got to the Jiuyang Main Hall, he told the leaders of the Jiuyang Sect about Jiang Ming’s intention and asked them whether they would be interested to tag along.
“The Chaos Primordial Land, the source of Dao and the beginning of fate? How can I not go?” The Sect Leader said with excitement, “The ultimate dream for the cultivators of my generation is to explore the great Dao. Now that we have such an encounter, we definitely would grab hold of it.”
“Even I’m interested.” Gu Hai also nodded his head. “Ming, you just arrange it in the way you think fits!”
“Alright!” Jiang Ming said, “Master, Sect Leader, please ask around if anyone wishes to stay here. If yes, do let them leave the Tianyuan Realm as soon as possible. Also, please ask Senior Brother Chang whether he would like to remain in the position as the Heavenly Emperor or join us together. As for the rest, you may just arrange as you wish.”
“Saint Lord, what if Chang Yiming didn’t want to be in the position of the Heavenly Emperor, what can we do to the position? If we were all leaving, what to do if the previously suppressed races rebel against our human race?” The Sect Leader had far-reaching thoughts.
“This is after all, our base. Ming, you’ll have to arrange it nicely.” Gu Hai warned.
“Don’t worry.” Jiang Ming smiled. “I’m going to leave some means to ensure that our Honggu Great Chiliocosm will not be invaded by the outside world, and the position of Heavenly Emperor can only be reserved for our human race. Even if there’re Saints in other races, they can be easily suppressed.”
“That’s good!” Gu Hai and the others heaved a sigh of relief.
The avatar of Jiang Ming returned.
As Jiang Ming pointed out, the God of Law Enforcement located in the Heaven Court, which he had refined as a Demi-Sage puppet, was given the power of King Saint Realm.
As Jiang Ming waved his hand, he laid a peerless Skynet based on the 3,000 laws of Honggu Great Chiliocosm. Jiang Ming even left an imprint of the human race in its core. Hence, only the human race could manipulate it to resist the external invasion and suppress all races in the chiliocosm itself.
Also, Jiang Ming refined the Heavenly Emperor Seal, Emperor Crown and the Heavenly Emperor Sword again so that all three became Saint Weapons and were tightened together with the luck of the human race. No one other than the human could evoke their power and communicate with the Skynet through the three Saint Weapons at the same time.
‘These means are enough.’ Jiang Ming lay back on the rattan chair.
Not long later, Chang Yiming returned. He sat directly beside Jiang Ming and poured himself a cup of tea. As soon as he took a sip, his face suddenly flushed, the pores all over his body opened, emanating rich divine luminance.
Chang Yiming hurriedly evoked his technique. It was only after a while that he managed to gradually calm down. Following that, he said in shock, “What is this, it almost made me burst!”
Jiang Ming chuckled. “This is the most normal pot of tea. Senior Brother Chang, you must not simply eat and drink my stuff here. Otherwise, you’d be annihilated.”
“Do you mean that you won’t even let me drink a cup of tea? How stingy.” Chang Yiming was speechless.
“I’ve gone beyond the Saint, the King Saint, the Lord Saint and advanced into the Chaos Realm. As I’m standing atop the Sea of Chaos, whatever I have, even if it’s very common, it’s a sky-defying precious collection for you.” Jiang Ming teased. “Just that pot of tea, after you’ve absorbed it, you’d just need to settle down and you’d advance into the Saint Realm.”
“What the f*ck, this is so amazing.” Chang Yiming was bewildered.
“Of course!”
“Awesome! Hehe, but I’ll not let go of your stuff. They are all supreme treasures after all. Look, just a sip of tea would let me advance into the Saint Realm. If I were to get something to eat in the future, I’d be improving leaps and bounds, wouldn’t I? As for being exploded, I’m not afraid with you around anyway.”
“You’re cheating, aren’t you?”
“How is it called cheating? This is my luck. By the way, are you truly leaving? I’ve just taken over the position of the Heavenly Emperor not long ago, and I haven’t had enough fun yet.”
“You can continue!”
“Forget about it. It’s meaningless that I stay alone here. Are we coming back after leaving?”
“With my peerless cultivation, we can come back anytime with a thought.”
“You’re amazing!” Chang Yiming was rendered so speechless that he could only give a thumbs up. He raised his head and saw a figure pacing over through the air. So he chuckled and left.
It was Xi Yao who landed at the side. Looking at the familiar figure of Jiang Ming, her cold eyes began to have some hints of warmth.
“You are back?”
“I’m back!”
Xi Yao smiled. She turned and directly returned to her residence.
Jiang Ming pouted. He sensed his junior sister’s eyes and felt the tingling sensation on his scalp. He wondered whether Linglong would give him 10 trillion clones of hers.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - Time Acceleration By A Billion Times, Tearing through the Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Time Acceleration By A Billion Times, Tearing through the Chaos
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After more than a months’ time, the preparations were done.
Chang Yiming abdicated the Heavenly Emperor’s position and his successor was a Great Overarching Golden Immortal of Jiuyang Sect. That successor thought even though the Chaos Primordial Land was a place of supreme great fortune, he would still be as feeble as a mere shrimp if he were to wander there. Hence, it would be better for him to just stay where he was.
After all, that successor said he could be invincible in Honggu Great Chiliocosm. Once he took over the position as the Heavenly Emperor, he would have gathered all the lucks and fortunes of the infinite realm. With the boundless resources flocking in, his cultivation base would surely soar and he could sanctify the Saint Realm in the future.
To that successor, the most crucial thing about being in Honggu Great Chiliocosm was that he would have the sense of vainglory here.
There was nothing wrong with the sect master and the likes taking on the position. Anyone could take over the position as the Heavenly Emperor as long as the person was of the human race and that the person wasn’t a heinous being.
Mountain Master Tian Yuan, Bai Yihou, the former Immortal Venerate Qing Yun, Immortal Venerate Tai Xu, Great Monarch Wan Lian and the likes would join Jiang Ming to the Chaos Primordial Land.
“This truly is a land of Creation!” After entering the Tianyuan Realm and arriving at the Chuyang Peak in particular, Yun Zizai sensed around and could not help but marvel at the environment here.
“Yeah! If I cultivate here all the time, I will definitely be able to advance into the King Saint Realm in no time!” Riyue Changfeng was even more amazed. “Since I’ve come here, I’m not leaving from now on. Is that alright, Brother Jiang?”
“I’m staying!” Without waiting for a reply, Riyue Changfeng directly made his remark.
“Just make yourselves at home.” Jiang Ming didn’t mind at all. “You guys can set up your own cavern yourselves.”
“Haha! I knew that Brother Jiang does have my interest in heart!” Riyue Changfeng was overjoyed and hurriedly went to look for a suitable space.
“Many thanks!” Yun Zizai had a grateful look on his face, and he was even more ecstatic at heart.
‘Alas, coming to this point, this is what it truly meant by riding on a Dao Patriarch’s coattails. My path of Dao will be formed. For sure it will. The Saint is definitely not the end for me. Not only the King Saint, I even dare to put up a fight to advance into the Lord Saint!’ Yun Zizai was filled with hope.
Riyue Changfeng and Yun Zizai didn’t set up their cavern on the mountain peak, but they went to the mountainsides.
Back on the mountain peak, Jiang Ming was overlooking Tianyuan Sea, the Infinite Realm Battlefield, Honggu Great Chiliocosm and many other places from a distance. He suddenly had an indescribable feeling in his heart.
“Feeling a little reluctant to leave?”
“A little.” Jiang Ming nodded. “This is considered our home after all. Now that we’re leaving, it’s definitely going to be a little emotional. Brother, what about you?”
“If it’s before this, there’s nothing much about leaving the place. But when it comes to really leaving the place for good, then there’s indeed the slight feeling of reluctance. After all, this is our place of birth, the place we grew up in and the place we sanctified the path of Dao. Who knows whether we’d have the chance to return after leaving the place? Hence, it’s normal to feel nostalgia.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan lamented, but laughed. “With your meticulous character and yet you’re now heading towards the Chaos Primordial Land, could it be that you have the absolute capability to protect yourself already?”
“You’re still the one who knows me well.” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh out loud. “I’m the predominant one here. When we get to the Chaos Primordial Land, I’ll still be the predominant one there.”
“You’ve got my respect.” Mountain Master Tian Yuan didn’t doubt Jiang Ming one bit, but hesitantly said, “The Chaos Primordial Land is the land of the ultimate, where many peerless experts flourish. With the current state of the people in the Tianyuan Realm, wouldn’t we be at the bottom of the food chain once we are there? Do you have any way to deal with this?”
“That’s simple.” Jiang Ming pointed towards the 49 evolved stars. Each of them was a Chiliocosm itself where there were great dangers as well as boundless fortunes and creation within. “I’m going to accelerate the time within these 49 worlds by a million time. It’ll allow the beings of Tianyuan Realm to improve their strength while we travel there.”
As he said so, he casually stroked his hand through the sky. Nine of the stars that were flowing with luminance turned into a golden color.
At the same time, the voice of Dao suddenly rang out, echoing in the ears of the crowds. “Your cultivation is lacking. As such, I’ve deliberately divided nine golden stars to be used as a space for cultivation. The remaining 40 stars are lands for adventures, within which all had their time sped up by a million times compared to the outside world.”
He also conveyed the special nature of the Chaos Primordial Land to the public. This included information such as the beings there born into the Golden Immortal Realm, where they could all step into the Great Overarching Realm at their adolescence, where Quasi-Sages could be seen roaming and Saints were as nothing more than dogs there and so on.
“Can we break through our cultivation realm within?” Mountain Master Tian Yuan asked.
“Of course.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “I’ve condensed 3,000 Saint Laws within. As long as your cultivation level reaches the threshold, you will naturally be able to break through. You can also break through here as well, brother. Just keep on cultivating here.”
“Time is endless. To keep on cultivating is way too boring. I’m prepared to wander through the chiliocosms that you made. You can say that I’m there to take a walk and chill out. My younger brother, hope you’re not making a fool of me.”
“Brother, I can make a fool out of anyone and it surely wouldn’t be you!”
“If that’s the case, okay then. I’ll head on for a walk first.”
Mountain Master Tian Yuan went off into the sky. In a moment’s time, he reached a golden star and plunged right into it.
Jiang Ming merely smiled.
Relatively speaking, Tianyuan Realm was indeed quite small. However, the 49 chiliocosm were all comparable to that of the great chiliocosms after Jiang Ming had evolved them. They were enough for people to leisure around, to wander through and temper their cultivation.
Right this moment, Linglong came walking over. As for her other nine clones, they were still in the midst of cultivating back at the World Tree.
“Senior brother, Xi Yao has returned. Is your heart itching again?” Linglong nestled beside him, asking with a slightly strange tone of voice.
“That’s only natural.” Jiang Ming took a glance at Linglong. “I remembered that you used to make it a point to urge her over to me. What? You’re jealous now?”
“Why would I be jealous?” Linglong rolled her eyes. “With that small body of hers, how can she withstand your immeasurable power? However, you can conjure up an avatar to give her a try.”
Jiang Ming was speechless.
With a slight thought in his mind, the Tianyuan Realm turned into a streak of luminance, tore through the universe, broke the shackles and penetrated through the world’s fetal membrane, plunging into the Chaos with just a snap of his fingers.
At that time, all of the experts with some accomplishment in their cultivation realm were able to see the situation of the outside world.
The Qi of Chaos surged violently, setting off an endless terrifying storm. However, they were blocked at the outside by a layer of membrane, unable to affect the Tianyuan Realm at all.
The other experts didn’t feel much about the torrents of the storm. After all, they had not experienced the horrors of the Chaos firsthand yet.
However, it was different for Yun Zizai and Riyue Changfeng. The two of them had personally witnessed the horror of the Chaos.
“That’s the Chaos Annihilation Storm.”
“Damn! To think that the time mist appeared right this moment. Even I’d find myself lost within.”
“What’s that patch of darkness? It’s the Chaos Black Hole!”
The two Saint Experts were shocked and baffled.
However, it didn’t matter what dangerous places they went by, they just went past them in a flash. When they thought of how powerful Jiang Ming was, the two of them just laughed and shook their heads before calming down. Following that, they began to immerse themselves in the supreme Dao fluctuation hidden within Chuyang Peak.
It was then they realized, practicing their cultivation there, they would find themselves entering the trance of enlightenment at any moment of time. The speed of comprehension of the Saint Laws was simply incredible.
Many of the beings of the Tianyuan Realm flew into the sky and went into the stars for their cultivation.
The time flow of a million years to one. That meant a year on the outside world would be equivalent to a million years within.
Is there even a better environment to temper themselves than this? Those who came out from their cultivation retreat might even be able to pass the Saint Venerate test and become a disciple.
…
On Chuyang Peak…
“Senior brother, how much time are you planning to use to get to the Chaos Origin?”
“Half a year I think! In half a year’s time, half a million years would’ve passed by in the accelerated chiliocosms. That’s enough for a batch of genius to be grown and nurtured.”
“What’s the purpose of doing this?”
“Recruit disciples!”
“Recruit disciples? Senior brother, you were reluctant to take in disciples before but now you turned around unexpectedly! Could it be that you’ve grown bored of the vicissitudes? You’re old now? Decrepit? Withered?”
“What? How dare you say I’ve shriveled up! You should be spanked!”
“Bring it on! This time, the battle will be three billion me against you! After all, we have half a years’ time to go. We’re both idle and this can also give me a boost towards the improvement of my strength. By the way, we’re going to accelerate 100 million times this time.”
“They say even iron rods can be sharpened into a needle. This mountain of mine is going to become a needle point soon!”
“Hehe… Senior brother… You’re being incapable here.”
“Bring it on! Let’s see who’s afraid of who!”
The two of them entered a realm of a whole Sea of flowers, began their great battle annihilating hundreds and millions of living beings within.
Back on the mountain peak, Jiang Ming left an avatar of his to communicate with the Great Dao Group in the Human Path Record.
Jiang Ming began to contact his friends and was shocked to learn that something big actually happened while he hadn’t gone online for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 00,000 Saints Charging to Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: 100,000 Saints Charging to Death together, Nine Great Disciples
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
In the Great Dao Group.
[Ao Jiu: Huang Quan, are you alright?]
[Di Huo: Huang Quan, what happened?]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Huang Quan, say something.]
[Huang Quan: I was just catching my breath. God damn! I almost got killed.]
[Hong Zhan: What’s going on over there? Seems you’re not in the same Sea of Chaos as we are.]
[Huang Quan: Damn it! I was about to head for the Sea of Chaos but was captured by a terrifying existence. I was later thrown into a secret battlefield where a great number of Saint Experts were in a bloodshed killing each other. I rushed high up into the sky and called out, saying that I knew Hong Zhan of the Hong Clan in the Chaos Primordial Land, Dao Patriarch Hong Lei, the Hong Clan’s great monarch and even know the newly ascended Dao Patriarch of Soul, but didn’t get any response from them.]
[Huang Quan: After that, I was besieged by many. Fortunately, I have the many Saint Weapons and the likes that you guys provided me with. I was able to fight back and obtained quite some spoils of war from it.]
[Huang Quan: I was just transferred out of the battlefield and this is how I learned that there were a hundred thousand Saint Experts placed into the secret battlefield that I was in and only a hundred of them survived.]
[Huang Quan: Alas, we’re talking about the peerless Saint Experts here and with a one in a thousand chance of survival! I couldn’t even help myself from not trembling.]
[Huang Quan: It almost scared me to death.]
[Huang Quan: Based on accumulated points from the Saints that I’ve killed, I ranked first.]
[Ao Jiu: Damn it! You’re just showing off.]
[Di Huo: Damn it! You’re just showing off.]
[Hong Yi : Amazing.]
[Hong Zhan: I never thought you’re the Huang Quan the Show Off.]
[Huang Quan: Ahem. I’m just telling the truth.]
[Huang Quan: Hold on…]
[Huang Quan: Something’s not right. There are rumors just now that the Saints that had died didn’t really die. They were just eliminated and integrated into an army! Hiss… An army made up of Saints. What are they trying to do? I feel like a great trouble is brewing.]
[Huang Quan: Brother Jiang, Brother Hong. This little life of your brother’s depends on you now.]
[Hong Yi : To pick out the best among them and the eliminated ones join the army? Is this some preparation for a great war?]
[Wang Ye: A great war with an army made of Saints. I fear it’s a war between the Sea of Chaos, right?]
[Hong Zhan: As all of you already know, there are more than one Sea of Chaos. Beyond our Sea of Chaos, there are other battlefields of the external domains where the bloodshed among experts of different Sea of Chaos takes place.]
[Hong Zhan: From what I’ve known, other than serving as a way of temperament for the experts, it is also a strategy to dwindle down the number of experts. After all, the size of the Chaos Primordial Land is limited, yet there are many peerless experts emerging. Resources would gradually be diminished. As such, it’s perfect to bring down the number through these bloodshed in the external domains.]
[Hong Zhan: However, if things become serious or one of the Sea of Chaos becomes weakened, it might face an invasion from the other Sea of Chaos. When that happens, it would then become a really terrifying great war.]
[Hong Zhan: There’s too little information from Huang Quan’s side to make any assumption.]
[Jiang Ming: Let’s just wait and see how it goes. If there’s any danger, call me!]
[Huang Quan: Brother Jiang actually popped up!]
[Huang Quan: Haha! With brother Jiang’s promise, I’m relieved.]
[Huang Quan: I’ve made my decision. I’m going to go on a reckless spree after this.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, you finally came out. Are you still short of a rider?]
[Hong Yi : I want to ride on your coattails as well!]
[Ao Jiu: Brother Jiang, you’re really too amazing. You actually killed two Dao Patriarchs. Your awesomeness is really to the extremes!]
[Hong Zhan: I still can’t believe it. The Dao Patriarch back at my clan was so shocked that he almost went off the rails. Alas! You actually killed both the Dao Patriarch of Space and Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation!]
[Jiang Ming: Well, they were the ones who were trying to set me up. In the end, they were the ones who’d been clipped instead. Alas! I’m just as innocent!]
[Huang Quan: Now this is really showing off!]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang is the best!]
[Ye Qingxian: Brother Jiang is amazing.]
[Hong Zhan: Brother Jiang, with such an achievement of yours, it’s high time for you to come over to the Chaos Primordial Land already, right?]
Jiang Ming: I’m in the middle of moving over. I’ll probably arrive in about six months’ time. Brother Hong, if any of the group members are interested in going to the Chaos Primordial Land, please guide them there, so as to not waste time.]
[Hong Zhan: Haha! Brother Jiang is finally coming over! Don’t you worry! Just leave the other group members to me.]
Jiang Ming’s avatar continued chatting around in the group chat. As he occasionally sensed the state of his original self, he couldn’t help but shivers. His original self was entangled by billions of Linglongs. Such an ordeal might scare people to death if it was to be brought into conversations
Soon after, Huang Quan told them about an army of Saints being sent into the Warzone of the Chaos.
It was the same over at Hong Zhan’s. The battlefield over in the outer domain was even more violent. The Chaos Primordial Land had sent out a great number of experts as well. It was as though there was some kind of incident recently.
As for the grand event that was going to start over at the Chaos Primordial Land, it had attracted a lot of attention from many. This was because that event was actually the opening of the Dao Field by a former Dao Patriarch. It allowed the beings of the Chaos Primordial Land to enter and seek for their great fortunes.
Some of the peak leveled experts also planned on taking this chance to seek for more disciples.
“Former Dao Patriarch?” Jiang Ming understood what was going on.
This was happening due to the fact that there was a Dao Patriarch who died. However, Jiang Ming was not interested in paying attention to these.
Tianyuan Realm was speeding through the Chaos. In fact, with Jiang Ming’s strength, he could’ve just teleported the entire Tianyuan Realm over in mere seconds. However, traveling through the Chaos was also quite a pleasure.
As time flowed, half a year passed by. They were already very close to the Chaos Primordial Land.
Looking into the distance, an immensely enormous land could be seen suspending in the Chaos. It looked just like an isolated island in the middle of the ocean, an immensely vast land.
Energy field surrounded the entire Chaos Primordial Land. Supreme Dao Fluctuations formed forbidden domains that dispersed the Chaos Qi, forming a 300 billion kilometers empty space.
At this very moment, Jiang Ming’s true self came out of seclusion. After integrating with his avatar, he knew what had happened but it didn’t cause that much of a ripple.
He lay on the rattan chair and let out a long sigh before snapping at junior sister moodily. “This time around, the session is too long. I’ve already grown numb.”
“It’s only three million years!” Linglong pouted and continued, “If you can’t, just say so.”
“I can’t then. Is that alright with you?” Jiang Ming had a resigned look on his face, “Don’t look for me from now on.”
“I’ll find others then.”
“You dare?”
“What’s there not to?”
“Hehe! Then try it!”
Jiang Ming sneered.
Linglong rolled her eyes and continued, “Senior brother, can’t we have children?”
“Children?” Jiang Ming was suddenly in high spirits. His pair of divine eyes peered through the void and saw the Chaos Primordial Land. His gaze penetrated further and saw the lands above the Sea of Chaos.
“It’s not time yet!” Jiang Ming said softly.
“Not time?” Linglong frowned. “I’m already a Lord Saint and you’re already a Dao Patriarch. We’re already standing at the top of the Sea of Chaos. We have an eternal lifespan with boundless techniques at our disposal. How is it still not time yet? Senior brother, what exactly are you worried about?”
“I’m worried about beyond the Sea of Chaos.”
“Beyond the Sea of Chaos? Does it really exist?”
“It does!”
“What does it matter to us if it exists or not? In the past when we were in the Infinite Realm Battlefield, and now we are heading towards the Chaos Primordial Land. Here, time no longer means anything. Ten thousand years, billions of years, trillions of years… Do we just keep waiting on? Or have you found something?”
“Don’t worry.” Jiang Ming pulled his junior sister over and placed his arms around her. “It’s just some premonition, that’s all. We’ll just wait and see. If nothing changes within ten thousand years, we’ll try and have a child.”
“Really?” Linglong was overjoyed.
“When have I ever lied to you?” Jiang Ming hugged her even tighter.
As his gaze turned over, Jiang Ming looked towards the heavenly ladder. In what seemed to be half a year, half a million years had passed by in the chiliocosms that he created.
Inside them were the countless great fortune of creation that he scattered around. For geniuses who were truly blessed with luck, this amount of time was enough for them to grow already.
In fact, there were another eight others who managed to ascend onto the peak of the heavenly ladder and were all taken in as disciples by Jiang Ming’s avatar.
At this point, he had a total of nine disciples, namely Fengyun Wuji, Dugu Potian, Shi Hao, Ye Fan, Qin Yu, Han Li, Zhang Yuanqing, Zhou Mingrui, Shu Yu.
“Still missing the last one. I wonder what the rewards would be.” Jiang Ming was looking forward to the rewards.
After all, the reward last time was heaven-defying already. Would the next reward surpass the Chaos? He had a hunch that there would be a big change on his next reward.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - The Dangers of the Sea of Chaos, the Ultimate Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: The Dangers of the Sea of Chaos, the Ultimate Destruction
Translator:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
As they penetrated through the barrier of the Primordial Land, Jiang Ming steered Tianyuan Realm into the Chaos Primordial Land.
Although this place was vast and boundless, all of the places of excellence had already been occupied by others. Other than a few barren places and some forbidden domains, there weren’t many places that Jiang Ming could set foot at.
However, Jiang Ming didn’t mind. It was because he already had two choices.
“Senior brother, where are we descending?” Linglong was curious as well.
“The land where the Dao Patriarch of Space once resided.” Jiang Ming gave his answer.
This was all his intention all along. With both the Dao Patriarch of Space and Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation killed by him, the Sacred Lands where they resided had become unowned.
As for their disciples still occupying the place? Jiang Ming would just blast them to death. After all, the path of cultivation was in short, a life and death struggle to compete and climb to the top.
“Why not the residence of the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation?”
“Because it’s closer to the Hong Clan.”
This was the reason behind Jiang Ming’s choice. Even if there might be any accidents in the future, Tianyuan Realm could still be protected by the Hong Clan for a short while. After all, Jiang Ming was a close friend to Hong Zhan.
Back when he killed the two Dao Patriarch, Jiang Ming had transmitted telepathically his intention to Hong Lei, the Dao Patriarch of Thunder so that Hong Lei would help him to handle the territory that belonged to the Dao Patriarch of Reincarnation.
Buzz… With a single leap, the Tianyuan Realm had sped through billions of light years, arriving at a 990,999,000 million feet high mountain peak.
It was the Sacred Sky Mountain, the Dao domain which used to be in the pssession of the Dao Patriarch of Space.
As soon as Tianyuan Realm descended, it sent out rays after rays of luminance, enveloping the entire Sacred Sky Mountain. The luminance imprisoned the space, stagnating the laws as it rapidly expanded outwards. The ray of light directly enveloped all parts of the domain that were under the late Dao Patriarch of Space’s possession.
This included 36 million mountain peaks. Among the experts living in these mountains, there were already 106 Lord Saint Experts and more than 36,000 King Saint Experts. In fact, they were experts who belonged to the Dao Patriarch of Space.
Jiang Ming naturally had no reason to let them go. He evoked his Soul Dao to enslave all these experts. Even a few of them who were at the peak stage of the Lord Saint Realm and possessed Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasures, did not escape their fate.
From that day onwards, they had all become the guardians of Tianyuan Realm.
Jiang Ming stood up and with one step, arrived outside of Tianyuan Realm. He stood at the peak of the Sacred Sky Mountain and his body began to grow taller.
In just a snap of a finger, he was already a light-year tall. His immortal aura and Great Dao-Suppressing power swept across the nine heavens and ten earth, radiating throughout the Chaos Primordial Land, announcing his arrival.
Jiang Ming also sent out rumbling Dao voices that resounded through all four directions.
“The Dao Patriarch of Space, who plotted against me, has been killed. Hence, I’ll take over the authority over the entire Sacred Sky Mountain as of today.”
“I’m the Dao Patriarch of Soul.”
“Sacred Sky Mountain is now renamed Tianyuan Mountain.”
“I’ve opened up the Tianyuan Dao Domain.”
It was an act of proclamation for his arrival and also to establish authority over the place.
“Congratulations to the Dao Patriarch of Soul on establishing your Domain.” The Dao Patriarch of Thunder conjured his avatar and appeared in the sky over the Hong Clan’s Domain. He clasped his hands and greeted Jiang Ming. “Fellow Daoist Jiang, with you around, we won’t have to be worried over our Primordial Land anymore.”
“Fellow Daoist Hong, let’s become even closer in the future!” Jiang Ming smiled and clasped his hands as well.
At the same time, he nodded in all directions as a greeting and retracted his avatar. It was enough of him to just reveal his identity to the public.
Right that moment however, a rainbow bridge appeared from the Hong Clan’s which spanned across the vast sky and descended over Jiang Ming’s domain.
Jiang Ming smiled as he ushered them all over. These were his friends from the former group. They were Hong Zhan, Hong Yi, Ao Jiu, Di Huo and the likes. There were also Ye Qingxian, Dongfang Chenxi and the likes, who had been received by Hong Zhan not long ago. However, Luo Heng, Huang Quan and even Tian Fozi were nowhere to be seen.
It was obvious that these group members were not in the same Sea of Chaos. It was clear as well that most of his group members were all within the same Sea of Chaos, which was quite amazing.
“Brother Jiang!” Dongfang Chenxi was the first to exclaim. Just as she was about to pounce over, she noticed Linglong who was standing beside Jiang Ming and quickly paused, somewhat at a loss for words.
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile as he ruffled through her hair. Dongfang Chenxi immediately revealed a sweet smile on her face.
“Brother Jiang!” Ye Qingxian clasped her hands. “I’ll be hanging around here from now on.”
“Brother Jiang! Haha! I’ve finally seen your Domain.” Hong Zhan laughed out loud. “From now on, this will be my second home.”
“Brother Jiang.” Hong Yi smiled as he clasped his hands. “I’ll be counting on you for your protection from now on.”
“This coattail is extraordinarily large to ride on indeed!” Ao Jiu remarked. “Haha! From now on, a dragon like me can wander across the billions of miles of earth over here with a carefree spirit.”
“This place is still the place that puts people at ease!” Feng Wu smiled as well. “It’s such an unfortunate thing that I no longer have the chance to.”
As the crowd went on one after another, Jiang Ming let out a smile on his face. Seeing these people, Jiang Ming had a feeling of comfort even though their cultivation base wasn’t high.
They knew each other’s background well and they need not worry about their identities or whatsoever.
“Guys, this is Zi Linglong, my junior Sister. We’ve grown up together since our childhood and she is now my Daoist partner.” Jiang Ming held onto his junior sister and introduced her to his friends. “Her cultivation isn’t weak. All three of her paths have already been cultivated to the Lord Saint Realm.”
“You’re awesome, sister.” Dongfang Chenxi was marvelous. “Brother Jiang is already a miracle to begin with. Little did we expect you to be just as powerful as well. To think that your soul, physique and cultivation realm have all advanced into the Lord Saint Realm, this is incredible!”
“If you want to, you can be this fast as well.” Linglong said smilingly and wrapped around Dongfang Chenxi’s arm. “Let us sisters be closer in the future!”
She then looked over at the other three ladies, namely Ye Qingxian, Feng Wu and Ming Fei. Her smile became even brighter as she said, “If you would like to, you can all swiftly advance into the Lord Saint Realm as well! After all, Senior Brother has the infinite power of Creation.”
“Haha….”Ao Jiu was baffled upon hearing so. When he came back to his senses, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud as he gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up. “Brother Jiang, you’ve my respect.”
“Indeed.” Di Huo laughed as well.
Even Hong Zhan understood what Linglong meant.
The faces of Ye Qingxian and the likes blushed even more. This was especially for Dongfang Chenxi. Her face blushed even redder but she couldn’t break free from Linglong’s embrace.
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. He knew that his junior sister was recruiting concubines for him.
“She’s already half a step into the Dao Patriarch level. Be careful or she’ll become annoyed and suppress all of you.” Jiang Ming laughed and continued, “It’s rare that we’re able to gather like this. Moreover, today is the day I open up my domain. Let’s all make it a joyous moment. I’ll be bringing out the many treasures of mine, so that you can all see what Chaos treasures are and what’s the most precious Supreme-leveled Spiritual fruits and wines.”
“The treasures from killing two top-notch Dao Patriarchs. I can’t help drooling already!” Hong Zhan was very excited. “But Brother Jiang, hope you don’t fill us until we burst!”
“Don’t worry! I dominate over anything and everything around here. Don’t you worry. Eat and drink with ease. When you’ve digested the food, it will at least raise your cultivation base by a single step!” With a wave of his hand, Jiang Ming set up an entire banquet for his guests.
All kinds of Spiritual treasures, countless exotic fruits, great wines that were unheard of and the likes were all brought out. Various divine luminance were released, interwoven with the boundless power of Law. The Dao fluctuations that were contained in each of them were beyond imagination.
Jiang Ming even picked up Luo Heng and Tian Fozi over. As for Huang Quan? There seemed to be a special situation over at his side and he temporarily did not bring him over. However, Jiang Ming sent over some treasures to him.
Linglong brought Xi Yao over as well. It was quite a headache for Jiang Ming but he no longer cared about it anymore.
After a full day of fervor, Hong Zhan and the likes could no longer hold in the powers anymore. Hence, Jiang Ming built a Sacred Land of Cultivation so that they would have a place to digest the boundless power of creation in their stomach.
During this period of time, he also made it so that Tianyuan Realm stayed afloat up on the sky of Tian Yuan Mountain, fixing it in place and wasn’t moving anytime soon.
The place became the highest place, the most sacred place and also the foundation towards his domain.
At the same time, paths were opened so that people within could descend into Tian Yuan Mountain to wander into different places.
Back on Chuyang Peak, Jiang Ming wrapped his arms around his junior sister and swayed leisurely on the rattan chair.
“Girl, are you becoming restless?”
“I knew I couldn’t hide it from you! Alas, the Chaos Primordial Land, the ideal direction towards cultivation. Now that we’re here, I naturally want to go out and have a good look around the place.”
“If that’s the case, just go on! With your current strength you can go anywhere around the heavens. By the way, you can also stop by at your master’s. Haha! When you get there and it turns out that your cultivation level is higher than your Great Heavenly Venerate, it would be very interesting then.”
“Hehe! Senior brother, I’m thinking the same thing as well. By the way, are you not accompanying me?”
“Alas, I’ve swept through the heavens with just a single thought. What should be seen I have already seen. It’s not interesting doing so already!”
“You’ve already seen what could be seen? How many immortal ladies have you seen?”
“Ahem… You girl! That mind of yours is too dirty. I am a Dao Patriarch, the supreme Dao Patriarch. How would I peep?”
“The others don’t know about you, but I know you very well. You’re a sultry scourge!”
“Looking for a spanking!”
Pat, pat, pat… Just as he was spanking her, a message was sent over from the Great Dao Group.
Jiang Ming’s subconscious dove into the group.
[Huang Quan: You are all free and unfettered, but on the contrary, there’s something big happening over here.]
[Huang Quan: Remember the time I was captured into the Sacred Land of the Chaos to pass the test? I am now under a Sacred Master. Just now, I heard the news that the Lord Saint has died in the battle.]
[Huang Quan: This isn’t a great war of the Sacred Lands of the Chaos, but an invasion onto our sea of Chaos.]
[Huang Quan: The news said that it was a group of terrifying demons that are billions of times more evil than us. Each of them are at the cultivation base of King Saint and above.]
[Huang Quan: Crap! There’s another news saying that a Dao Patriarch from our side has died on the battlefield.]
[Huang Quan: Crap! There’s an enormous hand above my head that spans through 300 million miles of radius. Its terrifying suppressive force suppressed me to the point that I couldn’t move.]
[Huang Jiang: Come quick, Brother Jiang. Or else I’m done for.]
As Jiang Ming read the messages from Huang Jiang, he frowned greatly.

chapters.title: Chapter 514
chapters.content:
?514 Primordial Demon Abyss, Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast
The death of a Dao Patriarch was no trivial matter. Generally speaking, it would be difficult to really kill a Dao Patriarch even if a Dao Patriarch was besieged by two to three other Dao Patriarchs.
Yet, Jiang Ming was able to kill two. This was because he was too special compared to others. He had numerous supreme treasures and to top it off, he could forcibly leave and descend as he pleased, leaving the two Dao Patriarchs nowhere to escape.
Yet, one such existence had died over at Huang Quan’s place.
Jiang Ming no longer pondered about it and instead, evoked the Human Path Record to descend over to Huang Quan’s chiliocosm.
It was another Sea of Chaos and a Primordial Land. However, this place was called the Chaos Sacred Land.
At that moment, Huang Quan raised his head, looking at the huge palm that was coming down on him. His eyes were filled with despair.
Being suppressed by supreme powers, he couldn’t even move a muscle. Even his thoughts were almost frozen in place. His physique also began to crumble, and blood could be seen trickling. It seemed that in the next millisecond time, he would be obliterated into oblivion, completely disappear from the heavens and earth.
However, it was at this moment, a human figure suddenly appeared beside him. The suppressive force that was pinning down Huang Quan abruptly disappeared.
After barely taking in a few breaths, he saw Jiang Ming beside him and revealed a look of relief from the desperation. He was so moved that he almost hugged onto Jiang Ming and bawled his eyes out.
He was in a really miserable state just now. Beyond desperate. Even though he had faced various life-threatening situations before, he didn’t feel as powerless and desperate as the moment just now.
“Brother Jiang, I thought I was really going to die!” Huang Quan’s eyes were red. “I’ve made up my mind. I’ll follow you from now on. Wherever you are, I’ll be there.”
“Haha!” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but burst into laughter. “Alright! Brother Huang Quan, you’re really afraid this time.”
“I’m not afraid, I’m in despair.” Huang Quan lifted his head and looked at the palm that covered the sky. It was so huge that there didn’t seem to be an edge to the palm. He said in a complicated manner, “Brother Jiang, is this the doing of a Dao Patriarch?”
“Yes!” Jiang Ming revealed a grave look on his face. “This is the beast’s claw. But because it’s too huge, and it’s condensed with supreme power, it’s becoming too difficult to be distinguished. The power contained within this beast’s claw is very odd. To think that it can actually restrain the power of laws. This is really strange.”
Jiang Ming had a vague feeling of uneasiness. As he raised his hand, he sent off a punch and shattered the beast’s claw that was coming down onto them.
He then turned his gaze over to the other size. It was as if at the end of heaven and earth, there was a behemoth standing in the chaos. Its pair of eyes were as huge as a whole chiliocosm, looking over at them with an atrocious demeanor.
Jiang Ming also saw the information about the beast. It was just that the information shocked him greatly.
This beast was named the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast. It was a race that was born from the boundless negative breath of life of the great Dao.
The great Dao gave life to all things and nurtured all spirits. This was the creation of life. After the birth of all spirits however, they would be dominated by the seven emotions and six desires, experience sorrow and happiness, life and death. This would inevitably produce a variety of negative energy such as grievance, fury, Yin, death, curses, heart demon and so on.
These energies could be purified through the cycles of heaven and earth. However, there was still a small portion of negative energies contained in the spirits themselves remained. Even going through the cycles of heaven and earth, these negative energies were difficult to be completely purified.
This was especially the case for the negative energies left by peerless experts.
These negative energies would then be brought through the cycle of the Dao and accumulated at a special place. Such was the exact opposite of the Dao Evolution of Life and was transformed into the Primordial Demon Abyss.
As the boundless negative energies converge over time, it gave birth to an extremely special creature which was the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast.
It possessed the ruthlessness of the demons, the ferocity of the beasts and also the destructive characteristics of the two. It was ruthless and heartless, destructive by nature.
Under the great Dao however, there were too many living beings that existed, thus producing an extremely powerful and terrifying life aura. This invisible and massless power penetrated through the long river of fate. It also formed a very strong suppression onto the Primordial Demon Abyss. It even slowly wore away the Abyss, allowing the order of the Dao to continue its cycle indefinitely.
However, the Great Dao was just and there would always be a silver lining.
The Primordial Demon Abyss finally gave birth to a great number of Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts. Since they possessed a different type of power from the Great Dao, they were extraordinarily frightening.
They were born with the innate power that restrains hundreds of millions of other living beings. They also possessed terrifying destructive power over the Laws that shelters billions of living beings. What was even more terrifying was that they could devour other living beings to grow themselves.
The most terrifying of all was that these Beasts which broke through the shackles and crawled their way out of the Demon Abyss would have a cultivation realm of at least King Saint Realm. By constantly devouring others, they grew rapidly as well.
The one that Jiang Ming was looking at was one of the beasts which had grown from the King Saint Realm into the Dao Patriarch Realm in just a thousand years’ time. It was simply unimaginable.
He also perceived another thing. In the deepest part of the Primordial Demon Abyss, there was an even more terrifying existence. Based on the ‘Status’ of this Heavenly Demonic Beast, it seemed that the Heavenly Demonic Beast in the depths of the Primordial Demon Abyss was an existence that surpassed even the Dao Patriarch Realm. Due to the confinement of the great Dao, it was difficult for it to force its way out into the world.
‘How can there be such an existence in the world?’ Even Jiang Ming found it hard to believe.
As for where the Primordial Demonic Abyss was located, even the Heavenly Demonic Beast itself wasn’t sure.
When these Heavenly Demonic Beasts crawled out of the Primordial Demonic Abyss, they would have an innate ability to sense the locations of the Sea of Chaos. They would then open void passages and descend into the Sea of Chaos, plundering the billions of living things until all life in the Sea of Chaos extinguished. Following that, they would destroy the entire Sea of Chaos to plunder the Heart of the Chaos.
“Brother Jiang, what’s wrong?” Huang Quan, who noticed that Jiang Ming was frowning, couldn’t help himself from worrying and asked, “Could it be that the intruder is of a really great background? However great it may be, they would probably be at the Dao Patriarch Realm only right? You are a person who beheaded two of such supreme beings before.”
“If it were to be Dao Patriarchs, then that’s that. I wouldn’t even be bothered even if I was to face a dozen of them. However, this one...” Jiang Ming shook his head and didn’t continue to delve deeper into the topic. Instead, he said, “Brother Huang Quan, do you have any relatives here? I’ll send you all over to my place all together.”
“No, I don’t!” Huang Quan smiled bitterly. “I’m a skeleton after all. How would I have any relatives? Just send me over there. I don’t want to be a burden to you here.”
Jiang Ming merely smiled and didn’t say anything more. He evoked the Human Path Record and sent Huang Quan over into the Tianyuan Realm.
With a flutter, Jiang Ming stepped into the Chaos amidst the gaze of many peerless experts of the Chaos Sacred Land.
His body was getting taller until the height of one light year before coming to a stop. In just a blink of an eye, he was already standing in front of the Heavenly Demonic Beast that he scouted earlier.
This beast had only one head, but there were nine spiral horns on the top of it. It had four arms and feathered wings behind its back. Its form wasn’t considered demonic anyway.
Also, all the Heavenly Demonic Beasts were different.
“Human, you smell countless times sweeter than the ten septillion humans I ate.” When this Heavenly Demonic Beast saw Jiang Ming, it cracked open its huge mouth. The beast actually had thirty-two rows of teeth and looked extremely peculiar.
“Eating you is definitely more valuable than me plundering all the living beings of the other Sea of Chaos. By the way, my name is Destroyer Nine.” The Heavenly Demonic Beast then continued, “Are you prepared to be eaten by me?”
“You beasts had already destroyed a Sea of Chaos?” Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank.
This was not stated in this beast’s ‘Status’.
“More than one. I’ve destroyed a whole nine of them! That’s why I’m called Destroyer Nine.” Destroyer Nine laughed as its face became even more hideous. “After destroying this Sea of Chaos, I’ll become Destroyer Ten then.”
Jiang Ming’s heart trembled.
How many living beings were there in a Sea of Chaos? It was uncountable! A single great chiliocosm would have myriads of middle chiliocosm, countless small chiliocosm and an almost infinite number of planar worlds. How many great chiliocosms were there in a Sea of Chaos? To think that these beasts had destroyed nine Sea of Chaos already. What heinous sin this was!
“We are merely one of the teams, that’s all.” Destroyer Nine laughed again.
It just loved to see others getting angry, shocked, and even more furious. This feeling was extremely wonderful to the beast.
“You all deserve to die!” Jiang Ming was enraged.
This was an unprecedented rage.
“Die!” The Dao Exterminating Lance appeared in Jiang Ming’s hand as he lunged forward to pierce through the beast without any hesitation.
Bang... Destroyer Nine merely raised one of its hands and blocked it off with its palm. At the center of its palm, only a tiny spot of blood appeared and the blood that trickled from it was black.
Its blackness was something that even the Chaos Laws found unbearable. The rules of Dao even started to become corrupted.
“This...” Jiang Ming’s pupils shrank.
A sudden thought ran through Jiang Ming’s mind. ‘Something’s off! Can the Human Path Record even detect information about the great Dao?

chapters.content:
515 Dao Annihilation, Invincible and Immortal
A sudden thought ran through Jiang Ming’s mind. ‘Something’s off! Can the Human Path Record even detect information about the great Dao?
Regardless of whether Destroyer Nine’s remarks were true or false, the Human Path Record had pointed out clearly that the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast was conceived of the power of the Great Dao. To think that this beast was an existence of such a high level and yet the Human Path Record was capable of probing into the origin of the beast.
Could the Human Path Record deduce even information regarding the great Dao? Even though Jiang Ming knew how extremely terrifying this Human Path Record was, the fact that it could reach such a level still caused Jiang Ming to feel like his legs were being pulled.
If that was the case, Jiang Ming wondered whether the Human Path Record was a Great Dao Weapon? What about the System then? The father of the Great Dao?
In just a snap of a finger, countless thoughts ran through Jiang Ming’s mind. Ultimately, he suppressed all of these thoughts.
With insufficient information, it was difficult for him to investigate deeper and could only leave this matter up for exploration in the future.
With just a thought, his mind had run ten trillion cycles pondering about it. Jiang Ming had to stop himself. If he was to continue pondering about it, he would have lost in thoughts.
Moreover, he was now facing a terrifying existence. Hence, he had to pose himself with high spirit.
The Chaos Defensive Garment emitted flashes of luminance, shielding him within. The Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda could be seen appearing on top of his head as well.
Jiang Ming put away the Dao Exterminating Lance and took out the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword instead. This Great weapon was far stronger than the Dao Exterminating Lance.
He was armed to the extreme in an instant.
At the same time, his gaze swept through the surroundings and saw that within the borderlands of the Sea of Chaos, there were earth-shattering battles taking place in various locations.
The aftershocks of the tremors even spread over to where he was. There were also malicious gazes that were casted over towards his direction.
Jiang Ming knew that the great battles were between the Dao Patriarch of the Chaos Sacred Land against the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
It was just that he was a little pessimistic about the outcome of the battles. This was because these Heavenly Demonic Beasts were all too damn strong. So strong that it didn’t make sense.
There were of course weaker ones among them, but were all at least above the King Saint Realm. Packed densely with their countless heads seen, they were being blocked off by the Lord Saints of the Chaos Sacred Realm, but it was an extremely difficult feat.
“Good gracious! These equipment of yours are amazing.” Destroyer Nine revealed a surprised look on his face before finally baring his teeth with that hideous and strange look of his. “For me and the others, this is rather an above-average snack. When I devour you, I might be able to even take a step further and advance into the next realm!”
“Thinking of devouring me? You’re still quite lacking!” Jiang Ming struck again.
As the Dao Slashing Sword slashed onwards, it comprised the spatial energy of the Chaos, allowing this slash attack to reach an extreme level. It manipulated space and slashed through the infinite Daos.
After Jiang Ming had killed the Dao Patriarch of Space and Reincarnation last time, he had been mingling with his junior sister for countless years.
As dashing as it seemed, Jiang Ming didn’t waste his time then. He split his subconsciousness into four portions. A part of it was to maintain his trillion of avatars proving the Yin Yang Great Dao with his junior sister; the second part was to comprehend the Chaos Rhythm and the Laws of Chaos; the third part was to sink into his inner world to promote the cycle of his inner world, strengthen its core and to stimulate the growth of the rules of the Chaos; the fourth portion was to deduce the Spatial Dao, Reincarnation Dao and the other special abilities.
He had some slight gains in a sense. As such, the moment he struck forth was with the extreme power of ultimate annihilation.
“This attack is not too bad.” With a shake of its body, Destroyer Nine’s immensely huge body that was comparable to a whole chiliocosm, invoked a limitless amount of supreme power.
“I have a fist that destroys the law!”
“I have a palm that destroys the body!”
“I have a finger that destroys the spirit!”
“I have a seal that destroys the Dao!”
Destroyer Nine had four arms and all four of them evoked different special abilities at the same time and at an extremely fast pace.
With a punch, the blade of the sword was blocked off, disintegrating the power of space.
The palm, finger and seal however, fell onto Jiang Ming one after another, causing the billion layers of divine luminance around his body to shatter, sending him flying 3,000 light-years away.
Jiang Ming who was sent flying back, crashed directly into a chiliocosm within the Chaos.
It was a really heaven and earth shattering scene, though Jiang Ming ended up looking quite wretched.
“Good slash!”
Upon seeing his fist splitting in two to the point that even his arm was almost separated from his body, Destroyer Nine couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
Jiang Ming who steadied himself from afar, couldn’t help but take in a breath of cold air when he saw his opponent’s condition.
‘It’s so troublesome and even a headache! Damn it! What kind of freak is this? How can its mere physique be this strong? What I just used was the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword!’
The usual techniques were useless and Jiang Ming was really astonished. From the exchange of blows just now, he was considered to be at the shorter end.
If it wasn’t because of the Chaos Defensive Garment that he was equipped in, his physique would’ve broken apart without a doubt.
“Come, Come! Let me enjoy this!” Destroyer Nine laughed out loud as he walked over towards Jiang Ming.
His strides were extremely huge. A single step was equivalent to several light years already.
“Alright! I’ll surely give you the pleasure of it.” With an explosive roar, Jiang Ming’s eye was of a merciless killing machine. A single slash of the sword in his hand filled the air with the Reincarnation Dao fluctuation. “Reincarnation of the Infinite Daos!”
Rumble! In an instant, the chaotic airflow in front of him went on a rampage. A whirling black hole was formed, devouring Destroyer Nine within.
“What can such feeble trickeries do to me?” Destroyer Nine was not bothered at all.
These beasts believed in the supremacy of power. To hell with the laws, reasons, Daos or special abilities. All of these wouldn’t even hold against a punch of ultimate power.
Boom... The punch that could destroy the infinite Daos, tore through the swirling black hole. Just as the beast thought that it managed to walk out of it, another vortex could be seen around itself.
“Quite interesting indeed. However, it ends here!” As Destroyer Nine grunted coldly, its aura soared rapidly, distorting the law itself as each of the vortex channels exploded.
However, this passage seemed as though it was a never-ending one. It was as though the whole Sea of Chaos had turned into a vortex of Reincarnation, making it difficult for the beast to break free.
“Fist of Explosion, tear them apart!” All four of its arms struck one after another, completely annihilating all of the Chaos Aura.
The attack really annihilated everything in its path. The vortexes were completely blown apart, dispersing into smokes.
However, it was at this moment that a pagoda abruptly appeared on top of the beast’s head, suppressing down onto him.
On top of the treasured pagoda, Jiang Ming’s Inner World Projection was added in, creating a power of suppression to the point of unprecedented extremes.
This caused Destroyer Nine to be stopped on his feet, as he struggled to escape from it.
“Soul Slash!”
As a flicker sparked between Jiang Ming’s brows, a soul attack was launched, directly penetrating the beast’s subconscious. This dazzled Destroyer Nine, as fresh blood spurt out of its orifices. However, it was apparent that the attack merely had the beast injured.
This wasn’t Jiang Ming’s strongest technique as of yet.
“Chaos Dao Slashing Sword, merge into my fingers!”
“Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique!”
“Annihilate!”
Jiang Ming evoked his strongest technique of all.
As the index finger on his right hand was raised, layers of sword silhouettes could be seen. These shadows were incorporated with the Laws of Spatial Chaos, Reincarnation and Soul.
Although there were only three types of Laws, the attack was still extremely powerful.
Poof... The finger landed between the brows of Destroyer Nine, directly piercing through its skull, strangling its soul.
Looking through the Infinite Realms and even the boundless Sea of Chaos, Jiang Ming was confident that no Dao Patriarch would be able to withstand this attack of his. Even a peak stage Dao Patriarch wouldn’t be able to do so.
If the attack hits the target full on out, death would’ve been imminent. However, Destroyer Nine was still struggling on with a silver of health even though its aura had declined drastically.
Its life force was way too terrifying. The miserable shriek of the beast echoed throughout, causing the vast Sea of Chaos to even tremble.
“You’re still not dead?”
Jiang Ming hardened his heart and slashed down onto Destroyer Nine’s head with the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda.
It was also at this very second, waves and waves of terrifying calls made its way over to their location.
“Puny human! How dare you hurt my fellow clansmen!”
“You’re courting death!”
“Destroyer Nine! Hang in there! We are coming over to tear this human apart!”
“Who wouldn’t think that there would be such a strong existence appearing among the Humans. Haha! He’ll surely be a tasty one to bite on!”
“Alas, Destroyer Nine. Since you are unable to kill him off, it’s our turn to enjoy ourselves then.”
“We are all immortal and invincible! At least gnaw hard on him, Destroyer Nine!”
Along with the waves of bellowing dispersing over his direction, there were also terrifying killer intent that was peering over and powers that could even puncture through the Chaos.
A cold chill ran down Jiang Ming’s spine. Even so, he rapidly evoked the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda to completely shackle up Destroyer Nine and transfer it over into his inner world.
Within the inner world, Jiang Ming’s power could be at least a thousand times more powerful than before. It was in the inner world that Jiang Ming was the true master of everything.
At the same time, he rapidly flew off to retreat and dodge from waves after waves of incomparably terrifying attacks coming at him.
