chapters.title: Chapter 516
chapters.content:
516 Devouring Great Dao
Suppressing just one Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast was extremely difficult. Hence, Jiang Ming could only retreat when facing an attack from a few of the beasts.
Jiang Ming communicated with the Supreme Order to get into the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda. It was a place where a snap of the finger was akin to eternal, hence Jiang Ming was not worried of wasting time.
Jiang Ming sat cross-legged in the space and when he began to think, there were trillions of thoughts running through his mind.
Were the Heavenly Demonic Beasts born from the negative energies the great Dao collected from all beings? Why would they be so strong? Some were even beyond the Dao Patriarch Realm. However, the Sea of Chaos could only carry the power of the Dao Patriarch Realm at most.
Jiang Ming shook his head. He had so much confusion that he had to give up looking for an answer. Hence, he decided to take a step at a time instead. If he couldn’t take it, he could stay back in the exclusive space till he managed to deduce the great Dao.
Following that, he shifted his focus to his inner world. At this moment, Destroyer Nine had been suppressed thoroughly.
The inner world was akin to a small-scaled Sea of Chaos. Jiang Ming was capable of manipulating all its power. Hence, the power Jiang Ming could evoke was naturally terrifying beyond imagination.
Jiang Ming didn’t interrogate nor torture Destroyer Nine because these acts were meaningless. Instead, Jiang Ming evoked the origin of the Chaos inner world to refine Destroyer Nine.
“Are you trying to refine me? It’d be a vain attempt!”
“I’m nurtured by the great Dao. Hence, I’m invincible and immortal. How can you, as a despicable life, shake my essence.”
“Just wait till my brothers get here, we’ll definitely separate you into pieces!”
Destroyer Nine had been intensely struggling, but to no avail. It could do nothing else but be incompetently furious and roared in a shocking manner.
Nevertheless, under the terrific grinding power, Destroyer Nine slowly melted away. Its constitution was indeed higher than the norm, hence making it more difficult for Jiang Ming to refine it.
‘This...’ As the beast was being refined, Jiang Ming had shock across his face. The power of Destroyer Nine seemed like a super tonic. A little of it was akin to a relatively great improvement for Jiang Ming’s inner world. Even the seeds of Chaos Laws seemed to be eager to break their seed coats and be conceived. Once the laws were conceived, even just one of them, would make Jiang Ming a lot stronger.
‘There’s such a benefit?’ Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up. He began to indulge in his inner world and rapidly refined Destroyer Nine.
Even though refining Destroyer Nine was much harder than refining a Chaos Supreme Treasure, there was progress even if it was slow.
Time had flown without Jiang Ming realizing it. In just a snap of the finger, a billion years had passed.
Jiang Ming suddenly opened his eyes and guffawed. “I’ve achieved my Dao, I’ve achieved it indeed!”
Jiang Ming was ecstatic. He was unprecedentedly joyful, even more joyful than obtaining 10 Chaos Supreme Treasures.
‘Just a Destroyer Nine has allowed my inner world to conceive five Chaos Laws! It’s a whole five Chaos Laws. This is akin to me devouring five Dao Patriarchs. If I were to cultivate and conceive them on my own, I’d need at least trillions of years. Such an improvement has also expanded my inner world by 50% and increased my origin exponentially. The return of my power has made my soul directly advance into the peak stage of the Dao Patriarch Realm and my physique into the middle stage of Chaos Realm. As a whole, the combat power I can burst forth has increased by at least ten-folds.’
These were the reasons why Jiang Ming was ecstatic. It was rather incredible. The Heavenly Demonic Beast was not only a super tonic, but a super great fortune.
‘The Great Dao Prime Heavenly Demonic Beast, haha, it’s not a catastrophe but great fortune.’ Jiang Ming’s eyes had brightened up a lot, and he even revealed hints of greed.
Jiang Ming didn’t go out of his seclusion, but he went on with his cultivation. This time he was to settle and adapt to the surge in his energy. At the same time, he also deduced the techniques to confront his enemies.
...
In the Sea of Chaos where the Chaos Sacred Land was located.
The next moment after Jiang Ming had disappeared, he reappeared. As soon as he reappeared, there were five Heavenly Demonic Beasts lunging at him. Each was a light year tall and enormously huge. Their intimidating aura overwhelmed the Sea of Chaos.
The aura of the one in front of all five was even more horrifying than that of Destroyer Nine. It had a strange head because it had no mouth and nose but a total of 48,000 eyes. One would get goosebumps by just taking a glance at it.
“You disappeared just now. Even though you didn’t cause any waves in the Chaos, you disappeared without a trace and beyond my senses. Now that you abruptly reappear without any sign. What technique is this? Can it be that you go beyond the Sea of Chaos in an instant?” This Heavenly Demonic Beast stared at Jiang Ming while releasing its invisible power to confine space and time. “And where’s Destroyer Nine? Can you utterly suppress him? No, it’s impossible!”
“There are many things that are impossible.” Jiang Ming was emanating a rather icy-cold aura. “Where is your king?”
“King?” The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast was slightly startled before its eyes shot out rays of destructive luminance. “You seem to know something about us. Are you in despair now?”
“I’ve realized one thing.” Hints of strangeness flashed across Jiang Ming’s face as he said, “All of you are long-winded. Destroyer Nine is one and so do you.”
Rumble... It was at this moment that an explosion was heard from a distance. A blood color spread out, covering a large area of the Sea of Chaos. At the same time, a Chaos Law tremble and sadness had sent out to the heart of all beings, including Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming’s heart sank because there was another Dao Patriarch who was killed.
“It’s not long-winded but confident.” The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast snorted coldly. Although it didn’t have a mouth, its voice resounded.
“When we got here, the fate of this Sea of Chaos had been decided. Hence, why shall we be in a hurry? It’s more interesting to spend some time looking at you all, to struggle, to see false hope, to be desperate, to whoop, to cry and to curse the great Dao.” The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast said, “Alas, unending killing and devouring are too boring. Even though the lives of you beings are inferior and are just our food, you beings can communicate with us. Hence, this is something that we can enjoy.”
Jiang Ming felt sad and angry in his heart. He felt like he was being treated as feeble ants by these Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
“Even if I’ve suppressed Destroyer Nine.” Jiang Ming’s expression remained unchanged, nor his voice.
“Whatever. He won’t die anyway.” The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast said, “We’re invincible and immortal. We enjoy a long-lasting life and stay together with the great Dao. No, the great Dao would eventually be our food anyway.”
“Are you sure that you are invincible and immortal?” Jiang Ming smiled coldly. “If that’s the case, why did you devour the other members of your species to grow?”
“You actually know this as well!” The Infinite Eyes Demonic Beast’s tone suddenly turned grave and his aura had become unprecedentedly frantic. “As a result of you peeking into my clan’s secret, I’ll wipe you out completely from the great Dao and there won’t be any traces about you in the past, present and future.”
“You have been too arrogant.” Jiang Ming suddenly laughed. “Can you still sense the aura of Destroyer Nine?”
“I can’t feel it since just now. Don’t tell me you have any means to kill him? I don’t believe it, we don’t believe it!” The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast had gone berserk. “Feeble human, you must have used certain techniques to conceal his aura of life.”
The other four Heavenly Demonic Beasts, which had remained quiet all these while, were emanating their incomparably frantic aura.
In an instant, a world had opened up in a range of hundreds of billions of light years, where all the elements, earth, fire, wind and water oozed out. The sky even became clear while the earth was turbid, and innate beings began to evolve quickly, but then they were destroyed by boundless forces.
As the world was opened up, it was annihilated in a blink of an eye. In a snap of the finger following that, the world had been reincarnated.
Rumble! It was at this moment that Jiang Ming had taken his move.
“Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda, squelch on!”
“World Projection, pin him down!”
The power of suppression this time was at least ten times stronger than when Jiang Ming was facing Destroyer Nine. It had frozen the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast and the other four in place.
“All of you, die!” Jiang Ming pointed at their forehead one after another. It was the Return of Infinite Law Finger, which had merged with the power of the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword and eight Chaos Laws. Hence, the might of this finger had become even more horrifying, and the lethality had gone to the extreme. It was possible that the finger alone could penetrate the entire Sea of Chaos.
“How is it possible that we aren’t vigilant when you have suppressed Destroyer Nine!”
“Merged into the body of the great Dao!”
The power within the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast vibrated and broke through Jiang Ming’s power of repression, allowing its voice to be sent out.
The Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast seemed to have sensed the horror of the finger, but it didn’t elude, nor did it resist the power of the finger. The beast merely evoked the innate special ability of theirs.
It was also at this moment that the other four Heavenly Demonic Beasts were abruptly infusing their power into the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast, allowing the power of the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast to increase exponentially. The power was so strong that it swept through the entire Sea of Chaos, intimidating all sentient beings.
All the luminance emanated from its 48,000 eyes were fused into one destructive divine light and blocked off the finger of Jiang Ming.
Bang... The clash of two forces set off an explosion that annihilated all things.
“You actually blocked it off. To think that you can fuse all of your power into one, it’s cheating, isn’t it?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but grumble.

chapters.title: Chapter 517
chapters.content:
517 Strength Soaring, The World Tree Descends
The Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts were inherently powerful to begin with. They were so powerful that even Dao Patriarchs would find themselves in despair. Who would’ve thought that they would even be able to draw on each other’s power and to even fuse into one.
This rendered Jiang Ming’s almost sure-kill strike useless.
“When you dealt with Destroyer Nine, to think that you actually hid your true strength. If it weren’t for the five of us together, we would’ve surely been killed by now.” Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast’s voice was extremely cold. “With five of us united as one, we are simply an invincible existence across this Sea of Chaos of yours.”
“Your fate has been sealed, little bastard! The end of this Sea of Chaos is also predestined now! Die!”
As its fist went forth, tens of thousands of powers of laws exploded in an instant, sending over the most powerful energy that could wipe out anything and everything. Even the Sea of Chaos was trembling violently from the attack, as though it could no longer bear such damages.
This wasn’t just a single punch from the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast, but the fusion of power from the other four existence as well.
“It’s still not certain who will be the one dying!” Jiang Ming wrinkled his eyebrows. A sense of hostility from him soared and he sent off another attack with his finger without any hesitation, forcibly blocking off the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast’s attack.
“I’m just a single person but equivalent to the five of you. What are you even proud of? Puny Beast!” Jiang Ming smirked coldly as he reached out and turned his palm over. The Dao Exterminating Lance was directly projected at the beasts.
This was a Supreme Treasure of Chaos, a spoil of war from back then.
“The Beasts is the most noble bloodline of all, the strongest form of life there is and the one that contains the ultimate potential of transcending the great Dao! As for you humans, you are nothing but mere reptiles in our eyes.” As Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast clenched its fists, it blossomed into a divine luminance that shone through three trillion light years away. Under the brilliance of this luminance, even the Chaos Laws were suppressed by such power. “To think that you are using such a weapon against me. You’re really a humiliation to me, reptile! Now decimate!”
“Detonate!” Jiang Ming’s voice shot off at the same time.
Rumbles! The moment the Dao Exterminating Lance collided with the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast, the lance suddenly exploded, causing the vast power contained within the lance to all explode in an instant.
Such power was equivalent to the power of a Dao Patriarch self-destructing. All power within the lance exploded. The raging torrents that were set off were beyond the limits of imagination. Even the whole Sea of Chaos trembled.
Amidst the explosive sounds, the power of the five of them concentrated in the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast was blown off, sending them flying a hundred billion light years away.
“It worked!” Jiang Ming let out a sigh of relief.
If even such a technique could not break their fusion, Jiang Ming would’ve had to retreat for the time being. Fortunately, he succeeded.
This was the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique that Jiang Ming had managed to comprehend. This technique could already induce the explosion of a Chaos Supreme Treasure already. It was the main direction of comprehension after he refined Destroyer Nine.
It was a good thing that his efforts weren’t in vain.
“Infinite Reincarnation, Void Segmentation!”
“Chaos Dao Suppression Pagoda, squelch on!
“World Projection, pin him down!”
Jiang Ming also exploded into a frenzy.
With each step of his illuminating with the Mystic Lights of Chaos, he chased after the beasts in an instant, evoking the fusion of special ability of the Reincarnation and Spatial techniques. It split apart all five of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts’ bodies, eliminating the possibility of them fusing into one again.
At the same time, he evoked Dao Vessels once again and cooperated with his World Projection to suppress the five beasts.
“Die!”
Jiang Ming pointed another finger towards the beast. The same Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique caused the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast’s heart and soul to pound frantically. Life-threatening danger was gripping onto its heart. Due to the severe injury from the attack previously, the beast hurriedly evoked supreme special abilities with that cracked up body of his.
“The Immortal Devil’s Body burning with the flame of the Eternals. Supreme Fist of the Great Demon, shatter!”
As the body of the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast swayed, the cracks on its body were healed in an instant. Its body was burning with a blazing holy flame, causing its aura to surge rapidly. The beast concentrated all of its power, condensed them all into a single punch and set off the punch directly at the incoming finger.
Poof... This time however, the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast didn’t manage to block off the attack.
Under the finger technique of Jiang Ming, the beast’s fist shattered and even its entire arm was blown apart, followed by his entire shoulder.
The brilliance from the Chaos Dao Slashing Sword coupled with the power of the Chaos Laws directly drilled into the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast’s body, frantically cutting it from within. Even the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast could not hold itself back but let out a growl.
“Suppress!”
As the Chaos Suppressing Pagoda fell, the World Projection shrank. This time, Jiang Ming was targeting only the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast, allowing the binding force of this weapon to reach an unprecedented degree. The attack directly caused the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast to totally lose mobility.
“The finishing blow! Primal Spirit Slash!”
As a flicker of light shot through Jiang Ming’s brow, an attack that transcended space and time severely damaged the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast yet again.
Rumble! Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda fell downwards, trapping the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast inside. Jiang Ming instantly transported the beast over into his inner world.
At this moment, the other four managed to force their way out of Jiang Ming’s Reincarnation Spatial Technique.
In comparison, the four of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts were all inferior to the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast, and even inferior to Destroyer Nine. The gap of their inferiority was quite huge but they were still very powerful, nonetheless.
As Jiang Ming frowned, he directly disappeared from the scene and returned to the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda. Rather than barely able to fight off the enemy, he felt that it was better for him to improve himself more.
With the experience of refining Destroyer Nine from before, Jiang Ming was much faster this time when dealing with the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast. This even allowed him to conceive a total of six Chaos Laws.
At this point, Jiang Ming had already mastered 14 Chaos Laws in total. His strength increased yet again. After digesting the increased strength, Jiang Ming returned to the scene.
Using the same method, the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda and World Projection were evoked together yet again. This time, the suppressive force was even stronger, causing the four Heavenly Demonic Beasts to be immobile for a brief moment.
“Infinite Spatial Reincarnation!”
Jiang Ming divided the four of them once again.
“Long River of Destiny!”
As a stream of light flowed beneath Jiang Ming’s feet, an illusory long river manifested itself.
Standing on top of the long river, three figures were condensed. They were the Past Body, Present Body and the Future Body. This was conjured from the long river of history.
The avatars were more powerful and enigmatic than before, almost equivalent to the real clone.
Each of them directly burned through their mana and evoked the ultimate strike of the Return of Infinite Law Finger Technique. Each of their attacks pierced through the respective brow of the Heavenly Demonic Beast’s which were divided and suppressed.
With a single finger directly piercing through their foreheads, all of them were injured gravely.
“Chaos Engulfment!”
Jiang Ming evoked the power of his inner world to form a void passage that enveloped all three of the heavily wounded Heavenly Demonic Beasts, pulling them within.
The suction force of the Void Passage wasn’t too strong but unfortunately these three beasts had already suffered heavy injuries and were unable to pull themselves out of it.
“What did you do to them?”
The last Heavenly Demonic Beast managed to struggle its way out of the restraint and looked at Jiang Ming with a startled look on his face.
First it was Destroyer Nine and later the Infinite Eyes Heavenly Demonic Beast. Another three of his companions followed suit right after. Now, it was the only one left.
How could this human be so strong? Jiang Ming was so incredibly strong, beyond its expectation and imagination.
“They’re killed of course!” Jiang Ming grinned.
With only one of them remaining, Jiang Ming no longer cared much.
“It’s your turn now!” Striking with all his might, Jiang Ming suppressed the last beasts in a moment’s time.
Just as he was about to leave the place, Jiang Ming’s gaze swept through the surrounding, piercing through the void and looking through the Sea of Chaos. He discovered that there were still seven Heavenly Demonic Beasts which were in a great battle with seven Dao Patriarchs.
The seven Dao Patriarchs were barely keeping up with the beasts. Each of them possessed Chaos Supreme Treasures and the support of a great formation. Even so, they were still in danger.
It was just that those Heavenly Demonic Beasts had discovered about the situation over at Jiang Ming’s. When they saw him annihilating Destroyer Nine and the likes, it was clear that they were very shaken up and were taking on the battle while retreating into the edge of Chaos.
They were obviously afraid.
‘They’re thinking of leaving? Should I let them leave?’ Jiang Ming frowned greatly.
‘After all, I’m still rather weak as of now. In the case that all of them managed to escape and spread the news around, summoning an even more terrifying existence beyond the Chaos Realm, it’ll be all over. If that’s the case, all of them shall stay behind then!’
With a slight thought in Jiang Ming’s mind, he directly communicated with his World Tree and transferred the tree over into the outside world through the Human Path Record.
When the World Tree first descended, it was only one light-year high in height. However, as it felt the rhythm over at the Sea of Chaos here, it integrated itself into the Sea of Chaos immediately and began to expand itself.
In just a blink of an eye, the World Tree had soared to a height of three trillion light years already. It had even surpassed the boundaries of the Chaos Sacred Land. Its immeasurable might also radiated throughout the entire Sea of Chaos.
However, such power was still ultimately smaller in comparison to the place.
‘If that’s the case, then we shall fuse!’
With a flutter, Jiang Ming directly merged himself into the World Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 518
chapters.content:
518 The World Tree Devouring the Sea of Chaos
Jiang Ming’s World’s Tree had already reached the extreme state of the Chaos Realm.
Its power was so formidable to the point that even Jiang Ming was shocked at heart. When he integrated himself into the World Tree, it instantly raised his power level to an unimaginable height.
It felt as if the entire Sea of Chaos couldn’t even contain Jiang Ming’s mind. With just a sweep of his mind, Jiang Ming was able to traverse the entire Sea of Chaos already.
The Sea of Chaos was extremely enormous. It was big beyond one could even imagine.
Even a Dao Patriarch would’ve taken quite some time coming over from the Chaos Sacred Land. Moreover, the Chaos Laws of Time and Space near the borderlands were intertwined, coupled with the Chaos Law of Reincarnation permeating throughout. With billions of power of rules intertwined, it might look seemingly the same as any ordinary chaotic air current. However, once you got inside, you would experience a dislocation of time and space. Under the distortion of the Chaos Laws, you would directly be sent to other places, making it simply impossible for the person to really reach the true borders.
Nevertheless, there were also very few Chaos Passages extremely hidden which connected to inexplicable places.
Right that moment, Jiang Ming was confident that he could tear through the Chaos Void Barrier. Furthermore, it was as though he could already see the realm above the Chaos already. It was as if he could’ve just leapt into another higher realm with just a slight thought of doing so. This kind of sensation was wondrous.
Even Jiang Ming was tempted by it, he hurriedly suppressed his mind from such thoughts. To try peeping into the realm beyond without the necessary strength to do so would result in severe backlash.
‘World’s Confinement!’
Just a slight turn of thought brought upon a hundred thousands of tribulations.
As Jiang Ming’s mind returned to its collected state, he evoked the World Tree’s innate special ability, the World Chaos Solidification Law. The technique directly suppressed the orders of Chaos, forming a forbidden domain around the area. As if it wasn’t enough, Jiang Ming also incorporated his own World Projection into the technique. With the chemical reaction between the two techniques, it caused the confinement technique’s prowess to skyrocket.
Jiang Ming didn’t stop there. He even evoked the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda, calling forth supreme suppressive prowess.
Buzz... Without the slightest sound, a huge half of the Sea of Chaos was imprisoned within, encompassing the remaining seven Heavenly Demonic Beasts within as well.
“Transformation between illusory and reality, projection of passage through the World Projection. Come in, all of you!”
Jiang Ming pushed the power of the World Tree and his own power to the extreme. By using the World Projection as a medium, a passage was formed above the heads of all seven Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
In an instant, all of them were caught within the passage.
“Feeble ants trying to suppress us! You’re just delusional!”
“This is the so-called power of the World. Let’s tear it apart!”
“How dare you plot against us! How dare you! Kill him!”
Between the power shifts, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts continued to snarl but it was already too late for them.
The moment they were enveloped within the World’s Passage, Jiang Ming had completely transferred them over to his inner world, separated them from each other and suppressed them individually.
Upon reaching the inner world, Jiang Ming was the true domineering master of all. With just a single thought, the boundless Chaos Origin formed seven humongous mountains, suppressing all seven of them completely.
In addition to that, there were already another four other Heavenly Demonic Beasts suppressed here to begin with.
The World Tree converged itself, turning into a small sapling before landing on top of Jiang Ming’s head. The sapling was slightly flaunting while sending over signals of intention to Jiang Ming so that Jiang Ming would send it back to the previous Sea of Chaos.
“You want to devour the entire Sea of Chaos to prompt the sublimation of your own life essence?” Sensing the information from the World Tree, Jiang Ming was taken aback.
Could it work? It almost might.
“When you really come to that stage, wait for me! Also, there’s a universe there as well. Don’t devour that!”
After Jiang Ming explained to the sapling, he sent it off through the Human Path Record.
Devouring a whole Sea of Chaos? Jiang Ming still had some trouble wrapping his head around such an act.
However, when Jiang Ming thought of the nature of the World Tree, it seemed as though it was really suitable for the World Tree to devour a Sea of Chaos.
Jiang Ming began thinking whether he should try devouring a Chaos Sea himself. After all, he had already refined a Heart of Chaos before this.
Once such a thought came to mind, he couldn’t hold himself back any more.
However, he shook his head in the end.
How many living beings would there be within a single Sea of Chaos? Even though he was used to bloodshed and had already taken a lighter thought on life, he still couldn’t hold himself to do so.
‘Forget it! I’ll just do as I go.’ Jiang Ming did not rush to leave the place. Instead, he lifted his head and looked upwards.
However, there wasn’t anything that popped up, which Jiang Ming thought it shouldn’t be.
‘I’ve killed the Heavenly Demonic Beasts which were the enemy of the living beings and the destroyer of the Great Dao’s order. Shouldn’t I be given the merit of rewards and virtue by the Great Dao?’ Jiang Ming smiled to himself.
When looked over at the many Dao Patriarchs who were rushing over to him, Jiang Ming had no intention of meeting up with them. With just a single thought, he returned to his exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda.
Jiang Ming was planning to cultivate properly this time. After all, there were even Heavenly Demonic Beasts which were still currently suppressed within his Inner World.
Seclusion knew no time. With just a snap of a finger, trillions of years went by.
When Jiang Ming opened his eyes once again, he couldn’t help the smile on his face.
The harvest from this session of cultivation retreat was so great that it had far exceeded his imagination.
Through the refinement of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, it allowed his inner world to expand non-stop and allowed the evolution of laws to speed up by a great surge. With the increase in numbers of the Chaos Laws, this also triggered a chain reaction which in turn promoted the metamorphosis of the other Seeds of Law.
The benefits that Jiang Ming had reap from this cultivation seclusion was astonishingly impressive. His Soul had directly advanced into the ultimate limit of the Chaos Realm. His physique had advanced into the later stage of Chaos. As for his cultivation realm? The power of Chaos Origin that he could now mobilize was even more terrifying.
Jiang Ming estimated that his current self was more than thousands times stronger than the time when he had just descended into the Sea of Chaos where Huang Quan was, hunting down the Heavenly Demonic Beasts. He was absolutely sure that the improvement was above a thousand folds, and might even reach ten thousands as well.
What magnitude of terrifying breakthrough was this?
‘This is what true power feels like!’
Jiang Ming stood up and clenched his fist, being uplifted to the extreme. He had also finally understood the terrifying nature of the World’s Dao. It was really terrifying indeed.
Once his inner world had completed its evolution into the utmost limit, with all 3,000 Chaos Laws reaching the matured stage, how high would he reach then? There would be a fully grasped Sea of Chaos within his body! What kind of terrifying power would that be?
Jiang Ming couldn’t even imagine it himself.
‘The World’s Dao is the true and genuine path of the great Dao!’ Jiang Ming was thoroughly convinced.
With just a slight thought, he returned to Chuyang Peak. His eyes wandered throughout, witnessing the billions of scenery of the Chaos Primordial Land.
When he looked downwards, there were quite a number of people from Tianyuan Realm who had gone to the Tianyuan Mountain below.
The Sect Leader and the others were discussing management issues. They were now living in the Chaos Primordial Land where numerous peerless experts were born. However, the members of the Jiuyang Sect’s cultivation realm were far too poor. Without possessing the capability of standing in the limelight, how could they help manage the property of Dao Patriarch Jiang?
Alas! The Sect Leader and the others had a sense of powerlessness and helplessness! Since that was the case, they chose to just stay and enjoy themselves in Tianyuan Realm instead, going down the mountains to stroll once in a while. And this was life!
When Jiang Ming’s gaze swept through the place, he understood the thoughts of the Sect Leader and the likes. He merely smiled as he thought it was better for them, wasn’t it?
“Senior Brother, your aura has changed!” As Linglong walked over to him, she directly wrapped herself around his arms. “Don’t tell me you’ve improved again.”
“I did and it was an extremely great improvement also.” Jiang Ming nodded and smiled. “I’ve also attained the possibility of improving your cultivation realm to the Dao Patriarch Realm as well.”
“Is that so?”
“Yes!”
“Long live senior brother!”
“Why don’t you give me a kiss then?”
“A kiss would be too simple! Why don’t we each conjure three thousand trillion avatars? Let’s have a really extreme cultivation session!”
Puff... Jiang Ming almost choked himself
‘Three thousand trillion? Isn’t this asking for the moon? Can my hips even stand this? Maybe it’ll be fine... However... It’s just that...I’ll be tired of it! It’ll be numbing! He’ll become thinner...’
“Senior Brother, are you tired of me?” Linglong’s little face turned gloomy. As she wrinkled her nose and hummed. “Do you want to have a fresh taste? How about I make all of my avatars different?”
Slap... Jiang Ming gave her a slap and said helplessly, “What’s even running through your mind every day?”
“Well, I’m doing it for cultivation!” Linglong replied, “Don’t you see? Everytime we enjoy ourselves, I’ll make huge progress in my cultivation!”
Jiang Ming was rendered speechless. Her remarks were true anyway.
“Now that we’ve reached the Chaos Primordial Land, I feel so sorry to not go around and enjoy the scenery with our naked eyes. Let’s go, girl! I’ll bring you on a spontaneous trip!”
“Really? That’s great, senior brother!”
“It seems that I’ve never taken you around before!”
“Hmph! Luckily you still know about this!”
“Let’s go then!”
Jiang Ming wrapped his arms around her, took a step forward and left Tianyuan Realm.
On the other side, a Dao Patriarch was looking over the direction of Tianyuan Mountain. He whispered to himself, “He should be here soon!”

chapters.title: Chapter 519
chapters.content:
519 Jiang Ming Was Taken Aback
Within the Chaos Primordial Land, rivers of spiritual liquid were formed and there were even wisps of innate spiritual essence as well. The goodness and beauty of the environment here was far beyond imagination.
Jiang Ming held his junior sister in his arms as he paced through the skies and walk through sea of flowers, leaving their unique aura wherever they went pass; that or they’d stay around lakes with myriad luminance brimming, frolicking within and leaving traces of their essence and so on.
It didn’t matter if it was mountains or rivers, forbidden lands or dangerous territories, nothing could stop their strides.
On this day, they arrived at the Heavenly Venerate Dao Square.
The owner of the Heavenly Venerate Dao Square was an ancient being, who had existed since a very long time ago. He was a Quasi-Dao Patriarch Expert. Other than the Dao Patriarch, there were very few who could compare to him. Hence, he had an extraordinary status.
Within the Dao Square, there were naturally numerous experts within.
“This is your master’s sect.” Jiang Ming pointed ahead and smiled as he said so.
“My master’s sect!” Linglong felt a little complicated.
When she first obtained the Heavenly Order, she obtained a lot of inheritance from it, which was somewhat helpful towards her cultivation.
By now, she had long understood the truth. The Heavenly Order was an object of channeling. Once a person passes the trial, the expert would be considered to have passed the test and would be guided over, allowing him or her to descend into a simulated Dao Square to conduct their cultivation.
The Dao which this Quasi-Dao Patriarch had comprehended was the True Illusion Dao. Although he wasn’t comparable to a real Dao Patriarch, he was able to achieve some unimaginable means through the Heavenly Order.
“Dao Patriarch of Soul!” Heavenly Venerated paced over in the air, clasped his hands and gave Jiang Ming a bow. This was a sign of respect for Dao Patriarchs.
He sensed Jiang Ming’s arrival and naturally had to come out to meet him.
“Heavenly Venerate!” Jiang Ming clasped his hands as well. “We are kind of destined by fate.”
“Heavenly Venerate!” Linglong took out the Heavenly Order.
“Never would I have thought that we had such fate to meet each other.” The Heavenly Venerate was quite surprised. When he looked at Linglong, he felt his scalp tingling. “It seems that Fellow Daoist’s cultivation realm is actually no longer weaker than mine. No, you’re already stronger than me. This is unbelievable! Truly unbelievable!”
“It’s all because of Senior Brother’s help.” Linglong revealed a smile on her face.
“This is even more unbelievable!” Heavenly Venerate exclaimed.
Jiang Ming nodded his head.
To have nurtured an existence up to the pinnacle stage of the Lord Saint in such a short time was more than unbelievable. It was simply beyond common sense.
The two of them did not stay much longer. After chatting for a while more, they stepped off into the air and continued on their journey.
A few moments later, several people appeared beside the Heavenly Venerate.
“Upon advancing into the Dao Patriarch Realm, he managed to suppress two Dao Patriarchs already. He possesses the supreme power of suppressing the whole Chaos Primordial Land. Master, is that the Dao Patriarch of Soul?” inquired a white-clothed disciple who was shocked to his soul.
The Heavenly Venerate nodded and continued, “That person by his side is Linglong. She obtained the Heavenly Order about 100 years ago and once did her cultivation within. Now, she has already reached the pinnacle stage of Lord Saint Realm.”
“Reach the pinnacle stage of Lord Saint Realm in just a hundred-year time? How is that possible?”
“Nothing is impossible. The Dao Patriarch of Soul himself is a person full of miracles. Those around him naturally cannot be regarded by common sense. In any case, with this relationship of his, if you encounter difficulties while wandering throughout the world, you can go ask for help from the Tianyuan Sacred Land.”
Somewhere far away, Jiang Ming was smiling while asking Linglong, “Girl, I thought that you might enter the Heavenly Venerate Dao Square and put on a good show! Never thought that we would just stay for a little while. This didn’t seem like your intention.”
“It doesn’t feel very interesting either. Not as meaningful as this trip of ours!”
“Alright then! Let’s go!”
“Senior brother, how about we just lie in white clouds together? With you below and me on top, we’ll flow along with the white clouds and wander throughout the Chaos Primordial Land.”
“Goodness! To think that you’d actually have such wild thoughts!”
“Is that a yes or a no?”
“Asking me if it’s a yes? You’re just asking for a beating.”
There was naturally nothing that couldn’t be discussed among a young couple.
Time flowed by slowly.It was almost time for the late Dao Patriarch’s cultivation site to open itself.
Yet, both Jiang Ming and Linglong did not care about it at all.
Over on the northern side of the Chaos Primordial Land however, there were a large number of experts gathered. The weakest among them were even of the Saint Realm and there wasn’t a lack of Lord Saints as well. This was because all of them wanted to head into the cultivation site of the late Dao Patriarch for a look and to see if there were any wordings left behind by the Dao Patriarch about the Chaos Realm.
On this day, the Jiang Ming and Linglong stopped by on a mountain top.
A living being could be seen sitting cross-legged at the peak of the mountain. There was a tea table in front of him, with mists rising above the already brewed teapot. Surprisingly, this even evolved into a phenomenon unique to the rules of the Chaos.
This living being was a Chaos Expert, the Dao Patriarch of Darkness. He was a being who sanctified the Chaos Dao of Darkness.
“I’ve been waiting for you for a long time, Dao Patriarch of Soul. I thought you would pass by my place before, but instead you went further and further. I had no choice but to come over and stop you on your tracks.” Dao Patriarch of Darkness laughed. “Both of you, please!”
Jiang Ming sat himself down and couldn’t help but ask, “Dao Patriarch of Darkness, the fact that you were looking for me. Are you wanting to ask if I sanctified my Dao through the Supreme Pagoda?”
“That’s right!” Dao Patriarch of Darkness’s eyes lit up, “It’s only within the Supreme Pagoda that you are able to grow up at such a rapid pace. That place is connected to the boundless Sea of Chaos after all. With countless geniuses and peerless experts within, one would be able to gather boundless resources if utilized properly. Even more so, if the person becomes the Group Admin, he or she can even travel into the Hongmeng Primordial Land for their cultivation.”
“If that’s the case then we’re actually considered to be from the same clan!” Jiang Ming remarked. “I was the Group Admin not long ago. Since my combat ability was extremely powerful, I managed to collect more than tens of millions of points there.”
“God damn! Tens and millions of points?” The Dao Patriarch of Darkness lost his cool. “Back in the year, I was extremely gifted and managed to overwhelm countless geniuses of the Sea of Chaos. I became the Group Admin of the Mortal Group and also the Immortal Group. With my heaven-defying combat ability, I managed to forcibly break through the Battle Towers, condense my Saint Soul. The points I accumulated back then were only a few million. I thought that my achievement was already a record that can’t be broken by those of the past nor would it be possible for those of the future. Who would’ve thought that you were able to accumulate that many points. It’s no wonder that you grew up so fast. You’re really a monster. That’s not right...”
He paused for a while before hesitantly asked, “If that’s the case, advancing to the Lord Saint Realm would already be the limit. However, you managed to sanctify the Chaos Realm in such a short period of time. Fellow Daoist, you have also traveled into the lands of the Masters, right?”
Jiang Ming shook his head. “No I didn’t. It’s just that I’ve acquired other great fortunes, that’s all. Fellow Daoist, what kind of existence is the master?” Beyond the Sea of Chaos? The legendary Hongmeng Chiliocosm?”
“Other great fortunes!” The Dao Patriarch of Darkness pondered for a while but didn’t ask in detail. To ask further would be overstepping the person’s boundary already.
“Alas, the Master’s territory!” There was a rather complicated look on Dao Patriarch of Darkness’s face. “I guess it doesn’t hurt to talk to you about it. That place is an incomparably huge world. The cultivation environment is far better than that of the Chaos Primordial Land. Other than the Center Zone, when you look around all directions, all the other parts are filled with boundless dangers. However, these dangers seem to have been set up specifically to temper us. There are a lot of experts there and were all brought over after passing the Supreme Pagoda’s test. But once you get there, you will never be able to return unless you sanctify the Chaos Realm.”
“Such harsh conditions?” Jiang Ming was surprised. “Isn’t it divided into the core, inner and outer sects?”
“It is!” Dao Patriarch of Darkness nodded his head and continued, “Because of the distinction, the cultivation environment is naturally different. Some examples would be the concentration of the Chaos Spiritual Essence, the sensitivity of enlightening the Great Dao and many more.”
“Is there existence beyond the Chaos Realm? ”
“There isn’t any there. However, I’ve heard from some of the seniors that there were quite a number of existences of the pinnacle stage of the Chaos Realm. However, those experts have long since disappeared. Perhaps they’ve transcended the Chaos Realm.” As Dao Patriarch of Darkness continued to explain, he was also in slight confusion himself. “Where would we end up after transcending the Chaos? Planar world, small chilicosom, middle chiliocosm, great chiliocosm and then the Sea of Chaos. What would the existence that transcends from here on out? Upon transcendence, is there a realm of higher level of heaven and earth?”
This wasn’t something that the Dao Patriarch of Darkness was confused about, but it was the common confusion among all of the experts who had achieved a certain degree in their path of cultivation. It felt the same as opening a nesting doll, no one knew if there was an end to it.
“Alas, transcendence beyond the Chaos. Let’s just take one step at a time and see how it goes.” Jiang Ming would find himself confused at times. However, he had his junior sister with him and felt that it was best to grasp onto the current moment. “Can you still return?”
“I can! It’s just that it takes an interval of ten thousand years to do so. When the time comes, I could come and go anytime.” As the Dao Patriarch of Darkness said so, he blurted a remark that was somewhat eccentric. “That place is known as Tianyuan Realm, exactly the same name as your Dao Domain.”
“Tianyuan Realm?” Jiang Ming was taken aback.

chapters.title: Chapter 520
chapters.content:
520 Xi Yao, Are You Willing to Take Me As Your Master?
The phrase ‘Tianyuan Realm’ that the Dao Patriarch of Darkness brought up had caused Jiang Ming’s heart of Dao to tremble.
Could it be a coincidence? If that was the case, why would his Heart of Dao tremble?
Jiang Ming had a vague feeling that the Tianyuan Realm of the Supreme Pagoda must have something to do with him. When he scanned through himself, the only thing that might be the connection would be the Human Path Record and the ‘System’.
As for how exactly they were related? To hell with that!
The Dao Patriarch of Darkness eventually left. The reason he came over to stop Jiang Ming in his tracks was just to connect with him.
After all, the Dao Patriarch of Soul was such a ruthless person, who had slaughtered two Dao Patriarchs even before arriving at the Chaos Primordial Land. As a Dao Patriarch himself, the Dao Patriarch of Darkness was naturally afraid as well.
Since they shared the same background through the Supreme Pagoda, how could the Dao Patriarch of Darkness not take the advantage to obtain such a connection?
With his junior sister in his arms, Jiang Ming stepped into the sky, gaze forth beyond the trillions of miles of clouds and golden waves of luminance and continued their next journey.
“Senior Brother, could it really be such a coincidence?” Based on the great fortunes that Jiang Ming possessed, Linglong had long been aware.
With her intelligence, she was definitely able to guess that her senior brother had other heavenly-defying great fortunes. Otherwise, it would have been impossible for Jiang Ming to grow so fast.
Even his inner world had evolved into a small Sea of Chaos. This was an incredible feat. In fact, there hadn’t been a person that did such a thing throughout the ages.
Even the Dao Patriarch of Darkness also said that within the foreign Tianyuan Realm which was filled with heavenly-defying geniuses, there weren’t any beings who were capable of cultivating their inner world to such a level. There were those who took on the path of the World Dao. Upon reaching the perfect stage of great chiliocosm however they cut themselves off from this path and allowed their inner world to evolve into a chiliocosm of a single attribute.
Such a feat would instead push the person to leap forth and advance into the Chaos Realm. Unfortunately however, their path on the World Dao would also be completely broken off from then on.
“Who knows?” Jiang Ming shook his head, “It’s better to live in the moment.”
“Since we’re living in the present moment, why is there still an uneasiness within your heart, to the point that you wouldn’t dare to have a descendent of your own?” Linglong hesitated slightly but still pointed out what she discovered.
Jiang Ming paused for a moment and sighed in his heart. Tilting his head, he looked up into the sea of clouds floating across him. In fact, he did always have hidden worries within his heart.
There were among two worries where one of them was Jun Sanqian. When he thought about it by now, this person was definitely an existence that was beyond the Chaos Realm. Coupled with the fact of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts appearing not long ago, this made him even more uncertain about the future.
This was all just well, and didn’t amount to much. The most worrisome was the second worry that Jiang Ming had, which was the fact that he was a traveler himself.
By now, he was already at the Dao Patriarch Realm and had even comprehended dozens of the Chaos Laws. Looking through the entire Sea of Chaos throughout the ages, how many people were even comparable to him? It could be said that he overwhelmed the endless Chaos bulldozing through the past and present.
Unfortunately, he still couldn’t find any traces of his past life. Even evoking the Human Path Record didn’t work. This was truly unimaginable to him.
“Wait a little longer. Just a little more!” Jiang Ming held his little junior sister in his arms and soothed her with a subdued tone.
Linglong’s heart was aching to the point that her eyes were red. However, she didn’t continue to ask further. She was the only one who could feel the uneasiness within her senior brother’s heart.
“If that’s the case, let’s continue on our journey, Senior Brother. In a day of such brilliant weather, we shouldn’t let down this beautiful scenery.” Linglong revealed a smile on her face that even lit up the sky.
“Let’s go then!”
The two of them traveled on. They stopped by different cities to taste the unique cuisines from time to time. Due to the fact that there was such a rich amount of different races, the number of cuisines were simply unimaginable. The two of them feasted all the way throughout their journey.
Of course the two of them stumbled upon quite a number of experts who were looking for troubles. However, all of them ended up dead.
On this day, the late Dao Patriarch’s Dao Domain had opened. With that, countless experts flocked to enter. However, there was a Dao Patriarch who did some investigation before, revealing that there were quite a number of arrangements within which would teleport a person to different places depending on their cultivation base.
This also reduced the chances of the strong bullying the weak within.
Both Jiang Ming and Linglong took just a glance at it and no longer paid any attention to the Dao Domain.
Even the experts of the Tianyuan Realm did not go to Dao Domain. In their eyes, Tianyuan Realm was the true blessed land. As for the rest? They were not much more than just that.
Time was like a grain of sand on the fingertip, slipping away from it without anyone noticing. In just a blink of an eye, another year had gone by.
Throughout this year, Jiang Ming and Linglong didn’t cultivate at all. They didn’t even return to Chuyang Peak.
At this moment, the two of them were in a divine city. This divine city was extremely huge, spanning three million miles from the east to the west. It was vast and boundless, filled with all kinds of holy luminance that rose within, enveloping a whole part of the heavenly realm.
There were also boundary formations everywhere within the place that prevents prying eyes.
On the 999th floor of the Ninth Cloud Tower, Jiang Ming and Linglong sat at the highest place. In front of them was a table completely laid out with a whole 360 delicious delicacies.
“The taste of this Yin Yang Fish is quite alright.” After tasting it herself, Linglong picked a piece of it and brought it to Jiang Ming’s mouth. “Try it, Senior brother.”
Looking at the fish filet that was condensed with both the Yin and Yang, Jiang Ming rolled his tongue, and the unique fragrance instantly filled his taste buds. The sensation made Jiang Ming’s mouth twitch as he said, “Though it’s not as tasty as your tongue.”
“Would you like to try them?” Linglong rolled her eyes.
“Right here? That’s not quite nice!” Jiang Ming said after slight hesitation, “I’m afraid that if I get slightly excited, the whole building might just be destroyed.”
“Senior brother, you’re really a nasty person.”
“Isn’t that exactly what you were thinking about?”
The two continued to bicker as they enjoyed their meal.
However, it was at this moment that Jiang Ming abruptly turned his head over and looked towards the northern sky.
That was the location where the mysterious Dao Domain had opened up.
“Senior brother, what’s wrong?” When Linglong saw Jiang Ming frowning, her heart immediately tightened.
Looking throughout the whole world, what could even make her Senior Brother worried? It wouldn’t even be a problem if all of the Dao Patriarchs of the Chaos Primordial Land came forth.
“Here comes trouble!” Jiang Ming stood up. With a wave of his hand, he teleported with Linglong directly back to the Chuyang Peak of the Tianyuan Realm.
As he flung his arms through the air, the Chaos Dao Suppressing Pagoda appeared. The pagoda directly merged from the top of the Tianyuan Realm. It combined itself with the place, forming a supreme defensive barrier.
When Jiang Ming raised his hand and pointed, the Chaos Defensive Garment appeared equipped on Linglong.
“Senior Brother, this is?” Linglong’s face changed wildly.
These were two pieces of Chaos Supreme Treasures! The Treasured Pagoda to protect the Dao Domain within and the battle armor to protect her.
This was preparation for the worst!
“Great enemies are coming!” Jiang Ming remarked.
He sensed the aura belonging to the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast and he was absolutely sure about it. The aura came from the mythical Dao Domain that opened one year ago.
As Jiang Ming focused his gaze, his divine eyes pierced through every illusion and even saw through the barrier of the Dao Domain, allowing him to see what was happening inside.
Who knew how many experts had gone into the Dao Domain, yet it was now completely empty inside.
No, there was one being left and it was the Heavenly Demonic Beast. Its strength was no weaker than that of Destroyer Nine. It was this beast that entered the Dao Domain here and devoured every expert within. It was but a big gulp and they were all done for.
Even Lord Saints became a bloody meal in his mouth.
The Dao Domain was almost unable to withstand the peerless aura of the Heavenly Demonic Beast. It seemed that this beast was reining in its immensely ferocious aura and was trying to open a pitch-black channel with its special ability.
When Jiang Ming looked towards the passage, he could feel an eerie malice. Jiang Ming turned away his gaze and stopped observing the passage. Otherwise, it was very likely that he would’ve been discovered.
When he looked up at the heavenly ladder of Tianyuan Realm, there was another person up there.
“Senior Brother!” Linglong called out to him softly. Her face was full of worry, but she couldn’t help him, and her heart was aching
No matter how hard she tried, she always ended up under the shelter of his Senior Brother. When she saw her senior brother frowning, her heart bleed. It also dawned on her the fact that this great enemy could even worry his Senior Brother. If that was the case, how immensely powerful would this enemy be?
“Don’t worry!”
Jiang Ming patted her hand, raised his arms, and grasped mid-air. The silhouette that was on the Heavenly Ladder landed right in front of him.
This person was none other than Xi Yao. Being a cultivator of the Great Overarching Realm, she had already possessed the will of the Saint Realm. Such a feat was extremely remarkable.
“Brother Jiang, Linglong!” Xi Yao was stunned for a while. When she saw that she was back in Chuyang Peak, Xi Yao couldn’t help herself from smiling. Today, she was even more beautiful than before and even had a unique inviolable aura on her.
“Xi Yao.” Jiang Ming had a grave look on his face, “Would you like to take me as your master?”
Linglong had an astonished look on her face.
Xi Yao on the other hand, was stunned there and then.

chapters.title: Chapter 521
chapters.content:
521 Transcending Beyond the Chaos
This remark of Jiang Ming caught both Xi Yao and Linglong by surprise.
Xi Yao was a simple-minded person after all. She was fond of Jiang Ming. Even though she had been trying to cut off her feelings for him, she wasn’t able to completely do so. She simply couldn’t control herself from liking Jiang Ming.
Even though Xi Yao left Chuyang Peak, she was only wandering around Tianyuan Realm or Tianyuan Sea. Did this even count as leaving? Maybe it was the feeling of reluctance? Or maybe it was too hard for her to sever her feelings.
Even Jiang Ming himself found it difficult to say whether he had good feelings for Xi Yao. Looking back then, there might have been some ambiguity of feelings among the two.
It was just that Xi Yao back then was a Holy Daughter and found it difficult to put down her pride; over at Jiang Ming’s side, he had his junior sister clinging around his side every day. Although Linglong revealed that she didn’t mind about Xi Yao, how could Jiang Ming not?
But now? Jiang Ming was asking Xi Yao to make him her Master.
“Senior Brother, what are you playing at here?” even Linglong was confused.
If Jiang Ming was to keep Xi Yao by his side with such a status, wouldn’t it be wrong? Master and disciple? It seemed that her Senior Brother really knew how to enjoy life.
“This matter is of utmost importance!” Jiang Ming had a stern look on his face as he looked at Xi Yao and asked, “Are you willing?”
“Disciple pays respect to the Master!” When she saw Jiang Ming’s solemn look, she understood that making him her master was very important to this man that she had been longing for. It was just that she couldn’t help the tears rolling in her eyes.
As she clenched her teeth, she knelt down and bowed to pay Jiang Ming the respect. Maybe this was for the best. From now on, she could stay here with authority and fairness.
“Alright! You are now my tenth disciple!” Jiang Ming nodded his head and let out a slight sigh of relief. With a big wave of his arm, he lifted Xi Yao up and said with a pleasant smile, “Due to certain reasons, I must take in ten disciples and also nurture all of them into the Saint Realm. The fact that you are my disciple is but a name. You can still call me Brother Jiang.”
“Master!” Xi Yao pursed her lips. “I’m the disciple and you’re the master. Our status has been established and cannot be changed anymore.”
“Hehe! Brother Jiang. You’re finished!” Linglong’s eyes were flashing as she suppressed the other ideas popping into her mind. She smiled and continued saying, “Seems you’re going to fail from getting ahold of such beauty now.”
Xi Yao immediately blushed as she hurriedly lowered her head.
As for Jiang Ming? He was rendered speechless.
He grabbed with his hand mid-air and transferred the other disciples of him over to space in front of him. They were Fengyun Wuji, Dugu Potian, Shi Hao, Ye Fan, Qin Yu, Han Li, Zhang Yuanqing, Zhou Mingrui, Shu Yu and also Xi Yao. There were exactly ten of them.
“We pay our respect to the Master.” All of them bowed and saluted with great respect.
To them, Jiang Ming was an existence comparable to that of a Creator. This was because all of them knew that the original Tianyuan Realm was nothing more than a planar world in one corner of the universe. It was brought over to the Infinite Realm Battlefield by their master and later grew into the level of a Sacred Land in a very short period of time.
Now, they had even reached the Chaos Primordial Land.
Several of these disciples had experienced all these changes that felt as though it was all a dream.
Jiang Ming nodded his head, raised his hand and swept through the void. A slit in the void suddenly appeared right next to him, followed by a rapid change of evolution into an individual chiliocosm. Within the chiliocosm, time and luminance flowed throughout and the aura of creation were boundless.
He casually pointed his fingers and endowed boundless fortunes and heaven-defying opportunities into the world before finally saying, “In this small world, I’ve left the Heavenly Heart of Great Dao Fruit, the Golden Lotus of Enlightenment and the Dao Enlightening Platform. There are also the Long River of Innate Vital Essence as well as the Xuanhuang Origin Essence Long River within, both condensing the three thousand Laws of the Saint Dao, directly materializing itself.”
“I’ve also refined various Chaos leveled supreme treasures as well as treasures that would lead your soul towards transformation. For example, there are Ginseng Fruit Tree, Enlightenment Fruit Tree, Star Stream Fruit Tree, Yellow Plums and many others.”
“Within this chiliocosm also, I’ve reversed time by ten million folds.”
“Your next task is to enter the chiliocosm and fully strive to enlighten the Laws of Saint Dao.”
“I hope that you will all advance into the Saint Realm as soon as possible.”
“After reaching the Saint Realm, it will still not be too late for all of you to forge a supreme foundation.”
“Can you understand my intention?”
Jiang Ming stated his intent of opening up this world.
“Master’s intent is for us to strive with all we’ve got and sanctify the path of Dao in the shortest possible time.” Fengyun Wuji bowed and replied.
“Indeed!” Jiang Ming nodded. With a wave of his hand, he sent all of them into the world before saying, “Commit to your cultivation well. This will be the greatest fortune that you’ve all attained so far. If you grasp this opportunity well, you can completely forge yourself with the potential of advancing into Lord Saint Realm and there will even be hope of attaining the Chaos Realm in the future.”
Jiang Ming’s words resounded in the hearts of the many disciples. This remark of his was not fake at all.
Jiang Ming had beheaded two Dao Patriarchs, killed dozens of Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts and even obtained the power of creation that was even far beyond the imagination of a Dao Patriarch.
His means were even more unimaginable. Just take a few rare treasures for example. He could just casually coalesce them with a swift wave of his hand.
“Thank you, Master!” All ten of Jiang Ming’s disciples greeted respectfully within the new world. They were all filled with boundless excitement.
Back in the outside world, Linglong was smiling as she said, “Senior Brother, it seems you’ve put down quite a lot this time around! Just looking at them made the feeling of greed within me boil, wanting to take them all for myself.”
“A single instance of release of mine is already comparable to this boundless creation.” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “When this great tribulation passes, I’ll give you a blessing of creation in the billions every day.”
“Hehe! You’re the one who said it, Senior Brother! I’ll be draining you dry.” Linglong licked her red and tender lips as her eyes gleamed with luminance. “A session a day and I’ll surely skyrocket into the Chaos Realm.”
Jiang Ming rolled his eyes in response.
As he turned his gaze over and looked at the small world that he had just created, it had already formed a small fist-sized ball suspended in front of him. Its outer layer was shrouded by the power of time.
Alas! A snap of a finger and boundless years would’ve passed by within.
It was a sped up time of one to a million. Based on the calculation of time in the ancient world, a day in the outside world would’ve been 20,000 years within.
With the blessing of creation that he had left behind, coupled with the boundless potential of his ten disciples, it would take less than an hour, or rather even half a tea time before all of them would end up successfully sanctifying the path of Dao.
“Girl, I’m afraid it’ll be quite some time upon this departure of mine. I’ll be leaving this place to you!” Jiang Ming turned around and hugged Linglong in his arms. “Don’t you worry!”
“Senior Brother, I’ll take care of the rest!” Linglong tightly hugged Jiang Ming.
This was the first time she had seen such solemnity from her senior brother.
“You mean the world to me and you are my everything.” Linglong said with a murmuring voice, “I’ll wait for your return. No! I’ll start preparing a meal right now. I’ll prepare all of the delicacies that I’ve seen or heard of for you to taste them!”
“Alright! Wait for me to come back for dinner!”
Jiang Ming left with a big smile on his face. He left an avatar of himself to stand guard in order to avoid any accidents.
Outside of the late Dao Patriarch’s Dao Domain, there were a few experts who had already sensed something was wrong. This was especially for several of the Dao Patriarch as they felt great fear when they gaze into the inside.
“Dao Patriarch of Soul!” Upon noticing Jiang Ming’s arrival, Dao Patriarch of Thunder immediately came over to him and clasped his hands to greet him. “This Dao Domain was suddenly enveloped by an inexplicable power. Even the several of us were unable to see through the situation inside. Were you able to?”
“There’s something in there that’s giving me a great sense of terror.” Dao Patriarch of Darkness also came over. “This is the Dao Domain of the late Dao Patriarch of Great Earth. Even if he was still alive, it would’ve been impossible for him to arrange this kind of barrier.”
“There are great terrors inside.” Jiang Ming nodded gravely. “I came here this time just to settle this matter.”
Jiang Ming briefly explained the story regarding the Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
“What? The invasion of the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beast? They’ve already destroyed many Seas of Chaos? They’ve even opened up a Chaos Passage to descend into our Sea of Chaos and are currently expanding the passage?” Dao Patriarch of Thunder was extremely shocked by the news.
Dao Patriarch of Thunder felt that the news was even more incredible. How could a whole Sea of Chaos be destroyed just like that? As for this Heavenly Demonic Beast? He had never even heard of it.
“Does such a terrifying existence really exist?” Dao Patriarch of Darkness was also numb from horror. “How could there be no records of them? How could we have not heard of them?”
“The universe is vast and there are many Seas of Chaos as well.” Jiang Ming laughed abruptly. “You can all think of the Heavenly Demonic Beast as the calamity of the many Seas of Chaos. If we manage to transition through it, the Sea of Chaos will continue its long-life cycle, whereas the beings above the Saint Realms could continue wandering through the world. If we are unable to overcome this, then this is the end of the cycle of life.”
“Tribulation?” Dao Patriarch of Thunder let out a sigh. “Even the great chiliocosms experience the cycle of life. Seas of Chaos would naturally have it as well. It’s just that with the Sea of Chaos having such a long-life span, it even made it difficult for us Dao Patriarchs to realize this. Dao Patriarch of Soul, are you sure that there are higher realms above the Chaos?”
“There are existences that transcends above the Chaos among these Heavenly Demonic Beasts. I don’t know if such an existence would be able to descend into the Sea of Chaos. If they can, then this would be a truly Tribulation of despair.” Upon finishing the sentence, Jiang Ming paced forth into the sky and directly entered the Dao Domain. “Gentlemen, I’ll be leaving the outside to you all!”
Dao Patriarch of Thunder and the likes had an instant change in their expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 522
chapters.content:
522 Barging Out of the Sea of Chaos
The inside of the Dao Domain of the late Dao Patriarch had been shrouded by the power of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts. Such a power was extremely mysterious, so mysterious that it was difficult for experts like the Dao Patriarchs to peek through, nor break through.
However, Jiang Ming didn’t care about such a power at all. He forcefully barged into it and immediately alerted two Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
There was only one Heavenly Demonic Beast at the beginning, but now there was another one. Obviously, the second one was a newcomer. The two were currently trying to further enlarging the Chaos Passage so that more members of their clan could enter to invade this Sea of Chaos.
“Killing Sila, the expert of the Sea of Chaos has barged in. Go deal with it.”
“Haha, sure! The intruder must be of this Sea of Chaos. For sure it’s a great meal. Jie Lu, thanks.”
“A great meal has to be enjoyed slowly. Moreover, there are living beings of the entire Sea of Chaos out there, which can be counted in trillions. By that time, it’d be a shocking feast.”
“Unlike you who enjoy the soul and absorb various emotions, I enjoy the flesh of experts!”
The two Heavenly Demonic Beasts chatted in a supercilious manner. They disregarded Jiang Ming completely. They didn’t care about Jiang Ming because they had, after all, traversed a few Sea of Chaos. And the so-called Dao Patriarch and Chaos Realm were truly ordinary.
“Indeed arrogant!” Jiang ming said in an extremely cold tone.
“This isn’t arrogant but a fact.” Killing Sila walked towards Jiang Ming.
The Dao Domain had long been destroyed. It had become an enormous and boundless space. In its innermost was a giant passage, which was enlarging along with the Heavenly Demonic Beast called Jie Lu evoking it. Vaguely, numerous Heavenly Demonic Beasts could be seen roaring greedily in the other end of the passage.
“You sentient beings of the Sea of Chaos are the food given by the great Dao. Now that you all have grown abundantly, we naturally have to come over to harvest.” Three mouths were grown on the face of the Killing Sila. Between their opening and closing, white liquid actually flowed out from within.
It looked strange indeed. Besides, the white liquid was corrosive. It corroded the void, and it was even difficult for the Chaos Laws to bear with it.
“Food?” Jiang Ming laughed strangely. “How many of you are there at the other end of the passage?”
“You know us!” The sound of Killing Sila had risen up to 30 thousand degrees. “In that case, I’ll have to capture you, devour your soul and absorb your memory so that I know how you learned about us!”
“Devour!” It opened its three big mouths and let out a silent growl.
The current of Chaos, various laws etc in front of Killing Sila, had been sucked in. Its mouths were a lot darker and more horrifying than the black hole. Even Jiang Ming’s soul was somewhat affected.
“Since I can’t drag further, I’ll finish this quickly.” Jiang Ming intended to talk further with the Heavenly Demonic Beast to understand their situation while waiting for the system’s rewards after his 10 disciples had sanctified their Daos.
However, because the Heavenly Demonic Beast had taken its move, Jiang Ming had to counteract so that he wouldn’t be put into a passive position.
“World Projection!” Jiang Ming didn’t move a bit, but the small Sea of Chaos within him had surged out, shrouding the entire space in an instant.
At that moment, space stagnated and time stopped. The special ability that Killing Sila had evoked, collapsed and dissipated. All the laws were reversed under the projection and had become the power which Jiang Ming could manipulate. It was at this moment that Jiang Ming had become the ruler of this space.
After consecutively digesting a dozen of Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts, Jiang Ming’s inner world had produced a few dozen Chaos Laws and expanded a hundredth time, hence Jiang Ming’s current power was strong beyond imagination. Looking at the intensity of Jiang Ming’s World Projection, which could even confine experts of Dao Patriarch level, showed how strong Jiang Ming was.
“It’s a World Projection. How can it be so strong? Impossible!” From within the body of Killing Sila, a power like the roasting oven burst forth. As if a 100,000 terabyte nuclear bomb exploded, the surging force could open up a Chaos, and it also caused the World Projection shook violently.
However, Killing Sila seemed to have fallen into a muddy swamp, difficult to break free.
“Void Cage!” Jiang Ming ignored the question of Killing Sila, and with a thought, he sent boundless power towards Killing Sila through the projection to create a cage and confine Killing Sila within it.
Following that, Jiang Ming cut the space with a wave, isolating the cage and creating a black hole above it.
Killing Sila sensed the death aura and howled. “Trying to suppress me? No way! Eight Laws of Desolation, open up!”
Killing Sila cast a peerless special ability and as its fists opened, it burst forth boundless of power which intensely shook the cage. It almost collapsed the cage, but it eventually failed.
The next moment, the cage had been absorbed into the black hole and was transferred into Jiang Ming’s inner world. Upon reaching, the power of the little Chaos’s origin was showered on Killing Sila, causing it to be incapable of resisting at all. Hence, Killing Sila was instantly imprisoned, unable to move a bit.
“Now it’s your turn!” Jiang Ming turned to Jie Lu.
Jie Lu was even more horrifying. A great halbert appeared in its hand. The halbert was extraordinarily domineering, and the power it released was capable of cutting through the Sea of Chaos.
What was strange, however, the halbert didn’t contain any laws but merely raging power and peerless monstrous origin within.
“Release!” The domineering great halbert could crack the universe and cut off all things. However, as Jiang Ming grabbed his palm upwards, the power emanated from the great halbert was instantly collapsed.
It was the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique, which had long been capable of affecting Chaos Dao Vessels.
Moreover, Jiang Ming had also been analyzing and contemplating for a countermeasure while refining and absorbing the essence of the Great Dao Primal Heavenly Demonic Beasts and had found a way to it.
“Die!” Jiang Ming raised a finger of his right hand and pointed forward. His attack directly merged into the void, reappeared above Jie Lu in the next moment and pierced into its skull.
Jiang Ming had taken advantage of the projection to distort the space when he cast his attack.
Bang... The power of the Return of Infinite Law Finger had blasted Jie Lu into a cloud of blood. The blood contained enormous will power and vitality and it was twisting to try to reunite. But its efforts were in vain as it was imprisoned directly by the World Projection.
Jiang Ming was able to confine Jie Lu for a moment with the World Projection, what’s more Jie Lu had become a cloud of blood.
With a flutter of his sleeve, Jiang Ming directly put Jie Lu into his inner world. Of course, Jiang Ming did not forget to put away that great halbert as well.
Following that, Jiang Ming frowned as he looked at the passage. So he communicated with the Supreme Order and entered the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda.
It was currently difficult for Jiang Ming to grow further, but Heavenly Demonic Beasts were a great supplement to him. Now that he had two in his inner world, Jiang Ming would have to quickly absorb their essence to improve his strength, which was the most important thing to survive.
The next moment, Jiang Ming reappeared, but with his stronger hidden aura. It was obvious that he had absorbed the essence of Jie Lu and Killing Sila.
Looking at the passage, Jiang Ming was rather hesitating. He wondered whether he should wait or barge his way out. If Jiang Ming was to wait, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts at the other end would have obtained the news about the ordeal of their two members and he didn’t know if the beasts would still come in. If Jiang Ming was to barge his way out, he didn’t know what was waiting for him out there.
‘If I’m still afraid now, millions of Sea of Chaos would be completely done for.’ Jiang Ming smiled wryly and took a look back.
The holy light in the Tianyuan Sacred Land illuminated the earth for hundreds of millions of miles. The Tianyuan Sacred Land was where Jiang Ming’s junior sister, master and the others were staying.
‘For the sake of my home I shall barge my way out! I shall kill all the extremes. Even if the great Dao is the demon, I shall destroy it as well!’ The murderous intention of Jiang Ming was unprecedentedly fiery. The strong murderous intention turned into a path that collapsed and wrapped around his body, which was subsequently purified.
“Let’s go!” Jiang Ming plunged into the Chaos passage.
