chapters.title: Chapter 523
chapters.content:
523 The Great Dao Alliance
The Chaos passage was extremely long. It was filled with various terrifying powers of destruction, even Jiang Ming had to block some of them personally. The space and time were a total mess, and Yin and Yang were restraining each other to the point that Jiang Ming had even seen a lump of more than thousands of Chaos Laws coagulated together, forming a terrifying and stalwart power.
‘That’s why the two Heavenly Demonic Beasts had to maintain and open the Chaos passage!’ Jiang Ming was enlightened.
This had further proven how precious the Chaos passage connecting to the external region which had formed itself was. Fortunately, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts didn’t discover that. Else, the Sea of Chaos where Jiang Ming originated, would have been attacked by numerous Heavenly Demonic Beasts already.
The moment Jiang Ming walked out of the Chaos passage, he felt heavy-laden. His surroundings were abruptly being confined and he was trapped.
When Jiang Ming looked around, he saw a total of 12 Heavenly Demonic Beasts, whose cultivation bases were akin to the Chaos Realm. In the distance, there were 13 mountain peaks glistering with supreme divine luminances and enclosing the destructive power of Chaos. On top of the peak were numerous Heavenly Demonic Beasts, but their cultivation bases were below the Chaos Realm. They were obviously the army of Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
“Were you the one who killed Killing Sila and Jie Lu?” The questioning Heavenly Demonic Beast was radiating with violet luminance. On its head was an emperor crown, disseminating his nobility and domineering aura. It had a figure similar to a human, but it had a bald head and didn’t have a nose. It looked rather strange indeed.
“Bingo!” Jiang Ming nodded. He looked at the beast and asked in a solemn manner, “How many of you here? Do you have a real leader?”
Through the Human Path Record, Jiang Ming had checked out a few of them, but he didn’t find out who was the leader. Every team was independent.
Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Record to check on the beast, which had just questioned him.
The beast was called Violet Kill. Its information shown was similar to the other Heavenly Demonic Beasts, but the only difference was that it had new information that it was of the King Bloodline. Hence, Violet Kill was the King Heavenly Demonic Beast.
“To think that you actually know about us. Are you a member of the Great Dao Alliance?” Violet Kill was rather surprised and then revealed its excitement. “That’s great. After I capture you, maybe I can find out the location of the Great Dao Alliance so that we can capture all of you altogether and destroy the alliance completely.”
Great Dao Alliance? Jiang Ming was shocked and was wondering what the organization was about. Moreover, from the tone of Violet Kill, it seemed that this alliance was specializing in resisting the Heavenly Demonic Beasts and even caused quite a lot of troubles for those beasts. Yet, Jiang Ming had not heard about it.
“To think that you know about the Great Dao Alliance.” Jiang Ming smirked while maintaining his composure. “It looks like your status in the Primordial Demon Abyss was quite high.”
“You even know about the Primordial Demon Abyss!” Violet Kill was even more surprised. “In that case, your status in the Great Dao Alliance is significant too. Although our Primordial Demon Abyss isn’t a secret, it’s not what an ordinary Dao Patriarch can know. Haha, I thought this would be just another typical hunt, but it turns out that I’ve met a big fish.”
“Tell me, who are you?” Jiang Ming was not in a rush to take his move.
Instead, he wished to obtain more information through conversation. In fact, the most bizarre thing was that when he was refining those Heavenly Demonic Beasts in his inner world, he did not get too much information about them, and even the memory of the Primordial Demon Abyss was blurred.
Moreover, most information he got from the Human Path Records were blurred as well. This was indeed a bizarre thing.
“Trying to trap information from me?” Violet Kill shook his head. “Even if you’re destined to be my meal, I won’t tell you anything about it at all.”
“In that case, go to hell!” Jiang Ming was very decisive.
The power surged out from his body just like the eruption of a volcano. In just an instant, Jiang Ming had burst forth a destructive torrent that could destroy infinite realms, which shattered the confinement.
Besides, there were a dozen of Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasures, which appeared outside Jiang Ming. These Supreme Treasures were refined from the various precious materials he had obtained so that he could detonate them with the Infinite Vessel Manipulation Technique and unleash their powers to create a destructive strike.
And this was the best moment.
Rumble! In an instant, the explosion emanated luminances and annihilated the universe. The trembling power had destroyed all things.
All 12 Heavenly Demonic Beasts were blasted out.
Jiang Ming had discovered that when he detonated a total of 10 Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasures, the range swept by the destruction storm was only one ten thousandth of the range in the Sea of Chaos. In other words, the power had been weakened to one ten thousandth of the original.
“World Projection!”
“Great Imprisonment Technique!”
“Long River of Fate!”
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
Along with the quick dissipation of the destructive storm, Jiang Ming evoked four special abilities almost simultaneously.
It was still the power of Jiang Ming’s inner world, which had first spread out in an invisible and intangible form just like an illusion. However, it could be materialized to form a world suppression and forbidden cage.
While Jiang Ming’s palm was emanating rays of light, he evoked the imprisoning special ability that he had comprehended and merged it into his World Projection to further superimpose it to a terrifying level.
Besides, there was a long river of fate which appeared beneath Jiang Ming. It was a mighty one, so long that its beginning and ending point were not known, only its waves were seen.
In the long river, there were billions and trillions of river sand. Every grain of river sand was as heavy as a world. It seemed that every grain of river sand was a microcosm of a world.
Meanwhile, all the Past Body, Present Body and the Future Body showed themselves.
The current bodies of three lifetimes were utterly different from the past. The Past Body had condensed the cultivation base, the Present Body represented the power of the physique, and the Future Body manifested the means of the soul.
The three bodies had the power akin to a certain aspect of Jiang Ming. Taking the Present Body as an example, it had the same physique with the same level of power as Jiang Ming’s real physique.
Only the Past Body was slightly different because it didn’t have the little Sea of Chaos. However, the power of its cultivation was still shocking because it had vaguely surpassed the power of the ordinary pinnacle stage Dao Patriarch.
The most bizarre thing was when the three bodies simultaneously evoked the Return of Infinite Law Finger, the form of the special ability displayed in the three bodies was utterly different.
These showed how terrifying Jiang Ming was.
Three different Return of Infinite Law Fingers evoked based on the bodies of three lifetimes had simultaneously pierced through the forehead of a Heavenly Demonic Beast each, directly destroyed their wills and annihilated their spirits in a snap of a finger.
This was what Jiang Ming couldn’t achieve in the past. It was because of the Heavenly Demonic Beast itself, which was difficult to be killed. Moreover, the beast had an unusual power and was difficult to be annihilated.
However, because Jiang Ming had killed quite many of the beasts and his efforts in deducing the attribute of the beasts’ power while refining them, he had roughly understood them.
It was only after Jiang Ming had refined Jie Lu and Killing Sila, he completely readjusted his special abilities to form a means of targeting the power of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Now it seemed that the effects Jiang Ming had achieved were pretty good.
As the World Projection retrieved its power, it put away the corpses of the three Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
The three bodies didn’t disappear but continued to cast their attacks.
“How dare you!” Violet Kill was furious when it saw his three brothers being killed. It emanated a wave, which abruptly reduced the speed of Jiang Ming’s three bodies.
Following that, Violet Kill punched towards the Present Body. The punch collapsed the sky and pierced through the falsehood.
The Present Body reacted by fixing his gaze at Violet Kill as a preparation to receive the blow.
The ultimate speed carried the ultimate power, and when they collided together, the blasting power was even more terrifying than the destruction of the world. It formed a circle of waves, causing the World Projection to be violently distorted.
Boom... Both the Present Body and the Violet Kill were forced to retreat simultaneously at the exchange.
The pupils of Jiang Ming constricted.

chapters.title: Chapter 524
chapters.content:
524 One Dao Force, The Dao Sanctification of Ten Disciples
Since Jiang Ming began to refine the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, his power had been improving greatly. The improvement of his inner world was particularly terrifying. The World Projection alone could immobilize even an ordinary Dao Patriarch. How terrifying was it?
Both the soul and physique of Jiang Ming long reached the ultimate limit of the Chaos Realm. To be exact, it was far better than the ultimate limit.
Nevertheless, the pure power of Jiang Ming’s physique had been blocked off by Violet Kill. Moreover, it was under the situation whereby Violet Kill was experiencing the explosion of ten Quasi-Chaos Supreme Treasures and the confinement of the World Projection. These had proven how terrific Violet Kill was.
“Human, with your avatars being so amazing, you are indeed extraordinary!” Violet Kill was even more shocked. “You definitely are a member of the Great Dao Alliance’s top level. Otherwise, it’s impossible that you have such a high combat power, absolutely impossible!”
“Therefore, I’ll definitely have to capture you!”
“Guys, merge with me!”
As soon as Violet Kill howled into the void, the other eight Heavenly Demonic Beasts released a bizarre fluctuation so that their power resonated with that of Violet Kill.
“Merge?” Jiang Ming smirked as he stroked in the void, evoking the Time-Space Reincarnation Technique, a peerless special ability. It was a special ability, which was formed by merging the power of time, space, reincarnation and the wonder of illusion into one.
In that instant, the void vibrated, shrouded with time fog and was cut into little worlds which then turned into black holes. The black holes were constantly circulating, cutting off the connection among their powers.
“Let me kill you first!” As soon as Jiang Ming finished his words, his three bodies lunged themselves towards Violet Kill at the same time.
“Dao Exterminating Punch!”
“Soul Strike!”
“Return of Infinite Law Finger!”
The three bodies were simultaneously burning themselves, sublimating to the limit and turning their boundless might into the ultimate blow.
“Wanna kill me? No way!” Violet Kill, who was shrouded in the mystifying time, space and reincarnation, suddenly felt a chill down its spine, and it had a bad feeling.
Violet Kill immediately burned the supreme King Blood within its body, which transformed into the blood-colored might power and formed the vision of the stormy waves crashing on the shore. It blasted the Time-Space Reincarnation Technique and managed to rush out from the technique itself.
“Eight thousand layers of scarlet indestructible immortals!”
As Violet Skill saw the three approaching strikes, his eyebrows twitched intensely, and the power in his body exploded, forming a total of 8,000 layers of immortal aperture in an instant.
Round by round, one after another, immortal and supreme. This was the talent of its bloodline, a supreme defense.
Violet Kill was confident that nothing in the Sea of Chaos could break through the defense of its bloodline. Regardless of whether one was a peak stage Dao Patriarch, the supreme Chaos, or even a peerless Supreme Treasure, all were useless.
But now...
Boom... As soon as the three peerless blows of the three bodies blasted at Violet Kill simultaneously, it directly blasted the 8,000-layer defense outside its body, followed by its body, tearing its body into five pieces.
The disintegrated bodies quickly wriggled and formed into five Violet Kill in a blink of an eye. It was the immortal Bloodline Special Ability, but it was too late.
The blast had weakened the power of Violet Kill, hence giving a good chance for Jiang Ming.
“Great Devouring Technique!” When Jiang Ming merged this special ability into the World Projection, it had formed numerous black holes which devoured five pieces of Violet Kill’s body in an instant.
“Now it’s your turn!” Jiang Ming’s eyes were cold, and he had to slaughter all of the remaining Heavenly Demonic Beasts as soon as he took his move.
Jiang Ming no longer evoked the Long River of Fate to create bodies of three lifetimes, but he mobilized all his power. With a flutter as fast as lightning, he got to the front of a Heavenly Demonic Beast, which was still being trapped by the Time-Space Reincarnation Technique and gave it a punch.
The punch had gathered the power of the physique, the laws of the cultivation base and the wonder of the soul. Hence, the power of the punch had completely gone beyond the previous utmost limit, so strong that it was difficult for the endless void outside of the Sea of Chaos to bear, and it actually created ripples of destruction.
Bang... This Heavenly Demonic Beast was instantly blasted on the spot. Following that, the World Projection was distorted as it devoured the bloody pieces of the Heavenly Demonic Beast.
Jiang Ming didn’t stop there. With consecutive flashes, he bombarded the remaining Heavenly Demonic Beasts one after another. To the current Jiang Ming, a Heavenly Demonic Beast at Chaos Realm was like a lamb.
In just a blink of an eye, Jiang Ming had slaughtered all 12 of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Jiang Ming was burning with passion and was filled with fighting intent. He felt an unprecedented ease.
Such a battle was indeed the passion a man should have.
Following that, he shifted his gaze towards the 13 boundless divine mountains and couldn’t help but smile.
“Such a premium delicacy. I’m afraid that each divine mountain is no weaker than a Heavenly Demonic Beast!” Jiang Ming muttered. He didn’t rush forward but meticulously observing the external space of the Sea of Chaos. He realized the difference and couldn’t help but frown.
“This void here is extremely stable!” As Jiang Ming stroked, he discovered that he couldn’t cut through the void, nor could he teleport himself.
“There’s no rules here but I can deduce my own laws. How strange it is.” Jiang Ming felt the void carefully. The battle just now, Jiang Ming fought by relying on his own power alone. Other than that, he couldn’t absorb the power of the void to replenish his power.
“No...” Jiang Ming somewhat sensed something. He lifted his hand and grabbed, conjuring a mighty power that was beyond the Chaos Realm. A faint purple stream of light appeared in the void, which Jiang Ming swallowed, and it was quickly digested.
When the purple stream of light was refined, it turned into something akin to a Long River of Innate Vital Essence of Chaos.
“This...” Jiang Ming was surprised but also felt it was a matter of course.
After Jiang Ming had tried for a couple of times, he concluded that only the power beyond the Chaos Realm could shake the void outside the Sea of Chaos and extract the purple stream of light for replenishment. Therefore, this was an act which was inachieveble by a common Dao Patriarch.
‘This is interesting!’ Jiang Ming left as he thought.
At this moment, the divine mountains were about to escape. But none of them could escape from Jiang Ming, whose speed had gone beyond the speed of light even though he couldn’t teleport.
In just a while, Jiang Ming had caught up with the divine mountains. He evoked the World Projection to envelop them but it failed to affect the light of defense shrouded on top of the mountains.
“In that case, smash!” Jiang Ming blasted the defense of a mountain with a smash. In just a snap of a finger, all the divine mountains were exposed under the World Projection. As the power of the World Projection vibrated, the mountains were completely confined and were then absorbed.
It was at this moment that Jiang Ming suddenly turned to look at the other side. He saw the void was vibrating and then a human figure appeared.
Yes, it was a human figure, a human being. Jiang Ming was certain about what he had seen. He squinted his eyes, but he disregarded it. Instead, he smashed a dozen times to blast the remaining divine mountains and put them away into his inner world so that they could be his provision for growth.
Following that, the battle was considered to have ended completely. Of course, the plunder Jiang Ming had obtained was amazing as well. Once he finished refined all of them, there was bound to be a qualitative change in his strength.
“Fellow Daoist!” The figure paced towards Jiang Ming from a far, but stopped thousands of miles away. He clasped hands towards Jiang Ming solemnly, and there was still a look of shock on his face. “I’m Jian Wushuang, a member of the Great Dao Alliance!”
“Are you here for me?” Jiang Ming asked.
Although Jiang Ming had no idea about the method that Jian Wushuang had used to descend directly to where he was, he guessed that Jian Wushuang was here for him.
“Yes!” Jian Wushuang smiled. “The Great Dao Alliance sensed a power beyond One Dao Force. Hence, I’m assigned to come to receive and guide you there.”
It was at this moment that Jiang Ming’s expression had slightly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 525
chapters.content:
525 The Explosion of the System, Ultimate Mission
Jian Wushuang, who was a member of the Great Dao Alliance, obviously came for Jiang Ming as he had invited Jiang Ming to go with him.
Before Jiang Ming could check on Jian Wushuang, he suddenly received a notification from the system.
“Ding: Congratulations to the host for completing the mission of getting all ten disciples to sanctify their ways of Dao and becoming Sants.”
“Ding: You are rewarded with 49 hearts of Chaos.”
“Ding: Based on the host’s current situation, you are given an ultimate mission, ie. to transcend the Chaos.”
Jiang Ming was shocked. The reward was indeed abundant. After all, a heart of Chaos was akin to the condensation of a whole Sea of Chaos. Hence, it had at least more than 80 percent of the power of Creation contained in a Sea of Chaos.
How terrifying the heart of Chaos was. Imagine if Jiang Ming was to refine all of them, how far his improvement would be? Even Jiang Ming didn’t dare to imagine it.
However, Jiang Ming was wondering why the system would give him an ultimate mission? Would the system no longer be usable once he transcended the Chaos Realm? If this was the case, he thought the system was too lousy.
With just a thought, Jiang Ming called out the Human Path Record. As he sensed it slightly, he still could utilize the record to descend to places as he wished even though he was located in this place of nothingness.
This made Jiang Ming relieved a little.
However... With a flip of his hand, there was a token. It was the Supreme Order but it had now lost all its Dao fluctuations.
‘Why is it so?’ Jiang Ming evoked the Supreme Order but there was no reaction at all. Moreover, he couldn’t sense the Supreme Pagoda, let alone enter it.
‘The system has just changed and the Supreme Order becomes invalid? What to do with my millions of points I have collected? Is it because the Supreme Order can’t take it anymore? What the f*ck!’ Jiang Ming had been cursing as he thought of it.
Jiang Ming planned to go to the Hongmeng Primordial Land again in the near future, yet it turned out that the Supreme Order had become invalid?
Jiang Ming hurriedly contacted the members of the Great Dao Group.
[Jiang Ming: Guys, can you still enter the Supreme Pagoda?]
[Huang Quan: I was preparing to cultivate in seclusion when there was some sound from the Supreme Order. I took it out to check it, and I found that the function of entering the Supreme Pagoda is no longer available. Group Admin, what’s happening actually?]
[Dongfang Chenxi: I’ve just come out from the seclusion and found out about it too. Can it be that the Supreme Pagoda is facing its catastrophe?]
[Jiang Ming: It shouldn’t be. Based on my assumption, the level of the Supreme Pagoda is far above the Supreme Treasures. If it’s facing its catastrophe, I think we would be affected as well.]
[Dongfang Chenxi: Brother Jiang, if it’s not facing a catastrophe, why would it have such a sudden change? Brother Hong used to say that the Supreme Pagoda has a long history. For how many trillions of years, it’s remained the same yet why has it changed suddenly? Brother Jiang, does it mean that all the points you have collected have become invalid? Hehe, brother Jiang, why do I have the urge to laugh out loud]
[Feng Wu: Haha, I’ve already laughed out loud. A rich man like brother Jiang is really losing his fortune this time. I no longer have to be envious of brother Jiang from now onwards. By the way, fortunately we have a Great Dao Group to connect to each other anytime. Else, it’d be difficult for us to be so at ease in the future.]
After chatting for a while, Jiang Ming retrieved his consciousness. He was comforted because it was not only his Supreme Order which had broken.
However, as soon as the system had announced the ultimate mission, the fact that the Supreme Order had become invalid, had made Jiang Ming wonder about the connection between the two.
Eventually, Jiang Ming decided not to dwell further on the topic.
Jian Wushuang, who was standing aside, remained standing quietly. As he looked at the slight change of Jiang Ming’s expression, he didn’t ask nor say anything.
It was because he felt pressure from Jiang Ming himself. Moreover, he had witnessed how easily Jiang Ming could suppress the Demonic Mountains.
Each Demonic Mountain was akin to the top-notch Chaos Supreme Treasure. In addition, there were countless Heavenly Demonic Beasts living in those Demonic Mountains, and it was even strengthened by bizarre formations. Therefore, an ordinary Chaos Expert might not be capable of breaking its formation even after he spent thousands of years trying.
Yet, Jiang Ming not only broke the bizarre formation of the Demonic Mountain in just a snap, but also put it away. Amazing.
“Can you tell me more about the Great Dao Alliance?” Jiang Ming asked as he looked at Jian Wushuang. At this time, he turned and saw that the Chaos passage had been closed.
“Of course!” Jian Wushuang pointed at the Chaos passage, which had closed yet still radiating terrific waves, and explained. “A Chaos Channel which is not formed naturally, would gradually be repaired by the orders of Chaos from the Sea of Chaos and then disappear. However, the naturally formed Chaos passage usually would last for a long time, hence critical for various Sea of Chaos to keep in touch.”
Jiang Ming nodded, “I have just entered the external part of the Sea of Chaos, so please do start from here.”
“Sure!” Jian Wushuang agreed. However, he felt strange when Jiang Ming told him that Jiang Ming had just entered the external part of the Sea of Chaos. He thought Jiang Ming was pulling his leg because he couldn’t believe that Jiang Ming would be this strong if he were to get here not long ago.
Nevertheless, Jian Wushuang didn’t ask Jiang Ming at all. He just explained as Jiang Ming wished. After all, it would just waste a bit of his time.
“In this vast land of emptiness, there are countless Sea of Chaos!” Jian Wushuang explained slowly.
The land of nothingness was also known as the land of origin, the land of return to the ruins, and the land of primordial.
In this place of unknown size, there was nothingness. There wasn’t any legal principle, order, so-called spiritual qi, Chaos qi and so on. It seemed like a total emptiness, not even a Sea of Chaos could be seen.
However, the Sea of Chaos existed in the dark place in this vast void, and it could only be connected to the Sea of Chaos when there was a Chaos Channel.
One could also sense the location of the Sea of Chaos through special means, followed by forcibly breaking through the shackles to enter it. However, this was extremely difficult and not achievable by an ordinary Dao Patriarch.
It was due to the fact that upon entering into this land of nothingness, one could only rely on one’s own strength. Once the strength had been exhausted, one would die because the strength couldn’t be replenished.
However, if one’s capability had achieved a certain level, one could forcefully shake the heaven and earth to attract purple light. It was a great supplement, which was useful even to a Chaos Expert.
“We also call the purple light the Hongmeng Violet Qi. It is assumed that such a power should be the essence of the origin of all things, the power of the land of nothingness’s origin, or the power beyond the Chaos level. Because our power has broken through the utmost limit of the Chaos Realm, we are considered qualified to use or enjoy it!” Jian Wushuang said continuously.
“Broken through the utmost limit of the Chaos Realm?” Jiang Ming frowned.
“Yes, to be exact, it’s the utmost limit of a Dao Patriarch!” Jian Wushuang smiled. “The cultivation level of infinite worlds doesn’t differ much. The Chaos Realm is usually known as a Dao Patriarch but a Dao Patriarch is not completely the Chaos Realm. It’s generally said that the peak of the Dao Patriarch is considered to be the highest level for cultivation, but it’s not the case!”
The peak of the Dao Patriarch was equivalent to having completely mastered a Chaos Law. Yet, the Dao Patriarch could still improve further from this level. For instance, the Dao Patriarch could master two Chaos Laws. Or the physique of the Dao Patriarch could be transformed again to another level.
“Once one’s cultivation base surpasses the peak of the Dao Monarch, one could shake the land of nothingness to attract Hongmeng Violet Qi. We call this realm the Dao Breaking Realm. In fact, the Dao Breaking Realm is considered as a part of Chaos Realm. It’s merely just a division.”
“The power upon advancing into the Dao Breaking Realm, regardless of the physique or the soul and the power of cultivation is at least One Dao Force!”
“Dao Force is the measuring unit for the Dao Breaking Realm. That is to say, the power that can be exerted when you just advance into the Dao Breaking Realm is One Dao Force.”
“One Dao Force is the weakest Dao Breaking Realm. And the strength of the Dao Breaking Realm is based on the Dao Force.”
Jian Wushuang explained with ease and fluently.
In this way, the Dao Patriarch didn’t even have One Dao Force? Jiang Ming had a strange expression flashed across his face.
It turned out that the Dao Patriarch was not a prestige identity at all. It was so ridiculous. If Jiang Ming was to send the news back to the Sea of Chaos, he was afraid that the Dao Patriarch of Darkness and the likes would spurt a river of blood of 30 million miles in depression.
As Jian Wushuang saw Jiang Ming seemed to be interested in what he was talking, he continued.
At the same time, Jiang Ming had also checked on Jian Wushuang. Jian Wushuang was a human born in a Sea of Chaos. He was not only ingenious, but he also had sky-defying opportunities. These had helped him to counterattack step by step, conquer the heavens and trample all the other talents of the same era.
After a series of grievances and hatreds, he finally sanctified the Chaos Realm. He began to enjoy the happiness of the eternal Dao, the eternal life, and being invincible in the world. Besides, he had been improving his cultivation base until the peak of Dao Patriarch.
However, the Sea of Chaos where he came from was suddenly being invaded by Heavenly Demonic Beasts. In a snap of a finger, hundreds of millions of large, medium and small chiliocosms were destroyed, and Saints, King Saints, and Lord Saints perished like ants. Even Dao Patriarchs were killed consecutively.
At that time Jian Wushuang was fighting against the Heavenly Demonic Beast. When he was in despair because he was about to be killed, Jian Wushuang actually comprehended the second, the third, until the ninth Chaos Laws along with the trembling Sea of Chaos. Following that, he mastered all nine Chaos Laws completely when the Sea of Chaos was about to be destroyed. This allowed his combat power to have increased exponentially.
Jian Wushuang was able to force a retreat of all the seven invading Heavenly Demonic Beasts out of the Sea of Chaos. He also took advantage of the situation to chase after them. As soon as he got out of the external Sea of Chaos, he was sensed by the Great Dao Alliance, and then came a group of Dao Breaking Experts, helping him to besiege and kill the Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Following that, Jian Wushuang joined the Great Dao Alliance.
Jian Wushuang was indeed lucky, and he could be known as the son of great Dao indeed. To be able to have a breakthrough during the critical stage and mastered a few Chaos Laws consecutively, it was truly the Origin of the Sea of Chaos, which had helped him cheat personally.
“Alas, about the Great Dao Alliance!” When Jian Wushuang talked about it, his expression looked rather complicated.

chapters.title: Chapter 526
chapters.content:
526 3,000 Seas of Chaos, Palace of Fortune
A long time ago since ancient times, when the Xuanhuang had yet to condense and there weren’t any orders, the vast world and hundreds of millions of space were in chaos. However, as time passed by, they gradually moved towards order.
As heaven and earth evolved, life flourished. A terrifying life appeared in the world at an unknown time. They called themselves Heavenly Demonic Beasts. They had strong physique, profound cultivation and especially the unique power that could restrain all beings. What was more terrifying was that they could rapidly improve themselves through devouring spirits of thousands of clans. Therefore, their appearance was akin to natural disasters, destroying one world after another.
Gradually the experts who could barely resist these Heavenly Demonic Beasts appeared. They eventually gathered together, and an earth-shattering supreme war broke out.
It was said that there was a Heavenly Demonic Beast, which had surpassed the Chaos Realm. Because there was also one from among other spirits, the two led a group of thousands of Chaos Experts and blew up the world of Chaos.
As a result, almost half of the world had been destroyed. The clan of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts was crippled as almost all of them were slaughtered. However, there were some beasts which managed to escape but no one knew where they had gone hiding.
“According to the record, after that battle, the world has abruptly changed and divided into 3,000 Seas of Chaos and this land of nothingness.” Jian Wushuang described the past. “In order to deal with the disaster of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts which may break out again in the future, the surviving experts founded the Great Dao Alliance. The Dao Breaking Realm was divided at that time. Whoever has advanced into the Dao Breaking Realm would be invited. Because all 3,000 Sea of Daos are too far apart to be found, a special Great Dao Vessel was refined to detect the creature whose combat power has reached One Dao Force. It’s just like me descending to where you are, I did it through that special Supreme Treasure. However, it does consume a lot.”
The past had become history. No one would know whether the recorded past was real or not. But even so, the past was magnificent. Who would have thought that the formation of the Sea of Chaos was a result of that battle? And there were 3,000 of them.
Jiang Ming silently thought of Jun Sanqian. ‘I wonder where that brother is?’ Jiang Ming sighed in his heart.
Jiang Ming didn’t know whether he would be meeting Jun Sanqian again since he had lost the opportunity to communicate with the Supreme Pagoda.
“I wonder how big the world was in the past? It can actually be divided into 3,000 Seas of Chaos?” Jiang Ming was truly astonished.
“Who knows?” Jian Wushuang was confused as well.
If all the Seas of Chaos and the land of nothingness were to be merged together, the vastness of heaven and earth would give him the feeling of astonishment.
Even if a Lord Saint Expert was to travel through the entire heaven and earth at full speed, the expert would not be able to succeed without a hundred billion years. In fact, such length of time was optimistic speculation only. It was supposed to be immeasurable and even more unfathomable.
Jian Wushuang also explained more about the Great Dao Alliance.
Overall, the alliance was a loose organization with no mandatory requirements, with the Palace of Fortune as its headquarters. The organization also emphasized on one’s strength, and there were several veterans to maintain the basic continuity of the organization.
The internal transaction used Hongmeng Coin as its currency. These coins were formed from condensing the Hongmeng Violet Qi. Everyone could create them but would need to spend time and energy. After the condensation, one could also absorb it for one’s cultivation. A common Dao Breaking Expert could condense only ten pieces of coins per day, hence it showed the immeasurable value of the Hongmeng Coin.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, would you like to go over?” Jian Wushuang finally invited Jiang Ming.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming accepted the invitation. After all, unless one had the capability to suppress all things, else it was the organization that was more powerful.
Jian Wushuang showed a happy look on his face. At the same time, he pointed at the ground, and a formation appeared beneath their feet. The formation emanated an undulation, which sent them away.
Upon appearance, Jian Wushuang and Jiang Ming had got to a great hall.
The hall was very empty, and there weren’t many people around.
Jiang Ming took a glance and knew that it wasn’t a trap!
“This is the reception hall!” Jian Wushang explained. When he saw a white-haired elder pacing towards them, he quickly introduced. “Fellow Daoist Jiang, this is brother Gu Cheng, one of the five veterans. Brother Gu, this is Jiang Ming. When I got there, he had killed a dozen of Heavenly Demonic Beasts and suppressed a total of 13 Demonic Mountains.”
The eyes of Gu Cheng were beaming with surprise. He hurriedly paced forward, clasped his hands and said, “It’s my pleasure to meet you, fellow Daoist Jiang!”
“Fellow Daoist Gu, my pleasure!” Jiang Ming clasped his hands too.
“It is so unexpected to learn that you’ve made such a record as soon as you show up. This is incredible.” Gu Cheng complimented. “We haven’t had any newcomers for 3,000 epochs. Your arrival will definitely excite other fellow Daoists and we get to meet as well.”
Jiang Ming had learned that an epoch here was equivalent to a trillion years. Hence, 3,000 epochs was akin to a very long period of time.
For so many years in the many Seas of Chaos, the fact that no one actually successfully advanced into the Dao Breaking Realm was indeed a rather pathetic scene.
They entered the Dao Breaking Hall directly. It was the procedure every newcomer had to go through, that was to test the Dao Force.
There wasn’t any mandatory requirement to request the newcomer to reserve his power or to evoke his special ability and the likes. Provided the newcomer’s power could reach the minimum requirement of One Dao Force, it would be considered as a testimony of passing the threshold.
The room was enormous. On the wall in front of Jiang Ming, there was the word ‘Dao’ engraved. It was just a simple word, but it made Jiang Ming abruptly feel gloomy.
From the word ‘Dao’, Jiang Ming actually felt the pressure, and there were traces of various Chaos Laws, which were incomparably ingeniously fused together and woven into a terrifying web. The left and right walls were tentacles, and the center was the core.
“This is the Dao Breaking Hall which was refined by a total of 81 Dao Breaking Predecessors in the past. It’s built to measure the level of Dao Force so that we will have a subjective judgment, which also allows the testers to have a basic understanding of their own combat power.” Gu Cheng introduced. “The Chaos Realm of Heavenly Demonic Beasts are divided into ranks as well. Once we advance into the Dao Breaking Realm, it would be equivalent to their King level; 100 Dao Force is akin to their Monarch level; and 10,000 Dao Force is akin to their Emperor level.”
Jiang Ming listened seriously. He had also understood that Violet Kill, which was suppressed within his inner world not only had the King leveled bloodline, but it itself had also achieved the King level.
“An Emperor leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast has at least 10,000 Dao Force?” Jiang Ming was surprised.
“Yep!” Gu Cheng nodded. “Whenever there’s such an existence among the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, it’d be a disaster to us.”
“Can we reach up to 10,000 Dao Force?” Jiang Ming doubted. “Can it be that the more Chaos Laws we master, the more terrifying the power we can burst forth? How many Chaos Laws do we need to master in order to achieve this level? There should be at least 100 Chaos Laws right?”
“More than 100? Difficult, it’s really difficult!” Gu Cheng exclaimed. “The Chaos Law itself is difficult to comprehend. If you try to comprehend other laws after you have mastered one, your law would repel the others. Hence, the degree of difficulty will increase exponentially, that’s by ten times and then followed by a hundred times. Even if you have mastered more than 100 of Chaos Laws, it’d be even more difficult to merge them together in order to burst forth the real power.”
“So it’s difficult to comprehend and to merge!” Jiang Ming understood it.
“Yes.” Gu Cheng said, “As two different Chaos Laws repel each other, it is extraordinarily difficult to merge into one special ability, let alone to merge more than 100 of Chaos Laws. This is totally different from the laws within a small chiliocosm. After all, every Chaos Law is a complete, independent and intolerant great Dao.”
“Are there anyone taking the path of World Dao?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“No, because it’s even more difficult!” Gu Cheng smiled wryly. “It’s usually the utmost limit for the inner world to evolve until the great chiliocosm level. It’s extremely tempting for it to further transform into the Chaos, the Seas of Chaos and nurture 3,000 laws, which is also known as the perfect Dao. Based on the assumption, once the inner world has transformed into the Sea of Chaos and has nurtured 3,000 Daos, the host is akin to the heaven Dao. The host can easily master various Chaos Laws, and it’s particularly easy for the host to merge them together. Unfortunately, it’s not only the perfect Dao, but also the way of deception.”
“The way of deception?” Jiang Ming was confused.
“Yes, because it’s unattainable at all!” Gu Cheng explained. “We used to nurture numerus experts of Word Dao to the perfect stage of great chiliocosm. Yet, when they went through the transformation, all of them died! Among them were those who advanced into the Dao Breaking Realm through their soul before getting their physique to advance into the Dao Breaking Realm as well. There was also an expert who had both his soul and physique advanced into the Dao Breaking Realm and was supported by all 81 Dao Breaking Experts, yet he still failed at the critical point of the transformation.”
“It...” Jiang Ming was shocked.
Merely a few sentences of Gu Cheng had shown that there was a terrifying price to pay. Not to mention the resources required to nurture the inner world, just to help the expert to have his soul and physique advancing into the Dao Breaking Realm, how much would it cost? It was immeasurable, the means taken were even more incredible. Yet, with such strong support, why would those experts in World Dao still fail?
‘I remember that I managed to transform my inner world into the Chaos when my soul had just advanced into the Chaos Realm, which was at the initial stage of the Dao Patriarch. Although it was truly difficult, it was completely incomparable to what Gu Cheng had said. The difference in the difficulty is one trillion light-years away!’ Jiang Ming thought.
In fact, Jiang Ming felt very strange. He wondered why he could succeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 527
chapters.content:
527 What To Do When Being Invincible
According to Gu Cheng, the transformation of the inner world into the Sea of Chaos was a dead end. However, Jiang Ming himself had succeeded, and he did it rather effortlessly.
Jiang Ming thought of the three possibilities. First, he had the heart of Chaos merged into his inner world; second, he did the transformation in the exclusive space of the Supreme Pagoda, where he was inexplicably affected; and third, he had the power of the World Tree merged into his inner world because of the capability of the World Tree to nurture its own 3,000 Daos. Other than that, there was also an impossible possibility, i.e Jiang Ming was affected by the system.
But no matter what, Jiang Ming succeeded and became a unique being.
If Jiang Ming didn’t have these possibilities, based on what Gu Cheng had said, Jiang Ming would never succeed and he would have died.
‘I must say that I’m truly blessed by the great Dao.’ Jiang Ming thought happily but he didn’t plan to say it. Hiding his true self had become a habit and instinct.
“Alas, when the World Dao can’t be transformed into the Chaos, it’s not useful for us and the billions of clans.” Gu Cheng sighed. “Fellow Daoist Jiang, let’s stop talking about it. By the way, would you like to try?” Gu Cheng pointed at the word ‘Dao’ before them.
“Alright!” Jiang Ming stepped forward and punched onto the word purely with his power of physique.
The surging blood flowed through the cosmos and exploded the mysterious world. This punch was indescribable. The radiated power made both Gu Cheng and Jian Wushuang to take a few steps back.
If such a power of shock was to occur in the Sea of Chaos, it would annihilate countless great chiliocosms. But the power was absorbed by the room itself.
Boom... As the luminance of the punch radiated, the word ‘Dao’ in front of Jiang Ming burst forth boundless colors and endless might. It eventually showed a number of ’36’.
“It’s so weak?” Jiang Ming frowned. He felt disappointed with himself as he got only 36 Dao Force.
“It’s weak?” Jian Wushuang shook his head in disagreement. “Daoist, it’s difficult for the many Daoists in the Palace of Fortune to reach this number even though they have evoked their special abilities. Moreover, it’s just the power of your physique.”
“You’re already very amazing!” Gu Cheng added. Because it was obvious for Gu Cheng that Jiang Ming didn’t exert his full force, he suggested, “Would you like to try again?”
“I’ll do it again!” Jiang Ming shook his body as he circulated his blood and energy, turning them into a torrential wave. Following that, he punched with his fist in a perfect arc and bombarded the word ‘Dao’ again. “Fist Crushing.”
Fist Crushing was a physique type special ability Jiang Ming had deduced. It crushed all things.
The next moment, along with the shivering Break Dao Hall, the word ‘Dao’ showed the number of 49.
“I can’t even double its number?” Jiang Ming lost his temper. “Impossible!”
“Haha!” Gu Cheng couldn’t help but laugh. “Alas, fellow Daoist. Two Dao Force seems to be the double of One Dao Force, but it’s in fact a representative of two different levels! Forty-nine Dao Force doesn’t seem to be the double of 36 Dao Force, but the actual power exerted is more than a dozen times stronger. It means a different level would be represented by different meanings. Therefore, the Dao Force is not represented by the multiples but by level!” Gu Cheng pointed out the essence.
Jiang Ming was enlightened. He learned that it was difficult to kill existence like himself purely with power. The changes in special abilities and the evolution of power essence, etc, were the fundamental.
“Again!” With a flash shown on Jiang Ming’s forehead, his power of soul materialized and slashed against the word ‘Dao’.
Buzz... The room trembled and it showed the number 49.
“It’s not bad!” Jiang Ming nodded. It was purely the strike of his soul’s power. Jiang Ming suddenly shouted, “Again!”
This time Jiang Ming evoked the strongest soul type special ability.
Bang...
It’s another strike of Jiang Ming’s soul, and the result shown this time was the number 81. The number was not far away from a Monarch level Heavenly Demonic Beast.
Jian Wushuang was taken aback as he took a deep breath.
Meanwhile, Gu Cheng was shocked. He didn’t expect Jiang Ming to be a double cultivator. ‘To think that he’s such an ingenious, who is capable of casting such a terrifying power as soon as he’s got out of the Sea of Chaos. This is truly unbelievable because he’s broken the norm.’
In fact, the value of the Dao Force Jiang Ming had just created had surpassed the value of 90% of the members.
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, this one best represents you.” Gu Cheng gave Jiang Ming a thumbs up.
“Amazing!” Jian Wushuang exclaimed. He recalled Jiang Ming’s capability of suppressing about a dozen of Demonic Mountains effortlessly and thought it was a matter of course for Jiang Ming. After all, if Jiang Ming didn’t have such a power, he wouldn’t be able to suppress those Demonic Mountains that easily.
“Thank you!” Jiang Ming smiled. He was quite satisfied with the result.
“Would you like to try further?” Gu Cheng asked with hints of expectation.
Jiang Ming shook his head instead, “Basically it’s my best, hence it’s not worth it to try again!”
Through the testing of physique and soul power, Jiang Ming had a clearer understanding about the measurement of the Dao Force. With some calculation, he could estimate the power of his inner world.
‘It may not be up to 10,000 Dao Force, but it’s definitely 1,000 Dao Force. After digesting dozens of Heavenly Demonic Beasts and Demonic Mountains, my combat power will definitely increase exponentially again.’
‘That’s right, I still have the 49 hearts of Chaos rewarded by the System.’
Upon digesting all of them, Jiang Ming didn’t even know to what degree his personal capability would become. However, he speculated that it would be at least up to the Emperor level of the Heavenly Demonic Beast.
‘Sigh, when I think of this, I’ve seemed to become invincible. Alas, what a f*cking boring life. No, there used to be a being who surpassed the Chaos Realm. Such a surpass is obviously beyond the Dao Breaking Realm. Hence, because I’ve a long way to go, I must not be proud of myself. I need to remain low-profile instead.’
Gu Cheng didn’t try to convince Jiang Ming. After all, whether Jiang Ming hid his best self or not, Jiang Ming’s current result, which was at 81 Dao Force, had made him ecstatic. The most exciting part was that Jiang Ming was a new member of the Great Dao Alliance. Hence, Gu Cheng believed that Jiang Ming would be able to improve further after Jiang Ming had absorbed the wisdom of the alliance.
‘The future is promising, for sure it is. Haha... It’s indeed awesome.’
“Brother Jiang, let’s go, I’ll gather other fellow Daoists to hold a welcome ceremony for you. At the same time, we can discuss Daos.” As Gu Cheng said, he couldn’t help guffawing. “Moreover, it’s been a long time since our last gathering. We can also take this opportunity to have a meeting.”
Jiang Ming nodded. He felt happy with how Gu Cheng had addressed him. It was obviously an act for Gu Cheng to get closer with Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming himself was willing to get to know more experts as well. However, he frowned as he said, “Brother Gu, before I came here, the Sea of Chaos where I’m from was under the attack by the Heavenly Demonic Beasts. As far as I know, other Chaos Seas have also been attacked at the same time. Is it ignored here?”
“Sigh!” Gu Cheng sighed. “It is not that we wanted to ignore. It’s because the Great Dao Alliance is currently weak. We are aware of it when the Heavenly Demonic Beasts started launching their guerilla attacks. However, their Heavenly Demonic Beasts are mostly below the Dao Breaking Realm and there are only a few at the Dao Breaking Realm. Their invasion is a catastrophe, but it’s also a golden opportunity to evoke the potential of experts in the Sea of Chaos. If there would be more beings like you, it’d be the best as a whole.”
“As for the damage...” Gu Cheng shook his head with a helpless expression. “We can’t help it. If we were to take our move now, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts would come out in full force, and that’s the real disaster. Now, it’s equivalent to a military training state.”
Jiang Ming felt it was difficult to accept the answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 528
chapters.content:
528 Tianyan Formation Disk, The Collapse of Time
Jiang Ming had now understood that the so-called Great Dao Alliance wasn’t the rival of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts at all. Therefore, the members of the alliance could only remain hiding while furtively accumulating power.
What Gu Cheng said about the need of sacrificing numerous Sea of Chaos to train up a military team was thereby nonsense.
Not long later, all the members of the Great Dao Alliance had rushed over. There weren’t many of them, there were merely 240 of them.
There was a formation disk in the Palace of Fortune. It was called the Tianyan Formation Disk, which was left behind in ancient times. Once the members left their imprints on the formation disk, they could return easily by spending Hongmeng Coins.
Returning would use up lots of Hongmeng Coins, but it was the most costly to descend to defined places. In fact, it was 100 times more costly to places than returning. Hence, they would use it only when the alliance sensed the appearance of Dao Breaking Expert with the aim of inviting the new Dao Breaking Expert to join them. Other than this purpose, no one would use it.
The more Jiang Ming learned about the alliance, the more he respected the alliance. Although it was a lenient organization and needed resources to operate, it didn’t impose much on its members.
However, whenever members traded among themselves, they would have to pay a certain amount of Hongmeng Coins to be used as the alliance’s operating cost. All the members did it willingly because they knew that they would become stronger only with the support of the organization.
None of them would escape even when they had to face the Heavenly Demonic Beasts. It was because they clearly understood that if the Dao Great Alliance was to be done for, they wouldn’t survive long as well.
Therefore, the Great Dao Alliance was an organization which appeared to be lenient, but the members were all united.
Nevertheless, Jiang Ming felt rather a headache because this alliance was not of a great help to him. It was truly useless to him because he didn’t need trading nor did he need any techniques, special abilities and experience. Moreover, he didn’t really need support from others during the war.
‘Fortunately, there’s a good benefit that I can gain from this alliance. It’s the corpses of those Heavenly Demonic Beasts!’ Jiang Ming, however, didn’t voice out his thoughts because he didn’t think it was the right time for him to do so yet.
This gathering lasted for three months. After the meeting, some left while some cultivated in retreat. There were also some members who had left to hunt down weaker Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Jiang Ming left after he left an imprint on the Tianyan Formation Disk. After he had left, Jiang Ming turned to look at the Palace of Fortune from a distance. It was an extremely enormous palace akin to the size of a great chiliocosm. While revolving in the void, it extracted the endless power of the void.
With a swipe in the air to cut the space, Jiang Ming leaped into the land of nothingness.
Such was the way to enter the land of nothingness. It seemed both easy and difficult because one would have to achieve the standard of One Dao Force.
Jiang Ming didn’t rush back. Instead, he carefully observed and felt the condition of the land of nothingness.
It wasn’t anything at all in the land of nothingness. There wasn’t any material nor laws. In fact, materials such as Chaos Supreme Treasures could be present but they would be consumed by an inexplicable power along with time, leaving not a trace behind.
‘This is the power of nothingness, the power of void and the power of emptiness!’ Jiang Ming recalled the words of Gu Cheng and felt that it was reasonable.
Following that, Jiang Ming swiped, cracking the void and streams of violet light flew out from within. As soon as he grabbed it, he oscillated, and it was refined into Hongmeng coins.
In just a blink of an eye, there were already a couple of Hongmeng Coins in Jiang Ming’s hands.
‘One Hongmeng coin is enough to build the foundation of a Saint!’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile. ‘From now onwards, I can bless whoever I want to become a Saint.’
As Jiang Ming was thinking, he evoked the World Projection. Laws run through it while oscillating and twisting, forming an absolute tide of power. In an instant, void cracks appeared in a radius of ten thousand miles, and a large number of violet lights descended from it.
As Jiang Ming kept mobilizing his consciousness, he continuously was refining those violet lights. It could be seen that Hongmeng Coins were falling down like heavy rain. If Gu Cheng was to see such a scene, he definitely would be surprised.
‘They seem a lot, but not useful for me anyway!’ Jiang Ming shook his head and decided to stop refining the Hongmeng Coins. He was good with only having some of them because he didn’t feel worthy to refine more. He thought he might as well slaughter those Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Jiang Ming stopped after he had spent a day and accumulated a small mountain of Hongmeng Coins.
Following that, Jiang Ming called out his Human Path Record to return to his Sea of Chaos. But he stopped because of an idea that popped out in his mind.
The World Projection reappeared, this time it neither focused on anything nor shrank. Jiang Ming could exert greater power with a smaller projection range. However, Jiang Ming blurred the projection so that the projection range swiftly expanded out.
It expanded out to a light year, 100 light years, 10,000 light years and 100 million light years before it finally stopped expanding.
‘It’s difficult to teleport in the land of nothingness, let alone to make a big shift. I wonder if this method works!’ As Jiang Ming thought, he had his spatial law run through the projection and disappeared with a flutter. Upon reappearance, he was a light year away.
‘With the projection, I can actually teleport myself. It’s just that the resistance is too terrifying.’ Jiang Ming was surprised.
The distance of a light year was too short. When Jiang Ming shrank the projection range of the World Projection, the power gathered was gradually strengthened.
For a couple of times Jiang Ming had experimented, he finally discovered the furthest distance he could teleport. It was 1,000 light years.
‘It’s still too short. It’s not so useful since the land of nothingness is too enormous!’ Jiang Ming shook his head rather helplessly.
If Gu Cheng was to learn about Jiang Ming’s ability of teleporting in the land of nothingness up to a distance of 1,000 light years, Gu Cheng would definitely be stunned. It was in fact, an impossible miracle. Yet, Jiang Ming was dissatisfied.
‘I’m still too weak indeed. I think when I become stronger after I finish digesting those Heavenly Demonic Beasts and 49 hearts of Chaos, I should be able to teleport a trillion light years away at a time. And this distance would be just nice!’ As Jiang Ming thought, he called out the Human Path Record and returned to the Chuyang Peak.
‘I wonder which level is this Human Path Record?’ Even now, Jiang Ming still couldn’t manage to speculate the Record’s level. It was obviously beyond the range of the Dao Breaking Realm.
“Senior brother!” As soon as Linglong saw Jiang Ming’s return, she lunged herself into Jiang Ming’s embrace and replaced her worries with happiness.
Jiang Ming put away his avatar and patted on Linglong’s back. “No worries.”
“Senior brother, can you tell me now what’s actually happening?” Linglong raised her face towards Jiang Ming.
Jiang Ming gave her a kiss and told Linglong everything about the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, land of nothingness, the Great Dao Alliance and the likes without holding back.
“What...” Linglong was stunned. “The Great Dao Alliance? Even the Dao Patriarchs are not qualified to be the member? Yet the alliance is still being pinned down by the Heavenly Demonic Beasts? Senior brother, that’s why you have been worried all these while. It turns out that there is such a horrifying power of evil out there.”
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming also exclaimed. “I thought a Dao Patriarch is the strongest. But it seems that a Dao Patriarch can dominate within the Sea of Chaos only.”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smirk as he said so.
“I wonder what would those Dao Patriarchs think when they learn about it?” Linglong chuckled. Following that, she unbuttoned Jiang Ming’s clothes. “Senior brother, in this case, I’m even weaker now. Let’s have an intimate communication so that you can help me to sanctify my Dao.”
Jiang Ming, “...”
The duo began to do what Linglong had just requested. However, Jiang Ming realized one thing that made him feel extremely bad.
The time reversed space could no longer carry his power and collapsed. The greater the number of times of the time reversed, the more difficult it was for him to maintain.
‘Is this the disadvantage?’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but whimper.
It was at this moment that Jiang Ming recalled the advantages of the exclusive cultivation space within the Supreme Pagoda.
After Jiang Ming had enjoyed the intimacy with Linglong, he went into the depth of the Sea of Chaos because he wanted to cultivate quietly for some time.
As for cultivating in the Chuyang Peak? Jiang Ming was afraid that the aura he accidentally leaked out would lead to the destruction of the entire Tianyuan Realm. Even though he could support the barrier he formed continuously, he didn’t dare to take the risk.
In the depth of the Sea of Chaos, Jiang Ming arranged for a great formation for time reverse. The formation was to accelerate the time by 10,000 times only. If Jiang Ming were to make it faster, the power of the time would be contorted and collapsed.
‘The life of creation within me is so strong that even Time Laws would collapse!’ Jiang Ming had no other alternative to further accelerating the time. ‘I wonder how far I can achieve from this cultivation?’ As Jiang Ming thought, he started his retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 529
chapters.content:
529 1,800 Chaos Laws
The Heavenly Demonic Beasts were still on a rampage. It was still fortunate that their rate of rampage was not particularly high as it was still quite difficult to look for a Sea of Chaos. If they really wanted to destroy all 3,000 Sea of Chaos, it would be many years later.
In reality, there were far fewer Heavenly Demonic Beasts which were beyond the Dao Patriarch Realm than one might think. This was also the reason why the Great Dao Alliance managed to barely fight back against them.
When the Heavenly Demonic Beasts attack, the Great Dao Alliance would harass and assassinate them. Such a tug-of-war relation had furtively formed.
It seemed that such a situation had been going on since the distant past. As long as one side still remained standing, there was no possibility of peace and tranquility.
On one of the corners of the Primordial Demon Abyss, there was an incomparably huge Demon Palace where a purple figure could be seen sitting on the supreme throne. The figure was radiating a terrifying aura that could whizz through the Chaos and annihilate all things.
As the purple figure looked through the area, the void was distorted.
“Still no news?” His sound rumbled. Just the sound of him could jolt a Saint to death to the point that their soul would be decimated completely.
“My King, there’s yet to be any news so far!” A three headed being that was as pale as a sheet was prostrated on the ground. “The direction that His Highness went forth, had been searched and there’s yet to be any responses received.”
“I can feel that he is still alive. However, I cannot contact him. Could it be that he is imprisoned by the Great Dao Alliance?” The King muttered. Just as he was pondering over the matter, he abruptly stood up. Overwhelming power surged out from his body like a mountain-sized tsunami, forming boundless luminance that completely destroyed the whole palace and turned countless maids serving him into smoke.
Even the three-headed old man was sent flying 100,000 miles away. Although he was of the Dao Patriarch Realm, one of his heads had exploded and his aura was extremely weakened.
Slightly stabilizing himself, the three-headed old man omitted his own injuries and prostrated himself onto the ground again, trembling in fear.
“It was just now that I’ve sensed the complete death of my son through the sensory of my bloodline. Haha! The one who can even kill my son is none other than the Great Dao Alliance; the one who even dares to do so is also none other than the Great Dao Alliance!”
“Great Dao Alliance... Good...Very good!”
“The one who dared to kill my son? You’re very good!”
The king was abnormally furious.
“In that case, I’ll be sending out all that I command and sweep through the entire Sea of Chaos! I don’t believe that you, as the Great Dao Alliance, will still cower away from this!”
“Three-headed! Heed my orders! All hands on deck!”
“Go all out! Leave none behind!”
The King let out a furious roar.
It wasn’t a day’s work to command an entire body of his demons to move out. Breaking through the Abyss and entering the land of nothingness wasn’t as easy as one might have thought. To find a single Sea of Chaos amongst the land of nothingness was even more difficult.
However, time poses no meaning to the experts of such level. Be it thousands, ten thousand or even a billion years, the difference wasn’t really that big to them. After all, the time taken for them to improve their cultivation realm, would be counted in the trillions.
...
Back in the Sea of Chaos, before Jiang Ming truly started his seclusion, he gave a heart of Chaos to his World Tree.
Based on his speculation, the World Tree’s combat power had long since reached the Dao Breaking Realm. It was just that it hadn’t entered the land of nothingness and hadn’t been detected by the Great Dao Alliance just yet.
For now, it was still silently improving its strength.
“If it manages to refine a whole heart of the Chaos, and later devour an entire Sea of Chaos, it will be truly remarkable. I wonder how far it will be able to grow.”
Jiang Ming was very much looking forward to this.
He then went on with his deep retreat into seclusion.
Time went by. The river of destiny remained vast and unstoppable by anyone. Even experts of the Dao Breaking Realm couldn’t reverse the flow of destiny. When there was partial reversal of destiny, it would still be washed down by the flood of time and continue moving forward.
...
Back in Chuyang Peak, Linglong also retreated into seclusion from time to time. She was mainly enlightening with special abilities to allow her battle body to improve and to allow her mind to merge with heavens and earth, feeling the Chaos Law. She was hoping to rely on her own power to break through the shackles and advance into the Chaos Realm.
However, it was just way too difficult.
On top of Tianyuan Realm, the 49 stars were still suspended above as though they were really revolving like real stars.
From time to time, there were people who had great encounters within, allowing their cultivation realm to soar and went on with sanctifying their Dao on the path of cultivation.
Saint Experts were budding like mushrooms after a heavy downpour.
All ten of Jiang Ming’s disciples had long sanctified the path of Dao. However, they did not come out of their seclusion and continued cultivating in the cultivational space that Jiang Ming deliberately created for them. All of them were progressing at a speed far beyond imagination.
On this day, Gu Hai had sanctified the Saint Realm.
“Hahaha! Never would I have thought an old man like me would also come to this step! Alas! The Saints!”
After a great laugh of joy, Gu Hai’s face was full of tears.
“Gu, why are you crying? This is a great joyous occasion!” In the midst of envy, the Sect Master couldn’t help but tease Gu Hai.
The other First Seats went forth one after another to congratulate Gu Hai.
First Seat Ming Yue was even more happy. Not only was Gu Hai her senior brother, but he was also her husband.
“Alas!” Gu Hai lamented inexplicably. “When I look back into the past now, who would’ve thought that there would come a day when I sanctify the path of Dao? Back in the planar world, our Jiuyang Sect was but only a second-rated sect. However, it has only been a few dozens of years’ time and we’ve managed to come to such a point of standing at the peak of the Infinite Realms. Even a mediocre person such as myself has sanctified the path of Dao. Whenever I think back on this, it still feels unbelievable.”
“We are all here getting pumped up from a single person who is so blessed!” First Seat of Lieyang Peak guffawed. “Senior Brother Gu, this is because you are being blessed by the Dao Patriarch of Soul!”
“Well, I’m happy, honored, proud and happily pat my chest to yell out loud that who can even nurture a disciple into a Dao Patriarch? Haha! Who can? There’s absolutely no one who can compare to me on this!” Gu Hai couldn’t help but show his sense of pride. “I’m the only one throughout the infinite realms in this regard!”
The Sect Master and other Head Disciples were all rendered speechless. What followed was a boundless sense of admiration.
It was right! Who would’ve thought that Gu Hai, who had just sanctified the path of Dao and even did that by relying on his own disciple, managed to nurture a Dao Patriarch.
Not only Gu Hai felt that his achievement today was so unreal like a dream, but the rest also felt the same. When they look back into the past and reminisce about their journey, they couldn’t help feeling that it was all so magical.
...
Back in Chuyang Peak, Linglong looked over at their direction and couldn’t help but smile. After all, Gu Hai was her own master. Since Gu Hai had sanctified the path of Dao, it was something deserving of celebration.
‘I wonder when my senior brother will come out of his seclusion. I really miss the extreme feeling of ten trillion avatars going at it.’
When she thought about the ridiculous things that they had done, she couldn’t help but blush a little.
In just a blink of an eye, ten thousand years’ time flowed by.
In the eyes of the beings of the Chaos Primordial Land however, there seemed to be no other major events happening other than the catastrophe during the opening of the Dao Domain of Patriarch ten thousand years ago.
Even that had quickly sunk in silence through the test of time.
After all, life and death were all too common to cultivators. They were just wondering what kind of experts were behind the end back then, to the point that even Dao Patriarch Experts were tight-lipped about it. It was very odd.
...
Boom... In the depth of the Chaos, a great array formation had exploded, giving off a deafening bang.
This time reversal array formation was the one that Jiang Ming had deliberately set up to host himself within and was now completely destroyed.
Jiang Ming could be seen walking out of it as well.
“Time passes by just in a snap of a finger. I never thought I would be out of the seclusion so soon this time.” Jiang Ming lamented to himself.
Jiang Ming originally thought that this seclusion of his would be for at least a whole trillion years. How long had it just been instead?
‘As my cultivation continues to improve, my inner world has continued to grow as well. My speed of refining the Heavenly Demonic Beast and the heart of Chaos has also become faster and faster.’
This was the real key towards how short Jiang Ming’s cultivation retreat was.
Now that the many Heavenly Demonic Beasts and heart of Chaos had all been digested, Jiang Ming’s inner world had already expanded to an unimaginable level. Jiang Ming estimated that his inner world was now even more vast than the current Sea of Chaos where he was today. This was a little unbelievable. Even he himself found it hard to believe.
What was even more incredible was that his inner world hadn’t even fully produced the 3,000 Chaos Laws yet. At this point,there were only 1,800 of them.
‘It seems that my inner world is abnormal. Its vastness has exceeded the vastness of the current Sea of Chaos and yet hasn’t entered its mature state.’
This was very bizarre.
‘Oh well. It’s my power anyways. It’s just that it will be more difficult to continue improving in the future.’
Jiang Ming shook his head. However, this was also something that couldn’t be helped with. After all, the stronger he became, the better the effect would be when he was refining Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
From now on, there wouldn’t be any rewards from the System anymore. He would basically have to rely on his own.
‘I wonder what my battle power has become by now. It shouldn’t be a problem for me to beat up an Emperor-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast now, right? If a single punch doesn’t do it, two punches should suffice!’
As Jiang Ming pondered on this, he wanted to try and experiment on this. However, when he saw the Sea of Chaos in front of him, he immediately dismissed such thought.
He had no doubt that a single punch by him would punch through the entire Sea of Chaos here. Even the Chaos Origin would’ve been completely annihilated.
Raising his arms and swiping through the air, he tore open a rift and plunged himself into it. As he just arrived at the land of nothingness, he could see an immense and incomparably huge Demonic Mountain appearing in front of him.
The divine aura from the mountain was so immense, radiating throughout every direction.
“Good lord. Is this a special greeting for me after knowing that I’ve come out of seclusion?”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but burst into laughter. This was just what he was looking for and it fell into his lap.
Heavenly Demonic Beasts? They were just right for him to practice a little. There was absolutely nothing more suitable for Jiang Ming’s practice than the beasts.
