chapters.title: Chapter 530
chapters.content:
530 Gosh! I’m Really Invincible Now!
Right after finishing his cultivation retreat, Jiang Ming stepped into the land of nothingness. Never could he have imagined that just as he was ready to test how far his combat power had improved, he stumbled upon an army of Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Good lord! This mountain was so enormous! It was at least 300 billion feet high, spewing boundless violet luminance and emitting power fluctuation across the horizon. This was definitely a supreme treasure.
Jiang Ming also noticed that there were many small hills attached to this huge mountain. On each and every one of these hills, there were great numbers of experts and quite a handful of Dao Patriarch Experts as well.
Jiang Ming focused his gaze, allowing his divine eyes to peer through the void, piercing through any obstacles and swept through the entire violet mountain with just a glance.
“Good lord! There’s a whole 108 Dao Patriarch leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts! There’s even an existence that transcends the Dao Patriarch’s Dao Breaking Realm! These aren’t the feeble pawns! Haha! Now this is interesting!”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help himself from bursting into laughter.
Seemingly sensing his prying eyes, the violet mountain trembled and an enormous phantom manifested on it. The phantom seemed like a demon with the sky above its head and its feet stepping the earth.
“Human? There’s no Chaos channel nearby yet you actually appeared here. Did you break through the barriers of the Sea of Chaos with your supreme strength? Or are you a member of the Great Dao Alliance? Either way, you are definitely an excellent prey!”
The voice of the violet phantom rumbled, with the feeling of condescension of someone who was high and above, hunting on mere rodents.
“Prey?” Jiang Ming laughed as well.
He evoked the Human Path Record and checked on the opposing party’s information.
Name: Violet Ghost.
God damn! This name was really something.
Born in the Primordial Demon Abyss, the Violet Ghost rose from the Devouring Clan and gradually took over a whole territory, claiming hegemony. Through countless life and death tribulations, it was at the pinnacle stage of the Dao Patriarch Realm and managed to fuse its blood essence with boundless Qi of killing to give birth to a son named Violet Kill.
The Violet Ghost later advanced into the Dao Breaking Realm, allowing its bloodline to sublimate into the King. The Violet Ghost became a small tycoon of the Primordial Demon Abyss, dominating its kingdom and enslaving thousands.
The Violet Ghost later reshaped its son through its blood essence, aiding its son to condense into the King Bloodline, forging concrete foundation onto its path of cultivation.
‘Why is there so little information? Something must be wrong!’
There wasn’t any revelation of the origin of the Abyss nor was there information on the situation there.
‘I hope I’m not overthinking this!’
Jiang Ming wasn’t sure of anything by then. However, he also discovered several problems as well.
For example, advancing into the Dao Breaking Realm would automatically allow the Heavenly Demonic Beast to become a member of the King Clan. The bloodline would also become the King Bloodline.
This made it apparent that there weren’t any rankings among the Primordial Demon Abyss.
As long as the Heavenly Demonic Beast was strong enough, it could become the King, Monarch and Emperor. It didn’t matter if that beast was a human or a ghost.
‘This seems kind of fair in the midst of Chaos!’
In just a split second of thought, there were countless ideas forming in Jiang Ming’s mind.
Jiang Ming gathered his many thoughts and looked at Violet Ghost with a smile. “Do you have a son named Violet Kill?”
“You know of my son!” Violet Ghost was greatly shocked. Its voice even resounded through the boundless land of nothingness. As it fixed its gaze onto Jiang Ming, its murderous intent was spewing out, whistling through the heavens and earth. “You killed my son! Good! Very Good! If I can’t suppress you here today, I won’t even be worthy as the noblest Heavenly Demonic Beast!”
“After sending away your son, I’ll send you on your merry way as well, just in time for the two of you to reunite. Just look at how thoughtful and humane my service is.” As Jiang Ming said so, his body swayed and grew into a trillion feet high. “You’re here for revenge, right? Come, come, come! Let’s get down to a great battle!”
“You’re courting death!” Sensing the disdain from Jiang Ming, Violet Ghost stepped out of the mountain and confronted Jiang Ming. Without saying another word, it went off with a punch.
Rumble! The explosion even echoed through the land of nothingness. The incomparably robust space was twisting and crackling.
That punch had reached the strength of an appalling level.
“Now this is interesting!” Jiang Ming wasn’t afraid in the slightest, but was eager to try himself. Instead, Jiang Ming leaped forward, gathering the pure power of his physique and launched a punch at Violet Ghost in return.
This punch of Jiang Ming was even more terrifying. Even sky-splitting or the universe-annihilating couldn’t describe its horror.
Jiang Ming’s strength had brought many to the point of despair. Even Violet Ghost’s expression changed greatly.
Rumble! As the two fists clashed, it didn’t set off boundless torrents as expected, but a lopsided rampage.
Violet Ghost’s fist exploded almost immediately, followed by his arms, shoulders and even his whole body. It abruptly exploded into a cloud of bloody mist.
“That’s all?” Jiang Ming shrugged his fist off and had a bizarre look on his face.
“Am I too strong or are you too worthless of a waste? King bloodline? More like a garbage bloodline!”
Jiang Ming looked at the writhing blood mist of Violet Ghost which was rapidly recovering, but didn’t give chase. Instead, he shook his head with extreme dissatisfaction.
“Impossible!” Violet Ghost had almost fully recovered himself. Only its aura was slightly weaker than before. However, it had an ugly expression on its face, seemingly unable to believe such a result of their clash. “I’m at the pinnacle of the King Bloodline! A supreme King with immortal physique! Coupled with our powers that restrain your race, it would be impossible for you to lay a hair on me without the strength of more than ten times over. You actually... You actually beat me into a pulp with just one punch? How is this possible?”
“You’re just too weak!” Jiang Ming said reluctantly, “From that punch I just threw at you just now, I’ve only used a third of my strength. Moreover, it was purely the power of my physique. Violet Ghost, could it be that you haven’t had your meals?”
“Damn you!” Violet Ghost was extremely furious.
‘Haven’t eaten? Damn it! This is the greatest insult for me.’
“Mountain, Come!”
As Violet Ghost let out a whistle, the whole immeasurably huge mountain range behind abruptly turned into a stream of luminance that merged with its body. This allowed its power to rapidly sky-rocket. Besides, its physique also grew, directly rising to the extent of a light year tall.
“Comparing heights now, are we?” With just a slight sway of his body, Jiang Ming’s size skyrocketed and actually reached a height of ten light years. He then stomped onto Violet Ghost, causing all the integration of mountains in its body to be exploded throughout, forming a terrifying torrent instead.
“These shouldn’t go to waste!”
As Jiang Ming’s World Projection appeared, it swept through the air, taking in every wisp of power within. After refining these, even his current state of inner world would be able to improve by quite a bit.
There were too many Dao Patriarch leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts after all. As for those of the Saint Realm, they were as abundant as the hairs on a cattle.
This was truly a blessing to Jiang Ming.
“You, you, you!” When Violet Ghost recovered itself once again, he merely looked at Jiang Ming with a gaze filled with fear. By now, how could Violet Ghost still not understand that it wasn’t because it wasn’t strong, but the fact that Jiang Ming was too terrifying. In fact, the Violet Ghost had never felt such a terrifying threat on its life from even the supreme Emperors before.
“Who the hell are you?” Violet Ghost roared angrily, immediately turning into a stream of luminance and sped away to escape from Jiang Ming.
With his speed, a snap of a finger was enough for Violet Ghost to escape through hundreds of millions of years away. However, as fast as Violet Ghost was, it was no faster than Jiang Ming’s World Projection. The technique directly enveloped Violet Ghost within, imprisoning it on the spot.
Violet Ghost tried to struggle through and distort the power of protection but still couldn’t escape from it. Its struggle became more futile by the second and was finally completely imprisoned.
“It seems that the World Projection is finally something worthy now!” Jiang Ming was extremely satisfied. With a smile on his face, he arrived in front of Violet Ghost and asked, “Do you want to live?”
“Live?” Violet Ghost sneered. “For us, life is death and vice versa. Who even cares about life and death? Why? You’re thinking of torturing me to leak about our internal affairs? Haha! Feeble ants of the Sea of Chaos, feel free to try. Even with the eighty million torture device of you Great Dao Alliance, see if I’m afraid.”
“It seems you’re a true man of iron blood!” Jiang Ming caressed his chin as his gaze became colder and colder.

chapters.title: Chapter 531
chapters.content:
531 Return Quickly, Brother Jiang
Jiang Ming had long discovered one thing. Perhaps the Heavenly Demonic Beasts were really not afraid of death to begin with.
“So be it. If you’re not afraid of death, then die!”
Jiang Ming didn’t pleasure from torturing either way. He directly suppressed Violet Ghost within his inner world and rapidly grind and refined it, turning it into a source of sustenance in the expansion of his inner Chaos world. There were also the other Heavenly Demonic Beast Army that Violet Ghost had brought along with it.
From this group of Heavenly Demonic Beasts, the blessings Jiang Ming had obtained were comparable to one or two hearts of Chaos already.
As Jiang Ming scanned through his surroundings, there was just plain nothingness. Lifting his head high, there wasn’t anything there either. This really wasn’t a place that anyone would like to stay in.
With just a thought in Jiang Ming’s mind, his inner world projection reappeared. With a slight tremble, it caused the space of void to become twisted and cracked, followed by waves after waves of suction force. At the very next moment, purple luminance could be seen swarming over like a waterfall.
As vast as the surrounding was and as far the eyes could reach, all direction was filled with streams of purple luminance. The range was as wide as ten thousand square miles, completely filled with purple luminance, forming a sea of purple luminance. This purple luminance was Hongmeng Qi, which was then refined into Hongmeng Coins.
At this moment, Jiang Ming was surrounded by a complete ocean of Hongmeng Coins.
In just a snap of a finger, a mountain of coins was formed.
‘In just a year and a half, I’ll definitely become the richest person of this land of nothingness.’ Jiang Ming couldn’t help but smile as he thought about this to himself.
It was really because his speed of condensing Hongmeng Coins was far too rapid. Even if Gu Cheng was here, he would’ve been in shock and disbelief.
Of course, Jiang Ming hadn’t exerted his full strength yet. Jiang Ming wasn’t in a hurry to leave as well. Instead, he gave his full hand in evoking his World Projection, frantically condensing the Hongmeng Coins.
A few days later, it became boring and uninteresting to him. Jiang Ming threw a punch forward, directly blowing up a black hole in front of him.
To think that a black hole was struck open from this land of nothingness where even the Dao Patriarch wouldn’t be capable of trembling it the slightest. The black hole expanded into the boundless distance.
When Jiang Ming set gaze within the black hole, he inexplicably felt great fear as well as a feeling of closeness from within. It was extremely bizarre. Even with his special abilities, he couldn’t make out what existed within the black hole.
“It’s the unknown that’s the most frightening!” Jiang Ming sighed.
To think that at this point in his life, there were still some places that he couldn’t peer into. He shook his head and watched the black hole heal rapidly. Later on, he raised his hand and split a spatial channel directly based on his senses, connecting the place to the inside of the Sea of Chaos.
He then dove in headfirst.
...
Back at Chuyang Peak.
“Senior Brother!” The moment Linglong saw Jiang Ming appearing, she rubbed her eyes and pounced forth with a piquant cry. She jumped directly onto Jiang Ming, with her legs clamping onto his waist.
“I really missed you!” She wrapped both her hands around Jiang Ming’s neck and hugged him tight.
“If I was any weaker, my neck would’ve been broken by you already.” Jiang Ming smiled as he patted on her butt. “It’s only been a mere ten thousand years here and you miss me that much, little girl?”
“The moment you left, I’ve thought about you to the length of 300 billion trillion light years, let alone 10,000 years. Just thinking about you made me old!” Linglong pouted. “Look, I even have wrinkles on my face already.”
“Do you want to wipe them with essence? It will absolutely make your wrinkles disappear and make you a million years younger.”
“Senior brother, it’s too wasteful to smear them on my face.”
“Haha...”
Jiang Ming couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this.
It was such a rare occasion that they didn’t go for exercise this time, but instead laid down on the rocking chair and swayed leisurely, whispering to each other.
“Senior brother, do you think that if this goes on for ten years, hundred years, ten thousand years or even a billion years, will you get tired of it? Will you feel bored? Will you gradually feel indifferent?” Linglong laid on top of Jiang Ming as she whispered, “Our speed of sanctifying the path of Dao is way too fast. Although there are times where we reverse time, it would also be for cultivation purposes. Nowadays, we’ve reached a certain level of cultivation where further improvement would be extremely difficult and time consuming. When you think about it sometimes, to repeat this day after day, years after years really withers one’s interest and extinguishes the passion. Such thoughts really bring chills down my spine.”
“Will there be such a day?” Jiang Ming wasn’t even confident in himself.
He had been in cultivation seclusion for a long time before. Even if it was just cultivation, under the boundless flood of time, it had also fragmented his memory, and he gradually became indifferent like an emotionless rock.
Another example would be the exercise with his junior sister. As time passed by, it really became tedious and dull. Even if there were three thousand trillion incarnations doing it together, Jiang Ming was afraid that he would gradually lose such joy as well.
As for their daily life? One year would be fine, ten years would be alright, a hundred years would be normal, but what of ten thousand years, billion years and even trillion years?
Time was the most relentless of all. It could tear down any trials into pieces.
“This won’t happen to us. Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming hugged onto his junior sister tightly instead. “I’m at the Supreme Chaos Realm and absolutely capable of maintaining my state of mind, never-changing. Little girl, I’m afraid you’ll be the one changing!”
“If my heart changes, you can just suppress me directly!” Linglong suddenly laughed. “Besides, I’ve got nine other clones as well. Although they are of the same core, they have very different personalities. Perhaps this can also be used as a seasoning of life. What if we take in Xi Yao as well? The love between a disciple and the master. Tsk, tsk, tsk! It will absolutely be exciting!”
“What’s going on in your head all day?” Jiang Ming was speechless. “It’s better for you to cultivate and advance into the Dao Patriarch Realm as soon as possible so that I can be rest assured.”
“Alas, stepping into the Dao Patriarch Realm. Will I be able to withstand your power then?”
“Haha! You probably could!”
Just the thought of such wonders cause Jiang Ming to laugh out inexplicably.
As they continued chatting and laughing around, Jiang Ming suddenly asked, “How about we continue on our previous journey? This time, we’ll only be using our two feet and no other special abilities.”
“Sure!” Linglong cheered. “I’ve wanted to for a long time, but was afraid of affecting your time. Senior Brother, how long will it be this time?”
“As long as it takes!”
“For real?”
“As real as your treasure!”
“You’re nasty!”
The two of them took off into the air and left for their journey.
Jiang Ming left an avatar on the Chuyang Peak. His avatar often met up with Chang Yiming, visited his master Gu Hai, chatted with Mountain Master Tian Yuan and looked for Riyue Changfeng to enjoy some tea. He even gathered with Dongfang Chenxi and the likes ever so often. Being with them felt the most relaxed to him.
Anyways, his avatar didn’t have much free time as well.
He also used the many Hongmeng Coins that Jiang Ming condensed to bestow countless blessings, allowing all of the beings of Tianyuan Realm to rapidly soar in their cultivation realm.
The Chaos Primordial Land was very vast, extremely boundless at that.
Jiang Ming and Linglong blocked off their special ability of being able to see through the entire world with just a glance. The two of them were like the ordinary Great Overarching Golden Immortal Experts, traveling through this immeasurable land on foot, witnessing the beauty of the world.
One year, ten years, one hundred years, one thousand years, ten thousand years passed...
There were landscapes everywhere as well as delicacies in every corner of the world.
When they got tired of walking, the sky was their blanket and the earth was their bed. The two of them hugged each other snoozing away. Sometimes, they would sleep for hundreds of years before waking up and continuing on their journey.
Such days were of utmost leisure to them. They were free of any worries. They enjoyed the sceneries of the world, tasted the delicacies of the infinite races and witnessed the strange events of the worlds as well.
On this day, there was a slight hunch in Jiang Ming’s mind and a golden tablet suddenly appeared in front of him. Trembling slightly, a message from Gu Cheng was transmitted to him.
When he left the Great Dao Alliance back then, they exchanged methods of contact and relied on the Tianyuan Formation Disk to transmit messages across.
Gu Cheng, “Brother Jiang, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts are going on a large-scale invasion. They have gotten close to our Palace of Fortune. They seem to have locked on to our position. Once the Palace of Fortune is besieged, all beings will fall before them. Return quickly, brother Jiang!”

chapters.title: Chapter 532
chapters.content:
532 Jiang Ming’s Terrifying Improvement, Annihilated With Just A Snap of A Finger
Time flowed by and it had already been 300,000,000 years since their journey began.
“Senior brother, did something happen?” Linglong nestled in Jiang Ming’s arms. Her soft voice was soft, as she peeled the outer skin of a seven-colored grape and delivered it into her senior brother’s mouth.
“As I told you before, the territory beyond the Sea of Chaos remains vast and boundless. There are other Sea of Chaos as well.” Jiang Ming chewed on the grapes and said, “There is an organization that runs through all of the Seas of Chaos, has been silently keeping order and fighting against our common enemy, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts. I don’t know what the reason is, but it seems that the headquarters of the Great Dao Alliance has been discovered and is currently under attack. I received a message from them asking me to go and support them.”
“Huh, this grape tastes good. Although it’s not as good as yours, it’s quite hard to reach your level anyways.” Jiang Ming’s eyes lit up, as he carefully tasted the grapes again. “The milk flavor is very intense.”
“How many years have you been eating for? Haven’t you had enough yet?” Linglong rolled her eyes, then worriedly and hurriedly asked, “Are you going? Will it be too dangerous?”
“Don’t worry!” Jiang Ming smiled. “With my current strength, I can effortlessly kill a little Dao Patriarch like you with just a finger of mine. If we look through every Sea of Chaos, there might not even exist anyone who can be compared to your senior brother.”
“Really?” Linglong was slightly relieved. After all, she had experienced the impact of the torrents before. She was also aware of her senior brother’s nature of being cautious as the best route. She knew he wouldn’t involve himself in dangerous matters if possible. Therefore, since he had said so, there was basically no danger to him.
“Of course!” Jiang Ming nodded, but sighed and said, “It’s such a shame though. This trip is still far from over. We haven’t even wandered a tenth of the Chaos Primordial Land, yet I can’t refuse going over to support them. Girl, should I leave an avatar to accompany you on your journey, or will you be returning to Chuyang Peak?”
“Let’s return to Chuyang Peak first. Our trip has been long enough this time.” Linglong said, “I’ll also go back to see our master and meet my many old friends. We’ll continue on our journey when you return!”
“Alright!” With a flip of his sleeve, the whole sky of stars seemed to have shifted and the two of them returned to Chuyang Peak.
Even though 300,000 years had passed, nothing had changed here. The only thing was that the beings within the Tianyuan Realm had increased in strength tremendously.
Among Jiang Ming’s disciples, one of them had actually advanced into the Lord Saint Realm, who was none other than Fengyun Wuji.
Xi Yao wasn’t too shabby either. After refining the many resources provided by Jiang Ming, she had already reached the pinnacle stage of the King Saint Realm.
Even the Sect Master of Jiuyang Sect and the other First Seats had basically advanced into the Saint Realm already.
All in all, the Tianyuan Realm had been thriving. The place had already started to portray the appearance that a Sacred Land should have.
Furthermore, Linglong had already advanced into the Dao Patriarch Realm herself. Under Jiang Ming’s comprehensive nourishment, whether it was her physique, her soul, or even her enlightenment of the Chaos Laws, she had a comprehensive improvement and all three aspects had sanctified the path of Dao.
Also, the other nine clones of Linglong had also advanced into the Chaos Realm. In fact, apart from Jiang Ming, the strongest amongst all would be none other than Linglong.
“I’ll be right back. You can just stay here at peace!” Jiang Ming’s figure disappeared, and arrived in the land of nothingness the very next second.
There was no sound, nor did his arrival trigger a vibration of the Sea of Chaos’ fetal membrane. Jiang Ming didn’t even rely on the Human Path Record to project himself over.
If Gu Cheng were to have witnessed such an ability of Jiang Ming, he would definitely be shocked and his Heart of Dao would collapse.
“Alas, the land of nothingness!” Jiang Ming stood unmoving, sighing to himself. As he focused his gaze, the pair of divine eyes burst out divine luminance, directly piercing through the incomparably solid space of the land of nothingness.
How terrifying was Jiang Ming? He could kill even a Heavenly Demonic Beast of the Dao Patriarch Realm with just a glance. This was his achievement over 300,000,000 years.
Although Jiang Ming hadn’t been reversing time for his cultivation practice, refining the army of Violet Ghost, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, had allowed his cultivation realm to sky-rocket at an even more terrifying speed. The Chaos Law of his inner world evolved so fast, that it was a billion times faster than it initially was.
His inner world continued expanding and the laws within kept evolving. The evolution was getting faster and faster while he himself became stronger and stronger.
By now, his inner world had already produced 2,400 Chaos Laws while the Dao seeds of the remaining 600 had already been nurtured. They just had to grow and become mature.
Since Jiang Ming had already fully mastered these Laws and also the fact that he had the experience of fusing 3,000 laws, he was even more comfortable fusing the Dao now.
Even without evoking special abilities, he had also mastered a series of terrifyingly powerful supreme Sacred Techniques.
‘The land of nothingness isn’t a place of total emptiness... Take for example...’
As Jiang Ming raised his fingers and plucked gently in the void, it was as if the lawless land of nothingness started a ripple.
‘This should be the Laws of the land of nothingness!’
Jiang Ming smiled to himself. At this point, it was true that the infinite laws were within his eyes and the infinite objects were in his heart.
When one’s power had reached a certain level, everything throughout the veils of the world would be unveiled rapidly in front of him.
Jiang Ming couldn’t sense them before because he hadn’t reached that level quite yet back then. Now however...With a slight movement of his body, Jiang Ming suddenly disappeared. When he reappeared, he had already traveled a span of three trillion light-years.
This was the Great Displacement Technique. It was an incredibly terrifying technique at that.
Soon, Jiang Ming arrived in the area. This area was already within the boundary of the Palace of Fortune. The Palace of Fortune was hidden within part of the Sea of Chaos and could ‘leap’ and ‘swim’ around as well. When Jiang Ming first learned of this back then, he felt that such a feat was truly unimaginable.
Jiang Ming used to think that it was ridiculous for the Palace of Fortune to leap from a Sea of Chaos to another. But he now understood that the palace was merely running its cycling by relying on the Laws of the Void.
Once the truth had been unveiled, the feat was no longer worth anything.
‘Good Lord! Is this the entire army of Heavenly Demonic Beasts moving all out?’ Even Jiang Ming who looked ahead, couldn’t help himself from being astonished.
There were numerous mountains that were billions of feet high, condensing boundless divine luminance in the land of nothingness. Its terrifying aura swept through billions of miles away.
With a glance, there were as many as 72 mountains in total. On each of these mountains, there was a King-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast as strong as Violet Ghost, or it might be slightly weaker or stronger.
Besides, there were armies of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts on top of these mountains. They were all commanded by the Dao Patriarch leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts.
Together, there were more than thousands of them.
Leading in the forefront were three even more incomparably huge mountains that contained overwhelming powers within. Their strength even caused Jiang Ming to give them another glance.
‘Are these the Monarch Level?’ Jiang Ming became interested.
He noticed that the three mountains at the forefront were evoking a supreme treasure, seemingly trying to break through some sort of barrier.
“The defensive barrier of the Palace of Fortune!” Jiang Ming shook his head. Of course he knew what was going on.
The outer defensive layer of the Palace of Fortune wasn’t as insignificant as one might think. Even the power concentrated from three Monarch-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts might not be able to break the barrier. However, when such a force became coupled with 72 of the King Level and also the great army of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, it was hard to be certain.
This was no wonder Gu Cheng was so anxious.
‘Once the outer layer of the defensive barrier is broken through, I’m afraid it will be time when weapons will start clashing. With the resources of the Palace of Fortune, even if they couldn’t withstand the attack, it shouldn’t be difficult for it to escape from the place.’ Jiang Ming kept pondering in his heart.
After all, how could such an organization which had existed since ancient time not have any means of saving itself?
Jiang Ming didn’t bother to think more on this matter. He evoked his World Projection, directly encompassing all 75 Demonic Mountains within. The terrifying suppressive force caused even boundless divine luminance to shatter.
The Demonic Mountains were suppressed to the point of collapsing.
Rumble! Without waiting for the many Heavenly Demonic Beasts to react, there were incomparably huge pitch-black passages appearing one after another, devouring the entire 72 Demonic Mountains within.
Any resistance was futile. Even with the King leveled beasts making their move or the Great Army of the Heavenly Demonic Beast erupting, none were able to escape the fate of being devoured.
‘Only now can I be said to possess the strength to exterminate all beasts with just a snap of my finger!’
Jiang Ming was extremely satisfied.
It was a shame that the last three Demonic Mountains managed to barely withstand the devouring power but they were still being suppressed and it was difficult to struggle their way out.
“Who are you?” An incomparably huge figure stood up from the middle in the middle. He had a total of 360 heads and looked bizarre and terrifying. Even a slight glance would make a person’s scalp go numb.
“I am your ancestors. Jeez, I don’t even have such a deformed grandchild like you!” With a grunt, Jiang Ming shouted out loud, “Are your Emperor not coming?”

chapters.title: Chapter 533
chapters.content:
533 Supremacy Above the Great Dao
As Jiang Ming looked at the three Heavenly Demonic Beast Monarchs, his body was also becoming bigger and bigger, up till the point when he was at the same level as they were. The aura encompassing his body was even more terrifying.
Jiang Ming’s World Projection did not fade, but continued closing in. Its suppressive force became more and more terrifying, causing the three Demonic Monarchs to struggle less and less.
Jiang Ming stepped closer, slowly approaching the three of them. Meanwhile, the power of his inner world’s origin was trembling. Chaos Laws penetrated throughout, turning the entire space into a huge furnace, which was a billion times more powerful than even the Chaos Supreme Treasures.
Within the furnace, Heavenly Demonic Beasts that were below the Dao Patriarch Realm were completely refined in just a snap of a finger. They were transformed into floods of incomparably pure energy that would be injected into the inner world, partly expanding it and also to allow the Seeds of Law to undergo metamorphosis.
Even Heavenly Demonic Beasts of the Dao Patriarch Realm couldn’t last a few breaths before they were completely refined.
King-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts could struggle for a little but would also end up dying out swiftly.
Such a speed of refinement was so fast that it was beyond anyone’s imagination.
Taking Gu Cheng for example, just killing a King-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast would’ve been of utmost difficulties. However, when it came to Jiang Ming, refining one of them now would take less than half a day’s work even.
Such speed was appalling.
As the Chaos Laws continued to grow and mature one after another in his body, Jiang Ming’s power soared rapidly.
“Who the hell are you?” The multi-headed Heavenly Demonic Beast bellowed. It tried to evoke its own power to cause waves of power outbursts. Such torrents of power that could’ve pierced through the Sea of Chaos were but a drop of water into the ocean. It was extremely difficult for the beast to tear apart this World Projection of Jiang Ming.
While the beast was astonished, it continued to think of other ways of escaping.
“How did you guys find your way here? Did any Heavenly Demonic Beast Emperors come?” Jiang Ming enquired.
“You want to know?” The multi-headed Heavenly Demonic laughed coldly., “Dream on! Liang Qiang, explode!”
“Alright!” The Monarch-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast responded. The powers within its body went through some sort of nuclear fusion, causing it to grow explosively and its whole body expanded rapidly.
“Wanting to self-destruct?” Jiang Ming snorted coldly. “You can’t even choose death when you are before me!”
A speckle of luminance sparked between Jiang Ming’s brows, sending a supreme power of soul directly into Liang Qiang’s body, disintegrating most of its will.
The dramatic accumulation of power stopped abruptly.
“Death to all of you!” Jiang Ming roared.
There was no possibility of him showing mercy to these Heavenly Demonic Beasts. Since Jiang Ming couldn’t get any information from them, he would simply exterminate them.
As he pointed forth, it formed two powers of Dao that broke through the protective special ability of the two Monarch-level Heavenly Demonic Beasts, directly piercing through their heads. Their violently struggling bodies were put to rest.
“Come in, all of you!”
Jiang Ming’s World Projection turned into a black hole, swallowing the other three experts as well as the mountain beneath them.
It was also at this time that Jiang Ming sensed some strange fluctuation. He saw a person appearing out of thin air not far away.
Yes, it was a Human. Its form was exactly the same as a human, except for that vertical eye on its brow.
“A human-form Heavenly Demonic Beast!” Jiang Ming became slightly more solemn. He felt a hint of danger from this person. Yes, it was a sense of danger. Though only a hint of it.
“You actually killed Liang Qiang and his group!” The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast looked extremely cold. “I know a thing or two about the Great Dao Alliance. However, I’ve never heard of a person of your stature. Who exactly are you?”
“An existence who’s here to exterminate you and your likes!” As Jiang Ming said so, he felt something and turned his head over, only to find a person appearing right next to him.
This person was unmistakably a pure human.
“Three-Eyes! You actually came.” When this person looked at the Heavenly Demonic Beast, he snorted coldly before turning over and looked at Jiang Ming with a strange look flashed across his face. “You’re Jiang Ming, the new member of the Great Dao Alliance? Were you the one who wiped out the entire Heavenly Demonic Beast Army just now? Those were three Monarchs-Leveled beasts! Remarkable! Truly remarkable! Haha! Never would I have expected that our Great Dao Alliance would have an addition of such supreme existence into our ranks.”
“Brother, I’m Huang Tian. I’m considered to be an ancient existence of the Great Dao Alliance. I haven’t shown myself to the outside world for quite some time. There are only very few who know of my existence. The emergence of the three Monarch-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts didn’t alarm my true self but the wisp of intent that I left behind detected them.”
“With the arrival of Three-Eyes, his supreme Emperor-level aura completely woke me from my slumber. Even if I didn’t wake up, the Palace of Fortune would still be able to withstand their attack, but it would be quite difficult. If there were another Emperor-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast added into their ranks, I’m afraid the Palace of Fortune would’ve been done for.”
As Huang Tian started talking, he told most of the stories of his origin.
“Elder brother!” Jiang Ming smiled as he clasped his hand. “You guys know each other?”
This person in front of him was clearly an existence capable of fighting against an Emperor-Leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast. It was obvious that this was also one of the foundations of the Great Dao Alliance. Jiang Ming felt that the hidden powers of the Palace of Fortune wouldn’t be just this one person.
“Of course we know each other!” Huang Tian took a glance at the three-eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast and snorted coldly. “Going way back into the eras, there hasn’t been a short of great battles between the two of us. It was just that we couldn’t do anything to each other. I didn’t expect this old brat to pop up again now. Well, just in time! I can have a good time!”
“He’s mine!” Jiang Ming said nonchalantly.
“You? Can you?” Huang Tian hesitated.
“How can a man say he can’t?”
“Haha! Alright kid! I’ll set up an array formation for you. However, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts are very difficult to kill, especially those that have reached the Emperor level. They are almost immortal beings. His third eye contains the luminance of destruction. It’s very terrifying and even I myself have to be careful when fighting against him. You must be careful when fighting against him. Remember not to be impatient.”
“Don’t worry! The moment he came to me, his destiny was sealed, only death awaits.” Jiang Ming smiled as he continued, “Elder brother, do you know where the Primordial Demon Abyss is?”
“In fact... I actually do know!” Huang Tian had a complicated look on his face.
“You do?” Jiang Ming’s brow furrowed and his heart dawned.
During the endless years of confrontation, the Great Dao Alliance had definitely been in a disadvantaged position. Otherwise, why would the Palace of Fortune go into hiding? The Primordial Demon Abyss however, was just right there.
The gap between them was immeasurable.
“Could it be that there are existences beyond the Emperor level in the Primordial Demon Abyss?” Jiang Ming asked again.
“I don’t think so!” Huang Tian replied hesitantly. “If there were really an existence of such a level, I’m afraid the infinite Chaos would’ve fallen a long time ago. But as far as I know, there are five or six Emperor-level experts in the Abyss. There’s probably two or three of them that I don’t know of.”
His tone of voice was very solemn. Incredibly solemn at that.
“Within the Great Dao Alliance, how many are of your level?” Jiang Ming asked curiously.
“Three!” Huang Tian answered telepathically. “However, we have the Palace of Fortune. If we were to counterattack in desperation, we will still be able to take a huge portion of the Emperor- Leveled Heavenly Demonic Beasts down with us. This is the fundamental reason why we exist to this day.”
“Didn’t there anyone beyond the Chaos Realm back in the ages?”
“Those were mere legends.”
“Legends...”
Jiang Ming was speechless.
It might have been true, or that it was truly just a legend.
Only that whatever the case was, it was just like what Gu Cheng had said. It was way too long ago, so long that even they couldn’t glimpse at the hidden secrets of the past with their lifespan.
“Huang Tian, are you done talking?” The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast finally became impatient.
“You’re quite a patient one!” Jiang Ming however, took over as he walked towards the beast. His aura began to soar, causing even the space of the land of nothingness to tremble, and setting off ripples of torrents.
“It’s not that I’m patient, but the fact that my arrival has predetermined the fate of you two, that’s death!” The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast replied in an indifferent tone.
“You can’t even deal with me, yet you’re thinking of killing the two of us?” Huang Tian couldn’t help but shake his head.
“That was back then. Now however...” Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast suddenly laughed. “I’ve already reached the pinnacle stage of the Emperor level. According to your power system, I’m in the Extreme Chaos Realm. It’s just a step further from reaching the legendary realm! Supremacy above the Great Dao!”
“Supremacy above the Great Dao?” Jiang Ming couldn’t help but break into laughter. “It’s more appropriate for me to say that.”
“Extreme Chaos Realm? Allow me to see how strong you are. Let’s see if you are really in the Extreme Chaos Realm.”
With that, Jiang Ming’s punch shattered the void, charging forth at the beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 534
chapters.content:
534 Descending into the Primordial Demon Abyss
The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast was very strong. It was extremely powerful. Otherwise, the beast wouldn’t have indifferently watched as Huang Tian chattered with Jiang Ming. This was a showcase of absolute self-confidence.
Even though the beast had already been in great battle against Huang Tian for quite a few times, coupled with the fact that Jiang Ming had just annihilated three Emperor-Leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast Armies, it was still extremely confident.
As soon as Jiang Ming struck out, the beast’s expression instantly changed. This punch of Jiang Ming struck off with such power that it was invincible.
Right in front of the fist, an endless scroll of civilization manifested itself. There were drawings of the slashing and burning of agricultural life, the rainy days coupled with people cutting wood. Everyone was of high-spirit as though they were dragons. The infinite races striving towards advancement. This punch accommodated all of the power of civilization into one.
All of these turned into a monstrous will that could destroy everything in its path.
“Killer Civilization Punch Technique!”
Jiang Ming’s deafening howl startled even the heavens.
This Killer Civilization Punch Technique of his was deduced by combining the once Civilization Dao. It was the condensation of the will of every being throughout the ages. As Jiang Ming cast this punch, it pierced through the Sea of Chaos’s boundless river of Wisdom.
As the punch was struck towards the Heavenly Demonic Beasts, it seemed as though it was the long river of fate, sweeping away everything in its path.
Rumble! The space in the land of nothingness was even annihilated directly. With just this single punch, the arm of the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast which tried to block off the attack was blown apart.
“I’ve even reached the peak of the Emperor Level and yet I can’t even block off a single punch from you?” The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast cried out in shock. It was in a frenzy and its aura was tyrannical.
The arm that was blown apart earlier had already fully recovered to its initial state.
“So what if you’re stronger in power? You’ll eventually be hunted down by me anyways!”
“Luminance of Annihilation!”
As the third eye on the Beast’s forehead opened, it shot out a ray of luminance that penetrated through fate itself. It was a form of invisible power that pierced through everything, directly coming at Jiang Ming.
“Luminance of Annihilation? Let’s see who’ll be annihilated instead, shall we?” Jiang Ming frowned before throwing yet another punch.
“Unlimited Killing Punch!” Jiang Ming threw another punch at the beast.
This punch revealed an extremely tragic aura, coupled with other forces such as killing, fury, curse, grievance, decay and withering. All of these forces converged into the single punch, yet surprisingly integrated perfectly together, forming an incomparable sacred feeling.
It was a punch that was meant for killing, yet gave off a feeling of sacred divinity.
This was formed by Jiang Ming through the condensation of all his killing power, forming the Killing Punch’s second form. It contained pure incomparable killing power where, as the punch struck, everything would be annihilated.
It directly shattered the Luminance of Annihilation and directly landed onto the Three Eyes’s head.
Bang...The beast’s third eye abruptly exploded with a thud, followed by his entire head blown off. The beast was even thrown back three million miles away.
Three Eyes was beyond miserable at this point.
“Impossible!” The will of the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast sets off a tragic and incredulous disbelief at what just happened. “I’m at the Supreme Emperor level! What I evoke is my innate special ability! How could I be blasted apart?”
“Impossible! Absolutely impossible!”
His head coalesced and he waved his arms, stirring up an invisible order of the void so much that even the land became twisted and chaotic.The power that was triggered was terrifying to the extreme.
If Gu Cheng was here and was caught within, he would’ve been dead without a single doubt.
Huang Tian, who was watching the battle unfolding, was even more dumbfounded.
‘This little brother is too strong! So strong that he’s simply inhuman! God damn! He’s too amazing. He’s even more amazing than I am! When did such a terrifying person join the ranks of our Human race and our Great Dao Alliance? Even an existence like the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast has no chance of retaliating! Haha! Awesome! This is simply awesome!’
Huang Tian was so overjoyed that both his hands and feet were dancing around. He was extremely excited.
Jiang Ming’s foot landed on the veins of the void, appearing in front of Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast with just a single step. At the same time, he threw his third punch at the beast.
“Chaotic Killer Punch!”
This was the third form of the Killer Punch. It invoked the power of origin of Jiang Ming’s inner world, integrating with the technique of his physique and even included different Chaos Laws Into this punch, allowing the prowess of this punch to reach an extreme.
Just as the punch was thrown, the great Dao exploding aura caused even the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast to tremble. The overwhelming aura of the punch even stopped the beast in its feet, making it difficult to move even an inch.
At that moment, the beast’s head had already been restored to its initial state.
“What special ability is this?” With a loud shriek, thirty million streams of air rushed out from its body and with a streak of luminance, formed a blood-coloured pagoda.
The pagoda trembled and drew on the power of order from the land of nothingness.
At a glance, this Pagoda seemed as though it was embedded within the void, merging itself with the radiance and the boundless void.
The beast had become the void and the void became it.
“This is a good special ability. However, can you withstand my attack?”
Jiang Ming sneered as his punch landed onto the Pagoda.
Rumble! Explosive rumbles resounded yet again.
As soon as the Pagoda trembled, it exploded violently, forming waves of currents before scattering into nothingness.
The Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast was also directly blasted out of the void. His whole body exploded with a thud, becoming a cloud of bloody mist.
“That’s the Extreme Emperor Level? Nothing much to be seen!” Jiang Ming snorted coldly as his World Projection loomed over, directly sweeping the blood mist into his inner world. He completely suppressed the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast that had just recovered, rendering it motionless.
The beast wasn’t even an opponent to begin with in the outside world, and would only amount to a feeble ant within Jiang Ming’s inner world.
“This is amazing, brother!” Huang Tian was so surprised that even his sound broke.
“Just some small tricks. Nothing worth mentioning!” Jiang Ming smiled and waved his hand, being very modest himself.
“If you’re not worth mentioning, I would like to see who is even worth mentioning in this world!” Huang Tian laughed out loud. “Haha! You’re really carrying forward our humble human nature to the extreme. With you around, I’ll be able to sleep peacefully from now on. I’ll never have to worry about waking up one day and realizing my whole house has gone missing.”
Jiang Ming broke into laughter when he heard Huang Tian’s remark. This old man was really a jolly cute person.
Jiang Ming still asked the question, “Where exactly is the Primordial Demon Abyss?”
“Brother, are you sure you want to go there?” Huang Tian abruptly became serious.
“I’m going!” Jiang Ming nodded. “We’ve always been the weaker faction. Such a situation needs to be reversed eventually. I’ll go and explore a little about the place first. If possible, I’ll directly wipe out the entire Primordial Demon Abyss. If the Demon Abyss is really extremely terrifying, then we can all prepare in advance as well right? To better prepare ourselves for the next step.”
“Brother, it seems that your great ambition hasn’t been extinguished.” Huang Tian let out a wryly smile. “Thinking back, who among us weren’t so? Every one of us had great ambitions, wanting to destroy the entire Primordial Demon Abyss. However, the results were either death or despair. The Great Dao Alliance went into passive defense and the Palace of Fortune hid itself. Even I myself had often been in deep slumbers. However, if you want to go...”
He hesitated for a little before continuing, “We can’t gamble our entire Great Dao Alliance just for you. After all, this is the matter of the survival of all living beings. However, I can go with you. I can be a spectator at least, or maybe even help out a little.”
“Elder brother, you don’t have to!”
“I have to!”
“Alright. Let’s go then?”
“Let’s go!”
The two of them marched forth in the same direction. They weren’t speeding off.
“Rumor has it that ten thousand years ago, the Heavenly Demonic Beasts and our Great Dao Alliance, both had an existence that transcended the Chaos Realm. After a great battle between them, they opened up what’s presently known as the land of nothingness, Sea of Chaos and also the Primordial Demon Abyss. However, these were just rumors.” Huang Tian continued chattering along the way. “As for whether these were true, no one knew. After all, there are no longer experts of that era currently remaining within our Great Dao Alliance now.”
“That shouldn’t be!”
“Yes, it shouldn’t be! We have an endless lifespan. Could it be true that the ancestors of that era died out during their fights against the Heavenly Demonic Beasts? I still have doubts about this. Also, the Primordial Demon Abyss is already powerful since way before, yet why didn’t they annihilate us all? There are too many unanswered questions.”
“Strange!”
“Yes! It’s very strange.”
“Elder brother. Do you know how the Heavenly Demonic Beasts discovered the location of the Palace of Fortune?”
“Hehe! My guess is that they’ve long known of the location of the Palace of Fortune.” Huang Tian let out a wry laugh. “During the great battle between you and Three-Eyed, I’ve learned a little about what has happened this time around. Perhaps there were too many Heavenly Demonic Beasts that had died recently, which triggered their fury and led them towards making a scene here.”
“Making a scene?”
“If they don’t make a scene, can they annihilate us?”
Jiang Ming listened in silence.
He was also puzzled. Why did the two sides be in confrontation for such a long time? With the Heavenly Demonic Beasts being so overwhelming, could they really not find the location of the Palace of Fortune? Were they really unable to annihilate the Great Dao Alliance? This didn’t seem in line. The relationship between the two seemed to be somewhat intriguing.
Even though Jiang Ming and Huang Tian walked slowly, they finally came upon the place. Right in front of them was the Primordial Demon Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 535
chapters.content:
535 Before the End, 30 Quintillion Chaotic Eras
They didn’t travel at a very fast pace along the way here. Jiang Ming had already completely refined Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast and the likes, allowing his strength to skyrocket once again.
The number of the Chaos Laws in his inner world had already reached a total of 2,600 laws. At the later stages, it became even more difficult to produce Chaos Laws. Therefore, such an achievement was already extremely terrifying.
If Jiang Ming was just starting out, he could probably produce a thousand Daos in his inner world in one go.
Nevertheless, with the improving strength, Jiang Ming had gained more confidence.
Currently, what lay in front of them was a huge rift that spanned a thousand light years long. In fact, it wasn’t a real rift but a projection.
“The Primordial Demon Abyss is extremely terrifying. Even so, it is still extremely difficult for them to open up such a huge portal in the land of nothingness. This is just a projection.” Huang Tian explained, “By just slightly forcing it, we can break through the barrier and descend into the other side. Of course, this also blocks out the ordinary Heavenly Demonic Beasts from entering the land of nothingness.
“Such a huge portal is just right here. Yet it’s amazing that so many ages have passed and yet the Demon Abyss hasn’t been destroyed.” Jiang Ming sighed. “Has the Palace of Fortune always been this weak or has it not once been strong before?”
Huang Tian gently let out a sigh. He had to admit to such a fact. “Something like that. There’s time where we forcefully charge forth but it was still too difficult to fight against the Primordial Demon Abyss. That is why we’ve been entangled to this day. The inside of the Demon Abyss is extremely huge. So vast that it resembles the fusion of millions of Sea of Chaos. The nature of the Heavenly Demonic Beasts is to plunder each other in order to improve themselves. As such, this naturally produces countless terrifying existence amongst them, a natural advantage of the race. On the contrary, although we’re also constantly fighting over on our side, we are overall still too mild and gentle.”
“All’s well before. Just leave it to me now!” Jiang Ming took a step forward “Elder brother, you just wait out here. I’ll go and destroy the entire Primordial Demonic Abyss!”
“Such recklessness? That’s right. When it comes to such a level as ours, any conspiracy and trickery as well as planning are just useless. It’s better to just descend forcibly and push our way through everything!” Huang Tian nodded. “I’ll go with you. Don’t worry. I won’t be pulling you back. I’ll just be securing the area for you from afar!”
“Alright then!” Jiang Ming replied.
As Jiang Ming focused his gaze, divine luminance erupted and directly broke through the spatial void in front of them, forming a huge portal in which he steps in.
Jiang Ming showed incomparable forcefulness, a carefree endeavor.
Huang Tian followed suit.
At the top of the sky, Jiang Ming stood firm.
As he reached out and grabbed with his hand, there were wisps of air currents. The nature of these air currents were comparable to that of the innate spiritual essence. Moreover, even when they were at such endlessly high altitude, these essences were still extremely dense.
The relative cultivation environment of this place was more than 100 times better than that of the Chaos Primordial Land.
There were no stars or sun over here, only a blood-coloured moon hanging high on top of the dimensional space. Below them was a huge piece of land that was vast and boundless. Surrounding this piece of land were many spatial realms that made it look like bee hives.
“The nature of the spiritual essence here is completely opposite to that of our Sea of Chaos. It’s as though these were two extremely opposite forms of energy.” Huang Tian explained.
Jiang Ming nodded in agreement. He had long analyzed this matter.
“To be opposite also means mutually exclusive!” Jiang Ming smiled and continued, “However, these are all great sustenance to me!”
Rumble! Jiang Ming evoked the projection of his inner world. Without the suppression from the land of nothingness, the technique was fully unfolded over here, expanding rapidly at the speed of a hundred billion light years.
Yes, this time, the projection was fully unfolding its potential.
The World Projection that could even envelop an entire Sea of Chaos, enveloped a countless number of Heavenly Demonic Realms in just an instant.
As the projection trembled, it emitted a suction force that directly devoured all of the realms from the spatial layers. As soon as these realms entered Jiang Ming’s inner world, they were all immediately refined by the furnace conjured from the boundless Chaos Origin within. The lives of Heavenly Demonic Beasts that were in the billions and trillions became sustenance to his inner world in just a snap of a finger.
It was like a whale swallowing whole. A whale that never stopped devouring. In just a single snap of a finger, there were thirty dimensional spaces that were equivalent to that of great chiliocosm plundered and refined completely.
Such a scene horrified Huang Tian.
Even with his mind and will, he almost collapsed. He then came back to senses and his face was flushed with excitement. Even his whole body was trembling, “B-b-brother! You’re specializing in the World Dao? Your inner world has transcended the great chiliocosm and evolved into Chaos?”
“That’s right!” Jiang Ming smiled. “Does this count as breaking the iron laws of ages already?”
“For real? This is actually real! This is more than just breaking the iron laws! This is a miracle among miracles! This is turning impossible into a possibility!” Huang Tian was dancing in excitement. “Haha! We finally have ourselves a terrifying genius! Let’s go, brother! Follow me back to the Palace of Fortune. We’ll open up all of our resources to you! The billions of years of resources and even my resources as well! All of them will be provided to you to help the evolution of your inner world. No, this isn’t enough! All members of the Palace of Fortune will set out together to plunder resources and to go all out in aiding your inner world’s evolution. Once the Chaos evolves completely, your slight movement of hand would be equivalent to the power of a whole Sea of Chaos! Who can even stop you then? Even Emperor-leveled existence would be mere feeble ants! Brother, we can’t take any chances. Let’s go! Go back with me and we’ll first grow meticulously. You will become invincible! You will be able to force through anything and everything!”
Huang Tian was really exhilarated.
“Elder brother, there’s no need.” Jiang Ming shook his head and smiled. “The evolution of my inner world is almost complete. Moreover...”
He pointed towards the Demon Abyss. “This place is the best sustenance to me, the true treasure that will allow my inner world to grow by leaps and bounds.”
“This...” Huang Tian was stunned.
“Even Three-Eyed was blasted into pieces with just a snap of my finger. Compared to then, I am more than ten times stronger.” Jiang Ming added. “My strength is improving at every moment!”
“This...” Huang Tian was still stunned.
In just a few years’ of work, he had already improved by ten times? He’s improving every moment of time? God damn! Was he really still a human? Was he not the son of the great Dao? No, he should be the father of the great Dao!
Huang Tian opened his mouth but ultimately said nothing.
It took Jiang Ming three punches to kill the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast. What about now? One punch? That should already do it!
Three-Eyed was a supreme Emperor-level Heavenly Demonic Beast. How many of such level existence could there be in the Demon Abyss? They weren’t even enough for Jiang Ming as appetizers!
“Haha...” When Huang Tian thought of this, he couldn’t help himself from bursting into laughter. His laughter shook through three thousand worlds from his extreme joy. “Brother, you focus on devouring here. These aren’t living beings. They’re worse than feeble ants! They’re the foulest existence in the world. Remember! In the event of danger, I’ll hold back for you. You staying alive is the hope of the hundreds and millions of our human race!”
“Don’t worry!” Feeling Huang Tian’s determination to even die for him, Jiang Ming nodded his head. This old man could really sacrifice himself for the sake of the greater good of the race.
Jiang Ming continued descending and devouring non-step. He swept through one great chiliocosm after another, which were all rapidly refined by the furnace within his body.
The Seeds of the Chaos Law kept on growing and transforming. They became complete and ran throughout the Sea of Chaos of his Inner World.
The origin of Jiang Ming’s inner world was also growing rapidly and the space within was expanding at a rapid pace.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ming’s power was increasing explosively. This was as though he was taking in great tonic pills non-stop.
“Who! Who is it that is destroying our world?” A long howl penetrated through the void. A Monarch-leveled Heavenly Demonic Beast could be seen rushing over from the distance. There were many other terrifying existences appearing one after another, from every direction.
Jiang Ming simply ignored every one of them.
With just a sweep of his inner world, they were all collected into his inner world and later refined into sustenance in just a snap of a finger.
‘The breadth of my current inner world, the origin and even the strength of laws have all vaguely surpassed the Sea of Chaos already. Based on my deduction, the power of Origin of a Sea of Chaos coupled with its power of Laws are at least equivalent to that of forty-eight thousand Dao Patriarchs, and that’s counting those pinnacle stage Dao Patriarchs. When these powers are gathered, they weren’t just the simple matter of being added together!’
Jiang Ming’s heart perked up.
In fact, he was very puzzled as well. The inner world within him had already surpassed the ordinary Sea of Chaos. However, his inner world had yet to complete its evolution. This was obviously not quite right.
The good thing was that his power was constantly increasing, which was enough for him.
“How dare you! How dare the Great Dao Alliance invade our Demon Abyss! You’re courting death!” An Emperor- Leveled existence finally couldn’t stand around any longer, tore through the void and ascended.
With a huge palm that covers the entire heaven and earth, the peerless existence tried to dissipate Jiang Ming’s World Projection. However, Jiang Ming merely pointed into the void and directly annihilated the opponent on the spot, collecting its remnants into his inner world.
Sheesh... Such a scene caused Huang Tian to draw in incessant cool breaths. Each breath of cool air swept through thirty million miles.
Alas! That was an Emperor-leveled existence! Although it was incomparable to the Three-Eyed Heavenly Demonic Beast, it was still within the Emperor-level category. To think that it had just been annihilated abruptly like that.
‘God damn! This kid is just too amazing! However, I like it! If we continue pushing across like this, maybe the Primordial Demon Abyss would be done for. It might even be annihilated from the roots up!’ Huang Tian became even more excited.
Jiang Ming kept moving forward and continued killing the Emperor-leveled beasts that charged at him, one after another.
At one point, there were five of them appearing at the same time.
“Five? I’ll kill you just as usual!”
Jiang Ming’s eyes were bloodshot from the onslaught.
Meanwhile, his inner world now had a total of 2,800 Chaos Laws. Sky-rocket wasn’t even enough to describe the surge of enhancement to his strength.
At this point, every additional Chaos Laws produced was akin to doubling of his strength. It was unimaginable.
The five Emperor-leveled existence were all suppressed in just a moment’s time, turning into Jiang Ming’s sustenance in the end.
Eventually, Jiang Ming landed on the lands of the Primordial Demon Abyss.
“Still not coming out?”
Jiang Ming sensed a terrifying aura in the depth of the Demon Abyss but somehow, it still didn’t want to show itself.
“It’s even better if you don’t show yourself!”
Jiang Ming gave a cold laugh and began to devour once again. The layers of space around the Demon Abyss were plundered at a rapid pace.
After an unknown amount of time, they were unexpectedly all cleared up.
“Still not showing yourself?”
Jiang Ming raised his eyebrows. The murderous intent in his heart went ablaze. His Inner World Projection enveloped the entire land beneath his feet forming a gigantic mouth, swallowing it whole.
The whole Primordial Land of the Primordial Demon Abyss was directly taken into his inner world.
This terrifying Primordial Land was something that was more than 100 times larger than that of the Chaos Primordial Land.
Rumble... As the origin of Jiang Ming’s inner world trembled, the Laws fused together, forming a furnace that exploded in power, rapidly refining this piece of land.
Pure streams of power flowed out and combined itself with the Inner World origin. His inner world was rapidly undergoing metamorphosis. The Chaos Laws within were also rapidly evolving.
“Finally coming out?”
Jiang Ming paid no notice to his inner world. Instead, he looked ahead into the void and saw two figures walking over towards him.
“You’re finally here!” One of them spoke.
“I’ve been waiting for you for so long that I almost turned into Dao itself already.” The other person suddenly laughed and continued. “It’s a good thing you’re here now. You’re not considered late, but your growth is still ultimately too slow. No, you’re 30 Quintillion Chaotic Eras slow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 536
chapters.content:
536 The End (Part 1)
Upon descending to the Primordial Demon Abyss, Jiang Ming got ferocious and almost devoured everything in the abyss. Yet, he was startled with the appearance of two terrific beings.
“You two have been waiting for me?” Jiang Ming asked with surprise. Meanwhile, his inner world had been refining the plunders rapidly. Chaos Laws were produced one after another and the increment of his strength was still sky-roketting. His inner world was rapidly moving towards producing a total number of 3,000 Chaos Laws and its expansion had reached an incredible degree.
“We have been waiting for you all these while.” One of them revealed himself. It was an old man clad in Dao robe. He was looking at Jiang Ming with his sophisticated gaze. “Let’s talk after your inner world has completely transformed into the Chaos. Else, it’s useless to talk more.”
“Since we have waited for billions of years, we don’t mind waiting for a little bit longer.” Another was clad in black robe. He looked like a strong, middle-aged man. He added, “Chaos and I will reverse the time for you to cultivate quickly. Don’t you care about others for now!”
Following that, the black-robed middle-aged man evoked a supreme special ability. The old man took his move as well.
The two were extraordinarily horrifying. Their strength exerted was far beyond the Emperor-leveled power.
In just a snap of a finger, they had reversed the flowing of the time by a billion times. This scene had shocked Jiang Ming, but he merely looked at them without saying anything.
The two were also within the range of time-reverse.
“I’m the Chaos Dao Lord and he’s the Heavenly Demon Dao Lord.” The old man smiled and said, “In ancient times, there was neither land of nothingness nor numerous Sea of Chaos. There was only one Sea of Chaos. When the Heavenly Demon Dao Lord and I descended into that only Sea of Chaos, we startled fighting against each other. We shattered the Primordial Land and destroyed the Sea of Chaos. We blasted all things and transformed it into its most primitive state.”
“After exerting influence, heaven and earth evolved, and the place of nothingness appeared first. My Daoist Body collapsed and fused with Chaos Qi to evolve into 3,000 Sea of Chaos and at the same time, I founded the Great Dao Alliance.”
“Meanwhile, the Heavenly Demon Dao Lord opened up the Primordial Demon Abyss and evolved his body into Heavenly Demon Beasts.”
“The reason why the Great Dao Alliance and the Heavenly Demonic Beasts are fighting against each other is to let those Heavenly Demonic Beasts devour the power of sentient beings and merge them into one. This is the fusion of the power of the Heavenly Demon Dao Lord and mine.”
The old man explained at a slow pace. However, what he had said made Jiang Ming feel shock and a chill down his spine. Although it was obviously different from the version he heard from Gu Cheng, he inexplicably trusted the old man more.
If what the old man said was real, did it mean that these two Dao Lords here were the one who built the Sea of Chaos and opened up the Primordial Demon Abyss?
Jiang Ming didn’t understand the reason why the two Dao Lords did so.
Seeming to have realized Jiang Ming’s doubt, the Heavenly Demon Dao Lord suddenly beamed. “The reason is simple. It’s for you to absorb and promote the evolution of your inner world.”
Jiang Ming was stunned again.
“Well, it’d be difficult for you to believe if we were to explain further. Let’s talk further only after your inner world has become perfect. It’d be extremely difficult at the later stage of nurturing your inner world, particularly when you’re nurturing the last Chaos Law. According to the deduction, it’s at least 100 times more difficult than to produce 2,999 Chaos Laws. However, with the dozens of hearts of Chaos you have absorbed, plus the entire Primordial Demon Abyss and your inner world’s self evolution, it should work!” Chaos Dao Lord said, “We’ll wait for you outside.”
Following that, the two left with a flash.
Jiang Ming couldn’t stay calm.
The Chaos Dao Lord even knew about the hearts of Chaos? They were rewarded by the system, after all.
Jiang Ming had a headache.
‘Forget about it, I’ll do whatever I can to deal with whatever problems that might arise. As for the rest, f*ck off! I shall first improve my strength.’
Jiang Ming sat cross-legged and shifted most part of his consciousness into the inner world to refine what he had devoured while promoting the acceleration of the revolving inner world. Meanwhile, he had a part of his consciousness to remain vigilant of the external surroundings.
As time passed by quickly, Jiang Ming’s inner world had been rapidly expanding as well. Especially after the production of 2,900 Chaos Laws, every new Chaos Law produced would expand the inner world by the size of a Sea of Chaos.
It was extremely terrifying and extraordinarily incredible.
Fortunately, Jiang Ming had the entire Primordial Demon Abyss as his sustenance. The inner world had finally produced a total of 2,999 Chaos Laws, and it was a Chaos Law short to perfection.
However, Jiang Ming frowned. He had spent almost all of his sustenance except the core piece of the Primordial Demon Abyss’s origin.
“Simultaneously when I refine this last piece, I shall also promote the inner world’s self-operation so that it would drive the other laws in producing this last Chaos Law.”
As Jiang Ming pondered, he again focused on his inner world.
This time is the longest time Jiang Ming had spent for his cultivation.
Thirty million years later. In Jiang Ming’s inner world, the last seed of Chaos Law had finally transformed into the chain, which instantly penetrated the Inner Sea of Chaos, merged into every Chaos’s particle, and spread throughout the universe.
Meanwhile, as the Inner Sea of Chaos shivered, it underwent qualitative transformation. Its origin skyrocketed and the space expanded. The 3,000 great Daos intertwined, the time flowed, and reincarnation revolved. Even Jiang Ming’s physique was transformed and his soul baptized.
It was a holistic transformation and growth, a swift and intense one.
Finally, all had calmed down. Jiang Ming opened his eyes, which were flowing with divine luminance. He effortlessly broke the great formation of time-reverse and walked out of it.
Jiang Ming could clearly feel that the Chaos could no longer suppress him. With a light stroke, he tore apart the shackles of the Chaos and transcended. His current strength had truly transcended the Chaos.
“Succeeded?” The Chaos Dao Lord said with some excitement. The Heavenly Demon Dao Lord had hints of excitement on his face too.
“Yes!” Jiang Ming nodded. “Now can you tell me the truth?” He shifted his gaze and saw Huang Tian. This expert of the Great Dao Alliance was being confined, but because his life was not in danger, Jiang Ming didn’t care for him temporarily.
The two Dao Lords remained silent. As they looked at each other, they nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 537
chapters.content:
537 The End (Part 2)
“It’s time.” When the Chaos Dao Lord said this sentence, he sounded indescribably emotional. With a flick of his finger, a stream of light flew out.
Jiang Ming reached out to grab and absorbed all information contained in it. Following that, he was stunned.
Prior to the formation of the 3,000 Sea of Chaos, it was a prosperous world full of talents and countless experts. Among them, there were eight experts who had transcended the Chaos. They were the Three Thousand Dao Lord, Chaos Dao Lord, Heavenly Demon Dao Lord, Linglong Dao Lord, Monarch Dao Lord, World Dao Lord, Riyue Dao Lord and Infinite Dao Lord.
After the eight Dao Lords had transcended the Chaos, they got to the real Primordial Land, where it was filled with rich Hongmeng Qi and contained the supreme foundation of Dao.
However, with their achievement, even the Hongmeng Qi wasn’t of much use for them. Even after hundreds of millions of years had passed by, it was difficult for them to go further. They couldn’t break the barrier of Hongmeng and witness the real great Dao.
Naturally they were unwilling to reconcile to it. Upon reaching their level, they could manipulate all things in the world freely. The vicissitudes of life and the life and death of the world no longer meant anything to them. The only thing that they were concerned about, was to break through the Dao and to witness the true face of the great Dao.
However, whatever methods they had tried, it didn’t work out. Therefore, they discussed among themselves and decided to fight against each other to stimulate the strongest power to forcefully break through the shackles of the great Dao.
In that battle, the eight Dao Lords shattered the Hongmeng World. The power stimulated was greatly beyond imagination. In particular, the last strike, which had accumulated all the eight Dao Lords’ terrific powers, had broken a corner of the shackle.
However, they had to endure the severe backlash. It caused Riyue Dao Lord to have died tragically on the spot, only a wisp of his soul survived.
With a crack in the corner of the great Dao, they seemed to have seen the origin of the great Dao, peeping into the top of the Dao. Unfortunately, they couldn’t break through it regardless.
Seeing the crack was about to close down, the Infinite Dao Lord went crazy. He rushed in by burning himself, doing everything he could. In the end, his Daoist Body was annihilated, only a wisp of his soul went into the crack.
The rest were pleasantly surprised. They waited for the Infinite Dao Lord for a long period of time, but he didn’t return.
They originally assumed that the ability of the wisp of Infinite Dao Lord’s soul to pass through the crack meant he had sanctified the great Dao. Hence, they were expecting Infinite Dao Lord to send them some messages even if he didn’t lead them to sanctifying their great Dao.
Nevertheless, they didn’t receive anything at all. Therefore, they had a bad feeling.
They eventually used the residual energy of the Infinite Dao Lord as a guide, performed the supreme method of receiving and attracting, and brought back the wisp of Infinite Dao Lord’s soul.
To their surprise, the remnant of Infinite Dao Lord’s soul had been restored. Moreover, there was a Dao fluctuation in the essence that was unfamiliar to them, and it also carried the memory of the mortal world. As for the original memory of Infinite Dao Lord, it had completely gone.
They felt strange and analyzed for billions of years, but to no avail.
For the sake of the great Dao and to transcend the great Dao, they laid a shocking plan. They decided to accumulate all their powers into one prowess to forcefully break through the shackles of the great Dao.
After a long discussion, they finally hatched a plan to reincarnate the soul of the Infinite Dao Lord and secretly led him to take on the path of World Dao to integrate their powers.
Chaos Dao Lord and Heavenly Demon Dao Lord scattered the original Sea of Chaos and rebuilt it by fusing their own powers into it. They took billions of years’ time as the carrier to merge their powers together.
Linglong Dao Lord separated out a consciousness to be reincarnated to accompany Infinite Dao Lord. Through Yin-Yang Technique, she fused her essence into Infinite Dao Lord little by little.
World Dao Lord evolved a seed of the Chaotic World Tree and let it recognize the reincarnated body of Infinite Dao Lord as its master so that Infinite Dao Lord could imperceptibly adapt to his power.
Three Thousand Dao Lord used a special ability to build a system that supported Infinite Dao Lord’s growth and at the same time started a Supreme Pagoda to guide the reincarnated body of Infinite Dao Lord.
Monarch Dao Lord evolved into a Human Path Record with his personal fruit of Dao to guide Infinite Dao Lord’s growth.
“I’m the Infinite Dao Lord?” Jiang Ming felt it was unbelievable.
“Yes, you are the Infinite Dao Lord!” A familiar voice rang out, and Jiang Ming saw his junior sister Linglong came to him along with her nine clones behind her.
Behind them was a massive figure, which was extremely horrifying and could repress the Chaos. Jiang Ming knew instantly that the figure was the true body of Linglong, the Dharma Body of Linglong Dao Lord.
“Junior sister!” Jiang Ming looked sophisticated. “Or you’re the Linglong Dao Lord?”
“Of course I’m your junior sister!” Linglong’s indifferent look was suddenly replaced by a grin. Following that, she went to Jiang Ming and cuddled on his chest. “In the past, we have been together for a long time, and now we can be considered to have achieved a positive result. In fact, I’ve just absorbed the memory of the past.”
“Shall I address you as my master?” Another voice rang out, and an extremely enormous tree came over.
It was a World Tree. At the front was a smaller tree, but it could be measured in light years. Behind it was an even larger World Tree.
The little World Tree converged its light and turned into a young man with a playful look on his face.
“Brother Jiang, can you still remember me?” This voice was a voice that Jiang Ming was extremely familiar with. It belonged to Jun Sanqian, the avatar of Three Thousand Dao Lord.
“I have never thought that we can meet again after such a long period of time!” A voice came from within Jiang Ming, and the Human Path Record flew out. A figure walked out of the Human Path Record and turned into an arrogant man, radiating the aura of the supreme and noble. “I’m the Monarch Dao Lord. Fellow Daoist Infinite, I didn’t peek into your privacy, I had been slumbering in this Record all these while.”
What else could Jiang Ming say? He couldn’t say anything other than smiling wryly. After Jiang Ming had absorbed the memory of his past, he didn’t feel uncomfortable at all.
Jiang Ming remained as who he was. It was just that he had memories about his past.
